metadata.name: RecipeGraph-10K — dataset de receitas para PageRank + busca textual
metadata.description: Amostra aleatória de 10.000 receitas (seed=42) extraída do split de teste do RecipeNLG (espelho Zappandy/recipe_nlg no Hugging Face), enriquecida com grafo de similaridade por ingredientes (Jaccard sobre entidades NER) e PageRank pré-calculado (d=0.85, power iteration).

source_dataset.name: RecipeNLG
source_dataset.paper: Biéń et al., 'RecipeNLG: A Cooking Recipes Dataset for Semi-Structured Text Generation', INLG 2020

graph.edge_construction: top-5 vizinhos por Jaccard entre conjuntos NER de ingredientes (via índice invertido); peso = Jaccard

recipes.title: Grandpa'S Surprise Pie
ingredients: 1/2 tsp. each: salt, cinnamon and ginger
directions: Combine pumpkin, sugar, salt and spices in saucepan.
Heat thoroughly, stirring while heating.
Chill well.
Combine softened ice cream and chilled pumpkin mixture.
Spoon into pie crust. Freeze firm.
Preparation time:
20 to 30 minutes.
Must be frozen.
Makes 1 (9-inch) pie.
recipes.text: Grandpa'S Surprise Pie. Combine pumpkin, sugar, salt and spices in saucepan. Heat thoroughly, stirring while heating. Chill well. Combine softened ice cream and chilled pumpkin mixture. Spoon into pie crust. Freeze firm. Preparation time: 20 to 30 minutes. Must be frozen. Makes 1 (9-inch) pie.

recipes.title: "No Peek" Chicken Rice
directions: Coat pieces of chicken with flour and paprika.
Put out single pan with a little oil.
Cover with foil and bake 1 1/2 hours at 350°.
Take cover off a little to brown.
recipes.text: "No Peek" Chicken Rice. Coat pieces of chicken with flour and paprika. Put out single pan with a little oil. Cover with foil and bake 1 1/2 hours at 350°. Take cover off a little to brown.

recipes.title: Mexican Salad
directions: Combine cottage cheese and cream cheese.
recipes.text: Mexican Salad. Combine cottage cheese and cream cheese.

recipes.title: Mammy'S Macaroni And Cheese
ingredients: 1/2 (16 oz.) box small elbow macaroni, cooked according to directions, set aside to drain
directions: Use 2 to 3 quart casserole dish.
Layer with thin layer of macaroni, cheese, butter, salt and pepper.
Continue to layer until full (about 3 layers).
Mix together milk and eggs.
Pour over macaroni mixture, about 1/4-inch from top.
Melt butter and crumble in crackers mix.
Spread over top and cook in 425° oven approximately 1/2 hour or until milk is no longer runny and crackers browned.
recipes.text: Mammy'S Macaroni And Cheese. Use 2 to 3 quart casserole dish. Layer with thin layer of macaroni, cheese, butter, salt and pepper. Continue to layer until full (about 3 layers). Mix together milk and eggs. Pour over macaroni mixture, about 1/4-inch from top. Melt butter and crumble in crackers mix. Spread over top and cook in 425° oven approximately 1/2 hour or until milk is no longer runny and crackers browned.

recipes.title: Grandma'S Oatmeal Bread
directions: Pour 2 cups boiling water over first 5 ingredients and stir. Cool until lukewarm.
Dissolve 1 tablespoon dry yeast in 1/2 cup warm water.
Add to batter:
add flour until thick enough (about 5 cups).
Place in greased bowl.
Cover with towel.
Let rise until double in bulk.
Punch down and let rise again in loaf pans.
Bake at 350° about 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Grandma'S Oatmeal Bread. Pour 2 cups boiling water over first 5 ingredients and stir. Cool until lukewarm. Dissolve 1 tablespoon dry yeast in 1/2 cup warm water. Add to batter: add flour until thick enough (about 5 cups). Place in greased bowl. Cover with towel. Let rise until double in bulk. Punch down and let rise again in loaf pans. Bake at 350° about 30 minutes.

recipes.title: B~B~Q Sauce
directions: Simmer 15 to 20 minutes. Makes 1 qt.
recipes.text: B~B~Q Sauce. Simmer 15 to 20 minutes. Makes 1 qt.

recipes.title: Chicken Vegetable Soup
directions: Cook chicken and cut into bite size pieces.
Dice potatoes, carrots, squash and onions; cook until tender.
Mix with chicken broth, chicken, salt and pepper.
Add enough water to make right consistency.
Simmer 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Chicken Vegetable Soup. Cook chicken and cut into bite size pieces. Dice potatoes, carrots, squash and onions; cook until tender. Mix with chicken broth, chicken, salt and pepper. Add enough water to make right consistency. Simmer 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Spiced Tea
ingredients: 1 c. firmly packed light brown sugar
directions: In a large saucepan, combine water, sugar, cinnamon and cloves; bring to a boil.
Reduce heat and simmer, uncovered, for 10 minutes.
Remove from heat; remove spices.
In a large bowl, pour mixture over the tea bags and let steep for 5 to 10 minutes. Remove tea bags.
Add juices.
Serve warm or cold.
recipes.text: Spiced Tea. In a large saucepan, combine water, sugar, cinnamon and cloves; bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer, uncovered, for 10 minutes. Remove from heat; remove spices. In a large bowl, pour mixture over the tea bags and let steep for 5 to 10 minutes. Remove tea bags. Add juices. Serve warm or cold.

recipes.title: Caramel Pralines(Choudrant, Louisiana)
ingredients: 1 c. heavy cream or undiluted evaporated milk
directions: Caramelize 1 cup sugar in heavy iron skillet.
Cook over very low heat until sugar turns to syrup.
While sugar is melting, place other 2 cups of sugar, milk, butter and salt in heavy saucepan.
Bring to boiling point.
Very slowly pour syrup from skillet into other ingredients, stirring constantly.
Be sure to turn heat to low before starting the pouring.
Cook until good firm ball stage (drop a bit of mixture into cool water to test firmness).
Cool slightly.
Add vanilla and pecan halves.
Stir until mixture loses gloss.
Drop by tablespoon onto wax paper.
recipes.text: Caramel Pralines(Choudrant, Louisiana). Caramelize 1 cup sugar in heavy iron skillet. Cook over very low heat until sugar turns to syrup. While sugar is melting, place other 2 cups of sugar, milk, butter and salt in heavy saucepan. Bring to boiling point. Very slowly pour syrup from skillet into other ingredients, stirring constantly. Be sure to turn heat to low before starting the pouring. Cook until good firm ball stage (drop a bit of mixture into cool water to test firmness). Cool slightly. Add vanilla and pecan halves. Stir until mixture loses gloss. Drop by tablespoon onto wax paper.

recipes.title: Quick And Good Casserole
ingredients: cheese (American or Cheddar work well with this), sliced or shredded
directions: Brown ground beef and onions.
Drain.
Stir in seasonings.
Add tomatoes, mushroom soup and rice.
Mix well.
Simmer 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Top with cheese.
Replace top and simmer 2 to 3 minutes or until cheese melts.
recipes.text: Quick And Good Casserole. Brown ground beef and onions. Drain. Stir in seasonings. Add tomatoes, mushroom soup and rice. Mix well. Simmer 5 minutes, stirring occasionally. Top with cheese. Replace top and simmer 2 to 3 minutes or until cheese melts.

recipes.title: Ramaki
directions: Wrap bacon slices around water chestnuts (cut bacon slice in half first); secure with toothpicks.
Place in baking pan.
Pour barbecue sauce over wrapped water chestnuts.
Bake at 450° until bacon is done.
recipes.text: Ramaki. Wrap bacon slices around water chestnuts (cut bacon slice in half first); secure with toothpicks. Place in baking pan. Pour barbecue sauce over wrapped water chestnuts. Bake at 450° until bacon is done.

recipes.title: Potato Pancakes
directions: Combine all ingredients, except the potatoes, in a blender. Blend at high for 2 to 3 seconds.
Gradually, while blending, add the potatoes.
Blend for 45 seconds.
Cook for 3 to 4 minutes on each side.
recipes.text: Potato Pancakes. Combine all ingredients, except the potatoes, in a blender. Blend at high for 2 to 3 seconds. Gradually, while blending, add the potatoes. Blend for 45 seconds. Cook for 3 to 4 minutes on each side.

recipes.title: Corn Bread
directions: Mix well corn meal and flour; add boiling water a little at a time.
Use a little warm water to make the batter just right.
Let set overnight or longer until sours a little.
Buttermilk will make it sour faster.
Once you are ready to bake, add salt, sugar, soda and baking powder.
Grease pan and bake until brown.
recipes.text: Corn Bread. Mix well corn meal and flour; add boiling water a little at a time. Use a little warm water to make the batter just right. Let set overnight or longer until sours a little. Buttermilk will make it sour faster. Once you are ready to bake, add salt, sugar, soda and baking powder. Grease pan and bake until brown.

recipes.title: Vegetable Pizza
ingredients: 2 c. shredded Mozzarella or Cheddar cheese
4 to 6 c. assorted chopped raw vegetables
directions: Unroll crescent rolls from cans.
Spread each whole sheet flat onto jelly roll pan.
Bake at 400° for 8 to 10 minutes or until golden brown.
Cool completely.
recipes.text: Vegetable Pizza. Unroll crescent rolls from cans. Spread each whole sheet flat onto jelly roll pan. Bake at 400° for 8 to 10 minutes or until golden brown. Cool completely.

recipes.title: Squash Dressing
ingredients: 3 c. cooked squash, cooked, drained and mashed
salt, pepper and sage to taste
directions: Mix all together and bake in casserole dish at 350° for 30 to 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Squash Dressing. Mix all together and bake in casserole dish at 350° for 30 to 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Oven Barbecued Steaks
directions: Cut steak into about 10 equal portions.
Brown in oil in skillet on both sides.
Place in roasting pan.
Saute onion in oil; add remaining ingredients.
Simmer together for about 5 minutes.
Pour over steaks.
Cover and bake in preheated 350° oven for 2 hours or until fork-tender.
Yield:
5 to 6 medium servings.
recipes.text: Oven Barbecued Steaks. Cut steak into about 10 equal portions. Brown in oil in skillet on both sides. Place in roasting pan. Saute onion in oil; add remaining ingredients. Simmer together for about 5 minutes. Pour over steaks. Cover and bake in preheated 350° oven for 2 hours or until fork-tender. Yield: 5 to 6 medium servings.

recipes.title: Roast Pork With Thyme & Mushroom Sauce
ingredients: 1 1/2 tsp. fresh thyme or 1/2 tsp. dried thyme
1 1/2 lb. new or red potatoes, quartered and cooked until almost tender
8 oz. baby carrots cooked until almost tender
directions: Mix together first 5 ingredients and brush on roast.
Place in roasting pan fat side up.
Bake in 350° oven for 1 to 2 hours, basting occasionally.
Near end of roasting, mix together potatoes, carrots, and onion.
Toss vegetables with olive oil, vinegar, and salt.	Roast in pan with pork roast last 10 to 20 minutes of cooking time.
recipes.text: Roast Pork With Thyme & Mushroom Sauce. Mix together first 5 ingredients and brush on roast. Place in roasting pan fat side up. Bake in 350° oven for 1 to 2 hours, basting occasionally. Near end of roasting, mix together potatoes, carrots, and onion. Toss vegetables with olive oil, vinegar, and salt.	Roast in pan with pork roast last 10 to 20 minutes of cooking time.

recipes.title: Strawberry Chantilly
directions: Mix flour, brown sugar and butter until crumbly.
Stir in walnuts.
Place in baking pan.
Bake at 300° for 20 minutes, stirring every 5 minutes.
Place 2/3 of the mixture in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish.
Place egg whites, sugar, strawberries and lemon juice in a large, deep bowl.
Whip with an electric mixer. Whip the cream until stiff.
Fold into strawberry mixture.
Spread over crumb mixture in baking dish.
Sprinkle with remaining crumb mixture.
Freeze for 6 hours or overnight.
recipes.text: Strawberry Chantilly. Mix flour, brown sugar and butter until crumbly. Stir in walnuts. Place in baking pan. Bake at 300° for 20 minutes, stirring every 5 minutes. Place 2/3 of the mixture in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Place egg whites, sugar, strawberries and lemon juice in a large, deep bowl. Whip with an electric mixer. Whip the cream until stiff. Fold into strawberry mixture. Spread over crumb mixture in baking dish. Sprinkle with remaining crumb mixture. Freeze for 6 hours or overnight.

ingredients: 3 c. or more cooked, diced chicken
directions: Place

recipes.title: Flavorful Baked Beans
directions: Empty 1 can beans into 1 1/2-quart casserole. Combine brown sugar and mustard; sprinkle 1/2 over beans.
Top with the other can of beans and sprinkle with remaining brown sugar mixture, chopped bacon and catsup.
Bake, uncovered, at 325° for 2 1/2 hours.
recipes.text: Flavorful Baked Beans. Empty 1 can beans into 1 1/2-quart casserole. Combine brown sugar and mustard; sprinkle 1/2 over beans. Top with the other can of beans and sprinkle with remaining brown sugar mixture, chopped bacon and catsup. Bake, uncovered, at 325° for 2 1/2 hours.

recipes.title: Caramel Apple Oat Squares
directions: Preheat oven to 350°.
Combine flour, oats, sugar, baking soda and salt.
Cut in margarine or butter until crumbly, reserving 1 1/2 cups crumb mixture.
Press remaining on bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan.
Bake 15 minutes.
Add nuts to reserved crumb mixture.
recipes.text: Caramel Apple Oat Squares. Preheat oven to 350°. Combine flour, oats, sugar, baking soda and salt. Cut in margarine or butter until crumbly, reserving 1 1/2 cups crumb mixture. Press remaining on bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake 15 minutes. Add nuts to reserved crumb mixture.

recipes.title: Corn Bread
directions: Sift cornmeal and flour together.
Mix in buttermilk; add egg. Melt your oil unless Crisco oil is used.
Let your oil heat in pan.
Mix into your bread mixture.
Pour in pan and bake at 450° until done.
recipes.text: Corn Bread. Sift cornmeal and flour together. Mix in buttermilk; add egg. Melt your oil unless Crisco oil is used. Let your oil heat in pan. Mix into your bread mixture. Pour in pan and bake at 450° until done.

recipes.title: Chocolate Cookie Pie
directions: Beat egg whites until frothy.
Add salt, baking powder and sugar and beat until stiff.
Fold in cookies and nuts.
Pour into greased pie plate.
Bake at 325° for 30 minutes.
Serve with Cool Whip or ice cream.
recipes.text: Chocolate Cookie Pie. Beat egg whites until frothy. Add salt, baking powder and sugar and beat until stiff. Fold in cookies and nuts. Pour into greased pie plate. Bake at 325° for 30 minutes. Serve with Cool Whip or ice cream.

recipes.title: Zero-Calorie Salad Dressing
directions: Shake well; pour over salad.
Can be stored in refrigerator several weeks.
Yield: 1/2 cup.
recipes.text: Zero-Calorie Salad Dressing. Shake well; pour over salad. Can be stored in refrigerator several weeks. Yield: 1/2 cup.

recipes.title: Beef And Bean Chimichangas
directions: Brown ground beef in medium skillet over medium-high heat. Drain.
Remove beef from skillet; set aside.
Place 2 tablespoons oil in skillet.
Add onion and garlic.
Saute over medium heat until onion is tender.
Stir in ground beef, tomatoes, salsa, chili powder, coriander, thyme, salt, cayenne and cumin.
Cook over medium-low heat, stirring occasionally, 10 to 15 minutes, or until mixture is thickened.
Remove from heat.
Stir in refried beans.
Heat 2 inches oil in deep fryer or large saucepan to 375° (a wok works well).
recipes.text: Beef And Bean Chimichangas. Brown ground beef in medium skillet over medium-high heat. Drain. Remove beef from skillet; set aside. Place 2 tablespoons oil in skillet. Add onion and garlic. Saute over medium heat until onion is tender. Stir in ground beef, tomatoes, salsa, chili powder, coriander, thyme, salt, cayenne and cumin. Cook over medium-low heat, stirring occasionally, 10 to 15 minutes, or until mixture is thickened. Remove from heat. Stir in refried beans. Heat 2 inches oil in deep fryer or large saucepan to 375° (a wok works well).

recipes.title: Three Bean Salad
directions: Combine sugar, oil, vinegar and salt.
Heat to dissolve sugar. Stir in all beans, onion and pepper.
Marinate in refrigerator overnight.
recipes.text: Three Bean Salad. Combine sugar, oil, vinegar and salt. Heat to dissolve sugar. Stir in all beans, onion and pepper. Marinate in refrigerator overnight.

recipes.title: Chocolate Covered Cherries
directions: Drain maraschino cherries.
Make fondant by mixing thoroughly the softened margarine, Karo and powdered sugar.
Cover each cherry with about 1 teaspoon fondant.
Put on cookie sheet.
Cool fondant balls in freezer, but do not let the cherries freeze.
In double boiler, melt together the paraffin, chocolate chips and Baker's chocolate.
Keep warm.
Remove cherries from freezer and dip into chocolate sauce.
Put on wax paper to harden.
recipes.text: Chocolate Covered Cherries. Drain maraschino cherries. Make fondant by mixing thoroughly the softened margarine, Karo and powdered sugar. Cover each cherry with about 1 teaspoon fondant. Put on cookie sheet. Cool fondant balls in freezer, but do not let the cherries freeze. In double boiler, melt together the paraffin, chocolate chips and Baker's chocolate. Keep warm. Remove cherries from freezer and dip into chocolate sauce. Put on wax paper to harden.

recipes.title: Sweet Potato Casserole
directions: Mash potatoes and mix ingredients well.
recipes.text: Sweet Potato Casserole. Mash potatoes and mix ingredients well.

recipes.title: Country-Style Scalloped Corn
directions: Melt butter and beat eggs.
Drain the whole kernel corn. Combine all the ingredients together, adding the muffin mix last. Pour mixture into a greased 7 x 11-inch baking dish.
Bake at 375° for 35 to 40 minutes or until lightly browned.
Makes 10 servings.
Prep time:
10 minutes.
recipes.text: Country-Style Scalloped Corn. Melt butter and beat eggs. Drain the whole kernel corn. Combine all the ingredients together, adding the muffin mix last. Pour mixture into a greased 7 x 11-inch baking dish. Bake at 375° for 35 to 40 minutes or until lightly browned. Makes 10 servings. Prep time: 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Prune Cake
ingredients: 1 tsp. each: vanilla, soda, salt, nutmeg, allspice and cinnamon
directions: Sift dry ingredients together.
Add Wesson oil, buttermilk and eggs.
Mix well, then add prunes and nuts.
Mix well.
Pour in two 8-inch round pans or 1 long pan, 9 x 13-inches.
Bake 30 to 40 minutes.
recipes.text: Prune Cake. Sift dry ingredients together. Add Wesson oil, buttermilk and eggs. Mix well, then add prunes and nuts. Mix well. Pour in two 8-inch round pans or 1 long pan, 9 x 13-inches. Bake 30 to 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Cheese Grits
ingredients: 1 c. Velveeta cheese, cut into small pieces
directions: In 2-quart saucepan, heat water to boiling.
Stir grits, salt and pepper into boiling water.
Cook, stirring until thickened and bubbly.
Cover and cook over low heat 5 minutes.
recipes.text: Cheese Grits. In 2-quart saucepan, heat water to boiling. Stir grits, salt and pepper into boiling water. Cook, stirring until thickened and bubbly. Cover and cook over low heat 5 minutes.

recipes.title: Mexican Bean Dip
ingredients: diced green onions (your choice how much)
directions: Mix beans and taco seasoning.
Layer in bottom of dish.
Peel and seed avocado, then mash it.
Blend in lemon juice and sour cream until smooth.
Layer on top of bean mixture, then a layer each of the remaining ingredients in order as listed.
recipes.text: Mexican Bean Dip. Mix beans and taco seasoning. Layer in bottom of dish. Peel and seed avocado, then mash it. Blend in lemon juice and sour cream until smooth. Layer on top of bean mixture, then a layer each of the remaining ingredients in order as listed.

recipes.title: Beef Stew With Confetti Dumplings
directions: Brown onions and mushrooms in oil; set aside.
In a large stew pot, brown beef in small amount of oil.
Add the 2 cans of beef broth and seasonings.
Cover and simmer 1 1/2 hours.
Mix flour and water and add to stew to thicken.
Add onions, mushrooms and peas.
recipes.text: Beef Stew With Confetti Dumplings. Brown onions and mushrooms in oil; set aside. In a large stew pot, brown beef in small amount of oil. Add the 2 cans of beef broth and seasonings. Cover and simmer 1 1/2 hours. Mix flour and water and add to stew to thicken. Add onions, mushrooms and peas.

recipes.title: Dirt Pie
directions: Mix the pudding and milk until it just starts to thicken.
Then add the cream cheese by chunks.
Keep blending with mixer until smooth.
The mixture will still be a little lumpy which is fine.
recipes.text: Dirt Pie. Mix the pudding and milk until it just starts to thicken. Then add the cream cheese by chunks. Keep blending with mixer until smooth. The mixture will still be a little lumpy which is fine.

recipes.title: Zesty Chicken
ingredients: 2 chicken breasts or 2 to 4 pork chops
directions: If using chicken, skin it.
Mix ingredients together.
Pour over the meat and bake at 350° until done.
recipes.text: Zesty Chicken. If using chicken, skin it. Mix ingredients together. Pour over the meat and bake at 350° until done.

recipes.title: Cherry Cheese Dessert
directions: Press the first 4 ingredients into bottom of well-greased 12 x 8 x 2-inch pan.
Bake 12 to 15 minutes at 375°.
Add sugar to cream cheese.
Add Cool Whip.
Spread over crust.
Spread pie filling over cream cheese.
Refrigerate.
recipes.text: Cherry Cheese Dessert. Press the first 4 ingredients into bottom of well-greased 12 x 8 x 2-inch pan. Bake 12 to 15 minutes at 375°. Add sugar to cream cheese. Add Cool Whip. Spread over crust. Spread pie filling over cream cheese. Refrigerate.

recipes.title: Cauliflower With Herb Butter
ingredients: 1 Tbsp. chopped parsley or 1 1/2 tsp. dried parsley
directions: Steam flowerets over boiling water for 10 minutes; arrange in serving dish and sprinkle with lemon juice.
Melt butter and stir in parsley, salt, basil and garlic.
Pour herb butter over all. Serves 6.
recipes.text: Cauliflower With Herb Butter. Steam flowerets over boiling water for 10 minutes; arrange in serving dish and sprinkle with lemon juice. Melt butter and stir in parsley, salt, basil and garlic. Pour herb butter over all. Serves 6.

recipes.title: Chocolate Fudge
directions: Cook Jell-O pudding, sugar and milk until soft ball stage or exactly 1 minute after boiling starts.
Remove from burner, set pan into cold water in sink.
Stir butter in until thick, but thin enough to pour into buttered platter.
Cool.
Cut into squares.
recipes.text: Chocolate Fudge. Cook Jell-O pudding, sugar and milk until soft ball stage or exactly 1 minute after boiling starts. Remove from burner, set pan into cold water in sink. Stir butter in until thick, but thin enough to pour into buttered platter. Cool. Cut into squares.

recipes.title: Freezer Pickles
directions: Mix cucumbers, onions and salt.
Let stand for 2 hours.
Drain off liquid.
Combine sugar and vinegar.
Bring to a boil until sugar is dissolved.
Add celery seed.
Put cucumbers and onions in plastic freezer containers; pour syrup on top.
Close tightly and freeze.
recipes.text: Freezer Pickles. Mix cucumbers, onions and salt. Let stand for 2 hours. Drain off liquid. Combine sugar and vinegar. Bring to a boil until sugar is dissolved. Add celery seed. Put cucumbers and onions in plastic freezer containers; pour syrup on top. Close tightly and freeze.

recipes.title: Tarralli
directions: Start with eggs; add butter, sugar, milk, vanilla and baking powder.
Slowly add enough flour to make firm soft dough.
Flour hands.
Roll into 1/2-inch rings.
Bake on greased cookie sheet for 15 minutes at 375°.
Different flavors can be used instead of vanilla.
recipes.text: Tarralli. Start with eggs; add butter, sugar, milk, vanilla and baking powder. Slowly add enough flour to make firm soft dough. Flour hands. Roll into 1/2-inch rings. Bake on greased cookie sheet for 15 minutes at 375°. Different flavors can be used instead of vanilla.

recipes.title: Southern Barbecue Chicken Sauce
directions: Mix all ingredients.
Makes enough for 2 to 2 1/2 pounds of chicken (3/4 cup sauce).
recipes.text: Southern Barbecue Chicken Sauce. Mix all ingredients. Makes enough for 2 to 2 1/2 pounds of chicken (3/4 cup sauce).

recipes.title: Washington State Apple Pie
ingredients: 6 c. sliced, peeled apples (5 to 6 medium)
directions: In a saucepan, combine apples, water and lemon juice; cook over medium-low heat just until the apples are tender.
Remove from the heat and cool (do not drain).
recipes.text: Washington State Apple Pie. In a saucepan, combine apples, water and lemon juice; cook over medium-low heat just until the apples are tender. Remove from the heat and cool (do not drain).

recipes.title: Popcorn Cake
directions: You will need a Bundt pan (buttered).
recipes.text: Popcorn Cake. You will need a Bundt pan (buttered).

recipes.title: Pudding Dessert
directions: Mix ingredient for crust.
Put into 9x13 inch pan.
Bake at 350° for 20 minutes. Cool.
recipes.text: Pudding Dessert. Mix ingredient for crust. Put into 9x13 inch pan. Bake at 350° for 20 minutes. Cool.

recipes.title: Salmon Loaf
directions: Grease loaf pan.
Mix all ingredients together.
Shape into loaf.
Bake at 375° for about 40 minutes.
Serves 6.
recipes.text: Salmon Loaf. Grease loaf pan. Mix all ingredients together. Shape into loaf. Bake at 375° for about 40 minutes. Serves 6.

recipes.title: Raspberry Angel Food Cake
directions: Mix sugar, flour and 1/2 tsp salt in a sauce pan, slowly add milk. Mix well. Stir often medium heat until mixture is thick and bubbly. Stir 2 Tbsp of the hot mixture into the egg yolks. Return all to hot mixture bring just to boiling. Stirring constantly, remove from heat and add vanilla. Cool. Slice cake in 3 layers. Fold
whip cream
into pudding and fill between layers. Top with raspberries just before serving.
recipes.text: Raspberry Angel Food Cake. Mix sugar, flour and 1/2 tsp salt in a sauce pan, slowly add milk. Mix well. Stir often medium heat until mixture is thick and bubbly. Stir 2 Tbsp of the hot mixture into the egg yolks. Return all to hot mixture bring just to boiling. Stirring constantly, remove from heat and add vanilla. Cool. Slice cake in 3 layers. Fold whip cream into pudding and fill between layers. Top with raspberries just before serving.

recipes.title: Brats My Way
ingredients: Brats (in natural casings, Johnsonville's are fine just use the plain ones)
directions: Pierce the casing on the Brats with a fork a couple of times on each side. Toss in a large pot, add all ingredients, make sure the beer covers everything and bring to a slow boil. Boil at least an hour if not longer. (I like Polish sausage too, and make lots, they are better the next day!)
recipes.text: Brats My Way. Pierce the casing on the Brats with a fork a couple of times on each side. Toss in a large pot, add all ingredients, make sure the beer covers everything and bring to a slow boil. Boil at least an hour if not longer. (I like Polish sausage too, and make lots, they are better the next day!)

recipes.title: Cream Of Broccoli Soup(Diet)
directions: Pour in pan 2 to 3 tablespoons sunflower oil.
Heat and stir-fry the celery and onion (cut up).
When tender, stir in the broccoli (only flowerets), not the stalks.
Stir until covered with oil. Add the water. Cover and boil. When boils, add the bouillon cubes and bouquet garni or other soup spices to taste. Cover and simmer until broccoli is just tender.
recipes.text: Cream Of Broccoli Soup(Diet). Pour in pan 2 to 3 tablespoons sunflower oil. Heat and stir-fry the celery and onion (cut up). When tender, stir in the broccoli (only flowerets), not the stalks. Stir until covered with oil. Add the water. Cover and boil. When boils, add the bouillon cubes and bouquet garni or other soup spices to taste. Cover and simmer until broccoli is just tender.

recipes.title: Apricot Salad
ingredients: 1 c. fruit juice from drained fruit
directions: Mix ingredients and let set.
recipes.text: Apricot Salad. Mix ingredients and let set.

recipes.title: Corn Macaroni Bake
ingredients: 1 pkg. or less salad macaroni (I like to keep cooked and drain a little liquid in casserole)
about 1/2 lb. American or Cheddar cheese
directions: Combine all ingredients.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour, stirring every 15 minutes.
recipes.text: Corn Macaroni Bake. Combine all ingredients. Bake at 350° for 1 hour, stirring every 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Corned Beef Stew
directions: Cut onion and brown in hot fat.
Add beans and tomatoes. Simmer 5 minutes.
Break beef into small chunks.
Add to mixture and cook 5 minutes more.
Season with salt and pepper.
Serves 4.
recipes.text: Corned Beef Stew. Cut onion and brown in hot fat. Add beans and tomatoes. Simmer 5 minutes. Break beef into small chunks. Add to mixture and cook 5 minutes more. Season with salt and pepper. Serves 4.

recipes.title: Jerry'S Artichoke Dip
directions: Start with enough mayonnaise to equal the desired quantity of dip.
Add ingredients to taste.
Mix and refrigerate for several hours before serving for best flavor.
Serve with hot or cold cooked artichokes.
recipes.text: Jerry'S Artichoke Dip. Start with enough mayonnaise to equal the desired quantity of dip. Add ingredients to taste. Mix and refrigerate for several hours before serving for best flavor. Serve with hot or cold cooked artichokes.

recipes.title: Chocolate Graham Cracker Bars
directions: Line a jelly roll pan with graham crackers. In a saucepan, bring margarine, butter and brown sugar to a boil. Boil 2 minutes. Pour over crackers. Sprinkle with finely chopped nuts. Bake 10 minutes at 350°. Remove from oven and immediately spread chocolate chips. Cool and break into small pieces.
recipes.text: Chocolate Graham Cracker Bars. Line a jelly roll pan with graham crackers. In a saucepan, bring margarine, butter and brown sugar to a boil. Boil 2 minutes. Pour over crackers. Sprinkle with finely chopped nuts. Bake 10 minutes at 350°. Remove from oven and immediately spread chocolate chips. Cool and break into small pieces.

recipes.title: Strawberry And Lemon Cream Mold
ingredients: 1 c. whipped topping or whipping cream
directions: Dissolve lemon gelatin in half of the boiling water; add half of the cold water and refrigerate.
Before the lemon gelatin sets, add whipping cream and sliced strawberries.
Dissolve the strawberry gelatin in the rest of the boiling water and add rest of the cold water.
When the lemon gelatin has set in mold, add strawberry gelatin.
Refrigerate overnight.
Garnish with sugared strawberries and grapes or rosettes of whipped cream.
recipes.text: Strawberry And Lemon Cream Mold. Dissolve lemon gelatin in half of the boiling water; add half of the cold water and refrigerate. Before the lemon gelatin sets, add whipping cream and sliced strawberries. Dissolve the strawberry gelatin in the rest of the boiling water and add rest of the cold water. When the lemon gelatin has set in mold, add strawberry gelatin. Refrigerate overnight. Garnish with sugared strawberries and grapes or rosettes of whipped cream.

recipes.title: Brazil-Nut Bread Pudding
directions: Cut buttered bread into finger-width pieces.
Arrange in layers in buttered baking dish, sprinkling each layer with Brazil nuts.
Beat eggs slightly, add sugar, salt, vanilla and milk.
Mix well and pour over bread.
Garnish top with Brazil nuts and bake in slow oven (325°) for 1 hour.
Serves 6.
recipes.text: Brazil-Nut Bread Pudding. Cut buttered bread into finger-width pieces. Arrange in layers in buttered baking dish, sprinkling each layer with Brazil nuts. Beat eggs slightly, add sugar, salt, vanilla and milk. Mix well and pour over bread. Garnish top with Brazil nuts and bake in slow oven (325°) for 1 hour. Serves 6.

recipes.title: Cranberry Mousse(Jello Salad)
directions: In a large bowl, dissolve gelatin in boiling water. Drain pineapple, setting the pineapple aside and adding juice to gelatin. Stir in cranberry sauce, lemon juice, peel, and nutmeg. Chill until mixture thickens. Fold in sour cream, reserved pineapple and pecans. Pour into glass serving bowl or an oiled 9-cup mold. Chill until set, at least 2 hours.
recipes.text: Cranberry Mousse(Jello Salad). In a large bowl, dissolve gelatin in boiling water. Drain pineapple, setting the pineapple aside and adding juice to gelatin. Stir in cranberry sauce, lemon juice, peel, and nutmeg. Chill until mixture thickens. Fold in sour cream, reserved pineapple and pecans. Pour into glass serving bowl or an oiled 9-cup mold. Chill until set, at least 2 hours.

recipes.title: Taco Soup
ingredients: 1 pkg. Hidden Valley Ranch dressing mix
directions: Can add onion, green chilies, Mexican tomatoes and chili beans.
recipes.text: Taco Soup. Can add onion, green chilies, Mexican tomatoes and chili beans.

recipes.title: Chicken, Broccoli And Rice Casserole
directions: In a large pot, boil chicken, onion and celery until the chicken is done.
Take out the chicken; allow it to cool while cooking rice in the water that you used to cook the chicken.
When the rice is done, add broccoli, the boned chopped chicken, cream of mushroom soup and cheese.
Top with cheese and put in warm oven until the cheese is melted and the broccoli is warm.
recipes.text: Chicken, Broccoli And Rice Casserole. In a large pot, boil chicken, onion and celery until the chicken is done. Take out the chicken; allow it to cool while cooking rice in the water that you used to cook the chicken. When the rice is done, add broccoli, the boned chopped chicken, cream of mushroom soup and cheese. Top with cheese and put in warm oven until the cheese is melted and the broccoli is warm.

recipes.title: Eggplant Appetizer
directions: Peel eggplant.
Cut into 1-inch cubes.
Heat oil and start cooking chopped celery, then add eggplant, green pepper, onion and garlic.
Cook until tender.
Add nutmeg, curry powder and oregano to taste.
Then add Worcestershire sauce, tomato paste, salt and pepper.
Serve hot or cold on crackers or bread.
recipes.text: Eggplant Appetizer. Peel eggplant. Cut into 1-inch cubes. Heat oil and start cooking chopped celery, then add eggplant, green pepper, onion and garlic. Cook until tender. Add nutmeg, curry powder and oregano to taste. Then add Worcestershire sauce, tomato paste, salt and pepper. Serve hot or cold on crackers or bread.

recipes.title: Buttermilk Pie
directions: Cream margarine.
Gradually add sugar, beating well.
Add flour and beat until smooth.
Add eggs; beat until combined.
Stir in buttermilk and vanilla.
Beat well.
Pour filling into pie crust.
Bake at 400° for 5 minutes.
Reduce oven temperature to 350° and bake an additional 45 minutes or until set.
recipes.text: Buttermilk Pie. Cream margarine. Gradually add sugar, beating well. Add flour and beat until smooth. Add eggs; beat until combined. Stir in buttermilk and vanilla. Beat well. Pour filling into pie crust. Bake at 400° for 5 minutes. Reduce oven temperature to 350° and bake an additional 45 minutes or until set.

recipes.title: Shante'S Goulash
directions: Cook and drain macaroni.
Fry hamburger with onions and green peppers; drain.
recipes.text: Shante'S Goulash. Cook and drain macaroni. Fry hamburger with onions and green peppers; drain.

recipes.title: Grilled Steak And Vegetable Salad
ingredients: 1 1/2 lb. beef flank steak, fat trimmed and scored
1 medium sweet onion, cut into small wedges
6 medium Italian plum tomatoes, cut into wedges
4 ears corn, cooked and cut into 1 1/2-inch pieces
directions: Grill steak over medium-hot coals to desired degree of doneness, about 20 minutes for medium, turning halfway through cooking time.
Slice steak, diagonally across grain, into scant 1/4-inch slices.
Combine sliced meat and vegetables in shallow serving bowl.
Pour dressing over and toss.
Serve immediately or refrigerate several hours.
Serve chilled.
Makes 6 servings.
recipes.text: Grilled Steak And Vegetable Salad. Grill steak over medium-hot coals to desired degree of doneness, about 20 minutes for medium, turning halfway through cooking time. Slice steak, diagonally across grain, into scant 1/4-inch slices. Combine sliced meat and vegetables in shallow serving bowl. Pour dressing over and toss. Serve immediately or refrigerate several hours. Serve chilled. Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Joyce'S Punch Ring
directions: Heat water and sugar together until syrupy. Add juices. Freeze
recipes.text: Joyce'S Punch Ring. Heat water and sugar together until syrupy. Add juices. Freeze

recipes.title: Meat Balls
directions: Mix the first 10 ingredients well and make into small balls. Arrange in baking dish.
recipes.text: Meat Balls. Mix the first 10 ingredients well and make into small balls. Arrange in baking dish.

recipes.title: Chocolate Orange Cake
directions: Heat oven to 350°.
Butter and flour a 9-inch square baking pan.
Combine flour, cocoa, soda, baking powder and salt.
Beat butter, sugar and zest until fluffy.
Beat in eggs and vanilla. Stir in half the flour mixture, then sour cream, then remaining flour.
Stir in chocolate chips.
Spread batter in pan.
Bake until a toothpick stuck in center comes out clean, 60 to 70 minutes.
Cool in pan 10 minutes; remove to rack and cool completely.
Sprinkle with confectioners sugar.
Makes 9 slices.
recipes.text: Chocolate Orange Cake. Heat oven to 350°. Butter and flour a 9-inch square baking pan. Combine flour, cocoa, soda, baking powder and salt. Beat butter, sugar and zest until fluffy. Beat in eggs and vanilla. Stir in half the flour mixture, then sour cream, then remaining flour. Stir in chocolate chips. Spread batter in pan. Bake until a toothpick stuck in center comes out clean, 60 to 70 minutes. Cool in pan 10 minutes; remove to rack and cool completely. Sprinkle with confectioners sugar. Makes 9 slices.

recipes.title: Chicken Roll-Ups(Old Recipe)
directions: Mix chicken with 1 1/4 cups cheese.
Put mixture in center of each roll and "roll up".
Lay rolls in 9 x 13-inch pans.
Heat soup, milk and 3/4 cup cheese until cheese melts.
Pour over rolls. Bake at 350° for about 1/2 hour.
recipes.text: Chicken Roll-Ups(Old Recipe). Mix chicken with 1 1/4 cups cheese. Put mixture in center of each roll and "roll up". Lay rolls in 9 x 13-inch pans. Heat soup, milk and 3/4 cup cheese until cheese melts. Pour over rolls. Bake at 350° for about 1/2 hour.

recipes.title: German Potato Pancakes
directions: Vary the amount of flour, depending upon whether you like a thick or thin batter.
Some add a little sugar to make the cakes browner.
recipes.text: German Potato Pancakes. Vary the amount of flour, depending upon whether you like a thick or thin batter. Some add a little sugar to make the cakes browner.

recipes.title: Buttermilk Chocolate Brownies
directions: Heat to boil water and butter.
Pour over dry ingredients. Blend well and add the eggs and buttermilk.
Beat well.
Bake for 20 minutes in a greased and floured rather large cookie sheet or large shallow cake pan.
recipes.text: Buttermilk Chocolate Brownies. Heat to boil water and butter. Pour over dry ingredients. Blend well and add the eggs and buttermilk. Beat well. Bake for 20 minutes in a greased and floured rather large cookie sheet or large shallow cake pan.

recipes.title: Spaghetti Casserole
directions: Cook spaghetti and drain with cold water as usual.
In large skillet melt 1/2 stick margarine.
Add 1 small onion and brown. Add hamburger, stir until brown.
Add salt.
Add tomatoes and puree.
Add spaghetti to mixture and mix well.
Cook on top of stove until it thickens.
Put into large Pyrex bowl and top it with cracker crumbs with a dash of margarine over it.
Bake in oven at 350° until crackers brown.
recipes.text: Spaghetti Casserole. Cook spaghetti and drain with cold water as usual. In large skillet melt 1/2 stick margarine. Add 1 small onion and brown. Add hamburger, stir until brown. Add salt. Add tomatoes and puree. Add spaghetti to mixture and mix well. Cook on top of stove until it thickens. Put into large Pyrex bowl and top it with cracker crumbs with a dash of margarine over it. Bake in oven at 350° until crackers brown.

recipes.title: Ham Loaf
directions: Combine
ham, pork, ground beef, cracker crumbs, pepper, eggs and milk.
Shape into 2 loaves and place in greased baking dish. Combine
brown
sugar,
mustard
and
vinegar; pour over loaves. Bake 1 hour at 350°.
recipes.text: Ham Loaf. Combine ham, pork, ground beef, cracker crumbs, pepper, eggs and milk. Shape into 2 loaves and place in greased baking dish. Combine brown sugar, mustard and vinegar; pour over loaves. Bake 1 hour at 350°.

recipes.title: Chess Pie
directions: Mix all ingredients well.
Pour in uncooked pie crust.
Cook at 300° for 35 to 40 minutes.
recipes.text: Chess Pie. Mix all ingredients well. Pour in uncooked pie crust. Cook at 300° for 35 to 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Ratatouille
ingredients: 2 c. each: sliced zucchini and diced eggplant
directions: Coarsely chop tomatoes (about 4 cups).
Set aside.
Heat oil in large saucepan.
Add onion and garlic.
Cook 3 to 4 minutes. Add zucchini, eggplant and green pepper.
Cook 2 to 3 minutes. Add 1/2 cup water, seasonings and tomatoes.
Bring to boil; reduce heat.
Simmer, uncovered, until vegetables are tender, about 15 minutes.
Serve over cooked rice.
recipes.text: Ratatouille. Coarsely chop tomatoes (about 4 cups). Set aside. Heat oil in large saucepan. Add onion and garlic. Cook 3 to 4 minutes. Add zucchini, eggplant and green pepper. Cook 2 to 3 minutes. Add 1/2 cup water, seasonings and tomatoes. Bring to boil; reduce heat. Simmer, uncovered, until vegetables are tender, about 15 minutes. Serve over cooked rice.

recipes.title: Crab-Stuffed Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 to 2 Tbsp. fine dry bread crumbs
directions: Melt 1 tablespoon butter in saute pan.
Saute mushroom caps, coating well with butter.
Combine remaining butter and the next 6 ingredients until blended.
Place mushrooms on rimmed baking sheet.
Evenly mound filling into each mushroom cavity, pressing lightly.
Sprinkle with pepper and cheese.
Broil about 6 inches from heat source for 5 to 8 minutes.
Serve immediately.
recipes.text: Crab-Stuffed Mushrooms. Melt 1 tablespoon butter in saute pan. Saute mushroom caps, coating well with butter. Combine remaining butter and the next 6 ingredients until blended. Place mushrooms on rimmed baking sheet. Evenly mound filling into each mushroom cavity, pressing lightly. Sprinkle with pepper and cheese. Broil about 6 inches from heat source for 5 to 8 minutes. Serve immediately.

recipes.title: Overnite Cookies
directions: Beat eggs until foamy.
Beat sugar in a little at a time. Beat until it stands in peaks. Add vanilla, salt, nuts and chips. Put foil on pan.
Put cookie with teaspoon on the foil-lined pan. Heat oven to 350°.
Put cookies in oven and turn off heat.
Leave in overnight.
Makes 30 minutes.
Very good and pretty.
recipes.text: Overnite Cookies. Beat eggs until foamy. Beat sugar in a little at a time. Beat until it stands in peaks. Add vanilla, salt, nuts and chips. Put foil on pan. Put cookie with teaspoon on the foil-lined pan. Heat oven to 350°. Put cookies in oven and turn off heat. Leave in overnight. Makes 30 minutes. Very good and pretty.

recipes.title: Creamy Potluck Potatoes
directions: Cook potatoes in boiling water for 10 to 12 minutes or until tender.
Drain.
Rinse with cold water; drain again.
In a large mixing bowl, stir together the soup, sour cream, cream cheese and butter.
Add 1/4 cup of Cheddar cheese, 3 tablespoons of green onion, skim milk, parsley, garlic salt and pepper.
Stir mixture to combine.
Stir in potatoes.
Place in 2-quart shallow casserole dish.
Bake, uncovered, for 30 to 35 minutes in a 350° oven or until heated through.
Sprinkle with remaining cheese and bake until cheese melts.
Sprinkle with remaining green onion.
recipes.text: Creamy Potluck Potatoes. Cook potatoes in boiling water for 10 to 12 minutes or until tender. Drain. Rinse with cold water; drain again. In a large mixing bowl, stir together the soup, sour cream, cream cheese and butter. Add 1/4 cup of Cheddar cheese, 3 tablespoons of green onion, skim milk, parsley, garlic salt and pepper. Stir mixture to combine. Stir in potatoes. Place in 2-quart shallow casserole dish. Bake, uncovered, for 30 to 35 minutes in a 350° oven or until heated through. Sprinkle with remaining cheese and bake until cheese melts. Sprinkle with remaining green onion.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Cookies
directions: Cream shortening and sugar.
Add eggs, peanut butter and vanilla.
Blend in flour, baking powder, salt and peanuts.
Roll in small balls and place on greased cookie sheet.
Flatten with fork tines.
Bake 10 to 15 minutes at 375°.
recipes.text: Peanut Butter Cookies. Cream shortening and sugar. Add eggs, peanut butter and vanilla. Blend in flour, baking powder, salt and peanuts. Roll in small balls and place on greased cookie sheet. Flatten with fork tines. Bake 10 to 15 minutes at 375°.

recipes.title: Peach Blueberry Cobbler
directions: Place fruit in 9 x 13-inch casserole and sprinkle with 2 tablespoons sugar. Mix together flour, baking powder, egg and 1/2 cup sugar. Sprinkle over fruit in dish. Drizzle with melted margarine, then sprinkle with cinnamon-sugar. Bake at 375°, uncovered, for 15 minutes, then increase oven to 400° and bake an additional 15 minutes.
recipes.text: Peach Blueberry Cobbler. Place fruit in 9 x 13-inch casserole and sprinkle with 2 tablespoons sugar. Mix together flour, baking powder, egg and 1/2 cup sugar. Sprinkle over fruit in dish. Drizzle with melted margarine, then sprinkle with cinnamon-sugar. Bake at 375°, uncovered, for 15 minutes, then increase oven to 400° and bake an additional 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Broccoli Salad
directions: Chop up and mix together cauliflower, broccoli, grated cheese, peas, bacon bits and sunflower seeds.
In separate bowl, mix Miracle Whip, sour cream, garlic powder and sugar.
Stir all together.
Store in refrigerator covered.
recipes.text: Broccoli Salad. Chop up and mix together cauliflower, broccoli, grated cheese, peas, bacon bits and sunflower seeds. In separate bowl, mix Miracle Whip, sour cream, garlic powder and sugar. Stir all together. Store in refrigerator covered.

recipes.title: Mostaccioli Salad
ingredients: 1 (16 oz.) pkg. mostaccioli pasta, cooked al dente
2 green peppers, diced (red pepper or broccoli can also be used)
directions: Place salad ingredients in a large bowl and toss.
recipes.text: Mostaccioli Salad. Place salad ingredients in a large bowl and toss.

recipes.title: Date Pecan Balls
directions: Cream butter and sugar.
Add vanilla and mix.
Blend in pecans and dates.
Roll teaspoonful of dough into balls.
Refrigerate balls for 1 to 2 hours.
Bake at 350° on greased cookie sheet 20 minutes.
Remove from oven and roll balls in powdered sugar. Sprinkle again with powdered sugar after cookies have cooled.
recipes.text: Date Pecan Balls. Cream butter and sugar. Add vanilla and mix. Blend in pecans and dates. Roll teaspoonful of dough into balls. Refrigerate balls for 1 to 2 hours. Bake at 350° on greased cookie sheet 20 minutes. Remove from oven and roll balls in powdered sugar. Sprinkle again with powdered sugar after cookies have cooled.

recipes.title: Christmas Pickles
ingredients: 1 Tbsp. prepared horseradish or 1 tsp. powdered horseradish
directions: Drain pickles and discard liquid.
Slice each pickle lengthwise into quarters.
As you repack the pickle strips into the jar, add remaining ingredients, alternating with pickles.
recipes.text: Christmas Pickles. Drain pickles and discard liquid. Slice each pickle lengthwise into quarters. As you repack the pickle strips into the jar, add remaining ingredients, alternating with pickles.

recipes.title: Broiled Lamb Chops
directions: In a large skillet place lamb chops and mix in all ingredients.
Cook on medium-high for 1 hour, then let simmer for 30 minutes or until desired tenderness.
recipes.text: Broiled Lamb Chops. In a large skillet place lamb chops and mix in all ingredients. Cook on medium-high for 1 hour, then let simmer for 30 minutes or until desired tenderness.

recipes.title: Death By Chocolate
ingredients: 2 lg. pkg. chocolate instant pudding mix
directions: Make brownie mix according to package directions. Stir in chocolate chips. Bake according to directions. Pour coffee over cooled brownies. Mix pudding. Crumble half the brownies into the bottom of a large glass bowl. Pour half the pudding on top. Crumble three candy bars on top of pudding and cover with half the whipped topping. Repeat layers.
recipes.text: Death By Chocolate. Make brownie mix according to package directions. Stir in chocolate chips. Bake according to directions. Pour coffee over cooled brownies. Mix pudding. Crumble half the brownies into the bottom of a large glass bowl. Pour half the pudding on top. Crumble three candy bars on top of pudding and cover with half the whipped topping. Repeat layers.

recipes.title: Crazy Cupcakes
directions: Add ingredients in order; beat 3 minutes in blender.
Bake in greased muffin tins at 325° for 30 minutes.
Top with favorite frosting.
Yields 14 cupcakes.
recipes.text: Crazy Cupcakes. Add ingredients in order; beat 3 minutes in blender. Bake in greased muffin tins at 325° for 30 minutes. Top with favorite frosting. Yields 14 cupcakes.

recipes.title: Zucchini Bread
directions: Beat eggs, sugar and oil.
Add vanilla; stir in zucchini. Sift flour, salt, cinnamon, soda and baking powder.
Stir into first mixture.
Fold in nuts.
Pour into 2 well-greased 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pans.
Bake at 325° for 60 to 75 minutes.
recipes.text: Zucchini Bread. Beat eggs, sugar and oil. Add vanilla; stir in zucchini. Sift flour, salt, cinnamon, soda and baking powder. Stir into first mixture. Fold in nuts. Pour into 2 well-greased 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pans. Bake at 325° for 60 to 75 minutes.

recipes.title: Corned Beef Ball
directions: Set out cream cheese until room temperature.
Mix all ingredients together.
Form into a ball.
Garnish with parsley.
recipes.text: Corned Beef Ball. Set out cream cheese until room temperature. Mix all ingredients together. Form into a ball. Garnish with parsley.

recipes.title: Country Vanilla Ice Cream
directions: Add sugar gradually to beaten eggs, beating well after each addition.
When mixture becomes very stiff, add remaining ingredients and mix thoroughly.
Pour into 1 gallon freezer and freeze.
recipes.text: Country Vanilla Ice Cream. Add sugar gradually to beaten eggs, beating well after each addition. When mixture becomes very stiff, add remaining ingredients and mix thoroughly. Pour into 1 gallon freezer and freeze.

recipes.title: Cheese Surprise Appetizer
ingredients: 1 small jar green, pimento stuffed olives
directions: Mix cheese, butter and flour to form dough.
Shape into small balls about 1 inch in diameter.
Flatten ball with hands; place one olive in center, wrap dough around it, sealing edges completely.
Freeze until just before ready to serve.
(These must be frozen.)
recipes.text: Cheese Surprise Appetizer. Mix cheese, butter and flour to form dough. Shape into small balls about 1 inch in diameter. Flatten ball with hands; place one olive in center, wrap dough around it, sealing edges completely. Freeze until just before ready to serve. (These must be frozen.)

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Hash
directions: Blend chocolate and peanut butter. Add other ingredients.
Mix and pour in a 13 x 9-inch pan. Slice when set.
recipes.text: Peanut Butter Hash. Blend chocolate and peanut butter. Add other ingredients. Mix and pour in a 13 x 9-inch pan. Slice when set.

recipes.title: Ranchero Raised Biscuits
directions: Combine raisins, milk, sugar, salt, shortening and cornmeal in bowl.
Dissolve yeast in warm water and add to mixture.
Add egg and flour.
Blend well.
Drop by spoonfuls into a well-greased 11-inch oblong baking pan.
Let rise 45 minutes or until doubled in size.
Bake in a preheated oven at 400° for about 20 minutes. Serve hot with butter or jam.
recipes.text: Ranchero Raised Biscuits. Combine raisins, milk, sugar, salt, shortening and cornmeal in bowl. Dissolve yeast in warm water and add to mixture. Add egg and flour. Blend well. Drop by spoonfuls into a well-greased 11-inch oblong baking pan. Let rise 45 minutes or until doubled in size. Bake in a preheated oven at 400° for about 20 minutes. Serve hot with butter or jam.

recipes.title: Strawberry Bread
directions: Heat oven to 350°.
Grease bottoms only of 1 loaf pan.
Combine flour, soda and sugar in medium mixing bowl.
In another bowl, lightly beat eggs.
Add oil and almond extract to eggs.
Add egg mixture to flour mixture and stir well.
Fold berries into batter. Pour into prepared pan.
Bake for 45 to 55 minutes, until wooden pick inserted in center comes out clean.
Let cool for 5 minutes before removing from pan.
recipes.text: Strawberry Bread. Heat oven to 350°. Grease bottoms only of 1 loaf pan. Combine flour, soda and sugar in medium mixing bowl. In another bowl, lightly beat eggs. Add oil and almond extract to eggs. Add egg mixture to flour mixture and stir well. Fold berries into batter. Pour into prepared pan. Bake for 45 to 55 minutes, until wooden pick inserted in center comes out clean. Let cool for 5 minutes before removing from pan.

recipes.title: Fruit Punch
directions: Dilute lemonade by half.
Mix all ingredients together.
Add ginger ale just before serving.
recipes.text: Fruit Punch. Dilute lemonade by half. Mix all ingredients together. Add ginger ale just before serving.

recipes.title: Spicy Hot Beans
ingredients: 1 lb. smoked sausage, cut into 1/2-inch slices
directions: Sort and wash beans.
Put in large Dutch oven and cover with water.
Add 1/2 teaspoon baking soda.
Bring to a boil and boil for 5 minutes.
Drain.
Return to Dutch oven, adding about 6 cups of water.
recipes.text: Spicy Hot Beans. Sort and wash beans. Put in large Dutch oven and cover with water. Add 1/2 teaspoon baking soda. Bring to a boil and boil for 5 minutes. Drain. Return to Dutch oven, adding about 6 cups of water.

recipes.title: German Chocolate Cake
directions: Combine chocolate and water; bring to a boil.
Stir until chocolate melts.
Cool; stir in vanilla and set aside.
Cream butter; gradually add sugar, beating well at medium speed.
Add egg yolks, one at a time, beating well after each addition.
Add chocolate mixture; beat until blended.
Combine flour, soda and salt.
Add to creamed mixture.
Beat egg whites until stiff peaks form; fold into batter.
Pour into 3 greased and floured 9-inch round cake pans.
Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes or until a wooden pick inserted in center comes out clean.
Cool in pans 10 minutes.
Remove from pans and let cool completely on wire racks. Frost with Coconut-Pecan Frosting.
recipes.text: German Chocolate Cake. Combine chocolate and water; bring to a boil. Stir until chocolate melts. Cool; stir in vanilla and set aside. Cream butter; gradually add sugar, beating well at medium speed. Add egg yolks, one at a time, beating well after each addition. Add chocolate mixture; beat until blended. Combine flour, soda and salt. Add to creamed mixture. Beat egg whites until stiff peaks form; fold into batter. Pour into 3 greased and floured 9-inch round cake pans. Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes or until a wooden pick inserted in center comes out clean. Cool in pans 10 minutes. Remove from pans and let cool completely on wire racks. Frost with Coconut-Pecan Frosting.

recipes.title: Buttermilk Pound Cake
directions: Cream butter with sugar.
Add eggs, one at a time, beating well to incorporate each one.
Add vanilla.
Add buttermilk alternately with the dry ingredients which have been sifted together.
Beat until smooth.
recipes.text: Buttermilk Pound Cake. Cream butter with sugar. Add eggs, one at a time, beating well to incorporate each one. Add vanilla. Add buttermilk alternately with the dry ingredients which have been sifted together. Beat until smooth.

recipes.title: Vegetable Salad
ingredients: 8 to 10 cooked and drained bacon slices (served on top)
directions: Serves 12 to 15.
recipes.text: Vegetable Salad. Serves 12 to 15.

recipes.title: Sod Cake
directions: Mix all ingredients, except nuts and chips, until well blended.
Add nuts and chips.
Bake on sheet cake pan.
Cool completely before cutting.
Bake 40 minutes at 350°.
recipes.text: Sod Cake. Mix all ingredients, except nuts and chips, until well blended. Add nuts and chips. Bake on sheet cake pan. Cool completely before cutting. Bake 40 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Cherry Bread
ingredients: 1 (10 oz.) jar maraschino cherries, drained and chopped
directions: Cream sugar, butter and eggs until fluffy.
Sift together flour, soda and salt; add to creamed mixture.
Add buttermilk and beat until blended.
Stir in cherries, pecans and vanilla.
Pour into greased loaf pan.
Bake at 350° for 55 to 60 minutes.
Remove from pan and cool.
recipes.text: Cherry Bread. Cream sugar, butter and eggs until fluffy. Sift together flour, soda and salt; add to creamed mixture. Add buttermilk and beat until blended. Stir in cherries, pecans and vanilla. Pour into greased loaf pan. Bake at 350° for 55 to 60 minutes. Remove from pan and cool.

recipes.title: Mulled Apple Cider
directions: Mix cider and other ingredients in a large pan.
Bring to a boil.
Reduce heat and simmer for 20 minutes.
Serve hot.
recipes.text: Mulled Apple Cider. Mix cider and other ingredients in a large pan. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer for 20 minutes. Serve hot.

recipes.title: Italian Beef
ingredients: 7 lb. roast beef (rump, sirloin tip or round roast)
1 jar pepperoncini (Italian peppers) and liquid from jar
directions: Roast beef to medium rare or medium.
Slice thinly; refrigerate.
Add ingredients to drippings in pan.
(Hint for rosemary:
Staple into tea bag.)
Strain rosemary after 10 to 20 minutes simmering.
Cool.
Remove fat.
Add cold beef to heated mixture.
Serve on submarine buns, hoagie buns, potato rolls or kaiser rolls.
Great for crowds.
recipes.text: Italian Beef. Roast beef to medium rare or medium. Slice thinly; refrigerate. Add ingredients to drippings in pan. (Hint for rosemary: Staple into tea bag.) Strain rosemary after 10 to 20 minutes simmering. Cool. Remove fat. Add cold beef to heated mixture. Serve on submarine buns, hoagie buns, potato rolls or kaiser rolls. Great for crowds.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Apple Streusel Muffins
ingredients: 2 c. peeled, finely chopped cooking apples
directions: In a large bowl, combine first 5 ingredients and set aside.
recipes.text: Pumpkin Apple Streusel Muffins. In a large bowl, combine first 5 ingredients and set aside.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Pecan Bread
directions: Preheat oven to 350°.
Use 2 loaf pans or 4 (7 1/2 x 3 1/2 x 2-inch).
Stir together flour, sugar, baking soda, spices and 1 teaspoon salt.
Combine eggs, pumpkin, milk and oil.
Add to dry ingredients.
Stir until combined.
Stir in nuts.
Bake for 55 to 65 minutes.
Cool pans on wire rack for 10 minutes, then remove from pans to finish cooling.
Enjoy.
recipes.text: Pumpkin Pecan Bread. Preheat oven to 350°. Use 2 loaf pans or 4 (7 1/2 x 3 1/2 x 2-inch). Stir together flour, sugar, baking soda, spices and 1 teaspoon salt. Combine eggs, pumpkin, milk and oil. Add to dry ingredients. Stir until combined. Stir in nuts. Bake for 55 to 65 minutes. Cool pans on wire rack for 10 minutes, then remove from pans to finish cooling. Enjoy.

recipes.title: Chili Bean Dip
directions: Prepare chili.
Fry refried beans until pasty.
Layer: Chili on bottom, sour cream, refried beans and Cheddar cheese.
Bake until cheese melts.
Serve with tortilla chips.
recipes.text: Chili Bean Dip. Prepare chili. Fry refried beans until pasty. Layer: Chili on bottom, sour cream, refried beans and Cheddar cheese. Bake until cheese melts. Serve with tortilla chips.

recipes.title: Chicken With Asparagus Sauce
directions: Dip chicken in egg whites, then coat with bread crumbs.
Cook chicken in skillet until tender.
Add soup, milk and water.
Serve over rice.
recipes.text: Chicken With Asparagus Sauce. Dip chicken in egg whites, then coat with bread crumbs. Cook chicken in skillet until tender. Add soup, milk and water. Serve over rice.

recipes.title: Refrigerator Sweet Cinnamon Rolls
ingredients: 1 c. powdered sugar and 1 Tbsp. milk for glaze
directions: Dissolve yeast in warm (110°) water.
Combine and beat next 6 ingredients.
Cover with damp cloth; put in refrigerator 2 hours or overnight.
Divide dough in half, roll in rectangle and brush with melted butter.
Combine 1 cup sugar, cinnamon and raisins and sprinkle over dough.
Roll up jelly-roll style.
Cut and put in greased pans.
Cover for about 1 hour or until double in size. Bake at 350° for 35 minutes.
Glaze with powdered sugar and milk.
recipes.text: Refrigerator Sweet Cinnamon Rolls. Dissolve yeast in warm (110°) water. Combine and beat next 6 ingredients. Cover with damp cloth; put in refrigerator 2 hours or overnight. Divide dough in half, roll in rectangle and brush with melted butter. Combine 1 cup sugar, cinnamon and raisins and sprinkle over dough. Roll up jelly-roll style. Cut and put in greased pans. Cover for about 1 hour or until double in size. Bake at 350° for 35 minutes. Glaze with powdered sugar and milk.

recipes.title: German Chocolate Cake
directions: Cream sugar and shortening; add eggs, flavors and buttermilk. Sift together flour, soda and salt.
Mix well.
Add German chocolate that has been softened.
Blend together well.
Cook in a 9-inch stem pan, that has been well greased and dusted with flour, about 1 1/2 hours at 300°.
Remove cake from pan while still hot and place under tight-fitting cake cover; leave covered until cold.
recipes.text: German Chocolate Cake. Cream sugar and shortening; add eggs, flavors and buttermilk. Sift together flour, soda and salt. Mix well. Add German chocolate that has been softened. Blend together well. Cook in a 9-inch stem pan, that has been well greased and dusted with flour, about 1 1/2 hours at 300°. Remove cake from pan while still hot and place under tight-fitting cake cover; leave covered until cold.

recipes.title: Squash Dressing
directions: Combine all ingredients.
Stir well to blend.
Bake in buttered casserole dish at 350° about 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Squash Dressing. Combine all ingredients. Stir well to blend. Bake in buttered casserole dish at 350° about 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Strudel
directions: Beat eggs.
Alternate dry ingredients.
Let stand 30 minutes. Place dough on board floured with cake meal.
Put more cake meal on dough.
Pat thin.
Spread with jelly and nuts.
Bake on oil greased pan for 45 minutes at 350°.
recipes.text: Strudel. Beat eggs. Alternate dry ingredients. Let stand 30 minutes. Place dough on board floured with cake meal. Put more cake meal on dough. Pat thin. Spread with jelly and nuts. Bake on oil greased pan for 45 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Pastry For Double Pie Crust
directions: Stir together flour and salt. Cut in the shortening until pieces are the size of a pea. Sprinkle 1 tablespoon water over part of the mixture. Gently toss with a fork.
Push to side of bowl.
Repeat until all is moistened.
Divide dough in half.
Use immediately or cover and chill until needed.
recipes.text: Pastry For Double Pie Crust. Stir together flour and salt. Cut in the shortening until pieces are the size of a pea. Sprinkle 1 tablespoon water over part of the mixture. Gently toss with a fork. Push to side of bowl. Repeat until all is moistened. Divide dough in half. Use immediately or cover and chill until needed.

recipes.title: Texas Red Chili
ingredients: 3 lb. ground turkey or beef (turkey lower in fat)
directions: Combine chili powder, oregano, salt, cayenne pepper, cumin, tomato juice and chili beans with 4 cups of water in a large saucepan.
Simmer for several minutes.
Cook beef.
Drain and add to bean mixture.
Cook on low heat for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Texas Red Chili. Combine chili powder, oregano, salt, cayenne pepper, cumin, tomato juice and chili beans with 4 cups of water in a large saucepan. Simmer for several minutes. Cook beef. Drain and add to bean mixture. Cook on low heat for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Copper Dollars
ingredients: salt and freshly ground black pepper to taste
directions: Peel and slice carrots into 1/4-inch thick slices.
Place in saucepan; add boiling water to cover and cook 15 minutes, until crisp-tender.
Drain and cool.
Slice and separate onion into rings; seed green pepper and cut into strips.
Combine carrots, onion and pepper in large bowl.
In saucepan, combine sugar, soup, vinegar, oil, Worcestershire and mustard.
Heat to boiling, stirring, until sugar dissolves.
Remove from heat and pour over vegetables; mix well.
Divide mixture between 2 quart jars, cover and refrigerate.
Serve cold as a salad relish side dish, alone or over fresh greens.
Makes 8 cups.
recipes.text: Copper Dollars. Peel and slice carrots into 1/4-inch thick slices. Place in saucepan; add boiling water to cover and cook 15 minutes, until crisp-tender. Drain and cool. Slice and separate onion into rings; seed green pepper and cut into strips. Combine carrots, onion and pepper in large bowl. In saucepan, combine sugar, soup, vinegar, oil, Worcestershire and mustard. Heat to boiling, stirring, until sugar dissolves. Remove from heat and pour over vegetables; mix well. Divide mixture between 2 quart jars, cover and refrigerate. Serve cold as a salad relish side dish, alone or over fresh greens. Makes 8 cups.

recipes.title: Strawberry Jello Salad
directions: Dissolve jello in water.
Mix all other ingredients except sour cream.
Pour 1/2 mixture into dish.
Chill firm.
Then spread sour cream onto layer.
Then pour remaining mix onto it.
Chill overnight.
recipes.text: Strawberry Jello Salad. Dissolve jello in water. Mix all other ingredients except sour cream. Pour 1/2 mixture into dish. Chill firm. Then spread sour cream onto layer. Then pour remaining mix onto it. Chill overnight.

recipes.title: Breakfast Pie
directions: Use a glass 9-inch pie dish.
Form crust into dish.
Brown loose sausage with chopped onion, green pepper and mushrooms. Drain grease well.
In a bowl, beat eggs, whipping cream, salt and pepper.
Add cheese.
Add sausage mixture.
Pour into pie dish. Bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes.
Serve with home fries.
recipes.text: Breakfast Pie. Use a glass 9-inch pie dish. Form crust into dish. Brown loose sausage with chopped onion, green pepper and mushrooms. Drain grease well. In a bowl, beat eggs, whipping cream, salt and pepper. Add cheese. Add sausage mixture. Pour into pie dish. Bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes. Serve with home fries.

recipes.title: Easy Fall Ratatouille Recipe
ingredients: Cut 1 each, medium eggplant, onion, red pepper and zucchini into chunks
1/4 c. Kraft Special Collections Sun-Dried Tomato Dressing
1 can (16 oz.) undrained low-sodium diced tomatoes
2 Tbsp. reduced fat Parmesan cheese, shredded
1/2 c. reduced fat Mozzarella cheese, shredded
directions: Saute vegetables in sun-dried tomato dressing in large ovenproof skillet until tender.
Add diced tomatoes, cook about 15 minutes, allowing some of the liquid to evaporate.
Top with cheeses and bake in 350° oven for 15 minutes.
recipes.text: Easy Fall Ratatouille Recipe. Saute vegetables in sun-dried tomato dressing in large ovenproof skillet until tender. Add diced tomatoes, cook about 15 minutes, allowing some of the liquid to evaporate. Top with cheeses and bake in 350° oven for 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Cheese Broccoli Casserole
directions: Cook broccoli and drain well. Cook sauce of milk and cheese on low in double boiler or
melt in microwave.

Melt butter and mix well with cracker crumbs. Grease a 9 x 9-inch casserole dish. Spread broccoli in bottom and pour sauce over. Cover with crumb mixture. Sprinkle with paprika. Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Cheese Broccoli Casserole. Cook broccoli and drain well. Cook sauce of milk and cheese on low in double boiler or melt in microwave. Melt butter and mix well with cracker crumbs. Grease a 9 x 9-inch casserole dish. Spread broccoli in bottom and pour sauce over. Cover with crumb mixture. Sprinkle with paprika. Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Beef Nacho Casserole
ingredients: 1 c. Birds Eye sweet corn, thawed and drained
2 c. (8 oz.) Kraft natural shredded Colby/Monterey Jack cheese, divided
directions: Heat oven to 350°.
Brown meat; drain.
Stir in salsa, corn, dressing and chili powder.
Layer 1/2 each of the meat mixture, chips and cheese in a 2-quart casserole dish.
Repeat layers. Bake for 20 minutes, or until thoroughly heated.
Top with shredded lettuce and chopped tomatoes, if desired.
Makes 6 servings.
recipes.text: Beef Nacho Casserole. Heat oven to 350°. Brown meat; drain. Stir in salsa, corn, dressing and chili powder. Layer 1/2 each of the meat mixture, chips and cheese in a 2-quart casserole dish. Repeat layers. Bake for 20 minutes, or until thoroughly heated. Top with shredded lettuce and chopped tomatoes, if desired. Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Sloppy Joe Hot Dish
directions: In medium skillet, cook hamburger and onion until meat is brown and onion is tender.
Stir in catsup, mustard and soup. Simmer 15 minutes.
recipes.text: Sloppy Joe Hot Dish. In medium skillet, cook hamburger and onion until meat is brown and onion is tender. Stir in catsup, mustard and soup. Simmer 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Sausage Spanish Rice
ingredients: 1 1/2 c. (6 oz.) shredded sharp Cheddar cheese
directions: In a skillet, cook sausage, onion and celery or peppers over medium heat, until meat is no longer pink and vegetables are tender; drain. Add tomatoes, water, rice and chili or salsa sauce. Cover and cook over low heat for 30 minutes or until rice is tender. Remove from the heat. Sprinkle with cheese. Cover and let stand for 5 minutes or until cheese is melted.
recipes.text: Sausage Spanish Rice. In a skillet, cook sausage, onion and celery or peppers over medium heat, until meat is no longer pink and vegetables are tender; drain. Add tomatoes, water, rice and chili or salsa sauce. Cover and cook over low heat for 30 minutes or until rice is tender. Remove from the heat. Sprinkle with cheese. Cover and let stand for 5 minutes or until cheese is melted.

recipes.title: Squash Relish
ingredients: 3 Tbsp. pickling spices, tied in cloth
directions: Combine first 6 ingredients and let stand overnight in refrigerator.
Rinse in cold water 4 or 5 times.
Combine the rest of the ingredients and bring to a boil.
Add the squash mixture and return to a boil.
Pour mixture into hot sterilized jars and seal.
recipes.text: Squash Relish. Combine first 6 ingredients and let stand overnight in refrigerator. Rinse in cold water 4 or 5 times. Combine the rest of the ingredients and bring to a boil. Add the squash mixture and return to a boil. Pour mixture into hot sterilized jars and seal.

recipes.title: Swedish Rusks
ingredients: 3 c. flour (add more if too sticky to handle)
directions: Brown almonds in oven.
Mix eggs, sugar and oleo together. Add milk, soda and flavoring.
Gradually add flour.
Stir in nuts. Form into 2 long rolls on cookie sheet.
Can add more flour if too sticky to handle.
Bake at 300° for 45 minutes.
Cut on angle in slices.
Lay out on cookie sheet and dry at 200° for 45 minutes, turning once.
recipes.text: Swedish Rusks. Brown almonds in oven. Mix eggs, sugar and oleo together. Add milk, soda and flavoring. Gradually add flour. Stir in nuts. Form into 2 long rolls on cookie sheet. Can add more flour if too sticky to handle. Bake at 300° for 45 minutes. Cut on angle in slices. Lay out on cookie sheet and dry at 200° for 45 minutes, turning once.

recipes.title: Persimmon Pudding
ingredients: 1 tsp. each: cinnamon, soda, salt and vanilla
directions: Dissolve soda in hot water.
Mix all ingredients together. Beat well.
Pour into greased mold.
Bake 1 hour in covered roaster (set in pan of hot water).
recipes.text: Persimmon Pudding. Dissolve soda in hot water. Mix all ingredients together. Beat well. Pour into greased mold. Bake 1 hour in covered roaster (set in pan of hot water).

recipes.title: Salsa
ingredients: 1 Tbsp. chili peppers, drained and finely chopped
directions: Mix all ingredients throughly.
Best if put in blender.
recipes.text: Salsa. Mix all ingredients throughly. Best if put in blender.

recipes.title: Tea Cakes
ingredients: enough flour to make stiff dough (plain)
directions: Cream butter and sugar.
Add eggs, beating after each egg. Add cream of tartar, soda and flour; mix well.
Add vanilla and mix well.
Knead; roll out and cut with cookie cutters.
Bake at 300° for 8 to 10 minutes.
recipes.text: Tea Cakes. Cream butter and sugar. Add eggs, beating after each egg. Add cream of tartar, soda and flour; mix well. Add vanilla and mix well. Knead; roll out and cut with cookie cutters. Bake at 300° for 8 to 10 minutes.

recipes.title: 3 Day Coconut Sour Cream Cake
ingredients: 1 box Duncan Hines butter cake mix
12 oz. frozen coconut (this comes in 6 oz. pkg. in freezer section)
directions: Bake cake according to directions; cool.
Split layers to make 4 layers.
While cake is baking, combine sugar, sour cream and coconut.
Blend well.
Chill.
Reserve 1 cup of sugar/sour cream/coconut mixture.
With remaining sugar mixture, frost layers.
To reserved 1 cup of mixture, add 8 ounces Cool Whip. Then frost top and sides with this.
Refrigerate in airtight container.
Keep for 3 days in refrigerator before serving.
recipes.text: 3 Day Coconut Sour Cream Cake. Bake cake according to directions; cool. Split layers to make 4 layers. While cake is baking, combine sugar, sour cream and coconut. Blend well. Chill. Reserve 1 cup of sugar/sour cream/coconut mixture. With remaining sugar mixture, frost layers. To reserved 1 cup of mixture, add 8 ounces Cool Whip. Then frost top and sides with this. Refrigerate in airtight container. Keep for 3 days in refrigerator before serving.

recipes.title: Old Fashioned Ham And Bean Soup
ingredients: 1 (112 oz.) can Hanover Great Northern beans
directions: Cook ham in water 2 to 3 hours or until meat is tender. Remove meat from bones and cut into bite-size pieces.
Add celery and carrots to broth; simmer until vegetables are tender.
Add ham, beans and pepper.
Bring to a boil, reduce heat and simmer 30 minutes.
Serves 30 to 35.
recipes.text: Old Fashioned Ham And Bean Soup. Cook ham in water 2 to 3 hours or until meat is tender. Remove meat from bones and cut into bite-size pieces. Add celery and carrots to broth; simmer until vegetables are tender. Add ham, beans and pepper. Bring to a boil, reduce heat and simmer 30 minutes. Serves 30 to 35.

recipes.title: English Toffee Candy
directions: Combine the sugar, butter and water in heavy saucepan.
Cook at 300° (to hard crack stage), stirring constantly without burning.
Add vanilla and pour into buttered 9 x 9-inch pan.
Lay 2 chocolate bars on top and spread them evenly as they melt. While still warm, sprinkle chopped pecans on top.
Cool thoroughly and break into pieces.
recipes.text: English Toffee Candy. Combine the sugar, butter and water in heavy saucepan. Cook at 300° (to hard crack stage), stirring constantly without burning. Add vanilla and pour into buttered 9 x 9-inch pan. Lay 2 chocolate bars on top and spread them evenly as they melt. While still warm, sprinkle chopped pecans on top. Cool thoroughly and break into pieces.

recipes.title: Lemon Delight
directions: Mix all the ingredients together.
Spread in 13 x 9-inch pan and bake at 350° about 10 to 15 minutes or until light brown.
Let cool.
recipes.text: Lemon Delight. Mix all the ingredients together. Spread in 13 x 9-inch pan and bake at 350° about 10 to 15 minutes or until light brown. Let cool.

recipes.title: Lemon Lush
directions: 1st Layer: Mix and pat into pan the flour, butter and walnuts. Bake at 350° for 10 minutes. Let cool.
recipes.text: Lemon Lush. 1st Layer: Mix and pat into pan the flour, butter and walnuts. Bake at 350° for 10 minutes. Let cool.

recipes.title: Mexican Casserole
directions: Brown meat and add salt, pepper and onion.
Set aside.
Mash Ro-Tel tomatoes and add 3 cans of soup.
Stir well and add to meat.
recipes.text: Mexican Casserole. Brown meat and add salt, pepper and onion. Set aside. Mash Ro-Tel tomatoes and add 3 cans of soup. Stir well and add to meat.

recipes.title: Scalloped Cabbage
directions: Cook cabbage and drain.
Add soup and Cheez Whiz.
Melt margarine and mix with crackers.
Layer cabbage and crackers. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Scalloped Cabbage. Cook cabbage and drain. Add soup and Cheez Whiz. Melt margarine and mix with crackers. Layer cabbage and crackers. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Mom'S Goulash
directions: Brown meat and drain.
Add soup, beans, onion and pepper. Simmer for 25 to 30 minutes.
Serves 4 to 6.
Best with tossed salad and apple pie.
recipes.text: Mom'S Goulash. Brown meat and drain. Add soup, beans, onion and pepper. Simmer for 25 to 30 minutes. Serves 4 to 6. Best with tossed salad and apple pie.

recipes.title: Delicious Cookies
directions: Preheat oven at 325°.
Cream together butter and sugar.
Add eggs and mix well.
Add remaining ingredients except pecans.
Mix until combined.
Stir in pecans.
Form into balls the size of a walnut.
Place on ungreased cookie sheet and flatten with a fork. Bake 10 to 12 minutes or until lightly brown.
Do not overcook. Let cool before removing from pan.
Makes 6 dozen.
recipes.text: Delicious Cookies. Preheat oven at 325°. Cream together butter and sugar. Add eggs and mix well. Add remaining ingredients except pecans. Mix until combined. Stir in pecans. Form into balls the size of a walnut. Place on ungreased cookie sheet and flatten with a fork. Bake 10 to 12 minutes or until lightly brown. Do not overcook. Let cool before removing from pan. Makes 6 dozen.

recipes.title: Mrs. Eman'S Crumb Cake
ingredients: 1 c. milk (sweet or sour) or yogurt
directions: Mix together flours, sugar, spices and margarine until crumbly.
Take out 1 cup of these crumbs and reserve for topping. Dissolve soda in milk or yogurt.
Add to mixture, stirring until blended.
Put batter into 2 greased 8-inch pans and top with crumbs.
Bake 35 minutes at 350°.
recipes.text: Mrs. Eman'S Crumb Cake. Mix together flours, sugar, spices and margarine until crumbly. Take out 1 cup of these crumbs and reserve for topping. Dissolve soda in milk or yogurt. Add to mixture, stirring until blended. Put batter into 2 greased 8-inch pans and top with crumbs. Bake 35 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Sour Cream Cornbread
directions: Combine and mix well. Pour into a hot greased skillet and bake at 400° for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Sour Cream Cornbread. Combine and mix well. Pour into a hot greased skillet and bake at 400° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Three Bean Stew With Vegetables
ingredients: 1/2 c. sun-dried tomatoes, packed in oil (optional)
1/4 c. balsamic or sherry wine vinegar
salt and freshly ground black pepper
directions: Chop the onions and tomatoes.
Peel and slice the carrots 1/4-inch thick.
Seed and mince the jalapenos for a hot and spicy taste.
Heat the oil in a medium size saucepan over medium heat. Add the onions and carrots, reduce heat to low, and simmer, covered, until somewhat tender, about 3 minutes.
Add the tomatoes, jalapenos, corn (frozen or thawed), the beans with their juices, and chilies.
Cover and simmer for as little as 20 minutes just to heat the ingredients or for as long as 45 minutes for a more mellow flavor.
Stir the beans to make sure they are not scorching; add a little water if they are.
Four servings.
Delicious over a bowl of pasta, rice or cornmeal puree.
recipes.text: Three Bean Stew With Vegetables. Chop the onions and tomatoes. Peel and slice the carrots 1/4-inch thick. Seed and mince the jalapenos for a hot and spicy taste. Heat the oil in a medium size saucepan over medium heat. Add the onions and carrots, reduce heat to low, and simmer, covered, until somewhat tender, about 3 minutes. Add the tomatoes, jalapenos, corn (frozen or thawed), the beans with their juices, and chilies.
