Cover and simmer for as little as 20 minutes just to heat the ingredients or for as long as 45 minutes for a more mellow flavor. Stir the beans to make sure they are not scorching; add a little water if they are. Four servings. Delicious over a bowl of pasta, rice or cornmeal puree.

recipes.title: Special K Cookies
directions: Put 5 cups Special K into a bowl.
Mix syrup and sugar in a pan; bring slowly to 30 second boil.
Remove from stove.
Add peanut butter.
Pour over Special K.
Shape size desired or put by tablespoon onto wax paper.
recipes.text: Special K Cookies. Put 5 cups Special K into a bowl. Mix syrup and sugar in a pan; bring slowly to 30 second boil. Remove from stove. Add peanut butter. Pour over Special K. Shape size desired or put by tablespoon onto wax paper.

recipes.title: Raspberry Glaze Pie
directions: Glaze:
Mix 1/2 cup berries, cornstarch, sugar and water.
Cook until clear and thick.
Remove from stove and add butter and lemon juice.
Let cool.
recipes.text: Raspberry Glaze Pie. Glaze: Mix 1/2 cup berries, cornstarch, sugar and water. Cook until clear and thick. Remove from stove and add butter and lemon juice. Let cool.

recipes.title: Cherry-Pecan-Pineapple Muffins
directions: Mix flour, baking powder, salt, baking soda and cinnamon together.
Set aside.
In large mixing bowl, mix together eggs, sugar and vegetable oil until well blended.
Add gradually to flour mixture until smooth.
Next, add pineapple with juice, cherries, cut in half and chopped pecans.
Place mixture into paper cupcake cups.
Place pan in a 350° oven until muffins spring up in middle, approximately 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Cherry-Pecan-Pineapple Muffins. Mix flour, baking powder, salt, baking soda and cinnamon together. Set aside. In large mixing bowl, mix together eggs, sugar and vegetable oil until well blended. Add gradually to flour mixture until smooth. Next, add pineapple with juice, cherries, cut in half and chopped pecans. Place mixture into paper cupcake cups. Place pan in a 350° oven until muffins spring up in middle, approximately 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Stuffed Potatoes
ingredients: medium baked potatoes (1 to 2 per person)
seasoned meat - taco or beef stroganoff
directions: Open
baked potatoes.
Fill with meat, desired stuffing items (some or all of listed) and picante sauce.
Heat together Velveeta,
milk
and
1/2 cup picante sauce.
Enjoy!
Serve with mixed green salad, fruit salad and a light dessert.
recipes.text: Stuffed Potatoes. Open baked potatoes. Fill with meat, desired stuffing items (some or all of listed) and picante sauce. Heat together Velveeta, milk and 1/2 cup picante sauce. Enjoy! Serve with mixed green salad, fruit salad and a light dessert.

recipes.title: Punch
directions: Mix all of the above ingredients together and freeze.
Take mixture out of freezer about 4 - 6 hours before using.
Add 1 pint ginger ale - should be slushy.
recipes.text: Punch. Mix all of the above ingredients together and freeze. Take mixture out of freezer about 4 - 6 hours before using. Add 1 pint ginger ale - should be slushy.

recipes.title: Peach Crisp
directions: Place melted margarine in baking dish.
In small bowl mix the flour, sugar and milk.
Pour into baking dish with the margarine but do not stir.
Spoon fruit over batter evenly.
Sprinkle with cinnamon.
Bake at 350°
until golden brown and dough rises to the top.
recipes.text: Peach Crisp. Place melted margarine in baking dish. In small bowl mix the flour, sugar and milk. Pour into baking dish with the margarine but do not stir. Spoon fruit over batter evenly. Sprinkle with cinnamon. Bake at 350° until golden brown and dough rises to the top.

recipes.title: Sugar-Free Cookies
directions: Combine sweetener with orange juice.
Cream oleo and add orange juice mixture.
Add the rest of ingredients.
Shape into a roll and chill.
Cut in 1/8-inch slices and put on cookie sheet. Bake at 400° for 10 minutes or until edges are brown.
recipes.text: Sugar-Free Cookies. Combine sweetener with orange juice. Cream oleo and add orange juice mixture. Add the rest of ingredients. Shape into a roll and chill. Cut in 1/8-inch slices and put on cookie sheet. Bake at 400° for 10 minutes or until edges are brown.

recipes.title: Freezer Strawberry Jam
directions: Combine strawberries and sugar.
Let stand 20 minutes.
Stir occasionally.
Combine water and pectin.
Bring to a boil.
Boil 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add pectin mixture to fruit and stir 3 minutes.
Pour into jars or freezer containers, leaving 1-inch headspace.
Cover with lids.
Let stand at room temperature for 24 hours.
Freeze.
Yield:
6 cups.
recipes.text: Freezer Strawberry Jam. Combine strawberries and sugar. Let stand 20 minutes. Stir occasionally. Combine water and pectin. Bring to a boil. Boil 1 minute, stirring constantly. Add pectin mixture to fruit and stir 3 minutes. Pour into jars or freezer containers, leaving 1-inch headspace. Cover with lids. Let stand at room temperature for 24 hours. Freeze. Yield: 6 cups.

recipes.title: Boggs' Italian Chicken
ingredients: 1 pkg. dry Italian salad dressing mix
directions: Preheat oven to 400°.
Rinse chicken pieces and pat dry. Place in shallow baking pan.
In saucepan, melt butter; add dressing mix and dry mustard.
Baste pieces with mixture.
Bake for 1 hour, basting often.
recipes.text: Boggs' Italian Chicken. Preheat oven to 400°. Rinse chicken pieces and pat dry. Place in shallow baking pan. In saucepan, melt butter; add dressing mix and dry mustard. Baste pieces with mixture. Bake for 1 hour, basting often.

recipes.title: Fresh Apple Cake
directions: In large bowl, combine oil, eggs, vanilla and sugar; mix well. In separate bowl, sift flour and cinnamon. Add to egg mixture; mix well. Stir in apples, nuts and chips. Pour in metal 9 x 13 pan sprayed with Pam. Bake at 350° for 45 to 50 minutes. Cool and cut into squares.
recipes.text: Fresh Apple Cake. In large bowl, combine oil, eggs, vanilla and sugar; mix well. In separate bowl, sift flour and cinnamon. Add to egg mixture; mix well. Stir in apples, nuts and chips. Pour in metal 9 x 13 pan sprayed with Pam. Bake at 350° for 45 to 50 minutes. Cool and cut into squares.

recipes.title: Cold Oven Pound Cake
directions: Cream sugar,
butter and shortening.
Add eggs one at a time; beat
after
each.
Add
flour and milk alternately with flour being added last.
Add vanilla, lemon and brandy flavorings.
Add baking
powder
last.
Place
in greased tube pan. Place in cold oven.
Turn
heat to 325° or 350°.
Bake 1 hour and 15
minutes or
longer.
Cool
and remove from pan.
Cool about 10 minutes.
recipes.text: Cold Oven Pound Cake. Cream sugar, butter and shortening. Add eggs one at a time; beat after each. Add flour and milk alternately with flour being added last. Add vanilla, lemon and brandy flavorings. Add baking powder last. Place in greased tube pan. Place in cold oven. Turn heat to 325° or 350°. Bake 1 hour and 15 minutes or longer. Cool and remove from pan. Cool about 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Scrumptious Caramel Squares
directions: Heat oven to 350°.
Melt caramels and milk over low heat.
Mix Bisquick, oats and brown sugar.
Stir in melted margarine until crumbly.
Press half of the mixture in ungreased rectangular pan. Bake 10 minutes.
Sprinkle with chocolate chips and nuts. Sprinkle remaining crumbly mixture over chips, nuts and caramel mixture.
Press lightly.
Bake 15 to 20 minutes longer or until light golden brown.
Cut in squares.
recipes.text: Scrumptious Caramel Squares. Heat oven to 350°. Melt caramels and milk over low heat. Mix Bisquick, oats and brown sugar. Stir in melted margarine until crumbly. Press half of the mixture in ungreased rectangular pan. Bake 10 minutes. Sprinkle with chocolate chips and nuts. Sprinkle remaining crumbly mixture over chips, nuts and caramel mixture. Press lightly. Bake 15 to 20 minutes longer or until light golden brown. Cut in squares.

recipes.title: Strawberry Balls
directions: Combine 1 1/2 boxes Jell-O, pecans and coconut.
Add enough Eagle Brand milk to hold together.
Form into small balls.
Roll balls in remaining 1/2 box of Jell-O.
recipes.text: Strawberry Balls. Combine 1 1/2 boxes Jell-O, pecans and coconut. Add enough Eagle Brand milk to hold together. Form into small balls. Roll balls in remaining 1/2 box of Jell-O.

recipes.title: Mock Angel Food Cake
directions: Mix cake flour, sugar and hot water; let set overnight.
Next day, beat egg whites until stiff.
Add rest of ingredients and fold into overnight mixture.
Can be baked in tube pan or a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Do not grease pan.
Bake at 325° for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Mock Angel Food Cake. Mix cake flour, sugar and hot water; let set overnight. Next day, beat egg whites until stiff. Add rest of ingredients and fold into overnight mixture. Can be baked in tube pan or a 9 x 13-inch pan. Do not grease pan. Bake at 325° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Grandma'S Peach Crumble
directions: Combine peaches and brown sugar in an 8 x 8-inch square pan. In a bowl, mix together the remaining ingredients and sprinkle over the top of peach mixture.
Bake at 375° for 30 to 35 minutes. Serve with ice cream.
recipes.text: Grandma'S Peach Crumble. Combine peaches and brown sugar in an 8 x 8-inch square pan. In a bowl, mix together the remaining ingredients and sprinkle over the top of peach mixture. Bake at 375° for 30 to 35 minutes. Serve with ice cream.

recipes.title: Cole Slaw
directions: Stir together and pour over chopped cabbage, green pepper, celery and carrots.
Let set overnight.
recipes.text: Cole Slaw. Stir together and pour over chopped cabbage, green pepper, celery and carrots. Let set overnight.

recipes.title: Halibut Chowder
directions: 1. Boil water and bouillon.
2. Add vegetables and turn down to simmer for 10 minutes.
3. Add fish and simmer for 5 minutes. 4. Melt butter in large sauce pan, add flour and stir well adding milk slowly. Stir CONSTANTLY ! until thick.
5. Remove from heat. Add cheese and stir until cheese
melts.
6. Mix vegetables and sauce together.
7. Add salt and pepper to taste.
recipes.text: Halibut Chowder. 1. Boil water and bouillon. 2. Add vegetables and turn down to simmer for 10 minutes. 3. Add fish and simmer for 5 minutes. 4. Melt butter in large sauce pan, add flour and stir well adding milk slowly. Stir CONSTANTLY ! until thick. 5. Remove from heat. Add cheese and stir until cheese melts. 6. Mix vegetables and sauce together. 7. Add salt and pepper to taste.

recipes.title: Squash Casserole
directions: Cut squash and bell pepper and cook until tender; drain, then add margarine, soup, sour cream, carrot, onion and bag of dressing. Bake at 325° for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Squash Casserole. Cut squash and bell pepper and cook until tender; drain, then add margarine, soup, sour cream, carrot, onion and bag of dressing. Bake at 325° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Ham Quiche
directions: Line pie pan with pastry.
Bake at 400° for 3 minutes.
Remove from oven and gently prick with a fork.
Bake 5 minutes longer. Let cool on rack.
Combine mayonnaise, flour, eggs and milk; mix thoroughly.
Stir in ham and cheese.
Pour into pie shell and bake at 350° for 45 to 50 minutes.
Do not overcook.
recipes.text: Ham Quiche. Line pie pan with pastry. Bake at 400° for 3 minutes. Remove from oven and gently prick with a fork. Bake 5 minutes longer. Let cool on rack. Combine mayonnaise, flour, eggs and milk; mix thoroughly. Stir in ham and cheese. Pour into pie shell and bake at 350° for 45 to 50 minutes. Do not overcook.

recipes.title: Biscuit Ring
directions: Combine sugar, margarine and water in 1-quart bowl.
Cook 1 minute.
Stir in nuts.
Separate biscuits and cut each biscuit into quarters.
Add to sugar mixture.
Stir to coat each piece of biscuit with caramel.
Push mixture away from center and set glass in center to make ring mold.
Cook, uncovered, 2 1/2 to 3 minutes, rotating 1/4 turn halfway through cooking time.
Biscuits should be firm and no longer doughy.
Rest 2 minutes.
Remove center mold and invert on serving plate.
Serve warm by pulling apart.
recipes.text: Biscuit Ring. Combine sugar, margarine and water in 1-quart bowl. Cook 1 minute. Stir in nuts. Separate biscuits and cut each biscuit into quarters. Add to sugar mixture. Stir to coat each piece of biscuit with caramel. Push mixture away from center and set glass in center to make ring mold. Cook, uncovered, 2 1/2 to 3 minutes, rotating 1/4 turn halfway through cooking time. Biscuits should be firm and no longer doughy. Rest 2 minutes. Remove center mold and invert on serving plate. Serve warm by pulling apart.

recipes.title: Corn Chowder
ingredients: milk (until desired consistency) or half and half
directions: Brown bacon.
Cook potatoes and barley separately.
Add everything else and bring to a boil.
Only need about 30 minutes after everything is added to cook.
If you use milk, add cornstarch to thicken.
If you use half and half, you probably won't need it thickened.
Serves 4 to 5.
recipes.text: Corn Chowder. Brown bacon. Cook potatoes and barley separately. Add everything else and bring to a boil. Only need about 30 minutes after everything is added to cook. If you use milk, add cornstarch to thicken. If you use half and half, you probably won't need it thickened. Serves 4 to 5.

recipes.title: Cheese Fondue
directions: Cube a loaf of French bread.
Set aside.
Melt butter and cheese in a pan on low heat or in a fondue pot.
Add crab and garlic powder.
Dip bread in fondue.
recipes.text: Cheese Fondue. Cube a loaf of French bread. Set aside. Melt butter and cheese in a pan on low heat or in a fondue pot. Add crab and garlic powder. Dip bread in fondue.

recipes.title: Louisiana Papadums
directions: Slice the bread as thinly as possible.
Dip in the melted butter or brush with melted butter.
Spread on cookie sheet and bake at 250° until crisp or bake at 375° for 12 minutes.
Sprinkle with sesame seed or the grated cheese.
recipes.text: Louisiana Papadums. Slice the bread as thinly as possible. Dip in the melted butter or brush with melted butter. Spread on cookie sheet and bake at 250° until crisp or bake at 375° for 12 minutes. Sprinkle with sesame seed or the grated cheese.

recipes.title: Ham And Noodle Casserole
directions: Cook macaroni.
Melt butter and add tomato sauce, onion, salt and pepper.
Simmer 18 minutes.
Add ham and 3/4 cheese until it melts.
Stir in macaroni.
Pour into greased casserole dish.
Add remaining cheese.
Bake 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Ham And Noodle Casserole. Cook macaroni. Melt butter and add tomato sauce, onion, salt and pepper. Simmer 18 minutes. Add ham and 3/4 cheese until it melts. Stir in macaroni. Pour into greased casserole dish. Add remaining cheese. Bake 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Dawn'S Iced Tea
directions: Boil 4 to 6 cups of water and remove from heat. Add 3 tea bags and set aside to brew. Best if steeped until cool. Remove tea bags.
recipes.text: Dawn'S Iced Tea. Boil 4 to 6 cups of water and remove from heat. Add 3 tea bags and set aside to brew. Best if steeped until cool. Remove tea bags.

recipes.title: Harvard Beets
ingredients: 1 (1 lb.) can cubed or sliced beets
directions: Mix cornstarch, sugar, salt and pepper.
Slowly blend in liquid and vinegar.
Bring to boil over medium heat.
Boil 1 minute.
Add beets and heat.
recipes.text: Harvard Beets. Mix cornstarch, sugar, salt and pepper. Slowly blend in liquid and vinegar. Bring to boil over medium heat. Boil 1 minute. Add beets and heat.

recipes.title: Porcupines
directions: Mix all together.
Roll in round balls.
Pour diluted can of tomato sauce and 1 can of water over.
Cover and cook 1 1/2 hours. Keep covered until done.
recipes.text: Porcupines. Mix all together. Roll in round balls. Pour diluted can of tomato sauce and 1 can of water over. Cover and cook 1 1/2 hours. Keep covered until done.

recipes.title: Strawberry Cream Layered Salad
ingredients: 1 (10 oz.) pkg. frozen, sweetened strawberries, thawed
1 (8 oz.) can crushed pineapple, well drained
directions: Dissolve gelatin in boiling water.
Mash bananas and combine with thawed strawberries and their juice, pineapple and nuts.
Add gelatin mixture.

Pour half the mixture into an 8-inch square baking dish; cover and chill until firm (about 1 1/2 hours). Cover remaining gelatin mixture and let stand at room temperature. When refrigerated portion is firm, spread evenly with sour cream. Spoon remaining gelatin mixture evenly over cream layer.
Cover and chill until firm (at least 4 hours).
May be cut into squares and served on lettuce or made in a pretty clear bowl and passed.
recipes.text: Strawberry Cream Layered Salad. Dissolve gelatin in boiling water. Mash bananas and combine with thawed strawberries and their juice, pineapple and nuts. Add gelatin mixture. Pour half the mixture into an 8-inch square baking dish; cover and chill until firm (about 1 1/2 hours). Cover remaining gelatin mixture and let stand at room temperature. When refrigerated portion is firm, spread evenly with sour cream. Spoon remaining gelatin mixture evenly over cream layer. Cover and chill until firm (at least 4 hours). May be cut into squares and served on lettuce or made in a pretty clear bowl and passed.

recipes.title: Spicy Honey Chicken Wings
directions: Combine first 5 ingredients in a 3-quart baking dish. Add chicken wings and toss to coat; cover and refrigerate 1 hour. Uncover dish and bake at 350° for 45 to 60 minutes or until done. Serves 8.
recipes.text: Spicy Honey Chicken Wings. Combine first 5 ingredients in a 3-quart baking dish. Add chicken wings and toss to coat; cover and refrigerate 1 hour. Uncover dish and bake at 350° for 45 to 60 minutes or until done. Serves 8.

recipes.title: Overnight Coffee Cake
directions: The night before serving, liberally grease Bundt pan.
Separate each cloverleaf roll into 3 pieces.
Combine dry pudding mix with brown sugar and pecans.
Melt butter.
Place pieces of roll in prepared pan.
Pour melted butter over dough and sprinkle with the pudding mixture.
Place pan in cold oven and cover with tea towel. The dough rises beautifully by morning.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
Invert pan on serving plate immediately after removing from oven.
recipes.text: Overnight Coffee Cake. The night before serving, liberally grease Bundt pan. Separate each cloverleaf roll into 3 pieces. Combine dry pudding mix with brown sugar and pecans. Melt butter. Place pieces of roll in prepared pan. Pour melted butter over dough and sprinkle with the pudding mixture. Place pan in cold oven and cover with tea towel. The dough rises beautifully by morning. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes. Invert pan on serving plate immediately after removing from oven.

recipes.title: Sour Cream Chocolate Cake
directions: Heat oven to 350°.
Measure all ingredients into a large bowl. Mix 1/2 minute on low speed, scraping bowl constantly.
Beat 3 minutes at high speed, scraping bowl occasionally.
Pour into prepared pans.
Bake 30 to 35 minutes.
recipes.text: Sour Cream Chocolate Cake. Heat oven to 350°. Measure all ingredients into a large bowl. Mix 1/2 minute on low speed, scraping bowl constantly. Beat 3 minutes at high speed, scraping bowl occasionally. Pour into prepared pans. Bake 30 to 35 minutes.

recipes.title: Swiss Steak
directions: Remove all fat from meat and cut in steaks.
Tenderize meat with meat mallet.
Mix flour, onion salt, celery salt, pepper and garlic salt in small bowl.
Cover each piece of meat with flour mixture and brown in frying pan.
After browned, place beef cubes and water in pan (enough water to cover meat).
Cover, reduce heat to simmer and cook 45 minutes.
Serve with mashed potatoes.
recipes.text: Swiss Steak. Remove all fat from meat and cut in steaks. Tenderize meat with meat mallet. Mix flour, onion salt, celery salt, pepper and garlic salt in small bowl. Cover each piece of meat with flour mixture and brown in frying pan. After browned, place beef cubes and water in pan (enough water to cover meat). Cover, reduce heat to simmer and cook 45 minutes. Serve with mashed potatoes.

recipes.title: Sausage And Wild Rice Casserole
ingredients: 1 (6 oz.) pkg. long grain and wild rice
1 (10 3/4 oz.) can cream of mushroom soup, undiluted
directions: Cook rice as directed and set aside.
Brown sausage in skillet, stir and crumble; drain well.
Combine all ingredients. Spoon into lightly greased 2-quart casserole dish.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
Serves 6.
recipes.text: Sausage And Wild Rice Casserole. Cook rice as directed and set aside. Brown sausage in skillet, stir and crumble; drain well. Combine all ingredients. Spoon into lightly greased 2-quart casserole dish. Bake at 350° for 1 hour. Serves 6.

recipes.title: Coconut Cream Pie
directions: Mix sugar and cornstarch. Add enough milk to dissolve cornstarch. Add egg yolks. Beat well. Add remaining milk. Cook over medium heat until thickened and add vanilla, coconut and butter. Pour in baked pie shell.
recipes.text: Coconut Cream Pie. Mix sugar and cornstarch. Add enough milk to dissolve cornstarch. Add egg yolks. Beat well. Add remaining milk. Cook over medium heat until thickened and add vanilla, coconut and butter. Pour in baked pie shell.

recipes.title: Baked Pineapple
directions: Drain pineapple.
Beat together the sugar, eggs, butter and milk until well blended.
Stir in bread and pineapple.
Pour into greased 1 1/2-quart casserole.
Sprinkle cinnamon.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Baked Pineapple. Drain pineapple. Beat together the sugar, eggs, butter and milk until well blended. Stir in bread and pineapple. Pour into greased 1 1/2-quart casserole. Sprinkle cinnamon. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Rhubarb Pie
directions: Mix like pie crust and pat in bottom of the pie tin.
recipes.text: Rhubarb Pie. Mix like pie crust and pat in bottom of the pie tin.

recipes.title: Chocolate Oatmeal Cookies
directions: Bring butter, cocoa, sugar and milk to boil.
Add oats, peanut butter and vanilla.
Drop by spoonfuls onto cookie sheet.
recipes.text: Chocolate Oatmeal Cookies. Bring butter, cocoa, sugar and milk to boil. Add oats, peanut butter and vanilla. Drop by spoonfuls onto cookie sheet.

recipes.title: Hello Dolly Bars
directions: In 9 x 13-inch pan, melt 1 stick of butter.
Add graham cracker crumbs, coconut, chocolate chips, butterscotch chips and condensed milk.
Sprinkle with walnuts (chopped).
Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes.
recipes.text: Hello Dolly Bars. In 9 x 13-inch pan, melt 1 stick of butter. Add graham cracker crumbs, coconut, chocolate chips, butterscotch chips and condensed milk. Sprinkle with walnuts (chopped). Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Oatmeal Pie
directions: Beat eggs.
Add other ingredients.
Dump in oatmeal.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Oatmeal Pie. Beat eggs. Add other ingredients. Dump in oatmeal. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Eclairs
directions: Melt butter in 1 cup boiling water.
Add flour and salt all at once; stir vigorously.
Cook and stir until mixture forms a ball that doesn't separate.
Remove from heat; cool slightly.
Add eggs, one at a time, beating after each until smooth.
Put through a pastry tube or paper one making 4-inch strips, 3/4-inch wide on greased cookie sheet.
Bake, split and dry.
Bake in 450° oven for 15 minutes, then at 325° for 25 minutes.
Turn oven off and put eclairs back in to dry, about 20 minutes.
Cool on rack.
Fill with double recipe of French Custard Filling just before serving and frost with Chocolate Frosting.
recipes.text: Eclairs. Melt butter in 1 cup boiling water. Add flour and salt all at once; stir vigorously. Cook and stir until mixture forms a ball that doesn't separate. Remove from heat; cool slightly. Add eggs, one at a time, beating after each until smooth. Put through a pastry tube or paper one making 4-inch strips, 3/4-inch wide on greased cookie sheet. Bake, split and dry. Bake in 450° oven for 15 minutes, then at 325° for 25 minutes. Turn oven off and put eclairs back in to dry, about 20 minutes. Cool on rack. Fill with double recipe of French Custard Filling just before serving and frost with Chocolate Frosting.

recipes.title: Date Sticks
ingredients: 1 c. dates, cut in small pieces
directions: Mix together.
Bake at 350° for 35 minutes, or until done, in a 9-inch greased square pan.
recipes.text: Date Sticks. Mix together. Bake at 350° for 35 minutes, or until done, in a 9-inch greased square pan.

recipes.title: Corn Casserole
directions: Combine all ingredients and stir together.
Bake in a greased 8 x 8-inch casserole dish at 350° for 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Corn Casserole. Combine all ingredients and stir together. Bake in a greased 8 x 8-inch casserole dish at 350° for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Sweet 'N Sour Spread
directions: Combine pineapple preserves, horseradish and mustard; stir well.
Cover and refrigerate at least 3 hours.
Spoon pineapple mixture over softened cream cheese and serve with crackers.
recipes.text: Sweet 'N Sour Spread. Combine pineapple preserves, horseradish and mustard; stir well. Cover and refrigerate at least 3 hours. Spoon pineapple mixture over softened cream cheese and serve with crackers.

recipes.title: Cheesy Artichoke Heart Appetizers
ingredients: 14 oz. can artichoke hearts, drained and finely chopped
directions: Unroll dough; press into bottom and sides of 15 x 10 pan. Bake at 375° for 10 minutes.
Combine all ingredients; spread over crust and bake at 375° for 15 minutes.
Let stand 5 minutes and cut into pieces.
recipes.text: Cheesy Artichoke Heart Appetizers. Unroll dough; press into bottom and sides of 15 x 10 pan. Bake at 375° for 10 minutes. Combine all ingredients; spread over crust and bake at 375° for 15 minutes. Let stand 5 minutes and cut into pieces.

recipes.title: Warm Crab Dip
ingredients: 1/2 tsp. butter to grease baking dish
directions: Shred crab meat into small pieces.
Blend in a small bowl, softened cream cheese with Worcestershire sauce, half and half, shredded crab meat, onion and horseradish sauce.
Mix lightly, but well.
Butter small baking dish and fill with crab mixture. Sprinkle with almonds and bake for 15 minutes at 350°.
Serve with crackers.
recipes.text: Warm Crab Dip. Shred crab meat into small pieces. Blend in a small bowl, softened cream cheese with Worcestershire sauce, half and half, shredded crab meat, onion and horseradish sauce. Mix lightly, but well. Butter small baking dish and fill with crab mixture. Sprinkle with almonds and bake for 15 minutes at 350°. Serve with crackers.

recipes.title: Lebanese Rice
directions: Boil chicken until tender with some onion and celery.
Take chicken off bone; strain broth (keep broth boiling).
Soak rice in enough water to cover while deboning chicken.
recipes.text: Lebanese Rice. Boil chicken until tender with some onion and celery. Take chicken off bone; strain broth (keep broth boiling). Soak rice in enough water to cover while deboning chicken.

recipes.title: No Bake Cookies
directions: Combine sugar and cocoa in a 2-quart boiler.
Stir in milk and butter.
Cook until mixture comes to a rolling boil; stir well. Continue to cook on high for 1 minute.
Remove mixture and stir in vanilla.
Add oats; mix thoroughly.
Add coconut and nuts (optional).
Drop by teaspoon onto waxed paper.
Place in refrigerator to set.
recipes.text: No Bake Cookies. Combine sugar and cocoa in a 2-quart boiler. Stir in milk and butter. Cook until mixture comes to a rolling boil; stir well. Continue to cook on high for 1 minute. Remove mixture and stir in vanilla. Add oats; mix thoroughly. Add coconut and nuts (optional). Drop by teaspoon onto waxed paper. Place in refrigerator to set.

recipes.title: Curry Dip For Vegetables
directions: Mix ingredients together and refrigerate overnight.
Serve with a variety of fresh vegetables.
recipes.text: Curry Dip For Vegetables. Mix ingredients together and refrigerate overnight. Serve with a variety of fresh vegetables.

recipes.title: Frozen Slaw
directions: Shred cabbage in pan and sprinkle salt over; mix.
Let stand for 1 hour.
Squeeze out water.
Boil rest of ingredients: green pepper, carrots, sugar, vinegar, water and celery seed, then cool and cover the cabbage.
Freeze the combination.
It can be refrozen for another time if not all used.
recipes.text: Frozen Slaw. Shred cabbage in pan and sprinkle salt over; mix. Let stand for 1 hour. Squeeze out water. Boil rest of ingredients: green pepper, carrots, sugar, vinegar, water and celery seed, then cool and cover the cabbage. Freeze the combination. It can be refrozen for another time if not all used.

recipes.title: Sauerkraut Salad
directions: Drain sauerkraut and bean sprouts.
Add the celery, green pepper, onion and pimento.
Heat sugar and vinegar.
Let cool.
Add to vegetables and mix well.
recipes.text: Sauerkraut Salad. Drain sauerkraut and bean sprouts. Add the celery, green pepper, onion and pimento. Heat sugar and vinegar. Let cool. Add to vegetables and mix well.

recipes.title: Shrimp Creole
directions: Rinse and peel shrimp; refrigerate.
Use shells for stock.
recipes.text: Shrimp Creole. Rinse and peel shrimp; refrigerate. Use shells for stock.

recipes.title: Oven Baked Stew Beef
directions: Place stew meat in pan or baking dish.
Sprinkle onion soup on top.
Pour cream of mushroom soup over this.
Cover tightly and bake at 325° for 1 to 1 1/2 hours.
Serve over rice or noodles.
recipes.text: Oven Baked Stew Beef. Place stew meat in pan or baking dish. Sprinkle onion soup on top. Pour cream of mushroom soup over this. Cover tightly and bake at 325° for 1 to 1 1/2 hours. Serve over rice or noodles.

recipes.title: Zucchini Jelly
directions: Mix zucchini, sugar and lemon juice in saucepan.
Bring to a boil over low heat.
Stir in gelatin.
Ladle into hot sterilized 8 ounce jars.
Yield: 3 or 4 jars.
recipes.text: Zucchini Jelly. Mix zucchini, sugar and lemon juice in saucepan. Bring to a boil over low heat. Stir in gelatin. Ladle into hot sterilized 8 ounce jars. Yield: 3 or 4 jars.

recipes.title: Chocolate Chip Pie
directions: Pour chips in unbaked pie shell.
Melt margarine.
Stir in sugar.
Add eggs, vanilla and nuts.
Pour over chips in pie shell. Bake at 350° until firm, approximately 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Chocolate Chip Pie. Pour chips in unbaked pie shell. Melt margarine. Stir in sugar. Add eggs, vanilla and nuts. Pour over chips in pie shell. Bake at 350° until firm, approximately 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Pancakes
directions: Sift together the first 7 ingredients.
Beat the next 5 ingredients together, then blend into dry ingredients.
For each pancake, pour about 1/4 cup batter onto a hot, lightly greased griddle. Turn pancakes when tops are covered with bubbles and edges look dark.
Serve immediately.
Yields 20 (4-inch) pancakes.
recipes.text: Pumpkin Pancakes. Sift together the first 7 ingredients. Beat the next 5 ingredients together, then blend into dry ingredients. For each pancake, pour about 1/4 cup batter onto a hot, lightly greased griddle. Turn pancakes when tops are covered with bubbles and edges look dark. Serve immediately. Yields 20 (4-inch) pancakes.

recipes.title: Chicken Rice Scallop
ingredients: 1 c. uncooked rice, cooked (3 c. cooked)
directions: Alternate layers of rice, chicken, pimento, peppers and mushrooms, ending with rice.
Brown bread crumbs in butter and spread over top. Thicken broth with flour and pour over all. Bake 45 minutes at 350°.
recipes.text: Chicken Rice Scallop. Alternate layers of rice, chicken, pimento, peppers and mushrooms, ending with rice. Brown bread crumbs in butter and spread over top. Thicken broth with flour and pour over all. Bake 45 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Oatmeal Cake
directions: Pour boiling water over oats and margarine.
Let stand 20 minutes.
Add sugars, eggs and vanilla.
Sift in remaining ingredients.
Mix well.
Bake at 350° for 35 minutes.
recipes.text: Oatmeal Cake. Pour boiling water over oats and margarine. Let stand 20 minutes. Add sugars, eggs and vanilla. Sift in remaining ingredients. Mix well. Bake at 350° for 35 minutes.

recipes.title: Curried Salad Dressing
directions: Mix everything together, except the milk. If too thick, add enough milk to reach pouring consistency. Refrigerate 1 to 2 hours to allow the flavors to develop.
recipes.text: Curried Salad Dressing. Mix everything together, except the milk. If too thick, add enough milk to reach pouring consistency. Refrigerate 1 to 2 hours to allow the flavors to develop.

recipes.title: Shrimp And Papaya Salad
ingredients: 1 head bibb lettuce, washed and dried
directions: Bring a pot with enough water to cover the shrimp to a boil. Add the shrimp and cook only until pink (about 5 minutes).
Drain, rinse with cold water, peel, shell and remove any black vein, then chill in the refrigerator.
Mix the parsley into the mayonnaise. Cut papaya in slices or large cubes.
Toss the shrimp and papaya in the mayonnaise until well coated.
Add salt to taste.
Arrange the shrimp mixture on lettuce leaves.
recipes.text: Shrimp And Papaya Salad. Bring a pot with enough water to cover the shrimp to a boil. Add the shrimp and cook only until pink (about 5 minutes). Drain, rinse with cold water, peel, shell and remove any black vein, then chill in the refrigerator. Mix the parsley into the mayonnaise. Cut papaya in slices or large cubes. Toss the shrimp and papaya in the mayonnaise until well coated. Add salt to taste. Arrange the shrimp mixture on lettuce leaves.

recipes.title: Sherbet Punch
directions: Pour ginger ale over sherbet and serve as a beverage.
recipes.text: Sherbet Punch. Pour ginger ale over sherbet and serve as a beverage.

recipes.title: Broccoli Casserole
ingredients: 8 oz. Cheez Whiz or American cheese
directions: Saute first 3 ingredients.
Stir together next 5 ingredients. Put in casserole and bake 350°
for 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Broccoli Casserole. Saute first 3 ingredients. Stir together next 5 ingredients. Put in casserole and bake 350° for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Beer Bread
directions: Mix all ingredients together and pour into greased bread pan. Bake at 350° to 375° for 1 hour.
For a variety, add 2 tablespoons onion soup mix or 1/2 cup grated cheese.
Makes 1 loaf.
recipes.text: Beer Bread. Mix all ingredients together and pour into greased bread pan. Bake at 350° to 375° for 1 hour. For a variety, add 2 tablespoons onion soup mix or 1/2 cup grated cheese. Makes 1 loaf.

recipes.title: Carrot Salad
directions: Combine all ingredients; stir well.
Cover and chill for 2 to 3 hours.
Yields 6 servings.
recipes.text: Carrot Salad. Combine all ingredients; stir well. Cover and chill for 2 to 3 hours. Yields 6 servings.

recipes.title: Honey Crusted Ham
directions: Bake ham according
to	directions.
Mix
together
all ingredients.
Thirty minutes before
ham is done, spread glaze over top and sides of ham.	Continue to bake.
recipes.text: Honey Crusted Ham. Bake ham according to	directions. Mix together all ingredients. Thirty minutes before ham is done, spread glaze over top and sides of ham.	Continue to bake.

recipes.title: Late Nite Noodle Special
directions: Cook macaroni until tender.
Rinse, heat margarine and tomato juice until margarine is melted.
Add to noodles.
Nice for a late night snack.
recipes.text: Late Nite Noodle Special. Cook macaroni until tender. Rinse, heat margarine and tomato juice until margarine is melted. Add to noodles. Nice for a late night snack.

recipes.title: Spanish Delight
directions: Brown the ground beef and onion; drain. Add cooked noodles and other ingredients. Put layer of meat mixture in casserole dish; cover with 1/2 the cheese. Add another layer of meat mixture and top with remaining cheese. Bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes or until the cheese is melted.
recipes.text: Spanish Delight. Brown the ground beef and onion; drain. Add cooked noodles and other ingredients. Put layer of meat mixture in casserole dish; cover with 1/2 the cheese. Add another layer of meat mixture and top with remaining cheese. Bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes or until the cheese is melted.

recipes.title: Sausage Cheese Balls
directions: Mix together.
Shape in melon size balls.
Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes.
recipes.text: Sausage Cheese Balls. Mix together. Shape in melon size balls. Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Fruit Pizza
ingredients: fresh fruit (kiwi, strawberries, pineapple, Mandarin oranges, etc.)
directions: Spread cookie dough in pizza pan.
Bake according to package directions.
Cool completely.
Mix cream cheese, Cool Whip and powdered sugar.
Spread on cooled cookie.
Top with sliced fruits of your choice.
Chill before serving.
recipes.text: Fruit Pizza. Spread cookie dough in pizza pan. Bake according to package directions. Cool completely. Mix cream cheese, Cool Whip and powdered sugar. Spread on cooled cookie. Top with sliced fruits of your choice. Chill before serving.

recipes.title: Mom'S Pumpkin Pie
directions: Line pie pans with unbaked pastry.
Preheat oven at 450°. Combine pumpkin, sugar and remaining ingredients.
(If desire, use 2 teaspoons cinnamon, 3/4 teaspoon ginger and 1/2 teaspoon nutmeg instead of pumpkin pie spice.)
Bake at 450° for 10 minutes.
Reduce heat quickly (leave oven door slightly open for 5 minutes) to 325°.
Continue baking for 30 minutes at 325° or unti knife inserted in center comes out clean.
recipes.text: Mom'S Pumpkin Pie. Line pie pans with unbaked pastry. Preheat oven at 450°. Combine pumpkin, sugar and remaining ingredients. (If desire, use 2 teaspoons cinnamon, 3/4 teaspoon ginger and 1/2 teaspoon nutmeg instead of pumpkin pie spice.) Bake at 450° for 10 minutes. Reduce heat quickly (leave oven door slightly open for 5 minutes) to 325°. Continue baking for 30 minutes at 325° or unti knife inserted in center comes out clean.

recipes.title: Seafood Delight Salad
directions: Chop crabmeat, olives, celery and onions. Cook pasta and cool. Mix all ingredients together. Add salad dressing to your liking.
recipes.text: Seafood Delight Salad. Chop crabmeat, olives, celery and onions. Cook pasta and cool. Mix all ingredients together. Add salad dressing to your liking.

recipes.title: Easy Rice Dish
directions: In 13 x 9 Pyrex, melt butter. Add other ingredients. Cover and bake 45 to 50 minutes at 350°. It's great with or without the chicken or mushrooms!
recipes.text: Easy Rice Dish. In 13 x 9 Pyrex, melt butter. Add other ingredients. Cover and bake 45 to 50 minutes at 350°. It's great with or without the chicken or mushrooms!

recipes.title: Overnight Chili
ingredients: 2 (1 lb.) cans pinto or kidney beans, drained
2 lb. ground chuck, browned and drained
directions: Pour beans, tomatoes, beef, pepper and onion and add spices. Make sure you layer the mixture as it is directed.
Stir up and cover and cook over low heat for 10 to 12 hours or 5 to 6 hours in crock-pot.
recipes.text: Overnight Chili. Pour beans, tomatoes, beef, pepper and onion and add spices. Make sure you layer the mixture as it is directed. Stir up and cover and cook over low heat for 10 to 12 hours or 5 to 6 hours in crock-pot.

recipes.title: Chicken Breast
ingredients: your choice of oil, butter or margarine
lemon pepper seasoning (as much as you like)
a dash of salt and pepper
directions: This may be cooked on top of the stove or baked. I add a little water after the chicken has browned and cover for a few minutes to steam. Then uncover and continue cooking. A side dish of rice and a salad makes a light dinner/supper.
recipes.text: Chicken Breast. This may be cooked on top of the stove or baked. I add a little water after the chicken has browned and cover for a few minutes to steam. Then uncover and continue cooking. A side dish of rice and a salad makes a light dinner/supper.

recipes.title: Waldorf Salad
directions: Combine all ingredients and toss. Serve in chilled bowl or mound salad in lettuce cups and garnish with cherries.
recipes.text: Waldorf Salad. Combine all ingredients and toss. Serve in chilled bowl or mound salad in lettuce cups and garnish with cherries.

recipes.title: Alaskan Fruit Salad
directions: Drain all fruits well.
Mix all ingredients together well. Refrigerate overnight before serving.
recipes.text: Alaskan Fruit Salad. Drain all fruits well. Mix all ingredients together well. Refrigerate overnight before serving.

recipes.title: Cornmeal Soup
directions: Boil chicken, oleo, celery, onions, salt and pepper.
Remove from stock; cool.
Debone chicken.
Add cream of chicken soup, deboned chicken and sprinkle cornmeal into boiling soup a pinch at a time while stirring.
recipes.text: Cornmeal Soup. Boil chicken, oleo, celery, onions, salt and pepper. Remove from stock; cool. Debone chicken. Add cream of chicken soup, deboned chicken and sprinkle cornmeal into boiling soup a pinch at a time while stirring.

recipes.title: Carolyn'S Secret Sausage Appetizer
directions: Cut sausage into 1/2-inch rounds.
In 5-quart pot, cook beer and brown sugar together until sugar dissolves.
Add sausage and bring to boil, then turn heat down to simmer for 30 to 45 minutes. Even better if it could sit for a while after that so sausage can absorb the flavor.
recipes.text: Carolyn'S Secret Sausage Appetizer. Cut sausage into 1/2-inch rounds. In 5-quart pot, cook beer and brown sugar together until sugar dissolves. Add sausage and bring to boil, then turn heat down to simmer for 30 to 45 minutes. Even better if it could sit for a while after that so sausage can absorb the flavor.

recipes.title: Baked Pineapple Stuffing
directions: Cream together butter and sugar; beat in eggs one at a time. Stir in pineapple.
Fold in bread cubes.
Turn into greased 1 1/2-quart casserole dish.
Bake uncovered at 350° for 1 hour. Serve with ham.
recipes.text: Baked Pineapple Stuffing. Cream together butter and sugar; beat in eggs one at a time. Stir in pineapple. Fold in bread cubes. Turn into greased 1 1/2-quart casserole dish. Bake uncovered at 350° for 1 hour. Serve with ham.

recipes.title: Banana Bread Muffins
directions: Cream margarine and sugar.
Add eggs and mix well.
Add bananas and mix.
Sift dry ingredients and add to creamed mixture. Beat until smooth.
Pour into greased or paper-lined muffin tin. Bake 20 minutes at 350°.
recipes.text: Banana Bread Muffins. Cream margarine and sugar. Add eggs and mix well. Add bananas and mix. Sift dry ingredients and add to creamed mixture. Beat until smooth. Pour into greased or paper-lined muffin tin. Bake 20 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Mushroom-Eggplant Soup
directions: Heat oil in a large, heavy saucepan.
Add the onions and saute until tender, about 8 minutes.
Add the garlic and mushrooms and saute another few minutes, then stir in the thyme.
Add the eggplant, tomatoes and stock and simmer gently until the eggplant is tender, about 20 minutes.
Allow to cool briefly then puree in blender or food processor.
You may have to do in batches.
Return the puree to saucepan.
Season with salt and pepper.
Stir in the sliced mushrooms.
Add cooked small pasta, if desired.
Simmer 5 more minutes.
Serve.
Makes 6 to 8 servings.
recipes.text: Mushroom-Eggplant Soup. Heat oil in a large, heavy saucepan. Add the onions and saute until tender, about 8 minutes. Add the garlic and mushrooms and saute another few minutes, then stir in the thyme. Add the eggplant, tomatoes and stock and simmer gently until the eggplant is tender, about 20 minutes. Allow to cool briefly then puree in blender or food processor. You may have to do in batches. Return the puree to saucepan. Season with salt and pepper. Stir in the sliced mushrooms. Add cooked small pasta, if desired. Simmer 5 more minutes. Serve. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

recipes.title: Skewered Shrimp Grilled Or Broiled On Skewers
ingredients: 1/2 tsp. grated fresh ginger or 1/4 tsp. ground ginger
1 to 1 1/2 lb. medium shrimp, shelled and deveined
directions: Mix sherry, soy sauce (low salt), sugar, ginger and garlic. Heat above; cool to room temperature.
Thread clean shrimp lengthwise on the skewer.
Place on platter; brush with sauce on all sides.
Put in fridge for about 1 hour.
Grill over medium coals or under broiler for 4 to 6 minutes, depending upon size of shrimp.
Turn once; brush again with sauce until glazed to perfection.
Serve hot to delighted guests.
Can be main dish or super party appetizers.
recipes.text: Skewered Shrimp Grilled Or Broiled On Skewers. Mix sherry, soy sauce (low salt), sugar, ginger and garlic. Heat above; cool to room temperature. Thread clean shrimp lengthwise on the skewer. Place on platter; brush with sauce on all sides. Put in fridge for about 1 hour. Grill over medium coals or under broiler for 4 to 6 minutes, depending upon size of shrimp. Turn once; brush again with sauce until glazed to perfection. Serve hot to delighted guests. Can be main dish or super party appetizers.

recipes.title: Dennis' Famous Chili
ingredients: 2 to 8 Tbsp. chili powder (to your taste)
sprinkling of salt, pepper and paprika
pinch of cayenne or hot chili sauce
directions: In 1/2-inch oil, saute until soft the onions, peppers and garlic.
In another pan, brown the beef. Drain fat from beef and add beef to onions and peppers. Add the tomatoes, tomato paste and chili powder.
Add the sugar, salt, pepper, paprika, bay leaves, cumin, basil and cayenne or hot chili sauce. Simmer all for at least 1 1/2 hours, then add the kidney beans.
Makes 6 to 8 servings.
recipes.text: Dennis' Famous Chili. In 1/2-inch oil, saute until soft the onions, peppers and garlic. In another pan, brown the beef. Drain fat from beef and add beef to onions and peppers. Add the tomatoes, tomato paste and chili powder. Add the sugar, salt, pepper, paprika, bay leaves, cumin, basil and cayenne or hot chili sauce. Simmer all for at least 1 1/2 hours, then add the kidney beans. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

recipes.title: Mexican Crescent Bake
ingredients: 1 (8 oz.) can quick crescent dinner rolls
directions: Preheat oven to 375°.
Brown ground beef with onion and seasoning mix. Drain. Stir in refried beans.
Separate dinner rolls into two rectangles.
In a 13 x 9-inch pan, ungreased, press over bottom and 1/2 sides up to form crust sealing perforations.
Spoon meat mixture over crust.
Sprinkle with olives.
recipes.text: Mexican Crescent Bake. Preheat oven to 375°. Brown ground beef with onion and seasoning mix. Drain. Stir in refried beans. Separate dinner rolls into two rectangles. In a 13 x 9-inch pan, ungreased, press over bottom and 1/2 sides up to form crust sealing perforations. Spoon meat mixture over crust. Sprinkle with olives.

recipes.title: Vanilla Caramels
directions: Combine sugar, 1 cup of half-and-half, syrup and butter.
Cook over medium heat for 7 to 8 minutes until mixture comes to a full boil.
Add remaining half-and-half and cook at a slow boil until mixture reaches 245 degrees on a candy thermometer (this takes a while).
Add vanilla.
Pour into a greased 8 or 9 inch square pan and let cool.
Cut into pieces.
recipes.text: Vanilla Caramels. Combine sugar, 1 cup of half-and-half, syrup and butter. Cook over medium heat for 7 to 8 minutes until mixture comes to a full boil. Add remaining half-and-half and cook at a slow boil until mixture reaches 245 degrees on a candy thermometer (this takes a while). Add vanilla. Pour into a greased 8 or 9 inch square pan and let cool. Cut into pieces.

recipes.title: Baked Beans
directions: Brown ground beef; add salt, pepper, garlic powder, onions and chopped green pepper to taste.
Add remaining ingredients. Bake at 325° for approximately 1 1/2 to 2 hours.
recipes.text: Baked Beans. Brown ground beef; add salt, pepper, garlic powder, onions and chopped green pepper to taste. Add remaining ingredients. Bake at 325° for approximately 1 1/2 to 2 hours.

recipes.title: Quiche
directions: For best results, heat pie crust in a 400° oven for about 5 minutes.
Saute onion in oleo in saucepan for about 5 minutes. Pour in pie crust.
Add grated cheese, then eggs.
Season eggs with dash of salt, pepper and seasoned salt.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
Serve with bacon, ham, sausage or Spam.
Good wintertime evening meal.
recipes.text: Quiche. For best results, heat pie crust in a 400° oven for about 5 minutes. Saute onion in oleo in saucepan for about 5 minutes. Pour in pie crust. Add grated cheese, then eggs. Season eggs with dash of salt, pepper and seasoned salt. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes. Serve with bacon, ham, sausage or Spam. Good wintertime evening meal.

recipes.title: Veggie Bars
directions: Press crescent roll dough into ungreased 12 x 24-inch pan, forming a rectangle.
Seal the perforations and form a 1 inch crust on sides.
Bake as directed and cool completely.
recipes.text: Veggie Bars. Press crescent roll dough into ungreased 12 x 24-inch pan, forming a rectangle. Seal the perforations and form a 1 inch crust on sides. Bake as directed and cool completely.

recipes.title: Southern Party Potatoes
ingredients: 1 can cream of chicken soup or celery soup
1 small jar Cheez Whiz or 2 c. grated cheese
directions: Defrost potatoes.
Combine butter, salt, pepper, onion, soup, sour cream and cheese.
Mix thoroughly.
Pour over potatoes into 3-quart casserole.
Mix 1/4 cup butter and cornflakes; sprinkle over top.
Cover and bake at 350° for 45 minutes.
Serves 16.
ner: cream of chicken soup or celery soup
recipes.text: Southern Party Potatoes. Defrost potatoes. Combine butter, salt, pepper, onion, soup, sour cream and cheese. Mix thoroughly. Pour over potatoes into 3-quart casserole. Mix 1/4 cup butter and cornflakes; sprinkle over top. Cover and bake at 350° for 45 minutes. Serves 16.

recipes.title: Mint Cookies
directions: Melt wax slowly in pan on stove.
Add chocolate chips and peppermint oil.
Dip crackers and place on wax paper.
recipes.text: Mint Cookies. Melt wax slowly in pan on stove. Add chocolate chips and peppermint oil. Dip crackers and place on wax paper.

recipes.title: Microwave Chicken 'N Rice Casserole
directions: Mix soups and water together.
Add rice.
Pour into deep baking dish (8 x 8-inch Pyrex).
Cover with wax paper or plastic wrap.
Cook in radar range (covered) on Full power for 4 minutes. Place pieces of chicken on rice mixture.
Cover again and cook on Full power 18 to 20 minutes.
Turn chicken over 1 or 2 times during cooking.
recipes.text: Microwave Chicken 'N Rice Casserole. Mix soups and water together. Add rice. Pour into deep baking dish (8 x 8-inch Pyrex). Cover with wax paper or plastic wrap. Cook in radar range (covered) on Full power for 4 minutes. Place pieces of chicken on rice mixture. Cover again and cook on Full power 18 to 20 minutes. Turn chicken over 1 or 2 times during cooking.

recipes.title: Gracie'S Shaky Pudding
directions: Follow the directions on the pudding box to make the pudding. Stir in the fruit cocktail and it's ready to serve!
recipes.text: Gracie'S Shaky Pudding. Follow the directions on the pudding box to make the pudding. Stir in the fruit cocktail and it's ready to serve!

recipes.title: Zucchini Squares
ingredients: 3 c. thinly sliced zucchini (3 to 4 small)
directions: Mix all ingredients.
Grease 9 x 13-inch pan or use Pam.
Pour mixture into pan and spread.
Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.
May add sliced pepperoni if like.
Serve warm.
Good for brunches or potluck suppers.
recipes.text: Zucchini Squares. Mix all ingredients. Grease 9 x 13-inch pan or use Pam. Pour mixture into pan and spread. Bake at 350° for 25 minutes. May add sliced pepperoni if like. Serve warm. Good for brunches or potluck suppers.

recipes.title: Tuna Casserole(Serves 6 To 8)
ingredients: 2 c. (7 oz.) macaroni, cooked and drained
1 (6 1/2 oz.) can tuna, drained and flaked
1 (10 oz.) pkg. frozen peas, cooked and drained
directions: Saute onion in margarine.
Blend in flour.
Gradually add milk.
Cook, stirring constantly, until thickened.
Add 1/2 pound of Velveeta cheese (cubed).
Stir until melted.
Add macaroni, peas, tuna and seasonings.
Mix well.
Pour into 2-quart casserole.
Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.
Top with cheese slices (cut in triangles).
Continue baking until cheese melts.
recipes.text: Tuna Casserole(Serves 6 To 8). Saute onion in margarine. Blend in flour. Gradually add milk. Cook, stirring constantly, until thickened. Add 1/2 pound of Velveeta cheese (cubed). Stir until melted. Add macaroni, peas, tuna and seasonings. Mix well. Pour into 2-quart casserole. Bake at 350° for 40 minutes. Top with cheese slices (cut in triangles). Continue baking until cheese melts.

recipes.title: Apricot Sparkle
directions: Pour 2 cups hot water over jello.
When dissolved, put in 1 1/2 cups cold water.
Refrigerate and start to congeal.
Mix flour, sugar and egg.
Add pineapple juice and butter.
Cook over low heat until thickens.
While still warm, add cream cheese. Whip instant whip and fold into custard after it has cooled. Set aside. Add nuts, pineapple, marshmallows and diced bananas to the jello mixture.
Put in flat dish and spread custard over; put in refrigerator.
recipes.text: Apricot Sparkle. Pour 2 cups hot water over jello. When dissolved, put in 1 1/2 cups cold water. Refrigerate and start to congeal. Mix flour, sugar and egg. Add pineapple juice and butter. Cook over low heat until thickens. While still warm, add cream cheese. Whip instant whip and fold into custard after it has cooled. Set aside. Add nuts, pineapple, marshmallows and diced bananas to the jello mixture. Put in flat dish and spread custard over; put in refrigerator.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Balls
directions: Combine butter, sugar and peanut butter and roll into balls. Dip in melted chocolate.
Place on wax paper.
recipes.text: Peanut Butter Balls. Combine butter, sugar and peanut butter and roll into balls. Dip in melted chocolate. Place on wax paper.

recipes.title: Zucchini Brownies
directions: Mix flour, cocoa and cinnamon together.
Add eggs, sugar, oil, vanilla and soda. Then add flour 1 cup at a time with buttermilk and zucchini.
Bake in 10 x 15-inch greased and floured pan at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes. Sprinkle on chocolate chips and nuts. Frost within 15 minutes after baking.
recipes.text: Zucchini Brownies. Mix flour, cocoa and cinnamon together. Add eggs, sugar, oil, vanilla and soda. Then add flour 1 cup at a time with buttermilk and zucchini. Bake in 10 x 15-inch greased and floured pan at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes. Sprinkle on chocolate chips and nuts. Frost within 15 minutes after baking.

recipes.title: Quick Apple Cake
directions: Mix cake as directed on box.
Pour into greased and floured 13 x 9-inch pan.
Drain apples.
Place apples on top of batter. Mix remaining ingredients together, except whipped topping, and sprinkle evenly over apples.
Bake at 350° for 35 minutes or until a toothpick inserted into cake comes out clean.
Cool and top with whipped topping.
recipes.text: Quick Apple Cake. Mix cake as directed on box. Pour into greased and floured 13 x 9-inch pan. Drain apples. Place apples on top of batter. Mix remaining ingredients together, except whipped topping, and sprinkle evenly over apples. Bake at 350° for 35 minutes or until a toothpick inserted into cake comes out clean. Cool and top with whipped topping.

recipes.title: Chicken Casserole
ingredients: red pepper, mushrooms or frozen peas (optional)
directions: Mix ingredients together and put in 9 x 12-inch pan, greased. Top with buttered bread crumbs or chips.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Chicken Casserole. Mix ingredients together and put in 9 x 12-inch pan, greased. Top with buttered bread crumbs or chips. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Pretty Good Cake
directions: Preheat oven to 350°.
Spread pie filling in bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan.
Combine flour, sugar, salt and soda; sprinkle over filling.
In bowl, combine eggs, vanilla and oil; mix well.
Pour over other ingredients.
Stir only until blended in pan.
Bake for 40 to 45 minutes.
Ice with ready made cream cheese frosting.
May be served warm, unfrosted, with ice cream.
recipes.text: Pretty Good Cake. Preheat oven to 350°. Spread pie filling in bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan. Combine flour, sugar, salt and soda; sprinkle over filling. In bowl, combine eggs, vanilla and oil; mix well. Pour over other ingredients. Stir only until blended in pan. Bake for 40 to 45 minutes. Ice with ready made cream cheese frosting. May be served warm, unfrosted, with ice cream.

recipes.title: Chicken Deluxe Casserole
directions: Mix stuffing and butter together.
Press half of mixture in lightly greased 9 x 13-inch baker.
Mix the remaining ingredients together and pour over stuffing.
Sprinkle remaining stuffing on top.
Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.
recipes.text: Chicken Deluxe Casserole. Mix stuffing and butter together. Press half of mixture in lightly greased 9 x 13-inch baker. Mix the remaining ingredients together and pour over stuffing. Sprinkle remaining stuffing on top. Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Chopped Steak Supreme
ingredients: 3 lb. ground chuck or round of beef
directions: In a large bowl, combine first 5 ingredients. Blend well. Form into 8 thick patties about 3 1/2-inches in diameter and 1 1/2 to 2-inches thick. Combine soy sauce, molasses and chili sauce. Arrange patties on grill. Brush with soy sauce mixture. Cook, turning frequently and brushing with sauce.
Cook to desired doneness.
Makes 8 generous steaks.
recipes.text: Chopped Steak Supreme. In a large bowl, combine first 5 ingredients. Blend well. Form into 8 thick patties about 3 1/2-inches in diameter and 1 1/2 to 2-inches thick. Combine soy sauce, molasses and chili sauce. Arrange patties on grill. Brush with soy sauce mixture. Cook, turning frequently and brushing with sauce. Cook to desired doneness. Makes 8 generous steaks.

recipes.title: Buttermilk Pie 1
directions: Cream butter, sugar, flour, vanilla and nutmeg.
Add eggs and buttermilk, stirring until mixed.
Put in dash of salt, if desired.
Pour in unbaked pie shell.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Buttermilk Pie 1. Cream butter, sugar, flour, vanilla and nutmeg. Add eggs and buttermilk, stirring until mixed. Put in dash of salt, if desired. Pour in unbaked pie shell. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Macaroni Skillet
directions: Brown beef in skillet.
Add onion and garlic.
Cook until tender.
Add tomatoes.
Stir in bouillon, Worcestershire sauce, salt, pepper, mushrooms with liquid and macaroni.
Bring to boil. Reduce heat.
Cover and simmer for 30 minutes, stirring occasionally, until macaroni is tender and most of liquid is absorbed.
Sprinkle with parsley.
recipes.text: Macaroni Skillet. Brown beef in skillet. Add onion and garlic. Cook until tender. Add tomatoes. Stir in bouillon, Worcestershire sauce, salt, pepper, mushrooms with liquid and macaroni. Bring to boil. Reduce heat. Cover and simmer for 30 minutes, stirring occasionally, until macaroni is tender and most of liquid is absorbed. Sprinkle with parsley.

recipes.title: Chicken Breasts Supreme
directions: Arrange chicken in shallow baking dish, making sure there is no overlapping.
Cover with the mushrooms.
Combine undiluted soups together, then a little at a time, blend in the wine and sour cream.
Spread over chicken completely covering all. Sprinkle almonds over sauce, dust with paprika and bake in a 350° oven for 1 1/2 hours.
recipes.text: Chicken Breasts Supreme. Arrange chicken in shallow baking dish, making sure there is no overlapping. Cover with the mushrooms. Combine undiluted soups together, then a little at a time, blend in the wine and sour cream. Spread over chicken completely covering all. Sprinkle almonds over sauce, dust with paprika and bake in a 350° oven for 1 1/2 hours.

recipes.title: Chocolate Creamy Fudge
ingredients: 1 (5 oz.) can evaporated milk about 3/4 cup
1 1/2 cup jet puffed Marshmallow cream, about 13 oz. jar
directions: Lightly grease 9 x 9 x 2 pan. Set aside. Heat sugar, butter, milk and marshmallow cream in heavy 3 qt. sauce pan, over medium heat until mixture boils, stirring constantly. Boil and stir, 5 minutes. Add chocolate chips and vanilla. Beat till chips are melted. Stir in walnuts. Immediately spread into greased pan. Refrigerate over night, cut into 1 inch squares. Store in air tight container in refrigerator. For creamer fudge, set out 1 hour before serving.
recipes.text: Chocolate Creamy Fudge. Lightly grease 9 x 9 x 2 pan. Set aside. Heat sugar, butter, milk and marshmallow cream in heavy 3 qt. sauce pan, over medium heat until mixture boils, stirring constantly. Boil and stir, 5 minutes. Add chocolate chips and vanilla. Beat till chips are melted. Stir in walnuts. Immediately spread into greased pan. Refrigerate over night, cut into 1 inch squares. Store in air tight container in refrigerator. For creamer fudge, set out 1 hour before serving.

recipes.title: Rick'S Favorite Birthday Cake
ingredients: 1 box instant vanilla pudding (I use diet)
directions: Mix all and pour into greased and floured Bundt pan.
(I have used 9 x 13-inch pan in past.)
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes for 9 x 13-inch and one hour for a Bundt pan.
recipes.text: Rick'S Favorite Birthday Cake. Mix all and pour into greased and floured Bundt pan. (I have used 9 x 13-inch pan in past.) Bake at 350° for 45 minutes for 9 x 13-inch and one hour for a Bundt pan.

recipes.title: Spaghetti Salad
directions: Cook spaghetti according to package directions.
Drain and rinse with cold water and drain well again.
Transfer to large bowl.
recipes.text: Spaghetti Salad. Cook spaghetti according to package directions. Drain and rinse with cold water and drain well again. Transfer to large bowl.

recipes.title: Coffee "Azuki" Jello
directions: Mix and soften gelatine in cold coffee. Add hot coffee. Stir until dissolved. Add the tsubushi an and condensed milk. Pour into 9 x 9 pan. Refrigerate until set. Cut into squares.
recipes.text: Coffee "Azuki" Jello. Mix and soften gelatine in cold coffee. Add hot coffee. Stir until dissolved. Add the tsubushi an and condensed milk. Pour into 9 x 9 pan. Refrigerate until set. Cut into squares.

recipes.title: Bran Muffins
directions: In large bowl, beat egg, milk and oil.
Stir in remaining ingredients.
Mix until flour is moistened (batter will be lumpy). Fill greased cupcake pan 3/4 full.
Bake at 400° until golden brown, about 18 to 20 minutes.
Remove immediately from pan. Serve hot with butter or margarine.
Makes 12 muffins.
recipes.text: Bran Muffins. In large bowl, beat egg, milk and oil. Stir in remaining ingredients. Mix until flour is moistened (batter will be lumpy). Fill greased cupcake pan 3/4 full. Bake at 400° until golden brown, about 18 to 20 minutes. Remove immediately from pan. Serve hot with butter or margarine. Makes 12 muffins.

recipes.title: Baked French Doughnuts
directions: Preheat oven to 350°.
Cream the margarine and sugar.
Beat in egg.
Add dry ingredients (mixed together) alternately with milk. Fill greased muffin tins half full.
Bake 25 minutes.
When done, brush with melted butter and roll in mixture of 1/2 cup of sugar and 1/2 teaspoon of cinnamon.
Makes 1 dozen.
recipes.text: Baked French Doughnuts. Preheat oven to 350°. Cream the margarine and sugar. Beat in egg. Add dry ingredients (mixed together) alternately with milk. Fill greased muffin tins half full. Bake 25 minutes. When done, brush with melted butter and roll in mixture of 1/2 cup of sugar and 1/2 teaspoon of cinnamon. Makes 1 dozen.

recipes.title: Bean Soup
directions: Rinse and soak beans overnight in 4 to 6 cups water, changing water once or twice. In a large pot or Dutch oven, place ham bone, sausage, onion, celery and 3 or 4 cups water. Simmer for a couple of hours. Remove from stove. Refrigerate overnight. Next day, return soup to stove after removing most of fat which rises to top. Heat on medium-low and remove ham bone, leaving as much ham in the pot as desired. Add tomatoes, carrots, additional water if needed and potatoes. Increase heat to medium and cook for 1 hour. Drain and rinse beans and add to soup, simmering for 2 hours. Season with black pepper or a dash of hot sauce, if desired. Preparation time: 30 minutes. Cooking time: 4 to 5 hours.
recipes.text: Bean Soup. Rinse and soak beans overnight in 4 to 6 cups water, changing water once or twice. In a large pot or Dutch oven, place ham bone, sausage, onion, celery and 3 or 4 cups water. Simmer for a couple of hours. Remove from stove. Refrigerate overnight. Next day, return soup to stove after removing most of fat which rises to top. Heat on medium-low and remove ham bone, leaving as much ham in the pot as desired. Add tomatoes, carrots, additional water if needed and potatoes. Increase heat to medium and cook for 1 hour. Drain and rinse beans and add to soup, simmering for 2 hours. Season with black pepper or a dash of hot sauce, if desired. Preparation time: 30 minutes. Cooking time: 4 to 5 hours.

recipes.title: "Ship Wreck"

and
slice
potatoes

bottom

casserole
dish.
Salt
and pepper to taste.
Add layer of carrots
and celery and then beans.
Brown onion and ground beef. Put on top then add tomato soup.
Cover and bake at 350° for
hours.
Uncover and let brown the last 15 minutes.
recipes.text: "Ship Wreck". Peel and slice potatoes in bottom of well-greased 2-inch deep casserole dish. Salt and pepper to taste. Add layer of carrots and celery and then beans. Brown onion and ground beef. Put on top then add tomato soup. Cover and bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours. Uncover and let brown the last 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Pork And Apple Stew With Rosemary
ingredients: 3 c. peeled, tart apples, thickly sliced
directions: Mix together the flour, salt and pepper in a bag or a large bowl.
Add cubed pork a few pieces at a time and coat lightly; set aside.
In a large Dutch oven or casserole dish, heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil.
Add garlic and onions and saute until onions are clear.
Remove and set aside.
Add a little oil to same pan and, over medium heat, brown meat; set aside.
Raise temperature under pan.
Add cider and stir to get up bits at the bottom.
Put all ingredients into pan.
Stir.
Bring to boiling.
Cover and cook in oven for about 1 hour or until meat is tender.
recipes.text: Pork And Apple Stew With Rosemary. Mix together the flour, salt and pepper in a bag or a large bowl. Add cubed pork a few pieces at a time and coat lightly; set aside. In a large Dutch oven or casserole dish, heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil. Add garlic and onions and saute until onions are clear. Remove and set aside. Add a little oil to same pan and, over medium heat, brown meat; set aside. Raise temperature under pan. Add cider and stir to get up bits at the bottom. Put all ingredients into pan. Stir. Bring to boiling. Cover and cook in oven for about 1 hour or until meat is tender.

recipes.title: Easy Onion Soup
ingredients: 4 oz. Swiss or Gruyere cheese, sliced
directions: In covered saucepan, cook onions and garlic in butter over low heat for 20 minutes.
Add stock and wine with 1/4 teaspoon pepper. Bring to boiling.
Cover and simmer for 15 minutes.
Toast bread. Top each with sliced cheese.
Sprinkle with Parmesan.
Broil for 2 minutes, or until cheese melts.
Ladle soups into 4 bowls.
Top each with a toast slice.
Makes 4 servings.
recipes.text: Easy Onion Soup. In covered saucepan, cook onions and garlic in butter over low heat for 20 minutes. Add stock and wine with 1/4 teaspoon pepper. Bring to boiling. Cover and simmer for 15 minutes. Toast bread. Top each with sliced cheese. Sprinkle with Parmesan. Broil for 2 minutes, or until cheese melts. Ladle soups into 4 bowls. Top each with a toast slice. Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: Tiny'S Slaw
directions: Grate cabbage and carrots.
Mix vinegar and sugar and then combine with mayonnaise.
Toss dressing with cabbage and carrots. Chill.
recipes.text: Tiny'S Slaw. Grate cabbage and carrots. Mix vinegar and sugar and then combine with mayonnaise. Toss dressing with cabbage and carrots. Chill.

recipes.title: Veal Patty Scallopini
directions: Combine the egg, milk, bread crumbs, salt and pepper.
Add ground veal; mix well.
Shape mixture into 6 patties; coat with flour.
In skillet, brown patties in hot Crisco; drain off fat. Combine tomato sauce, undrained mushrooms, water, parsley, crushed oregano and garlic powder; pour over meat.
Cover; simmer 20 to 25 minutes.
recipes.text: Veal Patty Scallopini. Combine the egg, milk, bread crumbs, salt and pepper. Add ground veal; mix well. Shape mixture into 6 patties; coat with flour. In skillet, brown patties in hot Crisco; drain off fat. Combine tomato sauce, undrained mushrooms, water, parsley, crushed oregano and garlic powder; pour over meat. Cover; simmer 20 to 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Chicken Almondine
ingredients: 1 Stewing chicken (salt to taste; save broth)
1 Pkg. M.J.B rice (herb) or Herb Rice-a Roni will work too
directions: Cook chicken until tender (not soft).
Remove from bone and cut into fairly large pieces. Cook celery in broth till crisp tender. Cook rice following directions of package
using chicken broth for liquid.
Mix all ingredients but reserve some of the almonds to sprinkle on top.
Bake 45 minutes in 350 degrees oven. Too moist - cook longer.
recipes.text: Chicken Almondine. Cook chicken until tender (not soft). Remove from bone and cut into fairly large pieces. Cook celery in broth till crisp tender. Cook rice following directions of package using chicken broth for liquid. Mix all ingredients but reserve some of the almonds to sprinkle on top. Bake 45 minutes in 350 degrees oven. Too moist - cook longer.

recipes.title: Lemon Chess Pie
directions: Beat eggs, add melted oleo and other ingredients.
Pour into a 9-inch deep unbaked pie crust.
Bake at 350° for about 1 hour.
recipes.text: Lemon Chess Pie. Beat eggs, add melted oleo and other ingredients. Pour into a 9-inch deep unbaked pie crust. Bake at 350° for about 1 hour.

recipes.title: Thai Noodles With Spicy Peanut Sauce
ingredients: 1 bunch of scallions, diced, for garnish
directions: Cook linguine.	Rinse, drain and toss with olive oil.
Cut veggies into matchsticks or dice. Toss sauce with noodles and vegetables.
Garnish with scallions and sesame seeds.
Can be served hot or cold.
(If serving hot, blanch veggies).
recipes.text: Thai Noodles With Spicy Peanut Sauce. Cook linguine.	Rinse, drain and toss with olive oil. Cut veggies into matchsticks or dice. Toss sauce with noodles and vegetables. Garnish with scallions and sesame seeds. Can be served hot or cold. (If serving hot, blanch veggies).

recipes.title: Cheese Ball
directions: Mix all ingredients together; roll into ball and chill. Serve with your favorite crackers.
recipes.text: Cheese Ball. Mix all ingredients together; roll into ball and chill. Serve with your favorite crackers.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Cake
directions: Place sugar, oil and pumpkin in large mixer bowl and beat well at medium speed.
Add eggs one at a time, beating well after each. Sift flour, baking powder, soda, cinnamon and salt together and fold into batter.
Stir in nuts and raisins.
Pour into greased and floured 10-inch tube pan.
Bake at 350° for 1 1/4 hours or until done.
Do not open oven door under 1 hour.
Let cool slightly in pan before turning onto cake rack.
recipes.text: Pumpkin Cake. Place sugar, oil and pumpkin in large mixer bowl and beat well at medium speed. Add eggs one at a time, beating well after each. Sift flour, baking powder, soda, cinnamon and salt together and fold into batter. Stir in nuts and raisins. Pour into greased and floured 10-inch tube pan. Bake at 350° for 1 1/4 hours or until done. Do not open oven door under 1 hour. Let cool slightly in pan before turning onto cake rack.

recipes.title: Seafood Croissants
ingredients: 3 oz. each: cooked crab, bay shrimp and Langostino
directions: Preheat oven to 350°.
Mix cream cheese, sour cream and mayonnaise until smooth.
Add seafood, salt and Tabasco.
Spread seafood mixture on sliced croissants; top with Gruyere and sprinkle with paprika.
Bake 8 minutes or until cheese melts.
Top with sliced avocado (lightly fan for good appeal).
Serve with fresh fruit.
Langostino can be substituted with crab or any seafood.
recipes.text: Seafood Croissants. Preheat oven to 350°. Mix cream cheese, sour cream and mayonnaise until smooth. Add seafood, salt and Tabasco. Spread seafood mixture on sliced croissants; top with Gruyere and sprinkle with paprika. Bake 8 minutes or until cheese melts. Top with sliced avocado (lightly fan for good appeal). Serve with fresh fruit. Langostino can be substituted with crab or any seafood.

recipes.title: Frozen Sandwich
directions: Add milk to peanut butter and blend until smooth.
Add pudding. On low speed, beat 1 to 2 minutes until smooth.
Let stand 5 minutes.
Spread 1/2-inch thick on 12 crackers.
Top with remaining crackers.
Press lightly and smooth around edges with spatula. Freeze until firm (about 3 hours).
Can be stored wrapped in freezer for 3 to 4 days.
Healthy, tasty dessert or snack for little ones.
recipes.text: Frozen Sandwich. Add milk to peanut butter and blend until smooth. Add pudding. On low speed, beat 1 to 2 minutes until smooth. Let stand 5 minutes. Spread 1/2-inch thick on 12 crackers. Top with remaining crackers. Press lightly and smooth around edges with spatula. Freeze until firm (about 3 hours). Can be stored wrapped in freezer for 3 to 4 days. Healthy, tasty dessert or snack for little ones.

recipes.title: Shrimp Dip
ingredients: 2 (4 oz.) glasses shrimp cocktail in sauce
directions: Soften cheese.
In a blender, add cheese and shrimp sauce. Chill and dip.
recipes.text: Shrimp Dip. Soften cheese. In a blender, add cheese and shrimp sauce. Chill and dip.

recipes.title: Lemon Cool Whip Cake
directions: Mix together the first 3 ingredients.
(It will be crumbly; press in with fingers.)
Bake for 10 minutes at 375°.
Cream the cream cheese and powdered sugar.
Fold in the Cool Whip and spread over.
Cook the lemon pie filling; let cool and spread on top of cream cheese layer.
Put Cool Whip on top.
Use a 10 x 4 x 2-inch or 9 1/2 x 13 1/2 x 2-inch pan.
recipes.text: Lemon Cool Whip Cake. Mix together the first 3 ingredients. (It will be crumbly; press in with fingers.) Bake for 10 minutes at 375°. Cream the cream cheese and powdered sugar. Fold in the Cool Whip and spread over. Cook the lemon pie filling; let cool and spread on top of cream cheese layer. Put Cool Whip on top. Use a 10 x 4 x 2-inch or 9 1/2 x 13 1/2 x 2-inch pan.

recipes.title: Blond Brownies(Chew Bread)
directions: Mix butter, sugar and eggs.
Add flour and vanilla.
Bake in greased and floured 13 x 9-inch pan at 325° for 1 hour.
May add 1 cup coconut, 3 cups chocolate chips or 1 cup nuts.
recipes.text: Blond Brownies(Chew Bread). Mix butter, sugar and eggs. Add flour and vanilla. Bake in greased and floured 13 x 9-inch pan at 325° for 1 hour. May add 1 cup coconut, 3 cups chocolate chips or 1 cup nuts.

recipes.title: Pineapple Cottage Cheese Salad
directions: Place pineapple with juice in a pot and let it heat up to a boil.
Add jello, stir until dissolved.
Set aside until cool. Mix Cool Whip and cottage cheese together.
Add cool pineapple mix. Beat with the mixer until fluffy.
Pour into a bowl and chill. Good as a dessert or part of the main course.
recipes.text: Pineapple Cottage Cheese Salad. Place pineapple with juice in a pot and let it heat up to a boil. Add jello, stir until dissolved. Set aside until cool. Mix Cool Whip and cottage cheese together. Add cool pineapple mix. Beat with the mixer until fluffy. Pour into a bowl and chill. Good as a dessert or part of the main course.

recipes.title: Cheese Ball
directions: Make sure cheese is room temperature.
Mix all ingredients. Refrigerate so you can shape into balls.
Use margarine or cooking oil on hands to prevent the mixture from sticking to hands.
Form into 2 balls.
Roll in chopped nuts.
Wrap in waxed paper. Refrigerate until ready to serve.
recipes.text: Cheese Ball. Make sure cheese is room temperature. Mix all ingredients. Refrigerate so you can shape into balls. Use margarine or cooking oil on hands to prevent the mixture from sticking to hands. Form into 2 balls. Roll in chopped nuts. Wrap in waxed paper. Refrigerate until ready to serve.

recipes.title: Dilled Tomatoes
ingredients: 1 large head dill or 2 smaller ones
directions: Wash and stem tomatoes.
(Be sure they have not started to turn.)
Place dill in bottom of 1-quart jar.
Fill jar to about 1 1/2 inches from top of jar with uncut tomatoes.
To each jar, add garlic and another head of dill.
recipes.text: Dilled Tomatoes. Wash and stem tomatoes. (Be sure they have not started to turn.) Place dill in bottom of 1-quart jar. Fill jar to about 1 1/2 inches from top of jar with uncut tomatoes. To each jar, add garlic and another head of dill.

recipes.title: Buckeyes
directions: Mix margarine, peanut butter, graham cracker crumbs, vanilla and sugar well with hands.
Roll in 1-inch balls and place on waxed paper.
recipes.text: Buckeyes. Mix margarine, peanut butter, graham cracker crumbs, vanilla and sugar well with hands. Roll in 1-inch balls and place on waxed paper.

recipes.title: Orange Slice Cake
ingredients: 1 tsp. soda dissolved in 1/2 c. buttermilk
directions: Cut dates and candy with kitchen shears.
Use 1/2 cup flour to coat the dates, candy and nuts.
Set aside orange slice candy, pecans, coconut and dates.
Mix butter and sugar in mixer.
Add eggs, then milk and flour.
Beat well.
Blend the fruit and nuts in dough with spoon.
Bake in a tube pan at 250° for 3 hours (about) or until done.
recipes.text: Orange Slice Cake. Cut dates and candy with kitchen shears. Use 1/2 cup flour to coat the dates, candy and nuts. Set aside orange slice candy, pecans, coconut and dates. Mix butter and sugar in mixer. Add eggs, then milk and flour. Beat well. Blend the fruit and nuts in dough with spoon. Bake in a tube pan at 250° for 3 hours (about) or until done.

recipes.title: Shrimp Canapes
directions: Mix shrimp, onion, mayonnaise, salt and pepper.
Spread on Ritz crackers or Club crackers.
Place slice of cheese on shrimp and sprinkle with paprika.
Bake at 375° for 10 minutes or until cheese starts to melt.
Serve hot.
recipes.text: Shrimp Canapes. Mix shrimp, onion, mayonnaise, salt and pepper. Spread on Ritz crackers or Club crackers. Place slice of cheese on shrimp and sprinkle with paprika. Bake at 375° for 10 minutes or until cheese starts to melt. Serve hot.

recipes.title: Sausage Meat Loaf
directions: Mix all ingredients together.
Place in bread pan.
Bake at 350° for 40 minutes, or until done.
recipes.text: Sausage Meat Loaf. Mix all ingredients together. Place in bread pan. Bake at 350° for 40 minutes, or until done.

recipes.title: Cherries Jubilee
ingredients: 1 (17 oz.) can dark sweet pitted cherries, drained (keep juice)
directions: In small saucepan, combine cherry juice, sugar and cinnamon. Bring to boil.
Reduce heat. Simmer 10 minutes or until syrupy. Add cherries.
Heat through.
Transfer to chafing dish.
Add brandy.
Ignite carefully. When flame dies, spoon over ice cream.
recipes.text: Cherries Jubilee. In small saucepan, combine cherry juice, sugar and cinnamon. Bring to boil. Reduce heat. Simmer 10 minutes or until syrupy. Add cherries. Heat through. Transfer to chafing dish. Add brandy. Ignite carefully. When flame dies, spoon over ice cream.

recipes.title: Fruit Salad(Macaroni Rings)
ingredients: juice from 1 large can chunk pineapple
directions: Cook macaroni rings.
Drain.
Boil together sugar, salt, flour, pineapple juice, lemon juice and eggs.
Pour over macaroni rings. Mix and refrigerate overnight.
Add fruit.
Whip 1 pint of whipping cream.
Mix all together.
Nuts and marshmallows can be added if desired.
recipes.text: Fruit Salad(Macaroni Rings). Cook macaroni rings. Drain. Boil together sugar, salt, flour, pineapple juice, lemon juice and eggs. Pour over macaroni rings.
