Mix and refrigerate overnight. Add fruit. Whip 1 pint of whipping cream. Mix all together. Nuts and marshmallows can be added if desired.

recipes.title: Festive Flamed Cherries
directions: Scoop ice cream into serving dishes.
Heat pie filling and spoon over ice cream.
Soak sugar cubes in rum or rum extract; place on cherries and ignite.
Makes a quick and easy festive dessert.
recipes.text: Festive Flamed Cherries. Scoop ice cream into serving dishes. Heat pie filling and spoon over ice cream. Soak sugar cubes in rum or rum extract; place on cherries and ignite. Makes a quick and easy festive dessert.

recipes.title: Calypso Beets
directions: Heat to boiling: pineapple, beet juice and vinegar.
Mix cornstarch and sugar and add to liquid.
Cook until thickened. Add drain beets, butter and salt.
Serve hot.
recipes.text: Calypso Beets. Heat to boiling: pineapple, beet juice and vinegar. Mix cornstarch and sugar and add to liquid. Cook until thickened. Add drain beets, butter and salt. Serve hot.

recipes.title: Apple Hill Cake
directions: Mix apples and sugar (let stand).
Mix eggs, oil and vanilla. Stir in apples and sugar.
Sift flour, soda, salt and cinnamon. Add to mixture.
Mix well, adding nuts.
Pour into greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan.
Bake in a 350° oven for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Apple Hill Cake. Mix apples and sugar (let stand). Mix eggs, oil and vanilla. Stir in apples and sugar. Sift flour, soda, salt and cinnamon. Add to mixture. Mix well, adding nuts. Pour into greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake in a 350° oven for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Poppy'S Favorite Cookies
ingredients: 1 pkg. (18.5 oz.) cake mix (yellow, strawberry, any)
directions: Mix cream cheese and butter until blended.
Blend in yolk and vanilla.
Add cake mix (dry), 1/3 at a time, mixing well after each addition.
If mixer is used, add last 1/3 by hand.
Cover and chill for at least 30 minutes.
Heat oven to 375°.
Drop by teaspoons onto ungreased baking sheet. Bake 8 to 10 minutes or until light brown.
Cool slightly before removing from sheet.
recipes.text: Poppy'S Favorite Cookies. Mix cream cheese and butter until blended. Blend in yolk and vanilla. Add cake mix (dry), 1/3 at a time, mixing well after each addition. If mixer is used, add last 1/3 by hand. Cover and chill for at least 30 minutes. Heat oven to 375°. Drop by teaspoons onto ungreased baking sheet. Bake 8 to 10 minutes or until light brown. Cool slightly before removing from sheet.

recipes.title: Homemade Barbecue Sauce
directions: Combine all ingredients and marinate any meat desired. Delicious!
recipes.text: Homemade Barbecue Sauce. Combine all ingredients and marinate any meat desired. Delicious!

recipes.title: Worlds Best Sugar Cookies
directions: Cream sugars and margarine. Add oil, eggs, and vanilla. Mix well. Add soda, salt, cream of tartar and mix well. Roll into small balls. Place on a cookie sheet. Flatten with a glass dipped in sugar. Bake at 350° for 10-12 minutes.
recipes.text: Worlds Best Sugar Cookies. Cream sugars and margarine. Add oil, eggs, and vanilla. Mix well. Add soda, salt, cream of tartar and mix well. Roll into small balls. Place on a cookie sheet. Flatten with a glass dipped in sugar. Bake at 350° for 10-12 minutes.

recipes.title: Sunday Dinner
directions: Put all ingredients in roasting pan in order given.
Cover and bake at 325° to 350° from 8:30 a.m. until you get home from church.
I skin my chicken to remove as much fat as possible. Serve with salad or applesauce.
recipes.text: Sunday Dinner. Put all ingredients in roasting pan in order given. Cover and bake at 325° to 350° from 8:30 a.m. until you get home from church. I skin my chicken to remove as much fat as possible. Serve with salad or applesauce.

recipes.title: Rice Pudding
directions: Don't wash rice.
Place rice in 1/2 cup water; bring to a boil.
Turn
heat
down;
let
simmer until all the water is gone, about
minutes.
Pour the milk into the rice; simmer for about
1 hour, stirring once.
Add the remaining ingredients, except the egg;
cook for 8 minutes before adding egg to the hot mixture.
Gradually add egg to the hot mixture.
recipes.text: Rice Pudding. Don't wash rice. Place rice in 1/2 cup water; bring to a boil. Turn heat down; let simmer until all the water is gone, about 5 minutes. Pour the milk into the rice; simmer for about 1 hour, stirring once. Add the remaining ingredients, except the egg; cook for 8 minutes before adding egg to the hot mixture. Gradually add egg to the hot mixture.

recipes.title: Great Grandma'S Sugar Cookies
directions: Cream butter and sugar until fluffy; add eggs, nutmeg, vanilla and almond extracts.
Blend well.
Gradually add in flour. Chill in fridge for at least 1 hour or until dough is stiff. Spread out and use cookie cutters to cut out shapes.
Bake on ungreased cookie sheet at 400° until you think they are done. Bake longer for crispy cookies and shorter time for softer cookies.
recipes.text: Great Grandma'S Sugar Cookies. Cream butter and sugar until fluffy; add eggs, nutmeg, vanilla and almond extracts. Blend well. Gradually add in flour. Chill in fridge for at least 1 hour or until dough is stiff. Spread out and use cookie cutters to cut out shapes. Bake on ungreased cookie sheet at 400° until you think they are done. Bake longer for crispy cookies and shorter time for softer cookies.

recipes.title: Petit Fours
directions: Mix ingredients; shape into a long roll.
Wrap in wax paper; refrigerate for 1 hour.
Remove and slice into cookies.
Fill each one with a favorite jam or preserve.
Place on ungreased cookie sheet after you have folded in half as if making a fried pie. Bake at 375° for 15 minutes.
Place wax paper down.
After each cookie is cooked, roll quickly into powdered sugar.
recipes.text: Petit Fours. Mix ingredients; shape into a long roll. Wrap in wax paper; refrigerate for 1 hour. Remove and slice into cookies. Fill each one with a favorite jam or preserve. Place on ungreased cookie sheet after you have folded in half as if making a fried pie. Bake at 375° for 15 minutes. Place wax paper down. After each cookie is cooked, roll quickly into powdered sugar.

recipes.title: Blueberry Cake
directions: Bake cake mix and slice into 3 layers and fill.
recipes.text: Blueberry Cake. Bake cake mix and slice into 3 layers and fill.

recipes.title: Dill Rye Bread Dip
directions: Combine all the ingredients in a large mixing bowl.
Tear all the meat into small pieces and mix into dip.
Cut round circle in top of bread and remove like a lid.
Dip inside of bread out and save.
Pour dip into hollowed out bread.
Place bread on a platter and put your bread saved around the bread dip.
recipes.text: Dill Rye Bread Dip. Combine all the ingredients in a large mixing bowl. Tear all the meat into small pieces and mix into dip. Cut round circle in top of bread and remove like a lid. Dip inside of bread out and save. Pour dip into hollowed out bread. Place bread on a platter and put your bread saved around the bread dip.

recipes.title: Country French Toast
directions: Pour eggnog into shallow bowl.
Dip both sides of French bread into eggnog. In large skillet, cook bread in hot cooking oil over medium heat 2 1/2 minutes or until golden.
Turn bread.
Cook about 1 1/2 minutes more (add more oil if needed).
Transfer to serving plate. Sift powdered sugar over toast.
Yields 2 servings.
recipes.text: Country French Toast. Pour eggnog into shallow bowl. Dip both sides of French bread into eggnog. In large skillet, cook bread in hot cooking oil over medium heat 2 1/2 minutes or until golden. Turn bread. Cook about 1 1/2 minutes more (add more oil if needed). Transfer to serving plate. Sift powdered sugar over toast. Yields 2 servings.

recipes.title: Corn Relish
directions: Combine all ingredients
in a large nonaluminum kettle. Bring to a boil.
Reduce
heat.
Simmer
uncovered
to
40 minutes until vegetables are tender.
Pack into hot sterilized jars leaving 1/2 inch headspace.
Seal; cool completely.
recipes.text: Corn Relish. Combine all ingredients in a large nonaluminum kettle. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat. Simmer uncovered 30 to 40 minutes until vegetables are tender. Pack into hot sterilized jars leaving 1/2 inch headspace. Seal; cool completely.

recipes.title: Aunt Johnnie'S Cake
directions: Combine first 4 ingredients and beat 2 minutes. Mix remaining ingredients in with first and bake for 35 minutes at 350°.
recipes.text: Aunt Johnnie'S Cake. Combine first 4 ingredients and beat 2 minutes. Mix remaining ingredients in with first and bake for 35 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: German Cake(Fruit Filled)
directions: Cream together margarine and sugar.
Add eggs and vanilla and beat until smooth and creamy.
Add flour and salt and blend until well mixed.
In a 13 x 9 x 2-inch sheet cake pan, spread a little more than 1/2 of batter on bottom of ungreased pan.
Spread fruit pie filling (I use cherry or blueberry) over top of batter in pan. Drop by spoonfuls the remaining batter onto the pie filling. Bake at 325° for approximately 1 hour.
Top will be light golden brown.
Test cake with toothpick for doneness.
Can be served warm and with whipped cream or ice cream.
recipes.text: German Cake(Fruit Filled). Cream together margarine and sugar. Add eggs and vanilla and beat until smooth and creamy. Add flour and salt and blend until well mixed. In a 13 x 9 x 2-inch sheet cake pan, spread a little more than 1/2 of batter on bottom of ungreased pan. Spread fruit pie filling (I use cherry or blueberry) over top of batter in pan. Drop by spoonfuls the remaining batter onto the pie filling. Bake at 325° for approximately 1 hour. Top will be light golden brown. Test cake with toothpick for doneness. Can be served warm and with whipped cream or ice cream.

recipes.title: Chicken Spaghetti
directions: Cook chicken, take off bone.
Cook spaghetti, drain.
Add butter, then mix soup, milk, cheese and chicken.
Stir until melted.
Bake at 325° to 300° for 1/2 hour.
recipes.text: Chicken Spaghetti. Cook chicken, take off bone. Cook spaghetti, drain. Add butter, then mix soup, milk, cheese and chicken. Stir until melted. Bake at 325° to 300° for 1/2 hour.

recipes.title: Rice Cooker Jambalaya
ingredients: 1 (10 oz.) can diced tomatoes (with green chillies)
1 Tbsp. Tony Chachere seasoning (use 1/2 Tbsp. for less spicy dish or may be omitted)
directions: Stir all ingredients together in rice cooker.
Turn rice cooker on. After the bell rings signifying the rice is cooked, let jambalaya stand for 5 minutes. Serves 10 to 12 people. Preparation time: 10 to 15 minutes. Cooking time: 40 minutes.
recipes.text: Rice Cooker Jambalaya. Stir all ingredients together in rice cooker. Turn rice cooker on. After the bell rings signifying the rice is cooked, let jambalaya stand for 5 minutes. Serves 10 to 12 people. Preparation time: 10 to 15 minutes. Cooking time: 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Taco Soup
ingredients: 1 lb. ground beef, browned and drained
directions: Mix all ingredients in soup pot and heat until hot.
recipes.text: Taco Soup. Mix all ingredients in soup pot and heat until hot.

recipes.title: Hominy Casserole
directions: Mix hominy, soup, Worcestershire sauce and salt.
Pour into buttered casserole and sprinkle with corn flake crumbs and butter. Bake at 300° until brown.
recipes.text: Hominy Casserole. Mix hominy, soup, Worcestershire sauce and salt. Pour into buttered casserole and sprinkle with corn flake crumbs and butter. Bake at 300° until brown.

recipes.title: Oven Omelette
ingredients: 1 lb. sausage, bacon or ham, diced
directions: Cook sausage and/or fry bacon.
Mix with remaining ingredients.
Set in refrigerator overnight in a greased 9 x 13-inch pan.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Oven Omelette. Cook sausage and/or fry bacon. Mix with remaining ingredients. Set in refrigerator overnight in a greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Creamy Cauliflower Salad
directions: Mix yogurt, mayo and Ranch dressing.
Combine with other vegetables and ingredients.
Chill.
Add radishes when ready to serve.
Makes 25 servings.
recipes.text: Creamy Cauliflower Salad. Mix yogurt, mayo and Ranch dressing. Combine with other vegetables and ingredients. Chill. Add radishes when ready to serve. Makes 25 servings.

recipes.title: Montana Potato Soup
directions: Cook potatoes and onion with margarine.
Salt and pepper in enough water to cover until tender.
Add flour to milk and add to potato mixture along with ham.
Cook until thick.
Serves 2.
recipes.text: Montana Potato Soup. Cook potatoes and onion with margarine. Salt and pepper in enough water to cover until tender. Add flour to milk and add to potato mixture along with ham. Cook until thick. Serves 2.

recipes.title: Cherry Delights
directions: Mix 1 cup of butter and 1/2 cup sugar.
Stir in 1/2 cup light corn syrup, 2 egg yolks and 2 1/2 cups of flour.
Chill.
Roll into 1 inch balls.
Dip into slightly beaten egg whites and then roll in nuts.
Place on greased baking sheet.
Press candied cherry halves into centers.
Bake in 325° oven 20 minutes.
Makes 4 dozen.
recipes.text: Cherry Delights. Mix 1 cup of butter and 1/2 cup sugar. Stir in 1/2 cup light corn syrup, 2 egg yolks and 2 1/2 cups of flour. Chill. Roll into 1 inch balls. Dip into slightly beaten egg whites and then roll in nuts. Place on greased baking sheet. Press candied cherry halves into centers. Bake in 325° oven 20 minutes. Makes 4 dozen.

recipes.title: Cucumber Salad
directions: Soak onions and cucumbers in salt water for 1 hour.
Drain and pack into canning jars as tightly as possible.
Heat sugar and vinegar to boiling.
Pour liquid to fill each jar.
Cool and freeze.
recipes.text: Cucumber Salad. Soak onions and cucumbers in salt water for 1 hour. Drain and pack into canning jars as tightly as possible. Heat sugar and vinegar to boiling. Pour liquid to fill each jar. Cool and freeze.

recipes.title: Salsa Dip
ingredients: 8 oz. shredded Cheddar and Mozzarella cheese
directions: Spread cream cheese over bottom of 8 x 8-inch or 9 x 9-inch square pan.
Add the remaining ingredients from bottom to top (in order).
Bake at 350° until bubbly.
Serve with tortilla chips.
recipes.text: Salsa Dip. Spread cream cheese over bottom of 8 x 8-inch or 9 x 9-inch square pan. Add the remaining ingredients from bottom to top (in order). Bake at 350° until bubbly. Serve with tortilla chips.

recipes.title: Curry Dip
directions: Mix well all ingredients.
Great with raw vegetables.
recipes.text: Curry Dip. Mix well all ingredients. Great with raw vegetables.

recipes.title: Clam Chowder
directions: Saute onions in oil until limp.
Add potatoes and water.
Cook 10 minutes or until tender.
Add milk, spices and clams just before serving and bring to a boil.
Allow to cook a few minutes before serving.
recipes.text: Clam Chowder. Saute onions in oil until limp. Add potatoes and water. Cook 10 minutes or until tender. Add milk, spices and clams just before serving and bring to a boil. Allow to cook a few minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Taco Casserole
ingredients: 1 small bag Doritos chips (cheese or taco flavor)
8 oz. shredded Mozzarella cheese or use Cheddar or whatever you have on hand
directions: Crumble Doritos in bag.
Place in bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan. Reserve few for top.
Put browned hamburger and onion on top of Doritos.
Mix tomatoes, beans and soup together; put on top of hamburger.
Add cheese to top of mixture; sprinkle few Doritos on top.
Bake at 425° for 25 minutes.
recipes.text: Taco Casserole. Crumble Doritos in bag. Place in bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan. Reserve few for top. Put browned hamburger and onion on top of Doritos. Mix tomatoes, beans and soup together; put on top of hamburger. Add cheese to top of mixture; sprinkle few Doritos on top. Bake at 425° for 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Veal Piccata For Two*
directions: *You may use boneless chicken breasts instead of the veal!
recipes.text: Veal Piccata For Two*. *You may use boneless chicken breasts instead of the veal!

recipes.title: Zucchini Cake(Or Bread)
directions: Mix first 4 ingredients in a large mixing bowl.
Mix in remaining ingredients.
Pour into ungreased 9 x 13-inch pan.
Bake 60 to 70 minutes at 300°.
Turn off heat and leave cake in the oven 10 more minutes.
This same recipe will make 3 loaves of bread.
recipes.text: Zucchini Cake(Or Bread). Mix first 4 ingredients in a large mixing bowl. Mix in remaining ingredients. Pour into ungreased 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake 60 to 70 minutes at 300°. Turn off heat and leave cake in the oven 10 more minutes. This same recipe will make 3 loaves of bread.

recipes.title: Pizza Rustica Or Easter Pie
directions: Preheat oven to 350°.
Brown sausage meat and drain excess fat.
Mix eggs, Ricotta and grated cheese.
Add all other ingredients and mix well.
Grease a large lasagna pan and pour mix in.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour or until golden brown.
Best when settled for 1 day and heat before serving.
Do not serve out of the oven or else the pie will run.
Must be cooled down.
recipes.text: Pizza Rustica Or Easter Pie. Preheat oven to 350°. Brown sausage meat and drain excess fat. Mix eggs, Ricotta and grated cheese. Add all other ingredients and mix well. Grease a large lasagna pan and pour mix in. Bake at 350° for 1 hour or until golden brown. Best when settled for 1 day and heat before serving. Do not serve out of the oven or else the pie will run. Must be cooled down.

recipes.title: Russian Salad
directions: Heat marshmallows, milk and cream cheese together until solid ingredients are melted.
Dissolve gelatin in hot water.
Add remaining ingredients to gelatin.
Combine the two mixtures. Congeal.
May add some chopped nuts on top after it has congealed.
recipes.text: Russian Salad. Heat marshmallows, milk and cream cheese together until solid ingredients are melted. Dissolve gelatin in hot water. Add remaining ingredients to gelatin. Combine the two mixtures. Congeal. May add some chopped nuts on top after it has congealed.

recipes.title: Broccoli And Cheese Soup
ingredients: 2 1/2 c. fresh broccoli, cut up or 16 oz. bag frozen broccoli
2 c. milk (or 1 c. milk and 1 c. cream)
directions: Bring chicken stock, onion and seasonings to boil in large pot.
Add broccoli, reduce heat to simmer and cook until soft, about 8 minutes.
In separate pan, melt butter and add flour. Whisk with wire whisk for a few minutes over medium high heat until smooth.
Slowly add milk, whisking constantly to avoid lumps.
Stir with wooden paddle as you slowly add broccoli to roux.
Whisk vigorously until soup begins to thicken.
Remove from heat and adjust seasonings.
Garnish with grated cheddar cheese.
recipes.text: Broccoli And Cheese Soup. Bring chicken stock, onion and seasonings to boil in large pot. Add broccoli, reduce heat to simmer and cook until soft, about 8 minutes. In separate pan, melt butter and add flour. Whisk with wire whisk for a few minutes over medium high heat until smooth. Slowly add milk, whisking constantly to avoid lumps. Stir with wooden paddle as you slowly add broccoli to roux. Whisk vigorously until soup begins to thicken. Remove from heat and adjust seasonings. Garnish with grated cheddar cheese.

recipes.title: Non-Toxic Play Dough
directions: Mix the salt, flour and cream of tartar, then add the water, oil and coloring.
Cook on medium heat until dough is consistency of thick mashed potatoes, stirring constantly.
Remove from heat. Let cool slightly.
Store in plastic bag.
recipes.text: Non-Toxic Play Dough. Mix the salt, flour and cream of tartar, then add the water, oil and coloring. Cook on medium heat until dough is consistency of thick mashed potatoes, stirring constantly. Remove from heat. Let cool slightly. Store in plastic bag.

recipes.title: Savory Chipper Loaf
directions: Combine all ingredients in bowl.
Blend together.
Shape into loaf and bake in shallow pan, uncovered, in 350° oven for 1 1/2 hours.
recipes.text: Savory Chipper Loaf. Combine all ingredients in bowl. Blend together. Shape into loaf and bake in shallow pan, uncovered, in 350° oven for 1 1/2 hours.

recipes.title: Let'S Have Some More Fruit Dip
directions: Mix equal parts of soft cream cheese and marshmallow topping. Tint mixture pink with red food coloring.
Good with strawberries, watermelon, cantaloupe, grapes, etc.
recipes.text: Let'S Have Some More Fruit Dip. Mix equal parts of soft cream cheese and marshmallow topping. Tint mixture pink with red food coloring. Good with strawberries, watermelon, cantaloupe, grapes, etc.

recipes.title: Baked Stuffed Red Fish
ingredients: 1 c. soft stale bread crumbs (day old at least)
directions: Melt shortening in frying pan.
Add bread crumbs.
Stir until crumbs are golden brown, then add seasonings and salt.
recipes.text: Baked Stuffed Red Fish. Melt shortening in frying pan. Add bread crumbs. Stir until crumbs are golden brown, then add seasonings and salt.

recipes.title: Nancy'S Chocolate Chip Cookies
directions: Preheat oven to 350°.

Cream the margarine, oil, sugars, egg and vanilla. Mix flour, soda and salt and add to creamed mixture. Fold in the oatmeal, chocolate chips, Rice Krispies and pecans. Drop by rounded teaspoonful on greased cookie sheet. Cook for 10 minutes at 350°.
Makes 10 dozen.
recipes.text: Nancy'S Chocolate Chip Cookies. Preheat oven to 350°. Cream the margarine, oil, sugars, egg and vanilla. Mix flour, soda and salt and add to creamed mixture. Fold in the oatmeal, chocolate chips, Rice Krispies and pecans. Drop by rounded teaspoonful on greased cookie sheet. Cook for 10 minutes at 350°. Makes 10 dozen.

recipes.title: Corn Bread Dressing
ingredients: 1/2 c. butter plus 1 c. water or enough to make a thin mix
directions: Combine and bake at 325°
for 30 to 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Corn Bread Dressing. Combine and bake at 325° for 30 to 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Sausage Soup
ingredients: 1 1/2 to 2 lb. sausage, fry to get fat out
any other vegetable or seasoning you wish to use
directions: Slice fried sausage and add other ingredients to pot.
You may use water, tomato juice or any other broth to cover.
Cook 20 minutes to 1/2 hour.
Use your imagination for different varieties like chicken or beef or pasta, etc.
recipes.text: Sausage Soup. Slice fried sausage and add other ingredients to pot. You may use water, tomato juice or any other broth to cover. Cook 20 minutes to 1/2 hour. Use your imagination for different varieties like chicken or beef or pasta, etc.

recipes.title: Ketchup
directions: Quarter tomatoes; remove stems.
Cut pepper into strips. Slice onions.
Blend in blender until soft.
Pour in large pot. Add vinegar, sugar, salt, mustard, red pepper and spice wrapped in a spice cloth.
Simmer in a slow oven on 325° until shrinks in half.
Remove spice cloth.
Pour into hot jars.
Process 10 minutes.
Makes 5 pints.
Cook in oven approximately 7 more hours.
recipes.text: Ketchup. Quarter tomatoes; remove stems. Cut pepper into strips. Slice onions. Blend in blender until soft. Pour in large pot. Add vinegar, sugar, salt, mustard, red pepper and spice wrapped in a spice cloth. Simmer in a slow oven on 325° until shrinks in half. Remove spice cloth. Pour into hot jars. Process 10 minutes. Makes 5 pints. Cook in oven approximately 7 more hours.

recipes.title: Celery Seed Dressing
directions: Mix sugar, mustard, salt and celery seed.
Add onion. Gradually add, beating constantly, oil and vinegar.
Combine together the ingredients in a blender.
Great with salads or fruit salads.
recipes.text: Celery Seed Dressing. Mix sugar, mustard, salt and celery seed. Add onion. Gradually add, beating constantly, oil and vinegar. Combine together the ingredients in a blender. Great with salads or fruit salads.

recipes.title: Chicken Saladwestboro, Missouri
directions: Mix first 4 ingredients, then mix dressing together and combine with chicken.
Let chill.
recipes.text: Chicken Saladwestboro, Missouri. Mix first 4 ingredients, then mix dressing together and combine with chicken. Let chill.

recipes.title: Abigail Adams' Champagne Punch
ingredients: fresh orange slices and mint sprigs (optional)
directions: Tea is an unusual addition to this refreshing punch popular for gatherings in the 1700's.
recipes.text: Abigail Adams' Champagne Punch. Tea is an unusual addition to this refreshing punch popular for gatherings in the 1700's.

recipes.title: Cool Rise Bread
ingredients: 1 Tbsp. salt (if using self-rising flour, omit salt)
directions: Dissolve yeast in water in a large warm bowl. Add milk, sugar, salt and margarine.
Stir in 2 cups unsifted flour.
Beat with rotary beater until smooth, about 1 minute. Add 1
cup flour and beat until mixed.
Gradually stir in enough additional flour (3 cups or more) to make a soft dough.
Turn onto lightly floured board and knead until smooth and elastic.
Cover dough with towel and let rest 20 minutes.
recipes.text: Cool Rise Bread. Dissolve yeast in water in a large warm bowl. Add milk, sugar, salt and margarine. Stir in 2 cups unsifted flour. Beat with rotary beater until smooth, about 1 minute. Add 1 cup flour and beat until mixed. Gradually stir in enough additional flour (3 cups or more) to make a soft dough. Turn onto lightly floured board and knead until smooth and elastic. Cover dough with towel and let rest 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Sweet Yogurt Dressing
ingredients: 1/4 c. chopped nuts (walnuts, pecans or other)
directions: Mix all ingredients and chill overnight.
Serve cold.
Great over sliced fruit.
recipes.text: Sweet Yogurt Dressing. Mix all ingredients and chill overnight. Serve cold. Great over sliced fruit.

recipes.title: Vidalia Onion Pie
directions: Preheat oven to 350°.
Mix cracker crumbs and 4 tablespoons butter; press into 8-inch pie plate.
Melt 2 tablespoons butter. Saute onions until tender.
Beat other ingredients, except cheese, together.
Pour onions over cracker crust. Pour other mixture over onions.
Sprinkle with grated cheese and dot with paprika or parsley flakes.
Bake 35 minutes.
recipes.text: Vidalia Onion Pie. Preheat oven to 350°. Mix cracker crumbs and 4 tablespoons butter; press into 8-inch pie plate. Melt 2 tablespoons butter. Saute onions until tender. Beat other ingredients, except cheese, together. Pour onions over cracker crust. Pour other mixture over onions. Sprinkle with grated cheese and dot with paprika or parsley flakes. Bake 35 minutes.

recipes.title: Barbecue Sauce
directions: Mix all together and cook until the right thickness for you.
recipes.text: Barbecue Sauce. Mix all together and cook until the right thickness for you.

recipes.title: No Bake Orange Cookies
directions: Crush vanilla wafers (fine); orange juice should be mushy. Heat confectioners sugar and margarine together and beat until light and fluffy.
Add crushed wafers and orange juice.
Let stand 1/2 hour.
If too moist, add more wafers.
Roll small balls in coconut.
recipes.text: No Bake Orange Cookies. Crush vanilla wafers (fine); orange juice should be mushy. Heat confectioners sugar and margarine together and beat until light and fluffy. Add crushed wafers and orange juice. Let stand 1/2 hour. If too moist, add more wafers. Roll small balls in coconut.

recipes.title: Broccoli Casserole
ingredients: 1 (10 oz.) can cream of mushroom soup
directions: Mix soup, mayonnaise, eggs, onion, broccoli, salt and pepper together.
Pour in casserole dish.
Melt butter.
Mix stuffing and cheese with butter and spread over top.
Cook at 350° for 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Broccoli Casserole. Mix soup, mayonnaise, eggs, onion, broccoli, salt and pepper together. Pour in casserole dish. Melt butter. Mix stuffing and cheese with butter and spread over top. Cook at 350° for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Mulled Cider
directions: Put cider, lemon juice, lemon slices, sugar, molasses, cinnamon stick, cloves and allspice in medium saucepan.
Bring to a boil over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until sugar dissolves.
Reduce heat to low and simmer 5 minutes.
recipes.text: Mulled Cider. Put cider, lemon juice, lemon slices, sugar, molasses, cinnamon stick, cloves and allspice in medium saucepan. Bring to a boil over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until sugar dissolves. Reduce heat to low and simmer 5 minutes.

recipes.title: Faultless Fudge (Microwave)
directions: Mix sugar and cocoa; add milk and butter.
Cook on High 2 minutes.
Remove from microwave, add vanilla and nuts.
Stir ingredients thoroughly.
Pour into a greased dish and refrigerate 1 hour.
recipes.text: Faultless Fudge (Microwave). Mix sugar and cocoa; add milk and butter. Cook on High 2 minutes. Remove from microwave, add vanilla and nuts. Stir ingredients thoroughly. Pour into a greased dish and refrigerate 1 hour.

recipes.title: Flying High Ham And Noodles Casserole
directions: Saute onions and ham just till onions are tender.
Add soup, milk, sour cream, mustard and pepper.
Mix sauce, ham and noodles. Put in casserole dish.
Sprinkled with toasted almonds and bake at 350° for approximately 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Flying High Ham And Noodles Casserole. Saute onions and ham just till onions are tender. Add soup, milk, sour cream, mustard and pepper. Mix sauce, ham and noodles. Put in casserole dish. Sprinkled with toasted almonds and bake at 350° for approximately 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Prune Spice Bread
directions: Soak prunes overnight, saving 2 cups water to use later.
Cut prunes into bits and cook prunes, liquid, sugar and oleo.
Cool. Sift flour, salt, spices and baking soda.
Add beaten eggs and sifted dry ingredients to cooled mix.
Pour into 2 greased 5 x 9-inch loaf pans.
Bake at 350° , one hour.
Yields 1 pound size loaf.
recipes.text: Prune Spice Bread. Soak prunes overnight, saving 2 cups water to use later. Cut prunes into bits and cook prunes, liquid, sugar and oleo. Cool. Sift flour, salt, spices and baking soda. Add beaten eggs and sifted dry ingredients to cooled mix. Pour into 2 greased 5 x 9-inch loaf pans. Bake at 350° , one hour. Yields 1 pound size loaf.

recipes.title: Yum Cake
directions: Bake and cool 1 large white or yellow cake mix.
Prepare 3 ounces vanilla pudding mix; spread over cake.
Put 1 can drained, crushed pineapple over pudding.
Spread 1 large bowl of Cool Whip over pineapple.
Sprinkle nuts and coconut on top.
recipes.text: Yum Cake. Bake and cool 1 large white or yellow cake mix. Prepare 3 ounces vanilla pudding mix; spread over cake. Put 1 can drained, crushed pineapple over pudding. Spread 1 large bowl of Cool Whip over pineapple. Sprinkle nuts and coconut on top.

recipes.title: Marinated Turkey Fillets
ingredients: 1 1/2 lb. skinless turkey fillets, all visible fat removed
directions: Rinse turkey fillets and pat dry.
Set aside.
In a small bowl, combine remaining ingredients.
Pour into rectangular enamel or ovenproof glass baking dish.
Add fillets, turning to coat evenly.
Cover and refrigerate for several hours or overnight, turning fillets several times.
Grill or broil marinated fillets. Serve hot.
This dish is also good chilled and sliced over salad greens.
(Keep covered in the refrigerator.)
Serves 6.
recipes.text: Marinated Turkey Fillets. Rinse turkey fillets and pat dry. Set aside. In a small bowl, combine remaining ingredients. Pour into rectangular enamel or ovenproof glass baking dish. Add fillets, turning to coat evenly. Cover and refrigerate for several hours or overnight, turning fillets several times. Grill or broil marinated fillets. Serve hot. This dish is also good chilled and sliced over salad greens. (Keep covered in the refrigerator.) Serves 6.

recipes.title: Broiled Chicken Casserole
ingredients: 1 (10.5 oz.) can cream of chicken soup
directions: Grease casserole dish (about 8 x 10-inch). Mix vegetables and cream of chicken soup.
Spread bread crumbs over mixture. Sprinkle cheese on top of bread crumbs.
Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.
Serves 4.
recipes.text: Broiled Chicken Casserole. Grease casserole dish (about 8 x 10-inch). Mix vegetables and cream of chicken soup. Spread bread crumbs over mixture. Sprinkle cheese on top of bread crumbs. Bake at 350° for 20 minutes. Serves 4.

recipes.title: Cape Cod Clam Chowder
directions: Fry bacon until crisp and cut small.
Remove from pan.
Fry pork until golden brown.
Remove from pan.
Saute onions until soft.
Drain clams, saving juice, then chop clams fine.
Add to clam juice enough water to make 3 cups.
Bring to a boil and add potatoes, browned pork, onions and bacon.
Simmer until potatoes are done, about 15 minutes.
Blend flour to a smooth paste with cold water, add to the potatoes, stirring until it boils and thickens.
Add clams and seasonings.
Add the milk and add slowly to hot clam mixture.
Add 2 tablespoons butter when done.
Serves 6.
recipes.text: Cape Cod Clam Chowder. Fry bacon until crisp and cut small. Remove from pan. Fry pork until golden brown. Remove from pan. Saute onions until soft. Drain clams, saving juice, then chop clams fine. Add to clam juice enough water to make 3 cups. Bring to a boil and add potatoes, browned pork, onions and bacon. Simmer until potatoes are done, about 15 minutes. Blend flour to a smooth paste with cold water, add to the potatoes, stirring until it boils and thickens. Add clams and seasonings. Add the milk and add slowly to hot clam mixture. Add 2 tablespoons butter when done. Serves 6.

recipes.title: Eggplant Dressing
ingredients: 1/2 tsp. poultry seasoning or to taste
directions: Peel off outside eggplant and cut into wedges. Boil completely in salted water with pepper and little butter. When soft, drain and set aside.
recipes.text: Eggplant Dressing. Peel off outside eggplant and cut into wedges. Boil completely in salted water with pepper and little butter. When soft, drain and set aside.

recipes.title: Crock-Pot Dip
directions: Melt cheese in pot.
Cook sausage and crumble into pieces. Add soup and mix well.
Eat with taco chips.
recipes.text: Crock-Pot Dip. Melt cheese in pot. Cook sausage and crumble into pieces. Add soup and mix well. Eat with taco chips.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Fudge
directions: Mix sugar and cream; bring to boil on stove until mixture forms soft ball stage in cold water.
Take off stove and stir in peanut butter.
Stir until candy is hard.
Pour out into platter and cut into squares.
recipes.text: Peanut Butter Fudge. Mix sugar and cream; bring to boil on stove until mixture forms soft ball stage in cold water. Take off stove and stir in peanut butter. Stir until candy is hard. Pour out into platter and cut into squares.

recipes.title: Jello Punch
directions: Dissolve Jell-O and sugar in hot water.
Add remaining ingredients, mixing well.
Pour over ice to serve.
recipes.text: Jello Punch. Dissolve Jell-O and sugar in hot water. Add remaining ingredients, mixing well. Pour over ice to serve.

recipes.title: Shoestring Apple Pie
directions: Combine ingredients and pour into 2 (9-inch) pie plates. Sprinkle with cinnamon and dot with butter.
Bake at 450° for 15 minutes, then reduce heat to 350° and bake until apples are soft.
recipes.text: Shoestring Apple Pie. Combine ingredients and pour into 2 (9-inch) pie plates. Sprinkle with cinnamon and dot with butter. Bake at 450° for 15 minutes, then reduce heat to 350° and bake until apples are soft.

recipes.title: Luscious Lemon Shrimp
ingredients: 3/4 c. fresh crabmeat, drained and flaked (I have used canned crabmeat)
directions: Peel shrimp, leaving tails on; devein and set aside.
Melt butter in a large skillet.
Add shrimp, crabmeat and the rest of the ingredients.
Bring to boil; reduce heat and simmer 4 to 5 minutes.
Spoon into 4 individual serving dishes.
Arrange shrimp around crabmeat.
recipes.text: Luscious Lemon Shrimp. Peel shrimp, leaving tails on; devein and set aside. Melt butter in a large skillet. Add shrimp, crabmeat and the rest of the ingredients. Bring to boil; reduce heat and simmer 4 to 5 minutes. Spoon into 4 individual serving dishes. Arrange shrimp around crabmeat.

recipes.title: Easy Pound Cake
directions: Put all of the ingredients into a large mixing bowl. Everything can be added without sifting.
Beat for 20 minutes. Pour into a greased and floured tube pan.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour and 30 minutes.
Cool cake on rack 15 minutes before removing from pan.
Serves 20.
recipes.text: Easy Pound Cake. Put all of the ingredients into a large mixing bowl. Everything can be added without sifting. Beat for 20 minutes. Pour into a greased and floured tube pan. Bake at 350° for 1 hour and 30 minutes. Cool cake on rack 15 minutes before removing from pan. Serves 20.

recipes.title: Pepperoni Bread
ingredients: 1 lb. Mozzarella or Provolone cheese, cut in small chunks
1 stick pepperoni, cut in small chunks
dash each of basil, parsley and garlic powder
directions: Thaw dough.
Combine all other ingredients.
Mix well.
Roll out dough.
Spread half of mixture on each piece of dough.
Roll up lengthwise and fold ends shut.
Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Pepperoni Bread. Thaw dough. Combine all other ingredients. Mix well. Roll out dough. Spread half of mixture on each piece of dough. Roll up lengthwise and fold ends shut. Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Chiffon Pumpkin Pie(From The Files Of Ola Dortch Williams)
directions: Mix gelatine with 1/2 cup sugar, salt and spices in saucepan. Stir in milk and egg yolks.
Cook on low heat and stir until gelatine dissolves and thickens (about 5 minutes).
Remove from heat and stir in pumpkin and chill, stirring occasionally.
Beat egg whites and remaining 1/4 cup sugar until stiff.
Fold stiff egg whites into pumpkin mixture and pour into baked pie crust.
Keep chilled and serve.
recipes.text: Chiffon Pumpkin Pie(From The Files Of Ola Dortch Williams). Mix gelatine with 1/2 cup sugar, salt and spices in saucepan. Stir in milk and egg yolks. Cook on low heat and stir until gelatine dissolves and thickens (about 5 minutes). Remove from heat and stir in pumpkin and chill, stirring occasionally. Beat egg whites and remaining 1/4 cup sugar until stiff. Fold stiff egg whites into pumpkin mixture and pour into baked pie crust. Keep chilled and serve.

recipes.title: Banana Pudding
directions: Mix together pudding, milk, Eagle Brand milk and Cool Whip. Alternate wafers, bananas (sliced) and pudding mixture.
Garnish with vanilla wafer crumbs.
Refrigerate several hours before serving.
recipes.text: Banana Pudding. Mix together pudding, milk, Eagle Brand milk and Cool Whip. Alternate wafers, bananas (sliced) and pudding mixture. Garnish with vanilla wafer crumbs. Refrigerate several hours before serving.

recipes.title: Corn Bread Dressing
directions: Cook celery and onion in water in saucepan over low heat until tender; drain.
Combine with corn bread and bread crumbs in bowl. Add eggs, butter, sage, salt and enough broth to make of moist consistency.
recipes.text: Corn Bread Dressing. Cook celery and onion in water in saucepan over low heat until tender; drain. Combine with corn bread and bread crumbs in bowl. Add eggs, butter, sage, salt and enough broth to make of moist consistency.

recipes.title: Baked Apples
directions: Mix all ingredients and bake 20 minutes at 350°.
recipes.text: Baked Apples. Mix all ingredients and bake 20 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Ground Beef Special(Sloppy Joes)
directions: Brown meat and onion; drain.
Add all other ingredients. Simmer 20 minutes.
recipes.text: Ground Beef Special(Sloppy Joes). Brown meat and onion; drain. Add all other ingredients. Simmer 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Orange Black Walnut Pie
directions: Mix all ingredients (except walnuts) with wire whisk. Mix well, then add walnuts. Pour into 1 unbaked deep-dish pie crust. Bake at 350° for 1 hour or until firm. Let cool before slicing.
recipes.text: Orange Black Walnut Pie. Mix all ingredients (except walnuts) with wire whisk. Mix well, then add walnuts. Pour into 1 unbaked deep-dish pie crust. Bake at 350° for 1 hour or until firm. Let cool before slicing.

recipes.title: Carrot Cake
directions: Beat eggs until frothy.
Slowly beat in oil.
Gradually add flour, sugar, baking soda, salt and cinnamon that have already been mixed together.
Mix in carrots and nuts.
Pour into 3 greased 8-inch pans.
Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Carrot Cake. Beat eggs until frothy. Slowly beat in oil. Gradually add flour, sugar, baking soda, salt and cinnamon that have already been mixed together. Mix in carrots and nuts. Pour into 3 greased 8-inch pans. Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Hash Brown Casserole
ingredients: 1 (32 oz.) pkg. frozen hash browns, thawed
directions: Mix all ingredients and pour into a large casserole dish. Bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Hash Brown Casserole. Mix all ingredients and pour into a large casserole dish. Bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Baked Beans
directions: Heat oven to 350°.
In large skillet, cook green pepper and onion in margarine until tender.
Add ketchup, brown sugar, garlic powder and mustard.
Blend well.
Stir in baked beans; blend well.
recipes.text: Baked Beans. Heat oven to 350°. In large skillet, cook green pepper and onion in margarine until tender. Add ketchup, brown sugar, garlic powder and mustard. Blend well. Stir in baked beans; blend well.

recipes.title: Chilled Hawaiian Salad
ingredients: 1 pkg. lime gelatin or lemon gelatin
directions: Dissolve gelatin in boiling pineapple juice. Cool.
Add vegetables and fruit.
Let stand until syrupy.
Fold in salad dressing.
Chill until firm.
Use an 8 x 8-inch pan.
recipes.text: Chilled Hawaiian Salad. Dissolve gelatin in boiling pineapple juice. Cool. Add vegetables and fruit. Let stand until syrupy. Fold in salad dressing. Chill until firm. Use an 8 x 8-inch pan.

recipes.title: Hummingbird Cake
directions: Grease and flour 10 inch tube pan.
In a large bowl mix dry ingredients.
Add remaining ingredients and stir until mixed. Hand mix only.
Pour into pan and bake 1 hour and 10 minutes at 350 degrees.
Cool on rack 25 to 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Hummingbird Cake. Grease and flour 10 inch tube pan. In a large bowl mix dry ingredients. Add remaining ingredients and stir until mixed. Hand mix only. Pour into pan and bake 1 hour and 10 minutes at 350 degrees. Cool on rack 25 to 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Spiced Peaches
ingredients: large can cling peach halves (29 oz.)
directions: Drain peaches.
Combine sugar, vinegar and spices.
Bring to a boil and simmer 5 minutes.
Add peaches and simmer 5 minutes more.
Remove from heat and allow peaches to cool in liquid. Serve warm or cold as a meat accompaniment or salad.
recipes.text: Spiced Peaches. Drain peaches. Combine sugar, vinegar and spices. Bring to a boil and simmer 5 minutes. Add peaches and simmer 5 minutes more. Remove from heat and allow peaches to cool in liquid. Serve warm or cold as a meat accompaniment or salad.

recipes.title: Spinach Dip
ingredients: 1/2 c onion sauteed with 1 stick butter
directions: Cream together cream cheese, sour cream.
Add to remainder of ingredients (except tortilla chips).
Bake at 350° 20-30 minutes. Serve with tortilla chips.
recipes.text: Spinach Dip. Cream together cream cheese, sour cream. Add to remainder of ingredients (except tortilla chips). Bake at 350° 20-30 minutes. Serve with tortilla chips.

recipes.title: Crab Sandwich
ingredients: 6 English muffins, split, OR thick French bread slices
directions: Cook bacon until crisp, remove and drain.
Saute mushrooms and onions in bacon drippings until the mushrooms begin to turn brown.
Cool.
Combine the crab, cheeses, and mayonnaise, then add to the bacon/mushrooms/onions mixture.
Spread the mixture on sliced, buttered muffins.
Place sandwiches on a cookie sheet and bake at 400° for 15 minutes.
Serves 6.
You may substitute shrimp for the crab meat, if you wish.
recipes.text: Crab Sandwich. Cook bacon until crisp, remove and drain. Saute mushrooms and onions in bacon drippings until the mushrooms begin to turn brown. Cool. Combine the crab, cheeses, and mayonnaise, then add to the bacon/mushrooms/onions mixture. Spread the mixture on sliced, buttered muffins. Place sandwiches on a cookie sheet and bake at 400° for 15 minutes. Serves 6. You may substitute shrimp for the crab meat, if you wish.

recipes.title: Vegetable Stew
directions: In a stew pot, begin sauteing onions, garlic, potatoes and eggplant in butter.
Salt and pepper lightly.
When potatoes begin to get tender, add celery, broccoli, carrots

and Burgundy. Steam until all vegetables begin to be tender, then add zucchini, tomato paste, mushrooms, molasses and dill. Cover and simmer over low heat about 20 minutes. Correct seasoning. Serve piping hot, topped with sour cream and freshly chopped parsley.
recipes.text: Vegetable Stew. In a stew pot, begin sauteing onions, garlic, potatoes and eggplant in butter. Salt and pepper lightly. When potatoes begin to get tender, add celery, broccoli, carrots and Burgundy. Steam until all vegetables begin to be tender, then add zucchini, tomato paste, mushrooms, molasses and dill. Cover and simmer over low heat about 20 minutes. Correct seasoning. Serve piping hot, topped with sour cream and freshly chopped parsley.

recipes.title: Fluffy Pancakes
directions: Mix dry ingredients in a large bowl.
Combine eggs, milk and sour cream; slowly pour into dry ingredients, beating with a whisk to prevent lumping.
Add butter and beat smooth.
recipes.text: Fluffy Pancakes. Mix dry ingredients in a large bowl. Combine eggs, milk and sour cream; slowly pour into dry ingredients, beating with a whisk to prevent lumping. Add butter and beat smooth.

recipes.title: Chocolate Torte
directions: Melt butter in saucepan and add flour and pecans.
Spread in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish.
Bake at 350° until lightly brown. Cool.
recipes.text: Chocolate Torte. Melt butter in saucepan and add flour and pecans. Spread in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Bake at 350° until lightly brown. Cool.

recipes.title: Vegetable Casserole
directions: Cook vegetables according to package instructions; drain.
Mix all ingredients together and top with the crushed soda crackers. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Vegetable Casserole. Cook vegetables according to package instructions; drain. Mix all ingredients together and top with the crushed soda crackers. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Butterhorns
ingredients: 1 pkg. yeast, dissolved in 1/4 c. warm water
directions: Cream shortening and sugar.
Add beaten eggs and salt.
Mix again.
Add dissolved yeast and cooled milk; blend well.
Add flour, one cup at a time, mixing well after each cup.
Put on floured board and knead until smooth.
Put in greased bowl and turn dough on each side until greased.
Let rise, covered, in refrigerator overnight.
recipes.text: Butterhorns. Cream shortening and sugar. Add beaten eggs and salt. Mix again. Add dissolved yeast and cooled milk; blend well. Add flour, one cup at a time, mixing well after each cup. Put on floured board and knead until smooth. Put in greased bowl and turn dough on each side until greased. Let rise, covered, in refrigerator overnight.

recipes.title: Chocolate Peanut Butter Bars
directions: Heat oven to 350°.
Melt margarine in 13 x 9-inch baking pan in the oven.
Sprinkle crumbs evenly over margarine and pour condensed milk evenly over the crumbs.
Top with chips and press down firmly.
Bake 30 minutes or until golden brown.
Cool, then cut into bars.
recipes.text: Chocolate Peanut Butter Bars. Heat oven to 350°. Melt margarine in 13 x 9-inch baking pan in the oven. Sprinkle crumbs evenly over margarine and pour condensed milk evenly over the crumbs. Top with chips and press down firmly. Bake 30 minutes or until golden brown. Cool, then cut into bars.

recipes.title: Oatmeal Cookies
directions: Mix and drop by teaspoon on greased sheet.
Makes about 5 dozen.
recipes.text: Oatmeal Cookies. Mix and drop by teaspoon on greased sheet. Makes about 5 dozen.

recipes.title: Pecan Swirl Pudding Cake
ingredients: 1 (4 serving size) pkg. Jell-O brand butter pecan flavor instant pudding and pie filling
directions: Combine sugar, nuts and cinnamon; set aside.
Combine remaining ingredients in large mixer bowl.
Blend.
Beat at medium speed for 4 minutes.
Pour 2/3 of the batter into greased and floured 10-inch Bundt pan.
Sprinkle with sugar-nut mixture.
recipes.text: Pecan Swirl Pudding Cake. Combine sugar, nuts and cinnamon; set aside. Combine remaining ingredients in large mixer bowl. Blend. Beat at medium speed for 4 minutes. Pour 2/3 of the batter into greased and floured 10-inch Bundt pan. Sprinkle with sugar-nut mixture.

recipes.title: Fresh Pork Sausage
ingredients: 10 pork butts or 5-inch pork or 5 deer meat
1/2 oz. fresh garlic (2 good sized buds)
directions: Garlic should be chopped very fine with a knife or pulverized in a blender.
recipes.text: Fresh Pork Sausage. Garlic should be chopped very fine with a knife or pulverized in a blender.

recipes.title: Sour Cream And Noodle Casserole
directions: Cook noodles as directed; rinse and drain.
Brown meat; add salt, pepper and garlic salt, then tomato sauce.
Simmer 5 minutes; combine cheese, sour cream, onions and noodles.
In a 2-quart casserole, alternate layers of noodle mixture and meat, beginning with noodles and ending with meat.
Top with Cheddar cheese.
Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.
recipes.text: Sour Cream And Noodle Casserole. Cook noodles as directed; rinse and drain. Brown meat; add salt, pepper and garlic salt, then tomato sauce. Simmer 5 minutes; combine cheese, sour cream, onions and noodles. In a 2-quart casserole, alternate layers of noodle mixture and meat, beginning with noodles and ending with meat. Top with Cheddar cheese. Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Chicken Casserole
ingredients: 1 pkg. cheese sauce (from macaroni and cheese dinner)
directions: Pick chicken from bones.
Boil the egg noodles in chicken broth from chicken.
Mix all other ingredients with chicken and egg noodles.
recipes.text: Chicken Casserole. Pick chicken from bones. Boil the egg noodles in chicken broth from chicken. Mix all other ingredients with chicken and egg noodles.

recipes.title: Mexican Corn Bread
directions: Mix corn meal, milk, eggs and corn together and set aside. Brown ground beef and drain.
Pour 1/2 of corn meal batter into greased 15 x 9-inch baking dish.
Put in layers next the cheese, meat, onion and pepper.
Pour on remaining batter.
Bake at 350° for 45 to 50 minutes.
Makes 4 servings.
recipes.text: Mexican Corn Bread. Mix corn meal, milk, eggs and corn together and set aside. Brown ground beef and drain. Pour 1/2 of corn meal batter into greased 15 x 9-inch baking dish. Put in layers next the cheese, meat, onion and pepper. Pour on remaining batter. Bake at 350° for 45 to 50 minutes. Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: Herley Grilled Potatoes
ingredients: 2 medium onions, thinly sliced and cut in half, crosswise
directions: In saucepan, melt butter.
Add celery; cook until tender.
Stir in oregano, salt, garlic powder and pepper.
Cutting not quite through, slit potatoes into 1/2-inch slices.
Place each potato on a piece of foil large enough to wrap potatoes.
Drizzle about half of margarine mixture into slits.
Insert a half slice of onion into each slit.
Drizzle with remaining margarine.
Bring edges of foil together; seal securely with double foil.
Grill over hot coals 40 to 50 minutes.
Makes 6 servings.
recipes.text: Herley Grilled Potatoes. In saucepan, melt butter. Add celery; cook until tender. Stir in oregano, salt, garlic powder and pepper. Cutting not quite through, slit potatoes into 1/2-inch slices. Place each potato on a piece of foil large enough to wrap potatoes. Drizzle about half of margarine mixture into slits. Insert a half slice of onion into each slit. Drizzle with remaining margarine. Bring edges of foil together; seal securely with double foil. Grill over hot coals 40 to 50 minutes. Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Swedish Chicken
ingredients: 3 c. Cheddar cheese, diced in 1/2-inch cubes
directions: Remove skin and excess fat from chicken.
Melt margarine. Grease sides and bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan generously.
Put cheese, salt, pepper and Bisquick in a bowl and toss thoroughly to coat the cheese.
Dip chicken in melted margarine and roll it in the cheese and Bisquick mixture.
Place in the pan with several pieces of cheese tucked around each piece of chicken.
Sprinkle remaining Bisquick and cheese over top of chicken.
Pour remaining margarine on top.
Cover with foil.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes. Remove foil and bake until browned and crisp on top, approximately 35 to 45 minutes more.
recipes.text: Swedish Chicken. Remove skin and excess fat from chicken. Melt margarine. Grease sides and bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan generously. Put cheese, salt, pepper and Bisquick in a bowl and toss thoroughly to coat the cheese. Dip chicken in melted margarine and roll it in the cheese and Bisquick mixture. Place in the pan with several pieces of cheese tucked around each piece of chicken. Sprinkle remaining Bisquick and cheese over top of chicken. Pour remaining margarine on top. Cover with foil. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes. Remove foil and bake until browned and crisp on top, approximately 35 to 45 minutes more.

recipes.title: Easy Chocolate Pie
ingredients: 1 large Hershey chocolate bar with almonds
directions: Melt the Hershey bar over low heat.
Blend into Cool Whip. Pour mixture into the pie crust.
Put in refrigerator and chill for 1 hour before serving.
recipes.text: Easy Chocolate Pie. Melt the Hershey bar over low heat. Blend into Cool Whip. Pour mixture into the pie crust. Put in refrigerator and chill for 1 hour before serving.

recipes.title: Southern Chess Pie
directions: Mix sugar, flour and cornmeal.
Add eggs and beat until thick and ivory color.
Add lemon juice, rind, butter and milk.
Beat just enough to blend.
Pour into pastry shell.
Bake in preheated oven at 350° on rack just below the center until top is very brown and a knife inserted halfway between rim and center comes out clean, 50 to 60 minutes.
Good served warm.
recipes.text: Southern Chess Pie. Mix sugar, flour and cornmeal. Add eggs and beat until thick and ivory color. Add lemon juice, rind, butter and milk. Beat just enough to blend. Pour into pastry shell. Bake in preheated oven at 350° on rack just below the center until top is very brown and a knife inserted halfway between rim and center comes out clean, 50 to 60 minutes. Good served warm.

recipes.title: Orange-Mandarin Salad
directions: Use 9 x 9-inch pan.
Dissolve jello in 1 cup hot water.
Chill until slightly thickened.
Add other ingredients, including juice of fruits.
Chill until firm.
recipes.text: Orange-Mandarin Salad. Use 9 x 9-inch pan. Dissolve jello in 1 cup hot water. Chill until slightly thickened. Add other ingredients, including juice of fruits. Chill until firm.

recipes.title: Cinnamon Cake
directions: Mix cinnamon and sugar and set aside.
Mix cake mix, sour cream, eggs and oil together and mix well.
Pour 1/2 of batter into a greased and floured pan.
Sprinkle with 1/2 of cinnamon and sugar mixture.
Pour remaining batter into pan and sprinkle remaining sugar and cinnamon mixture over top.
Bake at 350° for 20 to 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Cinnamon Cake. Mix cinnamon and sugar and set aside. Mix cake mix, sour cream, eggs and oil together and mix well. Pour 1/2 of batter into a greased and floured pan. Sprinkle with 1/2 of cinnamon and sugar mixture. Pour remaining batter into pan and sprinkle remaining sugar and cinnamon mixture over top. Bake at 350° for 20 to 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Butter Dips
directions: Heat oven to 450° and melt butter in a 13 x 9 1/2-inch pan. Sift together dry ingredients.
Add milk and stir with fork until it clings; knead 10 times.
Roll out on floured surface until 1/2-inch thick in a rectangle.
Cut 16 strips approximately 4-inches long and 3/4-inch wide.
Roll in melted butter and arrange in pan.
Bake 15 to 20 minutes.
Great with stews.
recipes.text: Butter Dips. Heat oven to 450° and melt butter in a 13 x 9 1/2-inch pan. Sift together dry ingredients. Add milk and stir with fork until it clings; knead 10 times. Roll out on floured surface until 1/2-inch thick in a rectangle. Cut 16 strips approximately 4-inches long and 3/4-inch wide. Roll in melted butter and arrange in pan. Bake 15 to 20 minutes. Great with stews.

recipes.title: Hearty Baked Macaroni
directions: In a small bowl, combine tomato puree, water, Italian seasonings and 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder.
recipes.text: Hearty Baked Macaroni. In a small bowl, combine tomato puree, water, Italian seasonings and 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder.

recipes.title: Spaghetti Pie
directions: Cook spaghetti and drain.
Stir in butter, beaten eggs and Parmesan cheese.
Form spaghetti mixture into a crust in greased 10-inch pie plate.
Spread with cottage cheese.
Cook ground beef and onion until done.
Stir in spaghetti sauce. Pour meat mixture into spaghetti crust.
Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 20 minutes. Sprinkle with Mozzarella cheese.
Bake until cheese is melted.
recipes.text: Spaghetti Pie. Cook spaghetti and drain. Stir in butter, beaten eggs and Parmesan cheese. Form spaghetti mixture into a crust in greased 10-inch pie plate. Spread with cottage cheese. Cook ground beef and onion until done. Stir in spaghetti sauce. Pour meat mixture into spaghetti crust. Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 20 minutes. Sprinkle with Mozzarella cheese. Bake until cheese is melted.

recipes.title: Pavolova
directions: Place all ingredients in large mixing bowl and beat until stiff enough to stand in peaks.
Place mixture on well-greased slide or ovenproof plate and bake at 350° for 10 minutes, then turn oven down to 230° for 1 hour.
Leave in oven to cool. Decorate with whipped cream and fruit.
recipes.text: Pavolova. Place all ingredients in large mixing bowl and beat until stiff enough to stand in peaks. Place mixture on well-greased slide or ovenproof plate and bake at 350° for 10 minutes, then turn oven down to 230° for 1 hour. Leave in oven to cool. Decorate with whipped cream and fruit.

recipes.title: Father'S Day Delight
directions: Combine Jell-O with 2 cups boiling water.
Add undrained pineapple and let cool.
Whip cream cheese.
Add to Cool Whip; add sugar, then blend with Jell-O mixture.
Pour into large pan.
Add marshmallows and nuts.
Let chill thoroughly.
recipes.text: Father'S Day Delight. Combine Jell-O with 2 cups boiling water. Add undrained pineapple and let cool. Whip cream cheese. Add to Cool Whip; add sugar, then blend with Jell-O mixture. Pour into large pan. Add marshmallows and nuts. Let chill thoroughly.

recipes.title: Lemon Bars
directions: Mix 1 egg, butter and dry cake mix until crumbly.
Reserve 1 cup of mix.
Pat remaining mix into a 9 x 13-inch ungreased pan. Bake 15 minutes in a 350° oven.
recipes.text: Lemon Bars. Mix 1 egg, butter and dry cake mix until crumbly. Reserve 1 cup of mix. Pat remaining mix into a 9 x 13-inch ungreased pan. Bake 15 minutes in a 350° oven.

recipes.title: Clam Dip
directions: Mix all together and season to taste with salt and pepper. Serve with crackers.
recipes.text: Clam Dip. Mix all together and season to taste with salt and pepper. Serve with crackers.

recipes.title: Sara'S Wedding Punch
ingredients: 2 pkg. Jell-O (any flavor to make color)
directions: Bring sugar and water to a boil.
Add Jell-O.
Let cool.
Add pineapple juice, orange juice and lemon juice.
Mix well and freeze.
Thaw for 3 to 4 hours.
Place in punch bowl.
Add ginger ale.
Serves 25 to 30 people.
recipes.text: Sara'S Wedding Punch. Bring sugar and water to a boil. Add Jell-O. Let cool. Add pineapple juice, orange juice and lemon juice. Mix well and freeze. Thaw for 3 to 4 hours. Place in punch bowl. Add ginger ale. Serves 25 to 30 people.

recipes.title: Beefed-Up Biscuit Casserole
ingredients: 1/2 c. chopped onion or 2 Tbsp. instant minced onions
1/4 c. diced green chilies or green pepper
1 can refrigerated buttermilk or country style biscuits
directions: Brown ground beef, onion and chilies; drain.
Stir tomato sauce, chili and garlic powders; simmer while preparing dough. Separate biscuit dough into 10 biscuits (pull each one in 2 layers).
Put 10 layers in ungreased 8 or 9-inch square pan. Combine 1/2 cup cheese, sour cream and egg.
Mix well.
Remove meat from heat and stir in sour cream mixture; spoon over dough. Arrange remaining biscuits over top and sprinkle with remaining cheese.
Bake at 357° for 25 to 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Beefed-Up Biscuit Casserole. Brown ground beef, onion and chilies; drain. Stir tomato sauce, chili and garlic powders; simmer while preparing dough. Separate biscuit dough into 10 biscuits (pull each one in 2 layers). Put 10 layers in ungreased 8 or 9-inch square pan. Combine 1/2 cup cheese, sour cream and egg. Mix well. Remove meat from heat and stir in sour cream mixture; spoon over dough. Arrange remaining biscuits over top and sprinkle with remaining cheese. Bake at 357° for 25 to 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Mexican Chicken
directions: Heat soups, broth and chopped up tomatoes in a saucepan.
Layer ingredients in a casserole dish as follows: Chicken, onions, Doritos, cheese and sauce. Repeat these layers and end with cheese on top.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Mexican Chicken. Heat soups, broth and chopped up tomatoes in a saucepan. Layer ingredients in a casserole dish as follows: Chicken, onions, Doritos, cheese and sauce. Repeat these layers and end with cheese on top. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Hot Cheesy Potatoes
ingredients: small red potatoes, washed and sliced thin
1 (16 oz.) jar Cheez Whiz or 1 (8 oz.) jalapeno Cheez Whiz and 1 (8 oz.) regular Cheez Whiz
directions: Layer potatoes, green onions and celery. Dot with butter, salt and pepper.
Spread half of Cheez Whiz over this and repeat layers.
Cover with foil and bake 1 1/2 hours at 325° or until potatoes are tender.
recipes.text: Hot Cheesy Potatoes. Layer potatoes, green onions and celery. Dot with butter, salt and pepper. Spread half of Cheez Whiz over this and repeat layers. Cover with foil and bake 1 1/2 hours at 325° or until potatoes are tender.

recipes.title: Country Apple Dessert
directions: Melt caramels in water in saucepan over low heat.
Toss bread with margarine, sugar and cinnamon.
In 8-inch square pan, layer 1/2 apples, 1/2 nuts, 1/2 caramel sauce and 1/2 bread cubes. Repeat.
Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Country Apple Dessert. Melt caramels in water in saucepan over low heat. Toss bread with margarine, sugar and cinnamon. In 8-inch square pan, layer 1/2 apples, 1/2 nuts, 1/2 caramel sauce and 1/2 bread cubes. Repeat. Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Country Scrambled Eggs
directions: Microwave:
In 3-quart casserole, microwave bacon on High until softened (2 1/2 to 3 minutes).
Add potatoes.
Cover; microwave on High, stirring after half the time, until potatoes are crisp-tender (5 to 8 minutes).
Stir in onions and green pepper.
Cover; microwave on High, stirring halfway, until crisp-tender, 2 to 2 1/2 minutes.
Pour off fat.
Stir together remaining ingredients, except cheese.
Pour egg mixture over vegetables; stir to blend. Cover; microwave on High, stirring halfway, until eggs are just dry and set, 4 to 5 minutes.
Sprinkle with cheese; let stand until cheese melts.
recipes.text: Country Scrambled Eggs. Microwave: In 3-quart casserole, microwave bacon on High until softened (2 1/2 to 3 minutes). Add potatoes. Cover; microwave on High, stirring after half the time, until potatoes are crisp-tender (5 to 8 minutes). Stir in onions and green pepper. Cover; microwave on High, stirring halfway, until crisp-tender, 2 to 2 1/2 minutes. Pour off fat. Stir together remaining ingredients, except cheese. Pour egg mixture over vegetables; stir to blend. Cover; microwave on High, stirring halfway, until eggs are just dry and set, 4 to 5 minutes. Sprinkle with cheese; let stand until cheese melts.

recipes.title: Sock-It-To-Me Cake
directions: Mix cake mix, sugar, oil, eggs and sour cream together. In a small bowl, mix 1 tablespoon cinnamon and 2 tablespoons brown sugar; mix by hand. Set aside.
recipes.text: Sock-It-To-Me Cake. Mix cake mix, sugar, oil, eggs and sour cream together. In a small bowl, mix 1 tablespoon cinnamon and 2 tablespoons brown sugar; mix by hand. Set aside.

recipes.title: Lazy Lasagna
ingredients: 1 lb. ground beef, browned and drained well
directions: Mix together the eggs, cottage cheese and Parmesan cheese. Add the spaghetti sauce, water and Italian seasoning to ground beef.
In a 12 x 8 x 2-inch baking dish, layer 1 1/2
cups of sauce, 5 noodles, half of cottage cheese mixture, half of Mozzarella cheese, remaining half of sauce, noodles and cottage cheese.
Top with Mozzarella cheese and sprinkle Parmesan cheese. You may add olives.
Cook in oven for 1 hour at 350°.
recipes.text: Lazy Lasagna. Mix together the eggs, cottage cheese and Parmesan cheese. Add the spaghetti sauce, water and Italian seasoning to ground beef. In a 12 x 8 x 2-inch baking dish, layer 1 1/2 cups of sauce, 5 noodles, half of cottage cheese mixture, half of Mozzarella cheese, remaining half of sauce, noodles and cottage cheese. Top with Mozzarella cheese and sprinkle Parmesan cheese. You may add olives. Cook in oven for 1 hour at 350°.

recipes.title: Creamy Dutch Apple Dessert
ingredients: 1 (14 oz.) can Eagle Brand sweetened condensed milk
directions: Preheat oven to 350°.
In 1 1/2-quart shallow baking dish (10 x 6-inch).
Melt butter in oven.
Sprinkle in crumbs, stir well. Press on bottom of dish.
In bowl, mix together sweetened milk, sour cream and lemon juice.
Spread pie filling over creamy layer. Bake 25 to 30 minutes.
Cool slightly, mix nuts and cinnamon. Sprinkle over pie filling.
recipes.text: Creamy Dutch Apple Dessert. Preheat oven to 350°. In 1 1/2-quart shallow baking dish (10 x 6-inch). Melt butter in oven. Sprinkle in crumbs, stir well. Press on bottom of dish. In bowl, mix together sweetened milk, sour cream and lemon juice. Spread pie filling over creamy layer. Bake 25 to 30 minutes. Cool slightly, mix nuts and cinnamon. Sprinkle over pie filling.

recipes.title: Fat-Free Chocolate Cake
directions: Preheat oven to 350°.
Spray 9-inch square baking pan with no-stick cooking spray.
In large bowl, combine dry ingredients until well mixed.
In medium bowl, whisk egg whites, water and corn syrup.
Stir into dry ingredients until smooth.
Pour into prepared pan.
Bake 30 minutes or until cake springs back when lightly touched.
Cool on rack 10 minutes.
Makes 16 servings. Prep time:
15 minutes.
recipes.text: Fat-Free Chocolate Cake. Preheat oven to 350°. Spray 9-inch square baking pan with no-stick cooking spray. In large bowl, combine dry ingredients until well mixed. In medium bowl, whisk egg whites, water and corn syrup. Stir into dry ingredients until smooth. Pour into prepared pan. Bake 30 minutes or until cake springs back when lightly touched. Cool on rack 10 minutes. Makes 16 servings. Prep time: 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Chocolate Zucchini Cake
ingredients: 1 pkg. chocolate cake mix with pudding in it
directions: Mix all together and pour into 2 greased and floured loaf pans.
Bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Chocolate Zucchini Cake. Mix all together and pour into 2 greased and floured loaf pans. Bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Walnut Cake
ingredients: 1 c. finely chopped English or black walnuts
directions: Sift flour, sugar, baking powder and salt together into large bowl.
Add Crisco, milk, vanilla and eggs.
Beat for 2 minutes. Fold in walnuts.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
Cool in pan on rack.
recipes.text: Walnut Cake. Sift flour, sugar, baking powder and salt together into large bowl. Add Crisco, milk, vanilla and eggs. Beat for 2 minutes. Fold in walnuts. Bake at 350° for 1 hour. Cool in pan on rack.

recipes.title: Kidney Bean Roast
directions: Grind beans and potatoes.
Braise onion, sage and celery leaves.
Add this to beans and potato mixture along with egg, flour and salt.
Bake at 350° until done.
recipes.text: Kidney Bean Roast. Grind beans and potatoes. Braise onion, sage and celery leaves. Add this to beans and potato mixture along with egg, flour and salt. Bake at 350° until done.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Bread
directions: Mix all ingredients thoroughly, adding flour slowly.
Grease 3 bread pans and pour in batter.
Bake at 350° for 45 to 50 minutes.
recipes.text: Pumpkin Bread. Mix all ingredients thoroughly, adding flour slowly. Grease 3 bread pans and pour in batter. Bake at 350° for 45 to 50 minutes.

recipes.title: Surprise Pie
ingredients: 5 slices sandwich bread, cut off heels and cut into strips
directions: Layer fruit and bread.
Mix sugar, flour, butter and egg.
Pour over layers; sprinkle with sugar.
Bake in a 350° oven for 25 minutes or until brown.
recipes.text: Surprise Pie. Layer fruit and bread. Mix sugar, flour, butter and egg. Pour over layers; sprinkle with sugar. Bake in a 350° oven for 25 minutes or until brown.

recipes.title: Mexican Cornbread
directions: Mix and bake at 375° until brown.
recipes.text: Mexican Cornbread. Mix and bake at 375° until brown.

recipes.title: Pork Chops
directions: Arrange pork chops in bottom of casserole dish. Top with sliced pepper and onion.
Pour tomato sauce on top.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Pork Chops. Arrange pork chops in bottom of casserole dish. Top with sliced pepper and onion. Pour tomato sauce on top. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Chicken Adobo
ingredients: 1 chicken, regular size or equivalent number of preferred pieces
directions: Clean the chicken and cut into pieces.
Add the salt, minced garlic and pepper to the chicken.
Put in a kettle and add the bay leaf, vinegar and water.
Cover and let simmer until the chicken is tender and the liquid is partially evaporated.
(Filipinos let most of the liquid evaporate; my family prefers to save some to use as gravy with our rice.)
Take the tender chicken pieces and stir-fry them in a little oil.
recipes.text: Chicken Adobo. Clean the chicken and cut into pieces. Add the salt, minced garlic and pepper to the chicken. Put in a kettle and add the bay leaf, vinegar and water. Cover and let simmer until the chicken is tender and the liquid is partially evaporated. (Filipinos let most of the liquid evaporate; my family prefers to save some to use as gravy with our rice.) Take the tender chicken pieces and stir-fry them in a little oil.

recipes.title: Nacho Dip
directions: Brown ground beef and drain off fat.
Place it and rest of ingredients in crock-pot and cook until cheese is melted.
Serve hot in crock-pot.
recipes.text: Nacho Dip. Brown ground beef and drain off fat. Place it and rest of ingredients in crock-pot and cook until cheese is melted. Serve hot in crock-pot.

recipes.title: Punch
ingredients: 1 can pineapple juice (freeze in ice cube trays)
1 jar maraschino cherries (put one cherry in each cube before freezing)
directions: Mix all ingredients except ginger ale.
Add ginger ale just before serving.
recipes.text: Punch. Mix all ingredients except ginger ale. Add ginger ale just before serving.

recipes.title: Southern Living'S Fresh Apple Salad
directions: Combine apples, celery and raisins.
Combine mayonnaise, sugar, salt and pepper.
Stir well.
Pour over apple mixture. Toss gently. Serves 4 to 6.
recipes.text: Southern Living'S Fresh Apple Salad. Combine apples, celery and raisins. Combine mayonnaise, sugar, salt and pepper. Stir well. Pour over apple mixture. Toss gently. Serves 4 to 6.

recipes.title: Chicken Spaghetti
directions: Boil chicken, save broth to boil spaghetti in. Debone chicken and dice. Saut celery, bell pepper and onion. Combine all ingredients. If needed, add some of broth to thin mixture.
recipes.text: Chicken Spaghetti. Boil chicken, save broth to boil spaghetti in. Debone chicken and dice. Saut celery, bell pepper and onion. Combine all ingredients. If needed, add some of broth to thin mixture.

recipes.title: Hot Rolls
directions: Dissolve yeast in warm water.
Mix the other ingredients and add the yeast.
Let rise until double in size and make out what rolls you want.
Put the rest in the refrigerator.
Use as needed. Cook at 425° until golden brown.
recipes.text: Hot Rolls. Dissolve yeast in warm water. Mix the other ingredients and add the yeast. Let rise until double in size and make out what rolls you want. Put the rest in the refrigerator. Use as needed. Cook at 425° until golden brown.

recipes.title: Orange-Cashew Chicken Salad
ingredients: 2 c. diced, cooked chicken or turkey
1 (6 oz.) pkg. frozen pea pods, thawed, halved or 2 c. fresh pea pods, blanched
1 small red bell pepper, cut into short, thin strips
1/3 c. thinly sliced, small red onion rings
1/3 c. cashew halves or coarsely chopped cashews
directions: Peel and separate orange into sections and cut each section in half. In a large bowl, combine orange, chicken, pea pods, red pepper and onion rings.
recipes.text: Orange-Cashew Chicken Salad. Peel and separate orange into sections and cut each section in half. In a large bowl, combine orange, chicken, pea pods, red pepper and onion rings.

recipes.title: Zucchini Rounds
directions: In mixing bowl,
stir
together the flour, cheese, salt and pepper.
Stir in
the
beaten
eggs
until	the mixture is moistened.	Fold in
zucchini.
Pour
oil
in skillet 1/8-inch and heat.
Drop
slightly rounded tablespoonfuls of the batter into oil. Cook, turning once
for
about 1 minute on each side or until golden brown.
recipes.text: Zucchini Rounds. In mixing bowl, stir together the flour, cheese, salt and pepper. Stir in the beaten eggs until	the mixture is moistened.	Fold in zucchini. Pour oil in skillet 1/8-inch and heat. Drop slightly rounded tablespoonfuls of the batter into oil. Cook, turning once for about 1 minute on each side or until golden brown.

recipes.title: Peach Kuchen(Serves 1)
directions: Mix 1 1/4 cups flour and 1/4 teaspoon salt. Cut in butter (or margarine) until pieces are about the size of a pea. Stir in 2 tablespoons sour cream. Press mixture into a 9 x 9-inch baking pan. Bake for 20 minutes at 375°. Spread peaches on baked crust. Mix remaining flour, salt, sour cream, egg yolks and sugar together. Pour over peaches. Bake at 375° for 35 to 40 minutes. Chill and serve with ice cream, whipped cream or plain.
recipes.text: Peach Kuchen(Serves 1). Mix 1 1/4 cups flour and 1/4 teaspoon salt. Cut in butter (or margarine) until pieces are about the size of a pea. Stir in 2 tablespoons sour cream. Press mixture into a 9 x 9-inch baking pan. Bake for 20 minutes at 375°. Spread peaches on baked crust. Mix remaining flour, salt, sour cream, egg yolks and sugar together. Pour over peaches. Bake at 375° for 35 to 40 minutes. Chill and serve with ice cream, whipped cream or plain.

recipes.title: New Orleans Bread Pudding
directions: Break bread into small pieces and soak in the milk until very soft.
Break up any large pieces with a fork.
Add beaten eggs, sugar, vanilla and raisins.
Break butter into small pieces and add to pudding.
Bake in buttered baking dish for about 30 minutes, or until firm at 325°.
Serve warm with Whiskey Sauce.
recipes.text: New Orleans Bread Pudding. Break bread into small pieces and soak in the milk until very soft. Break up any large pieces with a fork. Add beaten eggs, sugar, vanilla and raisins. Break butter into small pieces and add to pudding. Bake in buttered baking dish for about 30 minutes, or until firm at 325°. Serve warm with Whiskey Sauce.

recipes.title: Mrs. Roby'S White Sugar Cookies
ingredients: 1 c. sour milk with 1 1/2 tsp. soda in it
enough flour to make dough stiff
directions: You must use an old coffee cup and a regular teaspoon for measuring.
Must use lard.
Roll out and cut with cookie cutter. Bake in moderate oven about 350° for 10 to 12 minutes.
This is an old fashion recipe.
recipes.text: Mrs. Roby'S White Sugar Cookies. You must use an old coffee cup and a regular teaspoon for measuring. Must use lard. Roll out and cut with cookie cutter. Bake in moderate oven about 350° for 10 to 12 minutes. This is an old fashion recipe.

recipes.title: Stained Glass Jello(Very Good And Colorful For Holidays)
ingredients: 1 (3 oz. each) pkg. orange, cherry and lime jello
2 envelopes Dream Whip or whipped cream
directions: Using 1 cup of boiling water and 1/2 cup cold water each, dissolve and make the three different flavors of jello; chill overnight.
recipes.text: Stained Glass Jello(Very Good And Colorful For Holidays). Using 1 cup of boiling water and 1/2 cup cold water each, dissolve and make the three different flavors of jello; chill overnight.

recipes.title: Baseball Party Punch
ingredients: 1 large can sweetened pineapple juice (if unsweetened, add 1 c. sugar)
directions: Add 7-Up until bowl is filled, may take only 6 to 7 bottles.
recipes.text: Baseball Party Punch. Add 7-Up until bowl is filled, may take only 6 to 7 bottles.

recipes.title: All-In-One Chicken
directions: Preheat oven to 350°.
Wash potatoes, but do not peel them. Cut them into quarters.
Wash the carrots and cut them into 2-inch chunks.
Peel onions and cut into wedges.
recipes.text: All-In-One Chicken. Preheat oven to 350°. Wash potatoes, but do not peel them. Cut them into quarters. Wash the carrots and cut them into 2-inch chunks. Peel onions and cut into wedges.

recipes.title: Rice Casserole
directions: Saute onion in oil.
Cook rice.
Mix all ingredients; bake in casserole dish for 1/2 hour at 325°.
recipes.text: Rice Casserole. Saute onion in oil. Cook rice. Mix all ingredients; bake in casserole dish for 1/2 hour at 325°.

recipes.title: Eggplant Patties
directions: Peel eggplant and cut into small pieces.
Boil in salted water until tender.
Drain well.
Mash and stir in other ingredients. Mix well.
Drop by teaspoon onto well-greased griddle.
Fry on both sides until golden brown.
recipes.text: Eggplant Patties. Peel eggplant and cut into small pieces. Boil in salted water until tender. Drain well. Mash and stir in other ingredients. Mix well. Drop by teaspoon onto well-greased griddle. Fry on both sides until golden brown.

recipes.title: Quick Chicken - Tasting Is Believing
ingredients: 1 cut up fryer (breasts and thighs suggested)
directions: In a large skillet, brown chicken in butter or margarine. Drain chicken on paper towels.
Place in baking dish. Mix together salad dressing, soup mix and cranberry sauce.
Pour over chicken. Bake in oven at 350° for 1 hour or until chicken is tender.
recipes.text: Quick Chicken - Tasting Is Believing. In a large skillet, brown chicken in butter or margarine. Drain chicken on paper towels. Place in baking dish. Mix together salad dressing, soup mix and cranberry sauce. Pour over chicken. Bake in oven at 350° for 1 hour or until chicken is tender.

recipes.title: Tuna Noodle Casserole
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup
directions: Cook noodles according to package directions; drain.
Combine noodles, tuna, soup, cheese, milk and mushrooms, if desired.
Turn into a buttered 2-quart casserole.
Cover and bake at 375° for 20 minutes or until hot and bubbly.
Makes 4 servings.
recipes.text: Tuna Noodle Casserole. Cook noodles according to package directions; drain. Combine noodles, tuna, soup, cheese, milk and mushrooms, if desired. Turn into a buttered 2-quart casserole. Cover and bake at 375° for 20 minutes or until hot and bubbly. Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: Apricot Cake
directions: Mix 1 cup apricot nectar, Crisco oil, lemon cake mix and lemon Jell-O.
Bake at 350° until done.
recipes.text: Apricot Cake. Mix 1 cup apricot nectar, Crisco oil, lemon cake mix and lemon Jell-O. Bake at 350° until done.

recipes.title: Easy Parmesan Chicken
directions: Preheat oven to 350°.
Flour and cook chicken until golden brown.
Place chicken in pan.
Add cheese slices on top of each breast.
Add sauce.
