Shake Parmesan cheese to cover.
Bake until chicken is done and cheese is melted and browned, about 15 to 20 minutes.
recipes.text: Easy Parmesan Chicken. Preheat oven to 350°. Flour and cook chicken until golden brown. Place chicken in pan. Add cheese slices on top of each breast. Add sauce. Shake Parmesan cheese to cover. Bake until chicken is done and cheese is melted and browned, about 15 to 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Spicy Chicken Nachos
directions: Combine cooked chicken, water, picante sauce, pepper and chicken seasoning in a saucepan and heat thoroughly.
Fry tortillas lightly and drain.
Distribute equal portions of the chicken mixture on the fried tortillas and top with a slice of cheese.
Place completed tortillas on a sheet pan and place pan on a high rack of oven broiler.
Broil until cheese bubbles.
Remove pan and using a pizza cutter or large knife, cut each tortilla into fourths.
Garnish each section with sour cream.
Serves 2 to 3.
recipes.text: Spicy Chicken Nachos. Combine cooked chicken, water, picante sauce, pepper and chicken seasoning in a saucepan and heat thoroughly. Fry tortillas lightly and drain. Distribute equal portions of the chicken mixture on the fried tortillas and top with a slice of cheese. Place completed tortillas on a sheet pan and place pan on a high rack of oven broiler. Broil until cheese bubbles. Remove pan and using a pizza cutter or large knife, cut each tortilla into fourths. Garnish each section with sour cream. Serves 2 to 3.

recipes.title: "Powerful Good" Grape Wine
directions: For each jar, fill 1/2 full with grapes; add sugar. Fill to 1-inch of top with cold water.
Screw new enamal type lids on jars.
Store in a dark place for 90 days. Strain.
Chill.
Wine may be bottled and stored; the longer it sets, the better it gets.
recipes.text: "Powerful Good" Grape Wine. For each jar, fill 1/2 full with grapes; add sugar. Fill to 1-inch of top with cold water. Screw new enamal type lids on jars. Store in a dark place for 90 days. Strain. Chill. Wine may be bottled and stored; the longer it sets, the better it gets.

recipes.title: Ghost Cookies
directions: Melt almond bark in microwave or in a double boiler.
Dip the cookie two thirds of the way into the bark and drain excess chocolate.
Place on waxed paper and lightly place small chocolate chips for eyes.
Let almond bark harden and you have ghosts!
recipes.text: Ghost Cookies. Melt almond bark in microwave or in a double boiler. Dip the cookie two thirds of the way into the bark and drain excess chocolate. Place on waxed paper and lightly place small chocolate chips for eyes. Let almond bark harden and you have ghosts!

recipes.title: Sweet 'N Sour Beef
ingredients: 1 lb. beef, cooked medium well and cut into 1-inch squares
2 c. water or juice from pineapple
directions: Combine cornstarch, sugar, salt and liquids.
Cook until it boils and thickens.
Add pineapple, green peppers, tomatoes and beef.
Heat through.
Serve over rice.
recipes.text: Sweet 'N Sour Beef. Combine cornstarch, sugar, salt and liquids. Cook until it boils and thickens. Add pineapple, green peppers, tomatoes and beef. Heat through. Serve over rice.

recipes.title: Roasted Pumpkin Seeds
directions: Mix all ingredients and spread on cookie sheet.
Bake approximately 1 hour at 250°.
Stir often until seeds are no longer wet and are nicely browned.
recipes.text: Roasted Pumpkin Seeds. Mix all ingredients and spread on cookie sheet. Bake approximately 1 hour at 250°. Stir often until seeds are no longer wet and are nicely browned.

recipes.title: Homemade Clay
directions: Mix the flour and the salt together.
Next, add the oil and water.
Work the mixture with your hands until it is dough like. If the dough is wet, add more flour.
If it is dry, add more water.
When it is just right, add the hand lotion.
Store in the refrigerator.
recipes.text: Homemade Clay. Mix the flour and the salt together. Next, add the oil and water. Work the mixture with your hands until it is dough like. If the dough is wet, add more flour. If it is dry, add more water. When it is just right, add the hand lotion. Store in the refrigerator.

recipes.title: Glazed Carrots
directions: Cook and drain carrots.
Mix remaining ingredients.
Cook until thick.
Pour sauce over carrots and let stand for a short time.
Serve hot.
Yield: 6 servings.
recipes.text: Glazed Carrots. Cook and drain carrots. Mix remaining ingredients. Cook until thick. Pour sauce over carrots and let stand for a short time. Serve hot. Yield: 6 servings.

recipes.title: Enchiladas
directions: Boil together in saucepan the enchilada mix, tomato sauce and water.
Brown ground beef and drain fat.
Stir in 3/4 cup of sauce to meat.
Also add 1/2 cup Mozzarella and 1/2 cup Cheddar cheese to meat.
In a 9 x 13-inch pan, pour enough sauce to cover the bottom.
Dip tortilla shells into sauce and fill with 3 tablespoons of meat mixture, placing them seam down.
Pour remaining sauce over prepared enchiladas and remaining cheese. Bake at 350° for 15 minutes and garnish with lettuce, tomato and sour cream before serving.
recipes.text: Enchiladas. Boil together in saucepan the enchilada mix, tomato sauce and water. Brown ground beef and drain fat. Stir in 3/4 cup of sauce to meat. Also add 1/2 cup Mozzarella and 1/2 cup Cheddar cheese to meat. In a 9 x 13-inch pan, pour enough sauce to cover the bottom. Dip tortilla shells into sauce and fill with 3 tablespoons of meat mixture, placing them seam down. Pour remaining sauce over prepared enchiladas and remaining cheese. Bake at 350° for 15 minutes and garnish with lettuce, tomato and sour cream before serving.

recipes.title: Tessie Smith'S Orange Chiffon Cake
directions: Dissolve Jell-O in hot water.
Mix all ingredients.
Bake in angel food or Bundt pan.
recipes.text: Tessie Smith'S Orange Chiffon Cake. Dissolve Jell-O in hot water. Mix all ingredients. Bake in angel food or Bundt pan.

recipes.title: Chicken
directions: Skin chicken and cover with water.
Boil and remove when chicken is tender.
Let chicken cool; take 2 cups broth and put in medium saucepan.
Add cheese and Ro-Tel tomatoes.
Cook on low heat until cheese melts.
Put spaghetti in rest of broth and cook. Chop onion, green pepper and drain mushrooms.
Put in small saucepan with small amount of butter.
Add salt, pepper and garlic salt; simmer on low heat.
Drain spaghetti; put in ovenproof pan. Tear chicken up into small pieces and add to spaghetti.
Add to cheese mix, then add green pepper and mix.
Stir well.
Heat oven to 350°.
Cover pan and bake 30 minutes.
Remove; stir and let sit 15 minutes.
recipes.text: Chicken. Skin chicken and cover with water. Boil and remove when chicken is tender. Let chicken cool; take 2 cups broth and put in medium saucepan. Add cheese and Ro-Tel tomatoes. Cook on low heat until cheese melts. Put spaghetti in rest of broth and cook. Chop onion, green pepper and drain mushrooms. Put in small saucepan with small amount of butter. Add salt, pepper and garlic salt; simmer on low heat. Drain spaghetti; put in ovenproof pan. Tear chicken up into small pieces and add to spaghetti. Add to cheese mix, then add green pepper and mix. Stir well. Heat oven to 350°. Cover pan and bake 30 minutes. Remove; stir and let sit 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Pull Apart Bread
directions: Cut each biscuit in quarters.
Makes 3 layers.
Alternate biscuits and sugar mixture.
Bake 30 minutes at 350° or 375°.
recipes.text: Pull Apart Bread. Cut each biscuit in quarters. Makes 3 layers. Alternate biscuits and sugar mixture. Bake 30 minutes at 350° or 375°.

recipes.title: Strawberry Pie
directions: Blend flour, butter and powdered sugar.
Press in pan with fingers. Bake at 350° until slightly brown, about 20 minutes. Place half of the berries in baked crust.
Add sugar and cornstarch. Boil until clear and thick.
Cool slightly and pour over berries in crust. Cool. Cover with Cool Whip.
recipes.text: Strawberry Pie. Blend flour, butter and powdered sugar. Press in pan with fingers. Bake at 350° until slightly brown, about 20 minutes. Place half of the berries in baked crust. Add sugar and cornstarch. Boil until clear and thick. Cool slightly and pour over berries in crust. Cool. Cover with Cool Whip.

recipes.title: Strawberry Pudding Shortcake(Yields 6 Servings)
directions: Combine almond milk and rice syrup in a 2-quart saucepan and bring to a simmer.
Add grits and cook for 25 to 30 minutes, stirring constantly.
Remove from heat and mix in vanilla.
Pour into 6 individual serving dishes or one large mold.
Cover and refrigerate immediately for 2 hours to chill and prevent drying. Mix strawberries, rice syrup, lemon juice and mint.
Spoon over chilled dessert.
Garnish with mint leaves and serve.
recipes.text: Strawberry Pudding Shortcake(Yields 6 Servings). Combine almond milk and rice syrup in a 2-quart saucepan and bring to a simmer. Add grits and cook for 25 to 30 minutes, stirring constantly. Remove from heat and mix in vanilla. Pour into 6 individual serving dishes or one large mold. Cover and refrigerate immediately for 2 hours to chill and prevent drying. Mix strawberries, rice syrup, lemon juice and mint. Spoon over chilled dessert. Garnish with mint leaves and serve.

recipes.title: Southern Raised Biscuits
directions: Mix together the dry ingredients. Dissolve the yeast in slightly warmed buttermilk.
Combine dry ingredients, oil, yeast and buttermilk, stirring lightly and quickly until mixed. Turn onto a lightly floured board and knead gently about 20 to 30 times.
Roll out or pat to a 1/4-inch thickness.
Cut with a floured 1-inch biscuit cutter.
Place on ungreased baking sheet. Cover and let rise in a warm place for about 2 hours.
Bake at 375° for 12 to 15 minutes.
recipes.text: Southern Raised Biscuits. Mix together the dry ingredients. Dissolve the yeast in slightly warmed buttermilk. Combine dry ingredients, oil, yeast and buttermilk, stirring lightly and quickly until mixed. Turn onto a lightly floured board and knead gently about 20 to 30 times. Roll out or pat to a 1/4-inch thickness. Cut with a floured 1-inch biscuit cutter. Place on ungreased baking sheet. Cover and let rise in a warm place for about 2 hours. Bake at 375° for 12 to 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Mama'S Chocolate Pound Cake
directions: Cream butter, Crisco and sugar. Sift all dry ingredients together and add alternately with milk and vanilla. Add eggs, 1 at a time, blending with all other ingredients. Coat tube pan with shortening. Use a small amount of flour and cocoa to flour pan. Pour mixture into prepared tube pan and place in COLD oven. Turn oven on and let it heat to 325°. Cook for 1 hour and 20 minutes or until done. Cool in pan for 10 minutes.
recipes.text: Mama'S Chocolate Pound Cake. Cream butter, Crisco and sugar. Sift all dry ingredients together and add alternately with milk and vanilla. Add eggs, 1 at a time, blending with all other ingredients. Coat tube pan with shortening. Use a small amount of flour and cocoa to flour pan. Pour mixture into prepared tube pan and place in COLD oven. Turn oven on and let it heat to 325°. Cook for 1 hour and 20 minutes or until done. Cool in pan for 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Apple Cake
directions: Cream together eggs and sugar.
Sift together soda, salt, flour and cinnamon.
Add rest of ingredients to the eggs and sugar mixture.
Pour into 9 x 13-inch pan and bake at 350° for 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Apple Cake. Cream together eggs and sugar. Sift together soda, salt, flour and cinnamon. Add rest of ingredients to the eggs and sugar mixture. Pour into 9 x 13-inch pan and bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Brownies
directions: Mix cocoa and oleo together.
Add sugar and eggs and beat. Add flour, baking powder, salt, nuts and vanilla.
Pour batter into greased 8-inch square pan.
Bake at 350° about 20 minutes. Cool in pan and cut into squares.
Makes about 3 dozen.
recipes.text: Brownies. Mix cocoa and oleo together. Add sugar and eggs and beat. Add flour, baking powder, salt, nuts and vanilla. Pour batter into greased 8-inch square pan. Bake at 350° about 20 minutes. Cool in pan and cut into squares. Makes about 3 dozen.

recipes.title: Craft . . . Pine Cone Birdfeeders
directions: Tie yarn to the top of pine cone.
Cover pine cone with peanut butter, then roll in bird seed.
Hang feeder in tree and watch the birds enjoy.
recipes.text: Craft . . . Pine Cone Birdfeeders. Tie yarn to the top of pine cone. Cover pine cone with peanut butter, then roll in bird seed. Hang feeder in tree and watch the birds enjoy.

recipes.title: Sour Cream Chicken Enchiladas
ingredients: 1 chicken, boiled and deboned or 3 (6 oz.) cans chicken
directions: Combine the first 5 ingredients in a saucepan and cook until heated through, approximately 10 to 15 minutes.
Add sour cream and blend.
recipes.text: Sour Cream Chicken Enchiladas. Combine the first 5 ingredients in a saucepan and cook until heated through, approximately 10 to 15 minutes. Add sour cream and blend.

recipes.title: Oatmeal Cake
directions: Mix first 3 ingredients.
Set aside until cool in a separate bowl.
Mix remaining ingredients together.
Add cooled ingredients from 1st bowl.
Mix and bake in a 350° oven for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Oatmeal Cake. Mix first 3 ingredients. Set aside until cool in a separate bowl. Mix remaining ingredients together. Add cooled ingredients from 1st bowl. Mix and bake in a 350° oven for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Salisbury Steak Supper
directions: Combine ground beef, cracker crumbs, onion, salt, pepper, egg and milk.
Shape into patties.
Brown in electric skillet.
Add potatoes and green beans.
Make gravy according to package directions.
Pour over ingredients.
Simmer 30 to 40 minutes.
recipes.text: Salisbury Steak Supper. Combine ground beef, cracker crumbs, onion, salt, pepper, egg and milk. Shape into patties. Brown in electric skillet. Add potatoes and green beans. Make gravy according to package directions. Pour over ingredients. Simmer 30 to 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Chocolate Eclair Cake
directions: Grease a 9 x 13-inch pan well.
Layer bottom with whole graham crackers.
Mix pudding, 3 cups milk and vanilla; let stand 5 minutes.
Fold in Cool Whip.
Pour half of mixture on graham crackers.
Top with more whole graham crackers.
Pour rest of pudding mixture.
Add last layer of graham crackers.
Top with ready to spread frosting.
Let set in refrigerator for 8 hours before serving.
recipes.text: Chocolate Eclair Cake. Grease a 9 x 13-inch pan well. Layer bottom with whole graham crackers. Mix pudding, 3 cups milk and vanilla; let stand 5 minutes. Fold in Cool Whip. Pour half of mixture on graham crackers. Top with more whole graham crackers. Pour rest of pudding mixture. Add last layer of graham crackers. Top with ready to spread frosting. Let set in refrigerator for 8 hours before serving.

recipes.title: Broccoli Salad
directions: Combine broccoli, sunflower seeds, raisins, bacon and onions in a large bowl.
Mix together remaining ingredients and toss with broccoli mixture.
Chill until serving time.
Serves 6-8.
recipes.text: Broccoli Salad. Combine broccoli, sunflower seeds, raisins, bacon and onions in a large bowl. Mix together remaining ingredients and toss with broccoli mixture. Chill until serving time. Serves 6-8.

recipes.title: Corn Pudding
directions: Combine first 6 ingredients and pour into casserole dish.
Top with butter.
Cook at 350° for 1 hour.
Serves 4.
recipes.text: Corn Pudding. Combine first 6 ingredients and pour into casserole dish. Top with butter. Cook at 350° for 1 hour. Serves 4.

recipes.title: Jacks Dip
directions: Mix well. Serve with vegetables.
recipes.text: Jacks Dip. Mix well. Serve with vegetables.

recipes.title: Jumbo Reese'S
directions: In microwave bowl, microwave 1/2 cup margarine and peanut butter for 1 minute.
Stir.
Add powdered sugar and graham cracker crumbs.
Press into a 9 x 9-inch pan.
Refrigerate.
recipes.text: Jumbo Reese'S. In microwave bowl, microwave 1/2 cup margarine and peanut butter for 1 minute. Stir. Add powdered sugar and graham cracker crumbs. Press into a 9 x 9-inch pan. Refrigerate.

recipes.title: Italian Rice Pudding
directions: In a large pot, bring the milk, sugar and pinch of salt to a boil.
Add the rice.
Cook and simmer over low heat, uncovered, for about 40 minutes or until rice is soft.
Stir occasionally; set aside.
In a large bowl, mix the eggs, vanilla and half and half.
Beat until foamy.
Add all of this mixture to the rice mixture and bring to a slow boil, stirring.
Shut off the heat and place in a large casserole.
When cool, cover and refrigerate. Serve cold.
recipes.text: Italian Rice Pudding. In a large pot, bring the milk, sugar and pinch of salt to a boil. Add the rice. Cook and simmer over low heat, uncovered, for about 40 minutes or until rice is soft. Stir occasionally; set aside. In a large bowl, mix the eggs, vanilla and half and half. Beat until foamy. Add all of this mixture to the rice mixture and bring to a slow boil, stirring. Shut off the heat and place in a large casserole. When cool, cover and refrigerate. Serve cold.

recipes.title: Taco Casserole
directions: Brown ground beef, onion, salt and pepper in medium saucepan. Stir in rest of ingredients, except Doritos.
Heat oven to 350°. Layer bottom of 13 x 9-inch baking pan with tortilla chips.
Then spoon 1/2 meat mixture and 1/2 cheese.
Repeat. Bake 1/2 hour.
recipes.text: Taco Casserole. Brown ground beef, onion, salt and pepper in medium saucepan. Stir in rest of ingredients, except Doritos. Heat oven to 350°. Layer bottom of 13 x 9-inch baking pan with tortilla chips. Then spoon 1/2 meat mixture and 1/2 cheese. Repeat. Bake 1/2 hour.

recipes.title: Strawberry Delight
ingredients: 1 (8 oz.) pkg. cream cheese (at room temperature)
enough fresh strawberry pie filling for two 9-inch pies
directions: Mix margarine with cracker crumbs.
Press into bottom of Tupperware "cold cut keeper" or a 9 x 13-inch dish.
recipes.text: Strawberry Delight. Mix margarine with cracker crumbs. Press into bottom of Tupperware "cold cut keeper" or a 9 x 13-inch dish.

recipes.title: Sugar Cookies
directions: Preheat oven to 350°.
Cream butter, shortening and both sugars.
Add eggs; beat well.
Add flour, sifted with cream of tartar and soda.
Add vanilla.
Roll into small balls.
Roll each ball in granulated sugar and place on lightly greased cookie sheet.
Flatten with a glass that has been dipped in sugar.
Bake at 350° for 8 to 10 minutes or until lightly browned.
recipes.text: Sugar Cookies. Preheat oven to 350°. Cream butter, shortening and both sugars. Add eggs; beat well. Add flour, sifted with cream of tartar and soda. Add vanilla. Roll into small balls. Roll each ball in granulated sugar and place on lightly greased cookie sheet. Flatten with a glass that has been dipped in sugar. Bake at 350° for 8 to 10 minutes or until lightly browned.

recipes.title: Savory Patties
ingredients: 1 tsp. onion powder or 1 chopped onion
directions: Wash soybeans and soak in 3 cups water overnight.
Save 1 1/4 cups of this water and drain the rest.
Grind soybeans with saved water.
Mix soybeans with oatmeal; let stand 10 minutes.
Stir in other ingredients.
Drop by rounded teaspoonfuls into oiled skillet.
Cover and cook on moderate heat until browned on both sides.
Serve with sauce, tomato, mushroom or whatever desired.
recipes.text: Savory Patties. Wash soybeans and soak in 3 cups water overnight. Save 1 1/4 cups of this water and drain the rest. Grind soybeans with saved water. Mix soybeans with oatmeal; let stand 10 minutes. Stir in other ingredients. Drop by rounded teaspoonfuls into oiled skillet. Cover and cook on moderate heat until browned on both sides. Serve with sauce, tomato, mushroom or whatever desired.

recipes.title: Tartar Sauce
directions: Mix together and refrigerate.
recipes.text: Tartar Sauce. Mix together and refrigerate.

recipes.title: A Whole Meal In A Baked Potato
ingredients: 8 oz. Danish Cream Havarti or Fontina, shredded
1 c. each (4 c. total) thinly sliced carrots, sliced zucchini, broccoli florets, halved Brussels sprouts
directions: Scrub potatoes; dry
and
place
on
racks in 450° oven. Bake until tender (approximately 1 hour).
Cook vegetables in a medium saucepan
until

taste.
Place vegetables in bowl. Measure cooking
liquid,

add milk to make 2 cups. Pour into saucepan
and set over medium heat.
Toss cheese with flour. Gradually
add to hot liquid, stirring constantly until cheese melts and

When

are

press

recipes.text: A Whole Meal In A Baked Potato. Scrub potatoes; dry and place on racks in 450° oven. Bake until tender (approximately 1 hour). Cook vegetables in a medium saucepan until tender to taste. Place vegetables in bowl. Measure cooking liquid, then add milk to make 2 cups. Pour into saucepan and set over medium heat. Toss cheese with flour. Gradually add to hot liquid, stirring constantly until cheese melts and sauce is smooth. Stir in vegetables. Cover; keep warm. When potatoes are tender, immediately cut crisscross tops to release steam. Squeeze and press ends toward center to fluff up insides. Place on serving dishes and top each with sauce.

recipes.title: Pretzel Jello Salad
directions: Mix together and press into 9 x 13 pan. Bake in 400 oven for 8 minutes, cool. Mix cream cheese, sugar, Cool Whip. Spread on cool pretzel crust. Dissolve jello in water, mix in the strawberries.
Let sit for 10 minutes.
Pour jello mixture on top of cream cheese. Let chill overnight.
recipes.text: Pretzel Jello Salad. Mix together and press into 9 x 13 pan. Bake in 400 oven for 8 minutes, cool. Mix cream cheese, sugar, Cool Whip. Spread on cool pretzel crust. Dissolve jello in water, mix in the strawberries. Let sit for 10 minutes. Pour jello mixture on top of cream cheese. Let chill overnight.

recipes.title: Meatza Pizza
directions: In a large bowl, mix the ingredients (except toppings) thoroughly.
Cover cookie sheet with foil.
Put the ground beef mixture on the foil.
Pat the meat firmly into a 10-inch circle, about 1/2-inch thick.
Build a stand-up rim about 1-inch high all around the edge of the circle.
This makes a meat "crust" for your pizza.
(Be sure it's high and firm enough so it will prevent the meat juices and soup sauce from bubbling over.)
Turn up edges of the foil to catch drippings.
recipes.text: Meatza Pizza. In a large bowl, mix the ingredients (except toppings) thoroughly. Cover cookie sheet with foil. Put the ground beef mixture on the foil. Pat the meat firmly into a 10-inch circle, about 1/2-inch thick. Build a stand-up rim about 1-inch high all around the edge of the circle. This makes a meat "crust" for your pizza. (Be sure it's high and firm enough so it will prevent the meat juices and soup sauce from bubbling over.) Turn up edges of the foil to catch drippings.

recipes.title: Holiday Breakfast(Serve Warm)
ingredients: 3 tart apples, peeled, cored, sliced thin
1 loaf French bread cut in 1 inch slices
directions: Combine brown sugar, butter, and 1 tsp. cinnamon in 9 x 13 pan. Add apples and raisins. Toss to coat well. Spread apples evenly over bottom of pan. Arrange sliced bread on top. Mix eggs, milk, vanilla, and remaining 2 tsp. cinnamon until well blended. Pour over bread, soaking completely. Cover and refrigerate 4 to 24 hours. Bake covered with aluminum foil in preheated 375° oven for 40 minutes. Uncover and bake 5 more minutes. Let set 5 minutes before serving.
recipes.text: Holiday Breakfast(Serve Warm). Combine brown sugar, butter, and 1 tsp. cinnamon in 9 x 13 pan. Add apples and raisins. Toss to coat well. Spread apples evenly over bottom of pan. Arrange sliced bread on top. Mix eggs, milk, vanilla, and remaining 2 tsp. cinnamon until well blended. Pour over bread, soaking completely. Cover and refrigerate 4 to 24 hours. Bake covered with aluminum foil in preheated 375° oven for 40 minutes. Uncover and bake 5 more minutes. Let set 5 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Turkey Salad Burritos
directions: In medium mixing bowl, combine turkey, celery, onion, black olives and cheese.
In another bowl, whisk together salad dressing, picante sauce and salt.
Pour sauce over turkey mixture; blend well.
Spoon filling onto tortillas; wrap burrito-style.* Heat in 13 x 9 x 3-inch baking pan at 350° for 20 minutes or until thoroughly warmed or microwave each burrito 2 to 2 1/2 minutes on High.
Serve with additional picante sauce; garnish with black olives.
Yield: 4 servings.
recipes.text: Turkey Salad Burritos. In medium mixing bowl, combine turkey, celery, onion, black olives and cheese. In another bowl, whisk together salad dressing, picante sauce and salt. Pour sauce over turkey mixture; blend well. Spoon filling onto tortillas; wrap burrito-style.* Heat in 13 x 9 x 3-inch baking pan at 350° for 20 minutes or until thoroughly warmed or microwave each burrito 2 to 2 1/2 minutes on High. Serve with additional picante sauce; garnish with black olives. Yield: 4 servings.

recipes.title: Rum Cake
directions: Mix well and bake at 250° for 1 hour. Use Bundt pan.
recipes.text: Rum Cake. Mix well and bake at 250° for 1 hour. Use Bundt pan.

recipes.title: Vinegar Dressing
directions: Uses:
Salad dressing, coleslaw dressing, chicken marinade.
recipes.text: Vinegar Dressing. Uses: Salad dressing, coleslaw dressing, chicken marinade.

recipes.title: Marshmallow Creme
directions: Boil sugar and water to a thin syrup.
Press 12 marshmallows into the syrup, but do not stir.
Beat 1 egg white (thick) and when marshmallows are melted, beat into the egg white.
recipes.text: Marshmallow Creme. Boil sugar and water to a thin syrup. Press 12 marshmallows into the syrup, but do not stir. Beat 1 egg white (thick) and when marshmallows are melted, beat into the egg white.

recipes.title: Mixed Vegetable Casserole
directions: Mix together first 5 ingredients.
Add margarine and crackers last.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Mixed Vegetable Casserole. Mix together first 5 ingredients. Add margarine and crackers last. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: 3 Bean Casserole
directions: Brown ground beef and onion.
Add ketchup and brown sugar. Cook a few minutes.
Then add all of the beans.
Bake for 1 hour until it gets a little thick at 350°.
Put in a casserole dish.
recipes.text: 3 Bean Casserole. Brown ground beef and onion. Add ketchup and brown sugar. Cook a few minutes. Then add all of the beans. Bake for 1 hour until it gets a little thick at 350°. Put in a casserole dish.

recipes.title: Zucchini Appetizers
ingredients: 3 c. thinly sliced, unpared zucchini (about 4 small ones)
1/2 tsp. dried marjoram or oregano leaves
directions: Grease
a
x
9 x 2-inch pan.
Mix all ingredients; spread in pan.
Bake at 350° for about 25 minutes until golden brown. Cut into pieces (about 2 x 1-inch).
Makes 24 appetizers.
recipes.text: Zucchini Appetizers. Grease a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Mix all ingredients; spread in pan. Bake at 350° for about 25 minutes until golden brown. Cut into pieces (about 2 x 1-inch). Makes 24 appetizers.

recipes.title: Frozen Fruit Salad
directions: Blend together cream cheese and mayonnaise.
Fold in Cool Whip, marshmallows and fruit.
Pour into a 9 x 13-inch pan and freeze.
This needs to thaw a little while in order to serve. Time depends on weather.
recipes.text: Frozen Fruit Salad. Blend together cream cheese and mayonnaise. Fold in Cool Whip, marshmallows and fruit. Pour into a 9 x 13-inch pan and freeze. This needs to thaw a little while in order to serve. Time depends on weather.

recipes.title: Spicy Oatmeal Raisin Cookies
directions: Mix all ingredients, add oats, raisins and nuts last.
Bake on greased cookie sheet in 375 F oven 8-10 minutes.
Makes approx. 40 cookies.
recipes.text: Spicy Oatmeal Raisin Cookies. Mix all ingredients, add oats, raisins and nuts last. Bake on greased cookie sheet in 375 F oven 8-10 minutes. Makes approx. 40 cookies.

recipes.title: Grilling Herb Mix
ingredients: 1 part each: ground dried rosemary, basil and oregano
1/2 part each: ground dried sage, peppermint and thyme
directions: Mix all ingredients well.
Pour into a jar; seal tightly. Store in a cool, dry place.
recipes.text: Grilling Herb Mix. Mix all ingredients well. Pour into a jar; seal tightly. Store in a cool, dry place.

recipes.title: Rhubarb Nut Bread
directions: Bake 45 minutes in a 350° oven.
recipes.text: Rhubarb Nut Bread. Bake 45 minutes in a 350° oven.

recipes.title: Grandma Ellen Hess' Cold Biscuit Pie
directions: Warm apples and sweeten to taste.
Layer a dish with the apples, then add a layer of biscuits and another layer of apples and biscuits until all used, with apples on top.
recipes.text: Grandma Ellen Hess' Cold Biscuit Pie. Warm apples and sweeten to taste. Layer a dish with the apples, then add a layer of biscuits and another layer of apples and biscuits until all used, with apples on top.

recipes.title: Striped Delight
ingredients: 2 (4 oz.) pkg. Jell-O instant pudding and pie filling (any flavor)
directions: Combine graham cracker crumbs, 1/4 cup sugar and melted butter. Press in pie pan.
Beat cream cheese with sugar and 2 tablespoons milk until smooth.
Fold in half the whipped topping.
Spread over crust.
Prepare pudding as directed on package using 3 1/2 cups milk.
Pour over cream cheese layer.
Chill several hours.
Spread remaining topping over pudding.
Garnish with grated chocolate or nuts.
recipes.text: Striped Delight. Combine graham cracker crumbs, 1/4 cup sugar and melted butter. Press in pie pan. Beat cream cheese with sugar and 2 tablespoons milk until smooth. Fold in half the whipped topping. Spread over crust. Prepare pudding as directed on package using 3 1/2 cups milk. Pour over cream cheese layer. Chill several hours. Spread remaining topping over pudding. Garnish with grated chocolate or nuts.

recipes.title: Leek, Potato And Tarragon Soup
ingredients: 2 leeks (white and pale green parts only), sliced (about 2 cups)
1/2 lb red-skinned potatoes, unpeeled, cut into 1/2 inch pieces
4 cups low-salt chicken broth or vegetable broth
directions: Melt butter in heavy large pot over medium heat.
Add leeks, onion, garlic and 2 tbsp.
Water.
Cook until leeks are just golden, about 10 minutes.
Add potatoes and both; bring to boil. Reduce heat to low and simmer until potatoes are tender, about 10 minutes.
Mix in tarragon.
(Can be made 1 day ahead.)
Cool slightly.
Cover and refrigerate.
(Rewarm before continuing.) Stir in cream and yogurt.
Season soup to taste with salt and pepper. 4-6 servings.
recipes.text: Leek, Potato And Tarragon Soup. Melt butter in heavy large pot over medium heat. Add leeks, onion, garlic and 2 tbsp. Water. Cook until leeks are just golden, about 10 minutes. Add potatoes and both; bring to boil. Reduce heat to low and simmer until potatoes are tender, about 10 minutes. Mix in tarragon. (Can be made 1 day ahead.) Cool slightly. Cover and refrigerate. (Rewarm before continuing.) Stir in cream and yogurt. Season soup to taste with salt and pepper. 4-6 servings.

recipes.title: Carrot Salad
directions: Mix above ingredients well.
Allow to stand about 30 minutes before serving.
recipes.text: Carrot Salad. Mix above ingredients well. Allow to stand about 30 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Tonda'S Homemade Chili
ingredients: 1 lb. ground (hot or mild) pork sausage
directions: Brown meat and onion.
Salt and pepper.
Drain fat.
Blend tomatoes in blender.
Add tomatoes, beans and chili powder. Simmer for 45 minutes to 1 hour.
recipes.text: Tonda'S Homemade Chili. Brown meat and onion. Salt and pepper. Drain fat. Blend tomatoes in blender. Add tomatoes, beans and chili powder. Simmer for 45 minutes to 1 hour.

recipes.title: Rice Krispies Chewies
directions: Mix sugar and corn syrup in a large saucepan; heat to boil. Stir.
Set off burner.
Add peanut butter and put back on burner. Stir constantly and bring to a boil; remove from heat.
Add Rice Krispies.
Press in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish.
Melt chips together and pour over Rice Krispies treats.
Let cool, then cut into squares.
recipes.text: Rice Krispies Chewies. Mix sugar and corn syrup in a large saucepan; heat to boil. Stir. Set off burner. Add peanut butter and put back on burner. Stir constantly and bring to a boil; remove from heat. Add Rice Krispies. Press in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Melt chips together and pour over Rice Krispies treats. Let cool, then cut into squares.

recipes.title: Zucchini Cake
directions: Blend eggs, oil, sugar and zucchini.
Sift dry ingredients together; add to first mixture.
Add nuts and vanilla.
Bake in two greased loaf pans or one greased tube pan for 1 hour at 350°. Invert and cool completely before removing from pans.
recipes.text: Zucchini Cake. Blend eggs, oil, sugar and zucchini. Sift dry ingredients together; add to first mixture. Add nuts and vanilla. Bake in two greased loaf pans or one greased tube pan for 1 hour at 350°. Invert and cool completely before removing from pans.

recipes.title: Wise Pork Chops
directions: Season chops with salt and pepper; dredge in flour.
Set aside.
In large skillet, saute onions and sage in oil until onions are golden; remove.
Set aside.
recipes.text: Wise Pork Chops. Season chops with salt and pepper; dredge in flour. Set aside. In large skillet, saute onions and sage in oil until onions are golden; remove. Set aside.

recipes.title: Fresh Peach Dumplings
ingredients: 1 pkg. quick cinnamon rolls with icing
directions: Mix water and sugar in 2 1/2 to 3-quart pan with a tight fitting lid.
Heat to boil.
Add peaches and heat to a boil.
Lay cinnamon rolls, cinnamon side down closely over top of peaches. Cover and cook over medium heat for 15 minutes.
Spread icing over cinnamon dumplings.
Serve warm with peaches from pan spooned over dumplings.
recipes.text: Fresh Peach Dumplings. Mix water and sugar in 2 1/2 to 3-quart pan with a tight fitting lid. Heat to boil. Add peaches and heat to a boil. Lay cinnamon rolls, cinnamon side down closely over top of peaches. Cover and cook over medium heat for 15 minutes. Spread icing over cinnamon dumplings. Serve warm with peaches from pan spooned over dumplings.

recipes.title: Sugar-Free Apple Pie
ingredients: 6 to 8 medium apples, peeled and sliced
directions: Mix nutmeg, cinnamon and Equal.
Mix with apples and add lemon juice, mixing well to coat apples.
Pour into prepared crust and bake in a preheated 425° oven for 40 to 50 minutes or until crust is golden and mixture bubbly.
recipes.text: Sugar-Free Apple Pie. Mix nutmeg, cinnamon and Equal. Mix with apples and add lemon juice, mixing well to coat apples. Pour into prepared crust and bake in a preheated 425° oven for 40 to 50 minutes or until crust is golden and mixture bubbly.

recipes.title: Glorified Rice
ingredients: 1 (8 oz.) can crushed pineapple in juice, well drained
directions: Combine water, butter and salt in saucepan, bring to boil. Stir in rice, cover and set off heat.
Let stand 5 minutes, fluff with fork and let cool.
Stir in pineapple, marshmallows, coconut and cherries.
Fold in Cool Whip, cover, chill about 1 hour. Serves 8.
recipes.text: Glorified Rice. Combine water, butter and salt in saucepan, bring to boil. Stir in rice, cover and set off heat. Let stand 5 minutes, fluff with fork and let cool. Stir in pineapple, marshmallows, coconut and cherries. Fold in Cool Whip, cover, chill about 1 hour. Serves 8.

recipes.title: Sour Cream Raisin Bars
directions: Cook
and
drain raisins.
Mix cornstarch, sugar, eggs, sour cream and raisins.	Boil until thick, stirring constantly.	Pour over
crumb
mixture.
Sprinkle
some of mixture on top.
Bake 30 minutes in 325° oven.
recipes.text: Sour Cream Raisin Bars. Cook and drain raisins. Mix cornstarch, sugar, eggs, sour cream and raisins.	Boil until thick, stirring constantly.	Pour over crumb mixture. Sprinkle some of mixture on top. Bake 30 minutes in 325° oven.

recipes.title: Ham Cabbage Rice
ingredients: 1 good ham bone with leftover ham
directions: Boil ham bone in water until broth tastes "hammy", about 1 1/2 hours.
Add head of cabbage (quartered).
Cook until tender. Remove and keep warm in another pot.
Add rice to broth (about 2 1/2 cups) and cook until done.
recipes.text: Ham Cabbage Rice. Boil ham bone in water until broth tastes "hammy", about 1 1/2 hours. Add head of cabbage (quartered). Cook until tender. Remove and keep warm in another pot. Add rice to broth (about 2 1/2 cups) and cook until done.

recipes.title: Ambrosia
ingredients: 8 to 10 juicy oranges, peeled and diced
directions: Combine all ingredients. Chill overnight.
Yields 4 to 6 servings.
recipes.text: Ambrosia. Combine all ingredients. Chill overnight. Yields 4 to 6 servings.

recipes.title: Apple Dessert
directions: Heat oven to 375°.
Melt butter and add apples, walnuts, sugar and cinnamon.
Cook, stirring 4 minutes or until tender. Let cool.
Separate dough into triangles.
Roll out and place 1 tablespoon of apple mixture on each crescent triangle.
Roll up each crescent and gently pinch edges together.
Place on ungreased baking sheet.
Bake 10 minutes.
recipes.text: Apple Dessert. Heat oven to 375°. Melt butter and add apples, walnuts, sugar and cinnamon. Cook, stirring 4 minutes or until tender. Let cool. Separate dough into triangles. Roll out and place 1 tablespoon of apple mixture on each crescent triangle. Roll up each crescent and gently pinch edges together. Place on ungreased baking sheet. Bake 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Ham And Cheese Bake
ingredients: 1 (10 oz.) pkg. frozen broccoli, thawed and drained
directions: Place 6 slices of bread on bottom of 12 x 8-inch baking dish. Cover with 1 cup of Cheddar cheese.
Add ham, broccoli and top with remaining bread.
Beat cream cheese until fluffy.
Add eggs one at a time; mix well.
Blend in milk and mustard.
Pour over bread.
Top with remaining cheese.
Bake at 350° for 45 to 50 minutes.
Let stand 10 minutes before serving.
recipes.text: Ham And Cheese Bake. Place 6 slices of bread on bottom of 12 x 8-inch baking dish. Cover with 1 cup of Cheddar cheese. Add ham, broccoli and top with remaining bread. Beat cream cheese until fluffy. Add eggs one at a time; mix well. Blend in milk and mustard. Pour over bread. Top with remaining cheese. Bake at 350° for 45 to 50 minutes. Let stand 10 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Cream Cheese Brownies
ingredients: 2 (4 oz.) pkg. Baker's German's sweet chocolate
directions: Melt chocolate with 6 tablespoons butter over low heat, stirring constantly.
Cool.
Cream remaining butter with cheese. Gradually add 1/2 cup sugar; cream well after each addition. Blend in 2 eggs, 2 tablespoons flour and 1 teaspoon vanilla.
Set aside.
recipes.text: Cream Cheese Brownies. Melt chocolate with 6 tablespoons butter over low heat, stirring constantly. Cool. Cream remaining butter with cheese. Gradually add 1/2 cup sugar; cream well after each addition. Blend in 2 eggs, 2 tablespoons flour and 1 teaspoon vanilla. Set aside.

recipes.title: Liz'S Clam Sauce
directions: Heat oil.
Lightly brown garlic.
Add butter and parsley. Next, add clams and juice.
Salt and pepper now.
Add to cooked, drained spaghetti and toss.
Better the next day!
recipes.text: Liz'S Clam Sauce. Heat oil. Lightly brown garlic. Add butter and parsley. Next, add clams and juice. Salt and pepper now. Add to cooked, drained spaghetti and toss. Better the next day!

recipes.title: Mom'S Baked Beans
ingredients: 3 c. red kidney beans or mixture
directions: Soak enough beans overnight to make 3 cups. Combine all the ingredients in a crock-pot, bean pot or suitable dish with cover for oven. (If too dry during cooking, add more tomatoes or tomato juice.) Bake in oven at 300° or slow cook for 12 1/2 to 13 hours.
recipes.text: Mom'S Baked Beans. Soak enough beans overnight to make 3 cups. Combine all the ingredients in a crock-pot, bean pot or suitable dish with cover for oven. (If too dry during cooking, add more tomatoes or tomato juice.) Bake in oven at 300° or slow cook for 12 1/2 to 13 hours.

recipes.title: Chicken And Broccoli Casserole(For Microwave)
directions: Place in casserole in this order:
broccoli, chicken, soup and potatoes.
Top with cheese.
Bake in microwave for 15 minutes.
recipes.text: Chicken And Broccoli Casserole(For Microwave). Place in casserole in this order: broccoli, chicken, soup and potatoes. Top with cheese. Bake in microwave for 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Helen'S Chicken Breasts
ingredients: chicken breasts, deboned and skinned (2 per person)
pinch of garlic salt or 1/8 tsp. onion juice
directions: Mix ingredients.
Put chicken in Ziploc bags.
Cover with mixture and marinate in refrigerator overnight.
One and one-half hours before baking, remove from refrigerator.
Roll up chicken into rolls, then roll in bread crumbs.
Let sit for 1 hour.
Spray baking pan with Pam.
Bake at 325° for 1 1/2 hours.
Good hot or cold!
recipes.text: Helen'S Chicken Breasts. Mix ingredients. Put chicken in Ziploc bags. Cover with mixture and marinate in refrigerator overnight. One and one-half hours before baking, remove from refrigerator. Roll up chicken into rolls, then roll in bread crumbs. Let sit for 1 hour. Spray baking pan with Pam. Bake at 325° for 1 1/2 hours. Good hot or cold!

recipes.title: No Bake Banana Pudding
directions: Mix first 3 ingredients until thickened.
Layer with vanilla wafers and bananas in large Pyrex dish.
Top with Cool Whip and refrigerate.
recipes.text: No Bake Banana Pudding. Mix first 3 ingredients until thickened. Layer with vanilla wafers and bananas in large Pyrex dish. Top with Cool Whip and refrigerate.

recipes.title: Jello Salad
directions: Mix Cool Whip and cottage cheese.
Add Jell-O and fruit.
Cool in refrigerator.
recipes.text: Jello Salad. Mix Cool Whip and cottage cheese. Add Jell-O and fruit. Cool in refrigerator.

recipes.title: Potato Pancakes(Placki)
directions: Mix liquid raw potatoes, salt and egg.
Gradually add flour (you may not need to use the full cup of flour).
Using shortening heated in iron skillet, drop batter into hot liquid and spread to size placki you want.
Fry on both sides.
Serve with sour cream.
recipes.text: Potato Pancakes(Placki). Mix liquid raw potatoes, salt and egg. Gradually add flour (you may not need to use the full cup of flour). Using shortening heated in iron skillet, drop batter into hot liquid and spread to size placki you want. Fry on both sides. Serve with sour cream.

recipes.title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
directions: * We use all or half butter Crisco.
recipes.text: Chocolate Chip Cookies. * We use all or half butter Crisco.

recipes.title: Fresh Pear Cake
ingredients: 3 c. chopped pears or 4 c. chopped apples
directions: Mix oil and sugar; blend in vanilla and eggs.
Sift all dry ingredients and add to mixture.
Add pears and nuts (optional). Mix well.
Bake in greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan.
Cook 45 minutes in 350° oven.
Cool and ice with Cream Cheese Icing.
Cut into 24 squares.
recipes.text: Fresh Pear Cake. Mix oil and sugar; blend in vanilla and eggs. Sift all dry ingredients and add to mixture. Add pears and nuts (optional). Mix well. Bake in greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan. Cook 45 minutes in 350° oven. Cool and ice with Cream Cheese Icing. Cut into 24 squares.

recipes.title: Pastry Crust
ingredients: 1 egg, beaten with 3 tsp. milk, to glaze
directions: Place flour and salt in a bowl.
Add butter.
With fingertips only, mix to a bread crumb consistency.
Mix in egg yolk and lemon juice.
With a knife, cut in 1 teaspoon water, adding a little more if necessary to form a stiff dough.
Turn out onto a floured board and knead gently into a small ball.
If using to make a pie, roll out to size of pie plate.
Carefully line pie plate with crust. Prick base with a fork.
Bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes or until golden brown.
Makes bottom crust for one 8-inch pie.
recipes.text: Pastry Crust. Place flour and salt in a bowl. Add butter. With fingertips only, mix to a bread crumb consistency. Mix in egg yolk and lemon juice. With a knife, cut in 1 teaspoon water, adding a little more if necessary to form a stiff dough. Turn out onto a floured board and knead gently into a small ball. If using to make a pie, roll out to size of pie plate. Carefully line pie plate with crust. Prick base with a fork. Bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes or until golden brown. Makes bottom crust for one 8-inch pie.

recipes.title: Christmas Cranberry Salad
directions: Combine cranberries, marshmallows and sugar and let set, covered overnight in refrigerator.
Next day, add apples, grapes, nuts and apples to cranberry mixture and fold in whipped cream. Chill until serving time.
recipes.text: Christmas Cranberry Salad. Combine cranberries, marshmallows and sugar and let set, covered overnight in refrigerator. Next day, add apples, grapes, nuts and apples to cranberry mixture and fold in whipped cream. Chill until serving time.

recipes.title: Churros
directions: Heat oil in a large saucepan over high heat.
Reduce heat to medium 5 minutes before adding the dough.
Roll dough into nickel size balls.
Drop into preheated oil. Fry until lightly browned. (Dough will expand as it is heated.) Remove from heat.
Drain. Coat with icing.
recipes.text: Churros. Heat oil in a large saucepan over high heat. Reduce heat to medium 5 minutes before adding the dough. Roll dough into nickel size balls. Drop into preheated oil. Fry until lightly browned. (Dough will expand as it is heated.) Remove from heat. Drain. Coat with icing.

recipes.title: Christmas Sweet Pickles
directions: Drain pickles; wash and cut into chunks.
Put pickle chunks, sugar and spices in jar (in layers).
Stir every day until sugar melts.
Keep in refrigerator.
Ready to eat in 2 weeks.
Good!
recipes.text: Christmas Sweet Pickles. Drain pickles; wash and cut into chunks. Put pickle chunks, sugar and spices in jar (in layers). Stir every day until sugar melts. Keep in refrigerator. Ready to eat in 2 weeks. Good!

recipes.title: Stuffed Peppers
directions: Boil peppers until tender (firm, but tender), then drain. Brown hamburger, seasoned with chili and set aside.
Saute onion and bread chunks in a small amount of leftover hamburger drippings.
Add stewed tomatoes and hamburger, mixing thoroughly. Fill peppers with mixture.
Nice served with jello on the side with a vegetable.
recipes.text: Stuffed Peppers. Boil peppers until tender (firm, but tender), then drain. Brown hamburger, seasoned with chili and set aside. Saute onion and bread chunks in a small amount of leftover hamburger drippings. Add stewed tomatoes and hamburger, mixing thoroughly. Fill peppers with mixture. Nice served with jello on the side with a vegetable.

recipes.title: Biscuits
directions: Mix and roll out on floured board.
Cut to desired size with biscuit cutter.
Bake at 475° for 10 to 12 minutes.
recipes.text: Biscuits. Mix and roll out on floured board. Cut to desired size with biscuit cutter. Bake at 475° for 10 to 12 minutes.

recipes.title: Chicken Broccoli Bake
ingredients: 1/2 c. bread crumbs or Pepperidge Farm dressing
directions: Layer in pan and bake 25 minutes at 350°.
recipes.text: Chicken Broccoli Bake. Layer in pan and bake 25 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Great Deer Chili
directions: Cook deer meat.
Add chili seasoning with tomato sauce and tomato juice.
Takes about 20 to 25 minutes.
Add kidney beans, if desired.
Great with hot dogs!
recipes.text: Great Deer Chili. Cook deer meat. Add chili seasoning with tomato sauce and tomato juice. Takes about 20 to 25 minutes. Add kidney beans, if desired. Great with hot dogs!

recipes.title: Beets With Pineapple
directions: Drain beets (if fresh, cook).
In a saucepan, combine brown sugar, cornstarch and dash of salt. Stir in undrained pineapple. Cook and stir until mixture is thickened and bubbly. Cook and stir 1 to 2 minutes more.
Add butter, lemon juice and beets.
Cook and stir over medium heat about 5 minutes or until heated through.
recipes.text: Beets With Pineapple. Drain beets (if fresh, cook). In a saucepan, combine brown sugar, cornstarch and dash of salt. Stir in undrained pineapple. Cook and stir until mixture is thickened and bubbly. Cook and stir 1 to 2 minutes more. Add butter, lemon juice and beets. Cook and stir over medium heat about 5 minutes or until heated through.

recipes.title: Karen Kuhlman'S Country Club Potato Salad
directions: Boil potatoes in salted water until knife soft.
Chop into bite size pieces.
Add mayonnaise, celery, relish, pickle juice, mustard, dill weed, salt and pepper to taste.
Refrigerate overnight.
Garnish with hard-boiled eggs.
recipes.text: Karen Kuhlman'S Country Club Potato Salad. Boil potatoes in salted water until knife soft. Chop into bite size pieces. Add mayonnaise, celery, relish, pickle juice, mustard, dill weed, salt and pepper to taste. Refrigerate overnight. Garnish with hard-boiled eggs.

recipes.title: Congo Bars
directions: Mix all ingredients; bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Congo Bars. Mix all ingredients; bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Summer Sausage
ingredients: 2 lb. ground beef or ground deer burger
directions: Mix well.
Divide into 3 parts.
Roll in plastic wrap. Refrigerate 24 hours.
Bake at 300° for 1 1/2 hours.
recipes.text: Summer Sausage. Mix well. Divide into 3 parts. Roll in plastic wrap. Refrigerate 24 hours. Bake at 300° for 1 1/2 hours.

recipes.title: Sausage Dip
directions: Brown sausage.
Drain well.
Put in a large crock-pot along with the other ingredients and cook until cheese has melted. Serve with nacho chips or Doritos or over hot dogs.
recipes.text: Sausage Dip. Brown sausage. Drain well. Put in a large crock-pot along with the other ingredients and cook until cheese has melted. Serve with nacho chips or Doritos or over hot dogs.

recipes.title: Green Wonder Salad
directions: Drain beans and peas.
Add celery, onions, pepper and pimento. Marinate several hours in dressing in refrigerator.
recipes.text: Green Wonder Salad. Drain beans and peas. Add celery, onions, pepper and pimento. Marinate several hours in dressing in refrigerator.

recipes.title: Impossible Pie
directions: Blend eggs and sugar; add flour.
Mix well.
Add the other ingredients, mix well.
Pour into two 8-inch buttered pie pans. Bake at 325° for 35 minutes or until firm.
recipes.text: Impossible Pie. Blend eggs and sugar; add flour. Mix well. Add the other ingredients, mix well. Pour into two 8-inch buttered pie pans. Bake at 325° for 35 minutes or until firm.

recipes.title: Mystery Pie
directions: Beat egg whites, 1 cup sugar and baking powder well.
Add Ritz crackers, nuts and vanilla.
Bake in greased metal pie plate approximately 50 minutes at 300°.
Whip cream, vanilla and 2 teaspoons sugar.
Cover top and chill until served.
recipes.text: Mystery Pie. Beat egg whites, 1 cup sugar and baking powder well. Add Ritz crackers, nuts and vanilla. Bake in greased metal pie plate approximately 50 minutes at 300°. Whip cream, vanilla and 2 teaspoons sugar. Cover top and chill until served.

recipes.title: Whacky Snacky
ingredients: 1 c. pretzel sticks or 1 c. Teddy Grahams snacks
directions: In small bowl, blend butter and cinnamon.
In large bowl, combine cereal, pretzels (or Teddy Grahams) and peanuts.
Toss with margarine mixture onto baking sheet.
Bake at 350° for 8 to 10 minutes, stirring once.
Remove from oven; stir in raisins and coconut.
Store tightly covered for up to 1 week.
recipes.text: Whacky Snacky. In small bowl, blend butter and cinnamon. In large bowl, combine cereal, pretzels (or Teddy Grahams) and peanuts. Toss with margarine mixture onto baking sheet. Bake at 350° for 8 to 10 minutes, stirring once. Remove from oven; stir in raisins and coconut. Store tightly covered for up to 1 week.

recipes.title: Eggplant Parmesan
directions: In a large skillet, saute onion and garlic until yellow.
Add tomatoes and seasonings.
With 2 knives, cut up and blend ingredients.
Simmer sauce, uncovered, about 20 minutes until slightly thick.
recipes.text: Eggplant Parmesan. In a large skillet, saute onion and garlic until yellow. Add tomatoes and seasonings. With 2 knives, cut up and blend ingredients. Simmer sauce, uncovered, about 20 minutes until slightly thick.

recipes.title: Grandma Opal'S Baked Chicken
directions: Prepare Bisquick dumpling mix.
Mix cornstarch and water. Place chicken in large roasting pan.
Cover with remaining ingredients, except dumpling mix and cornstarch mix.
Bake 3 hours at 325°.
recipes.text: Grandma Opal'S Baked Chicken. Prepare Bisquick dumpling mix. Mix cornstarch and water. Place chicken in large roasting pan. Cover with remaining ingredients, except dumpling mix and cornstarch mix. Bake 3 hours at 325°.

recipes.title: Orange Colada
ingredients: 6 oz. frozen non-alcoholic Pina Colada mix, thawed
directions: Combine first 4 ingredients in blender.
Process for 30 seconds.
Add ice and continue until liquified.
Serve with orange slice.
Makes 6 servings.
recipes.text: Orange Colada. Combine first 4 ingredients in blender. Process for 30 seconds. Add ice and continue until liquified. Serve with orange slice. Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Beer Butt Chicken
directions: For dry rub: Mix together the sugar, salt, pepper, cajun seasoning and black pepper.
recipes.text: Beer Butt Chicken. For dry rub: Mix together the sugar, salt, pepper, cajun seasoning and black pepper.

recipes.title: Lemonade Pie
ingredients: 1 (20 oz.) can crushed pineapple, well drained
directions: Blend first 3 ingredients.
Add pineapple and nuts.
Put in graham cracker crust.
Makes 2 pies.
Freezes well.
recipes.text: Lemonade Pie. Blend first 3 ingredients. Add pineapple and nuts. Put in graham cracker crust. Makes 2 pies. Freezes well.

recipes.title: Placki Z Kartofli (Potato Pancakes)
directions: Pour off dark water accumulated on top of grated potatoes. Add the other ingredients and beat well.
With spoon, drop mixture on hot griddle and spread as thinly as possible.
Fry on both sides.
To prevent potatoes from darkening, add 1 teaspoon lemon juice.
An old Polish cook saying, "A noisy cow gives little milk: Great talkers are little doers."
recipes.text: Placki Z Kartofli (Potato Pancakes). Pour off dark water accumulated on top of grated potatoes. Add the other ingredients and beat well. With spoon, drop mixture on hot griddle and spread as thinly as possible. Fry on both sides. To prevent potatoes from darkening, add 1 teaspoon lemon juice. An old Polish cook saying, "A noisy cow gives little milk: Great talkers are little doers."

recipes.title: Frozen Peach Mousse
directions: Puree peaches in a blender.
Add remaining ingredients.
Blend and pour in container and freeze.
recipes.text: Frozen Peach Mousse. Puree peaches in a blender. Add remaining ingredients. Blend and pour in container and freeze.

recipes.title: Taco Sauce
directions: Cook 1/2 cup onion and garlic in oil for five minutes.
Add tomato juice and simmer 10 minutes.
Strain and add salt to taste and as much cayenne as you can take.
recipes.text: Taco Sauce. Cook 1/2 cup onion and garlic in oil for five minutes. Add tomato juice and simmer 10 minutes. Strain and add salt to taste and as much cayenne as you can take.

recipes.title: Broiled Spicy Mustard Chicken(Light And Easy)
directions: Preheat the broiler.
Coat a broiling pan with low calorie cooking spray.
recipes.text: Broiled Spicy Mustard Chicken(Light And Easy). Preheat the broiler. Coat a broiling pan with low calorie cooking spray.

recipes.title: Canned Butter Corn
directions: Place ingredients in pan with enough boiling water to cover. Bring to boil and while keeping the mixture at boiling temperature, pack loosely into jars.
Process 4 hours in boiling water bath.
recipes.text: Canned Butter Corn. Place ingredients in pan with enough boiling water to cover. Bring to boil and while keeping the mixture at boiling temperature, pack loosely into jars. Process 4 hours in boiling water bath.

recipes.title: Clam Chowder
directions: Cook bacon and drain.
Add onion and saute.
In kettle, put clams,
potatoes,
celery, carrots and seasoning.
Simmer until tender.
Dissolve
cornstarch
in
a little milk; add to clam mixture until thick.
Add
remaining milk.	Cook over low heat, stirring constantly until thickened again.	Do not boil. Add bacon, onion and oleo.
recipes.text: Clam Chowder. Cook bacon and drain. Add onion and saute. In kettle, put clams, potatoes, celery, carrots and seasoning. Simmer until tender. Dissolve cornstarch in a little milk; add to clam mixture until thick. Add remaining milk.	Cook over low heat, stirring constantly until thickened again.	Do not boil. Add bacon, onion and oleo.

recipes.title: Green Bean Casserole
directions: Drain beans and diced mushrooms.
Mix soup, beans and mushrooms and put in casserole.*
Bake at 375°.
When this starts to bubble, put onions on top and place in oven until onions are hot.
Serve immediately.
recipes.text: Green Bean Casserole. Drain beans and diced mushrooms. Mix soup, beans and mushrooms and put in casserole.* Bake at 375°. When this starts to bubble, put onions on top and place in oven until onions are hot. Serve immediately.

recipes.title: Gourmet Meatballs
directions: Combine ground beef, sausage, egg, bread crumbs, onion, green pepper, celery, salt, garlic, basil, chili powder, thyme and red pepper in bowl; mix well.
Shape into 3/4-inch balls.
Brown on all sides in oil in skillet; drain.
Spoon meatballs into baking dish.
Cover with Red Wine Sauce.
Bake at 375° for 45 minutes. May prepare ahead and freeze uncooked meatballs in sauce for up to 2 months.
Yield:
96 servings.
recipes.text: Gourmet Meatballs. Combine ground beef, sausage, egg, bread crumbs, onion, green pepper, celery, salt, garlic, basil, chili powder, thyme and red pepper in bowl; mix well. Shape into 3/4-inch balls. Brown on all sides in oil in skillet; drain. Spoon meatballs into baking dish. Cover with Red Wine Sauce. Bake at 375° for 45 minutes. May prepare ahead and freeze uncooked meatballs in sauce for up to 2 months. Yield: 96 servings.

recipes.title: Cherry-Rhubarb Jam
directions: Cook rhubarb in water until tender.
Add sugar and cook a few minutes, stirring constantly.
Add pie filling and cook 6 to 8 minutes.
Remove from heat and add gelatin.
Stir until completely dissolved.
Pour into jars and seal.
Store in refrigerator or freezer.
recipes.text: Cherry-Rhubarb Jam. Cook rhubarb in water until tender. Add sugar and cook a few minutes, stirring constantly. Add pie filling and cook 6 to 8 minutes. Remove from heat and add gelatin. Stir until completely dissolved. Pour into jars and seal. Store in refrigerator or freezer.

recipes.title: Vegetable Salad
directions: First you take the cucumber slices and put into a bowl, then you take a bunch of broccoli pieces and put them in a bowl too. Then you take the tomato slices in the bowl with the carrot slices, then you mix it all up.
Then you add some dressing and eat it.
It's good.
recipes.text: Vegetable Salad. First you take the cucumber slices and put into a bowl, then you take a bunch of broccoli pieces and put them in a bowl too. Then you take the tomato slices in the bowl with the carrot slices, then you mix it all up. Then you add some dressing and eat it. It's good.

recipes.title: Cheese Dip
ingredients: 1 can diced Ro-Tel tomatoes and chiles
directions: Cube cheese.
Place in a 2-quart microwavable bowl.
Add can of tomatoes and chiles.
Cook on High for 2 minutes.
Stir and cook 2 more minutes.
When cheese is melted, serve with chips.
recipes.text: Cheese Dip. Cube cheese. Place in a 2-quart microwavable bowl. Add can of tomatoes and chiles. Cook on High for 2 minutes. Stir and cook 2 more minutes. When cheese is melted, serve with chips.

recipes.title: Oklahoma Scramble
ingredients: green tomatoes or any other vegetables available
directions: Combine all vegetables together.
Fry in grease as you would fried potatoes.
Drain on paper towels.
recipes.text: Oklahoma Scramble. Combine all vegetables together. Fry in grease as you would fried potatoes. Drain on paper towels.

recipes.title: Sweet And Sour Baked Beans
ingredients: 8 slices bacon, fried, drained and crumbled
4 large onions, sliced and sauteed in bacon drippings
1 tall can B & M baked beans
directions: Cook onions in bacon drippings.
Add sugar, mustard, garlic powder, salt and vinegar.
Cook, covered, for 20 minutes.
Add mixture to beans.
Add bacon.
Pour into casseroles.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
May be frozen.
Serves 20.
recipes.text: Sweet And Sour Baked Beans. Cook onions in bacon drippings. Add sugar, mustard, garlic powder, salt and vinegar. Cook, covered, for 20 minutes. Add mixture to beans. Add bacon. Pour into casseroles. Bake at 350° for 1 hour. May be frozen. Serves 20.

recipes.title: Mixed Vegetables
directions: Cook vegetables in water and seasoned salt until tender-crisp, uncovered.
Drain vegetables and mix with soup.
Combine stuffing, spices and melted butter.
Sprinkle over vegetables.
Bake 30 minutes at 350°.
Can be made early and refrigerated.
recipes.text: Mixed Vegetables. Cook vegetables in water and seasoned salt until tender-crisp, uncovered. Drain vegetables and mix with soup. Combine stuffing, spices and melted butter. Sprinkle over vegetables. Bake 30 minutes at 350°. Can be made early and refrigerated.

recipes.title: Peach Crisp
directions: Arrange peach slices in an 8 inch square dish or pan.
Set aside.
Combine next 3 ingredients in a large bowl.
Mix well. Cut in margarine with pastry blender until mixture resembles coarse meal.
Sprinkle over peaches.
Bake uncovered at 400° for 18 to 20
minutes or until golden brown.
Serve warm with ice cream if desired. Serves 6 to 8.
recipes.text: Peach Crisp. Arrange peach slices in an 8 inch square dish or pan. Set aside. Combine next 3 ingredients in a large bowl. Mix well. Cut in margarine with pastry blender until mixture resembles coarse meal. Sprinkle over peaches. Bake uncovered at 400° for 18 to 20 minutes or until golden brown. Serve warm with ice cream if desired. Serves 6 to 8.

recipes.title: Crumb Torte
directions: Cream butter and sugar until fluffy.
Add eggs and mix well. Spread half the crushed wafers on bottom of buttered 8-inch square pan, then butter mixture, then pineapple.
Add nuts to whipped cream and top with remaining crumbs.
Chill 2 hours.
recipes.text: Crumb Torte. Cream butter and sugar until fluffy. Add eggs and mix well. Spread half the crushed wafers on bottom of buttered 8-inch square pan, then butter mixture, then pineapple. Add nuts to whipped cream and top with remaining crumbs. Chill 2 hours.

recipes.title: Cherry Delights
directions: Preheat oven to 325°.
Grease sheets.
Cream butter and sugar. Stir in corn syrup, egg yolks and flour. Chill.
Roll into 1-inch balls.
Dip in beaten egg whites and roll in chopped nuts.
Place on greased sheets.
Press candied cherry halves into centers. Bake at 325° for 20 minutes.
recipes.text: Cherry Delights. Preheat oven to 325°. Grease sheets. Cream butter and sugar. Stir in corn syrup, egg yolks and flour. Chill. Roll into 1-inch balls. Dip in beaten egg whites and roll in chopped nuts. Place on greased sheets. Press candied cherry halves into centers. Bake at 325° for 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Broccoli Casserole
ingredients: 2 c. Pepperidge Farm herb stuffing mix
directions: Combine all ingredients and cook for 1 hour at 350°.
recipes.text: Broccoli Casserole. Combine all ingredients and cook for 1 hour at 350°.

recipes.title: Japanese Fruit Pie
directions: Mix melted margarine, eggs and sugar.
Add other ingredients. Pour into a 9-inch unbaked pie shell.
Bake at 325° for 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Japanese Fruit Pie. Mix melted margarine, eggs and sugar. Add other ingredients. Pour into a 9-inch unbaked pie shell. Bake at 325° for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Chicken Casserole
ingredients: 2 cans cream of celery or chicken soup
1 can water chestnuts or slivered almonds
1 small pkg. Pepperidge Farm herb-flavored stuffing mix
3 Tbsp. margarine for topping the casserole
directions: Cook chicken until tender; skin, bone and cut in cubes.
Mix chicken with other ingredients except stuffing mix.
Pour into casserole and sprinkle stuffing mix and dot with margarine on top. Bake at 350° for about an hour.
Will serve 8 to 10 people.
recipes.text: Chicken Casserole. Cook chicken until tender; skin, bone and cut in cubes. Mix chicken with other ingredients except stuffing mix. Pour into casserole and sprinkle stuffing mix and dot with margarine on top. Bake at 350° for about an hour. Will serve 8 to 10 people.

recipes.title: Play Dough(For Children)
directions: In a heavy aluminum saucepan, mix dry ingredients.
Add oil, water and food coloring.
Cook 3 minutes or until mixture pulls away from side of pan.
Knead slightly. Store in an airtight container.
recipes.text: Play Dough(For Children). In a heavy aluminum saucepan, mix dry ingredients. Add oil, water and food coloring. Cook 3 minutes or until mixture pulls away from side of pan. Knead slightly. Store in an airtight container.

recipes.title: Waffles
directions: Mix ingredients together but do not overbeat.
Pour desired amount into waffle iron.
Enjoy!
recipes.text: Waffles. Mix ingredients together but do not overbeat. Pour desired amount into waffle iron. Enjoy!

recipes.title: Larry'S Green Tomatoes
directions: Combine the vinegar, water and salt and boil for 5 minutes. Cut tomatoes to a desired size and put into Mason jars.
Fill jars with boiling vinegar-water mixture to 1/2-inch from top.
Seal and wait 4 to 6 weeks before using.
recipes.text: Larry'S Green Tomatoes. Combine the vinegar, water and salt and boil for 5 minutes. Cut tomatoes to a desired size and put into Mason jars. Fill jars with boiling vinegar-water mixture to 1/2-inch from top. Seal and wait 4 to 6 weeks before using.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Candy
directions: Bring sugar and milk to a soft boil stage.
Add 1 tablespoon of butter, vanilla and peanut butter.
Beat until creamy and pour into pan.
Cut in 1-inch squares.
recipes.text: Peanut Butter Candy. Bring sugar and milk to a soft boil stage. Add 1 tablespoon of butter, vanilla and peanut butter. Beat until creamy and pour into pan. Cut in 1-inch squares.

recipes.title: Hummingbird Cake
directions: Mix all ingredients until smooth.
Spread on cake.
recipes.text: Hummingbird Cake. Mix all ingredients until smooth. Spread on cake.

recipes.title: Seashell Super Salad
ingredients: 8 oz. pkg. seashells, cooked and drained
2 c. diced meat or poultry or wieners, boiled, sliced and browned
directions: Combine all ingredients and toss lightly.
Chill.
Serve on salad greens.
Makes 6 average servings.
recipes.text: Seashell Super Salad. Combine all ingredients and toss lightly. Chill. Serve on salad greens. Makes 6 average servings.

recipes.title: Cabbage Lasagna
directions: Brown beef, pepper, onion and celery.
Drain and add sauce. Layer in casserole the meat, cabbage and cheese until gone.
Bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours or microwave 25 minutes; then rotate.
recipes.text: Cabbage Lasagna. Brown beef, pepper, onion and celery. Drain and add sauce. Layer in casserole the meat, cabbage and cheese until gone. Bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours or microwave 25 minutes; then rotate.

recipes.title: Freezer Pickles
directions: Place pickles, onions and salt in a kettle.
Heat sugar, vinegar, celery seed and mustard seed until all sugar is dissolved.
Pour over pickles.
Let stand for 24 hours.
Freeze.
recipes.text: Freezer Pickles. Place pickles, onions and salt in a kettle. Heat sugar, vinegar, celery seed and mustard seed until all sugar is dissolved. Pour over pickles. Let stand for 24 hours. Freeze.

recipes.title: Pepper Jelly(Canning)
ingredients: 4 large peppers (bell peppers) or finger peppers
1 c. peppers or 1/4 hot and 3/4 sweet, squeeze dry
directions: Chop or grind peppers fine.
Combine all ingredients except Certo.
Bring to boil (rolling), remove from heat, let stand 5 minutes.
Add Certo.
Pour into hot jars and seal.
Makes 3 1/2 pints.
recipes.text: Pepper Jelly(Canning). Chop or grind peppers fine. Combine all ingredients except Certo. Bring to boil (rolling), remove from heat, let stand 5 minutes. Add Certo. Pour into hot jars and seal. Makes 3 1/2 pints.

recipes.title: Quiche
ingredients: 1 1/2 c. Cheddar and Monterey Jack cheeses (combined)
directions: Throw all in blender and mix.
Brush pie crust with butter and chill while mixing.
Bake at 425° for 15 minutes.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Quiche. Throw all in blender and mix. Brush pie crust with butter and chill while mixing. Bake at 425° for 15 minutes. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Sweet Potato Casserole
directions: Combine potatoes, sugar, eggs, salt, 1/2 stick margarine, milk and vanilla.
Spoon into a 1 to 1 1/2-quart baking dish.
recipes.text: Sweet Potato Casserole. Combine potatoes, sugar, eggs, salt, 1/2 stick margarine, milk and vanilla. Spoon into a 1 to 1 1/2-quart baking dish.

recipes.title: Zero Dressing
directions: Combine all ingredients together and blenderize.
Shake well before serving.
May be used as desired.
recipes.text: Zero Dressing. Combine all ingredients together and blenderize. Shake well before serving. May be used as desired.

recipes.title: Scalloped Corn And Broccoli
directions: Saut onion in margarine until soft.
Add flour, stirring until smooth.
Add milk and cook, stirring until thick.
recipes.text: Scalloped Corn And Broccoli. Saut onion in margarine until soft. Add flour, stirring until smooth. Add milk and cook, stirring until thick.

recipes.title: Percolator Punch
directions: Mix pineapple juice, cranberry juice, water and brown sugar in a large 30 cup coffee pot.
recipes.text: Percolator Punch. Mix pineapple juice, cranberry juice, water and brown sugar in a large 30 cup coffee pot.

recipes.title: Grammie'S Chocolate Cocoa Cake
directions: Mix together sugar, flour and cocoa.
Add remaining ingredients.
Bake in a medium oven for about 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Grammie'S Chocolate Cocoa Cake. Mix together sugar, flour and cocoa. Add remaining ingredients. Bake in a medium oven for about 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Peanut Brittle
directions: Combine sugar, syrup, water and salt. Bring to a boil. Add raw peanuts and cook until small amount dropped in cold water forms a hard ball. Remove from heat and add soda.
Stir.
Pour into a buttered pan or platter.
recipes.text: Peanut Brittle. Combine sugar, syrup, water and salt. Bring to a boil. Add raw peanuts and cook until small amount dropped in cold water forms a hard ball. Remove from heat and add soda. Stir. Pour into a buttered pan or platter.

recipes.title: Hot Potato Salad
directions: Slice cooked potatoes thinly.
Saute onion in butter until tender.
Stir in soup and sour cream.
Pour over potatoes and add cheese.
Mix well and turn into greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch dish. Cover and refrigerate overnight.
Bake in 350° oven for one hour.
recipes.text: Hot Potato Salad. Slice cooked potatoes thinly. Saute onion in butter until tender. Stir in soup and sour cream. Pour over potatoes and add cheese. Mix well and turn into greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch dish. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Bake in 350° oven for one hour.

recipes.title: Unbeatable Cookies
ingredients: 1/2 c. chopped raisins, dates, apples or cherries
directions: Mix the first 4 ingredients in a large mixing bowl.
Stir in fruit and nuts.
Drop by slightly rounded teaspoonfuls onto cookie sheet sprayed with Pam.
Leave 4 inches between cookies.
Bake at 325° for 12 to 15 minutes.
Contains no fat, no cholesterol.
recipes.text: Unbeatable Cookies. Mix the first 4 ingredients in a large mixing bowl. Stir in fruit and nuts. Drop by slightly rounded teaspoonfuls onto cookie sheet sprayed with Pam. Leave 4 inches between cookies. Bake at 325° for 12 to 15 minutes. Contains no fat, no cholesterol.

recipes.title: Chocolate Walnut Wheels
directions: Cream butter and add sugar gradually. Add egg, melted baking chocolate and vanilla. Add flour, salt and nuts.
Beat well. Drop from tip of spoon 1-inch apart onto greased baking sheet. Garnish each with walnut halve. Bake in moderate oven at 350° for 10 minutes.
Yields 2 dozen wheels.
recipes.text: Chocolate Walnut Wheels. Cream butter and add sugar gradually. Add egg, melted baking chocolate and vanilla. Add flour, salt and nuts. Beat well. Drop from tip of spoon 1-inch apart onto greased baking sheet. Garnish each with walnut halve. Bake in moderate oven at 350° for 10 minutes. Yields 2 dozen wheels.

recipes.title: Ranch Beans
ingredients: 1 can (1 lb. 12 oz.) pork and beans
directions: Saute beef and onions in melted margarine until beef is browned.
Add salt, Worcestershire sauce and mustard.
Simmer 15 minutes.
Combine sugar and catsup.
Add to beans and beef mixture.
Turn into a 2 1/2-quart baking dish.
Bake, uncovered, in a preheated 325° oven for 45 minutes.
Makes 8 to 10 servings.
recipes.text: Ranch Beans. Saute beef and onions in melted margarine until beef is browned. Add salt, Worcestershire sauce and mustard. Simmer 15 minutes. Combine sugar and catsup. Add to beans and beef mixture. Turn into a 2 1/2-quart baking dish. Bake, uncovered, in a preheated 325° oven for 45 minutes. Makes 8 to 10 servings.

recipes.title: Hot Water Sponge Cake
directions: Mix eggs, sugar and hot water all together until foamy. Add remaining ingredients and mix well. Cook in 13 x 9-inch pan or muffin tins. Bake 15 minutes at 315°.
recipes.text: Hot Water Sponge Cake. Mix eggs, sugar and hot water all together until foamy. Add remaining ingredients and mix well. Cook in 13 x 9-inch pan or muffin tins. Bake 15 minutes at 315°.

recipes.title: Speedy Apple Crisp For One
directions: In a small glass pie plate, combine the first 4 ingredients. Cover with waxed paper.
Microwave on High for 2 minutes.
Turn dish and cook 2 more minutes.
Sprinkle with granola or Grape Nuts before eating.
recipes.text: Speedy Apple Crisp For One. In a small glass pie plate, combine the first 4 ingredients. Cover with waxed paper. Microwave on High for 2 minutes. Turn dish and cook 2 more minutes. Sprinkle with granola or Grape Nuts before eating.

recipes.title: Shrimp Dip
directions: Thoroughly blend all ingredients.
Keep refrigerated in closed container.
Will keep up to 1 month in refrigerator.
Serve with crisp crackers.
recipes.text: Shrimp Dip. Thoroughly blend all ingredients. Keep refrigerated in closed container. Will keep up to 1 month in refrigerator. Serve with crisp crackers.

recipes.title: Potato Cheese Chowder
ingredients: 1 (8 oz.) pkg. American cheese slices, diced
directions: In 3-quart saucepan, melt margarine.
Add potatoes, onion, salt and paprika.
Cook until vegetables are lightly brown and tender.
Add milk and cheese; cook, stirring constantly, until mixture is hot and cheese is melted and smooth.
Spoon into 4 soup bowls and sprinkle with paprika.
Serve with assorted crackers.
recipes.text: Potato Cheese Chowder. In 3-quart saucepan, melt margarine. Add potatoes, onion, salt and paprika. Cook until vegetables are lightly brown and tender. Add milk and cheese; cook, stirring constantly, until mixture is hot and cheese is melted and smooth. Spoon into 4 soup bowls and sprinkle with paprika. Serve with assorted crackers.

recipes.title: Chocolate Waffle Iron Cookies
ingredients: 2 sq. (1 oz. each) unsweetened baking chocolate, melted
directions: Melt chocolate with margarine or butter in saucepan over low heat; stirring constantly.
Beat eggs; add sugar, vanilla and flour.
Blend well and add to chocolate margarine mixture.
Heat iron to medium setting.
Drop batter by teaspoon onto waffle iron, making 4 to each square.
Bake 1/2 to 1 minute.
Place on racks to cool.
When cool, frost with chocolate frosting.
recipes.text: Chocolate Waffle Iron Cookies. Melt chocolate with margarine or butter in saucepan over low heat; stirring constantly. Beat eggs; add sugar, vanilla and flour. Blend well and add to chocolate margarine mixture. Heat iron to medium setting. Drop batter by teaspoon onto waffle iron, making 4 to each square. Bake 1/2 to 1 minute. Place on racks to cool. When cool, frost with chocolate frosting.

recipes.title: Picante Chicken And Rice
ingredients: 6 boneless chicken breast halves, skin removed
1 c. mild red salsa or picante sauce
directions: Sprinkle chicken with salt.
Set aside.
In a 10-inch skillet, cook onion and garlic in oil for 2 minutes.
Add chicken broth and salsa.
Bring to a boil.
Stir in rice.
Arrange chicken breasts over rice.
recipes.text: Picante Chicken And Rice. Sprinkle chicken with salt. Set aside. In a 10-inch skillet, cook onion and garlic in oil for 2 minutes. Add chicken broth and salsa. Bring to a boil. Stir in rice. Arrange chicken breasts over rice.

recipes.title: Cheese Straws
directions: Let cheese and margarine soften to room temperature.
Mix all ingredients together.
Press through a cookie press onto cookie sheet.
Bake at 325° for 10 minutes.
recipes.text: Cheese Straws. Let cheese and margarine soften to room temperature. Mix all ingredients together. Press through a cookie press onto cookie sheet. Bake at 325° for 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Nanna'S Shortcake And Strawberry Dip
ingredients: 3/4 c. milk (can use 2 egg yolks with milk)
directions: Blend flour, salt, sugar and baking powder.
Cut in shortening.
Mix in milk and pat into round cake pan.
Bake at 350° until slightly browned and pick is clean.
recipes.text: Nanna'S Shortcake And Strawberry Dip. Blend flour, salt, sugar and baking powder. Cut in shortening. Mix in milk and pat into round cake pan. Bake at 350° until slightly browned and pick is clean.

recipes.title: One Gallon Refrigerator Pickles
directions: Combine first 6 ingredients and stir to dissolve.
Make alternate layers of onion and sliced cucumbers in gallon jar. When sugar is all dissolved, pour liquid over onion and cukes. Refrigerate for several days before using.
Keep in refrigerator. Will be good for several months.
These are very good.
recipes.text: One Gallon Refrigerator Pickles. Combine first 6 ingredients and stir to dissolve. Make alternate layers of onion and sliced cucumbers in gallon jar. When sugar is all dissolved, pour liquid over onion and cukes. Refrigerate for several days before using. Keep in refrigerator. Will be good for several months. These are very good.

recipes.title: Russian Cream Salad
directions: Double these ingredients for one jello mold.
recipes.text: Russian Cream Salad. Double these ingredients for one jello mold.

recipes.title: Veal Parmesan
ingredients: any seasoning to match your taste
directions: Cook patties until done; drain grease.
Simmer sauce, then mix cheeses, sauce, patties, garlic and herbs.
Cook for 20 to 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Veal Parmesan. Cook patties until done; drain grease. Simmer sauce, then mix cheeses, sauce, patties, garlic and herbs. Cook for 20 to 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Wedding Punch
ingredients: 1 (6 oz.) frozen lemonade or juice, diluted
fresh strawberries or bananas (to float in juice)
directions: Mix all the juices together.
Fill 2 small ice trays with mixture and freeze.
Before serving, add 1/2 quart ginger ale. Float strawberries or sliced bananas in juice.
Yields 15 to 20 servings.
recipes.text: Wedding Punch. Mix all the juices together. Fill 2 small ice trays with mixture and freeze. Before serving, add 1/2 quart ginger ale. Float strawberries or sliced bananas in juice. Yields 15 to 20 servings.

recipes.title: Fresh Apple Cake
ingredients: 1/2 tsp. each: nutmeg, allspice and cinnamon
directions: Beat eggs, vanilla and oil together.
Sift flour, sugar, soda and salt.
Add to egg mixture.
Add apples and nuts.
Mix well. Bake in 3 layers at 325° for 40 minutes.
recipes.text: Fresh Apple Cake. Beat eggs, vanilla and oil together. Sift flour, sugar, soda and salt. Add to egg mixture. Add apples and nuts. Mix well. Bake in 3 layers at 325° for 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Zucchini Au Gratin
directions: Slice zucchini and cook until barely tender.
