Mix sour cream, margarine, Parmesan cheese, salt and pepper in saucepan over low heat until all melted.
Add yolks and chives, then pour over zucchini in 9 x 13-inch casserole.
Cover with crumbs and more Parmesan cheese.
Brown 30 minutes at 350°.
recipes.text: Zucchini Au Gratin. Slice zucchini and cook until barely tender. Mix sour cream, margarine, Parmesan cheese, salt and pepper in saucepan over low heat until all melted. Add yolks and chives, then pour over zucchini in 9 x 13-inch casserole. Cover with crumbs and more Parmesan cheese. Brown 30 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Hearty Beef Stew
directions: Heat oil in heavy saucepan.
Add stewing beef and brown on all sides.
Add water and dash of salt.
Bring to a boil.
Cover and simmer about 1 hour.
Cool and skim off hardened fat.
Return to heat and add onion, carrot and potato.
Cook 30 minutes until vegetables are tender.
Mix flour and 1/2 cup cold water by shaking in a small jar.
Add to stew.
Stir until it has boiled for 1 minute and is thickened.
Let simmer until ready to eat. Serves 1.
recipes.text: Hearty Beef Stew. Heat oil in heavy saucepan. Add stewing beef and brown on all sides. Add water and dash of salt. Bring to a boil. Cover and simmer about 1 hour. Cool and skim off hardened fat. Return to heat and add onion, carrot and potato. Cook 30 minutes until vegetables are tender. Mix flour and 1/2 cup cold water by shaking in a small jar. Add to stew. Stir until it has boiled for 1 minute and is thickened. Let simmer until ready to eat. Serves 1.

recipes.title: Apple Rolls
directions: Roll dough out the size of a plate.
Put apples, sugar and pats of butter on dough.
Sprinkle with vanilla.
Roll into a roll and place in well-greased pan.
May repeat for as many rolls as you want.
Bake in oven for 40 minutes or until well done at 350°. Remove from oven.
Mix 2 cups milk, 1 1/2 cups sugar and vanilla. Pour over apple rolls.
Return to oven about 30 minutes or until thickened.
Serve while hot.
recipes.text: Apple Rolls. Roll dough out the size of a plate. Put apples, sugar and pats of butter on dough. Sprinkle with vanilla. Roll into a roll and place in well-greased pan. May repeat for as many rolls as you want. Bake in oven for 40 minutes or until well done at 350°. Remove from oven. Mix 2 cups milk, 1 1/2 cups sugar and vanilla. Pour over apple rolls. Return to oven about 30 minutes or until thickened. Serve while hot.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Cookies
directions: Mix all together.
Roll into balls.
Put on a cookie sheet, press with a fork.
Bake at 350 for 10 to 12 minutes.
recipes.text: Peanut Butter Cookies. Mix all together. Roll into balls. Put on a cookie sheet, press with a fork. Bake at 350 for 10 to 12 minutes.

recipes.title: Basic Roll Dough
directions: Cream together the sugar and shortening.
Add the rest of the ingredients and stir well.
Dough may be sticky.
Cover and raise until double in bulk.
Makes 2 loaves of bread or 1 loaf and 12 rolls.
Bake at 350° to 375° for 20 to 25 minutes.
recipes.text: Basic Roll Dough. Cream together the sugar and shortening. Add the rest of the ingredients and stir well. Dough may be sticky. Cover and raise until double in bulk. Makes 2 loaves of bread or 1 loaf and 12 rolls. Bake at 350° to 375° for 20 to 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Swedish Cabbage Pudding(Meat Loaf)
directions: Chop cabbage coarsely and saute in butter or margarine.
Add Karo syrup and vinegar.
Simmer for 10 minutes.
Mix hamburg, bread, pepper, salt, onion powder, allspice, nutmeg, egg and catsup.
Mix well.
Grease baking dish.
Cover bottom of dish with one-half of the cabbage mixture.
Spread hamburg mixture over the cabbage and then put the rest of the cabbage and juice on top of the hamburg.
Bake 1 hour and 15 minutes at 350°.
recipes.text: Swedish Cabbage Pudding(Meat Loaf). Chop cabbage coarsely and saute in butter or margarine. Add Karo syrup and vinegar. Simmer for 10 minutes. Mix hamburg, bread, pepper, salt, onion powder, allspice, nutmeg, egg and catsup. Mix well. Grease baking dish. Cover bottom of dish with one-half of the cabbage mixture. Spread hamburg mixture over the cabbage and then put the rest of the cabbage and juice on top of the hamburg. Bake 1 hour and 15 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Golden Carrot Bars
ingredients: 1 c. ready to eat flake cereal
directions: In a large bowl, combine the oats, cereal flakes, flour and baking powder.
Stir in the carrots, raisins and cinnamon.
In a medium bowl, whisk together the water and dry milk until smooth. Whisk in maple syrup, egg whites and oil.
Pour over dry ingredients.
Mix until just combined; do not overmix.
Let stand for 10 minutes.
Spray 9 x 13-inch pan with nonstick spray.
Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes or until firm to touch; turn off heat, leave in oven with door ajar for 2 hours.
recipes.text: Golden Carrot Bars. In a large bowl, combine the oats, cereal flakes, flour and baking powder. Stir in the carrots, raisins and cinnamon. In a medium bowl, whisk together the water and dry milk until smooth. Whisk in maple syrup, egg whites and oil. Pour over dry ingredients. Mix until just combined; do not overmix. Let stand for 10 minutes. Spray 9 x 13-inch pan with nonstick spray. Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes or until firm to touch; turn off heat, leave in oven with door ajar for 2 hours.

recipes.title: Crab Cakes
ingredients: 5 oz. Kraft Old English cheese spread
directions: Combine first 7 ingredients; spread on English muffins.
Cut into quarters, if desired.
Freeze on cookie sheet for an hour. Cook at 400° for 10 to 15 minutes.
recipes.text: Crab Cakes. Combine first 7 ingredients; spread on English muffins. Cut into quarters, if desired. Freeze on cookie sheet for an hour. Cook at 400° for 10 to 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Mamaw'S Pie Crust
directions: Mix together and roll out to shape needed.
recipes.text: Mamaw'S Pie Crust. Mix together and roll out to shape needed.

recipes.title: Homemade Noodles
directions: Place flour in bowl and make a "well" in the center.
Place egg yolks, egg and salt in the well.
Mix well.
Add water, a little at a time, until a ball forms and dough "cleans" the bowl.
recipes.text: Homemade Noodles. Place flour in bowl and make a "well" in the center. Place egg yolks, egg and salt in the well. Mix well. Add water, a little at a time, until a ball forms and dough "cleans" the bowl.

recipes.title: Spoon Bread
directions: Scald milk (not boil).
Add cornmeal, stir constantly until thick.
Add salt and egg yolks.
Beat until well mixed.
Beat egg whites until stiff in a separate bowl, then fold into other mixture. Pour into a buttered pan.
Bake 45 minutes at 350°.
recipes.text: Spoon Bread. Scald milk (not boil). Add cornmeal, stir constantly until thick. Add salt and egg yolks. Beat until well mixed. Beat egg whites until stiff in a separate bowl, then fold into other mixture. Pour into a buttered pan. Bake 45 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Indian Chocolate Cake
directions: Beat margarine, sugar and eggs until fluffy.
Add cocoa and mix.
Add coffee, mix slowly.
Add flour, soda and salt.
Beat 1 minute.
Add boiling water.
Mix slowly until well blended.
Bake 25 to 30 minutes at 350°.
When cool, frost.
Use 9 x 13-inch pan or 2 round cake pans.
recipes.text: Indian Chocolate Cake. Beat margarine, sugar and eggs until fluffy. Add cocoa and mix. Add coffee, mix slowly. Add flour, soda and salt. Beat 1 minute. Add boiling water. Mix slowly until well blended. Bake 25 to 30 minutes at 350°. When cool, frost. Use 9 x 13-inch pan or 2 round cake pans.

recipes.title: Chew Cake
directions: Preheat oven to 350°.
Grease and flour 9 x 13 pan.
Mix eggs and brown sugar over low heat just until sugar melts.
Add flour, vanilla and pecans.
Spread in pan and bake for 15 to 20 minutes.
recipes.text: Chew Cake. Preheat oven to 350°. Grease and flour 9 x 13 pan. Mix eggs and brown sugar over low heat just until sugar melts. Add flour, vanilla and pecans. Spread in pan and bake for 15 to 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Grandma Negus' Ground Beef Patties
directions: In a medium sized dish break in eggs; whip with fork.
Add milk, crushed crackers, onion, salt and pepper. Let stand five minutes to soften crackers.
Knead in ground beef and make into patties.
Fry in skillet until brown.
recipes.text: Grandma Negus' Ground Beef Patties. In a medium sized dish break in eggs; whip with fork. Add milk, crushed crackers, onion, salt and pepper. Let stand five minutes to soften crackers. Knead in ground beef and make into patties. Fry in skillet until brown.

recipes.title: Queen Elizabeth Ii Cake
directions: Pour boiling water over chopped dates and soda.
Let stand. Mix sugar, butter, egg, vanilla, flour, baking powder, nuts and salt.
Add to date mixture and bake in a 9 x 12-inch pan for 35 minutes in a moderate oven.
Boil the cream, butter and light brown sugar for 3 minutes.
Spread on cake.
Sprinkle with coconut and nuts.
recipes.text: Queen Elizabeth Ii Cake. Pour boiling water over chopped dates and soda. Let stand. Mix sugar, butter, egg, vanilla, flour, baking powder, nuts and salt. Add to date mixture and bake in a 9 x 12-inch pan for 35 minutes in a moderate oven. Boil the cream, butter and light brown sugar for 3 minutes. Spread on cake. Sprinkle with coconut and nuts.

recipes.title: Salsa Salad Dip
directions: Beat cream cheese.
Mix in enough sour cream to make it the right consistency for dipping.
Place in layer on plate.
Place salsa on top of cream cheese and sour cream mixture.
Layer lettuce, onion and tomatoes on top of salsa.
Use chips or Fritos to dip with.
recipes.text: Salsa Salad Dip. Beat cream cheese. Mix in enough sour cream to make it the right consistency for dipping. Place in layer on plate. Place salsa on top of cream cheese and sour cream mixture. Layer lettuce, onion and tomatoes on top of salsa. Use chips or Fritos to dip with.

recipes.title: Chicken Casserole
directions: Mix chicken, soups and milk together.
Place in baking dish and top with stuffing,
prepared as directed on box.
Cover with aluminum foil and bake at 350° for 20 minutes.
Uncover and brown.
recipes.text: Chicken Casserole. Mix chicken, soups and milk together. Place in baking dish and top with stuffing, prepared as directed on box. Cover with aluminum foil and bake at 350° for 20 minutes. Uncover and brown.

recipes.title: Sausage Balls
directions: Blend all ingredients.
Shape into 1-teaspoon size balls.
Put on ungreased cookie sheet.
Bake at 325° for 15 to 20 minutes. Makes 4 to 6 dozen.
recipes.text: Sausage Balls. Blend all ingredients. Shape into 1-teaspoon size balls. Put on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 325° for 15 to 20 minutes. Makes 4 to 6 dozen.

recipes.title: Red Devil'S Food Cake
directions: Cream sugar and shortening until fluffy.
Add salt and vanilla.
Combine cocoa and 1/3 cup water; add to mixture.
Add flour to mixture with water.
Beat egg whites until stiff.
Add 3/4 cup sugar.
Fold egg whites into batter.
Combine soda and 1/3 cup cold water; add to mixture.
Put in 3 greased pans and cook in 350° oven.
Ice with your favorite icing.
recipes.text: Red Devil'S Food Cake. Cream sugar and shortening until fluffy. Add salt and vanilla. Combine cocoa and 1/3 cup water; add to mixture. Add flour to mixture with water. Beat egg whites until stiff. Add 3/4 cup sugar. Fold egg whites into batter. Combine soda and 1/3 cup cold water; add to mixture. Put in 3 greased pans and cook in 350° oven. Ice with your favorite icing.

recipes.title: Upside-Down Pumpkin Pie
directions: Mix all ingredients except butter, nuts and cake mix.
Pour into a large 13 x 9 x 2-inch buttered pan.
Sprinkle dry cake mix over pumpkin; then sprinkle nuts on top.
Pour melted butter over top.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Upside-Down Pumpkin Pie. Mix all ingredients except butter, nuts and cake mix. Pour into a large 13 x 9 x 2-inch buttered pan. Sprinkle dry cake mix over pumpkin; then sprinkle nuts on top. Pour melted butter over top. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Marinated Crock-Pot Pot Roast
ingredients: 1 1/2 c. tomato juice or 1 c. tomato sauce and 1/2 c. water
directions: Place meat in bag.
Stir together all ingredients except last 4.
Pour over meat and refrigerate overnight, turning a couple of times.
Place onions and carrots in crock-pot.
Add roast and marinade.
Cover and cook at low setting for 10 hours.
Measure out 2 cups cooking liquid; pour into saucepan.
Add the water and flour mixture to cooking liquid and thicken for gravy.
recipes.text: Marinated Crock-Pot Pot Roast. Place meat in bag. Stir together all ingredients except last 4. Pour over meat and refrigerate overnight, turning a couple of times. Place onions and carrots in crock-pot. Add roast and marinade. Cover and cook at low setting for 10 hours. Measure out 2 cups cooking liquid; pour into saucepan. Add the water and flour mixture to cooking liquid and thicken for gravy.

recipes.title: Beer And Cheese Soup
ingredients: 11 fluid oz. beer (use a can or bottle and save a swallow for the cook!)
directions: Saut the diced vegetables in butter. Mix flour and mustard into sauteed vegetables. Add the chicken or vegetable stock to mixture and cook for 5 minutes. Break broccoli into small flowerets; cut stems into bite-size pieces. Steam until tender-crisp. Add beer and cheeses to the soup. Simmer 10 to 15 minutes. Check seasonings.
recipes.text: Beer And Cheese Soup. Saut the diced vegetables in butter. Mix flour and mustard into sauteed vegetables. Add the chicken or vegetable stock to mixture and cook for 5 minutes. Break broccoli into small flowerets; cut stems into bite-size pieces. Steam until tender-crisp. Add beer and cheeses to the soup. Simmer 10 to 15 minutes. Check seasonings.

recipes.title: Ratatouille
directions: Cook onions slightly, using little oil.
Add eggplant, pepper and celery.
Cook, stirring frequently, to keep from sticking. Add tomato or vegetable juice; simmer for about 20 to 30 minutes. Add zucchini; cook for another 10 minutes or so.
recipes.text: Ratatouille. Cook onions slightly, using little oil. Add eggplant, pepper and celery. Cook, stirring frequently, to keep from sticking. Add tomato or vegetable juice; simmer for about 20 to 30 minutes. Add zucchini; cook for another 10 minutes or so.

recipes.title: Baked Cabbage
directions: Chop cabbage coarsely.
Cook in boiling water until tender; drain.
Add eggs, margarine and cracker crumbs.
Mix well and spread in a shallow, greased baking dish.
Bake at 350° for 30 to 45 minutes or until browned.
Brown 1 to 1 1/2 cups large cracker pieces in melted margarine in frying pan, stirring until golden brown.
Spoon over top of cabbage before serving.
Serves 6 to 8.
recipes.text: Baked Cabbage. Chop cabbage coarsely. Cook in boiling water until tender; drain. Add eggs, margarine and cracker crumbs. Mix well and spread in a shallow, greased baking dish. Bake at 350° for 30 to 45 minutes or until browned. Brown 1 to 1 1/2 cups large cracker pieces in melted margarine in frying pan, stirring until golden brown. Spoon over top of cabbage before serving. Serves 6 to 8.

recipes.title: Chicken And Rice
directions: Put the uncooked rice in an ungreased oven dish.
Place the chicken pieces, skin side down, on the rice.
recipes.text: Chicken And Rice. Put the uncooked rice in an ungreased oven dish. Place the chicken pieces, skin side down, on the rice.

recipes.title: Orange Balls(No Bake)
ingredients: 7 1/2 oz. pkg. vanilla wafers, finely crushed
directions: Mix well.
Form in 1/2-inch balls.
Roll in confectioners sugar.
Keep in a cool place.
recipes.text: Orange Balls(No Bake). Mix well. Form in 1/2-inch balls. Roll in confectioners sugar. Keep in a cool place.

recipes.title: Jello Cake
ingredients: 1 pkg. yellow or white cake mix
directions: Bake cake in a 9 x 13-inch pan according to package directions.
When cake is done and out of the oven, poke holes all over the top of the cake.
Stir jello into boiling water until dissolved; spoon jello mixture over cake and refrigerate until jello sets.
Then cover with Cool Whip and refrigerate until serving.
recipes.text: Jello Cake. Bake cake in a 9 x 13-inch pan according to package directions. When cake is done and out of the oven, poke holes all over the top of the cake. Stir jello into boiling water until dissolved; spoon jello mixture over cake and refrigerate until jello sets. Then cover with Cool Whip and refrigerate until serving.

recipes.title: Ripple Cake
directions: Crumble pound cake in large casserole dish.
Add 1 layer of bananas.
Cover with whipped cream.
Pour on pineapple chunks and another layer of whipped cream.
Put on layer of blueberries and one layer of strawberries.
Cover well with whipped cream.
Chill and serve.
recipes.text: Ripple Cake. Crumble pound cake in large casserole dish. Add 1 layer of bananas. Cover with whipped cream. Pour on pineapple chunks and another layer of whipped cream. Put on layer of blueberries and one layer of strawberries. Cover well with whipped cream. Chill and serve.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Brownies
directions: Beat butter and peanut butter together until light.
Gradually add sugar and brown sugar, creaming well.
Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each addition.
Add flour, baking powder and salt, mixing well.
Add chocolate morsels and vanilla.
Spread mixture in a well-greased 9-inch pan.
Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.
recipes.text: Peanut Butter Brownies. Beat butter and peanut butter together until light. Gradually add sugar and brown sugar, creaming well. Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each addition. Add flour, baking powder and salt, mixing well. Add chocolate morsels and vanilla. Spread mixture in a well-greased 9-inch pan. Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.

recipes.title: Pineapple Punch
directions: Mix first 3 ingredients.
Pour into 1 gallon container.
Add enough water to fill container.
Shake well.
Freeze until ready to use.
Thaw until the texture of slush.
Serve immediately. Yield:
1 gallon.
recipes.text: Pineapple Punch. Mix first 3 ingredients. Pour into 1 gallon container. Add enough water to fill container. Shake well. Freeze until ready to use. Thaw until the texture of slush. Serve immediately. Yield: 1 gallon.

recipes.title: Big Mama'S Tea Cakes
directions: Mix everything well.
Press onto large sheet pan.
Bake at 350° until lightly browned around edges, 10 to 12 minutes.
May be rolled and cut, or use cookie molds.
A great cookie if rolled thin and cut for a children's cookie decorating party.
Taste great.
recipes.text: Big Mama'S Tea Cakes. Mix everything well. Press onto large sheet pan. Bake at 350° until lightly browned around edges, 10 to 12 minutes. May be rolled and cut, or use cookie molds. A great cookie if rolled thin and cut for a children's cookie decorating party. Taste great.

recipes.title: Key Lime Bars
directions: Preheat oven to 350°. Grease an 8 x 8 inch pan. Mix 1 cup flour and confectioners sugar; add butter, and pat into pan. Bake 15-20 minutes.
recipes.text: Key Lime Bars. Preheat oven to 350°. Grease an 8 x 8 inch pan. Mix 1 cup flour and confectioners sugar; add butter, and pat into pan. Bake 15-20 minutes.

recipes.title: 7-Layer Salad
directions: Note:
To be started the day before you plan to serve it.
recipes.text: 7-Layer Salad. Note: To be started the day before you plan to serve it.

recipes.title: Busy Day Cobbler
ingredients: 1 can cherries, fruit cocktail or peaches (juice and all)
directions: In 8 x 8-inch baking dish, melt margarine.
Mix 1 cup sugar, flour, milk, baking powder and salt.
Pour over margarine.
Then add fruit over the batter.
Sprinkle 1/2 cup sugar over the top and bake in 350° oven until done.
recipes.text: Busy Day Cobbler. In 8 x 8-inch baking dish, melt margarine. Mix 1 cup sugar, flour, milk, baking powder and salt. Pour over margarine. Then add fruit over the batter. Sprinkle 1/2 cup sugar over the top and bake in 350° oven until done.

recipes.title: Potatoes Deluxe
ingredients: 6 to 8 large potatoes, boiled in jackets
directions: Peel cooled potatoes and grate.
Add rest of ingredients to potatoes.
Bake in a covered casserole for 45 minutes at 375°.
If you prefer, put them in a slow cooker for 1 1/2 to 2 hours.
recipes.text: Potatoes Deluxe. Peel cooled potatoes and grate. Add rest of ingredients to potatoes. Bake in a covered casserole for 45 minutes at 375°. If you prefer, put them in a slow cooker for 1 1/2 to 2 hours.

recipes.title: Happy Home Recipe
directions: Take love and loyalty, mix it with faith.
Blend with tenderness, kindness and understanding.
Add friendship and hope. Sprinkle abundantly with laughter.
Say lots of prayers, then bake with sunshine.
Serve daily with generous helpings.
recipes.text: Happy Home Recipe. Take love and loyalty, mix it with faith. Blend with tenderness, kindness and understanding. Add friendship and hope. Sprinkle abundantly with laughter. Say lots of prayers, then bake with sunshine. Serve daily with generous helpings.

recipes.title: Earthquake Cake
directions: Grease 9 x 13-inch cake pan.
Put coconut and nuts in pan. Mix cake mix according to package directions and pour over first layer.
Mix remaining ingredients and drop by teaspoons over cake mixture.
Bake at 350° for 35 to 45 minutes. Store in refrigerator.
recipes.text: Earthquake Cake. Grease 9 x 13-inch cake pan. Put coconut and nuts in pan. Mix cake mix according to package directions and pour over first layer. Mix remaining ingredients and drop by teaspoons over cake mixture. Bake at 350° for 35 to 45 minutes. Store in refrigerator.

recipes.title: Mom'S Ginger Bread
ingredients: 1 tsp. soda (in about 3 Tbsp. hot water)
directions: *To make moderately stiff batter.
recipes.text: Mom'S Ginger Bread. *To make moderately stiff batter.

recipes.title: Mayonnaise Cake
directions: Mix all together.
Bake at 350° for 35 minutes.
recipes.text: Mayonnaise Cake. Mix all together. Bake at 350° for 35 minutes.

recipes.title: Spaghetti Salad
ingredients: 1 large bottle Kraft Zesty Italian salad dressing
2 tomatoes, chopped small (can substitute canned tomatoes without the juice)
directions: Mix all ingredients together in a big bowl.
Cover and chill in refrigerator overnight.
Keep cold until serving.
recipes.text: Spaghetti Salad. Mix all ingredients together in a big bowl. Cover and chill in refrigerator overnight. Keep cold until serving.

recipes.title: Orange Fruit Cake
directions: Cut up all fruit and nuts.
Mix together.
Add no liquid.
Add eggs and cake mix.
Mix well with hands.
Bake in tube pan for 2 1/2 hours on 250°.
recipes.text: Orange Fruit Cake. Cut up all fruit and nuts. Mix together. Add no liquid. Add eggs and cake mix. Mix well with hands. Bake in tube pan for 2 1/2 hours on 250°.

recipes.title: Cucumber Dill Appetizers
ingredients: 1 square loaf Kasanol's black bread (or party round bread)
directions: Mix Italian dressing into softened cream cheese.
Spread on bread. Top with one thinly sliced cucumber.
Sprinkle dill on top.
recipes.text: Cucumber Dill Appetizers. Mix Italian dressing into softened cream cheese. Spread on bread. Top with one thinly sliced cucumber. Sprinkle dill on top.

recipes.title: Mexican Casserole
directions: Brown meat; add garlic powder, chili powder, salt and pepper; drain. Layer in greased 9 x 13-inch casserole as follows: Tortillas, meat, beans, onions and cheese. Top with tortillas. Pour soup and Ro-Tel tomato mixture over all. Cover with foil. Cook in 400° oven for 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Mexican Casserole. Brown meat; add garlic powder, chili powder, salt and pepper; drain. Layer in greased 9 x 13-inch casserole as follows: Tortillas, meat, beans, onions and cheese. Top with tortillas. Pour soup and Ro-Tel tomato mixture over all. Cover with foil. Cook in 400° oven for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Bars
directions: Mix eggs, sugar, oil and pumpkin together in large bowl. Combine rest of ingredients in a separate bowl, then add to pumpkin mixture.
Bake in 13 x 9-inch pan at 350° for 30 minutes. Cool and frost.
recipes.text: Pumpkin Bars. Mix eggs, sugar, oil and pumpkin together in large bowl. Combine rest of ingredients in a separate bowl, then add to pumpkin mixture. Bake in 13 x 9-inch pan at 350° for 30 minutes. Cool and frost.

recipes.title: Monkey Bread
directions: Cut each biscuit into 4 pieces.
Mix sugar and cinnamon together in a large bowl or bag.
Place biscuit pieces in bag and shake to coat.
Place pieces in a well-greased Bundt pan.
Stir brown sugar into the margarine until well blended and then pour it over biscuits.
Place in 350° oven for 30 minutes.
Flip pan over and enjoy!
recipes.text: Monkey Bread. Cut each biscuit into 4 pieces. Mix sugar and cinnamon together in a large bowl or bag. Place biscuit pieces in bag and shake to coat. Place pieces in a well-greased Bundt pan. Stir brown sugar into the margarine until well blended and then pour it over biscuits. Place in 350° oven for 30 minutes. Flip pan over and enjoy!

recipes.title: Heavenly Salad
directions: Dissolve marshmallows in milk on a double boiler. Add nuts and cherries and fold in whipped cream. Freeze until mushy, then beat well. Freeze again until firm. Serves 6 to 8.
recipes.text: Heavenly Salad. Dissolve marshmallows in milk on a double boiler. Add nuts and cherries and fold in whipped cream. Freeze until mushy, then beat well. Freeze again until firm. Serves 6 to 8.

recipes.title: Oatmeal Drop Cookies
directions: Sift together flour, baking powder and salt.
Add shortening, brown sugar, eggs, vanilla and milk.
Beat until smooth, about 2 minutes.
Stir in oats.
Drop from teaspoons onto greased cookie sheets.
Bake in preheated moderate oven (350°) for 12 to 15 minutes.
recipes.text: Oatmeal Drop Cookies. Sift together flour, baking powder and salt. Add shortening, brown sugar, eggs, vanilla and milk. Beat until smooth, about 2 minutes. Stir in oats. Drop from teaspoons onto greased cookie sheets. Bake in preheated moderate oven (350°) for 12 to 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Tomato Juice Cocktail
directions: Combine 1 1/2 cups tomato juice with kraut juice.
Put in an ice tray and freeze.
Use remaining juice, onion, lemon juice and 1/2 teaspoon salt; put in jar.
Cover and place in refrigerator. Before serving, set out tomato ice to melt a little.
Cut into small pieces.
Place in glass and cover with other juice.
recipes.text: Tomato Juice Cocktail. Combine 1 1/2 cups tomato juice with kraut juice. Put in an ice tray and freeze. Use remaining juice, onion, lemon juice and 1/2 teaspoon salt; put in jar. Cover and place in refrigerator. Before serving, set out tomato ice to melt a little. Cut into small pieces. Place in glass and cover with other juice.

recipes.title: Oatmeal Cookies
directions: Combine shortening, sugars, eggs, water and vanilla. Sift together flour, salt and soda and combine with creamed mixture. Stir in oatmeal. Drop by teaspoonful onto cookie sheet. Bake at 350° 12 to 15 minutes.
recipes.text: Oatmeal Cookies. Combine shortening, sugars, eggs, water and vanilla. Sift together flour, salt and soda and combine with creamed mixture. Stir in oatmeal. Drop by teaspoonful onto cookie sheet. Bake at 350° 12 to 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Aunt Willie'S Beef Casserole
directions: Brown beef and onions.
Drain.
Add remaining ingredients. Mix well.
Bake 30 minutes at 400°.
Serve with hot bread and fresh salad.
recipes.text: Aunt Willie'S Beef Casserole. Brown beef and onions. Drain. Add remaining ingredients. Mix well. Bake 30 minutes at 400°. Serve with hot bread and fresh salad.

recipes.title: Chocolate Fudge
directions: Combine first 5 ingredients in a 4-quart saucepan.
Stir over medium heat until blended.
Bring to a boil and boil for 5 minutes.
Remove from heat and stir in chocolate bits, vanilla and nuts until chocolate is melted.
Pour into a buttered pan, 9 x 9-inches.
Cool and cut while warm.
Makes 5 pounds.
recipes.text: Chocolate Fudge. Combine first 5 ingredients in a 4-quart saucepan. Stir over medium heat until blended. Bring to a boil and boil for 5 minutes. Remove from heat and stir in chocolate bits, vanilla and nuts until chocolate is melted. Pour into a buttered pan, 9 x 9-inches. Cool and cut while warm. Makes 5 pounds.

recipes.title: Coconut Pie
directions: Mix all together thoroughly.
Put into pie shell.
Chill before serving.
recipes.text: Coconut Pie. Mix all together thoroughly. Put into pie shell. Chill before serving.

recipes.title: Strawberry Pie
directions: Mix sugar, water and cornstarch together and heat until it forms a syrup.
Arrange berries in baked crust.
Pour syrup over berries.
Top with cream just before serving.
recipes.text: Strawberry Pie. Mix sugar, water and cornstarch together and heat until it forms a syrup. Arrange berries in baked crust. Pour syrup over berries. Top with cream just before serving.

recipes.title: Mexican Corn Bread
directions: Mix all ingredients together.
Bake at 400° for 40 to 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Mexican Corn Bread. Mix all ingredients together. Bake at 400° for 40 to 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Dessert Pizza
directions: Take Pillsbury sugar cookie mix and bake as directed on pizza pan.
Cool.
Mix cream cheese, Cool Whip and sugar together. Spread over cookies.
Then decorate with choice of fruits, sliced strawberries, kiwi or blueberries.
Looks and tastes great!
recipes.text: Dessert Pizza. Take Pillsbury sugar cookie mix and bake as directed on pizza pan. Cool. Mix cream cheese, Cool Whip and sugar together. Spread over cookies. Then decorate with choice of fruits, sliced strawberries, kiwi or blueberries. Looks and tastes great!

recipes.title: Shrimp Spread
ingredients: 1 (8 oz.) pkg. light cream cheese, softened
2 c. (8 oz.) shredded light Mozzarella cheese
2 (4 1/4 oz. each) cans shrimp, rinsed and drained (may use fresh shrimp, cooked and drained)
directions: In a small mixing bowl, beat the cream cheese until smooth. Add sour cream and mayonnaise.
Mix well.
Spread on a 12-inch round serving plate.
Cover with the seafood sauce.
Sprinkle with cheese, shrimp, onions and tomato.
Cover and chill.
Yield:
8 to 10 servings.
Serve with Triscuits or Hi-Ho's.
recipes.text: Shrimp Spread. In a small mixing bowl, beat the cream cheese until smooth. Add sour cream and mayonnaise. Mix well. Spread on a 12-inch round serving plate. Cover with the seafood sauce. Sprinkle with cheese, shrimp, onions and tomato. Cover and chill. Yield: 8 to 10 servings. Serve with Triscuits or Hi-Ho's.

recipes.title: Cream Cole Slaw(My Favorite)
directions: Shred cabbage.
Mix sugar with vinegar in cup.
Stir until sugar is dissolved, then add coffee cream and stir.
Mixture will thicken.
Add salt to cabbage, then add cream mixture.
This dressing may be used on other salads.
If not enough, just mix another batch as before.
recipes.text: Cream Cole Slaw(My Favorite). Shred cabbage. Mix sugar with vinegar in cup. Stir until sugar is dissolved, then add coffee cream and stir. Mixture will thicken. Add salt to cabbage, then add cream mixture. This dressing may be used on other salads. If not enough, just mix another batch as before.

recipes.title: Barbecued Beef Patties
directions: Mix and shape ingredients in patties and place in baking dish.
recipes.text: Barbecued Beef Patties. Mix and shape ingredients in patties and place in baking dish.

recipes.title: Corn Flake Peanut Butter Balls
directions: Cook sugar and Karo syrup until sugar melts.
Turn off and add peanut butter.
Mix well.
Stir in corn flakes.
Roll into balls. Place on wax paper.
recipes.text: Corn Flake Peanut Butter Balls. Cook sugar and Karo syrup until sugar melts. Turn off and add peanut butter. Mix well. Stir in corn flakes. Roll into balls. Place on wax paper.

recipes.title: Lo-Cal Brownies
ingredients: 1 1/2 tsp. Sweet' N Low or Sugar Twin
directions: Stir all ingredients by hand until well blended. Turn into 8-inch square pan (Teflon-coated) or sprayed with Pam. Bake 30 minutes at 350°. Cut into squares while still warm.
recipes.text: Lo-Cal Brownies. Stir all ingredients by hand until well blended. Turn into 8-inch square pan (Teflon-coated) or sprayed with Pam. Bake 30 minutes at 350°. Cut into squares while still warm.

recipes.title: Chicken Stew
directions: Cook chicken until tender.
Pour off all fat and debone chicken.
In a pot, combine chicken, water, bouillon and all ingredients.
Cook over medium heat for 45 minutes.
Season to taste.
(I like Mrs. Dash table blend and/or extra spicy.)
Serves 3 to 5.
recipes.text: Chicken Stew. Cook chicken until tender. Pour off all fat and debone chicken. In a pot, combine chicken, water, bouillon and all ingredients. Cook over medium heat for 45 minutes. Season to taste. (I like Mrs. Dash table blend and/or extra spicy.) Serves 3 to 5.

recipes.title: Hot Artichoke Dip
ingredients: 1 (14 oz.) can artichoke hearts, drained and chopped
directions: Mix all ingredients; spoon into a small ovenproof dish.
Bake at 350° for 10 to 15 minutes.
Serve with tortilla chips or crackers.
Makes 2 cups.
recipes.text: Hot Artichoke Dip. Mix all ingredients; spoon into a small ovenproof dish. Bake at 350° for 10 to 15 minutes. Serve with tortilla chips or crackers. Makes 2 cups.

recipes.title: Chicken And Noodle Casserole
directions: Cook chicken. Bone and dice. Saute onion, celery and pepper in butter until tender. Cook noodles in chicken stock; drain, leaving about 1 cup stock in noodles.
Mix the soup, mushrooms and cheese with the sauteed vegetables and chicken. Toss with the noodles, adding more stock if needed.
Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese and bake at 350° for about 1 hour.
recipes.text: Chicken And Noodle Casserole. Cook chicken. Bone and dice. Saute onion, celery and pepper in butter until tender. Cook noodles in chicken stock; drain, leaving about 1 cup stock in noodles. Mix the soup, mushrooms and cheese with the sauteed vegetables and chicken. Toss with the noodles, adding more stock if needed. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese and bake at 350° for about 1 hour.

recipes.title: Deer Roast
directions: Cook deer roast.
Cook first 11 ingredients (except deer roast) until thickens, stirring constantly.
Add lemon juice, orange juice and capers.
Serve over thin sliced deer.
recipes.text: Deer Roast. Cook deer roast. Cook first 11 ingredients (except deer roast) until thickens, stirring constantly. Add lemon juice, orange juice and capers. Serve over thin sliced deer.

recipes.title: Homemade Barbecue Sauce
directions: Mix all ingredients well.
recipes.text: Homemade Barbecue Sauce. Mix all ingredients well.

recipes.title: Ground Beef And Wild Rice Casserole
ingredients: 2 bouillon cubes, dissolved in 1 c. hot water
directions: Pour boiling water over rice.
Let stand 15 minutes and drain. Brown onion in fat; add meat and brown.
Combine all ingredients. Let stand in casserole overnight.
Bake at 325° for 1 1/2 hours. Yield:
12 servings.
recipes.text: Ground Beef And Wild Rice Casserole. Pour boiling water over rice. Let stand 15 minutes and drain. Brown onion in fat; add meat and brown. Combine all ingredients. Let stand in casserole overnight. Bake at 325° for 1 1/2 hours. Yield: 12 servings.

recipes.title: Quiche
directions: Mix
everything
together
and	pour
into a (deep pie) shell. Bake at 300° for 40 to 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Quiche. Mix everything together and	pour into a (deep pie) shell. Bake at 300° for 40 to 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Triple Berry Wake-Up
directions: Spread some cream cheese on two slices of bread.
Top with strawberry slices, making a complete blanket over the cheese.
Top each with remaining bread.
recipes.text: Triple Berry Wake-Up. Spread some cream cheese on two slices of bread. Top with strawberry slices, making a complete blanket over the cheese. Top each with remaining bread.

recipes.title: Angel Biscuits
directions: Dissolve yeast in warm water; set aside.
Cut Crisco into dry ingredients.
Place in covered container and store in refrigerator.
Pinch dough as needed.
Place biscuits on cookie sheet in cold oven.
Turn oven to 450°.
This will keep well in refrigerator.
recipes.text: Angel Biscuits. Dissolve yeast in warm water; set aside. Cut Crisco into dry ingredients. Place in covered container and store in refrigerator. Pinch dough as needed. Place biscuits on cookie sheet in cold oven. Turn oven to 450°. This will keep well in refrigerator.

recipes.title: Poppy Seed Cake
directions: Mix all ingredients in bowl and beat at low speed for 3 minutes.
Beat 2 minutes at high speed.
Pour into a floured and greased pan.
Bake at temperature on box.
Let cool 25 minutes before removing.
recipes.text: Poppy Seed Cake. Mix all ingredients in bowl and beat at low speed for 3 minutes. Beat 2 minutes at high speed. Pour into a floured and greased pan. Bake at temperature on box. Let cool 25 minutes before removing.

recipes.title: Cabbage Creole
directions: Brown hamburger and onions; drain.
Combine regular tomatoes, Ro-Tel tomatoes, Cheddar cheese soup and 1 head cabbage.
Simmer 1 hour uncovered.
Serve with cornbread.
recipes.text: Cabbage Creole. Brown hamburger and onions; drain. Combine regular tomatoes, Ro-Tel tomatoes, Cheddar cheese soup and 1 head cabbage. Simmer 1 hour uncovered. Serve with cornbread.

recipes.title: Deluxe Brownies
directions: Preheat
oven
to
Cream
margarine,
sugars and peanut butter.
Beat
eggs
well
and add to batter along with vanilla. Blend in
flour.
Mix
well
and
pour into a 9 1/2 x 13-inch pan. Sprinkle with chocolate chips.
Place in oven for 5 minutes until chips begin to melt.
Remove from oven and run a knife
through batter in crisscross direction to make batter marble. Bake an additional 25 minutes.
recipes.text: Deluxe Brownies. Preheat oven to 350°. Cream margarine, sugars and peanut butter. Beat eggs well and add to batter along with vanilla. Blend in flour. Mix well and pour into a 9 1/2 x 13-inch pan. Sprinkle with chocolate chips. Place in oven for 5 minutes until chips begin to melt. Remove from oven and run a knife through batter in crisscross direction to make batter marble. Bake an additional 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Cheese Beef Spread
ingredients: 1 small onion, minced or chopped green onions
directions: Chop corned beef in food processor, then blend all together. Serve on crackers.
recipes.text: Cheese Beef Spread. Chop corned beef in food processor, then blend all together. Serve on crackers.

recipes.title: Pineapple-Orange Salad
ingredients: 1 (16 oz.) can crushed pineapple, well drained
2 (11 oz.) cans mandarin oranges, well drained
directions: In large mixing bowl, combine all ingredients.
Mix well with a spoon or spatula.
Pour into a 9 x 9 x 2-inch glass dish. Refrigerate overnight.
Cut into squares to serve.
recipes.text: Pineapple-Orange Salad. In large mixing bowl, combine all ingredients. Mix well with a spoon or spatula. Pour into a 9 x 9 x 2-inch glass dish. Refrigerate overnight. Cut into squares to serve.

recipes.title: Wedding Cookies
directions: Cream butter; add sugar, pecans and flour.
Mix well.
Shape into balls using about 1 tablespoon of dough for each cookie. Bake at 300° on ungreased baking sheet for about 45 minutes.
Roll in confectioners sugar while hot and again when cooled.
recipes.text: Wedding Cookies. Cream butter; add sugar, pecans and flour. Mix well. Shape into balls using about 1 tablespoon of dough for each cookie. Bake at 300° on ungreased baking sheet for about 45 minutes. Roll in confectioners sugar while hot and again when cooled.

recipes.title: Pineapple-Waldorf Pasta Salad
directions: Drain pineapple, reserving 1/4 cup of the juice.
Combine pineapple, pasta, apple, celery and nuts in a large bowl.
Combine mayonnaise, sour cream, reserved pineapple juice and salt.
Add to salad.
Toss until well mixed; chill well before serving.
recipes.text: Pineapple-Waldorf Pasta Salad. Drain pineapple, reserving 1/4 cup of the juice. Combine pineapple, pasta, apple, celery and nuts in a large bowl. Combine mayonnaise, sour cream, reserved pineapple juice and salt. Add to salad. Toss until well mixed; chill well before serving.

recipes.title: Grapefruit-Avocado Salad
directions: Bring to boil sugar, 1 cup water and grapefruit juice.
Add 2 envelopes gelatin that has been dissolved in 9 tablespoons water. Set aside.
Arrange avocado slices in bottom of pan.
(I grease pan first with oil.)
Pour 1/2 of gelatin mixture over avocado slices. After gelatin is firm, spread over all, the cream cheese that has been blended with mayonnaise.
Drain grapefruit perfectly and arrange sections over cheese.
Pour remaining gelatin over grapefruit.
Cover and refrigerate overnight.
Cut in squares. Using spatula, turn out on lettuce leaf.
This is very good!
recipes.text: Grapefruit-Avocado Salad. Bring to boil sugar, 1 cup water and grapefruit juice. Add 2 envelopes gelatin that has been dissolved in 9 tablespoons water. Set aside. Arrange avocado slices in bottom of pan. (I grease pan first with oil.) Pour 1/2 of gelatin mixture over avocado slices. After gelatin is firm, spread over all, the cream cheese that has been blended with mayonnaise. Drain grapefruit perfectly and arrange sections over cheese. Pour remaining gelatin over grapefruit. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Cut in squares. Using spatula, turn out on lettuce leaf. This is very good!

recipes.title: Fried Chicken
directions: Divide seasoning.
Put half in flour and half on chicken.
In brown grocery bag, put flour, salt, pepper, Old Bay and paprika. Shake until mixed.
Cut chicken into 10 pieces.
In large bowl, put chicken pieces.
Rub seasoning into chicken with hands (salt, pepper, Old Bay and paprika).
Heat oil in cast-iron skillet until hot.
Shake chicken in flour mixture.
Drop into hot oil.
Cook until done, approximately 13 to 15 minutes (until golden brown).
recipes.text: Fried Chicken. Divide seasoning. Put half in flour and half on chicken. In brown grocery bag, put flour, salt, pepper, Old Bay and paprika. Shake until mixed. Cut chicken into 10 pieces. In large bowl, put chicken pieces. Rub seasoning into chicken with hands (salt, pepper, Old Bay and paprika). Heat oil in cast-iron skillet until hot. Shake chicken in flour mixture. Drop into hot oil. Cook until done, approximately 13 to 15 minutes (until golden brown).

recipes.title: Congealed Mandarin Orange Salad
ingredients: 1 (8 oz.) can water chestnuts, drained and chopped
directions: Drain	pineapple
and
oranges;
reserve
juice.
Add enough water
to have 1 1/2 cups of reserved liquid.
Dissolve gelatin in	hot
tea.
Add	1 1/2 cups reserved liquid. Chill until consistency of unbeaten egg whites.
Fold in pineapple, oranges and
water	chestnuts.
Spoon
mixture into a lightly oiled
ring mold;
cover and chill until firm.	Unmold onto a lettuce-lined plate.
Serves 8.
recipes.text: Congealed Mandarin Orange Salad. Drain	pineapple and oranges; reserve juice. Add enough water to have 1 1/2 cups of reserved liquid. Dissolve gelatin in	hot tea. Add	1 1/2 cups reserved liquid. Chill until consistency of unbeaten egg whites. Fold in pineapple, oranges and water	chestnuts. Spoon mixture into a lightly oiled ring mold; cover and chill until firm.	Unmold onto a lettuce-lined plate. Serves 8.

recipes.title: Nicaraugan Casserole
ingredients: 8 oz. wide noodles, cooked and drained
directions: Brown and drain beef.
Cook first five ingredients together. Mix cream cheese and sour cream together.
Layer noodles, cheese mixture and beef mixture.
Repeat layers and top with grated Cheddar cheese.
Bake until bubbly at 350°.
recipes.text: Nicaraugan Casserole. Brown and drain beef. Cook first five ingredients together. Mix cream cheese and sour cream together. Layer noodles, cheese mixture and beef mixture. Repeat layers and top with grated Cheddar cheese. Bake until bubbly at 350°.

recipes.title: Tempura
ingredients: 2 c. pastry flour or all-purpose flour
directions: Mix together these ingredients and enough cold water to make batter thick enough to hold vegetables.
Beat batter until smooth.
recipes.text: Tempura. Mix together these ingredients and enough cold water to make batter thick enough to hold vegetables. Beat batter until smooth.

recipes.title: Cindy'S Chile Rellenos
ingredients: 2 (4.5 oz.) cans green chiles, diced or whole, peeled
1 pkg. (2 c.) natural shredded sharp Cheddar cheese
directions: Brown ground beef with onion.
Drain grease.
Set aside. Spread chiles on bottom of dish, approximately 10 x 10-inch. Cover with ground beef and onion mixture.
Sprinkle cheese over chile and hamburger mixture.
recipes.text: Cindy'S Chile Rellenos. Brown ground beef with onion. Drain grease. Set aside. Spread chiles on bottom of dish, approximately 10 x 10-inch. Cover with ground beef and onion mixture. Sprinkle cheese over chile and hamburger mixture.

recipes.title: Fruit Cocktail Cake
directions: Sift flour with sugar, soda and salt. Beat eggs in mixing bowl until thick and lemon colored. Add drained fruit. Stir in dry ingredients. Mix thoroughly. Pour into greased and floured dish. Sprinkle brown sugar over top. Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes or until toothpick comes out clean. Serve warm or cold.
recipes.text: Fruit Cocktail Cake. Sift flour with sugar, soda and salt. Beat eggs in mixing bowl until thick and lemon colored. Add drained fruit. Stir in dry ingredients. Mix thoroughly. Pour into greased and floured dish. Sprinkle brown sugar over top. Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes or until toothpick comes out clean. Serve warm or cold.

recipes.title: English Apple Pie
ingredients: 4 large cooking apples, peeled and sliced (about 6 c.)
heavy cream, half and half or ice cream (optional)
directions: In medium size bowl, beat butter and brown sugar with wooden spoon or electric mixer until pale and fluffy.
Stir in flour, 1 teaspoon cinnamon and the water until smooth and thick.
Stir in pecans.
Mound apples in 9-inch pie plate.
Mix granulated sugar with remaining cinnamon; sprinkle over apples.
Spoon pecan topping over apples and dollops.
Bake on lowest rack of preheated 375° oven for 45 to 50 minutes until apples are tender when pierced with a skewer.
Serve in bowls with the cream or ice cream.
Makes 8 servings.
recipes.text: English Apple Pie. In medium size bowl, beat butter and brown sugar with wooden spoon or electric mixer until pale and fluffy. Stir in flour, 1 teaspoon cinnamon and the water until smooth and thick. Stir in pecans. Mound apples in 9-inch pie plate. Mix granulated sugar with remaining cinnamon; sprinkle over apples. Spoon pecan topping over apples and dollops. Bake on lowest rack of preheated 375° oven for 45 to 50 minutes until apples are tender when pierced with a skewer. Serve in bowls with the cream or ice cream. Makes 8 servings.

recipes.title: Thin White Sauce(Soup Base)
directions: Melt butter. Add flour and blend. Add milk and salt. Cook until slightly thick, stirring constantly.
Makes 3 cups.
recipes.text: Thin White Sauce(Soup Base). Melt butter. Add flour and blend. Add milk and salt. Cook until slightly thick, stirring constantly. Makes 3 cups.

recipes.title: Cheese Dip
directions: Combine all ingredients.
Chill for 2 hours.
Eat with crackers or chips.
recipes.text: Cheese Dip. Combine all ingredients. Chill for 2 hours. Eat with crackers or chips.

recipes.title: Chicken, Broccoli And Ziti
ingredients: 1/2 c. white wine or 1/2 c. chicken broth
directions: Saute chicken in garlic and oil.
In large pot, boil broccoli and ziti together until done.
Add wine or broth and butter to chicken and simmer, keep stirring until ready to add to ziti and broccoli.
Simmer briefly.
Add cheese to suit your taste.
recipes.text: Chicken, Broccoli And Ziti. Saute chicken in garlic and oil. In large pot, boil broccoli and ziti together until done. Add wine or broth and butter to chicken and simmer, keep stirring until ready to add to ziti and broccoli. Simmer briefly. Add cheese to suit your taste.

recipes.title: Jiffy Cinnamon Rolls
directions: Soften yeast in water; mix all ingredients well.
Add 2 1/2 to 3 cups flour.
Mix into a soft dough.
Let rise until doubled in bulk.
Work one half at a time.
Roll out on a floured surface. Sprinkle with a mixture of the cinnamon and sugar.
Roll up from the small end.
Cut into half-inch pieces and put into a greased pan.
Let rise until doubled in bulk.
Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes or until lightly browned.
May be frosted with a drizzle of powdered sugar and milk.
recipes.text: Jiffy Cinnamon Rolls. Soften yeast in water; mix all ingredients well. Add 2 1/2 to 3 cups flour. Mix into a soft dough. Let rise until doubled in bulk. Work one half at a time. Roll out on a floured surface. Sprinkle with a mixture of the cinnamon and sugar. Roll up from the small end. Cut into half-inch pieces and put into a greased pan. Let rise until doubled in bulk. Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes or until lightly browned. May be frosted with a drizzle of powdered sugar and milk.

recipes.title: Simple Summer Appetizer
directions: Cut artichoke hearts and tomatoes into bite size pieces. Slice avocados.
Arrange in glass serving dish.
Pour Italian dressing over all and chill for a few hours.
Serve with toothpicks.
recipes.text: Simple Summer Appetizer. Cut artichoke hearts and tomatoes into bite size pieces. Slice avocados. Arrange in glass serving dish. Pour Italian dressing over all and chill for a few hours. Serve with toothpicks.

recipes.title: Spicy Chicken Skewers
ingredients: 2 small red bell peppers, each cut into 16 (1-inch) pieces
directions: Coat a small skillet with vegetable cooking spray.
Place over medium heat until hot. Add minced onion and crushed red pepper. Saute 3 minutes or until tender. Remove from heat.
Stir in brown sugar, black pepper, white wine vinegar, soy sauce and sherry. Set aside.
recipes.text: Spicy Chicken Skewers. Coat a small skillet with vegetable cooking spray. Place over medium heat until hot. Add minced onion and crushed red pepper. Saute 3 minutes or until tender. Remove from heat. Stir in brown sugar, black pepper, white wine vinegar, soy sauce and sherry. Set aside.

recipes.title: Squash Corn Bread
ingredients: 18 oz. pkg. corn bread mix or 2 Jiffy mixes
directions: Beat eggs and milk.
Add meal, cottage cheese and squash. Pour into well greased 9 x 13-inch pan.
Drizzle with margarine. Bake in a 375° oven for 40 minutes.
Makes 15 servings.
recipes.text: Squash Corn Bread. Beat eggs and milk. Add meal, cottage cheese and squash. Pour into well greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Drizzle with margarine. Bake in a 375° oven for 40 minutes. Makes 15 servings.

recipes.title: Scalloped Pineapple
ingredients: 2 (20 oz.)( cans chunk pineapple, drained but reserve liquid
directions: Butter a 2-quart casserole.
Put 1 can of pineapple on bottom of dish.
Mix cheeses together and sprinkle half of cheese mixture on top of pineapple.
Mix flour and sugar and sprinkle on cheese. Follow with second can of pineapple and the remaining half of flour-sugar mixture, leaving remaining half of cheese mixture for top.
Pour 1/2 cup pineapple juice over entire dish and dot with butter.
Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes until bubbly and brown.
recipes.text: Scalloped Pineapple. Butter a 2-quart casserole. Put 1 can of pineapple on bottom of dish. Mix cheeses together and sprinkle half of cheese mixture on top of pineapple. Mix flour and sugar and sprinkle on cheese. Follow with second can of pineapple and the remaining half of flour-sugar mixture, leaving remaining half of cheese mixture for top. Pour 1/2 cup pineapple juice over entire dish and dot with butter. Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes until bubbly and brown.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Fudge
directions: Blend butter into corn syrup; stir in peanut butter, salt and vanilla.
Mix until creamy.
Stir in confectioners sugar.
Turn candy onto pastry board; knead with hands until blended and smooth.
Add nuts gradually, pressing and kneading into dough. Press candy into greased 8-inch square pan.
Chill for 1 hour; cut into squares.
Yield:
2 pounds.
recipes.text: Peanut Butter Fudge. Blend butter into corn syrup; stir in peanut butter, salt and vanilla. Mix until creamy. Stir in confectioners sugar. Turn candy onto pastry board; knead with hands until blended and smooth. Add nuts gradually, pressing and kneading into dough. Press candy into greased 8-inch square pan. Chill for 1 hour; cut into squares. Yield: 2 pounds.

recipes.title: Caramel Marshmallow Balls
directions: Melt butter, caramels and sweetened condensed milk in medium pan over low heat. Dip each marshmallow into melted mixture and roll in Rice Krispies. Cool individually on waxed paper. Store in container, NOT AIRTIGHT or they will get sticky.
recipes.text: Caramel Marshmallow Balls. Melt butter, caramels and sweetened condensed milk in medium pan over low heat. Dip each marshmallow into melted mixture and roll in Rice Krispies. Cool individually on waxed paper. Store in container, NOT AIRTIGHT or they will get sticky.

recipes.title: Microwave Mississippi Mud
directions: Mix together well the first 5 ingredients.
Pour in a greased microwave pan. Bake 7 to 9 minutes on High. As soon as it's finished, dot top with the Marshmallow Creme.
Put in microwave for 1 minute. Spread evenly over cake.
Spread on Chocolate Icing.
recipes.text: Microwave Mississippi Mud. Mix together well the first 5 ingredients. Pour in a greased microwave pan. Bake 7 to 9 minutes on High. As soon as it's finished, dot top with the Marshmallow Creme. Put in microwave for 1 minute. Spread evenly over cake. Spread on Chocolate Icing.

recipes.title: Quick Fettuccine Alfredo
directions: While pasta is cooking, melt butter in a large skillet.
Add cream and 1/4 cup cheese.

Simmer over very low heat 4 to 5 minutes until sauce starts to thicken. Drain pasta well and add to skillet. Lift and stir to combine all ingredients and coat the pasta. Add remaining cheese, nutmeg, salt and a generous grinding of black pepper.
recipes.text: Quick Fettuccine Alfredo. While pasta is cooking, melt butter in a large skillet. Add cream and 1/4 cup cheese. Simmer over very low heat 4 to 5 minutes until sauce starts to thicken. Drain pasta well and add to skillet. Lift and stir to combine all ingredients and coat the pasta. Add remaining cheese, nutmeg, salt and a generous grinding of black pepper.

recipes.title: Cranberry Salad
directions: *Only use about half the rind.
recipes.text: Cranberry Salad. *Only use about half the rind.

recipes.title: Basic Cobbler
ingredients: just enough milk to make pastry dough
directions: On bottom of baking dish, spread a layer of sweetened fruit (apples, peaches, cherries), then a layer of pastry.
Then spread another layer of fruit and top off with a layer of pastry.
Bake at 425° for about 25 minutes, checking frequently.
recipes.text: Basic Cobbler. On bottom of baking dish, spread a layer of sweetened fruit (apples, peaches, cherries), then a layer of pastry. Then spread another layer of fruit and top off with a layer of pastry. Bake at 425° for about 25 minutes, checking frequently.

recipes.title: No-Bake Pineapple Cheese Cake
ingredients: 1 (3 oz.) pkg. lemon Jell-O, mixed in c. boiling water
directions: Prepare Jell-O first so it can cool.
Pour melted margarine into crumbs and stir until thoroughly mixed.
Set aside.
Whip Milnot and 2 tablespoons sugar until stiff.
Cream together cream cheese and cup of sugar.
Mix in Jell-O.
Add to Milnot and then stir in pineapple.
Press crumb mixture into bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Add layer of filling and sprinkle additional graham cracker crumbs over top. Chill.
recipes.text: No-Bake Pineapple Cheese Cake. Prepare Jell-O first so it can cool. Pour melted margarine into crumbs and stir until thoroughly mixed. Set aside. Whip Milnot and 2 tablespoons sugar until stiff. Cream together cream cheese and cup of sugar. Mix in Jell-O. Add to Milnot and then stir in pineapple. Press crumb mixture into bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan. Add layer of filling and sprinkle additional graham cracker crumbs over top. Chill.

recipes.title: Pound Cake
directions: Mix all ingredients well at medium speed. Pour into a tube pan.
Bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours.
recipes.text: Pound Cake. Mix all ingredients well at medium speed. Pour into a tube pan. Bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours.

recipes.title: Broccoli Salad
ingredients: 3 c. broccoli, cut into bite size
directions: Combine all ingredients. This is best when used with Broccoli Dressing.
recipes.text: Broccoli Salad. Combine all ingredients. This is best when used with Broccoli Dressing.

recipes.title: Cowboy Cookies
ingredients: 1 c. light brown sugar, firmly packed
2 c. quick-cooking oatmeal or Rice Krispies
directions: Cream sugars and Crisco.
Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each.
Add vanilla.
Sift together flour, salt, baking soda and baking powder.
Blend into butter mixture.
Add oatmeal or Rice Krispies and stir well.
Add chocolate bits and nuts. Stir to distribute evenly.
Drop by teaspoon onto greased cookie sheet.
Bake at 350° for 10 to 12 minutes or until golden brown.
recipes.text: Cowboy Cookies. Cream sugars and Crisco. Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each. Add vanilla. Sift together flour, salt, baking soda and baking powder. Blend into butter mixture. Add oatmeal or Rice Krispies and stir well. Add chocolate bits and nuts. Stir to distribute evenly. Drop by teaspoon onto greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350° for 10 to 12 minutes or until golden brown.

recipes.title: Crab Casserole
directions: Mix together all ingredients. Top with bread crumbs.
recipes.text: Crab Casserole. Mix together all ingredients. Top with bread crumbs.

recipes.title: Oatmeal Cookies
ingredients: 3 c. old fashioned or quick cooking oats
directions: Cream sugars and shortening.
Add egg, water and vanilla and beat together until creamy by hand.
Mix together flour, soda and salt.
Add to creamed mixture.
Mix well.
Stir in oats.
Drop by heaping teaspoon onto greased cookie sheet.
Bake at 350° for 10 to 15 minutes.
recipes.text: Oatmeal Cookies. Cream sugars and shortening. Add egg, water and vanilla and beat together until creamy by hand. Mix together flour, soda and salt. Add to creamed mixture. Mix well. Stir in oats. Drop by heaping teaspoon onto greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350° for 10 to 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Pizza Bread
directions: Beat eggs and add Parmesan cheese.
This will be used to baste the crust.
recipes.text: Pizza Bread. Beat eggs and add Parmesan cheese. This will be used to baste the crust.

recipes.title: Crabmeat Cheese Dip
directions: In double boiler, melt butter and Velveeta.
Add crab meat. Serve in chafing dish with crackers or Melba toast rounds.
recipes.text: Crabmeat Cheese Dip. In double boiler, melt butter and Velveeta. Add crab meat. Serve in chafing dish with crackers or Melba toast rounds.

recipes.title: Pizza Pie
directions: Mix beef with salt and pepper; pat out in a 9-inch pie plate. Spread tomatoes over meat and sprinkle with remaining ingredients. Bake at 375° for a good 20 minutes.
recipes.text: Pizza Pie. Mix beef with salt and pepper; pat out in a 9-inch pie plate. Spread tomatoes over meat and sprinkle with remaining ingredients. Bake at 375° for a good 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Princess Gem Cookies
ingredients: 2 tsp. ammonium carbonate crystals, crushed (can be purchased at some drugstores)
directions: Cream shortening and margarine.
Add ammonia crystals and sugar gradually, creaming well.
Add flour, a little at a time. Add coconut and form into small balls.
Place 1 inch apart on baking sheet and bake at 325° for about 15 minutes.
Roll in powdered sugar immediately after baked.
recipes.text: Princess Gem Cookies. Cream shortening and margarine. Add ammonia crystals and sugar gradually, creaming well. Add flour, a little at a time. Add coconut and form into small balls. Place 1 inch apart on baking sheet and bake at 325° for about 15 minutes. Roll in powdered sugar immediately after baked.

recipes.title: Hot Mushroom Dip
ingredients: 24 oz. fresh mushrooms, stems removed and sliced
10 oz. extra sharp Cheddar cheese, grated
directions: Saute mushrooms in butter until all liquid is absorbed.
Mix mushrooms, sour cream and soup mix.
Put mixture in an ovenproof serving dish.
Top with cheese.
Bake until bubbly, approximately 30 minutes at 350°.
Serve with crackers or French bread.
recipes.text: Hot Mushroom Dip. Saute mushrooms in butter until all liquid is absorbed. Mix mushrooms, sour cream and soup mix. Put mixture in an ovenproof serving dish. Top with cheese. Bake until bubbly, approximately 30 minutes at 350°. Serve with crackers or French bread.

recipes.title: Colcannon
ingredients: 4 or 5 slices bacon, cooked and crumbled
approximately 2 cans cream of mushroom soup
directions: Choose casserole according to number of servings desired and adjust ingredients accordingly.
recipes.text: Colcannon. Choose casserole according to number of servings desired and adjust ingredients accordingly.

recipes.title: Quick And Dirty Italian Cream Cake
ingredients: 2 pkg. Stella D'Oro anisette sponge cookies
2 small pkg. chocolate pudding or 1 large
2 small pkg. vanilla pudding or 1 large
directions: Cut cookies lengthwise.
Line bottom of 9 x 11-inch pan.
Cook vanilla pudding; after thickens, add rum extract.
Stir.
Pour hot over cookies.
Do a second layer of cookies.
Pour hot chocolate pudding on top.
Put cherries on pudding.
Refrigerate.
When cool, cover top with Cool Whip and sprinkle on pecans.
recipes.text: Quick And Dirty Italian Cream Cake. Cut cookies lengthwise. Line bottom of 9 x 11-inch pan. Cook vanilla pudding; after thickens, add rum extract. Stir. Pour hot over cookies. Do a second layer of cookies. Pour hot chocolate pudding on top. Put cherries on pudding. Refrigerate. When cool, cover top with Cool Whip and sprinkle on pecans.

recipes.title: Stuffed Cabbage
directions: Steam cabbage until leaves are loose.
Remove leaves.
Cut off hard veins on large leaves so they will roll easily.
recipes.text: Stuffed Cabbage. Steam cabbage until leaves are loose. Remove leaves. Cut off hard veins on large leaves so they will roll easily.

recipes.title: Mission Cake
directions: Bake at 350° for 25 minutes or until done.
recipes.text: Mission Cake. Bake at 350° for 25 minutes or until done.

recipes.title: Meat Loaf
ingredients: 1 dry pkg. Lipton onion soup mix
directions: Mix onion, egg, tomato sauce, dry onion soup, oatmeal and hamburger.
Place in baking dish and bake at 350° for 1 hour. When it is finished, add ketchup to the top and serve.
recipes.text: Meat Loaf. Mix onion, egg, tomato sauce, dry onion soup, oatmeal and hamburger. Place in baking dish and bake at 350° for 1 hour. When it is finished, add ketchup to the top and serve.

recipes.title: Not So Sweet Pecan Pie
directions: Soften butter and cream.
Add sugar gradually and cream until fluffy.
Add syrup and salt.
Beat well.
Add eggs one at a time, beating thoroughly.
Stir in pecans. Pour into pie shell, and bake in a 350° oven for 50 minutes, or until knife comes out clean.
recipes.text: Not So Sweet Pecan Pie. Soften butter and cream. Add sugar gradually and cream until fluffy. Add syrup and salt. Beat well. Add eggs one at a time, beating thoroughly. Stir in pecans. Pour into pie shell, and bake in a 350° oven for 50 minutes, or until knife comes out clean.

recipes.title: Chocolate Pound Cake
directions: Cream butter, Crisco and sugar.
Add eggs one at a time.
Sift dry ingredients and add alternately with milk.
Bake 1 hour and 25 minutes at 325°.
recipes.text: Chocolate Pound Cake. Cream butter, Crisco and sugar. Add eggs one at a time. Sift dry ingredients and add alternately with milk. Bake 1 hour and 25 minutes at 325°.

recipes.title: Zucchini Bread
directions: Mix all ingredients well and put in greased 13 x 9 pan. Bake at 325° for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Zucchini Bread. Mix all ingredients well and put in greased 13 x 9 pan. Bake at 325° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Slow Baked Beef Stew
directions: More celery, onions and potatoes may be used.
Put meat and vegetables in casserole.
Do not brown meat.
Blend 2 teaspoons salt, 1 tablespoon sugar and 3 tablespoons Minute tapioca. Sprinkle over meat and add 1 cup tomato juice.
Cover and bake for 4 hours at 250°.
Add 1 cup water.
Use more tapioca to thicken, if necessary.
Do not peek!
recipes.text: Slow Baked Beef Stew. More celery, onions and potatoes may be used. Put meat and vegetables in casserole. Do not brown meat. Blend 2 teaspoons salt, 1 tablespoon sugar and 3 tablespoons Minute tapioca. Sprinkle over meat and add 1 cup tomato juice. Cover and bake for 4 hours at 250°. Add 1 cup water. Use more tapioca to thicken, if necessary. Do not peek!

recipes.title: Chicken Steak
directions: Pound the chicken in order to tenderize it.
Pour half of the Worcestershire sauce on the breast and add the seasonings. Tenderize until chicken is thin and flat.
Broil both sides and add the rest of the sauce.
This makes 1 serving.
recipes.text: Chicken Steak. Pound the chicken in order to tenderize it. Pour half of the Worcestershire sauce on the breast and add the seasonings. Tenderize until chicken is thin and flat. Broil both sides and add the rest of the sauce. This makes 1 serving.

recipes.title: Patty Dorsey Salsa
directions: Grind the first seven ingredients together, then add the rest of the ingredients.
Cook about 2 hours and seal in pint jars. Makes 25 pints.
recipes.text: Patty Dorsey Salsa. Grind the first seven ingredients together, then add the rest of the ingredients. Cook about 2 hours and seal in pint jars. Makes 25 pints.

recipes.title: Veggie Pizza
ingredients: 2 pkg. Pillsbury crescent rolls (8 roll size)
directions: Pat crescent rolls into an ungreased cookie sheet.
Bake at 350° until golden brown, 8 to 10 minutes.
Cool.
Spread mayonnaise, cream cheese and dressing over crust.
Top with cut up vegetables such as cauliflower, broccoli, carrots, celery, fresh mushrooms, green peppers, black or green olives and tomatoes. Grate Cheddar cheese on top.
Cut into squares.
recipes.text: Veggie Pizza. Pat crescent rolls into an ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 350° until golden brown, 8 to 10 minutes. Cool. Spread mayonnaise, cream cheese and dressing over crust. Top with cut up vegetables such as cauliflower, broccoli, carrots, celery, fresh mushrooms, green peppers, black or green olives and tomatoes. Grate Cheddar cheese on top. Cut into squares.

recipes.title: Ham Barbecue Sauce
directions: Mix ingredients together in large saucepan.
Simmer to thicken; add meat until heated through.
Makes 2 pounds.
recipes.text: Ham Barbecue Sauce. Mix ingredients together in large saucepan. Simmer to thicken; add meat until heated through. Makes 2 pounds.

recipes.title: Zucchini Bread
directions: Add sugar and oil to eggs.
Mix well and add zucchini.
Sift dry ingredients and add to mixture.
Add vanilla and nuts.
Pour into two 5x9 inch loaf pans that have been greased.
Bake at 325 degrees for 1 hour.
Makes 2 loaves.
recipes.text: Zucchini Bread. Add sugar and oil to eggs. Mix well and add zucchini. Sift dry ingredients and add to mixture. Add vanilla and nuts. Pour into two 5x9 inch loaf pans that have been greased. Bake at 325 degrees for 1 hour. Makes 2 loaves.

recipes.title: Spinach Elegante
ingredients: 1/2 c. shredded sharp process American cheese
directions: Cook spinach according to package directions. Drain well. Spread on bottom of 10 x 6 x 1/2-inch baking dish. Arrange bacon and mushrooms over spinach. Sprinkle with dash of pepper and marjoram. Bake at 325° for 15 minutes. Cover with sour cream and cheese. Return to oven 5 minutes or until cheese melts. Serves 6.
recipes.text: Spinach Elegante. Cook spinach according to package directions. Drain well. Spread on bottom of 10 x 6 x 1/2-inch baking dish. Arrange bacon and mushrooms over spinach. Sprinkle with dash of pepper and marjoram. Bake at 325° for 15 minutes. Cover with sour cream and cheese. Return to oven 5 minutes or until cheese melts. Serves 6.

recipes.title: Cranberry-Apple Salad
directions: Grate orange peel on coarse grater to make long shreds, about 2 tablespoons (optional).
Peel oranges; cut oranges into 1/2-inch cubes.
Wash and drain cranberries; remove any stems.
Using blender, chop cranberries.
In medium bowl, combine the grated orange peel, cubed oranges, cranberries and sugar; mix well. Refrigerate until well chilled, several hours.
recipes.text: Cranberry-Apple Salad. Grate orange peel on coarse grater to make long shreds, about 2 tablespoons (optional). Peel oranges; cut oranges into 1/2-inch cubes. Wash and drain cranberries; remove any stems. Using blender, chop cranberries. In medium bowl, combine the grated orange peel, cubed oranges, cranberries and sugar; mix well. Refrigerate until well chilled, several hours.

recipes.title: Cherry Glazed Pork Roast
ingredients: 5 to 6 lb. boneless pork loin roast, rolled and tied
directions: Place roast on rack in shallow roasting pan.
Cook uncovered in 325°
oven for 2 1/2 hours or until meat thermometer registers 170°.
recipes.text: Cherry Glazed Pork Roast. Place roast on rack in shallow roasting pan. Cook uncovered in 325° oven for 2 1/2 hours or until meat thermometer registers 170°.

recipes.title: Chocolate Pudding
directions: Mix sugar,
cocoa and flour well.
Separate eggs and add yolks to
mixture.
Slowly
add the water and mix until smooth. Cook in top
of
double
boiler until thick.
Pour into baking dish.
recipes.text: Chocolate Pudding. Mix sugar, cocoa and flour well. Separate eggs and add yolks to mixture. Slowly add the water and mix until smooth. Cook in top of double boiler until thick. Pour into baking dish.

recipes.title: Colcannon With Kale Or Spinach
ingredients: 3 c. cut kale or 1 pkg. spinach
directions: Preheat oven to hot (400°).
Peel potatoes; cut into quarters. Place in saucepan with water and salt.
Cover and cook 15 to 20 minutes until potatoes are tender.
Drain and mash.
recipes.text: Colcannon With Kale Or Spinach. Preheat oven to hot (400°). Peel potatoes; cut into quarters. Place in saucepan with water and salt. Cover and cook 15 to 20 minutes until potatoes are tender. Drain and mash.

recipes.title: Potato Salad
ingredients: 7 medium potatoes, diced to equal 6 c.
1/3 c. sliced green onions and tops
directions: Cook potatoes; drain.
Add Italian dressing, toss lightly and chill 2 hours.
recipes.text: Potato Salad. Cook potatoes; drain. Add Italian dressing, toss lightly and chill 2 hours.

recipes.title: Spiced Lentils
ingredients: freshly grated black pepper to taste
directions: Cook the lentils in 2 1/4 cups water (bring to boil, cover and lower heat to simmer) 30 to 40 minutes or until tender.
Meanwhile, cook everything else (except the apples) until tender, in deep heavy skillet, adding water if necessary to avoid sticking.
Add apples to the saute; cook 10 minutes more (covered) and then combine this mixture with the lentils in a casserole.
Cover and keep warm in a 250° oven.
Serves 4 to 6 folks.
recipes.text: Spiced Lentils. Cook the lentils in 2 1/4 cups water (bring to boil, cover and lower heat to simmer) 30 to 40 minutes or until tender. Meanwhile, cook everything else (except the apples) until tender, in deep heavy skillet, adding water if necessary to avoid sticking. Add apples to the saute; cook 10 minutes more (covered) and then combine this mixture with the lentils in a casserole. Cover and keep warm in a 250° oven. Serves 4 to 6 folks.

recipes.title: Kapusta(Polish Sauerkraut With Spareribs)
ingredients: 4 to 5 cut up potatoes (depending on how much you like potatoes)
directions: Put spareribs in a large Dutch oven or soup pot.
Cover with water; add bay leaves and garlic.
Boil and simmer 1 hour.
Wash sauerkraut well.
Drain some of water off the ribs (most of it) and put sauerkraut in with ribs and remaining water.
Add 1 chopped onion and the mushrooms.
Let simmer all day (at least 3 to 4 hours).
Add bacon, flour and potatoes and let simmer about 1 hour longer.
Polish sausage may also be added at this time.
recipes.text: Kapusta(Polish Sauerkraut With Spareribs). Put spareribs in a large Dutch oven or soup pot. Cover with water; add bay leaves and garlic. Boil and simmer 1 hour. Wash sauerkraut well. Drain some of water off the ribs (most of it) and put sauerkraut in with ribs and remaining water. Add 1 chopped onion and the mushrooms. Let simmer all day (at least 3 to 4 hours). Add bacon, flour and potatoes and let simmer about 1 hour longer. Polish sausage may also be added at this time.

recipes.title: Stir-Fried Shrimp With Broccoli
ingredients: 1 lb. large shrimp, shelled and deveined
1 lb. fresh broccoli, cut into small pieces
directions: Heat oil in large skillet over high heat.
Add green onions, ginger and garlic.
Stir-fry about 1 minute.
Add shrimp and stir-fry until shrimp turn pink, about 3 minutes.
Add broccoli and stir-fry about 5 minutes.
Combine remaining ingredients in small bowl; mix well.
Pour over shrimp-broccoli mixture.
Cook and stir until sauce boils and thickens, about 2 minutes more.
recipes.text: Stir-Fried Shrimp With Broccoli. Heat oil in large skillet over high heat. Add green onions, ginger and garlic. Stir-fry about 1 minute. Add shrimp and stir-fry until shrimp turn pink, about 3 minutes. Add broccoli and stir-fry about 5 minutes. Combine remaining ingredients in small bowl; mix well. Pour over shrimp-broccoli mixture. Cook and stir until sauce boils and thickens, about 2 minutes more.

recipes.title: Stuffed Bell Peppers
ingredients: 1 tsp. cumin powder or curry powder
directions: Halve the bell peppers and remove seeds.
Dip in boiling water for a minute and keep aside.
Boil the potatoes; peel and mash coarsely with a fork.
Chop tomatoes and slice the onions.
recipes.text: Stuffed Bell Peppers. Halve the bell peppers and remove seeds. Dip in boiling water for a minute and keep aside. Boil the potatoes; peel and mash coarsely with a fork. Chop tomatoes and slice the onions.

recipes.title: Squash Casserole
ingredients: 3 lb. yellow squash or 2 (16 oz.) pkg. frozen
directions: Cut up unpeeled squash.
Cook until tender; drain and mash. Add margarine and mix well.
Add all other ingredients.
Mix well. Pour into casserole dish and bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes or until golden brown.
recipes.text: Squash Casserole. Cut up unpeeled squash. Cook until tender; drain and mash. Add margarine and mix well. Add all other ingredients. Mix well. Pour into casserole dish and bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes or until golden brown.

recipes.title: Basil Chicken
directions: Place chicken breasts in slow cooker. Sprinkle with pepper and basil.	Spread soup on top of chicken. Arrange slices of green pepper and onion on top of soup. Cover and cook on low for 6 to 8 hours.
recipes.text: Basil Chicken. Place chicken breasts in slow cooker. Sprinkle with pepper and basil.	Spread soup on top of chicken. Arrange slices of green pepper and onion on top of soup. Cover and cook on low for 6 to 8 hours.

recipes.title: Strawberry Pecan Cake
directions: Cream oil, eggs and milk together.
Add cake mix and Jell-O already mixed together dry.
Add frozen strawberries, coconut and pecans.
Bake in well-greased and lightly floured 9 x 13-inch cake pan at 350° until it tests done.
recipes.text: Strawberry Pecan Cake. Cream oil, eggs and milk together. Add cake mix and Jell-O already mixed together dry. Add frozen strawberries, coconut and pecans. Bake in well-greased and lightly floured 9 x 13-inch cake pan at 350° until it tests done.

recipes.title: Impossible Pie
directions: Heat oven to 400°.
Bring a small amount of salted water to a boil.
Add broccoli.
Cover and cook 5 minutes.
Drain.
Mix broccoli, cheese, onion and green pepper; put in a greased pie plate.
Beat remaining ingredients well.
Pour over broccoli mixture.
Bake 35 to 40 minutes or until a knife inserted comes out clean.
recipes.text: Impossible Pie. Heat oven to 400°. Bring a small amount of salted water to a boil. Add broccoli. Cover and cook 5 minutes. Drain. Mix broccoli, cheese, onion and green pepper; put in a greased pie plate. Beat remaining ingredients well. Pour over broccoli mixture. Bake 35 to 40 minutes or until a knife inserted comes out clean.

recipes.title: Caesar Salad
directions: Wash and cut lettuce in bite size pieces.
Mix oil, lemon juice, garlic, Worcestershire sauce and shake of m.s.g.
Pour on lettuce.
Sprinkle with cheese.
recipes.text: Caesar Salad. Wash and cut lettuce in bite size pieces. Mix oil, lemon juice, garlic, Worcestershire sauce and shake of m.s.g. Pour on lettuce. Sprinkle with cheese.

recipes.title: Molasses Crinkles
directions: Cream sugar and butter; add egg and molasses.
Mix well.
Add dry ingredients.
Chill about 1 hour.
Roll in 1-inch balls, then roll in granulated sugar.
Place on cookie sheet and press with damp fork.
Bake for 10 minutes or until slightly brown at 350°. Do not overbake.
recipes.text: Molasses Crinkles. Cream sugar and butter; add egg and molasses. Mix well. Add dry ingredients. Chill about 1 hour. Roll in 1-inch balls, then roll in granulated sugar. Place on cookie sheet and press with damp fork. Bake for 10 minutes or until slightly brown at 350°. Do not overbake.

recipes.title: Creative Dough(Kids' Play Dough)
directions: Cook all ingredients in 1 1/2-quart saucepan over medium heat for 4 to 5 minutes, stirring vigorously, until mixture forms a ball.
Remove dough from saucepan and let stand on counter 5 minutes.
Knead dough about 30 seconds or until smooth and blended. Cool completely.
Store in airtight container in refrigerator.
recipes.text: Creative Dough(Kids' Play Dough). Cook all ingredients in 1 1/2-quart saucepan over medium heat for 4 to 5 minutes, stirring vigorously, until mixture forms a ball. Remove dough from saucepan and let stand on counter 5 minutes. Knead dough about 30 seconds or until smooth and blended. Cool completely. Store in airtight container in refrigerator.

recipes.title: Cheese And Beef Casserole
directions: Brown meat; drain.
Stir in tomatoes, cheese, macaroni and seasoning.
Put in greased 2 1/2-quart casserole.
Melt margarine and add crumbs.
Top casserole with crumbs.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Cheese And Beef Casserole. Brown meat; drain. Stir in tomatoes, cheese, macaroni and seasoning. Put in greased 2 1/2-quart casserole. Melt margarine and add crumbs. Top casserole with crumbs. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Toffee Bars
ingredients: 1/2 c. semi-sweet chocolate or butterscotch chips
directions: Combine oats and brown sugar.
Blend in butter and syrup. Spread in 8-inch square pan.
Bake 10 minutes at 350° (??? minutes in a microwave).
Cool
recipes.text: Toffee Bars. Combine oats and brown sugar. Blend in butter and syrup. Spread in 8-inch square pan. Bake 10 minutes at 350° (??? minutes in a microwave). Cool

recipes.title: Baked Pork Chops
directions: Season pork chops
with salt and pepper. Dip in beaten egg and then cornflake crumbs. Bake in lightly greased pan at 350 for 45 - 50 minutes or until done.
recipes.text: Baked Pork Chops. Season pork chops with salt and pepper. Dip in beaten egg and then cornflake crumbs. Bake in lightly greased pan at 350 for 45 - 50 minutes or until done.

recipes.title: Turtle Cake
directions: Mix the German chocolate cake mix with the evaporated milk and butter.
Pour 1/2 of this batter into a 13 x 9-inch lightly greased cake pan.
Bake in a preheated 350° oven for 5 to 6 minutes.
recipes.text: Turtle Cake. Mix the German chocolate cake mix with the evaporated milk and butter. Pour 1/2 of this batter into a 13 x 9-inch lightly greased cake pan. Bake in a preheated 350° oven for 5 to 6 minutes.

recipes.title: Marinara Sauce
directions: Place all ingredients in crock-pot.
Cook on low 6 to 8 hours.
recipes.text: Marinara Sauce. Place all ingredients in crock-pot. Cook on low 6 to 8 hours.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Pie
