directions: Mix peanut butter and confectioners sugar and crumble together.
Cook next four ingredients until thick and then add margarine and vanilla.
Add powdered sugar and peanut butter mixture to the saucepan and stir until the mixture is dissolved. Pour
in pie shell.
Beat egg whites until stiff and sweeten. Pour egg white mixture over pie and cook 10 minutes at 350° or until golden brown.
recipes.text: Peanut Butter Pie. Mix peanut butter and confectioners sugar and crumble together. Cook next four ingredients until thick and then add margarine and vanilla. Add powdered sugar and peanut butter mixture to the saucepan and stir until the mixture is dissolved. Pour in pie shell. Beat egg whites until stiff and sweeten. Pour egg white mixture over pie and cook 10 minutes at 350° or until golden brown.

recipes.title: Almond Bread Pudding
directions: Break up bread into pieces. Cover with half and half. Let stand 1 hour.
recipes.text: Almond Bread Pudding. Break up bread into pieces. Cover with half and half. Let stand 1 hour.

recipes.title: Microwave Cracker Jacks
directions: Put brown sugar, white syrup, butter and salt in bowl and boil in microwave for 2 minutes.
Take out.
Add 1/2 teaspoon baking soda.
Stir well.
Spray a brown paper bag well with Pam.
Put 1 gallon popped corn in bag.
Pour in syrup mixture.
Microwave on High for 1 1/2 minutes.
Take out and shake well.
Put in for another 1 1/2 minutes on High.
Take out and shake well.
Put back in for 1/2 minute on High.
Take out, shake well and put on cookie sheet to cool.
recipes.text: Microwave Cracker Jacks. Put brown sugar, white syrup, butter and salt in bowl and boil in microwave for 2 minutes. Take out. Add 1/2 teaspoon baking soda. Stir well. Spray a brown paper bag well with Pam. Put 1 gallon popped corn in bag. Pour in syrup mixture. Microwave on High for 1 1/2 minutes. Take out and shake well. Put in for another 1 1/2 minutes on High. Take out and shake well. Put back in for 1/2 minute on High. Take out, shake well and put on cookie sheet to cool.

recipes.title: Kathy Levine'S Sweet And Sour Chicken
ingredients: 6 chicken breasts, cut into bite-sized pieces and breaded for frying
2 (13 oz.) cans pineapple chunks, drain and reserve juice
directions: Brown chicken, in T-Fal wok.
Mix in separate saucepan brown sugar, vinegar, lemon juice, soy sauce, cornstarch.
Cook until thickened.
Add pineapple juice and enough water to make one quart; stir, add pineapple.
Add mushrooms, green peppers, onions to mixture.
Add the mixture to the chicken in ovenware baking pan. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Kathy Levine'S Sweet And Sour Chicken. Brown chicken, in T-Fal wok. Mix in separate saucepan brown sugar, vinegar, lemon juice, soy sauce, cornstarch. Cook until thickened. Add pineapple juice and enough water to make one quart; stir, add pineapple. Add mushrooms, green peppers, onions to mixture. Add the mixture to the chicken in ovenware baking pan. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Squares
directions: Preheat oven to 350°.
Combine dry cake mix, oil, salt and baking soda.
Mixture will be crumbly.
Press evenly in ungreased 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan.
Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes or until crust is browned at edges.
Meanwhile, prepare pie filling recipe as directed on can.
Pour over hot baked crust.
Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes or until center is firm.
Cool.
Garnish with dollops of whipped topping.
recipes.text: Pumpkin Squares. Preheat oven to 350°. Combine dry cake mix, oil, salt and baking soda. Mixture will be crumbly. Press evenly in ungreased 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes or until crust is browned at edges. Meanwhile, prepare pie filling recipe as directed on can. Pour over hot baked crust. Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes or until center is firm. Cool. Garnish with dollops of whipped topping.

recipes.title: Barbecue Meatballs
directions: Moisten bread crumbs with milk.
Combine with ground beef, salt and pepper.
Shape mixture into balls.
Place in baking dish. Combine remaining ingredients to make barbecue sauce.
Pour over meatballs.
Bake, uncovered, for 45 minutes at 375°.
recipes.text: Barbecue Meatballs. Moisten bread crumbs with milk. Combine with ground beef, salt and pepper. Shape mixture into balls. Place in baking dish. Combine remaining ingredients to make barbecue sauce. Pour over meatballs. Bake, uncovered, for 45 minutes at 375°.

recipes.title: Copper Pennies
directions: Peel and slice carrots.
Boil 5 minutes in salted water until tender but not mushy.
Mix other ingredients and pour over warm carrots (after draining).
Stir well, then refrigerate.
Last up to one week in refrigerator.
Yields 8 servings.
recipes.text: Copper Pennies. Peel and slice carrots. Boil 5 minutes in salted water until tender but not mushy. Mix other ingredients and pour over warm carrots (after draining). Stir well, then refrigerate. Last up to one week in refrigerator. Yields 8 servings.

recipes.title: Oriental Skillet Supper
ingredients: 1 lb. round steak, cut into thin strips
directions: In skillet, heat oil and brown steak; drain.
Add soup and garlic powder with water.
Simmer, covered, stirring occasionally, for 20 minutes.
Add zucchini and onion; simmer, covered, 10 minutes or until zucchini is crisp and tender.
Serve over rice.
recipes.text: Oriental Skillet Supper. In skillet, heat oil and brown steak; drain. Add soup and garlic powder with water. Simmer, covered, stirring occasionally, for 20 minutes. Add zucchini and onion; simmer, covered, 10 minutes or until zucchini is crisp and tender. Serve over rice.

recipes.title: Crab-Asparagus Pate
ingredients: 1 1/2 c. canned asparagus cuts and tips, reserving 2 Tbsp. liquid
directions: Drain asparagus; puree in blender.
Soften gelatin using the 2 tablespoons liquid and 2 tablespoons lemon juice.
Heat soup and cheese together over low heat, stirring until smooth.
Add remaining ingredients; heat until gelatin melts.
Put in mold. (Entire mixture fits in a 2-quart mold or can be broken down into smaller ones.)
Enjoy!
recipes.text: Crab-Asparagus Pate. Drain asparagus; puree in blender. Soften gelatin using the 2 tablespoons liquid and 2 tablespoons lemon juice. Heat soup and cheese together over low heat, stirring until smooth. Add remaining ingredients; heat until gelatin melts. Put in mold. (Entire mixture fits in a 2-quart mold or can be broken down into smaller ones.) Enjoy!

recipes.title: Cheese-Mushroom Strata
directions: In large bowl, beat together eggs, broth, sour cream and mustard.
Stir in bread cubes, cheese and mushrooms.
Pour into greased 2-quart oval baking dish.
Cover; refrigerate overnight. Bake at 350° for 50 to 60 minutes.
recipes.text: Cheese-Mushroom Strata. In large bowl, beat together eggs, broth, sour cream and mustard. Stir in bread cubes, cheese and mushrooms. Pour into greased 2-quart oval baking dish. Cover; refrigerate overnight. Bake at 350° for 50 to 60 minutes.

recipes.title: Pudding Mixture
directions: Add dry ingredients to pudding mixture.
Add milk.
Cook, then add vanilla.
recipes.text: Pudding Mixture. Add dry ingredients to pudding mixture. Add milk. Cook, then add vanilla.

recipes.title: Dirt Dessert
directions: Blend cream cheese, pudding, sugar and milk.
Fold in Cool Whip.
Layer pudding mixture, then cookies (crushed), then pudding mixture, ending with cookies.
Layer in a plastic plant pot. Cover with gummy worms or plastic flowers.
recipes.text: Dirt Dessert. Blend cream cheese, pudding, sugar and milk. Fold in Cool Whip. Layer pudding mixture, then cookies (crushed), then pudding mixture, ending with cookies. Layer in a plastic plant pot. Cover with gummy worms or plastic flowers.

recipes.title: Basic Pie Crust(For Single-Crust Pie)
directions: Combine flour and salt in medium bowl. Place shortening on top and using pastry blender, cut shortening into flour until particles are about size of small peas or coarse meal. Sprinkle cold water, 1 tablespoon at a time, over flour-shortening mixture, tossing lightly with fork to distribute liquid evenly. Form pastry into ball using hands. Roll out immediately or chill 30 minutes to 2 days. Makes crust for 1 single-crust pie.
recipes.text: Basic Pie Crust(For Single-Crust Pie). Combine flour and salt in medium bowl. Place shortening on top and using pastry blender, cut shortening into flour until particles are about size of small peas or coarse meal. Sprinkle cold water, 1 tablespoon at a time, over flour-shortening mixture, tossing lightly with fork to distribute liquid evenly. Form pastry into ball using hands. Roll out immediately or chill 30 minutes to 2 days. Makes crust for 1 single-crust pie.

recipes.title: Rice Krispies Balls
directions: Combine first 4 ingredients in a saucepan.
Cook until like a thin jam, about 10 minutes.
Remove from heat.
Add nuts and Rice Krispies.
Mix well.
Roll about 1 teaspoon at a time in coconut to form balls.
Cool and store in airtight container.
Makes 4 dozen.
recipes.text: Rice Krispies Balls. Combine first 4 ingredients in a saucepan. Cook until like a thin jam, about 10 minutes. Remove from heat. Add nuts and Rice Krispies. Mix well. Roll about 1 teaspoon at a time in coconut to form balls. Cool and store in airtight container. Makes 4 dozen.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Bread
directions: Grease bottom only of loaf pans.
Mix shortening and sugar in a large bowl.
Add eggs, pumpkin and water.
Blend in flour, soda, baking powder, cinnamon and cloves.
Stir in nuts and raisins.
recipes.text: Pumpkin Bread. Grease bottom only of loaf pans. Mix shortening and sugar in a large bowl. Add eggs, pumpkin and water. Blend in flour, soda, baking powder, cinnamon and cloves. Stir in nuts and raisins.

recipes.title: Broccoli Salad
ingredients: 8 slices bacon, fried crisp and broken up
1/2 c. mayonnaise to which has been added 2 Tbsp. sugar and 1 Tbsp. vinegar
directions: Mix and chill until ready to serve.
recipes.text: Broccoli Salad. Mix and chill until ready to serve.

recipes.title: Coconut Cake
directions: Combine sour cream, coconut and sugar and let set overnight in refrigerator.
The next day, make cake mix as directed on package, make 2 layers.
When cool, split each layer in half.
Put 1 cup of sour cream and coconut mixture aside.
Put the rest on each layer of cake except for the sides and top layer.
Combine the sour cream and coconut mixture with the Cool Whip and spread on sides and top of cake.
Refrigerate.
recipes.text: Coconut Cake. Combine sour cream, coconut and sugar and let set overnight in refrigerator. The next day, make cake mix as directed on package, make 2 layers. When cool, split each layer in half. Put 1 cup of sour cream and coconut mixture aside. Put the rest on each layer of cake except for the sides and top layer. Combine the sour cream and coconut mixture with the Cool Whip and spread on sides and top of cake. Refrigerate.

recipes.title: Pineapple Upside Down Cake
directions: Preheat oven 375°.
Before making cake batter prepare cake topping.
In a 13-inch by 9-inch baking pan place butter.
Place pan in oven until butter melts.
Sprinkle brown sugar over butter. Drain pineapple chunks.
Use pineapple in sugar mixture.
Prepare cake batter as recipe directs, and carefully spoon over design in baking pan.
Bake 35-40 minutes until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean.
Cool in pan on wire rack 10 minutes.
Then loosen cake from side of pan; place platter on top of pan, and invert both lift off pan.
recipes.text: Pineapple Upside Down Cake. Preheat oven 375°. Before making cake batter prepare cake topping. In a 13-inch by 9-inch baking pan place butter. Place pan in oven until butter melts. Sprinkle brown sugar over butter. Drain pineapple chunks. Use pineapple in sugar mixture. Prepare cake batter as recipe directs, and carefully spoon over design in baking pan. Bake 35-40 minutes until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean. Cool in pan on wire rack 10 minutes. Then loosen cake from side of pan; place platter on top of pan, and invert both lift off pan.

recipes.title: Beef Tips And Rice
ingredients: 1 1/2 lb. beef strips (sirloin or top round)
1/4 c. cornstarch, mixed in 1/2 c. water
directions: Brown beef (cut in 1/2-inch strips) in oil. Add onions.
Cover and let cook about 30 to 40 minutes.
Add garlic, water and cornstarch.
Let simmer 30 minutes more.
Now add mushrooms and heat well. Serve over the rice.
recipes.text: Beef Tips And Rice. Brown beef (cut in 1/2-inch strips) in oil. Add onions. Cover and let cook about 30 to 40 minutes. Add garlic, water and cornstarch. Let simmer 30 minutes more. Now add mushrooms and heat well. Serve over the rice.

recipes.title: Date Nut Bran Muffins(Makes 5 Dozen)
directions: Sift together flour, sugar, baking soda and salt.
Set aside. Combine remaining ingredients in 6-quart bowl.
Mix well.
Add dry ingredients, stirring just enough to moisten.
Fill greased muffin tins 2/3 full.
Bake at 400° for 20 minutes.
recipes.text: Date Nut Bran Muffins(Makes 5 Dozen). Sift together flour, sugar, baking soda and salt. Set aside. Combine remaining ingredients in 6-quart bowl. Mix well. Add dry ingredients, stirring just enough to moisten. Fill greased muffin tins 2/3 full. Bake at 400° for 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Company Eggs(Recipe From Bill Banks)
directions: Cube bread.
Place bread in buttered (greased) 9 x 13-inch pan.
Add cheese on top.
Beat eggs well and add milk, salt, pepper and mustard.
Pour over bread and cheese.
Refrigerate overnight.
Bake 1 to 1 1/2 hours at 325° to 350°.
May add chopped ham, dried beef or bacon chips.
recipes.text: Company Eggs(Recipe From Bill Banks). Cube bread. Place bread in buttered (greased) 9 x 13-inch pan. Add cheese on top. Beat eggs well and add milk, salt, pepper and mustard. Pour over bread and cheese. Refrigerate overnight. Bake 1 to 1 1/2 hours at 325° to 350°. May add chopped ham, dried beef or bacon chips.

recipes.title: Wild Rice-Chicken Casserole
ingredients: 1 c. mayonnaise or 3/4 c. mayonnaise and 1/4 c. chicken broth
1 can chicken broth or 1 (14 1/2 oz.) can chicken broth
1 pkg. Uncle Ben's wild rice (do not cook) and seasoning packet
directions: Mix all ingredients together.
Pour into a 2-quart casserole dish.
Bake, uncovered, at 325° for 30 minutes, then cover and bake 30 more minutes.
recipes.text: Wild Rice-Chicken Casserole. Mix all ingredients together. Pour into a 2-quart casserole dish. Bake, uncovered, at 325° for 30 minutes, then cover and bake 30 more minutes.

recipes.title: Watergate Salad
directions: Combine pineapple (undrained) in a large bowl with dry pudding.
Gradually stir in Cool Whip.
Add marshmallows and nuts. Refrigerate.
Can be frozen for later use.
recipes.text: Watergate Salad. Combine pineapple (undrained) in a large bowl with dry pudding. Gradually stir in Cool Whip. Add marshmallows and nuts. Refrigerate. Can be frozen for later use.

recipes.title: Lemon Dessert
directions: Dissolve jello in boiling water.
Mix cream cheese, sugar and vanilla.
Whip the can of milk.
Line 9 x 13-inch pan with graham cracker crust (mix crumbs with butter, then line pan with mixture).
Add cheese to warm jello.
Chill until slightly thickened.
Fold in milk (that has been whipped).
Pour into pan and chill.
Top with cherry pie filling if desired.
recipes.text: Lemon Dessert. Dissolve jello in boiling water. Mix cream cheese, sugar and vanilla. Whip the can of milk. Line 9 x 13-inch pan with graham cracker crust (mix crumbs with butter, then line pan with mixture). Add cheese to warm jello. Chill until slightly thickened. Fold in milk (that has been whipped). Pour into pan and chill. Top with cherry pie filling if desired.

recipes.title: Banana Cake
directions: Cream butter until light and fluffy.
Beat the sugar in gradually.
Add eggs and beat thoroughly.
Add the bananas and the vanilla.
Sift together flour, baking soda and salt.
Add the flour mixture to the butter mixture alternately with the milk. Spoon into a greased 13 x 9-inch pan and bake at 350° for 45 minutes.
Serve with whipped cream on top.
recipes.text: Banana Cake. Cream butter until light and fluffy. Beat the sugar in gradually. Add eggs and beat thoroughly. Add the bananas and the vanilla. Sift together flour, baking soda and salt. Add the flour mixture to the butter mixture alternately with the milk. Spoon into a greased 13 x 9-inch pan and bake at 350° for 45 minutes. Serve with whipped cream on top.

recipes.title: Crock-Pot Pepper Steak
directions: Cut steak in strips.
Mix flour, salt and pepper in a bag; shake steaks.
Put in crock-pot.
Pour the remaining flour mixture on top.
Add all other ingredients.
Cover and turn crock-pot to high for 1 hour.
Reduce to low and cook for 9 to 10 hours. Serves 4 to 6.
recipes.text: Crock-Pot Pepper Steak. Cut steak in strips. Mix flour, salt and pepper in a bag; shake steaks. Put in crock-pot. Pour the remaining flour mixture on top. Add all other ingredients. Cover and turn crock-pot to high for 1 hour. Reduce to low and cook for 9 to 10 hours. Serves 4 to 6.

recipes.title: Grandma Alexander'S Oatmeal Cake
directions: Stir butter, oatmeal and boiling water together; let stand 20 minutes.
Combine remaining ingredients together; add oatmeal mix and stir well.
Pour into greased pan and bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until done.
recipes.text: Grandma Alexander'S Oatmeal Cake. Stir butter, oatmeal and boiling water together; let stand 20 minutes. Combine remaining ingredients together; add oatmeal mix and stir well. Pour into greased pan and bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until done.

recipes.title: Taco Puffs
ingredients: 1 lb. cooked ground beef, seasoned with taco seasoning
directions: Combine cooked beef, taco seasoning and shredded cheese.
Peel each biscuit apart, making 3 thin biscuits out of each.
Place 1 tablespoon of mixture on each biscuit.
Fold in half.
Pinch edges to seal.
Shape into crescents.
Cook in oil; drain.
Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese.
Serve hot with salsa.
recipes.text: Taco Puffs. Combine cooked beef, taco seasoning and shredded cheese. Peel each biscuit apart, making 3 thin biscuits out of each. Place 1 tablespoon of mixture on each biscuit. Fold in half. Pinch edges to seal. Shape into crescents. Cook in oil; drain. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Serve hot with salsa.

recipes.title: Sauerkraut Salad
directions: Drain and wash sauerkraut under cold water.
Squeeze and pull apart.
Wash again and squeeze and rinse until all of canned water is out.
Mix rest of ingredients together with sauerkraut.
Chill overnight.
Keep in glass container in refrigerator.
recipes.text: Sauerkraut Salad. Drain and wash sauerkraut under cold water. Squeeze and pull apart. Wash again and squeeze and rinse until all of canned water is out. Mix rest of ingredients together with sauerkraut. Chill overnight. Keep in glass container in refrigerator.

recipes.title: Squash Casserole
directions: Cream together egg and mushroom soup.
Cut up squash; cook until tender and all the water has cooked out of them.
Add margarine (1/2 of margarine), salt, pepper, onion and mushroom soup with egg mixture.
Let cook a little longer.
Pour into casserole dish (spray with Pam).
Crush enough Ritz crackers to cover top and melt margarine (1/2 stick) and pour over top.
Cook at 350° for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Squash Casserole. Cream together egg and mushroom soup. Cut up squash; cook until tender and all the water has cooked out of them. Add margarine (1/2 of margarine), salt, pepper, onion and mushroom soup with egg mixture. Let cook a little longer. Pour into casserole dish (spray with Pam). Crush enough Ritz crackers to cover top and melt margarine (1/2 stick) and pour over top. Cook at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Hamburger Casserole
directions: Cook macaroni and cheese according to package directions. Brown hamburger meat
and add onion.
Drain.
Mix macaroni and cheese and browned hamburger meat.
Place in an ungreased casserole dish.
Spread cheese over top and bake at 350° for 20 minutes or until cheese is melted.
Good with cornbread and green salad.
recipes.text: Hamburger Casserole. Cook macaroni and cheese according to package directions. Brown hamburger meat and add onion. Drain. Mix macaroni and cheese and browned hamburger meat. Place in an ungreased casserole dish. Spread cheese over top and bake at 350° for 20 minutes or until cheese is melted. Good with cornbread and green salad.

recipes.title: Chicken Supreme
directions: Combine all ingredients and turn into shallow baking pan. Sprinkle with the Crumb Topping and bake 45 minutes at 350°.
recipes.text: Chicken Supreme. Combine all ingredients and turn into shallow baking pan. Sprinkle with the Crumb Topping and bake 45 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Goof Balls
directions: Heat just to boiling the Karo syrup and sugar.
Take off heat and add peanut butter.
Mix well.
Add Rice Krispies.
Form into balls and let cool.
recipes.text: Goof Balls. Heat just to boiling the Karo syrup and sugar. Take off heat and add peanut butter. Mix well. Add Rice Krispies. Form into balls and let cool.

recipes.title: Quick Beef Stroganoff
directions: Brown hamburger; add mushrooms, soup and seasonings. Cook noodles as stated on package. Simmer hamburger mixture for about 15 to 30 minutes. Add sour cream 10 minutes before serving. Serve over noodles.
recipes.text: Quick Beef Stroganoff. Brown hamburger; add mushrooms, soup and seasonings. Cook noodles as stated on package. Simmer hamburger mixture for about 15 to 30 minutes. Add sour cream 10 minutes before serving. Serve over noodles.

recipes.title: Baked Eggplant
directions: Peel eggplant and cut into cubes.
Add tomatoes to raw eggplant and cook slowly in saucepan until tender.
Remove from heat and add other ingredients using enough crackers to take up moisture.
Bake in large casserole in a 350° oven for about 45 minutes.
Serves 6.
recipes.text: Baked Eggplant. Peel eggplant and cut into cubes. Add tomatoes to raw eggplant and cook slowly in saucepan until tender. Remove from heat and add other ingredients using enough crackers to take up moisture. Bake in large casserole in a 350° oven for about 45 minutes. Serves 6.

recipes.title: Foolproof Beef And Broccoli
ingredients: 3/4 lb. steak, cut in bite size pieces
directions: Brown steak with vegetable oil.
Add all ingredients to skillet except noodles or rice.
Cook until bubbly on medium heat. Simmer 5 minutes on low heat.
Serve over noodles or rice.
recipes.text: Foolproof Beef And Broccoli. Brown steak with vegetable oil. Add all ingredients to skillet except noodles or rice. Cook until bubbly on medium heat. Simmer 5 minutes on low heat. Serve over noodles or rice.

recipes.title: Chocolate Dessert
directions: Heat chocolate chips over hot water; add beaten egg yolks. Whip egg whites with dab of salt.
Add sugar.
Add chocolate and egg yolk mixture to whites.
Fold in Cool Whip.
Break cake up into small pieces.
Put layer of cake in bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan. Pour 1/2 of chocolate mixture over cake.
Repeat layers.
Chill. Dessert is better if it sits in refrigerator overnight.
recipes.text: Chocolate Dessert. Heat chocolate chips over hot water; add beaten egg yolks. Whip egg whites with dab of salt. Add sugar. Add chocolate and egg yolk mixture to whites. Fold in Cool Whip. Break cake up into small pieces. Put layer of cake in bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan. Pour 1/2 of chocolate mixture over cake. Repeat layers. Chill. Dessert is better if it sits in refrigerator overnight.

recipes.title: Pineapple Fruit Compote
directions: Mix the sugar and melted oleo; add flour, stirring until smooth.
Add juice and pineapple chunks.
Top with grated cheese. Crumble Ritz crackers over to cover evenly.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
Good with baked ham.
recipes.text: Pineapple Fruit Compote. Mix the sugar and melted oleo; add flour, stirring until smooth. Add juice and pineapple chunks. Top with grated cheese. Crumble Ritz crackers over to cover evenly. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes. Good with baked ham.

recipes.title: Honey Cake From Egypt
directions: Blend together butter and honey. Beat until fluffy. Beat in eggs. Mix together 1/2 teaspoon each cinnamon, nutmeg and mace, chopped dates or raisins, nuts and whole-wheat flour. Add to honey mixture.
Pour into lightly oiled baking pan. Bake at 325° for 20 to 30 minutes. When cool, cut into 12 strips.
recipes.text: Honey Cake From Egypt. Blend together butter and honey. Beat until fluffy. Beat in eggs. Mix together 1/2 teaspoon each cinnamon, nutmeg and mace, chopped dates or raisins, nuts and whole-wheat flour. Add to honey mixture. Pour into lightly oiled baking pan. Bake at 325° for 20 to 30 minutes. When cool, cut into 12 strips.

recipes.title: Chicken Or Turkey Casserole(Serves 12 To 15)
ingredients: 1 small can Pet milk or 1/2 c. milk
directions: Mix and put in 13 x 11-inch casserole.
Refrigerate overnight. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
Put buttered crumbs on top of casserole the last 15 minutes.
recipes.text: Chicken Or Turkey Casserole(Serves 12 To 15). Mix and put in 13 x 11-inch casserole. Refrigerate overnight. Bake at 350° for 1 hour. Put buttered crumbs on top of casserole the last 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Chocolate Covered Cherries
ingredients: 1 (12 oz.) pkg. semi-sweet chocolate bits, melted
directions: Mix first 3 ingredients together.
Wrap around cherries. Refrigerate for 1 hour.
Melt wax and chocolate bits over medium heat until melted.
Dip cherries in chocolate.
recipes.text: Chocolate Covered Cherries. Mix first 3 ingredients together. Wrap around cherries. Refrigerate for 1 hour. Melt wax and chocolate bits over medium heat until melted. Dip cherries in chocolate.

recipes.title: Nacho Cheese Dip
directions: Depending on how hot desired, you can use different flavors (mild, hot, etc.).
recipes.text: Nacho Cheese Dip. Depending on how hot desired, you can use different flavors (mild, hot, etc.).

recipes.title: Shrimp And Crab Casserole
ingredients: 1 large pkg. cooked shrimp (salad or bite size)
1 large can crab meat or pkg. crab fingers, cut into small pieces
directions: Mix together.
Cook at 350° until it bubbles (about 30 minutes).
Mix buttered bread crumbs and Cheddar cheese and sprinkle on top.
Pop back in oven until cheese melts.
recipes.text: Shrimp And Crab Casserole. Mix together. Cook at 350° until it bubbles (about 30 minutes). Mix buttered bread crumbs and Cheddar cheese and sprinkle on top. Pop back in oven until cheese melts.

recipes.title: Hot Pineapple Salad
directions: In a 9 x 13-inch casserole dish, layer the drained pineapple, cream cheese and marshmallows.
In a saucepan, mix sugar, flour, eggs and drained juice; cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until thickened.
Mixture will be consistency of thin pudding.
Pour thickened sauce over pineapple mixture; top with cheese.
Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes until cheese is slightly brown around edges.
recipes.text: Hot Pineapple Salad. In a 9 x 13-inch casserole dish, layer the drained pineapple, cream cheese and marshmallows. In a saucepan, mix sugar, flour, eggs and drained juice; cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until thickened. Mixture will be consistency of thin pudding. Pour thickened sauce over pineapple mixture; top with cheese. Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes until cheese is slightly brown around edges.

recipes.title: Zucchini Fritters
directions: Mix all ingredients well.
Use nonstick skillet, well coated with spray.
Heat skillet.
Drop zucchini mixture by tablespoons into hot skillet.
Brown on both sides.
recipes.text: Zucchini Fritters. Mix all ingredients well. Use nonstick skillet, well coated with spray. Heat skillet. Drop zucchini mixture by tablespoons into hot skillet. Brown on both sides.

recipes.title: Poppy Seed Bread
directions: Mix all ingredients together.
Pour into 2 greased bread pans. Bake at 350°
for 30 to 40 minutes.
recipes.text: Poppy Seed Bread. Mix all ingredients together. Pour into 2 greased bread pans. Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Vegetable Bars
directions: Cover jelly roll pan with crescent rolls and bake at 350° until brown (7 to 8 minutes).
Cool 10 to 12 minutes.
recipes.text: Vegetable Bars. Cover jelly roll pan with crescent rolls and bake at 350° until brown (7 to 8 minutes). Cool 10 to 12 minutes.

recipes.title: Mama'S Banana Pudding
directions: Mix sugar, flour and eggs.
Add milk and vanilla.
Cook on low heat until it thickens.
Layer cookies and sliced bananas in a bowl.
Pour thickened hot pudding over cookies and bananas.
recipes.text: Mama'S Banana Pudding. Mix sugar, flour and eggs. Add milk and vanilla. Cook on low heat until it thickens. Layer cookies and sliced bananas in a bowl. Pour thickened hot pudding over cookies and bananas.

recipes.title: Baked Pears Delicious
ingredients: 4 pears, peeled, cored and halved lengthwise
1 c. Burgundy or other dry red wine
directions: Arrange pear halves, cut side down, in a 12 x 8 x 2-inch baking dish.
Set aside.
recipes.text: Baked Pears Delicious. Arrange pear halves, cut side down, in a 12 x 8 x 2-inch baking dish. Set aside.

recipes.title: Peach Alexander
ingredients: 1 medium fresh peach (canned or frozen may be used)
directions: Mix in blender and serve.
This will make 4 to 6 servings.
recipes.text: Peach Alexander. Mix in blender and serve. This will make 4 to 6 servings.

recipes.title: Cream Puffs
directions: Combine Crisco, butter and water; bring to a rolling boil. Add flour, all at once, stirring until mixture leaves the sides of the pan and forms a ball; cool slightly.
Add eggs, one at a time, beating well.
recipes.text: Cream Puffs. Combine Crisco, butter and water; bring to a rolling boil. Add flour, all at once, stirring until mixture leaves the sides of the pan and forms a ball; cool slightly. Add eggs, one at a time, beating well.

recipes.title: "I Can'T Cook" Chicken
directions: Preheat oven to 450°.
Remove excess fat from chicken.

Cut chicken in half from one side of breast to opposite side of back. Fold up wings and place bone side down on broiler (save inerds and cook separately or discard or cook on end of broiling pan). Sprinkle to taste with garlic salt and pepper.
Put on rack in middle of oven; cook for 15 to 20 minutes (until nice golden brown).
Reduce heat to 350° and cook 45 minutes to 1 hour.
recipes.text: "I Can'T Cook" Chicken. Preheat oven to 450°. Remove excess fat from chicken. Cut chicken in half from one side of breast to opposite side of back. Fold up wings and place bone side down on broiler (save inerds and cook separately or discard or cook on end of broiling pan). Sprinkle to taste with garlic salt and pepper. Put on rack in middle of oven; cook for 15 to 20 minutes (until nice golden brown). Reduce heat to 350° and cook 45 minutes to 1 hour.

recipes.title: Walnut Bread
directions: Cream butter and sugar until fully blended.
Slowly beat in eggs.
Sift flour, salt and soda.
Add to egg mixture.
Blend in nuts, vanilla and sour cream.
Pour batter into 2 greased and floured loaf pans.
Bake at 350° for 45 to 60 minutes.
Cool in pans, then invert onto wire racks.
recipes.text: Walnut Bread. Cream butter and sugar until fully blended. Slowly beat in eggs. Sift flour, salt and soda. Add to egg mixture. Blend in nuts, vanilla and sour cream. Pour batter into 2 greased and floured loaf pans. Bake at 350° for 45 to 60 minutes. Cool in pans, then invert onto wire racks.

recipes.title: Apple Crumble
directions: Peel and slice apples.
Place apples in pan.
Sprinkle with cinnamon.
Add sugar and lemon juice.
Mix flour, butter and brown sugar.
Crumble this mixture over apples.
Bake at 350° until lightly browned.
Serve with whipped cream.
recipes.text: Apple Crumble. Peel and slice apples. Place apples in pan. Sprinkle with cinnamon. Add sugar and lemon juice. Mix flour, butter and brown sugar. Crumble this mixture over apples. Bake at 350° until lightly browned. Serve with whipped cream.

recipes.title: Italian Cream Cake
directions: Beat egg whites until stiff and set aside.
Mix egg yolks and remaining ingredients together in order listed.
Beat well.
Fold in stiffly beaten egg whites.
Place in Bundt pan.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Italian Cream Cake. Beat egg whites until stiff and set aside. Mix egg yolks and remaining ingredients together in order listed. Beat well. Fold in stiffly beaten egg whites. Place in Bundt pan. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Poppy Seed Bread
directions: Mix together first three ingredients with hot water, add eggs and blend well.
Add poppy seed last.
Bake at 350° until browned or pick comes out clean.
recipes.text: Poppy Seed Bread. Mix together first three ingredients with hot water, add eggs and blend well. Add poppy seed last. Bake at 350° until browned or pick comes out clean.

recipes.title: Fudge Squares Irresistible
directions: Beat eggs.
Add sugar, melted butter, melted chocolate, vanilla and salt.
Beat well.
Then add flour and nuts.
Pour in greased shallow pan and bake in moderate oven about 25 minutes. Cut in squares while warm.
recipes.text: Fudge Squares Irresistible. Beat eggs. Add sugar, melted butter, melted chocolate, vanilla and salt. Beat well. Then add flour and nuts. Pour in greased shallow pan and bake in moderate oven about 25 minutes. Cut in squares while warm.

recipes.title: Cheesy Broccoli Casserole
directions: Steam broccoli and drain.
Put half of it into a casserole dish.
Beat 1 egg until light, add undiluted mushroom soup and mayonnaise; mix well.
Pour 1/2 of this mixture over broccoli in the casserole and also half of the grated cheese.
Repeat with layers of broccoli mixture and cheese.
Melt 1/4 cup butter.
Mix with crumbled crackers and sprinkle over entire casserole.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until bubbly.
Recipe can be doubled.
recipes.text: Cheesy Broccoli Casserole. Steam broccoli and drain. Put half of it into a casserole dish. Beat 1 egg until light, add undiluted mushroom soup and mayonnaise; mix well. Pour 1/2 of this mixture over broccoli in the casserole and also half of the grated cheese. Repeat with layers of broccoli mixture and cheese. Melt 1/4 cup butter. Mix with crumbled crackers and sprinkle over entire casserole. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until bubbly. Recipe can be doubled.

recipes.title: Strawberry Glace Pie
directions: To 3 cups of whole large hulled berries, add 1/2 cup sugar. Let stand 1 hour.
Cut remaining berries in pieces.
Put in a small saucepan and add 3/4 cup of water.
Simmer 3 to 4 minutes. Combine the cornstarch and 1 cup sugar.
Mix well. Add to simmering berries. Cook until mixture is thick and clear, stirring constantly. Remove from heat.
Add lemon juice and 3 drops red food coloring.
Cool. Stand whole berries, cut side down, in pie crust.
Cover with cooled sauce. Chill thoroughly. Decorate with border of sweetened whipped cream.
recipes.text: Strawberry Glace Pie. To 3 cups of whole large hulled berries, add 1/2 cup sugar. Let stand 1 hour. Cut remaining berries in pieces. Put in a small saucepan and add 3/4 cup of water. Simmer 3 to 4 minutes. Combine the cornstarch and 1 cup sugar. Mix well. Add to simmering berries. Cook until mixture is thick and clear, stirring constantly. Remove from heat. Add lemon juice and 3 drops red food coloring. Cool. Stand whole berries, cut side down, in pie crust. Cover with cooled sauce. Chill thoroughly. Decorate with border of sweetened whipped cream.

recipes.title: Chicken Casserole
directions: Combine all ingredients, except cheese and potato chips.
Put in large baking dish.
Sprinkle cheese on top and add potato chips.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Chicken Casserole. Combine all ingredients, except cheese and potato chips. Put in large baking dish. Sprinkle cheese on top and add potato chips. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Baked Broccoli And Cheese
directions: Day before:
Cook broccoli and drain.
Mix eggs, soup, mayonnaise, onion and 3/4 of cheese.
Add broccoli and mix well. Pour into a 1 1/2-quart casserole.
Cover top lightly with breadcrumbs.
Sprinkle with remaining cheese.
Dot with 3 or 4 pieces of butter.
Refrigerate overnight, covered.
Bake, uncovered, 25 to 30 minutes at 350°.
Serves 8.
recipes.text: Baked Broccoli And Cheese. Day before: Cook broccoli and drain. Mix eggs, soup, mayonnaise, onion and 3/4 of cheese. Add broccoli and mix well. Pour into a 1 1/2-quart casserole. Cover top lightly with breadcrumbs. Sprinkle with remaining cheese. Dot with 3 or 4 pieces of butter. Refrigerate overnight, covered. Bake, uncovered, 25 to 30 minutes at 350°. Serves 8.

recipes.title: Miracle Fudge Frosting
directions: Combine all ingredients in top of double boiler over simmering water.
When smooth, remove from heat.
Cool, stirring frequently until spreading consistency.
recipes.text: Miracle Fudge Frosting. Combine all ingredients in top of double boiler over simmering water. When smooth, remove from heat. Cool, stirring frequently until spreading consistency.

recipes.title: Carolyn'S Bologna
directions: Mix well.
Shape into 4 rolls.
Wrap in Saran Wrap; place in refrigerator for 24 hours.
Bake at 300° for 1 1/2 hours.
recipes.text: Carolyn'S Bologna. Mix well. Shape into 4 rolls. Wrap in Saran Wrap; place in refrigerator for 24 hours. Bake at 300° for 1 1/2 hours.

recipes.title: Granny Southard'S Persimmon Pudding
directions: Bake for 2 hours in moderate oven.
recipes.text: Granny Southard'S Persimmon Pudding. Bake for 2 hours in moderate oven.

recipes.title: Beans And Burgers
ingredients: 1 lb. hamburger, browned with 1 small onion
1 can lima beans (use as much juice as desired)
directions: Mix all ingredients.
Place in a 13 inch x 9 inch baking dish.
Bake one hour at 350 degrees.
recipes.text: Beans And Burgers. Mix all ingredients. Place in a 13 inch x 9 inch baking dish. Bake one hour at 350 degrees.

recipes.title: Nine Bean Soup
ingredients: 1 small can tomatoes and green chiles (undrained)
directions: Sort and wash bean mix; place in heavy pot.
Cover with water 2 inches above beans and soak overnight.
recipes.text: Nine Bean Soup. Sort and wash bean mix; place in heavy pot. Cover with water 2 inches above beans and soak overnight.

recipes.title: Spiced Tea
ingredients: 1 (18 oz.) jar instant orange breakfast drink
directions: Put the ingredients in a plastic bag.
Close with a bag tie and shake.
Place 2 to 3 heaping teaspoonfuls of mix in a cup. Add boiling water and stir.
recipes.text: Spiced Tea. Put the ingredients in a plastic bag. Close with a bag tie and shake. Place 2 to 3 heaping teaspoonfuls of mix in a cup. Add boiling water and stir.

recipes.title: Glogg Nog
ingredients: 1/4 tsp. each: ground cloves, cinnamon and cardamon
directions: Mix all together and serve sprinkled with nutmeg.
recipes.text: Glogg Nog. Mix all together and serve sprinkled with nutmeg.

recipes.title: Mom'S Bread And Butter Pickles
directions: Combine cucumbers, onions and peppers.
Cover with water and 1/3 cup salt; put several trays of ice cubes on top.
Let stand 3 hours.
Drain and add vinegar to cover cucumbers.
Add rest of ingredients; bring to boiling point.
Put in jars and seal.
recipes.text: Mom'S Bread And Butter Pickles. Combine cucumbers, onions and peppers. Cover with water and 1/3 cup salt; put several trays of ice cubes on top. Let stand 3 hours. Drain and add vinegar to cover cucumbers. Add rest of ingredients; bring to boiling point. Put in jars and seal.

recipes.title: Peach Cobbler
ingredients: 1 regular size can lite sliced peaches
directions: Preheat oven to 350°.
Melt butter or margarine in medium casserole or glass baking dish.
In small saucepan on low heat, heat fruit and sugar until sugar is dissolved.
Mix remaining ingredients in separate bowl.
Pour mixture into melted butter. Spoon fruit on top of batter.
Spoon remaining juice over fruit and batter.
Bake at 350° for 50 minutes.
Cool 10 minutes.
Serve with vanilla ice cream.
recipes.text: Peach Cobbler. Preheat oven to 350°. Melt butter or margarine in medium casserole or glass baking dish. In small saucepan on low heat, heat fruit and sugar until sugar is dissolved. Mix remaining ingredients in separate bowl. Pour mixture into melted butter. Spoon fruit on top of batter. Spoon remaining juice over fruit and batter. Bake at 350° for 50 minutes. Cool 10 minutes. Serve with vanilla ice cream.

recipes.title: Pineapple Cheese Casserole
ingredients: 1 (20 oz.) can pineapple chunks, drained (save 3 Tbsp. juice)
directions: Put pineapple and juice in a greased 1-quart casserole.
Mix flour, sugar and cheese.
Put over pineapple.
Top with crushed crackers.
Pour melted margarine over crackers.
Bake, uncovered, at 350° for about 20 minutes.
recipes.text: Pineapple Cheese Casserole. Put pineapple and juice in a greased 1-quart casserole. Mix flour, sugar and cheese. Put over pineapple. Top with crushed crackers. Pour melted margarine over crackers. Bake, uncovered, at 350° for about 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Funnel Cake
directions: Beat mixture of ingredients until smooth.
Holding your finger over bottom of funnel, fill funnel with batter.
Holding funnel as near to hot oil as possible, remove finger and drop batter into 375° oil.
Use circular movement from center outward when pouring batter.
Fry until golden brown.
Dust with 10x sugar.
recipes.text: Funnel Cake. Beat mixture of ingredients until smooth. Holding your finger over bottom of funnel, fill funnel with batter. Holding funnel as near to hot oil as possible, remove finger and drop batter into 375° oil. Use circular movement from center outward when pouring batter. Fry until golden brown. Dust with 10x sugar.

recipes.title: Caramel Cereal Bars
directions: Grease 9 x 13-inch pan.
In large bowl, mix cereals and peanuts.
In medium bowl, microwave caramels and water on Medium for 3 to 5 minutes until caramels are melted, stirring every 2 minutes.
Pour over cereal and mix thoroughly.
Spray hands and press into pan. Let stand for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Caramel Cereal Bars. Grease 9 x 13-inch pan. In large bowl, mix cereals and peanuts. In medium bowl, microwave caramels and water on Medium for 3 to 5 minutes until caramels are melted, stirring every 2 minutes. Pour over cereal and mix thoroughly. Spray hands and press into pan. Let stand for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Chocolate Pecan Pie
directions: In large bowl, combine corn syrup, eggs, sugar, butter and salt.
Beat until blended.
Beat in melted chocolate.
Stir in pecans.
Pour into unbaked pie shell.
Bake on lower rack of preheated 375° oven, until filling is completely puffed across top and crusted over, 55 to 60 minutes.
Cool.
recipes.text: Chocolate Pecan Pie. In large bowl, combine corn syrup, eggs, sugar, butter and salt. Beat until blended. Beat in melted chocolate. Stir in pecans. Pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake on lower rack of preheated 375° oven, until filling is completely puffed across top and crusted over, 55 to 60 minutes. Cool.

recipes.title: Tea Cakes #2
directions: Cream margarine and sugar.
Add eggs; mix well.
Add dry ingredients and vanilla.
Drop on a cookie sheet by teaspoonfuls. Bake 8 to 10 minutes at 375°.
recipes.text: Tea Cakes #2. Cream margarine and sugar. Add eggs; mix well. Add dry ingredients and vanilla. Drop on a cookie sheet by teaspoonfuls. Bake 8 to 10 minutes at 375°.

recipes.title: Pink Fluff
directions: Combine flour, brown sugar, melted butter and chopped nuts; mix and spread in a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Bake at 350° for 10 minutes. Remove, stir and return to oven to bake another 10 minutes. Remove half of the crumbs to be used for topping.
recipes.text: Pink Fluff. Combine flour, brown sugar, melted butter and chopped nuts; mix and spread in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350° for 10 minutes. Remove, stir and return to oven to bake another 10 minutes. Remove half of the crumbs to be used for topping.

recipes.title: Sputniks
directions: Combine peanut butter and chips and microwave 2 minutes, stirring after each minute.
Add chow mein noodles and nuts and drop on wax paper and refrigerate until set.
recipes.text: Sputniks. Combine peanut butter and chips and microwave 2 minutes, stirring after each minute. Add chow mein noodles and nuts and drop on wax paper and refrigerate until set.

recipes.title: Bar-B-Cups
directions: Brown ground meat.
Drain the grease.
Add sauce.
Press biscuits into cupcake pan.
Shape biscuits into cups.
Put the meat mixture in cups.
Top with cheese.
Bake until brown at 350°.
recipes.text: Bar-B-Cups. Brown ground meat. Drain the grease. Add sauce. Press biscuits into cupcake pan. Shape biscuits into cups. Put the meat mixture in cups. Top with cheese. Bake until brown at 350°.

recipes.title: Pork Medallions With Dijon Mustard Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 to 3/4 pork tenderloin, cut in 1-inch slices
directions: Melt 2 teaspoons butter in medium skillet. Add shallot and mushrooms. Cook and stir 1 minute or until tender. Remove. Add remaining butter and oil to skillet. Add pork. Cook 8 to 10 minutes. Turn once. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Remove and keep warm. Gradually add apple juice. Stir in mustard and cream. Bring to boil. Boil 1 to 2 minutes. Add mushroom mixture. Cook 1 minute, stirring constantly. Place pork on plate. Spoon sauce over. Garnish with thyme. Goes well with wild rice.
recipes.text: Pork Medallions With Dijon Mustard Sauce. Melt 2 teaspoons butter in medium skillet. Add shallot and mushrooms. Cook and stir 1 minute or until tender. Remove. Add remaining butter and oil to skillet. Add pork. Cook 8 to 10 minutes. Turn once. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Remove and keep warm. Gradually add apple juice. Stir in mustard and cream. Bring to boil. Boil 1 to 2 minutes. Add mushroom mixture. Cook 1 minute, stirring constantly. Place pork on plate. Spoon sauce over. Garnish with thyme. Goes well with wild rice.

recipes.title: Chicken And Dumplings
directions: Boil chicken; debone and cut into small pieces.
Mix flour, pepper and margarine.
Add milk; mix well.
Roll out thin.
Cut in strips.
Drop dumplings in the 2 quarts of boiling chicken broth. (I use a little more than 2 quarts.)
Cook 10 minutes uncovered and 5 minutes covered.
(Add salt and pepper to chicken while boiling.)
recipes.text: Chicken And Dumplings. Boil chicken; debone and cut into small pieces. Mix flour, pepper and margarine. Add milk; mix well. Roll out thin. Cut in strips. Drop dumplings in the 2 quarts of boiling chicken broth. (I use a little more than 2 quarts.) Cook 10 minutes uncovered and 5 minutes covered. (Add salt and pepper to chicken while boiling.)

recipes.title: Sugar-Free Holiday Nog
ingredients: 1 (.9 oz.) pkg. sugar-free instant vanilla pudding mix
directions: Combine pudding mix, 2 cups of cold milk, vanilla and sugar substitute in a bowl. Mix according to pudding directions. Pour into a 1/2-gallon container with a tight-fitting lid. Add 3 cups milk and shake well. Add evaporated milk and shake. Add remaining milk; shake well. Chill. Yield: 8 servings.
recipes.text: Sugar-Free Holiday Nog. Combine pudding mix, 2 cups of cold milk, vanilla and sugar substitute in a bowl. Mix according to pudding directions. Pour into a 1/2-gallon container with a tight-fitting lid. Add 3 cups milk and shake well. Add evaporated milk and shake. Add remaining milk; shake well. Chill. Yield: 8 servings.

recipes.title: Chocolate Chip Cheese Loaf
ingredients: 3 - 8 oz. pkg. light cream cheese, softened
directions: Combine first 4 ingredients.
Blend and divide into two loafs and garnish or roll in pecans.
Serve with gingersnaps.
recipes.text: Chocolate Chip Cheese Loaf. Combine first 4 ingredients. Blend and divide into two loafs and garnish or roll in pecans. Serve with gingersnaps.

recipes.title: Cherry Delight
directions: Mix ingredients together and top with Cool Whip and nuts. Chill one hour.
A 9 x 13-inch pan may be used.
recipes.text: Cherry Delight. Mix ingredients together and top with Cool Whip and nuts. Chill one hour. A 9 x 13-inch pan may be used.

recipes.title: Weight Watchers Baked Buffalo Chicken
ingredients: 1/2 c. fat free blue cheese dressing
directions: Preheat oven to 400.
Coat large nonstick skillet with cooking spray.
Place over medium high heat until.
Add chichen, cook 4 minutes on each side (or until browned).
Place chicken in an 11 x 7 inch baking dish coated with cooking spray.
Combine hot sauce and next 4 ingredients:
Pour over chichen.
Bake, uncovered, at 400 for 25 minutes.
recipes.text: Weight Watchers Baked Buffalo Chicken. Preheat oven to 400. Coat large nonstick skillet with cooking spray. Place over medium high heat until. Add chichen, cook 4 minutes on each side (or until browned). Place chicken in an 11 x 7 inch baking dish coated with cooking spray. Combine hot sauce and next 4 ingredients: Pour over chichen. Bake, uncovered, at 400 for 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Rice Pudding
directions: Place rice in large bowl.
Add sugar, eggs, milk, vanilla, raisins and cinnamon.
Stir thoroughly.
Pour mixture into greased baking dish.
Bake for 25 minutes at 350°.
Makes 6 servings.
recipes.text: Rice Pudding. Place rice in large bowl. Add sugar, eggs, milk, vanilla, raisins and cinnamon. Stir thoroughly. Pour mixture into greased baking dish. Bake for 25 minutes at 350°. Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Red Rice
directions: Brown meat slightly in the bacon drippings.
Combine all other ingredients, mix well.
Bake in covered casserole dish at 350° for one hour.
recipes.text: Red Rice. Brown meat slightly in the bacon drippings. Combine all other ingredients, mix well. Bake in covered casserole dish at 350° for one hour.

recipes.title: Almond Bars
directions: Preheat oven to 325°.
Cream eggs and sugar.
Mix in rest of ingredients.
Pour into well-greased 9 x 13-inch pan.
Sprinkle 2 tablespoons powdered sugar over top, if desired and bake for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Almond Bars. Preheat oven to 325°. Cream eggs and sugar. Mix in rest of ingredients. Pour into well-greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Sprinkle 2 tablespoons powdered sugar over top, if desired and bake for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Chicken Breast With Orange Sauce
ingredients: 2 whole chicken breasts, cut in half (2 1/2 lb.)
2 thin slices orange with rind, cut crosswise
directions: Preheat oven to 325°.
Melt margarine in a large skillet. Brown chicken breasts in skillet over medium heat, turning 2 or 3 times.
Transfer chicken to a shallow casserole, skin side up; set aside.
Add seasonings and flour to hot fat in the skillet and stir to blend until smooth and lightly browned.
Gradually add chicken broth and orange juice, stirring constantly.
Cook and stir over low heat until smooth and thickened.
Pour on top of chicken.
Bake 30 minutes.
Cut each orange slice in quarters and place two quarter slices on top of each piece of chicken.
Scatter ginger and orange rind on top.
Bake another 10 to 15 minutes.
recipes.text: Chicken Breast With Orange Sauce. Preheat oven to 325°. Melt margarine in a large skillet. Brown chicken breasts in skillet over medium heat, turning 2 or 3 times. Transfer chicken to a shallow casserole, skin side up; set aside. Add seasonings and flour to hot fat in the skillet and stir to blend until smooth and lightly browned. Gradually add chicken broth and orange juice, stirring constantly. Cook and stir over low heat until smooth and thickened. Pour on top of chicken. Bake 30 minutes. Cut each orange slice in quarters and place two quarter slices on top of each piece of chicken. Scatter ginger and orange rind on top. Bake another 10 to 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Coconut Pie Without Crust
directions: Mix well the eggs, sugar, melted margarine, flour, milk, grated coconut and vanilla. Bake at 375° for about 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Coconut Pie Without Crust. Mix well the eggs, sugar, melted margarine, flour, milk, grated coconut and vanilla. Bake at 375° for about 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Quick Cake
directions: Mix all ingredients together, except pie filling, thoroughly. Put 3/4 dough in a greased 13 x 9-inch pan.
Spread pie filling over dough and top with remaining dough.
Bake 1 hour in 350° oven. Cut in slices when cool.
recipes.text: Quick Cake. Mix all ingredients together, except pie filling, thoroughly. Put 3/4 dough in a greased 13 x 9-inch pan. Spread pie filling over dough and top with remaining dough. Bake 1 hour in 350° oven. Cut in slices when cool.

recipes.title: Christmas Cookies
directions: Mix butter, sugar and egg. Stir in vanilla. Add flour and baking powder. Roll and cut into shapes on floured board.
Bake until lightly browned at 425° for 6 to 8 minutes.
Makes about 6 dozen.
recipes.text: Christmas Cookies. Mix butter, sugar and egg. Stir in vanilla. Add flour and baking powder. Roll and cut into shapes on floured board. Bake until lightly browned at 425° for 6 to 8 minutes. Makes about 6 dozen.

recipes.title: Spinach Balls
ingredients: 1 (6 oz.) pkg. chicken flavored Stove Top
directions: Thaw and cook spinach; drain.
Add other ingredients.
Shape into 1-inch balls.
Place on cookie sheet and freeze (couple of days).
Bake in 350° oven for 10 to 15 minutes.
Serve hot.
recipes.text: Spinach Balls. Thaw and cook spinach; drain. Add other ingredients. Shape into 1-inch balls. Place on cookie sheet and freeze (couple of days). Bake in 350° oven for 10 to 15 minutes. Serve hot.

recipes.title: Angel Food Dessert - So Quick
directions: You will need 1 large bowl.
recipes.text: Angel Food Dessert - So Quick. You will need 1 large bowl.

recipes.title: * Mock Lasagna Casserole *
ingredients: 1 (7 oz.) pkg. macaroni, cooked and drained
directions: Brown meat; drain off fat.
Add tomato sauce, garlic salt, pepper, basil and 1/2 cup water.
Cover and simmer 15 minutes, stirring occasionally.
In a 2-quart casserole, layer half each of macaroni, cottage cheese, shredded cheese and meat sauce.
Repeat layers.
Bake at 370° for 30 minutes.
Serves 6 to 8.
recipes.text: * Mock Lasagna Casserole *. Brown meat; drain off fat. Add tomato sauce, garlic salt, pepper, basil and 1/2 cup water. Cover and simmer 15 minutes, stirring occasionally. In a 2-quart casserole, layer half each of macaroni, cottage cheese, shredded cheese and meat sauce. Repeat layers. Bake at 370° for 30 minutes. Serves 6 to 8.

recipes.title: Rhubarb Cake
ingredients: 2 c. flour (reserve 2 Tbsp.) to mix with rhubarb
directions: Cream together butter, sugar and egg.
Add buttermilk alternately with combined flour, soda, salt and cinnamon.
Mix until smooth.
Add vanilla.
Toss rhubarb with flour.
Add to mixture.
Spread in greased and floured 13 x 9 x 2-inch cake pan. Bake at 350° for 35 minutes.
recipes.text: Rhubarb Cake. Cream together butter, sugar and egg. Add buttermilk alternately with combined flour, soda, salt and cinnamon. Mix until smooth. Add vanilla. Toss rhubarb with flour. Add to mixture. Spread in greased and floured 13 x 9 x 2-inch cake pan. Bake at 350° for 35 minutes.

recipes.title: Strawberry Congealed Salad
ingredients: 2 (10 oz.) pkg. frozen strawberries, thawed, with juice
1 can (1 lb. 3 oz.) canned crushed pineapple, drained
1 pt. sour cream or cream cheese
directions: Dissolve jello in boiling water.
Cool.
Add fruits and nuts. Spoon half into pan or mold.
Chill until firm.
Spread sour cream or softened cream cheese over salad.
Cover with remainder of salad mixture. Chill until firm.
recipes.text: Strawberry Congealed Salad. Dissolve jello in boiling water. Cool. Add fruits and nuts. Spoon half into pan or mold. Chill until firm. Spread sour cream or softened cream cheese over salad. Cover with remainder of salad mixture. Chill until firm.

recipes.title: Steamed Shrimp Ii
directions: Place margarine in saucepan and melt.
Add chopped vegetables and saute until tender.
Add shrimp and cool about 5 minutes.
Add beer; cover and steam about 15 to 20 minutes.
Serves 5.
recipes.text: Steamed Shrimp Ii. Place margarine in saucepan and melt. Add chopped vegetables and saute until tender. Add shrimp and cool about 5 minutes. Add beer; cover and steam about 15 to 20 minutes. Serves 5.

recipes.title: Buttermilk Cake
ingredients: 1 c. buttermilk, mixed with 1 tsp. baking soda
directions: Cream butter and sugar together.
Add remaining ingredients. Fold in egg whites.
Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes (two 9-inch pans).
recipes.text: Buttermilk Cake. Cream butter and sugar together. Add remaining ingredients. Fold in egg whites. Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes (two 9-inch pans).

recipes.title: Monster Cookies
directions: Mix in order given. Drop by spoonful on ungreased cookie sheets. Bake at 350° for about 12 minutes.
recipes.text: Monster Cookies. Mix in order given. Drop by spoonful on ungreased cookie sheets. Bake at 350° for about 12 minutes.

recipes.title: Enchiladas
ingredients: 1 large pkg. shredded Cheddar cheese (mild) or Big Horn mild Cheddar cheese, grated
directions: Melt shortening in a small frypan.
Warm chile sauce mixture in another frypan.
Dip corn tortillas in shortening for 20 seconds or so and dip into chile sauce mixture.
Then place on cookie sheet open.
Fill with onion, cheese and two olives and roll.
Repeat for all 12 tortillas.
Sprinkle leftover cheese on top and olives, too.
Bake in a 350° oven for 25 to 30 minutes or until cheese melts.
recipes.text: Enchiladas. Melt shortening in a small frypan. Warm chile sauce mixture in another frypan. Dip corn tortillas in shortening for 20 seconds or so and dip into chile sauce mixture. Then place on cookie sheet open. Fill with onion, cheese and two olives and roll. Repeat for all 12 tortillas. Sprinkle leftover cheese on top and olives, too. Bake in a 350° oven for 25 to 30 minutes or until cheese melts.

recipes.title: Corn Salad
directions: Drain corn.
Add celery, pepper, onion and pimento.
Mix mustard, vinegar and sugar.
Pour over corn mixture and cover. Let stand overnight for best flavor.
recipes.text: Corn Salad. Drain corn. Add celery, pepper, onion and pimento. Mix mustard, vinegar and sugar. Pour over corn mixture and cover. Let stand overnight for best flavor.

recipes.title: Date Delight
ingredients: 2 c. miniature marshmallows or 16 large ones
directions: Crush cookies and mix with butter.
Put in bottom of 8 x 8-inch dish. Chop dates and cook in water with salt until soft. While hot, add marshmallows and nuts.
Spread this over cookie crust and chill.
Whip cream with vanilla.
Spread over date mixture.
Sprinkle crushed crumbs over top for garnish.
Chill overnight.
Freezes and keeps well.
recipes.text: Date Delight. Crush cookies and mix with butter. Put in bottom of 8 x 8-inch dish. Chop dates and cook in water with salt until soft. While hot, add marshmallows and nuts. Spread this over cookie crust and chill. Whip cream with vanilla. Spread over date mixture. Sprinkle crushed crumbs over top for garnish. Chill overnight. Freezes and keeps well.

recipes.title: Steph'S Gourmet Pasta
directions: Cook pasta as directed on package.
While pasta is cooking, in a large frying pan, warm olive oil (medium heat), toss in bread crumbs; brown (about 3 minutes).
Chop Prosciutto.
Drain pasta and toss all together.
Enjoy.
recipes.text: Steph'S Gourmet Pasta. Cook pasta as directed on package. While pasta is cooking, in a large frying pan, warm olive oil (medium heat), toss in bread crumbs; brown (about 3 minutes). Chop Prosciutto. Drain pasta and toss all together. Enjoy.

recipes.title: Chihuahua Dip
directions: Cover bottom of 8 x 10-inch baking dish with the beans.
Mix together avocado, sour cream, mayonnaise and seasoning as the second layer.
Top with layer of tomatoes, onions and cheese. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
Serve with taco chips.
recipes.text: Chihuahua Dip. Cover bottom of 8 x 10-inch baking dish with the beans. Mix together avocado, sour cream, mayonnaise and seasoning as the second layer. Top with layer of tomatoes, onions and cheese. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes. Serve with taco chips.

recipes.title: Apricot Cottage Cheese Salad
ingredients: 1 (12 oz.) carton creamy small curd cottage cheese
directions: Dissolve gelatin in boiling water.
Add apricot juice and mix well.

Chill until jelly-like consistency, then fold in the cottage cheese, walnuts, cherries, apricots and last add the whipped cream. Pour into lightly oiled 1 1/2-quart mold and chill until well set. Unmold to serve.
Makes at least 8 servings.
recipes.text: Apricot Cottage Cheese Salad. Dissolve gelatin in boiling water. Add apricot juice and mix well. Chill until jelly-like consistency, then fold in the cottage cheese, walnuts, cherries, apricots and last add the whipped cream. Pour into lightly oiled 1 1/2-quart mold and chill until well set. Unmold to serve. Makes at least 8 servings.

recipes.title: Ribs
directions: Bake ribs on rack at 450° for half hour.
Drain off fat. Sprinkle on seasoning.
Finish baking at 350° for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Ribs. Bake ribs on rack at 450° for half hour. Drain off fat. Sprinkle on seasoning. Finish baking at 350° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Parmesan Olive Potato Topper
ingredients: 1 c. pitted California ripe olives, chopped
directions: Mix salad dressing, olives, red pepper, cheese, green onions and black pepper until well blended.
Serve over baked potatoes. Makes about 2 cups of topping.
recipes.text: Parmesan Olive Potato Topper. Mix salad dressing, olives, red pepper, cheese, green onions and black pepper until well blended. Serve over baked potatoes. Makes about 2 cups of topping.

recipes.title: Cheese Potato Crisps
directions: Peel and cut lengthwise the potatoes into 1/4-inch slices. Place in shallow baking pan.
Drizzle with 1/4 cup melted butter or margarine.
Sprinkle with the salt and cheese.
Top with corn flakes.
Bake at 375° for 25 minutes.
recipes.text: Cheese Potato Crisps. Peel and cut lengthwise the potatoes into 1/4-inch slices. Place in shallow baking pan. Drizzle with 1/4 cup melted butter or margarine. Sprinkle with the salt and cheese. Top with corn flakes. Bake at 375° for 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Mother'S Angel Biscuits
directions: Dissolve yeast in water.
Sift together dry ingredients.
Cut in shortening.
Add yeast to buttermilk and dry ingredients. Knead enough to hold together. Roll dough to 1/2-inch.
Cut with biscuit cutter and fold in half. Bake at 400° for 15 to 20 minutes.
recipes.text: Mother'S Angel Biscuits. Dissolve yeast in water. Sift together dry ingredients. Cut in shortening. Add yeast to buttermilk and dry ingredients. Knead enough to hold together. Roll dough to 1/2-inch. Cut with biscuit cutter and fold in half. Bake at 400° for 15 to 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Heavenly Chocolate Cake
ingredients: 1 (2 layer size) pkg. chocolate cake mix
directions: Mix dry ingredients.
Add the rest and beat until well blended with mixer.
Bake in a 9 x 13-inch pan at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes. Test with toothpick.
recipes.text: Heavenly Chocolate Cake. Mix dry ingredients. Add the rest and beat until well blended with mixer. Bake in a 9 x 13-inch pan at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes. Test with toothpick.

recipes.title: Lemon Delight
directions: 1st Layer:
Mix together flour and oleo in 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan.
Bake at 350° for 15 minutes.
Cool.
recipes.text: Lemon Delight. 1st Layer: Mix together flour and oleo in 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan. Bake at 350° for 15 minutes. Cool.

recipes.title: Smokey Barbecue Sauce
directions: Simmer 7 to 10 minutes.
recipes.text: Smokey Barbecue Sauce. Simmer 7 to 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Dump Cake
ingredients: 1 can cherry or blueberry pie filling
1/4 to 1/2 c. chopped pecans or walnuts
directions: In a 9 x 13 x 2-inch ungreased pan, layer pineapple evenly. Next, put pie filling on top of pineapple.
Put dry cake mix on top of these and smooth until flat.
Pour chopped nuts on top, then margarine or butter cut in pieces.
Bake 1 hour at 300°.
recipes.text: Dump Cake. In a 9 x 13 x 2-inch ungreased pan, layer pineapple evenly. Next, put pie filling on top of pineapple. Put dry cake mix on top of these and smooth until flat. Pour chopped nuts on top, then margarine or butter cut in pieces. Bake 1 hour at 300°.

recipes.title: Apricot Chicken
directions: Put chicken pieces in casserole dish and shake dry French onion soup over so all pieces are well covered.
Place, well covered, in refrigerator.
Leave a minimum of 4 hours, but better if left 8 hours.
recipes.text: Apricot Chicken. Put chicken pieces in casserole dish and shake dry French onion soup over so all pieces are well covered. Place, well covered, in refrigerator. Leave a minimum of 4 hours, but better if left 8 hours.

recipes.title: Japanese Salad
ingredients: 1 can chopped clams or 1 can shrimp
directions: Cook saifun in boiling water for 4 to 5 minutes or longer. Drain and set aside.
Add clams, shredded lettuce and sliced cucumber, celery and carrots.
recipes.text: Japanese Salad. Cook saifun in boiling water for 4 to 5 minutes or longer. Drain and set aside. Add clams, shredded lettuce and sliced cucumber, celery and carrots.

recipes.title: Gold Cake
ingredients: 2 3/4 c. sifted Swans Down cake flour
directions: Sift flour once; measure.
Add baking powder and salt and sift together 3 times.
Cream butter thoroughly.
Add sugar gradually and cream together until light and fluffy.
Beat egg yolks thoroughly until light colored and thick enough to fall from the beater in a heavy continuous stream.
Add to creamed mixture and beat until smooth, almost waxy in appearance.
Add flour alternately after each addition.
When all flour is added, beat thoroughly again.
Add lemon extract.
Bake in 3 greased 9-inch layer pans in moderate oven at 375° for about twenty minutes or until tops spring back.
Cool.
Frost with any icing you choose.
recipes.text: Gold Cake. Sift flour once; measure. Add baking powder and salt and sift together 3 times. Cream butter thoroughly. Add sugar gradually and cream together until light and fluffy. Beat egg yolks thoroughly until light colored and thick enough to fall from the beater in a heavy continuous stream. Add to creamed mixture and beat until smooth, almost waxy in appearance. Add flour alternately after each addition. When all flour is added, beat thoroughly again. Add lemon extract. Bake in 3 greased 9-inch layer pans in moderate oven at 375° for about twenty minutes or until tops spring back. Cool. Frost with any icing you choose.

recipes.title: Roast Beef And Yorkshire Puddingengland
ingredients: Boneless beef roast, allow 4-6 oz. per person
3/4 c. All purpose flour, DO NOT use self rising flour.
directions: Heat oven to 350°f. 180°c. gas mark 4. In a 13 x 9-inch baking pan, brush the beef with the melted butter, pour any remaining butter into the pan.
Place in the center of the oven and roast for 20 minutes per pound + 20 minutes extra.
Baste occassionally.
In the meantime, using a whisk, mix together the water, milk and egg then add the flour and salt, whisk well until smooth.
Set aside until beef is cooked.
Remove beef from oven and use drippings to grease 12 muffin tins, turn heat up to 425°f. 215°c. gas mark 7 and place muffin tins on center rack.
When muffin tins are smoking, quickly divide the batter between them.
Bake for approximately 30-40 minutes or until the yorkshire puddings are well risen and golden brown.
Makes 1 dozen puddings.
Serve with brown gravy, potatoes (roasted in the pan with the beef for the last hour of cooking) and fresh veggies.
recipes.text: Roast Beef And Yorkshire Puddingengland. Heat oven to 350°f. 180°c. gas mark 4. In a 13 x 9-inch baking pan, brush the beef with the melted butter, pour any remaining butter into the pan. Place in the center of the oven and roast for 20 minutes per pound + 20 minutes extra. Baste occassionally. In the meantime, using a whisk, mix together the water, milk and egg then add the flour and salt, whisk well until smooth. Set aside until beef is cooked. Remove beef from oven and use drippings to grease 12 muffin tins, turn heat up to 425°f. 215°c. gas mark 7 and place muffin tins on center rack. When muffin tins are smoking, quickly divide the batter between them. Bake for approximately 30-40 minutes or until the yorkshire puddings are well risen and golden brown. Makes 1 dozen puddings. Serve with brown gravy, potatoes (roasted in the pan with the beef for the last hour of cooking) and fresh veggies.

recipes.title: Coconut Pound Cake
directions: Cream and mix first 4 ingredients, using egg yolks only.
Add extract and at low speed, beat in flour and milk alternately.
Add coconut.
Fold in stiffly beaten egg whites.
Pour in greased tube pan.
Bake 2 hours at 300°.
Cool 15 minutes in pan before removing.
Sprinkle with 4x sugar or ice, if desired.
recipes.text: Coconut Pound Cake. Cream and mix first 4 ingredients, using egg yolks only. Add extract and at low speed, beat in flour and milk alternately. Add coconut. Fold in stiffly beaten egg whites. Pour in greased tube pan. Bake 2 hours at 300°. Cool 15 minutes in pan before removing. Sprinkle with 4x sugar or ice, if desired.

recipes.title: Best Ever Homemade Baked Beans
directions: Chop onion fine or put in blender.
Mix everything together well in mixing bowl.
Then pour on top of beans in a roaster. Stir well.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour, covered.
Stir a few times.
recipes.text: Best Ever Homemade Baked Beans. Chop onion fine or put in blender. Mix everything together well in mixing bowl. Then pour on top of beans in a roaster. Stir well. Bake at 350° for 1 hour, covered. Stir a few times.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Cake
ingredients: 1 can pumpkin pie mix (use directions on can for pie filling)
directions: Step 1:
Remove 1 cup cake mix and cut in 1/2 stick margarine with 1 teaspoon cinnamon.
Set aside.
recipes.text: Pumpkin Cake. Step 1: Remove 1 cup cake mix and cut in 1/2 stick margarine with 1 teaspoon cinnamon. Set aside.

recipes.title: Oriental Chicken
directions: Layer chicken in a dish.
Mix other ingredients and pour over chicken.
Cover and bake for 2 hours at 300°.
Good served with rice.
recipes.text: Oriental Chicken. Layer chicken in a dish. Mix other ingredients and pour over chicken. Cover and bake for 2 hours at 300°. Good served with rice.

recipes.title: Ham And Barley Soup
ingredients: 1 ham bone with plenty of meat or 2 smoked ham hocks
1 (9 oz.) pkg. frozen Italian green beans
directions: In large pot, brown celery, carrots and onions in 2 tablespoons oil.
Remove from pan.
Brown turnips and mushrooms in 2 more tablespoons oil.
Return carrot mixture.
Add ham bone, barley, thyme, salt, pepper, bouillon and 12 cups water to the pot; heat to boiling.
Reduce heat; cover and simmer for 1 1/2 hours.
Cut meat from bone and into small pieces.
Return ham; add stewed tomatoes and beans to pot.
Heat to boiling.
Cover; simmer on low 5 to 10 minutes, until beans are tender.
Serves 10.
recipes.text: Ham And Barley Soup. In large pot, brown celery, carrots and onions in 2 tablespoons oil. Remove from pan. Brown turnips and mushrooms in 2 more tablespoons oil. Return carrot mixture. Add ham bone, barley, thyme, salt, pepper, bouillon and 12 cups water to the pot; heat to boiling. Reduce heat; cover and simmer for 1 1/2 hours. Cut meat from bone and into small pieces. Return ham; add stewed tomatoes and beans to pot. Heat to boiling. Cover; simmer on low 5 to 10 minutes, until beans are tender. Serves 10.

recipes.title: Breakfast Quiche
directions: Cook sausage; drain well. Cover pie crust with cheese. Mix eggs, milk and pepper. Crumble sausage over cheese crust. Add milk-egg mixture. Cover mixture with remaining cheese. Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes. Test with knife. Don't overbake. Cool 5 minutes before serving. Makes 2 pies. Serve with fruit salad.
recipes.text: Breakfast Quiche. Cook sausage; drain well. Cover pie crust with cheese. Mix eggs, milk and pepper. Crumble sausage over cheese crust. Add milk-egg mixture. Cover mixture with remaining cheese. Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes. Test with knife. Don't overbake. Cool 5 minutes before serving. Makes 2 pies. Serve with fruit salad.

recipes.title: Baked Turkey
directions: Preheat oven to 475° (very hot), about 9 or 10 p.m. the night before you plan your family feast.
Place turkey in a covered roaster.
Add 1 quart hot water and bake 1 hour.
Turn off oven. Do not open door.
Leave all night.
In the morning, it will be golden brown; you will have plenty of broth for dressing and gravy and the most tender turkey you ever tasted.
Be sure the roasting pan's lid fits.
I use a hot water bath canner with rack under turkey.
recipes.text: Baked Turkey. Preheat oven to 475° (very hot), about 9 or 10 p.m. the night before you plan your family feast. Place turkey in a covered roaster. Add 1 quart hot water and bake 1 hour. Turn off oven. Do not open door. Leave all night. In the morning, it will be golden brown; you will have plenty of broth for dressing and gravy and the most tender turkey you ever tasted. Be sure the roasting pan's lid fits. I use a hot water bath canner with rack under turkey.

recipes.title: Easy Pumpkin Cake
directions: Beat the first 7 ingredients together and pour in 9 x 13-inch pan.
Sprinkle yellow cake mix over top.
Pour melted oleo over top.
Sprinkle chopped nuts over all.
Bake at 350° for one hour (no longer).
Top with whipped cream.
recipes.text: Easy Pumpkin Cake. Beat the first 7 ingredients together and pour in 9 x 13-inch pan. Sprinkle yellow cake mix over top. Pour melted oleo over top. Sprinkle chopped nuts over all. Bake at 350° for one hour (no longer). Top with whipped cream.

recipes.title: Chicken Viennoise
ingredients: 1 c. bread crumbs, mixed with 1/4 c. chopped parsley
directions: Pound chicken fillets with mallet until thin.
Sprinkle meat with salt and pepper.
Beat eggs and pour into flat plate.
Pour flour and bread crumbs onto 2 additional flat plates.
Prepare garnishes before cooking meat and serve in small bowls.
Heat oil. Dredge chicken slices in flour.
Dip in egg, then bread crumbs. Cook until brown on one side.
Flip and repeat.
Arrange on platter.
Heat butter in skillet until it foams and pour over meat.
Serve with rice.
recipes.text: Chicken Viennoise. Pound chicken fillets with mallet until thin. Sprinkle meat with salt and pepper. Beat eggs and pour into flat plate. Pour flour and bread crumbs onto 2 additional flat plates. Prepare garnishes before cooking meat and serve in small bowls. Heat oil. Dredge chicken slices in flour. Dip in egg, then bread crumbs. Cook until brown on one side. Flip and repeat. Arrange on platter. Heat butter in skillet until it foams and pour over meat. Serve with rice.

recipes.title: Popcorn Cake
directions: Melt together first 3 ingredients.
Pour over popcorn, peanuts and M&M's.
Mix well and pack into angel food pan (sprayed).
Pack well; also can be put into two bread pans.
recipes.text: Popcorn Cake. Melt together first 3 ingredients. Pour over popcorn, peanuts and M&M's. Mix well and pack into angel food pan (sprayed). Pack well; also can be put into two bread pans.

recipes.title: Pretzel Salad
directions: Mix pretzels, 1 cup sugar and oleo.
Pour into 9 x 13-inch pan and bake at 350° for 10 minutes.
Cool.
Mix cheese, 1 cup sugar and Cool Whip together.
Spread on cooled crust.
Then boil water. Add both packages of jello and mix well to dissolve.
Add frozen strawberries.
Pour on top of salad and place in refrigerator for at least 2 hours or overnight.
recipes.text: Pretzel Salad. Mix pretzels, 1 cup sugar and oleo. Pour into 9 x 13-inch pan and bake at 350° for 10 minutes. Cool. Mix cheese, 1 cup sugar and Cool Whip together. Spread on cooled crust. Then boil water. Add both packages of jello and mix well to dissolve. Add frozen strawberries. Pour on top of salad and place in refrigerator for at least 2 hours or overnight.

recipes.title: Jewish Apple Cake
directions: Place all ingredients into bowl except apples.
Beat until smooth.
Pour half of batter into greased and floured tube pan. Cover with a layer of sliced apples.
Sprinkle apples with cinnamon and sugar.
Repeat a layer of batter then another layer of apples.
Sprinkle cinnamon and sugar on top layer of apples. Preheat oven to 350° and bake for 1 hour or until inserted toothpick comes out clean.
recipes.text: Jewish Apple Cake. Place all ingredients into bowl except apples. Beat until smooth. Pour half of batter into greased and floured tube pan. Cover with a layer of sliced apples. Sprinkle apples with cinnamon and sugar. Repeat a layer of batter then another layer of apples. Sprinkle cinnamon and sugar on top layer of apples. Preheat oven to 350° and bake for 1 hour or until inserted toothpick comes out clean.

recipes.title: Tortilla Pie
ingredients: 10 to 12 flour tortillas, torn into small pieces
1 lb. hamburger meat, cooked and drained
directions: Layer the ingredients in a casserole bowl (in order).
Cook at 350° for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Tortilla Pie. Layer the ingredients in a casserole bowl (in order). Cook at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Hot Water Cornbread
directions: Combine cornmeal, salt and oil.
Pour hot water and mix.
Add flour and baking powder.
Mix well.
Blend in egg.
Make 8 to 10 patties.
Cook in hot oil in skillet or in the oven on greased cooking sheet until browned on both sides.
Takes 10 to 15 minutes on top of stove and 20 to 25 minutes in the oven.
recipes.text: Hot Water Cornbread. Combine cornmeal, salt and oil. Pour hot water and mix. Add flour and baking powder. Mix well. Blend in egg. Make 8 to 10 patties. Cook in hot oil in skillet or in the oven on greased cooking sheet until browned on both sides. Takes 10 to 15 minutes on top of stove and 20 to 25 minutes in the oven.

recipes.title: Potato Casserole
directions: Boil potatoes in jacket until tender, approximately 25 to 30 minutes.
Drain water and let cool.
Peel potatoes and grate potatoes as hash brown potatoes.
Mix in onion, cheese, soup and sour cream.
Salt and pepper to taste.
Top with stuffing and pour melted butter over top.
Cover and bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.
Remove cover last 5 minutes.
Serves 8 to 10.
recipes.text: Potato Casserole. Boil potatoes in jacket until tender, approximately 25 to 30 minutes. Drain water and let cool. Peel potatoes and grate potatoes as hash brown potatoes. Mix in onion, cheese, soup and sour cream. Salt and pepper to taste. Top with stuffing and pour melted butter over top. Cover and bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes. Remove cover last 5 minutes. Serves 8 to 10.

recipes.title: Cream Cheese Frosting
directions: Beat cream cheese, milk and vanilla in medium bowl on low speed until smooth. Gradually add in powdered sugar, 1 cup at a time, until smooth and of spreading consistency.
recipes.text: Cream Cheese Frosting. Beat cream cheese, milk and vanilla in medium bowl on low speed until smooth. Gradually add in powdered sugar, 1 cup at a time, until smooth and of spreading consistency.

recipes.title: No-Bake Cookies
directions: In a saucepan, mix together the first 4 ingredients.
Bring to a boil; boil for 1 minute.
Remove from heat.
Add oatmeal and peanut butter, then spoon onto waxed paper and let cool.
recipes.text: No-Bake Cookies. In a saucepan, mix together the first 4 ingredients. Bring to a boil; boil for 1 minute. Remove from heat. Add oatmeal and peanut butter, then spoon onto waxed paper and let cool.

recipes.title: Seven Layer Salad
directions: Tear or shred lettuce and spread over bottom of wide, 4-quart serving dish.
Thinly slice onions and part of tops, scatter over lettuce.
Drain and slice water chestnuts, sprinkle over onions. Add chopped green pepper.
Next, add celery.
Top with English peas.
Spread mayonnaise over peas.
Use enough to cover vegetable layers completely.
Sprinkle with sugar, grated Parmesan cheese, salt and garlic powder.
Top with eggs and bacon bits.
Refrigerate at least 8 hours.
Best if overnight.
