recipes.text: Seven Layer Salad. Tear or shred lettuce and spread over bottom of wide, 4-quart serving dish. Thinly slice onions and part of tops, scatter over lettuce. Drain and slice water chestnuts, sprinkle over onions. Add chopped green pepper. Next, add celery. Top with English peas. Spread mayonnaise over peas. Use enough to cover vegetable layers completely. Sprinkle with sugar, grated Parmesan cheese, salt and garlic powder. Top with eggs and bacon bits. Refrigerate at least 8 hours. Best if overnight.

recipes.title: Chicken `65'
ingredients: 4 lbs. boneless chicken, cut into 1-inch pieces
4 Tbsp. each, ginger and garlic paste
directions: Mix chicken with the next 8 ingredients.
Marinate for 3 hours.
Then deep-fry the chicken pieces.
Reserve the marinade.
recipes.text: Chicken `65'. Mix chicken with the next 8 ingredients. Marinate for 3 hours. Then deep-fry the chicken pieces. Reserve the marinade.

recipes.title: Meatball-Spinach Soup
directions: Mix meat, egg, crumbs, onion, parsley, cheese and salt.
Make very small (1 bite) meatballs and saute in skillet or in the microwave on bacon rack for 4 minutes; drain fat.
Freeze half for soup next time.
recipes.text: Meatball-Spinach Soup. Mix meat, egg, crumbs, onion, parsley, cheese and salt. Make very small (1 bite) meatballs and saute in skillet or in the microwave on bacon rack for 4 minutes; drain fat. Freeze half for soup next time.

recipes.title: Christmas Eve Crescents
ingredients: 1 (16.5 oz.) pkg. Duncan Hines peanut butter cookie mix
directions: Preheat oven to 375°.
Empty both mix pouches into bowl.
Add egg and maple flavoring.
Mix thoroughly. Shape dough into 3/4-inch balls. Roll into 2-inch cylinders in "crescent" shape, tapering ends slightly.
Place on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake 8 to 10 minutes. Sprinkle with confectioners sugar immediately. Cool slightly. Roll completely in confectioners sugar while still warm. Makes 36 cookies.
recipes.text: Christmas Eve Crescents. Preheat oven to 375°. Empty both mix pouches into bowl. Add egg and maple flavoring. Mix thoroughly. Shape dough into 3/4-inch balls. Roll into 2-inch cylinders in "crescent" shape, tapering ends slightly. Place on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake 8 to 10 minutes. Sprinkle with confectioners sugar immediately. Cool slightly. Roll completely in confectioners sugar while still warm. Makes 36 cookies.

recipes.title: Fuzzy Navel Punch
ingredients: 16 oz. pkg. frozen unsweetened peach slices
directions: In large punch bowl, combine Peach Schnapps liqueur and orange juice; blend well.
Add ice.
Garnish with peach slices and orange slices.
If desired, make an ice ring using the peach slices and orange slices.
recipes.text: Fuzzy Navel Punch. In large punch bowl, combine Peach Schnapps liqueur and orange juice; blend well. Add ice. Garnish with peach slices and orange slices. If desired, make an ice ring using the peach slices and orange slices.

recipes.title: Chicken Fajitas
ingredients: 2 whole skinless, boneless chicken breasts, cut into strips
1/2 medium red pepper, yellow pepper and green pepper, cut into strips
1 1/2 c. shredded Cheddar or Monterey Jack cheese
directions: In a small bowl, combine lime juice, garlic, chili powder and cumin.
Add chicken; stir.
Marinate for 15 minutes.
In a nonstick skillet, cook onion, chicken and marinade for 3 minutes or until chicken is no longer pink.
Add peppers; saute for 3 to 5 minutes. Stir in salsa.
Divide mixture among tortillas; top with cheese and sour cream.
Roll up and serve.
recipes.text: Chicken Fajitas. In a small bowl, combine lime juice, garlic, chili powder and cumin. Add chicken; stir. Marinate for 15 minutes. In a nonstick skillet, cook onion, chicken and marinade for 3 minutes or until chicken is no longer pink. Add peppers; saute for 3 to 5 minutes. Stir in salsa. Divide mixture among tortillas; top with cheese and sour cream. Roll up and serve.

recipes.title: Spaghetti With Meat Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 c. beef stock or 1 cube bouillon in 1/2 c. water
directions: Melt butter in heavy fry pan or Dutch oven.
Saute onion and garlic 5 minutes; add mushrooms and meat, browning lightly.
Add celery, stock, wine, tomato paste, tomato, salt, pepper, parsley and flour.
Mix thoroughly.
recipes.text: Spaghetti With Meat Sauce. Melt butter in heavy fry pan or Dutch oven. Saute onion and garlic 5 minutes; add mushrooms and meat, browning lightly. Add celery, stock, wine, tomato paste, tomato, salt, pepper, parsley and flour. Mix thoroughly.

recipes.title: Banana Cake
directions: Combine flour, sugar, baking powder, salt and baking soda. Add shortening, half of mashed banana and eggs.
Mix to moisten flour.
Last, add remaining banana and vanilla.
Mix by hand until well blended.
You can also add chopped walnuts, if desired.
Use a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Bake at 370° for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Banana Cake. Combine flour, sugar, baking powder, salt and baking soda. Add shortening, half of mashed banana and eggs. Mix to moisten flour. Last, add remaining banana and vanilla. Mix by hand until well blended. You can also add chopped walnuts, if desired. Use a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 370° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Hot Sweet Mustard Sauce
directions: Mix mustard with a little water; allow to stand.
Mix cornstarch, sugar and salt with remainder of water until smooth. Add vinegar.
Cook over low heat, stirring constantly, for 5 minutes.
Bring to low boil; remove from heat.
Cool.
Add mustard; mix well.
recipes.text: Hot Sweet Mustard Sauce. Mix mustard with a little water; allow to stand. Mix cornstarch, sugar and salt with remainder of water until smooth. Add vinegar. Cook over low heat, stirring constantly, for 5 minutes. Bring to low boil; remove from heat. Cool. Add mustard; mix well.

recipes.title: Ruth'S Best Vegetable Soup
ingredients: 2 c. each: sliced carrots and celery
directions: Put everything in soup pot; bring to a boil.
Simmer 3 or 4 hours.
Just as good when leftover.
recipes.text: Ruth'S Best Vegetable Soup. Put everything in soup pot; bring to a boil. Simmer 3 or 4 hours. Just as good when leftover.

recipes.title: Ann'S Key Lime Cake
ingredients: 1/2 c. Key lime juice (squeeze real Key limes)
directions: Mix the beaten eggs and the next 4 ingredients with the yellow cake mix.
Beat 2 minutes on high speed.
Spray Bundt pan and pour in the mixture.
Bake at 350° for 35 minutes.
Top with powdered sugar and 1/3 cup of squeezed Key limes.
recipes.text: Ann'S Key Lime Cake. Mix the beaten eggs and the next 4 ingredients with the yellow cake mix. Beat 2 minutes on high speed. Spray Bundt pan and pour in the mixture. Bake at 350° for 35 minutes. Top with powdered sugar and 1/3 cup of squeezed Key limes.

recipes.title: Shrimp Creole
directions: Chop onion, garlic, bell pepper and celery and saute.
Add tomato paste, stewed tomatoes, sugar, salt and pepper.
Clean and devein shrimp.
Bring sauce to a boil, now add shrimp.
Cook until shrimp is cooked.
Serve over bed of rice.
recipes.text: Shrimp Creole. Chop onion, garlic, bell pepper and celery and saute. Add tomato paste, stewed tomatoes, sugar, salt and pepper. Clean and devein shrimp. Bring sauce to a boil, now add shrimp. Cook until shrimp is cooked. Serve over bed of rice.

recipes.title: Pikadillo And Cornbread Wedges
directions: Prepare cornbread; spray 8 x 1 1/2-inch nonstick round cake pan with cooking spray.
Stir together cornmeal, flour and baking powder in a medium bowl until well mixed.
Lightly beat egg whites in a small bowl.

Stir in buttermilk and oil until well combined. Pour the liquid ingredients all at once into the dry ingredients. Stir the mixture briskly with a fork until all the ingredients are just evenly moistened; do not overstir.
The batter will be lumpy. Turn into prepared pan.
Bake at 400° for 18 to 20 minutes or until wooden pick inserted comes out clean.
Turn out onto wire to cool slightly.
recipes.text: Pikadillo And Cornbread Wedges. Prepare cornbread; spray 8 x 1 1/2-inch nonstick round cake pan with cooking spray. Stir together cornmeal, flour and baking powder in a medium bowl until well mixed. Lightly beat egg whites in a small bowl. Stir in buttermilk and oil until well combined. Pour the liquid ingredients all at once into the dry ingredients. Stir the mixture briskly with a fork until all the ingredients are just evenly moistened; do not overstir. The batter will be lumpy. Turn into prepared pan. Bake at 400° for 18 to 20 minutes or until wooden pick inserted comes out clean. Turn out onto wire to cool slightly.

recipes.title: Orange Yoghurt Cake(Use Yoghurt Pot To Measure Ingredients)
ingredients: 1 pot Orange yoghurt, or any other flavor you like
directions: Mix everything but the powdered sugar and orange juice together, pour into an 11 x 7-inch baking pan.
Bake at 325°f. 160°c. gas mark 3 for 1 hour.
Allow to cool, turn out of the pan. Add the orange juice to the powdered sugar until desired consistancy to make a frosting for the cake.
recipes.text: Orange Yoghurt Cake(Use Yoghurt Pot To Measure Ingredients). Mix everything but the powdered sugar and orange juice together, pour into an 11 x 7-inch baking pan. Bake at 325°f. 160°c. gas mark 3 for 1 hour. Allow to cool, turn out of the pan. Add the orange juice to the powdered sugar until desired consistancy to make a frosting for the cake.

recipes.title: Cherry Crunch
ingredients: 1 (1 lb. 5 oz.) can cherry pie filling
1 pkg. Duncan Hines white deluxe cake mix
1/2 c. (1 stick) melted butter or margarine
sweetened whipped cream, ice cream or coffee cream
directions: Preheat oven to 350°.
Spread pie filling in the bottom of a 9-inch square pan.
Sprinkle with lemon juice.
Combine dry cake mix, nuts and melted butter.
Sprinkle over pie filling.
Bake 40 to 50 minutes until golden brown.
Serve with ice cream, whipped cream or serve with warm coffee cream.
recipes.text: Cherry Crunch. Preheat oven to 350°. Spread pie filling in the bottom of a 9-inch square pan. Sprinkle with lemon juice. Combine dry cake mix, nuts and melted butter. Sprinkle over pie filling. Bake 40 to 50 minutes until golden brown. Serve with ice cream, whipped cream or serve with warm coffee cream.

recipes.title: Beef Vegetable Soup
directions: In large kettle, cook beef and onion.
Add water, vegetables and potatoes.
Cook to soften vegetables.
Add tomatoes and paste. Put in desired seasonings.
Simmer until all vegetables are done.
recipes.text: Beef Vegetable Soup. In large kettle, cook beef and onion. Add water, vegetables and potatoes. Cook to soften vegetables. Add tomatoes and paste. Put in desired seasonings. Simmer until all vegetables are done.

recipes.title: Honey Cake
directions: Beat eggs with sugar; add oil and beat.
Add honey and beat, then milk.
Sift flour with baking powder and soda.
Then add a little flour at a time and continue beating on low speed.
When ingredients are mixed, add walnuts and mix.
Bake at 300° for 1 hour in greased and floured 9 x 13-inch cake pan.
Do not fill pan with cake mixture more than half.
recipes.text: Honey Cake. Beat eggs with sugar; add oil and beat. Add honey and beat, then milk. Sift flour with baking powder and soda. Then add a little flour at a time and continue beating on low speed. When ingredients are mixed, add walnuts and mix. Bake at 300° for 1 hour in greased and floured 9 x 13-inch cake pan. Do not fill pan with cake mixture more than half.

recipes.title: Spirit Balls(About 75)
ingredients: finely chopped coconut (optional, but highly recommended; mix in big handfuls to suit taste)
directions: Chop dates finely.
Add other ingredients; mix well.
Shape into small balls and roll in powdered sugar.
Store in tightly covered container in a cool spot.
recipes.text: Spirit Balls(About 75). Chop dates finely. Add other ingredients; mix well. Shape into small balls and roll in powdered sugar. Store in tightly covered container in a cool spot.

recipes.title: Mixed Fruit Pies
ingredients: 1 regular size can crushed pineapple, drained
directions: Mix
milk and lemon juice; add other ingredients.
Pour in crusts.
Chill for 4 hours.
recipes.text: Mixed Fruit Pies. Mix milk and lemon juice; add other ingredients. Pour in crusts. Chill for 4 hours.

recipes.title: Poppy Seed Chicken(Good Over Rice)
directions: Put chicken in bottom of baking dish.
Blend soup and sour cream together and pour over chicken.
Combine margarine, crumbs and poppy seed. Sprinkle on top.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Poppy Seed Chicken(Good Over Rice). Put chicken in bottom of baking dish. Blend soup and sour cream together and pour over chicken. Combine margarine, crumbs and poppy seed. Sprinkle on top. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Bubbas Cornbread
directions: Mix all ingredients.
Pour in two 9 x 13-inch pans, sprayed with Pam.
Cook in a 375° oven for 25 to 30 minutes until browned on top.
recipes.text: Bubbas Cornbread. Mix all ingredients. Pour in two 9 x 13-inch pans, sprayed with Pam. Cook in a 375° oven for 25 to 30 minutes until browned on top.

recipes.title: Quick And Easy Hot Rolls
ingredients: 1/8 to 1/4 c. sugar (depending on sweetness desired)
directions: Melt margarine and set aside.
Dissolve yeast in water.
Add sugar, salt and margarine; mix and add flour.
Cover and let rise for 1 hour.
Mash down.
Shape into rolls and let rise again, about 1 hour or more depending on temperature of room.
Bake for 20 minutes at 400°.
Brush with margarine when taken from oven.
recipes.text: Quick And Easy Hot Rolls. Melt margarine and set aside. Dissolve yeast in water. Add sugar, salt and margarine; mix and add flour. Cover and let rise for 1 hour. Mash down. Shape into rolls and let rise again, about 1 hour or more depending on temperature of room. Bake for 20 minutes at 400°. Brush with margarine when taken from oven.

recipes.title: Strawberry Fruit Salad
ingredients: 1 (20 oz.) can crushed pineapple, drained and reserved
1 (16 oz.) can sliced peaches, drained and reserved
1 small can fruit cocktail, drained and reserved
directions: Using juices from fruit, add the pudding mix.
Blend with mixer until thickens slightly.
You will pour this over all your fruit.
You can use different fruit or add to what is here.
recipes.text: Strawberry Fruit Salad. Using juices from fruit, add the pudding mix. Blend with mixer until thickens slightly. You will pour this over all your fruit. You can use different fruit or add to what is here.

recipes.title: Oriental Salad Dressing
directions: Mix together in bottle and shake well. Store in airtight container in refrigerator.
recipes.text: Oriental Salad Dressing. Mix together in bottle and shake well. Store in airtight container in refrigerator.

recipes.title: Herbed French Bread
directions: Slice bread.
Combine soft butter, parsley flakes, onion powder and thyme leaves.
Spread between bread slices.
Wrap in aluminum foil.
Heat in oven at 400° for 10 minutes.
recipes.text: Herbed French Bread. Slice bread. Combine soft butter, parsley flakes, onion powder and thyme leaves. Spread between bread slices. Wrap in aluminum foil. Heat in oven at 400° for 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Chicken And Sausage Casserole
ingredients: 6 sweet or hot Shofar kosher sausages
1 large green pepper, cubed in 1-inch pieces
directions: In saucepan, cook down tomatoes until there are about 2 cups liquid; stir in sugar.
Sprinkle chicken with salt and pepper. Heat oil in large skillet and add chicken pieces.
Prick sausages with fork and add.
Saute them both until browned on all sides, about 15 minutes.
Pour off all fat.
Scatter the onions, mushrooms, garlic and peppers in between pieces of chicken and sausage.
Sprinkle with oregano.
Add tomatoes, broth and red wine; stir to loosen brown bits in skillet.
Cover tightly and simmer about 20 minutes.
recipes.text: Chicken And Sausage Casserole. In saucepan, cook down tomatoes until there are about 2 cups liquid; stir in sugar. Sprinkle chicken with salt and pepper. Heat oil in large skillet and add chicken pieces. Prick sausages with fork and add. Saute them both until browned on all sides, about 15 minutes. Pour off all fat. Scatter the onions, mushrooms, garlic and peppers in between pieces of chicken and sausage. Sprinkle with oregano. Add tomatoes, broth and red wine; stir to loosen brown bits in skillet. Cover tightly and simmer about 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Seven Layer Cookies
directions: Melt margarine in a 9 x 13-inch pan, then sprinkle over margarine the graham cracker crumbs, chocolate chips, butterscotch chips, coconut, Eagle Brand milk and nuts.
Place in order given. Do not stir.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
Let cool 5 minutes. Cut into bars.
recipes.text: Seven Layer Cookies. Melt margarine in a 9 x 13-inch pan, then sprinkle over margarine the graham cracker crumbs, chocolate chips, butterscotch chips, coconut, Eagle Brand milk and nuts. Place in order given. Do not stir. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes. Let cool 5 minutes. Cut into bars.

recipes.title: Creole Champagne Punch
ingredients: 1 large fresh pineapple or 1 can diced pineapple
1/2 c. curacao or other orange liqueur
directions: If using fresh pineapple, slice and dice into 1/2-inch wedges.
Rinse and stem strawberries.
Just before serving, combine sugar, lemon and orange juice and curacao in punch bowl. Stir to dissolve sugar completely.
Stir in champagne, wine and club soda.
Add ice ring if desired, then pineapple and strawberries.
Makes about 5 quarts.
recipes.text: Creole Champagne Punch. If using fresh pineapple, slice and dice into 1/2-inch wedges. Rinse and stem strawberries. Just before serving, combine sugar, lemon and orange juice and curacao in punch bowl. Stir to dissolve sugar completely. Stir in champagne, wine and club soda. Add ice ring if desired, then pineapple and strawberries. Makes about 5 quarts.

recipes.title: Sausage Omelet
ingredients: 1 pkg. (8 oz.) Swift Premium Brown 'N Serve sausage links
directions: Heat sausage in heavy 8-inch ovenproof skillet according to package directions.
Remove sausage and keep warm.
Saute onion and green pepper in same skillet over medium-high heat until vegetables are tender.
Combine eggs and milk in medium bowl.
Add onion, green pepper and tomato.
Melt butter in same skillet over low heat.
Add egg mixture and cook until eggs are almost set. Arrange sausage on top of eggs.
To finish cooking top of omelet, broil, 4 inches form heat, until center is firm and top is lightly browned.
Cut into wedges and serve immediately.
recipes.text: Sausage Omelet. Heat sausage in heavy 8-inch ovenproof skillet according to package directions. Remove sausage and keep warm. Saute onion and green pepper in same skillet over medium-high heat until vegetables are tender. Combine eggs and milk in medium bowl. Add onion, green pepper and tomato. Melt butter in same skillet over low heat. Add egg mixture and cook until eggs are almost set. Arrange sausage on top of eggs. To finish cooking top of omelet, broil, 4 inches form heat, until center is firm and top is lightly browned. Cut into wedges and serve immediately.

recipes.title: Tuna Casserole
directions: Crush potato chips until very fine.
Mix all ingredients together.
Grease baking dish with butter.
Spread in mixture. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until top starts to brown.
recipes.text: Tuna Casserole. Crush potato chips until very fine. Mix all ingredients together. Grease baking dish with butter. Spread in mixture. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until top starts to brown.

recipes.title: Sausage And Cheese Balls
ingredients: 1 lb. medium to hot pork sausage
directions: Combine all ingredients well.
Form small balls and place on an ungreased cookie sheet.
Bake 12 to 15 minutes at 400° or until lightly brown.
Serve warm.
Freeze leftovers and warm in microwave for a great after school snack.
recipes.text: Sausage And Cheese Balls. Combine all ingredients well. Form small balls and place on an ungreased cookie sheet. Bake 12 to 15 minutes at 400° or until lightly brown. Serve warm. Freeze leftovers and warm in microwave for a great after school snack.

recipes.title: Date Nut Balls
directions: In food grinder, grind together dates, raisins, apricots and prunes/figs.
Combine with orange juice in 2-quart mixing bowl. Roll into bite-size balls.
Roll in coconut or in nuts. Refrigerate, covered, until time to serve.
Yields about 2 dozen.
recipes.text: Date Nut Balls. In food grinder, grind together dates, raisins, apricots and prunes/figs. Combine with orange juice in 2-quart mixing bowl. Roll into bite-size balls. Roll in coconut or in nuts. Refrigerate, covered, until time to serve. Yields about 2 dozen.

recipes.title: Zucchini Pie
directions: Mix eggs, Bisquick and oil.
Add all remaining ingredients to egg mixture.
Spread in a greased 9 x 12 x 2-inch pan.
Bake 45 minutes at 350°.
recipes.text: Zucchini Pie. Mix eggs, Bisquick and oil. Add all remaining ingredients to egg mixture. Spread in a greased 9 x 12 x 2-inch pan. Bake 45 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Ada'S Nacho Casual
directions: Crumble beef and sausage into skillet with onion; saute until red color disappears.
Drain off fat and season with salt to taste.
Spread refried beans on greased 10 x 15-inch cookie sheet or jelly roll pan with sides.
Top with meat mixture.
Cover with chilies and sprinkle with cheese.
Drizzle taco sauce over all. This may be covered and refrigerated at this point.
recipes.text: Ada'S Nacho Casual. Crumble beef and sausage into skillet with onion; saute until red color disappears. Drain off fat and season with salt to taste. Spread refried beans on greased 10 x 15-inch cookie sheet or jelly roll pan with sides. Top with meat mixture. Cover with chilies and sprinkle with cheese. Drizzle taco sauce over all. This may be covered and refrigerated at this point.

recipes.title: Beef-Macaroni-Cheese
ingredients: 1 pkg. Kraft macaroni and cheese dinner
directions: Prepare dinner as directed.
Combine remaining ingredients. Mix lightly.
Press meat mixture on bottom of 8-inch square baking dish.
Top with dinner.
Cover and bake at 350° for 20 minutes. Remove cover.
Continue to bake 20 minutes.
Let stand 5 minutes before serving.
recipes.text: Beef-Macaroni-Cheese. Prepare dinner as directed. Combine remaining ingredients. Mix lightly. Press meat mixture on bottom of 8-inch square baking dish. Top with dinner. Cover and bake at 350° for 20 minutes. Remove cover. Continue to bake 20 minutes. Let stand 5 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Cream Puff Dessert
directions: Melt oleo in hot water and add flour.
Whisk together until dough forms into a ball.
Turn off heat and add eggs, one at a time, mixing in well with whisk.
Spread over greased 11 x 15-inch pan and bake at 400° for 25 to 30 minutes.
Allow to cool.
recipes.text: Cream Puff Dessert. Melt oleo in hot water and add flour. Whisk together until dough forms into a ball. Turn off heat and add eggs, one at a time, mixing in well with whisk. Spread over greased 11 x 15-inch pan and bake at 400° for 25 to 30 minutes. Allow to cool.

recipes.title: Round-Up Bean Casserole
ingredients: 1 (16 oz.) can large lima beans, drained
directions: Put 1 teaspoon salt in bottom of a large skillet.
Heat, then add beef and stir until browned.
Add pepper and salt, then other ingredients.
Mix well, then put in a large casserole.
Bake for 1 hour at 350°.
recipes.text: Round-Up Bean Casserole. Put 1 teaspoon salt in bottom of a large skillet. Heat, then add beef and stir until browned. Add pepper and salt, then other ingredients. Mix well, then put in a large casserole. Bake for 1 hour at 350°.

recipes.title: Ice Cream Sandwich
directions: Put the whip cream on the graham cracker and top with another cracker.
Wrap in foil and freeze.
Low-fat.
recipes.text: Ice Cream Sandwich. Put the whip cream on the graham cracker and top with another cracker. Wrap in foil and freeze. Low-fat.

recipes.title: Rhubarb Sauce
directions: In a medium saucepan, combine sugar and 1/4 cup water.
Bring to a boil.
Add rhubarb.
Reduce heat.
Cover and simmer for 5 to 10 minutes.
Add strawberries and simmer for another 5 minutes.
recipes.text: Rhubarb Sauce. In a medium saucepan, combine sugar and 1/4 cup water. Bring to a boil. Add rhubarb. Reduce heat. Cover and simmer for 5 to 10 minutes. Add strawberries and simmer for another 5 minutes.

recipes.title: Cranberry Pear Pie
ingredients: 2 C pared, sliced fresh pears (3 pears)
Pastry for two crust 9 inch pie
directions: In saucepan, combine cranberries and water.
Bring to boil and simmer 3 minutes.
Mix sugar, cornstarch an cinnamon and add to hot cranberries.
Cook quickly, stirring constantly, until mixture thickens and bubbles.
Remove from heat.
Gently stir in pears.
recipes.text: Cranberry Pear Pie. In saucepan, combine cranberries and water. Bring to boil and simmer 3 minutes. Mix sugar, cornstarch an cinnamon and add to hot cranberries. Cook quickly, stirring constantly, until mixture thickens and bubbles. Remove from heat. Gently stir in pears.

recipes.title: Chinese Casserole
ingredients: 1 lb. ground beef, browned and drained
1 can cream of chicken soup, undiluted
1 can cream of mushroom soup, undiluted
directions: Combine all ingredients except chow mein noodles.
Mix well and turn into a large casserole.
Cover and bake at 350° for 1 hour.
Remove cover; top with chow mein noodles and bake 10 to 15 minutes longer.
Serves 6.
recipes.text: Chinese Casserole. Combine all ingredients except chow mein noodles. Mix well and turn into a large casserole. Cover and bake at 350° for 1 hour. Remove cover; top with chow mein noodles and bake 10 to 15 minutes longer. Serves 6.

recipes.title: Sugar-Free Coconut Pie
directions: Mix all ingredients together.
Pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake at 350° for 45 to 60 minutes.
recipes.text: Sugar-Free Coconut Pie. Mix all ingredients together. Pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake at 350° for 45 to 60 minutes.

recipes.title: Strawberry Dessert
ingredients: 1/2 pt. whipping cream (whipped) or Cool Whip
directions: Use deep round dish.
Cut pound cake and layer cake and strawberries; beginning with cake and ending with strawberries. Top with:
egg yolks beaten with confectioners sugar.
Beat this until mixture is pale yellow.
Add the whipped cream or Cool Whip. Mix well.
Refrigerate.
Is better when sets several hours to allow cake to absorb juice from berries.
recipes.text: Strawberry Dessert. Use deep round dish. Cut pound cake and layer cake and strawberries; beginning with cake and ending with strawberries. Top with: egg yolks beaten with confectioners sugar. Beat this until mixture is pale yellow. Add the whipped cream or Cool Whip. Mix well. Refrigerate. Is better when sets several hours to allow cake to absorb juice from berries.

recipes.title: Honey Baked Chicken
directions: Preheat oven to 350°.
Place breast in baking pan.
Combine all other ingredients for sauce.
Pour sauce over chicken; bake for 1 1/4 hours, basting every 15 minutes, until chicken is tender and nicely browned.
recipes.text: Honey Baked Chicken. Preheat oven to 350°. Place breast in baking pan. Combine all other ingredients for sauce. Pour sauce over chicken; bake for 1 1/4 hours, basting every 15 minutes, until chicken is tender and nicely browned.

recipes.title: Lee'S Fig Cake
directions: Use Bundt pan and spray with Pam.
Combine ingredients.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Lee'S Fig Cake. Use Bundt pan and spray with Pam. Combine ingredients. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Mama'S Molasses Cookies
ingredients: 1/2 c. boiling water with 1 Tbsp. soda dissolved in it
directions: Combine all ingredients, except flour, and mix well. Gradually add flour until you have a stiff dough.
Roll out and cut into desired shapes.
(Great for gingerbread men.) Bake at 350° for 8 to 10 minutes.
recipes.text: Mama'S Molasses Cookies. Combine all ingredients, except flour, and mix well. Gradually add flour until you have a stiff dough. Roll out and cut into desired shapes. (Great for gingerbread men.) Bake at 350° for 8 to 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Vidalias And Rice
directions: Melt 4 tablespoons butter in 3-quart casserole until foamy. Add onions.
Stir until well coated.
Add rice and salt.
Cook in a 300° oven about 1 hour, stirring 2 to 3 times.
Just before serving, add milk, cheese and parsley.
Stir until cheese is melted and well mixed.
recipes.text: Vidalias And Rice. Melt 4 tablespoons butter in 3-quart casserole until foamy. Add onions. Stir until well coated. Add rice and salt. Cook in a 300° oven about 1 hour, stirring 2 to 3 times. Just before serving, add milk, cheese and parsley. Stir until cheese is melted and well mixed.

recipes.title: Barbecue
directions: Brown meat; drain off any fat.
Add onion and green pepper. Add other ingredients and simmer for about 30 minutes. Serve on buns.
recipes.text: Barbecue. Brown meat; drain off any fat. Add onion and green pepper. Add other ingredients and simmer for about 30 minutes. Serve on buns.

recipes.title: Frozen Viennese Coffee Pie
directions: Soften vanilla yogurt to spreading consistency. Spread in an even layer on bottom of crumb crust.
Drizzle with 2 tablespoons of the chocolate sauce.
Place in freezer.
Chill 1 hour or until firm.
Soften coffee yogurt to spreading consistency. Spread in an even layer over vanilla yogurt. Drizzle with remaining 1 tablespoon sauce in a lace pattern. Cover and freeze until firm.
recipes.text: Frozen Viennese Coffee Pie. Soften vanilla yogurt to spreading consistency. Spread in an even layer on bottom of crumb crust. Drizzle with 2 tablespoons of the chocolate sauce. Place in freezer. Chill 1 hour or until firm. Soften coffee yogurt to spreading consistency. Spread in an even layer over vanilla yogurt. Drizzle with remaining 1 tablespoon sauce in a lace pattern. Cover and freeze until firm.

recipes.title: Baked Zucchini Casserole
directions: Place above ingredients in a mixing bowl.
Heat oven to 325°. Great for 1 1/2-quart casserole.
Melt 2 tablespoons butter in skillet.
Saute onion until golden.
Steam squash until tender, but still crisp.
Add squash, cheese and eggs.
Mix well.
Turn into casserole.
Sprinkle with crumbs; dot with remaining butter. Bake 45 minutes or until set and lightly browned.
recipes.text: Baked Zucchini Casserole. Place above ingredients in a mixing bowl. Heat oven to 325°. Great for 1 1/2-quart casserole. Melt 2 tablespoons butter in skillet. Saute onion until golden. Steam squash until tender, but still crisp. Add squash, cheese and eggs. Mix well. Turn into casserole. Sprinkle with crumbs; dot with remaining butter. Bake 45 minutes or until set and lightly browned.

recipes.title: Banana Cookies
ingredients: 1 c. creamy or superchunk peanut butter
directions: Preheat oven to 350°.
In a medium bowl, combine oats, flour, baking powder, baking soda and salt.
In a large bowl with mixer at medium speed, beat peanut butter and margarine until smooth. Beat in sugars until blended.
Beat in banana, egg and vanilla. Stir in flour mixture.
Drop dough by one-fourth cupfuls, about 5 inches apart, onto ungreased cookie sheets.
With spatula, spread dough into 3 1/2-inch circles.
Bake in a 350° oven for 10 to 12 minutes or until golden.
Let cool on cookie sheets for 4 minutes. Remove from cookie sheets; cool completely on a wire rack.
If desired, pipe a stars or stripes frosting design, using plain piping, onto each cookie.
Store in a tightly-covered container. Makes about 24 cookies.
recipes.text: Banana Cookies. Preheat oven to 350°. In a medium bowl, combine oats, flour, baking powder, baking soda and salt. In a large bowl with mixer at medium speed, beat peanut butter and margarine until smooth. Beat in sugars until blended. Beat in banana, egg and vanilla. Stir in flour mixture. Drop dough by one-fourth cupfuls, about 5 inches apart, onto ungreased cookie sheets. With spatula, spread dough into 3 1/2-inch circles. Bake in a 350° oven for 10 to 12 minutes or until golden. Let cool on cookie sheets for 4 minutes. Remove from cookie sheets; cool completely on a wire rack. If desired, pipe a stars or stripes frosting design, using plain piping, onto each cookie. Store in a tightly-covered container. Makes about 24 cookies.

recipes.title: Jam Cake
directions: Sift flour once, then measure.
Add dry ingredients; sift 3 times.
Cream sugar and shortening well.
Add eggs, milk, jam and raisins.
Mix lightly and pour in two 9-inch square pans.
Bake at 350° approximately 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Jam Cake. Sift flour once, then measure. Add dry ingredients; sift 3 times. Cream sugar and shortening well. Add eggs, milk, jam and raisins. Mix lightly and pour in two 9-inch square pans. Bake at 350° approximately 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Cranapple Mold
directions: Dissolve Jell-O completely in boiling water.
Stir in cranberry sauce until melted.
Add applesauce.
Pour into greased mold.
Refrigerate until set, unmold onto plate.
recipes.text: Cranapple Mold. Dissolve Jell-O completely in boiling water. Stir in cranberry sauce until melted. Add applesauce. Pour into greased mold. Refrigerate until set, unmold onto plate.

recipes.title: Tasty Toss Up
ingredients: 1 (12 1/2 oz.) can tuna, drained and flaked (2 c.)
directions: Cook pasta; drain and cool.
In large bowl, combine pasta, tuna, cucumbers, tomato, celery, green peppers and onions.
In a small bowl, blend together dressing, mayonnaise, mustard and seasonings.
Add to salad mixture.
Toss to coat.
Cover and chill.
recipes.text: Tasty Toss Up. Cook pasta; drain and cool. In large bowl, combine pasta, tuna, cucumbers, tomato, celery, green peppers and onions. In a small bowl, blend together dressing, mayonnaise, mustard and seasonings. Add to salad mixture. Toss to coat. Cover and chill.

recipes.title: Chicken Curry
directions: Sprinkle chicken pieces with salt and pepper.
Melt 4 tablespoons of butter in skillet.
Add chicken pieces and cook 5 minutes on one side until golden.
Add onion, celery, garlic and curry powder.
Stir well and cook 5 more minutes.
Add bay leaf, apples and banana and cook 5 more minutes, stirring gently.
Add chicken broth and simmer 15 minutes or until chicken is tender. Remove chicken pieces and stir cream or yogurt into sauce.
Return chicken to sauce.
Serve with rice.
recipes.text: Chicken Curry. Sprinkle chicken pieces with salt and pepper. Melt 4 tablespoons of butter in skillet. Add chicken pieces and cook 5 minutes on one side until golden. Add onion, celery, garlic and curry powder. Stir well and cook 5 more minutes. Add bay leaf, apples and banana and cook 5 more minutes, stirring gently. Add chicken broth and simmer 15 minutes or until chicken is tender. Remove chicken pieces and stir cream or yogurt into sauce. Return chicken to sauce. Serve with rice.

recipes.title: Chocolate Oatmeal Cookies
directions: Blend oleo and sugars.
Add eggs and vanilla. Blend with mixer or spoon the flour, cocoa, soda, salt, oats and nuts.
Add chocolate chips.
Bake at 350° for 9 to 10 minutes.
Don't overbake.
recipes.text: Chocolate Oatmeal Cookies. Blend oleo and sugars. Add eggs and vanilla. Blend with mixer or spoon the flour, cocoa, soda, salt, oats and nuts. Add chocolate chips. Bake at 350° for 9 to 10 minutes. Don't overbake.

recipes.title: Lasagna
directions: Cook noodles according to package directions and drain.
In a skillet brown ground beef.
Add to meat, 1/2 of the spaghetti sauce, tomato paste, garlic salt and oregano.
Simmer for 10 minutes.
recipes.text: Lasagna. Cook noodles according to package directions and drain. In a skillet brown ground beef. Add to meat, 1/2 of the spaghetti sauce, tomato paste, garlic salt and oregano. Simmer for 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Hot Artichoke Dip
directions: Drain and chop artichoke hearts.
Mix with mayonnaise, cheese and add garlic powder to taste.
Put in baking dish.
Heat at 350° for 20 minutes or until bubbly.
Serve with Wheat Thins or crackers.
recipes.text: Hot Artichoke Dip. Drain and chop artichoke hearts. Mix with mayonnaise, cheese and add garlic powder to taste. Put in baking dish. Heat at 350° for 20 minutes or until bubbly. Serve with Wheat Thins or crackers.

recipes.title: Cream Cheese Bars
directions: Roll out 1 package of crescent rolls in a lightly greased 9 X 13 baking dish.
Pat out rolls into corners if necessary.
Mix cream cheese, 1 cup sugar, and vanilla.
Spread mixture over crescent rolls.
Cover cream cheese mixture with a layer of crescent rolls.
Melt 1/4 cup margarine.
Add remaining sugar and cinnamon.
Spread over top.
Bake 350 degrees for 20-25 minutes.
recipes.text: Cream Cheese Bars. Roll out 1 package of crescent rolls in a lightly greased 9 X 13 baking dish. Pat out rolls into corners if necessary. Mix cream cheese, 1 cup sugar, and vanilla. Spread mixture over crescent rolls. Cover cream cheese mixture with a layer of crescent rolls. Melt 1/4 cup margarine. Add remaining sugar and cinnamon. Spread over top. Bake 350 degrees for 20-25 minutes.

recipes.title: French Custard Pe
directions: Mix all ingredients together in bowl.
Pour into pie shell and bake for 10 minutes at 400°, then reduce heat to 350°.
Bake for 30 minutes longer.
recipes.text: French Custard Pe. Mix all ingredients together in bowl. Pour into pie shell and bake for 10 minutes at 400°, then reduce heat to 350°. Bake for 30 minutes longer.

recipes.title: Barbecue Sweet Potatoes
ingredients: 1 Tbsp. ancho or regular chili powder
directions: Preheat oven to 400°. On foil-lined baking sheet, bake potatoes 1 hour until just tender; let cool. (Can be roasted a day ahead and refrigerated; bring to room temperature to continue.)
recipes.text: Barbecue Sweet Potatoes. Preheat oven to 400°. On foil-lined baking sheet, bake potatoes 1 hour until just tender; let cool. (Can be roasted a day ahead and refrigerated; bring to room temperature to continue.)

recipes.title: Caddo Relish
directions: Heat very hot, but do not boil.
Can immediately.
Makes 9 pints.
recipes.text: Caddo Relish. Heat very hot, but do not boil. Can immediately. Makes 9 pints.

recipes.title: Cinnamon Red Hot Cucumber Pickles
ingredients: 7 lb. cucumbers, peeled and sliced in 1/4-inch rings
directions: Peel, seed and slice cucumbers.
Soak in lime and 1 gallon water for 24 hours.
Wash; soak covered with ice water for 3 hours.
Mix 1 cup vinegar, red food coloring, alum and water to cover.
Pour over cucumbers and simmer 2 hours; pour off water. Bring 2 cups vinegar, 2 cups water, sugar, cinnamon sticks and red hots to boil.
Pour over cucumbers and let stand 24 hours; pour off and boil.
Pour over cucumbers in jars and seal.
These cucumbers taste like cinnamon apple rings.
recipes.text: Cinnamon Red Hot Cucumber Pickles. Peel, seed and slice cucumbers. Soak in lime and 1 gallon water for 24 hours. Wash; soak covered with ice water for 3 hours. Mix 1 cup vinegar, red food coloring, alum and water to cover. Pour over cucumbers and simmer 2 hours; pour off water. Bring 2 cups vinegar, 2 cups water, sugar, cinnamon sticks and red hots to boil. Pour over cucumbers and let stand 24 hours; pour off and boil. Pour over cucumbers in jars and seal. These cucumbers taste like cinnamon apple rings.

recipes.title: Divinity
ingredients: 1 c. nuts (walnuts, pecans or almonds, if desired)
directions: Boil sugar, water and white corn syrup until hard boil stage. Pour hot mixture into stiffly beaten egg whites; continue beating on high speed of mixer.
Add vanilla and powdered sugar.
Beat until mixture loses its gloss.
Add nuts, if desired.
Pour onto marble.
Cool.
Store in airtight container.
recipes.text: Divinity. Boil sugar, water and white corn syrup until hard boil stage. Pour hot mixture into stiffly beaten egg whites; continue beating on high speed of mixer. Add vanilla and powdered sugar. Beat until mixture loses its gloss. Add nuts, if desired. Pour onto marble. Cool. Store in airtight container.

recipes.title: Squash Stir-Fry
ingredients: 2 Tbsp. vegetable oil or peanut oil
1 large onion, sliced and separated into rings
3 medium size yellow squash, thinly sliced
directions: Pour oil into iron frying pan or hot wok, coating sides until bottom is covered with oil.
Add garlic and onion; stir-fry 1 minute.
Stir in zucchini and yellow squash.
Cook 2 to 3 minutes or until crisp-tender.
Add tomatoes (optional), salt and pepper. Stir well.
Sprinkle cheese over vegetables, stirring just until cheese melts.
Yields about 6 servings.
recipes.text: Squash Stir-Fry. Pour oil into iron frying pan or hot wok, coating sides until bottom is covered with oil. Add garlic and onion; stir-fry 1 minute. Stir in zucchini and yellow squash. Cook 2 to 3 minutes or until crisp-tender. Add tomatoes (optional), salt and pepper. Stir well. Sprinkle cheese over vegetables, stirring just until cheese melts. Yields about 6 servings.

recipes.title: Fried Pizza
directions: Mix dough (flour, salt, shortening and water).
Let rest a few minutes.
Preheat oil to 365°.
Roll dough into rounds.
Put 1 tablespoon sauce and 1 tablespoon cheese in middle of circle of dough.
Fold dough over; seal edges.
Other toppings can be added to sauce and cheese.
Fry 3 minutes, turning once until pizzas are golden brown.
recipes.text: Fried Pizza. Mix dough (flour, salt, shortening and water). Let rest a few minutes. Preheat oil to 365°. Roll dough into rounds. Put 1 tablespoon sauce and 1 tablespoon cheese in middle of circle of dough. Fold dough over; seal edges. Other toppings can be added to sauce and cheese. Fry 3 minutes, turning once until pizzas are golden brown.

recipes.title: Fruit Cocktail Cake
directions: Beat eggs and sugar until lemon colored.
Stir in remaining ingredients and pour into oblong pan.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Fruit Cocktail Cake. Beat eggs and sugar until lemon colored. Stir in remaining ingredients and pour into oblong pan. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Carrots That Even Kids Will Eat
directions: Melt margarine and Velveeta cheese.
Steam carrots and drain. Fold into cheese mixture.
Pour into greased casserole dish; top with crushed Ritz crackers.
Bake for 30 minutes at 350°.
recipes.text: Carrots That Even Kids Will Eat. Melt margarine and Velveeta cheese. Steam carrots and drain. Fold into cheese mixture. Pour into greased casserole dish; top with crushed Ritz crackers. Bake for 30 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Hot Cheese Dip
directions: Melt Cheddar cheese in a double boiler with milk.
Add garlic salt.
Serve in a fondue dish with crackers or dip chips.
recipes.text: Hot Cheese Dip. Melt Cheddar cheese in a double boiler with milk. Add garlic salt. Serve in a fondue dish with crackers or dip chips.

recipes.title: Spoon Bread
directions: Mix meal, salt and shortening and scald with boiling water. Add well beaten eggs, milk and baking powder.
Bake in a greased deep pan or casserole in moderate oven.
Serve from pan with spoon.
recipes.text: Spoon Bread. Mix meal, salt and shortening and scald with boiling water. Add well beaten eggs, milk and baking powder. Bake in a greased deep pan or casserole in moderate oven. Serve from pan with spoon.

recipes.title: Apple Crisp
directions: Ahead of time mix
apples,
cornstarch and brown sugar. Separately	mix
oil,
oatmeal
and
brown	sugar.	Put
apple mixture in Dutch oven and
cover with oatmeal topping mixture. Set on medium coals for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Apple Crisp. Ahead of time mix apples, cornstarch and brown sugar. Separately	mix oil, oatmeal and brown	sugar.	Put apple mixture in Dutch oven and cover with oatmeal topping mixture. Set on medium coals for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Shoo-Fly Pie(A Pennsylvania Dutch Favorite)
directions: Put 1/2 of crumb mixture (flour, sugar, butter and baking powder) in each shell. Pour 3/4 juice mixture (molasses, hot water and baking soda) in each shell. Pour 1/2 of remaining juice mixture over each shell. Bake at 400° for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Shoo-Fly Pie(A Pennsylvania Dutch Favorite). Put 1/2 of crumb mixture (flour, sugar, butter and baking powder) in each shell. Pour 3/4 juice mixture (molasses, hot water and baking soda) in each shell. Pour 1/2 of remaining juice mixture over each shell. Bake at 400° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Custard Pie
directions: Bake at 425° for 10 minutes and turn oven to 350°; bake for 20 to 25 minutes.
recipes.text: Custard Pie. Bake at 425° for 10 minutes and turn oven to 350°; bake for 20 to 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Crabmeat Dip
directions: Mix together and serve.
recipes.text: Crabmeat Dip. Mix together and serve.

recipes.title: Beef Roast(Marinated)
ingredients: 2 medium onions, chopped or 1 Tbsp. onion powder
2 cloves garlic or 1 tsp. garlic powder
directions: Mix dry ingredients and rub into meat on both sides.
Place in baking dish and dribble the lemon juice, vinegar and salad oil over meat.
Cover dish and turn meat occasionally for 4 hours or more.
(I let meat marinate overnight.)
Cover meat with sliced onions.
Add water and bake at 300° for 2 hours.
recipes.text: Beef Roast(Marinated). Mix dry ingredients and rub into meat on both sides. Place in baking dish and dribble the lemon juice, vinegar and salad oil over meat. Cover dish and turn meat occasionally for 4 hours or more. (I let meat marinate overnight.) Cover meat with sliced onions. Add water and bake at 300° for 2 hours.

recipes.title: Beef Stroganoff
ingredients: 1 lb. beef round steaks, cut 1/8 to 1/4-inch thick
directions: Cook noodles and drain; keeping warm.
Stack beef strips. cut into 1 inch strips.
In large skillet, heat 2 tsp. oil over medium heat until hot.
Add beef and garlic; stir fry 1 minute or until outside of meat is no longer pink.
Remove from skillet; season with salt and pepper.
In same skillet, cook mushrooms in remaining oil until tender.
Remove from heat.
Add brown gravy mix and water; blend well.
Over medium heat bring to boil.
Reduce heat, simmer until gravy has thickened, stirring frequently.
Add beef back into gravy mixture; heat through.
Serve over noodles; top with sour cream.
Serves 4.
recipes.text: Beef Stroganoff. Cook noodles and drain; keeping warm. Stack beef strips. cut into 1 inch strips. In large skillet, heat 2 tsp. oil over medium heat until hot. Add beef and garlic; stir fry 1 minute or until outside of meat is no longer pink. Remove from skillet; season with salt and pepper. In same skillet, cook mushrooms in remaining oil until tender. Remove from heat. Add brown gravy mix and water; blend well. Over medium heat bring to boil. Reduce heat, simmer until gravy has thickened, stirring frequently. Add beef back into gravy mixture; heat through. Serve over noodles; top with sour cream. Serves 4.

recipes.title: Mom'S Easy Ham Sandwiches
directions: Mix together onions, poppy seed, melted butter and mustard.
recipes.text: Mom'S Easy Ham Sandwiches. Mix together onions, poppy seed, melted butter and mustard.

recipes.title: Vegetable Dip
directions: Beat cottage cheese with mixer until smooth or unlumpy.
Add other ingredients.
Mix.
Best if made several hours before serving.
recipes.text: Vegetable Dip. Beat cottage cheese with mixer until smooth or unlumpy. Add other ingredients. Mix. Best if made several hours before serving.

recipes.title: Graham Cracker Crust
directions: Using a food processor, mix graham crackers to desired consistency (net 2 cups).
Place in mixing bowl.
Melt the spread and add into graham crackers and mix by hand using a fork, blending together until sticky and completely blended.
Put mixture into pie plate and form into crust.
Place in freeze to harden.
(There may be some mixture leftover to add on top, if desired.)
Makes enough for one 8-inch diameter by 1 inch deep pie plate.
recipes.text: Graham Cracker Crust. Using a food processor, mix graham crackers to desired consistency (net 2 cups). Place in mixing bowl. Melt the spread and add into graham crackers and mix by hand using a fork, blending together until sticky and completely blended. Put mixture into pie plate and form into crust. Place in freeze to harden. (There may be some mixture leftover to add on top, if desired.) Makes enough for one 8-inch diameter by 1 inch deep pie plate.

recipes.title: No Ball Sugar Cookies
directions: With mixer, mix sugars, oleo and oil, then beat in eggs and vanilla.
Sift together the flour, baking soda and cream of tartar.
Add them to mixture.
Cover and place in refrigerator for several hours or overnight.
Form into small balls and roll in sugar.
Flatten with fork.
Bake at 350° for 10 to 15 minutes.
recipes.text: No Ball Sugar Cookies. With mixer, mix sugars, oleo and oil, then beat in eggs and vanilla. Sift together the flour, baking soda and cream of tartar. Add them to mixture. Cover and place in refrigerator for several hours or overnight. Form into small balls and roll in sugar. Flatten with fork. Bake at 350° for 10 to 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Stir-Fry Veggies
directions: In a large skillet over high heat in hot oil, cook onion, carrots, broccoli and cauliflower, stirring quickly and often, for 3 to 4 minutes.
Add olives, seasonings and water; cover and cook for 4 minutes, stirring occasionally, until vegetables are crisp-tender.
Makes 4 to 6 servings.
recipes.text: Stir-Fry Veggies. In a large skillet over high heat in hot oil, cook onion, carrots, broccoli and cauliflower, stirring quickly and often, for 3 to 4 minutes. Add olives, seasonings and water; cover and cook for 4 minutes, stirring occasionally, until vegetables are crisp-tender. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

recipes.title: Carrot Bread
directions: Cook carrots; place carrots in blender and grate coarsely, but do not puree.
In a large bowl, combine flour, salt, baking soda, cinnamon and nutmeg.
Stir together carrots, oil, eggs, water and vanilla.
Add dry ingredients.
Stir until blended.
Pour batter into greased loaf pan.
Bake at 350° for 65 to 75 minutes, or until done.
Check every so often to see if done.
Cool for 10 minutes.
Remove from pan and serve.
recipes.text: Carrot Bread. Cook carrots; place carrots in blender and grate coarsely, but do not puree. In a large bowl, combine flour, salt, baking soda, cinnamon and nutmeg. Stir together carrots, oil, eggs, water and vanilla. Add dry ingredients. Stir until blended. Pour batter into greased loaf pan. Bake at 350° for 65 to 75 minutes, or until done. Check every so often to see if done. Cool for 10 minutes. Remove from pan and serve.

recipes.title: Buckeyes
directions: Mix together all but Hershey bar and chocolate chips after crushing the cereal.
Roll into balls and freeze.
Dip in mixture of Hershey bar and chocolate chips.
recipes.text: Buckeyes. Mix together all but Hershey bar and chocolate chips after crushing the cereal. Roll into balls and freeze. Dip in mixture of Hershey bar and chocolate chips.

recipes.title: Liberian Sauce And Rice
ingredients: 2 to 4 c. greens (collards, mustard, okra, green beans, etc.)
meat, fish or poultry (fresh or dried)
directions: Saute onions and peppers in oil.
Add meat to sear and brown. Chop greens very fine and add to pot and cover for 2 to 3 minutes, until greens appear slick.
Stir and add other ingredients.
Simmer for 10 to 15 minutes on low heat.
Serve over steamed rice.
recipes.text: Liberian Sauce And Rice. Saute onions and peppers in oil. Add meat to sear and brown. Chop greens very fine and add to pot and cover for 2 to 3 minutes, until greens appear slick. Stir and add other ingredients. Simmer for 10 to 15 minutes on low heat. Serve over steamed rice.

recipes.title: Chocolate Fudge Pie
directions: Mix sugar and cocoa.
Add flour.
Add remainder of ingredients.
Mix well and pour into pie crust.
Bake 30 to 40 minutes at 350°.
recipes.text: Chocolate Fudge Pie. Mix sugar and cocoa. Add flour. Add remainder of ingredients. Mix well and pour into pie crust. Bake 30 to 40 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Roll
directions: Combine eggs and sugar; beat well.
Add pumpkin and lemon juice; mix until blended.
In a separate bowl, combine flour, baking powder, spices and salt.
Add to egg mixture.
Mix well.
recipes.text: Pumpkin Roll. Combine eggs and sugar; beat well. Add pumpkin and lemon juice; mix until blended. In a separate bowl, combine flour, baking powder, spices and salt. Add to egg mixture. Mix well.

recipes.title: Super Luscious Freeze
directions: Combine milk and pineapple with juice. In a 5-quart container, combine pineapple mixture and enough orange soda to fill container. Freeze until firm.
recipes.text: Super Luscious Freeze. Combine milk and pineapple with juice. In a 5-quart container, combine pineapple mixture and enough orange soda to fill container. Freeze until firm.

recipes.title: Bird Stew
ingredients: 6 lb. potatoes (1/2 cut small, the other 1/2 large)
2 (14 oz.) bottles Heinz catsup (add when nearly done)
directions: Cook until birds are done and the meat begins to fall from bones.
Add half of the catsup and Worcestershire sauce after it has cooked 45 minutes and the other half about 1/2 hour before it is done.
Then, the flavor cooks into the meat.
Hope you like it.
recipes.text: Bird Stew. Cook until birds are done and the meat begins to fall from bones. Add half of the catsup and Worcestershire sauce after it has cooked 45 minutes and the other half about 1/2 hour before it is done. Then, the flavor cooks into the meat. Hope you like it.

recipes.title: Tea Cakes
directions: Cream butter and sugar; add eggs and beat well.
Add baking soda dissolved in vinegar and salt.
Add flour, a little at a time, to make a stiff batter.
Roll thin and cut.
Place on a greased cookie sheet and bake at 350°.
recipes.text: Tea Cakes. Cream butter and sugar; add eggs and beat well. Add baking soda dissolved in vinegar and salt. Add flour, a little at a time, to make a stiff batter. Roll thin and cut. Place on a greased cookie sheet and bake at 350°.

recipes.title: Cornflake Candy
directions: Bring sugar and syrup to a boil. Mix in the ingredients. Make balls and mash flat on wax paper.
recipes.text: Cornflake Candy. Bring sugar and syrup to a boil. Mix in the ingredients. Make balls and mash flat on wax paper.

recipes.title: Pizza Hot Dish
directions: Mix together. Spread Mozzarella or Cheddar cheese on top. Bake at 350° until cheese melts and is brown.
recipes.text: Pizza Hot Dish. Mix together. Spread Mozzarella or Cheddar cheese on top. Bake at 350° until cheese melts and is brown.

recipes.title: Cocoa Kiss Cookies
directions: Cream butter; gradually add sugar, beating until light and fluffy.
Add vanilla, mixing well.
Add flour, cocoa and baking powder; stir in walnuts.
Chill dough 2 hours.
recipes.text: Cocoa Kiss Cookies. Cream butter; gradually add sugar, beating until light and fluffy. Add vanilla, mixing well. Add flour, cocoa and baking powder; stir in walnuts. Chill dough 2 hours.

recipes.title: Unbelievable Fudge
directions: Melt butter and cheese over low heat, stirring constantly. Take off heat; stir in vanilla.
Pour over sugar and cocoa that has been blended together.
Mix quickly.
Spread in buttered 9 x 13-inch pan.
Press in nuts.
Let set 2 hours.
Cut into squares.
recipes.text: Unbelievable Fudge. Melt butter and cheese over low heat, stirring constantly. Take off heat; stir in vanilla. Pour over sugar and cocoa that has been blended together. Mix quickly. Spread in buttered 9 x 13-inch pan. Press in nuts. Let set 2 hours. Cut into squares.

recipes.title: Devil'S Food Cake
directions: Cream 2 cups sugar with 1/2 cup butter.
Add 2 eggs, beating well after each.
Sift two cups flour and 1/2 teaspoon salt.
Add to cream mixture along with 1 cup buttermilk.
Mix together, 1 cup hot water, 1/2 cup cocoa, 1 teaspoon soda.
Mix with other ingredients, and add 1 teaspoon vanilla.
2 greased and floured pans, 9-inch.
Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.
recipes.text: Devil'S Food Cake. Cream 2 cups sugar with 1/2 cup butter. Add 2 eggs, beating well after each. Sift two cups flour and 1/2 teaspoon salt. Add to cream mixture along with 1 cup buttermilk. Mix together, 1 cup hot water, 1/2 cup cocoa, 1 teaspoon soda. Mix with other ingredients, and add 1 teaspoon vanilla. 2 greased and floured pans, 9-inch. Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.

recipes.title: One Christmas Pitta(An Italian Pastry Made In Calabria, Italy)
ingredients: 1/2 tsp. yeast, dissolved in small amount of warm water
directions: Make a pile of flour; make a well in flour.
Add eggs, salt, Crisco and yeast.
Mix with hands.
Roll into circle like pie crust; brush with melted butter.
Sprinkle with sugar, raisins, nuts, cloves and some honey.
Cut in 2-inch wide strips.
Fold in half each strip lengthwise and roll into rosette.
Tie rosettes with thread.
Arrange together closely forming a circle and tie together.
Brush top with small amount of vegetable oil.
Line cookie sheet with brown paper bag.
Bake at 325° for 30 to 35 minutes or until brown.
Spread with honey while hot.
(Freezes well.)
recipes.text: One Christmas Pitta(An Italian Pastry Made In Calabria, Italy). Make a pile of flour; make a well in flour. Add eggs, salt, Crisco and yeast. Mix with hands. Roll into circle like pie crust; brush with melted butter. Sprinkle with sugar, raisins, nuts, cloves and some honey. Cut in 2-inch wide strips. Fold in half each strip lengthwise and roll into rosette. Tie rosettes with thread. Arrange together closely forming a circle and tie together. Brush top with small amount of vegetable oil. Line cookie sheet with brown paper bag. Bake at 325° for 30 to 35 minutes or until brown. Spread with honey while hot. (Freezes well.)

recipes.title: Broccoli Lima Bake
directions: Cook vegetables, barely tender.
Blend soup, sour cream and onion; stir into cooked vegetables.
Add chestnuts.
Pour into buttered casserole.
Top with Rice Krispies that have been lightly browned in oleo.
Cover loosely with foil.
Bake 30 minutes at 350°.
recipes.text: Broccoli Lima Bake. Cook vegetables, barely tender. Blend soup, sour cream and onion; stir into cooked vegetables. Add chestnuts. Pour into buttered casserole. Top with Rice Krispies that have been lightly browned in oleo. Cover loosely with foil. Bake 30 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Roast Turkey
directions: Defrost time:
A 20 pound bird takes 3 days in refrigerator or 12 hours in sink of water.
Remove giblets as soon as thawed. Roast time:
Unstuffed, chilled turkey at 325° for 16 to 20 pounds is 4 to 6 hours; 20 to 26 pounds, 5 1/2 to 7 1/2 hours.
Baste turkey frequently with melted butter and pan juices during cooking time.
recipes.text: Roast Turkey. Defrost time: A 20 pound bird takes 3 days in refrigerator or 12 hours in sink of water. Remove giblets as soon as thawed. Roast time: Unstuffed, chilled turkey at 325° for 16 to 20 pounds is 4 to 6 hours; 20 to 26 pounds, 5 1/2 to 7 1/2 hours. Baste turkey frequently with melted butter and pan juices during cooking time.

recipes.title: Rhubarb Cake
ingredients: 1 c. buttermilk or sour milk with 1 tsp. baking soda
directions: Mix ingredients as listed.
Mix well after each addition.
Fold in rhubarb last.
Pour in baking dish.
Mix 1/2 cup brown sugar, 1 teaspoon cinnamon, 1/2 cup chopped nuts well.
Sprinkle over top of cake and cut into cake with knife.
Bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Rhubarb Cake. Mix ingredients as listed. Mix well after each addition. Fold in rhubarb last. Pour in baking dish. Mix 1/2 cup brown sugar, 1 teaspoon cinnamon, 1/2 cup chopped nuts well. Sprinkle over top of cake and cut into cake with knife. Bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Prime Rib
directions: Cover meat with all ingredients.
Cover with rock salt all over top.
Bake, uncovered, at 200° for 3 to 4 hours or if a large roast, bake 7 to 8 hours.
recipes.text: Prime Rib. Cover meat with all ingredients. Cover with rock salt all over top. Bake, uncovered, at 200° for 3 to 4 hours or if a large roast, bake 7 to 8 hours.

recipes.title: Easy Chicken Cacciatore
ingredients: 1 medium green pepper, sliced into 1/4-inch strips
8 oz. seashell macaroni, cooked and drained
directions: Preheat oven to 350°.
In a large skillet, saute garlic and green pepper until tender; remove and set aside.
Brown chicken on both sides.
Cook 30 minutes or until tender.
Add spaghetti sauce and green pepper; simmer, covered, 10 minutes.
Place pasta in an 11 x 7-inch baking dish.
Spoon chicken and sauce over pasta. Bake, covered, for 20 minutes or until bubbly.
Serves 4.
recipes.text: Easy Chicken Cacciatore. Preheat oven to 350°. In a large skillet, saute garlic and green pepper until tender; remove and set aside. Brown chicken on both sides. Cook 30 minutes or until tender. Add spaghetti sauce and green pepper; simmer, covered, 10 minutes. Place pasta in an 11 x 7-inch baking dish. Spoon chicken and sauce over pasta. Bake, covered, for 20 minutes or until bubbly. Serves 4.

recipes.title: Minnesota Wild Rice And Ham Casserole
ingredients: 2 c. cooked cubed ham or chicken
1 can (10 oz.) cream of celery soup
directions: Cook rice according to package directions.
Spread in bottom of greased 9 x 13-inch pan.
Cook and drain broccoli.
Layer on rice.
Then sprinkle ham and cover with cheese.
Combine soup, mayonnaise and mustard.
Spread over casserole and top with Parmesan cheese.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes or until golden in color.
recipes.text: Minnesota Wild Rice And Ham Casserole. Cook rice according to package directions. Spread in bottom of greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Cook and drain broccoli. Layer on rice. Then sprinkle ham and cover with cheese. Combine soup, mayonnaise and mustard. Spread over casserole and top with Parmesan cheese. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes or until golden in color.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Cookies
directions: Combine all ingredients.
Grease cookie sheet.
Bake at 350° for 12 to 15 minutes.
recipes.text: Peanut Butter Cookies. Combine all ingredients. Grease cookie sheet. Bake at 350° for 12 to 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Ray'S Ultimate Ham Roll-Ups
ingredients: 3 (8 oz. each) pkg. Philadelphia cream cheese
directions: Allow cream cheese to reach room temperature and thoroughly blend with bacon-horseradish dip. Spread mixture heavily onto slice of shaved ham and roll each one into a log. Cut each log into 3 pieces and insert a toothpick into each one. Arrange Ham Roll-Ups in a spoke pattern, place on a large serving platter.
recipes.text: Ray'S Ultimate Ham Roll-Ups. Allow cream cheese to reach room temperature and thoroughly blend with bacon-horseradish dip. Spread mixture heavily onto slice of shaved ham and roll each one into a log. Cut each log into 3 pieces and insert a toothpick into each one. Arrange Ham Roll-Ups in a spoke pattern, place on a large serving platter.

recipes.title: Laura'S Chocolate Cake
directions: Bake the cake per package directions in 2 (9-inch) round pans. While cake is baking, make frosting.
recipes.text: Laura'S Chocolate Cake. Bake the cake per package directions in 2 (9-inch) round pans. While cake is baking, make frosting.

recipes.title: Strawberry Pie
directions: Combine sugar, cornstarch and water cook until thick - add few drops red food color and strawberry jello.
Cool.
Spread the bottom of pie shell with cream cheese and milk.
Fill shell with strawberries. Pour glaze over all and chill.
Top with whip cream. To serve: Try this pie with fresh fruit peaches - etc.
recipes.text: Strawberry Pie. Combine sugar, cornstarch and water cook until thick - add few drops red food color and strawberry jello. Cool. Spread the bottom of pie shell with cream cheese and milk. Fill shell with strawberries. Pour glaze over all and chill. Top with whip cream. To serve: Try this pie with fresh fruit peaches - etc.

recipes.title: Sweet And Sour Beef Stew
ingredients: 2 lb. beef stew meat, cut in 1-inch cubes
directions: Coat meat with seasoned flour; brown meat and onion in hot oil. Combine ketchup, brown sugar, vinegar, water and Worcestershire sauce. Stir into browned meat. Cover and cook over low heat for 45 minutes; stirring occasionally. Add carrots and more water, if needed. Cook another 45 minutes. Serve over rice or noodles.
recipes.text: Sweet And Sour Beef Stew. Coat meat with seasoned flour; brown meat and onion in hot oil. Combine ketchup, brown sugar, vinegar, water and Worcestershire sauce. Stir into browned meat. Cover and cook over low heat for 45 minutes; stirring occasionally. Add carrots and more water, if needed. Cook another 45 minutes. Serve over rice or noodles.

recipes.title: Sausage Gravy
directions: Crumble sausage into a large skillet or saucepan; cook over medium heat until brown and well done.
Stir in flour; cook over medium-low heat about 6 minutes or until mixture bubbles and turns golden.
Stir in milk.
Add salt and pepper.
Cook, stirring, until thickened.
To serve, slice biscuits or crumble biscuits and spoon gravy over biscuits.
Yields 4 to 6 servings.
recipes.text: Sausage Gravy. Crumble sausage into a large skillet or saucepan; cook over medium heat until brown and well done. Stir in flour; cook over medium-low heat about 6 minutes or until mixture bubbles and turns golden. Stir in milk. Add salt and pepper. Cook, stirring, until thickened. To serve, slice biscuits or crumble biscuits and spoon gravy over biscuits. Yields 4 to 6 servings.

recipes.title: Broccoli-Bean Casserole
ingredients: 4 oz. drained canned small white beans
1/8 tsp. each oregano leaves and pepper
4 oz. sharp Cheddar cheese, coarsely shredded
directions: Preheat oven to 375°.
In small skillet, heat 1 teaspoon margarine until bubbly.
Add onion and garlic and saute until onion is softened.
recipes.text: Broccoli-Bean Casserole. Preheat oven to 375°. In small skillet, heat 1 teaspoon margarine until bubbly. Add onion and garlic and saute until onion is softened.

recipes.title: Mandarin Orange Salad
ingredients: 11 oz. can mandarin oranges, drained, reserve juice
directions: Wash greens and chill.
Place avocado slices in reserved mandarin juice.
At serving time, toss greens, drained mandarin oranges, avocado slices and almonds.
Serve with poppy seed dressing.
recipes.text: Mandarin Orange Salad. Wash greens and chill. Place avocado slices in reserved mandarin juice. At serving time, toss greens, drained mandarin oranges, avocado slices and almonds. Serve with poppy seed dressing.

recipes.title: Maple Oatmeal Bread
directions: In bread machine pan, place all ingredients in order suggested by manufacturer.
Select the basic bread setting.
Choose crust color and loaf size, if available.
Bake according to bread machine directions.
(Check dough after 5 minutes of mixing; add 1 to 2 Tbsp. water or flour, if needed.)
Yield:
recipes.text: Maple Oatmeal Bread. In bread machine pan, place all ingredients in order suggested by manufacturer. Select the basic bread setting. Choose crust color and loaf size, if available. Bake according to bread machine directions. (Check dough after 5 minutes of mixing; add 1 to 2 Tbsp. water or flour, if needed.) Yield: 1 loaf (1-1/2 lb.).

recipes.title: Papa'S Favorite Fluffy Lemon Cookies
directions: Combine the first 3 ingredients and food coloring, if desired. Drop by teaspoon into sugar and roll until covered.
Place on greased cookie sheet; bake at 350° for 10 to 15 minutes.
recipes.text: Papa'S Favorite Fluffy Lemon Cookies. Combine the first 3 ingredients and food coloring, if desired. Drop by teaspoon into sugar and roll until covered. Place on greased cookie sheet; bake at 350° for 10 to 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Oven Baked French Toast
directions: Place sugar, butter, and corn syrup in small pan and cook until syrupy.
Pour into greased 9 x 13 inch baking dish.
Slice French bread 3/4 inches thick and arrange in pan over syrup mixture.
Beat together eggs, milk, and vanilla flavoring.
Pour over bread.
Cover dish and refrigerate overnight.
Bake uncovered at 350-375° for 40-45 minutes.
This makes its own syrup, but it can also be served with additional maple syrup.
recipes.text: Oven Baked French Toast. Place sugar, butter, and corn syrup in small pan and cook until syrupy. Pour into greased 9 x 13 inch baking dish. Slice French bread 3/4 inches thick and arrange in pan over syrup mixture. Beat together eggs, milk, and vanilla flavoring. Pour over bread. Cover dish and refrigerate overnight. Bake uncovered at 350-375° for 40-45 minutes. This makes its own syrup, but it can also be served with additional maple syrup.

recipes.title: Cocktail Barbecue Wieners
directions: Mix on low heat.
Add 1 to 2 pounds of wieners (cut into bite sizes).
Use toothpicks for serving.
recipes.text: Cocktail Barbecue Wieners. Mix on low heat. Add 1 to 2 pounds of wieners (cut into bite sizes). Use toothpicks for serving.

recipes.title: Crunch Peanut Butter Balls
directions: In a large bowl combine the peanut butter and marshmallow cream. Add cereal and stir until until well coated. In small microwave safe bowl combine chocolate chips and shortening. Microwave uncovered for 1-2 minutes or until chips are melted. Stir until smooth. Roll cereal mixture into tiny balls. Dip in chocolate. Place on a wax paper lined pan. Refrigerate until set.
recipes.text: Crunch Peanut Butter Balls. In a large bowl combine the peanut butter and marshmallow cream. Add cereal and stir until until well coated. In small microwave safe bowl combine chocolate chips and shortening. Microwave uncovered for 1-2 minutes or until chips are melted. Stir until smooth. Roll cereal mixture into tiny balls. Dip in chocolate. Place on a wax paper lined pan. Refrigerate until set.

recipes.title: Pinto Bean Pie
ingredients: 1 c. pinto beans, mashed (Luck's canned beans may be used)
directions: Combine all ingredients and pour into an unbaked 9-inch pie shell.
Bake at 350° for 50 to 55 minutes.
Serves 6 to 8.
recipes.text: Pinto Bean Pie. Combine all ingredients and pour into an unbaked 9-inch pie shell. Bake at 350° for 50 to 55 minutes. Serves 6 to 8.

recipes.title: Cheese Ball
ingredients: 1 c. pecans (1/2 in mixture, 1/2 rolled outside)
directions: Mix all together; form in ball.
Chill before rolling in nuts. Wrap in foil and let set for 6 to 7 hours in refrigerator.
recipes.text: Cheese Ball. Mix all together; form in ball. Chill before rolling in nuts. Wrap in foil and let set for 6 to 7 hours in refrigerator.

recipes.title: Pickled Carrots(Wanda'S)
ingredients: 2 lb. cooked, sliced carrots (I have used canned and frozen)
directions: Mix together and simmer 10 minutes.
Cool and pour over cooked carrots.
recipes.text: Pickled Carrots(Wanda'S). Mix together and simmer 10 minutes. Cool and pour over cooked carrots.

recipes.title: Rice Broccoli Casserole
directions: Saute onion and celery in butter.
Cook rice and broccoli according to directions on package. Drain in colander.
Use only a sprinkle of salt in water to cook rice.
No salt in broccoli.
The butter and Cheez Whiz are so salty; additional salt is unnecessary.
recipes.text: Rice Broccoli Casserole. Saute onion and celery in butter. Cook rice and broccoli according to directions on package. Drain in colander. Use only a sprinkle of salt in water to cook rice. No salt in broccoli. The butter and Cheez Whiz are so salty; additional salt is unnecessary.

recipes.title: Calico Beans
directions: Brown and drain ground beef, bacon and onion.
Put all ingredients together and bake in ungreased casserole for 45 minutes at 350°.
Or cook in crock-pot.
recipes.text: Calico Beans. Brown and drain ground beef, bacon and onion. Put all ingredients together and bake in ungreased casserole for 45 minutes at 350°. Or cook in crock-pot.

recipes.title: Oven Spareribs
directions: Heat oven to 375°.
Sprinkle ribs with lemon juice.
Cook for 1/2 hour.
While cooking, combine rest of ingredients.
Bring to boil, then remove.
Pour over ribs and bake 45 minutes to 1 hour (until tender).
recipes.text: Oven Spareribs. Heat oven to 375°. Sprinkle ribs with lemon juice. Cook for 1/2 hour. While cooking, combine rest of ingredients. Bring to boil, then remove. Pour over ribs and bake 45 minutes to 1 hour (until tender).

recipes.title: Dumplings
directions: Drop spoonfuls into salted boiling water.
When they float to the top, they are done.
recipes.text: Dumplings. Drop spoonfuls into salted boiling water. When they float to the top, they are done.

recipes.title: Jello Salad
directions: Mix all together and chill.
recipes.text: Jello Salad. Mix all together and chill.

recipes.title: Party Cheese Ball
ingredients: dash each of salt and cayenne pepper
directions: Combine softened cream cheese and Cheddar cheese.
Mix until well blended.
Add all other ingredients (except pecans).
Mix well.
Chill.
Shape into a ball and roll in pecans.
recipes.text: Party Cheese Ball. Combine softened cream cheese and Cheddar cheese. Mix until well blended. Add all other ingredients (except pecans). Mix well. Chill. Shape into a ball and roll in pecans.

recipes.title: Chicken Marengo
directions: In large skillet, brown chicken in shortening.
Drain off fat. Stir in remaining ingredients.
Cover and simmer for 45 minutes or until tender.
Stir occasionally.
Uncover and cook until desired consistency.
Serves 6.
recipes.text: Chicken Marengo. In large skillet, brown chicken in shortening. Drain off fat. Stir in remaining ingredients. Cover and simmer for 45 minutes or until tender. Stir occasionally. Uncover and cook until desired consistency. Serves 6.

recipes.title: Frost On The Pumpkin Cake
directions: Combine sugar, oil and eggs in large bowl.
Mix well.
Combine dry ingredients and add to oil mixture, beating well.
Stir in pumpkin. Pour batter into 2 (9-inch) pans which have been greased and floured.
Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes.
Cool on rack.
recipes.text: Frost On The Pumpkin Cake. Combine sugar, oil and eggs in large bowl. Mix well. Combine dry ingredients and add to oil mixture, beating well. Stir in pumpkin. Pour batter into 2 (9-inch) pans which have been greased and floured. Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes. Cool on rack.

recipes.title: Stuffed Zucchini
ingredients: 1 c. (4 oz.) shredded Monterey Jack cheese
directions: Cook whole zucchini in boiling salted water for 10 minutes; drain.
Cut in half lengthwise.
Scoop out centers, leaving 1/4-inch shell.
Chop center portion; set aside.
recipes.text: Stuffed Zucchini. Cook whole zucchini in boiling salted water for 10 minutes; drain. Cut in half lengthwise. Scoop out centers, leaving 1/4-inch shell. Chop center portion; set aside.

recipes.title: Coconut Cake
ingredients: 1 box yellow Duncan Hines cake mix
directions: Prepare mix as directed on back of box and add 1 teaspoon coconut flavoring and frozen coconut.
Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.
Punch holes all over top of cake with a toothpick.
Heat the following ingredients together and pour over hot cake: milk, sugar, 1 teaspoon coconut flavoring and enough water to make 2 cups.
Let cake cool.
Ice with 9 ounces of Cool Whip and sprinkle with 9 ounces of fresh frozen coconut on top.
recipes.text: Coconut Cake. Prepare mix as directed on back of box and add 1 teaspoon coconut flavoring and frozen coconut. Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes. Punch holes all over top of cake with a toothpick. Heat the following ingredients together and pour over hot cake: milk, sugar, 1 teaspoon coconut flavoring and enough water to make 2 cups. Let cake cool. Ice with 9 ounces of Cool Whip and sprinkle with 9 ounces of fresh frozen coconut on top.

recipes.title: Crusty Corn Bread
directions: Combine first 6 ingredients.
Mix well.
Add egg and milk. Stir until smooth.
Melt shortening in skillet.
Pour hot shortening into batter and mix well.
Pour batter into skillet. Bake at 425° for 25 minutes or until golden brown.
recipes.text: Crusty Corn Bread. Combine first 6 ingredients. Mix well. Add egg and milk. Stir until smooth. Melt shortening in skillet. Pour hot shortening into batter and mix well. Pour batter into skillet. Bake at 425° for 25 minutes or until golden brown.

recipes.title: Hash Brown Casserole
directions: Thaw hash browns.
Mix all ingredients except crumbs.
Place in a greased 9 x 13-inch baking pan.
Top with cracker crumbs. Bake at 350° for 1 1/4 hours.
recipes.text: Hash Brown Casserole. Thaw hash browns. Mix all ingredients except crumbs. Place in a greased 9 x 13-inch baking pan. Top with cracker crumbs. Bake at 350° for 1 1/4 hours.

recipes.title: Ambrosia
ingredients: 1 small box instant pistachio pudding mix
directions: Mix pudding and crushed pineapple.
Add remaining ingredients in order listed.
Mix well.
Refrigerate.
recipes.text: Ambrosia. Mix pudding and crushed pineapple. Add remaining ingredients in order listed. Mix well. Refrigerate.

recipes.title: Five Step Pot Roast
ingredients: 1 can cream of mushroom soup with water
directions: Brown roast; place in Dutch oven or crock-pot.
Place Pepsi, Lipton onion soup mix, soup with water and brown gravy mix in container.
Cook until done.
ner: cream of mushroom soup with water
recipes.text: Five Step Pot Roast. Brown roast; place in Dutch oven or crock-pot. Place Pepsi, Lipton onion soup mix, soup with water and brown gravy mix in container. Cook until done.

recipes.title: Crock-Pot Steak
ingredients: 1 1/2 lb. round steak, cut in strips
directions: Put steak, flour, salt and pepper in crock-pot. Stir well to coat. Add other ingredients. Cover and cook 8 hours on low or 5 hours on high. Serve over rice.
recipes.text: Crock-Pot Steak. Put steak, flour, salt and pepper in crock-pot. Stir well to coat. Add other ingredients. Cover and cook 8 hours on low or 5 hours on high. Serve over rice.

recipes.title: Bean Bread
directions: Combine all ingredients, beating just enough to make a smooth batter. Turn into a greased loaf pan and bake 45 to 50 minutes in a 375° preheated oven.
When top browns and sides pull away from the pan, turn out and cool on a rack.
Delicious warm with butter.
recipes.text: Bean Bread. Combine all ingredients, beating just enough to make a smooth batter. Turn into a greased loaf pan and bake 45 to 50 minutes in a 375° preheated oven. When top browns and sides pull away from the pan, turn out and cool on a rack. Delicious warm with butter.

recipes.title: Little Barbecued Wieners
directions: Bake in casserole dish for 1 1/2 hours at 350°.
recipes.text: Little Barbecued Wieners. Bake in casserole dish for 1 1/2 hours at 350°.

recipes.title: Chicken Tetrazzini
ingredients: 8 to 12 oz. skim Mozzarella cheese, shredded
directions: Garlic salt may be substituted for regular salt if desired.
recipes.text: Chicken Tetrazzini. Garlic salt may be substituted for regular salt if desired.

recipes.title: Squash Casserole
directions: Melt butter and mix with stuffing mix.
Spread 1/2 in casserole dish.
Combine squash, carrot, onion, pimento and sugar. Spread mixture over stuffing mix.
Combine soup with sour cream and spread over squash.
Spread other 1/2 stuffing mix over top. Bake at 350° to 400° for 25 minutes.
recipes.text: Squash Casserole. Melt butter and mix with stuffing mix. Spread 1/2 in casserole dish. Combine squash, carrot, onion, pimento and sugar. Spread mixture over stuffing mix. Combine soup with sour cream and spread over squash. Spread other 1/2 stuffing mix over top. Bake at 350° to 400° for 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Polynesian Stuffed Peppers
ingredients: 1 Tbsp. cornstarch, mixed in 1/4 c. cold water
directions: Remove tops and seeds from peppers.
Set aside.
Combine rice, ham, chopped onion, coriander, ginger, salt and pepper.
Stuff cleaned peppers with rice mixture.
Place upright in a shallow pan.
Set aside.
Combine undrained pineapple, onion, green pepper and tomatoes in a pot.
Heat until boiling.
Add in cornstarch mixture.
Stir until thick.
Put the sauce in the pan with the stuffed peppers.
Bake at 375° for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Polynesian Stuffed Peppers. Remove tops and seeds from peppers. Set aside. Combine rice, ham, chopped onion, coriander, ginger, salt and pepper. Stuff cleaned peppers with rice mixture.
