Place upright in a shallow pan. Set aside. Combine undrained pineapple, onion, green pepper and tomatoes in a pot. Heat until boiling. Add in cornstarch mixture. Stir until thick. Put the sauce in the pan with the stuffed peppers. Bake at 375° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Beans And Sausage
ingredients: 1 1/2 to 2 lb. smoked sausage, sliced to bite-sized pieces
2 (1 1/2 lb.) cans Ranch Style pinto beans
1 medium onion, chopped or 1 tsp. onion salt substituted
directions: Saute celery, onion and pepper in small amount of cooking oil or butter.
Add to remaining ingredients.
Stir until well blended.
Simmer until consistency to serve over cooked rice.
recipes.text: Beans And Sausage. Saute celery, onion and pepper in small amount of cooking oil or butter. Add to remaining ingredients. Stir until well blended. Simmer until consistency to serve over cooked rice.

recipes.title: Teriyaki Microwave Chicken
directions: Combine water, soy sauce and teriyaki sauce in a deep microwavable bowl or casserole dish.
Place chicken breast side up in bowl.
Sprinkle onion, green pepper and spices over chicken. Marinate 15 minutes to 1/2 hour.
Turn chicken breast side down before placing in microwave.
Microwave on High 7 minutes per pound (average 35 minutes).
Turn breast side up halfway through cooking time.
Liquid left in bowl can be simmered for fat removal and thickened for gravy.
Serve over rice.
recipes.text: Teriyaki Microwave Chicken. Combine water, soy sauce and teriyaki sauce in a deep microwavable bowl or casserole dish. Place chicken breast side up in bowl. Sprinkle onion, green pepper and spices over chicken. Marinate 15 minutes to 1/2 hour. Turn chicken breast side down before placing in microwave. Microwave on High 7 minutes per pound (average 35 minutes). Turn breast side up halfway through cooking time. Liquid left in bowl can be simmered for fat removal and thickened for gravy. Serve over rice.

recipes.title: Calico Corn Muffins
ingredients: 1 c. canned or frozen whole kernel corn
directions: In a medium bowl, combine cornmeal, flour, sugar, baking powder and red pepper.
Stir in milk, egg and margarine just until blended (batter will be slightly lumpy).
Stir in corn, chopped red pepper and onions until just mixed.
Spoon mixture into 12 lightly greased 2 1/2-inch muffin cups.
Bake at 400° for 20 to 25 minutes or until done.
Remove from pan.
Cool slightly on wire rack.
Serve warm at room temperature.
recipes.text: Calico Corn Muffins. In a medium bowl, combine cornmeal, flour, sugar, baking powder and red pepper. Stir in milk, egg and margarine just until blended (batter will be slightly lumpy). Stir in corn, chopped red pepper and onions until just mixed. Spoon mixture into 12 lightly greased 2 1/2-inch muffin cups. Bake at 400° for 20 to 25 minutes or until done. Remove from pan. Cool slightly on wire rack. Serve warm at room temperature.

recipes.title: Crescent Taco Pie
ingredients: 1 1/2 c. crushed taco chips or Doritos
directions: Brown meat; add seasoning mix and water.
Simmer 5 minutes. In a 9-inch pie pan, form crust for pie with rolls.
Sprinkle 1/2 of chips on bottom of crust.
Spoon on meat; spread sour cream and cover with cheese.
Sprinkle over the other 1/2 of chips.
Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes.
Serve with chopped lettuce, tomatoes and taco sauce.
recipes.text: Crescent Taco Pie. Brown meat; add seasoning mix and water. Simmer 5 minutes. In a 9-inch pie pan, form crust for pie with rolls. Sprinkle 1/2 of chips on bottom of crust. Spoon on meat; spread sour cream and cover with cheese. Sprinkle over the other 1/2 of chips. Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes. Serve with chopped lettuce, tomatoes and taco sauce.

recipes.title: Blueberry Torte (Or Cherry)
directions: Gradually add 2 cups sugar to egg whites.
Fold in nuts and saltines and bake in 13 x 9-inch buttered pan for 30 minutes at 350°.
Cool.
recipes.text: Blueberry Torte (Or Cherry). Gradually add 2 cups sugar to egg whites. Fold in nuts and saltines and bake in 13 x 9-inch buttered pan for 30 minutes at 350°. Cool.

recipes.title: Broccoli-Rice Casserole
directions: Put cooked broccoli in casserole dish.
Mix soup, Cheez Whiz, milk and rice; pour over broccoli.
Bake at 350° for 30 to 45 minutes.
Cooked and diced chicken, ham or turkey may be added for 1 dish meal.
recipes.text: Broccoli-Rice Casserole. Put cooked broccoli in casserole dish. Mix soup, Cheez Whiz, milk and rice; pour over broccoli. Bake at 350° for 30 to 45 minutes. Cooked and diced chicken, ham or turkey may be added for 1 dish meal.

recipes.title: Sweet Dills
ingredients: 1 qt. sliced dill pickles, well drained
directions: Mix sugar and water; bring to a boil.
Add a few drops green food coloring, if desired.
Pour liquid over pickles and chill thoroughly before serving.
recipes.text: Sweet Dills. Mix sugar and water; bring to a boil. Add a few drops green food coloring, if desired. Pour liquid over pickles and chill thoroughly before serving.

recipes.title: German Pancakes
directions: Whip eggs until thick and lemon-colored.
Add milk, flour and salt.
Heat and melt butter in a 9 x 13-inch dripper pan.
Pour batter into pan of melted butter.
Bake at 450° for 15 to 20 minutes.
Serve with hot maple syrup.
recipes.text: German Pancakes. Whip eggs until thick and lemon-colored. Add milk, flour and salt. Heat and melt butter in a 9 x 13-inch dripper pan. Pour batter into pan of melted butter. Bake at 450° for 15 to 20 minutes. Serve with hot maple syrup.

recipes.title: Sausage Stars
ingredients: 1/2 c. chopped pimiento or roasted peppers
directions: Brown and drain sausage. Mix with remaining ingredients.
Fill wontons. Place in muffin tins and bake at 350° for 5 minutes.
recipes.text: Sausage Stars. Brown and drain sausage. Mix with remaining ingredients. Fill wontons. Place in muffin tins and bake at 350° for 5 minutes.

recipes.title: Mama'S Creamed Spinach
directions: Heat slowly the white sauce.
Add spinach and onion.
Stir until spinach is defrosted and serve.
recipes.text: Mama'S Creamed Spinach. Heat slowly the white sauce. Add spinach and onion. Stir until spinach is defrosted and serve.

recipes.title: Pie Crust(Never Fail)
directions: Cut Crisco, flour and salt.
Add beaten egg, water and vinegar; blend thoroughly.
Bake as recipe says.
Yields 3 large crusts.
Roll between waxed paper.
recipes.text: Pie Crust(Never Fail). Cut Crisco, flour and salt. Add beaten egg, water and vinegar; blend thoroughly. Bake as recipe says. Yields 3 large crusts. Roll between waxed paper.

recipes.title: Layered Dip For Nacho Chips
directions: Using an 8 x 10-inch serving dish, layer all ingredients in exact order given.
Make sure everyone knows to dig deep.
recipes.text: Layered Dip For Nacho Chips. Using an 8 x 10-inch serving dish, layer all ingredients in exact order given. Make sure everyone knows to dig deep.

recipes.title: Marinated Vegetables
directions: Place vegetables in shallow dish. Combine remaining ingredients.
Mix well.
Pour over vegetables. Cover and place in refrigerator for 6 hours.
Stir occasionally.
recipes.text: Marinated Vegetables. Place vegetables in shallow dish. Combine remaining ingredients. Mix well. Pour over vegetables. Cover and place in refrigerator for 6 hours. Stir occasionally.

recipes.title: Walnut Cake
directions: Cream butter and sugar; add eggs.
Sift flour; add baking powder and salt.
Add to butter mixture, alternating with milk. Add chopped walnuts.
Bake in 9 x 13-inch pan or two 9-inch pans. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes at 375°.
recipes.text: Walnut Cake. Cream butter and sugar; add eggs. Sift flour; add baking powder and salt. Add to butter mixture, alternating with milk. Add chopped walnuts. Bake in 9 x 13-inch pan or two 9-inch pans. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes at 375°.

recipes.title: Lime Pickles
ingredients: 1 gal. cucumbers, sliced (not real large ones)
directions: Mix and pour over cucumbers.
Let set for 24 hours.
Use a crock or glass container.
Wash well.
Let set in cold water for 3 hours.
recipes.text: Lime Pickles. Mix and pour over cucumbers. Let set for 24 hours. Use a crock or glass container. Wash well. Let set in cold water for 3 hours.

recipes.title: Brady'S Fish Fry Hush Puppies
ingredients: 2 c. Martha White self-rising corn meal mix
1/2 c. Martha White self-rising yellow corn meal
directions: Combine dry ingredients.
Add onion.
Gradually stir in milk and eggs; set aside while you fry fish so mixture can rise.
Do not stir.
After rising, drop from teaspoon into hot fat where fish was fried.
Enjoy.
recipes.text: Brady'S Fish Fry Hush Puppies. Combine dry ingredients. Add onion. Gradually stir in milk and eggs; set aside while you fry fish so mixture can rise. Do not stir. After rising, drop from teaspoon into hot fat where fish was fried. Enjoy.

recipes.title: Marinades For Meats
directions: Heat and pour over meatballs.
recipes.text: Marinades For Meats. Heat and pour over meatballs.

recipes.title: Hummingbird Cake
directions: Put in 9 x 13-inch pan.
Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes.
recipes.text: Hummingbird Cake. Put in 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Sausage Balls
directions: Mix all ingredients.
Form into 1-inch balls.
Bake on greased baking sheet at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes or until done.
Be sure baking pan has sides or grease will drip into oven.
Good party food!
recipes.text: Sausage Balls. Mix all ingredients. Form into 1-inch balls. Bake on greased baking sheet at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes or until done. Be sure baking pan has sides or grease will drip into oven. Good party food!

recipes.title: Carrot Cake #2
ingredients: 2 (6 oz. each) jars junior carrot baby food
1 (8 oz.) can crushed pineapple in its own juice
directions: Heat oven to 350°.
Grease tube pan.
In large bowl, stir together flour, sugar, baking soda and cinnamon.
Whisk in oil, baby food and eggs until smooth.
Fold in pineapple with juice and coconut and pour into pan.
Bake for 1 hour to 1 hour and 15 minutes.
recipes.text: Carrot Cake #2. Heat oven to 350°. Grease tube pan. In large bowl, stir together flour, sugar, baking soda and cinnamon. Whisk in oil, baby food and eggs until smooth. Fold in pineapple with juice and coconut and pour into pan. Bake for 1 hour to 1 hour and 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Buttermilk Pancakes
ingredients: 1/4 c. melted butter plus some for frying
directions: In large bowl, sift together flour, sugar, baking powder, baking soda and salt. Beat eggs with buttermilk and melted butter. Combine dry and wet ingredients; do not overmix. Heat butter in skillet over medium heat. Spoon 1/3 cup of batter into skillet. Cook 2 to 3 minutes on each side. Serve with whipped cream and syrup.
recipes.text: Buttermilk Pancakes. In large bowl, sift together flour, sugar, baking powder, baking soda and salt. Beat eggs with buttermilk and melted butter. Combine dry and wet ingredients; do not overmix. Heat butter in skillet over medium heat. Spoon 1/3 cup of batter into skillet. Cook 2 to 3 minutes on each side. Serve with whipped cream and syrup.

recipes.title: Fruit Pizza
ingredients: 1 can cherry or strawberry pie filling
directions: Bake sugar cookies on pizza pan; cool.
recipes.text: Fruit Pizza. Bake sugar cookies on pizza pan; cool.

recipes.title: Rice Picnic Salad
directions: Combine all ingredients and
toss
lightly with a fork. Chill thoroughly.
recipes.text: Rice Picnic Salad. Combine all ingredients and toss lightly with a fork. Chill thoroughly.

recipes.title: Angel Food Pie
directions: Follow recipe on can of pumpkin except use artificial sweetener to taste and use skimmed canned milk.
Pour into glass baking dish and bake.
When cool, cut in squares (no shell).
recipes.text: Angel Food Pie. Follow recipe on can of pumpkin except use artificial sweetener to taste and use skimmed canned milk. Pour into glass baking dish and bake. When cool, cut in squares (no shell).

recipes.title: Zesty 3 - Bean Salad
ingredients: 1/2 - 12 ounce jar thick and chunky salsa, about 3/4 cup
1 - 15 1/4 to 19-ounce can red kidney beans, drained
1 - 15 1/2 to 19 ounce can garbanzo beans, drained
directions: About 30 minutes before serving or early in day:
recipes.text: Zesty 3 - Bean Salad. About 30 minutes before serving or early in day:

recipes.title: Tex Mex Chops
directions: Brown chops in large skillet in oil over medium heat, approximately 5 minutes.
Turn chops; add salsa and chiles. Lower heat; cover and simmer gently 8 to 10 minutes.
Serves 4.
recipes.text: Tex Mex Chops. Brown chops in large skillet in oil over medium heat, approximately 5 minutes. Turn chops; add salsa and chiles. Lower heat; cover and simmer gently 8 to 10 minutes. Serves 4.

recipes.title: Homemade Yogurt
directions: Bring milk and half and half to a boil.
Set aside until lukewarm. Mix yogurt and 2 cups of milk mixture well.
Put in a bowl with a tight lid and cover with a heavy blanket or quilt. Leave on counter for several hours, then refrigerate.
recipes.text: Homemade Yogurt. Bring milk and half and half to a boil. Set aside until lukewarm. Mix yogurt and 2 cups of milk mixture well. Put in a bowl with a tight lid and cover with a heavy blanket or quilt. Leave on counter for several hours, then refrigerate.

recipes.title: Beans, Beans, Beans
directions: Fry hamburger, bacon and onions and drain.
Put in casserole or Dutch oven.
Add beans.
Stir in remaining ingredients.
Mix all together.
Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.
recipes.text: Beans, Beans, Beans. Fry hamburger, bacon and onions and drain. Put in casserole or Dutch oven. Add beans. Stir in remaining ingredients. Mix all together. Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Taco Soup
directions: Brown the ground beef and drain; rinse away fat.
Mix all ingredients together.
Simmer 45 minutes to 1 hour.
Serve topped with Fritos and grated cheese.
recipes.text: Taco Soup. Brown the ground beef and drain; rinse away fat. Mix all ingredients together. Simmer 45 minutes to 1 hour. Serve topped with Fritos and grated cheese.

recipes.title: Breakfast Casserole
directions: Crumble bread in bottom of an 11 x 9-inch greased pan.
Fry and drain sausage.
Beat eggs, milk, ground mustard, salt and pepper together, then add grated cheese.
Pour over bread and sausage.
Cover and put in the refrigerator overnight.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Breakfast Casserole. Crumble bread in bottom of an 11 x 9-inch greased pan. Fry and drain sausage. Beat eggs, milk, ground mustard, salt and pepper together, then add grated cheese. Pour over bread and sausage. Cover and put in the refrigerator overnight. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Chicken Balls
ingredients: 1 12 oz. tub of Philadelphia cream cheese
directions: Cut up chicken in small chunks and fry.
In small mix cream cheese, butter, Lawrys, and garlic salt until the cream cheese is real soft. Add cooked chicken. Roll in crescent rolls. Bake about 20 minutes. Makes about 16 chicken balls.
recipes.text: Chicken Balls. Cut up chicken in small chunks and fry. In small mix cream cheese, butter, Lawrys, and garlic salt until the cream cheese is real soft. Add cooked chicken. Roll in crescent rolls. Bake about 20 minutes. Makes about 16 chicken balls.

recipes.title: Holiday Cookies(Sugar Cookies)
directions: Mix all ingredients in mixing bowl with hands until smooth. Roll dough, one part at a time, 1/4-inch thick.
Cut into desired shapes and place on cookie sheets.
Bake at 350° for 12 to 15 minutes.
Let cool; decorate.
Yields 3 to 4 dozen.
recipes.text: Holiday Cookies(Sugar Cookies). Mix all ingredients in mixing bowl with hands until smooth. Roll dough, one part at a time, 1/4-inch thick. Cut into desired shapes and place on cookie sheets. Bake at 350° for 12 to 15 minutes. Let cool; decorate. Yields 3 to 4 dozen.

recipes.title: Guacamole Dip
ingredients: 4 to 5 drops hot sauce to taste (more if desired)
directions: Drain all ingredients well.
Spread evenly in layers on a platter:
recipes.text: Guacamole Dip. Drain all ingredients well. Spread evenly in layers on a platter:

recipes.title: Coffee Cake
ingredients: 2 c. flour, sifted with 1 tsp. baking powder
directions: Mix in order.
Let stand overnight.
Put mixture in a 9 x 13-inch greased pan.
recipes.text: Coffee Cake. Mix in order. Let stand overnight. Put mixture in a 9 x 13-inch greased pan.

recipes.title: Hot Sausage Soup
directions: Fry celery, onions and sausage in small amount of oil.
Cut sausage into 1/2-inch pieces. Put all ingredients into large pan and simmer for 1 hour.
Makes 6 servings.
Preparation Time: 1:00.
recipes.text: Hot Sausage Soup. Fry celery, onions and sausage in small amount of oil. Cut sausage into 1/2-inch pieces. Put all ingredients into large pan and simmer for 1 hour. Makes 6 servings. Preparation Time: 1:00.

recipes.title: Apple Pie
directions: Sift together flour and salt.
Cut in shortening with pastry blender.
Add enough water to hold ingredients together, sprinkling evenly and mixing with fork to form ball.
Makes enough for 8-inch or 9-inch pie, either 2-crust or bottom crust and crisscross strips on top.
recipes.text: Apple Pie. Sift together flour and salt. Cut in shortening with pastry blender. Add enough water to hold ingredients together, sprinkling evenly and mixing with fork to form ball. Makes enough for 8-inch or 9-inch pie, either 2-crust or bottom crust and crisscross strips on top.

recipes.title: Squaw Corn
directions: Cook rice according to directions.
Add undiluted soup, melted margarine and corn.
Cover with grated cheese.
Pour into casserole dish.
Cover with aluminum foil.
Cook at 350° until bubbly.
recipes.text: Squaw Corn. Cook rice according to directions. Add undiluted soup, melted margarine and corn. Cover with grated cheese. Pour into casserole dish. Cover with aluminum foil. Cook at 350° until bubbly.

recipes.title: Chicken Casserole
directions: Put chicken in a 2-quart baking dish (greased).
Cover with vegetables.
Combine soup, broth and pepper.
Pour over chicken. Combine flour, milk and butter and pour over mixture.
Bake at 400° for 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Chicken Casserole. Put chicken in a 2-quart baking dish (greased). Cover with vegetables. Combine soup, broth and pepper. Pour over chicken. Combine flour, milk and butter and pour over mixture. Bake at 400° for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Broccoli Soup
directions: Cook broccoli, onion and celery in 2 cups water until tender (do not drain).
Melt margarine. Add flour and bouillon.
When bubbly, add 2 1/2 cups water.
Combine pans until boils. Stir in cream.
Garnish with shredded Cheddar cheese, if desired.
recipes.text: Broccoli Soup. Cook broccoli, onion and celery in 2 cups water until tender (do not drain). Melt margarine. Add flour and bouillon. When bubbly, add 2 1/2 cups water. Combine pans until boils. Stir in cream. Garnish with shredded Cheddar cheese, if desired.

recipes.title: Beef Stew 57
ingredients: 1 1/2 lb. cubed, boneless beef for stew
directions: Sprinkle meat with salt, pepper and sugar.
Brown well in shortening.
Add water and bouillon cubes.
Cover; simmer 1 hour or until meat is almost tender.
Add 57 sauce and remaining ingredients.
Cover; simmer 1 hour or until vegetables are tender. Stew may be thickened with flour-water mixture, if desired. Makes 6 servings (about 6 cups).
recipes.text: Beef Stew 57. Sprinkle meat with salt, pepper and sugar. Brown well in shortening. Add water and bouillon cubes. Cover; simmer 1 hour or until meat is almost tender. Add 57 sauce and remaining ingredients. Cover; simmer 1 hour or until vegetables are tender. Stew may be thickened with flour-water mixture, if desired. Makes 6 servings (about 6 cups).

recipes.title: Broccoli And Cauliflower Salad
directions: Mix all ingredients together.
Let set overnight.
recipes.text: Broccoli And Cauliflower Salad. Mix all ingredients together. Let set overnight.

recipes.title: Cocktail Eggroll (Lumpia)(Philippine Recipe)
ingredients: 1 c. water chestnuts, chopped, or celery
directions: Combine the first 7 ingredients in a bowl.
Beat egg.
Add to the first mixture and mix thoroughly.
At one end of lumpia wrapper, spoon 2 tablespoons of the mixture and roll tightly. Seal one end of wrapper by brushing with water.
Cut roll in 2 equal pieces and deep fry until golden brown.
Serve with prepared sweet and sour sauce.
recipes.text: Cocktail Eggroll (Lumpia)(Philippine Recipe). Combine the first 7 ingredients in a bowl. Beat egg. Add to the first mixture and mix thoroughly. At one end of lumpia wrapper, spoon 2 tablespoons of the mixture and roll tightly. Seal one end of wrapper by brushing with water. Cut roll in 2 equal pieces and deep fry until golden brown. Serve with prepared sweet and sour sauce.

recipes.title: Cheesy Broccoli Bake
ingredients: 1 (10 oz.) pkg. frozen, chopped broccoli, cooked according to pkg. directions and drained
2 c. ham, cut in small pieces
directions: In 1 1/2-quart casserole dish, combine soup and sour cream. Stir in broccoli, ham and rice.
Mix well. In a cup, combine bread crumbs and butter. Sprinkle over casserole.
Heat oven to 350°. Bake 30 to 35 minutes or until hot and bubbly. Serve.
recipes.text: Cheesy Broccoli Bake. In 1 1/2-quart casserole dish, combine soup and sour cream. Stir in broccoli, ham and rice. Mix well. In a cup, combine bread crumbs and butter. Sprinkle over casserole. Heat oven to 350°. Bake 30 to 35 minutes or until hot and bubbly. Serve.

recipes.title: Chuck Wagon Mac
ingredients: 1 pkg. Kraft macaroni and cheese dinner
directions: Prepare dinner as directed.
Brown hamburger.
Add celery, green pepper and onion, cook until tender.
Stir in corn, tomato sauce, salt and pepper.
Add dinner, mix well.
Pour into 2-quart casserole.
Bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes.
recipes.text: Chuck Wagon Mac. Prepare dinner as directed. Brown hamburger. Add celery, green pepper and onion, cook until tender. Stir in corn, tomato sauce, salt and pepper. Add dinner, mix well. Pour into 2-quart casserole. Bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Classic Macaroni Salad
ingredients: 8 oz. elbow macaroni, cooked and drained
directions: In a large bowl combine mayonnaise, vinegar, mustard, sugar, salt and pepper.
Add noodles, celery, green pepper, tomato, onion and cucumber.
Toss to coat well.
Cover and chill.
Makes 5 cups.
recipes.text: Classic Macaroni Salad. In a large bowl combine mayonnaise, vinegar, mustard, sugar, salt and pepper. Add noodles, celery, green pepper, tomato, onion and cucumber. Toss to coat well. Cover and chill. Makes 5 cups.

recipes.title: Creole Burger
directions: Brown meat and onion on burner.
Let simmer for 1/2 hour. Serves 4.
recipes.text: Creole Burger. Brown meat and onion on burner. Let simmer for 1/2 hour. Serves 4.

recipes.title: Home-Canned Pork And Beans
ingredients: 1 lb. bacon, cut in small pieces
directions: Wash beans thoroughly.
Cover with cold water and soak overnight.
Boil in same water for 45 minutes.
Drain beans, reserving liquid.
Add all ingredients to beans and 2 cups bean liquid.
Mix well.
Pack in clean jars to within 1-inch of top. Put on cap and screw firmly tight.
Process pints and quarts 60 minutes at 10 pounds pressure.
Yields 8 pints.
recipes.text: Home-Canned Pork And Beans. Wash beans thoroughly. Cover with cold water and soak overnight. Boil in same water for 45 minutes. Drain beans, reserving liquid. Add all ingredients to beans and 2 cups bean liquid. Mix well. Pack in clean jars to within 1-inch of top. Put on cap and screw firmly tight. Process pints and quarts 60 minutes at 10 pounds pressure. Yields 8 pints.

recipes.title: Hawaiian Salad
directions: Combine pineapple, sugar and salt; cook for 10 minutes.
Let cool.
Combine pineapple mixture and cream cheese; mix with whipped topping.
Mix everything together and chill.
Top with Mandarin oranges.
recipes.text: Hawaiian Salad. Combine pineapple, sugar and salt; cook for 10 minutes. Let cool. Combine pineapple mixture and cream cheese; mix with whipped topping. Mix everything together and chill. Top with Mandarin oranges.

recipes.title: Eatable Centerpiece
ingredients: variety of cheese (Cheddar, Swiss, Colby, etc.)
directions: Cut cheese in small squares, place toothpicks in each piece. Put in cabbage, place parsley or lettuce leaves or broccoli. Place parsley or some type of greens on top to give appearance of pineapple.
recipes.text: Eatable Centerpiece. Cut cheese in small squares, place toothpicks in each piece. Put in cabbage, place parsley or lettuce leaves or broccoli. Place parsley or some type of greens on top to give appearance of pineapple.

recipes.title: Pasta Salad
directions: Boil pasta.
Meanwhile, place all chopped items in bowl; add vinegar, oil and garlic salt and mix.
Fold into cooked pasta. Refrigerate.
Add Feta cheese before serving.
May have to add more wine vinegar when tossing.
recipes.text: Pasta Salad. Boil pasta. Meanwhile, place all chopped items in bowl; add vinegar, oil and garlic salt and mix. Fold into cooked pasta. Refrigerate. Add Feta cheese before serving. May have to add more wine vinegar when tossing.

recipes.title: Creamy Fruit Delight
directions: Dissolve jello in boiling water.
Cool slightly to prevent milk from curdling.
Stir in evaporated skimmed milk.
Chill until as thick as unbeaten egg whites.
Stir in fruit.
Pour into an 8-inch square pan or 5-cup mold.
Chill until firm.
Garnish with additional fruit.
Makes 7 servings, 1/2 cup each.
recipes.text: Creamy Fruit Delight. Dissolve jello in boiling water. Cool slightly to prevent milk from curdling. Stir in evaporated skimmed milk. Chill until as thick as unbeaten egg whites. Stir in fruit. Pour into an 8-inch square pan or 5-cup mold. Chill until firm. Garnish with additional fruit. Makes 7 servings, 1/2 cup each.

recipes.title: Yogurt Pancakes
directions: Preheat griddle.
Grease very lightly.
Beat eggs, shortening, milk and yogurt in bowl.
Add other ingredients and beat just a little.
Spoon onto hot griddle.
When bubbles appear on top, flip pancakes.
recipes.text: Yogurt Pancakes. Preheat griddle. Grease very lightly. Beat eggs, shortening, milk and yogurt in bowl. Add other ingredients and beat just a little. Spoon onto hot griddle. When bubbles appear on top, flip pancakes.

recipes.title: Onion Twist
directions: Preheat oven to 425°.
Sift flour, baking powder and salt. Stir in dip mix.
Cut in butter until mixture forms fine crumbs. Sprinkle cold water over top, a tablespoon at a time, mixing lightly until pastry holds together.
Roll out on a lightly floured cloth to a rectangle.
Cut in half lengthwise.
Lift and twist strips.
Place on ungreased cookie sheet.
Bake 10 minutes or until lightly golden.
Remove from cookie sheets.
recipes.text: Onion Twist. Preheat oven to 425°. Sift flour, baking powder and salt. Stir in dip mix. Cut in butter until mixture forms fine crumbs. Sprinkle cold water over top, a tablespoon at a time, mixing lightly until pastry holds together. Roll out on a lightly floured cloth to a rectangle. Cut in half lengthwise. Lift and twist strips. Place on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake 10 minutes or until lightly golden. Remove from cookie sheets.

recipes.title: Waikiki Meatballs
directions: Mix meat, crumbs, onions, egg, salt, ginger and milk.
Shape mixture into round meatballs.
Melt shortening in skillet; brown and cook meatballs.
Remove meatballs; keep warm.
Pour fat from skillet.
recipes.text: Waikiki Meatballs. Mix meat, crumbs, onions, egg, salt, ginger and milk. Shape mixture into round meatballs. Melt shortening in skillet; brown and cook meatballs. Remove meatballs; keep warm. Pour fat from skillet.

recipes.title: Black Devil'S Food Cake(Heart Association)
ingredients: 1 c. strong black coffee (instant coffee may be used)
directions: Sift together flour, sugar, cocoa and baking soda.
Add the oil and buttermilk. Stir until well blended. Bring the coffee to a boil and stir it gently into the batter.
Mixture will be soupy. Bake in a greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes.
recipes.text: Black Devil'S Food Cake(Heart Association). Sift together flour, sugar, cocoa and baking soda. Add the oil and buttermilk. Stir until well blended. Bring the coffee to a boil and stir it gently into the batter. Mixture will be soupy. Bake in a greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Buttermilk Cake
directions: Cream shortening and sugar; add eggs and beat well.
Add buttermilk and dry ingredients and vanilla.
Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.
recipes.text: Buttermilk Cake. Cream shortening and sugar; add eggs and beat well. Add buttermilk and dry ingredients and vanilla. Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Bread
directions: Combine sugar, oil, eggs, nutmeg, cinnamon and salt.
Beat well.
Add remaining ingredients and mix well.
Pour batter into 2 loaf pans or 3 (1 pound) coffee cans which have been well-greased. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
Slide bread out of pans or cans and cool.
recipes.text: Pumpkin Bread. Combine sugar, oil, eggs, nutmeg, cinnamon and salt. Beat well. Add remaining ingredients and mix well. Pour batter into 2 loaf pans or 3 (1 pound) coffee cans which have been well-greased. Bake at 350° for 1 hour. Slide bread out of pans or cans and cool.

recipes.title: Sugar Cookies
directions: Preheat oven to 375°.
Mix sugar, butter, egg and flavoring together well.
Sift flour with dry ingredients; blend in.
Chill 2 or 3 hours.
recipes.text: Sugar Cookies. Preheat oven to 375°. Mix sugar, butter, egg and flavoring together well. Sift flour with dry ingredients; blend in. Chill 2 or 3 hours.

recipes.title: Berry Mato Jelly
directions: Bring tomatoes and sugar to boil; cook 15 minutes on low heat. Add jello and mix well.
Pack in pint or 1/2-pint jars.
Seal. Refrigerate overnight.
Store in freezer or refrigerator.
recipes.text: Berry Mato Jelly. Bring tomatoes and sugar to boil; cook 15 minutes on low heat. Add jello and mix well. Pack in pint or 1/2-pint jars. Seal. Refrigerate overnight. Store in freezer or refrigerator.

recipes.title: Chili-Potato Casserole
directions: Heat oven to 400°.
Empty potatoes into ungreased 2-quart casserole.
Cook and stir ground beef, green peppers, onion and salt in 10-inch skillet until beef is brown; drain.
Stir in sauce mix, chili powder, water and beans.
Add to potatoes.
Cook for about 40 minutes (until potatoes are tender).
Sprinkle with Cheddar cheese.
Let stand 5 minutes before serving.
recipes.text: Chili-Potato Casserole. Heat oven to 400°. Empty potatoes into ungreased 2-quart casserole. Cook and stir ground beef, green peppers, onion and salt in 10-inch skillet until beef is brown; drain. Stir in sauce mix, chili powder, water and beans. Add to potatoes. Cook for about 40 minutes (until potatoes are tender). Sprinkle with Cheddar cheese. Let stand 5 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Quick And Easy Swedish Meatballs
ingredients: 1 Tbsp. chopped fresh parsley or 1 tsp. dry
directions: Blend cream of celery soup with water in casserole or saucepan. Measure out 1/4 cup soup mixture and combine in bowl with ground beef, bread crumbs, egg, onion and parsley.
Shape mixture into balls, about 1-inch in diameter.
Brown on top of stove or microwave on High for 12 to 15 minutes.
Add meatballs to remaining soup mixture.
Cook, covered, over low heat about 20 minutes, stirring now and then.
Makes 4 servings.
recipes.text: Quick And Easy Swedish Meatballs. Blend cream of celery soup with water in casserole or saucepan. Measure out 1/4 cup soup mixture and combine in bowl with ground beef, bread crumbs, egg, onion and parsley. Shape mixture into balls, about 1-inch in diameter. Brown on top of stove or microwave on High for 12 to 15 minutes. Add meatballs to remaining soup mixture. Cook, covered, over low heat about 20 minutes, stirring now and then. Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: Mop Sauce For Barbecue
directions: Cook onion in margarine until clear.
Add other ingredients. Bring to a boil.
Mop onto meat while grilling.
recipes.text: Mop Sauce For Barbecue. Cook onion in margarine until clear. Add other ingredients. Bring to a boil. Mop onto meat while grilling.

recipes.title: Grandpa'S Special Sauce
directions: Add orange juice until smooth.
recipes.text: Grandpa'S Special Sauce. Add orange juice until smooth.

recipes.title: Blackberry Butter
ingredients: 1/2 lb. (2 sticks) unsalted butter, at room temperature
1/2 c. ripe blackberries (fresh or frozen), drained
directions: In food processor, process the butter and berries to a smooth puree.
The butter will be a deep pink color.
Spoon butter into cute serving dish and refrigerate 1 hour before serving.
Serve with a small butter spreader, to accompany scones or homemade rolls.
recipes.text: Blackberry Butter. In food processor, process the butter and berries to a smooth puree. The butter will be a deep pink color. Spoon butter into cute serving dish and refrigerate 1 hour before serving. Serve with a small butter spreader, to accompany scones or homemade rolls.

recipes.title: Company Squash Casserole
directions: Place squash and onion in boiling salted water to cover. Cover and cook 5 minutes; drain well and set aside.
Melt 3 tablespoons oleo in a heavy saucepan over low heat; add flour and cook 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Gradually add milk; cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until thickened.
Add cheese and stir until melted.
Combine squash mixture, cheese sauce and mushrooms; spoon into lightly greased 1 1/2-quart casserole.
Melt 2 tablespoons oleo and stir in cracker crumbs and pecans. Sprinkle over squash.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
Serves 6.
recipes.text: Company Squash Casserole. Place squash and onion in boiling salted water to cover. Cover and cook 5 minutes; drain well and set aside. Melt 3 tablespoons oleo in a heavy saucepan over low heat; add flour and cook 1 minute, stirring constantly. Gradually add milk; cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until thickened. Add cheese and stir until melted. Combine squash mixture, cheese sauce and mushrooms; spoon into lightly greased 1 1/2-quart casserole. Melt 2 tablespoons oleo and stir in cracker crumbs and pecans. Sprinkle over squash. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes. Serves 6.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Cookies
directions: Mix well and use a teaspoon to dip batter.
Place on a cookie sheet.
Flatten with fork.
Bake at 375° for 10 to 12 minutes.
recipes.text: Peanut Butter Cookies. Mix well and use a teaspoon to dip batter. Place on a cookie sheet. Flatten with fork. Bake at 375° for 10 to 12 minutes.

recipes.title: Pistachio Nut Cake Deluxe
directions: Heat oven to 350°.
Grease and flour Bundt cake pan.
(I also cut out a circle of wax paper to fit bottom of pan to prevent sticking).
Melt shortening.
Put all ingredients into food processor.
Now, add shortening and mix for 1 1/2 to 2 minutes. Batter will be thin.
Spoon into prepared pan.
Level with spoon. Bake for 50 to 55 minutes or until cake comes out clean.
Remove cake when pan is cool to the touch.
recipes.text: Pistachio Nut Cake Deluxe. Heat oven to 350°. Grease and flour Bundt cake pan. (I also cut out a circle of wax paper to fit bottom of pan to prevent sticking). Melt shortening. Put all ingredients into food processor. Now, add shortening and mix for 1 1/2 to 2 minutes. Batter will be thin. Spoon into prepared pan. Level with spoon. Bake for 50 to 55 minutes or until cake comes out clean. Remove cake when pan is cool to the touch.

recipes.title: Mandarin Orange Cake
ingredients: 1 box Duncan Hines yellow cake mix (no pudding)
1 can mandarin orange slices, cut in small pieces (use juice)
directions: Mix ingredients. Bake at 325° for 30 minutes in layered pans (greased and floured).
recipes.text: Mandarin Orange Cake. Mix ingredients. Bake at 325° for 30 minutes in layered pans (greased and floured).

recipes.title: Angel Food Dream
ingredients: 2 (12 oz.) containers lite Cool Whip, thawed
3 small or 2 large angel food cakes
directions: Combine Cool Whip and yogurt with wire whip.
Add strawberries.
Tear cake into small pieces; add to mixture. Refrigerate at least 3 hours.
Serves 12 to 16.
(This is very low-fat!!!)
recipes.text: Angel Food Dream. Combine Cool Whip and yogurt with wire whip. Add strawberries. Tear cake into small pieces; add to mixture. Refrigerate at least 3 hours. Serves 12 to 16. (This is very low-fat!!!)

recipes.title: Hawaiian Sweet And Sour Ribs
ingredients: 2 lb. spareribs (have butcher cut ribs in fourth)
shredded daikon and carrots for garnish
directions: Boil ribs in
water
for
about 30 minutes; drain.
Add all ingredients (except the garnish) and cook about 15 minutes on high to coat
well and tender.
Layer platter with shredded daikon and carrots mixture.
Pour ribs on top and serve.
recipes.text: Hawaiian Sweet And Sour Ribs. Boil ribs in water for about 30 minutes; drain. Add all ingredients (except the garnish) and cook about 15 minutes on high to coat well and tender. Layer platter with shredded daikon and carrots mixture. Pour ribs on top and serve.

recipes.title: Chicken Dijon With Artichokes
ingredients: 8 chicken breast halves, skinned and boned
1 (14 1/2 oz.) can artichoke hearts, drained and sliced
6 Tbsp. liquid reduced fat butter mix
directions: In large nonstick skillet sprayed with vegetable spray, saute chicken in liquid butter mix over low heat.
Remove from pan.
Add flour and stir over low heat until smooth.
Add more liquid butter mix, if dry.
Stir in broth and skim milk.
Add mustard.
Add artichoke hearts and simmer chicken in sauce for 30 minutes. Serve over rice or noodles.
recipes.text: Chicken Dijon With Artichokes. In large nonstick skillet sprayed with vegetable spray, saute chicken in liquid butter mix over low heat. Remove from pan. Add flour and stir over low heat until smooth. Add more liquid butter mix, if dry. Stir in broth and skim milk. Add mustard. Add artichoke hearts and simmer chicken in sauce for 30 minutes. Serve over rice or noodles.

recipes.title: Squash Dressing
directions: Mix all together in 2-quart dish.
Bake at 400° until brown on top, approximately 30 to 40 minutes.
recipes.text: Squash Dressing. Mix all together in 2-quart dish. Bake at 400° until brown on top, approximately 30 to 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Icebox Fruit Cake
ingredients: 1 box vanilla wafers or graham crackers
directions: Crush wafers and mix thoroughly with coconut, pecans and raisins.
Add milk and mix with hands.
Place in a loaf pan lined with wax paper, pressing together firmly.
Place in refrigerator with a heavy weight on top overnight.
Then slice as needed; store in refrigerator when not in use.
recipes.text: Icebox Fruit Cake. Crush wafers and mix thoroughly with coconut, pecans and raisins. Add milk and mix with hands. Place in a loaf pan lined with wax paper, pressing together firmly. Place in refrigerator with a heavy weight on top overnight. Then slice as needed; store in refrigerator when not in use.

recipes.title: Swiss Chicken
ingredients: 4 whole chicken breasts, split, boned and skinned
1/4 c. white wine (may use broth, apple juice or white grape juice)
directions: Place chicken breasts in buttered baking dish.
Cover each breast with one slice of cheese.
In small saucepan, mix 2 tablespoons butter with flour; blend over low heat until smooth and bubbling.
Slowly stir in milk and broth; season with salt and pepper to taste.
Add wine and pour over chicken.
Combine stuffing mix with remaining 3 tablespoons butter.
Spread over top of chicken.
Bake at 350° for 45 to 60 minutes.
recipes.text: Swiss Chicken. Place chicken breasts in buttered baking dish. Cover each breast with one slice of cheese. In small saucepan, mix 2 tablespoons butter with flour; blend over low heat until smooth and bubbling. Slowly stir in milk and broth; season with salt and pepper to taste. Add wine and pour over chicken. Combine stuffing mix with remaining 3 tablespoons butter. Spread over top of chicken. Bake at 350° for 45 to 60 minutes.

recipes.title: Chicken Divan
directions: Boil chicken until done.
Cut up in cubes.
Steam fresh broccoli until fork can go through.
recipes.text: Chicken Divan. Boil chicken until done. Cut up in cubes. Steam fresh broccoli until fork can go through.

recipes.title: Mexican Layered Taco Dip
directions: Spread bean dip on a 14-inch round tray.
Combine mayonnaise, sour cream and taco seasoning.
Put that on top
of bean dip. Dice tomatoes, green onions (stems included) and black olives. Grate Cheddar cheese.
Layer tomatoes, green onions and black olives in order and top with cheese.
Keep in refrigerator until ready to serve.
recipes.text: Mexican Layered Taco Dip. Spread bean dip on a 14-inch round tray. Combine mayonnaise, sour cream and taco seasoning. Put that on top of bean dip. Dice tomatoes, green onions (stems included) and black olives. Grate Cheddar cheese. Layer tomatoes, green onions and black olives in order and top with cheese. Keep in refrigerator until ready to serve.

recipes.title: Meat Loaf
directions: In large bowl, combine catsup, tomato juice, salt, black pepper, red pepper, eggs, bread crumbs, onions and mustard. Blend well.
Add ground beef.
Mix gently, but thoroughly.
Line 9 x 5-inch loaf pan with foil; press in the beef mixture.
recipes.text: Meat Loaf. In large bowl, combine catsup, tomato juice, salt, black pepper, red pepper, eggs, bread crumbs, onions and mustard. Blend well. Add ground beef. Mix gently, but thoroughly. Line 9 x 5-inch loaf pan with foil; press in the beef mixture.

recipes.title: Yum Chicken
ingredients: 3 whole chicken breasts, halved, skinned and deboned
directions: Wrap a slice of bacon around each piece of chicken; secure with toothpicks.
Place on greased 10 x 7-inch baking dish. Combine remaining ingredients and pour over chicken.
Bake uncovered at 350° for 2 hours.
recipes.text: Yum Chicken. Wrap a slice of bacon around each piece of chicken; secure with toothpicks. Place on greased 10 x 7-inch baking dish. Combine remaining ingredients and pour over chicken. Bake uncovered at 350° for 2 hours.

recipes.title: Lo-Cal Eggnog
ingredients: 1 1/2 c. Egg Beaters, mixed until light and fluffy
directions: Mix all together and store in refrigerator for at least 2 hours, then serve.
recipes.text: Lo-Cal Eggnog. Mix all together and store in refrigerator for at least 2 hours, then serve.

recipes.title: Chicken-In-Soups
ingredients: 2 to 3 lb. boneless chicken, cut into chunks
directions: Combine soups and wine.
Add chicken.
Bake 1 hour, covered, at 350°.
recipes.text: Chicken-In-Soups. Combine soups and wine. Add chicken. Bake 1 hour, covered, at 350°.

recipes.title: Irish Potatoes(Candy)
directions: In a large bowl, place coconut and confectioners sugar and mix.
Add lite cream, but only until you can form a ball (1/2-inch in diameter).
Roll in cinnamon.
Makes 30 to 35 candy potatoes.
recipes.text: Irish Potatoes(Candy). In a large bowl, place coconut and confectioners sugar and mix. Add lite cream, but only until you can form a ball (1/2-inch in diameter). Roll in cinnamon. Makes 30 to 35 candy potatoes.

recipes.title: Microwave Caramel Corn
directions: Bring to boil in glass bowl the sugar, margarine and salt. When it begins to boil, then boil for 2 minutes on Full power. Remove and add baking soda.
Pour over popcorn that has been put in a paper bag sprayed with Pam.
Shake up and put in microwave for 1 1/2 minutes.
Remove and shake.
Put back in for 1 1/2 minutes.
Remove and shake, then pour on waxed paper.
Let cool.
recipes.text: Microwave Caramel Corn. Bring to boil in glass bowl the sugar, margarine and salt. When it begins to boil, then boil for 2 minutes on Full power. Remove and add baking soda. Pour over popcorn that has been put in a paper bag sprayed with Pam. Shake up and put in microwave for 1 1/2 minutes. Remove and shake. Put back in for 1 1/2 minutes. Remove and shake, then pour on waxed paper. Let cool.

recipes.title: Bisquick Mix
directions: Mix dry ingredients together in large bowl.
Add Crisco and blend by hand or pastry blender
until
mixture looks like cornmeal.
Store
in glass, plastic
or
can
container
with tight-fitting lid.
recipes.text: Bisquick Mix. Mix dry ingredients together in large bowl. Add Crisco and blend by hand or pastry blender until mixture looks like cornmeal. Store in glass, plastic or can container with tight-fitting lid.

recipes.title: Banana Nut Fruit Cake
directions: Mix well, beating after each addition.
Grease and line bottom of angel food pan.
Use 2 thick pieces of brown paper.
Bake for 1 hour and 15 minutes at 350°.
Keeps moist for a long time.
recipes.text: Banana Nut Fruit Cake. Mix well, beating after each addition. Grease and line bottom of angel food pan. Use 2 thick pieces of brown paper. Bake for 1 hour and 15 minutes at 350°. Keeps moist for a long time.

recipes.title: Spiced Tea Mix
ingredients: 1/2 c. instant tea (no sugar or lemon)
2 tsp. cinnamon (I usually put a little more)
directions: Stir all ingredients together and mix well. Put in a tightly closed jar. Use 3 tablespoons to 1 cup boiling water.
recipes.text: Spiced Tea Mix. Stir all ingredients together and mix well. Put in a tightly closed jar. Use 3 tablespoons to 1 cup boiling water.

recipes.title: Favorite Pecan Pie
directions: Preheat oven to 350°.
Combine ingredients by hand and pour into pie shell.
Bake 45 to 55 minutes.
recipes.text: Favorite Pecan Pie. Preheat oven to 350°. Combine ingredients by hand and pour into pie shell. Bake 45 to 55 minutes.

recipes.title: Uncooked Cookies
directions: Melt chocolate over hot water.
Combine with syrup and juice. Add rest in any order.
Let stand 30 minutes.
(I never had that much time.)
Form into 1-inch balls (or whatever size you wish). Roll in granulated sugar.
recipes.text: Uncooked Cookies. Melt chocolate over hot water. Combine with syrup and juice. Add rest in any order. Let stand 30 minutes. (I never had that much time.) Form into 1-inch balls (or whatever size you wish). Roll in granulated sugar.

recipes.title: Pamela'S Dip
ingredients: 2 small tomatoes, chopped; take seeds out
directions: Mix all ingredients together well.
Serve with tortilla chips. Delicious.
recipes.text: Pamela'S Dip. Mix all ingredients together well. Serve with tortilla chips. Delicious.

recipes.title: Eth'S Donuts
directions: Mix sugar, eggs and shortening.
Put flour, salt, nutmeg, ginger, soda and baking powder in sieve.
Add to sugar mixture alternately with sour milk.
recipes.text: Eth'S Donuts. Mix sugar, eggs and shortening. Put flour, salt, nutmeg, ginger, soda and baking powder in sieve. Add to sugar mixture alternately with sour milk.

recipes.title: Special Coffee Cake
directions: Follow recipe for Nestle Toll House chocolate chip cookies, but use Crisco instead of butter and melt it completely first along with a handful of chocolate chips (usually 1 to 2 minutes in microwave).
The cookies won't flatten out while baking.
Everyone will want to know your secret.
recipes.text: Special Coffee Cake. Follow recipe for Nestle Toll House chocolate chip cookies, but use Crisco instead of butter and melt it completely first along with a handful of chocolate chips (usually 1 to 2 minutes in microwave). The cookies won't flatten out while baking. Everyone will want to know your secret.

recipes.title: Golden Bars
directions: Mix Cheerios, nuts and coconut in large bowl; set aside.
Mix in saucepan sugar, corn syrup and milk together and cook over low heat, stirring occasionally to 236° or until soft ball stage. Remove and pour syrup mixture over Cheerios; mix well.
Put in a buttered 9-inch pan and pat.
Cool and cut in squares.
recipes.text: Golden Bars. Mix Cheerios, nuts and coconut in large bowl; set aside. Mix in saucepan sugar, corn syrup and milk together and cook over low heat, stirring occasionally to 236° or until soft ball stage. Remove and pour syrup mixture over Cheerios; mix well. Put in a buttered 9-inch pan and pat. Cool and cut in squares.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Logs
directions: Blend peanut butter, honey, and dry milk. Add raisins and mix well. Stir in graham cracker crumbs. Roll teaspoonful of mixture on wax paper to shape in logs. Refrigerate one hour. Make about 50.
recipes.text: Peanut Butter Logs. Blend peanut butter, honey, and dry milk. Add raisins and mix well. Stir in graham cracker crumbs. Roll teaspoonful of mixture on wax paper to shape in logs. Refrigerate one hour. Make about 50.

recipes.title: Sausage Pinwheels
directions: Blend shortening with dry ingredients.
Add milk and mix well. Turn onto floured surface and knead about 1 minute.
Divide dough into 2 parts.
Roll about 1/4-inch thick.
Spread each half with 1/2 pound sausage, which has been softened to room temperature. Put rolls into refrigerator for at least 1 hour or overnight. Slice 1/4-inch thick.
Bake in 400° oven for about 15 to 20 minutes.
Makes about 60 to 70.
recipes.text: Sausage Pinwheels. Blend shortening with dry ingredients. Add milk and mix well. Turn onto floured surface and knead about 1 minute. Divide dough into 2 parts. Roll about 1/4-inch thick. Spread each half with 1/2 pound sausage, which has been softened to room temperature. Put rolls into refrigerator for at least 1 hour or overnight. Slice 1/4-inch thick. Bake in 400° oven for about 15 to 20 minutes. Makes about 60 to 70.

recipes.title: Flan
directions: Melt 1 cup sugar in saucepan.
Mix all ingredients except cinnamon together and pour into casserole or pie plate or if you don't have one, use a 7x
12-inch Pyrex casserole.
Mix milk and a can of water and blend in the eggs and 5 tablespoons of the sugar. Sprinkle with the cinnamon and bake in water bath about 1-inch of water in large pan.
Bake in preheated 350° oven for about 1 1/2 hours.
Serve in the pan or unmold after it is cooled.
recipes.text: Flan. Melt 1 cup sugar in saucepan. Mix all ingredients except cinnamon together and pour into casserole or pie plate or if you don't have one, use a 7x 12-inch Pyrex casserole. Mix milk and a can of water and blend in the eggs and 5 tablespoons of the sugar. Sprinkle with the cinnamon and bake in water bath about 1-inch of water in large pan. Bake in preheated 350° oven for about 1 1/2 hours. Serve in the pan or unmold after it is cooled.

recipes.title: Vegetable Soup
directions: Combine in crock-pot on low for 6 to 8 hours. Serves 8 to 10.
recipes.text: Vegetable Soup. Combine in crock-pot on low for 6 to 8 hours. Serves 8 to 10.

recipes.title: Hot Artichoke Dip
directions: Drain pimento.
In a bowl, mix chilies, cheeses, artichoke hearts and mayo. Spoon into 1 1/2-quart baking dish.
Sprinkle more Parmesan and the pimento on top. Bake for 30 minutes at 325°.
recipes.text: Hot Artichoke Dip. Drain pimento. In a bowl, mix chilies, cheeses, artichoke hearts and mayo. Spoon into 1 1/2-quart baking dish. Sprinkle more Parmesan and the pimento on top. Bake for 30 minutes at 325°.

recipes.title: Baked Salmon Loaf
directions: Mix all ingredients; press into loaf shape.
Place in open baking pan lined with heavily greased aluminum foil.
Bake 40 minutes at 370°.
recipes.text: Baked Salmon Loaf. Mix all ingredients; press into loaf shape. Place in open baking pan lined with heavily greased aluminum foil. Bake 40 minutes at 370°.

recipes.title: Fruit Jar Bread
directions: *Two cups sweet potatoes or zucchini squash may be substituted for pumpkin.
recipes.text: Fruit Jar Bread. *Two cups sweet potatoes or zucchini squash may be substituted for pumpkin.

recipes.title: Queen Elizabeth Cake
directions: Mix together sugar, shortening, egg and vanilla.
Add flour, baking powder and soda.
Next, add remaining ingredients.
Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes or until cake tests done.
recipes.text: Queen Elizabeth Cake. Mix together sugar, shortening, egg and vanilla. Add flour, baking powder and soda. Next, add remaining ingredients. Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes or until cake tests done.

recipes.title: Mound'S Balls
directions: Mix and make into balls.
Chill 1 hour.
recipes.text: Mound'S Balls. Mix and make into balls. Chill 1 hour.

recipes.title: Chocolate Layered Dessert
directions: Mix above and spread into an 8-inch pan and bake at 350° for 15 minutes; cool completely.
recipes.text: Chocolate Layered Dessert. Mix above and spread into an 8-inch pan and bake at 350° for 15 minutes; cool completely.

recipes.title: Fruit Dip
directions: Mix and serve as a dip for fruit.
recipes.text: Fruit Dip. Mix and serve as a dip for fruit.

recipes.title: Hello Dollies
directions: Heat margarine in 9 x 9 x 2-inch pan.
Sprinkle crumbs over margarine and pat into a crust.
Sprinkle in next 3 ingredients. Pour milk evenly over entire pan.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes. Cut into squares while warm.
Yields 24.
recipes.text: Hello Dollies. Heat margarine in 9 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Sprinkle crumbs over margarine and pat into a crust. Sprinkle in next 3 ingredients. Pour milk evenly over entire pan. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes. Cut into squares while warm. Yields 24.

recipes.title: Apple Dip
directions: Mix the ingredients with mixer on medium speed until blended and at high speed until smooth and creamy.
recipes.text: Apple Dip. Mix the ingredients with mixer on medium speed until blended and at high speed until smooth and creamy.

recipes.title: Marinated Broccoli Salad
ingredients: 1/2 c. golden raisins, blanched (plunge for a few seconds in boiling water)
directions: Cut broccoli flowerets into bite size pieces and wash thoroughly.
Drain well.
Add onion, raisins and bacon.
Mix mayonnaise, cheese, sugar and vinegar.
Toss the 2 mixtures and refrigerate for at least 3 hours.
recipes.text: Marinated Broccoli Salad. Cut broccoli flowerets into bite size pieces and wash thoroughly. Drain well. Add onion, raisins and bacon. Mix mayonnaise, cheese, sugar and vinegar. Toss the 2 mixtures and refrigerate for at least 3 hours.

recipes.title: Peach Cobbler
directions: Add sugar, flour, salt, peaches and brandy to margarine in saucepan.
Cook for about 4 minutes after it comes to a boil. Pour mixture into a greased casserole dish.
recipes.text: Peach Cobbler. Add sugar, flour, salt, peaches and brandy to margarine in saucepan. Cook for about 4 minutes after it comes to a boil. Pour mixture into a greased casserole dish.

recipes.title: Oriental Chicken Casserole
directions: Marinate cubed chicken in soy sauce and lemon juice overnight. Mix with remaining ingredients (except noodles).
Pour into greased 2-quart casserole; top with noodles or almonds.
Cook 25 minutes in 350° oven.
recipes.text: Oriental Chicken Casserole. Marinate cubed chicken in soy sauce and lemon juice overnight. Mix with remaining ingredients (except noodles). Pour into greased 2-quart casserole; top with noodles or almonds. Cook 25 minutes in 350° oven.

recipes.title: Pig Cake
directions: Mix all ingredients together and bake in 3 pans according to cake directions.
recipes.text: Pig Cake. Mix all ingredients together and bake in 3 pans according to cake directions.

recipes.title: No Sugar Apple Bars(Sugar-Free)
directions: In saucepan, mix water, raisins, shortening, cinnamon and nutmeg.
Bring to a boil and simmer 3 minutes; cool.
In mixing bowl, beat egg and vanilla.
Add to raisin mixture.
Mix flour, salt, soda and nuts and add to mixture.
Spread into 6 x 6-inch pans.
Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.
Cut into bars and serve warm.
recipes.text: No Sugar Apple Bars(Sugar-Free). In saucepan, mix water, raisins, shortening, cinnamon and nutmeg. Bring to a boil and simmer 3 minutes; cool. In mixing bowl, beat egg and vanilla. Add to raisin mixture. Mix flour, salt, soda and nuts and add to mixture. Spread into 6 x 6-inch pans. Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes. Cut into bars and serve warm.

recipes.title: Calabasa(Mexican Stew)
ingredients: 1 to 2 lb. pork, cubed (can use roast, chops, steak, etc.)
3 to 4 zucchini (yellow squash can be used)
directions: Boil cubed pork in lightly salted water for about 30 minutes. Drain.
Add canned tomatoes, squash and onion; simmer until vegetables are tender, about 20 minutes.
Add cumin, salt and pepper to taste.
(Can serve with warmed tortillas or rice.)
recipes.text: Calabasa(Mexican Stew). Boil cubed pork in lightly salted water for about 30 minutes. Drain. Add canned tomatoes, squash and onion; simmer until vegetables are tender, about 20 minutes. Add cumin, salt and pepper to taste. (Can serve with warmed tortillas or rice.)

recipes.title: Strawberry Pineapple Cup
directions: Drain pineapple.
Alternate layers of pineapple and strawberries; sprinkle each layer with sugar.
Sprinkle mint over top; chill thoroughly.
Serve in sherbet glass.
Serves 6.
recipes.text: Strawberry Pineapple Cup. Drain pineapple. Alternate layers of pineapple and strawberries; sprinkle each layer with sugar. Sprinkle mint over top; chill thoroughly. Serve in sherbet glass. Serves 6.

recipes.title: Chocolate Pie
directions: Melt chocolate bars, water and salt in double boiler or microwave oven.
Let cool.
Fold the whipped cream into it.
Pour into cooked pie shell.
Cool in refrigerator.
Can garnish with whipped cream.
recipes.text: Chocolate Pie. Melt chocolate bars, water and salt in double boiler or microwave oven. Let cool. Fold the whipped cream into it. Pour into cooked pie shell. Cool in refrigerator. Can garnish with whipped cream.

recipes.title: Cabbage Salad
ingredients: 1 pkg. chicken or onion Top Ramen noodles
directions: Saute almonds in a small amount of butter.
Add to shredded cabbage.
Add green onions.
recipes.text: Cabbage Salad. Saute almonds in a small amount of butter. Add to shredded cabbage. Add green onions.

recipes.title: Granny'S Cake And Topping
directions: Mix all the ingredients and pour into a greased 9 x 13-inch baking dish.
Mix 1/2 cup brown sugar and 1 1/2 cups nuts. Sprinkle on top of cake batter and bake 40 minutes at 325°.
recipes.text: Granny'S Cake And Topping. Mix all the ingredients and pour into a greased 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Mix 1/2 cup brown sugar and 1 1/2 cups nuts. Sprinkle on top of cake batter and bake 40 minutes at 325°.

recipes.title: Deviled Ham Dip For Crackers
directions: Stir together; refrigerate. Serve on crackers.
recipes.text: Deviled Ham Dip For Crackers. Stir together; refrigerate. Serve on crackers.

recipes.title: Tofu Dip(Dairyless Dip)
directions: Process lemon and garlic in blender.
Add everything except parsley; add parsley last.
Serve with crackers.
recipes.text: Tofu Dip(Dairyless Dip). Process lemon and garlic in blender. Add everything except parsley; add parsley last. Serve with crackers.

recipes.title: Cheese Straws
directions: Cream butter and cheese together with seasoning.
Add flour, baking powder and salt.
Knead dough.
Roll out and cut or use a cookie press.
Add 1 tablespoon of water if dough is too stiff. Use ungreased cookie sheet.
Bake at 325° for 15 minutes.
recipes.text: Cheese Straws. Cream butter and cheese together with seasoning. Add flour, baking powder and salt. Knead dough. Roll out and cut or use a cookie press. Add 1 tablespoon of water if dough is too stiff. Use ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 325° for 15 minutes.

recipes.title: 8 Minute Cheesecake
ingredients: 1 large can fruit of your choice (cherries, strawberries or crushed pineapple)
directions: Beat cream cheese until smooth; gradually beat in sugar. Blend in sour cream and vanilla.
Fold in Cool Whip, blending well.
Spoon into crust.
Chill until set, at least 4 hours. Garnish with fruit.
recipes.text: 8 Minute Cheesecake. Beat cream cheese until smooth; gradually beat in sugar. Blend in sour cream and vanilla. Fold in Cool Whip, blending well. Spoon into crust. Chill until set, at least 4 hours. Garnish with fruit.

recipes.title: Cream Of Broccoli Soup
ingredients: 2 (10 3/4 oz.) cans cream of celery soup (undiluted)
directions: Saute onion in cooking oil in skillet until soft.
Combine all ingredients in slow cooker.
Cover.
Cook on low 3 to 4 hours. Yield: 6 to 8 servings.
recipes.text: Cream Of Broccoli Soup. Saute onion in cooking oil in skillet until soft. Combine all ingredients in slow cooker. Cover. Cook on low 3 to 4 hours. Yield: 6 to 8 servings.

recipes.title: London Broil Marinade
ingredients: 2 to 3 lb. top round steak (1 to 1 1/2-inches thick) or cut of your choice
directions: Combine ingredients in a small bowl. Score meat on both sides. Pour marinade over meat.
Marinate overnight. Broil steak 4 to 5 minutes per pound on each side. Slice thin and serve.
recipes.text: London Broil Marinade. Combine ingredients in a small bowl. Score meat on both sides. Pour marinade over meat. Marinate overnight. Broil steak 4 to 5 minutes per pound on each side. Slice thin and serve.

recipes.title: Artichoke Dip
ingredients: 1 pkg. Good Season's Zesty Italian salad dressing mix
directions: Drain artichokes.
Cut into small pieces.
Mix mayonnaise and salad dressing mix and add to artichokes.
Mix well.
Chill. Delicious with sourdough bread.
recipes.text: Artichoke Dip. Drain artichokes. Cut into small pieces. Mix mayonnaise and salad dressing mix and add to artichokes. Mix well. Chill. Delicious with sourdough bread.

recipes.title: No Bake Oatmeal Cookies
directions: Mix sugar, milk, cocoa and butter.
Cook until boiling.
Then add peanut butter, vanilla and oatmeal.
Spoon out onto wax paper and let stand for approximately 10 minutes.
recipes.text: No Bake Oatmeal Cookies. Mix sugar, milk, cocoa and butter. Cook until boiling. Then add peanut butter, vanilla and oatmeal. Spoon out onto wax paper and let stand for approximately 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Tacoritas
ingredients: 1 can Old El Paso enchilada sauce
directions: Brown beef
and add taco seasoning, according to directions on package.
Place
flour
tortillas in baking dish and fill with
2 heaping
tablespoons
ground
beef mixture.
Add lettuce, tomato and
onions.
Fold over and close with toothpicks.	Heat enchilada
sauce and Velveeta cheese.
Pour over the tortillas and
top
with
grated Cheddar cheese.
Bake 20 minutes at 350°. Serve with picante.
recipes.text: Tacoritas. Brown beef and add taco seasoning, according to directions on package. Place flour tortillas in baking dish and fill with 2 heaping tablespoons ground beef mixture. Add lettuce, tomato and onions. Fold over and close with toothpicks.	Heat enchilada sauce and Velveeta cheese. Pour over the tortillas and top with grated Cheddar cheese. Bake 20 minutes at 350°. Serve with picante.

recipes.title: Better Than *** Cake
directions: Bake cake as per directions. While cake is still hot, poke holes all over. Pour over sweetened milk and caramel.
Let set and cool.
When cake is cool, top with Cool Whip. Crush candy bars. Sprinkle on Cool Whip. Refrigerate.
recipes.text: Better Than *** Cake. Bake cake as per directions. While cake is still hot, poke holes all over. Pour over sweetened milk and caramel. Let set and cool. When cake is cool, top with Cool Whip. Crush candy bars. Sprinkle on Cool Whip. Refrigerate.

recipes.title: Chunky Pimiento Cheese
ingredients: 4 c. (16 oz.) finely shredded sharp Cheddar cheese
directions: Combine cream cheese and pimiento; stir well.
Add remaining ingredients; stir well.
Cover and chill.
recipes.text: Chunky Pimiento Cheese. Combine cream cheese and pimiento; stir well. Add remaining ingredients; stir well. Cover and chill.

recipes.title: Ice Cream Icing
directions: Mix ingredients all together and beat until light and fluffy.
recipes.text: Ice Cream Icing. Mix ingredients all together and beat until light and fluffy.

recipes.title: Easy Hamburger Stroganoff
directions: Brown hamburger with onion and drain.
Salt and pepper to taste.
Add soups and sour cream and simmer for a few minutes. Serve over cooked noodles.
recipes.text: Easy Hamburger Stroganoff. Brown hamburger with onion and drain. Salt and pepper to taste. Add soups and sour cream and simmer for a few minutes. Serve over cooked noodles.

recipes.title: Hamburger Potato Casserole
directions: In large heavy skillet, melt butter.
Add rest of ingredients in layers.
Cover and let simmer 40 minutes or until done.
recipes.text: Hamburger Potato Casserole. In large heavy skillet, melt butter. Add rest of ingredients in layers. Cover and let simmer 40 minutes or until done.

recipes.title: Artichoke Surprise
ingredients: 2 (6 oz.) jars artichoke hearts, quartered (reserve liquid)
1 c. ham, cubed (turkey or chicken may be used)
directions: Cook rice in chicken broth with enough water to make 2 cups of liquid. Combine liquid from artichokes with mayonnaise and curry. Set aside. Stir remaining ingredients into hot rice. Add curry-mayo dressing. Blend well. Cover and bake at 350° for 20 minutes. Serves 4.
recipes.text: Artichoke Surprise. Cook rice in chicken broth with enough water to make 2 cups of liquid. Combine liquid from artichokes with mayonnaise and curry. Set aside. Stir remaining ingredients into hot rice. Add curry-mayo dressing. Blend well. Cover and bake at 350° for 20 minutes. Serves 4.

recipes.title: Tortellini Salad
ingredients: 1/2 c. Marie's lite and zesty fat-free Italian vinaigrette
2 c. salad greens, torn in bite-size pieces
directions: Cook tortellini according to package directions (omitting salt).
Drain.
In a medium bowl, toss tortellini with dressing. Cool 10 minutes.
Add cucumber, tomato and green onion.
Toss gently to coat.
Serve at room temperature or cover and refrigerate.
Serve over salad greens.
recipes.text: Tortellini Salad. Cook tortellini according to package directions (omitting salt). Drain. In a medium bowl, toss tortellini with dressing. Cool 10 minutes. Add cucumber, tomato and green onion. Toss gently to coat. Serve at room temperature or cover and refrigerate. Serve over salad greens.

recipes.title: Chocolate Overdose Cookies
ingredients: 1 c. chocolate covered peanuts, chocolate covered raisins or mixed
directions: Preheat oven to 375°.
Cream margarine and sugar.
Blend in oil, eggs and vanilla.
Mix together dry ingredients and add to batter.
Fold in fudge and chocolate morsels and mix.
Roll into golf ball size balls and place on ungreased cookie sheet.
Bake for 15 to 18 minutes.
Makes 4 to 5 dozen.
recipes.text: Chocolate Overdose Cookies. Preheat oven to 375°. Cream margarine and sugar. Blend in oil, eggs and vanilla. Mix together dry ingredients and add to batter. Fold in fudge and chocolate morsels and mix. Roll into golf ball size balls and place on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake for 15 to 18 minutes. Makes 4 to 5 dozen.

recipes.title: Jane'S Shrimp Scampi And Baked Stuff Shrimp
ingredients: 2 lb. jumbo shrimp, peeled and dry
directions: Peel and devein shrimp.
In a baking dish, melt butter and add all ingredients.
Simmer for a few minutes.
Let cool.
Place shrimp in a baking dish.
Pour almost all mixture on shrimp.
Mix rest with bread crumbs.
Spread over top, rest of mixture or dry bread crumbs.
Bake at 450° for 10 to 15 minutes; then lower oven to 350° and bake an additional 15 to 20 minutes.
Voila!
recipes.text: Jane'S Shrimp Scampi And Baked Stuff Shrimp. Peel and devein shrimp. In a baking dish, melt butter and add all ingredients. Simmer for a few minutes. Let cool. Place shrimp in a baking dish. Pour almost all mixture on shrimp. Mix rest with bread crumbs. Spread over top, rest of mixture or dry bread crumbs. Bake at 450° for 10 to 15 minutes; then lower oven to 350° and bake an additional 15 to 20 minutes. Voila!

recipes.title: German Spice Bars(Lebkuchen)
ingredients: 1 1/3 c. honey (you can substitute some molasses for honey)
1/4 c. each: chopped citron, candied orange and lemon peel
directions: Heat honey and sugar slightly in a pan.
Add butter.
Add 2 cups flour and baking powder; beat well.
Add nuts, citron, peels and spices.
Add 1 1/2 to 2 more cups flour until you have a thick, pliable dough.
Pat it 1/4 inch thick into pans (three 8 x 8-inch cake pans and one 9 x 9-inch cake pan).
Bake about 25 minutes. When cool, cut in squares and ice with Lemon Glaze.
Make this ahead for Christmas.
Keeps 6 months when in an airtight container!
recipes.text: German Spice Bars(Lebkuchen). Heat honey and sugar slightly in a pan. Add butter. Add 2 cups flour and baking powder; beat well. Add nuts, citron, peels and spices. Add 1 1/2 to 2 more cups flour until you have a thick, pliable dough. Pat it 1/4 inch thick into pans (three 8 x 8-inch cake pans and one 9 x 9-inch cake pan). Bake about 25 minutes. When cool, cut in squares and ice with Lemon Glaze. Make this ahead for Christmas. Keeps 6 months when in an airtight container!

recipes.title: Cheddar Pecan Spread
ingredients: 4 oz reduced fat cream cheese, softened
directions: Beat cream cheese and butter until smooth.
Beat in remaining ingredients.
Serve with assorted vegetables and crackers.
This spread can be refrigerated up to 3 weeks.
recipes.text: Cheddar Pecan Spread. Beat cream cheese and butter until smooth. Beat in remaining ingredients. Serve with assorted vegetables and crackers. This spread can be refrigerated up to 3 weeks.

recipes.title: Cream Cheese Mints
ingredients: 1/8 tsp. peppermint oil or 1/2 tsp. peppermint extract
directions: Beat cream cheese and powdered sugar at medium speed with an electric mixer until smooth.
Add peppermint oil and food coloring.
Shape into 1/2-inch balls; roll in granulated sugar. Chill 1 to 2 hours or until firm.
Mints may be frozen in an airtight container up to 2 months.
Yields 6 dozen.
recipes.text: Cream Cheese Mints. Beat cream cheese and powdered sugar at medium speed with an electric mixer until smooth. Add peppermint oil and food coloring. Shape into 1/2-inch balls; roll in granulated sugar. Chill 1 to 2 hours or until firm. Mints may be frozen in an airtight container up to 2 months. Yields 6 dozen.

recipes.title: Rainbow Ice Cream Dessert
ingredients: 1 (3 oz.) pkg. each strawberry, lime and orange flavored gelatin
1 (10 oz.) pkg. frozen strawberries, partially thawed
directions: Cut or tear cake into small pieces.
Divide into thirds and place in medium-size bowls.
Sprinkle strawberry gelatin over one third, lime gelatin over another and orange gelatin over one third.
Toss each lightly with a fork until cake is well coated with gelatin.
In a 10-inch tube pan or angel food pan, put strawberry cake pieces in bottom.
Spoon strawberries over cake. Spread one third ice cream over strawberries.
Repeat layers with lime cake pieces, blueberries, ice cream, orange pieces, mandarin oranges and ice cream.
Freeze until firm.
Unmold on a chilled dessert plate.
recipes.text: Rainbow Ice Cream Dessert. Cut or tear cake into small pieces. Divide into thirds and place in medium-size bowls. Sprinkle strawberry gelatin over one third, lime gelatin over another and orange gelatin over one third. Toss each lightly with a fork until cake is well coated with gelatin. In a 10-inch tube pan or angel food pan, put strawberry cake pieces in bottom. Spoon strawberries over cake. Spread one third ice cream over strawberries. Repeat layers with lime cake pieces, blueberries, ice cream, orange pieces, mandarin oranges and ice cream. Freeze until firm. Unmold on a chilled dessert plate.

recipes.title: Pistachio Fruit Salad
directions: Mix all and refrigerate.
recipes.text: Pistachio Fruit Salad. Mix all and refrigerate.

recipes.title: Basic Vanilla Ice Cream
directions: Stir cream, sugar and vanilla to dissolve.
Freeze according to freezer directions.
recipes.text: Basic Vanilla Ice Cream. Stir cream, sugar and vanilla to dissolve. Freeze according to freezer directions.

recipes.title: Sour Cream Cake
directions: Combine the first 8 ingredients for the batter.
Mix the brown sugar, cinnamon and chopped pecans separately; set aside.
Grease a Bundt pan.
Alternate batter and nut mixture until all batter is used, ending with batter.
Bake at 350° for 55 minutes.
Let cake cool 10 minutes, then turn upside down.
recipes.text: Sour Cream Cake. Combine the first 8 ingredients for the batter. Mix the brown sugar, cinnamon and chopped pecans separately; set aside. Grease a Bundt pan. Alternate batter and nut mixture until all batter is used, ending with batter. Bake at 350° for 55 minutes. Let cake cool 10 minutes, then turn upside down.

recipes.title: Consomme Rice
ingredients: 1 can consomme plus enough water to make 2 c.
directions: In large skillet on top of stove, melt margarine.
Add onion and saute until tender.
Add rice and brown a little.
Add liquid, salt and parsley.
Place in covered casserole and bake at 350° for 1 hour.
Check in 30 minutes for consistency.
recipes.text: Consomme Rice. In large skillet on top of stove, melt margarine. Add onion and saute until tender. Add rice and brown a little. Add liquid, salt and parsley. Place in covered casserole and bake at 350° for 1 hour. Check in 30 minutes for consistency.

recipes.title: Toasted Coconut Bread
directions: Preheat oven to 350°.
Mix milk, egg, oil and vanilla.
Add to dry ingredients.
Stir until blended.
Pour into a greased and floured loaf pan, 9 x 5 x 3-inches.
Bake 1 hour.
recipes.text: Toasted Coconut Bread. Preheat oven to 350°. Mix milk, egg, oil and vanilla. Add to dry ingredients. Stir until blended. Pour into a greased and floured loaf pan, 9 x 5 x 3-inches. Bake 1 hour.

recipes.title: Boiled Cookies
directions: Mix cocoa and sugar.
Add milk and butter; cook for 2 1/2 minutes.
Remove from heat.
Add vanilla. Stir in oats and drop spoonfuls onto wax paper until set.
recipes.text: Boiled Cookies. Mix cocoa and sugar. Add milk and butter; cook for 2 1/2 minutes. Remove from heat. Add vanilla. Stir in oats and drop spoonfuls onto wax paper until set.

recipes.title: Spanish Rice
directions: *May add garlic, if desired.
recipes.text: Spanish Rice. *May add garlic, if desired.

recipes.title: Corn Potato Bake
directions: Peel and cut potatoes for cooking.
Cook until almost done. Transfer to casserole; add corn and salt and pepper to taste. Cover top with grated cheese.
Bake until brown in a 350° oven.
recipes.text: Corn Potato Bake. Peel and cut potatoes for cooking. Cook until almost done. Transfer to casserole; add corn and salt and pepper to taste. Cover top with grated cheese. Bake until brown in a 350° oven.

recipes.title: Chicken Liver Kabobs
directions: On skewers, alternate chicken livers, sprinkled with salt and pepper, folded half slices of bacon, mushrooms and stuffed olives. Grill kabobs over charcoal or broil indoors 2 to 3 inches from heat, turning occasionally until done.
To serve, rest skewer on plate.
Push off food.
Pass bottled meat sauce.
recipes.text: Chicken Liver Kabobs. On skewers, alternate chicken livers, sprinkled with salt and pepper, folded half slices of bacon, mushrooms and stuffed olives. Grill kabobs over charcoal or broil indoors 2 to 3 inches from heat, turning occasionally until done. To serve, rest skewer on plate. Push off food. Pass bottled meat sauce.

recipes.title: Pork Chop Dinner
ingredients: 4 medium sized Irish potatoes, thinly sliced
directions: Brown chops in frying pan.
Make layers of chops and sliced onions in a casserole dish.
Pour mushroom soup over this.
Bake, covered, one hour at 350°.
Use your own judgment about potatoes and onions, just enough of each to make a layer over chops. Serves 8.
recipes.text: Pork Chop Dinner. Brown chops in frying pan. Make layers of chops and sliced onions in a casserole dish. Pour mushroom soup over this. Bake, covered, one hour at 350°. Use your own judgment about potatoes and onions, just enough of each to make a layer over chops. Serves 8.

recipes.title: Praline Cheese Cake
ingredients: 3/4 c. firmly packed light brown sugar
directions: Grease well 8 or 9-inch round pan.
Prepare crumb crust and line sides and bottom of pan to about 1/4-inch thickness.
Set aside.
recipes.text: Praline Cheese Cake. Grease well 8 or 9-inch round pan. Prepare crumb crust and line sides and bottom of pan to about 1/4-inch thickness. Set aside.

recipes.title: Spinach Casserole
directions: Thaw spinach and drain until dry.
(Use strainer and press spinach with a spoon, then drying in a paper towel.)
Slice chestnuts.
Combine all ingredients well.
Place in 2-quart casserole dish and bake 45 minutes at 350° or until it bubbles. Serves 8 to 10.
recipes.text: Spinach Casserole. Thaw spinach and drain until dry. (Use strainer and press spinach with a spoon, then drying in a paper towel.) Slice chestnuts. Combine all ingredients well. Place in 2-quart casserole dish and bake 45 minutes at 350° or until it bubbles. Serves 8 to 10.

recipes.title: Oreo Cream Pie
directions: Take a can of biscuits out of the refrigerator. Peel back flap to open.
Hit the counter top edge and open can of biscuits.
Lay on a greased baking pan. Put in oven and bake as directed on can. Serve hot with white soup.
recipes.text: Oreo Cream Pie. Take a can of biscuits out of the refrigerator. Peel back flap to open. Hit the counter top edge and open can of biscuits. Lay on a greased baking pan. Put in oven and bake as directed on can. Serve hot with white soup.

recipes.title: Spiced Grapefruit Upside-Down Cake
directions: Heat oven to 325°.
Finely grate about 1/2 grapefruit peel; reserve.
Peel and cut grapefruit into 6 cartwheels and drain well.
recipes.text: Spiced Grapefruit Upside-Down Cake. Heat oven to 325°. Finely grate about 1/2 grapefruit peel; reserve. Peel and cut grapefruit into 6 cartwheels and drain well.

recipes.title: Chicken With Rice
ingredients: 1 whole chicken, cut up (approximately 3 to 4 lb.)
directions: Put rice on bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan, ungreased.
Place chicken parts over rice.
Mix soup and juice; pour over chicken. Sprinkle soup mix on top; cover with foil.
Bake at 325° for 2 1/2 hours.
recipes.text: Chicken With Rice. Put rice on bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan, ungreased. Place chicken parts over rice. Mix soup and juice; pour over chicken. Sprinkle soup mix on top; cover with foil. Bake at 325° for 2 1/2 hours.

recipes.title: Ugly Duckling Cake
ingredients: 1 pkg. lemon flavor instant pudding and pie filling
directions: Blend all ingredients except brown sugar and nuts in large mixing bowl.
Beat 4 minutes at medium speed.
Pour into greased and floured 13 x 9-inch pan.
Sprinkle with brown sugar and nuts. Bake at 325° for 1 hour.
Cool in pan 15 minutes.
Spoon hot butter glaze over warm cake.
recipes.text: Ugly Duckling Cake. Blend all ingredients except brown sugar and nuts in large mixing bowl. Beat 4 minutes at medium speed. Pour into greased and floured 13 x 9-inch pan. Sprinkle with brown sugar and nuts. Bake at 325° for 1 hour. Cool in pan 15 minutes. Spoon hot butter glaze over warm cake.

recipes.title: One Pot Stew
directions: Mix. Bake at 325° for 3 1/2 hours.
recipes.text: One Pot Stew. Mix. Bake at 325° for 3 1/2 hours.

recipes.title: Jello No Bake Cake
directions: Cut or tear angel food cake into large pieces and place in 9 x 13-inch pan.
Mix together jello and boiling water in large bowl. Mix in strawberries and cold water and pour over angel food cake. Top with Cool Whip when jello is set.
Great for a refreshing summer cake.
recipes.text: Jello No Bake Cake. Cut or tear angel food cake into large pieces and place in 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix together jello and boiling water in large bowl. Mix in strawberries and cold water and pour over angel food cake. Top with Cool Whip when jello is set. Great for a refreshing summer cake.

recipes.title: Chicken Cacciatore
ingredients: 3 to 4 chicken breasts, split and skinned
1 (16 oz.) can tomatoes, chopped with juice
directions: Brown chicken in oil.
Remove from pan.
Saute onion, celery and garlic in same oil very slowly for 15 minutes.
Do not allow to brown.
Return chicken to pan and add remaining ingredients. Cook over low heat until chicken is tender, about 45 minutes. Serve over freshly cooked mostaccioli.
recipes.text: Chicken Cacciatore. Brown chicken in oil. Remove from pan. Saute onion, celery and garlic in same oil very slowly for 15 minutes. Do not allow to brown.
