Return chicken to pan and add remaining ingredients. Cook over low heat until chicken is tender, about 45 minutes. Serve over freshly cooked mostaccioli.

recipes.title: Phadiaho(Mexican Spaghetti)
directions: Fry noodles in olive oil, stirring constantly until golden brown.
Add celery, onion, mushrooms, garlic, tomatoes, wine, water and raw ground beef.
Cook on medium heat until vegetables are tender and ground beef is cooked.
Then add cheese, 1 slice at a time, mixing well.
It's ready and it's good.
recipes.text: Phadiaho(Mexican Spaghetti). Fry noodles in olive oil, stirring constantly until golden brown. Add celery, onion, mushrooms, garlic, tomatoes, wine, water and raw ground beef. Cook on medium heat until vegetables are tender and ground beef is cooked. Then add cheese, 1 slice at a time, mixing well. It's ready and it's good.

recipes.title: Cold Broccoli Salad
directions: Mix together all of the ingredients.
Use tops only of the broccoli (raw) and thinly sliced red onion.
Wish-Bone dressing is the best.
recipes.text: Cold Broccoli Salad. Mix together all of the ingredients. Use tops only of the broccoli (raw) and thinly sliced red onion. Wish-Bone dressing is the best.

recipes.title: Baked Beans
directions: Grease casserole and pour in the pork and beans,
Dice onion and add to pork and beans.
Now add remaining ingredients and stir well.
Cut the bacon into 1 inch pieces and place on top of beans.
Bake for 30 minutes at 350 degrees.
recipes.text: Baked Beans. Grease casserole and pour in the pork and beans, Dice onion and add to pork and beans. Now add remaining ingredients and stir well. Cut the bacon into 1 inch pieces and place on top of beans. Bake for 30 minutes at 350 degrees.

recipes.title: Banana Pudding
directions: Combine 1/2 cup sugar, flour and salt in top of double boiler. Stir in 4 egg yolks and milk; blend well.
Cook, uncovered, over boiling water.
Stir constantly until thickened.
Reduce heat and cook, stirring occasionally, for 5 minutes.
Remove from heat; add vanilla.
Spread small amount on bottom of 1 1/2-quart casserole. Cover with Nilla wafers.
Top with layers of sliced bananas; pour 1/3 of custard over bananas.
Continue to layer wafers, bananas and custard to make 3 layers of each, ending with custard.
Beat egg whites until stiff, but not dry.
Gradually add remaining 1/4 cup sugar and beat until stiff peaks form.
Spoon on top of pudding, spreading to edges.
Bake at 425° for 5 minutes or until delicately brown.
Cool slightly or chill.
recipes.text: Banana Pudding. Combine 1/2 cup sugar, flour and salt in top of double boiler. Stir in 4 egg yolks and milk; blend well. Cook, uncovered, over boiling water. Stir constantly until thickened. Reduce heat and cook, stirring occasionally, for 5 minutes. Remove from heat; add vanilla. Spread small amount on bottom of 1 1/2-quart casserole. Cover with Nilla wafers. Top with layers of sliced bananas; pour 1/3 of custard over bananas. Continue to layer wafers, bananas and custard to make 3 layers of each, ending with custard. Beat egg whites until stiff, but not dry. Gradually add remaining 1/4 cup sugar and beat until stiff peaks form. Spoon on top of pudding, spreading to edges. Bake at 425° for 5 minutes or until delicately brown. Cool slightly or chill.

recipes.title: Cantaloupe Preserves
directions: Cut cantaloupe into 1/2 to 3/4-inch size pieces.
Mix with sugar and let set overnight or all day.
Add lemon juice and cook until clear and thick.
recipes.text: Cantaloupe Preserves. Cut cantaloupe into 1/2 to 3/4-inch size pieces. Mix with sugar and let set overnight or all day. Add lemon juice and cook until clear and thick.

recipes.title: Super Bean Dip
directions: Spread refried beans thin on a platter.
Mix sour cream, paprika, peppers and avocado.
Spread over refried beans; layer tomatoes, olives and cheese on top.
Serve with corn chips.
recipes.text: Super Bean Dip. Spread refried beans thin on a platter. Mix sour cream, paprika, peppers and avocado. Spread over refried beans; layer tomatoes, olives and cheese on top. Serve with corn chips.

recipes.title: Hash Brown Casserole
directions: Mix together and bake at 350° for 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Hash Brown Casserole. Mix together and bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Favorite Salad
directions: Drain tomatoes.
Save juice. Add water to make 2 cups.
Heat 1 cup to boiling. Stir in Jell-O. Add the other cup when cool. Mix tomatoes and cottage cheese. Add to gelatin mixture.
recipes.text: Favorite Salad. Drain tomatoes. Save juice. Add water to make 2 cups. Heat 1 cup to boiling. Stir in Jell-O. Add the other cup when cool. Mix tomatoes and cottage cheese. Add to gelatin mixture.

recipes.title: Broccoli And Rice Casserole
directions: Mix together all ingredients and bake 1 hour at 350°.
recipes.text: Broccoli And Rice Casserole. Mix together all ingredients and bake 1 hour at 350°.

recipes.title: Beer-Cheese Fondue
ingredients: few drops bottled hot pepper sauce
French bread, cut into bite-size pieces, each with 1 crust
directions: Have the cheeses at room temperature.
recipes.text: Beer-Cheese Fondue. Have the cheeses at room temperature.

recipes.title: Chicken Supreme
directions: Mix first 3 ingredients together.
In 9 x 13-inch baking pan, spread the jar of dried beef on bottom of pan.
Then put chicken breasts on top of dried beef.
Pour chicken soup mixture over and cover.
Bake at 350° for 2 hours.
Remove cover last 15 minutes to brown.
Prepare rice (Minute rice) and put on serving platter or put rice on each plate and put breast and mixture over it.
recipes.text: Chicken Supreme. Mix first 3 ingredients together. In 9 x 13-inch baking pan, spread the jar of dried beef on bottom of pan. Then put chicken breasts on top of dried beef. Pour chicken soup mixture over and cover. Bake at 350° for 2 hours. Remove cover last 15 minutes to brown. Prepare rice (Minute rice) and put on serving platter or put rice on each plate and put breast and mixture over it.

recipes.title: Vegetable Bar
ingredients: 1 1/2 pkg. Hidden Valley Ranch dressing mix
directions: Cover bottom of cookie sheet pan with rolls.
Bake 7 to 8 minutes, at temperature on carton; cool.
Mix the cream cheese, Miracle Whip and dressing; spread on rolls.
Sprinkle chopped vegetables on dressing.
Chill 1 to 2 hours.
Cut into small squares.
Serve cold.
recipes.text: Vegetable Bar. Cover bottom of cookie sheet pan with rolls. Bake 7 to 8 minutes, at temperature on carton; cool. Mix the cream cheese, Miracle Whip and dressing; spread on rolls. Sprinkle chopped vegetables on dressing. Chill 1 to 2 hours. Cut into small squares. Serve cold.

recipes.title: Flying Saucers
directions: Prepare Dream Whip with 1/2 cup milk and vanilla in a small bowl.
In another bowl, add rest of milk to pudding and mix.
Beat for 2 minutes and stir into Dream Whip mixture.
Spread filling on crackers and top with another cracker.
Press and smooth edges. Freeze about 3 hours.
recipes.text: Flying Saucers. Prepare Dream Whip with 1/2 cup milk and vanilla in a small bowl. In another bowl, add rest of milk to pudding and mix. Beat for 2 minutes and stir into Dream Whip mixture. Spread filling on crackers and top with another cracker. Press and smooth edges. Freeze about 3 hours.

recipes.title: Chiffon Cake
directions: Sift the first 4 ingredients together 3 times and set aside. Mix the next 4 ingredients and set aside.
Beat egg whites and cream of tartar.
Mix all ingredients together and bake 55 minutes in an angel food cake pan.
recipes.text: Chiffon Cake. Sift the first 4 ingredients together 3 times and set aside. Mix the next 4 ingredients and set aside. Beat egg whites and cream of tartar. Mix all ingredients together and bake 55 minutes in an angel food cake pan.

recipes.title: Chocolate Cake
ingredients: 2 tsp. coffee, mixed with 1 c. boiling water
directions: Mix together and beat like heck!
Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Chocolate Cake. Mix together and beat like heck! Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Potato Salad
directions: Mix well and refrigerate until serving.
recipes.text: Potato Salad. Mix well and refrigerate until serving.

recipes.title: A Nice Cup Of Tea
ingredients: A tea cozy for keeping teapot warm
Good quality tea leaves, e. g. Earl Grey
directions: Boil a kettle of water.
As soon as the water boils, pour sufficient water into teapot to allow you to swish it about to clean out any residue left after the previous brewing.
This also warms the teapot.
Throw away the water.
Place 1 1/2 - 2 teaspoons of tea leaves into the pot and immediately fill with boiled water. Stir with a teaspoon.
Replace lid of teapot and cover teapot with the cozy.
This will keep the tea hot for a very long time. If you use American tea, for some reason weaker than most English blends, you may need to use 3 - 4 teaspoons per pot.
recipes.text: A Nice Cup Of Tea. Boil a kettle of water. As soon as the water boils, pour sufficient water into teapot to allow you to swish it about to clean out any residue left after the previous brewing. This also warms the teapot. Throw away the water. Place 1 1/2 - 2 teaspoons of tea leaves into the pot and immediately fill with boiled water. Stir with a teaspoon. Replace lid of teapot and cover teapot with the cozy. This will keep the tea hot for a very long time. If you use American tea, for some reason weaker than most English blends, you may need to use 3 - 4 teaspoons per pot.

recipes.title: Hankie Pankies
directions: Brown hamburger.
Drain.
Mix all ingredients together (except bread) in pan, using low heat to melt cheese, stirring constantly. Spread on bread.
recipes.text: Hankie Pankies. Brown hamburger. Drain. Mix all ingredients together (except bread) in pan, using low heat to melt cheese, stirring constantly. Spread on bread.

recipes.title: Popcorn Crisp
ingredients: 1/2 c. glucose or 5/8 c. white syrup
directions: Pop popcorn and put in a large kettle in a moderate oven, 300°.
Bring to boil white sugar, brown sugar, glucose and water; wash sides down and add salt.
Cook to 300° and add butter.
When butter is well mixed in, take off the fire and add soda.
Mix with vanilla.
Stir in well.
Take the corn out of oven.
Set on warm part of stove.
Scrape all the syrup into the corn and mix the whole thing together.
Pour on a cold dry slab or wax paper. Spread out while hot.
This can be rolled into balls.
When cool, break into a size you wish.
A great caramel corn.
Store in airtight container to prevent corn from getting sticky.
recipes.text: Popcorn Crisp. Pop popcorn and put in a large kettle in a moderate oven, 300°. Bring to boil white sugar, brown sugar, glucose and water; wash sides down and add salt. Cook to 300° and add butter. When butter is well mixed in, take off the fire and add soda. Mix with vanilla. Stir in well. Take the corn out of oven. Set on warm part of stove. Scrape all the syrup into the corn and mix the whole thing together. Pour on a cold dry slab or wax paper. Spread out while hot. This can be rolled into balls. When cool, break into a size you wish. A great caramel corn. Store in airtight container to prevent corn from getting sticky.

recipes.title: Bean Casserole
ingredients: 1 can Ranch Style beans with juice
1 (6 or 8 oz.) pkg. corn muffin mix, add 2 Tbsp. sugar
directions: Brown ground beef, chopped onion and chopped green pepper together; drain off grease.
Mix with beans, tomato sauce, ketchup, steak sauce and Worcestershire sauce.
Put in a cake pan; sprinkle black pepper all over.
Prepare corn bread according to directions on the package; add sugar.
Pour batter evenly over meat mixture.
Bake at 400° for about 1/2 hour or until cornbread is browned.
recipes.text: Bean Casserole. Brown ground beef, chopped onion and chopped green pepper together; drain off grease. Mix with beans, tomato sauce, ketchup, steak sauce and Worcestershire sauce. Put in a cake pan; sprinkle black pepper all over. Prepare corn bread according to directions on the package; add sugar. Pour batter evenly over meat mixture. Bake at 400° for about 1/2 hour or until cornbread is browned.

recipes.title: Fruit Punch
directions: Dissolve jello and Kool-Aid in hot water.
Add a little water to sugar in a saucepan and dissolve thoroughly.
Mix all together and add pineapple juice in a gallon plastic jug and fill with water and freeze.
Thaw when ready to use and add ginger ale.
Makes 1 gallon.
recipes.text: Fruit Punch. Dissolve jello and Kool-Aid in hot water. Add a little water to sugar in a saucepan and dissolve thoroughly. Mix all together and add pineapple juice in a gallon plastic jug and fill with water and freeze. Thaw when ready to use and add ginger ale. Makes 1 gallon.

recipes.title: Potato Custard Pie
ingredients: juice and grated rind of 1/2 lemon
directions: Boil potato.
Mash.
Add butter, sugar and salt; stir to creamy consistency.
Cool.
Add beaten egg yolks, milk, lemon juice and rind.
Mix well together.
Fold in stiffly beaten egg whites.
Pour into pastry shell.
Bake at 400° for 25 minutes or until done.
recipes.text: Potato Custard Pie. Boil potato. Mash. Add butter, sugar and salt; stir to creamy consistency. Cool. Add beaten egg yolks, milk, lemon juice and rind. Mix well together. Fold in stiffly beaten egg whites. Pour into pastry shell. Bake at 400° for 25 minutes or until done.

recipes.title: Dilly Cheese Ring
ingredients: 2 cans Hungry Jack flaky biscuits (10 oz.)
directions: Cheddar cheese or Colby/Jack mixture can be substituted for Parmesan.
recipes.text: Dilly Cheese Ring. Cheddar cheese or Colby/Jack mixture can be substituted for Parmesan.

recipes.title: Chocolate Cake
directions: Combine all ingredients in large bowl and beat just until blended.
Pour into well greased and floured cake pan.
Bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes or until done.
Contains 86 calories per serving.
recipes.text: Chocolate Cake. Combine all ingredients in large bowl and beat just until blended. Pour into well greased and floured cake pan. Bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes or until done. Contains 86 calories per serving.

recipes.title: Orange Julius
directions: Combine all ingredients in blender.
Blend 30 seconds.
Makes 2 servings.
recipes.text: Orange Julius. Combine all ingredients in blender. Blend 30 seconds. Makes 2 servings.

recipes.title: German Potato Salad
directions: Place unpeeled potatoes in large pan containing enough boiling water to cover them completely. Boil over medium heat until potatoes can just be pierced through with sharp knife.
Do not overcook. Drain at once in colander. Cool, peel and slice potatoes 1/4-inch thick into large flat pan.
Set aside.
recipes.text: German Potato Salad. Place unpeeled potatoes in large pan containing enough boiling water to cover them completely. Boil over medium heat until potatoes can just be pierced through with sharp knife. Do not overcook. Drain at once in colander. Cool, peel and slice potatoes 1/4-inch thick into large flat pan. Set aside.

recipes.title: Jogging In A Jug
ingredients: 1 (12 oz.) can frozen grape juice, thawed
directions: Preheat oven to 375°.
Go answer the telephone.
Measure 2 cups of flour, 1 teaspoon of salt and 3 tablespoons baking powder. Answer the door bell.
Let Carson and Wayne in to fix the ceiling fan in the living room.
recipes.text: Jogging In A Jug. Preheat oven to 375°. Go answer the telephone. Measure 2 cups of flour, 1 teaspoon of salt and 3 tablespoons baking powder. Answer the door bell. Let Carson and Wayne in to fix the ceiling fan in the living room.

recipes.title: Easy Hamburger Stroganoff
ingredients: 1 (10 1/2 oz.) can cream of chicken soup
directions: Saute onion and garlic in butter over medium heat.
Add meat and brown.
Add flour, salt, pepper and mushrooms.
Cook 5 minutes.
Add soup and simmer uncovered 10 minutes.
Stir in sour cream.
Heat through.
Sprinkle with parsley.
Serve with noodles. Makes 4 to 6 servings.
recipes.text: Easy Hamburger Stroganoff. Saute onion and garlic in butter over medium heat. Add meat and brown. Add flour, salt, pepper and mushrooms. Cook 5 minutes. Add soup and simmer uncovered 10 minutes. Stir in sour cream. Heat through. Sprinkle with parsley. Serve with noodles. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

recipes.title: Beer Rolls
directions: Mix and pour into greased muffin tin.
Bake 400° for 12 to 15 minutes.
recipes.text: Beer Rolls. Mix and pour into greased muffin tin. Bake 400° for 12 to 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Country-Style Pudding
ingredients: 16 oz. can whole kernel corn, drained
directions: Preheat oven to 350°.
Use an ungreased 9 x 13-inch pan.
Mix together all ingredients except for the cheese.
Pour into pan. Bake for 15 miinutes.
Then sprinkle top with the cheese and bake 20 minutes longer.
recipes.text: Country-Style Pudding. Preheat oven to 350°. Use an ungreased 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix together all ingredients except for the cheese. Pour into pan. Bake for 15 miinutes. Then sprinkle top with the cheese and bake 20 minutes longer.

recipes.title: Easter Lilies
directions: Combine eggs, mayonnaise, onion, salt and pepper.
Add vinegar and mash to smooth paste.
Spread on bread.
Fasten two opposite corners of bread together with toothpicks forming lily shape. Decorate with carrot stick for center of lily and pickle slices for leaves.
Makes 4 servings.
recipes.text: Easter Lilies. Combine eggs, mayonnaise, onion, salt and pepper. Add vinegar and mash to smooth paste. Spread on bread. Fasten two opposite corners of bread together with toothpicks forming lily shape. Decorate with carrot stick for center of lily and pickle slices for leaves. Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: Lasagna Casserole
directions: Brown hamburger and onion. Set aside.

Bring to a boil the salt, pepper, sugar, garlic powder, tomato sauce, tomato paste and mushrooms. Simmer 15 minutes; set aside. Soften cream cheese and sour cream together. Set aside. Cook noodles. Put 1 cup of the tomato sauce mixture and 1 cup hamburger on the bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Add 1/2 cream cheese mixture, then 1/2 noodles on top of that and 1/2 of the cheese, then repeat the layers. Bake at 350° for 20 minutes or if baking cold, bake for 40 minutes.
recipes.text: Lasagna Casserole. Brown hamburger and onion. Set aside. Bring to a boil the salt, pepper, sugar, garlic powder, tomato sauce, tomato paste and mushrooms. Simmer 15 minutes; set aside. Soften cream cheese and sour cream together. Set aside. Cook noodles. Put 1 cup of the tomato sauce mixture and 1 cup hamburger on the bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan. Add 1/2 cream cheese mixture, then 1/2 noodles on top of that and 1/2 of the cheese, then repeat the layers. Bake at 350° for 20 minutes or if baking cold, bake for 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Drumstick Torte
directions: Oil and flour 9 X 12 inch pan; bake 1 hour at 350 degrees.
recipes.text: Drumstick Torte. Oil and flour 9 X 12 inch pan; bake 1 hour at 350 degrees.

recipes.title: Corned Beef Casserole(Makes 4 Servings)
ingredients: 1 can (12 oz.) corned beef, cut in 8 slices
1 can (8 oz.) sauerkraut, rinsed and drained
directions: Preheat oven to 350°. In a 2-quart round baking dish, layer corned beef, sauerkraut, dressing and cheese. Top with bread cubes.
Drizzle bread with butter.
Cover and bake 30 minutes. Uncover and bake 10 minutes longer.
recipes.text: Corned Beef Casserole(Makes 4 Servings). Preheat oven to 350°. In a 2-quart round baking dish, layer corned beef, sauerkraut, dressing and cheese. Top with bread cubes. Drizzle bread with butter. Cover and bake 30 minutes. Uncover and bake 10 minutes longer.

recipes.title: Tasty Turkey Breast
ingredients: frozen turkey breast, washed very well and defrosted overnight
directions: Fill breast cavity with celery or onions.
Place so that breast is covering the vegetables.
Spray with Baker's Joy.
Sprinkle heavily with paprika so that it is well covered.
Sprinkle with garlic salt.
Bake about 4 hours at 325°.
recipes.text: Tasty Turkey Breast. Fill breast cavity with celery or onions. Place so that breast is covering the vegetables. Spray with Baker's Joy. Sprinkle heavily with paprika so that it is well covered. Sprinkle with garlic salt. Bake about 4 hours at 325°.

recipes.title: Salmon Loaf
directions: Drain and flake salmon, reserving 2 tablespoons liquid. Combine all other ingredients.
Place in well-greased baking pan, or shape into loaf on greased baking pan.
Bake for 45 minutes at 350°.
recipes.text: Salmon Loaf. Drain and flake salmon, reserving 2 tablespoons liquid. Combine all other ingredients. Place in well-greased baking pan, or shape into loaf on greased baking pan. Bake for 45 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Pasta Primavera
ingredients: 1 pkg. Ranch dressing or 8 oz. bottled prepared dressing
directions: If you are using packaged dressing mix, prepare according to directions and refrigerate.
Mix together and set aside, shrimp, snowpeas, olives, pimentos, artichoke hearts, scallions and tomatoes.
Cook and drain pasta and toss with all ingredients.
Add dressing and garnish with parsley.
For variety, add seasonal vegetables.
recipes.text: Pasta Primavera. If you are using packaged dressing mix, prepare according to directions and refrigerate. Mix together and set aside, shrimp, snowpeas, olives, pimentos, artichoke hearts, scallions and tomatoes. Cook and drain pasta and toss with all ingredients. Add dressing and garnish with parsley. For variety, add seasonal vegetables.

recipes.title: Buttermilk Coconut Pie
directions: Melt margarine.
Add sugar, buttermilk, eggs, coconut, vanilla and a pinch of salt.
Mix together and pour into frozen pie crust. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until golden brown.
recipes.text: Buttermilk Coconut Pie. Melt margarine. Add sugar, buttermilk, eggs, coconut, vanilla and a pinch of salt. Mix together and pour into frozen pie crust. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until golden brown.

recipes.title: Jimmy Carter Pudding
ingredients: 1 (8 oz.) container frozen whipped topping, thawed
1 (5 oz.) pkg. instant vanilla pudding mix
directions: For first layer, mix 1 cup flour, stick of oleo, and 2/3 cup salted chopped peanuts. Press into 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake at 350° for 20 minutes. Cool. For second layer, mix 1/3 c. peanut butter, 8 oz. pkg. cream cheese, 1 c. powdered sugar, 1 c. whipped cream. Spread over first layer. For third layer, mix boxes of puddings with milk and spread over second layer. Finally spread whipped cream to cover top of pudding. Sprinkle with chopped peanuts.
recipes.text: Jimmy Carter Pudding. For first layer, mix 1 cup flour, stick of oleo, and 2/3 cup salted chopped peanuts. Press into 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake at 350° for 20 minutes. Cool. For second layer, mix 1/3 c. peanut butter, 8 oz. pkg. cream cheese, 1 c. powdered sugar, 1 c. whipped cream. Spread over first layer. For third layer, mix boxes of puddings with milk and spread over second layer. Finally spread whipped cream to cover top of pudding. Sprinkle with chopped peanuts.

recipes.title: Carrot Casserole
ingredients: 2 lb. carrots, sliced, cooked and drained
directions: Melt together the margarine and Velveeta cheese.
Pour over carrots in a 9 x 13-inch pan.
recipes.text: Carrot Casserole. Melt together the margarine and Velveeta cheese. Pour over carrots in a 9 x 13-inch pan.

recipes.title: Chocolate Chip Surprise
ingredients: 1 pkg. Pillsbury slice 'n bake chocolate chip cookies
directions: Grease a 9 x 9-inch square pan.
Slice and spread half chocolate chip dough in bottom of pan.
Mix cream cheese filling. Spread over dough.
Top with remaining cookie dough slices.
Bake at 350° for 30 to 45 minutes.
Cool and slice.
recipes.text: Chocolate Chip Surprise. Grease a 9 x 9-inch square pan. Slice and spread half chocolate chip dough in bottom of pan. Mix cream cheese filling. Spread over dough. Top with remaining cookie dough slices. Bake at 350° for 30 to 45 minutes. Cool and slice.

recipes.title: Coffee-Orange-Fudge Cake
ingredients: 1 (4 oz.) pkg. instant chocolate fudge pudding mix
directions: Combine all ingredients, except chocolate chips and confectioners sugar.
Beat at medium speed for 4 minutes.
Add chips and blend.
Pour into greased Bundt pan.
Bake at 350° for 50 to 60 minutes.
Cool 10 minutes.
Remove from pan.
Sprinkle with confectioners sugar.
Makes 12 to 16 servings.
recipes.text: Coffee-Orange-Fudge Cake. Combine all ingredients, except chocolate chips and confectioners sugar. Beat at medium speed for 4 minutes. Add chips and blend. Pour into greased Bundt pan. Bake at 350° for 50 to 60 minutes. Cool 10 minutes. Remove from pan. Sprinkle with confectioners sugar. Makes 12 to 16 servings.

recipes.title: Scalloped Potatoes
ingredients: 1 can Campbell's creamy chicken or mushroom soup
directions: Blend soup, milk and dash of pepper.
In buttered 1 1/2-quart casserole, arrange alternate layers of potatoes, onions, soup mixture and cheese.
Dot top with margarine and sprinkle with paprika.
Cover.
Bake at 375° for 1 hour; uncover and bake 15 minutes.
recipes.text: Scalloped Potatoes. Blend soup, milk and dash of pepper. In buttered 1 1/2-quart casserole, arrange alternate layers of potatoes, onions, soup mixture and cheese. Dot top with margarine and sprinkle with paprika. Cover. Bake at 375° for 1 hour; uncover and bake 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Broccoli Soup
directions: Chop and prepare broccoli; cook 8 to 10 minutes.
Melt butter in pan; add flour, chicken cubes and boiling water.
Stir; add broccoli, shredded cheese, half and half and salt and pepper to taste.
Add 1 cup rice or cooked potatoes (optional).
recipes.text: Broccoli Soup. Chop and prepare broccoli; cook 8 to 10 minutes. Melt butter in pan; add flour, chicken cubes and boiling water. Stir; add broccoli, shredded cheese, half and half and salt and pepper to taste. Add 1 cup rice or cooked potatoes (optional).

recipes.title: Reese'S Squares
directions: Mix together and then pat down in pan.
Melt chocolate chips and pour over peanut butter.
Cut into squares.
recipes.text: Reese'S Squares. Mix together and then pat down in pan. Melt chocolate chips and pour over peanut butter. Cut into squares.

recipes.title: Sweet*10 Cookies(For Diabetics)
directions: Blend all together.
Drop by teaspoonful on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 375° for 12 to 15 minutes.
recipes.text: Sweet*10 Cookies(For Diabetics). Blend all together. Drop by teaspoonful on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 375° for 12 to 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Microwave Peanut Brittle
directions: In 1 1/2-quart casserole dish, mix sugar, syrup and peanuts. Cook on full power 7 1/2 minutes.
Stir 1/2 way through.
Remove from oven; stir in vanilla and butter.
Cook another 2 minutes on full power.
Remove quickly; add soda.
Stir and pour into a warmed, buttered cookie sheet.
recipes.text: Microwave Peanut Brittle. In 1 1/2-quart casserole dish, mix sugar, syrup and peanuts. Cook on full power 7 1/2 minutes. Stir 1/2 way through. Remove from oven; stir in vanilla and butter. Cook another 2 minutes on full power. Remove quickly; add soda. Stir and pour into a warmed, buttered cookie sheet.

recipes.title: Citrus Mint Cooler
ingredients: 1/2 tsp. liquid or 1/4 tsp. paste food colors for each batch
directions: To Prepare Makeup:
In a small bowl, mix cornstarch and flour. Gradually stir in light corn syrup and water until smooth.
Pour about 1/4 cup into each of four bowls or paper cups.
Color three of the batches with desired liquid or paste food colors.
(Paste provides more intense color.) Leave one batch untinted.
For additional colors, prepare more makeup.
recipes.text: Citrus Mint Cooler. To Prepare Makeup: In a small bowl, mix cornstarch and flour. Gradually stir in light corn syrup and water until smooth. Pour about 1/4 cup into each of four bowls or paper cups. Color three of the batches with desired liquid or paste food colors. (Paste provides more intense color.) Leave one batch untinted. For additional colors, prepare more makeup.

recipes.title: Jello Whipped Pie
directions: Make jello; let thicken.
Add to thawed whipped topping.
Mix until well blended.
Put in pie crust.
Refrigerate overnight. Can substitute cherry jello.
Garnish with strawberries or cherries.
recipes.text: Jello Whipped Pie. Make jello; let thicken. Add to thawed whipped topping. Mix until well blended. Put in pie crust. Refrigerate overnight. Can substitute cherry jello. Garnish with strawberries or cherries.

recipes.title: Party Time Meat Loaf
directions: Mix well by kneading with hands.
Pat into 4 two-inch steamer pans.
Pour over tops of meat 2 (No. 10) cans Ragu sauce.
Seal edges with sauce.
Bake 2 to 2 1/2 hours at 350°.
Serves 100 to 125.
recipes.text: Party Time Meat Loaf. Mix well by kneading with hands. Pat into 4 two-inch steamer pans. Pour over tops of meat 2 (No. 10) cans Ragu sauce. Seal edges with sauce. Bake 2 to 2 1/2 hours at 350°. Serves 100 to 125.

recipes.title: Cheese Grits Casserole
directions: Prepare enough grits to serve 12.
Mix all ingredients in grits while hot.
Bake at 350°.
recipes.text: Cheese Grits Casserole. Prepare enough grits to serve 12. Mix all ingredients in grits while hot. Bake at 350°.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Squares
ingredients: 1 box Duncan Hines yellow cake mix
1 can Libby's pumpkin pie mix (3 c.)
directions: Note:
Hold out 1 cup cake mix for top of cake.
recipes.text: Pumpkin Squares. Note: Hold out 1 cup cake mix for top of cake.

recipes.title: Philadelphia Cream Cheese Pound Cake
ingredients: 3 c. Swans Down cake flour, sifted
1 Tbsp. vanilla or 2 tsp. vanilla and 1 tsp. almond
directions: Beat softened cream cheese with softened butter until smooth. Add sugar.
Cream the cream cheese, butter and sugar together. Add to mixture eggs alternately with flour, in which 1/2 teaspoon of salt has been sifted.
Add extract and mix all ingredients well.
recipes.text: Philadelphia Cream Cheese Pound Cake. Beat softened cream cheese with softened butter until smooth. Add sugar. Cream the cream cheese, butter and sugar together. Add to mixture eggs alternately with flour, in which 1/2 teaspoon of salt has been sifted. Add extract and mix all ingredients well.

recipes.title: Pigs In The Blanket
directions: Open dinner rolls and let set at room temperature until thawed.
Cut 5 wieners into 4 pieces each.
Ope each roll and place 1 piece of wiener in middle of roll.
Fold over and seal tight.
Place in greased 8 x 8-inch pan and bake for 20 to 25 minutes or until golden brown at 325° to 350°.
Makes 20 pigs in blanket.
recipes.text: Pigs In The Blanket. Open dinner rolls and let set at room temperature until thawed. Cut 5 wieners into 4 pieces each. Ope each roll and place 1 piece of wiener in middle of roll. Fold over and seal tight. Place in greased 8 x 8-inch pan and bake for 20 to 25 minutes or until golden brown at 325° to 350°. Makes 20 pigs in blanket.

recipes.title: Fast Tartar Sauce
directions: In a small bowl, combine all ingredients. Mix well. Serve or cover and chill until ready to use.
recipes.text: Fast Tartar Sauce. In a small bowl, combine all ingredients. Mix well. Serve or cover and chill until ready to use.

recipes.title: Tuna Cakes
ingredients: 3/4 c. bread crumbs or corn flake crumbs
directions: Combine all ingredients, except 3/4 crumbs.
Form 6 patties, coating with 3/4 crumbs.
Spray Pam on cookie sheet and place patties on sheet.
Bake at 350° for 1/2 hour, or heat 2 tablespoons oil and fry in pan.
Flip and add another 1 tablespoon oil.
recipes.text: Tuna Cakes. Combine all ingredients, except 3/4 crumbs. Form 6 patties, coating with 3/4 crumbs. Spray Pam on cookie sheet and place patties on sheet. Bake at 350° for 1/2 hour, or heat 2 tablespoons oil and fry in pan. Flip and add another 1 tablespoon oil.

recipes.title: Broccoli Puff
ingredients: 1 can undiluted cream of mushroom soup
directions: Cook broccoli slightly and place in a greased casserole dish. Mix the next 5 ingredients and spoon over broccoli.
Sprinkle bread crumbs and Parmesan cheese on top.
Bake at 350° for 40 minutes or until set.
recipes.text: Broccoli Puff. Cook broccoli slightly and place in a greased casserole dish. Mix the next 5 ingredients and spoon over broccoli. Sprinkle bread crumbs and Parmesan cheese on top. Bake at 350° for 40 minutes or until set.

recipes.title: Chicken Casserole
ingredients: 2 c. cooked chicken, boiled with salt and pepper to taste
directions: Mix all ingredients except grated cheese.
Put in large shallow casserole dish.
Top with grated cheese.
Bake 30 minutes at 350°.
recipes.text: Chicken Casserole. Mix all ingredients except grated cheese. Put in large shallow casserole dish. Top with grated cheese. Bake 30 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Never Fail Fluffy Biscuits
directions: Sift together into a bowl:
flour, baking powder, sugar, salt and cream of tartar.
Add shortening.
Cut in with pastry blender until the mixture looks like coarse cornmeal.
Add milk all at once.
Stir just enough to make a soft dough.
Turn out onto a lightly floured board.
Knead lightly for 30 seconds.
Roll out to a thickness of 1/2-inch.
Cut with a floured 2-inch round cutter. Place on an ungreased baking sheet.
Bake at 450° for 12 to 15 minutes.
Makes about 16 biscuits.
recipes.text: Never Fail Fluffy Biscuits. Sift together into a bowl: flour, baking powder, sugar, salt and cream of tartar. Add shortening. Cut in with pastry blender until the mixture looks like coarse cornmeal. Add milk all at once. Stir just enough to make a soft dough. Turn out onto a lightly floured board. Knead lightly for 30 seconds. Roll out to a thickness of 1/2-inch. Cut with a floured 2-inch round cutter. Place on an ungreased baking sheet. Bake at 450° for 12 to 15 minutes. Makes about 16 biscuits.

recipes.title: Broccoli And Rice Casserole
directions: Cook broccoli according to package directions; drain.
Add to rice.
Stir in cheese, soup and onions.
Pour into casserole dish. Cook approximately 30 minutes or until cheese appears to be thoroughly melted.
Do not overcook as casserole will be dry.
recipes.text: Broccoli And Rice Casserole. Cook broccoli according to package directions; drain. Add to rice. Stir in cheese, soup and onions. Pour into casserole dish. Cook approximately 30 minutes or until cheese appears to be thoroughly melted. Do not overcook as casserole will be dry.

recipes.title: Stone Cake
ingredients: 1 tsp. each flavoring: almond, lemon and vanilla
directions: Beat all together.
Bake in an ungreased angel food pan, until cracks appear on top.
Bake 1 hour in a preheated 350° oven.
recipes.text: Stone Cake. Beat all together. Bake in an ungreased angel food pan, until cracks appear on top. Bake 1 hour in a preheated 350° oven.

recipes.title: Whole Wheat Not So Sweet Dough
directions: In a mixing bowl, combine yeast, powdered milk, salt and cereal.
Add 2 cups warm water and stir until yeast and milk dissolve.
Add shortening, molasses, eggs, remaining 1 1/2 cups warm water and wheat flour.
Beat well.
Stir in 4 cups all-purpose flour.
Use remaining 1 1/2 cups flour to add dough while kneading until dough is smooth.
Shape dough into ball.
Cover with damp towel.
Allow to rest on lightly floured board for 15 minutes. Divide dough into equal 4 parts.
To bake just do what each recipe tells you to do.
recipes.text: Whole Wheat Not So Sweet Dough. In a mixing bowl, combine yeast, powdered milk, salt and cereal. Add 2 cups warm water and stir until yeast and milk dissolve. Add shortening, molasses, eggs, remaining 1 1/2 cups warm water and wheat flour. Beat well. Stir in 4 cups all-purpose flour. Use remaining 1 1/2 cups flour to add dough while kneading until dough is smooth. Shape dough into ball. Cover with damp towel. Allow to rest on lightly floured board for 15 minutes. Divide dough into equal 4 parts. To bake just do what each recipe tells you to do.

recipes.title: Monterey Chicken Casserole
ingredients: 4 c. cooked chicken breast cut into 1/2 to 1 inch pieces
1 16 oz. bottle Ortega thick and smooth taco sauce
2 4 oz. cans Ortega diced green chilies
1 2 1/4 oz. can sliced ripe olives drained
2 c. shredded monterey jack cheese or cheddar cheese
directions: Preheat oven to 375°.
In a large bowl, combine chicken cubes, taco sauce, onion, chilies, corn, rice water and olives.
Spoon into ungreased 9 x 13 inch baking dish.
In a medium bowl, combine taco shell pieces and cheese.
Sprinkle over chicken mixture.
Bake 40-45 minutes or until top is golden brown.
Garnish suggestions: sliced green onions and sour cream.
recipes.text: Monterey Chicken Casserole. Preheat oven to 375°. In a large bowl, combine chicken cubes, taco sauce, onion, chilies, corn, rice water and olives. Spoon into ungreased 9 x 13 inch baking dish. In a medium bowl, combine taco shell pieces and cheese. Sprinkle over chicken mixture. Bake 40-45 minutes or until top is golden brown. Garnish suggestions: sliced green onions and sour cream.

recipes.title: Deep Fried Dutch Apple Cake
directions: In a large skillet, heat oil or shortening to a depth of 1/2-inch.
Beat egg with 1/4-cup milk.
Use rotary beater or whisk. Do not overbeat.
Add flour alternately with the milk and mix thoroughly using a slotted spoon; ending with milk.
Stir in apples.
Pour into hot oil.
Fry on both sides until golden brown; sprinkle with cinnamon-sugar.
recipes.text: Deep Fried Dutch Apple Cake. In a large skillet, heat oil or shortening to a depth of 1/2-inch. Beat egg with 1/4-cup milk. Use rotary beater or whisk. Do not overbeat. Add flour alternately with the milk and mix thoroughly using a slotted spoon; ending with milk. Stir in apples. Pour into hot oil. Fry on both sides until golden brown; sprinkle with cinnamon-sugar.

recipes.title: Coconut Cake
directions: Bake cake according to directions in a 9 x 13-inch pan.
While warm, poke holes in cake with a straw.
Combine coconut milk and Eagle Brand milk; pour over cake.
When cool, frost cake with Cool Whip and shredded coconut.
recipes.text: Coconut Cake. Bake cake according to directions in a 9 x 13-inch pan. While warm, poke holes in cake with a straw. Combine coconut milk and Eagle Brand milk; pour over cake. When cool, frost cake with Cool Whip and shredded coconut.

recipes.title: Hunter'S Chicken
ingredients: 4 slices bacon, cut in 1 inch pieces
1 (16 oz.) can tomatoes, cut in bite size pieces
directions: In large skillet, saute bacon until crisp.
Remove bacon; drain fat.
Saute onions in oil until tender; remove.
In small skillet, brown chicken, adding more oil if necessary.
Drain excess fat.
Combine bacon, onions, tomatoes, 57 sauce and pepper; pour over chicken.
Cover; simmer 20 to 25 minutes or until chicken is tender, basting occasionally.
Remove chicken.
Skim excess fat from sauce.
If thicker sauce is desired, gradually stir in mixture of equal parts flour and water, simmer until thick.
Serve chicken and sauce with rice or noodles.
Makes 4 to 5 servings.
recipes.text: Hunter'S Chicken. In large skillet, saute bacon until crisp. Remove bacon; drain fat. Saute onions in oil until tender; remove. In small skillet, brown chicken, adding more oil if necessary. Drain excess fat. Combine bacon, onions, tomatoes, 57 sauce and pepper; pour over chicken. Cover; simmer 20 to 25 minutes or until chicken is tender, basting occasionally. Remove chicken. Skim excess fat from sauce. If thicker sauce is desired, gradually stir in mixture of equal parts flour and water, simmer until thick. Serve chicken and sauce with rice or noodles. Makes 4 to 5 servings.

recipes.title: Spiced Salad Dressing
directions: Combine
all ingredients and blend well.
Makes about 1 (16 ounce) bottle.
A delicious treat with any of your salads.
recipes.text: Spiced Salad Dressing. Combine all ingredients and blend well. Makes about 1 (16 ounce) bottle. A delicious treat with any of your salads.

recipes.title: Red Velvet Cake
directions: Grease and flour pans.
(Makes three (9-inch) layers.) Mix all ingredients together and bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Red Velvet Cake. Grease and flour pans. (Makes three (9-inch) layers.) Mix all ingredients together and bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: German Chocolate Pie
directions: Preheat oven to 400°.
Combine sugar, cornstarch, flour, cocoa and salt.
Add eggs, butter and milk, then coconut, nuts and vanilla.
Pour into pastry shell and bake for 35 to 40 minutes.
recipes.text: German Chocolate Pie. Preheat oven to 400°. Combine sugar, cornstarch, flour, cocoa and salt. Add eggs, butter and milk, then coconut, nuts and vanilla. Pour into pastry shell and bake for 35 to 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Baked Peaches And Cream
ingredients: 1 large can peaches, halves or sliced
directions: Drain peaches, reserving 1/2 cup syrup.
Arrange peaches, cut side up, in an 8-inch pan.
Pour reserved cup of syrup over all. Combine sugar, nuts and cinnamon and sprinkle over the top.
Dot with butter.
Bake at 375° for 15 minutes. Serve warm with small scoops of vanilla ice cream.
recipes.text: Baked Peaches And Cream. Drain peaches, reserving 1/2 cup syrup. Arrange peaches, cut side up, in an 8-inch pan. Pour reserved cup of syrup over all. Combine sugar, nuts and cinnamon and sprinkle over the top. Dot with butter. Bake at 375° for 15 minutes. Serve warm with small scoops of vanilla ice cream.

recipes.title: Best Ever Apple Crisp
directions: Mix sugar, cinnamon and salt.
Pour over apples and mix.
Add melted butter.
Mix thoroughly so all apples are coated.
Put in a 9-inch square pan.
recipes.text: Best Ever Apple Crisp. Mix sugar, cinnamon and salt. Pour over apples and mix. Add melted butter. Mix thoroughly so all apples are coated. Put in a 9-inch square pan.

recipes.title: Sausage Stuffed Mushrooms
directions: Rinse mushrooms, pat dry, remove stems.
Chop stems and saute with sausage, garlic and parsley until sausage is browned, stirring to crumble.
Drain off pan drippings.
Stir in cheese, mixing well. Spoon mixture into mushroom caps and place in a 9 X 13-inch baking dish.
Bake at 350 degrees for 20 minutes.
recipes.text: Sausage Stuffed Mushrooms. Rinse mushrooms, pat dry, remove stems. Chop stems and saute with sausage, garlic and parsley until sausage is browned, stirring to crumble. Drain off pan drippings. Stir in cheese, mixing well. Spoon mixture into mushroom caps and place in a 9 X 13-inch baking dish. Bake at 350 degrees for 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Spiced Tomato Aspic
directions: Pour 1 cup of tomato juice into medium saucepan; sprinkle with gelatin.
Heat slowly until gelatin dissolves.
Remove from heat; add seasonings and remaining tomato juice.
Pour into 6 individual salad molds or 1 large salad mold.
Chill until set.
Unmold on lettuce; garnish with parsley.
Can add chopped cucumber and onion (if desired) and omit onion powder.
recipes.text: Spiced Tomato Aspic. Pour 1 cup of tomato juice into medium saucepan; sprinkle with gelatin. Heat slowly until gelatin dissolves. Remove from heat; add seasonings and remaining tomato juice. Pour into 6 individual salad molds or 1 large salad mold. Chill until set. Unmold on lettuce; garnish with parsley. Can add chopped cucumber and onion (if desired) and omit onion powder.

recipes.title: Easy Meat Loaf
directions: Saute seasonings (bacon slices, onions, green pepper and celery).
Mix meat, tomato juice, milk, eggs, cracker crumbs, salt and black pepper.
Add browned seasonings to meat mixture and shape into a loaf.
Brush loaf with catsup and add 2 or 3 bay leaves on top.
Bake 1 hour at 350°.
Remove bay leaves before serving.
recipes.text: Easy Meat Loaf. Saute seasonings (bacon slices, onions, green pepper and celery). Mix meat, tomato juice, milk, eggs, cracker crumbs, salt and black pepper. Add browned seasonings to meat mixture and shape into a loaf. Brush loaf with catsup and add 2 or 3 bay leaves on top. Bake 1 hour at 350°. Remove bay leaves before serving.

recipes.title: Sauerkraut Salad
directions: Rinse kraut and drain.
Chop vegetables and mix with kraut. Mix vinegar, oil, water and sugar.
Pour over kraut and blend well.
Chill at least overnight.
Keeps well in refrigerator for several days.
recipes.text: Sauerkraut Salad. Rinse kraut and drain. Chop vegetables and mix with kraut. Mix vinegar, oil, water and sugar. Pour over kraut and blend well. Chill at least overnight. Keeps well in refrigerator for several days.

recipes.title: Banana Cake
directions: Cream
together
oleo
and sugar.
Add eggs, sour milk, flour, soda,
baking powder and mashed bananas.
Mix together well. Bake at 350° until done.
recipes.text: Banana Cake. Cream together oleo and sugar. Add eggs, sour milk, flour, soda, baking powder and mashed bananas. Mix together well. Bake at 350° until done.

recipes.title: Cream Cheese Cupcakes
directions: Put vanilla wafers in 36 to 40 paper liners. Mix cream cheese, sugar and vanilla. Spoon filling in paper lined muffin pans. Bake at 300° for 25 minutes.
recipes.text: Cream Cheese Cupcakes. Put vanilla wafers in 36 to 40 paper liners. Mix cream cheese, sugar and vanilla. Spoon filling in paper lined muffin pans. Bake at 300° for 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Firecracker Enchilada Casserole
ingredients: 1 can Ro-Tel tomatoes and green chilies
1 1/2 c. Monterey Jack cheese (may use Mozzarella instead)
1 to 2 cans cream of mushroom soup
directions: Cook together meat, chili powder, salt and onion.
Drain after browning, then cook 10 minutes.
Spoon into 12 x 9-inch baking dish.
Layer Ranch Style beans, then tortillas (small pieces), then Ro-Tel and then cheeses (shredded).
Spread soup over top of casserole; cover.
Bake at 250° to 300° until bubbly.
recipes.text: Firecracker Enchilada Casserole. Cook together meat, chili powder, salt and onion. Drain after browning, then cook 10 minutes. Spoon into 12 x 9-inch baking dish. Layer Ranch Style beans, then tortillas (small pieces), then Ro-Tel and then cheeses (shredded). Spread soup over top of casserole; cover. Bake at 250° to 300° until bubbly.

recipes.title: Cherry Salad
directions: Mix all ingredients together; refrigerate and serve.
recipes.text: Cherry Salad. Mix all ingredients together; refrigerate and serve.

recipes.title: Mock Cranberry Fruit Spritzer
ingredients: 4 oz. Ocean Spray cranapple cranberry apple drink
directions: In a large wine glass, pour cranberry apple drink and white grape juice over ice.
Add a splash of club soda.
Garnish with grapes or a lime slice.
Makes 1 serving.
recipes.text: Mock Cranberry Fruit Spritzer. In a large wine glass, pour cranberry apple drink and white grape juice over ice. Add a splash of club soda. Garnish with grapes or a lime slice. Makes 1 serving.

recipes.title: Asparagus Vinaigrette
ingredients: 2 lb. fattest, fresh spears you can find
directions: Make your dressing out of the last five ingredients.
An acceptable bottled substitute is any vinaigrette from the Paul Newman's Own or Ken's brands.
Using a vegetable peeler, peel the asparagus spears almost down to the tip.
Be careful to avoid breaking the spears as you work, which is much easier with really fat spears.
Cut off the woody ends, which is usually a couple of inches.
In a large flat skillet, bring about an inch of water to an almost-boil.
Lay spears in water and cook until they just begin to bend when you take them out - just a very few minutes. Carefully remove with tongs to a flat dish and top with the dressing while still hot.
Don't expect them to be swimming in it. Chill overnight and gently turn them over in the marinade a couple of times.
Serve chilled.
Makes 8 servings.
recipes.text: Asparagus Vinaigrette. Make your dressing out of the last five ingredients. An acceptable bottled substitute is any vinaigrette from the Paul Newman's Own or Ken's brands. Using a vegetable peeler, peel the asparagus spears almost down to the tip. Be careful to avoid breaking the spears as you work, which is much easier with really fat spears. Cut off the woody ends, which is usually a couple of inches. In a large flat skillet, bring about an inch of water to an almost-boil. Lay spears in water and cook until they just begin to bend when you take them out - just a very few minutes. Carefully remove with tongs to a flat dish and top with the dressing while still hot. Don't expect them to be swimming in it. Chill overnight and gently turn them over in the marinade a couple of times. Serve chilled. Makes 8 servings.

recipes.title: Honey Iced Chocolate(Punch)
directions: Combine honey, cocoa, salt and mix.
Add milk and crushed ice. Serve at once
recipes.text: Honey Iced Chocolate(Punch). Combine honey, cocoa, salt and mix. Add milk and crushed ice. Serve at once

recipes.title: Indian Fry Bread
directions: Mix together flour, baking powder and salt.
Add warm water. Knead until dough is soft and does not stick to bowl.
(If necessary, add more water.)
recipes.text: Indian Fry Bread. Mix together flour, baking powder and salt. Add warm water. Knead until dough is soft and does not stick to bowl. (If necessary, add more water.)

recipes.title: Chicken Supreme Casserole
ingredients: 1 (8 oz.) carton sour cream or 8 oz. milk
directions: Line bottom of baking dish with chipped beef.
Lay chicken on beef.
Mix cream or milk with soup and pour over chicken.
Cover with foil and bake at 325° for about 2 hours.
About 5 minutes before done, uncover and sprinkle with paprika.
Put back in oven for last 5 minutes.
Serve with rice.
recipes.text: Chicken Supreme Casserole. Line bottom of baking dish with chipped beef. Lay chicken on beef. Mix cream or milk with soup and pour over chicken. Cover with foil and bake at 325° for about 2 hours. About 5 minutes before done, uncover and sprinkle with paprika. Put back in oven for last 5 minutes. Serve with rice.

recipes.title: Orange Salad
directions: Mix cottage cheese and jello together, then add pineapple that has been drained. Fold in Cool Whip. Ready to be served.
recipes.text: Orange Salad. Mix cottage cheese and jello together, then add pineapple that has been drained. Fold in Cool Whip. Ready to be served.

recipes.title: Hawaiian Pie
directions: Cream oleo; add sugar, eggs and other ingredients.
Mix well and pour into large unbaked crust.	Bake 1 hour at 350°.
recipes.text: Hawaiian Pie. Cream oleo; add sugar, eggs and other ingredients. Mix well and pour into large unbaked crust.	Bake 1 hour at 350°.

recipes.title: Cinnamon Spice Cake
directions: Mix ingredients.
Pour 1/2 of the batter into a 9 x 13-inch pan.
recipes.text: Cinnamon Spice Cake. Mix ingredients. Pour 1/2 of the batter into a 9 x 13-inch pan.

recipes.title: Gingerbread
directions: Combine flour, baking powder, soda, salt, sugar and spices. Add shortening, water and molasses to dry ingredients. Beat for 2 minutes on medium speed. Add egg and beat 1 more minute. Bake in 9 x 9-inch pan at 350° for 25 or 30 minutes. Top with lemon sauce and serve.
recipes.text: Gingerbread. Combine flour, baking powder, soda, salt, sugar and spices. Add shortening, water and molasses to dry ingredients. Beat for 2 minutes on medium speed. Add egg and beat 1 more minute. Bake in 9 x 9-inch pan at 350° for 25 or 30 minutes. Top with lemon sauce and serve.

recipes.title: Old Fashion Candied Yams
directions: Peel and cut yams in quarters.
Sprinkle sugar, nutmeg and butter.
Cover and simmer over medium heat until liquid thickens. Top with marshmallows and allow to melt.
Serve hot.
recipes.text: Old Fashion Candied Yams. Peel and cut yams in quarters. Sprinkle sugar, nutmeg and butter. Cover and simmer over medium heat until liquid thickens. Top with marshmallows and allow to melt. Serve hot.

recipes.title: Congealed Fruit Salad
directions: Dissolve Jell-O in boiling water.
Add undrained strawberries, pineapple, and bananas.
Pour half mixture in mold and congeal thoroughly.
Spread sour cream over congealed mixture. Then add rest of mixture and let congeal.
recipes.text: Congealed Fruit Salad. Dissolve Jell-O in boiling water. Add undrained strawberries, pineapple, and bananas. Pour half mixture in mold and congeal thoroughly. Spread sour cream over congealed mixture. Then add rest of mixture and let congeal.

recipes.title: Basil Vegetables
ingredients: 1/4 c. snipped basil leaves or 1 Tbsp. dried
directions: Cook and stir onion and garlic in oil in 10-inch nonstick skillet over medium-high heat until onion is tender, about 2 minutes.
Stir in tomatoes, zucchini and basil.
Heat to boiling; reduce heat.
Simmer uncovered until zucchini is crisp and tender, about 3 minutes longer.
Stir in cheese.
recipes.text: Basil Vegetables. Cook and stir onion and garlic in oil in 10-inch nonstick skillet over medium-high heat until onion is tender, about 2 minutes. Stir in tomatoes, zucchini and basil. Heat to boiling; reduce heat. Simmer uncovered until zucchini is crisp and tender, about 3 minutes longer. Stir in cheese.

recipes.title: Scalloped Potatoes Supreme
directions: Cook and slice potatoes.
Saute mushrooms and onion in butter. Combine cottage cheese and sour cream.
In a 9 x 13-inch casserole dish, layer first potatoes with salt and pepper. Second, mushroom mixture.
Third, cottage cheese mixture, then Cheddar cheese on top.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes covered; uncovered, bake 15 minutes.
Add more cheese.
recipes.text: Scalloped Potatoes Supreme. Cook and slice potatoes. Saute mushrooms and onion in butter. Combine cottage cheese and sour cream. In a 9 x 13-inch casserole dish, layer first potatoes with salt and pepper. Second, mushroom mixture. Third, cottage cheese mixture, then Cheddar cheese on top. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes covered; uncovered, bake 15 minutes. Add more cheese.

recipes.title: Lima-Broccoli Bake
directions: Cook first 2 ingredients until almost done; drain.
Mix next 4 ingredients.
Add vegetables and stir well.
Pour into buttered casserole.
Brown 2 cups Rice Krispies in 1 stick oleo.
Put over top.
Loosely cover with foil.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes. Serves 8.
recipes.text: Lima-Broccoli Bake. Cook first 2 ingredients until almost done; drain. Mix next 4 ingredients. Add vegetables and stir well. Pour into buttered casserole. Brown 2 cups Rice Krispies in 1 stick oleo. Put over top. Loosely cover with foil. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes. Serves 8.

recipes.title: Dried Beef Hot Dip
directions: Mix ingredients together, spreading in 9-inch pie plate.
Bake at 350° for 15 minutes.
recipes.text: Dried Beef Hot Dip. Mix ingredients together, spreading in 9-inch pie plate. Bake at 350° for 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Norma'S Easy One Dish Meal
ingredients: 1 small onion or 2 Tbsp. dried onions
directions: In a heavy skillet, brown meat.
Pour off fat.
Push meat to sides and saute the onion.
Add catsup, spices and water.
Simmer 30 minutes. While meat is still cooking, cook the macaroni and drain. Add macaroni and beans to meat. Correct seasonings and simmer 10 minutes.
recipes.text: Norma'S Easy One Dish Meal. In a heavy skillet, brown meat. Pour off fat. Push meat to sides and saute the onion. Add catsup, spices and water. Simmer 30 minutes. While meat is still cooking, cook the macaroni and drain. Add macaroni and beans to meat. Correct seasonings and simmer 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Apple Cuts
directions: Mix like pie crust. Divide into 2 crusts and roll on cookie sheet.
recipes.text: Apple Cuts. Mix like pie crust. Divide into 2 crusts and roll on cookie sheet.

recipes.title: Baked Chicken And Cheese Enchiladas
ingredients: 3 c. (12 oz.) shredded Monterey Jack cheese, divided
1 (14.5 oz.) can Hunt's petite diced tomatoes with mild green chiles
directions: Stir together first 6 ingredients and 1 cup cheese in a large bowl until well blended. Wrap tortillas in heavy-duty plastic wrap; heat in microwave according to package directions. Spoon about 1/3 cup chicken mixture down center of each warm tortilla; roll up. Place in a lightly greased 13 x 9-inch baking dish. Cook diced tomatoes, tomato sauce and cream in a 2-quart saucepan over medium-high heat, stirring often, 10 minutes or until thoroughly heated. Pour tomato mixture evenly over tortillas, spreading to ends of tortillas; sprinkle with remaining 2 cups cheese. Bake at 350° for 20 minutes or until cheese melts and tomato mixture is bubbly. Serve with desired topping of sour cream and shredded lettuce.
recipes.text: Baked Chicken And Cheese Enchiladas. Stir together first 6 ingredients and 1 cup cheese in a large bowl until well blended. Wrap tortillas in heavy-duty plastic wrap; heat in microwave according to package directions. Spoon about 1/3 cup chicken mixture down center of each warm tortilla; roll up. Place in a lightly greased 13 x 9-inch baking dish. Cook diced tomatoes, tomato sauce and cream in a 2-quart saucepan over medium-high heat, stirring often, 10 minutes or until thoroughly heated. Pour tomato mixture evenly over tortillas, spreading to ends of tortillas; sprinkle with remaining 2 cups cheese. Bake at 350° for 20 minutes or until cheese melts and tomato mixture is bubbly. Serve with desired topping of sour cream and shredded lettuce.

recipes.title: Golden Rice Bake
directions: Saute onion in water.
Mix all ingredients together and pour into buttered casserole.
If desired, layer with Cheddar cheese. Cover and bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Golden Rice Bake. Saute onion in water. Mix all ingredients together and pour into buttered casserole. If desired, layer with Cheddar cheese. Cover and bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Mixed Vegetable Dish
directions: Combine ingredients and put into 2-quart casserole dish.
Top with croutons and sprinkle with butter.
Bake at 325° to 350° for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Mixed Vegetable Dish. Combine ingredients and put into 2-quart casserole dish. Top with croutons and sprinkle with butter. Bake at 325° to 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Hot Chicken Salad
ingredients: 5 c. Cubed Cooked Chicken Breasts, Drained
directions: Combine ingredients except cheese and potato chips.
Pile lightly in a baking dish.
Sprinkle with grated cheese and chips. Bake at 350° for 20-30 minutes in a glass baking dish.
recipes.text: Hot Chicken Salad. Combine ingredients except cheese and potato chips. Pile lightly in a baking dish. Sprinkle with grated cheese and chips. Bake at 350° for 20-30 minutes in a glass baking dish.

recipes.title: Quick Broccoli Cheese Soup
ingredients: small bunch fresh broccoli, chopped fine
directions: Saute margarine in pan, then add the shredded carrot, onion and fresh broccoli; set aside.
recipes.text: Quick Broccoli Cheese Soup. Saute margarine in pan, then add the shredded carrot, onion and fresh broccoli; set aside.

recipes.title: Green Tomato Pie
ingredients: 5 to 6 green tomatoes, washed, pared and sliced thin
raw pie dough (1 for bottom and 1 for top)
directions: Line a large pie pan with dough.
Mix flour and 1/4 cup sugar together; spread over pie dough.
Add sliced tomatoes.
Sprinkle with vinegar or lemon juice.
Sprinkle with 3/4 cup sugar and allspice.
Dot with butter.
Cover with top crust and bake at 375° to 400° for about 40 to 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Green Tomato Pie. Line a large pie pan with dough. Mix flour and 1/4 cup sugar together; spread over pie dough. Add sliced tomatoes. Sprinkle with vinegar or lemon juice. Sprinkle with 3/4 cup sugar and allspice. Dot with butter. Cover with top crust and bake at 375° to 400° for about 40 to 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Grandma'S Currant Pound Cake
directions: Rinse currants in hot water; drain and dry on a towel.
Cream butter until fluffy; add sugar and spice and cream thoroughly. Beat egg yolks until thick and creamy; add to butter mixture and blend well.
Add 1/2 of the flour and mix until smooth; add remainder of flour and mix until smooth again.
Mix in stiffly beaten egg whites.
Pour into 2 paper lined 9 x 4 x 2 1/2-inch loaf pans and bake at 350° for 1 hour and 25 minutes.
Test for doneness by inserting a toothpick in center.
Yield:
12 servings.
recipes.text: Grandma'S Currant Pound Cake. Rinse currants in hot water; drain and dry on a towel. Cream butter until fluffy; add sugar and spice and cream thoroughly. Beat egg yolks until thick and creamy; add to butter mixture and blend well. Add 1/2 of the flour and mix until smooth; add remainder of flour and mix until smooth again. Mix in stiffly beaten egg whites. Pour into 2 paper lined 9 x 4 x 2 1/2-inch loaf pans and bake at 350° for 1 hour and 25 minutes. Test for doneness by inserting a toothpick in center. Yield: 12 servings.

recipes.title: Caramel Popcorn
directions: Pop the popcorn; salt to taste.
Place in roasting pan in 200° oven to keep warm.
Mix remaining ingredients, excluding vanilla. Cook over medium heat to "hard crack" on a candy thermometer.
Add vanilla.
Pour over warm popcorn and stir to coat.
Spread out on a buttered counter to cool.
After cooled, break up and store in Ziploc bags.
recipes.text: Caramel Popcorn. Pop the popcorn; salt to taste. Place in roasting pan in 200° oven to keep warm. Mix remaining ingredients, excluding vanilla. Cook over medium heat to "hard crack" on a candy thermometer. Add vanilla. Pour over warm popcorn and stir to coat. Spread out on a buttered counter to cool. After cooled, break up and store in Ziploc bags.

recipes.title: Shoo-Fly Pie
ingredients: 1/4 c. warm water, mixed with 1 tsp. baking soda
directions: Mix until crumbly the flour, brown sugar, butter and oil. Reserve 1/2 cup.
Add syrup, egg, warm water and water mixed with baking soda.
Beat mixture until smooth.
Pour into pie shell. Sprinkle reserved crumbs on top.
Bake 10 minutes at 400° and then 30 minutes at 350°.
recipes.text: Shoo-Fly Pie. Mix until crumbly the flour, brown sugar, butter and oil. Reserve 1/2 cup. Add syrup, egg, warm water and water mixed with baking soda. Beat mixture until smooth. Pour into pie shell. Sprinkle reserved crumbs on top. Bake 10 minutes at 400° and then 30 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Carrot Souffle
directions: Blend carrots until smooth.
Add remaining ingredients.
Bake in a greased casserole 45 minutes at 350°.
To test, insert knife (like pumpkin pie).
recipes.text: Carrot Souffle. Blend carrots until smooth. Add remaining ingredients. Bake in a greased casserole 45 minutes at 350°. To test, insert knife (like pumpkin pie).

recipes.title: Pickled Shrimp
ingredients: 2 lb. raw peeled shrimp (41 to 50 count or larger)
2 medium white or purple onions, sliced into rings
directions: Place shrimp in boiling salted water.
Reduce heat and simmer for 3 to 5 minutes.
Shrimp are done when they are pink and tender. Drain and rinse with cold water, then chill.
Make alternate layers of shrimp and onion rings in a sealable container.
Mix remaining ingredients and pour over shrimp and onions.
Seal and place in refrigerator for 6 hours or more, shaking or inverting occasionally.
Drain and serve.
Makes 6 servings.
recipes.text: Pickled Shrimp. Place shrimp in boiling salted water. Reduce heat and simmer for 3 to 5 minutes. Shrimp are done when they are pink and tender. Drain and rinse with cold water, then chill. Make alternate layers of shrimp and onion rings in a sealable container. Mix remaining ingredients and pour over shrimp and onions. Seal and place in refrigerator for 6 hours or more, shaking or inverting occasionally. Drain and serve. Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Ruth'S Western Barbecued Beans
ingredients: 2 (1 lb. size) cans pork and beans
directions: Combine ground beef, salt, pepper and garlic.
Saute in cooking oil in large skillet over medium heat until lightly browned.
Add onion and brown a few minutes longer until onion is golden.
Remove from heat and add remaining ingredients.
Pour into bean pot or 9-inch square baking dish.
If desired, garnish top with onion rings and drizzle with a little catsup.
Bake in a slow 325° oven for 40 to 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Ruth'S Western Barbecued Beans. Combine ground beef, salt, pepper and garlic. Saute in cooking oil in large skillet over medium heat until lightly browned. Add onion and brown a few minutes longer until onion is golden. Remove from heat and add remaining ingredients. Pour into bean pot or 9-inch square baking dish. If desired, garnish top with onion rings and drizzle with a little catsup. Bake in a slow 325° oven for 40 to 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Microwave Chili
ingredients: 2 (8 oz.) cans tomato sauce or 1 (8 oz.) can tomato sauce and 1 c. beef broth or consomme
directions: Combine meat, onion and garlic in a large casserole.
Cover and cook at High setting for 10 minutes or until meat loses its reddish color, stirring once or twice.
Add remaining ingredients, mixing thoroughly.
Cover casserole and heat until mixture comes to a boil.
Reduce microwave temperature to Slow or Defrost and cook for about 1 hour, stirring a few times.
After cooking, allow chili to stand for a few minutes before serving.
recipes.text: Microwave Chili. Combine meat, onion and garlic in a large casserole. Cover and cook at High setting for 10 minutes or until meat loses its reddish color, stirring once or twice. Add remaining ingredients, mixing thoroughly. Cover casserole and heat until mixture comes to a boil. Reduce microwave temperature to Slow or Defrost and cook for about 1 hour, stirring a few times. After cooking, allow chili to stand for a few minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Squash Dressing
directions: Saute onion and oleo.
Mix well.
Put in dish and bake 30 minutes uncovered at 350° to 375°.
recipes.text: Squash Dressing. Saute onion and oleo. Mix well. Put in dish and bake 30 minutes uncovered at 350° to 375°.

recipes.title: We Made Ice Cream Today(Easy)
directions: Fill the large bag half full of ice.
Add the salt.
Seal the bag.
Put milk, vanilla and sugar into the small bag.
Seal it. Place the small bag inside the large one and seal again carefully. Shake until mixture is ice cream, about 5 minutes.
Wipe off top of small bag.
Then open carefully and enjoy!
recipes.text: We Made Ice Cream Today(Easy). Fill the large bag half full of ice. Add the salt. Seal the bag. Put milk, vanilla and sugar into the small bag. Seal it. Place the small bag inside the large one and seal again carefully. Shake until mixture is ice cream, about 5 minutes. Wipe off top of small bag. Then open carefully and enjoy!

recipes.title: Country Pork 'N Sauerkraut
directions: In a Dutch oven, cook ribs and onion in oil until ribs are browned and onion is tender.
Remove from heat.
Combine remaining ingredients and pour over ribs.
Cover and bake at 350° for 1 1/2 to 2 hours or until ribs are tender.
Yields 4 servings.
recipes.text: Country Pork 'N Sauerkraut. In a Dutch oven, cook ribs and onion in oil until ribs are browned and onion is tender. Remove from heat. Combine remaining ingredients and pour over ribs. Cover and bake at 350° for 1 1/2 to 2 hours or until ribs are tender. Yields 4 servings.

recipes.title: Moms Apple Pie
directions: Peel and core apples slices and cook in 1 cup water till tender.
Drain off juice and add 1 cup sugar, 1/4 cup cornstarch. Cook till thick and clear add back to apples, 1/2 tsp cinnamon, 1/4 tsp nutmeg.
Put in crust sprinkle with coconut and butter.
Bake at 400° till crusts are browned.
recipes.text: Moms Apple Pie. Peel and core apples slices and cook in 1 cup water till tender. Drain off juice and add 1 cup sugar, 1/4 cup cornstarch. Cook till thick and clear add back to apples, 1/2 tsp cinnamon, 1/4 tsp nutmeg. Put in crust sprinkle with coconut and butter. Bake at 400° till crusts are browned.

recipes.title: Easy Fruit Salad
ingredients: 1 (3 oz.) pkg. vanilla or French vanilla pudding (not instant)
1 (15 oz.) can peaches or fruit cocktail
directions: Take juice from all three cans of fruit and add enough water to make 1 1/2 cups.
Cook juice with pudding.
Cool completely, then add drained fruit and refrigerate.
recipes.text: Easy Fruit Salad. Take juice from all three cans of fruit and add enough water to make 1 1/2 cups. Cook juice with pudding. Cool completely, then add drained fruit and refrigerate.

recipes.title: Low-Fat Waldorf Salad
ingredients: 1 (6 oz.) container Yoplait low-fat yogurt (spiced apple or peach flavored; regular or light)
directions: Toss ingredients and serve.
recipes.text: Low-Fat Waldorf Salad. Toss ingredients and serve.

recipes.title: Lasagne
ingredients: 1 box lasagne noodles (10 oz. or larger)
directions: Brown meat slowly; spoon off excess fat.
Simmer ground beef, sausage, onion, tomatoes, garlic salt, basil leaves, salt and tomato paste for 30 minutes, stirring occasionally.
recipes.text: Lasagne. Brown meat slowly; spoon off excess fat. Simmer ground beef, sausage, onion, tomatoes, garlic salt, basil leaves, salt and tomato paste for 30 minutes, stirring occasionally.

recipes.title: Cabbage Casserole
directions: Cook cabbage until tender; drain.
Pour into casserole dish. Cover with cheese sauce.
Sprinkle dry dressing mix on top.
Bake in a 325° oven until bubbly.
recipes.text: Cabbage Casserole. Cook cabbage until tender; drain. Pour into casserole dish. Cover with cheese sauce. Sprinkle dry dressing mix on top. Bake in a 325° oven until bubbly.

recipes.title: Kentucky Bourbon Balls
ingredients: 1/2 c. bourbon (I use Canadian Club whiskey)
sweetened cocoa or melted chocolate (for dipping)
directions: In the mixing bowl of an electric mixer, beat the butter to soften, then gradually and thoroughly beat in the sugar and salt. Very slowly, so the mixture doesn't curdle, beat in the bourbon in a steady stream. Beat in the minced pecans and mix well. Cover and refrigerate 1 to 2 hours until firm.
recipes.text: Kentucky Bourbon Balls. In the mixing bowl of an electric mixer, beat the butter to soften, then gradually and thoroughly beat in the sugar and salt. Very slowly, so the mixture doesn't curdle, beat in the bourbon in a steady stream. Beat in the minced pecans and mix well. Cover and refrigerate 1 to 2 hours until firm.

recipes.title: Strawberry Pie
ingredients: 1 jar strawberry glaze or gel (can but at grocery store)
directions: Pour pecan chips into pie crust and cook according to directions on package.
Cream Cool Whip and cream cheese together. Add powdered sugar and mix well.
Pour into cooled pie crust. Wash and slice strawberries.
recipes.text: Strawberry Pie. Pour pecan chips into pie crust and cook according to directions on package. Cream Cool Whip and cream cheese together. Add powdered sugar and mix well. Pour into cooled pie crust. Wash and slice strawberries.

recipes.title: Cinnamon Bread
directions: *To
test,
put pinch of sugar on top.	Wait 5 minutes. Should be foam on top, if good.
recipes.text: Cinnamon Bread. *To test, put pinch of sugar on top.	Wait 5 minutes. Should be foam on top, if good.

recipes.title: Peanut Blossom Cookies
directions: Combine all ingredients (except Kisses) in large mixer bowl; blend well at low speed.
Shape into balls, using a rounded teaspoonful for each.
Roll balls in additional granulated sugar. Place on ungreased cookie sheets.
Bake at 375° for 10 to 12 minutes.
Remove from oven.
Top each cookie immediately with a candy Kiss, pressing down firmly so cookie cracks around the edge.
recipes.text: Peanut Blossom Cookies. Combine all ingredients (except Kisses) in large mixer bowl; blend well at low speed. Shape into balls, using a rounded teaspoonful for each. Roll balls in additional granulated sugar. Place on ungreased cookie sheets. Bake at 375° for 10 to 12 minutes. Remove from oven. Top each cookie immediately with a candy Kiss, pressing down firmly so cookie cracks around the edge.

recipes.title: Easy Cheese Ring
ingredients: dash of black pepper and cayenne pepper
directions: Mix all ingredients together, except preserves.
Spray a ring mold with Pam spray.
Place mix in mold and refrigerate until firm.
Turn out when ready to serve.
Fill center with strawberry preserves.
Serve with an assortment of crackers.
recipes.text: Easy Cheese Ring. Mix all ingredients together, except preserves. Spray a ring mold with Pam spray. Place mix in mold and refrigerate until firm. Turn out when ready to serve. Fill center with strawberry preserves. Serve with an assortment of crackers.

recipes.title: Rice Casserole
ingredients: 2 1/4 c. bouillon or 2 1/4 c. water with 3 chicken bouillon cubes
1 tsp. each minced onion, celery and green pepper
1 (4 oz.) can green Ortega chili peppers
directions: Cook rice in bouillon with onion, celery and green pepper added.
Seed, wash and cut up chili peppers.
In buttered casserole, put a layer of rice, 1/3 of the sour cream, 1/3 of the chilies and 1/2 of the Jack cheese.
Repeat layers.
Bake at 350° for 20 to 30 minutes.
The last 5 minutes, cover with Cheddar cheese.
recipes.text: Rice Casserole. Cook rice in bouillon with onion, celery and green pepper added. Seed, wash and cut up chili peppers. In buttered casserole, put a layer of rice, 1/3 of the sour cream, 1/3 of the chilies and 1/2 of the Jack cheese. Repeat layers. Bake at 350° for 20 to 30 minutes. The last 5 minutes, cover with Cheddar cheese.

recipes.title: Fruit Cocktail Cake
directions: Combine all ingredients.
Pour into an 8 x 8-inch greased pan. Sprinkle with 1/2 cup brown sugar and 1/2 cup chopped nuts.
Bake 30 to 35 minutes at 350°.
Serve warm or cold with whipped cream or ice cream.
recipes.text: Fruit Cocktail Cake. Combine all ingredients. Pour into an 8 x 8-inch greased pan. Sprinkle with 1/2 cup brown sugar and 1/2 cup chopped nuts. Bake 30 to 35 minutes at 350°. Serve warm or cold with whipped cream or ice cream.

recipes.title: Chicken Ball
directions: Mix all ingredients well.
Shape into ball.
Roll in grated pecans (1/2 cup).
Freezes well.
Serve with crackers.
recipes.text: Chicken Ball. Mix all ingredients well. Shape into ball. Roll in grated pecans (1/2 cup). Freezes well. Serve with crackers.

recipes.title: Curried Meatballs
directions: Mix beef, curry
powder, stuffing mix, salt and pepper. Shape into teaspoon size	balls
and saute in butter over high heat for 5 minutes or until brown.
Yields 32 balls.
recipes.text: Curried Meatballs. Mix beef, curry powder, stuffing mix, salt and pepper. Shape into teaspoon size	balls and saute in butter over high heat for 5 minutes or until brown. Yields 32 balls.

recipes.title: Spinach Squares
directions: Melt butter in a 9 x 13-inch pan.
In a large bowl, beat eggs well.
Add flour, milk and baking powder.
Mix well.
Add cheese, cooked spinach (well drained) and onion.
Spoon into baking dish. Level off.
Top with bread crumbs.
Bake 35 minutes at 350°.
Let cool 45 minutes.
Serves 6.
recipes.text: Spinach Squares. Melt butter in a 9 x 13-inch pan. In a large bowl, beat eggs well. Add flour, milk and baking powder. Mix well. Add cheese, cooked spinach (well drained) and onion. Spoon into baking dish. Level off. Top with bread crumbs. Bake 35 minutes at 350°. Let cool 45 minutes. Serves 6.

recipes.title: French Fried Liver
directions: Cut liver in strips in the shape of French fries.
Mix cornmeal, cracker crumbs, salt and pepper together.
Place in a plastic bag.
Add liver and shake to coat liver evenly.
Fry in deep fat.
Drain on paper towels.
Try it, you'll like it!
recipes.text: French Fried Liver. Cut liver in strips in the shape of French fries. Mix cornmeal, cracker crumbs, salt and pepper together. Place in a plastic bag. Add liver and shake to coat liver evenly. Fry in deep fat. Drain on paper towels. Try it, you'll like it!

recipes.title: Chicken With Capers
directions: In a large skillet combine all ingredients.
Cover and bring to a boil.
Let simmer for 20 minutes.
Serve over steamed rice.
recipes.text: Chicken With Capers. In a large skillet combine all ingredients. Cover and bring to a boil. Let simmer for 20 minutes. Serve over steamed rice.

recipes.title: Cheese Squares
directions: Cream together butter and
brown
sugar.
Add
flour and nuts, mix with hands to make
crumb
mixture.
Reserve
one cup for topping.
Press remainder into bottom of 8-inch square pan. Bake at 350° for 12 to
minutes
until
light brown.
Cool. Blend together granulated sugar
and cream cheese until smooth. Add milk.
Add
egg, lemon
juice
and
vanilla.
Beat
well. Spread over baked crust.
Sprinkle with reserved crumb mixture. Cut into squares after baking for
25 minutes at 350°.
Freezes well.
recipes.text: Cheese Squares. Cream together butter and brown sugar. Add flour and nuts, mix with hands to make crumb mixture. Reserve one cup for topping. Press remainder into bottom of 8-inch square pan. Bake at 350° for 12 to 15 minutes until light brown. Cool. Blend together granulated sugar and cream cheese until smooth. Add milk. Add egg, lemon juice and vanilla. Beat well. Spread over baked crust. Sprinkle with reserved crumb mixture. Cut into squares after baking for 25 minutes at 350°. Freezes well.

recipes.title: Spanish Rice
directions: Saute butter, onions, celery and garlic.
Cook rice according to directions.
Add Rotel, cream of mushroom soup, Cheese Whiz, jalapenos and green pepper.
Add salt to taste.
Bake at 350 degrees for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Spanish Rice. Saute butter, onions, celery and garlic. Cook rice according to directions. Add Rotel, cream of mushroom soup, Cheese Whiz, jalapenos and green pepper. Add salt to taste. Bake at 350 degrees for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Snicker Pie
directions: Take frozen Snickers and put in blender.
Chop 3 minutes on high.
In bowl, pour Cool Whip; add Snickers.
Stir and blend. Pour into graham crust.
Chill for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Snicker Pie. Take frozen Snickers and put in blender. Chop 3 minutes on high. In bowl, pour Cool Whip; add Snickers. Stir and blend. Pour into graham crust. Chill for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Favorite Oven-Fried Chicken
directions: Combine pancake mix, salt, paprika, onion salt, garlic powder and pepper in shallow bowl. Beat milk and eggs in small bowl. Rinse chicken and pat dry. Dip in milk mixture; coat with pancake mixture. Place, skin side down, on rack in shallow baking pan. Brush with melted butter. Turn; brush with butter. Bake at 375° for 1 hour or until chicken is cooked through.
recipes.text: Favorite Oven-Fried Chicken. Combine pancake mix, salt, paprika, onion salt, garlic powder and pepper in shallow bowl. Beat milk and eggs in small bowl. Rinse chicken and pat dry. Dip in milk mixture; coat with pancake mixture. Place, skin side down, on rack in shallow baking pan. Brush with melted butter. Turn; brush with butter. Bake at 375° for 1 hour or until chicken is cooked through.

recipes.title: Banana Bread
directions: Mix butter, sugar, eggs and bananas together and beat 2 minutes.
Then add rest of ingredients.
Mix
all together and beat 2 or 3 minutes longer.
Bake in loaf pan
at
for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Banana Bread. Mix butter, sugar, eggs and bananas together and beat 2 minutes. Then add rest of ingredients. Mix all together and beat 2 or 3 minutes longer. Bake in loaf pan at 350° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Apricot Fluff Salad
ingredients: 1 (4 oz.) can frozen orange juice concentrate
2 (11 oz.) cans apricots, drained and chopped
directions: Dissolve Jell-O in hot water.
Add pineapple and orange juice concentrate.
Stir well and chill until partially set.
Fold in apricots.
Pour into 9 x 13-inch pan.
Beat pudding mix and milk. Fold in whipped cream.
Spread on firm Jell-O.
Chill and serve.
recipes.text: Apricot Fluff Salad. Dissolve Jell-O in hot water. Add pineapple and orange juice concentrate. Stir well and chill until partially set. Fold in apricots. Pour into 9 x 13-inch pan. Beat pudding mix and milk. Fold in whipped cream. Spread on firm Jell-O. Chill and serve.

recipes.title: Cranberry-Cherry Pie
ingredients: 1 (21 oz.) can prepared cherry pie filling
directions: Combine all ingredients, except milk.
Let stand 15 minutes.
recipes.text: Cranberry-Cherry Pie. Combine all ingredients, except milk. Let stand 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Nut Bread
directions: Cream together brown sugar and shortening until light and fluffy.
Add eggs, one at a time, mixing well.
Stir in pumpkin and milk.
