Mix thoroughly flour, baking powder, salt, ginger, soda and cloves.
Stir in pumpkin mixture.
Beat for 1 minute with electric mixer.
Add nuts.
Turn into greased 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan.
Bake at 350° for 55 to 60 minutes.
Remove from pan.
Cool. Wrap and store overnight.
recipes.text: Pumpkin Nut Bread. Cream together brown sugar and shortening until light and fluffy. Add eggs, one at a time, mixing well. Stir in pumpkin and milk. Mix thoroughly flour, baking powder, salt, ginger, soda and cloves. Stir in pumpkin mixture. Beat for 1 minute with electric mixer. Add nuts. Turn into greased 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan. Bake at 350° for 55 to 60 minutes. Remove from pan. Cool. Wrap and store overnight.

recipes.title: Barbecue Sauce
directions: Saute the oil and onion 10 minutes. Add the rest of the ingredients. Bring to a boil and simmer for 20 minutes.
recipes.text: Barbecue Sauce. Saute the oil and onion 10 minutes. Add the rest of the ingredients. Bring to a boil and simmer for 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Pineapple Stuffing
ingredients: 1 (1 lb. 4 oz.) can crushed pineapple, drained
directions: Cream together butter and sugar. Beat in eggs, one at a time. Stir in pineapple.
Fold in bread cubes. Turn into 1 1/2-quart casserole. Bake, uncovered, 1 hour or until brown on top at 350°.
recipes.text: Pineapple Stuffing. Cream together butter and sugar. Beat in eggs, one at a time. Stir in pineapple. Fold in bread cubes. Turn into 1 1/2-quart casserole. Bake, uncovered, 1 hour or until brown on top at 350°.

recipes.title: White Cream Sauce For Scallops And Shrimp
directions: Melt butter; stir in flour over low heat.
Gradually add milk and water.
Heat slowly until it boils and thickens.
Stir in cheese and basil.
Add pepper to taste.
Serve over linguini with fresh scallops and shrimp.
recipes.text: White Cream Sauce For Scallops And Shrimp. Melt butter; stir in flour over low heat. Gradually add milk and water. Heat slowly until it boils and thickens. Stir in cheese and basil. Add pepper to taste. Serve over linguini with fresh scallops and shrimp.

recipes.title: Fried Chicken
directions: Mix flour, salt and pepper together in pan.
Dip chicken pieces in milk, then roll in
flour.
Heat oil in large skillet to cover chicken halfway.
When
oil
is
hot,
add chicken and cook until done. Drain on paper towel.
recipes.text: Fried Chicken. Mix flour, salt and pepper together in pan. Dip chicken pieces in milk, then roll in flour. Heat oil in large skillet to cover chicken halfway. When oil is hot, add chicken and cook until done. Drain on paper towel.

recipes.title: Beans And Polish Sausage
directions: Slice Polish sausage 1-inch thick.
Put all ingredients in crock-pot or oven (375°) for 2 hours.
recipes.text: Beans And Polish Sausage. Slice Polish sausage 1-inch thick. Put all ingredients in crock-pot or oven (375°) for 2 hours.

recipes.title: Honey Cake
directions: Preheat oven to 325°.
Grease and flour a 9 x 13-inch cake pan.
In a large mixing bowl, beat eggs and honey together.
Add sugar and mix again.
Mix coffee with baking powder and add margarine to the egg mixture.
Add baking soda, flour and cinnamon and beat together well.
Pour into greased cake pan.
Bake for 55 minutes to 1 hour.
recipes.text: Honey Cake. Preheat oven to 325°. Grease and flour a 9 x 13-inch cake pan. In a large mixing bowl, beat eggs and honey together. Add sugar and mix again. Mix coffee with baking powder and add margarine to the egg mixture. Add baking soda, flour and cinnamon and beat together well. Pour into greased cake pan. Bake for 55 minutes to 1 hour.

recipes.title: 12-Day Pickles
directions: Days 1 - 7:
Slice 2 gallons cucumbers.
Soak in 1 gallon cold water and 1 pint salt for 7 days.
recipes.text: 12-Day Pickles. Days 1 - 7: Slice 2 gallons cucumbers. Soak in 1 gallon cold water and 1 pint salt for 7 days.

recipes.title: Homemade Noodles
directions: Put eggs in a bowl.
Beat with a fork.
Add a little salt and flour (continue adding flour until you can handle easily).
Then roll out.
Add flour, roll out and turn over until dough is real thin.
Let dry for 30 minutes to one hour.
Roll up dough and cut into small noodles.
recipes.text: Homemade Noodles. Put eggs in a bowl. Beat with a fork. Add a little salt and flour (continue adding flour until you can handle easily). Then roll out. Add flour, roll out and turn over until dough is real thin. Let dry for 30 minutes to one hour. Roll up dough and cut into small noodles.

recipes.title: Blueberry Muffins
directions: Heat oven to 375°.
Line 12 muffin cups with baking cups, or grease bottoms of pan.
Beat egg slightly in medium bowl. Stir in remaining ingredients except blueberries just until moistened. Fold in blueberries.
Divide batter evenly among cups.
Bake 15 to 18 minutes until golden brown.
recipes.text: Blueberry Muffins. Heat oven to 375°. Line 12 muffin cups with baking cups, or grease bottoms of pan. Beat egg slightly in medium bowl. Stir in remaining ingredients except blueberries just until moistened. Fold in blueberries. Divide batter evenly among cups. Bake 15 to 18 minutes until golden brown.

recipes.title: Carrot Salad
directions: Mix together carrots, coconut and raisins.
Combine remaining ingredients and stir.
Makes 6 servings.
recipes.text: Carrot Salad. Mix together carrots, coconut and raisins. Combine remaining ingredients and stir. Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Spicy Pumpkin Pie
directions: Combine pumpkin, eggs, milk, sweetener, cinnamon, salt and nutmeg in saucepan.
Mix well.
Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until mixture comes to a boil.
Remove from heat. Stir in gelatin softened in 1/4 cup cold water.
Let cool.
Chill until partially set and pour in pie shell.
Serve with whipped topping, if desired.
(One vegetable, 1/2 milk and 1/2 fat for diabetics.)
recipes.text: Spicy Pumpkin Pie. Combine pumpkin, eggs, milk, sweetener, cinnamon, salt and nutmeg in saucepan. Mix well. Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until mixture comes to a boil. Remove from heat. Stir in gelatin softened in 1/4 cup cold water. Let cool. Chill until partially set and pour in pie shell. Serve with whipped topping, if desired. (One vegetable, 1/2 milk and 1/2 fat for diabetics.)

recipes.title: Hot Chicken Salad Casserole
directions: Combine all ingredients (except cheese).
Mix well.
Put in lightly greased 3-quart baking dish.
Sprinkle grated cheese on top.
Bake 20 minutes at 350°.
Remove from oven.
Cover top with chips or corn chips (crushed up).
Put back into oven and bake another 10 minutes.
recipes.text: Hot Chicken Salad Casserole. Combine all ingredients (except cheese). Mix well. Put in lightly greased 3-quart baking dish. Sprinkle grated cheese on top. Bake 20 minutes at 350°. Remove from oven. Cover top with chips or corn chips (crushed up). Put back into oven and bake another 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Pineapple Tart
ingredients: 1 box Duncan Hines butter cake mix
directions: Mix cake mix according to directions.
Bake in 2 layers.
Cool baked layers and split into four thin layers.
Mix sugar and cornstarch in a 4-cup Pyrex measuring cup.
Add can of crushed pineapple.
Cook on High in microwave until thick and clear.
Add lemon juice and oleo.
Spread pineapple between the thin layers.
recipes.text: Pineapple Tart. Mix cake mix according to directions. Bake in 2 layers. Cool baked layers and split into four thin layers. Mix sugar and cornstarch in a 4-cup Pyrex measuring cup. Add can of crushed pineapple. Cook on High in microwave until thick and clear. Add lemon juice and oleo. Spread pineapple between the thin layers.

recipes.title: Cheese Delights
directions: Mix well and make into a roll.
Place in fridge until firm and easier to handle.
Slice into thin biscuits.
Bake at 350° on greased pan 10 minutes.
recipes.text: Cheese Delights. Mix well and make into a roll. Place in fridge until firm and easier to handle. Slice into thin biscuits. Bake at 350° on greased pan 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Cauliflower Puff
ingredients: 1/2 tsp. salt and pepper to taste
directions: Cook cauliflower according to package directions until tender; drain.
Blend until smooth the cauliflower, egg yolks, milk, salt and pepper.
In a medium bowl, beat egg whites until stiff; fold in the cauliflower mixture, scallions and Cheddar cheese.
Spread over bottom of a 9-inch pie plate which has been buttered. Drizzle with melted butter and sprinkle with cheese.
Bake at 375° until golden brown and set, about 20 minutes.
Cut into wedges and remove with a wide spatula.
Serves 6 to 8.
recipes.text: Cauliflower Puff. Cook cauliflower according to package directions until tender; drain. Blend until smooth the cauliflower, egg yolks, milk, salt and pepper. In a medium bowl, beat egg whites until stiff; fold in the cauliflower mixture, scallions and Cheddar cheese. Spread over bottom of a 9-inch pie plate which has been buttered. Drizzle with melted butter and sprinkle with cheese. Bake at 375° until golden brown and set, about 20 minutes. Cut into wedges and remove with a wide spatula. Serves 6 to 8.

recipes.title: Chocolate Applesauce Cake
directions: Sift dry ingredients and add shortening and eggs.
Beat well. Add applesauce and 1/2 cup pecans and beat slightly.
Put in greased 9 x 13-inch pan.
Sprinkle over cake dough in the pan the 2 tablespoons of sugar, 1/2 cup pecans and 1 cup chocolate chips. Bake in preheated 350° oven for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Chocolate Applesauce Cake. Sift dry ingredients and add shortening and eggs. Beat well. Add applesauce and 1/2 cup pecans and beat slightly. Put in greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Sprinkle over cake dough in the pan the 2 tablespoons of sugar, 1/2 cup pecans and 1 cup chocolate chips. Bake in preheated 350° oven for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Aunt Debbie'S Cracker Barrel Pie
directions: Beat egg whites until stiff.
Add sugar, baking powder and vanilla; mix thoroughly.
Fold crackers and pecans into egg whites.
Bake in greased pie plate for 30 minutes at 350°.
Chill. Garnish with Cool Whip and pecans.
recipes.text: Aunt Debbie'S Cracker Barrel Pie. Beat egg whites until stiff. Add sugar, baking powder and vanilla; mix thoroughly. Fold crackers and pecans into egg whites. Bake in greased pie plate for 30 minutes at 350°. Chill. Garnish with Cool Whip and pecans.

recipes.title: Baby Wipes
ingredients: 1 roll Bounty paper towels, cut in half
directions: Mix first 3 ingredients together.
Pour over each section of paper towel.
Squeeze out excess liquid; put in airtight container.
If wipes dry out, repeat first 3 ingredients.
recipes.text: Baby Wipes. Mix first 3 ingredients together. Pour over each section of paper towel. Squeeze out excess liquid; put in airtight container. If wipes dry out, repeat first 3 ingredients.

recipes.title: Crunchie Cookies
ingredients: 4 oz. Bisquick or all purpose flour
directions: Cream fats and sugar together; add the other wet ingredients and mix with the other dry ingredients (quite a stiff mix).
Roll into small balls and space them out on a greased baking tray. Bake for 15 to 20 minutes at 350° or on gas mark 4.
recipes.text: Crunchie Cookies. Cream fats and sugar together; add the other wet ingredients and mix with the other dry ingredients (quite a stiff mix). Roll into small balls and space them out on a greased baking tray. Bake for 15 to 20 minutes at 350° or on gas mark 4.

recipes.title: Cheese Cake
ingredients: Graham Cracker crust to fit 6 x 9 inch pan
directions: In large mixer bowl, cream cream cheese, sugar, eggs and vanilla; beat until creamy.
Pour into crust and bake at 375° for 20-30 minutes; cool completely.
Mix sour cream, sugar and vanilla together; pour over cooled cake.
Bake at 375° for 10 minutes.
recipes.text: Cheese Cake. In large mixer bowl, cream cream cheese, sugar, eggs and vanilla; beat until creamy. Pour into crust and bake at 375° for 20-30 minutes; cool completely. Mix sour cream, sugar and vanilla together; pour over cooled cake. Bake at 375° for 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Oven Beef Stew
directions: Put stew beef in 9 x 13-inch cake pan.
Spread onion soup mix over top; spread mushroom soup over and then pour cooking sherry over.
Do not stir.
Cover with aluminum foil.
Bake at 325° for 3 hours.
Serve over rice.
recipes.text: Oven Beef Stew. Put stew beef in 9 x 13-inch cake pan. Spread onion soup mix over top; spread mushroom soup over and then pour cooking sherry over. Do not stir. Cover with aluminum foil. Bake at 325° for 3 hours. Serve over rice.

recipes.title: Tomato Soup Cake
directions: Preheat oven to 350°.
Grease and flour 2 round layer pans (8 or 9-inch oblong or 13 x 9 x 2-inch).
Measure dry ingredients in a large bowl.
Add soup and shortening; beat at low speed for 2 minutes, scraping sides and bottom of bowl frequently.
Add eggs and water and beat for 2 minutes.
recipes.text: Tomato Soup Cake. Preheat oven to 350°. Grease and flour 2 round layer pans (8 or 9-inch oblong or 13 x 9 x 2-inch). Measure dry ingredients in a large bowl. Add soup and shortening; beat at low speed for 2 minutes, scraping sides and bottom of bowl frequently. Add eggs and water and beat for 2 minutes.

recipes.title: Chocolate Coffee Cake
directions: Sift flour, sugar and cocoa together, then add soda, powder and salt.
Stir in eggs, oil, water, coffee and vanilla.
Stir well with large spoon until all is mixed well.
recipes.text: Chocolate Coffee Cake. Sift flour, sugar and cocoa together, then add soda, powder and salt. Stir in eggs, oil, water, coffee and vanilla. Stir well with large spoon until all is mixed well.

recipes.title: Strawberry-Banana Delight
ingredients: 1 small can crushed or tidbit pineapple
directions: Mix up jello and water.
Add other ingredients.
When jelled, frost with sour cream.
recipes.text: Strawberry-Banana Delight. Mix up jello and water. Add other ingredients. When jelled, frost with sour cream.

recipes.title: Surprise Pasta
directions: Put acini de pepe, salt and oil in boiling water.
Cook until tender, about 10 to 12 minutes.
Rinse and drain pasta.
Cool to room temperature.
Add pineapple, sugar, marshmallows and cherries to the pasta.
Sprinkle pudding mix over this and mix lightly. Add coconut, pecans and Cool Whip; fold in lightly.
Refrigerate several hours before serving.
recipes.text: Surprise Pasta. Put acini de pepe, salt and oil in boiling water. Cook until tender, about 10 to 12 minutes. Rinse and drain pasta. Cool to room temperature. Add pineapple, sugar, marshmallows and cherries to the pasta. Sprinkle pudding mix over this and mix lightly. Add coconut, pecans and Cool Whip; fold in lightly. Refrigerate several hours before serving.

recipes.title: Turkey Loaf
directions: Simmer chicken bouillon in boiling water for 5 minutes.
Add seasoning package in Stove Top stuffing. Gently beat egg and add to meat in large bowl. Add stuffing and bouillon mixture.
Mix well and form into loaf.
Bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours.
recipes.text: Turkey Loaf. Simmer chicken bouillon in boiling water for 5 minutes. Add seasoning package in Stove Top stuffing. Gently beat egg and add to meat in large bowl. Add stuffing and bouillon mixture. Mix well and form into loaf. Bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours.

recipes.title: Vegetable Pizza
directions: Crust:
Flatten 1 can crescent rolls on baking sheet; bake until done.
recipes.text: Vegetable Pizza. Crust: Flatten 1 can crescent rolls on baking sheet; bake until done.

recipes.title: Italian Vegetable Soup
directions: Brown beef in a large heavy kettle; drain fat.
Add all the ingredients except cabbage, green beans and macaroni.
Bring to boil.
Lower heat; cover and simmer 20 minutes.
Add cabbage, green beans and macaroni.
Bring to boil and simmer until vegetables are tender.
If you prefer thinner soup, add additional water or broth.
Yield:
12 servings.
Diabetic exchange:
one serving equals 1 protein, 1 bread, 152 calories, 776 mg. sodium and 4 grams fat.
recipes.text: Italian Vegetable Soup. Brown beef in a large heavy kettle; drain fat. Add all the ingredients except cabbage, green beans and macaroni. Bring to boil. Lower heat; cover and simmer 20 minutes. Add cabbage, green beans and macaroni. Bring to boil and simmer until vegetables are tender. If you prefer thinner soup, add additional water or broth. Yield: 12 servings. Diabetic exchange: one serving equals 1 protein, 1 bread, 152 calories, 776 mg. sodium and 4 grams fat.

recipes.title: Sweet Potato Pie
directions: Mix all ingredients in mixing bowl.
Place in a pie plate. There is no crust.
Bake at 450° for 10 minutes.
Turn down to 350° and bake until done.
recipes.text: Sweet Potato Pie. Mix all ingredients in mixing bowl. Place in a pie plate. There is no crust. Bake at 450° for 10 minutes. Turn down to 350° and bake until done.

recipes.title: Chicken Chili
ingredients: 1 (15 oz.) can red kidney beans, drained
2 tsp. chili powder or to taste
directions: Wash chicken and pat dry. Remove visible fat. Cut chicken in 1/2-inch pieces. In large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat, cook chicken in hot oil until meat is lightly browned. Add onion, celery and garlic; cook over medium heat until vegetables are tender. Add tomatoes, stirring to break up. Add all remaining ingredients. Cover and allow to simmer for 10 minutes. Remove cover and simmer 15 minutes or until part of the liquid evaporates and chili thickens. Makes 6 servings.
recipes.text: Chicken Chili. Wash chicken and pat dry. Remove visible fat. Cut chicken in 1/2-inch pieces. In large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat, cook chicken in hot oil until meat is lightly browned. Add onion, celery and garlic; cook over medium heat until vegetables are tender. Add tomatoes, stirring to break up. Add all remaining ingredients. Cover and allow to simmer for 10 minutes. Remove cover and simmer 15 minutes or until part of the liquid evaporates and chili thickens. Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Chicken Paprika
directions: Saute chopped onion in oil; lift brown onion out of pan.
Roll cut up chicken in flour, salt, pepper and paprika; brown well in the oil.
Put fried onion back in pan.
Add 1 1/2 cups water. Cover; let simmer until tender, about 45 minutes.
Add cooked noodles with a dash of paprika 5 minutes before serving (optional).
Add 1/2 pint sour cream 10 minutes before serving.
recipes.text: Chicken Paprika. Saute chopped onion in oil; lift brown onion out of pan. Roll cut up chicken in flour, salt, pepper and paprika; brown well in the oil. Put fried onion back in pan. Add 1 1/2 cups water. Cover; let simmer until tender, about 45 minutes. Add cooked noodles with a dash of paprika 5 minutes before serving (optional). Add 1/2 pint sour cream 10 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Sweet And Sour Carrots
directions: In large saucepan, combine all ingredients, except for the carrots.
Cook over medium heat, stirring often.
When the onion is translucent, the sauce is done.
Add the carrots and the dish is ready to serve.
recipes.text: Sweet And Sour Carrots. In large saucepan, combine all ingredients, except for the carrots. Cook over medium heat, stirring often. When the onion is translucent, the sauce is done. Add the carrots and the dish is ready to serve.

recipes.title: Stuffed Sparerib
directions: Sprinkle ribs with pepper.
Place stuffing into rib.
Roll rib and tie with string.
Spread butter over rib; sprinkle with paprika.
Wrap in foil and put in baking pan.
Bake at 400° to 425° until done.
Open foil to brown.
recipes.text: Stuffed Sparerib. Sprinkle ribs with pepper. Place stuffing into rib. Roll rib and tie with string. Spread butter over rib; sprinkle with paprika. Wrap in foil and put in baking pan. Bake at 400° to 425° until done. Open foil to brown.

recipes.title: Brownies
ingredients: 1/4 c. cocoa or carob baking powder
directions: Melt margarine in long cake pan.
Stir sugar, cocoa, eggs, flour and vanilla.
Then add melted margarine and stir well.
Pour into pan and bake at 375° for 35 minutes.
recipes.text: Brownies. Melt margarine in long cake pan. Stir sugar, cocoa, eggs, flour and vanilla. Then add melted margarine and stir well. Pour into pan and bake at 375° for 35 minutes.

recipes.title: Bread Pudding
directions: Heat oven to 350°.
Butter 1 loaf bread, cut into fourths. Layer pan and sprinkle with sugar and cinnamon.
Do another layer the same.
Beat eggs; add milk.
Add sugar, vanilla and salt.
Mix well.
Pour over bread.
Set pan in another pan with water to bake. Bake for 45 minutes to 1 hour.
recipes.text: Bread Pudding. Heat oven to 350°. Butter 1 loaf bread, cut into fourths. Layer pan and sprinkle with sugar and cinnamon. Do another layer the same. Beat eggs; add milk. Add sugar, vanilla and salt. Mix well. Pour over bread. Set pan in another pan with water to bake. Bake for 45 minutes to 1 hour.

recipes.title: Lory'S Cheesecake
ingredients: 3 to 4 Tbsp. flour (if batter is too thin)
directions: All ingredients should be at room temperature.
recipes.text: Lory'S Cheesecake. All ingredients should be at room temperature.

recipes.title: Chicken And Wild Rice Casserole
ingredients: 1 (6 1/2 oz.) pkg. long grain wild rice
1 (10 3/4 oz.) can cream of celery soup
2 (16 oz.) cans French-style green beans, drained
1 (8 oz.) can water chestnuts, sliced, drained
directions: Boil chicken in seasoned water.
Debone and chop.
Cook rice in chicken broth with slightly less liquid than called for in package directions.
Mix chicken and cooked rice with remaining ingredients.
Place in large casserole.
Sprinkle with paprika and chopped parsley.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
Serves 12 to 16.
recipes.text: Chicken And Wild Rice Casserole. Boil chicken in seasoned water. Debone and chop. Cook rice in chicken broth with slightly less liquid than called for in package directions. Mix chicken and cooked rice with remaining ingredients. Place in large casserole. Sprinkle with paprika and chopped parsley. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes. Serves 12 to 16.

recipes.title: Mike'S Potato Soup
directions: Cook bacon in a soup pan.
When crisp, remove bacon.
Drain and set aside.
recipes.text: Mike'S Potato Soup. Cook bacon in a soup pan. When crisp, remove bacon. Drain and set aside.

recipes.title: Hot Fudge Sauce
directions: Combine cocoa, sugar, flour and boiling water.
Cook until thick, approximately 5 minutes.
Remove from heat.
Add a pinch of salt, butter and vanilla.
recipes.text: Hot Fudge Sauce. Combine cocoa, sugar, flour and boiling water. Cook until thick, approximately 5 minutes. Remove from heat. Add a pinch of salt, butter and vanilla.

recipes.title: Candied Nuts(Club Member: Jason Baldwin)
directions: Mix sugar, cream, water and vanilla. Cook to soft ball stage. Add nuts and stir until nuts are coated. Pour onto wax paper. Separate with 2 forks.
recipes.text: Candied Nuts(Club Member: Jason Baldwin). Mix sugar, cream, water and vanilla. Cook to soft ball stage. Add nuts and stir until nuts are coated. Pour onto wax paper. Separate with 2 forks.

recipes.title: Long Island Ice Teas(Alcohlic Beverages)
directions: For one drink, combine all preceding ingredients and shake.
recipes.text: Long Island Ice Teas(Alcohlic Beverages). For one drink, combine all preceding ingredients and shake.

recipes.title: Chicken Spaghetti
directions: Boil chicken until tender with bay leaves and small onion and salt.
Cool and cut in pieces.
Simmer in fat of hen for one hour the large onion, bell pepper, celery and tomatoes.
Add ripe olives, mushrooms and pimento.
Cook 9 ounces spaghetti in salted chicken broth.
Drain.
Mix together chicken, sauce and spaghetti. Put on serving dish, topping with grated cheese.
recipes.text: Chicken Spaghetti. Boil chicken until tender with bay leaves and small onion and salt. Cool and cut in pieces. Simmer in fat of hen for one hour the large onion, bell pepper, celery and tomatoes. Add ripe olives, mushrooms and pimento. Cook 9 ounces spaghetti in salted chicken broth. Drain. Mix together chicken, sauce and spaghetti. Put on serving dish, topping with grated cheese.

recipes.title: Sweet And Sour Beef Stew
ingredients: 1 1/2 lb. beef stew meat, cut into 1-inch cubes
directions: In a 3-quart saucepan, brown the meat, half at a time, in hot oil.

In the same saucepan, combine the meat, carrot, onion, tomato sauce, 1/2 cup water, brown sugar, vinegar, Worcestershire sauce and salt. Cover and cook over low heat until the meat is tender (about 1 1/2 hours).
Blend 1 tablespoon cold water with the cornstarch. Add to the stew.
Cook and stir until thickened and bubbly. Serve the stew over the noodles, sprinkled with poppy seed.
Makes 4 to 6 servings.
recipes.text: Sweet And Sour Beef Stew. In a 3-quart saucepan, brown the meat, half at a time, in hot oil. In the same saucepan, combine the meat, carrot, onion, tomato sauce, 1/2 cup water, brown sugar, vinegar, Worcestershire sauce and salt. Cover and cook over low heat until the meat is tender (about 1 1/2 hours). Blend 1 tablespoon cold water with the cornstarch. Add to the stew. Cook and stir until thickened and bubbly. Serve the stew over the noodles, sprinkled with poppy seed. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

recipes.title: Dorito Dip
directions: Using a microwave-safe dish, spread cream cheese on bottom of dish.
Layer chili over cream cheese; layer salsa on top of chili and top with grated cheese.
Cover and microwave until bubbly. Serve with dipping chips of your choice.
recipes.text: Dorito Dip. Using a microwave-safe dish, spread cream cheese on bottom of dish. Layer chili over cream cheese; layer salsa on top of chili and top with grated cheese. Cover and microwave until bubbly. Serve with dipping chips of your choice.

recipes.title: Hot Cocoa
directions: Combine cocoa, sugar and salt in a saucepan; gradually add hot water.
Bring to a boil over medium heat for 2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Reduce to low heat, add milk and heat thoroughly. Stir often.
Remove from heat.
Add vanilla.
Beat with a wire whisk until foamy.
Top with marshmallows.
Makes 6 (6 ounce) servings.
recipes.text: Hot Cocoa. Combine cocoa, sugar and salt in a saucepan; gradually add hot water. Bring to a boil over medium heat for 2 minutes, stirring constantly. Reduce to low heat, add milk and heat thoroughly. Stir often. Remove from heat. Add vanilla. Beat with a wire whisk until foamy. Top with marshmallows. Makes 6 (6 ounce) servings.

recipes.title: Spinach Filled Manicotti
directions: Cook lasagna noodles according to directions.
Cut drained noodles in half widthwise.
Cook and drain spinach.
Shred Mozzarella cheese.
Mix the cheeses, spinach, spices and egg (optional).
Put 2 to 3 tablespoons of mixture in the middle of each noodle and roll up.
Layer the dish with tomato sauce, roll-up, tomato sauce and more Mozzarella cheese (optional).
Bake 20 to 30 minutes at 350°.
Let set 5 minutes.
recipes.text: Spinach Filled Manicotti. Cook lasagna noodles according to directions. Cut drained noodles in half widthwise. Cook and drain spinach. Shred Mozzarella cheese. Mix the cheeses, spinach, spices and egg (optional). Put 2 to 3 tablespoons of mixture in the middle of each noodle and roll up. Layer the dish with tomato sauce, roll-up, tomato sauce and more Mozzarella cheese (optional). Bake 20 to 30 minutes at 350°. Let set 5 minutes.

recipes.title: Snow Log
ingredients: 1/2 c. chopped maraschino cherries, well drained
directions: Soften cream cheese, then beat until smooth. Work in the rest of the ingredients but be sure to blot all the moisture from the cherries with paper towels. You may have to add more confectioners sugar. You can safely add as much as you can work in. Shape into a log 1 1/2 to 2 inches in diameter. Roll in wafer crumbs to coat. Store in waxed paper in a plastic bag. Keep in refrigerator. Slice in thin slices to serve.
recipes.text: Snow Log. Soften cream cheese, then beat until smooth. Work in the rest of the ingredients but be sure to blot all the moisture from the cherries with paper towels. You may have to add more confectioners sugar. You can safely add as much as you can work in. Shape into a log 1 1/2 to 2 inches in diameter. Roll in wafer crumbs to coat. Store in waxed paper in a plastic bag. Keep in refrigerator. Slice in thin slices to serve.

recipes.title: Spaghetti Salad
ingredients: 1 large bottle your favorite Italian dressing
directions: Cook spaghetti as package directs.
Drain spaghetti and place in a bowl with a lid.
Add the mushrooms, olives, onion, pepper and cucumber.
Mix well.
Add the dressing and place lid on the bowl.
Shake well.
Refrigerate and serve.
Great as a side dish or as a meal.
recipes.text: Spaghetti Salad. Cook spaghetti as package directs. Drain spaghetti and place in a bowl with a lid. Add the mushrooms, olives, onion, pepper and cucumber. Mix well. Add the dressing and place lid on the bowl. Shake well. Refrigerate and serve. Great as a side dish or as a meal.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Bars
directions: In medium bowl, combine oatmeal, flour, sugar, baking powder and salt. Stir to mix. Make well in center; add pumpkin, egg, butter and vanilla. Stir until dry ingredients are moistened. Stir in raisins and nuts. Spread mixture in a 9 x 9 pan that has been greased. Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes or until firm and lightly browned. Let cool in pan. Cut into bars.
recipes.text: Pumpkin Bars. In medium bowl, combine oatmeal, flour, sugar, baking powder and salt. Stir to mix. Make well in center; add pumpkin, egg, butter and vanilla. Stir until dry ingredients are moistened. Stir in raisins and nuts. Spread mixture in a 9 x 9 pan that has been greased. Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes or until firm and lightly browned. Let cool in pan. Cut into bars.

recipes.title: Mexican Dip
ingredients: 1 can Old El Paso green chili peppers, chopped
directions: Cook meat together until crumbly and drain. Add onion, garlic, soup, tomatoes and peppers. Add Velveeta cheese and stir into mixture until cheese is melted. Serve with tortilla chips.
recipes.text: Mexican Dip. Cook meat together until crumbly and drain. Add onion, garlic, soup, tomatoes and peppers. Add Velveeta cheese and stir into mixture until cheese is melted. Serve with tortilla chips.

recipes.title: Chess Pie
directions: Mix together the egg yolks (save the whites), sugar and butter or margarine.
Pour into pie shell.
Bake at 450° for 10 minutes, then bake at 300° to 350° until done.
recipes.text: Chess Pie. Mix together the egg yolks (save the whites), sugar and butter or margarine. Pour into pie shell. Bake at 450° for 10 minutes, then bake at 300° to 350° until done.

recipes.title: Mushroom Macaroni
directions: Heat oven to 350°.
Saute onions and mushrooms in 1 tablespoon oil and 3 tablespoons butter for about 15 minutes.
Add another 3 tablespoons butter and stir until melted.
Stir in flour until smooth.
Gradually stir in milk.
Add 1 1/2 teaspoons salt, 1/2 teaspoon pepper and the cayenne.
Bring to boil and cook for 1 minute.
Stir in macaroni and 2 tablespoons parsley.
Put in a 2-quart casserole.
Melt remaining 2 tablespoons of butter. Combine bread crumbs, Parmesan cheese, 1 tablespoon parsley, 1 tablespoon oil and the melted butter.
Sprinkle on top.
Bake until browned, about 25 minutes.
recipes.text: Mushroom Macaroni. Heat oven to 350°. Saute onions and mushrooms in 1 tablespoon oil and 3 tablespoons butter for about 15 minutes. Add another 3 tablespoons butter and stir until melted. Stir in flour until smooth. Gradually stir in milk. Add 1 1/2 teaspoons salt, 1/2 teaspoon pepper and the cayenne. Bring to boil and cook for 1 minute. Stir in macaroni and 2 tablespoons parsley. Put in a 2-quart casserole. Melt remaining 2 tablespoons of butter. Combine bread crumbs, Parmesan cheese, 1 tablespoon parsley, 1 tablespoon oil and the melted butter. Sprinkle on top. Bake until browned, about 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Tallarena
directions: Brown beef in pan with onion, bell pepper and garlic.
Add noodles and tomatoes.
Simmer for 20 minutes.
Add cheese on top and simmer about 10 minutes more or until cheese melts.
recipes.text: Tallarena. Brown beef in pan with onion, bell pepper and garlic. Add noodles and tomatoes. Simmer for 20 minutes. Add cheese on top and simmer about 10 minutes more or until cheese melts.

recipes.title: "No Fail" Pie Meringue
directions: Mix cornstarch, sugar and water in little saucepan and bring to boil and let boil until clear (1 minute or so).
Beat egg whites until real stiff.
Fold hot mixture into stiff egg whites.
Put on pie, sealing edges to crust and bake at 400° until golden brown, about 8 to 10 minutes.
recipes.text: "No Fail" Pie Meringue. Mix cornstarch, sugar and water in little saucepan and bring to boil and let boil until clear (1 minute or so). Beat egg whites until real stiff. Fold hot mixture into stiff egg whites. Put on pie, sealing edges to crust and bake at 400° until golden brown, about 8 to 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Meat Loaf
directions: Combine all ingredients, place in loaf pan.
Bake 45 minutes to 1 hour at 350°.
recipes.text: Meat Loaf. Combine all ingredients, place in loaf pan. Bake 45 minutes to 1 hour at 350°.

recipes.title: Pork Chops In Gravy
ingredients: 2 (4 oz.) lean boneless cut loin pork chops
1/3 c. each: diced onion and green pepper
1 c. hot cooked rice, cooked without fat and salt
directions: Trim excess fat from pork; set aside.
Combine flour, paprika, salt and pepper; dredge pork chops in flour mixture, reserving remaining flour mixture.
Coat a nonstick skillet with vegetable cooking spray.
Place over medium-high heat until hot.
Add pork chops and brown on each side.
Remove to a 1-quart casserole coated with cooking spray.
Add mushrooms, onion and green pepper to skillet.
Saute until tender.
Stir in reserved flour mixture. Cook 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Gradually stir in milk; cook until thickened, stirring constantly.
Stir in lemon juice.
Pour gravy over pork chops.
Cover and bake an additional 10 minutes. Serve over rice.
Yields 2 servings.
recipes.text: Pork Chops In Gravy. Trim excess fat from pork; set aside. Combine flour, paprika, salt and pepper; dredge pork chops in flour mixture, reserving remaining flour mixture. Coat a nonstick skillet with vegetable cooking spray. Place over medium-high heat until hot. Add pork chops and brown on each side. Remove to a 1-quart casserole coated with cooking spray. Add mushrooms, onion and green pepper to skillet. Saute until tender. Stir in reserved flour mixture. Cook 1 minute, stirring constantly. Gradually stir in milk; cook until thickened, stirring constantly. Stir in lemon juice. Pour gravy over pork chops. Cover and bake an additional 10 minutes. Serve over rice. Yields 2 servings.

recipes.title: Saucy Meat Loaf
directions: Save 3 or 4 onion rings for topping.
Place the rest in the bottom of a baking pan (8 x 8 x 2-inch).
Cover onions with ground beef; break lightly with a fork, but do not pack down.
Sprinkle with salt, basil and oregano; top with saved onion rings.
recipes.text: Saucy Meat Loaf. Save 3 or 4 onion rings for topping. Place the rest in the bottom of a baking pan (8 x 8 x 2-inch). Cover onions with ground beef; break lightly with a fork, but do not pack down. Sprinkle with salt, basil and oregano; top with saved onion rings.

recipes.title: Broccoli Salad
ingredients: 1 bunch broccoli, cut in small pieces
directions: Mix all ingredients thoroughly and chill until ready to serve.
recipes.text: Broccoli Salad. Mix all ingredients thoroughly and chill until ready to serve.

recipes.title: Milk Chocolate Fudge
directions: Cook sugar, milk and butter to soft ball stage (8 minutes). Remove from heat and add the rest.
Whip and put in large buttered pan.
recipes.text: Milk Chocolate Fudge. Cook sugar, milk and butter to soft ball stage (8 minutes). Remove from heat and add the rest. Whip and put in large buttered pan.

recipes.title: Holiday Dessert Cake
ingredients: 1 large angel food cake, sliced thin
1 can blueberry or your choice pie filling
directions: Beat together powdered sugar, milk and cream cheese.
Beat Dream Whip, milk and vanilla, then fold into first mixture.
In 13 x 9-inch pan, alternate layers of cake and mixture.
Top with can of pie filling.
Refrigerate until serving.
Best made day before use.
recipes.text: Holiday Dessert Cake. Beat together powdered sugar, milk and cream cheese. Beat Dream Whip, milk and vanilla, then fold into first mixture. In 13 x 9-inch pan, alternate layers of cake and mixture. Top with can of pie filling. Refrigerate until serving. Best made day before use.

recipes.title: Taco Cups
directions: Press biscuits on bottom and up sides of ungreased muffin tins.
Spoon meat mixture in first; top with chopped tomatoes, a dollop of sour cream and cover with grated cheese.
Bake at 400° for 10 to 15 minutes.
Makes 10 cups.
recipes.text: Taco Cups. Press biscuits on bottom and up sides of ungreased muffin tins. Spoon meat mixture in first; top with chopped tomatoes, a dollop of sour cream and cover with grated cheese. Bake at 400° for 10 to 15 minutes. Makes 10 cups.

recipes.title: Goulash
ingredients: chili powder to taste (or 2 to 3 tsp.)
1 (7 oz.) box bite size spaghetti, uncooked
directions: Simmer all for 1/2 hour.
Stir occasionally to prevent sticking to pan.
recipes.text: Goulash. Simmer all for 1/2 hour. Stir occasionally to prevent sticking to pan.

recipes.title: Diabetic Spice Cookie
ingredients: 1/2 tsp. Sucaryl or other liquid sweetener
directions: Boil water, shortening, raisins, dates, nutmeg and cinnamon for 3 minutes. Let cool. Then beat in eggs; dissolve salt, soda and sweetener in the 2 tablespoons of water. Then add egg mixture. Drop by teaspoon on a cookie sheet and bake at 350° for about 12 minutes or until done.
recipes.text: Diabetic Spice Cookie. Boil water, shortening, raisins, dates, nutmeg and cinnamon for 3 minutes. Let cool. Then beat in eggs; dissolve salt, soda and sweetener in the 2 tablespoons of water. Then add egg mixture. Drop by teaspoon on a cookie sheet and bake at 350° for about 12 minutes or until done.

recipes.title: Dan Melvin'S Crisp Corn Bread
directions: Preheat an 8-inch iron skillet (hot).
Sift all dry ingredients together.
Add eggs and milk.
Mix well.
Pour batter into the iron skillet.
Bake at 425° for about 20 minutes or until done.
recipes.text: Dan Melvin'S Crisp Corn Bread. Preheat an 8-inch iron skillet (hot). Sift all dry ingredients together. Add eggs and milk. Mix well. Pour batter into the iron skillet. Bake at 425° for about 20 minutes or until done.

recipes.title: Caramel Corn
directions: Melt butter.
Stir in brown sugar, syrup and salt.
Bring to boil and cook 5 minutes.
Remove from heat.
Stir in vanilla and soda.
Pour over popcorn and nuts (which have been dumped in large greased pan).
Stir with wooden spoon.
Bake at 250° for 1 hour, stirring every 15 minutes.
recipes.text: Caramel Corn. Melt butter. Stir in brown sugar, syrup and salt. Bring to boil and cook 5 minutes. Remove from heat. Stir in vanilla and soda. Pour over popcorn and nuts (which have been dumped in large greased pan). Stir with wooden spoon. Bake at 250° for 1 hour, stirring every 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Colorful Veggie Bake
ingredients: 2 (16 oz.) pkg. frozen California Blend veggies
1/2 c. crushed butter flavored crackers (about 13 crackers)
directions: Prepare vegetables according to package directions. Drain. Place half in a greased 11 x 7 x 2-inch baking dish. In a small saucepan, combine cheese and 4 tablespoons butter. Cook and stir over low heat until melted. Pour half over vegetables. Repeat layers. Melt remaining butter. Toss with cracker crumbs. Sprinkle over the top. Bake, uncovered, at 325° for 20 to 25 minutes. Makes 8 to 10 servings.
recipes.text: Colorful Veggie Bake. Prepare vegetables according to package directions. Drain. Place half in a greased 11 x 7 x 2-inch baking dish. In a small saucepan, combine cheese and 4 tablespoons butter. Cook and stir over low heat until melted. Pour half over vegetables. Repeat layers. Melt remaining butter. Toss with cracker crumbs. Sprinkle over the top. Bake, uncovered, at 325° for 20 to 25 minutes. Makes 8 to 10 servings.

recipes.title: Broccoli Macaroni Casserole
directions: Melt butter; stir in flour, salt and pepper.
Add milk gradually, stirring constantly.
Cook until thickened, stirring occasionally.
Add the mayonnaise.
Cook macaroni in boiling, salted water until tender.
Drain, rinse and drain again.
Layer macaroni, broccoli and sauce in a greased 1 1/2-quart casserole dish, ending with sauce.
Sprinkle with cheese.
Bake at 350° about 20 minutes.
recipes.text: Broccoli Macaroni Casserole. Melt butter; stir in flour, salt and pepper. Add milk gradually, stirring constantly. Cook until thickened, stirring occasionally. Add the mayonnaise. Cook macaroni in boiling, salted water until tender. Drain, rinse and drain again. Layer macaroni, broccoli and sauce in a greased 1 1/2-quart casserole dish, ending with sauce. Sprinkle with cheese. Bake at 350° about 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Puppy Chow
directions: Mix chocolate chips, peanut butter and margarine in microwave oven.
Pour over Rice Chex.
Pour mixture in jelly roll pan.
Let cool.
Place in large container and work in powdered sugar.
recipes.text: Puppy Chow. Mix chocolate chips, peanut butter and margarine in microwave oven. Pour over Rice Chex. Pour mixture in jelly roll pan. Let cool. Place in large container and work in powdered sugar.

recipes.title: Bourbon Slush
directions: Place in freezer until ready to serve.
Add (top off) with 7-Up when serving.
recipes.text: Bourbon Slush. Place in freezer until ready to serve. Add (top off) with 7-Up when serving.

recipes.title: Custard Pie
directions: Preheat oven to 425°.
In a medium bowl, combine Eagle Brand milk, water, salt and vanilla.
Add eggs and mix well.
Pour into pie shells.
Sprinkle with nutmeg.
Bake 10 minutes.
Reduce heat to 300°.
Bake 30 to 45 additional minutes, or until knife inserted in middle comes out clean.
Cool at room temperature.
Refrigerate leftovers.
recipes.text: Custard Pie. Preheat oven to 425°. In a medium bowl, combine Eagle Brand milk, water, salt and vanilla. Add eggs and mix well. Pour into pie shells. Sprinkle with nutmeg. Bake 10 minutes. Reduce heat to 300°. Bake 30 to 45 additional minutes, or until knife inserted in middle comes out clean. Cool at room temperature. Refrigerate leftovers.

recipes.title: Rice-Y-Spicy Meatballs
directions: In large mixing bowl, beat egg until foamy.
Add Rice Krispies, catsup, water, onion, dry milk, salt and pepper.
Mix well; add ground meat.
Mix only until combined.
Portion using 1 level tablespoon.
Shape into meatballs.
Place in single layers in well-greased or foil-lined shallow baking pan.
Bake at 400° for about 12 minutes or until well browned.
recipes.text: Rice-Y-Spicy Meatballs. In large mixing bowl, beat egg until foamy. Add Rice Krispies, catsup, water, onion, dry milk, salt and pepper. Mix well; add ground meat. Mix only until combined. Portion using 1 level tablespoon. Shape into meatballs. Place in single layers in well-greased or foil-lined shallow baking pan. Bake at 400° for about 12 minutes or until well browned.

recipes.title: Reuben Sandwich
ingredients: 8 slices dark rye or pumpernickel bread
directions: Toast bread, butter lightly.
Arrange sliced corned beef on 4 slices of toast.
Divide sauerkraut among sandwiches.
Top with Thousand Island dressing.
Top each with a slice of Swiss cheese. Top with other slices of toast, buttered side down.
Place each sandwich on a paper plate.
Cook one at a time, for 1 1/2 to 2 minutes, or just until cheese melts.
Either use grill or microwave to cook.
recipes.text: Reuben Sandwich. Toast bread, butter lightly. Arrange sliced corned beef on 4 slices of toast. Divide sauerkraut among sandwiches. Top with Thousand Island dressing. Top each with a slice of Swiss cheese. Top with other slices of toast, buttered side down. Place each sandwich on a paper plate. Cook one at a time, for 1 1/2 to 2 minutes, or just until cheese melts. Either use grill or microwave to cook.

recipes.title: Venison Steak
ingredients: 1 lb. large raw shrimp in shells
directions: Be sure to use ice water and don't overmix if you want a lovely and lacey crisp batter on the shrimp.
recipes.text: Venison Steak. Be sure to use ice water and don't overmix if you want a lovely and lacey crisp batter on the shrimp.

recipes.title: Chicken Pot Pie
directions: Cook chicken and onion in water to make broth.
When done, remove chicken from bones and add to broth.
recipes.text: Chicken Pot Pie. Cook chicken and onion in water to make broth. When done, remove chicken from bones and add to broth.

recipes.title: Lemon-Baked Chicken
directions: Skin chicken.
Rub 1 teaspoon of butter on each breast. Sprinkle pepper, salt, paprika and parsley on breasts after applying lemon juice.
Put 2 tablespoons of water in pan to prevent sticking.
Bake at 425° for 35 minutes or until done in a 9 x 9-inch baking pan.
Serves 4.
recipes.text: Lemon-Baked Chicken. Skin chicken. Rub 1 teaspoon of butter on each breast. Sprinkle pepper, salt, paprika and parsley on breasts after applying lemon juice. Put 2 tablespoons of water in pan to prevent sticking. Bake at 425° for 35 minutes or until done in a 9 x 9-inch baking pan. Serves 4.

recipes.title: Cheese Cake
directions: Mix the cake mix, 2 eggs and 1 stick of butter/oleo (melted) together.
Press into a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Next, mix the powdered sugar, 2 eggs, cheese and 1 stick of butter/oleo (melted) together.
Pour over other mixture.
Do not mix the two together. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Cheese Cake. Mix the cake mix, 2 eggs and 1 stick of butter/oleo (melted) together. Press into a 9 x 13-inch pan. Next, mix the powdered sugar, 2 eggs, cheese and 1 stick of butter/oleo (melted) together. Pour over other mixture. Do not mix the two together. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Chicken Casserole
ingredients: 1 can cream of chicken or chicken mushroom soup
bite size pieces of 4 to 6 chicken thighs or any other chicken parts you wish to use
directions: Mix all together; pour into a 7 x 12-inch casserole.
Sprinkle with pepper and paprika.
Bake approximately 1 hour and 15 minutes at 350°.
recipes.text: Chicken Casserole. Mix all together; pour into a 7 x 12-inch casserole. Sprinkle with pepper and paprika. Bake approximately 1 hour and 15 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Dirt Cake
ingredients: 2 pkg. instant vanilla pudding mix (large size)
directions: Crumble cookies very fine in food processor or by hand. Layer 1/2 of the crumbs in container or large dish that resembles a flower pot. Blend cream cheese, margarine and powdered sugar until light; add vanilla and fold in whipped topping. Combine pudding mix and milk; fold into cheese mixture. Pour in container over crumbs. Top with remaining crumbs to look like potting soil.
recipes.text: Dirt Cake. Crumble cookies very fine in food processor or by hand. Layer 1/2 of the crumbs in container or large dish that resembles a flower pot. Blend cream cheese, margarine and powdered sugar until light; add vanilla and fold in whipped topping. Combine pudding mix and milk; fold into cheese mixture. Pour in container over crumbs. Top with remaining crumbs to look like potting soil.

recipes.title: Lo-Cal Cottage Cheese Salad
ingredients: 1 container Cool Whip or 2 pkg. Dream Whip, mixed
directions: Sprinkle dry Jell-O over whipped topping and mix.
Add cottage cheese and stir.
Add drained pineapple.
Let set in refrigerator and hour, if desired, but may be eaten immediately.
recipes.text: Lo-Cal Cottage Cheese Salad. Sprinkle dry Jell-O over whipped topping and mix. Add cottage cheese and stir. Add drained pineapple. Let set in refrigerator and hour, if desired, but may be eaten immediately.

recipes.title: Black Olive Spread
ingredients: 1 large clove garlic, put through garlic press or 1/4 tsp. minced garlic in jar
directions: Blend all together.
Place on plastic wrap; mold to shape. Refrigerate for an hour so can freely be removed from wrap.
Serve with melba toast or non salty cracker of choice.
recipes.text: Black Olive Spread. Blend all together. Place on plastic wrap; mold to shape. Refrigerate for an hour so can freely be removed from wrap. Serve with melba toast or non salty cracker of choice.

recipes.title: Ladyfingers Dessert
directions: Arrange Ladyfingers in bottom of 9 x 9-inch pan.
recipes.text: Ladyfingers Dessert. Arrange Ladyfingers in bottom of 9 x 9-inch pan.

recipes.title: Chicken Broccoli Salad
ingredients: 1/2 lb. broccoli flowerets, washed and slightly cooked
Miracle Whip salad dressing to taste
directions: Break broccoli into bite-size pieces and allow to cool completely. Add chicken, grapes and walnuts. Stir in Miracle Whip and chill.
May be served with a meal or on lettuce leaves.
recipes.text: Chicken Broccoli Salad. Break broccoli into bite-size pieces and allow to cool completely. Add chicken, grapes and walnuts. Stir in Miracle Whip and chill. May be served with a meal or on lettuce leaves.

recipes.title: Crock-Pot Beef Stew
ingredients: 1 1/2 lb. stew beef, cut in 1-inch cubes
directions: Put stew beef into crock-pot; cover with water.
Cook overnight.
recipes.text: Crock-Pot Beef Stew. Put stew beef into crock-pot; cover with water. Cook overnight.

recipes.title: Spiced Tea
ingredients: 1 orange, sliced peel and all or 2 heaping Tbsp. Tang
directions: Combine apple and lemon juice and set aside.
Bring to a boil remaining ingredients.
Simmer 20 minutes.
Strain.
Add to apple and lemon juice.
Heat and serve.
recipes.text: Spiced Tea. Combine apple and lemon juice and set aside. Bring to a boil remaining ingredients. Simmer 20 minutes. Strain. Add to apple and lemon juice. Heat and serve.

recipes.title: Wine Soup(Vinesuppe)
ingredients: 1 bottle grape juice or a grape wine (2 c.)
directions: Soak separately overnight the tapioca and prunes.
Cook the prunes in one quart of water until tender.
Add the tapioca and the rest of the ingredients and cook slowly until the tapioca is dissolved.
Add the lemon at the end of the cooking time.
recipes.text: Wine Soup(Vinesuppe). Soak separately overnight the tapioca and prunes. Cook the prunes in one quart of water until tender. Add the tapioca and the rest of the ingredients and cook slowly until the tapioca is dissolved. Add the lemon at the end of the cooking time.

recipes.title: Dump Cake
ingredients: 1 box lemon or yellow cake mix
directions: Grease 9 x 13-inch pan; spread pineapple evenly.
Cover with cherries.
Sprinkle cake mix over fruit.
Sprinkle melted butter over cake mix.
Add nuts if wanted.
Bake at 350° for 45 to 50 minutes.
recipes.text: Dump Cake. Grease 9 x 13-inch pan; spread pineapple evenly. Cover with cherries. Sprinkle cake mix over fruit. Sprinkle melted butter over cake mix. Add nuts if wanted. Bake at 350° for 45 to 50 minutes.

recipes.title: Lentil Patty
directions: Combine lentils, salt, water and rice; bring to boil.
Lower heat.
Cover, then simmer until tender, about 35 minutes.
Remove; let stand 10 minutes.
Wash with water.
Stir in bread crumbs, wheat germ, onion, celery seed, etc.
Shape into patties; roll in the wheat germ.
Fry slowly in well-oiled pan for 10 minutes. These are delicious.
recipes.text: Lentil Patty. Combine lentils, salt, water and rice; bring to boil. Lower heat. Cover, then simmer until tender, about 35 minutes. Remove; let stand 10 minutes. Wash with water. Stir in bread crumbs, wheat germ, onion, celery seed, etc. Shape into patties; roll in the wheat germ. Fry slowly in well-oiled pan for 10 minutes. These are delicious.

recipes.title: Shrimp With Spinach Soup
directions: Heat butter in a 4-quart saucepan on high heat.
Add garlic and shrimp.
Saute for a few seconds.
Add half of chicken broth, salt, white pepper and m.s.g.
Bring it to simmer.
Add spinach and cook for 2 minutes.
Add remaining chicken stock, stir and cover.
Simmer until spinach is soft.
Serve immediately.
recipes.text: Shrimp With Spinach Soup. Heat butter in a 4-quart saucepan on high heat. Add garlic and shrimp. Saute for a few seconds. Add half of chicken broth, salt, white pepper and m.s.g. Bring it to simmer. Add spinach and cook for 2 minutes. Add remaining chicken stock, stir and cover. Simmer until spinach is soft. Serve immediately.

recipes.title: Nacho Dip
directions: Mix all ingredients together, except chips.
Simmer over low heat or in a slow cooker.
Serve when mixture is completely warmed.
recipes.text: Nacho Dip. Mix all ingredients together, except chips. Simmer over low heat or in a slow cooker. Serve when mixture is completely warmed.

recipes.title: Eternal Meringue
directions: Bring cornstarch and water to a boil or until really thick and clear.
Set aside to cool completely.
Beat 3 egg whites until real stiff; add 3 tablespoons sugar.
Beat 1 minute.
Add cooled cornstarch and beat 2 to 3 minutes more.
Put on pie.
Bake 15 minutes at 350° until golden brown.
Will not fall or water.
recipes.text: Eternal Meringue. Bring cornstarch and water to a boil or until really thick and clear. Set aside to cool completely. Beat 3 egg whites until real stiff; add 3 tablespoons sugar. Beat 1 minute. Add cooled cornstarch and beat 2 to 3 minutes more. Put on pie. Bake 15 minutes at 350° until golden brown. Will not fall or water.

recipes.title: Martha Washington Candy
directions: Mix well and put in refrigerator overnight.
Make into balls and put in icebox for 30 minutes.
Melt 1 large package paraffin. Dip the balls into the chocolate and set on wax paper.
recipes.text: Martha Washington Candy. Mix well and put in refrigerator overnight. Make into balls and put in icebox for 30 minutes. Melt 1 large package paraffin. Dip the balls into the chocolate and set on wax paper.

recipes.title: Chicken And Wild Rice Casserole
ingredients: 1 can fried onion rings or almonds
directions: Mix rice according to directions.
Melt butter in frying pan, then stir in flour.
Add milk and stir on medium heat until well blended.
Add remaining ingredients, then mix well with the rice. Pour in greased dish.
Bake 30 minutes at 350°.
Add French fried onions or sliced almonds on top and bake 15 minutes.
recipes.text: Chicken And Wild Rice Casserole. Mix rice according to directions. Melt butter in frying pan, then stir in flour. Add milk and stir on medium heat until well blended. Add remaining ingredients, then mix well with the rice. Pour in greased dish. Bake 30 minutes at 350°. Add French fried onions or sliced almonds on top and bake 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Grandma Hardin'S Christmas Jam Cakegroves, Texas
directions: Cream butter and sugar and add eggs.
Add other ingredients and beat all until they are blended.
Cook at 350° until toothpick comes out clean.
recipes.text: Grandma Hardin'S Christmas Jam Cakegroves, Texas. Cream butter and sugar and add eggs. Add other ingredients and beat all until they are blended. Cook at 350° until toothpick comes out clean.

recipes.title: Large Meat Sandwich
ingredients: 1 large roll (either French or Italian bread)
1/2 tsp. garlic powder and onion powder
directions: Cut half off top of sandwich bread.
Scoop out bread.
Layer with cream cheese mixture, cheese, meat, etc., until all used. Wrap and let set overnight.
recipes.text: Large Meat Sandwich. Cut half off top of sandwich bread. Scoop out bread. Layer with cream cheese mixture, cheese, meat, etc., until all used. Wrap and let set overnight.

recipes.title: Spicy Sweet Popcorn
directions: Pop popcorn, mix dry ingredients in a Ziploc bag.
Add popcorn and spray with cooking spray.
Close bag and mix.
Repeat with cooking spray until popcorn is coated.
Makes about 6 cups.
recipes.text: Spicy Sweet Popcorn. Pop popcorn, mix dry ingredients in a Ziploc bag. Add popcorn and spray with cooking spray. Close bag and mix. Repeat with cooking spray until popcorn is coated. Makes about 6 cups.

recipes.title: Golden Scalloped Potatoes
ingredients: 1 can Campbell's cream of celery soup
directions: Combine soup, milk and pepper.
In buttered 1 1/2-quart casserole, arrange alternate layers of potatoes, onion, soup mixture and cheese.
Dot top with butter; sprinkle with paprika. Cover; bake at 375° for 1 hour.
Uncover; bake 15 minutes more or until potatoes are done.
Makes about 4 cups.
recipes.text: Golden Scalloped Potatoes. Combine soup, milk and pepper. In buttered 1 1/2-quart casserole, arrange alternate layers of potatoes, onion, soup mixture and cheese. Dot top with butter; sprinkle with paprika. Cover; bake at 375° for 1 hour. Uncover; bake 15 minutes more or until potatoes are done. Makes about 4 cups.

recipes.title: Molasses Crinkles
directions: Mix together the butter, sugar, egg and molasses.
Mix together the flour, baking soda, salt, cloves, cinnamon and ginger.
Stir into the buttered mixture.
Chill dough.
Roll into balls the size of walnuts; dip tops in sugar and place on a greased baking sheet.
Bake 10 to 12 minutes at 375°.
recipes.text: Molasses Crinkles. Mix together the butter, sugar, egg and molasses. Mix together the flour, baking soda, salt, cloves, cinnamon and ginger. Stir into the buttered mixture. Chill dough. Roll into balls the size of walnuts; dip tops in sugar and place on a greased baking sheet. Bake 10 to 12 minutes at 375°.

recipes.title: Rich And Thick Milk Shake
ingredients: 1 (4 serving size) pkg. instant pudding and pie filling (any flavor)
directions: Pour milk into electric blender container.
Add pudding mix, ice cream and ice.
Cover and blend at high speed for 1 minute. Serve at once.
Makes about 5 cups.
recipes.text: Rich And Thick Milk Shake. Pour milk into electric blender container. Add pudding mix, ice cream and ice. Cover and blend at high speed for 1 minute. Serve at once. Makes about 5 cups.

recipes.title: Frozen Banana Dessert
directions: Mix banana, pineapple, sugar and sour cream.
Add pecans and cherries.
Freeze in individual molds or cut in squares.
recipes.text: Frozen Banana Dessert. Mix banana, pineapple, sugar and sour cream. Add pecans and cherries. Freeze in individual molds or cut in squares.

recipes.title: Irish Potato Casserole
ingredients: 1/4 c. chopped chives or green onion tops
directions: Boil, drain and mash potatoes.
Add cheese and remaining ingredients except paprika.
Beat until smooth.
Spoon into buttered 2-quart casserole.
Sprinkle with paprika.
Cover and refrigerate overnight.
Remove from refrigerator, wait 15 minutes and bake at 350° for 35 minutes.
Serves 8 to 10.
recipes.text: Irish Potato Casserole. Boil, drain and mash potatoes. Add cheese and remaining ingredients except paprika. Beat until smooth. Spoon into buttered 2-quart casserole. Sprinkle with paprika. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Remove from refrigerator, wait 15 minutes and bake at 350° for 35 minutes. Serves 8 to 10.

recipes.title: Chocolate Covered Cherries
directions: Drain maraschino cherries well and lay on paper towel.	Mix sugar, condensed milk, butter and vanilla.	Knead thoroughly until like soft dough.
Roll fondant around the cherries until a ball (dust palm of hand with powdered sugar).
Lightly freeze balls as they dip better into the chocolate bark.
Melt chocolate bark in microwave and dip cherries.
Lay on buttered plate to cool.
This recipe can be doubled.
recipes.text: Chocolate Covered Cherries. Drain maraschino cherries well and lay on paper towel.	Mix sugar, condensed milk, butter and vanilla.	Knead thoroughly until like soft dough. Roll fondant around the cherries until a ball (dust palm of hand with powdered sugar). Lightly freeze balls as they dip better into the chocolate bark. Melt chocolate bark in microwave and dip cherries. Lay on buttered plate to cool. This recipe can be doubled.

recipes.title: Hungarian Stew With Noodles
ingredients: 5 lb. lean beef for stewing, cut into 1-inch cubes
directions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven; add garlic and cook 1 minute over medium-high heat.
Discard garlic.
Add beef and onions; cook until the meat is browned, stirring occasionally.
Stir in tomato paste, water, paprika, salt, pepper and bay leaf; bring to a boil. Reduce heat; cover and cook over low heat 2 hours or until meat is tender; stir occasionally.
Toss noodles with butter and parsley.
Top stew with lemon rind and caraway seed; serve with egg noodles.
recipes.text: Hungarian Stew With Noodles. Heat oil in a large Dutch oven; add garlic and cook 1 minute over medium-high heat. Discard garlic. Add beef and onions; cook until the meat is browned, stirring occasionally. Stir in tomato paste, water, paprika, salt, pepper and bay leaf; bring to a boil. Reduce heat; cover and cook over low heat 2 hours or until meat is tender; stir occasionally. Toss noodles with butter and parsley. Top stew with lemon rind and caraway seed; serve with egg noodles.

recipes.title: Ham And Broccoli Casserole
directions: Cook macaroni according to package directions; do not overcook.
Wash broccoli; cut into bite-size pieces and cook, uncovered in boiling salted water for 5 minutes.
Drain.
Make cheese sauce by combining milk, cornstarch, 1/2 stick margarine, salt and pepper in saucepan.
Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, with a wire whisk.
When mixture thickens, add cheese, mayonnaise and onions and blend until the cheese is melted. Remove from heat; add macaroni, broccoli and ham.
Pour mixture into casserole dish.
Melt remaining 1/2 stick margarine; add to cracker crumbs and stir until moistened.
Spoon crumbs over top of casserole.
Bake for 20 minutes at 350°.
Freezes well!
recipes.text: Ham And Broccoli Casserole. Cook macaroni according to package directions; do not overcook. Wash broccoli; cut into bite-size pieces and cook, uncovered in boiling salted water for 5 minutes. Drain. Make cheese sauce by combining milk, cornstarch, 1/2 stick margarine, salt and pepper in saucepan. Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, with a wire whisk. When mixture thickens, add cheese, mayonnaise and onions and blend until the cheese is melted. Remove from heat; add macaroni, broccoli and ham. Pour mixture into casserole dish. Melt remaining 1/2 stick margarine; add to cracker crumbs and stir until moistened. Spoon crumbs over top of casserole. Bake for 20 minutes at 350°. Freezes well!

recipes.title: Beef Stroganoff
ingredients: 1 lb. round steak, cut into 1-inch cubes
1 envelope Lipton onion and mushroom soup mix
directions: Brown cubed steak with chopped onion until onion is tender and meat is browned on all sides.
Add water and simmer covered for 5 minutes.
Stir in soup mix and sour cream, salt and pepper.
Cook until thickened.
Serve over egg noodles.
Serves 4.
recipes.text: Beef Stroganoff. Brown cubed steak with chopped onion until onion is tender and meat is browned on all sides. Add water and simmer covered for 5 minutes. Stir in soup mix and sour cream, salt and pepper. Cook until thickened. Serve over egg noodles. Serves 4.

recipes.title: Christmas Cookies
ingredients: 1 tsp. each: allspice, cinnamon and nutmeg
directions: Chop pecans, pineapple and cherries.
Use 1 cup flour to coat them.
Mix in order given; drop on greased cookie sheet.
Bake at 300° about 25 to 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Christmas Cookies. Chop pecans, pineapple and cherries. Use 1 cup flour to coat them. Mix in order given; drop on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 300° about 25 to 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Dump Cake
directions: Mix all ingredients and bake at 375° for 1 hour in a 9 x 13-inch pan.
recipes.text: Dump Cake. Mix all ingredients and bake at 375° for 1 hour in a 9 x 13-inch pan.

recipes.title: Old-Fashion Sugar Cookies
directions: Cream together butter, sugar and Crisco; add egg yolks and flavorings.
Next add buttermilk.
Blend in 1 cup of flour at a time.
Cover and refrigerate overnight.
Bake at 450° for 8 minutes.
recipes.text: Old-Fashion Sugar Cookies. Cream together butter, sugar and Crisco; add egg yolks and flavorings. Next add buttermilk. Blend in 1 cup of flour at a time. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Bake at 450° for 8 minutes.

recipes.title: Cream Cheese Pound Cake
directions: Sprinkle 1/2 cup pecans in greased and floured 10-inch tube pan; set aside.
recipes.text: Cream Cheese Pound Cake. Sprinkle 1/2 cup pecans in greased and floured 10-inch tube pan; set aside.

recipes.title: Cheese Herb Bread
directions: Combine 2 cups flour, sugar, salt, yeast, oregano and basil. Heat milk and butter to 120° to 130°. Gradually add hot mixture to flour, beating 2 minutes with electric mixer. Add 1 cup flour, potatoes, eggs and cheese. Beat 2 more minutes. Stir in enough flour to make a soft dough.
Turn dough on a floured surface and knead 8 to 10 minutes.

Shape into a ball and place in greased bowl. Cover and let rise until almost doubled. Punch dough down and divide in half. Roll into 10 to 12 inch lengths and place on greased cookie sheet. Brush with melted butter. Let rise until almost double in size. Bake at 375° for 25 to 30 minutes.
Brush with melted butter.
recipes.text: Cheese Herb Bread. Combine 2 cups flour, sugar, salt, yeast, oregano and basil. Heat milk and butter to 120° to 130°. Gradually add hot mixture to flour, beating 2 minutes with electric mixer. Add 1 cup flour, potatoes, eggs and cheese. Beat 2 more minutes. Stir in enough flour to make a soft dough. Turn dough on a floured surface and knead 8 to 10 minutes. Shape into a ball and place in greased bowl. Cover and let rise until almost doubled. Punch dough down and divide in half. Roll into 10 to 12 inch lengths and place on greased cookie sheet. Brush with melted butter. Let rise until almost double in size. Bake at 375° for 25 to 30 minutes. Brush with melted butter.

recipes.title: Freckle Bread
directions: Mix all ingredients by hand.
Pour into lightly greased loaf pans (3).
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.
Top will crack.
recipes.text: Freckle Bread. Mix all ingredients by hand. Pour into lightly greased loaf pans (3). Bake at 350° for 45 minutes. Top will crack.

recipes.title: Broccoli Salad
directions: Cut
broccoli, onion, apple and celery together.
Leave in refrigerator
overnight.
Mix
in another bowl mayonnaise, vinegar and sugar.
Mix together when ready to serve.
recipes.text: Broccoli Salad. Cut broccoli, onion, apple and celery together. Leave in refrigerator overnight. Mix in another bowl mayonnaise, vinegar and sugar. Mix together when ready to serve.

recipes.title: Pizza Dip
ingredients: 1/4 lb. pepperoni, shredded in food processor
directions: Beat all ingredients up to pepper until smooth (with mixer) and spread into medium size baking dish.
Top with 1/2 of pizza sauce.
Alternate pepperoni, cheese, scallions, olives and sauce in 2 more layers.
Top with olives.
Bake in microwave on High 8 to 10 minutes, until bubbly.
Serve with garlic bagel chips.
recipes.text: Pizza Dip. Beat all ingredients up to pepper until smooth (with mixer) and spread into medium size baking dish. Top with 1/2 of pizza sauce. Alternate pepperoni, cheese, scallions, olives and sauce in 2 more layers. Top with olives. Bake in microwave on High 8 to 10 minutes, until bubbly. Serve with garlic bagel chips.

recipes.title: Apple-Nut Coffee Bread
directions: Stir together flour, baking powder and soda; then set aside. In large bowl combine apple, sugar and coffee crystals.
Let stand 5 minutes, stirring once.
Add egg and oil.
Mix well.
Stir in flour mixture just until combined.
Fold in nuts.
recipes.text: Apple-Nut Coffee Bread. Stir together flour, baking powder and soda; then set aside. In large bowl combine apple, sugar and coffee crystals. Let stand 5 minutes, stirring once. Add egg and oil. Mix well. Stir in flour mixture just until combined. Fold in nuts.

recipes.title: Party Mix
directions: Mix together.
Bake at 250° for 45 minutes. Stir every 15 minutes.
recipes.text: Party Mix. Mix together. Bake at 250° for 45 minutes. Stir every 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Chocolate-Coconut Pie
directions: Combine dry ingredients; add beaten eggs, milk and vanilla. Stir in pecans and coconut.
Pour into uncooked pie crusts (2 crusts).
Bake in a 350° oven for 40 minutes.
recipes.text: Chocolate-Coconut Pie. Combine dry ingredients; add beaten eggs, milk and vanilla. Stir in pecans and coconut. Pour into uncooked pie crusts (2 crusts). Bake in a 350° oven for 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Christmas Butter Cookies
directions: Cream together oleo, sugar and 2 teaspoons water; set aside. In bowl, beat eggs and vanilla until light and fluffy.
Add flour, baking powder and salt.
Blend all together, then chill.
recipes.text: Christmas Butter Cookies. Cream together oleo, sugar and 2 teaspoons water; set aside. In bowl, beat eggs and vanilla until light and fluffy. Add flour, baking powder and salt. Blend all together, then chill.

recipes.title: Butter Crisps
directions: Mix all together.
Chill.
Shape into balls; put on ungreased pan.
Flatten with a fork, sprinkle with colored sugar.
Bake at 325° for 18 to 20 minutes.
recipes.text: Butter Crisps. Mix all together. Chill. Shape into balls; put on ungreased pan. Flatten with a fork, sprinkle with colored sugar. Bake at 325° for 18 to 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Raspberry Dessert
directions: Soak marshmallows in sour cream.
Stir water into Jello.
Add remaining ingredients.
Refrigerate before serving.
Serves 8.
recipes.text: Raspberry Dessert. Soak marshmallows in sour cream. Stir water into Jello. Add remaining ingredients. Refrigerate before serving. Serves 8.

recipes.title: Sugar Cookies
directions: Cream shortening and sugar until well blended.
Add egg. Beat well and add flour, baking powder and milk.
Chill.
Roll 1/8-inch thick for a crisp cookie; not so thin for a soft cookie. Cut in shapes.
Bake in 350° oven for 12 to 15 minutes or until lightly brown around edges.
You can sprinkle sugar on cookies before baking or they can be iced with a powdered sugar icing using different colors.
recipes.text: Sugar Cookies. Cream shortening and sugar until well blended. Add egg. Beat well and add flour, baking powder and milk. Chill. Roll 1/8-inch thick for a crisp cookie; not so thin for a soft cookie. Cut in shapes. Bake in 350° oven for 12 to 15 minutes or until lightly brown around edges. You can sprinkle sugar on cookies before baking or they can be iced with a powdered sugar icing using different colors.

recipes.title: M.N.'S Favorite Soup
ingredients: 1 large can whole tomatoes, cut into pieces
directions: In large kettle, saute bacon until browned; drain fat.
Add sausage, onion, carrot and celery.
Saute until onion is tender. Add water, tomatoes and beans.
Bring to a boil.
Reduce heat, cover and simmer 45 minutes until beans are almost tender.
Stir in remaining ingredients.
Simmer, covered until done.
Discard bay leaf.
recipes.text: M.N.'S Favorite Soup. In large kettle, saute bacon until browned; drain fat. Add sausage, onion, carrot and celery. Saute until onion is tender. Add water, tomatoes and beans. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat, cover and simmer 45 minutes until beans are almost tender. Stir in remaining ingredients. Simmer, covered until done. Discard bay leaf.

recipes.title: Cherry Coconut Bars
directions: Heat oven to 350°.
With hands, mix flour, butter, confectioner's sugar until smooth.
Spread thin with fingers in 8-inch square pan (greased).
Bake 25 minutes.
Stir remaining ingredients into beaten eggs.
Spread over top of baked pastry. Bake about 25 minutes.
Cool.
Cut into bars or squares.
recipes.text: Cherry Coconut Bars. Heat oven to 350°. With hands, mix flour, butter, confectioner's sugar until smooth. Spread thin with fingers in 8-inch square pan (greased). Bake 25 minutes. Stir remaining ingredients into beaten eggs. Spread over top of baked pastry. Bake about 25 minutes. Cool. Cut into bars or squares.

recipes.title: Vinegar Pie
directions: Combine sugar and flour.
Add rest of ingredients and place in saucepan.
Cook until thick, then pour in pie crust.
Bake at 375° until crust is brown.
recipes.text: Vinegar Pie. Combine sugar and flour. Add rest of ingredients and place in saucepan. Cook until thick, then pour in pie crust. Bake at 375° until crust is brown.

recipes.title: Tuna Rice Roll
directions: Cook rice in water until tender.
Turn into a large bowl and cool slightly.
Break tuna into large chunks and add to rice.
Stir in 1/3 cup of the soup.
Prepare pie crust.
Roll out on floured surface to 14 x 11-inch oval.
Spoon tuna mixture down center third of pastry.
Bring sides up and over filling to meet.
Press long edges together and pinch seam tightly with fingers.
Pinch each end of roll tightly until filling is completely enclosed.
recipes.text: Tuna Rice Roll. Cook rice in water until tender. Turn into a large bowl and cool slightly. Break tuna into large chunks and add to rice. Stir in 1/3 cup of the soup. Prepare pie crust. Roll out on floured surface to 14 x 11-inch oval. Spoon tuna mixture down center third of pastry. Bring sides up and over filling to meet. Press long edges together and pinch seam tightly with fingers. Pinch each end of roll tightly until filling is completely enclosed.

recipes.title: Blackberry Or Raspberry Jam Cake
directions: Cream together 2/3 cup of butter and 1 1/2 cup sugar. Separate 3 egg yolks, reserving the whites.
Slightly beat the yolks and mix with 1 cup of jam; whip into creamed mixture.
Sift together flour, baking powder, soda, salt, ground cloves and cinnamon.
Add dry ingredients alternately with 1 cup sour milk. Beat the 3 egg whites and fold into the batter.
Add vanilla. Bake in 3 lined layer cake pans in 350° oven for 25 minutes or until done.
Test with a toothpick.
Cool and frost with cream cheese frosting or a vanilla frosting.
recipes.text: Blackberry Or Raspberry Jam Cake. Cream together 2/3 cup of butter and 1 1/2 cup sugar. Separate 3 egg yolks, reserving the whites. Slightly beat the yolks and mix with 1 cup of jam; whip into creamed mixture. Sift together flour, baking powder, soda, salt, ground cloves and cinnamon. Add dry ingredients alternately with 1 cup sour milk. Beat the 3 egg whites and fold into the batter. Add vanilla. Bake in 3 lined layer cake pans in 350° oven for 25 minutes or until done. Test with a toothpick. Cool and frost with cream cheese frosting or a vanilla frosting.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Bread
directions: Sift together dry ingredients.
Beat eggs, sugar, pumpkin, vanilla, oil and water.
Add flour mixture a little at a time. Mix well after each addition.
Pour into 2 well floured loaf pans. Bake at 325 degrees for 45 minutes to 1 hour.
recipes.text: Pumpkin Bread. Sift together dry ingredients. Beat eggs, sugar, pumpkin, vanilla, oil and water. Add flour mixture a little at a time. Mix well after each addition. Pour into 2 well floured loaf pans. Bake at 325 degrees for 45 minutes to 1 hour.

recipes.title: Ice Cream Sandwiches
directions: Mix half of cake mix with the egg, shortening and margarine. Mix well and then add second half of cake mix.
Roll out 1/4-inch thick on lightly floured surface.
Cut out with round cookie cutter or top of a 1/2 quart or quart canning bottle.
Prick with fork (like you see on store bought sandwiches).
Bake on ungreased cookie sheet at 375° for 6 minutes.
Fill with any flavor of ice cream and freeze in sandwich bags.
Makes approximately 12 to 18.
recipes.text: Ice Cream Sandwiches. Mix half of cake mix with the egg, shortening and margarine. Mix well and then add second half of cake mix. Roll out 1/4-inch thick on lightly floured surface. Cut out with round cookie cutter or top of a 1/2 quart or quart canning bottle. Prick with fork (like you see on store bought sandwiches). Bake on ungreased cookie sheet at 375° for 6 minutes. Fill with any flavor of ice cream and freeze in sandwich bags. Makes approximately 12 to 18.

recipes.title: Topsy Turvey
ingredients: any pie fruit filling (cherry or berry filling is best)
directions: Melt margarine.
Mix dry ingredients, except 1/2 cup sugar. Add margarine.
Pour into a casserole dish.
Add fruit on top and sprinkle with 1/2 cup sugar.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Topsy Turvey. Melt margarine. Mix dry ingredients, except 1/2 cup sugar. Add margarine. Pour into a casserole dish. Add fruit on top and sprinkle with 1/2 cup sugar. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Green Bean Casserole Deluxe
ingredients: 2 (16 oz.) pkg. frozen French or cut green beans
1 (10 3/4 oz.) can condensed cream of mushroom soup
1 (2.8 oz.) can French fried onion rings, divided
1 (3 oz.) jar Hormel Real Bacon Bits, divided
directions: Heat oven to 350°.
In a bowl, combine beans, soup, milk, 1/2 can of onions, 1/2 jar of Hormel Real Bacon Bits and pepper.
Pour into a 1 1/2-quart casserole.
Bake 30 minutes.
Top with remaining onions and Bacon bits.
Bake 5 minutes longer.
Serves 5.
recipes.text: Green Bean Casserole Deluxe. Heat oven to 350°. In a bowl, combine beans, soup, milk, 1/2 can of onions, 1/2 jar of Hormel Real Bacon Bits and pepper. Pour into a 1 1/2-quart casserole. Bake 30 minutes. Top with remaining onions and Bacon bits. Bake 5 minutes longer. Serves 5.

recipes.title: Strawberry Salad
directions: Dissolve gelatin in hot water.
Cool.
Add Seven-Up, strawberries, celery, pineapple and nuts.
Chill until firm. Yields 6 servings.
recipes.text: Strawberry Salad. Dissolve gelatin in hot water. Cool. Add Seven-Up, strawberries, celery, pineapple and nuts. Chill until firm. Yields 6 servings.

recipes.title: Jewish Rye Dill Dip
directions: Mix all ingredients well and set aside.
Scoop out a good sized hole in bread and put the dip in hole.
Break up scooped out bread and use to dip.
recipes.text: Jewish Rye Dill Dip. Mix all ingredients well and set aside. Scoop out a good sized hole in bread and put the dip in hole. Break up scooped out bread and use to dip.

recipes.title: Cranberry Salad
directions: Mix cranberries with sugar and marshmallows.
Let set overnight.
Add pineapple, apples, grapes and nuts.
Fold in small Cool Whip and chill.
recipes.text: Cranberry Salad. Mix cranberries with sugar and marshmallows. Let set overnight. Add pineapple, apples, grapes and nuts. Fold in small Cool Whip and chill.

recipes.title: Stuffed Manicotti
directions: Cook shells as directed on the package and drain.
In skillet, brown ground beef and green peppers.
Drain well.
Cool. Add salt, cheese, cottage cheese and spinach.
Mix well.
Stuff shells with mixture.
Place in a greased baking dish. Pour in spaghetti sauce. Cover with additional Mozzarella cheese and Parmesan cheese. Bake at 375° for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Stuffed Manicotti. Cook shells as directed on the package and drain. In skillet, brown ground beef and green peppers. Drain well. Cool. Add salt, cheese, cottage cheese and spinach. Mix well. Stuff shells with mixture. Place in a greased baking dish. Pour in spaghetti sauce. Cover with additional Mozzarella cheese and Parmesan cheese. Bake at 375° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Quick And Easy Fruit Cobbler
ingredients: 1 (23 oz.) can Comstock peach or apple pie filling
directions: Heat oven to 400°.
Spoon peach (or apple) filling into 8 or 9-inch square pan.
Stir together Bisquick, milk, sugar and margarine with fork until blended.
Drop by spoonfuls on top of filling.
Bake 20 to 25 minutes until golden brown.
Serve warm. Makes 6 servings.
recipes.text: Quick And Easy Fruit Cobbler. Heat oven to 400°. Spoon peach (or apple) filling into 8 or 9-inch square pan. Stir together Bisquick, milk, sugar and margarine with fork until blended. Drop by spoonfuls on top of filling. Bake 20 to 25 minutes until golden brown. Serve warm. Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Candy Bar Pie
ingredients: 8 oz. carton frozen whipped topping, thawed
directions: In a small mixing bowl, beat the cream cheese until smooth. Fold in whipped topping. Crush the candy bars; fold 1 cup into the cream cheese mixture. Spoon into crust. Sprinkle with remaining candy bar crumbs. Refrigerate for 2 to 4 hours before slicing. Serves 6 or 8.
