recipes.text: Candy Bar Pie. In a small mixing bowl, beat the cream cheese until smooth. Fold in whipped topping. Crush the candy bars; fold 1 cup into the cream cheese mixture. Spoon into crust. Sprinkle with remaining candy bar crumbs. Refrigerate for 2 to 4 hours before slicing. Serves 6 or 8.

recipes.title: Spinach Casserole
directions: Cook spinach according to directions and drain.
Place spinach and eggs in a shallow casserole dish and toss together.
Fry bacon, crumble and sprinkle over spinach.
Reserve 3 tablespoons bacon grease and saute onions in it until tender.
Drain and layer over spinach and bacon.
Mix together sour cream and grated cheese.
Spread over casserole.
Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes or until bubbly.
recipes.text: Spinach Casserole. Cook spinach according to directions and drain. Place spinach and eggs in a shallow casserole dish and toss together. Fry bacon, crumble and sprinkle over spinach. Reserve 3 tablespoons bacon grease and saute onions in it until tender. Drain and layer over spinach and bacon. Mix together sour cream and grated cheese. Spread over casserole. Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes or until bubbly.

recipes.title: Carrot Sandwich Filling
ingredients: 1/2 c. pecans, finely chopped (I usually use a few more)
directions: Mix all ingredients and it is best made the night before using, in order for garlic to season well.
Use garlic freely.
recipes.text: Carrot Sandwich Filling. Mix all ingredients and it is best made the night before using, in order for garlic to season well. Use garlic freely.

recipes.title: Fried Rice
directions: Cook rice (preferably the day before and keep in fridge overnight; otherwise, allow cooked rice to cool).
Finely slice bacon and chop onion and green pepper. Set aside.
recipes.text: Fried Rice. Cook rice (preferably the day before and keep in fridge overnight; otherwise, allow cooked rice to cool). Finely slice bacon and chop onion and green pepper. Set aside.

recipes.title: Four Bean Casserole
directions: Cook together bacon, onions, vinegar, brown sugar and mustard. Simmer for 20 minutes.
Add all beans.
Bake in a large casserole dish for 2 hours at 325°.
Serves 10 to 12 people.
recipes.text: Four Bean Casserole. Cook together bacon, onions, vinegar, brown sugar and mustard. Simmer for 20 minutes. Add all beans. Bake in a large casserole dish for 2 hours at 325°. Serves 10 to 12 people.

recipes.title: Pork Tenderloins
directions: Saute thinly sliced pork in 3 tablespoons olive oil.
Remove. Saute onions and pepper.
Add spices.
Mix tomatoes in with the spices, onions and pepper.
Put pork in this sauce and simmer about 20 or so minutes.
Pour over fresh angel hair pasta. Delicious!!!!
recipes.text: Pork Tenderloins. Saute thinly sliced pork in 3 tablespoons olive oil. Remove. Saute onions and pepper. Add spices. Mix tomatoes in with the spices, onions and pepper. Put pork in this sauce and simmer about 20 or so minutes. Pour over fresh angel hair pasta. Delicious!!!!

recipes.title: Jogging In A Jug
ingredients: 6 cans water (use can the juice came in)
directions: Combine and drink 2 ounces twice a day.
recipes.text: Jogging In A Jug. Combine and drink 2 ounces twice a day.

recipes.title: Breakfast Wellington
ingredients: 1 lb. pork sausage or your choice
1 c. shredded Cheddar or Swiss cheese
directions: Cook sausage in medium skillet; drain well.
Add broccoli, cheese, onion, sour cream and pepper.
Mix well.
Simmer 10 minutes.
Separate dough into 4 long rectangles on ungreased cookie sheet.
Overlap long sides of rectangles.
Spoon meat mixture down center of rectangle.
Fold strips over filling.
Mix egg with 1 tablespoon of water; brush over dough.
Sprinkle with sesame seed.
Bake at 375° for 18 to 22 minutes, until deep golden brown.
recipes.text: Breakfast Wellington. Cook sausage in medium skillet; drain well. Add broccoli, cheese, onion, sour cream and pepper. Mix well. Simmer 10 minutes. Separate dough into 4 long rectangles on ungreased cookie sheet. Overlap long sides of rectangles. Spoon meat mixture down center of rectangle. Fold strips over filling. Mix egg with 1 tablespoon of water; brush over dough. Sprinkle with sesame seed. Bake at 375° for 18 to 22 minutes, until deep golden brown.

recipes.title: Fruit Salad
ingredients: 1 gal. can mixed fruit, drain well
directions: Mix well; chill and serve.
recipes.text: Fruit Salad. Mix well; chill and serve.

recipes.title: Granny'S Banana Pudding
ingredients: 1 (3.5 oz.) pkg. instant vanilla pudding mix
directions: Combine cream cheese and 1/2 cup milk, mixing at medium speed until well blended.
Add remaining milk and pudding mix; beat at low speed 1 minute.
Layer 1/3 of pudding mix, half of wafers and half of bananas in 1 1/2-quart serving bowl; repeat layers.
Top with remaining pudding.
Cover and chill.
Garnish with additional banana slices and wafers.
recipes.text: Granny'S Banana Pudding. Combine cream cheese and 1/2 cup milk, mixing at medium speed until well blended. Add remaining milk and pudding mix; beat at low speed 1 minute. Layer 1/3 of pudding mix, half of wafers and half of bananas in 1 1/2-quart serving bowl; repeat layers. Top with remaining pudding. Cover and chill. Garnish with additional banana slices and wafers.

recipes.title: Butter Carrot Sticks With Parsley
directions: About 30 minutes before serving, clean and cut carrots into carrot sticks, then cut sticks two inches long.
In a 1 1/2-quart saucepan over high heat and 1 inch of salted water, heat carrots to a boil.
Reduce heat to low, cover and cook 10 minutes or until tender.
Drain and stir in sugar, parsley and margarine.
Mix well. Makes 4 servings.
recipes.text: Butter Carrot Sticks With Parsley. About 30 minutes before serving, clean and cut carrots into carrot sticks, then cut sticks two inches long. In a 1 1/2-quart saucepan over high heat and 1 inch of salted water, heat carrots to a boil. Reduce heat to low, cover and cook 10 minutes or until tender. Drain and stir in sugar, parsley and margarine. Mix well. Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: Pollo Criollo Rapido
ingredients: 1 lb. can tomato wedges with juice, drained
directions: Place cooked rice in a lightly greased 8-cup baking dish. Saute green pepper, onion, celery and garlic in butter until tender in a large saucepan. Stir in remaining ingredients except cheese. Pour mixture over rice, spreading evenly. Sprinkle with cheese. Cover and bake in moderate oven (350°) for 30 minutes until bubbly hot. Serves 4.
recipes.text: Pollo Criollo Rapido. Place cooked rice in a lightly greased 8-cup baking dish. Saute green pepper, onion, celery and garlic in butter until tender in a large saucepan. Stir in remaining ingredients except cheese. Pour mixture over rice, spreading evenly. Sprinkle with cheese. Cover and bake in moderate oven (350°) for 30 minutes until bubbly hot. Serves 4.

recipes.title: Pound Cake
directions: Cream butter and sugar.
Add eggs, one at a time.
Combine flour and baking powder.
Combine milk, vanilla, almond and sherry.
Alternate, adding flour and milk mixture.
Pour into tube pan.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour and 20 minutes.
recipes.text: Pound Cake. Cream butter and sugar. Add eggs, one at a time. Combine flour and baking powder. Combine milk, vanilla, almond and sherry. Alternate, adding flour and milk mixture. Pour into tube pan. Bake at 350° for 1 hour and 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Mexican Lasagna
ingredients: Monterey Jack or Colby cheese, grated
directions: *Omit if taco seasoning has lots of onion.
recipes.text: Mexican Lasagna. *Omit if taco seasoning has lots of onion.

recipes.title: Grape-Nuts Bread
directions: Combine Grape-Nuts and sour milk and let stand 1 hour.
Add baking soda and stir.
Combine and add the eggs and sugar.
Combine and add the flour and salt.
Bake at 375° for about 1 hour or until knife comes out clean.
Makes 2 loaves.
recipes.text: Grape-Nuts Bread. Combine Grape-Nuts and sour milk and let stand 1 hour. Add baking soda and stir. Combine and add the eggs and sugar. Combine and add the flour and salt. Bake at 375° for about 1 hour or until knife comes out clean. Makes 2 loaves.

recipes.title: Grandma'S Mayonnaise Cake
directions: Mix all ingredients together in a large mixing bowl.
Bake in greased and floured cake pans (use two 8-inch pans or one 9 x 13-inch pan) for 30 minutes at 350°.
recipes.text: Grandma'S Mayonnaise Cake. Mix all ingredients together in a large mixing bowl. Bake in greased and floured cake pans (use two 8-inch pans or one 9 x 13-inch pan) for 30 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Honey Apple Muffins
ingredients: 1 large cored, pared and finely chopped apple
directions: In a bowl, combine flour, baking powder, cinnamon, salt and sugar.
In another bowl, combine honey, egg, milk and oil.
Add egg mixture to flour mixture.
Blend in apple.
Grease 2 muffin tins liberally.
Pour in lumpy batter to fill 2/3 of each cup. Bake at 375° for 20 to 25 minutes.
Remove tins to a rack; let stand for 5 minutes.
Use a greased knife to cut around each cup. Tap to remove muffins.
Sprinkle with confectioners sugar.
recipes.text: Honey Apple Muffins. In a bowl, combine flour, baking powder, cinnamon, salt and sugar. In another bowl, combine honey, egg, milk and oil. Add egg mixture to flour mixture. Blend in apple. Grease 2 muffin tins liberally. Pour in lumpy batter to fill 2/3 of each cup. Bake at 375° for 20 to 25 minutes. Remove tins to a rack; let stand for 5 minutes. Use a greased knife to cut around each cup. Tap to remove muffins. Sprinkle with confectioners sugar.

recipes.title: Cajun Shrimp Pasta
directions: Saute 3 cloves garlic in olive oil (about 1/4 cup).
Add seasonings.
Add tomatoes.
Cook over medium heat for about 10 minutes.
Add shrimp and beer.
Simmer until shrimp is cooked. Add butter (1 1/2 sticks) until melted.
Pour sauce over cooked pasta (may use rice instead).
recipes.text: Cajun Shrimp Pasta. Saute 3 cloves garlic in olive oil (about 1/4 cup). Add seasonings. Add tomatoes. Cook over medium heat for about 10 minutes. Add shrimp and beer. Simmer until shrimp is cooked. Add butter (1 1/2 sticks) until melted. Pour sauce over cooked pasta (may use rice instead).

recipes.title: French Stuffed Mushrooms
ingredients: 80 small, fresh raw mushrooms of uniform size
1 Tbsp. chopped scallions or green onions
directions: Wipe mushrooms dry with damp cloth.
Remove stems and mince. Saute stems and scallions in butter 2 to 3 minutes, stirring.
Add cream, sherry, salt and pepper.
Cook until thickens, about 5 to 7 minutes.
Fill mushroom caps with mixture.
Set aside ready to broil.
Place under broiler just enough to slightly brown.
recipes.text: French Stuffed Mushrooms. Wipe mushrooms dry with damp cloth. Remove stems and mince. Saute stems and scallions in butter 2 to 3 minutes, stirring. Add cream, sherry, salt and pepper. Cook until thickens, about 5 to 7 minutes. Fill mushroom caps with mixture. Set aside ready to broil. Place under broiler just enough to slightly brown.

recipes.title: Bernice Heugatter'S Very Good Chocolate Pie
directions: Cook all ingredients together until thick, then add margarine and vanilla.
Mix well.
Pour into 9-inch baked crust.
recipes.text: Bernice Heugatter'S Very Good Chocolate Pie. Cook all ingredients together until thick, then add margarine and vanilla. Mix well. Pour into 9-inch baked crust.

recipes.title: Fried Bananas
directions: Peel bananas and cut in half and then lengthwise.
Dip in beaten egg.
Roll in cracker crumbs.
Fry in shallow cooking oil. When brown, turn over and brown on other side.
recipes.text: Fried Bananas. Peel bananas and cut in half and then lengthwise. Dip in beaten egg. Roll in cracker crumbs. Fry in shallow cooking oil. When brown, turn over and brown on other side.

recipes.title: Pig Eaten Cake
ingredients: 1 (18 oz.) box Duncan Hines Golden Butter Recipe cake mix
1 (8 oz.) can mandarin oranges with juice
directions: Combine cake mix, mandarin oranges, eggs and oil. Beat on medium speed for 4 minutes. Pour into three greased layer cake pans or 1 oblong cake pan. Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes.
recipes.text: Pig Eaten Cake. Combine cake mix, mandarin oranges, eggs and oil. Beat on medium speed for 4 minutes. Pour into three greased layer cake pans or 1 oblong cake pan. Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Bean Casserole
directions: Fry bacon; remove from pan. Add to grease the brown sugar, vinegar and onions.
Simmer 20 minutes.
recipes.text: Bean Casserole. Fry bacon; remove from pan. Add to grease the brown sugar, vinegar and onions. Simmer 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Mrs. Barrett'S Sugar Cookies
directions: Preheat oven to 350°.
Mix all ingredients together until smooth.
Grease cookie sheets or use parchment paper.
Bake 8 to 10 minutes, until lightly browned.
Cookies are very light and will melt in your mouth.
recipes.text: Mrs. Barrett'S Sugar Cookies. Preheat oven to 350°. Mix all ingredients together until smooth. Grease cookie sheets or use parchment paper. Bake 8 to 10 minutes, until lightly browned. Cookies are very light and will melt in your mouth.

recipes.title: Carbonara Ala Diane
directions: Cook spaghetti, drain and set aside.
Slice onions and mushrooms.
Cut the pound of bacon in half then in half again; set aside.
Saute the onions and mushrooms in margarine, remove and set aside.
In same frying pan cook bacon until almost done (not crisp).
Drain bacon grease.
Add onions and mushrooms to bacon. Add oregano, spaghetti, half and half and stir over medium heat. Add Parmesan cheese.
Mix well.
Cook 1 to 2 minutes and remove. Serve with a salad and garlic bread.
recipes.text: Carbonara Ala Diane. Cook spaghetti, drain and set aside. Slice onions and mushrooms. Cut the pound of bacon in half then in half again; set aside. Saute the onions and mushrooms in margarine, remove and set aside. In same frying pan cook bacon until almost done (not crisp). Drain bacon grease. Add onions and mushrooms to bacon. Add oregano, spaghetti, half and half and stir over medium heat. Add Parmesan cheese. Mix well. Cook 1 to 2 minutes and remove. Serve with a salad and garlic bread.

recipes.title: Country Ribs And Sauerkraut
ingredients: 2 (2 lb.) jars sauerkraut, drained and rinsed
directions: Heat oil and butter in Dutch oven over medium heat.
Brown ribs.
Add garlic and cook with ribs just until golden.
Remove ribs.
Saute red onion in drippings until tender.
Add caraway seed, sauerkraut, sweet red pepper, broth, salt and pepper to taste and brown sugar.
Bring to boil.
Remove from stove and top with apples and ribs.
Cover and bake at 350° for 2 to 3 hours or until pork is tender.
Stir in carrots last 10 minutes of baking. Adjust seasonings to taste.
Makes about 6 servings.
recipes.text: Country Ribs And Sauerkraut. Heat oil and butter in Dutch oven over medium heat. Brown ribs. Add garlic and cook with ribs just until golden. Remove ribs. Saute red onion in drippings until tender. Add caraway seed, sauerkraut, sweet red pepper, broth, salt and pepper to taste and brown sugar. Bring to boil. Remove from stove and top with apples and ribs. Cover and bake at 350° for 2 to 3 hours or until pork is tender. Stir in carrots last 10 minutes of baking. Adjust seasonings to taste. Makes about 6 servings.

recipes.title: Barbecue Meat Balls
directions: Mix and shape into 1-inch balls.
Bake at 350° for 12 to 15 minutes on broiler pan.
recipes.text: Barbecue Meat Balls. Mix and shape into 1-inch balls. Bake at 350° for 12 to 15 minutes on broiler pan.

recipes.title: Enchiladas
directions: Make chili of your choice.
Remove some of the chili meat from the pot with a slotted spoon.
Chop onion; set aside.
Grate American cheese; set aside.
Fill a 2-quart saucepan about 3/4 full of water, let come to a boil.
Place tortillas, one at a time, in the hot water for 1 second.
Keep water very hot.
recipes.text: Enchiladas. Make chili of your choice. Remove some of the chili meat from the pot with a slotted spoon. Chop onion; set aside. Grate American cheese; set aside. Fill a 2-quart saucepan about 3/4 full of water, let come to a boil. Place tortillas, one at a time, in the hot water for 1 second. Keep water very hot.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Bread
directions: Cream sugar and oil; add eggs and mix well after each.
Add pumpkin; mix well.
Sift together dry ingredients; add water and mix all together.
Pour into two well-greased and floured 9 x 5-inch loaf pans.
Bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours or until toothpick comes out clean.
Let stand 10 minutes.
Remove from pan to cool.
recipes.text: Pumpkin Bread. Cream sugar and oil; add eggs and mix well after each. Add pumpkin; mix well. Sift together dry ingredients; add water and mix all together. Pour into two well-greased and floured 9 x 5-inch loaf pans. Bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours or until toothpick comes out clean. Let stand 10 minutes. Remove from pan to cool.

recipes.title: Cole Slaw
directions: Shred cabbage and mince peppers.
recipes.text: Cole Slaw. Shred cabbage and mince peppers.

recipes.title: The Mayors Salad
directions: Bring soup and water to boil, stirring constantly.
Add dry jello mix, cream cheese and mayonnaise.
Beat until smooth and well mixed.
Fold in celery, green peppers and onions.
Pour into 8-inch square pan and chill 3 to 4 hours before serving.
recipes.text: The Mayors Salad. Bring soup and water to boil, stirring constantly. Add dry jello mix, cream cheese and mayonnaise. Beat until smooth and well mixed. Fold in celery, green peppers and onions. Pour into 8-inch square pan and chill 3 to 4 hours before serving.

recipes.title: Quick And Easy Lasagna
directions: Brown meat.
Add onion and cook until tender.
Stir in tomato paste, tomato sauce, water, seasonings and Parmesan cheese. Simmer for 30 minutes.
In a 13 x 9-inch baking dish, layer noodles, meat sauce and cheese.
Repeat layers.
Bake at 350° for about 20 minutes or until cheeses are completely melted.
recipes.text: Quick And Easy Lasagna. Brown meat. Add onion and cook until tender. Stir in tomato paste, tomato sauce, water, seasonings and Parmesan cheese. Simmer for 30 minutes. In a 13 x 9-inch baking dish, layer noodles, meat sauce and cheese. Repeat layers. Bake at 350° for about 20 minutes or until cheeses are completely melted.

recipes.title: Corn Dressing
ingredients: 1 pkg. Pepperidge Farm herb stuffing mix (large bag)
directions: Saute onion and celery in butter until tender.
In a large bowl, mix remaining ingredients well.
Add onion and celery. Place in 13 x 9-inch pan or dish (you might want to spray with Pam).
You can also dribble butter or turkey broth over top.
Bake at 375° for 30 to 45 minutes or until desired doneness.
recipes.text: Corn Dressing. Saute onion and celery in butter until tender. In a large bowl, mix remaining ingredients well. Add onion and celery. Place in 13 x 9-inch pan or dish (you might want to spray with Pam). You can also dribble butter or turkey broth over top. Bake at 375° for 30 to 45 minutes or until desired doneness.

recipes.title: Chicken And Stove Top Dressing Casserole
directions: Place chicken in casserole dish.
Layer cheese over chicken. Spread cream of chicken soup evenly over cheese.
In separate bowl, mix the flavor packet with the dressing.
Sprinkle the dry dressing and flavoring over casserole.
Spray top of dressing with butter several times while baking.
Bake at 325° for 1 hour and 15 minutes. Let stand 5 minutes before serving.
recipes.text: Chicken And Stove Top Dressing Casserole. Place chicken in casserole dish. Layer cheese over chicken. Spread cream of chicken soup evenly over cheese. In separate bowl, mix the flavor packet with the dressing. Sprinkle the dry dressing and flavoring over casserole. Spray top of dressing with butter several times while baking. Bake at 325° for 1 hour and 15 minutes. Let stand 5 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Wheat Blueberry Pancakes
directions: Blend dry ingredients together.
Stir in eggs, milk, blueberries and butter.
Mix batter until lumps are gone.
Put on griddle 1/4 cup of batter.
Cook until browned on each side. Makes 20 pancakes.
recipes.text: Wheat Blueberry Pancakes. Blend dry ingredients together. Stir in eggs, milk, blueberries and butter. Mix batter until lumps are gone. Put on griddle 1/4 cup of batter. Cook until browned on each side. Makes 20 pancakes.

recipes.title: Cinnamon Swirl Raisin Bread
directions: Heat oven to 350°.
Mix 3 cups flour, 1/2 cup sugar, salt and yeast in large bowl.
Heat water and oil until very warm (120° to 130°); stir into flour mixture.
Stir in eggs.
Beat until smooth. Mix in enough remaining flour to make dough easy to handle.
Turn dough onto lightly floured surface.
Gently roll in flour to coat. Knead 8 to 10 times until smooth.
Place in greased bowl; turn greased side up.
Cover and let rise in warm place 1 hour or doubled in size.
Grease 2 loaf pans (9 x 5 x 3).
Punch dough down; divide in half.
Knead 1/2 cup raisins into each half.
Roll out 18 x 9-inches; brush 1 tablespoon oil over rectangles.	Mix 1/2 cup sugar and the cinnamon.
Sprinkle each rectangle with 1/2 of mixture.
Roll up each rectangle, beginning at 9-inch side. Pinch edge of dough into roll to seal.
Press ends with edge of hand to seal.
Fold ends under loaf. Place loaves, seam side down in pans.
Brush oil over loaves. Cover, let rise in warm place about 1 hour or until double.
Move oven rack to lowest position. Bake 30 to 35 minutes or until loaves are deep golden brown or sounds hollow when tapped.	Remove from pans to wire rack to cool. Brush butter over loaves.
recipes.text: Cinnamon Swirl Raisin Bread. Heat oven to 350°. Mix 3 cups flour, 1/2 cup sugar, salt and yeast in large bowl. Heat water and oil until very warm (120° to 130°); stir into flour mixture. Stir in eggs. Beat until smooth. Mix in enough remaining flour to make dough easy to handle. Turn dough onto lightly floured surface. Gently roll in flour to coat. Knead 8 to 10 times until smooth. Place in greased bowl; turn greased side up. Cover and let rise in warm place 1 hour or doubled in size. Grease 2 loaf pans (9 x 5 x 3). Punch dough down; divide in half. Knead 1/2 cup raisins into each half. Roll out 18 x 9-inches; brush 1 tablespoon oil over rectangles.	Mix 1/2 cup sugar and the cinnamon. Sprinkle each rectangle with 1/2 of mixture. Roll up each rectangle, beginning at 9-inch side. Pinch edge of dough into roll to seal. Press ends with edge of hand to seal. Fold ends under loaf. Place loaves, seam side down in pans. Brush oil over loaves. Cover, let rise in warm place about 1 hour or until double. Move oven rack to lowest position. Bake 30 to 35 minutes or until loaves are deep golden brown or sounds hollow when tapped.	Remove from pans to wire rack to cool. Brush butter over loaves.

recipes.title: Oyster Stew
directions: Bring 1 cup of the oyster liquor to a boil and when it has cooked for 5 minutes, skim off the top, which will be foamy.
Add the cream, butter and seasonings to taste.
Cook the oysters in the other cup of liquor until the edges curl (about 5 minutes). Strain and add to the cream.
Serve immediately.
recipes.text: Oyster Stew. Bring 1 cup of the oyster liquor to a boil and when it has cooked for 5 minutes, skim off the top, which will be foamy. Add the cream, butter and seasonings to taste. Cook the oysters in the other cup of liquor until the edges curl (about 5 minutes). Strain and add to the cream. Serve immediately.

recipes.title: Olde Fashioned Homemade Burgers
ingredients: 1/2 tsp. Fines Herbs or 1/4 tsp. each parsley, tarragon and chives
1 Tbsp. Lea and Perrin's or Worcestershire Sauce
directions: Mix all ingredients together.
Form into patties and fry in skillet with Pam or grill outdoors.
Place on toasted hamburger bun with your favorite condiments.
recipes.text: Olde Fashioned Homemade Burgers. Mix all ingredients together. Form into patties and fry in skillet with Pam or grill outdoors. Place on toasted hamburger bun with your favorite condiments.

recipes.title: Hanky Pankies
directions: Brown meats and drain well.
Add diced cheese and remaining ingredients.
Spread on party rye bread and freeze until firm. Put in plastic bags and keep in freezer.
When needed, broil until bubbly or bake 10 minutes at 400°.
recipes.text: Hanky Pankies. Brown meats and drain well. Add diced cheese and remaining ingredients. Spread on party rye bread and freeze until firm. Put in plastic bags and keep in freezer. When needed, broil until bubbly or bake 10 minutes at 400°.

recipes.title: Zesty Italian Chicken
ingredients: 1 large bottle fat-free Zesty Italian dressing (Kraft)
directions: Place chicken in a medium size bowl and pour the large bottle of dressing over the chicken.
Marinate overnight or at least 2 hours before cooking.
recipes.text: Zesty Italian Chicken. Place chicken in a medium size bowl and pour the large bottle of dressing over the chicken. Marinate overnight or at least 2 hours before cooking.

recipes.title: Irish Potatoes
directions: Mix cream cheese and butter.
Add vanilla to mix.
Gradually add sugar.
Blend until smooth.
Add coconut.
Put in refrigerator for 2 hours.
Roll in cinnamon after forming small balls.
recipes.text: Irish Potatoes. Mix cream cheese and butter. Add vanilla to mix. Gradually add sugar. Blend until smooth. Add coconut. Put in refrigerator for 2 hours. Roll in cinnamon after forming small balls.

recipes.title: Marinade(For Chicken Parts Or Steak)
ingredients: 1/4 c. extra virgin olive oil (no sleezy oil, please)
directions: Marinate chicken pieces or steak for 2 to 3 days in refrigerator (no kiddin').
Cook (broil or bake) as usual.
recipes.text: Marinade(For Chicken Parts Or Steak). Marinate chicken pieces or steak for 2 to 3 days in refrigerator (no kiddin'). Cook (broil or bake) as usual.

recipes.title: Papa'S Oyster Stew
directions: Melt butter in heavy saucepan. Add drained oysters and heat until edges curl. Add milk, salt and pepper.
Heat but do not boil. Sprinkle each serving with paprika.
recipes.text: Papa'S Oyster Stew. Melt butter in heavy saucepan. Add drained oysters and heat until edges curl. Add milk, salt and pepper. Heat but do not boil. Sprinkle each serving with paprika.

recipes.title: Broccoli Casserole
directions: Cook broccoli and drain; mix soup and milk together.
Pour over broccoli.
Sprinkle cheese over this.
Mix Bisquick with margarine.
Sprinkle over whole mixture.
Cook at 400° until Bisquick is brown.
recipes.text: Broccoli Casserole. Cook broccoli and drain; mix soup and milk together. Pour over broccoli. Sprinkle cheese over this. Mix Bisquick with margarine. Sprinkle over whole mixture. Cook at 400° until Bisquick is brown.

recipes.title: Coconut Cake
directions: Mix all together. Makes 3 layers.
recipes.text: Coconut Cake. Mix all together. Makes 3 layers.

recipes.title: Katie Schaffer'S Corn Bread
directions: Heat oven to 400°.
Grease 8 or 9-inch baking pan.
Combine dry ingredients.
Stir in milk, oil and egg, mixing just until dry ingredients are moistened.
Pour batter into prepared pan.
Bake 20 to 25 minutes or until light golden brown and wooden pick inserted near center comes out clear.
To make this taste more like Grandma Schaffer's, bake in a preheated cast-iron skillet. Grandma made her corn bread on top of the stove using a preheated omelet pan (low flame 10 minutes each side).
Serve warm with sorghum for a down home treat in the morning.
recipes.text: Katie Schaffer'S Corn Bread. Heat oven to 400°. Grease 8 or 9-inch baking pan. Combine dry ingredients. Stir in milk, oil and egg, mixing just until dry ingredients are moistened. Pour batter into prepared pan. Bake 20 to 25 minutes or until light golden brown and wooden pick inserted near center comes out clear. To make this taste more like Grandma Schaffer's, bake in a preheated cast-iron skillet. Grandma made her corn bread on top of the stove using a preheated omelet pan (low flame 10 minutes each side). Serve warm with sorghum for a down home treat in the morning.

recipes.title: Low-Fat French Fried Potatoes
directions: Wash potatoes and slice into thin wedges.
Mix ingredients and add half of mixture to potatoes.
Place in oblong flat baking dish. Bake 45 minutes at 375°.
Baste occasionally with remaining liquid.
Makes about 4 servings.
recipes.text: Low-Fat French Fried Potatoes. Wash potatoes and slice into thin wedges. Mix ingredients and add half of mixture to potatoes. Place in oblong flat baking dish. Bake 45 minutes at 375°. Baste occasionally with remaining liquid. Makes about 4 servings.

recipes.title: Miniature Cheese Onion Loaves
directions: Heat oven to 375°.
Grease bread pans (2 small or 1 large). Cook green onions in butter; set aside.
In large bowl, mix flour with baking powder, mustard, cheese and salt.
Add onions, milk and eggs.
Stir until flour is moistened.
Pour into pans and bake 45 to 50 minutes.
Cool in pan.
Freezes well.
Preheat in a 375° oven to serve.
recipes.text: Miniature Cheese Onion Loaves. Heat oven to 375°. Grease bread pans (2 small or 1 large). Cook green onions in butter; set aside. In large bowl, mix flour with baking powder, mustard, cheese and salt. Add onions, milk and eggs. Stir until flour is moistened. Pour into pans and bake 45 to 50 minutes. Cool in pan. Freezes well. Preheat in a 375° oven to serve.

recipes.title: Fresh Apple Cake With Butterscotch Chips
directions: Mix apples, sugar and eggs together.
Add oil, nuts, flour, baking powder, cinnamon and salt.
Mix until well blended, then add butterscotch chips.
Bake in 13 x 9-inch pan for 1 hour at 350°.
recipes.text: Fresh Apple Cake With Butterscotch Chips. Mix apples, sugar and eggs together. Add oil, nuts, flour, baking powder, cinnamon and salt. Mix until well blended, then add butterscotch chips. Bake in 13 x 9-inch pan for 1 hour at 350°.

recipes.title: Fruit Cobbler
directions: Put fruit, 1 cup sugar and 1 tablespoon flour in pan; dot with butter.
Take egg, sugar and shortening; mix.
Add 1/2 cup milk, alternating with flour, baking powder and salt; blend well.
Pour over fruit.
Bake at 350° for 1/2 hour, or until done.
recipes.text: Fruit Cobbler. Put fruit, 1 cup sugar and 1 tablespoon flour in pan; dot with butter. Take egg, sugar and shortening; mix. Add 1/2 cup milk, alternating with flour, baking powder and salt; blend well. Pour over fruit. Bake at 350° for 1/2 hour, or until done.

recipes.title: Baked Macaroni
directions: Boil macaroni until tender.
Drain thoroughly.
Stir in butter and egg.
Mix mustard with salt and 1 tablespoon hot water and add to milk.
Add cheese to macaroni, leaving enough to sprinkle on top.
Pour macaroni into buttered casserole.
Add milk.
Sprinkle with cheese.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes or until top is crispy.
recipes.text: Baked Macaroni. Boil macaroni until tender. Drain thoroughly. Stir in butter and egg. Mix mustard with salt and 1 tablespoon hot water and add to milk. Add cheese to macaroni, leaving enough to sprinkle on top. Pour macaroni into buttered casserole. Add milk. Sprinkle with cheese. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes or until top is crispy.

recipes.title: Tostado Soup
directions: Brown ground beef and onion.
Add Ro-Tel, tomato sauce, water and picante sauce.
Let simmer.
Serve over chips.
Top with cheese and sour cream.
recipes.text: Tostado Soup. Brown ground beef and onion. Add Ro-Tel, tomato sauce, water and picante sauce. Let simmer. Serve over chips. Top with cheese and sour cream.

recipes.title: Beef And Macaroni
directions: Brown ground beef and chopped onions.
Pour cooked macaroni over meat.
Add ketchup, salt and pepper.
Mix together well. Stir in soup.
Place in casserole dish and top with grated cheese. Place in a 450° oven until cheese melts.
recipes.text: Beef And Macaroni. Brown ground beef and chopped onions. Pour cooked macaroni over meat. Add ketchup, salt and pepper. Mix together well. Stir in soup. Place in casserole dish and top with grated cheese. Place in a 450° oven until cheese melts.

recipes.title: Wilted Leaf Lettuce
directions: Cook bacon until crisp.
Save 3 tablespoons grease in skillet and combine with vinegar, water, sugar and salt.
Heat to boiling and stir 2 minutes.
Combine lettuce, onion and crumbled bacon. Pour hot liquid over greens and mix.
Garnish with chopped hard-cooked eggs.
recipes.text: Wilted Leaf Lettuce. Cook bacon until crisp. Save 3 tablespoons grease in skillet and combine with vinegar, water, sugar and salt. Heat to boiling and stir 2 minutes. Combine lettuce, onion and crumbled bacon. Pour hot liquid over greens and mix. Garnish with chopped hard-cooked eggs.

recipes.title: Baked Corn Casserole
directions: Mix first 4 ingredients.
Pour into a greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan.
Cover with sour cream (thin with 1 tablespoon milk if it doesn't spread easily).
Layer the onion and add layer of cheese.
Bake at 350° for 35 minutes.
Cool 20 minutes before cutting.
recipes.text: Baked Corn Casserole. Mix first 4 ingredients. Pour into a greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan. Cover with sour cream (thin with 1 tablespoon milk if it doesn't spread easily). Layer the onion and add layer of cheese. Bake at 350° for 35 minutes. Cool 20 minutes before cutting.

recipes.title: Peppercorn Chicken Breasts
ingredients: 4 large chicken breast halves, skinned and boned
directions: Place chicken between sheets of plastic wrap.
Pound with a mallet to about 1/4 inch thick.
Sprinkle with peppercorns.
Heat a heavy skillet; add butter and chicken.
Cook, turning once, until chicken is done, about 5 minutes.
Remove chicken and keep warm.
recipes.text: Peppercorn Chicken Breasts. Place chicken between sheets of plastic wrap. Pound with a mallet to about 1/4 inch thick. Sprinkle with peppercorns. Heat a heavy skillet; add butter and chicken. Cook, turning once, until chicken is done, about 5 minutes. Remove chicken and keep warm.

recipes.title: Mom'S Cake Filling(Pineapple)
directions: Mix all together and cook in saucepan until thick.
Pour over cake while hot.
Cook cake in 9 x 13-inch pan.
Be sure to take the batter out before you put the cake in to bake.
recipes.text: Mom'S Cake Filling(Pineapple). Mix all together and cook in saucepan until thick. Pour over cake while hot. Cook cake in 9 x 13-inch pan. Be sure to take the batter out before you put the cake in to bake.

recipes.title: Zucchini Cake
ingredients: 1/2 c. plus 2 Tbsp. orange juice, divided
directions: Cream the butter and sugar.
Beat in eggs and vanilla.
Stir in zucchini and 1 tablespoon grated orange peel. Stir dry ingredients together.
Alternately stir in the flour mixture with 1/2 cup orange juice until blended.
Pour into a
greased and floured Bundt pan.
Bake at 350° for 55 to 65 minutes or until a toothpick comes out clean.
Cool on wire rack for 15 minutes. Remove from pan. Cool for 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Zucchini Cake. Cream the butter and sugar. Beat in eggs and vanilla. Stir in zucchini and 1 tablespoon grated orange peel. Stir dry ingredients together. Alternately stir in the flour mixture with 1/2 cup orange juice until blended. Pour into a greased and floured Bundt pan. Bake at 350° for 55 to 65 minutes or until a toothpick comes out clean. Cool on wire rack for 15 minutes. Remove from pan. Cool for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Johnny Mazette
ingredients: 4 oz. can sliced mushrooms with liquid
directions: In a very large skillet, saute pepper, celery, onion and ground meat in very hot butter
Add salt.
Reduce heat.
Cook 5 minutes.
Stir in mushrooms, soup and sauces.
Cook 5 minutes. Cook noodles; drain.
Turn noodles into a 14 x 10 x 2 1/2-inch roasting pan.
Add sauce mixture and olives;
gently stir until well mixed.
Top with grated cheese.
Bake at 350° for 35 minutes. Makes 12 servings.
recipes.text: Johnny Mazette. In a very large skillet, saute pepper, celery, onion and ground meat in very hot butter Add salt. Reduce heat. Cook 5 minutes. Stir in mushrooms, soup and sauces. Cook 5 minutes. Cook noodles; drain. Turn noodles into a 14 x 10 x 2 1/2-inch roasting pan. Add sauce mixture and olives; gently stir until well mixed. Top with grated cheese. Bake at 350° for 35 minutes. Makes 12 servings.

recipes.title: Taco Delight
directions: Brown beef and onion in skillet for 5 minutes.
Add salsa, tomato sauce and bouillon cube; bring to a full boil.
Stir in rice; cover and remove from heat.
Let stand 5 minutes and fluff with a fork.
recipes.text: Taco Delight. Brown beef and onion in skillet for 5 minutes. Add salsa, tomato sauce and bouillon cube; bring to a full boil. Stir in rice; cover and remove from heat. Let stand 5 minutes and fluff with a fork.

recipes.title: Shrimp Quiche
directions: Heat oven to 400° (375° if using glass dish).
Saute onions and parsley in butter.
Add shrimp and seasonings; cook until shrimp turn pink.
Lightly grease 10 x 1 1/2-inch pie plate. Sprinkle cheese in plate.
Drain shrimp, reserving liquid.
Add shrimp to cheese.
Beat remaining ingredients until smooth, 15 seconds in blender on high speed or 1 minute with hand beater. Pour into plate.
Bake until knife inserted halfway between center and edge comes out clean, 35 to 40 minutes.
Let stand 5 minutes. Makes 6 large servings.
recipes.text: Shrimp Quiche. Heat oven to 400° (375° if using glass dish). Saute onions and parsley in butter. Add shrimp and seasonings; cook until shrimp turn pink. Lightly grease 10 x 1 1/2-inch pie plate. Sprinkle cheese in plate. Drain shrimp, reserving liquid. Add shrimp to cheese. Beat remaining ingredients until smooth, 15 seconds in blender on high speed or 1 minute with hand beater. Pour into plate. Bake until knife inserted halfway between center and edge comes out clean, 35 to 40 minutes. Let stand 5 minutes. Makes 6 large servings.

recipes.title: Piney Wood Hush Puppies
directions: Mix all dry ingredients; beat milk and egg together and combine with dry ingredients; batter should hold its shape when picked up with a spoon. If dough is too soft, add more cornmeal. Drop by spoonfuls into hot oil. Cook about 1 1/2 minutes on one side; turn and cook on other side for 1 minute. Makes about 45 hush puppies.
recipes.text: Piney Wood Hush Puppies. Mix all dry ingredients; beat milk and egg together and combine with dry ingredients; batter should hold its shape when picked up with a spoon. If dough is too soft, add more cornmeal. Drop by spoonfuls into hot oil. Cook about 1 1/2 minutes on one side; turn and cook on other side for 1 minute. Makes about 45 hush puppies.

recipes.title: Beef Fried Rice
directions: Fry beef cubes.
Saute vegetables until soft.
Soft scramble eggs and add vanilla.
Fry rice in soy sauce and butter or oil. Combine all ingredients, salt and pepper to taste and serve.
Any kind of meat, fish or chicken may be substituted for beef.
recipes.text: Beef Fried Rice. Fry beef cubes. Saute vegetables until soft. Soft scramble eggs and add vanilla. Fry rice in soy sauce and butter or oil. Combine all ingredients, salt and pepper to taste and serve. Any kind of meat, fish or chicken may be substituted for beef.

recipes.title: Rye Bread
directions: Take all and mix together.
Stir until smooth.
Put into baking loaf pans.
Bake for 1 hour in a 350° oven.
recipes.text: Rye Bread. Take all and mix together. Stir until smooth. Put into baking loaf pans. Bake for 1 hour in a 350° oven.

recipes.title: Better Than Sex Cake
ingredients: 1 German chocolate cake mix, prepared as directed on box
directions: Preheat oven and bake in oblong pan as directed on cake mix. Cool cake 2 minutes only and poke holes over entire surface using the handle of a wooden spoon.
(Do not poke all the way through.) Then pour 1/2 to 3/4 can of Eagle Brand into the holes and repeat the process with 1/2 to 2/3 jar caramel.
Cool cake in refrigerator.
When cool, spread with Cool Whip and top cake with broken up pieces of the candy bars (they break easier when frozen).
recipes.text: Better Than Sex Cake. Preheat oven and bake in oblong pan as directed on cake mix. Cool cake 2 minutes only and poke holes over entire surface using the handle of a wooden spoon. (Do not poke all the way through.) Then pour 1/2 to 3/4 can of Eagle Brand into the holes and repeat the process with 1/2 to 2/3 jar caramel. Cool cake in refrigerator. When cool, spread with Cool Whip and top cake with broken up pieces of the candy bars (they break easier when frozen).

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Hard Tack(Tastes Like Inside Of Clark Bars)
ingredients: 2 1/4 c. (18 oz. jar) creamy peanut butter
directions: Cook first 3 ingredients to 300° on candy thermometer; while cooking syrup, grease iron skillet with butter and sprinkle with salt.
Add peanut butter to skillet.
Two people need to work together; one pours syrup mixture into peanut butter slowly, while the other stirs the mixture well.
Mixture will be stiff.
Pour onto greased cookie sheet.
Cut at once into pieces.
Roll into confectioners sugar.
recipes.text: Peanut Butter Hard Tack(Tastes Like Inside Of Clark Bars). Cook first 3 ingredients to 300° on candy thermometer; while cooking syrup, grease iron skillet with butter and sprinkle with salt. Add peanut butter to skillet. Two people need to work together; one pours syrup mixture into peanut butter slowly, while the other stirs the mixture well. Mixture will be stiff. Pour onto greased cookie sheet. Cut at once into pieces. Roll into confectioners sugar.

recipes.title: B.T.L.  Bites
directions: Cut a thin slice off each tomato top; scoop out and discard pulp.
Invert the tomatoes on a paper towel to drain.
recipes.text: B.T.L.  Bites. Cut a thin slice off each tomato top; scoop out and discard pulp. Invert the tomatoes on a paper towel to drain.

recipes.title: Egg Enchiladas(For Lent Or Anytime)
ingredients: 29 oz. enchilada sauce (1 large and 1 medium can)
directions: In saucepan, steam onions in small amount of water.
In large, flat pan, pour half of enchilada sauce.
Fry tortillas briefly in small amount of oil.
Then turn tortillas in enchilada sauce and place 1 tablespoon onions, 2 olives, 1 tablespoon eggs and 2 tablespoons cheese in tortillas.
Roll and place filled tortillas in greased 9 x 13-inch pan.
Continue until all tortillas are filled.
May fill another 8 x 8-inch pan.
Pour remaining enchilada sauce over tortillas and cover with remaining cheese. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Egg Enchiladas(For Lent Or Anytime). In saucepan, steam onions in small amount of water. In large, flat pan, pour half of enchilada sauce. Fry tortillas briefly in small amount of oil. Then turn tortillas in enchilada sauce and place 1 tablespoon onions, 2 olives, 1 tablespoon eggs and 2 tablespoons cheese in tortillas. Roll and place filled tortillas in greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Continue until all tortillas are filled. May fill another 8 x 8-inch pan. Pour remaining enchilada sauce over tortillas and cover with remaining cheese. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Sweet-Sour Chicken And Rice
directions: Place chicken in a deep baking dish.
Sprinkle soup mix over chicken. Pour Russian dressing over soup mix and spoon apricot marmalade over the Russian dressing.
Cover with foil and bake 40 minutes in a 325° to 350° oven.
Remove foil cover and continue baking another 20 to 30 minutes.
Chicken makes own gravy. Prepare rice as directed. Serve chicken on warm serving platter with the rice and gravy on the side.
recipes.text: Sweet-Sour Chicken And Rice. Place chicken in a deep baking dish. Sprinkle soup mix over chicken. Pour Russian dressing over soup mix and spoon apricot marmalade over the Russian dressing. Cover with foil and bake 40 minutes in a 325° to 350° oven. Remove foil cover and continue baking another 20 to 30 minutes. Chicken makes own gravy. Prepare rice as directed. Serve chicken on warm serving platter with the rice and gravy on the side.

recipes.title: Chicken Casserole With Apples And Cheese
ingredients: 3 medium red cooking apples, cored and sliced
2 Tbsp. apple cider or juice or brandy
directions: Cooking Time: 35 to 45 minutes.
Servings: 6.
recipes.text: Chicken Casserole With Apples And Cheese. Cooking Time: 35 to 45 minutes. Servings: 6.

recipes.title: Cabbage Hot Dish
directions: Saute onion and green pepper with hamburger, heating but not totally browned.
Season to taste.
Spread half of cabbage in baking dish.
Cover with ground beef mixture.
Add rest of cabbage. Pour soup over top.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
Makes 3 to 4 servings.
recipes.text: Cabbage Hot Dish. Saute onion and green pepper with hamburger, heating but not totally browned. Season to taste. Spread half of cabbage in baking dish. Cover with ground beef mixture. Add rest of cabbage. Pour soup over top. Bake at 350° for 1 hour. Makes 3 to 4 servings.

recipes.title: Fresh Apple Cake
directions: Combine oil and sugar.
Beat
in
eggs.
Sift
together dry ingredients
and add to egg
mixture.
Fold
in
vanilla, apples and pecans.
Bake in a 9 x 13-inch
pan
at 325° for 55 minutes. Cool and ice with Vanilla
Cream Cheese Icing.
Cake will keep moist and fresh for days.
recipes.text: Fresh Apple Cake. Combine oil and sugar. Beat in eggs. Sift together dry ingredients and add to egg mixture. Fold in vanilla, apples and pecans. Bake in a 9 x 13-inch pan at 325° for 55 minutes. Cool and ice with Vanilla Cream Cheese Icing. Cake will keep moist and fresh for days.

recipes.title: Pecan Pie
directions: Mix sugar and flour.
Beat in eggs, one at a time.
Add syrup and butter.
Pour over nuts in pie shell.
Bake for 10 minutes at 375°, then for 30 minutes at 350°.
recipes.text: Pecan Pie. Mix sugar and flour. Beat in eggs, one at a time. Add syrup and butter. Pour over nuts in pie shell. Bake for 10 minutes at 375°, then for 30 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Yuletide Egg Nog
ingredients: 1 doz. eggs, yolks and whites separated
directions: After separating egg whites and egg yolks into separate large bowls, beat each until stiff peaks form.
Also in a separate bowl, beat whipping cream until soft peaks form.
Add 1 cup sugar to both yolks and whites and beat for approximately 5 minutes until sugar is dissolved.
recipes.text: Yuletide Egg Nog. After separating egg whites and egg yolks into separate large bowls, beat each until stiff peaks form. Also in a separate bowl, beat whipping cream until soft peaks form. Add 1 cup sugar to both yolks and whites and beat for approximately 5 minutes until sugar is dissolved.

recipes.title: Ugly Duckling Cake
directions: Combine cake mix, undrained fruit cocktail, 1 cup of the coconut and eggs.
Beat at medium speed for 2 minutes; pour into greased 9 x 13-inch pan.
Sprinkle with brown sugar and nuts. Bake at 325° for 45 minutes.
Bring margarine, sugar and milk to a boil; boil 1 minute.
Stir in remaining 1 1/3 cup coconut; spoon over warm cake.
Top with prepared whipped topping if desired.
recipes.text: Ugly Duckling Cake. Combine cake mix, undrained fruit cocktail, 1 cup of the coconut and eggs. Beat at medium speed for 2 minutes; pour into greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Sprinkle with brown sugar and nuts. Bake at 325° for 45 minutes. Bring margarine, sugar and milk to a boil; boil 1 minute. Stir in remaining 1 1/3 cup coconut; spoon over warm cake. Top with prepared whipped topping if desired.

recipes.title: Choco-Dot Pumpkin Cake
directions: Sift together all dry ingredients.
In large bowl, beat eggs until foamy.
Add pumpkin, oil and bran flakes.
Mix well.
Add sifted dry ingredients, mixing only until combined.
Stir in semi-sweet chocolate morsels and nuts.
Spread evenly in a 10 x 4-inch ungreased tube pan.
Bake at 350° for about 1 hour and 10 minutes.
Cool completely before removing from pan.
Drizzle with a confectioners sugar glaze, if desired.
recipes.text: Choco-Dot Pumpkin Cake. Sift together all dry ingredients. In large bowl, beat eggs until foamy. Add pumpkin, oil and bran flakes. Mix well. Add sifted dry ingredients, mixing only until combined. Stir in semi-sweet chocolate morsels and nuts. Spread evenly in a 10 x 4-inch ungreased tube pan. Bake at 350° for about 1 hour and 10 minutes. Cool completely before removing from pan. Drizzle with a confectioners sugar glaze, if desired.

recipes.title: Chewy Granola Bars
ingredients: 2 c. mini chocolate chips, mini M&M's, dried fruit or anything you want
directions: Preheat oven to 325°.
Lightly grease a 9 x 13 pan.
Combine oats, flour, soda, vanilla, butter, honey and brown sugar in large mixing bowl.
Stir in the 2 cups of your choice of chips, nuts or fruit.
Firmly press into the prepared pan and bake for 20 to 22 minutes.
If you overbake it, they will be too crumbly, so watch when the edges and top start to brown and take out to cool.
Let cool 10 minutes and then cut bars.
Then let cool completely before removing bars.
recipes.text: Chewy Granola Bars. Preheat oven to 325°. Lightly grease a 9 x 13 pan. Combine oats, flour, soda, vanilla, butter, honey and brown sugar in large mixing bowl. Stir in the 2 cups of your choice of chips, nuts or fruit. Firmly press into the prepared pan and bake for 20 to 22 minutes. If you overbake it, they will be too crumbly, so watch when the edges and top start to brown and take out to cool. Let cool 10 minutes and then cut bars. Then let cool completely before removing bars.

recipes.title: Mini Blue Cheese Rolls
directions: In a saucepan, melt the butter and Blue cheese over low heat. Unroll dough and cut each breadstick into 6 pieces; place in a foil-lined 11 x 7 x 2-inch baking pan.
Pour cheese mixture over dough.
Bake at 400° for 20 minutes or until butter is absorbed and rolls are lightly browned.
Carefully lift foil out of pan; place on a serving dish.
Serve hot.
Yields 4 to 6 servings.
recipes.text: Mini Blue Cheese Rolls. In a saucepan, melt the butter and Blue cheese over low heat. Unroll dough and cut each breadstick into 6 pieces; place in a foil-lined 11 x 7 x 2-inch baking pan. Pour cheese mixture over dough. Bake at 400° for 20 minutes or until butter is absorbed and rolls are lightly browned. Carefully lift foil out of pan; place on a serving dish. Serve hot. Yields 4 to 6 servings.

recipes.title: Orange Cake
directions: Combine cake and pudding mixes in large bowl.
Add eggs, one at a time, stirring into dry ingredients.
Add oil and water.
Mix until smooth.
Add orange peel and stir in.
Bake 45 minutes at 375° in a tube or Bundt pan.
recipes.text: Orange Cake. Combine cake and pudding mixes in large bowl. Add eggs, one at a time, stirring into dry ingredients. Add oil and water. Mix until smooth. Add orange peel and stir in. Bake 45 minutes at 375° in a tube or Bundt pan.

recipes.title: Lobster Bisque
ingredients: 1 (46 oz.) College Inn broth plus 1 c. water
directions: Heat chicken broth, diluted with 1 cup water, in saucepan. Keep hot.
Lightly saute lobster meat in 1/2 stick of butter (1/4 cup).
Season with garlic powder to taste.
Add brandy.
Remove from heat and allow to cool.
Process in food processor to chop. In a large pot, melt remaining butter (1 1/4 cups or 2 1/2 sticks); add 1 1/2 cups flour and Newberg sauce mix to make a roux.
Cook roux over very low heat 3 to 5 minutes.
Slowly add hot chicken broth to roux, mixing thoroughly with whisk after each addition. Mixture will be very thick.
recipes.text: Lobster Bisque. Heat chicken broth, diluted with 1 cup water, in saucepan. Keep hot. Lightly saute lobster meat in 1/2 stick of butter (1/4 cup). Season with garlic powder to taste. Add brandy. Remove from heat and allow to cool. Process in food processor to chop. In a large pot, melt remaining butter (1 1/4 cups or 2 1/2 sticks); add 1 1/2 cups flour and Newberg sauce mix to make a roux. Cook roux over very low heat 3 to 5 minutes. Slowly add hot chicken broth to roux, mixing thoroughly with whisk after each addition. Mixture will be very thick.

recipes.title: Sour Cream Dip
directions: Mix all ingredients thoroughly.
Refrigerate at least 3 hours to blend flavors.
Makes 20 to 24 servings.
recipes.text: Sour Cream Dip. Mix all ingredients thoroughly. Refrigerate at least 3 hours to blend flavors. Makes 20 to 24 servings.

recipes.title: Spinach Dip
directions: Thaw and drain spinach. Set aside. Mix all other ingredients. Squeeze excess juice out of spinach with fork or spin dry. Add all items together. Refrigerate. Hollow out round rye (or pumpernickel) bread. Keep bread pieces to dip. Fill hollow with Spinach Dip when ready to serve.
recipes.text: Spinach Dip. Thaw and drain spinach. Set aside. Mix all other ingredients. Squeeze excess juice out of spinach with fork or spin dry. Add all items together. Refrigerate. Hollow out round rye (or pumpernickel) bread. Keep bread pieces to dip. Fill hollow with Spinach Dip when ready to serve.

recipes.title: Asparagus Casserole With Ham
ingredients: 1 (10 3/4 oz.) can cream of mushroom soup
directions: Blend butter and flour in saucepan. Add mushroom soup and cook until thick. Stir in mustard. Combine asparagus, peas, eggs and ham in 2-quart greased casserole dish. Pour mushroom sauce over all. Mix bread crumbs with cheese. Spread over top of casserole. Bake at 300° for 30 minutes or until casserole is brown and bubbly. Makes 4 to 6 servings.
recipes.text: Asparagus Casserole With Ham. Blend butter and flour in saucepan. Add mushroom soup and cook until thick. Stir in mustard. Combine asparagus, peas, eggs and ham in 2-quart greased casserole dish. Pour mushroom sauce over all. Mix bread crumbs with cheese. Spread over top of casserole. Bake at 300° for 30 minutes or until casserole is brown and bubbly. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

recipes.title: Sausage And Cheese Pie
ingredients: 1 (8 oz.) pkg. Brown 'N Serve sausage links
directions: Separate crescent dough into 2 large rectangles.
Place in ungreased casserole.
Press over bottom and halfway up sides to form crust.
Seal perforations.
Slice sausages and arrange over crust.
Sprinkle with cheese.
Combine remaining ingredients and pour over cheese.
Bake at 400° for 20 to 25 minutes until golden brown.
recipes.text: Sausage And Cheese Pie. Separate crescent dough into 2 large rectangles. Place in ungreased casserole. Press over bottom and halfway up sides to form crust. Seal perforations. Slice sausages and arrange over crust. Sprinkle with cheese. Combine remaining ingredients and pour over cheese. Bake at 400° for 20 to 25 minutes until golden brown.

recipes.title: Potato Casserole
directions: Preheat oven to 350°.
Thaw potatoes and combine with 1/2 cup margarine, salt, pepper, onions, soup, sour cream and cheese. Place in a greased 9 x 13 x 2-inch casserole.
recipes.text: Potato Casserole. Preheat oven to 350°. Thaw potatoes and combine with 1/2 cup margarine, salt, pepper, onions, soup, sour cream and cheese. Place in a greased 9 x 13 x 2-inch casserole.

recipes.title: Strawberry Pie
directions: Cook 1/2 of the strawberries.
Mash with Jell-O and sugar. Let cool.
Pour into baked pie shell and top with rest of fresh berries in baked pie shell.
Serve with whipped cream or Cool Whip.
recipes.text: Strawberry Pie. Cook 1/2 of the strawberries. Mash with Jell-O and sugar. Let cool. Pour into baked pie shell and top with rest of fresh berries in baked pie shell. Serve with whipped cream or Cool Whip.

recipes.title: Tuna Noodle Casserole
ingredients: 1/2 c. slivered almonds, toasted or potato chips, crumbled
directions: Cook noodles in boiling salted water until tender; drain. Combine noodles, drained tuna, mayonnaise, vegetables and salt. Blend soup and milk.
Heat through; add cheese.
Heat and stir until cheese melts.
Add to noodle mixture.
Turn into a 1 1/2-quart casserole.
Top with almonds.
Bake at 425° for about 25 minutes.
Makes 6 servings.
recipes.text: Tuna Noodle Casserole. Cook noodles in boiling salted water until tender; drain. Combine noodles, drained tuna, mayonnaise, vegetables and salt. Blend soup and milk. Heat through; add cheese. Heat and stir until cheese melts. Add to noodle mixture. Turn into a 1 1/2-quart casserole. Top with almonds. Bake at 425° for about 25 minutes. Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Taco Casserole
directions: Prepare ground beef according to taco seasoning mix package instructions.

Pour refried beans into a 9 x 13-inch pan and spread evenly in bottom of pan; spread chopped olives evenly over beans. Mix salsa with ground beef; simmer approximately 15 minutes. Spread over beans and olives.
Sprinkle cheese over mixture; add tomatoes, lettuce and tortilla chips.
Use sour cream as desired.
recipes.text: Taco Casserole. Prepare ground beef according to taco seasoning mix package instructions. Pour refried beans into a 9 x 13-inch pan and spread evenly in bottom of pan; spread chopped olives evenly over beans. Mix salsa with ground beef; simmer approximately 15 minutes. Spread over beans and olives. Sprinkle cheese over mixture; add tomatoes, lettuce and tortilla chips. Use sour cream as desired.

recipes.title: Spaghetti Pie
directions: Cook spaghetti.
Drain.
Stir in butter until melted.
Add Parmesan cheese and egg.
Mix well.
Form mixture into crust in a greased pie pan or small cake pan.
In a skillet, cook ground beef, onion and green pepper until vegetables are tender.
Drain off any grease.
Stir in undrained tomatoes, tomato sauce, sugar, oregano and garlic salt.
Heat through.
Spread tomato mixture over spaghetti crust.
Sprinkle Mozzarella cheese and Parmesan cheese on top.
Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Spaghetti Pie. Cook spaghetti. Drain. Stir in butter until melted. Add Parmesan cheese and egg. Mix well. Form mixture into crust in a greased pie pan or small cake pan. In a skillet, cook ground beef, onion and green pepper until vegetables are tender. Drain off any grease. Stir in undrained tomatoes, tomato sauce, sugar, oregano and garlic salt. Heat through. Spread tomato mixture over spaghetti crust. Sprinkle Mozzarella cheese and Parmesan cheese on top. Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Bean Soup
ingredients: assortment of beans: pinto, red kidney, lentils, small white beans, green split peas, pearl barley, lima beans, black-eyed peas
salt, pepper and garlic powder to taste
directions: Wash beans.
Add salt.
Add water and soak overnight.
Drain the beans.
Add 2 quarts of water and ham hocks.
Bring to a boil. Simmer 2 1/2 to 3 hours.
Add onion, tomatoes, chili powder, lemon juice, salt, pepper and garlic powder.
Simmer another 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Bean Soup. Wash beans. Add salt. Add water and soak overnight. Drain the beans. Add 2 quarts of water and ham hocks. Bring to a boil. Simmer 2 1/2 to 3 hours. Add onion, tomatoes, chili powder, lemon juice, salt, pepper and garlic powder. Simmer another 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Hash Browns
directions: Peel potatoes and cut up or shred.
Combine potatoes, onion, salt and pepper in a large skillet with melted butter.
Cook over medium heat about 10 minutes, until bottom is crisp.
Turn over and cook 10 more minutes.
recipes.text: Hash Browns. Peel potatoes and cut up or shred. Combine potatoes, onion, salt and pepper in a large skillet with melted butter. Cook over medium heat about 10 minutes, until bottom is crisp. Turn over and cook 10 more minutes.

recipes.title: Fried Green Tomatoes
directions: Wash and dry tomatoes.
Cut in 1/4-inch slices and coat in mixture of flour, meal, salt and pepper.
Heat shortening in skillet to moderately hot temperature.
Fry, turning slices until golden brown.
recipes.text: Fried Green Tomatoes. Wash and dry tomatoes. Cut in 1/4-inch slices and coat in mixture of flour, meal, salt and pepper. Heat shortening in skillet to moderately hot temperature. Fry, turning slices until golden brown.

recipes.title: Bean Chowder
directions: Soak and cook beans.
Add brown sugar.
Brown meat and onion. Drain. Add to the beans.
Combine remaining ingredients and simmer about 1 hour.
recipes.text: Bean Chowder. Soak and cook beans. Add brown sugar. Brown meat and onion. Drain. Add to the beans. Combine remaining ingredients and simmer about 1 hour.

recipes.title: Wayne'S Chili
directions: Mix beans, chili powder, tomato juice, onion and chili roll. Cook slowly until chili roll is melted.
Add ground beef (cooked slightly) and cook for 20 minutes.
Add more juice as needed to consistency desired.
recipes.text: Wayne'S Chili. Mix beans, chili powder, tomato juice, onion and chili roll. Cook slowly until chili roll is melted. Add ground beef (cooked slightly) and cook for 20 minutes. Add more juice as needed to consistency desired.

recipes.title: Italian Rice Meatballs
ingredients: 3 Tbsp. olive oil or other vegetable oil
directions: Combine ground beef and next 8 ingredients.
Form into 18 meatballs, approximately 2-inches in diameter, and chill for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Italian Rice Meatballs. Combine ground beef and next 8 ingredients. Form into 18 meatballs, approximately 2-inches in diameter, and chill for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Sicilian Meat Loaf
directions: Combine first 8 ingredients and stir into hamburger; mix well. On a 10 x 12-inch piece of wax paper, spread hamburger mixture. Arrange slices of ham on hamburger, leaving a 1-inch border all the way around.
Spread cheese on ham; roll and seal edges and ends. Bake, seam side down, in pan for 1 hour and 10 minutes.
Put 4 slices of Mozzarella cheese, cut in half, on loaf.
Bake for 5 minutes more at 350°.
recipes.text: Sicilian Meat Loaf. Combine first 8 ingredients and stir into hamburger; mix well. On a 10 x 12-inch piece of wax paper, spread hamburger mixture. Arrange slices of ham on hamburger, leaving a 1-inch border all the way around. Spread cheese on ham; roll and seal edges and ends. Bake, seam side down, in pan for 1 hour and 10 minutes. Put 4 slices of Mozzarella cheese, cut in half, on loaf. Bake for 5 minutes more at 350°.

recipes.title: Hamburger Rice Casserole
directions: Brown hamburger and drain off grease.
In a large skillet, place hamburger, rice, tomato sauce, water, carrots, salt and pepper.
Stir to combine.
Bring to a boil, then reduce to simmer. Simmer, covered, over low heat until rice is done and carrots are tender.
Do not stir!
Add water as needed to keep from sticking. Serves 6.
recipes.text: Hamburger Rice Casserole. Brown hamburger and drain off grease. In a large skillet, place hamburger, rice, tomato sauce, water, carrots, salt and pepper. Stir to combine. Bring to a boil, then reduce to simmer. Simmer, covered, over low heat until rice is done and carrots are tender. Do not stir! Add water as needed to keep from sticking. Serves 6.

recipes.title: `Over-Night' Layered Salad
ingredients: 1 head iceberg lettuce (cut into bite sized pieces)
1 small can sliced water chestnuts (finely chopped)
2 medium tomatoes (sliced, to be arranged on top)
directions: Layer above ingredients, in order listed.
recipes.text: `Over-Night' Layered Salad. Layer above ingredients, in order listed.

recipes.title: Marinated Shrimp
directions: Alternate layers of shrimp and onions in a very large jar with lid.
Mix all other ingredients together and pour over shrimp. Marinate in fridge for at least 24 hours.
Turn jar over often. May be kept a week to 10 days.
recipes.text: Marinated Shrimp. Alternate layers of shrimp and onions in a very large jar with lid. Mix all other ingredients together and pour over shrimp. Marinate in fridge for at least 24 hours. Turn jar over often. May be kept a week to 10 days.

recipes.title: Chicken Breasts With Chipped Beef
directions: Layer dried beef in 8 x 11-inch casserole.
Wrap bacon around chicken pieces and place on top of dried beef.
Mix up sour cream and mushroom soup.
Pour mixture over chicken.
Bake at 250° for 1 1/2 hours, covered.
Uncover and bake 30 minutes more.
recipes.text: Chicken Breasts With Chipped Beef. Layer dried beef in 8 x 11-inch casserole. Wrap bacon around chicken pieces and place on top of dried beef. Mix up sour cream and mushroom soup. Pour mixture over chicken. Bake at 250° for 1 1/2 hours, covered. Uncover and bake 30 minutes more.

recipes.title: Chicken Casserole
directions: Place broccoli in bottom of pan.
Sprinkle chicken pieces on top of broccoli.
Combine soup and other ingredients adding next. Top with bread crumbs and cheese.
Bake in 8 1/2 x 13-inch pan at 250° for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Chicken Casserole. Place broccoli in bottom of pan. Sprinkle chicken pieces on top of broccoli. Combine soup and other ingredients adding next. Top with bread crumbs and cheese. Bake in 8 1/2 x 13-inch pan at 250° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Sour Cream Coffee Cake
directions: Prepare topping and set aside.
recipes.text: Sour Cream Coffee Cake. Prepare topping and set aside.

recipes.title: Salmon Loaf
directions: Remove dark skin and bones from salmon.
Flake with fork.
Add cracker crumbs, margarine, tomato juice, onions, paprika and salt to salmon.
Mix well.
Separate egg yolks to salmon mixture.
Fold in stiffly beaten egg whites.
Pour into well-greased 1-quart casserole dish and bake, uncovered, at 350° for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Salmon Loaf. Remove dark skin and bones from salmon. Flake with fork. Add cracker crumbs, margarine, tomato juice, onions, paprika and salt to salmon. Mix well. Separate egg yolks to salmon mixture. Fold in stiffly beaten egg whites. Pour into well-greased 1-quart casserole dish and bake, uncovered, at 350° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Strawberry Cookies
directions: Cook oleo, dates, sugar and eggs together.
Add Rice Krispies and nuts.
Mix well and form into small strawberry shapes.
Roll in red sugar.
recipes.text: Strawberry Cookies. Cook oleo, dates, sugar and eggs together. Add Rice Krispies and nuts. Mix well and form into small strawberry shapes. Roll in red sugar.

recipes.title: Steamed Chicken
directions: Prepare chicken for roasting.
Rub inside and outside with salt and pepper.
Rub outside with melted butter.
Place in steamer. Steam until tender.
If desired, steamed chicken may be brushed with melted butter and browned in oven.
recipes.text: Steamed Chicken. Prepare chicken for roasting. Rub inside and outside with salt and pepper. Rub outside with melted butter. Place in steamer. Steam until tender. If desired, steamed chicken may be brushed with melted butter and browned in oven.

recipes.title: German Potato Salad
directions: Boil potatoes in skins.
When cool enough to hold, dice potatoes.
Fry bacon crisp.
Crumble.
Add potatoes with salt and pepper.
Heat vinegar and water.
Pour over mixture of potatoes. Heat oil.
Pour over ingredients.
Toss and set aside.
Do not refrigerate.
Serve at room temperature.
This salad must be put together while hot.
recipes.text: German Potato Salad. Boil potatoes in skins. When cool enough to hold, dice potatoes. Fry bacon crisp. Crumble. Add potatoes with salt and pepper. Heat vinegar and water. Pour over mixture of potatoes. Heat oil. Pour over ingredients. Toss and set aside. Do not refrigerate. Serve at room temperature. This salad must be put together while hot.

recipes.title: Quick And Easy Fruit Salad
directions: Drain pineapple and mixed fruit, reserving pineapple juice. Combine juice, pudding mix and Tang.
Stir well.
Combine fruit and dressing; toss gently.
Chill.
recipes.text: Quick And Easy Fruit Salad. Drain pineapple and mixed fruit, reserving pineapple juice. Combine juice, pudding mix and Tang. Stir well. Combine fruit and dressing; toss gently. Chill.

recipes.title: Sugar Cookies
ingredients: sprinkle of sugar on top of cookies
directions: Cream together sugar, shortening and eggs.
Add the milk and dry ingredients.
Mix well.
Add vanilla and mix thoroughly.
Drop on ungreased cookie sheet.
Bake at 375° approximately 10 minutes.
recipes.text: Sugar Cookies. Cream together sugar, shortening and eggs. Add the milk and dry ingredients. Mix well. Add vanilla and mix thoroughly. Drop on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 375° approximately 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Cinnamon Apple Salad
ingredients: 8 oz. cream cheese plus small amount milk
directions: Heat candies in boiling water until dissolved.
Pour over jello to dissolve it, then add cold water.
Chill until partially set.
Add diced apples and celery. Put half this mixture in a casserole dish and refrigerate until set.
Cream cheese with milk and spread over the set portion of salad.
Add remaining jello.
recipes.text: Cinnamon Apple Salad. Heat candies in boiling water until dissolved. Pour over jello to dissolve it, then add cold water. Chill until partially set. Add diced apples and celery. Put half this mixture in a casserole dish and refrigerate until set. Cream cheese with milk and spread over the set portion of salad. Add remaining jello.

recipes.title: Campers Special
directions: Make hamburger patties; put in foil.
Put slice of onion, tomato, potatoes and carrots on top of patty.
Cover with foil. Bake at 350° until vegetables are tender.
recipes.text: Campers Special. Make hamburger patties; put in foil. Put slice of onion, tomato, potatoes and carrots on top of patty. Cover with foil. Bake at 350° until vegetables are tender.

recipes.title: Appreciation Party Punch
ingredients: 1 (46 oz.) can unsweetened pineapple juice, chilled
directions: Combine all ingredients in a punch bowl and enjoy.
Yields 5 1/2 quarts.
recipes.text: Appreciation Party Punch. Combine all ingredients in a punch bowl and enjoy. Yields 5 1/2 quarts.

recipes.title: Cheese Grits
directions: Bring milk to a boil.
Add 1/2 cup margarine and stir in grits. Cook, stirring constantly, until mixture is the consistency of oatmeal.
Remove from heat; add salt and pepper.
Beat mixture with egg beater.
Add grated cheese and pour into a greased 2-quart casserole.
Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
This can be made the day before and baked the morning of the brunch.
recipes.text: Cheese Grits. Bring milk to a boil. Add 1/2 cup margarine and stir in grits. Cook, stirring constantly, until mixture is the consistency of oatmeal. Remove from heat; add salt and pepper. Beat mixture with egg beater. Add grated cheese and pour into a greased 2-quart casserole. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Bake at 350° for 1 hour. This can be made the day before and baked the morning of the brunch.

recipes.title: Mary'S Mushroom Soup
directions: Melt butter in large pan. Add onion and garlic, stirring over medium heat until onion is soft (about 3 minutes). Mix in mushrooms and stir about 5 minutes. Add flour and stir for another minute. Pour in milk and beef stock, stirring well until combined and bring to a boil; reduce heat to low. Simmer, uncovered, for 15 minutes or until mixture has reduced, is thickened and mushrooms are tender. Add parsley. Serve with a dollop of sour cream.
recipes.text: Mary'S Mushroom Soup. Melt butter in large pan. Add onion and garlic, stirring over medium heat until onion is soft (about 3 minutes). Mix in mushrooms and stir about 5 minutes. Add flour and stir for another minute. Pour in milk and beef stock, stirring well until combined and bring to a boil; reduce heat to low. Simmer, uncovered, for 15 minutes or until mixture has reduced, is thickened and mushrooms are tender. Add parsley. Serve with a dollop of sour cream.

recipes.title: Almond Butter Crunch(Do Not Double)
ingredients: 2 c. chopped toasted almonds, toasted at 375~ until brown
directions: Butter a 9 x 13 x 2-inch pan.
Combine butter, sugar, syrup and water in heavy saucepan and cook over medium heat, stirring constantly to 300° on the candy thermometer.
Turn off heat and immediately stir in 1/2 almonds.
Pour immediately into pan, spread evenly and cool.
When hard, pry out of pan and turn onto wax paper; melt 1/2 chocolate (microwave on High 90 seconds, stir, zap again 90 seconds on High) and spread on top.
Sprinkle and press in 1/2 remaining almonds.
When cool, turn over and do same on other side.
Hold with wax paper and crumble when cool.
recipes.text: Almond Butter Crunch(Do Not Double). Butter a 9 x 13 x 2-inch pan. Combine butter, sugar, syrup and water in heavy saucepan and cook over medium heat, stirring constantly to 300° on the candy thermometer. Turn off heat and immediately stir in 1/2 almonds. Pour immediately into pan, spread evenly and cool. When hard, pry out of pan and turn onto wax paper; melt 1/2 chocolate (microwave on High 90 seconds, stir, zap again 90 seconds on High) and spread on top. Sprinkle and press in 1/2 remaining almonds. When cool, turn over and do same on other side. Hold with wax paper and crumble when cool.

recipes.title: Party Steak Diane
ingredients: 1 sirloin steak (2-inches thick and weighing about 5 lb.)
3/4 lb. fresh mushrooms, washed, trimmed and sliced
directions: I add a little dry vermouth.
recipes.text: Party Steak Diane. I add a little dry vermouth.

recipes.title: Coffee Cake
directions: Cream sugar, butter and eggs.
Fold in flour, sour cream, vanilla, baking powder and salt.
recipes.text: Coffee Cake. Cream sugar, butter and eggs. Fold in flour, sour cream, vanilla, baking powder and salt.

recipes.title: Grilled Cornish Hens
directions: Place charcoal around drip pan.
Wash hens.
Pat dry and rub onion salt in and on hens.
Place hens over medium coals.
Baste hens often with mixture.
Grill until tender, turning often.
recipes.text: Grilled Cornish Hens. Place charcoal around drip pan. Wash hens. Pat dry and rub onion salt in and on hens. Place hens over medium coals. Baste hens often with mixture. Grill until tender, turning often.

recipes.title: Five Minute Fudge
directions: Heat together until melted and pour into buttered plate.
recipes.text: Five Minute Fudge. Heat together until melted and pour into buttered plate.

recipes.title: Pizza Dogs
directions: In a saucepan, combine pizza sauce and pepperoni; heat through.
Stir in the cheese until melted.
Spoon about 2 tablespoons into each bun; top with hot dog.
Serve immediately.
recipes.text: Pizza Dogs. In a saucepan, combine pizza sauce and pepperoni; heat through. Stir in the cheese until melted. Spoon about 2 tablespoons into each bun; top with hot dog. Serve immediately.

recipes.title: Chicken-Broccoli Bake
ingredients: 2 (10 oz.) pkg. frozen broccoli, cooked and drained
1 lb. sliced, cooked chicken or turkey
directions: Arrange cooked and drained broccoli in 3-quart casserole. Combine cream cheese, milk and garlic salt in saucepan.
Cook and stir until thickened.
Pour about half the sauce over the broccoli. Top with 1 pound sliced, cooked chicken or turkey and remaining sauce.
Sprinkle with grated Parmesan cheese.
Bake at 350° for about 20 minutes.
Then boil until lightly browned.
Serves 6.
recipes.text: Chicken-Broccoli Bake. Arrange cooked and drained broccoli in 3-quart casserole. Combine cream cheese, milk and garlic salt in saucepan. Cook and stir until thickened. Pour about half the sauce over the broccoli. Top with 1 pound sliced, cooked chicken or turkey and remaining sauce. Sprinkle with grated Parmesan cheese. Bake at 350° for about 20 minutes. Then boil until lightly browned. Serves 6.

recipes.title: Brownies
directions: Beat all ingredients together at medium speed on mixer for 1 minute.
Spread in greased 15 x 10-inch pan and bake at 350° for 25 minutes.
recipes.text: Brownies. Beat all ingredients together at medium speed on mixer for 1 minute. Spread in greased 15 x 10-inch pan and bake at 350° for 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Banana Cream Pie
directions: Mix together sugar, cornstarch and salt.
Add milk slowly and heat.
Add eggs by putting a small amount of milk into egg mixture.
Stir constantly until it boils - add butter and vanilla. Put 1 sliced banana in bottom of mazola oil baked pie shell. (see pastry section).
Add small amount of cream mixture and more bananas, then cover with cream filling.
Chill several hours.
Top with real whipped cream or meringue.
recipes.text: Banana Cream Pie. Mix together sugar, cornstarch and salt. Add milk slowly and heat. Add eggs by putting a small amount of milk into egg mixture. Stir constantly until it boils - add butter and vanilla. Put 1 sliced banana in bottom of mazola oil baked pie shell. (see pastry section). Add small amount of cream mixture and more bananas, then cover with cream filling. Chill several hours. Top with real whipped cream or meringue.

recipes.title: Lunchroom Soup
ingredients: salt, pepper and celery to taste
directions: Brown meat and onions.
Drain.
Add remaining ingredients and water to desired consistency.
Simmer for 30 to 90 minutes.
recipes.text: Lunchroom Soup. Brown meat and onions. Drain. Add remaining ingredients and water to desired consistency. Simmer for 30 to 90 minutes.

recipes.title: Million Dollar Fudge
directions: Mix broken pieces of Hershey bars, chips, vanilla, marshmallow cream and margarine in a 6 to 8-quart pan.
Set aside.
Mix sugar and milk in a 4 to 6-quart pan.
Boil and cook for 6 1/2 minutes. Pour the cooked
sugar and milk over first mixture and blend.
Add chopped pecans.
Drop balls onto waxed paper.
Let stand for 4 to 6 hours, or until chilled.
Remove from paper and store.
Makes 6 pounds.
recipes.text: Million Dollar Fudge. Mix broken pieces of Hershey bars, chips, vanilla, marshmallow cream and margarine in a 6 to 8-quart pan. Set aside. Mix sugar and milk in a 4 to 6-quart pan. Boil and cook for 6 1/2 minutes. Pour the cooked sugar and milk over first mixture and blend. Add chopped pecans. Drop balls onto waxed paper. Let stand for 4 to 6 hours, or until chilled. Remove from paper and store. Makes 6 pounds.

recipes.title: Green Chili Rice
ingredients: 1 or 2 small cans chopped green chilies
directions: Cook rice and salt and pepper to taste. Mix in sour cream. Pour half mixture in casserole dish. Sprinkle half cheese and green chilies on top. Add another layer of rice mixture and repeat with cheese and chilies. Put a few dabs of butter on top and bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Green Chili Rice. Cook rice and salt and pepper to taste. Mix in sour cream. Pour half mixture in casserole dish. Sprinkle half cheese and green chilies on top. Add another layer of rice mixture and repeat with cheese and chilies. Put a few dabs of butter on top and bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Polish Sausage And Potatoes
directions: Cook diced potatoes in oil until halfway done.
Slice sausage in thin slices and add with onions to potatoes.
Cover and cook until potatoes are done.
recipes.text: Polish Sausage And Potatoes. Cook diced potatoes in oil until halfway done. Slice sausage in thin slices and add with onions to potatoes. Cover and cook until potatoes are done.

recipes.title: Tutti-Frutti Salad
directions: Combine all undrained fruits with the coconut and lemon juice. Sprinkle dry pudding over and toss lightly; chill overnight.
Add bananas before serving if desired.
recipes.text: Tutti-Frutti Salad. Combine all undrained fruits with the coconut and lemon juice. Sprinkle dry pudding over and toss lightly; chill overnight. Add bananas before serving if desired.

recipes.title: Hickory Smoked Pulled Pork
directions: Prepare gas grill, turn half of grill on high, leaving the other half off.
Add water soaked hickory chips to side that is turned on.
Place roast on side that is off.
Grill, covered, until fork slips easily into meat.
Cook slowly so meat does not burn on outside.
When meat is cool enough to handle, shred meat and place in bowl.
Meanwhile, stir together vinegar, water, hot sauce, mustard and salt in small bowl.
Add sauce to meat when ready to eat on buns.
recipes.text: Hickory Smoked Pulled Pork. Prepare gas grill, turn half of grill on high, leaving the other half off. Add water soaked hickory chips to side that is turned on. Place roast on side that is off. Grill, covered, until fork slips easily into meat. Cook slowly so meat does not burn on outside. When meat is cool enough to handle, shred meat and place in bowl. Meanwhile, stir together vinegar, water, hot sauce, mustard and salt in small bowl. Add sauce to meat when ready to eat on buns.

recipes.title: Zucchini Fritters
ingredients: salt, pepper and oregano to taste
