directions: Put together zucchini, flour, eggs, salt, pepper, oregano, garlic, water and cheese.
Mix well.
Heat the oil.
When hot, drop batter by tablespoons into the oil and fry until golden brown. Drain on paper towels!
recipes.text: Zucchini Fritters. Put together zucchini, flour, eggs, salt, pepper, oregano, garlic, water and cheese. Mix well. Heat the oil. When hot, drop batter by tablespoons into the oil and fry until golden brown. Drain on paper towels!

recipes.title: Punch Bowl Cake
directions: Bake cake and let cool.
Put about 1/3 of the cake in bottom of bowl.
Begin to layer each remaining ingredient, using 1/3 of each item.
This includes the cake.
When you finish using all the ingredients the first time, begin another layer until you use all ingredients.
Top off with the coconut.
recipes.text: Punch Bowl Cake. Bake cake and let cool. Put about 1/3 of the cake in bottom of bowl. Begin to layer each remaining ingredient, using 1/3 of each item. This includes the cake. When you finish using all the ingredients the first time, begin another layer until you use all ingredients. Top off with the coconut.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Cookies
directions: Mix peanut butter and margarine.
Add white and brown sugar. Mix well; add eggs.
Beat well.
Stir in flour.
Drop by teaspoon. Bake at 375° for 10 to 15 minutes.
recipes.text: Peanut Butter Cookies. Mix peanut butter and margarine. Add white and brown sugar. Mix well; add eggs. Beat well. Stir in flour. Drop by teaspoon. Bake at 375° for 10 to 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Donald'S Honey Chicken
directions: Season chicken. Bake or fry your chicken. Cover with honey and cook for 5 minutes.
recipes.text: Donald'S Honey Chicken. Season chicken. Bake or fry your chicken. Cover with honey and cook for 5 minutes.

recipes.title: Fresh Strawberry Pie
directions: Boil until thickened and stir in 3 drops of red food color, 3 Tbsp dry strawberry jello. Cool. In a baked pie shell place 1 quart of sliced strawberries, cover with above mixture. Chill. Serve with whipped cream or Cool Whip.
recipes.text: Fresh Strawberry Pie. Boil until thickened and stir in 3 drops of red food color, 3 Tbsp dry strawberry jello. Cool. In a baked pie shell place 1 quart of sliced strawberries, cover with above mixture. Chill. Serve with whipped cream or Cool Whip.

recipes.title: Lemon Dessert
directions: Pour into bowl and mix; refrigerate.
recipes.text: Lemon Dessert. Pour into bowl and mix; refrigerate.

recipes.title: Beef Noodle Casserole
ingredients: 1 lb. egg noodles, cooked and drained
directions: Brown ground beef, salt and pepper to taste.
Add tomato soup and 1/2 can water.
Add mushroom soup and 3/4 can water; add to noodles.
Top with cheese (optional).
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes until cheese is melted and brown.
recipes.text: Beef Noodle Casserole. Brown ground beef, salt and pepper to taste. Add tomato soup and 1/2 can water. Add mushroom soup and 3/4 can water; add to noodles. Top with cheese (optional). Bake at 350° for 30 minutes until cheese is melted and brown.

recipes.title: Corn Pudding
directions: Add corn to beaten eggs, then add all other ingredients.
Mix well.
Pour into greased casserole.
Bake, covered, at 350° for 1 1/2 hours.
recipes.text: Corn Pudding. Add corn to beaten eggs, then add all other ingredients. Mix well. Pour into greased casserole. Bake, covered, at 350° for 1 1/2 hours.

recipes.title: Chocolate-Caramel Layer Squares
ingredients: 1 (18 oz.) pkg. German chocolate cake mix
directions: Combine caramels and 1/3 cup of the milk in top of double boiler.
Melt, stirring constantly, until completely melted. Remove from heat (keep warm so it will not harden).
recipes.text: Chocolate-Caramel Layer Squares. Combine caramels and 1/3 cup of the milk in top of double boiler. Melt, stirring constantly, until completely melted. Remove from heat (keep warm so it will not harden).

recipes.title: Kirsch Fruit Dessert
ingredients: 2 c. fresh, frozen or canned fruit, in 1-inch pieces
4 Tbsp. Kirsch or clear cherry flavored liqueur
directions: Mix fruit with grenadine syrup and Kirsch in bowl.
Cover. Refrigerate 3 hours or more.
When ready, divide mixture between 4 dessert dishes.
Top each serving with a spoon of raspberry sherbet.
Preparation time:
15 to 20 minutes.
recipes.text: Kirsch Fruit Dessert. Mix fruit with grenadine syrup and Kirsch in bowl. Cover. Refrigerate 3 hours or more. When ready, divide mixture between 4 dessert dishes. Top each serving with a spoon of raspberry sherbet. Preparation time: 15 to 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Cinnamon Coffee Cake
directions: Mix with spoon and beat 1/2 minute. Pour into 8x8x2 pan.
recipes.text: Cinnamon Coffee Cake. Mix with spoon and beat 1/2 minute. Pour into 8x8x2 pan.

recipes.title: Sauerkraut Cake With Mocha Frosting
ingredients: 2/3 c. rinsed, drained and chopped sauerkraut
directions: Grease and flour two 8-inch round cake pans.
On wax paper sift together the flour, baking powder, baking soda, salt and cocoa.
In a large mixing bowl cream butter and sugar.
Thoroughly beat in eggs, one at a time, and vanilla.
Stir in dry ingredients, alternating with water until smooth.
Begin and end with dry.
Stir in sauerkraut.
Turn into pans.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes until cake tester comes out clean.
Cool 10 minutes. Turn out on rack to cool.
recipes.text: Sauerkraut Cake With Mocha Frosting. Grease and flour two 8-inch round cake pans. On wax paper sift together the flour, baking powder, baking soda, salt and cocoa. In a large mixing bowl cream butter and sugar. Thoroughly beat in eggs, one at a time, and vanilla. Stir in dry ingredients, alternating with water until smooth. Begin and end with dry. Stir in sauerkraut. Turn into pans. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes until cake tester comes out clean. Cool 10 minutes. Turn out on rack to cool.

recipes.title: Seven Layer Green Salad
directions: In large pan start layers of vegetables with layer of lettuce, then continue with other vegetables.
Spread salad dressing on evenly.
Then sprinkle with Parmesan cheese and bacon.
Cover and refrigerate 24 hours.
Do not toss at serving time.
Use large spoon to serve.
Serves from 8 to 12.
recipes.text: Seven Layer Green Salad. In large pan start layers of vegetables with layer of lettuce, then continue with other vegetables. Spread salad dressing on evenly. Then sprinkle with Parmesan cheese and bacon. Cover and refrigerate 24 hours. Do not toss at serving time. Use large spoon to serve. Serves from 8 to 12.

recipes.title: Palmer'S Company Casserole
ingredients: 1/2 to 1 tsp. garlic powder (depending on taste)
directions: Melt 2 tablespoons butter and brown ground beef.
Add garlic powder, salt, pepper and tomato sauce; mix and simmer 30 minutes. Mix sour cream, cottage cheese and cream cheese in bowl, blending well.
Add green onions and mix again.
Cook the noodles in salted water until al dente (firm); drain and mix with 2 tablespoons butter.
recipes.text: Palmer'S Company Casserole. Melt 2 tablespoons butter and brown ground beef. Add garlic powder, salt, pepper and tomato sauce; mix and simmer 30 minutes. Mix sour cream, cottage cheese and cream cheese in bowl, blending well. Add green onions and mix again. Cook the noodles in salted water until al dente (firm); drain and mix with 2 tablespoons butter.

recipes.title: Sundown'S Grilled Pork Tenderloin
ingredients: pork tenderloin, trimmed of sinew and excess fat
directions: Allow 6 to 8 ounces per person.
recipes.text: Sundown'S Grilled Pork Tenderloin. Allow 6 to 8 ounces per person.

recipes.title: Chicken Surprise
directions: Place oil in skillet and add chicken strips, onion, bell pepper; saute.
Add tomatoes and water, salt and pepper, garlic and potatoes.
Cook on medium heat for 40 minutes.
Serves 4.
recipes.text: Chicken Surprise. Place oil in skillet and add chicken strips, onion, bell pepper; saute. Add tomatoes and water, salt and pepper, garlic and potatoes. Cook on medium heat for 40 minutes. Serves 4.

recipes.title: Almond Bacon Cheese Dip
directions: Chop almonds fine and crumble bacon. Combine all ingredients. Mix lightly. Serve as dip for vegetables or with crackers.
recipes.text: Almond Bacon Cheese Dip. Chop almonds fine and crumble bacon. Combine all ingredients. Mix lightly. Serve as dip for vegetables or with crackers.

recipes.title: Buttermilk Pancakes
directions: Preheat griddle to 350°.
Whisk all dry ingredients together before mixing in liquid ingredients.
Whisk eggs, buttermilk and melted butter into dry mixture.
Batter will be lumpy.
Do not whisk until smooth.
Use a 1/2 cup measuring cup to pour onto griddle.
Turn when surface appears bubbly.
Makes 8 to 10 pancakes.
recipes.text: Buttermilk Pancakes. Preheat griddle to 350°. Whisk all dry ingredients together before mixing in liquid ingredients. Whisk eggs, buttermilk and melted butter into dry mixture. Batter will be lumpy. Do not whisk until smooth. Use a 1/2 cup measuring cup to pour onto griddle. Turn when surface appears bubbly. Makes 8 to 10 pancakes.

recipes.title: Leftover Ham With Noodles
directions: Brown ham in butter.
Add onion and cook until soft.
Add milk to soup.
In casserole, alternate layers of ham/onion, noodles, cheese (cut into strips) and soup mixture.
Repeat until all ingredients are used up.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Leftover Ham With Noodles. Brown ham in butter. Add onion and cook until soft. Add milk to soup. In casserole, alternate layers of ham/onion, noodles, cheese (cut into strips) and soup mixture. Repeat until all ingredients are used up. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Cool Rise Sweet Dough Rolls
directions: Combine 2 cups flour, undissolved yeast, sugar and salt in large bowl.
Using electric mixer, mix well.
Add butter; blend thoroughly.
Add hot tap water.
Beat with electric mixer at medium speed for 2 minutes.
Scrape bowl occasionally.
Add eggs and 1 cup more flour.
Beat with electric mixer at high speed for 1 minute or until thick and elastic.
Gradually stir in just enough of remaining flour with wooden spoon to make a soft dough which leaves sides of bowl.
Turn out onto floured board.
Knead 5 to 10 minutes or until dough is smooth and elastic.
Cover with plastic wrap, then a towel.
recipes.text: Cool Rise Sweet Dough Rolls. Combine 2 cups flour, undissolved yeast, sugar and salt in large bowl. Using electric mixer, mix well. Add butter; blend thoroughly. Add hot tap water. Beat with electric mixer at medium speed for 2 minutes. Scrape bowl occasionally. Add eggs and 1 cup more flour. Beat with electric mixer at high speed for 1 minute or until thick and elastic. Gradually stir in just enough of remaining flour with wooden spoon to make a soft dough which leaves sides of bowl. Turn out onto floured board. Knead 5 to 10 minutes or until dough is smooth and elastic. Cover with plastic wrap, then a towel.

recipes.title: Quiche
directions: Layer ham, cheese and onion in pie plate.
Combine baking mix, milk, eggs, salt and pepper in blender.
Process until smooth. Pour over layers.
Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.
Cut into wedges.
recipes.text: Quiche. Layer ham, cheese and onion in pie plate. Combine baking mix, milk, eggs, salt and pepper in blender. Process until smooth. Pour over layers. Bake at 350° for 40 minutes. Cut into wedges.

recipes.title: Sweet Potato Pecan Pie
directions: Cook and mash sweet potatoes.
Combine all ingredients in a bowl, stirring until well blended.
Pour into pie shell and bake at 375° for 50 to 55 minutes or until knife inserted in center comes out clean.
recipes.text: Sweet Potato Pecan Pie. Cook and mash sweet potatoes. Combine all ingredients in a bowl, stirring until well blended. Pour into pie shell and bake at 375° for 50 to 55 minutes or until knife inserted in center comes out clean.

recipes.title: Vegetable Salad
directions: Bring oil, pepper, sugar, vinegar, salt and water to a boil for 1 minute.
Let cool and pour over vegetables.
recipes.text: Vegetable Salad. Bring oil, pepper, sugar, vinegar, salt and water to a boil for 1 minute. Let cool and pour over vegetables.

recipes.title: Green Bean Casserole
directions: Put green beans in greased baking dish.
Mix milk with mushroom soup and pour over beans. Top with crushed chips.
Bake at 375° for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Green Bean Casserole. Put green beans in greased baking dish. Mix milk with mushroom soup and pour over beans. Top with crushed chips. Bake at 375° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Crisscross Cookies
directions: Cream shortening and sugar.
Add beaten egg and beat until mixture is fluffy.
Mix in flour, salt and vanilla and blend well.
recipes.text: Crisscross Cookies. Cream shortening and sugar. Add beaten egg and beat until mixture is fluffy. Mix in flour, salt and vanilla and blend well.

recipes.title: Farmer'S Breakfast
directions: Fry bacon and break into pieces.
Reserve 3 tablespoons drippings; add pepper, onions and potatoes.
Cook on medium heat for 5 minutes, until potatoes are brown.
Sprinkle with cheese. Melt.
Scramble eggs.
Add bacon, salt and pepper.
Mix together.
recipes.text: Farmer'S Breakfast. Fry bacon and break into pieces. Reserve 3 tablespoons drippings; add pepper, onions and potatoes. Cook on medium heat for 5 minutes, until potatoes are brown. Sprinkle with cheese. Melt. Scramble eggs. Add bacon, salt and pepper. Mix together.

recipes.title: Easy Homemade Chili
ingredients: 1 qt. water (more or less to desired thickness)
directions: In large saucepan, mix chili seasoning and tomato paste.
Add ground beef and beans.
Stir well.
Add water to desired thickness.
Cook on medium heat until simmers.
Lower heat and simmer 1 hour or until desired flavor.
recipes.text: Easy Homemade Chili. In large saucepan, mix chili seasoning and tomato paste. Add ground beef and beans. Stir well. Add water to desired thickness. Cook on medium heat until simmers. Lower heat and simmer 1 hour or until desired flavor.

recipes.title: Swedish Meatballs
ingredients: 1/2 tsp. thyme leaves, dried and crushed
directions: Mix ground turkey, onion, egg, bread crumbs, nutmeg, allspice, thyme, salt and pepper.
Form into balls about the size of a walnut.
Heat a small amount of oil in a heavy skillet over moderately high heat.
Brown meatballs; remove from skillet.
Add enough oil to skillet to equal 3 tablespoons.
When hot, stir in 1/4 cup flour.
Continue stirring until flour is golden brown. Pour in beef broth, stirring constantly.
When gravy has thickened, return meatballs to skillet.
Reduce heat; add parsley. Simmer for 20 minutes; do not boil.
Serve over cooked noodles. Makes 6 to 8 servings.
recipes.text: Swedish Meatballs. Mix ground turkey, onion, egg, bread crumbs, nutmeg, allspice, thyme, salt and pepper. Form into balls about the size of a walnut. Heat a small amount of oil in a heavy skillet over moderately high heat. Brown meatballs; remove from skillet. Add enough oil to skillet to equal 3 tablespoons. When hot, stir in 1/4 cup flour. Continue stirring until flour is golden brown. Pour in beef broth, stirring constantly. When gravy has thickened, return meatballs to skillet. Reduce heat; add parsley. Simmer for 20 minutes; do not boil. Serve over cooked noodles. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter And Jelly Bars
directions: Combine flour, sugar and baking powder.
Cut in margarine until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
Stir in beaten eggs; stir until mixture is smooth.
Reserve one half of mixture; press remaining half of mixture onto bottom of greased 13 x 9-inch pan. Spread grape jelly over crust in pan.
Sprinkle 1 cup Reese's peanut butter chips over jelly.
Crumble remaining dough over chips.
Bake at 375° for 30 to 35 minutes or until lightly browned.
Remove from oven immediately.
Sprinkle with remaining 1 cup chips.
Cool and cut into squares.
recipes.text: Peanut Butter And Jelly Bars. Combine flour, sugar and baking powder. Cut in margarine until mixture resembles coarse crumbs. Stir in beaten eggs; stir until mixture is smooth. Reserve one half of mixture; press remaining half of mixture onto bottom of greased 13 x 9-inch pan. Spread grape jelly over crust in pan. Sprinkle 1 cup Reese's peanut butter chips over jelly. Crumble remaining dough over chips. Bake at 375° for 30 to 35 minutes or until lightly browned. Remove from oven immediately. Sprinkle with remaining 1 cup chips. Cool and cut into squares.

recipes.title: Milk Shake
ingredients: 2 Tbsp. chocolate syrup or 1 Tbsp. jam
directions: Place ice cream, milk and chocolate syrup or jam into a mixing bowl.
Beat with rotary egg beater or mixer until well blended. Pour in a cold glass to serve.
Makes 1 serving.
recipes.text: Milk Shake. Place ice cream, milk and chocolate syrup or jam into a mixing bowl. Beat with rotary egg beater or mixer until well blended. Pour in a cold glass to serve. Makes 1 serving.

recipes.title: Potato Soup
directions: Peel potatoes and cut into bite sized squares.
Cover with water and cook; drain.
Add butter, onions, soup, chowder, milk and salt and pepper.
Bring to a boil, then simmer until soup is right consistency.
I prefer this to simmer in crock-pot for 2 to 3 hours.
recipes.text: Potato Soup. Peel potatoes and cut into bite sized squares. Cover with water and cook; drain. Add butter, onions, soup, chowder, milk and salt and pepper. Bring to a boil, then simmer until soup is right consistency. I prefer this to simmer in crock-pot for 2 to 3 hours.

recipes.title: A Cake Mix
directions: This is the first cake I learned to bake at the age of 8 years old.
recipes.text: A Cake Mix. This is the first cake I learned to bake at the age of 8 years old.

recipes.title: Pecan Pralines(May Also Use For A Frosting.)
directions: Combine sugar, soda, butter milk and salt. Cook over high heat 5 minutes, stirring constantly and scraping bottom of pan. Add butter and pecans. Continue cooking until candy reaches soft-ball (cook less time for frosting). Remove from heat and cool slightly. Beat until thick and creamy. Drop by tablespoon onto wax paper and let cool.
recipes.text: Pecan Pralines(May Also Use For A Frosting.). Combine sugar, soda, butter milk and salt. Cook over high heat 5 minutes, stirring constantly and scraping bottom of pan. Add butter and pecans. Continue cooking until candy reaches soft-ball (cook less time for frosting). Remove from heat and cool slightly. Beat until thick and creamy. Drop by tablespoon onto wax paper and let cool.

recipes.title: Lasagna Sausage Pinwheels
ingredients: 1 lb. hot Italian link sausage, cut into 1-inch pieces
directions: Brown sausage over low heat in a large, heavy skillet; drain sausage on paper towels, reserving 1/4 cup drippings.
Saute onion and garlic in drippings until crisp-tender.
Return sausage to skillet; stir in tomato paste, water, sugar, 1/2 teaspoon salt and bay leaf.
Simmer, uncovered, for 1 hour; stir occasionally. Discard bay leaf.
recipes.text: Lasagna Sausage Pinwheels. Brown sausage over low heat in a large, heavy skillet; drain sausage on paper towels, reserving 1/4 cup drippings. Saute onion and garlic in drippings until crisp-tender. Return sausage to skillet; stir in tomato paste, water, sugar, 1/2 teaspoon salt and bay leaf. Simmer, uncovered, for 1 hour; stir occasionally. Discard bay leaf.

recipes.title: Life'S Recipe
directions: (A recipe passed on through the ages.)
recipes.text: Life'S Recipe. (A recipe passed on through the ages.)

recipes.title: Avocado Dip
directions: Put in small container.
Mix well.
Garnish with avocado seed to keep from turning brown.
recipes.text: Avocado Dip. Put in small container. Mix well. Garnish with avocado seed to keep from turning brown.

recipes.title: Death By Chocolate
ingredients: 1 tsp. sugar, mixed with 4 Tbsp. leftover black coffee
8 (1/4 oz. size) Skor or Heath bars
3 (3 to 5 oz.) boxes Jell-O chocolate mousse
directions: Bake brownies according to directions; cool.
Punch holes in brownies; pour coffee over brownies.
Set aside.
Whip up chocolate mousse according to directions.
Break candy bars into small pieces in food processor or by tapping them with a hammer. Break 1/2 brownies and place in trifle dish.
Cover with 1/2 of the mousse; layer with 1/2 candy, then add 1/2 whipped topping. Repeat layers with remaining ingredients.
recipes.text: Death By Chocolate. Bake brownies according to directions; cool. Punch holes in brownies; pour coffee over brownies. Set aside. Whip up chocolate mousse according to directions. Break candy bars into small pieces in food processor or by tapping them with a hammer. Break 1/2 brownies and place in trifle dish. Cover with 1/2 of the mousse; layer with 1/2 candy, then add 1/2 whipped topping. Repeat layers with remaining ingredients.

directions: In
a
large
soup pot saute onion, celery and carrots. Add seasonings	to
taste.
Fill
pot 1/2 full of water.
Add potatoes that
were peeled and chopped, after water starts to boil.

Cook

potatoes
are almost tender.	Add canned
milk

Slightly mash some of the
potatoes. Cook
until cheese melts and potatoes are done but not mushy. Enjoy with cornbread!
recipes.text: Potato Soup. In a large soup pot saute onion, celery and carrots. Add seasonings	to taste. Fill pot 1/2 full of water. Add potatoes that were peeled and chopped, after water starts to boil. Add chicken broth. Cook until potatoes are almost tender.	Add canned milk and cheese. Slightly mash some of the potatoes. Cook until cheese melts and potatoes are done but not mushy. Enjoy with cornbread!

recipes.title: Gumdrop Cookies
directions: Stir flour, oats, gumdrops, baking powder, soda and salt and set aside.
With mixer, cream margarine, sugar and vanilla until fluffy.
Beat in egg and stir in flour mixture.
recipes.text: Gumdrop Cookies. Stir flour, oats, gumdrops, baking powder, soda and salt and set aside. With mixer, cream margarine, sugar and vanilla until fluffy. Beat in egg and stir in flour mixture.

recipes.title: Chicken Cacciatore
directions: Place onions in bottom of crock-pot. Add chicken. Stir remaining ingredients together and pour over the chicken. Cook on low 7 to 9 hours or on high 3 to 4 hours. Serve with noodles or pasta.
recipes.text: Chicken Cacciatore. Place onions in bottom of crock-pot. Add chicken. Stir remaining ingredients together and pour over the chicken. Cook on low 7 to 9 hours or on high 3 to 4 hours. Serve with noodles or pasta.

recipes.title: Chicken Sibelius
ingredients: 2 whole chicken breasts, boned and cut into 3-inch pieces
2 pkg. (10 oz. each) frozen asparagus spears, cooked
1 (10 1/2 oz.) can condensed cream of chicken soup
directions: Season chicken with salt and poultry seasoning.
Melt margarine in large skillet; add chicken and saute until brown. Arrange asparagus in bottom of a greased 1 1/2-quart shallow baking dish.
Top with chicken.
Combine soup, cream and curry powder.
Pour over chicken and asparagus.
Top with cheese.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until done.
Makes 4 servings.
recipes.text: Chicken Sibelius. Season chicken with salt and poultry seasoning. Melt margarine in large skillet; add chicken and saute until brown. Arrange asparagus in bottom of a greased 1 1/2-quart shallow baking dish. Top with chicken. Combine soup, cream and curry powder. Pour over chicken and asparagus. Top with cheese. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until done. Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: Spread Cheese
directions: In a large mixing bowl, combine softened cheese and sour cream.
Add wine and beat with mixer until well blended.
Stir in herbs (do not beat).
This can be pressed into a 2-cup mold that has been sprayed with nonstick coating or covered container. Refrigerate at least 24 hours before serving.
Excellent cracker spread or omelette filling.
recipes.text: Spread Cheese. In a large mixing bowl, combine softened cheese and sour cream. Add wine and beat with mixer until well blended. Stir in herbs (do not beat). This can be pressed into a 2-cup mold that has been sprayed with nonstick coating or covered container. Refrigerate at least 24 hours before serving. Excellent cracker spread or omelette filling.

recipes.title: Hot Ham And Cauliflower Dish
ingredients: 4 c. cut up cauliflower and/or broccoli
directions: Cook cauliflower and/or broccoli in a small amount of boiling salted water, covered, until crisp and tender.
Drain well; remove from pan.
recipes.text: Hot Ham And Cauliflower Dish. Cook cauliflower and/or broccoli in a small amount of boiling salted water, covered, until crisp and tender. Drain well; remove from pan.

recipes.title: Quick And Easy Lemon Pie
ingredients: 1 large size container whipped topping (Cool Whip)
1 small (6 oz.) can frozen concentrate lemonade
2 pie shells (either baked pastry or graham cracker)
directions: Mix whipped topping and condensed milk.
Add frozen lemonade (do not dilute or unthaw).
Mix all ingredients well.
Pour into 2 pie shells (either baked and cooled pastry or graham cracker, your choice).
Let it stand in refrigerator several hours or overnight. Serve cold.
recipes.text: Quick And Easy Lemon Pie. Mix whipped topping and condensed milk. Add frozen lemonade (do not dilute or unthaw). Mix all ingredients well. Pour into 2 pie shells (either baked and cooled pastry or graham cracker, your choice). Let it stand in refrigerator several hours or overnight. Serve cold.

recipes.title: Best Beans You'Ll Ever Eat
ingredients: 1 lb. ground beef, browned and drained
1 c. ketchup or more to taste
directions: Mix all the ingredients and cook slowly.
recipes.text: Best Beans You'Ll Ever Eat. Mix all the ingredients and cook slowly.

recipes.title: Two Bean And Rice Salad
ingredients: 1 (15 oz.) can pinto beans, rinsed and drained
1 15 oz.) can black beans, rinsed and drained
2 (4 oz.) cans diced green chili peppers, drained
1 recipe garlic dressing or 1 (8 oz.) jar Italian salad dressing
directions: In a 1 1/2 qt. covered container combine cooked rice, pinto beans, black beans, peas, celery, onion, diced green chili peppers, and the 1/2 cup cilantro. Add the dressing to the rice mixture; toss gently to mix. Cover and chill up to 24 hours. To serve, transfer the chilled salad to a serving bowl. If desired, garnish with cilantro sprigs, and whole chili peppers. Makes 16 servings.
recipes.text: Two Bean And Rice Salad. In a 1 1/2 qt. covered container combine cooked rice, pinto beans, black beans, peas, celery, onion, diced green chili peppers, and the 1/2 cup cilantro. Add the dressing to the rice mixture; toss gently to mix. Cover and chill up to 24 hours. To serve, transfer the chilled salad to a serving bowl. If desired, garnish with cilantro sprigs, and whole chili peppers. Makes 16 servings.

recipes.title: Stay Soft Chocolate Frosting
directions: Blend together cocoa, cornstarch and sugar.
Add milk, a little at a time.
Cook slowly until thickened.
Remove from heat. Add vanilla and butter.
Stir gently, until cool and thick enough to spread.
This will frost 2 layers.
recipes.text: Stay Soft Chocolate Frosting. Blend together cocoa, cornstarch and sugar. Add milk, a little at a time. Cook slowly until thickened. Remove from heat. Add vanilla and butter. Stir gently, until cool and thick enough to spread. This will frost 2 layers.

recipes.title: Hand Dipped Chocolates
directions: Mix all ingredients (will be stiff).
Chill overnight.
Make into 1-inch balls.
Line on a cookie sheet and chill overnight again.
recipes.text: Hand Dipped Chocolates. Mix all ingredients (will be stiff). Chill overnight. Make into 1-inch balls. Line on a cookie sheet and chill overnight again.

recipes.title: Jello Dessert
directions: Mix jello with 2 cups boiling water.
Add 1 1/2 cups cold water.
When dissolved, mix pineapple and strawberries into jello. Pour 1/2 of mixture into pan; let set until firm.
Spread sour cream over layer.
Add bananas.
Pour rest of mixture and chill.
recipes.text: Jello Dessert. Mix jello with 2 cups boiling water. Add 1 1/2 cups cold water. When dissolved, mix pineapple and strawberries into jello. Pour 1/2 of mixture into pan; let set until firm. Spread sour cream over layer. Add bananas. Pour rest of mixture and chill.

recipes.title: Sugarless Cake
directions: Blend dates, eggs and juice. Add flour, cinnamon and salt; mix well. Add oil, carrots and nuts. Blend well. Spread in greased and floured 9 x 13 inch pan. Bake at 350 degrees for 40 minutes. Serve with non-dairy whipped topping.
recipes.text: Sugarless Cake. Blend dates, eggs and juice. Add flour, cinnamon and salt; mix well. Add oil, carrots and nuts. Blend well. Spread in greased and floured 9 x 13 inch pan. Bake at 350 degrees for 40 minutes. Serve with non-dairy whipped topping.

recipes.title: Corn Bread
directions: Mix all ingredients together good.
Grease a big bread pan with oil.
Pour in bread pan.
Bake in oven at 325° for about 25 minutes or until done.
Eat hot with milk or butter.
recipes.text: Corn Bread. Mix all ingredients together good. Grease a big bread pan with oil. Pour in bread pan. Bake in oven at 325° for about 25 minutes or until done. Eat hot with milk or butter.

recipes.title: Pasta Salad
ingredients: salad seasoning to taste (this is a spice)
directions: Cook pasta as directed on package.
Chop vegetables to desired size pieces.
If desired, other vegetables may be added.
Add as much salad seasoning as you desire.
Pour on the salad dressing and refrigerate until cool.
Mix well before serving.
recipes.text: Pasta Salad. Cook pasta as directed on package. Chop vegetables to desired size pieces. If desired, other vegetables may be added. Add as much salad seasoning as you desire. Pour on the salad dressing and refrigerate until cool. Mix well before serving.

recipes.title: Frozen Pineapple Salad
directions: Fold sour cream, lemon juice, sugar and salt into whipped cream; add remaining ingredients except salad dressing.
Spoon into paper muffin cups; freeze until solid.
Unmold on lettuce; top with salad dressing.
Yield:
18 small servings.
recipes.text: Frozen Pineapple Salad. Fold sour cream, lemon juice, sugar and salt into whipped cream; add remaining ingredients except salad dressing. Spoon into paper muffin cups; freeze until solid. Unmold on lettuce; top with salad dressing. Yield: 18 small servings.

recipes.title: Squash Casserole
ingredients: 1 pkg. Pepperidge Farm herbed seasoned crumbs
directions: Cook and mash squash; add soup, sour cream, grated carrot, onion, salt and pepper.
Butter casserole dish.
Cover bottom with crumbs.
Add squash mixture.
Cover with additional crumbs and dot with chunks of butter.
Bake at 350° for 35 minutes.
recipes.text: Squash Casserole. Cook and mash squash; add soup, sour cream, grated carrot, onion, salt and pepper. Butter casserole dish. Cover bottom with crumbs. Add squash mixture. Cover with additional crumbs and dot with chunks of butter. Bake at 350° for 35 minutes.

recipes.title: Mayonnaise Cake
directions: Mix all ingredients and bake in oblong cake pan at 350° until done.
recipes.text: Mayonnaise Cake. Mix all ingredients and bake in oblong cake pan at 350° until done.

recipes.title: French Fried Onion Rings
ingredients: 2 to 3 large onions, peeled and sliced 1/4 inch thick
directions: Sift flour.
Mix salt, flour, milk, oil and egg white, then beat until smooth.
Add water to make a medium-thin batter.
recipes.text: French Fried Onion Rings. Sift flour. Mix salt, flour, milk, oil and egg white, then beat until smooth. Add water to make a medium-thin batter.

recipes.title: Greek Butter Crescents
directions: With electric mixer, cream together butter and Crisco.
Add 10x sugar and eggs.
Gradually add flour.
Form into crescents. Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.
Cool.
Sift 10x sugar over cookies. Makes approximately 10 dozen cookies.
recipes.text: Greek Butter Crescents. With electric mixer, cream together butter and Crisco. Add 10x sugar and eggs. Gradually add flour. Form into crescents. Bake at 350° for 25 minutes. Cool. Sift 10x sugar over cookies. Makes approximately 10 dozen cookies.

recipes.title: Poppy Seed Bread
ingredients: 1 box Betty Crocker SuperMoist butter pecan cake mix
1 (3 3/8 oz.) Royal instant toasted coconut pudding mix
directions: Preheat oven to 350°.
Spray 2 bread pans with Pam.
Combine the ingredients.
Pour into prepared pans and bake for 45 to 50 minutes.
Leave bread in pan for 5 minutes to cool before removing from bread pans.
recipes.text: Poppy Seed Bread. Preheat oven to 350°. Spray 2 bread pans with Pam. Combine the ingredients. Pour into prepared pans and bake for 45 to 50 minutes. Leave bread in pan for 5 minutes to cool before removing from bread pans.

recipes.title: Ragu No-Boiling Lasagna
ingredients: 2 (2 lb.) jars Ragu rich and meaty mean sauce
directions: Preheat oven to 375°. In bowl,

combine Ricotta cheese, 1 cup Mozzarella cheese, 1/4 cup Parmesan cheese and eggs. In 13 x 9-inch baking dish, spread 1/2 of one jar of pasta sauce. Layer 4 uncooked noodles, then 1/2 jar of pasta sauce and 1/2 of the Ricotta cheese mixture; repeat. Top with remaining 4 uncooked noodles and rest of pasta sauce. Cover tightly with aluminum foil and bake 1 hour. Remove foil and sprinkle remaining cheeses. Bake, uncovered, an additional 10 minutes. Let stand 10 minutes before serving.
recipes.text: Ragu No-Boiling Lasagna. Preheat oven to 375°. In bowl, combine Ricotta cheese, 1 cup Mozzarella cheese, 1/4 cup Parmesan cheese and eggs. In 13 x 9-inch baking dish, spread 1/2 of one jar of pasta sauce. Layer 4 uncooked noodles, then 1/2 jar of pasta sauce and 1/2 of the Ricotta cheese mixture; repeat. Top with remaining 4 uncooked noodles and rest of pasta sauce. Cover tightly with aluminum foil and bake 1 hour. Remove foil and sprinkle remaining cheeses. Bake, uncovered, an additional 10 minutes. Let stand 10 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Pie
directions: Whip cream cheese with a mixer; add powdered sugar, beating until smooth, then add peanut butter and milk, again beating until smooth.
Fold in Cool Whip and pour into pie shells.
Refrigerate or can be put in freezer for 4 to 6 hours.
recipes.text: Peanut Butter Pie. Whip cream cheese with a mixer; add powdered sugar, beating until smooth, then add peanut butter and milk, again beating until smooth. Fold in Cool Whip and pour into pie shells. Refrigerate or can be put in freezer for 4 to 6 hours.

recipes.title: Chicken Cacciatore Supreme
ingredients: 1 3/4 lb. boneless chicken breasts, cut into large pieces
directions: It's best to precook chicken for about 30 minutes, either roasting
recipes.text: Chicken Cacciatore Supreme. It's best to precook chicken for about 30 minutes, either roasting

recipes.title: Ozark Apple Pudding
directions: Beat egg and sugar together until very smooth.
Mix together flour, baking powder and salt; stir into egg mixture.
Stir in walnuts, apple and vanilla.
Turn into greased and floured 1-quart baking dish and bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.
Makes four servings.
Good with ice cream or whipped cream.
recipes.text: Ozark Apple Pudding. Beat egg and sugar together until very smooth. Mix together flour, baking powder and salt; stir into egg mixture. Stir in walnuts, apple and vanilla. Turn into greased and floured 1-quart baking dish and bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes. Makes four servings. Good with ice cream or whipped cream.

recipes.title: Sour Cream Raisin Bars
directions: Mix first 5 ingredients.
Pat half of the mixture in a 9 x 13-inch pan and bake at 350° for 10 to 15 minutes.
recipes.text: Sour Cream Raisin Bars. Mix first 5 ingredients. Pat half of the mixture in a 9 x 13-inch pan and bake at 350° for 10 to 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Creamy Macaroni And Cheese
ingredients: 1/2 lb. mild Longhorn Cheddar cheese, grated
directions: In 3-quart pan, saute onion in margarine until translucent. Sprinkle flour, mustard, salt and pepper, continuing to stir vigorously.
Slowly stir in milk, continuously stirring until mixture boils; boil 2 minutes.
Remove from heat; blend in grated cheese.
Drain macaroni well and add to the sauce.
Spray large baking dish with Pam; add mixture.
Mix bread crumbs with paprika; sprinkle on top.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or at 425° for 15 to 20 minutes.
recipes.text: Creamy Macaroni And Cheese. In 3-quart pan, saute onion in margarine until translucent. Sprinkle flour, mustard, salt and pepper, continuing to stir vigorously. Slowly stir in milk, continuously stirring until mixture boils; boil 2 minutes. Remove from heat; blend in grated cheese. Drain macaroni well and add to the sauce. Spray large baking dish with Pam; add mixture. Mix bread crumbs with paprika; sprinkle on top. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or at 425° for 15 to 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Three Bean Casserole
ingredients: 1 (15 oz.) can garbanzo beans or chick peas, drained
1 (4 oz.) can green hot chilies, drained
directions: This casserole requires only 15 minutes preparation time.
A great dish for those busy Moms and Dads.
recipes.text: Three Bean Casserole. This casserole requires only 15 minutes preparation time. A great dish for those busy Moms and Dads.

recipes.title: Sausage And Rice Bake
directions: Cook sausage until brown and crumbly, drain and set aside. Combine rice and 1-1/2 cups of cheese. Spread rice mixture in greased 12 x 8 x 2 baking dish, sprinkle with sausage. Combine soup and milk, pour over sausage, sprinkle with crumbled bacon and the remaining cheese and cover with bread crumbs (as desired). Bake at 350° for 30 minutes. Can also be frozen for later date.
recipes.text: Sausage And Rice Bake. Cook sausage until brown and crumbly, drain and set aside. Combine rice and 1-1/2 cups of cheese. Spread rice mixture in greased 12 x 8 x 2 baking dish, sprinkle with sausage. Combine soup and milk, pour over sausage, sprinkle with crumbled bacon and the remaining cheese and cover with bread crumbs (as desired). Bake at 350° for 30 minutes. Can also be frozen for later date.

recipes.title: Scalloped Pineapple
ingredients: 2 (15 oz.) cans pineapple chunks (drain 1 can, use juice from the other)
5 slices white bread, cut in 1-inch cubes
directions: Combine all ingredients in a medium mixing bowl; mix well. Pour into a greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Scalloped Pineapple. Combine all ingredients in a medium mixing bowl; mix well. Pour into a greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Chicken Divan
ingredients: 1 (10 oz.) can cream of mushroom soup
directions: Melt margarine in skillet. Sprinkle salt and paprika over chicken; brown. Remove from pan.
Lay broccoli in single layer in 13 x 9-inch baking dish.
Layer chicken. Combine soup, mayonnaise and lemon juice. Spread over chicken. Bake 20 to 25 minutes at 350°.
Sprinkle cheese over top and broil 2 to 3 minutes until browned.
recipes.text: Chicken Divan. Melt margarine in skillet. Sprinkle salt and paprika over chicken; brown. Remove from pan. Lay broccoli in single layer in 13 x 9-inch baking dish. Layer chicken. Combine soup, mayonnaise and lemon juice. Spread over chicken. Bake 20 to 25 minutes at 350°. Sprinkle cheese over top and broil 2 to 3 minutes until browned.

recipes.title: Tomato Buttermilk Soup
directions: Cook onion in oil in medium saucepan until lightly brown.
Stir in flour, then add 2 cups buttermilk.
Stir over low heat until thick.
Add tomatoes and remaining 1 cup buttermilk, salt, pepper and parsley.
Heat, but do not boil.
Makes about 5 cups.
recipes.text: Tomato Buttermilk Soup. Cook onion in oil in medium saucepan until lightly brown. Stir in flour, then add 2 cups buttermilk. Stir over low heat until thick. Add tomatoes and remaining 1 cup buttermilk, salt, pepper and parsley. Heat, but do not boil. Makes about 5 cups.

recipes.title: Apple Skillet Cake
directions: Melt butter in heavy skillet, measuring 10-inches across top. Remove from heat.
Add brown sugar.
Arrange apples in skillet. Add raisins.
Sift together flour, baking powder and salt.
Set aside.
Add brown sugar and sugar gradually to shortening, creaming well.
Blend in egg yolks and vanilla.
Beat well.
Add dry ingredients alternately with milk.
Blend thoroughly after each addition.
recipes.text: Apple Skillet Cake. Melt butter in heavy skillet, measuring 10-inches across top. Remove from heat. Add brown sugar. Arrange apples in skillet. Add raisins. Sift together flour, baking powder and salt. Set aside. Add brown sugar and sugar gradually to shortening, creaming well. Blend in egg yolks and vanilla. Beat well. Add dry ingredients alternately with milk. Blend thoroughly after each addition.

recipes.title: Chewy Cake
directions: Melt butter; stir in brown sugar.
Beat in eggs one at a time. Add the rest of the ingredients.
Pour in greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350° for about 20 minutes.
Cool and cut.
recipes.text: Chewy Cake. Melt butter; stir in brown sugar. Beat in eggs one at a time. Add the rest of the ingredients. Pour in greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350° for about 20 minutes. Cool and cut.

recipes.title: Forgotten Cookies
directions: Preheat oven to 375°.
Beat white of eggs and salt until very stiff.
Gradually beat in sugar for stiff meringue.
Beat in vanilla and mix in chocolate chips.
Drop by teaspoon on greased cookie sheet.
Put in oven and turn off heat.
Let cookies stay in oven for 8 to 10 hours.
recipes.text: Forgotten Cookies. Preheat oven to 375°. Beat white of eggs and salt until very stiff. Gradually beat in sugar for stiff meringue. Beat in vanilla and mix in chocolate chips. Drop by teaspoon on greased cookie sheet. Put in oven and turn off heat. Let cookies stay in oven for 8 to 10 hours.

recipes.title: Barbecue
directions: Hamburger:
Brown hamburger and onion; drain excess grease. Add remaining ingredients.
Simmer 20 minutes.
recipes.text: Barbecue. Hamburger: Brown hamburger and onion; drain excess grease. Add remaining ingredients. Simmer 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Brownie Cake With Buttermilk Icing
directions: Sift flour, salt and sugar; set aside.
Bring margarine, cocoa and water to boil.
Pour over flour and sugar mixture; stir quickly.
Whisk together the eggs, buttermilk, soda, salt and vanilla.
Pour into the other mixture; beat well.
Bake in a greased and floured pan (15 x 18-inch) for 20 minutes at 350°. Five minutes before cake is done, make the Buttermilk Icing.
recipes.text: Brownie Cake With Buttermilk Icing. Sift flour, salt and sugar; set aside. Bring margarine, cocoa and water to boil. Pour over flour and sugar mixture; stir quickly. Whisk together the eggs, buttermilk, soda, salt and vanilla. Pour into the other mixture; beat well. Bake in a greased and floured pan (15 x 18-inch) for 20 minutes at 350°. Five minutes before cake is done, make the Buttermilk Icing.

recipes.title: Chicken Casserole
directions: Heat soups, water and margarine until margarine melts.
Put rice on bottom of 9 x 13-inch dish.
Place chicken on top of rice. Pour soups over chicken and rice.
Bake at 300° for 3 hours.
recipes.text: Chicken Casserole. Heat soups, water and margarine until margarine melts. Put rice on bottom of 9 x 13-inch dish. Place chicken on top of rice. Pour soups over chicken and rice. Bake at 300° for 3 hours.

recipes.title: Corn Pudding
directions: Mix all ingredients together and bake at 375°F for 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Corn Pudding. Mix all ingredients together and bake at 375°F for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Taco Salad
directions: Brown hamburger and onions. Drain off fat. Add salt and pepper to taste. Add taco seasoning mix (without water).
Add hamburger to lettuce and tomatoes. Let stand at least 1 1/2 hours, then add cheese. Add chips and sauce when ready to serve.
recipes.text: Taco Salad. Brown hamburger and onions. Drain off fat. Add salt and pepper to taste. Add taco seasoning mix (without water). Add hamburger to lettuce and tomatoes. Let stand at least 1 1/2 hours, then add cheese. Add chips and sauce when ready to serve.

recipes.title: Grits Casserole 2
directions: Cook grits in boiling water for 15 minutes.
Mix all ingredients together and place in greased casserole.
Bake at 400° for 30 minutes.
Delicious with ham.
recipes.text: Grits Casserole 2. Cook grits in boiling water for 15 minutes. Mix all ingredients together and place in greased casserole. Bake at 400° for 30 minutes. Delicious with ham.

recipes.title: Company Crab
directions: Thaw crabmeat, if frozen; drain.
Remove any shell or cartilage.
Cut artichoke hearts in half.
Place artichokes in a well-greased shallow 1 1/2-quart casserole.
Cover with mushrooms and crabmeat.
Melt butter in saucepan; blend in flour and seasonings.
Add cream gradually and cook until thick, stirring constantly.
Stir in sherry.
Pour sauce over crabmeat.
Combine crumbs and cheese.
Sprinkle over sauce.
Sprinkle with paprika. Bake at 350° for 15 minutes, until bubbly.
Makes 6 servings.
recipes.text: Company Crab. Thaw crabmeat, if frozen; drain. Remove any shell or cartilage. Cut artichoke hearts in half. Place artichokes in a well-greased shallow 1 1/2-quart casserole. Cover with mushrooms and crabmeat. Melt butter in saucepan; blend in flour and seasonings. Add cream gradually and cook until thick, stirring constantly. Stir in sherry. Pour sauce over crabmeat. Combine crumbs and cheese. Sprinkle over sauce. Sprinkle with paprika. Bake at 350° for 15 minutes, until bubbly. Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Elaine'S Brisket
ingredients: 1 brisket (can use chuck roast or other cuts of pot roast)
directions: Put meat in roaster pan, without lid, and sear on high heat using oven at 450°.
Turn after about 15 minutes.
Now, pour remaining ingredients in with brisket.
Cover pan with lid or foil.
Pour ginger ale halfway up pot (don't cover pan completely).
Cook at 350° for 2 1/2 hours, covered.
No fail recipe.
recipes.text: Elaine'S Brisket. Put meat in roaster pan, without lid, and sear on high heat using oven at 450°. Turn after about 15 minutes. Now, pour remaining ingredients in with brisket. Cover pan with lid or foil. Pour ginger ale halfway up pot (don't cover pan completely). Cook at 350° for 2 1/2 hours, covered. No fail recipe.

recipes.title: Chicken Noodle Casserole Royale
ingredients: 2 c. cooked noodles (3 to 4 oz. uncooked)
directions: Bake chicken breast halves at 350° for 45 minutes to 1 hour (or until done).
Remove chicken from bones and discard skin.
Cut meat into bite-size pieces (1 1/2 to 2 cups of chicken).
Combine in 1 1/2-quart casserole, soup, sour cream and thyme.
Stir in cooked noodles, diced pimento and chicken meat.
Top with bread crumbs combined with poppy seed.
Bake at 375° for 30 minutes. Serves 6.
recipes.text: Chicken Noodle Casserole Royale. Bake chicken breast halves at 350° for 45 minutes to 1 hour (or until done). Remove chicken from bones and discard skin. Cut meat into bite-size pieces (1 1/2 to 2 cups of chicken). Combine in 1 1/2-quart casserole, soup, sour cream and thyme. Stir in cooked noodles, diced pimento and chicken meat. Top with bread crumbs combined with poppy seed. Bake at 375° for 30 minutes. Serves 6.

recipes.title: Birds' Nest
directions: Form into small balls.
Dip in slightly beaten egg whites. Roll in nuts; press hollow in center (using back of teaspoon). Bake 8 minutes in 350° oven.
Remove from oven and fill centers with jam or date-nut filling.
Return to oven.
Bake 10 minutes longer.
recipes.text: Birds' Nest. Form into small balls. Dip in slightly beaten egg whites. Roll in nuts; press hollow in center (using back of teaspoon). Bake 8 minutes in 350° oven. Remove from oven and fill centers with jam or date-nut filling. Return to oven. Bake 10 minutes longer.

recipes.title: Double Chocolate Crumble Bars
directions: Mix ingredients together, then bake at 350°F until bars test done.
Add 2 c. marshmallows on top of bars and bake 3 more min. Melt 1 ppkg. chocolate chips and 1 c. peanut butter on oven.
Mix together with 1 1/2 c. Rice Krispies and spread on top of marshmallows and let cool.
Keep it in the fridge for a better taste.
recipes.text: Double Chocolate Crumble Bars. Mix ingredients together, then bake at 350°F until bars test done. Add 2 c. marshmallows on top of bars and bake 3 more min. Melt 1 ppkg. chocolate chips and 1 c. peanut butter on oven. Mix together with 1 1/2 c. Rice Krispies and spread on top of marshmallows and let cool. Keep it in the fridge for a better taste.

recipes.title: Taunia'S Corn Pudding
directions: Mix all ingredients together, stirring well.
Pour into greased 9 x 13-inch cake pan.
Bake at 350° until golden brown.
recipes.text: Taunia'S Corn Pudding. Mix all ingredients together, stirring well. Pour into greased 9 x 13-inch cake pan. Bake at 350° until golden brown.

recipes.title: Confetti Vegetables
ingredients: 3 c. shredded parsnips or turnips (approximately 1 1/2 lb.)
directions: Boil water in a Dutch oven or large saucepan.
Heat all ingredients to boiling.
Cover and simmer about 5 minutes until vegetables are tender-crisp, stirring occasionally.
recipes.text: Confetti Vegetables. Boil water in a Dutch oven or large saucepan. Heat all ingredients to boiling. Cover and simmer about 5 minutes until vegetables are tender-crisp, stirring occasionally.

recipes.title: Pineapple Fingers
directions: Drain pineapple.
Mix cake mix, egg yolks, butter and flavoring.
Press into a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Beat egg whites until stiff; gradually beat in sugar.
Fold in coconut and pineapple. Pour over cake mixture.
Bake at 325° for 30 minutes.
Cool thoroughly.
Cut into finger strips.
recipes.text: Pineapple Fingers. Drain pineapple. Mix cake mix, egg yolks, butter and flavoring. Press into a 9 x 13-inch pan. Beat egg whites until stiff; gradually beat in sugar. Fold in coconut and pineapple. Pour over cake mixture. Bake at 325° for 30 minutes. Cool thoroughly. Cut into finger strips.

recipes.title: Sour Cream Pound Cake
directions: In a mixing bowl, cream butter. Gradually beat in sugar until light and fluffy, about 5 to 7 minutes. Add eggs, one at

a time, beating well after each addition. Combine flour, baking soda and salt; add to creamed mixture alternately with the sour cream and vanilla. Beat on low just until blended. Pour into a greased and floured 10-inch fluted tube pan. Bake at 325° for 1 hour and 25 minutes or until cake tests done. Cool in pan for 15 minutes before removing to a wire rack to cool completely.
recipes.text: Sour Cream Pound Cake. In a mixing bowl, cream butter. Gradually beat in sugar until light and fluffy, about 5 to 7 minutes. Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each addition. Combine flour, baking soda and salt; add to creamed mixture alternately with the sour cream and vanilla. Beat on low just until blended. Pour into a greased and floured 10-inch fluted tube pan. Bake at 325° for 1 hour and 25 minutes or until cake tests done. Cool in pan for 15 minutes before removing to a wire rack to cool completely.

recipes.title: Chocolate Gravy
directions: Mix cocoa, sugar, flour and milk.
Circle approximately 10 minutes.
Add salt and butter and circle 3 to 5 minutes.
recipes.text: Chocolate Gravy. Mix cocoa, sugar, flour and milk. Circle approximately 10 minutes. Add salt and butter and circle 3 to 5 minutes.

recipes.title: Ham Rolls
directions: Cream first 4 ingredients.
Cut rolls longwise.
Spread butter mixture on top and bottom of rolls.
Place ham and cheese on bottom half.
Replace top and return to pan.
Sprinkle with water. Cover with foil and bake 10 minutes at 400°.
Cut into individual rolls.
recipes.text: Ham Rolls. Cream first 4 ingredients. Cut rolls longwise. Spread butter mixture on top and bottom of rolls. Place ham and cheese on bottom half. Replace top and return to pan. Sprinkle with water. Cover with foil and bake 10 minutes at 400°. Cut into individual rolls.

recipes.title: Jezebel Sauce
directions: Combine all ingredients and mix well.
Serve with cream cheese and
Ritz
crackers.
The
sauce can be put on top of a block
of cream cheese.
Sauce is also good with meat and can be
used on bread instead of mayonnaise.
Sauce can be refrigerated
up
to several months.
You can also substitute peach preserves or use 12 ounces of preserves instead of 18 ounces.
recipes.text: Jezebel Sauce. Combine all ingredients and mix well. Serve with cream cheese and Ritz crackers. The sauce can be put on top of a block of cream cheese. Sauce is also good with meat and can be used on bread instead of mayonnaise. Sauce can be refrigerated up to several months. You can also substitute peach preserves or use 12 ounces of preserves instead of 18 ounces.

recipes.title: Quiche
ingredients: 1 c. shredded Swiss cheese or mix of Swiss and American
directions: Cook bacon; drain and chop up.
Saute onion in bacon fat; drain.
Combine eggs, milk, cream cheese, bacon and seasonings. Pour into pie crust.
Bake at 375° for 25 to 35 minutes.
If you like, add more cheese, mushrooms, crab meat or vegetables.
Makes 1 pie.
Serves 8.
recipes.text: Quiche. Cook bacon; drain and chop up. Saute onion in bacon fat; drain. Combine eggs, milk, cream cheese, bacon and seasonings. Pour into pie crust. Bake at 375° for 25 to 35 minutes. If you like, add more cheese, mushrooms, crab meat or vegetables. Makes 1 pie. Serves 8.

recipes.title: Pound Cake
directions: Cream together 2 sticks soft butter, Crisco and sugar.
Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each addition.
Sift all-purpose flour, salt and baking powder together.
Add to batter with milk, beginning and ending with dry ingredients.
Add flavoring.
Bake in greased and floured tube pan at 325° for about 1 1/2 hours.
recipes.text: Pound Cake. Cream together 2 sticks soft butter, Crisco and sugar. Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each addition. Sift all-purpose flour, salt and baking powder together. Add to batter with milk, beginning and ending with dry ingredients. Add flavoring. Bake in greased and floured tube pan at 325° for about 1 1/2 hours.

recipes.title: Broccoli Quiche
directions: Toss cheese with flour.
Add all other ingredients.
Pour into a pastry shell.
Bake at 350° for 60 minutes.
recipes.text: Broccoli Quiche. Toss cheese with flour. Add all other ingredients. Pour into a pastry shell. Bake at 350° for 60 minutes.

recipes.title: Aunt Liz'S Beaumont Inn Corn Pudding
directions: Stir into the corn the flour, salt, sugar and butter.
Add eggs to cream and stir into the corn.
Pour into a buttered 1 1/2-quart shallow pan.
Bake at 325° for 45 minutes.
Stir from bottom 3 different times while baking.
recipes.text: Aunt Liz'S Beaumont Inn Corn Pudding. Stir into the corn the flour, salt, sugar and butter. Add eggs to cream and stir into the corn. Pour into a buttered 1 1/2-quart shallow pan. Bake at 325° for 45 minutes. Stir from bottom 3 different times while baking.

recipes.title: Jamaica Cake
ingredients: 2 (8 oz.) cans crushed pineapple (juice and all)
directions: Stir all together, either by hand or mixer.
Place in greased and floured tube or Bundt pan.
Bake 1 hour and 20 minutes at 350° (time approximate).
Test for doneness.
recipes.text: Jamaica Cake. Stir all together, either by hand or mixer. Place in greased and floured tube or Bundt pan. Bake 1 hour and 20 minutes at 350° (time approximate). Test for doneness.

recipes.title: Seafood Fettucine
ingredients: salt and red pepper flakes to taste
directions: Cook fettucine according to package directions; drain.
In a large skillet, melt butter.
Add garlic and onion; saute until onion is tender.
Add shrimp and scallops; saute about 5 minutes. Season with parsley, basil, salt and red pepper.
Place hot fettucine in a serving dish.
Add seafood.
Toss gently to mix. Serve immediately.
recipes.text: Seafood Fettucine. Cook fettucine according to package directions; drain. In a large skillet, melt butter. Add garlic and onion; saute until onion is tender. Add shrimp and scallops; saute about 5 minutes. Season with parsley, basil, salt and red pepper. Place hot fettucine in a serving dish. Add seafood. Toss gently to mix. Serve immediately.

recipes.title: Broccoli Salad
directions: Fry bacon until crisp, drain and break up.
Mix sugar, vinegar, salt and mayo; pour over salad.
Enjoy!
recipes.text: Broccoli Salad. Fry bacon until crisp, drain and break up. Mix sugar, vinegar, salt and mayo; pour over salad. Enjoy!

recipes.title: Salmon Stew
directions: In saucepan mash the salmon until it is in small pieces. Cover with water, salt, butter, and pepper.
Bring to a boil.
Add peeled, diced potatoes, cook until tender.
Add milk until the broth is white.
Slightly mash the potatoes.
Serve with oyster crackers.
Serves 4.
recipes.text: Salmon Stew. In saucepan mash the salmon until it is in small pieces. Cover with water, salt, butter, and pepper. Bring to a boil. Add peeled, diced potatoes, cook until tender. Add milk until the broth is white. Slightly mash the potatoes. Serve with oyster crackers. Serves 4.

recipes.title: Nonalcoholic Punch
directions: Makes 10 gallons of punch.
Can add champagne.
recipes.text: Nonalcoholic Punch. Makes 10 gallons of punch. Can add champagne.

recipes.title: Picante Sauce
ingredients: 16 c. tomatoes, peeled and chopped (fresh, frozen or canned)
1 c. jalapeno or hot peppers (more or less to taste)
directions: Blend all ingredients.
Cook for 1 1/2 hours, uncovered, stirring often.
Pour into hot jars; seal.
Process in hot water bath for 35 minutes.
Yields 10 pints.
recipes.text: Picante Sauce. Blend all ingredients. Cook for 1 1/2 hours, uncovered, stirring often. Pour into hot jars; seal. Process in hot water bath for 35 minutes. Yields 10 pints.

recipes.title: Gerry'S Orange Dessert
ingredients: 2 cantaloupes, seeds removed, cut and cubed
2 honeydew melons, seeds removed, cut and cubed
2 ripe pineapples, peeled and sliced or cubed
10 kiwi fruit, peeled and sliced in circles
2 lb. white seedless grapes, rinsed in cold water
2 lb. dark Concord grapes, rinsed in cold water
2 lb. Burgundy red grapes, rinsed in cold water
2 pt. whole strawberries, washed and de-stemmed
1 c. sweet potatoes, cooked and mashed to get the 1 c.
directions: Preheat oven to 350°.
Cook the sweet potatoes in water. Drain off the liquid, then mash.
Set aside.
Sift together flour, baking soda and salt in a large bowl.
Add the yellow cornmeal, then stir.
In a small bowl, combine both types of sugar.
Add the eggs to the sugar mixture and cream until fluffy.
recipes.text: Gerry'S Orange Dessert. Preheat oven to 350°. Cook the sweet potatoes in water. Drain off the liquid, then mash. Set aside. Sift together flour, baking soda and salt in a large bowl. Add the yellow cornmeal, then stir. In a small bowl, combine both types of sugar. Add the eggs to the sugar mixture and cream until fluffy.

recipes.title: Jello Punch
ingredients: 2 qt. diet ginger ale (or a 2 liter bottle)
directions: Dissolve Jell-O and sugar in boiling water.
Add cold water, then lemon juice and pineapple juice.
Mix and chill.
Add ginger ale.
Just prior to serving, may be frozen (without adding ginger ale).
It may be partially thawed and served slushy.
Serves approximately 40 punch cups.
recipes.text: Jello Punch. Dissolve Jell-O and sugar in boiling water. Add cold water, then lemon juice and pineapple juice. Mix and chill. Add ginger ale. Just prior to serving, may be frozen (without adding ginger ale). It may be partially thawed and served slushy. Serves approximately 40 punch cups.

recipes.title: Squash Bake
directions: Combine all ingredients in baking dish and cook at 350° for 1 hour.
Or microwave on High for 10 to 15 minutes or until tender.
recipes.text: Squash Bake. Combine all ingredients in baking dish and cook at 350° for 1 hour. Or microwave on High for 10 to 15 minutes or until tender.

recipes.title: Caviar And Salmon Spread
ingredients: 1/4 c. heavy cream or skim milk
directions: Mix the cream cheese and cream or milk gently.
Stir in scallions, lemon juice and Tabasco sauce.
Fold in the smoked salmon and caviar until well combined.
Be careful not to overmix so the shreds of salmon and caviar can remain whole.
Serve with crackers or toast points.
Yield:
2 cups.
recipes.text: Caviar And Salmon Spread. Mix the cream cheese and cream or milk gently. Stir in scallions, lemon juice and Tabasco sauce. Fold in the smoked salmon and caviar until well combined. Be careful not to overmix so the shreds of salmon and caviar can remain whole. Serve with crackers or toast points. Yield: 2 cups.

recipes.title: Hummingbird Cake
ingredients: 1 c. chopped nuts (black walnuts are best)
directions: Mix first 9 ingredients in a large bowl.
Mix by hand only. Add bananas and nuts.
Mix again.
Bake at 350° in a Bundt pan for one hour and 5 minutes.
recipes.text: Hummingbird Cake. Mix first 9 ingredients in a large bowl. Mix by hand only. Add bananas and nuts. Mix again. Bake at 350° in a Bundt pan for one hour and 5 minutes.

recipes.title: Chicken Marsala
ingredients: 3 chicken breasts, split, skinned, boned and pounded flat
directions: In a shallow dish, mix together the flour and 1 teaspoon salt; dredge the chicken in the flour mixture.
In a large skillet heat the oil over medium-high heat; saute the chicken for 6 to 8 minutes or until browned on both sides.
Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside.
(At this point, I remove all the fat and do not add margarine.
Continue with rest of recipe.)
recipes.text: Chicken Marsala. In a shallow dish, mix together the flour and 1 teaspoon salt; dredge the chicken in the flour mixture. In a large skillet heat the oil over medium-high heat; saute the chicken for 6 to 8 minutes or until browned on both sides. Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside. (At this point, I remove all the fat and do not add margarine. Continue with rest of recipe.)

recipes.title: Pork Chop Casserole
ingredients: 1 can cream of chicken soup, diluted with 1 can water
directions: Season pork chops with salt and pepper.
Trim fat from chops and brown in 2 tablespoons oil.
Place in casserole dish.
Combine other ingredients and pour over chops, covering them.
Bake in 350° oven for 45 to 60 minutes.
recipes.text: Pork Chop Casserole. Season pork chops with salt and pepper. Trim fat from chops and brown in 2 tablespoons oil. Place in casserole dish. Combine other ingredients and pour over chops, covering them. Bake in 350° oven for 45 to 60 minutes.

recipes.title: Apple Cake With Hot Caramel Sauce
directions: Preheat oven to 350°.
Chop pecans finely.
Peel, core and chop apples to make 2 1/2 cups.
Pieces should be size of your thumbnail.
recipes.text: Apple Cake With Hot Caramel Sauce. Preheat oven to 350°. Chop pecans finely. Peel, core and chop apples to make 2 1/2 cups. Pieces should be size of your thumbnail.

recipes.title: Deviled Pecan Ball
directions: Combine first 3 ingredients.
Mix well.
Stir in remaining ingredients except pecans.
Chill 2 hours or until firm.
Divide mixture to make 2 balls or maybe leave together to make 1 large ball.
Roll in pecans and chill until ready to serve.
Serve with your favorite crackers.
recipes.text: Deviled Pecan Ball. Combine first 3 ingredients. Mix well. Stir in remaining ingredients except pecans. Chill 2 hours or until firm. Divide mixture to make 2 balls or maybe leave together to make 1 large ball. Roll in pecans and chill until ready to serve. Serve with your favorite crackers.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Pie
directions: Mix powdered sugar and peanut butter until crumbly.
Put 3/4 of the mixture in a cooled baked pie shell and top with pudding. Top that with Cool Whip.
Sprinkle remaining peanut butter mixture on top.
recipes.text: Peanut Butter Pie. Mix powdered sugar and peanut butter until crumbly. Put 3/4 of the mixture in a cooled baked pie shell and top with pudding. Top that with Cool Whip. Sprinkle remaining peanut butter mixture on top.

recipes.title: Good 'N' Fillin'
ingredients: 1 large onion, cut into short, thin strips
2 large green peppers, cut into thin strips
1 (16 oz.) can tomatoes and green chilies
directions: Cook sausage, onions and green peppers over medium heat in 1 tablespoon oil until veggies are tender and sausage is done. Stir in tomatoes and peas; reduce heat and simmer 5 to 10 minutes. Pour into lightly greased 13 x 9 baking dish.
recipes.text: Good 'N' Fillin'. Cook sausage, onions and green peppers over medium heat in 1 tablespoon oil until veggies are tender and sausage is done. Stir in tomatoes and peas; reduce heat and simmer 5 to 10 minutes. Pour into lightly greased 13 x 9 baking dish.

recipes.title: No Guilt Pumpkin Pudding
directions: Makes 2 servings. Mix ingredients. Garnish with sprinkle of cinnamon and cinnamon sticks.
recipes.text: No Guilt Pumpkin Pudding. Makes 2 servings. Mix ingredients. Garnish with sprinkle of cinnamon and cinnamon sticks.

recipes.title: Red Bean Lasagna
directions: Cook onion, carrot and garlic in oil.
Add undrained tomatoes, beans, parsley, sugar, oregano, basil and salt.
Bring to boil. Cover and simmer 15 minutes.
Add slightly mashed bean mixture with mushrooms and simmer uncovered for 15 minutes.
Combine egg with half of the 3 cheeses.
Spread 1/2 cup bean mixture in a 10 x 6 x 2-inch dish.
Arrange two noodles atop.
Spread with 1/3 cheese mixture, then with 1/3 bean mixture.
Repeat layers twice. Bake covered in 375° oven 40 minutes.
Top with remaining cheese and bake 5 minutes.
Makes 6 servings.
recipes.text: Red Bean Lasagna. Cook onion, carrot and garlic in oil. Add undrained tomatoes, beans, parsley, sugar, oregano, basil and salt. Bring to boil. Cover and simmer 15 minutes. Add slightly mashed bean mixture with mushrooms and simmer uncovered for 15 minutes. Combine egg with half of the 3 cheeses. Spread 1/2 cup bean mixture in a 10 x 6 x 2-inch dish. Arrange two noodles atop. Spread with 1/3 cheese mixture, then with 1/3 bean mixture. Repeat layers twice. Bake covered in 375° oven 40 minutes. Top with remaining cheese and bake 5 minutes. Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Pistachio Pie
directions: mix together crushed pineapple and pudding mix, add nuts and mix well.
Then add other ingredients and pour in crust and chill before serving.
recipes.text: Pistachio Pie. mix together crushed pineapple and pudding mix, add nuts and mix well. Then add other ingredients and pour in crust and chill before serving.

recipes.title: Copper Carrots
directions: Slice and cook fresh carrots.
Mix the remaining ingredients well and pour over carrots.
Cover and refrigerate overnight.
recipes.text: Copper Carrots. Slice and cook fresh carrots. Mix the remaining ingredients well and pour over carrots. Cover and refrigerate overnight.

recipes.title: Oven Barbecued Brisket
directions: Trim away excess fat from brisket, pierce both sides of brisket with fork and sprinkle moderately with tenderizer.
Place in roasting pan large enough for meat to lay flat.
Blend together all the above ingredients and pour over meat.
Cover and refrigerate 6 hours or overnight.
Bake tightly closed at 300° for 4 1/2 to 5 1/2 hours until tender.
Slice in thin slices across the grain.
Great served with Potato salad, green beans or baked beans.
recipes.text: Oven Barbecued Brisket. Trim away excess fat from brisket, pierce both sides of brisket with fork and sprinkle moderately with tenderizer. Place in roasting pan large enough for meat to lay flat. Blend together all the above ingredients and pour over meat. Cover and refrigerate 6 hours or overnight. Bake tightly closed at 300° for 4 1/2 to 5 1/2 hours until tender. Slice in thin slices across the grain. Great served with Potato salad, green beans or baked beans.

recipes.title: Carl Reiner'S Cookies
ingredients: finely chopped walnuts (9, I use more)
directions: Blend all; put small "dollops" on cookie sheet and bake at 350° until slightly brown on edge.
recipes.text: Carl Reiner'S Cookies. Blend all; put small "dollops" on cookie sheet and bake at 350° until slightly brown on edge.

recipes.title: Poppy Seed Bread
directions: Mix the first 4 ingredients together.
Beat the last 5 ingredients together.
Combine the two mixtures and stir.
Pour into well-greased and floured pan (9 x 5 x 3-inch or Bundt pan). Bake at 350° for 50 minutes.
recipes.text: Poppy Seed Bread. Mix the first 4 ingredients together. Beat the last 5 ingredients together. Combine the two mixtures and stir. Pour into well-greased and floured pan (9 x 5 x 3-inch or Bundt pan). Bake at 350° for 50 minutes.

recipes.title: Chicken Cordon Bleu
directions: Flatten each chicken breast.
Spread breast on a sheet of wax paper and cover with another sheet.
Using a mallet or edge of saucer, pound each breast until flat, about 1/4-inch thick.
Do not tear chicken.
Sprinkle with salt and pepper.
Top each with a slice of ham.
Cut cheese into 4 bars.
Place a bar of cheese at one short end of each ham.
Fold long edges of cutlet over ends of bar of cheese, then starting at short end of cutlet, roll up, jelly roll style.
To hold each chicken roll together, fasten with string and wooden toothpicks.
recipes.text: Chicken Cordon Bleu. Flatten each chicken breast. Spread breast on a sheet of wax paper and cover with another sheet. Using a mallet or edge of saucer, pound each breast until flat, about 1/4-inch thick. Do not tear chicken. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Top each with a slice of ham. Cut cheese into 4 bars. Place a bar of cheese at one short end of each ham. Fold long edges of cutlet over ends of bar of cheese, then starting at short end of cutlet, roll up, jelly roll style. To hold each chicken roll together, fasten with string and wooden toothpicks.

recipes.title: Hearty Havarti Chicken
ingredients: 4 3 oz. boneless, skinless thin chicken breast fillets
4 1/2 oz. slices Havarti cheese (or Mozzarella, Swiss, Cheddar)
directions: Pound chicken breasts.
Dip each chicken breast into salad dressing and bread crumbs, then roll up around cheese and secure with a toothpick.
Bake 30 minutes at 350°.
Makes 4 servings.
recipes.text: Hearty Havarti Chicken. Pound chicken breasts. Dip each chicken breast into salad dressing and bread crumbs, then roll up around cheese and secure with a toothpick. Bake 30 minutes at 350°. Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: Fat-Free Devil'S Food Cake
directions: Mix flour, salt, sugar, cocoa, cornstarch and soda.
In another bowl, whisk together egg whites, water and syrup.
Add dry ingredients to this and pour into either a 9 x 9-inch or 8 x 8-inch pan that has been sprayed with Pam.
Bake 30 minutes at 350° in 9 x 9-inch pan.
Bake 35 minutes to 40 minutes with an 8 x 8-inch pan.
recipes.text: Fat-Free Devil'S Food Cake. Mix flour, salt, sugar, cocoa, cornstarch and soda. In another bowl, whisk together egg whites, water and syrup. Add dry ingredients to this and pour into either a 9 x 9-inch or 8 x 8-inch pan that has been sprayed with Pam. Bake 30 minutes at 350° in 9 x 9-inch pan. Bake 35 minutes to 40 minutes with an 8 x 8-inch pan.

recipes.title: Dijon 'N Honey Cream Sauce
directions: In a medium bowl, combine Grey Poupon, cream, ginger and honey. Beat until stiff.
Fold in pecans.
Serve on sliced fruit.
Makes about 1 1/4 cups.
recipes.text: Dijon 'N Honey Cream Sauce. In a medium bowl, combine Grey Poupon, cream, ginger and honey. Beat until stiff. Fold in pecans. Serve on sliced fruit. Makes about 1 1/4 cups.

recipes.title: Fruit Salad
ingredients: 1 can mandarin oranges (do not use liquid)
directions: Mix juice from pineapple, Tang and instant pudding.
Stir and add bananas, pineapple and oranges.
Put in refrigerator.
recipes.text: Fruit Salad. Mix juice from pineapple, Tang and instant pudding. Stir and add bananas, pineapple and oranges. Put in refrigerator.

recipes.title: Breakfast Pizza
directions: Spray pan with Pam.
Lay biscuits on pan.
Press biscuits. Scramble eggs and pour on top of biscuits.
Place all meat and cheese on top.
Bake at 350° for 20 to 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Breakfast Pizza. Spray pan with Pam. Lay biscuits on pan. Press biscuits. Scramble eggs and pour on top of biscuits. Place all meat and cheese on top. Bake at 350° for 20 to 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Grandma'S Dumplings
directions: Beat butter (softened at room temperature) with eggs until well blended.
Add self-rising flour until thoroughly combined. Drop by tablespoon into just simmering broth.
Cover and simmer 20 minutes.
recipes.text: Grandma'S Dumplings. Beat butter (softened at room temperature) with eggs until well blended. Add self-rising flour until thoroughly combined. Drop by tablespoon into just simmering broth. Cover and simmer 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Roman Holiday
ingredients: 1 tsp. salt and pepper to taste
directions: Fry onion and hamburg in little olive oil with salt and pepper.
Cook 5 minutes.
Make layers of spaghetti and meat in casserole; pour in tomatoes and sprinkle with cheese.
Cover dish. May be frozen now or bake 35 minutes at 350°; remove cover and bake 10 minutes longer.
recipes.text: Roman Holiday. Fry onion and hamburg in little olive oil with salt and pepper. Cook 5 minutes. Make layers of spaghetti and meat in casserole; pour in tomatoes and sprinkle with cheese. Cover dish. May be frozen now or bake 35 minutes at 350°; remove cover and bake 10 minutes longer.

recipes.title: Cabbage Rolls
directions: Pour boiling water over cabbage leaves.
Let stand for 5 minutes.
Season meat; add onion, rice and egg.
Roll a portion of filling into each leaf; fasten ends with toothpicks.
Place the cabbage rolls in the pressure cooker.
Pour tomato soup and water over rolls.
Cover, set control and cook 8 minutes after pressure is reached.
Let pressure go down normally.
recipes.text: Cabbage Rolls. Pour boiling water over cabbage leaves. Let stand for 5 minutes. Season meat; add onion, rice and egg. Roll a portion of filling into each leaf; fasten ends with toothpicks. Place the cabbage rolls in the pressure cooker. Pour tomato soup and water over rolls. Cover, set control and cook 8 minutes after pressure is reached. Let pressure go down normally.

recipes.title: Turtle Cake
directions: Mix first 3 ingredients and bake 1/2 mixture in greased and floured 9
x 13-inch pan at 350° for 5 minutes.
Melt caramels with 1/3 cup milk over low heat.
Spread over cooled cake mixture. Add pecans and chips.
Pour over rest of batter.
Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.
recipes.text: Turtle Cake. Mix first 3 ingredients and bake 1/2 mixture in greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan at 350° for 5 minutes. Melt caramels with 1/3 cup milk over low heat. Spread over cooled cake mixture. Add pecans and chips. Pour over rest of batter. Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Brown Sugar Pie
directions: Cook 8 tbsp milk, brown sugar and butter over medium heat until brown.
The more you cook the better it tastes.
Combine milk, flour, egg yolks and pour into sugar mixture.
Cook until thickens. Put vanilla in after it cooks, then pour into 2 baked pie shells.
recipes.text: Brown Sugar Pie. Cook 8 tbsp milk, brown sugar and butter over medium heat until brown. The more you cook the better it tastes. Combine milk, flour, egg yolks and pour into sugar mixture. Cook until thickens. Put vanilla in after it cooks, then pour into 2 baked pie shells.

recipes.title: Fruit Squares
directions: Cream eggs, butter and sugar.
Add vanilla and flour.
Add fruit and nuts; mix by hand.
Press into a greased 9 x 13-inch pan.
Bake at 300° for 45 to 50 minutes.
Cool about 30 minutes; cut into squares.
recipes.text: Fruit Squares. Cream eggs, butter and sugar. Add vanilla and flour. Add fruit and nuts; mix by hand. Press into a greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 300° for 45 to 50 minutes. Cool about 30 minutes; cut into squares.

recipes.title: Sugar Cream Pie #2
directions: Mix first 6 ingredients well and pour into unbaked pie shell. Melt the 2 tablespoons butter and pour over filling.
Bake 10 minutes at 450°.
Reduce heat to 350° and bake 45 to 50 minutes more.
recipes.text: Sugar Cream Pie #2. Mix first 6 ingredients well and pour into unbaked pie shell. Melt the 2 tablespoons butter and pour over filling. Bake 10 minutes at 450°. Reduce heat to 350° and bake 45 to 50 minutes more.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Cake
directions: Combine first 7 ingredients and beat on medium speed for 5 minutes.
Fold in chopped nuts.
Bake in greased and floured Bundt pan in a 350° oven for 40 to 45 minutes.
Let set 15 minutes, then turn out on cooling rack.
Frost when cool.
recipes.text: Pumpkin Cake. Combine first 7 ingredients and beat on medium speed for 5 minutes. Fold in chopped nuts. Bake in greased and floured Bundt pan in a 350° oven for 40 to 45 minutes. Let set 15 minutes, then turn out on cooling rack. Frost when cool.

recipes.title: Holiday Spinach
ingredients: 1 (1.0 oz.) envelope Hidden Valley Ranch original party dip mix
1 (14 oz.) can artichoke hearts, rinsed, drained and chopped
1 (2 oz.) jar diced pimentos, drained and rinsed
1 large round loaf sourdough bread, whole
1 large round loaf sourdough bread, cubed
directions: Combine sour cream and Hidden Valley mix.
Stir in artichokes, spinach and pimentos.
Cut slice off top of whole loaf of bread and hollow out center leaving 1-inch shell.
Reserve the bread for dipping.
Also use cubed bread for dipping.
Serve warm or cold. To serve warm, bake in preheated 400° oven for 20 to 25 minutes.
recipes.text: Holiday Spinach. Combine sour cream and Hidden Valley mix. Stir in artichokes, spinach and pimentos. Cut slice off top of whole loaf of bread and hollow out center leaving 1-inch shell. Reserve the bread for dipping. Also use cubed bread for dipping. Serve warm or cold. To serve warm, bake in preheated 400° oven for 20 to 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Hot Chicken Salad
ingredients: 2 c. corn flakes, crushed and rolled in 1/2 stick oleo, melted
directions: Combine chicken, celery, onion and pimento in a mixing bowl. Mix mayonnaise and chicken soup and stir into chicken-vegetable mixture.
Put into oblong casserole dish.
Top with egg slices, cheese, corn flakes and almonds.
Bake for 30 minutes at 350°.
recipes.text: Hot Chicken Salad. Combine chicken, celery, onion and pimento in a mixing bowl. Mix mayonnaise and chicken soup and stir into chicken-vegetable mixture. Put into oblong casserole dish. Top with egg slices, cheese, corn flakes and almonds. Bake for 30 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Rio Lace Cookies
directions: Preheat oven to 350°.
Combine oatmeal, flour, baking powder and sugar. Combine eggs and margarine.
Mix with oatmeal mixture. Add vanilla, lemon extract, almond extract and pecans.
recipes.text: Rio Lace Cookies. Preheat oven to 350°. Combine oatmeal, flour, baking powder and sugar. Combine eggs and margarine. Mix with oatmeal mixture. Add vanilla, lemon extract, almond extract and pecans.

recipes.title: Cheese Ball
directions: Combine softened cream cheese and Cheddar cheese, mixing well, until blended.
Add lemon juice, pimento, green pepper, onions, Worcestershire sauce and salt.
Mix well.
Shape into ball.
Roll in finely chopped dried beef and chill.
recipes.text: Cheese Ball. Combine softened cream cheese and Cheddar cheese, mixing well, until blended. Add lemon juice, pimento, green pepper, onions, Worcestershire sauce and salt. Mix well. Shape into ball. Roll in finely chopped dried beef and chill.

recipes.title: Anita'S Lasagna
ingredients: 1/4 c. grated cheese of your choice
8-10 slices of mozzarella or scamorze cheese, if desired
Double recipe of Italian Pasta Sauce (see Sauces)
directions: Mix first 6 ingredients well. Boil a 1 pound package of lasagna noodles. Spread 1 tablespoon of sauce thinly in the bottom of a 9 x 13 inch pan. Put one layer of noodles down; put close together - no need to overlap. One layer should require 3 or 4 noodles. Sprinkle with grated cheese of choice. Spread 1/2 the cheese filling as a layer over the noodles. Cover with 4-5 slices of cheese. Then add another layer of noodles, sprinkle with grated cheese, and cover this layer with sauce.
