Add another layer of noodles, grated cheese, rest of cheese filling and sliced cheese. Add the last layer of noodles, grated cheese and sauce. Bake in 350° oven for 30-40 minutes or in 400° oven for 20-30 minutes, or until the cheese filling appears to be firm.
Allow to cool for 5-10 minutes.
Serve with any leftover sauce.
recipes.text: Anita'S Lasagna. Mix first 6 ingredients well. Boil a 1 pound package of lasagna noodles. Spread 1 tablespoon of sauce thinly in the bottom of a 9 x 13 inch pan. Put one layer of noodles down; put close together - no need to overlap. One layer should require 3 or 4 noodles. Sprinkle with grated cheese of choice. Spread 1/2 the cheese filling as a layer over the noodles. Cover with 4-5 slices of cheese. Then add another layer of noodles, sprinkle with grated cheese, and cover this layer with sauce. Add another layer of noodles, grated cheese, rest of cheese filling and sliced cheese. Add the last layer of noodles, grated cheese and sauce. Bake in 350° oven for 30-40 minutes or in 400° oven for 20-30 minutes, or until the cheese filling appears to be firm. Allow to cool for 5-10 minutes. Serve with any leftover sauce.

recipes.title: Chow Chow
directions: Mix cabbage, green peppers and tomatoes with salt and let stand overnight; drain.
Tie mixed whole spices in a cheesecloth bag and add to sugar and vinegar.
Simmer for 20 minutes.
Add all other ingredients and simmer until mixture is hot and well seasoned.
Remove spice bag.
Pack in hot canning jars and seal at once.
recipes.text: Chow Chow. Mix cabbage, green peppers and tomatoes with salt and let stand overnight; drain. Tie mixed whole spices in a cheesecloth bag and add to sugar and vinegar. Simmer for 20 minutes. Add all other ingredients and simmer until mixture is hot and well seasoned. Remove spice bag. Pack in hot canning jars and seal at once.

recipes.title: Praline Cookies
directions: Combine sugar, oleo and cream; bring to a boil.
Boil gently for 3 minutes.
Take off heat and add marshmallows.
Stir until melted.
Add a pinch of salt, vanilla, pecans and graham crackers. Blend well.
Drop by teaspoon on wax paper.
Store in a container or Ziploc bag.
recipes.text: Praline Cookies. Combine sugar, oleo and cream; bring to a boil. Boil gently for 3 minutes. Take off heat and add marshmallows. Stir until melted. Add a pinch of salt, vanilla, pecans and graham crackers. Blend well. Drop by teaspoon on wax paper. Store in a container or Ziploc bag.

recipes.title: Cinnamon Twist
directions: Use can of biscuits.
Cut out centers and fry.
Put in bag of cinnamon and sugar, then shake up.
recipes.text: Cinnamon Twist. Use can of biscuits. Cut out centers and fry. Put in bag of cinnamon and sugar, then shake up.

recipes.title: Cleo'S Hot Chicken Salad
ingredients: 1 1/2 Tbsp. fresh lemon juice (this is important)
1 can cream chicken or celery soup
directions: Mix together first 7 ingredients.
Put in a greased 9 x 13-inch baking dish.
Over the top, spread mixture of chicken or celery soup, shredded cheese and nuts.
On top of this, sprinkle crushed potato chips.
Bake 20 minutes in 350° to 375° oven.
recipes.text: Cleo'S Hot Chicken Salad. Mix together first 7 ingredients. Put in a greased 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Over the top, spread mixture of chicken or celery soup, shredded cheese and nuts. On top of this, sprinkle crushed potato chips. Bake 20 minutes in 350° to 375° oven.

recipes.title: Shish Kabob(Microwave)
ingredients: 12 tomato wedges or cherry tomatoes (very firm)
directions: Make marinade by combining vinegar, oil, onion salt, garlic, soy sauce, oregano and water in large bowl.
Cut meat in 1-inch cubes.
Add to marinade and let stand refrigerated 5 to 6 hours. Stir occasionally.
Arrange meat cubes and vegetables alternately on 6 long wooden skewers.
Place 2 or 3 skewers at a time on microproof dinner plate.
Cook uncovered on High (maximum power) 1 to 1 1/2 minutes for medium rare.
Repeat for remaining skewers. Cook slightly longer for well-done meat.
(Total cooking time is 2 to 4 1/2 minutes.)
recipes.text: Shish Kabob(Microwave). Make marinade by combining vinegar, oil, onion salt, garlic, soy sauce, oregano and water in large bowl. Cut meat in 1-inch cubes. Add to marinade and let stand refrigerated 5 to 6 hours. Stir occasionally. Arrange meat cubes and vegetables alternately on 6 long wooden skewers. Place 2 or 3 skewers at a time on microproof dinner plate. Cook uncovered on High (maximum power) 1 to 1 1/2 minutes for medium rare. Repeat for remaining skewers. Cook slightly longer for well-done meat. (Total cooking time is 2 to 4 1/2 minutes.)

recipes.title: Escalloped Pineapple
ingredients: 4 c. bread cubes (do not use croutons)
directions: Cream eggs, margarine and sugar.
Add milk, then pineapple and bread cubes.
Grease casserole dish.
Bake at 375° for 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Escalloped Pineapple. Cream eggs, margarine and sugar. Add milk, then pineapple and bread cubes. Grease casserole dish. Bake at 375° for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Best Ever Chicken Salad
ingredients: 1 small can crushed pineapple in juice
directions: Stew the chicken until done.
Skin, debone and chop into small pieces.
Finely dice the apple, onion and celery.
Add the diced ingredients to the chicken, along with the pineapple in juice. Mix in the mayonnaise (adding a little more, if necessary).
Salt and pepper to taste.
(Nuts and raisins are optional additions.) Best if made the night before.
Serves 8 to 10.
recipes.text: Best Ever Chicken Salad. Stew the chicken until done. Skin, debone and chop into small pieces. Finely dice the apple, onion and celery. Add the diced ingredients to the chicken, along with the pineapple in juice. Mix in the mayonnaise (adding a little more, if necessary). Salt and pepper to taste. (Nuts and raisins are optional additions.) Best if made the night before. Serves 8 to 10.

recipes.title: Macaroni And Cheese
directions: Cook macaroni according to directions. Drain. Combine cottage cheese, sour cream, processed cheese spread, Cheddar cheese, cream cheese and eggs in 3-quart casserole. Add cooked macaroni. Fold in thoroughly. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes. Yields 16 servings.
recipes.text: Macaroni And Cheese. Cook macaroni according to directions. Drain. Combine cottage cheese, sour cream, processed cheese spread, Cheddar cheese, cream cheese and eggs in 3-quart casserole. Add cooked macaroni. Fold in thoroughly. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes. Yields 16 servings.

recipes.title: Zucchini Al Forno
ingredients: 2 Tbsp. fresh basil leaves, roughly torn
directions: Preheat oven to 375°.
Top and tail the zucchini and cut lengthwise into 1/2 inch slices.
Coat the slices in flour and fry until they are crisp and golden.
Oil a circular ovenproof dish and arrange the zucchini slices like the spokes of a wheel.
Beat together the eggs, milk, salt, pepper and half the cheese.
Add the basil leaves and pour over the zucchini.
Sprinkle with breadcrumbs and remaining cheese.
Bake for 15-20 minutes.
recipes.text: Zucchini Al Forno. Preheat oven to 375°. Top and tail the zucchini and cut lengthwise into 1/2 inch slices. Coat the slices in flour and fry until they are crisp and golden. Oil a circular ovenproof dish and arrange the zucchini slices like the spokes of a wheel. Beat together the eggs, milk, salt, pepper and half the cheese. Add the basil leaves and pour over the zucchini. Sprinkle with breadcrumbs and remaining cheese. Bake for 15-20 minutes.

recipes.title: Fantastic Frozen Strawberries
directions: Put cleaned berries in a large bowl with sugar.
Mix carefully.
Mix Sure-Jell with 1 cup water and boil 1 minute. Pour over berries and mix carefully.
Let stand 10 minutes.
Put in freezer bags or containers.
recipes.text: Fantastic Frozen Strawberries. Put cleaned berries in a large bowl with sugar. Mix carefully. Mix Sure-Jell with 1 cup water and boil 1 minute. Pour over berries and mix carefully. Let stand 10 minutes. Put in freezer bags or containers.

recipes.title: Orange Salad
directions: Mix all of the ingredients.
Chill in refrigerator until served.
recipes.text: Orange Salad. Mix all of the ingredients. Chill in refrigerator until served.

recipes.title: Angel Delight Candy
directions: Boil 6 minutes; do not stir.
recipes.text: Angel Delight Candy. Boil 6 minutes; do not stir.

recipes.title: Pecan Chicken Breasts
ingredients: 1/2 c. plus 2 Tbsp. Dijon mustard, divided
4 whole chicken breasts, split, skinned and boned
1 c. pitted ripe black olives, sliced
1 pkg. (1 oz.) Hidden Valley Ranch Original salad dressing mix
directions: Preheat oven to 400°.
Melt butter in small saucepan over low heat; remove from heat.
Whisk in 1/4 cup Dijon mustard.
Set aside.
To grind pecans, process pecan halves in small batches with on/off pulses in food processor to a fine powder.
Place ground pecans in shallow dish; set aside.
recipes.text: Pecan Chicken Breasts. Preheat oven to 400°. Melt butter in small saucepan over low heat; remove from heat. Whisk in 1/4 cup Dijon mustard. Set aside. To grind pecans, process pecan halves in small batches with on/off pulses in food processor to a fine powder. Place ground pecans in shallow dish; set aside.

recipes.title: Chocolate Sour Cream Cake
directions: Put butter, sugar and unbeaten eggs in bowl.
Beat and blend very well.
Add sour cream, sifted flour, baking soda, baking powder and salt.
Blend well.
Last, make a thin paste of Hershey's cocoa and hot water.
Blend all this into the batter. Stir well and pour into 2 (9-inch) greased layer cake pans.
Bake 30 to 35 minutes in 350° oven.
Put layers together with any chocolate frosting or whipped cream.
recipes.text: Chocolate Sour Cream Cake. Put butter, sugar and unbeaten eggs in bowl. Beat and blend very well. Add sour cream, sifted flour, baking soda, baking powder and salt. Blend well. Last, make a thin paste of Hershey's cocoa and hot water. Blend all this into the batter. Stir well and pour into 2 (9-inch) greased layer cake pans. Bake 30 to 35 minutes in 350° oven. Put layers together with any chocolate frosting or whipped cream.

recipes.title: Snow Ice Cream
ingredients: 1 (2 1/2 qt.) mixing bowl fresh, clean snow
directions: Mix all ingredients, using a spoon.
Eat immediately.
recipes.text: Snow Ice Cream. Mix all ingredients, using a spoon. Eat immediately.

recipes.title: Sweet Potato Pie
directions: Beat eggs.
Blend dry ingredients; add cream.
Mix thoroughly. Pour into unbaked pie shell.
Bake at 425° for 15 minutes. Reduce heat to 350°.
Bake for 25 minutes or until center is firm.
recipes.text: Sweet Potato Pie. Beat eggs. Blend dry ingredients; add cream. Mix thoroughly. Pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake at 425° for 15 minutes. Reduce heat to 350°. Bake for 25 minutes or until center is firm.

recipes.title: Hot Dish
directions: Line an electric frypan with strips of bacon.
Crumble ground beef on top of that.
Add, in layers, sliced onion, potatoes, carrots and cabbage.
Turn up heat to slightly fry the meat to low and simmer until vegetables are done.
recipes.text: Hot Dish. Line an electric frypan with strips of bacon. Crumble ground beef on top of that. Add, in layers, sliced onion, potatoes, carrots and cabbage. Turn up heat to slightly fry the meat to low and simmer until vegetables are done.

recipes.title: Green Bean Casserole
ingredients: 3/4 to 1 c. mayonnaise and sour cream, combined as desired
directions: Melt cheese.
Add mayonnaise/sour cream.
Add beans (drain one can completely, about half of the second can).
Mix together completely.
Cook at 350° for 20 minutes.
Add topping of Ritz crackers (crushed) and margarine slices.
Bake additional 15 minutes.
recipes.text: Green Bean Casserole. Melt cheese. Add mayonnaise/sour cream. Add beans (drain one can completely, about half of the second can). Mix together completely. Cook at 350° for 20 minutes. Add topping of Ritz crackers (crushed) and margarine slices. Bake additional 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Fresh Strawberry Pie
directions: Cook ingredients until thick. Place sliced strawberries in a baked pie shell and pour cooled mixture over berries.
recipes.text: Fresh Strawberry Pie. Cook ingredients until thick. Place sliced strawberries in a baked pie shell and pour cooled mixture over berries.

recipes.title: Simple Baked Crab
ingredients: 1 lb. crabmeat or half crab and half shrimp
directions: Combine first 6 ingredients in a casserole.
Mix bread crumbs and butter and sprinkle over top of casserole.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until browned.
Serves 4.
recipes.text: Simple Baked Crab. Combine first 6 ingredients in a casserole. Mix bread crumbs and butter and sprinkle over top of casserole. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until browned. Serves 4.

recipes.title: Braised Chicken Breasts With Mustard Sauce
directions: Remove
skin
from chicken breasts.
Place on a rack in an electric
frying pan or in frying pan on top of stove.
Add 1 cup water
to
frying
pan.
Cover
and
cook on high until breasts are
almost
done.
Remove
breasts
from frying pan. Heat
grill. Place
breasts on very hot grill for 10 minutes. Turn often and baste with honey/lemon mixture.
Place on a bed of wild rice and top with 3 tablespoons of Mustard Sauce.
recipes.text: Braised Chicken Breasts With Mustard Sauce. Remove skin from chicken breasts. Place on a rack in an electric frying pan or in frying pan on top of stove. Add 1 cup water to frying pan. Cover and cook on high until breasts are almost done. Remove breasts from frying pan. Heat grill. Place breasts on very hot grill for 10 minutes. Turn often and baste with honey/lemon mixture. Place on a bed of wild rice and top with 3 tablespoons of Mustard Sauce.

recipes.title: Bubbly Cheese Toast
directions: Cut each bread slice into 4 pieces.
Cut a cheese slice to fit each piece of bread; place on a cookie sheet. Broil until cheese is bubbly and lightly browned.
recipes.text: Bubbly Cheese Toast. Cut each bread slice into 4 pieces. Cut a cheese slice to fit each piece of bread; place on a cookie sheet. Broil until cheese is bubbly and lightly browned.

recipes.title: Red Velvet Cake
directions: Cream sugar, oil and eggs well.
Mix cocoa, coloring and vinegar.
Add remaining ingredients.
Beat well.
Cook for 20 minutes at 375°.
Cool.
recipes.text: Red Velvet Cake. Cream sugar, oil and eggs well. Mix cocoa, coloring and vinegar. Add remaining ingredients. Beat well. Cook for 20 minutes at 375°. Cool.

recipes.title: Pike'S Peak Peach Cobbler
ingredients: 3 c. sliced peaches, canned or fresh
1/4 c. plus 3 Tbsp. Holly granulated sugar
directions: Arrange peaches in well-buttered 8-inch square pan or deep casserole; sprinkle with mixture of 1/4 cup Holly granulated sugar, lemon juice, lemon peel and almond extract.
Heat peaches in 375° oven while preparing dough.
recipes.text: Pike'S Peak Peach Cobbler. Arrange peaches in well-buttered 8-inch square pan or deep casserole; sprinkle with mixture of 1/4 cup Holly granulated sugar, lemon juice, lemon peel and almond extract. Heat peaches in 375° oven while preparing dough.

recipes.title: Easy Round Steak
directions: Sprinkle 1/2 package soup mix in bottom of pan.
Place steak on top of soup mix.
Add rest of soup mix and then add mushrooms and water.
Cover with foil.
Bake in 350° oven for 1 hour and 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Easy Round Steak. Sprinkle 1/2 package soup mix in bottom of pan. Place steak on top of soup mix. Add rest of soup mix and then add mushrooms and water. Cover with foil. Bake in 350° oven for 1 hour and 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Crispy Beef Casserole
directions: Brown ground beef and onion in skillet.
Cook celery and onions in small amount of water in saucepan until tender.
Place layer of beef mixture, peas, celery and carrots in 1-quart casserole.
Repeat procedure.
Mix soup, milk and Worcestershire sauce.
Pour over other ingredients.
Top with potato chips.
Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.
recipes.text: Crispy Beef Casserole. Brown ground beef and onion in skillet. Cook celery and onions in small amount of water in saucepan until tender. Place layer of beef mixture, peas, celery and carrots in 1-quart casserole. Repeat procedure. Mix soup, milk and Worcestershire sauce. Pour over other ingredients. Top with potato chips. Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Chocolate Bourbon Balls
directions: Microwave margarine in medium bowl on High, 1 to 2 minutes. Mix in sugar, nuts and bourbon. Refrigerate until firm. Shape mixture into 1-inch balls and refrigerate until firm.
Combine chocolate morsels and cream in a small bowl.
Microwave at Medium-high 1 to 2 minutes, stirring once.
Chocolate should be melted.
Stir until smooth and drizzle over bourbon balls. Chill.
recipes.text: Chocolate Bourbon Balls. Microwave margarine in medium bowl on High, 1 to 2 minutes. Mix in sugar, nuts and bourbon. Refrigerate until firm. Shape mixture into 1-inch balls and refrigerate until firm. Combine chocolate morsels and cream in a small bowl. Microwave at Medium-high 1 to 2 minutes, stirring once. Chocolate should be melted. Stir until smooth and drizzle over bourbon balls. Chill.

recipes.title: Creamy Carrot-Nut Salad
ingredients: 1 (8 oz.) container vanilla or plain yogurt
directions: Dissolve jello in boiling water; add yogurt and stir until well blended.
Stir in pineapple, carrots, pecans and salt. Spoon into lightly oiled mold or cake pan.
Cover and chill until firm.
Yield: 9 servings.
recipes.text: Creamy Carrot-Nut Salad. Dissolve jello in boiling water; add yogurt and stir until well blended. Stir in pineapple, carrots, pecans and salt. Spoon into lightly oiled mold or cake pan. Cover and chill until firm. Yield: 9 servings.

recipes.title: Refrigerated Chocolate Cream Pie
directions: Bake 20 minutes or until light brown.
recipes.text: Refrigerated Chocolate Cream Pie. Bake 20 minutes or until light brown.

recipes.title: Mexican Corn Bread
directions: Mix all together.
Beat eggs before putting them in.
Put meal in last.
Bake like corn bread.
recipes.text: Mexican Corn Bread. Mix all together. Beat eggs before putting them in. Put meal in last. Bake like corn bread.

recipes.title: Potato Soup
directions: Bring potatoes, water, onions and celery to a boil.
Reduce heat to low and cook 15 minutes. Add milk and cook on high to almost boil. Mix flour, egg, salt and pepper.
Stir in flour mixture and add butter.
Reduce to low heat and cook 10 to 15 minutes.
recipes.text: Potato Soup. Bring potatoes, water, onions and celery to a boil. Reduce heat to low and cook 15 minutes. Add milk and cook on high to almost boil. Mix flour, egg, salt and pepper. Stir in flour mixture and add butter. Reduce to low heat and cook 10 to 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Orange Salad
directions: Mix and cool jello and water.
Add and mix orange sherbet. Refrigerate until mixture begins to thicken, then add oranges and Cool Whip.
Refrigerate until firm.
recipes.text: Orange Salad. Mix and cool jello and water. Add and mix orange sherbet. Refrigerate until mixture begins to thicken, then add oranges and Cool Whip. Refrigerate until firm.

recipes.title: 24-Hour Cole Slaw
directions: Slice or grate onions and cabbage.
Put into gallon glass jar. Mix sugar, vinegar, salt and mustard.
Bring to boil; remove from heat and add oil.
Mix well and pour over cabbage and onions. Cover tightly; set in refrigerator and let set for 24 hours.
Will keep a week if kept in refrigerator.
recipes.text: 24-Hour Cole Slaw. Slice or grate onions and cabbage. Put into gallon glass jar. Mix sugar, vinegar, salt and mustard. Bring to boil; remove from heat and add oil. Mix well and pour over cabbage and onions. Cover tightly; set in refrigerator and let set for 24 hours. Will keep a week if kept in refrigerator.

recipes.title: Banana Nut Bread
directions: Cream sugar and butter.
Add eggs and beat well.
Sift flour, salt, baking powder and baking soda together and mix with butter mixture.
Add mashed bananas and vanilla, mix well.
Add buttermilk and nuts and stir well. Pour in 8 1/2 x 4 1/2 x 2 1/2-inch lightly greased loaf pan and bake at 375° for 45 minutes or until done.
recipes.text: Banana Nut Bread. Cream sugar and butter. Add eggs and beat well. Sift flour, salt, baking powder and baking soda together and mix with butter mixture. Add mashed bananas and vanilla, mix well. Add buttermilk and nuts and stir well. Pour in 8 1/2 x 4 1/2 x 2 1/2-inch lightly greased loaf pan and bake at 375° for 45 minutes or until done.

recipes.title: Cauliflower Salad
directions: Fry bacon; drain and crumble.
Slice onion.
Pull apart flowerets from cauliflower.
Shred lettuce.
Make 3 layers of onion, bacon, cauliflower and lettuce.
Then mix together the mayonnaise, sugar and Parmesan cheese for dressing; spread over the top of the salad.
Refrigerate for 24 hours before serving, then mix just prior to serving.
recipes.text: Cauliflower Salad. Fry bacon; drain and crumble. Slice onion. Pull apart flowerets from cauliflower. Shred lettuce. Make 3 layers of onion, bacon, cauliflower and lettuce. Then mix together the mayonnaise, sugar and Parmesan cheese for dressing; spread over the top of the salad. Refrigerate for 24 hours before serving, then mix just prior to serving.

recipes.title: Yarmouth Straws
ingredients: 1 pinch dried mustard powder or 1/4 tsp. ready mixed mustard
1 tin kipper fillets (John West are best!)
directions: Before adding the water to pastry mix, add the grated cheese and mustard.
Divide the pastry in half; roll out one half into a rectangle fairly thin.
Place on baking tray; brush with beaten egg.
Place kipper fillets on pastry.
Roll out another rectangle a little bigger than the lower rectangle.
Place on top of fillets; press down all sides.
Brush over with beaten egg; sprinkle with grated cheese.
Bake in a preheated oven at 400° for approximately 20 to 30 minutes.
When cool, trim off edges and cut into neat, bite size strips.
Serve on plate with parsley garnish. Serves approximately 12 to 15.
recipes.text: Yarmouth Straws. Before adding the water to pastry mix, add the grated cheese and mustard. Divide the pastry in half; roll out one half into a rectangle fairly thin. Place on baking tray; brush with beaten egg. Place kipper fillets on pastry. Roll out another rectangle a little bigger than the lower rectangle. Place on top of fillets; press down all sides. Brush over with beaten egg; sprinkle with grated cheese. Bake in a preheated oven at 400° for approximately 20 to 30 minutes. When cool, trim off edges and cut into neat, bite size strips. Serve on plate with parsley garnish. Serves approximately 12 to 15.

recipes.title: Cheese Straws
directions: Mix cheese and butter and
mix in mixer.
Add remaining ingredients.
Mix well and put on
cookie sheet.
Use star shape cookie press. Bake at 350° for 12 minutes.
recipes.text: Cheese Straws. Mix cheese and butter and mix in mixer. Add remaining ingredients. Mix well and put on cookie sheet. Use star shape cookie press. Bake at 350° for 12 minutes.

recipes.title: Banana Nut Cake
directions: Mash bananas.
Mix all the ingredients together and pour into an oiled and floured Bundt pan.
Cook at 350° for about 40 to 50 minutes.
Watch for cake to pull away from pan.
Very moist cake. You can serve with or without icing or with a dollop of whipped cream.
recipes.text: Banana Nut Cake. Mash bananas. Mix all the ingredients together and pour into an oiled and floured Bundt pan. Cook at 350° for about 40 to 50 minutes. Watch for cake to pull away from pan. Very moist cake. You can serve with or without icing or with a dollop of whipped cream.

recipes.title: Cheese Ring
directions: Grate cheese, then mix it with mayonnaise.
Stir well.
Add chopped onion and pecans.
Stir well.
Add pepper to taste.
Spoon into mold sprayed with Pam.
Remove from mold and top with preserves.
Serve with crackers.
recipes.text: Cheese Ring. Grate cheese, then mix it with mayonnaise. Stir well. Add chopped onion and pecans. Stir well. Add pepper to taste. Spoon into mold sprayed with Pam. Remove from mold and top with preserves. Serve with crackers.

recipes.title: Squash Dressing
ingredients: 2 c. corn bread, cooked and crumbled
directions: Cook squash until tender and drain; mash until fine.
Add all remaining ingredients.
Pour into casserole dish and bake about 30 minutes at 350°.
recipes.text: Squash Dressing. Cook squash until tender and drain; mash until fine. Add all remaining ingredients. Pour into casserole dish and bake about 30 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Swiss Cheese Chicken(Very Easy, Very Good!)
directions: Place chicken in greased 9 x 13-inch casserole dish.
Place cheese on top of chicken.
Mix soup with milk or sherry and pour on top.
Place stuffing mix over all and drizzle with melted butter.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Swiss Cheese Chicken(Very Easy, Very Good!). Place chicken in greased 9 x 13-inch casserole dish. Place cheese on top of chicken. Mix soup with milk or sherry and pour on top. Place stuffing mix over all and drizzle with melted butter. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Tailgate Beans
directions: In skillet, cook bacon; drain and crumble.
Brown ground beef and drain.
Combine beef and bacon with remaining ingredients. Pour into a large casserole dish and bake at 350° until bubbly.
recipes.text: Tailgate Beans. In skillet, cook bacon; drain and crumble. Brown ground beef and drain. Combine beef and bacon with remaining ingredients. Pour into a large casserole dish and bake at 350° until bubbly.

recipes.title: Oatmeal Cookies
ingredients: 1 (3 oz.) plain chocolate bar, cut into small pieces
directions: Cream together butter, sugar and brown sugar.
Add eggs and vanilla.
In separate bowl, mix flour, oatmeal, salt, baking powder and baking soda.
Mix all ingredients together.
Add chocolate chips, chocolate bar and chopped nuts.
recipes.text: Oatmeal Cookies. Cream together butter, sugar and brown sugar. Add eggs and vanilla. In separate bowl, mix flour, oatmeal, salt, baking powder and baking soda. Mix all ingredients together. Add chocolate chips, chocolate bar and chopped nuts.

recipes.title: Baked Pineapple
directions: Spray 9 1/2 x 13-inch baking dish with Pam.
recipes.text: Baked Pineapple. Spray 9 1/2 x 13-inch baking dish with Pam.

recipes.title: Chocolate Brownies
directions: Mix ingredients together.
Put in a pan.
Let bake until the center falls.
recipes.text: Chocolate Brownies. Mix ingredients together. Put in a pan. Let bake until the center falls.

recipes.title: Potato Soup
directions: In a large cooking pan, saute onions in butter until onion is tender.
Add potatoes, chicken broth and water.
Bring to a boil. Cook until tender.
Remove from heat.
Puree half of mixture in blender or with mixer.
Return to saucepan.
In skillet, brown the sausage.
Drain.
Add sausage and milk to soup.
Cook over low heat until sausage is heated thoroughly.
recipes.text: Potato Soup. In a large cooking pan, saute onions in butter until onion is tender. Add potatoes, chicken broth and water. Bring to a boil. Cook until tender. Remove from heat. Puree half of mixture in blender or with mixer. Return to saucepan. In skillet, brown the sausage. Drain. Add sausage and milk to soup. Cook over low heat until sausage is heated thoroughly.

recipes.title: Strawberry Minute Pie
directions: Dissolve gelatin in water.
Add unthawed frozen berries. Break up berries with fork.
As berries thaw, gelatin thickens. When partially set, pour into baked pie shell.
Chill until set. Top with Cool Whip.
recipes.text: Strawberry Minute Pie. Dissolve gelatin in water. Add unthawed frozen berries. Break up berries with fork. As berries thaw, gelatin thickens. When partially set, pour into baked pie shell. Chill until set. Top with Cool Whip.

recipes.title: Squash Casserole
ingredients: 1 (10 3/4 oz.) can cream of mushroom soup
1 pkg. Pepperidge Farm herb seasoned stuffing
directions: Drain off some of the liquid from squash.
Leave about 1/4 cup per can.
Combine squash, soup, carrots, onion, pimento and sour cream.
Set aside.
recipes.text: Squash Casserole. Drain off some of the liquid from squash. Leave about 1/4 cup per can. Combine squash, soup, carrots, onion, pimento and sour cream. Set aside.

recipes.title: Salad Dressing Cake
directions: Mix dry ingredients together.
Add water, salad dressing and vanilla.
Mix with spoon until well blended.
Pour in 9-inch square pan.
Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes.
recipes.text: Salad Dressing Cake. Mix dry ingredients together. Add water, salad dressing and vanilla. Mix with spoon until well blended. Pour in 9-inch square pan. Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Smoky Salmon Dip
ingredients: 1 lb. can salmon, drained and flaked
directions: Mix thoroughly and chill.
Cover with minced parsley and nuts if desired.
Serve with crackers.
recipes.text: Smoky Salmon Dip. Mix thoroughly and chill. Cover with minced parsley and nuts if desired. Serve with crackers.

recipes.title: Skillet Meat Loaf
directions: Heat oven to 350°.
Mix beef, 1/3 cup of tomato sauce, olives, onion, oats, egg and seasoning.
Spread in heavy 10-inch skillet. Cover with remaining 2/3 cup tomato sauce.
Bake 1 hour.
Remove excess fat from skillet before serving.
Cut in wedges to serve.
recipes.text: Skillet Meat Loaf. Heat oven to 350°. Mix beef, 1/3 cup of tomato sauce, olives, onion, oats, egg and seasoning. Spread in heavy 10-inch skillet. Cover with remaining 2/3 cup tomato sauce. Bake 1 hour. Remove excess fat from skillet before serving. Cut in wedges to serve.

recipes.title: No Cholesterol Honey Bran Muffins
ingredients: Mazola no stick corn oil cooking spray
1 c. sifted whole wheat or all-purpose flour
directions: Spray 12 large muffin cups with cooking spray.
In large bowl, stir flour, bran cereal, baking powder, salt and raisins.
In small bowl, stir egg whites, milk, corn oil and honey until well blended. Add to flour mixture, stirring until moistened.
Let stand 3 minutes.
Spoon into muffin tins.
Bake at 400° for 15 to 20 minutes or until lightly browned.
recipes.text: No Cholesterol Honey Bran Muffins. Spray 12 large muffin cups with cooking spray. In large bowl, stir flour, bran cereal, baking powder, salt and raisins. In small bowl, stir egg whites, milk, corn oil and honey until well blended. Add to flour mixture, stirring until moistened. Let stand 3 minutes. Spoon into muffin tins. Bake at 400° for 15 to 20 minutes or until lightly browned.

recipes.title: Italian Beef
directions: Put all ingredients in slow cooker with roast.
Cook on medium all night.
In morning, shred with fork and leave in cooker all day.
Serve on French bread or buns.
recipes.text: Italian Beef. Put all ingredients in slow cooker with roast. Cook on medium all night. In morning, shred with fork and leave in cooker all day. Serve on French bread or buns.

recipes.title: Cheeseburger Pie
ingredients: 1 pkg. WW broth and seasoning mix (beef)
8 oz. cooked ground beef or turkey
directions: Simmer the first 6 ingredients.
Add meat, cheese and rice. Put into an 8 x 8-inch pan.
Bake at 350° until cheese melts. Makes 4 servings (1 vegetable, 3 proteins, 1 bread and 2 1/2 optional calories).
recipes.text: Cheeseburger Pie. Simmer the first 6 ingredients. Add meat, cheese and rice. Put into an 8 x 8-inch pan. Bake at 350° until cheese melts. Makes 4 servings (1 vegetable, 3 proteins, 1 bread and 2 1/2 optional calories).

recipes.title: Christmas Cranberries
directions: Chop cranberries (blender).
Mix sugar and allow to drain overnight.
Mix cranberries with pineapple.
Add red grapes and nuts.
Blend in Cool Whip.
Store in refrigerator.
recipes.text: Christmas Cranberries. Chop cranberries (blender). Mix sugar and allow to drain overnight. Mix cranberries with pineapple. Add red grapes and nuts. Blend in Cool Whip. Store in refrigerator.

recipes.title: Ice Cream Dessert
directions: Crumble crackers.
Add melted margarine and nuts.
Chill while mixing softened ice cream, instant pudding and milk, blending well.
Pour over chilled crust.
Top with Cool Whip.
Sprinkle chopped nuts or reserve some cracker crumbs from crust mixture to top with.
Freeze solid.
recipes.text: Ice Cream Dessert. Crumble crackers. Add melted margarine and nuts. Chill while mixing softened ice cream, instant pudding and milk, blending well. Pour over chilled crust. Top with Cool Whip. Sprinkle chopped nuts or reserve some cracker crumbs from crust mixture to top with. Freeze solid.

recipes.title: Giant Bubble Mix
ingredients: 3 c. Dawn or Joy dishwashing soap
directions: Mix all ingredients together in large bucket.
Use large bubble wands to produce giant bubbles.
Fun for children of all ages!
recipes.text: Giant Bubble Mix. Mix all ingredients together in large bucket. Use large bubble wands to produce giant bubbles. Fun for children of all ages!

recipes.title: Spinach Salad
ingredients: 8 c. spinach, cleaned and cut in pieces
directions: Combine the first 7 ingredients in a jar.
Shake and chill. Combine remaining ingredients in a large bowl.
Toss with the dressing and serve immediately.
recipes.text: Spinach Salad. Combine the first 7 ingredients in a jar. Shake and chill. Combine remaining ingredients in a large bowl. Toss with the dressing and serve immediately.

recipes.title: Apple Dumplings
ingredients: 3 apples, diced and sprinkled with cinnamon
directions: Wrap diced apples in a crescent roll, 1 at a time. Grease dish (9 x 13 casserole). Put layer of rolls in casserole dish. Pour sauce over rolls. Bake 30 minutes at 350°; if not brown, bake a little longer. Dip sauce over rolls all during baking time.
recipes.text: Apple Dumplings. Wrap diced apples in a crescent roll, 1 at a time. Grease dish (9 x 13 casserole). Put layer of rolls in casserole dish. Pour sauce over rolls. Bake 30 minutes at 350°; if not brown, bake a little longer. Dip sauce over rolls all during baking time.

recipes.title: Gravad Lax Appetizers
ingredients: 1 1/2 Tbsp. center cut fresh salmon, scaled with skin on and bones removed
fresh dill and lemon wedges (for garnish)
directions: In cup, combine salt, sugar and peppercorns.
Rub into all sides of fish.
Sprinkle with brandy.
Place 1/3 of dill in shallow glass baking dish.
Put 1 piece of fish skin side down on dill. Top with another 1/3 of dill.
Add another piece of fish skin side up and top with remaining dill.
Cover salmon with plastic wrap. Set plate larger than salmon on it.
Place 2 heavy cans of food on top.
Refrigerate 24 to 36 hours.
recipes.text: Gravad Lax Appetizers. In cup, combine salt, sugar and peppercorns. Rub into all sides of fish. Sprinkle with brandy. Place 1/3 of dill in shallow glass baking dish. Put 1 piece of fish skin side down on dill. Top with another 1/3 of dill. Add another piece of fish skin side up and top with remaining dill. Cover salmon with plastic wrap. Set plate larger than salmon on it. Place 2 heavy cans of food on top. Refrigerate 24 to 36 hours.

recipes.title: Salmon Patties
directions: Mix all together.
Spoon drop patties into skillet and fry until brown on both sides (oil or shortening may be used).
recipes.text: Salmon Patties. Mix all together. Spoon drop patties into skillet and fry until brown on both sides (oil or shortening may be used).

recipes.title: Easy Seven Layer Dip
directions: In serving dish, layer in order given.
Chill and serve with Fritos corn chips.
recipes.text: Easy Seven Layer Dip. In serving dish, layer in order given. Chill and serve with Fritos corn chips.

recipes.title: Tuna Mushroom Casserole
ingredients: 1 (10 oz.) can cream of mushroom soup
2 c. crushed potato chips or crackers
directions: Cook macaroni in salted boiling water
for
10 minutes. Empty drained tuna into large 2-quart baking
dish.
Add	all the ingredients and cooked, drained
macaroni;	mixing	well. Saute the crushed chips or crackers in melting margarine; then sprinkle on	top of casserole.
Bake at 375°
for
to
25 minutes. Serves 6 to 8.
recipes.text: Tuna Mushroom Casserole. Cook macaroni in salted boiling water for 10 minutes. Empty drained tuna into large 2-quart baking dish. Add	all the ingredients and cooked, drained macaroni;	mixing	well. Saute the crushed chips or crackers in melting margarine; then sprinkle on	top of casserole. Bake at 375° for 20 to 25 minutes. Serves 6 to 8.

recipes.title: Enchiladas
directions: Brown hamburger meat; drain grease.
Mix taco seasoning mix with 1/3 cup of water.
Simmer for 5 minutes.
Preheat oven at 350°.
Rol meat inside shells.
Cover with tomato sauce in pan, then put shredded cheese, onions and olives and bake for 15 minutes.
recipes.text: Enchiladas. Brown hamburger meat; drain grease. Mix taco seasoning mix with 1/3 cup of water. Simmer for 5 minutes. Preheat oven at 350°. Rol meat inside shells. Cover with tomato sauce in pan, then put shredded cheese, onions and olives and bake for 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Two Cup Citrus Punch
directions: Dissolve sugar in water in large container.
Add lemon juice, orange juice and pineapple juice.
Add ginger ale just before serving.
Serve over crushed ice.
Yield:
34 servings.
recipes.text: Two Cup Citrus Punch. Dissolve sugar in water in large container. Add lemon juice, orange juice and pineapple juice. Add ginger ale just before serving. Serve over crushed ice. Yield: 34 servings.

recipes.title: Shrimp And Broccoli With Lemon Butter
ingredients: 12 oz. fresh or frozen shelled shrimp
directions: Thaw shrimp; pat dry on paper towels.
In a 10-inch skillet heat half of the butter or margarine over medium-high heat.
Add broccoli and celery.
Cook for 3 or 4 minutes or until vegetables are crisp-tender, stirring often.
Remove from the skillet.
Keep warm.
In the same skillet heat remaining butter or margarine over medium heat.
Add shrimp; cook about 3 minutes or until shrimp turn pink, stirring often.
Return vegetable mixture to the skillet.
Stir in lemon juice and sesame seed.
Can be served over rice, if desired.
recipes.text: Shrimp And Broccoli With Lemon Butter. Thaw shrimp; pat dry on paper towels. In a 10-inch skillet heat half of the butter or margarine over medium-high heat. Add broccoli and celery. Cook for 3 or 4 minutes or until vegetables are crisp-tender, stirring often. Remove from the skillet. Keep warm. In the same skillet heat remaining butter or margarine over medium heat. Add shrimp; cook about 3 minutes or until shrimp turn pink, stirring often. Return vegetable mixture to the skillet. Stir in lemon juice and sesame seed. Can be served over rice, if desired.

recipes.title: Peas And Cucumbers
ingredients: 1/4 c. sour cream or plain yogurt
directions: Cut cucumber lengthwise in fourths, then crisscross into 1-inch pieces.
Bring cucumber, peas and water to boil.
Reduce heat; cover and simmer until peas are tender (about 10 minutes). Drain.
Stir in lettuce, margarine, sugar, salt and pepper; heat until lettuce is hot.
Mix sour cream and lemon juice; toss with vegetables.
Sprinkle with paprika.
recipes.text: Peas And Cucumbers. Cut cucumber lengthwise in fourths, then crisscross into 1-inch pieces. Bring cucumber, peas and water to boil. Reduce heat; cover and simmer until peas are tender (about 10 minutes). Drain. Stir in lettuce, margarine, sugar, salt and pepper; heat until lettuce is hot. Mix sour cream and lemon juice; toss with vegetables. Sprinkle with paprika.

recipes.title: Shrimp Gumbo
directions: Saute celery, green pepper, onion and garlic in small amount of margarine. Stir in chicken broth, tomatoes and sliced okra. Add spices; add any you like with shrimp.
Simmer for awhile.
Add shrimp and cook just until pink.
If not thick, add 1 tablespoon cornstarch.
This is especially good in the summer using fresh veggies.
recipes.text: Shrimp Gumbo. Saute celery, green pepper, onion and garlic in small amount of margarine. Stir in chicken broth, tomatoes and sliced okra. Add spices; add any you like with shrimp. Simmer for awhile. Add shrimp and cook just until pink. If not thick, add 1 tablespoon cornstarch. This is especially good in the summer using fresh veggies.

recipes.title: Chicken Pot Pie
ingredients: 2 (10 3/4 oz.) cans cream of potato soup
directions: Combine first six ingredients.	Spoon into prepared pie crust.
Cover with top crust.
Seal top crust by pressing with fork all the way around edge of crust.
Slit top crust and brush with beaten egg.
Bake at 375° for 40 minutes.
Cool 10 minutes.
recipes.text: Chicken Pot Pie. Combine first six ingredients.	Spoon into prepared pie crust. Cover with top crust. Seal top crust by pressing with fork all the way around edge of crust. Slit top crust and brush with beaten egg. Bake at 375° for 40 minutes. Cool 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Fabulous Pecan Bars
directions: Toast chopped pecans in 350°
oven for 5 to 8 minutes.
Melt butter, peanut butter and butterscotch chips together over low heat.
Cool slightly.
Add marshmallows, pecans and 3/4 cup coconut.
Mix well.
Pat mixture into buttered 9 x 13-inch pan. Sprinkle on remaining coconut.
Cool until firm in refrigerator. Cut into small bars.
recipes.text: Fabulous Pecan Bars. Toast chopped pecans in 350° oven for 5 to 8 minutes. Melt butter, peanut butter and butterscotch chips together over low heat. Cool slightly. Add marshmallows, pecans and 3/4 cup coconut. Mix well. Pat mixture into buttered 9 x 13-inch pan. Sprinkle on remaining coconut. Cool until firm in refrigerator. Cut into small bars.

recipes.title: Cheese Log
ingredients: 1 pkg. Hidden Valley Ranch-style dressing mix
directions: Soften cream cheese and Cheddar cheese until room temperature. Mix in Hidden Valley.
Shape into log and roll in parsley flakes or chopped nuts.
recipes.text: Cheese Log. Soften cream cheese and Cheddar cheese until room temperature. Mix in Hidden Valley. Shape into log and roll in parsley flakes or chopped nuts.

recipes.title: Garlic Grits Souffle
directions: Cook the first 3 ingredients until thick. Add the butter, cheese and eggs.
Mix well. Place in a buttered dish. Cover with crushed cheese crackers.
Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.
recipes.text: Garlic Grits Souffle. Cook the first 3 ingredients until thick. Add the butter, cheese and eggs. Mix well. Place in a buttered dish. Cover with crushed cheese crackers. Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.

recipes.title: El Paso Bake
ingredients: 12 to 14 oz. Monterey Jack cheese, shredded
12 oz. jar salsa (your choice, hot or mild)
3/4 lb. ground meat, ham or sausage, cooked and drained (optional)
directions: Overlap the bottom of a greased 13 x 9-inch pan with tortillas. Beat eggs with milk, then add cheese and salsa.
Mix together.
Add meat, if desired.
Bake at 350° for good hour.
It's done when an inserted knife comes out clean.
recipes.text: El Paso Bake. Overlap the bottom of a greased 13 x 9-inch pan with tortillas. Beat eggs with milk, then add cheese and salsa. Mix together. Add meat, if desired. Bake at 350° for good hour. It's done when an inserted knife comes out clean.

recipes.title: Boiled Dinner
directions: Put ham in very large pan and cover with water.
Boil at least 2 hours.
Cook onions, carrots and potatoes in broth.
Remove enough broth to cover sliced cabbage and cook until just tender. Do not cook cabbage with ham and vegetables as cabbage taste will penetrate them.
recipes.text: Boiled Dinner. Put ham in very large pan and cover with water. Boil at least 2 hours. Cook onions, carrots and potatoes in broth. Remove enough broth to cover sliced cabbage and cook until just tender. Do not cook cabbage with ham and vegetables as cabbage taste will penetrate them.

recipes.title: Oven Roasted Potatoes
ingredients: 1 envelope Lipton Recipe Secrets savory herb with garlic recipe soup mix
1/3 c. olive oil or vegetable oil
directions: Preheat oven to 450°.
Cut potatoes into large chunks.
In large bowl, add ingredients.
Mix well until potatoes are evenly coated.
Bake in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish or roasting pan, stirring occasionally.
Cook about 40 minutes or until potatoes are tender and golden brown.
Garnish, if desired, with chopped fresh parsley.
Makes about 8 servings.
recipes.text: Oven Roasted Potatoes. Preheat oven to 450°. Cut potatoes into large chunks. In large bowl, add ingredients. Mix well until potatoes are evenly coated. Bake in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish or roasting pan, stirring occasionally. Cook about 40 minutes or until potatoes are tender and golden brown. Garnish, if desired, with chopped fresh parsley. Makes about 8 servings.

recipes.title: Apple Cobbler
directions: In a 7 x 11-inch pan, fill less than 1/4 full of boiling water and add butter.
Add sugar, cinnamon and vinegar.
Set aside.
recipes.text: Apple Cobbler. In a 7 x 11-inch pan, fill less than 1/4 full of boiling water and add butter. Add sugar, cinnamon and vinegar. Set aside.

recipes.title: Carrot Cake
ingredients: 3 jars (4 or 4 1/2 oz.) strained carrots (baby food)
directions: Beat together sugar, eggs, vanilla and salt.
Add oil; beat well.
Add strained carrots and mix well.
Add flour, baking soda and cinnamon.
Beat 4 minutes.
Add pineapple, walnuts and raisins.
Pour into greased and floured loaf cake pan and bake at 375° for about 40 to 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Carrot Cake. Beat together sugar, eggs, vanilla and salt. Add oil; beat well. Add strained carrots and mix well. Add flour, baking soda and cinnamon. Beat 4 minutes. Add pineapple, walnuts and raisins. Pour into greased and floured loaf cake pan and bake at 375° for about 40 to 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Mistakes
directions: Brown sausage in large skillet.
Drain.
Melt cheese in skillet with sausage.
Mix in garlic and Worcestershire.
Remove from heat.
Arrange bread on cookie sheet in a single layer.
Put about one tablespoon of sausage mixture on each piece of bread. Bake in oven at 350° for about 10 to 15 minutes.
Makes about 6 dozen.
recipes.text: Mistakes. Brown sausage in large skillet. Drain. Melt cheese in skillet with sausage. Mix in garlic and Worcestershire. Remove from heat. Arrange bread on cookie sheet in a single layer. Put about one tablespoon of sausage mixture on each piece of bread. Bake in oven at 350° for about 10 to 15 minutes. Makes about 6 dozen.

recipes.title: Pork Chop Casserole
directions: Combine all ingredients.
Bake in casserole about 1 hour at 350° or less time if meat is boneless.
recipes.text: Pork Chop Casserole. Combine all ingredients. Bake in casserole about 1 hour at 350° or less time if meat is boneless.

recipes.title: Easy Lemon Pie
directions: Mix together all ingredients.
Pour into graham cracker crust.
recipes.text: Easy Lemon Pie. Mix together all ingredients. Pour into graham cracker crust.

recipes.title: Cajun Catfish Ala "A"
directions: Cut catfish in half; butter both sides of each piece and season with Cajun seasoning.
Stack catfish with parsley in between and wrap securely.
Wrap again two more times so no leaking can occur.
Wire package to "A" manifold just tight enough to keep package from bounding off.
recipes.text: Cajun Catfish Ala "A". Cut catfish in half; butter both sides of each piece and season with Cajun seasoning. Stack catfish with parsley in between and wrap securely. Wrap again two more times so no leaking can occur. Wire package to "A" manifold just tight enough to keep package from bounding off.

recipes.title: Red Velvet Cake
directions: In bowl, combine first 4 ingredients.
In another bowl, beat eggs with fork; add vegetable oil.
Beat again, using mixer.
Add buttermilk, food coloring, vinegar, vanilla and pecans.
Beat until smooth.
Stir liquid into dry ingredients and heat with mixture until well blended.
Pour into 4 greased and floured 8 or 9-inch pans and bake at 350° for 25 minutes or until cake tests done. Cool before frosting.
recipes.text: Red Velvet Cake. In bowl, combine first 4 ingredients. In another bowl, beat eggs with fork; add vegetable oil. Beat again, using mixer. Add buttermilk, food coloring, vinegar, vanilla and pecans. Beat until smooth. Stir liquid into dry ingredients and heat with mixture until well blended. Pour into 4 greased and floured 8 or 9-inch pans and bake at 350° for 25 minutes or until cake tests done. Cool before frosting.

recipes.title: Bamboo Pickles
directions: Boil together.
Put into jars one clove garlic, hot pepper, a small amount of alum, dill weed or 1/2 tsp dill seed.
Cook bamboo for 25 minutes.
After it begins to boil cool in ice water, fill jars with bamboo.
Pour hot vinegar into jars; seal.
Boil five minutes in a hot water bath to seal.
recipes.text: Bamboo Pickles. Boil together. Put into jars one clove garlic, hot pepper, a small amount of alum, dill weed or 1/2 tsp dill seed. Cook bamboo for 25 minutes. After it begins to boil cool in ice water, fill jars with bamboo. Pour hot vinegar into jars; seal. Boil five minutes in a hot water bath to seal.

recipes.title: Pickled Eggs
directions: In saucepan, heat beets and juice on low heat.
Add sugar, vinegar and pickling spice to taste.
Stir until sugar dissolves. Let cool.
Pour over eggs.
Cover and store in refrigerator for several days until eggs are pickled as desired.
recipes.text: Pickled Eggs. In saucepan, heat beets and juice on low heat. Add sugar, vinegar and pickling spice to taste. Stir until sugar dissolves. Let cool. Pour over eggs. Cover and store in refrigerator for several days until eggs are pickled as desired.

recipes.title: Refrigerator Mashed Potatoes
directions: Cook potatoes in boiling salted water.
Drain well.
Mash until smooth.
Add cream cheese, sour cream, onion salt, pepper and oleo. Beat until smooth and fluffy.
Refrigerate.
Recommend storage 2 weeks.
Dot with butter.
Bake about 30 or 40 minutes or until heated through.
Makes 8 cups.
I used an 8 x 10-inch Corning Ware.
recipes.text: Refrigerator Mashed Potatoes. Cook potatoes in boiling salted water. Drain well. Mash until smooth. Add cream cheese, sour cream, onion salt, pepper and oleo. Beat until smooth and fluffy. Refrigerate. Recommend storage 2 weeks. Dot with butter. Bake about 30 or 40 minutes or until heated through. Makes 8 cups. I used an 8 x 10-inch Corning Ware.

recipes.title: Rolled Sugar Cookies
directions: Stir flour, baking powder and salt.
In a large bowl, beat butter and shortening until butter is soft.
Add sugar and beat until fluffy.
Add egg, milk and vanilla.
Beat well.
Add flour mixture and beat until well mixed.
Divide in half.
recipes.text: Rolled Sugar Cookies. Stir flour, baking powder and salt. In a large bowl, beat butter and shortening until butter is soft. Add sugar and beat until fluffy. Add egg, milk and vanilla. Beat well. Add flour mixture and beat until well mixed. Divide in half.

recipes.title: Enchilada Casserole
ingredients: 2 lb. ground beef, browned and drained
1 can enchilada sauce (hot or mild, to your taste)
directions: Mix the enchilada sauce, chilies and soups together.
Layer as follows in casserole dish: chips; half of beef; layer of onions, about 1/2 cup; 1 cup cheese; half of soup mixture.
Repeat layers, top with soup mixture.
Bake at 350° about 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Enchilada Casserole. Mix the enchilada sauce, chilies and soups together. Layer as follows in casserole dish: chips; half of beef; layer of onions, about 1/2 cup; 1 cup cheese; half of soup mixture. Repeat layers, top with soup mixture. Bake at 350° about 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter
directions: Put ingredients in blender.
Blend well.
Salt to taste. Spread on cracker.
recipes.text: Peanut Butter. Put ingredients in blender. Blend well. Salt to taste. Spread on cracker.

recipes.title: Sweet Potato Pecan Balls
directions: Combine all ingredients except pecans and jelly.
In a large bowl, blend well with a potato masher.
Shape into balls, using a measuring tbsp. for each.
Roll balls in ground pecans until coated.

Place on a large cookie sheet at least two inches apart. Indent top of each ball with a spoon and fill with 1/2 tsp. jelly. Bake in preheated 350° oven 15 to 20 minutes or until nuts are lightly toasted.
Yield, about 24 balls.
recipes.text: Sweet Potato Pecan Balls. Combine all ingredients except pecans and jelly. In a large bowl, blend well with a potato masher. Shape into balls, using a measuring tbsp. for each. Roll balls in ground pecans until coated. Place on a large cookie sheet at least two inches apart. Indent top of each ball with a spoon and fill with 1/2 tsp. jelly. Bake in preheated 350° oven 15 to 20 minutes or until nuts are lightly toasted. Yield, about 24 balls.

recipes.title: Gay Cauliflower
directions: Break cauliflower into flowerets and cook in small amount of boiling salted water until tender (8 to 12 minutes).
Meanwhile, place the cheese soup, milk, pepper, pimento and Tabasco in saucepan.
Cover and cook slowly until it starts to boil.
Drain cauliflower and pour the sauce over it.
Serve immediately. Yield: 8 servings.
recipes.text: Gay Cauliflower. Break cauliflower into flowerets and cook in small amount of boiling salted water until tender (8 to 12 minutes). Meanwhile, place the cheese soup, milk, pepper, pimento and Tabasco in saucepan. Cover and cook slowly until it starts to boil. Drain cauliflower and pour the sauce over it. Serve immediately. Yield: 8 servings.

recipes.title: Punch Bowl Dessert
directions: Bake cake and cool. Crumble 1/2 of cake in punch bowl. Mix pudding with milk. Pour 1/2 of pudding over 1/2 of cake. add 1/2 of cool whip. Repeat layers and top with 2 large butterfinger candy bars that have been crushed.
recipes.text: Punch Bowl Dessert. Bake cake and cool. Crumble 1/2 of cake in punch bowl. Mix pudding with milk. Pour 1/2 of pudding over 1/2 of cake. add 1/2 of cool whip. Repeat layers and top with 2 large butterfinger candy bars that have been crushed.

recipes.title: Grandma'S Chocolate Sour Cream Cake
directions: Combine flour, sugar, baking soda and salt in large bowl. Blend in butter, sour cream, eggs and vanilla on low speed.
Beat 3 minutes on medium speed.
Pour batter into greased and floured 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan.
Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes.
Cool completely and frost.
recipes.text: Grandma'S Chocolate Sour Cream Cake. Combine flour, sugar, baking soda and salt in large bowl. Blend in butter, sour cream, eggs and vanilla on low speed. Beat 3 minutes on medium speed. Pour batter into greased and floured 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes. Cool completely and frost.

recipes.title: Lucy'S French Cheesecake
ingredients: grated rind and juice of 1 lemon
5 jumbo eggs, separated (or 6 large eggs minus 1 yolk)
directions: Beat cream cheese and sugar with an electric mixer until sugar no longer looks granular.
Mix in egg yolks, vanilla, sour cream, lemon juice and grated lemon rind.
Beat egg whites until stiff and fold gently, but well, into cheese mixture.
Pour into lightly baked pastry-lined spring-form pan.
recipes.text: Lucy'S French Cheesecake. Beat cream cheese and sugar with an electric mixer until sugar no longer looks granular. Mix in egg yolks, vanilla, sour cream, lemon juice and grated lemon rind. Beat egg whites until stiff and fold gently, but well, into cheese mixture. Pour into lightly baked pastry-lined spring-form pan.

recipes.title: German Pancake
directions: Melt butter in baking pan (9 x 13-inch).
Beat eggs and add milk; mix well.
Add flour a little at a time and mix smooth. Pour in pan.
Bake at 425° for 25 minutes.
recipes.text: German Pancake. Melt butter in baking pan (9 x 13-inch). Beat eggs and add milk; mix well. Add flour a little at a time and mix smooth. Pour in pan. Bake at 425° for 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Pork Chops And Apples
directions: Heat oven to 350°.
Brown pork chops on both sides in hot fat. Place apples in greased baking dish.
Sprinkle with sugar and cinnamon.
Dot with butter.
Top with pork chops.
Cover and bake 1 1/2 hours.
recipes.text: Pork Chops And Apples. Heat oven to 350°. Brown pork chops on both sides in hot fat. Place apples in greased baking dish. Sprinkle with sugar and cinnamon. Dot with butter. Top with pork chops. Cover and bake 1 1/2 hours.

recipes.title: French Dressing
directions: Mix all together in blender.
Beat well for 5 minutes.
recipes.text: French Dressing. Mix all together in blender. Beat well for 5 minutes.

recipes.title: Cucumber Relish
directions: Sprinkle salt over cucumbers, onion and green pepper.
Cover and set in refrigerator 1 hour; drain.
Mix vinegar, celery salt or seed and sugar.
Pour over cucumber mixture.
Mix well.
Place in covered jars and refrigerate.
Can be kept 2 weeks.
Makes 2 full mayonnaise jars.
recipes.text: Cucumber Relish. Sprinkle salt over cucumbers, onion and green pepper. Cover and set in refrigerator 1 hour; drain. Mix vinegar, celery salt or seed and sugar. Pour over cucumber mixture. Mix well. Place in covered jars and refrigerate. Can be kept 2 weeks. Makes 2 full mayonnaise jars.

recipes.title: Cheese Tempters
directions: Combine cheese and butter until well blended.
Add flour and mix.
Add cereal and mix until mixture holds together.
Pinch off 2 teaspoons and roll into balls.
Sprinkle with paprika and place balls on ungreased baking sheet 2-inches apart.
Bake at 400° for 12 to 15 minutes.
Makes 25.
recipes.text: Cheese Tempters. Combine cheese and butter until well blended. Add flour and mix. Add cereal and mix until mixture holds together. Pinch off 2 teaspoons and roll into balls. Sprinkle with paprika and place balls on ungreased baking sheet 2-inches apart. Bake at 400° for 12 to 15 minutes. Makes 25.

recipes.title: "Lyn'S" Wonderful Chicken
directions: Mix together the chicken and cream cheese.
Mix together the broth and soup.
Unroll the rolls and spoon chicken mixture onto wide end of roll.
Continue until all chicken is used.
Place rolls in Pam coated pan.
Pour soup on top of rolls and bake 45 minutes at 350°.
Uncover to brown.
recipes.text: "Lyn'S" Wonderful Chicken. Mix together the chicken and cream cheese. Mix together the broth and soup. Unroll the rolls and spoon chicken mixture onto wide end of roll. Continue until all chicken is used. Place rolls in Pam coated pan. Pour soup on top of rolls and bake 45 minutes at 350°. Uncover to brown.

recipes.title: New York Cheese Cake
directions: Note:
All ingredients must be at room temperature.
recipes.text: New York Cheese Cake. Note: All ingredients must be at room temperature.

recipes.title: Dried Beef Gravy
ingredients: 1 large jar dried beef, rinsed and chopped into shreds
directions: In a large saucepan, melt butter or margarine.
Add flour, salt and pepper.
Stir until smooth and bubbly.
Add milk. Continue stirring until mixture thickens and boils.
Add eggs and beef.
Stir and simmer until hot.
Serve over potato or rice.
recipes.text: Dried Beef Gravy. In a large saucepan, melt butter or margarine. Add flour, salt and pepper. Stir until smooth and bubbly. Add milk. Continue stirring until mixture thickens and boils. Add eggs and beef. Stir and simmer until hot. Serve over potato or rice.

recipes.title: Corn Casserole
directions: Mix corn, eggs and sour cream.
Stir in Jiffy mix.
Blend in melted oleo.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes to one hour.
Cut should come out clean.
recipes.text: Corn Casserole. Mix corn, eggs and sour cream. Stir in Jiffy mix. Blend in melted oleo. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes to one hour. Cut should come out clean.

recipes.title: Butterscotch (Or Chocolate) Crunchies
ingredients: 1 (12 oz.) bag butterscotch or chocolate chips (Hershey's chips Do Not Melt)
directions: 1. Place chips in a medium, microwave-safe bowl. Cover and microwave on medium for 3-1/2 to 5-1/2 minutes, until chips are melted. Stir until smooth (or melt using a double boiler).
recipes.text: Butterscotch (Or Chocolate) Crunchies. 1. Place chips in a medium, microwave-safe bowl. Cover and microwave on medium for 3-1/2 to 5-1/2 minutes, until chips are melted. Stir until smooth (or melt using a double boiler).

recipes.title: Squash Casserole
ingredients: 1 c. grated, extra sharp Cheddar cheese
directions: Mix squash, onion, celery, bouillon, garlic salt, cornbread crumbs, eggs, melted margarine, salt and pepper.
Put layer in greased 9 x 13-inch pan or casserole and add cheese.
Add remaining squash mixture.
Top with bacon bits.
Bake at 350° (325° if glass dish) for about 2 hours.
Should be cooked slowly until golden brown, but still moist, if cooked too fast, it will burn.
Makes 8 to 10 servings.
recipes.text: Squash Casserole. Mix squash, onion, celery, bouillon, garlic salt, cornbread crumbs, eggs, melted margarine, salt and pepper. Put layer in greased 9 x 13-inch pan or casserole and add cheese. Add remaining squash mixture. Top with bacon bits. Bake at 350° (325° if glass dish) for about 2 hours. Should be cooked slowly until golden brown, but still moist, if cooked too fast, it will burn. Makes 8 to 10 servings.

recipes.title: Cheese Biscuits
directions: Preheat oven to 350°. Mix flour, baking powder and sugar together. Using a fork, cut in shortening until it resembles cornmeal. Add cheese. Stir in buttermilk all at one time just until blended. Do not overstir. Drop by tablespoonfuls (I use an ice cream scoop to give biscuits a nicer shape) onto a well-greased baking sheet. Bake for 12 to 15 minutes.
recipes.text: Cheese Biscuits. Preheat oven to 350°. Mix flour, baking powder and sugar together. Using a fork, cut in shortening until it resembles cornmeal. Add cheese. Stir in buttermilk all at one time just until blended. Do not overstir. Drop by tablespoonfuls (I use an ice cream scoop to give biscuits a nicer shape) onto a well-greased baking sheet. Bake for 12 to 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Burnt Sugar Cake
directions: Grease and flour two 9-inch layer pans or 13 x 9-inch oblong pan (large tube pan works well also and is my choice).
recipes.text: Burnt Sugar Cake. Grease and flour two 9-inch layer pans or 13 x 9-inch oblong pan (large tube pan works well also and is my choice).

recipes.title: Buffalo Chicken Wings
ingredients: 1/4 tsp. each celery and garlic powder
directions: Cut each wing into 2 pieces. In a large deep skillet, heat oil over moderate heat (365°). Fry wings for 5 minutes.
Transfer to paper towel. In pie plate, combine butter, vinegar and cayenne pepper. Add wings; toss to coat.
Arrange on warm platter. In small bowl, blend remaining ingredients and serve with wings. Makes 4 servings.
recipes.text: Buffalo Chicken Wings. Cut each wing into 2 pieces. In a large deep skillet, heat oil over moderate heat (365°). Fry wings for 5 minutes. Transfer to paper towel. In pie plate, combine butter, vinegar and cayenne pepper. Add wings; toss to coat. Arrange on warm platter. In small bowl, blend remaining ingredients and serve with wings. Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: Chinese Cabbage Salad
directions: Brown almonds and sesame seed in oil.
When cool, mix with crushed Ramen noodles (do not use seasoning packet) and set aside. Shred cabbage; add chopped onions and pour following Dressing over. Mix and refrigerate until ready to serve.
recipes.text: Chinese Cabbage Salad. Brown almonds and sesame seed in oil. When cool, mix with crushed Ramen noodles (do not use seasoning packet) and set aside. Shred cabbage; add chopped onions and pour following Dressing over. Mix and refrigerate until ready to serve.

recipes.title: Hot Ryes
ingredients: 1/4 c. minced green onions or chives
directions: Mix together all ingredients, except bread.
Spread on party rye or pumpernickel and bake at 375° for 10 or 15 minutes until browned.
recipes.text: Hot Ryes. Mix together all ingredients, except bread. Spread on party rye or pumpernickel and bake at 375° for 10 or 15 minutes until browned.

recipes.title: No Cholesterol Deviled Eggs
directions: Cook egg substitute until done, being careful not to brown. Put in blender.
Add salt, pepper, vinegar and mayonnaise.
Blend well.
Set aside.
Peel eggs.
Cut in halves and discard yolks. Fill egg whites with egg substitute and sprinkle with paprika.
recipes.text: No Cholesterol Deviled Eggs. Cook egg substitute until done, being careful not to brown. Put in blender. Add salt, pepper, vinegar and mayonnaise. Blend well. Set aside. Peel eggs. Cut in halves and discard yolks. Fill egg whites with egg substitute and sprinkle with paprika.

recipes.title: Potato Salad
ingredients: 1/2 c. celery or 1/4 tsp. celery seed
directions: Boil potatoes until tender; peel and dice.
Dice and add pickles, celery, eggs and onion; mix together.
Add salt, pepper and salad dressing; sprinkle with paprika.
Cut egg on top in circles.
recipes.text: Potato Salad. Boil potatoes until tender; peel and dice. Dice and add pickles, celery, eggs and onion; mix together. Add salt, pepper and salad dressing; sprinkle with paprika. Cut egg on top in circles.

recipes.title: Unleavened Bread
directions: Combine hot water, sugar, salt and shortening. Cool to lukewarm.
recipes.text: Unleavened Bread. Combine hot water, sugar, salt and shortening. Cool to lukewarm.

recipes.title: Morning Glory Muffins
directions: Preheat oven to 400°.
Beat eggs, oil and almond flavoring with wire whisk and set aside.
Mix dry ingredients in large mixing bowl.
Add peeled and grated carrots, apple (peeled and grated), raisins, nuts and coconut.
Add egg mixture and stir until moistened.
Put in prepared muffin pan and bake 15 to 20 minutes.
Makes 18 muffins.
recipes.text: Morning Glory Muffins. Preheat oven to 400°. Beat eggs, oil and almond flavoring with wire whisk and set aside. Mix dry ingredients in large mixing bowl. Add peeled and grated carrots, apple (peeled and grated), raisins, nuts and coconut. Add egg mixture and stir until moistened. Put in prepared muffin pan and bake 15 to 20 minutes. Makes 18 muffins.

recipes.title: Grandma'S Fruit Cake
directions: Cream together sugar and butter.
Add applesauce; add fruit, raisins, currants and nuts, mixing well.
Add flour, salt, baking soda and spices, sifting together as you add to
the applesauce mixture.
The batter will be quite stiff.
Pour into a greased and floured 9 x 5-inch loaf pan or a 10-inch tube pan.
Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.
Then reduce heat to 325° and bake for 1 hour. Put a pan of water under it in oven.
Test for doneness with a toothpick.
Let cool in pan for about 5 minutes.
Turn out of pan and continue to cool.
When thoroughly cool, wrap in Saran Wrap and then in aluminum foil.
Put away in a cool place to season. Should be about a month before you want to use it.
recipes.text: Grandma'S Fruit Cake. Cream together sugar and butter. Add applesauce; add fruit, raisins, currants and nuts, mixing well. Add flour, salt, baking soda and spices, sifting together as you add to the applesauce mixture. The batter will be quite stiff. Pour into a greased and floured 9 x 5-inch loaf pan or a 10-inch tube pan. Bake at 350° for 20 minutes. Then reduce heat to 325° and bake for 1 hour. Put a pan of water under it in oven. Test for doneness with a toothpick. Let cool in pan for about 5 minutes. Turn out of pan and continue to cool. When thoroughly cool, wrap in Saran Wrap and then in aluminum foil. Put away in a cool place to season. Should be about a month before you want to use it.

recipes.title: Lemon Poppy Seed Bread
directions: Mix all ingredients together and pour into two loaf pans. Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes.
recipes.text: Lemon Poppy Seed Bread. Mix all ingredients together and pour into two loaf pans. Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Seven Layer Salad
ingredients: 1 pkg. frozen peas, cooked and drained
directions: Fill large salad bowl half full of shredded lettuce.
Add the next four ingredients in layers.
Sprinkle the sugar over the mayonnaise.
Add a layer of cheese, topped with a layer of bacon bits.
Don't mix.
recipes.text: Seven Layer Salad. Fill large salad bowl half full of shredded lettuce. Add the next four ingredients in layers. Sprinkle the sugar over the mayonnaise. Add a layer of cheese, topped with a layer of bacon bits. Don't mix.

recipes.title: Chex Party Mix
ingredients: 8 c. favorite Chex cereals (corn, rice and/or wheat)
directions: In a small bowl, mix seasoned salt and Worcestershire sauce with melted butter and mix well.
Pour cereals, nuts and pretzels into a Ziploc bag.
Pour sauce mixture over cereal mixture in bag.
Seal bag securely.
Shake well, until all pieces are evenly coated.
Pour contents of bag into large microwave safe bowl. Microwave on High 5 to 6 minutes.
Spread out on absorbent paper to cool.
Store in airtight container.
recipes.text: Chex Party Mix. In a small bowl, mix seasoned salt and Worcestershire sauce with melted butter and mix well. Pour cereals, nuts and pretzels into a Ziploc bag. Pour sauce mixture over cereal mixture in bag. Seal bag securely. Shake well, until all pieces are evenly coated. Pour contents of bag into large microwave safe bowl. Microwave on High 5 to 6 minutes. Spread out on absorbent paper to cool. Store in airtight container.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Cookies
directions: Cream shortening and sugar together until light.
Add unbeaten eggs and blend.
Sift together flour and spices.
Add to creamed mixture alternately with pumpkin.
Add raisins and nuts.
Mix well.
Drop by teaspoonfuls on greased baking sheet about 2 inches apart.
Bake at 400° for about 15 minutes until lightly browned. Makes 4 dozen.
recipes.text: Pumpkin Cookies. Cream shortening and sugar together until light. Add unbeaten eggs and blend. Sift together flour and spices. Add to creamed mixture alternately with pumpkin. Add raisins and nuts. Mix well. Drop by teaspoonfuls on greased baking sheet about 2 inches apart. Bake at 400° for about 15 minutes until lightly browned. Makes 4 dozen.

recipes.title: Chocolate Chip Kiss Cookies
ingredients: 1 c. Hershey's semi-sweet mini baking chips
directions: Heat oven to 375 degrees.
Remove wrappers from Hershey's kisses.
Beat butter, granulated sugar, brown sugar and vanilla in large bowl until well blended.
Add flour to mixture, stir in semi-sweet chips.
Mold scant tablespoon dough around each Hershey's kisses covering completely shape into balls.
Place on ungreased baking pan.
Bake 10 to 12 minutes, cool slightly. Remove from pan, cool completely, drip Hershey's chocolate over cookies.
About 4 dozen.
recipes.text: Chocolate Chip Kiss Cookies. Heat oven to 375 degrees. Remove wrappers from Hershey's kisses. Beat butter, granulated sugar, brown sugar and vanilla in large bowl until well blended. Add flour to mixture, stir in semi-sweet chips. Mold scant tablespoon dough around each Hershey's kisses covering completely shape into balls. Place on ungreased baking pan. Bake 10 to 12 minutes, cool slightly. Remove from pan, cool completely, drip Hershey's chocolate over cookies. About 4 dozen.

recipes.title: Dirty Rice(Servings: 6.  Preparation Time: 1 Hour And 30 Minutes.)
directions: Bring stock to a boil with onion, celery and garlic.
Add giblets and livers; lower heat and simmer until livers are just done, but still pink inside.
Drain, reserving stock.
Coarsely chop livers and edible giblets and reserve.
recipes.text: Dirty Rice(Servings: 6.  Preparation Time: 1 Hour And 30 Minutes.). Bring stock to a boil with onion, celery and garlic. Add giblets and livers; lower heat and simmer until livers are just done, but still pink inside. Drain, reserving stock. Coarsely chop livers and edible giblets and reserve.

recipes.title: Shrimp Casserole
ingredients: 5 slices of bread (cut up into cubes)
directions: Mix bread, butter, shrimp, salt, pepper, cheese.
Mix eggs and milk.
Combine these two mixtures and pour into greased casserole dish.
Set dish in pan of hot water in 350° oven for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Shrimp Casserole. Mix bread, butter, shrimp, salt, pepper, cheese. Mix eggs and milk. Combine these two mixtures and pour into greased casserole dish. Set dish in pan of hot water in 350° oven for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Three Greens Salad
ingredients: 1/4 c. finely chopped fresh flat leaf parsley
directions: Combine first 5 ingredients in a large bowl; toss well. Combine vinegar, broth and oil; stir well with a whisk. Pour over pasta mixture; toss gently to coat. Sprinkle with parsley and cheese. Serves 6.
recipes.text: Three Greens Salad. Combine first 5 ingredients in a large bowl; toss well. Combine vinegar, broth and oil; stir well with a whisk. Pour over pasta mixture; toss gently to coat. Sprinkle with parsley and cheese. Serves 6.

recipes.title: Aunt Denise'S Fruit Salad
directions: Drain fruit. Slice bananas into large bowl. Add fruit, marshmallows and mayonnaise. Refrigerate at least 1 hour.
recipes.text: Aunt Denise'S Fruit Salad. Drain fruit. Slice bananas into large bowl. Add fruit, marshmallows and mayonnaise. Refrigerate at least 1 hour.

recipes.title: Vegetable Dip
directions: Mix all the ingredients together and use as a dip for fresh vegetables.
recipes.text: Vegetable Dip. Mix all the ingredients together and use as a dip for fresh vegetables.

recipes.title: Potato Salad
ingredients: 1/2 doz. eggs, boiled hard and chopped fine
directions: Peel
the potatoes and cut into small quarters;
wrench the potatoes and cover with sufficient amount of water; bring to a boil
and boil until tender, not mushy.
Drain and rinse with cool water for about 5 minutes.
recipes.text: Potato Salad. Peel the potatoes and cut into small quarters; wrench the potatoes and cover with sufficient amount of water; bring to a boil and boil until tender, not mushy. Drain and rinse with cool water for about 5 minutes.

recipes.title: Cranberry Refrigerator Cake
directions: Mix together cranberries, banana and sugar.
Set aside. Place 1/2 of the crushed wafers in bottom of an 8 x 8 x 2-inch pan. Cream together butter and confectioners sugar.
Add eggs and beat well.
Spread
over the crumbs.
Top with a layer of the cranberry-banana
mixture
adding
the nuts and spreading whipped cream over it.
Cover with remaining wafers and chill overnight.
recipes.text: Cranberry Refrigerator Cake. Mix together cranberries, banana and sugar. Set aside. Place 1/2 of the crushed wafers in bottom of an 8 x 8 x 2-inch pan. Cream together butter and confectioners sugar. Add eggs and beat well. Spread over the crumbs. Top with a layer of the cranberry-banana mixture adding the nuts and spreading whipped cream over it. Cover with remaining wafers and chill overnight.

recipes.title: Jazz Pies
directions: Mix all together and place pie crust in muffin pans.
Fill 3/4 full with filling.
Bake at 350° until done.
recipes.text: Jazz Pies. Mix all together and place pie crust in muffin pans. Fill 3/4 full with filling. Bake at 350° until done.

recipes.title: Chocolate Turtle Cheesecake
ingredients: 1/2 c. semi-sweet or milk chocolate chips
directions: Fix it like it says.
Follow the directions on the package, that is what you do.
recipes.text: Chocolate Turtle Cheesecake. Fix it like it says. Follow the directions on the package, that is what you do.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Frosting
directions: Combine all ingredients except vanilla in heavy saucepan. Stir over medium heat until sugar dissolves.
Boil for approximately 2 minutes.
Remove from heat and add vanilla.
Cool and beat until right consistency for spreading.
Frost tops and sides of three 9-inch layers.
recipes.text: Peanut Butter Frosting. Combine all ingredients except vanilla in heavy saucepan. Stir over medium heat until sugar dissolves. Boil for approximately 2 minutes. Remove from heat and add vanilla. Cool and beat until right consistency for spreading. Frost tops and sides of three 9-inch layers.

recipes.title: Aggression Cookies(Good For Kids To Make On Dreary Days)
directions: Put everything into large bowl.
Mash, knead or beat with hands.
Shape into walnut size balls.
Butter bottom of glass. Place balls in ungreased cookie sheet.
Dip glass in sugar and lightly mash balls to flatten.
Re-dip glass in sugar each time. Bake at 350° for 10 minutes.
Makes 3 1/2 dozen.
recipes.text: Aggression Cookies(Good For Kids To Make On Dreary Days). Put everything into large bowl. Mash, knead or beat with hands. Shape into walnut size balls. Butter bottom of glass. Place balls in ungreased cookie sheet. Dip glass in sugar and lightly mash balls to flatten. Re-dip glass in sugar each time. Bake at 350° for 10 minutes. Makes 3 1/2 dozen.

recipes.title: Rice Krispies Peanut Butter Balls
directions: Combine syrup, sugar and butter in saucepan and bring to a boil.

Reduce heat and add peanut butter, stirring until melted. Pour peanut butter mixture over Rice Krispies in a large bowl. Stir until well mixed and spread into greased 9 x 13 inch pan and press down lightly and cool, cut into bars.
recipes.text: Rice Krispies Peanut Butter Balls. Combine syrup, sugar and butter in saucepan and bring to a boil. Reduce heat and add peanut butter, stirring until melted. Pour peanut butter mixture over Rice Krispies in a large bowl. Stir until well mixed and spread into greased 9 x 13 inch pan and press down lightly and cool, cut into bars.

recipes.title: Rice Pudding
directions: Preheat oven to 350°. In large bowl, beat eggs, sugar and salt. Scald milk and pour into egg mixture. Stir in raisins, rice and vanilla. Pour into slightly greased ovenproof baking dish, 1-quart size. Sprinkle with nutmeg. Place the dish in the oven in a pan of water 1-inch deep. Bake for 1 hour and 15 minutes.
recipes.text: Rice Pudding. Preheat oven to 350°. In large bowl, beat eggs, sugar and salt. Scald milk and pour into egg mixture. Stir in raisins, rice and vanilla. Pour into slightly greased ovenproof baking dish, 1-quart size. Sprinkle with nutmeg. Place the dish in the oven in a pan of water 1-inch deep. Bake for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Spinach Casserole
ingredients: 1 (10 oz.) pkg. frozen chopped spinach, thawed
directions: Preheat oven to 350°.
Beat eggs and flour in bowl until smooth.
Stir in spinach, cottage cheese, Cheddar cheese and salt. Mix well.
Pour into greased 1-quart casserole.
Bake in oven for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Spinach Casserole. Preheat oven to 350°. Beat eggs and flour in bowl until smooth. Stir in spinach, cottage cheese, Cheddar cheese and salt. Mix well. Pour into greased 1-quart casserole. Bake in oven for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Party Special Chicken Salad
directions: Stew and pull meat from chickens or use enough parts to equal 2 whole chickens.
May select parts to taste, but remember, too much white meat will make your salad dry.
Cut up by hand into fine bits.
Cut up celery, pickles and hard-boiled eggs.
Mix together with mayonnaise (may use fat-free).
Season to taste. Keep refrigerated.
recipes.text: Party Special Chicken Salad. Stew and pull meat from chickens or use enough parts to equal 2 whole chickens. May select parts to taste, but remember, too much white meat will make your salad dry. Cut up by hand into fine bits. Cut up celery, pickles and hard-boiled eggs. Mix together with mayonnaise (may use fat-free). Season to taste. Keep refrigerated.

recipes.title: Taco Hot Dish
directions: Brown the hamburger and add onion, salt, pepper and taco seasoning with water.
Combine with soups, enchilada sauce and chilies. Heat.
Place in casserole, alternating layers of chips, sauce
and cheese. Bake until bubbly at 300°.
Serve with more chips.
recipes.text: Taco Hot Dish. Brown the hamburger and add onion, salt, pepper and taco seasoning with water. Combine with soups, enchilada sauce and chilies. Heat. Place in casserole, alternating layers of chips, sauce and cheese. Bake until bubbly at 300°. Serve with more chips.

recipes.title: Apple-Nut Cake
ingredients: 3 c. chopped, peeled and cored apples
directions: Measure all but last 2 ingredients into large bowl.
Mix on low speed of mixer, scraping sides of bowl.
Fold in apples and chopped nuts.
Spread batter in greased, floured 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake 60 to 65 minutes or until toothpick in center comes out clean in a 350° oven.
Cool 10 minutes.
