recipes.text: Apple-Nut Cake. Measure all but last 2 ingredients into large bowl. Mix on low speed of mixer, scraping sides of bowl. Fold in apples and chopped nuts. Spread batter in greased, floured 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake 60 to 65 minutes or until toothpick in center comes out clean in a 350° oven. Cool 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Ruby'S Rolls
directions: Dissolve yeast in water.
Put flour in a large bowl.
Make a hole in flour.
Pour buttermilk, yeast, sugar and oil in flour. Stir with a spoon to make dough.
Knead on board.
Roll out 1/4-inch thick and cut with a biscuit cutter.
Fold over with melted butter and let rise 45 minutes.
Bake at 450° until brown. Melt butter and pour just a little bit on each roll before putting in oven to bake.
When making dough the night before, it will keep in the refrigerator 4 to 5 days.
recipes.text: Ruby'S Rolls. Dissolve yeast in water. Put flour in a large bowl. Make a hole in flour. Pour buttermilk, yeast, sugar and oil in flour. Stir with a spoon to make dough. Knead on board. Roll out 1/4-inch thick and cut with a biscuit cutter. Fold over with melted butter and let rise 45 minutes. Bake at 450° until brown. Melt butter and pour just a little bit on each roll before putting in oven to bake. When making dough the night before, it will keep in the refrigerator 4 to 5 days.

recipes.title: Caramel Corn
directions: Bring to boil the butter, brown sugar, Karo syrup and salt for 5 minutes.
Add baking soda; pour over popped corn.
Place in a deep baking pan.
Cook at 200° for 1 hour, stirring every 15 minutes.
recipes.text: Caramel Corn. Bring to boil the butter, brown sugar, Karo syrup and salt for 5 minutes. Add baking soda; pour over popped corn. Place in a deep baking pan. Cook at 200° for 1 hour, stirring every 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Broccoli-Lima Bake
ingredients: 3 c. Rice Krispies, lightly browned in butter
directions: Cook vegetables until barely tender.
Blend mushroom soup, sour cream and onion mix.
Stir into cooked vegetables.
Add water chestnuts.
Spoon into a buttered 9 x 13-inch casserole.
Top with Rice Krispies that have been browned lightly in butter.
Cover loosely with foil and bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Broccoli-Lima Bake. Cook vegetables until barely tender. Blend mushroom soup, sour cream and onion mix. Stir into cooked vegetables. Add water chestnuts. Spoon into a buttered 9 x 13-inch casserole. Top with Rice Krispies that have been browned lightly in butter. Cover loosely with foil and bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Heavenly Strawberry
directions: Tear angel food cake apart.
Mix Cool Whip, cream cheese and sugar together.
Then mix strawberries and glaze together.
Pour over cake.
recipes.text: Heavenly Strawberry. Tear angel food cake apart. Mix Cool Whip, cream cheese and sugar together. Then mix strawberries and glaze together. Pour over cake.

recipes.title: Noodles Kugel
directions: Melt oleo.
Beat eggs until foamy.
Boil noodles, leave slightly underdone.
Let stand in cold water until needed.
Pare and slice thinly the apples; add cinnamon, nutmeg, orange juice, lemon peel and sugar.
Mix and let stand.
Grease a 2-quart casserole.
Put ingredients in layers, starting with noodles and ending with apples.
Sprinkle raisins on each layer.
Pour remaining juice over all.
Sprinkle with bread crumbs.
No raisins on top.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Noodles Kugel. Melt oleo. Beat eggs until foamy. Boil noodles, leave slightly underdone. Let stand in cold water until needed. Pare and slice thinly the apples; add cinnamon, nutmeg, orange juice, lemon peel and sugar. Mix and let stand. Grease a 2-quart casserole. Put ingredients in layers, starting with noodles and ending with apples. Sprinkle raisins on each layer. Pour remaining juice over all. Sprinkle with bread crumbs. No raisins on top. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Sausage-Cheese Balls
directions: Cook sausage in skillet, about 8 to 10 minutes.
Break up sausage as it cooks.
Drain off fat.
Let cool.
In 2-quart bowl, mix meat, cheese, Bisquick and water; roll into 1-inch balls.
Bake at 400° on lightly greased cookie sheet until fluffed and browned. Serve hot.
Makes approximately 30 balls.
recipes.text: Sausage-Cheese Balls. Cook sausage in skillet, about 8 to 10 minutes. Break up sausage as it cooks. Drain off fat. Let cool. In 2-quart bowl, mix meat, cheese, Bisquick and water; roll into 1-inch balls. Bake at 400° on lightly greased cookie sheet until fluffed and browned. Serve hot. Makes approximately 30 balls.

recipes.title: Cottage Cheese Salad
directions: Mix jello and boiling water together and chill, just until it starts to jell.
Add mayonnaise, pineapple, cottage cheese and horseradish; mix.
Turn into a mold; let set.
Serve on lettuce.
recipes.text: Cottage Cheese Salad. Mix jello and boiling water together and chill, just until it starts to jell. Add mayonnaise, pineapple, cottage cheese and horseradish; mix. Turn into a mold; let set. Serve on lettuce.

recipes.title: Diabetic Cake
directions: Mix first five ingredients.
Stir in applesauce, flour, soda and vanilla.
Beat at low speed.
Add raisins and nuts.
Mix well. Bake in greased and floured pan at 350° until done.
recipes.text: Diabetic Cake. Mix first five ingredients. Stir in applesauce, flour, soda and vanilla. Beat at low speed. Add raisins and nuts. Mix well. Bake in greased and floured pan at 350° until done.

recipes.title: Hors D'Oeuvres
ingredients: 1 lb. hot dogs, cut in 1-inch pieces
directions: Mix jelly with mustard and horseradish.
Add hot dog pieces. Heat and serve with toothpicks on the side.
recipes.text: Hors D'Oeuvres. Mix jelly with mustard and horseradish. Add hot dog pieces. Heat and serve with toothpicks on the side.

recipes.title: Cherry Cheesecakes
directions: Beat mixture until fluffy.
Place a vanilla wafer in the bottom of a cupcake liner.
Fill 2/3 full of cream cheese mixture. Bake at 375° for about 15 to 20 minutes until mixture is set. Let cool.
Top with cherry pie filling.
recipes.text: Cherry Cheesecakes. Beat mixture until fluffy. Place a vanilla wafer in the bottom of a cupcake liner. Fill 2/3 full of cream cheese mixture. Bake at 375° for about 15 to 20 minutes until mixture is set. Let cool. Top with cherry pie filling.

recipes.title: Veggie Pizza
ingredients: vegetables (broccoli, cauliflower, carrots, mushrooms, green pepper and lettuce)
directions: Spread dough on jelly roll pan.
Bake for 10 minutes.
Preheat oven according to package.
Cool.
Blend the mayonnaise, dry Hidden Valley mix and cream cheese.
Spread on cooled crust. Sprinkle your choice of vegetables over cheese mixture (all vegetables shredded).
May top with cheese.
Chill.
Cut and serve.
recipes.text: Veggie Pizza. Spread dough on jelly roll pan. Bake for 10 minutes. Preheat oven according to package. Cool. Blend the mayonnaise, dry Hidden Valley mix and cream cheese. Spread on cooled crust. Sprinkle your choice of vegetables over cheese mixture (all vegetables shredded). May top with cheese. Chill. Cut and serve.

recipes.title: Chicken Delight
ingredients: 4 to 6 chicken breasts, cut into bite size pieces
directions: Blend soups together and set aside.
Melt butter in a 13 x 9-inch casserole dish.
Stir rice into melted butter in casserole dish.
Blend in 1/2 of soup mixture into rice.
Mix chicken pieces into remaining soup mixture and spread on top of rice mixture. Top with paprika.
Bake 1 hour at 350°.
recipes.text: Chicken Delight. Blend soups together and set aside. Melt butter in a 13 x 9-inch casserole dish. Stir rice into melted butter in casserole dish. Blend in 1/2 of soup mixture into rice. Mix chicken pieces into remaining soup mixture and spread on top of rice mixture. Top with paprika. Bake 1 hour at 350°.

recipes.title: Chocolate Crisps
directions: In a medium bowl, combine the flour, cocoa powder, salt, baking soda and sugar. In a small bowl, mix the egg white, oil, vanilla and water. Add wet ingredients to the dry ingredients all at once. Mix well, then roll the dough in your hands into 1 1/2-inch thick "snake". Wrap the dough in plastic wrap and refrigerate for 30 minutes. Preheat the oven to 350° and spray baking sheet with pan spray. Slice the chilled dough into 1/4-inch thick rounds. Arrange the cookies 1-inch apart on the baking sheet. Bake for 12 to 14 minutes. Makes 30.
recipes.text: Chocolate Crisps. In a medium bowl, combine the flour, cocoa powder, salt, baking soda and sugar. In a small bowl, mix the egg white, oil, vanilla and water. Add wet ingredients to the dry ingredients all at once. Mix well, then roll the dough in your hands into 1 1/2-inch thick "snake". Wrap the dough in plastic wrap and refrigerate for 30 minutes. Preheat the oven to 350° and spray baking sheet with pan spray. Slice the chilled dough into 1/4-inch thick rounds. Arrange the cookies 1-inch apart on the baking sheet. Bake for 12 to 14 minutes. Makes 30.

recipes.title: Sour Cream Biscuits
directions: Mix all ingredients; drop by tablespoon.
Bake at 400° until golden brown.
recipes.text: Sour Cream Biscuits. Mix all ingredients; drop by tablespoon. Bake at 400° until golden brown.

recipes.title: Strawberry Delight Salad
ingredients: 1 large Cool Whip or sour cream
directions: Dissolve strawberry gelatin in boiling water.
Put strawberries in hot gelatin and stir until melted.
Add crushed pineapple and syrup.
Stir well.
Pour into rectangular dish.
Chill for two hours or overnight.
Stir cream cheese and sugar together until fluffy.
Add Cool Whip and vanilla.
Spread over gelatin then sprinkle chopped nuts over top.
Chill.
Cut into squares.
recipes.text: Strawberry Delight Salad. Dissolve strawberry gelatin in boiling water. Put strawberries in hot gelatin and stir until melted. Add crushed pineapple and syrup. Stir well. Pour into rectangular dish. Chill for two hours or overnight. Stir cream cheese and sugar together until fluffy. Add Cool Whip and vanilla. Spread over gelatin then sprinkle chopped nuts over top. Chill. Cut into squares.

recipes.title: Goulash
ingredients: 2 lb. chuck, blade or boneless pot roast, cut in cubes
directions: Brown bacon in heavy 3-quart pot with a tight fitting lid. Remove bacon and brown onions in drippings until transparent. Remove pot from heat and add paprika, beef, salt, caraway, bacon and half green pepper and tomato.
Return to heat and cover tightly.
Simmer over low heat, stirring occasionally, and add small amounts of water as needed.
Cook 1 1/2 to 2 hours until meat is tender.
Add garlic, potatoes, the rest of peppers and tomatoes.
Add enough water to completely cover meat and vegetables.
Bring to a boil; simmer 30 minutes.
Serve with very small bow tie egg noodles.
recipes.text: Goulash. Brown bacon in heavy 3-quart pot with a tight fitting lid. Remove bacon and brown onions in drippings until transparent. Remove pot from heat and add paprika, beef, salt, caraway, bacon and half green pepper and tomato. Return to heat and cover tightly. Simmer over low heat, stirring occasionally, and add small amounts of water as needed. Cook 1 1/2 to 2 hours until meat is tender. Add garlic, potatoes, the rest of peppers and tomatoes. Add enough water to completely cover meat and vegetables. Bring to a boil; simmer 30 minutes. Serve with very small bow tie egg noodles.

recipes.title: Cran-Apple Bake
directions: Combine fruit and sugar in a 9 x 13 x 2-inch baking dish.
Mix remaining ingredients and sprinkle over top.
Bake at 350° for one hour or until brown and bubbly.
recipes.text: Cran-Apple Bake. Combine fruit and sugar in a 9 x 13 x 2-inch baking dish. Mix remaining ingredients and sprinkle over top. Bake at 350° for one hour or until brown and bubbly.

recipes.title: Taco Rice
directions: Cook rice according to directions.
I use 1 cup of rice to 2 cups water.
recipes.text: Taco Rice. Cook rice according to directions. I use 1 cup of rice to 2 cups water.

recipes.title: Strawberry Dessert
ingredients: 1/2 (10 1/2 oz.) angel food cake, torn into bite size pieces
directions: Fold Cool Whip and yogurt together; set aside.
Layer half each of the cake, yogurt, strawberries and kiwi in an 8-inch square dish.
Repeat layers.
Sprinkle almonds on top.
Cover and chill at least 2 hours.
recipes.text: Strawberry Dessert. Fold Cool Whip and yogurt together; set aside. Layer half each of the cake, yogurt, strawberries and kiwi in an 8-inch square dish. Repeat layers. Sprinkle almonds on top. Cover and chill at least 2 hours.

recipes.title: Cheese-Olive Balls
ingredients: 4 oz. finely shredded sharp Cheddar cheese
directions: Preheat oven to 400°.
Mix all ingredients together except for olives.
Form dough into small balls with an olive in the center. Bake about 15 minutes until lightly browned.
Makes about 4 dozen. Best served hot.
recipes.text: Cheese-Olive Balls. Preheat oven to 400°. Mix all ingredients together except for olives. Form dough into small balls with an olive in the center. Bake about 15 minutes until lightly browned. Makes about 4 dozen. Best served hot.

recipes.title: P.T.A.  Casserole
ingredients: 1 can Franco American spaghetti with cheese
directions: Brown meat; pour off grease.
Add everything into casserole. Just fold together; don't whip.
Bake at 350° for at least 1/2 hour.
recipes.text: P.T.A.  Casserole. Brown meat; pour off grease. Add everything into casserole. Just fold together; don't whip. Bake at 350° for at least 1/2 hour.

recipes.title: Ham Pinwheels
directions: Combine softened cream cheese with 1 heaping tablespoonful of mayonnaise and a dash of onion salt.
Take filling and spread 1/8-inch thickness on a slice of ham.
Roll up lengthwise.
Insert toothpicks to help hold roll.
Put in freezer for about 30 minutes, then remove from freezer and slice 1/4-inch slices.
recipes.text: Ham Pinwheels. Combine softened cream cheese with 1 heaping tablespoonful of mayonnaise and a dash of onion salt. Take filling and spread 1/8-inch thickness on a slice of ham. Roll up lengthwise. Insert toothpicks to help hold roll. Put in freezer for about 30 minutes, then remove from freezer and slice 1/4-inch slices.

recipes.title: Mexican Salsa Salad
directions: Mix ingredients and chill before serving.
recipes.text: Mexican Salsa Salad. Mix ingredients and chill before serving.

recipes.title: Strawberry Coconut Divinity(Make On A Dry Day With Low Humidity)
directions: In a heavy bottom saucepan, combine the sugar, corn syrup and water and bring to a boil, stirring constantly, then cover and let boil 3 minutes while the steam washes down any crystals formed on the sides of the pan.
Remove lid and cook to hard ball stage (250° on your candy thermometer).
Stir occasionally while cooking to hard ball stage.
While this is cooking, beat egg whites and combine them with the gelatin in another saucepan; pour the hot syrup in a thin stream into the egg white-gelatin mixture, beating simultaneously.
Mixture will lose gloss and begin to hold shape. Fold in coconut and nuts.
Pour into buttered 9-inch square pan. Let cool.
Cut into pieces.
recipes.text: Strawberry Coconut Divinity(Make On A Dry Day With Low Humidity). In a heavy bottom saucepan, combine the sugar, corn syrup and water and bring to a boil, stirring constantly, then cover and let boil 3 minutes while the steam washes down any crystals formed on the sides of the pan. Remove lid and cook to hard ball stage (250° on your candy thermometer). Stir occasionally while cooking to hard ball stage. While this is cooking, beat egg whites and combine them with the gelatin in another saucepan; pour the hot syrup in a thin stream into the egg white-gelatin mixture, beating simultaneously. Mixture will lose gloss and begin to hold shape. Fold in coconut and nuts. Pour into buttered 9-inch square pan. Let cool. Cut into pieces.

recipes.title: Cheese Pecan Crisps
directions: Grate the cheese.
Cream butter and cheese and add remaining ingredients.
Refrigerate until able to roll into round rolls the size of fifty-cent piece.
Put rolls in freezer.
May freeze indefinitely.
Take out of freezer and wait 10 minutes before slicing into thin rounds.
Place on ungreased cookie sheet and bake about 10 minutes at 350°.
recipes.text: Cheese Pecan Crisps. Grate the cheese. Cream butter and cheese and add remaining ingredients. Refrigerate until able to roll into round rolls the size of fifty-cent piece. Put rolls in freezer. May freeze indefinitely. Take out of freezer and wait 10 minutes before slicing into thin rounds. Place on ungreased cookie sheet and bake about 10 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Salisbury Steak
directions: Combine ground meat, salt and pepper.
Shape into 4 patties. Brown in margarine.
Cook onion along with burgers.
After they are browned, top with soup, water, basil and mushrooms.
Cover and cook over low heat 15 minutes or until heated through.
Serve with mashed potatoes or noodles and a vegetable.
recipes.text: Salisbury Steak. Combine ground meat, salt and pepper. Shape into 4 patties. Brown in margarine. Cook onion along with burgers. After they are browned, top with soup, water, basil and mushrooms. Cover and cook over low heat 15 minutes or until heated through. Serve with mashed potatoes or noodles and a vegetable.

recipes.title: Cherry Cheese Pie 2(Leanna Cerbu)
directions: In a large bowl, beat cream cheese until fluffy. Beat in milk until smooth. Stir in lemon juice and vanilla, then pour whole mixture into graham cracker crust. Cover and refrigerate for 3 hours or until set.
Top with desired amount of pie filling before serving. Refrigerate leftovers.
recipes.text: Cherry Cheese Pie 2(Leanna Cerbu). In a large bowl, beat cream cheese until fluffy. Beat in milk until smooth. Stir in lemon juice and vanilla, then pour whole mixture into graham cracker crust. Cover and refrigerate for 3 hours or until set. Top with desired amount of pie filling before serving. Refrigerate leftovers.

recipes.title: Vegetarian Chili
ingredients: 1 medium green or red bell pepper, chopped
8 oz. jar mild or hot picante sauce
2 1/4 oz. can ripe sliced olives, drained
directions: In large saucepan or Dutch oven, saut green pepper, onion, celery, carrots and garlic in oil until crisp-tender. Add herbs and spices. Stir in tomatoes, picante sauce, bouillon and mushrooms. Bring to a boil; reduce heat. Cover and simmer 30 minutes, stirring occasionally. Stir in olives, zucchini, chili and garbanzo beans. Add water; simmer until thoroughly heated and zucchini is crisp and tender. Sprinkle cheese over chili when served. Can be served with rice and corn muffins. Makes 8 (1 1/2 cup) servings.
recipes.text: Vegetarian Chili. In large saucepan or Dutch oven, saut green pepper, onion, celery, carrots and garlic in oil until crisp-tender. Add herbs and spices. Stir in tomatoes, picante sauce, bouillon and mushrooms. Bring to a boil; reduce heat. Cover and simmer 30 minutes, stirring occasionally. Stir in olives, zucchini, chili and garbanzo beans. Add water; simmer until thoroughly heated and zucchini is crisp and tender. Sprinkle cheese over chili when served. Can be served with rice and corn muffins. Makes 8 (1 1/2 cup) servings.

recipes.title: Bombay Chicken
ingredients: 10 chicken breast halves, boned and skinned
1 can chicken broth (Swanson's chicken broth is best)
mushrooms, sauteed in butter (as many as preferred)
directions: Mix rice, sherry, soups, broth, onion flakes, parsley, celery, flour, salt and pepper.
Saute until golden brown in butter. Place rice mixture in buttered 3-quart casserole dish.
Place chicken breasts on top.
Sprinkle heavily with Parmesan cheese. Dot with butter.
Cover with foil.
Bake at 300° for 2 hours. Delicious!
recipes.text: Bombay Chicken. Mix rice, sherry, soups, broth, onion flakes, parsley, celery, flour, salt and pepper. Saute until golden brown in butter. Place rice mixture in buttered 3-quart casserole dish. Place chicken breasts on top. Sprinkle heavily with Parmesan cheese. Dot with butter. Cover with foil. Bake at 300° for 2 hours. Delicious!

recipes.title: Cream Corn Casserole
directions: Drain the whole kernel corn. Combine with the cream-style corn in a baking dish. Stir in butter, celery, carrot, bell pepper and egg.

Use small amount, 1/2 cup or less of cream or milk to make consistency of dish very moist, as in dressing. Top casserole with coarse crumbs from dry French bread, buttered toast, hard rolls or seasoned crackers.
Bake in moderate oven until simmered, for 20 to 30 minutes.
Moisture will depend on your brand of creamed corn.
This dish may be stretched with leftover cooked rice.
recipes.text: Cream Corn Casserole. Drain the whole kernel corn. Combine with the cream-style corn in a baking dish. Stir in butter, celery, carrot, bell pepper and egg. Use small amount, 1/2 cup or less of cream or milk to make consistency of dish very moist, as in dressing. Top casserole with coarse crumbs from dry French bread, buttered toast, hard rolls or seasoned crackers. Bake in moderate oven until simmered, for 20 to 30 minutes. Moisture will depend on your brand of creamed corn. This dish may be stretched with leftover cooked rice.

recipes.title: Ham Loaf
ingredients: 1 lb. lean uncooked pork, ground fine
directions: Mix ham and pork together with their juices.
In a mixer, combine eggs, sugar, bread crumbs and milk; blend well.
Add meat into the mixture, working in with hands.
Shape into loaf. Decorate top with half pineapple slices and cherries.
Bake in baking dish at 300° for 2 1/2 hours or longer.
Baste often with 1/2 cup pineapple juice.
Serves 12.
recipes.text: Ham Loaf. Mix ham and pork together with their juices. In a mixer, combine eggs, sugar, bread crumbs and milk; blend well. Add meat into the mixture, working in with hands. Shape into loaf. Decorate top with half pineapple slices and cherries. Bake in baking dish at 300° for 2 1/2 hours or longer. Baste often with 1/2 cup pineapple juice. Serves 12.

recipes.title: Fruit Chewies
directions: Cut 2 bananas into medium size chunks.
Mash the third banana. Combine all ingredients and stir until mixed.
Let stand for 10 minutes. Drop by teaspoonfuls onto greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes.
Makes 2 dozen.
recipes.text: Fruit Chewies. Cut 2 bananas into medium size chunks. Mash the third banana. Combine all ingredients and stir until mixed. Let stand for 10 minutes. Drop by teaspoonfuls onto greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes. Makes 2 dozen.

recipes.title: Dutch Apple Bread
directions: Sift flour. Add baking powder, salt and sugar. Sift again. Cut softened butter into dry ingredients as for pastry. Add beaten eggs and milk. Beat. Spread in 8 x 12 pan (greased). Press apple slices over top and sprinkle with sugar and cinnamon. Bake at 400° for 25 to 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Dutch Apple Bread. Sift flour. Add baking powder, salt and sugar. Sift again. Cut softened butter into dry ingredients as for pastry. Add beaten eggs and milk. Beat. Spread in 8 x 12 pan (greased). Press apple slices over top and sprinkle with sugar and cinnamon. Bake at 400° for 25 to 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Apple Nut Saladnederland, Texas
directions: Chop apples and pecans.
recipes.text: Apple Nut Saladnederland, Texas. Chop apples and pecans.

recipes.title: Broccoli Salad
ingredients: 1 bunch fresh broccoli, cut into flowerets
1 c. white grapes, cut in half
directions: Serves 4 to 6.
recipes.text: Broccoli Salad. Serves 4 to 6.

recipes.title: Orange Drop Cookies
directions: Peel orange.
Remove seed and skin.
Combine sugar, shortening, orange, orange juice, eggs, soda, salt and flour in a large mixing bowl.
Mix well.
Drop by rounded teaspoonfuls on and ungreased baking sheet.
Bake at 350 degrees until lightly brown. Remove from oven and cool slightly.
Transfer cookies to rack to cool completely.
recipes.text: Orange Drop Cookies. Peel orange. Remove seed and skin. Combine sugar, shortening, orange, orange juice, eggs, soda, salt and flour in a large mixing bowl. Mix well. Drop by rounded teaspoonfuls on and ungreased baking sheet. Bake at 350 degrees until lightly brown. Remove from oven and cool slightly. Transfer cookies to rack to cool completely.

recipes.title: Stuffed Chicken Breast
directions: Do not take skin off of chicken.
Pound chicken breast to make larger.
Put stuffing in center of chicken; roll and secure with toothpicks.
Brown in skillet; remove when brown and put into baking dish.
Mix soup as directed on can.
Pour over chicken and cover.
Bake 1 hour at 350°.
Serve with potatoes and vegetables.
recipes.text: Stuffed Chicken Breast. Do not take skin off of chicken. Pound chicken breast to make larger. Put stuffing in center of chicken; roll and secure with toothpicks. Brown in skillet; remove when brown and put into baking dish. Mix soup as directed on can. Pour over chicken and cover. Bake 1 hour at 350°. Serve with potatoes and vegetables.

recipes.title: Mexican Chef Salad
directions: Chop lettuce, tomatoes and onion; place in a large bowl. Brown beef and add salt and pepper to taste.
Stir in beans and warm through.
At the last minute, toss all ingredients together and mix thoroughly.
Serves 4 to 6 generously.
recipes.text: Mexican Chef Salad. Chop lettuce, tomatoes and onion; place in a large bowl. Brown beef and add salt and pepper to taste. Stir in beans and warm through. At the last minute, toss all ingredients together and mix thoroughly. Serves 4 to 6 generously.

recipes.title: Last Minute Noodle Dish
directions: Cook noodles and drain.
Add remaining ingredients and mix together.
Quick and easy!
recipes.text: Last Minute Noodle Dish. Cook noodles and drain. Add remaining ingredients and mix together. Quick and easy!

recipes.title: Cobbler
ingredients: 6 to 8 c rhubarb, cut in pieces
directions: Press 1/2 of crumbs into a 9 x 13 pan. Add rhubarb mixture and put remaining crumbs over top. Bake 350° for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Cobbler. Press 1/2 of crumbs into a 9 x 13 pan. Add rhubarb mixture and put remaining crumbs over top. Bake 350° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Pasta "Perfect" Salad
directions: Cook spiral noodles according to package. Drain thoroughly. Mix all ingredients.
Pour dressing over mixture to marinate.
Do not over use.
Chill so flavor can reach full potential.
Enjoy with everything!
recipes.text: Pasta "Perfect" Salad. Cook spiral noodles according to package. Drain thoroughly. Mix all ingredients. Pour dressing over mixture to marinate. Do not over use. Chill so flavor can reach full potential. Enjoy with everything!

recipes.title: Peanut Blossoms
directions: Heat oven to 375°.
Combine all ingredients except candy in large mixer bowl.
Mix on lowest speed until dough sticks together.
Shape dough into balls, using rounded teaspoonful for each.
Roll balls in sugar; place 1-inch apart on ungreased cookie sheets.
Bake in preheated oven 10 to 12 minutes.
Top each cookie immediately with a candy kiss; press down firmly so cookie cracks around edges.
recipes.text: Peanut Blossoms. Heat oven to 375°. Combine all ingredients except candy in large mixer bowl. Mix on lowest speed until dough sticks together. Shape dough into balls, using rounded teaspoonful for each. Roll balls in sugar; place 1-inch apart on ungreased cookie sheets. Bake in preheated oven 10 to 12 minutes. Top each cookie immediately with a candy kiss; press down firmly so cookie cracks around edges.

recipes.title: Pasta And Rice
directions: Cook ground beef, bell pepper and onion.
Drain off fat.
Cook egg noodles and drain.
Mix all together in a casserole dish.
Add tomato soup and grated cheese.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour..
recipes.text: Pasta And Rice. Cook ground beef, bell pepper and onion. Drain off fat. Cook egg noodles and drain. Mix all together in a casserole dish. Add tomato soup and grated cheese. Bake at 350° for 1 hour..

recipes.title: London Broil
ingredients: 15 oz. top round, sirloin tip or London broil
4 oz. or 1/2 c. dry red wine
directions: Place steak in a gallon size sealable bag.
Add wine, garlic, pepper and rosemary.
Lightly massage marinade into meat.
Seal bag, squeezing out air; turn to coat steak.
Refrigerate overnight or up to 24 hours, turning bag occasionally.
Remove meat from refrigerator at least 30 minutes before broiling or grilling. Lift meat from marinade and discard marinade.
You can either broil or grill.
recipes.text: London Broil. Place steak in a gallon size sealable bag. Add wine, garlic, pepper and rosemary. Lightly massage marinade into meat. Seal bag, squeezing out air; turn to coat steak. Refrigerate overnight or up to 24 hours, turning bag occasionally. Remove meat from refrigerator at least 30 minutes before broiling or grilling. Lift meat from marinade and discard marinade. You can either broil or grill.

recipes.title: Never Fail Peanut Brittle
directions: Boil sugar, Karo and water until thread spins or 250°.
Add peanuts and cook until a few drops dropped in a cup of cold water cracks.
Remove from heat.
Add butter, vanilla and soda.
Pour onto buttered cookie sheet, spreading as thin as possible with spoon.
recipes.text: Never Fail Peanut Brittle. Boil sugar, Karo and water until thread spins or 250°. Add peanuts and cook until a few drops dropped in a cup of cold water cracks. Remove from heat. Add butter, vanilla and soda. Pour onto buttered cookie sheet, spreading as thin as possible with spoon.

recipes.title: Vegetable Quiche
directions: Saute onions, zucchini and garlic in margarine or oil. Prebake 1 pie crust until slightly cooked.
Mix together cheese, eggs, milk and dash of Tabasco sauce.
Add sauteed vegetables to egg mixture.
Pour into crust.
Bake at about 350° until set, about 45 to 60 minutes.
Sprinkle Parmesan cheese on top after it is baked.
recipes.text: Vegetable Quiche. Saute onions, zucchini and garlic in margarine or oil. Prebake 1 pie crust until slightly cooked. Mix together cheese, eggs, milk and dash of Tabasco sauce. Add sauteed vegetables to egg mixture. Pour into crust. Bake at about 350° until set, about 45 to 60 minutes. Sprinkle Parmesan cheese on top after it is baked.

recipes.title: Smooshy Cake
directions: Tear up cake into small pieces and put into a large bowl. Boil water for jello as directed.
Do not add the cold water. Dissolve jello in boiling water and add frozen strawberries, then put into bowl with the cake.
Blend all ingredients together with wooden spoon.
Put in jello mold and freeze for 45 minutes.
Top with whipped cream, if desired.
Serves 8.
recipes.text: Smooshy Cake. Tear up cake into small pieces and put into a large bowl. Boil water for jello as directed. Do not add the cold water. Dissolve jello in boiling water and add frozen strawberries, then put into bowl with the cake. Blend all ingredients together with wooden spoon. Put in jello mold and freeze for 45 minutes. Top with whipped cream, if desired. Serves 8.

recipes.title: Red Hot Salad
directions: Add red hots to water and bring to boil.
Red hots should be dissolved.
Pour over jello.
Add applesauce and nuts.
Let set in refrigerator.
recipes.text: Red Hot Salad. Add red hots to water and bring to boil. Red hots should be dissolved. Pour over jello. Add applesauce and nuts. Let set in refrigerator.

recipes.title: Bread Squares
directions: Spread on toasted bread squares or crackers.
Sprinkle on additional cheese and broil.
Serve hot.
recipes.text: Bread Squares. Spread on toasted bread squares or crackers. Sprinkle on additional cheese and broil. Serve hot.

recipes.title: Golden Secret Meat Loaf
ingredients: 4 oz. Cheddar cheese, cut into 1/2-inch cubes
directions: In large bowl combine the egg, applesauce, bread crumbs, onion, nutmeg, salt and pepper.
Add ground beef; mix well.
Fold in cheese.
Pat into 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan.
Bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours or until no pink remains.
Drain.
Let stand a few minutes before slicing.
Yields 8 to 10 servings.
recipes.text: Golden Secret Meat Loaf. In large bowl combine the egg, applesauce, bread crumbs, onion, nutmeg, salt and pepper. Add ground beef; mix well. Fold in cheese. Pat into 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan. Bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours or until no pink remains. Drain. Let stand a few minutes before slicing. Yields 8 to 10 servings.

recipes.title: Coconut Cookies
directions: Cream butter and sugar.
Add flour, coconut and baking soda. Roll into balls and press or crisscross with fork dipped in sugar. Bake at 350° for 8 minutes.
recipes.text: Coconut Cookies. Cream butter and sugar. Add flour, coconut and baking soda. Roll into balls and press or crisscross with fork dipped in sugar. Bake at 350° for 8 minutes.

recipes.title: Quick Cake
directions: Mix with electric mixer in order given.
Bake in tube pan for 1 hour at 325°.
recipes.text: Quick Cake. Mix with electric mixer in order given. Bake in tube pan for 1 hour at 325°.

recipes.title: Cheddar Baked Orzo With Pepperoni
directions: In saucepan, saute pepperoni and onion over medium heat while stirring for 3 to 4 minutes.
Reduce heat and add flour with whisk to form a roux.
Whisk in broth.
Simmer sauce 2 minutes while continually stirring.
Whisk in Cheddar cheese, stirring until cheese is melted and sauce is smooth.
recipes.text: Cheddar Baked Orzo With Pepperoni. In saucepan, saute pepperoni and onion over medium heat while stirring for 3 to 4 minutes. Reduce heat and add flour with whisk to form a roux. Whisk in broth. Simmer sauce 2 minutes while continually stirring. Whisk in Cheddar cheese, stirring until cheese is melted and sauce is smooth.

recipes.title: Crispy Potato Wedges
directions: Place potato wedges in large bowl; add cold water to cover. Let set 15 minutes.
Preheat oven to 425°.
Spray nonstick spray on baking pan and set aside.
recipes.text: Crispy Potato Wedges. Place potato wedges in large bowl; add cold water to cover. Let set 15 minutes. Preheat oven to 425°. Spray nonstick spray on baking pan and set aside.

recipes.title: Tomato Zucchini Casserole
ingredients: 3 zucchini squash, sliced into diagonal rings
directions: Rub casserole with butter.
Line dish with a layer of zucchini, onion and sliced tomatoes; top layer with 1/2 teaspoon salt, 1 teaspoon basil and 2 tablespoons cheese.
Dot with butter. Repeat layers; top with remaining salt, basil and cheese.
Bake, uncovered, at 375° for 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Tomato Zucchini Casserole. Rub casserole with butter. Line dish with a layer of zucchini, onion and sliced tomatoes; top layer with 1/2 teaspoon salt, 1 teaspoon basil and 2 tablespoons cheese. Dot with butter. Repeat layers; top with remaining salt, basil and cheese. Bake, uncovered, at 375° for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Southern Fried Apple Rings
directions: Mix sugar, nutmeg, cinnamon and salt.
Slice apples in 1/2-inch slices.
Heat butter in heavy frying pan.
Add apple rings and 1/2 of sugar mixture; cook about 3 minutes.
Turn. Sprinkle with remainder of sugar mixture.
Continue cooking until apples are almost transparent.
Serve hot.
Makes 6 servings.
recipes.text: Southern Fried Apple Rings. Mix sugar, nutmeg, cinnamon and salt. Slice apples in 1/2-inch slices. Heat butter in heavy frying pan. Add apple rings and 1/2 of sugar mixture; cook about 3 minutes. Turn. Sprinkle with remainder of sugar mixture. Continue cooking until apples are almost transparent. Serve hot. Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Graham Cracker Goodies
directions: Melt butter and sugar.
Drizzle over crackers.
Sprinkle nuts and marshmallows over crackers.
Melt chocolate chips and pour over mixture in pan.
Bake for 10 to 12 minutes at 350°.
recipes.text: Graham Cracker Goodies. Melt butter and sugar. Drizzle over crackers. Sprinkle nuts and marshmallows over crackers. Melt chocolate chips and pour over mixture in pan. Bake for 10 to 12 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Chicken And Chinese Vegetables
ingredients: 1 whole chicken breast (skinned and boned), cut into 3/4-inch cubes
directions: In small bowl, combine chicken broth, cornstarch, sherry and soy sauce; blend well.
Set aside.
Heat large skillet over medium heat until hot.
Add oil; heat until it ripples.
Add chicken; stir-fry 3 to 4 minutes or until chicken is no longer pink.
Remove from skillet; keep warm.
recipes.text: Chicken And Chinese Vegetables. In small bowl, combine chicken broth, cornstarch, sherry and soy sauce; blend well. Set aside. Heat large skillet over medium heat until hot. Add oil; heat until it ripples. Add chicken; stir-fry 3 to 4 minutes or until chicken is no longer pink. Remove from skillet; keep warm.

recipes.title: Spinach Quiche Appetizer
directions: Sift dry ingredients. Drain spinach and squeeze out excess water. Add other ingredients. Spread in greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake 30 to 35 minutes at 350°. Cut in small squares.
Serve hot.
recipes.text: Spinach Quiche Appetizer. Sift dry ingredients. Drain spinach and squeeze out excess water. Add other ingredients. Spread in greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake 30 to 35 minutes at 350°. Cut in small squares. Serve hot.

recipes.title: Fresh Peach Pie
directions: Bake the pie crusts; set aside to cool. Mix together the cream cheese and 1/2 cup sugar. Spread in bottom of pie shells. Place sliced peaches on top of the cream cheese layer. Cook 1 cup sugar, water and cornstarch together until thickened. Add the jello. Cool. Pour over peach slices. Chill. Cover with Cool Whip.
recipes.text: Fresh Peach Pie. Bake the pie crusts; set aside to cool. Mix together the cream cheese and 1/2 cup sugar. Spread in bottom of pie shells. Place sliced peaches on top of the cream cheese layer. Cook 1 cup sugar, water and cornstarch together until thickened. Add the jello. Cool. Pour over peach slices. Chill. Cover with Cool Whip.

recipes.title: Taco Dip
directions: Blend cream cheese, sour cream and 1/3 package taco mix; mix well.
Spread on a dinner plate and layer lettuce, taco mix, tomato, taco mix, Cheddar cheese and taco mix.
Serve with Doritos.
recipes.text: Taco Dip. Blend cream cheese, sour cream and 1/3 package taco mix; mix well. Spread on a dinner plate and layer lettuce, taco mix, tomato, taco mix, Cheddar cheese and taco mix. Serve with Doritos.

recipes.title: Christmas Wreath Cookies
directions: You will need a saucepan, waxed paper and a mixing spoon.
recipes.text: Christmas Wreath Cookies. You will need a saucepan, waxed paper and a mixing spoon.

recipes.title: Scalloped Potatoes With Cheese And Herbs
directions: Melt butter in skillet; add onions and garlic.
Cook until tender, without browning.
Reserve.
Heat milk, rosemary, basil, oregano, salt and pepper.
Reserve.
Combine cheese with bread crumbs.
recipes.text: Scalloped Potatoes With Cheese And Herbs. Melt butter in skillet; add onions and garlic. Cook until tender, without browning. Reserve. Heat milk, rosemary, basil, oregano, salt and pepper. Reserve. Combine cheese with bread crumbs.

recipes.title: Chocolate-Cherry Dessert
directions: First Layer:
Mix flour, oleo and walnuts.
Press into 9 x 13-inch pan.
Bake at 350° for 15 minutes.
recipes.text: Chocolate-Cherry Dessert. First Layer: Mix flour, oleo and walnuts. Press into 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350° for 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Brussels Sprouts, Mushrooms And Cheese Sauce
ingredients: lots of fresh ground black pepper
directions: Steam Brussels sprouts 15 minutes.
Cook onion and mushrooms together in butter and salt for 10 minutes.
Add herbs as they cook.
Sprinkle in flour.
Stir.
Gradually drizzle in hot milk. Cook over low heat for 5 to 8 minutes.
Stir in Brussels sprouts, horseradish and cheese.
Spoon sauce over a dish of spaghetti and top with grated cheese and fresh pepper.
ner: lots of fresh ground black pepper
recipes.text: Brussels Sprouts, Mushrooms And Cheese Sauce. Steam Brussels sprouts 15 minutes. Cook onion and mushrooms together in butter and salt for 10 minutes. Add herbs as they cook. Sprinkle in flour. Stir. Gradually drizzle in hot milk. Cook over low heat for 5 to 8 minutes. Stir in Brussels sprouts, horseradish and cheese. Spoon sauce over a dish of spaghetti and top with grated cheese and fresh pepper.

recipes.title: Pecan Glazed Pumpkin Pie
directions: Preheat oven and baking sheet pan to 375°.
In large bowl, using a wire whisk, whisk together eggs, pumpkin, milk, 3/4 cup sugar and pumpkin pie spice.
Place frozen pie crust on preheated baking sheet. Pour filling into crust.
Bake 40 minutes. In small bowl, combine remaining 1/4 cup sugar, pecans and melted butter. Crumble over top of partially baked pie.
Bake an additional 30 minutes or until knife inserted in center comes out clean.
recipes.text: Pecan Glazed Pumpkin Pie. Preheat oven and baking sheet pan to 375°. In large bowl, using a wire whisk, whisk together eggs, pumpkin, milk, 3/4 cup sugar and pumpkin pie spice. Place frozen pie crust on preheated baking sheet. Pour filling into crust. Bake 40 minutes. In small bowl, combine remaining 1/4 cup sugar, pecans and melted butter. Crumble over top of partially baked pie. Bake an additional 30 minutes or until knife inserted in center comes out clean.

recipes.title: Summer Chicken Salad
directions: I add shredded Cheddar cheese.
recipes.text: Summer Chicken Salad. I add shredded Cheddar cheese.

recipes.title: Baked Cabbage
directions: Preheat oven to 350°.
Butter a 12 x 8-inch shallow baking dish. Discard outer leaves from cabbage.
Wash head and cut into 12 wedges.
Put 1 cup water in large skillet. Bring to a boil. Add 1 teaspoon salt and the cabbage. Cook over medium heat, covered, 10 minutes. Drain well.
Arrange cabbage in prepared baking dish. Sprinkle with mixture of flour, sugar, 1 teaspoon salt and the pepper.
Dot with butter.
Pour hot milk over cabbage. Sprinkle with cheese.
Bake, uncovered, 35 minutes. Makes 8 servings.
recipes.text: Baked Cabbage. Preheat oven to 350°. Butter a 12 x 8-inch shallow baking dish. Discard outer leaves from cabbage. Wash head and cut into 12 wedges. Put 1 cup water in large skillet. Bring to a boil. Add 1 teaspoon salt and the cabbage. Cook over medium heat, covered, 10 minutes. Drain well. Arrange cabbage in prepared baking dish. Sprinkle with mixture of flour, sugar, 1 teaspoon salt and the pepper. Dot with butter. Pour hot milk over cabbage. Sprinkle with cheese. Bake, uncovered, 35 minutes. Makes 8 servings.

recipes.title: See'S Candy
directions: In a large bowl combine chocolate bits, Marshmallow Creme, oleo, nuts and vanilla.
Set aside.
In heavy pan, combine sugar, salt and Pet milk.
Cook, stirring, until a full rolling boil begins; boil another 6 or 8 minutes, stirring constantly.
Pour over other ingredients and mix together.
Store in refrigerator.
recipes.text: See'S Candy. In a large bowl combine chocolate bits, Marshmallow Creme, oleo, nuts and vanilla. Set aside. In heavy pan, combine sugar, salt and Pet milk. Cook, stirring, until a full rolling boil begins; boil another 6 or 8 minutes, stirring constantly. Pour over other ingredients and mix together. Store in refrigerator.

recipes.title: Cranberry-Banana Nut Bread
directions: Combine berries, 1 cup sugar and water in medium saucepan. Bring to a boil over medium heat and cook until berries pop. Drain and set aside.
recipes.text: Cranberry-Banana Nut Bread. Combine berries, 1 cup sugar and water in medium saucepan. Bring to a boil over medium heat and cook until berries pop. Drain and set aside.

recipes.title: Portuguese Sweet Rice
directions: Boil 1 cup of rice until almost cooked; drain the water and replace with fresh water, just enough to cover rice (no more). Over a very low flame, add 1 can evaporated milk slowly.
In a bowl, mix 5 eggs and 1 cup sugar.
When rice is cooked, stir in egg mixture, stirring constantly, until completely blended.
Cook for just another minute.
Do not dry rice.
Raisins may be added. Sprinkle with cinnamon.
recipes.text: Portuguese Sweet Rice. Boil 1 cup of rice until almost cooked; drain the water and replace with fresh water, just enough to cover rice (no more). Over a very low flame, add 1 can evaporated milk slowly. In a bowl, mix 5 eggs and 1 cup sugar. When rice is cooked, stir in egg mixture, stirring constantly, until completely blended. Cook for just another minute. Do not dry rice. Raisins may be added. Sprinkle with cinnamon.

recipes.title: Swiss Steak
directions: In a bowl, beat egg.
Dip meat in egg wash, then in flour. Brown in a small amount of vegetable oil.
Put steaks in a baking pan.
Meanwhile, add flour to the drippings in the pan and brown a bit.
Add water, hot sauce, Worcestershire sauce, salt and pepper. Bring to a boil.
Add onions and carrots to meat; pour gravy over meat.
You may need to make additional gravy to cover meat.
Cover with foil and bake in 350° oven until meat is done and vegetables are tender.
Good served with mashed potatoes or rice.
recipes.text: Swiss Steak. In a bowl, beat egg. Dip meat in egg wash, then in flour. Brown in a small amount of vegetable oil. Put steaks in a baking pan. Meanwhile, add flour to the drippings in the pan and brown a bit. Add water, hot sauce, Worcestershire sauce, salt and pepper. Bring to a boil. Add onions and carrots to meat; pour gravy over meat. You may need to make additional gravy to cover meat. Cover with foil and bake in 350° oven until meat is done and vegetables are tender. Good served with mashed potatoes or rice.

recipes.title: Chicken Pasta Salad
ingredients: 1 c. (4 oz.) corkscrew noodles, cooked and drained
directions: Combine salad dressing, cheese, milk and salt.
Mix well.
Add all remaining ingredients.
Mix lightly.
Chill several hours or overnight.
Makes 4 servings.
recipes.text: Chicken Pasta Salad. Combine salad dressing, cheese, milk and salt. Mix well. Add all remaining ingredients. Mix lightly. Chill several hours or overnight. Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: Coconut Pecan German Chocolate Cake
directions: Mix all ingredients, including icing, and bake in Bundt pan at 350° about an hour.
recipes.text: Coconut Pecan German Chocolate Cake. Mix all ingredients, including icing, and bake in Bundt pan at 350° about an hour.

recipes.title: Baked Apples
ingredients: 4 apples, Golden Delicious, Fuji, or Rome, cored
directions: Heat oven to 375°F.
Combine sugar and cinnamon in small bowl.
Peel apples, leaving a 1-inch wide band of peel around the center of each.
Arrange apples in a 9-inch square baking dish. Fill each cavity with 1 tsp. each butter and cinnamon-sugar. Sprinkle with remaining cinnamon-sugar.
recipes.text: Baked Apples. Heat oven to 375°F. Combine sugar and cinnamon in small bowl. Peel apples, leaving a 1-inch wide band of peel around the center of each. Arrange apples in a 9-inch square baking dish. Fill each cavity with 1 tsp. each butter and cinnamon-sugar. Sprinkle with remaining cinnamon-sugar.

recipes.title: Cajun Chicken
ingredients: 1 Tbsp. McCormick Cajun Quick chicken seasoning
directions: Melt butter in skillet.
Stir in Cajun seasoning.
Add chicken and saute for 8 to 10 minutes per side or until thoroughly cooked.
recipes.text: Cajun Chicken. Melt butter in skillet. Stir in Cajun seasoning. Add chicken and saute for 8 to 10 minutes per side or until thoroughly cooked.

recipes.title: Mom'S Lasagna
directions: Brown meat.
Add onion and garlic.
Cook until golden.
Add remaining ingredients, except noodles and cheese.
Simmer sauce for 2 hours or use any prepared spaghetti sauce and save 2 hours.
recipes.text: Mom'S Lasagna. Brown meat. Add onion and garlic. Cook until golden. Add remaining ingredients, except noodles and cheese. Simmer sauce for 2 hours or use any prepared spaghetti sauce and save 2 hours.

recipes.title: Bart'S Clam Chowder
directions: Put water in large pot.
Add onions, carrots, celery, potatoes, parsley and tomatoes.
Fry bacon until browned; add to water mixture with the drippings.
Add clams, salt and pepper. Cook 1 hour or more.
recipes.text: Bart'S Clam Chowder. Put water in large pot. Add onions, carrots, celery, potatoes, parsley and tomatoes. Fry bacon until browned; add to water mixture with the drippings. Add clams, salt and pepper. Cook 1 hour or more.

recipes.title: Shrimp Soup
directions: Use soup pot. Add water. Bring water to a boil on top of stove, adding all the ingredients except shrimp. Then add shrimp and cook until tender. Drain, reserving fluid. Place shrimp in blender with 2 cups of liquid. Blend until finely chopped. Add to remaining liquid in pot. Serve hot with crackers.
recipes.text: Shrimp Soup. Use soup pot. Add water. Bring water to a boil on top of stove, adding all the ingredients except shrimp. Then add shrimp and cook until tender. Drain, reserving fluid. Place shrimp in blender with 2 cups of liquid. Blend until finely chopped. Add to remaining liquid in pot. Serve hot with crackers.

recipes.title: Strawberry Cream Cheese Pie
directions: Mix together first 4 ingredients.
Pour filling into crust and cook about 30 minutes, or until pie is set, at 350°.
Place thawed strawberries and 1 tablespoon flour in pan and cook until thick.
Pour in lemon juice.
Cool and spread over cooled pie.
Refrigerate until set.
recipes.text: Strawberry Cream Cheese Pie. Mix together first 4 ingredients. Pour filling into crust and cook about 30 minutes, or until pie is set, at 350°. Place thawed strawberries and 1 tablespoon flour in pan and cook until thick. Pour in lemon juice. Cool and spread over cooled pie. Refrigerate until set.

recipes.title: Mixer Icing
directions: Beat until sugar is dissolved.
recipes.text: Mixer Icing. Beat until sugar is dissolved.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Roll Cake
directions: Grease cookie sheet and line with wax paper, grease the paper, too.
Pour batter and sprinkle with powdered sugar.
Bake at 375° for 15 minutes.
Sprinkle powdered sugar on a tea towel and turn cake on towel when baked.
Pull off waxed paper.
Roll cake together with towel while hot.
Cool for 1 1/2 to 2 hours, then unroll and spread with filling.
recipes.text: Pumpkin Roll Cake. Grease cookie sheet and line with wax paper, grease the paper, too. Pour batter and sprinkle with powdered sugar. Bake at 375° for 15 minutes. Sprinkle powdered sugar on a tea towel and turn cake on towel when baked. Pull off waxed paper. Roll cake together with towel while hot. Cool for 1 1/2 to 2 hours, then unroll and spread with filling.

recipes.title: Vegetable Soup
directions: Place all ingredients, except tomatoes, in saucepan.
Cover and boil gently for 10 minutes.
Break up tomatoes.
Add to vegetable mixture and continue cooking until vegetables are tender, about 20 minutes.
Remove bay leaf before serving.
Makes 4 servings (about 1 cup each).
recipes.text: Vegetable Soup. Place all ingredients, except tomatoes, in saucepan. Cover and boil gently for 10 minutes. Break up tomatoes. Add to vegetable mixture and continue cooking until vegetables are tender, about 20 minutes. Remove bay leaf before serving. Makes 4 servings (about 1 cup each).

recipes.title: Million Dollar Pie
directions: Melt margarine in pie pan; mix in flour, 4 tablespoons sugar and half of nuts.
Spread with fingers to fit pan.
Bake at 350° until golden brown; cool crust.
recipes.text: Million Dollar Pie. Melt margarine in pie pan; mix in flour, 4 tablespoons sugar and half of nuts. Spread with fingers to fit pan. Bake at 350° until golden brown; cool crust.

recipes.title: Seven Layer Bars
directions: Mix butter and graham crackers.
Pat in ungreased 9 x 13-inch pan.
Layer in order:
butterscotch chips, chocolate chips, coconut and walnuts.
Pour milk over the top and bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Seven Layer Bars. Mix butter and graham crackers. Pat in ungreased 9 x 13-inch pan. Layer in order: butterscotch chips, chocolate chips, coconut and walnuts. Pour milk over the top and bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Swedish Coffee Twist
directions: Dissolve yeast in warm water with 1 teaspoon sugar.
Bring buttermilk and butter to boiling.
Pour into large bowl with sugar and salt.
Beat in 2 cups flour and then beat in yeast mixture and egg and soda.
Gradually stir in the remaining flour until mixture cleans sides of bowl.
Turn out on floured board and knead smooth and elastic, adding more flour to prevent sticking.
Turn bowl over dough and let set for 15 minutes.
Roll into a rectangle and spread with melted butter, brown sugar and cinnamon.
Fold over and cut into strips and twist.
Raise on cookie sheet for 45 minutes in warm place.
Bake at 375° for 10 to 12 minutes until lightly browned.
Frost lightly with powdered sugar glaze.
Serve warm.
recipes.text: Swedish Coffee Twist. Dissolve yeast in warm water with 1 teaspoon sugar. Bring buttermilk and butter to boiling. Pour into large bowl with sugar and salt. Beat in 2 cups flour and then beat in yeast mixture and egg and soda. Gradually stir in the remaining flour until mixture cleans sides of bowl. Turn out on floured board and knead smooth and elastic, adding more flour to prevent sticking. Turn bowl over dough and let set for 15 minutes. Roll into a rectangle and spread with melted butter, brown sugar and cinnamon. Fold over and cut into strips and twist. Raise on cookie sheet for 45 minutes in warm place. Bake at 375° for 10 to 12 minutes until lightly browned. Frost lightly with powdered sugar glaze. Serve warm.

recipes.title: Baked Bean Casserole
directions: Brown onion and ground beef in skillet.
Mix pork and beans and add drained kidney beans.
Stir in ground beef and onion.
Add remaining ingredients.
Mix well.
Bake in a moderate oven at 350° for 45 minutes.
Stir occasionally.
recipes.text: Baked Bean Casserole. Brown onion and ground beef in skillet. Mix pork and beans and add drained kidney beans. Stir in ground beef and onion. Add remaining ingredients. Mix well. Bake in a moderate oven at 350° for 45 minutes. Stir occasionally.

recipes.title: Pineapple Pies
directions: Mix all ingredients together after draining pineapple.
Pour into 2 small vanilla wafer crusts or 2 graham cracker crusts. Chill.
Makes 2 pies.
recipes.text: Pineapple Pies. Mix all ingredients together after draining pineapple. Pour into 2 small vanilla wafer crusts or 2 graham cracker crusts. Chill. Makes 2 pies.

recipes.title: Monster Chip Cookies
ingredients: 1 c. plus 2 Tbsp. unsifted all-purpose flour
1/2 c. firmly packed light brown sugar
directions: Preheat oven to slow 325°.
Lightly grease 2 large cookie sheets.
Break chocolate bars into squares, then cut each square diagonally in half.
Set aside 1/2 cup pecan halves; coarsely chop remainder.
Stir together the flour and baking soda on wax paper to mix well.
Beat together the butter, peanut butter, granulated sugar and brown sugar in medium size bowl until light and fluffy. Beat in egg and vanilla until mixed.
Stir in flour mixture until blended; stir in chopped pecans.
recipes.text: Monster Chip Cookies. Preheat oven to slow 325°. Lightly grease 2 large cookie sheets. Break chocolate bars into squares, then cut each square diagonally in half. Set aside 1/2 cup pecan halves; coarsely chop remainder. Stir together the flour and baking soda on wax paper to mix well. Beat together the butter, peanut butter, granulated sugar and brown sugar in medium size bowl until light and fluffy. Beat in egg and vanilla until mixed. Stir in flour mixture until blended; stir in chopped pecans.

recipes.title: Homemade Noodles
directions: Combine egg, salt and milk.
Add enough flour to make dough stiff.
Roll very thin.
Let stand 20 minutes.
Roll up and slice 1/8-inch thick.
Let dry for 2 hours.
Drop in boiling water or broth and cook 10 minutes.
recipes.text: Homemade Noodles. Combine egg, salt and milk. Add enough flour to make dough stiff. Roll very thin. Let stand 20 minutes. Roll up and slice 1/8-inch thick. Let dry for 2 hours. Drop in boiling water or broth and cook 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Cherries On A Cloud
directions: Heat oven to 275°.
Cover baking sheet with heavy brown paper. Beat egg whites and cream of tartar until foamy.
Beat in 3/4 cup sugar, 1 tablespoon at a time; continue beating until stiff and glossy.
Spoon meringue into desired shape on paper, building upside.
Bake 1 1/2 hours.
Turn off oven; leave meringue in oven with door closed 1 hour.
Remove from oven; cool.
recipes.text: Cherries On A Cloud. Heat oven to 275°. Cover baking sheet with heavy brown paper. Beat egg whites and cream of tartar until foamy. Beat in 3/4 cup sugar, 1 tablespoon at a time; continue beating until stiff and glossy. Spoon meringue into desired shape on paper, building upside. Bake 1 1/2 hours. Turn off oven; leave meringue in oven with door closed 1 hour. Remove from oven; cool.

recipes.title: Cheese Ball
directions: Mix together; shape into ball and roll in chopped pecans. Chill and serve.
recipes.text: Cheese Ball. Mix together; shape into ball and roll in chopped pecans. Chill and serve.

recipes.title: Potato Dippers
directions: Scrub potatoes.
Cut each potato in half lengthwise.
Cut each potato half lengthwise into 3 wedges.
Arrange potato wedges in a spoke circle on a large microwavable platter.
Melt margarine for 30 seconds in the microwave.
Brush potatoes with melted margarine.
Sprinkle with seasoned salt.
Cover with wax paper. Cook in microwave for 7 minutes on High.
Turn the platter halfway around.
Microwave for 8 minutes.
Remove wax paper.
Sprinkle cheese over potatoes immediately.
Serve with the prepared party dip.
recipes.text: Potato Dippers. Scrub potatoes. Cut each potato in half lengthwise. Cut each potato half lengthwise into 3 wedges. Arrange potato wedges in a spoke circle on a large microwavable platter. Melt margarine for 30 seconds in the microwave. Brush potatoes with melted margarine. Sprinkle with seasoned salt. Cover with wax paper. Cook in microwave for 7 minutes on High. Turn the platter halfway around. Microwave for 8 minutes. Remove wax paper. Sprinkle cheese over potatoes immediately. Serve with the prepared party dip.

recipes.title: Blueberry Yum Yum
directions: Cream together cream cheese, Dream Whip, sugar and milk.
Beat until very stiff.
Melt butter and mix with vanilla wafer crumbs. In a 9 x 13 x 2-inch pan, you will layer mixture.
First put 1/2 of vanilla wafers in bottom of pan, then half of the cream mixture.
Add blueberries, then the rest of cream cheese mixture. Top with rest of wafer crumbs.
Chill 24 hours.
Cherry pie filling may be used.
recipes.text: Blueberry Yum Yum. Cream together cream cheese, Dream Whip, sugar and milk. Beat until very stiff. Melt butter and mix with vanilla wafer crumbs. In a 9 x 13 x 2-inch pan, you will layer mixture. First put 1/2 of vanilla wafers in bottom of pan, then half of the cream mixture. Add blueberries, then the rest of cream cheese mixture. Top with rest of wafer crumbs. Chill 24 hours. Cherry pie filling may be used.

recipes.title: Kapusta
directions: Combine hamburger, eggs, salt, pepper, rice and 1/3 can tomato juice.
Make into meatballs.
Put layer of cabbage, meat and sauerkraut.
Pour rest of juice over it.
Add water.
Bake 1 hour or until cabbage is done.
recipes.text: Kapusta. Combine hamburger, eggs, salt, pepper, rice and 1/3 can tomato juice. Make into meatballs. Put layer of cabbage, meat and sauerkraut. Pour rest of juice over it. Add water. Bake 1 hour or until cabbage is done.

recipes.title: Easy Salad Surprise
ingredients: 1 large or 2 small avocados, thinly sliced
1/4 c. salad dressing (your choice: Italian, Ranch or oil and vinegar)
directions: In a large bowl, combine the vegetables. Toss to coat.
recipes.text: Easy Salad Surprise. In a large bowl, combine the vegetables. Toss to coat.

recipes.title: Fluffy Macaroni And Cheese
directions: Cook macaroni as directed; drain.
Toss bread crumbs with butter, salt, pepper, parsley, basil and Parmesan cheese.
Butter a 3-quart casserole dish.
Arrange layers of macaroni, bread crumbs and Cheddar cheese in casserole dish.
Slowly drizzle milk over top of casserole until all is absorbed.
Bake 1 hour until bubbly and brown.
recipes.text: Fluffy Macaroni And Cheese. Cook macaroni as directed; drain. Toss bread crumbs with butter, salt, pepper, parsley, basil and Parmesan cheese. Butter a 3-quart casserole dish. Arrange layers of macaroni, bread crumbs and Cheddar cheese in casserole dish. Slowly drizzle milk over top of casserole until all is absorbed. Bake 1 hour until bubbly and brown.

recipes.title: Caramel-Cheese Cake Dip
directions: Mix all ingredients (except almonds and caramel topping) in bowl on low speed until well blended.
Pour into 8-inch pie plate. Top with caramel ice cream topping and sprinkle with slivered almonds.
Refrigerate 2 to 3 hours.
Garnish dip with Granny Smith apple slices.
Yum!
recipes.text: Caramel-Cheese Cake Dip. Mix all ingredients (except almonds and caramel topping) in bowl on low speed until well blended. Pour into 8-inch pie plate. Top with caramel ice cream topping and sprinkle with slivered almonds. Refrigerate 2 to 3 hours. Garnish dip with Granny Smith apple slices. Yum!

recipes.title: Baked Chicken Parmesan
directions: Brush chicken with salad dressing.
Coat with remaining ingredients.
Place in a 13 x 9-inch baking dish.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Baked Chicken Parmesan. Brush chicken with salad dressing. Coat with remaining ingredients. Place in a 13 x 9-inch baking dish. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Asparagus Casserole
directions: Crumble about 10 or 12 cheese crackers and spread on the bottom of a baking dish.
Drain the asparagus and peas and pour into dish.
Mix the soup (undiluted) and vegetables together. Sprinkle cheese crackers on the top.
Bake at 325° for about 20 minutes or until top is turning light brown.
Makes about 6 servings.
recipes.text: Asparagus Casserole. Crumble about 10 or 12 cheese crackers and spread on the bottom of a baking dish. Drain the asparagus and peas and pour into dish. Mix the soup (undiluted) and vegetables together. Sprinkle cheese crackers on the top. Bake at 325° for about 20 minutes or until top is turning light brown. Makes about 6 servings.

recipes.title: Apple-Walnut Cake
directions: Combine first 5 ingredients; mix well. Add flour, soda and cinnamon; mix well. Fold in apple, walnuts and coconut.
Spoon into greased and floured tube pan. Bake at 325° for 1 1/2 hours. Cool on rack 15 minutes. Turn into cake plate.
Drizzle Buttermilk Glaze over warm cake.
recipes.text: Apple-Walnut Cake. Combine first 5 ingredients; mix well. Add flour, soda and cinnamon; mix well. Fold in apple, walnuts and coconut. Spoon into greased and floured tube pan. Bake at 325° for 1 1/2 hours. Cool on rack 15 minutes. Turn into cake plate. Drizzle Buttermilk Glaze over warm cake.

recipes.title: Quick Blueberry Pie
directions: Mix milk and lemon juice together until thickened.
Pour in blueberries. Stir until all blueberries are covered with milk mixture.
Pour into baked pie crust.
Chill and serve.
recipes.text: Quick Blueberry Pie. Mix milk and lemon juice together until thickened. Pour in blueberries. Stir until all blueberries are covered with milk mixture. Pour into baked pie crust. Chill and serve.

recipes.title: Peasant'S Caviar
ingredients: 2 ripe plum tomatoes, seeded and cut into 1/4 inch dice
directions: Preheat oven to 400°.
Cut eggplants in half lengthwise.
Make deep slits in the flesh (do not pierce the skin) and insert 2 cloves garlic in each half.
Place eggplants in shallow roasting pan, skin side down, and sprinkle tops with salt.
Cover with foil and bake for one hour or until eggplants and garlic are tender. Cool.
With a spoon, scoop eggplants and garlic out of skin into bowl.
Mash well with fork.
Stir in lemon juice, oil, pepper and salt.
Mix well.
Gently fold in remaining ingredients except endive.
Refrigerate, covered to chill.
recipes.text: Peasant'S Caviar. Preheat oven to 400°. Cut eggplants in half lengthwise. Make deep slits in the flesh (do not pierce the skin) and insert 2 cloves garlic in each half. Place eggplants in shallow roasting pan, skin side down, and sprinkle tops with salt. Cover with foil and bake for one hour or until eggplants and garlic are tender. Cool. With a spoon, scoop eggplants and garlic out of skin into bowl. Mash well with fork. Stir in lemon juice, oil, pepper and salt. Mix well. Gently fold in remaining ingredients except endive. Refrigerate, covered to chill.

recipes.title: Zucchini Bread
ingredients: 2 c. grated or shredded, raw, unpeeled zucchini
directions: Mix all wet ingredients together.
Add dry ingredients.
Mix very well.
Put batter into small bread pans.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Zucchini Bread. Mix all wet ingredients together. Add dry ingredients. Mix very well. Put batter into small bread pans. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: 13 Bean Soup(Serves 8)
ingredients: 1 of the following three: 1 pod red pepper, 1 tsp. chili powder or 1 small can green chopped chilies
directions: Rinse and sort beans before cooking.
Cover beans with water. Add 2 tablespoons salt.
Soak overnight and drain.
Add 2 quarts fresh water and ham or ham hock.
Bring to a boil, simmer 3 hours. Add onion and tomatoes.
Add one of the following three: pod of red pepper, chili powder or green chopped chilies.
Add juice of lemon.
Salt and pepper to taste.
Simmer another 30 minutes or 1 hour.
Flavor improves with age.
recipes.text: 13 Bean Soup(Serves 8). Rinse and sort beans before cooking. Cover beans with water. Add 2 tablespoons salt. Soak overnight and drain. Add 2 quarts fresh water and ham or ham hock. Bring to a boil, simmer 3 hours. Add onion and tomatoes. Add one of the following three: pod of red pepper, chili powder or green chopped chilies. Add juice of lemon. Salt and pepper to taste. Simmer another 30 minutes or 1 hour. Flavor improves with age.

recipes.title: Ground Beef Porcupines
directions: Combine first 6 ingredients and shape into balls.
Brown in 2 tablespoons oil.
Place in casserole.
Dissolve bouillon in water. Add soup, Worcestershire sauce and sour cream.
Bake covered 45 minutes at 350°.
Serve topped with Chinese noodles.
recipes.text: Ground Beef Porcupines. Combine first 6 ingredients and shape into balls. Brown in 2 tablespoons oil. Place in casserole. Dissolve bouillon in water. Add soup, Worcestershire sauce and sour cream. Bake covered 45 minutes at 350°. Serve topped with Chinese noodles.

recipes.title: Broccoli-Rice Casserole
directions: Melt cheese and butter. Mix all ingredients together in baking dish. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Broccoli-Rice Casserole. Melt cheese and butter. Mix all ingredients together in baking dish. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Mrs. Caldwell'S Cake
directions: Mix the first 3 ingredients together and place in a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Mix the remaining ingredients and place on top of mixture.
Sprinkle nuts on top and bake 30 minutes at 350°.
recipes.text: Mrs. Caldwell'S Cake. Mix the first 3 ingredients together and place in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix the remaining ingredients and place on top of mixture. Sprinkle nuts on top and bake 30 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Pronto Pups
directions: Mix together and dip hot dogs into mixture.
Fry in hot fat until done.
recipes.text: Pronto Pups. Mix together and dip hot dogs into mixture. Fry in hot fat until done.

recipes.title: Corn Custard
directions: Mix all together and pour into greased baking dish.
Dot with butter.
Bake 45 minutes at 350° until set like custard.
Do not cover while baking.
recipes.text: Corn Custard. Mix all together and pour into greased baking dish. Dot with butter. Bake 45 minutes at 350° until set like custard. Do not cover while baking.

recipes.title: Chocolate Dip Cookies
directions: Thoroughly cream the butter, sugar and vanilla.
Gradually blend in flour.
Chill dough.
Form logs about 1 1/2 inches long. Place on ungreased cookie sheet.
Bake at 350° until delicately browned (about 15 minutes).
Cool cookies.
Melt chocolate chips and shortening.
Dip cookies in melted chocolate; coat with toppings.
recipes.text: Chocolate Dip Cookies. Thoroughly cream the butter, sugar and vanilla. Gradually blend in flour. Chill dough. Form logs about 1 1/2 inches long. Place on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 350° until delicately browned (about 15 minutes). Cool cookies. Melt chocolate chips and shortening. Dip cookies in melted chocolate; coat with toppings.

recipes.title: Caramel Apple Dip
ingredients: 1 (14 oz.) can Borden sweetened condensed milk (Eagle Brand)
directions: Remove label and place unopened can in a pot of water deep enough to completely cover the can.
Bring water to a boil; keep it at a slow boil for 4 hours.
Additional water may be needed to keep the can totally covered with water.
At the end of 4 hours, remove the can and cool, then open the can and enjoy a yummy caramel sauce dip.
recipes.text: Caramel Apple Dip. Remove label and place unopened can in a pot of water deep enough to completely cover the can. Bring water to a boil; keep it at a slow boil for 4 hours. Additional water may be needed to keep the can totally covered with water. At the end of 4 hours, remove the can and cool, then open the can and enjoy a yummy caramel sauce dip.

recipes.title: Congealed Ambrosia Salad
directions: Dissolve gelatin and sugar in boiling water.
Add rest of ingredients and chill until set.
recipes.text: Congealed Ambrosia Salad. Dissolve gelatin and sugar in boiling water. Add rest of ingredients and chill until set.

recipes.title: Spicy Low Fat Low Calorie Spinach Dip
ingredients: 1 (10 oz.) box frozen spinach (chopped or whole) thawed and squeezed dry
1 (8 oz.) can water chestnuts, drained and chopped
directions: Heat oil in a non-stick skillet over medium high heat and add onions and garlic.
Cook about 3 minutes and transfer to food processor or food chopper.
Add remaining ingredients, except water chestnuts, and process until almost smooth.
Scrape into a serving bowl and stir in water chestnuts.
Refrigerate until ready to serve.
recipes.text: Spicy Low Fat Low Calorie Spinach Dip. Heat oil in a non-stick skillet over medium high heat and add onions and garlic. Cook about 3 minutes and transfer to food processor or food chopper. Add remaining ingredients, except water chestnuts, and process until almost smooth. Scrape into a serving bowl and stir in water chestnuts. Refrigerate until ready to serve.

recipes.title: Spiced Cider Punch
ingredients: 1 1/3 c. firmly packed light brown sugar
2 to 4 bottles chilled club soda (as desired)
directions: Combine water and sugar to spices in saucepan.
Stir over heat until sugar dissolves.
Cool.
Add cider with lemon juice.
Chill. Add club soda.
Pour over blocks of ice in small punch bowl. Garnish with lemon slices.
Yields 20 punch cup servings.
recipes.text: Spiced Cider Punch. Combine water and sugar to spices in saucepan. Stir over heat until sugar dissolves. Cool. Add cider with lemon juice. Chill. Add club soda. Pour over blocks of ice in small punch bowl. Garnish with lemon slices. Yields 20 punch cup servings.

recipes.title: Easy Chicken Casserole
directions: Melt margarine and combine with stuffing and broth.
Place half of this mixture in a 9-inch square pan and save the other half for the top.
Place chicken over stuffing.
Mix soup and sour cream and pour over chicken.
Top with remaining stuffing mixture. Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.
Serves 6.
recipes.text: Easy Chicken Casserole. Melt margarine and combine with stuffing and broth. Place half of this mixture in a 9-inch square pan and save the other half for the top. Place chicken over stuffing. Mix soup and sour cream and pour over chicken. Top with remaining stuffing mixture. Bake at 350° for 20 minutes. Serves 6.

recipes.title: Raggedy Top Bars
directions: Cream together margarine, sugar and brown sugar thoroughly. Add egg and vanilla and beat until fluffy.
Blend in flour, salt and baking soda well.
recipes.text: Raggedy Top Bars. Cream together margarine, sugar and brown sugar thoroughly. Add egg and vanilla and beat until fluffy. Blend in flour, salt and baking soda well.

recipes.title: Jalapeno Cornbread
directions: Mix all ingredients well. Pour into 9 in. pan and bake in pre-heated 350° oven for 1 hr.
recipes.text: Jalapeno Cornbread. Mix all ingredients well. Pour into 9 in. pan and bake in pre-heated 350° oven for 1 hr.

recipes.title: Uncooked Oatmeal Cookies
directions: Mix together quick oats, coconut, chocolate chips and nuts. Bring to a boil the milk, butter, sugar and salt.
Add milk mixture to oats until all blended.
Drop by teaspoon on wax paper. Cool.
recipes.text: Uncooked Oatmeal Cookies. Mix together quick oats, coconut, chocolate chips and nuts. Bring to a boil the milk, butter, sugar and salt. Add milk mixture to oats until all blended. Drop by teaspoon on wax paper. Cool.

recipes.title: Grapefruit And Avocado Salad
ingredients: 1 large grapefruit, peeled and cut into sections
2 ripe avocados, peeled and cut into slices
directions: Arrange grapefruit on four serving plates.
Arrange avocados on plates with grapefruit.
Spoon lime juice over each salad and salt and pepper to taste.
recipes.text: Grapefruit And Avocado Salad. Arrange grapefruit on four serving plates. Arrange avocados on plates with grapefruit. Spoon lime juice over each salad and salt and pepper to taste.

recipes.title: Munner'S Cracklin Corn Bread
directions: Mix thoroughly.
Pour in greased iron frying pan and bake at 350° until golden brown.
recipes.text: Munner'S Cracklin Corn Bread. Mix thoroughly. Pour in greased iron frying pan and bake at 350° until golden brown.

recipes.title: Hot Curried Fruit
ingredients: 1 to 2 tsp. lemon juice (optional, I use 1 tsp.)
directions: Drain fruit.
Arrange in shallow, 2-quart casserole; use glass.
Combine all other ingredients to make sauce.
Pour over fruit.
Bake at 300° (uncovered) for 1 hour.
Makes 8 to 10 servings (at least).
recipes.text: Hot Curried Fruit. Drain fruit. Arrange in shallow, 2-quart casserole; use glass. Combine all other ingredients to make sauce. Pour over fruit. Bake at 300° (uncovered) for 1 hour. Makes 8 to 10 servings (at least).

recipes.title: Caramel Custard (Flan)
directions: Make a hot water bath to fit a 9-inch pie pan.
Heat water as you preheat the oven to 350°.
In a small frying pan over moderate heat, melt the 1/3 cup sugar.
Shake the pan instead of stirring contents.
Once melted, the sugar will caramelize quickly.
As soon as this happens, pour at once into a 9-inch pie pan.
Tilt pan quickly to let the syrup flow over bottom and slightly up sides of pan.
Use hot pads to protect hands from heat.
If syrup hardens before you finish, set pan on moderate heat until syrup softens, then continue.
recipes.text: Caramel Custard (Flan). Make a hot water bath to fit a 9-inch pie pan. Heat water as you preheat the oven to 350°. In a small frying pan over moderate heat, melt the 1/3 cup sugar. Shake the pan instead of stirring contents. Once melted, the sugar will caramelize quickly. As soon as this happens, pour at once into a 9-inch pie pan. Tilt pan quickly to let the syrup flow over bottom and slightly up sides of pan. Use hot pads to protect hands from heat. If syrup hardens before you finish, set pan on moderate heat until syrup softens, then continue.

recipes.title: Strawberry Bread
directions: Sift
dry
ingredients into a large bowl.
Mix remaining ingredients
well
and
add to dry ingredients.
Mix just until the
liquids coat the flour.
Pour into greased 9 x 5-inch loaf pan and bake about 1 hour at 350°.
recipes.text: Strawberry Bread. Sift dry ingredients into a large bowl. Mix remaining ingredients well and add to dry ingredients. Mix just until the liquids coat the flour. Pour into greased 9 x 5-inch loaf pan and bake about 1 hour at 350°.

recipes.title: Makes Its Own Crust Coconut Pie
directions: Step 1:
Beat eggs and then add rest of ingredients.
Mix well.
Beat 2 to 3 minutes with electric mixer.
recipes.text: Makes Its Own Crust Coconut Pie. Step 1: Beat eggs and then add rest of ingredients. Mix well. Beat 2 to 3 minutes with electric mixer.

recipes.title: Brownies
directions: Mix all ingredients well.
Pour in greased, floured baking pan 11x7.
Bake at 375
degrees for 18 minutes.
Serves 10.
recipes.text: Brownies. Mix all ingredients well. Pour in greased, floured baking pan 11x7. Bake at 375 degrees for 18 minutes. Serves 10.

recipes.title: Coconut Cake Topping
ingredients: 2 to 3 c. coconut (either flaked or Angel Flake)
directions: Bake any white cake mix.
When done, have already mixed the remaining ingredients.
Pour over warm cake and brown under broiler.
Watch closely.
Serve warm.
recipes.text: Coconut Cake Topping. Bake any white cake mix. When done, have already mixed the remaining ingredients. Pour over warm cake and brown under broiler. Watch closely. Serve warm.

recipes.title: Corn Flake Cookies
directions: Melt wax and chocolate over low heat.
Remove from heat and add sugar.
Stir until melted.
Add peanut butter and corn flakes. Stir together.
Drop mixture on wax paper by spoonfuls.
recipes.text: Corn Flake Cookies. Melt wax and chocolate over low heat. Remove from heat and add sugar. Stir until melted. Add peanut butter and corn flakes. Stir together. Drop mixture on wax paper by spoonfuls.

recipes.title: Peanut Crisp Bars
directions: Combine sugar, corn syrup and salt in saucepan. Cook and stir until sugar is dissolved. Blend in peanut butter; stir in Rice Krispies. Pat evenly into 11 x 7 x 2 pan. In small saucepan, melt butter and brown sugar. Remove from heat; add milk and vanilla. Stir in powdered sugar and beat until smooth. Spread frosting and cut in small pieces. This is very sweet.
recipes.text: Peanut Crisp Bars. Combine sugar, corn syrup and salt in saucepan. Cook and stir until sugar is dissolved. Blend in peanut butter; stir in Rice Krispies. Pat evenly into 11 x 7 x 2 pan. In small saucepan, melt butter and brown sugar. Remove from heat; add milk and vanilla. Stir in powdered sugar and beat until smooth. Spread frosting and cut in small pieces. This is very sweet.

recipes.title: Veg-All Casserole
ingredients: salt, pepper, Accent and Season-All to taste
directions: Mix first 5 ingredients.
Season with salt, pepper, Accent and Season-All.
Melt 1 stick margarine and crumble crackers in it (until margarine is soaked up).
Brown crumbs and sprinkle over top of casserole.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Veg-All Casserole. Mix first 5 ingredients. Season with salt, pepper, Accent and Season-All. Melt 1 stick margarine and crumble crackers in it (until margarine is soaked up). Brown crumbs and sprinkle over top of casserole. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Banana Nut Bread
directions: Cream margarine, add sugar gradually. Add eggs one at a time. Mix thoroughly and add sifted flour, soda, salt, baking powder and mix. Add bananas and nuts. Pour into well greased loaf pan. Bake at 350° for 45-60 min. Remove from oven and let stand in pan 10 min. Remove from pan, cool and slice.
recipes.text: Banana Nut Bread. Cream margarine, add sugar gradually. Add eggs one at a time. Mix thoroughly and add sifted flour, soda, salt, baking powder and mix. Add bananas and nuts. Pour into well greased loaf pan. Bake at 350° for 45-60 min. Remove from oven and let stand in pan 10 min. Remove from pan, cool and slice.

recipes.title: Sawdust Salad
directions: Dissolve gelatin in 2 cups hot water.
Add cold water, bananas, crushed pineapple and marshmallows.
Chill until gelled.
Cook sugar, flour, egg and pineapple juice until thick.
Allow to cool and spread cooked mixture over gelatin.
Whip cream and blend with cream cheese.
Beat until light.
Spread over second layer. Sprinkle grated cheese on top.
recipes.text: Sawdust Salad. Dissolve gelatin in 2 cups hot water. Add cold water, bananas, crushed pineapple and marshmallows. Chill until gelled. Cook sugar, flour, egg and pineapple juice until thick. Allow to cool and spread cooked mixture over gelatin. Whip cream and blend with cream cheese. Beat until light. Spread over second layer. Sprinkle grated cheese on top.
