recipes.title: Chicken Broccoli Braid
directions: Mix in order listed. Then spread rolls out in a square. Press the rolls together to connect forming a rectangle. Take mixture and place in the center all the way down leaving room along the edge to cut slits in the rolls. Cut slits on both sides of the rolls then roll the cut roll up over the mixture on both sides as to braid. Spread the braid with melted butter and bake at 350° for 20 minutes.
recipes.text: Chicken Broccoli Braid. Mix in order listed. Then spread rolls out in a square. Press the rolls together to connect forming a rectangle. Take mixture and place in the center all the way down leaving room along the edge to cut slits in the rolls. Cut slits on both sides of the rolls then roll the cut roll up over the mixture on both sides as to braid. Spread the braid with melted butter and bake at 350° for 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Dill Pickles
ingredients: 1 tsp. alum (in bottom of each jar)
1 tsp. dill (in bottom of each jar)
directions: Pack cucumbers into jars.
Heat vinegar, water and salt. Bring to a rolling boil and pour over cucumbers.
Seal.
recipes.text: Dill Pickles. Pack cucumbers into jars. Heat vinegar, water and salt. Bring to a rolling boil and pour over cucumbers. Seal.

recipes.title: Artichoke Spread
directions: Chop and drain artichoke hearts.
Mix completely with mayonnaise and cheese.
Heat for 20 minutes in 350° oven.
Serve on cocktail rye bread, sliced and toasted.
recipes.text: Artichoke Spread. Chop and drain artichoke hearts. Mix completely with mayonnaise and cheese. Heat for 20 minutes in 350° oven. Serve on cocktail rye bread, sliced and toasted.

recipes.title: Almond Cookies
directions: Mix all but flour, baking soda and almonds together well, then incorporate the dry ingredients into the first mixture.
Batter will be very stiff.
Roll into 2 long rolls, about 1 1/2 inches in diameter.
Wrap in wax paper.
Chill in refrigerator overnight. Slice 3/4-inch thick slices; place on a greased cookie sheet. Bake for 10 minutes at 350°.
recipes.text: Almond Cookies. Mix all but flour, baking soda and almonds together well, then incorporate the dry ingredients into the first mixture. Batter will be very stiff. Roll into 2 long rolls, about 1 1/2 inches in diameter. Wrap in wax paper. Chill in refrigerator overnight. Slice 3/4-inch thick slices; place on a greased cookie sheet. Bake for 10 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Vanilla Ice Cream
directions: Beat eggs until light and fluffy.
Add sugar and salt; continue beating.
Fold in milk, cream, flavoring and, if you like, 1 1/2 to 2 cups sweetened peaches or strawberries.
Omit flavoring if you use fruit.
recipes.text: Vanilla Ice Cream. Beat eggs until light and fluffy. Add sugar and salt; continue beating. Fold in milk, cream, flavoring and, if you like, 1 1/2 to 2 cups sweetened peaches or strawberries. Omit flavoring if you use fruit.

recipes.title: Supper Layer Casserole
ingredients: 1 can cream of celery or cream of mushroom soup
directions: Cook macaroni.
Brown onion and fat.
Add meat and brown.
Pour soup and milk over meat mix.
Put 1/2 macaroni in casserole and 1/2 cup green beans or asparagus and 1/2 meat mix.
Top with 1/2 cup cheese and repeat process.
Bake 30 minutes at 350°.
recipes.text: Supper Layer Casserole. Cook macaroni. Brown onion and fat. Add meat and brown. Pour soup and milk over meat mix. Put 1/2 macaroni in casserole and 1/2 cup green beans or asparagus and 1/2 meat mix. Top with 1/2 cup cheese and repeat process. Bake 30 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Pork Chop Casserole
directions: Brown pork chops and set aside.
Add cup of rice to drippings. Add beef broth and water.
Place chops back into mixture.
On top of each chop, put 1 slice of onion, tomato and pepper.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Pork Chop Casserole. Brown pork chops and set aside. Add cup of rice to drippings. Add beef broth and water. Place chops back into mixture. On top of each chop, put 1 slice of onion, tomato and pepper. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Artichoke Chili Pepper Dip
directions: Mix all and put into pan.
Heat through.
Serve with chips, etc.
recipes.text: Artichoke Chili Pepper Dip. Mix all and put into pan. Heat through. Serve with chips, etc.

recipes.title: Earthquake Cake
directions: Grease a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Put the coconut and pecans on bottom of pan (mixed).
Fix cake mix per directions, put on top of mixture.
recipes.text: Earthquake Cake. Grease a 9 x 13-inch pan. Put the coconut and pecans on bottom of pan (mixed). Fix cake mix per directions, put on top of mixture.

recipes.title: Pork Fried Rice
ingredients: 1/2 c. frozen tiny English peas, thawed
directions: Saute first 5 ingredients in butter in a large skillet 3 to 4 minutes or until pork is cooked.
Remove from skillet and set aside.
Heat rice in skillet until thoroughly heated.
Push rice to sides of skillet forming a well or nest in the center.
Pour egg into well and cook until set, stirring once.
Stir rice into eggs. Add the vegetables and remaining ingredients.
Stir well.
Yields 4 to 6 servings.
recipes.text: Pork Fried Rice. Saute first 5 ingredients in butter in a large skillet 3 to 4 minutes or until pork is cooked. Remove from skillet and set aside. Heat rice in skillet until thoroughly heated. Push rice to sides of skillet forming a well or nest in the center. Pour egg into well and cook until set, stirring once. Stir rice into eggs. Add the vegetables and remaining ingredients. Stir well. Yields 4 to 6 servings.

recipes.title: Custard Pie
directions: Mix ingredients together except pie crust.
Pour mixture into unbaked pie shell.
Bake at 400° for 10 minutes, then bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
An inserted knife will come out clean when custard is done.
recipes.text: Custard Pie. Mix ingredients together except pie crust. Pour mixture into unbaked pie shell. Bake at 400° for 10 minutes, then bake at 350° for 30 minutes. An inserted knife will come out clean when custard is done.

recipes.title: Bread Pudding
directions: Beat eggs.
Add sugar, salt, milk, bread and vanilla; bake at 350° in buttered dish until golden brown, approximately 1 1/2 hours.
recipes.text: Bread Pudding. Beat eggs. Add sugar, salt, milk, bread and vanilla; bake at 350° in buttered dish until golden brown, approximately 1 1/2 hours.

recipes.title: Chicken And Dressing
directions: Use a big pan.
Mix all ingredients, except soup, together with 1/2 of the broth.
To rest of broth, add mushroom soup.
Pour over dressing.
Bake 1 hour at 350°.
recipes.text: Chicken And Dressing. Use a big pan. Mix all ingredients, except soup, together with 1/2 of the broth. To rest of broth, add mushroom soup. Pour over dressing. Bake 1 hour at 350°.

recipes.title: Creamy Tacos
directions: Mix all ingredients and cook for a few minutes until cheese melts.
Cooks well in crock-pot.
Serve warm.
recipes.text: Creamy Tacos. Mix all ingredients and cook for a few minutes until cheese melts. Cooks well in crock-pot. Serve warm.

recipes.title: Beef Fajitas
ingredients: 1 to 1 1/2 lb. beef skirt steak or round steak
directions: Cut beef into 4 pieces.
Put in plastic bag with lime juice, garlic, salt and pepper.
Close bag and marinate in refrigerator for 2 to 30 hours or overnight.
recipes.text: Beef Fajitas. Cut beef into 4 pieces. Put in plastic bag with lime juice, garlic, salt and pepper. Close bag and marinate in refrigerator for 2 to 30 hours or overnight.

recipes.title: Carrot Pumpkin Bars With Orange Icing
directions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.
Grease a 15 x 10 x 1 inch pan; set aside.
In a large mixing bowl, stir together the flour, baking powder, orange peel, baking soda, and salt.
Set the flour mixture aside.
In a medium bowl combine eggs and brown sugar. Stir in pumpkin, oil, milk, and vanilla.
Then stir in carrots and chopped walnuts or pecans.
Add egg mixture to flour mixture, stirring with a wooden spoon until combined.
Spread batter into the prepared pan.
Bake for 20 to 25 minutes or until a wooden toothpick inserted near the center comes out clean.
Cool in pan on a wire rack.
Spread with Orange Icing.
Cut into triangles or bars.
recipes.text: Carrot Pumpkin Bars With Orange Icing. Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Grease a 15 x 10 x 1 inch pan; set aside. In a large mixing bowl, stir together the flour, baking powder, orange peel, baking soda, and salt. Set the flour mixture aside. In a medium bowl combine eggs and brown sugar. Stir in pumpkin, oil, milk, and vanilla. Then stir in carrots and chopped walnuts or pecans. Add egg mixture to flour mixture, stirring with a wooden spoon until combined. Spread batter into the prepared pan. Bake for 20 to 25 minutes or until a wooden toothpick inserted near the center comes out clean. Cool in pan on a wire rack. Spread with Orange Icing. Cut into triangles or bars.

recipes.title: Goose Liver Pate
ingredients: 12 oz. goose, duck or chicken livers
directions: Lightly saute the livers
in butter so they are still pink inside.
Add herbs, sherry, brandy, honey, salt and pepper and simmer for 2 minutes.
Finely puree the mixture, one cupful at a time, in a food processor or blender.
Pack into an earthenware jar and refrigerate for 24 hours.
Serve cold on small pieces of toasted rye bread.
recipes.text: Goose Liver Pate. Lightly saute the livers in butter so they are still pink inside. Add herbs, sherry, brandy, honey, salt and pepper and simmer for 2 minutes. Finely puree the mixture, one cupful at a time, in a food processor or blender. Pack into an earthenware jar and refrigerate for 24 hours. Serve cold on small pieces of toasted rye bread.

recipes.title: Family Style Beef Brisket Dinner
directions: Heat oven to 325°.
In a 13 x 9-inch pan or baking dish, add onion soup mix, blended with water.
Add brisket, turning to coat with soup mixture.
Loosely wrap with foil and roast 1 hour.
Add potatoes and carrots.
Coat well with soup mixture.
Reset foil and continue roasting 2 hours or until brisket and veggies are tender. Thicken gravy, if desired.
recipes.text: Family Style Beef Brisket Dinner. Heat oven to 325°. In a 13 x 9-inch pan or baking dish, add onion soup mix, blended with water. Add brisket, turning to coat with soup mixture. Loosely wrap with foil and roast 1 hour. Add potatoes and carrots. Coat well with soup mixture. Reset foil and continue roasting 2 hours or until brisket and veggies are tender. Thicken gravy, if desired.

recipes.title: Buttery Pound Cake
directions: Oil pan; sprinkle flour in pan and heat pan and oven to 350°. Mix sugar and butter with mixer; pour vanilla flavoring in milk. Alternate flour and milk, mixing as you alternate.
Put egg yolks in the batter and beat egg whites in a bowl.
Fold in the egg whites; mix batter for about 30 seconds, adding baking powder. Remove heated pan from oven and pour in batter.
Let cake cook for 1 hour and 15 minutes.
recipes.text: Buttery Pound Cake. Oil pan; sprinkle flour in pan and heat pan and oven to 350°. Mix sugar and butter with mixer; pour vanilla flavoring in milk. Alternate flour and milk, mixing as you alternate. Put egg yolks in the batter and beat egg whites in a bowl. Fold in the egg whites; mix batter for about 30 seconds, adding baking powder. Remove heated pan from oven and pour in batter. Let cake cook for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Crunchy Graham Treats
ingredients: 1 (18 oz.) box Honey Grahams cereal squares
directions: Combine cereal, raisins and nuts.
Melt chocolate morsels, peanut butter and margarine, in a medium saucepan, over low heat, stirring frequently.
Turn off heat.
Stir in vanilla.
Pour melted mixture over cereal mixture.
Stir until well coated.
recipes.text: Crunchy Graham Treats. Combine cereal, raisins and nuts. Melt chocolate morsels, peanut butter and margarine, in a medium saucepan, over low heat, stirring frequently. Turn off heat. Stir in vanilla. Pour melted mixture over cereal mixture. Stir until well coated.

recipes.title: Mexican Hamburger Casserole
directions: Brown about 1 1/2 pounds of hamburger.
Drain.
In a large bowl, mix together meat, beans and soup.
Crush up Doritos and place in bottom of a 13 x 9-inch dish (1/2 package).
Spoon meat and bean mixture on top of chips.
Cover with grated cheese.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Mexican Hamburger Casserole. Brown about 1 1/2 pounds of hamburger. Drain. In a large bowl, mix together meat, beans and soup. Crush up Doritos and place in bottom of a 13 x 9-inch dish (1/2 package). Spoon meat and bean mixture on top of chips. Cover with grated cheese. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Chicken Enchiladas
directions: Boil and debone chicken; set aside and either sprinkle with chili powder or a little bit of enchilada sauce mix.
Combine soup, sour cream, green chilies, onion and chicken.
Soften each tortilla in an oil brushed skillet as you fill with chicken mixture.
Roll and put in an oblong dish for baking.
recipes.text: Chicken Enchiladas. Boil and debone chicken; set aside and either sprinkle with chili powder or a little bit of enchilada sauce mix. Combine soup, sour cream, green chilies, onion and chicken. Soften each tortilla in an oil brushed skillet as you fill with chicken mixture. Roll and put in an oblong dish for baking.

recipes.title: Champagne Punch
ingredients: 1 (12 oz.) can frozen orange juice concentrate (do not thaw)
1 fifth champagne or sparkling grape juice
directions: Mix cranberry juice with orange juice concentrate.
Add carbonated liquids just before serving.
recipes.text: Champagne Punch. Mix cranberry juice with orange juice concentrate. Add carbonated liquids just before serving.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Pie
directions: Melt margarine and chocolate chips.
Stir in Rice Krispies. Press in pie shell.
Chill for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Peanut Butter Pie. Melt margarine and chocolate chips. Stir in Rice Krispies. Press in pie shell. Chill for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Sour Cream And Cucumber Salad(Serves 12, Kinda)
directions: Mix
salt, sugar and vinegar thoroughly.
Then add sour cream and stir until smooth.
Adjust mixture to taste (not too sweet). Then
add
chives,
dill and celery seed.
Next slice cuke very thin,
leave
peel
on.
Finally
mix thinly sliced cucumber and dressing and chill for at least 4 hours.
recipes.text: Sour Cream And Cucumber Salad(Serves 12, Kinda). Mix salt, sugar and vinegar thoroughly. Then add sour cream and stir until smooth. Adjust mixture to taste (not too sweet). Then add chives, dill and celery seed. Next slice cuke very thin, leave peel on. Finally mix thinly sliced cucumber and dressing and chill for at least 4 hours.

recipes.title: Tapioca Pudding
ingredients: artificial sweetener to equal 5 Tbsp. sugar
directions: Combine milk, tapioca and sweetener and salt.
Let stand 5 minutes.
Add 2 slightly beaten egg yolks.
Bring to a boil over medium heat, stirring constantly.
Remove from heat (mixture will be thin).
Add vanilla. Beat 2 egg whites to stiff peaks. Gradually fold in hot mixture. Chill.
Serves 8.
recipes.text: Tapioca Pudding. Combine milk, tapioca and sweetener and salt. Let stand 5 minutes. Add 2 slightly beaten egg yolks. Bring to a boil over medium heat, stirring constantly. Remove from heat (mixture will be thin). Add vanilla. Beat 2 egg whites to stiff peaks. Gradually fold in hot mixture. Chill. Serves 8.

recipes.title: Calico Beans
ingredients: 1/2 lb. bacon, cut in small pieces
directions: Brown first 3 ingredients in a skillet and drain off fat.
Mix with remaining ingredients.
Bake for 1 hour at 350° in an uncovered casserole.
Butter beans may be substituted for lima beans.
Add reserved lima bean liquid if needed (just a little).
recipes.text: Calico Beans. Brown first 3 ingredients in a skillet and drain off fat. Mix with remaining ingredients. Bake for 1 hour at 350° in an uncovered casserole. Butter beans may be substituted for lima beans. Add reserved lima bean liquid if needed (just a little).

recipes.title: Tangy Beef-Vegetable Stew
ingredients: 2 c. each: frozen peas and corn
directions: Place potatoes, carrots and onions in a large slow cooker. In a large skillet brown beef in oil.
Place over vegetables. Sprinkle with flour.
Dissolve bouillon cubes in boiling water. Stir in vinegar, ketchup, horseradish, mustard and sugar; pour over meat and vegetables.
Cover and cook on high for 5 hours. Add peas, corn and mushrooms.
Cover and cook on high for 45 minutes.
Yields 12 to 16 servings.
recipes.text: Tangy Beef-Vegetable Stew. Place potatoes, carrots and onions in a large slow cooker. In a large skillet brown beef in oil. Place over vegetables. Sprinkle with flour. Dissolve bouillon cubes in boiling water. Stir in vinegar, ketchup, horseradish, mustard and sugar; pour over meat and vegetables. Cover and cook on high for 5 hours. Add peas, corn and mushrooms. Cover and cook on high for 45 minutes. Yields 12 to 16 servings.

recipes.title: Lucky Chocolate Cake
directions: Melt chocolate.
Cool to room temperature. Cream butter and sugar.
Beat in eggs, one at a time.
Mix in vanilla and chocolate.
recipes.text: Lucky Chocolate Cake. Melt chocolate. Cool to room temperature. Cream butter and sugar. Beat in eggs, one at a time. Mix in vanilla and chocolate.

recipes.title: Candied Pecans
directions: Put butter in a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Melt at 325° in oven.
Beat egg whites until stiff.
Fold in sugar.
Add nuts and stir.
Put in buttered pan.
Bake at 325° for 30 minutes.
Turn every 10 minutes.
Store in airtight container.
recipes.text: Candied Pecans. Put butter in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Melt at 325° in oven. Beat egg whites until stiff. Fold in sugar. Add nuts and stir. Put in buttered pan. Bake at 325° for 30 minutes. Turn every 10 minutes. Store in airtight container.

recipes.title: Waldorf Chicken Salad
ingredients: 4 c. loosely packed torn spinach (torn into bite-size pieces)
1/2 c. diced cooked chicken, boned and skinned
directions: Line 2-quart salad bowl with spinach. Sprinkle egg on spinach. Arrange grated carrots around edge of spinach. Arrange chicken, celery, apple, walnuts and raisins in center. Serve with Honey Mustard Dressing on the side.
recipes.text: Waldorf Chicken Salad. Line 2-quart salad bowl with spinach. Sprinkle egg on spinach. Arrange grated carrots around edge of spinach. Arrange chicken, celery, apple, walnuts and raisins in center. Serve with Honey Mustard Dressing on the side.

recipes.title: Zucchini Bread
directions: Beat sugar, oil, eggs and vanilla extract in a mixing bowl until fluffy.
Mix flour, salt, baking soda and cinnamon.
Add to egg mixture and stir until blended.
Stir in zucchini and nuts. Put into a greased 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour and 20 minutes or until done.
Cool before serving.
recipes.text: Zucchini Bread. Beat sugar, oil, eggs and vanilla extract in a mixing bowl until fluffy. Mix flour, salt, baking soda and cinnamon. Add to egg mixture and stir until blended. Stir in zucchini and nuts. Put into a greased 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan. Bake at 350° for 1 hour and 20 minutes or until done. Cool before serving.

recipes.title: Red Velvet Cake
directions: Make a paste with the Nestle Quick and food coloring.
Cream the Crisco and sugar.
Add eggs; beat and add colored paste.
Mix well.
Sift flour 3 times.
Add flour and buttermilk alternately starting with flour.
Add salt and vanilla.
Last add the vinegar mixed with soda.
Mix and bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes or until done.
Pan size: 8 or 9-inch round.
recipes.text: Red Velvet Cake. Make a paste with the Nestle Quick and food coloring. Cream the Crisco and sugar. Add eggs; beat and add colored paste. Mix well. Sift flour 3 times. Add flour and buttermilk alternately starting with flour. Add salt and vanilla. Last add the vinegar mixed with soda. Mix and bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes or until done. Pan size: 8 or 9-inch round.

recipes.title: Pecan Pie
directions: Add eggs to all ingredients except pecans.
Pour into unbaked pie shell.
Decorate with pecans, being careful pecans do not sink to bottom of pie.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.
Pie will seem uncooked when hot, but will thicken as it cools.
recipes.text: Pecan Pie. Add eggs to all ingredients except pecans. Pour into unbaked pie shell. Decorate with pecans, being careful pecans do not sink to bottom of pie. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes. Pie will seem uncooked when hot, but will thicken as it cools.

recipes.title: Cranberry Swirl Cake
ingredients: 1 tsp. each: baking powder and soda
directions: Cream margarine and sugar.
Add eggs, one at a time, beating in well.
Add dry ingredients, sour cream and flavoring, mixing quickly and thoroughly.
recipes.text: Cranberry Swirl Cake. Cream margarine and sugar. Add eggs, one at a time, beating in well. Add dry ingredients, sour cream and flavoring, mixing quickly and thoroughly.

recipes.title: Diet Strawberry Pie
ingredients: 1 small pkg. sugar free strawberry Jello
directions: Fill cooled pie shell with sliced strawberries.
Combine Jello, 7 up, and cornstarch in saucepan.
Heat until thickened. Let cool and pour over berries.
Top with De zerta Whip Topping.
recipes.text: Diet Strawberry Pie. Fill cooled pie shell with sliced strawberries. Combine Jello, 7 up, and cornstarch in saucepan. Heat until thickened. Let cool and pour over berries. Top with De zerta Whip Topping.

recipes.title: Sausage Balls
directions: Have sausage at room temperature.
Knead flour and sausage together.
Add cheese and mix together.
Make into balls the size of walnuts.
Place on cookie sheet.
Bake at 350° for 15 minutes or until brown.
Serve hot.
Can be frozen and baked later.
recipes.text: Sausage Balls. Have sausage at room temperature. Knead flour and sausage together. Add cheese and mix together. Make into balls the size of walnuts. Place on cookie sheet. Bake at 350° for 15 minutes or until brown. Serve hot. Can be frozen and baked later.

recipes.title: Potatoes And Onions
directions: Grease casserole dish.
Place peeled and quartered potatoes and sliced onions in dish.
Melt margarine; stir in flour. Combine cream and water; add to flour mixture in saucepan.
Cook until mixture thickens.
Add salt and pepper.
recipes.text: Potatoes And Onions. Grease casserole dish. Place peeled and quartered potatoes and sliced onions in dish. Melt margarine; stir in flour. Combine cream and water; add to flour mixture in saucepan. Cook until mixture thickens. Add salt and pepper.

recipes.title: Chicken And Rice Casserole
directions: Melt margarine in 9
x
13-inch
pan or Dutch oven pan. Sprinkle rice in the
pan.
Place
fryer
on top of rice.
Mix soup, water and soup
mix.
Pour over chicken.
Cover and bake 1 hour at 350°.
Remove cover and allow chicken to brown.
recipes.text: Chicken And Rice Casserole. Melt margarine in 9 x 13-inch pan or Dutch oven pan. Sprinkle rice in the pan. Place fryer on top of rice. Mix soup, water and soup mix. Pour over chicken. Cover and bake 1 hour at 350°. Remove cover and allow chicken to brown.

recipes.title: Mustard Marinated Green Beans
ingredients: 2 (regular size) cans green beans (I use whole beans and only 1 can)
directions: Mix all the ingredients except beans and bring to a boil. Simmer and pour over beans. Refrigerate.
recipes.text: Mustard Marinated Green Beans. Mix all the ingredients except beans and bring to a boil. Simmer and pour over beans. Refrigerate.

recipes.title: Cheese Ring
ingredients: 1 lb. extra sharp Cheddar cheese, shredded
directions: Combine cheeses, onion, mayonnaise
and
red pepper and mix well.
Sprinkle about 1/4 cup
of pecans in an oiled 7-cup ring mold.
Chill until firm.
Unmold
on
platter
and
pat remaining pecans
onto
cheese
ring.
Garnish
with
parsley sprigs. Serve on crackers
with
strawberry preserves on top, if desired. This is pretty with preserves served in center of ring.
recipes.text: Cheese Ring. Combine cheeses, onion, mayonnaise and red pepper and mix well. Sprinkle about 1/4 cup of pecans in an oiled 7-cup ring mold. Chill until firm. Unmold on platter and pat remaining pecans onto cheese ring. Garnish with parsley sprigs. Serve on crackers with strawberry preserves on top, if desired. This is pretty with preserves served in center of ring.

recipes.title: M&M'S Cookies
directions: Mix all ingredients and bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes.
recipes.text: M&M'S Cookies. Mix all ingredients and bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Banana Bread
ingredients: 1 1/2 c. ripe mashed bananas (3 to 4; the riper the better)
directions: Cream sugar and margarine.
Add eggs, 1 at a time.
Add bananas and set aside.
Combine flour, baking powder, salt and nuts.
Add to creamed mixture.
Put into a greased 9 x 5-inch loaf pan.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
Cool on rack.
Makes 1 loaf.
recipes.text: Banana Bread. Cream sugar and margarine. Add eggs, 1 at a time. Add bananas and set aside. Combine flour, baking powder, salt and nuts. Add to creamed mixture. Put into a greased 9 x 5-inch loaf pan. Bake at 350° for 1 hour. Cool on rack. Makes 1 loaf.

recipes.title: Baked Eggplant Casserole
directions: Cut peeled eggplant into 1-inch cubes and soak overnight in salt water in refrigerator.
Drain eggplant and place in pan. Cover with water and cook until tender.
Soak bread crumbs in milk.
Saute onion, green pepper and celery in melted oleo about 15 minutes or until tender.
Combine cooked eggplant, bread crumbs and vegetables.
Add eggs, pimiento and seasoning.
Blend thoroughly.
Place in greased baking dish and bake at 350° for 45 minutes.
Top with grated cheese and return to oven until cheese melts.
recipes.text: Baked Eggplant Casserole. Cut peeled eggplant into 1-inch cubes and soak overnight in salt water in refrigerator. Drain eggplant and place in pan. Cover with water and cook until tender. Soak bread crumbs in milk. Saute onion, green pepper and celery in melted oleo about 15 minutes or until tender. Combine cooked eggplant, bread crumbs and vegetables. Add eggs, pimiento and seasoning. Blend thoroughly. Place in greased baking dish and bake at 350° for 45 minutes. Top with grated cheese and return to oven until cheese melts.

recipes.title: Easy Hot Chocolate Mix
ingredients: 8 qt. box instant nonfat dry milk
directions: Blend and store in sealed container.
recipes.text: Easy Hot Chocolate Mix. Blend and store in sealed container.

recipes.title: Cocoa Oatmeal Cookies(No Bake Cookies)
ingredients: 1/3 c. creamy peanut butter or crunchy if preferred
directions: In a medium saucepan, stir together sugar and cocoa.
Stir in milk and butter.
Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly until mixture comes to a boil.
Boil 1 minute.
Remove from heat.
Stir in peanut butter. Add oats.
Stir to mix well.
Quickly drop mixture by rounded teaspoonfuls onto wax paper or foil.
Cool completely.
Store in cool, dry place.
Yields about 4 dozen.
recipes.text: Cocoa Oatmeal Cookies(No Bake Cookies). In a medium saucepan, stir together sugar and cocoa. Stir in milk and butter. Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly until mixture comes to a boil. Boil 1 minute. Remove from heat. Stir in peanut butter. Add oats. Stir to mix well. Quickly drop mixture by rounded teaspoonfuls onto wax paper or foil. Cool completely. Store in cool, dry place. Yields about 4 dozen.

recipes.title: Italian Chicken Breasts
directions: Place dressing in large container and dip chicken breasts (one at a time and coating well) into dressing.
Leave chicken in container of dressing.
Cover and place in refrigerator to marinate 4 to 6 hours.
After marinated, dip chicken into egg and roll in flour seasoned with Season-All spice.
Deep-fry 5 to 8 minutes or until golden brown and crispy.
Chicken breasts will be very tender and juicy when done.
recipes.text: Italian Chicken Breasts. Place dressing in large container and dip chicken breasts (one at a time and coating well) into dressing. Leave chicken in container of dressing. Cover and place in refrigerator to marinate 4 to 6 hours. After marinated, dip chicken into egg and roll in flour seasoned with Season-All spice. Deep-fry 5 to 8 minutes or until golden brown and crispy. Chicken breasts will be very tender and juicy when done.

recipes.title: Pocatilla Potatoes
ingredients: 1 lb. Cheddar cheese, cut into cubes
1 or 2 slices bread, toasted and cubed
directions: Dice potatoes, leaving some skin on.
Sprinkle cubed cheese on top.
Set aside.
Cook onion slightly in margarine.
Add potatoes with pimento, cheese, bread cubes, onion and seasonings. Do not melt cheese completely, you want them chunky.
Toss, sprinkle with parsley and bake at 350° until cheese starts to melt.
I use a 9 x 13-inch glass pan.
recipes.text: Pocatilla Potatoes. Dice potatoes, leaving some skin on. Sprinkle cubed cheese on top. Set aside. Cook onion slightly in margarine. Add potatoes with pimento, cheese, bread cubes, onion and seasonings. Do not melt cheese completely, you want them chunky. Toss, sprinkle with parsley and bake at 350° until cheese starts to melt. I use a 9 x 13-inch glass pan.

recipes.title: Pat Cary'S Refrigerator Rolls
directions: Pour
boiling
water
over
salt,
sugar and shortening. Stir and
cool.
Add
yeast
to
water;
put
yeast and egg in mixture. Stir in flour to make soft dough.
Rub top with solid shortening. Cover
loosely.
Put in refrigerator (keeps 3 to 4 days).
Put out about 2 hours before use.
Make into rolls, let rise.
Bake at 450° until browned.
recipes.text: Pat Cary'S Refrigerator Rolls. Pour boiling water over salt, sugar and shortening. Stir and cool. Add yeast to water; put yeast and egg in mixture. Stir in flour to make soft dough. Rub top with solid shortening. Cover loosely. Put in refrigerator (keeps 3 to 4 days). Put out about 2 hours before use. Make into rolls, let rise. Bake at 450° until browned.

recipes.title: Blonde Brownies
directions: Combine all ingredients.
Bake in a 9 x 12-inch pan for 20 minutes.
recipes.text: Blonde Brownies. Combine all ingredients. Bake in a 9 x 12-inch pan for 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Vegetables Mexican Style
ingredients: 1 1/2 c mild or medium picante sauce
directions: Drain pinto beans, and corn.
Cut bell pepper into small pieces also dice onion.
Mix all ingredients.
Let set in refrigerator at least 1 hour.
Serve with crackers or restaurant chips.
recipes.text: Vegetables Mexican Style. Drain pinto beans, and corn. Cut bell pepper into small pieces also dice onion. Mix all ingredients. Let set in refrigerator at least 1 hour. Serve with crackers or restaurant chips.

recipes.title: Spiced Zucchini Bread
directions: Combine first six ingredients and set aside.
Beat eggs lightly; add sugar, oil and vanilla.
Beat until creamy.
Stir in zucchini and pineapple.
Add dry ingredients and stir only until moistened.
Pour into two well-greased and floured 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pans.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour or until done.
Cool 10 minutes before removing from pan.
recipes.text: Spiced Zucchini Bread. Combine first six ingredients and set aside. Beat eggs lightly; add sugar, oil and vanilla. Beat until creamy. Stir in zucchini and pineapple. Add dry ingredients and stir only until moistened. Pour into two well-greased and floured 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pans. Bake at 350° for 1 hour or until done. Cool 10 minutes before removing from pan.

recipes.title: Grandpa'S Shredded Wheat
directions: Put Shredded Wheat squares in a cake pan.
Put about 2 pats of butter on each square.
Sprinkle with sugar, cinnamon and nutmeg. Put in broiler for about 5 minutes.
Carefully put into a cereal bowl and add milk.
recipes.text: Grandpa'S Shredded Wheat. Put Shredded Wheat squares in a cake pan. Put about 2 pats of butter on each square. Sprinkle with sugar, cinnamon and nutmeg. Put in broiler for about 5 minutes. Carefully put into a cereal bowl and add milk.

recipes.title: Peanut-Butter Fudge
directions: Slowly add milk as stirring first four ingredients.
Stir all ingredients together, then turn heat on high until it comes to a boil.
Then turn heat to medium and cool until it forms a little ball on cold water (stirring constantly).
Then turn off heat and add the peanut butter and marshmallows.
Remove from stove and stir vigorously until the fudge begins to harden.
Put in a cake square container, level the fudge with a knife.
Let cool for about 20 minutes, then put in refrigerator to set up.
recipes.text: Peanut-Butter Fudge. Slowly add milk as stirring first four ingredients. Stir all ingredients together, then turn heat on high until it comes to a boil. Then turn heat to medium and cool until it forms a little ball on cold water (stirring constantly). Then turn off heat and add the peanut butter and marshmallows. Remove from stove and stir vigorously until the fudge begins to harden. Put in a cake square container, level the fudge with a knife. Let cool for about 20 minutes, then put in refrigerator to set up.

recipes.title: Barbecue Chicken And Rice
directions: Brown chicken in hot oil in a large skillet.
Stir in barbecue sauce and water.
Cover, cook over medium-low heat for 20 minutes or until tender.
Stir in rice and corn.
Cover, reduce heat and simmer 5 minutes.
Garnish with red and green peppers, if desired. Serves 4 or more.
recipes.text: Barbecue Chicken And Rice. Brown chicken in hot oil in a large skillet. Stir in barbecue sauce and water. Cover, cook over medium-low heat for 20 minutes or until tender. Stir in rice and corn. Cover, reduce heat and simmer 5 minutes. Garnish with red and green peppers, if desired. Serves 4 or more.

recipes.title: Cheeseburger Pie
directions: Preheat oven to 425°.
Bake pastry shell 8 minutes; remove from oven.
Reduce oven temperature to 350°.
recipes.text: Cheeseburger Pie. Preheat oven to 425°. Bake pastry shell 8 minutes; remove from oven. Reduce oven temperature to 350°.

recipes.title: Chicken Kiev
directions: In a small bowl mix butter, chives and garlic. Shape into a 3 x 2-inch rectangle.
Cover and freeze until firm.
Flatten each chicken breast to 1/4-inch thickness. Cut frozen butter mixture crosswise into 6 pieces.
Place one piece in the center of each chicken breast.
Fold along sides over butter.
Fold ends up and secure with a toothpick.
Combine cornflakes, parsley and paprika. Dip chicken with buttermilk and coat evenly with cornflake mixture.
Place chicken seam side down on a greased 9 x 13-inch pan.
Bake, uncovered, 425° for 35 minutes.
Remove toothpicks before serving.
Serve with rice.
Makes 6 servings.
recipes.text: Chicken Kiev. In a small bowl mix butter, chives and garlic. Shape into a 3 x 2-inch rectangle. Cover and freeze until firm. Flatten each chicken breast to 1/4-inch thickness. Cut frozen butter mixture crosswise into 6 pieces. Place one piece in the center of each chicken breast. Fold along sides over butter. Fold ends up and secure with a toothpick. Combine cornflakes, parsley and paprika. Dip chicken with buttermilk and coat evenly with cornflake mixture. Place chicken seam side down on a greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake, uncovered, 425° for 35 minutes. Remove toothpicks before serving. Serve with rice. Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Stuffed Chicken Cutlets
ingredients: 1 box Stove Top stuffing (mushroom and onion flavor)
salt, pepper and parsley to taste
directions: Cook stuffing as directed on box.
Filet chicken breast. Place cooked stuffing over filleted chicken breast; roll and place in baking pan.
Place a small piece of butter or margarine on each rolled chicken breast.
Season to taste with salt, pepper and parsley.
Add about 1/4 to 1/2 cup of water in pan and cover pan with foil.
Bake at 375° for 45 minutes.
Mix soup with water as directed on can and pour over chicken, cooking chicken uncovered for 15 minutes longer.
recipes.text: Stuffed Chicken Cutlets. Cook stuffing as directed on box. Filet chicken breast. Place cooked stuffing over filleted chicken breast; roll and place in baking pan. Place a small piece of butter or margarine on each rolled chicken breast. Season to taste with salt, pepper and parsley. Add about 1/4 to 1/2 cup of water in pan and cover pan with foil. Bake at 375° for 45 minutes. Mix soup with water as directed on can and pour over chicken, cooking chicken uncovered for 15 minutes longer.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Squares
ingredients: 1 pkg. Duncan Hines spice cake mix
directions: Mix together pumpkin, sugar, salt, spice, eggs and milk. Spread in greased 9 x 13-inch pan.
Sprinkle 1/2 package of cake mix over top.
Spread on pecan halves, then drizzle melted margarine over top.
Make sure all of the dry cake mix is covered with margarine.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
Check after mixture has been in the oven 10 minutes to make certain there are no dry spots, if so put more melted margarine on top.
May be served with whipped cream.
Store remainder of cake mix in plastic bag for later use.
recipes.text: Pumpkin Squares. Mix together pumpkin, sugar, salt, spice, eggs and milk. Spread in greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Sprinkle 1/2 package of cake mix over top. Spread on pecan halves, then drizzle melted margarine over top. Make sure all of the dry cake mix is covered with margarine. Bake at 350° for 1 hour. Check after mixture has been in the oven 10 minutes to make certain there are no dry spots, if so put more melted margarine on top. May be served with whipped cream. Store remainder of cake mix in plastic bag for later use.

recipes.title: Fried Wontons
ingredients: cooking oil for deep fat frying
directions: In a large mixing bowl, combine egg, cabbage, green onion, soy sauce, grated ginger root, sugar, salt, sesame oil, garlic and a dash of pepper.
Add the ground beef or pork and chopped shrimp; mix well.
recipes.text: Fried Wontons. In a large mixing bowl, combine egg, cabbage, green onion, soy sauce, grated ginger root, sugar, salt, sesame oil, garlic and a dash of pepper. Add the ground beef or pork and chopped shrimp; mix well.

recipes.title: Macaroni Casserole
ingredients: 1 (8 oz.) pkg. macaroni, cooked as directed on pkg.
directions: Mix together.
Bake for 30 minutes at 350°.
Grate cheese on top, if desired.
recipes.text: Macaroni Casserole. Mix together. Bake for 30 minutes at 350°. Grate cheese on top, if desired.

recipes.title: Mexican Trash Appetizer
ingredients: 2 cans tiny chopped black olives (4 oz.)
2 cans tiny chopped green chilies (4 oz.)
directions: Mix together the above ingredients. Season with salt, pepper and garlic powder.
Add 4 tablespoons vinegar and 6 tablespoons oil.
Marinate.
Chill.
Drain and then serve with tortilla chips.
recipes.text: Mexican Trash Appetizer. Mix together the above ingredients. Season with salt, pepper and garlic powder. Add 4 tablespoons vinegar and 6 tablespoons oil. Marinate. Chill. Drain and then serve with tortilla chips.

recipes.title: Italian Cream Squares
directions: Mix first 3 ingredients until blended.
Add coconut and pecans.
Grease and flour a 13 x 9-inch pan.
Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes.
Cool.
recipes.text: Italian Cream Squares. Mix first 3 ingredients until blended. Add coconut and pecans. Grease and flour a 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes. Cool.

recipes.title: Scrambled Egg Bake
ingredients: 1/4 lb. mild or sharp Cheddar cheese, cut into small cubes
directions: In a large mixing bowl with a wire whisk or fork, beat eggs until frothy.
Stir in milk; mix well.
Add cheese.
Season with salt and pepper.
Pour into buttered 2-quart baking dish.
Bake in a preheated 350° oven for 30 minutes.
Serves immediately.
recipes.text: Scrambled Egg Bake. In a large mixing bowl with a wire whisk or fork, beat eggs until frothy. Stir in milk; mix well. Add cheese. Season with salt and pepper. Pour into buttered 2-quart baking dish. Bake in a preheated 350° oven for 30 minutes. Serves immediately.

recipes.title: Hush Puppies
directions: Combine meal, flour and sugar. Add buttermilk and chopped onion. Blend all together. Drop by spoonfuls into hot Crisco oil. Brown lightly until done. When both sides are browned evenly, take up and drain on a paper towel.
recipes.text: Hush Puppies. Combine meal, flour and sugar. Add buttermilk and chopped onion. Blend all together. Drop by spoonfuls into hot Crisco oil. Brown lightly until done. When both sides are browned evenly, take up and drain on a paper towel.

recipes.title: Potato Salad
directions: Sprinkle potatoes with sugar and vinegar.
Add onion, seasoning and mayonnaise; toss to mix.
Carefully fold eggs in. Chill; garnish with parsley and cherry tomatoes or tomato wedges and deviled egg.
Yields 4 servings.
recipes.text: Potato Salad. Sprinkle potatoes with sugar and vinegar. Add onion, seasoning and mayonnaise; toss to mix. Carefully fold eggs in. Chill; garnish with parsley and cherry tomatoes or tomato wedges and deviled egg. Yields 4 servings.

recipes.title: Terry Brock'S Strawberry Fruit Dip
directions: Mix Cool Whip and yogurt together well.
Chill.
Serve with cut fruit.
recipes.text: Terry Brock'S Strawberry Fruit Dip. Mix Cool Whip and yogurt together well. Chill. Serve with cut fruit.

recipes.title: Steamed Broccoli With Sesame Vinaigrette
directions: Sprinkle sesame seed on a baking sheet.
Bake at 350° for 7 minutes. Set aside.
Trim off leaves and tough lower stalks of broccoli. Wash thoroughly and separate into spears. Arrange with stalks toward center in a vegetable steamer. Steam 6 minutes (or simmer in pan 6 minutes).
Drain. Combine sesame seed, vinegar and remaining ingredients. Stir. Drizzle over broccoli.
Exchanges:
1 vegetable, 1/2 fat.
Serving Size:
1/2 cup.
recipes.text: Steamed Broccoli With Sesame Vinaigrette. Sprinkle sesame seed on a baking sheet. Bake at 350° for 7 minutes. Set aside. Trim off leaves and tough lower stalks of broccoli. Wash thoroughly and separate into spears. Arrange with stalks toward center in a vegetable steamer. Steam 6 minutes (or simmer in pan 6 minutes). Drain. Combine sesame seed, vinegar and remaining ingredients. Stir. Drizzle over broccoli. Exchanges: 1 vegetable, 1/2 fat. Serving Size: 1/2 cup.

recipes.title: Quick Barbecue Chicken
directions: Put flour, salt and cut up chicken in brown sack.
Close tightly and shake chicken pieces good.
Fry in hot shortening or oil of your choice.
When browned, remove to paper towel on platter.
Mix remaining ingredients.
Dip each piece of chicken into sauce while hot.
Then place in roasting pan.
Leave open. Bake for 20 minutes in 375° oven.
recipes.text: Quick Barbecue Chicken. Put flour, salt and cut up chicken in brown sack. Close tightly and shake chicken pieces good. Fry in hot shortening or oil of your choice. When browned, remove to paper towel on platter. Mix remaining ingredients. Dip each piece of chicken into sauce while hot. Then place in roasting pan. Leave open. Bake for 20 minutes in 375° oven.

recipes.title: Glorified Potatoes
ingredients: 1 large pkg. frozen hash brown potatoes
Special K cereal or other crumbs (for topping)
directions: Grate cheese and mix with potatoes (thawed or frozen). Heat margarine, soup and sour cream until bubbly and mix with potatoes and cheese. Place in large casserole dish. Add enough milk to cover 3/4 to 1 cup. Dot rest of margarine on top. Top with Special K cereal or crumbs (corn flake, bread, etc.) If potatoes are thawed thoroughly, bake at 350° for 30 minutes. If frozen, bake 1 1/2 hours or until bubbly.
recipes.text: Glorified Potatoes. Grate cheese and mix with potatoes (thawed or frozen). Heat margarine, soup and sour cream until bubbly and mix with potatoes and cheese. Place in large casserole dish. Add enough milk to cover 3/4 to 1 cup. Dot rest of margarine on top. Top with Special K cereal or crumbs (corn flake, bread, etc.) If potatoes are thawed thoroughly, bake at 350° for 30 minutes. If frozen, bake 1 1/2 hours or until bubbly.

recipes.title: Low-Fat Autumn Medley Stew
directions: In a large soup kettle, simmer chicken breasts in the broth. Add the onion as the chicken simmers.
When chicken is fully cooked, remove and set aside.
recipes.text: Low-Fat Autumn Medley Stew. In a large soup kettle, simmer chicken breasts in the broth. Add the onion as the chicken simmers. When chicken is fully cooked, remove and set aside.

recipes.title: Carrot Soup
directions: Cook first 4 ingredients over medium heat for 15 minutes. Add beef broth; cook 15 minutes more.
Add salt, pepper, parsley and marjoram.
Put in blender and puree.
Serve.
recipes.text: Carrot Soup. Cook first 4 ingredients over medium heat for 15 minutes. Add beef broth; cook 15 minutes more. Add salt, pepper, parsley and marjoram. Put in blender and puree. Serve.

recipes.title: Asparagus Plate
directions: Boil asparagus in salted water for 10 minutes.
Mix soup, milk, lemon juice, egg, salt and pepper.
Heat thoroughly
recipes.text: Asparagus Plate. Boil asparagus in salted water for 10 minutes. Mix soup, milk, lemon juice, egg, salt and pepper. Heat thoroughly

recipes.title: Frozen Fruit Salad
directions: Combine all ingredients, lightly folding in bing cherries last.
Spoon into 12 paper muffin cups placed in muffin tins and freeze.
When frozen, place in plastic freezer bags.
Before serving peel off paper cups.
recipes.text: Frozen Fruit Salad. Combine all ingredients, lightly folding in bing cherries last. Spoon into 12 paper muffin cups placed in muffin tins and freeze. When frozen, place in plastic freezer bags. Before serving peel off paper cups.

recipes.title: Instant Cocoa Mix
directions: Mix in a very large bowl.
Store in airtight container.
Use 1/4 cup mixture for each cup of hot chocolate.
recipes.text: Instant Cocoa Mix. Mix in a very large bowl. Store in airtight container. Use 1/4 cup mixture for each cup of hot chocolate.

recipes.title: Texas Pecan Candy Cake(Make At Least 2 Weeks Ahead So Flavors Can Mellow.)
ingredients: 1/2 lb. candied red cherries, cut in quarters (1 1/3 c.)
1/2 lb. candied pineapple, coarsely chopped (1 c.)
1/2 lb. pitted dates, coarsely snipped (1 1/2 c.)
4 1/3 c. coarsely chopped pecans (1 lb.), shelled
directions: Preheat oven to 250°.
Grease and flour 9
x 13-inch tube pan with removable bottom.
Set aside.
Combine cherries, pineapple and dates in a very large bowl.
Sprinkle with flour.
Toss to coat well; add pecans and coconut and toss to mix.
Add sweetened condensed milk; stir to mix well.
Spoon evenly into prepared pan, smoothing top.
Bake in preheated 250° oven for 1 1/2 hours.
Cool in pan on rack.
Remove from pan.
Wrap tightly in foil. Refrigerate at least 2 weeks.
Cake cuts best when cold.
Slice very thin with serrated knife.
recipes.text: Texas Pecan Candy Cake(Make At Least 2 Weeks Ahead So Flavors Can Mellow.). Preheat oven to 250°. Grease and flour 9 x 13-inch tube pan with removable bottom. Set aside. Combine cherries, pineapple and dates in a very large bowl. Sprinkle with flour. Toss to coat well; add pecans and coconut and toss to mix. Add sweetened condensed milk; stir to mix well. Spoon evenly into prepared pan, smoothing top. Bake in preheated 250° oven for 1 1/2 hours. Cool in pan on rack. Remove from pan. Wrap tightly in foil. Refrigerate at least 2 weeks. Cake cuts best when cold. Slice very thin with serrated knife.

recipes.title: Browned Rice Pilaf
directions: Coat a medium saucepan with cooking spray; place over medium heat until hot.
Add rice and garlic; saute 3 minutes or until rice is lightly browned, stirring often.
Add oregano and next three ingredients; stir well.
Cover, reduce heat and simmer 15 minutes.
Add carrots and red pepper; toss gently.
Cover and cook an additional 5 minutes or until liquid is absorbed and rice is tender.
Yield:
2 servings.
recipes.text: Browned Rice Pilaf. Coat a medium saucepan with cooking spray; place over medium heat until hot. Add rice and garlic; saute 3 minutes or until rice is lightly browned, stirring often. Add oregano and next three ingredients; stir well. Cover, reduce heat and simmer 15 minutes. Add carrots and red pepper; toss gently. Cover and cook an additional 5 minutes or until liquid is absorbed and rice is tender. Yield: 2 servings.

recipes.title: D'Alessio'S Anise Delights
directions: In large pot, mix sugar, sweet butter, eggs, flour, baking powder, anise, salt and oil until it becomes dough.
Take out of pot and knead the dough on the table.
(Put flour on table.)
Take small pieces and roll in your hands like a snake and shape into a hill.
Place cookies on nonstick cookie sheet.
Bake at 350° for 12 to 15 minutes (no longer).
Makes about 25 cookies (hills).
recipes.text: D'Alessio'S Anise Delights. In large pot, mix sugar, sweet butter, eggs, flour, baking powder, anise, salt and oil until it becomes dough. Take out of pot and knead the dough on the table. (Put flour on table.) Take small pieces and roll in your hands like a snake and shape into a hill. Place cookies on nonstick cookie sheet. Bake at 350° for 12 to 15 minutes (no longer). Makes about 25 cookies (hills).

recipes.title: Chess Squares
directions: Preheat oven to 350°.
Mix cake mix, margarine and 1 egg together.
Pat into bottom of 9 x 13-inch glass baking dish to form crust.
Mix confectioners sugar (softened), 3 eggs and vanilla together.
Pour over crust and bake at 350° for 10 minutes.
Reduce heat to 300° and bake for 25 minutes or until top is light golden brown.
recipes.text: Chess Squares. Preheat oven to 350°. Mix cake mix, margarine and 1 egg together. Pat into bottom of 9 x 13-inch glass baking dish to form crust. Mix confectioners sugar (softened), 3 eggs and vanilla together. Pour over crust and bake at 350° for 10 minutes. Reduce heat to 300° and bake for 25 minutes or until top is light golden brown.

recipes.title: 7-Layer Salad
ingredients: 1 (10 oz.) pkg. frozen peas (cook to boil, then drain)
directions: Layer salad, starting with lettuce.
recipes.text: 7-Layer Salad. Layer salad, starting with lettuce.

recipes.title: Maple-Pecan Pie
directions: Combine first 6 ingredients, mixing well. Sprinkle pecans evenly in pastry shell.
Pour syrup mixture over pecans.
Bake at 325° for 45 minutes or until set. Yields 1 (9-inch) pie.
recipes.text: Maple-Pecan Pie. Combine first 6 ingredients, mixing well. Sprinkle pecans evenly in pastry shell. Pour syrup mixture over pecans. Bake at 325° for 45 minutes or until set. Yields 1 (9-inch) pie.

recipes.title: Nordstrom'S Nordy Bars
directions: In medium sauce pan, melt butter over medium heat; add butterscotch chips and brown sugar stirring until melted. Remove from heat and stir in eggs. Add flour, baking powder and salt mixing thoroughly. Stir in vanilla, set-aside until cool. When cool, stir in chocolate chips, marshmallow and pecans. Spread into greased 9x12 inch pan. Bake 350 degrees for 25 minutes. Let cool and cut into squares.
recipes.text: Nordstrom'S Nordy Bars. In medium sauce pan, melt butter over medium heat; add butterscotch chips and brown sugar stirring until melted. Remove from heat and stir in eggs. Add flour, baking powder and salt mixing thoroughly. Stir in vanilla, set-aside until cool. When cool, stir in chocolate chips, marshmallow and pecans. Spread into greased 9x12 inch pan. Bake 350 degrees for 25 minutes. Let cool and cut into squares.

recipes.title: 7-Up Cake
directions: Prepare cake from first 5 ingredients.
Bake in oiled and floured 9 x 12-inch cake pan for 45 minutes.
When cool, frost.
recipes.text: 7-Up Cake. Prepare cake from first 5 ingredients. Bake in oiled and floured 9 x 12-inch cake pan for 45 minutes. When cool, frost.

recipes.title: Rice And Beans
directions: Warm oil in large pot (4 quart or more).
Add the onion, carrot and green pepper; cook for about 2 minutes, then add the oregano, black pepper, red pepper, tarragon, salt and cumin.
Stir, then add kidney beans and cook for about 5 minutes at low heat, stirring constantly.
Add the 4 cups of water; increase the heat to high and cook until the water boils.
Stir in the rice, tomato paste and chicken bouillon, then lower the heat to low and cook for about 40 minutes.
Stir to fluff rice after 20 minutes.
To ensure rice is done, stick a spoon into the rice.
If the spoon stays upright, the rice is done.
Serves 6.
recipes.text: Rice And Beans. Warm oil in large pot (4 quart or more). Add the onion, carrot and green pepper; cook for about 2 minutes, then add the oregano, black pepper, red pepper, tarragon, salt and cumin. Stir, then add kidney beans and cook for about 5 minutes at low heat, stirring constantly. Add the 4 cups of water; increase the heat to high and cook until the water boils. Stir in the rice, tomato paste and chicken bouillon, then lower the heat to low and cook for about 40 minutes. Stir to fluff rice after 20 minutes. To ensure rice is done, stick a spoon into the rice. If the spoon stays upright, the rice is done. Serves 6.

recipes.title: Tropical Pork Chops
directions: Brown the chops in a little shortening.
Remove and sprinkle rice in the pan.
Pour orange juice over the rice and arrange chops over this.
Pour soup over all.
Cover and simmer until the rice has absorbed all the liquid and chops are tender.
recipes.text: Tropical Pork Chops. Brown the chops in a little shortening. Remove and sprinkle rice in the pan. Pour orange juice over the rice and arrange chops over this. Pour soup over all. Cover and simmer until the rice has absorbed all the liquid and chops are tender.

recipes.title: Franya'S Corn And Potato Soup
directions: Mix soup with corn using the corn's liquid to dilute soup. Add green onion and pepper to taste; heat.
Serve topped with bacon bits.
recipes.text: Franya'S Corn And Potato Soup. Mix soup with corn using the corn's liquid to dilute soup. Add green onion and pepper to taste; heat. Serve topped with bacon bits.

recipes.title: Fish Stew
directions: Saute garlic, onion and green pepper in olive oil until onion is limp. Add tomato sauce, undrained tomatoes and spices.
Bring to a boil.
Add cubed fish and shrimp. Coul also add 1/4 cup chopped parsley and 1 dozen butter clams in the shell.
Bring back to a boil, cover and simmer for 8 minutes.
recipes.text: Fish Stew. Saute garlic, onion and green pepper in olive oil until onion is limp. Add tomato sauce, undrained tomatoes and spices. Bring to a boil. Add cubed fish and shrimp. Coul also add 1/4 cup chopped parsley and 1 dozen butter clams in the shell. Bring back to a boil, cover and simmer for 8 minutes.

recipes.title: Fusilli Tricolore With Artichokes And Sun Dried Tomatoes
ingredients: 3 oz. sun-dried tomatoes, cut in thin strips
1 (8 oz.) can artichoke hearts, cut in 1/2-inch pieces
directions: Heat oil in a large skillet.
Add hot pepper flakes, garlic, scallions, tomatoes and artichoke pieces and cook until scallions are softened and slightly browned, about 5 minutes.
Add cooked and drained Antoine's Fusilli and toss.
Season with salt and pepper and add Parmesan cheese to taste.
Toss well and serve with additional Parmesan.
Serves 2 to 4.
recipes.text: Fusilli Tricolore With Artichokes And Sun Dried Tomatoes. Heat oil in a large skillet. Add hot pepper flakes, garlic, scallions, tomatoes and artichoke pieces and cook until scallions are softened and slightly browned, about 5 minutes. Add cooked and drained Antoine's Fusilli and toss. Season with salt and pepper and add Parmesan cheese to taste. Toss well and serve with additional Parmesan. Serves 2 to 4.

recipes.title: Apple Pudding
directions: Fill buttered baking dish with sliced apples.
Pour over top the batter made with remaining ingredients.
Bake in moderate (350°) oven until brown.
Some like to eat this with cinnamon and milk over it.
recipes.text: Apple Pudding. Fill buttered baking dish with sliced apples. Pour over top the batter made with remaining ingredients. Bake in moderate (350°) oven until brown. Some like to eat this with cinnamon and milk over it.

recipes.title: Sour Cream Corn Bread
directions: Preheat oven to 450°.
Mix first 4 ingredients well.
Fold in sour cream and mix well.
Pour into preheated greased iron skillet and bake until golden brown.
recipes.text: Sour Cream Corn Bread. Preheat oven to 450°. Mix first 4 ingredients well. Fold in sour cream and mix well. Pour into preheated greased iron skillet and bake until golden brown.

recipes.title: Swiss Steak
directions: Combine flour, salt and pepper.
Cut
steak; flour them and brown steak in oil.
Drain and place in casserole dish.
Top with onion and mushrooms.
Combine water, garlic and steak sauce; pour over vegies.
Cover and bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours or until meat is tender.
recipes.text: Swiss Steak. Combine flour, salt and pepper. Cut steak; flour them and brown steak in oil. Drain and place in casserole dish. Top with onion and mushrooms. Combine water, garlic and steak sauce; pour over vegies. Cover and bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours or until meat is tender.

recipes.title: Honey Bran Bread
directions: Empty bran in a large bowl.
Add buttermilk, honey, eggs, oil, flour, oatmeal and soda.
Mix well.
Add raisins last.
Bake at 375° until tester comes out clean.
Makes two large loaves or 3 small ones.
recipes.text: Honey Bran Bread. Empty bran in a large bowl. Add buttermilk, honey, eggs, oil, flour, oatmeal and soda. Mix well. Add raisins last. Bake at 375° until tester comes out clean. Makes two large loaves or 3 small ones.

recipes.title: Chewy Chocolate Chip Cookies
directions: Mix together flour and soda; set aside.
Combine margarine, sugars, vanilla and pudding mix.
Beat until smooth and creamy. Beat in eggs.
Gradually add flour mix.
Stir in chocolate chips and walnuts.
Batter will be stiff.
Drop by heaping teaspoonfuls 2-inches apart on ungreased cookie sheet.
Bake 9 to 9 1/2 minutes or until brown.
Preheat oven to 375°.
Makes 4 1/2 dozen.
recipes.text: Chewy Chocolate Chip Cookies. Mix together flour and soda; set aside. Combine margarine, sugars, vanilla and pudding mix. Beat until smooth and creamy. Beat in eggs. Gradually add flour mix. Stir in chocolate chips and walnuts. Batter will be stiff. Drop by heaping teaspoonfuls 2-inches apart on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake 9 to 9 1/2 minutes or until brown. Preheat oven to 375°. Makes 4 1/2 dozen.

recipes.title: German Red Cabbage
directions: Melt margarine in Dutch oven.
Add apples and onion; saute. Add cabbage, wine, cloves and sugar.
Pour vinegar over cabbage first to prevent it from losing red color.
Simmer, covered, for 1 hour.
Makes 6 servings.
recipes.text: German Red Cabbage. Melt margarine in Dutch oven. Add apples and onion; saute. Add cabbage, wine, cloves and sugar. Pour vinegar over cabbage first to prevent it from losing red color. Simmer, covered, for 1 hour. Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Chicken Cheese Ball
directions: Shape into ball and roll in finely chopped pecans.
Chill. Serve with crackers.
recipes.text: Chicken Cheese Ball. Shape into ball and roll in finely chopped pecans. Chill. Serve with crackers.

recipes.title: Cheap Chili
directions: Simmer all together for 30 minutes.
Serves 6 to 8.
recipes.text: Cheap Chili. Simmer all together for 30 minutes. Serves 6 to 8.

recipes.title: Cherry Almond Sauce(For Pork Roast Or Pork Chops)
directions: Combine all ingredients except almonds.
Heat to boiling; stir frequently.
Reduce heat and simmer for 2 minutes.
Add almonds. Spoon over meat as meat is cooking.
Return roast to oven for 30 minutes.
Baste several times.
recipes.text: Cherry Almond Sauce(For Pork Roast Or Pork Chops). Combine all ingredients except almonds. Heat to boiling; stir frequently. Reduce heat and simmer for 2 minutes. Add almonds. Spoon over meat as meat is cooking. Return roast to oven for 30 minutes. Baste several times.

recipes.title: Scotch Shortbread Cookies
directions: Roll out on floured cutting area about 1/4-inch thick.
Bake 25 to 30 minutes in 300° oven.
Ice and decorate.
recipes.text: Scotch Shortbread Cookies. Roll out on floured cutting area about 1/4-inch thick. Bake 25 to 30 minutes in 300° oven. Ice and decorate.

recipes.title: Molded Fruit Salad
ingredients: 1 can crushed pineapple, drained but save juice
directions: Drain pineapple, reserving juice.
In saucepan, combine reserved pineapple juice, eggs, sugar and flour.
Cook over low heat until thick (about 5 minutes).
Add jello.
Stir until dissolved.
Cool before adding oranges, bananas, pineapple and marshmallows.
Chill in refrigerator for several hours before serving.
recipes.text: Molded Fruit Salad. Drain pineapple, reserving juice. In saucepan, combine reserved pineapple juice, eggs, sugar and flour. Cook over low heat until thick (about 5 minutes). Add jello. Stir until dissolved. Cool before adding oranges, bananas, pineapple and marshmallows. Chill in refrigerator for several hours before serving.

recipes.title: Crabmeat Bites
ingredients: 1 (7 oz.) can crabmeat, drained and flaked
1 (5 oz.) jar sharp process cheese spread (Kraft)
1 (12 oz.) pkg. English muffins, split in half
directions: Combine first 6 ingredients, blending well.
Chill.
Spread split muffins with cheese mixture.	Cut each muffin half into quarters.
Serve cold or slip under broiler until cheese is bubbly. Yields 4 dozen bites.
recipes.text: Crabmeat Bites. Combine first 6 ingredients, blending well. Chill. Spread split muffins with cheese mixture.	Cut each muffin half into quarters. Serve cold or slip under broiler until cheese is bubbly. Yields 4 dozen bites.

recipes.title: Pecan Pralines
directions: Boil milk and sugars to boil stage (240°).
Stir occasionally to prevent sticking.
Remove from heat.
Add butter, nuts and vanilla.
Beat until mixture begins to stick to sides of saucepan, then pour into patties.
Make only one recipe at a time because it hardens as you get finished.
recipes.text: Pecan Pralines. Boil milk and sugars to boil stage (240°). Stir occasionally to prevent sticking. Remove from heat. Add butter, nuts and vanilla. Beat until mixture begins to stick to sides of saucepan, then pour into patties. Make only one recipe at a time because it hardens as you get finished.

recipes.title: Spinach Wow
ingredients: 2 pkg. (10 oz.) frozen chopped spinach, drained
1 c. mushrooms, sauteed or canned, drained
directions: Melt butter; saute onion and garlic.
Add spinach, salt, garlic powder, sour cream, artichokes, cheeses and mushrooms. Stir.
Place in a casserole.
Top with more grated Parmesan cheese and bake in 350° oven for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Spinach Wow. Melt butter; saute onion and garlic. Add spinach, salt, garlic powder, sour cream, artichokes, cheeses and mushrooms. Stir. Place in a casserole. Top with more grated Parmesan cheese and bake in 350° oven for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Refrigerator Pickles
directions: Mix cucumbers, onions and green pepper.
Pour salt on top; let sit 1 hour.
Rinse well.
Mix remaining ingredients; pour over cucumbers.
Place in jars or large bowl; store in refrigerator.
recipes.text: Refrigerator Pickles. Mix cucumbers, onions and green pepper. Pour salt on top; let sit 1 hour. Rinse well. Mix remaining ingredients; pour over cucumbers. Place in jars or large bowl; store in refrigerator.

recipes.title: Inside Out Ravioli
ingredients: 1 pkg. (10 oz.) frozen spinach, save liquid
1 can (1 lb.) spaghetti sauce with mushrooms
1 (8 oz.) pkg. shell or elbow macaroni, cooked
directions: Cook spinach according to directions on package, drain, saving liquid.
Set aside.
Brown ground chuck, onion and garlic in 1 Tbsp. oil.
Add enough water to spinach liquid to make 1 cup. Add spinach liquid, spaghetti sauce, tomato sauce, tomato paste, salt and pepper to ground chuck mixture.
Simmer 10 minutes. Combine spinach, cooked macaroni, cheese, eggs and 1/4 cup oil. Spread spinach mixture in a 10x9x2 inch baking dish.
Spread meat mixture on top.
Bake at 350 degrees for 30 minutes.
Let stand 15 minutes before serving.
recipes.text: Inside Out Ravioli. Cook spinach according to directions on package, drain, saving liquid. Set aside. Brown ground chuck, onion and garlic in 1 Tbsp. oil. Add enough water to spinach liquid to make 1 cup. Add spinach liquid, spaghetti sauce, tomato sauce, tomato paste, salt and pepper to ground chuck mixture. Simmer 10 minutes. Combine spinach, cooked macaroni, cheese, eggs and 1/4 cup oil. Spread spinach mixture in a 10x9x2 inch baking dish. Spread meat mixture on top. Bake at 350 degrees for 30 minutes. Let stand 15 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Clam And Oyster Stew
directions: Put oysters, clams, shrimp, lobster meat, potatoes (cut in small bite-size) and onion in a skillet with lots of water and simmer for 30 minutes.
Take your can of milk with 1 can of water; put into pot on low.
Add all the ingredients.
Drain your skillet first.
Add salt and pepper to taste.
Let simmer until potatoes are done.
Serve with little crackers.
Um-um good.
recipes.text: Clam And Oyster Stew. Put oysters, clams, shrimp, lobster meat, potatoes (cut in small bite-size) and onion in a skillet with lots of water and simmer for 30 minutes. Take your can of milk with 1 can of water; put into pot on low. Add all the ingredients. Drain your skillet first. Add salt and pepper to taste. Let simmer until potatoes are done. Serve with little crackers. Um-um good.

recipes.title: Deer Roast
ingredients: 4 to 6 lb. deer roast without bone
directions: Use a small roaster with lid.
Place all ingredients in roaster.
Cover and bake at 350° for 4 hours.
Serve over rice or noodles, if desired.
Serves 6.
recipes.text: Deer Roast. Use a small roaster with lid. Place all ingredients in roaster. Cover and bake at 350° for 4 hours. Serve over rice or noodles, if desired. Serves 6.

recipes.title: Porcupine Meat Balls
directions: Mix all ingredients.
Make into balls.
Put in a casserole dish.
You can brown the meat balls before you bake them if you want.
Cover them with tomato juice and sliced green pepper. Cover with aluminum and bake on 350° for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Porcupine Meat Balls. Mix all ingredients. Make into balls. Put in a casserole dish. You can brown the meat balls before you bake them if you want. Cover them with tomato juice and sliced green pepper. Cover with aluminum and bake on 350° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: German Potato Salad
directions: Boil until tender. Drain. Run cold water over them. When cool, peel and cut into thin slices.
recipes.text: German Potato Salad. Boil until tender. Drain. Run cold water over them. When cool, peel and cut into thin slices.

recipes.title: Onion Rings
directions: Mix all ingredients together and dip onion slices in batter. Deep fry in hot oil until golden brown.
recipes.text: Onion Rings. Mix all ingredients together and dip onion slices in batter. Deep fry in hot oil until golden brown.

recipes.title: Asparagus Quiche
directions: Crust:
Mix first four ingredients.
Line two 9-inch pie pans with dough and bake for 12 minutes at 400°.
recipes.text: Asparagus Quiche. Crust: Mix first four ingredients. Line two 9-inch pie pans with dough and bake for 12 minutes at 400°.

recipes.title: Chicken Dinner Bars
directions: Melt marshmallows and margarine.
Combine with Rice Krispies and pat into greased 9 x 13-inch pan.
Heat together sugar and syrup (do not boil).
Add peanut butter.
Pour over Rice Krispies mixture.
recipes.text: Chicken Dinner Bars. Melt marshmallows and margarine. Combine with Rice Krispies and pat into greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Heat together sugar and syrup (do not boil). Add peanut butter. Pour over Rice Krispies mixture.

recipes.title: Lucina'S Oatmeal Pancakes
directions: Combine the oatmeal with the milk and let stand for about 5 minutes.
Add the eggs and oil to the oatmeal mixture.
Sift dry ingredients and add to the oatmeal mixture.
Cook over medium heat.
Makes about 12 pancakes.
recipes.text: Lucina'S Oatmeal Pancakes. Combine the oatmeal with the milk and let stand for about 5 minutes. Add the eggs and oil to the oatmeal mixture. Sift dry ingredients and add to the oatmeal mixture. Cook over medium heat. Makes about 12 pancakes.

recipes.title: Oven Stew
directions: Put meat in bottom of roaster.
Add potatoes, carrots, onions and celery (cut in chunks).
Add salt and pepper to taste. Pour tomatoes over all.
Cover; cook in 250° oven.
Do not open lid for 4 hours.
recipes.text: Oven Stew. Put meat in bottom of roaster. Add potatoes, carrots, onions and celery (cut in chunks). Add salt and pepper to taste. Pour tomatoes over all. Cover; cook in 250° oven. Do not open lid for 4 hours.

recipes.title: Raisin Krunchers
directions: Grease an 8-inch square pan by rubbing lightly with shortening or butter.
Set aside.
Place peanut butter, brown sugar and corn syrup in large microwave-safe glass or plastic bowl.
Place bowl in microwave oven.
Turn microwave on High (100%) and cook for 2 minutes.
Remove bowl from microwave.
Add vanilla; stir with spoon until mixture is smooth.
Add rice cereal, oats and raisins. Gently stir without crushing cereal.
Spoon into prepared pan. Press mixture down firmly with fingertips to pack.
Let stand 30 minutes.
Cut into bars.
Wrap bars in plastic wrap.
Store in tightly covered container.
recipes.text: Raisin Krunchers. Grease an 8-inch square pan by rubbing lightly with shortening or butter. Set aside. Place peanut butter, brown sugar and corn syrup in large microwave-safe glass or plastic bowl. Place bowl in microwave oven. Turn microwave on High (100%) and cook for 2 minutes. Remove bowl from microwave. Add vanilla; stir with spoon until mixture is smooth. Add rice cereal, oats and raisins. Gently stir without crushing cereal. Spoon into prepared pan. Press mixture down firmly with fingertips to pack. Let stand 30 minutes. Cut into bars. Wrap bars in plastic wrap. Store in tightly covered container.

recipes.title: Sauce For Ribs
directions: Slice onions over ribs.
Pour sauce over ribs.
Bake in 350° oven for 2 hours or until done.
recipes.text: Sauce For Ribs. Slice onions over ribs. Pour sauce over ribs. Bake in 350° oven for 2 hours or until done.

recipes.title: Stuffed Portobellos(Low Carb)
ingredients: 1 (10 oz.) pkg. frozen whole leaf spinach, thawed
directions: Crumble sausage and cook until done. Set aside.
recipes.text: Stuffed Portobellos(Low Carb). Crumble sausage and cook until done. Set aside.

recipes.title: Collard Greens
directions: Place bacon in large heavy kettle.
Brown carefully.
Add 1 cup water to hot kettle.
Put in collards (that have been washed and torn from large stems).
Turn burner to lowest heat (not simmer).
Cook 1 hour.
Add about 1 1/2 cups water before putting lid on to cook.
recipes.text: Collard Greens. Place bacon in large heavy kettle. Brown carefully. Add 1 cup water to hot kettle. Put in collards (that have been washed and torn from large stems). Turn burner to lowest heat (not simmer). Cook 1 hour. Add about 1 1/2 cups water before putting lid on to cook.

recipes.title: Carrot Walnut Bread
directions: Preheat oven to 350°. Spray 1 loaf pan with Baker's Joy. In mixing bowl, combine flour, nuts, sugars, baking powder, cinnamon and salt. Mix until well blended. Stir in remaining ingredients just until moistened. Pour in pan. Bake 50 to 60 minutes.
recipes.text: Carrot Walnut Bread. Preheat oven to 350°. Spray 1 loaf pan with Baker's Joy. In mixing bowl, combine flour, nuts, sugars, baking powder, cinnamon and salt. Mix until well blended. Stir in remaining ingredients just until moistened. Pour in pan. Bake 50 to 60 minutes.

recipes.title: Sweet-Sour Greens
ingredients: 1/2 lb greens; turnip, mustard or collard
directions: Discard stems of greens and any damaged portions.
Thoroughly wash greens in cool water to remove dirt and sand particles.
Cut or tear leaves into small pieces.
In covered saucepan, cook greens in large amount of boiling salted water till tender, about 60 to 75 minutes.
Drain well and rinse.
In skillet, cook bacon until crisp.
Remove bacon, reserving drippings in skillet. Crumble bacon and set aside.
Blend flour into drippings.
Add hot water; cook and stir till thickened and bubbly.
Stir in sugar, cider vinegar, salt and pepper.
Stir in drained, cooked greens; heat thoroughly.
Garnish with crumbled bacon.
recipes.text: Sweet-Sour Greens. Discard stems of greens and any damaged portions. Thoroughly wash greens in cool water to remove dirt and sand particles. Cut or tear leaves into small pieces. In covered saucepan, cook greens in large amount of boiling salted water till tender, about 60 to 75 minutes. Drain well and rinse. In skillet, cook bacon until crisp. Remove bacon, reserving drippings in skillet. Crumble bacon and set aside. Blend flour into drippings. Add hot water; cook and stir till thickened and bubbly. Stir in sugar, cider vinegar, salt and pepper. Stir in drained, cooked greens; heat thoroughly. Garnish with crumbled bacon.

recipes.title: Cottage Cheese Patties
directions: Mix well and fry in oil.
Place in deep casserole pan and pour mushroom soup over.
Simmer in oven for 1/2 hour at 350°.
recipes.text: Cottage Cheese Patties. Mix well and fry in oil. Place in deep casserole pan and pour mushroom soup over. Simmer in oven for 1/2 hour at 350°.

recipes.title: Maidrites
directions: Lightly brown ground beef.
Add remaining ingredients (chop onion); mix and cook over low heat until onion is done, stirring occasionally.
Serve on hamburger buns.
recipes.text: Maidrites. Lightly brown ground beef. Add remaining ingredients (chop onion); mix and cook over low heat until onion is done, stirring occasionally. Serve on hamburger buns.

recipes.title: Deer Steak
directions: Take desired amount of deer steak; chop with edge of saucer. Salt, pepper and flour each piece; drop in hot skillet.
Cook until done.
Call me when it is ready.
recipes.text: Deer Steak. Take desired amount of deer steak; chop with edge of saucer. Salt, pepper and flour each piece; drop in hot skillet. Cook until done. Call me when it is ready.

recipes.title: Banana Pancakes
directions: Sift flour with baking powder, salt, sugar and cinnamon.
Beat eggs and beat in milk, butter, bananas and vanilla.
Add dry ingredients and stir until blended.
Bake each pancake on a hot, lightly oiled griddle, pouring out 1/4 cup of batter for each pancake.
Flip once when brown.
recipes.text: Banana Pancakes. Sift flour with baking powder, salt, sugar and cinnamon. Beat eggs and beat in milk, butter, bananas and vanilla. Add dry ingredients and stir until blended. Bake each pancake on a hot, lightly oiled griddle, pouring out 1/4 cup of batter for each pancake. Flip once when brown.

recipes.title: Corn Muffins
directions: Mix together.
Bake 20 to 25 minutes at 400°.
Makes 15.
recipes.text: Corn Muffins. Mix together. Bake 20 to 25 minutes at 400°. Makes 15.

recipes.title: Danish Bars
directions: Boil 2 sticks margarine, sugar, egg and 1/2 cup milk for 1 minute. Take off heat and add pecans, coconut and crushed graham crackers.
recipes.text: Danish Bars. Boil 2 sticks margarine, sugar, egg and 1/2 cup milk for 1 minute. Take off heat and add pecans, coconut and crushed graham crackers.

recipes.title: Cutout Cookies
directions: Mix sugar, eggs and butter until fluffy.
Beat in vanilla. Sift together baking powder and flour and beat into sugar mixture. Roll out on floured board.
Cut into desired shapes.
Bake at 400° for 7 minutes.
Yields 4 to 5 dozen.
recipes.text: Cutout Cookies. Mix sugar, eggs and butter until fluffy. Beat in vanilla. Sift together baking powder and flour and beat into sugar mixture. Roll out on floured board. Cut into desired shapes. Bake at 400° for 7 minutes. Yields 4 to 5 dozen.

recipes.title: Crab Casserole
ingredients: 3 slices fresh bread, cut into cubes
directions: Place all ingredients into large bowl and mix well.
Pour into greased baking dish.
Bake at 350° for about 1 hour.
Pour cheese sauce over individual servings.
recipes.text: Crab Casserole. Place all ingredients into large bowl and mix well. Pour into greased baking dish. Bake at 350° for about 1 hour. Pour cheese sauce over individual servings.

recipes.title: Yellow Squash Muffins
ingredients: 2 to 3 medium yellow squash = 2 c. cooked and mashed with 1 c. water
directions: In 2-quart saucepan,

cook chopped squash in 1 cup water until soft and able to mash. Add more squash if necessary or water. Add sugar, eggs and butter to hot mixture. Beat in dry ingredients. The batter should be cake mix consistency. Add more water to batter to make smooth like cake mix consistency.

Pour into 16 greased muffin tins. Bake at 400° for 25 minutes. Cool. Good frozen for weeks. Makes 16 muffins. Can do ahead. Summer squash is always plentiful and finding delicious and nutritious recipes are appreciated. This is good for any meal or snack.
recipes.text: Yellow Squash Muffins. In 2-quart saucepan, cook chopped squash in 1 cup water until soft and able to mash. Add more squash if necessary or water. Add sugar, eggs and butter to hot mixture. Beat in dry ingredients. The batter should be cake mix consistency. Add more water to batter to make smooth like cake mix consistency. Pour into 16 greased muffin tins. Bake at 400° for 25 minutes. Cool. Good frozen for weeks. Makes 16 muffins. Can do ahead. Summer squash is always plentiful and finding delicious and nutritious recipes are appreciated. This is good for any meal or snack.

recipes.title: Summer Coolness
directions: In a bowl, blend flour, margarine and nuts.
Press into greased 9 x 13-inch pan and bake 20 minutes at 325°.
Cool.
recipes.text: Summer Coolness. In a bowl, blend flour, margarine and nuts. Press into greased 9 x 13-inch pan and bake 20 minutes at 325°. Cool.

recipes.title: Chicken Casserole
ingredients: biscuits (as many as are needed to cover casserole)
directions: Cut up the chicken as you would for frying.
Brown slightly in small amount of oil and set aside.
In a 2-quart casserole dish, place a layer of sliced potatoes and then cover with a layer of peas.
Arrange pieces of chicken over this.
Add salt and pepper to cream and pour over the chicken.
Cover and bake at 350° for 40 minutes.
Remove cover and return to oven until chicken is brown. Add biscuits for topping if desired and bake 15 minutes or until chicken and/or biscuits are brown.
recipes.text: Chicken Casserole. Cut up the chicken as you would for frying. Brown slightly in small amount of oil and set aside. In a 2-quart casserole dish, place a layer of sliced potatoes and then cover with a layer of peas. Arrange pieces of chicken over this. Add salt and pepper to cream and pour over the chicken. Cover and bake at 350° for 40 minutes. Remove cover and return to oven until chicken is brown. Add biscuits for topping if desired and bake 15 minutes or until chicken and/or biscuits are brown.

recipes.title: Buffalo Chip Cookies
directions: Mix and bake for 15 minutes or less at 350°.
The bigger the cookie the better it is.
Makes about 4 dozen large cookies.
recipes.text: Buffalo Chip Cookies. Mix and bake for 15 minutes or less at 350°. The bigger the cookie the better it is. Makes about 4 dozen large cookies.

recipes.title: Easy Spiced Tea
directions: Steep tea and spices 5 to 10 minutes.
Remove tea bags.
Add sugar and juices.
Serve hot.
recipes.text: Easy Spiced Tea. Steep tea and spices 5 to 10 minutes. Remove tea bags. Add sugar and juices. Serve hot.

recipes.title: Cherry Pudding
ingredients: 1 (No. 2) can sour cherries, drained (keep the juice)
directions: Sift together the sugar, flour, cinnamon and baking powder. Add the cherries and nuts. Add the egg.
Add the shortening.
Mix well and pour into square pan.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Cherry Pudding. Sift together the sugar, flour, cinnamon and baking powder. Add the cherries and nuts. Add the egg. Add the shortening. Mix well and pour into square pan. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Vanilla Ice Cream
ingredients: 2 c. heavy cream or half and half
directions: Combine sugar and flour in saucepan.
Beat eggs and add milk and salt to dry ingredients.
Cook until mixture begins to thicken, remove and chill.
Add vanilla and cream, then freeze in freezer.
Makes 1/2 gallon.
