recipes.text: Vanilla Ice Cream. Combine sugar and flour in saucepan. Beat eggs and add milk and salt to dry ingredients. Cook until mixture begins to thicken, remove and chill. Add vanilla and cream, then freeze in freezer. Makes 1/2 gallon.

recipes.title: Floyd'S Chocolate Pound Cake
directions: Mix as any cake.
Bake in 9 or 10-inch tube pan.
Cook at 300° for 80 minutes or until done.
recipes.text: Floyd'S Chocolate Pound Cake. Mix as any cake. Bake in 9 or 10-inch tube pan. Cook at 300° for 80 minutes or until done.

recipes.title: Cherry Delight Pie
directions: Mix butter and crumbs, put in long pan and let chill.
recipes.text: Cherry Delight Pie. Mix butter and crumbs, put in long pan and let chill.

recipes.title: Harvard Beets
ingredients: Large pot of cooked sliced beets
1 Tbsp. flour or 1 tsp. corn starch
directions: Cut off greens. Do not cut too close to beet. It will bleed. Wash beets. Do not cut up. Cook till tender in boiling water, about 30 minutes. Cool. Peel and slice. Put in clean pot. Add about 1-2 cups water. Simmer on low heat to make red liquid.
recipes.text: Harvard Beets. Cut off greens. Do not cut too close to beet. It will bleed. Wash beets. Do not cut up. Cook till tender in boiling water, about 30 minutes. Cool. Peel and slice. Put in clean pot. Add about 1-2 cups water. Simmer on low heat to make red liquid.

recipes.title: French Onion Soup(Crock-Pot)
directions: In small skillet, saute onions in butter.
In crock-pot, add water, Worcestershire sauce, salt and onions.
Cover and cook on low for 4 or 5 hours.
Serve in bowl and top with slice of French bread that has been sprinkled with Parmesan cheese.
Recipe can be doubled or tripled easily.
recipes.text: French Onion Soup(Crock-Pot). In small skillet, saute onions in butter. In crock-pot, add water, Worcestershire sauce, salt and onions. Cover and cook on low for 4 or 5 hours. Serve in bowl and top with slice of French bread that has been sprinkled with Parmesan cheese. Recipe can be doubled or tripled easily.

recipes.title: Egg Sausage Casserole
directions: Cut bread; add a little butter.
Beat eggs with milk, salt and mustard.
Layer bread, sausage and cheese.
Pour egg mixture on top and refrigerate overnight.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Egg Sausage Casserole. Cut bread; add a little butter. Beat eggs with milk, salt and mustard. Layer bread, sausage and cheese. Pour egg mixture on top and refrigerate overnight. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Tom Kha Kaichicken Coconut Soup
ingredients: 2 to 4 Slices 2 Tbsp. Galangal Root (Laos Root)
directions: Cut up the chicken meat either diced or in strips, chop lemon grass and kaffir leaves in food processor or hand chop finely. Cut the shallots to 1/4 inch strips, cut scallions to 1 inch pieces, chop cilantro with stems, no roots.
Peel and slice the galangal root in thin strips 1/2 inch long.
Heat pan on medium, add the kaffir, lemon grass, shallots, whole dried chilis, and galangal, stir until light brown.
Add the chicken broth and increase the heat to high and bring to a boil.
Add chicken, coconut and milk, fish sauce and 1/2 teaspoon chili paste.
Add the chili paste in increments and taste before adding the second half.
Heat almost to boiling, remove from the heat, add lime juice, cilantro and scallions.
Serves 4.
recipes.text: Tom Kha Kaichicken Coconut Soup. Cut up the chicken meat either diced or in strips, chop lemon grass and kaffir leaves in food processor or hand chop finely. Cut the shallots to 1/4 inch strips, cut scallions to 1 inch pieces, chop cilantro with stems, no roots. Peel and slice the galangal root in thin strips 1/2 inch long. Heat pan on medium, add the kaffir, lemon grass, shallots, whole dried chilis, and galangal, stir until light brown. Add the chicken broth and increase the heat to high and bring to a boil. Add chicken, coconut and milk, fish sauce and 1/2 teaspoon chili paste. Add the chili paste in increments and taste before adding the second half. Heat almost to boiling, remove from the heat, add lime juice, cilantro and scallions. Serves 4.

recipes.title: Country Fried Chicken In Gravy
directions: Season and flour chicken.
Heat Crisco in a large pan.
When hot, add chicken.
Brown chicken on both sides.
Remove from pan. Remove all Crisco from pan, except about 1 tablespoon.
Put 3 teaspoons of flour in pan.
Brown the flour.
Pour 1 cup of water in pan.
Stir until thick.
Put chicken back in pan and cover. Leave in pan until ready to serve.
recipes.text: Country Fried Chicken In Gravy. Season and flour chicken. Heat Crisco in a large pan. When hot, add chicken. Brown chicken on both sides. Remove from pan. Remove all Crisco from pan, except about 1 tablespoon. Put 3 teaspoons of flour in pan. Brown the flour. Pour 1 cup of water in pan. Stir until thick. Put chicken back in pan and cover. Leave in pan until ready to serve.

recipes.title: Praline Yams
ingredients: 6 medium yams, cooked, peeled and cut into 1-inch slices
directions: Place yams in serving dish; keep hot.
Mix remaining ingredients together.
Heat, stirring constantly for 5 minutes. Pour over yams; serve immediately.
Serves 6.
recipes.text: Praline Yams. Place yams in serving dish; keep hot. Mix remaining ingredients together. Heat, stirring constantly for 5 minutes. Pour over yams; serve immediately. Serves 6.

recipes.title: Chicken With Apricots And Prunes
directions: Place chicken breast halves, prunes, apricots, olive oil, wine, garlic, brown sugar, salt and pepper in a bowl large enough to marinate for several hours.
(May be left overnight.)
Remove chicken from marinade when ready to bake.
Arrange in a shallow baking casserole dish and spread marinade on top.
Cover and bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes.
Serve with rice or mashed sweet potatoes.
Makes 4 servings.
recipes.text: Chicken With Apricots And Prunes. Place chicken breast halves, prunes, apricots, olive oil, wine, garlic, brown sugar, salt and pepper in a bowl large enough to marinate for several hours. (May be left overnight.) Remove chicken from marinade when ready to bake. Arrange in a shallow baking casserole dish and spread marinade on top. Cover and bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes. Serve with rice or mashed sweet potatoes. Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: Goulash
directions: Okay. Wash them in a sink and then dry them off and then you have to put them in a pan and put them in there for 30 minutes, and then you take them out and then you eat them.
recipes.text: Goulash. Okay. Wash them in a sink and then dry them off and then you have to put them in a pan and put them in there for 30 minutes, and then you take them out and then you eat them.

recipes.title: Coconut Cream Pie
directions: Stir together sugar, cornstarch and salt in a saucepan.
Blend milk and egg yolks together.
Gradually stir into sugar mixture. Cook over medium heat.
Blend in butter and extract.
Stir in 3/4 cup flaked coconut.
Sprinkle remainder of flaked coconut over whipped cream on pie.
Chill pie for 2 hours prior to serving.
recipes.text: Coconut Cream Pie. Stir together sugar, cornstarch and salt in a saucepan. Blend milk and egg yolks together. Gradually stir into sugar mixture. Cook over medium heat. Blend in butter and extract. Stir in 3/4 cup flaked coconut. Sprinkle remainder of flaked coconut over whipped cream on pie. Chill pie for 2 hours prior to serving.

recipes.title: Hamburger Casserole
directions: Cook macaroni; fry hamburger, onion and green pepper together. Layer ingredients into baking dish.
Place half of macaroni on bottom, then hamburger, puree (heated) and cheese (in that order). Repeat until all ingredients are used.
Bake at 325° for 30 to 35 minutes or until done.
recipes.text: Hamburger Casserole. Cook macaroni; fry hamburger, onion and green pepper together. Layer ingredients into baking dish. Place half of macaroni on bottom, then hamburger, puree (heated) and cheese (in that order). Repeat until all ingredients are used. Bake at 325° for 30 to 35 minutes or until done.

recipes.title: Snickers Brownies
directions: Preheat oven to 350°.
Mix cake mix with 1/2 can of milk and melted margarine.
Press 2/3 of this mixture into a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Bake for 12 minutes.
While in oven, melt chopped caramels with other half of can of milk.
Pour this over the cooked cake mixture and sprinkle peanuts and chocolate chips over caramels. Sprinkle remaining cake mixture on top.
Bake for 8 minutes.
Cool and cut into squares.
recipes.text: Snickers Brownies. Preheat oven to 350°. Mix cake mix with 1/2 can of milk and melted margarine. Press 2/3 of this mixture into a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake for 12 minutes. While in oven, melt chopped caramels with other half of can of milk. Pour this over the cooked cake mixture and sprinkle peanuts and chocolate chips over caramels. Sprinkle remaining cake mixture on top. Bake for 8 minutes. Cool and cut into squares.

recipes.title: Oven Stew
directions: Mix ingredients in large casserole.
Cover.
Bake in 250° oven for 5 hours.
recipes.text: Oven Stew. Mix ingredients in large casserole. Cover. Bake in 250° oven for 5 hours.

recipes.title: Christmas Holly
directions: Melt marshmallows and oleo together; add vanilla, green food coloring and corn flakes.
Mix together; drop by spoonful on wax paper.
Decorate with cinnamon red hots (3 or 4).
Store in tight container.
recipes.text: Christmas Holly. Melt marshmallows and oleo together; add vanilla, green food coloring and corn flakes. Mix together; drop by spoonful on wax paper. Decorate with cinnamon red hots (3 or 4). Store in tight container.

recipes.title: Date Nut Bread
ingredients: 1/2 lb. dates, cut in small pieces
directions: Pour boiling water over dates; let stand about 5 minutes. Sift dry ingredients.
Add date mixture and eggs, mixing well. Fold in nuts.
Pour into greased loaf pan.
Bake at 350° for 45 to 50 minutes.
recipes.text: Date Nut Bread. Pour boiling water over dates; let stand about 5 minutes. Sift dry ingredients. Add date mixture and eggs, mixing well. Fold in nuts. Pour into greased loaf pan. Bake at 350° for 45 to 50 minutes.

recipes.title: Barbecued Lima Beans
directions: Mix all ingredients except onion.
Put into skillet, top with onion and simmer for 10 minutes.
recipes.text: Barbecued Lima Beans. Mix all ingredients except onion. Put into skillet, top with onion and simmer for 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Shrimp Dip
ingredients: 1 c. (1 small can) tiny shrimp, chopped
directions: Mix all ingredients and chill. Serve with raw vegetables or crackers.
recipes.text: Shrimp Dip. Mix all ingredients and chill. Serve with raw vegetables or crackers.

recipes.title: Peanut Brittle
directions: Bring to a rolling boil the sugar, syrup and water.
Slowly add peanuts, keeping a rolling boil until peanuts pop and brown (hard crack stage, 290°).
Remove from heat.
Add soda and salt. Pour onto a foil lined cookie sheet.
recipes.text: Peanut Brittle. Bring to a rolling boil the sugar, syrup and water. Slowly add peanuts, keeping a rolling boil until peanuts pop and brown (hard crack stage, 290°). Remove from heat. Add soda and salt. Pour onto a foil lined cookie sheet.

recipes.title: Grilled Herb Chicken Salad
ingredients: romaine lettuce head, washed and torn
directions: Rinse and pat chicken breasts dry, cut the chicken into chunks.
Spray a medium skillet with vegetable spray.
Over medium-high heat, place chicken in skillet and sprinkle with Italian seasoning.
Cook until chicken is no longer pink.
In a large bowl, place romaine lettuce, olives and red onion.
In a small bowl or pitcher, mix dijon mustard, white wine vinegar, Worcestershire sauce, salt, pepper and olive oil.
Pour mixture over salad and toss well.
Place tomato quarters around the inside edge of bowl.
Serve immediately.
Serves 4 as a meal or 6 as a side salad.
recipes.text: Grilled Herb Chicken Salad. Rinse and pat chicken breasts dry, cut the chicken into chunks. Spray a medium skillet with vegetable spray. Over medium-high heat, place chicken in skillet and sprinkle with Italian seasoning. Cook until chicken is no longer pink. In a large bowl, place romaine lettuce, olives and red onion. In a small bowl or pitcher, mix dijon mustard, white wine vinegar, Worcestershire sauce, salt, pepper and olive oil. Pour mixture over salad and toss well. Place tomato quarters around the inside edge of bowl. Serve immediately. Serves 4 as a meal or 6 as a side salad.

recipes.title: Cake Mix Cookies
directions: Mix well; make into balls.
Squash with bottom of a glass that has been dipped in sugar.
Bake at 350° for about 8 minutes or until lightly browned.
recipes.text: Cake Mix Cookies. Mix well; make into balls. Squash with bottom of a glass that has been dipped in sugar. Bake at 350° for about 8 minutes or until lightly browned.

recipes.title: Caramel Layer Chocolate Squares
directions: Melt caramels in 1/3 cup evaporated milk and set aside. Grease and flour a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Combine butter, cake mix, 1/3 cup evaporated milk and pecans.
Press half of this into the cake pan and bake at 350° for 12 minutes.
Remove from oven. Sprinkle the chocolate chips over this and then spread the caramel over the chips. Cover with the remaining cake mix batter.
You may have to take little bits between your fingers and drop them onto the caramel; a little slow but well worth it. Return to oven and bake for 18 minutes.
Cool before cutting.
recipes.text: Caramel Layer Chocolate Squares. Melt caramels in 1/3 cup evaporated milk and set aside. Grease and flour a 9 x 13-inch pan. Combine butter, cake mix, 1/3 cup evaporated milk and pecans. Press half of this into the cake pan and bake at 350° for 12 minutes. Remove from oven. Sprinkle the chocolate chips over this and then spread the caramel over the chips. Cover with the remaining cake mix batter. You may have to take little bits between your fingers and drop them onto the caramel; a little slow but well worth it. Return to oven and bake for 18 minutes. Cool before cutting.

recipes.title: My Original Pimento Cheese
directions: Have cheese at room temperature, then grate.
Beat with mixer after you add mayonnaise.
Beat until smooth.
Then add rest of ingredients.
Beat until smooth again.
Put in refrigerator and chill.
recipes.text: My Original Pimento Cheese. Have cheese at room temperature, then grate. Beat with mixer after you add mayonnaise. Beat until smooth. Then add rest of ingredients. Beat until smooth again. Put in refrigerator and chill.

recipes.title: Crock-Pot Pork Chops And Stuffing
directions: Mix stuffing mix as directed on package. Place half of stuffing in lightly greased crock-pot. Spread half of undiluted soup on top of stuffing. Place pork chops on top. Spoon rest of stuffing on top. Spread rest of soup on top. Cook on low for 8 to 10 hours.
recipes.text: Crock-Pot Pork Chops And Stuffing. Mix stuffing mix as directed on package. Place half of stuffing in lightly greased crock-pot. Spread half of undiluted soup on top of stuffing. Place pork chops on top. Spoon rest of stuffing on top. Spread rest of soup on top. Cook on low for 8 to 10 hours.

recipes.title: Ginger Mandarin Frosting
ingredients: 1 baked sponge cake or angel food cake
directions: Stir ginger preserves and marmalade together until soft.
Split cake into 2 layers.
Spread half of this mixture over bottom layer of split cake.
Beat cream with sugar and vanilla until stiff. Spread half of cream over ginger and marmalade mixture, sprinkle with nuts.
Put on top layer, repeat ginger, cream and nut layer.
recipes.text: Ginger Mandarin Frosting. Stir ginger preserves and marmalade together until soft. Split cake into 2 layers. Spread half of this mixture over bottom layer of split cake. Beat cream with sugar and vanilla until stiff. Spread half of cream over ginger and marmalade mixture, sprinkle with nuts. Put on top layer, repeat ginger, cream and nut layer.

recipes.title: Lemon Cheesecake
ingredients: 2 (8 oz.) pkg. Philly cream cheese, softened
graham cracker crumb crust (6 oz. or 9-inch)
directions: Mix cream cheese, sugar, lemon juice, lemon peel, vanilla and eggs.
Pour into ready-to-use graham cracker crumb crust.
Bake at 350° for 40 minutes or until center is almost set.
Cool; refrigerate at least 3 hours.
Garnish with whipped cream and lemon slices.
Makes 8 servings.
recipes.text: Lemon Cheesecake. Mix cream cheese, sugar, lemon juice, lemon peel, vanilla and eggs. Pour into ready-to-use graham cracker crumb crust. Bake at 350° for 40 minutes or until center is almost set. Cool; refrigerate at least 3 hours. Garnish with whipped cream and lemon slices. Makes 8 servings.

recipes.title: Zucchini Bread
directions: Mix all dry ingredients, then add liquids and mix thoroughly. Bake in loaf pan at 325° for one hour.
recipes.text: Zucchini Bread. Mix all dry ingredients, then add liquids and mix thoroughly. Bake in loaf pan at 325° for one hour.

recipes.title: Nuts And Bolts
directions: Melt butter and add seasonings.
Mix cereal, nuts, etc.
Pour butter mixture in shallow pan and bake at 250° for 1 hour.
Stir up once.
Store in covered container when cool.
recipes.text: Nuts And Bolts. Melt butter and add seasonings. Mix cereal, nuts, etc. Pour butter mixture in shallow pan and bake at 250° for 1 hour. Stir up once. Store in covered container when cool.

recipes.title: Mushroom Rice
directions: Combine all ingredients in a 1 1/2-quart casserole.
Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 1 hour.
Yields 6 servings.
recipes.text: Mushroom Rice. Combine all ingredients in a 1 1/2-quart casserole. Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 1 hour. Yields 6 servings.

recipes.title: German Chocolate Upside-Down Cake
ingredients: 1 box German chocolate cake mix, mix according to instructions on box
directions: Sprinkle chopped pecans over bottom of pan.
Sprinkle coconut over the nuts.
Pour cake mix (after mixed according to instructions) over coconut and nuts in pan.
Mix together remaining ingredients and pour over cake mix.
Cook in sheet cake pan at 350° for 35 minutes.
recipes.text: German Chocolate Upside-Down Cake. Sprinkle chopped pecans over bottom of pan. Sprinkle coconut over the nuts. Pour cake mix (after mixed according to instructions) over coconut and nuts in pan. Mix together remaining ingredients and pour over cake mix. Cook in sheet cake pan at 350° for 35 minutes.

recipes.title: Summer Italian Pasta Salad
ingredients: 1 bottle Seven Seas Viva Italian dressing
directions: Cook pasta according to directions; drain and rinse with cold water.
Mix all ingredients in large bowl.
Refrigerate for several hours.
Serves 8 to 10.
recipes.text: Summer Italian Pasta Salad. Cook pasta according to directions; drain and rinse with cold water. Mix all ingredients in large bowl. Refrigerate for several hours. Serves 8 to 10.

recipes.title: Tater Tot Casserole
directions: Brown ground beef.
Stir in Lipton beefy mushroom soup mix and scant water and simmer for a few minutes.
Pour ground beef mixture in casserole dish.
Pour vegetables on meat.
Pour and spread cream of chicken soup.
Arrange Tater Tots on top and bake 1 hour at 350°.
recipes.text: Tater Tot Casserole. Brown ground beef. Stir in Lipton beefy mushroom soup mix and scant water and simmer for a few minutes. Pour ground beef mixture in casserole dish. Pour vegetables on meat. Pour and spread cream of chicken soup. Arrange Tater Tots on top and bake 1 hour at 350°.

recipes.title: No Bake Cocoa Puff Bars
directions: Mix butter, peanut butter, honey and chocolate chips in a saucepan.
Melt.
Add peanuts and Cocoa Puffs cereal.
Place in greased 9 x 13-inch pan.
Cut in squares.
recipes.text: No Bake Cocoa Puff Bars. Mix butter, peanut butter, honey and chocolate chips in a saucepan. Melt. Add peanuts and Cocoa Puffs cereal. Place in greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Cut in squares.

recipes.title: Ernie'S Banana Bread
directions: Preheat oven to 350°. Grease and flour 2 loaf pans. Cream butter and sugar together; add eggs and beat well. Add mashed bananas, flour, baking soda and nuts. Pour into pans and bake 45 to 50 minutes or until toothpick comes out clean when center is tested.
recipes.text: Ernie'S Banana Bread. Preheat oven to 350°. Grease and flour 2 loaf pans. Cream butter and sugar together; add eggs and beat well. Add mashed bananas, flour, baking soda and nuts. Pour into pans and bake 45 to 50 minutes or until toothpick comes out clean when center is tested.

recipes.title: Buttermilk Nut Candy(Like Pralines)
directions: Combine sugar, salt, soda and buttermilk in a heavy iron skillet. Cook over medium heat. Bring to a rolling boil, stirring often to prevent burning or boiling over. Remove from heat. Add butter, flavoring and nuts. Beat until creamy and thick. Drop on waxed paper lined pan.
recipes.text: Buttermilk Nut Candy(Like Pralines). Combine sugar, salt, soda and buttermilk in a heavy iron skillet. Cook over medium heat. Bring to a rolling boil, stirring often to prevent burning or boiling over. Remove from heat. Add butter, flavoring and nuts. Beat until creamy and thick. Drop on waxed paper lined pan.

recipes.title: Kathy'S Chocolate Chip Cookies
ingredients: 1 (6 serving size) pkg. instant vanilla pudding
directions: Cream shortening and sugars.
Add pudding mix, vanilla and eggs.
Beat well.
Stir in flour and soda, mixed.
Add chips. Bake on ungreased sheets for 8 to 10 minutes at 375°.
recipes.text: Kathy'S Chocolate Chip Cookies. Cream shortening and sugars. Add pudding mix, vanilla and eggs. Beat well. Stir in flour and soda, mixed. Add chips. Bake on ungreased sheets for 8 to 10 minutes at 375°.

recipes.title: Quick Caramel Popcorn
directions: Pour popcorn into brown paper grocery sack.
Bring to a boil the butter, sugar and Karo or honey; then add baking soda.
(It will puff up.)
Pour over popcorn; shake well.
Microwave for 1/2 minute; shake well.
Pour on wax paper.
Let cool and eat!
recipes.text: Quick Caramel Popcorn. Pour popcorn into brown paper grocery sack. Bring to a boil the butter, sugar and Karo or honey; then add baking soda. (It will puff up.) Pour over popcorn; shake well. Microwave for 1/2 minute; shake well. Pour on wax paper. Let cool and eat!

recipes.title: Cinnamon Toast Spread
directions: Cream all ingredients thoroughly and store in covered container in refrigerator.
Spread on hot toast, hot French toast or biscuits.
recipes.text: Cinnamon Toast Spread. Cream all ingredients thoroughly and store in covered container in refrigerator. Spread on hot toast, hot French toast or biscuits.

recipes.title: 8 Day Pickles
directions: Wash and cut up cucumbers.
Put in churn.
Mix salt in 1 gallon water and pour over cucumbers.
Let stand 3 days.
Drain off salt water.
Cover with alum water (1 tablespoon to 1 gallon water).
Let stand 1 day.
Drain and cover with ginger water (1 tablespoon ginger to 1 gallon water).
Let stand 1 day.
Drain and rinse cucumbers once and drain well.
Put back in churn.
Mix vinegar, sugar and pickling spice and bring to a boil.
Put over cucumbers.
Let stand 1 day.
Next day, put cucumbers in jars. Boil liquid and pour over pickles.
Seal and store.
recipes.text: 8 Day Pickles. Wash and cut up cucumbers. Put in churn. Mix salt in 1 gallon water and pour over cucumbers. Let stand 3 days. Drain off salt water. Cover with alum water (1 tablespoon to 1 gallon water). Let stand 1 day. Drain and cover with ginger water (1 tablespoon ginger to 1 gallon water). Let stand 1 day. Drain and rinse cucumbers once and drain well. Put back in churn. Mix vinegar, sugar and pickling spice and bring to a boil. Put over cucumbers. Let stand 1 day. Next day, put cucumbers in jars. Boil liquid and pour over pickles. Seal and store.

recipes.title: Choco-Cherry Nut Drops
ingredients: 1 c. (6 oz. pkg.) Nestle semi-sweet chocolate morsels
directions: Sift together Pillsbury's all-purpose flour, soda and salt. Cream butter.
Gradually add 1 cup firmly packed brown sugar and sugar, creaming well.
Blend in 1 unbeaten egg and vanilla; beat well.
Add in dry ingredients gradually, blending well.
Stir in chocolate morsels, chopped nuts and chopped cherries.
Drop by rounded teaspoon onto greased cookie sheets.
Bake at 375° for 10 to 12 minutes.
recipes.text: Choco-Cherry Nut Drops. Sift together Pillsbury's all-purpose flour, soda and salt. Cream butter. Gradually add 1 cup firmly packed brown sugar and sugar, creaming well. Blend in 1 unbeaten egg and vanilla; beat well. Add in dry ingredients gradually, blending well. Stir in chocolate morsels, chopped nuts and chopped cherries. Drop by rounded teaspoon onto greased cookie sheets. Bake at 375° for 10 to 12 minutes.

recipes.title: Lima And Ham Salad
ingredients: 1 (16 oz.) pkg. frozen lima or baby beans, cooked and drained
3/4 lb. tiny new potatoes, cooked and sliced
2 c. snow peas or sugar snap peas, cut into 1-inch pieces
directions: Combine dressing, beans, potatoes, ham, celery, green onion, parsley and chives in a large salad bowl.
Cover; refrigerate for 2 hours or overnight.
Before serving, stir in snow peas or sugar snap peas.
To serve, if desired, place halved tomato slices on a platter.
Top the salad mixture, or mound portions of salad on individual lettuce lined plates.
Makes 6 servings.
recipes.text: Lima And Ham Salad. Combine dressing, beans, potatoes, ham, celery, green onion, parsley and chives in a large salad bowl. Cover; refrigerate for 2 hours or overnight. Before serving, stir in snow peas or sugar snap peas. To serve, if desired, place halved tomato slices on a platter. Top the salad mixture, or mound portions of salad on individual lettuce lined plates. Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Spaghetti Sauce
directions: Brown beef, bell pepper and onions.
Drain.
Add remaining ingredients.
Mix well and let simmer 1 hour.
recipes.text: Spaghetti Sauce. Brown beef, bell pepper and onions. Drain. Add remaining ingredients. Mix well and let simmer 1 hour.

recipes.title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
directions: Heat oven to 375°.
Oil cookie sheets well.
Combine flour, baking soda and salt; set aside.
Combine egg, water and vanilla; set aside.
Blend brown sugar and oil in large bowl at low speed of electric mixer.
Add egg mixture; beat until smooth.
Add flour mixture in 3 parts at lowest speed.
Scrape bowl well after each addition.
Stir in chocolate chips.
Drop dough by rounded teaspoonfuls onto cookie sheets.
Bake at 375° for 7 to 8 minutes, or until lightly browned.
Cool on cookie sheets for 1 minute. Remove to wire racks.
Each cookie contains 74 calories and 3 grams fat.
recipes.text: Chocolate Chip Cookies. Heat oven to 375°. Oil cookie sheets well. Combine flour, baking soda and salt; set aside. Combine egg, water and vanilla; set aside. Blend brown sugar and oil in large bowl at low speed of electric mixer. Add egg mixture; beat until smooth. Add flour mixture in 3 parts at lowest speed. Scrape bowl well after each addition. Stir in chocolate chips. Drop dough by rounded teaspoonfuls onto cookie sheets. Bake at 375° for 7 to 8 minutes, or until lightly browned. Cool on cookie sheets for 1 minute. Remove to wire racks. Each cookie contains 74 calories and 3 grams fat.

recipes.title: Microwave Shrimp Creole
ingredients: 1 can Ro-Tel tomatoes and chilies, chopped
13 3/4 oz. can chicken or beef broth
directions: Saute first 6 ingredients in a 3-quart dish on High for 20 minutes or	until
wilted.	Stir
in
flour.
Add tomatoes, sauce and broth.	Cook
on
High	for 10 minutes.
Add shrimp. Cover and cook on
High 6 minutes or until shrimp are pink and tender.
Stir once or twice.
Let stand 5 minutes.
recipes.text: Microwave Shrimp Creole. Saute first 6 ingredients in a 3-quart dish on High for 20 minutes or	until wilted.	Stir in flour. Add tomatoes, sauce and broth.	Cook on High	for 10 minutes. Add shrimp. Cover and cook on High 6 minutes or until shrimp are pink and tender. Stir once or twice. Let stand 5 minutes.

recipes.title: Warm Okra Salad
directions: Cook okra until tender, then add all ingredients and simmer. Let stand.
Cook rest of meat, then warm in microwave.
recipes.text: Warm Okra Salad. Cook okra until tender, then add all ingredients and simmer. Let stand. Cook rest of meat, then warm in microwave.

recipes.title: Barbecued Sauce For Chicken
ingredients: little garlic, salt and pepper to taste
directions: Bring to boil and pour over fried chicken. Bake in oven for 30 minutes at 350° (covered).
recipes.text: Barbecued Sauce For Chicken. Bring to boil and pour over fried chicken. Bake in oven for 30 minutes at 350° (covered).

recipes.title: Cheese Biscuits
directions: Mix Rice Krispies and flour well.
Add grated cheese and margarine.
Mix well.
Drop by teaspoonfuls on cookie sheet. Flatten with hand or fork.
Bake at 350° for 15 minutes.
Turn oven off and leave them in oven until cool.
This make them crispier.
recipes.text: Cheese Biscuits. Mix Rice Krispies and flour well. Add grated cheese and margarine. Mix well. Drop by teaspoonfuls on cookie sheet. Flatten with hand or fork. Bake at 350° for 15 minutes. Turn oven off and leave them in oven until cool. This make them crispier.

recipes.title: Lime Delight Salad
ingredients: 1/2 (12 oz.) carton small curd cottage cheese
1/2 pt. whipping cream, whipped with sugar and vanilla
directions: Boil pineapple 3 minutes.
Add jello and boil 2 minutes longer.
Let cool.
Add cottage cheese, chopped pecans and whipping cream.
Chill and serve.
recipes.text: Lime Delight Salad. Boil pineapple 3 minutes. Add jello and boil 2 minutes longer. Let cool. Add cottage cheese, chopped pecans and whipping cream. Chill and serve.

recipes.title: Green Pepper Jelly
directions: Seed peppers and chop coarsely.
Place 1/2 pepper and 3/4 cup vinegar in food processor on high until smooth.
Repeat with rest of peppers and vinegar.
Combine pureed peppers, red pepper, sugar and salt in large Dutch oven; bring to a boil.
Add pectin.
Cook, stirring often, for 30 minutes or until mixture sheets from a metal spoon.
Quickly pour into sterilized jars with 1/2-inch headspace.
Cover at once with 1/8-inch paraffin.
Cover with metal lids.
recipes.text: Green Pepper Jelly. Seed peppers and chop coarsely. Place 1/2 pepper and 3/4 cup vinegar in food processor on high until smooth. Repeat with rest of peppers and vinegar. Combine pureed peppers, red pepper, sugar and salt in large Dutch oven; bring to a boil. Add pectin. Cook, stirring often, for 30 minutes or until mixture sheets from a metal spoon. Quickly pour into sterilized jars with 1/2-inch headspace. Cover at once with 1/8-inch paraffin. Cover with metal lids.

recipes.title: Red Hot Vegetarian Chili
ingredients: 1 (35 oz.) can Italian plum tomatoes, chopped
grated cheese or sour cream (for garnish)
directions: Saute the onion, zucchini, garlic and red peppers.
Add spices, tomatoes and parsley.
Cook for 30 minutes.
Add kidney beans and dill.
Cook an additional 15 minutes.
Salt to taste. Serve in bowls topped with grated cheese or sour cream.
recipes.text: Red Hot Vegetarian Chili. Saute the onion, zucchini, garlic and red peppers. Add spices, tomatoes and parsley. Cook for 30 minutes. Add kidney beans and dill. Cook an additional 15 minutes. Salt to taste. Serve in bowls topped with grated cheese or sour cream.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Pie
directions: Mix peanut butter and sugar.
Sprinkle 3/4 of crumbs in bottom of pie shell.
Pour in cooked vanilla pudding.
When cold, spread with Cool Whip.
Sprinkle with remaining crumbs.
recipes.text: Peanut Butter Pie. Mix peanut butter and sugar. Sprinkle 3/4 of crumbs in bottom of pie shell. Pour in cooked vanilla pudding. When cold, spread with Cool Whip. Sprinkle with remaining crumbs.

recipes.title: Hot Buttered Rum
directions: Add water to spices in a saucepan, stirring 2 minutes. Add butter and melt. Add brown sugar and vanilla. Stir 2 minutes. Remove from heat. Use 2 tablespoons butter batter (more or less to taste). Add 1 jigger rum and stir. Fill mug with boiling water and stir. Store remainder of butter batter in refrigerator.
recipes.text: Hot Buttered Rum. Add water to spices in a saucepan, stirring 2 minutes. Add butter and melt. Add brown sugar and vanilla. Stir 2 minutes. Remove from heat. Use 2 tablespoons butter batter (more or less to taste). Add 1 jigger rum and stir. Fill mug with boiling water and stir. Store remainder of butter batter in refrigerator.

recipes.title: Vegetable Canapes
ingredients: thinly sliced vegetables: squash, cucumber, radish
directions: Beat cream cheese until fluffy.
Stir in next 4 ingredients. Cut 2 (1 3/4-inch) rounds from each bread slice.
Spread with 1 teaspoon cream cheese mix, top with vegetables as desired.
Makes 32 canapes.
recipes.text: Vegetable Canapes. Beat cream cheese until fluffy. Stir in next 4 ingredients. Cut 2 (1 3/4-inch) rounds from each bread slice. Spread with 1 teaspoon cream cheese mix, top with vegetables as desired. Makes 32 canapes.

recipes.title: Quick Lasagna
directions: Brown ground meat and drain.
Mix meat and spaghetti sauce together.
In a 11 x 14-inch pan, layer ingredients starting with spaghetti sauce mixture, then noodles (uncooked), cottage cheese, Mozzarella and then Parmesan cheese.
Continue to layer.
Save 1 cup of sauce.
Cover and bake for 90 minutes at 350°.
Check after 30 minutes.
If dry, add sauce.
If not, save sauce and serve as a dipping sauce for French bread.
recipes.text: Quick Lasagna. Brown ground meat and drain. Mix meat and spaghetti sauce together. In a 11 x 14-inch pan, layer ingredients starting with spaghetti sauce mixture, then noodles (uncooked), cottage cheese, Mozzarella and then Parmesan cheese. Continue to layer. Save 1 cup of sauce. Cover and bake for 90 minutes at 350°. Check after 30 minutes. If dry, add sauce. If not, save sauce and serve as a dipping sauce for French bread.

recipes.title: Watergate Cake
directions: Mix all ingredients together.
Pour into greased and floured Bundt pan and bake 45 minutes at 350°.
recipes.text: Watergate Cake. Mix all ingredients together. Pour into greased and floured Bundt pan and bake 45 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Fresh Berry Fruit Dip
directions: Mix marshmallow cream and cream cheese; mix until well blended.
Add flavoring and 1/2 cup pureed strawberries.
Mix again.
Garnish dip with halved strawberries and toothpicks.
recipes.text: Fresh Berry Fruit Dip. Mix marshmallow cream and cream cheese; mix until well blended. Add flavoring and 1/2 cup pureed strawberries. Mix again. Garnish dip with halved strawberries and toothpicks.

recipes.title: Crock Pot Chicken Or Steak
directions: Mix ingredients well in crock pot. Add chicken or steak. Start on high heat then turn down to low and let simmer for 2 or 3 hours. Do not salt.
recipes.text: Crock Pot Chicken Or Steak. Mix ingredients well in crock pot. Add chicken or steak. Start on high heat then turn down to low and let simmer for 2 or 3 hours. Do not salt.

recipes.title: Liver - N - Onions
directions: Wash liver.
Heat large skillet and oil.
Flour liver.
Cook very slow.
Take liver out.
Pour in onions.
Cook.
Pour in 1/2 cup water.
Add liver.
Cover.
Cook about 10 minutes.
Serve with rice or mashed potatoes.
recipes.text: Liver - N - Onions. Wash liver. Heat large skillet and oil. Flour liver. Cook very slow. Take liver out. Pour in onions. Cook. Pour in 1/2 cup water. Add liver. Cover. Cook about 10 minutes. Serve with rice or mashed potatoes.

recipes.title: Five Day Coconut Cake
directions: Mix together coconut, 16 ounce sour cream, 2 cups sugar and
1 teaspoon
vanilla.
Place	in
refrigerator overnight. Next day, cream
butter
and	3 cups sugar until fluffy.
Add eggs, one
at a time, beating well after each egg.
Stir soda into 1/2 pint of sour cream; add to eggs and sugar alternately with flour.
Add vanilla and blend thoroughly.
recipes.text: Five Day Coconut Cake. Mix together coconut, 16 ounce sour cream, 2 cups sugar and 1 teaspoon vanilla. Place	in refrigerator overnight. Next day, cream butter and	3 cups sugar until fluffy. Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each egg. Stir soda into 1/2 pint of sour cream; add to eggs and sugar alternately with flour. Add vanilla and blend thoroughly.

recipes.title: Refrigerator Crescent Rolls
directions: In a large bowl, combine 1 1/2 c. flour, sugar, undissolved yeast and salt.
recipes.text: Refrigerator Crescent Rolls. In a large bowl, combine 1 1/2 c. flour, sugar, undissolved yeast and salt.

recipes.title: Applesauce Cake
directions: Sift a few tablespoons of the flour over nuts and raisins. Cream butter and sugar.
Beat in egg.
Add nut meats and raisins. Sift together flour, soda and spices.
Stir into butter mixture. Last, add the applesauce which has been heated.
Bake cake in a 9-inch tube pan lined with buttered paper, in a moderate 350° oven for about 1 hour.
recipes.text: Applesauce Cake. Sift a few tablespoons of the flour over nuts and raisins. Cream butter and sugar. Beat in egg. Add nut meats and raisins. Sift together flour, soda and spices. Stir into butter mixture. Last, add the applesauce which has been heated. Bake cake in a 9-inch tube pan lined with buttered paper, in a moderate 350° oven for about 1 hour.

recipes.title: Dill Dip
ingredients: 1 pkg. Good Seasons Italian dry dressing mix
directions: Mix all ingredients together except bread.
Hollow one loaf of bread and shape into bowl.
Cut into small pieces what is removed. Put dip in "bowl."
Eat bread "bowl" when dip is gone.
recipes.text: Dill Dip. Mix all ingredients together except bread. Hollow one loaf of bread and shape into bowl. Cut into small pieces what is removed. Put dip in "bowl." Eat bread "bowl" when dip is gone.

recipes.title: Soft Pretzels
ingredients: 1 loaf frozen white bread dough, thawed
1 egg white, beaten with 1 tsp. water
3 Tbsp. coarse salt and/or caraway seed
directions: Cover dough; let rise in warm, draft-free place until doubled. Divide in 12 pieces.
With lightly floured hands, roll each piece into a 16-inch rope.
Form in pretzel shape.
In a large skillet, bring 2 inches of water to a boil.
Slip pretzels, a few at a time, into gently boiling water.
Cook until pretzels rise to the surface, about 45 seconds.
Remove with slotted spoon; drain on paper towels.
Brush lightly with egg-white mixture.
Sprinkle with salt and/or caraway seed.
Do not let pretzels rise.
Bake immediately in preheated 400° oven for 15 to 20 minutes until browned.
recipes.text: Soft Pretzels. Cover dough; let rise in warm, draft-free place until doubled. Divide in 12 pieces. With lightly floured hands, roll each piece into a 16-inch rope. Form in pretzel shape. In a large skillet, bring 2 inches of water to a boil. Slip pretzels, a few at a time, into gently boiling water. Cook until pretzels rise to the surface, about 45 seconds. Remove with slotted spoon; drain on paper towels. Brush lightly with egg-white mixture. Sprinkle with salt and/or caraway seed. Do not let pretzels rise. Bake immediately in preheated 400° oven for 15 to 20 minutes until browned.

recipes.title: Ice Cream Crunch
directions: Blend the first five ingredients.
Spread in 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 400° for 15 minutes.
Stir frequently.
Cool completely. Put aside half of crumb mixture.
recipes.text: Ice Cream Crunch. Blend the first five ingredients. Spread in 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 400° for 15 minutes. Stir frequently. Cool completely. Put aside half of crumb mixture.

recipes.title: Wellesley Fudge Cake
ingredients: 1/2 c. cocoa and 1/3 c. hot water, mixed
directions: Cream shortening and sugar; add eggs. Add dry ingredients alternating with sour milk. Blend in cocoa mixture. Grease and flour two 8-inch cake pans. Divide cake mix in each pan. Bake in 350° oven for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Wellesley Fudge Cake. Cream shortening and sugar; add eggs. Add dry ingredients alternating with sour milk. Blend in cocoa mixture. Grease and flour two 8-inch cake pans. Divide cake mix in each pan. Bake in 350° oven for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Roll
directions: Bake at
for 20 minutes.	Grease cookie sheet and lay in wax paper.
Mix eggs, sugar, pumpkin, flour, spice and nuts in a bowl.
Stir
and pour in pan and bake.
Place a tea towel on counter
top

When
pumpkin
bread is done, place on towel and roll
up while
it's
very warm.

Unroll. Spread cream cheese filling and roll up again. Slice and enjoy.
recipes.text: Pumpkin Roll. Bake at 375° for 20 minutes.	Grease cookie sheet and lay in wax paper. Mix eggs, sugar, pumpkin, flour, spice and nuts in a bowl. Stir and pour in pan and bake. Place a tea towel on counter top and sift powdered sugar on towel until its very white. When pumpkin bread is done, place on towel and roll up while it's very warm. Let set. Roll up until cold. Unroll. Spread cream cheese filling and roll up again. Slice and enjoy.

recipes.title: Butterscotch Fudge
directions: Mix pie mix, sugar and milk until smooth.
Place over medium-low heat.
Stir frequently for 10 minutes.
Lower heat and cook 10 more minutes.
Stir constantly until mixture forms a soft ball when dropped in cold water.
Remove from heat and add 2 tablespoons butter. Beat with electric mixer for 10 minutes, starting on low and gradually increasing to high speed. Stir in chopped pecans.
Pour at once into buttered 8-inch square pan and cut into squares. Yields 2 dozen squares.
recipes.text: Butterscotch Fudge. Mix pie mix, sugar and milk until smooth. Place over medium-low heat. Stir frequently for 10 minutes. Lower heat and cook 10 more minutes. Stir constantly until mixture forms a soft ball when dropped in cold water. Remove from heat and add 2 tablespoons butter. Beat with electric mixer for 10 minutes, starting on low and gradually increasing to high speed. Stir in chopped pecans. Pour at once into buttered 8-inch square pan and cut into squares. Yields 2 dozen squares.

recipes.title: Chocolate Sheet Cake
directions: Mix flour, sugar and salt.
In a saucepan or microwave, melt butter, cocoa and water.
Stir.
Pour and mix with flour mixture. Mix remaining ingredients and then add.
Bake at 400° for 20 minutes in a 15 x 12 x 1-inch pan or at 350° for 30 minutes in a 13 1/2 x 9-inch pan.
recipes.text: Chocolate Sheet Cake. Mix flour, sugar and salt. In a saucepan or microwave, melt butter, cocoa and water. Stir. Pour and mix with flour mixture. Mix remaining ingredients and then add. Bake at 400° for 20 minutes in a 15 x 12 x 1-inch pan or at 350° for 30 minutes in a 13 1/2 x 9-inch pan.

recipes.title: 3 Bean Casserole
directions: Combine first 6 ingredients.
Cook and season; drain.
Mix last 6 ingredients well.
Alternate sauce with layer of vegetables.
End with sauce on top.
Bake at 350° until sauce bubbles.
Cover with cracker crumbs and brown.
recipes.text: 3 Bean Casserole. Combine first 6 ingredients. Cook and season; drain. Mix last 6 ingredients well. Alternate sauce with layer of vegetables. End with sauce on top. Bake at 350° until sauce bubbles. Cover with cracker crumbs and brown.

recipes.title: Make Ahead Punch
directions: Mix first five ingredients and freeze.
Twenty-four hours before needed, place in refrigerator and let it thaw until slushy. To serve pour into punch bowl with Sprite.
recipes.text: Make Ahead Punch. Mix first five ingredients and freeze. Twenty-four hours before needed, place in refrigerator and let it thaw until slushy. To serve pour into punch bowl with Sprite.

recipes.title: Tony'S Egg Sandwich
directions: In a small bowl, add small amount butter and then add egg. Beat and place in microwave for 1 1/2 minutes.
You may need to turn over halfway through cooking.
Place on bread and add cheese, if desired.
recipes.text: Tony'S Egg Sandwich. In a small bowl, add small amount butter and then add egg. Beat and place in microwave for 1 1/2 minutes. You may need to turn over halfway through cooking. Place on bread and add cheese, if desired.

recipes.title: Mexican Chicken
directions: Boil chicken, peel off skin.
Remove from bone.
Mix soup, tomatoes, bell pepper, onion, garlic powder, chili powder and 1/2 cup of cheese.
Mix well.
Grease large Pyrex pan, line bottom with Doritos and then place chicken on top of Doritos.
Pour mixed ingredients over chicken.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
Remove and pour remaining Doritos and cheese over top.
Put in oven until cheese melts.
recipes.text: Mexican Chicken. Boil chicken, peel off skin. Remove from bone. Mix soup, tomatoes, bell pepper, onion, garlic powder, chili powder and 1/2 cup of cheese. Mix well. Grease large Pyrex pan, line bottom with Doritos and then place chicken on top of Doritos. Pour mixed ingredients over chicken. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes. Remove and pour remaining Doritos and cheese over top. Put in oven until cheese melts.

recipes.title: Excellent Molasses Cookies
directions: Bake 11 minutes at 350°.
Roll in white sugar just before baking.
Chilled dough works best.
YUMMMMMM....
recipes.text: Excellent Molasses Cookies. Bake 11 minutes at 350°. Roll in white sugar just before baking. Chilled dough works best. YUMMMMMM....

recipes.title: Sweet-Sour Beef Vegetables For Slow Cooker
ingredients: 2 lb. round or chuck steak, cut into 1-inch cubes
1 large green pepper, cut into 1-inch cubes
directions: Brown meat in hot oil in skillet.
Place in cooker; add remaining ingredients and mix well.
Cook 6 to 7 hours on low or 4 hours on high.
recipes.text: Sweet-Sour Beef Vegetables For Slow Cooker. Brown meat in hot oil in skillet. Place in cooker; add remaining ingredients and mix well. Cook 6 to 7 hours on low or 4 hours on high.

recipes.title: Fatless Potato Salad
ingredients: 1/2 c. nonfat plain yogurt (allow liquid to drain away)
directions: Mix together in medium-small bowl.
A tiny glug of Italian or other oil based dressing adds flavor.
Serves 1.
recipes.text: Fatless Potato Salad. Mix together in medium-small bowl. A tiny glug of Italian or other oil based dressing adds flavor. Serves 1.

recipes.title: Mexican Beef Dip
directions: Melt Velveeta cheese in double boiler until melted.
Brown ground beef and diced onion in skillet and drain excess fat.
Add ground beef, onion and Ro-Tel to melted cheese; reduce heat and simmer for 15 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Serve with your favorite chips.
recipes.text: Mexican Beef Dip. Melt Velveeta cheese in double boiler until melted. Brown ground beef and diced onion in skillet and drain excess fat. Add ground beef, onion and Ro-Tel to melted cheese; reduce heat and simmer for 15 minutes, stirring occasionally. Serve with your favorite chips.

recipes.title: Hummingbird Cake
directions: Mix all ingredients together and bake in two 8 to 9-inch round pans or a 9 x 13-inch loaf pan that has been greased and floured. Bake in 350° to 375° oven for 25 minutes (or longer if necessary). Cool and spread with icing.
recipes.text: Hummingbird Cake. Mix all ingredients together and bake in two 8 to 9-inch round pans or a 9 x 13-inch loaf pan that has been greased and floured. Bake in 350° to 375° oven for 25 minutes (or longer if necessary). Cool and spread with icing.

recipes.title: Oatmeal Pie
directions: Combine all ingredients.
Pour into 9-inch unbaked pie shell. Bake 30 minutes at 350°, or until inserted knife comes out clean.
recipes.text: Oatmeal Pie. Combine all ingredients. Pour into 9-inch unbaked pie shell. Bake 30 minutes at 350°, or until inserted knife comes out clean.

recipes.title: Two Minute Microwave Fudge
directions: Combine all ingredients in a 3-quart mixing bowl.
Microwave on High for 2 minutes.
Stir until well blended.
Pour into a buttered 8-inch baking dish.
Cover and refrigerate until set. Cut in 1-inch squares.
Makes 64 pieces.
recipes.text: Two Minute Microwave Fudge. Combine all ingredients in a 3-quart mixing bowl. Microwave on High for 2 minutes. Stir until well blended. Pour into a buttered 8-inch baking dish. Cover and refrigerate until set. Cut in 1-inch squares. Makes 64 pieces.

recipes.title: Meat Loaf
directions: Heat oven to 350°.
Tear bread in pieces into a large mixing bowl; add remaining ingredients and mix thoroughly.
Form lightly into loaf and place in shallow baking pan.
Spread 3 tablespoons catsup over top of loaf before baking.
Bake 1 1/2 hours.
recipes.text: Meat Loaf. Heat oven to 350°. Tear bread in pieces into a large mixing bowl; add remaining ingredients and mix thoroughly. Form lightly into loaf and place in shallow baking pan. Spread 3 tablespoons catsup over top of loaf before baking. Bake 1 1/2 hours.

recipes.title: Yum Yum Cake
directions: Mix together cake mix, margarine and 1 egg.
Press in bottom of long pan.
Mix together cream cheese, 2 eggs and powdered sugar.
Spread over top of cake mixture.
Bake at 300° for about 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Yum Yum Cake. Mix together cake mix, margarine and 1 egg. Press in bottom of long pan. Mix together cream cheese, 2 eggs and powdered sugar. Spread over top of cake mixture. Bake at 300° for about 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Mexican Casserole
directions: Brown and drain hamburger.
Mix chilies, soup, hamburger, cheese and chips in casserole.
Bake approximately 30 minutes at 350°.
recipes.text: Mexican Casserole. Brown and drain hamburger. Mix chilies, soup, hamburger, cheese and chips in casserole. Bake approximately 30 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Cucumber-Onion Salad(4 To 6 Servings)
directions: Place cucumber and onion slices in salad bowl.
Combine salad oil, vinegar, sugar and pepper.
Pour over cucumber and onion; marinate 1 to 2 hours.
recipes.text: Cucumber-Onion Salad(4 To 6 Servings). Place cucumber and onion slices in salad bowl. Combine salad oil, vinegar, sugar and pepper. Pour over cucumber and onion; marinate 1 to 2 hours.

recipes.title: Broccoli-Cauliflower Salad
directions: Chop the broccoli, cauliflower and onion. Toss well.
Mix the salt, sugar, vinegar and mayonnaise. Pour over vegetables. Cover and refrigerate overnight.
recipes.text: Broccoli-Cauliflower Salad. Chop the broccoli, cauliflower and onion. Toss well. Mix the salt, sugar, vinegar and mayonnaise. Pour over vegetables. Cover and refrigerate overnight.

recipes.title: Broccoli And Cauliflower Salad
directions: Cut vegetables into small pieces.
recipes.text: Broccoli And Cauliflower Salad. Cut vegetables into small pieces.

recipes.title: Southern Apple Pie
directions: Place apples in pie shell.
Mix flour, sugar and cinnamon. Sprinkle over apples.
Make crumb mixture of other ingredients. Sprinkle over apples.
Bake 20 minutes at 450°.
Bake 30 to 40 minutes at 350°.
Serve with ice cream.
recipes.text: Southern Apple Pie. Place apples in pie shell. Mix flour, sugar and cinnamon. Sprinkle over apples. Make crumb mixture of other ingredients. Sprinkle over apples. Bake 20 minutes at 450°. Bake 30 to 40 minutes at 350°. Serve with ice cream.

recipes.title: Cauliflower Salad
directions: Mix all with Miracle Whip (enough to mix together).
recipes.text: Cauliflower Salad. Mix all with Miracle Whip (enough to mix together).

recipes.title: Papas Chorreadas
ingredients: 4 medium size potatoes, cooked with the skin on in salt water
1 Tbsp. wheat flour, dissolved in 3 Tbsp. milk
directions: Saute onion in butter and oil.
When transparent, add tomatoes, salt and pepper.
Let season a few minutes, then add the flour dissolved in the milk, stirring well until it begins to thicken. Pour this sauce over the cooked potatoes, cutting a cross on top of them.
Pour the cheese, the cilantro and the green onions on top while still hot.
MMMMM!!
recipes.text: Papas Chorreadas. Saute onion in butter and oil. When transparent, add tomatoes, salt and pepper. Let season a few minutes, then add the flour dissolved in the milk, stirring well until it begins to thicken. Pour this sauce over the cooked potatoes, cutting a cross on top of them. Pour the cheese, the cilantro and the green onions on top while still hot. MMMMM!!

recipes.title: Olive Cheese Ball
ingredients: 2/3 c. olives, well drained and chopped
directions: Blend cream cheese, Blue cheese and butter, then stir in chives and olives.
Chill slightly.
Form into a ball.
Chill well.
Press walnuts over outside of ball.
Serve surrounded with assorted crackers.
Makes 3 cups.
recipes.text: Olive Cheese Ball. Blend cream cheese, Blue cheese and butter, then stir in chives and olives. Chill slightly. Form into a ball. Chill well. Press walnuts over outside of ball. Serve surrounded with assorted crackers. Makes 3 cups.

recipes.title: Snicker Pie
ingredients: 1/2 of 1/2 gallon Vanilla Fat Free Ice Cream or Yogurt
1 sm. pkg. Fat Free Sugar Free Chocolate Pudding
1/4 c. creamy or crunchy Peanut Butter
1/2 container Lite or Fat Free Cool Whip
directions: Soften ice cream to stirring stage.
Mix with pudding and peanut butter. Fold in cool whip.
Pour into crust and freeze. Let sit out 10 minutes before serving.
recipes.text: Snicker Pie. Soften ice cream to stirring stage. Mix with pudding and peanut butter. Fold in cool whip. Pour into crust and freeze. Let sit out 10 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Baked Spaghetti
directions: Cook spaghetti and drain, then add eggs, Parmesan cheese, salt and pepper and garlic salt. Spread in bottom of 13 x 9 pan. Sprinkle half of Mozzarella cheese over top. Spread cottage cheese over this.
recipes.text: Baked Spaghetti. Cook spaghetti and drain, then add eggs, Parmesan cheese, salt and pepper and garlic salt. Spread in bottom of 13 x 9 pan. Sprinkle half of Mozzarella cheese over top. Spread cottage cheese over this.

recipes.title: Fudge Topping
directions: In a 2-quart saucepan, combine cocoa and milk over heat.
Add stick of oleo and vanilla.
When it starts to bubble take off fire and add powdered sugar and pecans.
Pour while hot over hot cake. Work fast because topping gets hard quickly.
recipes.text: Fudge Topping. In a 2-quart saucepan, combine cocoa and milk over heat. Add stick of oleo and vanilla. When it starts to bubble take off fire and add powdered sugar and pecans. Pour while hot over hot cake. Work fast because topping gets hard quickly.

recipes.title: Fudge Pie
directions: Melt butter in medium saucepan; remove from heat.
Add cocoa, sugar, eggs, flour, salt and vanilla.
Beat well.
Pour into a well-greased 9-inch pie pan.
Bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes. Cool.
Serve plain or topped with whipped cream or ice cream, if desired.
If served warm, spoon into compotes.
If chilled, cut as pie wedges.
Yields 6 servings.
recipes.text: Fudge Pie. Melt butter in medium saucepan; remove from heat. Add cocoa, sugar, eggs, flour, salt and vanilla. Beat well. Pour into a well-greased 9-inch pie pan. Bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes. Cool. Serve plain or topped with whipped cream or ice cream, if desired. If served warm, spoon into compotes. If chilled, cut as pie wedges. Yields 6 servings.

recipes.title: Play Dough
ingredients: food coloring (for good color, use generous amount)
directions: Boil salt and water together.
Add food coloring.
After salt dissolves, remove from heat and add salad oil, powdered alum and flour.
Mix thoroughly, then knead while still warm, until color is evenly distributed and lumps are gone.
Store in airtight container or plastic bag tightly closed.
recipes.text: Play Dough. Boil salt and water together. Add food coloring. After salt dissolves, remove from heat and add salad oil, powdered alum and flour. Mix thoroughly, then knead while still warm, until color is evenly distributed and lumps are gone. Store in airtight container or plastic bag tightly closed.

recipes.title: Shrimp Salad
directions: Dress shrimp.
Cut in bite size pieces.
Season to taste.
Add eggs, celery and lettuce.
Season.
Mix gently.
Add onion and desired amount of mayonnaise.
recipes.text: Shrimp Salad. Dress shrimp. Cut in bite size pieces. Season to taste. Add eggs, celery and lettuce. Season. Mix gently. Add onion and desired amount of mayonnaise.

recipes.title: 1-2-3-4 Pound Cake
directions: Cream butter and sugar; add eggs, one at a time.
Beat well after each addition.
Add vanilla.
Add the soda to the buttermilk and let rise a bit.
Add this alternately with flour and salt. Beat well.
Grease and flour 1 tube pan; bake at 325° until lightly browned or done, about 1 hour and 15 minutes.
recipes.text: 1-2-3-4 Pound Cake. Cream butter and sugar; add eggs, one at a time. Beat well after each addition. Add vanilla. Add the soda to the buttermilk and let rise a bit. Add this alternately with flour and salt. Beat well. Grease and flour 1 tube pan; bake at 325° until lightly browned or done, about 1 hour and 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Oven-Scrambled Eggs
directions: Melt butter in 9 x 13-inch pan in 350° oven.
Beat eggs slightly.
Add salt and scalded milk; mix.
Pour into melted butter and bake 15 minutes.
Stir; bake approximately another 15 minutes.
Serves 6 people.
recipes.text: Oven-Scrambled Eggs. Melt butter in 9 x 13-inch pan in 350° oven. Beat eggs slightly. Add salt and scalded milk; mix. Pour into melted butter and bake 15 minutes. Stir; bake approximately another 15 minutes. Serves 6 people.

recipes.title: Kool-Aid Punch
directions: Mix all ingredients except ginger ale and freeze.
When ready to use, let thaw to a thin ice or slush, place in punch bowl and add ginger ale.
recipes.text: Kool-Aid Punch. Mix all ingredients except ginger ale and freeze. When ready to use, let thaw to a thin ice or slush, place in punch bowl and add ginger ale.

recipes.title: Hickory Country Ribs
directions: Combine all ingredients except ribs; mix well.
Place ribs in a shallow dish.
Cover with marinade and refrigerate for 24 hours, turning meat occasionally.
Place several presoaked hickory chips on hot coals.
Remove ribs from marinade and place approximately 6 inches above coals.
Close hood of grill.
Cook over low heat, brushing occasionally with marinade.
Serves 6.
recipes.text: Hickory Country Ribs. Combine all ingredients except ribs; mix well. Place ribs in a shallow dish. Cover with marinade and refrigerate for 24 hours, turning meat occasionally. Place several presoaked hickory chips on hot coals. Remove ribs from marinade and place approximately 6 inches above coals. Close hood of grill. Cook over low heat, brushing occasionally with marinade. Serves 6.

recipes.title: Vidalia Onion Dip
directions: Mix all ingredients. Pour into an ungreased baking dish. Bake at 350° until browning on top, approximately 30 to 40 minutes. Serve with your favorite small cracker.
recipes.text: Vidalia Onion Dip. Mix all ingredients. Pour into an ungreased baking dish. Bake at 350° until browning on top, approximately 30 to 40 minutes. Serve with your favorite small cracker.

recipes.title: *Custard Pita(Pita Di Lapti)
ingredients: 1 c. fine noodles, cooked and drained
directions: Grease a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Place cooked noodles in pan covering bottom of pan.
Beat eggs and add balance of ingredients. Slowly pour into pan over noodles which should not float.
Place in preheated 400° oven. Bake 1 hour.
recipes.text: *Custard Pita(Pita Di Lapti). Grease a 9 x 13-inch pan. Place cooked noodles in pan covering bottom of pan. Beat eggs and add balance of ingredients. Slowly pour into pan over noodles which should not float. Place in preheated 400° oven. Bake 1 hour.

recipes.title: Oatmeal Spice Cake
directions: Mix well.
Pour into greased and floured 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes.
Frost or eat plain.
recipes.text: Oatmeal Spice Cake. Mix well. Pour into greased and floured 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes. Frost or eat plain.

recipes.title: American Moussaka
ingredients: 1 pkg. Hamburger Helper mix (for potato stroganoff)
directions: Heat oven to 375°.
Cook and stir ground beef and onion in 10-inch skillet until beef is light brown; drain.
Stir in tomato sauce, salt, oregano, cinnamon and garlic powder.
Grease baking dish 11 3/4 x 7 1/2 x 1 3/4-inch.
Layer half each of the potatoes, beef mixture and cheese in dish; repeat.
Mix sauce mix, milk and water; stir in eggs gradually.
Pour milk-egg mixture over cheese and sprinkle with paprika.
Cover and bake 50 minutes.
Uncover and bake 10 minutes.
Let stand 10 minutes before serving.
Makes about 6 servings.
recipes.text: American Moussaka. Heat oven to 375°. Cook and stir ground beef and onion in 10-inch skillet until beef is light brown; drain. Stir in tomato sauce, salt, oregano, cinnamon and garlic powder. Grease baking dish 11 3/4 x 7 1/2 x 1 3/4-inch. Layer half each of the potatoes, beef mixture and cheese in dish; repeat. Mix sauce mix, milk and water; stir in eggs gradually. Pour milk-egg mixture over cheese and sprinkle with paprika. Cover and bake 50 minutes. Uncover and bake 10 minutes. Let stand 10 minutes before serving. Makes about 6 servings.

recipes.title: Fresh Vegetable Pizza
directions: Press out cans of dinner rolls on ungreased jelly roll pan. Bake until golden brown.
Top with sour cream dip and fresh vegetables.
recipes.text: Fresh Vegetable Pizza. Press out cans of dinner rolls on ungreased jelly roll pan. Bake until golden brown. Top with sour cream dip and fresh vegetables.

recipes.title: Dirt Cake
directions: You will need 1 (8-inch) plastic flower pot, plastic flowers and garden trowel.
recipes.text: Dirt Cake. You will need 1 (8-inch) plastic flower pot, plastic flowers and garden trowel.

recipes.title: Mrs. Turner'S Crab Casserole
directions: Make sauce with flour, butter and milk.
Saute butter with bell pepper and onion.
Add pepper and onion to sauce.
Mix mayo, eggs, Worcestershire sauce, crab meat and salt and pepper.
Mix all ingredients.
Pour into casserole dish.
Top with cracker crumbs. Bake at 350° until brown.
recipes.text: Mrs. Turner'S Crab Casserole. Make sauce with flour, butter and milk. Saute butter with bell pepper and onion. Add pepper and onion to sauce. Mix mayo, eggs, Worcestershire sauce, crab meat and salt and pepper. Mix all ingredients. Pour into casserole dish. Top with cracker crumbs. Bake at 350° until brown.

recipes.title: Chip Dip
directions: Beat until smooth and then add onions to taste.
recipes.text: Chip Dip. Beat until smooth and then add onions to taste.

recipes.title: Mock Swedish Brown Beans
directions: Mix together; simmer 10 minutes.
Cook until lightly thickened; salt to taste.
recipes.text: Mock Swedish Brown Beans. Mix together; simmer 10 minutes. Cook until lightly thickened; salt to taste.

recipes.title: Zucchini Pie
directions: Slice zucchini and boil in water until tender; drain.
Add next 5 ingredients.
Put in double crust and bake at 400° for 40 to 50 minutes.
recipes.text: Zucchini Pie. Slice zucchini and boil in water until tender; drain. Add next 5 ingredients. Put in double crust and bake at 400° for 40 to 50 minutes.

recipes.title: Banana Muffins
ingredients: 3 small ripe bananas, mashed but still chunky (about 1 1/4 c.)
directions: Heat oven to 400°.
Spray muffin pan cups with nonstick cooking spray.
In large bowl, stir flour, sugar, baking powder, salt and nutmeg to mix well.
Stir in nuts; set aside.
recipes.text: Banana Muffins. Heat oven to 400°. Spray muffin pan cups with nonstick cooking spray. In large bowl, stir flour, sugar, baking powder, salt and nutmeg to mix well. Stir in nuts; set aside.

recipes.title: Von'S Soft Molasses Cookies
directions: Beat Egg; add Sugar, Shortening, Molasses and Water.
Sift dry ingredients and add to mixture.
Mix well and chill.
Drop by teaspoon and bake at 375 for 10 minutes.
recipes.text: Von'S Soft Molasses Cookies. Beat Egg; add Sugar, Shortening, Molasses and Water. Sift dry ingredients and add to mixture. Mix well and chill. Drop by teaspoon and bake at 375 for 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Easy Banana Pudding
directions: Mix milk, cream cheese, Eagle Brand milk, pudding and half of Cool Whip until thick.
Layer wafers, pudding and bananas and then top with remaining Cool Whip.
Garnish with crushed wafers. Refrigerate until it sets.
recipes.text: Easy Banana Pudding. Mix milk, cream cheese, Eagle Brand milk, pudding and half of Cool Whip until thick. Layer wafers, pudding and bananas and then top with remaining Cool Whip. Garnish with crushed wafers. Refrigerate until it sets.

recipes.title: Peanut Brittle
directions: Dissolve the first 4 ingredients.
Add peanuts.
Cook at high heat; stir often.
Cook until peanuts take up all syrup and pop like popcorn.
Take off heat; add soda.
Pour in greased cookie sheet.
Cool and break up.
recipes.text: Peanut Brittle. Dissolve the first 4 ingredients. Add peanuts. Cook at high heat; stir often. Cook until peanuts take up all syrup and pop like popcorn. Take off heat; add soda. Pour in greased cookie sheet. Cool and break up.

recipes.title: Green Chile Salsa
directions: Chop jalapenos, tomato, onion and cilantro.
Mix together and add tomato sauce.
Add garlic and salt; continue mixing.
To thin, dilute with water slowly.
(For hotter, add more jalapenos.) Garnish with tortilla chips.
recipes.text: Green Chile Salsa. Chop jalapenos, tomato, onion and cilantro. Mix together and add tomato sauce. Add garlic and salt; continue mixing. To thin, dilute with water slowly. (For hotter, add more jalapenos.) Garnish with tortilla chips.

recipes.title: Turnip Salad
directions: Mix all ingredients and chill.
recipes.text: Turnip Salad. Mix all ingredients and chill.

recipes.title: Cream Cheese Sandwiches
directions: Cream the
cream cheese. Add salad dressing and pineapple and cream
together.
Add nuts.
Spread on slices of whole wheat bread or bread of choice.
recipes.text: Cream Cheese Sandwiches. Cream the cream cheese. Add salad dressing and pineapple and cream together. Add nuts. Spread on slices of whole wheat bread or bread of choice.

recipes.title: Apple Betty
directions: Mound apples in 9-inch buttered pie plate.
Sprinkle with orange juice.
Combine sugar, flour, spices and salt.
Cut in butter until mixture is crumbly.
Sprinkle over apples.
Bake at 375° for 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Apple Betty. Mound apples in 9-inch buttered pie plate. Sprinkle with orange juice. Combine sugar, flour, spices and salt. Cut in butter until mixture is crumbly. Sprinkle over apples. Bake at 375° for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Potato Soup
directions: Combine all ingredients except milk and margarine.
Cook over medium heat for 40 minutes, covered.
Add milk and margarine and simmer for 30 more minutes on low.
recipes.text: Potato Soup. Combine all ingredients except milk and margarine. Cook over medium heat for 40 minutes, covered. Add milk and margarine and simmer for 30 more minutes on low.

recipes.title: Floating Island
directions: Beat egg whites until foamy.
Gradually beat in 6 tablespoons sugar; beat until stiff.
Bring milk to a boil with salt, vanilla and remaining 1/4 cup of sugar in a saucepan.
Drop meringue mixture by tablespoon into milk and poach the island until they are firm, turning them to cook on both sides.
Remove with a slotted spoon.
recipes.text: Floating Island. Beat egg whites until foamy. Gradually beat in 6 tablespoons sugar; beat until stiff. Bring milk to a boil with salt, vanilla and remaining 1/4 cup of sugar in a saucepan. Drop meringue mixture by tablespoon into milk and poach the island until they are firm, turning them to cook on both sides. Remove with a slotted spoon.

recipes.title: Pizza
ingredients: 1 loaf French bread or slices of bread on cookie sheet
slices of cheese (Swiss or Jack cheese can be used)
directions: Cut the French bread lengthwise, making two slices.
Place on cookie sheet.
Mix the hamburger and tomato paste.
Add the chopped onion, oregano, salt and pepper.
Mix well, then spread over the bread.
Sprinkle the grated cheese over the top.
Bake 15 minutes in 400° oven.
Take from oven and cover with slices of cheese, cut diagonally and lapping point over each slice.
Return to oven and bake for 5 more minutes.
Will serve 4 to 6 people.
recipes.text: Pizza. Cut the French bread lengthwise, making two slices. Place on cookie sheet. Mix the hamburger and tomato paste. Add the chopped onion, oregano, salt and pepper. Mix well, then spread over the bread. Sprinkle the grated cheese over the top. Bake 15 minutes in 400° oven. Take from oven and cover with slices of cheese, cut diagonally and lapping point over each slice. Return to oven and bake for 5 more minutes. Will serve 4 to 6 people.

recipes.title: Quick Quiche
directions: Brown sausage with onions and mushrooms; drain well.
Mix eggs, milk, salt and pepper; add sausage mixture.
Pour into pie shells.
Bake at 350° until knife comes out clean.
recipes.text: Quick Quiche. Brown sausage with onions and mushrooms; drain well. Mix eggs, milk, salt and pepper; add sausage mixture. Pour into pie shells. Bake at 350° until knife comes out clean.

recipes.title: Banana Nut Bread
directions: Mix the eggs and bananas in a bowl.
Sift the flour, sugar, salt and baking soda in separate bowl.
Add to first mixture. Stir to mix and blend well, but do not overbeat.
Add the nuts. Stir well.
Pour into a buttered loaf pan (9 x 5-inch).
Bake 1 hour at 350° or until tests done with toothpick.
recipes.text: Banana Nut Bread. Mix the eggs and bananas in a bowl. Sift the flour, sugar, salt and baking soda in separate bowl. Add to first mixture. Stir to mix and blend well, but do not overbeat. Add the nuts. Stir well. Pour into a buttered loaf pan (9 x 5-inch). Bake 1 hour at 350° or until tests done with toothpick.

recipes.title: Apricot Delight
directions: Pour into saucepan pineapple, water and gelatin.
Let come to a ripple.
Add cream cheese; stir until cream cheese is almost dissolved.
Set aside to cool.
Pour into a mixing bowl and set in the refrigerator for about 15 or 20 minutes.
Whip the Dream Whip and add to the cooled pineapple mixture.
Add nuts and celery. Pour into mold.
Best if chilled overnight.
recipes.text: Apricot Delight. Pour into saucepan pineapple, water and gelatin. Let come to a ripple. Add cream cheese; stir until cream cheese is almost dissolved. Set aside to cool. Pour into a mixing bowl and set in the refrigerator for about 15 or 20 minutes. Whip the Dream Whip and add to the cooled pineapple mixture. Add nuts and celery. Pour into mold. Best if chilled overnight.

recipes.title: Fig Cake
directions: Cream sugar, oil and eggs together; add flour, allspice, cinnamon, nutmeg, cloves, soda, salt, buttermilk and nuts.
Stir in figs.
Bake for 1 1/2 hours at 350°.
recipes.text: Fig Cake. Cream sugar, oil and eggs together; add flour, allspice, cinnamon, nutmeg, cloves, soda, salt, buttermilk and nuts. Stir in figs. Bake for 1 1/2 hours at 350°.

recipes.title: Broccoli-Cheese-Rice Casserole
directions: Put broccoli in a micro-dish and put in microwave on defrost for 5 minutes. Then add rice and soup. Put back in for 5 minutes on High. Then put cheese in and stir. Put back in for 5 to 6 minutes. Stir and serve.
recipes.text: Broccoli-Cheese-Rice Casserole. Put broccoli in a micro-dish and put in microwave on defrost for 5 minutes. Then add rice and soup. Put back in for 5 minutes on High. Then put cheese in and stir. Put back in for 5 to 6 minutes. Stir and serve.

recipes.title: Plum Upside-Down Cake
ingredients: 3 to 4 plums, pitted and thinly sliced
directions: Place 1 tablespoon butter in a 9-inch round baking pan.
Put pan in a preheated 350° oven to melt.
Remove from oven and sprinkle with 1/3 cup sugar.
Arrange plum slices in a circular pattern over sugar. Bake for 10 minutes.
recipes.text: Plum Upside-Down Cake. Place 1 tablespoon butter in a 9-inch round baking pan. Put pan in a preheated 350° oven to melt. Remove from oven and sprinkle with 1/3 cup sugar. Arrange plum slices in a circular pattern over sugar. Bake for 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Quick Baked Catfish(Low-Fat)
ingredients: 1/2 to 1 tsp. each: thyme, dill, pepper and garlic powder
directions: Preheat oven to 500°.
Rinse and pat dry fillets.
Dip in milk.
Place, skin side down, in foil-lined pan (spray with cooking oil spray).
Mix bread crumbs and seasonings.
Add oleo to moisten and sprinkle or spoon over fish.
Bake, uncovered, for about 12 to 15 minutes (a little longer for thick fillets). (Guilt free.)
recipes.text: Quick Baked Catfish(Low-Fat). Preheat oven to 500°. Rinse and pat dry fillets. Dip in milk. Place, skin side down, in foil-lined pan (spray with cooking oil spray). Mix bread crumbs and seasonings. Add oleo to moisten and sprinkle or spoon over fish. Bake, uncovered, for about 12 to 15 minutes (a little longer for thick fillets). (Guilt free.)

recipes.title: Shrimp Dip
directions: Soften cream cheese.
Add the rest of the ingredients and mix well.
Let set for 1 hour.
Use with any crackers.
recipes.text: Shrimp Dip. Soften cream cheese. Add the rest of the ingredients and mix well. Let set for 1 hour. Use with any crackers.

recipes.title: Beef Nacho Casserole
ingredients: 2 c. shredded Monterey Jack cheese, divided
directions: Heat oven to 350°.
Brown meat and drain.
Stir in salsa, corn, mayo and chili powder.
Grease a 2 1/2-quart casserole.
Put 2 handfuls of chips from extra on bottom.
Put layer of meat, layer of chips and layer of cheese.
Repeat layers.
Bake 20 minutes or until thoroughly heated.
Top with shredded lettuce and tomatoes, if desired.
recipes.text: Beef Nacho Casserole. Heat oven to 350°. Brown meat and drain. Stir in salsa, corn, mayo and chili powder. Grease a 2 1/2-quart casserole. Put 2 handfuls of chips from extra on bottom. Put layer of meat, layer of chips and layer of cheese. Repeat layers. Bake 20 minutes or until thoroughly heated. Top with shredded lettuce and tomatoes, if desired.

recipes.title: Hamburger Pie
ingredients: 1 (16 oz.) can cut green beans, drained
5 medium potatoes, cooked, or instant potatoes
directions: In large skillet cook the meat and onion until meat is lightly browned and onion is tender.
Add salt and pepper.
Stir in drained beans and soup.
Pour into greased 1 1/2-quart casserole. Spoon in mounds of mashed potatoes over casserole.
Sprinkle potatoes with grated cheese.
Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes. Serves 4 to 6.
recipes.text: Hamburger Pie. In large skillet cook the meat and onion until meat is lightly browned and onion is tender. Add salt and pepper. Stir in drained beans and soup. Pour into greased 1 1/2-quart casserole. Spoon in mounds of mashed potatoes over casserole. Sprinkle potatoes with grated cheese. Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes. Serves 4 to 6.

recipes.title: Irish Coffee
directions: Place the whiskey and sugar in bottom of cup and stir to dissolve sugar.
Slowly add hot coffee filling to an inch from the top.
Fill remainder of the cup with whipped cream.
Do not stir.
recipes.text: Irish Coffee. Place the whiskey and sugar in bottom of cup and stir to dissolve sugar. Slowly add hot coffee filling to an inch from the top. Fill remainder of the cup with whipped cream. Do not stir.

recipes.title: Nutter Butter Creamy Crisps
directions: Spread peanut butter between two ritz crackers. Dip in melted chocolate candy. Cool on waxed paper. Drizzle melted white chocolate across tops. Enjoy!
recipes.text: Nutter Butter Creamy Crisps. Spread peanut butter between two ritz crackers. Dip in melted chocolate candy. Cool on waxed paper. Drizzle melted white chocolate across tops. Enjoy!

recipes.title: Rice And Corn Bake
directions: Drain corn.
Cut up Velveeta cheese.
Chop onion and bell pepper; saute in skillet with 1 stick of butter.
Add remaining ingredients.
Bake at 350° for 20 to 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Rice And Corn Bake. Drain corn. Cut up Velveeta cheese. Chop onion and bell pepper; saute in skillet with 1 stick of butter. Add remaining ingredients. Bake at 350° for 20 to 30 minutes.

recipes.title: "In And Out" Skillet Beef
ingredients: 1 lb. rare roast beef, sliced deli style and cut into strips
directions: In a large skillet over medium heat, warm the roast beef. Separate the slices and "drape" them around the pan.
When warm, add the gravy, Worcestershire and salt.
Cook and stir, blending well and coating the meat as much as possible.
Add the sherry and cook for 1 to 2 minutes.
Then add the tomatoes, onion, mushrooms, peas and carrots.
Cover and simmer for about 5 minutes.
Serve hot with garlic bread.
recipes.text: "In And Out" Skillet Beef. In a large skillet over medium heat, warm the roast beef. Separate the slices and "drape" them around the pan. When warm, add the gravy, Worcestershire and salt. Cook and stir, blending well and coating the meat as much as possible. Add the sherry and cook for 1 to 2 minutes. Then add the tomatoes, onion, mushrooms, peas and carrots. Cover and simmer for about 5 minutes. Serve hot with garlic bread.

recipes.title: Scalloped Potatoes
ingredients: 4 to 5 strips bacon, diced and fried golden brown
directions: Butter a 9 x 9-inch square pan.
Layer 1 layer of sliced potatoes, salt and pepper to taste, 1 teaspoon parsley, 1/3 of fried bacon, 1/2 tablespoon flour, 1 teaspoon butter (placed as 4 small dots) and diced onions (if desired).
Make 2 more layers. Heat up milk (at least enough so when poured over potatoes it comes to the top of them).
Bake at 325° to 350° for 1 to 1 1/2 hours in oven or 20 to 30 minutes in microwave.
If using microwave, cover with wax paper.
May top with cheese.
recipes.text: Scalloped Potatoes. Butter a 9 x 9-inch square pan. Layer 1 layer of sliced potatoes, salt and pepper to taste, 1 teaspoon parsley, 1/3 of fried bacon, 1/2 tablespoon flour, 1 teaspoon butter (placed as 4 small dots) and diced onions (if desired). Make 2 more layers. Heat up milk (at least enough so when poured over potatoes it comes to the top of them). Bake at 325° to 350° for 1 to 1 1/2 hours in oven or 20 to 30 minutes in microwave. If using microwave, cover with wax paper. May top with cheese.

recipes.title: Butterscotch Loaf
directions: Cream egg and sugar; add melted butter.
Sift flour, soda, powder and salt and set aside.
Put half your buttermilk into creamed mixture; add half your flour mixture.
Keep doing until all used.
Put in nuts.
Pour into bread pan and bake 1 hour at 350° in greased pan.
recipes.text: Butterscotch Loaf. Cream egg and sugar; add melted butter. Sift flour, soda, powder and salt and set aside. Put half your buttermilk into creamed mixture; add half your flour mixture. Keep doing until all used. Put in nuts. Pour into bread pan and bake 1 hour at 350° in greased pan.

recipes.title: Poppy Seed Dressing
ingredients: few drops of red food coloring
directions: Mix sugar, mustard, salt and vinegar.
Add onion juice and stir well.
With mixer set on beating setting, add oil very slowly, beating constantly.
Continue beating until dressing is quite thick.
Add poppy seed and food coloring.
Continue to beat 3 to 5 minutes longer.
Put into glass container with tight fitting lid.
recipes.text: Poppy Seed Dressing. Mix sugar, mustard, salt and vinegar. Add onion juice and stir well. With mixer set on beating setting, add oil very slowly, beating constantly. Continue beating until dressing is quite thick. Add poppy seed and food coloring. Continue to beat 3 to 5 minutes longer. Put into glass container with tight fitting lid.

recipes.title: E-Z Lasagna
ingredients: 1 (16 oz.) carton Ricotta or small curd cottage cheese
directions: Combine Ricotta cheese, 1 cup Mozzarella cheese, egg, salt, pepper and oregano in a large bowl, stir well.
Spread 1/2 cup spaghetti sauce in a greased 9 x 13-inch dish.
Place 1/2 of noodles over sauce, 1/2 cheese mixture.
Repeat layers.
Top with noodles, sauce and 1/2 cup Mozzarella cheese.
Pour water around edges, cover with foil.
Bake 1 hour and 15 minutes at 350°.
Cool 15 minutes.
recipes.text: E-Z Lasagna. Combine Ricotta cheese, 1 cup Mozzarella cheese, egg, salt, pepper and oregano in a large bowl, stir well. Spread 1/2 cup spaghetti sauce in a greased 9 x 13-inch dish. Place 1/2 of noodles over sauce, 1/2 cheese mixture. Repeat layers. Top with noodles, sauce and 1/2 cup Mozzarella cheese. Pour water around edges, cover with foil. Bake 1 hour and 15 minutes at 350°. Cool 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Porcupine Meat Balls
directions: Mix all ingredients, except soup, together in a bowl.
