Make into balls and place in dish or pan.
Pour soup over meat balls. Bake in a 350° oven for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Porcupine Meat Balls. Mix all ingredients, except soup, together in a bowl. Make into balls and place in dish or pan. Pour soup over meat balls. Bake in a 350° oven for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Gourmet Potatoes
directions: Peel and boil potatoes until soft on outside, but firm inside. Let cool.
Grate potatoes and onion, mix with other ingredients and place in greased casserole dish.
Sprinkle with crushed cornflakes or bread crumbs.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Gourmet Potatoes. Peel and boil potatoes until soft on outside, but firm inside. Let cool. Grate potatoes and onion, mix with other ingredients and place in greased casserole dish. Sprinkle with crushed cornflakes or bread crumbs. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: B.J.'S Broccoli Casserole
directions: Combine and blend together the broccoli, onion, mushroom soup, mayonnaise, egg and salt and pepper. Put all ingredients in a casserole dish.
Add crumbled cheese crackers on top and
layer 1/2 cup of shredded Cheddar cheese on crumbled cheese crackers.
recipes.text: B.J.'S Broccoli Casserole. Combine and blend together the broccoli, onion, mushroom soup, mayonnaise, egg and salt and pepper. Put all ingredients in a casserole dish. Add crumbled cheese crackers on top and layer 1/2 cup of shredded Cheddar cheese on crumbled cheese crackers.

recipes.title: Salmon Loaf Or Timbales
ingredients: 2 c. (1 lb. can) drained salmon (remove bones and skin, if desired; I don't)
2 c. soft bread crumbs or 1/2 c. dry bread or cracker crumbs
1 Tbsp. instant minced onion or 1/4 c. fresh
1/2 c. condensed cream of celery soup (or salmon liquid plus water)
directions: Preheat oven to 375°.
Mix all ingredients in large bowl. Place in well-greased 8 x 4-inch loaf pan or 8-inch square or round pan.
Also can be put in greased baking cups or muffin tins (3/4 full).
Bake at 375°; for mini-loaves, 25 to 30 minutes; for larger loaves, 40 to 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Salmon Loaf Or Timbales. Preheat oven to 375°. Mix all ingredients in large bowl. Place in well-greased 8 x 4-inch loaf pan or 8-inch square or round pan. Also can be put in greased baking cups or muffin tins (3/4 full). Bake at 375°; for mini-loaves, 25 to 30 minutes; for larger loaves, 40 to 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Microwave Savory Cabbage Rolls
directions: Power Level:
High.
Cut core from cabbage; rinse.
In medium glass bowl, heat, covered, 4 to 5 minutes on High.
Remove 8 leaves; reserve (using remaining cabbage in other recipes).
Into glass bowl, crumble ground beef; stir in onions.
Heat 3 1/2 to 4 1/2 minutes on High until beef is browned, stirring once; drain. Stir in 1/2 tomato sauce, rice, salt and pepper.
To stuff cabbage, place beef-rice filling in cabbage leaf; roll up, folding edges in. Arrange seam side down in square baking dishes.
Pour in remaining tomato sauce blended with brown sugar and vinegar.
Heat, covered, 5 minutes before serving.
recipes.text: Microwave Savory Cabbage Rolls. Power Level: High. Cut core from cabbage; rinse. In medium glass bowl, heat, covered, 4 to 5 minutes on High. Remove 8 leaves; reserve (using remaining cabbage in other recipes). Into glass bowl, crumble ground beef; stir in onions. Heat 3 1/2 to 4 1/2 minutes on High until beef is browned, stirring once; drain. Stir in 1/2 tomato sauce, rice, salt and pepper. To stuff cabbage, place beef-rice filling in cabbage leaf; roll up, folding edges in. Arrange seam side down in square baking dishes. Pour in remaining tomato sauce blended with brown sugar and vinegar. Heat, covered, 5 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Sawdust Salad
directions: First Layer:
Dissolve gelatins in boiling water; stir in cold water.
Add crushed pineapple.
Pour into a 9 x 13-inch pan; chill until set.
Top with sliced bananas and miniature marshmallows.
recipes.text: Sawdust Salad. First Layer: Dissolve gelatins in boiling water; stir in cold water. Add crushed pineapple. Pour into a 9 x 13-inch pan; chill until set. Top with sliced bananas and miniature marshmallows.

recipes.title: Strawberry-Pineapple Delight
directions: Mix all ingredients together.
Pour into 9 x 13-inch pan and refrigerate several hours or overnight.
Serves 12 to 15.
recipes.text: Strawberry-Pineapple Delight. Mix all ingredients together. Pour into 9 x 13-inch pan and refrigerate several hours or overnight. Serves 12 to 15.

recipes.title: Never Fail Meringue
directions: Add cornstarch to cold water and mix.
Add boiling water and stir until thick and clear.
(May have to thicken on stove.)
Let cool.
Beat egg whites until foamy.
Gradually add the sugar and beat until stiff.
Add cornstarch mixture and mix well until stiff.
Beat in the vanilla.
Spread on top of pie.
Bake for 10 minutes or until brown in 350° oven.
recipes.text: Never Fail Meringue. Add cornstarch to cold water and mix. Add boiling water and stir until thick and clear. (May have to thicken on stove.) Let cool. Beat egg whites until foamy. Gradually add the sugar and beat until stiff. Add cornstarch mixture and mix well until stiff. Beat in the vanilla. Spread on top of pie. Bake for 10 minutes or until brown in 350° oven.

recipes.title: Taco Salad
ingredients: 1 lb. ground beef, browned and drained (refrigerate)
1 head lettuce, torn into bite sized pieces
2 to 3 tomatoes, chopped into small pieces
8 oz. grated Cheddar cheese (sharp or mild, your taste)
directions: Mix 1/2 package taco seasoning with salad dressing and set aside.
To assemble:
A few hours before serving, mix lettuce, tomatoes, beef, onions, beans and cheese into a large bowl.
Pour dressing mixture over the salad and mix.
Immediately before serving, add crushed Doritos chips and serve (or can omit if desired).
recipes.text: Taco Salad. Mix 1/2 package taco seasoning with salad dressing and set aside. To assemble: A few hours before serving, mix lettuce, tomatoes, beef, onions, beans and cheese into a large bowl. Pour dressing mixture over the salad and mix. Immediately before serving, add crushed Doritos chips and serve (or can omit if desired).

recipes.title: Eldorado Casserole
directions: Brown hamburger with onion salt.
Add black olives, then add tomato sauce.
Mix cottage cheese, sour cream and green chilies. Mash chips.
Layer chips, sauce and grated cheese.
Bake at 350° for 1/2 hour.
recipes.text: Eldorado Casserole. Brown hamburger with onion salt. Add black olives, then add tomato sauce. Mix cottage cheese, sour cream and green chilies. Mash chips. Layer chips, sauce and grated cheese. Bake at 350° for 1/2 hour.

recipes.title: Barbecue Meatballs
directions: Mix meatball ingredients together.
Roll into balls the size of walnuts.
Roll the balls into flour and brown in fry pan.
recipes.text: Barbecue Meatballs. Mix meatball ingredients together. Roll into balls the size of walnuts. Roll the balls into flour and brown in fry pan.

recipes.title: Frittata(Italian Style Omelet)
ingredients: 3 Tbsp. olive oil, cooking oil, butter or margarine
1 1/2 c. chopped, cooked vegetables or meat (ham)
directions: In saucepan cook onion in 1 tablespoon of the oil, butter or margarine until tender.
Remove from heat.
Stir in vegetables or meat.
Combine eggs, salt, pepper and vegetable or meat mixture. In a 10-inch ovenproof skillet, heat the remaining oil, butter or margarine over medium-low heat.
Pour egg mixture into skillet. As eggs set, run a spatula around edge of skillet, lifting egg mixture to allow uncooked portion to flow underneath.
Continue cooking and lifting edges until mixture is almost set (surface will be moist).
The total cooking time should be about 6 minutes. Place skillet under broiler, 5 inches from heat.
Broil for 1 or 2 minutes or just until top is set.
Sprinkle with Parmesan or Romano cheese.
Loosen bottom of Frittata and slide out onto plate.
Cut into wedges.
Makes 4 to 6 side dish servings.
recipes.text: Frittata(Italian Style Omelet). In saucepan cook onion in 1 tablespoon of the oil, butter or margarine until tender. Remove from heat. Stir in vegetables or meat. Combine eggs, salt, pepper and vegetable or meat mixture. In a 10-inch ovenproof skillet, heat the remaining oil, butter or margarine over medium-low heat. Pour egg mixture into skillet. As eggs set, run a spatula around edge of skillet, lifting egg mixture to allow uncooked portion to flow underneath. Continue cooking and lifting edges until mixture is almost set (surface will be moist). The total cooking time should be about 6 minutes. Place skillet under broiler, 5 inches from heat. Broil for 1 or 2 minutes or just until top is set. Sprinkle with Parmesan or Romano cheese. Loosen bottom of Frittata and slide out onto plate. Cut into wedges. Makes 4 to 6 side dish servings.

recipes.title: Enchilada Casserole
directions: Brown the hamburger.
Add sauces, onions, beans, half of the corn chips (lightly crushed) and half of the Cheddar cheese.
Pour into a large casserole and bake for 25 minutes at 350°.
recipes.text: Enchilada Casserole. Brown the hamburger. Add sauces, onions, beans, half of the corn chips (lightly crushed) and half of the Cheddar cheese. Pour into a large casserole and bake for 25 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Old-Time German Potato Salad
directions: Cook potatoes; cool, peel and slice.
Fry bacon until golden brown.
Take bacon out of pan; add butter to bacon grease.
Stir in flour until smooth.
Mix vinegar and water together in a bowl, then slowly add to flour mixture.
Add sugar, stirring all the time.
Pour over potatoes with chopped onions and crumbled bacon. Stir gently until all mixed together.
Serve.
recipes.text: Old-Time German Potato Salad. Cook potatoes; cool, peel and slice. Fry bacon until golden brown. Take bacon out of pan; add butter to bacon grease. Stir in flour until smooth. Mix vinegar and water together in a bowl, then slowly add to flour mixture. Add sugar, stirring all the time. Pour over potatoes with chopped onions and crumbled bacon. Stir gently until all mixed together. Serve.

recipes.title: Banana Bread
ingredients: 3 ripe or overripe bananas (4 if small)
directions: Mash bananas with fork.
Stir in all other ingredients.
Pour into a buttered 8 1/2 x 4 1/2 x 2 1/2-inch loaf pan.
Bake 1 hour at 325° until top is evenly brown.
recipes.text: Banana Bread. Mash bananas with fork. Stir in all other ingredients. Pour into a buttered 8 1/2 x 4 1/2 x 2 1/2-inch loaf pan. Bake 1 hour at 325° until top is evenly brown.

recipes.title: Little Pizzas
directions: Brown sausage and lean chuck.
Drain most of grease off.
Add spices and cheese.
When cheese is melted, spread on bread and put on a cookie sheet in freezer until firm.
After frozen, stack in plastic bags and store in freezer.
Take out as many as you need and put under broiler for about 5 minutes.
Very good to serve as a pick-up.
recipes.text: Little Pizzas. Brown sausage and lean chuck. Drain most of grease off. Add spices and cheese. When cheese is melted, spread on bread and put on a cookie sheet in freezer until firm. After frozen, stack in plastic bags and store in freezer. Take out as many as you need and put under broiler for about 5 minutes. Very good to serve as a pick-up.

recipes.title: Potato Casserole
directions: Boil potatoes in skins, peel and chunk.
Saute onion in butter.
Add cheese and soup, chunky potatoes.
Mix together.
recipes.text: Potato Casserole. Boil potatoes in skins, peel and chunk. Saute onion in butter. Add cheese and soup, chunky potatoes. Mix together.

recipes.title: Easy Wassail
directions: Stick cloves around middle of oranges about 1 inch apart, then several close together at stem and bottom ends.
Bake, uncovered, in shallow pan for 30 minutes at 350°.
Remove from oven.
Combine Tang, water, cider and cinnamon sticks in large saucepan.
Bring to a boil.
Reduce heat and simmer 5 minutes.
recipes.text: Easy Wassail. Stick cloves around middle of oranges about 1 inch apart, then several close together at stem and bottom ends. Bake, uncovered, in shallow pan for 30 minutes at 350°. Remove from oven. Combine Tang, water, cider and cinnamon sticks in large saucepan. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer 5 minutes.

recipes.title: Sugar-Free Grape Sherbet
ingredients: 1 (12 oz.) can frozen grape juice concentrate, thawed (no sugar added)
directions: Heat 1 cup thawed concentrate to boiling; dissolve gelatin in this.
Cool completely.
Combine remaining concentrate, milk and gelatin mixture in large mixing bowl; stir until well blended. Pour into freezer can of ice cream freezer and churn according to manufacturer's directions.
Remove from can and pack into plastic container with tight fitting lid.
Ripen several hours or overnight in freezer.
Makes 2 quarts.
recipes.text: Sugar-Free Grape Sherbet. Heat 1 cup thawed concentrate to boiling; dissolve gelatin in this. Cool completely. Combine remaining concentrate, milk and gelatin mixture in large mixing bowl; stir until well blended. Pour into freezer can of ice cream freezer and churn according to manufacturer's directions. Remove from can and pack into plastic container with tight fitting lid. Ripen several hours or overnight in freezer. Makes 2 quarts.

recipes.title: Pickled Eggs
directions: Shell eggs.
Place in hot sterilized jars and cover with boiling liquid.
Seal immediately.
recipes.text: Pickled Eggs. Shell eggs. Place in hot sterilized jars and cover with boiling liquid. Seal immediately.

recipes.title: Barbecue Shrimp
directions: Mix spices in a bowl.
Melt butter in skillet.
Add spices to melted butter.
Over high heat, add shrimp and cook until shrimp is pink, about 2 to 2 1/2 minutes.
Serve hot with French bread. Dip bread in sauce.
recipes.text: Barbecue Shrimp. Mix spices in a bowl. Melt butter in skillet. Add spices to melted butter. Over high heat, add shrimp and cook until shrimp is pink, about 2 to 2 1/2 minutes. Serve hot with French bread. Dip bread in sauce.

recipes.title: Chicken Spread
directions: Soften cream cheese.
Mix all 3 ingredients together well. Refrigerate overnight.
Serve on crackers or party rye slices.
recipes.text: Chicken Spread. Soften cream cheese. Mix all 3 ingredients together well. Refrigerate overnight. Serve on crackers or party rye slices.

recipes.title: Low-Fat Raisin-Cinnamon Bread
ingredients: 2 c. raisins (soaked in water for 15 to 30 minutes)
directions: In a large bowl, dissolve yeast in warm water, not hot.
Set aside.
Heat milk, sugar, salt and margarine to lukewarm and then add this to the yeast mixture.
Stir in small amounts of both flours and the raisins and mix to form a stiff dough.
Turn onto a floured surface, knead 10 minutes, adding extra flour as needed. Shape into ball.
Place in bowl sprayed with nonstick spray.
Turn dough over to coat.
Cover with plastic wrap loosely.
Let rise in a warm place for 1 1/2 hours.
recipes.text: Low-Fat Raisin-Cinnamon Bread. In a large bowl, dissolve yeast in warm water, not hot. Set aside. Heat milk, sugar, salt and margarine to lukewarm and then add this to the yeast mixture. Stir in small amounts of both flours and the raisins and mix to form a stiff dough. Turn onto a floured surface, knead 10 minutes, adding extra flour as needed. Shape into ball. Place in bowl sprayed with nonstick spray. Turn dough over to coat. Cover with plastic wrap loosely. Let rise in a warm place for 1 1/2 hours.

recipes.title: Cookie Brittle
directions: Heat oven to 375°.
Combine margarine, vanilla and salt. Blend well.
Gradually beat in sugar.
Add flour and chocolate bits.
Mix well.
Press evenly into ungreased 15 x 10 x 1-inch pan.
Sprinkle nuts over top.
Bake for 20 to 25 minutes.
Cool, then break into irregular pieces or cut in squares.
recipes.text: Cookie Brittle. Heat oven to 375°. Combine margarine, vanilla and salt. Blend well. Gradually beat in sugar. Add flour and chocolate bits. Mix well. Press evenly into ungreased 15 x 10 x 1-inch pan. Sprinkle nuts over top. Bake for 20 to 25 minutes. Cool, then break into irregular pieces or cut in squares.

recipes.title: Cranberry-Apple Mold
directions: Mix together first 4 ingredients.
Cool until partially set. Then add last 4 ingredients.
Pour into a 2-quart mold.
Makes 10 to 12 servings.
recipes.text: Cranberry-Apple Mold. Mix together first 4 ingredients. Cool until partially set. Then add last 4 ingredients. Pour into a 2-quart mold. Makes 10 to 12 servings.

recipes.title: Bj'S World Class Chili
ingredients: 2 cans peeled whole tomatoes with liquid
directions: Fry bacon in skillet.
Remove bacon to paper towel.
Brown onion slices in bacon grease until tender.	Remove onions.	Brown ground beef in same skillet.
Drain.
Crumble bacon.
Combine all ingredients into large casserole dish.
Stir well. Salt and pepper to taste.
Bake in 325° oven for one and one half hours.
Bake uncovered for thick chili; cover casserole for soupy chili.
recipes.text: Bj'S World Class Chili. Fry bacon in skillet. Remove bacon to paper towel. Brown onion slices in bacon grease until tender.	Remove onions.	Brown ground beef in same skillet. Drain. Crumble bacon. Combine all ingredients into large casserole dish. Stir well. Salt and pepper to taste. Bake in 325° oven for one and one half hours. Bake uncovered for thick chili; cover casserole for soupy chili.

recipes.title: Peach Cobbler
directions: Melt stick of butter in pan.
Mix sugar, flour and milk in bowl.
Pour over butter, then add peaches.
Do not stir.
Bake at 375° for 45 to 60 minutes.
recipes.text: Peach Cobbler. Melt stick of butter in pan. Mix sugar, flour and milk in bowl. Pour over butter, then add peaches. Do not stir. Bake at 375° for 45 to 60 minutes.

recipes.title: Tater Tot Casserole
directions: Mix soup, milk and water.
Layer in baking dish Tater Tots, soup mix, onion and cheese.
Repeat once, and top with mushrooms. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Tater Tot Casserole. Mix soup, milk and water. Layer in baking dish Tater Tots, soup mix, onion and cheese. Repeat once, and top with mushrooms. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Fruit Cobbler
directions: In 9-inch square pan, put about 4 cups fruit.
Mix the remaining ingredients together and pour over fruit.
Sprinkle 1 cup sugar on top, then pour 1/2 cup water on top of sugar. Sprinkle cinnamon over top.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes to 1 hour.
recipes.text: Fruit Cobbler. In 9-inch square pan, put about 4 cups fruit. Mix the remaining ingredients together and pour over fruit. Sprinkle 1 cup sugar on top, then pour 1/2 cup water on top of sugar. Sprinkle cinnamon over top. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes to 1 hour.

recipes.title: Appleless Apple Pie
directions: Bring sugar, water and cream of tartar to a boil.
Add crackers.
Boil for 2 minutes; cool.
Pour into a pie shell. Sprinkle with spice.
Dot with butter.
Bake in 350° oven for 30 minutes.
Serve hot with ice cream.
recipes.text: Appleless Apple Pie. Bring sugar, water and cream of tartar to a boil. Add crackers. Boil for 2 minutes; cool. Pour into a pie shell. Sprinkle with spice. Dot with butter. Bake in 350° oven for 30 minutes. Serve hot with ice cream.

recipes.title: Broccoli Casserole
directions: Cook and drain broccoli.
Saute onion and celery in oleo.
Mix all ingredients in a buttered baking dish and bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Broccoli Casserole. Cook and drain broccoli. Saute onion and celery in oleo. Mix all ingredients in a buttered baking dish and bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Cookies
ingredients: 1 1/4 c. firmly packed light brown sugar
directions: Heat oven to 375°.
Combine shortening, peanut butter, brown sugar, milk and vanilla in a large bowl.
Beat at medium speed of electric mixer until well blended.
Add egg.
Beat just until blended.
Combine flour and baking soda.
Add to creamed mixture at low speed.
Mix just until blended.
Drop by heaping teaspoonfuls 2 inches apart onto ungreased baking sheet.
Flatten slightly in crisscross pattern with tines of fork.
Bake at 375° for 7 to 8 minutes or until set and just beginning to brown.
Do not overbake.
Cool 2 minutes on baking sheet.
Remove cookies to cool completely.
recipes.text: Peanut Butter Cookies. Heat oven to 375°. Combine shortening, peanut butter, brown sugar, milk and vanilla in a large bowl. Beat at medium speed of electric mixer until well blended. Add egg. Beat just until blended. Combine flour and baking soda. Add to creamed mixture at low speed. Mix just until blended. Drop by heaping teaspoonfuls 2 inches apart onto ungreased baking sheet. Flatten slightly in crisscross pattern with tines of fork. Bake at 375° for 7 to 8 minutes or until set and just beginning to brown. Do not overbake. Cool 2 minutes on baking sheet. Remove cookies to cool completely.

recipes.title: Fancy Egg Scramble
directions: In large skillet, cook Canadian bacon and onion in 3 tablespoons margarine until onion is tender, but not brown.
Add eggs and scramble just until set.
Fold mushrooms and cooked eggs into Cheese Sauce.
Turn into a 9 x 13-inch baking dish.
Combine melted margarine, crumbs and paprika; sprinkle atop eggs.
Cover and chill.
To serve, bake, uncovered in 350° oven for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Fancy Egg Scramble. In large skillet, cook Canadian bacon and onion in 3 tablespoons margarine until onion is tender, but not brown. Add eggs and scramble just until set. Fold mushrooms and cooked eggs into Cheese Sauce. Turn into a 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Combine melted margarine, crumbs and paprika; sprinkle atop eggs. Cover and chill. To serve, bake, uncovered in 350° oven for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Broccoli Casserole
directions: Combine
all
ingredients
and place in a butter baking dish. Bake at 325° for 1 hour.
Serves 12.
recipes.text: Broccoli Casserole. Combine all ingredients and place in a butter baking dish. Bake at 325° for 1 hour. Serves 12.

recipes.title: Lime Jello Mold
directions: Mix jello and hot water; let sit until partially jelled.
Mix all other ingredients.
Pour in mold.
Refrigerate until jelled completely.
Perfect for Thanksgiving and Christmas.
recipes.text: Lime Jello Mold. Mix jello and hot water; let sit until partially jelled. Mix all other ingredients. Pour in mold. Refrigerate until jelled completely. Perfect for Thanksgiving and Christmas.

recipes.title: Christmas Banana Spice Nut Bread
directions: Cream together eggs, oleo, sugar, vanilla and bananas.
Slowly add flour, baking soda and spices.
Add nuts last.
Bake in greased and floured pan of choice (Bundt, bread or other pan) at 350° for 45 minutes to 1 hour.
recipes.text: Christmas Banana Spice Nut Bread. Cream together eggs, oleo, sugar, vanilla and bananas. Slowly add flour, baking soda and spices. Add nuts last. Bake in greased and floured pan of choice (Bundt, bread or other pan) at 350° for 45 minutes to 1 hour.

recipes.title: Husband'S Delight
directions: Brown beef and drain; add garlic, pepper, sugar and tomato sauce.
Cover and simmer about 15 minutes.
Cook noodles and drain. Finely chop tops and bottoms of green onions and mix with cream cheese and yogurt.
Layer noodles, meat sauce, cream cheese mixture and grated cheese in 2-quart baking dish, ending with cheese on top.
Bake about 20 minutes to heat thoroughly at 350°.
Best mixed the day before.
Serves 8 with seconds; freezes well.
recipes.text: Husband'S Delight. Brown beef and drain; add garlic, pepper, sugar and tomato sauce. Cover and simmer about 15 minutes. Cook noodles and drain. Finely chop tops and bottoms of green onions and mix with cream cheese and yogurt. Layer noodles, meat sauce, cream cheese mixture and grated cheese in 2-quart baking dish, ending with cheese on top. Bake about 20 minutes to heat thoroughly at 350°. Best mixed the day before. Serves 8 with seconds; freezes well.

recipes.title: Corn And Black Bean Salsa
ingredients: 1 (15 oz.) can black beans, rinsed and drained
directions: Mix all ingredients and refrigerate. Serve with tortilla chips. Can be refrigerated for 3 days.
recipes.text: Corn And Black Bean Salsa. Mix all ingredients and refrigerate. Serve with tortilla chips. Can be refrigerated for 3 days.

recipes.title: Holly Cookies
directions: Combine marshmallows, butter, vanilla and food coloring in top of a double boiler (or in a big heavy saucepan, my pressure cooker bottom).
Heat until marshmallows and butter are melted, stirring frequently.
Take from heat and gradually stir in cornflakes and stir until well coated.
Drop from teaspoon onto waxed paper.
Decorate with cinnamon candies.
Leave to dry several hours or overnight.
recipes.text: Holly Cookies. Combine marshmallows, butter, vanilla and food coloring in top of a double boiler (or in a big heavy saucepan, my pressure cooker bottom). Heat until marshmallows and butter are melted, stirring frequently. Take from heat and gradually stir in cornflakes and stir until well coated. Drop from teaspoon onto waxed paper. Decorate with cinnamon candies. Leave to dry several hours or overnight.

recipes.title: Hot Potato(Microwave)
ingredients: 1/4 c. water, mixed with 1/2 tsp. salt
directions: Peel potatoes and slice thinly into a 2-quart baking dish. Add salt water.
Cover.
Cook on High for 18 minutes, stirring every 5 minutes.
Drain.
recipes.text: Hot Potato(Microwave). Peel potatoes and slice thinly into a 2-quart baking dish. Add salt water. Cover. Cook on High for 18 minutes, stirring every 5 minutes. Drain.

recipes.title: Lemon Dill Potatoes
directions: Bake potatoes 40 to 60 minutes.
Cut potatoes in half (long way).
Scoop out inside of potatoes, leaving potato shell.
Add all ingredients inside of potatoes.
Beat or mix together and fill in potato shells with stuffing.
Goes great with red meat, broccoli and a side of salad.
recipes.text: Lemon Dill Potatoes. Bake potatoes 40 to 60 minutes. Cut potatoes in half (long way). Scoop out inside of potatoes, leaving potato shell. Add all ingredients inside of potatoes. Beat or mix together and fill in potato shells with stuffing. Goes great with red meat, broccoli and a side of salad.

recipes.title: Quick Fruit Salad
directions: Combine all ingredients in a bowl.
Refrigerate until serving.
recipes.text: Quick Fruit Salad. Combine all ingredients in a bowl. Refrigerate until serving.

recipes.title: Egg Salad Sandwiches
directions: Mix together and add mayonnaise to make a spreading consistency.
Pickle relish may be added if desired.
Yields 6 sandwiches.
recipes.text: Egg Salad Sandwiches. Mix together and add mayonnaise to make a spreading consistency. Pickle relish may be added if desired. Yields 6 sandwiches.

recipes.title: Lime Applesauce Mold
ingredients: 1 (4 serving) envelope low calorie lime-flavored gelatin
1 c. low calorie lemon-lime carbonated beverage
directions: Combine applesauce and gelatin in saucepan.
Cook and stir until gelatin dissolves.
Slowly stir in the carbonated beverage. Pour into individual molds or 3-cup mold.
Chill until firm.
recipes.text: Lime Applesauce Mold. Combine applesauce and gelatin in saucepan. Cook and stir until gelatin dissolves. Slowly stir in the carbonated beverage. Pour into individual molds or 3-cup mold. Chill until firm.

recipes.title: Pie Crust Mix
directions: Mix flour, salt and sugar.
Blend in butter flavor Crisco with pastry blender, knives and forks until mixture resembles pebbles. Cover and refrigerate.
When needed, 1 1/2 cups for single crust, 2 1/2 cups for double crust.
Moisten with Sprite or 7-Up to hold together.
Roll out on floured board.
Proceed with favorite pie.
recipes.text: Pie Crust Mix. Mix flour, salt and sugar. Blend in butter flavor Crisco with pastry blender, knives and forks until mixture resembles pebbles. Cover and refrigerate. When needed, 1 1/2 cups for single crust, 2 1/2 cups for double crust. Moisten with Sprite or 7-Up to hold together. Roll out on floured board. Proceed with favorite pie.

recipes.title: Zucchini Brownies
directions: Mix and bake at 350° for 40 minutes.
Ice while warm.
recipes.text: Zucchini Brownies. Mix and bake at 350° for 40 minutes. Ice while warm.

recipes.title: Melon Colada
ingredients: 4 oz. thawed frozen or fresh watermelon (1/2 c.)
1 oz. cream of coconut syrup (Coco Lopez)
directions: Mix in blender with desired amount of ice for a slushy drink. Pour into tall glass.
Decorate with pineapple chunk and serve with a straw or two.
recipes.text: Melon Colada. Mix in blender with desired amount of ice for a slushy drink. Pour into tall glass. Decorate with pineapple chunk and serve with a straw or two.

recipes.title: Salmon Cheese Pate
directions: Blend cheeses with salmon and seasonings until smooth.
Mold into small bowl lined with plastic wrap.
Chill several hours. Unmold to serve, garnishing with sprigs of parsley.
Serve with crackers, toast rounds or thin rye bread.
recipes.text: Salmon Cheese Pate. Blend cheeses with salmon and seasonings until smooth. Mold into small bowl lined with plastic wrap. Chill several hours. Unmold to serve, garnishing with sprigs of parsley. Serve with crackers, toast rounds or thin rye bread.

recipes.title: Mexican Dip
ingredients: 1 (8 oz.) jar taco sauce or salsa
directions: Mix ingredients and chill.
Top with shredded Cheddar cheese, chopped tomatoes, green pepper, black olives and onions.
Serve with taco chips.
recipes.text: Mexican Dip. Mix ingredients and chill. Top with shredded Cheddar cheese, chopped tomatoes, green pepper, black olives and onions. Serve with taco chips.

recipes.title: Chicken Cacciatore(30 Minutes)
ingredients: 1 lb. boneless, skinless chicken breasts, cut into strips
1 medium green pepper, cut into thin strips
directions: Cook and stir chicken, onion and green pepper in hot oil in large skillet until lightly browned.
Add tomatoes, tomato sauce, garlic powder, oregano, salt and pepper.
Bring to boil.
Reduce heat and simmer 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, prepare 4 servings rice. Serve chicken and vegetables over rice.
recipes.text: Chicken Cacciatore(30 Minutes). Cook and stir chicken, onion and green pepper in hot oil in large skillet until lightly browned. Add tomatoes, tomato sauce, garlic powder, oregano, salt and pepper. Bring to boil. Reduce heat and simmer 5 minutes. Meanwhile, prepare 4 servings rice. Serve chicken and vegetables over rice.

recipes.title: Meat Loaf
directions: Preheat oven to 350° and grease a 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan. Thoroughly combine all ingredients but use only 1/2 of tomato sauce.
Turn meat mixture into loaf pan.
Smooth and top with rest of the tomato sauce.
recipes.text: Meat Loaf. Preheat oven to 350° and grease a 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan. Thoroughly combine all ingredients but use only 1/2 of tomato sauce. Turn meat mixture into loaf pan. Smooth and top with rest of the tomato sauce.

recipes.title: Kraut Salad
directions: Put kraut in colander and run cold water over it.
Drain. Heat vinegar and sugar until dissolved completely.
Cool slightly. Pour over mixture.
Let stand at least 3 hours.
recipes.text: Kraut Salad. Put kraut in colander and run cold water over it. Drain. Heat vinegar and sugar until dissolved completely. Cool slightly. Pour over mixture. Let stand at least 3 hours.

recipes.title: Hot Fudge Sauce
directions: Melt oleo and chocolate over low heat.
Stir in sugar, one cup at a time, being sure to blend well.
Mixture will be thick and dry.
Add salt and stir in milk gradually.
Continue to cook 7 to 8 minutes to blend and dissolve sugar.
Remove from heat.
Add vanilla.
Serve over ice cream.
Serve hot or cold.
recipes.text: Hot Fudge Sauce. Melt oleo and chocolate over low heat. Stir in sugar, one cup at a time, being sure to blend well. Mixture will be thick and dry. Add salt and stir in milk gradually. Continue to cook 7 to 8 minutes to blend and dissolve sugar. Remove from heat. Add vanilla. Serve over ice cream. Serve hot or cold.

recipes.title: Tammy'S Potatoes
directions: Wash and cube unpeeled potatoes; place in frying pan. Add the remaining ingredients; cover and cook over medium heat, stirring often. When potatoes are tender, remove cover and cook until water is cooked out.
recipes.text: Tammy'S Potatoes. Wash and cube unpeeled potatoes; place in frying pan. Add the remaining ingredients; cover and cook over medium heat, stirring often. When potatoes are tender, remove cover and cook until water is cooked out.

recipes.title: Chicken And Dumplings
ingredients: 1 hen, washed and cut into pieces
directions: Place chicken in pot and cook until done.
recipes.text: Chicken And Dumplings. Place chicken in pot and cook until done.

recipes.title: Corn And Bacon Muffins
directions: Preheat oven to 400°.
Grease standard muffin tins.
Fry bacon until crisp; drain to towels and cool.
Reserve 1/4 cup bacon drippings.
Crumble cooled bacon strips and set aside.
recipes.text: Corn And Bacon Muffins. Preheat oven to 400°. Grease standard muffin tins. Fry bacon until crisp; drain to towels and cool. Reserve 1/4 cup bacon drippings. Crumble cooled bacon strips and set aside.

recipes.title: Red Beans And Rice
ingredients: 4 Tbsp. Creole seasoning (I use Tony Chachere)
directions: Simmer beans in water.
After 1 1/2 hours, add onions, bell pepper, seasoning and sausage.
Add water as required.
Adjust seasoning as needed.
When beans are tender, start cooking rice. Serve over cooked white rice.
recipes.text: Red Beans And Rice. Simmer beans in water. After 1 1/2 hours, add onions, bell pepper, seasoning and sausage. Add water as required. Adjust seasoning as needed. When beans are tender, start cooking rice. Serve over cooked white rice.

recipes.title: Cookie Press Cookies
directions: Stir dry ingredients.
Cream butter and sugar.
Beat in egg and flavorings.
Add dry ingredients by halves.
Pack into cookie press and form desired shapes on ungreased cookie sheet.
Bake at 350° for 10 minutes.
recipes.text: Cookie Press Cookies. Stir dry ingredients. Cream butter and sugar. Beat in egg and flavorings. Add dry ingredients by halves. Pack into cookie press and form desired shapes on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 350° for 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Bread
directions: Sift together dry ingredients.
Make well in center of dry ingredients. Add salad oil, eggs, water and pumpkin.
Mix until smooth. Pour into 2 or 3 greased and floured 1 pound loaf pans. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
Yields 2 loaves.
recipes.text: Pumpkin Bread. Sift together dry ingredients. Make well in center of dry ingredients. Add salad oil, eggs, water and pumpkin. Mix until smooth. Pour into 2 or 3 greased and floured 1 pound loaf pans. Bake at 350° for 1 hour. Yields 2 loaves.

recipes.title: Fruit Cake
ingredients: 1 c. liquid jelly, molasses or coffee
directions: Use two 9 x 5-inch pans. Bake at 300° for 3 hours.
For an angel cake pan, bake 2 1/2 hours.
recipes.text: Fruit Cake. Use two 9 x 5-inch pans. Bake at 300° for 3 hours. For an angel cake pan, bake 2 1/2 hours.

recipes.title: Pudding Cheesecake In 15 Minutes(Choose Tart-Sweet Lemon Or Luscious Pineapple Cream Flavor)
ingredients: 1 pkg. Jell-O lemon or pineapple cream instant pudding
directions: Stir cream cheese until very soft.
Gradually blend in 1/2 cup of milk until smooth and creamy.
Add remaining milk and the pudding mix.
Beat slowly with eggbeater 1 minute (do not overbeat).
recipes.text: Pudding Cheesecake In 15 Minutes(Choose Tart-Sweet Lemon Or Luscious Pineapple Cream Flavor). Stir cream cheese until very soft. Gradually blend in 1/2 cup of milk until smooth and creamy. Add remaining milk and the pudding mix. Beat slowly with eggbeater 1 minute (do not overbeat).

recipes.title: Brownies
directions: Combine all in a bowl; mix well with spoon.
Spread in pan. Bake at 375° for no longer than 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Brownies. Combine all in a bowl; mix well with spoon. Spread in pan. Bake at 375° for no longer than 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Kraut And Pineapple
directions: Mix in saucepan.
Let it simmer for about 2 hours.
Serve with pork.
recipes.text: Kraut And Pineapple. Mix in saucepan. Let it simmer for about 2 hours. Serve with pork.

recipes.title: Banana Surprise
directions: Mash banana in a bowl until soft.
Add dash of nutmeg; stir. Add sprinkles, red and green sugar.
Stir.
Put in a drop of vanilla and drop of banana flavoring.
Stir with a toothpick.
Add food coloring; stir.
Serves one person.
recipes.text: Banana Surprise. Mash banana in a bowl until soft. Add dash of nutmeg; stir. Add sprinkles, red and green sugar. Stir. Put in a drop of vanilla and drop of banana flavoring. Stir with a toothpick. Add food coloring; stir. Serves one person.

recipes.title: Mediterranean Bread
ingredients: any kind of seeds to sprinkle (poppy seed, sunflower, etc.)
directions: Dissolve yeast in warm water.
Beat together sugar and soft butter then add salt, eggs and yeast.
Beat in 2 cups flour.
Once mixed add 2 cups more flour and mix with spoon or hands.
Knead on floured board and put in greased bowl.
Let rise to double (about 1 1/2 to 2 hours).	Note:

Dough will be sticky before kneading. Drain well and pat dry 1 cup each small ripe olives and green stuffed olives then slice.	Roll dough into a 14 x 16-inch rectangle.	Scatter olives evenly over dough and press in.	Roll tightly lengthwise and seal seams and ends well.
Note:
Not easy but water works fairly well to help seal seams.
Put on greased sheet and let rise again.
Brush with egg and sprinkle with whatever type of seeds you want.
Bake at 325° for 40 minutes.
recipes.text: Mediterranean Bread. Dissolve yeast in warm water. Beat together sugar and soft butter then add salt, eggs and yeast. Beat in 2 cups flour. Once mixed add 2 cups more flour and mix with spoon or hands. Knead on floured board and put in greased bowl. Let rise to double (about 1 1/2 to 2 hours).	Note: Dough will be sticky before kneading. Drain well and pat dry 1 cup each small ripe olives and green stuffed olives then slice.	Roll dough into a 14 x 16-inch rectangle.	Scatter olives evenly over dough and press in.	Roll tightly lengthwise and seal seams and ends well. Note: Not easy but water works fairly well to help seal seams. Put on greased sheet and let rise again. Brush with egg and sprinkle with whatever type of seeds you want. Bake at 325° for 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Spaghetti Sauce
ingredients: 1 (6 oz.) can tomato paste (use can to fill with water 3 times to add)
directions: In skillet, brown hamburger meat and onions. Drain. Add remaining ingredients and simmer.
recipes.text: Spaghetti Sauce. In skillet, brown hamburger meat and onions. Drain. Add remaining ingredients and simmer.

recipes.title: Barbecue Chicken
ingredients: 15 oz. bottle your favorite barbecue sauce
directions: Place chicken in crock-pot.
Add water, salt, pepper and garlic powder.
Cook on high until hot.
Cook on low overnight.
Cool, skin, bone and remove fat.
Pull apart and chop.
Add barbecue sauce; mix thoroughly.
Place in baking dish.
Bake at 300° for 1 1/2 hours.
recipes.text: Barbecue Chicken. Place chicken in crock-pot. Add water, salt, pepper and garlic powder. Cook on high until hot. Cook on low overnight. Cool, skin, bone and remove fat. Pull apart and chop. Add barbecue sauce; mix thoroughly. Place in baking dish. Bake at 300° for 1 1/2 hours.

recipes.title: Fresh Pineapple Compote
directions: Drain the lychees, reserving one-half cup of the syrup.
Mix the reserved syrup with the lime juice.
Cut the lychees into halves; toss with pineapple and orange sections.
Pour the syrup mixture over the fruit; cover and refrigerate.
Serves four to six.
recipes.text: Fresh Pineapple Compote. Drain the lychees, reserving one-half cup of the syrup. Mix the reserved syrup with the lime juice. Cut the lychees into halves; toss with pineapple and orange sections. Pour the syrup mixture over the fruit; cover and refrigerate. Serves four to six.

recipes.title: Overnight Bundt Coffee Cake
directions: Spray Bundt pan with Pam.
Sprinkle with nuts.
Place frozen dough rolls into pan.
Pour melted butter over dough.
Sprinkle with mixture of pudding mix, brown sugar and cinnamon.
Leave out on counter overnight to rise.
Bake first thing in the morning in 350° oven for 35 minutes.
Invert on platter and serve immediately.
recipes.text: Overnight Bundt Coffee Cake. Spray Bundt pan with Pam. Sprinkle with nuts. Place frozen dough rolls into pan. Pour melted butter over dough. Sprinkle with mixture of pudding mix, brown sugar and cinnamon. Leave out on counter overnight to rise. Bake first thing in the morning in 350° oven for 35 minutes. Invert on platter and serve immediately.

recipes.title: Spinach Squares
directions: Cook and drain spinach; melt the butter and cheese into spinach.
Mix all other ingredients into a bowl, then mix together.
More cheese can be used, if desired.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
Cool for 10 minutes, then cut and serve.
recipes.text: Spinach Squares. Cook and drain spinach; melt the butter and cheese into spinach. Mix all other ingredients into a bowl, then mix together. More cheese can be used, if desired. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes. Cool for 10 minutes, then cut and serve.

recipes.title: Pecan Pie
directions: Heat oven to 375°.
Beat eggs, sugar, salt, butter and syrup. Mix in pecan halves.
Pour into pastry lined pie pan.
Bake for 40 to 50 minutes, or until set.
Cool before serving.
recipes.text: Pecan Pie. Heat oven to 375°. Beat eggs, sugar, salt, butter and syrup. Mix in pecan halves. Pour into pastry lined pie pan. Bake for 40 to 50 minutes, or until set. Cool before serving.

recipes.title: Squash Casserolegroves, Texas
directions: Pour all ingredients into pyrex dish.
Sprinkle cracker crumbs and bake at 400° for about 30 minutes.
The touch of garlic powder will give it a special taste.
recipes.text: Squash Casserolegroves, Texas. Pour all ingredients into pyrex dish. Sprinkle cracker crumbs and bake at 400° for about 30 minutes. The touch of garlic powder will give it a special taste.

recipes.title: Broccoli Salad
directions: Prepare and cool bacon.
Crumble bacon and toss with the broccoli and onion. Pour dressing on and mix well.
recipes.text: Broccoli Salad. Prepare and cool bacon. Crumble bacon and toss with the broccoli and onion. Pour dressing on and mix well.

recipes.title: Doggie Oatmeal Peanut Butter Cookies
ingredients: 1/2 c. beef drippings or safflower oil
directions: In mixing bowl combine dry ingredients.
Stir in drippings or safflower oil, eggs, milk, peanut butter and brown sugar or honey. With hands, pat dough out on lightly floured board and cut into biscuits the size suitable for your breed.
Put cut outs on baking sheet and bake in a 350° oven for about 20 minutes.
recipes.text: Doggie Oatmeal Peanut Butter Cookies. In mixing bowl combine dry ingredients. Stir in drippings or safflower oil, eggs, milk, peanut butter and brown sugar or honey. With hands, pat dough out on lightly floured board and cut into biscuits the size suitable for your breed. Put cut outs on baking sheet and bake in a 350° oven for about 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Grilled Teriyaki Salmon
directions: Put seasoning on fish with 1/8 cup of water. Marinate overnight, skin side down. Place salmon on grill, medium-low, skin side down. Grill for 10 to 12 minutes, basting with olive oil every few minutes. Put onion rings on salmon 5 minutes into cooking. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese after salmon is removed from grill. Serves 4.
recipes.text: Grilled Teriyaki Salmon. Put seasoning on fish with 1/8 cup of water. Marinate overnight, skin side down. Place salmon on grill, medium-low, skin side down. Grill for 10 to 12 minutes, basting with olive oil every few minutes. Put onion rings on salmon 5 minutes into cooking. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese after salmon is removed from grill. Serves 4.

recipes.title: Chicken-Spinach-Mushroom Quiche
directions: Place pie shell in Pyrex pie plate.
Beat one egg and brush bottom of pie shell.
Cook spinach as directed.
Drain.
Beat other 4 eggs; add milk, salt, Tabasco sauce, mushrooms, drained spinach, onions, celery and bell pepper.
Toss together chicken, cheese and flour.
Stir into egg mixture.
Pour into pie crust. Bake in a preheated 400° oven on a cookie sheet for 20 to 25 minutes or until center puffs up slightly, or a knife inserted comes out clean.
Cool for 5 minutes!!!!
recipes.text: Chicken-Spinach-Mushroom Quiche. Place pie shell in Pyrex pie plate. Beat one egg and brush bottom of pie shell. Cook spinach as directed. Drain. Beat other 4 eggs; add milk, salt, Tabasco sauce, mushrooms, drained spinach, onions, celery and bell pepper. Toss together chicken, cheese and flour. Stir into egg mixture. Pour into pie crust. Bake in a preheated 400° oven on a cookie sheet for 20 to 25 minutes or until center puffs up slightly, or a knife inserted comes out clean. Cool for 5 minutes!!!!

recipes.title: Frog Eye Salad(Good Enough For Dessert)
ingredients: 1 large or 2 small cans mandarin oranges, well drained
1 large can pineapple tidbits, do not drain
1 (8 oz.) carton Cool Whip (use `lite' for fewer calories)
directions: Night before serving: Boil pasta 8 minutes, rinse and drain. In large bowl mix pasta, pudding, oranges, pineapple and juice. Refrigerate overnight.
recipes.text: Frog Eye Salad(Good Enough For Dessert). Night before serving: Boil pasta 8 minutes, rinse and drain. In large bowl mix pasta, pudding, oranges, pineapple and juice. Refrigerate overnight.

recipes.title: Fruit Cocktail Cake
directions: Cream sugar and Crisco.
Sift all dry ingredients together and add to the creamed mixture.
Add eggs and mix well.
Add a No. 2 can of fruit cocktail, undrained, to the mix and blend well.
Pour in a greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan.
Take 1/2 cup brown sugar and 1/2 cup chopped pecans and mix.
Sprinkle over top of the uncooked batter.
Bake at 325° for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Fruit Cocktail Cake. Cream sugar and Crisco. Sift all dry ingredients together and add to the creamed mixture. Add eggs and mix well. Add a No. 2 can of fruit cocktail, undrained, to the mix and blend well. Pour in a greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan. Take 1/2 cup brown sugar and 1/2 cup chopped pecans and mix. Sprinkle over top of the uncooked batter. Bake at 325° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Old Fashioned Light Fruit Cake
directions: Mix butter and sugar until creamed.
Add eggs, one at the time, beating after each addition until yolk is broken.
Then add flavoring.
Sift flour, salt, nutmeg and cinnamon together.
Add to sugar mixture gradually.
Work in nuts and fruit with a heavy spoon.
Pour into prepared pans filling 2/3 full.
Bake at 275°, tube pan about 3 hours, 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pans about 2 hours.
recipes.text: Old Fashioned Light Fruit Cake. Mix butter and sugar until creamed. Add eggs, one at the time, beating after each addition until yolk is broken. Then add flavoring. Sift flour, salt, nutmeg and cinnamon together. Add to sugar mixture gradually. Work in nuts and fruit with a heavy spoon. Pour into prepared pans filling 2/3 full. Bake at 275°, tube pan about 3 hours, 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pans about 2 hours.

recipes.title: Anna'S Sausage Rolls
directions: Mix flour, buttermilk and butter.
Roll out on floured surface.
Put sausage on dough.
Roll it up.
Cut into 1/4-inch pieces.
Bake at 450° until done.
recipes.text: Anna'S Sausage Rolls. Mix flour, buttermilk and butter. Roll out on floured surface. Put sausage on dough. Roll it up. Cut into 1/4-inch pieces. Bake at 450° until done.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Bread
directions: Place all dry ingredients in a bowl and make well in center. Add all other ingredients.
Stir well until moistened.
Bake in two large well-greased loaf pans at 350° for about 1 hour.
recipes.text: Pumpkin Bread. Place all dry ingredients in a bowl and make well in center. Add all other ingredients. Stir well until moistened. Bake in two large well-greased loaf pans at 350° for about 1 hour.

recipes.title: Cowboy Cookies
directions: Mix sugar, oil, eggs and vanilla together.
Mix flour, baking soda, baking powder and salt together.
Add to mixture.
Mix the rest of the ingredients together and add.
Mix well.
Roll mixture into 2-inch balls and flatten.
Bake at 350° on ungreased cookie sheet for 10 to 12 minutes.
recipes.text: Cowboy Cookies. Mix sugar, oil, eggs and vanilla together. Mix flour, baking soda, baking powder and salt together. Add to mixture. Mix the rest of the ingredients together and add. Mix well. Roll mixture into 2-inch balls and flatten. Bake at 350° on ungreased cookie sheet for 10 to 12 minutes.

recipes.title: Swedish Meatballs
ingredients: 1 lb. mixed ground meat (beef, pork, veal)
dash of white or black pepper
directions: In a bowl, combine bread crumbs and water.
Let soak for 5 minutes.
Peel onion.
Grate finely.
In another bowl, combine meat, grated onion, salt, pepper and egg.
Add crumb mixture. Combine until well blended.
Roll meat mixture into even meatballs with hands.
In a skillet, heat butter until melted and lightly browned.
Add meatballs, a few at a time.
Shake pan constantly and cook meatballs until brown all around and cooked through. Remove.
recipes.text: Swedish Meatballs. In a bowl, combine bread crumbs and water. Let soak for 5 minutes. Peel onion. Grate finely. In another bowl, combine meat, grated onion, salt, pepper and egg. Add crumb mixture. Combine until well blended. Roll meat mixture into even meatballs with hands. In a skillet, heat butter until melted and lightly browned. Add meatballs, a few at a time. Shake pan constantly and cook meatballs until brown all around and cooked through. Remove.

recipes.title: Spice Or Holiday Tea Mix
directions: Mix all ingredients. Store in a covered container. When ready to serve, add 2 tsp. to 1 cup boiling water.
recipes.text: Spice Or Holiday Tea Mix. Mix all ingredients. Store in a covered container. When ready to serve, add 2 tsp. to 1 cup boiling water.

recipes.title: Shark Swim
ingredients: 1 lb. shark fillets, cut in 1-inch pieces
directions: Chop up tomatoes and simmer the whole shebang, except the fish. Simmer about 20 minutes to cook vegetables, then add the shark and simmer another 10 minutes to cook it through.
recipes.text: Shark Swim. Chop up tomatoes and simmer the whole shebang, except the fish. Simmer about 20 minutes to cook vegetables, then add the shark and simmer another 10 minutes to cook it through.

recipes.title: Million Dollar Pie
directions: Mix Eagle Brand milk and lemon juice.
Fold in remaining ingredients in order listed.
Fill pie crusts and refrigerate.
recipes.text: Million Dollar Pie. Mix Eagle Brand milk and lemon juice. Fold in remaining ingredients in order listed. Fill pie crusts and refrigerate.

recipes.title: Squash And Apple Bake
ingredients: 2 apples, cored and cut into slices
directions: Heat oven to 350°.
Cut each squash in half.
Remove seeds and fibers.
Pare squash; cut into 1/2-inch slices.
Stir together sugar, margarine, flour, cinnamon and salt.
Arrange squash in baking dish (11 1/2 x 7 1/2 x 1 1/2-inches).
Top with apples. Sprinkle with sugar mixture.
Cover with foil.
Bake 50 to 60 minutes or until squash is tender.
recipes.text: Squash And Apple Bake. Heat oven to 350°. Cut each squash in half. Remove seeds and fibers. Pare squash; cut into 1/2-inch slices. Stir together sugar, margarine, flour, cinnamon and salt. Arrange squash in baking dish (11 1/2 x 7 1/2 x 1 1/2-inches). Top with apples. Sprinkle with sugar mixture. Cover with foil. Bake 50 to 60 minutes or until squash is tender.

recipes.title: Broccoli Cornbread
ingredients: 1 c. cottage cheese (add a little milk to be able to pour)
directions: Mix all ingredients.
Spray dish with Pam cooking spray.
Bake at 300° to 325°° for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Broccoli Cornbread. Mix all ingredients. Spray dish with Pam cooking spray. Bake at 300° to 325°° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Moist Bread Stuffing
ingredients: 1/2 to 3/4 c. butter, margarine or salad oil
3 qt. day old bread crumbs or 1/2-inch squares (12 c.), lightly packed
directions: In large kettle, combine water, butter and onion.
Simmer for 5 minutes.
Add rest of ingredients; mix well.
Will stuff body cavity of 8-pound turkey.
recipes.text: Moist Bread Stuffing. In large kettle, combine water, butter and onion. Simmer for 5 minutes. Add rest of ingredients; mix well. Will stuff body cavity of 8-pound turkey.

recipes.title: Barbecue Hot Dogs
directions: Cook onion in oil until soft.
Add ketchup, tomato sauce, mustard, vinegar and brown sugar.
Simmer until cooks down a bit and add slashed hot dogs.
Cook until sauce thickens and dogs are done.
Meat balls can also be simmered in this sauce.
recipes.text: Barbecue Hot Dogs. Cook onion in oil until soft. Add ketchup, tomato sauce, mustard, vinegar and brown sugar. Simmer until cooks down a bit and add slashed hot dogs. Cook until sauce thickens and dogs are done. Meat balls can also be simmered in this sauce.

recipes.title: Mulled Cider
ingredients: 3 (3-inch each) cinnamon sticks plus additional for garnish
directions: Combine cider, orange juice, lemon juice, sugar, 3 cinnamon sticks, cloves and nutmeg in a heavy saucepan.
Heat over medium heat to boiling.
Keep on stove over low heat.
Strain.
Serve with a cinnamon stick in mugs.
recipes.text: Mulled Cider. Combine cider, orange juice, lemon juice, sugar, 3 cinnamon sticks, cloves and nutmeg in a heavy saucepan. Heat over medium heat to boiling. Keep on stove over low heat. Strain. Serve with a cinnamon stick in mugs.

recipes.title: Champagne Punch(Non-Alcoholic)
directions: Mix together and chill.
Makes an elegant punch for a special occasion.
recipes.text: Champagne Punch(Non-Alcoholic). Mix together and chill. Makes an elegant punch for a special occasion.

recipes.title: Breakfast Casserole
directions: Brown sausage in skillet and drain.
Combine half and half, eggs and salt.
Mix well.
Layer bread, sausage and cheese in a 10 x 15-inch baking dish.
Pour egg mixture over layers. Chill overnight, covered.
Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 45 minutes or until golden brown. Serves 12.
recipes.text: Breakfast Casserole. Brown sausage in skillet and drain. Combine half and half, eggs and salt. Mix well. Layer bread, sausage and cheese in a 10 x 15-inch baking dish. Pour egg mixture over layers. Chill overnight, covered. Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 45 minutes or until golden brown. Serves 12.

recipes.title: Monkey Bread
directions: Cut each biscuit into four pieces; set aside.
Mix the sugar and cinnamon.
Roll pieces in mixture or put a portion of sugar mixture in a small clean paper bag and drop in a few pieces of biscuit.
Shake to coat.
Repeat until all pieces are coated.
recipes.text: Monkey Bread. Cut each biscuit into four pieces; set aside. Mix the sugar and cinnamon. Roll pieces in mixture or put a portion of sugar mixture in a small clean paper bag and drop in a few pieces of biscuit. Shake to coat. Repeat until all pieces are coated.

recipes.title: Toll House Pie
directions: Preheat oven to 325°.
In large mixer bowl, beat eggs at high speed until foamy, about 3 minutes. Beat in flour and sugars until well blended.
Beat in butter.
Stir in chocolate chips and nuts. Pour into pie shell.
Bake 55 to 60 minutes until knife comes out clean and top is golden brown.
Cool completely.
recipes.text: Toll House Pie. Preheat oven to 325°. In large mixer bowl, beat eggs at high speed until foamy, about 3 minutes. Beat in flour and sugars until well blended. Beat in butter. Stir in chocolate chips and nuts. Pour into pie shell. Bake 55 to 60 minutes until knife comes out clean and top is golden brown. Cool completely.

recipes.title: Potato Salad
ingredients: 6 heaping Tbsp. sweet pickle salad cubes
directions: Peel potatoes; boil until done.
Cut into cubes or mash the potatoes.
Add
diced,
boiled
eggs.
Save
other
for decorative
appearance.
Add
rest
of
ingredients
and
mix thoroughly.
Take
last
egg and start from the pointed end of egg and cut
or
lines down to bottom of egg; do not cut flat part of egg, and only cut through the white of egg.
Very carefully set
the
flat part of egg into middle of the potato salad and
gently
start
at
the top and peel the white stems down to form flower.
Paprika can be sprinkled over top.
recipes.text: Potato Salad. Peel potatoes; boil until done. Cut into cubes or mash the potatoes. Add 5 diced, boiled eggs. Save other for decorative appearance. Add rest of ingredients and mix thoroughly. Take last egg and start from the pointed end of egg and cut 5 or 6 lines down to bottom of egg; do not cut flat part of egg, and only cut through the white of egg. Very carefully set the flat part of egg into middle of the potato salad and gently start at the top and peel the white stems down to form flower. Paprika can be sprinkled over top.

recipes.title: Faye'S Cheese Ball
directions: Mix all ingredients in bowl; chill overnight in refrigerator. Form into ball and roll in 1 cup finely chopped pecans.
Serve with crackers.
recipes.text: Faye'S Cheese Ball. Mix all ingredients in bowl; chill overnight in refrigerator. Form into ball and roll in 1 cup finely chopped pecans. Serve with crackers.

recipes.title: Art'S Mint Brownies
ingredients: 1 tsp. each: milk and mint flavoring
directions: Preheat oven to 350°.
In a bowl, beat together the first 6 ingredients to make brownie layer.
Pour into greased 9 x 13-inch pan.
Bake 20 to 30 minutes until firm.
Cool.
recipes.text: Art'S Mint Brownies. Preheat oven to 350°. In a bowl, beat together the first 6 ingredients to make brownie layer. Pour into greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake 20 to 30 minutes until firm. Cool.

recipes.title: Cake Mix Cookies
directions: Mix in bowl with wooden spoon.
Batter will be very stiff. Drop on cookie sheet (greased) the size of walnuts.
Bake at 350° for 8 to 10 minutes.
Makes 8 dozen small cookies (2 dozen to a cookie sheet).
recipes.text: Cake Mix Cookies. Mix in bowl with wooden spoon. Batter will be very stiff. Drop on cookie sheet (greased) the size of walnuts. Bake at 350° for 8 to 10 minutes. Makes 8 dozen small cookies (2 dozen to a cookie sheet).

recipes.title: Crisp Sweet Slaw
directions: Mix all vegetables.
Whisk together the vinegar, apple juice, oil, Sweet 'N Low, celery seed, dry mustard, salt and pepper. Pour over vegetables; toss to coat.
Refrigerate until served. Makes 8 servings.
recipes.text: Crisp Sweet Slaw. Mix all vegetables. Whisk together the vinegar, apple juice, oil, Sweet 'N Low, celery seed, dry mustard, salt and pepper. Pour over vegetables; toss to coat. Refrigerate until served. Makes 8 servings.

recipes.title: Butterfinger Bars
directions: Melt 2 sticks
of
oleo
in a large pan.
Add the brown sugar and
white sugar.
Mix thoroughly.	Add oatmeal and mix. Pat this into a 15 x 10-inch jelly roll pan.
Bake at 350° for 15 minutes. Melt
chocolate
chips
over
low
heat.
Mix
in peanut butter. Spread this over the bars.	Enjoy!
recipes.text: Butterfinger Bars. Melt 2 sticks of oleo in a large pan. Add the brown sugar and white sugar. Mix thoroughly.	Add oatmeal and mix. Pat this into a 15 x 10-inch jelly roll pan. Bake at 350° for 15 minutes. Melt chocolate chips over low heat. Mix in peanut butter. Spread this over the bars.	Enjoy!

recipes.title: Sloppy Joes
directions: Brown ground meat with chopped onion.
Stir to separate meat particles.
Add soup, mustard, ketchup and pepper.
Simmer 5 minutes.
Spoon onto 8 split, toasted buns.
recipes.text: Sloppy Joes. Brown ground meat with chopped onion. Stir to separate meat particles. Add soup, mustard, ketchup and pepper. Simmer 5 minutes. Spoon onto 8 split, toasted buns.

recipes.title: Cheese Ball
ingredients: 2 (8 oz.) pkg. cream cheese, softened to room temperature
1 box Winespread sharp Cheddar cheese spread
directions: Cream together the cheeses, garlic powder, onion powder and Worcestershire sauce.
Mix well.
Shape into a ball.
Put in freezer for 15 minutes.
Roll in walnuts and parsley flakes.
Will stay fresh for 4 weeks, if refrigerated.
Serve with crackers. Enjoy!!
recipes.text: Cheese Ball. Cream together the cheeses, garlic powder, onion powder and Worcestershire sauce. Mix well. Shape into a ball. Put in freezer for 15 minutes. Roll in walnuts and parsley flakes. Will stay fresh for 4 weeks, if refrigerated. Serve with crackers. Enjoy!!

recipes.title: Cheese Spread
ingredients: 1 small can crushed pineapple, drained (save juice)
directions: Mix all ingredients together.
If too thick, add some pineapple juice.
recipes.text: Cheese Spread. Mix all ingredients together. If too thick, add some pineapple juice.

recipes.title: Buster Bar Dessert
directions: Mix butter and Oreo cookie crumbs.
Spread in pan.
Spread ice cream over cookie mixture.
Sprinkle peanuts over ice cream.
Pour chocolate syrup on top.
Freeze until hard.
recipes.text: Buster Bar Dessert. Mix butter and Oreo cookie crumbs. Spread in pan. Spread ice cream over cookie mixture. Sprinkle peanuts over ice cream. Pour chocolate syrup on top. Freeze until hard.

recipes.title: Cherry Nut Cake
directions: Sift together flour, salt and baking powder.
Set aside.
Cream shortening; add confectioners sugar (gradually) and almond extract. Add eggs one at a time.
Add milk to dry ingredients.
Blend together; add cherries and walnuts.
Bake at 350° until brown.
Let cool; smooth top with butter.
Sprinkle with cinnamon and confectioners sugar.
recipes.text: Cherry Nut Cake. Sift together flour, salt and baking powder. Set aside. Cream shortening; add confectioners sugar (gradually) and almond extract. Add eggs one at a time. Add milk to dry ingredients. Blend together; add cherries and walnuts. Bake at 350° until brown. Let cool; smooth top with butter. Sprinkle with cinnamon and confectioners sugar.

recipes.title: Hot German Potato Salad
directions: Cook potatoes; cool and diced.
Fry bacon; drain.
Brown onions in bacon fat until lightly browned.
Blend in flour, sugar, salt, celery seed and pepper.
Cook over low heat until smooth. Remove from heat.
Add vinegar and water.
Heat to a boil 1 minute.
Stir in potatoes and crumbled bacon.
recipes.text: Hot German Potato Salad. Cook potatoes; cool and diced. Fry bacon; drain. Brown onions in bacon fat until lightly browned. Blend in flour, sugar, salt, celery seed and pepper. Cook over low heat until smooth. Remove from heat. Add vinegar and water. Heat to a boil 1 minute. Stir in potatoes and crumbled bacon.

recipes.title: Dusty Cream Frosting
ingredients: 1 tsp. milk or cream (may need more)
directions: Soften cream cheese and blend in vanilla.
Sift sugar and cocoa together and gradually add to cream cheese.
Blend thoroughly.
If too stiff to spread, add milk or cream, one teaspoon at a time until desired consistency is reached.
recipes.text: Dusty Cream Frosting. Soften cream cheese and blend in vanilla. Sift sugar and cocoa together and gradually add to cream cheese. Blend thoroughly. If too stiff to spread, add milk or cream, one teaspoon at a time until desired consistency is reached.

recipes.title: Vegetable Salad
directions: Add all the ingredients in a large bowl and add salad dressing.
Mix well.
Add or omit any vegetables you personally do not like.
recipes.text: Vegetable Salad. Add all the ingredients in a large bowl and add salad dressing. Mix well. Add or omit any vegetables you personally do not like.

recipes.title: French Bread
directions: Cool boiling water and butter until lukewarm.
Dissolve yeast in 1/4 cup warm water with sugar added.
Combine yeast mixture with water mixture.
Pour liquid mixture in large mixing bowl and stir in 3 cups flour and salt gradually.
Then add 1 1/2 cups flour by hand and knead 1 minute.
Put in a greased bowl with lid and let rise 1 1/2 hours or until doubled; divide in two parts and form loaves long and thin.
Place on cookie sheet and let rise 30 minutes.
Before baking, beat 1 egg white and 1 teaspoon cold water and glaze bread loaves.
Seeds may be added on top of loaves.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until golden brown and sounds hollow when tapped with knife.
recipes.text: French Bread. Cool boiling water and butter until lukewarm. Dissolve yeast in 1/4 cup warm water with sugar added. Combine yeast mixture with water mixture. Pour liquid mixture in large mixing bowl and stir in 3 cups flour and salt gradually. Then add 1 1/2 cups flour by hand and knead 1 minute. Put in a greased bowl with lid and let rise 1 1/2 hours or until doubled; divide in two parts and form loaves long and thin. Place on cookie sheet and let rise 30 minutes. Before baking, beat 1 egg white and 1 teaspoon cold water and glaze bread loaves. Seeds may be added on top of loaves. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until golden brown and sounds hollow when tapped with knife.

recipes.title: Crawfish Etouffee
ingredients: 1 lb. cleaned crawfish tails, including crawfish fat
directions: Saute onions and celery in margarine until soft.
Add everything, including fat which adds much of the flavor, except the crawfish tails and simmer for 10 minutes, sprinkling the flour over the contents of the pan.
This is to give the sauce a little body and you can add more, if you like.
Now, add the crawfish tails and water (2 cups or more, depending on the fact you may need to serve 2 or more additional persons); simmer for 15 minutes.
Serve over cooked rice.
recipes.text: Crawfish Etouffee. Saute onions and celery in margarine until soft. Add everything, including fat which adds much of the flavor, except the crawfish tails and simmer for 10 minutes, sprinkling the flour over the contents of the pan. This is to give the sauce a little body and you can add more, if you like. Now, add the crawfish tails and water (2 cups or more, depending on the fact you may need to serve 2 or more additional persons); simmer for 15 minutes. Serve over cooked rice.

recipes.title: Frosted Coffee And Raisin Squares
directions: Put the soda in the warm coffee, then melt margarine in coffee also. Cook raisins just a little in hot water in microwave or on top of stove.
Place brown sugar in
mixing bowl. Add coffee mixture and egg.
Beat.
Mix together and add the flour, baking powder, cinnamon, cloves and nutmeg.
Add raisins.
Spread in a greased jelly roll pan.
Bake at 350° for 15 minutes.
Frost with powdered sugar frosting.
recipes.text: Frosted Coffee And Raisin Squares. Put the soda in the warm coffee, then melt margarine in coffee also. Cook raisins just a little in hot water in microwave or on top of stove. Place brown sugar in mixing bowl. Add coffee mixture and egg. Beat. Mix together and add the flour, baking powder, cinnamon, cloves and nutmeg. Add raisins. Spread in a greased jelly roll pan. Bake at 350° for 15 minutes. Frost with powdered sugar frosting.

recipes.title: Buttermilk Pound Cake
directions: Mix all ingredients together and place in greased tube pan. Bake at 325° for 1 hour and 10 minutes.
recipes.text: Buttermilk Pound Cake. Mix all ingredients together and place in greased tube pan. Bake at 325° for 1 hour and 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Zucchini Squares
directions: Mix all the ingredients together.
Grease a 13 X 9 casserole dish.
Spoon mixture into casserole dish.
Bake at 350 for
45 minutes to an hour, uncovered.
recipes.text: Zucchini Squares. Mix all the ingredients together. Grease a 13 X 9 casserole dish. Spoon mixture into casserole dish. Bake at 350 for 45 minutes to an hour, uncovered.

recipes.title: Beef Stroganoff
directions: Dip thawed fish in milk.
Season with salt and pepper.
Roll in bread crumbs.
Place in baking dish.
Brush with melted butter. Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.
recipes.text: Beef Stroganoff. Dip thawed fish in milk. Season with salt and pepper. Roll in bread crumbs. Place in baking dish. Brush with melted butter. Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Cauliflower Salad
ingredients: 1/2 c. onion or green onions, chopped
directions: Put the ingredients in a large bowl in the order given.
Cover bowl well.
Let stand overnight.
Mix when ready to serve.
recipes.text: Cauliflower Salad. Put the ingredients in a large bowl in the order given. Cover bowl well. Let stand overnight. Mix when ready to serve.

recipes.title: Oreo Cookie Dessert
directions: Crush cookies; set aside 1/2 cup.
Mix cookie crumbs with melted oleo.
Press into a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Chill 1 hour.
recipes.text: Oreo Cookie Dessert. Crush cookies; set aside 1/2 cup. Mix cookie crumbs with melted oleo. Press into a 9 x 13-inch pan. Chill 1 hour.

recipes.title: Gloria'S Famous Party Dip
directions: Mix together with hand mixer and serve with chips, crackers or vegetables.
recipes.text: Gloria'S Famous Party Dip. Mix together with hand mixer and serve with chips, crackers or vegetables.

recipes.title: Pasta Salad
ingredients: 1 can black olives, cut in half
directions: Cook pasta according to directions on package. Stir in remaining ingredients. Chill and serve.
recipes.text: Pasta Salad. Cook pasta according to directions on package. Stir in remaining ingredients. Chill and serve.

recipes.title: Dot'S Five Flavor Pound Cake
directions: Mix butter, Crisco, sugar, eggs, cake flour, baking powder and milk.
Add flavorings.
Blend together well until smooth.
Bake in tube pan at 325° for 1 hour and 15 minutes.
recipes.text: Dot'S Five Flavor Pound Cake. Mix butter, Crisco, sugar, eggs, cake flour, baking powder and milk. Add flavorings. Blend together well until smooth. Bake in tube pan at 325° for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Stuffed Ham Rolls
ingredients: 2 thin slices fully cooked smoked ham
2 Tbsp. shredded Monterey Jack or Swiss cheese
1/2 pkg. (6 oz.) frozen cooked crab meat
directions: Rinse frozen asparagus under cold running water to separate. Place one frozen stick of crab meat and 2 asparagus spears on narrow end of each ham slice.
Roll up and secure with a wooden pick.
Place rolls, seam side down, in an ungreased 8 or 9-inch baking dish.
Cook uncovered in 350° oven about 15 minutes. Sprinkle with cheese.
Cook uncovered until crab meat is hot and cheese is melted, about 5 minutes.
ner: thin slices fully cooked smoked ham
recipes.text: Stuffed Ham Rolls. Rinse frozen asparagus under cold running water to separate. Place one frozen stick of crab meat and 2 asparagus spears on narrow end of each ham slice. Roll up and secure with a wooden pick. Place rolls, seam side down, in an ungreased 8 or 9-inch baking dish. Cook uncovered in 350° oven about 15 minutes. Sprinkle with cheese. Cook uncovered until crab meat is hot and cheese is melted, about 5 minutes.

recipes.title: Shepherd'S Pie
directions: Brown ground beef and place in 13 x 9-inch pan.
Slightly cook peas and carrots.
Then layer on top of beef.
Pour gravy over this.
With three potatoes, make mashed potatoes, slightly firm. Cover meat and vegetables with mashed potatoes.
Sprinkle cheese over the top.
Bake 20 to 25 minutes at 350°.
recipes.text: Shepherd'S Pie. Brown ground beef and place in 13 x 9-inch pan. Slightly cook peas and carrots. Then layer on top of beef. Pour gravy over this. With three potatoes, make mashed potatoes, slightly firm. Cover meat and vegetables with mashed potatoes. Sprinkle cheese over the top. Bake 20 to 25 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Tarte 'A La Tomate
directions: Bake shell and cool. Sprinkle tomatoes with salt and drain for 30 min. Preheat oven to 375°. Put cheese overlapping, in pastry shell. Place tomatoes side by side on top of cheese. Sprinkle with pepper, basil and parmesan cheese.
Dribble margarine over tomatoes. Bake on top rack, for 25 min., or until cheese is melted.
recipes.text: Tarte 'A La Tomate. Bake shell and cool. Sprinkle tomatoes with salt and drain for 30 min. Preheat oven to 375°. Put cheese overlapping, in pastry shell. Place tomatoes side by side on top of cheese. Sprinkle with pepper, basil and parmesan cheese. Dribble margarine over tomatoes. Bake on top rack, for 25 min., or until cheese is melted.

recipes.title: Hawaiian Salad
directions: Mix together and chill.
recipes.text: Hawaiian Salad. Mix together and chill.

recipes.title: Petite French Cheesecake
ingredients: 1 can pie filling (blueberry, cherry, strawberry, peach, etc.)
directions: Mix first four ingredients until creamy and fluffy.
Place 1 wafer in bottom of cupcake liner in cupcake tin.
Fill each cup 2/3 full with mixture and bake at 350° for 20 minutes.
When cool, garnish with filling.
recipes.text: Petite French Cheesecake. Mix first four ingredients until creamy and fluffy. Place 1 wafer in bottom of cupcake liner in cupcake tin. Fill each cup 2/3 full with mixture and bake at 350° for 20 minutes. When cool, garnish with filling.

recipes.title: Cheese Cake
directions: Mix crumbs and butter together and line pie plate.
Mix together the cream cheese, sugar and lemon juice.
Whip one package Dream Whip and mix with the cheese mixture.
Place in shell and cover with pie filling.
It can be cherry, pineapple or blueberry.
Freeze before serving.
recipes.text: Cheese Cake. Mix crumbs and butter together and line pie plate. Mix together the cream cheese, sugar and lemon juice. Whip one package Dream Whip and mix with the cheese mixture. Place in shell and cover with pie filling. It can be cherry, pineapple or blueberry. Freeze before serving.

recipes.title: Rosettes
directions: Beat eggs slightly with sugar and salt; add flour and milk. Beat until smooth.
Set aside to set.
This is a must, as it prevents bubbles remaining on top of batter.
Using a deep frypan, heat oil to 320°.
Place rosette iron in the oil to be heated. When oil reaches 320° remove iron, tapping it lightly against the edge of pan.
Dip hot iron into batter, being careful not to spill batter over top edge of iron.
Immerse rosette in hot oil for at least 20 seconds to obtain light brown color.
recipes.text: Rosettes. Beat eggs slightly with sugar and salt; add flour and milk. Beat until smooth. Set aside to set. This is a must, as it prevents bubbles remaining on top of batter. Using a deep frypan, heat oil to 320°. Place rosette iron in the oil to be heated. When oil reaches 320° remove iron, tapping it lightly against the edge of pan. Dip hot iron into batter, being careful not to spill batter over top edge of iron. Immerse rosette in hot oil for at least 20 seconds to obtain light brown color.

recipes.title: Peas And Broccoli Casserole
ingredients: 1 (10 3/4 oz.) can cream of mushroom soup
directions: Arrange one package of broccoli (thawed) in bottom of 13 x 9-inch pan.
Cover with peas.
Mix soup, mayonnaise, salt, pepper, onions, cheese and eggs.
Pour 1/2 sauce over broccoli.
Put next package of broccoli and remaining sauce.
Top with crushed crackers.
Bake for 30 minutes in 350° oven.
recipes.text: Peas And Broccoli Casserole. Arrange one package of broccoli (thawed) in bottom of 13 x 9-inch pan. Cover with peas. Mix soup, mayonnaise, salt, pepper, onions, cheese and eggs. Pour 1/2 sauce over broccoli. Put next package of broccoli and remaining sauce. Top with crushed crackers. Bake for 30 minutes in 350° oven.

recipes.title: Low-Fat Fettuccine Supreme
directions: In blender, combine Ricotta cheese and milk and process until smooth; set aside.
recipes.text: Low-Fat Fettuccine Supreme. In blender, combine Ricotta cheese and milk and process until smooth; set aside.

recipes.title: Economy Punch
directions: Mix all ingredients in large punch bowl.
recipes.text: Economy Punch. Mix all ingredients in large punch bowl.

recipes.title: Beef Marinade
directions: Place beef in marinade and refrigerate for 2 to 3 days.
recipes.text: Beef Marinade. Place beef in marinade and refrigerate for 2 to 3 days.

recipes.title: Cinnamon Bubbly Rolls
ingredients: 3 small cans flaky biscuits, or one large can
directions: Preheat oven to 350°. Mix sugar and cinnamon in a large plastic bag. Cut biscuits into quarters, put them in the bag, and shake well to coat. Spray a large tube pan with cooking spray. Put a couple of small pieces of butter around, then sprinkle with nuts. Pile biscuits pieces into the pan. Meanwhile, mix butter, sugar and cinnamon in a small saucepan and bring to a boil. Pour over biscuits and bake at 350° for 35 minutes or so. Put a large serving platter over the pan and invert the biscuits to serve.
recipes.text: Cinnamon Bubbly Rolls. Preheat oven to 350°. Mix sugar and cinnamon in a large plastic bag. Cut biscuits into quarters, put them in the bag, and shake well to coat. Spray a large tube pan with cooking spray. Put a couple of small pieces of butter around, then sprinkle with nuts. Pile biscuits pieces into the pan. Meanwhile, mix butter, sugar and cinnamon in a small saucepan and bring to a boil. Pour over biscuits and bake at 350° for 35 minutes or so. Put a large serving platter over the pan and invert the biscuits to serve.

recipes.title: Meat Loaf
directions: Mix together and spread over loaf.
Return to oven and bake 10 minutes longer.
recipes.text: Meat Loaf. Mix together and spread over loaf. Return to oven and bake 10 minutes longer.

recipes.title: Potato Soup
directions: Place potatoes and onion in a large soup kettle.
Add water just to cover and bring to a boil.
Simmer until potatoes are just tender.
Add remaining ingredients and season to taste.
Heat through and serve at once.
Serves 4. Preparation Time:
1 hour.
recipes.text: Potato Soup. Place potatoes and onion in a large soup kettle. Add water just to cover and bring to a boil. Simmer until potatoes are just tender. Add remaining ingredients and season to taste. Heat through and serve at once. Serves 4. Preparation Time: 1 hour.

recipes.title: Italian Cream Cake
directions: Combine margarine, shortening and sugar.
recipes.text: Italian Cream Cake. Combine margarine, shortening and sugar.

recipes.title: Almond Biscotti(Servings:  4)
ingredients: 2 1/2 c. flour (may use part whole wheat)
1 c. slivered almonds or almond pieces
1 extra egg yolk, mixed with a little water
directions: Mix together first 5 ingredients.
Sift together cinnamon, baking powder, cloves and flour.
Add to first mixture along with the almonds.
Separate dough into 3 parts and roll each part into a rope.

Place on greased or oiled cookie sheet and flatten. Brush with mixture of egg yolk and water (you needn't use all). Bake at 375° for 20 minutes or until center is slightly firm. Cool slightly on rack.
Slice diagonally with sharp knife.
recipes.text: Almond Biscotti(Servings:  4). Mix together first 5 ingredients. Sift together cinnamon, baking powder, cloves and flour. Add to first mixture along with the almonds. Separate dough into 3 parts and roll each part into a rope. Place on greased or oiled cookie sheet and flatten. Brush with mixture of egg yolk and water (you needn't use all). Bake at 375° for 20 minutes or until center is slightly firm. Cool slightly on rack. Slice diagonally with sharp knife.

recipes.title: Gravy Baked Pork Chops
directions: Sprinkle chops with salt and pepper.
Brown in shortening. Pour off drippings.
Combine soup, milk and water.
Pour over chops.
Cover with foil.
Bake for 45 minutes in 350° oven.
Stir gravy and serve over rice.
recipes.text: Gravy Baked Pork Chops. Sprinkle chops with salt and pepper. Brown in shortening. Pour off drippings. Combine soup, milk and water. Pour over chops. Cover with foil. Bake for 45 minutes in 350° oven. Stir gravy and serve over rice.

recipes.title: Apple Pie
directions: Combine sugar, flour, spices, salt and lemon juice.
Add apples; toss to mix.
Roll out pastry dough for crust and top.
Cut vents in top piece.
Line pie pan with pastry and cut off overhang. Fill with half the apples and dot with butter.
Add remaining apples.
Moisten rim with water.
Adjust top crust.
Leave about 1/2-inch pastry beyond edge.
Fold in under lower pastry.
Seal rim by pressing together and flute it.
Brush with milk.
Bake at 400° for 50 to 60 minutes or until apples test done with fork.
For a single crust, use a 425° oven.
recipes.text: Apple Pie. Combine sugar, flour, spices, salt and lemon juice. Add apples; toss to mix. Roll out pastry dough for crust and top. Cut vents in top piece.
