Line pie pan with pastry and cut off overhang. Fill with half the apples and dot with butter. Add remaining apples. Moisten rim with water. Adjust top crust. Leave about 1/2-inch pastry beyond edge. Fold in under lower pastry. Seal rim by pressing together and flute it. Brush with milk. Bake at 400° for 50 to 60 minutes or until apples test done with fork. For a single crust, use a 425° oven.

recipes.title: Date Nut Bread
directions: Pour boiling water over chopped dates.
Add butter or shortening, sugar and salt; mix well and let cool.
Add eggs and vanilla and mix; sift dry ingredients together and add to mixture. Add nuts and mix well.
Makes one large loaf or 2 small loaves; bake at 350° for 50 to 60 minutes.
recipes.text: Date Nut Bread. Pour boiling water over chopped dates. Add butter or shortening, sugar and salt; mix well and let cool. Add eggs and vanilla and mix; sift dry ingredients together and add to mixture. Add nuts and mix well. Makes one large loaf or 2 small loaves; bake at 350° for 50 to 60 minutes.

recipes.title: Cherry Cheesecake
ingredients: 2 (8 oz.) pkg. Philly cream cheese or Philly Neufchatel cheese (1/3 less fat than cream cheese)
directions: Mix softened cream cheese, sugar and vanilla.
Add eggs.
Pour into crust.
Bake at 350° for 40 minutes or until center is almost set.
Cool.
Refrigerate at least 3 hours.
Spread with cherry pie filling.
Makes 8 servings.
recipes.text: Cherry Cheesecake. Mix softened cream cheese, sugar and vanilla. Add eggs. Pour into crust. Bake at 350° for 40 minutes or until center is almost set. Cool. Refrigerate at least 3 hours. Spread with cherry pie filling. Makes 8 servings.

recipes.title: Cheese Cake
directions: Mix cream cheese, powdered sugar and Cool Whip.
Pour over crust, then top with pie filling.
Keep in refrigerator.
recipes.text: Cheese Cake. Mix cream cheese, powdered sugar and Cool Whip. Pour over crust, then top with pie filling. Keep in refrigerator.

recipes.title: Teriyaki Meat Sticks
ingredients: 1/2 tsp. minced fresh ginger or 1/8 tsp. powdered ginger
directions: Slice steak diagonally into 2 x 1 x 1/4-inch strips.
Combine all the remaining ingredients; marinate meat slices for 30 minutes.
Thread slices on skewers.
Barbecue or broil until done. Makes 48.
(Also great with chicken strips!)
recipes.text: Teriyaki Meat Sticks. Slice steak diagonally into 2 x 1 x 1/4-inch strips. Combine all the remaining ingredients; marinate meat slices for 30 minutes. Thread slices on skewers. Barbecue or broil until done. Makes 48. (Also great with chicken strips!)

recipes.title: Brioches
ingredients: 2 to 3 apples, cut in small pieces
directions: In bottom of pan, pour molasses and water.
Mix the first 4 ingredients, then add shortening as to make pie shells and milk. Roll dough in 1 large piece; spread over it small apple pieces and walnuts.
Form a roll; slice approximately 1-inch thick.
Drop in molasses and water mixture.
Cook for 35 minutes at 250°.
recipes.text: Brioches. In bottom of pan, pour molasses and water. Mix the first 4 ingredients, then add shortening as to make pie shells and milk. Roll dough in 1 large piece; spread over it small apple pieces and walnuts. Form a roll; slice approximately 1-inch thick. Drop in molasses and water mixture. Cook for 35 minutes at 250°.

recipes.title: Crab Bisque Or Oyster Bisque
ingredients: 1 lb. Maryland crabmeat or 1 pt. shucked oysters with liqueur
1 (10 1/2 oz.) can cream of mushroom soup
directions: Remove cartilage
from
crabmeat if making crab soup or put oysters with
liqueur
in
small
pan and bring to a boil. Remove from heat.
recipes.text: Crab Bisque Or Oyster Bisque. Remove cartilage from crabmeat if making crab soup or put oysters with liqueur in small pan and bring to a boil. Remove from heat.

recipes.title: Swiss Chicken
directions: Arrange chicken breasts in 9 x 13-inch dish.
Place slice of cheese on top of each chicken.
Dilute soup with 1/2 can water and pour over chicken.
Combine croutons with butter and sprinkle over dish.
Bake, uncovered, at 375° for 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Swiss Chicken. Arrange chicken breasts in 9 x 13-inch dish. Place slice of cheese on top of each chicken. Dilute soup with 1/2 can water and pour over chicken. Combine croutons with butter and sprinkle over dish. Bake, uncovered, at 375° for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Slimming Potato Salad
ingredients: 1 1/2 lb. red potatoes (peeled, if desired), cooked and cut into 3/4-inch cubes
2 1/2 Tbsp. Molly McButter natural sour cream and butter flavor sprinkles
directions: Combine potatoes, cucumber and tomatoes in a large bowl.
Set aside.
In a food processor, fitted with steel blade, or in a blender container, combine yogurt, cottage cheese, chives, parsley and Molly McButter.
Process or blend until smooth. Add cottage cheese mixture to potato mixture.
Toss lightly to coat. Garnish with additional parsley and onion rings, if desired. Cover and chill. Serve with additional Molly McButter, if desired.
Makes 6 servings.
Single serving contains 122 calories and 2 fat grams.
recipes.text: Slimming Potato Salad. Combine potatoes, cucumber and tomatoes in a large bowl. Set aside. In a food processor, fitted with steel blade, or in a blender container, combine yogurt, cottage cheese, chives, parsley and Molly McButter. Process or blend until smooth. Add cottage cheese mixture to potato mixture. Toss lightly to coat. Garnish with additional parsley and onion rings, if desired. Cover and chill. Serve with additional Molly McButter, if desired. Makes 6 servings. Single serving contains 122 calories and 2 fat grams.

recipes.title: Salem Clam Chowder
ingredients: 2 good sized potatoes, peeled and diced
2 good sized onions, peeled and diced
directions: Put potatoes and onions in a 4-quart soup pot.
Add water to cover and a shake of salt and pepper (at least 1/2 teaspoon pepper).
Bring to a boil and simmer 15 minutes until potatoes and onions are cooked.
Add minced clams and chowder, stirring well over medium or low heat.
Add both milks.
Again, season to taste. Bring just to a boil and simmer at least 15 minutes.
Add butter. Do not let boil.
Can be done a day before.
Yield:
recipes.text: Salem Clam Chowder. Put potatoes and onions in a 4-quart soup pot. Add water to cover and a shake of salt and pepper (at least 1/2 teaspoon pepper). Bring to a boil and simmer 15 minutes until potatoes and onions are cooked. Add minced clams and chowder, stirring well over medium or low heat. Add both milks. Again, season to taste. Bring just to a boil and simmer at least 15 minutes. Add butter. Do not let boil. Can be done a day before. Yield: 8.

recipes.title: Pan Seared Salmon(Prep Time: 15 Minutes; Cooking Time: 12 Minutes.)
ingredients: 4 (3-inch) strips each orange and lemon peel
directions: In a small saucepan, bring wine, vinegar, sugar and citrus juices to a boil over high heat. Continue to boil until reduced to about 3/4 cup, 10 to 12 minutes; remove from heat and stir in black pepper.
recipes.text: Pan Seared Salmon(Prep Time: 15 Minutes; Cooking Time: 12 Minutes.). In a small saucepan, bring wine, vinegar, sugar and citrus juices to a boil over high heat. Continue to boil until reduced to about 3/4 cup, 10 to 12 minutes; remove from heat and stir in black pepper.

recipes.title: Monkey Bread(Kids Of All Ages Love This!)
directions: Grease a tube pan.
Mix 2/3 cup sugar and cinnamon in a plastic bag.
Cut biscuits in quarters and shake in plastic bag. Place half the biscuits in pan.
Boil 1 cup sugar and butter or margarine.
Pour half over biscuits in pan.
Place remaining biscuits in pan and pour other half of butter-sugar mixture over top.
Bake 45 minutes at 350°.
This may be runny; place foil under pan.
recipes.text: Monkey Bread(Kids Of All Ages Love This!). Grease a tube pan. Mix 2/3 cup sugar and cinnamon in a plastic bag. Cut biscuits in quarters and shake in plastic bag. Place half the biscuits in pan. Boil 1 cup sugar and butter or margarine. Pour half over biscuits in pan. Place remaining biscuits in pan and pour other half of butter-sugar mixture over top. Bake 45 minutes at 350°. This may be runny; place foil under pan.

recipes.title: Coconut Crunch
directions: Mix flour, sugar, oleo and coconut.
Bake in 9 x 13 pan at 350° and keep stirring while baking crunch until light brown.
recipes.text: Coconut Crunch. Mix flour, sugar, oleo and coconut. Bake in 9 x 13 pan at 350° and keep stirring while baking crunch until light brown.

recipes.title: Grannies Fruit Cake
ingredients: 1/4 c. dark molasses (I use dark Karo)
directions: Combine first 6 ingredients.
Boil gently for 3 minutes, then cool in large mixing bowl.
Add mixed fruit and nuts.
Beat in eggs.
Sift in flour and
add cinnamon, nutmeg, baking powder, salt and soda.
Beat well after each addition.
Pour into tube pan and bake in very slow oven at 275° for 2 1/2 hours or until completely done.
recipes.text: Grannies Fruit Cake. Combine first 6 ingredients. Boil gently for 3 minutes, then cool in large mixing bowl. Add mixed fruit and nuts. Beat in eggs. Sift in flour and add cinnamon, nutmeg, baking powder, salt and soda. Beat well after each addition. Pour into tube pan and bake in very slow oven at 275° for 2 1/2 hours or until completely done.

recipes.title: Curried Chicken And Vegetables
ingredients: 1 (2 1/2 to 3 lb.) broiler-fryer chicken or one 4 to 5-lb. domestic duck or wild goose
2 large potatoes, peeled and quartered or 8 new potatoes
2 medium apples, cored and cut into wedges
directions: Set oven to 375°.
In a small saucepan combine first 10 ingredients.
Bring to boiling, stirring constantly.
Remove from heat; set aside.
recipes.text: Curried Chicken And Vegetables. Set oven to 375°. In a small saucepan combine first 10 ingredients. Bring to boiling, stirring constantly. Remove from heat; set aside.

recipes.title: Banana Nut Bread
directions: Cream shortening and sugar in mixing bowl.
Beat at speed 6 for 1 minute.
Stop and scrape bowl.
Beat 1 minute more at speed 6, then turn to speed 4 and add eggs.
Beat 30 seconds.
Stop and scrape bowl, then turn to speed 6 for 1 1/2 minutes.
Stop.
recipes.text: Banana Nut Bread. Cream shortening and sugar in mixing bowl. Beat at speed 6 for 1 minute. Stop and scrape bowl. Beat 1 minute more at speed 6, then turn to speed 4 and add eggs. Beat 30 seconds. Stop and scrape bowl, then turn to speed 6 for 1 1/2 minutes. Stop.

recipes.title: Short Cut Lasagna
directions: Brown meat and onion; drain off excess fat and pour tomato sauce into skillet.
Simmer for 20 minutes.
Cook and drain noodles.
Mix sour cream, cream cheese and noodles in casserole. Pour meat sauce over and sprinkle with garlic salt.
Put Cheddar cheese over top and bake until hot.
recipes.text: Short Cut Lasagna. Brown meat and onion; drain off excess fat and pour tomato sauce into skillet. Simmer for 20 minutes. Cook and drain noodles. Mix sour cream, cream cheese and noodles in casserole. Pour meat sauce over and sprinkle with garlic salt. Put Cheddar cheese over top and bake until hot.

recipes.title: Deviled Clams
directions: Saute dry ingredients in oil until golden brown.
Put celery, clams and broth in blender.
Chop well.
Mix in bowl with sauteed mixture.
Let stand for a few minutes.
Stuff into oiled clam shells.
(Shells can be washed and reused.)
Sprinkle with paprika.
Bake at 350° until golden and bubbly.
Makes approximately 5 to 6 dozen.
Serve with lemon slices.
recipes.text: Deviled Clams. Saute dry ingredients in oil until golden brown. Put celery, clams and broth in blender. Chop well. Mix in bowl with sauteed mixture. Let stand for a few minutes. Stuff into oiled clam shells. (Shells can be washed and reused.) Sprinkle with paprika. Bake at 350° until golden and bubbly. Makes approximately 5 to 6 dozen. Serve with lemon slices.

recipes.title: Black Bottom Cupcakes
directions: Combine and beat the cream cheese, egg and sugar.
Stir in chocolate morsels.
Set aside.
Combine the flour, sugar, soda, vinegar, vanilla, cocoa, salt, water and oil.
Beat well.
Fill lined cupcake tins 1/2 full with chocolate batter.
Top each with 1 heaping teaspoon of cream cheese mixture.
Sprinkle with sugar and nuts, if desired.
Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes.
recipes.text: Black Bottom Cupcakes. Combine and beat the cream cheese, egg and sugar. Stir in chocolate morsels. Set aside. Combine the flour, sugar, soda, vinegar, vanilla, cocoa, salt, water and oil. Beat well. Fill lined cupcake tins 1/2 full with chocolate batter. Top each with 1 heaping teaspoon of cream cheese mixture. Sprinkle with sugar and nuts, if desired. Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Gooey Cake
directions: Mix together first 4 ingredients. Spread into a well-greased 13 x 9-inch pan. Cream and mix together last 3 ingredients. Pour on top of cake mixture. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes. Cool thoroughly for 1 hour before cutting into squares.
recipes.text: Gooey Cake. Mix together first 4 ingredients. Spread into a well-greased 13 x 9-inch pan. Cream and mix together last 3 ingredients. Pour on top of cake mixture. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes. Cool thoroughly for 1 hour before cutting into squares.

recipes.title: Rice Pudding
directions: Soak rice for 1/2 hour.
Put milk in pot; add rice and simmer for 45 minutes, stirring constantly.
In separate bowl, add eggs, Carnation milk, sugar and vanilla; beat together.
When rice is cooked, add these ingredients and when it comes to a boil, shut it off.
recipes.text: Rice Pudding. Soak rice for 1/2 hour. Put milk in pot; add rice and simmer for 45 minutes, stirring constantly. In separate bowl, add eggs, Carnation milk, sugar and vanilla; beat together. When rice is cooked, add these ingredients and when it comes to a boil, shut it off.

recipes.title: Nannie'S Butter Pie
directions: Put oleo in mixing bowl. Soften. Add sugar and egg. Beat together. Add flour. Blend together. Add Milnot and water. Add vanilla. Mix well. Pour into pie crust and bake at 400° to set (approximately 8 minutes). Turn down to 350° and bake until done. (Filling will move a little in center.) Baking time: About 30 minutes. Remove from oven and sprinkle with cinnamon.
recipes.text: Nannie'S Butter Pie. Put oleo in mixing bowl. Soften. Add sugar and egg. Beat together. Add flour. Blend together. Add Milnot and water. Add vanilla. Mix well. Pour into pie crust and bake at 400° to set (approximately 8 minutes). Turn down to 350° and bake until done. (Filling will move a little in center.) Baking time: About 30 minutes. Remove from oven and sprinkle with cinnamon.

recipes.title: Baked Crab
directions: Melt butter. Add flour. Stir until smooth.
Pour in milk. Stir until thick. Add salt, pepper, mayonnaise, eggs and crab. Mix well.
Pour into shells or individual casseroles. Sprinkle with paprika.
Bake 12 to 15 minutes at 375°.
recipes.text: Baked Crab. Melt butter. Add flour. Stir until smooth. Pour in milk. Stir until thick. Add salt, pepper, mayonnaise, eggs and crab. Mix well. Pour into shells or individual casseroles. Sprinkle with paprika. Bake 12 to 15 minutes at 375°.

recipes.title: Butternut Cake
directions: Cream Crisco and sugar; add eggs.
Beat on high for 10 minutes.
Add 1 cup of flour and beat 1 minute.
Add flavoring and mix.
Bake in 3 layers at 350° for 25 minutes.
recipes.text: Butternut Cake. Cream Crisco and sugar; add eggs. Beat on high for 10 minutes. Add 1 cup of flour and beat 1 minute. Add flavoring and mix. Bake in 3 layers at 350° for 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Chicken Gumbo
directions: Boil whole chicken until the meat falls off the bones.
Remove skin and bones.
Keep meat in broth over medium heat.
Saute onion, celery, bell pepper and green onions in butter.
Add this to the chicken.
Cut up the smoked sausage into bite-size pieces and add to the pot.
Add the eggs (whole).
Add desired spices. Allow pot to simmer.
recipes.text: Chicken Gumbo. Boil whole chicken until the meat falls off the bones. Remove skin and bones. Keep meat in broth over medium heat. Saute onion, celery, bell pepper and green onions in butter. Add this to the chicken. Cut up the smoked sausage into bite-size pieces and add to the pot. Add the eggs (whole). Add desired spices. Allow pot to simmer.

recipes.title: Onion Patties
ingredients: milk (enough to make a thick batter)
directions: Drop by tablespoon in deep hot fat.
Fry to a golden brown on both sides.
Flatten patties slightly when you turn them.
recipes.text: Onion Patties. Drop by tablespoon in deep hot fat. Fry to a golden brown on both sides. Flatten patties slightly when you turn them.

recipes.title: Kentucky Coleslaw
directions: Combine cabbage, carrot and green pepper in a large bowl; set aside.
Combine sugar, vinegar and salt; bring to a boil and boil 2 or 3 minutes.
Cool.
Stir celery seed and mustard seed into vinegar mixture.
Pour over vegetables, stirring well.
Cover and refrigerate 24 hours.
Yields about 5 quarts.
Slaw may be stored several weeks in refrigerator.
recipes.text: Kentucky Coleslaw. Combine cabbage, carrot and green pepper in a large bowl; set aside. Combine sugar, vinegar and salt; bring to a boil and boil 2 or 3 minutes. Cool. Stir celery seed and mustard seed into vinegar mixture. Pour over vegetables, stirring well. Cover and refrigerate 24 hours. Yields about 5 quarts. Slaw may be stored several weeks in refrigerator.

recipes.title: Cottage Cheese Cake Or Kuchen
ingredients: juice of 1/2 lemon or 1 Tbsp. lemon juice
directions: Sprinkle with cinnamon and bake 45 minutes at 350°.
recipes.text: Cottage Cheese Cake Or Kuchen. Sprinkle with cinnamon and bake 45 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Chicken Casserole
ingredients: 4 chicken breasts, stewed and chopped (save 2 c. broth)
directions: Melt margarine and mix with stuffing.

Place 1 layer of stuffing in casserole dish, followed by 1 layer chicken, 1 layer celery soup, 1 layer of 1 cup broth, another layer of stuffing, 1 layer of chicken, 1 layer of cream of chicken soup and 1 layer of 1 cup broth.
Sprinkle remaining stuffing on top.
Bake at 350° for 30 to 45 minutes or until bubbly.
recipes.text: Chicken Casserole. Melt margarine and mix with stuffing. Place 1 layer of stuffing in casserole dish, followed by 1 layer chicken, 1 layer celery soup, 1 layer of 1 cup broth, another layer of stuffing, 1 layer of chicken, 1 layer of cream of chicken soup and 1 layer of 1 cup broth. Sprinkle remaining stuffing on top. Bake at 350° for 30 to 45 minutes or until bubbly.

recipes.title: Dip For Strawberries
directions: Mix, chill and then dip fruit into it.
recipes.text: Dip For Strawberries. Mix, chill and then dip fruit into it.

recipes.title: Chicken Divan
directions: Mix all ingredients together. Place in baking dish. Cover with cracker crumbs. Bake 30 minutes at 350°.
recipes.text: Chicken Divan. Mix all ingredients together. Place in baking dish. Cover with cracker crumbs. Bake 30 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Chocolate Zucchini Cake
directions: Set chocolate chips aside.
Cream margarine, oil and sugar together.
Add remaining ingredients, except chocolate chips.
Mix well.
Spread in greased rectangular cake pan.
Sprinkle chocolate chips over top.
Bake at 325° for 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Chocolate Zucchini Cake. Set chocolate chips aside. Cream margarine, oil and sugar together. Add remaining ingredients, except chocolate chips. Mix well. Spread in greased rectangular cake pan. Sprinkle chocolate chips over top. Bake at 325° for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Beans And Macaroni (Pasta Con Fagoli)(Hearty Italian Peasant Dish)
ingredients: 1 (16 oz.) can beans (pinto or white beans)*
directions: *If
desired,
use
fresh shelled butter beans to which you add slight amount of water.
recipes.text: Beans And Macaroni (Pasta Con Fagoli)(Hearty Italian Peasant Dish). *If desired, use fresh shelled butter beans to which you add slight amount of water.

recipes.title: Sausage Brunch Casserole
ingredients: 1 1/2 lb. loose sausage, cooked and drained
directions: Butter 9 x 13-inch dish.
Spread stuffing evenly.
Sprinkle cheese over stuffing, then the sausage.
Beat eggs, 2 1/4 cups milk and dry mustard.
Pour over sausage.
Refrigerate overnight. Next morning, mix soup and 1/2 cup milk.
Pour over casserole. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Sausage Brunch Casserole. Butter 9 x 13-inch dish. Spread stuffing evenly. Sprinkle cheese over stuffing, then the sausage. Beat eggs, 2 1/4 cups milk and dry mustard. Pour over sausage. Refrigerate overnight. Next morning, mix soup and 1/2 cup milk. Pour over casserole. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Spiced Chicken And Pea Pods
ingredients: 2 1/2 to 3 lb. broiler-fryer chicken, cut up
directions: Put all ingredients in the order listed.
Cook in a 350° oven for 15 minutes.
recipes.text: Spiced Chicken And Pea Pods. Put all ingredients in the order listed. Cook in a 350° oven for 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Salmon Loaf
directions: Beat egg lightly.
Add water, then salmon, bread crumbs, chopped onion, salt, pepper and melted butter.
Mix well.
Mold in loaf pan.
Bake in 350° oven for 45 minutes.
Serves 6.
recipes.text: Salmon Loaf. Beat egg lightly. Add water, then salmon, bread crumbs, chopped onion, salt, pepper and melted butter. Mix well. Mold in loaf pan. Bake in 350° oven for 45 minutes. Serves 6.

recipes.title: Katie'S Jam Bars
directions: Mix cake mix, butter and oats until crumbly.
Press 1/2 of mixture into greased 9 x 13-inch pan.
Mix jam with water and spread on top of first layer.
Press second 1/2 of mixture on top of jam layer.
Bake at 375° for 20 minutes.
Cool and cut into bars.
recipes.text: Katie'S Jam Bars. Mix cake mix, butter and oats until crumbly. Press 1/2 of mixture into greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix jam with water and spread on top of first layer. Press second 1/2 of mixture on top of jam layer. Bake at 375° for 20 minutes. Cool and cut into bars.

recipes.title: Chocolate Chip Pudding Cookies
directions: Mix flour with baking soda.
Combine butter, the sugars, pudding mix and vanilla; mix until smooth and creamy.
Beat in eggs.
Gradually add flour mixture and stir in chips and nuts. (Batter will be stiff.)
Drop by teaspoons on ungreased cookie sheet.
Bake at 375° for 8 to 10 minutes.
Makes 7 dozen.
recipes.text: Chocolate Chip Pudding Cookies. Mix flour with baking soda. Combine butter, the sugars, pudding mix and vanilla; mix until smooth and creamy. Beat in eggs. Gradually add flour mixture and stir in chips and nuts. (Batter will be stiff.) Drop by teaspoons on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 375° for 8 to 10 minutes. Makes 7 dozen.

recipes.title: Birds Nest(Easy)
directions: Cut a hole in the middle of the piece of bread, large enough to contain the egg yolk.
Melt margarine in skillet and brown bread on one side.
Flip and carefully crack egg, dropping it into the hole so as not to break the yolk.
Cover skillet and simmer slowly until egg firms.
recipes.text: Birds Nest(Easy). Cut a hole in the middle of the piece of bread, large enough to contain the egg yolk. Melt margarine in skillet and brown bread on one side. Flip and carefully crack egg, dropping it into the hole so as not to break the yolk. Cover skillet and simmer slowly until egg firms.

recipes.title: Macaroni Cheese Pie
directions: Cook macaroni until tender.
Grate block cheese in bowl.
Mix powdered cheese, milk and eggs together.
Layer macaroni, then cheese alternately in casserole dish.
Pour mixture on top.
Salt and pepper to taste.
Cook at 450° for 45 to 50 minutes until golden brown.
recipes.text: Macaroni Cheese Pie. Cook macaroni until tender. Grate block cheese in bowl. Mix powdered cheese, milk and eggs together. Layer macaroni, then cheese alternately in casserole dish. Pour mixture on top. Salt and pepper to taste. Cook at 450° for 45 to 50 minutes until golden brown.

recipes.title: Pancakes
directions: Mix baking soda and buttermilk; mix all other ingredients, then add milk.
Cook on grill or in skillet.
recipes.text: Pancakes. Mix baking soda and buttermilk; mix all other ingredients, then add milk. Cook on grill or in skillet.

recipes.title: Crab Cakes
directions: Mix crab meat, mayonnaise, egg, salt, pepper and Worcestershire sauce; form into cakes.
The smaller you make the cakes, the better they hold together.
Dip both sides of each cake in bread crumbs.
recipes.text: Crab Cakes. Mix crab meat, mayonnaise, egg, salt, pepper and Worcestershire sauce; form into cakes. The smaller you make the cakes, the better they hold together. Dip both sides of each cake in bread crumbs.

recipes.title: Breakfast Quiche
ingredients: hot sausage, ham or meat of choice
directions: Stir eggs thoroughly and mix in all other ingredients including cheeses.
Pour into unbaked pie crust.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until crust is browned.
Serve warm.
recipes.text: Breakfast Quiche. Stir eggs thoroughly and mix in all other ingredients including cheeses. Pour into unbaked pie crust. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until crust is browned. Serve warm.

recipes.title: Spicy Angel Cake
directions: In mixing bowl sift together dry flour mixture from cake mix and spices.
Prepare and bake cake according to package directions.
After cool, remove from pan; cut into 1-inch slices. Serve with Maple Fluff Topping.
recipes.text: Spicy Angel Cake. In mixing bowl sift together dry flour mixture from cake mix and spices. Prepare and bake cake according to package directions. After cool, remove from pan; cut into 1-inch slices. Serve with Maple Fluff Topping.

recipes.title: Congo Bills
directions: Use regular cake procedures for mixing.
Bake in greased 9 x 13-inch pan at 325° for 40 to 45 minutes.
Cool and cut into squares.
recipes.text: Congo Bills. Use regular cake procedures for mixing. Bake in greased 9 x 13-inch pan at 325° for 40 to 45 minutes. Cool and cut into squares.

recipes.title: Fiesta Dish
directions: Saute onion and garlic in salad oil.
Add hamburger meat. Cook until brown.
Add tomatoes, beans, chili, salt and pepper. Heat to boiling.
Cover bottom of a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan with tortillas, then sauce, etc., until mixture is used.
Cover top with cheese.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Fiesta Dish. Saute onion and garlic in salad oil. Add hamburger meat. Cook until brown. Add tomatoes, beans, chili, salt and pepper. Heat to boiling. Cover bottom of a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan with tortillas, then sauce, etc., until mixture is used. Cover top with cheese. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Pancit Bijon Guisado
ingredients: 2 pieces chorizo canton (Chinese sausage), fried and sliced
1 bundle first class bijon China rice (rice sticks)
directions: Saute garlic in cooking oil, add onions, pork, carrot and cabbage.
Season with soy sauce and fry for 2 minutes.
Add broth and simmer, add Kintsay.
When vegetables are cooked, mix in soaked and drained bijon and season with salt and ajinomoto. Garnish with chorizo canton and spring onions.
Serve with calamansi.
recipes.text: Pancit Bijon Guisado. Saute garlic in cooking oil, add onions, pork, carrot and cabbage. Season with soy sauce and fry for 2 minutes. Add broth and simmer, add Kintsay. When vegetables are cooked, mix in soaked and drained bijon and season with salt and ajinomoto. Garnish with chorizo canton and spring onions. Serve with calamansi.

recipes.title: Greek Ground Beef With Rice
directions: Brown meat in skillet.
When some grease accumulates, add onion and cook until soft.
Drain off grease.
Add rest of ingredients (except rice) and simmer for about 15 minutes.
Serve over cooked rice.
recipes.text: Greek Ground Beef With Rice. Brown meat in skillet. When some grease accumulates, add onion and cook until soft. Drain off grease. Add rest of ingredients (except rice) and simmer for about 15 minutes. Serve over cooked rice.

recipes.title: Applesauce Cake
directions: Sift together flour, soda and salt.
Combine raisins and nuts and toss with 2 tablespoons of flour mixture.
Beat together shortening and spices.
Gradually add sugar and beat until fluffy. Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each addition.
Add flour mixture and applesauce, beating only until smooth.
Stir in raisins and nuts.
Grease Bundt or 3-quart ring mold.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
Cool in pan 15 minutes.
Remove cake from pan and place on rack until cold.
Makes 8 to 10 servings.
Dust with confectioners sugar or use cream cheese frosting, if desired.
recipes.text: Applesauce Cake. Sift together flour, soda and salt. Combine raisins and nuts and toss with 2 tablespoons of flour mixture. Beat together shortening and spices. Gradually add sugar and beat until fluffy. Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each addition. Add flour mixture and applesauce, beating only until smooth. Stir in raisins and nuts. Grease Bundt or 3-quart ring mold. Bake at 350° for 1 hour. Cool in pan 15 minutes. Remove cake from pan and place on rack until cold. Makes 8 to 10 servings. Dust with confectioners sugar or use cream cheese frosting, if desired.

recipes.title: Calico Bean Casserole
ingredients: 1 tall can Campbell's pork and beans
directions: Cook bacon, onion and ground beef until done.
Drain butter beans and kidney beans.
Add to all other ingredients.
Bake 1 to 1 1/2 hours at 350°.
recipes.text: Calico Bean Casserole. Cook bacon, onion and ground beef until done. Drain butter beans and kidney beans. Add to all other ingredients. Bake 1 to 1 1/2 hours at 350°.

recipes.title: Pineapple Carrot Jello Salad
directions: Drain pineapple.
Mix Jell-O, hot water and pineapple juice. Set until chilled.
Add carrots, pineapple and olives.
Serve with thin layer of Miracle Whip.
recipes.text: Pineapple Carrot Jello Salad. Drain pineapple. Mix Jell-O, hot water and pineapple juice. Set until chilled. Add carrots, pineapple and olives. Serve with thin layer of Miracle Whip.

recipes.title: Mrs. Eunice'S Giblet Gravy
ingredients: 2 to 3 cans chicken broth (substitute turkey broth, if desired)
directions: Melt butter and then add enough flour to thicken. Mix well and add broth, 1 can at a time. Stir each can in well. Add chopped giblets and chopped eggs. Let simmer for 30 to 40 minutes. Salt and pepper to taste. Add flour or broth as needed for your desired thickness.
recipes.text: Mrs. Eunice'S Giblet Gravy. Melt butter and then add enough flour to thicken. Mix well and add broth, 1 can at a time. Stir each can in well. Add chopped giblets and chopped eggs. Let simmer for 30 to 40 minutes. Salt and pepper to taste. Add flour or broth as needed for your desired thickness.

recipes.title: Pecan Brittle
directions: Boil sugar, water and syrup until spins thread.
Add pecans. Stir continually until syrup turns golden brown.
Remove from heat; add remaining ingredients.
Stir until butter melts.
Pour quickly on 2 cookie sheets with sides.
As mixture begins to harden around the edges, pull until thin.
recipes.text: Pecan Brittle. Boil sugar, water and syrup until spins thread. Add pecans. Stir continually until syrup turns golden brown. Remove from heat; add remaining ingredients. Stir until butter melts. Pour quickly on 2 cookie sheets with sides. As mixture begins to harden around the edges, pull until thin.

recipes.title: Broccoli Salad
ingredients: 2 boxes frozen chopped broccoli, cooked and drained
directions: Mix last 6 ingredients together.
Add broccoli.
Pour in 2-quart casserole dish.
Crumble Ritz crackers over top.
Bake, uncovered, at 325° for 25 minutes.
recipes.text: Broccoli Salad. Mix last 6 ingredients together. Add broccoli. Pour in 2-quart casserole dish. Crumble Ritz crackers over top. Bake, uncovered, at 325° for 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Hollandaise Sauce(Zero Cholesterol)
directions: Put egg substitute, lemon juice and pepper into blender.
Blend until smooth.
Pour margarine into mixture and blend together until sauce is slightly thickened.
Put into microwave for 20 seconds to thicken more.
Contains 35 calories per tablespoon.
recipes.text: Hollandaise Sauce(Zero Cholesterol). Put egg substitute, lemon juice and pepper into blender. Blend until smooth. Pour margarine into mixture and blend together until sauce is slightly thickened. Put into microwave for 20 seconds to thicken more. Contains 35 calories per tablespoon.

recipes.title: Rice Chicken Casserole
directions: Saute onion and rice in oil until rice is soft.
Add all ingredients.
Mix in casserole.
Bake at 325° for 1 hour.
Can be made ahead, frozen, thawed, then baked.
recipes.text: Rice Chicken Casserole. Saute onion and rice in oil until rice is soft. Add all ingredients. Mix in casserole. Bake at 325° for 1 hour. Can be made ahead, frozen, thawed, then baked.

recipes.title: Fruit Custard
ingredients: 1 can (10 1/2 oz.) mandarin orange segments, unsweetened
directions: Drain fruit, reserving syrups.
Cut pears in half lengthwise. Measure syrups to make 1 1/2 cups.
Combine fruit syrups, lemon juice, salt and cornstarch in small saucepan.
Cook, stirring constantly, until thickened and bubbly.
Add Sweet 'n Low.
Add small amount of hot mixture to well beaten egg and blend thoroughly.
Return to hot mixture and add grated lemon peel. Cool.
Place small amount of lemon custard in bottom of 4 sherbet glasses.
Arrange 4 pear slices, spoke fashion, in custard. Divide remaining custard over pears.
Garnish with 2 orange segments.
Chill.
Makes 4 servings.
recipes.text: Fruit Custard. Drain fruit, reserving syrups. Cut pears in half lengthwise. Measure syrups to make 1 1/2 cups. Combine fruit syrups, lemon juice, salt and cornstarch in small saucepan. Cook, stirring constantly, until thickened and bubbly. Add Sweet 'n Low. Add small amount of hot mixture to well beaten egg and blend thoroughly. Return to hot mixture and add grated lemon peel. Cool. Place small amount of lemon custard in bottom of 4 sherbet glasses. Arrange 4 pear slices, spoke fashion, in custard. Divide remaining custard over pears. Garnish with 2 orange segments. Chill. Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: Old Fashioned Macaroni And Cheese
directions: Butter a 2-quart casserole.
Set aside.
Bring water to a rapid boil in a heavy 4-quart saucepan.
Add 1 teaspoon of salt and oil.
Gradually add macaroni, being sure water continues to boil.
Cook macaroni, uncovered, until tender, but firm.
Stir occasionally.
Drain.
Place in prepared casserole.
recipes.text: Old Fashioned Macaroni And Cheese. Butter a 2-quart casserole. Set aside. Bring water to a rapid boil in a heavy 4-quart saucepan. Add 1 teaspoon of salt and oil. Gradually add macaroni, being sure water continues to boil. Cook macaroni, uncovered, until tender, but firm. Stir occasionally. Drain. Place in prepared casserole.

recipes.title: Graham Cracker Cake
directions: Cream butter and sugar. Add all eggs at one time. Add milk, coconut, nuts, baking powder and vanilla. Add cracker crumbs. Bake two layers at 350° for about 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Graham Cracker Cake. Cream butter and sugar. Add all eggs at one time. Add milk, coconut, nuts, baking powder and vanilla. Add cracker crumbs. Bake two layers at 350° for about 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Cheese-Sausage Balls
directions: Heat oven to 350°.
Bring cheese to room temperature.
Mix cheese and sausage with biscuit mix using fork.
Shape into 1-inch balls and place on ungreased baking sheet.
Bake 12 to 15 minutes. Serve hot or cold.
recipes.text: Cheese-Sausage Balls. Heat oven to 350°. Bring cheese to room temperature. Mix cheese and sausage with biscuit mix using fork. Shape into 1-inch balls and place on ungreased baking sheet. Bake 12 to 15 minutes. Serve hot or cold.

recipes.title: Hamburger Spaghetti Goulash
directions: Cook bacon, hamburger, onion, green pepper and mushrooms until meat loses its color.
Add remaining ingredients.
Let simmer. Cook 1 pound spaghetti according to package directions.
Add to sauce and simmer for 30 minutes.
Serve with grated Parmesan cheese.
Serves 8.
recipes.text: Hamburger Spaghetti Goulash. Cook bacon, hamburger, onion, green pepper and mushrooms until meat loses its color. Add remaining ingredients. Let simmer. Cook 1 pound spaghetti according to package directions. Add to sauce and simmer for 30 minutes. Serve with grated Parmesan cheese. Serves 8.

recipes.title: Delicious Breakfast Cake
directions: Grease a 10-inch tube pan.
Mix flour, baking soda and salt; set aside.
Cream sugar and shortening.
Add eggs and vanilla, mixing well.
Add the dry ingredients to the creamed mixture, alternating with the soured milk.
Pour half the batter in pan, then add half of topping mixture of nuts, brown sugar and cinnamon.
Repeat layers.
Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.
(Baking soda can be added to the milk.)
recipes.text: Delicious Breakfast Cake. Grease a 10-inch tube pan. Mix flour, baking soda and salt; set aside. Cream sugar and shortening. Add eggs and vanilla, mixing well. Add the dry ingredients to the creamed mixture, alternating with the soured milk. Pour half the batter in pan, then add half of topping mixture of nuts, brown sugar and cinnamon. Repeat layers. Bake at 350° for 40 minutes. (Baking soda can be added to the milk.)

recipes.title: Wonderful Cucumber Dip
directions: Peel and grate cucumber.
Mash softened cream cheese.
Season to taste.
Serve with Ruffles potato chips.
recipes.text: Wonderful Cucumber Dip. Peel and grate cucumber. Mash softened cream cheese. Season to taste. Serve with Ruffles potato chips.

recipes.title: Texas Sheet Cake
directions: Melt margarine, water and cocoa and boil for one minute. Add remaining ingredients.
Bake for 20 minutes at 350° in greased jelly roll pan or cookie sheet.
recipes.text: Texas Sheet Cake. Melt margarine, water and cocoa and boil for one minute. Add remaining ingredients. Bake for 20 minutes at 350° in greased jelly roll pan or cookie sheet.

recipes.title: Scallops Meuniere
directions: Toss scallops in flour, salt and pepper.
Melt butter in medium skillet.
Cook scallops 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Sprinkle with lemon juice.
Spoon scallops over bed of rice.
Garnish with lemon wedges and parsley.
recipes.text: Scallops Meuniere. Toss scallops in flour, salt and pepper. Melt butter in medium skillet. Cook scallops 5 minutes, stirring occasionally. Sprinkle with lemon juice. Spoon scallops over bed of rice. Garnish with lemon wedges and parsley.

recipes.title: E-Z Lemon Pie
directions: Combine milk and lemonade.
Add Cool Whip and stir slowly. Pour into graham cracker crust.
Refrigerate until serving time. Garnish with graham cracker crumbs.
recipes.text: E-Z Lemon Pie. Combine milk and lemonade. Add Cool Whip and stir slowly. Pour into graham cracker crust. Refrigerate until serving time. Garnish with graham cracker crumbs.

recipes.title: Cam'S Fruit Pancakes
ingredients: 1/2 c. each raisins, canned peaches, pears, applesauce or grated apple
directions: Bring raisins to a boil in water to soften; drain them.
Drain canned fruit.
Combine all fruit in large bowl.
Add yogurt.
Puree in food processor or mash well.
Soften cream cheese in milk.
Add to pancake mix, oil and egg yolks; beat well.
Fold in fruit mixture.
Beat egg whites until stiff and fold into mixture.
Heat large skillet, lightly greased.
Pour about 1/4 cup mixture for each pancake.
Turn when pancake edges look cooked, cooking both sides until golden brown.
Serve with your favorite pancake syrup and jellies.
Also a mixture of fresh fruit with a dressing of 1 tablespoon honey and Cool Whip.
recipes.text: Cam'S Fruit Pancakes. Bring raisins to a boil in water to soften; drain them. Drain canned fruit. Combine all fruit in large bowl. Add yogurt. Puree in food processor or mash well. Soften cream cheese in milk. Add to pancake mix, oil and egg yolks; beat well. Fold in fruit mixture. Beat egg whites until stiff and fold into mixture. Heat large skillet, lightly greased. Pour about 1/4 cup mixture for each pancake. Turn when pancake edges look cooked, cooking both sides until golden brown. Serve with your favorite pancake syrup and jellies. Also a mixture of fresh fruit with a dressing of 1 tablespoon honey and Cool Whip.

recipes.title: Chicken Fiesta
directions: Brown onion and green pepper in butter.
Add chicken, cream of mushroom soup, cream of chicken soup and chicken broth.
Heat this mixture.
Pour over crushed Doritos.
Spread in a greased pan. Add grated cheese on top.
Heat 20 to 25 minutes at 350°.
Makes 4 servings.
recipes.text: Chicken Fiesta. Brown onion and green pepper in butter. Add chicken, cream of mushroom soup, cream of chicken soup and chicken broth. Heat this mixture. Pour over crushed Doritos. Spread in a greased pan. Add grated cheese on top. Heat 20 to 25 minutes at 350°. Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: Crazy Cake
ingredients: 2 tsp. baking soda dissolved in 2 Tbsp. vinegar
directions: Mix all together.
Pour in pan and bake at 350 degrees until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean.
recipes.text: Crazy Cake. Mix all together. Pour in pan and bake at 350 degrees until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean.

recipes.title: English Trifle Or "Glutton'S Delight"
directions: Make in a large deep bowl.
Tear up cake in small pieces in bowl.
Dissolve dry jello in thawed strawberries and mix with cake. Slice 1 banana over cake.
Mix pudding according to package directions and pour half in.
Spread on 1/2 container of Cool Whip.
Add other sliced banana.
Pour on remaining pudding. Spread on remaining Cool Whip.
Sprinkle on chopped pecans. Serves 10 to 12.
recipes.text: English Trifle Or "Glutton'S Delight". Make in a large deep bowl. Tear up cake in small pieces in bowl. Dissolve dry jello in thawed strawberries and mix with cake. Slice 1 banana over cake. Mix pudding according to package directions and pour half in. Spread on 1/2 container of Cool Whip. Add other sliced banana. Pour on remaining pudding. Spread on remaining Cool Whip. Sprinkle on chopped pecans. Serves 10 to 12.

recipes.title: Corn Chowder
directions: Brown salt pork; saute onion in same pan until they are transparent.
Dice potato and boil until tender.
Add milk, corn, onion, pork and season to taste.
Heat through before serving.
recipes.text: Corn Chowder. Brown salt pork; saute onion in same pan until they are transparent. Dice potato and boil until tender. Add milk, corn, onion, pork and season to taste. Heat through before serving.

recipes.title: Cream Cheese Ball
directions: Mix all ingredients, except nuts.
Roll into ball; roll in nuts.
recipes.text: Cream Cheese Ball. Mix all ingredients, except nuts. Roll into ball; roll in nuts.

recipes.title: Cabbage Casserole
directions: Brown ground beef in skillet; drain.
Mix all remaining ingredients in casserole with beef.
Cover tightly.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
Top with grated cheese if desired.
recipes.text: Cabbage Casserole. Brown ground beef in skillet; drain. Mix all remaining ingredients in casserole with beef. Cover tightly. Bake at 350° for 1 hour. Top with grated cheese if desired.

recipes.title: Yummies
directions: Cream the first 4 ingredients.
Add the egg, vanilla, flour, soda and salt. Roll into 1-inch balls (leave as a ball) and put into greased small muffin pans.
Bake at 375° for 8 to 10 minutes.
recipes.text: Yummies. Cream the first 4 ingredients. Add the egg, vanilla, flour, soda and salt. Roll into 1-inch balls (leave as a ball) and put into greased small muffin pans. Bake at 375° for 8 to 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Autumn Leaf Punch
directions: Combine all ingredients in saucepan.
Bring to a boil, stirring until sugar is dissolved.
Flavor is improved if mixture stands for a day or two.
Reheat to serve.
Yields 6 to 8 servings.
recipes.text: Autumn Leaf Punch. Combine all ingredients in saucepan. Bring to a boil, stirring until sugar is dissolved. Flavor is improved if mixture stands for a day or two. Reheat to serve. Yields 6 to 8 servings.

recipes.title: Breakfast Pizza
directions: Brown sausage in skillet on top of stove.
Preheat oven to 375°.
In a 10-inch pie plate, place browned, drained sausage. Top with hash browns, then sprinkle with Cheddar cheese.
Beat eggs with milk and pepper.
Pour over Cheddar cheese.
Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese.
Bake 30 to 35 minutes.
(Can be cooled, refrigerated and reheated.) Serves 6.
recipes.text: Breakfast Pizza. Brown sausage in skillet on top of stove. Preheat oven to 375°. In a 10-inch pie plate, place browned, drained sausage. Top with hash browns, then sprinkle with Cheddar cheese. Beat eggs with milk and pepper. Pour over Cheddar cheese. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Bake 30 to 35 minutes. (Can be cooled, refrigerated and reheated.) Serves 6.

recipes.title: Pecan Pie
directions: Beat eggs, sugar, salt, butter and syrup.
Stir in nuts.
Bake 40 to 50 minutes or until filling is settled or set.
recipes.text: Pecan Pie. Beat eggs, sugar, salt, butter and syrup. Stir in nuts. Bake 40 to 50 minutes or until filling is settled or set.

recipes.title: Pickled Peaches
directions: Insert whole cloves into peach halves. Mix remaining ingredients; simmer 3 minutes. Pour over peaches and let set.
recipes.text: Pickled Peaches. Insert whole cloves into peach halves. Mix remaining ingredients; simmer 3 minutes. Pour over peaches and let set.

recipes.title: Dawn'S Garlic Breadsticks
directions: Dissolve yeast in warm water in large mixing bowl.
Add honey and garlic powder and mix well.
Gradually add flour, beating until smooth. Knead 3/4 to 1 cup additional flour into the dough until smooth and elastic (about 10 minutes).
Divide mixture into 4 dozen equal parts.
Shape each into an 8-inch long rope.
Place on greased baking sheet (not Teflon).
Brush with melted butter and sprinkle lightly with coarse salt.
Let rise in
warm place, free from drafts 30 minutes or until doubled in bulk.
Bake at 400° for 10 to 15 minutes or until golden.
Transfer to cake rack and brush with melted butter (add garlic powder to butter to taste for a more garlic intensity).
recipes.text: Dawn'S Garlic Breadsticks. Dissolve yeast in warm water in large mixing bowl. Add honey and garlic powder and mix well. Gradually add flour, beating until smooth. Knead 3/4 to 1 cup additional flour into the dough until smooth and elastic (about 10 minutes). Divide mixture into 4 dozen equal parts. Shape each into an 8-inch long rope. Place on greased baking sheet (not Teflon). Brush with melted butter and sprinkle lightly with coarse salt. Let rise in warm place, free from drafts 30 minutes or until doubled in bulk. Bake at 400° for 10 to 15 minutes or until golden. Transfer to cake rack and brush with melted butter (add garlic powder to butter to taste for a more garlic intensity).

recipes.title: Custard Pie
directions: Beat one egg white stiff.
Add sugar, 2 eggs, salt and seasoning.
Add lukewarm milk.
Put in an unbaked crust.
Bake at 425° for 15 minutes.
Reduce heat to 375° and bake until custard is set.
recipes.text: Custard Pie. Beat one egg white stiff. Add sugar, 2 eggs, salt and seasoning. Add lukewarm milk. Put in an unbaked crust. Bake at 425° for 15 minutes. Reduce heat to 375° and bake until custard is set.

recipes.title: Orange And Raisin Bars
directions: Put orange and raisins through food chopper.
Put soda in sour milk.
Add to other ingredients.
Bake in a greased 9 x 13-inch pan for 35 to 40 minutes in 350° oven.
recipes.text: Orange And Raisin Bars. Put orange and raisins through food chopper. Put soda in sour milk. Add to other ingredients. Bake in a greased 9 x 13-inch pan for 35 to 40 minutes in 350° oven.

recipes.title: Million Dollar Pie
ingredients: 1 (14 oz.) can Eagle Brand condensed milk
directions: Blend Eagle Brand and lemon juice.
Fold in pineapple, nuts and Cool Whip.
Pour into graham cracker crusts.
Chill thoroughly.
Garnish with nuts.
recipes.text: Million Dollar Pie. Blend Eagle Brand and lemon juice. Fold in pineapple, nuts and Cool Whip. Pour into graham cracker crusts. Chill thoroughly. Garnish with nuts.

recipes.title: Bunny Cake
ingredients: 1 small can crushed pineapple, well drained
2 c. mashed ripe bananas (4 or 5 bananas)
directions: In large mixing bowl, sift sugar and flour with baking soda, cinnamon and salt.
Make a well in the center.
Add eggs, oil, nuts, vanilla, pineapple and mashed bananas.
Stir together (do not beat).
recipes.text: Bunny Cake. In large mixing bowl, sift sugar and flour with baking soda, cinnamon and salt. Make a well in the center. Add eggs, oil, nuts, vanilla, pineapple and mashed bananas. Stir together (do not beat).

recipes.title: Asparagus Casserole
directions: Melt
butter in heavy saucepan.
Mix in flour, salt and pepper.
Add grated cheese and as it begins to melt; add milk. Cook
until
thick.
Place
of
bread crumbs in bottom of casserole.
Put
remaining
ingredients
in
layers, beginning with
asparagus,
sliced
eggs, pimentos, mushrooms, then pour over part
of
sauce.
Make another layer and top with crumbs. Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Asparagus Casserole. Melt butter in heavy saucepan. Mix in flour, salt and pepper. Add grated cheese and as it begins to melt; add milk. Cook until thick. Place 1/2 of bread crumbs in bottom of casserole. Put remaining ingredients in layers, beginning with asparagus, sliced eggs, pimentos, mushrooms, then pour over part of sauce. Make another layer and top with crumbs. Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Shoney'S Strawberry Pie
ingredients: few drops of red food coloring
directions: Combine sugar, cornstarch and water.
Cook over medium heat until clear and remove from heat.
Add a few drops of red food coloring and 4 tablespoons strawberry jello dry powder.
Stir well.
Fill pie shell with fresh strawberries.
Pour cooked filling over berries.
Place in refrigerator and chill until thick.
Serve with whipped topping.
recipes.text: Shoney'S Strawberry Pie. Combine sugar, cornstarch and water. Cook over medium heat until clear and remove from heat. Add a few drops of red food coloring and 4 tablespoons strawberry jello dry powder. Stir well. Fill pie shell with fresh strawberries. Pour cooked filling over berries. Place in refrigerator and chill until thick. Serve with whipped topping.

recipes.title: Pineapple Cheese Ball
ingredients: 1 (8 oz.) can crushed pineapple, drained thoroughly
1 Tbsp. onion, grated or finely chopped
2 packets Sweet 'N Low (can add more if you prefer sweeter)
directions: Mix all ingredients (except 1 cup of nuts). Roll into a ball and refrigerate until chilled; can be overnight or longer. Before serving, roll cheese ball into remaining chopped nuts. Serve with favorite crackers (Wheat Thins or Ritz are very good).
recipes.text: Pineapple Cheese Ball. Mix all ingredients (except 1 cup of nuts). Roll into a ball and refrigerate until chilled; can be overnight or longer. Before serving, roll cheese ball into remaining chopped nuts. Serve with favorite crackers (Wheat Thins or Ritz are very good).

recipes.title: Spaghetti
directions: Cook the noodles according to directions.
Brown the ground beef with the onion and drain the grease off of the meat.
Put back in the pan and put the tomato sauce in and add the seasonings and mushrooms.
Let it simmer for 10 to 20 minutes.
When the noodles get done, drain them and put them in a bowl with butter.
recipes.text: Spaghetti. Cook the noodles according to directions. Brown the ground beef with the onion and drain the grease off of the meat. Put back in the pan and put the tomato sauce in and add the seasonings and mushrooms. Let it simmer for 10 to 20 minutes. When the noodles get done, drain them and put them in a bowl with butter.

recipes.title: Company Chicken
ingredients: 1 small can B & B sliced mushrooms
directions: Rinse chicken breasts and roll in Bisquick until they are coated evenly.
Place chicken breasts in Pyrex dish. Spoon the undiluted mushroom soup evenly over the chicken breasts.
Drain mushrooms and place over chicken breasts.
Fill empty mushroom can with white wine and pour over chicken breasts.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour and serve over rice or noodles.
recipes.text: Company Chicken. Rinse chicken breasts and roll in Bisquick until they are coated evenly. Place chicken breasts in Pyrex dish. Spoon the undiluted mushroom soup evenly over the chicken breasts. Drain mushrooms and place over chicken breasts. Fill empty mushroom can with white wine and pour over chicken breasts. Bake at 350° for 1 hour and serve over rice or noodles.

recipes.title: Grape Salad
directions: Layer all ingredients in a glass salad or serving bowl.
Mix gently before serving.
Very simple but delicious.
recipes.text: Grape Salad. Layer all ingredients in a glass salad or serving bowl. Mix gently before serving. Very simple but delicious.

recipes.title: Chinese Supper Skillet
ingredients: 2 cans (10 3/4 oz. each) condensed golden mushroom soup
directions: In skillet, brown beef and cook onion until tender (use shortening, if necessary).
Stir to separate meat; pour off fat. Add remaining ingredients; bring to a boil.
Cover.
Reduce heat; cook 10 minutes or until rice is done.
Stir often.
Serve with additional soy.
Makes about 6 cups.
recipes.text: Chinese Supper Skillet. In skillet, brown beef and cook onion until tender (use shortening, if necessary). Stir to separate meat; pour off fat. Add remaining ingredients; bring to a boil. Cover. Reduce heat; cook 10 minutes or until rice is done. Stir often. Serve with additional soy. Makes about 6 cups.

recipes.title: Guava And Ginger Marmalade
directions: Add
cup
sugar to the sliced guavas and set aside for 10 to 20 minutes.
After the 20 minutes have passed, pour the guava
paste and slices into a large pot.
Add the ground ginger and
bring to a boil.
Add the sugar and the Sure Jell. Turn heat off.
Pour into pint jars.	Makes about 6 pints.
recipes.text: Guava And Ginger Marmalade. Add 1/2 cup sugar to the sliced guavas and set aside for 10 to 20 minutes. After the 20 minutes have passed, pour the guava paste and slices into a large pot. Add the ground ginger and bring to a boil. Add the sugar and the Sure Jell. Turn heat off. Pour into pint jars.	Makes about 6 pints.

recipes.title: Chicken And Broccoli Au Gratin
ingredients: 1 (10 oz.) pkg. frozen broccoli spears, cooked and drained
1 chicken, cooked and cut in large cubes
1 c. (4 oz.) shredded Monterey Jack cheese
directions: Melt butter in skillet.
Saute onions until transparent. Remove from heat.
Stir in flour, salt, curry powder and pepper. Drain mushrooms, reserving liquid.
Add water to make 1/2 cup liquid.
recipes.text: Chicken And Broccoli Au Gratin. Melt butter in skillet. Saute onions until transparent. Remove from heat. Stir in flour, salt, curry powder and pepper. Drain mushrooms, reserving liquid. Add water to make 1/2 cup liquid.

recipes.title: Peas Supreme
directions: Thaw frozen peas.
(Do not cook.)
Add diced ham and cheese. Toss to coat with creamy bacon dressing.
Chill well.
Serve on lettuce.
recipes.text: Peas Supreme. Thaw frozen peas. (Do not cook.) Add diced ham and cheese. Toss to coat with creamy bacon dressing. Chill well. Serve on lettuce.

recipes.title: Fruit 'N Cheese Kabobs
ingredients: 1 fresh pineapple, peeled, cored and cut into 2-inch chunks
1 to 2 lb. seedless green or red grapes
directions: Cut cheese into chunks or slices. Alternately, thread cheese and fruit onto wooden skewers. Serve immediately. Yield: About 3 dozen.
recipes.text: Fruit 'N Cheese Kabobs. Cut cheese into chunks or slices. Alternately, thread cheese and fruit onto wooden skewers. Serve immediately. Yield: About 3 dozen.

recipes.title: Slow Cooker Fudge
directions: Melt butter and cheese in slow cooker on low, stirring to mix well.
Stir in vanilla.
Sift powdered sugar and cocoa together. Add to cheese mixture gradually, mixing well after each addition. Stir in pecans.
Pour into buttered 9 x 13-inch dish.
Let stand until firm.
Cut into squares.
recipes.text: Slow Cooker Fudge. Melt butter and cheese in slow cooker on low, stirring to mix well. Stir in vanilla. Sift powdered sugar and cocoa together. Add to cheese mixture gradually, mixing well after each addition. Stir in pecans. Pour into buttered 9 x 13-inch dish. Let stand until firm. Cut into squares.

recipes.title: Texas Millionaires
ingredients: 1 large or 2 small pkg. milk chocolate chips
directions: Melt chocolate in double boiler. Add milk and vanilla.
Mix well. Add nuts and drop by spoonfuls onto waxed paper.
Let cool.
recipes.text: Texas Millionaires. Melt chocolate in double boiler. Add milk and vanilla. Mix well. Add nuts and drop by spoonfuls onto waxed paper. Let cool.

recipes.title: Buckeyes
directions: Mix peanut butter, powered sugar and margarine.
Roll into balls.
Place on cookie sheet and freeze for approximately 30 minutes.
Melt chocolate.
Stick tooth picks into balls and dip in chocolate.
Leave a little on top to make it look like a buckeye. Place on cookie sheet lined with wax paper to cool.
recipes.text: Buckeyes. Mix peanut butter, powered sugar and margarine. Roll into balls. Place on cookie sheet and freeze for approximately 30 minutes. Melt chocolate. Stick tooth picks into balls and dip in chocolate. Leave a little on top to make it look like a buckeye. Place on cookie sheet lined with wax paper to cool.

recipes.title: Strawberry Torte
directions: Beat egg white until stiff peaks form. Add sugar, crackers, nuts and vanilla and blend well. Grease a 9 X 13 pan. Spread mixture in pan and bake at 350 degree oven for 20-25 minutes. Let cool, Clean and slice strawberries fold into cool whip and spread over cooled crust. Garnish with a few slices of strawberry.
recipes.text: Strawberry Torte. Beat egg white until stiff peaks form. Add sugar, crackers, nuts and vanilla and blend well. Grease a 9 X 13 pan. Spread mixture in pan and bake at 350 degree oven for 20-25 minutes. Let cool, Clean and slice strawberries fold into cool whip and spread over cooled crust. Garnish with a few slices of strawberry.

recipes.title: Guacamole
directions: Peel and mash avocados.
Add spices, grated onion and about 1 tablespoon of sour cream or mayonnaise.
Mix with a fork.
May be refrigerated for about an hour.
recipes.text: Guacamole. Peel and mash avocados. Add spices, grated onion and about 1 tablespoon of sour cream or mayonnaise. Mix with a fork. May be refrigerated for about an hour.

recipes.title: Broccoli Supreme
ingredients: 1 can cream of celery or mushroom soup
directions: Cut bacon in small pieces and fry with meat, onion, garlic, celery and pepper.
After meat is brown, add soup and cheese. Stir until melted.
In another pot, cook all broccoli as directed on package and drain thoroughly.
Mix with meat mixture.
Put in casserole dish.
Cook in 350° oven for 20 minutes.
recipes.text: Broccoli Supreme. Cut bacon in small pieces and fry with meat, onion, garlic, celery and pepper. After meat is brown, add soup and cheese. Stir until melted. In another pot, cook all broccoli as directed on package and drain thoroughly. Mix with meat mixture. Put in casserole dish. Cook in 350° oven for 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Potato Soup
directions: Brown onion in butter.
Add potatoes, hot water, salt and pepper.
Cover and cook until done.
Add hot milk.
recipes.text: Potato Soup. Brown onion in butter. Add potatoes, hot water, salt and pepper. Cover and cook until done. Add hot milk.

recipes.title: Fruit Salad
directions: Combine sugar, water and orange juice in saucepan.
Bring to boil over medium heat.
Cook for 3 minutes.
Cool.
Pour over combined fruits in a freezer-safe bowl.
Cover and freeze.
Thaw until slushy before serving.
recipes.text: Fruit Salad. Combine sugar, water and orange juice in saucepan. Bring to boil over medium heat. Cook for 3 minutes. Cool. Pour over combined fruits in a freezer-safe bowl. Cover and freeze. Thaw until slushy before serving.

recipes.title: Spoon Cornbread
directions: Preheat oven to 350. Mix all ingredients. Bake 35 minutes. Remove from oven. Grate velveeta cheese on top and bake 10 more minutes.
recipes.text: Spoon Cornbread. Preheat oven to 350. Mix all ingredients. Bake 35 minutes. Remove from oven. Grate velveeta cheese on top and bake 10 more minutes.

recipes.title: Quick Spicy Shrimp Cocktail
ingredients: 1 lb. large shrimp, shelled and deveined
1/4 c. plus 2 Tbsp. salsa (mild, medium or hot)
directions: In a large saucepan, bring beer and seasoning to a boil.
Add shrimp. Reduce heat to low.
Cover and simmer 3 to 4 minutes, stirring occasionally, until shrimp are opaque.
Remove shrimp with slotted spoon to a 9 x 9-inch metal pan.
Add 1 cup beer mixture. Cover with plastic wrap and place in freezer 5 minutes to cool.
recipes.text: Quick Spicy Shrimp Cocktail. In a large saucepan, bring beer and seasoning to a boil. Add shrimp. Reduce heat to low. Cover and simmer 3 to 4 minutes, stirring occasionally, until shrimp are opaque. Remove shrimp with slotted spoon to a 9 x 9-inch metal pan. Add 1 cup beer mixture. Cover with plastic wrap and place in freezer 5 minutes to cool.

recipes.title: Bread Pudding
ingredients: raisins and coconut (optional, may use 1 or both)
directions: Put bread in buttered pan; top with raisins and coconut.
Mix eggs, sugar, vanilla and milk.
Pour this over the bread cubes and raisins; if not moist enough, add more milk.
Bread should be nice and juicy.
Sprinkle with nutmeg.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes or until firm.
recipes.text: Bread Pudding. Put bread in buttered pan; top with raisins and coconut. Mix eggs, sugar, vanilla and milk. Pour this over the bread cubes and raisins; if not moist enough, add more milk. Bread should be nice and juicy. Sprinkle with nutmeg. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes or until firm.

recipes.title: Cranberry Salad
directions: Grind cranberries and orange.
Mix remaining ingredients.
Add ground cranberries and orange.
Refrigerate.
recipes.text: Cranberry Salad. Grind cranberries and orange. Mix remaining ingredients. Add ground cranberries and orange. Refrigerate.

recipes.title: Aliya'S Swordfish
ingredients: swordfish (8 oz. in weight, however many to be served)
directions: Add all ingredients
to food processor except fish.
Process into sauce consistency.
Marinate fish in sauce for 2 to 4 hours. Grill or broil until flakes with a fork.
Chilean sea bass can be used also!
recipes.text: Aliya'S Swordfish. Add all ingredients to food processor except fish. Process into sauce consistency. Marinate fish in sauce for 2 to 4 hours. Grill or broil until flakes with a fork. Chilean sea bass can be used also!

recipes.title: Snickers Bars
directions: Melt chocolate chips and shortening over hot (not boiling) water and pour half into an 8-inch square pan that has been lined with foil. Refrigerate until firm.
recipes.text: Snickers Bars. Melt chocolate chips and shortening over hot (not boiling) water and pour half into an 8-inch square pan that has been lined with foil. Refrigerate until firm.

recipes.title: Fruit Punch
directions: Mix all ingredients.
Serve chilled over ice.
recipes.text: Fruit Punch. Mix all ingredients. Serve chilled over ice.

recipes.title: Old-Fashioned Sweet Potato Pie
directions: Mix thoroughly and put in an unbaked 9-inch crust.
Bake in 450° oven for 10 minutes.
Reduce heat to 350° and bake for 30 minutes or until set.
recipes.text: Old-Fashioned Sweet Potato Pie. Mix thoroughly and put in an unbaked 9-inch crust. Bake in 450° oven for 10 minutes. Reduce heat to 350° and bake for 30 minutes or until set.

recipes.title: Snickerdoodles
directions: Mix together thoroughly the shortening, 1 1/2 cups sugar and eggs. Sift together flour, cream of tartar, soda and salt; stir into shortening mixture. Chill dough. Roll into balls the size of small walnuts. Roll in a mixture of 2 tablespoons sugar and the cinnamon. Place about 2 inches apart on an ungreased baking sheet. Bake until lightly browned, but still soft (8 to 10 minutes) in 400° oven.
recipes.text: Snickerdoodles. Mix together thoroughly the shortening, 1 1/2 cups sugar and eggs. Sift together flour, cream of tartar, soda and salt; stir into shortening mixture. Chill dough. Roll into balls the size of small walnuts. Roll in a mixture of 2 tablespoons sugar and the cinnamon. Place about 2 inches apart on an ungreased baking sheet. Bake until lightly browned, but still soft (8 to 10 minutes) in 400° oven.

recipes.title: Shrimp Dip
directions: Wash shrimp and devein.
Mix together and beat well.
recipes.text: Shrimp Dip. Wash shrimp and devein. Mix together and beat well.

recipes.title: Coconut Sour Cream Cake
ingredients: 1 1/2 c. whipped cream or whipped topping
directions: Prepare cake according to directions on box using two 8-inch layer pans.
Split both layers horizontally after they have cooled. Blend together the sugar, sour cream and coconut.
Chill.
Spread all but 1 cup of the sour cream mixture between the layers.
Blend the remaining cup of the mixture with whipped cream.
Spread on top and sides of the cake.
Seal in airtight container and refrigerate for 3 days before serving.
Keep refrigerated after cutting.
(Ours never last the 3 day waiting period!)
recipes.text: Coconut Sour Cream Cake. Prepare cake according to directions on box using two 8-inch layer pans. Split both layers horizontally after they have cooled. Blend together the sugar, sour cream and coconut. Chill. Spread all but 1 cup of the sour cream mixture between the layers. Blend the remaining cup of the mixture with whipped cream. Spread on top and sides of the cake. Seal in airtight container and refrigerate for 3 days before serving. Keep refrigerated after cutting. (Ours never last the 3 day waiting period!)

recipes.title: Easy Cornbread Casserole
directions: Melt 2 tablespoons shortening in extra large cast-iron skillet.
Mix all ingredients and bake at 400° for 30 minutes. Heat and time vary on type and size of skillet.
recipes.text: Easy Cornbread Casserole. Melt 2 tablespoons shortening in extra large cast-iron skillet. Mix all ingredients and bake at 400° for 30 minutes. Heat and time vary on type and size of skillet.

recipes.title: Spinach Soup
directions: Cook spinach; drain.
Cook onion in butter; stir in flour and bouillon.
Blend in milk gradually; stir until thick and boiling. Add spinach and salt and pepper to taste; top with sour cream and croutons if desired.
Serve hot or cold.
recipes.text: Spinach Soup. Cook spinach; drain. Cook onion in butter; stir in flour and bouillon. Blend in milk gradually; stir until thick and boiling. Add spinach and salt and pepper to taste; top with sour cream and croutons if desired. Serve hot or cold.

recipes.title: Strawberry Delight
ingredients: 1 envelope D-Zerta whipped topping or Cool Whip
1 angel food cake, cut in 1-inch squares
directions: Dissolve jello in 1 cup boiling water.
Add strawberries and stir until thawed.
Add 1/2 cup cold water and stir until syrupy. Add whipped topping and angel food cake.
Chill until firm.
recipes.text: Strawberry Delight. Dissolve jello in 1 cup boiling water. Add strawberries and stir until thawed. Add 1/2 cup cold water and stir until syrupy. Add whipped topping and angel food cake. Chill until firm.

recipes.title: Fruit Cake
directions: Line angel food tube with brown (sacks) paper.
Cut all fruit and nuts into small pieces.
Add dry ingredients; mix.
Beat eggs and vanilla.
Pour over mixture; mix well.
Pour into pan and bake 2 hours at 250°.
recipes.text: Fruit Cake. Line angel food tube with brown (sacks) paper. Cut all fruit and nuts into small pieces. Add dry ingredients; mix. Beat eggs and vanilla. Pour over mixture; mix well. Pour into pan and bake 2 hours at 250°.

recipes.title: Grandma'S Oatmeal Cookies
directions: Sift dry ingredients once. Cream shortening and sugar. Add eggs, beaten lightly, then dry ingredients and milk. Add oatmeal and raisins. Drop by teaspoon or tablespoon on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 375° until lightly brown. Makes 4 dozen+, depending on size. Can freeze. Can do ahead.
recipes.text: Grandma'S Oatmeal Cookies. Sift dry ingredients once. Cream shortening and sugar. Add eggs, beaten lightly, then dry ingredients and milk. Add oatmeal and raisins. Drop by teaspoon or tablespoon on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 375° until lightly brown. Makes 4 dozen+, depending on size. Can freeze. Can do ahead.

recipes.title: Ray Hutchison'S Homemade Vanilla Ice Cream
directions: These ingredients are for a 1 gallon freezer; multiply or reduce proportionately for 1/2 or 1 1/2 gallon freezers.
recipes.text: Ray Hutchison'S Homemade Vanilla Ice Cream. These ingredients are for a 1 gallon freezer; multiply or reduce proportionately for 1/2 or 1 1/2 gallon freezers.

recipes.title: Herb Dip
directions: Mix all together. Cool.
Use for vegetables as hors d'oeuvres.
recipes.text: Herb Dip. Mix all together. Cool. Use for vegetables as hors d'oeuvres.

recipes.title: Chicken Pot Pie
directions: Precook 1 (9-inch) pie crust as directed.
Boil chicken until brown.
Drain. Shred chicken into chunks.
Add cream of chicken soup and vegetables.
Cook until hot.
Pour into cooked pie crust. Use remaining pie crust to make topping layer.
Cook at temperature given on pie crust.
Cook until brown.
recipes.text: Chicken Pot Pie. Precook 1 (9-inch) pie crust as directed. Boil chicken until brown. Drain. Shred chicken into chunks. Add cream of chicken soup and vegetables. Cook until hot. Pour into cooked pie crust. Use remaining pie crust to make topping layer. Cook at temperature given on pie crust. Cook until brown.

recipes.title: Red Wine Vinaigrette
directions: Mix well.
Serve over cold cooked vegetables or fresh green salad.
recipes.text: Red Wine Vinaigrette. Mix well. Serve over cold cooked vegetables or fresh green salad.

recipes.title: Rice And Sausage Quick Dish
directions: Slice sausage into bite size pieces.
Add other ingredients into covered casserole dish.
Mix well.
Cook about 1 hour at 350°.
recipes.text: Rice And Sausage Quick Dish. Slice sausage into bite size pieces. Add other ingredients into covered casserole dish. Mix well. Cook about 1 hour at 350°.

recipes.title: Cheddar 'N Turkey Potato Pie
directions: Cook and stir mushrooms and onion in margarine over medium-high heat for 3 minutes.
Stir in flour, tarragon and pepper.
Gradually stir in broth and milk; cook, stirring frequently until mixture thickens and comes to a boil, about 5 minutes.
Reduce heat to low; stir in turkey, mixed vegetables and 1 cup of cheese.
Simmer for 5 minutes.
Stir 3/4 cup of cheese into hot mashed potatoes.
Spoon turkey mixture into 1 1/2-quart casserole.
Top with potato mixture.
Place under heated broiler for 5 minutes.
Sprinkle with remaining cheese and paprika.
Place under broiler for 2 minutes.
Makes 6 servings.
recipes.text: Cheddar 'N Turkey Potato Pie. Cook and stir mushrooms and onion in margarine over medium-high heat for 3 minutes. Stir in flour, tarragon and pepper. Gradually stir in broth and milk; cook, stirring frequently until mixture thickens and comes to a boil, about 5 minutes. Reduce heat to low; stir in turkey, mixed vegetables and 1 cup of cheese. Simmer for 5 minutes. Stir 3/4 cup of cheese into hot mashed potatoes. Spoon turkey mixture into 1 1/2-quart casserole. Top with potato mixture. Place under heated broiler for 5 minutes. Sprinkle with remaining cheese and paprika. Place under broiler for 2 minutes. Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Sour Cream Cornbread
directions: Combine corn,
sour
cream,
eggs
and	oil; beat well. Combine cornmeal
and
baking powder.
Stir into corn mixture. Pour into a
greased 10-inch skillet or pan.
Bake at 400° for 30 minutes or until done.
Yields 8 servings.
recipes.text: Sour Cream Cornbread. Combine corn, sour cream, eggs and	oil; beat well. Combine cornmeal and baking powder. Stir into corn mixture. Pour into a greased 10-inch skillet or pan. Bake at 400° for 30 minutes or until done. Yields 8 servings.

recipes.title: Aunt Emmie'S Chicken Picase(Serves 2)
ingredients: 2 whole chickens, trimmed of all fat and cut in half
3 fresh plum tomatoes in season, skinned, deseeded and diced or canned whole tomatoes
1 small can Progresso artichokes in oil, cut in half lengthwise
1 Tbsp. cornstarch, mixed in a jar with 1/4 c. water
directions: Beat egg with milk in a medium-size bowl.
Set aside.
In a shallow dish, add salt, pepper, parsley and flour; mix.
Dip cutlet into flour mixture and then coat with beaten egg.
recipes.text: Aunt Emmie'S Chicken Picase(Serves 2). Beat egg with milk in a medium-size bowl. Set aside. In a shallow dish, add salt, pepper, parsley and flour; mix. Dip cutlet into flour mixture and then coat with beaten egg.

recipes.title: Rice And Pork Chops
directions: Brown
pork
chops.
Remove
from
pan	and
add 2 cups water, bouillon
cubes and 1 cup rice.
Replace pork chops in pan
and add slices of onion, bell pepper and tomatoes.
Cook at 350° for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Rice And Pork Chops. Brown pork chops. Remove from pan	and add 2 cups water, bouillon cubes and 1 cup rice. Replace pork chops in pan and add slices of onion, bell pepper and tomatoes. Cook at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Cheese Ball
ingredients: 1 small pack of Carl Buddig beef, chopped
directions: Mix cream cheese, onions, and mustard. Roll cream cheese mixture in beef.
recipes.text: Cheese Ball. Mix cream cheese, onions, and mustard. Roll cream cheese mixture in beef.

recipes.title: Mini Chocolate Chip Pancakes
directions: Use lightly greased griddle or frypan (375° if griddle).
In small bowl, combine batter and chocolate chips.
Pour 2 tablespoons of batter and chocolate chips on griddle.
Turn when bubbly.
Cook until desired lightly browned surface is obtained. Serve with syrup.
recipes.text: Mini Chocolate Chip Pancakes. Use lightly greased griddle or frypan (375° if griddle). In small bowl, combine batter and chocolate chips. Pour 2 tablespoons of batter and chocolate chips on griddle. Turn when bubbly. Cook until desired lightly browned surface is obtained. Serve with syrup.

recipes.title: Chinese Hamburger
directions: Brown hamburger. Add onion and celery until transparent; drain. Add soups, water, rice, soy sauce and pepper. Transfer to a casserole dish. Bake at 350° for 20 minutes. Top with chow mein noodles and cook for 10 minutes more.
recipes.text: Chinese Hamburger. Brown hamburger. Add onion and celery until transparent; drain. Add soups, water, rice, soy sauce and pepper. Transfer to a casserole dish. Bake at 350° for 20 minutes. Top with chow mein noodles and cook for 10 minutes more.

recipes.title: Ham-Cheese Appetizers
ingredients: 2 (8 oz.) pkg. Philadelphia cream cheese (room temperature)
1 Tbsp. finely minced or grated onion
directions: Mix softened cream cheese with remaining ingredients.
Spread on slices of ham, roll lengthwise.
Refrigerate until firm and slice into bite-size pieces.
recipes.text: Ham-Cheese Appetizers. Mix softened cream cheese with remaining ingredients. Spread on slices of ham, roll lengthwise. Refrigerate until firm and slice into bite-size pieces.

recipes.title: Cookies 'N Cream Pie
ingredients: 1 1/2 c. cold half and half or light cream
1 pkg. (4 serving size) vanilla instant pudding and pie filling
directions: Pour half and half into large bowl.
Add pie filling mix.
Beat with wire whisk until well blended, 1 minute.
Let stand 5 minutes. Fold in whipped topping and crushed cookies.
Spoon into crust. Freeze until firm, about 6 hours or overnight.
Remove from freezer and let stand 10 minutes to soften before serving.
Store any leftover pie in freezer.
recipes.text: Cookies 'N Cream Pie. Pour half and half into large bowl. Add pie filling mix. Beat with wire whisk until well blended, 1 minute. Let stand 5 minutes. Fold in whipped topping and crushed cookies. Spoon into crust. Freeze until firm, about 6 hours or overnight. Remove from freezer and let stand 10 minutes to soften before serving. Store any leftover pie in freezer.

recipes.title: Holiday Coconut Rum Balls
ingredients: 12 oz. pkg. vanilla wafers, crushed (3 1/3 c.)
1 c. finely chopped walnuts or pecans
directions: In a large bowl, combine crushed cookies, nuts and coconut. Add sweetened condensed milk and rum; mix well.
Chill 4 hours. Dip palms of hands in powdered sugar and shape batter into 1-inch balls.
Roll in powdered sugar; cover and store in fridge.
If desired, reroll in powdered sugar before serving.
May be made ahead and stored in fridge for several weeks.
recipes.text: Holiday Coconut Rum Balls. In a large bowl, combine crushed cookies, nuts and coconut. Add sweetened condensed milk and rum; mix well. Chill 4 hours. Dip palms of hands in powdered sugar and shape batter into 1-inch balls. Roll in powdered sugar; cover and store in fridge. If desired, reroll in powdered sugar before serving. May be made ahead and stored in fridge for several weeks.

recipes.title: Bisque Tortoni
ingredients: 1/2 c. plus 2 Tbsp. crushed macaroons or coconut cookies
directions: In small bowl, beat yolks with sugar until fluffy.
Stir in liquid (vanilla and brandy).
Fold egg yolks into egg whites and the egg white mixture into the whipped cream.
Stir in crushed macaroons.
Fill 8 cupcake papers or pretty dessert glasses. Serve with chocolate laced cookies.
recipes.text: Bisque Tortoni. In small bowl, beat yolks with sugar until fluffy. Stir in liquid (vanilla and brandy). Fold egg yolks into egg whites and the egg white mixture into the whipped cream. Stir in crushed macaroons. Fill 8 cupcake papers or pretty dessert glasses. Serve with chocolate laced cookies.

recipes.title: Mocha Truffles
directions: In a large saucepan, melt shortening.
Add 1/2 cup chocolate chips; heat over low heat until chips melt.
(Watch these; do not let the chocolate scorch.)
Stir in coffee crystals; blend until they dissolve.
Stir in sugar, eggs and vanilla.
In a medium mixing bowl, combine the flour, cocoa, baking powder and salt. Stir into the coffee mixture.
Add 1 cup chocolate chips.
Drop by rounded teaspoonfuls or tablespoonfuls onto lightly greased cookie sheet.
Bake at 350° for 10 minutes.
Let cool 1 minute before removing from sheet.
Makes 3 dozen of the large size cookies. (Some people prefer the cookies without the coffee flavor.)
recipes.text: Mocha Truffles. In a large saucepan, melt shortening. Add 1/2 cup chocolate chips; heat over low heat until chips melt. (Watch these; do not let the chocolate scorch.) Stir in coffee crystals; blend until they dissolve. Stir in sugar, eggs and vanilla. In a medium mixing bowl, combine the flour, cocoa, baking powder and salt. Stir into the coffee mixture. Add 1 cup chocolate chips. Drop by rounded teaspoonfuls or tablespoonfuls onto lightly greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350° for 10 minutes. Let cool 1 minute before removing from sheet. Makes 3 dozen of the large size cookies. (Some people prefer the cookies without the coffee flavor.)

recipes.title: Betty'S Marvelous Fudge
directions: Combine first 3 ingredients.
Boil for 8 minutes, stirring so it will not scorch.
Pour mixture over pecans.
Add marshmallows and chocolate chips.
Beat with mixer until creamy.
Pour into large greased Pyrex dish.
recipes.text: Betty'S Marvelous Fudge. Combine first 3 ingredients. Boil for 8 minutes, stirring so it will not scorch. Pour mixture over pecans. Add marshmallows and chocolate chips. Beat with mixer until creamy. Pour into large greased Pyrex dish.

recipes.title: Microwave Caramel Corn
directions: Pop corn.
In pan, combine all other ingredients, except soda and popcorn.
Bring to boil.
Continue to boil for 2 minutes. Stir in baking soda.
Put popped corn in brown paper bag.
Pour syrup over corn; shake gently.
Microwave 1 1/2 minutes on High. Shake.
Microwave 1 1/2 minutes more.
Pour onto flat pan to cool. Mixture will be very hot.
recipes.text: Microwave Caramel Corn. Pop corn. In pan, combine all other ingredients, except soda and popcorn. Bring to boil. Continue to boil for 2 minutes. Stir in baking soda.
