Put popped corn in brown paper bag. Pour syrup over corn; shake gently. Microwave 1 1/2 minutes on High. Shake. Microwave 1 1/2 minutes more. Pour onto flat pan to cool. Mixture will be very hot.

recipes.title: Sweet Potato Treat
directions: Cream margarine and sugar. Add potatoes, milk and vanilla. Mix until thoroughly blended. Place in a buttered 1 1/2-quart baking dish. Cover with a topping made by crumbling together brown sugar, flour, pecans and margarine. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes. Makes 6 servings.
recipes.text: Sweet Potato Treat. Cream margarine and sugar. Add potatoes, milk and vanilla. Mix until thoroughly blended. Place in a buttered 1 1/2-quart baking dish. Cover with a topping made by crumbling together brown sugar, flour, pecans and margarine. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes. Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Country Cobbler
directions: Combine and mix butter, sugar, flour, baking powder, salt and milk.
Blend well and pour into deep 1 1/2-quart casserole dish. Combine 1/2 to 3/4 cup of sugar with blackberries or peaches. Pour over batter.
Bake at 375° for 30 to 40 minutes.
Serves 6.
recipes.text: Country Cobbler. Combine and mix butter, sugar, flour, baking powder, salt and milk. Blend well and pour into deep 1 1/2-quart casserole dish. Combine 1/2 to 3/4 cup of sugar with blackberries or peaches. Pour over batter. Bake at 375° for 30 to 40 minutes. Serves 6.

recipes.title: Jean'S Chicken Roll
ingredients: 2 large chicken breasts, cooked and cut into bite size pieces
salt, pepper and garlic salt to taste
directions: After chicken is cooked and cut up, add remaining ingredients along with small amount of stock from chicken.
Cook until vegetables are just done.
Let cool.
Make 1 1/2 recipes Bisquick biscuits, roll in large rectangle and put in chicken mixture.
Roll up and put on large cookie sheet.
Bake 25 to 30 minutes at 375°. Serve with chicken gravy.
recipes.text: Jean'S Chicken Roll. After chicken is cooked and cut up, add remaining ingredients along with small amount of stock from chicken. Cook until vegetables are just done. Let cool. Make 1 1/2 recipes Bisquick biscuits, roll in large rectangle and put in chicken mixture. Roll up and put on large cookie sheet. Bake 25 to 30 minutes at 375°. Serve with chicken gravy.

recipes.title: Apple Brown Betty
directions: Place sliced apples in a buttered pie plate and drizzle with orange juice.
recipes.text: Apple Brown Betty. Place sliced apples in a buttered pie plate and drizzle with orange juice.

recipes.title: Salisbury Steak
ingredients: 1 (10 1/2 oz.) can condensed golden mushroom soup
directions: Blend soup, mustard, Worcestershire sauce and horseradish. Combine beef, 1/4 cup soup mixture, egg, bread crumbs, onion and seasonings.
Shape into patties.
Brown patties in skillet and pour off fat.
Stir in remaining soup mixture, water and parsley. Cover and cook over low heat for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Serve with potatoes.
recipes.text: Salisbury Steak. Blend soup, mustard, Worcestershire sauce and horseradish. Combine beef, 1/4 cup soup mixture, egg, bread crumbs, onion and seasonings. Shape into patties. Brown patties in skillet and pour off fat. Stir in remaining soup mixture, water and parsley. Cover and cook over low heat for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally. Serve with potatoes.

recipes.title: Potato Pizza Hot Dish
directions: Preheat oven to 350°.
Peel and slice potatoes.
Put in 9 x 13-inch casserole dish.
Mix Cheddar cheese with 1/2 can of milk; pour over potatoes.
Brown hamburger; add salt, pepper and onion salt.
Add tomato soup.
Let simmer 10 minutes, then put on top of potatoes.
Do not mix.
Cover with foil and bake at 350° about 1 hour or until potatoes are done.
Remove from oven.
Add cheese on top.
Bake until cheese is melted.
recipes.text: Potato Pizza Hot Dish. Preheat oven to 350°. Peel and slice potatoes. Put in 9 x 13-inch casserole dish. Mix Cheddar cheese with 1/2 can of milk; pour over potatoes. Brown hamburger; add salt, pepper and onion salt. Add tomato soup. Let simmer 10 minutes, then put on top of potatoes. Do not mix. Cover with foil and bake at 350° about 1 hour or until potatoes are done. Remove from oven. Add cheese on top. Bake until cheese is melted.

recipes.title: Marinated Broccoli Slaw
ingredients: 1/2 tsp. dry mustard or 1/4 tsp. prepared mustard
directions: Can also use 5 cups green cabbage, chopped.
recipes.text: Marinated Broccoli Slaw. Can also use 5 cups green cabbage, chopped.

recipes.title: Penuche Coconut Bars
directions: Blend shortening and 1/2 cup brown sugar.
Add 1 cup flour and the salt.
Stir in milk.
Pat evenly in lightly greased 9 x 9 x 2-inch pan.
Bake at 325° for about 20 minutes or until light brown.
Beat eggs; add 1 cup brown sugar and vanilla and beat until thick and lemon colored.
Add remaining ingredients and mix well.
Spread over baked crust.
Bake at 325° for 20 minutes until golden brown.
Cool and cut into 36 squares.
recipes.text: Penuche Coconut Bars. Blend shortening and 1/2 cup brown sugar. Add 1 cup flour and the salt. Stir in milk. Pat evenly in lightly greased 9 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Bake at 325° for about 20 minutes or until light brown. Beat eggs; add 1 cup brown sugar and vanilla and beat until thick and lemon colored. Add remaining ingredients and mix well. Spread over baked crust. Bake at 325° for 20 minutes until golden brown. Cool and cut into 36 squares.

recipes.title: Country Supper Casserole
directions: Brown ground beef in 10-inch skillet with onion and green pepper.
Sprinkle with salt and pepper.
Pour off any excess grease.
Place in a 3-quart casserole dish.
Pour over 8 ounces tomato sauce.
Add green beans and carrots.
Prepare mashed potatoes.
Spoon over top of vegetables.
Pour over 8 ounces of tomato sauce.
Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.
recipes.text: Country Supper Casserole. Brown ground beef in 10-inch skillet with onion and green pepper. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Pour off any excess grease. Place in a 3-quart casserole dish. Pour over 8 ounces tomato sauce. Add green beans and carrots. Prepare mashed potatoes. Spoon over top of vegetables. Pour over 8 ounces of tomato sauce. Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.

recipes.title: Delicious Sweet Potatoes
directions: Mix the first 6 ingredients and spread in greased baking dish. Sprinkle pecans over top.
Mix the brown sugar, flour and margarine; sprinkle over pecans.
Bake at 350° for 35 minutes.
recipes.text: Delicious Sweet Potatoes. Mix the first 6 ingredients and spread in greased baking dish. Sprinkle pecans over top. Mix the brown sugar, flour and margarine; sprinkle over pecans. Bake at 350° for 35 minutes.

recipes.title: Shrimp Toast
directions: Mix all together using a hand mixer, then spread on English muffins.
Place muffins on cookie sheet and put in a 350° oven until toasted.
Cut muffin slices into 4, then serve.
recipes.text: Shrimp Toast. Mix all together using a hand mixer, then spread on English muffins. Place muffins on cookie sheet and put in a 350° oven until toasted. Cut muffin slices into 4, then serve.

recipes.title: Hash Brown Potato Casserole(Serves 15 To 20 People)
directions: Melt margarine and potatoes and put into a 13 x 15-inch baking dish.
Mix the rest of ingredients and pour over potatoes.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Hash Brown Potato Casserole(Serves 15 To 20 People). Melt margarine and potatoes and put into a 13 x 15-inch baking dish. Mix the rest of ingredients and pour over potatoes. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Lime Jello Salad
directions: Mix jello with water and add 1 cup marshmallows while hot. Set aside to cool.
Mix remaining ingredients and add to jello mixture.
Place in refrigerator to set.
recipes.text: Lime Jello Salad. Mix jello with water and add 1 cup marshmallows while hot. Set aside to cool. Mix remaining ingredients and add to jello mixture. Place in refrigerator to set.

recipes.title: Cranberry Salad
directions: Dissolve Jell-O and sugar in hot water.
Let cool.
Add cranberries.
Mix well.
Add remaining ingredients.
Place in refrigerator to jell.
recipes.text: Cranberry Salad. Dissolve Jell-O and sugar in hot water. Let cool. Add cranberries. Mix well. Add remaining ingredients. Place in refrigerator to jell.

recipes.title: Hot Fudge Sauce
directions: Melt 1/2 cup butter in top of double boiler. Add 4 squares of unsweetened chocolate and let melt. Add 3 cups sugar, 1/4 cup at a time, stirring slowly. Add 1/2 teaspoon salt. Slowly stir in 1 can evaporated milk. Cook until slightly thick. Store in jar in refrigerator. Serve on ice cream. Tastes like real Dairy Queen chocolate.
recipes.text: Hot Fudge Sauce. Melt 1/2 cup butter in top of double boiler. Add 4 squares of unsweetened chocolate and let melt. Add 3 cups sugar, 1/4 cup at a time, stirring slowly. Add 1/2 teaspoon salt. Slowly stir in 1 can evaporated milk. Cook until slightly thick. Store in jar in refrigerator. Serve on ice cream. Tastes like real Dairy Queen chocolate.

recipes.title: Lasagne
ingredients: 3 c. fresh Ricotta or cream-style cottage cheese
1/2 c. grated Parmesan or Romano cheese
1 lb. Mozzarella cheese, sliced very thin
directions: Brown meat slowly. Spoon off excess fat.
Add next 5 ingredients and 1 cup water. Simmer, covered, 15 minutes.
Stir often. Cook noodles in boiling salted water until tender. Drain and rinse. Beat eggs. Add remaining ingredients, except Mozzarella.

Layer half the noodles in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish. Spread with half the Ricotta filling. Add half the Mozzarella cheese and half the meat sauce. Repeat. Bake at 375° about 30 minutes. (Or assemble early and refrigerate; bake 45 minutes.) Let stand 10 minutes before serving.
Serves 8 to 10.
recipes.text: Lasagne. Brown meat slowly. Spoon off excess fat. Add next 5 ingredients and 1 cup water. Simmer, covered, 15 minutes. Stir often. Cook noodles in boiling salted water until tender. Drain and rinse. Beat eggs. Add remaining ingredients, except Mozzarella. Layer half the noodles in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish. Spread with half the Ricotta filling. Add half the Mozzarella cheese and half the meat sauce. Repeat. Bake at 375° about 30 minutes. (Or assemble early and refrigerate; bake 45 minutes.) Let stand 10 minutes before serving. Serves 8 to 10.

recipes.title: Broccoli Ring
directions: Cook broccoli in boiling water with garlic until tender. Remove garlic; drain.
Melt butter; add flour and gradually pour in the cream.
Cook until thick; add beaten egg yolks and broccoli.
Fold in stiffly beaten egg whites.
Season.
Pour into buttered and floured ring.
Place in pan of boiling water and bake in a 325° oven for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Broccoli Ring. Cook broccoli in boiling water with garlic until tender. Remove garlic; drain. Melt butter; add flour and gradually pour in the cream. Cook until thick; add beaten egg yolks and broccoli. Fold in stiffly beaten egg whites. Season. Pour into buttered and floured ring. Place in pan of boiling water and bake in a 325° oven for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Chinese Casserole
directions: Add soup to boiling water.
Add all ingredients together. Bake 1 hour in 350° oven.
Serves 12.
This is a hearty main meal.
recipes.text: Chinese Casserole. Add soup to boiling water. Add all ingredients together. Bake 1 hour in 350° oven. Serves 12. This is a hearty main meal.

recipes.title: Easy Spinach Casserole
ingredients: 1 pkg. Hidden Valley Ranch dry salad dressing mix
directions: In a microwave oven, cook spinach (without water) covered for about 6 to 8 minutes, until spinach is hot.
Remove from oven and drain well.
Mix together sour cream and salad dressing mix and then stir into the spinach.
Pour into greased casserole dish. Sprinkle Parmesan cheese and paprika on top.
Return to microwave for 3 to 4 minutes or may be baked in a regular oven for 25 to 30 minutes at 325°.
(I prefer the regular oven.)
recipes.text: Easy Spinach Casserole. In a microwave oven, cook spinach (without water) covered for about 6 to 8 minutes, until spinach is hot. Remove from oven and drain well. Mix together sour cream and salad dressing mix and then stir into the spinach. Pour into greased casserole dish. Sprinkle Parmesan cheese and paprika on top. Return to microwave for 3 to 4 minutes or may be baked in a regular oven for 25 to 30 minutes at 325°. (I prefer the regular oven.)

recipes.title: Beef Stroganoff
ingredients: 1 lb. boneless beef round steak, cut 3/4 inch thick
directions: Slice beef across the grain into very thin strips.
In skillet over high heat in 1 tablespoon of margarine, cook half of the beef and half the onion.
Cook until beef is no longer pink and onion is tender; set aside.
Repeat with remaining margarine, beef and onion.
Return all meat mixture to skillet.
Stir in soup and paprika.
Heat thoroughly, stirring occasionally.
Reduce heat to very low.
Stir in sour cream.
Serve over noodles.
Serves 6.
recipes.text: Beef Stroganoff. Slice beef across the grain into very thin strips. In skillet over high heat in 1 tablespoon of margarine, cook half of the beef and half the onion. Cook until beef is no longer pink and onion is tender; set aside. Repeat with remaining margarine, beef and onion. Return all meat mixture to skillet. Stir in soup and paprika. Heat thoroughly, stirring occasionally. Reduce heat to very low. Stir in sour cream. Serve over noodles. Serves 6.

recipes.title: Orzo Salad
ingredients: 1 c. dry orzo macaroni, cooked 10 minutes and drained
directions: Add ingredients in order; mix together until well mixed and refrigerate.
Serve with a dollop of Cool Whip.
recipes.text: Orzo Salad. Add ingredients in order; mix together until well mixed and refrigerate. Serve with a dollop of Cool Whip.

recipes.title: Crab Mousse
directions: Coat a 4-cup mold with cooking spray; set aside.
Sprinkle gelatin over milk in saucepan; let stand 1 minute.
Add cream cheese (or Neufchatel cheese) and cook over low heat, stirring until gelatin dissolves and mixture is smooth.
Add yogurt, blend. Remove from heat.
Add crabmeat, celery, green onions, lemon juice, pepper and horseradish, blending well.
recipes.text: Crab Mousse. Coat a 4-cup mold with cooking spray; set aside. Sprinkle gelatin over milk in saucepan; let stand 1 minute. Add cream cheese (or Neufchatel cheese) and cook over low heat, stirring until gelatin dissolves and mixture is smooth. Add yogurt, blend. Remove from heat. Add crabmeat, celery, green onions, lemon juice, pepper and horseradish, blending well.

recipes.title: Chicken Casserole
ingredients: 2 chicken breasts, cooked or 2 cans (5 oz.) boned chicken
directions: Mix soups, milk, mushrooms and pimento.
Fold in cooked chicken; let stand about 12 hours.
Add noodles; place in buttered casserole and sprinkle with almonds.
No salt is needed.
Bake for 1 hour at 350°.
Makes 12 servings.
recipes.text: Chicken Casserole. Mix soups, milk, mushrooms and pimento. Fold in cooked chicken; let stand about 12 hours. Add noodles; place in buttered casserole and sprinkle with almonds. No salt is needed. Bake for 1 hour at 350°. Makes 12 servings.

recipes.title: Sweetened Condensed Milk
directions: Combine all ingredients in electric blender.
Process until smooth.
Store in refrigerator.
This makes 1 1/2 cups.
You may want to add a little more water as it makes a thick milk.
recipes.text: Sweetened Condensed Milk. Combine all ingredients in electric blender. Process until smooth. Store in refrigerator. This makes 1 1/2 cups. You may want to add a little more water as it makes a thick milk.

recipes.title: Kahlua Fruit Dip
directions: Beat cream cheese and sour cream until smooth.
Add Kahlua and brown sugar.
Mix well.
Fold in Cool Whip and nuts.
Chill.
Serve with assorted fruit:
Granny Smith apples, bananas, winter pears, etc.
recipes.text: Kahlua Fruit Dip. Beat cream cheese and sour cream until smooth. Add Kahlua and brown sugar. Mix well. Fold in Cool Whip and nuts. Chill. Serve with assorted fruit: Granny Smith apples, bananas, winter pears, etc.

recipes.title: Artichoke Dip
ingredients: 1 (14 or 15 oz.) can artichoke hearts in water, drained and chopped
directions: Heat oven to 350°.
Mix all ingredients; spread in a 9-inch pan.
Bake for 25 to 30 minutes.
Makes 1 1/2 cups.
recipes.text: Artichoke Dip. Heat oven to 350°. Mix all ingredients; spread in a 9-inch pan. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes. Makes 1 1/2 cups.

recipes.title: Squash Casserole
ingredients: 1 (10 3/4 oz.) can cream of mushroom soup
directions: Cook squash and onion in boiling water until tender.
Drain, mash and drain again.
Add butter, beaten egg yolks, cream of mushroom soup, salt and pepper.
Beat egg whites until stiff. Fold into squash mixture.
Place mixture in a buttered 2-quart casserole dish.
Top with Ritz cracker crumbs.
Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese.
Bake in a 350° oven for 30 minutes.
Makes 6 servings.
recipes.text: Squash Casserole. Cook squash and onion in boiling water until tender. Drain, mash and drain again. Add butter, beaten egg yolks, cream of mushroom soup, salt and pepper. Beat egg whites until stiff. Fold into squash mixture. Place mixture in a buttered 2-quart casserole dish. Top with Ritz cracker crumbs. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Bake in a 350° oven for 30 minutes. Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Potato Salad
ingredients: 1/8 tsp. red pepper (if you like hotter, add more pepper, Accent or m.s.g.)
enough mayonnaise to mix like you want it
directions: Taste to see if it needs anything and add if it does.
Pour in bowl.
Sprinkle paprika on top.
Serve.
recipes.text: Potato Salad. Taste to see if it needs anything and add if it does. Pour in bowl. Sprinkle paprika on top. Serve.

recipes.title: Peaches And Cream Salad
directions: Dissolve gelatins in boiling water in bowl.
Spoon in ice cream, stirring until melted.
Chill in refrigerator until partially set.
Add peaches; mix well.
Pour into serving dish; chill until set.
Yields 12 servings.
recipes.text: Peaches And Cream Salad. Dissolve gelatins in boiling water in bowl. Spoon in ice cream, stirring until melted. Chill in refrigerator until partially set. Add peaches; mix well. Pour into serving dish; chill until set. Yields 12 servings.

recipes.title: Cranberry Salad
directions: Drain pineapple; reserve syrup.
Add enough water to syrup to make 1 cup liquid.
Boil liquid; dissolve Jell-O.
Add 1 cup water.
Chill until thick but not set.
Stir in cranberry sauce, pineapple and nuts.
Chill until firm.
recipes.text: Cranberry Salad. Drain pineapple; reserve syrup. Add enough water to syrup to make 1 cup liquid. Boil liquid; dissolve Jell-O. Add 1 cup water. Chill until thick but not set. Stir in cranberry sauce, pineapple and nuts. Chill until firm.

recipes.title: Pancakes
ingredients: 1 c. milk (or more if needed to make right consistency)
directions: Stir until real smooth and drop with spoon.
recipes.text: Pancakes. Stir until real smooth and drop with spoon.

recipes.title: Blueberry Cake
directions: Mix first four ingredients, then add blueberries and nuts. Pour into bundt pan.
recipes.text: Blueberry Cake. Mix first four ingredients, then add blueberries and nuts. Pour into bundt pan.

recipes.title: Cool Pink Lemonade Pie
directions: Blend all ingredients and pour into prepared graham cracker crust. Chill 1 hour before serving.
recipes.text: Cool Pink Lemonade Pie. Blend all ingredients and pour into prepared graham cracker crust. Chill 1 hour before serving.

recipes.title: Snickerdoodles
directions: Mix together soft shortening, 1 1/2 cups sugar and eggs thoroughly.
Sift together soda, sifted flour, salt and cream of tartar and stir in.
Chill dough.
recipes.text: Snickerdoodles. Mix together soft shortening, 1 1/2 cups sugar and eggs thoroughly. Sift together soda, sifted flour, salt and cream of tartar and stir in. Chill dough.

recipes.title: Golden Cornbread
directions: Mix all dry ingredients; add liquid ingredients and stir until well mixed.
Bake in greased 8-inch square pan at 425° for 20 to 25 minutes until browned.
recipes.text: Golden Cornbread. Mix all dry ingredients; add liquid ingredients and stir until well mixed. Bake in greased 8-inch square pan at 425° for 20 to 25 minutes until browned.

recipes.title: Spanish Rice
directions: Brown together onion, green pepper, hamburger and rice.
Add salt, pepper, tomato sauce, water and mustard.
Bring mixture to a boil, then simmer for 25 minutes.
recipes.text: Spanish Rice. Brown together onion, green pepper, hamburger and rice. Add salt, pepper, tomato sauce, water and mustard. Bring mixture to a boil, then simmer for 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Pizza Burgers
directions: Brown hamburger, pepperoni and onion together.
Drain off fat. Add remaining ingredients.
Place 1 to 2 tablespoons of mixture on each top or bottom of hamburger bun.
Bake open-faced for 10 to 15 minutes at 425°.
recipes.text: Pizza Burgers. Brown hamburger, pepperoni and onion together. Drain off fat. Add remaining ingredients. Place 1 to 2 tablespoons of mixture on each top or bottom of hamburger bun. Bake open-faced for 10 to 15 minutes at 425°.

recipes.title: Whole Wheat Pie Crust
directions: Mix
first
3 ingredients.
Sprinkle water over and mix well, not
too much.
Roll out on wax paper.
Bake at 325° for 25 to 30 minutes.
Makes a single crust.
recipes.text: Whole Wheat Pie Crust. Mix first 3 ingredients. Sprinkle water over and mix well, not too much. Roll out on wax paper. Bake at 325° for 25 to 30 minutes. Makes a single crust.

recipes.title: Ham-Broccoli Bake
ingredients: fresh stem broccoli or frozen asparagus can be substituted
directions: Take broccoli spear, wrap piece of cheese around it.
Wrap ham around cheese and secure with a toothpick.
Do this with all 8 slices.
Mix mushroom soup and sour cream with mustard.
Pour over ham, cheese and broccoli roll-ups.
Bake uncovered for 25 minutes at 350°.
recipes.text: Ham-Broccoli Bake. Take broccoli spear, wrap piece of cheese around it. Wrap ham around cheese and secure with a toothpick. Do this with all 8 slices. Mix mushroom soup and sour cream with mustard. Pour over ham, cheese and broccoli roll-ups. Bake uncovered for 25 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Gratin Potatoes
ingredients: 3 large baking potatoes, peeled and thinly sliced
directions: Layer potatoes slices in buttered 13 x 9 inch baking dish. Stir together cream and remaining ingredients; pour mixture over potatoes.
Bake at 400° for 50 minutes or until potatoes are tender and mixture is bubbly and golden.
Let stand 15 minutes before serving.
recipes.text: Gratin Potatoes. Layer potatoes slices in buttered 13 x 9 inch baking dish. Stir together cream and remaining ingredients; pour mixture over potatoes. Bake at 400° for 50 minutes or until potatoes are tender and mixture is bubbly and golden. Let stand 15 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Hulupkies(Cabbage Rolls)
directions: Cook rice according to package directions.
In a large bowl, combine beef, rice, egg, oregano, onion, salt, pepper and 1/2 cup Ragu.
In a large kettle, boil cabbage head, removing leaves as they become very tender.
Roll approximately 2 tablespoons of meat mixture in each cabbage leaf.
Place loose edge down into roaster lined with extra cabbage leaves.
Top with water, Ragu and bacon strips.
Bake at 300° for 2 1/2 hours.
Check every 45 minutes. Add water if necessary.
recipes.text: Hulupkies(Cabbage Rolls). Cook rice according to package directions. In a large bowl, combine beef, rice, egg, oregano, onion, salt, pepper and 1/2 cup Ragu. In a large kettle, boil cabbage head, removing leaves as they become very tender. Roll approximately 2 tablespoons of meat mixture in each cabbage leaf. Place loose edge down into roaster lined with extra cabbage leaves. Top with water, Ragu and bacon strips. Bake at 300° for 2 1/2 hours. Check every 45 minutes. Add water if necessary.

recipes.title: Chili Con Queso
ingredients: 1 lb. Bob Evans sausage, browned and crumbled
1 can Ro-Tel chopped tomatoes and green chiles
directions: Combine all ingredients and heat until cheese is melted.
recipes.text: Chili Con Queso. Combine all ingredients and heat until cheese is melted.

recipes.title: Rum Cake
ingredients: 1 pkg. yellow cake mix with pudding in the mix
directions: Preheat oven to 350°.
Grease and flour a 12-cup fluted tube pan or Bundt pan.
In a large bowl, blend cake ingredients until moistened.
Beat 2 minutes at high speed.
Pour into prepared pan.
Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes or until a toothpick comes out clean.
recipes.text: Rum Cake. Preheat oven to 350°. Grease and flour a 12-cup fluted tube pan or Bundt pan. In a large bowl, blend cake ingredients until moistened. Beat 2 minutes at high speed. Pour into prepared pan. Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes or until a toothpick comes out clean.

recipes.title: Oatmeal Cookies
directions: Combine all ingredients.
Add flour and oatmeal last.
Roll into little balls.
Put on cookie sheet; bake until cookies are lightly browned.
Will make about 3 to 4 dozen.
recipes.text: Oatmeal Cookies. Combine all ingredients. Add flour and oatmeal last. Roll into little balls. Put on cookie sheet; bake until cookies are lightly browned. Will make about 3 to 4 dozen.

recipes.title: Seven Layer Salad
ingredients: 1 large head lettuce, tear in pieces
1 large bag or 1 lb. green peas, cook and drain
directions: Put ingredients in 9 x 13-inch pan.
Layer until all is used. Top with dressing.
Serves 6 to 8.
recipes.text: Seven Layer Salad. Put ingredients in 9 x 13-inch pan. Layer until all is used. Top with dressing. Serves 6 to 8.

recipes.title: Ropa Vieja
directions: Boil steak with 1 onion, 3 cloves garlic, 1 green pepper, 3 bay leaves, 1/4 cup vinegar and salt until tender.
Cool; then fry out remaining onions, peppers and garlic in olive oil.
Add meat, bay leaves, vinegar and small amount of broth.
Simmer until liquid is absorbed.
Stir in tomatoes and paste.
Heat.
Serve with black beans over white rice.
recipes.text: Ropa Vieja. Boil steak with 1 onion, 3 cloves garlic, 1 green pepper, 3 bay leaves, 1/4 cup vinegar and salt until tender. Cool; then fry out remaining onions, peppers and garlic in olive oil. Add meat, bay leaves, vinegar and small amount of broth. Simmer until liquid is absorbed. Stir in tomatoes and paste. Heat. Serve with black beans over white rice.

recipes.title: Pineapple Casserole
directions: Drain pineapple.
Reserve 6 tablespoons of juice. Pour pineapple in a casserole dish.
Mix flour, sugar and 6 tablespoons of juice in a bowl until smooth.
Pour mixture over pineapple. Add cheese. Sprinkle crackers on top.
Melt margarine and pour over the top of crackers.
Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.
recipes.text: Pineapple Casserole. Drain pineapple. Reserve 6 tablespoons of juice. Pour pineapple in a casserole dish. Mix flour, sugar and 6 tablespoons of juice in a bowl until smooth. Pour mixture over pineapple. Add cheese. Sprinkle crackers on top. Melt margarine and pour over the top of crackers. Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Potato Casserole
ingredients: 1 can cream of potato and celery soup
directions: Combine all ingredients together except cheese.
Spray a 9 x 13-inch glass dish with Pam and bake for 1 hour at 350°.
Top with grated cheese and bake 30 minutes.
ner: cream of potato and celery soup
recipes.text: Potato Casserole. Combine all ingredients together except cheese. Spray a 9 x 13-inch glass dish with Pam and bake for 1 hour at 350°. Top with grated cheese and bake 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Pretzel Jello Salad
directions: Bake at 400° for 7 minutes.
Cool.
recipes.text: Pretzel Jello Salad. Bake at 400° for 7 minutes. Cool.

recipes.title: Speedy Tartar Sauce
directions: Just mix in blender or shaker and serve over your favorite fish.
Makes 4 to 6 servings.
recipes.text: Speedy Tartar Sauce. Just mix in blender or shaker and serve over your favorite fish. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

recipes.title: Green Bean Casserole
directions: Mix all ingredients, except 1/2 of fried onions. Put in 1 1/2-quart casserole. Bake 30 minutes at 350°. Put on remaining onions and bake for 5 minutes more or until brown.
recipes.text: Green Bean Casserole. Mix all ingredients, except 1/2 of fried onions. Put in 1 1/2-quart casserole. Bake 30 minutes at 350°. Put on remaining onions and bake for 5 minutes more or until brown.

recipes.title: Tangy Vegetable Salad
ingredients: 16 oz. can whole kernel corn or frozen
16 oz. can green peas or frozen
8 green onions or 1 medium onion, cut up
directions: If using frozen vegetables, cook until barely tender; drain and cool.
If using canned vegetables, drain well.
Combine the cold salad ingredients in large bowl.
Pour cold dressing over all and stir gently until vegetables are well-coated.
Cover and refrigerate overnight.
recipes.text: Tangy Vegetable Salad. If using frozen vegetables, cook until barely tender; drain and cool. If using canned vegetables, drain well. Combine the cold salad ingredients in large bowl. Pour cold dressing over all and stir gently until vegetables are well-coated. Cover and refrigerate overnight.

recipes.title: Marbled Andes Brownies
ingredients: 2 pkgs. (4.67 oz. each) Andes Creme De Menthe Thins or Andes Mint Parfait Thins
directions: Preheat oven as indicated on brownie mix.
recipes.text: Marbled Andes Brownies. Preheat oven as indicated on brownie mix.

recipes.title: Jumbles
directions: Cream the butter; gradually add the sugar, beating until light and fluffy, then add flavoring and eggs, beating all together until light.
Stir in the flour and mix to a stiff dough.
The dough can be chilled at this point for easier handling.
recipes.text: Jumbles. Cream the butter; gradually add the sugar, beating until light and fluffy, then add flavoring and eggs, beating all together until light. Stir in the flour and mix to a stiff dough. The dough can be chilled at this point for easier handling.

recipes.title: Mahi Mahi On The Grill
directions: Start a charcoal fire on the outdoor grill.
Let it burn down until all charcoal is fully involved. Mix mayonnaise and peppers (poblanos can be substituted but only use about half).
When the peppers have been thoroughly blended into the mayonnaise, use a pastry brush and apply the mixture thinly but thoroughly to the skin side of the Mahi Mahi.
recipes.text: Mahi Mahi On The Grill. Start a charcoal fire on the outdoor grill. Let it burn down until all charcoal is fully involved. Mix mayonnaise and peppers (poblanos can be substituted but only use about half). When the peppers have been thoroughly blended into the mayonnaise, use a pastry brush and apply the mixture thinly but thoroughly to the skin side of the Mahi Mahi.

recipes.title: Beef Stroganoff
directions: Brown steak and dry ingredients together.
After browning, add soup; simmer 20 minutes.
Add sour cream; simmer 10 minutes.
recipes.text: Beef Stroganoff. Brown steak and dry ingredients together. After browning, add soup; simmer 20 minutes. Add sour cream; simmer 10 minutes.

recipes.title: French Onion Soup
directions: You will need cup/bowl.
recipes.text: French Onion Soup. You will need cup/bowl.

recipes.title: Baked Beans
directions: Saute bacon.
Add hamburger and onion; drain fat.
Add rest of ingredients.
Bake until it bubbles (approximately 1 hour) at 350°.
Freezes well before baking for later use.
recipes.text: Baked Beans. Saute bacon. Add hamburger and onion; drain fat. Add rest of ingredients. Bake until it bubbles (approximately 1 hour) at 350°. Freezes well before baking for later use.

recipes.title: Pot Of Gold Salad
directions: Chop lettuce and mix with celery and shallots.
Add orange slices and almonds.
Mix remaining ingredients to make dressing. Toss dressing with salad.
recipes.text: Pot Of Gold Salad. Chop lettuce and mix with celery and shallots. Add orange slices and almonds. Mix remaining ingredients to make dressing. Toss dressing with salad.

recipes.title: Liver Pate
directions: Mix together and boil 10 minutes.
Put in pint or 1/2 pint jars.
If mixture is hot, jars will seal.
If you get a lot of juice, strain and put in separate jar.
Makes good Bloody Mary mix.
Makes 5 quarts.
recipes.text: Liver Pate. Mix together and boil 10 minutes. Put in pint or 1/2 pint jars. If mixture is hot, jars will seal. If you get a lot of juice, strain and put in separate jar. Makes good Bloody Mary mix. Makes 5 quarts.

recipes.title: Three Soup Chicken
directions: Mix rice and soups together.
Melt oleo in pan and pour soup mixture into pan.
Place chicken parts of large fryer, skin side up, on the mixture.
Bake at 350° for 1 1/2 to 2 hours.
recipes.text: Three Soup Chicken. Mix rice and soups together. Melt oleo in pan and pour soup mixture into pan. Place chicken parts of large fryer, skin side up, on the mixture. Bake at 350° for 1 1/2 to 2 hours.

recipes.title: Pie Crust
directions: Mix one cup flour and one heaping tablespoonful Crisco. Cut shortening	into
flour
until
you have a coarse mixture. Add just enough ice water to moisten.
Knead well.
Roll thin.
recipes.text: Pie Crust. Mix one cup flour and one heaping tablespoonful Crisco. Cut shortening	into flour until you have a coarse mixture. Add just enough ice water to moisten. Knead well. Roll thin.

recipes.title: Copper Penny Salad
ingredients: 2 lb. carrots, pared and sliced (about 5 c.)
directions: Bring the carrots, with
water	to cover, to a boil and boil 5 minutes.
Drain
and
cool.
In
medium-sized bowl, mix the salt, pepper and mustard.
Beat
in a little of the oil to blend with the mustard.
Add
remaining oil and sugar, vinegar and soup and beat again	to
blend
well.
Stir	in the cooled carrots, onion and
green	pepper.
Cover	tightly
and
chill overnight.	Makes 12 to 16 servings.
recipes.text: Copper Penny Salad. Bring the carrots, with water	to cover, to a boil and boil 5 minutes. Drain and cool. In medium-sized bowl, mix the salt, pepper and mustard. Beat in a little of the oil to blend with the mustard. Add remaining oil and sugar, vinegar and soup and beat again	to blend well. Stir	in the cooled carrots, onion and green	pepper. Cover	tightly and chill overnight.	Makes 12 to 16 servings.

recipes.title: Baked Caramel Corn
directions: In a 1 1/2-quart saucepan melt margarine.
Stir in brown sugar, corn syrup and salt.
Bring mixture to boiling, stirring constantly.
Boil over medium heat without stirring for 5 minutes. Remove from heat.
Stir in baking soda and vanilla.
In a large bowl gradually pour hot syrup over popped corn, mixing well.
recipes.text: Baked Caramel Corn. In a 1 1/2-quart saucepan melt margarine. Stir in brown sugar, corn syrup and salt. Bring mixture to boiling, stirring constantly. Boil over medium heat without stirring for 5 minutes. Remove from heat. Stir in baking soda and vanilla. In a large bowl gradually pour hot syrup over popped corn, mixing well.

recipes.title: Poke Cake
ingredients: 1 pkg. white cake mix (2 layer size)
1 pkg. vanilla instant pudding (4 serving size)
directions: Combine cake mix, pudding, eggs, water and the oil in a large mixing bowl; blend well.
Then beat at medium speed for 4 minutes. Pour into a greased and floured 13 x 9-inch pan.
Bake at 350° for 45 to 50 minutes, or until tests done.
Cool in pan about 15 minutes.
recipes.text: Poke Cake. Combine cake mix, pudding, eggs, water and the oil in a large mixing bowl; blend well. Then beat at medium speed for 4 minutes. Pour into a greased and floured 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake at 350° for 45 to 50 minutes, or until tests done. Cool in pan about 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Vegetable Dip
directions: Stir together sour cream and mayonnaise until blended. Stir in seasonings. Refrigerate. Serve with raw veggies or with chips.
recipes.text: Vegetable Dip. Stir together sour cream and mayonnaise until blended. Stir in seasonings. Refrigerate. Serve with raw veggies or with chips.

recipes.title: Homemade Soup
directions: Cook meat well.
Remove bones.
Chop up.
Add stew beef.
Set aside.
Cook potatoes, onion and sweet potatoes until tender.
Add rest of ingredients except hot pepper.
Add salt, sugar and pepper to taste.
Boil for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Homemade Soup. Cook meat well. Remove bones. Chop up. Add stew beef. Set aside. Cook potatoes, onion and sweet potatoes until tender. Add rest of ingredients except hot pepper. Add salt, sugar and pepper to taste. Boil for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Sausage Stars
ingredients: 1 pkg. fresh or frozen won ton wrappers or egg roll wrappers cut in fourths
directions: Preheat oven to 350°.
Blot sausage dry with paper towels and combine with cheeses, dressing, olives and pepper.
Lightly grease a muffin tin and press 1 wrapper in each cup.
Brush with oil. Bake 5 minutes until golden.
Remove from tins, placing on baking sheet.
Fill with sausage mixture.
Bake 5 minutes until bubbly. Makes 4 to 5 dozen.
recipes.text: Sausage Stars. Preheat oven to 350°. Blot sausage dry with paper towels and combine with cheeses, dressing, olives and pepper. Lightly grease a muffin tin and press 1 wrapper in each cup. Brush with oil. Bake 5 minutes until golden. Remove from tins, placing on baking sheet. Fill with sausage mixture. Bake 5 minutes until bubbly. Makes 4 to 5 dozen.

recipes.title: Sloppy Joes
directions: Brown meat; remove fat.
Add onion and cook until onion is transparent.
Add remaining ingredients.
Simmer, uncovered, for 45 minutes or until thick, stirring occasionally.
Serve on hamburger buns with a slice of American cheese and a slice of sweet onion.
recipes.text: Sloppy Joes. Brown meat; remove fat. Add onion and cook until onion is transparent. Add remaining ingredients. Simmer, uncovered, for 45 minutes or until thick, stirring occasionally. Serve on hamburger buns with a slice of American cheese and a slice of sweet onion.

recipes.title: Chocolate Mousse Pie
ingredients: 1 (8 or 9-inch) graham cracker crust or chocolate crumb crust
directions: Melt candy bar, marshmallows and milk over a low heat, stirring until smooth. Cool, then fold in whipped cream; pour into crust. Refrigerate for at least 3 hours.
recipes.text: Chocolate Mousse Pie. Melt candy bar, marshmallows and milk over a low heat, stirring until smooth. Cool, then fold in whipped cream; pour into crust. Refrigerate for at least 3 hours.

recipes.title: Drop Cookies
directions: Grease pans.
Sift flour before measuring.
Mix together dry ingredients.
Mix together liquid ingredients.
Add dry to liquid and mix thoroughly.
Drop by teaspoonful on greased pan 2 inches apart.
Bake in a hot oven (350°) for 10 to 15 minutes.
Nuts, raisins or sprinkles can be added on top of cookie before baking.
recipes.text: Drop Cookies. Grease pans. Sift flour before measuring. Mix together dry ingredients. Mix together liquid ingredients. Add dry to liquid and mix thoroughly. Drop by teaspoonful on greased pan 2 inches apart. Bake in a hot oven (350°) for 10 to 15 minutes. Nuts, raisins or sprinkles can be added on top of cookie before baking.

recipes.title: Cauliflower Broccoli Salad
ingredients: 1 head cauliflower, cut into small pieces
1 bunch broccoli, cut into small pieces
1/4 c. sugar or 2 pkg. Sweet 'N Low
directions: Just before serving, add bacon and sunflower seeds.
recipes.text: Cauliflower Broccoli Salad. Just before serving, add bacon and sunflower seeds.

recipes.title: Creamy Mints
directions: Soften and whip the cream cheese with a wooden spoon.
Blend in the peppermint extract.
Sift the powdered sugar into the cream cheese, working it until it is well blended, kneading it with your hands.
Press into small mint molds or roll into small balls and press down with a fork.
Roll lightly in granulated sugar.
recipes.text: Creamy Mints. Soften and whip the cream cheese with a wooden spoon. Blend in the peppermint extract. Sift the powdered sugar into the cream cheese, working it until it is well blended, kneading it with your hands. Press into small mint molds or roll into small balls and press down with a fork. Roll lightly in granulated sugar.

recipes.title: Marinated Sliced Tomatoes
directions: Place tomatoes in an 11 x 7 x 1 1/2 inch dish.
Combine remaining ingredients and pour over tomatoes.
Cover and chill. Serves 10 to 12.
recipes.text: Marinated Sliced Tomatoes. Place tomatoes in an 11 x 7 x 1 1/2 inch dish. Combine remaining ingredients and pour over tomatoes. Cover and chill. Serves 10 to 12.

recipes.title: Oriental Salad
ingredients: Ramen noodles (from Oriental chicken soup mix)
directions: Mix oil, sugar, flavor package and vinegar for dressing. Layer cabbage, almonds and sunflower kernels in serving bowl. Just before serving, crumble noodles on top and pour dressing over.
recipes.text: Oriental Salad. Mix oil, sugar, flavor package and vinegar for dressing. Layer cabbage, almonds and sunflower kernels in serving bowl. Just before serving, crumble noodles on top and pour dressing over.

recipes.title: Dressing
ingredients: 1 tsp. sage and poultry seasoning (season to taste)
directions: Combine crumbled corn bread, bread cubes, pepper and sage. Put just enough shortening to lightly brown celery and onion.
Add to bread mixture; add eggs and water, tossing lightly to combine (use 1/2 cup water for more moist).
Stuff lightly into neck region and body of turkey.
Roast according to turkey size.
Bake any remaining dressing in uncovered dish during last 30 minutes of roasting.
recipes.text: Dressing. Combine crumbled corn bread, bread cubes, pepper and sage. Put just enough shortening to lightly brown celery and onion. Add to bread mixture; add eggs and water, tossing lightly to combine (use 1/2 cup water for more moist). Stuff lightly into neck region and body of turkey. Roast according to turkey size. Bake any remaining dressing in uncovered dish during last 30 minutes of roasting.

recipes.title: Million Dollar Pie
directions: Drain pineapple.
Mix lemon juice and milk.
Add remaining ingredients and mix well.
Pour into pie crusts and chill.
recipes.text: Million Dollar Pie. Drain pineapple. Mix lemon juice and milk. Add remaining ingredients and mix well. Pour into pie crusts and chill.

recipes.title: Butter Crescent Rolls
directions: Dissolve yeast in water in large bowl.
Add milk, sugar, salt and egg, stirring until well blended.
Add 1 cup flour and beat until smooth.
(Don't worry if it doesn't dissolve all together, it will be fine.)
Add melted margarine; blend and set aside. Take another bowl and add the 1 cup cold margarine and remaining 4 cups of flour.
Cut the margarine and flour with a pastry blender or table knife until in fine particles like pie crust.
Pour the yeast batter into the flour mixture; carefully mix and blend well. Cover with clear plastic wrap and refrigerate for 4 hours or 4 days.
Remove the dough to floured board and knead several times to release any air bubbles, then divide the dough into 4 equal parts.
Shape the portion to be used into a ball and refrigerate the rest.
Roll out into a circle about 17-inches.
Using a table knife, cut into 8 equal parts and roll up into a croissant shape. Place on ungreased cookie sheet; cover with dish towels and keep out of drafts.
They will rise in 4 to 5 hours.
In warmer weather, they will rise faster.
Rolls may be lightly brushed with the egg wash as they begin to rise.
Bake at 325° for 30 to 35 minutes.
The complete recipe makes about 32 rolls.
recipes.text: Butter Crescent Rolls. Dissolve yeast in water in large bowl. Add milk, sugar, salt and egg, stirring until well blended. Add 1 cup flour and beat until smooth. (Don't worry if it doesn't dissolve all together, it will be fine.) Add melted margarine; blend and set aside. Take another bowl and add the 1 cup cold margarine and remaining 4 cups of flour. Cut the margarine and flour with a pastry blender or table knife until in fine particles like pie crust. Pour the yeast batter into the flour mixture; carefully mix and blend well. Cover with clear plastic wrap and refrigerate for 4 hours or 4 days. Remove the dough to floured board and knead several times to release any air bubbles, then divide the dough into 4 equal parts. Shape the portion to be used into a ball and refrigerate the rest. Roll out into a circle about 17-inches. Using a table knife, cut into 8 equal parts and roll up into a croissant shape. Place on ungreased cookie sheet; cover with dish towels and keep out of drafts. They will rise in 4 to 5 hours. In warmer weather, they will rise faster. Rolls may be lightly brushed with the egg wash as they begin to rise. Bake at 325° for 30 to 35 minutes. The complete recipe makes about 32 rolls.

recipes.title: Angel Biscuits
directions: Sift
dry
ingredients
together.
Add
shortening. Dissolve yeast
in	warm
water and add with buttermilk to dry ingredients; mix
well.
Turn
out on floured board;
add more flour if
necessary and roll 1/4-inch thick.
Cut; then dip in melted butter and fold to make pocketbook rolls.
Bake at 400° for 15 minutes.
recipes.text: Angel Biscuits. Sift dry ingredients together. Add shortening. Dissolve yeast in	warm water and add with buttermilk to dry ingredients; mix well. Turn out on floured board; add more flour if necessary and roll 1/4-inch thick. Cut; then dip in melted butter and fold to make pocketbook rolls. Bake at 400° for 15 minutes.

recipes.title: String Beans With A Chinese Flavor
directions: Cook first 3 ingredients until tender-crisp.
Moisten cornstarch with a little cold water.
Add ginger, garlic salt and soy sauce.
Add 1/4 cup hot chicken stock and stir.
Return to hot vegetable.
Cook until thickened.
Season to taste.
recipes.text: String Beans With A Chinese Flavor. Cook first 3 ingredients until tender-crisp. Moisten cornstarch with a little cold water. Add ginger, garlic salt and soy sauce. Add 1/4 cup hot chicken stock and stir. Return to hot vegetable. Cook until thickened. Season to taste.

recipes.title: Pecan Pie
directions: Line unbaked pie shell with pecans.
Mix all ingredients well. Pour into pie shell.
Bake at 325° about 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Pecan Pie. Line unbaked pie shell with pecans. Mix all ingredients well. Pour into pie shell. Bake at 325° about 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Cheese Ball
directions: Mix all ingredients together. Put in a jello ring or bundt pan, that is sprayed with pam. Serve with strawberry preserves and crackers.
recipes.text: Cheese Ball. Mix all ingredients together. Put in a jello ring or bundt pan, that is sprayed with pam. Serve with strawberry preserves and crackers.

recipes.title: Cheese Wafers
directions: Blend warm cheese and margarine.
Mix in flour, salt and pepper.
Last, mix in Rice Krispies.
Drop by spoonful; mark with fork.
Bake at 350° for 10 to 15 minutes.
May be stored in tin, frozen, thawed and then baked.
recipes.text: Cheese Wafers. Blend warm cheese and margarine. Mix in flour, salt and pepper. Last, mix in Rice Krispies. Drop by spoonful; mark with fork. Bake at 350° for 10 to 15 minutes. May be stored in tin, frozen, thawed and then baked.

recipes.title: Venison Stew
ingredients: 1/4 lb. salt pork, trimmed of all rind and cut into 1/4 inch dice
2 lb. boneless venison (preferably loin), trimmed of all fat and cut into 2 inch cubes
2 medium carrots, scraped and cut into 2 inch lengths
directions: In a heavy 4 to 5-quart pan, fry the salt pork over medium heat until crisp and brown and have rendered all fat.

Transfer to paper towels to drain; pour off all but about 4 tablespoons of the fat from the pan. Roll the cubes of venison in the flour to coat them evenly, then shake off excess flour. Over high heat, brown venison in the fat 4 or 5 pieces at a time. As they brown, transfer to a plate. Add onions and garlic to pan, stirring occasionally until soft and translucent, but not brown. Pour in the stock; bring to a boil. Add bay leaf, thyme, salt and pepper and return venison to pan. Reduce heat to low; cover and simmer 1 hour. Add potatoes and carrots to pan; simmer, covered, 30 minutes or until vegetables are tender. Stir in the vinegar; taste for seasoning. Sprinkle pork bits on top and serve at once.
recipes.text: Venison Stew. In a heavy 4 to 5-quart pan, fry the salt pork over medium heat until crisp and brown and have rendered all fat. Transfer to paper towels to drain; pour off all but about 4 tablespoons of the fat from the pan. Roll the cubes of venison in the flour to coat them evenly, then shake off excess flour. Over high heat, brown venison in the fat 4 or 5 pieces at a time. As they brown, transfer to a plate. Add onions and garlic to pan, stirring occasionally until soft and translucent, but not brown. Pour in the stock; bring to a boil. Add bay leaf, thyme, salt and pepper and return venison to pan. Reduce heat to low; cover and simmer 1 hour. Add potatoes and carrots to pan; simmer, covered, 30 minutes or until vegetables are tender. Stir in the vinegar; taste for seasoning. Sprinkle pork bits on top and serve at once.

recipes.title: 7-Up Cake
directions: Combine cake mix, pudding, oil and eggs.
Add 7-Up.
Bake at 350° for about 40 minutes.
Use confectioners sugar icing and sprinkle nuts on top.
recipes.text: 7-Up Cake. Combine cake mix, pudding, oil and eggs. Add 7-Up. Bake at 350° for about 40 minutes. Use confectioners sugar icing and sprinkle nuts on top.

recipes.title: Beef Dip
directions: Mix cheese, sour cream, milk and beef.
Add seasonings and mix.
Put in baking dish. Saute pecans in small amount of butter. Sprinkle on top of dip.
Bake 20 minutes at 350°.
Serve hot with crackers.
recipes.text: Beef Dip. Mix cheese, sour cream, milk and beef. Add seasonings and mix. Put in baking dish. Saute pecans in small amount of butter. Sprinkle on top of dip. Bake 20 minutes at 350°. Serve hot with crackers.

recipes.title: Crab Swiss Bites(Appetizers)
directions: Separate crescent rolls into three layers.
Place on ungreased baking sheet.
Mix crab mixture together and spoon onto layer of crescent rolls.
Bake 10 minutes in 400° oven.
Makes 36 appetizers.
recipes.text: Crab Swiss Bites(Appetizers). Separate crescent rolls into three layers. Place on ungreased baking sheet. Mix crab mixture together and spoon onto layer of crescent rolls. Bake 10 minutes in 400° oven. Makes 36 appetizers.

recipes.title: Old Fashioned Mincemeat Bars
ingredients: 2 c. mincemeat or 1 c. raisins and 1 c. water
directions: Combine raisins and water (if using in place of mincemeat) and bring to a boil.
Remove from heat.
Stir in salad oil.
Cool to lukewarm.
recipes.text: Old Fashioned Mincemeat Bars. Combine raisins and water (if using in place of mincemeat) and bring to a boil. Remove from heat. Stir in salad oil. Cool to lukewarm.

recipes.title: Chicken Dish
ingredients: 1 can cream of chicken or cream of mushroom soup
directions: In an oblong dish, grease bottom with margarine.
Add 1/2 cup uncooked rice. Shake it so it covers bottom of dish.
Cut up chicken and lay pieces in pan.
recipes.text: Chicken Dish. In an oblong dish, grease bottom with margarine. Add 1/2 cup uncooked rice. Shake it so it covers bottom of dish. Cut up chicken and lay pieces in pan.

recipes.title: Mexican Cornbread
ingredients: 1 (4 oz.) can green chili peppers, chopped
directions: Combine corn and Jiffy mix well.
Pour half of batter into 9 x 9 x 2-inch greased pan.
Sprinkle peppers and half of cheese over batter.
Pour on remaining batter and top with cheese.
Bake at 400° for 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Mexican Cornbread. Combine corn and Jiffy mix well. Pour half of batter into 9 x 9 x 2-inch greased pan. Sprinkle peppers and half of cheese over batter. Pour on remaining batter and top with cheese. Bake at 400° for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Beef Nacho Casserole
ingredients: 1 c. Birds Eye sweet corn, thawed and drained
2 c. (8 oz.) Kraft natural shredded Colby
directions: Brown meat; drain.
Stir in salsa, corn, Miracle Whip and chili powder.
In a 2-quart casserole, layer meat, half of chips and half of cheese.
Repeat layers.
Bake at 350° for 20 minutes, or until thoroughly heated.
Top with shredded lettuce and tomato.
recipes.text: Beef Nacho Casserole. Brown meat; drain. Stir in salsa, corn, Miracle Whip and chili powder. In a 2-quart casserole, layer meat, half of chips and half of cheese. Repeat layers. Bake at 350° for 20 minutes, or until thoroughly heated. Top with shredded lettuce and tomato.

recipes.title: Frozen Cherry Delight
directions: Mix together and freeze.
recipes.text: Frozen Cherry Delight. Mix together and freeze.

recipes.title: Cream Of Potato Soup
directions: Microwave potatoes.
Let cool.
Cut in half lengthwise.
Scoop out.
Melt butter in a large pot.
Add flour, stirring constantly. Gradually add milk.
Stir until thick and bubbly.
Add potatoes, salt, pepper, green onions, bacon and cheese.
Cook until heated. Stir in sour cream.
Add extra milk, if needed.
Serve with onion, bacon and cheese sprinkled on top, if desired.
recipes.text: Cream Of Potato Soup. Microwave potatoes. Let cool. Cut in half lengthwise. Scoop out. Melt butter in a large pot. Add flour, stirring constantly. Gradually add milk. Stir until thick and bubbly. Add potatoes, salt, pepper, green onions, bacon and cheese. Cook until heated. Stir in sour cream. Add extra milk, if needed. Serve with onion, bacon and cheese sprinkled on top, if desired.

recipes.title: Fido'S Feast Homemade Dog Bones
ingredients: 1 to 2 tsp. instant chicken or beef bouillon
2 to 3 c. all-purpose flour or whole wheat
directions: Heat oven to 325°.
Grease cookie sheet.
In a large bowl, combine all, except flour.
Mix well.
Add flour, one cup at a time, mixing well after each addition to form a stiff dough.
On floured surface, knead in remaining flour until dough is smooth and no longer sticky, 3 to 4 minutes.
Roll or pat to 1/2-inch thickness.
Cut in bone shapes or bite-size pieces.
Place 1-inch apart on cookie sheet.
Bake at 325° for 35 to 45 minutes until golden brown.
Store loosely covered.
recipes.text: Fido'S Feast Homemade Dog Bones. Heat oven to 325°. Grease cookie sheet. In a large bowl, combine all, except flour. Mix well. Add flour, one cup at a time, mixing well after each addition to form a stiff dough. On floured surface, knead in remaining flour until dough is smooth and no longer sticky, 3 to 4 minutes. Roll or pat to 1/2-inch thickness. Cut in bone shapes or bite-size pieces. Place 1-inch apart on cookie sheet. Bake at 325° for 35 to 45 minutes until golden brown. Store loosely covered.

recipes.title: Peach Cobbler
ingredients: 1 large can sliced peaches or 3 to 4 c. raw peaches
directions: Dissolve peach
Jell-O with 1 1/2 cups water.
Pour over peaches in
baking
dish.
Sprinkle cake mix over peaches.
Dot with butter.
Bake at 350° until brown.
recipes.text: Peach Cobbler. Dissolve peach Jell-O with 1 1/2 cups water. Pour over peaches in baking dish. Sprinkle cake mix over peaches. Dot with butter. Bake at 350° until brown.

recipes.title: Brownie Pie
directions: Mix and bake in same 8 x 8-inch pan.
Melt butter and chocolate in pan.
Add sugar and mix.
Add 2 eggs and mix.
Add 3/4 cup flour, vanilla and nuts.
Bake 20 to 25 minutes at 350°. Serve with ice cream or whipped cream.
recipes.text: Brownie Pie. Mix and bake in same 8 x 8-inch pan. Melt butter and chocolate in pan. Add sugar and mix. Add 2 eggs and mix. Add 3/4 cup flour, vanilla and nuts. Bake 20 to 25 minutes at 350°. Serve with ice cream or whipped cream.

recipes.title: Blueberry Delight
directions: Mix and pat into a 13 x 9-inch pan.
recipes.text: Blueberry Delight. Mix and pat into a 13 x 9-inch pan.

recipes.title: Chicken Broccoli Rice Casserole
ingredients: 2 (10 oz.) pkg. frozen chopped broccoli, cooked and drained
1 (10 3/4 oz.) can cream of chicken soup
directions: Saute onions and pepper in margarine.
Combine remaining ingredients, except crackers, 4 tablespoons margarine and grated cheese.
Place in a 9 x 11-inch casserole dish.
Top with grated cheese and crackers mixed with melted margarine.
Bake at 350° until bubbly.
recipes.text: Chicken Broccoli Rice Casserole. Saute onions and pepper in margarine. Combine remaining ingredients, except crackers, 4 tablespoons margarine and grated cheese. Place in a 9 x 11-inch casserole dish. Top with grated cheese and crackers mixed with melted margarine. Bake at 350° until bubbly.

recipes.title: Amish Fruit Salad
directions: Drain fruit cocktail and pineapple.
Place everything in bowl then add sour cream.
Mix and let set in the refrigerator about 2 hours.
recipes.text: Amish Fruit Salad. Drain fruit cocktail and pineapple. Place everything in bowl then add sour cream. Mix and let set in the refrigerator about 2 hours.

recipes.title: Pecan Buttermilk Pralines
directions: Mix sugar, soda and milk in heavy saucepan and cook over medium heat
to
soft
ball stage (234°).
Remove from heat and add vanilla and pecans.
Begin beating immediately.
Beat until candy begins
to
thicken.
Drop
by teaspoon on waxed paper or greased baking sheet.
Cool.
Yields 30 small patties.
recipes.text: Pecan Buttermilk Pralines. Mix sugar, soda and milk in heavy saucepan and cook over medium heat to soft ball stage (234°). Remove from heat and add vanilla and pecans. Begin beating immediately. Beat until candy begins to thicken. Drop by teaspoon on waxed paper or greased baking sheet. Cool. Yields 30 small patties.

recipes.title: Hot Dog Sauce
directions: Chop onions and cook in fat.
Chop hamburg and add to onions and brown.
Add tomatoes and seasonings.
Boil until water from tomatoes evaporates, then add enough water to make soupy.
Cook until thickened over low heat.
Takes about 2 hours.
recipes.text: Hot Dog Sauce. Chop onions and cook in fat. Chop hamburg and add to onions and brown. Add tomatoes and seasonings. Boil until water from tomatoes evaporates, then add enough water to make soupy. Cook until thickened over low heat. Takes about 2 hours.

recipes.title: Icebox Cookies
directions: Roll out and put on wax paper and freeze.
Take out when you get ready for some cookies.
Take a knife and cut in 1-inch pieces and put on cookie sheet.
Put in preheated oven at 350° until almost brown. Don't cook too long!
recipes.text: Icebox Cookies. Roll out and put on wax paper and freeze. Take out when you get ready for some cookies. Take a knife and cut in 1-inch pieces and put on cookie sheet. Put in preheated oven at 350° until almost brown. Don't cook too long!

recipes.title: Mandarin Cream Cake
ingredients: 1 box Duncan Hines yellow cake mix
1 large can crushed pineapple (do not drain)
directions: Combine cake mix, eggs, oil and oranges with electric mixer until well blended.
Bake in two 9-inch round cake pans (greased) for 30 to 35 minutes at 325°.
Cool on wire racks.
recipes.text: Mandarin Cream Cake. Combine cake mix, eggs, oil and oranges with electric mixer until well blended. Bake in two 9-inch round cake pans (greased) for 30 to 35 minutes at 325°. Cool on wire racks.

recipes.title: Baked Fish
ingredients: bread crumbs with butter and pepper
directions: Clean and dry fish, cut in pieces.
Dip in milk after adding salt, then bread crumbs.
Place in baking dish adding a little olive oil.
Add little butter to fish.
Brown quickly in very hot oven with no water in pan.
recipes.text: Baked Fish. Clean and dry fish, cut in pieces. Dip in milk after adding salt, then bread crumbs. Place in baking dish adding a little olive oil. Add little butter to fish. Brown quickly in very hot oven with no water in pan.

recipes.title: Crock-Pot Macaroni And Cheese
ingredients: 1- 8 oz. pkg. macaroni, cooked and drained
directions: In crock pot, mix butter, eggs, and milk with 2 cups grated cheese, salt and pepper.
Add macaroni, stir well.
Add last cup of cheese on top.
Do not stir.
Place lid on crock pot.
Cook on high for 3 hours.
Do not stir or open lid while cooking.
Serves eight.
recipes.text: Crock-Pot Macaroni And Cheese. In crock pot, mix butter, eggs, and milk with 2 cups grated cheese, salt and pepper. Add macaroni, stir well. Add last cup of cheese on top. Do not stir. Place lid on crock pot. Cook on high for 3 hours. Do not stir or open lid while cooking. Serves eight.

recipes.title: Layer Salad
directions: Tear lettuce into pieces.
Layer in order as recipe lists; mix mayonnaise with sugar and spread on top.
Top with grated Cheddar cheese.
recipes.text: Layer Salad. Tear lettuce into pieces. Layer in order as recipe lists; mix mayonnaise with sugar and spread on top. Top with grated Cheddar cheese.

recipes.title: Creole Cake
directions: Mix sugar, oil and eggs in separate bowl.
In different bowl, mix flour, salt and cocoa.
Mix buttermilk and vanilla together. Combine all together, then add soda to boiling water and pour into other ingredients (grease pan).
Cook 30 minutes at 350°.
(Use buttermilk icing.)
recipes.text: Creole Cake. Mix sugar, oil and eggs in separate bowl. In different bowl, mix flour, salt and cocoa. Mix buttermilk and vanilla together. Combine all together, then add soda to boiling water and pour into other ingredients (grease pan). Cook 30 minutes at 350°. (Use buttermilk icing.)

recipes.title: 15-Minute Super Sundae Pie
directions: Melt buttah ... add chips ... heat, till chips are melted ... add remainin' ingredients ... mix 'n pour in an unbaked pie shell ... bake at 350° fur 45 minutes.
recipes.text: 15-Minute Super Sundae Pie. Melt buttah ... add chips ... heat, till chips are melted ... add remainin' ingredients ... mix 'n pour in an unbaked pie shell ... bake at 350° fur 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Nordstrom'S Nordy Bars
directions: In medium saucepan, melt butter over medium heat. Add butterscotch chips and brown sugar, stirring until melted.
Remove pan.
Add eggs, flour, baking powder and salt.
Mix thoroughly. Stir in vanilla. Cool. When cool, stir in chocolate chips, marshmallows and pecans.
Spread in a greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.
Remove and cool thoroughly.
Cut into squares.
recipes.text: Nordstrom'S Nordy Bars. In medium saucepan, melt butter over medium heat. Add butterscotch chips and brown sugar, stirring until melted. Remove pan. Add eggs, flour, baking powder and salt. Mix thoroughly. Stir in vanilla. Cool. When cool, stir in chocolate chips, marshmallows and pecans. Spread in a greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350° for 25 minutes. Remove and cool thoroughly. Cut into squares.

recipes.title: Key Lime Pie
directions: Stir 3/4 Cool Whip into a bowl.
Add condensed milk, lime juice and food coloring.
Place in pie crust.
Chill in refrigerator.
Serve with remaining Cool Whip.
recipes.text: Key Lime Pie. Stir 3/4 Cool Whip into a bowl. Add condensed milk, lime juice and food coloring. Place in pie crust. Chill in refrigerator. Serve with remaining Cool Whip.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Bars
directions: Mix together and roll into balls.
Melt a block of semi-sweet chocolate and paraffin and dip each ball of candy.
Place on wax paper to dry.
recipes.text: Peanut Butter Bars. Mix together and roll into balls. Melt a block of semi-sweet chocolate and paraffin and dip each ball of candy. Place on wax paper to dry.

recipes.title: Sloppy Joe Shepherd'S Pie
ingredients: 1 (15.5 oz.) can Sloppy Joe Sandwich Sauce
directions: Heat oven to 350.
In large skillet, cook ground beef and onion until beef is thoroughly cooked, stirring frequently. Drain.
Add mixed vegetables and sandwich sauce.
Mix well.
Bring to a boil.
Reduce heat and simmer for 5 minutes or until the vegetables are tender.
Spoon into an ungreased 8-inch square glass baking dish.
Cook mashed potatoes as directed on the package using hot water, milk, and margarine.
Let stand for 5 minutes. Spoon potatoes around the edges of the hot beef mixture. Sprinkle paprika over the potatoes.
Bake at 350 for 25 to 30 minutes or until bubbly and thoroughly heated.
recipes.text: Sloppy Joe Shepherd'S Pie. Heat oven to 350. In large skillet, cook ground beef and onion until beef is thoroughly cooked, stirring frequently. Drain. Add mixed vegetables and sandwich sauce. Mix well. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer for 5 minutes or until the vegetables are tender. Spoon into an ungreased 8-inch square glass baking dish. Cook mashed potatoes as directed on the package using hot water, milk, and margarine. Let stand for 5 minutes. Spoon potatoes around the edges of the hot beef mixture. Sprinkle paprika over the potatoes. Bake at 350 for 25 to 30 minutes or until bubbly and thoroughly heated.

recipes.title: Yummy Bars
ingredients: 1 (18 oz.) chocolate cake mix (no devil's food, milk chocolate or German)
1/3 c. evaporated milk (to go with caramels)
1/3 c. evaporated milk (to go with cake mix)
directions: Mix cake mix with margarine and 1/3 cup evaporated milk. Spread 1/2 in pan and bake at 350° for 6 minutes.
Melt caramels with 1/3 cup evaporated milk.
Sprinkle chocolate chips and nuts over cake.
Drizzle caramel mixture over cake.
Crumble rest of cake mix over top.
Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.
Enjoy!
recipes.text: Yummy Bars. Mix cake mix with margarine and 1/3 cup evaporated milk. Spread 1/2 in pan and bake at 350° for 6 minutes. Melt caramels with 1/3 cup evaporated milk. Sprinkle chocolate chips and nuts over cake. Drizzle caramel mixture over cake. Crumble rest of cake mix over top. Bake at 350° for 20 minutes. Enjoy!

recipes.title: B. G.'S Sausage And Wild Rice Casserole
directions: Cook sausage.
Drain, then crumble.
Mix all ingredients together.
Bake for 2 hours at 325°.
recipes.text: B. G.'S Sausage And Wild Rice Casserole. Cook sausage. Drain, then crumble. Mix all ingredients together. Bake for 2 hours at 325°.

recipes.title: Special K Bars
directions: Heat sugar and syrup until they boil.
Remove from heat and stir in peanut butter and vanilla; mix well.
Pour in cereal and stir.
Press into 9 x 12-inch pan.
Melt chocolate and butterscotch chips.
Spread on top.
recipes.text: Special K Bars. Heat sugar and syrup until they boil. Remove from heat and stir in peanut butter and vanilla; mix well. Pour in cereal and stir. Press into 9 x 12-inch pan. Melt chocolate and butterscotch chips. Spread on top.

recipes.title: Butternut Squash Casserole
directions: Bake squash until done, then remove seeds and scrape out pulp. Put in blender with other ingredients until all is mixed well. Pour into greased 4 1/2 x 8 1/2-inch casserole dish (loaf pan). Bake at 350° for about 45 minutes or until casserole is set.
recipes.text: Butternut Squash Casserole. Bake squash until done, then remove seeds and scrape out pulp. Put in blender with other ingredients until all is mixed well. Pour into greased 4 1/2 x 8 1/2-inch casserole dish (loaf pan). Bake at 350° for about 45 minutes or until casserole is set.

recipes.title: White Cucumber Salad
ingredients: 1 Tbsp. grated onion for each cucumber
directions: Slice peeled cucumbers very thin.
For each large cuke, add a tablespoon of grated onion to 1/2 cup of mayonnaise mixture. Arrange a layer of cukes in a shallow bowl.
Sprinkle with salt and spread with mayonnaise mixture.
Continue until all is used, ending with mayo on top.
Cover and place in refrigerator 12 to 14 hours before serving.
recipes.text: White Cucumber Salad. Slice peeled cucumbers very thin. For each large cuke, add a tablespoon of grated onion to 1/2 cup of mayonnaise mixture. Arrange a layer of cukes in a shallow bowl. Sprinkle with salt and spread with mayonnaise mixture. Continue until all is used, ending with mayo on top. Cover and place in refrigerator 12 to 14 hours before serving.

recipes.title: Pecan Squares
directions: Preheat oven to 350°.
Grease a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Mix ingredients and bake for 20 to 25 minutes.
Sprinkle with powdered sugar and cool.
Cut into squares.
Yields 24 (2-inch) squares.
recipes.text: Pecan Squares. Preheat oven to 350°. Grease a 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix ingredients and bake for 20 to 25 minutes. Sprinkle with powdered sugar and cool. Cut into squares. Yields 24 (2-inch) squares.

recipes.title: Pineapple Casserole
directions: Put bread crumbs in long cake pan and pour pineapple over it. Combine the eggs, sugar and melted butter or oleo and pour over mixture in pan.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Pineapple Casserole. Put bread crumbs in long cake pan and pour pineapple over it. Combine the eggs, sugar and melted butter or oleo and pour over mixture in pan. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Double Apple Cake
directions: Cream butter with sugar.
Beat in 2 eggs.
Add apples and vanilla.
In a large bowl mix flour with cinnamon and baking soda. Mix the 2 mixtures.
Core 2 to 3 apples; cut into thin wedges. Arrange some wedges on sides of well-greased 9-inch round, 1 1/2-inch deep cake pan.
Spoon in batter, level.
Arrange remaining wedges on top.
Drizzle 2 tablespoons butter over top.
Bake at 350° for 55 minutes.
Glaze apple topping with 1/4 cup melted currant jelly.
recipes.text: Double Apple Cake. Cream butter with sugar. Beat in 2 eggs. Add apples and vanilla. In a large bowl mix flour with cinnamon and baking soda. Mix the 2 mixtures. Core 2 to 3 apples; cut into thin wedges. Arrange some wedges on sides of well-greased 9-inch round, 1 1/2-inch deep cake pan. Spoon in batter, level. Arrange remaining wedges on top. Drizzle 2 tablespoons butter over top. Bake at 350° for 55 minutes. Glaze apple topping with 1/4 cup melted currant jelly.

recipes.title: Onion Bread
directions: Preheat oven to 400°. Soak instant onions in water 5 minutes. Combine biscuit mix, egg, milk and Tabasco sauce in large bowl; stir until blended. Stir in onion. Turn into greased 8-inch pie plate. Brush with melted butter.
Sprinkle with seed. Bake 20 to 25 minutes until golden brown.
recipes.text: Onion Bread. Preheat oven to 400°. Soak instant onions in water 5 minutes. Combine biscuit mix, egg, milk and Tabasco sauce in large bowl; stir until blended. Stir in onion. Turn into greased 8-inch pie plate. Brush with melted butter. Sprinkle with seed. Bake 20 to 25 minutes until golden brown.

recipes.title: Strawberry Pie
directions: Heat and boil until thick and drops like jelly.
Bake crust. Pile strawberries in crust.
Pour cold sauce over.
Serve with whipped cream.
recipes.text: Strawberry Pie. Heat and boil until thick and drops like jelly. Bake crust. Pile strawberries in crust. Pour cold sauce over. Serve with whipped cream.

recipes.title: Shrimp Dip(For Vegies Or Crackers)
directions: Mix well with electric beater.
Chill. Serve as spread or dip for raw vegetables or crackers.
recipes.text: Shrimp Dip(For Vegies Or Crackers). Mix well with electric beater. Chill. Serve as spread or dip for raw vegetables or crackers.

recipes.title: Aunt Dorothy'S Banana Bread
directions: Put batter in greased loaf pan.
Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.
recipes.text: Aunt Dorothy'S Banana Bread. Put batter in greased loaf pan. Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.

recipes.title: Vegie Wedgies
ingredients: 1 envelope dry Hidden Valley Ranch dressing
3/4 c. each of variety of chopped vegetables: green peppers, onions, tomatoes, carrots, broccoli, cauliflower
directions: Cover the bottom of jelly roll pan with crescent rolls, spreading over entire bottom.
Bake at 350° for 8 to 9 minutes. Cool.
Mix cream cheese, Miracle Whip and dry dressing together; spread over rolls.
Sprinkle vegetables over top.
Press down. Chill 1 to 2 hours.
Sprinkle shredded Cheddar cheese on top before cutting into squares.
recipes.text: Vegie Wedgies. Cover the bottom of jelly roll pan with crescent rolls, spreading over entire bottom. Bake at 350° for 8 to 9 minutes. Cool. Mix cream cheese, Miracle Whip and dry dressing together; spread over rolls. Sprinkle vegetables over top. Press down. Chill 1 to 2 hours. Sprinkle shredded Cheddar cheese on top before cutting into squares.

recipes.title: Snowball Snacks
directions: Preheat oven to 350°. Stir butter, sugar, nuts, flour and vanilla together. Mix well. Roll batter into 1-inch balls with your hands. Place balls on the cookie sheet and bake for 10 minutes. After the cookies cool, roll them in additional confectioners sugar to make the snowballs.
recipes.text: Snowball Snacks. Preheat oven to 350°. Stir butter, sugar, nuts, flour and vanilla together. Mix well. Roll batter into 1-inch balls with your hands. Place balls on the cookie sheet and bake for 10 minutes. After the cookies cool, roll them in additional confectioners sugar to make the snowballs.

recipes.title: Fancy Saucy Franks
directions: In a 3-quart saucepan, cook preserves and barbecue sauce until bubbly.
Cut franks 1/4-inch thick.
Add franks to saucepan. Boil.
Simmer 20 minutes.
Mix water and cornstarch until smooth. Add to hot mixture.
Cook until thick.
Serves 25.
recipes.text: Fancy Saucy Franks. In a 3-quart saucepan, cook preserves and barbecue sauce until bubbly. Cut franks 1/4-inch thick. Add franks to saucepan. Boil. Simmer 20 minutes. Mix water and cornstarch until smooth. Add to hot mixture. Cook until thick. Serves 25.

recipes.title: Hawaiian Pork Chops(Diabetic; Low Sugar.)
directions: In large skillet, sprayed with vegetable pan spray, cook onion and green pepper until tender. Remove from skillet. Mix flour, salt and pepper in plastic bag. Add chops one at a time; shake to coat meat. Brown chops in skillet. Place pineapple slice on top of each chop. Sprinkle with onion and green pepper. Combine vinegar, catsup and juice to make sauce. Pour over chops. Simmer 4 minutes, until chops are tender.
recipes.text: Hawaiian Pork Chops(Diabetic; Low Sugar.). In large skillet, sprayed with vegetable pan spray, cook onion and green pepper until tender. Remove from skillet. Mix flour, salt and pepper in plastic bag. Add chops one at a time; shake to coat meat. Brown chops in skillet. Place pineapple slice on top of each chop. Sprinkle with onion and green pepper. Combine vinegar, catsup and juice to make sauce. Pour over chops. Simmer 4 minutes, until chops are tender.

recipes.title: Taco Dip
ingredients: 1 pkg. hot or regular taco seasoning mix
homemade or store brand guacamole dip
directions: Spread the bean dip on a large platter.
Spread the guacamole dip over beans.
Mix the sour cream and mayonnaise.
Add the taco seasoning mix.
Spread this mixture as the next layer.
Refrigerate for a few hours and it will become firm.
Right before serving, top with a layer of chopped black olives, chopped tomatoes and cover with sharp Cheddar cheese.
Serve with Fritos and taco chips.
recipes.text: Taco Dip. Spread the bean dip on a large platter. Spread the guacamole dip over beans. Mix the sour cream and mayonnaise. Add the taco seasoning mix. Spread this mixture as the next layer. Refrigerate for a few hours and it will become firm. Right before serving, top with a layer of chopped black olives, chopped tomatoes and cover with sharp Cheddar cheese. Serve with Fritos and taco chips.

recipes.title: Orange Roughy(Or Lemon Sole)
directions: Rinse fish with cold water.
Pat dry.
Mix bread crumbs, Parmesan cheese and thyme (optional).
Spray baking pan.
Soak fish in milk for 15 to 30 minutes before baking.
Dip in crumb mixture.
Place on baking sheet.
Drizzle with melted butter or margarine.
Bake at 450° for 15 minutes.
recipes.text: Orange Roughy(Or Lemon Sole). Rinse fish with cold water. Pat dry. Mix bread crumbs, Parmesan cheese and thyme (optional). Spray baking pan. Soak fish in milk for 15 to 30 minutes before baking. Dip in crumb mixture. Place on baking sheet. Drizzle with melted butter or margarine. Bake at 450° for 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Escalloped Oysters
directions: Mix crumbs and melted butter or oleo. Cover a thin layer of crumbs with oysters. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Add some of liquid and cream. Repeat layers and top with crumbs. Bake 30 minutes at 450°. May double or triple this recipe to make a nice size casserole. This recipe will only serve about 4 people.
recipes.text: Escalloped Oysters. Mix crumbs and melted butter or oleo. Cover a thin layer of crumbs with oysters. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Add some of liquid and cream. Repeat layers and top with crumbs. Bake 30 minutes at 450°. May double or triple this recipe to make a nice size casserole. This recipe will only serve about 4 people.

recipes.title: Zesty Carrots
directions: Scrape carrots and cut thin strips julienne style.
Cook carrots in saucepan about 6 to 8 minutes or until tender.
Drain. Put carrots in baking dish.
In a bowl, combine 1/4 cup of the liquid (carrots were cooked in), onion, horseradish, mayonnaise, 1 teaspoon salt and pepper.
Pour over carrots.
Top with bread crumbs and butter. Bake 30 minutes in a 350° oven.
recipes.text: Zesty Carrots. Scrape carrots and cut thin strips julienne style. Cook carrots in saucepan about 6 to 8 minutes or until tender. Drain. Put carrots in baking dish. In a bowl, combine 1/4 cup of the liquid (carrots were cooked in), onion, horseradish, mayonnaise, 1 teaspoon salt and pepper. Pour over carrots. Top with bread crumbs and butter. Bake 30 minutes in a 350° oven.

recipes.title: Sauteed Bananas
directions: Melt the butter in a skillet.
Peel the bananas and cut them in half lengthwise.
Cook over moderate heat for 5 minutes, turning once.
Remove to a dish and spoon the butter from the pan over them.
Sift the confectioners sugar on top.
recipes.text: Sauteed Bananas. Melt the butter in a skillet. Peel the bananas and cut them in half lengthwise. Cook over moderate heat for 5 minutes, turning once. Remove to a dish and spoon the butter from the pan over them. Sift the confectioners sugar on top.

recipes.title: Cold Dill Peas
directions: Cook and drain peas thoroughly.
Mix together other ingredients very thoroughly.
Carefully combine with peas. Chill and garnish with more dill or chives.
recipes.text: Cold Dill Peas. Cook and drain peas thoroughly. Mix together other ingredients very thoroughly. Carefully combine with peas. Chill and garnish with more dill or chives.

recipes.title: Lola'S Pepper Jelly
directions: Dissolve sugar in vinegar in a saucepan.
Bring mixture to
a boil
and
add
Certo.
Let
mixture set for 10 minutes before pouring
into
jars.
You
may use your choice of food coloring for color.	Add after the Certo.
If you like it hot, add 1/4 cup red hot peppers.
recipes.text: Lola'S Pepper Jelly. Dissolve sugar in vinegar in a saucepan. Bring mixture to a boil and add Certo. Let mixture set for 10 minutes before pouring into jars. You may use your choice of food coloring for color.	Add after the Certo. If you like it hot, add 1/4 cup red hot peppers.

recipes.title: Pork Chop Casserole
directions: Brown chops in skillet; drain.
Combine next 5 ingredients in skillet.
Cook until brown.
Remove from heat; stir in soup.
Pour mixture in casserole; top with pork chops.
Cover.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Pork Chop Casserole. Brown chops in skillet; drain. Combine next 5 ingredients in skillet. Cook until brown. Remove from heat; stir in soup. Pour mixture in casserole; top with pork chops. Cover. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Alison'S Fast, Fun And Healthy Pasta Salad
ingredients: about 2 c. assorted vegetables (fresh or frozen), steamed
directions: How to make it:
Prepare the pasta according to package directions; drain and let cool for a few minutes.
Mix the pasta, vegetables and tomatoes together.
Toss the whole thing with the fat-free dressing.
(You can use as much or as little as you like, but make sure that you use at least enough to coat the pasta, or it will stick together in an ugly and congealed lump!)
recipes.text: Alison'S Fast, Fun And Healthy Pasta Salad. How to make it: Prepare the pasta according to package directions; drain and let cool for a few minutes. Mix the pasta, vegetables and tomatoes together. Toss the whole thing with the fat-free dressing. (You can use as much or as little as you like, but make sure that you use at least enough to coat the pasta, or it will stick together in an ugly and congealed lump!)

recipes.title: Tuna Noodle Casserole
directions: In casserole dish, combine noodles, tuna, cream of mushroom soup and milk.
Top with Stove Top stuffing (dry) and Parmesan cheese.
Pour melted butter over top.
