Bake at 350° for 1/2 to 3/4 hour.
recipes.text: Tuna Noodle Casserole. In casserole dish, combine noodles, tuna, cream of mushroom soup and milk. Top with Stove Top stuffing (dry) and Parmesan cheese. Pour melted butter over top. Bake at 350° for 1/2 to 3/4 hour.

recipes.title: Chicken And Rice Casserole
directions: Melt 1 tablespoon butter in a 9 x 13-inch Pyrex pan.
Add cream of mushroom soup, cream of chicken soup, 2 soup cans of water and chopped green olives.
Mix; stir in raw rice.
Salt and pepper fryer.
Place in pan; cover with foil and bake about 1 hour at 350°.
Uncover and bake about 10 minutes to brown.
recipes.text: Chicken And Rice Casserole. Melt 1 tablespoon butter in a 9 x 13-inch Pyrex pan. Add cream of mushroom soup, cream of chicken soup, 2 soup cans of water and chopped green olives. Mix; stir in raw rice. Salt and pepper fryer. Place in pan; cover with foil and bake about 1 hour at 350°. Uncover and bake about 10 minutes to brown.

recipes.title: Rhubarb Jam
directions: Mix rhubarb, sugar and pineapple.
Let stand overnight.
Add strawberry jello.
Heat to boiling, boil 10 minutes and seal in jars.
recipes.text: Rhubarb Jam. Mix rhubarb, sugar and pineapple. Let stand overnight. Add strawberry jello. Heat to boiling, boil 10 minutes and seal in jars.

recipes.title: Orange Sangria
ingredients: 1 fifth dry red wine (use Mountain Red or Pinot Noir)
directions: Cut orange in half.
Take off a couple of slices, quarter them, and save for garnish.
With vegetable peeler, take peel off 1/2 orange; bruise the peel with sugar in bowl.
Stir in other ingredients.
Chill for 15 minutes.
Remove peel and continue to chill.
Serve in pitcher with or without ice cubes.
Garnish with quarter slices of orange.
recipes.text: Orange Sangria. Cut orange in half. Take off a couple of slices, quarter them, and save for garnish. With vegetable peeler, take peel off 1/2 orange; bruise the peel with sugar in bowl. Stir in other ingredients. Chill for 15 minutes. Remove peel and continue to chill. Serve in pitcher with or without ice cubes. Garnish with quarter slices of orange.

recipes.title: Blu' Bana Bread
ingredients: 2 c. frozen or fresh blueberries, drained
directions: Preheat oven to 325°.
Grease and flour 2 loaf pans.
Cream together butter and sugar.
Beat in eggs; add vanilla.
Fold in mashed bananas and 2 cups of the flour.
Place 2 remaining cups of flour (less 2 tablespoons) in sifter and add allspice, baking soda, baking powder and salt.
Sift and fold into mixture. Sprinkle blueberries with remaining flour.
Coat well and fold into the batter.
recipes.text: Blu' Bana Bread. Preheat oven to 325°. Grease and flour 2 loaf pans. Cream together butter and sugar. Beat in eggs; add vanilla. Fold in mashed bananas and 2 cups of the flour. Place 2 remaining cups of flour (less 2 tablespoons) in sifter and add allspice, baking soda, baking powder and salt. Sift and fold into mixture. Sprinkle blueberries with remaining flour. Coat well and fold into the batter.

recipes.title: Strawberry Jam
directions: Boil the first 2 ingredients 3 minutes.
Stir constantly.
Add 3 more cups sugar.
Boil 5 more minutes. Stir constantly.
Put in jars and let set until morning. Seal or freeze.
recipes.text: Strawberry Jam. Boil the first 2 ingredients 3 minutes. Stir constantly. Add 3 more cups sugar. Boil 5 more minutes. Stir constantly. Put in jars and let set until morning. Seal or freeze.

recipes.title: Cranberry Salad
directions: Cook the cranberries with the 1 1/2 cups water and sugar until thick.
Let cool.
Pour 2 cups boiling water over the Jell-O; let it cool.
Add drained pineapple, celery, apples and nuts to Jell-O.
Mix well.
Add the cooked cranberries.
Put into large dish and refrigerate.
This salad will keep for several days.
recipes.text: Cranberry Salad. Cook the cranberries with the 1 1/2 cups water and sugar until thick. Let cool. Pour 2 cups boiling water over the Jell-O; let it cool. Add drained pineapple, celery, apples and nuts to Jell-O. Mix well. Add the cooked cranberries. Put into large dish and refrigerate. This salad will keep for several days.

recipes.title: Calico Beans - Old Settlers Beans
ingredients: 2 Tbsp. vinegar or 1 tsp. dry mustard (I use the mustard)
directions: Drain beans.
Save bean liquid and use if necessary as beans bake.
Brown bacon, ground meat and onion; drain off any fat.
Mix together brown sugar, catsup, vinegar or dry mustard.
Combine all ingredients in 2 1/2-quart casserole dish and bake 45 minutes at 350° or 1 1/2 hours at 325°.
recipes.text: Calico Beans - Old Settlers Beans. Drain beans. Save bean liquid and use if necessary as beans bake. Brown bacon, ground meat and onion; drain off any fat. Mix together brown sugar, catsup, vinegar or dry mustard. Combine all ingredients in 2 1/2-quart casserole dish and bake 45 minutes at 350° or 1 1/2 hours at 325°.

recipes.title: Scotch Cookies
ingredients: 1 1/2 tsp. soda dissolved in a little warm water
directions: Thoroughly combine sugar and butter.
Add molasses and eggs. Combine dry ingredients and add gradually to butter mixture.
Roll out on lightly floured board, and cut with large cookie cutter. Place on ungreased cookie sheet and brush with topping.
recipes.text: Scotch Cookies. Thoroughly combine sugar and butter. Add molasses and eggs. Combine dry ingredients and add gradually to butter mixture. Roll out on lightly floured board, and cut with large cookie cutter. Place on ungreased cookie sheet and brush with topping.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Bars
directions: Mix well and spread in cookie sheet (with sides).
Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.
Cool and frost.
recipes.text: Pumpkin Bars. Mix well and spread in cookie sheet (with sides). Bake at 350° for 25 minutes. Cool and frost.

recipes.title: Drop Fruit Cookies
ingredients: 1 c. raisins or dates or both
directions: Mix all ingredients together.
Add enough flour to make it stiff enough to drop from a spoon (3 1/2 cups or more).
Bake at 375° for 12 minutes.
recipes.text: Drop Fruit Cookies. Mix all ingredients together. Add enough flour to make it stiff enough to drop from a spoon (3 1/2 cups or more). Bake at 375° for 12 minutes.

recipes.title: Steak Marinate Sauce
directions: Mix red wine vinegar, soy sauce, oil, garlic powder, onion and brown sugar. Marinate steak 3 to 4 days in the refrigerator. Grill.
recipes.text: Steak Marinate Sauce. Mix red wine vinegar, soy sauce, oil, garlic powder, onion and brown sugar. Marinate steak 3 to 4 days in the refrigerator. Grill.

recipes.title: Fresh Fruit Cobbler
ingredients: 3 c. cut-up fruit (apples, cherries, peaches or blueberries)
directions: Preheat oven to 350°.
Arrange fruit in 9 x 9 x 1 3/4-inch pan. Sprinkle with 2/3 cup sugar and 2 tablespoons flour.
Sift remaining dry ingredients in bowl.
Add oil, milk and egg and stir with a fork until blended.
Drop batter over fruit and bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.
recipes.text: Fresh Fruit Cobbler. Preheat oven to 350°. Arrange fruit in 9 x 9 x 1 3/4-inch pan. Sprinkle with 2/3 cup sugar and 2 tablespoons flour. Sift remaining dry ingredients in bowl. Add oil, milk and egg and stir with a fork until blended. Drop batter over fruit and bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.

recipes.title: E Z Butter Cookies
directions: Mix butter until very, very soft.
Add sugar and beat until well blended.
Add flour slowly until well blended.
Press evenly onto two cookie sheets.
When still warm, cut into sticks.
You can press chopped nuts or sesame seed onto top before baking. Bake at 350° until very light brown.
Watch them as they brown very quickly.
recipes.text: E Z Butter Cookies. Mix butter until very, very soft. Add sugar and beat until well blended. Add flour slowly until well blended. Press evenly onto two cookie sheets. When still warm, cut into sticks. You can press chopped nuts or sesame seed onto top before baking. Bake at 350° until very light brown. Watch them as they brown very quickly.

recipes.title: Souperburger Sandwiches
directions: In medium skillet cook beef and onion until beef is browned, stirring to separate meat. Drain off fat. Add soup, mustard and pepper. Reduce heat to low and simmer. Divide meat mixture among buns. Serve.
recipes.text: Souperburger Sandwiches. In medium skillet cook beef and onion until beef is browned, stirring to separate meat. Drain off fat. Add soup, mustard and pepper. Reduce heat to low and simmer. Divide meat mixture among buns. Serve.

recipes.title: Zucchini Squares
ingredients: 3 c. pared and thinly sliced zucchini
directions: Heat oven to 350°.
Grease a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Mix all ingredients, except zucchini, thoroughly then fold in the zucchini.
Pour into greased pan and bake 30 minutes until brown. Cut into 2-inch squares; serve warm.
Also delicious refrigerator cold.
recipes.text: Zucchini Squares. Heat oven to 350°. Grease a 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix all ingredients, except zucchini, thoroughly then fold in the zucchini. Pour into greased pan and bake 30 minutes until brown. Cut into 2-inch squares; serve warm. Also delicious refrigerator cold.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Fudge
directions: Put peanut butter and Marshmallow Creme in bowl; set aside. Bring to boil the sugar and water.
Boil 4 1/2 minutes (time closely).
Then pour over Marshmallow Creme and peanut butter. Whip and stir until all is mixed.
Add nuts.
Pour into large buttered pan.
recipes.text: Peanut Butter Fudge. Put peanut butter and Marshmallow Creme in bowl; set aside. Bring to boil the sugar and water. Boil 4 1/2 minutes (time closely). Then pour over Marshmallow Creme and peanut butter. Whip and stir until all is mixed. Add nuts. Pour into large buttered pan.

recipes.title: Blueberry Tea Cake
directions: Preheat oven to 400°.
Grease and flour 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan.
recipes.text: Blueberry Tea Cake. Preheat oven to 400°. Grease and flour 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan.

recipes.title: Rice And Broccoli Dish
directions: Saute onion in butter. Cook and drain chopped broccoli.
Cook rice according to directions on package.
Combine all ingredients and place in greased casserole dish. Grate cheese on top and bake for 30 minutes at 350°.
recipes.text: Rice And Broccoli Dish. Saute onion in butter. Cook and drain chopped broccoli. Cook rice according to directions on package. Combine all ingredients and place in greased casserole dish. Grate cheese on top and bake for 30 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Chop Suey Hot Dish
directions: Brown meat, onion and celery.
Add Oriental vegetables, soup and chow mein noodles.
Mix well and put in casserole.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Chop Suey Hot Dish. Brown meat, onion and celery. Add Oriental vegetables, soup and chow mein noodles. Mix well and put in casserole. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Dirt Cake
directions: Stir milk into pudding mix and set aside.
Soften cream cheese (one minute in microwave) and mix with Cool Whip.
Stir into pudding mixture, it can be a little lumpy.
Alternate layers of crushed Oreos with filling in a large flowerpot, ending with Oreos on top.
Chill until ready to serve.
Insert artificial flowers in straws and poke into mixture, creating a nice looking arrangement.
recipes.text: Dirt Cake. Stir milk into pudding mix and set aside. Soften cream cheese (one minute in microwave) and mix with Cool Whip. Stir into pudding mixture, it can be a little lumpy. Alternate layers of crushed Oreos with filling in a large flowerpot, ending with Oreos on top. Chill until ready to serve. Insert artificial flowers in straws and poke into mixture, creating a nice looking arrangement.

recipes.title: Pork Scallops With Dijon Sauce
ingredients: salt and freshly ground pepper to taste
directions: Heat half the butter and half the oil in each of 2 large, heavy skillets over medium-high heat.
Add just enough scallops to each hot skillet so they do not overlap.
(If skillet is crowded, pork will steam rather than brown.) Cook about 1 minute on each side or until browned.
Transfer the cooked scallops on a platter and cover tightly to keep warm while you cook remaining scallops. Discard fat in skillets.
Add half the wine and half the broth to each skillet; cook over high heat 1 minute, scraping up bits from bottom.
Consolidate wine/broth mixture in one skillet.
Boil, uncovered, until reduced to 1/3 cup.
Add cream and boil, uncovered, until sauce is reduced to about 3/4 cup or until it lightly coats back of spoon.
Turn off heat; whisk in mustard. Add to sauce any juices that have collected from the pork.
Pour sauce over pork or serve separately.
recipes.text: Pork Scallops With Dijon Sauce. Heat half the butter and half the oil in each of 2 large, heavy skillets over medium-high heat. Add just enough scallops to each hot skillet so they do not overlap. (If skillet is crowded, pork will steam rather than brown.) Cook about 1 minute on each side or until browned. Transfer the cooked scallops on a platter and cover tightly to keep warm while you cook remaining scallops. Discard fat in skillets. Add half the wine and half the broth to each skillet; cook over high heat 1 minute, scraping up bits from bottom. Consolidate wine/broth mixture in one skillet. Boil, uncovered, until reduced to 1/3 cup. Add cream and boil, uncovered, until sauce is reduced to about 3/4 cup or until it lightly coats back of spoon. Turn off heat; whisk in mustard. Add to sauce any juices that have collected from the pork. Pour sauce over pork or serve separately.

recipes.title: Indian Chickpeas
ingredients: 2 medium tomatoes, peeled, seeded and chopped
4 small potatoes, boiled, peeled and chopped
directions: Heat oil.
Add cumin and onions.
Cook 3 minutes.
Add garlic and ginger.
Cook 5 minutes on low heat.
Add turmeric, coriander, cayenne and salt.
Stir; add chopped tomatoes and garam masala. Cook on low heat 10 minutes.
Add chickpeas and lemon juice.
Cook 5 minutes; add potatoes.
Serve over white steamed basmati rice, garnished with chopped green jalapeno peppers.
recipes.text: Indian Chickpeas. Heat oil. Add cumin and onions. Cook 3 minutes. Add garlic and ginger. Cook 5 minutes on low heat. Add turmeric, coriander, cayenne and salt. Stir; add chopped tomatoes and garam masala. Cook on low heat 10 minutes. Add chickpeas and lemon juice. Cook 5 minutes; add potatoes. Serve over white steamed basmati rice, garnished with chopped green jalapeno peppers.

recipes.title: Barbecue Tuna
directions: Cook onion, pepper and celery in water.
Mix tomato juice, sugar, vinegar sauce, mustard, salt and pepper together.
Add to pan and bring to boil.
Add flaked tuna.
Simmer for 15 minutes or until liquid is boiled away.
recipes.text: Barbecue Tuna. Cook onion, pepper and celery in water. Mix tomato juice, sugar, vinegar sauce, mustard, salt and pepper together. Add to pan and bring to boil. Add flaked tuna. Simmer for 15 minutes or until liquid is boiled away.

recipes.title: No Crust Egg Custard Pie
directions: Mix in order listed. Grease baking dish. Bake at 350° for 35 minutes.
recipes.text: No Crust Egg Custard Pie. Mix in order listed. Grease baking dish. Bake at 350° for 35 minutes.

recipes.title: Rhubarb Cake
ingredients: 1 1/2 c. raw rhubarb, cut very fine
directions: Mix all ingredients together and put in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Top with mixture of 1/4 cup sugar and 1 teaspoon cinnamon.
Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes.
recipes.text: Rhubarb Cake. Mix all ingredients together and put in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Top with mixture of 1/4 cup sugar and 1 teaspoon cinnamon. Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes.

recipes.title: June'S Blueberry Salad
ingredients: 1 (20 oz.) can crushed pineapple (in natural juice)
directions: Using a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan - Mix pie filling and pineapple, including juice, right in the pan.
recipes.text: June'S Blueberry Salad. Using a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan - Mix pie filling and pineapple, including juice, right in the pan.

recipes.title: Dry Jello Salad
ingredients: 1 can fruit (mandarin oranges or pineapple), drained
directions: Add jello to Cool Whip.
Add cheese, fruit and nuts, if desired.
Chill until ready to serve.
recipes.text: Dry Jello Salad. Add jello to Cool Whip. Add cheese, fruit and nuts, if desired. Chill until ready to serve.

recipes.title: Whole Wheat Bread
directions: Stir yeast, 1 cup water and sugar in small bowl and let stand 5 minutes.
In large bowl, put 2 cups water, honey, shortening and salt.
Stir until shortening is melted.
Beat in white flour.
Add whole wheat flour or enough to make moderately stiff dough.
Turn out on a floured surface.
Knead until smooth and elastic, about 10 minutes.
Shape into ball.
Place in greased bowl.
Turn to grease surface.
Cover and let rise in warm place until doubled in size. Punch down.
Shape into loaves.
Put in pans.
Let rise until doubled.
Bake at 375° for 45 minutes.
Cover with foil last 20 minutes if overbrowning.
Makes 2 loaves.
recipes.text: Whole Wheat Bread. Stir yeast, 1 cup water and sugar in small bowl and let stand 5 minutes. In large bowl, put 2 cups water, honey, shortening and salt. Stir until shortening is melted. Beat in white flour. Add whole wheat flour or enough to make moderately stiff dough. Turn out on a floured surface. Knead until smooth and elastic, about 10 minutes. Shape into ball. Place in greased bowl. Turn to grease surface. Cover and let rise in warm place until doubled in size. Punch down. Shape into loaves. Put in pans. Let rise until doubled. Bake at 375° for 45 minutes. Cover with foil last 20 minutes if overbrowning. Makes 2 loaves.

recipes.title: 2-Minute Fudge
directions: *If not using nuts, use a little less butter.
recipes.text: 2-Minute Fudge. *If not using nuts, use a little less butter.

recipes.title: George Washington'S Cherry Tree Cake(Make This In Honor Of His Birthday Or Someone Else'S!)
directions: Cream sugar and oil; add eggs and vanilla.
Sift flour, baking soda and cinnamon and add to first mixture.
Stir in pie filling and chocolate chips.
Pour in two greased and floured cake pans or a 13 x 9-inch pan.
Bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes.
You can frost if you like.
A rich and moist cake.
recipes.text: George Washington'S Cherry Tree Cake(Make This In Honor Of His Birthday Or Someone Else'S!). Cream sugar and oil; add eggs and vanilla. Sift flour, baking soda and cinnamon and add to first mixture. Stir in pie filling and chocolate chips. Pour in two greased and floured cake pans or a 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes. You can frost if you like. A rich and moist cake.

recipes.title: Veggie Squares
ingredients: 2 (8 oz.) pkg. Philadelphia cream cheese (room temperature)
1 pkg. Hidden Valley Ranch dressing mix
favorite vegetables, chopped (such as broccoli, cauliflower, carrots and a few onions)
directions: Place dough on jelly roll pan; press together so there are no perforations or breaks in dough.
Bake at 350° for 10 minutes. Remove from oven and cool.
recipes.text: Veggie Squares. Place dough on jelly roll pan; press together so there are no perforations or breaks in dough. Bake at 350° for 10 minutes. Remove from oven and cool.

recipes.title: Cheese Dip
directions: Combine in blender or food processor.
Serve with vegetables, crackers or hollow out a round loaf of bread and serve with bread pieces.
recipes.text: Cheese Dip. Combine in blender or food processor. Serve with vegetables, crackers or hollow out a round loaf of bread and serve with bread pieces.

recipes.title: Easy Peas And Mushrooms
directions: Cook peas according to package directions; drain well.
Cook mushrooms and onion in butter or margarine until tender.
Stir in sugar, 1/2 teaspoon salt and dash of pepper. Add cooked peas and pimento. Cover and heat through.
Serves 4.
recipes.text: Easy Peas And Mushrooms. Cook peas according to package directions; drain well. Cook mushrooms and onion in butter or margarine until tender. Stir in sugar, 1/2 teaspoon salt and dash of pepper. Add cooked peas and pimento. Cover and heat through. Serves 4.

recipes.title: Death By Chocolate
directions: Cook cake mix as directed.
Puncture with fork and pour 1 cup Hershey's syrup over cake.
Let stand 3 to 4 hours.
Break up cake until crumbly and mix pudding.
Put in deep glass container, layering as follows:
recipes.text: Death By Chocolate. Cook cake mix as directed. Puncture with fork and pour 1 cup Hershey's syrup over cake. Let stand 3 to 4 hours. Break up cake until crumbly and mix pudding. Put in deep glass container, layering as follows:

recipes.title: Potato Casserole
ingredients: 2 c. hot or cold mashed potatoes
directions: Beat all ingredients together at low speed until well blended, then beat on high speed until light and fluffy.
Place in greased 9-inch casserole. Bake 35 minutes at 350°.
Last 10 minutes, top with onion rings if desired. Serves 6.
recipes.text: Potato Casserole. Beat all ingredients together at low speed until well blended, then beat on high speed until light and fluffy. Place in greased 9-inch casserole. Bake 35 minutes at 350°. Last 10 minutes, top with onion rings if desired. Serves 6.

recipes.title: Macaroni And Cheese(Not For The Faint Of Heart)
ingredients: 1/2 c. (2 oz) shredded mild Cheddar cheese
1/2 c. (2 oz) shredded sharp Cheddar cheese
1 c. (8 oz) Velveeta, cut into small cubes
directions: Preheat the oven to 350.
Lightly butter a deep 2 1/2 quart casserole.
recipes.text: Macaroni And Cheese(Not For The Faint Of Heart). Preheat the oven to 350. Lightly butter a deep 2 1/2 quart casserole.

recipes.title: Gingersnaps
directions: Mix the ingredients and chill thoroughly.
Make balls the size of walnuts and roll in granulated sugar.
Bake at 350° for 7 to 10 minutes.
recipes.text: Gingersnaps. Mix the ingredients and chill thoroughly. Make balls the size of walnuts and roll in granulated sugar. Bake at 350° for 7 to 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Pizza Cups
directions: Brown meat and drain. Add tomato paste and seasonings. Simmer, uncovered, for 5 minutes; stir frequently. Press biscuits up sides of muffin pan. Spoon meat mixture in them and sprinkle with cheese. Bake at 400° for 10 to 12 minutes.
recipes.text: Pizza Cups. Brown meat and drain. Add tomato paste and seasonings. Simmer, uncovered, for 5 minutes; stir frequently. Press biscuits up sides of muffin pan. Spoon meat mixture in them and sprinkle with cheese. Bake at 400° for 10 to 12 minutes.

recipes.title: New England Brown Bread
directions: In a large bowl, combine all-purpose flour, baking soda and salt.
In another bowl, combine whole wheat flour, buttermilk and molasses.
Add to first flour mixture and mix well.
Stir in raisins.
Pour into two well-greased coffee cans (5 1/4 x 3 3/4-inch).
Bake at 350° for 45 to 60 minutes or until done.
recipes.text: New England Brown Bread. In a large bowl, combine all-purpose flour, baking soda and salt. In another bowl, combine whole wheat flour, buttermilk and molasses. Add to first flour mixture and mix well. Stir in raisins. Pour into two well-greased coffee cans (5 1/4 x 3 3/4-inch). Bake at 350° for 45 to 60 minutes or until done.

recipes.title: Taffy Apple Salad
ingredients: 8 oz. dry roasted peanuts, chopped or whole
directions: Put apples in pineapple juice.
Drain apples (save juice). To the juice, add sugar, eggs, flour and vinegar.
Cook until thick; cool.
Add cooked mixture, pineapple and nuts to apples. Add Cool Whip.
Garnish with chopped nuts.
recipes.text: Taffy Apple Salad. Put apples in pineapple juice. Drain apples (save juice). To the juice, add sugar, eggs, flour and vinegar. Cook until thick; cool. Add cooked mixture, pineapple and nuts to apples. Add Cool Whip. Garnish with chopped nuts.

recipes.title: Boston Clam Chowder
directions: Cook potatoes with enough water to cover.
Cook onion at same time.
Stir occasionally so they do not stick.
By the time they are soft, most of liquid disappears.
Add the clams and clam juice.
Shake about a cup of water with 3 or 4 tablespoons flour in a jar to mix for thickening.
Add flour and water (strain if lumpy) to clams and potatoes.
Add enough milk to make chowder your desired consistency.
If chowder is too thin, add more flour and water mixture.
Heat only to boiling.
Add cooked, diced bacon and seasonings.
Remove from heat and let stand covered for about 5 minutes.
Stir and serve.
recipes.text: Boston Clam Chowder. Cook potatoes with enough water to cover. Cook onion at same time. Stir occasionally so they do not stick. By the time they are soft, most of liquid disappears. Add the clams and clam juice. Shake about a cup of water with 3 or 4 tablespoons flour in a jar to mix for thickening. Add flour and water (strain if lumpy) to clams and potatoes. Add enough milk to make chowder your desired consistency. If chowder is too thin, add more flour and water mixture. Heat only to boiling. Add cooked, diced bacon and seasonings. Remove from heat and let stand covered for about 5 minutes. Stir and serve.

recipes.title: Date Rolls
directions: Cook first 3 ingredients slowly until thick.
Add sugar and take off stove.
Add nuts and Rice Krispies.
When cool enough to handle, roll in Angel Flake coconut.
recipes.text: Date Rolls. Cook first 3 ingredients slowly until thick. Add sugar and take off stove. Add nuts and Rice Krispies. When cool enough to handle, roll in Angel Flake coconut.

recipes.title: Broccoli And Corn Casserole
directions: Mix everything except cheese.
Place in 9 x 13-inch pan. Sprinkle on cheese.
Bake at 350° for 35 minutes.
recipes.text: Broccoli And Corn Casserole. Mix everything except cheese. Place in 9 x 13-inch pan. Sprinkle on cheese. Bake at 350° for 35 minutes.

recipes.title: Tuna Stuffed Eggs
ingredients: 1 (7 oz.) can Chicken of the Sea tuna
directions: Cut eggs in half lengthwise.
Remove the yolks to bowl; mash with a fork.
Drain and finely flake tuna.
Combine with egg yolks.
Add remaining ingredients, mixing well.
Pile mixture back into egg whites.
Refrigerate until serving time.
recipes.text: Tuna Stuffed Eggs. Cut eggs in half lengthwise. Remove the yolks to bowl; mash with a fork. Drain and finely flake tuna. Combine with egg yolks. Add remaining ingredients, mixing well. Pile mixture back into egg whites. Refrigerate until serving time.

recipes.title: Chocolate Candy Cake
directions: Combine flour and sugar; mix well and set aside.
Combine water, butter and cocoa in heavy saucepan.
Bring to boil, stirring constantly.
Gradually stir in flour mixture.
Stir in buttermilk, eggs and vanilla.
Pour into greased and floured 9 x 13 x 2-inch baking pan.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
While warm, prick surface and spread with Chocolate Candy Frosting.
recipes.text: Chocolate Candy Cake. Combine flour and sugar; mix well and set aside. Combine water, butter and cocoa in heavy saucepan. Bring to boil, stirring constantly. Gradually stir in flour mixture. Stir in buttermilk, eggs and vanilla. Pour into greased and floured 9 x 13 x 2-inch baking pan. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes. While warm, prick surface and spread with Chocolate Candy Frosting.

recipes.title: Marshmallow-Cereal Bars
ingredients: 25 large marshmallows or 3 1/2 c. miniature marshmallows
directions: Grease square pan, 8 x 8 x 2-inches or rectangular pan, 13 x 9 x 2-inches.
Place margarine and marshmallows in large microwavable bowl.
Microwave uncovered on High, 1 1/2 to 3 minutes, stirring after 1 minute until mixture is melted and smooth when stirred.
Stir in cereal until well coated.
Press mixture in pan, using buttered back of spoon.
Cool.
Makes 16 or 24 bars.
recipes.text: Marshmallow-Cereal Bars. Grease square pan, 8 x 8 x 2-inches or rectangular pan, 13 x 9 x 2-inches. Place margarine and marshmallows in large microwavable bowl. Microwave uncovered on High, 1 1/2 to 3 minutes, stirring after 1 minute until mixture is melted and smooth when stirred. Stir in cereal until well coated. Press mixture in pan, using buttered back of spoon. Cool. Makes 16 or 24 bars.

recipes.title: Bell Pepper Fajitas
directions: Saute sliced bell peppers and onions in butter until tender. Add milk and shredded cheese.
Lower heat.
Stir until melted. Wrap in tortilla.
Enjoy.
recipes.text: Bell Pepper Fajitas. Saute sliced bell peppers and onions in butter until tender. Add milk and shredded cheese. Lower heat. Stir until melted. Wrap in tortilla. Enjoy.

recipes.title: Apple Pie
directions: Cook apples and water and stir in remaining ingredients.
recipes.text: Apple Pie. Cook apples and water and stir in remaining ingredients.

recipes.title: Weeknight Fajitas
ingredients: 4 boneless chicken breasts, cut into strips
1 green bell pepper, cut into strips
1 medium onion, cut into thin wedges
directions: In large bowl, pour dressing over chicken, green pepper, onion, garlic and oregano.
Toss lightly and refrigerate at least 10 minutes.
Drain.
Stir-fry chicken mixture until chicken is browned and no longer pink.
Stir in tomato.
Wrap tortillas in dampened paper towels.
Microwave on High 45 seconds to 1 1/2 minutes or until softened.
Fill tortillas with chicken mixture.
Serve with salsa, no-fat sour cream and no-fat Cheddar cheese.
Makes 4 servings.
recipes.text: Weeknight Fajitas. In large bowl, pour dressing over chicken, green pepper, onion, garlic and oregano. Toss lightly and refrigerate at least 10 minutes. Drain. Stir-fry chicken mixture until chicken is browned and no longer pink. Stir in tomato. Wrap tortillas in dampened paper towels. Microwave on High 45 seconds to 1 1/2 minutes or until softened. Fill tortillas with chicken mixture. Serve with salsa, no-fat sour cream and no-fat Cheddar cheese. Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: Dog Food On Toast
directions: Scramble the hamburger and sausage.
Drain all of the fat. Add the cheese, which has been cut into small chunks.
Keep the heat on until all of the cheese has melted.
Place the meat mixture on top of the bread and place under the broiler for a few minutes.
recipes.text: Dog Food On Toast. Scramble the hamburger and sausage. Drain all of the fat. Add the cheese, which has been cut into small chunks. Keep the heat on until all of the cheese has melted. Place the meat mixture on top of the bread and place under the broiler for a few minutes.

recipes.title: Lemon Jello Salad
directions: Dissolve Jell-O in hot water.
Put in cream cheese and beat until dissolved, then add cold water, pineapple and nuts.
Put in jello mold and refrigerate until molded.
Remove and put in jello dish.
recipes.text: Lemon Jello Salad. Dissolve Jell-O in hot water. Put in cream cheese and beat until dissolved, then add cold water, pineapple and nuts. Put in jello mold and refrigerate until molded. Remove and put in jello dish.

recipes.title: Upside-Down Apple Pecan Pie
directions: In 9-inch pan, combine nuts, brown sugar and butter.
Spread evenly on bottom of pan.
Place bottom pie crust over pecan mixture in pan.
In a large bowl, combine remaining ingredients.
Spoon into crust lined pan.
Top with second crust and flute.
Cut slits in several places.
Bake at 350° for 45 to 55 minutes or until crust is browned and apples are tender.
Cool pie 5 minutes.
Place serving plate over pie and invert.
Carefully remove pie pan.
Some nuts may remain in pan; place them on pie with knife or spatula. Cool at least 1 hour before serving.
recipes.text: Upside-Down Apple Pecan Pie. In 9-inch pan, combine nuts, brown sugar and butter. Spread evenly on bottom of pan. Place bottom pie crust over pecan mixture in pan. In a large bowl, combine remaining ingredients. Spoon into crust lined pan. Top with second crust and flute. Cut slits in several places. Bake at 350° for 45 to 55 minutes or until crust is browned and apples are tender. Cool pie 5 minutes. Place serving plate over pie and invert. Carefully remove pie pan. Some nuts may remain in pan; place them on pie with knife or spatula. Cool at least 1 hour before serving.

recipes.title: South Maryland Stuffed Ham
ingredients: 1 corned ham or 15 to 25 lb. Mashes low-salt ham
directions: Chop vegetables (cabbage, kale and onions); mix with other ingredients.
Cut slits in ham.
Stuff ingredients in slits and if any are left over, put on top of ham.
Wrap ham in heavy-duty aluminum foil.
Put in a roasting pan; add 2 small saucepans of water.
Cook in oven at 350° for 4 1/2 to 5 hours.
recipes.text: South Maryland Stuffed Ham. Chop vegetables (cabbage, kale and onions); mix with other ingredients. Cut slits in ham. Stuff ingredients in slits and if any are left over, put on top of ham. Wrap ham in heavy-duty aluminum foil. Put in a roasting pan; add 2 small saucepans of water. Cook in oven at 350° for 4 1/2 to 5 hours.

recipes.title: Hamburger Casserole
directions: Cook noodles according to package directions; drain.
Brown meat in 1 tablespoon butter.
Stir in tomato sauce.
Remove from heat; set aside.

Combine cheeses, sour cream, onion and pepper. In a buttered 2-quart casserole, spread half of the noodles. Cover with cheese mixture, then cover with remaining noodles. Pour melted butter over the noodles.
Pour hamburger mixture on top of the noodles.
Bake at 350° for 20 to 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Hamburger Casserole. Cook noodles according to package directions; drain. Brown meat in 1 tablespoon butter. Stir in tomato sauce. Remove from heat; set aside. Combine cheeses, sour cream, onion and pepper. In a buttered 2-quart casserole, spread half of the noodles. Cover with cheese mixture, then cover with remaining noodles. Pour melted butter over the noodles. Pour hamburger mixture on top of the noodles. Bake at 350° for 20 to 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Like Kentucky Fried Dressing
directions: Mix all together and keep in refrigerator.
recipes.text: Like Kentucky Fried Dressing. Mix all together and keep in refrigerator.

recipes.title: Cassie'S Spaghetti
ingredients: 1 lb. ground chuck, browned and drained
directions: After browning and draining ground chuck, add spaghetti sauce. Also add oregano, a dash of garlic powder and salt.
In a separate pot, prepare spaghetti noodles according to package directions. Drain spaghetti and add sauce.
Let simmer slowly for 10 to 15 minutes.
Serves 4.
recipes.text: Cassie'S Spaghetti. After browning and draining ground chuck, add spaghetti sauce. Also add oregano, a dash of garlic powder and salt. In a separate pot, prepare spaghetti noodles according to package directions. Drain spaghetti and add sauce. Let simmer slowly for 10 to 15 minutes. Serves 4.

recipes.title: Chicken Casserole
directions: Arrange chicken
in
lightly greased 13 x 9-inch baking dish. Top with cheese.
Combine soup and water stirring well. Spoon sauce
over
chicken
evenly
and sprinkle with stuffing mix. Drizzle butter
over
the crumbs and bake at 350° for 45 to 50 minutes.
recipes.text: Chicken Casserole. Arrange chicken in lightly greased 13 x 9-inch baking dish. Top with cheese. Combine soup and water stirring well. Spoon sauce over chicken evenly and sprinkle with stuffing mix. Drizzle butter over the crumbs and bake at 350° for 45 to 50 minutes.

recipes.title: Cheese Spaghetti Bake
ingredients: 10 to 12 oz. spaghetti, cooked and drained
directions: Brown meat and onions in skillet.
Add tomato sauce, tomatoes, oregano, salt, basil, sugar and parsley.
Simmer 15 minutes.
Add cooked spaghetti and mix.
Turn half of spaghetti into 9 x 13-inch greased pan.
Put layer of Velveeta cheese on spaghetti.
Add rest of spaghetti and top with Mozzarella cheese.
Cover with foil and bake 20 to 30 minutes at 350°.
recipes.text: Cheese Spaghetti Bake. Brown meat and onions in skillet. Add tomato sauce, tomatoes, oregano, salt, basil, sugar and parsley. Simmer 15 minutes. Add cooked spaghetti and mix. Turn half of spaghetti into 9 x 13-inch greased pan. Put layer of Velveeta cheese on spaghetti. Add rest of spaghetti and top with Mozzarella cheese. Cover with foil and bake 20 to 30 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Applesauce Cake
directions: Sift together the first 6 ingredients.
Cream shortening and sugar; add egg and beat until light and fluffy.
Blend in applesauce.
Add dry ingredients.
Stir in raisins and nuts.
Bake at 350° for 50 minutes.
recipes.text: Applesauce Cake. Sift together the first 6 ingredients. Cream shortening and sugar; add egg and beat until light and fluffy. Blend in applesauce. Add dry ingredients. Stir in raisins and nuts. Bake at 350° for 50 minutes.

recipes.title: Split Pea Soup
directions: In a stockpot, combine peas, ham, onion, bouillon, water, salt and pepper.
Bring to a boil.
Cover and simmer 1 1/2 hours, stirring frequently.
Add carrots and celery and simmer 30 more minutes. Stir margarine into soup and heat through.
Serve.
Makes 8 servings.
recipes.text: Split Pea Soup. In a stockpot, combine peas, ham, onion, bouillon, water, salt and pepper. Bring to a boil. Cover and simmer 1 1/2 hours, stirring frequently. Add carrots and celery and simmer 30 more minutes. Stir margarine into soup and heat through. Serve. Makes 8 servings.

recipes.title: Stuffing
directions: Place bread in large bowl; add egg.
Saute onion and celery in oleo.
Add that to bread mixture.
Add seasoning.
Then add milk. Form into a ball.
If it is too moist, add more bread.
recipes.text: Stuffing. Place bread in large bowl; add egg. Saute onion and celery in oleo. Add that to bread mixture. Add seasoning. Then add milk. Form into a ball. If it is too moist, add more bread.

recipes.title: Crazy Custard Pie
directions: Beat all liquid ingredients together.
Break up bread and add to liquid mixture.
Place in baking pan.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Crazy Custard Pie. Beat all liquid ingredients together. Break up bread and add to liquid mixture. Place in baking pan. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Foundation Yellow Cake
ingredients: 3/4 c. butter or part other shortening
directions: Cream the butter or shortening thoroughly in a deep bowl. (Have it soft before you start.)

Add sugar gradually, beating until the mixture is fluffy and light like whipped cream. Add eggs, beaten until light. Sift dry ingredients together and add alternately with liquid, beginning and ending with the dry ingredients.
Beat thoroughly and add flavoring.
Bake in layers or flat loaf pan in preheated 375° oven for 30 minutes.
Makes 2 large squares or 3 layers.
recipes.text: Foundation Yellow Cake. Cream the butter or shortening thoroughly in a deep bowl. (Have it soft before you start.) Add sugar gradually, beating until the mixture is fluffy and light like whipped cream. Add eggs, beaten until light. Sift dry ingredients together and add alternately with liquid, beginning and ending with the dry ingredients. Beat thoroughly and add flavoring. Bake in layers or flat loaf pan in preheated 375° oven for 30 minutes. Makes 2 large squares or 3 layers.

recipes.title: Potato Soup
directions: Cook 20 minutes on medium-high or until potatoes are tender. Then add 1 can of Carnation milk.
recipes.text: Potato Soup. Cook 20 minutes on medium-high or until potatoes are tender. Then add 1 can of Carnation milk.

recipes.title: Rotel Chicken
directions: Saute Bell peppers, onion and celery in butter.
Boil chicken with salt and pepper.
Retrieve the chicken, save the water to boil the noodles in.
Chop the chicken, set aside.
Drain the noodles, set aside.
Combine velveeta cheese, Rotel, chicken soup and English peas.
Put all together in a large baking pan.
Bake at 350 for 20 minutes.
You can put this in a crock pot to keep warm.
recipes.text: Rotel Chicken. Saute Bell peppers, onion and celery in butter. Boil chicken with salt and pepper. Retrieve the chicken, save the water to boil the noodles in. Chop the chicken, set aside. Drain the noodles, set aside. Combine velveeta cheese, Rotel, chicken soup and English peas. Put all together in a large baking pan. Bake at 350 for 20 minutes. You can put this in a crock pot to keep warm.

recipes.title: Company Vegetable Casserole
ingredients: 1 (15 oz.) can cut green beans, drained or 2 c. frozen cut green beans, thawed
1 (15 oz.) can whole kernel corn, drained or 2 c. cooked fresh or frozen whole kernel corn
1 (10 3/4 oz.) can condensed cream of celery soup (undiluted)
directions: In bowl, combine beans, corn, sour cream, cheese and onion. Pour into an ungreased 2-quart baking dish.
Combine butter, crumbs and almonds, sprinkle over vegetables.
Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes or until bubbly.
Yields 6 to 8 servings.
recipes.text: Company Vegetable Casserole. In bowl, combine beans, corn, sour cream, cheese and onion. Pour into an ungreased 2-quart baking dish. Combine butter, crumbs and almonds, sprinkle over vegetables. Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes or until bubbly. Yields 6 to 8 servings.

recipes.title: Tuna Casserole(My Children'S Favorite)
directions: Add milk to rest of ingredients.
Bake 30 minutes at 350°. Cover for the first 20 minutes.
recipes.text: Tuna Casserole(My Children'S Favorite). Add milk to rest of ingredients. Bake 30 minutes at 350°. Cover for the first 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Chase'S Kahlua Cake
ingredients: 1 box Pillsbury devil's food with pudding cake mix
directions: Mix together all ingredients except Kahlua.
Beat 4 minutes. Bake at 350° for 50 minutes in floured tube or Bundt pan.
When done, pour 1/4 cup Kahlua over cake.
recipes.text: Chase'S Kahlua Cake. Mix together all ingredients except Kahlua. Beat 4 minutes. Bake at 350° for 50 minutes in floured tube or Bundt pan. When done, pour 1/4 cup Kahlua over cake.

recipes.title: Strawberry Cake
directions: Mix well with mixer.
Bake 30 minutes at 350°.
Makes 2 layer cake or tube pan.
recipes.text: Strawberry Cake. Mix well with mixer. Bake 30 minutes at 350°. Makes 2 layer cake or tube pan.

recipes.title: Pineapple Pie
directions: Freeze evaporated milk to a mush.
Combine pineapple, eggs and sugar.
Bring to a boil.
Add lemon jello.
Cool.
Whip evaporated milk stiff and fold into fruit mixture.
Pour in graham cracker pie crust.
Refrigerate.
Makes enough for 2 pies.
recipes.text: Pineapple Pie. Freeze evaporated milk to a mush. Combine pineapple, eggs and sugar. Bring to a boil. Add lemon jello. Cool. Whip evaporated milk stiff and fold into fruit mixture. Pour in graham cracker pie crust. Refrigerate. Makes enough for 2 pies.

recipes.title: Easy Peanut Butter Cookies
directions: Preheat oven to 375°.
In a large bowl, beat Eagle Brand and peanut butter until smooth.
Add biscuit mix and vanilla.
Mix well.
Shape in 1-inch balls.
Roll in sugar.
Place 2 inches apart on ungreased baking sheet.
Flatten with fork.
Bake 6 to 8 minutes or until lightly brown (do not overbake).
Cool.
Store tightly covered.
recipes.text: Easy Peanut Butter Cookies. Preheat oven to 375°. In a large bowl, beat Eagle Brand and peanut butter until smooth. Add biscuit mix and vanilla. Mix well. Shape in 1-inch balls. Roll in sugar. Place 2 inches apart on ungreased baking sheet. Flatten with fork. Bake 6 to 8 minutes or until lightly brown (do not overbake). Cool. Store tightly covered.

recipes.title: Cherry Delight
ingredients: 1 pkg. Dream Whip, prepared per directions
directions: Mix together crushed grahams, butter and sugar.
Press into oblong dish.
Chill 15 minutes.
recipes.text: Cherry Delight. Mix together crushed grahams, butter and sugar. Press into oblong dish. Chill 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Vegetable Casserole
directions: Mix together with salt and pepper.
Melt 1 stick butter; pour over 1 cup crushed Ritz crackers.
Sprinkle over casserole.
Bake 45 minutes at 375°.
recipes.text: Vegetable Casserole. Mix together with salt and pepper. Melt 1 stick butter; pour over 1 cup crushed Ritz crackers. Sprinkle over casserole. Bake 45 minutes at 375°.

recipes.title: Marinated Fish
directions: Combine ingredients except fish and bread crumbs and cook 5 minutes.
Cool and pour over fish.
Marinate covered and refrigerate several hours.
Remove fish, dip into bread crumbs and fry until brown and tender.
Yield: 6 servings.
recipes.text: Marinated Fish. Combine ingredients except fish and bread crumbs and cook 5 minutes. Cool and pour over fish. Marinate covered and refrigerate several hours. Remove fish, dip into bread crumbs and fry until brown and tender. Yield: 6 servings.

recipes.title: Deep Dish Pizza
ingredients: 1 lb. loaf frozen bread dough, thawed
directions: Grease 14 x 2-inch pizza pan.
On flour dusted surface, roll dough into 16-inch circle.
Press into bottom and 1 1/2-inch up sides of pan.
Sprinkle with 3 cups Mozzarella.
Crumble sausage over cheese.
Top with oregano, tomatoes, mushrooms and remaining cheese.
Place in 500° oven.
Immediately reduce to 400°.
Bake 40 to 50 minutes.
Remove pizza when crust is golden and sausage is cooked through.
recipes.text: Deep Dish Pizza. Grease 14 x 2-inch pizza pan. On flour dusted surface, roll dough into 16-inch circle. Press into bottom and 1 1/2-inch up sides of pan. Sprinkle with 3 cups Mozzarella. Crumble sausage over cheese. Top with oregano, tomatoes, mushrooms and remaining cheese. Place in 500° oven. Immediately reduce to 400°. Bake 40 to 50 minutes. Remove pizza when crust is golden and sausage is cooked through.

recipes.title: Baby Calzone
ingredients: 1 (10 oz.) pkg. large flaky refrigerator biscuits
directions: Combine Ricotta, Mozzarella and Parmesan cheeses in small bowl and mix.
Half each biscuit horizontally making 20 thin biscuits. If kitchen is hot, refrigerate half the dough.
Shape one piece of dough into an oval about 2 1/2 x 4-inches.
Place a slice of pepperoni slightly off center on the dough.
Top with one level tablespoon of cheese mixture.
Moisten edge and fold dough over to enclose filling.
Pinch edges to seal.
Place on lightly greased baking sheet.
Repeat.
Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.
recipes.text: Baby Calzone. Combine Ricotta, Mozzarella and Parmesan cheeses in small bowl and mix. Half each biscuit horizontally making 20 thin biscuits. If kitchen is hot, refrigerate half the dough. Shape one piece of dough into an oval about 2 1/2 x 4-inches. Place a slice of pepperoni slightly off center on the dough. Top with one level tablespoon of cheese mixture. Moisten edge and fold dough over to enclose filling. Pinch edges to seal. Place on lightly greased baking sheet. Repeat. Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Pineapple Dessert
ingredients: 1 large or 2 (8 oz.) containers Cool Whip
directions: Lightly grease a 13 x 9 x 2 pan with vegetable oil or cooking spray.
recipes.text: Pineapple Dessert. Lightly grease a 13 x 9 x 2 pan with vegetable oil or cooking spray.

recipes.title: Pineapple Cabbage Salad
directions: Combine cabbage, pineapple chunks, carrots, celery and pepper. Toss lightly to mix.
Combine salad dressing, sour cream, honey or sugar, celery seed and salt.
Pour over vegetables and mix carefully.
recipes.text: Pineapple Cabbage Salad. Combine cabbage, pineapple chunks, carrots, celery and pepper. Toss lightly to mix. Combine salad dressing, sour cream, honey or sugar, celery seed and salt. Pour over vegetables and mix carefully.

recipes.title: Fruit Cobbler
directions: Optional:
Use can fruit instead of fresh.
recipes.text: Fruit Cobbler. Optional: Use can fruit instead of fresh.

recipes.title: Lime Sweet Pickles
directions: Soak clean cucumbers in water and lime for 12 hours or overnight.
Wash cucumbers 3 times in clean water and soak in fresh ice water for 3 hours.
Mix remaining ingredients and bring to a low boil.
Stir until sugar is dissolved.
Add cucumber and soak for 5 to 6 hours or overnight.
Boil pickles for 35 minutes. Fill in jars and pour syrup over cucumbers in jars.
Leave 1/8-inch headspace.
Process jars 5 minutes in boiling water. Start time when water gets to a full rolling boil.
recipes.text: Lime Sweet Pickles. Soak clean cucumbers in water and lime for 12 hours or overnight. Wash cucumbers 3 times in clean water and soak in fresh ice water for 3 hours. Mix remaining ingredients and bring to a low boil. Stir until sugar is dissolved. Add cucumber and soak for 5 to 6 hours or overnight. Boil pickles for 35 minutes. Fill in jars and pour syrup over cucumbers in jars. Leave 1/8-inch headspace. Process jars 5 minutes in boiling water. Start time when water gets to a full rolling boil.

recipes.title: Purple Cloud
directions: Place all ingredients in blender container.
Blend briefly. Pour into serving glasses.
Serves 2.
recipes.text: Purple Cloud. Place all ingredients in blender container. Blend briefly. Pour into serving glasses. Serves 2.

recipes.title: Zucchini Marmalade
ingredients: 1 large pkg. jello (orange or any flavor)
directions: Boil the sugar and zucchini for 5 minutes.
Add crushed pineapple and cook 1 minute.
Turn off heat and add 1 large package orange jello or any flavor.
Stir until dissolved.
Pour into jars and seal. Keep in refrigerator.
recipes.text: Zucchini Marmalade. Boil the sugar and zucchini for 5 minutes. Add crushed pineapple and cook 1 minute. Turn off heat and add 1 large package orange jello or any flavor. Stir until dissolved. Pour into jars and seal. Keep in refrigerator.

recipes.title: Broccoli-Cauliflower Salad
directions: Remove flowerets from broccoli and cauliflower. Cut into bite size pieces. Combine broccoli and cauliflower flowerets, pepper, mushrooms and celery. Toss lightly. Combine sugar, dry mustard, salt, vinegar, onion, oil and poppy seeds. Mix well and pour over vegetables. Chill for at least 2 hours, stirring occasionally.
recipes.text: Broccoli-Cauliflower Salad. Remove flowerets from broccoli and cauliflower. Cut into bite size pieces. Combine broccoli and cauliflower flowerets, pepper, mushrooms and celery. Toss lightly. Combine sugar, dry mustard, salt, vinegar, onion, oil and poppy seeds. Mix well and pour over vegetables. Chill for at least 2 hours, stirring occasionally.

recipes.title: Quiche Lorraine
ingredients: 2 c. grated cheese (medium or sharp Cheddar or Monterey Jack)
directions: Options:
Ham instead of bacon.
Broccoli instead of spinach. Or egg, bacon and cheese for breakfast quiche.
recipes.text: Quiche Lorraine. Options: Ham instead of bacon. Broccoli instead of spinach. Or egg, bacon and cheese for breakfast quiche.

recipes.title: Fruit Pizza
ingredients: 1 (20 oz.) tube Pillsbury sugar cookie mix
fruit (bananas, Mandarin oranges, kiwi and pineapple tidbits)
directions: Grease a pizza pan and spread cookie mix on it.
Bake at 350° for 15 minutes.
Let cool.
Cream together cream cheese, sugar and vanilla; spread on cookie mix.
Dip bananas in lemon juice to keep them from turning black.
Arrange fruit on top of cream cheese mixture, in a circle, one fruit at a time, working towards the center.
recipes.text: Fruit Pizza. Grease a pizza pan and spread cookie mix on it. Bake at 350° for 15 minutes. Let cool. Cream together cream cheese, sugar and vanilla; spread on cookie mix. Dip bananas in lemon juice to keep them from turning black. Arrange fruit on top of cream cheese mixture, in a circle, one fruit at a time, working towards the center.

recipes.title: Pork Chop Casserole
directions: Brown pork chops.
While pork chops are browning, microwave hash browns 10 to 13 minutes.
Combine soup, milk, sour cream, dash of salt and pepper.
Stir in hash browns, 1/2 Cheddar cheese and 1/2 French fried onions.
Pour in baking dish.
Put pork chops on top.
Cover.
Bake 40 minutes at 350°.
Take top off.
Put remaining cheese and French fried onions on top.
Bake 5 minutes, uncovered.
recipes.text: Pork Chop Casserole. Brown pork chops. While pork chops are browning, microwave hash browns 10 to 13 minutes. Combine soup, milk, sour cream, dash of salt and pepper. Stir in hash browns, 1/2 Cheddar cheese and 1/2 French fried onions. Pour in baking dish. Put pork chops on top. Cover. Bake 40 minutes at 350°. Take top off. Put remaining cheese and French fried onions on top. Bake 5 minutes, uncovered.

recipes.title: Helen'S Cherry Cream Pie
directions: Beat cream and 1/2 cup sugar until creamy.
Add large tub of Cool Whip.
Pour into graham cracker crust.
Chill.
Top with cherry pie filling and 1/2 cup sugar.
recipes.text: Helen'S Cherry Cream Pie. Beat cream and 1/2 cup sugar until creamy. Add large tub of Cool Whip. Pour into graham cracker crust. Chill. Top with cherry pie filling and 1/2 cup sugar.

recipes.title: Carrot Cake
directions: Beat eggs. Add sugar and beat. Mix dry ingredients and add alternately with salad oil. Add vanilla, carrots, nuts and raisins. Bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes in 9 x 13-inch pan or bake 1 hour in an angel food cake pan.
recipes.text: Carrot Cake. Beat eggs. Add sugar and beat. Mix dry ingredients and add alternately with salad oil. Add vanilla, carrots, nuts and raisins. Bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes in 9 x 13-inch pan or bake 1 hour in an angel food cake pan.

recipes.title: Cheesy Potatoes
directions: Bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours.
Stir while baking (tastes better).
Can add more cheese.
recipes.text: Cheesy Potatoes. Bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours. Stir while baking (tastes better). Can add more cheese.

recipes.title: Orange-Pecan Bread
directions: Combine egg, orange, raisins, rind, shortening and vanilla. Sift flour, baking powder, soda, salt and sugar into orange mixture; mix well.
Stir in pecans.
Pour into a well-greased 5 x 9 x 2 1/2-inch loaf pan.
Bake at 325 to 350° for 1 hour, or longer (check with a toothpick at 1 hour).
recipes.text: Orange-Pecan Bread. Combine egg, orange, raisins, rind, shortening and vanilla. Sift flour, baking powder, soda, salt and sugar into orange mixture; mix well. Stir in pecans. Pour into a well-greased 5 x 9 x 2 1/2-inch loaf pan. Bake at 325 to 350° for 1 hour, or longer (check with a toothpick at 1 hour).

recipes.title: Creamy Fudge
directions: Put sugar, chocolate, milk and Karo in a large boiler and bring to a rolling boil (one that you can't stir down). Cook for 2 minutes after it begins to boil. Do not stir after sugar dissolves. Remove from stove after it cooks 2 minutes. Add the butter and let cool for 5 minutes. Add vanilla; beat until it loses gloss. Add nuts and pour quickly into buttered pan or plate. Cut when firm.
recipes.text: Creamy Fudge. Put sugar, chocolate, milk and Karo in a large boiler and bring to a rolling boil (one that you can't stir down). Cook for 2 minutes after it begins to boil. Do not stir after sugar dissolves. Remove from stove after it cooks 2 minutes. Add the butter and let cool for 5 minutes. Add vanilla; beat until it loses gloss. Add nuts and pour quickly into buttered pan or plate. Cut when firm.

recipes.title: Easy Spanish Rice
directions: Cook rice (your choice of white or long grain).
Brown ground beef.
Drain fat and rinse meat with water. Drain off water.
Add chopped onions, beef and picante sauce (your choice of mild, medium or hot sauce) to rice.
Mix together evenly.
May serve with refried beans, tacos, or as a side dish to Mexican or barbecue chicken.
recipes.text: Easy Spanish Rice. Cook rice (your choice of white or long grain). Brown ground beef. Drain fat and rinse meat with water. Drain off water. Add chopped onions, beef and picante sauce (your choice of mild, medium or hot sauce) to rice. Mix together evenly. May serve with refried beans, tacos, or as a side dish to Mexican or barbecue chicken.

recipes.title: Banana Devil'S Food Cake
directions: Melt oleo, brown sugar, eggs, bananas and bitter chocolate. Cool.
Add flour mix (flour, baking soda, salt, vanilla and buttermilk) and milk alternately into first mix.
Bake in 2 layer pans 30 minutes at 350°.
Use mashed bananas between layers and ice with your favorite chocolate icing.
Very good if left set overnight.
recipes.text: Banana Devil'S Food Cake. Melt oleo, brown sugar, eggs, bananas and bitter chocolate. Cool. Add flour mix (flour, baking soda, salt, vanilla and buttermilk) and milk alternately into first mix. Bake in 2 layer pans 30 minutes at 350°. Use mashed bananas between layers and ice with your favorite chocolate icing. Very good if left set overnight.

recipes.title: Apricot Pecan Balls
directions: In a bowl, stir together the vanilla wafers, pecans, 1/2 cup powdered sugar and apricots.
Stir in corn syrup and brandy. Using 1 level tablespoon for each cookie, shape mixture into balls.
Roll in remaining 1/4 cup powdered sugar.
Store in covered container.
Makes a lot of balls (3 dozen).
recipes.text: Apricot Pecan Balls. In a bowl, stir together the vanilla wafers, pecans, 1/2 cup powdered sugar and apricots. Stir in corn syrup and brandy. Using 1 level tablespoon for each cookie, shape mixture into balls. Roll in remaining 1/4 cup powdered sugar. Store in covered container. Makes a lot of balls (3 dozen).

recipes.title: Shrimp Stew
ingredients: 1 pt. fresh small shrimp, peeled and deveined
directions: Season flour with salt and pepper; flour the shrimp.
Fry the bacon; remove from the pan.
Stir-fry the onion; remove from the pan.
Add the floured shrimp to the bacon grease; cook over medium heat until pinkish.
Add about 1 cup of water; stir to thicken. Crumble in bacon; add the onion.
May need more water if too thick.
Serve over rice or grits.
Delicious.
Serves several, depending on appetite.
recipes.text: Shrimp Stew. Season flour with salt and pepper; flour the shrimp. Fry the bacon; remove from the pan. Stir-fry the onion; remove from the pan. Add the floured shrimp to the bacon grease; cook over medium heat until pinkish. Add about 1 cup of water; stir to thicken. Crumble in bacon; add the onion. May need more water if too thick. Serve over rice or grits. Delicious. Serves several, depending on appetite.

recipes.title: Pineapple Upside-Down Cake
directions: Melt butter in pan.
Sprinkle brown sugar evenly in pan. Arrange slices of pineapple and cherries on sugar mixture.
Mix cake mix as directed.
Pour batter over fruit.
Bake at 350° for 45 to 50 minutes.
Let stand 5 minutes for topping to set.
Then turn upside-down onto cookie sheet.
recipes.text: Pineapple Upside-Down Cake. Melt butter in pan. Sprinkle brown sugar evenly in pan. Arrange slices of pineapple and cherries on sugar mixture. Mix cake mix as directed. Pour batter over fruit. Bake at 350° for 45 to 50 minutes. Let stand 5 minutes for topping to set. Then turn upside-down onto cookie sheet.

recipes.title: Lasagna
ingredients: 1 lb. ground meat, cooked and drained
1/2 lb. lasagna noodles, cooked and drained
directions: In medium bowl, combine sauce and ground meat.
In a separate medium bowl, combine Ricotta cheese, 3/4 cup Parmesan cheese and parsley.
Pour 3/4 cup sauce mixture in bottom of a 13 x 9-inch pan.
Layer one-third of the noodles, half of the Ricotta mixture, 1/3 of the remaining sauce and 1 cup Mozzarella cheese in pan. Repeat layers.
Top with remaining noodles, sauce, 1 cup Mozzarella cheese and 3/4 cup Parmesan cheese.
Cover with foil; bake at 350° for 50 minutes.
Uncover; bake 15 minutes more. Makes 8 to 10 servings.
recipes.text: Lasagna. In medium bowl, combine sauce and ground meat. In a separate medium bowl, combine Ricotta cheese, 3/4 cup Parmesan cheese and parsley. Pour 3/4 cup sauce mixture in bottom of a 13 x 9-inch pan. Layer one-third of the noodles, half of the Ricotta mixture, 1/3 of the remaining sauce and 1 cup Mozzarella cheese in pan. Repeat layers. Top with remaining noodles, sauce, 1 cup Mozzarella cheese and 3/4 cup Parmesan cheese. Cover with foil; bake at 350° for 50 minutes. Uncover; bake 15 minutes more. Makes 8 to 10 servings.

recipes.title: Cherry Pudding(No Cholesterol)
directions: Place cherries in an 8 x 8-inch glass baking dish.
Mix dry ingredients
and
add milk.
Pour over cherries.
Bake at 350° until cake rises to top and is brown.
recipes.text: Cherry Pudding(No Cholesterol). Place cherries in an 8 x 8-inch glass baking dish. Mix dry ingredients and add milk. Pour over cherries. Bake at 350° until cake rises to top and is brown.

recipes.title: Peach Salad Mold
directions: Drain peaches.
Heat juice to boiling.
Soften gelatin in lemon juice.
Dissolve in hot juice and cool.
Mash cream cheese and blend in mayonnaise and salt.
Stir in gelatin and whipped cream.
Fold in celery and sliced peaches.
Turn into ring mold. Chill until firm.
May be garnished with sliced peaches and maraschino cherries, if desired.
recipes.text: Peach Salad Mold. Drain peaches. Heat juice to boiling. Soften gelatin in lemon juice. Dissolve in hot juice and cool. Mash cream cheese and blend in mayonnaise and salt. Stir in gelatin and whipped cream. Fold in celery and sliced peaches. Turn into ring mold. Chill until firm. May be garnished with sliced peaches and maraschino cherries, if desired.

recipes.title: Broiled Herbed Tomatoes
directions: Wash tomatoes and remove stem ends.
Cut tomatoes in half crosswise.
Melt butter in saucepan.
Brush over cut surface of tomatoes with butter.
Combine bread crumbs, rosemary, basil, salt and pepper.
Sprinkle crumbs over tops of tomatoes.
Pour remaining butter over top of crumbs.
Broil under low heat with tops of tomatoes about 3-inches from heat for 10 to 12 minutes until tomatoes are heated through and crumbs are well browned.
recipes.text: Broiled Herbed Tomatoes. Wash tomatoes and remove stem ends. Cut tomatoes in half crosswise. Melt butter in saucepan. Brush over cut surface of tomatoes with butter. Combine bread crumbs, rosemary, basil, salt and pepper. Sprinkle crumbs over tops of tomatoes. Pour remaining butter over top of crumbs. Broil under low heat with tops of tomatoes about 3-inches from heat for 10 to 12 minutes until tomatoes are heated through and crumbs are well browned.

recipes.title: Braciola
directions: Mince
garlic
and parsley together; add to this grated cheese,
salt
and	pepper	to
taste.
On each slice of steak spread mixture.
Add strips of meat fat if desired.
Roll each slice
and	secure	with
toothpicks.
Brown
in
pan.
Add to tomato
sauce and let simmer until sauce is done.
When tomato sauce
is
not being used, add chopped onion and white wine to Braciola; simmer until tender.
recipes.text: Braciola. Mince garlic and parsley together; add to this grated cheese, salt and	pepper	to taste. On each slice of steak spread mixture. Add strips of meat fat if desired. Roll each slice and	secure	with toothpicks. Brown in pan. Add to tomato sauce and let simmer until sauce is done. When tomato sauce is not being used, add chopped onion and white wine to Braciola; simmer until tender.

recipes.title: Turnovers
directions: Mix until it makes a firm dough. Roll out into 6 in.

circles. Put your favorite filling (example; cooked meat, fruit, vegetables, etc.) in the middle. Brush water halfway around the edge of each. Draw both sides to the center over the filling to seal. Crimp the edges and brush all over with beaten egg. Bake on cookie sheet at 400° 25-30 min. until well browned. Serve hot or cold. If you wish to fry them do not brush with egg. Deep fry 5-6 min.
recipes.text: Turnovers. Mix until it makes a firm dough. Roll out into 6 in. circles. Put your favorite filling (example; cooked meat, fruit, vegetables, etc.) in the middle. Brush water halfway around the edge of each. Draw both sides to the center over the filling to seal. Crimp the edges and brush all over with beaten egg. Bake on cookie sheet at 400° 25-30 min. until well browned. Serve hot or cold. If you wish to fry them do not brush with egg. Deep fry 5-6 min.

recipes.title: Turkey Loaf
directions: Preheat oven to 350°.
Spray 9 x 5-inch loaf pan with nonstick cooking spray.
In large bowl, mix all ingredients well.
Shape into loaf and put in pan.
Bake 50 to 60 minutes or unti loaf pulls away from sides of pan.
Remove to platter.
Cool 10 minutes before slicing.
Makes 6 servings with 210 calories and 10 g fat.
recipes.text: Turkey Loaf. Preheat oven to 350°. Spray 9 x 5-inch loaf pan with nonstick cooking spray. In large bowl, mix all ingredients well. Shape into loaf and put in pan. Bake 50 to 60 minutes or unti loaf pulls away from sides of pan. Remove to platter. Cool 10 minutes before slicing. Makes 6 servings with 210 calories and 10 g fat.

recipes.title: Hamburger Relish
directions: Grind all vegetables and drain well.
Add remaining ingredients and place in jars; refrigerate.
This recipe can be cut.
recipes.text: Hamburger Relish. Grind all vegetables and drain well. Add remaining ingredients and place in jars; refrigerate. This recipe can be cut.

recipes.title: Oyster Crackers
ingredients: 1 pkg. Hidden Valley dry milk dressing mix
directions: Put crackers in a large Ziploc bag.
In a separate bowl, mix remaining ingredients.
Pour into bag with crackers and shake until crackers are well coated. Store in an airtight container.
recipes.text: Oyster Crackers. Put crackers in a large Ziploc bag. In a separate bowl, mix remaining ingredients. Pour into bag with crackers and shake until crackers are well coated. Store in an airtight container.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Cracker Dessert
directions: Mix and press into 13X9 pan and set aside.
recipes.text: Pumpkin Cracker Dessert. Mix and press into 13X9 pan and set aside.

recipes.title: Chocolate Butter-Cream Frosting
ingredients: 1 1/2 c. (3 sticks) butter or margarine, softened
1 c. (6 oz.) semi-sweet chocolate pieces, melted
directions: In a large bowl, beat at high speed and cream butter; gradually add sugar.
Beat until fluffy.
Beat in egg yolks one at a time.
Gradually beat in melted chocolate until creamy.
If too soft, refrigerate for 1/2 hour.
recipes.text: Chocolate Butter-Cream Frosting. In a large bowl, beat at high speed and cream butter; gradually add sugar. Beat until fluffy. Beat in egg yolks one at a time. Gradually beat in melted chocolate until creamy. If too soft, refrigerate for 1/2 hour.

recipes.title: Braised Duck
directions: Place ducks in baking pan, breasts up.
Season each duck with 1/2 teaspoon each: celery salt, curry powder, pepper and salt. Let stand for about 1 hour.
Add onion and celery to the pan along with 1/2-inch of water.
Bake at 500° for about 20 minutes.
Turn the ducks and bake until backs are brown.
Cover and cook for 1 hour at 300°.
recipes.text: Braised Duck. Place ducks in baking pan, breasts up. Season each duck with 1/2 teaspoon each: celery salt, curry powder, pepper and salt. Let stand for about 1 hour. Add onion and celery to the pan along with 1/2-inch of water. Bake at 500° for about 20 minutes. Turn the ducks and bake until backs are brown. Cover and cook for 1 hour at 300°.

recipes.title: Marinated Vegetables
directions: Place all vegetables in dish (such as Tupperware) with lid: pour the bottle of dressing over and toss.
Let stand overnight before eating.
Toss 2 or 3 times before serving.
Keep refrigerated green onions are good in there too!
recipes.text: Marinated Vegetables. Place all vegetables in dish (such as Tupperware) with lid: pour the bottle of dressing over and toss. Let stand overnight before eating. Toss 2 or 3 times before serving. Keep refrigerated green onions are good in there too!

recipes.title: Two Minute Fudge
directions: Put ingredients into microwave-safe mixing bowl.
Cover and microwave on High for 2 minutes.
Remove mixture and beat until smooth.
Pour into buttered dish.
Let cool and cut into serving pieces.
recipes.text: Two Minute Fudge. Put ingredients into microwave-safe mixing bowl. Cover and microwave on High for 2 minutes. Remove mixture and beat until smooth. Pour into buttered dish. Let cool and cut into serving pieces.

recipes.title: Pinto Bean Pie
ingredients: 1/2 c. cooked and mashed pinto beans
directions: Mix ingredients well.
Bake in unbaked pie shell until solid (as in pumpkin pie).
Top with meringue or Cool Whip.
recipes.text: Pinto Bean Pie. Mix ingredients well. Bake in unbaked pie shell until solid (as in pumpkin pie). Top with meringue or Cool Whip.

recipes.title: Quick And Easy Barbecue Meatballs
directions: Note:
For best results, use lean hamburger (ground meat).
recipes.text: Quick And Easy Barbecue Meatballs. Note: For best results, use lean hamburger (ground meat).

recipes.title: Peach Cobbler
ingredients: 1 (29 oz.) can sliced peaches (or any fruit), undrained
directions: Combine first three ingredients.
Mix well.
Add milk.
Stir. Pour mixture into a lightly greased shallow 2-quart casserole. Dot with butter.
Combine 3 tablespoons of sugar and cinnamon.
Add to peaches.
Spoon peach mixture over batter.
Do not stir.
Bake at 350° for 50 or 60 minutes or until brown.
Yields 6 to 8 servings.
recipes.text: Peach Cobbler. Combine first three ingredients. Mix well. Add milk. Stir. Pour mixture into a lightly greased shallow 2-quart casserole. Dot with butter. Combine 3 tablespoons of sugar and cinnamon. Add to peaches. Spoon peach mixture over batter. Do not stir. Bake at 350° for 50 or 60 minutes or until brown. Yields 6 to 8 servings.

recipes.title: Blueberry Muffins(16 Muffins)
directions: In a mixing bowl, combine safflower oil, brown sugar, flour, baking powder, baking soda and salt.
Add buttermilk, egg, oat bran, oatmeal and wheat germ; mix lightly with a wooden spoon to moisten.
Stir in blueberries.
Fill paper-lined muffin tins 3/4 full with batter.
Bake at 400° for 20 minutes, or until toothpick inserted into center comes out dry.
Remove muffins from tins and cool on wire racks.
recipes.text: Blueberry Muffins(16 Muffins). In a mixing bowl, combine safflower oil, brown sugar, flour, baking powder, baking soda and salt. Add buttermilk, egg, oat bran, oatmeal and wheat germ; mix lightly with a wooden spoon to moisten. Stir in blueberries. Fill paper-lined muffin tins 3/4 full with batter. Bake at 400° for 20 minutes, or until toothpick inserted into center comes out dry. Remove muffins from tins and cool on wire racks.

recipes.title: Fruit Cocktail Cake
ingredients: 1 medium can fruit cocktail with juice
directions: Add all ingredients except cinnamon and mix well.
Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes.
Serve warm topped with whipped cream.
recipes.text: Fruit Cocktail Cake. Add all ingredients except cinnamon and mix well. Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes. Serve warm topped with whipped cream.

recipes.title: Uncooked 7 Minute Icing
directions: Put all ingredients into a large mixing bowl.
Add the boiling water.
Beat until it has high peaks.
Add any color food coloring you choose.
Spread on cake and set in a cool place for several hours.
recipes.text: Uncooked 7 Minute Icing. Put all ingredients into a large mixing bowl. Add the boiling water. Beat until it has high peaks. Add any color food coloring you choose. Spread on cake and set in a cool place for several hours.

recipes.title: Chocolate, Coconut Cake
directions: Prepare cake mix as directed on package.
Chop 2 squares of the chocolate into cake mix.
Bake cake in 4 layers.
recipes.text: Chocolate, Coconut Cake. Prepare cake mix as directed on package. Chop 2 squares of the chocolate into cake mix. Bake cake in 4 layers.

recipes.title: Three Cheese Chicken Enchiladas
ingredients: 2 c. cooked and cubed or shredded chicken
2 c. shredded low-fat Monterey Jack cheese, divided
directions: Place tortillas on baking sheet; place in a 350° oven for about 5 minutes.
In large bowl, stir together the sour cream and cream cheese until smooth.
Stir in salt, cumin, pepper, chicken, 1 cup Jack cheese, Cheddar cheese and green onions.
Place 1/2 cup mix in center of each tortilla.
Fold 2 edges of tortilla to overlap in center.
Place, seal side down, in a 13 x 9-inch baking pan; bake for 15 minutes.
Pour salsa over enchiladas; bake for 15 minutes.
Sprinkle remaining 1 cup Jack cheese over salsa.
Return to oven for 1 to 2 minutes.
recipes.text: Three Cheese Chicken Enchiladas. Place tortillas on baking sheet; place in a 350° oven for about 5 minutes. In large bowl, stir together the sour cream and cream cheese until smooth. Stir in salt, cumin, pepper, chicken, 1 cup Jack cheese, Cheddar cheese and green onions. Place 1/2 cup mix in center of each tortilla. Fold 2 edges of tortilla to overlap in center. Place, seal side down, in a 13 x 9-inch baking pan; bake for 15 minutes. Pour salsa over enchiladas; bake for 15 minutes. Sprinkle remaining 1 cup Jack cheese over salsa. Return to oven for 1 to 2 minutes.

recipes.title: Pregnant Pigs
directions: You will need toothpicks, if using olives.
recipes.text: Pregnant Pigs. You will need toothpicks, if using olives.

recipes.title: Old Fashioned Molasses Cookies
directions: Blend butter, eggs, brown sugar and molasses together.
Sift together flour, soda, salt, cloves, cinnamon and ginger.
Add to mixture.
Chill at least 1 hour.
recipes.text: Old Fashioned Molasses Cookies. Blend butter, eggs, brown sugar and molasses together. Sift together flour, soda, salt, cloves, cinnamon and ginger. Add to mixture. Chill at least 1 hour.

recipes.title: Cranberry Salad
directions: Dissolve Jell-O in boiling water.
Add sugar, lemon juice and pineapple syrup.
Stir to dissolve.
When cold, add other ingredients.
Chill until firm.
Best to refrigerate overnight. Serves 8.
recipes.text: Cranberry Salad. Dissolve Jell-O in boiling water. Add sugar, lemon juice and pineapple syrup. Stir to dissolve. When cold, add other ingredients. Chill until firm. Best to refrigerate overnight. Serves 8.

recipes.title: Butter Cookies
directions: Cream butter; gradually add sugar, beating until fluffy.
Stir in vanilla.
Gradually add flour.
Mix well.
Chill dough.
Shape into balls or sticks.
Place on ungreased cookie sheet and bake at 350° for 12 to 14 minutes.
recipes.text: Butter Cookies. Cream butter; gradually add sugar, beating until fluffy. Stir in vanilla. Gradually add flour. Mix well. Chill dough. Shape into balls or sticks. Place on ungreased cookie sheet and bake at 350° for 12 to 14 minutes.

recipes.title: Jambalaya
ingredients: 1 tsp. Creole seasoning or three-pepper seasoning
2 whole large chicken breasts, skinned, boned and cut into bite size pieces
directions: Cook rice according to package; set aside.
In 3-quart pan cook onion, celery, green pepper and garlic in butter or margarine until tender.
Stir in undrained tomatoes, tomato paste, sausage and Creole seasoning.
Bring to boiling; reduce heat.
Cover and simmer for 30 minutes.
Stir in chicken pieces and hot pepper sauce.
Simmer, covered, about 15 minutes or until chicken is done.
Stir in cooked rice; serve with okra.
recipes.text: Jambalaya. Cook rice according to package; set aside. In 3-quart pan cook onion, celery, green pepper and garlic in butter or margarine until tender. Stir in undrained tomatoes, tomato paste, sausage and Creole seasoning. Bring to boiling; reduce heat. Cover and simmer for 30 minutes. Stir in chicken pieces and hot pepper sauce. Simmer, covered, about 15 minutes or until chicken is done. Stir in cooked rice; serve with okra.

recipes.title: Ranger Cookies
directions: Stir dry ingredients together.
In a mixer bowl, beat butter; add sugars and beat until fluffy.
Add egg and vanilla; beat well. Add dry ingredients to beaten mixture.
Stir in oatmeal, cornflakes, coconut and pecans.
Drop from teaspoon 2 inches apart on an ungreased cookie sheet.
Bake at 375° for 8 to 10 minutes. Cool about 1 minute before removing to wire rack.
recipes.text: Ranger Cookies. Stir dry ingredients together. In a mixer bowl, beat butter; add sugars and beat until fluffy. Add egg and vanilla; beat well. Add dry ingredients to beaten mixture. Stir in oatmeal, cornflakes, coconut and pecans. Drop from teaspoon 2 inches apart on an ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 375° for 8 to 10 minutes. Cool about 1 minute before removing to wire rack.

recipes.title: Easy Spinach Lasagna
directions: In a large bowl, mix Ricotta cheese, 1 cup Mozzarella cheese, egg, spinach, oregano, salt and pepper.
recipes.text: Easy Spinach Lasagna. In a large bowl, mix Ricotta cheese, 1 cup Mozzarella cheese, egg, spinach, oregano, salt and pepper.

recipes.title: Bran Muffins
ingredients: 2 1/2 c. Bran, soaked in 2 c. milk
1 c. chopped dates or any dry fruit
directions: Cream butter; add eggs and sugar gradually.
Add dry ingredients and chopped dates.
Fill muffin cups 3/4 full.
Bake 25 to 30 minutes at 350°.
Makes 3 to 4 dozen.
Believe it or not, I get compliments every time I make these.
recipes.text: Bran Muffins. Cream butter; add eggs and sugar gradually. Add dry ingredients and chopped dates. Fill muffin cups 3/4 full. Bake 25 to 30 minutes at 350°. Makes 3 to 4 dozen. Believe it or not, I get compliments every time I make these.

recipes.title: Bread Pudding
directions: Toast bread; spread with butter.
Mix all ingredients but 2 tablespoons sugar and cinnamon.
Put toast in a buttered dish. Pour milk mixture over toast; let stand 10 minutes.
Sprinkle sugar and cinnamon over top.
Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes.
recipes.text: Bread Pudding. Toast bread; spread with butter. Mix all ingredients but 2 tablespoons sugar and cinnamon. Put toast in a buttered dish. Pour milk mixture over toast; let stand 10 minutes. Sprinkle sugar and cinnamon over top. Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Fresh Lemonade
directions: Combine sugar and 2 cups of water in saucepan; bring to a boil, stirring until sugar dissolves.
Add to remaining water and lemon juice.
Chill and serve over ice.
Garnish, if desired. Yields 2 1/2 quarts.
recipes.text: Fresh Lemonade. Combine sugar and 2 cups of water in saucepan; bring to a boil, stirring until sugar dissolves. Add to remaining water and lemon juice. Chill and serve over ice. Garnish, if desired. Yields 2 1/2 quarts.

recipes.title: Enchilada Casserole
directions: Brown ground chuck, onion and garlic.
Drain.
Add tomatoes, tomato sauce, taco mix, chili powder, salt and pepper.
Line bottom of 9 x 13 dish with 1/2 tortillas.
Place 1/2 mixture on top and then layer other tortillas and other 1/2 of mixture.
Add can of soup on top of this, then milk and sprinkle with cheese. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Enchilada Casserole. Brown ground chuck, onion and garlic. Drain. Add tomatoes, tomato sauce, taco mix, chili powder, salt and pepper. Line bottom of 9 x 13 dish with 1/2 tortillas. Place 1/2 mixture on top and then layer other tortillas and other 1/2 of mixture. Add can of soup on top of this, then milk and sprinkle with cheese. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Dark Chocolate Turtles
directions: Combine the caramels with milk
in
the top of a double boiler and heat until caramels are melted.
You can do this in the microwave too, at High for about 3 to 4 minutes, stirring often. Beat
with
a
wooden
spoon
until
creamy.
Stir
in pecans. Drop by spoonfuls onto a sheet of buttered wax paper. Let set for 15 minutes.
recipes.text: Dark Chocolate Turtles. Combine the caramels with milk in the top of a double boiler and heat until caramels are melted. You can do this in the microwave too, at High for about 3 to 4 minutes, stirring often. Beat with a wooden spoon until creamy. Stir in pecans. Drop by spoonfuls onto a sheet of buttered wax paper. Let set for 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Chocolate Delight
directions: Mix butter, flour and nuts.
Grease pan with butter and bake 10 to 15 minutes at 300°.
Cool.
recipes.text: Chocolate Delight. Mix butter, flour and nuts. Grease pan with butter and bake 10 to 15 minutes at 300°. Cool.

recipes.title: Lemon Jello
directions: Dissolve jello and sugar in boiling water.
Add frozen lemonade and stir until dissolved.
Refrigerate for exactly 20 minutes (no more, no less).
Remove from refrigerator and beat in Cool Whip.
Pour into large mold or bowl.
The jello will separate into 2 layers.
recipes.text: Lemon Jello. Dissolve jello and sugar in boiling water. Add frozen lemonade and stir until dissolved. Refrigerate for exactly 20 minutes (no more, no less). Remove from refrigerator and beat in Cool Whip. Pour into large mold or bowl. The jello will separate into 2 layers.

recipes.title: Sandy'S Mexican Dip
directions: Brown ground meat and drain. Add taco seasoning to ground meat. Layer beef on bottom of casserole. Combine softened cream cheese and sour cream. Spread cheese mixture on top of meat.
