Sprinkle with chopped green pepper and onion. Top with shredded Cheddar cheese and olives. Bake at 350° until warm and cheese is melted. Serve with tortilla chips.
recipes.text: Sandy'S Mexican Dip. Brown ground meat and drain. Add taco seasoning to ground meat. Layer beef on bottom of casserole. Combine softened cream cheese and sour cream. Spread cheese mixture on top of meat. Sprinkle with chopped green pepper and onion. Top with shredded Cheddar cheese and olives. Bake at 350° until warm and cheese is melted. Serve with tortilla chips.

recipes.title: Happy Home Recipe
directions: By Helen Steiner Rice.
recipes.text: Happy Home Recipe. By Helen Steiner Rice.

recipes.title: Pizza Rounds
directions: Brown meat; drain fat.
Add cheese; stir until it melts.
Add seasonings; mix thoroughly.
Spread on bread while warm.
Place under broiler for a few minutes before serving.
These are excellent to make and freeze ahead of time.
They can also be put on regular rye and used for a meal.
recipes.text: Pizza Rounds. Brown meat; drain fat. Add cheese; stir until it melts. Add seasonings; mix thoroughly. Spread on bread while warm. Place under broiler for a few minutes before serving. These are excellent to make and freeze ahead of time. They can also be put on regular rye and used for a meal.

recipes.title: Coffee Can Pumpkin Bread
directions: Mix all dry ingredients.
Add all liquids and pumpkin.
Stir until smooth.
Grease and flour four 1 pound coffee cans.
Fill half full with batter.
Bake at 325° for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Coffee Can Pumpkin Bread. Mix all dry ingredients. Add all liquids and pumpkin. Stir until smooth. Grease and flour four 1 pound coffee cans. Fill half full with batter. Bake at 325° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Taco Stew
directions: Cook ground meat, chilies and onion in a large pot until the meat has lost its pink color.
Add the rest of the ingredients and simmer for 30 to 40 minutes or longer.
recipes.text: Taco Stew. Cook ground meat, chilies and onion in a large pot until the meat has lost its pink color. Add the rest of the ingredients and simmer for 30 to 40 minutes or longer.

recipes.title: Spice Cake
directions: Combine all ingredients.
Mix well.
Pour into 3 greased and floured cake pans.
Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes.
recipes.text: Spice Cake. Combine all ingredients. Mix well. Pour into 3 greased and floured cake pans. Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Scalloped Pineapple
ingredients: 7 slices bread, tear into small pieces
directions: Mix everything together and bake 35 to 40 minutes at 350°.
recipes.text: Scalloped Pineapple. Mix everything together and bake 35 to 40 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Creamy Lemon Pie
ingredients: 2 pkg. vanilla flavor instant pudding and pie filling
1 (6 oz.) can frozen lemonade concentrate, thawed
1 pie crust, baked or graham cracker crust
directions: Pour milk in large bowl. Add pudding mixes. Beat with whisk 30 seconds. Add lemonade. Beat 30 seconds more (mixture will be thick). Stir in whipped topping. Spoon into baked crust. Refrigerate 4 hours or until set. Garnish with lemon slices, if desired. Store leftover pie in refrigerator.
recipes.text: Creamy Lemon Pie. Pour milk in large bowl. Add pudding mixes. Beat with whisk 30 seconds. Add lemonade. Beat 30 seconds more (mixture will be thick). Stir in whipped topping. Spoon into baked crust. Refrigerate 4 hours or until set. Garnish with lemon slices, if desired. Store leftover pie in refrigerator.

recipes.title: Peach Almond Cream Tart
ingredients: 1 (21 oz.) can peach filling and topping
directions: Preheat oven to 375°.
Bake pastry shell 15 minutes. Meanwhile, in a medium bowl, combine condensed milk, sour cream, lemon juice and almond extract and mix well.
Reserving 6 sliced peaches, spread remaining peach filling on bottom of prepared pastry shell.
Top with sour cream mixture.
Top with reserved peach slices and almonds.
Bake 30 minutes or until set.
Cool. Chill.
Refrigerate leftovers.
recipes.text: Peach Almond Cream Tart. Preheat oven to 375°. Bake pastry shell 15 minutes. Meanwhile, in a medium bowl, combine condensed milk, sour cream, lemon juice and almond extract and mix well. Reserving 6 sliced peaches, spread remaining peach filling on bottom of prepared pastry shell. Top with sour cream mixture. Top with reserved peach slices and almonds. Bake 30 minutes or until set. Cool. Chill. Refrigerate leftovers.

recipes.title: Polish Potato Pancakes
directions: Combine ingredients and beat well.
Using large spoon, drop on hot frying pan and fry both sides in corn oil.
Makes 8 to 10 pancakes.
recipes.text: Polish Potato Pancakes. Combine ingredients and beat well. Using large spoon, drop on hot frying pan and fry both sides in corn oil. Makes 8 to 10 pancakes.

recipes.title: Forgotten Cookies
directions: Preheat oven to 350°.
Beat egg whites stiff, gradually adding sugar, salt and vanilla.
Fold in nuts and chocolate chips.
Drop by spoonfuls onto cookie sheet.
Turn off oven.
Place cookies into oven and close door.
Leave undisturbed overnight.
recipes.text: Forgotten Cookies. Preheat oven to 350°. Beat egg whites stiff, gradually adding sugar, salt and vanilla. Fold in nuts and chocolate chips. Drop by spoonfuls onto cookie sheet. Turn off oven. Place cookies into oven and close door. Leave undisturbed overnight.

recipes.title: Hamburger Casserole
directions: Brown beef and onion, add peppers.
Mix eggs, milk and oil. Add bread mix and corn.
Pour half of batter into 9 x 13-inch baking dish.
Spread meat mixture, sprinkle cheese.
Add rest of batter.
Bake in preheated 350° oven approximately 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Hamburger Casserole. Brown beef and onion, add peppers. Mix eggs, milk and oil. Add bread mix and corn. Pour half of batter into 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Spread meat mixture, sprinkle cheese. Add rest of batter. Bake in preheated 350° oven approximately 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Buttermilk Pound Cake
directions: Cream oleo,
Crisco and 2 cups sugar well.
Reserve 1/2 cup sugar for
egg
whites.
Add 1 egg yolk at a time, beating well after each.
Sift and measure flour;
add salt and baking powder. Add
soda
to
buttermilk and dissolve.
Begin adding flour mixture and add alternately with buttermilk, ending with flour. Add
flavoring.
Beat
egg	whites	and
1/2 cup sugar until stiff peaks form.
Fold into cake mixture.
Bake in tube pan at 325° for 1 1/2 hours.
recipes.text: Buttermilk Pound Cake. Cream oleo, Crisco and 2 cups sugar well. Reserve 1/2 cup sugar for egg whites. Add 1 egg yolk at a time, beating well after each. Sift and measure flour; add salt and baking powder. Add soda to buttermilk and dissolve. Begin adding flour mixture and add alternately with buttermilk, ending with flour. Add flavoring. Beat egg	whites	and 1/2 cup sugar until stiff peaks form. Fold into cake mixture. Bake in tube pan at 325° for 1 1/2 hours.

recipes.title: Mexi Dip
directions: Layer all ingredients and serve cold.
recipes.text: Mexi Dip. Layer all ingredients and serve cold.

recipes.title: Stuffed Boneless Chicken Breasts
directions: Split the breasts and stuff with broccoli and shredded cheese. Sprinkle with paprika. Bake at 400° for 1 hour and 15 minutes.
recipes.text: Stuffed Boneless Chicken Breasts. Split the breasts and stuff with broccoli and shredded cheese. Sprinkle with paprika. Bake at 400° for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Banana Waffles
directions: Mix flour, baking powder, lemon rind and salt in a large bowl. Beat egg yolks, milk, melted butter and mashed bananas together in a bowl.
Add all at once to dry mixture; stir just enough to moisten.
Beat egg whites until stiff but not dry; fold into batter.
Let batter stand for 5 to 10 minutes to develop banana flavor.
Bake in waffle iron according to manufacturer's directions.
Serve with Apricot-Banana Sauce.
Yields 4 large waffles.
recipes.text: Banana Waffles. Mix flour, baking powder, lemon rind and salt in a large bowl. Beat egg yolks, milk, melted butter and mashed bananas together in a bowl. Add all at once to dry mixture; stir just enough to moisten. Beat egg whites until stiff but not dry; fold into batter. Let batter stand for 5 to 10 minutes to develop banana flavor. Bake in waffle iron according to manufacturer's directions. Serve with Apricot-Banana Sauce. Yields 4 large waffles.

recipes.title: Quiche Lorraine
ingredients: 2 c. whipping cream or half and half
directions: Sprinkle bacon, cheese and onion in unbaked 9-inch pie shell. In a bowl, add the rest of the ingredients and mix well.
Pour over the bacon and cheese mixture.
Bake in a 400° oven for 15 minutes.
Reduce temperature to 300° and bake 30 minutes longer or until knife inserted 1-inch from edge comes out clean.
Let stand 10 minutes; cut into wedges and serve.
recipes.text: Quiche Lorraine. Sprinkle bacon, cheese and onion in unbaked 9-inch pie shell. In a bowl, add the rest of the ingredients and mix well. Pour over the bacon and cheese mixture. Bake in a 400° oven for 15 minutes. Reduce temperature to 300° and bake 30 minutes longer or until knife inserted 1-inch from edge comes out clean. Let stand 10 minutes; cut into wedges and serve.

recipes.title: Chicken Picante
directions: Butterfly chicken breasts or pound to even thickness, about 1/2-inch thick.
Season with salt, pepper, garlic powder, chili powder and rosemary.
Heat oil to medium-high in frypan and cook each side of chicken, about 1 minute.
Set chicken aside and keep warm.
In same pan, add picante and Worcestershire sauce.
Simmer until mixture is reduced in half.
On sheet pan, arrange chicken. Cover each piece with cooked picante mixture and top with cheese. Place under broiler until cheese bubbles and is brown.
Serve with yellow or Spanish rice.
recipes.text: Chicken Picante. Butterfly chicken breasts or pound to even thickness, about 1/2-inch thick. Season with salt, pepper, garlic powder, chili powder and rosemary. Heat oil to medium-high in frypan and cook each side of chicken, about 1 minute. Set chicken aside and keep warm. In same pan, add picante and Worcestershire sauce. Simmer until mixture is reduced in half. On sheet pan, arrange chicken. Cover each piece with cooked picante mixture and top with cheese. Place under broiler until cheese bubbles and is brown. Serve with yellow or Spanish rice.

recipes.title: Vegetable Soup
directions: In a large pan, cook meat until tender, 2 to 3 hours.
When cool, cut up meat in small pieces.
Add back to broth the meat, potatoes, carrots and onion and cook until tender.
Add peas, corn and tomatoes.
Cook on low heat for about 30 minutes.
Use salt and pepper as you like.
You can use some tomato juice if soup gets too thick.
Left over beef roast makes good soup, too.
recipes.text: Vegetable Soup. In a large pan, cook meat until tender, 2 to 3 hours. When cool, cut up meat in small pieces. Add back to broth the meat, potatoes, carrots and onion and cook until tender. Add peas, corn and tomatoes. Cook on low heat for about 30 minutes. Use salt and pepper as you like. You can use some tomato juice if soup gets too thick. Left over beef roast makes good soup, too.

recipes.title: Nancy'S Zucchini Bread
ingredients: 3 eggs, beaten until light and fluffy
directions: To beaten eggs, add sugar, oil and vanilla.
Stir in zucchini. Add remaining ingredients.
Blend.
Turn into greased and floured loaf pans (2).
Bake 1 hour at 350°.
recipes.text: Nancy'S Zucchini Bread. To beaten eggs, add sugar, oil and vanilla. Stir in zucchini. Add remaining ingredients. Blend. Turn into greased and floured loaf pans (2). Bake 1 hour at 350°.

recipes.title: Shrimp Butter
directions: Whip cream cheese and butter together.
Rinse and drain cans of shrimp.
Add all ingredients and blend well.
Use on crackers or bread.
recipes.text: Shrimp Butter. Whip cream cheese and butter together. Rinse and drain cans of shrimp. Add all ingredients and blend well. Use on crackers or bread.

recipes.title: Nifty Nachos
directions: Preheat oven to 400°.
Spread tortillas in single layer in a 15 x 10 x 1-inch baking pan or 12 inch pizza pan.
Sprinkle shredded cheese over chips.
Bake for 2 to 3 minutes, until cheese melts.
Dip chips in salsa.
recipes.text: Nifty Nachos. Preheat oven to 400°. Spread tortillas in single layer in a 15 x 10 x 1-inch baking pan or 12 inch pizza pan. Sprinkle shredded cheese over chips. Bake for 2 to 3 minutes, until cheese melts. Dip chips in salsa.

recipes.title: Oatmeal Cookies
directions: Blend sugars, egg and water.
Add vanilla.
Next, add all dry ingredients.
Add oatmeal.
Next, add raisins and chopped almonds. Bake at 350° for 12 to 15 minutes.
recipes.text: Oatmeal Cookies. Blend sugars, egg and water. Add vanilla. Next, add all dry ingredients. Add oatmeal. Next, add raisins and chopped almonds. Bake at 350° for 12 to 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Creamy Vegetable Soup
ingredients: 3 medium sweet potatoes, peeled and chopped
2 medium Irish potatoes, peeled and shredded
directions: In a large kettle, saute onion in oleo until transparent but not browned.
Add the sweet potatoes, zucchini and broccoli. Saute lightly for 5 minutes or until crisp-tender.
Stir in broth; simmer for a few minutes.
Add Irish potatoes and seasonings. Cook another 10 minutes.
Stir in cream and heat through.
recipes.text: Creamy Vegetable Soup. In a large kettle, saute onion in oleo until transparent but not browned. Add the sweet potatoes, zucchini and broccoli. Saute lightly for 5 minutes or until crisp-tender. Stir in broth; simmer for a few minutes. Add Irish potatoes and seasonings. Cook another 10 minutes. Stir in cream and heat through.

recipes.title: Cold Tortellini Salad
directions: Boil tortellini until soft (longer than package directions). Drain and chill.
Add rest of ingredients and stir well.
Serve cold.
recipes.text: Cold Tortellini Salad. Boil tortellini until soft (longer than package directions). Drain and chill. Add rest of ingredients and stir well. Serve cold.

recipes.title: Raspberry Salad
directions: 1. In a mixing bowl combine hot water and jello. Stir until jello is completely dissolved.
2. Add raspberries and applesauce. Stir until mixed
throughly.
3. Refrigerate overnight then top with cool whip and
serve the next day.
recipes.text: Raspberry Salad. 1. In a mixing bowl combine hot water and jello. Stir until jello is completely dissolved. 2. Add raspberries and applesauce. Stir until mixed throughly. 3. Refrigerate overnight then top with cool whip and serve the next day.

recipes.title: Egg Nog
directions: Beat eggs in blender for 30 seconds; add sugar and beat 30 seconds.
Add milk; beat again for 30 seconds.
Then add vanilla and nutmeg; beat for 30 seconds longer.
Makes 2 quarts.
recipes.text: Egg Nog. Beat eggs in blender for 30 seconds; add sugar and beat 30 seconds. Add milk; beat again for 30 seconds. Then add vanilla and nutmeg; beat for 30 seconds longer. Makes 2 quarts.

recipes.title: Marshmallow Meringue
directions: Cut marshmallows in quarters if large and place with milk in saucepan.
Cook over low heat, folding over and over until marshmallow are melted down to about half their original size. Remove from heat.
Add vanilla and continue folding until mixture is smooth, yet light and spongy.
Beat egg whites until stiff.
Add salt and sugar slowly, beating constantly.
Carefully fold in slightly warm marshmallow mixture.
Pile on pie, pudding or cake. Place under broiler 3 inches from heat for 30 seconds or until meringue is a delicate brown.
recipes.text: Marshmallow Meringue. Cut marshmallows in quarters if large and place with milk in saucepan. Cook over low heat, folding over and over until marshmallow are melted down to about half their original size. Remove from heat. Add vanilla and continue folding until mixture is smooth, yet light and spongy. Beat egg whites until stiff. Add salt and sugar slowly, beating constantly. Carefully fold in slightly warm marshmallow mixture. Pile on pie, pudding or cake. Place under broiler 3 inches from heat for 30 seconds or until meringue is a delicate brown.

recipes.title: Caramel Candy
ingredients: 3 c. nuts (pecans, Brazil nuts and almonds)
directions: Put sugar, cream and syrup in a large saucepan; bring to a boil, stirring constantly, until mixture forms soft ball in cold water.
Remove from heat and add vanilla and nuts.
Beat until stiff and pour in buttered platter.
Slice.
recipes.text: Caramel Candy. Put sugar, cream and syrup in a large saucepan; bring to a boil, stirring constantly, until mixture forms soft ball in cold water. Remove from heat and add vanilla and nuts. Beat until stiff and pour in buttered platter. Slice.

recipes.title: Cool Cucumber Pasta
directions: Cook pasta according to package directions. Drain and rinse in cold water. Place in large bowl. Stir in oil, cucumbers and onion. Combine remaining ingredients. Pour over salad and toss. Cover and chill 3 to 4 hours, stirring occasionally. Makes 8 to 10 servings.
recipes.text: Cool Cucumber Pasta. Cook pasta according to package directions. Drain and rinse in cold water. Place in large bowl. Stir in oil, cucumbers and onion. Combine remaining ingredients. Pour over salad and toss. Cover and chill 3 to 4 hours, stirring occasionally. Makes 8 to 10 servings.

recipes.title: Taco Dip
ingredients: 1 bar Cracker Barrel sharp Cheddar cheese
directions: In skillet, brown chopped meat, adding seasoning packet. Drain excess oil.
Let cool!
recipes.text: Taco Dip. In skillet, brown chopped meat, adding seasoning packet. Drain excess oil. Let cool!

recipes.title: Chicken Loaf(Yield:  18 Servings)
directions: Make white sauce of the stock, milk, flour and oleo.
Combine all ingredients.
Pack well into loaf pans; set loaf pans in pan of hot water and bake at 350° for 45 minutes to 1 hour.
Let stand 20 minutes before slicing.
Serve with rich chicken gravy.
recipes.text: Chicken Loaf(Yield:  18 Servings). Make white sauce of the stock, milk, flour and oleo. Combine all ingredients. Pack well into loaf pans; set loaf pans in pan of hot water and bake at 350° for 45 minutes to 1 hour. Let stand 20 minutes before slicing. Serve with rich chicken gravy.

recipes.title: Pickled Eggs And Beets
directions: Drain liquid from beets in a saucepan; add sugar and vinegar. Heat to boiling.
Place shelled eggs, beets and onion in a large bowl.
Pour hot beet juice mixture on top.
Cover and refrigerate for 2 days.
Makes a great side dish for Easter dinner.
recipes.text: Pickled Eggs And Beets. Drain liquid from beets in a saucepan; add sugar and vinegar. Heat to boiling. Place shelled eggs, beets and onion in a large bowl. Pour hot beet juice mixture on top. Cover and refrigerate for 2 days. Makes a great side dish for Easter dinner.

recipes.title: Buttermilk Pie
directions: Have butter soft.
Add sugar and cream together well.
Add flour and eggs; beat well.
Stir in buttermilk and vanilla.
Pour into unbaked pie shell.
Bake for 45 to 50 minutes at 350°.
Cool completely before serving.
recipes.text: Buttermilk Pie. Have butter soft. Add sugar and cream together well. Add flour and eggs; beat well. Stir in buttermilk and vanilla. Pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake for 45 to 50 minutes at 350°. Cool completely before serving.

recipes.title: Keebler Cracker Cookies
directions: Layer a jelly roll pan with crackers.
Mix together on stove, sugar, brown sugar, margarine and milk.
Melt, then add 2 cups graham cracker crumbs.
Boil 6 to 7 minutes, stirring constantly. Pour half of mixture over crackers.
Add another layer of crackers and pour remaining ingredients over them.
Cool in refrigerator one hour.
Melt together peanut butter and chocolate chips.
Pour over top and refrigerate.
When chocolate is set, cut into squares.
recipes.text: Keebler Cracker Cookies. Layer a jelly roll pan with crackers. Mix together on stove, sugar, brown sugar, margarine and milk. Melt, then add 2 cups graham cracker crumbs. Boil 6 to 7 minutes, stirring constantly. Pour half of mixture over crackers. Add another layer of crackers and pour remaining ingredients over them. Cool in refrigerator one hour. Melt together peanut butter and chocolate chips. Pour over top and refrigerate. When chocolate is set, cut into squares.

recipes.title: Pink Delite
directions: Fold together; chill for 2 hours.
recipes.text: Pink Delite. Fold together; chill for 2 hours.

recipes.title: Broccoli Casserole
directions: Cook broccoli a little until unthawed; drain.
Add to remaining ingredients which have been mixed together well.
Put in a large casserole dish and cover.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Broccoli Casserole. Cook broccoli a little until unthawed; drain. Add to remaining ingredients which have been mixed together well. Put in a large casserole dish and cover. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Squash Pie
directions: Peel squash, remove seeds, cut in pieces.
Boil in salt water, add butter	and
sugar until soft.	Beat in mixer well, remove beater and	rinse
under water to wash out any strings. Add butter and
sugar,
beat again until light.
Add eggs, one at a time, then
add
milk,
nutmeg,
cinnamon,
orange peel, vanilla and lemon extract.
Bake in crust at 350° until brown. (Bake on cookie sheet
if preferred.) Add 1 small box raisins for variety.
recipes.text: Squash Pie. Peel squash, remove seeds, cut in pieces. Boil in salt water, add butter	and sugar until soft.	Beat in mixer well, remove beater and	rinse under water to wash out any strings. Add butter and sugar, beat again until light. Add eggs, one at a time, then add milk, nutmeg, cinnamon, orange peel, vanilla and lemon extract. Bake in crust at 350° until brown. (Bake on cookie sheet if preferred.) Add 1 small box raisins for variety.

recipes.title: Pina Colada Cake
ingredients: 1 box yellow cake mix with pudding in mix
directions: Prepare cake mix as directed.
Cook in greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan.
Leaving cake in pan, pour Eagle Brand milk, cream of coconut (mix cream of coconut well) and crushed pineapple (including juice) over cake.
Let cake cool, then top with Cool Whip.
Sprinkle with coconut; decorate with cherries.
Refrigerate overnight.
recipes.text: Pina Colada Cake. Prepare cake mix as directed. Cook in greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan. Leaving cake in pan, pour Eagle Brand milk, cream of coconut (mix cream of coconut well) and crushed pineapple (including juice) over cake. Let cake cool, then top with Cool Whip. Sprinkle with coconut; decorate with cherries. Refrigerate overnight.

recipes.title: Roast Beef 'N Swiss Tortilla Roll-Ups
ingredients: 2 large leaf lettuce leaves, torn to fit tortilla
4 oz. thinly sliced deli roast beef
4 (3/4 oz.) slices pasteurized process Swiss cheese
directions: Spread 1 tablespoon salad dressing on each tortilla, covering entire surface.
Top each with lettuce leaf and half of roast beef, cheese and onion.
Roll up each tortilla tightly.
recipes.text: Roast Beef 'N Swiss Tortilla Roll-Ups. Spread 1 tablespoon salad dressing on each tortilla, covering entire surface. Top each with lettuce leaf and half of roast beef, cheese and onion. Roll up each tortilla tightly.

recipes.title: Scotch Eggs
directions: Boil eggs and set aside.
Divide sausage into 6 portions; roll each egg in flour and with hands, press portion of the sausage around egg.
Dip sausage wrapped eggs into beaten eggs and roll in bread crumbs.
Heat oil to 350°; cook each egg in oil for 4 to 5 minutes.
Drain on paper towel.
recipes.text: Scotch Eggs. Boil eggs and set aside. Divide sausage into 6 portions; roll each egg in flour and with hands, press portion of the sausage around egg. Dip sausage wrapped eggs into beaten eggs and roll in bread crumbs. Heat oil to 350°; cook each egg in oil for 4 to 5 minutes. Drain on paper towel.

recipes.title: Barbecued Short Ribs
ingredients: 3 lb. short ribs, cut into serving pieces
directions: Saute short ribs and onion in hot fat until brown.
Combine remaining ingredients and pour over ribs.
Cover and cook slowly for 2 hours.
Makes 4 to 5 servings.
recipes.text: Barbecued Short Ribs. Saute short ribs and onion in hot fat until brown. Combine remaining ingredients and pour over ribs. Cover and cook slowly for 2 hours. Makes 4 to 5 servings.

recipes.title: Granny'S Chicken And Dumplings
directions: Mix dry ingredients together, then add shortening. Mix until it's a cornmeal type texture.
Add egg and enough water to make it "a little wetter than pie crust dough." Roll out onto floured board and cut into squares.
Drop into boiling chicken and broth. Add salt and black pepper to taste and thicken broth with more flour.
Dumplings should be ready in 10 to 15 minutes.
recipes.text: Granny'S Chicken And Dumplings. Mix dry ingredients together, then add shortening. Mix until it's a cornmeal type texture. Add egg and enough water to make it "a little wetter than pie crust dough." Roll out onto floured board and cut into squares. Drop into boiling chicken and broth. Add salt and black pepper to taste and thicken broth with more flour. Dumplings should be ready in 10 to 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Elegant Crab Meat Balls
directions: Drain and flake crabmeat; combine with remaining ingredients except bacon.
Mix well.
Shape into walnut size balls.
Wrap with bacon; secure with toothpicks.
Broil under medium heat until bacon is crisp, about 10 minutes, turning to brown evenly.
Garnish with parsley and lemon.
Makes about 2 dozen.
recipes.text: Elegant Crab Meat Balls. Drain and flake crabmeat; combine with remaining ingredients except bacon. Mix well. Shape into walnut size balls. Wrap with bacon; secure with toothpicks. Broil under medium heat until bacon is crisp, about 10 minutes, turning to brown evenly. Garnish with parsley and lemon. Makes about 2 dozen.

recipes.title: 4 Layer Chocolate Pie
ingredients: 1 large box Jell-O instant chocolate pudding
directions: Melt butter.
Add chopped pecans and flour.
Mix well and pat in baking dish.
Bake 1 hour at 125° to 150°.
Mix cream cheese, confectioners sugar and approximately 1/3 bowl of Cool Whip.
Beat until smooth.
Mix Jell-O instant chocolate pudding. Pour cream cheese mix on baked crusty layer.
Add the next layer of chocolate pudding.
Top with the remainder of Cool Whip.
recipes.text: 4 Layer Chocolate Pie. Melt butter. Add chopped pecans and flour. Mix well and pat in baking dish. Bake 1 hour at 125° to 150°. Mix cream cheese, confectioners sugar and approximately 1/3 bowl of Cool Whip. Beat until smooth. Mix Jell-O instant chocolate pudding. Pour cream cheese mix on baked crusty layer. Add the next layer of chocolate pudding. Top with the remainder of Cool Whip.

recipes.title: Lowfat Chicken And Rice Primavera
ingredients: 3 c. cooked and chopped chicken breasts
1 (14.5 oz.) can Italian diced tomatoes, drained (reserve liquid)
1 (15 oz.) can mixed vegetables, drained (reserve liquid)
1 (10 3/4 oz.) can reduced fat cream of mushroom soup
3/4 c. reduced fat shredded Cheddar cheese
directions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees. Pour the uncooked rice in the bottom of a 9x13x2 inch baking pan. Layer the chicken over the rice.
Add the drained tomatoes and vegetables. Combine the liquid from the tomatoes and vegetables with enough chicken broth to make 2 1/2 cups of liquid.
Add this to the mushroom soup and heat. Pour this mixture over the vegetables.
Sprinkle the cheese over top of the casserole.
Bake for about 35 minutes.
Makes 10 generous servings.
Less than 4 grams of fat per serving.
recipes.text: Lowfat Chicken And Rice Primavera. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees. Pour the uncooked rice in the bottom of a 9x13x2 inch baking pan. Layer the chicken over the rice. Add the drained tomatoes and vegetables. Combine the liquid from the tomatoes and vegetables with enough chicken broth to make 2 1/2 cups of liquid. Add this to the mushroom soup and heat. Pour this mixture over the vegetables. Sprinkle the cheese over top of the casserole. Bake for about 35 minutes. Makes 10 generous servings. Less than 4 grams of fat per serving.

recipes.title: Chili
ingredients: 1/4 tsp. chili powder (or more if you wish)
directions: Cut up onion and
brown in butter.
Add hamburger; stir and cook until no longer red.
Add tomato juice and salt.
Cook slowly, about 1/2 hour.
Add kidney beans.
Break up and add spaghetti.
Cook slowly until soft.
Add water, if necessary.
Add chili powder last.
Allow about 1 hour or longer to make, stirring occasionally.
Can be reheated or can be frozen for later use.
recipes.text: Chili. Cut up onion and brown in butter. Add hamburger; stir and cook until no longer red. Add tomato juice and salt. Cook slowly, about 1/2 hour. Add kidney beans. Break up and add spaghetti. Cook slowly until soft. Add water, if necessary. Add chili powder last. Allow about 1 hour or longer to make, stirring occasionally. Can be reheated or can be frozen for later use.

recipes.title: Vegetable Pizza
ingredients: garlic and onion salt to taste
directions: Spread crescent roll dough out flat on large cookie sheet, making an edge up sides.
Bake as directed on package; cool.
recipes.text: Vegetable Pizza. Spread crescent roll dough out flat on large cookie sheet, making an edge up sides. Bake as directed on package; cool.

recipes.title: Delicious Pork Chops
directions: Spread pork chops with prepared mustard, salt and pepper; roll into flour.
Brown.
Put in baking dish and add 1 can chicken gumbo soup and 1/2 can water.
Bake 45 minutes at 350°.
recipes.text: Delicious Pork Chops. Spread pork chops with prepared mustard, salt and pepper; roll into flour. Brown. Put in baking dish and add 1 can chicken gumbo soup and 1/2 can water. Bake 45 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Bread
directions: Cream oil and sugar.
Add spices, eggs and vanilla; mix.
Add flour, baking powder and soda; mix.
Add pumpkin; mix.
Add nuts; mix.
Pour into 3 greased and floured coffee cans.
Fill half full.
Bake at 325° for 1 hour.
Remove from cans when cool. Slice and serve.
recipes.text: Pumpkin Bread. Cream oil and sugar. Add spices, eggs and vanilla; mix. Add flour, baking powder and soda; mix. Add pumpkin; mix. Add nuts; mix. Pour into 3 greased and floured coffee cans. Fill half full. Bake at 325° for 1 hour. Remove from cans when cool. Slice and serve.

recipes.title: Cranberry Sauce
directions: Combine all ingredients, except cranberries.
Bring to a boil. Add cranberries and bring to a boil again.
Simmer for 10 minutes.
Let stand at room temperature until jellied.
(Buy extra cranberries and put in freezer.)
recipes.text: Cranberry Sauce. Combine all ingredients, except cranberries. Bring to a boil. Add cranberries and bring to a boil again. Simmer for 10 minutes. Let stand at room temperature until jellied. (Buy extra cranberries and put in freezer.)

recipes.title: Applesauce Cake
directions: Cream the margarine.
Gradually add sugars.
Add beaten eggs. Stir well.
Add dry ingredients to creamed mixture, alternating with applesauce.
Grease and flour bread loaf pan.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes or until done.
Cool in pan.
recipes.text: Applesauce Cake. Cream the margarine. Gradually add sugars. Add beaten eggs. Stir well. Add dry ingredients to creamed mixture, alternating with applesauce. Grease and flour bread loaf pan. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes or until done. Cool in pan.

recipes.title: Party Tortillas
directions: Mix the first 6 ingredients; spread on tortillas.
Roll tortillas and refrigerate overnight.
Slice into bite size slices. Serve with picante sauce.
recipes.text: Party Tortillas. Mix the first 6 ingredients; spread on tortillas. Roll tortillas and refrigerate overnight. Slice into bite size slices. Serve with picante sauce.

recipes.title: Tahiti Salad
ingredients: 1 c. whole kernel corn with sweet peppers
directions: Put together and mix.
ner: whole kernel corn with sweet peppers
recipes.text: Tahiti Salad. Put together and mix.

recipes.title: Egg Nog
directions: For best results, use a blender or hand shaker.
Blend all 30 to 60 seconds.
Pour into 2 glasses.
Garnish with nutmeg.
recipes.text: Egg Nog. For best results, use a blender or hand shaker. Blend all 30 to 60 seconds. Pour into 2 glasses. Garnish with nutmeg.

recipes.title: Creamy Potato Salad
directions: In a covered saucepan, cook potatoes in boiling water for 20 to 25 minutes or until just tender; drain well.
Peel and cube potatoes.
recipes.text: Creamy Potato Salad. In a covered saucepan, cook potatoes in boiling water for 20 to 25 minutes or until just tender; drain well. Peel and cube potatoes.

recipes.title: Green Punch
directions: Mix ingredients in gallon container.
Finish with water to make 1 gallon.
recipes.text: Green Punch. Mix ingredients in gallon container. Finish with water to make 1 gallon.

recipes.title: Quick And Easy Breakfast Casserole
directions: Tear bread into pieces and place on greased baking dish (13 x 9 x 2-inch).
Brown sausage in skillet, then drain off fat.
Cut links in slices.
Spoon sausage over bread.
Sprinkle with grated Cheddar.
Beat together eggs, milk, dry mustard, salt and pepper. Pour over mixture in baking dish.
Bake in preheated 350° oven for 35 to 40 minutes.
Cheese will rise to top during baking.
This can be prepared the night before.
Cover and refrigerate. Breakfast cooks without effort.
recipes.text: Quick And Easy Breakfast Casserole. Tear bread into pieces and place on greased baking dish (13 x 9 x 2-inch). Brown sausage in skillet, then drain off fat. Cut links in slices. Spoon sausage over bread. Sprinkle with grated Cheddar. Beat together eggs, milk, dry mustard, salt and pepper. Pour over mixture in baking dish. Bake in preheated 350° oven for 35 to 40 minutes. Cheese will rise to top during baking. This can be prepared the night before. Cover and refrigerate. Breakfast cooks without effort.

recipes.title: Corn Bread
directions: Bake at 365° until done.
recipes.text: Corn Bread. Bake at 365° until done.

recipes.title: Crystal Garden
directions: Note: Bluing may be hard to find.
Look in laundry section of grocery store.
Blue bottle next to starch and bleach products.
recipes.text: Crystal Garden. Note: Bluing may be hard to find. Look in laundry section of grocery store. Blue bottle next to starch and bleach products.

recipes.title: French Dressing
ingredients: 2 Tbsp. brandy or 1/4 tsp. brandy extract (Cointreau, Kahlua, Grand Marnier, etc. may be substituted)
directions: Heat cream until bubbles begin to form around edge.
Remove from heat and add chocolate.
Stir gently until mixture is smooth and shiny.
Stir in brandy.
recipes.text: French Dressing. Heat cream until bubbles begin to form around edge. Remove from heat and add chocolate. Stir gently until mixture is smooth and shiny. Stir in brandy.

recipes.title: Corn Casserole
directions: Saute in butter the onion and green pepper.
In a large bowl, mix eggs, corns, pimento and corn bread mix.
Put mixture in a greased 9 x 13-inch pan; spoon the sauteed onion and pepper over top, then 1/2 pint sour cream in dollops.
Cover with grated sharp cheese.
Bake at 400° for 30 minutes.
Serves 8 to 12.
recipes.text: Corn Casserole. Saute in butter the onion and green pepper. In a large bowl, mix eggs, corns, pimento and corn bread mix. Put mixture in a greased 9 x 13-inch pan; spoon the sauteed onion and pepper over top, then 1/2 pint sour cream in dollops. Cover with grated sharp cheese. Bake at 400° for 30 minutes. Serves 8 to 12.

recipes.title: Chinese Chews
directions: Mix together the first 3 ingredients like pie crust.
Pat into pan.
Bake for 15 minutes at 350°.
Remove from oven.
Mix together the next 6 ingredients and pour over the first mixture. Return to oven and bake additional 15 minutes at 350°.
Cool slightly and cut into small squares.
This is a Swedish recipe. Very good and very rich.
recipes.text: Chinese Chews. Mix together the first 3 ingredients like pie crust. Pat into pan. Bake for 15 minutes at 350°. Remove from oven. Mix together the next 6 ingredients and pour over the first mixture. Return to oven and bake additional 15 minutes at 350°. Cool slightly and cut into small squares. This is a Swedish recipe. Very good and very rich.

recipes.title: Stuffed Pasta Shells
ingredients: salt and freshly ground black pepper to taste
directions: Cook shells in salted boiling water for 10 minutes.
Drain and rinse.
Preheat oven to 350°.
Dice half Mozzarella cheese; slice the rest.
In large skillet, brown ground round and sausage and drain off grease.
Add bread crumbs, milk, parsley, egg and diced Mozzarella cheese to the meat and mix well.
Season to taste with salt and pepper.
Fill cooked shells with meat mixture.
Place half tomato sauce in a shallow 3-quart baking dish.
Place stuffed shells in dish; top with remaining sauce and sliced Mozzarella. Cover and bake for 30 minutes.
Serve with Parmesan cheese.
recipes.text: Stuffed Pasta Shells. Cook shells in salted boiling water for 10 minutes. Drain and rinse. Preheat oven to 350°. Dice half Mozzarella cheese; slice the rest. In large skillet, brown ground round and sausage and drain off grease. Add bread crumbs, milk, parsley, egg and diced Mozzarella cheese to the meat and mix well. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Fill cooked shells with meat mixture. Place half tomato sauce in a shallow 3-quart baking dish. Place stuffed shells in dish; top with remaining sauce and sliced Mozzarella. Cover and bake for 30 minutes. Serve with Parmesan cheese.

recipes.title: Quick Salsa Dip
directions: Mix all ingredients with electric mixer. Chill 1 hour. Serve with taco chips.
recipes.text: Quick Salsa Dip. Mix all ingredients with electric mixer. Chill 1 hour. Serve with taco chips.

recipes.title: "More"
directions: Cook noodles until tender.
Fry meat and onion until brown. Mix all ingredients and place in a baking dish.
Cover with grated cheese and bake in moderate oven for 30 to 40 minutes.
recipes.text: "More". Cook noodles until tender. Fry meat and onion until brown. Mix all ingredients and place in a baking dish. Cover with grated cheese and bake in moderate oven for 30 to 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Bread (Dave'S Favorite)
directions: Mix all together by hand or electric mixer (mixer is faster and more thorough).
Bake in loaf pans (greased), one pound coffee cans or other cans.
Bake in preheated oven at 350° for 1 hour. Springs back to touch when done.
recipes.text: Pumpkin Bread (Dave'S Favorite). Mix all together by hand or electric mixer (mixer is faster and more thorough). Bake in loaf pans (greased), one pound coffee cans or other cans. Bake in preheated oven at 350° for 1 hour. Springs back to touch when done.

recipes.title: Smacked Turkey Flat
directions: You can substitute chicken breasts for turkey.
recipes.text: Smacked Turkey Flat. You can substitute chicken breasts for turkey.

recipes.title: Banana Pudding
directions: Mix the instant pudding separate.
Mix the Dream Whip separate.
Combine together with cream cheese.
Mix well.
Then pour over cookies and bananas.
recipes.text: Banana Pudding. Mix the instant pudding separate. Mix the Dream Whip separate. Combine together with cream cheese. Mix well. Then pour over cookies and bananas.

recipes.title: Chicken Spaghetti
directions: Clean and boil chicken until tender and chop.
Cook spaghetti and drain. Mix all ingredients, except cheese, and pour into casserole dish.
Place cheese slices on top.
Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.
recipes.text: Chicken Spaghetti. Clean and boil chicken until tender and chop. Cook spaghetti and drain. Mix all ingredients, except cheese, and pour into casserole dish. Place cheese slices on top. Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Velveeta Salsa Dip
ingredients: 1 (8 oz.) jar picante sauce or salsa
directions: Microwave Velveeta cheese and salsa in a 1 1/2-quart microwave-safe bowl on High for 5 minutes or until Velveeta is melted, stirring after 3 minutes.
Stir in cilantro.
Serve as directed.
recipes.text: Velveeta Salsa Dip. Microwave Velveeta cheese and salsa in a 1 1/2-quart microwave-safe bowl on High for 5 minutes or until Velveeta is melted, stirring after 3 minutes. Stir in cilantro. Serve as directed.

recipes.title: Hershey'S Chocolate Cake
directions: *Or 1 cup self- rising flour.
recipes.text: Hershey'S Chocolate Cake. *Or 1 cup self- rising flour.

recipes.title: Seafood Gumbo
ingredients: 2 c. shrimp, crab meat and oysters
directions: Melt butter.
Blend in flour; cook over low heat, stirring, until dark brown.
Add liquid, okra, tomatoes, onion, pepper sauce, thyme and bay leaf.
Bring to boil.
Cover; simmer for 30 minutes.
Add seafood; cook for 10 to 15 minutes.
Remove bay leaf.
Serve over hot rice.
recipes.text: Seafood Gumbo. Melt butter. Blend in flour; cook over low heat, stirring, until dark brown. Add liquid, okra, tomatoes, onion, pepper sauce, thyme and bay leaf. Bring to boil. Cover; simmer for 30 minutes. Add seafood; cook for 10 to 15 minutes. Remove bay leaf. Serve over hot rice.

recipes.title: Wiki-Wiki Dessert
ingredients: 2 (8 1/2 oz.) or 1 large can crushed pineapple, drained
directions: Mix together cheese and milk; blend in pineapple and mix well. Add pudding and mix for 1 minute or until well blended.
Pour into graham cracker crust and chill.
Top with whipped topping, if desired.
recipes.text: Wiki-Wiki Dessert. Mix together cheese and milk; blend in pineapple and mix well. Add pudding and mix for 1 minute or until well blended. Pour into graham cracker crust and chill. Top with whipped topping, if desired.

recipes.title: Hot Clam Dip
ingredients: 2 rounds French or pumpernickel bread, unsliced
directions: Cut top off one loaf of bread and scoop out soft bread.
Mix all remaining ingredients (except the other loaf of bread) and fill scooped out bread shell.
Replace top.
Wrap in foil and bake at 250° for 3 hours.
Cut up second loaf of bread to use for dipping.
recipes.text: Hot Clam Dip. Cut top off one loaf of bread and scoop out soft bread. Mix all remaining ingredients (except the other loaf of bread) and fill scooped out bread shell. Replace top. Wrap in foil and bake at 250° for 3 hours. Cut up second loaf of bread to use for dipping.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Fudge
directions: Combine sugar, milk and oleo; cook over medium heat until soft ball shape (approximately 15 minutes after it starts to boil). Remove from heat and add vanilla, peanut butter and marshmallow cream.
Stir until all ingredients are combined.
Pour into greased cake pan.
recipes.text: Peanut Butter Fudge. Combine sugar, milk and oleo; cook over medium heat until soft ball shape (approximately 15 minutes after it starts to boil). Remove from heat and add vanilla, peanut butter and marshmallow cream. Stir until all ingredients are combined. Pour into greased cake pan.

recipes.title: Zucchini Saute
directions: Use a food processor or hand grater to grate the zucchini. Saute in the margarine and Creole seasoning.
Cover and let the zucchini set in its juices.
Umm delicious!
recipes.text: Zucchini Saute. Use a food processor or hand grater to grate the zucchini. Saute in the margarine and Creole seasoning. Cover and let the zucchini set in its juices. Umm delicious!

recipes.title: Garden Pasta Salad
ingredients: 1 c. cubed, cooked chicken or ham
1 c. cubed Cheddar, Monterey or Mozzarella cheese
directions: Cook pasta according to package directions.
Drain, but do not rinse.
Put pasta back into the kettle. While the pasta is hot, toss with the vegetables.
Cover for 3 to 5 minutes.
Vegetables will lightly steam in pasta.
Place pasta in a large bowl.
Top with 3/4 of the dressing and lightly toss. Chill several hours or overnight.
If pasta is dry, add remaining dressing along with meat, cheese, olives and parsley or basil, if desired.
Chill until ready to serve.
Yields 6 to 8 servings.
recipes.text: Garden Pasta Salad. Cook pasta according to package directions. Drain, but do not rinse. Put pasta back into the kettle. While the pasta is hot, toss with the vegetables. Cover for 3 to 5 minutes. Vegetables will lightly steam in pasta. Place pasta in a large bowl. Top with 3/4 of the dressing and lightly toss. Chill several hours or overnight. If pasta is dry, add remaining dressing along with meat, cheese, olives and parsley or basil, if desired. Chill until ready to serve. Yields 6 to 8 servings.

recipes.title: Frozen Lemon Salad
directions: Melt butter in a 13 x 9-inch baking pan.
Mix in Rice Krispies and sugar.
Pat mixture into pan and bake at 300° for 12 minutes. Drain fruit cocktail and mix with lemon juice, condensed milk and lemon pie filling.
Spread on baked Rice Krispies mixture.
Freeze for 4 hours.
Serve with any whipped topping.
recipes.text: Frozen Lemon Salad. Melt butter in a 13 x 9-inch baking pan. Mix in Rice Krispies and sugar. Pat mixture into pan and bake at 300° for 12 minutes. Drain fruit cocktail and mix with lemon juice, condensed milk and lemon pie filling. Spread on baked Rice Krispies mixture. Freeze for 4 hours. Serve with any whipped topping.

recipes.title: Cheese Twists
ingredients: 1 (15 oz.) pkg. folded refrigerated pie crusts (unbaked)
directions: On lightly floured pastry sheet, unfold 1 of the pie crusts. Roll out with rolling pin until crust is 12-inch square.
Brush with 1 tablespoon of melted margarine and sprinkle with 2 tablespoons Parmesan cheese.
Cut into 1-inch strips.
Fold each strip in half lengthwise, pinch together and twist.
Place on greased baking sheet.
Bake at 400° for 10 to 12 minutes or until golden brown.
recipes.text: Cheese Twists. On lightly floured pastry sheet, unfold 1 of the pie crusts. Roll out with rolling pin until crust is 12-inch square. Brush with 1 tablespoon of melted margarine and sprinkle with 2 tablespoons Parmesan cheese. Cut into 1-inch strips. Fold each strip in half lengthwise, pinch together and twist. Place on greased baking sheet. Bake at 400° for 10 to 12 minutes or until golden brown.

recipes.title: Cocoa Frosting
directions: Prepare the frosting in a saucepan.
Combine butter, cocoa and milk.
Heat to boiling, stirring constantly.
Mix in powdered sugar and vanilla until frosting is smooth.
Pour warm frosting over cake or brownies as soon as taken out of the oven.
Cool.
recipes.text: Cocoa Frosting. Prepare the frosting in a saucepan. Combine butter, cocoa and milk. Heat to boiling, stirring constantly. Mix in powdered sugar and vanilla until frosting is smooth. Pour warm frosting over cake or brownies as soon as taken out of the oven. Cool.

recipes.title: Best Pecan Pie
directions: The secret is to bring the first 4 ingredients to a rolling boil for 3 or 4 minutes.
Cool until lukewarm.
Add beaten eggs and 1 cup of pecans.
Blend well with cooked mixture.
Pour into pie shell.
Bake at 325° for 50 to 55 minutes.
recipes.text: Best Pecan Pie. The secret is to bring the first 4 ingredients to a rolling boil for 3 or 4 minutes. Cool until lukewarm. Add beaten eggs and 1 cup of pecans. Blend well with cooked mixture. Pour into pie shell. Bake at 325° for 50 to 55 minutes.

recipes.title: Upside-Down Raisin Carrot Cake
directions: Drain pineapple; reserve 1/2 cup syrup.
Melt 1/4 cup margarine in 10-inch ovenproof skillet.
Blend in brown sugar and arrange pineapple over sugar mixture and top with 1/2 cup raisins. Beat remaining 1/4 cup margarine with sugar until light and fluffy.
Beat in eggs, vanilla and carrots.
Combine dry ingredients.
Beat 1/3 dry ingredients into creamed mixture.
Beat in half reserved syrup until blended.
Repeat, ending with dry ingredients.
Fold in remaining 1/2 cup raisins.
Pour batter over pineapple.
Bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes.
Let stand 5 minutes before inverting on a serving plate.
recipes.text: Upside-Down Raisin Carrot Cake. Drain pineapple; reserve 1/2 cup syrup. Melt 1/4 cup margarine in 10-inch ovenproof skillet. Blend in brown sugar and arrange pineapple over sugar mixture and top with 1/2 cup raisins. Beat remaining 1/4 cup margarine with sugar until light and fluffy. Beat in eggs, vanilla and carrots. Combine dry ingredients. Beat 1/3 dry ingredients into creamed mixture. Beat in half reserved syrup until blended. Repeat, ending with dry ingredients. Fold in remaining 1/2 cup raisins. Pour batter over pineapple. Bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes. Let stand 5 minutes before inverting on a serving plate.

recipes.title: Butterscotch Pie
directions: Mix all together and cook in double boiler until thick.
Cool slightly before putting in pie shell.
Mix 2 tablespoons sugar with beaten egg whites and spread on top and brown in a slow oven about 350°.
recipes.text: Butterscotch Pie. Mix all together and cook in double boiler until thick. Cool slightly before putting in pie shell. Mix 2 tablespoons sugar with beaten egg whites and spread on top and brown in a slow oven about 350°.

recipes.title: Banana Salad
directions: Cook first six ingredients until thickened.
Cool until warm. Slice bananas lengthwise; spread with peanut butter.
Pour sauce over them and serve chilled.
recipes.text: Banana Salad. Cook first six ingredients until thickened. Cool until warm. Slice bananas lengthwise; spread with peanut butter. Pour sauce over them and serve chilled.

recipes.title: Mushroom Florentine Casserole
ingredients: 1 (10 oz.) pkg. frozen chopped spinach, thawed and well drained
1 (10 3/4 oz.) can condensed cream of mushroom soup
directions: Heat oven to 400°.
Prepare Savory Crunch.
Mix spinach, soup and Worcestershire sauce in greased pie plate (9 x 1 1/4-inch). Arrange mushrooms on top.
Sprinkle Savory Crunch evenly over mushrooms.
Bake, uncovered, until hot and bubbly, about 20 minutes.
Serve with lemon wedges.
Makes 5 or 6 servings.
recipes.text: Mushroom Florentine Casserole. Heat oven to 400°. Prepare Savory Crunch. Mix spinach, soup and Worcestershire sauce in greased pie plate (9 x 1 1/4-inch). Arrange mushrooms on top. Sprinkle Savory Crunch evenly over mushrooms. Bake, uncovered, until hot and bubbly, about 20 minutes. Serve with lemon wedges. Makes 5 or 6 servings.

recipes.title: Refrigerator Rolls(An Old Southern Recipe)
directions: Cut the recipe in half to do in food processor.
recipes.text: Refrigerator Rolls(An Old Southern Recipe). Cut the recipe in half to do in food processor.

recipes.title: Easy Coconut Cake
directions: Mix cake according to package directions.
To batter add 1 teaspoon coconut flavoring and most of coconut.
Pour into a 9 x 13-inch pan which has been greased on the bottom.
Bake for 35 minutes at 350°.
While still hot, punch holes in cake with a straw.
Pour the following liquid into holes:
combine cream, powdered sugar and 1 teaspoon coconut flavoring.
Add enough water to make 1 cup of liquid.
Mix well and pour over cake.
Cool completely.
Top with Cool Whip.
Cover with coconut. Refrigerate.
recipes.text: Easy Coconut Cake. Mix cake according to package directions. To batter add 1 teaspoon coconut flavoring and most of coconut. Pour into a 9 x 13-inch pan which has been greased on the bottom. Bake for 35 minutes at 350°. While still hot, punch holes in cake with a straw. Pour the following liquid into holes: combine cream, powdered sugar and 1 teaspoon coconut flavoring. Add enough water to make 1 cup of liquid. Mix well and pour over cake. Cool completely. Top with Cool Whip. Cover with coconut. Refrigerate.

recipes.title: Vegetable Soup Mix
ingredients: 1 lb. ground beef, scrambled and browned
directions: Cook beans and corn until almost done.
Fry okra; combine with all other ingredients and boil for 30 minutes.
Seal or freeze after putting into jars or containers.
recipes.text: Vegetable Soup Mix. Cook beans and corn until almost done. Fry okra; combine with all other ingredients and boil for 30 minutes. Seal or freeze after putting into jars or containers.

recipes.title: Mustard Apricot Pork Chops
ingredients: 4 pork loin chops (1/2 to 3/4 inch thick)
directions: Cook preserves and mustard in a small pan over low heat until preserves are melted.
Place pork chops on a lightly greased broiler pan.
Broil about 4 inches from heat for 5 minutes.
Brush with half of the apricot mixture.
Turn pork chops and brush with remaining apricot mixture.
Broil 5 minutes more or until juices run clear.
Top with onions.
Serves 4.
recipes.text: Mustard Apricot Pork Chops. Cook preserves and mustard in a small pan over low heat until preserves are melted. Place pork chops on a lightly greased broiler pan. Broil about 4 inches from heat for 5 minutes. Brush with half of the apricot mixture. Turn pork chops and brush with remaining apricot mixture. Broil 5 minutes more or until juices run clear. Top with onions. Serves 4.

recipes.title: Pound Cake
ingredients: 1 box Duncan Hines Butter cake mix
directions: Mix well. Put into Bundt cake pan. Bake at 325° for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Pound Cake. Mix well. Put into Bundt cake pan. Bake at 325° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Suet Pudding
directions: Mix and sift dry ingredients; add molasses and milk to suet. Pour into buttered mold and cover.
Steam 3 hours.
Serve with sauce.
recipes.text: Suet Pudding. Mix and sift dry ingredients; add molasses and milk to suet. Pour into buttered mold and cover. Steam 3 hours. Serve with sauce.

recipes.title: 6 Weeks Bran Muffins
directions: Combine dry ingredients and pour mixed liquid ingredients over.
Mix well.
Store in covered container in refrigerator. Bake as needed for breakfast or snacks at 350° for 20 to 30 minutes.
recipes.text: 6 Weeks Bran Muffins. Combine dry ingredients and pour mixed liquid ingredients over. Mix well. Store in covered container in refrigerator. Bake as needed for breakfast or snacks at 350° for 20 to 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Sugar Doughnuts
directions: Cream sugar and shortening; add eggs; beat well.
Add milk with soda.
Add flour with baking powder, salt and nutmeg.
(Use enough flour to handle easily.)
Roll on floured board and cut out.
Fry in deep fat.
recipes.text: Sugar Doughnuts. Cream sugar and shortening; add eggs; beat well. Add milk with soda. Add flour with baking powder, salt and nutmeg. (Use enough flour to handle easily.) Roll on floured board and cut out. Fry in deep fat.

recipes.title: Broccoli Deluxe
ingredients: 1/2 c. sunflower seeds or chopped nuts
directions: Cut up broccoli and red onion.
Cook bacon crisp.
Mix first 5 ingredients in bowl.
Mix last 3 ingredients and pour over the first five.
Stir well.
recipes.text: Broccoli Deluxe. Cut up broccoli and red onion. Cook bacon crisp. Mix first 5 ingredients in bowl. Mix last 3 ingredients and pour over the first five. Stir well.

recipes.title: 8-Layer Casserole
ingredients: 15 oz. plus small can tomato sauce
directions: One-half hour preparation, 15 minutes cooking.
recipes.text: 8-Layer Casserole. One-half hour preparation, 15 minutes cooking.

recipes.title: Fiesta Sandwich
ingredients: 4 oz. County Line Colby Jack cheese, sliced
4 oz. sweet red peppers, in strips
4 oz. County Line Monterey Jack cheese with jalapeno
directions: Cut off the top one-third of loaf of bread and set aside.
Then hollow out, leaving 1/2-inch thick crust all the way around. Spread cut surfaces with bean dip.
Layer as follows:
Colby Jack, half the red pepper, Monterey Jack with jalapeno, olive slices, tomato cubes, Cheddar and avocado.
Top with remainder of red pepper.
Combine shredded taco cheese with salad dressing and spoon on top.
Replace top of bread loaf.
If desired, heat in oven to melt cheese.
Serves 6 to 8.
recipes.text: Fiesta Sandwich. Cut off the top one-third of loaf of bread and set aside. Then hollow out, leaving 1/2-inch thick crust all the way around. Spread cut surfaces with bean dip. Layer as follows: Colby Jack, half the red pepper, Monterey Jack with jalapeno, olive slices, tomato cubes, Cheddar and avocado. Top with remainder of red pepper. Combine shredded taco cheese with salad dressing and spoon on top. Replace top of bread loaf. If desired, heat in oven to melt cheese. Serves 6 to 8.

recipes.title: Crab Casserole
directions: Mix all ingredients together and place in casserole dish.
Bake 25 to 30 minutes at 350°.
recipes.text: Crab Casserole. Mix all ingredients together and place in casserole dish. Bake 25 to 30 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Pilgrim'S Pie
ingredients: 1/4 tsp. salt, pepper and garlic salt
directions: In large bowl, mix ground meat, Worcestershire sauce, salt, pepper and garlic salt; mix well.
Pat down in pie pan.
Drain corn and put on top.
Make potatoes; add on top of corn.
Cover with foil.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour (drain grease if any).
recipes.text: Pilgrim'S Pie. In large bowl, mix ground meat, Worcestershire sauce, salt, pepper and garlic salt; mix well. Pat down in pie pan. Drain corn and put on top. Make potatoes; add on top of corn. Cover with foil. Bake at 350° for 1 hour (drain grease if any).

recipes.title: Macaroni And Cheese
directions: Cook macaroni and drain.
Melt butter.
Blend in flour.
Slowly add milk and cook until smooth and thickened.
Add salt, pepper and 1 1/2 cups cheese.
Pour over macaroni and sprinkle with bread crumbs and remaining cheese.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Macaroni And Cheese. Cook macaroni and drain. Melt butter. Blend in flour. Slowly add milk and cook until smooth and thickened. Add salt, pepper and 1 1/2 cups cheese. Pour over macaroni and sprinkle with bread crumbs and remaining cheese. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Shirley'S Nonstick Baking Pan Coating
directions: Mix solid and oil Crisco slowly.
Add flour.
Coat pans.
No need to add anything else.
Refrigerate remainder in covered jar for future use.
Keeps 3 months.
recipes.text: Shirley'S Nonstick Baking Pan Coating. Mix solid and oil Crisco slowly. Add flour. Coat pans. No need to add anything else. Refrigerate remainder in covered jar for future use. Keeps 3 months.

recipes.title: Easy Summer Lemon Pie
directions: Mix Eagle Brand milk and lemonade.
Fold in Cool Whip until smooth and well blended.
(Makes two 8-inch pies.) Freeze for about 1 hour before serving.
Store in freezer, well covered.
recipes.text: Easy Summer Lemon Pie. Mix Eagle Brand milk and lemonade. Fold in Cool Whip until smooth and well blended. (Makes two 8-inch pies.) Freeze for about 1 hour before serving. Store in freezer, well covered.

recipes.title: Venison Barbecue Sandwich
directions: Place roast in pan and cover with water.
Cover and bring to boil.
Reduce heat and boil 1 hour.
Remove roast from pan and flake meat, using fork and knife.
Mix meat with catsup, Worcestershire sauce, corn syrup, chili powder and salt and pepper to taste.
Add water to barbecue mix and cook at low heat 30 minutes, stirring often, until liquid is absorbed.
Serve on buns.
recipes.text: Venison Barbecue Sandwich. Place roast in pan and cover with water. Cover and bring to boil. Reduce heat and boil 1 hour. Remove roast from pan and flake meat, using fork and knife. Mix meat with catsup, Worcestershire sauce, corn syrup, chili powder and salt and pepper to taste. Add water to barbecue mix and cook at low heat 30 minutes, stirring often, until liquid is absorbed. Serve on buns.

recipes.title: Garden Sausage Bake
ingredients: 1 lb. Armour Star Polish sausage, cut in 1-inch pieces
2 (10 3/4 oz.) cans cream of mushroom soup
directions: Heat the oven to 350°.
Combine all the ingredients.
Place in 2-quart casserole.
Bake, covered, 50 minutes.
Makes six servings.
recipes.text: Garden Sausage Bake. Heat the oven to 350°. Combine all the ingredients. Place in 2-quart casserole. Bake, covered, 50 minutes. Makes six servings.

recipes.title: Pear Conserves
directions: Put all through food chopper and cook one-half hour or until transparent.
Stir while cooking to keep from burning.
Put into pint or half-pint jars.
This conserve is very good when used as a cake filling.
recipes.text: Pear Conserves. Put all through food chopper and cook one-half hour or until transparent. Stir while cooking to keep from burning. Put into pint or half-pint jars. This conserve is very good when used as a cake filling.

recipes.title: Chicken And Rice
ingredients: 1 c. Uncle Ben's long grain rice (not instant)
directions: Mix soups and water.
Stir in rice.
Put in 13 x 9-inch pan. Place chicken on top.
Cook 1 hour or until done at 350°.
recipes.text: Chicken And Rice. Mix soups and water. Stir in rice. Put in 13 x 9-inch pan. Place chicken on top. Cook 1 hour or until done at 350°.

recipes.title: Turkey Lasagna
ingredients: 1 (10 oz.) pkg. frozen chopped spinach, thawed
2 (14 oz.) cans no salt whole tomatoes (undrained), chopped
2 (6 oz.) cans no salt tomato paste
directions: Coat a large Dutch oven with cooking spray; place over medium-high heat until hot.
Add turkey, onion and garlic; cook until turkey is browned, stirring until it crumbles.
Drain turkey mixture.
Pat dry with paper towels.
Wipe skillet with paper towel.
Drain spinach and press dry between layers of paper towels.
Return turkey mixture to skillet.
Add spinach, tomato and next 7 ingredients.
Cook over medium heat for 15 minutes or until thick, stirring occasionally.
Remove from heat and set aside.
Combine Ricotta cheese and egg substitute in a small bowl; stir well.
recipes.text: Turkey Lasagna. Coat a large Dutch oven with cooking spray; place over medium-high heat until hot. Add turkey, onion and garlic; cook until turkey is browned, stirring until it crumbles. Drain turkey mixture. Pat dry with paper towels. Wipe skillet with paper towel. Drain spinach and press dry between layers of paper towels. Return turkey mixture to skillet. Add spinach, tomato and next 7 ingredients. Cook over medium heat for 15 minutes or until thick, stirring occasionally. Remove from heat and set aside. Combine Ricotta cheese and egg substitute in a small bowl; stir well.

recipes.title: Potato Rolls
ingredients: 2 large potatoes, sliced (to make 1 c. mashed potatoes), cook in 4 c. water
directions: Mix 1/2 cup warm water, 2 tablespoons yeast and 1 teaspoon sugar.
Set aside.
recipes.text: Potato Rolls. Mix 1/2 cup warm water, 2 tablespoons yeast and 1 teaspoon sugar. Set aside.

recipes.title: Instant Russian Tea
directions: Mix all dry ingredients together and store.
Use 2 to 3 teaspoons per cup of hot water.
recipes.text: Instant Russian Tea. Mix all dry ingredients together and store. Use 2 to 3 teaspoons per cup of hot water.

recipes.title: Monkey Bread
directions: Cut biscuits in quarters and roll in sugar-cinnamon mix (1/2 cup sugar and 1/2 teaspoon cinnamon).
Pile in a greased and floured Bundt pan.
recipes.text: Monkey Bread. Cut biscuits in quarters and roll in sugar-cinnamon mix (1/2 cup sugar and 1/2 teaspoon cinnamon). Pile in a greased and floured Bundt pan.

recipes.title: Sammie'S Caramel Praline Pie
directions: Brown coconut and pecans in margarine; set aside to cool. Combine cream cheese, milk and 1 1/2 cartons Cool Whip.
Layer cream cheese mixture on bottom.
Then layer pecan mixture, next drizzle caramel on top of other layers.
End and top with remaining Cool Whip.
Freeze for 2 to 3 hours before serving.
Makes 3 small pies.
recipes.text: Sammie'S Caramel Praline Pie. Brown coconut and pecans in margarine; set aside to cool. Combine cream cheese, milk and 1 1/2 cartons Cool Whip. Layer cream cheese mixture on bottom. Then layer pecan mixture, next drizzle caramel on top of other layers. End and top with remaining Cool Whip. Freeze for 2 to 3 hours before serving. Makes 3 small pies.

recipes.title: Garlic Herb Spread
directions: In large food processor, with chopping blade, process first five ingredients until finely chopped.
Add cream cheese, butter, Worcestershire, and vinegar; process just until well mixed and creamy.
Line a 1 1/4-quart plastic container or shallow bowl with plastic wrap. Spread mixture into container. Refrigerate.
recipes.text: Garlic Herb Spread. In large food processor, with chopping blade, process first five ingredients until finely chopped. Add cream cheese, butter, Worcestershire, and vinegar; process just until well mixed and creamy. Line a 1 1/4-quart plastic container or shallow bowl with plastic wrap. Spread mixture into container. Refrigerate.

recipes.title: Pasties(Yields 5 Servings)
directions: In a large bowl, combine flour and salt.
With a pastry blender, cut shortening into flour until the mixture forms a ball. The pastry will be stickier than regular pie crust.
With floured hands, shape into a ball.
Wrap in wax paper and let rest in refrigerator while preparing filling.
recipes.text: Pasties(Yields 5 Servings). In a large bowl, combine flour and salt. With a pastry blender, cut shortening into flour until the mixture forms a ball. The pastry will be stickier than regular pie crust. With floured hands, shape into a ball. Wrap in wax paper and let rest in refrigerator while preparing filling.

recipes.title: Earthquake Cake
directions: Preheat oven to 350°.
Grease a 9 x 13-inch cake pan.
Spread pecans and coconut on bottom of pan.
Prepare cake mix according to package directions; pour over pecans and coconut.
Mix melted margarine, softened cream cheese and sugar together; pour over cake batter.
Bake for 1 hour, or until cake is brown.
recipes.text: Earthquake Cake. Preheat oven to 350°. Grease a 9 x 13-inch cake pan. Spread pecans and coconut on bottom of pan. Prepare cake mix according to package directions; pour over pecans and coconut. Mix melted margarine, softened cream cheese and sugar together; pour over cake batter. Bake for 1 hour, or until cake is brown.

recipes.title: French Onion Soup
ingredients: 8 medium onions, thinly sliced and separated into rings
1 (6 oz.) pkg. Mozzarella cheese, sliced and cut in halves
directions: Combine oil and butter in a large Dutch oven. Heat until butter melts.
Add onions and saute until tender. Add broth, sugar, salt and pepper. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer soup mixture 20 minutes.
Place toasted bread in individual soup bowls.
Add soup and top with cheese slice.
Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese.
recipes.text: French Onion Soup. Combine oil and butter in a large Dutch oven. Heat until butter melts. Add onions and saute until tender. Add broth, sugar, salt and pepper. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer soup mixture 20 minutes. Place toasted bread in individual soup bowls. Add soup and top with cheese slice. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese.

recipes.title: Two-Cheese Tossed Salad
directions: In a jar with tight-fitting lid, combine the first eight ingredients.
Refrigerate overnight.
Just before serving, toss spinach, lettuce, mushrooms and cheeses in a large salad bowl. Shake dressing and pour over salad.
Sprinkle with bacon.
Yield 12-14 servings.
recipes.text: Two-Cheese Tossed Salad. In a jar with tight-fitting lid, combine the first eight ingredients. Refrigerate overnight. Just before serving, toss spinach, lettuce, mushrooms and cheeses in a large salad bowl. Shake dressing and pour over salad. Sprinkle with bacon. Yield 12-14 servings.

recipes.title: Mexican Cheese Dip
directions: Combine first six ingredients.
Mix the cheeses together. Spread half of sour cream mixture in 2-quart baking dish.
Sprinkle with 1/2 the cheese.
Add remainder of sour cream mix then remainder of cheese.
Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes.
Serve with tortilla chips.
recipes.text: Mexican Cheese Dip. Combine first six ingredients. Mix the cheeses together. Spread half of sour cream mixture in 2-quart baking dish. Sprinkle with 1/2 the cheese. Add remainder of sour cream mix then remainder of cheese. Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes. Serve with tortilla chips.

recipes.title: Graham Cracker Delight
ingredients: 1 c. crushed pineapple, drain off juice
directions: Cream butter and sugar.
Add egg yolks beating good.
Add pineapple, nuts and marshmallows.
Line a baking dish or pan with whole graham crackers and pour the mixture on the crackers, then spread the stiffly beaten egg whites on top of mixture.
Place another layer of crackers on top of the egg whites.
Pour partially set jello on the egg whites.
Put the pan in refrigerator until jello sets.
Before serving, add whipped cream on top.
recipes.text: Graham Cracker Delight. Cream butter and sugar. Add egg yolks beating good. Add pineapple, nuts and marshmallows. Line a baking dish or pan with whole graham crackers and pour the mixture on the crackers, then spread the stiffly beaten egg whites on top of mixture. Place another layer of crackers on top of the egg whites. Pour partially set jello on the egg whites. Put the pan in refrigerator until jello sets. Before serving, add whipped cream on top.

recipes.title: Cake And Fruit Kabobs
ingredients: 18 (1-inch) cubes fresh pineapple or 8 oz. can pineapple chunks, drained
directions: You will need 6 (8-inch) bamboo skewers.
recipes.text: Cake And Fruit Kabobs. You will need 6 (8-inch) bamboo skewers.

recipes.title: Superior French Dressing
directions: Place all ingredients in a quart jar and shake vigorously. A garlic may be placed in the dressing overnight for added flavor.
recipes.text: Superior French Dressing. Place all ingredients in a quart jar and shake vigorously. A garlic may be placed in the dressing overnight for added flavor.

recipes.title: Tiger Butter(Candy)
directions: Melt white chocolate in double boiler.
Mix in peanut butter. Pour into cookie sheet lined with waxed paper.
Melt dark chocolate and pour over first mixture.
Take knife and swirl through both mixtures deep enough to give it a marbled look.
Cool and cut into squares.
recipes.text: Tiger Butter(Candy). Melt white chocolate in double boiler. Mix in peanut butter. Pour into cookie sheet lined with waxed paper. Melt dark chocolate and pour over first mixture. Take knife and swirl through both mixtures deep enough to give it a marbled look. Cool and cut into squares.

recipes.title: Dirt Dessert
directions: Cream together the margarine, confectioners sugar and cream cheese.
Mix together the pudding, milk and Cool Whip.
Add to the cream cheese mixture.
recipes.text: Dirt Dessert. Cream together the margarine, confectioners sugar and cream cheese. Mix together the pudding, milk and Cool Whip. Add to the cream cheese mixture.

recipes.title: No Cook Candy Balls
directions: Mix powdered sugar, Eagle Brand milk, coconut and butter well. Roll into balls.
Refrigerate for 1 hour.
Melt chocolate chips in pan.
Dip balls into chocolate, then drop on wax paper.
Put back in refrigerator until hard.
recipes.text: No Cook Candy Balls. Mix powdered sugar, Eagle Brand milk, coconut and butter well. Roll into balls. Refrigerate for 1 hour. Melt chocolate chips in pan. Dip balls into chocolate, then drop on wax paper. Put back in refrigerator until hard.

recipes.title: Hidden Valley Ranch Oyster Crackers
ingredients: 1 (1 oz.) pkg. Hidden Valley Ranch milk original recipe salad dressing mix
directions: Whisk together first 5 ingredients.
Pour over crackers, stirring to coat.
Place on baking sheet and bake at 275° for 15 to 20 minutes.
Makes 11 to 12 cups.
recipes.text: Hidden Valley Ranch Oyster Crackers. Whisk together first 5 ingredients. Pour over crackers, stirring to coat. Place on baking sheet and bake at 275° for 15 to 20 minutes. Makes 11 to 12 cups.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Roll
directions: Combine first 6 ingredients; mix well. Put into a greased and floured jelly roll pan or deep cookie sheet. Sprinkle with nuts and coconut as desired. Bake roll in 350° oven until firm, 10 to 15 minutes. Loosen roll and place on towel covered with 10x sugar. Cover with sugar and roll up; set aside to cool.
recipes.text: Pumpkin Roll. Combine first 6 ingredients; mix well. Put into a greased and floured jelly roll pan or deep cookie sheet. Sprinkle with nuts and coconut as desired. Bake roll in 350° oven until firm, 10 to 15 minutes. Loosen roll and place on towel covered with 10x sugar. Cover with sugar and roll up; set aside to cool.

recipes.title: Sausage Cheese Balls
directions: Preheat oven to 350°.
Mix all ingredients well with hands. Make into 1-inch balls.
Place on cookie sheet.
Bake 12 to 15 minutes on each side.
recipes.text: Sausage Cheese Balls. Preheat oven to 350°. Mix all ingredients well with hands. Make into 1-inch balls. Place on cookie sheet. Bake 12 to 15 minutes on each side.

recipes.title: Cherry Cake Pudding
directions: In 13 x 9-inch pan, mix pie filling and water together; sprinkle cake mix on top of cherry filling.
Add pats of margarine on top of cake mix.
Bake 35 minutes or until golden brown in heated oven at 350°.
recipes.text: Cherry Cake Pudding. In 13 x 9-inch pan, mix pie filling and water together; sprinkle cake mix on top of cherry filling. Add pats of margarine on top of cake mix. Bake 35 minutes or until golden brown in heated oven at 350°.

recipes.title: Chicken Salad
directions: If
using for salad, chop ham, chicken, pecans, pickles, boiled
eggs
and
celery
in larger pieces; if for sandwiches, chop
a
little finer.
Add cayenne to taste, and enough mayonnaise to hold together.
recipes.text: Chicken Salad. If using for salad, chop ham, chicken, pecans, pickles, boiled eggs and celery in larger pieces; if for sandwiches, chop a little finer. Add cayenne to taste, and enough mayonnaise to hold together.

recipes.title: Quick Cooked Cabbage
directions: In a 10-inch skillet, heat bacon fat or oil.
Add cabbage, salt and pepper.
Toss several times or until cabbage is coated with fat.
Cook, covered, about 3 minutes.
recipes.text: Quick Cooked Cabbage. In a 10-inch skillet, heat bacon fat or oil. Add cabbage, salt and pepper. Toss several times or until cabbage is coated with fat. Cook, covered, about 3 minutes.

recipes.title: Broccoli Casserole
directions: Mix broccoli, corn, egg and onion.
Put into a casserole dish. Mix melted butter and cracker crumbs and sprinkle on top.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Broccoli Casserole. Mix broccoli, corn, egg and onion. Put into a casserole dish. Mix melted butter and cracker crumbs and sprinkle on top. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Scalloped Potatoes
directions: Mix all ingredients in a casserole dish.
Bake at 325° for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Scalloped Potatoes. Mix all ingredients in a casserole dish. Bake at 325° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Oven Barbecue Spareribs
directions: Pour sauce over ribs, let stand several hours in refrigerator (overnight is better).
Cover baking dish with aluminum foil. Bake in 350° oven about 2 hours or until tender.
Remove foil the last few minutes to brown meat.
recipes.text: Oven Barbecue Spareribs. Pour sauce over ribs, let stand several hours in refrigerator (overnight is better). Cover baking dish with aluminum foil. Bake in 350° oven about 2 hours or until tender. Remove foil the last few minutes to brown meat.

recipes.title: Buckeyes
directions: Melt first 3 ingredients together until smooth.
Add powdered sugar and knead until smooth.
Roll into small balls.
recipes.text: Buckeyes. Melt first 3 ingredients together until smooth. Add powdered sugar and knead until smooth. Roll into small balls.

recipes.title: Chicken Carolina
directions: Coat chicken with mixture of flour, salt and pepper.
Melt shortening in large deep skillet.
Brown chicken pieces, then remove from skillet.
Saute green pepper, onion and garlic until tender.
Stir in catsup and remaining ingredients.
Return chicken to skillet.
Cover and simmer (basting occasionally) for 45 to 60 minutes or until chicken is tender.
Serve with hot fluffy rice, if desired.
Makes 6 servings, about 3 cups of sauce.
recipes.text: Chicken Carolina. Coat chicken with mixture of flour, salt and pepper. Melt shortening in large deep skillet. Brown chicken pieces, then remove from skillet. Saute green pepper, onion and garlic until tender. Stir in catsup and remaining ingredients. Return chicken to skillet. Cover and simmer (basting occasionally) for 45 to 60 minutes or until chicken is tender. Serve with hot fluffy rice, if desired. Makes 6 servings, about 3 cups of sauce.

recipes.title: Haystacks
ingredients: 1 large (5 oz.) can chow mein noodles
directions: Melt morsels in microwave or on low heat.
Mix noodles into mixture.
Stir.
Drop by spoonfuls onto wax paper to dry.
recipes.text: Haystacks. Melt morsels in microwave or on low heat. Mix noodles into mixture. Stir. Drop by spoonfuls onto wax paper to dry.

recipes.title: Bean-Onion Salad
directions: Drain beans; add celery and onion.
Combine remaining ingredients; mix with beans.
Let set in refrigerator several hours before serving.
recipes.text: Bean-Onion Salad. Drain beans; add celery and onion. Combine remaining ingredients; mix with beans. Let set in refrigerator several hours before serving.

recipes.title: Mexican Chicken
ingredients: 1 small can green chili peppers, chopped
1 medium jar Cheez Whiz with jalapenos
directions: Punch hole in bag of Doritos and crush.
Put a layer of chips in bottom of casserole dish.
Simmer all other ingredients for 15 minutes.
Pour over chips.
Put rest of the chips on top.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Mexican Chicken. Punch hole in bag of Doritos and crush. Put a layer of chips in bottom of casserole dish. Simmer all other ingredients for 15 minutes. Pour over chips. Put rest of the chips on top. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Microwave Savory Onion Chicken
directions: Dip chicken in butter.
Coat with dry soup mix and arrange in 12 x 8 x 2-inch dish, skin side up, with thick meaty pieces to the outside edges of dish.
Cover with wax paper.
Microwave at High 18 to 22 minutes, rotating dish 1/2 turn after 10 minutes, until meat is tender.
Let stand 5 minutes before serving.
recipes.text: Microwave Savory Onion Chicken. Dip chicken in butter. Coat with dry soup mix and arrange in 12 x 8 x 2-inch dish, skin side up, with thick meaty pieces to the outside edges of dish. Cover with wax paper. Microwave at High 18 to 22 minutes, rotating dish 1/2 turn after 10 minutes, until meat is tender. Let stand 5 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Chicken Teriyaki Chunks
ingredients: minced garlic to taste (I use 2 Tbsp.)
directions: Mix together soy sauce, honey, ginger and garlic.
Simmer in saucepan.
Cut chicken into 1-inch chunks.
Dip chicken in beaten egg, then dip chicken into flour.
Fry the coated chicken nuggets in oil until browned.
Dip chicken nuggets into soy sauce mixture, then bake them in 325° oven for 20 minutes.
Sprinkle chicken with sesame seed, if desired.
Serve with rice and whatever sauce remains.
recipes.text: Chicken Teriyaki Chunks. Mix together soy sauce, honey, ginger and garlic. Simmer in saucepan. Cut chicken into 1-inch chunks. Dip chicken in beaten egg, then dip chicken into flour. Fry the coated chicken nuggets in oil until browned. Dip chicken nuggets into soy sauce mixture, then bake them in 325° oven for 20 minutes. Sprinkle chicken with sesame seed, if desired. Serve with rice and whatever sauce remains.

recipes.title: Hamburger Stroganoff
ingredients: 1 clove garlic or use garlic powder
1/4 c. butter or shortening (I use a little less)
directions: Fry onion and garlic in butter over medium heat.
Stir in meat and brown.
Stir in flour, salt, pepper and soup; simmer, uncovered, for 10 minutes.
Stir in sour cream.
Heat through and serve over noodles.
recipes.text: Hamburger Stroganoff. Fry onion and garlic in butter over medium heat. Stir in meat and brown. Stir in flour, salt, pepper and soup; simmer, uncovered, for 10 minutes. Stir in sour cream. Heat through and serve over noodles.

recipes.title: Stuffed Meat Loaf
directions: Cook stuffing mix per package directions.
Set aside to cool. Mix meat with crumbs and spices.
Put half the meat on bottom of loaf pan.
Make an indentation in the middle.
Put stuffing mix in. Place other half of meat on top, sealing the sides with water. Bake at 375° for 1 1/4 hours.
Let sit before slicing.
Also good cold.
Serves 6.
recipes.text: Stuffed Meat Loaf. Cook stuffing mix per package directions. Set aside to cool. Mix meat with crumbs and spices. Put half the meat on bottom of loaf pan.
