Make an indentation in the middle. Put stuffing mix in. Place other half of meat on top, sealing the sides with water. Bake at 375° for 1 1/4 hours. Let sit before slicing. Also good cold. Serves 6.

recipes.title: Cocktail Cream Puffs(For Dessert Or Appetizers)
directions: Mix flour and salt that has been sifted into small bowl; set aside.
Combine butter and boiling water in medium saucepan.
Keep over low heat until butter is melted.
Add flour all at one time and stir vigorously over low heat until mixture forms a ball and leaves the side of pan.
Remove from heat.
Add unbeaten eggs one at a time, beating thoroughly after each addition.
Continue beating until a thick dough is formed.
Drop by small teaspoon onto greased baking sheet.
Bake 30 to 40 minutes 2 inches apart in 425°
oven.
Makes 3 to 4 dozen.
Cut off tops to fill when cool.
recipes.text: Cocktail Cream Puffs(For Dessert Or Appetizers). Mix flour and salt that has been sifted into small bowl; set aside. Combine butter and boiling water in medium saucepan. Keep over low heat until butter is melted. Add flour all at one time and stir vigorously over low heat until mixture forms a ball and leaves the side of pan. Remove from heat. Add unbeaten eggs one at a time, beating thoroughly after each addition. Continue beating until a thick dough is formed. Drop by small teaspoon onto greased baking sheet. Bake 30 to 40 minutes 2 inches apart in 425° oven. Makes 3 to 4 dozen. Cut off tops to fill when cool.

recipes.title: Overnight Vegetable Salad
ingredients: 1 (16 oz.) can tiny green peas, drained
1 (16 oz.) can French-style green beans, drained
1 (11 oz.) can Shoe Peg white corn, drained
directions: In a large bowl, combine peas, beans, corn, celery and pimento.
In saucepan, combine remaining ingredients.
Heat and stir until sugar dissolves. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Yields 10 to 12 servings.
recipes.text: Overnight Vegetable Salad. In a large bowl, combine peas, beans, corn, celery and pimento. In saucepan, combine remaining ingredients. Heat and stir until sugar dissolves. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Yields 10 to 12 servings.

recipes.title: No Peek Chicken
directions: Melt butter in 9 x 13-inch pan.
Pour uncooked Minute rice over butter.
Mix the 2 soups with the milk and pour over rice.
Press chicken into the mixture.
Cover with foil and seal tightly.
Bake at 350° for 2 1/2 hours.
Do not peek!
recipes.text: No Peek Chicken. Melt butter in 9 x 13-inch pan. Pour uncooked Minute rice over butter. Mix the 2 soups with the milk and pour over rice. Press chicken into the mixture. Cover with foil and seal tightly. Bake at 350° for 2 1/2 hours. Do not peek!

recipes.title: Cathy'S Smothered Meatballs And Onions
directions: Heat oil in skillet.
Roll ground beef into medium size balls. Roll in flour and place in skillet.
Brown on both sides.
Drain oil and pour enough water just to the top of meatballs.
Slice onions over top of meatballs and cook until tender.
recipes.text: Cathy'S Smothered Meatballs And Onions. Heat oil in skillet. Roll ground beef into medium size balls. Roll in flour and place in skillet. Brown on both sides. Drain oil and pour enough water just to the top of meatballs. Slice onions over top of meatballs and cook until tender.

recipes.title: Jello Dessert
directions: Take juice from fruit and heat in saucepan. Dissolve into jello. Add same amount of cool water and stir. Stir in cool whip, fruit and cottage cheese. Chill till set.
recipes.text: Jello Dessert. Take juice from fruit and heat in saucepan. Dissolve into jello. Add same amount of cool water and stir. Stir in cool whip, fruit and cottage cheese. Chill till set.

recipes.title: Bean Dip
directions: Mix together.
Bake for 20 minutes at 300°.
Sprinkle cheese on top to melt.
recipes.text: Bean Dip. Mix together. Bake for 20 minutes at 300°. Sprinkle cheese on top to melt.

recipes.title: Marty'S Oven Barbecue Steak
directions: Preheat oven to 350°.
Cut steak into serving pieces.
Brown steak in oil and transfer to roasting pan.
Saute onions and add to remaining ingredients.
Simmer 5 minutes.
Pour mixture over steak.
Cover and bake 2 hours.
Add extra water, if needed, to increase sauce if it is too thick after baking 1 hour.
recipes.text: Marty'S Oven Barbecue Steak. Preheat oven to 350°. Cut steak into serving pieces. Brown steak in oil and transfer to roasting pan. Saute onions and add to remaining ingredients. Simmer 5 minutes. Pour mixture over steak. Cover and bake 2 hours. Add extra water, if needed, to increase sauce if it is too thick after baking 1 hour.

recipes.title: Walnut Stuffed Chicken
ingredients: 3/4 c. hot water, canned broth or stock
1 (3 lb.) whole broiler-fryer chicken, washed and patted dry
directions: Pour croutettes stuffing mix into large mixing bowl.
Set aside.
Cook celery and onion in margarine until tender.
Add to stuffing mix, tossing gently.
Stir lightly while adding hot water.
Gently stir in walnuts.
recipes.text: Walnut Stuffed Chicken. Pour croutettes stuffing mix into large mixing bowl. Set aside. Cook celery and onion in margarine until tender. Add to stuffing mix, tossing gently. Stir lightly while adding hot water. Gently stir in walnuts.

recipes.title: Hominy Salad
directions: Cook hominy; drain and let cool.
Add egg, then desired amounts of tomato, onion, bell pepper and mayonnaise.
Add salt and pepper to taste.
recipes.text: Hominy Salad. Cook hominy; drain and let cool. Add egg, then desired amounts of tomato, onion, bell pepper and mayonnaise. Add salt and pepper to taste.

recipes.title: Easy Chicken Stew
ingredients: 1 1/2 c. each frozen peas and diced carrots or use 2 (10 oz.) pkg.
8 oz. can Pillsbury or other brand refrigerated buttermilk or country style biscuits
directions: In a large saucepan, combine first 5 ingredients.
Heat until hot and bubbly. Separate biscuit dough into 10 biscuits.
Cut each in half. Drop biscuit halves into hot chicken mixture.
Sprinkle with parsley. Cook over medium heat, uncovered, for 10 minutes. Cover tightly and simmer 15 minutes longer. Serve immediately. Makes 5 to 6 servings.
recipes.text: Easy Chicken Stew. In a large saucepan, combine first 5 ingredients. Heat until hot and bubbly. Separate biscuit dough into 10 biscuits. Cut each in half. Drop biscuit halves into hot chicken mixture. Sprinkle with parsley. Cook over medium heat, uncovered, for 10 minutes. Cover tightly and simmer 15 minutes longer. Serve immediately. Makes 5 to 6 servings.

recipes.title: Vanilla Wafer Cake
directions: Cream margarine and sugar; add eggs one at a time and beat after each. Add vanilla wafers alternately with milk. Add coconut and pecans. Bake in greased and floured tube pan at 325° for 1 hour and 15 minutes.
recipes.text: Vanilla Wafer Cake. Cream margarine and sugar; add eggs one at a time and beat after each. Add vanilla wafers alternately with milk. Add coconut and pecans. Bake in greased and floured tube pan at 325° for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Applesauce Raisin Nut Cake
directions: Cream sugar and butter until fluffy. Add eggs and beat well. Add applesauce and raisins. Stir dry ingredients together and add to creamed mixture. Fold in nuts. Bake in angel food cake pan at 350° for 1 hour or until toothpick comes out clean when stuck in cake.
recipes.text: Applesauce Raisin Nut Cake. Cream sugar and butter until fluffy. Add eggs and beat well. Add applesauce and raisins. Stir dry ingredients together and add to creamed mixture. Fold in nuts. Bake in angel food cake pan at 350° for 1 hour or until toothpick comes out clean when stuck in cake.

recipes.title: Anzac Cookies(Australian-New Zealand Army Corps)
directions: Melt margarine and syrup.
Add to dry ingredients.
Dissolve soda in boiling water.
Add to other ingredients.
Place on greased cookie sheet by teaspoon size.
Bake at 350° for 8 to 12 minutes.
recipes.text: Anzac Cookies(Australian-New Zealand Army Corps). Melt margarine and syrup. Add to dry ingredients. Dissolve soda in boiling water. Add to other ingredients. Place on greased cookie sheet by teaspoon size. Bake at 350° for 8 to 12 minutes.

recipes.title: Tunnel Of Fudge Cake
ingredients: 1 (12 1/2 oz.) pkg. chocolate dry frosting mix
directions: Cream butter in large mixer bowl at high speed.
Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each.
Gradually add sugar; continue beating at high speed until light and fluffy.
By hand, stir in flour, frosting mix and walnuts until well blended.
Pour batter into a well-greased and floured Bundt pan.
Bake at 350° for 60 to 65 minutes.
Cool 2 hours before removing from pan.
Cool completely before serving.
recipes.text: Tunnel Of Fudge Cake. Cream butter in large mixer bowl at high speed. Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each. Gradually add sugar; continue beating at high speed until light and fluffy. By hand, stir in flour, frosting mix and walnuts until well blended. Pour batter into a well-greased and floured Bundt pan. Bake at 350° for 60 to 65 minutes. Cool 2 hours before removing from pan. Cool completely before serving.

recipes.title: Ground Beef Shepherds Pie
directions: Preheat oven to 350°.
Coat a 2 quart casserole dish with cooking spray.
Heat oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Cook onion in oil for 5 minutes, stirring frequently.
Stir in the ground beef and basil, and cook and stir for 5 more minutes.
Mix in the garlic, green beans, and tomatoes, and simmer for 5 minutes. Transfer beef mixture to prepared dish.
In a mixing bowl, mix together the mashed potatoes, egg and water.
Spread evenly over meat mixture.
Bake in a preheated oven for 15 to 20 minutes, or until potatoes start to brown on top.
Sprinkle with cheese, and continue cooking for 5 minutes.
recipes.text: Ground Beef Shepherds Pie. Preheat oven to 350°. Coat a 2 quart casserole dish with cooking spray. Heat oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Cook onion in oil for 5 minutes, stirring frequently. Stir in the ground beef and basil, and cook and stir for 5 more minutes. Mix in the garlic, green beans, and tomatoes, and simmer for 5 minutes. Transfer beef mixture to prepared dish. In a mixing bowl, mix together the mashed potatoes, egg and water. Spread evenly over meat mixture. Bake in a preheated oven for 15 to 20 minutes, or until potatoes start to brown on top. Sprinkle with cheese, and continue cooking for 5 minutes.

recipes.title: Quick Brownies
directions: Bake at 325° for 30 to 35 minutes.
recipes.text: Quick Brownies. Bake at 325° for 30 to 35 minutes.

recipes.title: Chocolate Half-Moon Cookies
directions: Mix all ingredients together in the order given.
Beat until smooth.
Drop by rounded tablespoonful on a greased cookie sheet. Bake at 400° for about 7 minutes.
Cool; frost half of flat side with white icing, half with chocolate icing.
recipes.text: Chocolate Half-Moon Cookies. Mix all ingredients together in the order given. Beat until smooth. Drop by rounded tablespoonful on a greased cookie sheet. Bake at 400° for about 7 minutes. Cool; frost half of flat side with white icing, half with chocolate icing.

recipes.title: Corned Beef And Cabbage Casserole
directions: Layer potatoes (sliced), the onion (sliced thin) and then layer cabbage (wedged).
Salt and pepper as you layer.
Add 1 tablespoon meat grease, butter and water according to how much you cook.
Then put the corned beef on top of the cabbage and be sure to have the pan with airtight lid.
Let cook for 1 hour and 10 minutes on low heat.
recipes.text: Corned Beef And Cabbage Casserole. Layer potatoes (sliced), the onion (sliced thin) and then layer cabbage (wedged). Salt and pepper as you layer. Add 1 tablespoon meat grease, butter and water according to how much you cook. Then put the corned beef on top of the cabbage and be sure to have the pan with airtight lid. Let cook for 1 hour and 10 minutes on low heat.

recipes.title: Easy Caramel Rolls
directions: Spray a large Bundt pan with Pam.
Put rolls in pan and sprinkle other ingredients over the top.
Let set overnight in uncovered pan.
In the morning, bake at 375° for 25 minutes. Invert on large plate.
Serves 12.
Easy recipe for kids.
recipes.text: Easy Caramel Rolls. Spray a large Bundt pan with Pam. Put rolls in pan and sprinkle other ingredients over the top. Let set overnight in uncovered pan. In the morning, bake at 375° for 25 minutes. Invert on large plate. Serves 12. Easy recipe for kids.

recipes.title: Sherried Chicken(Serves 6)
ingredients: salt and freshly ground pepper to taste
1 c. fat-skimmed chicken broth (homemade or canned)
directions: Wash and dry chicken.
Trim off fringe fat, if any.
Arrange the chicken pieces skin side up in a shallow ovenproof nonstick pan.
Bake in a preheated 450° oven 20 to 25 minutes, until the skin is crisp and well rendered of fat.
Drain and discard fat. Add remaining ingredients to pan.
Lower heat to 350°.
Continue baking, basting occasionally, until chicken is tender (about 30 minutes).
Spoon pan juice over chicken to serve.
Four servings, 205 calories each.
recipes.text: Sherried Chicken(Serves 6). Wash and dry chicken. Trim off fringe fat, if any. Arrange the chicken pieces skin side up in a shallow ovenproof nonstick pan. Bake in a preheated 450° oven 20 to 25 minutes, until the skin is crisp and well rendered of fat. Drain and discard fat. Add remaining ingredients to pan. Lower heat to 350°. Continue baking, basting occasionally, until chicken is tender (about 30 minutes). Spoon pan juice over chicken to serve. Four servings, 205 calories each.

recipes.title: Baked Beef Stew
directions: Place meat in oven roaster.
Put in vegetables.
Pour juice over meat and vegetables.
Sprinkle tapioca over top.
Bake at 350° for 5 hours.
recipes.text: Baked Beef Stew. Place meat in oven roaster. Put in vegetables. Pour juice over meat and vegetables. Sprinkle tapioca over top. Bake at 350° for 5 hours.

recipes.title: Grandma'S Good And Easy Goop
directions: Brown
hamburger
and boil noodles.
When hamburger and noodles
are
done,
add noodles, cheese packet, tomato paste, milk and butter to hamburger.
Simmer for 15 minutes.
recipes.text: Grandma'S Good And Easy Goop. Brown hamburger and boil noodles. When hamburger and noodles are done, add noodles, cheese packet, tomato paste, milk and butter to hamburger. Simmer for 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Sweet Gherkins
ingredients: 2 qts. small green cucumbers cut to 1 to 2-inches long
directions: Cover fresh cucumbers with hot brine made by dissolving 2 cups salt in 2 1/2 qts. boiling water.
Soak cucumbers in brime for 24 hours.
Drain.
recipes.text: Sweet Gherkins. Cover fresh cucumbers with hot brine made by dissolving 2 cups salt in 2 1/2 qts. boiling water. Soak cucumbers in brime for 24 hours. Drain.

recipes.title: Corned Beef Cheese Ball
directions: Let cream cheese reach room temperature.
Chop up corned beef. Chop up the tops of the green onions (finely).
Mix all ingredients together.
Shape into a ball.
Refrigerate.
recipes.text: Corned Beef Cheese Ball. Let cream cheese reach room temperature. Chop up corned beef. Chop up the tops of the green onions (finely). Mix all ingredients together. Shape into a ball. Refrigerate.

recipes.title: Crab Meat Balls
directions: Soften the cream cheese.
Grate Cheddar cheese.
Cut crab meat into small pieces.
Mix the two cheeses and crab meat.
Form into balls.
Roll in chopped nuts.
Refrigerate until ready to serve.
recipes.text: Crab Meat Balls. Soften the cream cheese. Grate Cheddar cheese. Cut crab meat into small pieces. Mix the two cheeses and crab meat. Form into balls. Roll in chopped nuts. Refrigerate until ready to serve.

recipes.title: Rhubarb Bread
ingredients: 1 c. sour milk (1 tsp. vinegar in 1 c. milk)
directions: Mix ingredients together, adding rhubarb and raisins last and stir them in.
Put in 2 greased loaf pans.
recipes.text: Rhubarb Bread. Mix ingredients together, adding rhubarb and raisins last and stir them in. Put in 2 greased loaf pans.

recipes.title: Green Bean Casserole
ingredients: 1 c. all purpose flour (this is a lot but the amount is correct)
directions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Drain the juice from the beans and simmer it with the bacon grease and dill seed for about 45 minutes. Pour over the beans.
Marinate overnight.
recipes.text: Green Bean Casserole. Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Drain the juice from the beans and simmer it with the bacon grease and dill seed for about 45 minutes. Pour over the beans. Marinate overnight.

recipes.title: Strawberry Dessert
ingredients: 1/2 angel food cake or pound cake
directions: May use additional strawberries and Cool Whip for decoration on top.
recipes.text: Strawberry Dessert. May use additional strawberries and Cool Whip for decoration on top.

recipes.title: Hot Water Corn Bread
directions: Mix corn
meal,
flour, sugar and salt.
Boil water for 15 minutes;
add
to mixture (should be gummy).
Use a bowl of cold water to form into corn bread ball.
recipes.text: Hot Water Corn Bread. Mix corn meal, flour, sugar and salt. Boil water for 15 minutes; add to mixture (should be gummy). Use a bowl of cold water to form into corn bread ball.

recipes.title: Cocoa Fudge
directions: Combine dry ingredients in a heavy 4-quart pan.
Stir in milk. Bring to a boil over medium heat, stirring constantly.
Boil, without stirring, until it reaches 234° (soft ball stage).
Remove from heat and add butter and vanilla.
Beat until it thickens. Add nuts.
Pour into buttered pan.
(Be careful not to overbeat.)
recipes.text: Cocoa Fudge. Combine dry ingredients in a heavy 4-quart pan. Stir in milk. Bring to a boil over medium heat, stirring constantly. Boil, without stirring, until it reaches 234° (soft ball stage). Remove from heat and add butter and vanilla. Beat until it thickens. Add nuts. Pour into buttered pan. (Be careful not to overbeat.)

recipes.title: Eagle Brand Milk
directions: Combine in blender or with mixer until smooth.
If blended to long it will get very thick.
Just add a little hot water to thin. This equals one can of eagle brand milk.
recipes.text: Eagle Brand Milk. Combine in blender or with mixer until smooth. If blended to long it will get very thick. Just add a little hot water to thin. This equals one can of eagle brand milk.

recipes.title: Sauerkraut Balls
ingredients: 1 large bag sauerkraut or 1 large can, chopped finely
2 lb. bulk sausage, browned, drained and broken up good
directions: Mix first 3 ingredients.
Refrigerate 2 hours or overnight. Roll into balls.
Place on cookie sheet; chill 2 more hours.
Dip balls into 2 eggs and 1/4 cup milk, mixed.
Roll balls in bread crumbs.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour, then deep fry.
recipes.text: Sauerkraut Balls. Mix first 3 ingredients. Refrigerate 2 hours or overnight. Roll into balls. Place on cookie sheet; chill 2 more hours. Dip balls into 2 eggs and 1/4 cup milk, mixed. Roll balls in bread crumbs. Bake at 350° for 1 hour, then deep fry.

recipes.title: Barbecue Sauce
directions: Mix all together until smooth.
If too thick, add water.
recipes.text: Barbecue Sauce. Mix all together until smooth. If too thick, add water.

recipes.title: Seashell Pasta Salad
ingredients: 1 (12 oz.) pkg. large shell pasta, cooked and cooled
1 (28 oz.) can Hunt's Choice Cut tomatoes, drained
directions: In large bowl, stir together all ingredients until well mixed. Cover; refrigerate 1 hour before serving.
Makes 10 cup salad.
recipes.text: Seashell Pasta Salad. In large bowl, stir together all ingredients until well mixed. Cover; refrigerate 1 hour before serving. Makes 10 cup salad.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Pie Cake
directions: Mix and beat well the first 6 ingredients.
Pour into a 9 x 13-inch lightly greased pan.
Sprinkle the cake mix on top.
Melt 1 1/2 cubes margarine; pour over top.
Add the desired amount of chopped nuts.
Bake at 350° for 50 minutes, until crisp and brown. Very good!
recipes.text: Pumpkin Pie Cake. Mix and beat well the first 6 ingredients. Pour into a 9 x 13-inch lightly greased pan. Sprinkle the cake mix on top. Melt 1 1/2 cubes margarine; pour over top. Add the desired amount of chopped nuts. Bake at 350° for 50 minutes, until crisp and brown. Very good!

recipes.title: My Best Fudge Frosting
directions: Mix sugar and cocoa in boiler.
Add margarine, milk, syrup and salt.
Heat to boiling, stirring frequently.
Boil vigorously 3 minutes.
Stir occasionally.
Cool.
Beat in 4x sugar and vanilla.
recipes.text: My Best Fudge Frosting. Mix sugar and cocoa in boiler. Add margarine, milk, syrup and salt. Heat to boiling, stirring frequently. Boil vigorously 3 minutes. Stir occasionally. Cool. Beat in 4x sugar and vanilla.

recipes.title: Potato Candy
ingredients: Hershey's semi-sweet chocolate bar (melt 4 parts chocolate to 1 part paraffin wax in double boiler)
1 c. pecan halves (place on top of candy)
directions: Drain water
from boiled potato.
Mash potato in sugar. (If you
use different flavors, pinch off bits.) Roll dough in long fingers.
Cut
in
1-inch pieces and dip in melted chocolate. Place on waxed paper.
Pecans are optional.
recipes.text: Potato Candy. Drain water from boiled potato. Mash potato in sugar. (If you use different flavors, pinch off bits.) Roll dough in long fingers. Cut in 1-inch pieces and dip in melted chocolate. Place on waxed paper. Pecans are optional.

recipes.title: Orange Coconut Balls
directions: Mix well and form into small balls.
Let set for 20 minutes and then roll in glaze.
recipes.text: Orange Coconut Balls. Mix well and form into small balls. Let set for 20 minutes and then roll in glaze.

recipes.title: Vegetable Salad Mold
ingredients: 2 to 4 Tbsp. finely chopped green pepper
directions: "All wholesome food is caught without a net or a trap." - William Blake
recipes.text: Vegetable Salad Mold. "All wholesome food is caught without a net or a trap." - William Blake

recipes.title: Mexican Enchilada Casserole
ingredients: 1 (10 3/4 oz.) can cream of chicken soup
1 (4.8 oz.) pkg. taco shells, coarsely crushed
directions: Heat oven to 350°.
Grease a 2-quart casserole; set aside.
In large skillet, cook meat, onion and garlic in oil over medium heat until meat is no longer pink and onion is tender.
Drain.
Stir in tomato sauce, chili powder and salt.
Heat over medium heat until bubbly.
Reduce heat to very low; simmer for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Remove from heat; set aside.
Mix Cheddar cheese and Monterey Jack cheese and set aside.
recipes.text: Mexican Enchilada Casserole. Heat oven to 350°. Grease a 2-quart casserole; set aside. In large skillet, cook meat, onion and garlic in oil over medium heat until meat is no longer pink and onion is tender. Drain. Stir in tomato sauce, chili powder and salt. Heat over medium heat until bubbly. Reduce heat to very low; simmer for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally. Remove from heat; set aside. Mix Cheddar cheese and Monterey Jack cheese and set aside.

recipes.title: Sweet Potatoes
directions: Mix and pour into buttered casserole dish.
recipes.text: Sweet Potatoes. Mix and pour into buttered casserole dish.

recipes.title: Layered Pudding Dessert
directions: Mix together first 3 ingredients.
Add chocolate chips and bake in a 375° oven until brown.
Cool.
recipes.text: Layered Pudding Dessert. Mix together first 3 ingredients. Add chocolate chips and bake in a 375° oven until brown. Cool.

recipes.title: Lemon Meringue Pie
directions: Moisten the cornstarch with 1/4 cup of water.
Boil together the remaining water and sugar.
Add the moistened cornstarch and cook for 5 minutes, stirring constantly.
Cool slightly; add the grated rind and strained juice of the lemons, also the beaten egg yolks.
recipes.text: Lemon Meringue Pie. Moisten the cornstarch with 1/4 cup of water. Boil together the remaining water and sugar. Add the moistened cornstarch and cook for 5 minutes, stirring constantly. Cool slightly; add the grated rind and strained juice of the lemons, also the beaten egg yolks.

recipes.title: Cheese Logs
ingredients: paprika, chili powder or steak seasoning for rolling
directions: Blend all ingredients together.
Shape into a roll about 5 inches long and 1-1/2 inch.
Roll in paprika, chili powder, or steak seasoning.
Chill and slice.
recipes.text: Cheese Logs. Blend all ingredients together. Shape into a roll about 5 inches long and 1-1/2 inch. Roll in paprika, chili powder, or steak seasoning. Chill and slice.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Pie
directions: Mix cream cheese and sugar, then add peanut butter and mix well.
Fold in 1/2 carton Cool Whip.
Pour mixture into graham cracker crust.
Add remaining Cool Whip on top.
Refrigerate pie.
recipes.text: Peanut Butter Pie. Mix cream cheese and sugar, then add peanut butter and mix well. Fold in 1/2 carton Cool Whip. Pour mixture into graham cracker crust. Add remaining Cool Whip on top. Refrigerate pie.

recipes.title: Carrot Bread
directions: Heat oven to 350°.
Grease a loaf pan.
Assemble blender. Sift flour, baking soda, cinnamon and salt into a large mixing bowl.
Set aside.
Blend chopped nuts.
Add to dry ingredients. Put eggs, sugar, oil and vanilla extract into container, cover and process at mix until smooth.
Stop blender, add carrot pieces, cover and process at liquefy.
Pour over dry ingredients and mix only until dry ingredients are moistened.
Pour into prepared pan and bake 1 hour or until cake tester comes out clean.
Cool 5 minutes in pan, then turn out on cake rack and cool.
recipes.text: Carrot Bread. Heat oven to 350°. Grease a loaf pan. Assemble blender. Sift flour, baking soda, cinnamon and salt into a large mixing bowl. Set aside. Blend chopped nuts. Add to dry ingredients. Put eggs, sugar, oil and vanilla extract into container, cover and process at mix until smooth. Stop blender, add carrot pieces, cover and process at liquefy. Pour over dry ingredients and mix only until dry ingredients are moistened. Pour into prepared pan and bake 1 hour or until cake tester comes out clean. Cool 5 minutes in pan, then turn out on cake rack and cool.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Fudge
directions: Boil sugar, milk and butter to soft ball stage.
Remove from heat and add peanut butter and marshmallow cream.
Beat until ready to pour.
recipes.text: Peanut Butter Fudge. Boil sugar, milk and butter to soft ball stage. Remove from heat and add peanut butter and marshmallow cream. Beat until ready to pour.

recipes.title: Grits Casserole
ingredients: 2 eggs, well beaten, add milk to eggs to total 1 c.
directions: Cook grits in boiling water per directions on grit package. Add butter and cheese. Stir until
melted. Add eggs, beaten with milk. Stir until blended.
Pour into greased casserole. Bake 40 to 45 minutes in a 325° oven.
recipes.text: Grits Casserole. Cook grits in boiling water per directions on grit package. Add butter and cheese. Stir until melted. Add eggs, beaten with milk. Stir until blended. Pour into greased casserole. Bake 40 to 45 minutes in a 325° oven.

recipes.title: Toss It To Me
directions: Combine tomato sauce and spaghetti sauce mix in bowl; mix well.
Alternate layers of noodles, turkey, cheese and sauce in greased casserole.
Top with frankfurters. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Toss It To Me. Combine tomato sauce and spaghetti sauce mix in bowl; mix well. Alternate layers of noodles, turkey, cheese and sauce in greased casserole. Top with frankfurters. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Chicken Cacciatore
ingredients: 1 can whole tomatoes (remove seeds, cut up, reserve in liquid)
directions: Brown chicken in oil 8 minutes each side.
Remove from heat. Add mushrooms and onions.
Saute.
Add garlic, wine and vinegar. Cook on medium heat.
Almost all evaporated 5 minutes.
Stir in broth, basil, marjoram, salt and pepper.
Add tomatoes into onion mixture.
Cook 2 minutes.
Pour over chicken.
Cook on low 25 minutes.
Remove chicken.
Heat liquid to a boil for 5 minutes. Add olives and parsley to sauce.
Pour over chicken and serve.
recipes.text: Chicken Cacciatore. Brown chicken in oil 8 minutes each side. Remove from heat. Add mushrooms and onions. Saute. Add garlic, wine and vinegar. Cook on medium heat. Almost all evaporated 5 minutes. Stir in broth, basil, marjoram, salt and pepper. Add tomatoes into onion mixture. Cook 2 minutes. Pour over chicken. Cook on low 25 minutes. Remove chicken. Heat liquid to a boil for 5 minutes. Add olives and parsley to sauce. Pour over chicken and serve.

recipes.title: Caramels
directions: Mix in a large heavy pot and start cooking at medium high temperature.
Stir continuously.
When mixture comes to full boil, continue to stir and cook for 8 minutes.
Having pregreased a 9 x 13 x 1/2-inch cookie sheet, pour in cooked mixture.
Allow to set until cooled and cut into desired sizes and wrap in wax paper.
recipes.text: Caramels. Mix in a large heavy pot and start cooking at medium high temperature. Stir continuously. When mixture comes to full boil, continue to stir and cook for 8 minutes. Having pregreased a 9 x 13 x 1/2-inch cookie sheet, pour in cooked mixture. Allow to set until cooled and cut into desired sizes and wrap in wax paper.

recipes.title: Zucchini Bread
directions: Combine first 5 ingredients; set aside. Combine eggs, sugar, oil and vanilla in a large bowl. Beat at medium speed of electric mixer until well blended. Stir in zucchini and pecans. Add dry ingredients, stirring just until moistened. Spoon batter into 3 greased and floured 1-pound coffee cans. Bake at 350° for 55 to 60 minutes.
recipes.text: Zucchini Bread. Combine first 5 ingredients; set aside. Combine eggs, sugar, oil and vanilla in a large bowl. Beat at medium speed of electric mixer until well blended. Stir in zucchini and pecans. Add dry ingredients, stirring just until moistened. Spoon batter into 3 greased and floured 1-pound coffee cans. Bake at 350° for 55 to 60 minutes.

recipes.title: Hot Chocolate Mix
ingredients: 1 (8 qt.) pkg. instant nonfat dry milk
directions: Mix well.
Store in airtight container in dry place.
Use 1/3 cup of mix to 1 cup hot water.
For variety, instant coffee or a dash of cinnamon may be added to dry mix.
recipes.text: Hot Chocolate Mix. Mix well. Store in airtight container in dry place. Use 1/3 cup of mix to 1 cup hot water. For variety, instant coffee or a dash of cinnamon may be added to dry mix.

recipes.title: Microwave Applesauce
ingredients: 4 medium apples, peeled, cored and quartered
directions: Place apples and water in 1 1/2-quart casserole.
Microwave on High for 5 minutes.
Stir.
Cook 5 minutes longer on High.
recipes.text: Microwave Applesauce. Place apples and water in 1 1/2-quart casserole. Microwave on High for 5 minutes. Stir. Cook 5 minutes longer on High.

recipes.title: Chicken And Rice(Spanish)
directions: Cut up chicken as for frying. Put olive oil in deep frying pan and heat gradually. Add garlic cloves. When garlic begins to color, lay in chicken and turn several times until golden brown all over; add peppers, cut in strips, and onions, sliced. Continue cooking until onions are colored. Add tomatoes, skinned and quartered, and rice; add water or stock sufficient to cover. Salt to taste and simmer until tender. Add more stock if necessary.
recipes.text: Chicken And Rice(Spanish). Cut up chicken as for frying. Put olive oil in deep frying pan and heat gradually. Add garlic cloves. When garlic begins to color, lay in chicken and turn several times until golden brown all over; add peppers, cut in strips, and onions, sliced. Continue cooking until onions are colored. Add tomatoes, skinned and quartered, and rice; add water or stock sufficient to cover. Salt to taste and simmer until tender. Add more stock if necessary.

recipes.title: Pickled Coleslaw
directions: Mix together in a large bowl the cabbage, green pepper, onion, sugar and carrots.
Boil together the vinegar, oil and salt.
Pour over cabbage mixture and mix well.
Marinate a few hours.
recipes.text: Pickled Coleslaw. Mix together in a large bowl the cabbage, green pepper, onion, sugar and carrots. Boil together the vinegar, oil and salt. Pour over cabbage mixture and mix well. Marinate a few hours.

recipes.title: Shrimp Salad
directions: Combine salt, mustard, chili sauce, onion, parsley and salad dressing.
Marinate cooked macaroni in mixture 15 minutes.
Add shrimp, eggs and cucumber.
Toss together lightly.
Chill well. Serve on lettuce leaves.
recipes.text: Shrimp Salad. Combine salt, mustard, chili sauce, onion, parsley and salad dressing. Marinate cooked macaroni in mixture 15 minutes. Add shrimp, eggs and cucumber. Toss together lightly. Chill well. Serve on lettuce leaves.

recipes.title: Monkey Bread
directions: Combine milk, 1/2 of margarine, sugar and salt in a saucepan. Heat until margarine is melted.
Cool to 105° to 115°.
Stir in yeast until dissolved.
Place flour in a large bowl.
Make a well in the flour and pour in liquid mixture.
Stir until blended. Cover and let rise until double in bulk (about 1 1/2 hours).
recipes.text: Monkey Bread. Combine milk, 1/2 of margarine, sugar and salt in a saucepan. Heat until margarine is melted. Cool to 105° to 115°. Stir in yeast until dissolved. Place flour in a large bowl. Make a well in the flour and pour in liquid mixture. Stir until blended. Cover and let rise until double in bulk (about 1 1/2 hours).

recipes.title: Watermelon Cake
directions: This historic recipe has been transcribed from the original text in the 1883 version of the First Texas Cookbook.
recipes.text: Watermelon Cake. This historic recipe has been transcribed from the original text in the 1883 version of the First Texas Cookbook.

recipes.title: Lemon Chess Pie
directions: Mix sugar, corn meal and flour.
Add remaining ingredients and beat well.
Pour into 9-inch unbaked pie shell.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Lemon Chess Pie. Mix sugar, corn meal and flour. Add remaining ingredients and beat well. Pour into 9-inch unbaked pie shell. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Sour Cream Enchilada Casserole
directions: Brown meat and drain off excess fat.
Combine onion, spices and relish with meat; set aside.
Make white sauce by melting butter in a skillet, stirring in flour, then milk.
Bring to a boil or heat until thick.
Remove from heat and stir in sour cream.
Grease a casserole dish and prepare 2 layers like this: three tortillas in pieces, 1/2 the sour cream sauce, 1/2 the meat mixture and 1/2 cup grated cheese.
Repeat these layers.
Bake at 375° for about 20 minutes.
Remove from oven and let set 20 minutes before serving.
recipes.text: Sour Cream Enchilada Casserole. Brown meat and drain off excess fat. Combine onion, spices and relish with meat; set aside. Make white sauce by melting butter in a skillet, stirring in flour, then milk. Bring to a boil or heat until thick. Remove from heat and stir in sour cream. Grease a casserole dish and prepare 2 layers like this: three tortillas in pieces, 1/2 the sour cream sauce, 1/2 the meat mixture and 1/2 cup grated cheese. Repeat these layers. Bake at 375° for about 20 minutes. Remove from oven and let set 20 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Our Favorite Tuna Noodle Casserole
ingredients: 3 c. noodles (6 oz.) cooked and drained
7 oz. tuna, or more (Solid pack not chunk)
directions: In a saucepan, blend 1 can cream of celery soup and 1/2 cup milk, then add 4 ozs. sharp cheddar cheese, shredded, (1 cup). Stir until cheese melts on low heat.
Pour into the noodle mixture and turn into a 2 quart casserole.
Top with bread crumbs (we use the Italian style).
Bake at 425° for 25 minutes.
recipes.text: Our Favorite Tuna Noodle Casserole. In a saucepan, blend 1 can cream of celery soup and 1/2 cup milk, then add 4 ozs. sharp cheddar cheese, shredded, (1 cup). Stir until cheese melts on low heat. Pour into the noodle mixture and turn into a 2 quart casserole. Top with bread crumbs (we use the Italian style). Bake at 425° for 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Potatoes A La Harriet
directions: Parboil the potatoes.
Let potatoes become cold and then grate in casserole dish.
Pour in whipping cream and add butter, salt and pepper.
Mix.
Bake in a 350° oven until potatoes are done. Best when potatoes are not too soft.
Serves 4.
recipes.text: Potatoes A La Harriet. Parboil the potatoes. Let potatoes become cold and then grate in casserole dish. Pour in whipping cream and add butter, salt and pepper. Mix. Bake in a 350° oven until potatoes are done. Best when potatoes are not too soft. Serves 4.

recipes.title: Impossible Turkey Pie
directions: Heat oven to 400°.
Lightly grease pie plate (10 1/2 x 1 1/2-inch).
Beat remaining ingredients after you sprinkle turkey, mushrooms, onions, salt and cheese in pie plate.
Pour into pie plate.
Bake until golden brown and knife inserted halfway between center and edge comes out clean, 30 to 35 minutes.
Let stand 5 minutes before serving.
Refrigerate any remaining pie.
recipes.text: Impossible Turkey Pie. Heat oven to 400°. Lightly grease pie plate (10 1/2 x 1 1/2-inch). Beat remaining ingredients after you sprinkle turkey, mushrooms, onions, salt and cheese in pie plate. Pour into pie plate. Bake until golden brown and knife inserted halfway between center and edge comes out clean, 30 to 35 minutes. Let stand 5 minutes before serving. Refrigerate any remaining pie.

recipes.title: Rhubarb Cake
directions: Prepare cake mix as directed on package.
Pour into a 9 x 13-inch pan, greased and floured.
Over top of cake mix, sprinkle chopped rhubarb.
Sprinkle sugar over rhubarb and pour 1 pint whipping cream over top of sugar.
Bake at 350° for 45 to 60 minutes, or until done.
Top with Cool Whip.
recipes.text: Rhubarb Cake. Prepare cake mix as directed on package. Pour into a 9 x 13-inch pan, greased and floured. Over top of cake mix, sprinkle chopped rhubarb. Sprinkle sugar over rhubarb and pour 1 pint whipping cream over top of sugar. Bake at 350° for 45 to 60 minutes, or until done. Top with Cool Whip.

recipes.title: Pasta A' Figiol(Italian Soup)
directions: Simmer until pasta is done.
recipes.text: Pasta A' Figiol(Italian Soup). Simmer until pasta is done.

recipes.title: Sausage Balls
directions: Mix ingredients and roll into balls the size of walnuts.
Bake on ungreased cookie sheet 15 to 20 minutes at 350°.
recipes.text: Sausage Balls. Mix ingredients and roll into balls the size of walnuts. Bake on ungreased cookie sheet 15 to 20 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Fantasy Fudge
directions: Bring sugar, butter and milk to a boil over medium heat. Stirring constantly, boil 5 minutes.
Remove from heat and using a wooden spoon, add salt, marshmallow cream, chocolate chips and nuts.
Stir vigorously until well blended, melted and smooth. Pour onto greased pan.
Cool and cut into squares.
recipes.text: Fantasy Fudge. Bring sugar, butter and milk to a boil over medium heat. Stirring constantly, boil 5 minutes. Remove from heat and using a wooden spoon, add salt, marshmallow cream, chocolate chips and nuts. Stir vigorously until well blended, melted and smooth. Pour onto greased pan. Cool and cut into squares.

recipes.title: Coconut-Pineapple Cake
directions: Bake cake mix in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Cool.
Drain pineapple and spread over top of cake.
Prepare
instant pudding according to directions.
Pour over layer of pineapple. Sprinkle part of coconut and nuts on top of pudding.
Spread on Cool Whip. Sprinkle with more coconut and nuts.
recipes.text: Coconut-Pineapple Cake. Bake cake mix in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Cool. Drain pineapple and spread over top of cake. Prepare instant pudding according to directions. Pour over layer of pineapple. Sprinkle part of coconut and nuts on top of pudding. Spread on Cool Whip. Sprinkle with more coconut and nuts.

recipes.title: Tasty Tomato Soup(Microwave)
directions: Combine all ingredients in a quart measure container. Microwave on High, uncovered, for 5 to 6 minutes or until it begins to boil.
Remove bay leaf and clove; serve.
Two to three servings.
recipes.text: Tasty Tomato Soup(Microwave). Combine all ingredients in a quart measure container. Microwave on High, uncovered, for 5 to 6 minutes or until it begins to boil. Remove bay leaf and clove; serve. Two to three servings.

recipes.title: Apple Jack
directions: Mix together with fork the first 5 ingredients until crumbly. Sprinkle over sliced apples in pie plate (9-inch size).
Melt 1/3 cup oleo.
Pour over top; also sprinkle on 1/2 to 1 teaspoon cinnamon.
Bake for 30 to 40 minutes in 350° oven or until apples are tender.
recipes.text: Apple Jack. Mix together with fork the first 5 ingredients until crumbly. Sprinkle over sliced apples in pie plate (9-inch size). Melt 1/3 cup oleo. Pour over top; also sprinkle on 1/2 to 1 teaspoon cinnamon. Bake for 30 to 40 minutes in 350° oven or until apples are tender.

recipes.title: Pineapple Cheese Salad
directions: Dissolve jello in hot water.
Mix other ingredients and add to jello.
Congeal and serve on lettuce leaf with mayonnaise. Chopped maraschino cherries may be added for color if desired.
recipes.text: Pineapple Cheese Salad. Dissolve jello in hot water. Mix other ingredients and add to jello. Congeal and serve on lettuce leaf with mayonnaise. Chopped maraschino cherries may be added for color if desired.

recipes.title: Chicken Breasts Parmesan
ingredients: 2 sticks margarine or 1 c. oil (I mix half each)
directions: Dip salted and peppered chicken (I cut mine into bite size pieces) into flour and then egg (I add a little milk to the egg mixture).
Roll in mixed bread crumbs and Parmesan cheese.
Fry over low heat about 10 minutes.
recipes.text: Chicken Breasts Parmesan. Dip salted and peppered chicken (I cut mine into bite size pieces) into flour and then egg (I add a little milk to the egg mixture). Roll in mixed bread crumbs and Parmesan cheese. Fry over low heat about 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Ham And Cheese Appetizers
ingredients: 3/4 c. finely chopped, fully cooked smoked ham
1 c. shredded Swiss or Cheddar cheese (about 4 oz.)
directions: Heat oven to 350°.
Grease rectangular 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Mix all ingredients and spread in pan.
Bake until golden brown for 25 to 30 minutes.
Cut into rectangles about 2 x 1 1/2-inches. Serve warm (keep warm by placing on a warming tray).
Makes approximately 36.
recipes.text: Ham And Cheese Appetizers. Heat oven to 350°. Grease rectangular 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Mix all ingredients and spread in pan. Bake until golden brown for 25 to 30 minutes. Cut into rectangles about 2 x 1 1/2-inches. Serve warm (keep warm by placing on a warming tray). Makes approximately 36.

recipes.title: Strawberry Soup
ingredients: 15 oz. pkg. frozen strawberries, thawed (with juice)
directions: Mix strawberries and sour cream.
Beat slowly until well mixed. Add grenadine, vanilla and sugar while mixing until smooth consistency.
Add half and half last, mixing only until well blended.
Chill and serve.
Shake well before serving.
Serves 6.
recipes.text: Strawberry Soup. Mix strawberries and sour cream. Beat slowly until well mixed. Add grenadine, vanilla and sugar while mixing until smooth consistency. Add half and half last, mixing only until well blended. Chill and serve. Shake well before serving. Serves 6.

recipes.title: Beef Roni
directions: Brown onions in oleo.
Add ground beef and brown lightly.
Add other ingredients and bring to a boil.
Add macaroni; cover and cook 10 minutes.
Uncover and cook until thick.
recipes.text: Beef Roni. Brown onions in oleo. Add ground beef and brown lightly. Add other ingredients and bring to a boil. Add macaroni; cover and cook 10 minutes. Uncover and cook until thick.

recipes.title: Chili Con Queso
ingredients: 1 small jar Cheez Whiz and peppers
directions: Bring to a boil and serve with corn chips.
recipes.text: Chili Con Queso. Bring to a boil and serve with corn chips.

recipes.title: Parsley-Parmesan Baked Chicken
directions: Pour salad dressing in 13 x 9 x 2-inch dish.
Add chicken and coat well.
Cover and refrigerate 4 hours.
Occasionally spoon dressing over chicken.
Drain; reserve dressing.
Combine egg and water in separate bowl.
In plastic bag (Ziploc), combine cheese, bread crumbs, parsley, salt, pepper and paprika.
Dip chicken in egg mixture, then shake in crumb mixture.
Return coated chicken to baking dish and spoon reserved dressing over chicken.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes or until chicken is tender and golden brown.
recipes.text: Parsley-Parmesan Baked Chicken. Pour salad dressing in 13 x 9 x 2-inch dish. Add chicken and coat well. Cover and refrigerate 4 hours. Occasionally spoon dressing over chicken. Drain; reserve dressing. Combine egg and water in separate bowl. In plastic bag (Ziploc), combine cheese, bread crumbs, parsley, salt, pepper and paprika. Dip chicken in egg mixture, then shake in crumb mixture. Return coated chicken to baking dish and spoon reserved dressing over chicken. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes or until chicken is tender and golden brown.

recipes.title: Orange Julius
directions: Some women keep their husbands constantly in hot water. Some let
them
freeze by carelessness and indifference.
Some keep them in a stew by irritating ways, while others keep them in a pickle
all their lives.
See that the linen in which you wrap him in
is
nicely
washed
and
mended.
Tie
him with a strong silken
cord
called comfort.
Make a clear steady fire of love, neatness and cheerfulness.
Set your husband as near this as seems to
agree with him.
If he sputters and fizzes, don't be anxious. Some
do
this
until they are done.
Add a little sugar
called "kisses",
but
very
little
vinegar or pepper, if
any.
A little
spice
might
be
nice.
Stir him gently.
You cannot fail
to
know
when he is done.
He will keep indefinitely, unless he is set in too cool a place.
recipes.text: Orange Julius. Some women keep their husbands constantly in hot water. Some let them freeze by carelessness and indifference. Some keep them in a stew by irritating ways, while others keep them in a pickle all their lives. See that the linen in which you wrap him in is nicely washed and mended. Tie him with a strong silken cord called comfort. Make a clear steady fire of love, neatness and cheerfulness. Set your husband as near this as seems to agree with him. If he sputters and fizzes, don't be anxious. Some do this until they are done. Add a little sugar called "kisses", but very little vinegar or pepper, if any. A little spice might be nice. Stir him gently. You cannot fail to know when he is done. He will keep indefinitely, unless he is set in too cool a place.

recipes.title: Mercers Chocolate Marshmallow Pie
ingredients: 1 Tbsp. lemon juice (not concentrate) or rum or orange juice or 1 Tbsp. of any juice you prefer
1 c. Cool Whip or whipped cream
directions: Cook marshmallows, milk, cocoa and pinch of salt in double boiler until marshmallows dissolve. Cool. Add vanilla, lemon juice or rum or orange juice or 1 tablespoon of any juice you prefer. Fold in Cool Whip or whipped cream. Pour in a baked pie shell and chill. Cover with Cool Whip or whipped cream and top with pecans.
recipes.text: Mercers Chocolate Marshmallow Pie. Cook marshmallows, milk, cocoa and pinch of salt in double boiler until marshmallows dissolve. Cool. Add vanilla, lemon juice or rum or orange juice or 1 tablespoon of any juice you prefer. Fold in Cool Whip or whipped cream. Pour in a baked pie shell and chill. Cover with Cool Whip or whipped cream and top with pecans.

recipes.title: Unrolled Cabbage Rolls
directions: Spray pan, add onion and garlic, saute.
Add broth and rice. Bring to a boil and simmer for 25 minutes.
Pre-cook cabbage and chop.
Combine browned meat rice, egg white, parsley, margarine, salt and pepper.
Mix well.
Spray 3 quart casserole, line with half of the cabbage.
Layer meat mixture, then rest of the cabbage.
Mix soup and water and pour over cabbage.
Cover and bake at 350 for one hour, then for 45 minutes at 325.
recipes.text: Unrolled Cabbage Rolls. Spray pan, add onion and garlic, saute. Add broth and rice. Bring to a boil and simmer for 25 minutes. Pre-cook cabbage and chop. Combine browned meat rice, egg white, parsley, margarine, salt and pepper. Mix well. Spray 3 quart casserole, line with half of the cabbage. Layer meat mixture, then rest of the cabbage. Mix soup and water and pour over cabbage. Cover and bake at 350 for one hour, then for 45 minutes at 325.

recipes.title: Barbecue Chicken Sauce
directions: Combine all ingredients in a saucepan and cook over low flame for about 10 minutes. Stir.
recipes.text: Barbecue Chicken Sauce. Combine all ingredients in a saucepan and cook over low flame for about 10 minutes. Stir.

recipes.title: Cherry Fudge Bars
ingredients: 1 (4 oz.) pkg. chocolate pudding and pie filling
directions: Heat oven to 350°.
In a large saucepan, cook pudding as directed on the package.
Blend cake mix (dry) thoroughly into hot pudding, by hand or with electric mixer, for 1 to 2 minutes.
Add cherries.
Pour into greased and floured jelly roll pan, 15 1/2 x 10 1/2 x 1-inch.
Sprinkle with nuts and chocolate pieces.
Bake 25 to 30 minutes.
Cool and cut into bars.
Makes 40.
recipes.text: Cherry Fudge Bars. Heat oven to 350°. In a large saucepan, cook pudding as directed on the package. Blend cake mix (dry) thoroughly into hot pudding, by hand or with electric mixer, for 1 to 2 minutes. Add cherries. Pour into greased and floured jelly roll pan, 15 1/2 x 10 1/2 x 1-inch. Sprinkle with nuts and chocolate pieces. Bake 25 to 30 minutes. Cool and cut into bars. Makes 40.

recipes.title: Mandarin Orange Jello
directions: Mix orange jello, sugar, boiling water and orange juice.
Let set partially.
Add the mandarin oranges and pineapple to the jello.
Let set until solid.
While jello is setting, mix the vanilla pudding with 1 cup milk.
Let set.
Fold in the Cool Whip.
Spread onto set jello mixture and chill.
recipes.text: Mandarin Orange Jello. Mix orange jello, sugar, boiling water and orange juice. Let set partially. Add the mandarin oranges and pineapple to the jello. Let set until solid. While jello is setting, mix the vanilla pudding with 1 cup milk. Let set. Fold in the Cool Whip. Spread onto set jello mixture and chill.

recipes.title: Angel Pie
directions: Whip Eagle Brand milk and juice of 2 lemons.
Fold in whipped cream with sugar added.
Add pecans and fold in pineapple.
Pour into 2 cooked pie shells (or 2 graham cracker crusts).
Chill.
recipes.text: Angel Pie. Whip Eagle Brand milk and juice of 2 lemons. Fold in whipped cream with sugar added. Add pecans and fold in pineapple. Pour into 2 cooked pie shells (or 2 graham cracker crusts). Chill.

recipes.title: Waffles
directions: Mix flour, corn meal, salt and baking powder. Add 1 c. milk and egg yolk, Stir until smooth and add remaining milk. Fold in stiffly beaten egg whites. Have waffle iron smoking hot.
recipes.text: Waffles. Mix flour, corn meal, salt and baking powder. Add 1 c. milk and egg yolk, Stir until smooth and add remaining milk. Fold in stiffly beaten egg whites. Have waffle iron smoking hot.

recipes.title: Cheesy Peach Pie
directions: Beat cream cheese until creamy.
Then add Eagle Brand milk, lemon juice and vanilla.
Beat until smooth.
Stir in Cool Whip. Pour over pie crust.
Let set.
Then top with pie filling.
Chill before serving.
recipes.text: Cheesy Peach Pie. Beat cream cheese until creamy. Then add Eagle Brand milk, lemon juice and vanilla. Beat until smooth. Stir in Cool Whip. Pour over pie crust. Let set. Then top with pie filling. Chill before serving.

recipes.title: Pecan Trout
directions: Lightly flour fillets. In a large skillet melt 2 Tbsp. butter. Fry fillets over medium heat for 2 minutes on each side. remove fish from pan and keep warm. In a small saucepan, melt 1/3 c. butter and add remaining ingredients. Stir until well blended. Pour sauce over trout. Serves 4.
recipes.text: Pecan Trout. Lightly flour fillets. In a large skillet melt 2 Tbsp. butter. Fry fillets over medium heat for 2 minutes on each side. remove fish from pan and keep warm. In a small saucepan, melt 1/3 c. butter and add remaining ingredients. Stir until well blended. Pour sauce over trout. Serves 4.

recipes.title: Apple Daffle Cake
directions: Blend eggs, oil and sugar.
Sift flour, salt and soda; add to first mixture.
Stir in apples, nuts and vanilla.
Spread batter in greased 9 x 13-inch pan.
Bake at 350° for 35 to 45 minutes or until done.
Remove via oven.
Pour on topping.
recipes.text: Apple Daffle Cake. Blend eggs, oil and sugar. Sift flour, salt and soda; add to first mixture. Stir in apples, nuts and vanilla. Spread batter in greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350° for 35 to 45 minutes or until done. Remove via oven. Pour on topping.

recipes.title: Baked Beans Supreme
ingredients: 1 (15 1/2 oz.) can butter beans with molasses sauce and bacon
1 (15 1/2 oz.) can red kidney beans, drained
1 (8 oz.) can sliced water chestnuts, drained
directions: If using a low watt oven, first check the oven cavity to be sure it will hold a 3-quart microwave-safe casserole.
recipes.text: Baked Beans Supreme. If using a low watt oven, first check the oven cavity to be sure it will hold a 3-quart microwave-safe casserole.

recipes.title: Beef Stew
ingredients: 1 1/2 to 2 lb. stew meat or round steak
directions: Dredge meat in flour after cutting meat in 1 to 2-inch cubes. Brown in 2 to 3 tablespoons hot oil in large cooking pot.
Saute garlic with meat.
Brown meat on all sides.
Add tomatoes, water and spices.
Bring to low simmer.
Cook 1 1/2 hours until meat is tender.
Add diced vegetables (other vegetables may be added according to taste).
Cook 45 minutes or longer until tender.
recipes.text: Beef Stew. Dredge meat in flour after cutting meat in 1 to 2-inch cubes. Brown in 2 to 3 tablespoons hot oil in large cooking pot. Saute garlic with meat. Brown meat on all sides. Add tomatoes, water and spices. Bring to low simmer. Cook 1 1/2 hours until meat is tender. Add diced vegetables (other vegetables may be added according to taste). Cook 45 minutes or longer until tender.

recipes.title: Garlic Chicken
directions: Place poultry in an ovenproof pan.
Mix all other ingredients and pour over chicken.
Cook in 400° oven 1 hour or until done.
recipes.text: Garlic Chicken. Place poultry in an ovenproof pan. Mix all other ingredients and pour over chicken. Cook in 400° oven 1 hour or until done.

recipes.title: Macaroni Salad
ingredients: enough fat-free mayonnaise to moisten salad
directions: Mix all ingredients together.
Serve on lettuce leaves.
recipes.text: Macaroni Salad. Mix all ingredients together. Serve on lettuce leaves.

recipes.title: Cheese Strata
ingredients: 1 1/2 c. sharp or extra sharp cheese, sliced
directions: Quarter bread and lay in an 11 1/2 x 7 1/2 x 1 1/2-inch or 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish.
Alternate layers of bread and cheese (usually 2 layers each), ending with cheese.
Mix rest of ingredients and pour over bread and cheese.
Cover and chill overnight or at least 6 hours.
Bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes. When finished baking, let stand 30 to 45 minutes until firm, then serve.
recipes.text: Cheese Strata. Quarter bread and lay in an 11 1/2 x 7 1/2 x 1 1/2-inch or 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish. Alternate layers of bread and cheese (usually 2 layers each), ending with cheese. Mix rest of ingredients and pour over bread and cheese. Cover and chill overnight or at least 6 hours. Bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes. When finished baking, let stand 30 to 45 minutes until firm, then serve.

recipes.title: Fruit Crunch
directions: Mix the melted margarine with brown sugar, flour, oats, salt and baking powder. Grease a 13 x 9-inch pan and press 2/3 of the crumb mixture into pan. Set aside.
recipes.text: Fruit Crunch. Mix the melted margarine with brown sugar, flour, oats, salt and baking powder. Grease a 13 x 9-inch pan and press 2/3 of the crumb mixture into pan. Set aside.

recipes.title: Brownies
directions: Mix all ingredients together and bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Brownies. Mix all ingredients together and bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Red Bean Toss
directions: Combine first 6 ingredients. Blend mayonnaise and Worcestershire sauce in a small bowl. Toss with bean mixture. Sprinkle with corn chips.
Bake at 375° for 25 minutes.
recipes.text: Red Bean Toss. Combine first 6 ingredients. Blend mayonnaise and Worcestershire sauce in a small bowl. Toss with bean mixture. Sprinkle with corn chips. Bake at 375° for 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Hot Spinach Spread
ingredients: 10 oz. frozen spinach, thawed, drained and squeezed
directions: Mix together over stove.
Serve warm with crackers.
recipes.text: Hot Spinach Spread. Mix together over stove. Serve warm with crackers.

recipes.title: Monkey Bread
directions: Start 2 hours early.
Dissolve dry yeast in lukewarm water. Add egg, sugar, salt and flour.
Let rise 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Monkey Bread. Start 2 hours early. Dissolve dry yeast in lukewarm water. Add egg, sugar, salt and flour. Let rise 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Sauerkraut Salad
ingredients: 1 1/2 c. sugar (half white and half brown)
2/3 c. vinegar (half wine and half cider vinegar)
directions: Bring sugar and vinegars to a boil, then chill.
Wash kraut well and drain.
Combine with green pepper, onion, celery and pimento.
Add vinegar-sugar mixture and chill for a couple of hours or overnight.
recipes.text: Sauerkraut Salad. Bring sugar and vinegars to a boil, then chill. Wash kraut well and drain. Combine with green pepper, onion, celery and pimento. Add vinegar-sugar mixture and chill for a couple of hours or overnight.

recipes.title: Cheese Ball
ingredients: 1/2 tsp. minced onion or dry onion
directions: Mix together the first 3 ingredients; let stand for 1 hour and add the remaining ingredients.
Beat until fluffy.
Take hands and form a ball.
Slice.
recipes.text: Cheese Ball. Mix together the first 3 ingredients; let stand for 1 hour and add the remaining ingredients. Beat until fluffy. Take hands and form a ball. Slice.

recipes.title: Black Cherry Pie
directions: Line bottom and sides of pan with whole vanilla wafers, standing up wafers to form crust.
Crumble some wafers and fill spaces between bottom cookie layer to make crust.
Mix lemon juice and Eagle Brand milk; stir until thick.
Spread even over crust. Drain cherries and spread over top of filling; press down in filling.
Whip and sweeten cream and spread over top.
Crumble a few vanilla wafers and sprinkle over top.
Store in refrigerator.
recipes.text: Black Cherry Pie. Line bottom and sides of pan with whole vanilla wafers, standing up wafers to form crust. Crumble some wafers and fill spaces between bottom cookie layer to make crust. Mix lemon juice and Eagle Brand milk; stir until thick. Spread even over crust. Drain cherries and spread over top of filling; press down in filling. Whip and sweeten cream and spread over top. Crumble a few vanilla wafers and sprinkle over top. Store in refrigerator.

recipes.title: Stuffed Peppers
directions: Remove seeds from pepper; parboil 10 minutes and drain.
Brown meat; drain.
Add 1 can tomatoes, bread crumbs and seasoning; mix well.
Stuff peppers with mixture.
Place in baking dish.
Blend cornstarch with second can of tomatoes.
Cook, stirring, until thickened.
Pour over peppers.
Bake at 350° for 25 minutes or until tender.
recipes.text: Stuffed Peppers. Remove seeds from pepper; parboil 10 minutes and drain. Brown meat; drain. Add 1 can tomatoes, bread crumbs and seasoning; mix well. Stuff peppers with mixture. Place in baking dish. Blend cornstarch with second can of tomatoes. Cook, stirring, until thickened. Pour over peppers. Bake at 350° for 25 minutes or until tender.

recipes.title: Dog Biscuits(For Sam!)
directions: Combine flours, milk powder, oats, cornmeal and sugar.
Cut in shortening so the mixture is crumbly.
Stir in egg.
Stir bouillon in hot water until dissolved.
Slowly add to flour mixture.
Form a dough ball and knead 5 minutes.
Divide dough in half and roll out 1/2-inch thick.
Make cutouts or 5 dozen nuggets.
Place on plate and microwave on Medium for 5 to 10 minutes, until firm and dry to touch.
Rotate plate every 2 minutes and turn shapes over when halfway done.
Cool and shapes will turn crisp as they cool.
Makes 1 1/2 dozen cutouts.
recipes.text: Dog Biscuits(For Sam!). Combine flours, milk powder, oats, cornmeal and sugar. Cut in shortening so the mixture is crumbly. Stir in egg. Stir bouillon in hot water until dissolved. Slowly add to flour mixture. Form a dough ball and knead 5 minutes. Divide dough in half and roll out 1/2-inch thick. Make cutouts or 5 dozen nuggets. Place on plate and microwave on Medium for 5 to 10 minutes, until firm and dry to touch. Rotate plate every 2 minutes and turn shapes over when halfway done. Cool and shapes will turn crisp as they cool. Makes 1 1/2 dozen cutouts.

recipes.title: Steak Marinade
directions: Sprinkle the following seasonings in order:
salt, pepper, seasoning salt, garlic salt, tenderizer, hickory salt, parsley and Worcestershire sauce.
Marinate at least 3 hours.
recipes.text: Steak Marinade. Sprinkle the following seasonings in order: salt, pepper, seasoning salt, garlic salt, tenderizer, hickory salt, parsley and Worcestershire sauce. Marinate at least 3 hours.

recipes.title: Parmesan Chicken
directions: Mix breadcrumbs, Parmesan cheese, garlic powder and salt together.
Dip chicken into butter and then roll in breadcrumb mixture.
After putting chicken in baking dish, put 1 teaspoon of butter on top of each piece.
Bake for 1 hour at 350°.
(Be sure to preheat oven.)
recipes.text: Parmesan Chicken. Mix breadcrumbs, Parmesan cheese, garlic powder and salt together. Dip chicken into butter and then roll in breadcrumb mixture. After putting chicken in baking dish, put 1 teaspoon of butter on top of each piece. Bake for 1 hour at 350°. (Be sure to preheat oven.)

recipes.title: Weeknight Fajitas
ingredients: 1/3 c. Seven Seas Viva Italian dressing
4 boneless, skinless chicken breast halves, cut in strips (about 1 1/4 lb.)
1 green bell pepper, cut into strips
1 medium onion, cut into thin wedges
directions: In a large bowl, pour dressing over chicken, green bell pepper, onion, garlic and oregano.
Toss lightly.
Refrigerate at least 10 minutes.
Drain. Stir-fry chicken mixture until chicken is browned and no longer pink.
Stir in tomatoes.
Wrap tortillas in dampened paper towels.
Microwave on High (100%) for 45 seconds to 1 1/2 minutes or until softened.
Fill tortillas with chicken mixture.
Serve with salsa, sour cream, shredded cheese, refried beans or guacamole.
Makes 4 servings.
recipes.text: Weeknight Fajitas. In a large bowl, pour dressing over chicken, green bell pepper, onion, garlic and oregano. Toss lightly. Refrigerate at least 10 minutes. Drain. Stir-fry chicken mixture until chicken is browned and no longer pink. Stir in tomatoes. Wrap tortillas in dampened paper towels. Microwave on High (100%) for 45 seconds to 1 1/2 minutes or until softened. Fill tortillas with chicken mixture. Serve with salsa, sour cream, shredded cheese, refried beans or guacamole. Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: Buttermilk Brownies
directions: Preheat oven to 325°.
Grease and flour a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan.
Mix together sugar and flour.
Boil cocoa, water, butter and oil; mix in flour and sugar.
Add eggs.
Stir baking soda into buttermilk.
Add to batter, along with nuts (if desired).
Bake for 20 to 25 minutes.
Frost while hot.
recipes.text: Buttermilk Brownies. Preheat oven to 325°. Grease and flour a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan. Mix together sugar and flour. Boil cocoa, water, butter and oil; mix in flour and sugar. Add eggs. Stir baking soda into buttermilk. Add to batter, along with nuts (if desired). Bake for 20 to 25 minutes. Frost while hot.

recipes.title: Lime Mold
ingredients: 1 (8 oz.) pkg. low-fat cream cheese, softened
directions: Dissolve gelatin in boiling water. Add cold water and lemon juice. Add softened cream cheese; mix until well blended. Chill until almost firm. Fold in marshmallows, pineapple, coconut and nuts (about 2 hours). Mix again. Pour into mold. Chill until firm.
recipes.text: Lime Mold. Dissolve gelatin in boiling water. Add cold water and lemon juice. Add softened cream cheese; mix until well blended. Chill until almost firm. Fold in marshmallows, pineapple, coconut and nuts (about 2 hours). Mix again. Pour into mold. Chill until firm.

recipes.title: Salmon Spread
directions: Mix all ingredients together.
Serve with crackers.
recipes.text: Salmon Spread. Mix all ingredients together. Serve with crackers.

recipes.title: Pinocha Squares
directions: Melt butter; add brown sugar, egg and vanilla.
Beat until fluffy.
Sift together flour, baking powder and salt and add to first mixture.
Mix in chocolate bits and nuts.
Spread in an 8-inch pan.
Bake at 350° no longer than 30 minutes.
Cut into squares when cool.
recipes.text: Pinocha Squares. Melt butter; add brown sugar, egg and vanilla. Beat until fluffy. Sift together flour, baking powder and salt and add to first mixture. Mix in chocolate bits and nuts. Spread in an 8-inch pan. Bake at 350° no longer than 30 minutes. Cut into squares when cool.

recipes.title: Coconut Bread
directions: Grate coconut.
Dissolve yeast in warm water.
Cream sugar and shortening.
Add vanilla.
Add coconut.
Add dry ingredients with 2 parts milk.
Knead 5 minutes.
Cover; let double in size.
Shape and place in greased pan.
Let double in size.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until inserted knife comes out clean.
Remove from pan; cool on rack.
recipes.text: Coconut Bread. Grate coconut. Dissolve yeast in warm water. Cream sugar and shortening. Add vanilla. Add coconut. Add dry ingredients with 2 parts milk. Knead 5 minutes. Cover; let double in size. Shape and place in greased pan. Let double in size. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until inserted knife comes out clean. Remove from pan; cool on rack.

recipes.title: Rhubarb Oat Mixture
ingredients: 3 to 4 c. fresh or frozen rhubarb
directions: Combine flour, oatmeal, brown sugar, walnuts, baking soda and salt. Mix. Cut in cold butter or margarine. Press 3 cups mixture in ungreased 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Soak rhubarb in 1 cup cold water for 3 minutes. Drain.
recipes.text: Rhubarb Oat Mixture. Combine flour, oatmeal, brown sugar, walnuts, baking soda and salt. Mix. Cut in cold butter or margarine. Press 3 cups mixture in ungreased 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Soak rhubarb in 1 cup cold water for 3 minutes. Drain.

recipes.title: Wild Rice And Chicken Bake
ingredients: 8 oz. long grain and wild rice
1 (10 3/4 oz.) cream of mushroom soup (use lo-fat and low-sodium)
4 to 6 chicken breasts, deboned and skinned
directions: Mix all ingredients except chicken in large oval baking dish with lid.
Arrange chicken over rice.
Sprinkle with black pepper and paprika.
Bake covered for 90 minutes or until done at 350°. Serves 6.
recipes.text: Wild Rice And Chicken Bake. Mix all ingredients except chicken in large oval baking dish with lid. Arrange chicken over rice. Sprinkle with black pepper and paprika. Bake covered for 90 minutes or until done at 350°. Serves 6.

recipes.title: Favorite Baked Beans
ingredients: 1 (16 oz.) can baked beans in tomato sauce
1 small onion, sliced and separated into rings
directions: Cook bacon until crisp; drain and crumble.
Reserve drippings; set bacon aside.
Saute onion and green pepper in drippings; drain.
Combine onion mixture, crumbled bacon, beans, flour and the remaining ingredients in a greased 1-quart casserole.
Cover; bake at 350° for 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Favorite Baked Beans. Cook bacon until crisp; drain and crumble. Reserve drippings; set bacon aside. Saute onion and green pepper in drippings; drain. Combine onion mixture, crumbled bacon, beans, flour and the remaining ingredients in a greased 1-quart casserole. Cover; bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Balls
directions: Melt margarine and pour over confectioners sugar.
Add remaining ingredients.
Cream.
Roll into balls.
Melt in double boiler: 1 package chocolate or peanut butter chips and 1/2 bar paraffin wax.
Remove from stove.
Dip balls in this mixture.
Lay balls on wax paper.
recipes.text: Peanut Butter Balls. Melt margarine and pour over confectioners sugar. Add remaining ingredients. Cream. Roll into balls. Melt in double boiler: 1 package chocolate or peanut butter chips and 1/2 bar paraffin wax. Remove from stove. Dip balls in this mixture. Lay balls on wax paper.

recipes.title: Hamburger Barley Vegetable Soup
ingredients: 3 beef-flavor bouillon cubes or 3 tsp. instant beef bouillon
directions: Brown ground beef in 5-quart Dutch oven; drain.
Add rest of ingredients.
Bring to a boil.
Reduce heat.
Cover and simmer 1 hour or until vegetables and barley are tender.
Remove bay leaves before serving.
Makes 10 (1 1/2 cup) servings.
recipes.text: Hamburger Barley Vegetable Soup. Brown ground beef in 5-quart Dutch oven; drain. Add rest of ingredients. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat. Cover and simmer 1 hour or until vegetables and barley are tender. Remove bay leaves before serving. Makes 10 (1 1/2 cup) servings.

recipes.title: Banana Pineapple Dessert
ingredients: 2 (4 oz.) pkg. Jell-O vanilla flavor instant pudding and pie filling*
directions: *Sugar-free reduced calorie Jell-O pudding is okay (and good).
recipes.text: Banana Pineapple Dessert. *Sugar-free reduced calorie Jell-O pudding is okay (and good).

recipes.title: Zucchini Casserole
ingredients: 1 box Stove Top dressing (spice and all)
directions: Boil zucchini for 3 minutes in salt water.
Drain.
Add cream of chicken soup.
Mix dressing (spice and all) with butter in an 8 x 10-inch baking dish.
Layer 1/2 dressing mix, cream of mushroom soup and rest of dressing.
Bake for 30 to 35 minutes.
Makes a large dish.
recipes.text: Zucchini Casserole. Boil zucchini for 3 minutes in salt water. Drain. Add cream of chicken soup. Mix dressing (spice and all) with butter in an 8 x 10-inch baking dish. Layer 1/2 dressing mix, cream of mushroom soup and rest of dressing. Bake for 30 to 35 minutes. Makes a large dish.

recipes.title: Chocolate Chip Brownies
directions: Cream together the butter and sugar.
Add egg and vanilla; cream until smooth.
Add flour, baking powder and salt; mix.
Add nuts and 1/2 cup of chocolate chips; mix.
Spread in a greased 9 x 9-inch pan.
Spread remaining chocolate chips on top.
Bake in a preheated oven at 350° for 5 minutes.
Using a knife, make a grid through the melted chips on top.
Bake further for 15 minutes.
The brownies may look raw, but are cooked when brown at the edges.
Cut when cooled.
Yield:
16 brownies.
recipes.text: Chocolate Chip Brownies. Cream together the butter and sugar. Add egg and vanilla; cream until smooth. Add flour, baking powder and salt; mix. Add nuts and 1/2 cup of chocolate chips; mix. Spread in a greased 9 x 9-inch pan. Spread remaining chocolate chips on top. Bake in a preheated oven at 350° for 5 minutes. Using a knife, make a grid through the melted chips on top. Bake further for 15 minutes. The brownies may look raw, but are cooked when brown at the edges. Cut when cooled. Yield: 16 brownies.

recipes.title: Forgotten Cookies
directions: Beat egg whites until they begin to fluff.
Add sugar slowly. Beat until like divinity.
Add vanilla.
Fold in chips and pecans. Put on foiled lined cookie sheet by the spoonful.
Preheat oven to 350°.
Turn oven off.
Put cookies in oven on either or both racks. Leave in oven overnight.
Do not peek.
recipes.text: Forgotten Cookies. Beat egg whites until they begin to fluff. Add sugar slowly. Beat until like divinity. Add vanilla. Fold in chips and pecans. Put on foiled lined cookie sheet by the spoonful. Preheat oven to 350°. Turn oven off. Put cookies in oven on either or both racks. Leave in oven overnight. Do not peek.

recipes.title: Pearl'S Congealed Salad
directions: Bring pineapple to a boil.
Add jello straight from package. Pour in buttermilk and stir together.
When cool, add Cool Whip. Fold in nuts.
Pour into long pan to set.
recipes.text: Pearl'S Congealed Salad. Bring pineapple to a boil. Add jello straight from package. Pour in buttermilk and stir together. When cool, add Cool Whip. Fold in nuts. Pour into long pan to set.

recipes.title: Stuffed Peppers
directions: Halve and core peppers.
Mix other ingredients.
Place in peppers.
recipes.text: Stuffed Peppers. Halve and core peppers. Mix other ingredients. Place in peppers.

recipes.title: Tuna Salad
directions: Cook the noodle macaroni until tender.
Mix together the macaroni, tuna, bell pepper, hard-boiled eggs, celery, cucumber and green olives in large bowl.
Add mayonnaise to taste. Sprinkle top with paprika.
recipes.text: Tuna Salad. Cook the noodle macaroni until tender. Mix together the macaroni, tuna, bell pepper, hard-boiled eggs, celery, cucumber and green olives in large bowl. Add mayonnaise to taste. Sprinkle top with paprika.

recipes.title: 6 Week Muffin Mix
directions: Mix cereal, flour, sugar, salt, soda and cinnamon.
Add and mix well the eggs, vegetable oil and buttermilk.
Never stir again.
Batter wil be thick and get thicker.
Keeps 6 weeks.
Fill muffin cups 1/2 cup full.
Bake at 400° for 15 to 20 minutes.
recipes.text: 6 Week Muffin Mix. Mix cereal, flour, sugar, salt, soda and cinnamon. Add and mix well the eggs, vegetable oil and buttermilk. Never stir again. Batter wil be thick and get thicker. Keeps 6 weeks. Fill muffin cups 1/2 cup full. Bake at 400° for 15 to 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Wonder Cake
directions: Mix first five ingredients then add vinegar, vanilla, oil and water.
Pour into ungreased 9 x 13-inch pan and bake for 40 to 50 minutes in 350° oven.
Buttercream or Peanut Butter frosting is great on it.
Serves 24.
recipes.text: Wonder Cake. Mix first five ingredients then add vinegar, vanilla, oil and water. Pour into ungreased 9 x 13-inch pan and bake for 40 to 50 minutes in 350° oven. Buttercream or Peanut Butter frosting is great on it. Serves 24.

recipes.title: Breakfast Cookies
directions: In a mixing bowl, cream butter and sugar.
Beat in egg.
Add flour and baking soda, mix well.
Stir in bacon, cornflakes and raisins.
Drop by rounded tablespoon 2 inches apart onto ungreased baking sheet.
Bake at 350° for 15 - 18 minutes or until lightly browned.
Cool for 2 minutes before removing to wire racks. Store in the refrigerator.
Yield: 2 dozen.
recipes.text: Breakfast Cookies. In a mixing bowl, cream butter and sugar. Beat in egg. Add flour and baking soda, mix well. Stir in bacon, cornflakes and raisins. Drop by rounded tablespoon 2 inches apart onto ungreased baking sheet. Bake at 350° for 15 - 18 minutes or until lightly browned. Cool for 2 minutes before removing to wire racks. Store in the refrigerator. Yield: 2 dozen.

recipes.title: Apple Fritters
ingredients: 1 tsp. melted fat or salad oil
directions: Beat eggs.
Stir in milk.
Sift dry ingredients together and beat in.
When blended add shortening and beat.
Cut apples into crosswise slices (core but don't peel).
Dip into batter.
Drop into hot fat and fry at 375° until brown.
Drain and serve hot.
recipes.text: Apple Fritters. Beat eggs. Stir in milk. Sift dry ingredients together and beat in. When blended add shortening and beat. Cut apples into crosswise slices (core but don't peel). Dip into batter. Drop into hot fat and fry at 375° until brown. Drain and serve hot.

recipes.title: Green Bean Casserole
directions: Melt butter.
Drain beans and mix beans, soup, garlic cheese and butter.
Salt and pepper to taste.
Cook 35 to 40 minutes in a 325° oven.
Remove and add onions on top and cook for about 6 more minutes.
recipes.text: Green Bean Casserole. Melt butter. Drain beans and mix beans, soup, garlic cheese and butter. Salt and pepper to taste. Cook 35 to 40 minutes in a 325° oven. Remove and add onions on top and cook for about 6 more minutes.

recipes.title: Baked Pork Chops With Dressing
ingredients: 7 to 9 slices of toasted or dry bread
directions: Brown pork chops and place in shallow pan.
recipes.text: Baked Pork Chops With Dressing. Brown pork chops and place in shallow pan.

recipes.title: Party Ham Rolls
directions: Slice each package of rolls horizontally like a sandwich; set aside.
Melt the margarine and then add mustard, poppy seed, Worcestershire sauce and onion.
Brush this mixture on both sides of the sliced rolls.
Layer ham and Swiss cheese on the bottom portion of the rolls and then put the top on.
Heat about 10 minutes at 400°.
recipes.text: Party Ham Rolls. Slice each package of rolls horizontally like a sandwich; set aside. Melt the margarine and then add mustard, poppy seed, Worcestershire sauce and onion. Brush this mixture on both sides of the sliced rolls. Layer ham and Swiss cheese on the bottom portion of the rolls and then put the top on. Heat about 10 minutes at 400°.

recipes.title: Dill Dip
ingredients: 1 Tbsp. Beau Monde (Spice Islands available only at Safeway)
directions: Mix together in order given.
Chill 1 hour.
Serve with raw vegetables.
recipes.text: Dill Dip. Mix together in order given. Chill 1 hour. Serve with raw vegetables.

recipes.title: Glazed Hamburger Loaf
directions: Mix
ground
beef, onion, celery,
bell
pepper,
bread crumbs, 1 cup catsup, salt and pepper together.
Shape
into a loaf.
Bake in a loaf pan at 350° for 30 minutes.
Remove from oven.
Mix 1 cup catsup, pineapple and
brown
sugar
together and spread over hamburger loaf.
Return to the	oven
and cook about 30 minutes longer.	Serve with rice.
recipes.text: Glazed Hamburger Loaf. Mix ground beef, onion, celery, bell pepper, bread crumbs, 1 cup catsup, salt and pepper together. Shape into a loaf. Bake in a loaf pan at 350° for 30 minutes. Remove from oven. Mix 1 cup catsup, pineapple and brown sugar together and spread over hamburger loaf. Return to the	oven and cook about 30 minutes longer.	Serve with rice.

recipes.title: Sour Cream Corn Bread
directions: Mix everything in bowl but 1/4 cup oil.
Mix well and pour into bread pan.
Put the 1/4 cup oil in pan.
Pour bread mixture into this.
Cook at 375° about 45 minutes or until golden brown.
recipes.text: Sour Cream Corn Bread. Mix everything in bowl but 1/4 cup oil. Mix well and pour into bread pan. Put the 1/4 cup oil in pan. Pour bread mixture into this. Cook at 375° about 45 minutes or until golden brown.

recipes.title: English Pea Creole Casserole
directions: Cook
celery,
onion
and
green pepper in butter until tender,
but not brown.
Add 1 can tomato soup.
Place remaining ingredients in layers in casserole and pour tomato mixture over all.
Cover top with bread crumbs.
Bake in 350° oven for 20 minutes or longer.
recipes.text: English Pea Creole Casserole. Cook celery, onion and green pepper in butter until tender, but not brown. Add 1 can tomato soup. Place remaining ingredients in layers in casserole and pour tomato mixture over all. Cover top with bread crumbs. Bake in 350° oven for 20 minutes or longer.

recipes.title: Apple Bread
directions: Stir together apples, nuts and sugar.
Let stand, stirring often until juicy, about 1 hour.
Stir together flour, soda, salt and spices.
Add apple mixture and stir well.
Stir in butter and vanilla.
Add eggs.
Turn into 2 loaf pans that have been well-greased and floured.
Bake at 325° for about 1 hour and 15 minutes or until test is done.
Cool on pan 10 minutes and turn out onto rack.
recipes.text: Apple Bread. Stir together apples, nuts and sugar. Let stand, stirring often until juicy, about 1 hour. Stir together flour, soda, salt and spices. Add apple mixture and stir well. Stir in butter and vanilla. Add eggs. Turn into 2 loaf pans that have been well-greased and floured. Bake at 325° for about 1 hour and 15 minutes or until test is done. Cool on pan 10 minutes and turn out onto rack.

recipes.title: Pork Chop Dinner
directions: Brown pork chop in iron skillet in small amount of salad oil. Drain green beans and save liquid.
Place green beans on top of pork chops.
Add 1/2 soup can of green bean liquid to cream of celery soup.
