Mix well and pour over pork chops and green beans. Cover and bake at 375° for 50 to 60 minutes.
recipes.text: Pork Chop Dinner. Brown pork chop in iron skillet in small amount of salad oil. Drain green beans and save liquid. Place green beans on top of pork chops. Add 1/2 soup can of green bean liquid to cream of celery soup. Mix well and pour over pork chops and green beans. Cover and bake at 375° for 50 to 60 minutes.

recipes.title: Quick Cinnamon Fluff
directions: Cream the butter, sugar, egg and vanilla until light.
Sift dry ingredients. Combine all ingredients, including milk and mix until creamy.
Pour into a 9-inch square pan.
Dot the top with butter.
Generously sprinkle brown sugar and cinnamon on top and bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Quick Cinnamon Fluff. Cream the butter, sugar, egg and vanilla until light. Sift dry ingredients. Combine all ingredients, including milk and mix until creamy. Pour into a 9-inch square pan. Dot the top with butter. Generously sprinkle brown sugar and cinnamon on top and bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Tuna Rio Grande
directions: Melt butter or margarine in square baking dish.
Stir in chili sauce.
Crumble tuna into the chili and margarine.
Top with cheese, then with prepared muffin mix.
Bake 25 to 30 minutes at 375°.
Cut into squares.
Serves 4 to 6.
recipes.text: Tuna Rio Grande. Melt butter or margarine in square baking dish. Stir in chili sauce. Crumble tuna into the chili and margarine. Top with cheese, then with prepared muffin mix. Bake 25 to 30 minutes at 375°. Cut into squares. Serves 4 to 6.

recipes.title: Maryland Fried Chicken
directions: Combine flour, poultry seasoning, salt and peppers in a bowl. Whip eggs in another bowl.
Crush crackers in a third bowl.
Coat each piece of chicken in flour, then eggs, cracker crumbs and again in flour.
Pour oil into frying pan.
Heat to about 350°.
Add chicken, cover and fry for 15 minutes.
Turn chicken; pour white Worcestershire over chicken.
Cover and cook 10 to 15 minutes or until chicken is cooked through.
recipes.text: Maryland Fried Chicken. Combine flour, poultry seasoning, salt and peppers in a bowl. Whip eggs in another bowl. Crush crackers in a third bowl. Coat each piece of chicken in flour, then eggs, cracker crumbs and again in flour. Pour oil into frying pan. Heat to about 350°. Add chicken, cover and fry for 15 minutes. Turn chicken; pour white Worcestershire over chicken. Cover and cook 10 to 15 minutes or until chicken is cooked through.

recipes.title: 7-Up Cake
directions: Mix cake mix, sugar, oil and 7-Up together. Add eggs, one at a time. Bake in tube pan at 325° for 1 hour. Mix 1 cup powdered sugar and juice of 1 lemon. Pour over cake while still warm to make glaze.
recipes.text: 7-Up Cake. Mix cake mix, sugar, oil and 7-Up together. Add eggs, one at a time. Bake in tube pan at 325° for 1 hour. Mix 1 cup powdered sugar and juice of 1 lemon. Pour over cake while still warm to make glaze.

recipes.title: Raisin Cake
directions: Combine raisins, brown sugar, shortening and butter, cinnamon and boiling water and bring to a boil.
Let cool.
Stir in soda sifted with flour.
Stir in enough flour to make cake batter.
Pour into two 9-inch round cake pans.
Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.
recipes.text: Raisin Cake. Combine raisins, brown sugar, shortening and butter, cinnamon and boiling water and bring to a boil. Let cool. Stir in soda sifted with flour. Stir in enough flour to make cake batter. Pour into two 9-inch round cake pans. Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.

recipes.title: Classic Lasagna
ingredients: 2 (12 oz.) cartons cream-style cottage cheese or Ricotta cheese
directions: Cook beef until browned, stirring to crumble; drain.
Add garlic to next 4 ingredients; simmer 15 minutes or until thick, stirring occasionally.
recipes.text: Classic Lasagna. Cook beef until browned, stirring to crumble; drain. Add garlic to next 4 ingredients; simmer 15 minutes or until thick, stirring occasionally.

recipes.title: Microwave Chocolate Chip Bars
directions: Cream butter and sugar.
Add egg, milk and vanilla.
Mix well. Add flour, baking powder and salt.
Blend well.
Stir in 1/2 cup chocolate chips.
Spread in greased 8-inch square pan.
Sprinkle with remaining chips.
Microwave on High (10) for 5 to 7 minutes, rotating dish 1/2 turn after 3 minutes, until done.
Cool and cut into bars.
recipes.text: Microwave Chocolate Chip Bars. Cream butter and sugar. Add egg, milk and vanilla. Mix well. Add flour, baking powder and salt. Blend well. Stir in 1/2 cup chocolate chips. Spread in greased 8-inch square pan. Sprinkle with remaining chips. Microwave on High (10) for 5 to 7 minutes, rotating dish 1/2 turn after 3 minutes, until done. Cool and cut into bars.

recipes.title: Scalloped Potatoes And Carrots
directions: In large saucepan, melt butter.
Add onion and parsley and cook until onion is tender.
Blend in flour, salt and dill.
Stir in milk and cook, stirring constantly until sauce thickens slightly and comes to a boil.
Remove from heat.
recipes.text: Scalloped Potatoes And Carrots. In large saucepan, melt butter. Add onion and parsley and cook until onion is tender. Blend in flour, salt and dill. Stir in milk and cook, stirring constantly until sauce thickens slightly and comes to a boil. Remove from heat.

recipes.title: Nacho Dip
ingredients: chopped lettuce, tomatoes and black olives to taste
directions: Spread cream cheese onto large microwave dish.
Pour chili over cream cheese; cover with Cheddar cheese.
Microwave until cheese is melted and bubbly.
Add lettuce, sour cream, tomatoes and olives.
Serve warm with tortilla chips for dipping.
recipes.text: Nacho Dip. Spread cream cheese onto large microwave dish. Pour chili over cream cheese; cover with Cheddar cheese. Microwave until cheese is melted and bubbly. Add lettuce, sour cream, tomatoes and olives. Serve warm with tortilla chips for dipping.

recipes.title: German Chocolate Turtle Bars
directions: Melt caramels with 1/3 cup evaporated milk in double boiler. Mix cake mix, margarine, 1/3 cup evaporated milk and nuts.
Press 1/2 of mixture in a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Bake at 350° for 6 minutes. Sprinkle chips over this crust; pour the caramel mix on and dab the remaining cake mixture on top.
Bake an additional 15 to 20 minutes at 350°.
Let cool.
Cut in squares.
recipes.text: German Chocolate Turtle Bars. Melt caramels with 1/3 cup evaporated milk in double boiler. Mix cake mix, margarine, 1/3 cup evaporated milk and nuts. Press 1/2 of mixture in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350° for 6 minutes. Sprinkle chips over this crust; pour the caramel mix on and dab the remaining cake mixture on top. Bake an additional 15 to 20 minutes at 350°. Let cool. Cut in squares.

recipes.title: Meat Loaf
ingredients: 2 tsp. seasoning salt or 1/2 tsp. pepper, 1/2 tsp. paprika, 1 tsp. salt and 1 tsp. onion powder
directions: Combine all in a large bowl and mix well with hands.
Wash hands, preheat oven to 350° and grease 8 to 9-inch square pan. Add meat mixture and spread evenly in pan.
Cook at 350° for 1 hour.
Drain any grease off after removing from oven.
recipes.text: Meat Loaf. Combine all in a large bowl and mix well with hands. Wash hands, preheat oven to 350° and grease 8 to 9-inch square pan. Add meat mixture and spread evenly in pan. Cook at 350° for 1 hour. Drain any grease off after removing from oven.

recipes.title: Zesty Carrots
directions: Cook whole carrots until just tender, then slice in lengthwise strips.
Arrange carrots in baking dish.
Mix remaining ingredients and pour over carrots. Top with 1/4 cup bread crumbs and 1 tablespoon butter.
Sprinkle top with paprika or parsley. Bake at 375° for 15 to 20 minutes.
recipes.text: Zesty Carrots. Cook whole carrots until just tender, then slice in lengthwise strips. Arrange carrots in baking dish. Mix remaining ingredients and pour over carrots. Top with 1/4 cup bread crumbs and 1 tablespoon butter. Sprinkle top with paprika or parsley. Bake at 375° for 15 to 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Cold Pizza
directions: Preheat oven to 325°.
Roll out crescent rolls on a large cookie sheet.
Pat to fill out the sheet, pushing the seams together.
Bake until medium brown.
Let cool.
Mix the cream cheese, which has been allowed to soften, and the dry dressing mix together.
Spread on cooled crust.
Slice the green onions (including the tops) and olives.
Chop the tomatoes.
Arrange on top of the cheese mixture.
Refrigerate.
When ready to serve, cut into squares.
recipes.text: Cold Pizza. Preheat oven to 325°. Roll out crescent rolls on a large cookie sheet. Pat to fill out the sheet, pushing the seams together. Bake until medium brown. Let cool. Mix the cream cheese, which has been allowed to soften, and the dry dressing mix together. Spread on cooled crust. Slice the green onions (including the tops) and olives. Chop the tomatoes. Arrange on top of the cheese mixture. Refrigerate. When ready to serve, cut into squares.

recipes.title: Chicken Crisp
ingredients: crushed corn flakes or Rice Krispies
directions: Dip chicken in butter, then roll in corn flakes or Rice Krispies.
Put in a pan with foil lining.
Bake in a 350° oven for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Chicken Crisp. Dip chicken in butter, then roll in corn flakes or Rice Krispies. Put in a pan with foil lining. Bake in a 350° oven for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Inside Out Chocolate Bundt Cake
directions: Combine all ingredients in a bowl and mix by hand until well blended, about 2 minutes.
Pour into a greased and floured 12-cup tube or Bundt pan.
Bake at 350° for 60 minutes or until cake springs back when lightly pressed with finger.
Do not overbake. Cool 15 minutes in pan, remove and continue cooling on rack.
When cool dust with confectioners sugar.
recipes.text: Inside Out Chocolate Bundt Cake. Combine all ingredients in a bowl and mix by hand until well blended, about 2 minutes. Pour into a greased and floured 12-cup tube or Bundt pan. Bake at 350° for 60 minutes or until cake springs back when lightly pressed with finger. Do not overbake. Cool 15 minutes in pan, remove and continue cooling on rack. When cool dust with confectioners sugar.

recipes.title: Angel Cake
directions: Break cake in small bite size pieces.
Mix cream cheese and sugar well.
Add milk.
Fold in Cool Whip and then fold in cake pieces.
Put into 9 x 13-inch dish and press lightly.
Cover with cherry pie filling or filling of choice.
recipes.text: Angel Cake. Break cake in small bite size pieces. Mix cream cheese and sugar well. Add milk. Fold in Cool Whip and then fold in cake pieces. Put into 9 x 13-inch dish and press lightly. Cover with cherry pie filling or filling of choice.

recipes.title: Grandma'S Rice
directions: Cook rice according to package, except replace water with chicken stock. Saut green onions in butter, then add onion mixture to rice right before serving. Mix well.
recipes.text: Grandma'S Rice. Cook rice according to package, except replace water with chicken stock. Saut green onions in butter, then add onion mixture to rice right before serving. Mix well.

recipes.title: Cinnamon Sugar Muffins
directions: Mix all ingredients.
Pour into lined muffin cups.
Sprinkle with mixture of 3 tablespoons oleo (softened), 4 tablespoons sugar and 1 tablespoon cinnamon.
Bake at 350° for 18 to 20 minutes until done.
Makes 12 to 16 muffins.
recipes.text: Cinnamon Sugar Muffins. Mix all ingredients. Pour into lined muffin cups. Sprinkle with mixture of 3 tablespoons oleo (softened), 4 tablespoons sugar and 1 tablespoon cinnamon. Bake at 350° for 18 to 20 minutes until done. Makes 12 to 16 muffins.

recipes.title: Sweet-Sour Sauerkraut Salad
ingredients: 32 oz. canned sauerkraut, rinsed and drained
directions: Mix sugar, vinegar and oil together until sugar dissolves. Combine sauerkraut and vegetables in large container.
Pour dressing over vegetables, cover and refrigerate.
Serve well chilled.
recipes.text: Sweet-Sour Sauerkraut Salad. Mix sugar, vinegar and oil together until sugar dissolves. Combine sauerkraut and vegetables in large container. Pour dressing over vegetables, cover and refrigerate. Serve well chilled.

recipes.title: Bom-Boms
directions: Mix together.
Roll into little balls.
Let balls chill.
Dip into melted chocolate.
Cool on waxed paper.
recipes.text: Bom-Boms. Mix together. Roll into little balls. Let balls chill. Dip into melted chocolate. Cool on waxed paper.

recipes.title: Johnny Sandusky
ingredients: 1 large chopped onion (may use 2, if you wish)
directions: Brown beef, celery and onion. Drain.
Mix macaroni, tomatoes and green pepper.
Let set overnight.
Sprinkle grated cheese liberally on top and bake slowly at 325° for 60 minutes.
May add garlic.
recipes.text: Johnny Sandusky. Brown beef, celery and onion. Drain. Mix macaroni, tomatoes and green pepper. Let set overnight. Sprinkle grated cheese liberally on top and bake slowly at 325° for 60 minutes. May add garlic.

recipes.title: Rhubarb Salad
ingredients: 2 c. rhubarb, cut in small pieces
directions: Combine rhubarb, sugar and 1/4 cup water.
Bring to rolling boil; reduce heat and simmer for about 5 minutes.
Remove from heat.
Let stand, covered, until partially cooled.
Dissolve jello in 1 cup boiling water.
Stir and blend in rhubarb mixture.
Chill until thickened but not set.
Fold in the pineapple, apple and nuts.
Chill until set.
Can be frozen.
recipes.text: Rhubarb Salad. Combine rhubarb, sugar and 1/4 cup water. Bring to rolling boil; reduce heat and simmer for about 5 minutes. Remove from heat. Let stand, covered, until partially cooled. Dissolve jello in 1 cup boiling water. Stir and blend in rhubarb mixture. Chill until thickened but not set. Fold in the pineapple, apple and nuts. Chill until set. Can be frozen.

recipes.title: Chocolate Chip Treasure Cookies
ingredients: 1 (14 oz.) can Eagle brand sweetened condensed milk (not evaporated milk)
1 cup chopped walnuts or roasted unsalted peanuts
directions: Heat oven 350° to 375°.
In small bowl, mix graham cracker crumbs, flour and baking powder.
In large mixer bowl, beat sweetened condensed milk and margarine until smooth.
Add graham cracker crumb mixture; mix well.
Stir in coconut, chocolate chips and nuts.
Drop by rounded tbsp. onto ungreased cookie sheet.
Bake 9 to 10 minutes or until lightly browned.
Store loosely covered at room temperature.
(Makes about 3 dozen.)
recipes.text: Chocolate Chip Treasure Cookies. Heat oven 350° to 375°. In small bowl, mix graham cracker crumbs, flour and baking powder. In large mixer bowl, beat sweetened condensed milk and margarine until smooth. Add graham cracker crumb mixture; mix well. Stir in coconut, chocolate chips and nuts. Drop by rounded tbsp. onto ungreased cookie sheet. Bake 9 to 10 minutes or until lightly browned. Store loosely covered at room temperature. (Makes about 3 dozen.)

recipes.title: Lemonade Pie
ingredients: 1 (6 oz.) can frozen lemonade (or any type frozen juice)
directions: Mix the first 3 ingredients thoroughly and pour into graham cracker pie crust.
Cover and refrigerate.
recipes.text: Lemonade Pie. Mix the first 3 ingredients thoroughly and pour into graham cracker pie crust. Cover and refrigerate.

recipes.title: Scones
directions: Mix dry ingredients until well mixed.
Add margarine.
Mix until fine.
Add milk and mix lightly into a dough.
Roll out to half inch thick.
Use 2-inch cutter.
Brush with egg yolk.
Bake in 425° oven for about ten minutes.
recipes.text: Scones. Mix dry ingredients until well mixed. Add margarine. Mix until fine. Add milk and mix lightly into a dough. Roll out to half inch thick. Use 2-inch cutter. Brush with egg yolk. Bake in 425° oven for about ten minutes.

recipes.title: Broccoli Cheese Soup
ingredients: 1 (10 oz.) pkg. broccoli (4 c. "Market Day" broccoli florets)
directions: In deep kettle, put in oil, onions, water and bouillon cubes; cook until boiling slightly.
Then add noodles, broccoli and garlic powder.
Cook until noodles and broccoli are tender (about 15 minutes).
Mix 3 cups cold milk with flour.
Mix other 3 cups milk with melted Velveeta cheese.
Add both milk mixtures to kettle; cook until just comes to boiling so soup will thicken some.
recipes.text: Broccoli Cheese Soup. In deep kettle, put in oil, onions, water and bouillon cubes; cook until boiling slightly. Then add noodles, broccoli and garlic powder. Cook until noodles and broccoli are tender (about 15 minutes). Mix 3 cups cold milk with flour. Mix other 3 cups milk with melted Velveeta cheese. Add both milk mixtures to kettle; cook until just comes to boiling so soup will thicken some.

recipes.title: Butter Cake
directions: Mix together cake mix, 2 eggs and margarine.
Pour into 9 x 13-inch ungreased baking dish.
Mix together cream cheese, 2 eggs and powdered sugar and pour over cake mixture.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
(Do not overbake.)
When top is brown and crispy it will be done.
recipes.text: Butter Cake. Mix together cake mix, 2 eggs and margarine. Pour into 9 x 13-inch ungreased baking dish. Mix together cream cheese, 2 eggs and powdered sugar and pour over cake mixture. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes. (Do not overbake.) When top is brown and crispy it will be done.

recipes.title: Broccoli And Chicken Casserole
ingredients: 1 can condensed chicken soup or mushroom
directions: Cut chicken into 1-inch pieces and parboil.
Cut up broccoli and parboil.
recipes.text: Broccoli And Chicken Casserole. Cut chicken into 1-inch pieces and parboil. Cut up broccoli and parboil.

recipes.title: New York Cheesecake
directions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees.
In a large mixing bowl, beat together cream cheese and sugar until smooth and light.
Beat in the eggs, vanilla, and cornstarch - only until thoroughly mixed. Stir in sour cream until mixture is well blended.
Pour the mixture into a prepared graham cracker crust and bake for 45 minutes. Allow to cool in the oven with door propped slightly open for 3 hours.
Chill.
Can top with favorite fruit pie filling.
recipes.text: New York Cheesecake. Preheat oven to 400 degrees. In a large mixing bowl, beat together cream cheese and sugar until smooth and light. Beat in the eggs, vanilla, and cornstarch - only until thoroughly mixed. Stir in sour cream until mixture is well blended. Pour the mixture into a prepared graham cracker crust and bake for 45 minutes. Allow to cool in the oven with door propped slightly open for 3 hours. Chill. Can top with favorite fruit pie filling.

recipes.title: Broccoli-Cheese Soup
directions: Cook broccoli in chicken broth 15 minutes.
Saute onion in margarine until tender.
Add flour; stir.
Add evaporated milk and sweet milk and cook until thick.
Add to broccoli.
Add paprika and cheese.
Stir until cheese melts.
Simmer 30 minutes.
Stir often.
recipes.text: Broccoli-Cheese Soup. Cook broccoli in chicken broth 15 minutes. Saute onion in margarine until tender. Add flour; stir. Add evaporated milk and sweet milk and cook until thick. Add to broccoli. Add paprika and cheese. Stir until cheese melts. Simmer 30 minutes. Stir often.

recipes.title: Lemon Cake
directions: Preheat oven to 350°.
Sift flour, baking powder and salt; set aside.
Mix sugar and Crisco until creamy.
Add eggs, milk, flour and vanilla.
Beat until mixture is creamy.
Pour into two 9-inch cake pans.
Bake 30 minutes or until bounces when touched.
recipes.text: Lemon Cake. Preheat oven to 350°. Sift flour, baking powder and salt; set aside. Mix sugar and Crisco until creamy. Add eggs, milk, flour and vanilla. Beat until mixture is creamy. Pour into two 9-inch cake pans. Bake 30 minutes or until bounces when touched.

recipes.title: Creamy Milk Chocolate Fudge
directions: Line an 8 or 9-inch square baking pan with waxed paper. In heavy medium-sized saucepan over low heat, melt all chips with sweetened condensed milk, marshmallows and salt; stir until smooth and well blended. Remove from heat; stir in nuts and vanilla extract. Spread evenly into prepared pan.
Chill overnight. Turn fudge onto cutting board; peel off paper and cut into squares.
recipes.text: Creamy Milk Chocolate Fudge. Line an 8 or 9-inch square baking pan with waxed paper. In heavy medium-sized saucepan over low heat, melt all chips with sweetened condensed milk, marshmallows and salt; stir until smooth and well blended. Remove from heat; stir in nuts and vanilla extract. Spread evenly into prepared pan. Chill overnight. Turn fudge onto cutting board; peel off paper and cut into squares.

recipes.title: Mama'S Meat Loaf
ingredients: 3/4 c. Pepperidge Farm herb stuffing mix
directions: Mix all ingredients. In bottom of baking pan, place 1 cup ketchup. Place meat mixture on top and shape to form meat loaf. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Mama'S Meat Loaf. Mix all ingredients. In bottom of baking pan, place 1 cup ketchup. Place meat mixture on top and shape to form meat loaf. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: No Bake Cookies
directions: Boil sugar, cocoa, butter, vanilla and water; take off heat. Mix in peanut butter and oatmeal.
Place in clumps on ungreased cookie sheet.
Place in refrigerator 1 hour.
recipes.text: No Bake Cookies. Boil sugar, cocoa, butter, vanilla and water; take off heat. Mix in peanut butter and oatmeal. Place in clumps on ungreased cookie sheet. Place in refrigerator 1 hour.

recipes.title: Heavenly Hash
directions: Mix Dream Whip according to directions on box and whip until stiff.
Continue beating with electric mixer while adding cream cheese, a little at a time.
Add other 4 ingredients and mix, then chill 2 hours.
recipes.text: Heavenly Hash. Mix Dream Whip according to directions on box and whip until stiff. Continue beating with electric mixer while adding cream cheese, a little at a time. Add other 4 ingredients and mix, then chill 2 hours.

recipes.title: Quick And Easy Salmon Patties
directions: Drain salmon, reserving 2 tablespoons of juice.
In medium mixing bowl, mix salmon, egg and onion until sticky.
Stir in flour.
Add baking powder to salmon juice.
Stir into salmon mixture.
Form into small patties and fry 5 minutes until brown in hot oil.
Makes 4 to 6 servings.
recipes.text: Quick And Easy Salmon Patties. Drain salmon, reserving 2 tablespoons of juice. In medium mixing bowl, mix salmon, egg and onion until sticky. Stir in flour. Add baking powder to salmon juice. Stir into salmon mixture. Form into small patties and fry 5 minutes until brown in hot oil. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

recipes.title: Never Fail Hot Rolls
directions: Cream together Crisco, sugar and salt.
Add boiling water; stir until creamy.
Add eggs; crumble yeast in warm water and dissolve.
Pour into mixture.
Alternate 1 cup cold water with flour.
Grease top and seal tightly.
Put in refrigerator; will keep a week.
Knead and make into rolls.
Let rise 2 hours.
Bake at 375° for 20 minutes.
recipes.text: Never Fail Hot Rolls. Cream together Crisco, sugar and salt. Add boiling water; stir until creamy. Add eggs; crumble yeast in warm water and dissolve. Pour into mixture. Alternate 1 cup cold water with flour. Grease top and seal tightly. Put in refrigerator; will keep a week. Knead and make into rolls. Let rise 2 hours. Bake at 375° for 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Turkey Crunch
directions: Combine all ingredients except noodles and put into greased casserole. Sprinkle noodles over casserole. Bake at 325° for 40 minutes. Serves 8 to 10.
recipes.text: Turkey Crunch. Combine all ingredients except noodles and put into greased casserole. Sprinkle noodles over casserole. Bake at 325° for 40 minutes. Serves 8 to 10.

recipes.title: Elephant Ears
directions: Cut tortillas in half and deep fry until crisp (about 1 minute on each side).
Drain well and sprinkle with cinnamon and sugar.
recipes.text: Elephant Ears. Cut tortillas in half and deep fry until crisp (about 1 minute on each side). Drain well and sprinkle with cinnamon and sugar.

recipes.title: Never Fail Noodles
directions: Beat eggs slightly.
Add butter and cream.
Stir.
Add salt and baking powder and enough flour to roll out easily.
recipes.text: Never Fail Noodles. Beat eggs slightly. Add butter and cream. Stir. Add salt and baking powder and enough flour to roll out easily.

recipes.title: Cranberry Cream Punch
directions: Put sherbet in punch bowl and let stand at room temperature for 10 to 15 minutes.
Chill remaining ingredients and pour over sherbet.
recipes.text: Cranberry Cream Punch. Put sherbet in punch bowl and let stand at room temperature for 10 to 15 minutes. Chill remaining ingredients and pour over sherbet.

recipes.title: Chicken Dorito
ingredients: 1 to 2 lb. chicken, cooked and torn in pieces
1 can Ro-Tel green chilies and tomatoes
directions: Place tortilla chips in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Top with chicken and set aside. In a saucepan over low heat, combine cheese, Ro-Tel, soups and cumin. Heat until cheese melts. Pour mixture over chicken and bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes. Makes 6 servings.
recipes.text: Chicken Dorito. Place tortilla chips in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Top with chicken and set aside. In a saucepan over low heat, combine cheese, Ro-Tel, soups and cumin. Heat until cheese melts. Pour mixture over chicken and bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes. Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Pea Soup
directions: Wash and sort peas.
Boil in enough water to cover peas for 20 minutes.
Let stand for 20 more minutes and drain.
Fill pot with fresh water.
Add remaining ingredients and simmer until desired consistency.
recipes.text: Pea Soup. Wash and sort peas. Boil in enough water to cover peas for 20 minutes. Let stand for 20 more minutes and drain. Fill pot with fresh water. Add remaining ingredients and simmer until desired consistency.

recipes.title: Homemade Sweetened Condensed Milk
directions: In a 2-cup glass measuring cup, combine water and margarine. Microwave on High 2 minutes or until water is boiling and margarine is melted.
Add remaining ingredients; stir well; pour mixture in blender jar and whirl until smooth.
Makes the equivalent of 1 can of sweetened condensed milk and can be used in any recipe calling for sweetened condensed milk.
recipes.text: Homemade Sweetened Condensed Milk. In a 2-cup glass measuring cup, combine water and margarine. Microwave on High 2 minutes or until water is boiling and margarine is melted. Add remaining ingredients; stir well; pour mixture in blender jar and whirl until smooth. Makes the equivalent of 1 can of sweetened condensed milk and can be used in any recipe calling for sweetened condensed milk.

recipes.title: Do-Nothing Cake
directions: Combine flour, sugar, soda, salt, eggs and vanilla in mixer bowl; mix well.
Stir in pineapple.
Pour into greased and floured 9 x 13-inch cake pan.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.
Pour frosting over hot cake.
Yield:
15 servings.
recipes.text: Do-Nothing Cake. Combine flour, sugar, soda, salt, eggs and vanilla in mixer bowl; mix well. Stir in pineapple. Pour into greased and floured 9 x 13-inch cake pan. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes. Pour frosting over hot cake. Yield: 15 servings.

recipes.title: Donnie'S Mexican Tortillas
ingredients: shredded cheese, lettuce, sour cream, hot sauce, onions and olives (optional)
directions: In mixer or blender, beat eggs at medium speed.
Gradually add dry ingredients; alternate with milk and oil.
Beat until smooth. Spoon mixture about the size of pancakes onto hot griddle and lightly brown, about 30 seconds.
Remove from griddle.
In frying pan, fry hamburger; drain and add 1 can Sloppy Joe mix.
Take tortillas and Sloppy Joe mix, shredded cheese, lettuce, sour cream, hot sauce, onions, olives or anything you want to add. Fold tortillas in half.
recipes.text: Donnie'S Mexican Tortillas. In mixer or blender, beat eggs at medium speed. Gradually add dry ingredients; alternate with milk and oil. Beat until smooth. Spoon mixture about the size of pancakes onto hot griddle and lightly brown, about 30 seconds. Remove from griddle. In frying pan, fry hamburger; drain and add 1 can Sloppy Joe mix. Take tortillas and Sloppy Joe mix, shredded cheese, lettuce, sour cream, hot sauce, onions, olives or anything you want to add. Fold tortillas in half.

recipes.title: Beef Salad
ingredients: 1 1/2 lb. cooked lean beef, cut into thin strips
directions: Place all in a large bowl and pour dressing over all.
Stir well.
Enjoy.
recipes.text: Beef Salad. Place all in a large bowl and pour dressing over all. Stir well. Enjoy.

recipes.title: Grandpa Bennett'S Baha Chowder
directions: Fry bacon until crisp; remove bacon.
Fry chopped onion until brown; add diced celery and cubed potatoes.
Cover with water. Add crumpled bacon.
Cook.
Boil for 15 minutes or until potatoes are tender.
Add clams.
Cook for 6 to 7 minutes.
Turn fire off. Add milk all at once.
Return to heat.
Do not let boil!
recipes.text: Grandpa Bennett'S Baha Chowder. Fry bacon until crisp; remove bacon. Fry chopped onion until brown; add diced celery and cubed potatoes. Cover with water. Add crumpled bacon. Cook. Boil for 15 minutes or until potatoes are tender. Add clams. Cook for 6 to 7 minutes. Turn fire off. Add milk all at once. Return to heat. Do not let boil!

recipes.title: Squash Soup
ingredients: 2 cloves garlic or 1 whole onion, grated
6 c. chicken broth (can use 3 c. broth plus 3 c. water)
1 lb. Velveeta cheese, cubed (can use 1/2 lb.)
directions: Melt margarine; add vegetables.
Saute over medium heat until tender.
Stir in flour.
Cook a few minutes on low.
Add broth and heat thoroughly.
Add milk and cheese.
Then season with salt and pepper.
recipes.text: Squash Soup. Melt margarine; add vegetables. Saute over medium heat until tender. Stir in flour. Cook a few minutes on low. Add broth and heat thoroughly. Add milk and cheese. Then season with salt and pepper.

recipes.title: Seafood Batter
directions: Mix all ingredients together.
This can be used on fish or shrimp.
It can also be used for onion rings or chicken.
Dip in batter, then roll in a meal and flour mixture and fry.
recipes.text: Seafood Batter. Mix all ingredients together. This can be used on fish or shrimp. It can also be used for onion rings or chicken. Dip in batter, then roll in a meal and flour mixture and fry.

recipes.title: Meal-In-One
directions: Brown meat with bell pepper and onions. Cook macaroni and add to meat. Then add catsup and water. Cook for 8 minutes. Serve hot.
recipes.text: Meal-In-One. Brown meat with bell pepper and onions. Cook macaroni and add to meat. Then add catsup and water. Cook for 8 minutes. Serve hot.

recipes.title: Sour Cream Shrimp Curry
directions: Saute the onion, green pepper and garlic in butter until tender.
Stir in the sour cream, curry, salt and pepper along with the cooked shrimp.
Heat slowly and serve over rice.
recipes.text: Sour Cream Shrimp Curry. Saute the onion, green pepper and garlic in butter until tender. Stir in the sour cream, curry, salt and pepper along with the cooked shrimp. Heat slowly and serve over rice.

recipes.title: Key Lime Pie
ingredients: 4 oz. Key lime juice (you can substitute lime and lemon)
directions: Preheat oven to 325°.
Beat egg yolks well.
Add condensed milk.
Mix on low.
Add juice and cream of tartar.
Mix well.
Pour into crust and bake until set 10 to 15 minutes.
Freeze for at least 3 hours before topping with meringue.
This pie will keep for several days.
recipes.text: Key Lime Pie. Preheat oven to 325°. Beat egg yolks well. Add condensed milk. Mix on low. Add juice and cream of tartar. Mix well. Pour into crust and bake until set 10 to 15 minutes. Freeze for at least 3 hours before topping with meringue. This pie will keep for several days.

recipes.title: Russian Tea Cakes
directions: Blend well with fork.
Chill.
Bake at 350° until light brown. Remove when warm, then roll in powdered sugar.
recipes.text: Russian Tea Cakes. Blend well with fork. Chill. Bake at 350° until light brown. Remove when warm, then roll in powdered sugar.

recipes.title: Louisiana Pound Cake
ingredients: 1 c. Crisco or other solid shortening
directions: Mix all ingredients together.
Bring to a boil for one minute. Pour about half of this mixture over the baked cake; return to oven for 30 minutes.
Remove cake from oven.
Turn out on cooling rack with cookie sheet underneath.
Pour remaining half of glaze over cake, catching unused in pan beneath.
Use this to reglaze. Continue until glaze is used completely up.
Allow to cool completely before placing on serving plate.
Serve plain or with a dollop of ice cream.
Gets rave notices all the time.
recipes.text: Louisiana Pound Cake. Mix all ingredients together. Bring to a boil for one minute. Pour about half of this mixture over the baked cake; return to oven for 30 minutes. Remove cake from oven. Turn out on cooling rack with cookie sheet underneath. Pour remaining half of glaze over cake, catching unused in pan beneath. Use this to reglaze. Continue until glaze is used completely up. Allow to cool completely before placing on serving plate. Serve plain or with a dollop of ice cream. Gets rave notices all the time.

recipes.title: Special Sauce For Hamburgers
directions: Blend well and keep refrigerated in a covered container. Makes about 2 cups.
Spoon over piping hot hamburgers.
recipes.text: Special Sauce For Hamburgers. Blend well and keep refrigerated in a covered container. Makes about 2 cups. Spoon over piping hot hamburgers.

recipes.title: Curried Cream Of Pea Soup
ingredients: 1 tsp. curry powder or to taste
directions: Fry bacon crisp.
Remove and drain.
Cook all vegetables and garlic except peas in bacon fat until soft.
Add curry and pepper, then 1/2 the chicken stock and peas.
Simmer for 15 minutes. Puree in batches; return to pot.
Whisk in remaining stock and half and half.
Simmer on low until hot.
Ladle into bowls.
Top with crumbled bacon.
recipes.text: Curried Cream Of Pea Soup. Fry bacon crisp. Remove and drain. Cook all vegetables and garlic except peas in bacon fat until soft. Add curry and pepper, then 1/2 the chicken stock and peas. Simmer for 15 minutes. Puree in batches; return to pot. Whisk in remaining stock and half and half. Simmer on low until hot. Ladle into bowls. Top with crumbled bacon.

recipes.title: Skillet Corned Beef And Cabbage
directions: In a large skillet, saute onion and corned beef together, breaking up meat as it cooks.
Add cabbage and cover.
Steam for a few minutes.
(Cabbage will have retained some water from having been washed.)
Stir occasionally, adding water to prevent sticking, until cabbage is done to your liking.
Add margarine, salt and pepper.
recipes.text: Skillet Corned Beef And Cabbage. In a large skillet, saute onion and corned beef together, breaking up meat as it cooks. Add cabbage and cover. Steam for a few minutes. (Cabbage will have retained some water from having been washed.) Stir occasionally, adding water to prevent sticking, until cabbage is done to your liking. Add margarine, salt and pepper.

recipes.title: Greek Salad Supper
directions: In large bowl, mix lettuce (iceberg and romaine), radishes, onion, Feta cheese, tomatoes, anchovies, olives and cucumbers. Cover and chill.
In separate bowl, beat oil with vinegar, salt, pepper, oregano and sugar until thick.
Let stand at room temperature.
Before serving, beat dressing again and pour over salad.
Serve with Cheese Pita Breads.
Slash pita breads at one side and stuff each with Mozzarella cheese. Place pitas in 400° oven for 15 minutes.
Let stand 5 minutes.
recipes.text: Greek Salad Supper. In large bowl, mix lettuce (iceberg and romaine), radishes, onion, Feta cheese, tomatoes, anchovies, olives and cucumbers. Cover and chill. In separate bowl, beat oil with vinegar, salt, pepper, oregano and sugar until thick. Let stand at room temperature. Before serving, beat dressing again and pour over salad. Serve with Cheese Pita Breads. Slash pita breads at one side and stuff each with Mozzarella cheese. Place pitas in 400° oven for 15 minutes. Let stand 5 minutes.

recipes.title: Indecent Cookie Bars
directions: Mix first 3 ingredients together and press into 9 x 13-inch pan.
Cream together remaining ingredients and pour on top of crust.
Bake at 325° for approximately 35 minutes.
recipes.text: Indecent Cookie Bars. Mix first 3 ingredients together and press into 9 x 13-inch pan. Cream together remaining ingredients and pour on top of crust. Bake at 325° for approximately 35 minutes.

recipes.title: Mounds Cake
directions: This recipe is best made the day before you want to serve it. Make cake according to package. Bake in greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Allow to cool. Make holes all over cake with a long-tined fork. Add milk to cream of coconut until it measures 2 cups. Mix slowly. Pour over top of cake. Spread whipped topping over top and sprinkle on lots of coconut. Place in refrigerator. Stays moist 3 to 4 days.
recipes.text: Mounds Cake. This recipe is best made the day before you want to serve it. Make cake according to package. Bake in greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Allow to cool. Make holes all over cake with a long-tined fork. Add milk to cream of coconut until it measures 2 cups. Mix slowly. Pour over top of cake. Spread whipped topping over top and sprinkle on lots of coconut. Place in refrigerator. Stays moist 3 to 4 days.

recipes.title: Spinach Casserole
ingredients: 3 pkg. frozen chopped spinach, well drained
directions: Preheat oven to 375°.
While spinach is draining, saute onion in butter.
Add spinach, salt, pepper and garlic.
Spoon half of spinach mixture into 9-inch pan.
Spread Cheddar cheese and half of Mozzarella cheese and cover with remaining spinach.
Spoon egg evenly over top.
Sprinkle rest of Mozzarella cheese and then bread crumbs.
Bake until spinach is piping hot and cheeses have melted, for 30 to 40 minutes.
recipes.text: Spinach Casserole. Preheat oven to 375°. While spinach is draining, saute onion in butter. Add spinach, salt, pepper and garlic. Spoon half of spinach mixture into 9-inch pan. Spread Cheddar cheese and half of Mozzarella cheese and cover with remaining spinach. Spoon egg evenly over top. Sprinkle rest of Mozzarella cheese and then bread crumbs. Bake until spinach is piping hot and cheeses have melted, for 30 to 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Orange Jello Salad
directions: Mix jello powder into cottage cheese.
Fold in mandarin oranges and crushed pineapple.
recipes.text: Orange Jello Salad. Mix jello powder into cottage cheese. Fold in mandarin oranges and crushed pineapple.

recipes.title: Cinnamon Rolls
directions: Heat water and margarine to 120°.
In a large bowl combine 3 cups of flour, yeast, sugar, salt, dry milk, eggs and warm water mixture.
Mix well.

Gradually add enough remaining flour to form a moderately stiff dough. Turn out onto floured board and knead for about 10 minutes until "blisters" form on dough, adding only enough flour to keep dough from sticking to board.
Place in a greased bowl, turning once to grease top.
Cover and let rise in a warm place until doubled, about 30 minutes.
Punch dough down and make into cinnamon rolls.
recipes.text: Cinnamon Rolls. Heat water and margarine to 120°. In a large bowl combine 3 cups of flour, yeast, sugar, salt, dry milk, eggs and warm water mixture. Mix well. Gradually add enough remaining flour to form a moderately stiff dough. Turn out onto floured board and knead for about 10 minutes until "blisters" form on dough, adding only enough flour to keep dough from sticking to board. Place in a greased bowl, turning once to grease top. Cover and let rise in a warm place until doubled, about 30 minutes. Punch dough down and make into cinnamon rolls.

recipes.title: Scotch Raisin Bread
directions: Beat eggs until light.
Add sugar gradually, beating until fluffy.
Add molasses and buttermilk; mix well.
Sift together flour, salt, baking powder and baking soda.
Add to egg mixture and mix well.
Add oatmeal, nuts and raisins.
Stir only until blended.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
Store 1 day before slicing.
recipes.text: Scotch Raisin Bread. Beat eggs until light. Add sugar gradually, beating until fluffy. Add molasses and buttermilk; mix well. Sift together flour, salt, baking powder and baking soda. Add to egg mixture and mix well. Add oatmeal, nuts and raisins. Stir only until blended. Bake at 350° for 1 hour. Store 1 day before slicing.

recipes.title: Old-Fashioned Chocolate Loaf Cake
ingredients: 5 large or extra large eggs, separated
directions: Preheat oven to 300°.
Need a bread loaf pan with an 8-cup capacity.
Line or spray pan and set aside.
Sift together flour, baking powder and salt and set aside.
Melt chocolate in double boiler until smooth and set aside to cool slightly.
In large bowl, cream butter.
Add vanilla and 1 cup sugar (reserve 1/4 cup sugar).
Beat thoroughly.
Add egg yolks and beat well.
Add chocolate and beat until blended.
Add sifted dry ingredients and beat.
Beat egg whites on moderately high speed until whites hold a soft shape.
Fold whites into thick chocolate mixture.
Turn mixture into prepared pan.
Bake in preheated oven.
Cool.
Wrap cake in plastic wrap and let stand at room temperature overnight before serving.
recipes.text: Old-Fashioned Chocolate Loaf Cake. Preheat oven to 300°. Need a bread loaf pan with an 8-cup capacity. Line or spray pan and set aside. Sift together flour, baking powder and salt and set aside. Melt chocolate in double boiler until smooth and set aside to cool slightly. In large bowl, cream butter. Add vanilla and 1 cup sugar (reserve 1/4 cup sugar). Beat thoroughly. Add egg yolks and beat well. Add chocolate and beat until blended. Add sifted dry ingredients and beat. Beat egg whites on moderately high speed until whites hold a soft shape. Fold whites into thick chocolate mixture. Turn mixture into prepared pan. Bake in preheated oven. Cool. Wrap cake in plastic wrap and let stand at room temperature overnight before serving.

recipes.title: Potato Kentucky
directions: Mix all together in a 9 x 13-inch dish.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Potato Kentucky. Mix all together in a 9 x 13-inch dish. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Rice Bread
directions: Peel plantains and grate in blender.
In a large bowl, mix grated plantain, cream of rice, baking soda, oil, salt and sugar or honey.
Stir until properly mixed.
recipes.text: Rice Bread. Peel plantains and grate in blender. In a large bowl, mix grated plantain, cream of rice, baking soda, oil, salt and sugar or honey. Stir until properly mixed.

recipes.title: Molasses Oatmeal Cookies
directions: Sift together flour, soda, salt and spices.
Cream the shortening.
Beat in sugar. Blend in egg and molasses. Beat well. Stir in sifted ingredients. Fold in raisins and rolled oats. Drop by teaspoonfuls 2-inches apart on lightly greased or Pam sprayed cookie sheet.
Bake at 325° for 12 to 15 minutes.
Let stand 1 minute. Remove to cooling rack.
recipes.text: Molasses Oatmeal Cookies. Sift together flour, soda, salt and spices. Cream the shortening. Beat in sugar. Blend in egg and molasses. Beat well. Stir in sifted ingredients. Fold in raisins and rolled oats. Drop by teaspoonfuls 2-inches apart on lightly greased or Pam sprayed cookie sheet. Bake at 325° for 12 to 15 minutes. Let stand 1 minute. Remove to cooling rack.

recipes.title: Brenda'S Any Meat Barbecue Sauce(Great For Pork, Beef, Chicken, Venison)
directions: In medium saucepan combine all ingredients.
Simmer for 15 minutes.
Prebake meat for about 1/2 hour.
Pour sauce over and continue to bake until meat is tender.
Use extra sauce over rice.
recipes.text: Brenda'S Any Meat Barbecue Sauce(Great For Pork, Beef, Chicken, Venison). In medium saucepan combine all ingredients. Simmer for 15 minutes. Prebake meat for about 1/2 hour. Pour sauce over and continue to bake until meat is tender. Use extra sauce over rice.

recipes.title: Oatmeal Pie
directions: Mix all ingredients together.
Pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake at 375° for 40 to 45 minutes or until golden brown.
Tastes like pecan pie!
recipes.text: Oatmeal Pie. Mix all ingredients together. Pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake at 375° for 40 to 45 minutes or until golden brown. Tastes like pecan pie!

recipes.title: Liver And Onions
directions: Rinse liver and place on waxed paper.
Squeeze lemon juice on both sides of each piece of liver.
Sprinkle both sides of liver with salt and pepper.
Dredge liver in a mixture of flour and salt and pepper placed in a brown paper sack.
Quickly brown both sides of liver in a frypan of hot Crisco.
Remove liver from frypan and place on a plate or other container.
Set aside.
Slice onions and gently saute until translucent and a golden color.
In very large saucepan or Dutch oven pan, place a layer of liver.
Sprinkle with flour and a layer of onions.
Repeat until all liver and onions have been placed in pan.
Add 2 or 3 cups of water and place pan over medium heat.
Cook 15 minutes.
Add more flour and water. Cook another 30 minutes.
Liver should be tender and in a nice thick brown gravy.
recipes.text: Liver And Onions. Rinse liver and place on waxed paper. Squeeze lemon juice on both sides of each piece of liver. Sprinkle both sides of liver with salt and pepper. Dredge liver in a mixture of flour and salt and pepper placed in a brown paper sack. Quickly brown both sides of liver in a frypan of hot Crisco. Remove liver from frypan and place on a plate or other container. Set aside. Slice onions and gently saute until translucent and a golden color. In very large saucepan or Dutch oven pan, place a layer of liver. Sprinkle with flour and a layer of onions. Repeat until all liver and onions have been placed in pan. Add 2 or 3 cups of water and place pan over medium heat. Cook 15 minutes. Add more flour and water. Cook another 30 minutes. Liver should be tender and in a nice thick brown gravy.

recipes.title: Nut Spice Cake
directions: Cream butter and sugar, add eggs one at a time.
Mix flour and spices, add to butter mixture alternately with milk.
Add vanilla and nuts.
Mix well.
Bake in tube pan for 1 hour and 15 minutes at 325°.
recipes.text: Nut Spice Cake. Cream butter and sugar, add eggs one at a time. Mix flour and spices, add to butter mixture alternately with milk. Add vanilla and nuts. Mix well. Bake in tube pan for 1 hour and 15 minutes at 325°.

recipes.title: Chicken In A Skillet With Tomatoes
ingredients: 2 1/2 to 3 lb. chicken, cut into serving pieces
1 (14 1/2 oz.) can tomatoes, drained and chopped (reserving liquid)
directions: In large skillet, heat oil and brown chicken; drain.
Add tomatoes and soup mix blended with water and reserved liquid. Simmer, covered, stirring occasionally, 45 minutes or until chicken is tender.
recipes.text: Chicken In A Skillet With Tomatoes. In large skillet, heat oil and brown chicken; drain. Add tomatoes and soup mix blended with water and reserved liquid. Simmer, covered, stirring occasionally, 45 minutes or until chicken is tender.

recipes.title: Summer Squash Casserole
ingredients: 1 can cream of chicken or mushroom condensed soup
1 (8 oz.) pkg. herb seasoned stuffing mix
directions: Cook squash and onion together for 5 minutes in salted water. Drain.
Combine soup, sour cream and carrots.
Fold into drained squash and onion.
recipes.text: Summer Squash Casserole. Cook squash and onion together for 5 minutes in salted water. Drain. Combine soup, sour cream and carrots. Fold into drained squash and onion.

recipes.title: Macaroni Salad
directions: Cook macaroni and eggs.
Cool.
Add macaroni, eggs, onion, celery and sweet relish together.
Mix in mayonnaise.
recipes.text: Macaroni Salad. Cook macaroni and eggs. Cool. Add macaroni, eggs, onion, celery and sweet relish together. Mix in mayonnaise.

recipes.title: Grapefruit Pineapple Slush
directions: Mix juices and tequila.
Pour all but one cup into ice cube trays (preferably metal) fitted with dividers.
Freeze for several hours or up to 2 days.
Refrigerate remaining one cup mixture.
recipes.text: Grapefruit Pineapple Slush. Mix juices and tequila. Pour all but one cup into ice cube trays (preferably metal) fitted with dividers. Freeze for several hours or up to 2 days. Refrigerate remaining one cup mixture.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Bars
ingredients: 1 (16 oz.) large can solid pack pumpkin
directions: Mix pound cake mix, egg and spice with fork until it is all moist.
Pat in bottom of greased 8 x 11-inch pan.
Beat cream cheese until creamy.
Add pumpkin, milk, eggs and spice until well mixed.
Pour over crust and bake at 300° for 45 to 60 minutes.
recipes.text: Pumpkin Bars. Mix pound cake mix, egg and spice with fork until it is all moist. Pat in bottom of greased 8 x 11-inch pan. Beat cream cheese until creamy. Add pumpkin, milk, eggs and spice until well mixed. Pour over crust and bake at 300° for 45 to 60 minutes.

recipes.title: Chocolate Chip Cake
ingredients: 1 c. sour cream plus 1 heaped tsp.
directions: Preheat oven to 350°.
Grease and flour a 10-inch tube pan.
recipes.text: Chocolate Chip Cake. Preheat oven to 350°. Grease and flour a 10-inch tube pan.

recipes.title: Chocolate Creme De Menthe Pie
ingredients: 1/2 pt. heavy cream, whipped or 1 pkg. Dream Whip
directions: Combine milk and marshmallows in double boiler; cook until dissolved.
Cool thoroughly.
Add creme de menthe.
Combine crushed cookies and butter.
Mix well, then press in an 8-inch pie pan.
Fold the whipped cream into marshmallow mixture.
Pour in shell and sprinkle with cookie crumbs.
Chill at least 5 hours before serving.
recipes.text: Chocolate Creme De Menthe Pie. Combine milk and marshmallows in double boiler; cook until dissolved. Cool thoroughly. Add creme de menthe. Combine crushed cookies and butter. Mix well, then press in an 8-inch pie pan. Fold the whipped cream into marshmallow mixture. Pour in shell and sprinkle with cookie crumbs. Chill at least 5 hours before serving.

recipes.title: Apple Cobbler
directions: Dissolve 2 cups sugar in 2 cups water.
Heat until sugar is dissolved.
Will look like there is too much liquid.
Some of the liquid from canned fruit can replace part of sugar mixture. Spread 2 cups apples on dough.
Sprinkle with cinnamon.
Roll and cut in 1/2-inch pieces.
Melt 1 stick butter in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch dish.
Pour sugar mixture on and butter.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Apple Cobbler. Dissolve 2 cups sugar in 2 cups water. Heat until sugar is dissolved. Will look like there is too much liquid. Some of the liquid from canned fruit can replace part of sugar mixture. Spread 2 cups apples on dough. Sprinkle with cinnamon. Roll and cut in 1/2-inch pieces. Melt 1 stick butter in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch dish. Pour sugar mixture on and butter. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Hamburger Corn Pone Pie
ingredients: 1 c. corn bread batter (1/2 pkg. corn muffin mix or 1/2 corn bread recipe)
directions: Brown meat and chopped onion in melted shortening.
Add seasoning and tomatoes.
Cover and simmer over low heat for 15 minutes, then add kidney beans.
Pour meat mixture into a greased 1 or 1 1/2-quart casserole.
Top with corn bread mixture, spreading with a wet knife.
Bake in hot oven (425°) for 20 minutes.
recipes.text: Hamburger Corn Pone Pie. Brown meat and chopped onion in melted shortening. Add seasoning and tomatoes. Cover and simmer over low heat for 15 minutes, then add kidney beans. Pour meat mixture into a greased 1 or 1 1/2-quart casserole. Top with corn bread mixture, spreading with a wet knife. Bake in hot oven (425°) for 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Creamy Cucumber Salad
directions: Dissolve jello in boiling water. Add softened cream cheese, mayonnaise, salt, cayenne pepper and horseradish.
Blend until smooth. Add lemon juice. Chill until slightly thick. Fold in cucumber and onion. Turn into 6 (1/2 cup) salad molds and chill. Unmold and garnish with cherry tomatoes.
A nice summer molded salad.
Yields 6 servings.
recipes.text: Creamy Cucumber Salad. Dissolve jello in boiling water. Add softened cream cheese, mayonnaise, salt, cayenne pepper and horseradish. Blend until smooth. Add lemon juice. Chill until slightly thick. Fold in cucumber and onion. Turn into 6 (1/2 cup) salad molds and chill. Unmold and garnish with cherry tomatoes. A nice summer molded salad. Yields 6 servings.

recipes.title: Cream Cheese Pie
directions: Beat cheese until smooth.
Gradually beat in sugar.
Blend in sour cream and vanilla.
Fold in whipped topping.
Pour into graham cracker crust.
Chill 4 hours.
recipes.text: Cream Cheese Pie. Beat cheese until smooth. Gradually beat in sugar. Blend in sour cream and vanilla. Fold in whipped topping. Pour into graham cracker crust. Chill 4 hours.

recipes.title: Shower Dessert
directions: Prepare Jell-O according to package directions; chill until partially set.
Add fruits; fold in whipped cream.
Sprinkle nuts on top and chill until firm.
Yields 4 to 6 servings.
recipes.text: Shower Dessert. Prepare Jell-O according to package directions; chill until partially set. Add fruits; fold in whipped cream. Sprinkle nuts on top and chill until firm. Yields 4 to 6 servings.

recipes.title: Fruit Cocktail Pie
directions: Drain fruit cocktail,
Mix all ingredients, except crusts, together in bowl.
Blend well.
Put into crust and chill 2 hours in refrigerator.
recipes.text: Fruit Cocktail Pie. Drain fruit cocktail, Mix all ingredients, except crusts, together in bowl. Blend well. Put into crust and chill 2 hours in refrigerator.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Squares
directions: Mix the first 4 ingredients like pie crust.
Press in the bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Bake at 350° for 10 to 12 minutes. Mix the remaining ingredients.
Pour over crust and bake 45 to 50 minutes at 350°.
recipes.text: Pumpkin Squares. Mix the first 4 ingredients like pie crust. Press in the bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350° for 10 to 12 minutes. Mix the remaining ingredients. Pour over crust and bake 45 to 50 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Custard Pie
directions: Mix eggs, salt, nutmeg, sugar and vanilla.
Add hot milk slowly while stirring.
Pour into unbaked pie crust.
Bake at 425° for 30 to 40 minutes.
recipes.text: Custard Pie. Mix eggs, salt, nutmeg, sugar and vanilla. Add hot milk slowly while stirring. Pour into unbaked pie crust. Bake at 425° for 30 to 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Cheesy Scalloped Potatoes
directions: Combine mayonnaise, flour, salt and pepper.
Gradually add milk.
Cook, stirring constantly, over low heat until thickened. Add Cheddar cheese; stir until melted.
Place potatoes in a 10 x 6-inch baking dish.
Pour sauce over potatoes.
Bake in a 350° oven for about 60 minutes, or until potatoes are tender and bubbly.
Makes 4 to 6 servings.
recipes.text: Cheesy Scalloped Potatoes. Combine mayonnaise, flour, salt and pepper. Gradually add milk. Cook, stirring constantly, over low heat until thickened. Add Cheddar cheese; stir until melted. Place potatoes in a 10 x 6-inch baking dish. Pour sauce over potatoes. Bake in a 350° oven for about 60 minutes, or until potatoes are tender and bubbly. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

recipes.title: Girdle Buster
directions: Crumble cookies.
Layer in a 9 x 13-inch dish.
Pour margarine over mixture.
Spoon softened ice cream over layer.
Pour syrup and nuts over layer of ice cream.
Cover and freeze overnight. Next morning, spread Cool Whip over top and refrigerate until ready to use.
recipes.text: Girdle Buster. Crumble cookies. Layer in a 9 x 13-inch dish. Pour margarine over mixture. Spoon softened ice cream over layer. Pour syrup and nuts over layer of ice cream. Cover and freeze overnight. Next morning, spread Cool Whip over top and refrigerate until ready to use.

recipes.title: Baked Fresh Ham With Sherry Baste
directions: Remove rind from ham.
Season with salt and pepper.
Place in a roaster pan, bone side down, and with a sharp knife, score the top in a diamond design.
This will help to sherry the meat.
Add the water and tent with heavy foil.
Bake at 350° in a preheated oven for approximately 4 hours or until the ham is tender and pulls away from the bone.
Every 30 minutes, baste the ham with sherry.
Save the brownings in the pan for gravy.
recipes.text: Baked Fresh Ham With Sherry Baste. Remove rind from ham. Season with salt and pepper. Place in a roaster pan, bone side down, and with a sharp knife, score the top in a diamond design. This will help to sherry the meat. Add the water and tent with heavy foil. Bake at 350° in a preheated oven for approximately 4 hours or until the ham is tender and pulls away from the bone. Every 30 minutes, baste the ham with sherry. Save the brownings in the pan for gravy.

recipes.title: Butterhorn Cookies
ingredients: 1 pkg. dry yeast (use 2 Tbsp. warm water to dissolve yeast)
directions: Stir flour, baking powder and salt together.
Cut in butter with yeast, yolks, sour cream and vanilla.
Blend into flour mixture.
Chill for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Butterhorn Cookies. Stir flour, baking powder and salt together. Cut in butter with yeast, yolks, sour cream and vanilla. Blend into flour mixture. Chill for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Sopaipillas(Puffy Fried Bread)
directions: Sift flour; measure and sift again with salt, baking powder and sugar.
Cut in shortening.
Add milk to make a soft dough just firm enough to roll.
Cover bowl and let stand for 30 to 60 minutes or refrigerate until needed.
Divide dough in half; roll dough 1/4-inch thick on lightly floured board and cut into diamond-shaped pieces.
Heat oil in frying pan to approximately 370°.
Add a few pieces of dough at a time; turn at once so they will puff evenly, then turn back to brown both sides.
Drain on paper toweling.
Serve hot with butter and honey.
recipes.text: Sopaipillas(Puffy Fried Bread). Sift flour; measure and sift again with salt, baking powder and sugar. Cut in shortening. Add milk to make a soft dough just firm enough to roll. Cover bowl and let stand for 30 to 60 minutes or refrigerate until needed. Divide dough in half; roll dough 1/4-inch thick on lightly floured board and cut into diamond-shaped pieces. Heat oil in frying pan to approximately 370°. Add a few pieces of dough at a time; turn at once so they will puff evenly, then turn back to brown both sides. Drain on paper toweling. Serve hot with butter and honey.

recipes.title: Enchilada Casserole
ingredients: 1 (10 1/2 oz.) can chicken with rice soup
1 (10 1/2 oz.) can cream of mushroom soup
directions: Cook hamburger and drain, then put whole can of chicken with rice soup in.
Add can of cream of mushroom soup, enchilada sauce, green chilies, garlic, onion, salt and pepper.
This will be the sauce.
Layer ingredients:
first corn tortillas, sauce and Jack cheese (two layers).
Top with black olives.
recipes.text: Enchilada Casserole. Cook hamburger and drain, then put whole can of chicken with rice soup in. Add can of cream of mushroom soup, enchilada sauce, green chilies, garlic, onion, salt and pepper. This will be the sauce. Layer ingredients: first corn tortillas, sauce and Jack cheese (two layers). Top with black olives.

recipes.title: Coconut Custard Pie
directions: Make pastry for 1 crust pie.
Line 9-inch pie pan.
Build up high and fluted edge.
Beat eggs slightly, then beat in remaining ingredients.
Pour into pie crust.
Bake just until knife inserted 1 inch from side of filling comes out clean at 425° (25 to 30 minutes).
Too long baking makes custard watery.
recipes.text: Coconut Custard Pie. Make pastry for 1 crust pie. Line 9-inch pie pan. Build up high and fluted edge. Beat eggs slightly, then beat in remaining ingredients. Pour into pie crust. Bake just until knife inserted 1 inch from side of filling comes out clean at 425° (25 to 30 minutes). Too long baking makes custard watery.

recipes.title: Scalloped Corn Casserole
ingredients: 2 c. fresh corn, cut from cob, or 1 large can corn
directions: In small bowl, combine corn, milk, onion, green pepper, salt and pepper.
Put 1/2 of corn mixture into quart casserole dish. Layer half the cheese and half the bread crumbs.
Layer remaining corn and cheese.
Mix remaining crumbs with melted butter and cover corn and cheese with crumb mixture.
Bake 30 minutes at 375°.
recipes.text: Scalloped Corn Casserole. In small bowl, combine corn, milk, onion, green pepper, salt and pepper. Put 1/2 of corn mixture into quart casserole dish. Layer half the cheese and half the bread crumbs. Layer remaining corn and cheese. Mix remaining crumbs with melted butter and cover corn and cheese with crumb mixture. Bake 30 minutes at 375°.

recipes.title: Lemon Lime Rainbow Cake
directions: Prepare cake mix as box says, then pour into pan.
Bake at 350°.
While cake is in oven, mix Jell-O as box says; let refrigerate for 10 to 15 minutes.
When cake is done, poke holes in it while still in pan.
Pour 1/2 the jello in the holes on cake. (Don't pour too much, you don't want it mushy or real wet.)
Turn cake over onto cake plate.
Put icing on it and serve.
recipes.text: Lemon Lime Rainbow Cake. Prepare cake mix as box says, then pour into pan. Bake at 350°. While cake is in oven, mix Jell-O as box says; let refrigerate for 10 to 15 minutes. When cake is done, poke holes in it while still in pan. Pour 1/2 the jello in the holes on cake. (Don't pour too much, you don't want it mushy or real wet.) Turn cake over onto cake plate. Put icing on it and serve.

recipes.title: Banana Bread
directions: Cream with mixer or mash bananas to make 1 1/2 cups.
Set aside.
Cream together the butter, sugar and eggs.
Sift together the flour, salt, baking powder and soda.
Mix together alternately with buttermilk and bananas.
Fold in nuts.
Put into 2 small or 1 large bread pan.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes, until toothpick comes out clean.
recipes.text: Banana Bread. Cream with mixer or mash bananas to make 1 1/2 cups. Set aside. Cream together the butter, sugar and eggs. Sift together the flour, salt, baking powder and soda. Mix together alternately with buttermilk and bananas. Fold in nuts. Put into 2 small or 1 large bread pan. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes, until toothpick comes out clean.

recipes.title: Peanut Brittle
ingredients: small piece of paraffin (size of a thimble)
directions: Cook the first 4 ingredients in a thick boiler 5 to 6 minutes. Remove from heat. Add the soda.
Stir well.
Pour on greased foil or dish. When cool, turn over and break into pieces.
recipes.text: Peanut Brittle. Cook the first 4 ingredients in a thick boiler 5 to 6 minutes. Remove from heat. Add the soda. Stir well. Pour on greased foil or dish. When cool, turn over and break into pieces.

recipes.title: Chicken And Rice
directions: Pour uncooked rice into 9 x 13-inch dish.
Top with chicken breasts.
Mix soups and water together.
Pour over chicken.
Cover and bake at 350° for 1 hour and 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Chicken And Rice. Pour uncooked rice into 9 x 13-inch dish. Top with chicken breasts. Mix soups and water together. Pour over chicken. Cover and bake at 350° for 1 hour and 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Chicken Parmesan
directions: Mix bread crumbs, garlic powder, salt and Parmesan cheese. Skin 8 chicken breasts and dip each in 1 stick melted butter. Roll buttered chicken in crumb mixture and place in baking pan. Dot with butter and bake 1 hour at 360°.
recipes.text: Chicken Parmesan. Mix bread crumbs, garlic powder, salt and Parmesan cheese. Skin 8 chicken breasts and dip each in 1 stick melted butter. Roll buttered chicken in crumb mixture and place in baking pan. Dot with butter and bake 1 hour at 360°.

recipes.title: World'S Greatest Cornbread
ingredients: 1 box Flako or Jiffy corn muffin mix (8 1/2 oz.)
1 (8 oz.) can whole kernel corn (preferably Shoepeg corn)
directions: Mix all ingredients.
Bake at 350° to 375° for about 45 minutes.
Use 13 x 19-inch pan.
recipes.text: World'S Greatest Cornbread. Mix all ingredients. Bake at 350° to 375° for about 45 minutes. Use 13 x 19-inch pan.

recipes.title: Oven Fried Chicken
directions: Cook chicken 15 minutes and drain well.
Dip in buttermilk. Mix flour, parsley flakes, paprika, salt, pepper, thyme and seasoned salt.
Dredge chicken through mixture.
Place in single layer in baking dish with melted margarine.
Bake at 400° for 30 minutes, turn chicken and bake 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Oven Fried Chicken. Cook chicken 15 minutes and drain well. Dip in buttermilk. Mix flour, parsley flakes, paprika, salt, pepper, thyme and seasoned salt. Dredge chicken through mixture. Place in single layer in baking dish with melted margarine. Bake at 400° for 30 minutes, turn chicken and bake 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Oat Bran Muffins
directions: Combine oat bran, flour, sugar, baking powder, soda, salt and cinnamon.
Mix thoroughly and set aside.
Lightly beat egg whites with fork, then stir in milk, oil and orange zest.
Pour into flour mixture and stir just until dry ingredients are moistened. Fold in dates and nuts.
Fill 12 paper lined muffin cups 2/3 full. Bake at 400° until done, about 20 minutes.
Remove and cool on wire rack.
recipes.text: Oat Bran Muffins. Combine oat bran, flour, sugar, baking powder, soda, salt and cinnamon. Mix thoroughly and set aside. Lightly beat egg whites with fork, then stir in milk, oil and orange zest. Pour into flour mixture and stir just until dry ingredients are moistened. Fold in dates and nuts. Fill 12 paper lined muffin cups 2/3 full. Bake at 400° until done, about 20 minutes. Remove and cool on wire rack.

recipes.title: Hot Dog Stew
ingredients: 1 lb. hot dogs, cut in 1-inch pieces
directions: Put first three ingredients and 1 cup water in 3-quart pot. Bring to a boil and add potato and carrots.
Cover and let simmer 15 minutes.
Add peas and hot dogs.
Cover and simmer about 6 minutes longer.
Season to taste with salt and pepper.
Remove bay leaves and serve.
Yields 6 servings.
recipes.text: Hot Dog Stew. Put first three ingredients and 1 cup water in 3-quart pot. Bring to a boil and add potato and carrots. Cover and let simmer 15 minutes. Add peas and hot dogs. Cover and simmer about 6 minutes longer. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Remove bay leaves and serve. Yields 6 servings.

recipes.title: Southern Style Chili
directions: Brown meat and drain.
Add onions and garlic.
Cook until tender. Add tomatoes, water, beans and chili mix.
Simmer 15 minutes. Top with cheese.
Makes 9 (1 cup) servings.
recipes.text: Southern Style Chili. Brown meat and drain. Add onions and garlic. Cook until tender. Add tomatoes, water, beans and chili mix. Simmer 15 minutes. Top with cheese. Makes 9 (1 cup) servings.

recipes.title: Sausage Rolls
ingredients: 2 (1 lb.) sausage (Bob Evans, 1 hot and 1 mild)
2 c. grated cheese (Provolone, Swiss or Cheddar)
directions: Brown sausage well; drain.
Put in bowl; add garlic powder, parsley, basil and Parmesan cheese.
Cool, then add beaten eggs; mix well.
Open crescent rolls and separate each into 2 halves. Lay flat but don't roll out dough.
Press seams together to make rectangle.
Fill with meat mixture, then sprinkle with cheese. Roll up lengthwise.
Brush with beaten egg.
Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes.
Makes 4 rolls.
recipes.text: Sausage Rolls. Brown sausage well; drain. Put in bowl; add garlic powder, parsley, basil and Parmesan cheese. Cool, then add beaten eggs; mix well. Open crescent rolls and separate each into 2 halves. Lay flat but don't roll out dough. Press seams together to make rectangle. Fill with meat mixture, then sprinkle with cheese. Roll up lengthwise. Brush with beaten egg. Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes. Makes 4 rolls.

recipes.title: Seven Layer Salad
directions: Layer the first 5 ingredients in a 9 x 13-inch pan or dish. Mix sugar and salad dressing.
Spread over top of layers.
Sprinkle with cheese.
Store in refrigerator for 24 hours.
Crumble bacon over top before serving (bacon bits may be used).
Makes 6 to 8 servings.
recipes.text: Seven Layer Salad. Layer the first 5 ingredients in a 9 x 13-inch pan or dish. Mix sugar and salad dressing. Spread over top of layers. Sprinkle with cheese. Store in refrigerator for 24 hours. Crumble bacon over top before serving (bacon bits may be used). Makes 6 to 8 servings.

recipes.title: Springtime Salad
directions: Put sour cream in bowl with ingredients, except coconut.
Mix together.
Fold in coconut.
Refrigerate 12 to 24 hours.
recipes.text: Springtime Salad. Put sour cream in bowl with ingredients, except coconut. Mix together. Fold in coconut. Refrigerate 12 to 24 hours.

recipes.title: French Meat Pie
directions: In skillet, heat oil over medium.
Saute onion until tender. Remove and set aside.
Brown beef and pork together.
Drain. Combine onion, meat, potatoes and seasonings.
Line pie plate with pastry.
Fill with meat mixture.
Top with crust.
Seal and flute edges.
Make slits on top crust.
Brush with egg and bake in 375° oven 30 to 35 minutes or until golden brown.
recipes.text: French Meat Pie. In skillet, heat oil over medium. Saute onion until tender. Remove and set aside. Brown beef and pork together. Drain. Combine onion, meat, potatoes and seasonings. Line pie plate with pastry. Fill with meat mixture. Top with crust. Seal and flute edges. Make slits on top crust. Brush with egg and bake in 375° oven 30 to 35 minutes or until golden brown.

recipes.title: Sugarless Bars
directions: Boil raisins, dates, pineapple and water for 3 minutes.
Add oleo and cool.
Then add flour, Sweet 'N Low, nuts, eggs, vanilla and soda.
Bake in 9 x 13-inch pan at 350° for 25 minutes.
recipes.text: Sugarless Bars. Boil raisins, dates, pineapple and water for 3 minutes. Add oleo and cool. Then add flour, Sweet 'N Low, nuts, eggs, vanilla and soda. Bake in 9 x 13-inch pan at 350° for 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Rice-A-Roni
directions: Prepare Rice-A-Roni as on package; cool.
Cook carrots 5 minutes or until tender, but not soft.
Cool.
After cooked ingredients have cooled, mix all together with 1/2 cup mayonnaise; chill.
Serves 4 to 6.
recipes.text: Rice-A-Roni. Prepare Rice-A-Roni as on package; cool. Cook carrots 5 minutes or until tender, but not soft. Cool. After cooked ingredients have cooled, mix all together with 1/2 cup mayonnaise; chill. Serves 4 to 6.

recipes.title: Sherbet Punch
directions: Pour
Sprite over sherbet.
Add cherries.
Mix together lightly, leaving
a
good
portion of sherbet in center.
Pour into glasses.
More Sprite can be added until sherbet is gone.
recipes.text: Sherbet Punch. Pour Sprite over sherbet. Add cherries. Mix together lightly, leaving a good portion of sherbet in center. Pour into glasses. More Sprite can be added until sherbet is gone.

recipes.title: Turkish Delight
ingredients: 1/2 c. undiluted frozen orange juice concentrate
directions: Blend together 8 envelopes unflavored gelatin and 2 c. sugar in 2 1/2 quart saucepan.
Stir in water and salt.
Place over low heat, stirring constantly, until gelatin and sugar are dissolved. Let simmer 20 mins, stirring constantly.
Remove from heat and stir in orange juice concentrate.
Chill, stirring constantly until thickened.
Stir in nuts.
Line an 8 inch square pan with waxed paper.
Turn mixture into pan and chill until firm.
Unmold on board dusted with confectioners sugar.
Cut candy into squares and roll in sugar.
Makes 1 1/2 pounds.
recipes.text: Turkish Delight. Blend together 8 envelopes unflavored gelatin and 2 c. sugar in 2 1/2 quart saucepan. Stir in water and salt. Place over low heat, stirring constantly, until gelatin and sugar are dissolved. Let simmer 20 mins, stirring constantly. Remove from heat and stir in orange juice concentrate. Chill, stirring constantly until thickened. Stir in nuts. Line an 8 inch square pan with waxed paper. Turn mixture into pan and chill until firm. Unmold on board dusted with confectioners sugar. Cut candy into squares and roll in sugar. Makes 1 1/2 pounds.

recipes.title: Microwave Swiss Steak
ingredients: 1 medium onion, thinly sliced and separated into rings
directions: Trim steak and pound well.
Cut into 6 to 8 pieces.
Mix flour, salt and pepper.
Coat beef with flour mixture.
Place meat and remaining flour mixture into rectangular baking dish, 12 x 8-inch or 10-inch square.
recipes.text: Microwave Swiss Steak. Trim steak and pound well. Cut into 6 to 8 pieces. Mix flour, salt and pepper. Coat beef with flour mixture. Place meat and remaining flour mixture into rectangular baking dish, 12 x 8-inch or 10-inch square.

recipes.title: Pizza Sauce
directions: Wash, scald, skin, core and chop tomatoes.
Clean peppers (remove seeds) and onion.
Chop fine.
Add rest of ingredients and cook until sauce is as thick as you want it.
Pour into hot jars. Process pints 30 minutes and quarts 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Pizza Sauce. Wash, scald, skin, core and chop tomatoes. Clean peppers (remove seeds) and onion. Chop fine. Add rest of ingredients and cook until sauce is as thick as you want it. Pour into hot jars. Process pints 30 minutes and quarts 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Moose Meatballs
ingredients: 1 lb. ground moose meat or ground beef
1 medium green pepper, cut into strips
directions: In a mixing bowl combine meat, egg, 1 tablespoon cornstarch, salt, pepper and onion.
Shape into 1 1/2 inch balls.
In large skillet brown meatballs in oil.
Cover and cook over low heat until done, approximately 10 minutes.
In saucepan, stir vinegar and remaining cornstarch until smooth.
Drain pineapple, reserving juice; set pineapple aside. Add enough water to juice to equal 1 1/2 cups; stir into vinegar mixture.
Add sugar and soy sauce; cook and stir over medium heat until thickened.
Add meatballs, pineapple and green pepper; cook until heated through and green pepper is tender.
Serve over noodles.
Yield: 3 to 4 servings.
recipes.text: Moose Meatballs. In a mixing bowl combine meat, egg, 1 tablespoon cornstarch, salt, pepper and onion. Shape into 1 1/2 inch balls. In large skillet brown meatballs in oil. Cover and cook over low heat until done, approximately 10 minutes. In saucepan, stir vinegar and remaining cornstarch until smooth. Drain pineapple, reserving juice; set pineapple aside. Add enough water to juice to equal 1 1/2 cups; stir into vinegar mixture. Add sugar and soy sauce; cook and stir over medium heat until thickened. Add meatballs, pineapple and green pepper; cook until heated through and green pepper is tender. Serve over noodles. Yield: 3 to 4 servings.

recipes.title: Nut Cake
ingredients: 1/2 c. black walnuts rolled or ground
directions: Mix and bake at 350° until brown.
recipes.text: Nut Cake. Mix and bake at 350° until brown.

recipes.title: Bean And Sausage Chowder
ingredients: 1 (10 oz.) pkg. frozen lima beans, thawed and drained
1 (15 1/2 oz.) can garbanzo beans, rinsed and drained
1 (12 oz.) pkg. smoked sausage links, thinly sliced
directions: Melt butter in large kettle.
Saute onion until tender.
Stir in flour and seasonings until smooth.
Gradually stir in milk. Bring to boil over medium heat, stirring constantly.
Boil and stir 1 minute.
Stir in beans and sausage.
Cover and simmer until lima beans are tender, 10 minutes or longer.
(For quicker cooking of limas, place in microwave and zap for 5 minutes or more before adding to pot.)
Remove from heat and stir in cheese until melted.
Return to heat to finish melting cheese if necessary.
Do not boil.
Makes 8 cups.
recipes.text: Bean And Sausage Chowder. Melt butter in large kettle. Saute onion until tender. Stir in flour and seasonings until smooth. Gradually stir in milk. Bring to boil over medium heat, stirring constantly. Boil and stir 1 minute. Stir in beans and sausage. Cover and simmer until lima beans are tender, 10 minutes or longer. (For quicker cooking of limas, place in microwave and zap for 5 minutes or more before adding to pot.) Remove from heat and stir in cheese until melted. Return to heat to finish melting cheese if necessary. Do not boil. Makes 8 cups.

recipes.title: Easy Cheese Bread
directions: Combine butter and cheese; spread on both sides of each bread slice.
Sprinkle slices with poppy seed.
Place on baking sheet and toast in oven at 350° for 20 minutes, turning once.
recipes.text: Easy Cheese Bread. Combine butter and cheese; spread on both sides of each bread slice. Sprinkle slices with poppy seed. Place on baking sheet and toast in oven at 350° for 20 minutes, turning once.

recipes.title: Oreo Treat
directions: Crumble cookies on bottom of an 11 x 13-inch pan (reserve 1/2 cup).
Combine all other ingredients.
Pour on top of cookies. Sprinkle with reserve.
Chill for several hours before eating.
recipes.text: Oreo Treat. Crumble cookies on bottom of an 11 x 13-inch pan (reserve 1/2 cup). Combine all other ingredients. Pour on top of cookies. Sprinkle with reserve. Chill for several hours before eating.

recipes.title: Hungarian Goulash
ingredients: 2 lb. beef stew meat, cut in 1-inch chunks
directions: Place meat in slow-cooking pot; cover with sliced onion. Combine garlic, catsup, Worcestershire sauce, brown sugar, salt, paprika and mustard.
Stir in water and pour over meat.
Cover and cook on low for 9 to 10 hours.
Turn control to high.
Dissolve flour in small amount of cold water and stir into meat mixture. Cook on high for 10 to 15 minutes or until slightly thickened. Serve goulash over noodles or rice.
Makes 5 to 6 servings.
recipes.text: Hungarian Goulash. Place meat in slow-cooking pot; cover with sliced onion. Combine garlic, catsup, Worcestershire sauce, brown sugar, salt, paprika and mustard. Stir in water and pour over meat. Cover and cook on low for 9 to 10 hours. Turn control to high. Dissolve flour in small amount of cold water and stir into meat mixture. Cook on high for 10 to 15 minutes or until slightly thickened. Serve goulash over noodles or rice. Makes 5 to 6 servings.

recipes.title: Bean And Weenee
ingredients: 3 (16 oz.) cans Phillips pork and beans
3 tsp. Texas Pete or to taste
directions: Cut hot dog wieners into bite size pieces, then mix all of the ingredients into pot.
Cook over low heat for 30 to 45 minutes, until mixture thickens or wieners are done.
recipes.text: Bean And Weenee. Cut hot dog wieners into bite size pieces, then mix all of the ingredients into pot. Cook over low heat for 30 to 45 minutes, until mixture thickens or wieners are done.

recipes.title: Blender Hollandaise Sauce
directions: Heat butter in saucepan until bubbly, but not browned.
Put egg yolks, lemon juice, salt, pepper and mustard in blender container.
Cover and turn on low speed about 5 seconds.
recipes.text: Blender Hollandaise Sauce. Heat butter in saucepan until bubbly, but not browned. Put egg yolks, lemon juice, salt, pepper and mustard in blender container. Cover and turn on low speed about 5 seconds.

recipes.title: Deb'S Chicken Pie
ingredients: 3 or 4 lb. chicken, cooked and deboned
1 can Veg-All, drained, or your own steamed vegetables (carrots, peas, etc.)
1 c. buttermilk (you can use sweet milk)
directions: Mix
chicken,
mushroom
soup,	vegetables
and chicken broth and put in baking dish.
Stir together buttermilk, flour and margarine.	Pour over pie and bake at 350° for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Deb'S Chicken Pie. Mix chicken, mushroom soup,	vegetables and chicken broth and put in baking dish. Stir together buttermilk, flour and margarine.	Pour over pie and bake at 350° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Chicken-Turkey Casserole
ingredients: 3 c. cooked and diced chicken or turkey
1 (4 oz.) can mushrooms, chopped and juice
directions: Cook noodles.
Drain and rinse.
Cook bell peppers, onions and garlic in melted margarine until just tender.
Mix in all other ingredients.
Pour into a 10 x 14-inch baking dish.
Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese (be generous).
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.
This freezes well.
recipes.text: Chicken-Turkey Casserole. Cook noodles. Drain and rinse. Cook bell peppers, onions and garlic in melted margarine until just tender. Mix in all other ingredients. Pour into a 10 x 14-inch baking dish. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese (be generous). Bake at 350° for 45 minutes. This freezes well.

recipes.title: Mrs. Le Tourneau'S Fruit Cake Or Lemon Cake
ingredients: 3 oz. Sauer's lemon extract (not an error; put in all 3 oz.)
directions: Put all fruit in a bowl.
