Mix 1 cup of the flour with the fruit.
If using cherries and pineapple, mix them in the batter first without any flour on them.
Cream the butter and sugar.
Add Karo, lemon extract and alternate flour and whole eggs.
Beat well (5 minutes with electric beater).
Pour mixture over fruit and nuts.
Pour in loaf pans or tube pan.
(Note:
Put brown paper on bottom of pans; grease well.)
Bake slowly at 300° for 1 1/2 hours.
Test to see if done.
recipes.text: Mrs. Le Tourneau'S Fruit Cake Or Lemon Cake. Put all fruit in a bowl. Mix 1 cup of the flour with the fruit. If using cherries and pineapple, mix them in the batter first without any flour on them. Cream the butter and sugar. Add Karo, lemon extract and alternate flour and whole eggs. Beat well (5 minutes with electric beater). Pour mixture over fruit and nuts. Pour in loaf pans or tube pan. (Note: Put brown paper on bottom of pans; grease well.) Bake slowly at 300° for 1 1/2 hours. Test to see if done.

recipes.title: Ground Beef Casserole
directions: Brown ground beef and season.
Saute diced onion and green pepper in butter.
Cook Creamettes; drain.
Layer in casserole dish the Creamettes noodles, meat, pepper and onion, spoonfuls of celery soup and cheese.
Make 2 layers.
Bake at 325° until cheese melts.
recipes.text: Ground Beef Casserole. Brown ground beef and season. Saute diced onion and green pepper in butter. Cook Creamettes; drain. Layer in casserole dish the Creamettes noodles, meat, pepper and onion, spoonfuls of celery soup and cheese. Make 2 layers. Bake at 325° until cheese melts.

recipes.title: Caramel Apple Dip
directions: Cover apples with dip and roll in chopped nuts.
recipes.text: Caramel Apple Dip. Cover apples with dip and roll in chopped nuts.

recipes.title: Cappuccino Mix
ingredients: 1 c. coffee creamer (light or no fat)
1 c. instant sugar-free chocolate drink mix
directions: Combine and mix well. Store in airtight container. Use 2 to 3 teaspoons for each cup of water. Different coffee creamers may be used.
recipes.text: Cappuccino Mix. Combine and mix well. Store in airtight container. Use 2 to 3 teaspoons for each cup of water. Different coffee creamers may be used.

recipes.title: Peanut Brittle
directions: Cook
water,
syrup,
sugar
and
butter together until syrup threads.
Add
nuts and cook at a high temperature until peanuts pop
and syrup turns golden brown.
Take off stove and add baking soda,
stirring
well.
Pour
on
a greased cookie sheet.
Cool and press on bottom of the sheet to loosen.
recipes.text: Peanut Brittle. Cook water, syrup, sugar and butter together until syrup threads. Add nuts and cook at a high temperature until peanuts pop and syrup turns golden brown. Take off stove and add baking soda, stirring well. Pour on a greased cookie sheet. Cool and press on bottom of the sheet to loosen.

recipes.title: Golden Parmesan Potatoes
directions: Peel
potatoes	and
cut
in
quarters.
Combine flour, cheese,
salt,
pepper
in plastic bag.
Moisten potatoes with water and shake a few times in bag, coating potatoes well with cheese mixture.
Melt margarine in 9 x 13-inch baking dish and place potatoes in pan.
Bake at 350° for about 1 hour, turning once during baking.
recipes.text: Golden Parmesan Potatoes. Peel potatoes	and cut in quarters. Combine flour, cheese, salt, pepper in plastic bag. Moisten potatoes with water and shake a few times in bag, coating potatoes well with cheese mixture. Melt margarine in 9 x 13-inch baking dish and place potatoes in pan. Bake at 350° for about 1 hour, turning once during baking.

recipes.title: Mexican Casserole
ingredients: 1 small pkg. corn chips or nacho chips
1 small can enchilada or taco sauce (dilute with 1/2 can water)
directions: Fry hamburger until brown.
Drain.
Add onion to meat.
Spread beans in a 8 x 11-inch pan.
Crumble chips and spread on beans. Add hamburger with onions to chips and beans.
Pour diluted sauce on top of meat.
Top with grated cheese and olives.
Bake at 350° until bubbly and heated, about 20 minutes.
recipes.text: Mexican Casserole. Fry hamburger until brown. Drain. Add onion to meat. Spread beans in a 8 x 11-inch pan. Crumble chips and spread on beans. Add hamburger with onions to chips and beans. Pour diluted sauce on top of meat. Top with grated cheese and olives. Bake at 350° until bubbly and heated, about 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Ice Cream Sundae Dessert
directions: Crush cookies between 2 layers of wax paper to about 1/4 inch size.
Mix with melted margarine. Put in a greased 9 x 13-inch pan.
Chill.
Slice ice cream and spread over the cookie crust. Freeze hard.
recipes.text: Ice Cream Sundae Dessert. Crush cookies between 2 layers of wax paper to about 1/4 inch size. Mix with melted margarine. Put in a greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Chill. Slice ice cream and spread over the cookie crust. Freeze hard.

recipes.title: Butter Rolls - 1930'S
directions: Use enough biscuit dough for a 9 x 7-inch pan or iron skillet (easy butter; we had no icebox so butter must be soft).
I could take these to school in my lunch bucket and trade to other children for apples or bananas that we didn't have.
They loved them, too.
recipes.text: Butter Rolls - 1930'S. Use enough biscuit dough for a 9 x 7-inch pan or iron skillet (easy butter; we had no icebox so butter must be soft). I could take these to school in my lunch bucket and trade to other children for apples or bananas that we didn't have. They loved them, too.

recipes.title: Ice Cream Pie
directions: Allow ice cream (fudge twirl, vanilla, chocolate or experiment with your own flavor) to begin melting while making crust.
recipes.text: Ice Cream Pie. Allow ice cream (fudge twirl, vanilla, chocolate or experiment with your own flavor) to begin melting while making crust.

recipes.title: Chess Pie
directions: Melt margarine; add sugar and flour.
Mix well.
Add beaten eggs, milk and vanilla; mix well.
Pour into 2 unbaked pie shells. Bake at 375° until filling is firm and brown on top.
recipes.text: Chess Pie. Melt margarine; add sugar and flour. Mix well. Add beaten eggs, milk and vanilla; mix well. Pour into 2 unbaked pie shells. Bake at 375° until filling is firm and brown on top.

recipes.title: Chicken Licken Good Pork Chops
directions: Combine the flour, salt, dry mustard and garlic powder.
Shake chops in mixture. Brown in oil.
Place browned chops in oven pan. Add soup. Cover and bake at 350° for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Chicken Licken Good Pork Chops. Combine the flour, salt, dry mustard and garlic powder. Shake chops in mixture. Brown in oil. Place browned chops in oven pan. Add soup. Cover and bake at 350° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Thai-Style Marinade
ingredients: 1 medium jalapeno, seeded and finely chopped*
1 bunch cilantro, rinsed and finely chopped
directions: *Use caution with seeds, they give the heat, and can burn your eyes if you touch them after handling the seeds.
recipes.text: Thai-Style Marinade. *Use caution with seeds, they give the heat, and can burn your eyes if you touch them after handling the seeds.

recipes.title: Broccoli-Rice Casserole 2
directions: Cook broccoli and onion. Drain. Add rest of ingredients to broccoli and onion.
Pour in a
greased 2-quart casserole dish. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Broccoli-Rice Casserole 2. Cook broccoli and onion. Drain. Add rest of ingredients to broccoli and onion. Pour in a greased 2-quart casserole dish. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Congealed Tuna Salad
directions: Dissolve gelatin in 1/2 cup cold water for 5 minutes. Dissolve chicken bouillon cubes in 1 1/2 cups boiling water.
Add gelatin to bouillon cubes.
Add tuna, mayonnaise, celery, olives and boiled eggs.
Chill in your favorite mold or in a small bowl.
recipes.text: Congealed Tuna Salad. Dissolve gelatin in 1/2 cup cold water for 5 minutes. Dissolve chicken bouillon cubes in 1 1/2 cups boiling water. Add gelatin to bouillon cubes. Add tuna, mayonnaise, celery, olives and boiled eggs. Chill in your favorite mold or in a small bowl.

recipes.title: Barbecue Beef On A Bun
ingredients: 1 lb. boneless beef chuck or rump roast
directions: Dry roast on paper towels.
In a deep, heavy pot, heat oil and add roast.
Brown on all sides.
Add all the other ingredients. Cover and simmer slowly over medium to low heat for 3 to 4 hours until beef can be easily shredded.
With two forks, shred the beef and mix into the sauce.
Taste and add salt, if necessary. Serve on hot buttered buns.
recipes.text: Barbecue Beef On A Bun. Dry roast on paper towels. In a deep, heavy pot, heat oil and add roast. Brown on all sides. Add all the other ingredients. Cover and simmer slowly over medium to low heat for 3 to 4 hours until beef can be easily shredded. With two forks, shred the beef and mix into the sauce. Taste and add salt, if necessary. Serve on hot buttered buns.

recipes.title: Cream Cheese Dip
ingredients: tomato juice (enough to give color and consistency)
directions: Mix cream cheese (softened) with Zesty Italian dressing.
Add enough tomato juice for color and spreading.
I use on Town House crackers and celery.
recipes.text: Cream Cheese Dip. Mix cream cheese (softened) with Zesty Italian dressing. Add enough tomato juice for color and spreading. I use on Town House crackers and celery.

recipes.title: Chocolate Cake
ingredients: 1 box chocolate cake mix with pudding
directions: Mix together and beat for 2 minutes.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour. When it is done, it is very moist.
Pour confectioners sugar over entire cake.
recipes.text: Chocolate Cake. Mix together and beat for 2 minutes. Bake at 350° for 1 hour. When it is done, it is very moist. Pour confectioners sugar over entire cake.

recipes.title: Tasty Crust For Fried Pies
directions: Mix the flour, shortening and salt, then add buttermilk and egg white.
Beat until stiff.
Chill before using.
(Can be kept in refrigerator until used.)
Fill with filling of your choice. This is the best crust!!
recipes.text: Tasty Crust For Fried Pies. Mix the flour, shortening and salt, then add buttermilk and egg white. Beat until stiff. Chill before using. (Can be kept in refrigerator until used.) Fill with filling of your choice. This is the best crust!!

recipes.title: Ranch Stuffed Potatoes
ingredients: 1 oz. pkg. Hidden Valley Ranch dressing mix
directions: Scoop out inside of baked potatoes and combine with sour cream and dressing mix.
Fill potato skins with mixture.
Sprinkle with Cheddar cheese and bake 12 to 15 minutes at 375°.
recipes.text: Ranch Stuffed Potatoes. Scoop out inside of baked potatoes and combine with sour cream and dressing mix. Fill potato skins with mixture. Sprinkle with Cheddar cheese and bake 12 to 15 minutes at 375°.

recipes.title: Shrimp Cocktail
directions: Mix all ingredients together except the shrimp. Arrange shrimp on lettuce. Cover with sauce. Put tomatoes, sliced and quartered, on the side. Serves 4.
recipes.text: Shrimp Cocktail. Mix all ingredients together except the shrimp. Arrange shrimp on lettuce. Cover with sauce. Put tomatoes, sliced and quartered, on the side. Serves 4.

recipes.title: Frozen Sweet Pickles
directions: Slice cucumbers and onions very thin. Sprinkle salt over them and let stand for 2 hours. Boil sugar and vinegar until sugar dissolves. Let cool. Drain cucumbers and onions. Add celery seeds and mix together. Put this mixture in 1 pint freezer containers. (This will be approximately 2 containers.) After sugar and vinegar mixture is cooled, pour over cucumbers. Seal containers and freeze.
recipes.text: Frozen Sweet Pickles. Slice cucumbers and onions very thin. Sprinkle salt over them and let stand for 2 hours. Boil sugar and vinegar until sugar dissolves. Let cool. Drain cucumbers and onions. Add celery seeds and mix together. Put this mixture in 1 pint freezer containers. (This will be approximately 2 containers.) After sugar and vinegar mixture is cooled, pour over cucumbers. Seal containers and freeze.

recipes.title: Teriyaki Chicken
ingredients: 1/2 c. cubed pineapple or apples cut into chunks
8 oz. water or pineapple juice if you use pineapple
directions: Cut breast quarters across the breast into strips about 1/4-inch thick.
Place in a bowl with the teriyaki sauce and refrigerate overnight.
Cut up all vegetables.
Grate up carrot, chop bell pepper, onion, celery and sliced mushrooms.
recipes.text: Teriyaki Chicken. Cut breast quarters across the breast into strips about 1/4-inch thick. Place in a bowl with the teriyaki sauce and refrigerate overnight. Cut up all vegetables. Grate up carrot, chop bell pepper, onion, celery and sliced mushrooms.

recipes.title: Spice Tea
directions: Mix all ingredients together. Put 2 or 3 teaspoons in a cup with hot water.
recipes.text: Spice Tea. Mix all ingredients together. Put 2 or 3 teaspoons in a cup with hot water.

recipes.title: Fried Green Tomatoes
directions: Cut tomatoes into thick slices.
Sprinkle with salt and pepper.
Dip in cornmeal, pressing meal firmly onto slices.
Fry in bacon drippings, adding more if needed, until lightly browned. Drain on paper towels.
Serve at once.
Makes 12 to 16 servings.
recipes.text: Fried Green Tomatoes. Cut tomatoes into thick slices. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Dip in cornmeal, pressing meal firmly onto slices. Fry in bacon drippings, adding more if needed, until lightly browned. Drain on paper towels. Serve at once. Makes 12 to 16 servings.

recipes.title: Fruit 'N Easy
ingredients: 1 can cherry pie filling (your choice of fruit)
directions: Layer baking pan with pie filling, then 1/2 box cake mix sprinkled on top.
Melt 1/2 stick butter and pour on top.
Mix brown sugar, cinnamon and nuts.
Sprinkle on top.
Microwave for 5 minutes.
recipes.text: Fruit 'N Easy. Layer baking pan with pie filling, then 1/2 box cake mix sprinkled on top. Melt 1/2 stick butter and pour on top. Mix brown sugar, cinnamon and nuts. Sprinkle on top. Microwave for 5 minutes.

recipes.title: Gooey Butter Cake
directions: Mix until smooth and pour on top of first mixture.
Bake at 350° until golden brown (30 to 40 minutes).
Sprinkle with powdered sugar.
recipes.text: Gooey Butter Cake. Mix until smooth and pour on top of first mixture. Bake at 350° until golden brown (30 to 40 minutes). Sprinkle with powdered sugar.

recipes.title: Chocolate Fudge Squares
directions: Mix as usual (no liquid).
Bake 25 to 30 minutes at 350°. Take out of oven.
*Pour marshmallows over hot cake layer and top with Fudge made as follows:
recipes.text: Chocolate Fudge Squares. Mix as usual (no liquid). Bake 25 to 30 minutes at 350°. Take out of oven. *Pour marshmallows over hot cake layer and top with Fudge made as follows:

recipes.title: Whole Wheat Banana Bread
directions: Cream together the margarine and sugar.
Add eggs.
Blend bananas in blender.
Sift flour, soda and salt.
Add bananas and flour mixture to mix.
Put into 2 greased bread pans.
Bake at 350° for 40 to 50 minutes.
Remove from pans and cool on rack.
recipes.text: Whole Wheat Banana Bread. Cream together the margarine and sugar. Add eggs. Blend bananas in blender. Sift flour, soda and salt. Add bananas and flour mixture to mix. Put into 2 greased bread pans. Bake at 350° for 40 to 50 minutes. Remove from pans and cool on rack.

recipes.title: Fruit Salad
directions: Mix dry pudding into pineapple chunks and juice; add other ingredients.
Mix and chill.
recipes.text: Fruit Salad. Mix dry pudding into pineapple chunks and juice; add other ingredients. Mix and chill.

recipes.title: Taco Dip
ingredients: 8 oz. mild taco sauce or salsa
directions: Preheat oven to 350°.
Use 9 x 11-inch glass baking dish.
Put one layer of beans, then sour cream, taco sauce (salsa) and cheese.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Taco Dip. Preheat oven to 350°. Use 9 x 11-inch glass baking dish. Put one layer of beans, then sour cream, taco sauce (salsa) and cheese. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Chicken Casserole
directions: Boil chicken.
Cool.
Pull chicken off the bone.
Layer, starting with sauce as a bottom layer.
Then add chicken and cheese and continue to layer chicken, sauce and cheese.
Then bake until cheese has melted and sauce bubbles.
recipes.text: Chicken Casserole. Boil chicken. Cool. Pull chicken off the bone. Layer, starting with sauce as a bottom layer. Then add chicken and cheese and continue to layer chicken, sauce and cheese. Then bake until cheese has melted and sauce bubbles.

recipes.title: Easy Cottage Cheese Salad
ingredients: 2 small cans mandarin oranges, drained well
2 small cans crushed pineapple, drained well
directions: Mix first three ingredients together in a large bowl (large enough to hold all ingredients).
Mix dry jello into Cool Whip in Cool Whip container.
Then fold into 1st mixture.
recipes.text: Easy Cottage Cheese Salad. Mix first three ingredients together in a large bowl (large enough to hold all ingredients). Mix dry jello into Cool Whip in Cool Whip container. Then fold into 1st mixture.

recipes.title: Tuna Noodle Casserole
ingredients: 3 1/2 c. light fluffy medium egg noodles (uncooked)
1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup
directions: Cook noodles according to package directions; drain.
Combine noodles, tuna, soup, cheese, milk and olives (if desired).
Turn into buttered 2-quart casserole.
Cover and bake at 375° for 20 minutes or until hot and bubbly.
recipes.text: Tuna Noodle Casserole. Cook noodles according to package directions; drain. Combine noodles, tuna, soup, cheese, milk and olives (if desired). Turn into buttered 2-quart casserole. Cover and bake at 375° for 20 minutes or until hot and bubbly.

recipes.title: Armenian Tossed Salad
directions: Combine all ingredients into large salad bowl (except last two).
Sprinkle with lemon juice combined with vegetable seasoning or with your favorite tomato dressing.
Then toss.
recipes.text: Armenian Tossed Salad. Combine all ingredients into large salad bowl (except last two). Sprinkle with lemon juice combined with vegetable seasoning or with your favorite tomato dressing. Then toss.

recipes.title: Lemon Tea Bread
ingredients: 1 pkg. Duncan Hines Lemon Supreme cake mix
directions: Combine all ingredients and beat 5 minutes, then beat 1 minute on High.
Bake in 2 greased loaf pans 45 minutes at 350° for 40 minutes.
recipes.text: Lemon Tea Bread. Combine all ingredients and beat 5 minutes, then beat 1 minute on High. Bake in 2 greased loaf pans 45 minutes at 350° for 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
directions: Heat oven to 375°.
Sift flour, baking soda and salt in small bowl.
In large mixing bowl, mix butter, both sugars and vanilla. Beat until creamy.
Beat in eggs.
Add flour gradually.
Stir in chocolate chips and nuts; mix well.
Drop by rounded tablespoonfuls onto ungreased cookie sheet.
Bake at 375° for 9 to 11 minutes. Makes about 5 dozen.
recipes.text: Chocolate Chip Cookies. Heat oven to 375°. Sift flour, baking soda and salt in small bowl. In large mixing bowl, mix butter, both sugars and vanilla. Beat until creamy. Beat in eggs. Add flour gradually. Stir in chocolate chips and nuts; mix well. Drop by rounded tablespoonfuls onto ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 375° for 9 to 11 minutes. Makes about 5 dozen.

recipes.title: Mushroom Soup
directions: Melt butter and add onion and mushrooms; saute 5 minutes. Stir in soups and sherry.
Cook on medium heat until hot.
recipes.text: Mushroom Soup. Melt butter and add onion and mushrooms; saute 5 minutes. Stir in soups and sherry. Cook on medium heat until hot.

recipes.title: Mom'S Chicken Pie
directions: Heat oven to 350°.
Place chicken in lightly greased 13 x 9-inch baking dish.
Mix both soups together with tarragon; pour over chicken.
Place vegetables over top.
Mix flour and baking powder in a bowl; add buttermilk and margarine.
Stir to form a thin dough; pour evenly over chicken mixture.
Bake, uncovered, about 1 hour until crust rises to top and browns lightly.
Serves 6.
recipes.text: Mom'S Chicken Pie. Heat oven to 350°. Place chicken in lightly greased 13 x 9-inch baking dish. Mix both soups together with tarragon; pour over chicken. Place vegetables over top. Mix flour and baking powder in a bowl; add buttermilk and margarine. Stir to form a thin dough; pour evenly over chicken mixture. Bake, uncovered, about 1 hour until crust rises to top and browns lightly. Serves 6.

recipes.title: No-Bake Peanut Butter Cookies
directions: Combine sugar and corn syrup.
Bring to boil.
Remove from heat and stir in peanut butter.
Pour this mixture over the corn flakes and coconut.
Mix well.
Drop by teaspoons on waxed paper.
recipes.text: No-Bake Peanut Butter Cookies. Combine sugar and corn syrup. Bring to boil. Remove from heat and stir in peanut butter. Pour this mixture over the corn flakes and coconut. Mix well. Drop by teaspoons on waxed paper.

recipes.title: Healthy Breakfast Casserole
ingredients: 2 Tbsp. diced sweet red pepper (may omit)
1 c. (4 oz.) shredded reduced fat sharp cheese
directions: Place bread evenly in 8-inch square baking dish coated with cooking spray.
Layer ham, red pepper and cheese over bread and set aside.
Combine milk and next 4 ingredients.
Pour over cheese.
Cover and refrigerate 8 hours.
Remove from refrigerator; let stand 30 minutes.
Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 30 minutes. Sprinkle with paprika.
Serve immediately.
Serves 6.
recipes.text: Healthy Breakfast Casserole. Place bread evenly in 8-inch square baking dish coated with cooking spray. Layer ham, red pepper and cheese over bread and set aside. Combine milk and next 4 ingredients. Pour over cheese. Cover and refrigerate 8 hours. Remove from refrigerator; let stand 30 minutes. Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 30 minutes. Sprinkle with paprika. Serve immediately. Serves 6.

recipes.title: Teriyaki Sauce
ingredients: 2 tsp. fresh ginger, minced (or 1/2 tsp. ground ginger)
2 c. regular-strength beef broth (or 2 1/4 c., if wine is omitted)
directions: In a pan, blend together the cornstarch, soy sauce, sugar, garlic and fresh or ground ginger. Stir in wine, if used, and the beef broth. Cook, stirring until thickened. Makes about 2 1/2 cups.
recipes.text: Teriyaki Sauce. In a pan, blend together the cornstarch, soy sauce, sugar, garlic and fresh or ground ginger. Stir in wine, if used, and the beef broth. Cook, stirring until thickened. Makes about 2 1/2 cups.

recipes.title: Baked Fish
directions: Place fish fillets in baking dish.
Pour tomato soup, undiluted over fillets.
Sprinkle with parsley and Parmesan cheese.
Bake for 30 minutes at 375°.
recipes.text: Baked Fish. Place fish fillets in baking dish. Pour tomato soup, undiluted over fillets. Sprinkle with parsley and Parmesan cheese. Bake for 30 minutes at 375°.

recipes.title: Cookies
directions: Bring the sugar, cocoa, margarine and milk to boil.
Add peanut butter, vanilla, salt and oatmeal.
Drop a tablespoon of mixture on wax paper and leave to harden (about 1 hour).
recipes.text: Cookies. Bring the sugar, cocoa, margarine and milk to boil. Add peanut butter, vanilla, salt and oatmeal. Drop a tablespoon of mixture on wax paper and leave to harden (about 1 hour).

recipes.title: Chicken Breast In Lemon Sauce
directions: Saute chicken in butter until done through center.
Remove chicken to broiler proof platter.
Pour wine into frying pan.
Add lemon peel and juice.
Cook 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add salt and pepper to chicken.
Turn down heat.
Add slowly, cream to wine lemon mixture; stir constantly.
Pour sauce over chicken.
In separate pan, fry mushrooms (fresh) in butter.
Add to chicken. Dot each breast with butter and sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Place under broiler for 5 to 10 minutes.
Serve with wild rice.
recipes.text: Chicken Breast In Lemon Sauce. Saute chicken in butter until done through center. Remove chicken to broiler proof platter. Pour wine into frying pan. Add lemon peel and juice. Cook 1 minute, stirring constantly. Add salt and pepper to chicken. Turn down heat. Add slowly, cream to wine lemon mixture; stir constantly. Pour sauce over chicken. In separate pan, fry mushrooms (fresh) in butter. Add to chicken. Dot each breast with butter and sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Place under broiler for 5 to 10 minutes. Serve with wild rice.

recipes.title: Nut Bread Delight
directions: Mix together all ingredients and bake 1 hour at 350° in loaf pan.
recipes.text: Nut Bread Delight. Mix together all ingredients and bake 1 hour at 350° in loaf pan.

recipes.title: Baked Beans
ingredients: 2 large cans Bush's baked beans (green label)
1 lb. ground beef, seasoned, browned and drained
directions: Brown ground beef and onions together, drain.
Fry bacon, reserve fat.
Mix all ingredients together, including bacon fat. (Taste, if too bland add small amounts of granulated sugar or barbecue sauce until just right.)
Place in crock-pot on low heat. Cook at least 3 hours.
Delicious!
recipes.text: Baked Beans. Brown ground beef and onions together, drain. Fry bacon, reserve fat. Mix all ingredients together, including bacon fat. (Taste, if too bland add small amounts of granulated sugar or barbecue sauce until just right.) Place in crock-pot on low heat. Cook at least 3 hours. Delicious!

recipes.title: Bessie'S White Fruit Cake
directions: Use 1/3 of the flour to coat fruit and nuts.
Cream butter and sugar.
Sift together flour and baking powder.
Add eggs, one at a time, with 3 tablespoons flour, to creamed mixture.
Add 1/2 cup pineapple juice and the rest of flour.
Add fruit and nuts; mix well.
Bake in prepared tube pan for 3 hours at 275°.
recipes.text: Bessie'S White Fruit Cake. Use 1/3 of the flour to coat fruit and nuts. Cream butter and sugar. Sift together flour and baking powder. Add eggs, one at a time, with 3 tablespoons flour, to creamed mixture. Add 1/2 cup pineapple juice and the rest of flour. Add fruit and nuts; mix well. Bake in prepared tube pan for 3 hours at 275°.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Squares
directions: In a small pan, mix the honey and the brown sugar.
Heat until boiling point and continue mixing.
Add the butter, peanut butter and vanilla and mix well.
recipes.text: Peanut Butter Squares. In a small pan, mix the honey and the brown sugar. Heat until boiling point and continue mixing. Add the butter, peanut butter and vanilla and mix well.

recipes.title: Mexi-Corn Casserole
ingredients: 1 (5 oz.) bag M&R Quigs yellow rice
directions: Fix rice as directed on package.
Combine rice, corn, butter and soup.
Mix all together and pour into casserole dish.
Top with shredded Cheddar cheese and bake at 350° for about 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Mexi-Corn Casserole. Fix rice as directed on package. Combine rice, corn, butter and soup. Mix all together and pour into casserole dish. Top with shredded Cheddar cheese and bake at 350° for about 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Chocolate Easter Nests
directions: Place chocolate in large casserole.
Microwave for 2 to 3 minutes until melted.
Stir in coconut and cornflakes.
Spoon onto waxed paper and form into nests.
Decorate each with 3 or 4 jelly beans.
recipes.text: Chocolate Easter Nests. Place chocolate in large casserole. Microwave for 2 to 3 minutes until melted. Stir in coconut and cornflakes. Spoon onto waxed paper and form into nests. Decorate each with 3 or 4 jelly beans.

recipes.title: Sweet And Sour Pork
ingredients: 1 1/2 lb. lean pork, cut into 2 x 1/2-inch strips
1 medium green pepper, cut in strips
directions: Brown
the
pork
in
hot
shortening.
Stir
in water, chicken
bouillon cube and salt.
Cover;
simmer about 1 hour. Drain the pineapple, reserving the syrup.
Combine brown sugar and cornstarch
in
saucepan.
Add
reserved pineapple syrup, vinegar, soy sauce and salt.
Cook and stir until bubbly.
Add sauce to pork;
mix well.
Stir in pineapple, green pepper and onion.
Cook 2 to 3 minutes.
Serve over hot rice.
Serves 6.
recipes.text: Sweet And Sour Pork. Brown the pork in hot shortening. Stir in water, chicken bouillon cube and salt. Cover; simmer about 1 hour. Drain the pineapple, reserving the syrup. Combine brown sugar and cornstarch in saucepan. Add reserved pineapple syrup, vinegar, soy sauce and salt. Cook and stir until bubbly. Add sauce to pork; mix well. Stir in pineapple, green pepper and onion. Cook 2 to 3 minutes. Serve over hot rice. Serves 6.

recipes.title: Baked Chicken Casserole
directions: Mix and put in casserole.
Top with 2 cups crushed potato chips and 1 cup grated cheese.
Bake 25 minutes in 350° oven.
recipes.text: Baked Chicken Casserole. Mix and put in casserole. Top with 2 cups crushed potato chips and 1 cup grated cheese. Bake 25 minutes in 350° oven.

recipes.title: Caramel Nut Pie
directions: Preheat oven to 400°. Line pie crust with chopped pecans. Combine all other ingredients and pour over nuts. Bake at 400° for 10 minutes. Reduce heat to 300° and continue baking for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Caramel Nut Pie. Preheat oven to 400°. Line pie crust with chopped pecans. Combine all other ingredients and pour over nuts. Bake at 400° for 10 minutes. Reduce heat to 300° and continue baking for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Broccoli Balls
ingredients: 2 (10 oz.) boxes frozen chopped broccoli, cooked and drained
directions: Mix ingredients well and chill for 2 hours.
Put a little oil on hands and form balls, using 1 teaspoon mixture for each.
Bake on lightly greased baking sheet at 350° for 20 to 30 minutes. Freezes well in plastic bags.
Bake frozen at 350° for 35 minutes. May be served with hot mustard sauce.
Yields approximately 65 balls.
recipes.text: Broccoli Balls. Mix ingredients well and chill for 2 hours. Put a little oil on hands and form balls, using 1 teaspoon mixture for each. Bake on lightly greased baking sheet at 350° for 20 to 30 minutes. Freezes well in plastic bags. Bake frozen at 350° for 35 minutes. May be served with hot mustard sauce. Yields approximately 65 balls.

recipes.title: Biscuits
directions: Combine first three ingredients in a large bowl.
Cut in shortening with a pastry cutter until shortening is the size of peas.
Add buttermilk, stirring until moistened.
Dough will resemble cottage cheese, but sticky.
Turn dough out onto a floured surface and knead 4 or 5 times.
recipes.text: Biscuits. Combine first three ingredients in a large bowl. Cut in shortening with a pastry cutter until shortening is the size of peas. Add buttermilk, stirring until moistened. Dough will resemble cottage cheese, but sticky. Turn dough out onto a floured surface and knead 4 or 5 times.

recipes.title: Creamy Banana Pudding
directions: Dip sliced bananas in lemon juice; set aside.
Combine Eagle Brand milk, water and pudding; beat well.
Chill 5 minutes.
Fold in whipped cream.
Layer mixture with wafers and bananas.
Chill.
recipes.text: Creamy Banana Pudding. Dip sliced bananas in lemon juice; set aside. Combine Eagle Brand milk, water and pudding; beat well. Chill 5 minutes. Fold in whipped cream. Layer mixture with wafers and bananas. Chill.

recipes.title: Graham Zucchini Muffins
ingredients: 1 Tbsp. grated orange rind or dash of orange extract
directions: Beat eggs until frothy; fold in sugar, oil and vanilla.
Stir in grated zucchini and orange rind; mix well.
Sift dry ingredients together and add to creamed mixture in thirds, blending only until well mixed.
Overbeating makes muffins tough. Spoon into papered muffin tins or small loaf pans.
Bake at 350° for about 20 minutes for muffins and 40 minutes for loaf.
recipes.text: Graham Zucchini Muffins. Beat eggs until frothy; fold in sugar, oil and vanilla. Stir in grated zucchini and orange rind; mix well. Sift dry ingredients together and add to creamed mixture in thirds, blending only until well mixed. Overbeating makes muffins tough. Spoon into papered muffin tins or small loaf pans. Bake at 350° for about 20 minutes for muffins and 40 minutes for loaf.

recipes.title: Fig Pickles
directions: 1st Day:
Bring sugar and vinegar to boil.
Drop in figs and cook 20 minutes.
Pour into bowl and let set overnight.
recipes.text: Fig Pickles. 1st Day: Bring sugar and vinegar to boil. Drop in figs and cook 20 minutes. Pour into bowl and let set overnight.

recipes.title: Cherry Cake
directions: Cream butter and sugar together.
Add beaten eggs.
Add baking soda to sour milk, then stir flour, spices and milk alternately into creamed mixture.
Simmer cherries on stove and sweeten to taste.
Cool cherries; drain.
Add cherries, vanilla and nuts to creamed mixture.
Bake at 350° for 35 minutes or until done.
recipes.text: Cherry Cake. Cream butter and sugar together. Add beaten eggs. Add baking soda to sour milk, then stir flour, spices and milk alternately into creamed mixture. Simmer cherries on stove and sweeten to taste. Cool cherries; drain. Add cherries, vanilla and nuts to creamed mixture. Bake at 350° for 35 minutes or until done.

recipes.title: Hearty Chicken Stew
ingredients: 1 Tbsp. minced fresh ginger or 1 tsp. ground ginger
8 pieces chicken (about 2 1/2 lb.), skinned and fat removed
8 oz. red or white new potatoes, scrubbed and unpeeled
directions: In a deep skillet or Dutch oven, heat oil over medium-high heat.
Saute onion, ginger and garlic until onion is soft, about 3 minutes.
Add flour and cook 1 minute, stirring quickly to prevent sticking.
Stir in tomatoes and allow to cook another 2 minutes.
recipes.text: Hearty Chicken Stew. In a deep skillet or Dutch oven, heat oil over medium-high heat. Saute onion, ginger and garlic until onion is soft, about 3 minutes. Add flour and cook 1 minute, stirring quickly to prevent sticking. Stir in tomatoes and allow to cook another 2 minutes.

recipes.title: Radford'S Brown Sugar Pound Cake
directions: Cream butter, shortening and sugars.
Add eggs and beat well. Sift dry ingredients.
Add alternately to creamed mixture with milk.
Beat well at medium speed.
Add vanilla and nuts; stir well with spoon.
Use 1 standard-sized tube pan or 3 foil loaf pans (7 7/8 x 3 7/8 x 2 1/2-inch).
Ice with favorite brown sugar icing. Bake tube cake at 325° for 1 1/2 hours; loaf cakes at 325° for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Radford'S Brown Sugar Pound Cake. Cream butter, shortening and sugars. Add eggs and beat well. Sift dry ingredients. Add alternately to creamed mixture with milk. Beat well at medium speed. Add vanilla and nuts; stir well with spoon. Use 1 standard-sized tube pan or 3 foil loaf pans (7 7/8 x 3 7/8 x 2 1/2-inch). Ice with favorite brown sugar icing. Bake tube cake at 325° for 1 1/2 hours; loaf cakes at 325° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Slushy Punch
directions: Dissolve jello in 2 cups hot water.
Add 2 cups cold water. Add juice and sugar and stir.
Freeze until slushy.
Put in punch bowl:
1/2 punch and 1/2 ginger ale or Sprite.
recipes.text: Slushy Punch. Dissolve jello in 2 cups hot water. Add 2 cups cold water. Add juice and sugar and stir. Freeze until slushy. Put in punch bowl: 1/2 punch and 1/2 ginger ale or Sprite.

recipes.title: Apple Sausages With Cornmeal Mush
ingredients: 3 tart red apples, cored and cut into 1/2-inch rings
directions: In large saucepan, heat 1 cup water, the candies and food color until candies melt.
Place apple rings in syrup; simmer until tender, about 20 minutes.
Place links in skillet.
Add 3 tablespoons water.
Cover; simmer for 8 minutes.
Remove cover; cook until well done, turning sausage to brown evenly.
Serve hot sausage links and apple rings with Cornmeal Mush.
Makes 5 servings.
recipes.text: Apple Sausages With Cornmeal Mush. In large saucepan, heat 1 cup water, the candies and food color until candies melt. Place apple rings in syrup; simmer until tender, about 20 minutes. Place links in skillet. Add 3 tablespoons water. Cover; simmer for 8 minutes. Remove cover; cook until well done, turning sausage to brown evenly. Serve hot sausage links and apple rings with Cornmeal Mush. Makes 5 servings.

recipes.title: Chicken Casserole
directions: Cook chicken breasts and pull into small pieces.
Reserve broth from cooked chicken breasts.
Place chicken breasts in bottom of Pyrex dish (9 x 12-inch).
Mix together cream of chicken and cream of mushroom soup and milk.
Mix until smooth.
Pour this over chicken breasts.
Mix 1 1/4 chicken broth and 3/4 stick melted butter.
Pour over one package of herbs and stuffing and place on top of chicken.
Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Chicken Casserole. Cook chicken breasts and pull into small pieces. Reserve broth from cooked chicken breasts. Place chicken breasts in bottom of Pyrex dish (9 x 12-inch). Mix together cream of chicken and cream of mushroom soup and milk. Mix until smooth. Pour this over chicken breasts. Mix 1 1/4 chicken broth and 3/4 stick melted butter. Pour over one package of herbs and stuffing and place on top of chicken. Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Scones(Diabetic)
ingredients: 1 Tbsp. plus 2 tsp. reduced calorie margarine, melted
directions: Preheat oven to 375°.
Spray a nonstick baking sheet with nonstick cooking spray.
On wax paper, combine flour, baking powder, sugar, cinnamon, salt and cloves.
In large bowl, combine pumpkin and melted margarine.
Stir flour mixture into pumpkin mixture to combine.
Spray a work surface with nonstick cooking spray; roll pumpkin dough to 1/2-inch thick.
With fluted 2-inch cookie cutter, cut out 10 scones, re-rolling if necessary.
Place scones 1 1/2 inches apart on prepared baking sheet.
Bake 12 to 15 minutes, or until lightly browned.
One scone = 60 cal., 1 gr. fat and 0 choles.
Makes 10 servings.
recipes.text: Pumpkin Scones(Diabetic). Preheat oven to 375°. Spray a nonstick baking sheet with nonstick cooking spray. On wax paper, combine flour, baking powder, sugar, cinnamon, salt and cloves. In large bowl, combine pumpkin and melted margarine. Stir flour mixture into pumpkin mixture to combine. Spray a work surface with nonstick cooking spray; roll pumpkin dough to 1/2-inch thick. With fluted 2-inch cookie cutter, cut out 10 scones, re-rolling if necessary. Place scones 1 1/2 inches apart on prepared baking sheet. Bake 12 to 15 minutes, or until lightly browned. One scone = 60 cal., 1 gr. fat and 0 choles. Makes 10 servings.

recipes.title: Broccoli Rice Casserole
ingredients: 1 small box or bag frozen broccoli pieces, thawed and drained
directions: Melt butter.
Add all other ingredients except Cheez Whiz. Bake 25 minutes at 325°.
Add Cheez Whiz and bake 10 to 15 minutes longer.
recipes.text: Broccoli Rice Casserole. Melt butter. Add all other ingredients except Cheez Whiz. Bake 25 minutes at 325°. Add Cheez Whiz and bake 10 to 15 minutes longer.

recipes.title: Peanut Brittle
directions: Bring to a boil the sugar, syrup and water; boil until it threads.
Add peanuts; boil until brown.
Remove from heat.
Add soda and vanilla, stirring to mix well.
Pour onto greased cookie sheet.
Let cool, then break into pieces.
recipes.text: Peanut Brittle. Bring to a boil the sugar, syrup and water; boil until it threads. Add peanuts; boil until brown. Remove from heat. Add soda and vanilla, stirring to mix well. Pour onto greased cookie sheet. Let cool, then break into pieces.

recipes.title: Amigo
directions: Cook ground beef, onion, salt, pepper and garlic powder until red disappears from meat. Add tomato sauce and simmer until ready to serve. Add grated cheese and stir slightly. Serve over Fritos with tossed salad and buttered French bread.
recipes.text: Amigo. Cook ground beef, onion, salt, pepper and garlic powder until red disappears from meat. Add tomato sauce and simmer until ready to serve. Add grated cheese and stir slightly. Serve over Fritos with tossed salad and buttered French bread.

recipes.title: Christmas Punch
ingredients: 2 (6 oz.) cans frozen orange juice concentrate
directions: Dissolve gelatin and sugar in boiling water.
Stir.
Add juice and cold water.
Add almond extract.
Chill thoroughly.
To serve, pour into punch bowl.
Stir in sherbet and finish with ginger ale poured slowly.
Will make 5 quarts or 40 (1/2 cup) servings.
recipes.text: Christmas Punch. Dissolve gelatin and sugar in boiling water. Stir. Add juice and cold water. Add almond extract. Chill thoroughly. To serve, pour into punch bowl. Stir in sherbet and finish with ginger ale poured slowly. Will make 5 quarts or 40 (1/2 cup) servings.

recipes.title: Chocolate Lover'S Ice Cream Pie
ingredients: 4 c. chocolate ice cream, slightly softened
directions: In medium bowl stir together crushed cookies and butter.
Press on bottom and sides of 9-inch pie pan.
Freeze until firm (10 minutes).
Spread ice cream over crust.
Cover and freeze until firm (6 hours or longer).
Just before serving, drizzle pie with chocolate syrup.
recipes.text: Chocolate Lover'S Ice Cream Pie. In medium bowl stir together crushed cookies and butter. Press on bottom and sides of 9-inch pie pan. Freeze until firm (10 minutes). Spread ice cream over crust. Cover and freeze until firm (6 hours or longer). Just before serving, drizzle pie with chocolate syrup.

recipes.title: Danish Pastry Apple Bars
ingredients: 1 c. crushed Rice Krispies, cornflakes or Wheaties
directions: Combine flour and salt; cut in margarine and butter.
Beat egg yolk in measuring cup; add enough milk to make 2/3 cup liquid. Mix well.
Stir into flour.
Roll half of dough into jelly roll pan.
Sprinkle cold cereal on dough.
Top with apples; sprinkle with sugar and cinnamon.
Roll out remaining dough to fit top. Seal edges.
Beat egg whites until frothy; brush over top of dough.
Bake until golden brown.
Glaze warm bars with powdered sugar, milk and vanilla mixture.
recipes.text: Danish Pastry Apple Bars. Combine flour and salt; cut in margarine and butter. Beat egg yolk in measuring cup; add enough milk to make 2/3 cup liquid. Mix well. Stir into flour. Roll half of dough into jelly roll pan. Sprinkle cold cereal on dough. Top with apples; sprinkle with sugar and cinnamon. Roll out remaining dough to fit top. Seal edges. Beat egg whites until frothy; brush over top of dough. Bake until golden brown. Glaze warm bars with powdered sugar, milk and vanilla mixture.

recipes.title: Zucchini Casserole
directions: Grease pan.
Mix all ingredients together.
Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes.
recipes.text: Zucchini Casserole. Grease pan. Mix all ingredients together. Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Bread Pudding
ingredients: 1 (1 lb.) stale loaf French bread, discard 4 inches
directions: Place bread, torn into pieces, into 9 x 13-inch pan.
Mix together eggs, milk, sugar, margarine, raisins and pecans.
Pour over bread slices.
Bake at 375° until edges puff and turn brown.
recipes.text: Bread Pudding. Place bread, torn into pieces, into 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix together eggs, milk, sugar, margarine, raisins and pecans. Pour over bread slices. Bake at 375° until edges puff and turn brown.

recipes.title: Cheese Pastry
directions: Sift flour and salt.
Add cheese.
Cut in Crisco.
Add water. See recipe for Chicken Cheese Turnovers.
recipes.text: Cheese Pastry. Sift flour and salt. Add cheese. Cut in Crisco. Add water. See recipe for Chicken Cheese Turnovers.

recipes.title: Railroad Cornbread Pie
directions: Brown beef and onion; drain and return to pan.
Add soup, water, corn, pepper and seasoning; mix well. Simmer for 15 minutes.
Put in baking dish.
In another bowl, combine cornmeal, sugar, flour, salt, baking powder, egg, milk and oil; mix well and pour onto mixture.
Preheat oven to 350° and bake for 20 minutes.
recipes.text: Railroad Cornbread Pie. Brown beef and onion; drain and return to pan. Add soup, water, corn, pepper and seasoning; mix well. Simmer for 15 minutes. Put in baking dish. In another bowl, combine cornmeal, sugar, flour, salt, baking powder, egg, milk and oil; mix well and pour onto mixture. Preheat oven to 350° and bake for 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Taffy Apple Salad
ingredients: 2 c. unpeeled Red Delicious apples, chopped
directions: Drain pineapple; save juice.
Cook sugar, juice, flour, egg and vinegar until thickened.
Cool thoroughly.
Combine pineapple, marshmallows, peanuts and apples.
Combine Cool Whip with cooked mixture and coat apple mixture.
Chill.
recipes.text: Taffy Apple Salad. Drain pineapple; save juice. Cook sugar, juice, flour, egg and vinegar until thickened. Cool thoroughly. Combine pineapple, marshmallows, peanuts and apples. Combine Cool Whip with cooked mixture and coat apple mixture. Chill.

recipes.title: Speedy Spam Dip
directions: Blend Spam, onion and peppers in food processor until smooth. Stir in mayonnaise.
Cover and chill for 1 hour.
Serve with chips or crackers.
recipes.text: Speedy Spam Dip. Blend Spam, onion and peppers in food processor until smooth. Stir in mayonnaise. Cover and chill for 1 hour. Serve with chips or crackers.

recipes.title: Fresh Apple Cake
ingredients: 2 cups sugar- Mix it with apples
directions: Mix the above and bake in greased and floured 9 x 13 pan at 350 degrees for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Fresh Apple Cake. Mix the above and bake in greased and floured 9 x 13 pan at 350 degrees for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Pork Chops And Rice
directions: Combine soups, rice and mushrooms.
Season pork as usual. Pour mixture into casserole dish.
Lay pork chops on top.
Cover and bake at 375° for 1 hour.
Serve.
recipes.text: Pork Chops And Rice. Combine soups, rice and mushrooms. Season pork as usual. Pour mixture into casserole dish. Lay pork chops on top. Cover and bake at 375° for 1 hour. Serve.

recipes.title: Chicken Casserole
directions: Mix together chicken, soup and 1 cup broth in 2-quart casserole.
Top with dressing mixed with beaten egg and 1 cup broth.
Bake covered 45 minutes at 350°.
recipes.text: Chicken Casserole. Mix together chicken, soup and 1 cup broth in 2-quart casserole. Top with dressing mixed with beaten egg and 1 cup broth. Bake covered 45 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Frozen Fruit Dessert
directions: Mix ingredients and freeze until ready to eat.
recipes.text: Frozen Fruit Dessert. Mix ingredients and freeze until ready to eat.

recipes.title: Cranberry-Apple Relish
directions: Wash all fruit.
Pare and core apples.
Cut oranges and lemon. Put all through coarse blade food chopper.
Add sugar and honey. Refrigerate until cold.
Good with turkey and chicken.
recipes.text: Cranberry-Apple Relish. Wash all fruit. Pare and core apples. Cut oranges and lemon. Put all through coarse blade food chopper. Add sugar and honey. Refrigerate until cold. Good with turkey and chicken.

recipes.title: Old-Time Ginger Bars
directions: Sift dry ingredients; beat eggs until light.
Add sugar gradually, beating until fluffy.
Add molasses and sour cream and beat well.
Gradually add dry ingredients.
Fold in dates and nuts.
Spread evenly in a 15 x 10-inch pan, greased.
Bake at 350° for about 25 minutes.
Cool on rack.
recipes.text: Old-Time Ginger Bars. Sift dry ingredients; beat eggs until light. Add sugar gradually, beating until fluffy. Add molasses and sour cream and beat well. Gradually add dry ingredients. Fold in dates and nuts. Spread evenly in a 15 x 10-inch pan, greased. Bake at 350° for about 25 minutes. Cool on rack.

recipes.title: Spinach And Bacon Salad
ingredients: 2 heads red leaf or 1 head iceberg lettuce
1 Tbsp. onion juice or finely grated
directions: Wash and drain greens.
Break off stems and tear apart. Combine lettuce and spinach.
Drain, cool and crumble bacon.
Add to greens.
recipes.text: Spinach And Bacon Salad. Wash and drain greens. Break off stems and tear apart. Combine lettuce and spinach. Drain, cool and crumble bacon. Add to greens.

recipes.title: Chicken Noodle Dumplings
directions: Boil chicken.
Debone.
Add 2 cans cream of chicken soup to broth.
Add noodle dumplings.
Cook until tender.
Add salt and pepper to taste.
recipes.text: Chicken Noodle Dumplings. Boil chicken. Debone. Add 2 cans cream of chicken soup to broth. Add noodle dumplings. Cook until tender. Add salt and pepper to taste.

recipes.title: Hamburger Spaghetti Dinner
directions: Brown hamburger and onions in skillet.
Add tomato soup and mix well.
Cook spaghetti and drain and mix with tomato mixture. Put in baking dish and put cheese on top.
Bake until cheese melts at 350°.
recipes.text: Hamburger Spaghetti Dinner. Brown hamburger and onions in skillet. Add tomato soup and mix well. Cook spaghetti and drain and mix with tomato mixture. Put in baking dish and put cheese on top. Bake until cheese melts at 350°.

recipes.title: Texas Gold Bars
directions: Preheat oven to 325°.
Combine cake mix, first egg and melted margarine.
Press firmly into ungreased 9 x 13-inch pan.
recipes.text: Texas Gold Bars. Preheat oven to 325°. Combine cake mix, first egg and melted margarine. Press firmly into ungreased 9 x 13-inch pan.

recipes.title: Woo Woo
directions: Add ice cubes.
Shake and pour into glasses.
recipes.text: Woo Woo. Add ice cubes. Shake and pour into glasses.

recipes.title: Sugar-Free Strawberry Pie
directions: Cook together water and starch until bubbly.
Remove from heat and add Equal and Jell-O.
Stir well.
Let cool until warm to touch, then add strawberries.
Pour into pie crust.
Refrigerate 1 hour before serving.
recipes.text: Sugar-Free Strawberry Pie. Cook together water and starch until bubbly. Remove from heat and add Equal and Jell-O. Stir well. Let cool until warm to touch, then add strawberries. Pour into pie crust. Refrigerate 1 hour before serving.

recipes.title: Cream Tuna On Toast
ingredients: 1 can (6 1/2 oz.) tuna, rinsed and drained
directions: Blend soup and milk in saucepan until smooth.
Add tuna and heat thoroughly.
While heating prepare 8 slices toast.
Spoon mixture on toast and enjoy!
recipes.text: Cream Tuna On Toast. Blend soup and milk in saucepan until smooth. Add tuna and heat thoroughly. While heating prepare 8 slices toast. Spoon mixture on toast and enjoy!

recipes.title: Sweet-Sour Chicken
ingredients: boneless whole chicken breast to serve 4 to 6 people
1 medium to small jar apricot preserves
directions: Place chicken in casserole.
Spoon apricot preserves evenly over chicken. Sprinkle onion soup mix evenly over chicken.
Pour Russian dressing evenly over chicken.
Cover tightly and bake at 350° for 45 to 60 minutes.
Remove cover and stir sauce gently last 10 to 15 minutes.
Serve with rice.
recipes.text: Sweet-Sour Chicken. Place chicken in casserole. Spoon apricot preserves evenly over chicken. Sprinkle onion soup mix evenly over chicken. Pour Russian dressing evenly over chicken. Cover tightly and bake at 350° for 45 to 60 minutes. Remove cover and stir sauce gently last 10 to 15 minutes. Serve with rice.

recipes.title: Chocolate Pecan Pie Bars
ingredients: 6 (6 oz.) sq. Baker's semi-sweet chocolate or 1 1/2 (6 oz.) pkg. Baker's German sweet chocolate
directions: Crust:
Grease bottom and sides of a 15 x 10 x 1-inch baking pan.
In a large bowl with mixer at medium speed, beat flour, 1/2 cup sugar, butter and salt until mixture resembles coarse crumbs. Press firmly and evenly into pan.
Bake 20 minutes in a 350° oven.
recipes.text: Chocolate Pecan Pie Bars. Crust: Grease bottom and sides of a 15 x 10 x 1-inch baking pan. In a large bowl with mixer at medium speed, beat flour, 1/2 cup sugar, butter and salt until mixture resembles coarse crumbs. Press firmly and evenly into pan. Bake 20 minutes in a 350° oven.

recipes.title: Snickerdoodles
directions: Mix first three ingredients.
Add next three ingredients. Chill dough at least one hour.
Roll dough into balls the size of walnuts.
Roll in a mixture of 2 teaspoons cinnamon and two tablespoons sugar.
Bake on an ungreased cookie sheet for 8 to 10 minutes at 350°.
recipes.text: Snickerdoodles. Mix first three ingredients. Add next three ingredients. Chill dough at least one hour. Roll dough into balls the size of walnuts. Roll in a mixture of 2 teaspoons cinnamon and two tablespoons sugar. Bake on an ungreased cookie sheet for 8 to 10 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Fresh Cranberry Salad
directions: Grind cranberries in blender.
Mix all other ingredients together, then add cranberries.
Let stand overnight in refrigerator.
recipes.text: Fresh Cranberry Salad. Grind cranberries in blender. Mix all other ingredients together, then add cranberries. Let stand overnight in refrigerator.

recipes.title: Preacher'S Casserole(Serves 6 To 8)
directions: Brown ground beef and drain.
Cook onion, celery and green peppers in a small amount of olive oil until transparent.
Mix all ingredients together, saving 1/4 of noodles to sprinkle on top. Place in buttered casserole dish.
Bake at 350° for approximately 45 minutes, uncovered.
Serves 6 to 8.
recipes.text: Preacher'S Casserole(Serves 6 To 8). Brown ground beef and drain. Cook onion, celery and green peppers in a small amount of olive oil until transparent. Mix all ingredients together, saving 1/4 of noodles to sprinkle on top. Place in buttered casserole dish. Bake at 350° for approximately 45 minutes, uncovered. Serves 6 to 8.

recipes.title: Scalloped Corn And Green Peppers
directions: Combine white sauce and egg; beat thoroughly. Add corn, sugar and green pepper. Pour into well oiled baking dish.
Cover with crumbs. Bake in hot oven (425°) until well browned. Makes 6 servings.
recipes.text: Scalloped Corn And Green Peppers. Combine white sauce and egg; beat thoroughly. Add corn, sugar and green pepper. Pour into well oiled baking dish. Cover with crumbs. Bake in hot oven (425°) until well browned. Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Mexican Salad
directions: Mix these ingredients together and pour dressing on just before you serve.
recipes.text: Mexican Salad. Mix these ingredients together and pour dressing on just before you serve.

recipes.title: E Z Punch
directions: Mix well and add ice.
recipes.text: E Z Punch. Mix well and add ice.

recipes.title: Scallops Parisienne
directions: If using sea scallops, cut into 2 or 3 pieces.
In saucepan, combine scallops with wine, water, herbs and peppercorns.
Simmer 2 to 3 minutes.
Strain, reserving liquid (about 1 1/2 cups).
recipes.text: Scallops Parisienne. If using sea scallops, cut into 2 or 3 pieces. In saucepan, combine scallops with wine, water, herbs and peppercorns. Simmer 2 to 3 minutes. Strain, reserving liquid (about 1 1/2 cups).

recipes.title: Kansas City Dressing
directions: Beat well and strain.
Pour into 2 pint jars.
Add garlic cloves in each jar. Watch that garlic doesn't fall into salad.
recipes.text: Kansas City Dressing. Beat well and strain. Pour into 2 pint jars. Add garlic cloves in each jar. Watch that garlic doesn't fall into salad.

recipes.title: Tempura Batter
directions: Sift dry ingredients in bowl.
Gradually stir in water.
Add fresh vegetables, shrimp, etc.
The batter will be thin. Deep fry until golden brown.
recipes.text: Tempura Batter. Sift dry ingredients in bowl. Gradually stir in water. Add fresh vegetables, shrimp, etc. The batter will be thin. Deep fry until golden brown.

recipes.title: Rhubarb Cake
ingredients: 1 1/2 c. raw rhubarb, cut in 1/2-inch pieces
directions: Mix altogether.
Put in unbaked pie crust.
Sprinkle on top 1/2 cup sugar and 1 teaspoon cinnamon.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Rhubarb Cake. Mix altogether. Put in unbaked pie crust. Sprinkle on top 1/2 cup sugar and 1 teaspoon cinnamon. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Black-Eyed Pea Salad
directions: Cook peas according to directions; drain and refrigerate.
In medium bowl, combine peas, tomatoes, green pepper and onion; mix well.
Combine vinegar and sugar; pour over pea mixture and toss. Chill at least 30 minutes before serving.
Makes 4 to 6 servings.
recipes.text: Black-Eyed Pea Salad. Cook peas according to directions; drain and refrigerate. In medium bowl, combine peas, tomatoes, green pepper and onion; mix well. Combine vinegar and sugar; pour over pea mixture and toss. Chill at least 30 minutes before serving. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

recipes.title: Quick And Easy Baked Beans
ingredients: 1 (16 to 18 oz.) can pork and beans
directions: Combine ingredients.
Bake, covered, in greased casserole at 350° for 20 minutes.
Uncover and continue baking 20 minutes. Serves 4.
recipes.text: Quick And Easy Baked Beans. Combine ingredients. Bake, covered, in greased casserole at 350° for 20 minutes. Uncover and continue baking 20 minutes. Serves 4.

recipes.title: Breakfast Boosters(Great Use For Those Ripe Bananas.)
ingredients: 1 (20 oz.) can crushed pineapple with juice
1 (8 oz.) carton of your favorite yogurt (any flavor)
3 extra ripe bananas, peeled and frozen*
directions: Mix all ingredients in blender until smooth.
recipes.text: Breakfast Boosters(Great Use For Those Ripe Bananas.). Mix all ingredients in blender until smooth.

recipes.title: Sugar Cookies
directions: Cream sugar, margarine, oil, eggs and vanilla.
Add sifted dry ingredients.
Roll in balls the size of walnuts; dip in sugar. Place on cookie sheet.
Press down with glass dipped in sugar. Bake 10 minutes at 375°.
recipes.text: Sugar Cookies. Cream sugar, margarine, oil, eggs and vanilla. Add sifted dry ingredients. Roll in balls the size of walnuts; dip in sugar. Place on cookie sheet. Press down with glass dipped in sugar. Bake 10 minutes at 375°.

recipes.title: Potato Casserole
ingredients: 1 (2 lb.) bag Southern style hash browns
directions: Mix and put in casserole dish.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Potato Casserole. Mix and put in casserole dish. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Asparagus Casserole
directions: Use square casserole dish.
Put layer of asparagus, then layer of mushroom soup. Sprinkle over this the pecans, chopped.
Add another layer of each and asparagus juice.
Top with cornflakes. Sprinkle on grated cheese. Bake in moderate oven at 350° for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Asparagus Casserole. Use square casserole dish. Put layer of asparagus, then layer of mushroom soup. Sprinkle over this the pecans, chopped. Add another layer of each and asparagus juice. Top with cornflakes. Sprinkle on grated cheese. Bake in moderate oven at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Microwave Rice Pudding
directions: In saucepan, combine milk, rice, sugar and salt.
Bring to a boil.
Cook until rice is tender, about 25 minutes.
Add the eggs and cook an additional 3 minutes.
Add cream and vanilla.
recipes.text: Microwave Rice Pudding. In saucepan, combine milk, rice, sugar and salt. Bring to a boil. Cook until rice is tender, about 25 minutes. Add the eggs and cook an additional 3 minutes. Add cream and vanilla.

recipes.title: Gumdrop Cookies
directions: Cream sugars and shortening.
Add egg, flour and all other ingredients; blend.
Bake at 350° for 15 minutes.
recipes.text: Gumdrop Cookies. Cream sugars and shortening. Add egg, flour and all other ingredients; blend. Bake at 350° for 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Layered Salad
directions: In large bowl, layer ingredients as listed.
Cover and let stand in refrigerator overnight.
Toss and serve.
recipes.text: Layered Salad. In large bowl, layer ingredients as listed. Cover and let stand in refrigerator overnight. Toss and serve.

recipes.title: Broccoli Quiche(4 Servings)
directions: Use part of margarine to grease 10-inch quiche pan.
Blend eggs, milk, margarine, flour, salt and pepper in blender.
Cook broccoli and drain.
recipes.text: Broccoli Quiche(4 Servings). Use part of margarine to grease 10-inch quiche pan. Blend eggs, milk, margarine, flour, salt and pepper in blender. Cook broccoli and drain.

recipes.title: Fat-Free Carrot Pineapple Muffins
directions: Combine flour, sugar, baking soda and cinnamon.
Stir and mix well.
Add pineapple with juice, prune puree, egg whites and vanilla.
Stir until moistened.
Fold in carrots and pecans. Coat muffin pans with nonstick spray.
Bake at 350° for 15 to 17 minutes.
recipes.text: Fat-Free Carrot Pineapple Muffins. Combine flour, sugar, baking soda and cinnamon. Stir and mix well. Add pineapple with juice, prune puree, egg whites and vanilla. Stir until moistened. Fold in carrots and pecans. Coat muffin pans with nonstick spray. Bake at 350° for 15 to 17 minutes.

recipes.title: Swedish Pancakes
ingredients: 1 c. Wondra flour or regular flour
directions: Use blender if available.
Beat eggs for 1 minute.
Add milk and beat for 1 minute.
Add remaining ingredients and mix for 2 minutes.
Have frying pan coated lightly with butter and pour about 1/4 cup batter into hot pan.
Tilt pan all around so the batter covers the bottom.
These are very thin pancakes; they will appear like a crepe.
recipes.text: Swedish Pancakes. Use blender if available. Beat eggs for 1 minute. Add milk and beat for 1 minute. Add remaining ingredients and mix for 2 minutes. Have frying pan coated lightly with butter and pour about 1/4 cup batter into hot pan. Tilt pan all around so the batter covers the bottom. These are very thin pancakes; they will appear like a crepe.

recipes.title: Pork Chops And Rice
directions: Brown pork chops in a Dutch oven or casserole.
Add to the pork chops the Kitchen Bouquet and water.
Top chops with rice, then onions, then tomatoes.
Sprinkle parsley on top.
Cover and bake at 350° for 1 hour.
Salt may be added after rice, if desired.
recipes.text: Pork Chops And Rice. Brown pork chops in a Dutch oven or casserole. Add to the pork chops the Kitchen Bouquet and water. Top chops with rice, then onions, then tomatoes. Sprinkle parsley on top. Cover and bake at 350° for 1 hour. Salt may be added after rice, if desired.

recipes.title: Sweet Chicken
directions: Mix and coat chicken.
Bake uncovered 1 1/2 hours at 350°.
recipes.text: Sweet Chicken. Mix and coat chicken. Bake uncovered 1 1/2 hours at 350°.

recipes.title: Ritz Cracker Pie
directions: Beat eggs and baking powder together until stiff.
Add sugar a little at a time.
Add vanilla.
Fold in crushed Ritz crackers and pecans.
Pour into greased pie plate.
Bake 20 to 30 minutes in 350° oven.
Cool about 2 hours before serving.
Spread Cool Whip over pie.
Refrigerate until time to serve.
recipes.text: Ritz Cracker Pie. Beat eggs and baking powder together until stiff. Add sugar a little at a time. Add vanilla. Fold in crushed Ritz crackers and pecans. Pour into greased pie plate. Bake 20 to 30 minutes in 350° oven. Cool about 2 hours before serving. Spread Cool Whip over pie. Refrigerate until time to serve.

recipes.title: Corn Bread
directions: Combine cornmeal, flour, baking powder, sugar and salt, mixing well.
Dissolve soda in buttermilk.
Add cornmeal mix, stirring well.
Add remaining ingredients, mixing well.
Spoon batter into a well-greased 8 1/2 x 4 1/2 x 3-inch loaf pan.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour or until golden brown.
recipes.text: Corn Bread. Combine cornmeal, flour, baking powder, sugar and salt, mixing well. Dissolve soda in buttermilk. Add cornmeal mix, stirring well. Add remaining ingredients, mixing well. Spoon batter into a well-greased 8 1/2 x 4 1/2 x 3-inch loaf pan. Bake at 350° for 1 hour or until golden brown.

recipes.title: Beef Stroganoff
ingredients: 1 lb. boneless round steak (3/4 inch thick)
directions: Slice beef across the grain into very thin slices.
In skillet, over medium heat, in hot margarine, cook beef and onion until beef is no longer pink and onion is tender, stirring often. Set aside.
In same skillet, combine soup, sour cream and paprika. Return beef and onion to skillet.
Heat thoroughly, stirring occasionally.
Serve over noodles.
Yields 6 servings.
recipes.text: Beef Stroganoff. Slice beef across the grain into very thin slices. In skillet, over medium heat, in hot margarine, cook beef and onion until beef is no longer pink and onion is tender, stirring often. Set aside. In same skillet, combine soup, sour cream and paprika. Return beef and onion to skillet. Heat thoroughly, stirring occasionally. Serve over noodles. Yields 6 servings.

recipes.title: Irish Potato Soup
directions: Boil the water in a saucepan.
Add potatoes, carrot, onions, thyme, bay leaf and clove.
Cover over low heat for 45 minutes. Force the mixture through a sieve.
Add milk, cream, salt and pepper.
Cook over low heat for 10 minutes.
Correct seasoning. Serve hot.
recipes.text: Irish Potato Soup. Boil the water in a saucepan. Add potatoes, carrot, onions, thyme, bay leaf and clove. Cover over low heat for 45 minutes. Force the mixture through a sieve. Add milk, cream, salt and pepper. Cook over low heat for 10 minutes. Correct seasoning. Serve hot.

recipes.title: Bread Pudding
directions: Grease large casserole with butter.
Soak bread in milk; mix well with hands.
Beat eggs with sugar, flavorings, raisins and cinnamon (nuts if desired).
Mix well with bread.
Cook, uncovered, in oven at 350° for 1 hour and 15 minutes.
recipes.text: Bread Pudding. Grease large casserole with butter. Soak bread in milk; mix well with hands. Beat eggs with sugar, flavorings, raisins and cinnamon (nuts if desired). Mix well with bread. Cook, uncovered, in oven at 350° for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Sweet Potato Casserole
ingredients: 1 1/2 c. sweet potatoes, cooked and mashed
directions: Add all ingredients to the cooked and mashed potatoes.
Pour into 2 1/2-quart casserole.
recipes.text: Sweet Potato Casserole. Add all ingredients to the cooked and mashed potatoes. Pour into 2 1/2-quart casserole.

recipes.title: Baked Custard Pie
directions: Put all ingredients into blender until well blended.
Pour into 9-inch buttered pie pan.
Bake at 350° for 45 to 50 minutes. Easy, quick and delicious!
recipes.text: Baked Custard Pie. Put all ingredients into blender until well blended. Pour into 9-inch buttered pie pan. Bake at 350° for 45 to 50 minutes. Easy, quick and delicious!

recipes.title: Buckeye Balls
directions: Mix sugar, vanilla, softened margarine and peanut butter together.
Knead and shape into balls.
Place on tray on waxed paper.
Refrigerate for 1/2 hour.
Melt shortening with chocolate chips.
Dip balls with a toothpick in chocolate 3/4 way. Refrigerate for 1/2 hour.
Remove and store in a sealed container.
recipes.text: Buckeye Balls. Mix sugar, vanilla, softened margarine and peanut butter together. Knead and shape into balls. Place on tray on waxed paper. Refrigerate for 1/2 hour. Melt shortening with chocolate chips. Dip balls with a toothpick in chocolate 3/4 way. Refrigerate for 1/2 hour. Remove and store in a sealed container.

recipes.title: Meat And Veggie Balls
ingredients: salt and pepper (can add other seasonings)
directions: Mix all ingredients (except soup); shape into 1 1/2-inch balls. Brown a little in butter.
Place in a baking dish; then add your tomato soup over top.
Bake about 35 minutes in a 350° oven.
recipes.text: Meat And Veggie Balls. Mix all ingredients (except soup); shape into 1 1/2-inch balls. Brown a little in butter. Place in a baking dish; then add your tomato soup over top. Bake about 35 minutes in a 350° oven.

recipes.title: Festive Fruit
directions: Drain fruit.
Place fruit and almonds in layers in a shallow baking dish.
Set aside.
recipes.text: Festive Fruit. Drain fruit. Place fruit and almonds in layers in a shallow baking dish. Set aside.

recipes.title: Hamburger Zucchini
directions: Fry hamburger, onion and salt.
Pour off fat.
Add tomatoes and cut up zucchini and simmer until tender.
recipes.text: Hamburger Zucchini. Fry hamburger, onion and salt. Pour off fat. Add tomatoes and cut up zucchini and simmer until tender.

recipes.title: Crock-Pot Chili
directions: Spray inside of crock-pot with cooking spray. Add hamburger, beans, tomatoes, onion and chili mix. Cook on low for 8 to 10 hours.
recipes.text: Crock-Pot Chili. Spray inside of crock-pot with cooking spray. Add hamburger, beans, tomatoes, onion and chili mix. Cook on low for 8 to 10 hours.

recipes.title: Orange Delight Cake
directions: Mix orange juice with enough sugar (approximately 4 tablespoons) to make a syrup.
Set aside to dissolve.
recipes.text: Orange Delight Cake. Mix orange juice with enough sugar (approximately 4 tablespoons) to make a syrup. Set aside to dissolve.

recipes.title: Onion Rings
directions: Cut onions in rings.
Mix all ingredients except onions together.
Dip onions in mixture.
Deep fry until brown.
recipes.text: Onion Rings. Cut onions in rings. Mix all ingredients except onions together. Dip onions in mixture. Deep fry until brown.

recipes.title: Plantation Shrimp Pilau
directions: Fry bacon until crisp; save to use later.
Add bacon grease to water in which rice will be cooked.
In frying pan melt butter; add celery and chopped bell pepper.
Cook a few minutes; add shrimp, sprinkled with Worcestershire sauce and dredged in flour. Stir and simmer until shrimp are cooked.
Season with salt and pepper; add rice and mix.
More butter may be added.
Stir in crumbled bacon and serve.
recipes.text: Plantation Shrimp Pilau. Fry bacon until crisp; save to use later. Add bacon grease to water in which rice will be cooked. In frying pan melt butter; add celery and chopped bell pepper. Cook a few minutes; add shrimp, sprinkled with Worcestershire sauce and dredged in flour. Stir and simmer until shrimp are cooked. Season with salt and pepper; add rice and mix. More butter may be added. Stir in crumbled bacon and serve.

recipes.title: Mulberry Pie
directions: Lightly mix and pour into unbaked pie shell.
Bake at 350° until crust is light brown.
recipes.text: Mulberry Pie. Lightly mix and pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake at 350° until crust is light brown.

recipes.title: Chicken And Rice Casserole
directions: Mix rice and soups and 1 can of water in casserole.
Top with cooked chicken.
Sprinkle seasonings.
Cover tightly with foil and bake at 325° for 1 1/2 hours.
recipes.text: Chicken And Rice Casserole. Mix rice and soups and 1 can of water in casserole. Top with cooked chicken. Sprinkle seasonings. Cover tightly with foil and bake at 325° for 1 1/2 hours.

recipes.title: Hawaiian Chops
directions: Brown chops in hot fat; season.
Place pineapple on each chop.
Add carrots.
Add water; cover and cook slowly for 1 1/2 hours.
Makes 4 servings.
recipes.text: Hawaiian Chops. Brown chops in hot fat; season. Place pineapple on each chop. Add carrots. Add water; cover and cook slowly for 1 1/2 hours. Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: Ginger Tea
directions: Mix and serve over ice.
recipes.text: Ginger Tea. Mix and serve over ice.

recipes.title: Heath Bar Cake
ingredients: 2 Heath brickle or Heath candy bars
directions: Cook cake according to box instructions. When it is done poke holes in the cake. Pour eagle brand milk and then caramel over cake and let it seep in. Add Heath brickle. When cake is cool top with cool whip.
recipes.text: Heath Bar Cake. Cook cake according to box instructions. When it is done poke holes in the cake. Pour eagle brand milk and then caramel over cake and let it seep in. Add Heath brickle. When cake is cool top with cool whip.

recipes.title: Noodles Little Italy
ingredients: 1 (16 oz.) pkg. thinly sliced pepperoni, chopped
directions: Cook
macaroni	in 2-quarts water; drain and set aside. In
a saucepan, combine tomatoes, tomato sauce, onion, garlic salt, oregano
and
pepperoni (reserve 6 or 7 slices for garnish). Simmer
mixture

mix well.
Place 1/2 the mixture in	a
greased 2-quart casserole dish and fold in 1/2 the shredded

of casserole.	Garnish top with pepperoni slices and shredded cheese.
Sprinkle with paprika.
Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes or until casserole is fully heated and cheese is all melted. Serves 6 to 8.
recipes.text: Noodles Little Italy. Cook macaroni	in 2-quarts water; drain and set aside. In a saucepan, combine tomatoes, tomato sauce, onion, garlic salt, oregano and pepperoni (reserve 6 or 7 slices for garnish). Simmer mixture for 30 minutes. Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes or until casserole is fully heated and cheese is all melted. Serves 6 to 8.

recipes.title: Sarah'S Country Molasses Cookies
directions: Beat together oil, molasses, sugar and egg.
Add flour, soda, salt and spices.
Mix well.
Roll into 1 inch balls.
Dip in sugar.
Place on greased cookie sheet.
Bake 8 minutes at 350°.
recipes.text: Sarah'S Country Molasses Cookies. Beat together oil, molasses, sugar and egg. Add flour, soda, salt and spices. Mix well. Roll into 1 inch balls. Dip in sugar. Place on greased cookie sheet. Bake 8 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Chocolate Chip Pie(Makes 2 Pies)
directions: Take chips and nuts and spread in bottom of unbaked shallow pie shells.
Beat the rest of ingredients together and pour over nuts and chips.
Bake at 350° for 30 to 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Chocolate Chip Pie(Makes 2 Pies). Take chips and nuts and spread in bottom of unbaked shallow pie shells. Beat the rest of ingredients together and pour over nuts and chips. Bake at 350° for 30 to 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Creamy Mushroom Chicken
directions: In pan, slightly brown chicken.
Separately brown butter. Saute garlic, onion and tomatoes until well cooked.
Add the chicken and broth and simmer until chicken is tender.
Remove from heat and arrange in Pyrex dish.
Strain sauce.
Melt butter in skillet; blend flour, wine, carrot, mushroom soup, butter, mushrooms and strained sauce.
Pour mixture over chicken.
Cool and cover with creamy mashed potatoes.
Bake in preheated oven at 350° for 20 minutes uncovered until top is golden brown.
recipes.text: Creamy Mushroom Chicken. In pan, slightly brown chicken. Separately brown butter. Saute garlic, onion and tomatoes until well cooked. Add the chicken and broth and simmer until chicken is tender. Remove from heat and arrange in Pyrex dish. Strain sauce. Melt butter in skillet; blend flour, wine, carrot, mushroom soup, butter, mushrooms and strained sauce. Pour mixture over chicken. Cool and cover with creamy mashed potatoes. Bake in preheated oven at 350° for 20 minutes uncovered until top is golden brown.

recipes.title: Stewed Eggplant
directions: Wash, peel and cut eggplant into small pieces.
Cut onion and bell pepper into small pieces.
Enough water to cover; salt to taste.
Stew down until tender or most of water is gone.
recipes.text: Stewed Eggplant. Wash, peel and cut eggplant into small pieces. Cut onion and bell pepper into small pieces. Enough water to cover; salt to taste. Stew down until tender or most of water is gone.

recipes.title: Caramel Popcorn
directions: Pour
popped corn in very large flat pan.
In saucepan, combine
butter,
sugar, Karo and salt.
Bring to full rolling boil, stirring constantly.
Remove
from
heat.
Add
soda and vanilla.
Pour over popcorn
and mix well.
Bake for 1 hour at 250°.
Stir every 15 minutes.
recipes.text: Caramel Popcorn. Pour popped corn in very large flat pan. In saucepan, combine butter, sugar, Karo and salt. Bring to full rolling boil, stirring constantly. Remove from heat. Add soda and vanilla. Pour over popcorn and mix well. Bake for 1 hour at 250°. Stir every 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Quick Chili
directions: Brown ground beef in skillet. Salt and pepper to taste; drain. Put tomato sauce, water, chili mix, beans and some broken spaghetti noodles in pan. Add ground beef and mix.
Cook over low heat for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Quick Chili. Brown ground beef in skillet. Salt and pepper to taste; drain. Put tomato sauce, water, chili mix, beans and some broken spaghetti noodles in pan. Add ground beef and mix. Cook over low heat for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Cocoa Candy Cookies
directions: Mix margarine, sugar, milk and cocoa in saucepan and bring to a boil.
Boil for 1 minute and remove from heat.
Add oatmeal and mix together.
Spoon out on wax paper to cool.
recipes.text: Cocoa Candy Cookies. Mix margarine, sugar, milk and cocoa in saucepan and bring to a boil. Boil for 1 minute and remove from heat. Add oatmeal and mix together. Spoon out on wax paper to cool.

recipes.title: Onion Casserole
directions: Preheat oven to 350°.
Line a 9 x 12-inch Pyrex with crushed saltine crackers. Place a layer of onions over crackers.
Sprinkle with a layer of grated cheese.
Repeat until onions and cheese are used.
recipes.text: Onion Casserole. Preheat oven to 350°. Line a 9 x 12-inch Pyrex with crushed saltine crackers. Place a layer of onions over crackers. Sprinkle with a layer of grated cheese. Repeat until onions and cheese are used.

recipes.title: Cherry Pie Salad
directions: Mix all ingredients together and refrigerate.
recipes.text: Cherry Pie Salad. Mix all ingredients together and refrigerate.

recipes.title: Ambrosia
directions: Drain mandarin oranges and pineapple chunks.
Combine sour cream, oranges, pineapple, mini marshmallows and coconut in large bowl.
Chill for at least 1 hour before serving.
recipes.text: Ambrosia. Drain mandarin oranges and pineapple chunks. Combine sour cream, oranges, pineapple, mini marshmallows and coconut in large bowl. Chill for at least 1 hour before serving.

recipes.title: Avocado Dip
directions: Combine all ingredients and mix well.
Chill.
Serve with corn chips.
recipes.text: Avocado Dip. Combine all ingredients and mix well. Chill. Serve with corn chips.

recipes.title: Zippy Pork Barbecue Sandwiches
directions: In Dutch oven, combine meat and water.
Bring to boil; reduce heat and simmer, covered, approximately 2 hours or until meat is very tender.
Remove meat from broth, reserving 1/2 cup broth. Return broth to Dutch oven and add onion and celery.
Cook, covered, for approximately 10 minutes or until vegetables are very tender.
Stir in brown sugar, ketchup, Worcestershire, vinegar, mustard and pepper.
Remove meat from the bones and discard fat and bones.
Chop or shred remaining meat.
Add meat to mixture in Dutch oven and simmer until warmed up enough to eat.
Spoon onto buns and enjoy!
recipes.text: Zippy Pork Barbecue Sandwiches. In Dutch oven, combine meat and water. Bring to boil; reduce heat and simmer, covered, approximately 2 hours or until meat is very tender. Remove meat from broth, reserving 1/2 cup broth. Return broth to Dutch oven and add onion and celery. Cook, covered, for approximately 10 minutes or until vegetables are very tender. Stir in brown sugar, ketchup, Worcestershire, vinegar, mustard and pepper. Remove meat from the bones and discard fat and bones. Chop or shred remaining meat. Add meat to mixture in Dutch oven and simmer until warmed up enough to eat. Spoon onto buns and enjoy!

recipes.title: Hamburger Casserole
directions: Brown meat and onion slightly.
Alternate layers of meat mixture and potatoes in casserole dish until all are used.
Add soup, salt and pepper.
Sprinkle with cheese.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
Good for covered dish meals.
recipes.text: Hamburger Casserole. Brown meat and onion slightly. Alternate layers of meat mixture and potatoes in casserole dish until all are used. Add soup, salt and pepper. Sprinkle with cheese. Bake at 350° for 1 hour. Good for covered dish meals.

recipes.title: Cottage Pineapple Pie(Diet)
directions: Blend cottage cheese and pineapple juice to soften.
Add Knox unflavored gelatine until smooth.
Fold in pineapple, cottage cheese and vanilla.
Bake in graham cracker crust at 350° for 3 minutes.
Refrigerate.
recipes.text: Cottage Pineapple Pie(Diet). Blend cottage cheese and pineapple juice to soften. Add Knox unflavored gelatine until smooth. Fold in pineapple, cottage cheese and vanilla. Bake in graham cracker crust at 350° for 3 minutes. Refrigerate.

recipes.title: Pineapple Carrot Cake
directions: Mix first 6 ingredients.
Blend together sugar and oil; add eggs.
Beat well.
Add pineapple and juice, carrots, nuts and mix well.
Bake in layer pans at 350° for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Pineapple Carrot Cake. Mix first 6 ingredients. Blend together sugar and oil; add eggs. Beat well. Add pineapple and juice, carrots, nuts and mix well. Bake in layer pans at 350° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Date Loaf
directions: Grind the first 4 ingredients together.
Add the sweet cream; mix well into loaf.
Set in cool place.
Serve with whipped cream, topped with a cherry.
Also can be put in an 8 x 8-inch pan and cut into squares.
recipes.text: Date Loaf. Grind the first 4 ingredients together. Add the sweet cream; mix well into loaf. Set in cool place. Serve with whipped cream, topped with a cherry. Also can be put in an 8 x 8-inch pan and cut into squares.
