recipes.title: Sauce Bordelaise
directions: Saute diced onions in butter until lightly browned; add flour and mix thoroughly.
Add bouillon; stir until smooth.
Slowly mix in red cooking wine, crushed garlic and chopped parsley.
recipes.text: Sauce Bordelaise. Saute diced onions in butter until lightly browned; add flour and mix thoroughly. Add bouillon; stir until smooth. Slowly mix in red cooking wine, crushed garlic and chopped parsley.

recipes.title: Spinach Balls
ingredients: 2 (10 oz.) pkg. frozen spinach, cooked and well drained
directions: To the beaten eggs add the melted butter and cheese, then add stuffing cubes and let them soften in egg mixture about 5 minutes. Add spinach and mix well.
Roll into small balls and bake at 350° for 15 minutes.
Makes about 50 spinach balls.
recipes.text: Spinach Balls. To the beaten eggs add the melted butter and cheese, then add stuffing cubes and let them soften in egg mixture about 5 minutes. Add spinach and mix well. Roll into small balls and bake at 350° for 15 minutes. Makes about 50 spinach balls.

recipes.title: Miss Ruby'S Burnt Sugar Frosting
directions: Melt 1/2 cup sugar in heavy pot over medium heat.
In another boiler, combine 2 1/2 cups sugar and the flour, then add milk and margarine (cut up).
Bring to a boil over medium heat.
Pour this boiling mixture into melted sugar; stir until well mixed.
Cook to soft ball stage.
Cool, add vanilla and beat.
recipes.text: Miss Ruby'S Burnt Sugar Frosting. Melt 1/2 cup sugar in heavy pot over medium heat. In another boiler, combine 2 1/2 cups sugar and the flour, then add milk and margarine (cut up). Bring to a boil over medium heat. Pour this boiling mixture into melted sugar; stir until well mixed. Cook to soft ball stage. Cool, add vanilla and beat.

recipes.title: Baking Powder Biscuits
directions: Cut oleo into 3/4 cup flour, then add rest of the flour, salt and baking powder.
Stir in milk.
Dough should be stiff enough to pull away from the sides into a ball.
Place on a floured surface and knead at least 10 times.
Roll or pat to 1/2-inch thickness and cut with a biscuit cutter or 2-inch round glass.
Place on an ungreased cookie sheet and bake for 10 to 12 minutes at 450°.
recipes.text: Baking Powder Biscuits. Cut oleo into 3/4 cup flour, then add rest of the flour, salt and baking powder. Stir in milk. Dough should be stiff enough to pull away from the sides into a ball. Place on a floured surface and knead at least 10 times. Roll or pat to 1/2-inch thickness and cut with a biscuit cutter or 2-inch round glass. Place on an ungreased cookie sheet and bake for 10 to 12 minutes at 450°.

recipes.title: Gazpacho Salad(Very Cool And Refreshing)
ingredients: 1 medium tomato (1 c.), seeded and chopped
directions: Combine vegetables, vinegar, salt and pepper.
Set aside. Dissolve Jell-O in boiling water.
Combine with cold water.
Let set in refrigerator until slightly thickened.
Add vegetables. Chill.
Serves 6.
recipes.text: Gazpacho Salad(Very Cool And Refreshing). Combine vegetables, vinegar, salt and pepper. Set aside. Dissolve Jell-O in boiling water. Combine with cold water. Let set in refrigerator until slightly thickened. Add vegetables. Chill. Serves 6.

recipes.title: Microwave Hamburgers
directions: Mix hamburger and onion together; form into patties.
Throw in the microwave; cook until you are ready to eat.
recipes.text: Microwave Hamburgers. Mix hamburger and onion together; form into patties. Throw in the microwave; cook until you are ready to eat.

recipes.title: Easy Confetti-Pasta Salad
ingredients: 1 (6 oz.) can small pitted ripe olives, drained
1 sweet red pepper, cut into thin strips
1 (8 oz.) bottle Caesar salad dressing (Paul Newman)
directions: Cook macaroni according to package directions. Drain. Rinse with cold water. Drain again. Layer half each of pasta and next 8 ingredients in large (2 1/2-quart) bowl. Drizzle with half of salad dressing. Repeat layering with remaining ingredients. Cover and chill at least 8 hours. Toss gently before serving, if desired. Yields 10 to 12 servings. Actually up to 20. Serves 20. Must do ahead.
recipes.text: Easy Confetti-Pasta Salad. Cook macaroni according to package directions. Drain. Rinse with cold water. Drain again. Layer half each of pasta and next 8 ingredients in large (2 1/2-quart) bowl. Drizzle with half of salad dressing. Repeat layering with remaining ingredients. Cover and chill at least 8 hours. Toss gently before serving, if desired. Yields 10 to 12 servings. Actually up to 20. Serves 20. Must do ahead.

recipes.title: Pretzel Salad
ingredients: 2 oz. cans mandarin oranges and juice
directions: Mix together broken pretzels, melted butter and sugar.
Press into 9 x 13-inch baking dish.
Bake at 400°
for 8 minutes.
Cool.
recipes.text: Pretzel Salad. Mix together broken pretzels, melted butter and sugar. Press into 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Bake at 400° for 8 minutes. Cool.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Cookies(No Bake)
ingredients: 1 1/3 c. soda cracker crumbs (1/4 lb. crackers)
directions: In a 1 1/2-quart saucepan, combine sugar, milk and butter or margarine.
Bring to a boil over medium flame and boil for 1 minute.
Add peanut butter, vanilla and cracker crumbs.
Mix well. Drop by teaspoon on waxed paper.
When cool, the cookies are ready to eat.
Yields 3 dozen cookies.
recipes.text: Peanut Butter Cookies(No Bake). In a 1 1/2-quart saucepan, combine sugar, milk and butter or margarine. Bring to a boil over medium flame and boil for 1 minute. Add peanut butter, vanilla and cracker crumbs. Mix well. Drop by teaspoon on waxed paper. When cool, the cookies are ready to eat. Yields 3 dozen cookies.

recipes.title: Cheese Bread Cubes
directions: Cut crusts off French bread.
Cut bread in 2-inch squares and freeze.
Add cheese to butter and mix well.
When bread is frozen, spread cheese mixture on all sides but the bottom of the cube. Return to freezer.
Just before serving, bake at 400° for 15 minutes, watching carefully.
Serve with salsa or soup or as a snack.
recipes.text: Cheese Bread Cubes. Cut crusts off French bread. Cut bread in 2-inch squares and freeze. Add cheese to butter and mix well. When bread is frozen, spread cheese mixture on all sides but the bottom of the cube. Return to freezer. Just before serving, bake at 400° for 15 minutes, watching carefully. Serve with salsa or soup or as a snack.

recipes.title: Crab, Shrimp And Rice
directions: Preheat oven to 350°.
Combine all ingredients and turn into a greased casserole dish.
Bake 1 hour.
Also delicious unbaked, as a salad.
recipes.text: Crab, Shrimp And Rice. Preheat oven to 350°. Combine all ingredients and turn into a greased casserole dish. Bake 1 hour. Also delicious unbaked, as a salad.

recipes.title: Vegetable Ball
directions: Drain pineapple; squeeze out with hands. Add remaining ingredients and mix well. Serve as a dip, a ball with crackers or a sandwich spread.
recipes.text: Vegetable Ball. Drain pineapple; squeeze out with hands. Add remaining ingredients and mix well. Serve as a dip, a ball with crackers or a sandwich spread.

recipes.title: Fruit Cake Cookies
directions: Mix all together and drop by spoonfuls on greased cookie sheet.
Bake at 325° for 10 to 15 minutes.
recipes.text: Fruit Cake Cookies. Mix all together and drop by spoonfuls on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 325° for 10 to 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Mexican Casserole
directions: Brown hamburger and onions.
Drain.
Mix soup, sauce, milk, Doritos and chilies together.
Sprinkle cheese on top or mix with other ingredients.
Bake at 350° for 25 minutes in 2 qt. casserole dish.
recipes.text: Mexican Casserole. Brown hamburger and onions. Drain. Mix soup, sauce, milk, Doritos and chilies together. Sprinkle cheese on top or mix with other ingredients. Bake at 350° for 25 minutes in 2 qt. casserole dish.

recipes.title: Do-Ahead Iced Tea
directions: Use 2 teaspoons loose tea or 2 tea bags for each cup of cold water.
Place tea in glass container.
Add water.
Cover and refrigerate at least 24 hours.
Serve over crushed ice.
recipes.text: Do-Ahead Iced Tea. Use 2 teaspoons loose tea or 2 tea bags for each cup of cold water. Place tea in glass container. Add water. Cover and refrigerate at least 24 hours. Serve over crushed ice.

recipes.title: Wassail
directions: In large pan heat cider and cinnamon stick to boiling; reduce heat.
Cover; simmer 5 minutes longer.
Serve in punch bowl and float Orange Stars.
recipes.text: Wassail. In large pan heat cider and cinnamon stick to boiling; reduce heat. Cover; simmer 5 minutes longer. Serve in punch bowl and float Orange Stars.

recipes.title: Euna'S Sweet Potato Casserole(Very Good!)
directions: Combine potatoes, beaten egg, sugar, margarine, milk and spices.
Beat until smooth.
Pour into 1 1/2-quart casserole dish.
recipes.text: Euna'S Sweet Potato Casserole(Very Good!). Combine potatoes, beaten egg, sugar, margarine, milk and spices. Beat until smooth. Pour into 1 1/2-quart casserole dish.

recipes.title: Provolone Corn Loaf
ingredients: 4 oz. (1 oz.) shredded Provolone or Mozzarella cheese
directions: Sprinkle 2 teaspoons cornmeal on the bottom and sides of a greased 8 x 4 x 2-inch loaf pan; set aside.
recipes.text: Provolone Corn Loaf. Sprinkle 2 teaspoons cornmeal on the bottom and sides of a greased 8 x 4 x 2-inch loaf pan; set aside.

recipes.title: Chicken Casserole
directions: Stew chicken.
Melt margarine and stir in dressing.
In large dish,
put a layer of crumbs, a layer of chicken and can of mushroom
soup
diluted
with
chicken broth.
Put another layer of
crumbs,
layer
of chicken and cream of chicken soup (diluted same).
Top
with
crumbs.
Bake
at 350° for 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Chicken Casserole. Stew chicken. Melt margarine and stir in dressing. In large dish, put a layer of crumbs, a layer of chicken and can of mushroom soup diluted with chicken broth. Put another layer of crumbs, layer of chicken and cream of chicken soup (diluted same). Top with crumbs. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Carolyn'S Fruit Dip
directions: Blend cream cheese and Marshmallow Creme until smooth.
Add orange rind and ginger.
Chill before serving.
recipes.text: Carolyn'S Fruit Dip. Blend cream cheese and Marshmallow Creme until smooth. Add orange rind and ginger. Chill before serving.

recipes.title: Green Tomato Bread
directions: Combine first ingredients; set aside.
Combine eggs, sugar, oil, lemon juice and vanilla; beat well.
Stir in tomatoes.
Add ingredients; stir just into mixture.
Stir in pecans.
Pour batter into a greased and floured 8 1/2 x 4 1/2 x 3-inch loaf pan.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour and 5 minutes or until wooden pick comes out clean.
Cool in pan for 10 minutes.
recipes.text: Green Tomato Bread. Combine first ingredients; set aside. Combine eggs, sugar, oil, lemon juice and vanilla; beat well. Stir in tomatoes. Add ingredients; stir just into mixture. Stir in pecans. Pour batter into a greased and floured 8 1/2 x 4 1/2 x 3-inch loaf pan. Bake at 350° for 1 hour and 5 minutes or until wooden pick comes out clean. Cool in pan for 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Rhubarb Slush
directions: Simmer rhubarb and water for 15 minutes. Drain, keep juice. Add sugar, jello and lemonade. Stir well. Add one cup vodka and freeze. Serve with cup or strawberry pop.
recipes.text: Rhubarb Slush. Simmer rhubarb and water for 15 minutes. Drain, keep juice. Add sugar, jello and lemonade. Stir well. Add one cup vodka and freeze. Serve with cup or strawberry pop.

recipes.title: Cheese Meat Loaf
directions: Mix all ingredients except bacon.
Place in 1-quart baking dish. Cool and freeze. To serve, thaw slightly and top with the bacon. Bake 45 minutes at 350°.
Very good.
recipes.text: Cheese Meat Loaf. Mix all ingredients except bacon. Place in 1-quart baking dish. Cool and freeze. To serve, thaw slightly and top with the bacon. Bake 45 minutes at 350°. Very good.

recipes.title: Luscious Lemon Bars
directions: Cream margarine and sugar.
Add flour; mix until formed in a soft dough.
Put mixture evenly into a 9 x 13-inch baking dish which has been sprayed with Pam.
Bake in a 350° oven for 20 minutes, or until golden brown.
recipes.text: Luscious Lemon Bars. Cream margarine and sugar. Add flour; mix until formed in a soft dough. Put mixture evenly into a 9 x 13-inch baking dish which has been sprayed with Pam. Bake in a 350° oven for 20 minutes, or until golden brown.

recipes.title: Baked Potato Soup(Great On A Cold Night!)
ingredients: 1/2 c. all-purpose flour (more if you want it thicker)
14 slices bacon, cooked, crumbled and divided
1 1/4 c. shredded Cheddar cheese (about 5 oz.), divided
directions: Wash potatoes and prick them several times with a fork; bake at	400°
for 1 hour or until done.
Let cool.
Cut potatoes in half
lengthwise
and
then scoop out pulp.
Set pulp aside. Discard
skins.
Melt
butter in a heavy saucepan over low	heat; add
flour, stirring until smooth.	Cook 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Gradually
add
milk;	cook over medium heat, stirring
constantly
until
mixture
is
thickened and bubbly. Add
potato
pulp,	salt, pepper, 2 tablespoons green onions, 1/2 cup
bacon	and 1 cup of cheese.
Cook soup until thoroughly heated, but do not boil.
Stir in sour cream.
Add extra
milk
if necessary	for desired thickness.	Serve with remaining onions, bacon and cheese.
recipes.text: Baked Potato Soup(Great On A Cold Night!). Wash potatoes and prick them several times with a fork; bake at	400° for 1 hour or until done. Let cool. Cut potatoes in half lengthwise and then scoop out pulp. Set pulp aside. Discard skins. Melt butter in a heavy saucepan over low	heat; add flour, stirring until smooth.	Cook 1 minute, stirring constantly. Gradually add milk;	cook over medium heat, stirring constantly until mixture is thickened and bubbly. Add potato pulp,	salt, pepper, 2 tablespoons green onions, 1/2 cup bacon	and 1 cup of cheese. Cook soup until thoroughly heated, but do not boil. Stir in sour cream. Add extra milk if necessary	for desired thickness.	Serve with remaining onions, bacon and cheese.

recipes.title: Sour Cream Coffee Cake
directions: Combine the oleo, sugar, sour cream, flour, baking powder, salt, eggs and vanilla.
Put half in tube pan. Sprinkle with a mixture of the brown sugar, cinnamon and nuts.
Add other half of the mixture and bake 1 hour at 350°.
recipes.text: Sour Cream Coffee Cake. Combine the oleo, sugar, sour cream, flour, baking powder, salt, eggs and vanilla. Put half in tube pan. Sprinkle with a mixture of the brown sugar, cinnamon and nuts. Add other half of the mixture and bake 1 hour at 350°.

recipes.title: Fool Proof Pie Crust
directions: With a fork mix together first four ingredients.
In a separate dish beat together the vinegar, egg and water.
Combine the two with a fork until all ingredients are moistened.
With your hands mold dough into a ball.
Chill for 15 minutes before rolling into shape.
Makes 3-4 pie crusts.
Store in refrigerator or freeze.
recipes.text: Fool Proof Pie Crust. With a fork mix together first four ingredients. In a separate dish beat together the vinegar, egg and water. Combine the two with a fork until all ingredients are moistened. With your hands mold dough into a ball. Chill for 15 minutes before rolling into shape. Makes 3-4 pie crusts. Store in refrigerator or freeze.

recipes.title: Cherry Dump Cake
directions: Mix pie filling and pineapple together in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish.
Spread cake mix over top.
Drizzle melted oleo or butter over top of dry cake mix.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until golden.
When cool, top with whipped cream.
recipes.text: Cherry Dump Cake. Mix pie filling and pineapple together in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Spread cake mix over top. Drizzle melted oleo or butter over top of dry cake mix. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until golden. When cool, top with whipped cream.

recipes.title: Broccoli Bread
ingredients: 1 (10 oz.) box chopped broccoli, thaw and drain
1 (8 1/2 oz.) box Jiffy corn muffin mix
directions: Mix ingredients together and pour into greased 11 x 7-inch baking dish.
Bake at 400° for 25 to 30 minutes or until brown.
recipes.text: Broccoli Bread. Mix ingredients together and pour into greased 11 x 7-inch baking dish. Bake at 400° for 25 to 30 minutes or until brown.

recipes.title: Hot Artichoke Dip
ingredients: 1 (14 oz.) can artichoke hearts, drained and chopped
directions: Heat oven to 350°.
Mix all ingredients.
Spoon into greased 9-inch pie plate or 3 cup casserole dish.
Bake 20 to 25 minutes or until lightly browned.
Sprinkle with sliced green onion and chopped tomato if desired.
Serve with assorted chips and crackers. Makes 2 cups.
recipes.text: Hot Artichoke Dip. Heat oven to 350°. Mix all ingredients. Spoon into greased 9-inch pie plate or 3 cup casserole dish. Bake 20 to 25 minutes or until lightly browned. Sprinkle with sliced green onion and chopped tomato if desired. Serve with assorted chips and crackers. Makes 2 cups.

recipes.title: Old Fashion Punch
directions: Just before serving, add ice ring and 2 quarts chilled 7-Up. Add sliced oranges and maraschino cherries for decoration.
recipes.text: Old Fashion Punch. Just before serving, add ice ring and 2 quarts chilled 7-Up. Add sliced oranges and maraschino cherries for decoration.

recipes.title: Tostada Platter
directions: In skillet, cook beef, onion and garlic until meat is brown and onion is tender.
Drain off fat.
Add chili powder and 1/2 teaspoon salt.
Set aside and keep warm.
In saucepan, combine undrained green beans and kidney beans; heat and drain.
Heat tortillas in microwave or oven.
recipes.text: Tostada Platter. In skillet, cook beef, onion and garlic until meat is brown and onion is tender. Drain off fat. Add chili powder and 1/2 teaspoon salt. Set aside and keep warm. In saucepan, combine undrained green beans and kidney beans; heat and drain. Heat tortillas in microwave or oven.

recipes.title: Vegetable Salad
directions: Cut up cauliflower and broccoli.
Slice onions and celery. Add frozen peas.
Mix together mayo, sour cream and Ranch dressing.
Pour over veggies and stir well.
Refrigerate for 4 hours.
recipes.text: Vegetable Salad. Cut up cauliflower and broccoli. Slice onions and celery. Add frozen peas. Mix together mayo, sour cream and Ranch dressing. Pour over veggies and stir well. Refrigerate for 4 hours.

recipes.title: California Casserole
directions: In a large skillet, cook beef with green pepper and onion until meat is browned and vegetables are tender; drain.
Add next 11 ingredients; mix thoroughly.
Add noodles; mix well.
Pour into a 9 x 13-inch baking dish.
Cover and bake at 350° for 50 minutes. Sprinkle with cheese.
Return to oven for 10 minutes or until cheese is melted.
Makes 12 to 16 servings.
recipes.text: California Casserole. In a large skillet, cook beef with green pepper and onion until meat is browned and vegetables are tender; drain. Add next 11 ingredients; mix thoroughly. Add noodles; mix well. Pour into a 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Cover and bake at 350° for 50 minutes. Sprinkle with cheese. Return to oven for 10 minutes or until cheese is melted. Makes 12 to 16 servings.

recipes.title: Salmon Cakes
directions: Drain juice and remove bones from salmon.
Crumble crackers and add with egg to salmon.
Heat oil.
Mix ingredients well and shape into cakes.
Drop into hot oil and fry until golden brown on each side.
Serves 4 to 6.
recipes.text: Salmon Cakes. Drain juice and remove bones from salmon. Crumble crackers and add with egg to salmon. Heat oil. Mix ingredients well and shape into cakes. Drop into hot oil and fry until golden brown on each side. Serves 4 to 6.

recipes.title: Dandy Candy
ingredients: 1 c. rolled oats or puffed cereal (optional)
1 to 2 Tbsp. water if mixture is too crumbly (optional)
directions: Combine peanut butter, milk powder, honey and vanilla in mixing bowl.
Next, mix ingredients with spoon.
recipes.text: Dandy Candy. Combine peanut butter, milk powder, honey and vanilla in mixing bowl. Next, mix ingredients with spoon.

recipes.title: Hamburger Casserole
directions: Cook hamburger and sausage together with pepper and onion in skillet; drain fat and add both sugars, beans, catsup, liquid smoke and Worcestershire sauce. Put in casserole dish and heat about 30 minutes at 350°.
recipes.text: Hamburger Casserole. Cook hamburger and sausage together with pepper and onion in skillet; drain fat and add both sugars, beans, catsup, liquid smoke and Worcestershire sauce. Put in casserole dish and heat about 30 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Pie
directions: Mix all ingredients together.
Pour into pie shells.
Bake 30 minutes at 350°.
recipes.text: Pumpkin Pie. Mix all ingredients together. Pour into pie shells. Bake 30 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Chicken And Dressing
directions: Mix all together.
Top with butter.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Chicken And Dressing. Mix all together. Top with butter. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: French Cherry Delight
directions: Beat eggs until stiff.
Add vanilla.
Fold in sugar, crackers, baking powder and nuts.
Spread in loaf pan (grease well).
Bake 325 degrees for 20 minutes (let completely cool).
recipes.text: French Cherry Delight. Beat eggs until stiff. Add vanilla. Fold in sugar, crackers, baking powder and nuts. Spread in loaf pan (grease well). Bake 325 degrees for 20 minutes (let completely cool).

recipes.title: Taco Casserole
directions: Lay in layers the meat, onion, beans, chips and cheese in that order.
Make a mixture of soup and tomatoes.
Pour over casserole. Bake at 350° until cheese is melted.
recipes.text: Taco Casserole. Lay in layers the meat, onion, beans, chips and cheese in that order. Make a mixture of soup and tomatoes. Pour over casserole. Bake at 350° until cheese is melted.

recipes.title: Monkey Bread
directions: Sprinkle nuts in bottom of a greased Bundt or angel food pan. Mix cinnamon and 1 cup brown sugar in small bowl.
Cut each biscuit in fourths with scissors.
Roll biscuits in cinnamon-sugar mixture and layer biscuits in pan.
Blend remaining 1 cup brown sugar with melted margarine and pour over biscuits.
Bake at 400° for 5 minutes, then reduce heat to 350° and bake 20 to 25 minutes more.
Cook in pan 10 minutes, then invert on rack.
recipes.text: Monkey Bread. Sprinkle nuts in bottom of a greased Bundt or angel food pan. Mix cinnamon and 1 cup brown sugar in small bowl. Cut each biscuit in fourths with scissors. Roll biscuits in cinnamon-sugar mixture and layer biscuits in pan. Blend remaining 1 cup brown sugar with melted margarine and pour over biscuits. Bake at 400° for 5 minutes, then reduce heat to 350° and bake 20 to 25 minutes more. Cook in pan 10 minutes, then invert on rack.

recipes.title: Snickers Bars
directions: Bottom Layer:
Melt 1 cup milk chocolate chips, 1/4 cup butterscotch chips and 1/4 cup peanut butter.
Spread in a greased 9 x 13-inch pan.
Set until cool.
recipes.text: Snickers Bars. Bottom Layer: Melt 1 cup milk chocolate chips, 1/4 cup butterscotch chips and 1/4 cup peanut butter. Spread in a greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Set until cool.

recipes.title: Chocolate Chip Zucchini Cake
directions: Cream margarine, oil and sugar.
Beat in eggs, one at a time. Add vanilla and buttermilk.
Sift dry ingredients and add slowly to creamed mixture.
Stir in zucchini.
Pour into greased and floured pan.
Sprinkle with chocolate chips and nuts.
Bake for 45 minutes at 325°.
recipes.text: Chocolate Chip Zucchini Cake. Cream margarine, oil and sugar. Beat in eggs, one at a time. Add vanilla and buttermilk. Sift dry ingredients and add slowly to creamed mixture. Stir in zucchini. Pour into greased and floured pan. Sprinkle with chocolate chips and nuts. Bake for 45 minutes at 325°.

recipes.title: Chocolate Peanut Butter Balls
directions: Melt margarine in large container.
Stir in graham cracker crumbs, powdered sugar and vanilla.
Add peanut butter; mix well. Roll into walnut size balls; lay out on wax paper.
Melt chocolate and paraffin together over hot water.
Dip each ball in chocolate mixture.
(I use a fork to lift the balls in and out of the chocolate.)
The balls will cool quickly and be pretty and glossy.
recipes.text: Chocolate Peanut Butter Balls. Melt margarine in large container. Stir in graham cracker crumbs, powdered sugar and vanilla. Add peanut butter; mix well. Roll into walnut size balls; lay out on wax paper. Melt chocolate and paraffin together over hot water. Dip each ball in chocolate mixture. (I use a fork to lift the balls in and out of the chocolate.) The balls will cool quickly and be pretty and glossy.

recipes.title: Sweet Lemon Chicken
directions: Flour and salt fryer and fry in cooking oil.
Blend remaining ingredients and pour over chicken.
Simmer 45 to 50 minutes. Serve over steamed rice.
recipes.text: Sweet Lemon Chicken. Flour and salt fryer and fry in cooking oil. Blend remaining ingredients and pour over chicken. Simmer 45 to 50 minutes. Serve over steamed rice.

recipes.title: Granola
ingredients: raisins, figs or other dried fruit (optional)
directions: Mix all ingredients except fruits together with hands and get all lumps out of brown sugar.
Bake in roasting pan at 325° until golden brown, about 45 minutes.
Stir every 10 minutes.
Cool.
Add raisins, chopped figs or other dried fruits, if desired.
Keep in plastic bags or cannister in refrigerator or freezer.
recipes.text: Granola. Mix all ingredients except fruits together with hands and get all lumps out of brown sugar. Bake in roasting pan at 325° until golden brown, about 45 minutes. Stir every 10 minutes. Cool. Add raisins, chopped figs or other dried fruits, if desired. Keep in plastic bags or cannister in refrigerator or freezer.

recipes.title: Buttermilk Salad
directions: Bring pineapple to boil in saucepan.
Stir in jello.
Mix well, then chill until partly set.
Stir in buttermilk.
Chill again until partly set.
Fold in whipped topping.
Chill until firm.
recipes.text: Buttermilk Salad. Bring pineapple to boil in saucepan. Stir in jello. Mix well, then chill until partly set. Stir in buttermilk. Chill again until partly set. Fold in whipped topping. Chill until firm.

recipes.title: Cider-Baked Turkey Breast
ingredients: 1 1/2 c. plus 1/2 c. apple cider or apple juice
directions: Preheat oven to 450°.
Place breast, skin side up, in roaster. Bake, uncovered, for 30 minutes.
Lower oven to 325°.
Combine 1 1/2 cups cider and soy sauce.
Pour over turkey breast.
Cover and bake 1 1/2 to 2 hours, basting frequently, with the cider mixture.
recipes.text: Cider-Baked Turkey Breast. Preheat oven to 450°. Place breast, skin side up, in roaster. Bake, uncovered, for 30 minutes. Lower oven to 325°. Combine 1 1/2 cups cider and soy sauce. Pour over turkey breast. Cover and bake 1 1/2 to 2 hours, basting frequently, with the cider mixture.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Bread
directions: Mix sugar, oil, eggs, pumpkin and vanilla together.
Set aside.
Combine all dry ingredients and add to mix alternately with water.
Add nuts.
Grease and flour 3 loaf pans.
Makes 3 loaves. Bake in electric oven at 325° for 1 to 1-1/2 hours or gas oven at 375°, test for doneness.
recipes.text: Pumpkin Bread. Mix sugar, oil, eggs, pumpkin and vanilla together. Set aside. Combine all dry ingredients and add to mix alternately with water. Add nuts. Grease and flour 3 loaf pans. Makes 3 loaves. Bake in electric oven at 325° for 1 to 1-1/2 hours or gas oven at 375°, test for doneness.

recipes.title: Tater Tot Casserole
directions: Spread Tater Tots in bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Brown hamburger and onion.
Spread on top.
recipes.text: Tater Tot Casserole. Spread Tater Tots in bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan. Brown hamburger and onion. Spread on top.

recipes.title: Lee'S Favorite Cole Slaw
directions: Wash, cut and shred cabbage in food processor (or by hand). Peel carrot, cut off ends and shred with cabbage.
Add pickles, sugar and mayo.
Mix well. Serve cold with seafood, barbecue or on hot dogs.
recipes.text: Lee'S Favorite Cole Slaw. Wash, cut and shred cabbage in food processor (or by hand). Peel carrot, cut off ends and shred with cabbage. Add pickles, sugar and mayo. Mix well. Serve cold with seafood, barbecue or on hot dogs.

recipes.title: Caramel Bars
directions: Mix cake mix and 1/3 cup milk with butter until it holds together.
Melt caramels and 1/3 cup milk; set aside.
Put half of the cake mix in a 9 x 13-inch greased pan.
Bake for 6 minutes at 350°.
Pour caramel mixture over and sprinkle with chips.
Crumble remaining cake mix over top.
Bake at 350° for 16 to 18 minutes.
recipes.text: Caramel Bars. Mix cake mix and 1/3 cup milk with butter until it holds together. Melt caramels and 1/3 cup milk; set aside. Put half of the cake mix in a 9 x 13-inch greased pan. Bake for 6 minutes at 350°. Pour caramel mixture over and sprinkle with chips. Crumble remaining cake mix over top. Bake at 350° for 16 to 18 minutes.

recipes.title: Poppy Seed Bread
ingredients: 1 pkg. instant coconut cream pudding mix
directions: Grease and flour 2 loaf pans.
Mix all ingredients together. Beat 2 minutes.
Pour into loaf pans.
Bake 40 to 50 minutes at 350°.
recipes.text: Poppy Seed Bread. Grease and flour 2 loaf pans. Mix all ingredients together. Beat 2 minutes. Pour into loaf pans. Bake 40 to 50 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Luscious Lemon Shrimp
directions: Melt butter in casserole dish; add shrimp (in shells), lemons, cooking wine, herb spice, salt and Accent.
Cover and bake at 350° for 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Luscious Lemon Shrimp. Melt butter in casserole dish; add shrimp (in shells), lemons, cooking wine, herb spice, salt and Accent. Cover and bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Shrimp Or Crawfish Fettucini
ingredients: 1 lb. crawfish tails or 1 lb. shrimp
12 oz. pkg. fettucini noodles, cooked and drained
directions: Saute vegetables for 5 to 8 minutes.
Add garlic and seafood. Cook for 10 minutes.
Add flour, half and half and cheese; stir frequently.
Simmer for 30 minutes.
Add cooked noodles.
Pour into a greased casserole dish.
Bake for 20 minutes at 350°.
recipes.text: Shrimp Or Crawfish Fettucini. Saute vegetables for 5 to 8 minutes. Add garlic and seafood. Cook for 10 minutes. Add flour, half and half and cheese; stir frequently. Simmer for 30 minutes. Add cooked noodles. Pour into a greased casserole dish. Bake for 20 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Broccoli Casserole 2
directions: Cut and cook broccoli until tender.
Combine soup, milk and eggs.
Add broccoli, cheese, onion and mushrooms.
Pour into buttered casserole dish.
Add crackers on top.
Bake (uncovered) at 350° until bubbly (about 45 minutes).
recipes.text: Broccoli Casserole 2. Cut and cook broccoli until tender. Combine soup, milk and eggs. Add broccoli, cheese, onion and mushrooms. Pour into buttered casserole dish. Add crackers on top. Bake (uncovered) at 350° until bubbly (about 45 minutes).

recipes.title: Microwave Company Chicken Breasts
ingredients: 2 whole boneless chicken breasts, skinned, halved and flattened to 1/4-inch thick
directions: Cook rice or noodles conventionally while microwaving chicken. Place a slice of chipped beef on each half breast.
Roll up breasts and secure with 4 wooden picks.
Place sliced mushrooms in an 8 x 8-inch dish.
Arrange breasts on top.
Combine soup and sour cream; spoon over chicken.
Cover with wax paper.
Microwave 7 1/2 to 12 1/2 minutes or until chicken is no longer pink. Rearrange after half of time cooking.
Sprinkle almonds over chicken.
recipes.text: Microwave Company Chicken Breasts. Cook rice or noodles conventionally while microwaving chicken. Place a slice of chipped beef on each half breast. Roll up breasts and secure with 4 wooden picks. Place sliced mushrooms in an 8 x 8-inch dish. Arrange breasts on top. Combine soup and sour cream; spoon over chicken. Cover with wax paper. Microwave 7 1/2 to 12 1/2 minutes or until chicken is no longer pink. Rearrange after half of time cooking. Sprinkle almonds over chicken.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Cake
ingredients: 1 1/2 c. brown rice syrup or honey or fructose
1/2 c. canola oil and/or safflower oil
1/2 c. wheat germ or oat bran
directions: Combine all ingredients.
Pour into 13 x 9-inch pan prepared with Pam. Bake at 350° for 60 to 75 minutes until knife comes out clean.
recipes.text: Pumpkin Cake. Combine all ingredients. Pour into 13 x 9-inch pan prepared with Pam. Bake at 350° for 60 to 75 minutes until knife comes out clean.

recipes.title: Paper Cup Frozen Salad
ingredients: 1 (1 lb.) can pitted Bing cherries, well drained
1 (8 oz.) can crushed pineapple, well drained
directions: Combine sour cream, lemon juice, salt, drained pineapple, banana and red coloring to give pink tint.
Fold in nuts and cherries. Spoon into fluted paper muffin cups (large) placed in muffin cup pans. Freeze.
Cover with plastic wrap.
After freezing, remove from pan and store in freezer.
Remove from freezer about 15 minutes before serving to loosen paper cups. Peel off paper and serve plain or on lettuce leaf.
recipes.text: Paper Cup Frozen Salad. Combine sour cream, lemon juice, salt, drained pineapple, banana and red coloring to give pink tint. Fold in nuts and cherries. Spoon into fluted paper muffin cups (large) placed in muffin cup pans. Freeze. Cover with plastic wrap. After freezing, remove from pan and store in freezer. Remove from freezer about 15 minutes before serving to loosen paper cups. Peel off paper and serve plain or on lettuce leaf.

recipes.title: Broccoli Casserole
ingredients: 1 pkg. chopped broccoli, cooked and drained
1 can water chestnuts, drained and chopped
directions: Saute green pepper and onion in margarine.
Add to other ingredients and mix well.
Top with grated cheese.
Bake in covered casserole at 350° for 1/2 hour.
Serves 8 to 10.
recipes.text: Broccoli Casserole. Saute green pepper and onion in margarine. Add to other ingredients and mix well. Top with grated cheese. Bake in covered casserole at 350° for 1/2 hour. Serves 8 to 10.

recipes.title: Hearty Vegetable Chowder
ingredients: 1 (17 oz.) can whole kernel corn, drained
directions: In a 3 to 4-quart saucepan, fry bacon until crisp.
Scoop out bacon with slotted spoon; drain on paper towels.
Add boiling water, onion, celery, potatoes, carrots, beans, corn, garlic powder, salt and bay leaf to bacon drippings.
Stir; heat to boiling.
Reduce heat; cover and boil slowly for about 20 minutes, or until vegetables are tender.
Stir in evaporated milk.
Blend flour and water until smooth; stir into soup.
Add pimento. Return to boiling.
Reduce heat; cover and simmer for 5 minutes. Makes 2 quarts.
recipes.text: Hearty Vegetable Chowder. In a 3 to 4-quart saucepan, fry bacon until crisp. Scoop out bacon with slotted spoon; drain on paper towels. Add boiling water, onion, celery, potatoes, carrots, beans, corn, garlic powder, salt and bay leaf to bacon drippings. Stir; heat to boiling. Reduce heat; cover and boil slowly for about 20 minutes, or until vegetables are tender. Stir in evaporated milk. Blend flour and water until smooth; stir into soup. Add pimento. Return to boiling. Reduce heat; cover and simmer for 5 minutes. Makes 2 quarts.

recipes.title: Sweet Yellow Bread
directions: Put yeast in water; set aside.
Combine milk, butter and sugar in a large bowl.
Cool to lukewarm.
Stir in eggs, vanilla, salt and yeast.
Gradually add flour.
Cover and let stand until dough doubles (approximately 1 hour).
Beat down and let rise 45 minutes more.
Turn into 2 greased bread pans and let rise 45 minutes more.
Brush tops of bread lightly with remaining egg.
Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Sweet Yellow Bread. Put yeast in water; set aside. Combine milk, butter and sugar in a large bowl. Cool to lukewarm. Stir in eggs, vanilla, salt and yeast. Gradually add flour. Cover and let stand until dough doubles (approximately 1 hour). Beat down and let rise 45 minutes more. Turn into 2 greased bread pans and let rise 45 minutes more. Brush tops of bread lightly with remaining egg. Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Chilli Steaks
ingredients: thin steaks, cut in 4 servings or use small breakfast steaks
directions: Sear steaks in hot oil,
both sides and place steaks on baking dish.
Spread one
teaspoon
of chillies on each steak. Add sliced onions on top of chillies.	Place sliced Mozzarella cheese on top. Bake at 350° until cheese starts to brown.
recipes.text: Chilli Steaks. Sear steaks in hot oil, both sides and place steaks on baking dish. Spread one teaspoon of chillies on each steak. Add sliced onions on top of chillies.	Place sliced Mozzarella cheese on top. Bake at 350° until cheese starts to brown.

recipes.title: Sweet Chow Chow
ingredients: 10 to 15 green and red sweet peppers (1 pepper per lb. of tomatoes)
directions: Grind tomatoes, peppers, cabbage and onions.
Pour salt over mixture and mix all together.
Place mixture in cloth bag (pillow case) and hang outside (if not freezing) to drain overnight.
recipes.text: Sweet Chow Chow. Grind tomatoes, peppers, cabbage and onions. Pour salt over mixture and mix all together. Place mixture in cloth bag (pillow case) and hang outside (if not freezing) to drain overnight.

recipes.title: Hamburger Rolls With Tomatoes
directions: Mix meat with salt, pepper and water.
Form into barrel shaped rolls.
Dip into egg which has been beaten with the 1 tablespoon milk.
Roll in bread crumbs.
Heat shortening in heavy skillet and brown rolls on all sides.
Rub tomatoes through sieve and pour over rolls.
Add onion; cover and simmer 20 to 25 minutes, turning occasionally.
Serve hot with the tomato sauce poured over the rolls.
Makes 5 servings.
recipes.text: Hamburger Rolls With Tomatoes. Mix meat with salt, pepper and water. Form into barrel shaped rolls. Dip into egg which has been beaten with the 1 tablespoon milk. Roll in bread crumbs. Heat shortening in heavy skillet and brown rolls on all sides. Rub tomatoes through sieve and pour over rolls. Add onion; cover and simmer 20 to 25 minutes, turning occasionally. Serve hot with the tomato sauce poured over the rolls. Makes 5 servings.

recipes.title: Hamburger Casserole
directions: Brown and drain ground beef.
Cook onion with meat.
Warm cream of mushroom soup with water and pour over meat.
Put Tater Tots on top and bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes or until brown.
recipes.text: Hamburger Casserole. Brown and drain ground beef. Cook onion with meat. Warm cream of mushroom soup with water and pour over meat. Put Tater Tots on top and bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes or until brown.

recipes.title: Mom'S Sugar Cookies(Good)
directions: Cream Crisco, sugar, vanilla and egg.
Mix in remaining ingredients.
Roll into small balls.
Flatten with bottom of glass dipped in sugar or use slotted spoon to make an interesting imprint.
Bake in 350° oven for 12 minutes.
This makes 3 dozen small cookies.
recipes.text: Mom'S Sugar Cookies(Good). Cream Crisco, sugar, vanilla and egg. Mix in remaining ingredients. Roll into small balls. Flatten with bottom of glass dipped in sugar or use slotted spoon to make an interesting imprint. Bake in 350° oven for 12 minutes. This makes 3 dozen small cookies.

recipes.title: Corn Chowder
directions: Cook potatoes and onions.
Add corn and milk.
Season to taste.
Simmer 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Corn Chowder. Cook potatoes and onions. Add corn and milk. Season to taste. Simmer 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Halloween Bars
directions: Preheat oven to 325°.
Place butter in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish and melt in oven.
Remove from oven and distribute evenly over bottom of baking dish.
Sprinkle graham cracker crumbs over butter.
Pour the sweetened condensed milk evenly over the crumbs. Top with chocolate chips and peanut butter chips.
Press down firmly.
Bake 25 to 30 minutes until lightly browned.
Cool and cut into bars.
Makes 24 to 36 bars.
recipes.text: Halloween Bars. Preheat oven to 325°. Place butter in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish and melt in oven. Remove from oven and distribute evenly over bottom of baking dish. Sprinkle graham cracker crumbs over butter. Pour the sweetened condensed milk evenly over the crumbs. Top with chocolate chips and peanut butter chips. Press down firmly. Bake 25 to 30 minutes until lightly browned. Cool and cut into bars. Makes 24 to 36 bars.

recipes.title: Spaghetti
directions: Brown beef and onions; add remaining ingredients.
Cook very slow 2 1/2 hours.
Add 6 ounces spaghetti, previously cooked.
recipes.text: Spaghetti. Brown beef and onions; add remaining ingredients. Cook very slow 2 1/2 hours. Add 6 ounces spaghetti, previously cooked.

recipes.title: Barbecue Meatballs
directions: Combine bread crumbs, ground beef, 1/2 cup onion, salt, pepper and milk.
Make into balls and place into baking dish.
Combine vinegar, sugar, ketchup, water and 1/2 cup of onion to make sauce. Set aside half of this mixture to use later.
Pour 1/2 of mixture over meatballs and bake at 375° for 45 minutes.
Pour other half of mixture over meatballs after taking out of oven.
recipes.text: Barbecue Meatballs. Combine bread crumbs, ground beef, 1/2 cup onion, salt, pepper and milk. Make into balls and place into baking dish. Combine vinegar, sugar, ketchup, water and 1/2 cup of onion to make sauce. Set aside half of this mixture to use later. Pour 1/2 of mixture over meatballs and bake at 375° for 45 minutes. Pour other half of mixture over meatballs after taking out of oven.

recipes.title: Quiche Lorraine
ingredients: 1 1/2 c. shredded cheese (Mozzarella, American or Cheddar)
directions: Crumble bacon in crust.
Cover with cheese and onion rings. Mix flour, salt and pepper; blend with milk.
Add eggs to mixture and beat.
Pour into crust.
Bake at 375° for 30 minutes or until fork inserted in center comes out clean.
To prevent overbaking of crust, rub butter on edges before baking and lay foil loosely over top during latter baking time, if necessary.
Let stand 5 minutes before serving.
recipes.text: Quiche Lorraine. Crumble bacon in crust. Cover with cheese and onion rings. Mix flour, salt and pepper; blend with milk. Add eggs to mixture and beat. Pour into crust. Bake at 375° for 30 minutes or until fork inserted in center comes out clean. To prevent overbaking of crust, rub butter on edges before baking and lay foil loosely over top during latter baking time, if necessary. Let stand 5 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Apple-Smothered Pork Chops
ingredients: 3 medium tart apples, peeled and sliced
directions: You will need 2 sheets (18 x 24-inch each) Reynolds Wrap| heavy-duty aluminum foil.
recipes.text: Apple-Smothered Pork Chops. You will need 2 sheets (18 x 24-inch each) Reynolds Wrap| heavy-duty aluminum foil.

recipes.title: Mexican Meatloaf
directions: In skillet, brown onion, peppers, garlic and seasoning packet in oil.
Combine these ingredients with remaining ingredients in mixing bowl.
Shape mixture in a loaf and bake until browned, 45 minutes at 375 degrees.
recipes.text: Mexican Meatloaf. In skillet, brown onion, peppers, garlic and seasoning packet in oil. Combine these ingredients with remaining ingredients in mixing bowl. Shape mixture in a loaf and bake until browned, 45 minutes at 375 degrees.

recipes.title: Banana Split Cake
directions: Crush vanilla wafers.
Mix with butter.
Place in bottom of sheet cake pan.
Mix sugar, eggs, margarine and vanilla flavoring. Spread over crust.
Slice bananas.
Spread drained crushed pineapple over bananas.
Sprinkle with pecans. Top with Cool Whip. Garnish with cherries.
recipes.text: Banana Split Cake. Crush vanilla wafers. Mix with butter. Place in bottom of sheet cake pan. Mix sugar, eggs, margarine and vanilla flavoring. Spread over crust. Slice bananas. Spread drained crushed pineapple over bananas. Sprinkle with pecans. Top with Cool Whip. Garnish with cherries.

recipes.title: Popcorn Balls
directions: Boil sugar, syrup, water, vinegar and oleo; add vanilla. After mixture is cooked, boil until mixture forms hard ball in cold water.
Add
vanilla;
stir.
Pour
over the popped corn; dip your hands in cold water so mixture won't stick to them.
I usually double this batch.
recipes.text: Popcorn Balls. Boil sugar, syrup, water, vinegar and oleo; add vanilla. After mixture is cooked, boil until mixture forms hard ball in cold water. Add vanilla; stir. Pour over the popped corn; dip your hands in cold water so mixture won't stick to them. I usually double this batch.

recipes.title: Spiced Pecans
directions: Mix all ingredients, except pecans, in large bowl.
When thoroughly mixed, add pecans; stir to coat well.
Spread peanuts on foil covered cookie sheet.
Bake at 300° for 30 to 35 minutes. Stir once or twice to crisp and dry evenly.
recipes.text: Spiced Pecans. Mix all ingredients, except pecans, in large bowl. When thoroughly mixed, add pecans; stir to coat well. Spread peanuts on foil covered cookie sheet. Bake at 300° for 30 to 35 minutes. Stir once or twice to crisp and dry evenly.

recipes.title: Hash Brown Casserole
ingredients: 16 oz. sour cream (no fat may be used)
directions: Mix all ingredients together in a bowl.
Pour into a 9 x 13-inch casserole that has been sprayed with nonstick spray.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour and 15 minutes.
After removing from oven, sprinkle with a little more grated cheese to garnish.
recipes.text: Hash Brown Casserole. Mix all ingredients together in a bowl. Pour into a 9 x 13-inch casserole that has been sprayed with nonstick spray. Bake at 350° for 1 hour and 15 minutes. After removing from oven, sprinkle with a little more grated cheese to garnish.

recipes.title: Futti
directions: Boil chicken until tender.
Cool, debone, strain and reserve broth.
Brown ground beef, drain fat, wash rice, add to meat.
Add seasonings and pine nuts.
Add chicken broth to saucepan until mixture is just covered.
Cover and simmer approximately 30 minutes.
In separate bowl, mash 1 to 2 cloves garlic with salt to make a paste.
Add 1 cup vinegar and 2 cups chicken broth.
Toast bread and tear into bite size pieces.
In large bowl, combine chicken, meat and rice and toast.
Heat broth mixture, pour over and toss.
Season to taste.
recipes.text: Futti. Boil chicken until tender. Cool, debone, strain and reserve broth. Brown ground beef, drain fat, wash rice, add to meat. Add seasonings and pine nuts. Add chicken broth to saucepan until mixture is just covered. Cover and simmer approximately 30 minutes. In separate bowl, mash 1 to 2 cloves garlic with salt to make a paste. Add 1 cup vinegar and 2 cups chicken broth. Toast bread and tear into bite size pieces. In large bowl, combine chicken, meat and rice and toast. Heat broth mixture, pour over and toss. Season to taste.

recipes.title: Melba Rounds
directions: Cook bacon and crumble.
Mix oleo, caraway seed, bacon and cheese.
Spread on Melba rounds.
Broil until brown.
recipes.text: Melba Rounds. Cook bacon and crumble. Mix oleo, caraway seed, bacon and cheese. Spread on Melba rounds. Broil until brown.

recipes.title: U.M.W.'S Chickenetti For "360"
directions: Cook and bone chicken.
(Hint:
Cook 6 or more chickens in large pot, well covered with water.
Lightly salt the broth.
When thoroughly done, remove chickens and cook remainder of the chickens in this broth.
This method gives a richer broth and more flavorful chicken.)
Cook spaghetti as package directs; drain.
Mix remaining ingredients reserving 5 1/2 to 6 cups cheese for topping.
Put in 15 baking pans.
Sprinkle with reserved cheese.
Bake at 350° for 1 to 1 1/4 hours.
recipes.text: U.M.W.'S Chickenetti For "360". Cook and bone chicken. (Hint: Cook 6 or more chickens in large pot, well covered with water. Lightly salt the broth. When thoroughly done, remove chickens and cook remainder of the chickens in this broth. This method gives a richer broth and more flavorful chicken.) Cook spaghetti as package directs; drain. Mix remaining ingredients reserving 5 1/2 to 6 cups cheese for topping. Put in 15 baking pans. Sprinkle with reserved cheese. Bake at 350° for 1 to 1 1/4 hours.

recipes.title: Strawberry Trifle
ingredients: 2 (10 oz.) pkg. frozen sliced strawberries, slightly thawed
directions: Boil strawberries and box of jello (do not add water) and let cool.
Mix together milk, pudding and sour cream.
Layer a trifle dish with vanilla wafers.
Add a layer of pudding mix then a layer of the strawberry mixture then a layer of cool whip.
Continue to layer till ingredients are used.
recipes.text: Strawberry Trifle. Boil strawberries and box of jello (do not add water) and let cool. Mix together milk, pudding and sour cream. Layer a trifle dish with vanilla wafers. Add a layer of pudding mix then a layer of the strawberry mixture then a layer of cool whip. Continue to layer till ingredients are used.

recipes.title: Grandmaw'S Apple Pecan Cake
directions: Preheat oven to 350°. Beat eggs at medium speed until thick and pale. Gradually add sugar; beat until blended. Add oil and vanilla; beat at low speed until blended. Combine flour, baking soda, salt and cinnamon. Add to beaten mixture and stir until blended. Stir in apples and pecans. Pour into greased and floured 12-cup Bundt pan. Bake 1 hour and 25 minutes or until tester comes out clean. Cool in pan. Remove from pan when completely cool. Glaze, if desired.
recipes.text: Grandmaw'S Apple Pecan Cake. Preheat oven to 350°. Beat eggs at medium speed until thick and pale. Gradually add sugar; beat until blended. Add oil and vanilla; beat at low speed until blended. Combine flour, baking soda, salt and cinnamon. Add to beaten mixture and stir until blended. Stir in apples and pecans. Pour into greased and floured 12-cup Bundt pan. Bake 1 hour and 25 minutes or until tester comes out clean. Cool in pan. Remove from pan when completely cool. Glaze, if desired.

recipes.title: Gelatin Easter Baskets
ingredients: 1 pkg. (4 serving size) Jell-O brand gelatin (any flavor)
directions: Dissolve gelatin in boiling water.
Add cold water.
Pour into individual ring molds or 6 ounce custard cups.
Chill until firm, about 2 hours.
recipes.text: Gelatin Easter Baskets. Dissolve gelatin in boiling water. Add cold water. Pour into individual ring molds or 6 ounce custard cups. Chill until firm, about 2 hours.

recipes.title: Country French Chicken Breasts
ingredients: 1 lb. boneless, skinless chicken breast halves
1 envelope Lipton Recipe Secrets savory herb with garlic soup mix
directions: In a 12-inch skillet, melt butter over medium-high heat and brown chicken. Stir in soup mix blended with water and lemon juice. Arrange lemon slices on chicken. Reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, 10 minutes or until sauce is slightly thickened and chicken is done.
To serve, arrange chicken over rice and spoon sauce over chicken.
recipes.text: Country French Chicken Breasts. In a 12-inch skillet, melt butter over medium-high heat and brown chicken. Stir in soup mix blended with water and lemon juice. Arrange lemon slices on chicken. Reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, 10 minutes or until sauce is slightly thickened and chicken is done. To serve, arrange chicken over rice and spoon sauce over chicken.

recipes.title: Chicken A La James Beard(With 40 Cloves Of Garlic Provencale Recipe)
ingredients: 1 broiler-fryer chicken, cut in pieces or 4 whole chicken breasts, cut apart and skinned
1 Tbsp. chopped fresh tarragon or 1 tsp. dried
40 cloves garlic (unpeeled) or 20 if not so brave!*
directions: *Cooked garlic will have no after taste.
recipes.text: Chicken A La James Beard(With 40 Cloves Of Garlic Provencale Recipe). *Cooked garlic will have no after taste.

recipes.title: Banana Nut Cake
directions: Mix and bake 1 1/2 hours at 350° in tube pan.
Cool 1 hour before removing from pan.
recipes.text: Banana Nut Cake. Mix and bake 1 1/2 hours at 350° in tube pan. Cool 1 hour before removing from pan.

recipes.title: Bisquick Mix
directions: Mix together. Store in airtight plastic canister.
(May wish to refrigerate unless stored in cool place.)
recipes.text: Bisquick Mix. Mix together. Store in airtight plastic canister. (May wish to refrigerate unless stored in cool place.)

recipes.title: Hot Ham Barbecues
directions: Heat onion and celery in butter.
Add the remaining ingredients.
Bring to a boiling point and let simmer about 1 1/2 hours.
recipes.text: Hot Ham Barbecues. Heat onion and celery in butter. Add the remaining ingredients. Bring to a boiling point and let simmer about 1 1/2 hours.

recipes.title: Jean'S Apple Cake
directions: Mix well, adding apples and nuts last.
Dough will be stiff. Bake 55 minutes in a greased and floured tube pan at 350°.
recipes.text: Jean'S Apple Cake. Mix well, adding apples and nuts last. Dough will be stiff. Bake 55 minutes in a greased and floured tube pan at 350°.

recipes.title: Old Fashioned Cornbread Dressing
ingredients: 1 medium onion or 1 bunch green onions, chopped
directions: (I also use some sausage seasonings with chopped sage and chopped red peppers in it.)
recipes.text: Old Fashioned Cornbread Dressing. (I also use some sausage seasonings with chopped sage and chopped red peppers in it.)

recipes.title: Norwegian Apple Pie
ingredients: 1 egg or 2 egg whites or egg substitute equivalent to 1 egg
directions: Beat
egg,
sugar,
vanilla
extract
and baking powder together until
smooth and fluffy.	Beat in flour until smooth and well
blended.
Stir
in
walnuts and apples.
Turn into a lightly greased
8-inch pie plate and bake 30 minutes at 350°. Pie will puff
up as it cooks and then collapses as it cools. Serve warm with a scoop of ice milk.
recipes.text: Norwegian Apple Pie. Beat egg, sugar, vanilla extract and baking powder together until smooth and fluffy.	Beat in flour until smooth and well blended. Stir in walnuts and apples. Turn into a lightly greased 8-inch pie plate and bake 30 minutes at 350°. Pie will puff up as it cooks and then collapses as it cools. Serve warm with a scoop of ice milk.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Bread
directions: Add sugar to oil, then eggs, pumpkin, spices sifted with flour, water and raisins.
Bake at 350° for one hour.
Makes one loaf.
recipes.text: Pumpkin Bread. Add sugar to oil, then eggs, pumpkin, spices sifted with flour, water and raisins. Bake at 350° for one hour. Makes one loaf.

recipes.title: Southern Pecan Pie
directions: Combine sugar, syrup and margarine. Add eggs, pecans and vanilla flavoring. Pour into a pie shell. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes or longer if needed.
recipes.text: Southern Pecan Pie. Combine sugar, syrup and margarine. Add eggs, pecans and vanilla flavoring. Pour into a pie shell. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes or longer if needed.

recipes.title: Apple Cake
directions: Crumble butter and sugar.
Add rest of dry ingredients.
Add eggs and apple slices.
Mix well.
Pour in greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Apple Cake. Crumble butter and sugar. Add rest of dry ingredients. Add eggs and apple slices. Mix well. Pour in greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Cheese Sticks
ingredients: 4 c. grated sharp Cheddar cheese, softened
directions: Cream
margarine
and
cheese;
add
flour
and pepper. Press through a cookie press, using small star blade.
Bake at 300° for 20 minutes.
Cut while hot and sprinkle with paprika.
recipes.text: Cheese Sticks. Cream margarine and cheese; add flour and pepper. Press through a cookie press, using small star blade. Bake at 300° for 20 minutes. Cut while hot and sprinkle with paprika.

recipes.title: Baked Barbecue Potatoes
directions: Combine and mix flour, salt and pepper. Arrange potatoes, onions, flour mixture and 1/2 of cheese in a shallow 2-quart casserole. Combine catsup, Worcestershire, hot pepper sauce and scalded milk. Mix and pour over potatoes. Dot with butter, diced bacon and remaining cheese. Bake, covered, at 375° for 45 minutes. Uncover and continue baking 15 to 20 minutes. Makes 4 to 6 servings.
recipes.text: Baked Barbecue Potatoes. Combine and mix flour, salt and pepper. Arrange potatoes, onions, flour mixture and 1/2 of cheese in a shallow 2-quart casserole. Combine catsup, Worcestershire, hot pepper sauce and scalded milk. Mix and pour over potatoes. Dot with butter, diced bacon and remaining cheese. Bake, covered, at 375° for 45 minutes. Uncover and continue baking 15 to 20 minutes. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

recipes.title: Chili-Burger Supper
directions: Cook macaroni according to directions; drain thoroughly. Brown ground beef in skillet.
Add salt and pepper.
Add drained macaroni, chili-beef soup and tomato soup.
Heat, stirring occasionally, for 5 to 6 minutes, until bubbly.
Cut cheese slices in half diagonally.
Place cheese triangles on the hot mixture. Cover for a few minutes to allow cheese to melt slightly.
recipes.text: Chili-Burger Supper. Cook macaroni according to directions; drain thoroughly. Brown ground beef in skillet. Add salt and pepper. Add drained macaroni, chili-beef soup and tomato soup. Heat, stirring occasionally, for 5 to 6 minutes, until bubbly. Cut cheese slices in half diagonally. Place cheese triangles on the hot mixture. Cover for a few minutes to allow cheese to melt slightly.

recipes.title: English Salad
ingredients: 1 (16 oz.) can white Shoe Peg corn
directions: Drain juice from all vegetables.
In a pan, mix salt, black pepper, sugar, oil, vinegar and water.
Mix and heat mixture, stirring until sugar has dissolved.
Remove from heat; let stand to cool.
After cooling, mix in with vegetables.
Refrigerate at least 24 hours.
Pour marinade juice off.
Ready to serve.
recipes.text: English Salad. Drain juice from all vegetables. In a pan, mix salt, black pepper, sugar, oil, vinegar and water. Mix and heat mixture, stirring until sugar has dissolved. Remove from heat; let stand to cool. After cooling, mix in with vegetables. Refrigerate at least 24 hours. Pour marinade juice off. Ready to serve.

recipes.title: Egg Salad And Bologna Rolls
ingredients: 1/2 c. mayonnaise or cooked salad dressing
directions: Make Egg Salad:
In medium bowl, combine chopped eggs, green pepper, olives, mayonnaise, mustard and salt, mixing well.
recipes.text: Egg Salad And Bologna Rolls. Make Egg Salad: In medium bowl, combine chopped eggs, green pepper, olives, mayonnaise, mustard and salt, mixing well.

recipes.title: Pecan Pie
directions: Mix all ingredients together and pour into pie shell.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes or until done, when knife comes back clean.
recipes.text: Pecan Pie. Mix all ingredients together and pour into pie shell. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes or until done, when knife comes back clean.

recipes.title: Mexi-Corn Casserole
directions: Cook rice according to directions on package.
Mix corn, soup and cheese.
Add rice and oleo.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
Add some grated cheese on top.
recipes.text: Mexi-Corn Casserole. Cook rice according to directions on package. Mix corn, soup and cheese. Add rice and oleo. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes. Add some grated cheese on top.

recipes.title: Mama'S Parmesan Chicken
directions: Bone chicken and season with garlic powder; set aside.
Mix together bread crumbs and Parmesan cheese.
Dip chicken into egg batter; drain slightly.
Place chicken into bread crumbs.
In frying pan, pour moderate amount of Crisco cooking oil; fry chicken lightly, slightly browning both sides.
In casserole dish, bake for 1 hour at 350°.
Cover dish with foil to seal in juices.
recipes.text: Mama'S Parmesan Chicken. Bone chicken and season with garlic powder; set aside. Mix together bread crumbs and Parmesan cheese. Dip chicken into egg batter; drain slightly. Place chicken into bread crumbs. In frying pan, pour moderate amount of Crisco cooking oil; fry chicken lightly, slightly browning both sides. In casserole dish, bake for 1 hour at 350°. Cover dish with foil to seal in juices.

recipes.title: Glorified Cabbage
directions: Cut cabbage in small pieces and boil until very tender in lightly salted water.
Saute onion, celery and garlic in butter. When wilted, add cheese and soup; heat until melted and well blended.
Place cabbage in casserole dish and pour sauce on top. Top with bread crumbs.
Bake at 350 degrees for 20 to 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Glorified Cabbage. Cut cabbage in small pieces and boil until very tender in lightly salted water. Saute onion, celery and garlic in butter. When wilted, add cheese and soup; heat until melted and well blended. Place cabbage in casserole dish and pour sauce on top. Top with bread crumbs. Bake at 350 degrees for 20 to 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Cauliflower Casserole A La Astoria
ingredients: 1 Tbsp. fresh oregano or 1 1/2 tsp. dried
directions: Preheat oven to 350°.
Place the cauliflower flowerets in an 11 x 9-inch baking pan.
Pour on the broth.
Sprinkle the minced tomato, oregano, salt and pepper over the cauliflower.
Add the Feta cheese and toss well. Cover the pan with foil.
Bake for 45 minutes.
Remove the foil and continue baking until the cauliflower is very tender, 30 minutes longer.
Toss the bread crumbs with the olive oil.
Sprinkle the crumbs over the cauliflower.
Bake until the crumbs are golden brown, an additional 30 minutes.
Serve 4.
recipes.text: Cauliflower Casserole A La Astoria. Preheat oven to 350°. Place the cauliflower flowerets in an 11 x 9-inch baking pan. Pour on the broth. Sprinkle the minced tomato, oregano, salt and pepper over the cauliflower. Add the Feta cheese and toss well. Cover the pan with foil. Bake for 45 minutes. Remove the foil and continue baking until the cauliflower is very tender, 30 minutes longer. Toss the bread crumbs with the olive oil. Sprinkle the crumbs over the cauliflower. Bake until the crumbs are golden brown, an additional 30 minutes. Serve 4.

recipes.title: Squash Casserole
directions: Cook sliced squash and onions until tender.
Mix eggs and mayonnaise with drained squash and onions.
Top with shredded cheese and then buttered crumbs.
Bake at 350° in casserole dish.
recipes.text: Squash Casserole. Cook sliced squash and onions until tender. Mix eggs and mayonnaise with drained squash and onions. Top with shredded cheese and then buttered crumbs. Bake at 350° in casserole dish.

recipes.title: Zucchini Cookies
directions: Mix together first five ingredients.
Sift together dry ingredients and mix into shortening mixture.
Drop on greased cookie sheet and bake at 325° for 12 minutes.
recipes.text: Zucchini Cookies. Mix together first five ingredients. Sift together dry ingredients and mix into shortening mixture. Drop on greased cookie sheet and bake at 325° for 12 minutes.

recipes.title: Grandma'S Pumpkin Custard
ingredients: 6 oz. evaporated milk or 6 oz. cream
directions: Blend pumpkin, sugar, salt and spices.
Blend in eggs, milk and cream or evaporated milk.
Bake in a lightly greased 8 x 8-inch pan for approximately 50 minutes.
recipes.text: Grandma'S Pumpkin Custard. Blend pumpkin, sugar, salt and spices. Blend in eggs, milk and cream or evaporated milk. Bake in a lightly greased 8 x 8-inch pan for approximately 50 minutes.

recipes.title: Golden Potato Rolls
directions: Dissolve yeast in water; set aside.
In a saucepan, combine milk, shortening and potatoes; cook and stir over low heat just until shortening is melted.
Remove from heat and place in a large bowl with sugar, salt, 2 cups of flour and the yeast mixture.
Add eggs and mix well.
Cover loosely and allow to stand for 2 hours (the dough will be like a sponge).
Stir in enough of the remaining flour to make a soft dough.
Turn out onto a floured surface and knead until smooth and elastic, about 6 minutes. Place in a greased bowl, turning once to grease top.
Cover and let rise in a warm place until doubled, about (1 hour).
Punch down and divide into thirds.
On a floured surface, roll each portion into a 12-inch circle.
Cut each circle into 12 pie shaped wedges.
Start at the wide end, roll up each wedge.
Place rolls point side down, 2-inches apart on a greased baking sheet.
Cover and let rise 30 minutes or until nearly doubled.
Bake at 400° for 15 minutes or until golden brown.
Yields 3 dozen.
recipes.text: Golden Potato Rolls. Dissolve yeast in water; set aside. In a saucepan, combine milk, shortening and potatoes; cook and stir over low heat just until shortening is melted. Remove from heat and place in a large bowl with sugar, salt, 2 cups of flour and the yeast mixture. Add eggs and mix well. Cover loosely and allow to stand for 2 hours (the dough will be like a sponge). Stir in enough of the remaining flour to make a soft dough. Turn out onto a floured surface and knead until smooth and elastic, about 6 minutes. Place in a greased bowl, turning once to grease top. Cover and let rise in a warm place until doubled, about (1 hour). Punch down and divide into thirds. On a floured surface, roll each portion into a 12-inch circle. Cut each circle into 12 pie shaped wedges. Start at the wide end, roll up each wedge. Place rolls point side down, 2-inches apart on a greased baking sheet. Cover and let rise 30 minutes or until nearly doubled. Bake at 400° for 15 minutes or until golden brown. Yields 3 dozen.

recipes.title: Butterscotch Candy
directions: Melt butter in pan.
Add other ingredients.
Stir until sugar dissolves.
Boil until it tests brittle when dropped in cold water.
Pour onto buttered platter.
Break into pieces when cool. (Can also drop by teaspoonfuls onto waxed paper.)
recipes.text: Butterscotch Candy. Melt butter in pan. Add other ingredients. Stir until sugar dissolves. Boil until it tests brittle when dropped in cold water. Pour onto buttered platter. Break into pieces when cool. (Can also drop by teaspoonfuls onto waxed paper.)

recipes.title: Easy Peanut Butter Cookies
directions: Mix and roll into balls.
Place on a greased cookie sheet. Dip a glass into a bowl of sugar (bottom of glass) and smash cookie. Do each cookie this way, then go back and crisscross them with a fork.
Bake at 350° for about 10 minutes.
recipes.text: Easy Peanut Butter Cookies. Mix and roll into balls. Place on a greased cookie sheet. Dip a glass into a bowl of sugar (bottom of glass) and smash cookie. Do each cookie this way, then go back and crisscross them with a fork. Bake at 350° for about 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Potato Casserole
directions: Melt butter in 9 x 13-inch pan.
Add hash browns.
Mix together soup and sour cream.
Spread on top of potatoes. Sprinkle cheese on top.
Bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours.
recipes.text: Potato Casserole. Melt butter in 9 x 13-inch pan. Add hash browns. Mix together soup and sour cream. Spread on top of potatoes. Sprinkle cheese on top. Bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours.

recipes.title: Spaghetti With Green Pepper And Tomato Sauce
ingredients: 2 large onions, sliced into thin strips
directions: Mix tomatoes, peppers, onions, garlic, oil, salt and pepper in 13 x 9-inch baking pan. Bake at 400° for 30 minutes or until vegetables are very tender. Cook pasta as directed on package; drain. Toss pasta and cheese with hot vegetable sauce. Makes 12 servings.
recipes.text: Spaghetti With Green Pepper And Tomato Sauce. Mix tomatoes, peppers, onions, garlic, oil, salt and pepper in 13 x 9-inch baking pan. Bake at 400° for 30 minutes or until vegetables are very tender. Cook pasta as directed on package; drain. Toss pasta and cheese with hot vegetable sauce. Makes 12 servings.

recipes.title: Spaghetti Pie
ingredients: 1/4 lb. sliced Prosciutto or Virginia ham, cut in strips
1 jar (4 oz.) roasted red peppers, chopped
directions: In microwave-safe 10-inch quiche dish, combine zucchini, onion, garlic and basil.
Cover with plastic wrap; vent.
Cook on High 3 minutes.

Add remaining ingredients, 1/2 teaspoon salt and 1/8 teaspoon pepper; mix well. Evenly spread mixture in dish. Cook, uncovered, on High 6 minutes, rotating dish every 2 minutes and with fork, stirring cooked egg around side of dish with mixture in center.
Cook on Medium 12 minutes or until just set in center.
Let stand on counter 5 minutes before serving.
Makes 8 servings.
recipes.text: Spaghetti Pie. In microwave-safe 10-inch quiche dish, combine zucchini, onion, garlic and basil. Cover with plastic wrap; vent. Cook on High 3 minutes. Add remaining ingredients, 1/2 teaspoon salt and 1/8 teaspoon pepper; mix well. Evenly spread mixture in dish. Cook, uncovered, on High 6 minutes, rotating dish every 2 minutes and with fork, stirring cooked egg around side of dish with mixture in center. Cook on Medium 12 minutes or until just set in center. Let stand on counter 5 minutes before serving. Makes 8 servings.

recipes.title: Raw Veggie Dip
directions: Mix first 6 ingredients well, then fold in sour cream.
Chill.
recipes.text: Raw Veggie Dip. Mix first 6 ingredients well, then fold in sour cream. Chill.

recipes.title: Easy Chicken Dish
ingredients: 1 (8 oz.) can or jar baby onions, drained
directions: Place chicken in baking dish.
Salt lightly, if desired.
Add onions.
Mix soup and sherry; pour over chicken.
Sprinkle cheese on top.
recipes.text: Easy Chicken Dish. Place chicken in baking dish. Salt lightly, if desired. Add onions. Mix soup and sherry; pour over chicken. Sprinkle cheese on top.

recipes.title: Light Pumpkin Pancakes
directions: Mix flour, brown sugar, baking powder, cinnamon, ginger, nutmeg and salt together.
Combine remaining ingredients and add to dry ingredients.
Mix well and drop batter onto lightly greased griddle by 1/4 to 1/3 cupful.
Really good!
recipes.text: Light Pumpkin Pancakes. Mix flour, brown sugar, baking powder, cinnamon, ginger, nutmeg and salt together. Combine remaining ingredients and add to dry ingredients. Mix well and drop batter onto lightly greased griddle by 1/4 to 1/3 cupful. Really good!

recipes.title: Corn Pudding
directions: Mix eggs, sugar and salt; add corn and milk.
Bake in 2 or 2 1/2-quart baking dish at 350° for about 1 hour or until a knife comes out clean when inserted in center of pudding.
recipes.text: Corn Pudding. Mix eggs, sugar and salt; add corn and milk. Bake in 2 or 2 1/2-quart baking dish at 350° for about 1 hour or until a knife comes out clean when inserted in center of pudding.

recipes.title: Short-Cut Chili Sauce
directions: Combine tomatoes, celery, onion, green pepper and salt; let stand overnight.
Drain in colander, but do not press vegetables. Place vegetable mixture in a large kettle and add sugar, brown sugar, pepper, mixed pickling spices (tied in a cheesecloth bag) and vinegar.
Bring to a boil; reduce heat and simmer, uncovered, for 15 minutes.
Seal in jars and boil jars for 10 minutes.
recipes.text: Short-Cut Chili Sauce. Combine tomatoes, celery, onion, green pepper and salt; let stand overnight. Drain in colander, but do not press vegetables. Place vegetable mixture in a large kettle and add sugar, brown sugar, pepper, mixed pickling spices (tied in a cheesecloth bag) and vinegar. Bring to a boil; reduce heat and simmer, uncovered, for 15 minutes. Seal in jars and boil jars for 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Gingerbread
directions: Cream oil and sugar; add eggs and blend in molasses.
Dissolve soda in hot water; add to mixture.
Sift flour, salt and spices; add to creamed mixture.
Add boiling water.
Bake in greased 13 x 9 1/2-inch pan at 350° for 45 to 55 minutes.
recipes.text: Gingerbread. Cream oil and sugar; add eggs and blend in molasses. Dissolve soda in hot water; add to mixture. Sift flour, salt and spices; add to creamed mixture. Add boiling water. Bake in greased 13 x 9 1/2-inch pan at 350° for 45 to 55 minutes.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Cheesecake Bars
ingredients: 1 (16 oz.) pkg. Betty Crocker golden pound cake mix
directions: On low speed, combine cake mix, 1 egg, butter or margarine and 2 teaspoons pumpkin pie spice until crumbly.
Press into bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan with fork.
Beat cheese until fluffy.
Gradually beat in sweetened condensed milk, then 2 eggs, pumpkin, 2 teaspoons pumpkin pie spice and salt.
Mix well.
Pour over crust and sprinkle nuts on top.
Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes or until set.
Cool and chill in refrigerator.
Cut into bars and serve cold, otherwise they are mushy.
ner: betty crocker golden pound cake mix
recipes.text: Pumpkin Cheesecake Bars. On low speed, combine cake mix, 1 egg, butter or margarine and 2 teaspoons pumpkin pie spice until crumbly. Press into bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan with fork. Beat cheese until fluffy. Gradually beat in sweetened condensed milk, then 2 eggs, pumpkin, 2 teaspoons pumpkin pie spice and salt. Mix well. Pour over crust and sprinkle nuts on top. Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes or until set. Cool and chill in refrigerator. Cut into bars and serve cold, otherwise they are mushy.

recipes.title: Chocolate Syrup
directions: Mix all ingredients together.
Bring to a boil and boil for 5 minutes.
Stir good after it has stopped boiling and pour over ice cream.
recipes.text: Chocolate Syrup. Mix all ingredients together. Bring to a boil and boil for 5 minutes. Stir good after it has stopped boiling and pour over ice cream.

recipes.title: Mulligan Casserole
ingredients: 2 (10 oz.) cans condensed chicken rice soup
directions: Brown ground beef; add onion and cook until tender.
Place sliced potatoes in casserole dish.
Add all other ingredients. Bake covered in 350° oven until potatoes are tender, approximately 1 hour.
recipes.text: Mulligan Casserole. Brown ground beef; add onion and cook until tender. Place sliced potatoes in casserole dish. Add all other ingredients. Bake covered in 350° oven until potatoes are tender, approximately 1 hour.

recipes.title: Crisp Onion Roasted Potatoes
ingredients: 2 lb. all-purpose potatoes, cut into quarters
directions: Preheat oven to 450°.
Place in roasting pan.
Pour ingredients over potatoes.
Bake 60 minutes.
Garnish with parsley, if desired. Makes 8 servings.
recipes.text: Crisp Onion Roasted Potatoes. Preheat oven to 450°. Place in roasting pan. Pour ingredients over potatoes. Bake 60 minutes. Garnish with parsley, if desired. Makes 8 servings.

recipes.title: Gingerbread
directions: Mix together dry ingredients.
Add milk and eggs.
Mix thoroughly.
Stir in molasses and shortening. Pour into 8 x 8-inch shallow pan.
Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes.
recipes.text: Gingerbread. Mix together dry ingredients. Add milk and eggs. Mix thoroughly. Stir in molasses and shortening. Pour into 8 x 8-inch shallow pan. Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Apple Dip
directions: Put all ingredients in a bowl and blend with blender.
Slice apples and sprinkle with orange or lemon juice.
Dip the apples and enjoy.
recipes.text: Apple Dip. Put all ingredients in a bowl and blend with blender. Slice apples and sprinkle with orange or lemon juice. Dip the apples and enjoy.

recipes.title: Creamy Chicken Salad
directions: In a medium-size bowl, combine chicken, zucchini, spinach, carrots and walnuts; toss.
recipes.text: Creamy Chicken Salad. In a medium-size bowl, combine chicken, zucchini, spinach, carrots and walnuts; toss.

recipes.title: Glorified Gingerbread Cake
directions: Mix together flour, white sugar and soft oleo; take out 3/4 cup for crumb top.
Then to the rest add egg, vanilla, sour milk, soda, cinnamon and flour.
Put in greased and floured pan.
Put on crumb top and bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Glorified Gingerbread Cake. Mix together flour, white sugar and soft oleo; take out 3/4 cup for crumb top. Then to the rest add egg, vanilla, sour milk, soda, cinnamon and flour. Put in greased and floured pan. Put on crumb top and bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Baked Chicken Breasts
ingredients: 3 chicken breasts, halved and skin removed (6 pieces)
2 cans Campbell's cream of mushroom soup
directions: Mix soup and sour cream together.

Pour a layer of the sauce in the bottom of baking dish. Season breasts to taste and lay on top of sauce. Cover with remaining sauce. Bake 1 hour at 350°. Put breasts on serving platter and use sauce over rice, noodles or potatoes.
recipes.text: Baked Chicken Breasts. Mix soup and sour cream together. Pour a layer of the sauce in the bottom of baking dish. Season breasts to taste and lay on top of sauce. Cover with remaining sauce. Bake 1 hour at 350°. Put breasts on serving platter and use sauce over rice, noodles or potatoes.

recipes.title: Brownies
directions: Cream oleo and sugar together.
Add eggs one at a time.
Mix in remaining ingredients and bake in sheet cake pan, greased, at 350° for 30 minutes or until center is firm.
Cut in squares.
recipes.text: Brownies. Cream oleo and sugar together. Add eggs one at a time. Mix in remaining ingredients and bake in sheet cake pan, greased, at 350° for 30 minutes or until center is firm. Cut in squares.

recipes.title: 4 Bean Bake
ingredients: 1 can each green beans, lima beans, kidney beans and butter beans, drained
directions: Mix all ingredients into crock-pot.
Cook on slow for 4 hours or in 350° oven for 1 hour.
recipes.text: 4 Bean Bake. Mix all ingredients into crock-pot. Cook on slow for 4 hours or in 350° oven for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Chocolate Chip Pistachio Cake
directions: Mix all ingredients together.
Bake in greased and floured tube or Bundt pan for 50 to 60 minutes at 350°.
recipes.text: Chocolate Chip Pistachio Cake. Mix all ingredients together. Bake in greased and floured tube or Bundt pan for 50 to 60 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Baked Custard
directions: Beat eggs slightly; add sugar and salt.
Scald milk until crinkly film forms on top.
Stir in egg mixture gradually.
Add vanilla.
Pour into custard cups or baking dish; set in pan of hot water.
Sprinkle nutmeg on top.
Bake at 350° for 45 to 50 minutes until knife inserted comes out clean.
Remove from pan of water. Serve cool or chilled.
Serves 6.
recipes.text: Baked Custard. Beat eggs slightly; add sugar and salt. Scald milk until crinkly film forms on top. Stir in egg mixture gradually. Add vanilla. Pour into custard cups or baking dish; set in pan of hot water. Sprinkle nutmeg on top. Bake at 350° for 45 to 50 minutes until knife inserted comes out clean. Remove from pan of water. Serve cool or chilled. Serves 6.

recipes.title: Chocolate Peanut Butter Candy
directions: Mix together and press in buttered pan.
Melt 3 Hershey candy bars and pour over top.
Chill several hours and serve.
recipes.text: Chocolate Peanut Butter Candy. Mix together and press in buttered pan. Melt 3 Hershey candy bars and pour over top. Chill several hours and serve.

recipes.title: Zesty Butter Sticks
ingredients: 1/2 loaf French or Italian bread (approximately 10 x 14-inch)
directions: Preheat oven to 425°.
Cut bread in half lengthwise.
Then cut each piece lengthwise to make 3 wedges (total of 6 wedges).
In small bowl, combine remaining ingredients; blend well.
Spread butter on cut surfaces of bread wedges.
Bake on ungreased 15 x 10-inch baking sheet near center of 425° oven for 7 to 9 minutes or until golden brown.
Serve warm.
Yield: 6 (10-inch) sticks.
recipes.text: Zesty Butter Sticks. Preheat oven to 425°. Cut bread in half lengthwise. Then cut each piece lengthwise to make 3 wedges (total of 6 wedges). In small bowl, combine remaining ingredients; blend well. Spread butter on cut surfaces of bread wedges. Bake on ungreased 15 x 10-inch baking sheet near center of 425° oven for 7 to 9 minutes or until golden brown. Serve warm. Yield: 6 (10-inch) sticks.

recipes.title: Apple Bread
directions: Heat oven to 350°.
Grease loaf pan.
Cream together shortening, sugar and vanilla until fluffy.
Blend in remaining ingredients, except cinnamon and 1 1/2 teaspoons sugar.
Pour into prepared pan and sprinkle with cinnamon and sugar.
Bake 50 minutes.
After cooling, the bread may be wrapped and frozen.
recipes.text: Apple Bread. Heat oven to 350°. Grease loaf pan. Cream together shortening, sugar and vanilla until fluffy. Blend in remaining ingredients, except cinnamon and 1 1/2 teaspoons sugar. Pour into prepared pan and sprinkle with cinnamon and sugar. Bake 50 minutes. After cooling, the bread may be wrapped and frozen.

recipes.title: Fat-Free Crab Salad
