directions: Let imitation crab thaw out if frozen.
Chop into bite-size pieces.
Drain can of crab and add to chopped crab.
Mix into crab the celery and fat-free mayonnaise and salt and pepper. Serve with saltines.
recipes.text: Fat-Free Crab Salad. Let imitation crab thaw out if frozen. Chop into bite-size pieces. Drain can of crab and add to chopped crab. Mix into crab the celery and fat-free mayonnaise and salt and pepper. Serve with saltines.

recipes.title: Jello Salad
directions: Dissolve Jell-O in boiling water.
Add frozen strawberries. (Let them thaw in Jell-O mixture.)
Add pineapple, banana and nuts.
Chill.
recipes.text: Jello Salad. Dissolve Jell-O in boiling water. Add frozen strawberries. (Let them thaw in Jell-O mixture.) Add pineapple, banana and nuts. Chill.

recipes.title: Shanghai Noodles With Spicy Beef Sauce
ingredients: 1/4 c. dry sherry or beef broth
16 oz. vermicelli noodles, cooked and drained
directions: Heat skillet.
Add
the
oil,
garlic,	ginger root and pepper flakes.
Saute
seconds.
Add onions; stir-fry until onions are transparent.
Crumble in lean ground beef; stir-fry until meat is light brown.
recipes.text: Shanghai Noodles With Spicy Beef Sauce. Heat skillet. Add the oil, garlic,	ginger root and pepper flakes. Saute 5 seconds. Add onions; stir-fry until onions are transparent. Crumble in lean ground beef; stir-fry until meat is light brown.

recipes.title: Puppy Chow
directions: Melt last 3 ingredients.
Pour over Rice Chex.
Shake in a brown bag which has powdered sugar.
Cool for 30 minutes in fridge.
recipes.text: Puppy Chow. Melt last 3 ingredients. Pour over Rice Chex. Shake in a brown bag which has powdered sugar. Cool for 30 minutes in fridge.

recipes.title: Raisin Pie
directions: Mix together in pan.
Cook this mixture until it thickens and looks clear, doesn't take long.
If you cook this too long, it will taste strong.
Pour into unbaked pie shell.
Bake until brown.
recipes.text: Raisin Pie. Mix together in pan. Cook this mixture until it thickens and looks clear, doesn't take long. If you cook this too long, it will taste strong. Pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake until brown.

recipes.title: Melting Moments
directions: Mix flour, cornstarch and sugar in a bowl.
Blend in butter until a soft dough is formed.
If dough is too soft to handle, cover and chill.
recipes.text: Melting Moments. Mix flour, cornstarch and sugar in a bowl. Blend in butter until a soft dough is formed. If dough is too soft to handle, cover and chill.

recipes.title: Spirited Watermelon Slush
ingredients: 1 (6 oz.) can frozen fruit punch concentrate, thawed
directions: Place watermelon cubes in blender container or food processor bowl with metal blade and process until smooth.
In large nonmetal container, combine watermelon puree, fruit punch concentrate, water and vodka.
Cover and freeze 8 hours or overnight.
recipes.text: Spirited Watermelon Slush. Place watermelon cubes in blender container or food processor bowl with metal blade and process until smooth. In large nonmetal container, combine watermelon puree, fruit punch concentrate, water and vodka. Cover and freeze 8 hours or overnight.

recipes.title: Five Bean Salad
ingredients: 1 can bean sprouts or French-style green beans
directions: Mix all ingredients and refrigerate.
recipes.text: Five Bean Salad. Mix all ingredients and refrigerate.

recipes.title: Cauliflower Salad
directions: Cut cauliflower in bite size pieces; slice radishes and chop onions.
Combine all vegetables and add dressing.
recipes.text: Cauliflower Salad. Cut cauliflower in bite size pieces; slice radishes and chop onions. Combine all vegetables and add dressing.

recipes.title: Onion Dip
ingredients: 2 pkg. George Washington seasoning and broth mix
3 to 4 Tbsp. milk (add to make desired consistency)
directions: Mix ingredients on high speed mixer until completely blended. Chill before serving.
recipes.text: Onion Dip. Mix ingredients on high speed mixer until completely blended. Chill before serving.

recipes.title: Cucumbers And Onions
directions: Depending on the size of bowl or amount you want to make is how you go by the number of cucumbers and onions you want to use. Also the size of each would be taken into consideration.
You slice the cucumbers and onions in your container and use enough sour cream to form a consistency to hold them together.
Salt and pepper to season.
After it sets a while, juice will form from the cucumbers.
It can be stirred in or if it might make it too juicy, spoon some of the juice off if it comes to the top.
recipes.text: Cucumbers And Onions. Depending on the size of bowl or amount you want to make is how you go by the number of cucumbers and onions you want to use. Also the size of each would be taken into consideration. You slice the cucumbers and onions in your container and use enough sour cream to form a consistency to hold them together. Salt and pepper to season. After it sets a while, juice will form from the cucumbers. It can be stirred in or if it might make it too juicy, spoon some of the juice off if it comes to the top.

recipes.title: Apple And Wilted Lettuce Salad
ingredients: 6 c. romaine lettuce, wash and tear
4 c. leaf lettuce, wash and tear
1 (6 oz.) Good Seasons Italian salad dressing mix
directions: Core and thinly slice apples.
Place lettuce, apples and celery in bowl.
Cook bacon until crisp; drain and crumble. Reserve drippings from bacon and add vinegar, water, sugar and dressing mix.
Heat to boiling and pour over salad.
Sprinkle with bacon, scallions and pepper.
Toss gently.
Serve immediately.
recipes.text: Apple And Wilted Lettuce Salad. Core and thinly slice apples. Place lettuce, apples and celery in bowl. Cook bacon until crisp; drain and crumble. Reserve drippings from bacon and add vinegar, water, sugar and dressing mix. Heat to boiling and pour over salad. Sprinkle with bacon, scallions and pepper. Toss gently. Serve immediately.

recipes.title: Sweet Posies
directions: Melt butter in a small bowl.
Mix sugar and cinnamon in another small bowl.
Dip each biscuit into butter and then in sugar mixture.
Place biscuits, 1 inch apart, on a greased baking sheet. Place point of kitchen shears in middle of roll.
Clip through the roll from outside to center to make 7 petals, but don't separate petals.
Bake at 375° for 10 to 12 minutes.
Place teaspoonful of jam or pie filling in center of each roll after baking.
Vanilla glaze may be added; sprinkle with pecans.
Makes 10.
recipes.text: Sweet Posies. Melt butter in a small bowl. Mix sugar and cinnamon in another small bowl. Dip each biscuit into butter and then in sugar mixture. Place biscuits, 1 inch apart, on a greased baking sheet. Place point of kitchen shears in middle of roll. Clip through the roll from outside to center to make 7 petals, but don't separate petals. Bake at 375° for 10 to 12 minutes. Place teaspoonful of jam or pie filling in center of each roll after baking. Vanilla glaze may be added; sprinkle with pecans. Makes 10.

recipes.title: Chocolate Mints
directions: Melt chocolate chips in a double boiler or microwave.
Stir to see that all are melted.
Remove from heat and let cool completely, but not harden.
Beat together:
sugar, butter and eggs until fluffy.
Do not underbeat.
Add vanilla, peppermint and melted chocolate.
Beat well.
recipes.text: Chocolate Mints. Melt chocolate chips in a double boiler or microwave. Stir to see that all are melted. Remove from heat and let cool completely, but not harden. Beat together: sugar, butter and eggs until fluffy. Do not underbeat. Add vanilla, peppermint and melted chocolate. Beat well.

recipes.title: Chili Wraps
ingredients: 1/8 tsp. each black, white and red pepper
few dashes of hot pepper sauce
directions: Saute onion in oil in large skillet.
Add beef. Cook until beef is brown or until done.
Season with peppers, hot sauce, chili powder, oregano, ketchup and garlic powder.
Place 1/8 of mixture in center of tortilla.
Sprinkle with cheese.
Fold over top and bottom edges.
Fold one side over filling, then other side.
Heat oil in skillet 1/2-inch high.
Fry tortillas folded-side down first.
Turn.
Brown other side.
Drain and serve.
Good served with rice.
recipes.text: Chili Wraps. Saute onion in oil in large skillet. Add beef. Cook until beef is brown or until done. Season with peppers, hot sauce, chili powder, oregano, ketchup and garlic powder. Place 1/8 of mixture in center of tortilla. Sprinkle with cheese. Fold over top and bottom edges. Fold one side over filling, then other side. Heat oil in skillet 1/2-inch high. Fry tortillas folded-side down first. Turn. Brown other side. Drain and serve. Good served with rice.

recipes.title: Pinon De Amarillos
ingredients: 8 oz. Cheddar cheese, finely cut or grated
directions: Stir-fry garlic in oil.
Add peppers, onion, coriander, cilantro, tomato sauce and sazon.
Add meat and season well; cook 30 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Fry plantains, cut in pieces. Grease an 8 x 12 x 2-inch pan and place plantains in bottom.
Add meat mixture, spread evenly and press down.
Add grated cheese, then green beans.
Make another layer of plantains.
Beat egg whites; add yolks to sugar.
Cover the dish with this meringue. Bake at 325° for 15 minutes.
To brown, place under broiler for 5 minutes.
Cut and eat.
Makes about 10 portions.
recipes.text: Pinon De Amarillos. Stir-fry garlic in oil. Add peppers, onion, coriander, cilantro, tomato sauce and sazon. Add meat and season well; cook 30 minutes, stirring occasionally. Fry plantains, cut in pieces. Grease an 8 x 12 x 2-inch pan and place plantains in bottom. Add meat mixture, spread evenly and press down. Add grated cheese, then green beans. Make another layer of plantains. Beat egg whites; add yolks to sugar. Cover the dish with this meringue. Bake at 325° for 15 minutes. To brown, place under broiler for 5 minutes. Cut and eat. Makes about 10 portions.

recipes.title: Sui Mai
directions: Mix ingredients for the filling.
Place 1 1/2 teaspoons on the center of each won ton skin. Gather upward and pinch lightly where all edges meet over the filling, leaving the top of the Sui Mai open and the edges to ruffle freely.
Steam for 20 minutes.
Serve hot.
recipes.text: Sui Mai. Mix ingredients for the filling. Place 1 1/2 teaspoons on the center of each won ton skin. Gather upward and pinch lightly where all edges meet over the filling, leaving the top of the Sui Mai open and the edges to ruffle freely. Steam for 20 minutes. Serve hot.

recipes.title: Cranberry Bread
directions: Cut margarine into flour; add remaining dry ingredients and orange rind.
Mix well.
Add water to juice to make 3/4 cup liquid.
Mix with egg; fold into dry ingredients.
Add cranberries and nuts.
Bake in greased pans, 60 to 70 minutes, at 350°.
recipes.text: Cranberry Bread. Cut margarine into flour; add remaining dry ingredients and orange rind. Mix well. Add water to juice to make 3/4 cup liquid. Mix with egg; fold into dry ingredients. Add cranberries and nuts. Bake in greased pans, 60 to 70 minutes, at 350°.

recipes.title: Squash Surprise
ingredients: 2 acorn squash, cut into bite size pieces
directions: Cook until tender the squash; drain and then add sugar, brown sugar and cinnamon.
Mix well and place in baking dish.
Stir-fry slices of 2 apples in margarine, sugar and water. When tender, add pineapple and raisins.
Spoon into squash and top with brown sugar, flour, melted margarine and pecans; bake until slightly brown and serve.
recipes.text: Squash Surprise. Cook until tender the squash; drain and then add sugar, brown sugar and cinnamon. Mix well and place in baking dish. Stir-fry slices of 2 apples in margarine, sugar and water. When tender, add pineapple and raisins. Spoon into squash and top with brown sugar, flour, melted margarine and pecans; bake until slightly brown and serve.

recipes.title: Pork Chop Onion Rice Bake
directions: Preheat oven to 350°.
Brown chops in fat.
Spread rice in bottom of rectangular baking dish.
Reserve 1 tablespoon of onion soup mixture and sprinkle the rest over rice.
Drain mushrooms and save liquid.
Sprinkle mushrooms and pimiento over rice.
Add hot water to mushroom liquid to total 3 cups and pour over rice. Arrange chops on top of rice and sprinkle rest of onion soup over them.
Cover tightly with foil and bake in 350° oven until tender, 45 minutes to 1 hour.
Remove foil and continue cooking 10 minutes longer or until liquid evaporates.
recipes.text: Pork Chop Onion Rice Bake. Preheat oven to 350°. Brown chops in fat. Spread rice in bottom of rectangular baking dish. Reserve 1 tablespoon of onion soup mixture and sprinkle the rest over rice. Drain mushrooms and save liquid. Sprinkle mushrooms and pimiento over rice. Add hot water to mushroom liquid to total 3 cups and pour over rice. Arrange chops on top of rice and sprinkle rest of onion soup over them. Cover tightly with foil and bake in 350° oven until tender, 45 minutes to 1 hour. Remove foil and continue cooking 10 minutes longer or until liquid evaporates.

recipes.title: Four Cheese Macaroni
directions: In a large pot of boiling water, cook pasta for 8 to 10 minutes, until tender.
Drain and return to pot.
Add milk, cheeses and white pepper.
Cook over low heat, stirring constantly, about 5 minutes or until the cheeses are melted.
recipes.text: Four Cheese Macaroni. In a large pot of boiling water, cook pasta for 8 to 10 minutes, until tender. Drain and return to pot. Add milk, cheeses and white pepper. Cook over low heat, stirring constantly, about 5 minutes or until the cheeses are melted.

recipes.title: Chicken-Potato Balls
directions: Mix together chicken, potatoes, milk, 1/3 cup of crumbs, 1/4 cup margarine, onion salt, pepper and rosemary.
Roll mixture by teaspoonfuls into balls.
Dip balls in remaining margarine.
Coat with remaining bread crumbs.
Place balls on baking sheet.
Bake in preheated 350° oven for 15 minutes or until hot.
recipes.text: Chicken-Potato Balls. Mix together chicken, potatoes, milk, 1/3 cup of crumbs, 1/4 cup margarine, onion salt, pepper and rosemary. Roll mixture by teaspoonfuls into balls. Dip balls in remaining margarine. Coat with remaining bread crumbs. Place balls on baking sheet. Bake in preheated 350° oven for 15 minutes or until hot.

recipes.title: Banana Surprise Cake
directions: Mix eggs, sugar, oil and then add rest of ingredients.
Put nuts and raisins last.
Bake in 350° oven for 30 minutes or until center is done.
recipes.text: Banana Surprise Cake. Mix eggs, sugar, oil and then add rest of ingredients. Put nuts and raisins last. Bake in 350° oven for 30 minutes or until center is done.

recipes.title: Modern Marble Cake
ingredients: 1 oz. sq. chocolate or 3 Tbsp. cocoa plus 1 Tbsp. oil equals 1 sq. (1 oz.) baking chocolate
directions: Sift flour, baking powder and salt together.
Cream shortening with sugar until fluffy.
Beat eggs thoroughly and add sifted dry ingredients and milk alternately, beating well.
Add vanilla. Divide batter into halves.
Melt chocolate and add with 2 tablespoons milk to one half; blend well.
Drop batter by tablespoons into greased pan, alternating white and chocolate. Bake at 350° for 50 to 60 minutes.
The fun of baking a marble cake is to see what designs come through.
recipes.text: Modern Marble Cake. Sift flour, baking powder and salt together. Cream shortening with sugar until fluffy. Beat eggs thoroughly and add sifted dry ingredients and milk alternately, beating well. Add vanilla. Divide batter into halves. Melt chocolate and add with 2 tablespoons milk to one half; blend well. Drop batter by tablespoons into greased pan, alternating white and chocolate. Bake at 350° for 50 to 60 minutes. The fun of baking a marble cake is to see what designs come through.

recipes.title: Fruit Pizza
ingredients: selection of favorite fruits (fresh or canned)
directions: Prepare cookie dough as directed and spread on a pizza pan. Bake as directed.
Cream sugar, vanilla and cheese together. Spread on top of cooled cookie.
Garnish with selected fruits.
recipes.text: Fruit Pizza. Prepare cookie dough as directed and spread on a pizza pan. Bake as directed. Cream sugar, vanilla and cheese together. Spread on top of cooled cookie. Garnish with selected fruits.

recipes.title: Simon And Garfunkel Chicken
ingredients: 4 whole chicken breasts, split or 8 breast halves, skinned and boned
1/4 tsp. each: sage, rosemary and thyme
directions: Turn the chicken breasts, smooth side down and sprinkle with salt and pepper.
Dot each breast with 1 teaspoon margarine.
Lay a slice of Mozzarella cheese on top of each chicken piece.
Roll up jelly roll fashion, long edge to long edge.
Secure well with wooden toothpicks.
Melt the remaining margarine; add parsley, sage, rosemary and thyme.
Roll the chicken rolls in the flour, then in egg, then in crumbs.
Place in baking dish.
Pour melted margarine and spices over chicken.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Simon And Garfunkel Chicken. Turn the chicken breasts, smooth side down and sprinkle with salt and pepper. Dot each breast with 1 teaspoon margarine. Lay a slice of Mozzarella cheese on top of each chicken piece. Roll up jelly roll fashion, long edge to long edge. Secure well with wooden toothpicks. Melt the remaining margarine; add parsley, sage, rosemary and thyme. Roll the chicken rolls in the flour, then in egg, then in crumbs. Place in baking dish. Pour melted margarine and spices over chicken. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Rice And Broccoli Casserole
ingredients: 1 stick margarine, cut up in chunks
8 oz. Velveeta, melted or 8 oz. Cheez Whiz
directions: Thaw and cook the broccoli.
Drain.
Cook the rice as directed.
Combine the drained broccoli and rice. Mix in the soup. Add the margarine and Velveeta.
Put all of the mixture in a 13 x 9-inch baking dish. Bake 45 minutes at 350°.
Great to go with chicken dishes!
recipes.text: Rice And Broccoli Casserole. Thaw and cook the broccoli. Drain. Cook the rice as directed. Combine the drained broccoli and rice. Mix in the soup. Add the margarine and Velveeta. Put all of the mixture in a 13 x 9-inch baking dish. Bake 45 minutes at 350°. Great to go with chicken dishes!

recipes.title: Pineapple Zucchini Cake
directions: Beat eggs, sugar, vanilla and oil until fluffy.
Add zucchini, flour, soda and baking powder until well mixed.
Put in greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan.
Bake at 325° for 50 to 55 minutes, until toothpick inserted comes out clean.
Makes 12 servings.
recipes.text: Pineapple Zucchini Cake. Beat eggs, sugar, vanilla and oil until fluffy. Add zucchini, flour, soda and baking powder until well mixed. Put in greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 325° for 50 to 55 minutes, until toothpick inserted comes out clean. Makes 12 servings.

recipes.title: Fresh Corn Pudding
directions: Scald milk.
Beat eggs slightly and add all ingredients together.
Bake 1 hour in water at 350°.
Pour corn mixture into one casserole and place that casserole in a pan of hot water; place in the oven and bake.
recipes.text: Fresh Corn Pudding. Scald milk. Beat eggs slightly and add all ingredients together. Bake 1 hour in water at 350°. Pour corn mixture into one casserole and place that casserole in a pan of hot water; place in the oven and bake.

recipes.title: Party Mix
directions: Mix all ingredients but pretzels and nuts.
Add these at 15-minute intervals.
Bake at 250° for 1 hour.
Stir every 15 or 20 minutes.
recipes.text: Party Mix. Mix all ingredients but pretzels and nuts. Add these at 15-minute intervals. Bake at 250° for 1 hour. Stir every 15 or 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Harvard Beets
directions: Combine sugar, cornstarch, salt and pepper.
Add beet juice; cook until thickened.
Add the orange juice.
Add beets.
recipes.text: Harvard Beets. Combine sugar, cornstarch, salt and pepper. Add beet juice; cook until thickened. Add the orange juice. Add beets.

recipes.title: Taco Salad
directions: Prepare ground beef with seasonings, as on the package.
Shred lettuce, dice tomato.
Mix all ingredients together.
Add chips in last.
recipes.text: Taco Salad. Prepare ground beef with seasonings, as on the package. Shred lettuce, dice tomato. Mix all ingredients together. Add chips in last.

recipes.title: Chocolate Cupcakes
directions: Heat oven to 350°.
Mix dry ingredients.
Mix egg, shortening, buttermilk and vanilla; add to dry ingredients.
Beat on low speed for 1 minute, then on high speed for 3 minutes.
Fill muffin cups 3/4 full.
(Muffin tins lined with cupcake papers work the best.) Bake approximately 15 minutes or until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean.
Top with Chocolate Frosting.
recipes.text: Chocolate Cupcakes. Heat oven to 350°. Mix dry ingredients. Mix egg, shortening, buttermilk and vanilla; add to dry ingredients. Beat on low speed for 1 minute, then on high speed for 3 minutes. Fill muffin cups 3/4 full. (Muffin tins lined with cupcake papers work the best.) Bake approximately 15 minutes or until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean. Top with Chocolate Frosting.

recipes.title: Mexican Stew
ingredients: 1 can Ro-Tel chopped tomatoes and chillies
directions: Brown hamburger meat and onion.
Drain.
Add all remaining ingredients except Hamburger Helper.
Simmer 20 minutes.
Add macaroni and sauce mix from Hamburger Helper.
Simmer 15 minutes. This is juicy when served first, but macaroni absorbs juice after standing.
recipes.text: Mexican Stew. Brown hamburger meat and onion. Drain. Add all remaining ingredients except Hamburger Helper. Simmer 20 minutes. Add macaroni and sauce mix from Hamburger Helper. Simmer 15 minutes. This is juicy when served first, but macaroni absorbs juice after standing.

recipes.title: Punch
ingredients: 1 large (64 oz.) can bottle cran-raspberry juice
directions: Mix together and refrigerate.
Add 1 teaspoon vanilla ice cream to each cup.
Serves 35 to 40.
recipes.text: Punch. Mix together and refrigerate. Add 1 teaspoon vanilla ice cream to each cup. Serves 35 to 40.

recipes.title: Layered Taco Bean Dip
ingredients: 2 mashed avocados mixed with 1 Tbsp. sour cream
8 oz. fat-free sour cream mixed with 1/2 pkg. taco seasoning
directions: Place in 9 x 13-inch pan in order given.
Serve with chips.
recipes.text: Layered Taco Bean Dip. Place in 9 x 13-inch pan in order given. Serve with chips.

recipes.title: Chili Bean Soup
ingredients: 2 c. small red beans (pinto beans are good)
1 large and 1 small can tomato sauce
Louisiana hot sauce or ground cayenne pepper (if you like)
directions: Brown ground beef over medium heat
in large saucepan. Add salt, onions, parsley, and garlic,

stirring until onions are tender. Add beef broth, beans, tomato sauce, chili powder, salt, and hot sauce. Stir well, bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to low. Cover and simmer for at least 2 hours. Stir often to keep from sticking.
recipes.text: Chili Bean Soup. Brown ground beef over medium heat in large saucepan. Add salt, onions, parsley, and garlic, stirring until onions are tender. Add beef broth, beans, tomato sauce, chili powder, salt, and hot sauce. Stir well, bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to low. Cover and simmer for at least 2 hours. Stir often to keep from sticking.

recipes.title: Spanish Beef
directions: Brown hamburger, onion and green pepper.
Cook noodles according to directions on package.
Drain and mix all ingredients. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Spanish Beef. Brown hamburger, onion and green pepper. Cook noodles according to directions on package. Drain and mix all ingredients. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Easy Pasta Salad
ingredients: 4 oz. spiral pasta, cooked, drained and cooled
2 cups salad bar vegetables (such as broccoli florets, cherry tomatoes, olives, mushrooms, carrots, cucumbers and green onions)
1 cup (about 4 oz.) julienned cooked turkey from the deli
directions: In a large bowl combine pasta, vegetables and turkey.
In food processor or blender puree remaining ingredients; pour over pasta mixture.
Toss to coat thoroughly.
Serves 4.
recipes.text: Easy Pasta Salad. In a large bowl combine pasta, vegetables and turkey. In food processor or blender puree remaining ingredients; pour over pasta mixture. Toss to coat thoroughly. Serves 4.

recipes.title: Broccoli Salad
directions: Put broccoli, raisins, chopped onion and bacon in bowl.
Mix mayonnaise, vinegar and sugar and add to ingredients and mix well. Chill 2 hours.
recipes.text: Broccoli Salad. Put broccoli, raisins, chopped onion and bacon in bowl. Mix mayonnaise, vinegar and sugar and add to ingredients and mix well. Chill 2 hours.

recipes.title: Chocolate Layer Dessert
directions: Mix all ingredients and spread in a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
Let cool.
recipes.text: Chocolate Layer Dessert. Mix all ingredients and spread in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes. Let cool.

recipes.title: May Bean Darby'S Devil'S Food Cake
directions: Mix butter and sugar.
Add eggs.
Sift flour, soda, baking powder and chocolate together.
Add to sugar, butter and eggs alternately with buttermilk.
Bake in layers until done in 350° oven for 25 to 30 minutes.
recipes.text: May Bean Darby'S Devil'S Food Cake. Mix butter and sugar. Add eggs. Sift flour, soda, baking powder and chocolate together. Add to sugar, butter and eggs alternately with buttermilk. Bake in layers until done in 350° oven for 25 to 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Sweet 'N Sour Rice
ingredients: 2 Tbsp. melted margarine or bacon drippings
1 small can pineapple chunks or equivalent fresh pineapple
directions: Prepare 3 cups rice according to package directions (approximately 6 cups cooked).
recipes.text: Sweet 'N Sour Rice. Prepare 3 cups rice according to package directions (approximately 6 cups cooked).

recipes.title: Broccoli Casserole
ingredients: 1 large frozen broccoli or 1 bunch fresh broccoli
directions: Steam broccoli and place in baking dish.
Blend soup, cheese, milk, mayonnaise and egg.
Pour over broccoli.
Combine bread crumbs with butter.
Sprinkle over mixture.
Bake at 350° until it bubbles.
recipes.text: Broccoli Casserole. Steam broccoli and place in baking dish. Blend soup, cheese, milk, mayonnaise and egg. Pour over broccoli. Combine bread crumbs with butter. Sprinkle over mixture. Bake at 350° until it bubbles.

recipes.title: Orange Fruit Salad
directions: Drain cans of fruit (saving juice and set aside) for 2 hours. Mix all ingredients except for fruit.
Peel and cut apples and bananas; let sit in reserved juice for several minutes.
Remove from juice with slotted spoon and add to mixture along with drained fruit.
Chill and serve.
recipes.text: Orange Fruit Salad. Drain cans of fruit (saving juice and set aside) for 2 hours. Mix all ingredients except for fruit. Peel and cut apples and bananas; let sit in reserved juice for several minutes. Remove from juice with slotted spoon and add to mixture along with drained fruit. Chill and serve.

recipes.title: Grated Apple Pie
ingredients: 3 medium-size Granny Smith or Winesap apples, peeled and coarsely grated
1 1/3 c. sugar (half of it light brown)
1 Pillsbury all ready pie crust for 9 or 10-inch plate
directions: Preheat oven to 400°.
Combine sugar, cinnamon, nutmeg and salt in a large bowl.
Add apples and toss gently.
Stir in beaten egg and margarine.
Pour mixture into pastry shell.
(For firmer crust, brush first with egg white.)
If desired, may sprinkle with chopped pecans.
Bake for 10 minutes.
Reduce heat to 350° and bake for 50 minutes or until it quits shaking.
Check after 1 hour.
recipes.text: Grated Apple Pie. Preheat oven to 400°. Combine sugar, cinnamon, nutmeg and salt in a large bowl. Add apples and toss gently. Stir in beaten egg and margarine. Pour mixture into pastry shell. (For firmer crust, brush first with egg white.) If desired, may sprinkle with chopped pecans. Bake for 10 minutes. Reduce heat to 350° and bake for 50 minutes or until it quits shaking. Check after 1 hour.

recipes.title: Hamburger Steak Soup
directions: Make white sauce with first three ingredients.
Add salt and pepper to taste.
Set aside.
Brown hamburger meat.
Drain off excess fat.
Add remaining ingredients.
Simmer 1 1/2 hours, stirring occasionally.
recipes.text: Hamburger Steak Soup. Make white sauce with first three ingredients. Add salt and pepper to taste. Set aside. Brown hamburger meat. Drain off excess fat. Add remaining ingredients. Simmer 1 1/2 hours, stirring occasionally.

recipes.title: Skewered Sausages
directions: Cook over grill, brushing often with sweet and sour sauces.
recipes.text: Skewered Sausages. Cook over grill, brushing often with sweet and sour sauces.

recipes.title: Baked Pineapple
directions: Melt butter in casserole.
Add cubed bread and mix well.
Beat eggs until light.
Add flour, sugar, salt and pineapple to eggs. Mix.
Pour into casserole and mix with butter and bread.
Bake at 350° for 50 minutes or until like custard or when knife inserted in middle comes out clean.
Serves 8.
recipes.text: Baked Pineapple. Melt butter in casserole. Add cubed bread and mix well. Beat eggs until light. Add flour, sugar, salt and pineapple to eggs. Mix. Pour into casserole and mix with butter and bread. Bake at 350° for 50 minutes or until like custard or when knife inserted in middle comes out clean. Serves 8.

recipes.title: Basic Meat Loaf
ingredients: 1/3 c. dry bread or cracker crumbs
directions: Heat oven to 350°.
In large bowl, combine all ingredients; mix well.
Make in 12 individual muffin cups.
Bake for 25 to 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Basic Meat Loaf. Heat oven to 350°. In large bowl, combine all ingredients; mix well. Make in 12 individual muffin cups. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Chinese Almond Cookies
directions: Mix flour, sugar, baking powder and salt.
Slice butter into small pieces and stir into mixture.
Add egg and almond extract. Mix well.
Spoon dough onto greased cookie sheet.
Bake at 325° for 15 to 20 minutes and enjoy!
recipes.text: Chinese Almond Cookies. Mix flour, sugar, baking powder and salt. Slice butter into small pieces and stir into mixture. Add egg and almond extract. Mix well. Spoon dough onto greased cookie sheet. Bake at 325° for 15 to 20 minutes and enjoy!

recipes.title: Hamburger Casserole
directions: Preheat oven to 350°.
Cook macaroni by directions on package. Brown hamburger meat with onion and green pepper.
Add mushroom soup, cream of chicken soup and sour cream.
Cook on low heat. Drain macaroni; add to hamburger.
Put in casserole dish.
Grate cheese and place on top.
Put in 350° oven until cheese melts and casserole is bubbly.
recipes.text: Hamburger Casserole. Preheat oven to 350°. Cook macaroni by directions on package. Brown hamburger meat with onion and green pepper. Add mushroom soup, cream of chicken soup and sour cream. Cook on low heat. Drain macaroni; add to hamburger. Put in casserole dish. Grate cheese and place on top. Put in 350° oven until cheese melts and casserole is bubbly.

recipes.title: Chicken Soup
directions: Cook first 3 ingredients until done.
Remove chicken and dice. Add soup mix and noodles.
Cook until noodles are tender.
Add chicken and remove from heat.
recipes.text: Chicken Soup. Cook first 3 ingredients until done. Remove chicken and dice. Add soup mix and noodles. Cook until noodles are tender. Add chicken and remove from heat.

recipes.title: Catsup
directions: Simmer for 3 to 4 hours in a large kettle.
Pour into hot, sterilized jars and cover to seal.
recipes.text: Catsup. Simmer for 3 to 4 hours in a large kettle. Pour into hot, sterilized jars and cover to seal.

recipes.title: Chocolate Cheese Delight
ingredients: 2 (3 3/4 oz.) pkg. chocolate instant pudding mix
directions: Mix together margarine, flour and pecans and spread into a lightly greased 13 x 9-inch pan.
Bake 20 minutes at 350°.
Let cool.
Combine cream cheese, powdered sugar and 1 cup Cool Whip. Spread over baked crust.
Combine pudding mix and milk.
Mix well. Pour over cream cheese mixture.
Chill 1 hour.
Spread remaining Cool Whip over top.
Sprinkle with nuts or chocolate curls, if desired.
recipes.text: Chocolate Cheese Delight. Mix together margarine, flour and pecans and spread into a lightly greased 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake 20 minutes at 350°. Let cool. Combine cream cheese, powdered sugar and 1 cup Cool Whip. Spread over baked crust. Combine pudding mix and milk. Mix well. Pour over cream cheese mixture. Chill 1 hour. Spread remaining Cool Whip over top. Sprinkle with nuts or chocolate curls, if desired.

recipes.title: Easy Boston Baked Beans
ingredients: 2 to 3 strips bacon, cooked and crumbled (optional)
directions: After browning the bacon, saute onion in the bacon grease. Combine all ingredients.
Bake at 350° until hot.
recipes.text: Easy Boston Baked Beans. After browning the bacon, saute onion in the bacon grease. Combine all ingredients. Bake at 350° until hot.

recipes.title: Bagels
directions: Heat oven to 425°.
Mix all ingredients and let rise until double in size.
Punch down and form rings.
Let rise until double.
Drop in 6 quarts boiling water.
Boil for 3 minutes. Place on baking sheet; bake for 25 minutes.
recipes.text: Bagels. Heat oven to 425°. Mix all ingredients and let rise until double in size. Punch down and form rings. Let rise until double. Drop in 6 quarts boiling water. Boil for 3 minutes. Place on baking sheet; bake for 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Chicken And Broccoli Bake
directions: Brown
chicken	breasts.
Cook	noodles,
broccoli
and carrots separately.
In 13 x 9-inch
baking dish, mix noodles, broccoli and carrots.
Place chicken breasts
on
top.
In pan the chicken
was
browned
in, add soup and milk.
When warm, pour over casserole and bake 45 to 60 minutes at 375°.
recipes.text: Chicken And Broccoli Bake. Brown chicken	breasts. Cook	noodles, broccoli and carrots separately. In 13 x 9-inch baking dish, mix noodles, broccoli and carrots. Place chicken breasts on top. In pan the chicken was browned in, add soup and milk. When warm, pour over casserole and bake 45 to 60 minutes at 375°.

recipes.title: Angel Biscuits
directions: Sift flour and measure.
Sift again with dry ingredients into a large bowl.
Cut in shortening.
Add buttermilk and yeast, dissolved in warm water.
Mix well.
Pat or roll out on floured wax paper.
Cut and cook on greased pan in 425° oven for 15 minutes.
This does not need to rise and will keep well in refrigerator several days.
recipes.text: Angel Biscuits. Sift flour and measure. Sift again with dry ingredients into a large bowl. Cut in shortening. Add buttermilk and yeast, dissolved in warm water. Mix well. Pat or roll out on floured wax paper. Cut and cook on greased pan in 425° oven for 15 minutes. This does not need to rise and will keep well in refrigerator several days.

recipes.title: Diann'S Salsa
directions: Chop chilies, Ro-Tel tomatoes, onion, cilantro, avocado and jalapeno peppers.
Mix with crushed tomatoes.
Refrigerate for several hours to blend flavors.
Serve with tortilla chips or fresh vegetables as a dip.
recipes.text: Diann'S Salsa. Chop chilies, Ro-Tel tomatoes, onion, cilantro, avocado and jalapeno peppers. Mix with crushed tomatoes. Refrigerate for several hours to blend flavors. Serve with tortilla chips or fresh vegetables as a dip.

recipes.title: Spinach Enchilada Casserole
ingredients: 1 (1 lb.) pkg. frozen chopped spinach, thawed and squeezed dry
3/4 c. (3 oz.) shredded Monterey Jack cheese
directions: Brown meat with onion and garlic; drain.
Add tomatoes with green chilies, tomato sauce, tomatoes, bell pepper, lime juice and salt.
Simmer, uncovered, 15 minutes, stirring occasionally. Arrange 6 tortillas on bottom and up sides of lightly greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish, overlapping as necessary.
Top with half the meat mixture.
Arrange remaining tortillas, overlapping as necessary.
Spread sour cream evenly over tortillas.
Top with remaining meat mixture.
Bake at 350° about 30 minutes or until hot and bubbly.
Remove from oven; sprinkle with cheeses.
Let stand 10 minutes; cut into squares to serve.
Garnish with lettuce, if desired, and olives.
Serve with picante sauce, if desired.
Makes 8 servings.
recipes.text: Spinach Enchilada Casserole. Brown meat with onion and garlic; drain. Add tomatoes with green chilies, tomato sauce, tomatoes, bell pepper, lime juice and salt. Simmer, uncovered, 15 minutes, stirring occasionally. Arrange 6 tortillas on bottom and up sides of lightly greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish, overlapping as necessary. Top with half the meat mixture. Arrange remaining tortillas, overlapping as necessary. Spread sour cream evenly over tortillas. Top with remaining meat mixture. Bake at 350° about 30 minutes or until hot and bubbly. Remove from oven; sprinkle with cheeses. Let stand 10 minutes; cut into squares to serve. Garnish with lettuce, if desired, and olives. Serve with picante sauce, if desired. Makes 8 servings.

recipes.title: White Fudge
directions: Cook first 4 ingredients
to a firm ball, slightly above 240°.
Add 1 tablespoon butter and 1 teaspoon vanilla.
Cool, beat and add nuts or chopped maraschino cherries.
This gets white.
recipes.text: White Fudge. Cook first 4 ingredients to a firm ball, slightly above 240°. Add 1 tablespoon butter and 1 teaspoon vanilla. Cool, beat and add nuts or chopped maraschino cherries. This gets white.

recipes.title: Golden Cornbread
directions: Beat all ingredients until smooth. Bake in 9-inch square pan at 400° for about 20 minutes.
recipes.text: Golden Cornbread. Beat all ingredients until smooth. Bake in 9-inch square pan at 400° for about 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Mexican Crunch
ingredients: 1 medium jar thick and chunky salsa
directions: Brown your meat and drain, then add cheese.
Stir until melted.
Add the salsa.
Serve over tortilla chips.
recipes.text: Mexican Crunch. Brown your meat and drain, then add cheese. Stir until melted. Add the salsa. Serve over tortilla chips.

recipes.title: Dump Cake
directions: Pour pie filling into baking dish and spread.
Add crushed pineapple and spread.
Then add cake mix.
Sprinkle nuts on top then slice margarine on top.
Bake at 350° for 20 to 30 minutes until cake is brown.
recipes.text: Dump Cake. Pour pie filling into baking dish and spread. Add crushed pineapple and spread. Then add cake mix. Sprinkle nuts on top then slice margarine on top. Bake at 350° for 20 to 30 minutes until cake is brown.

recipes.title: Orange Slice Cake
directions: Chop nuts, dates and candy.
Combine with coconut.
Pour melted
butter
over
mixture;
let stand while preparing other mixture.
Beat
eggs, gradually adding sugar and other ingredients, mix well with nut mixture.
Bake in a greased tube pan or Bundt pan at 250° for 2 1/2 hours.
recipes.text: Orange Slice Cake. Chop nuts, dates and candy. Combine with coconut. Pour melted butter over mixture; let stand while preparing other mixture. Beat eggs, gradually adding sugar and other ingredients, mix well with nut mixture. Bake in a greased tube pan or Bundt pan at 250° for 2 1/2 hours.

recipes.title: Easy Chili With Beans
directions: Cook first 3 ingredients in olive oil in a Dutch oven over medium-high heat, stirring until ground beef crumbles; drain. Return mixture to Dutch oven; stir in tomato sauce, chili powder and chocolate kiss.
Cook over low heat 15 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add kidney beans; cook until thoroughly heated. Garnish if desired.
recipes.text: Easy Chili With Beans. Cook first 3 ingredients in olive oil in a Dutch oven over medium-high heat, stirring until ground beef crumbles; drain. Return mixture to Dutch oven; stir in tomato sauce, chili powder and chocolate kiss. Cook over low heat 15 minutes, stirring occasionally. Add kidney beans; cook until thoroughly heated. Garnish if desired.

recipes.title: Fruit Cheese Ball
directions: Mix and form into ball and roll in coconut.
recipes.text: Fruit Cheese Ball. Mix and form into ball and roll in coconut.

recipes.title: Sue'S Jello Salad
directions: Dissolve jello in two cups of boiling water.
Add orange juice and 1 can of water.
Blend in softened cream cheese and fruit. Chill in mold.
recipes.text: Sue'S Jello Salad. Dissolve jello in two cups of boiling water. Add orange juice and 1 can of water. Blend in softened cream cheese and fruit. Chill in mold.

recipes.title: Honey Mustard Chicken Bites
ingredients: 1 (12 oz.) jar honey mustard salad dressing, chilled
directions: Cut chicken into 1-inch pieces. Dip chicken pieces into 3/4 cup dressing. Coat with stuffing. Place chicken on a baking sheet. Bake at 400° for 15 minutes. Mix remaining dressing and orange juice in saucepan. Heat through. Serve with chicken for dipping. Makes 40 appetizers.
recipes.text: Honey Mustard Chicken Bites. Cut chicken into 1-inch pieces. Dip chicken pieces into 3/4 cup dressing. Coat with stuffing. Place chicken on a baking sheet. Bake at 400° for 15 minutes. Mix remaining dressing and orange juice in saucepan. Heat through. Serve with chicken for dipping. Makes 40 appetizers.

recipes.title: Angel Biscuits
ingredients: 2 pkg. yeast, dissolved in 1 c. warm water
directions: Make as you would biscuits. Dough will keep in refrigerator several days.
recipes.text: Angel Biscuits. Make as you would biscuits. Dough will keep in refrigerator several days.

recipes.title: Eva'S Mexican Squash With Ground Meat
ingredients: 3 Mexican squash, diced and seeded (if tender, don't peel)
directions: Brown meat
in	oil and pour off the grease.
Add onion and bell pepper.
Continue cooking the vegetables lightly.
recipes.text: Eva'S Mexican Squash With Ground Meat. Brown meat in	oil and pour off the grease. Add onion and bell pepper. Continue cooking the vegetables lightly.

recipes.title: Chicken Casserole
ingredients: 1 chicken, boiled and cut in chunks
directions: Melt butter in bottom of casserole dish.
Break crackers and press down into butter.
Add chicken broth, soup and sour cream. Sprinkle paprika over top.
Bake at 300° until bubbling.
recipes.text: Chicken Casserole. Melt butter in bottom of casserole dish. Break crackers and press down into butter. Add chicken broth, soup and sour cream. Sprinkle paprika over top. Bake at 300° until bubbling.

recipes.title: Corn Cob Jelly
directions: Run water over cobs to take off last of the chaff.
In a large pan (roaster oven), cover the cobs with water and boil 30 minutes. Use a lot of water, the cobs absorb a lot.
Strain.
Stir 3 cups of the red corn liquor into a pan and add Sure-Jell.
Let this come to a boil, then add sugar.
When this comes to a hard boil, let it boil a minute or until it starts to jell.
Test by dipping fork.
The liquid collects a minute on the groves.
recipes.text: Corn Cob Jelly. Run water over cobs to take off last of the chaff. In a large pan (roaster oven), cover the cobs with water and boil 30 minutes. Use a lot of water, the cobs absorb a lot. Strain. Stir 3 cups of the red corn liquor into a pan and add Sure-Jell. Let this come to a boil, then add sugar. When this comes to a hard boil, let it boil a minute or until it starts to jell. Test by dipping fork. The liquid collects a minute on the groves.

recipes.title: Chicken Chili
ingredients: 3 to 4 whole chicken breasts, skinned, boned and cut into 1-inch cubes
1 to 2 red or green peppers, chopped
directions: Saute chicken, onion, garlic and peppers in oil.
Add tomatoes, broth, chili powder, cumin, curry powder, oregano and allspice.
Cook 20 minutes.
Add zucchini, kidney beans, lemon juice and parsley.
Simmer 10 minutes, uncovered.
Adjust seasonings.
Serve over white or brown rice.
Garnish with nonfat plain yogurt, chopped scallions and grated Cheddar cheese.
recipes.text: Chicken Chili. Saute chicken, onion, garlic and peppers in oil. Add tomatoes, broth, chili powder, cumin, curry powder, oregano and allspice. Cook 20 minutes. Add zucchini, kidney beans, lemon juice and parsley. Simmer 10 minutes, uncovered. Adjust seasonings. Serve over white or brown rice. Garnish with nonfat plain yogurt, chopped scallions and grated Cheddar cheese.

recipes.title: Crunchy Parmesan Chicken
ingredients: 1 pkg. Pepperidge Farm herb stuffing mix
directions: Mix all dry ingredients.
Melt butter. Dip chicken in butter. Roll in dry mixture and place in shallow pan.
Do one piece at a time.
Sprinkle any remaining dry mixture over coated pieces. Pour remaining butter over all.
Bake at 350° for 50 to 60 minutes.
recipes.text: Crunchy Parmesan Chicken. Mix all dry ingredients. Melt butter. Dip chicken in butter. Roll in dry mixture and place in shallow pan. Do one piece at a time. Sprinkle any remaining dry mixture over coated pieces. Pour remaining butter over all. Bake at 350° for 50 to 60 minutes.

recipes.title: One Bowl Brownies
directions: Heat oven to 350°.
Microwave chocolate and margarine in a large bowl on High until chocolate and margarine are melted.
Stir until chocolate is completely melted.
Stir sugar into chocolate mixture.
Mix in eggs and vanilla until well-blended.
Stir in flour and nuts.
recipes.text: One Bowl Brownies. Heat oven to 350°. Microwave chocolate and margarine in a large bowl on High until chocolate and margarine are melted. Stir until chocolate is completely melted. Stir sugar into chocolate mixture. Mix in eggs and vanilla until well-blended. Stir in flour and nuts.

recipes.title: Hamburger Medley
directions: Chop onions and cook until transparent.
Add hamburger and cook until browned, but not dry.
Place in a baking dish.
Add mixed vegetables and mushroom soup.
Top with Tater Tots and cheese.
Bake at 250° for 30 to 35 minutes.
recipes.text: Hamburger Medley. Chop onions and cook until transparent. Add hamburger and cook until browned, but not dry. Place in a baking dish. Add mixed vegetables and mushroom soup. Top with Tater Tots and cheese. Bake at 250° for 30 to 35 minutes.

recipes.title: Easy Cornbread Stuffing
ingredients: 2 c. bread crumbs "from slices of bread" or 2 c. stuffing mix *
directions: *Or you may use all cornbread.
If you do, use 4 cups cornbread instead of 2.
recipes.text: Easy Cornbread Stuffing. *Or you may use all cornbread. If you do, use 4 cups cornbread instead of 2.

recipes.title: Honey Corn Bread
directions: Mix cornmeal, biscuit mix and baking powder in a large bowl. Add milk, eggs, honey and oil. Stir until dry ingredients are moistened.
Pour into an 8-inch square microwave-proof baking dish.
Cook on 50 for 10 minutes.
Rotate dish if bread seems to be rising unevenly.
Cook on High 2 to 4 minutes or until bread tests done.
Remove from microwave and let stand 5 minutes. Serve warm.
recipes.text: Honey Corn Bread. Mix cornmeal, biscuit mix and baking powder in a large bowl. Add milk, eggs, honey and oil. Stir until dry ingredients are moistened. Pour into an 8-inch square microwave-proof baking dish. Cook on 50 for 10 minutes. Rotate dish if bread seems to be rising unevenly. Cook on High 2 to 4 minutes or until bread tests done. Remove from microwave and let stand 5 minutes. Serve warm.

recipes.title: Open House Punch
ingredients: 1 (6 oz.) frozen orange juice, diluted with 3 cans water
directions: Combine sugar and water.
Heat until dissolved. Cool and chill. Add other juices.
Chill until ready to serve.
Gently combine with cold ginger ale. Garnish. Serves 50.
recipes.text: Open House Punch. Combine sugar and water. Heat until dissolved. Cool and chill. Add other juices. Chill until ready to serve. Gently combine with cold ginger ale. Garnish. Serves 50.

recipes.title: Nanny'S Sweet Potato Rolls
directions: In mixing bowl, dissolve yeast in warm water.
Stir in sugar, salt, shortening, eggs, sweet potatoes and half the flour.
Mix in remaining flour until dough is easy to handle.
Turn onto lightly floured board.
Knead until smooth and elastic, about 5 minutes. Place, greased side up, in greased bowl.
Cover with Saran Wrap and refrigerate.
recipes.text: Nanny'S Sweet Potato Rolls. In mixing bowl, dissolve yeast in warm water. Stir in sugar, salt, shortening, eggs, sweet potatoes and half the flour. Mix in remaining flour until dough is easy to handle. Turn onto lightly floured board. Knead until smooth and elastic, about 5 minutes. Place, greased side up, in greased bowl. Cover with Saran Wrap and refrigerate.

recipes.title: Grandma Jewell'S Chicken Pie
directions: Melt margarine.
Add mushrooms and garlic.
Combine cornstarch and milk.
When smooth, add to mushroom mixture.
Bring to boil, stirring constantly.
Stir in rest of ingredients. Pour into pastry shells.
Cover pie with pastry.
Seal and flute edges. Bake at 375° for 35 minutes.
recipes.text: Grandma Jewell'S Chicken Pie. Melt margarine. Add mushrooms and garlic. Combine cornstarch and milk. When smooth, add to mushroom mixture. Bring to boil, stirring constantly. Stir in rest of ingredients. Pour into pastry shells. Cover pie with pastry. Seal and flute edges. Bake at 375° for 35 minutes.

recipes.title: T'S Dole Golden Layer Cake
directions: Combine undrained pineapple, whipped topping and pudding mix. Let stand for 5 minutes.
Cut cake lengthwise into 3rds.
Spread 1/3 pudding mixture over each layer of cake, ending with pudding on top.
Chill 30 minutes.
Sprinkle with sliced almonds.
Serves 12.
recipes.text: T'S Dole Golden Layer Cake. Combine undrained pineapple, whipped topping and pudding mix. Let stand for 5 minutes. Cut cake lengthwise into 3rds. Spread 1/3 pudding mixture over each layer of cake, ending with pudding on top. Chill 30 minutes. Sprinkle with sliced almonds. Serves 12.

recipes.title: Mexican Bean Dip
directions: Cream beans, cream cheese, sour cream, taco mix and hot sauce. Spread in 13 x 9-inch pan.
Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.
Remove and sprinkle cheeses and bake for additional 5 minutes or until cheese melts.
Serve warm with tortilla chips.
recipes.text: Mexican Bean Dip. Cream beans, cream cheese, sour cream, taco mix and hot sauce. Spread in 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake at 350° for 20 minutes. Remove and sprinkle cheeses and bake for additional 5 minutes or until cheese melts. Serve warm with tortilla chips.

recipes.title: Never Fail Pie Crust
directions: Add shortening to flour and blend with pastry blender or use 2 knives, cutting shortening into flour until particles are about the size of peas.
Add salt, vinegar and milk.
Mix well and chill one day (can be left in fridge longer).
Allow dough to reach room temperature before using.
recipes.text: Never Fail Pie Crust. Add shortening to flour and blend with pastry blender or use 2 knives, cutting shortening into flour until particles are about the size of peas. Add salt, vinegar and milk. Mix well and chill one day (can be left in fridge longer). Allow dough to reach room temperature before using.

recipes.title: Cranberry Relish
ingredients: 4 oz. can crushed pineapple (syrup and all)
directions: Wash cranberries and crush in blender.
In mixing bowl, add sugar to berries and let stand 15 minutes.
Add pineapple.
Heat orange juice and add jello.
Mix all together and refrigerate overnight.
This is delicious!
recipes.text: Cranberry Relish. Wash cranberries and crush in blender. In mixing bowl, add sugar to berries and let stand 15 minutes. Add pineapple. Heat orange juice and add jello. Mix all together and refrigerate overnight. This is delicious!

recipes.title: Chili Sauce
directions: *Or use 4 tablespoons of pickling spice.
recipes.text: Chili Sauce. *Or use 4 tablespoons of pickling spice.

recipes.title: Sugarless Cake
directions: Combine raisins in water and simmer for 15 minutes.
Let stand until cool.
Add beaten egg.
Add soft shortening, oats, sweetener and flavoring.
Sift flour, salt, baking soda and cinnamon.
Mix all together well.
Pour into greased one-layer cake pan and bake 30 to 35 minutes at 350°.
Yields an 8-inch cake.
recipes.text: Sugarless Cake. Combine raisins in water and simmer for 15 minutes. Let stand until cool. Add beaten egg. Add soft shortening, oats, sweetener and flavoring. Sift flour, salt, baking soda and cinnamon. Mix all together well. Pour into greased one-layer cake pan and bake 30 to 35 minutes at 350°. Yields an 8-inch cake.

recipes.title: Sweet Potato Casserole
directions: Mix all together; put in buttered dish.
recipes.text: Sweet Potato Casserole. Mix all together; put in buttered dish.

recipes.title: Cream Cheese Pound Cake
directions: Beat butter, sugar and cream cheese.
Beat until smooth.
Add eggs, one at a time.
Add vanilla.
Add flour until smooth; beat. The more you beat the better the cake is.
Use a cold oven.
Bake at 300° for 1 1/2 hours.
Don't even walk on the floor.
This cake is very sensitive.
Don't substitute anything in this cake.
recipes.text: Cream Cheese Pound Cake. Beat butter, sugar and cream cheese. Beat until smooth. Add eggs, one at a time. Add vanilla. Add flour until smooth; beat. The more you beat the better the cake is. Use a cold oven. Bake at 300° for 1 1/2 hours. Don't even walk on the floor. This cake is very sensitive. Don't substitute anything in this cake.

recipes.title: Dark-Chocolate Walnut Drops
directions: About 2 hours before serving or up to 2 weeks ahead, mix ingredients together.
Preheat oven to 350°.
Grease cookie sheet. Into large bowl, measure all ingredients except walnuts.
With mixer at low speed, beat ingredients until blended.
Increase speed to high; beat 1 minute, occasionally scraping bowl with spatula.
With rubber spatula, stir in walnuts.
Drop mixture by rounded tablespoonfuls, 1 inch apart, onto cookie sheets.
Bake 15 minutes.
With pancake turner, remove cookies to wire racks; cool. Store cookies in tightly covered container to use up within 2 weeks.
Makes 1 1/2 dozen cookies.
recipes.text: Dark-Chocolate Walnut Drops. About 2 hours before serving or up to 2 weeks ahead, mix ingredients together. Preheat oven to 350°. Grease cookie sheet. Into large bowl, measure all ingredients except walnuts. With mixer at low speed, beat ingredients until blended. Increase speed to high; beat 1 minute, occasionally scraping bowl with spatula. With rubber spatula, stir in walnuts. Drop mixture by rounded tablespoonfuls, 1 inch apart, onto cookie sheets. Bake 15 minutes. With pancake turner, remove cookies to wire racks; cool. Store cookies in tightly covered container to use up within 2 weeks. Makes 1 1/2 dozen cookies.

recipes.title: Chocolate Mousse
directions: In small saucepan, combine chocolates and coffee.
Heat over low heat until chocolates are melted.
Cool.
In a large mixer bowl, beat eggs and yolks on high speed 10 minutes.
Add sugar and beat until shiny, 5 minutes.
Add melted chocolates, rum and vanilla.
Beat just until thoroughly blended.
recipes.text: Chocolate Mousse. In small saucepan, combine chocolates and coffee. Heat over low heat until chocolates are melted. Cool. In a large mixer bowl, beat eggs and yolks on high speed 10 minutes. Add sugar and beat until shiny, 5 minutes. Add melted chocolates, rum and vanilla. Beat just until thoroughly blended.

recipes.title: Layered Peach Cobbler
ingredients: 1 (20 oz.) can crushed pineapple with juice
directions: In a 9 x 13-inch pan, layer ingredients in the order they are listed. Do NOT stir. Peaches are listed twice in the ingredients because there are two layers of peaches. Bake at 350° for 45 to 55 minutes. Serve warm with vanilla ice cream.
recipes.text: Layered Peach Cobbler. In a 9 x 13-inch pan, layer ingredients in the order they are listed. Do NOT stir. Peaches are listed twice in the ingredients because there are two layers of peaches. Bake at 350° for 45 to 55 minutes. Serve warm with vanilla ice cream.

recipes.title: Sausage Balls
directions: Have cheese and sausage at room temperature. Mix cheese, sausage and Bisquick together. Make walnut size balls.
Place on ungreased baking sheet. Bake about 15 minutes in a preheated oven at 350°.
recipes.text: Sausage Balls. Have cheese and sausage at room temperature. Mix cheese, sausage and Bisquick together. Make walnut size balls. Place on ungreased baking sheet. Bake about 15 minutes in a preheated oven at 350°.

recipes.title: Cheese Scones
directions: In a large bowl, combine flour, sugar, baking powder, salt and baking soda; stir in cheese.
In another bowl, combine egg, sour cream, oil and milk; stir into dry ingredients just until moistened.
Turn onto a floured surface and knead gently 10-12 times.
Gently pat out to 1/3 inch thickness. Cut with a 3 inch heart-shaped cookie cutter.
Place on a greased baking sheet. Bake at 425° for 15-20 minutes or until golden brown.
recipes.text: Cheese Scones. In a large bowl, combine flour, sugar, baking powder, salt and baking soda; stir in cheese. In another bowl, combine egg, sour cream, oil and milk; stir into dry ingredients just until moistened. Turn onto a floured surface and knead gently 10-12 times. Gently pat out to 1/3 inch thickness. Cut with a 3 inch heart-shaped cookie cutter. Place on a greased baking sheet. Bake at 425° for 15-20 minutes or until golden brown.

recipes.title: Peggy'S Easy Punch
directions: Leave sherbet at room temperature for about 30 minutes.
Put in mixing bowl and add ginger ale.
Chop with vegetable chopper until desired consistency.
Pour into punch bowl and serve. Serves 20.
recipes.text: Peggy'S Easy Punch. Leave sherbet at room temperature for about 30 minutes. Put in mixing bowl and add ginger ale. Chop with vegetable chopper until desired consistency. Pour into punch bowl and serve. Serves 20.

recipes.title: Ricotta Pie
ingredients: Unbaked pie shells (2 regular or 1 deep dish)
directions: Cream sugar and cheese well. Add salt, cornstarch; cream again. Add lemon juice, vanilla and eggs. Mix milk in last. Bake at 375° for 45 minutes. Sprinkle nutmeg lightly on top. Lower temperature to 350° the last 15 minutes. Cool completely.
recipes.text: Ricotta Pie. Cream sugar and cheese well. Add salt, cornstarch; cream again. Add lemon juice, vanilla and eggs. Mix milk in last. Bake at 375° for 45 minutes. Sprinkle nutmeg lightly on top. Lower temperature to 350° the last 15 minutes. Cool completely.

recipes.title: Roast
ingredients: 3 1/2 to 4 lb. ribeye or prime rib roast
directions: Wipe roast with damp paper toweling.
Sprinkle with salt, pepper and garlic powder, if used.
Place meat on rack in roasting pan deep enough to hold the drippings.
Insert a meat thermometer (registers 130° for very rare, 140° for medium and 170° for well done).
recipes.text: Roast. Wipe roast with damp paper toweling. Sprinkle with salt, pepper and garlic powder, if used. Place meat on rack in roasting pan deep enough to hold the drippings. Insert a meat thermometer (registers 130° for very rare, 140° for medium and 170° for well done).

recipes.title: John'S Chili
ingredients: 4 Oscar Meyer Smokie sausage links, sliced and browned
1 Tbsp. each oregano, garlic powder and black pepper
directions: Combine all ingredients and heat in saucepan on high.
Bring to a boil.
Lower heat and simmer approximately 1 hour.
recipes.text: John'S Chili. Combine all ingredients and heat in saucepan on high. Bring to a boil. Lower heat and simmer approximately 1 hour.

recipes.title: Butter Cookies With Sprinkles
ingredients: 1/4 c. milk (a little at a time)
directions: Preheat oven to 375°.
Let butter come to room temperature. Mix all ingredients well.
Drop 1/2 teaspoon on ungreased cookie sheet.
Dip tines of a fork in milk and press cookie down.
Bake 10 minutes.
Can be put together with preserves.
recipes.text: Butter Cookies With Sprinkles. Preheat oven to 375°. Let butter come to room temperature. Mix all ingredients well. Drop 1/2 teaspoon on ungreased cookie sheet. Dip tines of a fork in milk and press cookie down. Bake 10 minutes. Can be put together with preserves.

recipes.title: Creamy Zucchini Quiche
directions: Preheat oven to 450°.
Spread bottom of pastry shell with mustard and bake 10 minutes.
Cool.
Reduce heat of oven to 350°. Place zucchini in colander; sprinkle with salt and drain about 5 minutes.
While zucchini is draining, saute mushrooms in butter. Sprinkle one cup of the grated cheese into the bottom of the pastry shell.
Spoon mushrooms on top.
Squeeze zucchini to remove the last bit of moisture and put into pastry shell, separating and fluffing with fingers.
Beat together cream cheese, cream, egg yolks and whole egg.
Season with salt and pepper.
Set pastry dish on baking sheet and carefully put in cream-egg mixture. Sprinkle remaining cheese on top.
Bake 35 minutes, until top is puffed and golden and knife inserted into center comes out clean. Let stand 5 minutes before cutting.
Makes eight servings.
recipes.text: Creamy Zucchini Quiche. Preheat oven to 450°. Spread bottom of pastry shell with mustard and bake 10 minutes. Cool. Reduce heat of oven to 350°. Place zucchini in colander; sprinkle with salt and drain about 5 minutes. While zucchini is draining, saute mushrooms in butter. Sprinkle one cup of the grated cheese into the bottom of the pastry shell. Spoon mushrooms on top. Squeeze zucchini to remove the last bit of moisture and put into pastry shell, separating and fluffing with fingers. Beat together cream cheese, cream, egg yolks and whole egg. Season with salt and pepper. Set pastry dish on baking sheet and carefully put in cream-egg mixture. Sprinkle remaining cheese on top. Bake 35 minutes, until top is puffed and golden and knife inserted into center comes out clean. Let stand 5 minutes before cutting. Makes eight servings.

recipes.title: Creamed Spinach
directions: Cook spinach.
Drain spinach until almost dry.
Add cream cheese and nutmeg to the above mixture and serve hot.
recipes.text: Creamed Spinach. Cook spinach. Drain spinach until almost dry. Add cream cheese and nutmeg to the above mixture and serve hot.

recipes.title: Italian Crescent Casserole
directions: Brown hamburger and onion together. Drain off grease. Add spaghetti sauce mix and tomato sauce.
Heat until bubbly.
Pour in ungreased 13 x 9-inch pan.
Mix sour cream and Mozzarella cheese together.
Spoon over hamburger mixture.
Unroll crescent rolls. Divide into 2 rectangular halves and lay on top of cheese mixture. Pour melted margarine over rolls and sprinkle with Parmesan cheese.
Bake at 375° for 15 to 25 minutes until brown.
recipes.text: Italian Crescent Casserole. Brown hamburger and onion together. Drain off grease. Add spaghetti sauce mix and tomato sauce. Heat until bubbly. Pour in ungreased 13 x 9-inch pan. Mix sour cream and Mozzarella cheese together. Spoon over hamburger mixture. Unroll crescent rolls. Divide into 2 rectangular halves and lay on top of cheese mixture. Pour melted margarine over rolls and sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Bake at 375° for 15 to 25 minutes until brown.

recipes.title: Broccoli Salad
directions: Break broccoli florets into small pieces and place in a bowl. Next, layer onion, cut in small pieces.
Then place cheese over as the next layer.
Stir the last 3 ingredients together and pour over the salad.
Sprinkle bacon that has been fried and crushed or bacon bits on top.
Place in refrigerator and let set for at least 3 hours before serving.
recipes.text: Broccoli Salad. Break broccoli florets into small pieces and place in a bowl. Next, layer onion, cut in small pieces. Then place cheese over as the next layer. Stir the last 3 ingredients together and pour over the salad. Sprinkle bacon that has been fried and crushed or bacon bits on top. Place in refrigerator and let set for at least 3 hours before serving.

recipes.title: Old Settler'S Beans
directions: Brown onion and meats.
Add sugar and catsup, then add kidney beans, lima beans and pork and beans.
Add remaining ingredients. Bake in 3-quart casserole one hour at 350°.
recipes.text: Old Settler'S Beans. Brown onion and meats. Add sugar and catsup, then add kidney beans, lima beans and pork and beans. Add remaining ingredients. Bake in 3-quart casserole one hour at 350°.

recipes.title: Easy Cream Cheese Pound Cake
directions: Cream first 3 ingredients; add sugar.
Beat.
Alternately add flour and eggs to creamed mixture, blending after each addition. Begin and end with flour.
Add vanilla.
Pour into greased and floured tube pan; bake at 300° for 1 1/2 hours or until tests done. Delicious with ice cream or your favorite sauce.
recipes.text: Easy Cream Cheese Pound Cake. Cream first 3 ingredients; add sugar. Beat. Alternately add flour and eggs to creamed mixture, blending after each addition. Begin and end with flour. Add vanilla. Pour into greased and floured tube pan; bake at 300° for 1 1/2 hours or until tests done. Delicious with ice cream or your favorite sauce.

recipes.title: Blueberry-Nectarine Crisp
directions: Heat oven to 375°. Toss nectarines, blueberries, granulated sugar, lemon juice and cornstarch in large bowl. Spoon fruit mixture into 8 x 8 x 2-inch dish. Mix flour and brown sugar. Mix butter into flour mixture until crumbly. Sprinkle over top of fruit. Bake at 375° for 50 to 60 minutes.
recipes.text: Blueberry-Nectarine Crisp. Heat oven to 375°. Toss nectarines, blueberries, granulated sugar, lemon juice and cornstarch in large bowl. Spoon fruit mixture into 8 x 8 x 2-inch dish. Mix flour and brown sugar. Mix butter into flour mixture until crumbly. Sprinkle over top of fruit. Bake at 375° for 50 to 60 minutes.

recipes.title: Million Dollar Pie
ingredients: 2 graham cracker or vanilla wafer crusts
directions: Mix Cool Whip, pineapple, nuts and lemon juice.
Pour into crust and chill for 3 hours (better if overnight).
recipes.text: Million Dollar Pie. Mix Cool Whip, pineapple, nuts and lemon juice. Pour into crust and chill for 3 hours (better if overnight).

recipes.title: Chocolate Velvet Cake
directions: Cream butter and sugar.
Add eggs and beat until fluffy.
Make paste of cocoa and vinegar and add to butter mixture.
Sift together flour, salt, baking soda and add to butter mixture, alternately with milk.
Add vanilla and melt Hershey's chocolate.
recipes.text: Chocolate Velvet Cake. Cream butter and sugar. Add eggs and beat until fluffy. Make paste of cocoa and vinegar and add to butter mixture. Sift together flour, salt, baking soda and add to butter mixture, alternately with milk. Add vanilla and melt Hershey's chocolate.

recipes.title: Baked Beans
directions: Soak beans overnight.
Sprinkle the soda over beans.
Boil for 10 minutes, skimming off foam.
Drain 1/2 water off; cover with warm water.
Add 3/4 cup sugar per pound of beans.
Add diced ham or bacon, the molasses, diced onion, ginger, salt and pepper. Bake at 300° for 8 hours, or use slow cooker.
recipes.text: Baked Beans. Soak beans overnight. Sprinkle the soda over beans. Boil for 10 minutes, skimming off foam. Drain 1/2 water off; cover with warm water. Add 3/4 cup sugar per pound of beans. Add diced ham or bacon, the molasses, diced onion, ginger, salt and pepper. Bake at 300° for 8 hours, or use slow cooker.

recipes.title: Popcorn Balls
directions: Boil mixture of the sugar, water, butter and vinegar until it becomes stringy, stirring constantly.
Immediately pour over popcorn and mix well. Dip hands into cold water, then form popcorn into small balls.
Wrap in wax paper.
recipes.text: Popcorn Balls. Boil mixture of the sugar, water, butter and vinegar until it becomes stringy, stirring constantly. Immediately pour over popcorn and mix well. Dip hands into cold water, then form popcorn into small balls. Wrap in wax paper.

recipes.title: Peach Cobbler
directions: Mix all dry ingredients.
Melt butter and mix with dry ingredients.
Pour peaches and juice over top of all.
Do not stir.
Bake at 350° until golden brown.
recipes.text: Peach Cobbler. Mix all dry ingredients. Melt butter and mix with dry ingredients. Pour peaches and juice over top of all. Do not stir. Bake at 350° until golden brown.

recipes.title: Honeyed French Green Beans
directions: Pour undrained green beans into a 1-quart casserole dish. Drizzle honey and Worcestershire sauce over beans. Place bacon strips on top. Bake at 350° until bacon is crisp, approximately 30 minutes. Serves 3 to 4.
recipes.text: Honeyed French Green Beans. Pour undrained green beans into a 1-quart casserole dish. Drizzle honey and Worcestershire sauce over beans. Place bacon strips on top. Bake at 350° until bacon is crisp, approximately 30 minutes. Serves 3 to 4.

recipes.title: Garlic-Herb Mashed Potatoes
directions: Take mature green beans and snap the ends. Lay them on a sheet
and dry for several days.
recipes.text: Garlic-Herb Mashed Potatoes. Take mature green beans and snap the ends. Lay them on a sheet and dry for several days.

recipes.title: Easy Chocolate Chip Cookies
directions: Mix all ingredients together.
Drop from teaspoon onto nonstick cookie sheet.
Bake at 375° for 10 to 12 minutes.
recipes.text: Easy Chocolate Chip Cookies. Mix all ingredients together. Drop from teaspoon onto nonstick cookie sheet. Bake at 375° for 10 to 12 minutes.

recipes.title: Vegetable Soup
ingredients: salt, pepper and garlic to taste
directions: Fry hamburger with onion; drain grease.
Add cabbage.
Add mixed vegetables, tomato paste and whole tomatoes (pour juice and all in).
Then add 2 cups water.
Let boil until done.
You may have to add more water while cooking.
Cook for about 1 1/2 hours.
recipes.text: Vegetable Soup. Fry hamburger with onion; drain grease. Add cabbage. Add mixed vegetables, tomato paste and whole tomatoes (pour juice and all in). Then add 2 cups water. Let boil until done. You may have to add more water while cooking. Cook for about 1 1/2 hours.

recipes.title: Pizza Casserole
directions: Brown the ground beef, onions and pepper together.
Add the mushrooms.
Stir in the cheese soup and pizza sauce.
Cook the spaghetti until tender; drain and mix with the previous mixture and spread in a rectangular baking dish.
Sprinkle on the Mozzarella cheese.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
Let set for 5 minutes before serving.
recipes.text: Pizza Casserole. Brown the ground beef, onions and pepper together. Add the mushrooms. Stir in the cheese soup and pizza sauce. Cook the spaghetti until tender; drain and mix with the previous mixture and spread in a rectangular baking dish. Sprinkle on the Mozzarella cheese. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes. Let set for 5 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Robin'S Jewish Penicillin(Chicken Barley Soup)
ingredients: salt and coarse black pepper to taste (I like a lot of pepper)
directions: Simmer chicken, sliced carrots, chopped celery and chopped onion in large pot with salt and pepper.
As chicken is boiling, skim top with slotted spoon to remove unwanted fat.
After chicken has simmered for about 1 hour, drain liquid and save.
Allow chicken to cool and pull off bones.
recipes.text: Robin'S Jewish Penicillin(Chicken Barley Soup). Simmer chicken, sliced carrots, chopped celery and chopped onion in large pot with salt and pepper. As chicken is boiling, skim top with slotted spoon to remove unwanted fat. After chicken has simmered for about 1 hour, drain liquid and save. Allow chicken to cool and pull off bones.

recipes.title: Cream Tacos
ingredients: 2 (10 3/4 oz.) cans cream of chicken soup
directions: If using corn tortillas, soften in hot oil; drain on paper towels.
Mix together chicken, cheese, green chiles and onion. Fill tortillas with mixture and roll.
Place seam side down in baking dish.
Mix together the soup, sour cream and milk.
Pour over filled tortillas.
Bake in a 350° oven for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Cream Tacos. If using corn tortillas, soften in hot oil; drain on paper towels. Mix together chicken, cheese, green chiles and onion. Fill tortillas with mixture and roll. Place seam side down in baking dish. Mix together the soup, sour cream and milk. Pour over filled tortillas. Bake in a 350° oven for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Candied Fruit Cookies
directions: Combine flour, soda and salt. Beat butter and sugar in bowl at medium speed until light and fluffy. Beat in egg at low speed; beat in buttermilk. Stir in raisins and candied fruit. Chill 1 hour. Grease baking sheets. Drop dough by tablespoon 2 inches apart on sheet; flatten slightly. Bake in preheated 375° oven 8 to 10 minutes.
recipes.text: Candied Fruit Cookies. Combine flour, soda and salt. Beat butter and sugar in bowl at medium speed until light and fluffy. Beat in egg at low speed; beat in buttermilk. Stir in raisins and candied fruit. Chill 1 hour. Grease baking sheets. Drop dough by tablespoon 2 inches apart on sheet; flatten slightly. Bake in preheated 375° oven 8 to 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Butter Riches
directions: Cream the butter.
Gradually add brown sugar and white sugar. Cream well.
Add egg yolk and vanilla.
Beat well.
Blend in flour to form a stiff dough.
Shape into small balls.
Put on greased cookie sheets.
Flatten to size of a 50 cent piece with the bottom of a glass dipped in sugar.
Bake at 350° for 7 to 9 minutes, until golden brown.
Cool and frost with Browned Butter Frosting.
recipes.text: Butter Riches. Cream the butter. Gradually add brown sugar and white sugar. Cream well. Add egg yolk and vanilla. Beat well. Blend in flour to form a stiff dough. Shape into small balls. Put on greased cookie sheets. Flatten to size of a 50 cent piece with the bottom of a glass dipped in sugar. Bake at 350° for 7 to 9 minutes, until golden brown. Cool and frost with Browned Butter Frosting.

recipes.title: Lasagna
ingredients: 1 lb. ground beef, browned in oil
1 medium pkg. noodles, cooked and drained
directions: Alternate meat, sauce and cottage cheese with noodles and top with Mozzarella cheese.
Bake 15 minutes until cheese melts.
Works well in crock-pot.
recipes.text: Lasagna. Alternate meat, sauce and cottage cheese with noodles and top with Mozzarella cheese. Bake 15 minutes until cheese melts. Works well in crock-pot.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Sheet Cake
directions: Preheat oven to 350°. Combine flour, sugar and cinnamon; set aside. Mix pumpkin, oil and eggs. Add pumpkin mixture to dry ingredients and mix until smooth. Pour batter into prepared pan. Bake 30 minutes or until toothpick inserted near center comes out clean. Cool, then frost.
recipes.text: Pumpkin Sheet Cake. Preheat oven to 350°. Combine flour, sugar and cinnamon; set aside. Mix pumpkin, oil and eggs. Add pumpkin mixture to dry ingredients and mix until smooth. Pour batter into prepared pan. Bake 30 minutes or until toothpick inserted near center comes out clean. Cool, then frost.

recipes.title: Bridal Punch (Lime Green)
directions: Mix lemon juice, lime juice, Sprite and pineapple juice.
When ready to serve, add sherbet and Fresca.
Serves 30.
recipes.text: Bridal Punch (Lime Green). Mix lemon juice, lime juice, Sprite and pineapple juice. When ready to serve, add sherbet and Fresca. Serves 30.

recipes.title: Fiesta Peppers
directions: Slice peppers and onion vertically about 1/8-inch wide. Heat a 12-inch frying
pan,
then put in olive oil and garlic. Saute for a short
time
until
garlic starts to tan.
Add the remaining ingredients and
saute
until onions start to wilt a little.
I prefer it not cooked to death.
This is a tasty and colorful addition to
steaks
or
chops,
better
for you than gravy.
recipes.text: Fiesta Peppers. Slice peppers and onion vertically about 1/8-inch wide. Heat a 12-inch frying pan, then put in olive oil and garlic. Saute for a short time until garlic starts to tan. Add the remaining ingredients and saute until onions start to wilt a little. I prefer it not cooked to death. This is a tasty and colorful addition to steaks or chops, better for you than gravy.

recipes.title: Mile High Barbecue Beef
ingredients: 3 lb. chuck roast or round steak
directions: Brown meat in small amount of oil along with celery and onion. Add meat mixture to beef broth and bring to boil.
Simmer 3 hours.
recipes.text: Mile High Barbecue Beef. Brown meat in small amount of oil along with celery and onion. Add meat mixture to beef broth and bring to boil. Simmer 3 hours.

recipes.title: Banana Bread
directions: Cream butter and sugar.
Beat in eggs, one at a time.
Mix dry ingredients; add to creamed mixture.
Beat in mashed bananas.
Add nuts.
Mix well.
Turn into greased 9 x 5 x 3-inch pan.
Bake at 350° for 50 to 60 minutes.
recipes.text: Banana Bread. Cream butter and sugar. Beat in eggs, one at a time. Mix dry ingredients; add to creamed mixture. Beat in mashed bananas. Add nuts. Mix well. Turn into greased 9 x 5 x 3-inch pan. Bake at 350° for 50 to 60 minutes.

recipes.title: Sicilian-Style Meatballs And Fettuccine
directions: Cook fettuccine to desired doneness as directed on package; drain.
Keep warm.
recipes.text: Sicilian-Style Meatballs And Fettuccine. Cook fettuccine to desired doneness as directed on package; drain. Keep warm.

recipes.title: Vegetarian Lasagna(Makes 8 Servings)
ingredients: 2 c. tomato sauce, canned tomatoes or thinned paste
3/4 lb. sliced mushrooms, sauteed in olive oil
3/4 c. dry, small, red beans, cooked tender
directions: Rinse the cooked noodles in cold water.
Set them aside. Saute the onions and garlic in the olive oil until soft and transparent, but not browned.
Stir in the tomato, oregano, basil, parsley and salt.
Cook sauce about 1/2 hour, simmering it and stirring often until it has thickened.
Stir in the sauteed mushrooms and cooked beans.
recipes.text: Vegetarian Lasagna(Makes 8 Servings). Rinse the cooked noodles in cold water. Set them aside. Saute the onions and garlic in the olive oil until soft and transparent, but not browned. Stir in the tomato, oregano, basil, parsley and salt. Cook sauce about 1/2 hour, simmering it and stirring often until it has thickened. Stir in the sauteed mushrooms and cooked beans.

recipes.title: Caramel Corn
directions: Mix brown sugar, butter, corn syrup, salt and baking soda. Melt in microwave.
Pour melted mixture over popcorn.
Stir well and put in microwave for 2 minutes (Medium-high).
Stir 2 more minutes in microwave.
Stir 1 to 2 more minutes in microwave. Spread out on buttered cookie sheet to cool.
Store in airtight container.
recipes.text: Caramel Corn. Mix brown sugar, butter, corn syrup, salt and baking soda. Melt in microwave. Pour melted mixture over popcorn. Stir well and put in microwave for 2 minutes (Medium-high). Stir 2 more minutes in microwave. Stir 1 to 2 more minutes in microwave. Spread out on buttered cookie sheet to cool. Store in airtight container.

recipes.title: Marie Calendars' Cornbread
directions: Mix together with spoon and pour into an 8 x 8-inch greased pan.
Bake at 425° for 20 to 25 minutes.
recipes.text: Marie Calendars' Cornbread. Mix together with spoon and pour into an 8 x 8-inch greased pan. Bake at 425° for 20 to 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Barbecue Spareribs(Baked In Foil)
directions: Use big, flat pan.
Use enough foil to wrap completely and tightly around the ribs.
Season ribs with salt and Creole-Cajun seasoning.
Spread with bottled barbecue sauce, topped with thin slices of onion, then seal tightly in foil.
Bake at 325° about 3 hours, until meat is tender and falling off bone.
Good and easy.
recipes.text: Barbecue Spareribs(Baked In Foil). Use big, flat pan. Use enough foil to wrap completely and tightly around the ribs. Season ribs with salt and Creole-Cajun seasoning. Spread with bottled barbecue sauce, topped with thin slices of onion, then seal tightly in foil. Bake at 325° about 3 hours, until meat is tender and falling off bone. Good and easy.

recipes.title: Potato Latkes
directions: Grate potatoes and drain well.
Blend in remaining ingredients. Drop from a spoon into hot oil and brown on both sides.
recipes.text: Potato Latkes. Grate potatoes and drain well. Blend in remaining ingredients. Drop from a spoon into hot oil and brown on both sides.

recipes.title: Italian Vegetable Soup(Slow-Cooker)
ingredients: 1 (8 oz.) can stewed tomatoes, cut up with juice reserved
directions: Layer in slow-cooker (in order) carrots, onion, celery, potatoes, parsley, garlic, bouillon, basil, salt, pepper and kidney beans with liquid.
Add water.
Do not stir.
Cover and cook on high for 4 to 4 1/2 hours or low for 8 to 9 hours.
