Stir in stewed tomatoes with juice and ham.
Immediately cover and cook on high for 10 to 15 minutes or until heated.
recipes.text: Italian Vegetable Soup(Slow-Cooker). Layer in slow-cooker (in order) carrots, onion, celery, potatoes, parsley, garlic, bouillon, basil, salt, pepper and kidney beans with liquid. Add water. Do not stir. Cover and cook on high for 4 to 4 1/2 hours or low for 8 to 9 hours. Stir in stewed tomatoes with juice and ham. Immediately cover and cook on high for 10 to 15 minutes or until heated.

recipes.title: Frank And Pineapple Kabobs
directions: Cut franks in 1-inch lengths.
Put on skewers alternately with drained pineapple chunks.
Mix together the mustard and the pineapple syrup.
Brush on the skewered franks and pineapple. Broil for 3 to 5 minutes.
Turn over.
Boil for another 3 minutes. Brush mixture on skewered franks after turned over.
Serve hot.
recipes.text: Frank And Pineapple Kabobs. Cut franks in 1-inch lengths. Put on skewers alternately with drained pineapple chunks. Mix together the mustard and the pineapple syrup. Brush on the skewered franks and pineapple. Broil for 3 to 5 minutes. Turn over. Boil for another 3 minutes. Brush mixture on skewered franks after turned over. Serve hot.

recipes.title: Rumaki
directions: You will also need toothpicks.
recipes.text: Rumaki. You will also need toothpicks.

recipes.title: Fruit Slush
ingredients: 1 (6 oz.) can frozen lemonade or 2 cans orange juice
1 (16 oz.) can crushed pineapple and juice
directions: Mix all ingredients together well.
Place in paper or plastic cups.
Cover with Saran Wrap and freeze.
To serve, partially thaw, eat and enjoy.
It's delicious.
recipes.text: Fruit Slush. Mix all ingredients together well. Place in paper or plastic cups. Cover with Saran Wrap and freeze. To serve, partially thaw, eat and enjoy. It's delicious.

recipes.title: Oven Peanut Bars
directions: Mix flour, butter, brown sugar and salt until crumbly.
Pat flat into pans.
Bake at 375°
for 10 minutes.
Melt chips, butter, water and syrup and pour into peanuts.
Spread over hot crumb base and return to oven 10 minutes.
Loosen edges while warm.
Cool and cut into desired sizes.
Makes 48 (2-inch) squares.
recipes.text: Oven Peanut Bars. Mix flour, butter, brown sugar and salt until crumbly. Pat flat into pans. Bake at 375° for 10 minutes. Melt chips, butter, water and syrup and pour into peanuts. Spread over hot crumb base and return to oven 10 minutes. Loosen edges while warm. Cool and cut into desired sizes. Makes 48 (2-inch) squares.

recipes.title: Roux
directions: Mix the flour and oil in
a
heavy pot; stir constantly over a medium fire.
As you
stir,
the
roux
browns
slowly. Don't cook the roux fast, because
as
it
reaches
the
done point, it will burn.	When the roux is a rich dark brown, turn fire
off while continuing to
stir
until
it
cools.
Makes enough roux for stew with one hen or 2 pounds shrimp.
recipes.text: Roux. Mix the flour and oil in a heavy pot; stir constantly over a medium fire. As you stir, the roux browns slowly. Don't cook the roux fast, because as it reaches the done point, it will burn.	When the roux is a rich dark brown, turn fire off while continuing to stir until it cools. Makes enough roux for stew with one hen or 2 pounds shrimp.

recipes.title: Lemon Squares
directions: Cream together flour, butter and confectioners sugar.
Press into a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan.
Bake in a preheated 350° oven until pale gold at edges (about 15 minutes).
Pour lemon topping over hot crust and return to oven until set, about 30 minutes.
Loosen edges; cool.
If desired, sift extra confectioners sugar over top. Cut in squares.
Makes 48 (1 1/2-inch) squares.
recipes.text: Lemon Squares. Cream together flour, butter and confectioners sugar. Press into a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Bake in a preheated 350° oven until pale gold at edges (about 15 minutes). Pour lemon topping over hot crust and return to oven until set, about 30 minutes. Loosen edges; cool. If desired, sift extra confectioners sugar over top. Cut in squares. Makes 48 (1 1/2-inch) squares.

recipes.title: Jalapeno Beans
ingredients: 1 large can pinto beans with jalapeno
directions: Chop bacon, brown and drain.
Brown hamburger and add onion, then fry until onion is limp.
Remove and drain all grease.
Mix all ingredients together. Put in a large casserole and bake in 350° oven for at least one hour.
recipes.text: Jalapeno Beans. Chop bacon, brown and drain. Brown hamburger and add onion, then fry until onion is limp. Remove and drain all grease. Mix all ingredients together. Put in a large casserole and bake in 350° oven for at least one hour.

recipes.title: Broccoli Cornbread
ingredients: 1 (10 oz.) pkg. chopped frozen Broccoli, thawed, not drained
directions: Melt butter in 13x9 inch pan.
Mix all other ingredients together.
Pour batter over butter. Bake at 375 degrees for 30 minutes or until brown.
recipes.text: Broccoli Cornbread. Melt butter in 13x9 inch pan. Mix all other ingredients together. Pour batter over butter. Bake at 375 degrees for 30 minutes or until brown.

recipes.title: Tijuana Pie
ingredients: 1 can Rotel diced tomatoes and chilies
directions: Brown meat and season to taste.
Drain.
While meat is cooking, mix all cans and heat through.
Grease crock pot with non-stick cooking spray.
Layer chips, meat, sauce and cheese, until all is used.
Heat in crock pot until cheese is melted.
recipes.text: Tijuana Pie. Brown meat and season to taste. Drain. While meat is cooking, mix all cans and heat through. Grease crock pot with non-stick cooking spray. Layer chips, meat, sauce and cheese, until all is used. Heat in crock pot until cheese is melted.

recipes.title: Seasoning Mix
directions: Put in bottle or jar.
Cover and shake to mix.
Store in salt shaker.
recipes.text: Seasoning Mix. Put in bottle or jar. Cover and shake to mix. Store in salt shaker.

recipes.title: Apple Cake
directions: Stir all together.
Put in 9 x 13-inch pan.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
Serve with Cool Whip or whipped cream.
recipes.text: Apple Cake. Stir all together. Put in 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350° for 1 hour. Serve with Cool Whip or whipped cream.

recipes.title: Strawberry Shortcake
directions: Preheat oven to 425°.
Combine flour, 2 tablespoons sugar, baking powder, baking soda and salt in a small bowl.
Cut in chilled butter with a pastry blender until mixture resembles coarse cornmeal.
Stir milk into flour mixture, mixing until a soft dough forms.
Knead briefly until dough forms a ball.
Divide dough in half.
Pat dough halves into 2 greased 8-inch layer cake pans. Bake for 10 to 12 minutes or until a cake tester inserted in center comes out clean.
Cool on rack.
recipes.text: Strawberry Shortcake. Preheat oven to 425°. Combine flour, 2 tablespoons sugar, baking powder, baking soda and salt in a small bowl. Cut in chilled butter with a pastry blender until mixture resembles coarse cornmeal. Stir milk into flour mixture, mixing until a soft dough forms. Knead briefly until dough forms a ball. Divide dough in half. Pat dough halves into 2 greased 8-inch layer cake pans. Bake for 10 to 12 minutes or until a cake tester inserted in center comes out clean. Cool on rack.

recipes.title: Cheese Ball
directions: Shred the Cheddar cheese and let stand until softened.
Cream together with softened cream cheese.
Add chopped red pepper, chopped green pepper, garlic and hot pepper.
(Drain off excess juice before adding to cheese.)
Add smidgen Italian seasoning, parsley and oregano.
Add couple drops Worcestershire sauce.
Blend with mixer.
Shape on plate and refrigerate.
Seasonings are really to your own liking.
There is no exact measurement.
Don't worry, you'll get better with practice.
recipes.text: Cheese Ball. Shred the Cheddar cheese and let stand until softened. Cream together with softened cream cheese. Add chopped red pepper, chopped green pepper, garlic and hot pepper. (Drain off excess juice before adding to cheese.) Add smidgen Italian seasoning, parsley and oregano. Add couple drops Worcestershire sauce. Blend with mixer. Shape on plate and refrigerate. Seasonings are really to your own liking. There is no exact measurement. Don't worry, you'll get better with practice.

recipes.title: Paradise Salad
directions: Combine lime jello, boiling water and pineapple juice. Refrigerate and let cool.
Mix cream cheese, crushed pineapple and mayonnaise together.
Mix together the whipping cream and chopped nuts.
When jello mixture has cooled, mix all ingredients together.
Pour into container.
Let set 3 or 4 hours before serving.
recipes.text: Paradise Salad. Combine lime jello, boiling water and pineapple juice. Refrigerate and let cool. Mix cream cheese, crushed pineapple and mayonnaise together. Mix together the whipping cream and chopped nuts. When jello mixture has cooled, mix all ingredients together. Pour into container. Let set 3 or 4 hours before serving.

recipes.title: Crunchy Oatmeal Cookies
directions: Cream
shortening and sugar together until fluffy.
Add egg and
vanilla.
Beat
well.	Add flour that has been sifted with baking
powder, soda and salt.
Gradually stir in rolled oats, coconut, raisins and nuts.	Shape dough into walnut-size balls on ungreased baking sheet.
Bake at 375° for 12 minutes.
recipes.text: Crunchy Oatmeal Cookies. Cream shortening and sugar together until fluffy. Add egg and vanilla. Beat well.	Add flour that has been sifted with baking powder, soda and salt. Gradually stir in rolled oats, coconut, raisins and nuts.	Shape dough into walnut-size balls on ungreased baking sheet. Bake at 375° for 12 minutes.

recipes.title: Throw-Together Beans
directions: Combine all ingredients in crock-pot and cook on high for 3 or 4 hours or on low for 6 hours.
recipes.text: Throw-Together Beans. Combine all ingredients in crock-pot and cook on high for 3 or 4 hours or on low for 6 hours.

recipes.title: Tropical Salad
ingredients: 1 small red onion, sliced thinly and separated into rings
directions: Place above ingredients in a large salad bowl and mix with Lemon Dressing.
recipes.text: Tropical Salad. Place above ingredients in a large salad bowl and mix with Lemon Dressing.

recipes.title: Husband'S Delight Pie
directions: Melt butter.
Pour flour and pecans into small cake pan.
Pour melted butter over. Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.
Chill.
recipes.text: Husband'S Delight Pie. Melt butter. Pour flour and pecans into small cake pan. Pour melted butter over. Bake at 350° for 20 minutes. Chill.

recipes.title: Ham Delights
directions: Split Pepperidge Farm party rolls horizontally.
Spread top and bottom with a mixture of all the ingredients.
Place shredded ham and Swiss cheese squares on each roll.
Wrap in foil and heat 10 minutes at 400° or until cheese begins to melt.
recipes.text: Ham Delights. Split Pepperidge Farm party rolls horizontally. Spread top and bottom with a mixture of all the ingredients. Place shredded ham and Swiss cheese squares on each roll. Wrap in foil and heat 10 minutes at 400° or until cheese begins to melt.

recipes.title: Ultimate Chocolate Chip Cookies
directions: Drop by teaspoons on cookie sheet and bake about 12 to 15 minutes. Take out as edges brown and tops are light brown.
Cool slightly and remove to wire cooling rack.
recipes.text: Ultimate Chocolate Chip Cookies. Drop by teaspoons on cookie sheet and bake about 12 to 15 minutes. Take out as edges brown and tops are light brown. Cool slightly and remove to wire cooling rack.

recipes.title: Pecan Pie
directions: Mix all ingredients in a blender for about 15 seconds. Add 1 1/2 cups pecans. Blend 5 more seconds. Pour into pie shell. Top with whole half pecans. Bake 35 minutes at 400°.
recipes.text: Pecan Pie. Mix all ingredients in a blender for about 15 seconds. Add 1 1/2 cups pecans. Blend 5 more seconds. Pour into pie shell. Top with whole half pecans. Bake 35 minutes at 400°.

recipes.title: Taco Salad
directions: Cook hamburger meat; drain.
Add taco seasoning and 3/4 cup water.
Simmer 5 minutes.
Let cool.
recipes.text: Taco Salad. Cook hamburger meat; drain. Add taco seasoning and 3/4 cup water. Simmer 5 minutes. Let cool.

recipes.title: Date Nut Bread
ingredients: 1/2 medium size jar maraschino cherries, chopped
directions: Place dates and cherries in bowl.
Pour boiling water over them; let stand.
Beat egg until light and add sugar gradually. Sift together flour, soda, baking powder and salt.
Stir in walnuts.
Add date and flour mixtures alternately to egg mixture. Stir in shortening and vanilla.
recipes.text: Date Nut Bread. Place dates and cherries in bowl. Pour boiling water over them; let stand. Beat egg until light and add sugar gradually. Sift together flour, soda, baking powder and salt. Stir in walnuts. Add date and flour mixtures alternately to egg mixture. Stir in shortening and vanilla.

recipes.title: Sparkling Cranberry Punch
directions: Mix cranberry juice and lemonade in punch bowl.
Add water immediately before serving.
Garnish with fresh lemon slices.
If desired, make an ice mold using a portion of the mineral water. Serves 25.
recipes.text: Sparkling Cranberry Punch. Mix cranberry juice and lemonade in punch bowl. Add water immediately before serving. Garnish with fresh lemon slices. If desired, make an ice mold using a portion of the mineral water. Serves 25.

recipes.title: Oreo Delight
ingredients: 1 (3 3/4 oz.) pkg. instant chocolate pie filling
directions: Crush approximately 25 to 30 cookies.
Mix with melted butter; press in 9 x 11-inch pan.
Bake at 350° for 10 minutes.
Cool.
recipes.text: Oreo Delight. Crush approximately 25 to 30 cookies. Mix with melted butter; press in 9 x 11-inch pan. Bake at 350° for 10 minutes. Cool.

recipes.title: Kahlua Cake
directions: Blend all together except chips.
Beat 2 minutes.
Add chips and pour into greased tube pan.
Bake 55 minutes at 350°.
recipes.text: Kahlua Cake. Blend all together except chips. Beat 2 minutes. Add chips and pour into greased tube pan. Bake 55 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Banana Cake
ingredients: 1 (4 oz.) pkg. vanilla instant pudding mix
directions: Combine cake mix, pudding mix, oil, eggs and water in mixer bowl; mix well.
Stir in bananas and pecans.
Spoon into greased and floured Bundt pan.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.
Cool in pan several minutes.
Invert onto serving plate.
recipes.text: Banana Cake. Combine cake mix, pudding mix, oil, eggs and water in mixer bowl; mix well. Stir in bananas and pecans. Spoon into greased and floured Bundt pan. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes. Cool in pan several minutes. Invert onto serving plate.

recipes.title: Gorp
ingredients: 1 c. each cereal: Bran, Wheat, Corn Chex
directions: Mix all the ingredients together for a tasty snack.
Store in an airtight container.
recipes.text: Gorp. Mix all the ingredients together for a tasty snack. Store in an airtight container.

recipes.title: Best Meat Loaf
directions: Mix all ingredients, except butter.
Form into a loaf and place in roaster. Make holes with your finger here and there on top of loaf.
Put margarine in holes.
Put cover on roaster and bake at 400° for 45 minutes or at 250° for 3 hours.
I usually double the recipe so we have some left for sandwiches.
recipes.text: Best Meat Loaf. Mix all ingredients, except butter. Form into a loaf and place in roaster. Make holes with your finger here and there on top of loaf. Put margarine in holes. Put cover on roaster and bake at 400° for 45 minutes or at 250° for 3 hours. I usually double the recipe so we have some left for sandwiches.

recipes.title: Old South Pralines
directions: In large 3 1/2-quart heavy saucepan combine sugar, soda, buttermilk and salt.
Cook over high heat about 5 minutes.
Stir often and scrape bottom of pan.
Mixture will foam up.
Add butter or margarine and 2 cups pecan halves.
Over medium heat, continue cooking, stirring constantly and scraping bottom and sides of pan until candy reaches soft ball stage.
Remove from heat and cool slightly about 2 minutes.
Beat with spoon until thick and creamy.
Drop from tablespoon onto sheet of aluminum foil or waxed paper.
Let cool.
Decorate with remaining pecan halves.
Makes about 20 (2-inch) pralines.
recipes.text: Old South Pralines. In large 3 1/2-quart heavy saucepan combine sugar, soda, buttermilk and salt. Cook over high heat about 5 minutes. Stir often and scrape bottom of pan. Mixture will foam up. Add butter or margarine and 2 cups pecan halves. Over medium heat, continue cooking, stirring constantly and scraping bottom and sides of pan until candy reaches soft ball stage. Remove from heat and cool slightly about 2 minutes. Beat with spoon until thick and creamy. Drop from tablespoon onto sheet of aluminum foil or waxed paper. Let cool. Decorate with remaining pecan halves. Makes about 20 (2-inch) pralines.

recipes.title: Potato Cake
directions: Cream sugar and margarine.
Add eggs, one at a time, beating after each one.
Add potatoes.
Sift together dry ingredients and add alternately with buttermilk.
Add vanilla and nuts.
Pour into 9 x 13 x 2-inch pan.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Potato Cake. Cream sugar and margarine. Add eggs, one at a time, beating after each one. Add potatoes. Sift together dry ingredients and add alternately with buttermilk. Add vanilla and nuts. Pour into 9 x 13 x 2-inch pan. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: One Dish Meal
directions: Mix first 5 ingredients and put in casserole dish.
Put oil, vegex, water, broth and soup into saucepan and cook for 3 minutes. Pour sauce over casserole and mix gently.
Bake in a 350° oven for 1 hour.
Serves 6.
recipes.text: One Dish Meal. Mix first 5 ingredients and put in casserole dish. Put oil, vegex, water, broth and soup into saucepan and cook for 3 minutes. Pour sauce over casserole and mix gently. Bake in a 350° oven for 1 hour. Serves 6.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Layer Cheese Cake
ingredients: dash each of ground cloves and nutmeg
directions: Mix cream cheese, sugar and vanilla with electric mixer. Add eggs. Mix until blended. Stir pumpkin and spices into 1 cup of batter. Pour remaining plain batter into crust. Top with pumpkin batter. Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes. Set. Cool. Refrigerate 3 hours.
recipes.text: Pumpkin Layer Cheese Cake. Mix cream cheese, sugar and vanilla with electric mixer. Add eggs. Mix until blended. Stir pumpkin and spices into 1 cup of batter. Pour remaining plain batter into crust. Top with pumpkin batter. Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes. Set. Cool. Refrigerate 3 hours.

recipes.title: Sour Cream Rhubarb Pie
directions: Pour 1/2 cup sugar over rhubarb in an unbaked pie shell.
Let set for awhile.
Mix remaining ingredients together.
Beat with eggbeater until blended.
Pour over rhubarb and bake at 450° for 40 minutes or until firm.
recipes.text: Sour Cream Rhubarb Pie. Pour 1/2 cup sugar over rhubarb in an unbaked pie shell. Let set for awhile. Mix remaining ingredients together. Beat with eggbeater until blended. Pour over rhubarb and bake at 450° for 40 minutes or until firm.

recipes.title: Pinwheels
ingredients: 1- 4 oz. pkg. Ranch salad dressing mix
directions: In a mixing bowl, beat cream cheese and dressing mix until smooth.
Add red peppers, celery, onions and olives; mix well. Spread on each tortilla.
Roll up tightly.
Wrap in plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 2 hours.
Slice in to 1/2 inch pieces. Yield 15 - 20 servings.
recipes.text: Pinwheels. In a mixing bowl, beat cream cheese and dressing mix until smooth. Add red peppers, celery, onions and olives; mix well. Spread on each tortilla. Roll up tightly. Wrap in plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 2 hours. Slice in to 1/2 inch pieces. Yield 15 - 20 servings.

recipes.title: Lemon Pudding Dessert
ingredients: 1 (8 oz.) pkg. cream cheese, softened (I generally substitute Neufchatel cheese)
2 (3.4 oz. each) pkg. instant lemon pudding mix
directions: In a bowl, cut butter into the flour until crumbly.
Press into an ungreased 9 x 13 pan.
Bake at 350° for 18 to 22 minutes or until set.
Let cool.
In a mixing bowl, beat cream cheese and sugar until smooth.
Fold in 1 cup whipped topping.
Spread over crust.
In a mixing bowl, beat milk and pudding mix for approximately 2 minutes.
Carefully spread over cream cheese layer.
Top with remaining whipped topping.
Refrigerate for at least 1 hour.
Yields 12 to 16 servings.
recipes.text: Lemon Pudding Dessert. In a bowl, cut butter into the flour until crumbly. Press into an ungreased 9 x 13 pan. Bake at 350° for 18 to 22 minutes or until set. Let cool. In a mixing bowl, beat cream cheese and sugar until smooth. Fold in 1 cup whipped topping. Spread over crust. In a mixing bowl, beat milk and pudding mix for approximately 2 minutes. Carefully spread over cream cheese layer. Top with remaining whipped topping. Refrigerate for at least 1 hour. Yields 12 to 16 servings.

recipes.title: Swiss Vegetable Medley
ingredients: 1 (16 oz.) bag frozen mixed broccoli, carrots and cauliflower
1 (10 3/4 oz.) can cream of mushroom soup
directions: Combine vegetables, soup, 1/2 cup cheese, sour cream, pepper, pimento and 1/2 can onions in a casserole dish.
Cover and bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
Top with remaining cheese and onions.
Bake, uncovered, 5 more minutes.
Serves 6.
recipes.text: Swiss Vegetable Medley. Combine vegetables, soup, 1/2 cup cheese, sour cream, pepper, pimento and 1/2 can onions in a casserole dish. Cover and bake at 350° for 30 minutes. Top with remaining cheese and onions. Bake, uncovered, 5 more minutes. Serves 6.

recipes.title: Chicken Rotel Spaghetti
ingredients: 1 can Ro-Tel tomatoes with chilies, drained
directions: Cook chicken until tender. Save 1 1/2 cups of broth and cook spaghetti in chicken broth; do not drain. Dice chicken into bite size pieces. Dice cheese and add to hot spaghetti. Stir until cheese is melted. Saute onion in butter. Add all ingredients. Pour into two 9 x 13-inch pans. Bake at 350° for 30 to 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Chicken Rotel Spaghetti. Cook chicken until tender. Save 1 1/2 cups of broth and cook spaghetti in chicken broth; do not drain. Dice chicken into bite size pieces. Dice cheese and add to hot spaghetti. Stir until cheese is melted. Saute onion in butter. Add all ingredients. Pour into two 9 x 13-inch pans. Bake at 350° for 30 to 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Fried Chicken
ingredients: 1 whole cut up fryer or your favorite pieces
directions: Place cut up and skinned chicken in cold water; salt and drop several ice cubes in water. Soak for 45 to 60 minutes. Rinse chicken; drain and salt to taste. Roll chicken in flour and fry in electric skillet in hot, melted Crisco on 300° until done; turn 2 to 3 times. Enjoy tender-moist golden fried chicken.
recipes.text: Fried Chicken. Place cut up and skinned chicken in cold water; salt and drop several ice cubes in water. Soak for 45 to 60 minutes. Rinse chicken; drain and salt to taste. Roll chicken in flour and fry in electric skillet in hot, melted Crisco on 300° until done; turn 2 to 3 times. Enjoy tender-moist golden fried chicken.

recipes.title: Bean Casserole
directions: Drain all beans, except pork and beans and mix in large, long casserole dish.
Rinse pork and beans can out with 1/2 cup water and add to casserole.
Mix together the brown sugar, mustard and vinegar; mix thoroughly with beans.
On top of mixture, put 1/2 pound raw bacon.
Separate the onion into rings and place on top of bacon.
Bake in a 350° oven for 1 1/2 hours.
Serve hot or cold!
recipes.text: Bean Casserole. Drain all beans, except pork and beans and mix in large, long casserole dish. Rinse pork and beans can out with 1/2 cup water and add to casserole. Mix together the brown sugar, mustard and vinegar; mix thoroughly with beans. On top of mixture, put 1/2 pound raw bacon. Separate the onion into rings and place on top of bacon. Bake in a 350° oven for 1 1/2 hours. Serve hot or cold!

recipes.title: Chicken Lasagna
ingredients: 3 or 4 cooked, boned chicken breasts, cut into bite size pieces
directions: Cook lasagna noodles according to package directions.
recipes.text: Chicken Lasagna. Cook lasagna noodles according to package directions.

recipes.title: Grapefruit Chiffon Cake
directions: Sift together flour, sugar, baking powder and salt.
Make a well in the middle.
Add in order egg yolks, oil, peel and juice. Beat briefly until smooth.
recipes.text: Grapefruit Chiffon Cake. Sift together flour, sugar, baking powder and salt. Make a well in the middle. Add in order egg yolks, oil, peel and juice. Beat briefly until smooth.

recipes.title: Kickin' Potatoes
ingredients: 1 1/2 c. shredded Monterey Jack cheese, divided
1 (4 oz.) can chopped green chilies, drained
1 Tbsp. minced cilantro (or 1 tsp. dried parsley)
directions: Preheat oven to 375°.
Mix half-and-half, hot pepper sauce and cumin.
Peel potatoes and cut into thin slices or julienne shreds.
Reserve 3 Tbsp. cheese.
Alternate layers of potatoes, chilies, onion, half-and-half mixture, and cheese in a lightly greased casserole dish.
Cover with foil.
Bake for 30 minutes or until potatoes are tender.
Remove foil.
Arrange tomato slices on top and sprinkle with reserved cheese.
Bake for five more minutes or broil for 2-3 minutes until cheese is golden brown and bubbly. Sprinkle with cilantro and serve.
Serves 6.
recipes.text: Kickin' Potatoes. Preheat oven to 375°. Mix half-and-half, hot pepper sauce and cumin. Peel potatoes and cut into thin slices or julienne shreds. Reserve 3 Tbsp. cheese. Alternate layers of potatoes, chilies, onion, half-and-half mixture, and cheese in a lightly greased casserole dish. Cover with foil. Bake for 30 minutes or until potatoes are tender. Remove foil. Arrange tomato slices on top and sprinkle with reserved cheese. Bake for five more minutes or broil for 2-3 minutes until cheese is golden brown and bubbly. Sprinkle with cilantro and serve. Serves 6.

recipes.title: Zucchini Bread
directions: Combine eggs, sugar and oil.
Add baking powder and cinnamon. Stir in zucchini, walnuts and vanilla.
Pour into greased loaf pans.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour until top springs back.
recipes.text: Zucchini Bread. Combine eggs, sugar and oil. Add baking powder and cinnamon. Stir in zucchini, walnuts and vanilla. Pour into greased loaf pans. Bake at 350° for 1 hour until top springs back.

recipes.title: Greek Chicken Salad
ingredients: 2 medium cucumbers, peeled, seeded and chopped
directions: Combine the first 5 ingredients.
Set aside.
In small bowl, combine remaining ingredients.
Toss with chicken mixture.
Cover and chill for several hours.
(Light mayonnaise may be used.)
recipes.text: Greek Chicken Salad. Combine the first 5 ingredients. Set aside. In small bowl, combine remaining ingredients. Toss with chicken mixture. Cover and chill for several hours. (Light mayonnaise may be used.)

recipes.title: Chili Sauce
directions: Ketchup spice may be used and others omitted.
recipes.text: Chili Sauce. Ketchup spice may be used and others omitted.

recipes.title: Squash Souffle
directions: Drain squash except for 1/2 cup liquid.
Add carrots, pimientos, onion, sour cream, cream of chicken soup and 1 cup Cheddar cheese.
Mix thoroughly.
Mix 3/4 stuffing with melted butter.
Line casserole, pouring squash and sprinkle with remaining 1/4 stuffing and 1/2 cup cheese.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Squash Souffle. Drain squash except for 1/2 cup liquid. Add carrots, pimientos, onion, sour cream, cream of chicken soup and 1 cup Cheddar cheese. Mix thoroughly. Mix 3/4 stuffing with melted butter. Line casserole, pouring squash and sprinkle with remaining 1/4 stuffing and 1/2 cup cheese. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Mom'S Chocolate Pie
ingredients: 1 (12 oz.) can evaporated milk with enough water to make 2 c. liquid
directions: Mix sugar, flour, cocoa and milk together in a large saucepan. As mixture begins to simmer, add egg yolks.
Cook on medium heat until mixture thickens.
Remove from heat.
Add flavoring and margarine.
Pour into cooked pie shell.
Cover with meringue.
recipes.text: Mom'S Chocolate Pie. Mix sugar, flour, cocoa and milk together in a large saucepan. As mixture begins to simmer, add egg yolks. Cook on medium heat until mixture thickens. Remove from heat. Add flavoring and margarine. Pour into cooked pie shell. Cover with meringue.

recipes.title: Jean'S Spanish Rice
directions: Brown rice in oil.
Add water, garlic, cominos and tomato sauce.
When it starts to boil, cover and reduce heat.
Simmer for 15 minutes.
Do not uncover during cooking.
recipes.text: Jean'S Spanish Rice. Brown rice in oil. Add water, garlic, cominos and tomato sauce. When it starts to boil, cover and reduce heat. Simmer for 15 minutes. Do not uncover during cooking.

recipes.title: Lime Gelatin Salad
directions: Prepare jello as directed on the package, using the juice from the drained pineapple for a portion of the liquid.
Set until this jells.
Soften the cream cheese and beat the jello into the cheese.
Fold in the whipped cream, mayonnaise, drained pineapple and nuts.
Pour into a jello mold and refrigerate until firm.
recipes.text: Lime Gelatin Salad. Prepare jello as directed on the package, using the juice from the drained pineapple for a portion of the liquid. Set until this jells. Soften the cream cheese and beat the jello into the cheese. Fold in the whipped cream, mayonnaise, drained pineapple and nuts. Pour into a jello mold and refrigerate until firm.

recipes.title: Microwave Fudge
ingredients: 1/2 c. pecans, walnuts or peanut butter
directions: Mix together the sugar, cocoa, salt and milk in a glass bowl; top with 1/2 cup butter.
Cook on High in 9 x 9-inch glass dish for 3 minutes.
Stir well.
Mix in nuts or leave plain.
Refrigerate. Cut after 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Microwave Fudge. Mix together the sugar, cocoa, salt and milk in a glass bowl; top with 1/2 cup butter. Cook on High in 9 x 9-inch glass dish for 3 minutes. Stir well. Mix in nuts or leave plain. Refrigerate. Cut after 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Good Spread
ingredients: chopped celery, green pepper, onion, canned shrimp and hard-boiled eggs
directions: Thin cream cheese with mayonnaise and curry, enough so it will spread thin on a plate.
Layer the chopped food on top of cream cheese. Serve with crackers.
recipes.text: Good Spread. Thin cream cheese with mayonnaise and curry, enough so it will spread thin on a plate. Layer the chopped food on top of cream cheese. Serve with crackers.

recipes.title: Cranberry Apple Ade
directions: Mix and serve cold.
recipes.text: Cranberry Apple Ade. Mix and serve cold.

recipes.title: Broccoli Cheese Chicken
directions: Cook chicken in skillet on medium heat 10 minutes.
Brown on both sides.
Spoon off fat.
Stir in soup, milk and pepper.
Heat to boiling.
Add broccoli.
Simmer 10 minutes on low heat or until tender and broccoli is done.
Cook 25 minutes.
recipes.text: Broccoli Cheese Chicken. Cook chicken in skillet on medium heat 10 minutes. Brown on both sides. Spoon off fat. Stir in soup, milk and pepper. Heat to boiling. Add broccoli. Simmer 10 minutes on low heat or until tender and broccoli is done. Cook 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Peach Dessert
ingredients: 2 large cans sliced peaches and juice
directions: Butter 9 x 13-inch pan.
Add peaches and juice.
Add dry cake mix, coconut and nuts.
Drizzle melted oleo over top.
Bake at 325° for 50 to 60 minutes.
recipes.text: Peach Dessert. Butter 9 x 13-inch pan. Add peaches and juice. Add dry cake mix, coconut and nuts. Drizzle melted oleo over top. Bake at 325° for 50 to 60 minutes.

recipes.title: Yummy Carrots
directions: Cook carrots for 10 minutes, put aside.
In large skillet mix honey, mustard, curry powder and lemon juice.
Add carrots, cook stirring 3 more minutes.
recipes.text: Yummy Carrots. Cook carrots for 10 minutes, put aside. In large skillet mix honey, mustard, curry powder and lemon juice. Add carrots, cook stirring 3 more minutes.

recipes.title: Chocolate Pies
directions: First lightly brown pie shells in oven.
Set aside to cool. In a double boiler, melt margarine.
Add milk.
Separate egg yolks.
Save whites and store in refrigerator.
Stir egg yolks with spoon and add to milk and butter mixture in a double boiler (before milk gets hot).
In a bowl, mix together sugar, salt, flour and cocoa.
Add to mixture in double boiler.
Stir continually until filling thickens.
Add flavoring.
Pour filling in pie shells.
Beat egg whites until foamy; add 1/2 cup of sugar and beat until stiff.
Spread over pies and lightly brown in a 350° oven.
recipes.text: Chocolate Pies. First lightly brown pie shells in oven. Set aside to cool. In a double boiler, melt margarine. Add milk. Separate egg yolks. Save whites and store in refrigerator. Stir egg yolks with spoon and add to milk and butter mixture in a double boiler (before milk gets hot). In a bowl, mix together sugar, salt, flour and cocoa. Add to mixture in double boiler. Stir continually until filling thickens. Add flavoring. Pour filling in pie shells. Beat egg whites until foamy; add 1/2 cup of sugar and beat until stiff. Spread over pies and lightly brown in a 350° oven.

recipes.title: White Chocolate Cheesecake
ingredients: 2 c. butter cookies or graham cracker crumbs
directions: Combine crumbs, chocolate and sugar; add butter.
Mix and press in pan.
recipes.text: White Chocolate Cheesecake. Combine crumbs, chocolate and sugar; add butter. Mix and press in pan.

recipes.title: Fresh Fruit Dip
directions: Blend cream cheese and marshmallow cream thoroughly.
Serve with strawberries, pear slices or other fruits.
Makes 16 servings.
Two teaspoons contains 92 calories and 5 grams fat.
recipes.text: Fresh Fruit Dip. Blend cream cheese and marshmallow cream thoroughly. Serve with strawberries, pear slices or other fruits. Makes 16 servings. Two teaspoons contains 92 calories and 5 grams fat.

recipes.title: Cranberry Salad
directions: Cook pineapple juice and sugar together until sugar dissolves. Add crushed pineapple and cranberry sauce.
Mix well.
Add nuts. Mix and pour into container and refrigerate until congealed.
Can be served with turkey and other meats.
recipes.text: Cranberry Salad. Cook pineapple juice and sugar together until sugar dissolves. Add crushed pineapple and cranberry sauce. Mix well. Add nuts. Mix and pour into container and refrigerate until congealed. Can be served with turkey and other meats.

recipes.title: Chocolate Chunk Brownies
directions: Melt butter.
Add the sugar, eggs, cocoa, vanilla and flour. Coarsely chop the chocolate squares, keeping in large chunks.
Mix the chocolate and nuts with the batter.
recipes.text: Chocolate Chunk Brownies. Melt butter. Add the sugar, eggs, cocoa, vanilla and flour. Coarsely chop the chocolate squares, keeping in large chunks. Mix the chocolate and nuts with the batter.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter-Cream Cheese Pie
directions: Beat cream cheese and sugar until light and fluffy.
Add peanut butter and milk.
Beat until smooth.
Fold in Cool Whip. Pour into pie crust.
Chill 5 to 6 hours.
Before serving, sprinkle with chopped peanuts.
This pie freezes well.
recipes.text: Peanut Butter-Cream Cheese Pie. Beat cream cheese and sugar until light and fluffy. Add peanut butter and milk. Beat until smooth. Fold in Cool Whip. Pour into pie crust. Chill 5 to 6 hours. Before serving, sprinkle with chopped peanuts. This pie freezes well.

recipes.title: Zucchini Bread
directions: Mix all ingredients.
Pour into loaf pan.
Bake at 345° for 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Zucchini Bread. Mix all ingredients. Pour into loaf pan. Bake at 345° for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Nichole'S Savory Cheddar Bread
directions: Combine
flour,
baking
powder,
sugar,
onion
salt, oregano,
dry
mustard
and grated cheese; set aside.
Combine well
beaten
egg, milk and melted butter;
add all at once to dry ingredients, stirring just until moistened.
Spread batter in a greased 8 1/2 x 4 1/2-inch loaf pan.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes. Yield:
1 loaf.
recipes.text: Nichole'S Savory Cheddar Bread. Combine flour, baking powder, sugar, onion salt, oregano, dry mustard and grated cheese; set aside. Combine well beaten egg, milk and melted butter; add all at once to dry ingredients, stirring just until moistened. Spread batter in a greased 8 1/2 x 4 1/2-inch loaf pan. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes. Yield: 1 loaf.

recipes.title: Spanish Rice
directions: Brown onion and meat in skillet.
Mix rice, juice, salt and pepper; sugar to taste. Bake 1 hour at 350°.
recipes.text: Spanish Rice. Brown onion and meat in skillet. Mix rice, juice, salt and pepper; sugar to taste. Bake 1 hour at 350°.

recipes.title: Lemon Broiled Fish
ingredients: 3/4 c. unsalted sweet butter or margarine, melted
3 lb. fresh fish (fillet of sole, flounder, haddock, halibut, salmon, trout or whiting)
directions: Combine lemon juice, butter and sage.
Pour over fish. Marinate in refrigerator at least 1 hour.
Remove fish from marinade, reserving marinade.
Broil fish until it flakes easily when tested with a fork, brushing occasionally with marinade.
recipes.text: Lemon Broiled Fish. Combine lemon juice, butter and sage. Pour over fish. Marinate in refrigerator at least 1 hour. Remove fish from marinade, reserving marinade. Broil fish until it flakes easily when tested with a fork, brushing occasionally with marinade.

recipes.title: Julie'S Chicken And Dumplings
directions: Boil chicken with salt and pepper. Remove skin and bones from chicken, when the chicken has cooked up tender, in a large pan, add broth from boiled chicken with 2 cans of chicken broth, add a tsp. of butter. Boil on medium heat. In a bowl, combine flour, eggs and water. Make sure the flour mixture is stiff. On a floured surface, roll out dough, cut into 2 inch strips or squares. Drop dumplings into boiling chicken broth. Stir gently with a fork between each rolling of dumpling. Add chicken, let set for about 10 minutes. Enjoy!
recipes.text: Julie'S Chicken And Dumplings. Boil chicken with salt and pepper. Remove skin and bones from chicken, when the chicken has cooked up tender, in a large pan, add broth from boiled chicken with 2 cans of chicken broth, add a tsp. of butter. Boil on medium heat. In a bowl, combine flour, eggs and water. Make sure the flour mixture is stiff. On a floured surface, roll out dough, cut into 2 inch strips or squares. Drop dumplings into boiling chicken broth. Stir gently with a fork between each rolling of dumpling. Add chicken, let set for about 10 minutes. Enjoy!

recipes.title: Chicken Broccoli Oriental
ingredients: 1 medium green or sweet red pepper, cut into 1-inch sq.
directions: Cook chicken in skillet until browned.
Add onions and pepper; cook 5 minutes or until vegetables are tender-crisp.
Stir in soup, water and soy sauce, heat to boiling, reduce heat to low.
Cover and simmer 5 minutes or until vegetables are tender.
Serve over rice.
recipes.text: Chicken Broccoli Oriental. Cook chicken in skillet until browned. Add onions and pepper; cook 5 minutes or until vegetables are tender-crisp. Stir in soup, water and soy sauce, heat to boiling, reduce heat to low. Cover and simmer 5 minutes or until vegetables are tender. Serve over rice.

recipes.title: Spinach Dip
directions: Thaw and squeeze spinach until dry.
Stir together remaining ingredients.
Blend well, cover and refrigerate several hours. Stir before serving.
recipes.text: Spinach Dip. Thaw and squeeze spinach until dry. Stir together remaining ingredients. Blend well, cover and refrigerate several hours. Stir before serving.

recipes.title: Chicken Or Beef Marinade
directions: Mix all ingredients together until blended well.
Pour over chicken or beef or both; cover and refrigerate 3 to 12 hours before cooking.
recipes.text: Chicken Or Beef Marinade. Mix all ingredients together until blended well. Pour over chicken or beef or both; cover and refrigerate 3 to 12 hours before cooking.

recipes.title: Zucchini Bread
ingredients: 2 c. loosely packed, no seed, coarsely grated zucchini
directions: Beat eggs until frothy.
Add sugar, oil and vanilla; beat until thick and lemon colored.
Stir in zucchini.
Sift flour with cinnamon, soda, salt and baking powder.
Add to zucchini mixture. Fold in walnuts.
Pour mixture into 2 oiled and floured loaf pans. Bake in preheated 350° oven for 1 hour or until a tester comes out clean.
Let cool in pans for 10 minutes.
Invert loaves on rack and cool completely.
recipes.text: Zucchini Bread. Beat eggs until frothy. Add sugar, oil and vanilla; beat until thick and lemon colored. Stir in zucchini. Sift flour with cinnamon, soda, salt and baking powder. Add to zucchini mixture. Fold in walnuts. Pour mixture into 2 oiled and floured loaf pans. Bake in preheated 350° oven for 1 hour or until a tester comes out clean. Let cool in pans for 10 minutes. Invert loaves on rack and cool completely.

recipes.title: Chocolate Chess Pie
ingredients: 2 eggs, beaten slightly (do not overbeat eggs)
directions: Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Chocolate Chess Pie. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Apricot Nectar Cake
ingredients: 1 box Duncan Hines Lemon Supreme cake mix
directions: Heat oven to 325°.
Grease and flour a 10-inch tube pan. Empty mix into a large bowl.
Blend in oil, apricot nectar and eggs.
Beat at high speed for 4 minutes.
Bake 30 to 35 minutes. Cool in pan.
Remove and dribble glaze over cake.
recipes.text: Apricot Nectar Cake. Heat oven to 325°. Grease and flour a 10-inch tube pan. Empty mix into a large bowl. Blend in oil, apricot nectar and eggs. Beat at high speed for 4 minutes. Bake 30 to 35 minutes. Cool in pan. Remove and dribble glaze over cake.

recipes.title: Watergate Congealed Salad
ingredients: 1 (20 oz.) can crushed pineapple and juice
directions: Mix pudding, pineapple with juice, nuts and marshmallows together.
Fold in Cool Whip topping.
Keep in refrigerator.
recipes.text: Watergate Congealed Salad. Mix pudding, pineapple with juice, nuts and marshmallows together. Fold in Cool Whip topping. Keep in refrigerator.

recipes.title: Microwave Baked Beans
directions: Place cut up bacon in a 2-quart casserole.
Microwave on High 4 to 5 minutes or until crispy.
Remove bacon and set aside.
Add onion, green pepper and celery to bacon drippings. Micro on High for 5 to 6 minutes or until tender.
Drain off grease.
Add bacon and remaining ingredients.
Cover with a tight lid or plastic wrap.
Micro on High for 5 to 6 minutes until bubbly. Stir and then micro on Medium for an additional 10 to 15 minutes.
Yields 6 to 8 servings.
recipes.text: Microwave Baked Beans. Place cut up bacon in a 2-quart casserole. Microwave on High 4 to 5 minutes or until crispy. Remove bacon and set aside. Add onion, green pepper and celery to bacon drippings. Micro on High for 5 to 6 minutes or until tender. Drain off grease. Add bacon and remaining ingredients. Cover with a tight lid or plastic wrap. Micro on High for 5 to 6 minutes until bubbly. Stir and then micro on Medium for an additional 10 to 15 minutes. Yields 6 to 8 servings.

recipes.title: Chicken Spaghetti
directions: Cook spaghetti and drain.
Fry bacon crisp, drain and put aside.
Fry chicken and onion in bacon grease until chicken is cooked.
Add soup, milk and garlic to chicken. Add the Mozzarella. Stir until blended. Add spaghetti. Stir until well blended.
Pour into dish and top with Parmesan cheese and crumbled bacon. Bake at 350° approximately 20 minutes or until bubbly and thick.
recipes.text: Chicken Spaghetti. Cook spaghetti and drain. Fry bacon crisp, drain and put aside. Fry chicken and onion in bacon grease until chicken is cooked. Add soup, milk and garlic to chicken. Add the Mozzarella. Stir until blended. Add spaghetti. Stir until well blended. Pour into dish and top with Parmesan cheese and crumbled bacon. Bake at 350° approximately 20 minutes or until bubbly and thick.

recipes.title: Best Ever Banana Bread
directions: In a large bowl, stir together flour, sugar, baking soda and salt.
recipes.text: Best Ever Banana Bread. In a large bowl, stir together flour, sugar, baking soda and salt.

recipes.title: Pollo Al Chilindron
ingredients: 1 large sweet green pepper, cut in strips
1 large sweet red pepper, cut in strips
1 large or 2 medium tomatoes, peeled and chopped
1 Tbsp. fresh basil or oregano, minced (optional)
directions: Dredge chicken pieces in flour seasoned with salt and pepper. Heat olive oil and add garlic; remove when browned.
Brown chicken.
Add ham and onion.
Cook until onion is golden.
Add the peppers and cook over medium to low heat until tender.
Add the tomatoes and cook over low heat until the chicken is cooked through.
Serves 4 to 6.
recipes.text: Pollo Al Chilindron. Dredge chicken pieces in flour seasoned with salt and pepper. Heat olive oil and add garlic; remove when browned. Brown chicken. Add ham and onion. Cook until onion is golden. Add the peppers and cook over medium to low heat until tender. Add the tomatoes and cook over low heat until the chicken is cooked through. Serves 4 to 6.

recipes.title: Grits Casserole
directions: Stir all together well and bake 1 hour in 300° oven.
recipes.text: Grits Casserole. Stir all together well and bake 1 hour in 300° oven.

recipes.title: Roasted Chicken
directions: Wash and prepare chicken for roasting.
Saute the chopped onions in the butter for 5 minutes.
Add the dried fruit and saute for 5 minutes.
Remove from heat.
Add seasoning and let cool for a few minutes.
recipes.text: Roasted Chicken. Wash and prepare chicken for roasting. Saute the chopped onions in the butter for 5 minutes. Add the dried fruit and saute for 5 minutes. Remove from heat. Add seasoning and let cool for a few minutes.

recipes.title: Easy No-Cook Fudge
directions: Cream the cream cheese until soft and smooth.
Slowly blend in sugar; add melted chocolate and other ingredients.
Press into well-buttered shallow pan; refrigerate until firm.
For softer fudge, blend in 1 teaspoon milk.
recipes.text: Easy No-Cook Fudge. Cream the cream cheese until soft and smooth. Slowly blend in sugar; add melted chocolate and other ingredients. Press into well-buttered shallow pan; refrigerate until firm. For softer fudge, blend in 1 teaspoon milk.

recipes.title: No Bake Chocolate Cookies
directions: Mix sugar, cocoa and oleo.
Heat until it comes to a boil, then cook for 1 minute.
Add peanut butter, vanilla and oatmeal; mix well.
Drop by spoonfuls on waxed paper.
recipes.text: No Bake Chocolate Cookies. Mix sugar, cocoa and oleo. Heat until it comes to a boil, then cook for 1 minute. Add peanut butter, vanilla and oatmeal; mix well. Drop by spoonfuls on waxed paper.

recipes.title: Soft Pumpkin Cookies
directions: Heat oven to 375°.
Mix sugar, pumpkin, shortening and orange peel.
Stir in flour, baking powder, baking soda, cinnamon and salt.
Stir in raisins and nuts.
Drop dough by teaspoonfuls onto ungreased baking sheet.
Bake until light brown, 8 to 10 minutes. Makes about 4 dozen.
recipes.text: Soft Pumpkin Cookies. Heat oven to 375°. Mix sugar, pumpkin, shortening and orange peel. Stir in flour, baking powder, baking soda, cinnamon and salt. Stir in raisins and nuts. Drop dough by teaspoonfuls onto ungreased baking sheet. Bake until light brown, 8 to 10 minutes. Makes about 4 dozen.

recipes.title: Orange Blossom Crepes
directions: In small mixing bowl mix cheese with milk and almond extract. Add finely chopped almonds.
Spread onto center of crepe (crepes must be thin, or they will split).
Roll up and set aside.
In large skillet or chafing dish, melt butter.
Stir in sugar and lemon juice.
Dissolve cornstarch in orange juice.
Add orange juice mixture, orange liqueur and grated peel to butter.
Cook on low heat, stirring constantly until thick and translucent.
Put filled crepes in skillet or chafing dish of hot orange sauce.
Heat to boiling.
Pour warm cognac over all.
Ignite with long match. Spoon flaming sauce over crepes.
Garnish each with toasted almonds.
Serve with dessert coffee or Espresso.
recipes.text: Orange Blossom Crepes. In small mixing bowl mix cheese with milk and almond extract. Add finely chopped almonds. Spread onto center of crepe (crepes must be thin, or they will split). Roll up and set aside. In large skillet or chafing dish, melt butter. Stir in sugar and lemon juice. Dissolve cornstarch in orange juice. Add orange juice mixture, orange liqueur and grated peel to butter. Cook on low heat, stirring constantly until thick and translucent. Put filled crepes in skillet or chafing dish of hot orange sauce. Heat to boiling. Pour warm cognac over all. Ignite with long match. Spoon flaming sauce over crepes. Garnish each with toasted almonds. Serve with dessert coffee or Espresso.

recipes.title: Squash Casserole
directions: Mix all ingredients.
Put in baking dish.
Bake at 300° for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Squash Casserole. Mix all ingredients. Put in baking dish. Bake at 300° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Chicken Cacciatore
ingredients: 2 1/2 to 3 lb. chicken, cut into serving pieces
directions: In oblong baking dish, arrange chicken.
Combine remaining ingredients and spoon over chicken.
recipes.text: Chicken Cacciatore. In oblong baking dish, arrange chicken. Combine remaining ingredients and spoon over chicken.

recipes.title: Frozen Lemon Pie
ingredients: 3 egg yolks, 2 egg whites, beaten, reserve one egg white
1 lemon, grated and juice of lemon
directions: Beat eggs, add sugar and lemon. Cook in a double boiler until custard thickens. Let cool. Add tbsp. of sugar to egg white and beat. Add to the cool mixture. Fold in whipped cream. Layer 3/4 of the crumbs mixture in a 1 1/2 qt. rectangular pyrex dish. Spread lemon mixture over crumb layer. Sprinkle the remaining crumbs over the lemon mixture. Put in freezer and chill. Cut and serve.
recipes.text: Frozen Lemon Pie. Beat eggs, add sugar and lemon. Cook in a double boiler until custard thickens. Let cool. Add tbsp. of sugar to egg white and beat. Add to the cool mixture. Fold in whipped cream. Layer 3/4 of the crumbs mixture in a 1 1/2 qt. rectangular pyrex dish. Spread lemon mixture over crumb layer. Sprinkle the remaining crumbs over the lemon mixture. Put in freezer and chill. Cut and serve.

recipes.title: Bath Salts
directions: Put Epsom salt in a glass or metal bowl, not plastic because it may stain.
Mix in the glycerin, a few drops of food coloring and enough perfume to make a fragrant mixture.
Slowly add this mixture to the Epsom salt and stir well.
For a decorative look, place the bath salts in a pretty jar and add a bow.
Now you can enjoy luxurious baths without spending a fortune.
recipes.text: Bath Salts. Put Epsom salt in a glass or metal bowl, not plastic because it may stain. Mix in the glycerin, a few drops of food coloring and enough perfume to make a fragrant mixture. Slowly add this mixture to the Epsom salt and stir well. For a decorative look, place the bath salts in a pretty jar and add a bow. Now you can enjoy luxurious baths without spending a fortune.

recipes.title: Easy Beef Stroganoff
directions: Brown ground beef, drain.
Add onion and cook until softened. Add the can of soup and sour cream and stir well.
Add garlic powder, Worcestershire and salt and pepper.
Simmer over medium to low heat for 10 minutes.
Serve over cooked rice.
recipes.text: Easy Beef Stroganoff. Brown ground beef, drain. Add onion and cook until softened. Add the can of soup and sour cream and stir well. Add garlic powder, Worcestershire and salt and pepper. Simmer over medium to low heat for 10 minutes. Serve over cooked rice.

recipes.title: Chicken Kiev
ingredients: 6 chicken breast halves, skinned and boned
directions: Combine butter and seasonings; blend thoroughly.
Shape butter mixture into a stick; cover and freeze about 45 minutes or until firm.
Place each piece of chicken between 2 pieces of wax paper. Flatten each chicken piece to 1/4-inch thickness using a meat mallet or rolling pin.
Cut stick of butter mixture into six pats; place a pat in center of each chicken breast.
Fold long sides of chicken over butter; fold ends over and secure with a wooden pick. Dredge each piece of chicken in flour; dip in egg and coat with bread crumbs.
Fry chicken in 1 inch hot oil (350°).
Cook 5 minutes on each side or until browned.
Yields 6 servings.
recipes.text: Chicken Kiev. Combine butter and seasonings; blend thoroughly. Shape butter mixture into a stick; cover and freeze about 45 minutes or until firm. Place each piece of chicken between 2 pieces of wax paper. Flatten each chicken piece to 1/4-inch thickness using a meat mallet or rolling pin. Cut stick of butter mixture into six pats; place a pat in center of each chicken breast. Fold long sides of chicken over butter; fold ends over and secure with a wooden pick. Dredge each piece of chicken in flour; dip in egg and coat with bread crumbs. Fry chicken in 1 inch hot oil (350°). Cook 5 minutes on each side or until browned. Yields 6 servings.

recipes.title: Quick And Delicious Chicken And Stuffing
directions: Mix Stove Top stuffing and place in center of casserole dish. Mix
the
soup with the milk and parsley flakes.
Cover bottom of dish on outer edges of stuffing with a little of the soup mixture.
Place boneless chicken breast pieces over soup mixture. Pour
the
remaining
soup mixture over entire dish. Cover with foil and bake at 400° for 15 minutes.
Remove foil and bake another 10 minutes or until chicken is cooked.
recipes.text: Quick And Delicious Chicken And Stuffing. Mix Stove Top stuffing and place in center of casserole dish. Mix the soup with the milk and parsley flakes. Cover bottom of dish on outer edges of stuffing with a little of the soup mixture. Place boneless chicken breast pieces over soup mixture. Pour the remaining soup mixture over entire dish. Cover with foil and bake at 400° for 15 minutes. Remove foil and bake another 10 minutes or until chicken is cooked.

recipes.title: O'Henry Bars
directions: Mix together oatmeal, syrup, butter and vanilla; pat down in a well-greased pan so it is about 1/2-inch thick.
Bake at 350° until light brown, approximately 10 to 15 minutes.
Don't overbake!
recipes.text: O'Henry Bars. Mix together oatmeal, syrup, butter and vanilla; pat down in a well-greased pan so it is about 1/2-inch thick. Bake at 350° until light brown, approximately 10 to 15 minutes. Don't overbake!

recipes.title: Yeast Rolls
directions: Add sugar, salt and margarine to milk.
Stir and let cool. Separately, add yeast and 1 teaspoon sugar and 1/4 cup water. Stir and let stand 10 minutes.
Mix together eggs, yeast and milk. Add two cups flour until smooth.
Add remaining flour; cover and let rise until doubles. Make big balls.
Place on greased pan. Let rise 45 minutes.
Bake at 400° for 10 to 12 minutes.
Makes 3 dozen.
recipes.text: Yeast Rolls. Add sugar, salt and margarine to milk. Stir and let cool. Separately, add yeast and 1 teaspoon sugar and 1/4 cup water. Stir and let stand 10 minutes. Mix together eggs, yeast and milk. Add two cups flour until smooth. Add remaining flour; cover and let rise until doubles. Make big balls. Place on greased pan. Let rise 45 minutes. Bake at 400° for 10 to 12 minutes. Makes 3 dozen.

recipes.title: Lazy Lasagna
directions: Brown meat in a large saucepan and drain.
Add next 4 ingredients.
Bring to boil and simmer for 10 minutes.
In a small bowl, mix Ricotta cheese or cottage cheese, egg and Parmesan cheese.
Put a little of the meat sauce in bottom of 13 x 9 baking dish and alternate layers as follows:
noodles, 1/3 meat sauce, half of cheese mixture.
Repeat and then top with remaining meat sauce.
Sprinkle Mozzarella cheese on top and cover with foil. Bake at 350° for one hour or until noodles are tender.
Let stand 10 minutes before cutting.
recipes.text: Lazy Lasagna. Brown meat in a large saucepan and drain. Add next 4 ingredients. Bring to boil and simmer for 10 minutes. In a small bowl, mix Ricotta cheese or cottage cheese, egg and Parmesan cheese. Put a little of the meat sauce in bottom of 13 x 9 baking dish and alternate layers as follows: noodles, 1/3 meat sauce, half of cheese mixture. Repeat and then top with remaining meat sauce. Sprinkle Mozzarella cheese on top and cover with foil. Bake at 350° for one hour or until noodles are tender. Let stand 10 minutes before cutting.

recipes.title: Caramel Balls
directions: Combine caramels, butter and cream; melt in microwave.
Fold in corn flakes and coconut.
This recipe can be doubled for the freezer.
recipes.text: Caramel Balls. Combine caramels, butter and cream; melt in microwave. Fold in corn flakes and coconut. This recipe can be doubled for the freezer.

recipes.title: Prune Cake
directions: Beat eggs, sugar and Wesson oil.
Add flour and spices; add buttermilk, nuts and prunes.
Last mix well.
Cook in stem pan 60 minutes at 350° or until done.
recipes.text: Prune Cake. Beat eggs, sugar and Wesson oil. Add flour and spices; add buttermilk, nuts and prunes. Last mix well. Cook in stem pan 60 minutes at 350° or until done.

recipes.title: Cheesecake Pie
directions: Blend cream cheese and sugar until creamy. Stir in vanilla. Fold in Cool Whip. Spoon into pie shell. Add topping of choice (cherry, blueberry or strawberry).
Chill pie several hours before serving.
recipes.text: Cheesecake Pie. Blend cream cheese and sugar until creamy. Stir in vanilla. Fold in Cool Whip. Spoon into pie shell. Add topping of choice (cherry, blueberry or strawberry). Chill pie several hours before serving.

recipes.title: Vegetable Pizza
ingredients: 1 envelope Hidden Valley Ranch original recipe
directions: Roll out dough; do not separate.
Pat flat in a pizza pan. Bake at 350° for 10 to 12 minutes.
recipes.text: Vegetable Pizza. Roll out dough; do not separate. Pat flat in a pizza pan. Bake at 350° for 10 to 12 minutes.

recipes.title: Spicy Clam Dip
ingredients: 3 (6 1/2 oz.) cans chopped Gorton's clams with juice
directions: Simmer chopped clams and lemon juice for 10 to 15 minutes (medium in microwave).
Mix all ingredients together and gradually add Italian style bread crumbs to thicken consistency.
Pour into large casserole dish.
Top with grated cheese (suggestion Muenster).
Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese and paprika.
recipes.text: Spicy Clam Dip. Simmer chopped clams and lemon juice for 10 to 15 minutes (medium in microwave). Mix all ingredients together and gradually add Italian style bread crumbs to thicken consistency. Pour into large casserole dish. Top with grated cheese (suggestion Muenster). Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese and paprika.

recipes.title: Chocolate Drops
directions: Sift together flour, salt, soda and cocoa.
Cream butter thoroughly.
Add sugar gradually and cream until light and fluffy. Add egg and vanilla and beat well.
Add dry ingredients and milk into creamed mixture.
Stir in nuts.
Drop on greased cookie sheet.
Bake at 350° for 10 to 15 minutes.
Frost while warm and sprinkle with coconut or nuts.
recipes.text: Chocolate Drops. Sift together flour, salt, soda and cocoa. Cream butter thoroughly. Add sugar gradually and cream until light and fluffy. Add egg and vanilla and beat well. Add dry ingredients and milk into creamed mixture. Stir in nuts. Drop on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350° for 10 to 15 minutes. Frost while warm and sprinkle with coconut or nuts.

recipes.title: Chicken-Egg-Lemon Soup(Kotosoupa Avgolemono)
directions: Cover chicken and vegetables with water; bring to a boil.
Skin off scum.
Reduce heat and cook partially covered 1 1/2 to 2 hours until chicken is tender.
Remove chicken from broth.
Set aside for later use as desired.
Strain broth into a kettle, discarding vegetables.
Bring broth to a boil, add rice; stir and salt to taste.
Reduce heat and cook covered until rice is tender.
Add white meat from chicken that you set aside.
Blend hot soup with Avgolemono sauce.
recipes.text: Chicken-Egg-Lemon Soup(Kotosoupa Avgolemono). Cover chicken and vegetables with water; bring to a boil. Skin off scum. Reduce heat and cook partially covered 1 1/2 to 2 hours until chicken is tender. Remove chicken from broth. Set aside for later use as desired. Strain broth into a kettle, discarding vegetables. Bring broth to a boil, add rice; stir and salt to taste. Reduce heat and cook covered until rice is tender. Add white meat from chicken that you set aside. Blend hot soup with Avgolemono sauce.

recipes.title: Pistachio Salad
directions: Prepare pudding according to directions on box.
Now mix all the other ingredients together with pudding and chill in a mold or dish.
recipes.text: Pistachio Salad. Prepare pudding according to directions on box. Now mix all the other ingredients together with pudding and chill in a mold or dish.

recipes.title: Chicken Picata
directions: Chop and saute the first 4 ingredients. Remove from pan.
Make thin chicken cutlets. Dredge in mixture of flour, salt and pepper. Fry cutlets in mixture of 1/2 olive oil and 1/2 butter on medium-high heat. Remove from pan.
Pour the wine in hot pan to glaze. Add the chicken broth, lemon juice and capers.
Stir while heating.
Replace cutlets and onion mixture. This should thicken gravy.
If too thick, add chicken broth to thin it.
recipes.text: Chicken Picata. Chop and saute the first 4 ingredients. Remove from pan. Make thin chicken cutlets. Dredge in mixture of flour, salt and pepper. Fry cutlets in mixture of 1/2 olive oil and 1/2 butter on medium-high heat. Remove from pan. Pour the wine in hot pan to glaze. Add the chicken broth, lemon juice and capers. Stir while heating. Replace cutlets and onion mixture. This should thicken gravy. If too thick, add chicken broth to thin it.

recipes.title: Millionaires
ingredients: 3 c. chopped pecans (do not chop small)
directions: Melt caramels in top of double boiler with the water added. (May be melted in microwave).
Add pecans and mix well.
Drop on greased cookie sheet by 1/2 to 1 tablespoon.
Let cool.
recipes.text: Millionaires. Melt caramels in top of double boiler with the water added. (May be melted in microwave). Add pecans and mix well. Drop on greased cookie sheet by 1/2 to 1 tablespoon. Let cool.

recipes.title: Chocolate Bars
directions: Cream 1 cup butter and the sugar until light and fluffy.
Stir in oatmeal.
Add dry ingredients to creamed mixture.
Mix chocolate chips, milk, remaining butter and salt in top of double boiler.
Heat until melted and smooth.
Add
nuts and remaining vanilla.
Spread 2/3 of oatmeal mix on cookie sheet.
Cover with chocolate mix.
Dot remaining oatmeal mix over this.
Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Chocolate Bars. Cream 1 cup butter and the sugar until light and fluffy. Stir in oatmeal. Add dry ingredients to creamed mixture. Mix chocolate chips, milk, remaining butter and salt in top of double boiler. Heat until melted and smooth. Add nuts and remaining vanilla. Spread 2/3 of oatmeal mix on cookie sheet. Cover with chocolate mix. Dot remaining oatmeal mix over this. Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Cole Slaw
directions: Mix salt with cabbage; let stand for 1 hour.
Squeeze out excess water.
Add carrot, pepper and celery.
recipes.text: Cole Slaw. Mix salt with cabbage; let stand for 1 hour. Squeeze out excess water. Add carrot, pepper and celery.

recipes.title: Hot Salsa
directions: Chop tomatoes with food chopper. Mince peppers with food chopper. Slice green onion very finely. Mince garlic and cilantro. Chop 1/2 white onion with food chopper. Squeeze limes and lemon into mixture. Add salt to taste. Mix all together. Refrigerate. Serve with chips of your choice.
recipes.text: Hot Salsa. Chop tomatoes with food chopper. Mince peppers with food chopper. Slice green onion very finely. Mince garlic and cilantro. Chop 1/2 white onion with food chopper. Squeeze limes and lemon into mixture. Add salt to taste. Mix all together. Refrigerate. Serve with chips of your choice.

recipes.title: Egg Custard Pie
directions: Beat eggs slightly.
Add sugar and mix well.
Add scalded milk gradually.
Pour into 2 unbaked pie shells.
Bake at 475° for 10 minutes.
Reduce heat to 375° and bake 10 minutes or until pie is firm.
recipes.text: Egg Custard Pie. Beat eggs slightly. Add sugar and mix well. Add scalded milk gradually. Pour into 2 unbaked pie shells. Bake at 475° for 10 minutes. Reduce heat to 375° and bake 10 minutes or until pie is firm.

recipes.title: Chicken Casserole
ingredients: 1 chicken, cooked and cut in bite-size pieces
directions: Cook chicken and reserve broth.
Cut chicken into bite-size pieces.
Use broth to cook noodles.
Mix noodles and chicken with all other ingredients.
Place in buttered casserole dish.
Top with crushed potato chips.
Bake 45 minutes at 350° or until bubbly and slightly brown.
recipes.text: Chicken Casserole. Cook chicken and reserve broth. Cut chicken into bite-size pieces. Use broth to cook noodles. Mix noodles and chicken with all other ingredients. Place in buttered casserole dish. Top with crushed potato chips. Bake 45 minutes at 350° or until bubbly and slightly brown.

recipes.title: Greek Tacos
directions: Mix together well all the ingredients and stuff pita bread. Enjoy!!
recipes.text: Greek Tacos. Mix together well all the ingredients and stuff pita bread. Enjoy!!

recipes.title: Vegetable Casserole
ingredients: 1 large pkg. frozen mixed vegetables, cooked as directed on pkg.
directions: Place vegetables in bottom of a buttered 12 x 8 x 2-inch cooking dish.
Mix mayonnaise, cheese, celery and onions; spread over vegetables.
Melt margarine and crumble crackers.
Mix together and spread over top of dish.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Vegetable Casserole. Place vegetables in bottom of a buttered 12 x 8 x 2-inch cooking dish. Mix mayonnaise, cheese, celery and onions; spread over vegetables. Melt margarine and crumble crackers. Mix together and spread over top of dish. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Microwave Chicken
ingredients: 1 jar Catalina or French or Russian dressing
directions: Mix and pour over chicken pieces.
Cover and bake on normal for 25 minutes.
Rotate dish 1/4 turn after 12 minutes.
recipes.text: Microwave Chicken. Mix and pour over chicken pieces. Cover and bake on normal for 25 minutes. Rotate dish 1/4 turn after 12 minutes.

recipes.title: Sausage Balls
ingredients: cayenne pepper to taste (will have to bake a couple to see if they are hot enough since cannot eat raw sausage)
directions: Mix all ingredients well with hands and shape into small balls about the size of walnuts.
Place on cookie sheet about 1-inch apart.
Will not spread when baked so can be placed close together.
Bake at 350° for about 15 minutes.
Will be brown on bottom.
Do not overcook.
Can be stored at room temperature in airtight container.
Makes about 100 balls.
recipes.text: Sausage Balls. Mix all ingredients well with hands and shape into small balls about the size of walnuts. Place on cookie sheet about 1-inch apart. Will not spread when baked so can be placed close together. Bake at 350° for about 15 minutes. Will be brown on bottom. Do not overcook. Can be stored at room temperature in airtight container. Makes about 100 balls.

recipes.title: Fudge
directions: Cook first 4 ingredients for 5 minutes after it comes to a boil.
Turn off and add the last 4 ingredients.
Pour into 9 x 13-inch pan.
Cool.
recipes.text: Fudge. Cook first 4 ingredients for 5 minutes after it comes to a boil. Turn off and add the last 4 ingredients. Pour into 9 x 13-inch pan. Cool.

recipes.title: Gogo Shake
directions: In a blender, blend banana until smooth.
Blend in peanut butter.
Add ice cream and milk.
Blend until smooth.
Serve immediately.
recipes.text: Gogo Shake. In a blender, blend banana until smooth. Blend in peanut butter. Add ice cream and milk. Blend until smooth. Serve immediately.

recipes.title: Gnocchi
directions: Boil potatoes (skins on) until fork-tender.
Drain; cool to touch.
Peel and run through ricer into mixer bowl.
Beat in egg yolk.
Add flour, semolina and salt.
Mix until soft dough.
recipes.text: Gnocchi. Boil potatoes (skins on) until fork-tender. Drain; cool to touch. Peel and run through ricer into mixer bowl. Beat in egg yolk. Add flour, semolina and salt. Mix until soft dough.

recipes.title: Magic Cookie Bars
directions: Melt margarine in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan.
Add remaining ingredients in order listed.
Bake at 350° for 25 minutes until lightly browned.
Let cool and cut into bars.
recipes.text: Magic Cookie Bars. Melt margarine in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Add remaining ingredients in order listed. Bake at 350° for 25 minutes until lightly browned. Let cool and cut into bars.

recipes.title: Raisin Apple Coffee Cake
directions: Mix sugar and shortening together thoroughly.
Add milk.
Stir in remaining ingredients.
Spread batter in greased and floured 9 x 9-inch pan.
Arrange thinly sliced apples in fancy designs on top of batter.
Press in slightly.
Sprinkle top with 1 teaspoon cinnamon, mixed with 2 tablespoons sugar.
Bake 30 to 35 minutes at 375°.
Test with toothpick.
Serve warm.
(Freezes well and warms in microwave.)
recipes.text: Raisin Apple Coffee Cake. Mix sugar and shortening together thoroughly. Add milk. Stir in remaining ingredients. Spread batter in greased and floured 9 x 9-inch pan. Arrange thinly sliced apples in fancy designs on top of batter. Press in slightly. Sprinkle top with 1 teaspoon cinnamon, mixed with 2 tablespoons sugar. Bake 30 to 35 minutes at 375°. Test with toothpick. Serve warm. (Freezes well and warms in microwave.)

recipes.title: Oven Fried Potatoes
directions: Scrub potatoes, then dry
well.
Cut
into finger width lengths and put in a
bowl.
Toss
potatoes
with rosemary and oil to coat well.
Lay	on
foil on cookie sheets and sprinkle with salt and pepper.
Bake in a preheated 400° oven for 30 to 40 minutes or until browned and crispy.
recipes.text: Oven Fried Potatoes. Scrub potatoes, then dry well. Cut into finger width lengths and put in a bowl. Toss potatoes with rosemary and oil to coat well. Lay	on foil on cookie sheets and sprinkle with salt and pepper. Bake in a preheated 400° oven for 30 to 40 minutes or until browned and crispy.

recipes.title: Strawberry Buttermilk Congealed Salad
directions: Mix gelatin and pineapple in large saucepan.
Heat on stove until gelatin dissolves.
(Do not boil.)
Allow to cool.
recipes.text: Strawberry Buttermilk Congealed Salad. Mix gelatin and pineapple in large saucepan. Heat on stove until gelatin dissolves. (Do not boil.) Allow to cool.

recipes.title: Asparagus And Green Bean Casserole
directions: Butter casserole dish.
Add asparagus and green beans.
Spread cheese over the vegetables.
Spoon cream of mushroom soup on top. Cook at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.
Take out of oven and place biscuits on top.
Return to oven, increase oven temperature and cook until biscuits are brown.
recipes.text: Asparagus And Green Bean Casserole. Butter casserole dish. Add asparagus and green beans. Spread cheese over the vegetables. Spoon cream of mushroom soup on top. Cook at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes. Take out of oven and place biscuits on top. Return to oven, increase oven temperature and cook until biscuits are brown.

recipes.title: Dirty Rice
directions: Cook sausage until brown.
Add onion and cook.
Drain.
Cook rice as directed on package.
Add rice to sausage.
Add soup.
Put in a casserole dish.
Sprinkle almonds on top.
Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes.
recipes.text: Dirty Rice. Cook sausage until brown. Add onion and cook. Drain. Cook rice as directed on package. Add rice to sausage. Add soup. Put in a casserole dish. Sprinkle almonds on top. Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Broccoli Casserole
directions: Have all ingredients at room temperature.
In a large mixing bowl, mix all ingredients.
Pour into a greased 9 x 12-inch baking dish.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour or until a knife comes out clean when inserted in middle of dish.
It should be golden brown and bubbly on top.
Serves 6.
recipes.text: Broccoli Casserole. Have all ingredients at room temperature. In a large mixing bowl, mix all ingredients. Pour into a greased 9 x 12-inch baking dish. Bake at 350° for 1 hour or until a knife comes out clean when inserted in middle of dish. It should be golden brown and bubbly on top. Serves 6.

recipes.title: Fruit Cocktail Cake
directions: Mix all ingredients together and bake at 350° for 35 minutes.
recipes.text: Fruit Cocktail Cake. Mix all ingredients together and bake at 350° for 35 minutes.

recipes.title: Diet Sloppy Joes
directions: Saute ground beef, onion, celery and garlic; drain well.
Add tomato sauce, salt and pepper.
Simmer 10 minutes.
Spoon hamburger mixture over both pieces of each bun.
Serves 6. Has 269 calories, 5 fat grams; food exchanges equal 3 meat, 1 bread, 1 fat.
recipes.text: Diet Sloppy Joes. Saute ground beef, onion, celery and garlic; drain well. Add tomato sauce, salt and pepper. Simmer 10 minutes. Spoon hamburger mixture over both pieces of each bun. Serves 6. Has 269 calories, 5 fat grams; food exchanges equal 3 meat, 1 bread, 1 fat.

recipes.title: Dirt Cake
directions: Mix oleo, cream cheese and confectioners sugar in small bowl; set aside.
In large bowl, mix pudding and milk.
Add whipped topping.
Then add cream cheese mixture to pudding.
Place cookie crumbs in container 1/2-inch thick.
Alternate cookies and cream mixture until container is full.
Finish with 1/2 cup of cookie crumbs; chill at least 6 hours.
recipes.text: Dirt Cake. Mix oleo, cream cheese and confectioners sugar in small bowl; set aside. In large bowl, mix pudding and milk. Add whipped topping. Then add cream cheese mixture to pudding. Place cookie crumbs in container 1/2-inch thick. Alternate cookies and cream mixture until container is full. Finish with 1/2 cup of cookie crumbs; chill at least 6 hours.

recipes.title: "Italian" Bruschetta(Appetizer)
directions: Cut tomatoes into 1/4-inch dice and toss with garlic and shallots.
Chop basil and add to tomatoes along with lemon juice, salt, pepper and 1/4 cup olive oil; set aside.
recipes.text: "Italian" Bruschetta(Appetizer). Cut tomatoes into 1/4-inch dice and toss with garlic and shallots. Chop basil and add to tomatoes along with lemon juice, salt, pepper and 1/4 cup olive oil; set aside.

recipes.title: Mexican Cornbread
directions: Combine all ingredients except 1/4 cup oil.
Pour 1/4 cup oil into pan or an iron skillet works best.
Preheat pan or skillet and pour batter into hot grease.
Bake at 325° for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Mexican Cornbread. Combine all ingredients except 1/4 cup oil. Pour 1/4 cup oil into pan or an iron skillet works best. Preheat pan or skillet and pour batter into hot grease. Bake at 325° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Chicken Breasts
directions: Pound the chicken to 1/4-inch thickness.
Add all other ingredients.
Roll up and dredge through flour, 1 beaten egg and then crushed corn flakes.
Line in a shallow pan, seam side down. Let stand overnight or at least 1 hour in refrigerator.
When ready to bake, pour 1/2 cup melted butter and 1/2 cup dry white wine or chicken broth over meat, carefully not disturb the crumbs. Cover with aluminum foil and bake 1 hour at 350°.
Remove foil, baste with liquid and cook 1/2 hour longer.
Serves 4 to 6.
recipes.text: Chicken Breasts. Pound the chicken to 1/4-inch thickness. Add all other ingredients. Roll up and dredge through flour, 1 beaten egg and then crushed corn flakes. Line in a shallow pan, seam side down. Let stand overnight or at least 1 hour in refrigerator. When ready to bake, pour 1/2 cup melted butter and 1/2 cup dry white wine or chicken broth over meat, carefully not disturb the crumbs. Cover with aluminum foil and bake 1 hour at 350°. Remove foil, baste with liquid and cook 1/2 hour longer. Serves 4 to 6.

recipes.title: Parmesan Chicken
ingredients: 1 c. Miracle Whip or Miracle Whip Light dressing
directions: Put bread in toaster.
Put butter on the bread after it is toasted, then put sugar-cinnamon on bread.
recipes.text: Parmesan Chicken. Put bread in toaster. Put butter on the bread after it is toasted, then put sugar-cinnamon on bread.

recipes.title: Sausage Soup
directions: Brown sausage in saucepan.
Add other ingredients; cook twenty minutes.
Place in bowl with Parmesan cheese on top.
recipes.text: Sausage Soup. Brown sausage in saucepan. Add other ingredients; cook twenty minutes. Place in bowl with Parmesan cheese on top.

recipes.title: Fried Spinach
ingredients: 1 T. peanut, sesame or garlic oil
directions: Wash spinach thoroughly and drain off excess water. Heat oil in a large wok or skillet. Add spinach and fry over fierce heat for 1 minute, stirring all the time with a chop stick, until spinach softens. Add salt and soy sauce, mix well and cook gently for another minute until spinach is tender and very bright green. Remove from wok and serve immediately. Makes 4 servings.
recipes.text: Fried Spinach. Wash spinach thoroughly and drain off excess water. Heat oil in a large wok or skillet. Add spinach and fry over fierce heat for 1 minute, stirring all the time with a chop stick, until spinach softens. Add salt and soy sauce, mix well and cook gently for another minute until spinach is tender and very bright green. Remove from wok and serve immediately. Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: Layered Strawberry Dessert Salad
ingredients: 1 small can crushed pineapple and syrup (1 c.)
2 c. (two 10 oz. pkg.) thawed, frozen sliced and sweetened strawberries
directions: Beat the cream cheese and sugar until smooth. Gradually add milk and vanilla. Soften gelatin in cold water.
Heat to dissolve. Blend into cream cheese mixture.
Pour into a 12 x 7 1/2 x 2-inch baking dish. Chill until firm, about 1/2 hour. Dissolve strawberry and raspberry gelatin in boiling water. Cool.
Mash bananas well. Blend into gelatin. Stir in pineapple and strawberries.
Spoon and spread over cream mixture.
Chill at least 3 hours.
recipes.text: Layered Strawberry Dessert Salad. Beat the cream cheese and sugar until smooth. Gradually add milk and vanilla. Soften gelatin in cold water. Heat to dissolve. Blend into cream cheese mixture. Pour into a 12 x 7 1/2 x 2-inch baking dish. Chill until firm, about 1/2 hour. Dissolve strawberry and raspberry gelatin in boiling water. Cool. Mash bananas well. Blend into gelatin. Stir in pineapple and strawberries. Spoon and spread over cream mixture. Chill at least 3 hours.

recipes.title: Creamy Chocolate Cupcakes
directions: Combine dry ingredients in a large bowl.
Add eggs, water, oil, vinegar and vanilla; mix well.
Pour into 18 greased or paper-lined muffin cups.
recipes.text: Creamy Chocolate Cupcakes. Combine dry ingredients in a large bowl. Add eggs, water, oil, vinegar and vanilla; mix well. Pour into 18 greased or paper-lined muffin cups.

recipes.title: Tortellini Salad (Cold)
ingredients: 1 bottle Paul Newman's creamy Italian salad dressing
directions: Cook tortellini as directed.
Drain with cold water and cool. Add dressing, pepperoni, olives, onions and Parmesan cheese.
Mix thoroughly and chill 2 hours.
Serve cold with sandwiches as you would any salad.
recipes.text: Tortellini Salad (Cold). Cook tortellini as directed. Drain with cold water and cool. Add dressing, pepperoni, olives, onions and Parmesan cheese. Mix thoroughly and chill 2 hours. Serve cold with sandwiches as you would any salad.

recipes.title: The Wurst Potato Salad
ingredients: 2 lb. red potatoes, diced into 1-inch cubes
8 oz. smoked sausage, cut into 2-inch chunks
directions: Place in steamer and steam 20 to 25 minutes until potatoes are tender.
recipes.text: The Wurst Potato Salad. Place in steamer and steam 20 to 25 minutes until potatoes are tender.

recipes.title: Low-Fat Cheese Ball
ingredients: 2 (8 oz.) pkg. mild low-fat Cheddar cheese, shredded
1/4 c. low-fat Ranch dressing or regular Ranch with bacon
directions: You can substitute 1 tablespoon of bacon bits if using low-fat dressing.
recipes.text: Low-Fat Cheese Ball. You can substitute 1 tablespoon of bacon bits if using low-fat dressing.
