recipes.title: Cheese And Bacon Ball
directions: Combine first 4 ingredients, mixing well.
Form into a ball and roll in nuts.
Refrigerate.
recipes.text: Cheese And Bacon Ball. Combine first 4 ingredients, mixing well. Form into a ball and roll in nuts. Refrigerate.

recipes.title: Easy Beef Stroganoff
directions: Brown cubed sirloin in small amount of cooking oil.
Add 2 cans French onion soup and 1 can water.
Cover and simmer until meat is tender.
Add mushroom soup; stir until well blended. Simmer 10 minutes.
Fifteen minutes before serving, add sour cream.
Stir well and let simmer.
Serve over cooked rice or egg noodles.
Serves 6 to 8.
recipes.text: Easy Beef Stroganoff. Brown cubed sirloin in small amount of cooking oil. Add 2 cans French onion soup and 1 can water. Cover and simmer until meat is tender. Add mushroom soup; stir until well blended. Simmer 10 minutes. Fifteen minutes before serving, add sour cream. Stir well and let simmer. Serve over cooked rice or egg noodles. Serves 6 to 8.

recipes.title: Macadamia Snowballs
directions: Cream
butter;	add
flour, rum, vanilla and salt.
Add nuts; mix
by
hand.
Wrap
in plastic and refrigerate 1 hour. Roll in balls;
bake at 300° for 35 minutes.
Roll in confectioners sugar.
recipes.text: Macadamia Snowballs. Cream butter;	add flour, rum, vanilla and salt. Add nuts; mix by hand. Wrap in plastic and refrigerate 1 hour. Roll in balls; bake at 300° for 35 minutes. Roll in confectioners sugar.

recipes.title: Graham Cracker Cake
directions: Preheat oven to 350°.
Mix milk, eggs, sugar and butter; set aside.
recipes.text: Graham Cracker Cake. Preheat oven to 350°. Mix milk, eggs, sugar and butter; set aside.

recipes.title: Sweet Potato Casserole
directions: Boil and mash potatoes.
Add other ingredients, except last four, and place in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish.
Combine the last four ingredients together and sprinkle on the top of the sweet potato mixture.
Bake for 25 minutes at 350°.
recipes.text: Sweet Potato Casserole. Boil and mash potatoes. Add other ingredients, except last four, and place in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Combine the last four ingredients together and sprinkle on the top of the sweet potato mixture. Bake for 25 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Bill'S Chili
ingredients: 1- 8 oz. can of water or enough for your desired thickness.
directions: In a heavy skillet, combine meat, onion, and bell pepper. Cook meat until brown and vegetables are tender. Drain well on a paper towel.
Place in a large pan. Add salt, chili pow der and chili mix. Stir until well mixed.
Add tomato soup, sauce, tomatoes and water. Mix well again.
Add potato.
Bring to a boil. Cover and simmer for 2 hours.
Serve over rice or spaghetti.
recipes.text: Bill'S Chili. In a heavy skillet, combine meat, onion, and bell pepper. Cook meat until brown and vegetables are tender. Drain well on a paper towel. Place in a large pan. Add salt, chili pow der and chili mix. Stir until well mixed. Add tomato soup, sauce, tomatoes and water. Mix well again. Add potato. Bring to a boil. Cover and simmer for 2 hours. Serve over rice or spaghetti.

recipes.title: Bohemian Chocolate Cookies
directions: Whirl walnuts in food processor, using short, on-off bursts, until almost powdery.
Or, use a nut grinder to grind finely.
Set aside.
Whirl chocolate in food processor or blender until powdery.
Set aside.
recipes.text: Bohemian Chocolate Cookies. Whirl walnuts in food processor, using short, on-off bursts, until almost powdery. Or, use a nut grinder to grind finely. Set aside. Whirl chocolate in food processor or blender until powdery. Set aside.

recipes.title: Applets
directions: Soak Knox gelatine with 1 cup applesauce.
In a large kettle combine 1 1/2 cups applesauce, sugar, salt and lemon juice; bring to a boil.
Add gelatine mixture and boil for 20 minutes, stirring frequently.
Cool.
Add walnuts, orange extract and vanilla extract. Mix well and pour into well-greased 8 x 13-inch pan.
Set in refrigerator overnight.
Cut into squares and roll in powdered sugar.
Let stand in open awhile to let edges dry.
Can also use pureed strawberries, pears or apricots.
recipes.text: Applets. Soak Knox gelatine with 1 cup applesauce. In a large kettle combine 1 1/2 cups applesauce, sugar, salt and lemon juice; bring to a boil. Add gelatine mixture and boil for 20 minutes, stirring frequently. Cool. Add walnuts, orange extract and vanilla extract. Mix well and pour into well-greased 8 x 13-inch pan. Set in refrigerator overnight. Cut into squares and roll in powdered sugar. Let stand in open awhile to let edges dry. Can also use pureed strawberries, pears or apricots.

recipes.title: Meat Loaf
directions: Combine hamburger, eggs, salt, pepper, soup mix, milk and crumbs.
Shape into loaf.
Place in greased baking dish.
Blend remaining ingredients.
Spread over top.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Meat Loaf. Combine hamburger, eggs, salt, pepper, soup mix, milk and crumbs. Shape into loaf. Place in greased baking dish. Blend remaining ingredients. Spread over top. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Baked Pineapple Chicken
directions: Drain pineapple.
Reserve juice.
Mix juice with corn starch, mustard and Worcestershire sauce.
Place chicken, skin side up in shallow baking dish.
Broil till brown.
Pour sauce over chicken. Bake at 400° for 30 minutes.
Place lemon and pineapple slices around chicken.
Spoon sauce from pan over all.
Bake 5 minutes longer.
recipes.text: Baked Pineapple Chicken. Drain pineapple. Reserve juice. Mix juice with corn starch, mustard and Worcestershire sauce. Place chicken, skin side up in shallow baking dish. Broil till brown. Pour sauce over chicken. Bake at 400° for 30 minutes. Place lemon and pineapple slices around chicken. Spoon sauce from pan over all. Bake 5 minutes longer.

recipes.title: Ice Cream Pudding Pie
ingredients: 1 pkg. Jell-O pudding and pie filling (except lemon)
directions: Prepare pie filling.
Mix with milk as directed on package for pie.
Stir in ice cream and pour immediately into pie shell. Chill until set, about 3 hours.
recipes.text: Ice Cream Pudding Pie. Prepare pie filling. Mix with milk as directed on package for pie. Stir in ice cream and pour immediately into pie shell. Chill until set, about 3 hours.

recipes.title: Monster Cookies
ingredients: 6 c. oatmeal (or 5 c. oatmeal and 1 c. bran, my preference)
directions: Mix together well margarine, peanut butter, eggs, sugars and syrup. Mix oatmeal and baking powder. Blend 2 mixes together.
recipes.text: Monster Cookies. Mix together well margarine, peanut butter, eggs, sugars and syrup. Mix oatmeal and baking powder. Blend 2 mixes together.

recipes.title: Brownie Cake
directions: Bring to a boil the oil, oleo, water and cocoa. While hot, pour over sugar and flour, which have been sifted together. Add remaining ingredients. Bake in 9 x 14-inch greased pan 20 minutes at 400°.
recipes.text: Brownie Cake. Bring to a boil the oil, oleo, water and cocoa. While hot, pour over sugar and flour, which have been sifted together. Add remaining ingredients. Bake in 9 x 14-inch greased pan 20 minutes at 400°.

recipes.title: Pink Lemonade Pie
directions: Mix all ingredients and pour into crust.
Chill several hours. Easy as pie to make.
recipes.text: Pink Lemonade Pie. Mix all ingredients and pour into crust. Chill several hours. Easy as pie to make.

recipes.title: Artichoke Hors D'Oeuvres
ingredients: 2 (6 oz.) jars marinated artichoke hearts, drained and chopped (reserve marinade)
directions: Oil an 8-inch square baking dish with marinade from artichokes.
Combine eggs and crackers.
Add the remaining ingredients; mix thoroughly.
Bake at 325° for 35 to 40 minutes, or until firm.
Cool 5 minutes.
Cut into 1-inch squares and serve warm.
recipes.text: Artichoke Hors D'Oeuvres. Oil an 8-inch square baking dish with marinade from artichokes. Combine eggs and crackers. Add the remaining ingredients; mix thoroughly. Bake at 325° for 35 to 40 minutes, or until firm. Cool 5 minutes. Cut into 1-inch squares and serve warm.

recipes.title: Chocolate Mint Snow-Top Cookies
ingredients: 1 (10 oz.) pkg. (1 1/2 c.) mint flavored semi-sweet chocolate morsels, divided
directions: Combine flour, baking powder and salt; set aside.
Melt 1 cup mint morsels.*
recipes.text: Chocolate Mint Snow-Top Cookies. Combine flour, baking powder and salt; set aside. Melt 1 cup mint morsels.*

recipes.title: Lime Honey Dressing
directions: Mix all ingredients together in a tall jar.
Shake well. Refrigerate.
Lasts up to 10 days in refrigerator.
recipes.text: Lime Honey Dressing. Mix all ingredients together in a tall jar. Shake well. Refrigerate. Lasts up to 10 days in refrigerator.

recipes.title: Favorite Eggnog
directions: Separate yolks and whites of eggs.
Beat yolks until thick and add sugar.
Stir this into milk and add bourbon.
Whip the cream; add and then fold the well beaten egg whites in and put into eggnog bowl.
Add the ice cream just before you serve it and break it up into small pieces and stir to mix it through the nog.
recipes.text: Favorite Eggnog. Separate yolks and whites of eggs. Beat yolks until thick and add sugar. Stir this into milk and add bourbon. Whip the cream; add and then fold the well beaten egg whites in and put into eggnog bowl. Add the ice cream just before you serve it and break it up into small pieces and stir to mix it through the nog.

recipes.title: Layered Cabbage Casserole
directions: Cut cabbage into small wedges; cook in boiling salted water until tender.
Drain.
Place wedges in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish.
Set aside.
Melt butter in a small saucepan; stir in flour, salt and pepper.
Gradually stir in milk; cook over medium heat until thickened, stirring constantly.
Pour sauce over cabbage wedges.
Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.
recipes.text: Layered Cabbage Casserole. Cut cabbage into small wedges; cook in boiling salted water until tender. Drain. Place wedges in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish. Set aside. Melt butter in a small saucepan; stir in flour, salt and pepper. Gradually stir in milk; cook over medium heat until thickened, stirring constantly. Pour sauce over cabbage wedges. Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Sausage Biscuits
ingredients: 1/2 lb. bulk sausage, cook, drain and crumble
directions: Cook sausage, drain and crumble.
Sift together flour, baking powder, salt and baking soda.
Cut shortening into mixture until texture is like cornmeal.
Stir in sausage and buttermilk.
Knead on floured board 10 times.
Roll out to 1/2-inch thick.
Cut with 3/4-inch round biscuit cutter.
Bake at 450° for 10 minutes.
recipes.text: Sausage Biscuits. Cook sausage, drain and crumble. Sift together flour, baking powder, salt and baking soda. Cut shortening into mixture until texture is like cornmeal. Stir in sausage and buttermilk. Knead on floured board 10 times. Roll out to 1/2-inch thick. Cut with 3/4-inch round biscuit cutter. Bake at 450° for 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Krispy Pickles
ingredients: 25 to 30 medium sized cucumbers (long and slim)
directions: Wash cucumbers and slice paper thin (use a slice).
Chop onions and peppers.
Combine with cucumbers and salt.
Let stand 3 hours and drain.
Combine vinegar, sugar and spices in a large kettle.
Bring to a boil.
Add drained cucumbers.
Heat thoroughly but do not boil.
Pack while hot into sterilized jars and seal at once.
recipes.text: Krispy Pickles. Wash cucumbers and slice paper thin (use a slice). Chop onions and peppers. Combine with cucumbers and salt. Let stand 3 hours and drain. Combine vinegar, sugar and spices in a large kettle. Bring to a boil. Add drained cucumbers. Heat thoroughly but do not boil. Pack while hot into sterilized jars and seal at once.

recipes.title: Apple Cake
directions: Mix all
together and bake in a 9 x 13-inch pan at 350° for 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Apple Cake. Mix all together and bake in a 9 x 13-inch pan at 350° for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Rosemary Walnuts
ingredients: 1 Tbsp. finely chopped fresh rosemary or 1 tsp. dried
directions: Mix butter and seasoning together in shallow baking pan.
Add nuts, turning them in mixture to coat.
Heat 7 to 10 minutes in 350° oven, stirring occasionally.
recipes.text: Rosemary Walnuts. Mix butter and seasoning together in shallow baking pan. Add nuts, turning them in mixture to coat. Heat 7 to 10 minutes in 350° oven, stirring occasionally.

recipes.title: Stuffed Pork Chops
ingredients: 4 pork chops, center cut, 2 inch thick
directions: Wash pork chops, pat dry and sprinkle with salt and black pepper.
Next, with a sharp filet or paring knife, trim off excess fat.
Cut a 1 inch slit into the middle of the front of the pork chop from side to side.
Use the slit to cut a pocket into the pork chop from the bone to about 1/2 inch from the end of the meat.
Your butcher will do this for you.
Next, in a large bowl mix ground pork with all remaining ingredients until all is blended well.
Preheat oven to 350 degrees.
Stuff the pork mixture into the pockets of the pork chops.
Be generous and stuff it in until pork chop expands in the center. If there is any stuffing left, just make them into balls and cook with the pork chops.
Next, spray an oven pan with a vegetable coating and place pork chops into pan with 1 cup water and cover.
Place in oven for 35 minutes, remove cover and bake another 15 minutes.
Serve.
recipes.text: Stuffed Pork Chops. Wash pork chops, pat dry and sprinkle with salt and black pepper. Next, with a sharp filet or paring knife, trim off excess fat. Cut a 1 inch slit into the middle of the front of the pork chop from side to side. Use the slit to cut a pocket into the pork chop from the bone to about 1/2 inch from the end of the meat. Your butcher will do this for you. Next, in a large bowl mix ground pork with all remaining ingredients until all is blended well. Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Stuff the pork mixture into the pockets of the pork chops. Be generous and stuff it in until pork chop expands in the center. If there is any stuffing left, just make them into balls and cook with the pork chops. Next, spray an oven pan with a vegetable coating and place pork chops into pan with 1 cup water and cover. Place in oven for 35 minutes, remove cover and bake another 15 minutes. Serve.

recipes.title: Carrot Cake
directions: Mix sugar and oil.
Add eggs; beat well.
Sift dry ingredients and add to other mixture.
Add carrots and beat well.
Add pecans. Bake in greased and floured pan for about 35 minutes at 350°.
recipes.text: Carrot Cake. Mix sugar and oil. Add eggs; beat well. Sift dry ingredients and add to other mixture. Add carrots and beat well. Add pecans. Bake in greased and floured pan for about 35 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Cream Cheese Cake
directions: Mix first 3 ingredients.
Pour mixture into graham cracker crumb crust.
Top with strawberry or blueberry pie filling.
recipes.text: Cream Cheese Cake. Mix first 3 ingredients. Pour mixture into graham cracker crumb crust. Top with strawberry or blueberry pie filling.

recipes.title: Caramel Graham Crackers
directions: Separate graham crackers and place on an ungreased cookie sheet. In small pan, heat margarine and brown sugar. Boil for 2 minutes; remove from heat. Add pecans. Spread over graham crackers and place in 350° oven for 6 to 8 minutes.
Do not overbake. Use spatula to remove from pan.
recipes.text: Caramel Graham Crackers. Separate graham crackers and place on an ungreased cookie sheet. In small pan, heat margarine and brown sugar. Boil for 2 minutes; remove from heat. Add pecans. Spread over graham crackers and place in 350° oven for 6 to 8 minutes. Do not overbake. Use spatula to remove from pan.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Cookies
directions: Mix soda and salt with flour.
Place all ingredients in large bowl.
Mix well.
Form into small balls; flatten with fork.
Cook in a 375° oven until light brown.
Makes approximately 100.
recipes.text: Peanut Butter Cookies. Mix soda and salt with flour. Place all ingredients in large bowl. Mix well. Form into small balls; flatten with fork. Cook in a 375° oven until light brown. Makes approximately 100.

recipes.title: Chocolate Eclair Dessert
ingredients: 2 pkg. instant French vanilla pudding mix
directions: Mix pudding and milk.
Let set.
Add Cool Whip.
Line 9 x 13-inch pan with graham crackers.
Layer pudding and crackers, ending with crackers.
Mix remaining ingredients in small bowl. Spread over dessert.
Refrigerate overnight.
recipes.text: Chocolate Eclair Dessert. Mix pudding and milk. Let set. Add Cool Whip. Line 9 x 13-inch pan with graham crackers. Layer pudding and crackers, ending with crackers. Mix remaining ingredients in small bowl. Spread over dessert. Refrigerate overnight.

recipes.title: Pea And Macaroni Salad
ingredients: 2 c. cooked macaroni, cooked in salted water
directions: Chill macaroni and when cool, mix in vegetables.
Moisten with Miracle Whip.
Season with salt and pepper.
Mix cheese with salad. If you want, top with cheese in bowl or on salad plates.
recipes.text: Pea And Macaroni Salad. Chill macaroni and when cool, mix in vegetables. Moisten with Miracle Whip. Season with salt and pepper. Mix cheese with salad. If you want, top with cheese in bowl or on salad plates.

recipes.title: Bologna Salad
directions: Run bologna through food processor.
Mix in bowl with remaining ingredients.
Mix well.
Serve on a plate as a side dish or on bread as a sandwich.
Good!!
recipes.text: Bologna Salad. Run bologna through food processor. Mix in bowl with remaining ingredients. Mix well. Serve on a plate as a side dish or on bread as a sandwich. Good!!

recipes.title: Goulash(Slop)
directions: Crumble and fry hamburger; drain.
Cook and drain 1 box macaroni.
Combine in frypan with corn, tomato sauce and seasonings.
Cook on low for 10 minutes.
Add cheese and continue cooking until cheese melts.
recipes.text: Goulash(Slop). Crumble and fry hamburger; drain. Cook and drain 1 box macaroni. Combine in frypan with corn, tomato sauce and seasonings. Cook on low for 10 minutes. Add cheese and continue cooking until cheese melts.

recipes.title: Sauteed Shrimp And Mushrooms
ingredients: 1.5 lb. or larger jumbo shrimp, peeled and deveined
directions: Slice mushrooms into 2 or 3 pieces each.
Melt butter in a large skillet; add mushrooms.
Cook on low heat or high simmer 30 minutes uncovered (until most of the water has cooked out).
Add garlic, salt and pepper.
Stir and add shrimp.
Cook covered 5 to 7 minutes, until shrimp are done.
Stir occasionally.
Serve over rice.
recipes.text: Sauteed Shrimp And Mushrooms. Slice mushrooms into 2 or 3 pieces each. Melt butter in a large skillet; add mushrooms. Cook on low heat or high simmer 30 minutes uncovered (until most of the water has cooked out). Add garlic, salt and pepper. Stir and add shrimp. Cook covered 5 to 7 minutes, until shrimp are done. Stir occasionally. Serve over rice.

recipes.title: Banana Cream Pie
directions: Bake crust until done. Cool. Line bottom of crust with bananas. Mix sugar, milk and cornstarch. Cook in double boiler until thick. In another bowl, beat egg yolks and add small amount of cooked mixture to yolks. Beat until smooth. Add yolk mixture to remaining cooked mixture. Cook about 2 more minutes. Remove from heat and add butter flavoring, vanilla, salt and butter. Let cool. Pour over bananas and top with Cool Whip.
recipes.text: Banana Cream Pie. Bake crust until done. Cool. Line bottom of crust with bananas. Mix sugar, milk and cornstarch. Cook in double boiler until thick. In another bowl, beat egg yolks and add small amount of cooked mixture to yolks. Beat until smooth. Add yolk mixture to remaining cooked mixture. Cook about 2 more minutes. Remove from heat and add butter flavoring, vanilla, salt and butter. Let cool. Pour over bananas and top with Cool Whip.

recipes.title: Dump It Cake
ingredients: 1 can blueberry or cherry pie filling
1 c. chopped nuts or 1/2 c. nuts and 1/2 c. coconut
directions: Place fruit in oblong ungreased pan.
Spread dry cake mix over filling.
Crumble sticks of margarine over this.
Top with nuts or nuts/coconut mixture.
Bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes.
Serve warm or cold!!
Serves 12.
recipes.text: Dump It Cake. Place fruit in oblong ungreased pan. Spread dry cake mix over filling. Crumble sticks of margarine over this. Top with nuts or nuts/coconut mixture. Bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes. Serve warm or cold!! Serves 12.

recipes.title: French Silk Pie
ingredients: pie crust, baked or graham cracker crust
directions: Melt and cool chocolate.
Cream well sugar and butter.
Add 1 egg; beat for 5 minutes.
Add chocolate and blend.
Add 1 more egg; beat 5 minutes more.
Add vanilla.
Place in crust.
Garnish with Cool Whip.
recipes.text: French Silk Pie. Melt and cool chocolate. Cream well sugar and butter. Add 1 egg; beat for 5 minutes. Add chocolate and blend. Add 1 more egg; beat 5 minutes more. Add vanilla. Place in crust. Garnish with Cool Whip.

recipes.title: Butter Cookies
directions: Cream butter and sugar.
Add remaining ingredients.
Drop by 1/2 teaspoonful on cookie sheet.
Dip fork in flour and push down. Can put red cinnamon hots in center.
Bake at 375° for 10 minutes.
recipes.text: Butter Cookies. Cream butter and sugar. Add remaining ingredients. Drop by 1/2 teaspoonful on cookie sheet. Dip fork in flour and push down. Can put red cinnamon hots in center. Bake at 375° for 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Caramel-Chocolate Pecan Pie
ingredients: 1 (6 oz.) pkg. semi-sweet chocolate pieces (1 c.)
directions: Sprinkle pecan pieces in unbaked pie shell.
Sprinkle in chocolate pieces and drizzle in caramel topping.
Set aside.
In medium bowl, beat cream cheese, sour cream, sugar and vanilla until smooth.
Add eggs; beat on low speed just until combined.
Pour over caramel topping in crust.
Bake at 350° for about 45 minutes or until center appears set.
Cool.
Chill covered for at least 1 hour before serving.
Sift cocoa powder over pie, if desired. Makes 8 to 10 servings.
recipes.text: Caramel-Chocolate Pecan Pie. Sprinkle pecan pieces in unbaked pie shell. Sprinkle in chocolate pieces and drizzle in caramel topping. Set aside. In medium bowl, beat cream cheese, sour cream, sugar and vanilla until smooth. Add eggs; beat on low speed just until combined. Pour over caramel topping in crust. Bake at 350° for about 45 minutes or until center appears set. Cool. Chill covered for at least 1 hour before serving. Sift cocoa powder over pie, if desired. Makes 8 to 10 servings.

recipes.title: Less Sugar-Less Fat Banana Bread
directions: Cream oleo and sugar. Add eggs, applesauce and mashed bananas. Beat well. Add other ingredients.
Mix well.
Pour into well-greased pan. Bake, starting in cold oven, at 325° for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Less Sugar-Less Fat Banana Bread. Cream oleo and sugar. Add eggs, applesauce and mashed bananas. Beat well. Add other ingredients. Mix well. Pour into well-greased pan. Bake, starting in cold oven, at 325° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Chocolate No Bake Cookies
directions: Bring milk, butter, sugar and cocoa to a boil.
Remove from heat and add peanut butter, vanilla and oats.
Drop by teaspoon on wax paper or foil until cooled.
recipes.text: Chocolate No Bake Cookies. Bring milk, butter, sugar and cocoa to a boil. Remove from heat and add peanut butter, vanilla and oats. Drop by teaspoon on wax paper or foil until cooled.

recipes.title: Apple Torte
directions: Beat egg; add sugar.
Beat again.
Sift together flour, salt and baking powder.
Add to egg and sugar mixture, then add nuts and apples.
Grease and flour 9-inch pie tin.
Bake at 325° for 35 minutes.
Top with whipped cream or ice cream.
recipes.text: Apple Torte. Beat egg; add sugar. Beat again. Sift together flour, salt and baking powder. Add to egg and sugar mixture, then add nuts and apples. Grease and flour 9-inch pie tin. Bake at 325° for 35 minutes. Top with whipped cream or ice cream.

recipes.title: Hot Dip
directions: Mix tomatoes, garlic salt, cooking oil, pepper and vinegar in blender. Serve with chips.
recipes.text: Hot Dip. Mix tomatoes, garlic salt, cooking oil, pepper and vinegar in blender. Serve with chips.

recipes.title: Irish Scone
directions: Mix the first five ingredients in a large bowl.
Add eggs, milk and melted butter.
Add caraway seed as desired.
Stir by hand.
Butter and lightly flour 3 large loaf pans.
Put mixture into 3 buttered loaf pans.
Bake at 380° for one hour.
recipes.text: Irish Scone. Mix the first five ingredients in a large bowl. Add eggs, milk and melted butter. Add caraway seed as desired. Stir by hand. Butter and lightly flour 3 large loaf pans. Put mixture into 3 buttered loaf pans. Bake at 380° for one hour.

recipes.title: Planters Holiday Nuts 'N Spice Cookies(Makes About 6 Dozen)
ingredients: 2 1/2 c. Planters pecan halves or walnuts
confectioners sugar glaze, tinted with food coloring, colored sprinkles or candies
directions: Finely chop 1 1/2 cups nuts.
Combine flour, chopped nuts and baking powder; set aside.
In saucepan, heat sugar, molasses, water, allspice and cinnamon to a boil.
Remove from heat; stir in margarine until melted.
Blend in flour mixture.
Chill 1 hour.
recipes.text: Planters Holiday Nuts 'N Spice Cookies(Makes About 6 Dozen). Finely chop 1 1/2 cups nuts. Combine flour, chopped nuts and baking powder; set aside. In saucepan, heat sugar, molasses, water, allspice and cinnamon to a boil. Remove from heat; stir in margarine until melted. Blend in flour mixture. Chill 1 hour.

recipes.title: Champ Sandwich
directions: Cut bread into 3 lengthwise slices.
Spread cut surfaces with butter.
Cover bottom slice with cheese, liverwurst and pickle. Top with middle slice of bread.
Begin next layer with lettuce; drizzle with oil and vinegar and salt.
Top with bologna and salami, tomato and onion rings.
Place top crust on sandwich.
recipes.text: Champ Sandwich. Cut bread into 3 lengthwise slices. Spread cut surfaces with butter. Cover bottom slice with cheese, liverwurst and pickle. Top with middle slice of bread. Begin next layer with lettuce; drizzle with oil and vinegar and salt. Top with bologna and salami, tomato and onion rings. Place top crust on sandwich.

recipes.title: Breast Of Chicken On Rice(Makes 4 To 6 Servings)
directions: Heat oven to 350°.
Mix soup and milk.
Set aside 1/2 cup of this mixture.
Stir together remaining soup mixture, rice, mushrooms with liquid and 1/2 of the onion soup mix.
Pour into ungreased baking dish.
Place chicken on top.
Pour remaining soup mixture over chicken and sprinkle with remaining onion soup mix. Cover.
Bake 1 hour, covered.
Remove cover and bake 15 additional minutes.
recipes.text: Breast Of Chicken On Rice(Makes 4 To 6 Servings). Heat oven to 350°. Mix soup and milk. Set aside 1/2 cup of this mixture. Stir together remaining soup mixture, rice, mushrooms with liquid and 1/2 of the onion soup mix. Pour into ungreased baking dish. Place chicken on top. Pour remaining soup mixture over chicken and sprinkle with remaining onion soup mix. Cover. Bake 1 hour, covered. Remove cover and bake 15 additional minutes.

recipes.title: Caramel Coffee Pull-Aparts
directions: Grease and lightly flour Bundt cake pan.
Put frozen rolls in pan.
In saucepan, simmer butter, pudding and brown sugar.
Drizzle over rolls.
Cover pan with towel and put in cold oven overnight. Bake next morning at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes starting in cold oven.
Invert pan onto plate immediately upon removing from oven.
recipes.text: Caramel Coffee Pull-Aparts. Grease and lightly flour Bundt cake pan. Put frozen rolls in pan. In saucepan, simmer butter, pudding and brown sugar. Drizzle over rolls. Cover pan with towel and put in cold oven overnight. Bake next morning at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes starting in cold oven. Invert pan onto plate immediately upon removing from oven.

recipes.title: Clam Chowder
directions: Fry bacon until crisp.
Break into bits and reserve.
In a saucepan place 1/2 cup of juice from clams, 1 1/2 cup water, 4 cups potatoes and 1/2 cup sliced onion.
Cook covered about 15 minutes.
recipes.text: Clam Chowder. Fry bacon until crisp. Break into bits and reserve. In a saucepan place 1/2 cup of juice from clams, 1 1/2 cup water, 4 cups potatoes and 1/2 cup sliced onion. Cook covered about 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Microwave Hot Bean Salad
directions: Cut bacon strips into small pieces into 2-quart casserole dish.
Microwave 3 to 4 minutes. Remove cooked bacon pieces to paper towel to drain.
Add sugar, cornstarch, salt, pepper and vinegar to bacon drippings.
Microwave 3 to 4 minutes until thick. Add drained beans and onion slices to sauce.
Cover, microwave 6 minutes.
Let stand 10 minutes before serving.
recipes.text: Microwave Hot Bean Salad. Cut bacon strips into small pieces into 2-quart casserole dish. Microwave 3 to 4 minutes. Remove cooked bacon pieces to paper towel to drain. Add sugar, cornstarch, salt, pepper and vinegar to bacon drippings. Microwave 3 to 4 minutes until thick. Add drained beans and onion slices to sauce. Cover, microwave 6 minutes. Let stand 10 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Homemade Pimento Cheese
directions: Grate the Velveeta cheese in a bowl.
Add pimentos and mayonnaise.
Spread on slices of bread or stuff celery sticks. Will make 8 to 10 sandwiches.
recipes.text: Homemade Pimento Cheese. Grate the Velveeta cheese in a bowl. Add pimentos and mayonnaise. Spread on slices of bread or stuff celery sticks. Will make 8 to 10 sandwiches.

recipes.title: Turnip Casserole
ingredients: 2 lb. white turnips, peeled and diced
directions: Put prepared turnips in a pot with water to cover and the salt.
Cook until well done, about 1/2 hour.
Drain well.
Mash. Add milk, sugar and butter; continue mixing.
Pour into buttered, oven-proof casserole.
Top with cracker crumbs.
Bake at 300° for 45 minutes or until browned on top.
Serves 8.
recipes.text: Turnip Casserole. Put prepared turnips in a pot with water to cover and the salt. Cook until well done, about 1/2 hour. Drain well. Mash. Add milk, sugar and butter; continue mixing. Pour into buttered, oven-proof casserole. Top with cracker crumbs. Bake at 300° for 45 minutes or until browned on top. Serves 8.

recipes.title: Sassy Caramel Apple Dip
directions: Mix container of apple dip with 1/2 cup of vanilla flavored yogurt and ground cinnamon; chill. Just before serving, stir in toasted pecans. Serve with sliced apples. Refrigerate leftover dip.
recipes.text: Sassy Caramel Apple Dip. Mix container of apple dip with 1/2 cup of vanilla flavored yogurt and ground cinnamon; chill. Just before serving, stir in toasted pecans. Serve with sliced apples. Refrigerate leftover dip.

recipes.title: Fruit Dip
ingredients: 1 (8 oz.) pkg. Philadelphia cream cheese, softened
directions: Combine cream cheese and Marshmallow Creme mixing on medium speed of electric mixer until well blended.
Blend in sour cream; chill.
Serve as a fruit dip.
recipes.text: Fruit Dip. Combine cream cheese and Marshmallow Creme mixing on medium speed of electric mixer until well blended. Blend in sour cream; chill. Serve as a fruit dip.

recipes.title: Old Fashioned Butter Cookies
directions: Cream butter.
Add sugar and vanilla; continue beating until light.
Beat eggs and add to butter mixture; blend well.
Sift flour, measure, sift with salt and add to dough using enough flour to make dough stiff.
Chill 20 to 30 minutes.
Roll out to 1/4-inch thickness.
Cut with cookie cutter and bake on lightly greased cookie sheet in 400° oven for approximately 10 minutes. Cookies may be sprinkled with sugar before baking.
Remove from cookie sheet to cool.
recipes.text: Old Fashioned Butter Cookies. Cream butter. Add sugar and vanilla; continue beating until light. Beat eggs and add to butter mixture; blend well. Sift flour, measure, sift with salt and add to dough using enough flour to make dough stiff. Chill 20 to 30 minutes. Roll out to 1/4-inch thickness. Cut with cookie cutter and bake on lightly greased cookie sheet in 400° oven for approximately 10 minutes. Cookies may be sprinkled with sugar before baking. Remove from cookie sheet to cool.

recipes.title: Greek Meat Loaf
ingredients: 2 pieces bread, soaked in water and then squeezed slightly and left fairly moist
directions: Preheat
oven
Mix all ingredients gently and pack into a loaf pan.
Bake about 1 hour.
Pour off accumulated drippings before serving.
Yield:
6 servings; approximate calories per serving is 310.
recipes.text: Greek Meat Loaf. Preheat oven to 350°. Mix all ingredients gently and pack into a loaf pan. Bake about 1 hour. Pour off accumulated drippings before serving. Yield: 6 servings; approximate calories per serving is 310.

recipes.title: Uncooked Fundoughs #1
directions: Mix dry ingredients together.
Stir in oil and water.
Add more water, as necessary, to form a soft, pliable dough.
This dough keeps well.
recipes.text: Uncooked Fundoughs #1. Mix dry ingredients together. Stir in oil and water. Add more water, as necessary, to form a soft, pliable dough. This dough keeps well.

recipes.title: Ham-Cheese-Egg Bake
directions: Coat 9 x 13-inch baking pan with margarine.
Add 1 1/2 packages crescent rolls in bottom of pan.
Spread ingredients over crescent rolls except eggs and milk.
Beat eggs and add to milk. Pour over mixture.
Break 1/2 package rolls into small pieces. Add on top of mixture.
Bake at 325° for approximately 50 minutes. Add salt and pepper to taste.
Serves 8.
recipes.text: Ham-Cheese-Egg Bake. Coat 9 x 13-inch baking pan with margarine. Add 1 1/2 packages crescent rolls in bottom of pan. Spread ingredients over crescent rolls except eggs and milk. Beat eggs and add to milk. Pour over mixture. Break 1/2 package rolls into small pieces. Add on top of mixture. Bake at 325° for approximately 50 minutes. Add salt and pepper to taste. Serves 8.

recipes.title: Easy Peanut Butter Cookies
directions: Cream butter and sugar.
Add peanut butter; cream well.
Add eggs; beat well.
Add flavoring.
Drop cookies on cookie sheet. Preheat oven to 350° and cook for 10 minutes.
recipes.text: Easy Peanut Butter Cookies. Cream butter and sugar. Add peanut butter; cream well. Add eggs; beat well. Add flavoring. Drop cookies on cookie sheet. Preheat oven to 350° and cook for 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Lemon Bisque
ingredients: 1 small box Nabisco vanilla cookies, crushed
directions: Prepare jello per package directions.

Refrigerate until partially set. Whip milk until thick. Add sugar, thickened jello and lemon juice. Sprinkle 1/2 of crushed cookies on bottom of 9 x 12 pan. Pour the jello mixture over the cookies. Sprinkle remaining crushed cookies over the jello mixture. Chill in refrigerator 1 hour before serving (or overnight). Cut in squares. Optional:
Top with fresh fruit (strawberries, blueberries, raspberries).
recipes.text: Lemon Bisque. Prepare jello per package directions. Refrigerate until partially set. Whip milk until thick. Add sugar, thickened jello and lemon juice. Sprinkle 1/2 of crushed cookies on bottom of 9 x 12 pan. Pour the jello mixture over the cookies. Sprinkle remaining crushed cookies over the jello mixture. Chill in refrigerator 1 hour before serving (or overnight). Cut in squares. Optional: Top with fresh fruit (strawberries, blueberries, raspberries).

recipes.title: Spicy Mexican Skillet Chicken
ingredients: 4 boneless, skinless chicken breast halves (about 1 lb.)
1 c. frozen (thawed) corn or canned (drained) whole kernel corn
1 can (15 oz.) black beans, rinsed and drained
directions: Mix chili powder, salt and pepper.
Sprinkle evenly over both sides of chicken.
Heat oil in 10-inch skillet over medium heat until hot.
Cook chicken in oil 10 minutes until brown on both sides.
Stir in remaining ingredients.
Heat to boiling; reduce heat.
Cover and simmer 3 to 5 minutes or until juice of chicken is no longer pink when centers of thickest pieces are cut and vegetables are heated through.
Yields 4 servings.
recipes.text: Spicy Mexican Skillet Chicken. Mix chili powder, salt and pepper. Sprinkle evenly over both sides of chicken. Heat oil in 10-inch skillet over medium heat until hot. Cook chicken in oil 10 minutes until brown on both sides. Stir in remaining ingredients. Heat to boiling; reduce heat. Cover and simmer 3 to 5 minutes or until juice of chicken is no longer pink when centers of thickest pieces are cut and vegetables are heated through. Yields 4 servings.

recipes.title: Golden Fish Casserole
directions: Saute pepper and onions in butter.
Blend in the flour and salt.
Remove from heat.
Stir in gradually 2 cups milk.
Return to heat and boil.
Stir in carefully the salmon and juice.
Pour mixture into well-greased baking dish.
Bake at 400° for 25 to 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Golden Fish Casserole. Saute pepper and onions in butter. Blend in the flour and salt. Remove from heat. Stir in gradually 2 cups milk. Return to heat and boil. Stir in carefully the salmon and juice. Pour mixture into well-greased baking dish. Bake at 400° for 25 to 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Mashed Potato Casserole
directions: Mix potatoes and enough water to cover in 4-quart saucepan. Bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to medium; cook 25 to 30 minutes or until tender.
Drain well.
Mash potatoes, gradually stirring in salad dressing, cream cheese, onion powder, 3/4 teaspoon salt and 1/4 teaspoon pepper until light and fluffy.
Spoon into 1 1/2-quart casserole.
Sprinkle with paprika.
Cover tightly; freeze.
recipes.text: Mashed Potato Casserole. Mix potatoes and enough water to cover in 4-quart saucepan. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat to medium; cook 25 to 30 minutes or until tender. Drain well. Mash potatoes, gradually stirring in salad dressing, cream cheese, onion powder, 3/4 teaspoon salt and 1/4 teaspoon pepper until light and fluffy. Spoon into 1 1/2-quart casserole. Sprinkle with paprika. Cover tightly; freeze.

recipes.title: 6-Cup Salad("Quik-N-Ez")
directions: Combine all ingredients in a large bowl.
Mix well.
Chill as long as possible or overnight.
Serves 6.
recipes.text: 6-Cup Salad("Quik-N-Ez"). Combine all ingredients in a large bowl. Mix well. Chill as long as possible or overnight. Serves 6.

recipes.title: Watergate Salad
directions: Mix all ingredients; let stand in refrigerator.
recipes.text: Watergate Salad. Mix all ingredients; let stand in refrigerator.

recipes.title: Hot Dog Fritters
directions: Heat fat in deep fryer or skillet to 375°.
Cook the hot dogs in water about 4 minutes.
Drain and cool.
Slice each hot dog in 6 pieces. Combine meal, flour, onion, egg, and milk.
Stir in hot dog pieces.
Drop from spoon into hot fat.
Fry until golden brown, about 5 minutes.
Drain on paper towels.
recipes.text: Hot Dog Fritters. Heat fat in deep fryer or skillet to 375°. Cook the hot dogs in water about 4 minutes. Drain and cool. Slice each hot dog in 6 pieces. Combine meal, flour, onion, egg, and milk. Stir in hot dog pieces. Drop from spoon into hot fat. Fry until golden brown, about 5 minutes. Drain on paper towels.

recipes.title: Weight Watchers Milkshake
directions: Place all ingredients in blender and blend on high until smooth.
You may substitute for strawberries 1/2 frozen banana, frozen pitted cherries, frozen peaches, frozen apples or frozen pineapple.
Contains approximately 150 calories with 9 grams fat or freeze milk, omit fruit and add imitation flavoring (contains 80 calories with 0 grams fat).
You won't miss ice cream anymore.
recipes.text: Weight Watchers Milkshake. Place all ingredients in blender and blend on high until smooth. You may substitute for strawberries 1/2 frozen banana, frozen pitted cherries, frozen peaches, frozen apples or frozen pineapple. Contains approximately 150 calories with 9 grams fat or freeze milk, omit fruit and add imitation flavoring (contains 80 calories with 0 grams fat). You won't miss ice cream anymore.

recipes.title: Cream Cheese Cookies
directions: Cream butter and cheese.
Blend in egg yolk and vanilla.
Add cake mix (dry mix), 1/3 at a time; mix well.
If mixer is used, add last part of cake mix by hand.
Chill dough for 30 minutes. Heat oven to 375°.
Makes 6 to 8 dozen.
recipes.text: Cream Cheese Cookies. Cream butter and cheese. Blend in egg yolk and vanilla. Add cake mix (dry mix), 1/3 at a time; mix well. If mixer is used, add last part of cake mix by hand. Chill dough for 30 minutes. Heat oven to 375°. Makes 6 to 8 dozen.

recipes.title: Easy Potato Salad
directions: In large bowl, combine potatoes, onions and salad dressing. Sprinkle with paprika.
Garnish with chives.
recipes.text: Easy Potato Salad. In large bowl, combine potatoes, onions and salad dressing. Sprinkle with paprika. Garnish with chives.

recipes.title: Jingle Bell'S Cake
directions: Mix well!
Grease and flour tube pan.
Bake 25 minutes or until done.
recipes.text: Jingle Bell'S Cake. Mix well! Grease and flour tube pan. Bake 25 minutes or until done.

recipes.title: Mexican Stew
directions: Saute meat and chopped onion; drain and add to other ingredients. Simmer in large pot for about 15 minutes.
recipes.text: Mexican Stew. Saute meat and chopped onion; drain and add to other ingredients. Simmer in large pot for about 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Green Beans
directions: Mix all ingredients; heat well and serve.
recipes.text: Green Beans. Mix all ingredients; heat well and serve.

recipes.title: Marinated Pea Salad
directions: Stir the first 7 ingredients together; boil for 1 minute.
Set aside to cool.
Add remaining ingredients to the cooled mixture; toss lightly.
Refrigerate overnight.
recipes.text: Marinated Pea Salad. Stir the first 7 ingredients together; boil for 1 minute. Set aside to cool. Add remaining ingredients to the cooled mixture; toss lightly. Refrigerate overnight.

recipes.title: Butter Pecan Pie
directions: Beat eggs.
Add Karo, brown sugar, melted margarine, salt and vanilla; blend well.
Arrange pecans on bottom of crust and pour filling over them.
Bake at 350° until brown.
Will set as it cools.
recipes.text: Butter Pecan Pie. Beat eggs. Add Karo, brown sugar, melted margarine, salt and vanilla; blend well. Arrange pecans on bottom of crust and pour filling over them. Bake at 350° until brown. Will set as it cools.

recipes.title: Hettie Pruitt'S Sweet Potato Casserole
directions: Melt butter.
Mix with remaining ingredients.
Pour into casserole dish; top with marshmallows.
Bake at 325° for 55 minutes.
recipes.text: Hettie Pruitt'S Sweet Potato Casserole. Melt butter. Mix with remaining ingredients. Pour into casserole dish; top with marshmallows. Bake at 325° for 55 minutes.

recipes.title: Wiltproof Salad
directions: Thinly slice mushrooms.
Set aside.
In large bowl, combine oil, vinegar, onion, salt, sugar, pepper and mustard.
Add to mushrooms to coat.
Cut cauliflower into flowerets and thinly slice.
Add to mushrooms along with celery and green pepper.
Let marinate at least one hour.
Just before serving, stir in tomatoes.
Improves with marinating.
recipes.text: Wiltproof Salad. Thinly slice mushrooms. Set aside. In large bowl, combine oil, vinegar, onion, salt, sugar, pepper and mustard. Add to mushrooms to coat. Cut cauliflower into flowerets and thinly slice. Add to mushrooms along with celery and green pepper. Let marinate at least one hour. Just before serving, stir in tomatoes. Improves with marinating.

recipes.title: Rhubarb Crisp
directions: Spread rhubarb in a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Sprinkle with sugar and gelatin. Sprinkle with dry cake mix. Pour water and melted butter over all.
Bake 1 hour at 350°.
Serve warm or cold.
recipes.text: Rhubarb Crisp. Spread rhubarb in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Sprinkle with sugar and gelatin. Sprinkle with dry cake mix. Pour water and melted butter over all. Bake 1 hour at 350°. Serve warm or cold.

recipes.title: Pancit Canton
ingredients: 1 medium size carrot, cut in 1/4-inch circles
directions: Cut chicken breast in small pieces.
Saute the garlic, onion and chicken breast and cook about 3/4 done.
Add 1/4 cup of water, 3 tablespoons of soy sauce, cabbage, carrot and celery.
Cover and simmer 1 to 2 minutes.
Place canton noodles in; stir.
Salt and white pepper to taste.
Cover and simmer 3 more minutes.
Serve hot.
recipes.text: Pancit Canton. Cut chicken breast in small pieces. Saute the garlic, onion and chicken breast and cook about 3/4 done. Add 1/4 cup of water, 3 tablespoons of soy sauce, cabbage, carrot and celery. Cover and simmer 1 to 2 minutes. Place canton noodles in; stir. Salt and white pepper to taste. Cover and simmer 3 more minutes. Serve hot.

recipes.title: Cheese Cake
directions: Combine cheese, sugar and flour, mixing at medium speed until well blended.
Add eggs, one at a time, mixing well after each addition.
Blend in sour cream and vanilla.
Pour mixture over crust.
Bake at 450° for 10 minutes.
Reduce heat to 250° and continue baking for 1 hour.
Loosen cake from rim, but cool before removing rim of pan. Chill.
Top with cherries, blueberries, etc.
recipes.text: Cheese Cake. Combine cheese, sugar and flour, mixing at medium speed until well blended. Add eggs, one at a time, mixing well after each addition. Blend in sour cream and vanilla. Pour mixture over crust. Bake at 450° for 10 minutes. Reduce heat to 250° and continue baking for 1 hour. Loosen cake from rim, but cool before removing rim of pan. Chill. Top with cherries, blueberries, etc.

recipes.title: Rum Balls
directions: Combine first 5 ingredients and mix; add corn syrup and rum. Mix well.
Shape into 1-inch balls.
Roll in additional powdered sugar.
recipes.text: Rum Balls. Combine first 5 ingredients and mix; add corn syrup and rum. Mix well. Shape into 1-inch balls. Roll in additional powdered sugar.

recipes.title: Fudge Krispies("They Taste Like A Nestle Crunch Bar.")
directions: Combine chocolate chips, butter and corn syrup in medium saucepan. Stir over low heat until melted and smooth.
Remove from heat.
Stir in vanilla and sugar. Add Rice Krispies, mixing lightly until coated. Spread in a 13 x 9-inch buttered pan.
Chill until firm. Store in refrigerator.
Makes 48 bars.
recipes.text: Fudge Krispies("They Taste Like A Nestle Crunch Bar."). Combine chocolate chips, butter and corn syrup in medium saucepan. Stir over low heat until melted and smooth. Remove from heat. Stir in vanilla and sugar. Add Rice Krispies, mixing lightly until coated. Spread in a 13 x 9-inch buttered pan. Chill until firm. Store in refrigerator. Makes 48 bars.

recipes.title: Pound Cake
ingredients: 1 tsp. lemon juice, almond and vanilla
directions: Cream butter and sugar. Mix molasses with 1 teaspoon soda and add to butter mixture. Beat until light and fluffy. Sift flour, baking powder and spices. Add to boiling water, beating until very smooth. Add beaten eggs. Pour into pans to bake at 350° for 30 minutes. Cool and turn on platter. Dust with sifted powdered sugar and serve with whipped cream.
recipes.text: Pound Cake. Cream butter and sugar. Mix molasses with 1 teaspoon soda and add to butter mixture. Beat until light and fluffy. Sift flour, baking powder and spices. Add to boiling water, beating until very smooth. Add beaten eggs. Pour into pans to bake at 350° for 30 minutes. Cool and turn on platter. Dust with sifted powdered sugar and serve with whipped cream.

recipes.title: Crock-Pot Stew
directions: Layer in crock-pot the stew meat, onion soup mix, potatoes, carrots, cream of celery soup, cream of mushroom soup, tomato sauce and bay leaf (optional).
Do not stir.
Cook 6 hours on low.
recipes.text: Crock-Pot Stew. Layer in crock-pot the stew meat, onion soup mix, potatoes, carrots, cream of celery soup, cream of mushroom soup, tomato sauce and bay leaf (optional). Do not stir. Cook 6 hours on low.

recipes.title: Chocolate Nut Clusters
ingredients: 1 tsp. shortening (do not use butter, margarine or oil)
directions: In medium microwave-safe bowl, place chocolate chips and shortening (Crisco).
Microwave on High 1 to 1 1/2 minutes or until smooth when stirred.
Stir in nuts.
Spoon heaping teaspoons into 1-inch paper candy cups or paper-lined small muffin cups, filling each cup about half full.
Refrigerate until firm.
Peel off paper cup if desired.
Makes 14 to 16 candies.
recipes.text: Chocolate Nut Clusters. In medium microwave-safe bowl, place chocolate chips and shortening (Crisco). Microwave on High 1 to 1 1/2 minutes or until smooth when stirred. Stir in nuts. Spoon heaping teaspoons into 1-inch paper candy cups or paper-lined small muffin cups, filling each cup about half full. Refrigerate until firm. Peel off paper cup if desired. Makes 14 to 16 candies.

recipes.title: Chicken Pot Pie
directions: Cook chicken and debone.
Put in 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Spread evenly with celery soup from can over chicken.
Spread Veg-All.
Spread mushroom and then chicken soup.
recipes.text: Chicken Pot Pie. Cook chicken and debone. Put in 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Spread evenly with celery soup from can over chicken. Spread Veg-All. Spread mushroom and then chicken soup.

recipes.title: California Chicken Wings
ingredients: 15 chicken wings, cut up and skinned
directions: Combine soy sauce, water, brown sugar, butter, pineapple juice and mustard.
Heat until sugar has dissolved.
Cool and pour over wings.
Put wings in shallow baking dish and marinate for 2 hours in fridge.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.
Drain marinade and put wings on paper towels.
Serve hot or cold.
recipes.text: California Chicken Wings. Combine soy sauce, water, brown sugar, butter, pineapple juice and mustard. Heat until sugar has dissolved. Cool and pour over wings. Put wings in shallow baking dish and marinate for 2 hours in fridge. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes. Drain marinade and put wings on paper towels. Serve hot or cold.

recipes.title: Lynn'S Cornbread
ingredients: enough buttermilk (must be buttermilk or the bread just won't be the same) to make batter the consistency of cake batter
directions: Mix all ingredients.
Grease an iron skillet with cold Crisco (this makes the bread not stick to the pan); pour the batter into the skillet.
Bake slowly at about 325° to 350° until bread is very brown and crispy.
If you prefer it softer, don't brown quite as much.
These are my kid's most favorite things I cook.
recipes.text: Lynn'S Cornbread. Mix all ingredients. Grease an iron skillet with cold Crisco (this makes the bread not stick to the pan); pour the batter into the skillet. Bake slowly at about 325° to 350° until bread is very brown and crispy. If you prefer it softer, don't brown quite as much. These are my kid's most favorite things I cook.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Fudge
directions: Boil sugar and evaporated milk until soft ball forms in cold water.
Add margarine, vanilla and peanut butter.
Beat the ingredients until you get a good spreading consistency.
Spread on greased cookie sheet or platter.
Fudge can be cut and served or can be refrigerated.
recipes.text: Peanut Butter Fudge. Boil sugar and evaporated milk until soft ball forms in cold water. Add margarine, vanilla and peanut butter. Beat the ingredients until you get a good spreading consistency. Spread on greased cookie sheet or platter. Fudge can be cut and served or can be refrigerated.

recipes.title: Spirited Punch
directions: Brew tea for 5 minutes.
Remove tea bags.
Add cider, lemon juice, sugar and spices.
Simmer 10 minutes.
Remove spices.
Add wine.
recipes.text: Spirited Punch. Brew tea for 5 minutes. Remove tea bags. Add cider, lemon juice, sugar and spices. Simmer 10 minutes. Remove spices. Add wine.

recipes.title: Cole Slaw
directions: Combine cabbage, celery seed, pepper, sugar, vinegar, sour cream and mayonnaise in a large bowl.
Mix well, chill.
recipes.text: Cole Slaw. Combine cabbage, celery seed, pepper, sugar, vinegar, sour cream and mayonnaise in a large bowl. Mix well, chill.

recipes.title: Cool Whip Pie
directions: Beat Cool Whip, condensed milk, lemon juice and pineapple. Fold in nuts and pour into baked pie crusts.
Chill about 1 hour.
recipes.text: Cool Whip Pie. Beat Cool Whip, condensed milk, lemon juice and pineapple. Fold in nuts and pour into baked pie crusts. Chill about 1 hour.

recipes.title: Chocolate Cake
directions: Preheat oven to 350°.
Mix dry ingredients together.
Then add liquid ingredients.
Beat with electric mixer 3 minutes on high. Grease and flour 13 x 9-inch or 2 rounds.
Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes.
Test with toothpick.
Usually cracks open.
recipes.text: Chocolate Cake. Preheat oven to 350°. Mix dry ingredients together. Then add liquid ingredients. Beat with electric mixer 3 minutes on high. Grease and flour 13 x 9-inch or 2 rounds. Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes. Test with toothpick. Usually cracks open.

recipes.title: Mushroom Casserole
directions: Preheat oven to 350°.
Saute onion in butter; drain mushrooms, reserving 3/4 cup of liquid.
Combine eggs, cream, mushrooms and liquid, spices and saltines; add onion and cheese and mix well. Pour into a greased 1 1/2-quart casserole.
Bake covered for 30 minutes.
Remove cover and continue baking for 30 minutes more.
recipes.text: Mushroom Casserole. Preheat oven to 350°. Saute onion in butter; drain mushrooms, reserving 3/4 cup of liquid. Combine eggs, cream, mushrooms and liquid, spices and saltines; add onion and cheese and mix well. Pour into a greased 1 1/2-quart casserole. Bake covered for 30 minutes. Remove cover and continue baking for 30 minutes more.

recipes.title: Pineapple Orange Punch
ingredients: 3 c. (2 cans) lemon-lime carbonated beverage, chilled
directions: Place sherbet in large punch bowl; add remaining ingredients and stir well.
Serves 50 people.
recipes.text: Pineapple Orange Punch. Place sherbet in large punch bowl; add remaining ingredients and stir well. Serves 50 people.

recipes.title: Beet Jelly
directions: Bring beet juice to a boil; boil 3 minutes.
Add Kool-Aid and Sure-Jell and bring to a boil again.
Add sugar and boil 3 minutes.
recipes.text: Beet Jelly. Bring beet juice to a boil; boil 3 minutes. Add Kool-Aid and Sure-Jell and bring to a boil again. Add sugar and boil 3 minutes.

recipes.title: Chicken Breasts With Stuffing
directions: Lay chicken breasts in single layer in a large baking dish. Put slice of cheese on each breast.
Mix soup and wine. Spread over chicken and cheese. Sprinkle stuffing over all. Drizzle butter on top. Bake 50 to 55 minutes at 350°. Serves 6.
recipes.text: Chicken Breasts With Stuffing. Lay chicken breasts in single layer in a large baking dish. Put slice of cheese on each breast. Mix soup and wine. Spread over chicken and cheese. Sprinkle stuffing over all. Drizzle butter on top. Bake 50 to 55 minutes at 350°. Serves 6.

recipes.title: Powerful Pea Chowder
directions: Bring peas, onion and water to a boil in a large pot over medium heat. Cook 15 minutes. Add potato and salt. Cook 15 or 20 minutes or until peas and potato are soft. Add evaporated milk and margarine. Heat 5 minutes. Serves 6.
recipes.text: Powerful Pea Chowder. Bring peas, onion and water to a boil in a large pot over medium heat. Cook 15 minutes. Add potato and salt. Cook 15 or 20 minutes or until peas and potato are soft. Add evaporated milk and margarine. Heat 5 minutes. Serves 6.

recipes.title: Tasty Spinach Dip
ingredients: 1 (10 oz.) pkg. frozen spinach, thawed, partially cooked and well drained
1 bunch green onions (including 3 to 4-inch green tops)
2 c. Best Foods mayonnaise (use only this brand)
directions: Squeeze out excess moisture of spinach.
Process until fine in food processor or blender.
Remove to a bowl.
Fold in the sour cream and mayonnaise.
Mix well and add garlic powder, salt and pepper to taste.
May be used as salad dressing.
Keeps well in refrigerator when stored in glass or Tupperware container.
recipes.text: Tasty Spinach Dip. Squeeze out excess moisture of spinach. Process until fine in food processor or blender. Remove to a bowl. Fold in the sour cream and mayonnaise. Mix well and add garlic powder, salt and pepper to taste. May be used as salad dressing. Keeps well in refrigerator when stored in glass or Tupperware container.

recipes.title: Punch With Mint
directions: Stir together orange juice, cranberry juice and sugar.
Add ginger ale just before serving.
Float mint leaves for garnish.
recipes.text: Punch With Mint. Stir together orange juice, cranberry juice and sugar. Add ginger ale just before serving. Float mint leaves for garnish.

recipes.title: Easy Potatoes
directions: Scrub potatoes; peel onion and melt 2 tablespoons butter in glass baking dish.
Slice potatoes and onion.
Alternate layers of each onto melted butter.
Top with 1 tablespoon butter.
Sprinkle with salt and pepper.
Cover with Saran Wrap and microwave 10 minutes (or until potatoes are tender.)
This may also be fixed inside foil and placed on grill just prior to cooking hamburgers.
recipes.text: Easy Potatoes. Scrub potatoes; peel onion and melt 2 tablespoons butter in glass baking dish. Slice potatoes and onion. Alternate layers of each onto melted butter. Top with 1 tablespoon butter. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Cover with Saran Wrap and microwave 10 minutes (or until potatoes are tender.) This may also be fixed inside foil and placed on grill just prior to cooking hamburgers.

recipes.title: Easy Macaroni And Cheese
directions: In a medium saucepan, melt butter; blend in flour, salt and pepper.
Gradually stir in milk and cheese; cook and stir over medium heat until thickened and smooth.
Stir in sour cream and macaroni; heat thoroughly.
Serve immediately.
recipes.text: Easy Macaroni And Cheese. In a medium saucepan, melt butter; blend in flour, salt and pepper. Gradually stir in milk and cheese; cook and stir over medium heat until thickened and smooth. Stir in sour cream and macaroni; heat thoroughly. Serve immediately.

recipes.title: Lucille'S Russian Pound Cake
directions: Mix by hand the oleo, butter, cream cheese, eggs (beaten one at a time), vanilla, sugar, flour and baking powder.
Place 1/2 batter in a greased and floured angel food cake pan.
Arrange 1 cup of nuts and 1 jar drained cherries on top of batter.
Add more batter and add the rest of nuts and cherries.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour, then at 325° for 45 more minutes.
recipes.text: Lucille'S Russian Pound Cake. Mix by hand the oleo, butter, cream cheese, eggs (beaten one at a time), vanilla, sugar, flour and baking powder. Place 1/2 batter in a greased and floured angel food cake pan. Arrange 1 cup of nuts and 1 jar drained cherries on top of batter. Add more batter and add the rest of nuts and cherries. Bake at 350° for 1 hour, then at 325° for 45 more minutes.

recipes.title: Macaroni And Cheese
directions: Cook macaroni according to directions on package.
Mix together eggs (beaten), evaporated milk, sweet milk and salt.
Add macaroni and pour into greased baking dish.
Dot with margarine. Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes.
recipes.text: Macaroni And Cheese. Cook macaroni according to directions on package. Mix together eggs (beaten), evaporated milk, sweet milk and salt. Add macaroni and pour into greased baking dish. Dot with margarine. Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Carrot Raisin Salad
directions: Scrape and shred carrots.
Add crushed pineapple, raisins, lemon juice and mayonnaise to moisten (as much or as little as you like).
recipes.text: Carrot Raisin Salad. Scrape and shred carrots. Add crushed pineapple, raisins, lemon juice and mayonnaise to moisten (as much or as little as you like).

recipes.title: Kraut Salad
directions: Drain kraut, mix other ingredients.
Let set overnight.
Will keep for 2 weeks in refrigerator.
recipes.text: Kraut Salad. Drain kraut, mix other ingredients. Let set overnight. Will keep for 2 weeks in refrigerator.

recipes.title: Jean'S Corn Casserole
ingredients: 1 lb. (1 small pkg.) yellow saffron rice
10 oz. (1 can) soup, cream of mushroom OR celery
directions: Cook rice according to directions on package, omitting the butter.
Add butter, Mexicorn and soup.
Mix well.
Pour into 1 1/2-quart casserole dish.
Top with cheese.
recipes.text: Jean'S Corn Casserole. Cook rice according to directions on package, omitting the butter. Add butter, Mexicorn and soup. Mix well. Pour into 1 1/2-quart casserole dish. Top with cheese.

recipes.title: Raisin Tart
directions: Mix sugar and eggs until well blended.
Add washed raisins and vanilla to mixture.
Mix up pie crust as directed on the box. Roll out crust and cut with a biscuit cutter.
Place crust in greased muffin tins.
Put spoonfuls of raisin mixture in each muffin tin lined with crust.
Bake 12 to 15 minutes at 350°.
recipes.text: Raisin Tart. Mix sugar and eggs until well blended. Add washed raisins and vanilla to mixture. Mix up pie crust as directed on the box. Roll out crust and cut with a biscuit cutter. Place crust in greased muffin tins. Put spoonfuls of raisin mixture in each muffin tin lined with crust. Bake 12 to 15 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Sauteed Butternut Squash
ingredients: 1 1/2 lb. butternut squash, seeded and cut into 1-inch chunks (about 3 1/2 c.)
directions: In a heavy (preferably nonstick) skillet, heat oil until sizzling.
Add squash and garlic to coat well with oil.
Saute slowly over low heat, stirring frequently, for about 30 minutes until squash is golden and tender.
(Add a tablespoon or two of water to pan if squash begins to stick.)
Add salt and pepper to taste, then sprinkle sage and parsley over squash and mix to combine well.
Serves 4.
recipes.text: Sauteed Butternut Squash. In a heavy (preferably nonstick) skillet, heat oil until sizzling. Add squash and garlic to coat well with oil. Saute slowly over low heat, stirring frequently, for about 30 minutes until squash is golden and tender. (Add a tablespoon or two of water to pan if squash begins to stick.) Add salt and pepper to taste, then sprinkle sage and parsley over squash and mix to combine well. Serves 4.

recipes.title: Chocolate Peanut Balls
directions: Melt butter.
Add peanut butter and sugar; blend well.
Add remaining ingredients and mix.
Roll in balls.
Melt chocolate and paraffin.
Dip balls in this, then put on rack to cool.
recipes.text: Chocolate Peanut Balls. Melt butter. Add peanut butter and sugar; blend well. Add remaining ingredients and mix. Roll in balls. Melt chocolate and paraffin. Dip balls in this, then put on rack to cool.

recipes.title: Pasta Seafood Salad
ingredients: 14 oz. tuna fish, drained and chunked
3/4 c. black olives, sliced and pitted
directions: Cool elbow macaroni as directed on package; drain, rinse with cold water and hold aside.
Blanch broccoli in boiling water for 5 minutes, drain and rinse with cold water.
Combine elbow macaroni, broccoli, green and red peppers, olives and tuna fish.
Add Italian dressing and toss gently, but well.
Makes 13 1/2 cups or 8 servings.
recipes.text: Pasta Seafood Salad. Cool elbow macaroni as directed on package; drain, rinse with cold water and hold aside. Blanch broccoli in boiling water for 5 minutes, drain and rinse with cold water. Combine elbow macaroni, broccoli, green and red peppers, olives and tuna fish. Add Italian dressing and toss gently, but well. Makes 13 1/2 cups or 8 servings.

recipes.title: German Potato Salad
directions: Mix potatoes, celery, onions and eggs. Cut bacon in small pieces and fry until done (little crispy). Do not drain fat.
recipes.text: German Potato Salad. Mix potatoes, celery, onions and eggs. Cut bacon in small pieces and fry until done (little crispy). Do not drain fat.

recipes.title: Banana Cake
ingredients: 1 tsp. baking soda, dissolved in water
directions: Combine all ingredients in order given, combining baking powder with the flour.
Use just enough hot water to dissolve the soda. Bake at 350°.
recipes.text: Banana Cake. Combine all ingredients in order given, combining baking powder with the flour. Use just enough hot water to dissolve the soda. Bake at 350°.

recipes.title: Applesauce Pie
directions: Mix all ingredients together.
Pour into 2 pie shells.
Bake until done.
recipes.text: Applesauce Pie. Mix all ingredients together. Pour into 2 pie shells. Bake until done.

recipes.title: Mom'S Christmas Pecan Cake
directions: Cream butter and brown sugar.
Add eggs.
Beat well.
Add flour, pecans, cherries and pineapple.
Mix well.
Add lemon extract and blend well.
recipes.text: Mom'S Christmas Pecan Cake. Cream butter and brown sugar. Add eggs. Beat well. Add flour, pecans, cherries and pineapple. Mix well. Add lemon extract and blend well.

recipes.title: Easy Quiche
directions: Grease well an oblong casserole dish or sheath cake pan well. Unroll dough and place in bottom of pan.
Brown sausage (drain well).
Sprinkle over dough.
Sprinkle cheese over sausage.
Beat 4 eggs well.
Add salt, pepper and 3/4 cup milk.
Pour evenly over cheese.
Bake at 400° for 25 minutes.
Let stand a few minutes before cutting.
recipes.text: Easy Quiche. Grease well an oblong casserole dish or sheath cake pan well. Unroll dough and place in bottom of pan. Brown sausage (drain well). Sprinkle over dough. Sprinkle cheese over sausage. Beat 4 eggs well. Add salt, pepper and 3/4 cup milk. Pour evenly over cheese. Bake at 400° for 25 minutes. Let stand a few minutes before cutting.

recipes.title: Robert Redford Cake
ingredients: 1 (19 1/2 oz.) jar butterscotch, caramel or fudge topping
3 crushed chocolate covered toffee candy bars or 1 c. peanuts
directions: Prepare and bake cake in 13 x 9-inch pan according to package directions.
While cake is still warm, poke holes (about a dozen) across top of cake with the end of a wooden spoon.
Let cool slightly.
Pour sweetened condensed milk and topping into holes and over cake.
Let stand a few minutes, then spread with Cool Whip. Sprinkle crushed candy bars over top.
Serves 12 to 16.
recipes.text: Robert Redford Cake. Prepare and bake cake in 13 x 9-inch pan according to package directions. While cake is still warm, poke holes (about a dozen) across top of cake with the end of a wooden spoon. Let cool slightly. Pour sweetened condensed milk and topping into holes and over cake. Let stand a few minutes, then spread with Cool Whip. Sprinkle crushed candy bars over top. Serves 12 to 16.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Bread
directions: Mix ingredients together.
Grease 4 coffee cans.
Fill 1/2 full.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour and leave in cans until ready to serve.
recipes.text: Pumpkin Bread. Mix ingredients together. Grease 4 coffee cans. Fill 1/2 full. Bake at 350° for 1 hour and leave in cans until ready to serve.

recipes.title: Roasted Red Pepper Dip
directions: Combine all ingredients in a food processor or blender; mix on high until smooth. Chill, then serve.
recipes.text: Roasted Red Pepper Dip. Combine all ingredients in a food processor or blender; mix on high until smooth. Chill, then serve.

recipes.title: Beef Stroganoff
ingredients: 1 round steak, chopped or cut into 1-inch strips
directions: Brown steak strips
in butter;	remove from pan.
Brown onions, then mushrooms;
adding
more
butter
as needed.
Add soup; allow to sit over
low heat for approximately 5 minutes. Add sour cream and enough
flour to thicken gravy.
Bring to a low boil; add meat strips.
Heat and serve.
recipes.text: Beef Stroganoff. Brown steak strips in butter;	remove from pan. Brown onions, then mushrooms; adding more butter as needed. Add soup; allow to sit over low heat for approximately 5 minutes. Add sour cream and enough flour to thicken gravy. Bring to a low boil; add meat strips. Heat and serve.

recipes.title: Escalloped Corn With Jiffy Mix
directions: Combine butter, sugar and salt with boiling water.
Stir well and cool to lukewarm.
Dissolve yeast in warm water and let set until foamy.
Separate 1 egg, reserving yolk.
Add egg white and 3 remaining eggs and yeast to butter and water mixture. Gradually stir in 4 cups of flour and blend well.
Add remaining flour gradually to form a soft dough.
Cover and let rest 10 minutes.
Knead about 5 minutes.
Let rise in covered, greased bowl.
Punch down.
Divide dough into 2 or 3 parts.
Divide each part into 3 equal portions and roll each into a rope 12 to 15 inches long.
Braid these 3 ropes; tuck ends under.
Repeat with all the portions.
recipes.text: Escalloped Corn With Jiffy Mix. Combine butter, sugar and salt with boiling water. Stir well and cool to lukewarm. Dissolve yeast in warm water and let set until foamy. Separate 1 egg, reserving yolk. Add egg white and 3 remaining eggs and yeast to butter and water mixture. Gradually stir in 4 cups of flour and blend well. Add remaining flour gradually to form a soft dough. Cover and let rest 10 minutes. Knead about 5 minutes. Let rise in covered, greased bowl. Punch down. Divide dough into 2 or 3 parts. Divide each part into 3 equal portions and roll each into a rope 12 to 15 inches long. Braid these 3 ropes; tuck ends under. Repeat with all the portions.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Bread
directions: Mix sugar, oil, eggs and pumpkin.
Add dry ingredients; mix well.
Pour into greased and floured loaf pan.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
Serve hot or cold.
recipes.text: Pumpkin Bread. Mix sugar, oil, eggs and pumpkin. Add dry ingredients; mix well. Pour into greased and floured loaf pan. Bake at 350° for 1 hour. Serve hot or cold.

recipes.title: Oatmeal Pie
directions: In a bowl, beat eggs.
Add sugar, oats, corn syrup, butter and coconut.
Pour into pastry shell.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes or until golden brown.
Yield: 6-8 servings.
recipes.text: Oatmeal Pie. In a bowl, beat eggs. Add sugar, oats, corn syrup, butter and coconut. Pour into pastry shell. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes or until golden brown. Yield: 6-8 servings.

recipes.title: Spinach Dip
ingredients: 1 box frozen spinach, thawed and drained of all water
directions: Mix spinach, sour cream, mayonnaise and water chestnuts.
Stir in soup mix.
Stir until all ingredients are mixed well.
Chill and serve with wheat crackers.
recipes.text: Spinach Dip. Mix spinach, sour cream, mayonnaise and water chestnuts. Stir in soup mix. Stir until all ingredients are mixed well. Chill and serve with wheat crackers.

recipes.title: Scallop Casserole
directions: Mix crumbs and butter.
Salt and pepper to taste.
Alternate layers of crumbs and scallops in buttered casserole.
Drizzle cream over the casserole.
Bake at 375° for 40 minutes.
recipes.text: Scallop Casserole. Mix crumbs and butter. Salt and pepper to taste. Alternate layers of crumbs and scallops in buttered casserole. Drizzle cream over the casserole. Bake at 375° for 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Egg Casserole
directions: Layer bread on bottom (cubed) of 9 x 13 x 2-inch pan.
Layer sausage, mushrooms and cheese.
Mix eggs, mustard, salt and 2 1/2 cups milk.
Add soup to egg mixture.
Pour over bread, sausage and cheese.
Cover and refrigerate overnight.
Cook 45 minutes at 350°.
recipes.text: Egg Casserole. Layer bread on bottom (cubed) of 9 x 13 x 2-inch pan. Layer sausage, mushrooms and cheese. Mix eggs, mustard, salt and 2 1/2 cups milk. Add soup to egg mixture. Pour over bread, sausage and cheese. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Cook 45 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Gnocchi(Potato Pasta)
directions: Boil the potatoes until soft.
Remove skins; mash.
When cool, empty onto a floured board or counter.
Break the egg and sprinkle the flour over the mixture, then knead until a smooth dough is attained.
Prepare a pot of salted, boiling water.
Roll the dough into long "ropes" about the diameter of a pencil.
Cut off dough in 1/2-inch pieces and boil until pasta rises to the top; drain. Serve with tomato sauce or sauteed vegetables.
recipes.text: Gnocchi(Potato Pasta). Boil the potatoes until soft. Remove skins; mash. When cool, empty onto a floured board or counter. Break the egg and sprinkle the flour over the mixture, then knead until a smooth dough is attained. Prepare a pot of salted, boiling water. Roll the dough into long "ropes" about the diameter of a pencil. Cut off dough in 1/2-inch pieces and boil until pasta rises to the top; drain. Serve with tomato sauce or sauteed vegetables.

recipes.title: Peach Cobbler
directions: Put peaches into buttered 8 x 12-inch dish.
Sprinkle with nutmeg.
Make a batter with next 5 ingredients and spoon over peaches.
Mix sugar, salt and cornstarch; sprinkle over batter. Spoon the boiling water over top.
Bake at 350° for about 1 hour. You can use other fruit.
recipes.text: Peach Cobbler. Put peaches into buttered 8 x 12-inch dish. Sprinkle with nutmeg. Make a batter with next 5 ingredients and spoon over peaches. Mix sugar, salt and cornstarch; sprinkle over batter. Spoon the boiling water over top. Bake at 350° for about 1 hour. You can use other fruit.

recipes.title: Ice Cream Surprise
ingredients: 4 to 6 Heath or Skor bars, broken in pieces
directions: Arrange ice cream sandwiches in a 9 x 13 serving dish. Cut if needed. Prick with fork. Pour syrup over ice cream, using as much as desired. Sprinkle with half pecan and candy pieces. Cover with Cool Whip. Sprinkle remaining pecans and candy on top. Freeze until ready to serve.
recipes.text: Ice Cream Surprise. Arrange ice cream sandwiches in a 9 x 13 serving dish. Cut if needed. Prick with fork. Pour syrup over ice cream, using as much as desired. Sprinkle with half pecan and candy pieces. Cover with Cool Whip. Sprinkle remaining pecans and candy on top. Freeze until ready to serve.

recipes.title: Chocolate Trifle
directions: Follow all directions on chocolate cake box and pudding.
Make whipped cream.
Add confectioners sugar to heavy cream and beat until fluffy.
recipes.text: Chocolate Trifle. Follow all directions on chocolate cake box and pudding. Make whipped cream. Add confectioners sugar to heavy cream and beat until fluffy.

recipes.title: Squash Casserole
directions: Stir all together and add 12 or more soda crackers, crumbled, and add 1 large can of canned milk. Put in a buttered casserole dish and cook at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes. Five minutes before it is done, put 4 slices of cheese on top and sprinkle paprika on top.
recipes.text: Squash Casserole. Stir all together and add 12 or more soda crackers, crumbled, and add 1 large can of canned milk. Put in a buttered casserole dish and cook at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes. Five minutes before it is done, put 4 slices of cheese on top and sprinkle paprika on top.

recipes.title: Remoulade Sauce
directions: Blend well.
Keep in refrigerator for 12 hours before serving. Makes 1 quart.
recipes.text: Remoulade Sauce. Blend well. Keep in refrigerator for 12 hours before serving. Makes 1 quart.

recipes.title: Crescent Chicken Squares
directions: Combine all ingredients, except rolls, and mix well. Separate crescent rolls into 4 rectangles. Spoon 1/2 cup of mixture onto center of each rectangle. Seal and brush top with 1 tablespoon melted margarine. Bake for 20 to 25 minutes at 350°. Serves 4.
recipes.text: Crescent Chicken Squares. Combine all ingredients, except rolls, and mix well. Separate crescent rolls into 4 rectangles. Spoon 1/2 cup of mixture onto center of each rectangle. Seal and brush top with 1 tablespoon melted margarine. Bake for 20 to 25 minutes at 350°. Serves 4.

recipes.title: Green Beans
ingredients: 2 (16 oz.) cans green beans, cut and drained
directions: Saute celery until tender-crisp.
Combine the cornstarch with the chicken broth and soy sauce.
Add to celery and cook, stirring until translucent and thickened.
Add beans and sliced water chestnuts, if desired, and heat through.
Add sliced scallions (green onions) and sesame seed.
recipes.text: Green Beans. Saute celery until tender-crisp. Combine the cornstarch with the chicken broth and soy sauce. Add to celery and cook, stirring until translucent and thickened. Add beans and sliced water chestnuts, if desired, and heat through. Add sliced scallions (green onions) and sesame seed.

recipes.title: Strawberry Jam
directions: Boil berries and 2 cups sugar for 3 minutes.
Add remaining 2 cups of sugar and boil 3 more minutes.
Let stand overnight, skimming before cooling.
Put in sterilized jar and paraffin. Berries stay whole.
recipes.text: Strawberry Jam. Boil berries and 2 cups sugar for 3 minutes. Add remaining 2 cups of sugar and boil 3 more minutes. Let stand overnight, skimming before cooling. Put in sterilized jar and paraffin. Berries stay whole.

recipes.title: French Dressing
directions: Mix well in blender.
Use for tossed salads, chicken, etc. Store unused salad dressing in refrigerator.
recipes.text: French Dressing. Mix well in blender. Use for tossed salads, chicken, etc. Store unused salad dressing in refrigerator.

recipes.title: Zucchini Pie
directions: To prepare squash, peel, scoop out the center and slice like apples.
Cover with cold water and bring to a boil.
Remove from heat and let stand 5 minutes.
Drain.
Add remaining ingredients and mix well.
Bake in the 2-crust pie shell at 450° for 15 minutes, then at 300° for 45 to 60 minutes.
recipes.text: Zucchini Pie. To prepare squash, peel, scoop out the center and slice like apples. Cover with cold water and bring to a boil. Remove from heat and let stand 5 minutes. Drain. Add remaining ingredients and mix well. Bake in the 2-crust pie shell at 450° for 15 minutes, then at 300° for 45 to 60 minutes.

recipes.title: Red Sauce
ingredients: 3/4 c. juice from cherries, strawberries or raspberries
few drops red food coloring (if desired)
directions: Mix the sugar and cornstarch in saucepan.
Stir the water and fruit juice in gradually.
Boil for 1 minute, stirring constantly. Stir in the almond flavoring and food coloring, if desired.
Use over cake slices or ice cream.
recipes.text: Red Sauce. Mix the sugar and cornstarch in saucepan. Stir the water and fruit juice in gradually. Boil for 1 minute, stirring constantly. Stir in the almond flavoring and food coloring, if desired. Use over cake slices or ice cream.

recipes.title: Macaroni Salad
directions: Mix all ingredients together in a large bowl and top with slices of boiled eggs and paprika.
Chill until ready to serve.
recipes.text: Macaroni Salad. Mix all ingredients together in a large bowl and top with slices of boiled eggs and paprika. Chill until ready to serve.

recipes.title: Hot Cocoa
ingredients: 1 (26 oz., 8 qt. size) box instant milk
1 (32 oz.) box Nestle Quik plus little more
directions: You can substitute brand names.
Mix together thoroughly in a very large container.
Put a 1/4 cup of mix to a cup or mug.
Add boiling water.
recipes.text: Hot Cocoa. You can substitute brand names. Mix together thoroughly in a very large container. Put a 1/4 cup of mix to a cup or mug. Add boiling water.

recipes.title: School Day Cookies
ingredients: 1/4 c. peanut butter, nuts, coconut or raisins
directions: Combine the first 4 ingredients; boil for 1 minute in large saucepan.
Remove from heat.
Add the oats, vanilla and other ingredients.
Drop by teaspoon onto waxed paper.
recipes.text: School Day Cookies. Combine the first 4 ingredients; boil for 1 minute in large saucepan. Remove from heat. Add the oats, vanilla and other ingredients. Drop by teaspoon onto waxed paper.

recipes.title: Fudge Sundae Ice Cream Pie
directions: Mix on medium heat until thick.
Take off heat and let cool. Line bottom of 8-inch pie pan with whole vanilla wafers.
Spoon in a layer of vanilla ice cream; spoon a layer of fudge sauce. Repeat ice cream and chocolate until out of sauce.
Place in freezer.
Keep frozen until ready to serve.
recipes.text: Fudge Sundae Ice Cream Pie. Mix on medium heat until thick. Take off heat and let cool. Line bottom of 8-inch pie pan with whole vanilla wafers. Spoon in a layer of vanilla ice cream; spoon a layer of fudge sauce. Repeat ice cream and chocolate until out of sauce. Place in freezer. Keep frozen until ready to serve.

recipes.title: Crisscross Cookies
directions: Mix shortening, egg and sugar together.
Stir in milk and lemon extract.
Sift flour, salt, cream of tartar and soda together; stir in creamed mixture.
Add raisins.
Roll into balls the size of walnuts.
Put on ungreased baking sheet; flatten with fork dipped in water.
