Bake 8 to 10 minutes at 400°.
Makes 3 dozen.
recipes.text: Crisscross Cookies. Mix shortening, egg and sugar together. Stir in milk and lemon extract. Sift flour, salt, cream of tartar and soda together; stir in creamed mixture. Add raisins. Roll into balls the size of walnuts. Put on ungreased baking sheet; flatten with fork dipped in water. Bake 8 to 10 minutes at 400°. Makes 3 dozen.

recipes.title: Veal Scallopini
directions: Saute mushrooms in hot oil.
Remove and set aside.
Flour meat lightly; brown in hot oil.
Add mushrooms, salt, pepper and wine. Cover and simmer 20 minutes.
Serves six.
recipes.text: Veal Scallopini. Saute mushrooms in hot oil. Remove and set aside. Flour meat lightly; brown in hot oil. Add mushrooms, salt, pepper and wine. Cover and simmer 20 minutes. Serves six.

recipes.title: Baked Asparagus Royal
ingredients: 1 lb. fresh asparagus, cooked and cut into 2-inch pieces
2 c. grated American or Cheddar cheese
1 (10 3/4 oz.) can cream of mushroom soup
directions: Place a layer of cooked asparagus pieces in bottom of a casserole.
Cover with a layer of crushed potato chips and a layer of sliced hard-boiled eggs.
Cover with grated cheese and repeat. Add cream of mushroom soup.
Cover with grated cheese and crushed potato chips.
Bake in a preheated 350° oven for 30 minutes. Serve hot.
recipes.text: Baked Asparagus Royal. Place a layer of cooked asparagus pieces in bottom of a casserole. Cover with a layer of crushed potato chips and a layer of sliced hard-boiled eggs. Cover with grated cheese and repeat. Add cream of mushroom soup. Cover with grated cheese and crushed potato chips. Bake in a preheated 350° oven for 30 minutes. Serve hot.

recipes.title: Hot Dog Sauce
directions: Pour onions, tomato juice, tomato soup and tomato paste into cooked hamburger.
Add chili powder, salt, pepper and garlic powder to taste.
Add sugar, ketchup and mustard.
Simmer.
recipes.text: Hot Dog Sauce. Pour onions, tomato juice, tomato soup and tomato paste into cooked hamburger. Add chili powder, salt, pepper and garlic powder to taste. Add sugar, ketchup and mustard. Simmer.

recipes.title: Quick Rolls
directions: Stir all ingredients together.
Bake at 425° for 20 minutes. Makes 2 dozen.
recipes.text: Quick Rolls. Stir all ingredients together. Bake at 425° for 20 minutes. Makes 2 dozen.

recipes.title: Skillet Cookies
directions: Add to the date mixture in the skillet.
Keep hot while removing spoonfuls to shape into balls.
Then roll each cookie in coconut and powdered sugar.
Makes 40 cookies.
recipes.text: Skillet Cookies. Add to the date mixture in the skillet. Keep hot while removing spoonfuls to shape into balls. Then roll each cookie in coconut and powdered sugar. Makes 40 cookies.

recipes.title: Corn Bread
directions: Mix together the first 5 ingredients.
Mix in the milk, egg and melted shortening.
Spoon into shallow pan (8-inch square). Bake for 20 minutes, until lightly browned and all edges let go. Set oven at 425°.
recipes.text: Corn Bread. Mix together the first 5 ingredients. Mix in the milk, egg and melted shortening. Spoon into shallow pan (8-inch square). Bake for 20 minutes, until lightly browned and all edges let go. Set oven at 425°.

recipes.title: Cajun Pasta
directions: Brown onion, pepper, celery and carrot in olive oil.
When soft and slightly browned, add tomatoes and spices.
Cook on low.
recipes.text: Cajun Pasta. Brown onion, pepper, celery and carrot in olive oil. When soft and slightly browned, add tomatoes and spices. Cook on low.

recipes.title: Raisin Puffs
directions: Cream sugar, shortening and eggs well.
Add flour, soda, cinnamon and salt, then add hot raisin juice.
Mix well.
Add raisins.
Roll into a ball in sugar and put on cookie sheet.
Bake at 375° for 10 to 12 minutes.
recipes.text: Raisin Puffs. Cream sugar, shortening and eggs well. Add flour, soda, cinnamon and salt, then add hot raisin juice. Mix well. Add raisins. Roll into a ball in sugar and put on cookie sheet. Bake at 375° for 10 to 12 minutes.

recipes.title: Classic Mexican Beans - Garay'S Version(These Beans Contain Less Fat Than The Canned Versions)
ingredients: 1 or 2 (depending on taste) links pork chorizo, casing removed
directions: Pick over, wash and drain beans.
Place in 6 to 8-quart Dutch oven and cover with water.
Add remaining ingredients.
Bring to boil.
Cover and simmer until tender (2 to 3 hours).
Add boiling water whenever needed to keep beans barely covered.
recipes.text: Classic Mexican Beans - Garay'S Version(These Beans Contain Less Fat Than The Canned Versions). Pick over, wash and drain beans. Place in 6 to 8-quart Dutch oven and cover with water. Add remaining ingredients. Bring to boil. Cover and simmer until tender (2 to 3 hours). Add boiling water whenever needed to keep beans barely covered.

recipes.title: Corn Salad
directions: Drain Mexicorn; add bell pepper, cucumbers, onions and mayonnaise.
Cover and chill.
Add tomatoes before serving.
recipes.text: Corn Salad. Drain Mexicorn; add bell pepper, cucumbers, onions and mayonnaise. Cover and chill. Add tomatoes before serving.

recipes.title: Sweet Potato Custard Pie
directions: Combine sweet potatoes and butter, mixing until blended.
Add sugar and spices; mix well.
Blend in eggs and milk, stirring well (batter should be a little thin).
Pour into crusts.
Bake at 350° until pies are pretty brown, about 1 1/2 hours.
recipes.text: Sweet Potato Custard Pie. Combine sweet potatoes and butter, mixing until blended. Add sugar and spices; mix well. Blend in eggs and milk, stirring well (batter should be a little thin). Pour into crusts. Bake at 350° until pies are pretty brown, about 1 1/2 hours.

recipes.title: Desert Inn Cake
directions: Pour water over oats and let stand 20 minutes or until cool. Cream shortening, sugars, eggs and vanilla; add to oats mixture. Sift together dry ingredients and add to oats mixture; mix well. Grease and flour 9 x 13-inch pan.
Bake at 350° for 35 minutes.
recipes.text: Desert Inn Cake. Pour water over oats and let stand 20 minutes or until cool. Cream shortening, sugars, eggs and vanilla; add to oats mixture. Sift together dry ingredients and add to oats mixture; mix well. Grease and flour 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350° for 35 minutes.

recipes.title: Let'S Talk Peanut Butter Pie
directions: Mix all ingredients together until smooth.
Pour into the crust and chill until firm.
Garnish with crushed peanuts, grated chocolate or crumbs of Reeses peanut butter cups.
recipes.text: Let'S Talk Peanut Butter Pie. Mix all ingredients together until smooth. Pour into the crust and chill until firm. Garnish with crushed peanuts, grated chocolate or crumbs of Reeses peanut butter cups.

recipes.title: Creamy Cream Puffs
directions: Heat oven to 400°.
Heat water in saucepan with oleo to a rolling boil in the pan.
Stir vigorously over low heat until mixture forms a ball that leaves pan after adding the flour, about 1 minute.
Remove from heat.
Beat in eggs thoroughly, one at a time.
Beat until smooth and mixture breaks off when spoon is raised.
Drop dough by scant 1/4 cupfuls about 2 inches apart onto ungreased baking sheet.
Bake 45 to 50 minutes or until puffed and golden brown.
Allow to cool slowly away from drafts.
Cut off tops with sharp knife.
Scoop out any strands of soft dough.
Fill with desired flavor of pudding.
Sprinkle with powdered sugar if desired.
Makes 12 large or 40 small.
recipes.text: Creamy Cream Puffs. Heat oven to 400°. Heat water in saucepan with oleo to a rolling boil in the pan. Stir vigorously over low heat until mixture forms a ball that leaves pan after adding the flour, about 1 minute. Remove from heat. Beat in eggs thoroughly, one at a time. Beat until smooth and mixture breaks off when spoon is raised. Drop dough by scant 1/4 cupfuls about 2 inches apart onto ungreased baking sheet. Bake 45 to 50 minutes or until puffed and golden brown. Allow to cool slowly away from drafts. Cut off tops with sharp knife. Scoop out any strands of soft dough. Fill with desired flavor of pudding. Sprinkle with powdered sugar if desired. Makes 12 large or 40 small.

recipes.title: Cherry Burst
directions: Combine condensed milk, lemon juice and vanilla.
Fold in remaining ingredients, one at a time.
Fill pie crust with mixture.
Freeze until firm (2 to 3 hours).
Let stand at room temperature for 15 to 20 minutes before serving.
recipes.text: Cherry Burst. Combine condensed milk, lemon juice and vanilla. Fold in remaining ingredients, one at a time. Fill pie crust with mixture. Freeze until firm (2 to 3 hours). Let stand at room temperature for 15 to 20 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Chocolate No Bake Cookies
directions: Bring last 5 ingredients to a boil.
At full boil add 1 teaspoon vanilla.
Add liquid to dry ingredients.
Drop on wax paper and cool.
Makes 3 1/2 dozen.
recipes.text: Chocolate No Bake Cookies. Bring last 5 ingredients to a boil. At full boil add 1 teaspoon vanilla. Add liquid to dry ingredients. Drop on wax paper and cool. Makes 3 1/2 dozen.

recipes.title: Party Dogs
directions: Cut hot dogs into pieces.
Mix mustard and jelly.
Put in crock-pot and simmer on high for 1 hour.
Serve hot.
recipes.text: Party Dogs. Cut hot dogs into pieces. Mix mustard and jelly. Put in crock-pot and simmer on high for 1 hour. Serve hot.

recipes.title: Potato Soup
directions: Cook potatoes in boiling salted water; when soft, rub through strainer.
Scald milk; add to potatoes.
Mel butter; add dry ingredients.
Stir until well mixed; stir into boiling soup.
Cook 1 minute.
Strain and sprinkle with chopped parsley.
recipes.text: Potato Soup. Cook potatoes in boiling salted water; when soft, rub through strainer. Scald milk; add to potatoes. Mel butter; add dry ingredients. Stir until well mixed; stir into boiling soup. Cook 1 minute. Strain and sprinkle with chopped parsley.

recipes.title: Instant Cocoa Mix(1 Gallon Dry Mix)
ingredients: 1 1/2 c. (6 oz. jar) powdered nondairy coffee creamer
10 2/3 c. nonfat dry milk (enough to make 8 qt.)
directions: Combine all ingredients in a large mixing bowl.
Store in an airtight one gallon container.
To serve, fill a mug half-full of the mixture; finish filling with water and stir until blended. Heat in microwave oven on Full power for 1 1/2 to 2 minutes or until warmed.
recipes.text: Instant Cocoa Mix(1 Gallon Dry Mix). Combine all ingredients in a large mixing bowl. Store in an airtight one gallon container. To serve, fill a mug half-full of the mixture; finish filling with water and stir until blended. Heat in microwave oven on Full power for 1 1/2 to 2 minutes or until warmed.

recipes.title: Russian Tea
directions: Mix well together and store in jar.
When serving, use 2 teaspoons to a cup of hot water.
recipes.text: Russian Tea. Mix well together and store in jar. When serving, use 2 teaspoons to a cup of hot water.

recipes.title: Squash Casserole
directions: Peel and cut squash. Remove seeds and cut in 1-inch cubes. Cook in boiling salted water until tender; drain.
Place in buttered baking dish. Top with butter and brown sugar. Bake in a 400° oven
about 20 minutes or until brown.
recipes.text: Squash Casserole. Peel and cut squash. Remove seeds and cut in 1-inch cubes. Cook in boiling salted water until tender; drain. Place in buttered baking dish. Top with butter and brown sugar. Bake in a 400° oven about 20 minutes or until brown.

recipes.title: Cold Cut Bread
directions: Beat the egg.
Chop cold cuts.
Put into egg and mix.
Spread dough on greased baking pan.
Place cold cuts down the center of the dough.
Fold ends of dough over each other to form bread. Pinch all ends to prevent breakage.
Bake in 350° oven until it is golden.
recipes.text: Cold Cut Bread. Beat the egg. Chop cold cuts. Put into egg and mix. Spread dough on greased baking pan. Place cold cuts down the center of the dough. Fold ends of dough over each other to form bread. Pinch all ends to prevent breakage. Bake in 350° oven until it is golden.

recipes.title: Green Bean Casserole
directions: Brown meat
and onion.
Place in the bottom of a casserole. Add
green
beans (drained).
Add soup and place potato tots on top
to
cover casserole.
Bake at 350° about 15 to 20 minutes or until potatoes are brown.
recipes.text: Green Bean Casserole. Brown meat and onion. Place in the bottom of a casserole. Add green beans (drained). Add soup and place potato tots on top to cover casserole. Bake at 350° about 15 to 20 minutes or until potatoes are brown.

recipes.title: Pineapple Cheese Mold
directions: Dissolve jello in water. Stir in remaining ingredients and pour into mold. Refrigerate until set. Serves 8.
recipes.text: Pineapple Cheese Mold. Dissolve jello in water. Stir in remaining ingredients and pour into mold. Refrigerate until set. Serves 8.

recipes.title: In The Pan Chocolate Cake
directions: Mix flour, sugar, soda, salt and cocoa together in a 9 X 13 ungreased cake pan. Make 3 holes in middle of mixture. Hole #1 put vinegar. Hole #2 put oil. Hole #3 put vanilla. Pour cold water over all. Mix all together well. Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes. Serve plain or with frosting.
recipes.text: In The Pan Chocolate Cake. Mix flour, sugar, soda, salt and cocoa together in a 9 X 13 ungreased cake pan. Make 3 holes in middle of mixture. Hole #1 put vinegar. Hole #2 put oil. Hole #3 put vanilla. Pour cold water over all. Mix all together well. Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes. Serve plain or with frosting.

recipes.title: Brown Sugar Brownies *
directions: Cream sugar and butter; add eggs (one by one), then add vanilla, flour and baking powder, then the nuts.
Spread onto pans which have been greased and floured.
Bake at 350° until brown, then cool and cut in squares.
recipes.text: Brown Sugar Brownies *. Cream sugar and butter; add eggs (one by one), then add vanilla, flour and baking powder, then the nuts. Spread onto pans which have been greased and floured. Bake at 350° until brown, then cool and cut in squares.

recipes.title: Aunt Agnes' Carrot Cake
directions: Mix oil, sugar and eggs.
Add dry ingredients and mix well. Add balance of ingredients.
Bake in a 9 x 12-inch pan for 55 to 60 minutes at 375°.
recipes.text: Aunt Agnes' Carrot Cake. Mix oil, sugar and eggs. Add dry ingredients and mix well. Add balance of ingredients. Bake in a 9 x 12-inch pan for 55 to 60 minutes at 375°.

recipes.title: Stuffed Celery
directions: Mix ingredients and stuff celery heart rib.
Leave smaller leaves on celery.
recipes.text: Stuffed Celery. Mix ingredients and stuff celery heart rib. Leave smaller leaves on celery.

recipes.title: Catherine'S Spaghetti With Clams
ingredients: 1 lb. very thin spaghetti (capellini or angel hair)
directions: Note:
Brand name and fresh ingredients produce excellent results.
Great gourmet meal for unexpected guests.
recipes.text: Catherine'S Spaghetti With Clams. Note: Brand name and fresh ingredients produce excellent results. Great gourmet meal for unexpected guests.

recipes.title: Mr. Mcgill'S Chicken
directions: Grease a shallow baking dish and then line the bottom with 2 layers of the dried beef.
Wrap each breast with 1 strip of bacon and lay in the pan.
Mix the sour cream and soup together.
Cover the chicken with this mixture.
Cover and cook for 2 1/2 hours at 300°.
Uncover and bake for another 1/2 hour.
Serve warm.
recipes.text: Mr. Mcgill'S Chicken. Grease a shallow baking dish and then line the bottom with 2 layers of the dried beef. Wrap each breast with 1 strip of bacon and lay in the pan. Mix the sour cream and soup together. Cover the chicken with this mixture. Cover and cook for 2 1/2 hours at 300°. Uncover and bake for another 1/2 hour. Serve warm.

recipes.title: Macaroni And Frank Casserole
ingredients: 1 lb. hot dogs, cut into 1-inch pieces
directions: Cook macaroni and drain well.
Set aside.
Melt oleo in large saucepan over low heat.
Add onion and celery.
Cook until tender, stirring occasionally.
Add flour.
Stir well.
Cook 1 minute, stirring constantly.
recipes.text: Macaroni And Frank Casserole. Cook macaroni and drain well. Set aside. Melt oleo in large saucepan over low heat. Add onion and celery. Cook until tender, stirring occasionally. Add flour. Stir well. Cook 1 minute, stirring constantly.

recipes.title: Paprikas Krumpli
directions: Saute onions in oil.
Add peppers and garlic.
Later, add tomato, paprika and water as much as needed.
Cook until ready, 3/4 to 1 hour, slowly until tender and thick.
Stir once in a while.
recipes.text: Paprikas Krumpli. Saute onions in oil. Add peppers and garlic. Later, add tomato, paprika and water as much as needed. Cook until ready, 3/4 to 1 hour, slowly until tender and thick. Stir once in a while.

recipes.title: Colcannon
directions: Cover potatoes with water in large Dutch oven or pot; boil until tender, about 20 minutes.
While potatoes cook, trim and slice cabbage.
Add to pan, adding more water as necessary. Combine onion and evaporated milk in medium saucepan and simmer over medium heat until onion is soft, about 15 minutes.
When potatoes and cabbage are tender, drain water from pan.
Spoon potatoes into bowl and mash.
Add cabbage and milk-onion mixture; season with pepper to taste and serve.
Yield:
8 servings.
recipes.text: Colcannon. Cover potatoes with water in large Dutch oven or pot; boil until tender, about 20 minutes. While potatoes cook, trim and slice cabbage. Add to pan, adding more water as necessary. Combine onion and evaporated milk in medium saucepan and simmer over medium heat until onion is soft, about 15 minutes. When potatoes and cabbage are tender, drain water from pan. Spoon potatoes into bowl and mash. Add cabbage and milk-onion mixture; season with pepper to taste and serve. Yield: 8 servings.

recipes.title: Anne'S Cheese Spread For Fish
directions: Broil fish (steaks take 10 minutes per inch and 5 minutes on each side).
Mix topping.
Spread on top of broiled fish.
Broil until brown and bubbly.
recipes.text: Anne'S Cheese Spread For Fish. Broil fish (steaks take 10 minutes per inch and 5 minutes on each side). Mix topping. Spread on top of broiled fish. Broil until brown and bubbly.

recipes.title: Sweet Potato Souffle
directions: Mix potatoes with mixer; then add remaining ingredients.
Mix well.
Pour into an 11 x 15-inch greased pan.
recipes.text: Sweet Potato Souffle. Mix potatoes with mixer; then add remaining ingredients. Mix well. Pour into an 11 x 15-inch greased pan.

recipes.title: Peach Custard Noodle Pudding(Side Dish For Chicken, Turkey Or Veal)
directions: Preheat oven to 375°.
Boil noodles according to package directions.
Beat eggs with 1/2 cup sugar and add milk and vanilla; mixing until well combined.
Drain noodles and pour into a buttered rectangular baking dish (10 x 13-inches).
Pour milk-egg mixture over noodles.
Arrange peach slices over top of noodles.
recipes.text: Peach Custard Noodle Pudding(Side Dish For Chicken, Turkey Or Veal). Preheat oven to 375°. Boil noodles according to package directions. Beat eggs with 1/2 cup sugar and add milk and vanilla; mixing until well combined. Drain noodles and pour into a buttered rectangular baking dish (10 x 13-inches). Pour milk-egg mixture over noodles. Arrange peach slices over top of noodles.

recipes.title: Glazed Carrots
directions: Cook carrots and set aside.
Melt butter and brown sugar. Add the cinnamon to melted mixture.
Combine with the carrots and serve.
recipes.text: Glazed Carrots. Cook carrots and set aside. Melt butter and brown sugar. Add the cinnamon to melted mixture. Combine with the carrots and serve.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Fudge Chews
directions: Combine corn syrup and sugar in a large saucepan.
Heat to boiling and remove from heat. Stir in peanut butter. Mix well. Stir in cereal and pecans.
Drop from a tablespoon onto wax paper.
recipes.text: Peanut Butter Fudge Chews. Combine corn syrup and sugar in a large saucepan. Heat to boiling and remove from heat. Stir in peanut butter. Mix well. Stir in cereal and pecans. Drop from a tablespoon onto wax paper.

recipes.title: Parmesan Chicken
ingredients: 1/2 c. fine bread or cracker crumbs
directions: Combine crumbs, 1/4 cup Parmesan cheese, oregano, garlic powder, salt and pepper.
Roll chicken in mixture.
Arrange skin side down in shallow baking pan or divide between two 2-quart shallow baking dishes.
Bake at 400° for 20 minutes.
Turn chicken and bake 20 minutes more.
recipes.text: Parmesan Chicken. Combine crumbs, 1/4 cup Parmesan cheese, oregano, garlic powder, salt and pepper. Roll chicken in mixture. Arrange skin side down in shallow baking pan or divide between two 2-quart shallow baking dishes. Bake at 400° for 20 minutes. Turn chicken and bake 20 minutes more.

recipes.title: Apple Or Peach Cobbler
directions: Heat oven to 350°.
Melt oleo in a 9 x 13 x 2-inch cake pan. Heat water and sugar in saucepan until sugar melts.
Mix flour and shortening until crumbly.
Add milk and stir with fork.
Turn out on floured board and knead until smooth.
Roll dough out into oblong about 1/4-inch thick.
Sprinkle with cinnamon.
Add fruit on top.
Roll up like jelly roll.
Dampen edge with water to seal. Slice dough into 16 slices, 1/2 inch thick.
Place in pan with melted butter.
Pour water and sugar syrup carefully around rolls. This looks like too much liquid, but the crust will absorb it. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Apple Or Peach Cobbler. Heat oven to 350°. Melt oleo in a 9 x 13 x 2-inch cake pan. Heat water and sugar in saucepan until sugar melts. Mix flour and shortening until crumbly. Add milk and stir with fork. Turn out on floured board and knead until smooth. Roll dough out into oblong about 1/4-inch thick. Sprinkle with cinnamon. Add fruit on top. Roll up like jelly roll. Dampen edge with water to seal. Slice dough into 16 slices, 1/2 inch thick. Place in pan with melted butter. Pour water and sugar syrup carefully around rolls. This looks like too much liquid, but the crust will absorb it. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Sour Cream Salmon Loaf
directions: Measure the corn flakes and crush into crumbs.
Drain off half of the liquid of the salmon.
Combine all ingredients.
recipes.text: Sour Cream Salmon Loaf. Measure the corn flakes and crush into crumbs. Drain off half of the liquid of the salmon. Combine all ingredients.

recipes.title: Apricot Glaze
directions: In blender at medium speed or in food processor with knife blade attached, blend all ingredients until smooth.
Pour into small bowl.
recipes.text: Apricot Glaze. In blender at medium speed or in food processor with knife blade attached, blend all ingredients until smooth. Pour into small bowl.

recipes.title: Whole Kernel Cornbread
directions: Beat ingredients together.
Bake 30 minutes in greased 9 x 13-inch dish at 400°.
Cut in squares and serve hot.
Serves 8.
recipes.text: Whole Kernel Cornbread. Beat ingredients together. Bake 30 minutes in greased 9 x 13-inch dish at 400°. Cut in squares and serve hot. Serves 8.

recipes.title: Chicken And Rice Casserole
ingredients: 4 c. water or 1/2 chicken broth and 1/2 water
directions: Place chicken in a buttered 13 x 9-inch pan.
Pour rice over chicken.
Mix water and soups.
Pour over chicken and rice.
Bake for 1 hour and 15 minutes at 350° in a covered dish.
recipes.text: Chicken And Rice Casserole. Place chicken in a buttered 13 x 9-inch pan. Pour rice over chicken. Mix water and soups. Pour over chicken and rice. Bake for 1 hour and 15 minutes at 350° in a covered dish.

recipes.title: Spicy Chicken Bites
directions: Cut chicken into bite-size pieces. Mix mustard and 1/4 cup melted butter.
Dip chicken pieces into mustard mixture and then into crushed crackers.
Place in baking pan and drizzle 1/4 cup butter over. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Spicy Chicken Bites. Cut chicken into bite-size pieces. Mix mustard and 1/4 cup melted butter. Dip chicken pieces into mustard mixture and then into crushed crackers. Place in baking pan and drizzle 1/4 cup butter over. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Hot Sausage Balls
directions: Mix well and shape in small balls.
Place on cookie tin and bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes.
recipes.text: Hot Sausage Balls. Mix well and shape in small balls. Place on cookie tin and bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Savory Pot Roast And Vegetables
ingredients: 4 medium potatoes, peeled and cut lengthwise into sixths
4 medium carrots, peeled, cut in 1-inch chunks
directions: Preheat oven to 350°.
In a 6- to 8-quart Dutch oven brown meat on both sides in hot oil.
Drain off excess fat.
In a small bowl stir together Marsala wine, 1/3 cup water, basil, garlic salt, and 1/2 teaspoon pepper; pour over meat.
Cover and bake for 2 hours.
recipes.text: Savory Pot Roast And Vegetables. Preheat oven to 350°. In a 6- to 8-quart Dutch oven brown meat on both sides in hot oil. Drain off excess fat. In a small bowl stir together Marsala wine, 1/3 cup water, basil, garlic salt, and 1/2 teaspoon pepper; pour over meat. Cover and bake for 2 hours.

recipes.title: Oven Fried Perch Parmesan
directions: Dip fillets in milk.
Combine crumbs, Parmesan and thyme. Coat fish with bread crumbs.
Lay in single layer on greased shallow baking pan.
Bake in 450° oven for 10 minutes per inch of thickness of fish.
It is done when fish flakes easily with a fork.
recipes.text: Oven Fried Perch Parmesan. Dip fillets in milk. Combine crumbs, Parmesan and thyme. Coat fish with bread crumbs. Lay in single layer on greased shallow baking pan. Bake in 450° oven for 10 minutes per inch of thickness of fish. It is done when fish flakes easily with a fork.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter No Bakes
directions: Mix oleo, sugar, milk and salt in saucepan.
Boil 1 minute. Remove from heat.
Stir in peanut butter, vanilla and oatmeal. Drop on waxed paper.
recipes.text: Peanut Butter No Bakes. Mix oleo, sugar, milk and salt in saucepan. Boil 1 minute. Remove from heat. Stir in peanut butter, vanilla and oatmeal. Drop on waxed paper.

recipes.title: Butter Crunch Bars
directions: Melt butter over low heat in 2-quart saucepan.
Remove from heat.
Add sugar.
Stir until well blended.
Return to cook on low heat.
Continue to stir until mixture reaches full rolling boil. Add water and syrup; mix well.
Cook over low heat, stirring constantly.
Heat to 390° or soft crack stage.
Remove from heat, stir in 3/4 cup nuts immediately.
Pour into lightly greased (buttered) 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan.
Spread with spatula.
Let cool. Remove from pan.
Place on wax paper.
Melt and spread chocolate on top.
Let stand until chocolate is set.
Break into pieces.
recipes.text: Butter Crunch Bars. Melt butter over low heat in 2-quart saucepan. Remove from heat. Add sugar. Stir until well blended. Return to cook on low heat. Continue to stir until mixture reaches full rolling boil. Add water and syrup; mix well. Cook over low heat, stirring constantly. Heat to 390° or soft crack stage. Remove from heat, stir in 3/4 cup nuts immediately. Pour into lightly greased (buttered) 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Spread with spatula. Let cool. Remove from pan. Place on wax paper. Melt and spread chocolate on top. Let stand until chocolate is set. Break into pieces.

recipes.title: Potatoes Au Gratin
directions: Melt butter; blend in flour and salt.
Stir until smooth. Turn to low heat and slowly add milk, stirring constantly.
Cook and stir until thick and smooth.
Remove from heat.
Add cheese and stir until cheese melts.
Arrange potatoes in 1 1/2-quart buttered casserole dish.
Pour cheese sauce over potatoes; top with crumbs.
Dot with additional butter.
Bake in 350° oven for 15 to 20 minutes or until golden brown.
Serves 4.
recipes.text: Potatoes Au Gratin. Melt butter; blend in flour and salt. Stir until smooth. Turn to low heat and slowly add milk, stirring constantly. Cook and stir until thick and smooth. Remove from heat. Add cheese and stir until cheese melts. Arrange potatoes in 1 1/2-quart buttered casserole dish. Pour cheese sauce over potatoes; top with crumbs. Dot with additional butter. Bake in 350° oven for 15 to 20 minutes or until golden brown. Serves 4.

recipes.title: Hershey'S Deep Dark Chocolate Cake
ingredients: 1 c. boiling water or hot coffee
directions: Heat oven to 350°.
Grease and flour pan (two 9-inch or 13 x 9 x 2).
Stir together flour, sugar, cocoa, baking powder, baking soda and salt in mixing bowl.
Add eggs (which are at room temperature), milk, oil and vanilla.
Beat 2 minutes.
Mix in the boiling water or hot coffee (I prefer coffee).
Batter will be thin.
Bake for 30 to 35 minutes
for round pans or 35 to 40 minutes for rectangular pan.
Check with toothpick.
Cool and frost.
Great with peanut butter cooked icing.
recipes.text: Hershey'S Deep Dark Chocolate Cake. Heat oven to 350°. Grease and flour pan (two 9-inch or 13 x 9 x 2). Stir together flour, sugar, cocoa, baking powder, baking soda and salt in mixing bowl. Add eggs (which are at room temperature), milk, oil and vanilla. Beat 2 minutes. Mix in the boiling water or hot coffee (I prefer coffee). Batter will be thin. Bake for 30 to 35 minutes for round pans or 35 to 40 minutes for rectangular pan. Check with toothpick. Cool and frost. Great with peanut butter cooked icing.

recipes.title: Microwave Caramel Corn
directions: Spray Pam inside sack.
Pour popcorn into sack.
Melt margarine in a 4 cup measuring cup.
Stir first 4 ingredients together.
Cook 2 minutes on High after mixture starts to boil. Remove from microwave; add soda and stir well (foamy).
Pour syrup over popped corn in paper sack.
Fold down sack top twice.
Cook sack and all 1 1/2 minutes on High.
Loosen sack and shake like crazy.
Repeat steps.
Put in bowl (hot).
recipes.text: Microwave Caramel Corn. Spray Pam inside sack. Pour popcorn into sack. Melt margarine in a 4 cup measuring cup. Stir first 4 ingredients together. Cook 2 minutes on High after mixture starts to boil. Remove from microwave; add soda and stir well (foamy). Pour syrup over popped corn in paper sack. Fold down sack top twice. Cook sack and all 1 1/2 minutes on High. Loosen sack and shake like crazy. Repeat steps. Put in bowl (hot).

recipes.title: Chocolate Covered Strawberries
directions: Wash strawberries.
Pat thoroughly dry.
Allow to stand at room temperature for 2 hours.
Leave stems and leaves intact.
Melt chocolate chips with shortening over a double boiler.
Holding strawberries by the stem, dip 3/4 into chocolate coating all around.
Allow to drip and place on a plate covered with wax paper. Place in refrigerator to cool.
May be done 2 to 3 hours in advance.
recipes.text: Chocolate Covered Strawberries. Wash strawberries. Pat thoroughly dry. Allow to stand at room temperature for 2 hours. Leave stems and leaves intact. Melt chocolate chips with shortening over a double boiler. Holding strawberries by the stem, dip 3/4 into chocolate coating all around. Allow to drip and place on a plate covered with wax paper. Place in refrigerator to cool. May be done 2 to 3 hours in advance.

recipes.title: Strawberry Angel Food Cake Dessert
directions: In a 9 x 13-inch dish, tear cake into pieces.
Mix the cream cheese, Cool Whip, sugar and milk together; spread over cake.
Mix berries and Glaze together and spread over cream mixture.
Chill until ready to serve.
recipes.text: Strawberry Angel Food Cake Dessert. In a 9 x 13-inch dish, tear cake into pieces. Mix the cream cheese, Cool Whip, sugar and milk together; spread over cake. Mix berries and Glaze together and spread over cream mixture. Chill until ready to serve.

recipes.title: Salami
directions: Mix well.
Let stand 24 hours in refrigerator (mix 3 times during this time).
Shape into loaves.
Bake on broiler pan.
Put meat thermometer in center of a loaf; when it reaches 170°, it is done.
Bake at 250°.
recipes.text: Salami. Mix well. Let stand 24 hours in refrigerator (mix 3 times during this time). Shape into loaves. Bake on broiler pan. Put meat thermometer in center of a loaf; when it reaches 170°, it is done. Bake at 250°.

recipes.title: Zucchini Bread
directions: In large bowl, stir together flour, sugar, cinnamon, salt, baking powder, baking soda, zucchini, nuts and raisins.
recipes.text: Zucchini Bread. In large bowl, stir together flour, sugar, cinnamon, salt, baking powder, baking soda, zucchini, nuts and raisins.

recipes.title: Pepperoni Loaf
ingredients: 1 frozen loaf bread, let thaw overnight
directions: Take thawed bread and roll out onto cookie sheet.
Set on door of oven preheated to 350° and let it rise for 15 to 20 minutes (until puffy).
Lay the slices of Provolone over entire loaf and then layer the pepperoni slices.
Roll bread in a jelly-like roll. Take egg white and baste bread.
Sprinkle sesame seed on top. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Pepperoni Loaf. Take thawed bread and roll out onto cookie sheet. Set on door of oven preheated to 350° and let it rise for 15 to 20 minutes (until puffy). Lay the slices of Provolone over entire loaf and then layer the pepperoni slices. Roll bread in a jelly-like roll. Take egg white and baste bread. Sprinkle sesame seed on top. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Sausage Bread Casserole
directions: Cook sausage and drain.
In a bowl mix cooked sausage, eggs and cheese.
Spray a 10x13 pan with pam...place 1 can crescent rolls, flat into bottom of pan.
Pour mixture on rolls... Place remaining rolls on top.
Cook according to directions on crescent roll pkg.
recipes.text: Sausage Bread Casserole. Cook sausage and drain. In a bowl mix cooked sausage, eggs and cheese. Spray a 10x13 pan with pam...place 1 can crescent rolls, flat into bottom of pan. Pour mixture on rolls... Place remaining rolls on top. Cook according to directions on crescent roll pkg.

recipes.title: Banana Pudding
directions: Mix sugar, flour and salt together.
Beat egg yellows and add with milk. Stir all ingredients together and heat until boiling on medium heat. Stir continuously.
Layer wafers, bananas and pudding.
End with a layer of wafers on top.
Enjoy.
recipes.text: Banana Pudding. Mix sugar, flour and salt together. Beat egg yellows and add with milk. Stir all ingredients together and heat until boiling on medium heat. Stir continuously. Layer wafers, bananas and pudding. End with a layer of wafers on top. Enjoy.

recipes.title: German Potato Dumplings
directions: Boil potatoes until soft enough to mash.
Add other ingredients and mix well.
Shape into balls.
Roll lightly into flour and cook in rapidly boiling water for 15 minutes.
recipes.text: German Potato Dumplings. Boil potatoes until soft enough to mash. Add other ingredients and mix well. Shape into balls. Roll lightly into flour and cook in rapidly boiling water for 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Marinade For Beef Or Pork
ingredients: 1 tsp. ground coriander (beef) or 1 tsp. ground ginger (pork)
directions: Blend in electric blender thoroughly and pour over 5 pounds beef or pork.
Marinate for only a few hours.
Excellent for barbecue.
recipes.text: Marinade For Beef Or Pork. Blend in electric blender thoroughly and pour over 5 pounds beef or pork. Marinate for only a few hours. Excellent for barbecue.

recipes.title: Pecan Pie
directions: Stir eggs and sugar with spoon. Do not beat with mixer. Add syrup, margarine and pecans. Put in regular pie crust and bake at 350° until firm.
recipes.text: Pecan Pie. Stir eggs and sugar with spoon. Do not beat with mixer. Add syrup, margarine and pecans. Put in regular pie crust and bake at 350° until firm.

recipes.title: Corn Bread
directions: Mix and bake at 400° until set and brown.
recipes.text: Corn Bread. Mix and bake at 400° until set and brown.

recipes.title: Wiener Wraps
directions: Measure oil into measuring cup; add milk to fill to 2/3 cup. Add mustard and onion; stir into Bisquick to make soft dough. Turn onto lightly floured board; roll out and cut into 10 strips. Roll each strip around wiener and place on lightly greased baking sheet.
Brush with butter and bake at 450° for 15 minutes or until lightly brown.
Serve hot with mustard.
recipes.text: Wiener Wraps. Measure oil into measuring cup; add milk to fill to 2/3 cup. Add mustard and onion; stir into Bisquick to make soft dough. Turn onto lightly floured board; roll out and cut into 10 strips. Roll each strip around wiener and place on lightly greased baking sheet. Brush with butter and bake at 450° for 15 minutes or until lightly brown. Serve hot with mustard.

recipes.title: Company Strada
ingredients: 12 slices white bread, cut like donuts
1 (10 oz.) pkg. broccoli, cooked (chopped or fresh)
directions: Put scraps of bread in bottom of 13 x 9-inch pan.
Layer cheese on top of that.
Next, put the broccoli and the ham. Arrange the donuts and holes on top.
Combine the eggs, salt, milk and dry mustard.
Pour over bread and cover with Saran Wrap. Refrigerate at least 6 hours.
Bake, uncovered, at 325° for 55 minutes.
Let stand 10 minutes before serving.
recipes.text: Company Strada. Put scraps of bread in bottom of 13 x 9-inch pan. Layer cheese on top of that. Next, put the broccoli and the ham. Arrange the donuts and holes on top. Combine the eggs, salt, milk and dry mustard. Pour over bread and cover with Saran Wrap. Refrigerate at least 6 hours. Bake, uncovered, at 325° for 55 minutes. Let stand 10 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Baked Chicken And Rice
directions: Heat soups, milk and butter.
Add rice.
Mix and pour into a 9 x 13-inch baking dish.
Place chicken on top. Brush chicken with melted butter. Bake at 275° for 2 1/2 to 3 hours.
recipes.text: Baked Chicken And Rice. Heat soups, milk and butter. Add rice. Mix and pour into a 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Place chicken on top. Brush chicken with melted butter. Bake at 275° for 2 1/2 to 3 hours.

recipes.title: Chess Cake
directions: Preheat at 350°.
Mix and bake for 35 minutes in oblong pan.
recipes.text: Chess Cake. Preheat at 350°. Mix and bake for 35 minutes in oblong pan.

recipes.title: Scalloped Potatoes
ingredients: 1/2 cup Parmesan cheese, freshly grated if possible
4 large baking potatoes, peeled and thinly sliced
directions: Combine Parmesan cheese and seasonings and set aside.
Layer 1/3 of the potatoes in casserole and top with half of the seasoning.
Repeat process ending with potatoes.
Combine whipping cream and water.
Pour over potatoes.
Top with cheddar cheese. Cover and bake at 350 degrees for 1-1/2 hours.
Uncover and bake 30 min. more.
recipes.text: Scalloped Potatoes. Combine Parmesan cheese and seasonings and set aside. Layer 1/3 of the potatoes in casserole and top with half of the seasoning. Repeat process ending with potatoes. Combine whipping cream and water. Pour over potatoes. Top with cheddar cheese. Cover and bake at 350 degrees for 1-1/2 hours. Uncover and bake 30 min. more.

recipes.title: Broccoli Salad
ingredients: 8 slices bacon, cooked crisp and crumbled
directions: Soak broccoli in cold water overnight.
recipes.text: Broccoli Salad. Soak broccoli in cold water overnight.

recipes.title: Apricot Filled Bars
directions: Place apricots and undrained pineapple in saucepan.
Cover and simmer 20 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Mix in 1/2 cup sugar and simmer 5 minutes longer; cool.
Beat butter and 1 cup sugar together.
Sift together flour, salt and soda.
Gradually add sifted ingredients to butter and sugar, mixing well.
Add nuts and coconut; mix well.
Press 2/3 of this mixture into bottom of ungreased 9 x 13-inch pan.
Bake at 400° for 10 minutes.
Remove from oven and spread apricot filling over crust.
Crumble remaining coconut mix over all.
Pat down.
Bake 20 to 25 minutes. Cool and cut into bars.
Makes 3 dozen.
recipes.text: Apricot Filled Bars. Place apricots and undrained pineapple in saucepan. Cover and simmer 20 minutes, stirring occasionally. Mix in 1/2 cup sugar and simmer 5 minutes longer; cool. Beat butter and 1 cup sugar together. Sift together flour, salt and soda. Gradually add sifted ingredients to butter and sugar, mixing well. Add nuts and coconut; mix well. Press 2/3 of this mixture into bottom of ungreased 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 400° for 10 minutes. Remove from oven and spread apricot filling over crust. Crumble remaining coconut mix over all. Pat down. Bake 20 to 25 minutes. Cool and cut into bars. Makes 3 dozen.

recipes.title: Low-Fat Macaroni And Cheese
directions: Place macaroni in a baking dish and set aside.
Make sauce by adding flour, water, milk and Egg Beaters; mix until smooth.
Dice 2 slices cheese in sauce and flour over macaroni.
Place remainder of cheese on top and bake until firm.
Less than 1 gram fat per serving.
Serves 4.
recipes.text: Low-Fat Macaroni And Cheese. Place macaroni in a baking dish and set aside. Make sauce by adding flour, water, milk and Egg Beaters; mix until smooth. Dice 2 slices cheese in sauce and flour over macaroni. Place remainder of cheese on top and bake until firm. Less than 1 gram fat per serving. Serves 4.

recipes.title: Candy Cookies
directions: Combine sugar, cocoa, milk and margarine in pan.
After mixture reaches a boil (medium heat), cook 1 minute; remove from heat.
Add remaining ingredients; stir well.
Drop on cookie sheet or wax paper.
Cool.
Serves 24.
recipes.text: Candy Cookies. Combine sugar, cocoa, milk and margarine in pan. After mixture reaches a boil (medium heat), cook 1 minute; remove from heat. Add remaining ingredients; stir well. Drop on cookie sheet or wax paper. Cool. Serves 24.

recipes.title: Ole Country Dinner
directions: Slice cabbage into thin strips.
Combine with rice in a large pot filled with water enough to cover cabbage and rice.
Cook until tender.
Brown hamburg with onion, draining off fat.
Put into pot with cabbage and rice.
Add soup base, salt and pepper.
Cook about an hour to get the flavor throughout all ingredients.
Makes about 4 quarts of dinner but can be decreased by the size of cabbage. Use your own judgment.
Serve with hot homemade bread.
You can also add other spices such as garlic if you like.
recipes.text: Ole Country Dinner. Slice cabbage into thin strips. Combine with rice in a large pot filled with water enough to cover cabbage and rice. Cook until tender. Brown hamburg with onion, draining off fat. Put into pot with cabbage and rice. Add soup base, salt and pepper. Cook about an hour to get the flavor throughout all ingredients. Makes about 4 quarts of dinner but can be decreased by the size of cabbage. Use your own judgment. Serve with hot homemade bread. You can also add other spices such as garlic if you like.

recipes.title: Crusty Fried Chicken
directions: Remove skin from chicken.
Soak in buttermilk overnight.
Next day, place flour, salt and pepper in a paper bag.
Put in chicken pieces and shake until coated.
Fry in medium grease until brown and crisp.
You may substitute for the buttermilk 3 tablespoons vinegar added to regular milk.
Let sit 3 or 4 minutes until thick.
recipes.text: Crusty Fried Chicken. Remove skin from chicken. Soak in buttermilk overnight. Next day, place flour, salt and pepper in a paper bag. Put in chicken pieces and shake until coated. Fry in medium grease until brown and crisp. You may substitute for the buttermilk 3 tablespoons vinegar added to regular milk. Let sit 3 or 4 minutes until thick.

recipes.title: Maple Walnut Apple Crisp
ingredients: 1/4 c. chilled butter, cut in small pieces
7 c. sliced apples (3 lb.; Rome, Gala or Granny Smith)
directions: Preheat oven to 375°. Lightly spoon flour into a dry measuring cup; level with a knife. Combine flour, sugar, oats and 1/4 teaspoon cinnamon in a medium bowl; cut in butter until crumbly. Stir in walnuts. Combine apple and remaining ingredients in a large bowl; toss well. Spoon apple mixture into an 8-inch square baking dish or 1 1/2-quart casserole. Sprinkle with crumb mixture. Bake at 375° for 45 minutes or until golden brown. Serve warm (with ice cream!). Contains 208 calories.
recipes.text: Maple Walnut Apple Crisp. Preheat oven to 375°. Lightly spoon flour into a dry measuring cup; level with a knife. Combine flour, sugar, oats and 1/4 teaspoon cinnamon in a medium bowl; cut in butter until crumbly. Stir in walnuts. Combine apple and remaining ingredients in a large bowl; toss well. Spoon apple mixture into an 8-inch square baking dish or 1 1/2-quart casserole. Sprinkle with crumb mixture. Bake at 375° for 45 minutes or until golden brown. Serve warm (with ice cream!). Contains 208 calories.

recipes.title: Orange Salad
directions: Combine jello, tapioca pudding and water in saucepan. Boil until jello is dissolved and tapioca is tender. Cool. Add mandarin oranges. Put in a bowl and chill until set. When ready to serve, blend in whipped cream. Serves 8.
recipes.text: Orange Salad. Combine jello, tapioca pudding and water in saucepan. Boil until jello is dissolved and tapioca is tender. Cool. Add mandarin oranges. Put in a bowl and chill until set. When ready to serve, blend in whipped cream. Serves 8.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Play Clay
directions: In medium bowl stir together all ingredients until blended. Knead about 30 seconds until smooth and plastic.
Use immediately or store in refrigerator in airtight container until ready to use. Makes about 1 and 3/4 cups.
recipes.text: Peanut Butter Play Clay. In medium bowl stir together all ingredients until blended. Knead about 30 seconds until smooth and plastic. Use immediately or store in refrigerator in airtight container until ready to use. Makes about 1 and 3/4 cups.

recipes.title: Asparagus Soup
ingredients: 2 c. asparagus, diced and cooked in 1 1/2 cup water)
directions: Put 1/2 of cooked asparagus in blender and chop.
Add to unchopped asparagus and water. Add 2 cups of White Sauce.
Heat thoroughly.
Yields 6 servings.
recipes.text: Asparagus Soup. Put 1/2 of cooked asparagus in blender and chop. Add to unchopped asparagus and water. Add 2 cups of White Sauce. Heat thoroughly. Yields 6 servings.

recipes.title: Best-Ever Meat Loaf
directions: In a large bowl, mix thoroughly 1/2 cup of the soup, beef, crumbs, onion and egg.
In a 12 x 8-inch baking pan, firmly shape meat into an 8 x 4-inch loaf.
Bake at 350° for 1 1/4 hours or until done.
Spoon off 1 tablespoon drippings; reserve.
In a saucepan over medium heat, heat remaining soup, water and reserved drippings to boiling, stirring occasionally.
Spoon over meat loaf.
recipes.text: Best-Ever Meat Loaf. In a large bowl, mix thoroughly 1/2 cup of the soup, beef, crumbs, onion and egg. In a 12 x 8-inch baking pan, firmly shape meat into an 8 x 4-inch loaf. Bake at 350° for 1 1/4 hours or until done. Spoon off 1 tablespoon drippings; reserve. In a saucepan over medium heat, heat remaining soup, water and reserved drippings to boiling, stirring occasionally. Spoon over meat loaf.

recipes.title: Summer Sauce
ingredients: 1 (28 oz.) can plum tomatoes or crushed tomatoes
6 chopped fresh basil leaves or 1 Tbsp. dried basil
directions: Combine all ingredients in a small deep bowl.
Cover and leave at room temperature until ready to use.
Cook your favorite pasta (either spaghetti, linguini or angel hair) al dente.
Drain and pour some sauce on the bottom of a serving dish; place pasta over that.
Sprinkle with Romano cheese and top with more sauce.
recipes.text: Summer Sauce. Combine all ingredients in a small deep bowl. Cover and leave at room temperature until ready to use. Cook your favorite pasta (either spaghetti, linguini or angel hair) al dente. Drain and pour some sauce on the bottom of a serving dish; place pasta over that. Sprinkle with Romano cheese and top with more sauce.

recipes.title: Chicken Fingers
directions: Cut breasts into strips.
Salt and pepper to taste.
Sprinkle with paprika.
Dip into egg mixture.
Roll in flour.
Deep fry.
recipes.text: Chicken Fingers. Cut breasts into strips. Salt and pepper to taste. Sprinkle with paprika. Dip into egg mixture. Roll in flour. Deep fry.

recipes.title: Seven Layer Casserole
ingredients: 1 (11 oz.) can whole kernel corn, drained
directions: Heat oven to 375°.
Parboil sliced potatoes for 5 minutes and drain.
Place in bottom of greased 2-quart casserole.
In skillet, brown hamburger, salt, pepper, garlic powder, dill weed and celery.
Drain; place on top of potatoes.
Place sliced onion on top of hamburger.
Spread can of corn on top of onions.
Pour tomato soup mixed with 3/4 can water over all the layers.
Add grated cheese on top of all.
Put bread crumbs over cheese.
Bake 1 hour.
recipes.text: Seven Layer Casserole. Heat oven to 375°. Parboil sliced potatoes for 5 minutes and drain. Place in bottom of greased 2-quart casserole. In skillet, brown hamburger, salt, pepper, garlic powder, dill weed and celery. Drain; place on top of potatoes. Place sliced onion on top of hamburger. Spread can of corn on top of onions. Pour tomato soup mixed with 3/4 can water over all the layers. Add grated cheese on top of all. Put bread crumbs over cheese. Bake 1 hour.

recipes.title: Poor Man'S Cake
directions: Simmer for 15 minutes and let cool the raisins and water. Cream the sugar, shortening and cold water.
Add flour, salt, cinnamon, nutmeg, cloves and baking soda.
Add raisins and juice (if needed).
Mix up real good.
Pour in 10-inch tube pan.
Bake 1 hour at 350°.
recipes.text: Poor Man'S Cake. Simmer for 15 minutes and let cool the raisins and water. Cream the sugar, shortening and cold water. Add flour, salt, cinnamon, nutmeg, cloves and baking soda. Add raisins and juice (if needed). Mix up real good. Pour in 10-inch tube pan. Bake 1 hour at 350°.

recipes.title: Meal In One
directions: Combine potatoes, carrots, peas, onion, salt and pepper. Arrange vegetables and frankfurters in layers in buttered casserole.
Sprinkle each layer with flour.
Add milk.
Bake at 400° for 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Meal In One. Combine potatoes, carrots, peas, onion, salt and pepper. Arrange vegetables and frankfurters in layers in buttered casserole. Sprinkle each layer with flour. Add milk. Bake at 400° for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Breathren Cheese Bread
directions: Sift flour, baking powder, salt and sugar in large bowl.
Cut butter in until coarse crumbs result.
Stir in cheese, onion and dill weed.
Mix well.
Combine milk and beaten eggs.
Pour into flour mixture all at once.
Stir quickly with fork to moisten flour.
Pour into greased 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan and bake at 350° for 40 to 50 minutes.
Cool 10 minutes in pan before serving. Serve warm.
Yield:
1 loaf.
recipes.text: Breathren Cheese Bread. Sift flour, baking powder, salt and sugar in large bowl. Cut butter in until coarse crumbs result. Stir in cheese, onion and dill weed. Mix well. Combine milk and beaten eggs. Pour into flour mixture all at once. Stir quickly with fork to moisten flour. Pour into greased 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan and bake at 350° for 40 to 50 minutes. Cool 10 minutes in pan before serving. Serve warm. Yield: 1 loaf.

recipes.title: Dill Dip
directions: Mix together.
Better if made 6 to 8 hours before use.
recipes.text: Dill Dip. Mix together. Better if made 6 to 8 hours before use.

recipes.title: Herbed Sauce For Cold Salmon
ingredients: fresh parsley, dill, chives and watercress
directions: Mince the fresh herbs and mix with other ingredients.
Chill.
recipes.text: Herbed Sauce For Cold Salmon. Mince the fresh herbs and mix with other ingredients. Chill.

recipes.title: Chicken Tetrazzini
directions: Boil pasta according to directions on box.
In separate pan, combine diet Mazola, chopped onions and celery.
Saute.
recipes.text: Chicken Tetrazzini. Boil pasta according to directions on box. In separate pan, combine diet Mazola, chopped onions and celery. Saute.

recipes.title: Orange Icing
directions: Combine all ingredients; cook 3 minutes or until thick. Spread on while cake is warm.
Ample icing for a 2 layer cake.
recipes.text: Orange Icing. Combine all ingredients; cook 3 minutes or until thick. Spread on while cake is warm. Ample icing for a 2 layer cake.

recipes.title: Kathy'S Favorite Pie Crust Recipe
directions: In a large bowl, cut shortening into flour using a knife or pastry cutter until coarse and crumbly.
Add beaten egg, ice water and vinegar.
Mix together and work into a dough.
Makes two 9-inch pie crusts.
recipes.text: Kathy'S Favorite Pie Crust Recipe. In a large bowl, cut shortening into flour using a knife or pastry cutter until coarse and crumbly. Add beaten egg, ice water and vinegar. Mix together and work into a dough. Makes two 9-inch pie crusts.

recipes.title: Cheese Roll
directions: Combine ingredients; shape into a roll.
Roll in paprika and refrigerate until firm.
Slice.
Cut in 32 slices.
recipes.text: Cheese Roll. Combine ingredients; shape into a roll. Roll in paprika and refrigerate until firm. Slice. Cut in 32 slices.

recipes.title: Broccoli-Cheese Soup
directions: Mix together and cook first seven ingredients for 30 minutes or until potatoes are done.
recipes.text: Broccoli-Cheese Soup. Mix together and cook first seven ingredients for 30 minutes or until potatoes are done.

recipes.title: Whole Grain Buttermilk Pancakes
directions: In a medium bowl combine flour, oat bran, cornmeal, sugar, baking powder, soda and salt.
Combine buttermilk, egg yolks and oil.
In a clean large bowl, beat egg whites with mixer on high speed until they form stiff peaks.
Combine buttermilk mixture with the flour mixture.
Fold in egg whites.
recipes.text: Whole Grain Buttermilk Pancakes. In a medium bowl combine flour, oat bran, cornmeal, sugar, baking powder, soda and salt. Combine buttermilk, egg yolks and oil. In a clean large bowl, beat egg whites with mixer on high speed until they form stiff peaks. Combine buttermilk mixture with the flour mixture. Fold in egg whites.

recipes.title: Date Bars
directions: Cream sugar and butter.
Add eggs, flour, salt, vanilla and baking powder and mix well.
Add dates and nuts.
Bake in a greased, 11 x 7-inch pan twenty minutes at 350° or until brown. Cut in squares and roll in powdered sugar.
recipes.text: Date Bars. Cream sugar and butter. Add eggs, flour, salt, vanilla and baking powder and mix well. Add dates and nuts. Bake in a greased, 11 x 7-inch pan twenty minutes at 350° or until brown. Cut in squares and roll in powdered sugar.

recipes.title: Crescent Cookies
directions: Beat butter until creamy; add sugar.
Stir in remaining ingredients and blend well.
Chill dough until firm enough to shape.
Form into small crescents and bake 10 to 12 minutes at 400°.
Cool and roll into powdered sugar.
recipes.text: Crescent Cookies. Beat butter until creamy; add sugar. Stir in remaining ingredients and blend well. Chill dough until firm enough to shape. Form into small crescents and bake 10 to 12 minutes at 400°. Cool and roll into powdered sugar.

recipes.title: Marinated Tomatoes
directions: Mix dressing and water together.
Cut tomatoes in quarters. Pour just enough dressing/water mixture over tomatoes to coat them. *
Need to have enough mixture in bowl to toss with.
Chill for 30 minutes, then serve.
recipes.text: Marinated Tomatoes. Mix dressing and water together. Cut tomatoes in quarters. Pour just enough dressing/water mixture over tomatoes to coat them. * Need to have enough mixture in bowl to toss with. Chill for 30 minutes, then serve.

recipes.title: Broccoli And Cheese Casserole
directions: Put cheese and soup in double boiler until cheese melts. Put broccoli in a buttered casserole. Pour cheese and soup mixture over. Sprinkle bread crumbs on top. Bake at 375° until bubbly.
recipes.text: Broccoli And Cheese Casserole. Put cheese and soup in double boiler until cheese melts. Put broccoli in a buttered casserole. Pour cheese and soup mixture over. Sprinkle bread crumbs on top. Bake at 375° until bubbly.

recipes.title: Tamale Corn Casserole
directions: Mix together well all ingredients and pour into a casserole dish and bake at 350° about one hour or until knife tip inserted in middle comes out clean.
recipes.text: Tamale Corn Casserole. Mix together well all ingredients and pour into a casserole dish and bake at 350° about one hour or until knife tip inserted in middle comes out clean.

recipes.title: Cucumber Relish
directions: Grind the cucumbers, onions and peppers; mix together with the salt and 2 quarts boiling water.
Let stand for 1 hour; drain well.
Add spices, vinegar and sugar.
Boil for 1/2 hour.
Add a few drops of green food coloring.
Seal hot.
Yields 6 to 8 pints.
recipes.text: Cucumber Relish. Grind the cucumbers, onions and peppers; mix together with the salt and 2 quarts boiling water. Let stand for 1 hour; drain well. Add spices, vinegar and sugar. Boil for 1/2 hour. Add a few drops of green food coloring. Seal hot. Yields 6 to 8 pints.

recipes.title: Peanutty Chews
directions: Lightly grease cookie sheets.
In large saucepan, combine sugar and corn syrup.
Bring to a boil over medium heat.
Boil 1 minute. Remove from heat.
Add peanut butter; stir until completely melted. Stir in peanuts.
Drop by tablespoonfuls onto prepared cookie sheets.
Cool until firm.
Store, covered, in refrigerator in single layer.
Makes about 32 patties.
Preparation Time:
20 minutes plus cooling.
recipes.text: Peanutty Chews. Lightly grease cookie sheets. In large saucepan, combine sugar and corn syrup. Bring to a boil over medium heat. Boil 1 minute. Remove from heat. Add peanut butter; stir until completely melted. Stir in peanuts. Drop by tablespoonfuls onto prepared cookie sheets. Cool until firm. Store, covered, in refrigerator in single layer. Makes about 32 patties. Preparation Time: 20 minutes plus cooling.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Bread
directions: Cream sugar and oil.
Add eggs and pumpkin.
Mix and set aside. Sift together dry ingredients and stir into pumpkin mix.
Add water.
Pour into greased and floured 9 x 5-inch loaf pans.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Pumpkin Bread. Cream sugar and oil. Add eggs and pumpkin. Mix and set aside. Sift together dry ingredients and stir into pumpkin mix. Add water. Pour into greased and floured 9 x 5-inch loaf pans. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Burger Bundles
directions: Prepare stuffing according to "in bird" directions.
Mix hamburger and milk together well.
Make a meatball and flatten it on a plate so it is about 6 inches in diameter.
Put a ball of stuffing in the middle and mold the hamburger around it so it looks like a huge meatball.
Top each meatball with a generous spoonful of mushroom soup right out of the can (use the entire can).
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
Makes its own gravy.
recipes.text: Burger Bundles. Prepare stuffing according to "in bird" directions. Mix hamburger and milk together well. Make a meatball and flatten it on a plate so it is about 6 inches in diameter. Put a ball of stuffing in the middle and mold the hamburger around it so it looks like a huge meatball. Top each meatball with a generous spoonful of mushroom soup right out of the can (use the entire can). Bake at 350° for 1 hour. Makes its own gravy.

recipes.title: Cranberry Salad
directions: Mix jello according to directions.
Refrigerate until partially set.
Add other ingredients and refrigerate until set.
recipes.text: Cranberry Salad. Mix jello according to directions. Refrigerate until partially set. Add other ingredients and refrigerate until set.

recipes.title: Cherry Whip Pie
ingredients: 2 c. soda crackers, broken to the size of a dime
directions: Beat egg whites stiff with sugar.
Add cream of tartar to hold firm.
Add vanilla and pecans.
Add broken soda crackers.
Mix well and bake in 9 x 13-inch pan 30 minutes at 350°.
Set aside to cool at room temperature.
Add Cool Whip on top of crust, then top with cherry pie filling and chill 2 or 3 hours.
recipes.text: Cherry Whip Pie. Beat egg whites stiff with sugar. Add cream of tartar to hold firm. Add vanilla and pecans. Add broken soda crackers. Mix well and bake in 9 x 13-inch pan 30 minutes at 350°. Set aside to cool at room temperature. Add Cool Whip on top of crust, then top with cherry pie filling and chill 2 or 3 hours.

recipes.title: Cookie Ice Cream Rounds
directions: Bake cookies like the tube says.
Cool.
Put ice cream between 2 cookies and press together.
Wrap in foil and freeze.
recipes.text: Cookie Ice Cream Rounds. Bake cookies like the tube says. Cool. Put ice cream between 2 cookies and press together. Wrap in foil and freeze.

recipes.title: Green Salad
ingredients: fresh chopped vegetable (any can be added: cauliflower, broccoli, zucchini or mushrooms)
directions: Using
a
large
glass
bowl,
layer
shredded lettuce, celery,
green pepper, diced onion and peas.
Add second layer of lettuce.
Cover
with Miracle Whip being careful to seal to edges. Sprinkle
top of dressing with sugar.
Add thick layer of Parmesan cheese.
Sprinkle with bits of crisp bacon.
Cover with plastic
wrap and chill for 24 hours.
Almost any fresh, chopped vegetable
can
be
added:
cauliflower,
broccoli, zucchini or mushrooms.
recipes.text: Green Salad. Using a large glass bowl, layer shredded lettuce, celery, green pepper, diced onion and peas. Add second layer of lettuce. Cover with Miracle Whip being careful to seal to edges. Sprinkle top of dressing with sugar. Add thick layer of Parmesan cheese. Sprinkle with bits of crisp bacon. Cover with plastic wrap and chill for 24 hours. Almost any fresh, chopped vegetable can be added: cauliflower, broccoli, zucchini or mushrooms.

recipes.title: Easy Hollandaise Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 stick cold butter (1/4 c.) in saucepan
directions: Cook over low heat, stirring constantly, until butter melts and sauce is slightly thick.
Season to taste with salt.
Makes 1/2 cup sauce.
recipes.text: Easy Hollandaise Sauce. Cook over low heat, stirring constantly, until butter melts and sauce is slightly thick. Season to taste with salt. Makes 1/2 cup sauce.

recipes.title: Cranberry Sauce Salad
directions: Dissolve the gelatin in boiling water.
Stir in cranberry sauce.
Chill and fold in other ingredients.
recipes.text: Cranberry Sauce Salad. Dissolve the gelatin in boiling water. Stir in cranberry sauce. Chill and fold in other ingredients.

recipes.title: Candy
ingredients: 1 lb. white chocolate or almond bark
directions: Melt chocolate in microwave.
Add peanuts and pretzels to chocolate.
Stir and spread on cookie sheet.
Put in refrigerator for about 30 minutes.
Then break apart.
recipes.text: Candy. Melt chocolate in microwave. Add peanuts and pretzels to chocolate. Stir and spread on cookie sheet. Put in refrigerator for about 30 minutes. Then break apart.

recipes.title: Broccoli Casserole
ingredients: 1 (10 oz.) pkg. frozen chopped broccoli, thawed
directions: Cook rice for 5 minutes in water and salt listed.
Then combine with rest of ingredients.
Pour into a greased casserole dish. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Broccoli Casserole. Cook rice for 5 minutes in water and salt listed. Then combine with rest of ingredients. Pour into a greased casserole dish. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Orange-Pineapple Jello Salad
directions: Bring pudding, jello and 1 1/2 cups water to a boil over medium heat.
Remove from heat and let cool completely.
After cooled, stir in Cool Whip and the drained fruit.
Refrigerate until firm.
recipes.text: Orange-Pineapple Jello Salad. Bring pudding, jello and 1 1/2 cups water to a boil over medium heat. Remove from heat and let cool completely. After cooled, stir in Cool Whip and the drained fruit. Refrigerate until firm.

recipes.title: Hamburger Soup
directions: Fry hamburger; drain grease.
In large pan, put can tomato soup, can stewed tomatoes, mixed vegetables (juice and all).
Dump in envelope of onion soup.
Add hamburger.
Cook on top of stove on medium heat until hot.
Serves 6.
recipes.text: Hamburger Soup. Fry hamburger; drain grease. In large pan, put can tomato soup, can stewed tomatoes, mixed vegetables (juice and all). Dump in envelope of onion soup. Add hamburger. Cook on top of stove on medium heat until hot. Serves 6.

recipes.title: Wild Rice And Chicken Casserole
ingredients: 1 (6 oz.) box long grain and wild rice
directions: Cook rice according to directions on package.
Saute onion in butter or margarine.
Blend in flour, salt and pepper.
Stir in half and half and chicken broth.
Stir constantly.
Cook until thickened.
Combine sauce with cooked rice, chopped pimiento and parsley, chicken and almonds.
Pour into 2-quart casserole which has been sprayed with Pam.
Bake 30 minutes at 425°.
Serves 4 to 6.
recipes.text: Wild Rice And Chicken Casserole. Cook rice according to directions on package. Saute onion in butter or margarine. Blend in flour, salt and pepper. Stir in half and half and chicken broth. Stir constantly. Cook until thickened. Combine sauce with cooked rice, chopped pimiento and parsley, chicken and almonds. Pour into 2-quart casserole which has been sprayed with Pam. Bake 30 minutes at 425°. Serves 4 to 6.

recipes.title: Zucchini, Onion And Carrot Saute
directions: Wash zucchini, but do not peel.
Cut into thin slices.
Put into a 10-inch skillet.
Add carrots, onions, salt, black pepper and basil.
Pour olive oil over top; stir gently until well mixed with vegetables.
Over medium heat, saute vegetables for 5 minutes, stirring often.
Reduce heat to low.
Cover vegetables; cook 5 minutes longer.
Remove cover; stir and cook about 10 more minutes, until vegetables are tender-crisp.
Serve hot.
Makes 4 servings.
recipes.text: Zucchini, Onion And Carrot Saute. Wash zucchini, but do not peel. Cut into thin slices. Put into a 10-inch skillet. Add carrots, onions, salt, black pepper and basil. Pour olive oil over top; stir gently until well mixed with vegetables. Over medium heat, saute vegetables for 5 minutes, stirring often. Reduce heat to low. Cover vegetables; cook 5 minutes longer. Remove cover; stir and cook about 10 more minutes, until vegetables are tender-crisp. Serve hot. Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: Squash Casserole
ingredients: 1 pkg. Pepperidge Farm seasoned bread crumbs
1 (10 1/2 oz.) can cream of chicken soup
directions: Preheat oven to 350°.
Mix all ingredients except bread crumbs.
Sprinkle bread crumbs on bottom of buttered casserole dish, add squash mixture, cover with more bread crumbs and add butter slices.
Bake for 30 minutes.
Yields 6 servings.
recipes.text: Squash Casserole. Preheat oven to 350°. Mix all ingredients except bread crumbs. Sprinkle bread crumbs on bottom of buttered casserole dish, add squash mixture, cover with more bread crumbs and add butter slices. Bake for 30 minutes. Yields 6 servings.

recipes.title: Oatmeal Cookies
directions: Combine first 4 ingredients until well mixed.
Sift next 4 ingredients together.
Add to first mixture along with frozen orange juice.
Fold in oats, nuts and raisins.
Bake on ungreased cookie pan 8 to 10 minutes in a 350° oven.
Drop by teaspoon.
recipes.text: Oatmeal Cookies. Combine first 4 ingredients until well mixed. Sift next 4 ingredients together. Add to first mixture along with frozen orange juice. Fold in oats, nuts and raisins. Bake on ungreased cookie pan 8 to 10 minutes in a 350° oven. Drop by teaspoon.

recipes.title: Dirt Cake
directions: Thoroughly crush Oreo cookies in large bowl (a blender can be used).
Mix together butter, cream cheese and powdered sugar in another bowl.
In another bowl mix pudding and milk.
Combine cream cheese mixture and pudding mixture.
Fold in Cool Whip.
In 8-inch plastic flowerpot, use the Cool Whip lid to cover the hole in bottom of the planter.
Layer crumbs and pudding mixture beginning and ending with cookie crumbs.
Refrigerate overnight to set. Garnish with gummy worms and an artificial flower.
Serve with a garden trowel.
recipes.text: Dirt Cake. Thoroughly crush Oreo cookies in large bowl (a blender can be used). Mix together butter, cream cheese and powdered sugar in another bowl. In another bowl mix pudding and milk. Combine cream cheese mixture and pudding mixture. Fold in Cool Whip. In 8-inch plastic flowerpot, use the Cool Whip lid to cover the hole in bottom of the planter. Layer crumbs and pudding mixture beginning and ending with cookie crumbs. Refrigerate overnight to set. Garnish with gummy worms and an artificial flower. Serve with a garden trowel.

recipes.title: Steak Marinated
directions: Mix ingredients and marinate overnight.
Then grill.
recipes.text: Steak Marinated. Mix ingredients and marinate overnight. Then grill.

recipes.title: Chocolate Delights
directions: Line an
x	13-inch cookie sheet with aluminum foil and spray with vegetable oil spray.
Place 36 saltines side by side. Boil
sticks
butter
and
brown sugar for 3 minutes (watch clock).
Pour
mixture over saltines and bake 7 minutes at 350°. Remove
from
oven	immediately
and while hot, pour chocolate morsels
over and spread with a knife.
Refrigerate for at least 1 hour.
Cut or break into pieces.
recipes.text: Chocolate Delights. Line an 11 x	13-inch cookie sheet with aluminum foil and spray with vegetable oil spray. Place 36 saltines side by side. Boil 2 sticks butter and brown sugar for 3 minutes (watch clock). Pour mixture over saltines and bake 7 minutes at 350°. Remove from oven	immediately and while hot, pour chocolate morsels over and spread with a knife. Refrigerate for at least 1 hour. Cut or break into pieces.

recipes.title: Elephant Ears
directions: Dissolve yeast in 1/4 cup warm water; let stand 5 minutes. Combine flour, 1 1/2 tablespoons sugar and salt in
a large bowl. Cut 1 cup butter into flour mixture with a pastry blender until a coarse meal.
Combine milk, egg yolk and yeast mixture; add to flour mixture.
Chill 2 hours.
Turn dough onto a floured surface; knead 1 to 2 minutes.
Cover and let rest 10 minutes.
Roll dough into an 18 x 10-inch rectangle on a lightly floured surface; brush with 2 tablespoons melted butter.
Combine 2 cups sugar and cinnamon; sprinkle 1 cup of mixture over dough.
Roll up jelly roll fashion, starting at long side; pinch long edge (do not seal ends).
Place roll, seam side down, and cut into 18 (1-inch) slices.
Sprinkle a portion of remaining cinnamon-sugar mixture lightly over waxed paper.
Roll each slice out to 1/8-inch thickness, turning over once.
Carefully transfer slices to an ungreased baking sheet.
Spread each pastry with remaining melted butter; sprinkle with remaining cinnamon-sugar mixture and pecans. Bake at 400° for 10 minutes or until lightly browned.
Cool on wire racks.
recipes.text: Elephant Ears. Dissolve yeast in 1/4 cup warm water; let stand 5 minutes. Combine flour, 1 1/2 tablespoons sugar and salt in a large bowl. Cut 1 cup butter into flour mixture with a pastry blender until a coarse meal. Combine milk, egg yolk and yeast mixture; add to flour mixture. Chill 2 hours. Turn dough onto a floured surface; knead 1 to 2 minutes. Cover and let rest 10 minutes. Roll dough into an 18 x 10-inch rectangle on a lightly floured surface; brush with 2 tablespoons melted butter. Combine 2 cups sugar and cinnamon; sprinkle 1 cup of mixture over dough. Roll up jelly roll fashion, starting at long side; pinch long edge (do not seal ends). Place roll, seam side down, and cut into 18 (1-inch) slices. Sprinkle a portion of remaining cinnamon-sugar mixture lightly over waxed paper. Roll each slice out to 1/8-inch thickness, turning over once. Carefully transfer slices to an ungreased baking sheet. Spread each pastry with remaining melted butter; sprinkle with remaining cinnamon-sugar mixture and pecans. Bake at 400° for 10 minutes or until lightly browned. Cool on wire racks.

recipes.title: Lola Faye'S Pound Cake
directions: Cream sugar, oil, shortening and eggs together.
Mix baking soda with flour.
Gradually blend in flour mixture and milk.
Mix in vanilla.
Pour into greased and floured tube cake pan.
Bake at 325° for about 1 1/2 hours.
recipes.text: Lola Faye'S Pound Cake. Cream sugar, oil, shortening and eggs together. Mix baking soda with flour. Gradually blend in flour mixture and milk. Mix in vanilla. Pour into greased and floured tube cake pan. Bake at 325° for about 1 1/2 hours.

recipes.title: Orange Fruit Salad
directions: Drain fruit well.
Mix pineapple, orange sections, cottage cheese, orange Jell-O (dry) and Cool Whip.
Chill.
recipes.text: Orange Fruit Salad. Drain fruit well. Mix pineapple, orange sections, cottage cheese, orange Jell-O (dry) and Cool Whip. Chill.

recipes.title: Lemon Cookies
ingredients: 2 c. Cool Whip or other frozen topping
directions: Mix first 3 ingredients.
Drop rounded teaspoonfuls into confectioners sugar; roll to coat thoroughly.
Bake on greased cookie sheet at 375° for 10 to 12 minutes until slightly browned at edges.
Cool.
recipes.text: Lemon Cookies. Mix first 3 ingredients. Drop rounded teaspoonfuls into confectioners sugar; roll to coat thoroughly. Bake on greased cookie sheet at 375° for 10 to 12 minutes until slightly browned at edges. Cool.

recipes.title: Never-Fail Pecan Pie
directions: Mix
all ingredients together.	Pour into
unbaked
pie shell and bake 30 to 45 minutes at 350° or until done.
recipes.text: Never-Fail Pecan Pie. Mix all ingredients together.	Pour into unbaked pie shell and bake 30 to 45 minutes at 350° or until done.

recipes.title: Fillet Of Sole In Lemon Parsley Butter
directions: Place margarine in rectangular baking dish, 12 x 8-inch, or 10-inch square casserole.
Microwave at High (100%) until melted, 45 seconds to 1 minute and 30 seconds.
Blend in remaining ingredients except fish fillets.
recipes.text: Fillet Of Sole In Lemon Parsley Butter. Place margarine in rectangular baking dish, 12 x 8-inch, or 10-inch square casserole. Microwave at High (100%) until melted, 45 seconds to 1 minute and 30 seconds. Blend in remaining ingredients except fish fillets.

recipes.title: Chicken Chablis
ingredients: Garlic powder and pepper to taste
directions: Combine eggs, parsley, cheese, milk, garlic powder and pepper and mix.
Place chicken in this marinade and refrigerate for two hours.
Bread each chicken breast and fry in oil.
To the oil remaining from frying, add a little water, wine, salt and pepper, parsley and mushrooms.
Pour this mixture over cooked chicken. Serve.
recipes.text: Chicken Chablis. Combine eggs, parsley, cheese, milk, garlic powder and pepper and mix. Place chicken in this marinade and refrigerate for two hours. Bread each chicken breast and fry in oil. To the oil remaining from frying, add a little water, wine, salt and pepper, parsley and mushrooms. Pour this mixture over cooked chicken. Serve.

recipes.title: Breakfast Casserole
ingredients: 1/2 c. cubed ham, bacon, sausage, green pepper, onion and mushrooms
directions: Preheat oven to 400°.
Crumble crackers.
Add butter; put in an 8 x 12-inch casserole dish.
Mix remaining ingredients.
Pour over crackers and bake 20 minutes.
recipes.text: Breakfast Casserole. Preheat oven to 400°. Crumble crackers. Add butter; put in an 8 x 12-inch casserole dish. Mix remaining ingredients. Pour over crackers and bake 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Marinated Cucumbers
ingredients: 2 Tbsp. tarragon vinegar or lemon juice
directions: Chill salted cucumbers 30 minutes and dry.
Combine remaining ingredients well and add cucumbers.
recipes.text: Marinated Cucumbers. Chill salted cucumbers 30 minutes and dry. Combine remaining ingredients well and add cucumbers.

recipes.title: Strawberry Cake
ingredients: 1 large pkg. frozen sliced strawberries, thawed
directions: Mix cake mix, eggs, oil, jello and milk together; set aside. In a separate bowl, mix strawberries, nuts and coconut together. Add 1/2 strawberry mixture to the cake batter.
Bake cake in a 13 x 9-inch pan at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Strawberry Cake. Mix cake mix, eggs, oil, jello and milk together; set aside. In a separate bowl, mix strawberries, nuts and coconut together. Add 1/2 strawberry mixture to the cake batter. Bake cake in a 13 x 9-inch pan at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Sour Cream Drop Cookies
directions: Mix shortening, sugar and vanilla.
Add eggs and beat.
Now add dry ingredients.
Add sour cream, stirring smooth after each addition.
Drop by teaspoonful on cookie sheet.
Bake in hot 400° oven until done.
When cool, spread with icing.
recipes.text: Sour Cream Drop Cookies. Mix shortening, sugar and vanilla. Add eggs and beat. Now add dry ingredients. Add sour cream, stirring smooth after each addition. Drop by teaspoonful on cookie sheet. Bake in hot 400° oven until done. When cool, spread with icing.

recipes.title: Deviled Crabs
directions: Mix together well.
Place in greased baking dish. Sprinkle with cracker crumbs and dot with butter.
Bake at 350° until brown.
recipes.text: Deviled Crabs. Mix together well. Place in greased baking dish. Sprinkle with cracker crumbs and dot with butter. Bake at 350° until brown.

recipes.title: Butterscotch Pie
directions: Cook in double boiler until thick and pour into baked pie crust.
Top with egg whites beaten until stiff with 2 tablespoons sugar.
Brown in oven.
recipes.text: Butterscotch Pie. Cook in double boiler until thick and pour into baked pie crust. Top with egg whites beaten until stiff with 2 tablespoons sugar. Brown in oven.

recipes.title: Foolproof Beef And Broccoli
ingredients: 1 can (10 3/4 oz.) cream of broccoli soup
directions: Slice beef across the grain into very thin strips.
In skillet, over medium-high heat, in hot oil, cook beef and garlic until beef is browned.
Add onion.
Cook 5 minutes, stirring often.
Stir in soup, water and soy sauce.
Heat to boiling.
Add broccoli.
Reduce heat to low.
Cover and simmer 5 minutes or until vegetables are tender.
Serve over noodles.
Serves 4.
recipes.text: Foolproof Beef And Broccoli. Slice beef across the grain into very thin strips. In skillet, over medium-high heat, in hot oil, cook beef and garlic until beef is browned. Add onion. Cook 5 minutes, stirring often. Stir in soup, water and soy sauce. Heat to boiling. Add broccoli. Reduce heat to low. Cover and simmer 5 minutes or until vegetables are tender. Serve over noodles. Serves 4.

recipes.title: Strawberry Wonder Dessert
directions: Prepare gelatin using 1 cup boiling water. Stir in frozen strawberries and chill until syrupy. Prepare pudding using 1 cup cold milk.
Beat in ice cream.
Tear cake into small pieces and place in a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Pour pudding mixture over cake, then pour strawberry mixture over pudding. Chill.
recipes.text: Strawberry Wonder Dessert. Prepare gelatin using 1 cup boiling water. Stir in frozen strawberries and chill until syrupy. Prepare pudding using 1 cup cold milk. Beat in ice cream. Tear cake into small pieces and place in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Pour pudding mixture over cake, then pour strawberry mixture over pudding. Chill.

recipes.title: Broccoli, Cheese And Rice Casserole
ingredients: 2 cans condensed cream of mushroom soup
directions: Combine first 7 ingredients in a casserole dish, mixing well. After mixed, cover the top with the Ritz crackers.
Cover casserole and bake at 350° for about 30 minutes.
Uncover and bake for another 15 to 20 minutes, so crackers can brown.
recipes.text: Broccoli, Cheese And Rice Casserole. Combine first 7 ingredients in a casserole dish, mixing well. After mixed, cover the top with the Ritz crackers. Cover casserole and bake at 350° for about 30 minutes. Uncover and bake for another 15 to 20 minutes, so crackers can brown.

recipes.title: Josie Dragseth'S Buns
directions: Soak yeast with water and 1 teaspoon of the sugar.
Add yeast mixture to the scalded milk.
Add 1/2 cup sugar, salt and eggs; mix well.
Add flour, a little at a time, beating well.
recipes.text: Josie Dragseth'S Buns. Soak yeast with water and 1 teaspoon of the sugar. Add yeast mixture to the scalded milk. Add 1/2 cup sugar, salt and eggs; mix well. Add flour, a little at a time, beating well.

recipes.title: Lemon Dessert
directions: In small saucepan, melt butter.
Stir in crumbs
(reserve 1 tablespoon for garnish).
Pat crumbs on bottom of 8 x 8-inch baking pan.
Set aside.
