recipes.text: Lemon Dessert. In small saucepan, melt butter. Stir in crumbs (reserve 1 tablespoon for garnish). Pat crumbs on bottom of 8 x 8-inch baking pan. Set aside.

recipes.title: Dilled Salmon Pie
ingredients: 1 (16 oz.) can salmon, drained and finely flaked
packaged instant mashed potatoes (to equal 4 servings)
directions: Combine bread crumbs, milk, the beaten egg, onion, butter or margarine and salt until crumbs are moistened. Add salmon and mix thoroughly. Turn into a greased 8-inch pie plate.
Prepare instant potatoes according to package directions, omitting milk. Beat in the remaining egg.
Spoon around edge of pie.
Bake in a 350° oven for 30 to 35 minutes. Serve wedges with warm Dill Sauce.
Makes 4 to 6 servings.
recipes.text: Dilled Salmon Pie. Combine bread crumbs, milk, the beaten egg, onion, butter or margarine and salt until crumbs are moistened. Add salmon and mix thoroughly. Turn into a greased 8-inch pie plate. Prepare instant potatoes according to package directions, omitting milk. Beat in the remaining egg. Spoon around edge of pie. Bake in a 350° oven for 30 to 35 minutes. Serve wedges with warm Dill Sauce. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

recipes.title: Banana Split Cake
directions: Have oleo at room temperature.
Pat graham cracker crumbs and one stick oleo into a long Pyrex dish.
Mix confectioners sugar, one stick oleo, cream cheese and eggs until melted.
(Note:
Use double boiler and beat eggs before adding to mix.)
recipes.text: Banana Split Cake. Have oleo at room temperature. Pat graham cracker crumbs and one stick oleo into a long Pyrex dish. Mix confectioners sugar, one stick oleo, cream cheese and eggs until melted. (Note: Use double boiler and beat eggs before adding to mix.)

recipes.title: Stuffed Green Peppers
ingredients: 4 lg. green peppers, tops and seeds removed
directions: Place ground beef, onion, celery and garlic in 2 quart microproof bowl.
Cook on HI for 5-6 minutes, stirring once to break up beef.
Stir in rice, egg, 3/4 c. tomato sauce, parsley, Worcestershire sauce, salt and pepper.
Fill green peppers with beef mixture, mounding top.
Arrange peppers in a ring in round or oval microproof baking dish just large enough to hold peppers upright.
Cover with casserole lid and cook on 70 for 12-14 minutes.
Spread 1 Tbsp. of the remaining tomato sauce on top of each pepper.
Serve with crusty garlic bread, if desired.
4 servings.
Total cooking time:
17-20 minutes.
recipes.text: Stuffed Green Peppers. Place ground beef, onion, celery and garlic in 2 quart microproof bowl. Cook on HI for 5-6 minutes, stirring once to break up beef. Stir in rice, egg, 3/4 c. tomato sauce, parsley, Worcestershire sauce, salt and pepper. Fill green peppers with beef mixture, mounding top. Arrange peppers in a ring in round or oval microproof baking dish just large enough to hold peppers upright. Cover with casserole lid and cook on 70 for 12-14 minutes. Spread 1 Tbsp. of the remaining tomato sauce on top of each pepper. Serve with crusty garlic bread, if desired. 4 servings. Total cooking time: 17-20 minutes.

recipes.title: Cherry Cobbler
ingredients: 1 c. cherry fruit syrup, with water added to make 1 c.
directions: Preheat oven to 375°.
Cream butter and 1/2 cup sugar until fluffy.
Sift dry ingredients together in another bowl; add this alternately to creamed mixture with milk.
Beat until smooth. Pour into loaf pan or 2-quart casserole.
Spoon drained cherries over batter.
Sprinkle with sugar, 1/4 to 1/2 cup as needed per tartness of cherries.
Pour 1 cup fruit juice and water mixture over top.
Bake for 45 to 50 minutes, until top browns.
During baking, juice goes to bottom and cakelike layer comes to the top.
recipes.text: Cherry Cobbler. Preheat oven to 375°. Cream butter and 1/2 cup sugar until fluffy. Sift dry ingredients together in another bowl; add this alternately to creamed mixture with milk. Beat until smooth. Pour into loaf pan or 2-quart casserole. Spoon drained cherries over batter. Sprinkle with sugar, 1/4 to 1/2 cup as needed per tartness of cherries. Pour 1 cup fruit juice and water mixture over top. Bake for 45 to 50 minutes, until top browns. During baking, juice goes to bottom and cakelike layer comes to the top.

recipes.title: Layered Bean Dip
directions: Layer in order on platter or serving dish.
Chill 1 hour before serving.
Serve with tortilla chips and salsa.
recipes.text: Layered Bean Dip. Layer in order on platter or serving dish. Chill 1 hour before serving. Serve with tortilla chips and salsa.

recipes.title: Layer Cake
directions: Cream butter and sugar.
Add eggs, beating one in at a time. Add milk and vanilla mixed together.
Mix in sifted flour and mix well.
Pour into four greased and floured cake pans and bake in moderate 350° oven until done.
(For thinner layers put less mixture in the pans.
I get 6 to 7 thin layers from this batter.) Frost with your favorite frosting.
recipes.text: Layer Cake. Cream butter and sugar. Add eggs, beating one in at a time. Add milk and vanilla mixed together. Mix in sifted flour and mix well. Pour into four greased and floured cake pans and bake in moderate 350° oven until done. (For thinner layers put less mixture in the pans. I get 6 to 7 thin layers from this batter.) Frost with your favorite frosting.

recipes.title: Good Punch
directions: Mix water and sugar together and bring to a boil.
Add juices. Mix well and pour into jars or 1 gallon container (milk jugs) and freeze.
Set out 2 hours before serving.
Mix in punch bowl with Sprite.
Food coloring may be added.
recipes.text: Good Punch. Mix water and sugar together and bring to a boil. Add juices. Mix well and pour into jars or 1 gallon container (milk jugs) and freeze. Set out 2 hours before serving. Mix in punch bowl with Sprite. Food coloring may be added.

recipes.title: Sicilian Quiche
ingredients: 1/4 lb. sliced salami, cut in strips
directions: Bake pastry shell at 450° for 8 minutes.
Be sure to prick shell before baking.
Saute onion and green pepper.
Arrange a layer of 1/2 the cheese, 1/2 the tomatoes, 1/2 the onion and green pepper mixture and 1/2 the salami into the baked pie shell. Repeat layers.
Beat eggs; stir in milk and remaining ingredients. Pour over layers in pastry shell; bake at 450° for 10 minutes. Reduce temperature to 350°; bake for 35 to 40 minutes, until set.
recipes.text: Sicilian Quiche. Bake pastry shell at 450° for 8 minutes. Be sure to prick shell before baking. Saute onion and green pepper. Arrange a layer of 1/2 the cheese, 1/2 the tomatoes, 1/2 the onion and green pepper mixture and 1/2 the salami into the baked pie shell. Repeat layers. Beat eggs; stir in milk and remaining ingredients. Pour over layers in pastry shell; bake at 450° for 10 minutes. Reduce temperature to 350°; bake for 35 to 40 minutes, until set.

recipes.title: Tuna Salad
directions: Drain tuna.
Combine celery, pickle, diced eggs and dash of pepper to tuna.
Mix salad dressing more, if needed, to tuna mixture.
Serve on lettuce leaf or crackers or make sandwich.
recipes.text: Tuna Salad. Drain tuna. Combine celery, pickle, diced eggs and dash of pepper to tuna. Mix salad dressing more, if needed, to tuna mixture. Serve on lettuce leaf or crackers or make sandwich.

recipes.title: Blackberry Sauce
directions: Combine berries, 1 cup water and sugar in a large saucepan; bring to a boil.
Combine 2 tablespoons water and cornstarch, mixing well; stir into blackberry mixture.
Cook 1 minute over medium-high heat, stirring constantly.
Remove from heat and add lemon juice; cool.
Chill.
Serve over angel food or sponge cake.
recipes.text: Blackberry Sauce. Combine berries, 1 cup water and sugar in a large saucepan; bring to a boil. Combine 2 tablespoons water and cornstarch, mixing well; stir into blackberry mixture. Cook 1 minute over medium-high heat, stirring constantly. Remove from heat and add lemon juice; cool. Chill. Serve over angel food or sponge cake.

recipes.title: Oriental Salad
directions: Drain all juice off peas, corn, bean sprouts and mushrooms. Mix all together.
Mix together oil, water, sugar and vinegar until sugar is dissolved.
Pour over other mixture and mix well. Let set overnight.
recipes.text: Oriental Salad. Drain all juice off peas, corn, bean sprouts and mushrooms. Mix all together. Mix together oil, water, sugar and vinegar until sugar is dissolved. Pour over other mixture and mix well. Let set overnight.

recipes.title: Grandma'S Toast
directions: Cut crusts from bread slices.
Combine cream cheese, egg yolks and 1/2 cup sugar.
Spread on the bread slices.
Roll up like kieflies or crescent rolls.
Brush with melted butter. Combine remaining 1/2 cup sugar and the cinnamon.
Roll each bread slice in the mixture.
Freeze on cookie sheets. Transfer into freezer bags.
When ready to use, bake in a 400° oven for 15 minutes.
recipes.text: Grandma'S Toast. Cut crusts from bread slices. Combine cream cheese, egg yolks and 1/2 cup sugar. Spread on the bread slices. Roll up like kieflies or crescent rolls. Brush with melted butter. Combine remaining 1/2 cup sugar and the cinnamon. Roll each bread slice in the mixture. Freeze on cookie sheets. Transfer into freezer bags. When ready to use, bake in a 400° oven for 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Mom'S Pumpkin Pie
directions: Combine pumpkin, sugar, salt, flour, cinnamon and nutmeg.
Add eggs and milk.
Blend.
Pour into unbaked pie shell.
Bake in very hot oven of 450° for 10 minutes, then bake at 325° for about 45 minutes or until mixture doesn't adhere to knife.
recipes.text: Mom'S Pumpkin Pie. Combine pumpkin, sugar, salt, flour, cinnamon and nutmeg. Add eggs and milk. Blend. Pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake in very hot oven of 450° for 10 minutes, then bake at 325° for about 45 minutes or until mixture doesn't adhere to knife.

recipes.title: Spanakopita(Greek Spinach Pie)
directions: Brown onion in olive oil.
Put browned onion in bowl with spinach (well drained), eggs and cheeses.
Mix well.
Add salt and pepper (if you like), dill and parsley.
Melt butter.
Brush 9 x 13-inch pan with butter.
Layer filo dough one sheet at a time, buttering each one.
Put 10 sheets down.
Spread spinach mixture. Cover with 10 more sheets of filo brushing each one with butter. With razor blade or sharp knife, cut through top 10 sheets to cut into pieces.
Bake in 350° to 375° oven for 40 to 50 minutes.
recipes.text: Spanakopita(Greek Spinach Pie). Brown onion in olive oil. Put browned onion in bowl with spinach (well drained), eggs and cheeses. Mix well. Add salt and pepper (if you like), dill and parsley. Melt butter. Brush 9 x 13-inch pan with butter. Layer filo dough one sheet at a time, buttering each one. Put 10 sheets down. Spread spinach mixture. Cover with 10 more sheets of filo brushing each one with butter. With razor blade or sharp knife, cut through top 10 sheets to cut into pieces. Bake in 350° to 375° oven for 40 to 50 minutes.

recipes.title: Baked Alaska Pie
directions: Mix coconut and melted butter and press into 8 or 9 inch pie pan.
Bake at 300 until golden brown.
Melt marshmallows and chocolate in milk over hot water.
Remove from heat, add vanilla and cool.
Pack slightly softened ice cream into crust and swirl in cooled chocolate sauce.
Freeze until VERY firm.
Make meringue of 3 egg whites and 6 Tbsp. sugar.
Seal to edges of crust. Sprinkle on 2/3 c. coconut (optional).
Place on board or large cookie sheet.
Bake at 500 about 2 minutes.
Serve IMMEDIATELY.
recipes.text: Baked Alaska Pie. Mix coconut and melted butter and press into 8 or 9 inch pie pan. Bake at 300 until golden brown. Melt marshmallows and chocolate in milk over hot water. Remove from heat, add vanilla and cool. Pack slightly softened ice cream into crust and swirl in cooled chocolate sauce. Freeze until VERY firm. Make meringue of 3 egg whites and 6 Tbsp. sugar. Seal to edges of crust. Sprinkle on 2/3 c. coconut (optional). Place on board or large cookie sheet. Bake at 500 about 2 minutes. Serve IMMEDIATELY.

recipes.title: Crawfish Fettucine
directions: Saute vegetables in oleo.
Add flour, parsley, garlic and crawfish.
Cook over medium heat for 10 minutes.
Add half and half and diced cheese.
Cook over low heat (20 to 30 minutes).
Boil noodles; drain.
Mix noodles and crawfish mixture together.
Pour into large greased baking dish.
Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.
recipes.text: Crawfish Fettucine. Saute vegetables in oleo. Add flour, parsley, garlic and crawfish. Cook over medium heat for 10 minutes. Add half and half and diced cheese. Cook over low heat (20 to 30 minutes). Boil noodles; drain. Mix noodles and crawfish mixture together. Pour into large greased baking dish. Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Lemon Chicken
ingredients: 4 whole chicken breasts, halved, boned and skinned
1 (8 oz.) pkg. fettuccine, cooked according to package
directions: Pound chicken breasts to 1/4-inch thickness between 2 pieces of waxed paper.
Mix salt, pepper, paprika and flour in a plastic bag; add chicken, one piece at a time, and shake to coat.
Place butter and oil in a saute pan or large skillet; heat over medium heat until bubbly.
Add garlic and chicken; saute, turning, about 6 minutes or until chicken is brown and fork can be easily inserted.
Drain on paper towels and keep warm.
Drain all but 2 tablespoons of cooking fat from pan; add wine and deglaze pan, scraping up brown bits.
Add lemon juice and heat 1 minute; return chicken to pan; add lemon slices and heat 2 minutes.
Add capers and pimento.
Sprinkle chives over all.
recipes.text: Lemon Chicken. Pound chicken breasts to 1/4-inch thickness between 2 pieces of waxed paper. Mix salt, pepper, paprika and flour in a plastic bag; add chicken, one piece at a time, and shake to coat. Place butter and oil in a saute pan or large skillet; heat over medium heat until bubbly. Add garlic and chicken; saute, turning, about 6 minutes or until chicken is brown and fork can be easily inserted. Drain on paper towels and keep warm. Drain all but 2 tablespoons of cooking fat from pan; add wine and deglaze pan, scraping up brown bits. Add lemon juice and heat 1 minute; return chicken to pan; add lemon slices and heat 2 minutes. Add capers and pimento. Sprinkle chives over all.

recipes.title: Spicy Oatmeal Raisin Cookies
ingredients: 1 c. quick cooking oats (not instant or old fashioned)
1/2 c. nuts may be added if desired
directions: Preheat oven to 350°.
Grease baking sheets.
recipes.text: Spicy Oatmeal Raisin Cookies. Preheat oven to 350°. Grease baking sheets.

recipes.title: Hot Beef Dip
directions: Saute onion in margarine.
Add milk and cream cheese; stir over low heat until cream cheese is melted.
Add remaining ingredients; heat thoroughly, stirring occasionally.
Serve hot with French bread slices, whole wheat or rye bread cubes.
recipes.text: Hot Beef Dip. Saute onion in margarine. Add milk and cream cheese; stir over low heat until cream cheese is melted. Add remaining ingredients; heat thoroughly, stirring occasionally. Serve hot with French bread slices, whole wheat or rye bread cubes.

recipes.title: Cornbread Dressing
ingredients: 4 c. soft biscuits or bread crumbs
1/4 c. chicken or turkey broth or water
directions: In a large bowl, combine biscuit and cornbread crumbs, onion, celery and butter; mix well.
Season with salt and pepper.
Add sage (rub spice gently between fingers to enhance flavor).
Add chicken or turkey broth and eggs; mix lightly.
Use mixture for stuffing poultry or a crown roast, or bake in a lightly greased baking pan, covered, at 350° for about 30 minutes.
Yields 8 servings.
recipes.text: Cornbread Dressing. In a large bowl, combine biscuit and cornbread crumbs, onion, celery and butter; mix well. Season with salt and pepper. Add sage (rub spice gently between fingers to enhance flavor). Add chicken or turkey broth and eggs; mix lightly. Use mixture for stuffing poultry or a crown roast, or bake in a lightly greased baking pan, covered, at 350° for about 30 minutes. Yields 8 servings.

recipes.title: Buttermilk Pound Cake
directions: Cream the Crisco and sugar. Add eggs, one at a time. Add soda to hot water, then add to buttermilk. Combine flour and salt. Add to creamed mixture, alternately with buttermilk, beginning and ending with flour mixture.
Mix well after each addition. Stir in vanilla, lemon and almond flavorings.
Pour batter into greased and floured 10-inch tube pan. Bake at 325° for 1 hour and 10 minutes. Cool cake in pan 10 to 15 minutes.
Remove from pan. Cool completely.
recipes.text: Buttermilk Pound Cake. Cream the Crisco and sugar. Add eggs, one at a time. Add soda to hot water, then add to buttermilk. Combine flour and salt. Add to creamed mixture, alternately with buttermilk, beginning and ending with flour mixture. Mix well after each addition. Stir in vanilla, lemon and almond flavorings. Pour batter into greased and floured 10-inch tube pan. Bake at 325° for 1 hour and 10 minutes. Cool cake in pan 10 to 15 minutes. Remove from pan. Cool completely.

recipes.title: Onion Baked Fillets
ingredients: 1 pkg. original Ranch salad dressing mix (4/10 oz.)
2 (3 oz. each) cans French fried onions, crushed
directions: Cut fish fillets into serving size portions.
Sprinkle salt. Combine sour cream, mayonnaise and Ranch salad dressing mix.
Dip fish into mixture, then roll in crushed onions.
recipes.text: Onion Baked Fillets. Cut fish fillets into serving size portions. Sprinkle salt. Combine sour cream, mayonnaise and Ranch salad dressing mix. Dip fish into mixture, then roll in crushed onions.

recipes.title: Cool Sprite(Serves 1)
directions: Mix all ingredients in blender on low speed until smooth.
recipes.text: Cool Sprite(Serves 1). Mix all ingredients in blender on low speed until smooth.

recipes.title: Oven Fried Chicken
directions: Coat chicken breasts in the melted butter.
Roll in bread crumbs mixed with Parmesan cheese.
Bake in a shallow pan for 1 hour in oven at 350°.
recipes.text: Oven Fried Chicken. Coat chicken breasts in the melted butter. Roll in bread crumbs mixed with Parmesan cheese. Bake in a shallow pan for 1 hour in oven at 350°.

recipes.title: Easy Breakfast Quiche
directions: Spray 8 x 8-inch pan with Pam.
Layer green chiles, tomato, shredded cheese and fried bacon in pan.
Beat eggs, milk, Bisquick and salt together and pour over layered mixture.
Bake 40 to 45 minutes at 375° until golden brown.
recipes.text: Easy Breakfast Quiche. Spray 8 x 8-inch pan with Pam. Layer green chiles, tomato, shredded cheese and fried bacon in pan. Beat eggs, milk, Bisquick and salt together and pour over layered mixture. Bake 40 to 45 minutes at 375° until golden brown.

recipes.title: Sugarless Cinnamon Cookies
ingredients: liquid sugar substitute to equal 1/3 c. sugar
directions: Combine margarine and vanilla.
Cream together until light and fluffy.
Sift flour and baking powder together.
Add flour mixture, 1/4 cup at a time, into margarine.
Combine sugar substitute and orange juice; stir into flour mixture.
Mix well. Sprinkle cinnamon over dough; knead to make a streaked appearance. Shape dough into balls about 1/2 inch in diameter; arrange on a nonstick cookie sheet.
Flatten the balls with a fork dipped in cold water.
Bake at 350° for 12 to 15 minutes.
recipes.text: Sugarless Cinnamon Cookies. Combine margarine and vanilla. Cream together until light and fluffy. Sift flour and baking powder together. Add flour mixture, 1/4 cup at a time, into margarine. Combine sugar substitute and orange juice; stir into flour mixture. Mix well. Sprinkle cinnamon over dough; knead to make a streaked appearance. Shape dough into balls about 1/2 inch in diameter; arrange on a nonstick cookie sheet. Flatten the balls with a fork dipped in cold water. Bake at 350° for 12 to 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Pear Preserves
directions: Peel, slice and wash pears. As you slice them, put them in a pot of slightly salted water. This keeps them from turning dark until you finish slicing. When all of the pears are sliced, take them out of the water and rinse them. Measure 2 parts fruit and 1 part sugar into a large pot. Cook slow until sugar melts. Turn up heat so they will boil hard for 1 1/2 hours. Stir occasionally. Pears turn red when they are ready.
recipes.text: Pear Preserves. Peel, slice and wash pears. As you slice them, put them in a pot of slightly salted water. This keeps them from turning dark until you finish slicing. When all of the pears are sliced, take them out of the water and rinse them. Measure 2 parts fruit and 1 part sugar into a large pot. Cook slow until sugar melts. Turn up heat so they will boil hard for 1 1/2 hours. Stir occasionally. Pears turn red when they are ready.

recipes.title: Standard Two-Egg Cake
directions: Cream margarine and sugar until fluffy.
Add eggs and dry ingredients alternately with milk, a small amount at a time.
Beat and add vanilla.
Pour into 2 x 9-inch layers pans.
Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.
Makes about 18 to 20 cupcakes.
recipes.text: Standard Two-Egg Cake. Cream margarine and sugar until fluffy. Add eggs and dry ingredients alternately with milk, a small amount at a time. Beat and add vanilla. Pour into 2 x 9-inch layers pans. Bake at 350° for 25 minutes. Makes about 18 to 20 cupcakes.

recipes.title: Punch Bowl Cake
directions: Bake cake as directed in two 8-inch round cake pans.
Place one layer in the bottom of a punch bowl.
Add pineapple.
Layer with bananas (sliced), 1 1/2 cans vanilla pudding and 1 layer Cool Whip.
Add the other layer of cake.
Layer with strawberries, 1 1/2 cans vanilla pudding and Cool Whip.
Cover with maraschino cherries and nuts.
recipes.text: Punch Bowl Cake. Bake cake as directed in two 8-inch round cake pans. Place one layer in the bottom of a punch bowl. Add pineapple. Layer with bananas (sliced), 1 1/2 cans vanilla pudding and 1 layer Cool Whip. Add the other layer of cake. Layer with strawberries, 1 1/2 cans vanilla pudding and Cool Whip. Cover with maraschino cherries and nuts.

recipes.title: Hash Browns Casserole
ingredients: 16 to 18 oz. southern style hash browns (Idahoan)
directions: Pour into long, greased cake pan.
Top with crackers mixed with margarine.
Bake at 350° until bubbly and beginning to brown. With a toothpick, test a bit of potato.
If not quite done or if casserole is still too soupy, return to oven until golden brown. It will thicken as it cools.
recipes.text: Hash Browns Casserole. Pour into long, greased cake pan. Top with crackers mixed with margarine. Bake at 350° until bubbly and beginning to brown. With a toothpick, test a bit of potato. If not quite done or if casserole is still too soupy, return to oven until golden brown. It will thicken as it cools.

recipes.title: German Caramel Cake
directions: Mix the cake according to directions on box of cake mix. Grease and flour a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Pour half of mixture in pan. Bake at 350° for 15 minutes.
recipes.text: German Caramel Cake. Mix the cake according to directions on box of cake mix. Grease and flour a 9 x 13-inch pan. Pour half of mixture in pan. Bake at 350° for 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Seafood Salad
directions: Mix together and chill overnight.
Serve in pita bread.
recipes.text: Seafood Salad. Mix together and chill overnight. Serve in pita bread.

recipes.title: Oatmeal Cookies
directions: Cream together Crisco or margarine, white sugar and brown sugar.
Add well beaten eggs and vanilla.
Add remaining ingredients.
Make into 2 to 3 long rolls.
Chill.
Slice and bake at 350° for 10 to 12 minutes on ungreased cookie sheets.
recipes.text: Oatmeal Cookies. Cream together Crisco or margarine, white sugar and brown sugar. Add well beaten eggs and vanilla. Add remaining ingredients. Make into 2 to 3 long rolls. Chill. Slice and bake at 350° for 10 to 12 minutes on ungreased cookie sheets.

recipes.title: Hot Or Cold Chicken 'N Pasta
ingredients: 12 oz. diced, cooked chicken or turkey
6 oz. corkscrew pasta, cooked, drained and cooled
1 (16 oz.) pkg. frozen mixed vegetables (low calorie ones), cooked, drained and cooled
directions: In
large
bowl, mix mayonnaise, buttermilk, cheese and basil. Mix
in chicken, pasta and vegetables.
Chill at least one hour before serving.
recipes.text: Hot Or Cold Chicken 'N Pasta. In large bowl, mix mayonnaise, buttermilk, cheese and basil. Mix in chicken, pasta and vegetables. Chill at least one hour before serving.

recipes.title: Roast Leg Of Lamb
directions: Place lamb in large roaster.
Rub lamb with minced garlic. Generously season entire roast with salt, pepper, garlic powder and onion powder.
Place bouillon cubes in hot water, stir to dissolve.
Pour into bottom of roaster.
Cover and place in preheated 325° oven for 6 to 6 1/2 hours, until outside is nicely browned.
Can make a gravy by removing roast from pan, setting aside. Bring drippings to a boil on top of stove.
Mix about 2 tablespoons cornstarch with enough water to make a thin mixture. Stir into boiling drippings, turn to medium-low heat, mixing until thickened slightly.
recipes.text: Roast Leg Of Lamb. Place lamb in large roaster. Rub lamb with minced garlic. Generously season entire roast with salt, pepper, garlic powder and onion powder. Place bouillon cubes in hot water, stir to dissolve. Pour into bottom of roaster. Cover and place in preheated 325° oven for 6 to 6 1/2 hours, until outside is nicely browned. Can make a gravy by removing roast from pan, setting aside. Bring drippings to a boil on top of stove. Mix about 2 tablespoons cornstarch with enough water to make a thin mixture. Stir into boiling drippings, turn to medium-low heat, mixing until thickened slightly.

recipes.title: 100 Cookies
directions: Preheat oven to 350°.
With an electric mixer, mix margarine, brown sugar, white sugar, salad oil, egg and vanilla.
In a separate bowl, sift together the salt, baking soda, cream of tartar and flour.
Once the margarine-sugar mixture is mixed and creamy, add the sifted dry ingredients using a large spoon to mix together.
With a teaspoon, drop dough onto cookie sheet and bake for 12 minutes.
recipes.text: 100 Cookies. Preheat oven to 350°. With an electric mixer, mix margarine, brown sugar, white sugar, salad oil, egg and vanilla. In a separate bowl, sift together the salt, baking soda, cream of tartar and flour. Once the margarine-sugar mixture is mixed and creamy, add the sifted dry ingredients using a large spoon to mix together. With a teaspoon, drop dough onto cookie sheet and bake for 12 minutes.

recipes.title: Basic Speedy Rolls(No Kneading)
directions: Combine first three ingredients.
Add one tablespoon salt and 2 cups sifted flour.
Beat for 2 minutes with electric mixer or rotary beater.
Add 2 eggs and 1/2 cup softened shortening.
Beat for 1 minute.
Blend in 4 1/2 cups sifted flour and stir until dough is formed.
Let rest for 20 minutes.
This makes dough easier to handle.
Shape into rolls, coffee cake or cinnamon rolls.
Bake 15 to 20 minutes in a 375° oven.
recipes.text: Basic Speedy Rolls(No Kneading). Combine first three ingredients. Add one tablespoon salt and 2 cups sifted flour. Beat for 2 minutes with electric mixer or rotary beater. Add 2 eggs and 1/2 cup softened shortening. Beat for 1 minute. Blend in 4 1/2 cups sifted flour and stir until dough is formed. Let rest for 20 minutes. This makes dough easier to handle. Shape into rolls, coffee cake or cinnamon rolls. Bake 15 to 20 minutes in a 375° oven.

recipes.title: Vegetable Pizza
ingredients: 1 pkg. Hidden Valley Ranch dip mix
1 c. each chopped broccoli and carrots
directions: Unroll rolls; press together on baking sheet and bake.
Let cool.
Mix cream cheese, mayo and dip mix together.
Spread on cooled crust (may not need entire mix).
Sprinkle broccoli, carrots, cauliflower and cheeses over mix.
Cover and refrigerate until ready to serve.
recipes.text: Vegetable Pizza. Unroll rolls; press together on baking sheet and bake. Let cool. Mix cream cheese, mayo and dip mix together. Spread on cooled crust (may not need entire mix). Sprinkle broccoli, carrots, cauliflower and cheeses over mix. Cover and refrigerate until ready to serve.

recipes.title: Macaroni And Cheese
directions: Preheat oven to 375°.
Cook macaroni as directed on box. Spray a 3-quart casserole dish with a nonstick spray.
After the macaroni is cooked, drain off water and add salt, pepper and butter or margarine.
Mix milk, egg and cheese together, then add the macaroni.
Place into casserole dish.
Pour on the milk mixture and bake until bubbly and golden brown, approximately 30 to 45 minutes.
Enjoy.
recipes.text: Macaroni And Cheese. Preheat oven to 375°. Cook macaroni as directed on box. Spray a 3-quart casserole dish with a nonstick spray. After the macaroni is cooked, drain off water and add salt, pepper and butter or margarine. Mix milk, egg and cheese together, then add the macaroni. Place into casserole dish. Pour on the milk mixture and bake until bubbly and golden brown, approximately 30 to 45 minutes. Enjoy.

recipes.title: Hot Chipped Beef Dip
ingredients: 2 pkg. (3 oz. size) dried beef, finely chopped
directions: Mix all ingredients in bowl.
recipes.text: Hot Chipped Beef Dip. Mix all ingredients in bowl.

recipes.title: Hamburger Dip
directions: Brown meat, drain and add Ro-Tel tomatoes, sour cream, garlic salt and melted cheese.
recipes.text: Hamburger Dip. Brown meat, drain and add Ro-Tel tomatoes, sour cream, garlic salt and melted cheese.

recipes.title: Angel Rolls
directions: Sift flour, sugar and salt.
Cut in Crisco.
recipes.text: Angel Rolls. Sift flour, sugar and salt. Cut in Crisco.

recipes.title: Broccoli Au Gratin
ingredients: 1 pkg. chopped broccoli, cooked and drained
directions: Combine ingredients in 1 1/2-quart casserole.
Top with 1/4 cup cracker crumbs and 2 tablespoons butter.
Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.
recipes.text: Broccoli Au Gratin. Combine ingredients in 1 1/2-quart casserole. Top with 1/4 cup cracker crumbs and 2 tablespoons butter. Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Best Corn Bread
directions: Combine all ingredients.
Stir with spoon until mixed well. Pour into preheated iron skillet.
Bake at 375° for about 20 minutes.
recipes.text: Best Corn Bread. Combine all ingredients. Stir with spoon until mixed well. Pour into preheated iron skillet. Bake at 375° for about 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Can'T Fail Divinity
directions: Boil sugar, water and salt until hard ball forms in water. Place cream in mixing bowl; stir in hot syrup.
Fold in nuts and vanilla.
Drop by spoonfuls onto wax paper.
recipes.text: Can'T Fail Divinity. Boil sugar, water and salt until hard ball forms in water. Place cream in mixing bowl; stir in hot syrup. Fold in nuts and vanilla. Drop by spoonfuls onto wax paper.

recipes.title: Coffee Cake
directions: Mix flour, sugar, margarine and baking powder into crumbs with hands.
Save some of this mixture (about 1/2 cup) to sprinkle on the top.
Break eggs into balance of crumbs and add milk.
Flavor with vanilla and beat very hard.
Pour into shallow 9 x 13-inch pan.
Put crumbs on top.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
Cinnamon and nuts may be sprinkled on the top if desired.
recipes.text: Coffee Cake. Mix flour, sugar, margarine and baking powder into crumbs with hands. Save some of this mixture (about 1/2 cup) to sprinkle on the top. Break eggs into balance of crumbs and add milk. Flavor with vanilla and beat very hard. Pour into shallow 9 x 13-inch pan. Put crumbs on top. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes. Cinnamon and nuts may be sprinkled on the top if desired.

recipes.title: Indonesian Grilled Lamb Chops
ingredients: 1 lb. lamb loin chops, trimmed and sliced
directions: Marinate for 24 hours.
Grill over charcoal.
Serve on a saute of mixed kula greens.
recipes.text: Indonesian Grilled Lamb Chops. Marinate for 24 hours. Grill over charcoal. Serve on a saute of mixed kula greens.

recipes.title: Baked Bean Casserole
ingredients: 1 can or jar butter or lima beans, drained
1 lb. ground beef, crumbled and cooked, drain off fat
directions: Mix together and bake for 1 hour at 350°.
recipes.text: Baked Bean Casserole. Mix together and bake for 1 hour at 350°.

recipes.title: Hot Buttered Rum
directions: Put rum, honey and peel in a mug.
Add boiling water.
Stir. Top with butter.
Yields 1 drink.
recipes.text: Hot Buttered Rum. Put rum, honey and peel in a mug. Add boiling water. Stir. Top with butter. Yields 1 drink.

recipes.title: Greg'S Famous Fruit Breakfast Casserole
directions: Layer bottom of 10-inch skillet with fresh fruit.
Add butter and brown sugar; sprinkle pecans over fruit.
Warm it up.
In a bowl, mix 7 eggs, sugar, vanilla and Bisquick.
Pour mix on top of fruit; cover and cook on low for 20 minutes.
Flip onto a plate; sprinkle with powdered sugar and serve with syrup.
recipes.text: Greg'S Famous Fruit Breakfast Casserole. Layer bottom of 10-inch skillet with fresh fruit. Add butter and brown sugar; sprinkle pecans over fruit. Warm it up. In a bowl, mix 7 eggs, sugar, vanilla and Bisquick. Pour mix on top of fruit; cover and cook on low for 20 minutes. Flip onto a plate; sprinkle with powdered sugar and serve with syrup.

recipes.title: Chicken Spaghetti
directions: Cook chicken and debone.
Melt butter and brown onions and garlic.
Add tomatoes and simmer for 10 minutes.
Add diced chicken, soup, cheese and olives.
Add cooked spaghetti and small can peas.
Cook until cheese has melted completely.
recipes.text: Chicken Spaghetti. Cook chicken and debone. Melt butter and brown onions and garlic. Add tomatoes and simmer for 10 minutes. Add diced chicken, soup, cheese and olives. Add cooked spaghetti and small can peas. Cook until cheese has melted completely.

recipes.title: Hash Brown Casserole
directions: Allow hash browns to thaw.
Mix all ingredients together and place in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Hash Brown Casserole. Allow hash browns to thaw. Mix all ingredients together and place in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Chicken-Dorito Casserole
directions: Layer Doritos in long baking pan.
Place chopped chicken on Doritos, then cheese, onion and another layer of Doritos.
Mix liquids together and pour over top.
Bake at 350° about 25 minutes.
recipes.text: Chicken-Dorito Casserole. Layer Doritos in long baking pan. Place chopped chicken on Doritos, then cheese, onion and another layer of Doritos. Mix liquids together and pour over top. Bake at 350° about 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Orange Sour Cream Cake
directions: Heat oven to 325°.
Grease and flour Bundt pan.
Mix flour, baking powder, baking soda and salt.
Beat egg whites until stiff. Beat margarine and sugar in another bowl until fluffy.
Beat in egg yolks one at a time.
Stir in orange peel and walnuts.
Add 1/3 of the dry ingredients and 1/2 of the sour cream and beat. Add 1/2 the dry ingredients and remaining sour cream and beat well.
Add remaining dry ingredients.
Fold in egg whites.
Bake one hour.
recipes.text: Orange Sour Cream Cake. Heat oven to 325°. Grease and flour Bundt pan. Mix flour, baking powder, baking soda and salt. Beat egg whites until stiff. Beat margarine and sugar in another bowl until fluffy. Beat in egg yolks one at a time. Stir in orange peel and walnuts. Add 1/3 of the dry ingredients and 1/2 of the sour cream and beat. Add 1/2 the dry ingredients and remaining sour cream and beat well. Add remaining dry ingredients. Fold in egg whites. Bake one hour.

recipes.title: Deviled Eggs
directions: Put eggs in pot and cover with water; heat just until the water boils. Remove pot from heat and cover. Let stand 15 to 18 minutes; remove shells from eggs. Cut eggs in half and remove yolks. Put the yolks in a small bowl and mash with fork. Add rest of ingredients and mix. Fill the egg whites with mixture, heaping it up slightly. Hint: Set pot in sink and run cold water over them to cool eggs down quickly. This makes them easier to peel.
recipes.text: Deviled Eggs. Put eggs in pot and cover with water; heat just until the water boils. Remove pot from heat and cover. Let stand 15 to 18 minutes; remove shells from eggs. Cut eggs in half and remove yolks. Put the yolks in a small bowl and mash with fork. Add rest of ingredients and mix. Fill the egg whites with mixture, heaping it up slightly. Hint: Set pot in sink and run cold water over them to cool eggs down quickly. This makes them easier to peel.

recipes.title: Spanish Fried Rice
directions: Soak rice in hot water for 1/2 hour; drain well.
Spread in big shallow pan to dry a little, about 1 hour.
Cook bacon until crisp; crumble and set aside.
Add rice to drippings and cook until rice is lightly browned.
Add crumbled bacon, beef broth, tomato sauce, green pepper, onion, garlic and cumin seed.
Cover; cook over low heat, stirring now and then, until rice is done and liquid absorbed, about 30 minutes (add extra water if needed).
recipes.text: Spanish Fried Rice. Soak rice in hot water for 1/2 hour; drain well. Spread in big shallow pan to dry a little, about 1 hour. Cook bacon until crisp; crumble and set aside. Add rice to drippings and cook until rice is lightly browned. Add crumbled bacon, beef broth, tomato sauce, green pepper, onion, garlic and cumin seed. Cover; cook over low heat, stirring now and then, until rice is done and liquid absorbed, about 30 minutes (add extra water if needed).

recipes.title: 7-Cup Salad
directions: Combine fruit, coconut and marshmallows with sour cream.
Toss lightly and chill.
recipes.text: 7-Cup Salad. Combine fruit, coconut and marshmallows with sour cream. Toss lightly and chill.

recipes.title: Lemon Strawberry Punch
directions: Follow directions on the juice cans and mix with the 7-Up. Blend the strawberries and mix in with the juices.
Then add the ice cream; stir and let a little float.
recipes.text: Lemon Strawberry Punch. Follow directions on the juice cans and mix with the 7-Up. Blend the strawberries and mix in with the juices. Then add the ice cream; stir and let a little float.

recipes.title: Two-Cheese Macaroni
directions: Preheat the oven to 350°. Lightly spray 12-quart baking dish with nonstick cooking spray. Place 2 quarts of water in a large saucepan. Bring to a boil. Add macaroni. Boil until tender, about 10 minutes. Drain well. Shred Cheddar.
recipes.text: Two-Cheese Macaroni. Preheat the oven to 350°. Lightly spray 12-quart baking dish with nonstick cooking spray. Place 2 quarts of water in a large saucepan. Bring to a boil. Add macaroni. Boil until tender, about 10 minutes. Drain well. Shred Cheddar.

recipes.title: Fisher'S Ham Bits
directions: Slice ham thin, then into strips.
Brown lightly to complete cooking.
Drain.
Add pepper jelly; simmer.
Serve hot.
recipes.text: Fisher'S Ham Bits. Slice ham thin, then into strips. Brown lightly to complete cooking. Drain. Add pepper jelly; simmer. Serve hot.

recipes.title: Cinnamon Coffee Cake
directions: In a large mixing bowl, cream butter and 2 c. sugar until fluffy.
Stir in vanilla.
Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each additional.
Combine flour baking powder, baking soda, and salt.
Add to the creamed mixture alternating with sour cream, beating just enough after each addition to keep batter smooth. Spoon one third of batter into greased 10 inch tube pan.
Combine cinnamon, nuts and remaining sugar, sprinkle 1/3 over batter in pan.
Repeat layers two more times.
Bake at 350° for 70 minutes until done.
Cool for 10 minutes.
Remove from pan to a wire rack to cool.
16-20 servings
recipes.text: Cinnamon Coffee Cake. In a large mixing bowl, cream butter and 2 c. sugar until fluffy. Stir in vanilla. Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each additional. Combine flour baking powder, baking soda, and salt. Add to the creamed mixture alternating with sour cream, beating just enough after each addition to keep batter smooth. Spoon one third of batter into greased 10 inch tube pan. Combine cinnamon, nuts and remaining sugar, sprinkle 1/3 over batter in pan. Repeat layers two more times. Bake at 350° for 70 minutes until done. Cool for 10 minutes. Remove from pan to a wire rack to cool. 16-20 servings

recipes.title: Cookie Jar Favorites
ingredients: 2 1/4 c. Fruit & Fibre or Fruitful Bran cereal
directions: Mix flour and baking soda (set aside).
Cream butter and sugars.
Beat in eggs and add vanilla.
Blend in flour mixture; add cereal.
Drop by spoonfuls onto cookie sheet.
Bake at 350° for 12 to 14 minutes.
Yield:
4 dozen.
recipes.text: Cookie Jar Favorites. Mix flour and baking soda (set aside). Cream butter and sugars. Beat in eggs and add vanilla. Blend in flour mixture; add cereal. Drop by spoonfuls onto cookie sheet. Bake at 350° for 12 to 14 minutes. Yield: 4 dozen.

recipes.title: Almond Cream Puffs(Serves 6)
directions: In a mixing bowl, whisk together the egg yolks, sugar and cornstarch until light and creamy.
Scald the milk in the top of a double boiler and pour into the egg yolk mixture, whisking constantly to keep the yolks from cooking.
Continue to whisk until the mixture is foamy, then pour into the top of the double boiler.
Cook slowly over simmering water, beating all the while, for about 10 minutes, until it has thickened to the consistency of custard.
Set the double boiler top in a bowl of ice and whisk the custard continuously until it has cooled completely.
Stir in the almond extract, ground almonds and Amaretto.
Whip the cream in a mixing bowl until it forms soft peaks.
Gently fold the custard into the whipped cream until it is thoroughly combined.
Using a pastry bag with a small plain tip, puncture the bottoms of the cream puffs and fill with the custard mixture.
Decorate with sliced strawberries or drizzle with chocolate sauce.
recipes.text: Almond Cream Puffs(Serves 6). In a mixing bowl, whisk together the egg yolks, sugar and cornstarch until light and creamy. Scald the milk in the top of a double boiler and pour into the egg yolk mixture, whisking constantly to keep the yolks from cooking. Continue to whisk until the mixture is foamy, then pour into the top of the double boiler. Cook slowly over simmering water, beating all the while, for about 10 minutes, until it has thickened to the consistency of custard. Set the double boiler top in a bowl of ice and whisk the custard continuously until it has cooled completely. Stir in the almond extract, ground almonds and Amaretto. Whip the cream in a mixing bowl until it forms soft peaks. Gently fold the custard into the whipped cream until it is thoroughly combined. Using a pastry bag with a small plain tip, puncture the bottoms of the cream puffs and fill with the custard mixture. Decorate with sliced strawberries or drizzle with chocolate sauce.

recipes.title: Beef Stroganoff
directions: Tenderize meat.
Cut into thin strips; trim fat.
Brown lightly in butter.
Remove meat from pan.
Add onions and mushrooms; cook until tender.
Add meat, tomato juice, salt and pepper.
Cover and simmer 50 minutes, until fork-tender.
recipes.text: Beef Stroganoff. Tenderize meat. Cut into thin strips; trim fat. Brown lightly in butter. Remove meat from pan. Add onions and mushrooms; cook until tender. Add meat, tomato juice, salt and pepper. Cover and simmer 50 minutes, until fork-tender.

recipes.title: Glazed Ham
ingredients: 3 lb. canned ham, cut into 1/2-inch thick slices, if desired
directions: Put jelly, onion, lemon and mustard in blender, cover and run on blend until smooth.
Place ham or slices in baking dish or pan and cover with sauce from blender.
Bake in 325° oven until ham is tender.
recipes.text: Glazed Ham. Put jelly, onion, lemon and mustard in blender, cover and run on blend until smooth. Place ham or slices in baking dish or pan and cover with sauce from blender. Bake in 325° oven until ham is tender.

recipes.title: Marinated Vegetable Medley
directions: Combine sugar, vinegar, oil and salt and pepper in a saucepan. Stir and heat until mixture comes to a boil.
Remove from heat and set aside.
Mix all vegetables together.
recipes.text: Marinated Vegetable Medley. Combine sugar, vinegar, oil and salt and pepper in a saucepan. Stir and heat until mixture comes to a boil. Remove from heat and set aside. Mix all vegetables together.

recipes.title: Deb'S Chicken Dressing Casserole
directions: Mix the stuffing mix, water or broth and butter together.
Add the celery, onion, mayonnaise and salt.
In a large casserole dish, layer dressing, chicken, then dressing.
Beat the eggs and milk together; pour over the dressing.
Let set overnight.
Pour the mushroom soup over the top.
Bake at 325° for 35 minutes.
Put grated cheese on the top.
Bake for 5 minutes longer.
recipes.text: Deb'S Chicken Dressing Casserole. Mix the stuffing mix, water or broth and butter together. Add the celery, onion, mayonnaise and salt. In a large casserole dish, layer dressing, chicken, then dressing. Beat the eggs and milk together; pour over the dressing. Let set overnight. Pour the mushroom soup over the top. Bake at 325° for 35 minutes. Put grated cheese on the top. Bake for 5 minutes longer.

recipes.title: Oven Baked Macaroni And Cheese
directions: You also need 1 medium size oblong glass baking dish or pan.
recipes.text: Oven Baked Macaroni And Cheese. You also need 1 medium size oblong glass baking dish or pan.

recipes.title: Chocolate Oatmeal-No Bake Cookies
directions: Mix together in saucepan milk, sugar, cocoa and butter; bring to boil for 1 minute.
Remove from heat and add peanut butter, vanilla and oatmeal.
Stir until well mixed.
Drop by spoonfuls on waxed paper.
recipes.text: Chocolate Oatmeal-No Bake Cookies. Mix together in saucepan milk, sugar, cocoa and butter; bring to boil for 1 minute. Remove from heat and add peanut butter, vanilla and oatmeal. Stir until well mixed. Drop by spoonfuls on waxed paper.

recipes.title: Punch
directions: This has done for a lot of weddings, showers and parties.
recipes.text: Punch. This has done for a lot of weddings, showers and parties.

recipes.title: Pecan Pie
ingredients: 1 c. dark firmly packed brown sugar
directions: Combine first six ingredients. Pour into pie shell. Sprinkle with pecan halves. Bake at 350° for 45 - 50 minutes or until set.
recipes.text: Pecan Pie. Combine first six ingredients. Pour into pie shell. Sprinkle with pecan halves. Bake at 350° for 45 - 50 minutes or until set.

recipes.title: Sour Cream Muffins
directions: Mix dry ingredients.
Beat egg until foamy; add sour cream and mix well.
Stir together dry ingredients and egg mixture until just mixed.
Bake in greased muffin tin at 450° for 20 minutes. Yields 12 muffins.
recipes.text: Sour Cream Muffins. Mix dry ingredients. Beat egg until foamy; add sour cream and mix well. Stir together dry ingredients and egg mixture until just mixed. Bake in greased muffin tin at 450° for 20 minutes. Yields 12 muffins.

recipes.title: Chocolate Chip Cream Cheese Cookies
directions: Cream first 3 ingredients together.
Add vanilla and lemon flavoring to cheese and beat in eggs.
Add flour and salt to creamed mixture.
Stir in chocolate chips.
Bake at 350° for 12 minutes.
recipes.text: Chocolate Chip Cream Cheese Cookies. Cream first 3 ingredients together. Add vanilla and lemon flavoring to cheese and beat in eggs. Add flour and salt to creamed mixture. Stir in chocolate chips. Bake at 350° for 12 minutes.

recipes.title: Chilled Vermicelli
directions: Pour dressing into bowl and mix in all ingredients except vermicelli.
Drain and mix with vinaigrette.
Chill for 24 hours. Bring to room temperature before serving.
Serve as a side dish or appetizer.
recipes.text: Chilled Vermicelli. Pour dressing into bowl and mix in all ingredients except vermicelli. Drain and mix with vinaigrette. Chill for 24 hours. Bring to room temperature before serving. Serve as a side dish or appetizer.

recipes.title: Hot Dogs And Rice
ingredients: 1 pkg. hot dogs, cut like pennies
directions: Melt
butter
in
skillet; add hot dogs, stirring until almost cooked.
Add onion and celery; stir until onion becomes clear. Stir
in
rice.
Add tomatoes and mix well.
Cover and simmer about 20 minutes.
recipes.text: Hot Dogs And Rice. Melt butter in skillet; add hot dogs, stirring until almost cooked. Add onion and celery; stir until onion becomes clear. Stir in rice. Add tomatoes and mix well. Cover and simmer about 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Applesauce Muffins
directions: Cream margarine and sugar; add beaten eggs, vanilla and applesauce.
Add spices and soda to sifted flour.
Add flour to other ingredients.
Bake at 400° for 15 to 20 minutes.
recipes.text: Applesauce Muffins. Cream margarine and sugar; add beaten eggs, vanilla and applesauce. Add spices and soda to sifted flour. Add flour to other ingredients. Bake at 400° for 15 to 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Chicken Spaghetti
directions: Fill large pan with water and chicken.
Cook and debone; add to water and spaghetti and cook until done.
Add sour cream and soups and cheese; cook until cheese is melted.
Pour into large casserole dish and bake at 375° until bubbly.
recipes.text: Chicken Spaghetti. Fill large pan with water and chicken. Cook and debone; add to water and spaghetti and cook until done. Add sour cream and soups and cheese; cook until cheese is melted. Pour into large casserole dish and bake at 375° until bubbly.

recipes.title: Berry Delight
directions: Wash and dry blueberries.
Place half the berries in the pie shell.
Melt jelly over low heat and pour it over the blueberries. Cover top of jelly with sour cream.
Top with remaining blueberries.
Chill at least 1 hour before serving.
recipes.text: Berry Delight. Wash and dry blueberries. Place half the berries in the pie shell. Melt jelly over low heat and pour it over the blueberries. Cover top of jelly with sour cream. Top with remaining blueberries. Chill at least 1 hour before serving.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Roll
directions: Sift together first 4 ingredients; set aside.
Beat eggs 5 minutes.
Add sugar to eggs 1 tablespoon at a time.
Add pumpkin and lemon juice to egg mixture.
Fold flour mixture into egg mixture until blended.
Spread in greased and floured jelly roll pan.
Sprinkle with pecans.
Bake at 375° for 15 minutes.
Turn out on cloth sprinkled with powdered sugar.
Roll up and cool.
Unroll cake, spread on filling.
Reroll cake.
Place roll, seam-side down. Refrigerate at least 4 hours.
Dust with powdered sugar.
Yields 8 to 10 servings.
recipes.text: Pumpkin Roll. Sift together first 4 ingredients; set aside. Beat eggs 5 minutes. Add sugar to eggs 1 tablespoon at a time. Add pumpkin and lemon juice to egg mixture. Fold flour mixture into egg mixture until blended. Spread in greased and floured jelly roll pan. Sprinkle with pecans. Bake at 375° for 15 minutes. Turn out on cloth sprinkled with powdered sugar. Roll up and cool. Unroll cake, spread on filling. Reroll cake. Place roll, seam-side down. Refrigerate at least 4 hours. Dust with powdered sugar. Yields 8 to 10 servings.

recipes.title: Roasted Sweet Onions And Carrots With Pecans(Yields 24 Servings)
directions: Combine carrots, oil and 3 ounces margarine; spread on a sheet pan.
Sprinkle with half the salt and pepper.
Bake at 350° until carrots are tender and golden brown, about 40 minutes.
Reserve; keep hot.
recipes.text: Roasted Sweet Onions And Carrots With Pecans(Yields 24 Servings). Combine carrots, oil and 3 ounces margarine; spread on a sheet pan. Sprinkle with half the salt and pepper. Bake at 350° until carrots are tender and golden brown, about 40 minutes. Reserve; keep hot.

recipes.title: Taco Dip(Hot)
ingredients: black olives and/or hot chili peppers (if desired)
at least 2 (8 oz.) pkg. shredded cheese (Cheddar or Monterey Jack)
directions: Mix cream cheese with taco seasoning mix (thin a little bit with small amount of milk).
In a rectangular baking dish (at bottom) spread taco/cream cheese mixture.
On top of this layer spread the Hormel chili without beans and sprinkle with cheese. Garnish with sliced black olives and/or chili peppers (if you like it hot).
Bake until bubbly at 350° for about 15 to 20 minutes. Serve with nacho chips for a great hot dip.
recipes.text: Taco Dip(Hot). Mix cream cheese with taco seasoning mix (thin a little bit with small amount of milk). In a rectangular baking dish (at bottom) spread taco/cream cheese mixture. On top of this layer spread the Hormel chili without beans and sprinkle with cheese. Garnish with sliced black olives and/or chili peppers (if you like it hot). Bake until bubbly at 350° for about 15 to 20 minutes. Serve with nacho chips for a great hot dip.

recipes.title: Macaroni With Meat Sauce
directions: Heat fat in a 10-inch skillet.
Add onion and garlic; cook until onion is soft, not brown.
Add meat; break into small pieces.
Cook and stir until lightly browned.
Add next 7 ingredients.
Bring to boil.
Cover; simmer 45 minutes.
Add mushrooms; heat to boiling.
Arrange macaroni on a platter.
Pour sauce over macaroni.
Sprinkle with cheese.
Makes 6 servings.
recipes.text: Macaroni With Meat Sauce. Heat fat in a 10-inch skillet. Add onion and garlic; cook until onion is soft, not brown. Add meat; break into small pieces. Cook and stir until lightly browned. Add next 7 ingredients. Bring to boil. Cover; simmer 45 minutes. Add mushrooms; heat to boiling. Arrange macaroni on a platter. Pour sauce over macaroni. Sprinkle with cheese. Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Chocolate Divine
directions: Soften the gelatin in the water.
Mix cocoa and milk.
Heat over boiling water.
Add softened gelatin and liquid artificial sweetener.
Stir until dissolve; remove mixture from heat.
Add vanilla.
Combine ice water and dry milk in bowl and beat until mixture is thick.
Beat gelatin until smooth and add to whipped milk.
Turn into pan sprayed with Pam.
Chill until firm.
Yield: 5 servings.
Carbohydrate 6 g, protein 4 g, fat .2 g, calories 40. One serving = 1/2 skim milk exchange.
recipes.text: Chocolate Divine. Soften the gelatin in the water. Mix cocoa and milk. Heat over boiling water. Add softened gelatin and liquid artificial sweetener. Stir until dissolve; remove mixture from heat. Add vanilla. Combine ice water and dry milk in bowl and beat until mixture is thick. Beat gelatin until smooth and add to whipped milk. Turn into pan sprayed with Pam. Chill until firm. Yield: 5 servings. Carbohydrate 6 g, protein 4 g, fat .2 g, calories 40. One serving = 1/2 skim milk exchange.

recipes.title: Beef Noodle Casserole
directions: Brown beef in small amount of butter.
Add tomato sauce, sugar, salt and pepper.
In a separate bowl, combine sour cream, cream cheese and chives.
In a 1 1/2-quart dish, alternate layers of cooked noodles, beef sauce and cream cheese mixture, ending with cream cheese layer.
Top with grated Cheddar cheese.
Bake at 350° for 20 minutes or until bubbly.
recipes.text: Beef Noodle Casserole. Brown beef in small amount of butter. Add tomato sauce, sugar, salt and pepper. In a separate bowl, combine sour cream, cream cheese and chives. In a 1 1/2-quart dish, alternate layers of cooked noodles, beef sauce and cream cheese mixture, ending with cream cheese layer. Top with grated Cheddar cheese. Bake at 350° for 20 minutes or until bubbly.

recipes.title: Rumaki
directions: Cut your steak into bite size pieces (the steak does not have to be an expensive cut).
Take your water chestnuts (sliced) and drain them.
Cut bacon into thirds or halves (enough to wrap around steak).
Wrap bacon around steak and a slice of water chestnut. Secure with a toothpick.
Place in a bowl and pour soy sauce over steak.
Cover and marinate overnight.
(I prefer low sodium soy sauce; it makes the appetizer less salty.)
Cook in broiler pan at 350° for 15 minutes.
Serve alone or with sweet and sour sauce.
recipes.text: Rumaki. Cut your steak into bite size pieces (the steak does not have to be an expensive cut). Take your water chestnuts (sliced) and drain them. Cut bacon into thirds or halves (enough to wrap around steak). Wrap bacon around steak and a slice of water chestnut. Secure with a toothpick. Place in a bowl and pour soy sauce over steak. Cover and marinate overnight. (I prefer low sodium soy sauce; it makes the appetizer less salty.) Cook in broiler pan at 350° for 15 minutes. Serve alone or with sweet and sour sauce.

recipes.title: Crustless Apple Pie
directions: Blend sugar and cinnamon in heavy pan.
Add apples and water. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat and cook slowly 10 minutes or until tender.
recipes.text: Crustless Apple Pie. Blend sugar and cinnamon in heavy pan. Add apples and water. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat and cook slowly 10 minutes or until tender.

recipes.title: Taco Salad
ingredients: 1 lb. ground beef, browned and seasoned
directions: Wash and break up lettuce into small pieces.
Mix all ingredients together and toss into a large bowl.
(Crush Doritos in bag before opening.)
recipes.text: Taco Salad. Wash and break up lettuce into small pieces. Mix all ingredients together and toss into a large bowl. (Crush Doritos in bag before opening.)

recipes.title: Hamburger Skillet Supper
directions: Brown hamburger and drain.
Add tomatoes, barbecue sauce, pepper, onions, rice and water. Bring to a boil.
Cover; reduce heat.
Cook at medium heat, simmer for 25 minutes.
Place cheese on top and set off stove to melt.
recipes.text: Hamburger Skillet Supper. Brown hamburger and drain. Add tomatoes, barbecue sauce, pepper, onions, rice and water. Bring to a boil. Cover; reduce heat. Cook at medium heat, simmer for 25 minutes. Place cheese on top and set off stove to melt.

recipes.title: Tamale Pie
directions: Fry the onions and hamburger; drain.
Add olive oil.
Mix all other ingredients in bowl.
Put the mixture in the pie crust. Bake at 325° for 1 hour or until firm.
recipes.text: Tamale Pie. Fry the onions and hamburger; drain. Add olive oil. Mix all other ingredients in bowl. Put the mixture in the pie crust. Bake at 325° for 1 hour or until firm.

recipes.title: Pickled Shrimp
ingredients: 3 lb. large shrimp, cooked and peeled
2 medium onions, thinly sliced and rings separated
directions: Blend together first 8 ingredients.
Layer shrimp, onions and bay leaves in bowl.
Pour sauce over all and cover.
Marinate in refrigerator at least 24 hours.
Serve in bowl with toothpicks or spear onto decorative picks and push into half head of red cabbage.
Serves about 20 guests.
recipes.text: Pickled Shrimp. Blend together first 8 ingredients. Layer shrimp, onions and bay leaves in bowl. Pour sauce over all and cover. Marinate in refrigerator at least 24 hours. Serve in bowl with toothpicks or spear onto decorative picks and push into half head of red cabbage. Serves about 20 guests.

recipes.title: Hawaiian Pineapple Poke Cake
directions: Bake cake; poke holes with wooden spoon handle.
Pour crushed pineapple over cake.
Mix pudding, milk and cream cheese until smooth; spread on top of pineapple.
Top with Cool Whip and sprinkle with coconut and nuts.
Refrigerate.
recipes.text: Hawaiian Pineapple Poke Cake. Bake cake; poke holes with wooden spoon handle. Pour crushed pineapple over cake. Mix pudding, milk and cream cheese until smooth; spread on top of pineapple. Top with Cool Whip and sprinkle with coconut and nuts. Refrigerate.

recipes.title: Baked Beans
directions: Mix well.
Bake 45 minutes at 350°.
recipes.text: Baked Beans. Mix well. Bake 45 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Baked Pineapple
ingredients: 2 (No. 3) cans pineapple chunks, drained, but reserve liquid
directions: Mix flour and sugar.
Add drained pineapple chunks and mix until covered.
Mix the cracker crumbs and melted margarine. Spread over pineapple mixture.
Sprinkle 3 to 4 tablespoons of pineapple juice over top.
Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.
Grated cheese may be added if desired.
recipes.text: Baked Pineapple. Mix flour and sugar. Add drained pineapple chunks and mix until covered. Mix the cracker crumbs and melted margarine. Spread over pineapple mixture. Sprinkle 3 to 4 tablespoons of pineapple juice over top. Bake at 350° for 25 minutes. Grated cheese may be added if desired.

recipes.title: Mom'S Delight
ingredients: 1 1/2 to 2 lb. beef (least expensive cuts work best)
1 bell pepper, cut in bite size pieces
directions: Cut beef into bite size pieces.
Marinate in Worcestershire sauce for at least 30 minutes.
Place marinated beef into a covered casserole dish.
Add tomato wedges with their juice.
Add onion quarters and bell pepper.
Add Worcestershire sauce.
Marinate. Cover and bake at 350° until aroma fills kitchen (approximately 1 hour).
Bake an additional 30 minutes.
Serve over white rice.
recipes.text: Mom'S Delight. Cut beef into bite size pieces. Marinate in Worcestershire sauce for at least 30 minutes. Place marinated beef into a covered casserole dish. Add tomato wedges with their juice. Add onion quarters and bell pepper. Add Worcestershire sauce. Marinate. Cover and bake at 350° until aroma fills kitchen (approximately 1 hour). Bake an additional 30 minutes. Serve over white rice.

recipes.title: Barbecue Sauce
directions: Bake brisket, covered, at 250° for 8 hours.
Brown together the butter, onion and garlic. Add the remaining ingredients and simmer 15 minutes.
The last 45 minutes of cooking brisket, pour sauce over to cover. Save remaining sauce to pour over as served.
recipes.text: Barbecue Sauce. Bake brisket, covered, at 250° for 8 hours. Brown together the butter, onion and garlic. Add the remaining ingredients and simmer 15 minutes. The last 45 minutes of cooking brisket, pour sauce over to cover. Save remaining sauce to pour over as served.

recipes.title: Oatmeal Patties
ingredients: 4 oz. can mushrooms, drained and chopped
directions: Mix together.
Form patties by dropping heaping tablespoonfuls into hot oil.
Fry until golden brown.
Makes 6 patties.
Make gravy.
Bake 30 minutes in gravy.
recipes.text: Oatmeal Patties. Mix together. Form patties by dropping heaping tablespoonfuls into hot oil. Fry until golden brown. Makes 6 patties. Make gravy. Bake 30 minutes in gravy.

recipes.title: Western Hash
directions: Brown ground beef; add tomatoes, green peppers, onion, rice, basil and pepper. Cover and simmer 25 minutes, stirring occasionally. When rice is cooked, top with cheese slices. Heat until cheese is melted. Serves 6.
recipes.text: Western Hash. Brown ground beef; add tomatoes, green peppers, onion, rice, basil and pepper. Cover and simmer 25 minutes, stirring occasionally. When rice is cooked, top with cheese slices. Heat until cheese is melted. Serves 6.

recipes.title: Meat Loaf
directions: Soak Shredded Wheat in milk and combine with meats in which onion, green pepper, salt, pepper, tomato catsup and egg have been mixed.
Form into loaf and place in greased loaf pan.
Cut bacon strips in half and place on top of meat loaf.
Bake in moderate oven (350°) about 50 minutes.
Serves 6.
recipes.text: Meat Loaf. Soak Shredded Wheat in milk and combine with meats in which onion, green pepper, salt, pepper, tomato catsup and egg have been mixed. Form into loaf and place in greased loaf pan. Cut bacon strips in half and place on top of meat loaf. Bake in moderate oven (350°) about 50 minutes. Serves 6.

recipes.title: Lemon-Strawberry Punch
directions: Combine lemon peel, lemon juice and 2 1/4 cups strawberries in blender; blend.
In punch bowl, combine sherbet and mixture; stir well.
Pour in soda and stir to blend.
Float lemon cartwheels and strawberry halves in punch.
Makes 10 (8 ounce) servings.
recipes.text: Lemon-Strawberry Punch. Combine lemon peel, lemon juice and 2 1/4 cups strawberries in blender; blend. In punch bowl, combine sherbet and mixture; stir well. Pour in soda and stir to blend. Float lemon cartwheels and strawberry halves in punch. Makes 10 (8 ounce) servings.

recipes.title: Stuffed Pork Chops
directions: Slit each chop horizontally so that a small pocket is formed. Dice the bread and mix with the cream, salt, pepper and herbs. Mix thoroughly and use to fill the pocket in each chop.
Secure with wooden toothpicks.
Brush the chops with oil and sprinkle with paprika, then broil or barbecue for 10 to 15 minutes on each side.
Remove the toothpicks and serve the chops on a bed of braised cabbage or sauerkraut.
Serves 4.
recipes.text: Stuffed Pork Chops. Slit each chop horizontally so that a small pocket is formed. Dice the bread and mix with the cream, salt, pepper and herbs. Mix thoroughly and use to fill the pocket in each chop. Secure with wooden toothpicks. Brush the chops with oil and sprinkle with paprika, then broil or barbecue for 10 to 15 minutes on each side. Remove the toothpicks and serve the chops on a bed of braised cabbage or sauerkraut. Serves 4.

recipes.title: Coconut Pie
directions: Melt butter.
Cool slightly.
Mix eggs, sugar and butter together.
Beat
well.
Add
cornmeal.
Add buttermilk, vanilla and coconut.
Bake in a 325° oven for approximately 40 minutes. Cool before slicing.
recipes.text: Coconut Pie. Melt butter. Cool slightly. Mix eggs, sugar and butter together. Beat well. Add cornmeal. Add buttermilk, vanilla and coconut. Bake in a 325° oven for approximately 40 minutes. Cool before slicing.

recipes.title: 24 Salad
ingredients: 1 pkg. shredded Parmesan or Romano cheese
directions: Layer all ingredients in a large casserole that can be covered tightly.
Spread or pat mayonnaise smoothly on top after all layers are laid.
Mix 1
teaspoon sugar, 1/2 teaspoon salt and 1/4 teaspoon pepper.
Sprinkle over mayonnaise.
Top with mixture of mayonnaise and cheese.
Cover tightly and refrigerate at least 12 hours.
Slice to serve.
recipes.text: 24 Salad. Layer all ingredients in a large casserole that can be covered tightly. Spread or pat mayonnaise smoothly on top after all layers are laid. Mix 1 teaspoon sugar, 1/2 teaspoon salt and 1/4 teaspoon pepper. Sprinkle over mayonnaise. Top with mixture of mayonnaise and cheese. Cover tightly and refrigerate at least 12 hours. Slice to serve.

recipes.title: Stuffed Peppers
directions: Cut top off peppers, scoop out seeds.
Cook in boiling water, salted, about 10 minutes.
Drain and place in 1 1/2-quart casserole dish.
Meanwhile, mix hamburger, eggs, onions, garlic, salt and bread crumbs. Mix together.
Place mixture into pepper. Bake in oven at 350° for 1 hour and 15 minutes.
Pour tomato sauce on top of pepper and bake another 15 minutes.
recipes.text: Stuffed Peppers. Cut top off peppers, scoop out seeds. Cook in boiling water, salted, about 10 minutes. Drain and place in 1 1/2-quart casserole dish. Meanwhile, mix hamburger, eggs, onions, garlic, salt and bread crumbs. Mix together. Place mixture into pepper. Bake in oven at 350° for 1 hour and 15 minutes. Pour tomato sauce on top of pepper and bake another 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Beef And Noodle Casserole
directions: Boil noodles.
In a large skillet, brown beef.
Remove beef and drain fat.
In the same skillet, melt butter over medium-high heat.
Saute onion and pepper until tender.
Add beef, Worcestershire sauce, noodles and soups.
Mix well.
Spoon into a greased 3-quart casserole.
Top with cheese.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Beef And Noodle Casserole. Boil noodles. In a large skillet, brown beef. Remove beef and drain fat. In the same skillet, melt butter over medium-high heat. Saute onion and pepper until tender. Add beef, Worcestershire sauce, noodles and soups. Mix well. Spoon into a greased 3-quart casserole. Top with cheese. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: My Mother'S Orange Slice Cookies
directions: Dredge orange slices and nuts in small amount of flour.
Mix remaining ingredients and add orange slices and nuts, mixing well. Grease and slightly flour glass or metal baking dish.
Bake at 350° for 20 to 30 minutes.
Cut into squares and serve.
recipes.text: My Mother'S Orange Slice Cookies. Dredge orange slices and nuts in small amount of flour. Mix remaining ingredients and add orange slices and nuts, mixing well. Grease and slightly flour glass or metal baking dish. Bake at 350° for 20 to 30 minutes. Cut into squares and serve.

recipes.title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
directions: Mix Crisco, sugar and brown sugar.
Mix egg and vanilla extract.
Mix flour, salt and baking soda.
Combine all 3 mixtures and add chocolate chips.
Drop by teaspoonfuls on ungreased cookie sheet.
Bake at 350° for 10 minutes.
recipes.text: Chocolate Chip Cookies. Mix Crisco, sugar and brown sugar. Mix egg and vanilla extract. Mix flour, salt and baking soda. Combine all 3 mixtures and add chocolate chips. Drop by teaspoonfuls on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 350° for 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Garlic Pretzels
ingredients: 1 pkg. dry Hidden Valley Ranch dressing
directions: Mix ingredients together.
Mix with a bag of pretzels in a large covered bowl.
Mix every hour until dry (approximately 3 to 5 hours).
Bag after drying.
recipes.text: Garlic Pretzels. Mix ingredients together. Mix with a bag of pretzels in a large covered bowl. Mix every hour until dry (approximately 3 to 5 hours). Bag after drying.

recipes.title: Chocolate Chewy Cookies
directions: Cream butter and sugar.
Add eggs and vanilla.
Combine flour, cocoa and salt.
Blend into butter and sugar mixture.
Stir in chocolate chips and nuts.
Drop by teaspoonfuls onto ungreased cookie sheet.
Bake at 350° for 8 to 9 minutes (no more).
recipes.text: Chocolate Chewy Cookies. Cream butter and sugar. Add eggs and vanilla. Combine flour, cocoa and salt. Blend into butter and sugar mixture. Stir in chocolate chips and nuts. Drop by teaspoonfuls onto ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 350° for 8 to 9 minutes (no more).

recipes.title: Summer Vegetable Salad
directions: In heavy pan, heat oil and cook garlic with lemon juice, wine, thyme, and salt and pepper to taste for 5 minutes. Add corn and simmer for about 3 minutes.
Combine all.
Refrigerate so flavors blend.
Serve cold or room temperature.
Serves 6.
recipes.text: Summer Vegetable Salad. In heavy pan, heat oil and cook garlic with lemon juice, wine, thyme, and salt and pepper to taste for 5 minutes. Add corn and simmer for about 3 minutes. Combine all. Refrigerate so flavors blend. Serve cold or room temperature. Serves 6.

recipes.title: Spicy Cashew Chicken
ingredients: 2 boneless, skinless chicken breast halves, cut in strips
directions: Snap spaghetti in half, cook in boiling water until just tender.
Drain and rinse with cold water and set aside.
In 3-quart microwaveproof casserole, combine onion, carrots, oil and pepper flakes.
Microwave on High for 3 minutes.
Add mushrooms and celery.
Peel broccoli stem and slice thinly.
Cut off florets and separate them into bite size pieces.
Add broccoli and diced pepper to the casserole and microwave on High for 3 minutes.
Stir in cashews and peas.
Microwave on High for 1 minute.
Cover and set aside.
recipes.text: Spicy Cashew Chicken. Snap spaghetti in half, cook in boiling water until just tender. Drain and rinse with cold water and set aside. In 3-quart microwaveproof casserole, combine onion, carrots, oil and pepper flakes. Microwave on High for 3 minutes. Add mushrooms and celery. Peel broccoli stem and slice thinly. Cut off florets and separate them into bite size pieces. Add broccoli and diced pepper to the casserole and microwave on High for 3 minutes. Stir in cashews and peas. Microwave on High for 1 minute. Cover and set aside.

recipes.title: Pineapple Cake Delight
ingredients: 1 box Betty Crocker SuperMoist yellow or white cake mix
directions: Bake cake in 13 x 9-inch baking pan.
Cool.
Make the vanilla instant pudding.
Spread pudding on top of cooled cake.
Pour can of pineapple (drained) over top of pudding.
Spread Cool Whip over layer of pineapple.
Sprinkle top with crushed walnuts.
recipes.text: Pineapple Cake Delight. Bake cake in 13 x 9-inch baking pan. Cool. Make the vanilla instant pudding. Spread pudding on top of cooled cake. Pour can of pineapple (drained) over top of pudding. Spread Cool Whip over layer of pineapple. Sprinkle top with crushed walnuts.

recipes.title: Hamburger Vegetable Soup
directions: Fry ground beef and onion together; drain fat.
Add all remaining ingredients.
Bring to a boil; cover.
Simmer 1 hour.
recipes.text: Hamburger Vegetable Soup. Fry ground beef and onion together; drain fat. Add all remaining ingredients. Bring to a boil; cover. Simmer 1 hour.

recipes.title: Cheese Ball
directions: Cream the cream cheese.
Grate Cheddar in the cream cheese and mix well (use fork).
In another bowl, mix onion, green pepper, pimento, jalapeno pepper, Worcestershire sauce, cayenne pepper and lemon juice.
Pour into cheese mixture and mix well.
Let chill about 2 hours.
Take out, make 2 balls.
Roll in pecans.
recipes.text: Cheese Ball. Cream the cream cheese. Grate Cheddar in the cream cheese and mix well (use fork). In another bowl, mix onion, green pepper, pimento, jalapeno pepper, Worcestershire sauce, cayenne pepper and lemon juice. Pour into cheese mixture and mix well. Let chill about 2 hours. Take out, make 2 balls. Roll in pecans.

recipes.title: Tetraginni (Pasta)
ingredients: 8 oz. vermicelli spaghetti, cooked and drained
directions: Combine cooked vermicelli with remaining ingredients and turn into a greased 2-quart casserole dish.
Bake in preheated oven for 25 minutes or until brown and bubbly.
recipes.text: Tetraginni (Pasta). Combine cooked vermicelli with remaining ingredients and turn into a greased 2-quart casserole dish. Bake in preheated oven for 25 minutes or until brown and bubbly.

recipes.title: Banana Chocolate Chip Cookies
directions: Beat eggs, water, shortening, bananas and about half of the cake mix (dry) until smooth.
Stir in remaining cake mix, oats, chocolate bits and nuts.
Drop dough by rounded teaspoonful, about 2 inches apart, onto ungreased baking sheet.
Bake 10 to 12 minutes in 375° oven.
Remove.
Makes about 7 dozen.
recipes.text: Banana Chocolate Chip Cookies. Beat eggs, water, shortening, bananas and about half of the cake mix (dry) until smooth. Stir in remaining cake mix, oats, chocolate bits and nuts. Drop dough by rounded teaspoonful, about 2 inches apart, onto ungreased baking sheet. Bake 10 to 12 minutes in 375° oven. Remove. Makes about 7 dozen.

recipes.title: Ranch Cracker Snacks
ingredients: 1 pkg. Hidden Valley Ranch original recipe
directions: Combine all ingredients except crackers and mix well.
Pour over crackers and make sure all are coated.
Place in sheet pan and cook in warm oven 20 to 30 minutes.
Store in airtight container and enjoy.
recipes.text: Ranch Cracker Snacks. Combine all ingredients except crackers and mix well. Pour over crackers and make sure all are coated. Place in sheet pan and cook in warm oven 20 to 30 minutes. Store in airtight container and enjoy.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Cookies
directions: Cream shortening; add sugar, egg and vanilla.
Add flour and mix well.
Form balls and put on greased pans.
Flatten balls with a fork dipped in flour.
Bake at 315° for 10 to 15 minutes.
Makes 3 to 4 dozen.
recipes.text: Peanut Butter Cookies. Cream shortening; add sugar, egg and vanilla. Add flour and mix well. Form balls and put on greased pans. Flatten balls with a fork dipped in flour. Bake at 315° for 10 to 15 minutes. Makes 3 to 4 dozen.

recipes.title: Lemon Cheese Pressed Cookie(Press Cookie)
directions: Blend butter and cream cheese. Add sugar; cream thoroughly. Add egg, lemon juice and rind; blend well. Measure flour and baking powder together, mixing well. Add to cream cheese mixture. Mix thoroughly. Chill dough 30 minutes. Heat oven to 350°. Force dough through cookie press onto an ungreased baking sheet. Bake 8 to 10 minutes or until slightly browned. Makes about 5 dozen 2-inch cookies.
recipes.text: Lemon Cheese Pressed Cookie(Press Cookie). Blend butter and cream cheese. Add sugar; cream thoroughly. Add egg, lemon juice and rind; blend well. Measure flour and baking powder together, mixing well. Add to cream cheese mixture. Mix thoroughly. Chill dough 30 minutes. Heat oven to 350°. Force dough through cookie press onto an ungreased baking sheet. Bake 8 to 10 minutes or until slightly browned. Makes about 5 dozen 2-inch cookies.

recipes.title: Apple Pie
directions: Mix apples, flour, sugar and spice together.
Blend well. Pour into unbaked 9-inch pie shell.
Add dots of margarine and milk over top, then cover with top crust.
recipes.text: Apple Pie. Mix apples, flour, sugar and spice together. Blend well. Pour into unbaked 9-inch pie shell. Add dots of margarine and milk over top, then cover with top crust.

recipes.title: Power House Cookies
directions: In bowl, stir together flour, soda and salt. Set aside. In large mixing bowl, beat butter with electric mixer 30 seconds. Beat in sugar, oil, eggs and vanilla. Add flour mixture. Beat until well combined. Stir in oatmeal, coconut, raisins, chocolate pieces and walnuts. Drop rounded teaspoonful 2-inches apart on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake in preheated 325° oven for 10 to 12 minutes, until edges are lightly browned. Cool 1 minute on cookie sheet before removing to cooling racks.
recipes.text: Power House Cookies. In bowl, stir together flour, soda and salt. Set aside. In large mixing bowl, beat butter with electric mixer 30 seconds. Beat in sugar, oil, eggs and vanilla. Add flour mixture. Beat until well combined. Stir in oatmeal, coconut, raisins, chocolate pieces and walnuts. Drop rounded teaspoonful 2-inches apart on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake in preheated 325° oven for 10 to 12 minutes, until edges are lightly browned. Cool 1 minute on cookie sheet before removing to cooling racks.

recipes.title: Chocolate Covered Cherries
ingredients: 1 (16 oz.) jar maraschino cherries, well drained
directions: In a mixing bowl, cream the butter. Add

marshmallow creme, salt, extract and sugar; mix well. Knead into a large ball; chill for 1 hour. Roll into 1-inch balls and flatten into 2-inch circles. Wrap the circles around the cherries and carefully shape into balls. Place on a waxed paper-lined baking sheet. Cover loosely and refrigerate for 4 hours or overnight
recipes.text: Chocolate Covered Cherries. In a mixing bowl, cream the butter. Add marshmallow creme, salt, extract and sugar; mix well. Knead into a large ball; chill for 1 hour. Roll into 1-inch balls and flatten into 2-inch circles. Wrap the circles around the cherries and carefully shape into balls. Place on a waxed paper-lined baking sheet. Cover loosely and refrigerate for 4 hours or overnight

recipes.title: Aunt Georgia'S Zesty Barbecue Sauce
directions: Boil all vegetables in the water until tender.
Add the tomato paste, barbecue sauce and liquid smoke.
Simmer slowly for about 30 minutes.
Remove from heat.
Cool.
Store in refrigerator in jar until ready for use.
(Oh yes!
The sauce must be strained before storing!)
Try it on beef ribs, chicken or pork ribs.
recipes.text: Aunt Georgia'S Zesty Barbecue Sauce. Boil all vegetables in the water until tender. Add the tomato paste, barbecue sauce and liquid smoke. Simmer slowly for about 30 minutes. Remove from heat. Cool. Store in refrigerator in jar until ready for use. (Oh yes! The sauce must be strained before storing!) Try it on beef ribs, chicken or pork ribs.

recipes.title: Oriental Meatballs
directions: Mix all together.
Make into small round balls and deep fry.
recipes.text: Oriental Meatballs. Mix all together. Make into small round balls and deep fry.

recipes.title: Orange Cream Salad
directions: Drain all canned fruits.
Combine and set aside.
Combine dry pudding mix, milk and frozen orange juice concentrate.
Beat until blended.
Mix in sour cream.
Fold into fruit mixture.
Cover and chill.
recipes.text: Orange Cream Salad. Drain all canned fruits. Combine and set aside. Combine dry pudding mix, milk and frozen orange juice concentrate. Beat until blended. Mix in sour cream. Fold into fruit mixture. Cover and chill.

recipes.title: Taco Soup
directions: Add the ingredients to the hamburger that has been browned. Cook 15 minutes with cover on pot.
Garnish with shredded cheese, sour cream and taco chips.
