recipes.text: Taco Soup. Add the ingredients to the hamburger that has been browned. Cook 15 minutes with cover on pot. Garnish with shredded cheese, sour cream and taco chips.

recipes.title: Pineapple Dream Pie
ingredients: 1 (20 oz.) can crushed pineapple, well drained
directions: Mix together cream cheese and sugar in bowl. Fold in whipped topping and crushed pineapple. Spoon into pie crust.
Top with pineapple chunks. Chill 2 hours or overnight. Garnish with additional whipped topping, if desired.
recipes.text: Pineapple Dream Pie. Mix together cream cheese and sugar in bowl. Fold in whipped topping and crushed pineapple. Spoon into pie crust. Top with pineapple chunks. Chill 2 hours or overnight. Garnish with additional whipped topping, if desired.

recipes.title: Hummus
directions: Put first 4
ingredients in blender or food processor. Blend until smooth.
Serve on flat plate or shallow bowl, spread out smoothly.
Top with olive oil.
Sprinkle with paprika.
Offer crackers or pita bread to dip.
recipes.text: Hummus. Put first 4 ingredients in blender or food processor. Blend until smooth. Serve on flat plate or shallow bowl, spread out smoothly. Top with olive oil. Sprinkle with paprika. Offer crackers or pita bread to dip.

recipes.title: Simple Punch
directions: In a gallon jar, mix Kool-Aid, pineapple juice, sugar and tea. Fill jar rest of way full and stir.
Put in freezer, stirring away from sides as it freezes.
When ready to serve, add ginger ale. This will make it slushy.
recipes.text: Simple Punch. In a gallon jar, mix Kool-Aid, pineapple juice, sugar and tea. Fill jar rest of way full and stir. Put in freezer, stirring away from sides as it freezes. When ready to serve, add ginger ale. This will make it slushy.

recipes.title: Custard Pie
directions: Let pie shell chill while making the filling.
Blend eggs, sugar, salt, vanilla and almond extract.
Gradually stir in scalded milk.
Pour into chilled, unbaked pie shell.
Bake in hot oven at 400° for 25 to 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Custard Pie. Let pie shell chill while making the filling. Blend eggs, sugar, salt, vanilla and almond extract. Gradually stir in scalded milk. Pour into chilled, unbaked pie shell. Bake in hot oven at 400° for 25 to 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Chicken Casserole
directions: Mix all ingredients except last two together in a buttered dish.
Top with melted butter and corn flakes.
Bake at 320° for 40 minutes.
recipes.text: Chicken Casserole. Mix all ingredients except last two together in a buttered dish. Top with melted butter and corn flakes. Bake at 320° for 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Yellow Squash Casserole
directions: Melt butter; mix with cornbread dressing.
Line an 8 x 12-inch pan with half the cornbread dressing mixture.
Set aside.
Cook squash until barely done; drain and mash.
Saute onion; add to squash along with the rest of ingredients.
Put in pan; cover with rest of cornbread mixture.
Bake at 350° for 35 to 45 minutes until bubbly and slightly browned.
Makes 10 to 12 servings.
recipes.text: Yellow Squash Casserole. Melt butter; mix with cornbread dressing. Line an 8 x 12-inch pan with half the cornbread dressing mixture. Set aside. Cook squash until barely done; drain and mash. Saute onion; add to squash along with the rest of ingredients. Put in pan; cover with rest of cornbread mixture. Bake at 350° for 35 to 45 minutes until bubbly and slightly browned. Makes 10 to 12 servings.

recipes.title: Skillet Chicken Risotto
ingredients: 4 medium carrots, peeled and cut into 1/2-inch slices
directions: In 10-inch skillet, brown chicken in hot oil for about 15 minutes.
Remove chicken and drain all but 2 tablespoons fat from skillet.
Add rice, onion, salt and poultry seasoning to skillet. Cook and stir until rice is lightly browned.
Add mushrooms, carrots and water.
Place chicken atop rice mixture.
Season chicken with additional salt and pepper.
recipes.text: Skillet Chicken Risotto. In 10-inch skillet, brown chicken in hot oil for about 15 minutes. Remove chicken and drain all but 2 tablespoons fat from skillet. Add rice, onion, salt and poultry seasoning to skillet. Cook and stir until rice is lightly browned. Add mushrooms, carrots and water. Place chicken atop rice mixture. Season chicken with additional salt and pepper.

recipes.title: Party Ham Ball
directions: Reserve 4 slices ham.
Mix all ingredients together by hand. Shape into ball and chill overnight.
Before serving wrap 4 pieces of ham around ball and secure with toothpicks.
Serve with crackers.
(Chop ham before combining with other ingredients.)
recipes.text: Party Ham Ball. Reserve 4 slices ham. Mix all ingredients together by hand. Shape into ball and chill overnight. Before serving wrap 4 pieces of ham around ball and secure with toothpicks. Serve with crackers. (Chop ham before combining with other ingredients.)

recipes.title: Layered Cauliflower Salad
directions: Wash cauliflower and cut into small pieces.
Layer bite-size shreds of lettuce, then onion, cauliflower and bacon in a large salad bowl.
Mix last 4 ingredients and spread on it.
Cover with plastic wrap and chill.
recipes.text: Layered Cauliflower Salad. Wash cauliflower and cut into small pieces. Layer bite-size shreds of lettuce, then onion, cauliflower and bacon in a large salad bowl. Mix last 4 ingredients and spread on it. Cover with plastic wrap and chill.

recipes.title: Creamy Rich Chicken Breast
ingredients: 2 (10 3/4 oz.) cans cream of chicken soup
directions: Pepper, but do not salt chicken breasts.
Wrap slice of bacon around each half of chicken breast.
Place layer of dried beef in bottom of baking dish.
Arrange bacon wrapped chicken on beef slices.
Cover with mixture of chicken soup, sour cream and cream cheese.
Cover pan tightly with foil.
Place in oven for 2 hours. When tender, remove foil and let brown slightly.
Serve on hot rice.
recipes.text: Creamy Rich Chicken Breast. Pepper, but do not salt chicken breasts. Wrap slice of bacon around each half of chicken breast. Place layer of dried beef in bottom of baking dish. Arrange bacon wrapped chicken on beef slices. Cover with mixture of chicken soup, sour cream and cream cheese. Cover pan tightly with foil. Place in oven for 2 hours. When tender, remove foil and let brown slightly. Serve on hot rice.

recipes.title: Soft Gingerbread
ingredients: 2 tsp. soda, dissolved in 1 c. boiling water
directions: Put sugar, molasses, butter, soda, ginger, cloves, cinnamon and butter in bowl and dissolve 2 teaspoons soda in 1 cup boiling water.
Hold soda water over bowl as it foams over cup.
Beat together. When well beaten, add 2 well beaten eggs the last thing before baking.
Bake in an oblong pan at 325° for 45 to 50 minutes.
Serve with whipped cream or as desired.
recipes.text: Soft Gingerbread. Put sugar, molasses, butter, soda, ginger, cloves, cinnamon and butter in bowl and dissolve 2 teaspoons soda in 1 cup boiling water. Hold soda water over bowl as it foams over cup. Beat together. When well beaten, add 2 well beaten eggs the last thing before baking. Bake in an oblong pan at 325° for 45 to 50 minutes. Serve with whipped cream or as desired.

recipes.title: Dishpan Cookies
directions: Cream in very large bowl the first five ingredients. Thoroughly mix in soda, flour and salt with mixer.
Stir in all other ingredients by hand, adding cornflakes last.
recipes.text: Dishpan Cookies. Cream in very large bowl the first five ingredients. Thoroughly mix in soda, flour and salt with mixer. Stir in all other ingredients by hand, adding cornflakes last.

recipes.title: Southern Comfort Punch
directions: Mix all of the ingredients in a punch bowl.
recipes.text: Southern Comfort Punch. Mix all of the ingredients in a punch bowl.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Bars
directions: Melt together
1 1/2 cubes margarine and peanut butter. Stir in the graham cracker crumbs and powdered sugar; mix well and pat into
a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Melt together the additional margarine and the
chocolate chips.
Spread into an even layer over the crumb
mixture.
Cool
and cut into squares.
Makes 3 to 4 dozen squares.
recipes.text: Peanut Butter Bars. Melt together 1 1/2 cubes margarine and peanut butter. Stir in the graham cracker crumbs and powdered sugar; mix well and pat into a 9 x 13-inch pan. Melt together the additional margarine and the chocolate chips. Spread into an even layer over the crumb mixture. Cool and cut into squares. Makes 3 to 4 dozen squares.

recipes.title: Avocado And Potato Salad Of Bacalao
ingredients: 1 large potato, cut into chunks and cooked
1 small avocado, peeled and cut into chunks
1 large tomato, seeded and cut into chunks
directions: In saucepan, place bacalao in cold water to cover.
Simmer 15 minutes.
Drain and repeat process 3 more times.
Shred bacalao with fingers.
Combine bacalao with potatoes, onion, avocado, tomato and eggs.
Blend olive oil and vinegar.
Combine with salt and pepper to taste.
Toss.
Serve with French bread.
Makes 4 to 6 servings.
recipes.text: Avocado And Potato Salad Of Bacalao. In saucepan, place bacalao in cold water to cover. Simmer 15 minutes. Drain and repeat process 3 more times. Shred bacalao with fingers. Combine bacalao with potatoes, onion, avocado, tomato and eggs. Blend olive oil and vinegar. Combine with salt and pepper to taste. Toss. Serve with French bread. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

recipes.title: Layered Green Salad
ingredients: 1 can or 1 pkg. cooked, frozen green peas
directions: Layer in order given.
recipes.text: Layered Green Salad. Layer in order given.

recipes.title: Pizzelles
directions: In blender, beat eggs until fluffy.
Gradually add sugar to beaten eggs.
Mix until smooth.
Add melted margarine, vanilla, anise flavor and Sambuca.
Mix until well blended. Sift flour and baking powder together in a large bowl.
Add egg mixture and beat with hand mixer until smooth.
Batter will be sticky.
Drop by teaspoonfuls in center of pattern on pizzelle iron.
Heat until golden.
When cool, sprinkle with confectioners sugar through sifter.
recipes.text: Pizzelles. In blender, beat eggs until fluffy. Gradually add sugar to beaten eggs. Mix until smooth. Add melted margarine, vanilla, anise flavor and Sambuca. Mix until well blended. Sift flour and baking powder together in a large bowl. Add egg mixture and beat with hand mixer until smooth. Batter will be sticky. Drop by teaspoonfuls in center of pattern on pizzelle iron. Heat until golden. When cool, sprinkle with confectioners sugar through sifter.

recipes.title: Italian Delight Hot Dish
ingredients: 1/2 lb. American cheese, cut up (I use a spicier cheese)
directions: Simmer ground beef in 3 tablespoons of oleo (or whatever you prefer) with onions and green pepper until meat is cooked.
Add cheese.
Cook spaghetti as directed.
Put all other ingredients together and add 2 cans of tomato soup.
Bake in oven at 350° for 3/4 hour.
recipes.text: Italian Delight Hot Dish. Simmer ground beef in 3 tablespoons of oleo (or whatever you prefer) with onions and green pepper until meat is cooked. Add cheese. Cook spaghetti as directed. Put all other ingredients together and add 2 cans of tomato soup. Bake in oven at 350° for 3/4 hour.

recipes.title: Kim'S Mexican Cornbread
directions: Mix all ingredients until well mixed.
Bake at 375° until golden brown.
recipes.text: Kim'S Mexican Cornbread. Mix all ingredients until well mixed. Bake at 375° until golden brown.

recipes.title: Pinto Beans(Lone Star Cafe)
directions: Cook over medium heat, stirring every 15 minutes.
Cook until done, 1 1/2 to 2 hours.

If you prefer, as I do, soak overnight. You will use less than a gallon of water if you soak overnight. Cover beans well with water and cook as you always cook beans. Add seasonings after the beans are partially cooked.
recipes.text: Pinto Beans(Lone Star Cafe). Cook over medium heat, stirring every 15 minutes. Cook until done, 1 1/2 to 2 hours. If you prefer, as I do, soak overnight. You will use less than a gallon of water if you soak overnight. Cover beans well with water and cook as you always cook beans. Add seasonings after the beans are partially cooked.

recipes.title: Hawaiian Cake Topping
directions: Blend cream cheese, pudding and milk.
Spread on top of sheet cake.
Spread crushed pineapple over the top.
Cover with Cool Whip and sprinkle with coconut and nuts.
recipes.text: Hawaiian Cake Topping. Blend cream cheese, pudding and milk. Spread on top of sheet cake. Spread crushed pineapple over the top. Cover with Cool Whip and sprinkle with coconut and nuts.

recipes.title: Battletown Inn Baked Squash
directions: Wash and slice squash; boil in salted water until tender. Drain and mash.
Saute onion in butter.
Add cream and crackers, stirring and cooking for a few minutes.
Mix with squash and place in greased casserole. Cover with bread crumbs; dot with butter. Bake for 30 minutes at 400°.
Serves 4 to 6.
recipes.text: Battletown Inn Baked Squash. Wash and slice squash; boil in salted water until tender. Drain and mash. Saute onion in butter. Add cream and crackers, stirring and cooking for a few minutes. Mix with squash and place in greased casserole. Cover with bread crumbs; dot with butter. Bake for 30 minutes at 400°. Serves 4 to 6.

recipes.title: Santa'S Whiskers
ingredients: 1 c. finely chopped red or green candied cherries
directions: Beat butter for 35 seconds; add sugar and beat until fluffy. Add milk and vanilla; beat well.
Stir in flour, then cherries and pecans.
Shape into 3 (7-inch) rolls.
Roll dough into coconut to coat outside.
Wrap in wax paper or clear plastic wrap; chill thoroughly.
Cut into 1/4-inch slices.
Place on an ungreased cookie sheet.
Bake at 375° for 12 minutes or until edges are golden.
Makes 80.
recipes.text: Santa'S Whiskers. Beat butter for 35 seconds; add sugar and beat until fluffy. Add milk and vanilla; beat well. Stir in flour, then cherries and pecans. Shape into 3 (7-inch) rolls. Roll dough into coconut to coat outside. Wrap in wax paper or clear plastic wrap; chill thoroughly. Cut into 1/4-inch slices. Place on an ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 375° for 12 minutes or until edges are golden. Makes 80.

recipes.title: Cauliflower Salad
ingredients: 1 head cauliflower, cut in bite size pieces
directions: Mix together first 4 ingredients.
Let set overnight.
Mix in mayonnaise before serving.
recipes.text: Cauliflower Salad. Mix together first 4 ingredients. Let set overnight. Mix in mayonnaise before serving.

recipes.title: Broccoli With Peppers
ingredients: 4 c. small broccoli florets (medium sized head)
1 small sweet red pepper, cored, seeded and cut lengthwise into 1/2-inch strips
directions: In a heavy skillet (12-inch), heat olive oil over moderate heat one minute.
Add onion, garlic, water, broccoli, red pepper, oregano and red pepper flakes.
Cook, stirring, 2 minutes.
Cover skillet; reduce heat to low and cook 6 to 8 minutes longer, stirring often, until broccoli is tender, but still crisp.
recipes.text: Broccoli With Peppers. In a heavy skillet (12-inch), heat olive oil over moderate heat one minute. Add onion, garlic, water, broccoli, red pepper, oregano and red pepper flakes. Cook, stirring, 2 minutes. Cover skillet; reduce heat to low and cook 6 to 8 minutes longer, stirring often, until broccoli is tender, but still crisp.

recipes.title: Marbled Brownies
directions: Soften cream cheese and butter.
Beat together. Add 2 eggs, flour and vanilla. Beat until smooth. Set aside.
Put brownie mix, chocolate package, 2 tablespoons water and 3 eggs in bowl.
Mix about 50 strokes by hand.
Pour half into 13 x 9-inch pan (greased).
Pour all of the cheese mix over brownies. Spoon remaining brownie layer here and there over the cream cheese mix. Pull knife through batter to create swirls.
Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes. Cool and frost with easy milk chocolate frosting or leave as is and enjoy.
recipes.text: Marbled Brownies. Soften cream cheese and butter. Beat together. Add 2 eggs, flour and vanilla. Beat until smooth. Set aside. Put brownie mix, chocolate package, 2 tablespoons water and 3 eggs in bowl. Mix about 50 strokes by hand. Pour half into 13 x 9-inch pan (greased). Pour all of the cheese mix over brownies. Spoon remaining brownie layer here and there over the cream cheese mix. Pull knife through batter to create swirls. Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes. Cool and frost with easy milk chocolate frosting or leave as is and enjoy.

recipes.title: Beef Roast
directions: Salt and pepper roast.
Place in a baking pan.
Pour mushroom soup, dry onion soup mix and water over roast.
Cover and bake at 300° until done.
(May add potatoes and carrots.)
recipes.text: Beef Roast. Salt and pepper roast. Place in a baking pan. Pour mushroom soup, dry onion soup mix and water over roast. Cover and bake at 300° until done. (May add potatoes and carrots.)

recipes.title: No Cook Divinity
directions: In small mixing bowl, combine frosting mix (dry), corn syrup, vanilla and boiling water.
Beat on highest speed until stiff peaks form; about 5 minutes.
Transfer to large mixing bowl; on low speed, gradually blend in sugar; stir in nuts.
Drop by teaspoons onto waxed paper.
When outside of candy feels firm, turn over.
Dry at least 12 hours.
Store candy in airtight container.
Makes 5 to 6 dozen.
recipes.text: No Cook Divinity. In small mixing bowl, combine frosting mix (dry), corn syrup, vanilla and boiling water. Beat on highest speed until stiff peaks form; about 5 minutes. Transfer to large mixing bowl; on low speed, gradually blend in sugar; stir in nuts. Drop by teaspoons onto waxed paper. When outside of candy feels firm, turn over. Dry at least 12 hours. Store candy in airtight container. Makes 5 to 6 dozen.

recipes.title: Wine-Sauced Shoulder Chops
ingredients: 1 (2 oz.) can (1/4 c.) sliced pimiento, drained and chopped
directions: For sauce:
Cook onion, pimiento, herbs and pepper in hot oil until onion is tender.
Combine cornstarch, Worcestershire and 1/3 cup cold water.
Stir into onion mixture.
Cook and stir until bubbly.
Add wine.
Keep sauce warm.
recipes.text: Wine-Sauced Shoulder Chops. For sauce: Cook onion, pimiento, herbs and pepper in hot oil until onion is tender. Combine cornstarch, Worcestershire and 1/3 cup cold water. Stir into onion mixture. Cook and stir until bubbly. Add wine. Keep sauce warm.

recipes.title: Sunday Chicken  Soup
directions: Saute first 4 ingredients in 1/4 cup butter.
Add flour and cook 2 minutes.
Heat milk and
broth to boiling.
Slowly add vegetables.
Stir constantly.
Add rice, pimento, chicken and parsley.
Simmer until thick.
recipes.text: Sunday Chicken  Soup. Saute first 4 ingredients in 1/4 cup butter. Add flour and cook 2 minutes. Heat milk and broth to boiling. Slowly add vegetables. Stir constantly. Add rice, pimento, chicken and parsley. Simmer until thick.

recipes.title: Baked Artichoke Dip
ingredients: 1/2 pkg. shredded Mozzarella cheese plus 2 Tbsp.
garlic, salt and pepper (optional, but good!)
directions: Mix all ingredients, except 2 tablespoons of Mozzarella cheese for top.
Spread in pan.
Top with remaining 2 tablespoons of Mozzarella cheese for top.
Bake in 350° oven for about 15 minutes or until bubbly.
Eat with stone Wheat Thins.
recipes.text: Baked Artichoke Dip. Mix all ingredients, except 2 tablespoons of Mozzarella cheese for top. Spread in pan. Top with remaining 2 tablespoons of Mozzarella cheese for top. Bake in 350° oven for about 15 minutes or until bubbly. Eat with stone Wheat Thins.

recipes.title: Hot Chicken Salad(Yields 4 Servings)
ingredients: 1 small can pineapple (add 3 pkg. artificial sweetener)
directions: Use leftover roast beef and gravy.
Put sliced roast beef and gravy on 2 slices of toast.
Serve with mashed potatoes and sliced tomatoes.
recipes.text: Hot Chicken Salad(Yields 4 Servings). Use leftover roast beef and gravy. Put sliced roast beef and gravy on 2 slices of toast. Serve with mashed potatoes and sliced tomatoes.

recipes.title: Ham And Asparagus Pie
ingredients: 2 (10 oz.) pkg. frozen cut asparagus, cooked
directions: Melt butter in a saucepan.
Stir in next 3 ingredients. Remove from heat.
Gradually stir in milk until smooth.
Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly until sauce comes to a boil. Boil for 1 minute.
Stir small amount of sauce into mayonnaise, then stir into mixture in saucepan.
Add ham, asparagus and lemon juice; cook until heated.
Turn into pie shell.
Sprinkle with grated Parmesan cheese.
Broil about 2 minutes, until lightly browned.
Serves 6.
recipes.text: Ham And Asparagus Pie. Melt butter in a saucepan. Stir in next 3 ingredients. Remove from heat. Gradually stir in milk until smooth. Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly until sauce comes to a boil. Boil for 1 minute. Stir small amount of sauce into mayonnaise, then stir into mixture in saucepan. Add ham, asparagus and lemon juice; cook until heated. Turn into pie shell. Sprinkle with grated Parmesan cheese. Broil about 2 minutes, until lightly browned. Serves 6.

recipes.title: Blueberry Streusel Cobbler
ingredients: 1 (14 oz.) can Eagle Brand sweetened condensed milk (not evaporated)
3/4 c. plus 2 Tbsp. cold butter or margarine
directions: Preheat oven to 325°. In a bowl, combine blueberries, Eagle Brand and peel. In a large bowl, cut 3/4 cup butter into 1 1/2 cups biscuit mix until crumbly; add blueberry mixture. Spread in greased 9-inch square baking pan. In a small bowl, combine remaining 1/2 cup biscuit mix and sugar; cut in remaining 2 tablespoons butter until crumbly. Add nuts. Sprinkle over cobbler. Bake 1 hour and 10 minutes or until golden. Serve warm with vanilla ice cream and blueberry sauce. Refrigerate leftovers.
recipes.text: Blueberry Streusel Cobbler. Preheat oven to 325°. In a bowl, combine blueberries, Eagle Brand and peel. In a large bowl, cut 3/4 cup butter into 1 1/2 cups biscuit mix until crumbly; add blueberry mixture. Spread in greased 9-inch square baking pan. In a small bowl, combine remaining 1/2 cup biscuit mix and sugar; cut in remaining 2 tablespoons butter until crumbly. Add nuts. Sprinkle over cobbler. Bake 1 hour and 10 minutes or until golden. Serve warm with vanilla ice cream and blueberry sauce. Refrigerate leftovers.

recipes.title: Potato Casserole
ingredients: 1 large bag hash brown potatoes, frozen
1 carton sour cream (more than 8 oz. and less than 16 oz.)
directions: Stir all together.
Pour into buttered 9 x 13-inch pan.
Dot with butter and cover with bread crumbs.
Bake at 325° for 1 1/2 hours.
recipes.text: Potato Casserole. Stir all together. Pour into buttered 9 x 13-inch pan. Dot with butter and cover with bread crumbs. Bake at 325° for 1 1/2 hours.

recipes.title: Bran Muffins
directions: Combine flour, baking powder, sugar and salt.
Set aside. Combine Bran cereal and milk; let set 2 minutes.
Add egg, oil and dry ingredients.
Mix lightly.
Spoon into 12 greased muffin cups. Bake at 400° for 18 to 20 minutes.
recipes.text: Bran Muffins. Combine flour, baking powder, sugar and salt. Set aside. Combine Bran cereal and milk; let set 2 minutes. Add egg, oil and dry ingredients. Mix lightly. Spoon into 12 greased muffin cups. Bake at 400° for 18 to 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Chicken Rotel
directions: Boil chicken and remove bone.
Cook spaghetti, broken in small pieces, in chicken broth.
Saute onion in 1 stick of butter.
Cut Velveeta cheese in cubes.
Mix all ingredients together and cook in oven for 30 minutes at 350°.
recipes.text: Chicken Rotel. Boil chicken and remove bone. Cook spaghetti, broken in small pieces, in chicken broth. Saute onion in 1 stick of butter. Cut Velveeta cheese in cubes. Mix all ingredients together and cook in oven for 30 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Poppy Seed Cake
directions: Blend until smooth in large mixing bowl the first 5 ingredients.
Add remaining ingredients to liquid ingredients. Mix for 15 minutes at regular speed.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour and 20 minutes in an ungreased angel food pan.
Do not ice.
Powder sugar if wished.
recipes.text: Poppy Seed Cake. Blend until smooth in large mixing bowl the first 5 ingredients. Add remaining ingredients to liquid ingredients. Mix for 15 minutes at regular speed. Bake at 350° for 1 hour and 20 minutes in an ungreased angel food pan. Do not ice. Powder sugar if wished.

recipes.title: Easy Pork Barbecue
directions: For 6 servings you will need:
recipes.text: Easy Pork Barbecue. For 6 servings you will need:

recipes.title: Swedish Spice Cookies
directions: Preheat oven to 350°.
Grease baking sheets.
Set aside.
In large mixing bowl, cream butter and sugar until light and fluffy. Blend in egg and sour cream.
Stir in orange peel, cardamom, ginger and cloves.
Mix in flour and baking soda.
Shape dough into 1-inch balls.
Roll in sugar.
Place 2 inches apart on prepared baking sheet.
Flatten each cookie with bottom of drinking glass.
Bake at 350° for 8 to 10 minutes or until light golden brown.
Remove to cooling rack.
Makes 5 to 5 1/2 dozen cookies.
recipes.text: Swedish Spice Cookies. Preheat oven to 350°. Grease baking sheets. Set aside. In large mixing bowl, cream butter and sugar until light and fluffy. Blend in egg and sour cream. Stir in orange peel, cardamom, ginger and cloves. Mix in flour and baking soda. Shape dough into 1-inch balls. Roll in sugar. Place 2 inches apart on prepared baking sheet. Flatten each cookie with bottom of drinking glass. Bake at 350° for 8 to 10 minutes or until light golden brown. Remove to cooling rack. Makes 5 to 5 1/2 dozen cookies.

recipes.title: Heavenly Hash
ingredients: 1/4 C. maraschino cherries, drained and halved
directions: Mix all ingredients thoroughly and chill for at least 1 hour before serving. Nuts may also be added, if desired.
recipes.text: Heavenly Hash. Mix all ingredients thoroughly and chill for at least 1 hour before serving. Nuts may also be added, if desired.

recipes.title: Creamy Cheese Spread
directions: Combine cheese, nuts and garlic in mixing bowl; stir to blend. Divide into 3 parts and shape into 3 balls.
Coat 1 ball with chili powder, one with parsley and one with nuts.
Chill before serving.
recipes.text: Creamy Cheese Spread. Combine cheese, nuts and garlic in mixing bowl; stir to blend. Divide into 3 parts and shape into 3 balls. Coat 1 ball with chili powder, one with parsley and one with nuts. Chill before serving.

recipes.title: Pea Salad
directions: Mix all ingredients in medium bowl.
Cover with equal amounts of oil and vinegar.
Marinate overnight.
Strain off oil and vinegar.
Season as desired.
Serve cold.
Yum!
recipes.text: Pea Salad. Mix all ingredients in medium bowl. Cover with equal amounts of oil and vinegar. Marinate overnight. Strain off oil and vinegar. Season as desired. Serve cold. Yum!

recipes.title: Pumpkin Cookies
directions: Cream sugar and margarine.
Stir in pumpkin, egg and vanilla. In another bowl, mix dry ingredients together.
Stir gradually into pumpkin mixture.
Add raisins and nuts.
With teaspoon, drop onto cookie sheet.
Bake at 350° for 10 minutes.
recipes.text: Pumpkin Cookies. Cream sugar and margarine. Stir in pumpkin, egg and vanilla. In another bowl, mix dry ingredients together. Stir gradually into pumpkin mixture. Add raisins and nuts. With teaspoon, drop onto cookie sheet. Bake at 350° for 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Divinity
directions: Boil sugar, corn syrup and water together until it will form a hard ball when dropped in water. Beat egg whites and salt at high speed for 3 minutes in a large bowl.
Pour syrup slowly into beaten whites while beating at high speed. Continue beating until passed the glossy stage. Add nuts or fruits and vanilla.
Continue beating until mixture forms a peak.
Pour into buttered platter or drop by spoonfuls on wax paper.
recipes.text: Divinity. Boil sugar, corn syrup and water together until it will form a hard ball when dropped in water. Beat egg whites and salt at high speed for 3 minutes in a large bowl. Pour syrup slowly into beaten whites while beating at high speed. Continue beating until passed the glossy stage. Add nuts or fruits and vanilla. Continue beating until mixture forms a peak. Pour into buttered platter or drop by spoonfuls on wax paper.

recipes.title: Aleasha'S Love Cookies
directions: Mix well.
Roll into little balls and share with someone you love.
recipes.text: Aleasha'S Love Cookies. Mix well. Roll into little balls and share with someone you love.

recipes.title: Salad
directions: Mix and let set.
recipes.text: Salad. Mix and let set.

recipes.title: Fish Chowder
ingredients: 1 (16 oz.) pkg. frozen flounder, cod or haddock fillet (better with fresh fish; also can use orange roughy or catfish)
1 medium green pepper, cut into thin strips
directions: Cut fish into bite size chunks.
In a 4-quart saucepan, over medium heat in hot oil, cook green pepper, onion and garlic until tender, stirring occasionally.
To vegetables in saucepan, add tomatoes with the liquid, basil, pepper and fish chunks.
Heat to boiling on high heat.
Reduce heat to low; cover and simmer for 10 minutes.
Continue cooking until fish flakes when tested with fork.
You can also add cooked potato chunks and cooked sliced carrots when you add fish.
recipes.text: Fish Chowder. Cut fish into bite size chunks. In a 4-quart saucepan, over medium heat in hot oil, cook green pepper, onion and garlic until tender, stirring occasionally. To vegetables in saucepan, add tomatoes with the liquid, basil, pepper and fish chunks. Heat to boiling on high heat. Reduce heat to low; cover and simmer for 10 minutes. Continue cooking until fish flakes when tested with fork. You can also add cooked potato chunks and cooked sliced carrots when you add fish.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Bars
directions: Mix Karo and sugar; bring to a boil.
Remove from heat.
Mix peanut butter and vanilla into sugar mixture.
Pour into Rice Krispies and mix well.
Put into buttered dish.
Melt white chocolate in microwave and pour on top.
recipes.text: Peanut Butter Bars. Mix Karo and sugar; bring to a boil. Remove from heat. Mix peanut butter and vanilla into sugar mixture. Pour into Rice Krispies and mix well. Put into buttered dish. Melt white chocolate in microwave and pour on top.

recipes.title: Danish Raspberry Bars
ingredients: 1 1/2 c. sifted Martha White plain flour
directions: Heat oven to 375°.
In mixing bowl, combine flour, baking powder, oats and sugars (not confectioners sugar).
Add melted butter and stir to blend.
recipes.text: Danish Raspberry Bars. Heat oven to 375°. In mixing bowl, combine flour, baking powder, oats and sugars (not confectioners sugar). Add melted butter and stir to blend.

recipes.title: Turtle Cookies
ingredients: 1 (18.5 oz.) box German chocolate cake mix
directions: Empty caramels in saucepan with 1/3 cup of milk.
Melt, stirring constantly.
Remove from heat.
Combine cake mix, 1/3 cup milk, melted butter and nuts.
Press two-thirds of cake mixture in greased and floured 9 x 13 x 2-inch baking dish.
Bake in 350° oven for 10 minutes.
Sprinkle chocolate chips over baked mixture. Spread caramel mixture over top of chips.
Add remaining cake mix by spoonfuls on top of caramels.
Bake an additional 20 to 25 minutes. Cut while warm.
Makes 12 to 16 servings.
recipes.text: Turtle Cookies. Empty caramels in saucepan with 1/3 cup of milk. Melt, stirring constantly. Remove from heat. Combine cake mix, 1/3 cup milk, melted butter and nuts. Press two-thirds of cake mixture in greased and floured 9 x 13 x 2-inch baking dish. Bake in 350° oven for 10 minutes. Sprinkle chocolate chips over baked mixture. Spread caramel mixture over top of chips. Add remaining cake mix by spoonfuls on top of caramels. Bake an additional 20 to 25 minutes. Cut while warm. Makes 12 to 16 servings.

recipes.title: Mexican Lasagna
ingredients: 2 1/2 c. (10 oz.) grated Monterey Jack cheese
directions: In a large skillet, brown the ground beef, stirring until cooked through; drain fat.
Add taco seasoning, seasoned salt, tomatoes, tomato sauce and chilies.
Blend well.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to a simmer, uncovered, for 10 minutes.
recipes.text: Mexican Lasagna. In a large skillet, brown the ground beef, stirring until cooked through; drain fat. Add taco seasoning, seasoned salt, tomatoes, tomato sauce and chilies. Blend well. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to a simmer, uncovered, for 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Cheesy Bread
directions: Heat oven to 400°.
Mix cheese, margarine and seasoning. Spread on bread.
Place on cookie sheet.
Bake for 5 to 10 minutes, until lightly browned.
recipes.text: Cheesy Bread. Heat oven to 400°. Mix cheese, margarine and seasoning. Spread on bread. Place on cookie sheet. Bake for 5 to 10 minutes, until lightly browned.

recipes.title: Chocolate Almond Pie(For Diabetics)
ingredients: 1 1/4 c. reduced-fat chocolate wafer crumbs (about 40 wafers)
directions: In a food processor, combine wafers, sweetener and butter. Pulse until blended.
Add egg white; pulse until moistened.
Press onto bottom and up sides of a 9-inch pie plate.
Bake at 370° for 8 to 10 minutes or until lightly browned.
Cool.
recipes.text: Chocolate Almond Pie(For Diabetics). In a food processor, combine wafers, sweetener and butter. Pulse until blended. Add egg white; pulse until moistened. Press onto bottom and up sides of a 9-inch pie plate. Bake at 370° for 8 to 10 minutes or until lightly browned. Cool.

recipes.title: Cajun Sweet Hot Pickles
ingredients: 1 gal. whole dill or sour pickles
1/2 tsp. red pepper seeds per layer (pizza pepper)
directions: Drain juice off pickles and discard.
Slice pickles into thick slices.
Layer pickles, sugar, pepper, cinnamon and garlic in 4 to 6 layers back in jar.
(Use a potato masher to push them down; they will all fit back in.)
Replace lid.
Seal tightly.
Turn upside down and leave 12 hours; turn up and down every 12 hours for 6 days.
Store in refrigerator.
They will make their own juice; don't add any liquid.
recipes.text: Cajun Sweet Hot Pickles. Drain juice off pickles and discard. Slice pickles into thick slices. Layer pickles, sugar, pepper, cinnamon and garlic in 4 to 6 layers back in jar. (Use a potato masher to push them down; they will all fit back in.) Replace lid. Seal tightly. Turn upside down and leave 12 hours; turn up and down every 12 hours for 6 days. Store in refrigerator. They will make their own juice; don't add any liquid.

recipes.title: Cinnamon Blintzes
directions: Trim crusts from bread and roll thin.
Cream together cream cheese, egg yolk and sugar.
Spread on bread slices.
Roll up jelly roll fashion.
Mix brown sugar and cinnamon.
Dip folded bread into butter, then in sugar mixture.
Place on cookie sheet or 9 x 13-inch and freeze.
(If keeping for a long time, put them in a Ziploc bag after they are frozen.)
recipes.text: Cinnamon Blintzes. Trim crusts from bread and roll thin. Cream together cream cheese, egg yolk and sugar. Spread on bread slices. Roll up jelly roll fashion. Mix brown sugar and cinnamon. Dip folded bread into butter, then in sugar mixture. Place on cookie sheet or 9 x 13-inch and freeze. (If keeping for a long time, put them in a Ziploc bag after they are frozen.)

recipes.title: Reuben Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 (3 oz.) pkg. thinly sliced corned beef
directions: Spread butter on one side of each slice of bread.
Spread other side with Thousand Island dressing.
On 4 slices, arrange corned beef, cheese and sauerkraut evenly over Thousand Island dressing.
Top with remaining bread, placing buttered side out.
recipes.text: Reuben Sandwiches. Spread butter on one side of each slice of bread. Spread other side with Thousand Island dressing. On 4 slices, arrange corned beef, cheese and sauerkraut evenly over Thousand Island dressing. Top with remaining bread, placing buttered side out.

recipes.title: Neiman Marcus Chocolate Chip Cookies
directions: Cream butter with sugar until fluffy. Beat in the egg and the vanilla. Combine the dry ingredients and beat into the butter mixture. Stir in the chocolate chips. Bake at 375° for 9 minutes.
recipes.text: Neiman Marcus Chocolate Chip Cookies. Cream butter with sugar until fluffy. Beat in the egg and the vanilla. Combine the dry ingredients and beat into the butter mixture. Stir in the chocolate chips. Bake at 375° for 9 minutes.

recipes.title: Creamy French Dressing
directions: In a blender, place the mayonnaise, ketchup, vinegar, sugar, onion, salt and pepper; cover and process until smooth.
While processing, gradually add oil in a steady stream.
Refrigerate. Yield: 2 1/2 cups.
recipes.text: Creamy French Dressing. In a blender, place the mayonnaise, ketchup, vinegar, sugar, onion, salt and pepper; cover and process until smooth. While processing, gradually add oil in a steady stream. Refrigerate. Yield: 2 1/2 cups.

recipes.title: Vanilla Wafer Cake
directions: Cream margarine.
Add sugar; mix until smooth and creamy.
Add eggs, one at a time, beating after each addition.
Add crushed vanilla wafers, coconut and pecans.
Bake in a greased tube pan at 275° for 1 1/2 hours.
recipes.text: Vanilla Wafer Cake. Cream margarine. Add sugar; mix until smooth and creamy. Add eggs, one at a time, beating after each addition. Add crushed vanilla wafers, coconut and pecans. Bake in a greased tube pan at 275° for 1 1/2 hours.

recipes.title: Coconut Cake
directions: Mix all together.
Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.
recipes.text: Coconut Cake. Mix all together. Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.

recipes.title: Chocolate Cream Cake
directions: Mix all together and bake in 3 layers at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes.
recipes.text: Chocolate Cream Cake. Mix all together and bake in 3 layers at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Macaroni Salad
directions: Cook macaroni.
Cool under cold water.
Mix everything together.
Put into refrigerator for at least 3 to 4 hours to settle.
Enjoy!
recipes.text: Macaroni Salad. Cook macaroni. Cool under cold water. Mix everything together. Put into refrigerator for at least 3 to 4 hours to settle. Enjoy!

recipes.title: Orange Smoothee
ingredients: 1 (6 oz.) can frozen orange juice concentrate
directions: Combine orange juice, milk, sugar, vanilla, 1 cup water and 10 ice cubes in blender.
Process until smooth.
Serve immediately. Yields 6 servings.
recipes.text: Orange Smoothee. Combine orange juice, milk, sugar, vanilla, 1 cup water and 10 ice cubes in blender. Process until smooth. Serve immediately. Yields 6 servings.

recipes.title: Company French Toast
directions: Melt butter in baking dish.
Stir in sugar and cinnamon.
Place bread in double layers over sugar mixture.
Beat eggs and milk; pour over bread.
Cover and refrigerate overnight.
Bake in a 350° oven, covered, for 35 minutes.
Uncover and bake for 10 minutes. Cut into squares and invert onto plate.
Sprinkle with powdered sugar and serve with syrup.
Serves 6 to 8.
recipes.text: Company French Toast. Melt butter in baking dish. Stir in sugar and cinnamon. Place bread in double layers over sugar mixture. Beat eggs and milk; pour over bread. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Bake in a 350° oven, covered, for 35 minutes. Uncover and bake for 10 minutes. Cut into squares and invert onto plate. Sprinkle with powdered sugar and serve with syrup. Serves 6 to 8.

recipes.title: Orange-Glazed Sweet Potatoes
ingredients: 1 c. orange juice or Five Alive juice
directions: Cook sweet potatoes in boiling water until tender.
Allow to cool to touch; peel and slice.
Arrange slices in a 3-quart baking dish.
Combine remaining ingredients in a small saucepan.
Cook, stirring constantly, until thickened.
Pour glaze over sweet potatoes, let set in glaze for awhile or overnight; the longer it sets the better.
Bake uncovered at 350° for 30 minutes.
Serves 10 to 12.
recipes.text: Orange-Glazed Sweet Potatoes. Cook sweet potatoes in boiling water until tender. Allow to cool to touch; peel and slice. Arrange slices in a 3-quart baking dish. Combine remaining ingredients in a small saucepan. Cook, stirring constantly, until thickened. Pour glaze over sweet potatoes, let set in glaze for awhile or overnight; the longer it sets the better. Bake uncovered at 350° for 30 minutes. Serves 10 to 12.

recipes.title: Chocolate Pecan Pie
directions: Combine the first 4 ingredients in a heavy saucepan; cook over low heat, stirring constantly until sugar dissolves.
Let cool slightly.
Add eggs, vanilla and salt, stirring well.
Stir in 1/2 cup pecans and coconut.
Pour filling into shell; top with remaining pecans.
Bake at 375° for 55 minutes.
recipes.text: Chocolate Pecan Pie. Combine the first 4 ingredients in a heavy saucepan; cook over low heat, stirring constantly until sugar dissolves. Let cool slightly. Add eggs, vanilla and salt, stirring well. Stir in 1/2 cup pecans and coconut. Pour filling into shell; top with remaining pecans. Bake at 375° for 55 minutes.

recipes.title: Basic Tomato Meat Sauce
directions: Heat olive oil in saucepot.
Add onion and cook until lightly browned.
Add and brown ground chuck.
Add slowly, a mixture of tomatoes, salt, bay leaf and sweet basil or oregano.
Cover saucepot and simmer over very low heat about 2 1/2 hours.
Add tomato sauce.
recipes.text: Basic Tomato Meat Sauce. Heat olive oil in saucepot. Add onion and cook until lightly browned. Add and brown ground chuck. Add slowly, a mixture of tomatoes, salt, bay leaf and sweet basil or oregano. Cover saucepot and simmer over very low heat about 2 1/2 hours. Add tomato sauce.

recipes.title: Mama'S Peanut Butter Candy
directions: Put
peanut butter and butter in double boiler and heat so it will
spread easily.
Put 3 cups sugar, 1 cup water and Karo syrup in one vessel to cook.
Put other cup of sugar and 1 cup
water in	another
vessel.
When	first vessel is done enough to	crack against
a glass when dropped in cold water, pour
slowly over stiffly beaten egg whites.	Beat until other vessel gets done, then pour it in, beating constantly.
recipes.text: Mama'S Peanut Butter Candy. Put peanut butter and butter in double boiler and heat so it will spread easily. Put 3 cups sugar, 1 cup water and Karo syrup in one vessel to cook. Put other cup of sugar and 1 cup water in	another vessel. When	first vessel is done enough to	crack against a glass when dropped in cold water, pour slowly over stiffly beaten egg whites.	Beat until other vessel gets done, then pour it in, beating constantly.

recipes.title: European Apple Cake
ingredients: 4 c. thinly sliced Cortland or any type cooking apples
directions: Preheat oven to 375°.
Lightly grease 10-inch tube pan.
In a separate bowl, combine apples, cinnamon and 3 tablespoons sugar.
recipes.text: European Apple Cake. Preheat oven to 375°. Lightly grease 10-inch tube pan. In a separate bowl, combine apples, cinnamon and 3 tablespoons sugar.

recipes.title: Six In One Cookies
directions: Cream butter and sugar; add
eggs
and beat well.
Mix in flour, salt, soda and vanilla.
Divide dough into as many parts as desired and add
one of the following:
approximately
cup coconut,
cup raisins, 1/2 cup nuts and 1/4 to 1/2 cup chocolate or caramel chips.
recipes.text: Six In One Cookies. Cream butter and sugar; add eggs and beat well. Mix in flour, salt, soda and vanilla. Divide dough into as many parts as desired and add one of the following: approximately 1/2 cup coconut, 1/2 cup raisins, 1/2 cup nuts and 1/4 to 1/2 cup chocolate or caramel chips.

recipes.title: Perfect Pie Crust
directions: Cut Crisco into flour and salt.
Beat egg in measuring cup and add ice water to equal 1/2 cup.
Pour in vinegar; mix well.
Add to flour mixture and mix until flour is moist.
Chill.
Divide dough into 3 balls (makes 3 crusts).
Roll to desired size of pan. Unused portion may be frozen.
Frozen dough will roll and handle better than when first mixed.
recipes.text: Perfect Pie Crust. Cut Crisco into flour and salt. Beat egg in measuring cup and add ice water to equal 1/2 cup. Pour in vinegar; mix well. Add to flour mixture and mix until flour is moist. Chill. Divide dough into 3 balls (makes 3 crusts). Roll to desired size of pan. Unused portion may be frozen. Frozen dough will roll and handle better than when first mixed.

recipes.title: 3-Bean Casserole
directions: Combine all ingredients except beans and simmer 20 minutes. Combine with beans. Place in buttered casserole and bake at 350° for 60 minutes.
recipes.text: 3-Bean Casserole. Combine all ingredients except beans and simmer 20 minutes. Combine with beans. Place in buttered casserole and bake at 350° for 60 minutes.

recipes.title: Lime Congealed Salad
directions: Mix cream cheese, Jell-O and marshmallows.
Add boiling water; let cool.
Add pineapple and nuts.
Put in refrigerator until jelled.
recipes.text: Lime Congealed Salad. Mix cream cheese, Jell-O and marshmallows. Add boiling water; let cool. Add pineapple and nuts. Put in refrigerator until jelled.

recipes.title: Tomato Bread
directions: Mix and bake for 1 hour at 350°.
recipes.text: Tomato Bread. Mix and bake for 1 hour at 350°.

recipes.title: Broccoli And Pasta
directions: Note:
Any vegetable oil can be used instead of olive oil.
recipes.text: Broccoli And Pasta. Note: Any vegetable oil can be used instead of olive oil.

recipes.title: Yellow Squash Relish
directions: Cube vegetables.
Mix first 6 ingredients and let stand 1 hour, then drain.
Mix remainder of ingredients in pan.
Bring to a boil and boil for 5 minutes, then add vegetables to this mixture and bring to a boil and pack in jars and seal.
recipes.text: Yellow Squash Relish. Cube vegetables. Mix first 6 ingredients and let stand 1 hour, then drain. Mix remainder of ingredients in pan. Bring to a boil and boil for 5 minutes, then add vegetables to this mixture and bring to a boil and pack in jars and seal.

recipes.title: Pauly'S Fish
ingredients: Paul Prudhomme's blackened redfish magic seasoning *
directions: Marinate fillets in Italian dressing for 1 hour.
Take out. Spray broiler pan with Pam.
Pour melted butter on fish.
Sprinkle with seasoning *(can be found in seasoning section of grocery). Broil 15 to 20 minutes, no need to turn.
Squirt with fresh lemon before serving.
recipes.text: Pauly'S Fish. Marinate fillets in Italian dressing for 1 hour. Take out. Spray broiler pan with Pam. Pour melted butter on fish. Sprinkle with seasoning *(can be found in seasoning section of grocery). Broil 15 to 20 minutes, no need to turn. Squirt with fresh lemon before serving.

recipes.title: Quick Ambrosia Salad
directions: Drain fruit well.
Mix all of the above together.
Chill for at least one hour.
Serves 6 to 8.
recipes.text: Quick Ambrosia Salad. Drain fruit well. Mix all of the above together. Chill for at least one hour. Serves 6 to 8.

recipes.title: Broccoli Chowder
directions: Pour chicken broth in kettle; add broccoli.
Slow boil until broccoli is just tender (10 to 15 minutes).
Remove broccoli and set aside.
To broth, add milk, ham, cream, Swiss cheese and butter.
Coarsely chop broccoli; add to chowder.
Cover and simmer 15 minutes.
Add salt and garlic to taste.
May add a little cornstarch mixed with broth to soup if a thicker base is desired. Feeds 6 (approximately).
recipes.text: Broccoli Chowder. Pour chicken broth in kettle; add broccoli. Slow boil until broccoli is just tender (10 to 15 minutes). Remove broccoli and set aside. To broth, add milk, ham, cream, Swiss cheese and butter. Coarsely chop broccoli; add to chowder. Cover and simmer 15 minutes. Add salt and garlic to taste. May add a little cornstarch mixed with broth to soup if a thicker base is desired. Feeds 6 (approximately).

recipes.title: Chunky Chippers
directions: Preheat oven to 350°.
Lightly grease cookie sheets.
Sift flour, baking soda and salt onto wax paper.
Beat shortening, peanut butter, eggs, sugars, vanilla and water in bowl until creamy.
Add flour mixture; blend well.
Stir in chocolate chips.
recipes.text: Chunky Chippers. Preheat oven to 350°. Lightly grease cookie sheets. Sift flour, baking soda and salt onto wax paper. Beat shortening, peanut butter, eggs, sugars, vanilla and water in bowl until creamy. Add flour mixture; blend well. Stir in chocolate chips.

recipes.title: Cottage Cheese And Cool Whip Salad
ingredients: 1 pkg. Jell-O (any flavor, dry right from the pkg.)
directions: Combine all ingredients.
You can also use orange Jell-O and mandarin oranges with the pineapple.
recipes.text: Cottage Cheese And Cool Whip Salad. Combine all ingredients. You can also use orange Jell-O and mandarin oranges with the pineapple.

recipes.title: Clam Chowder
directions: Open fresh clams with their own juice and grind in meat grinder.
Grind potatoes, carrots, onions, bacon and tomatoes. Put in a large kettle.
Add 1 quart of water, thyme and pepper. Bring to a boil; simmer 1 hour.
recipes.text: Clam Chowder. Open fresh clams with their own juice and grind in meat grinder. Grind potatoes, carrots, onions, bacon and tomatoes. Put in a large kettle. Add 1 quart of water, thyme and pepper. Bring to a boil; simmer 1 hour.

recipes.title: Frozen Cherry-Pineapple Salad
directions: Mix well and freeze in 13 x 9-inch pan.
recipes.text: Frozen Cherry-Pineapple Salad. Mix well and freeze in 13 x 9-inch pan.

recipes.title: Montez'S Rolls
ingredients: 3 pkg. dry yeast, dissolved in 1/2 c. warm water (not hot water because it will kill yeast)
directions: Combine yeast after dissolved in 1/2 cup of warm water, Crisco oil, eggs and buttermilk, then mix dry ingredients with liquid ingredients.
Beat with mixer or knead until smooth.
Put into large bowl and cover so it can rise.
Always make dough up the night before and put into icebox.
Be sure when dough begins to rise.
Shake it back down.
This will make rolls or cinnamon rolls.
recipes.text: Montez'S Rolls. Combine yeast after dissolved in 1/2 cup of warm water, Crisco oil, eggs and buttermilk, then mix dry ingredients with liquid ingredients. Beat with mixer or knead until smooth. Put into large bowl and cover so it can rise. Always make dough up the night before and put into icebox. Be sure when dough begins to rise. Shake it back down. This will make rolls or cinnamon rolls.

recipes.title: Crab Stuffed Mushrooms
directions: Wash and dry mushroom caps and dip in melted butter.
Arrange on a greased cookie sheet, cap side up.
Combine remaining ingredients except cheese and mix lightly.
Fill mushrooms with crab mixture and sprinkle with cheese.
Bake in a preheated 375° oven for 15 minutes.
recipes.text: Crab Stuffed Mushrooms. Wash and dry mushroom caps and dip in melted butter. Arrange on a greased cookie sheet, cap side up. Combine remaining ingredients except cheese and mix lightly. Fill mushrooms with crab mixture and sprinkle with cheese. Bake in a preheated 375° oven for 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Sweet Delight
ingredients: 1 box Duncan Hines yellow cake mix
directions: Bottom Layer:
Mix cake mix, butter and eggs together and press it into a 9 x 13-inch baking dish.
recipes.text: Sweet Delight. Bottom Layer: Mix cake mix, butter and eggs together and press it into a 9 x 13-inch baking dish.

recipes.title: Meatballs And Gravy
directions: Mix well ground meat, eggs, bread, tomato sauce, onion, 1 teaspoon of salt and 1/4 teaspoon of black pepper.
Roll the mixture into balls and fry until slightly brown and then place in large bowl and fry gravy in skillet with the grease from the meatballs.
recipes.text: Meatballs And Gravy. Mix well ground meat, eggs, bread, tomato sauce, onion, 1 teaspoon of salt and 1/4 teaspoon of black pepper. Roll the mixture into balls and fry until slightly brown and then place in large bowl and fry gravy in skillet with the grease from the meatballs.

recipes.title: Anzac Biscuits
directions: Melt butter and syrup in a large saucepan.
Mix bicarbonate of soda with boiling water and add to melted butter. This will froth up, so make sure saucepan is large enough.
Mix dry ingredients and add to saucepan.
Mix well to make a firm consistency. Drop teaspoonfuls onto well-greased baking trays, leaving space to spread.
Bake in a moderate oven for 15 to 20 minutes until golden brown.
Loosen on trays while still hot and allow to cool on trays, then transfer to wire racks and allow to cool.
recipes.text: Anzac Biscuits. Melt butter and syrup in a large saucepan. Mix bicarbonate of soda with boiling water and add to melted butter. This will froth up, so make sure saucepan is large enough. Mix dry ingredients and add to saucepan. Mix well to make a firm consistency. Drop teaspoonfuls onto well-greased baking trays, leaving space to spread. Bake in a moderate oven for 15 to 20 minutes until golden brown. Loosen on trays while still hot and allow to cool on trays, then transfer to wire racks and allow to cool.

recipes.title: Beary Cherry Cobbler
ingredients: 1 (16 oz.) can cherry or peach pie filling
directions: Preheat oven to 350°.
Place stick of margarine in a 2 1/2-quart baking dish and melt in oven while preheating. Meanwhile, combine dry ingredients.
Stir in 3/4 cup milk (batter will be thin).
Pour batter into center of melted margarine.
Pour pie filling into center of batter.
Bake about 50 minutes or until top is golden brown.
Serve warm or cold with whipped cream.
recipes.text: Beary Cherry Cobbler. Preheat oven to 350°. Place stick of margarine in a 2 1/2-quart baking dish and melt in oven while preheating. Meanwhile, combine dry ingredients. Stir in 3/4 cup milk (batter will be thin). Pour batter into center of melted margarine. Pour pie filling into center of batter. Bake about 50 minutes or until top is golden brown. Serve warm or cold with whipped cream.

recipes.title: Basil Zucchini Boats
ingredients: 1/2 c. frozen tiny English peas, thawed
1 Tbsp. chopped fresh basil or 1 tsp. dried
directions: Cut zucchini in half lengthwise.
Scoop out pulp, leaving shells intact; chop pulp.
Place zucchini shells, cut side down, in a shallow baking dish.
Add 1/2 cup water to dish.
Bake at 350° for 8 minutes or until crisp-tender.
Drain well; return shells, cut side up to baking dish. Saute pulp, red pepper, peas and garlic in olive oil over medium-high heat until pepper is crisp-tender.
Remove from heat; stir in basil.
Spoon mixture evenly into zucchini "boats."
Sprinkle with Parmesan.
Broil 6 inches from heat about 1 minute to thoroughly heat.
Sprinkle with bacon.
Serves 4.
recipes.text: Basil Zucchini Boats. Cut zucchini in half lengthwise. Scoop out pulp, leaving shells intact; chop pulp. Place zucchini shells, cut side down, in a shallow baking dish. Add 1/2 cup water to dish. Bake at 350° for 8 minutes or until crisp-tender. Drain well; return shells, cut side up to baking dish. Saute pulp, red pepper, peas and garlic in olive oil over medium-high heat until pepper is crisp-tender. Remove from heat; stir in basil. Spoon mixture evenly into zucchini "boats." Sprinkle with Parmesan. Broil 6 inches from heat about 1 minute to thoroughly heat. Sprinkle with bacon. Serves 4.

recipes.title: Potato Chip Munchies
ingredients: 1 c. crushed potato chips (5 c. uncrushed)
directions: Mix margarine until softened.
Add sugar and vanilla and beat until fluffy.
Gradually add flour and chips.
Beat until well mixed.
Drop by teaspoon onto ungreased cookie sheet and flatten with fork dipped in sugar.
Bake at 350° for 12 to 15 minutes or until golden.
Cool and munch away!
Makes about 3 dozen.
recipes.text: Potato Chip Munchies. Mix margarine until softened. Add sugar and vanilla and beat until fluffy. Gradually add flour and chips. Beat until well mixed. Drop by teaspoon onto ungreased cookie sheet and flatten with fork dipped in sugar. Bake at 350° for 12 to 15 minutes or until golden. Cool and munch away! Makes about 3 dozen.

recipes.title: Gingersnaps
directions: Form into balls, dip in sugar.
Bake at 350° for 10 minutes.
recipes.text: Gingersnaps. Form into balls, dip in sugar. Bake at 350° for 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Lace Cookies
directions: Cream butter, brown sugar and white sugar. Add vanilla and eggs. Add oatmeal and nuts. Mix well. Line cookie sheet with foil. Drop by 1/2 teaspoon, 2 inches apart. Bake at 350° for 8-10 minutes. Let cookies cool somewhat before removing from foil, they will be very thin and lacy.
recipes.text: Lace Cookies. Cream butter, brown sugar and white sugar. Add vanilla and eggs. Add oatmeal and nuts. Mix well. Line cookie sheet with foil. Drop by 1/2 teaspoon, 2 inches apart. Bake at 350° for 8-10 minutes. Let cookies cool somewhat before removing from foil, they will be very thin and lacy.

recipes.title: Green Apple Dip
directions: Mix all together and serve with green apples.
recipes.text: Green Apple Dip. Mix all together and serve with green apples.

recipes.title: Meat Loaf
directions: Mix all ingredients, except tomato paste.
Put in dish.
Top with tomato paste.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes to an hour.
recipes.text: Meat Loaf. Mix all ingredients, except tomato paste. Put in dish. Top with tomato paste. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes to an hour.

recipes.title: Cajun "Barbecued" Shrimp
ingredients: butter or margarine (squeeze margarine is best)
directions: Heat oven to 375°.
Lay shrimp in greased baking dish. Generously coat with margarine.
Sprinkle with Tony Chachere Creole seasoning heavily.
Cayenne is to taste, the more you use, the hotter it is, so start with a little.
Turn shrimp with spoon to coat.
Add a little garlic to enhance flavor.
Check every 10 to 15 minutes, turning shrimp each time.
Add more margarine and spices if necessary to coat all.
Shrimp will turn pink when done. Enjoy!
recipes.text: Cajun "Barbecued" Shrimp. Heat oven to 375°. Lay shrimp in greased baking dish. Generously coat with margarine. Sprinkle with Tony Chachere Creole seasoning heavily. Cayenne is to taste, the more you use, the hotter it is, so start with a little. Turn shrimp with spoon to coat. Add a little garlic to enhance flavor. Check every 10 to 15 minutes, turning shrimp each time. Add more margarine and spices if necessary to coat all. Shrimp will turn pink when done. Enjoy!

recipes.title: Pretzel Salad
directions: Spread pretzels on bottom of 9 x 13-inch baking pan.
Mix melted oleo or butter with 2 tablespoons sugar and pour over pretzels and bake at 350° for 10 minutes.
Cool.
Whip together the cream cheese and Cool Whip and 3/4 cup sugar.
Spread over cooled pretzels.
Dissolve strawberry gelatin with 2 cups boiling water.
Add 1/2 cup cold water and the sliced strawberries.
When cool and starting to gel, pour over the cream cheese layer and let set until firm.
recipes.text: Pretzel Salad. Spread pretzels on bottom of 9 x 13-inch baking pan. Mix melted oleo or butter with 2 tablespoons sugar and pour over pretzels and bake at 350° for 10 minutes. Cool. Whip together the cream cheese and Cool Whip and 3/4 cup sugar. Spread over cooled pretzels. Dissolve strawberry gelatin with 2 cups boiling water. Add 1/2 cup cold water and the sliced strawberries. When cool and starting to gel, pour over the cream cheese layer and let set until firm.

recipes.title: Punch Bowl Cake
ingredients: 1 box Duncan Hines cake mix, prepared
directions: Prepare cake and set aside. When cool, pull into pieces. Then put cake on bottom of bowl, one layer, then a layer of pudding, then a layer of cherry pie filling, then a layer of Cool Whip. Sprinkle with nuts. Keep doing this until all used up. Keep in the refrigerator.
recipes.text: Punch Bowl Cake. Prepare cake and set aside. When cool, pull into pieces. Then put cake on bottom of bowl, one layer, then a layer of pudding, then a layer of cherry pie filling, then a layer of Cool Whip. Sprinkle with nuts. Keep doing this until all used up. Keep in the refrigerator.

recipes.title: Chess Brownies
ingredients: 1 yellow cake mix (with pudding in the mix)
directions: Mix together cake mix, margarine and 1 egg and then pat out onto an 8 x 11-inch glass pan.
Beat eggs; add cream cheese and confectioners sugar.
Pour over cake mix in glass pan.
Bake at 300° for 50 minutes to 1 hour, depending on oven.
recipes.text: Chess Brownies. Mix together cake mix, margarine and 1 egg and then pat out onto an 8 x 11-inch glass pan. Beat eggs; add cream cheese and confectioners sugar. Pour over cake mix in glass pan. Bake at 300° for 50 minutes to 1 hour, depending on oven.

recipes.title: Boltanas
directions: On a round pizza pan, spread the refried beans.

Mix the sour cream with the taco seasoning mix. Spread over the beans. Sprinkle chopped onion over mixture. Sprinkle Cheddar cheese next. Top with cut olives of both kinds, chopped green pepper and chopped tomato. Dip your chips!
recipes.text: Boltanas. On a round pizza pan, spread the refried beans. Mix the sour cream with the taco seasoning mix. Spread over the beans. Sprinkle chopped onion over mixture. Sprinkle Cheddar cheese next. Top with cut olives of both kinds, chopped green pepper and chopped tomato. Dip your chips!

recipes.title: Sugar Cookies
directions: Mix sugar, eggs, Crisco, baking soda, baking powder, cream of tartar, nutmeg and vanilla together.
Add 1 cup flour and 1/2 cup sour milk.
Alternate between two until all used.
Bake 1 cookie to test for flour content.
If spreading occurs, add a small amount more flour until firm when baked.
Sprinkle top with sugar before baking.
Bake at 375° until done.
recipes.text: Sugar Cookies. Mix sugar, eggs, Crisco, baking soda, baking powder, cream of tartar, nutmeg and vanilla together. Add 1 cup flour and 1/2 cup sour milk. Alternate between two until all used. Bake 1 cookie to test for flour content. If spreading occurs, add a small amount more flour until firm when baked. Sprinkle top with sugar before baking. Bake at 375° until done.

recipes.title: Caramel Filled Brownies
directions: Preheat oven to 350°.
Melt caramels and 1/2 cup evaporated milk over low heat.
Mix together the cake mix, oleo and 1/3 cup evaporated milk.
Pat 1/2 of chocolate mixture into a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Bake 6 or 7 minutes.
Remove from oven and pour melted caramel over chocolate mixture.
Sprinkle chocolate chips over caramel.
Pat remaining chocolate mixture over caramel and chips. Bake 15 to 20 minutes more.
Refrigerate after cooling before cutting.
recipes.text: Caramel Filled Brownies. Preheat oven to 350°. Melt caramels and 1/2 cup evaporated milk over low heat. Mix together the cake mix, oleo and 1/3 cup evaporated milk. Pat 1/2 of chocolate mixture into a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake 6 or 7 minutes. Remove from oven and pour melted caramel over chocolate mixture. Sprinkle chocolate chips over caramel. Pat remaining chocolate mixture over caramel and chips. Bake 15 to 20 minutes more. Refrigerate after cooling before cutting.

recipes.title: Camp Cobbler
directions: Prepare bottom crust as directed by instructions on mix. Liberally grease Dutch oven with butter or margarine.
Lightly flour the bottom of the Dutch oven.
Cook the bottom crust over 10 to 20 coals until inside is light brown.
Remove from heat.
Add pie filling.
Mix second crust from commercial mix and place over filling (you can cut it into strips).
Place Dutch oven on cleared area, placing 10 to 15 coals on lid and some around sides at 6 inches from Dutch oven.
Check every 10 minutes until top crust is golden brown.
Remove from heat.
Cool and serve.
recipes.text: Camp Cobbler. Prepare bottom crust as directed by instructions on mix. Liberally grease Dutch oven with butter or margarine. Lightly flour the bottom of the Dutch oven. Cook the bottom crust over 10 to 20 coals until inside is light brown. Remove from heat. Add pie filling. Mix second crust from commercial mix and place over filling (you can cut it into strips). Place Dutch oven on cleared area, placing 10 to 15 coals on lid and some around sides at 6 inches from Dutch oven. Check every 10 minutes until top crust is golden brown. Remove from heat. Cool and serve.

recipes.title: Macaroni Ham Salad
directions: Boil eggs; set aside to cool.
Cook macaroni according to package directions; rinse with cold water.
In large mixing bowl, combine salad dressing, pickle relish, dill weed, sugar and half and half; mix well.
Add ham, celery, cheese, eggs and cooled macaroni; mix well.
Chill.
When ready to serve, sprinkle chow mein noodles over top. Serves 7 to 9.
recipes.text: Macaroni Ham Salad. Boil eggs; set aside to cool. Cook macaroni according to package directions; rinse with cold water. In large mixing bowl, combine salad dressing, pickle relish, dill weed, sugar and half and half; mix well. Add ham, celery, cheese, eggs and cooled macaroni; mix well. Chill. When ready to serve, sprinkle chow mein noodles over top. Serves 7 to 9.

recipes.title: Candied Carrots
ingredients: 1 Tbsp. orange juice or grated peel
directions: Mix sugars and cinnamon.
Put on top of carrots.
Add juice and dot with butter.
Brown on top of stove or bake in oven (350°) as like sweet potatoes.
recipes.text: Candied Carrots. Mix sugars and cinnamon. Put on top of carrots. Add juice and dot with butter. Brown on top of stove or bake in oven (350°) as like sweet potatoes.

recipes.title: Ice Cream
directions: Mix all ingredients; do not cook.
Freeze.
recipes.text: Ice Cream. Mix all ingredients; do not cook. Freeze.

recipes.title: Puppy Chow
directions: Melt together chocolate chips, peanut butter and margarine and pour over Crispix cereal (use a large bowl).
Stir well.
Get a grocery sack.
Shake out the dust.
Take the powdered sugar and pour in the sack.
Dump the cereal mixture in.
Close the top of the sack.
Shake it.
Shake it some more, baby, shake, shake, shake, shake.
Look in the bag.
Is your chow well coated?
If not, add more sugar and shake it, baby, shake it some more.
Pour out onto wax paper or foil.
Eat some.
Eat some more.
Put it in a bowl with a lid and put it in a cabinet.
Say you won't eat anymore.
Swear you won't eat more!
Eat some more . . . get really fat!
recipes.text: Puppy Chow. Melt together chocolate chips, peanut butter and margarine and pour over Crispix cereal (use a large bowl). Stir well. Get a grocery sack. Shake out the dust. Take the powdered sugar and pour in the sack. Dump the cereal mixture in. Close the top of the sack. Shake it. Shake it some more, baby, shake, shake, shake, shake. Look in the bag. Is your chow well coated? If not, add more sugar and shake it, baby, shake it some more. Pour out onto wax paper or foil. Eat some. Eat some more. Put it in a bowl with a lid and put it in a cabinet. Say you won't eat anymore. Swear you won't eat more! Eat some more . . . get really fat!

recipes.title: Egg Souffle
directions: Mix eggs, milk, mustard, salt and bread.
Add sausage and cheese.
Pour into 9 x 13-inch pan.
Refrigerate overnight.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Egg Souffle. Mix eggs, milk, mustard, salt and bread. Add sausage and cheese. Pour into 9 x 13-inch pan. Refrigerate overnight. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Fufu
directions: Mix the flour with water and make a smooth paste in a saucepan and cook it over medium heat, stirring all the time, until it thickens as desired.
Pour it into a wet bowl.
Shape into a ball. Serve with the peanut butter soup.
recipes.text: Fufu. Mix the flour with water and make a smooth paste in a saucepan and cook it over medium heat, stirring all the time, until it thickens as desired. Pour it into a wet bowl. Shape into a ball. Serve with the peanut butter soup.

recipes.title: Turkey Log
directions: Mix ingredients and refrigerate 12 to 24 hours.
Roll into logs and bake 1 1/2 hours at 325°.
recipes.text: Turkey Log. Mix ingredients and refrigerate 12 to 24 hours. Roll into logs and bake 1 1/2 hours at 325°.

recipes.title: Refrigerator Whole Wheat Rolls
directions: Add yeast and 1 teaspoon sugar to water.
Combine milk, 1/2 cup
sugar,
salt
and shortening; cool to lukewarm.
Add yeast mixture,
then egg.
Add to flour mixture.	Place dough mixture in greased bowl; cover and store in refrigerator.
recipes.text: Refrigerator Whole Wheat Rolls. Add yeast and 1 teaspoon sugar to water. Combine milk, 1/2 cup sugar, salt and shortening; cool to lukewarm. Add yeast mixture, then egg. Add to flour mixture.	Place dough mixture in greased bowl; cover and store in refrigerator.

recipes.title: Microwave Parmesan Chicken
directions: Mix tomato sauce, Italian seasoning and garlic salt in a 2-cup measuring cup.
Cover with wax paper.
Microwave on High for 2 minutes.
Stir.
Reduce power to Medium for 5 minutes.
recipes.text: Microwave Parmesan Chicken. Mix tomato sauce, Italian seasoning and garlic salt in a 2-cup measuring cup. Cover with wax paper. Microwave on High for 2 minutes. Stir. Reduce power to Medium for 5 minutes.

recipes.title: Italian Wedding Soup
directions: Wash chicken; place in large pot with water and boil.
Remove foam that forms.
Add salt, pepper, onion, celery and carrots. Cook 2 hours or until meat is tender.
Remove chicken and shred. Add spinach and already cooked pasta.
Add shredded chicken and tomatoes.
Cook 1/2 hour longer.
More water may be added if necessary.
Add cheese, garnish with parsley and serve while hot.
recipes.text: Italian Wedding Soup. Wash chicken; place in large pot with water and boil. Remove foam that forms. Add salt, pepper, onion, celery and carrots. Cook 2 hours or until meat is tender. Remove chicken and shred. Add spinach and already cooked pasta. Add shredded chicken and tomatoes. Cook 1/2 hour longer. More water may be added if necessary. Add cheese, garnish with parsley and serve while hot.

recipes.title: Chicken Waldorf Salad
ingredients: 2 c. diced cooked chicken or turkey
directions: Mix mayonnaise, lemon juice, salt and pepper.
Add to remaining ingredients.
Cover and chill.
Makes 5 cups.
recipes.text: Chicken Waldorf Salad. Mix mayonnaise, lemon juice, salt and pepper. Add to remaining ingredients. Cover and chill. Makes 5 cups.

recipes.title: Judy'S Sausage And Chicken Stew
ingredients: 1 pkg. refrigerated roasted drumsticks or wings (6 to 7 pieces)
directions: Cut kielbasa diagonally into 1/2-inch slices.
Chop onion. Cut celery stalk diagonally into 1/4-inch slices.
In a 5-quart Dutch oven over medium-high heat, cook kielbasa until lightly browned.
With slotted spoon, remove kielbasa to bowl.
In drippings in Dutch oven, cook onion and celery until tender-crisp, stirring frequently.
Add beans with their liquid, carrots, tomatoes, thyme leaves, chicken pieces and kielbasa; heat to boiling.
Reduce heat to low, cover and simmer 5 minutes or until heated through.
Makes about 6 servings.
recipes.text: Judy'S Sausage And Chicken Stew. Cut kielbasa diagonally into 1/2-inch slices. Chop onion. Cut celery stalk diagonally into 1/4-inch slices. In a 5-quart Dutch oven over medium-high heat, cook kielbasa until lightly browned. With slotted spoon, remove kielbasa to bowl. In drippings in Dutch oven, cook onion and celery until tender-crisp, stirring frequently. Add beans with their liquid, carrots, tomatoes, thyme leaves, chicken pieces and kielbasa; heat to boiling. Reduce heat to low, cover and simmer 5 minutes or until heated through. Makes about 6 servings.

recipes.title: Creamy Pumpkin Dessert
ingredients: 17 oz. pkg. refrigerated ready to slice sugar cookie dough
directions: Preheat oven to 375°.
Slice cookie dough into 1/4-inch slices.
Place slices in rows in 13 x 9 x 2-inch ungreased pan; press to edges and corners.
In a small bowl, combine cream cheese, 1/4 cup sugar and vanilla; mix at low speed until well blended.
Add egg; mix well.
Spread mixture over cookie base.
In a large bowl, combine 1/4 cup sugar, cinnamon, ginger, salt, cloves, pumpkin, milk and eggs; mix well.
Carefully pour pumpkin mixture over cream cheese layer.
Bake 45 to 55 minutes or until knife inserted near center comes out clean.
Cool; refrigerate.
recipes.text: Creamy Pumpkin Dessert. Preheat oven to 375°. Slice cookie dough into 1/4-inch slices. Place slices in rows in 13 x 9 x 2-inch ungreased pan; press to edges and corners. In a small bowl, combine cream cheese, 1/4 cup sugar and vanilla; mix at low speed until well blended. Add egg; mix well. Spread mixture over cookie base. In a large bowl, combine 1/4 cup sugar, cinnamon, ginger, salt, cloves, pumpkin, milk and eggs; mix well. Carefully pour pumpkin mixture over cream cheese layer. Bake 45 to 55 minutes or until knife inserted near center comes out clean. Cool; refrigerate.

recipes.title: Cranberry Ring Tea Bread *
directions: In saucepan, combine cranberry relish and corn syrup; heat just to boiling.
Spoon mixture into greased 6 1/2 cup ring mold. Combine margarine, brown sugar and cinnamon.
Spread 1 side of each biscuit with some of the brown sugar mixture.
Place biscuits on edge of ring mold.
Bake at 375° for 25 minutes.
Allow to cool in pan for 3 minutes.
Invert onto serving plate.
recipes.text: Cranberry Ring Tea Bread *. In saucepan, combine cranberry relish and corn syrup; heat just to boiling. Spoon mixture into greased 6 1/2 cup ring mold. Combine margarine, brown sugar and cinnamon. Spread 1 side of each biscuit with some of the brown sugar mixture. Place biscuits on edge of ring mold. Bake at 375° for 25 minutes. Allow to cool in pan for 3 minutes. Invert onto serving plate.

recipes.title: Egg And Grits Casserole
ingredients: 1 can whole potatoes, sliced or sliced raw potatoes
directions: Slice potatoes and layer in a 9 x 13-inch pan; sprinkle with onion.
Bake in a 325° oven while browning sausage on top of stove.

Sprinkle browned sausage on top of potatoes; set aside. In a large pan, empty grits and add enough water to make them creamy (not runny); bring to a boil while stirring constantly. Remove grits from heat.
Beat eggs with milk and add to grits along with the cheese and butter.
Stir until melted.
Pour egg grit mixture over potato sausage mixture.
Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes, until eggs set.
Serve with fruit or juice.
recipes.text: Egg And Grits Casserole. Slice potatoes and layer in a 9 x 13-inch pan; sprinkle with onion. Bake in a 325° oven while browning sausage on top of stove. Sprinkle browned sausage on top of potatoes; set aside. In a large pan, empty grits and add enough water to make them creamy (not runny); bring to a boil while stirring constantly. Remove grits from heat. Beat eggs with milk and add to grits along with the cheese and butter. Stir until melted. Pour egg grit mixture over potato sausage mixture. Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes, until eggs set. Serve with fruit or juice.

recipes.title: Spoon Rolls
directions: Stir and mix well in bowl.
Bake in muffin tins at 350° for 20 minutes or until golden brown.
Will keep in refrigerator for days.
Can bake as you need them.
recipes.text: Spoon Rolls. Stir and mix well in bowl. Bake in muffin tins at 350° for 20 minutes or until golden brown. Will keep in refrigerator for days. Can bake as you need them.

recipes.title: Italian Pretzels
ingredients: 1 lb. pretzels, broken into small pieces
directions: Spread pretzels on jelly roll pan.
Combine oil, dressing mix, dill weed, lemon pepper and garlic powder in bowl; mix well.
Pour over pretzels.
Stir well.
Bake at 325° for 15 minutes.
Store in airtight container.
recipes.text: Italian Pretzels. Spread pretzels on jelly roll pan. Combine oil, dressing mix, dill weed, lemon pepper and garlic powder in bowl; mix well. Pour over pretzels. Stir well. Bake at 325° for 15 minutes. Store in airtight container.

recipes.title: Aunt Mamie'S Tomato Relish(Good To Put On Vegetables)
ingredients: 4 c. vinegar (red vinegar, White Oaks Brand best)
1/4 c. sugar to 1/2 c. to taste (varies with vinegar)
2 heaping tsp. each of mustard, cinnamon and ginger
directions: In a cloth, put 2 heaping teaspoons of mustard (ground), cinnamon and ginger.
Tie up cloth.
Scald tomatoes and peel.
Cut up and mix all ingredients.
Cook until thick (use rubber gloves when cutting up hot peppers).
Cook about 3 hours until thick. Makes about 5 or 6 pints.
recipes.text: Aunt Mamie'S Tomato Relish(Good To Put On Vegetables). In a cloth, put 2 heaping teaspoons of mustard (ground), cinnamon and ginger. Tie up cloth. Scald tomatoes and peel. Cut up and mix all ingredients. Cook until thick (use rubber gloves when cutting up hot peppers). Cook about 3 hours until thick. Makes about 5 or 6 pints.

recipes.title: Chess Cake
directions: Mix cake mix, 1 egg and melted butter together and place in 13 x 9-inch pan to form crust.
Mix sugar, cream cheese and 2 eggs in a bowl.
Pour over crust.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes or until brown.
recipes.text: Chess Cake. Mix cake mix, 1 egg and melted butter together and place in 13 x 9-inch pan to form crust. Mix sugar, cream cheese and 2 eggs in a bowl. Pour over crust. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes or until brown.

recipes.title: Sweet Potato Pie
directions: Mix potatoes, sugars and slightly beaten eggs.
Add remaining ingredients.
Mix well.
Pour in an unbaked pie crust.
Bake at 425° for 15 minutes.
Reduce heat to 350° and bake for 40 minutes.
recipes.text: Sweet Potato Pie. Mix potatoes, sugars and slightly beaten eggs. Add remaining ingredients. Mix well. Pour in an unbaked pie crust. Bake at 425° for 15 minutes. Reduce heat to 350° and bake for 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Eclair
directions: Mix pudding and milk; fold in Cool Whip. Line pan with graham crackers. Pour 1/2 of mixture over crackers; add 2nd layer of crackers and add remaining mixture.
recipes.text: Eclair. Mix pudding and milk; fold in Cool Whip. Line pan with graham crackers. Pour 1/2 of mixture over crackers; add 2nd layer of crackers and add remaining mixture.

recipes.title: Spinach Pie
directions: Preheat oven to 350°.
Thaw spinach and squeeze out all the water from spinach.
Add all ingredients except butter.
Open box of filo dough.
Place one sheet at a time on a cookie sheet.
Use approximately 8 to 10 sheets for bottom layer, then spread all ingredients.
Place another 8 to 10 layers of filo dough on top, buttering each sheet.
Place in refrigerator for about 10 minutes until butter hardens.
Cut the pie, then cook it for about 1/2 hour.
You can also freeze the pie once it is cooked!
recipes.text: Spinach Pie. Preheat oven to 350°. Thaw spinach and squeeze out all the water from spinach. Add all ingredients except butter. Open box of filo dough. Place one sheet at a time on a cookie sheet. Use approximately 8 to 10 sheets for bottom layer, then spread all ingredients. Place another 8 to 10 layers of filo dough on top, buttering each sheet. Place in refrigerator for about 10 minutes until butter hardens. Cut the pie, then cook it for about 1/2 hour. You can also freeze the pie once it is cooked!

recipes.title: Mexican Chicken
directions: Boil fryers; debone.
Spray large oblong casserole dish with Pam.
Place chicken in dish.
Sprinkle with garlic salt and cayenne pepper.
Dice onion; sprinkle over meat.
Add shredded Velveeta on top.
Crush half of the chips; put over cheese.
In blender, blend mushroom soup, chicken soup and Ro-Tel.
Pour over other ingredients; top with remaining chips which have been crushed.
recipes.text: Mexican Chicken. Boil fryers; debone. Spray large oblong casserole dish with Pam. Place chicken in dish. Sprinkle with garlic salt and cayenne pepper. Dice onion; sprinkle over meat. Add shredded Velveeta on top. Crush half of the chips; put over cheese. In blender, blend mushroom soup, chicken soup and Ro-Tel. Pour over other ingredients; top with remaining chips which have been crushed.

recipes.title: Gooey Butter Cake
directions: Mix chopped nuts, melted margarine, cake mix and 2 eggs.
Pour into an oblong greased 9 x 13-inch pan.
Mix with mixer, cream cheese, 2 eggs and powdered sugar.
Pour on top of cake mix; bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes.
Don't overbake.
recipes.text: Gooey Butter Cake. Mix chopped nuts, melted margarine, cake mix and 2 eggs. Pour into an oblong greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix with mixer, cream cheese, 2 eggs and powdered sugar. Pour on top of cake mix; bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes. Don't overbake.

recipes.title: Mushroom And Cheese Omelette
ingredients: 1/2 lb. mushrooms, cleaned, trimmed and sliced thin
