1 clove garlic, minced or put through a press
salt and freshly ground black pepper to taste
1/2 c. grated Gruyere or Parmesan cheese
directions: Heat half the butter in a frying pan and add mushrooms and garlic.
Cook over moderate heat 5 minutes or until mushrooms begin to soften.
Add thyme, rosemary and white wine and continue to saute another 5 minutes or until liquid evaporates.
Season to taste with salt and freshly ground pepper.
Remove from heat and set aside.
recipes.text: Mushroom And Cheese Omelette. Heat half the butter in a frying pan and add mushrooms and garlic. Cook over moderate heat 5 minutes or until mushrooms begin to soften. Add thyme, rosemary and white wine and continue to saute another 5 minutes or until liquid evaporates. Season to taste with salt and freshly ground pepper. Remove from heat and set aside.

recipes.title: Deer Steak And Gravy
ingredients: mushroom soup or beef mushroom soup or Lipton onion soup mix
directions: Roll deer steaks in flour and brown.
Pour favorite soup over steak.
Add mushrooms. Bake all this in oven until tender.
Salt and pepper to taste.
recipes.text: Deer Steak And Gravy. Roll deer steaks in flour and brown. Pour favorite soup over steak. Add mushrooms. Bake all this in oven until tender. Salt and pepper to taste.

recipes.title: Popcorn Balls
directions: In saucepan, combine sugar, water, corn syrup, salt and butter.
Cook to 250° or until a few drops form a hard ball when dropped into cold water.
Remove from heat.
Stir in vanilla. Pour in a thin stream over popcorn, stirring constantly, to mix well.
Shape with buttered hands.
recipes.text: Popcorn Balls. In saucepan, combine sugar, water, corn syrup, salt and butter. Cook to 250° or until a few drops form a hard ball when dropped into cold water. Remove from heat. Stir in vanilla. Pour in a thin stream over popcorn, stirring constantly, to mix well. Shape with buttered hands.

recipes.title: Barbecued Spareribs
directions: Cut the spareribs into serving pieces and place in a baking pan.
Combine remaining ingredients and pour over the spareribs. Cover.
Bake at 350° until meat of spareribs is tender, turning once.
Makes 6 servings.
recipes.text: Barbecued Spareribs. Cut the spareribs into serving pieces and place in a baking pan. Combine remaining ingredients and pour over the spareribs. Cover. Bake at 350° until meat of spareribs is tender, turning once. Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Broccoli Cornbread
directions: Mix all ingredients together.
Pour into lightly greased pan and bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes.
recipes.text: Broccoli Cornbread. Mix all ingredients together. Pour into lightly greased pan and bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Aunt Martha'S Cheese Squares
directions: Remove crust from bread and cut into 1-inch squares.
In double boiler, melt cheese and margarine.

When creamy, fold in egg whites. Dip cubes into mixture and place on wax paper lined cookie sheet and freeze. When frozen, place in plastic bag and keep in freezer. To serve, bake at 450° for 8 minutes.
recipes.text: Aunt Martha'S Cheese Squares. Remove crust from bread and cut into 1-inch squares. In double boiler, melt cheese and margarine. When creamy, fold in egg whites. Dip cubes into mixture and place on wax paper lined cookie sheet and freeze. When frozen, place in plastic bag and keep in freezer. To serve, bake at 450° for 8 minutes.

recipes.title: Hot Chocolate Mix
ingredients: 1 (25 oz.) pkg. instant nonfat dry milk
1 (16 oz.) pkg. instant chocolate drink powder
directions: Mix all ingredients in large bowl.
Place in large container. Cover tightly.
Place desired amount in cup.
Fill cup with hot water.
Stir well.
recipes.text: Hot Chocolate Mix. Mix all ingredients in large bowl. Place in large container. Cover tightly. Place desired amount in cup. Fill cup with hot water. Stir well.

recipes.title: Squash Or Zucchini Casserole
directions: Melt butter in small baking dish.
Add squash and onion.
Pour mixture over all and bake approximately 45 minutes in 350° oven. Just before removing from oven, sprinkle Parmesan cheese on top.
recipes.text: Squash Or Zucchini Casserole. Melt butter in small baking dish. Add squash and onion. Pour mixture over all and bake approximately 45 minutes in 350° oven. Just before removing from oven, sprinkle Parmesan cheese on top.

recipes.title: Sweet Sour Chicken
directions: In a medium dish, put chicken, veggies and fruit all together. Pour honey and ginger on top.
Put lid on dish.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
Serve over rice.
recipes.text: Sweet Sour Chicken. In a medium dish, put chicken, veggies and fruit all together. Pour honey and ginger on top. Put lid on dish. Bake at 350° for 1 hour. Serve over rice.

recipes.title: Jean'S Tomato Florentine Soup
ingredients: 1 (28 oz.) can whole tomatoes, chopped in blender
1 Tbsp. lemon and pepper seasoning salt
directions: Add all items (except macaroni).
Bring to boil, then simmer for 30 minutes; add shell macaroni and simmer until tender.
Add water if you like a thinner soup or 1 1/2 cups of shell macaroni instead of 2 cups.
recipes.text: Jean'S Tomato Florentine Soup. Add all items (except macaroni). Bring to boil, then simmer for 30 minutes; add shell macaroni and simmer until tender. Add water if you like a thinner soup or 1 1/2 cups of shell macaroni instead of 2 cups.

recipes.title: Tuna Ball
ingredients: a little chopped pimento for color
directions: *Can use 1/2 teaspoon dried minced onions.
recipes.text: Tuna Ball. *Can use 1/2 teaspoon dried minced onions.

recipes.title: Hamburger Stroganoff
directions: Brown meat and add next six ingredients.
Cook until potatoes are done and water gone.
Add sour cream and pour all into 9 x 13-inch casserole dish.
Top with cheese and heat in oven to melt cheese.
recipes.text: Hamburger Stroganoff. Brown meat and add next six ingredients. Cook until potatoes are done and water gone. Add sour cream and pour all into 9 x 13-inch casserole dish. Top with cheese and heat in oven to melt cheese.

recipes.title: Grasshopper Pie
directions: Melt marshmallows in milk, pinch salt in top of double boiler. Let cool and add creme de cocoa and creme de menthe slowly. Whip cream and fold into mixture.
This fills 9-inch chocolate crumb pie crust.
Keep in refrigerator.
It can be frozen.
recipes.text: Grasshopper Pie. Melt marshmallows in milk, pinch salt in top of double boiler. Let cool and add creme de cocoa and creme de menthe slowly. Whip cream and fold into mixture. This fills 9-inch chocolate crumb pie crust. Keep in refrigerator. It can be frozen.

recipes.title: Icebox Fruit Cake
directions: Crumble graham crackers in large bowl.
Mix raisins and pecans in thoroughly.
In double boiler, pour milk and stir in marshmallows until melted, then pour into other mixture.
Then pour in 9 x 12-inch square pan and refrigerate.
recipes.text: Icebox Fruit Cake. Crumble graham crackers in large bowl. Mix raisins and pecans in thoroughly. In double boiler, pour milk and stir in marshmallows until melted, then pour into other mixture. Then pour in 9 x 12-inch square pan and refrigerate.

recipes.title: No-Cook Strawberry Jam
directions: Wash and remove stems from strawberries.
Chop berries one layer at a time.
Measure directed amount and place into a large container.
Mix sugar into fruit and let stand for 10 minutes.
Mix water and Sure-Jell in a saucepan.
Bring to a full boil and boil 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Stir this mixture into the fruit. Stir for 3 minutes.
Pour into glass containers which have been washed and rinsed in boiling water.
Fill to 1/2-inch of tops. Cover at once with tight lids.
Let stand overnight, then store in freezer.
recipes.text: No-Cook Strawberry Jam. Wash and remove stems from strawberries. Chop berries one layer at a time. Measure directed amount and place into a large container. Mix sugar into fruit and let stand for 10 minutes. Mix water and Sure-Jell in a saucepan. Bring to a full boil and boil 1 minute, stirring constantly. Stir this mixture into the fruit. Stir for 3 minutes. Pour into glass containers which have been washed and rinsed in boiling water. Fill to 1/2-inch of tops. Cover at once with tight lids. Let stand overnight, then store in freezer.

recipes.title: Chicken And Rice
directions: Stir flour and salt into butter in a saucepan.
Stir in chicken stock.
Cook until thickened, stirring constantly. Alternate layers of cooked rice, chicken, sauce and vegetables in a greased 2-quart casserole.
Bake in 350° oven for 30 minutes.
I use a whole chicken.
Cook it with water until it falls apart. Let it cool.
Remove the chicken from the bone and use the juice left in the pan for your chicken stock.
You can put a bouillon cube in the stock for more flavor.
This is your father's favorite.
recipes.text: Chicken And Rice. Stir flour and salt into butter in a saucepan. Stir in chicken stock. Cook until thickened, stirring constantly. Alternate layers of cooked rice, chicken, sauce and vegetables in a greased 2-quart casserole. Bake in 350° oven for 30 minutes. I use a whole chicken. Cook it with water until it falls apart. Let it cool. Remove the chicken from the bone and use the juice left in the pan for your chicken stock. You can put a bouillon cube in the stock for more flavor. This is your father's favorite.

recipes.title: Swiss Steak Supreme
ingredients: 2 lb. round or flank steak (1 or 1 1/2-inches thick)
directions: Pound 6 Tbsp. flour into sides of steak.
Brown in hot fat. Add all ingredients.
Cover, cook over simmer heat or in oven until tender.
2 - 2 1/2 hours.
Uncover the last 15 minutes and let sauce thicken.
recipes.text: Swiss Steak Supreme. Pound 6 Tbsp. flour into sides of steak. Brown in hot fat. Add all ingredients. Cover, cook over simmer heat or in oven until tender. 2 - 2 1/2 hours. Uncover the last 15 minutes and let sauce thicken.

recipes.title: Lemon Icebox Pie
directions: Combine sweetened condensed milk with frozen lemonaide.
Stir until mixed well.
Add half tub of cool whip.
Pour into graham cracker crust.
Top with remaining cool whip.
Chill for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Lemon Icebox Pie. Combine sweetened condensed milk with frozen lemonaide. Stir until mixed well. Add half tub of cool whip. Pour into graham cracker crust. Top with remaining cool whip. Chill for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Slaw
directions: Mix and refrigerate until ready to use. Cover.
recipes.text: Slaw. Mix and refrigerate until ready to use. Cover.

recipes.title: Chicken Enchilada Casserole
ingredients: 4 large chicken breasts, chopped and cooked
directions: Mix together milk, salsa and soup.
In baking dish, layer tortilla strips, chicken and sauce; repeat layers.
Bake at 325° for 1 1/2 hours.
recipes.text: Chicken Enchilada Casserole. Mix together milk, salsa and soup. In baking dish, layer tortilla strips, chicken and sauce; repeat layers. Bake at 325° for 1 1/2 hours.

recipes.title: Raw Apple Cake
directions: Mix well and bake in a 350° oven for 40 minutes.
recipes.text: Raw Apple Cake. Mix well and bake in a 350° oven for 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Citrus Cooler Punch
directions: Combine all ingredients into large punch bowl. Let ice cream melt a little before serving.
recipes.text: Citrus Cooler Punch. Combine all ingredients into large punch bowl. Let ice cream melt a little before serving.

recipes.title: Chicken Cacciatore
directions: Heat oil in a large skillet.
Add chicken pieces, brown and set aside.
Add onion, green pepper and garlic; cook until onion is tender.
Force Italian plum tomatoes through a strainer.
Add tomato liquid, parsley, oregano, thyme, salt and pepper to skillet.
Cook over low heat for 15 minutes; stir occasionally.
recipes.text: Chicken Cacciatore. Heat oil in a large skillet. Add chicken pieces, brown and set aside. Add onion, green pepper and garlic; cook until onion is tender. Force Italian plum tomatoes through a strainer. Add tomato liquid, parsley, oregano, thyme, salt and pepper to skillet. Cook over low heat for 15 minutes; stir occasionally.

recipes.title: Oreo Cookie Freeze
directions: Mix the cookies and melted margarine.
Put in a 9 x 13-inch Pyrex dish and freeze.

Add the ice cream to the crust and freeze. Bring to a boil the sugar, vanilla, margarine, milk and chocolate and boil for 1 minute. Add to the ice cream and re-freeze. Add Cool Whip and toasted almonds.
You can freeze Cool Whip but it is better to add almonds just before serving.
recipes.text: Oreo Cookie Freeze. Mix the cookies and melted margarine. Put in a 9 x 13-inch Pyrex dish and freeze. Add the ice cream to the crust and freeze. Bring to a boil the sugar, vanilla, margarine, milk and chocolate and boil for 1 minute. Add to the ice cream and re-freeze. Add Cool Whip and toasted almonds. You can freeze Cool Whip but it is better to add almonds just before serving.

recipes.title: Apple Snow
ingredients: 2 large, sour apples, peeled and grated
directions: Sprinkle the sugar over the apples while grating to keep from turning dark.
Break into this the egg whites; beat in a large bowl as it makes a lot.
Serve on custard, jello, fresh fruit, etc.
recipes.text: Apple Snow. Sprinkle the sugar over the apples while grating to keep from turning dark. Break into this the egg whites; beat in a large bowl as it makes a lot. Serve on custard, jello, fresh fruit, etc.

recipes.title: Poor Man'S Punch
directions: Mix together first 4 ingredients.
Use 1/4 cup mixture, pineapple juice, sugar, ginger ale and water.
recipes.text: Poor Man'S Punch. Mix together first 4 ingredients. Use 1/4 cup mixture, pineapple juice, sugar, ginger ale and water.

recipes.title: Spinach Chicken
directions: Combine cheeses and garlic powder in small bowl.
Add defrosted spinach.
Slice breasts in half.
Fill with mixture. Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes.
recipes.text: Spinach Chicken. Combine cheeses and garlic powder in small bowl. Add defrosted spinach. Slice breasts in half. Fill with mixture. Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Broccoli Cheese Soup
ingredients: 2 qt. chicken stock or 2 qt. water and 4 chicken bouillon cubes
1 lb. fresh broccoli or 1 large bag frozen broccoli cuts
directions: Bring chicken stock to a boil and add celery, onion and broccoli.
Cook until vegetables are tender.
Reduce heat; add milk and cheese.
Make a thickening of the flour and some milk and add to soup until desired consistency.
Do not boil.
recipes.text: Broccoli Cheese Soup. Bring chicken stock to a boil and add celery, onion and broccoli. Cook until vegetables are tender. Reduce heat; add milk and cheese. Make a thickening of the flour and some milk and add to soup until desired consistency. Do not boil.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Nut Loaf
directions: Preheat oven to 350°.
Spray 9 x 5-inch loaf pan with Baker's Joy baking spray.
In medium bowl, combine flour, baking soda, baking powder, salt, cinnamon and nutmeg.
Set aside.
recipes.text: Pumpkin Nut Loaf. Preheat oven to 350°. Spray 9 x 5-inch loaf pan with Baker's Joy baking spray. In medium bowl, combine flour, baking soda, baking powder, salt, cinnamon and nutmeg. Set aside.

recipes.title: Shrimp Pilaf
ingredients: 1/3 c. catsup (double if no chili sauce!)
directions: Mix ingredients and pur over chicken pieces.
Bake 1 to 2 hours (again according to the amount of chicken used).
recipes.text: Shrimp Pilaf. Mix ingredients and pur over chicken pieces. Bake 1 to 2 hours (again according to the amount of chicken used).

recipes.title: Peach Cobbler
directions: Melt oleo in pan. Add peaches.
Beat together milk, sugar and flour.
Pour over peaches.
Bake at 325° for about 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Peach Cobbler. Melt oleo in pan. Add peaches. Beat together milk, sugar and flour. Pour over peaches. Bake at 325° for about 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Ham And Spinach Rolls
ingredients: 1 (10 1/2 oz.) can cream of celery soup
2 Tbsp. dried onion or 1/2 c. minced fresh
directions: Mix soup, sour cream and mustard.
In medium bowl, combine 1/2 of soup mixture, rice, onion, eggs and flour.
Mix well and place 2 tablespoons mixture on each slice of ham.
Roll up and place, seam side down, in baking dish.
(I use Pam first.)
Top with remaining soup mixture and sprinkle with buttered bread crumbs.
recipes.text: Ham And Spinach Rolls. Mix soup, sour cream and mustard. In medium bowl, combine 1/2 of soup mixture, rice, onion, eggs and flour. Mix well and place 2 tablespoons mixture on each slice of ham. Roll up and place, seam side down, in baking dish. (I use Pam first.) Top with remaining soup mixture and sprinkle with buttered bread crumbs.

recipes.title: Knorr Spinach Dip
ingredients: 1 (10 oz.) pkg. frozen spinach, squeezed dry
directions: Mix soup mix, sour cream and mayonnaise until blended.
Stir in spinach, water chestnuts and green onions.
Cover; chill 2 hours.
Stir before serving.
Makes 4 cups.
recipes.text: Knorr Spinach Dip. Mix soup mix, sour cream and mayonnaise until blended. Stir in spinach, water chestnuts and green onions. Cover; chill 2 hours. Stir before serving. Makes 4 cups.

recipes.title: Rice-Broccoli Casserole
ingredients: 3/4 c. each, chopped: celery and onion
1 c. water chestnuts, sliced or chopped
directions: Butter 2 small or 1 large casserole dish (9 x 13 x 2-inch). Mix all ingredients together; pour into casserole dish(es).
This can be prepared and refrigerated overnight.
Bake at 300° for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Rice-Broccoli Casserole. Butter 2 small or 1 large casserole dish (9 x 13 x 2-inch). Mix all ingredients together; pour into casserole dish(es). This can be prepared and refrigerated overnight. Bake at 300° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Tuna Casserole #2
ingredients: 1 small can Durkee French fried onions
directions: Partially fill a large pan with water.
Add peas, celery and onion and bring to a boil.
Add pasta and cook about 10 minutes. Remove from stove and drain.
Pour mixture into a casserole dish. Mix in tuna, soup and cheese well.
Top with more cheese and French fried onions.
recipes.text: Tuna Casserole #2. Partially fill a large pan with water. Add peas, celery and onion and bring to a boil. Add pasta and cook about 10 minutes. Remove from stove and drain. Pour mixture into a casserole dish. Mix in tuna, soup and cheese well. Top with more cheese and French fried onions.

recipes.title: Manhatten Meatballs
directions: Combine meat, bread crumbs, eggs, onions and seasonings.
Mix lightly.
Shape into 1 1/2-inch meatballs.
Brown in margarine, drain.
Place in casserole. Combine preserves and barbecue sauce; pour over meatballs.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes, stirring occasionally. Makes about 5 dozen meatballs.
recipes.text: Manhatten Meatballs. Combine meat, bread crumbs, eggs, onions and seasonings. Mix lightly. Shape into 1 1/2-inch meatballs. Brown in margarine, drain. Place in casserole. Combine preserves and barbecue sauce; pour over meatballs. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes, stirring occasionally. Makes about 5 dozen meatballs.

recipes.title: Broccoli And Cheese
directions: Cook broccoli.
Put on bottom of a greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Cover broccoli with 8 slices of cheese, then put the crushed crackers on top of cheese.
Pour the melted oleo over the crackers.
Cover and bake at 350° for 25 minutes.
recipes.text: Broccoli And Cheese. Cook broccoli. Put on bottom of a greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Cover broccoli with 8 slices of cheese, then put the crushed crackers on top of cheese. Pour the melted oleo over the crackers. Cover and bake at 350° for 25 minutes.

recipes.title: V-8 Soup
ingredients: 1 lb. ground beef or ground turkey
1 c. each any vegetables (about 6 c. total)*
directions: *Green beans, zucchini, corn, peas, celery, carrots, potatoes, broccoli, cabbage.
recipes.text: V-8 Soup. *Green beans, zucchini, corn, peas, celery, carrots, potatoes, broccoli, cabbage.

recipes.title: Macaroni Salad
directions: Cook macaroni, drain, rinse with cold water and drain again. Chop tomato, onion, cucumber, green pepper and egg.
Add to macaroni.
Blend remaining ingredients and pour over salad and mix together.
recipes.text: Macaroni Salad. Cook macaroni, drain, rinse with cold water and drain again. Chop tomato, onion, cucumber, green pepper and egg. Add to macaroni. Blend remaining ingredients and pour over salad and mix together.

recipes.title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
directions: Cream oleo and sugars together.
Add eggs, water and vanilla; beat until fluffy.
Add flour, salt and soda; beat until smooth. Add chocolate chips.
Drop by teaspoon onto floured cookie sheet. Bake at 375° for 12 minutes.
recipes.text: Chocolate Chip Cookies. Cream oleo and sugars together. Add eggs, water and vanilla; beat until fluffy. Add flour, salt and soda; beat until smooth. Add chocolate chips. Drop by teaspoon onto floured cookie sheet. Bake at 375° for 12 minutes.

recipes.title: Broccoli And Rice Casserole
ingredients: 1 pkg. frozen broccoli, chopped and cooked
directions: Mix all ingredients together.
Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes.
recipes.text: Broccoli And Rice Casserole. Mix all ingredients together. Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Lemon-Orange Pound Cake
ingredients: 1 pkg. Duncan Hines yellow cake mix
directions: Blend all ingredients in large mixing bowl.
Beat at medium speed for 2 minutes.
Pour into greased and floured 10-inch tube pan.
Bake at 350° for 50 minutes.
Cake is done when center springs back when touched lightly with finger.
Let cake cool for about 5 minutes.
recipes.text: Lemon-Orange Pound Cake. Blend all ingredients in large mixing bowl. Beat at medium speed for 2 minutes. Pour into greased and floured 10-inch tube pan. Bake at 350° for 50 minutes. Cake is done when center springs back when touched lightly with finger. Let cake cool for about 5 minutes.

recipes.title: Friendship Tea
directions: Store all ingredients dry in airtight container.
To serve, place 1 1/2 tablespoons mix in cup and add 1 cup boiling water. Stir and enjoy.
Makes 50 servings.
recipes.text: Friendship Tea. Store all ingredients dry in airtight container. To serve, place 1 1/2 tablespoons mix in cup and add 1 cup boiling water. Stir and enjoy. Makes 50 servings.

recipes.title: Easy Lemon Icebox Pie
directions: Combine first 3 ingredients well with mixer.
Spoon into pie shell and refrigerate for 2 to 3 hours.
recipes.text: Easy Lemon Icebox Pie. Combine first 3 ingredients well with mixer. Spoon into pie shell and refrigerate for 2 to 3 hours.

recipes.title: Sloppy Joes
directions: Fry hamburger and season with garlic powder and seasoned salt until crumbled.
Drain and discard grease.
With hamburger, add onions and peppers.
Saute for 5 minutes; mix in next ingredients (soup, beer, Worcestershire sauce, oregano, Tabasco sauce and tomatoes).
Reduce heat and simmer 30 minutes (partially covered). Stir occasionally.
Serve open-faced over heated buns.
Sprinkle on cheese.
recipes.text: Sloppy Joes. Fry hamburger and season with garlic powder and seasoned salt until crumbled. Drain and discard grease. With hamburger, add onions and peppers. Saute for 5 minutes; mix in next ingredients (soup, beer, Worcestershire sauce, oregano, Tabasco sauce and tomatoes). Reduce heat and simmer 30 minutes (partially covered). Stir occasionally. Serve open-faced over heated buns. Sprinkle on cheese.

recipes.title: Chipped Beef Dip
ingredients: 1 small jar dried beef, broken into small pieces
directions: Soak first 4 ingredients together.
Combine all ingredients until well blended.
Serve with crackers or chips of choice.
recipes.text: Chipped Beef Dip. Soak first 4 ingredients together. Combine all ingredients until well blended. Serve with crackers or chips of choice.

recipes.title: Quiche
directions: Line bottom of pie pan with asparagus. Beat rest of ingredients and pour over asparagus.
recipes.text: Quiche. Line bottom of pie pan with asparagus. Beat rest of ingredients and pour over asparagus.

recipes.title: Eggs In Toast Cup
directions: Trim crusts from bread.
Brush both sides with melted margarine.
Fit each into large muffin pan.
Toast in oven at 325° for 15 minutes; remove.
Break eggs into each toast cup; season with salt and pepper.
Dot with margarine.
Cover with foil; return to oven and bake for 12 to 15 minutes.
Loosen toast from sides of cups.
Serve with hot bacon or sausage.
recipes.text: Eggs In Toast Cup. Trim crusts from bread. Brush both sides with melted margarine. Fit each into large muffin pan. Toast in oven at 325° for 15 minutes; remove. Break eggs into each toast cup; season with salt and pepper. Dot with margarine. Cover with foil; return to oven and bake for 12 to 15 minutes. Loosen toast from sides of cups. Serve with hot bacon or sausage.

recipes.title: Baked Beans
directions: Mix all ingredients and bake at 350° until done, about 45 minutes to 1 hour.
recipes.text: Baked Beans. Mix all ingredients and bake at 350° until done, about 45 minutes to 1 hour.

recipes.title: Winter Cabbage Salad
ingredients: 2 medium sweet red bell peppers (thinly sliced)
directions: In a saucepan, bring the first six ingredients to a boil. Reduce heat;
simmer, unconvered, for 5 minutes.
Remove from the heat and allow to cool.
recipes.text: Winter Cabbage Salad. In a saucepan, bring the first six ingredients to a boil. Reduce heat; simmer, unconvered, for 5 minutes. Remove from the heat and allow to cool.

recipes.title: Boiled Oatmeal Cookies
directions: Mix sugar, cocoa and milk together in a saucepan.
Boil for 1 to 3 minutes.
Add remaining ingredients.
Drop on cookie sheet or wax paper.
Cool until firm.
recipes.text: Boiled Oatmeal Cookies. Mix sugar, cocoa and milk together in a saucepan. Boil for 1 to 3 minutes. Add remaining ingredients. Drop on cookie sheet or wax paper. Cool until firm.

recipes.title: Three Bean Salad
directions: Combine beans.
Slowly stir vinegar into sugar, blending until smooth.
Add celery seed, oil and onion.
Refrigerate.
recipes.text: Three Bean Salad. Combine beans. Slowly stir vinegar into sugar, blending until smooth. Add celery seed, oil and onion. Refrigerate.

recipes.title: Bernie'S Pepperoni Pizza Dip
ingredients: 1 c. Ragu basil and garlic Pizza Quick sauce
1/2 large green or red sweet pepper
directions: Beat cream cheese, sour cream, Italian seasoning and garlic powder together.
Spread evenly in a 9 or 10-inch pie plate. Spread pizza sauce over top.
Sprinkle with pepperoni, scallions and green or red pepper.
Bake in 350° preheated oven for 10 minutes.
Top with cheese and bake 5 minutes more or until cheese is melted and mixture is heated.
Serve hot with deli-style tortilla chips.
recipes.text: Bernie'S Pepperoni Pizza Dip. Beat cream cheese, sour cream, Italian seasoning and garlic powder together. Spread evenly in a 9 or 10-inch pie plate. Spread pizza sauce over top. Sprinkle with pepperoni, scallions and green or red pepper. Bake in 350° preheated oven for 10 minutes. Top with cheese and bake 5 minutes more or until cheese is melted and mixture is heated. Serve hot with deli-style tortilla chips.

recipes.title: Sweet Potato Casserole
ingredients: 1 c. cream (a can of milk will do)
directions: Beat the eggs in a separate bowl. Combine the ingredients; add to beaten eggs. Place in casserole and bake at 400° for 25 minutes.
recipes.text: Sweet Potato Casserole. Beat the eggs in a separate bowl. Combine the ingredients; add to beaten eggs. Place in casserole and bake at 400° for 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Neiman-Marcus Cookies
directions: Cream together butter, sugar, eggs and vanilla.
Mix together the flour, oatmeal, salt, baking powder and soda; add them to first bowl.
Add the chocolate chips.
Bake on ungreased cookie sheet at 375° for 6 minutes.
recipes.text: Neiman-Marcus Cookies. Cream together butter, sugar, eggs and vanilla. Mix together the flour, oatmeal, salt, baking powder and soda; add them to first bowl. Add the chocolate chips. Bake on ungreased cookie sheet at 375° for 6 minutes.

recipes.title: Oatmeal Butterscotch Brownies
directions: Preheat oven to 375°.
In small bowl, combine flour, baking soda and salt.
In large bowl, combine butter, sugar, brown sugar, eggs and vanilla; beat until light and fluffy.
Gradually add flour mixture.
Stir in oats and butterscotch morsels.
Spread into greased 15 x 10 x 1-inch baking pan*.
Bake at 375° for 20 to 25 minutes.
recipes.text: Oatmeal Butterscotch Brownies. Preheat oven to 375°. In small bowl, combine flour, baking soda and salt. In large bowl, combine butter, sugar, brown sugar, eggs and vanilla; beat until light and fluffy. Gradually add flour mixture. Stir in oats and butterscotch morsels. Spread into greased 15 x 10 x 1-inch baking pan*. Bake at 375° for 20 to 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Three Week Slaw
directions: Mix first 4 ingredients together; let stand while preparing remaining ingredients; bring to a boil.
White hot, pour over cabbage mixture and stir.
This slaw will keep for 3 weeks in the refrigerator.
recipes.text: Three Week Slaw. Mix first 4 ingredients together; let stand while preparing remaining ingredients; bring to a boil. White hot, pour over cabbage mixture and stir. This slaw will keep for 3 weeks in the refrigerator.

recipes.title: Lemon Bars
directions: Mix dry cake mix and pie filling together well.
Add coconut. Bake 20 to 30 minutes at 350° in a jelly roll pan or a 9 x 13-inch pan, if you like them thicker.
recipes.text: Lemon Bars. Mix dry cake mix and pie filling together well. Add coconut. Bake 20 to 30 minutes at 350° in a jelly roll pan or a 9 x 13-inch pan, if you like them thicker.

recipes.title: Irish Soda Bread(From Grandma Bridget Higgins)
directions: Preheat oven to 350°.
Mix eggs, buttermilk and Crisco oil. Set aside.
In a very large bowl, mix dry ingredients and raisins. Pour in buttermilk mixture and stir with wooden spoon.
As mixture gets thick, use bare hands to be sure all ingredients are mixed together well. Equally divide mixture into 3 well buttered bread pans.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
Insert clean toothpick to test for doneness.
If particles cling to toothpick, bake another 10 to 15 minutes.
Wonderful to serve anytime.
recipes.text: Irish Soda Bread(From Grandma Bridget Higgins). Preheat oven to 350°. Mix eggs, buttermilk and Crisco oil. Set aside. In a very large bowl, mix dry ingredients and raisins. Pour in buttermilk mixture and stir with wooden spoon. As mixture gets thick, use bare hands to be sure all ingredients are mixed together well. Equally divide mixture into 3 well buttered bread pans. Bake at 350° for 1 hour. Insert clean toothpick to test for doneness. If particles cling to toothpick, bake another 10 to 15 minutes. Wonderful to serve anytime.

recipes.title: Banana Split Cake
directions: Mix first 2 ingredients together and press into a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Bake in 350° oven for 5 minutes.
Let cool.
Beat sugar, cream cheese, margarine and vanilla until creamy.
Spread on graham cracker crust.
Layer pineapple, then bananas.
Spread Cool Whip on bananas and decorate with cherries and nuts. Refrigerate.
recipes.text: Banana Split Cake. Mix first 2 ingredients together and press into a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake in 350° oven for 5 minutes. Let cool. Beat sugar, cream cheese, margarine and vanilla until creamy. Spread on graham cracker crust. Layer pineapple, then bananas. Spread Cool Whip on bananas and decorate with cherries and nuts. Refrigerate.

recipes.title: Shrimp Salad
ingredients: 10 oz. pkg. frozen peas, thawed and drained
10 oz. pkg. frozen shrimp, thawed and drained
directions: Prepare shells; drain.
Mix shells and next 6 ingredients. In small bowl, mix mayonnaise, horseradish and season salt.
Add to salad mixture; toss.
Cover; chill.
Makes 6 to 8 servings.
recipes.text: Shrimp Salad. Prepare shells; drain. Mix shells and next 6 ingredients. In small bowl, mix mayonnaise, horseradish and season salt. Add to salad mixture; toss. Cover; chill. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

recipes.title: Blender Coconut Pie
directions: Place all ingredients except coconut in blender. Cover and blend 10
seconds. Scrape sides if necessary. Blend 10 more seconds. Pour into a greased 10 in pie plate. Bake at 350° or until a knife inserted in center comes out clean. Serve warm or cold. 6 to 8 servings.
recipes.text: Blender Coconut Pie. Place all ingredients except coconut in blender. Cover and blend 10 seconds. Scrape sides if necessary. Blend 10 more seconds. Pour into a greased 10 in pie plate. Bake at 350° or until a knife inserted in center comes out clean. Serve warm or cold. 6 to 8 servings.

recipes.title: Monkey Bread
directions: Combine cinnamon and 1/2 cup sugar.
Quarter each biscuit. Roll in sugar and cinnamon mixture.
Place in a tube or Bundt pan. Mix margarine, 1/2 cup sugar and vanilla.
Bring to a boil.
Pour over biscuits.
Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.
Turn over on a plate. Pick with fingers and enjoy, as soon as it is cool enough to eat.
recipes.text: Monkey Bread. Combine cinnamon and 1/2 cup sugar. Quarter each biscuit. Roll in sugar and cinnamon mixture. Place in a tube or Bundt pan. Mix margarine, 1/2 cup sugar and vanilla. Bring to a boil. Pour over biscuits. Bake at 350° for 25 minutes. Turn over on a plate. Pick with fingers and enjoy, as soon as it is cool enough to eat.

recipes.title: Mama'S Sweet Potato Puffs
directions: Peel, slice and boil potatoes until tender; drain.
Add sugar, butter and vanilla flavoring.
Mash potatoes.
Set aside until the potatoes are cold.
When cold, mold potatoes around individual marshmallows, covering completely.
Roll each puff in crushed corn flakes.
Place each puff in a buttered 9 x 13-inch baking dish about 1 inch apart.
Heat in oven for about 5 minutes or until marshmallows are hot.
recipes.text: Mama'S Sweet Potato Puffs. Peel, slice and boil potatoes until tender; drain. Add sugar, butter and vanilla flavoring. Mash potatoes. Set aside until the potatoes are cold. When cold, mold potatoes around individual marshmallows, covering completely. Roll each puff in crushed corn flakes. Place each puff in a buttered 9 x 13-inch baking dish about 1 inch apart. Heat in oven for about 5 minutes or until marshmallows are hot.

recipes.title: Sausage Balls
directions: Mix all ingredients and roll into little balls.
Bake 15 to 20 minutes at 350°.
recipes.text: Sausage Balls. Mix all ingredients and roll into little balls. Bake 15 to 20 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Chick-N-Que Sauce
directions: Measure lemon juice or vinegar, water, salt, sugar and Tabasco into saucepan.
Heat to boiling.
Keep hot for basting chicken.
recipes.text: Chick-N-Que Sauce. Measure lemon juice or vinegar, water, salt, sugar and Tabasco into saucepan. Heat to boiling. Keep hot for basting chicken.

recipes.title: Seven Layered Salad
directions: Fill a large bowl with lettuce.
Add other vegetables in layers.
Spread mayonnaise and sprinkle sugar on top.
Cover with cheese and crumbled bacon.
Cover with plastic wrap.
Refrigerate for 8 hours or overnight.
recipes.text: Seven Layered Salad. Fill a large bowl with lettuce. Add other vegetables in layers. Spread mayonnaise and sprinkle sugar on top. Cover with cheese and crumbled bacon. Cover with plastic wrap. Refrigerate for 8 hours or overnight.

recipes.title: Apple Pie (Mom'S)
directions: Mix with cold water.
Put this into a pie shell (top and bottom).
Bake at 350° until done.
recipes.text: Apple Pie (Mom'S). Mix with cold water. Put this into a pie shell (top and bottom). Bake at 350° until done.

recipes.title: Sunday Entree
ingredients: 2 or 3 pork chops or 2 medium pork steaks
1 can Sweet Sue or other chicken and dumplings
directions: Pan-fry pork chops or steaks in water.
Cook until tender. Before meat is half done, toss in a few cauliflower and broccoli flowerets.
Cover and finish cooking meat.
Add only enough water to not scorch.
Turn down heat.
Add chopped bell pepper with flowerets, if you like.
Open up a can of chicken and dumplings. Spoon onto skillet mixture and heat without lid.
Be sure water is almost cooked away before adding dumplings.
Can be served from frying pan or pour into Pyrex dish, spooning meat over into dish first.
Finish in 325° oven for about 20 to 25 minutes to set and brown around edge of dish.
Serve with salad and sliced tomatoes.
recipes.text: Sunday Entree. Pan-fry pork chops or steaks in water. Cook until tender. Before meat is half done, toss in a few cauliflower and broccoli flowerets. Cover and finish cooking meat. Add only enough water to not scorch. Turn down heat. Add chopped bell pepper with flowerets, if you like. Open up a can of chicken and dumplings. Spoon onto skillet mixture and heat without lid. Be sure water is almost cooked away before adding dumplings. Can be served from frying pan or pour into Pyrex dish, spooning meat over into dish first. Finish in 325° oven for about 20 to 25 minutes to set and brown around edge of dish. Serve with salad and sliced tomatoes.

recipes.title: Potato Bacon Soup
ingredients: low-fat or nonfat dairy sour cream (optional)
directions: Spray a 3-quart saucepan with nonstick coating.
Add chopped onions and bacon; cook and stir over medium heat until onions are tender, not brown.
Stir in water and potatoes, bring to boiling and reduce heat.
Cover and simmer 10 to 15 minutes or until potatoes are just tender.
Using a potato masher, slightly mash some of the potatoes.
Stir in evaporated milk, butter seasoning mix, salt and pepper.
Cook and stir over medium heat until heated through.
Do not boil!
Top with sour cream and chives, if desired. Makes 6 servings.
recipes.text: Potato Bacon Soup. Spray a 3-quart saucepan with nonstick coating. Add chopped onions and bacon; cook and stir over medium heat until onions are tender, not brown. Stir in water and potatoes, bring to boiling and reduce heat. Cover and simmer 10 to 15 minutes or until potatoes are just tender. Using a potato masher, slightly mash some of the potatoes. Stir in evaporated milk, butter seasoning mix, salt and pepper. Cook and stir over medium heat until heated through. Do not boil! Top with sour cream and chives, if desired. Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: The Best Fudge Pie
directions: Combine sugar and flour in a large mixing bowl, stirring well. Stir
in
melted butter.
Combine cocoa, water and eggs; beat well.
Pour
into
sugar
mixture,
stirring
well.
Pour mixture into
a buttered 9-inch pie plate.
Bake at 350° for 35 minutes or
until
set.
Garnish
pie with pecan halves.
Cool completely and slice.
Yields 1 (9-inch) pie.
recipes.text: The Best Fudge Pie. Combine sugar and flour in a large mixing bowl, stirring well. Stir in melted butter. Combine cocoa, water and eggs; beat well. Pour into sugar mixture, stirring well. Pour mixture into a buttered 9-inch pie plate. Bake at 350° for 35 minutes or until set. Garnish pie with pecan halves. Cool completely and slice. Yields 1 (9-inch) pie.

recipes.title: Easy Date Nut Bars
ingredients: 1 c. (8 oz.) pkg. dates, finely cut
directions: Mix first 4 ingredients.
Make a well and add in order, oil, eggs and vanilla.
Beat until smooth.
Add dates and nuts.
Mix well.
Turn into greased shallow dish (11 x 7 x 1 1/2-inches).
Cut into bars while warm.
Dust with confectioners sugar.
Bake 30 to 40 minutes at 350°.
Great for the holidays.
recipes.text: Easy Date Nut Bars. Mix first 4 ingredients. Make a well and add in order, oil, eggs and vanilla. Beat until smooth. Add dates and nuts. Mix well. Turn into greased shallow dish (11 x 7 x 1 1/2-inches). Cut into bars while warm. Dust with confectioners sugar. Bake 30 to 40 minutes at 350°. Great for the holidays.

recipes.title: Corn Vegetable Medley
directions: In saucepan, heat milk and soup to boiling.
Stir in raw broccoli, carrots and cauliflower.
Return to boiling.
Cover and cook over low heat for 20 minutes or until vegetables are tender. (Add extra milk, if needed, to keep from boiling dry.)
Stir in Cheddar cheese.
Heat through and serve.
recipes.text: Corn Vegetable Medley. In saucepan, heat milk and soup to boiling. Stir in raw broccoli, carrots and cauliflower. Return to boiling. Cover and cook over low heat for 20 minutes or until vegetables are tender. (Add extra milk, if needed, to keep from boiling dry.) Stir in Cheddar cheese. Heat through and serve.

recipes.title: Flaky Pie Crust
directions: Melt oleo.
Blend in sugar and stir in flour.
Press in pie plate.
Bake at 350° until light brown.
Do not overcook.
recipes.text: Flaky Pie Crust. Melt oleo. Blend in sugar and stir in flour. Press in pie plate. Bake at 350° until light brown. Do not overcook.

recipes.title: Swedish Walnut Cake
directions: Mix all of the ingredients together thoroughly in a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Bake at 350° for approximately 30 minutes (test with toothpick for doneness).
recipes.text: Swedish Walnut Cake. Mix all of the ingredients together thoroughly in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350° for approximately 30 minutes (test with toothpick for doneness).

recipes.title: Strawberries And Cream
directions: Stir the cream cheese and powdered sugar together until smooth to make cream.
(You may want to add more powdered sugar to taste.)
Serve with strawberries.
recipes.text: Strawberries And Cream. Stir the cream cheese and powdered sugar together until smooth to make cream. (You may want to add more powdered sugar to taste.) Serve with strawberries.

recipes.title: Vegetable Dip
directions: Mix and chill until ready for use.
recipes.text: Vegetable Dip. Mix and chill until ready for use.

recipes.title: Chocolate Chip Cookies With Pudding
directions: Combine and bake at 350° for 10 minutes.
For chocolate cookies, use chocolate pudding.
Butter pecan is also good.
recipes.text: Chocolate Chip Cookies With Pudding. Combine and bake at 350° for 10 minutes. For chocolate cookies, use chocolate pudding. Butter pecan is also good.

recipes.title: Fruit Salad
ingredients: 1 (16 oz.) can chunky pineapple or tidbits, drained (save juice)
1 (16 oz.) can lite chunky fruit, drained (discard juice)
1 (13 oz.) pkg. sugar-free instant vanilla pudding mix
directions: Make pudding with pineapple juice, instant pudding and Tang. Slice bananas and add to pudding with fruit.
Chill both fruits before making.
This is good for diabetic diet.
recipes.text: Fruit Salad. Make pudding with pineapple juice, instant pudding and Tang. Slice bananas and add to pudding with fruit. Chill both fruits before making. This is good for diabetic diet.

recipes.title: Hush Puppies
directions: Mix dry ingredients.
Add onion, then milk and beaten egg. Add water until right consistency.
recipes.text: Hush Puppies. Mix dry ingredients. Add onion, then milk and beaten egg. Add water until right consistency.

recipes.title: Hot Fruit Punch
directions: Combine and heat slowly; do not boil!
Makes 20 small or 12 large cups.
recipes.text: Hot Fruit Punch. Combine and heat slowly; do not boil! Makes 20 small or 12 large cups.

recipes.title: Apricot Salad
ingredients: 2 (3 oz.) pkg. or 1 (6 oz.) pkg. apricot Jell-O
directions: Bring to a boil the Jell-O, sugar and water.
Remove from heat and add cream cheese, baby food and pineapple.
Mix thoroughly. Chill bowl and beaters; beat milk until it thickens.
Fold into Jell-O mixture.
Top with ground or chopped nuts.
Chill until firm.
This recipe makes a lot, but it keeps well in refrigerator.
recipes.text: Apricot Salad. Bring to a boil the Jell-O, sugar and water. Remove from heat and add cream cheese, baby food and pineapple. Mix thoroughly. Chill bowl and beaters; beat milk until it thickens. Fold into Jell-O mixture. Top with ground or chopped nuts. Chill until firm. This recipe makes a lot, but it keeps well in refrigerator.

recipes.title: Aw Maw'S Potatoes
ingredients: 2 c. shredded sharp Cheddar cheese, divided
directions: Place potatoes in Dutch oven and cover with water. Bring to boil, reduce heat and simmer for 20 minutes or until tender; drain. Cover and chill. Preheat oven to 350°.
recipes.text: Aw Maw'S Potatoes. Place potatoes in Dutch oven and cover with water. Bring to boil, reduce heat and simmer for 20 minutes or until tender; drain. Cover and chill. Preheat oven to 350°.

recipes.title: Zippy Fruit Salad
directions: Other fresh fruit may be added.
Combine all fruits and set aside.
Mix well; 2 tablespoons sugar, orange juice, lime juice and melon liqueur.
Pour over the fruit and chill one hour. Serves 6.
recipes.text: Zippy Fruit Salad. Other fresh fruit may be added. Combine all fruits and set aside. Mix well; 2 tablespoons sugar, orange juice, lime juice and melon liqueur. Pour over the fruit and chill one hour. Serves 6.

recipes.title: Easy Enchiladas
ingredients: 1 can cream of mushroom soup or chicken
directions: Preheat oven to 350°.
In a large bowl, combine chicken, soup, olives, green chilies and sour cream.
Add 1/2 cup enchilada sauce.
Mix thoroughly. Spread mixture evenly in each tortilla. Roll.
Continue procedure with each tortilla.
Place in baking dish.
Cover with remaining enchilada sauce.
Spread Jack cheese evenly over enchiladas.
Cover with foil and bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until cheese is completely melted.
Serve with refried beans and small salad.
ner: cream of mushroom soup or chicken
recipes.text: Easy Enchiladas. Preheat oven to 350°. In a large bowl, combine chicken, soup, olives, green chilies and sour cream. Add 1/2 cup enchilada sauce. Mix thoroughly. Spread mixture evenly in each tortilla. Roll. Continue procedure with each tortilla. Place in baking dish. Cover with remaining enchilada sauce. Spread Jack cheese evenly over enchiladas. Cover with foil and bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until cheese is completely melted. Serve with refried beans and small salad.

recipes.title: Light And Fruity Pie(Diabetic)
ingredients: 1 (4 serving size) pkg. Jell-O brand gelatin (sugar-free)
1 c. diced strawberries, orange sections, banana or fresh peaches
directions: Dissolve gelatin completely in boiling water.
Add ice cubes; stir until gelatin is thickened.
Remove any unmelted ice.
Using wire whip, blend in whipped topping; whip until smooth.
Fold in fruit.
Chill, if necessary, until mixture will mound.
Spoon into pie crust.
Chill 2 hours.
Serve.
recipes.text: Light And Fruity Pie(Diabetic). Dissolve gelatin completely in boiling water. Add ice cubes; stir until gelatin is thickened. Remove any unmelted ice. Using wire whip, blend in whipped topping; whip until smooth. Fold in fruit. Chill, if necessary, until mixture will mound. Spoon into pie crust. Chill 2 hours. Serve.

recipes.title: Macaroni And Crabmeat
directions: Boil macaroni.
Wash with cold water.
Let it chill before mixing.
Mix macaroni with crabmeat and other ingredients.
Serve.
recipes.text: Macaroni And Crabmeat. Boil macaroni. Wash with cold water. Let it chill before mixing. Mix macaroni with crabmeat and other ingredients. Serve.

recipes.title: Potato Salad
directions: Blend salad oil, vinegar, salt and pepper.
Pour over hot potatoes; toss, then let cool.
Add celery, onion, eggs, olives, pickles, pimentos and mayonnaise.
Toss and refrigerate.
recipes.text: Potato Salad. Blend salad oil, vinegar, salt and pepper. Pour over hot potatoes; toss, then let cool. Add celery, onion, eggs, olives, pickles, pimentos and mayonnaise. Toss and refrigerate.

recipes.title: Marie'S Stuffed Eggs
directions: Boil your eggs.
Cool and half.
Use yolks for something else or throw away.
Mix ingredients.
Stuff eggs.
Garnish with parsley (dried or fresh).
recipes.text: Marie'S Stuffed Eggs. Boil your eggs. Cool and half. Use yolks for something else or throw away. Mix ingredients. Stuff eggs. Garnish with parsley (dried or fresh).

recipes.title: St. Paul'S Rice
ingredients: 2 large envelopes chicken noodle soup mix
directions: In large skillet, brown sausage, pepper, onion and celery. Drain and set aside.
In saucepan, combine rice, soup mix and water.
Bring to boil and cook 7 minutes.
Combine sausage mixture, rice mixture and almonds.
Pour into 2-quart casserole dish.
Top with cheese, if desired.
Cover tightly and bake at 350° for 1 hour.
Serves 8 to 10.
recipes.text: St. Paul'S Rice. In large skillet, brown sausage, pepper, onion and celery. Drain and set aside. In saucepan, combine rice, soup mix and water. Bring to boil and cook 7 minutes. Combine sausage mixture, rice mixture and almonds. Pour into 2-quart casserole dish. Top with cheese, if desired. Cover tightly and bake at 350° for 1 hour. Serves 8 to 10.

recipes.title: 5 Cup Fruit Salad
directions: Cut oranges into small chunks.
Add other ingredients.
Mix well.
Refrigerate and serve.
recipes.text: 5 Cup Fruit Salad. Cut oranges into small chunks. Add other ingredients. Mix well. Refrigerate and serve.

recipes.title: Glazed Butternut Squash
directions: Cut squash into 3-inch pieces.
Pare and parboil until tender; drain.
Place in shallow baking pan.
Heat remaining ingredients, pour over squash.
Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes, basting with syrup until glazed.
Makes 6 servings.
recipes.text: Glazed Butternut Squash. Cut squash into 3-inch pieces. Pare and parboil until tender; drain. Place in shallow baking pan. Heat remaining ingredients, pour over squash. Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes, basting with syrup until glazed. Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Korean Spinach Salad
directions: Mix first 6 ingredients in blender.
Arrange spinach, bacon, mushrooms, red onion, mandarin oranges and grapes in bowl.
Pour some of dressing over.
Refrigerate rest of dressing for another salad.
Stores well.
recipes.text: Korean Spinach Salad. Mix first 6 ingredients in blender. Arrange spinach, bacon, mushrooms, red onion, mandarin oranges and grapes in bowl. Pour some of dressing over. Refrigerate rest of dressing for another salad. Stores well.

recipes.title: Chicken And Biscuit Dinner
ingredients: 1 1/2 c. chopped, cooked chicken or turkey
1 (12 oz.) jar chicken or turkey gravy
1 c. frozen green beans or peas
directions: Preheat oven to 350°.
Cut each biscuit into half.
In saucepan, put chicken or turkey, gravy, beans, seasoning and pepper.
Cook and stir until bubbly.
This can be baked in a casserole or individual baking cups.
Spoon into dishes and top with three biscuit pieces on each casserole.
Bake 15 to 18 minutes until biscuits are golden.
This is a fun recipe for kids to do.
recipes.text: Chicken And Biscuit Dinner. Preheat oven to 350°. Cut each biscuit into half. In saucepan, put chicken or turkey, gravy, beans, seasoning and pepper. Cook and stir until bubbly. This can be baked in a casserole or individual baking cups. Spoon into dishes and top with three biscuit pieces on each casserole. Bake 15 to 18 minutes until biscuits are golden. This is a fun recipe for kids to do.

recipes.title: Rolls
directions: Mix dry ingredients with water, oil and egg.
Will keep in refrigerator for a week.
Bake at 475°.
recipes.text: Rolls. Mix dry ingredients with water, oil and egg. Will keep in refrigerator for a week. Bake at 475°.

recipes.title: Wanda'S Wonder Cobbler
directions: Melt margarine in a 2-quart bowl.
Add pie filling.
In separate bowl, mix sugar and flour together.
Add egg; mix until crumbly.
Sprinkle on top of fruit.
Bake for 30 minutes at 350° or until brown.
recipes.text: Wanda'S Wonder Cobbler. Melt margarine in a 2-quart bowl. Add pie filling. In separate bowl, mix sugar and flour together. Add egg; mix until crumbly. Sprinkle on top of fruit. Bake for 30 minutes at 350° or until brown.

recipes.title: Deer Stew
directions: Cook ground deer meat.
Cover potatoes, carrots, onion and butter with water.
Let boil.
Cook for 10 to 15 minutes.
Add tomatoes, corn, cooked meat, macaroni and paprika.
Cook for approximately 20 to 25 minutes.
Serves about 8.
recipes.text: Deer Stew. Cook ground deer meat. Cover potatoes, carrots, onion and butter with water. Let boil. Cook for 10 to 15 minutes. Add tomatoes, corn, cooked meat, macaroni and paprika. Cook for approximately 20 to 25 minutes. Serves about 8.

recipes.title: The Best Homemade Ice Cream(No Cholesterol)
directions: Separate eggs.	Beat egg whites stiff. Beat egg yolks (Egg Beaters) until lemon colored.
recipes.text: The Best Homemade Ice Cream(No Cholesterol). Separate eggs.	Beat egg whites stiff. Beat egg yolks (Egg Beaters) until lemon colored.

recipes.title: Popeye'S Biscuits
directions: Mix ingredients together.
May spread flour on outside to make it easier to roll out and cut.
Melt 1/2 stick of oleo in a baking pan.
Cover with 1/2 stick melted oleo.
Bake at 425° until done.
recipes.text: Popeye'S Biscuits. Mix ingredients together. May spread flour on outside to make it easier to roll out and cut. Melt 1/2 stick of oleo in a baking pan. Cover with 1/2 stick melted oleo. Bake at 425° until done.

recipes.title: Squash Casserole
directions: Mix in greased casserole dish all ingredients except the crumbs; sprinkle them on top and bake until brown at 350°.
recipes.text: Squash Casserole. Mix in greased casserole dish all ingredients except the crumbs; sprinkle them on top and bake until brown at 350°.

recipes.title: Crescent Chicken Squares
directions: Blend the cream cheese and margarine until smooth.
To this mixture, add chicken, salt, pepper, milk and chopped onion and mix well.
Separate the crescent rolls into 8 rectangles.
Spoon 1/2 cup chicken mixture into each rectangle and pinch together.
Bake in 350° oven for 20 to 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Crescent Chicken Squares. Blend the cream cheese and margarine until smooth. To this mixture, add chicken, salt, pepper, milk and chopped onion and mix well. Separate the crescent rolls into 8 rectangles. Spoon 1/2 cup chicken mixture into each rectangle and pinch together. Bake in 350° oven for 20 to 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Musemandeln(Tiny Almonds)
directions: Beat together eggs and sugar until light and fluffy.
Add melted butter and blend.
Add flour and baking powder which have been sifted together.
Blend well.
Add rum.
recipes.text: Musemandeln(Tiny Almonds). Beat together eggs and sugar until light and fluffy. Add melted butter and blend. Add flour and baking powder which have been sifted together. Blend well. Add rum.

recipes.title: Corn Pudding
directions: Combine eggs, flour and sugar; beat well.
Add milk, corn and salt.
Melt margarine in baking dish (flat) and add corn mixture. Bake at 375° for 45 to 60 minutes or until brown.
recipes.text: Corn Pudding. Combine eggs, flour and sugar; beat well. Add milk, corn and salt. Melt margarine in baking dish (flat) and add corn mixture. Bake at 375° for 45 to 60 minutes or until brown.

recipes.title: Frosted Salad
directions: Dissolve gelatin in boiling water.
Stir in soda.
Chill until partly set.
Fold in pineapple, marshmallows, and bananas. Chill.
Serve with topping.
recipes.text: Frosted Salad. Dissolve gelatin in boiling water. Stir in soda. Chill until partly set. Fold in pineapple, marshmallows, and bananas. Chill. Serve with topping.

recipes.title: Santa'S Thumbprints
directions: Preheat oven to 350°.
Beat Crisco and sugar until fluffy. Beat in egg and vanilla.
Add combined oats, flour and salt.
Mix well.
Form 1 inch balls and roll in nuts.
Place 2 inches apart on ungreased cookie sheet.
Press centers with thumb and fill with preserves.
Bake for 12 to 15 minutes or until golden brown.
Cool completely.
Yields 4 1/2 dozen.
recipes.text: Santa'S Thumbprints. Preheat oven to 350°. Beat Crisco and sugar until fluffy. Beat in egg and vanilla. Add combined oats, flour and salt. Mix well. Form 1 inch balls and roll in nuts. Place 2 inches apart on ungreased cookie sheet. Press centers with thumb and fill with preserves. Bake for 12 to 15 minutes or until golden brown. Cool completely. Yields 4 1/2 dozen.

recipes.title: Squash Casserole
ingredients: 2 (16 oz.) pkg. frozen sliced yellow squash
1 (.4 oz.) envelope buttermilk style Ranch dressing mix
directions: Cook squash with onion according to directions on squash package, omitting salt.
Drain well, pressing between paper towels to remove excess liquid.
Combine squash mixture, mayonnaise and next 4 ingredients in a lightly greased 2-quart shallow casserole dish.
Combine bread crumbs and butter; sprinkle over top.
Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes.
Yields 8 servings.
recipes.text: Squash Casserole. Cook squash with onion according to directions on squash package, omitting salt. Drain well, pressing between paper towels to remove excess liquid. Combine squash mixture, mayonnaise and next 4 ingredients in a lightly greased 2-quart shallow casserole dish. Combine bread crumbs and butter; sprinkle over top. Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes. Yields 8 servings.

recipes.title: Lime Jello Salad
ingredients: 1 small pkg. lime jello (regular or sugar-free)
directions: Heat applesauce to boiling hot.
Sprinkle jello on applesauce and stir until dissolved.
Remove from heat; add ginger ale and blend well.
Pour into individual molds or one larger mold.
recipes.text: Lime Jello Salad. Heat applesauce to boiling hot. Sprinkle jello on applesauce and stir until dissolved. Remove from heat; add ginger ale and blend well. Pour into individual molds or one larger mold.

recipes.title: Bundt Coffee Cake
directions: Combine cake mix, pudding mix, oil, vanilla, butter flavoring, water and eggs in large mixer bowl.
Beat at high speed of mixer for 8 minutes.
Grease and flour Bundt pan.
Sprinkle 1/4 cup chopped pecans in bottom of pan.
Combine remaining 1/2 cup pecans with the sugar and cinnamon.
Pour a thin layer of cake batter over the pecans in the pan.
Sprinkle some of nut mixture over batter. Alternate batter and nut mixture, ending with batter on top.
Bake at 350° for 50 to 60 minutes.
Cool on rack for 8 minutes.
Remove from pan and pour glaze over cake.
recipes.text: Bundt Coffee Cake. Combine cake mix, pudding mix, oil, vanilla, butter flavoring, water and eggs in large mixer bowl. Beat at high speed of mixer for 8 minutes. Cool on rack for 8 minutes. Remove from pan and pour glaze over cake.

recipes.title: Chocolate Syrup Pound Cake
directions: Cream the butter and Crisco. Add chocolate syrup and sugar. Beat until smooth. Add eggs, one at a time, and continue to beat. Combine sifted flour and baking powder alternately with milk. Stir in vanilla.
Pour into a greased and floured tube pan. Start in a cold oven. Bake 1 hour and 30 minutes at 325°. Cover with Chocolate Cream Cheese Icing.
recipes.text: Chocolate Syrup Pound Cake. Cream the butter and Crisco. Add chocolate syrup and sugar. Beat until smooth. Add eggs, one at a time, and continue to beat. Combine sifted flour and baking powder alternately with milk. Stir in vanilla. Pour into a greased and floured tube pan. Start in a cold oven. Bake 1 hour and 30 minutes at 325°. Cover with Chocolate Cream Cheese Icing.

recipes.title: Salsa
ingredients: 6 very ripe tomatoes or 2 large cans tomatoes
directions: Blend all ingredients except spices in food processor.
Pour into large mixing bowl and add spices.
Pour up into jars and store in refrigerator.
Serve for dipping with taco chips.
recipes.text: Salsa. Blend all ingredients except spices in food processor. Pour into large mixing bowl and add spices. Pour up into jars and store in refrigerator. Serve for dipping with taco chips.

recipes.title: Low-Fat French Toast
ingredients: 4 to 6 slices whole wheat bread or oat bran
directions: You will also need Pam spray.
recipes.text: Low-Fat French Toast. You will also need Pam spray.

recipes.title: Red Beans And Rice
directions: In a large pot filled 3/4 full of water, add beans and cook until water is below bean level.
In a large skillet, saute onion, garlic, sausage and ham until the onion is translucent.
Put ingredients in pot with beans. Refill pot with hot water and cook until the water has turned into a thick gravy.
Season with salt and pepper.
Cook rice separately.
Serve red beans over the rice.
recipes.text: Red Beans And Rice. In a large pot filled 3/4 full of water, add beans and cook until water is below bean level. In a large skillet, saute onion, garlic, sausage and ham until the onion is translucent. Put ingredients in pot with beans. Refill pot with hot water and cook until the water has turned into a thick gravy. Season with salt and pepper. Cook rice separately. Serve red beans over the rice.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Cake #2
directions: Mix all ingredients.
Grease and flour four 1 pound coffee cans; fill all cans half full and bake 10 minutes at 350°; then lower oven temperature to 250° for 1 1/2 hours.
recipes.text: Pumpkin Cake #2. Mix all ingredients. Grease and flour four 1 pound coffee cans; fill all cans half full and bake 10 minutes at 350°; then lower oven temperature to 250° for 1 1/2 hours.

recipes.title: Taco Dip
directions: Brown and drain ground beef.
Combine with taco seasoning and refried beans and spread in a baking dish.
Combine sour cream and taco sauce and spread on top of beef/bean mixture.
Top with grated cheese and bake at 350° until bubbly (approximately 30 minutes).
Serve with taco chips.
recipes.text: Taco Dip. Brown and drain ground beef. Combine with taco seasoning and refried beans and spread in a baking dish. Combine sour cream and taco sauce and spread on top of beef/bean mixture. Top with grated cheese and bake at 350° until bubbly (approximately 30 minutes). Serve with taco chips.

recipes.title: Fruit Cream Cheese Pie
directions: Blend Eagle brand condensed milk and lemon juice. Beat cream cheese until smooth, add egg yolks, one at a time beating well. Add fruit and mix gently. Fold into Eagle brand mixture. Pour into cool pastry shell. Beat egg whites until stiff. Gradually add sugar and beat until peaked and stiff. Pile egg whites on pie filling. Bake in slow oven (325°) 15 minutes or until light brown.
recipes.text: Fruit Cream Cheese Pie. Blend Eagle brand condensed milk and lemon juice. Beat cream cheese until smooth, add egg yolks, one at a time beating well. Add fruit and mix gently. Fold into Eagle brand mixture. Pour into cool pastry shell. Beat egg whites until stiff. Gradually add sugar and beat until peaked and stiff. Pile egg whites on pie filling. Bake in slow oven (325°) 15 minutes or until light brown.

recipes.title: Creamy Low-Fat Potato Salad
ingredients: 2 Tbsp. finely chopped fresh tarragon or 2 tsp. dried, crumbled
1/2 small green or red bell pepper, diced or matchstick strips
directions: Cook potatoes in medium saucepan of boiling salted water until tender, about 25 minutes. Drain and cool.
Cut potatoes into squares.
Whisk yogurt, mustard and tarragon in large bowl until blended.
Add potatoes, bell pepper, green onions and celery; toss.
Season with salt and pepper.
Cover and chill well, about 3 hours (can be prepared one day ahead).
recipes.text: Creamy Low-Fat Potato Salad. Cook potatoes in medium saucepan of boiling salted water until tender, about 25 minutes. Drain and cool. Cut potatoes into squares. Whisk yogurt, mustard and tarragon in large bowl until blended. Add potatoes, bell pepper, green onions and celery; toss. Season with salt and pepper. Cover and chill well, about 3 hours (can be prepared one day ahead).

recipes.title: Non-Dairy Ciambellone
directions: Beat eggs and sugar.
Add oil.
Add 1/2 of flour and 1/2 of white grape juice and beat well.
Add salt, baking powder, anise and lemon juice and rind.
Mix well.
Slowly add the rest of the flour and grape juice and beat.
recipes.text: Non-Dairy Ciambellone. Beat eggs and sugar. Add oil. Add 1/2 of flour and 1/2 of white grape juice and beat well. Add salt, baking powder, anise and lemon juice and rind. Mix well. Slowly add the rest of the flour and grape juice and beat.

recipes.title: Norwegian Parsley Potatoes
directions: Cook potatoes in boiling, salted water for 15 minutes or until tender.
Cool slightly.
With sharp knife, remove one narrow strip of skin around the middle of each potato.
recipes.text: Norwegian Parsley Potatoes. Cook potatoes in boiling, salted water for 15 minutes or until tender. Cool slightly. With sharp knife, remove one narrow strip of skin around the middle of each potato.

recipes.title: Ladyfingers
directions: Mix well by hand and form small rolls. Bake on greased sheet at 350° for 20 minutes or until delicately browned.
While hot, roll in cane sugar.
Makes 3 dozen.
recipes.text: Ladyfingers. Mix well by hand and form small rolls. Bake on greased sheet at 350° for 20 minutes or until delicately browned. While hot, roll in cane sugar. Makes 3 dozen.

recipes.title: California Granola
ingredients: 2 1/4 c. quick or old fashioned oats, uncooked
1/2 c. wheat germ or unprocessed bran
directions: Heat oven to 325°.
In large bowl, combine all ingredients, except raisins and mix well.
Spread onto ungreased 15 x 10-inch jelly roll pan.
Bake 30 to 35 minutes or until golden brown, stirring occasionally.
Stir in raisins.
Spread onto ungreased cookie sheet or aluminum foil; cool.
Store in tightly covered container in refrigerator.
Serves as a snack or as cereal with milk.
Makes about 8 cups.
recipes.text: California Granola. Heat oven to 325°. In large bowl, combine all ingredients, except raisins and mix well. Spread onto ungreased 15 x 10-inch jelly roll pan. Bake 30 to 35 minutes or until golden brown, stirring occasionally. Stir in raisins. Spread onto ungreased cookie sheet or aluminum foil; cool. Store in tightly covered container in refrigerator. Serves as a snack or as cereal with milk. Makes about 8 cups.

recipes.title: Eggplant Casserole
directions: Cook eggplant 5 to 10 minutes or until tender, drain off water.
Mix all ingredients together with eggplant.
Pour into greased one-quart casserole dish or baking pan.
Bake at 425° approximately 30 minutes.
Cut cheese while eggplant is cooking and put a little grease on top of casserole before baking.
If larger portion is desired, double recipe.
recipes.text: Eggplant Casserole. Cook eggplant 5 to 10 minutes or until tender, drain off water. Mix all ingredients together with eggplant. Pour into greased one-quart casserole dish or baking pan. Bake at 425° approximately 30 minutes. Cut cheese while eggplant is cooking and put a little grease on top of casserole before baking. If larger portion is desired, double recipe.

recipes.title: Brownie Mix
directions: In large bowl, combine flour, baking powder, salt, sugar and cocoa; with a pastry blender, cut in shortening until evenly distributed.
Store in large container.
It doesn't have to be refrigerated.
Keeps 10 to 12 weeks and yields 17 cups mix.
recipes.text: Brownie Mix. In large bowl, combine flour, baking powder, salt, sugar and cocoa; with a pastry blender, cut in shortening until evenly distributed. Store in large container. It doesn't have to be refrigerated. Keeps 10 to 12 weeks and yields 17 cups mix.

recipes.title: Beef Stroganoff
ingredients: 1 lb. round steak, cut in 1 x 1 1/2-inch strips
directions: Mix together flour, salt, pepper and paprika in plastic bag or a bowl.
Cut up meat into strips.
Shake or roll meat strips in flour mix.
Heat canola oil in frypan or Dutch oven.
Fry steak strips until nice and brown.
Add onion.
Cook until golden color.
Stir in flour remaining from flouring meat.
Add consomme, water and mushrooms.
Cover and simmer 1 1/2 hours.
Add 1/2 cup sour cream and chives. Heat thoroughly but do not boil.
Serve over cooked wide noodles or rice.
Yields 4 to 6 servings.
recipes.text: Beef Stroganoff. Mix together flour, salt, pepper and paprika in plastic bag or a bowl. Cut up meat into strips. Shake or roll meat strips in flour mix. Heat canola oil in frypan or Dutch oven. Fry steak strips until nice and brown. Add onion. Cook until golden color. Stir in flour remaining from flouring meat. Add consomme, water and mushrooms. Cover and simmer 1 1/2 hours. Add 1/2 cup sour cream and chives. Heat thoroughly but do not boil. Serve over cooked wide noodles or rice. Yields 4 to 6 servings.

recipes.title: Candied Shredded Wheat
directions: Put biscuits in pie pan, pizza pan or cookie sheet.
Spread butter or margarine on top of each biscuit.
Put brown sugar over butter or margarine and melt both into biscuit with a small amount of hot water.
Cover with foil and place on stove burner or in oven until well steamed, about 3 to 5 minutes.
Kids love them and so do I.
recipes.text: Candied Shredded Wheat. Put biscuits in pie pan, pizza pan or cookie sheet. Spread butter or margarine on top of each biscuit. Put brown sugar over butter or margarine and melt both into biscuit with a small amount of hot water. Cover with foil and place on stove burner or in oven until well steamed, about 3 to 5 minutes. Kids love them and so do I.

recipes.title: Broccoli And Dressing Casserole
directions: Preheat oven to 350°.
Cook broccoli as directed and drain. Mix soup with milk.
Bring water to boiling; add dressing mix and cut margarine.
Mix.
In 1 1/2-quart casserole, layer broccoli, soup mixture and dressing mixture.
Repeat.
Top with shredded cheese (optional).
Bake for 15 to 20 minutes.
recipes.text: Broccoli And Dressing Casserole. Preheat oven to 350°. Cook broccoli as directed and drain. Mix soup with milk. Bring water to boiling; add dressing mix and cut margarine. Mix. In 1 1/2-quart casserole, layer broccoli, soup mixture and dressing mixture. Repeat. Top with shredded cheese (optional). Bake for 15 to 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Rotini Feta Salad
ingredients: 1 (14 oz.) can artichoke hearts, drained and quartered
directions: Place water in a 3-quart microwavable casserole.
Cover with lid.
Microwave on High for 7 minutes or until water boils.
Stir in pasta and re-cover.
Stirring midway through cooking, microwave on High for 6 to 8 minutes or until done.
Drain and cool slightly. Return pasta to same casserole and toss with dressing.
Stir in remaining ingredients.
Serve.
recipes.text: Rotini Feta Salad. Place water in a 3-quart microwavable casserole. Cover with lid. Microwave on High for 7 minutes or until water boils. Stir in pasta and re-cover. Stirring midway through cooking, microwave on High for 6 to 8 minutes or until done. Drain and cool slightly. Return pasta to same casserole and toss with dressing. Stir in remaining ingredients. Serve.

recipes.title: Yeast Biscuits
directions: Place warm water in bowl; add yeast and sugar.
Let set 10 minutes.
Blend flour, dry milk, baking powder and salt in mixer bowl.
Cut shortening into flour mixture.
Add yeast mixture and knead lightly.
Roll out as for biscuits; cut in rounds.
Place on greased pans and let rise 30 minutes.
Bake in 425° oven about 15 minutes, or until brown.
recipes.text: Yeast Biscuits. Place warm water in bowl; add yeast and sugar. Let set 10 minutes. Blend flour, dry milk, baking powder and salt in mixer bowl. Cut shortening into flour mixture. Add yeast mixture and knead lightly. Roll out as for biscuits; cut in rounds. Place on greased pans and let rise 30 minutes. Bake in 425° oven about 15 minutes, or until brown.

recipes.title: Hot Cocoa Mix
directions: Mix all together and store in Tupperware.
Use 1 1/2 teaspoons for a cup.
Stores well.
Good keeper.
recipes.text: Hot Cocoa Mix. Mix all together and store in Tupperware. Use 1 1/2 teaspoons for a cup. Stores well. Good keeper.

recipes.title: Creamy Shrimp Over Rice
directions: Finely chop onion, bell pepper and celery.
Saute this in butter.
Add soup and milk to this and heat on low setting.
Add sour cream, finely chopped tomatoes and shrimp.
Continue to stir over low heat for about 10 minutes until well heated and tomato bits are tender.
Season to taste with salt and pepper.
Serve over rice.
recipes.text: Creamy Shrimp Over Rice. Finely chop onion, bell pepper and celery. Saute this in butter. Add soup and milk to this and heat on low setting. Add sour cream, finely chopped tomatoes and shrimp. Continue to stir over low heat for about 10 minutes until well heated and tomato bits are tender. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Serve over rice.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Fudge
directions: Boil first three ingredients for 2 minutes; add peanut butter and Marshmallow Creme.
Put in a buttered pan.
Cut after cooling.
recipes.text: Peanut Butter Fudge. Boil first three ingredients for 2 minutes; add peanut butter and Marshmallow Creme. Put in a buttered pan. Cut after cooling.

recipes.title: Kitty'S Best Cake
directions: Bake cake as directed on box.
Let cool.
Punch holes with fork.
Cook pineapple and sugar together for 15 minutes.
Pour over cake after cooling.
Make pudding as directed on box.
Spread over cake and pineapple.
Add coconut and nuts.
Chill overnight.
recipes.text: Kitty'S Best Cake. Bake cake as directed on box. Let cool. Punch holes with fork. Cook pineapple and sugar together for 15 minutes. Pour over cake after cooling. Make pudding as directed on box. Spread over cake and pineapple. Add coconut and nuts. Chill overnight.

recipes.title: Snickerdoodles
directions: Cream together butter and sugar.
Add eggs and milk.
Sift and add flour and baking soda.
Drop by spoonfuls onto greased baking sheet.
Sprinkle with a mixture of sugar and cinnamon before baking.
Bake at 350° for 8 minutes or less.
recipes.text: Snickerdoodles. Cream together butter and sugar. Add eggs and milk. Sift and add flour and baking soda. Drop by spoonfuls onto greased baking sheet. Sprinkle with a mixture of sugar and cinnamon before baking. Bake at 350° for 8 minutes or less.

recipes.title: Diabetic Jello Salad
ingredients: 1 large box orange sugar free jello
1 small can frozen orange juice, thawed
1 small can pineapple with own juice (no sugar)
directions: Mix all together.
Pour in 9 x 13-inch dish or pan; refrigerate until set.
recipes.text: Diabetic Jello Salad. Mix all together. Pour in 9 x 13-inch dish or pan; refrigerate until set.

recipes.title: Single Crust
directions: Sift flour before measuring.
Combine flour and salt in a mixing bowl.

With a pastry blender or two knives, cut in shortening until uniform; mixture should be fairly coarse. Sprinkle with water, a tablespoon at a time; toss with a fork. Work dough into a firm ball with your hands.
Roll under to make a double thickness of dough into pie pan.
Fold under to make double thickness of dough around rim and flute with fingers or fork. Prick crust with fork and bake in
preheated 400° oven for 10 minutes or lightly brown.
recipes.text: Single Crust. Sift flour before measuring. Combine flour and salt in a mixing bowl. With a pastry blender or two knives, cut in shortening until uniform; mixture should be fairly coarse. Sprinkle with water, a tablespoon at a time; toss with a fork. Work dough into a firm ball with your hands. Roll under to make a double thickness of dough into pie pan. Fold under to make double thickness of dough around rim and flute with fingers or fork. Prick crust with fork and bake in preheated 400° oven for 10 minutes or lightly brown.

recipes.title: Irish Soda Bread
directions: Mix dry ingredients. Add buttermilk and mix well.
Knead lightly on floured board.
Shape into 1 round of 7-inches.
Place on lightly oiled baking sheet. Mark top with a cross.
Bake in top 1/3 of the oven at 400° for 45 minutes or until bottom sounds hollow.
recipes.text: Irish Soda Bread. Mix dry ingredients. Add buttermilk and mix well. Knead lightly on floured board. Shape into 1 round of 7-inches. Place on lightly oiled baking sheet. Mark top with a cross. Bake in top 1/3 of the oven at 400° for 45 minutes or until bottom sounds hollow.

recipes.title: Bread Dip
ingredients: 2 pkg. pressed meat (i.e., pastrami and ham), chopped fine
directions: Make hole in top of bread and scoop out inside of loaf.
Tear into bite size pieces.
Put mayonnaise mixture into center of loaf and dip bread.
Enjoy!
recipes.text: Bread Dip. Make hole in top of bread and scoop out inside of loaf. Tear into bite size pieces. Put mayonnaise mixture into center of loaf and dip bread. Enjoy!

recipes.title: Stromboli Sandwiches
directions: Brown together the ground beef and onion.
Pour off fat.
Add rest of ingredients to ground beef.
Slice 6 Kaiser rolls.
(Can use hamburger buns instead.)
Butter the top and bottom of each roll.
Sprinkle a little garlic powder and paprika on each roll. Add meat mixture to each bottom roll and a slice of Mozzarella cheese.
Replace roll tops and wrap in Reynold's Wrap.
Heat in 350° oven for about 15 minutes.
Recipe can be frozen, then heat about 25 to 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Stromboli Sandwiches. Brown together the ground beef and onion. Pour off fat. Add rest of ingredients to ground beef. Slice 6 Kaiser rolls. (Can use hamburger buns instead.) Butter the top and bottom of each roll. Sprinkle a little garlic powder and paprika on each roll. Add meat mixture to each bottom roll and a slice of Mozzarella cheese. Replace roll tops and wrap in Reynold's Wrap. Heat in 350° oven for about 15 minutes. Recipe can be frozen, then heat about 25 to 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Million Dollar Pie
ingredients: 1 (15 oz.) can crushed pineapple with juice
directions: Mix all together.
Pour into two baked pie shells. Refrigerate at least 4 hours before serving.
The longer refrigerated the better it is.
recipes.text: Million Dollar Pie. Mix all together. Pour into two baked pie shells. Refrigerate at least 4 hours before serving. The longer refrigerated the better it is.

recipes.title: Crumb Cake
directions: In a mixing bowl, combine sugar, flour and salt.
Cut in butter until mixture resembles a coarse meal.
Remove 1 cup of mixture and combine with cinnamon and nuts; set aside.
To remaining crumb mixture, add milk and baking powder.
Spread into a greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan.
Sprinkle the reserved crumb topping over batter.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until cake tests done.
Cut into squares.
Garnish with whipped topping and a pecan half, if desired.
Yields 12 to 16 servings.
recipes.text: Crumb Cake. In a mixing bowl, combine sugar, flour and salt. Cut in butter until mixture resembles a coarse meal. Remove 1 cup of mixture and combine with cinnamon and nuts; set aside. To remaining crumb mixture, add milk and baking powder. Spread into a greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan. Sprinkle the reserved crumb topping over batter. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until cake tests done. Cut into squares. Garnish with whipped topping and a pecan half, if desired. Yields 12 to 16 servings.

recipes.title: Poor Man'S Crab Imperial
ingredients: 1 c. each onion, celery and chopped pepper
directions: Saute onion, celery and pepper.
Mix with crabmeat and mayonnaise.
Spread 3/4 bread mixture over.
Add rest of bread on top.
Mix eggs and milk.
Pour over all.
Bake 15 minutes at 350°. Remove from oven.
Spread undiluted soup over.
Spread grated cheese.
Bake 45 minutes at 325°.
Serves 6 to 8.
recipes.text: Poor Man'S Crab Imperial. Saute onion, celery and pepper. Mix with crabmeat and mayonnaise. Spread 3/4 bread mixture over. Add rest of bread on top. Mix eggs and milk. Pour over all. Bake 15 minutes at 350°. Remove from oven. Spread undiluted soup over. Spread grated cheese. Bake 45 minutes at 325°. Serves 6 to 8.

recipes.title: Mexican Dip
ingredients: 3/4 lb. ground beef, sauteed and drained
directions: In glass pie plate, layer beans, meat and onion.
Top with chilies, cheese and taco sauce.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes. When cool, garnish with guacamole, sour cream and olives.
Serve with corn chips.
recipes.text: Mexican Dip. In glass pie plate, layer beans, meat and onion. Top with chilies, cheese and taco sauce. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes. When cool, garnish with guacamole, sour cream and olives. Serve with corn chips.

recipes.title: Oreo Dirt Dessert
ingredients: 1 large pkg. instant vanilla pudding mix
directions: Mix together and chill, milk and pudding mix. Separate the filling of the cookies. Crush the cookies and set aside. Mix together chilled pudding, cookie middles, cream cheese and Cool Whip. Starting with cookie crumbs, layer in a 9 x 13 pan. Chill and serve.
