recipes.text: Oreo Dirt Dessert. Mix together and chill, milk and pudding mix. Separate the filling of the cookies. Crush the cookies and set aside. Mix together chilled pudding, cookie middles, cream cheese and Cool Whip. Starting with cookie crumbs, layer in a 9 x 13 pan. Chill and serve.

recipes.title: Hot Rice Beef
ingredients: 1 lb. ground beef or sirloin, cubed
directions: Fry ground beef with onions.
Cook beef, onions, bouillon and celery with soups and hot water.
Wash rice in cold water and dry. Add to other ingredients.
Rice is uncooked.
Bake about 1 hour in 350° oven.
recipes.text: Hot Rice Beef. Fry ground beef with onions. Cook beef, onions, bouillon and celery with soups and hot water. Wash rice in cold water and dry. Add to other ingredients. Rice is uncooked. Bake about 1 hour in 350° oven.

recipes.title: Cornbread Dressing
directions: Brown bacon and remove.
Saute onion and celery in bacon drippings.
Add this to crumbled cornbread.
Dilute soup with one can of water.
Add melted margarine, poultry seasoning and pepper to soup.
Bring just to boil, stirring to blend.
Pour soup over cornbread mixture.
Add eggs.
Stir until all is mixed thoroughly. Butter an 8 x 8-inch pan.
Place cornbread dressing into pan. Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes.
recipes.text: Cornbread Dressing. Brown bacon and remove. Saute onion and celery in bacon drippings. Add this to crumbled cornbread. Dilute soup with one can of water. Add melted margarine, poultry seasoning and pepper to soup. Bring just to boil, stirring to blend. Pour soup over cornbread mixture. Add eggs. Stir until all is mixed thoroughly. Butter an 8 x 8-inch pan. Place cornbread dressing into pan. Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Turkey Meat Loaf
directions: Mix turkey and poultry seasoning.
Add egg, catsup, soy sauce, Worcestershire sauce, cracker crumbs, salt and pepper.
recipes.text: Turkey Meat Loaf. Mix turkey and poultry seasoning. Add egg, catsup, soy sauce, Worcestershire sauce, cracker crumbs, salt and pepper.

recipes.title: Chocolate Covered Peanut Butter Balls
ingredients: 1 c. peanut butter, chunky or plain
directions: Cream butter.
Add crumbs, vanilla, sugar and mix.
Stir in peanut butter.
Shape into small balls.
Refrigerate 1 hour or until hard.
Melt chocolate.
Dip each ball in chocolate.
Place on foil or waxed paper.
Refrigerate again or freeze.
recipes.text: Chocolate Covered Peanut Butter Balls. Cream butter. Add crumbs, vanilla, sugar and mix. Stir in peanut butter. Shape into small balls. Refrigerate 1 hour or until hard. Melt chocolate. Dip each ball in chocolate. Place on foil or waxed paper. Refrigerate again or freeze.

recipes.title: Chicken Spaghetti
directions: Cook spaghetti. Combine all ingredients (reserving 1/2 cheese). Place in casserole; top with cheese. Heat at 350° until hot and bubbly. Serves 10.
recipes.text: Chicken Spaghetti. Cook spaghetti. Combine all ingredients (reserving 1/2 cheese). Place in casserole; top with cheese. Heat at 350° until hot and bubbly. Serves 10.

recipes.title: 24 Hour Salad
ingredients: 3/4 c. crumbled bacon or bacon bits
directions: Use trifle bowl and layer all ingredients, starting with lettuce on bottom, then onion slices, peas, celery and bell pepper (all colors if desired), then bacon.
Take one cup mayonnaise; smooth across top to seal.
Sprinkle mayonnaise with 1 teaspoon sugar and grated Parmesan cheese, if desired.
Cover and chill 24 hours; toss just before serving.
recipes.text: 24 Hour Salad. Use trifle bowl and layer all ingredients, starting with lettuce on bottom, then onion slices, peas, celery and bell pepper (all colors if desired), then bacon. Take one cup mayonnaise; smooth across top to seal. Sprinkle mayonnaise with 1 teaspoon sugar and grated Parmesan cheese, if desired. Cover and chill 24 hours; toss just before serving.

recipes.title: Lemon Jack Jello Salad
ingredients: 1 c. (or more as desired) Jack cheese, grated
directions: Dissolve Jell-O according to package.
Add drained pineapple, bananas (sliced) and marshmallows.
Set until firm in 9 x 13-inch pan.
recipes.text: Lemon Jack Jello Salad. Dissolve Jell-O according to package. Add drained pineapple, bananas (sliced) and marshmallows. Set until firm in 9 x 13-inch pan.

recipes.title: Company Chicken(Serves 6)
directions: Cook noodles, celery, onion and green pepper together until tender.
Drain.
Mix in all other ingredients.
Turn into greased casserole dish.
Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes.
recipes.text: Company Chicken(Serves 6). Cook noodles, celery, onion and green pepper together until tender. Drain. Mix in all other ingredients. Turn into greased casserole dish. Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Surprise Bars
ingredients: 1 (14 oz.) can Eagle Brand condensed sweetened milk
directions: Preheat oven to 350° (325° for glass dish).
Melt butter in 13 x 9-inch pan, sprinkle crumbs over butter.
Pour milk evenly over crumbs.
Sprinkle with chips, coconut and walnuts, evenly on top. Bake 25 to 30 minutes or until lightly browned.
recipes.text: Surprise Bars. Preheat oven to 350° (325° for glass dish). Melt butter in 13 x 9-inch pan, sprinkle crumbs over butter. Pour milk evenly over crumbs. Sprinkle with chips, coconut and walnuts, evenly on top. Bake 25 to 30 minutes or until lightly browned.

recipes.title: Sweet And Sour Meatball Bake
directions: Combine egg, wheat germ, soy sauce, garlic powder and pepper. Add pork and mix well.
Shape into 24 meatballs.
Spray large skillet with Pam.
Add meatballs and cook over medium heat until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Drain on paper towels.
recipes.text: Sweet And Sour Meatball Bake. Combine egg, wheat germ, soy sauce, garlic powder and pepper. Add pork and mix well. Shape into 24 meatballs. Spray large skillet with Pam. Add meatballs and cook over medium heat until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes. Drain on paper towels.

recipes.title: Seedless Blackberry Dumplings
directions: *If using flour, add 2 teaspoons baking powder and 1/2 cup butter or oil.
recipes.text: Seedless Blackberry Dumplings. *If using flour, add 2 teaspoons baking powder and 1/2 cup butter or oil.

recipes.title: Play Dough
directions: Mix flour and alum together in a bowl.
Set aside.
Heat remaining ingredients to boiling.
Stir liquids into dry ingredients.
Knead until smooth.
Store in an airtight container.
recipes.text: Play Dough. Mix flour and alum together in a bowl. Set aside. Heat remaining ingredients to boiling. Stir liquids into dry ingredients. Knead until smooth. Store in an airtight container.

recipes.title: 24 Hour Vegetable Salad
ingredients: 1 lb. bacon, fried crisp and crumbled
directions: In bottom of large bowl place 1/2 of vegetables.
Sprinkle sugar, salt and pepper over all.
Layer 1/2 of eggs over vegetables.
Place remaining vegetables over eggs.
Sprinkle sugar, salt and pepper over vegetables.
Add cheese and bacon and layer eggs on top.
Spread mayonnaise or salad dressing over top, sealing to edge of bowl.
Cover and refrigerate 24 hours or overnight.
Garnish with sliced green onions and paprika if desired.
Toss before serving.
Makes 12 to 15 servings.
recipes.text: 24 Hour Vegetable Salad. In bottom of large bowl place 1/2 of vegetables. Sprinkle sugar, salt and pepper over all. Layer 1/2 of eggs over vegetables. Place remaining vegetables over eggs. Sprinkle sugar, salt and pepper over vegetables. Add cheese and bacon and layer eggs on top. Spread mayonnaise or salad dressing over top, sealing to edge of bowl. Cover and refrigerate 24 hours or overnight. Garnish with sliced green onions and paprika if desired. Toss before serving. Makes 12 to 15 servings.

recipes.title: Jalapeno Cornbread
ingredients: 1 (7 oz.) jar jalapeno relish (use only 1/2 can)
directions: Heat 10-inch cast-iron skillet in 400° oven for five minutes. Combine all ingredients, stirring until moistened.
Remove skillet from oven and coat with vegetable cooking spray.
Pour batter into hot skillet.
Bake at 400° for 25 minutes or until done.
recipes.text: Jalapeno Cornbread. Heat 10-inch cast-iron skillet in 400° oven for five minutes. Combine all ingredients, stirring until moistened. Remove skillet from oven and coat with vegetable cooking spray. Pour batter into hot skillet. Bake at 400° for 25 minutes or until done.

recipes.title: Easy Banana Pudding
ingredients: 2 (3 oz.) boxes instant vanilla pudding mix
directions: Mix pudding with milk.
Beat 2 minutes; add Eagle Brand milk. Mix well.
Add Cool Whip and mix well.
Layer ingredients in bowl, starting with the crackers, then pudding, then bananas.
recipes.text: Easy Banana Pudding. Mix pudding with milk. Beat 2 minutes; add Eagle Brand milk. Mix well. Add Cool Whip and mix well. Layer ingredients in bowl, starting with the crackers, then pudding, then bananas.

recipes.title: Fresh Apple Cake
directions: Put sugar over the apples; let stand for 20 minutes.
Mix oil and egg; sift flour, soda and salt and add to oil mixture.
Add apples and nuts; mix well.
Bake in a preheated 325° oven for 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Fresh Apple Cake. Put sugar over the apples; let stand for 20 minutes. Mix oil and egg; sift flour, soda and salt and add to oil mixture. Add apples and nuts; mix well. Bake in a preheated 325° oven for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Cheese Drop Biscuits
directions: Mix cheese, shortening and eggs.
Add remaining ingredients, blending thoroughly.
Drop onto greased cookie sheet.
Biscuits should be the size of small walnuts.
Bake about 15 minutes or until golden brown in a 425° oven.
recipes.text: Cheese Drop Biscuits. Mix cheese, shortening and eggs. Add remaining ingredients, blending thoroughly. Drop onto greased cookie sheet. Biscuits should be the size of small walnuts. Bake about 15 minutes or until golden brown in a 425° oven.

recipes.title: Cheese Rolls
directions: Put all through a food grinder.
Let stand to room temperature; work together with hands.
Roll into rolls in paprika or chili powder.
Roll in pecans.
Put in refrigerator.
Serve sliced.
recipes.text: Cheese Rolls. Put all through a food grinder. Let stand to room temperature; work together with hands. Roll into rolls in paprika or chili powder. Roll in pecans. Put in refrigerator. Serve sliced.

recipes.title: Meatballs In Spicy Sauce
directions: Mix and form meatballs.
Place in 9 x 11 pan.
recipes.text: Meatballs In Spicy Sauce. Mix and form meatballs. Place in 9 x 11 pan.

recipes.title: Artichoke Dip
ingredients: 1 (8 oz.) can non marinated artichoke hearts
directions: Drain artichoke hearts and chop in small pieces.
Add remaining ingredients.
(Add Tabasco only if you like spicy dip and mix.)
Put in 1-quart casserole dish or large pie plate.
Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.
Serve warm with crackers or chips.
recipes.text: Artichoke Dip. Drain artichoke hearts and chop in small pieces. Add remaining ingredients. (Add Tabasco only if you like spicy dip and mix.) Put in 1-quart casserole dish or large pie plate. Bake at 350° for 25 minutes. Serve warm with crackers or chips.

recipes.title: Crepes
directions: You will need small Teflon pan.
recipes.text: Crepes. You will need small Teflon pan.

recipes.title: Deep Dish Apple Pie
directions: Roll half of pastry; put in deep dish pie plate.
Combine sugar, flour, cinnamon, allspice and salt.
Add sugar mixture to apples; toss to coat apples.
Put apple mixture in pastry-lined dish; dot with butter.
Adjust top crust.
Seal and flute edge. Cover edges with foil.
Bake at 375° for 30 minutes.
Remove foil; bake for 25 minutes more (until crust is golden).
recipes.text: Deep Dish Apple Pie. Roll half of pastry; put in deep dish pie plate. Combine sugar, flour, cinnamon, allspice and salt. Add sugar mixture to apples; toss to coat apples. Put apple mixture in pastry-lined dish; dot with butter. Adjust top crust. Seal and flute edge. Cover edges with foil. Bake at 375° for 30 minutes. Remove foil; bake for 25 minutes more (until crust is golden).

recipes.title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
ingredients: 1 (12 oz.) pkg. (2 c.) Nestle Toll House morsels
directions: Preheat oven to 375°.
In a small bowl, combine butter, sugar, brown sugar and vanilla.
Beat until creamy.
Beat in eggs. Gradually add flour mixture.
Mix well.
Stir in morsels and nuts. Spread into greased 15 x 10 x 1-inch baking pan.
Bake for 20 minutes.
Cool; cut into 35 (2-inch) squares.
recipes.text: Chocolate Chip Cookies. Preheat oven to 375°. In a small bowl, combine butter, sugar, brown sugar and vanilla. Beat until creamy. Beat in eggs. Gradually add flour mixture. Mix well. Stir in morsels and nuts. Spread into greased 15 x 10 x 1-inch baking pan. Bake for 20 minutes. Cool; cut into 35 (2-inch) squares.

recipes.title: Cheesy Squash Casserole
directions: Cook squash and onion 15 minutes.
Add all other ingredients and mix well.
Bake in buttered casserole for 1 hour at 300°.
recipes.text: Cheesy Squash Casserole. Cook squash and onion 15 minutes. Add all other ingredients and mix well. Bake in buttered casserole for 1 hour at 300°.

recipes.title: Microwave Fruit Compote
directions: Drain fruit and combine in baking dish.
Make sauce by combining 1/2 cup pineapple syrup, 1/2 cup apricot syrup, 1/2 cup syrup from peaches along with brown sugar and butter.
Microwave for 5 to 6 minutes on High, stirring to dissolve sugar.
Mix cornstarch with 1/2 cup liquid from drained fruit and add to fruit to thicken.
Add cinnamon and flavoring and pour over fruit and microwave for 10 to 15 minutes on High.
Serves 6.
recipes.text: Microwave Fruit Compote. Drain fruit and combine in baking dish. Make sauce by combining 1/2 cup pineapple syrup, 1/2 cup apricot syrup, 1/2 cup syrup from peaches along with brown sugar and butter. Microwave for 5 to 6 minutes on High, stirring to dissolve sugar. Mix cornstarch with 1/2 cup liquid from drained fruit and add to fruit to thicken. Add cinnamon and flavoring and pour over fruit and microwave for 10 to 15 minutes on High. Serves 6.

recipes.title: Baked Grits
directions: Cook grits in salted water for 8 minutes.
Add remaining ingredients and bake in casserole for 1 hour at 300°.
Sprinkle top with margarine and paprika.
recipes.text: Baked Grits. Cook grits in salted water for 8 minutes. Add remaining ingredients and bake in casserole for 1 hour at 300°. Sprinkle top with margarine and paprika.

recipes.title: Easy Creamed Chicken
directions: Remove skin and bones from chicken; dice.
Saute celery, green pepper and onion in butter in a heavy skillet.
Add chicken and remaining ingredients; mix thoroughly.
Cook on low heat, stirring frequently, for 30 minutes. Serve on rice or noodles.
recipes.text: Easy Creamed Chicken. Remove skin and bones from chicken; dice. Saute celery, green pepper and onion in butter in a heavy skillet. Add chicken and remaining ingredients; mix thoroughly. Cook on low heat, stirring frequently, for 30 minutes. Serve on rice or noodles.

recipes.title: Beef Bourguignon
ingredients: 8 lb. meat (stew or chuck), cut into 1-1/2-inch cubes
directions: Cut meat and roll in flour.
Brown on all sides in half butter and olive oil.
Add salt and pepper.
Pour in 3 ounces warm Brandy and light.
Put in casserole dish.
recipes.text: Beef Bourguignon. Cut meat and roll in flour. Brown on all sides in half butter and olive oil. Add salt and pepper. Pour in 3 ounces warm Brandy and light. Put in casserole dish.

recipes.title: Skillet Pizza
directions: Use electric skillet at 375° or stove top skillet on high, greased.
Mix crust as directed.
Put crust into skillet.
Turn to medium heat.
Add sauce and seasonings, then add toppings.
Cook 15 minutes or until crust is brown and cheese is melted.
recipes.text: Skillet Pizza. Use electric skillet at 375° or stove top skillet on high, greased. Mix crust as directed. Put crust into skillet. Turn to medium heat. Add sauce and seasonings, then add toppings. Cook 15 minutes or until crust is brown and cheese is melted.

recipes.title: Strawberry Delight
ingredients: 1 qt. strawberries, sliced and covered with sugar
directions: Break cake into pieces and line 9 x 13-inch pan.
Mix cream cheese and sugar.
Mix Dream Whip according to directions and add cream cheese mixture; mix well.
Spread over cake.
Top with strawberries and glaze; keep in refrigerator.
recipes.text: Strawberry Delight. Break cake into pieces and line 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix cream cheese and sugar. Mix Dream Whip according to directions and add cream cheese mixture; mix well. Spread over cake. Top with strawberries and glaze; keep in refrigerator.

recipes.title: Halloween Treats(Easy Kid Recipe)
directions: Heat together the sugar and milk in a 2-quart saucepan.
Boil 3 minutes.
Remove from heat and add peanut butter, then add vanilla and crackers.
Mix well.
Cool.
Form into 1-inch balls. Makes 34.
recipes.text: Halloween Treats(Easy Kid Recipe). Heat together the sugar and milk in a 2-quart saucepan. Boil 3 minutes. Remove from heat and add peanut butter, then add vanilla and crackers. Mix well. Cool. Form into 1-inch balls. Makes 34.

recipes.title: Seafood Casserole
directions: Cream soup, mayonnaise and eggs together.
Fold in rest of ingredients, except bread crumbs and cheese.
Place in well-greased 9 x 12-inch Pyrex casserole dish.
Bake at 375° for 1 hour.
Add crumbs and cheese the last 15 minutes or baking time.
recipes.text: Seafood Casserole. Cream soup, mayonnaise and eggs together. Fold in rest of ingredients, except bread crumbs and cheese. Place in well-greased 9 x 12-inch Pyrex casserole dish. Bake at 375° for 1 hour. Add crumbs and cheese the last 15 minutes or baking time.

recipes.title: Walnut Torte
directions: Beat egg yolks and sugar until thick and lemon colored. Sift flour and baking powder.
Add slowly with chopped nuts to egg mixture.
Add vanilla;
beat egg whites until stiff.
Fold into first
mixture.
Bake
in
two well-greased 9-inch round pans at 350° for 10 to 15 minutes.	Cool and remove.
Ice with Custard Frosting.
recipes.text: Walnut Torte. Beat egg yolks and sugar until thick and lemon colored. Sift flour and baking powder. Add slowly with chopped nuts to egg mixture. Add vanilla; beat egg whites until stiff. Fold into first mixture. Bake in two well-greased 9-inch round pans at 350° for 10 to 15 minutes.	Cool and remove. Ice with Custard Frosting.

recipes.title: Bisquick Raspberry Swirl
directions: Heat oven to 375°.
Mix Bisquick, sugar and butter until crumbly.
Press in 13 x 9-inch pan.
Bake 10 minutes.
Cool.
recipes.text: Bisquick Raspberry Swirl. Heat oven to 375°. Mix Bisquick, sugar and butter until crumbly. Press in 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake 10 minutes. Cool.

recipes.title: Chocolate Cake
directions: Mix all ingredients by hand.
Bake in a tube or Bundt pan at 375° for 40 minutes.
recipes.text: Chocolate Cake. Mix all ingredients by hand. Bake in a tube or Bundt pan at 375° for 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Cranberry Salad
directions: Grind cranberries; add sugar.
Let stand for several hours. Dissolve Jell-O in water and cool.
Add to cranberries.
Grind celery and nuts and add with pineapple to Jell-O mixture.
Keeps for at least 2 weeks in refrigerator.
recipes.text: Cranberry Salad. Grind cranberries; add sugar. Let stand for several hours. Dissolve Jell-O in water and cool. Add to cranberries. Grind celery and nuts and add with pineapple to Jell-O mixture. Keeps for at least 2 weeks in refrigerator.

recipes.title: Freezer Coleslaw
ingredients: 1 tsp. each: celery and mustard seed
directions: Combine vegetables with salt.
Let stand 1 hour.
Place remaining ingredients in pan.
Boil for 1 minute.
Cool; drain vegetables.
Add to vinegar mixture.
Stir gently.
Put in containers and freeze.
To use, defrost and serve chilled.
recipes.text: Freezer Coleslaw. Combine vegetables with salt. Let stand 1 hour. Place remaining ingredients in pan. Boil for 1 minute. Cool; drain vegetables. Add to vinegar mixture. Stir gently. Put in containers and freeze. To use, defrost and serve chilled.

recipes.title: Banana Coconut Crunch
directions: While beating egg whites, add sugar and beat until stiff. Crush vanilla wafers.
Add to egg whites along with coconut, nuts, salt and vanilla.
Spread into a well-buttered, large pie plate. Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.
Cool.
Slice 1 or 2 bananas on top and add Cool Whip.
Chill.
recipes.text: Banana Coconut Crunch. While beating egg whites, add sugar and beat until stiff. Crush vanilla wafers. Add to egg whites along with coconut, nuts, salt and vanilla. Spread into a well-buttered, large pie plate. Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes. Cool. Slice 1 or 2 bananas on top and add Cool Whip. Chill.

recipes.title: Potato Casserole
ingredients: 4 or 5 lb. potatoes (enough to fill a 9 x 13-inch pan)
directions: Dice and boil the potatoes with the skins on. While they are boiling, melt the cheese in the microwave. Mix the mayonnaise in the cheese.
Put the boiled potatoes in the 9 x 13-inch pan and add salt and pepper.
Pour in the cheese and mayonnaise. Sprinkle with bacon bits and bake at 350° for 1 hour. Add onions and green onions for extra flavor.
recipes.text: Potato Casserole. Dice and boil the potatoes with the skins on. While they are boiling, melt the cheese in the microwave. Mix the mayonnaise in the cheese. Put the boiled potatoes in the 9 x 13-inch pan and add salt and pepper. Pour in the cheese and mayonnaise. Sprinkle with bacon bits and bake at 350° for 1 hour. Add onions and green onions for extra flavor.

recipes.title: Aried Green Plantains(Dominican Republic Style)
directions: Peel plantains and cut in round pieces, 1-inch long.
Place oil in skillet and heat until very warm.
Place plantains round in oil. When oil is boiling, reduce heat and cook for a few minutes, until plantains are well cooked and begin to change from yellow to golden.
Remove plantains from oil.
With the bottom of a glass, smash each piece of plantain into cookie shape.
Turn heat to high and place plantains in oil.
Let them brown until golden.
Strain and place on paper towel.
Sprinkle with salt.
recipes.text: Aried Green Plantains(Dominican Republic Style). Peel plantains and cut in round pieces, 1-inch long. Place oil in skillet and heat until very warm. Place plantains round in oil. When oil is boiling, reduce heat and cook for a few minutes, until plantains are well cooked and begin to change from yellow to golden. Remove plantains from oil. With the bottom of a glass, smash each piece of plantain into cookie shape. Turn heat to high and place plantains in oil. Let them brown until golden. Strain and place on paper towel. Sprinkle with salt.

recipes.title: Buttermilk Coffee Cake(No Eggs - Crumb)
directions: Sift flour, sugar, 1/2 teaspoon cinnamon, baking powder and salt into bowl.
Cut butter with pastry blender or two knives until mixture is crumbly.
Reserve 1/2 cup crumbs and to this add 1 teaspoon cinnamon, set aside.
Dissolve baking soda in buttermilk.
Add buttermilk and vanilla to remaining crumb mixture, stirring just enough to moisten (by hand).
Spread batter in greased 8-inch square pan.
Sprinkle crumb mixture over and bake at 375° for 30 to 35 minutes.
Can double recipe and bake in a 9 x 13-inch pan.
recipes.text: Buttermilk Coffee Cake(No Eggs - Crumb). Sift flour, sugar, 1/2 teaspoon cinnamon, baking powder and salt into bowl. Cut butter with pastry blender or two knives until mixture is crumbly. Reserve 1/2 cup crumbs and to this add 1 teaspoon cinnamon, set aside. Dissolve baking soda in buttermilk. Add buttermilk and vanilla to remaining crumb mixture, stirring just enough to moisten (by hand). Spread batter in greased 8-inch square pan. Sprinkle crumb mixture over and bake at 375° for 30 to 35 minutes. Can double recipe and bake in a 9 x 13-inch pan.

recipes.title: Egg Salad
directions: Mix together in pan eggs, flour, butter, vinegar and sugar; cook until thick, stirring constantly.
Remove from heat.
Add cream cheese and mix well.
Add evaporated milk and put in chopped onion.
Add cut up eggs and mix.
recipes.text: Egg Salad. Mix together in pan eggs, flour, butter, vinegar and sugar; cook until thick, stirring constantly. Remove from heat. Add cream cheese and mix well. Add evaporated milk and put in chopped onion. Add cut up eggs and mix.

recipes.title: Marvelous Carrot Cake
directions: Preheat oven to 350°.
In an electric mixer bowl combine carrots, eggs, sugar and oil.
Beat until well mixed.
Add remaining ingredients and beat well.
Pour into 2 oiled and floured 9-inch pans.
Bake 40 to 45 minutes.
Cool layers.
Frost.
recipes.text: Marvelous Carrot Cake. Preheat oven to 350°. In an electric mixer bowl combine carrots, eggs, sugar and oil. Beat until well mixed. Add remaining ingredients and beat well. Pour into 2 oiled and floured 9-inch pans. Bake 40 to 45 minutes. Cool layers. Frost.

recipes.title: Jezebel Sauce
directions: Serve over cream cheese with crackers.
Keep in refrigerator. Will last a long time.
recipes.text: Jezebel Sauce. Serve over cream cheese with crackers. Keep in refrigerator. Will last a long time.

recipes.title: Oatmeal Cookies
directions: Beat together Crisco, flour, eggs and both sugars.
Add remaining ingredients mixing well.
Bake on ungreased cookie sheets.
Make cookies with a tablespoon measuring spoon.
Bake at 375° for 8 to 10 minutes.
Enjoy!!
recipes.text: Oatmeal Cookies. Beat together Crisco, flour, eggs and both sugars. Add remaining ingredients mixing well. Bake on ungreased cookie sheets. Make cookies with a tablespoon measuring spoon. Bake at 375° for 8 to 10 minutes. Enjoy!!

recipes.title: Vegetable Dip
ingredients: 2 tsp. each: seasoned salt, chives, dill weed and parsley flakes
directions: Mix mayonnaise and sour cream together.
Stir in the seasonings (crush to make finer).
Mix thoroughly.
Chill.
Makes 2 cups.
recipes.text: Vegetable Dip. Mix mayonnaise and sour cream together. Stir in the seasonings (crush to make finer). Mix thoroughly. Chill. Makes 2 cups.

recipes.title: Lamb Sauce For Lamb On The Rod
directions: Put in blender and blend until foamy.
Can add pepper rings.
recipes.text: Lamb Sauce For Lamb On The Rod. Put in blender and blend until foamy. Can add pepper rings.

recipes.title: Miss Edna'S Roasted Potatoes
ingredients: 7 white potatoes, quartered lengthwise (peeled or unpeeled)
directions: Mix all ingredients together, except potatoes.
recipes.text: Miss Edna'S Roasted Potatoes. Mix all ingredients together, except potatoes.

recipes.title: Greek Burger
directions: In a medium bowl mix beef, onion, lemon juice, oregano, garlic powder, salt and black pepper (overmixing can cause toughness). Shape into patties.
recipes.text: Greek Burger. In a medium bowl mix beef, onion, lemon juice, oregano, garlic powder, salt and black pepper (overmixing can cause toughness). Shape into patties.

recipes.title: Corn Fritters
directions: Pour corn liquid into a bowl; add egg and biscuit mix, stirring until smooth.
Fold in corn and drop by spoonful into hot grease.
Fry until golden.
Serve with honey.
Serves 6.
recipes.text: Corn Fritters. Pour corn liquid into a bowl; add egg and biscuit mix, stirring until smooth. Fold in corn and drop by spoonful into hot grease. Fry until golden. Serve with honey. Serves 6.

recipes.title: Chip Beef Dip
directions: Dice the corned beef and onions; set aside.
Slightly melt the cream cheese and add the can of soup.
(Add no water.) Mix well. Add the beef and onions.
Mix well.
Best when refrigerated for 1 to 2 hours.
Ritz crackers are good for this dip.
recipes.text: Chip Beef Dip. Dice the corned beef and onions; set aside. Slightly melt the cream cheese and add the can of soup. (Add no water.) Mix well. Add the beef and onions. Mix well. Best when refrigerated for 1 to 2 hours. Ritz crackers are good for this dip.

recipes.title: Chili Con Queso(Mexican Cheese Dip)
ingredients: 1 large or 2 small green peppers, chopped
2 to 10 Vlasic pickled hot cherry peppers, seeded and chopped (use gloves when seeding and chopping to prevent the oils from burning eyes or skin inadvertently!)
2 lb. Velveeta or Mexican Velveeta cheese
directions: Fry bacon until crisp.
Drain and crumble; reserve.
Remove all grease from skillet, except enough to coat the bottom (about 2 tablespoons).
Saute onion and green pepper over medium heat in same skillet until softened and beginning to brown, about 5 minutes.
Stir in desired amount of cherry peppers (I use about 6 to 8 for noticeable heat) and chopped tomatoes.
Reduce heat to low.
recipes.text: Chili Con Queso(Mexican Cheese Dip). Fry bacon until crisp. Drain and crumble; reserve. Remove all grease from skillet, except enough to coat the bottom (about 2 tablespoons). Saute onion and green pepper over medium heat in same skillet until softened and beginning to brown, about 5 minutes. Stir in desired amount of cherry peppers (I use about 6 to 8 for noticeable heat) and chopped tomatoes. Reduce heat to low.

recipes.title: Chicken Salad In Pita Pockets
directions: Combine all ingredients in bowl except for pitas.
Warm the pitas in oven.
Cut in half and open the pockets.
Fill each pocket with chicken salad.
recipes.text: Chicken Salad In Pita Pockets. Combine all ingredients in bowl except for pitas. Warm the pitas in oven. Cut in half and open the pockets. Fill each pocket with chicken salad.

recipes.title: Peanut Delight
directions: Mix sugar and cracker crumbs together, add peanut butter and melted oleo and mix well.
Pat into a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Melt chocolate morsels and pour over peanut butter mixture. Refrigerate about 2 hours and cut into squares.
Easy to make and is delicious.
recipes.text: Peanut Delight. Mix sugar and cracker crumbs together, add peanut butter and melted oleo and mix well. Pat into a 9 x 13-inch pan. Melt chocolate morsels and pour over peanut butter mixture. Refrigerate about 2 hours and cut into squares. Easy to make and is delicious.

recipes.title: Diabetic Grape Spread
ingredients: artificial sweetener equivalent to 1/4 cup sugar
directions: Soak gelatin in cold water. Heat grape and lemon juice. Bring to a boil and simmer gently for 10 minutes. Remove from heat and add gelatin and artificial sweetener. Stir to dissolve. Pour carefully into 2 hot, clean 1/2 pint jars. Cover lightly until cooled, then tighten lids and store in refrigerator.
recipes.text: Diabetic Grape Spread. Soak gelatin in cold water. Heat grape and lemon juice. Bring to a boil and simmer gently for 10 minutes. Remove from heat and add gelatin and artificial sweetener. Stir to dissolve. Pour carefully into 2 hot, clean 1/2 pint jars. Cover lightly until cooled, then tighten lids and store in refrigerator.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Pie(Makes 2 Pies)
ingredients: 1 tsp. cinnamon or pumpkin pie spice
directions: Boil pared pumpkin in salt water until soft.
Drain well, put through food mill to make pulp.
In large bowl, combine pumpkin, milk and beaten eggs.
Stir well.
Mix together sugar, flour, salt and cinnamon then add to pumpkin.
Lastly, slightly brown butter and stir into pumpkin mixture.
Pour into pie crusts and bake at 400° for 10 minutes and then at 375° until done, about 50 minutes (or until knife comes out clean).
(Secret:
Use fresh pumpkin.)
recipes.text: Pumpkin Pie(Makes 2 Pies). Boil pared pumpkin in salt water until soft. Drain well, put through food mill to make pulp. In large bowl, combine pumpkin, milk and beaten eggs. Stir well. Mix together sugar, flour, salt and cinnamon then add to pumpkin. Lastly, slightly brown butter and stir into pumpkin mixture. Pour into pie crusts and bake at 400° for 10 minutes and then at 375° until done, about 50 minutes (or until knife comes out clean). (Secret: Use fresh pumpkin.)

recipes.title: Mississippi Mud Cake
directions: Melt butter and cocoa together. Remove from heat and stir in sugar and eggs.

Mix well. Add flour, salt, chopped nuts and vanilla. Mix well. Spoon batter into greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan and bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes. Sprinkle marshmallows on top of warm cake. Cover with your favorite chocolate frosting.
I like to use this:
recipes.text: Mississippi Mud Cake. Melt butter and cocoa together. Remove from heat and stir in sugar and eggs. Mix well. Add flour, salt, chopped nuts and vanilla. Mix well. Spoon batter into greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan and bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes. Sprinkle marshmallows on top of warm cake. Cover with your favorite chocolate frosting. I like to use this:

recipes.title: Aunt Myrtles Fudge
directions: Combine sugar, chocolate milk and corn syrup.
Bring to a boil over medium heat, stirring once in a while.
Cover with lid and turn heat
down for 3 minutes.
Uncover and cook until it forms a soft ball in a cup of cold water, about 10 minutes. When candy forms soft
ball,
remove from heat and stir in 1/2 stick
of butter
or
margarine.
Stir
just
enough
to
melt butter.
Let cool
until
able
to
touch
bottom of pan.
Add vanilla; beat well.
Add nuts.
recipes.text: Aunt Myrtles Fudge. Combine sugar, chocolate milk and corn syrup. Bring to a boil over medium heat, stirring once in a while. Cover with lid and turn heat down for 3 minutes. Uncover and cook until it forms a soft ball in a cup of cold water, about 10 minutes. When candy forms soft ball, remove from heat and stir in 1/2 stick of butter or margarine. Stir just enough to melt butter. Let cool until able to touch bottom of pan. Add vanilla; beat well. Add nuts.

recipes.title: The Best Brussels Sprouts
ingredients: 6 slices bacon, cut across into 1/4-inch pieces
2-1/2 lb. (8 cups) Brussels sprouts, halved, cored and each half cut into quarters
1 cup carrots, peeled and cut into very small dice
directions: Place the bacon in a large skillet over medium heat and cook until the fat is rendered.
Add the pine nuts and cook until the bacon is crisp and the nuts are golden, about 1 minute.
recipes.text: The Best Brussels Sprouts. Place the bacon in a large skillet over medium heat and cook until the fat is rendered. Add the pine nuts and cook until the bacon is crisp and the nuts are golden, about 1 minute.

recipes.title: Beef And Bean Casserole
ingredients: 1 can pork and beans with liquid
directions: Brown beef.
Add pork and beans, ketchup, Worcestershire sauce, brown sugar and salt to taste.
Heat in oven at 325° to 350° for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Beef And Bean Casserole. Brown beef. Add pork and beans, ketchup, Worcestershire sauce, brown sugar and salt to taste. Heat in oven at 325° to 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Shrimp Curry
directions: Melt butter or margarine in skillet.
Add onion, green pepper and celery.
Cook until onion is yellow.
Blend in flour; stir in curry powder and soy sauce.
Stir in 1 cup water and tomatoes. Cover and simmer 20 minutes.
recipes.text: Shrimp Curry. Melt butter or margarine in skillet. Add onion, green pepper and celery. Cook until onion is yellow. Blend in flour; stir in curry powder and soy sauce. Stir in 1 cup water and tomatoes. Cover and simmer 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Turkey Puff
directions: Mix soup and 1/3 cup water; put in 2-quart casserole.
Arrange turkey stuffing and beans in layers on soup.
Beat egg whites until stiff, then beat yolks until thick; fold into whites.
Pile on casserole.
Bake in slow oven (300°) for 40 minutes.
Sprinkle with onions.
Bake 4 to 5 minutes longer.
Great with Thanksgiving leftovers!
recipes.text: Turkey Puff. Mix soup and 1/3 cup water; put in 2-quart casserole. Arrange turkey stuffing and beans in layers on soup. Beat egg whites until stiff, then beat yolks until thick; fold into whites. Pile on casserole. Bake in slow oven (300°) for 40 minutes. Sprinkle with onions. Bake 4 to 5 minutes longer. Great with Thanksgiving leftovers!

recipes.title: Baked Pineapple
ingredients: 1 (1 lb.) can crushed pineapple (in own syrup)
directions: Melt stick of margarine.
Cream together butter, sugar, eggs and salt.
Remove ends from bread. Mix in pineapple and bread. Bake in 325° oven for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Baked Pineapple. Melt stick of margarine. Cream together butter, sugar, eggs and salt. Remove ends from bread. Mix in pineapple and bread. Bake in 325° oven for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Winter Strawberries
directions: Combine nuts, coconut, gelatin, condensed milk and vanilla. Work until smoothly mixed.
Form into a ball and refrigerate an hour at least.
Shape a small ball of the chilled mixture into the shape of a strawberry.
Use about a tablespoonful.
Chill on a tray of waxed paper again after all berries are formed.
Roll in red sugar.
Use almonds tinted green for stems or purchase plastic stems from cake and party supply store.
Refrigerate in airtight container until serving time.
Makes about 45 strawberries.
recipes.text: Winter Strawberries. Combine nuts, coconut, gelatin, condensed milk and vanilla. Work until smoothly mixed. Form into a ball and refrigerate an hour at least. Shape a small ball of the chilled mixture into the shape of a strawberry. Use about a tablespoonful. Chill on a tray of waxed paper again after all berries are formed. Roll in red sugar. Use almonds tinted green for stems or purchase plastic stems from cake and party supply store. Refrigerate in airtight container until serving time. Makes about 45 strawberries.

recipes.title: House "Stinker"
ingredients: 1 Tbsp. nutmeg or an unground nutmeg
directions: Simmer all together in a pot and the aroma of autumn will fill your home.
recipes.text: House "Stinker". Simmer all together in a pot and the aroma of autumn will fill your home.

recipes.title: Sweet And Sour Cabbage
directions: Melt butter on bottom of large pot; add chopped onion, then shredded cabbage.
Mix vinegar, sugar and water and pour over top; add caraway seed.
Put on stove, covered, and cook about 1 hour or more, stirring every 15 minutes until tender.
Add more water if it gets too dry.
recipes.text: Sweet And Sour Cabbage. Melt butter on bottom of large pot; add chopped onion, then shredded cabbage. Mix vinegar, sugar and water and pour over top; add caraway seed. Put on stove, covered, and cook about 1 hour or more, stirring every 15 minutes until tender. Add more water if it gets too dry.

recipes.title: Lime Salad
ingredients: 1 large can crushed pineapple and juice
directions: Melt marshmallows in milk, stirring constantly.
Pour immediately into lime jello to dissolve.
Add cream cheese to dissolve, then add pineapple and mayonnaise.
Add whipped cream, blending well. Pour into a dish (3-quart) and refrigerate.
recipes.text: Lime Salad. Melt marshmallows in milk, stirring constantly. Pour immediately into lime jello to dissolve. Add cream cheese to dissolve, then add pineapple and mayonnaise. Add whipped cream, blending well. Pour into a dish (3-quart) and refrigerate.

recipes.title: Sweet Onion Pie
directions: Saute onion in butter until soft.
Mix flour with cold milk until there are no lumps.
Add eggs, salt, pepper and cheese.
Add onion and mix well.
Pour into pie shell and bake for 40 minutes until brown, bake at 350 degrees.
recipes.text: Sweet Onion Pie. Saute onion in butter until soft. Mix flour with cold milk until there are no lumps. Add eggs, salt, pepper and cheese. Add onion and mix well. Pour into pie shell and bake for 40 minutes until brown, bake at 350 degrees.

recipes.title: Fruit Dip
directions: Mix together cheese and marshmallows at medium speed until fluffy. Add a splash of orange juice or lemon (optional). Serve with fruit.
recipes.text: Fruit Dip. Mix together cheese and marshmallows at medium speed until fluffy. Add a splash of orange juice or lemon (optional). Serve with fruit.

recipes.title: Chocolate Sheet Cake
directions: Sift together sugar and self-rising flour.
Set aside.
Boil for 1 minute water, butter, oil and cocoa.
Pour hot mixture over flour and sugar and stir well.
Add buttermilk, eggs and vanilla. Pour in greased and floured pan.
Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.
recipes.text: Chocolate Sheet Cake. Sift together sugar and self-rising flour. Set aside. Boil for 1 minute water, butter, oil and cocoa. Pour hot mixture over flour and sugar and stir well. Add buttermilk, eggs and vanilla. Pour in greased and floured pan. Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.

recipes.title: African Drumsticks
directions: In a small bowl, combine tomato sauce, cola, chutney and red pepper flakes.
Spread mixture on drumsticks and grill or broil according to package direction (usually 15 to 20 minutes), turning frequently.
recipes.text: African Drumsticks. In a small bowl, combine tomato sauce, cola, chutney and red pepper flakes. Spread mixture on drumsticks and grill or broil according to package direction (usually 15 to 20 minutes), turning frequently.

recipes.title: Chocolate Pie
directions: Cook all together until thick, stirring constantly.
Pour into baked pie shell.
Will make 2 pies.
recipes.text: Chocolate Pie. Cook all together until thick, stirring constantly. Pour into baked pie shell. Will make 2 pies.

recipes.title: Breakfast Casserole
directions: Brown sausage and drain.
Break bread up in a 9 x 13-inch dish, slightly greased.
Mix 4 eggs and
1 1/2 cups milk and pour over bread.
Add cooked sausage (bacon, onion and pepper) and 2 cups cheese.
Cover and refrigerate overnight.
Next day:
Mix soup with 1/2 to 3/4 cup milk and pour over mixture.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Breakfast Casserole. Brown sausage and drain. Break bread up in a 9 x 13-inch dish, slightly greased. Mix 4 eggs and 1 1/2 cups milk and pour over bread. Add cooked sausage (bacon, onion and pepper) and 2 cups cheese. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Next day: Mix soup with 1/2 to 3/4 cup milk and pour over mixture. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Broccoli Salad
directions: Mix salad ingredients together.
recipes.text: Broccoli Salad. Mix salad ingredients together.

recipes.title: Magic Pumpkin Pie
directions: In a large bowl, combine all ingredients and turn into unbaked pie shell. Bake at 375° for 50 to 55 minutes.
recipes.text: Magic Pumpkin Pie. In a large bowl, combine all ingredients and turn into unbaked pie shell. Bake at 375° for 50 to 55 minutes.

recipes.title: I Don'T Know, But It'S Good
directions: Brown both meats with 1/4 of a stick of butter.
Drain, then add chopped cabbage and 1/4 stick of butter and water as needed to the ground meats.
Cook until the cabbage is wilted, about 15 to 20 minutes.
Boil the spuds, drain and mash.
recipes.text: I Don'T Know, But It'S Good. Brown both meats with 1/4 of a stick of butter. Drain, then add chopped cabbage and 1/4 stick of butter and water as needed to the ground meats. Cook until the cabbage is wilted, about 15 to 20 minutes. Boil the spuds, drain and mash.

recipes.title: Fruit Pizza
ingredients: any kind of fruits (strawberries, blueberries, etc.)
directions: Mix cream cheese and Cool Whip.
Cut cake in slices to cover bottom of pan.
Add fruits on top.
Bring remaining ingredients to boil; cool and drizzle over.
recipes.text: Fruit Pizza. Mix cream cheese and Cool Whip. Cut cake in slices to cover bottom of pan. Add fruits on top. Bring remaining ingredients to boil; cool and drizzle over.

recipes.title: Turkey Fajitas
ingredients: 1 lb. turkey breast cutlets or slices, cut into 1/2-inch strips
1 each: green pepper and red pepper, cut into 1/8 x 2-inch slices
Pico de Gallo sauce or salsa (optional)
directions: In a 1-quart bowl, combine turkey, cilantro, garlic, cumin, chili powder, soy sauce and Worcestershire sauce.
Cover and refrigerate 1 hour.
recipes.text: Turkey Fajitas. In a 1-quart bowl, combine turkey, cilantro, garlic, cumin, chili powder, soy sauce and Worcestershire sauce. Cover and refrigerate 1 hour.

recipes.title: Southern Fried Chicken
directions: Wash chicken.
Season with garlic salt and black pepper.
Put flour, garlic salt and pepper in brown bag.
Put chicken in brown bag and shake until well coated.
Heat cooking oil until hot, usually 350°.
Fry in deep fryer or cooker until golden brown; turn only once.
Cook approximately 20 minutes.
Drain on paper towels.
recipes.text: Southern Fried Chicken. Wash chicken. Season with garlic salt and black pepper. Put flour, garlic salt and pepper in brown bag. Put chicken in brown bag and shake until well coated. Heat cooking oil until hot, usually 350°. Fry in deep fryer or cooker until golden brown; turn only once. Cook approximately 20 minutes. Drain on paper towels.

recipes.title: Irish Cream
directions: Put all the ingredients into a blender.
Blend until well mixed.
Refrigerate until you are ready to enjoy!!!
recipes.text: Irish Cream. Put all the ingredients into a blender. Blend until well mixed. Refrigerate until you are ready to enjoy!!!

recipes.title: Butter Cookies
directions: Cream together the oleo, sugar and eggs.
Gradually add the flour, baking soda, vanilla, salt and cream of tartar.
Chill. Roll out 1/4 inch thick and cut with cookie cutters.
Bake at 400° (350° to 375° for electric oven) for 6 to 8 minutes.
recipes.text: Butter Cookies. Cream together the oleo, sugar and eggs. Gradually add the flour, baking soda, vanilla, salt and cream of tartar. Chill. Roll out 1/4 inch thick and cut with cookie cutters. Bake at 400° (350° to 375° for electric oven) for 6 to 8 minutes.

recipes.title: Honey Butter
directions: Whip softened butter.
Add vanilla and egg yolk. Add honey gradually while whipping.
recipes.text: Honey Butter. Whip softened butter. Add vanilla and egg yolk. Add honey gradually while whipping.

recipes.title: Chicken And Rice
ingredients: 1 whole chicken or 12 legs or 12 thighs or 8 breasts
directions: Skin chicken.
Saute onion and bell pepper in 2 tablespoons of oil until tender.
Place chicken in oblong pan.
Top with onion and bell pepper.
Mix cream of mushroom and cream of chicken soups with water.
Spread over chicken and bake in oven at 350° for approximately 1 hour.
Turn chicken over in pan while it's cooking.
Use own judgement as to when to do this.
Fix instant rice as directed on box.
Spread gravy over rice.
Eat and enjoy.
recipes.text: Chicken And Rice. Skin chicken. Saute onion and bell pepper in 2 tablespoons of oil until tender. Place chicken in oblong pan. Top with onion and bell pepper. Mix cream of mushroom and cream of chicken soups with water. Spread over chicken and bake in oven at 350° for approximately 1 hour. Turn chicken over in pan while it's cooking. Use own judgement as to when to do this. Fix instant rice as directed on box. Spread gravy over rice. Eat and enjoy.

recipes.title: Easy Apple Pie
ingredients: 1/2 c. Rice Krispies or corn flakes
directions: Combine brown sugar, flour, apples and sour cream. Spoon into unbaked 9-inch crust.
Combine Rice Krispies or corn flakes, cinnamon, nutmeg, flour, brown sugar and softened butter. Sprinkle over apple mixture.
Bake in a 375° oven for 40 to 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Easy Apple Pie. Combine brown sugar, flour, apples and sour cream. Spoon into unbaked 9-inch crust. Combine Rice Krispies or corn flakes, cinnamon, nutmeg, flour, brown sugar and softened butter. Sprinkle over apple mixture. Bake in a 375° oven for 40 to 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Bread
directions: Cream shortening in a bowl.
Add sugar and eggs.
Mix well. Stir in molasses and pumpkin.
Sift flour, baking soda, salt and pumpkin spice together.
Add dry ingredients to shortening mixture. Mix thoroughly.
Stir in chopped nuts.
Pour mixture into well-greased 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan.
Bake at 350° for 1 to 1 1/4 hours or until a toothpick stuck in center of loaf comes out clean. Cut into thin slices and serve.
recipes.text: Pumpkin Bread. Cream shortening in a bowl. Add sugar and eggs. Mix well. Stir in molasses and pumpkin. Sift flour, baking soda, salt and pumpkin spice together. Add dry ingredients to shortening mixture. Mix thoroughly. Stir in chopped nuts. Pour mixture into well-greased 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan. Bake at 350° for 1 to 1 1/4 hours or until a toothpick stuck in center of loaf comes out clean. Cut into thin slices and serve.

recipes.title: Poppy Seed Chicken
directions: Cook chicken
and
debone it.
Mix crackers, poppy seed and melted
margarine
in
large
bowl.
Mix
deboned chicken, cream of	chicken
soup and sour cream in another bowl.
Layer 1/2 of Ritz
mixture
for	crust in bottom of casserole dish. Next, put in	the
chicken, soup and sour cream mixture.
Put remaining cracker
mixture
on
top.	Cook at 350° for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Poppy Seed Chicken. Cook chicken and debone it. Mix crackers, poppy seed and melted margarine in large bowl. Mix deboned chicken, cream of	chicken soup and sour cream in another bowl. Layer 1/2 of Ritz mixture for	crust in bottom of casserole dish. Next, put in	the chicken, soup and sour cream mixture. Put remaining cracker mixture on top.	Cook at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Meat Loaf Supreme
directions: Mix meat, oats, salt, pepper, eggs, onion, celery and catsup; shape into a loaf.
Cover with sauce.
Pour water in baking dish over loaf.
Bake at 325° for 1 hour and 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Meat Loaf Supreme. Mix meat, oats, salt, pepper, eggs, onion, celery and catsup; shape into a loaf. Cover with sauce. Pour water in baking dish over loaf. Bake at 325° for 1 hour and 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Cheddar Chicken
directions: Cut the chicken into bite-size pieces and saute in oil until the chicken turns white.
Remove from pan and drain on paper towel.
Cook broccoli or asparagus.
In mixing bowl, blend soup, mayo, lemon juice and curry powder.
In bottom of loaf pan, place broccoli or asparagus on top of vegetables.
Arrange chicken to cover vegetables and chicken.
Top with shredded Cheddar cheese. Bake in 350° oven for about 35 minutes or until the cheese is completely melted.
recipes.text: Cheddar Chicken. Cut the chicken into bite-size pieces and saute in oil until the chicken turns white. Remove from pan and drain on paper towel. Cook broccoli or asparagus. In mixing bowl, blend soup, mayo, lemon juice and curry powder. In bottom of loaf pan, place broccoli or asparagus on top of vegetables. Arrange chicken to cover vegetables and chicken. Top with shredded Cheddar cheese. Bake in 350° oven for about 35 minutes or until the cheese is completely melted.

recipes.title: Chicken Wings
ingredients: 2 lb. chicken wings, cut into pieces
directions: Pour liquid ingredients over chicken wing sections.
Marinate overnight.
recipes.text: Chicken Wings. Pour liquid ingredients over chicken wing sections. Marinate overnight.

recipes.title: Best Ever Banana Bread
ingredients: 2 ripe medium bananas, mashed to equal 1 c.
directions: In a large bowl, stir together flour, sugar, baking soda and salt.
In another mixing bowl, combine eggs, bananas, oil, buttermilk and vanilla; add to flour mixture, stirring just until combined.
Fold in nuts.
Pour into a greased 9 x 5 x 3-inch baking pan.
Bake at 325° for 1 hour and 20 minutes or until bread tests done.
Cool on wire rack.
Yield: 1 loaf.
recipes.text: Best Ever Banana Bread. In a large bowl, stir together flour, sugar, baking soda and salt. In another mixing bowl, combine eggs, bananas, oil, buttermilk and vanilla; add to flour mixture, stirring just until combined. Fold in nuts. Pour into a greased 9 x 5 x 3-inch baking pan. Bake at 325° for 1 hour and 20 minutes or until bread tests done. Cool on wire rack. Yield: 1 loaf.

recipes.title: Mixed Vegetable Casserole
directions: Cook vegetables according to directions on package and drain. Add celery, onion, grated cheese, water chestnuts and salad dressing.
Thoroughly mix and spread into long baking dish.
Crush crackers and sprinkle over top of vegetables.
Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Mixed Vegetable Casserole. Cook vegetables according to directions on package and drain. Add celery, onion, grated cheese, water chestnuts and salad dressing. Thoroughly mix and spread into long baking dish. Crush crackers and sprinkle over top of vegetables. Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Baked Beans
directions: In casserole, layer of beans, layer of hamburger, layer of onions.
Repeat until all ingredients are used.
On top sprinkle brown sugar and pour over catsup.
Lay on strips of bacon.
Bake at 325° for 3 hours.
recipes.text: Baked Beans. In casserole, layer of beans, layer of hamburger, layer of onions. Repeat until all ingredients are used. On top sprinkle brown sugar and pour over catsup. Lay on strips of bacon. Bake at 325° for 3 hours.

recipes.title: Belgium Waffles
directions: Separate eggs.
Beat whites until stiff; set aside.
Mix other ingredients and egg yolks, then add egg whites.
Bake in Belgium waffle iron.
recipes.text: Belgium Waffles. Separate eggs. Beat whites until stiff; set aside. Mix other ingredients and egg yolks, then add egg whites. Bake in Belgium waffle iron.

recipes.title: Bacon Crackers
directions: Preheat oven to 250°. Put crackers on a baking sheet. Top with 1/3 slice bacon. Sprinkle with sugar; bake for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Bacon Crackers. Preheat oven to 250°. Put crackers on a baking sheet. Top with 1/3 slice bacon. Sprinkle with sugar; bake for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Ham And Potato Bake
ingredients: 1 (2 lb.) bag cottage style frozen potatoes
1 lb. canned vacuum sealed ham, cut in 1/2-inch cubes
directions: Butter 2 (6-cup) casseroles.
Saute onion and pepper until soft, not brown.
Stir in flour, salt and pepper.
Add milk; simmer until thickened, stirring, approximately 2 minutes.
Stir in 1 cup cheese and mustard.
Cook, stirring until cheese is melted.
Remove from heat.
Fold in potatoes, carrots and ham. Pour into casserole.
Cover each with foil.
Bake in preheated hot oven (425°) for 30 minutes.
Remove foil; sprinkle with remaining cheese.
Bake, uncovered, 15 minutes more.
Serves 8 to 12, or use 1 and freeze the other for later.
recipes.text: Ham And Potato Bake. Butter 2 (6-cup) casseroles. Saute onion and pepper until soft, not brown. Stir in flour, salt and pepper. Add milk; simmer until thickened, stirring, approximately 2 minutes. Stir in 1 cup cheese and mustard. Cook, stirring until cheese is melted. Remove from heat. Fold in potatoes, carrots and ham. Pour into casserole. Cover each with foil. Bake in preheated hot oven (425°) for 30 minutes. Remove foil; sprinkle with remaining cheese. Bake, uncovered, 15 minutes more. Serves 8 to 12, or use 1 and freeze the other for later.

recipes.title: Hamburger Soup
ingredients: 1/3 c. dried split peas (3 or 4 serving size)
1/4 tsp. each: pepper, oregano and basil
directions: In large saucepan or kettle having a lid, brown meat in oil. Add salt, spices and onion soup mix.
Stir in boiling water, tomato sauce and soy sauce.
Cook and simmer about 15 minutes.
recipes.text: Hamburger Soup. In large saucepan or kettle having a lid, brown meat in oil. Add salt, spices and onion soup mix. Stir in boiling water, tomato sauce and soy sauce. Cook and simmer about 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Crab Cakes
directions: Mix all together.
Roll in balls or patties.
Fry in hot grease.
recipes.text: Crab Cakes. Mix all together. Roll in balls or patties. Fry in hot grease.

recipes.title: Microwave Peanut Brittle
directions: Power level on High, 8 to 11 minutes.
recipes.text: Microwave Peanut Brittle. Power level on High, 8 to 11 minutes.

recipes.title: Easy Chicken Pie
directions: Cook and debone chicken, reserving broth.
Put in a large baking dish and salt and pepper to taste.
Mix chicken soup and chicken broth.
Pour over chicken.
Cut up eggs for the next layer.
Mix butter, flour and milk.
Pour over top.
Bake at 350° until crust is golden brown, 35 to 40 minutes.
recipes.text: Easy Chicken Pie. Cook and debone chicken, reserving broth. Put in a large baking dish and salt and pepper to taste. Mix chicken soup and chicken broth. Pour over chicken. Cut up eggs for the next layer. Mix butter, flour and milk. Pour over top. Bake at 350° until crust is golden brown, 35 to 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Potato Soup
ingredients: 3 c. Potatoes cut into small pieces
1/2 c. Carrots cut into extra small pieces
1/4 c. Green Pepper cut into extra small pieces
directions: Put all vegetables, salt, pepper and parsley flakes into pot with 2 1/2 cups of water.
Bring to a boil; then turn heat down to low.
Put lid on pot and cook for 20-25 min.
Put milk and flour in a jar and shake up real good.
Pour into pot with vegetables. Cut Velveeta cheese into cubes and add to pot.
Continue cooking until cheese is melted.
recipes.text: Potato Soup. Put all vegetables, salt, pepper and parsley flakes into pot with 2 1/2 cups of water. Bring to a boil; then turn heat down to low. Put lid on pot and cook for 20-25 min. Put milk and flour in a jar and shake up real good. Pour into pot with vegetables. Cut Velveeta cheese into cubes and add to pot. Continue cooking until cheese is melted.

recipes.title: Napa Cabbage Salad
ingredients: 1 large head Napa (Chinese) cabbage, finely shredded (not bok choy)
1 pkg. oriental noodle soup mix (chicken flavor)
directions: Combine cabbage and onions.
Cover and refrigerate overnight. Combine flavor packet from soup mix, sugar, oil, vinegar, salt and pepper.
Cover and refrigerate overnight.
Just before serving, break up noodles from soup mix into small pieces.
Combine all ingredients and mix well.
recipes.text: Napa Cabbage Salad. Combine cabbage and onions. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Combine flavor packet from soup mix, sugar, oil, vinegar, salt and pepper. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Just before serving, break up noodles from soup mix into small pieces. Combine all ingredients and mix well.

recipes.title: Potato-Corn Bake
ingredients: 2 Tbsp. finely chopped green onion tops (if desired)
directions: Heat oven to 375°.
Cook bacon crisp.
Drain, reserving 1 tablespoon of drippings.
Add green pepper and onion.
Cook over medium heat until tender.
Stir in corn, milk, margarine, salt and pepper.
Cook over medium heat until mixture is hot and bubbly. Remove from heat.
Stir in potato flakes and sour cream until well blended.
Spoon mixture into greased 11 x 7-inch pan.
Top with bacon, Parmesan cheese and green onion.
Bake for 20 to 25 minutes or until heated through.
recipes.text: Potato-Corn Bake. Heat oven to 375°. Cook bacon crisp. Drain, reserving 1 tablespoon of drippings. Add green pepper and onion. Cook over medium heat until tender. Stir in corn, milk, margarine, salt and pepper. Cook over medium heat until mixture is hot and bubbly. Remove from heat. Stir in potato flakes and sour cream until well blended. Spoon mixture into greased 11 x 7-inch pan. Top with bacon, Parmesan cheese and green onion. Bake for 20 to 25 minutes or until heated through.

recipes.title: Swiss Turkey Quiche
ingredients: 2 c. cubed cooked turkey or chicken
directions: Preheat oven to 425°. Bake pastry shell 8 minutes; remove from oven.
Reduce oven temperature to 350°.
In medium bowl, toss cheese with flour and bouillon; add remaining ingredients.
Mix well.
Pour into prepared shell. Bake 40 to 45 minutes or until set, topping with French fried onions during last 5 minutes.
Let stand 10 minutes before serving.
Refrigerate leftovers.
recipes.text: Swiss Turkey Quiche. Preheat oven to 425°. Bake pastry shell 8 minutes; remove from oven. Reduce oven temperature to 350°. In medium bowl, toss cheese with flour and bouillon; add remaining ingredients. Mix well. Pour into prepared shell. Bake 40 to 45 minutes or until set, topping with French fried onions during last 5 minutes. Let stand 10 minutes before serving. Refrigerate leftovers.

recipes.title: Meat Loaf - Barbecue Style
ingredients: 1 1/2 lb. ground beef or ground buffalo
directions: Mix together beef, crumbs, onion, egg, salt, pepper and 1/2 can tomato sauce.
Form into loaf and place into shallow 8 x 10-inch baking dish.
Combine rest of sauce and all other ingredients; mix well.
Pour over loaf.
Bake in a 350° oven for 1 hour and 15 minutes.
recipes.text: Meat Loaf - Barbecue Style. Mix together beef, crumbs, onion, egg, salt, pepper and 1/2 can tomato sauce. Form into loaf and place into shallow 8 x 10-inch baking dish. Combine rest of sauce and all other ingredients; mix well. Pour over loaf. Bake in a 350° oven for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Beef Dip In Pumpernickel
directions: Scoop out center of loaf to form shell.
Cut center into chunks for dipping.
recipes.text: Beef Dip In Pumpernickel. Scoop out center of loaf to form shell. Cut center into chunks for dipping.

recipes.title: Grammy Tyler'S Sweet Tomato Relish
ingredients: 1/4 c. mixed pickling spice, tied in cheesecloth
directions: Grind tomatoes, cover with water and scald 15 minutes.
Drain well, even overnight.
Grind onions and peppers.
Mix onions, peppers and tomatoes with vinegar, sugar, salt and pickling spice. Cook 1/2 hour.
Pour in jars and seal.
recipes.text: Grammy Tyler'S Sweet Tomato Relish. Grind tomatoes, cover with water and scald 15 minutes. Drain well, even overnight. Grind onions and peppers. Mix onions, peppers and tomatoes with vinegar, sugar, salt and pickling spice. Cook 1/2 hour. Pour in jars and seal.

recipes.title: Watergate Salad
directions: Mix all ingredients together.
Chill until set.
recipes.text: Watergate Salad. Mix all ingredients together. Chill until set.

recipes.title: Potato-Broccoli Cheese Soup
ingredients: 8 potatoes, peeled and cut into 3/4 inch cubes
1 (10 oz.) pkg. frozen chopped broccoli, thawed
directions: Melt the margarine; add onions and saute for 5 minutes.
Add potatoes, water and bouillon cubes.
Cover and cook until tender. Remove 1 or 2 cups potatoes and set aside.
Blend remaining potato mixture in blender until smooth.
Return all to saucepan.
Mix in reserved potatoes and broccoli.
Simmer a few minutes until the broccoli is cooked the way you like it.
Add cheese and heat through to melt.
recipes.text: Potato-Broccoli Cheese Soup. Melt the margarine; add onions and saute for 5 minutes. Add potatoes, water and bouillon cubes. Cover and cook until tender. Remove 1 or 2 cups potatoes and set aside. Blend remaining potato mixture in blender until smooth. Return all to saucepan. Mix in reserved potatoes and broccoli. Simmer a few minutes until the broccoli is cooked the way you like it. Add cheese and heat through to melt.

recipes.title: Fruit Ambrosia
directions: Layer banana, grapes and oranges in serving bowl or 6 dessert dishes.
Sprinkle coconut between layers.
Sprinkle coconut on top layer.
Drizzle with orange juice.
Makes 6 servings.
recipes.text: Fruit Ambrosia. Layer banana, grapes and oranges in serving bowl or 6 dessert dishes. Sprinkle coconut between layers. Sprinkle coconut on top layer. Drizzle with orange juice. Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Chocolate Pound Cake
directions: Cream sugar and shortening.
Add eggs; mix well.
Add milk and vanilla.
Sift dry ingredients together twice and add to mixture. Bake in tube pan for 1 hour and 15 minutes at 350°.
recipes.text: Chocolate Pound Cake. Cream sugar and shortening. Add eggs; mix well. Add milk and vanilla. Sift dry ingredients together twice and add to mixture. Bake in tube pan for 1 hour and 15 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Custard Pudding(Bouillant Lait)
directions: Beat egg yolks and add sugar slowly.
Add a little milk at a time to make creamy.
Put evaporated milk, vanilla and milk in saucepan.
Let get real warm but not boiling.
Add egg mixture slowly and mix well.
Dissolve cornstarch in 1/2 cup warm water, mixing well.
Add cornstarch to milk, stirring constantly.
After mixing well, slowly turn up heat and let come to a boil stirring constantly.
Cook until as thick as desired.
recipes.text: Custard Pudding(Bouillant Lait). Beat egg yolks and add sugar slowly. Add a little milk at a time to make creamy. Put evaporated milk, vanilla and milk in saucepan. Let get real warm but not boiling. Add egg mixture slowly and mix well. Dissolve cornstarch in 1/2 cup warm water, mixing well. Add cornstarch to milk, stirring constantly. After mixing well, slowly turn up heat and let come to a boil stirring constantly. Cook until as thick as desired.

recipes.title: Scalloped Corn
directions: Mix all ingredients and bake for 1 hour at 350°.
recipes.text: Scalloped Corn. Mix all ingredients and bake for 1 hour at 350°.

recipes.title: 3 Bean Salad
directions: Mix all ingredients together.
Marinate in refrigerator for 24 hours.
recipes.text: 3 Bean Salad. Mix all ingredients together. Marinate in refrigerator for 24 hours.

recipes.title: Chicken And Dressing Casserole
directions: Cook chicken in water (no salt).
Remove from bone; cut into bite size pieces.
Melt butter; mix with dressing.
Layer 1/2 of chicken and stuffing.
Pour 1 can of mushroom soup, diluted with 1/2 can chicken broth.
Make another layer of chicken and stuffing.
Pour 1 can of mushroom soup, diluted with 1/2 can of chicken broth.
Sprinkle dry stuffing over top.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.
Makes 6 to 8 servings.
recipes.text: Chicken And Dressing Casserole. Cook chicken in water (no salt). Remove from bone; cut into bite size pieces. Melt butter; mix with dressing. Layer 1/2 of chicken and stuffing. Pour 1 can of mushroom soup, diluted with 1/2 can chicken broth. Make another layer of chicken and stuffing. Pour 1 can of mushroom soup, diluted with 1/2 can of chicken broth. Sprinkle dry stuffing over top. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Bars
directions: Combine peanut butter, 3/4 cup margarine and sugar.
Press mixture into 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan.
Melt chocolate morsels with remaining 1/2 cup margarine; pour over mixture in pan. Refrigerate 15 minutes, then cut into bars.
Yield:
recipes.text: Peanut Butter Bars. Combine peanut butter, 3/4 cup margarine and sugar. Press mixture into 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan. Melt chocolate morsels with remaining 1/2 cup margarine; pour over mixture in pan. Refrigerate 15 minutes, then cut into bars. Yield: 16 to 24.

recipes.title: Corn Pudding
directions: Combine all ingredients.
Pour into a well-greased casserole. Dot the top with butter.
Bake at 350° for 80 minutes, 400° last 10 minutes.
recipes.text: Corn Pudding. Combine all ingredients. Pour into a well-greased casserole. Dot the top with butter. Bake at 350° for 80 minutes, 400° last 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Shrimp Fettucine
ingredients: 1 lb. shrimp, peeled and deveined, uncooked
9 oz. fettucine noodles, cooked (al dente) and drained
directions: In large skillet, heat 1 tablespoon butter over medium high heat.
Add garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add parsley, shrimp and vermouth and cook for 2 minutes, stirring constantly until shrimp turn pink.
Do not overcook.
Transfer shrimp mixture to small bowl.

In same skillet, heat 3 tablespoons butter until melted. Reduce heat to low and add cream, Parmesan and red pepper flakes. Cook for 3 minutes, stirring constantly until cheese melts and sauce is smooth.
Stir in salt and pepper.
To serve, place warm fettucine in serving dish.
Add shrimp mixture and toss gently to coat thoroughly.
Makes 4 servings.
recipes.text: Shrimp Fettucine. In large skillet, heat 1 tablespoon butter over medium high heat. Add garlic and cook for 1 minute. Add parsley, shrimp and vermouth and cook for 2 minutes, stirring constantly until shrimp turn pink. Do not overcook. Transfer shrimp mixture to small bowl. In same skillet, heat 3 tablespoons butter until melted. Reduce heat to low and add cream, Parmesan and red pepper flakes. Cook for 3 minutes, stirring constantly until cheese melts and sauce is smooth. Stir in salt and pepper. To serve, place warm fettucine in serving dish. Add shrimp mixture and toss gently to coat thoroughly. Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: Vegetable Salad
directions: Toss with mayonnaise just before serving.
recipes.text: Vegetable Salad. Toss with mayonnaise just before serving.

recipes.title: Jerry'S Strawberry Pie
directions: Mix in saucepan sugar and cornstarch.
Add boiling water and cook until clear.
Add lemon
juice and a few drops red food coloring.
Wash and drain strawberries.
Put filling in cooled crust, then strawberries and repeat until all is used.
Cool until firm.
Serve plain or with whipped cream.
recipes.text: Jerry'S Strawberry Pie. Mix in saucepan sugar and cornstarch. Add boiling water and cook until clear. Add lemon juice and a few drops red food coloring. Wash and drain strawberries. Put filling in cooled crust, then strawberries and repeat until all is used. Cool until firm. Serve plain or with whipped cream.

recipes.title: Sweet Potato Casserole
directions: Mix potatoes, 1/2 cup brown sugar, eggs, 1/2 stick oleo, milk and vanilla.
Pour into 1 1/2-quart baking dish.
Mix flour, brown sugar, nuts and 1/2 stick oleo together.
Spread over sweet potatoes.
Bake at 350° for 35 minutes.
recipes.text: Sweet Potato Casserole. Mix potatoes, 1/2 cup brown sugar, eggs, 1/2 stick oleo, milk and vanilla. Pour into 1 1/2-quart baking dish. Mix flour, brown sugar, nuts and 1/2 stick oleo together. Spread over sweet potatoes. Bake at 350° for 35 minutes.

recipes.title: Potato Casserole
directions: Stir together and put in baking dish.
Sprinkle bread crumbs on top.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Potato Casserole. Stir together and put in baking dish. Sprinkle bread crumbs on top. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Avocado Pasta Salad
ingredients: 1/2 lb. rotini pasta, cooked and cooked
directions: In a large bowl, gently toss pasta with dressing.
Add remaining ingredients, except avocado; toss gently.
Season to taste.
Fan avocado slices on top.
Garnish with fresh basil leaves and tomato.
Serves 4.
recipes.text: Avocado Pasta Salad. In a large bowl, gently toss pasta with dressing. Add remaining ingredients, except avocado; toss gently. Season to taste. Fan avocado slices on top. Garnish with fresh basil leaves and tomato. Serves 4.

recipes.title: Shrimp Creole
ingredients: 2 Tbsp. flour, mixed in cold water
directions: Melt butter in saucepan.
Saute onion, celery and green pepper until soft, about 5 minutes.
Stir in garlic.
Fry about 5 more minutes.
Remove pan from direct heat and slowly stir in flour. Add parsley, bay leaves, salt, cayenne and tomatoes.
Simmer 15 minutes.
Add shrimp; cover and simmer 30 minutes.
Serve over cooked, fluffy rice.
Serves 4 to 6.
recipes.text: Shrimp Creole. Melt butter in saucepan. Saute onion, celery and green pepper until soft, about 5 minutes. Stir in garlic. Fry about 5 more minutes. Remove pan from direct heat and slowly stir in flour. Add parsley, bay leaves, salt, cayenne and tomatoes. Simmer 15 minutes. Add shrimp; cover and simmer 30 minutes. Serve over cooked, fluffy rice. Serves 4 to 6.

recipes.title: Shrimp Mold
directions: Dissolve gelatin in hot water.
Add tomato soup and cream cheese; bring to a boil.
Cool about 10 minutes in the refrigerator.
recipes.text: Shrimp Mold. Dissolve gelatin in hot water. Add tomato soup and cream cheese; bring to a boil. Cool about 10 minutes in the refrigerator.

recipes.title: Fresh Peach Pudding
directions: Beat together sugar, eggs and margarine.
Fold in Cool Whip and peaches.
In a large shallow glass casserole dish, place a layer of vanilla wafers.
Top with a layer of peach mixture. Continue layering until the peach mixture is used, ending with a layer of vanilla wafers.
Chill overnight.
Garnish with wafers and peach slices, if desired.
recipes.text: Fresh Peach Pudding. Beat together sugar, eggs and margarine. Fold in Cool Whip and peaches. In a large shallow glass casserole dish, place a layer of vanilla wafers. Top with a layer of peach mixture. Continue layering until the peach mixture is used, ending with a layer of vanilla wafers. Chill overnight. Garnish with wafers and peach slices, if desired.

recipes.title: Frosted Creams
directions: Mix ingredients in order given.
Spread on an oblong sheet pan (jelly roll pan).
Bake at 350° for 35 minutes or until done.
Ice with confectioners sugar and water.
Ice while still warm.
recipes.text: Frosted Creams. Mix ingredients in order given. Spread on an oblong sheet pan (jelly roll pan). Bake at 350° for 35 minutes or until done. Ice with confectioners sugar and water. Ice while still warm.

recipes.title: Stuffing Balls
directions: Cook celery, onion and parsley in butter.
Add bouillon cubes. Pour over bread.
Add egg and 1/4 cup milk.
Shape in balls the size of golf balls and place them in a greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix soups with the remaining milk.
Cover bottom of pan with soup mixture.
Spoon remaining soup over top of stuffing balls.
Bake at 325° for about 1 hour.
recipes.text: Stuffing Balls. Cook celery, onion and parsley in butter. Add bouillon cubes. Pour over bread. Add egg and 1/4 cup milk. Shape in balls the size of golf balls and place them in a greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix soups with the remaining milk. Cover bottom of pan with soup mixture. Spoon remaining soup over top of stuffing balls. Bake at 325° for about 1 hour.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Bread
ingredients: 2/3 c. raisins or cut up dates
directions: Heat oven to 350°.
Grease 2 (9 x 5 x 3-inch) loaf pans or 3 (8 1/2 x 4 1/2 x 2 1/2-inch) loaf pans.
Cream eggs, shortening and sugar.
Mix in pumpkin and water.
Blend in spices and dry ingredients.
Stir in nuts and raisins and put in pans.
Bake 65 to 70 minutes until clean.
recipes.text: Pumpkin Bread. Heat oven to 350°. Grease 2 (9 x 5 x 3-inch) loaf pans or 3 (8 1/2 x 4 1/2 x 2 1/2-inch) loaf pans. Cream eggs, shortening and sugar. Mix in pumpkin and water. Blend in spices and dry ingredients. Stir in nuts and raisins and put in pans. Bake 65 to 70 minutes until clean.

recipes.title: Sausage Balls
directions: Grate cheese and melt; crumble in sausage and Bisquick mix. Shape into small balls and bake on ungreased baking sheet for 20 minutes in preheated 350° oven.
recipes.text: Sausage Balls. Grate cheese and melt; crumble in sausage and Bisquick mix. Shape into small balls and bake on ungreased baking sheet for 20 minutes in preheated 350° oven.

recipes.title: Sugar Cookies
directions: Cream the sugar and butter; add egg and vanilla.
Beat well. Sift dry ingredients together, add to creamed ingredients and set in refrigerator 2 to 3 hours.
Drop by teaspoonful onto greased cookie sheet.
Bake in a 375° oven for 7 to 8 minutes.
(May roll out dough and use cookie cutters.)
recipes.text: Sugar Cookies. Cream the sugar and butter; add egg and vanilla. Beat well. Sift dry ingredients together, add to creamed ingredients and set in refrigerator 2 to 3 hours. Drop by teaspoonful onto greased cookie sheet. Bake in a 375° oven for 7 to 8 minutes. (May roll out dough and use cookie cutters.)

recipes.title: Quick Refrigerator Relish
directions: Combine all of the ingredients. Place in refrigerator for 2 to 4 hours before serving.
recipes.text: Quick Refrigerator Relish. Combine all of the ingredients. Place in refrigerator for 2 to 4 hours before serving.

recipes.title: Ginger Pork
directions: Preheat oven to 350°.
Put pork in pan; sprinkle with salt, pepper, rosemary and ginger.
Pour 1 cup of wine in pan.
Cook and bake 1 hour.
Remove pan from oven.
Place marmalade in small bowl.
Add pan drippings; mix well.
Pour over meat.
Cook for 30 to 40 minutes, basting meat.
Serve pork with pan juices.
recipes.text: Ginger Pork. Preheat oven to 350°. Put pork in pan; sprinkle with salt, pepper, rosemary and ginger. Pour 1 cup of wine in pan. Cook and bake 1 hour. Remove pan from oven. Place marmalade in small bowl. Add pan drippings; mix well. Pour over meat. Cook for 30 to 40 minutes, basting meat. Serve pork with pan juices.

recipes.title: Pussy Willow Salad Dressing
directions: Mix all ingredients together.
Stir until smooth.
recipes.text: Pussy Willow Salad Dressing. Mix all ingredients together. Stir until smooth.

recipes.title: Cheese Cake
directions: Mix together cream cheese, eggs, sugar and vanilla.
Pour into 9-inch graham cracker crust.
Mix sour cream and sugar; spread on top.
Bake 45 minutes at 350°.
recipes.text: Cheese Cake. Mix together cream cheese, eggs, sugar and vanilla. Pour into 9-inch graham cracker crust. Mix sour cream and sugar; spread on top. Bake 45 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: French Bean Casserole
directions: Drain beans and put in casserole.
Mix with soup and 1/2 can of onion rings.
Bake at 325° for 30 minutes, covered.
Add rest of onion rings and cook for 10 more minutes, uncovered.
recipes.text: French Bean Casserole. Drain beans and put in casserole. Mix with soup and 1/2 can of onion rings. Bake at 325° for 30 minutes, covered. Add rest of onion rings and cook for 10 more minutes, uncovered.

recipes.title: Picnic Potato Salad
directions: Cook potatoes in jackets.
Whisk mayonnaise, sour cream, evaporated milk, oil and vinegar together in a bowl.
Peel and slice potatoes.
Mix warm potatoes with salad dressing, grated vegetables and parsley.
Season with salt and pepper.
Chill overnight.
recipes.text: Picnic Potato Salad. Cook potatoes in jackets. Whisk mayonnaise, sour cream, evaporated milk, oil and vinegar together in a bowl. Peel and slice potatoes. Mix warm potatoes with salad dressing, grated vegetables and parsley. Season with salt and pepper. Chill overnight.

recipes.title: Raspberry Pecan Pastry Bars
directions: Combine 2 cups of flour, sugar and salt in a medium bowl.
Cut in butter with pastry blender until mixture turns into into coarse crumbs.
Press dough in an even layer in ungreased 10 x 15-inch jelly roll pan.
Bake at 350° for 15 to 18 minutes.
Cover for 15 minutes, then spread raspberry preserves over the crust.
recipes.text: Raspberry Pecan Pastry Bars. Combine 2 cups of flour, sugar and salt in a medium bowl. Cut in butter with pastry blender until mixture turns into into coarse crumbs. Press dough in an even layer in ungreased 10 x 15-inch jelly roll pan. Bake at 350° for 15 to 18 minutes. Cover for 15 minutes, then spread raspberry preserves over the crust.

recipes.title: Hearty Potatoes
directions: Mix ingredients together in a large bowl by hand.
Spread in a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Bake 1 hour at 325°.
recipes.text: Hearty Potatoes. Mix ingredients together in a large bowl by hand. Spread in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake 1 hour at 325°.

recipes.title: Beef Stroganoff
directions: Brown hamburger in skillet.
Add onion soup mix, mushroom soup, noodles and water.
Salt to taste.
Cook about 20 minutes until noodles are done.
Add sour cream.
Cook 3 more minutes.
recipes.text: Beef Stroganoff. Brown hamburger in skillet. Add onion soup mix, mushroom soup, noodles and water. Salt to taste. Cook about 20 minutes until noodles are done. Add sour cream. Cook 3 more minutes.

recipes.title: Apple Bread Pudding
directions: In a buttered 8 x 8 x 2-inch baking pan, layer half the dry bread cubes.
Combine applesauce mixture over bread cubes.
Layer remaining bread cubes atop, dot with butter.
Combine milk, eggs, vanilla and salt.
Pour over bread mixture.
Lightly sprinkle cinnamon over top.
Bake, uncovered, at 350° until knife inserted just off center comes out clean, 55 to 60 minutes.
Makes 6 servings.
recipes.text: Apple Bread Pudding. In a buttered 8 x 8 x 2-inch baking pan, layer half the dry bread cubes. Combine applesauce mixture over bread cubes. Layer remaining bread cubes atop, dot with butter. Combine milk, eggs, vanilla and salt. Pour over bread mixture. Lightly sprinkle cinnamon over top. Bake, uncovered, at 350° until knife inserted just off center comes out clean, 55 to 60 minutes. Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Swenson'S Potato Cake
directions: Cream sugar and oil; add egg yolks, then potatoes.
Mix all dry ingredients separately, sifted together 3 or 4 times.
Add alternately the dry ingredients and milk to creamed mixture.
Add vanilla and nuts.
Fold in beaten egg whites last.
Bake at 350° until done, approximately 1/2 hour or so.
recipes.text: Swenson'S Potato Cake. Cream sugar and oil; add egg yolks, then potatoes. Mix all dry ingredients separately, sifted together 3 or 4 times.
