Add alternately the dry ingredients and milk to creamed mixture. Add vanilla and nuts. Fold in beaten egg whites last. Bake at 350° until done, approximately 1/2 hour or so.

recipes.title: Date Pudding
directions: Mix
all
dry
ingredients
together.
Add
milk and egg whites, beaten stiff.
Set in pan of water and bake in moderate oven for 50 minutes.
Take out of pan of water last 5 minutes.
recipes.text: Date Pudding. Mix all dry ingredients together. Add milk and egg whites, beaten stiff. Set in pan of water and bake in moderate oven for 50 minutes. Take out of pan of water last 5 minutes.

recipes.title: Frozen Passion
ingredients: 2 (28 oz.) bottles (any flavor) carbonated beverage or 4 (12 oz.)
2 cans Eagle Brand sweetened condensed milk
directions: Blend ingredients well.
Pour into ice cream freezer.
Proceed according to the operating instructions for freezer.
Makes 2 quarts.
recipes.text: Frozen Passion. Blend ingredients well. Pour into ice cream freezer. Proceed according to the operating instructions for freezer. Makes 2 quarts.

recipes.title: Dana Houston Cajun Beans
directions: Cook bacon and sausage until halfway done and 1 tablespoon hot sauce.
Add onions, green peppers and celery until soft.
Add beans, 1/2 minced garlic, little liquid smoke.
Go slow and taste. Add more liquid smoke and hot sauce to taste.
Simmer for 30 minutes or until ready to eat.
recipes.text: Dana Houston Cajun Beans. Cook bacon and sausage until halfway done and 1 tablespoon hot sauce. Add onions, green peppers and celery until soft. Add beans, 1/2 minced garlic, little liquid smoke. Go slow and taste. Add more liquid smoke and hot sauce to taste. Simmer for 30 minutes or until ready to eat.

recipes.title: Cheeseburger Bake
ingredients: 1 lb. ground hamburger, browned and drained
directions: Preheat oven to 350°.
Generously grease 13 x 9-inch pan. After hamburger is browned and drained, mix vegetables, soup, onion and milk.
Heat through.
Set aside.
recipes.text: Cheeseburger Bake. Preheat oven to 350°. Generously grease 13 x 9-inch pan. After hamburger is browned and drained, mix vegetables, soup, onion and milk. Heat through. Set aside.

recipes.title: Shrimp Creole
directions: Cut large shrimp in half.
Blend flour into oil and brown, stirring constantly.
Add water gradually and cook until thick, smooth and shining.
Add remaining ingredients.
Cover and simmer 20 minutes.
Add shrimp.
Cook 5 more minutes.
Serve over rice.
recipes.text: Shrimp Creole. Cut large shrimp in half. Blend flour into oil and brown, stirring constantly. Add water gradually and cook until thick, smooth and shining. Add remaining ingredients. Cover and simmer 20 minutes. Add shrimp. Cook 5 more minutes. Serve over rice.

recipes.title: Pineapple Casserole
directions: Drain pineapple, reserving 1/3 cup of juice.
Mix flour, sugar and cheese and stir into pineapple.
Pour juice over all.
Pour in an 11 x 17-inch dish.
Blend butter and crushed crackers. Sprinkle over top of casserole.
Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.
recipes.text: Pineapple Casserole. Drain pineapple, reserving 1/3 cup of juice. Mix flour, sugar and cheese and stir into pineapple. Pour juice over all. Pour in an 11 x 17-inch dish. Blend butter and crushed crackers. Sprinkle over top of casserole. Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Chili Cheese Quiche(Appetizer)
directions: Beat eggs 4 to 5 minutes.
Stir flour, salt and baking powder together.
Add to eggs and mix well.
Fold in Jack cheese, cottage cheese and chilies.
Pour into greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan and bake in 350° oven for 40 minutes.
Let stand 10 minutes before cutting.
Can be served warm or cold.
recipes.text: Chili Cheese Quiche(Appetizer). Beat eggs 4 to 5 minutes. Stir flour, salt and baking powder together. Add to eggs and mix well. Fold in Jack cheese, cottage cheese and chilies. Pour into greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan and bake in 350° oven for 40 minutes. Let stand 10 minutes before cutting. Can be served warm or cold.

recipes.title: Hot Chicken Salad Casserole
directions: Cook fryer and bone.
Add onion, celery, mayonnaise, almonds, chicken soup and broth.
Mix well and place in 13 x 9-inch pan. Cover with crushed potato chips.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Hot Chicken Salad Casserole. Cook fryer and bone. Add onion, celery, mayonnaise, almonds, chicken soup and broth. Mix well and place in 13 x 9-inch pan. Cover with crushed potato chips. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Sweet Onion Pie
ingredients: 1 (15 oz.) pkg. Pillsbury All Ready pie crusts
directions: Prepare pie crust sheet according to package directions for a filled one-crust pie, using a 9-inch pie plate.
(Refrigerate remaining crust for later use.)
Bake at 450° for 9 to 11 minutes, or until lightly browned.
(If crust puffs up, gently press back to bottom and sides of pan with the back of a wooden spoon.)
Cool completely.
recipes.text: Sweet Onion Pie. Prepare pie crust sheet according to package directions for a filled one-crust pie, using a 9-inch pie plate. (Refrigerate remaining crust for later use.) Bake at 450° for 9 to 11 minutes, or until lightly browned. (If crust puffs up, gently press back to bottom and sides of pan with the back of a wooden spoon.) Cool completely.

recipes.title: Green Tomato Bread
directions: Place green tomatoes in blender; puree then strain to get out all the liquid.
In a large bowl beat together sugar, eggs, green tomatoes, salt, oil, vanilla and almond.
Sift together flour, baking soda, baking powder and cinnamon.
Add to egg mixture. Pour into 2 greased and floured 9 x 5-inch loaf pans.
Bake at 350° for 40 to 60 minutes or until done.
Cool on wire rack and remove from pans.
Bread may be frozen for future use if desired.
recipes.text: Green Tomato Bread. Place green tomatoes in blender; puree then strain to get out all the liquid. In a large bowl beat together sugar, eggs, green tomatoes, salt, oil, vanilla and almond. Sift together flour, baking soda, baking powder and cinnamon. Add to egg mixture. Pour into 2 greased and floured 9 x 5-inch loaf pans. Bake at 350° for 40 to 60 minutes or until done. Cool on wire rack and remove from pans. Bread may be frozen for future use if desired.

recipes.title: Recipe For A Happy Day
directions: Measure words carefully.
Add heaping cups of understanding. Use generous amounts of time and patience.
Cook with gas on the front burner.
Keep temperature low; do not boil.
Add dash of humor and a pinch of warm personality.
Serve individually.
recipes.text: Recipe For A Happy Day. Measure words carefully. Add heaping cups of understanding. Use generous amounts of time and patience. Cook with gas on the front burner. Keep temperature low; do not boil. Add dash of humor and a pinch of warm personality. Serve individually.

recipes.title: Almond Hershey Bar
directions: Melt marshmallows in milk and cool.
Add crushed Hershey bars, Cool Whip and vanilla.
Mix graham crackers and melted butter.
recipes.text: Almond Hershey Bar. Melt marshmallows in milk and cool. Add crushed Hershey bars, Cool Whip and vanilla. Mix graham crackers and melted butter.

recipes.title: Microwave Corn-On-The-Cob
directions: Place ear of corn with husk in the microwave.
Cook it for 3 minutes on High.
Remove husk, butter and salt the ear.
You are ready to eat!
Two or more ears: 4 minutes.
See if they are hot.
recipes.text: Microwave Corn-On-The-Cob. Place ear of corn with husk in the microwave. Cook it for 3 minutes on High. Remove husk, butter and salt the ear. You are ready to eat! Two or more ears: 4 minutes. See if they are hot.

recipes.title: Ice Cream Pie
ingredients: 1 qt. New York vanilla ice cream, slightly softened
directions: Measure peanut butter and corn syrup into mixing bowl; mix until blended.
Add Rice Krispies; stir until well coated.
Press mixture evenly and firmly in bottom and around sides of greased 9-inch pie pan.
Chill until firm.
Spread ice cream in chilled crust.
Freeze until firm.
Cut into wedges to serve; garnish with cherries or other fruit.
To remove pie pieces easily, place hot wet towel under bottom of pan or allow to stand a few minutes.
recipes.text: Ice Cream Pie. Measure peanut butter and corn syrup into mixing bowl; mix until blended. Add Rice Krispies; stir until well coated. Press mixture evenly and firmly in bottom and around sides of greased 9-inch pie pan. Chill until firm. Spread ice cream in chilled crust. Freeze until firm. Cut into wedges to serve; garnish with cherries or other fruit. To remove pie pieces easily, place hot wet towel under bottom of pan or allow to stand a few minutes.

recipes.title: Shortbread Bars
directions: Heat oven to 350°.
Lightly grease an 8-inch square pan. Combine flour and sugar.
Using a pastry blender, cut in margarine until mixture is like fine meal.
Press into pan.
Bake for 20 minutes.
recipes.text: Shortbread Bars. Heat oven to 350°. Lightly grease an 8-inch square pan. Combine flour and sugar. Using a pastry blender, cut in margarine until mixture is like fine meal. Press into pan. Bake for 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Mexican Corn Bread
directions: Mix all ingredients together.
Pour into 2 greased skillets. Bake at 400° for 20 to 25 minutes.
recipes.text: Mexican Corn Bread. Mix all ingredients together. Pour into 2 greased skillets. Bake at 400° for 20 to 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Nutty Noodly Clusters
ingredients: 2 (3 oz.) cans La Choy chow mein noodles
directions: Melt butterscotch chips in a heavy saucepan over low heat, stirring constantly.
Remove from heat; quickly stir in noodles and nuts until evenly coated.
Dip out by teaspoon onto waxed paper.
Refrigerate and chill.
recipes.text: Nutty Noodly Clusters. Melt butterscotch chips in a heavy saucepan over low heat, stirring constantly. Remove from heat; quickly stir in noodles and nuts until evenly coated. Dip out by teaspoon onto waxed paper. Refrigerate and chill.

recipes.title: Mandlebread
directions: Using electric mixer, beat eggs.
Add sugar and salt; blend well.
Add 1/4 cup oil; blend.
Stir in 1 cup flour and 1/2 cup nuts; blend.
Add remaining 1/4 cup oil, 1 cup flour and 1/2 cup nuts; blend.
Add remaining flour and baking powder and blend.
Add vanilla and optional chocolate chips.
Grease 2 large baking sheets.
Divide batter into 6 portions and spread dough onto baking sheets in loaf shapes.
Bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes, until edges are just brown.
Remove from oven; cool slightly and slice into 1/2-inch pieces.
Place pieces, cut side down, and bake for an additional 15 minutes.
Let cool and enjoy!
recipes.text: Mandlebread. Using electric mixer, beat eggs. Add sugar and salt; blend well. Add 1/4 cup oil; blend. Stir in 1 cup flour and 1/2 cup nuts; blend. Add remaining 1/4 cup oil, 1 cup flour and 1/2 cup nuts; blend. Add remaining flour and baking powder and blend. Add vanilla and optional chocolate chips. Grease 2 large baking sheets. Divide batter into 6 portions and spread dough onto baking sheets in loaf shapes. Bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes, until edges are just brown. Remove from oven; cool slightly and slice into 1/2-inch pieces. Place pieces, cut side down, and bake for an additional 15 minutes. Let cool and enjoy!

recipes.title: Barbecued Meat Patties
directions: Mix together all ingredients for patties.
When milk is absorbed, shape mixture into 12 patties.
Cook slowly for 10 minutes or until brown on both sides in a small amount of fat. Mix together all ingredients for Sauce.
Add to the meat in skillet and cook slowly, turning in Sauce.
recipes.text: Barbecued Meat Patties. Mix together all ingredients for patties. When milk is absorbed, shape mixture into 12 patties. Cook slowly for 10 minutes or until brown on both sides in a small amount of fat. Mix together all ingredients for Sauce. Add to the meat in skillet and cook slowly, turning in Sauce.

recipes.title: Tomato Soup Cake
directions: Preheat oven to 350°.
Prepare tube pan.
Cream the butter, Crisco, sugar and egg.
Add cinnamon, cloves and nutmeg.
Blend in raisins.
Add hot water and tomato soup.
Blend in flour, baking powder and soda.
Mix well.
Bake in tube pan for 40 to 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Tomato Soup Cake. Preheat oven to 350°. Prepare tube pan. Cream the butter, Crisco, sugar and egg. Add cinnamon, cloves and nutmeg. Blend in raisins. Add hot water and tomato soup. Blend in flour, baking powder and soda. Mix well. Bake in tube pan for 40 to 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Hash Brown Casserole
ingredients: bread crumbs and additional Cheddar cheese
directions: Thaw the potatoes and place in 2-quart casserole dish. Add soup, sour cream, onion and Cheddar cheese to potatoes.
Stir gently to mix well.
Top with bread crumbs and additional Cheddar cheese. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Hash Brown Casserole. Thaw the potatoes and place in 2-quart casserole dish. Add soup, sour cream, onion and Cheddar cheese to potatoes. Stir gently to mix well. Top with bread crumbs and additional Cheddar cheese. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Easy Peanut Butter Pie
directions: Blend all ingredients well with mixer except the Cool Whip. Fold in the Cool Whip.
Put in pie crust and freeze.
recipes.text: Easy Peanut Butter Pie. Blend all ingredients well with mixer except the Cool Whip. Fold in the Cool Whip. Put in pie crust and freeze.

recipes.title: Cabbage Soup
ingredients: celery flakes, onion flakes and oregano to taste
directions: Combine all ingredients in large soup pot.
Simmer for 1 hour or until cabbage is tender.
Add other vegetables to suit tastes or to recycle leftovers.
recipes.text: Cabbage Soup. Combine all ingredients in large soup pot. Simmer for 1 hour or until cabbage is tender. Add other vegetables to suit tastes or to recycle leftovers.

recipes.title: Tuna Macaroni Salad
directions: Cook macaroni and drain.
Add rest and mix with mayonnaise. Salt and pepper to taste.
recipes.text: Tuna Macaroni Salad. Cook macaroni and drain. Add rest and mix with mayonnaise. Salt and pepper to taste.

recipes.title: Chocolate Chip Cheese Cake
ingredients: additional mini semi-sweet chocolate chips for top
directions: Mix cream cheese, sugar and vanilla, then blend in eggs.
Stir in 1/2 cup mini semi-sweet chocolate chips.
Pour into a graham cracker pie crust.
Sprinkle with mini semi-sweet chocolate chips. Bake at 350° for 40 minutes; cool.
For best results, refrigerate for 3 hours before serving.
recipes.text: Chocolate Chip Cheese Cake. Mix cream cheese, sugar and vanilla, then blend in eggs. Stir in 1/2 cup mini semi-sweet chocolate chips. Pour into a graham cracker pie crust. Sprinkle with mini semi-sweet chocolate chips. Bake at 350° for 40 minutes; cool. For best results, refrigerate for 3 hours before serving.

recipes.title: Shrimp Scampi
directions: Saute onions, parsley and garlic in butter.
Add shrimp.
Cook until pink (about 3 minutes).
Add salt, pepper, lemon juice and dry vermouth.
Heat 3 to 5 minutes.
Serve over rice or noodles
recipes.text: Shrimp Scampi. Saute onions, parsley and garlic in butter. Add shrimp. Cook until pink (about 3 minutes). Add salt, pepper, lemon juice and dry vermouth. Heat 3 to 5 minutes. Serve over rice or noodles

recipes.title: Easy Nacho Dip
directions: Layer in 10-inch glass baking dish cream cheese, Hormel chili, then Cheddar cheese.
Bake at 350° for 15 minutes.
Cool 10 minutes.
Dip nacho chips.
recipes.text: Easy Nacho Dip. Layer in 10-inch glass baking dish cream cheese, Hormel chili, then Cheddar cheese. Bake at 350° for 15 minutes. Cool 10 minutes. Dip nacho chips.

recipes.title: Stromboli
directions: Let pizza dough come to room temperature.
Roll out in a rectangular shape, approximately 12 x 20-inch.
Place a row of ham along the 20-inch side, then the Provolone, salami and pepperoni. Shake on the garlic powder to taste and oregano flakes to taste. Roll up starting from the meat side.
Place on a greased pan and put in a 350° oven for 25 to 30 minutes or until crust browns.
recipes.text: Stromboli. Let pizza dough come to room temperature. Roll out in a rectangular shape, approximately 12 x 20-inch. Place a row of ham along the 20-inch side, then the Provolone, salami and pepperoni. Shake on the garlic powder to taste and oregano flakes to taste. Roll up starting from the meat side. Place on a greased pan and put in a 350° oven for 25 to 30 minutes or until crust browns.

recipes.title: Red Beans And Rice
ingredients: 1 lb. ham hock, smoked sausage or hot sausage
cayenne pepper or Tabasco to taste
directions: Addition of a ham bone adds real color and flavor not possible to achieve otherwise.
Most Cajun cooks like to boil for a couple of minutes, then let them soak in that same water overnight.
In the morning, brown sausage or fat meat first to remove some of the grease.
Bring beans to a boil again and add all other ingredients. Reduce heat and simmer for at least 3 hours.
Beans should become very creamy.
Serve over hot fluffy rice.
recipes.text: Red Beans And Rice. Addition of a ham bone adds real color and flavor not possible to achieve otherwise. Most Cajun cooks like to boil for a couple of minutes, then let them soak in that same water overnight. In the morning, brown sausage or fat meat first to remove some of the grease. Bring beans to a boil again and add all other ingredients. Reduce heat and simmer for at least 3 hours. Beans should become very creamy. Serve over hot fluffy rice.

recipes.title: Deer Meat Delight
directions: Place meat in an iron skillet with 1/4 cup oil.
Brown meat. Add peppers, onions, garlic, salt and pepper.
Cook until pepper, onions and garlic are transparent looking.
Add mushroom soup and milk.
Simmer for 15 minutes.
Put on hot rice and enjoy!
This is good with hot corn bread.
recipes.text: Deer Meat Delight. Place meat in an iron skillet with 1/4 cup oil. Brown meat. Add peppers, onions, garlic, salt and pepper. Cook until pepper, onions and garlic are transparent looking. Add mushroom soup and milk. Simmer for 15 minutes. Put on hot rice and enjoy! This is good with hot corn bread.

recipes.title: Easy Spaghetti
directions: Fry hamburger until brown.
While frying, add chopped onion and green pepper.
Drain fat from hamburger.
Add tomato paste and tomato sauce.
Stir to mix.
Salt and pepper to taste.
recipes.text: Easy Spaghetti. Fry hamburger until brown. While frying, add chopped onion and green pepper. Drain fat from hamburger. Add tomato paste and tomato sauce. Stir to mix. Salt and pepper to taste.

recipes.title: Fresh Tomato Bake
ingredients: 1/2 c. plus 2 Tbsp. butter or margarine, divided
directions: Heat
tablespoons
butter;
add onion and brown. Set aside. In
tablespoons butter, lightly brown bread crumbs; set aside. Mix tomatoes, salt, pepper, sugar and basil.
recipes.text: Fresh Tomato Bake. Heat 2 tablespoons butter; add onion and brown. Set aside. In 6 tablespoons butter, lightly brown bread crumbs; set aside. Mix tomatoes, salt, pepper, sugar and basil.

recipes.title: Fresh Vegetable Salad
directions: Put the lemon juice over the vegetables.
Use Ranch style dressing (enough to mix well).
This can be made ahead of serving time.
Serves 12.
recipes.text: Fresh Vegetable Salad. Put the lemon juice over the vegetables. Use Ranch style dressing (enough to mix well). This can be made ahead of serving time. Serves 12.

recipes.title: Sweet And Sour Sauce
directions: Mix all ingredients.
Simmer 10 minutes.
Make a paste with cornstarch and water.
Add and cook until thick.
Store with lid loose in cool, dry place.
Keeps for 2 months or more.
recipes.text: Sweet And Sour Sauce. Mix all ingredients. Simmer 10 minutes. Make a paste with cornstarch and water. Add and cook until thick. Store with lid loose in cool, dry place. Keeps for 2 months or more.

recipes.title: Tangy Slaw
directions: Combine cabbage, green pepper, carrots and onion in a large bowl.
recipes.text: Tangy Slaw. Combine cabbage, green pepper, carrots and onion in a large bowl.

recipes.title: Chicken Spread
directions: Mix all ingredients well.
Spread on bread.
Makes 1 1/2 loaves.
recipes.text: Chicken Spread. Mix all ingredients well. Spread on bread. Makes 1 1/2 loaves.

recipes.title: Albondingas Soup
ingredients: 2 Tbsp. olive oil or vegetable oil
directions: In medium bowl, combine beef, crumbs, minced onion, water, eggs, salt and 1/4 teaspoon Tabasco sauce.
Mix well.
Shape into 1-inch meatballs.
Cover and refrigerate.
Coarsely chop enough green pepper to yield 1/2 cup.
Cut remainder into thin strips for garnish.
recipes.text: Albondingas Soup. In medium bowl, combine beef, crumbs, minced onion, water, eggs, salt and 1/4 teaspoon Tabasco sauce. Mix well. Shape into 1-inch meatballs. Cover and refrigerate. Coarsely chop enough green pepper to yield 1/2 cup. Cut remainder into thin strips for garnish.

recipes.title: Mustardy Fried Chicken Breasts
directions: Wipe chicken breasts with damp paper towel.
Sprinkle with salt and black pepper.
In a bowl, beat together egg and mustard. In separate bowl, combine Parmesan cheese and bread crumbs, mixing well.
recipes.text: Mustardy Fried Chicken Breasts. Wipe chicken breasts with damp paper towel. Sprinkle with salt and black pepper. In a bowl, beat together egg and mustard. In separate bowl, combine Parmesan cheese and bread crumbs, mixing well.

recipes.title: Homemade Chocolate Ice Cream
directions: Beat all ingredients thoroughly.
Pour into ice cream freezer.
Freeze until solid.
Makes 1 1/2 gallons of ice cream.
recipes.text: Homemade Chocolate Ice Cream. Beat all ingredients thoroughly. Pour into ice cream freezer. Freeze until solid. Makes 1 1/2 gallons of ice cream.

recipes.title: Coffee Walnut Cake
directions: Cream fat and sugar.
Add eggs one at a time.
Add sifted flour, salt and baking soda.
Folding lightly add coffee and chopped walnuts.
Mix well.
recipes.text: Coffee Walnut Cake. Cream fat and sugar. Add eggs one at a time. Add sifted flour, salt and baking soda. Folding lightly add coffee and chopped walnuts. Mix well.

recipes.title: Scotch Fudge(Easy And Tasty)
directions: Combine butterscotch bits and peanut butter in top of double boiler.
Place over hot, not boiling, water; stir till butterscotch melts.
Add milk, stir until well blended.
Pour into foil lined 8 x 8 square pan. Chill till firm, cut in 1 inch squares.
Store in covered container.
recipes.text: Scotch Fudge(Easy And Tasty). Combine butterscotch bits and peanut butter in top of double boiler. Place over hot, not boiling, water; stir till butterscotch melts. Add milk, stir until well blended. Pour into foil lined 8 x 8 square pan. Chill till firm, cut in 1 inch squares. Store in covered container.

recipes.title: Vickie'S Baked Beans
ingredients: 2 cans vegetarian beans (or equivalent amount dried, cooked beans)
1 c. brown sugar (more or less to taste)
directions: Mix together and place in greased dish.
Bake slowly at 300° for 2 hours, or until set.
recipes.text: Vickie'S Baked Beans. Mix together and place in greased dish. Bake slowly at 300° for 2 hours, or until set.

recipes.title: Fruit Salad
directions: Drain juices off peaches and pears; cut up into small chunks. Add pineapple chunks with juice to the lemon instant pudding.
Mix in the peaches and pears.
Add the sliced banana just before serving.
recipes.text: Fruit Salad. Drain juices off peaches and pears; cut up into small chunks. Add pineapple chunks with juice to the lemon instant pudding. Mix in the peaches and pears. Add the sliced banana just before serving.

recipes.title: Monkey Bread
ingredients: 1/4 c. brown sugar or more if desired
directions: Make mixture of first 3 ingredients. Cut each biscuit into quarters. Roll each biscuit quarter in sugar mixture and drop into Bundt cake pan. Pour remaining sugar over the top and sprinkle with the nuts. Melt the oleo and pour over the top of the biscuits. Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes or until golden brown. Pour glaze over top of cake after you remove it from pan while cake is still hot.
recipes.text: Monkey Bread. Make mixture of first 3 ingredients. Cut each biscuit into quarters. Roll each biscuit quarter in sugar mixture and drop into Bundt cake pan. Pour remaining sugar over the top and sprinkle with the nuts. Melt the oleo and pour over the top of the biscuits. Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes or until golden brown. Pour glaze over top of cake after you remove it from pan while cake is still hot.

recipes.title: Shrimp And Rice
directions: Clean and devein shrimp; sprinkle with Worcestershire sauce and paprika.
Melt butter or margarine in a large skillet.
Add celery, green pepper and onion.
Cook over low heat for 5 minutes. Add shrimp; increase heat and cook
5 minutes more, or until shrimp turn pink.
Add hot rice; mix thoroughly.
Remove from heat.
Fry bacon until crisp; crumble and add with bacon drippings to shrimp.
Add salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot.
recipes.text: Shrimp And Rice. Clean and devein shrimp; sprinkle with Worcestershire sauce and paprika. Melt butter or margarine in a large skillet. Add celery, green pepper and onion. Cook over low heat for 5 minutes. Add shrimp; increase heat and cook 5 minutes more, or until shrimp turn pink. Add hot rice; mix thoroughly. Remove from heat. Fry bacon until crisp; crumble and add with bacon drippings to shrimp. Add salt and pepper to taste. Serve hot.

recipes.title: Turkey 'N Stuffing Bake
ingredients: 1 (2.8 oz.) can Durkee French fried onions
1 (10 3/4 oz.) can cream of celery soup
directions: Wash thawed turkey with warm water inside and out.
Tie wings and legs tight to body.
Rub skin of turkey with margarine.
Shake 1 tablespoon flour in 1 Reynold's oven bag (turkey size).
Insert turkey in bag and tie end, leaving hole in end of bag to protect against bursting.
Place turkey with bag breast side down in microwave dish.
Microwave approximately 4 to 5 minutes per pound on High.
Divide time into quarters, turning bird every quarter of time.
Turn bird 270° each time to let juice run over turkey, ending with breast up.
Use oven gloves.
Make sure the hole at the end of the bag stays open.
Remove when time is over; let cool and carve.
Good luck.
recipes.text: Turkey 'N Stuffing Bake. Wash thawed turkey with warm water inside and out. Tie wings and legs tight to body. Rub skin of turkey with margarine. Shake 1 tablespoon flour in 1 Reynold's oven bag (turkey size). Insert turkey in bag and tie end, leaving hole in end of bag to protect against bursting. Place turkey with bag breast side down in microwave dish. Microwave approximately 4 to 5 minutes per pound on High. Divide time into quarters, turning bird every quarter of time. Turn bird 270° each time to let juice run over turkey, ending with breast up. Use oven gloves. Make sure the hole at the end of the bag stays open. Remove when time is over; let cool and carve. Good luck.

recipes.title: Lemon Cake
ingredients: 1 box lemon cake mix (without the pudding mix)
1 box (4 serving size) instant lemon pudding
directions: Mix cake mix and lemon pudding, then add eggs, lemon extract, lemon juice and oil.
Beat with mixer well.
Cook on 350° for 45 to 55 minutes.
While cake is cooking make the glaze.
recipes.text: Lemon Cake. Mix cake mix and lemon pudding, then add eggs, lemon extract, lemon juice and oil. Beat with mixer well. Cook on 350° for 45 to 55 minutes. While cake is cooking make the glaze.

recipes.title: Crab And Cheese Wontons
directions: Beat cream cheese, sesame oil, soy sauce and pepper until smooth.
Mix in chives and crab.
Fill wontons with 1 teaspoon of mixture.
In a wok, heat 1 to 1 1/2 inches of oil to 350°.
Fry 4 to 6 wontons at a time until golden.
If made ahead of time, wrap airtight and freeze.
To reheat, arrange on a baking sheet and bake at 350° for 15 minutes.
Serve with plum sauce for dipping.
Makes about 6 dozen.
recipes.text: Crab And Cheese Wontons. Beat cream cheese, sesame oil, soy sauce and pepper until smooth. Mix in chives and crab. Fill wontons with 1 teaspoon of mixture. In a wok, heat 1 to 1 1/2 inches of oil to 350°. Fry 4 to 6 wontons at a time until golden. If made ahead of time, wrap airtight and freeze. To reheat, arrange on a baking sheet and bake at 350° for 15 minutes. Serve with plum sauce for dipping. Makes about 6 dozen.

recipes.title: Oat Muffins
directions: Mix oats and buttermilk.
Let set overnight.
Add to oats and buttermilk, egg, oil, brown sugar, nuts and raisins.
In separate bowl, mix together flour, baking powder, soda, and salt.
Fold into wet mixture until dry ingredients are just moistened.
Pour into greased muffin tin (12).
Bake 25 minutes at 400°.
recipes.text: Oat Muffins. Mix oats and buttermilk. Let set overnight. Add to oats and buttermilk, egg, oil, brown sugar, nuts and raisins. In separate bowl, mix together flour, baking powder, soda, and salt. Fold into wet mixture until dry ingredients are just moistened. Pour into greased muffin tin (12). Bake 25 minutes at 400°.

recipes.title: Taco Pie
directions: Preheat oven to 400°.
Brown meat and drain.
Cook onion until tender.
Combine meat, onion, taco mix, salsa and tomato sauce.
Add water.
Add garlic, salt and oregano to taste.
Mix well.
Place ingredients in 1 pie shell and top with half of the cheese.
Place the second crust on top and seal.
Bake until pie shell is brown.
Remove from oven and place remaining cheese on top of pie while it is hot.
recipes.text: Taco Pie. Preheat oven to 400°. Brown meat and drain. Cook onion until tender. Combine meat, onion, taco mix, salsa and tomato sauce. Add water. Add garlic, salt and oregano to taste. Mix well. Place ingredients in 1 pie shell and top with half of the cheese. Place the second crust on top and seal. Bake until pie shell is brown. Remove from oven and place remaining cheese on top of pie while it is hot.

recipes.title: Forgotten Cookies
directions: Mix well and place heaping teaspoonful of mixture on cookie sheet.
Preheat oven to 350°.
Turn oven off and put in cookies for 2 hours or overnight.
Store in airtight container.
recipes.text: Forgotten Cookies. Mix well and place heaping teaspoonful of mixture on cookie sheet. Preheat oven to 350°. Turn oven off and put in cookies for 2 hours or overnight. Store in airtight container.

recipes.title: Awesome Corn Chowder
directions: In a big kettle, fry bacon until crispy. Remove from pan. Cook onions in grease from bacon. Parboil potatoes in a smaller pan. After onions are clear, add milk, corn and cooked potatoes. Warm on low temperature until hot. Stir frequently since corn and potatoes tend to stick. Add bacon when hot or if you have vegetarian friends, serve the bacon in a bowl as a condiment. Eat and enjoy!
recipes.text: Awesome Corn Chowder. In a big kettle, fry bacon until crispy. Remove from pan. Cook onions in grease from bacon. Parboil potatoes in a smaller pan. After onions are clear, add milk, corn and cooked potatoes. Warm on low temperature until hot. Stir frequently since corn and potatoes tend to stick. Add bacon when hot or if you have vegetarian friends, serve the bacon in a bowl as a condiment. Eat and enjoy!

recipes.title: Aunt Nellie'S Salad
directions: Combine cottage cheese, lemon jello, and boiling water.
Let cool.
When thickened, but not set, whip until fluffy.
Fold in remaining ingredients and chill.
recipes.text: Aunt Nellie'S Salad. Combine cottage cheese, lemon jello, and boiling water. Let cool. When thickened, but not set, whip until fluffy. Fold in remaining ingredients and chill.

recipes.title: Parsley Pinwheel Loaf
directions: Prepare hot roll mix with one egg and let rise. Beat other egg in a cup. Stir in cheese. Heat remaining ingredients in small saucepan until greens wilt. Cool and blend in beaten egg mix. Punch down dough. Knead a few times. Roll out to an 18 x 6 rectangle. Spread with parsley mix. Roll jelly fashion and place seam side down in greased 9 x 5 x 3 pan. Cover. Let rise again until double in size (about 45 minutes). Bake at 375° for 45 minutes or until bread gives a hollow sound when tapped.
recipes.text: Parsley Pinwheel Loaf. Prepare hot roll mix with one egg and let rise. Beat other egg in a cup. Stir in cheese. Heat remaining ingredients in small saucepan until greens wilt. Cool and blend in beaten egg mix. Punch down dough. Knead a few times. Roll out to an 18 x 6 rectangle. Spread with parsley mix. Roll jelly fashion and place seam side down in greased 9 x 5 x 3 pan. Cover. Let rise again until double in size (about 45 minutes). Bake at 375° for 45 minutes or until bread gives a hollow sound when tapped.

recipes.title: Teeny Wienies
ingredients: 1 pkg. tiny cocktail hot dogs or regular hot dogs cut into 1-inch chunks
directions: Heat until melted jelly and mustard.
Add hot dogs.
Simmer. Enjoy!
recipes.text: Teeny Wienies. Heat until melted jelly and mustard. Add hot dogs. Simmer. Enjoy!

recipes.title: Pickled Eggs
directions: In medium saucepan, over high heat, heat vinegar, sugar, spice, salt and bay leaves to boiling.
Place shelled eggs in 2-quart jar.
Add vinegar mixture to the eggs; let stand 2 days, then use.
recipes.text: Pickled Eggs. In medium saucepan, over high heat, heat vinegar, sugar, spice, salt and bay leaves to boiling. Place shelled eggs in 2-quart jar. Add vinegar mixture to the eggs; let stand 2 days, then use.

recipes.title: Spicy French Dressing
ingredients: 1 Tbsp. grated or finely minced garlic
directions: Mix all ingredients in blender.
Process until smooth.
Store in refrigerator until ready to serve.
Shake well before serving. This is a great light dressing for tossed salad.
recipes.text: Spicy French Dressing. Mix all ingredients in blender. Process until smooth. Store in refrigerator until ready to serve. Shake well before serving. This is a great light dressing for tossed salad.

recipes.title: Meat Loaf
directions: Preheat oven to 400°.
In large bowl, mix meat, eggs, green onions, onion, bread crumbs, milk, horseradish, salt, mustard and 1/4 cup catsup.
In 13 x 9-inch baking pan, shape meat mixture into 10 x 5-inch loaf, pressing firmly.
Spread remaining 1/2 cup catsup over loaf.
Bake 1 hour.
Garnish with green onion.
recipes.text: Meat Loaf. Preheat oven to 400°. In large bowl, mix meat, eggs, green onions, onion, bread crumbs, milk, horseradish, salt, mustard and 1/4 cup catsup. In 13 x 9-inch baking pan, shape meat mixture into 10 x 5-inch loaf, pressing firmly. Spread remaining 1/2 cup catsup over loaf. Bake 1 hour. Garnish with green onion.

recipes.title: Macaroni With Mixed Vegetables
directions: Cook vegetables and macaroni separately according to package directions; drain.
Combine milk and soup in saucepan; cook over low heat, stirring until smooth and heated through.
recipes.text: Macaroni With Mixed Vegetables. Cook vegetables and macaroni separately according to package directions; drain. Combine milk and soup in saucepan; cook over low heat, stirring until smooth and heated through.

recipes.title: Ranger Cookies
ingredients: 2 c. Rice Krispies (or other cereal may be substituted)
directions: Cream shortening and sugars together, add eggs and vanilla. Stir in dry ingredients, then cereals, coconut and nuts.
Drop by spoonfuls onto greased baking sheet, and bake at 350° for 10 to 12 minutes.
Makes 5 dozen.
recipes.text: Ranger Cookies. Cream shortening and sugars together, add eggs and vanilla. Stir in dry ingredients, then cereals, coconut and nuts. Drop by spoonfuls onto greased baking sheet, and bake at 350° for 10 to 12 minutes. Makes 5 dozen.

recipes.title: My Grandmother'S Carrot Cake
directions: Sift together flour, soda, salt, cinnamon and baking powder. In a separate bowl, beat oil, sugar and eggs.
Combine both; mix in carrots and nuts.
Pour into greased and floured tube pan. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
Do not open oven for the 1 hour of baking.
Test with toothpick.
Cool on rack and sprinkle with sifted powdered sugar.
recipes.text: My Grandmother'S Carrot Cake. Sift together flour, soda, salt, cinnamon and baking powder. In a separate bowl, beat oil, sugar and eggs. Combine both; mix in carrots and nuts. Pour into greased and floured tube pan. Bake at 350° for 1 hour. Do not open oven for the 1 hour of baking. Test with toothpick. Cool on rack and sprinkle with sifted powdered sugar.

recipes.title: Cheese Crisp
directions: Blend butter and cheese. Cut in remaining ingredients; mix well. Roll into balls and mash with fork. Cook about 10 minutes in 350° oven.
recipes.text: Cheese Crisp. Blend butter and cheese. Cut in remaining ingredients; mix well. Roll into balls and mash with fork. Cook about 10 minutes in 350° oven.

recipes.title: Baked Beans
directions: Melt butter.
Add sugar, spices, onion and beans.
Crumble bacon on top.
Bake at 300° for 3 hours.
recipes.text: Baked Beans. Melt butter. Add sugar, spices, onion and beans. Crumble bacon on top. Bake at 300° for 3 hours.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Fudge
directions: Bring sugar and milk to a rolling boil, stirring constantly. Reduce heat.
Cover and continue boiling for 3 to 5 minutes. Remove lid and continue to cook until small amount dropped in cold water forms a small ball.
Remove from stove and add peanut butter, marshmallow and vanilla.
Beat until thick enough to pour in a greased square 9-inch pan.
Cool and cut in squares.
recipes.text: Peanut Butter Fudge. Bring sugar and milk to a rolling boil, stirring constantly. Reduce heat. Cover and continue boiling for 3 to 5 minutes. Remove lid and continue to cook until small amount dropped in cold water forms a small ball. Remove from stove and add peanut butter, marshmallow and vanilla. Beat until thick enough to pour in a greased square 9-inch pan. Cool and cut in squares.

recipes.title: Meat Loaf Festiva
directions: Mix in	all
ingredients
by
hand, except catsup, in a large bowl.
Work
the
mixture into a large ball.
Divide the ball into 4	portions.
Press
each portion into a Bundt cake pan.
Place the
cake pan on a cookie sheet.
Bake at 315° for 1 1/2 hours. Drain
any fat every 1/2 hour.
Cool 15 minutes. Turn the meat loaf onto serving dish.
Garnish with catsup.
recipes.text: Meat Loaf Festiva. Mix in	all ingredients by hand, except catsup, in a large bowl. Work the mixture into a large ball. Divide the ball into 4	portions. Press each portion into a Bundt cake pan. Place the cake pan on a cookie sheet. Bake at 315° for 1 1/2 hours. Drain any fat every 1/2 hour. Cool 15 minutes. Turn the meat loaf onto serving dish. Garnish with catsup.

recipes.title: Baked Eggplant
directions: Wash,
peel
and
slice
eggplant into 1/2-inch slices. Grease a baking dish.
Arrange eggplant slices in baking dish. Cover with stewed tomatoes, green pepper and onion.
Sprinkle with salt,
pepper, garlic salt and Parmesan cheese.
Bake at 350° for 35 minutes or until done.
recipes.text: Baked Eggplant. Wash, peel and slice eggplant into 1/2-inch slices. Grease a baking dish. Arrange eggplant slices in baking dish. Cover with stewed tomatoes, green pepper and onion. Sprinkle with salt, pepper, garlic salt and Parmesan cheese. Bake at 350° for 35 minutes or until done.

recipes.title: Hot Artichoke Dip
ingredients: 2 cans artichoke hearts, drained and chopped
1 c. Miracle Whip or Hellmann's salad dressing
directions: Mix all ingredients.
Spoon in casserole dish.
You can sprinkle bread crumbs on top, if desired.
Heat oven to 350°. Bake for about 20 to 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Hot Artichoke Dip. Mix all ingredients. Spoon in casserole dish. You can sprinkle bread crumbs on top, if desired. Heat oven to 350°. Bake for about 20 to 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Toffee Bar Crunch Pie
ingredients: 1 (4 oz.) pkg. vanilla flavor instant pudding
6 bars (1.4 oz. each) chocolate covered English toffee, chopped
1 Keebler Ready-Crust graham cracker pie crust
directions: Spread dessert topping on bottom of crust.
Pour milk into large bowl.
Add pudding mix.
Beat with wire whisk 2 minutes. Let stand 5 minutes.
Stir in Cool Whip and chopped toffee bars. Spoon into crust.
Freeze 4 hours or until set.
Let stand at room temperature 15 minutes or until pie can be cut easily.
recipes.text: Toffee Bar Crunch Pie. Spread dessert topping on bottom of crust. Pour milk into large bowl. Add pudding mix. Beat with wire whisk 2 minutes. Let stand 5 minutes. Stir in Cool Whip and chopped toffee bars. Spoon into crust. Freeze 4 hours or until set. Let stand at room temperature 15 minutes or until pie can be cut easily.

recipes.title: Fried Potato Cakes
directions: Combine potatoes, flour, egg, milk and onion in bowl; mix well.
Drop by spoonfuls into hot oil in skillet.
Brown on both sides, pressing with spatula to flatten.
Yields 12 cakes.
recipes.text: Fried Potato Cakes. Combine potatoes, flour, egg, milk and onion in bowl; mix well. Drop by spoonfuls into hot oil in skillet. Brown on both sides, pressing with spatula to flatten. Yields 12 cakes.

recipes.title: Breakfast Casserole(Serves 6 To 8)
directions: Beat eggs and milk together.
Layer in casserole bread, ham and cheese.
Sprinkle flour, mustard and butter.
Pour over milk and eggs.
Chill about 4 hours or overnight.
May be frozen.!
recipes.text: Breakfast Casserole(Serves 6 To 8). Beat eggs and milk together. Layer in casserole bread, ham and cheese. Sprinkle flour, mustard and butter. Pour over milk and eggs. Chill about 4 hours or overnight. May be frozen.!

recipes.title: Bean Sprout Salad
directions: Blanche bean sprouts in boiling water for 2 minutes and drain thoroughly.
Mix the remaining ingredients in a large bowl, then add the drained sprouts.
Chill thoroughly before serving.
Yield: 4 to 6 servings.
recipes.text: Bean Sprout Salad. Blanche bean sprouts in boiling water for 2 minutes and drain thoroughly. Mix the remaining ingredients in a large bowl, then add the drained sprouts. Chill thoroughly before serving. Yield: 4 to 6 servings.

recipes.title: Rhubarb-Raspberry Pie
ingredients: 4 c. rhubarb, cut in small pieces
directions: Beat egg, flour, honey and jello together.
Add to cut up rhubarb.
Place between crusts in a 9-inch pie plate.
Bake 50 minutes in a 350° oven.
recipes.text: Rhubarb-Raspberry Pie. Beat egg, flour, honey and jello together. Add to cut up rhubarb. Place between crusts in a 9-inch pie plate. Bake 50 minutes in a 350° oven.

recipes.title: Picnic Potatoes
directions: Melt butter; add potatoes.
Sprinkle with dressing.
Cover with foil and bake 1 hour.
Serves 25.
recipes.text: Picnic Potatoes. Melt butter; add potatoes. Sprinkle with dressing. Cover with foil and bake 1 hour. Serves 25.

recipes.title: Cho-Cherry Cake
directions: Blend cake using only the eggs and pie filling.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
Cool.
recipes.text: Cho-Cherry Cake. Blend cake using only the eggs and pie filling. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes. Cool.

recipes.title: Angel Food Cake
directions: Place egg whites in large mixing bowl with salt and extracts. Sift cream of tartar over the top.
Beat until the whites have no air bubbles, but are still moist.
Add 1 1/4 cups only of the sifted sugar, 1 tablespoon at a time, beating until the dry sugar disappears.
When sugar is all in, mixture stands in soft peaks whose tips bend slightly.
Sift flour with remaining 1/4 cup of sugar and fold sugar flour mixture into meringue, 1 tablespoon at a time.
Mix only until no flour can be seen.
Turn mixture into a 10-inch ungreased tube pan.
Release air bubbles by zig-zagging spatula through mixture.
recipes.text: Angel Food Cake. Place egg whites in large mixing bowl with salt and extracts. Sift cream of tartar over the top. Beat until the whites have no air bubbles, but are still moist. Add 1 1/4 cups only of the sifted sugar, 1 tablespoon at a time, beating until the dry sugar disappears. When sugar is all in, mixture stands in soft peaks whose tips bend slightly. Sift flour with remaining 1/4 cup of sugar and fold sugar flour mixture into meringue, 1 tablespoon at a time. Mix only until no flour can be seen. Turn mixture into a 10-inch ungreased tube pan. Release air bubbles by zig-zagging spatula through mixture.

recipes.title: Pineapple Casserole
directions: Drain
pineapple
and
place in 2 quart casserole.
Mix cheese, sugar, flour and pineapple juice and pour over pineapple. Top
with
crushed Ritz crackers and drizzle with melted oleo. Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.
Serves 6 to 8.
recipes.text: Pineapple Casserole. Drain pineapple and place in 2 quart casserole. Mix cheese, sugar, flour and pineapple juice and pour over pineapple. Top with crushed Ritz crackers and drizzle with melted oleo. Bake at 350° for 20 minutes. Serves 6 to 8.

recipes.title: Chicken Curry
ingredients: small bunch seedless white Tokay grapes, cut in half
directions: Mix and pour over big chunks of chicken placed in a 9 x 13-inch pan sprayed with Pam.
Bake at 325° for 20 to 30 minutes until warm.
Can omit curry.
recipes.text: Chicken Curry. Mix and pour over big chunks of chicken placed in a 9 x 13-inch pan sprayed with Pam. Bake at 325° for 20 to 30 minutes until warm. Can omit curry.

recipes.title: Grannie Buster'S Venison Roast
directions: For 24 hours, marinate venison in a crock which contains equal parts water and vinegar, enough to cover roast and the onions, bay leaves, peppercorns, celery seed and tarragon leaves.
Then remove roast and drain.
recipes.text: Grannie Buster'S Venison Roast. For 24 hours, marinate venison in a crock which contains equal parts water and vinegar, enough to cover roast and the onions, bay leaves, peppercorns, celery seed and tarragon leaves. Then remove roast and drain.

recipes.title: Pink Delight
directions: Mix all ingredients together and chill.
Serve.
recipes.text: Pink Delight. Mix all ingredients together and chill. Serve.

recipes.title: Caroline Marsh'S Impossible Coconut Pie
directions: Beat first 4 ingredients together well.
Add melted margarine, vanilla and coconut.
Beat all ingredients together.
Grease (or spray with Pam) 2 pie plates and pour mixture into the 2 pie plates, dividing mixture equally.
Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes.
When cold it slices well and it makes its own crust!
recipes.text: Caroline Marsh'S Impossible Coconut Pie. Beat first 4 ingredients together well. Add melted margarine, vanilla and coconut. Beat all ingredients together. Grease (or spray with Pam) 2 pie plates and pour mixture into the 2 pie plates, dividing mixture equally. Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes. When cold it slices well and it makes its own crust!

recipes.title: Green Stuff
directions: Combine ingredients until well mixed.
Pour into a container.
recipes.text: Green Stuff. Combine ingredients until well mixed. Pour into a container.

recipes.title: Pear Relish
directions: Grind pears, onions and peppers in blender. Mix vinegar, sugar, salt and spices. Bring to a boil. Add pears, onions and peppers. Bring to a boil and cook at reduced heat for 20 minutes. Put into sterilized jars and seal.
recipes.text: Pear Relish. Grind pears, onions and peppers in blender. Mix vinegar, sugar, salt and spices. Bring to a boil. Add pears, onions and peppers. Bring to a boil and cook at reduced heat for 20 minutes. Put into sterilized jars and seal.

recipes.title: Lemon Pie
directions: Bring to boil, milk, sugar and margarine. Add eggs and cornstarch and cook until thick.
Add lemon juice and vanilla. Whip.
Place in baked pie shell.
Use egg whites for meringue.
recipes.text: Lemon Pie. Bring to boil, milk, sugar and margarine. Add eggs and cornstarch and cook until thick. Add lemon juice and vanilla. Whip. Place in baked pie shell. Use egg whites for meringue.

recipes.title: Sweet And Sour Kebabs
ingredients: 2 large cans Spam, cut into 1-inch squares
directions: Drain pineapple; reserve juice.
In saucepan mix brown sugar and cornstarch.
Slowly add juice, vinegar and soy sauce.
Cook and stir until thick and bubbly.
Cook 1 to 2 minutes more.
On toothpicks thread meat and pineapple.
Place on cookie sheet. Baste with sauce.
Broil 4 to 5 inches from heat for 8 to 10 minutes.
Turn once and baste with sauce.
Keep remaining sauce for dipping.
recipes.text: Sweet And Sour Kebabs. Drain pineapple; reserve juice. In saucepan mix brown sugar and cornstarch. Slowly add juice, vinegar and soy sauce. Cook and stir until thick and bubbly. Cook 1 to 2 minutes more. On toothpicks thread meat and pineapple. Place on cookie sheet. Baste with sauce. Broil 4 to 5 inches from heat for 8 to 10 minutes. Turn once and baste with sauce. Keep remaining sauce for dipping.

recipes.title: Zucchini Fritters
directions: In colander mix zucchini and salt; let drain about 15 minutes. Squeeze out excess liquid.
Mix zucchini, carrot, onion, parsley, egg, flour and pepper.
Drop by tablespoonfuls into 1/2 inch hot oil in skillet.
Fry until brown on both sides.
Drain on absorbent paper.
Serve hot.
Makes 12 servings.
recipes.text: Zucchini Fritters. In colander mix zucchini and salt; let drain about 15 minutes. Squeeze out excess liquid. Mix zucchini, carrot, onion, parsley, egg, flour and pepper. Drop by tablespoonfuls into 1/2 inch hot oil in skillet. Fry until brown on both sides. Drain on absorbent paper. Serve hot. Makes 12 servings.

recipes.title: Cheese Ball
directions: Mix together and form into a ball.
Roll in chopped pecans and refrigerate.
recipes.text: Cheese Ball. Mix together and form into a ball. Roll in chopped pecans and refrigerate.

recipes.title: Noodles Romanoff
ingredients: 1 c. Old English sharp cheese, grated
directions: Boil noodles in salted water until just tender.
Drain and combine gently with all remaining ingredients except sharp cheese. Place in a buttered 2-quart baking dish and sprinkle grated cheese on top.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
Serves 8 to 10.
recipes.text: Noodles Romanoff. Boil noodles in salted water until just tender. Drain and combine gently with all remaining ingredients except sharp cheese. Place in a buttered 2-quart baking dish and sprinkle grated cheese on top. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes. Serves 8 to 10.

recipes.title: Vanilla Wafer Tarts
directions: Put cupcake liners in muffin pans.
Put wafer in bottom of liner.
Cream the cream cheese and sugar.
Add vanilla and eggs. Mix well.
Pour batter into cupcake liner.
Bake 15 minutes at 350°.
When cool, spoon on pie filling as topping.
recipes.text: Vanilla Wafer Tarts. Put cupcake liners in muffin pans. Put wafer in bottom of liner. Cream the cream cheese and sugar. Add vanilla and eggs. Mix well. Pour batter into cupcake liner. Bake 15 minutes at 350°. When cool, spoon on pie filling as topping.

recipes.title: Cheese Danish(Serves 24)
ingredients: 1 egg plus 1 egg yolk or 2 small eggs
directions: Place 2 packages crescent roll mix on bottom of large cookie sheet.
Combine cream cheese, egg, sugar and flavoring in large bowl and cream together.
Spread mixture over rolls and top with other 2 packages of crescent rolls.
Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.
recipes.text: Cheese Danish(Serves 24). Place 2 packages crescent roll mix on bottom of large cookie sheet. Combine cream cheese, egg, sugar and flavoring in large bowl and cream together. Spread mixture over rolls and top with other 2 packages of crescent rolls. Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Fried Garden Gumbo
directions: Mix all ingredients together and coat with flour and corn meal. Fry in skillet of oil until tender and golden brown.
recipes.text: Fried Garden Gumbo. Mix all ingredients together and coat with flour and corn meal. Fry in skillet of oil until tender and golden brown.

recipes.title: Black Olive Casserole
directions: Cook macaroni and set aside.
Brown meat.
Add onion, olives and tomatoes.
Cook for a few minutes.
Add cooked macaroni.
Mix well.
Add grated cheeses on top.
Cook in oven to melt cheese.
recipes.text: Black Olive Casserole. Cook macaroni and set aside. Brown meat. Add onion, olives and tomatoes. Cook for a few minutes. Add cooked macaroni. Mix well. Add grated cheeses on top. Cook in oven to melt cheese.

recipes.title: Egg Custard Pie
directions: Mix and cook in unbaked crust at 350°. Alice Ellis is in the Attala County Nursing Home now, but, she remembers making this pie for eatings at Springdale.
recipes.text: Egg Custard Pie. Mix and cook in unbaked crust at 350°. Alice Ellis is in the Attala County Nursing Home now, but, she remembers making this pie for eatings at Springdale.

recipes.title: Broccoli Vinaigrette
ingredients: 1 or 2 heads of broccoli, cut into small spears
1 tsp. garlic salt or 1/2 tsp. minced garlic
directions: Mix all ingredients and use to marinate broccoli for several hours or overnight, in refrigerator.
Serve cold as an appetizer.
recipes.text: Broccoli Vinaigrette. Mix all ingredients and use to marinate broccoli for several hours or overnight, in refrigerator. Serve cold as an appetizer.

recipes.title: Cheese Spaghetti
directions: Combine all ingredients.
Mix thoroughly.
Pour into casserole dish.
Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes.
recipes.text: Cheese Spaghetti. Combine all ingredients. Mix thoroughly. Pour into casserole dish. Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes.

recipes.title: One Hour Yeast Rolls
directions: Dissolve the yeast in the lukewarm water.
Place the milk, sugar, butter and salt in a pan.
Heat until lukewarm.
Add yeast and flour; mix well.
Place in a greased bowl and brush the top with melted butter.
Let rise for 15 minutes.
Turn out onto a floured board.
Pat until 3/4-inch thick.
Cut into rounds with a floured biscuit cutter.
Fold the rolls over and press the edges together lightly.
Place on a greased baking sheet.
Let rise 15 minutes.
Bake in 425° oven for 10 minutes.
Brush with melted butter.
Makes about 3 dozen rolls.
recipes.text: One Hour Yeast Rolls. Dissolve the yeast in the lukewarm water. Place the milk, sugar, butter and salt in a pan. Heat until lukewarm. Add yeast and flour; mix well. Place in a greased bowl and brush the top with melted butter. Let rise for 15 minutes. Turn out onto a floured board. Pat until 3/4-inch thick. Cut into rounds with a floured biscuit cutter. Fold the rolls over and press the edges together lightly. Place on a greased baking sheet. Let rise 15 minutes. Bake in 425° oven for 10 minutes. Brush with melted butter. Makes about 3 dozen rolls.

recipes.title: Annie Rice Pudding
directions: Cook rice in water until all water is absorbed.
Add remaining ingredients except raisins.
Cook slowly in heavy pot 1 1/2 to 2 hours, stirring often.
Cook until thick, then add raisins the last 15 minutes.
Remove from heat.
Stir in vanilla.
Cool.
Top with cinnamon and/or nutmeg if desired.
recipes.text: Annie Rice Pudding. Cook rice in water until all water is absorbed. Add remaining ingredients except raisins. Cook slowly in heavy pot 1 1/2 to 2 hours, stirring often. Cook until thick, then add raisins the last 15 minutes. Remove from heat. Stir in vanilla. Cool. Top with cinnamon and/or nutmeg if desired.

recipes.title: Chicken Honey Nut Stir-Fry
directions: Cut chicken into thin strips; set aside.
In small bowl, combine orange juice, honey, soy sauce, cornstarch and ginger. Mix well.
Heat 1 tablespoon oil in large skillet over medium heat.
Add carrots and celery.
Stir-fry about 3 minutes.
Remove vegetables and set aside.
recipes.text: Chicken Honey Nut Stir-Fry. Cut chicken into thin strips; set aside. In small bowl, combine orange juice, honey, soy sauce, cornstarch and ginger. Mix well. Heat 1 tablespoon oil in large skillet over medium heat. Add carrots and celery. Stir-fry about 3 minutes. Remove vegetables and set aside.

recipes.title: Apple Dapple
directions: Mix eggs, white sugar and oil.
Sift flour, salt and soda. Add sifted ingredients to egg mixture.
Add apples, vanilla and nuts (if you want); mix well.
Pour into greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes, or until done.
recipes.text: Apple Dapple. Mix eggs, white sugar and oil. Sift flour, salt and soda. Add sifted ingredients to egg mixture. Add apples, vanilla and nuts (if you want); mix well. Pour into greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes, or until done.

recipes.title: Taco Dip
directions: Mix the first three ingredients together, layer in a serving dish with tomato, lettuce and cheddar cheese.
recipes.text: Taco Dip. Mix the first three ingredients together, layer in a serving dish with tomato, lettuce and cheddar cheese.

recipes.title: Hominy Salad
ingredients: 6 slivers jalapeno peppers or to taste
directions: Mix and bake for 30 minutes in a 350° oven.
recipes.text: Hominy Salad. Mix and bake for 30 minutes in a 350° oven.

recipes.title: Savory Potato Gratin(4 Servings)
ingredients: 4 to 5 medium potatoes, peeled and sliced
3 to 4 medium onions, peeled and sliced
directions: Saute onions in butter in a large skillet until soft and transparent.
In a shallow baking dish, arrange in layers the sliced onions and potatoes, sprinkling with garlic and seasonings in between layers for best flavor.
Bake at 350° for about 40 minutes.
Add whipping cream all over top.
Increase temperature to 400°.
Bake for another 10 to 20 minutes until potatoes are soft and fork-tender and gratin is slightly browned on top.
recipes.text: Savory Potato Gratin(4 Servings). Saute onions in butter in a large skillet until soft and transparent. In a shallow baking dish, arrange in layers the sliced onions and potatoes, sprinkling with garlic and seasonings in between layers for best flavor. Bake at 350° for about 40 minutes. Add whipping cream all over top. Increase temperature to 400°. Bake for another 10 to 20 minutes until potatoes are soft and fork-tender and gratin is slightly browned on top.

recipes.title: Lime Party Salad(Serves 20)
directions: Melt marshmallows in top of double boiler with one cup of milk.
Pour hot mixture over lime jello and stir until dissolved. Stir cream cheese in hot mixture until cheese dissolves.
Add pineapple.
Cool mixture.
Keep stirring until cool to touch.
recipes.text: Lime Party Salad(Serves 20). Melt marshmallows in top of double boiler with one cup of milk. Pour hot mixture over lime jello and stir until dissolved. Stir cream cheese in hot mixture until cheese dissolves. Add pineapple. Cool mixture. Keep stirring until cool to touch.

recipes.title: Velveeta Cheese Chocolate Candy(Fudge)
directions: Cube
cheese
and
melt
in double boiler or microwave. Melt margarine.	Mix all ingredients well and press into 2 (9 x 13-inch)
baking
pans.
Let
set in refrigerator for 2 to 3 hours.
Cut into squares.
recipes.text: Velveeta Cheese Chocolate Candy(Fudge). Cube cheese and melt in double boiler or microwave. Melt margarine.	Mix all ingredients well and press into 2 (9 x 13-inch) baking pans. Let set in refrigerator for 2 to 3 hours. Cut into squares.

recipes.title: Vanilla Ice Cream(Makes 4 Quarts)
directions: Beat eggs until light.
Add sugar gradually, beating until mixture thickens.
Add condensed milk, vanilla and salt.
Mix and chill 2 hours before freezing.
recipes.text: Vanilla Ice Cream(Makes 4 Quarts). Beat eggs until light. Add sugar gradually, beating until mixture thickens. Add condensed milk, vanilla and salt. Mix and chill 2 hours before freezing.

recipes.title: Green Bean Casserole
directions: Preheat oven to 350°.
Drain beans and combine all ingredients except cheese and onions.
Pour mixture into 1 1/2 quart casserole dish; top with cheese.
Bake 30 to 35 minutes.
Top with onions.
recipes.text: Green Bean Casserole. Preheat oven to 350°. Drain beans and combine all ingredients except cheese and onions. Pour mixture into 1 1/2 quart casserole dish; top with cheese. Bake 30 to 35 minutes. Top with onions.

recipes.title: Wilma'S Sponge Cake
directions: Heat oven to 325°.
In small bowl, beat eggs yolks until very thick.
Pour yolks into large mixer bowl.
Gradually beat in sugar. On low speed, mix in flour, baking powder and salt alternately with water, flavorings and lemon peel.
In another bowl, beat egg whites and cream of tartar until stiff.
Gradually fold egg yolk mixture into egg whites.
Pour into greased tube pan.
Bake 60 to 65 minutes.
Invert pan on funnel.
Let hang until cake is completely cool.
recipes.text: Wilma'S Sponge Cake. Heat oven to 325°. In small bowl, beat eggs yolks until very thick. Pour yolks into large mixer bowl. Gradually beat in sugar. On low speed, mix in flour, baking powder and salt alternately with water, flavorings and lemon peel. In another bowl, beat egg whites and cream of tartar until stiff. Gradually fold egg yolk mixture into egg whites. Pour into greased tube pan. Bake 60 to 65 minutes. Invert pan on funnel. Let hang until cake is completely cool.

recipes.title: No Cook Marshmallow Frosting
directions: Beat egg whites with salt until they form soft peaks.
Add sugar, one tablespoon at a time, beating until smooth and glossy. Add syrup, a little at a time and beat after each addition until frosting holds firm peaks.
Fold in vanilla.
recipes.text: No Cook Marshmallow Frosting. Beat egg whites with salt until they form soft peaks. Add sugar, one tablespoon at a time, beating until smooth and glossy. Add syrup, a little at a time and beat after each addition until frosting holds firm peaks. Fold in vanilla.

recipes.title: Merry Christmas Cookies
ingredients: 3 cups flour sifted with 1 tsp cinnamon and 1 tsp allspice
2 cups candied cherries, red or green
directions: Cream sugar and margarine.
Add beaten eggs.
Add milk and flour alternately.
Add pineapple, cherries, dates and pecans. Mix all together.
(Can use hands.)
recipes.text: Merry Christmas Cookies. Cream sugar and margarine. Add beaten eggs. Add milk and flour alternately. Add pineapple, cherries, dates and pecans. Mix all together. (Can use hands.)

recipes.title: Ugly Duckling Cake
ingredients: 16 oz. can fruit cocktail and juice
directions: Blend cake mix, pudding, fruit cocktail and juice, coconut, eggs and oil in large bowl.
Beat 4 minutes at medium speed.
Pour into greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan.
Sprinkle packed brown sugar and chopped nuts over cake.
Bake 45 minutes at 325°.
Cool 15 minutes and then glaze.
recipes.text: Ugly Duckling Cake. Blend cake mix, pudding, fruit cocktail and juice, coconut, eggs and oil in large bowl. Beat 4 minutes at medium speed. Pour into greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan. Sprinkle packed brown sugar and chopped nuts over cake. Bake 45 minutes at 325°. Cool 15 minutes and then glaze.

recipes.title: Old Fashioned Oatmeal Cookies
ingredients: 2 c. chopped nuts, shredded carrots, carob chips, raisins, etc. (optional)
directions: Cream shortening, sugars, vinegar and salt.
Add vanilla and eggs.
Mix well.
In a separate bowl, combine flour, baking soda and baking powder.
Add to creamed mixture.
Stir in oats and optional ingredients, if desired.
Bake at 350° for 10 minutes.
recipes.text: Old Fashioned Oatmeal Cookies. Cream shortening, sugars, vinegar and salt. Add vanilla and eggs. Mix well. In a separate bowl, combine flour, baking soda and baking powder. Add to creamed mixture. Stir in oats and optional ingredients, if desired. Bake at 350° for 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Neiman Marcus Brownies
directions: Mix above ingredients well and pat into a 9 x 13 inch pan.
recipes.text: Neiman Marcus Brownies. Mix above ingredients well and pat into a 9 x 13 inch pan.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Cookies
directions: Cream butter and sugar until light and fluffy.
Beat in egg, pumpkin and vanilla.
Mix and sift flour, baking powder, baking soda, salt, nutmeg and cinnamon.
Add to creamed mixture; mix well.
Add chocolate pieces and mix thoroughly.
Drop dough by teaspoons onto well-greased cookie sheets.
Bake at 350° for 15 minutes or until light brown.
Remove while still warm; cool on rack.
Makes 6 dozen.
recipes.text: Pumpkin Cookies. Cream butter and sugar until light and fluffy. Beat in egg, pumpkin and vanilla. Mix and sift flour, baking powder, baking soda, salt, nutmeg and cinnamon. Add to creamed mixture; mix well. Add chocolate pieces and mix thoroughly. Drop dough by teaspoons onto well-greased cookie sheets. Bake at 350° for 15 minutes or until light brown. Remove while still warm; cool on rack. Makes 6 dozen.

recipes.title: Lazy Weekend Beef Casserole
ingredients: 1 lb. beef chuck or stewing beef, cut into 2-inch chunks
1/2 c. California Burgundy, Claret or other red dinner wine
directions: Combine beef, wine, consomme, salt, pepper and onion in casserole.
Mix flour with crumbs; stir into casserole mixture. Cover; bake in slow oven (300°) for about 3 hours, or until beef is tender.
Serves 4.
recipes.text: Lazy Weekend Beef Casserole. Combine beef, wine, consomme, salt, pepper and onion in casserole. Mix flour with crumbs; stir into casserole mixture. Cover; bake in slow oven (300°) for about 3 hours, or until beef is tender. Serves 4.

recipes.title: Southern Baked Rabbit
directions: Clean rabbits, then cut in pieces at joints.
Cover with cold water.
Add vinegar and let stand overnight.
Drain and dry well. Rub with salt, pepper and butter.
Place in baking pan in 400° oven for 15 minutes.
recipes.text: Southern Baked Rabbit. Clean rabbits, then cut in pieces at joints. Cover with cold water. Add vinegar and let stand overnight. Drain and dry well. Rub with salt, pepper and butter. Place in baking pan in 400° oven for 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Sweet 'N Sour Pork Chops
directions: Brown chops; pour off excess fat.
Drain fruit, reserving syrup.
Add remaining ingredients to syrup; pour over chops in skillet.
Cook, covered, over low heat 1/2 hour or until tender, turning chops once or twice.
Remove meat to platter.
Stir fruit into sauce; heat to boiling.
Spoon some sauce over chops; pass remainder.
Makes six servings.
recipes.text: Sweet 'N Sour Pork Chops. Brown chops; pour off excess fat. Drain fruit, reserving syrup. Add remaining ingredients to syrup; pour over chops in skillet. Cook, covered, over low heat 1/2 hour or until tender, turning chops once or twice. Remove meat to platter. Stir fruit into sauce; heat to boiling. Spoon some sauce over chops; pass remainder. Makes six servings.

recipes.title: Peter Paul Mounds
directions: Mix all ingredients real well.
Form into balls (size of walnuts).
Chill and dip in dipping chocolate.
Place on wax paper until chocolate is firm.
recipes.text: Peter Paul Mounds. Mix all ingredients real well. Form into balls (size of walnuts). Chill and dip in dipping chocolate. Place on wax paper until chocolate is firm.

recipes.title: Turtle Cake
directions: Mix cake mix according to package directions.
Pour half of batter in 9 x 13-inch pan.
Bake at 350° for 15 minutes.
Melt caramel and butter; add milk.
Pour over top of partially baked cake.
Add chocolate chips and nuts.
Pour remaining cake batter over mixture, covering caramels mixture, chips and nuts.
Bake at 350° for another 20 minutes.
Can serve with ice cream or Cool Whip on top.
recipes.text: Turtle Cake. Mix cake mix according to package directions. Pour half of batter in 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350° for 15 minutes. Melt caramel and butter; add milk. Pour over top of partially baked cake. Add chocolate chips and nuts. Pour remaining cake batter over mixture, covering caramels mixture, chips and nuts. Bake at 350° for another 20 minutes. Can serve with ice cream or Cool Whip on top.

recipes.title: Beefy Spanish Rice
directions: I cook this in the microwave.
recipes.text: Beefy Spanish Rice. I cook this in the microwave.

recipes.title: Soda Cracker Pie
directions: Beat egg whites until stiff.
Beat in sugar and vanilla.
Fold in nuts and crushed crackers.
Put in 9-inch buttered pie pan. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
Cool.
Beat 1 package Dream Whip. Cover pie with Dream Whip and sprinkle with frozen coconut.
recipes.text: Soda Cracker Pie. Beat egg whites until stiff. Beat in sugar and vanilla. Fold in nuts and crushed crackers. Put in 9-inch buttered pie pan. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes. Cool. Beat 1 package Dream Whip. Cover pie with Dream Whip and sprinkle with frozen coconut.

recipes.title: Tuna Broccoli Casserole
ingredients: 1/4 pkg. stuffing mix (I use Pepperidge Farm)
directions: Place broccoli in casserole.
Spread tuna over the top.
Add one-half can of the mushroom soup, the stuffing mix and then the rest of the soup.
Top with Cheddar cheese and bake in a 350° oven for one hour.
Serves four.
recipes.text: Tuna Broccoli Casserole. Place broccoli in casserole. Spread tuna over the top. Add one-half can of the mushroom soup, the stuffing mix and then the rest of the soup. Top with Cheddar cheese and bake in a 350° oven for one hour. Serves four.

recipes.title: Chicken Spaghetti Casserole
directions: Mix first ten ingredients together in saucepan and cook until thickened.
Cook spaghetti and drain.
Mix sauce together with chicken and spaghetti in casserole dish.
Bake at 350° for 35 to 45 minutes.
The last ten minutes, sprinkle with grated cheese and return to oven until cheese is melted.
recipes.text: Chicken Spaghetti Casserole. Mix first ten ingredients together in saucepan and cook until thickened. Cook spaghetti and drain. Mix sauce together with chicken and spaghetti in casserole dish. Bake at 350° for 35 to 45 minutes. The last ten minutes, sprinkle with grated cheese and return to oven until cheese is melted.

recipes.title: Gingerbread People
ingredients: raisins, citron, candied cherries, red gumdrops, string licorice
directions: Cream shortening and sugar.
Blend in molasses, water, flour, salt, soda, ginger, nutmeg and allspice.
Chill 2 to 3 hours. Heat oven to 350°.
Roll dough 1/4-inch thick on lightly floured board.
Cut with gingerbread people cutters.
Place on ungreased baking sheet.
Press raisins into dough for eyes, nose and buttons.
Use other items to trim as you choose.
Bake 10 to 12 minutes.
Remove to wire rack.
Trim with decorators icing. Yield: 14.
Recipe may be doubled.
recipes.text: Gingerbread People. Cream shortening and sugar. Blend in molasses, water, flour, salt, soda, ginger, nutmeg and allspice. Chill 2 to 3 hours. Heat oven to 350°. Roll dough 1/4-inch thick on lightly floured board. Cut with gingerbread people cutters. Place on ungreased baking sheet. Press raisins into dough for eyes, nose and buttons. Use other items to trim as you choose. Bake 10 to 12 minutes. Remove to wire rack. Trim with decorators icing. Yield: 14. Recipe may be doubled.

recipes.title: German Potato Salad
directions: Boil the potatoes until done.
Peel and slice while still warm.
Stir while pouring on the vinegar and hot grease.
Garnish with the bacon and chopped parsley, if available.
Sprinkle with sugar if too tart due to the vinegar.
recipes.text: German Potato Salad. Boil the potatoes until done. Peel and slice while still warm. Stir while pouring on the vinegar and hot grease. Garnish with the bacon and chopped parsley, if available. Sprinkle with sugar if too tart due to the vinegar.

recipes.title: Black-Eyed Pea Casserole
directions: Brown ground beef and onion in skillet; make cornbread mix. Add peas,
1/2 of grated cheese and creamed corn.
Mix thoroughly; pour over ground beef and mix.
Add rest of grated cheese over top of casserole.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Black-Eyed Pea Casserole. Brown ground beef and onion in skillet; make cornbread mix. Add peas, 1/2 of grated cheese and creamed corn. Mix thoroughly; pour over ground beef and mix. Add rest of grated cheese over top of casserole. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Sandy'S Shrimp Creole
directions: Peel, devein and wash shrimp.
Melt butter in large skillet over medium heat.
Add onion and green pepper.
Saute until soft; stir in garlic.
Remove from heat; blend in flour until smooth. Add tomato sauce and simmer 5 minutes.
Gradually add water, stirring to blend.
Add shrimp and all remaining ingredients. Cover and simmer about 40 minutes.
Serve over hot, cooked rice.
recipes.text: Sandy'S Shrimp Creole. Peel, devein and wash shrimp. Melt butter in large skillet over medium heat. Add onion and green pepper. Saute until soft; stir in garlic. Remove from heat; blend in flour until smooth. Add tomato sauce and simmer 5 minutes. Gradually add water, stirring to blend. Add shrimp and all remaining ingredients. Cover and simmer about 40 minutes. Serve over hot, cooked rice.

recipes.title: Hot Cocktail Sausages
ingredients: 1 (18 oz.) pkg. thick and spicy original Kraft barbecue sauce
2 Tbsp. Scott's barbecue sauce (any hot sauce may be used)
directions: Heat all ingredients except sausages.
When hot, add sausages and simmer until ready to use.
recipes.text: Hot Cocktail Sausages. Heat all ingredients except sausages. When hot, add sausages and simmer until ready to use.

recipes.title: Lemon Meltaways
directions: In a mixing bowl, cream butter and confectioners sugar until light and fluffy. Beat in lemon juice. Combine the flour and cornstarch; gradually add to the creamed mixture. Shape into two 8-inch rolls; wrap each roll in plastic wrap. Refrigerate for 2 hours or until firm. Unwrap & cut into 1/4 inch slices. Place 2 inches apart on ungreased baking sheets. Bake at 350 degrees for 8-12 minutes or until the cookies are firm to the touch. Remove to wire racks to cool.
recipes.text: Lemon Meltaways. In a mixing bowl, cream butter and confectioners sugar until light and fluffy. Beat in lemon juice. Combine the flour and cornstarch; gradually add to the creamed mixture. Shape into two 8-inch rolls; wrap each roll in plastic wrap. Refrigerate for 2 hours or until firm. Unwrap & cut into 1/4 inch slices. Place 2 inches apart on ungreased baking sheets. Bake at 350 degrees for 8-12 minutes or until the cookies are firm to the touch. Remove to wire racks to cool.

recipes.title: Ranch Veggies
ingredients: 1 pkg. Hidden Valley Original Ranch milk recipe dry salad dressing mix
directions: Combine Hidden Valley Original Ranch milk recipe dry salad dressing mix with oil in a large bowl.
Mix with frozen mixed vegetables and toss.
Bake in casserole dish in a 375° oven for 30 minutes.
Stir every 10 minutes while baking.
recipes.text: Ranch Veggies. Combine Hidden Valley Original Ranch milk recipe dry salad dressing mix with oil in a large bowl. Mix with frozen mixed vegetables and toss. Bake in casserole dish in a 375° oven for 30 minutes. Stir every 10 minutes while baking.

recipes.title: Potato Casserole
ingredients: 2 lb. frozen hash brown potatoes (do not thaw)
directions: Put all ingredients in mixing bowl and mix.
Place in 9 x 13-inch casserole dish and top with corn flakes, mixed with melted margarine.
Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 45 minutes to 1 hour.
recipes.text: Potato Casserole. Put all ingredients in mixing bowl and mix. Place in 9 x 13-inch casserole dish and top with corn flakes, mixed with melted margarine. Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 45 minutes to 1 hour.

recipes.title: Zucchini Casserole
ingredients: 1 (8 oz.) pkg. Pepperidge Farm seasoned stuffing mix, crushed
directions: Wash and slice zucchini.
Don't peel.
Cook in boiling water 5 minutes.
Drain.
Combine soup, carrot, sour cream and onion.
Add chicken, if desired.
Fold zucchini into mixture.
Add melted butter to stuffing.
Reserve 1 cup of crumbs.
Spread the rest of the crumbs in large casserole, 9 x 13 x 2-inch.
Spoon vegetable mixture over crumbs.
Top with remaining crumbs.
Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Zucchini Casserole. Wash and slice zucchini. Don't peel. Cook in boiling water 5 minutes. Drain. Combine soup, carrot, sour cream and onion. Add chicken, if desired. Fold zucchini into mixture. Add melted butter to stuffing. Reserve 1 cup of crumbs. Spread the rest of the crumbs in large casserole, 9 x 13 x 2-inch. Spoon vegetable mixture over crumbs. Top with remaining crumbs. Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Turkey And Stuffing Bake
directions: Grease a 3-quart baking dish.
Mix baking mix, milk, eggs, parsley, sage, thyme, salt, poultry seasoning and pepper in bowl. Mix with fork until batter is slightly lumpy and of uniform color. Stir in remaining ingredients.
Bake at 400° for 35 to 40 minutes.
recipes.text: Turkey And Stuffing Bake. Grease a 3-quart baking dish. Mix baking mix, milk, eggs, parsley, sage, thyme, salt, poultry seasoning and pepper in bowl. Mix with fork until batter is slightly lumpy and of uniform color. Stir in remaining ingredients. Bake at 400° for 35 to 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Rolled Dumplings
directions: Combine flour, baking powder and salt.
Cut in shortening.
Add milk to make a stiff dough.
Roll out to about 1/8 inch thickness and cut into 1-inch squares, 1 to 1 1/2-inch strips or diamonds. Sprinkle lightly with flour and drop into boiling ham broth.
Cover loosely and boil gently for 8 to 10 minutes.
Yield:
6 to 8 servings.
recipes.text: Rolled Dumplings. Combine flour, baking powder and salt. Cut in shortening. Add milk to make a stiff dough. Roll out to about 1/8 inch thickness and cut into 1-inch squares, 1 to 1 1/2-inch strips or diamonds. Sprinkle lightly with flour and drop into boiling ham broth. Cover loosely and boil gently for 8 to 10 minutes. Yield: 6 to 8 servings.

recipes.title: Chili Cheese Dip
directions: Spread cream cheese in baking dish.
Cover with chili.
Top with Cheddar cheese and microwave for 7 to 8 minutes at 50% power or until cheese is melted.
Serve with tortilla chips.
recipes.text: Chili Cheese Dip. Spread cream cheese in baking dish. Cover with chili. Top with Cheddar cheese and microwave for 7 to 8 minutes at 50% power or until cheese is melted. Serve with tortilla chips.

recipes.title: Lemon Sponge Cake
directions: Blend butter with sugar and flour; add egg yolks, lemon juice and peel and milk.
Fold in egg whites.
Pour into 9-inch pastry-lined pie pan.
Bake in hot oven (450°) for 8 minutes, then in moderate oven (325°) for 25 minutes.
Like my mother used to bake.
recipes.text: Lemon Sponge Cake. Blend butter with sugar and flour; add egg yolks, lemon juice and peel and milk. Fold in egg whites. Pour into 9-inch pastry-lined pie pan. Bake in hot oven (450°) for 8 minutes, then in moderate oven (325°) for 25 minutes. Like my mother used to bake.

recipes.title: Shrimp Pizza
ingredients: 1 (6 1/2 oz.) can small shrimp, rinsed and drained
directions: Spread cream cheese mixed with 1/2 cup milk onto a round flat platter to resemble pizza dough.
Spread cocktail sauce to within 1/2-inch of edge.
Sprinkle cheese, onions and pepper on and top with shrimp and black olives.
Sprinkle with garlic powder and parsley.
Chill.
Serve with favorite crackers or corn chips. Serves 12.
recipes.text: Shrimp Pizza. Spread cream cheese mixed with 1/2 cup milk onto a round flat platter to resemble pizza dough. Spread cocktail sauce to within 1/2-inch of edge. Sprinkle cheese, onions and pepper on and top with shrimp and black olives. Sprinkle with garlic powder and parsley. Chill. Serve with favorite crackers or corn chips. Serves 12.

recipes.title: Mimi'S Turtle Cake
directions: Prepare cake mix as directed in a 9 x 13-inch pan.
When done, poke holes all over cake.
Pour can of sweetened condensed milk over hot cake.
Then pour caramel over cake and spread evenly. Then sprinkle chopped walnuts over cake.
Whip heavy cream with sugar until thick and fluffy.
Spread over cake when cake is cooled.
Refrigerate.
recipes.text: Mimi'S Turtle Cake. Prepare cake mix as directed in a 9 x 13-inch pan. When done, poke holes all over cake. Pour can of sweetened condensed milk over hot cake. Then pour caramel over cake and spread evenly. Then sprinkle chopped walnuts over cake. Whip heavy cream with sugar until thick and fluffy. Spread over cake when cake is cooled. Refrigerate.

recipes.title: Coconut Sour Cream Cake
directions: Prepare cake according to directions making 2 (8-inch) layers. When completely cool, split both layers.
Combine sugar, sour cream and coconut and blend well.
Spread between layers and on top of cake.
Seal in airtight container and refrigerate 3 days before serving.
recipes.text: Coconut Sour Cream Cake. Prepare cake according to directions making 2 (8-inch) layers. When completely cool, split both layers. Combine sugar, sour cream and coconut and blend well.
