Spread between layers and on top of cake. Seal in airtight container and refrigerate 3 days before serving.

recipes.title: Marzetti
directions: Place cooked spaghetti in large greased casserole.
In separate pan, brown beef; drain fat, and add onion, salt, pepper and soups.
Simmer 15 minutes.
Add cheese and mix to melt.
Mix this mixture with spaghetti.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese and serve.
recipes.text: Marzetti. Place cooked spaghetti in large greased casserole. In separate pan, brown beef; drain fat, and add onion, salt, pepper and soups. Simmer 15 minutes. Add cheese and mix to melt. Mix this mixture with spaghetti. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese and serve.

recipes.title: German Apple Pancakes
directions: Heat oven to 400°.
Place 2 round layer pans, 9 x 1 1/2-inch in oven.
Beat eggs, flour, milk and salt in small mixer bowl on medium speed for 1 minute. Remove pans from oven.
Place 2 tablespoons margarine in each pan; rotate pans until margarine is melted and coats sides of pans.
Arrange half of apple slices in each pan; divide batter evenly between pans.
Mix sugar and cinnamon; sprinkle 2 tablespoons sugar mixture over batter in each pan.
Bake, uncovered, until puffed and golden brown, about 25 minutes.
recipes.text: German Apple Pancakes. Heat oven to 400°. Place 2 round layer pans, 9 x 1 1/2-inch in oven. Beat eggs, flour, milk and salt in small mixer bowl on medium speed for 1 minute. Remove pans from oven. Place 2 tablespoons margarine in each pan; rotate pans until margarine is melted and coats sides of pans. Arrange half of apple slices in each pan; divide batter evenly between pans. Mix sugar and cinnamon; sprinkle 2 tablespoons sugar mixture over batter in each pan. Bake, uncovered, until puffed and golden brown, about 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Dirt
directions: Crush Oreos.
Cream margarine, cream cheese and sugar.
Add milk, pudding and Cool Whip to creamed mixture.
Mix well.
Line 8-inch flowerpot with plastic wrap to cover holes.
Alternate 1-inch layer of crumbs and filling, ending with crumbs. Refrigerate at least 2 hours.
Decorate with flowers, shovels or gummy worms.
recipes.text: Dirt. Crush Oreos. Cream margarine, cream cheese and sugar. Add milk, pudding and Cool Whip to creamed mixture. Mix well. Line 8-inch flowerpot with plastic wrap to cover holes. Alternate 1-inch layer of crumbs and filling, ending with crumbs. Refrigerate at least 2 hours. Decorate with flowers, shovels or gummy worms.

recipes.title: Poppy Seed Cake
directions: Mix everything until smooth.
Pour into 10-inch tube pan (greased and floured).
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Poppy Seed Cake. Mix everything until smooth. Pour into 10-inch tube pan (greased and floured). Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Frozen Cherry Salad
directions: Mix all ingredients together and freeze.
(Does not have to be refrozen, but may be kept in the refrigerator.)
recipes.text: Frozen Cherry Salad. Mix all ingredients together and freeze. (Does not have to be refrozen, but may be kept in the refrigerator.)

recipes.title: Cinnamon Rolls
directions: Mix cake mix, yeast, flour and warm water.
Let rise until double in size.
Cut dough in half.
Roll into rectangle on a floured surface; spread with butter or oleo.
Sprinkle with white powdered sugar and cinnamon.
Roll in jelly roll fashion; cut into 2-inch rolls.
Repeat with second half of dough.
Place in two greased 9 x 13-inch pans.
Let rise.
Bake at 375° for 25 minutes.
recipes.text: Cinnamon Rolls. Mix cake mix, yeast, flour and warm water. Let rise until double in size. Cut dough in half. Roll into rectangle on a floured surface; spread with butter or oleo. Sprinkle with white powdered sugar and cinnamon. Roll in jelly roll fashion; cut into 2-inch rolls. Repeat with second half of dough. Place in two greased 9 x 13-inch pans. Let rise. Bake at 375° for 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Pasta Fa Sou
ingredients: 1 small onion, cut in small pieces
salt, pepper and parsley to taste
directions: Break spaghetti into thirds and cook; drain.
In 1 tablespoon oil cook the onion until light brown.
Add the sauce, beans, salt, pepper and parsley.
Let simmer 3 minutes.
Add sauce to spaghetti and simmer 3 to 5 minutes.
recipes.text: Pasta Fa Sou. Break spaghetti into thirds and cook; drain. In 1 tablespoon oil cook the onion until light brown. Add the sauce, beans, salt, pepper and parsley. Let simmer 3 minutes. Add sauce to spaghetti and simmer 3 to 5 minutes.

recipes.title: Apple Pie A La Mode
ingredients: 1 pt. butter pecan ice cream, softened
1 jar (12 oz) caramel ice cream topping
directions: Spread half of the pie filling over crust.
Top with half the ice cream; cover and freeze for 30 minutes.
Drizzle with half of the caramel topping; cover and freeze for 30 minutes.
Top with remaining pie filling; cover and freeze for 30 minutes.
Top with remaining ice cream; cover and freeze until firm.
May be frozen for up to 2 months.
Remove from freezer about 30 minutes before serving.
Warm remaining caramel topping; drizzle some on serving plates.
Top with a slice of pie; drizzle remaining caramel topping over pie and sprinkle with pecans.
Serves 6 to 8.
recipes.text: Apple Pie A La Mode. Spread half of the pie filling over crust. Top with half the ice cream; cover and freeze for 30 minutes. Drizzle with half of the caramel topping; cover and freeze for 30 minutes. Top with remaining pie filling; cover and freeze for 30 minutes. Top with remaining ice cream; cover and freeze until firm. May be frozen for up to 2 months. Remove from freezer about 30 minutes before serving. Warm remaining caramel topping; drizzle some on serving plates. Top with a slice of pie; drizzle remaining caramel topping over pie and sprinkle with pecans. Serves 6 to 8.

recipes.title: Scalloped Cabbage
directions: Cover cabbage with water and add salt.
Bring to boil only. Drain well.
Put in casserole.
Add 1 can cream of celery soup. Sprinkle with cracker crumbs and dot with butter.
Bake at 350° for 1/2 hour until brown.
recipes.text: Scalloped Cabbage. Cover cabbage with water and add salt. Bring to boil only. Drain well. Put in casserole. Add 1 can cream of celery soup. Sprinkle with cracker crumbs and dot with butter. Bake at 350° for 1/2 hour until brown.

recipes.title: Microwave Fudge
directions: Sift powdered sugar and cocoa together.
Add evaporated milk and butter or margarine.
Cook on Medium-high for 3 1/2 minutes. Mix in vanilla and nuts or coconut.
Pour in a small square buttered pan.
Place in refrigerator.
Makes about 1 pound.
(Keep in refrigerator.)
recipes.text: Microwave Fudge. Sift powdered sugar and cocoa together. Add evaporated milk and butter or margarine. Cook on Medium-high for 3 1/2 minutes. Mix in vanilla and nuts or coconut. Pour in a small square buttered pan. Place in refrigerator. Makes about 1 pound. (Keep in refrigerator.)

recipes.title: Hot 'N' Heavenly Chicken Breasts
ingredients: 1/2 c. flour, mixed with 1/2 tsp. celery salt, 1/2 tsp. poultry seasoning and 1/2 tsp. ground cumin
1/3 c. picante sauce (hot, medium or mild)
1 (8 oz.) pkg. angel hair pasta, cooked
directions: Dredge chicken in seasoned flour.
In medium frying pan, melt margarine with onion and garlic.
Add chicken and saute until lightly brown.
Add bouillon cube, mixed with water, and simmer 10 minutes.
Combine sour cream, lemon juice and picante sauce.
Pour over chicken; simmer, heating through.
Serve over angel hair pasta.
Serves 4.
recipes.text: Hot 'N' Heavenly Chicken Breasts. Dredge chicken in seasoned flour. In medium frying pan, melt margarine with onion and garlic. Add chicken and saute until lightly brown. Add bouillon cube, mixed with water, and simmer 10 minutes. Combine sour cream, lemon juice and picante sauce. Pour over chicken; simmer, heating through. Serve over angel hair pasta. Serves 4.

recipes.title: Potato Salad From Grandma Noyes
ingredients: 1 pt. Kraft (regular or light) Miracle Whip (not mayo)
directions: Cook potatoes with skins on.
Cool, peel and cut into bite size pieces.
Place in large bowl.
Cook and peel eggs.
Chop 6 eggs, using egg slicer 2 ways.
Add to bowl.
Slice 2 eggs, using egg slicer 1 way and set aside for garnish.
Finely chop celery stalks and add to bowl.
Spoon 3/4 jar of Miracle Whip into bowl and mix until all potatoes are well covered.
Add salt and pepper to taste and mix in.
Garnish top with reserved egg slices and lightly sprinkle with paprika.
Chill and serve.
(This salad is best served chilled, not ice cold.)
Serves 15 to 18.
recipes.text: Potato Salad From Grandma Noyes. Cook potatoes with skins on. Cool, peel and cut into bite size pieces. Place in large bowl. Cook and peel eggs. Chop 6 eggs, using egg slicer 2 ways. Add to bowl. Slice 2 eggs, using egg slicer 1 way and set aside for garnish. Finely chop celery stalks and add to bowl. Spoon 3/4 jar of Miracle Whip into bowl and mix until all potatoes are well covered. Add salt and pepper to taste and mix in. Garnish top with reserved egg slices and lightly sprinkle with paprika. Chill and serve. (This salad is best served chilled, not ice cold.) Serves 15 to 18.

recipes.title: Beef Enchiladas
ingredients: 1 lb. ground beef, browned and drained
directions: Dip tortillas, one at a time, into hot oil to soften and drain on paper towel.
Sprinkle beef, onion, cheese and pepper on tortilla and roll up.
Place, overlapped side down, in shallow baking dish and cover with enchilada sauce.
Top with grated cheese and bake at 350° until cheese is melted.
A can of nacho cheese soup poured along with the enchilada sauce on top of these enchiladas is good.
Just mix soup and sauce thoroughly and pour over top and heat thoroughly.
recipes.text: Beef Enchiladas. Dip tortillas, one at a time, into hot oil to soften and drain on paper towel. Sprinkle beef, onion, cheese and pepper on tortilla and roll up. Place, overlapped side down, in shallow baking dish and cover with enchilada sauce. Top with grated cheese and bake at 350° until cheese is melted. A can of nacho cheese soup poured along with the enchilada sauce on top of these enchiladas is good. Just mix soup and sauce thoroughly and pour over top and heat thoroughly.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Sticks
ingredients: 1 loaf day old bread, thinly sliced
directions: Cut crusts off bread.
Cut bread slices into 4 fingers.
Toast crust and bread fingers at 200° for about 2 hours, stirring occasionally.
Roll crusts into a fine crumb.
Mix together peanut butter and oil in saucepan over low heat, stirring well.
Dip bread sticks into peanut butter mixture and roll in crumbs.
Place on wax paper.
Nice for a party or to serve as a snack; isn't very sweet.
recipes.text: Peanut Butter Sticks. Cut crusts off bread. Cut bread slices into 4 fingers. Toast crust and bread fingers at 200° for about 2 hours, stirring occasionally. Roll crusts into a fine crumb. Mix together peanut butter and oil in saucepan over low heat, stirring well. Dip bread sticks into peanut butter mixture and roll in crumbs. Place on wax paper. Nice for a party or to serve as a snack; isn't very sweet.

recipes.title: Broiled Fish A L'Orange
directions: Arrange fish on rack in broiler pan.
Combine remaining ingredients and brush lightly over fish.
Place under hot broiler for 10 minutes, basting with remaining sauce.
recipes.text: Broiled Fish A L'Orange. Arrange fish on rack in broiler pan. Combine remaining ingredients and brush lightly over fish. Place under hot broiler for 10 minutes, basting with remaining sauce.

recipes.title: Sweet 'N Sour Hot Dogs
ingredients: 1 pkg. mini hot dogs or pkg. regular hot dogs cut into bite size pieces
1 small pkg. whole mushrooms or 1 jar whole mushrooms
1/2 green pepper, cut into bite size pieces
directions: In crock-pot put the ingredients.
Turn on low.
Simmer until ready.
Longer allowed to sit, spicier it is!
recipes.text: Sweet 'N Sour Hot Dogs. In crock-pot put the ingredients. Turn on low. Simmer until ready. Longer allowed to sit, spicier it is!

recipes.title: Shish-Kabobs
ingredients: 3 large green, red or yellow peppers
1-2 lbs fresh mushrooms, washed and stems removed
1-8 oz bottle red Russian salad dressing
1/4 c prepared mustard or honey mustard
directions: Combine salad dressing, ketchup, mustard, wine, salt and pepper and Worcestershire sauce in large bowl.
Mix well.
recipes.text: Shish-Kabobs. Combine salad dressing, ketchup, mustard, wine, salt and pepper and Worcestershire sauce in large bowl. Mix well.

recipes.title: Grandma'S Divinity
directions: Cook sugar, water and Karo at 260°.
Beat egg whites until stiff.
Pour sugar into egg whites in slow stream.
Add vanilla and beat until shine goes away (5 to 10 minutes).
Finish by hand. Add pecans and drop onto waxed paper.
recipes.text: Grandma'S Divinity. Cook sugar, water and Karo at 260°. Beat egg whites until stiff. Pour sugar into egg whites in slow stream. Add vanilla and beat until shine goes away (5 to 10 minutes). Finish by hand. Add pecans and drop onto waxed paper.

recipes.title: Mashed Potato Casserole
directions: Mix potatoes and enough water to cover in 4-quart saucepan. Bring to boil.
Reduce heat to medium.
Cook 25 to 30 minutes or until tender.
Drain well.
Mash potatoes, gradually stirring in salad dressing, cream cheese, onion powder, salt and pepper until light and fluffy.
Spoon into 1 1/2-quart casserole.
Sprinkle with paprika.
Heat oven to 350°.
Bake 30 to 35 minutes or until thoroughly heated.
recipes.text: Mashed Potato Casserole. Mix potatoes and enough water to cover in 4-quart saucepan. Bring to boil. Reduce heat to medium. Cook 25 to 30 minutes or until tender. Drain well. Mash potatoes, gradually stirring in salad dressing, cream cheese, onion powder, salt and pepper until light and fluffy. Spoon into 1 1/2-quart casserole. Sprinkle with paprika. Heat oven to 350°. Bake 30 to 35 minutes or until thoroughly heated.

recipes.title: Chicken In The Garden
ingredients: 1 (10 oz.) pkg. frozen mixed vegetables, thawed
1 can water chestnuts, drained and sliced
1 small can French fried onion rings
directions: Preheat oven to 375°.
Combine chicken, vegetables, water chestnuts, soup and milk; mix well.
Add 1 cup onion rings. Pour into 1 1/2-quart casserole.
Bake, covered, for 45 minutes. Uncover and top with remaining onion rings.
Bake, uncovered, for 10 minutes.
Serves 6.
recipes.text: Chicken In The Garden. Preheat oven to 375°. Combine chicken, vegetables, water chestnuts, soup and milk; mix well. Add 1 cup onion rings. Pour into 1 1/2-quart casserole. Bake, covered, for 45 minutes. Uncover and top with remaining onion rings. Bake, uncovered, for 10 minutes. Serves 6.

recipes.title: Holiday Joy
directions: Use large wishing bowl and mix above ingredients together until lumps disappear.
Bake in ample pan of joy until nicely brown.
Cool with comforting words.
To seal the generation gap use warm understanding!
Serve a "peace" everyday to give your life contentment.
No refrigeration needed.
Serve to everyone.
recipes.text: Holiday Joy. Use large wishing bowl and mix above ingredients together until lumps disappear. Bake in ample pan of joy until nicely brown. Cool with comforting words. To seal the generation gap use warm understanding! Serve a "peace" everyday to give your life contentment. No refrigeration needed. Serve to everyone.

recipes.title: Seedless Green Grape Pie
directions: Heat oven to 425°.
Make your favorite pie crust; stir sugar, flour and salt together.
Mix gently with washed grapes.
Pour into pastry-lined pie pan; dot with butter.
Cover with top crust; make a couple of slits and lightly sprinkle with sugar or make lattice top if preferred.
Bake for 35 to 45 minutes.
Is best served warm.
recipes.text: Seedless Green Grape Pie. Heat oven to 425°. Make your favorite pie crust; stir sugar, flour and salt together. Mix gently with washed grapes. Pour into pastry-lined pie pan; dot with butter. Cover with top crust; make a couple of slits and lightly sprinkle with sugar or make lattice top if preferred. Bake for 35 to 45 minutes. Is best served warm.

recipes.title: Marinara Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 tsp. each oregano, basil and parsley
directions: Saute garlic and onions in oil.
Add remaining ingredients; bring to a boil.
Cover, reduce heat and simmer 20 minutes to 1 hour.
Makes 4 servings.
recipes.text: Marinara Sauce. Saute garlic and onions in oil. Add remaining ingredients; bring to a boil. Cover, reduce heat and simmer 20 minutes to 1 hour. Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: Bologna
directions: Mix all ingredients for 5 minutes. Make 2 rolls and wrap in foil. Refrigerate 24 hours. Poke holes in bottom of foil. Bake on broiler pan at 275 degrees for 2 hours.
recipes.text: Bologna. Mix all ingredients for 5 minutes. Make 2 rolls and wrap in foil. Refrigerate 24 hours. Poke holes in bottom of foil. Bake on broiler pan at 275 degrees for 2 hours.

recipes.title: Crock-Pot Chili
ingredients: 1 1/2 lb. dried pinto or kidney beans or 2 (1 lb.) cans pinto or kidney beans, drained
2 lb. ground chuck, browned and drained
1 tsp. salt and pepper to taste
directions: Preboil dry beans until soft.
Drain well.
Place all ingredients in crock-pot in order listed.
Stir, cover and cook on low heat for 10 to 12 hours (high 5 to 6 hours).
Recipe may be halved.
recipes.text: Crock-Pot Chili. Preboil dry beans until soft. Drain well. Place all ingredients in crock-pot in order listed. Stir, cover and cook on low heat for 10 to 12 hours (high 5 to 6 hours). Recipe may be halved.

recipes.title: Erlene'S Pillow-Soft Rolls
directions: Combine 1 1/4 cups flour, sugar, yeast and salt. In a saucepan, heat sour cream and water to 120° to 130°. Add to dry ingredients and beat until blended. Beat in eggs until smooth. Exchange beater for dough hook and turn to speed 2. Add enough of remaining flour to form a soft dough. Continuing on speed 2, knead 5 minutes, until dough is smooth and elastic.
recipes.text: Erlene'S Pillow-Soft Rolls. Combine 1 1/4 cups flour, sugar, yeast and salt. In a saucepan, heat sour cream and water to 120° to 130°. Add to dry ingredients and beat until blended. Beat in eggs until smooth. Exchange beater for dough hook and turn to speed 2. Add enough of remaining flour to form a soft dough. Continuing on speed 2, knead 5 minutes, until dough is smooth and elastic.

recipes.title: Mexican Chicken
directions: In casserole dish, place a layer of tortilla chips and top with chicken breasts.
Cover with salsa and sprinkle with cheese.
Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes.
recipes.text: Mexican Chicken. In casserole dish, place a layer of tortilla chips and top with chicken breasts. Cover with salsa and sprinkle with cheese. Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Brownies
directions: In double boiler, melt oleo and chocolate.
Cool slightly. Beat eggs, sugar and vanilla.
Add to chocolate mixture.
Add flour and milk.
Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes in a 13 x 15-inch pan.
recipes.text: Brownies. In double boiler, melt oleo and chocolate. Cool slightly. Beat eggs, sugar and vanilla. Add to chocolate mixture. Add flour and milk. Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes in a 13 x 15-inch pan.

recipes.title: Best Ever Banana Bread
directions: Cream together butter, sugar and eggs. Mix sour cream and soda together in bowl and let stand until foamy. Add the rest of the ingredients to the above mixtures and mix well. Place into 4 greased and floured 9 x 5-inch bread pans or into 12 prepared mini loaf pans. Sprinkle lightly with sugar just before baking. Bake at 350° for 50 minutes or until a toothpick inserted comes out clean. Note: You may add 1 cup of chopped nuts to the batter if you wish. You may also use Egg Beaters, low-fat sour cream and margarine. This is a very moist bread recipe which makes a lot and freezes well.
recipes.text: Best Ever Banana Bread. Cream together butter, sugar and eggs. Mix sour cream and soda together in bowl and let stand until foamy. Add the rest of the ingredients to the above mixtures and mix well. Place into 4 greased and floured 9 x 5-inch bread pans or into 12 prepared mini loaf pans. Sprinkle lightly with sugar just before baking. Bake at 350° for 50 minutes or until a toothpick inserted comes out clean. Note: You may add 1 cup of chopped nuts to the batter if you wish. You may also use Egg Beaters, low-fat sour cream and margarine. This is a very moist bread recipe which makes a lot and freezes well.

recipes.title: Oven Chicken
directions: Coat chicken pieces in melted butter.
Combine corn flake crumbs, cheese, salt and pepper.
Dip chicken in this mixture. Place in buttered pan and brown in a 350° oven.
Sprinkle a few drops of water on browned chicken pieces.
Cover with foil.
Bake for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Oven Chicken. Coat chicken pieces in melted butter. Combine corn flake crumbs, cheese, salt and pepper. Dip chicken in this mixture. Place in buttered pan and brown in a 350° oven. Sprinkle a few drops of water on browned chicken pieces. Cover with foil. Bake for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Chocolate Zucchini Cake
directions: Melt chocolate over hot water; cool.
Beat eggs until thick and lemon colored.
Add sugar; beat well.
Add oil and chocolate; blend well.
Combine dry ingredients; add to liquid mixture and beat until smooth.
Stir in zucchini and 1 cup nuts.
Batter will be very thick.
Pour into greased and floured 10-inch tube pan. Sprinkle with 1/4 cup nuts.
Bake at 350° for 1 1/4 hours.
recipes.text: Chocolate Zucchini Cake. Melt chocolate over hot water; cool. Beat eggs until thick and lemon colored. Add sugar; beat well. Add oil and chocolate; blend well. Combine dry ingredients; add to liquid mixture and beat until smooth. Stir in zucchini and 1 cup nuts. Batter will be very thick. Pour into greased and floured 10-inch tube pan. Sprinkle with 1/4 cup nuts. Bake at 350° for 1 1/4 hours.

recipes.title: Sugar Cookies
directions: Mix all ingredients to form dough. Roll out on flat surface. Cut into desired shapes. Bake 8 to 10 minutes at 375° just until edges turn lightly brown.
recipes.text: Sugar Cookies. Mix all ingredients to form dough. Roll out on flat surface. Cut into desired shapes. Bake 8 to 10 minutes at 375° just until edges turn lightly brown.

recipes.title: Old-Fashioned Oat Cookies
ingredients: 1/2 tsp. each: baking soda and salt
1/4 c. butter or margarine (at room temperature)
6 Tbsp. unsalted butter or margarine (at room temperature)
1 large Granny Smith apple, peeled, quartered, cored and cut in 1/4-inch pieces (1 1/4 c.)
1 1/2 tsp. finely chopped crystallized ginger or 1/2 tsp. ground ginger
directions: Custard may be made up to 2 days ahead.
Glaze keeps at least 2 weeks.
recipes.text: Old-Fashioned Oat Cookies. Custard may be made up to 2 days ahead. Glaze keeps at least 2 weeks.

recipes.title: Watergate Salad
directions: Combine all ingredients well.
Refrigerate until cool and serve.
recipes.text: Watergate Salad. Combine all ingredients well. Refrigerate until cool and serve.

recipes.title: Hamburger Chop Suey
directions: Brown meat.
Mix all ingredients; put in casserole.
Add 2 cups boiling water.
Bake 1 hour at 350°.
Last 15 minutes, add 1/3 cup soy sauce and can of chow mein noodles.
recipes.text: Hamburger Chop Suey. Brown meat. Mix all ingredients; put in casserole. Add 2 cups boiling water. Bake 1 hour at 350°. Last 15 minutes, add 1/3 cup soy sauce and can of chow mein noodles.

recipes.title: City Chicken
ingredients: 2 lb. veal or pork, cut in 1 1/2-inch cubes
directions: Thread veal or pork cubes onto short skewers.
Combine crumbs and seasonings.
Combine egg and milk.
Dip meat in egg mixture, then in crumbs.
Brown slowly on all sides in hot shortening. Dissolve bouillon cube in 1/2 cup boiling water.
Add to meat, cover and bake at 350° for 45 minutes.
Uncover and bake 30 minutes.
recipes.text: City Chicken. Thread veal or pork cubes onto short skewers. Combine crumbs and seasonings. Combine egg and milk. Dip meat in egg mixture, then in crumbs. Brown slowly on all sides in hot shortening. Dissolve bouillon cube in 1/2 cup boiling water. Add to meat, cover and bake at 350° for 45 minutes. Uncover and bake 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Fantastic Corn On The Cob
ingredients: 6 ears frozen or fresh sweet corn
directions: Boil corn for 15 minutes.
Remove from water and place in rectangular dish.
Sprinkle with spices and add butter.
Sprinkle corn with Parmesan cheese.
Cover dish with foil and place in warm oven until ready to serve.
Serves 6.
recipes.text: Fantastic Corn On The Cob. Boil corn for 15 minutes. Remove from water and place in rectangular dish. Sprinkle with spices and add butter. Sprinkle corn with Parmesan cheese. Cover dish with foil and place in warm oven until ready to serve. Serves 6.

recipes.title: Rum Cake
directions: Combine cake mix, pudding mix, rum, water, salad oil and eggs. Beat 2 to 4 minutes at medium speed.
Grease and flour a 10-inch tube pan.
Sprinkle chopped nuts over bottom.
Pour batter into pan.
Bake at 325° for 50 to 60 minutes.
recipes.text: Rum Cake. Combine cake mix, pudding mix, rum, water, salad oil and eggs. Beat 2 to 4 minutes at medium speed. Grease and flour a 10-inch tube pan. Sprinkle chopped nuts over bottom. Pour batter into pan. Bake at 325° for 50 to 60 minutes.

recipes.title: Corn And Pea Salad
directions: Mix all ingredients in large container until well blended. Add salt and pepper to taste.
Serve well chilled.
recipes.text: Corn And Pea Salad. Mix all ingredients in large container until well blended. Add salt and pepper to taste. Serve well chilled.

recipes.title: Honey Cookies
directions: Combine flour, salt and baking powder; set aside.
Cream butter, sugar and honey; add eggs and vanilla.
Add dry ingredients to creamed mixture; blend well.
Add nuts.
Chill dough.
Shape into two long rolls.
Wrap in waxed paper and chill for several hours.
recipes.text: Honey Cookies. Combine flour, salt and baking powder; set aside. Cream butter, sugar and honey; add eggs and vanilla. Add dry ingredients to creamed mixture; blend well. Add nuts. Chill dough. Shape into two long rolls. Wrap in waxed paper and chill for several hours.

recipes.title: Swiss Chicken Bake
directions: Arrange chicken breasts in a greased 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Top with cheese.
Mix soup and milk; pour over chicken.
Sprinkle stuffing on top; drizzle melted butter on top.
Cover.
Bake at 350° for 50 minutes.
recipes.text: Swiss Chicken Bake. Arrange chicken breasts in a greased 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Top with cheese. Mix soup and milk; pour over chicken. Sprinkle stuffing on top; drizzle melted butter on top. Cover. Bake at 350° for 50 minutes.

recipes.title: Oven Fried Potatoes
directions: Preheat oven to 375°.
Cut each unpeeled potato into 8 wedges. Arrange wedges, peel side down, in 2 shallow baking pans. Combine remaining ingredients and brush over potatoes.
Brush oil mix over potatoes.
Bake for 45 minutes or until golden brown and tender, brushing occasionally with oil mixture.
Serves 8.
recipes.text: Oven Fried Potatoes. Preheat oven to 375°. Cut each unpeeled potato into 8 wedges. Arrange wedges, peel side down, in 2 shallow baking pans. Combine remaining ingredients and brush over potatoes. Brush oil mix over potatoes. Bake for 45 minutes or until golden brown and tender, brushing occasionally with oil mixture. Serves 8.

recipes.title: Hot Fudge Sauce
directions: Heat milk, chips and sugar until melted and boiling, either on the stove top or in the microwave.
Stir constantly on medium heat on the stove.
recipes.text: Hot Fudge Sauce. Heat milk, chips and sugar until melted and boiling, either on the stove top or in the microwave. Stir constantly on medium heat on the stove.

recipes.title: Crock-Pot Venison Stew
directions: Salt and pepper meat and roll in flour.
Brown in cooking oil on all sides.
Place vegetables in bottom of crock-pot.
Prepare the dry soup mix according to package directions and pour in pot. Add 2 more cups of water.
Put browned venison on top of all and cook for 4 to 5 hours on high.
Serves 3 to 4.
recipes.text: Crock-Pot Venison Stew. Salt and pepper meat and roll in flour. Brown in cooking oil on all sides. Place vegetables in bottom of crock-pot. Prepare the dry soup mix according to package directions and pour in pot. Add 2 more cups of water. Put browned venison on top of all and cook for 4 to 5 hours on high. Serves 3 to 4.

recipes.title: Fabulous Beef Fajitas
ingredients: 1/2 c. prepared Italian salad dressing, divided
1 lb. boneless sirloin steak, cut into 1/4 inch strips
1 medium onion, sliced and separated into rings
directions: In a large resealable plastic bag, combine 1/4 cup salad dressing and chili powder; add steak.
Seal and turn to coat; refrigerate for 30 minutes.
In a skillet, saute peppers and onion in remaining salad dressing until crisp and tender.
Remove and keep warm.	Drain steak, discarding marinade in skillet, saute steak for 6-10 minutes or until no longer pink.
Return vegetables to pan.
Heat through and spoon meat and vegetables down center of tortillas; fold in sides.
Yield:
4-6 servings.
recipes.text: Fabulous Beef Fajitas. In a large resealable plastic bag, combine 1/4 cup salad dressing and chili powder; add steak. Seal and turn to coat; refrigerate for 30 minutes. In a skillet, saute peppers and onion in remaining salad dressing until crisp and tender. Remove and keep warm.	Drain steak, discarding marinade in skillet, saute steak for 6-10 minutes or until no longer pink. Return vegetables to pan. Heat through and spoon meat and vegetables down center of tortillas; fold in sides. Yield: 4-6 servings.

recipes.title: Copper Carrot Pennies
directions: Slice and boil carrots in salted water until fork tender. Cool, alternate carrots, pepper rings and onions thinly sliced. Make a marinade of remaining ingredients, blending well. Pour over vegetables and refrigerate.
recipes.text: Copper Carrot Pennies. Slice and boil carrots in salted water until fork tender. Cool, alternate carrots, pepper rings and onions thinly sliced. Make a marinade of remaining ingredients, blending well. Pour over vegetables and refrigerate.

recipes.title: Snowball Cake
ingredients: 1 (10 3/4 oz.) angel food cake, torn into bite size pieces
directions: Sprinkle gelatin over boiling water.
Stir until gelatin dissolves.
Add sugar, pineapple and lemon juice.
Stir well and refrigerate until slightly thickened.
Prepare 2 envelopes of Dream Whip.
Stir into gelatin mixture.
recipes.text: Snowball Cake. Sprinkle gelatin over boiling water. Stir until gelatin dissolves. Add sugar, pineapple and lemon juice. Stir well and refrigerate until slightly thickened. Prepare 2 envelopes of Dream Whip. Stir into gelatin mixture.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Muffins
directions: Mix together all ingredients.
Pour into muffin pans.
Bake at 350° for 25 minutes or until brown.
recipes.text: Peanut Butter Muffins. Mix together all ingredients. Pour into muffin pans. Bake at 350° for 25 minutes or until brown.

recipes.title: Thousand Island Dressing(For Green Or Vegetable Salads)
directions: Mix ingredients.
Thin with whipping cream, if desired.
Makes 3/4 cup of dressing.
recipes.text: Thousand Island Dressing(For Green Or Vegetable Salads). Mix ingredients. Thin with whipping cream, if desired. Makes 3/4 cup of dressing.

recipes.title: Mexican Dip
ingredients: 1 small jar thick and chunky salsa
1 (8 oz.) pkg. Mexican shredded Velveeta (mild or hot)
directions: Mix together and chill.
Serve with chips.
recipes.text: Mexican Dip. Mix together and chill. Serve with chips.

recipes.title: Cherry Brownies
directions: Beat eggs.
Add sugar and oil, then beat.
Sift flour with cocoa and salt and add to egg, sugar and oil mixture.
Add nuts and vanilla.
Turn into 2 greased pans (8 x 8 x 2-inch) or one long pan (13 x 9-inch) and bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
Cut into squares while warm.
recipes.text: Cherry Brownies. Beat eggs. Add sugar and oil, then beat. Sift flour with cocoa and salt and add to egg, sugar and oil mixture. Add nuts and vanilla. Turn into 2 greased pans (8 x 8 x 2-inch) or one long pan (13 x 9-inch) and bake at 350° for 30 minutes. Cut into squares while warm.

recipes.title: Chewy Cookies
directions: Mix the flour and brown sugar.
Add softened butter and eggs. Add pecans and blend well.
Pour in a greased 9 x 11-inch pan. Bake 30 minutes at 350°.
recipes.text: Chewy Cookies. Mix the flour and brown sugar. Add softened butter and eggs. Add pecans and blend well. Pour in a greased 9 x 11-inch pan. Bake 30 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Fruit Salad
ingredients: 1 large can pineapple in own juice
directions: Drain canned fruit and cut into bite-size pieces.
Peel and cut fresh fruits into bite-size pieces.
Combine all fruit and stir.
You will need to add orange juice or an orange blend.
This helps to keep the fruit from drying out.
Enjoy.
recipes.text: Fruit Salad. Drain canned fruit and cut into bite-size pieces. Peel and cut fresh fruits into bite-size pieces. Combine all fruit and stir. You will need to add orange juice or an orange blend. This helps to keep the fruit from drying out. Enjoy.

recipes.title: Sausage And Broccoli Casserole
ingredients: 1 lb. sausage, browned in bite sizes
directions: Combine all ingredients.
Bake in a 9 x 13-inch pan for 40 to 45 minutes, uncovered.
recipes.text: Sausage And Broccoli Casserole. Combine all ingredients. Bake in a 9 x 13-inch pan for 40 to 45 minutes, uncovered.

recipes.title: Onion Cookies
directions: Blend and shape into 4 rolls about 1 inch in diameter.
Chill or freeze; cut into slices about 1/4 inch thick.
Bake on ungreased cookie sheet at 375° for 10 to 12 minutes.
recipes.text: Onion Cookies. Blend and shape into 4 rolls about 1 inch in diameter. Chill or freeze; cut into slices about 1/4 inch thick. Bake on ungreased cookie sheet at 375° for 10 to 12 minutes.

recipes.title: Watermelon Syrup
directions: Cut inside into cubes.
Boil seeds and all for about 20 minutes.
Strain.
Boil liquid until consistency of syrup.
recipes.text: Watermelon Syrup. Cut inside into cubes. Boil seeds and all for about 20 minutes. Strain. Boil liquid until consistency of syrup.

recipes.title: Salsa
directions: Chop onions, tomatoes (may use 1 large can of canned tomatoes), green pepper and celery.
These may be chopped as small or large as you like, depending on how chunky you like your salsa. This may also be done in a food processor.	Mix all ingredients and enjoy!
recipes.text: Salsa. Chop onions, tomatoes (may use 1 large can of canned tomatoes), green pepper and celery. These may be chopped as small or large as you like, depending on how chunky you like your salsa. This may also be done in a food processor.	Mix all ingredients and enjoy!

recipes.title: Sauerbraten
directions: Place beef in bowl.
Combine next 7 ingredients and blend. Pour over meat.
Marinate 24 hours.
Melt fat in a heavy skillet or Dutch oven.
Add meat.
Brown thoroughly.
Add water to meat liquid and pour over meat.
Cover.
Simmer over low heat 3 hours or until meat is tender.
Remove meat.
Make gravy from juices in pan.
recipes.text: Sauerbraten. Place beef in bowl. Combine next 7 ingredients and blend. Pour over meat. Marinate 24 hours. Melt fat in a heavy skillet or Dutch oven. Add meat. Brown thoroughly. Add water to meat liquid and pour over meat. Cover. Simmer over low heat 3 hours or until meat is tender. Remove meat. Make gravy from juices in pan.

recipes.title: Chocolate Crinkles
directions: Melt butter and chocolate in double boiler over hot, not boiling water until smooth.
recipes.text: Chocolate Crinkles. Melt butter and chocolate in double boiler over hot, not boiling water until smooth.

recipes.title: Shipwreck Casserole
ingredients: 1 c. kidney beans (16 oz.), drained and rinsed
1 can cream of celery soup, diluted as directed
directions: Place potatoes in bottom of 2 1/2-quart baking dish.
Layer butter, onion, beans, rice, green pepper, tomatoes and ground beef (pre-cook enough to drain fat) over potatoes; season with salt and pepper as desired.
Cover evenly with soup.
Bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours.
Cover the last 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Shipwreck Casserole. Place potatoes in bottom of 2 1/2-quart baking dish. Layer butter, onion, beans, rice, green pepper, tomatoes and ground beef (pre-cook enough to drain fat) over potatoes; season with salt and pepper as desired. Cover evenly with soup. Bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours. Cover the last 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Oyster Stew
ingredients: dash of bottled hot pepper sauce
1 pt. half and half milk and 1 pt. regular milk, added together and scalded
directions: Blend flour, seasonings and 2 tablespoons water in a 3-quart soup kettle.
Add undrained oysters and butter; simmer over very low heat for 3 to 4 minutes, until edges of oysters curl, stirring gently.
Add scalded or hot milk; remove from heat and cover.
Let stand 15 minutes.
Reheat briefly.
Top servings with pats of butter.
Serves 4 or 5.
recipes.text: Oyster Stew. Blend flour, seasonings and 2 tablespoons water in a 3-quart soup kettle. Add undrained oysters and butter; simmer over very low heat for 3 to 4 minutes, until edges of oysters curl, stirring gently. Add scalded or hot milk; remove from heat and cover. Let stand 15 minutes. Reheat briefly. Top servings with pats of butter. Serves 4 or 5.

recipes.title: Chicken Pilaf
ingredients: 3 chicken breasts, halved or other chicken parts
directions: Mix rice, soup mix, soup, water and wine in 1 1/2-quart baking dish.
Let stand 10 minutes.
Put chicken parts on top. Brush with butter.
Sprinkle with salt, pepper and paprika.
Bake in 350° oven for 1 hour until chicken is done.
recipes.text: Chicken Pilaf. Mix rice, soup mix, soup, water and wine in 1 1/2-quart baking dish. Let stand 10 minutes. Put chicken parts on top. Brush with butter. Sprinkle with salt, pepper and paprika. Bake in 350° oven for 1 hour until chicken is done.

recipes.title: Date Cookies
directions: Cream sugar, shortening and eggs.
Add sifted dry ingredients, then chopped dates and nuts.
Shape into rolls and chill.
Cut in slices and bake 10 to 12 minutes at 375°.
Half of the rolls may be frozen for later use.
recipes.text: Date Cookies. Cream sugar, shortening and eggs. Add sifted dry ingredients, then chopped dates and nuts. Shape into rolls and chill. Cut in slices and bake 10 to 12 minutes at 375°. Half of the rolls may be frozen for later use.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Cups
directions: Mix powdered sugar, brown sugar, peanut butter and melted margarine.
Press into a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Melt and then spread over top of the above mixture the chocolate chips and oleo.
Chill and cut into bars.
recipes.text: Peanut Butter Cups. Mix powdered sugar, brown sugar, peanut butter and melted margarine. Press into a 9 x 13-inch pan. Melt and then spread over top of the above mixture the chocolate chips and oleo. Chill and cut into bars.

recipes.title: Cranberry-Orange Nut Bread
directions: Heat oven to 350°.
Grease bottom only of 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan.
Mix flour, sugar, baking powder, salt and baking soda.
Stir in oleo until mixture is crumbly.
Stir in orange peel, orange juice and egg just until flour is moistened.
Stir in cranberries and nuts.
Pour into pan.
Bake until wooden toothpick inserted in center comes out clean, 55 to 65 minutes.
Loosen sides of loaf pan.
Remove from pan.
Cool completely before slicing.
recipes.text: Cranberry-Orange Nut Bread. Heat oven to 350°. Grease bottom only of 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan. Mix flour, sugar, baking powder, salt and baking soda. Stir in oleo until mixture is crumbly. Stir in orange peel, orange juice and egg just until flour is moistened. Stir in cranberries and nuts. Pour into pan. Bake until wooden toothpick inserted in center comes out clean, 55 to 65 minutes. Loosen sides of loaf pan. Remove from pan. Cool completely before slicing.

recipes.title: Dirt Cups
directions: Decorations:
gummy worms and frogs, chopped peanuts and granola.
recipes.text: Dirt Cups. Decorations: gummy worms and frogs, chopped peanuts and granola.

recipes.title: Meringue
directions: Boil the sugar and water until thread stage.
Beat egg whites until stiff.
Pour boiling mixture into egg whites and continue beating.
May brown in oven slightly.
recipes.text: Meringue. Boil the sugar and water until thread stage. Beat egg whites until stiff. Pour boiling mixture into egg whites and continue beating. May brown in oven slightly.

recipes.title: Taco Cups
ingredients: 1 1/2 lb. browned hamburger with diced onion
directions: Prepare cooked hamburger with taco seasoning mix as directed on package.
Spray nonstick cooking spray on a 12 cupcake pan. Line each cup with a crescent roll (just enough to cover bottom). Layer meat mixture, taco sauce, Cheddar cheese and crushed Doritos.
Bake at 375° until crescent rolls are browned and cheese melted.
Let set 3 to 5 minutes after done.
Remove from pan.
Top with lettuce, sour cream and tomatoes.
Make ahead and freeze.
recipes.text: Taco Cups. Prepare cooked hamburger with taco seasoning mix as directed on package. Spray nonstick cooking spray on a 12 cupcake pan. Line each cup with a crescent roll (just enough to cover bottom). Layer meat mixture, taco sauce, Cheddar cheese and crushed Doritos. Bake at 375° until crescent rolls are browned and cheese melted. Let set 3 to 5 minutes after done. Remove from pan. Top with lettuce, sour cream and tomatoes. Make ahead and freeze.

recipes.title: Potato Casserole
directions: Mix Parkay and Velveeta cheese; melt together.
Add all other ingredients and bake in a shallow pan at 350° for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Potato Casserole. Mix Parkay and Velveeta cheese; melt together. Add all other ingredients and bake in a shallow pan at 350° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Janet'S Hash Brown Potato Casserole
ingredients: 2 lb. frozen hash brown potatoes, thawed
directions: Mix all ingredients together.
Pour in large baking dish. Top with corn flakes.
Melt 1/2 stick margarine and pour over corn flakes.
Bake at 350 for 45 minutes.
This can be frozen.
If frozen, leave topping off until thawed.
recipes.text: Janet'S Hash Brown Potato Casserole. Mix all ingredients together. Pour in large baking dish. Top with corn flakes. Melt 1/2 stick margarine and pour over corn flakes. Bake at 350 for 45 minutes. This can be frozen. If frozen, leave topping off until thawed.

recipes.title: Pineapple Sheet Cake
ingredients: 1 (20 oz.) can crushed pineapple in heavy syrup (use juice and all)
directions: Beat with mixer until thoroughly blended.
Add more powdered sugar if needed to thicken.
Spread on cake.
recipes.text: Pineapple Sheet Cake. Beat with mixer until thoroughly blended. Add more powdered sugar if needed to thicken. Spread on cake.

recipes.title: Applesauce Cookies
directions: Mix together the sugar and Butter Buds.
Add baking soda to applesauce.
Add applesauce to Butter Buds mixture; blend well. Sift together the remaining ingredients and add to first mixture. Add raisins and Grape-Nuts.
Chill dough for 1 hour.
Drop by teaspoonfuls onto baking sheet sprayed with nonfat cooking spray. Bake at 350° for 12 minutes.
Yields 9 to 10 dozen cookies.
recipes.text: Applesauce Cookies. Mix together the sugar and Butter Buds. Add baking soda to applesauce. Add applesauce to Butter Buds mixture; blend well. Sift together the remaining ingredients and add to first mixture. Add raisins and Grape-Nuts. Chill dough for 1 hour. Drop by teaspoonfuls onto baking sheet sprayed with nonfat cooking spray. Bake at 350° for 12 minutes. Yields 9 to 10 dozen cookies.

recipes.title: Tater Tot Casserole
directions: In skillet, brown beef.
Preheat oven to 350°.
Place ground beef in bottom of glass dish, then pour soup over beef.
Place Tater Tots on top of meat and soup.
Bake for 30 to 40 minutes or until Tater Tots are brown.
recipes.text: Tater Tot Casserole. In skillet, brown beef. Preheat oven to 350°. Place ground beef in bottom of glass dish, then pour soup over beef. Place Tater Tots on top of meat and soup. Bake for 30 to 40 minutes or until Tater Tots are brown.

recipes.title: Apple Pound Cake
directions: Mix together all ingredients.
recipes.text: Apple Pound Cake. Mix together all ingredients.

recipes.title: Chicken Casserole
ingredients: 1 box Uncle Ben's long grain wild rice
directions: Set your oven to 350°.	Cook wild rice and add 1 can of cream of	mushroom,
can of celery and 1 can of water;
mix together. Place
in	buttered
x 13-inch casserole.
Layer chicken on top
of rice mixture and sprinkle onion mix on top of chicken. Bake for 2 hours or until done.
recipes.text: Chicken Casserole. Set your oven to 350°.	Cook wild rice and add 1 can of cream of	mushroom, 1 can of celery and 1 can of water; mix together. Place in	buttered 9 x 13-inch casserole. Layer chicken on top of rice mixture and sprinkle onion mix on top of chicken. Bake for 2 hours or until done.

recipes.title: Fried Apples
directions: Cook and keep stirring until tender.
recipes.text: Fried Apples. Cook and keep stirring until tender.

recipes.title: Roasted Pecans
directions: Spread on cookie sheet.
Bake at 250° for 1 hour. Stir every 15 minutes. Salt to taste with popcorn salt while hot.
Cool to serve.
recipes.text: Roasted Pecans. Spread on cookie sheet. Bake at 250° for 1 hour. Stir every 15 minutes. Salt to taste with popcorn salt while hot. Cool to serve.

recipes.title: Hot Spiced Cider
directions: Mix together in crock-pot or stove top.
Cover and cook on low for 2 hours or until hot.
Enjoy!
recipes.text: Hot Spiced Cider. Mix together in crock-pot or stove top. Cover and cook on low for 2 hours or until hot. Enjoy!

recipes.title: Soft Chocolate Chip Cookies
directions: Cream together butter and sugars.
Add eggs and vanilla, beating well.
Mix together flour, oats, salt, baking powder and soda.
Place small amounts in blender and process until mixture turns into powder.
Mix butter-egg mixture with flour mixture until just blended.
Add chocolate pieces, milk chocolate and chopped nuts.
recipes.text: Soft Chocolate Chip Cookies. Cream together butter and sugars. Add eggs and vanilla, beating well. Mix together flour, oats, salt, baking powder and soda. Place small amounts in blender and process until mixture turns into powder. Mix butter-egg mixture with flour mixture until just blended. Add chocolate pieces, milk chocolate and chopped nuts.

recipes.title: Broccoli Casserole I
directions: Cook celery and onion with broccoli in 1/2 cup water for 7 or 8 minutes (or until tender).
Add rest of ingredients; mix and put in casserole dish.
Bake for 30 minutes at 350°.
recipes.text: Broccoli Casserole I. Cook celery and onion with broccoli in 1/2 cup water for 7 or 8 minutes (or until tender). Add rest of ingredients; mix and put in casserole dish. Bake for 30 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Sloppy Joes
directions: Chop onion, celery and green pepper.
Brown ground beef with onion, celery and green pepper.
Add remaining ingredients. Simmer approximately 1 hour.
recipes.text: Sloppy Joes. Chop onion, celery and green pepper. Brown ground beef with onion, celery and green pepper. Add remaining ingredients. Simmer approximately 1 hour.

recipes.title: Green Tomato Catsup
directions: Grind all ingredients.
Put in large pan.
As you put salt in, keep tasting the mixture.
When you can taste the salt, stir up good, then put in container and freeze.
recipes.text: Green Tomato Catsup. Grind all ingredients. Put in large pan. As you put salt in, keep tasting the mixture. When you can taste the salt, stir up good, then put in container and freeze.

recipes.title: Honey Crunch Nut Bars
ingredients: 5 Tbsp. plus 1 tsp. (1/3 c.) butter or margarine
2 (5 oz. each) cans chow mein noodles
directions: Grease a 9-inch square pan.
Put butter, honey, brown sugar and cinnamon into a 3-quart saucepan.
Stirring constantly, bring to a boil over medium heat, then boil one minute.
Remove from heat.
Stir in vanilla.
Add noodles and gently stir (fold) until coated.
Stir in nuts.
Scrape mixture into prepared pan.
Cover with waxed paper and press into an even layer.
Remove paper; let stand at least 1 hour before cutting bars with a large heavy knife.
recipes.text: Honey Crunch Nut Bars. Grease a 9-inch square pan. Put butter, honey, brown sugar and cinnamon into a 3-quart saucepan. Stirring constantly, bring to a boil over medium heat, then boil one minute. Remove from heat. Stir in vanilla. Add noodles and gently stir (fold) until coated. Stir in nuts. Scrape mixture into prepared pan. Cover with waxed paper and press into an even layer. Remove paper; let stand at least 1 hour before cutting bars with a large heavy knife.

recipes.title: Cream Cheese Pound Cake
directions: Cream butter, margarine and cream cheese together; beat until fluffy.
Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each egg. Add vanilla.
Gradually add flour; mix until smooth.
recipes.text: Cream Cheese Pound Cake. Cream butter, margarine and cream cheese together; beat until fluffy. Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each egg. Add vanilla. Gradually add flour; mix until smooth.

recipes.title: Mexican Casserole
directions: Brown ground beef and onion; drain off fat.
Add green chilies.
Mix together soup and milk. Alternate layers of chips, meat and soup mixture.
Top with grated cheese. Bake at 350° until cheese melts or casserole is hot through.
recipes.text: Mexican Casserole. Brown ground beef and onion; drain off fat. Add green chilies. Mix together soup and milk. Alternate layers of chips, meat and soup mixture. Top with grated cheese. Bake at 350° until cheese melts or casserole is hot through.

recipes.title: Crock-Pot Meat Balls
directions: Make into walnut-size balls. Do not brown. Put into greased crock-pot.
recipes.text: Crock-Pot Meat Balls. Make into walnut-size balls. Do not brown. Put into greased crock-pot.

recipes.title: Hamburger Casserole
ingredients: cheese (enough for top), sliced or grated
directions: Brown meat with onion and pepper; drain.
Stir in remaining ingredients.
Place cheese on top.
Cover with aluminum foil. Bake for 35 minutes at 325°.
Uncover and bake 15 minutes.
recipes.text: Hamburger Casserole. Brown meat with onion and pepper; drain. Stir in remaining ingredients. Place cheese on top. Cover with aluminum foil. Bake for 35 minutes at 325°. Uncover and bake 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Maple-Mustard Pork Tenderloin With Apples
ingredients: 4 Granny Smith apples, peeled and thinly sliced
directions: Preheat oven to 425°.
Trim fat from pork.
Place on broiler pan coated with cooking spray.
Combine mustard, 2 tablespoons syrup, chopped rosemary and salt and pepper; brush over pork. Insert meat thermometer into thickest part of pork.
Bake at 425° for 25 minutes or thermometer reads 160° (slightly pink).
Place a nonstick pan with cooking spray over medium-high heat until hot. Saut apples 5 minutes.
Reduce to medium-low.
Add 4 tablespoons maple syrup; simmer 12 minutes until tender.
Cut pork crosswise. Spoon apples over pork.
recipes.text: Maple-Mustard Pork Tenderloin With Apples. Preheat oven to 425°. Trim fat from pork. Place on broiler pan coated with cooking spray. Combine mustard, 2 tablespoons syrup, chopped rosemary and salt and pepper; brush over pork. Insert meat thermometer into thickest part of pork. Bake at 425° for 25 minutes or thermometer reads 160° (slightly pink). Place a nonstick pan with cooking spray over medium-high heat until hot. Saut apples 5 minutes. Reduce to medium-low. Add 4 tablespoons maple syrup; simmer 12 minutes until tender. Cut pork crosswise. Spoon apples over pork.

recipes.title: Chicken And Dressing
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup (plus 1 can water)
directions: Cook chicken (skin and remove fat) in salted water with bay leaf until tender.
Remove from broth, throw away bay leaf. Remove bones and cut or tear meat into pieces; set aside.
In very large bowl or pan, crumble cornbread and white bread; add seasoning, chicken broth and soup.
Mix thoroughly.
If too dry, add the can of water.
Mix in chicken.
Generously grease 3-quart baking dish or roaster pan.
Put dressing in pan.
Dot with butter or margarine.
Bake at 450° until golden brown.
recipes.text: Chicken And Dressing. Cook chicken (skin and remove fat) in salted water with bay leaf until tender. Remove from broth, throw away bay leaf. Remove bones and cut or tear meat into pieces; set aside. In very large bowl or pan, crumble cornbread and white bread; add seasoning, chicken broth and soup. Mix thoroughly. If too dry, add the can of water. Mix in chicken. Generously grease 3-quart baking dish or roaster pan. Put dressing in pan. Dot with butter or margarine. Bake at 450° until golden brown.

recipes.title: Crusty Cobbler
directions: Melt oleo in deep dish.
Mix together flour, baking powder, sugar and milk.
Pour over melted oleo; do not stir.
Pour 1 can of fruit with juice over mixture.
Bake 50 minutes at 350°.
recipes.text: Crusty Cobbler. Melt oleo in deep dish. Mix together flour, baking powder, sugar and milk. Pour over melted oleo; do not stir. Pour 1 can of fruit with juice over mixture. Bake 50 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Strawberry-Orange Slush
directions: Combine first four ingredients in container of an electric blender.
Process until smooth.
Gradually add ice, processing until mixture reaches desired consistency.
Garnish each serving with a strawberry and orange wedge, if desired.
Serve immediately.
Yields 5 1/2 cups.
recipes.text: Strawberry-Orange Slush. Combine first four ingredients in container of an electric blender. Process until smooth. Gradually add ice, processing until mixture reaches desired consistency. Garnish each serving with a strawberry and orange wedge, if desired. Serve immediately. Yields 5 1/2 cups.

recipes.title: Linguini And Clam Sauce
directions: Slowly brown garlic in olive oil.
Add clam juice and parsley; simmer 30 minutes.
Add clams and heat 10 minutes.
Serve with linguini or other pasta and Parmesan cheese.
Serves 6.
recipes.text: Linguini And Clam Sauce. Slowly brown garlic in olive oil. Add clam juice and parsley; simmer 30 minutes. Add clams and heat 10 minutes. Serve with linguini or other pasta and Parmesan cheese. Serves 6.

recipes.title: Peach Blossoms
directions: In
blender, mix ingredients thoroughly.
Add and blend enough ice cubes to make drink thick.
recipes.text: Peach Blossoms. In blender, mix ingredients thoroughly. Add and blend enough ice cubes to make drink thick.

recipes.title: Banana Split Cake
directions: Crush vanilla wafers and mix with melted butter.
Press in pan and let set for 1 hour.
Mix softened cream cheese, softened butter, sugar and vanilla until creamy.
Spread over crust.
Layer bananas, pineapple, strawberries and nuts.
Top with Cool Whip.
recipes.text: Banana Split Cake. Crush vanilla wafers and mix with melted butter. Press in pan and let set for 1 hour. Mix softened cream cheese, softened butter, sugar and vanilla until creamy. Spread over crust. Layer bananas, pineapple, strawberries and nuts. Top with Cool Whip.

recipes.title: Broccoli Bake
directions: Cook frozen broccoli as directed.
Stir in 1/2 stick butter and the cheese.
Mix together 1/2 stick of butter and crushed Ritz crackers.
Sprinkle cracker mixture over broccoli and bake at 350° for 20 to 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Broccoli Bake. Cook frozen broccoli as directed. Stir in 1/2 stick butter and the cheese. Mix together 1/2 stick of butter and crushed Ritz crackers. Sprinkle cracker mixture over broccoli and bake at 350° for 20 to 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Candy
directions: Melt butterscotch morsels.
Add peanuts and noodles.
Mix well.
Spoon onto wax paper.
recipes.text: Candy. Melt butterscotch morsels. Add peanuts and noodles. Mix well. Spoon onto wax paper.

recipes.title: Bundt Cake
ingredients: 1 Tbsp. combined flavorings (1 tsp. each vanilla extract, almond or lemon extract, or other flavoring as desired)
directions: Preheat oven to 325°.
Grease Bundt pan generously (even the nonstick ones).
Combine sugar, flour, margarine, eggs and flavorings in an electric mixer all at once and beat until smooth, about 10 minutes.
Pour into prepared pan.
Bake one hour or until cake is done.
recipes.text: Bundt Cake. Preheat oven to 325°. Grease Bundt pan generously (even the nonstick ones). Combine sugar, flour, margarine, eggs and flavorings in an electric mixer all at once and beat until smooth, about 10 minutes. Pour into prepared pan. Bake one hour or until cake is done.

recipes.title: Boeuf Bourguignon(Beef Burgundy)
ingredients: 2 lb. lean stew beef, cut in cubes
1 jar sm. whole onions (or 1/2 pkg. frozen)
directions: Toss the meat in flour, salt and pepper and brown in butter and oil.
Add consomme, wine, onion, carrots, garlic, bay leaf and thyme.
Simmer 2 1/2 to 3 hours until meat is tender.
Add parsley, small whole onions and mushrooms just before serving and simmer until hot.
recipes.text: Boeuf Bourguignon(Beef Burgundy). Toss the meat in flour, salt and pepper and brown in butter and oil. Add consomme, wine, onion, carrots, garlic, bay leaf and thyme. Simmer 2 1/2 to 3 hours until meat is tender. Add parsley, small whole onions and mushrooms just before serving and simmer until hot.

recipes.title: Lettuce Salad
ingredients: 10 oz. frozen peas, cooked and drained
directions: Layer first 6 ingredients.
Do not mix.
Spread with mayonnaise.
Sprinkle with sugar.
Top with bacon and cheese. Refrigerate 8 hours.
Best made day before!
recipes.text: Lettuce Salad. Layer first 6 ingredients. Do not mix. Spread with mayonnaise. Sprinkle with sugar. Top with bacon and cheese. Refrigerate 8 hours. Best made day before!

recipes.title: Bohemian Buns
directions: Let rise once and shape into buns. Brush buns with beaten egg and sprinkle with poppy seed or sesame seed. Bake at 375° 20 to 25 minutes.
recipes.text: Bohemian Buns. Let rise once and shape into buns. Brush buns with beaten egg and sprinkle with poppy seed or sesame seed. Bake at 375° 20 to 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Pork Chop Schnitzel(John'S Favorite)
directions: Bread chops in flour; brown.
Place one layer in baking dish. Put a slice of lemon on each chop.
Add a slice or 2 of onion.
Do the same with the next layer.
Cover with mushrooms and just enough water to cover, along with the mushroom juice.
Add beef bouillon, cover and bake 1 1/2 hours at 350°.
recipes.text: Pork Chop Schnitzel(John'S Favorite). Bread chops in flour; brown. Place one layer in baking dish. Put a slice of lemon on each chop. Add a slice or 2 of onion. Do the same with the next layer. Cover with mushrooms and just enough water to cover, along with the mushroom juice. Add beef bouillon, cover and bake 1 1/2 hours at 350°.

recipes.title: Icebox Bran Muffins
directions: Pour
boiling
water over 1 cup All-Bran and let stand. Mix together the sugar, shortening, eggs and buttermilk.
Add the flour,
baking soda, salt and the rest of the All-Bran to the All-Bran
mixture.
Combine
both mixtures and put in the refrigerator.
Stir
and
put
in
muffin
pans.
Bake
for 25 minutes at 350°.
recipes.text: Icebox Bran Muffins. Pour boiling water over 1 cup All-Bran and let stand. Mix together the sugar, shortening, eggs and buttermilk. Add the flour, baking soda, salt and the rest of the All-Bran to the All-Bran mixture. Combine both mixtures and put in the refrigerator. Stir and put in muffin pans. Bake for 25 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Ice Cream Cupcakes
directions: Note:
Need 24 to 30 Joy ice cream cups.
recipes.text: Ice Cream Cupcakes. Note: Need 24 to 30 Joy ice cream cups.

recipes.title: Play Dough
directions: Mix well in saucepan.
Cook until leaves sides of pan.
Remove and knead when cool.
Keep in airtight container (Ziploc bag).
recipes.text: Play Dough. Mix well in saucepan. Cook until leaves sides of pan. Remove and knead when cool. Keep in airtight container (Ziploc bag).

recipes.title: Real Good Slaw
directions: Shred amount of cabbage needed.
Add dressing mix (amount desired).
Stir well.
Refrigerate until needed.
recipes.text: Real Good Slaw. Shred amount of cabbage needed. Add dressing mix (amount desired). Stir well. Refrigerate until needed.

recipes.title: Real Easy Chicken
ingredients: 1/2 tsp. each basil, thyme and seasoned salt
directions: You will need 1 large size oven cooking bag.
recipes.text: Real Easy Chicken. You will need 1 large size oven cooking bag.

recipes.title: Betsy'S Prime Rib
directions: Set thawed roast out at room temperature for 4 hours before cooking.
Put in oven, fat side up.
No water, no cover, no salt, no basting.
recipes.text: Betsy'S Prime Rib. Set thawed roast out at room temperature for 4 hours before cooking. Put in oven, fat side up. No water, no cover, no salt, no basting.

recipes.title: Texas Pasta
directions: Cook pasta until tender.
Drain all cans of vegetables.
Dice bell pepper (use only the amount for your taste).
Mix all together.
This recipe should be made up the day before you want to serve it.
Keep refrigerated until served.
recipes.text: Texas Pasta. Cook pasta until tender. Drain all cans of vegetables. Dice bell pepper (use only the amount for your taste). Mix all together. This recipe should be made up the day before you want to serve it. Keep refrigerated until served.

recipes.title: Easy Ground Meat Casserole
directions: Cook meat and onion until done; drain.
Spray casserole dish with Pam.
Combine all ingredients; pour into casserole dish. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Easy Ground Meat Casserole. Cook meat and onion until done; drain. Spray casserole dish with Pam. Combine all ingredients; pour into casserole dish. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Ham Cheese Ball
directions: Chop onions; shred meat and mix with other ingredients.
Roll into ball.
recipes.text: Ham Cheese Ball. Chop onions; shred meat and mix with other ingredients. Roll into ball.

recipes.title: Coq Au Vin
ingredients: 1/3 c. Burgundy or other dry red wine
directions: In skillet, brown chicken in butter.
Add broth, wine, mushrooms, onions and seasonings.
Cover; cook over low heat for 45 minutes or until tender.
Stir occasionally.
Remove bay leaf. Gradually blend water into flour until smooth.
Slowly stir into sauce.
Cook, stirring until thickened.
Makes 4 servings.
recipes.text: Coq Au Vin. In skillet, brown chicken in butter. Add broth, wine, mushrooms, onions and seasonings. Cover; cook over low heat for 45 minutes or until tender. Stir occasionally. Remove bay leaf. Gradually blend water into flour until smooth. Slowly stir into sauce. Cook, stirring until thickened. Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: Pastor Bill'S Peanut Butter And Jelly Sandwich
directions: Apply a large amount of peanut butter to bottom slice of bread. Top with preserves.
Place top slice of bread on top and cut in half diagonally.
recipes.text: Pastor Bill'S Peanut Butter And Jelly Sandwich. Apply a large amount of peanut butter to bottom slice of bread. Top with preserves. Place top slice of bread on top and cut in half diagonally.

recipes.title: Chinese Chicken Slaw
ingredients: 2 c. each: shredded green and red cabbage
1 (8 oz.) can sliced water chestnuts, drained
1 (6 oz.) pkg. frozen Chinese pea pods, thawed and drained
1/4 c. each: julienne carrots and sliced green onion
directions: Whisk dressing and soy sauce together and set aside.
In large bowl, combine remaining ingredients (except chow mein noodles). Pour dressing over salad and toss well.
Chill until ready to serve.
Serve topped with Chinese noodles.
(This is really good over hot white rice, too.)
recipes.text: Chinese Chicken Slaw. Whisk dressing and soy sauce together and set aside. In large bowl, combine remaining ingredients (except chow mein noodles). Pour dressing over salad and toss well. Chill until ready to serve. Serve topped with Chinese noodles. (This is really good over hot white rice, too.)

recipes.title: Cole Slaw
directions: Remove core of cabbage and cut head into eighths.
Put enough of the cabbage into the container of your blender to fill one half.
Add water to cover cabbage.
Press chop button for approximately 5 seconds, or until coarsely chopped throughout. Empty into strainer to drain thoroughly.
Repeat with remaining cabbage and the other vegetables until all are chopped.
Drain very well in a colander.
Place vegetables in a bowl.
recipes.text: Cole Slaw. Remove core of cabbage and cut head into eighths. Put enough of the cabbage into the container of your blender to fill one half. Add water to cover cabbage. Press chop button for approximately 5 seconds, or until coarsely chopped throughout. Empty into strainer to drain thoroughly. Repeat with remaining cabbage and the other vegetables until all are chopped. Drain very well in a colander. Place vegetables in a bowl.

recipes.title: Angel Food Ice Cream Cake
ingredients: 2 small pkg. frozen strawberries, thawed and drained
directions: Tear cake into three sections and place each section in a bowl. Pour one flavor of Jell-o (dry mix) over each section. Mix well. In a tube pan or other deep dish, layer as follows: orange cake mixture, drained mandarin oranges, ice cream. Raspberry cake mixture, blueberries, ice cream. Strawberry cake mixture, ice cream, drained strawberries. Place in freezer until ready to serve. Let sit out for about 5 minutes before serving.
recipes.text: Angel Food Ice Cream Cake. Tear cake into three sections and place each section in a bowl. Pour one flavor of Jell-o (dry mix) over each section. Mix well. In a tube pan or other deep dish, layer as follows: orange cake mixture, drained mandarin oranges, ice cream. Raspberry cake mixture, blueberries, ice cream. Strawberry cake mixture, ice cream, drained strawberries. Place in freezer until ready to serve. Let sit out for about 5 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Cream Of Broccoli Soup
directions: In saucepan, saute onion in butter.
Stir in flour and salt. Gradually add milk.
Bring to boil, stirring frequently.
Add broth, broccoli and carrots.
Simmer until carrots are tender.
recipes.text: Cream Of Broccoli Soup. In saucepan, saute onion in butter. Stir in flour and salt. Gradually add milk. Bring to boil, stirring frequently. Add broth, broccoli and carrots. Simmer until carrots are tender.

recipes.title: Rice Pudding
directions: Bring rice, water and salt to boil.
Cover and cook until done.
While rice is steaming, mix 2 eggs, sugar and vanilla. Also cornstarch and evaporated milk.
When rice is done, add 1 quart milk to rice.
Bring to boil again, stirring constantly as it tends to scorch.
When it has come to boil, add second mixture. Pour into casserole and sprinkle with cinnamon.
recipes.text: Rice Pudding. Bring rice, water and salt to boil. Cover and cook until done. While rice is steaming, mix 2 eggs, sugar and vanilla. Also cornstarch and evaporated milk. When rice is done, add 1 quart milk to rice. Bring to boil again, stirring constantly as it tends to scorch. When it has come to boil, add second mixture. Pour into casserole and sprinkle with cinnamon.

recipes.title: Meat Loaf
ingredients: 1 c. catsup and some for top
directions: Mix all ingredients and put catsup on top.
Bake at 400° for 30 minutes.
Then turn oven down to about 325° and cook for about 1 hour.
recipes.text: Meat Loaf. Mix all ingredients and put catsup on top. Bake at 400° for 30 minutes. Then turn oven down to about 325° and cook for about 1 hour.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Pie
directions: Mix egg yolks, sugar, flour and cinnamon.
Add 2 cups of cooked pumpkin.
Add 4 cups milk and a little salt.
Beat egg whites and fold into mixture.
Pour into prepared pie crusts. Bake at 400° for 10 minutes, then turn oven to 350° and bake until crust is firm.
recipes.text: Pumpkin Pie. Mix egg yolks, sugar, flour and cinnamon. Add 2 cups of cooked pumpkin. Add 4 cups milk and a little salt. Beat egg whites and fold into mixture. Pour into prepared pie crusts. Bake at 400° for 10 minutes, then turn oven to 350° and bake until crust is firm.

recipes.title: Onion Meat Loaf
directions: Heat oven to 350 degrees.
Mix ground beef, onion soup mix, milk and egg.
Press firmly in ungreased loaf pan 8 1/2 x 4 1/2 x 2 1/2 inches.
Loosen edges with a spatula.
recipes.text: Onion Meat Loaf. Heat oven to 350 degrees. Mix ground beef, onion soup mix, milk and egg. Press firmly in ungreased loaf pan 8 1/2 x 4 1/2 x 2 1/2 inches. Loosen edges with a spatula.

recipes.title: Blueberry Crunch
ingredients: 1 box white or yellow cake mix
directions: Put berries in dish.
Sprinkle sugar over them.
Combine cake mix with margarine and pecans.
Crumble over berries.
recipes.text: Blueberry Crunch. Put berries in dish. Sprinkle sugar over them. Combine cake mix with margarine and pecans. Crumble over berries.

recipes.title: Pepper Jelly
directions: Mix all but Certo.
Boil for 1 minute.
Add Certo and boil for 2 minutes.
Put in clean jars and seal.
recipes.text: Pepper Jelly. Mix all but Certo. Boil for 1 minute. Add Certo and boil for 2 minutes. Put in clean jars and seal.

recipes.title: Cherry Cheese Cake
directions: Save small amount of Cool Whip to use for topping.
Cream the cream cheese good and then add sugar.
Beat in sour cream and vanilla, then add Cool Whip.
Place in graham cracker crust.
In center of pie, place the cherry pie filling.
Place small teaspoonful of Cool Whip around edge of pie.
For variety, blueberry pie filling and fresh strawberries in the gel are really good.
Can be eaten immediately or kept several days in refrigerator.
recipes.text: Cherry Cheese Cake. Save small amount of Cool Whip to use for topping. Cream the cream cheese good and then add sugar. Beat in sour cream and vanilla, then add Cool Whip. Place in graham cracker crust. In center of pie, place the cherry pie filling. Place small teaspoonful of Cool Whip around edge of pie. For variety, blueberry pie filling and fresh strawberries in the gel are really good. Can be eaten immediately or kept several days in refrigerator.

recipes.title: Italian Chicken With Vegetables(For Microwave Only)
ingredients: 1/2 lb. boneless chicken breast, skin removed and cut into 2 x 1/2-inch strips
directions: Note:
You can substitute other fresh vegetables as you prefer.
recipes.text: Italian Chicken With Vegetables(For Microwave Only). Note: You can substitute other fresh vegetables as you prefer.

recipes.title: Piccalilli
directions: Mix together cabbage, tomatoes, peppers and onions.
Mix with salt and let stand overnight.
Next morning, drain and press to remove all liquid possible.
recipes.text: Piccalilli. Mix together cabbage, tomatoes, peppers and onions. Mix with salt and let stand overnight. Next morning, drain and press to remove all liquid possible.

recipes.title: Carrot Cake
directions: Heat oven to 350°.
Beat together eggs, sugar and oil.
Add the carrots (the carrots may be grated in the blender or a meat grinder, but hand grating is the best and it usually takes a one pound package of carrots).
add the flour, salt and cinnamon. Beat the mixture until frothy.
Bake in 8 x 13-inch pan for 40 to 45 minutes.
Frost with Cream Cheese Frosting.
recipes.text: Carrot Cake. Heat oven to 350°. Beat together eggs, sugar and oil. Add the carrots (the carrots may be grated in the blender or a meat grinder, but hand grating is the best and it usually takes a one pound package of carrots). add the flour, salt and cinnamon. Beat the mixture until frothy. Bake in 8 x 13-inch pan for 40 to 45 minutes. Frost with Cream Cheese Frosting.

recipes.title: Chicken Rice Casserole
ingredients: 3 lb. chicken (Market Day skinless, boneless works great)
directions: Roll chicken in flour, then brown in butter.
Remove chicken. Stir soup, seasonings and water or broth into drippings.
Cook and stir to a boil.
recipes.text: Chicken Rice Casserole. Roll chicken in flour, then brown in butter. Remove chicken. Stir soup, seasonings and water or broth into drippings. Cook and stir to a boil.

recipes.title: Chicken A La King
ingredients: fresh mushrooms and onion (as much as you want)
milk (1 to 2 cans until you get the thickness you want)
pimento (adds color mostly, as much as you want)
directions: Boil chicken 1 hour; saute mushrooms, onion and celery until tender in butter. When chicken is done, pull off bone and take skin off. Cut in bite size pieces. Mix cream of mushroom soup and milk; heat until warm. Add vegetables, chicken, peas and pimento. Heat until hot. Stir occasionally. Serve over rice or biscuits.
recipes.text: Chicken A La King. Boil chicken 1 hour; saute mushrooms, onion and celery until tender in butter. When chicken is done, pull off bone and take skin off. Cut in bite size pieces. Mix cream of mushroom soup and milk; heat until warm. Add vegetables, chicken, peas and pimento. Heat until hot. Stir occasionally. Serve over rice or biscuits.

recipes.title: Oven Pork Chops
directions: Layer potatoes and cheese in baking dish.
Place browned chops on top of potatoes and cheese.
Salt and pepper to taste.
Simmer onions in butter, then place over chops.
Pour soup over ingredients; add milk.
Cover with foil; bake at 350° for 1 hour. Uncover and bake another 1/2 hour.
recipes.text: Oven Pork Chops. Layer potatoes and cheese in baking dish. Place browned chops on top of potatoes and cheese. Salt and pepper to taste. Simmer onions in butter, then place over chops. Pour soup over ingredients; add milk. Cover with foil; bake at 350° for 1 hour. Uncover and bake another 1/2 hour.

recipes.title: Sunday Casserole
ingredients: 1/4 c. dry sherry or 1 Tbsp. vinegar and 1/4 c. water
directions: Put everything in a casserole.
Cover.
Bake at 325° for 3 hours.
Serve with noodles.
recipes.text: Sunday Casserole. Put everything in a casserole. Cover. Bake at 325° for 3 hours. Serve with noodles.

recipes.title: Baked Turkey
directions: Wash turkey thoroughly; salt outside of turkey.
Wrap in foil. Place in a deep pan lined with foil.
Bake in a 325° oven 25 minutes for each pound of turkey.
recipes.text: Baked Turkey. Wash turkey thoroughly; salt outside of turkey. Wrap in foil. Place in a deep pan lined with foil. Bake in a 325° oven 25 minutes for each pound of turkey.

recipes.title: Greek Rice
directions: Saute onion and lettuce in the butter.
Add rice and then consomme and goya beef bouillon and cook.
recipes.text: Greek Rice. Saute onion and lettuce in the butter. Add rice and then consomme and goya beef bouillon and cook.

recipes.title: Layered Chicken Salad
directions: Spread lettuce evenly in 4-quart dish. Add celery, water chestnuts, onion and chicken in layers. Pat peas dry and arrange on top layer.
recipes.text: Layered Chicken Salad. Spread lettuce evenly in 4-quart dish. Add celery, water chestnuts, onion and chicken in layers. Pat peas dry and arrange on top layer.

recipes.title: Stuffed Celery
directions: Cut celery 3 to 4-inches long.
Mix all the preceding.
Use decorating tube to fill.
Sprinkle with paprika.
recipes.text: Stuffed Celery. Cut celery 3 to 4-inches long. Mix all the preceding. Use decorating tube to fill. Sprinkle with paprika.

recipes.title: Cheese Fondue
directions: Mix first five ingredients.
Add yolks, well beaten; cut in whites, beaten stiff.
Pour in buttered baking dish.
Bake 20 minutes in moderate oven.
recipes.text: Cheese Fondue. Mix first five ingredients. Add yolks, well beaten; cut in whites, beaten stiff. Pour in buttered baking dish. Bake 20 minutes in moderate oven.

recipes.title: David'S Surprise
directions: Chop the onion and add to hamburger meat, then brown meat and add taco seasoning. In a separate pot, add both soups and pinto beans (heat to boil). Then reduce heat and add Ro-Tel for a few minutes. Microwave tortilla shells for a few seconds to soften. Put layer of six shells on bottom of pan. First layer will be the meat, then add the soup to the next layer, followed by the cheese (as much as you want). Repeat until all of the mixtures are gone.
recipes.text: David'S Surprise. Chop the onion and add to hamburger meat, then brown meat and add taco seasoning. In a separate pot, add both soups and pinto beans (heat to boil). Then reduce heat and add Ro-Tel for a few minutes. Microwave tortilla shells for a few seconds to soften. Put layer of six shells on bottom of pan. First layer will be the meat, then add the soup to the next layer, followed by the cheese (as much as you want). Repeat until all of the mixtures are gone.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Cheesecake Bars
directions: Combine flour, sugar, half the chopped peanuts and margarine until crumbly.
Stir in the beaten eggs and 1 teaspoon vanilla. Mix well.
Press into bottom of 15 x 10-inch jelly roll pan and bake at 350° for 15 minutes.
Beat cream cheese until fluffy. Beat in condensed milk, 2 remaining eggs, sugar and peanut butter. Add remaining teaspoon of vanilla and mix until smooth.
Pour over prepared crust and sprinkle the remaining peanuts on top.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes until set.
Cool and cut into bars.
recipes.text: Peanut Butter Cheesecake Bars. Combine flour, sugar, half the chopped peanuts and margarine until crumbly. Stir in the beaten eggs and 1 teaspoon vanilla. Mix well. Press into bottom of 15 x 10-inch jelly roll pan and bake at 350° for 15 minutes. Beat cream cheese until fluffy. Beat in condensed milk, 2 remaining eggs, sugar and peanut butter. Add remaining teaspoon of vanilla and mix until smooth. Pour over prepared crust and sprinkle the remaining peanuts on top. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes until set. Cool and cut into bars.

recipes.title: Oreo Ice Cream Dessert
directions: Form crust with Oreo cookies and melted butter in 8 1/2 x 11-inch pan.
recipes.text: Oreo Ice Cream Dessert. Form crust with Oreo cookies and melted butter in 8 1/2 x 11-inch pan.

recipes.title: Layered Salad
directions: Layer first 5 ingredients.
Mix sour cream and mayonnaise and spread over top, being sure to seal edges.
Sprinkle sugar over this mixture and top with the shredded cheese and bacon bits. This will keep in the refrigerator for a week.
recipes.text: Layered Salad. Layer first 5 ingredients. Mix sour cream and mayonnaise and spread over top, being sure to seal edges. Sprinkle sugar over this mixture and top with the shredded cheese and bacon bits. This will keep in the refrigerator for a week.

recipes.title: Angel Pie A La Gloria
directions: Beat egg whites until foamy.
Add all ingredients, except sugar.
Beat until stiff.
Add sugar, 1 tablespoon at a time.
Put in deep buttered 10-inch pie pan.
Bake at 275° for 45 minutes to 1 hour.
Crust should be high and slightly browned.
Turn off oven.
Let cool with door open.
recipes.text: Angel Pie A La Gloria. Beat egg whites until foamy. Add all ingredients, except sugar. Beat until stiff. Add sugar, 1 tablespoon at a time. Put in deep buttered 10-inch pie pan. Bake at 275° for 45 minutes to 1 hour. Crust should be high and slightly browned. Turn off oven. Let cool with door open.

recipes.title: Brotherhood Cookies
directions: Take 1 large field, half a dozen children, 2 or 3 small dogs, a pinch of brook and some pebbles.
Mix the children and dogs well together; put them on the field, stirring constantly.
Pour the brook over the pebbles; sprinkle the field with flowers; spread over all a deep blue sky and bake in the sun.
When brown, set away to cool in the bathtub.
recipes.text: Brotherhood Cookies. Take 1 large field, half a dozen children, 2 or 3 small dogs, a pinch of brook and some pebbles. Mix the children and dogs well together; put them on the field, stirring constantly. Pour the brook over the pebbles; sprinkle the field with flowers; spread over all a deep blue sky and bake in the sun. When brown, set away to cool in the bathtub.

recipes.title: Swiss Steak
ingredients: 2 lb. round steak, cut 1 inch thick
directions: Combine flour, salt and pepper; rub into both sides of steak or pound in with meat mallet or edge of heavy plate.
