Cut into 6 portions.
Peel and slice onions.
Preheat skillet; add half of shortening, then onions.
Brown lightly.
Remove from skillet. Add remaining shortening; brown steak on both sides.
Reduce heat. Add celery, garlic, chili sauce and water.
Cover; simmer 1 hour. Cut green pepper into slices.
Add pepper and onions to meat. Continue cooking 30 minutes or until meat is tender.
Makes 6 servings.
recipes.text: Swiss Steak. Combine flour, salt and pepper; rub into both sides of steak or pound in with meat mallet or edge of heavy plate. Cut into 6 portions. Peel and slice onions. Preheat skillet; add half of shortening, then onions. Brown lightly. Remove from skillet. Add remaining shortening; brown steak on both sides. Reduce heat. Add celery, garlic, chili sauce and water. Cover; simmer 1 hour. Cut green pepper into slices. Add pepper and onions to meat. Continue cooking 30 minutes or until meat is tender. Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Scalloped Salmon For Two
directions: Drain salmon, reserving liquid; remove skin and bones if desired.
Flake salmon with fork.
Dissolve bouillon in boiling water in a bowl.
Add salmon liquid, milk, egg, parsley and onion; mix well.
Add salmon, stuffing mix and cheese, mixing well. Place in 2 greased 10-ounce custard cups or casseroles.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
Serve with vegetable sauce if desired. (Vegetable sauce can be found in the Soup, Salads and Sauces section of this cookbook.)
recipes.text: Scalloped Salmon For Two. Drain salmon, reserving liquid; remove skin and bones if desired. Flake salmon with fork. Dissolve bouillon in boiling water in a bowl. Add salmon liquid, milk, egg, parsley and onion; mix well. Add salmon, stuffing mix and cheese, mixing well. Place in 2 greased 10-ounce custard cups or casseroles. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes. Serve with vegetable sauce if desired. (Vegetable sauce can be found in the Soup, Salads and Sauces section of this cookbook.)

recipes.title: Soap Flake Finger Paints
directions: Mix soap flakes and enough water to give the consistency of whipped cream.
Beat with a rotary beater until creamy.
Add food coloring for different colors.
recipes.text: Soap Flake Finger Paints. Mix soap flakes and enough water to give the consistency of whipped cream. Beat with a rotary beater until creamy. Add food coloring for different colors.

recipes.title: Easy Tuna Casserole
ingredients: 1 can cream of mushroom, chicken or celery soup
directions: Place tuna in layer in casserole or loaf pan; add undiluted soup.
Cover with potato chips.
Bake in preheated 350° oven for about 20 minutes or until bubbly.
Recipe may be served to large groups by increasing as many times as desired.
Yields 4 servings.
recipes.text: Easy Tuna Casserole. Place tuna in layer in casserole or loaf pan; add undiluted soup. Cover with potato chips. Bake in preheated 350° oven for about 20 minutes or until bubbly. Recipe may be served to large groups by increasing as many times as desired. Yields 4 servings.

recipes.title: Baked Beans Supreme
ingredients: 1/2 lb. hamburger (I use a little more)
1 c. brown sugar (I use 1/2 to 3/4 c.)
directions: Brown hamburger in skillet; add to beans.
Mix in remaining ingredients.
Bake at 375° for 1 hour or until brown.
Serves 6.
recipes.text: Baked Beans Supreme. Brown hamburger in skillet; add to beans. Mix in remaining ingredients. Bake at 375° for 1 hour or until brown. Serves 6.

recipes.title: Almond Cakes
directions: Sift together flour, baking powder and salt.
Combine oil with sugar; beat in egg and extract.
Add flour mixture.
If dough is crumbly, add a few drops of water to form a stiff dough.
Roll to 1/2-inch thick; cut with 2-inch cookie cutter.
Press an almond in center of each cookie.
Bake on ungreased cookie sheet at 350° until cookies are golden, 12 to 15 minutes.
Makes 2 dozen cookies.
recipes.text: Almond Cakes. Sift together flour, baking powder and salt. Combine oil with sugar; beat in egg and extract. Add flour mixture. If dough is crumbly, add a few drops of water to form a stiff dough. Roll to 1/2-inch thick; cut with 2-inch cookie cutter. Press an almond in center of each cookie. Bake on ungreased cookie sheet at 350° until cookies are golden, 12 to 15 minutes. Makes 2 dozen cookies.

recipes.title: Apricot Nectar Cake
directions: Mix together.
Bake for 1 hour at 350° in tube pan or 9 x 13-inch pan.
recipes.text: Apricot Nectar Cake. Mix together. Bake for 1 hour at 350° in tube pan or 9 x 13-inch pan.

recipes.title: Apple Streusel Pie
directions: Combine ingredients, except apples.
Toss with apples.
Pour into unbaked 9-inch pie crust.
recipes.text: Apple Streusel Pie. Combine ingredients, except apples. Toss with apples. Pour into unbaked 9-inch pie crust.

recipes.title: Citrus Marshmallow Dessert
directions: Cut marshmallows in quarters; put into double boiler; add orange juice and cook until marshmallows are thoroughly dissolved. Chill slightly; pour into sherbert glasses; chill in refrigerator and serve with whipped cream.
Serves 6 to 8.
recipes.text: Citrus Marshmallow Dessert. Cut marshmallows in quarters; put into double boiler; add orange juice and cook until marshmallows are thoroughly dissolved. Chill slightly; pour into sherbert glasses; chill in refrigerator and serve with whipped cream. Serves 6 to 8.

recipes.title: Glazed Nuts
ingredients: 12 oz. to 1 lb. nuts or pecans
directions: Mix egg white and water.
Whip until frothy.
Add cinnamon, sugar and salt.
Then add nuts or pecans.
Spread on a lightly greased cookie sheet.
Bake at 250° for 1 hour.
Toss every 15 minutes.
recipes.text: Glazed Nuts. Mix egg white and water. Whip until frothy. Add cinnamon, sugar and salt. Then add nuts or pecans. Spread on a lightly greased cookie sheet. Bake at 250° for 1 hour. Toss every 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Banana Nut Bread
directions: Mix all together in greased bread pan.
Bake 1 hour at 275°.
recipes.text: Banana Nut Bread. Mix all together in greased bread pan. Bake 1 hour at 275°.

recipes.title: Lemonade Pie
ingredients: 1 (6 oz.) can frozen lemonade concentrate, thawed
1 (14 oz.) Eagle Brand sweetened condensed milk
1 (8 oz.) carton frozen whipped topping, thawed
directions: Combine lemonade, milk and coloring.
Stir well.
Fold in whipped topping.
Pour into crust and freeze until firm (about 4 hours or overnight).
Garnish with lemon slices and whipped topping as desired.
(Remove frozen pie from freezer about 15 minutes before serving to thaw slightly.) Serves 6 to 8.
recipes.text: Lemonade Pie. Combine lemonade, milk and coloring. Stir well. Fold in whipped topping. Pour into crust and freeze until firm (about 4 hours or overnight). Garnish with lemon slices and whipped topping as desired. (Remove frozen pie from freezer about 15 minutes before serving to thaw slightly.) Serves 6 to 8.

recipes.title: Soap Bubbles
directions: Combine ingredients.
Glycerin will make bubbles iridescent. Blow bubbles through wire loops or spools.
To make lots of bubbles outdoors, place fly swatter in soapy water and swing it around.
recipes.text: Soap Bubbles. Combine ingredients. Glycerin will make bubbles iridescent. Blow bubbles through wire loops or spools. To make lots of bubbles outdoors, place fly swatter in soapy water and swing it around.

recipes.title: Monkey Bread
ingredients: 1 c. sugar and 4 Tbsp. cinnamon, mixed
directions: Break off balls of dough.
Roll in margarine, then sugar-cinnamon mixture.
Place in greased tube pan.
Let rise for 1 hour.
Bake for 30 minutes at 350°.
Invert pan to cool.
recipes.text: Monkey Bread. Break off balls of dough. Roll in margarine, then sugar-cinnamon mixture. Place in greased tube pan. Let rise for 1 hour. Bake for 30 minutes at 350°. Invert pan to cool.

recipes.title: San Francisco French Toast
directions: Combine eggs vanilla extract, sugar and
orange juice
Mix well.
Heat oil in skillet.
Dip bread slices into egg mixture. Fry in oil until lightly browned on each side.
Serve with syrup, powdered sugar and apple butter.
recipes.text: San Francisco French Toast. Combine eggs vanilla extract, sugar and orange juice Mix well. Heat oil in skillet. Dip bread slices into egg mixture. Fry in oil until lightly browned on each side. Serve with syrup, powdered sugar and apple butter.

recipes.title: Missouri Biscuits
directions: Preheat the oven to 450 degrees.
In a large mixing bowl, sift together the flour, baking powder and salt.
Add the oil and milk.
Beat until mixture clings together.
Pinch off portions and roll in balls about 1 1/2 inches in diameter.
Flatten slightly. Melt the butter in a 7 inch skillet.
Place each biscuit in the butter and then turn it over so that each side is buttered.
Bake for about 8 to 10 minutes or until golden brown.
Serve hot. Yield: about 8 biscuits.
recipes.text: Missouri Biscuits. Preheat the oven to 450 degrees. In a large mixing bowl, sift together the flour, baking powder and salt. Add the oil and milk. Beat until mixture clings together. Pinch off portions and roll in balls about 1 1/2 inches in diameter. Flatten slightly. Melt the butter in a 7 inch skillet. Place each biscuit in the butter and then turn it over so that each side is buttered. Bake for about 8 to 10 minutes or until golden brown. Serve hot. Yield: about 8 biscuits.

recipes.title: Chicken Teriyaki
directions: Debone chicken and cut into strips.
Marinate in sauce overnight.
Grill.
recipes.text: Chicken Teriyaki. Debone chicken and cut into strips. Marinate in sauce overnight. Grill.

recipes.title: Hickory Nut Cake
directions: Cream butter and sugar.
Sift flour and baking powder.
Add alternately with milk.
Then add well beaten egg whites.
Add nuts. Bake in layers put together with Caramel Icing and nuts.
recipes.text: Hickory Nut Cake. Cream butter and sugar. Sift flour and baking powder. Add alternately with milk. Then add well beaten egg whites. Add nuts. Bake in layers put together with Caramel Icing and nuts.

recipes.title: Barbecups
directions: Preheat oven to 400°.
Brown meat; drain.
Add sauce, onion and sugar and set aside.
Separate dough and place each in ungreased muffin cup, pressing dough up sides to edge of cup. Spoon meat mixture into cups.
Bake 10 to 15 minutes until golden. Sprinkle with cheese and return to oven until melted.
Makes 10.
recipes.text: Barbecups. Preheat oven to 400°. Brown meat; drain. Add sauce, onion and sugar and set aside. Separate dough and place each in ungreased muffin cup, pressing dough up sides to edge of cup. Spoon meat mixture into cups. Bake 10 to 15 minutes until golden. Sprinkle with cheese and return to oven until melted. Makes 10.

recipes.title: Pizza Cups
ingredients: meat of your choice (sausage, pepperoni, etc.)
directions: Spray muffin pans with cooking spray.
Press refrigerator biscuits in bottom and up sides.
Put on pizza sauce, other ingredients, then cheese.
Bake at 350° until done.
recipes.text: Pizza Cups. Spray muffin pans with cooking spray. Press refrigerator biscuits in bottom and up sides. Put on pizza sauce, other ingredients, then cheese. Bake at 350° until done.

recipes.title: Chicken Pot Pie
directions: Mix and set aside in 9 x 13-inch pan.
Prepare topping and pour over chicken mixture.
recipes.text: Chicken Pot Pie. Mix and set aside in 9 x 13-inch pan. Prepare topping and pour over chicken mixture.

recipes.title: Baked Chicken Breasts
directions: Wrap in foil unbrowned chicken with all ingredients.
Bake at 350°
for 2 hours.
Serve over rice.
recipes.text: Baked Chicken Breasts. Wrap in foil unbrowned chicken with all ingredients. Bake at 350° for 2 hours. Serve over rice.

recipes.title: English Pea Casserole
directions: Cook peas in butter for a few minutes; drain. Layer 1/2 of peas, soup, pimento, eggs and cheese. Repeat with other half. Top with cracker crumbs the last 10 minutes of cooking time. Bake 30 minutes at 350°.
recipes.text: English Pea Casserole. Cook peas in butter for a few minutes; drain. Layer 1/2 of peas, soup, pimento, eggs and cheese. Repeat with other half. Top with cracker crumbs the last 10 minutes of cooking time. Bake 30 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Chicken Noodle Bake
directions: In a buttered medium-size casserole dish, blend soup and milk.
Stir in cooked noodles, chicken and pimento.
Top with buttered bread crumbs.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes. Yield: 3 to 4 servings.
recipes.text: Chicken Noodle Bake. In a buttered medium-size casserole dish, blend soup and milk. Stir in cooked noodles, chicken and pimento. Top with buttered bread crumbs. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes. Yield: 3 to 4 servings.

recipes.title: Apple Crunch Salad
directions: Dissolve gelatin in boiling water.
Stir in apple juice and cinnamon; chill until consistency of unbeaten egg white.
Stir in remaining ingredients.
Pour into an oiled 8-inch square dish; chill until firm.
Yields 9 servings.
recipes.text: Apple Crunch Salad. Dissolve gelatin in boiling water. Stir in apple juice and cinnamon; chill until consistency of unbeaten egg white. Stir in remaining ingredients. Pour into an oiled 8-inch square dish; chill until firm. Yields 9 servings.

recipes.title: Mexican Salad
ingredients: 1 can Mexican chili beans, drained and chilled
directions: Combine lettuce, onion, chili beans and cheese.
Add tomatoes and Fritos just before serving.
Toss salad with dressing.
Yields 20 servings.
recipes.text: Mexican Salad. Combine lettuce, onion, chili beans and cheese. Add tomatoes and Fritos just before serving. Toss salad with dressing. Yields 20 servings.

recipes.title: Tasty Meat Loaf
ingredients: 1/4 c. grated onion or 2 Tbsp. dehydrated onion
chili sauce to cover (Nance's is best)
directions: Soak bread crumbs in milk for several minutes.
(If using dehydrated onions, soak in milk, also.)
Mix all ingredients together well.
Form in two individual loaves and place in greased pan.
Cover meat loaves with chili sauce.
Bake in moderate oven (350°) for 45 minutes or form in single loaf in 4 3/4 x 8 3/4-inch loaf pan.
Cover with chili sauce and bake 1 hour.
recipes.text: Tasty Meat Loaf. Soak bread crumbs in milk for several minutes. (If using dehydrated onions, soak in milk, also.) Mix all ingredients together well. Form in two individual loaves and place in greased pan. Cover meat loaves with chili sauce. Bake in moderate oven (350°) for 45 minutes or form in single loaf in 4 3/4 x 8 3/4-inch loaf pan. Cover with chili sauce and bake 1 hour.

recipes.title: Potato Chip Cookies
directions: Cream butter, sugar and vanilla until light and fluffy.
Stir in crushed potato chips and flour.
Drop dough by heaping teaspoonfuls on greased baking sheet.
Bake at 350° for 12 to 15 minutes or until edges of cookies are lightly browned.
Makes 8 1/2 dozen.
recipes.text: Potato Chip Cookies. Cream butter, sugar and vanilla until light and fluffy. Stir in crushed potato chips and flour. Drop dough by heaping teaspoonfuls on greased baking sheet. Bake at 350° for 12 to 15 minutes or until edges of cookies are lightly browned. Makes 8 1/2 dozen.

recipes.title: Pasta Delight
ingredients: 2 Tbsp. chopped fresh basil or 1/2 tsp. dried basil, crushed
12 oz. uncooked penne pasta, hot cooked and drained
directions: Cook and stir zucchini in hot oil in large skillet over medium-high heat.
Reduce heat to medium.
Add shallots and garlic; cook 1 minute.
Add tomato; cook and stir 45 seconds.
Add basil and cheese.
Pour vegetable mix over penne in bowl; toss gently to mix.
Serves 4 to 6.
recipes.text: Pasta Delight. Cook and stir zucchini in hot oil in large skillet over medium-high heat. Reduce heat to medium. Add shallots and garlic; cook 1 minute. Add tomato; cook and stir 45 seconds. Add basil and cheese. Pour vegetable mix over penne in bowl; toss gently to mix. Serves 4 to 6.

recipes.title: Traditional Meat Loaf
directions: Heat oven to 350°.
In a one-quart casserole dish, combine lime juice, water, garlic, chili powder, oregano and beef; cover with lid or foil.
Wrap tortillas in foil.
Heat meat and tortillas at 350° for 10 to 15 minutes or until meat is thoroughly heated and tortillas are softened.
recipes.text: Traditional Meat Loaf. Heat oven to 350°. In a one-quart casserole dish, combine lime juice, water, garlic, chili powder, oregano and beef; cover with lid or foil. Wrap tortillas in foil. Heat meat and tortillas at 350° for 10 to 15 minutes or until meat is thoroughly heated and tortillas are softened.

recipes.title: Scalloped Potatoes
ingredients: 1 1/2-inch chunk Velveeta, cut into small chunks
directions: Stir all together in a 2 1/2-quart ovensafe bowl. (Bowl should only be 3/4 full, so that potatoes don't boil over while baking.) Bake 1 1/2 hours at 350°. Will be brown on top.
recipes.text: Scalloped Potatoes. Stir all together in a 2 1/2-quart ovensafe bowl. (Bowl should only be 3/4 full, so that potatoes don't boil over while baking.) Bake 1 1/2 hours at 350°. Will be brown on top.

recipes.title: Italian Casserole
directions: Brown hamburger and onion with seasoning mix.
Drain.
Add tomato sauce.
Place in 9 x 13-inch pan.
Mix cheese and sour cream and layer over meat mixture.
Add the crescent rolls over the cheese mixture.
Spread dough out flat.
Mix Parmesan cheese and margarine.
Spoon over dough.
Bake at 400° for 20 to 25 minutes.
recipes.text: Italian Casserole. Brown hamburger and onion with seasoning mix. Drain. Add tomato sauce. Place in 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix cheese and sour cream and layer over meat mixture. Add the crescent rolls over the cheese mixture. Spread dough out flat. Mix Parmesan cheese and margarine. Spoon over dough. Bake at 400° for 20 to 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Slovenian Potato Salad
directions: Boil potatoes until tender, but firm.
Cool in water.
Peel and slice.
Prepare 1 package dressing according to package.
Pour over potatoes and marinate overnight.
Add additional dressing. Garnish with chives or onion.
recipes.text: Slovenian Potato Salad. Boil potatoes until tender, but firm. Cool in water. Peel and slice. Prepare 1 package dressing according to package. Pour over potatoes and marinate overnight. Add additional dressing. Garnish with chives or onion.

recipes.title: Fudge Sheet Cake
directions: Set aside flour and sugar.
Heat water, salt, cocoa and butter. Add the sugar and flour.
Add remaining ingredients.
Bake 15 to 20 minutes at 350°.
recipes.text: Fudge Sheet Cake. Set aside flour and sugar. Heat water, salt, cocoa and butter. Add the sugar and flour. Add remaining ingredients. Bake 15 to 20 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Appetizer Pizza
directions: Separate each biscuit into 2 layers.
Place on bottom and sides of greased 12-inch pizza pan, pressing together to form crust.
Saute onion, zucchini and mushrooms in margarine.
Combine cream cheese, milk, egg and salt, mixing until well blended.
Stir in vegetables.
Pour over crust and bake at 400° for 20 to 25 minutes or until crust is golden brown.
Serve warm.
recipes.text: Appetizer Pizza. Separate each biscuit into 2 layers. Place on bottom and sides of greased 12-inch pizza pan, pressing together to form crust. Saute onion, zucchini and mushrooms in margarine. Combine cream cheese, milk, egg and salt, mixing until well blended. Stir in vegetables. Pour over crust and bake at 400° for 20 to 25 minutes or until crust is golden brown. Serve warm.

recipes.title: Rice Pudding
directions: Bake at 325° for 35 minutes.
recipes.text: Rice Pudding. Bake at 325° for 35 minutes.

recipes.title: Chicken Enchilada Soup
directions: In large saucepan/stockpot place oil, chicken base, onions, and spices.
Saute until onions are soft and clear, about 5 minutes.
In a separate container add masa and 1 qt. of water. Stir until all lumps are dissolved.
Add to sauteed onions and bring to a boil.
Once the mixture starts to "bubble" continue cooking for approximately 2-3 minutes, stirring constantly.
This will eliminate the "raw" taste from the masa.
recipes.text: Chicken Enchilada Soup. In large saucepan/stockpot place oil, chicken base, onions, and spices. Saute until onions are soft and clear, about 5 minutes. In a separate container add masa and 1 qt. of water. Stir until all lumps are dissolved. Add to sauteed onions and bring to a boil. Once the mixture starts to "bubble" continue cooking for approximately 2-3 minutes, stirring constantly. This will eliminate the "raw" taste from the masa.

recipes.title: Crock-Pot Macaroni
directions: Mix macaroni with remaining ingredients and put in a crock-pot that has been greased with butter.
Sprinkle some on top.
Cook on low 3 1/2 to 4 hours.
recipes.text: Crock-Pot Macaroni. Mix macaroni with remaining ingredients and put in a crock-pot that has been greased with butter. Sprinkle some on top. Cook on low 3 1/2 to 4 hours.

recipes.title: Sausage Casserole
directions: Cook sausage with water in covered frying pan until tender, approximately 20 minutes.
Remove sausage and cook green pepper and onion for 5 minutes, then add the condensed tomato soup and heat through.
Combine sauce with macaroni and mix well.
Place in casserole with sausage arranged on top.
Bake in a moderate oven (350°) for approximately 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Sausage Casserole. Cook sausage with water in covered frying pan until tender, approximately 20 minutes. Remove sausage and cook green pepper and onion for 5 minutes, then add the condensed tomato soup and heat through. Combine sauce with macaroni and mix well. Place in casserole with sausage arranged on top. Bake in a moderate oven (350°) for approximately 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Oven Baked Chicken
ingredients: 1 (10 1/2 oz.) can condensed cream of mushroom soup
directions: Sprinkle rice in lightly buttered shallow pan (baking). Lay chicken pieces, skin side up, over rice. Spread soup evenly over all. Cover. Bake in 350° oven for 1 hour or until tender. May remove cover after 1/2 hour for crispy chicken. Yields 4 to 5 servings.
recipes.text: Oven Baked Chicken. Sprinkle rice in lightly buttered shallow pan (baking). Lay chicken pieces, skin side up, over rice. Spread soup evenly over all. Cover. Bake in 350° oven for 1 hour or until tender. May remove cover after 1/2 hour for crispy chicken. Yields 4 to 5 servings.

recipes.title: Black Walnut Fudge
directions: Boil to soft ball stage the sugar, salt and sour cream.
Add butter and black walnuts.
Cool at room temperature, without stirring, until lukewarm (110°).
Beat until loses its gloss.
Add nuts.
Spread in buttered 8 x 8 x 2-inch pan.
Cut into pieces.
recipes.text: Black Walnut Fudge. Boil to soft ball stage the sugar, salt and sour cream. Add butter and black walnuts. Cool at room temperature, without stirring, until lukewarm (110°). Beat until loses its gloss. Add nuts. Spread in buttered 8 x 8 x 2-inch pan. Cut into pieces.

recipes.title: Red Velvet Cake
directions: Cream together sugar and oil.
Add eggs beating well.
Add vinegar and food coloring to sugar mixture.
Set aside.
Sift together all dry ingredients in a separate bowl.
Add dry ingredients and buttermilk alternately to sugar mixture, mixing well after each.
Add vanilla.
Place in 3 (9-inch) cake pans that have been greased and floured.
Bake 30 to 35 minutes at 350°.
recipes.text: Red Velvet Cake. Cream together sugar and oil. Add eggs beating well. Add vinegar and food coloring to sugar mixture. Set aside. Sift together all dry ingredients in a separate bowl. Add dry ingredients and buttermilk alternately to sugar mixture, mixing well after each. Add vanilla. Place in 3 (9-inch) cake pans that have been greased and floured. Bake 30 to 35 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Suzanne'S Mexican Dip
ingredients: 1 small can Hormel no bean chili
1 small can Old El Paso mild chopped chilies
directions: Soften and spread cream cheese in pie dish.
Pour can of Hormel chili over cheese.
Sprinkle on green onions.
Add can of chopped chilies.
Add olives, if desired.
Shake packet of cheese over mixture.
Bake 1/2 hour at 350°.
Serve with Tostitos.
recipes.text: Suzanne'S Mexican Dip. Soften and spread cream cheese in pie dish. Pour can of Hormel chili over cheese. Sprinkle on green onions. Add can of chopped chilies. Add olives, if desired. Shake packet of cheese over mixture. Bake 1/2 hour at 350°. Serve with Tostitos.

recipes.title: Breakfast Casserole
directions: Cream butter and cheese.
Line 9 x 13-inch pan with bread slices.
Spread cheese mix over bread.
Put on a layer of meat. Beat eggs, add milk and mix together.
Pour over meat; put another layer of bread on top.
Bake 1 hour at 325° until puffy and brown. Can be fixed at night and baked in the morning.
recipes.text: Breakfast Casserole. Cream butter and cheese. Line 9 x 13-inch pan with bread slices. Spread cheese mix over bread. Put on a layer of meat. Beat eggs, add milk and mix together. Pour over meat; put another layer of bread on top. Bake 1 hour at 325° until puffy and brown. Can be fixed at night and baked in the morning.

recipes.title: Easy Breakfast Eggs
directions: Butter both sides of bread.
Place bread on bottom of a greased 9 x 13-inch pan.
Pour the rest of the ingredients over the bread and let stand overnight in the refrigerator.
Bake 1 hour at 350°.
recipes.text: Easy Breakfast Eggs. Butter both sides of bread. Place bread on bottom of a greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Pour the rest of the ingredients over the bread and let stand overnight in the refrigerator. Bake 1 hour at 350°.

recipes.title: Busy Day Casserole(Chicken Or Turkey)
directions: Combine soups in a 2-quart casserole dish.
Stir in meat. Sprinkle with croutons.
Bake for 30 minutes at 350°.
recipes.text: Busy Day Casserole(Chicken Or Turkey). Combine soups in a 2-quart casserole dish. Stir in meat. Sprinkle with croutons. Bake for 30 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Ritz Cracker Pie
directions: Add
sugar
to	boiling
water;
bring to a boil again. Add remaining ingredients;
boil for 3 minutes.
Pour into an unbaked pie
shell;
top
with butter and cinnamon.
Top with another pie shell.
Bake at 400° for 30 to 35 minutes.
recipes.text: Ritz Cracker Pie. Add sugar to	boiling water; bring to a boil again. Add remaining ingredients; boil for 3 minutes. Pour into an unbaked pie shell; top with butter and cinnamon. Top with another pie shell. Bake at 400° for 30 to 35 minutes.

recipes.title: Grandma'S Sugar Cookies
directions: Cream shortening and sugar.
Beat in egg.
Add sifted dry ingredients and hot milk.
Cut with cookie cutters.
Bake at 375° until done.
recipes.text: Grandma'S Sugar Cookies. Cream shortening and sugar. Beat in egg. Add sifted dry ingredients and hot milk. Cut with cookie cutters. Bake at 375° until done.

recipes.title: Orange Spiced Tea
directions: Peel oranges (no white), cut into thin strips, spread on cookie sheet.
Bake at 250° for 10 minutes.
Cool.
Toss all ingredients. Cover.
Store one week before use.
recipes.text: Orange Spiced Tea. Peel oranges (no white), cut into thin strips, spread on cookie sheet. Bake at 250° for 10 minutes. Cool. Toss all ingredients. Cover. Store one week before use.

recipes.title: Homemade Beans
directions: Cook beans until done.
Cook onion, pepper and bacon.
Combine ingredients with beans and simmer for 2 hours.
recipes.text: Homemade Beans. Cook beans until done. Cook onion, pepper and bacon. Combine ingredients with beans and simmer for 2 hours.

recipes.title: Lime Jello Salad
directions: Heat crushed pineapple to boiling.
Add Jell-O; stir until dissolved.
Cool.
Add cottage cheese and nuts.
Pour into bowl. Refrigerate until set.
recipes.text: Lime Jello Salad. Heat crushed pineapple to boiling. Add Jell-O; stir until dissolved. Cool. Add cottage cheese and nuts. Pour into bowl. Refrigerate until set.

recipes.title: Meat Loaf
ingredients: 3 slices white bread, cut in pieces
directions: Combine all ingredients.
Spread in a 9 x 5-inch ungreased loaf dish.
Microwave on High 16 to 21 minutes, or until firm, rotating dish.
Let stand 5 to 10 minutes.
recipes.text: Meat Loaf. Combine all ingredients. Spread in a 9 x 5-inch ungreased loaf dish. Microwave on High 16 to 21 minutes, or until firm, rotating dish. Let stand 5 to 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Caramel Popcorn
directions: Combine
margarine,
brown
sugar
and	corn syrup in a large saucepan;
bring
to a boil.
Boil for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally,
so
it doesn't scorch.
Remove from heat. Add baking
soda;
mixture will foam.
Pour over popped corn; mix well.
Pour
into
unbuttered
large pan (a roaster works well); place
in
a 200° oven for 1 hour, stirring about every 15 minutes.
Store in covered container.
recipes.text: Caramel Popcorn. Combine margarine, brown sugar and	corn syrup in a large saucepan; bring to a boil. Boil for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally, so it doesn't scorch. Remove from heat. Add baking soda; mixture will foam. Pour over popped corn; mix well. Pour into unbuttered large pan (a roaster works well); place in a 200° oven for 1 hour, stirring about every 15 minutes. Store in covered container.

recipes.title: Baked Sour Cream Chicken
ingredients: 3 chicken breasts, boned, skinned and halved
directions: In a medium bowl, combine first 8 ingredients. Dip chicken in batter, then roll in crumbs.
Place meaty side down in a large greased baking pan. Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 45 to 60 minutes, turning over after 1/2 hour.
Yields 4 to 6 servings.
recipes.text: Baked Sour Cream Chicken. In a medium bowl, combine first 8 ingredients. Dip chicken in batter, then roll in crumbs. Place meaty side down in a large greased baking pan. Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 45 to 60 minutes, turning over after 1/2 hour. Yields 4 to 6 servings.

recipes.title: Nut Bread
directions: Beat
2 eggs with 2 cups milk, stir in the dry ingredients, put in two loaf pans.
Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.
recipes.text: Nut Bread. Beat 2 eggs with 2 cups milk, stir in the dry ingredients, put in two loaf pans. Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Mushroom Bacon Bites
directions: Wrap each mushroom with a piece of bacon; secure with a toothpick. Thread onto metal or soaked bamboo skewers. Brush with barbecue sauce. Grill, uncovered, over indirect medium heat for 10 to 15 minutes or until the bacon is crisp and the mushrooms are tender, turning and basting occasionally with remaining barbecue sauce. YIELD: 2 dozen.
recipes.text: Mushroom Bacon Bites. Wrap each mushroom with a piece of bacon; secure with a toothpick. Thread onto metal or soaked bamboo skewers. Brush with barbecue sauce. Grill, uncovered, over indirect medium heat for 10 to 15 minutes or until the bacon is crisp and the mushrooms are tender, turning and basting occasionally with remaining barbecue sauce. YIELD: 2 dozen.

recipes.title: Chicken-Rice Casserole
directions: Put rice in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish and place chicken on top of it.
Mix together the water and cream of mushroom soup.
Pour over the chicken.
Sprinkle with onion soup mix; cover with foil and bake at 350° for about an hour.
Uncover and bake 30 minutes longer.
recipes.text: Chicken-Rice Casserole. Put rice in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish and place chicken on top of it. Mix together the water and cream of mushroom soup. Pour over the chicken. Sprinkle with onion soup mix; cover with foil and bake at 350° for about an hour. Uncover and bake 30 minutes longer.

recipes.title: Coca-Cola Cake
directions: Sift together sugar and flour.
Add marshmallows.
Set aside. Bring to a boil cocoa, oleo, shortening and cola.
Pour over dry ingredients.
Add the buttermilk, soda and eggs.
Mix by hand.
Do not beat with a mixer.
Pour into greased and floured 10 x 15-inch pan.
Bake at 350° for 20 to 30 minutes.
If chocolate cakes are baked too long, they may become too dry, so bake just until done. Frost with Coca-Cola Icing.
recipes.text: Coca-Cola Cake. Sift together sugar and flour. Add marshmallows. Set aside. Bring to a boil cocoa, oleo, shortening and cola. Pour over dry ingredients. Add the buttermilk, soda and eggs. Mix by hand. Do not beat with a mixer. Pour into greased and floured 10 x 15-inch pan. Bake at 350° for 20 to 30 minutes. If chocolate cakes are baked too long, they may become too dry, so bake just until done. Frost with Coca-Cola Icing.

recipes.title: Mallow Fruit Dip
directions: Beat ingredients at medium speed with electric mixer until well blended.
Serve with fruit or pound cake cubes, if desired. Makes 3 cups.
recipes.text: Mallow Fruit Dip. Beat ingredients at medium speed with electric mixer until well blended. Serve with fruit or pound cake cubes, if desired. Makes 3 cups.

recipes.title: Easy Cream Cheese Clouds
directions: Mix
cream cheese, sugar and vanilla at medium speed on electric
mixer.
Gradually
add
heavy cream; mix well.
Whip until thickened.
Using the
back
of
a
spoon, shape into 10 (3 1/2-inch) shells.
Place on waxed paper-lined cookie sheet. Freeze 2 hours or	overnight.
When
ready to serve, fill with cherry pie filling. Sprinkle chopped nuts on top, if desired.
recipes.text: Easy Cream Cheese Clouds. Mix cream cheese, sugar and vanilla at medium speed on electric mixer. Gradually add heavy cream; mix well. Whip until thickened. Using the back of a spoon, shape into 10 (3 1/2-inch) shells. Place on waxed paper-lined cookie sheet. Freeze 2 hours or	overnight. When ready to serve, fill with cherry pie filling. Sprinkle chopped nuts on top, if desired.

recipes.title: Hawaiian Meat Balls
directions: Combine beef, onion, salt, milk and bread crumbs; form into balls and brown.
Combine pineapple juice and water to make 1 cup. Add cornstarch, vinegar, sugar and soy sauce; cook until thick and clear.
Add green peppers and pineapple.
Pour over meat balls.
Bake 1 hour at 350°.
recipes.text: Hawaiian Meat Balls. Combine beef, onion, salt, milk and bread crumbs; form into balls and brown. Combine pineapple juice and water to make 1 cup. Add cornstarch, vinegar, sugar and soy sauce; cook until thick and clear. Add green peppers and pineapple. Pour over meat balls. Bake 1 hour at 350°.

recipes.title: Spinach Casserole
ingredients: 2 (10 oz.) boxes frozen chopped spinach, thawed
directions: Preheat oven to 350°.
Grease shallow 9-inch round baking dish.
Drain and squeeze out excess moisture from spinach.
Place in mixing bowl.
Stir in cottage cheese, sour cream, eggs, flour, nutmeg and salt.
Blend thoroughly and turn into greased dish. Bake 45 minutes or until firm and puffy.
Serves 4 to 6.
recipes.text: Spinach Casserole. Preheat oven to 350°. Grease shallow 9-inch round baking dish. Drain and squeeze out excess moisture from spinach. Place in mixing bowl. Stir in cottage cheese, sour cream, eggs, flour, nutmeg and salt. Blend thoroughly and turn into greased dish. Bake 45 minutes or until firm and puffy. Serves 4 to 6.

recipes.title: "Berry - Berry Christmas"
ingredients: 2 (12 oz.) cans frozen pink lemonade concentrate, thawed
directions: Stir together lemonade concentrate and vodka; add strawberries and lime slices.
Serve over crushed ice.
recipes.text: "Berry - Berry Christmas". Stir together lemonade concentrate and vodka; add strawberries and lime slices. Serve over crushed ice.

recipes.title: Beef Rouladen(Contest Winner)
ingredients: 10 slices round steak, cut in 3 x 6 x 1/4-inch thick
directions: Pound meat very thin until almost double in size.
Salt and pepper.
Saute bacon and onion.
Spread 1 tablespoon of bacon mixture on each slice, spreading evenly.
Roll meat slices and tie with butchers string or secure with toothpicks.
Heat oil or drippings in large skillet.
Fry rolls until brown.
Reduce heat to low and add water and bouillon until covered.
Cover and cook until tender, approximately 1 hour.
Remove rolls from pan.
Skim off any fat.
Mix 2 tablespoons flour to little water until smooth.
Add to skillet and cook until thick.
Add salt and pepper as needed.
Add sour cream and mix well.
Return rolls (without picks or string) until warm.
Do not boil.
recipes.text: Beef Rouladen(Contest Winner). Pound meat very thin until almost double in size. Salt and pepper. Saute bacon and onion. Spread 1 tablespoon of bacon mixture on each slice, spreading evenly. Roll meat slices and tie with butchers string or secure with toothpicks. Heat oil or drippings in large skillet. Fry rolls until brown. Reduce heat to low and add water and bouillon until covered. Cover and cook until tender, approximately 1 hour. Remove rolls from pan. Skim off any fat. Mix 2 tablespoons flour to little water until smooth. Add to skillet and cook until thick. Add salt and pepper as needed. Add sour cream and mix well. Return rolls (without picks or string) until warm. Do not boil.

recipes.title: Hopped Up Chicken
directions: Sprinkle salt, pepper, rosemary, marjoram and oregano over chicken.
Saute in butter until golden brown.
Add lemon juice and wine.
Cover and simmer until tender.
recipes.text: Hopped Up Chicken. Sprinkle salt, pepper, rosemary, marjoram and oregano over chicken. Saute in butter until golden brown. Add lemon juice and wine. Cover and simmer until tender.

recipes.title: Cowboy Beans
ingredients: 1 lb. ground beef, cooked and drained
directions: Combine all ingredients; bring to a boil.
Serve with crackers or Fritos and cheese.
recipes.text: Cowboy Beans. Combine all ingredients; bring to a boil. Serve with crackers or Fritos and cheese.

recipes.title: Cheese Log
directions: Grind cheese, garlic and pecans in finest grinder.
Mix well. Add vinegar and salt to taste.
This mixture is rather soft.
Form into small log and put in refrigerator.
When cheese is cooled, mix together paprika and chili powder and roll log in mixture. Wrap in plastic wrap.
recipes.text: Cheese Log. Grind cheese, garlic and pecans in finest grinder. Mix well. Add vinegar and salt to taste. This mixture is rather soft. Form into small log and put in refrigerator. When cheese is cooled, mix together paprika and chili powder and roll log in mixture. Wrap in plastic wrap.

recipes.title: Company Potatoes
directions: Peel potatoes.
Boil until tender, drain.
Beat softened cream cheese and sour cream at medium speed until well blended. Add hot potatoes gradually, beating constantly.
Add onion, mayonnaise, garlic powder, salt and pepper, still beating until potatoes are light and fluffy.
Put into a 2 quart casserole, sprinkle on parmesan cheese, dot with butter and sprinkle lightly with paprika.
Bake at 325 degrees for 25-30 minutes.
Makes 6 servings.
recipes.text: Company Potatoes. Peel potatoes. Boil until tender, drain. Beat softened cream cheese and sour cream at medium speed until well blended. Add hot potatoes gradually, beating constantly. Add onion, mayonnaise, garlic powder, salt and pepper, still beating until potatoes are light and fluffy. Put into a 2 quart casserole, sprinkle on parmesan cheese, dot with butter and sprinkle lightly with paprika. Bake at 325 degrees for 25-30 minutes. Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Barley Vegetable Soup
directions: Bring 5 cups water to boil with salt in large saucepan.
Add tomatoes, barley, bay leaf, sage and oregano.
Reduce heat, cover pan and simmer until barley is tender, 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Barley Vegetable Soup. Bring 5 cups water to boil with salt in large saucepan. Add tomatoes, barley, bay leaf, sage and oregano. Reduce heat, cover pan and simmer until barley is tender, 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Benedictine Spread
directions: Combine first 5 ingredients in a bowl; mix well.
Add a drop of green food coloring; stir well.
Spread mixture on bread slices.
Serve as finger sandwiches.
recipes.text: Benedictine Spread. Combine first 5 ingredients in a bowl; mix well. Add a drop of green food coloring; stir well. Spread mixture on bread slices. Serve as finger sandwiches.

recipes.title: Mexican Chicken
directions: Boil chicken; butter dish.
Add onion, cheese, chips and chicken to dish.
Heat can of mushroom soup, chicken soup and 1/2 can Ro-Tel tomatoes.
Pour over chicken.
Bake 25 minutes at 350°.
recipes.text: Mexican Chicken. Boil chicken; butter dish. Add onion, cheese, chips and chicken to dish. Heat can of mushroom soup, chicken soup and 1/2 can Ro-Tel tomatoes. Pour over chicken. Bake 25 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Fudge
directions: Melt butter and peanut butter on stove.
Remove from stove. Stir in sugar until smooth (I knead by hand).
Put into 9 x 13-inch greased pan.
Keep in refrigerator or cupboard.
recipes.text: Peanut Butter Fudge. Melt butter and peanut butter on stove. Remove from stove. Stir in sugar until smooth (I knead by hand). Put into 9 x 13-inch greased pan. Keep in refrigerator or cupboard.

recipes.title: Potato Soup
directions: Combine the first 6 ingredients in saucepan.
Bring to a boil; cook gently until potatoes are tender.
Put aside.
Make white sauce of butter, flour and milk; add to stock.
Put in blender. Add egg and heat.
Add salt and pepper to taste.
recipes.text: Potato Soup. Combine the first 6 ingredients in saucepan. Bring to a boil; cook gently until potatoes are tender. Put aside. Make white sauce of butter, flour and milk; add to stock. Put in blender. Add egg and heat. Add salt and pepper to taste.

recipes.title: Apple Cake
ingredients: 3 c. apples, peeled, cored and coarsely chopped
directions: Preheat oven to 350°.
In a large bowl, beat together the oil and sugar.
Beat in the eggs.
In a separate bowl combine flour, salt, cinnamon and soda.
Add to egg mixture; blend.
Add vanilla and beat together well.
Stir in apples, nuts and raisins.
Pour into greased and floured tube pan.
Bake 50 to 60 minutes until done.
Cool in pan for 10 minutes, then turn onto cooling rack to continue cooling.
Frost with chocolate frosting.
recipes.text: Apple Cake. Preheat oven to 350°. In a large bowl, beat together the oil and sugar. Beat in the eggs. In a separate bowl combine flour, salt, cinnamon and soda. Add to egg mixture; blend. Add vanilla and beat together well. Stir in apples, nuts and raisins. Pour into greased and floured tube pan. Bake 50 to 60 minutes until done. Cool in pan for 10 minutes, then turn onto cooling rack to continue cooling. Frost with chocolate frosting.

recipes.title: Seven Cup Salad
directions: Mix all together and chill.
recipes.text: Seven Cup Salad. Mix all together and chill.

recipes.title: Three-Step Cake
directions: Mix and bake cake according to directions, using a 9 x 13 inch baking pan. While hot, poke entire top with fork and spread Eagle Brand milk over top. Cool completely. Frost with Cool Whip and sprinkle with crushed Heath bars.
Refrigerate.
recipes.text: Three-Step Cake. Mix and bake cake according to directions, using a 9 x 13 inch baking pan. While hot, poke entire top with fork and spread Eagle Brand milk over top. Cool completely. Frost with Cool Whip and sprinkle with crushed Heath bars. Refrigerate.

recipes.title: Banana Nut Bread
directions: In
a
bowl,
stir
together
the flours, baking powder, baking soda
and
salt; set aside.
In another bowl, beat sugar and butter.
Add
eggs, one at a time.
Stir in milk and vanilla. Add flour mixture and banana alternately to sugar mixture. Fold in chopped
nuts.
Put
batter
into
a greased loaf pan. Bake at 350° for 45 to 50 minutes or until set and firm.
recipes.text: Banana Nut Bread. In a bowl, stir together the flours, baking powder, baking soda and salt; set aside. In another bowl, beat sugar and butter. Add eggs, one at a time. Stir in milk and vanilla. Add flour mixture and banana alternately to sugar mixture. Fold in chopped nuts. Put batter into a greased loaf pan. Bake at 350° for 45 to 50 minutes or until set and firm.

recipes.title: Skinny Soup
directions: Cook all together until it tastes like soup to you.
Adjust the seasoning to your taste.
Each cup contains 80 calories.
recipes.text: Skinny Soup. Cook all together until it tastes like soup to you. Adjust the seasoning to your taste. Each cup contains 80 calories.

recipes.title: Broccoli Pie
directions: Mix melted margarine and flour together.
Cook broccoli and drain.
Add eggs, cottage cheese, onion, Cheddar cheese and broccoli.
Mix well.
Bake in greased deep dish pie plate for 1 hour at 350°.
recipes.text: Broccoli Pie. Mix melted margarine and flour together. Cook broccoli and drain. Add eggs, cottage cheese, onion, Cheddar cheese and broccoli. Mix well. Bake in greased deep dish pie plate for 1 hour at 350°.

recipes.title: Stir-Fried Chicken And Mushrooms
directions: Remove skin and bone from chicken; slice thinly, holding knife at a diagonal slant.
Mix chicken with next six ingredients; set aside.
Thinly slice mushrooms and onion.
Stir-fry in 1/4 cup oil until tender (2 minutes).
Remove to bowl.
Add three tablespoons more oil; stir-fry chicken mixture until done (2 or 3 minutes). Add mushroom mixture and peas.
Heat through.
Serve with rice. Makes 4 servings.
recipes.text: Stir-Fried Chicken And Mushrooms. Remove skin and bone from chicken; slice thinly, holding knife at a diagonal slant. Mix chicken with next six ingredients; set aside. Thinly slice mushrooms and onion. Stir-fry in 1/4 cup oil until tender (2 minutes). Remove to bowl. Add three tablespoons more oil; stir-fry chicken mixture until done (2 or 3 minutes). Add mushroom mixture and peas. Heat through. Serve with rice. Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: Strawberry Rhubarb Compote
ingredients: 4 c. (20 oz. pkg.) frozen rhubarb, cut into 1-inch pieces
directions: Combine rhubarb, cinnamon, cloves and water in 2-quart microwave-safe casserole.
Cover and microwave at High (100%) for 10 to 14 minutes or until rhubarb is tender, stirring 2 or 3 times.
Mash rhubarb slightly; stir in strawberries, fructose and food coloring.
Reduce power to Medium (50%).
Microwave 1 minute or until strawberries are heated.
Makes 6 servings.
Calories 65 per serving, cholesterol 0 and sodium 18.
recipes.text: Strawberry Rhubarb Compote. Combine rhubarb, cinnamon, cloves and water in 2-quart microwave-safe casserole. Cover and microwave at High (100%) for 10 to 14 minutes or until rhubarb is tender, stirring 2 or 3 times. Mash rhubarb slightly; stir in strawberries, fructose and food coloring. Reduce power to Medium (50%). Microwave 1 minute or until strawberries are heated. Makes 6 servings. Calories 65 per serving, cholesterol 0 and sodium 18.

recipes.title: Pan Chicken And Dressing
ingredients: 1 (10 3/4 oz.) can cream of mushroom soup
directions: Mix package of seasoned bread stuffing with 1 stick of melted butter and 1 cup of water.	Put 1/2 of mixture in greased 13 x 9-inch casserole.
Mix together diced cooked chicken, onions, chopped green onion tops, chopped celery, mayonnaise, and salt. Pour over the dressing in casserole. Top with remaining stuffing mixture. Spread well.
Mix together eggs and milk. Then pour over casserole. Cover with foil and refrigerate overnight.
One hour before baking remove from refrigerator.
Add 1 can cream of mushroom soup mix with 1 can of water.
Spread over top.
Bake uncovered on 325° for 40 minutes.
Sprinkle with grated cheese and bake additional 10 minutes.
Serves 10-12.
recipes.text: Pan Chicken And Dressing. Mix package of seasoned bread stuffing with 1 stick of melted butter and 1 cup of water.	Put 1/2 of mixture in greased 13 x 9-inch casserole. Mix together diced cooked chicken, onions, chopped green onion tops, chopped celery, mayonnaise, and salt. Pour over the dressing in casserole. Top with remaining stuffing mixture. Spread well. Mix together eggs and milk. Then pour over casserole. Cover with foil and refrigerate overnight. One hour before baking remove from refrigerator. Add 1 can cream of mushroom soup mix with 1 can of water. Spread over top. Bake uncovered on 325° for 40 minutes. Sprinkle with grated cheese and bake additional 10 minutes. Serves 10-12.

recipes.title: Ice Cream Cake
ingredients: 2 (3 oz. size) pkg. instant coconut cream pudding
directions: Pour melted margarine over Ritz cracker crumbs and press into a 9 x 13-inch cake pan to make crust.
Beat ice cream, milk and pudding about 10 minutes.
Pour onto crust.
Refrigerate for 3 or 4 hours.
Spread Cool Whip on top and sprinkle the 1/4 cup reserved crumbs on top.
Keep refrigerated.
recipes.text: Ice Cream Cake. Pour melted margarine over Ritz cracker crumbs and press into a 9 x 13-inch cake pan to make crust. Beat ice cream, milk and pudding about 10 minutes. Pour onto crust. Refrigerate for 3 or 4 hours. Spread Cool Whip on top and sprinkle the 1/4 cup reserved crumbs on top. Keep refrigerated.

recipes.title: Diet Slaw(Low-Fat, Low Sugar, Low Salt)
directions: Beat egg; add vinegar, Sweet 'N Low and salt.
Cook until thick (about 1 to 2 minutes). Cool.
Add milk.
Pour over chopped cabbage.
recipes.text: Diet Slaw(Low-Fat, Low Sugar, Low Salt). Beat egg; add vinegar, Sweet 'N Low and salt. Cook until thick (about 1 to 2 minutes). Cool. Add milk. Pour over chopped cabbage.

recipes.title: Chocolate Pie
directions: In medium pan, add cornstarch, sugar, salt, and cocoa.
Mix well. Add milk and stir well.
Add egg yolks.
Mix completely.
Cook over med heat, stirring constantly until mixture starts to thicken and boil.
Cook 1 minute more, stirring quickly.
Remove from heat. Stir in butter and vanilla.
Cool slightly, pour into baked pie shell.
Set aside.
Beat egg whites until soft peaks form.
Add 4 Tbsp sugar and beat until very stiff.
Spoon onto pie, making sure to touch edges with meringue.
Cool and serve cold.
recipes.text: Chocolate Pie. In medium pan, add cornstarch, sugar, salt, and cocoa. Mix well. Add milk and stir well. Add egg yolks. Mix completely. Cook over med heat, stirring constantly until mixture starts to thicken and boil. Cook 1 minute more, stirring quickly. Remove from heat. Stir in butter and vanilla. Cool slightly, pour into baked pie shell. Set aside. Beat egg whites until soft peaks form. Add 4 Tbsp sugar and beat until very stiff. Spoon onto pie, making sure to touch edges with meringue. Cool and serve cold.

recipes.title: Chiffon Pound Cake
directions: Heat oven to 350°.
In bowl beat egg whites until frothy. Gradually add 1/2 cup sugar, beating until egg whites are very stiff.
Into another bowl, cream sugar, oil, egg yolks and 1/2 of milk and flavorings.
Mix well.
Add dry ingredients alternately with rest of milk.
Beat mixture until smooth.
Fold in egg whites with wooden spoon.
Bake in a greased and floured tube pan.
Bake 1 hour in a 350° oven.
recipes.text: Chiffon Pound Cake. Heat oven to 350°. In bowl beat egg whites until frothy. Gradually add 1/2 cup sugar, beating until egg whites are very stiff. Into another bowl, cream sugar, oil, egg yolks and 1/2 of milk and flavorings. Mix well. Add dry ingredients alternately with rest of milk. Beat mixture until smooth. Fold in egg whites with wooden spoon. Bake in a greased and floured tube pan. Bake 1 hour in a 350° oven.

recipes.title: Sloppy Joes
directions: Brown meat.
Drain and add remaining ingredients except buns. Cover; simmer for 30 minutes.
Spoon onto hamburger buns.
Makes 6 to 8 servings.
recipes.text: Sloppy Joes. Brown meat. Drain and add remaining ingredients except buns. Cover; simmer for 30 minutes. Spoon onto hamburger buns. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

recipes.title: Beer Rolls
directions: Mix together and pour into greased muffin tins.
Fill about half full. Let rise about 20 minutes. Bake at 400° for about 10 minutes.
recipes.text: Beer Rolls. Mix together and pour into greased muffin tins. Fill about half full. Let rise about 20 minutes. Bake at 400° for about 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Oreo Cookie Freakout
directions: Line 9 x 13-inch pan with crushed cookies.
Spread the softened ice cream over cookies.
Heat sauce and pour on, then nuts, Cool Whip and more crumbs.
Freeze.
Cut in small squares. Very rich.
recipes.text: Oreo Cookie Freakout. Line 9 x 13-inch pan with crushed cookies. Spread the softened ice cream over cookies. Heat sauce and pour on, then nuts, Cool Whip and more crumbs. Freeze. Cut in small squares. Very rich.

recipes.title: Pat'S Chocolate Pecan Toffee Bar
directions: Preheat oven to 350°.
In medium-sized bowl, cream the oil and sugar and beat well.
Stir in flour and vanilla.
Litely spray an 11 x 14-inch baking sheet with vegetable oil.
Press the dough onto the sheet.
Bake for 25 minutes, until golden brown.
Let cool.
Melt chocolate chips in a double boiler.
Spread the melted chocolate evenly over the cooled toffee bars and sprinkle with pecans.
Makes 48 (1-inch) squares.
recipes.text: Pat'S Chocolate Pecan Toffee Bar. Preheat oven to 350°. In medium-sized bowl, cream the oil and sugar and beat well. Stir in flour and vanilla. Litely spray an 11 x 14-inch baking sheet with vegetable oil. Press the dough onto the sheet. Bake for 25 minutes, until golden brown. Let cool. Melt chocolate chips in a double boiler. Spread the melted chocolate evenly over the cooled toffee bars and sprinkle with pecans. Makes 48 (1-inch) squares.

recipes.title: Marinated Shrimp
ingredients: 3/4 c. chive blossom, white wine or rice vinegar
1/4 c. sweet green pepper, cored, seeded and minced
directions: In a large, nonreactive bowl, combine all ingredients, except shrimp.
Whisk together.
Fill a large kettle 3/4 full of water; bring to a boil over high heat.
Add shrimp; cook until opaque in the center, or for about 3 to 4 minutes.
Drain; add to the marinade, stirring to coat.
Cover; refrigerate for at least 3 to 4 hours before serving.
Yields 8 servings.
recipes.text: Marinated Shrimp. In a large, nonreactive bowl, combine all ingredients, except shrimp. Whisk together. Fill a large kettle 3/4 full of water; bring to a boil over high heat. Add shrimp; cook until opaque in the center, or for about 3 to 4 minutes. Drain; add to the marinade, stirring to coat. Cover; refrigerate for at least 3 to 4 hours before serving. Yields 8 servings.

recipes.title: Pineapple Cream Cheese Pie
directions: Blend together the cream cheese, 1/4 cup sugar and the vanilla.
Fold in Cool Whip; pour into pie crust.
In a saucepan, cook the pineapple, 1/2 cup sugar and cornstarch until shiny or glazy.
Let cool, then pour over pie.
Refrigerate to set.
recipes.text: Pineapple Cream Cheese Pie. Blend together the cream cheese, 1/4 cup sugar and the vanilla. Fold in Cool Whip; pour into pie crust. In a saucepan, cook the pineapple, 1/2 cup sugar and cornstarch until shiny or glazy. Let cool, then pour over pie. Refrigerate to set.

recipes.title: German Chocolate Cake
directions: Bake cake according to directions on box.
recipes.text: German Chocolate Cake. Bake cake according to directions on box.

recipes.title: Ad Lib Soup
directions: Put all ingredients into blender container.
Cover and puree until smooth.
Pour into saucepan; heat over medium heat until hot.
Makes one serving, but increase portions as needed.
recipes.text: Ad Lib Soup. Put all ingredients into blender container. Cover and puree until smooth. Pour into saucepan; heat over medium heat until hot. Makes one serving, but increase portions as needed.

recipes.title: Swiss Chicken
directions: Melt chocolate in microwave just until it's soft enough to spread with a knife.
Place 1 fudge strip cookie flat on table; spread melted chocolate around the center of it.
Place pinwheel cookie on it's edge in center of 1st cookie.

Take the 2nd fudge strip cookie; spread chocolate on half of it and stick it to the back of the pinwheel cookie so that it looks like tail feathers. Take candy corn and put chocolate on the edge of it and stick it in the top center of the pinwheel cookie to make it look like a beak.
recipes.text: Swiss Chicken. Melt chocolate in microwave just until it's soft enough to spread with a knife. Place 1 fudge strip cookie flat on table; spread melted chocolate around the center of it. Place pinwheel cookie on it's edge in center of 1st cookie. Take the 2nd fudge strip cookie; spread chocolate on half of it and stick it to the back of the pinwheel cookie so that it looks like tail feathers. Take candy corn and put chocolate on the edge of it and stick it in the top center of the pinwheel cookie to make it look like a beak.

recipes.title: Crispy Bun Sticks
directions: Cut each bun half lengthwise (to make a total of 12 pieces). Place pieces on baking sheet.
Brush each bun stick lightly with salad dressing on all sides, using about 1 teaspoon for each piece. Bake at 375° until lightly browned, 10 to 12 minutes.
Makes 12 bun sticks.
recipes.text: Crispy Bun Sticks. Cut each bun half lengthwise (to make a total of 12 pieces). Place pieces on baking sheet. Brush each bun stick lightly with salad dressing on all sides, using about 1 teaspoon for each piece. Bake at 375° until lightly browned, 10 to 12 minutes. Makes 12 bun sticks.

recipes.title: Chocolate Syrup Brownies
directions: In a bowl, cream together butter, sugar and eggs until very creamy and well blended.
Add salt.
Stir in flour, mixing to blend well.
Add chocolate syrup, vanilla and chopped nuts.
Turn mixture into well-greased and lightly floured 9-inch square pan. Smooth top.
Bake at 350° for about 35 minutes or until a stick inserted near center comes out clean.
Cool in pan on wire rack but loosen cake at edges.
Cut into squares.
Makes 16 to 18 brownies.
recipes.text: Chocolate Syrup Brownies. In a bowl, cream together butter, sugar and eggs until very creamy and well blended. Add salt. Stir in flour, mixing to blend well. Add chocolate syrup, vanilla and chopped nuts. Turn mixture into well-greased and lightly floured 9-inch square pan. Smooth top. Bake at 350° for about 35 minutes or until a stick inserted near center comes out clean. Cool in pan on wire rack but loosen cake at edges. Cut into squares. Makes 16 to 18 brownies.

recipes.title: Squash Casserole
directions: Mix first 4 ingredients together and put in casserole dish. Sprinkle stuffing mix on top and bake for 30 minutes at 350°.
recipes.text: Squash Casserole. Mix first 4 ingredients together and put in casserole dish. Sprinkle stuffing mix on top and bake for 30 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Cheese Ball
directions: Let the cheeses set out at room temperature to soften.
Mix the 3 cheeses with Worcestershire sauce, salt and onion flakes thoroughly.
Combine minced pecans and parsley together.
Add half of this mixture to the cheese mixture; chill.
Shape into a ball after chilling, then roll in remaining parsley and pecan mixture.
recipes.text: Cheese Ball. Let the cheeses set out at room temperature to soften. Mix the 3 cheeses with Worcestershire sauce, salt and onion flakes thoroughly. Combine minced pecans and parsley together. Add half of this mixture to the cheese mixture; chill. Shape into a ball after chilling, then roll in remaining parsley and pecan mixture.

recipes.title: Mostaccioli Salad
directions: *Add a little oil to noodles while cooking so they won't stick.
recipes.text: Mostaccioli Salad. *Add a little oil to noodles while cooking so they won't stick.

recipes.title: Old Fashioned Bread Pudding
directions: Slice biscuits and lightly butter each side.
Arrange in layers in a shallow baking dish (6 x 9-inch).
Sprinkle each layer with cinnamon, cloves and raisins.
recipes.text: Old Fashioned Bread Pudding. Slice biscuits and lightly butter each side. Arrange in layers in a shallow baking dish (6 x 9-inch). Sprinkle each layer with cinnamon, cloves and raisins.

recipes.title: Sugar-Free Pie Filling
directions: Beat until stiff Dream Whip and cold milk.
Add sugar-free pudding and cold milk.
Beat until fluffy.
Pour into pie crust.
recipes.text: Sugar-Free Pie Filling. Beat until stiff Dream Whip and cold milk. Add sugar-free pudding and cold milk. Beat until fluffy. Pour into pie crust.

recipes.title: Michael'S Scrambled Eggs
directions: Beat eggs with a fork in a bowl and add dollop of milk.
Mix well.
Heat skillet and add pat of butter.
After butter is melted, pour eggs into skillet, stirring while cooking.
When eggs are done, slide onto plate and top with picante sauce.
recipes.text: Michael'S Scrambled Eggs. Beat eggs with a fork in a bowl and add dollop of milk. Mix well. Heat skillet and add pat of butter. After butter is melted, pour eggs into skillet, stirring while cooking. When eggs are done, slide onto plate and top with picante sauce.

recipes.title: All-Bran Bread
directions: Dissolve yeast in warm water.
Mix All-Bran cereal, sugar, shortening and salt.
Pour boiling water over bran mixture.
Let cool, then add yeast.
Add egg and half of flour.
Beat well.
Add remaining flour.
Cover and let rise until double in bulk.
Punch down.
Form into 2 small loaves, place in buttered pans and let rise again until double.
Just before baking, brush tops of loaves with melted butter.
Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.
Yield:
12 servings.
Carbohydrate 32 g, protein 5 g, fat 9.3 g, calories 229.
recipes.text: All-Bran Bread. Dissolve yeast in warm water. Mix All-Bran cereal, sugar, shortening and salt. Pour boiling water over bran mixture. Let cool, then add yeast. Add egg and half of flour. Beat well. Add remaining flour. Cover and let rise until double in bulk. Punch down. Form into 2 small loaves, place in buttered pans and let rise again until double. Just before baking, brush tops of loaves with melted butter. Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes. Yield: 12 servings. Carbohydrate 32 g, protein 5 g, fat 9.3 g, calories 229.

recipes.title: 8 Layer Salad
ingredients: 1 pkg. frozen peas, cooked, drained and cooled (10 oz. size)
1/2 lb. bacon, cooked crisp, drained and broken up fine
directions: Layer each ingredient in order listed.
Do not stir.
Let stand overnight.
Cover with foil.
Put ingredients in a large bowl or pan.
recipes.text: 8 Layer Salad. Layer each ingredient in order listed. Do not stir. Let stand overnight. Cover with foil. Put ingredients in a large bowl or pan.

recipes.title: *Chicken Oregano
ingredients: 1 (3 lb.) chicken, cut up or assorted parts
directions: Preheat oven to 400°.
Combine oregano, salt and pepper in small dish. Rub this mixture into chicken pieces. Arrange in a 9 x 13 x 2-inch baking dish.
Blend together the olive oil and lemon juice. Pour over chicken pieces and bake for 40 minutes until tender.
recipes.text: *Chicken Oregano. Preheat oven to 400°. Combine oregano, salt and pepper in small dish. Rub this mixture into chicken pieces. Arrange in a 9 x 13 x 2-inch baking dish. Blend together the olive oil and lemon juice. Pour over chicken pieces and bake for 40 minutes until tender.

recipes.title: Savory Scallops
directions: Pat dry scallops with paper towel.
Place in greased pie plate. Sprinkle with lemon juice, salt and pepper.
Top with mushrooms; drizzle with 1/4 cup butter.
Mix remaining 1/4 cup butter with bread crumbs.
Sprinkle over mushrooms.
Broil in preheated broiler 6 inches from heat until scallops are opaque, 10 to 12 minutes. Garnish with parsley.
recipes.text: Savory Scallops. Pat dry scallops with paper towel. Place in greased pie plate. Sprinkle with lemon juice, salt and pepper. Top with mushrooms; drizzle with 1/4 cup butter. Mix remaining 1/4 cup butter with bread crumbs. Sprinkle over mushrooms. Broil in preheated broiler 6 inches from heat until scallops are opaque, 10 to 12 minutes. Garnish with parsley.

recipes.title: Spanish Rice
ingredients: 2 c. diced canned chopped meat (Spam or ham)
directions: Cook rice in lard until lightly browned.
Add onions, green peppers, celery, tomatoes and sugar.
Heat to a boil.
Cover; reduce heat to simmer for 25 minutes, or until rice is tender. Stir in meat; cook slowly for 10 minutes.
recipes.text: Spanish Rice. Cook rice in lard until lightly browned. Add onions, green peppers, celery, tomatoes and sugar. Heat to a boil. Cover; reduce heat to simmer for 25 minutes, or until rice is tender. Stir in meat; cook slowly for 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Soda Cracker Cake
directions: Add cream of tartar to egg whites and beat until stiff.
Add vanilla and sugar.
Fold in crackers and nuts.
Place in a greased cake pan and bake at 350° for 20 to 30 minutes.
Cool.
Top with whipped topping (Dream Whip) and add fruit topping (use your imagination).
Refrigerate.
recipes.text: Soda Cracker Cake. Add cream of tartar to egg whites and beat until stiff. Add vanilla and sugar. Fold in crackers and nuts. Place in a greased cake pan and bake at 350° for 20 to 30 minutes. Cool. Top with whipped topping (Dream Whip) and add fruit topping (use your imagination). Refrigerate.

recipes.title: Pecan Pralines
directions: Combine sugar, water and butter.
When mixture begins to boil rapidly, add pecans.
Boil, stirring constantly, until mixture forms large bubbles on top and looks sugary.
Remove from fire. Drop by teaspoonfuls onto well buttered marble slab or platter.
recipes.text: Pecan Pralines. Combine sugar, water and butter. When mixture begins to boil rapidly, add pecans. Boil, stirring constantly, until mixture forms large bubbles on top and looks sugary. Remove from fire. Drop by teaspoonfuls onto well buttered marble slab or platter.

recipes.title: Glycerin Soap Bubbles
directions: Put mixture in small jar.
Add straws to blow.
recipes.text: Glycerin Soap Bubbles. Put mixture in small jar. Add straws to blow.

recipes.title: Hors D'Oeuvres Called Dog Food
ingredients: 1 lb. Jimmy Dean's sage pork sausage
directions: In frying pan, brown ground chuck and pork sausage and drain off all grease.
Put meat back into frying pan over medium heat and add cheese.
Stir until all is mixed and cheese is melted. Using a tablespoon, put a spoonful on top of each rye.
Put each on a cookie sheet.
Bake at 350° until top and bottom of rye are slightly toasted.
Serve hot.
recipes.text: Hors D'Oeuvres Called Dog Food. In frying pan, brown ground chuck and pork sausage and drain off all grease. Put meat back into frying pan over medium heat and add cheese. Stir until all is mixed and cheese is melted. Using a tablespoon, put a spoonful on top of each rye. Put each on a cookie sheet. Bake at 350° until top and bottom of rye are slightly toasted. Serve hot.

recipes.title: Reuben Casserole
ingredients: 1 lb. Polska kielbasa, cut and split lengthwise
directions: In 1 1/2-quart casserole, layer sauerkraut, tomatoes, Thousand Island dressing, Polska kielbasa, Swiss cheese and rye crackers. Bake at 425° for 15 minutes.
recipes.text: Reuben Casserole. In 1 1/2-quart casserole, layer sauerkraut, tomatoes, Thousand Island dressing, Polska kielbasa, Swiss cheese and rye crackers. Bake at 425° for 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Italian Baked Chicken
ingredients: 1 (0.7 oz.) pkg. Italian or zesty Italian dressing mix
1 1/2 lb. (6 pieces) boneless, skinless chicken breasts
directions: Heat oven to 375°.
Lightly grease 13 x 9-inch pan.
In shallow dish, combine bread crumbs and salad dressing mix.
Dip chicken in melted butter, then in bread crumb mixture to coat. Place in greased pan.
Bake at 375° for 30 to 40 minutes or until chicken is fork-tender and juices run clear, turning once during baking.
recipes.text: Italian Baked Chicken. Heat oven to 375°. Lightly grease 13 x 9-inch pan. In shallow dish, combine bread crumbs and salad dressing mix. Dip chicken in melted butter, then in bread crumb mixture to coat. Place in greased pan. Bake at 375° for 30 to 40 minutes or until chicken is fork-tender and juices run clear, turning once during baking.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Chewy
directions: Bring sugar and syrup to a boil (just to melt sugar and syrup). Add peanut butter and vanilla. Mix and add corn flakes.
recipes.text: Peanut Butter Chewy. Bring sugar and syrup to a boil (just to melt sugar and syrup). Add peanut butter and vanilla. Mix and add corn flakes.

recipes.title: Bagels
directions: Combine yeast and 1/2 cup warm water in measuring cup, stirring with a fork until dissolved.
Combine 2 cups flour, salt and sugar in a bowl.
Add dissolved yeast and remaining cup of warm water.
Beat vigorously with a fork for two minutes. Gradually add enough of remaining flour, 1/4 cup at a time, to make a soft dough.
Turn out of bowl; knead until smooth and elastic (about 8 to 10 minutes), adding a little flour.
Place dough back in clean, greased bowl; put in a warm place until doubled in size.
recipes.text: Bagels. Combine yeast and 1/2 cup warm water in measuring cup, stirring with a fork until dissolved. Combine 2 cups flour, salt and sugar in a bowl. Add dissolved yeast and remaining cup of warm water. Beat vigorously with a fork for two minutes. Gradually add enough of remaining flour, 1/4 cup at a time, to make a soft dough. Turn out of bowl; knead until smooth and elastic (about 8 to 10 minutes), adding a little flour. Place dough back in clean, greased bowl; put in a warm place until doubled in size.

recipes.title: Hamburger Pie
directions: Brown meat and onion.
Add salt and pepper, drained beans and soup.
Pour into greased dish.
Mash potatoes while hot, add milk and egg.
Season with salt and pepper.
Spoon over hamburger. Sprinkle with cheese.
Bake covered at 350° for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Hamburger Pie. Brown meat and onion. Add salt and pepper, drained beans and soup. Pour into greased dish. Mash potatoes while hot, add milk and egg. Season with salt and pepper. Spoon over hamburger. Sprinkle with cheese. Bake covered at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Granola Cookie Bars
directions: In a large mixing bowl, cream butter and sugars. Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each addition. Beat in vanilla and water.
recipes.text: Granola Cookie Bars. In a large mixing bowl, cream butter and sugars. Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each addition. Beat in vanilla and water.

recipes.title: Grandma'S Pumpkin Pie
ingredients: 1 can Pet milk or 1 pt. cream
directions: Mix dry ingredients into pumpkin in a large mixing bowl.
Stir in Pet milk.
Stir in milk; mix well.
Fill pie crust full.
Bake at 400° for approximately 45 minutes.
(Put top pies on bottom rack of oven and bottom pies on top rack of oven.)
Bake an additional 15 minutes.
Let cool.
Makes 4 pies.
recipes.text: Grandma'S Pumpkin Pie. Mix dry ingredients into pumpkin in a large mixing bowl. Stir in Pet milk. Stir in milk; mix well. Fill pie crust full. Bake at 400° for approximately 45 minutes. (Put top pies on bottom rack of oven and bottom pies on top rack of oven.) Bake an additional 15 minutes. Let cool. Makes 4 pies.

recipes.title: Pickled Beets
directions: Make enough liquid from sugar, cider vinegar and water until all jars of beets have been filled to very top and sealed.
Wash beets.
Trim off tops and roots.
Place in large pot and cover with water.
Cover pot and bring water to boil.
Continue to cook beets until just fork-tender to center.
Pour off hot water and add cold to cover.
Change cold water until beets have cooled.
If beets overcook, pickles will be mushy!
Skin and slice cooked beets.
Loosely fill sterile jars.
Put 2 cloves in each jar. Boil together sugar, vinegar and water 5 minutes.
Fill each jar with liquid; seal and process on rack covered with boiling water for 5 minutes.
recipes.text: Pickled Beets. Make enough liquid from sugar, cider vinegar and water until all jars of beets have been filled to very top and sealed. Wash beets. Trim off tops and roots. Place in large pot and cover with water. Cover pot and bring water to boil. Continue to cook beets until just fork-tender to center. Pour off hot water and add cold to cover. Change cold water until beets have cooled. If beets overcook, pickles will be mushy! Skin and slice cooked beets. Loosely fill sterile jars. Put 2 cloves in each jar. Boil together sugar, vinegar and water 5 minutes. Fill each jar with liquid; seal and process on rack covered with boiling water for 5 minutes.

recipes.title: Mock Cream Of Mushroom Soup(Lo-Fat)
directions: Drain mushrooms into measure and add water to make 1/2 cup juice.
In a small saucepan, heat oil over medium heat.
Add flour and bay leaf, stirring constantly, for 1 minute.
Gradually add mushroom liquid, milk, oleo and pepper, stirring constantly, until it thickens (2 to 3 minutes).
Remove from heat and discard bay leaf.
Pour into a blender and blend until smooth.
Add the mushrooms and garlic powder, blending until pureed.
Can be used in recipes calling for mushroom soup.
Makes 1 1/2 cups.
recipes.text: Mock Cream Of Mushroom Soup(Lo-Fat). Drain mushrooms into measure and add water to make 1/2 cup juice. In a small saucepan, heat oil over medium heat. Add flour and bay leaf, stirring constantly, for 1 minute. Gradually add mushroom liquid, milk, oleo and pepper, stirring constantly, until it thickens (2 to 3 minutes). Remove from heat and discard bay leaf. Pour into a blender and blend until smooth. Add the mushrooms and garlic powder, blending until pureed. Can be used in recipes calling for mushroom soup. Makes 1 1/2 cups.

recipes.title: No Bake Cookies
directions: Boil the first 4 ingredients on top of stove for 1 minute. Remove from stove. Add the peanut butter.
Mix until melted. Add the vanilla, oatmeal or Rice Krispies, coconut and walnuts.
Drop on wax paper.
recipes.text: No Bake Cookies. Boil the first 4 ingredients on top of stove for 1 minute. Remove from stove. Add the peanut butter. Mix until melted. Add the vanilla, oatmeal or Rice Krispies, coconut and walnuts. Drop on wax paper.

recipes.title: Turkey Barley Soup
directions: Combine all ingredients except peas.
Bring to a boil.
Reduce heat; cover and simmer for 30 minutes.
Add peas and simmer 5 more minutes.
Contains 150 calories per cup.
recipes.text: Turkey Barley Soup. Combine all ingredients except peas. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat; cover and simmer for 30 minutes. Add peas and simmer 5 more minutes. Contains 150 calories per cup.

recipes.title: Christmas Chili Roll
ingredients: Chili powder, Salt, pepper, garlic powder to taste
directions: Thoroughly mix cheese with ground cheese.
Add all other ingredients and mix well.
Shape into 4 rolls.
Put chili powder on wax paper.
Wrap rolls in aluminum foil and refrigerate until used. Slice before serving or cheese can be made into balls and at room temperature can be used as spread.
Sharp cheddar cheese can be substituted instead of longhorn.
recipes.text: Christmas Chili Roll. Thoroughly mix cheese with ground cheese. Add all other ingredients and mix well. Shape into 4 rolls. Put chili powder on wax paper. Wrap rolls in aluminum foil and refrigerate until used. Slice before serving or cheese can be made into balls and at room temperature can be used as spread. Sharp cheddar cheese can be substituted instead of longhorn.

recipes.title: Chocolate Chip Brownie Torte
directions: Preheat oven to 350°.
Line jelly roll pan (15 1/2 x 10 1/2 x 1-inch) with waxed paper, grease.
Heat butter and 1 cup semi-sweet chocolate in 3-quart saucepan over medium heat until melted.
Stir remaining ingredients (except frosting) into melted chocolate. Spread evenly into pan.
Bake 20 to 25 minutes.
Cool 10 minutes. Invert on board.
Remove wax paper.
Cool completely.
recipes.text: Chocolate Chip Brownie Torte. Preheat oven to 350°. Line jelly roll pan (15 1/2 x 10 1/2 x 1-inch) with waxed paper, grease. Heat butter and 1 cup semi-sweet chocolate in 3-quart saucepan over medium heat until melted. Stir remaining ingredients (except frosting) into melted chocolate. Spread evenly into pan. Bake 20 to 25 minutes. Cool 10 minutes. Invert on board. Remove wax paper. Cool completely.

recipes.title: The 8-Minute Light 'N Fruity Pie
ingredients: 1 c. fresh fruit (sliced strawberries, peaches, bananas, raspberries or blueberries).
OR you can use 1 (8 oz.) can of drained apricots, sliced peaches, fruit cocktail, or pineapple.
directions: Dissolve jello completely in boiling water; stirring about 3 minutes.
Add ice cubes and stir until jello is thickened, about 2-3 minutes.
Remove any unmelted ice.
Using a wire whisk, blend in Cool Whip; then whip until smooth.
Fold in fruit.
Chill, if necessary, until mixture will mound up.
Spoon into prepared pie crust.
Chill 2 hours.
Garnish, if desired.
recipes.text: The 8-Minute Light 'N Fruity Pie. Dissolve jello completely in boiling water; stirring about 3 minutes. Add ice cubes and stir until jello is thickened, about 2-3 minutes. Remove any unmelted ice. Using a wire whisk, blend in Cool Whip; then whip until smooth. Fold in fruit. Chill, if necessary, until mixture will mound up. Spoon into prepared pie crust. Chill 2 hours. Garnish, if desired.

recipes.title: Cherry Bars
directions: Mix butter, 1 cup flour and 3 tablespoons brown sugar with pastry cutter and spread in 13 x 9-inch pan.
Bake 12 minutes at 350°.
Beat eggs.
Add remaining ingredients.
Spread on crust. Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.
recipes.text: Cherry Bars. Mix butter, 1 cup flour and 3 tablespoons brown sugar with pastry cutter and spread in 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake 12 minutes at 350°. Beat eggs. Add remaining ingredients. Spread on crust. Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Chow Chow
directions: Grind the green tomatoes, bell peppers, onions and chili peppers in a food chopper.
Then squeeze out all the juice you can.
Put vinegar, 5 pound bag of sugar and half of another 5 pound bag of sugar and some pickling spice (wrapped up).
Let come to a boil.
Pour in chopped ingredients and cook about 1 hour. Cook until liquid is about evaporated.
Put into jars and seal.
recipes.text: Chow Chow. Grind the green tomatoes, bell peppers, onions and chili peppers in a food chopper. Then squeeze out all the juice you can. Put vinegar, 5 pound bag of sugar and half of another 5 pound bag of sugar and some pickling spice (wrapped up). Let come to a boil. Pour in chopped ingredients and cook about 1 hour. Cook until liquid is about evaporated. Put into jars and seal.

recipes.title: Pound Cake
directions: Cream together butter, juice and extracts.
Gradually add sugar.
Add in 3rds, beating well 4 well beaten eggs.
Blend in dry ingredients in 4ths.
Bake at 325° for 1 hour 10 minutes in 9 x 5-inch loaf pan (greased and floured).
Have ingredients at room temperature.
recipes.text: Pound Cake. Cream together butter, juice and extracts. Gradually add sugar. Add in 3rds, beating well 4 well beaten eggs. Blend in dry ingredients in 4ths. Bake at 325° for 1 hour 10 minutes in 9 x 5-inch loaf pan (greased and floured). Have ingredients at room temperature.

recipes.title: Mike'S Macaroni And Cheese Ala Italiano
ingredients: 3 c. Cracker Barrel Sharp Cheese, grated
directions: Cook macaroni according to package, use salt in cooking water (a lot).
Cook until medium soft (do not overcook).
Drain. Place in oblong baking dish.
Put butter in milk and microwave until butter is melted and milk is warm.
Pour over macaroni. Dust flour and seasonings over top of mixture.
Add cheeses and mix in thoroughly.
Dot top with butter.
Bake at 350° for 35 - 40 minutes or until top is brown and crusty.
Leftovers are great.
recipes.text: Mike'S Macaroni And Cheese Ala Italiano. Cook macaroni according to package, use salt in cooking water (a lot). Cook until medium soft (do not overcook). Drain. Place in oblong baking dish. Put butter in milk and microwave until butter is melted and milk is warm. Pour over macaroni. Dust flour and seasonings over top of mixture. Add cheeses and mix in thoroughly. Dot top with butter. Bake at 350° for 35 - 40 minutes or until top is brown and crusty. Leftovers are great.

recipes.title: Poppy Seed Dressing
ingredients: 2/3 c. sugar (can use part sugar and Equal)
1 Tbsp. poppy seed or celery seed
directions: Blend in blender until thick and smooth.
Makes 1 pint.
recipes.text: Poppy Seed Dressing. Blend in blender until thick and smooth. Makes 1 pint.

recipes.title: Flank Steak Marinade
directions: Marinate steak 12 hours.
Barbecue or broil steak 7 1/2 minutes on each side.
Slice on the diagonal.
recipes.text: Flank Steak Marinade. Marinate steak 12 hours. Barbecue or broil steak 7 1/2 minutes on each side. Slice on the diagonal.

recipes.title: Creamy Timbale Tacos
ingredients: 1 can Black Label Ranch Style beans
directions: Brown meat; drain.
Add beans, chili and tomatoes.
Heat all together, then add the cheese (grated or cubed) and whipping cream.
