Heat and serve over Doritos with your favorite taco topping or just serve as a dip.
recipes.text: Creamy Timbale Tacos. Brown meat; drain. Add beans, chili and tomatoes. Heat all together, then add the cheese (grated or cubed) and whipping cream. Heat and serve over Doritos with your favorite taco topping or just serve as a dip.

recipes.title: Quickie Rolls
directions: Mix well.
Grease muffin pan; fill half full.
Bake at 375° for about 15 minutes.
recipes.text: Quickie Rolls. Mix well. Grease muffin pan; fill half full. Bake at 375° for about 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Easy Buttermilk Salad
ingredients: 1 large pkg. strawberry or peach, lemon, berry jello
directions: Bring pineapple to boil and stir in jello until dissolved.
Add Cool Whip, buttermilk and pecans.
Mix together and chill.
recipes.text: Easy Buttermilk Salad. Bring pineapple to boil and stir in jello until dissolved. Add Cool Whip, buttermilk and pecans. Mix together and chill.

recipes.title: Chocolate Pie
directions: Mix sugar, flour and cocoa together in saucepan. Add milk, eggs, vanilla and margarine. Cook until thick; have to keep it stirred as you cook. Pour in baked pie shell. Top with meringue or Cool Whip.
recipes.text: Chocolate Pie. Mix sugar, flour and cocoa together in saucepan. Add milk, eggs, vanilla and margarine. Cook until thick; have to keep it stirred as you cook. Pour in baked pie shell. Top with meringue or Cool Whip.

recipes.title: Chocolate Marshmallow Cookie Pie
ingredients: 2 pkg. instant Jell-O chocolate pudding and pie filling
directions: Microwave marshmallows and 2 tablespoons milk in medium bowl on High for 45 seconds.
Stir (marshmallows will be partially melted).
Refrigerate 15 minutes to cool.
Stir in 1 cup of the Cool Whip.
Pour 2 cups milk into large bowl.
Add pudding mixes. Beat with wire whisk for 2 minutes (let stand 1 minute or until thickened).
Stir in remaining 1 1/2 cups Cool Whip. Spoon into crust and arrange cookies over pudding mixture. Spread marshmallow mixture over cookies.
Refrigerate 4 hours or until set.
recipes.text: Chocolate Marshmallow Cookie Pie. Microwave marshmallows and 2 tablespoons milk in medium bowl on High for 45 seconds. Stir (marshmallows will be partially melted). Refrigerate 15 minutes to cool. Stir in 1 cup of the Cool Whip. Pour 2 cups milk into large bowl. Add pudding mixes. Beat with wire whisk for 2 minutes (let stand 1 minute or until thickened). Stir in remaining 1 1/2 cups Cool Whip. Spoon into crust and arrange cookies over pudding mixture. Spread marshmallow mixture over cookies. Refrigerate 4 hours or until set.

recipes.title: Crab Meat Spread
ingredients: 6 oz. chili sauce mixed with horseradish
directions: Combine all ingredients except chili sauce and horseradish and shape into a ball or ring.
Mix chili sauce and horseradish, lemon juice and Worcestershire to taste.
Pour over crab mixture.
recipes.text: Crab Meat Spread. Combine all ingredients except chili sauce and horseradish and shape into a ball or ring. Mix chili sauce and horseradish, lemon juice and Worcestershire to taste. Pour over crab mixture.

recipes.title: Holiday Cheese Ball
directions: Beat together cream cheese, sugar and vanilla until smooth. Stir in 1/4 cup cereal, chocolate chips and raisins. Cover and chill several hours or overnight. Shape into ball. Roll into remaining cereal to coat. Serve with apple or pear wedges, unsalted crackers or graham crackers. Can make up to 3 days ahead.
recipes.text: Holiday Cheese Ball. Beat together cream cheese, sugar and vanilla until smooth. Stir in 1/4 cup cereal, chocolate chips and raisins. Cover and chill several hours or overnight. Shape into ball. Roll into remaining cereal to coat. Serve with apple or pear wedges, unsalted crackers or graham crackers. Can make up to 3 days ahead.

recipes.title: 3 Bean Salad
ingredients: 1 (No. 10) can each: kidney, green and yellow beans
directions: Boil the sugar, oil, vinegar and salt; cool and pour over mixed beans.
Makes 10 quarts.
recipes.text: 3 Bean Salad. Boil the sugar, oil, vinegar and salt; cool and pour over mixed beans. Makes 10 quarts.

recipes.title: Chicken Upside-Down
directions: Melt butter over low heat. Add flour, salt and pepper. Let come to a boil over low heat. Remove from heat. Add chicken broth and milk. Return to heat; bring to a boil, stirring all the time. Boil 1 minute. Cut heat to low and fold in chicken, peas and lemon juice. Top with Cornbread Topping and bake at 400° for 25 minutes.
recipes.text: Chicken Upside-Down. Melt butter over low heat. Add flour, salt and pepper. Let come to a boil over low heat. Remove from heat. Add chicken broth and milk. Return to heat; bring to a boil, stirring all the time. Boil 1 minute. Cut heat to low and fold in chicken, peas and lemon juice. Top with Cornbread Topping and bake at 400° for 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Poppy Seed Bread
directions: Mix together.
Bake in greased pans approximately 40 minutes at 350°.
Makes 3 loaves (about 3 1/2 x 7 1/2 x 2 1/2 size pans). Cool 5 minutes in pan and then remove to cooling rack and cool completely.
recipes.text: Poppy Seed Bread. Mix together. Bake in greased pans approximately 40 minutes at 350°. Makes 3 loaves (about 3 1/2 x 7 1/2 x 2 1/2 size pans). Cool 5 minutes in pan and then remove to cooling rack and cool completely.

recipes.title: Crawfish Etouffee
ingredients: red and black pepper to taste
directions: Melt butter in large heavy skillet.
Saute vegetables in butter for 30 minutes.
Add seasonings to taste, then crawfish tails and fat.
Saute for a minute and stir in flour.
Continue sauteing for 3 minutes.
Add water, chicken bouillon, green onions and parsley.
Simmer for 10 to 15 minutes.
Serves 4 to 6.
recipes.text: Crawfish Etouffee. Melt butter in large heavy skillet. Saute vegetables in butter for 30 minutes. Add seasonings to taste, then crawfish tails and fat. Saute for a minute and stir in flour. Continue sauteing for 3 minutes. Add water, chicken bouillon, green onions and parsley. Simmer for 10 to 15 minutes. Serves 4 to 6.

recipes.title: Hanky Panky(Appetizer)
directions: Brown and drain meat.
Under low heat, add cheese and mix until all melted and blended.
Place tablespoons of meat and cheese mixture on slices of bread and place on cookie sheet. Place under broiler until mixture bubbles and bread is crisp (usually 5 to 7 minutes).
recipes.text: Hanky Panky(Appetizer). Brown and drain meat. Under low heat, add cheese and mix until all melted and blended. Place tablespoons of meat and cheese mixture on slices of bread and place on cookie sheet. Place under broiler until mixture bubbles and bread is crisp (usually 5 to 7 minutes).

recipes.title: Bacon Roll-Ups
directions: Blend cheese and sour cream.
Add soup mix and Worcestershire. Cut crust off bread and flatten with rolling pin.
Spread with mixture and roll up.
Cut into thirds.
Cut bacon and wrap around rolls; secure with toothpicks.
Bake at 350° until brown, about 15 minutes.
Yield:
recipes.text: Bacon Roll-Ups. Blend cheese and sour cream. Add soup mix and Worcestershire. Cut crust off bread and flatten with rolling pin. Spread with mixture and roll up. Cut into thirds. Cut bacon and wrap around rolls; secure with toothpicks. Bake at 350° until brown, about 15 minutes. Yield: 50.

recipes.title: Frozen Strawberry Jam
directions: The rest is the same as for jam.
recipes.text: Frozen Strawberry Jam. The rest is the same as for jam.

recipes.title: Meat Loaf
directions: Combine all ingredients and place in a baking dish.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour or until not bloody when pressed with a fork. Pour tomato sauce over the top after draining grease off and bake for 10 minutes.
recipes.text: Meat Loaf. Combine all ingredients and place in a baking dish. Bake at 350° for 1 hour or until not bloody when pressed with a fork. Pour tomato sauce over the top after draining grease off and bake for 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Lemon Pudding Cake
directions: Combine sugar, dash salt, and flour; stir in melted butter, lemon peel, and juice.
Combine milk and egg yolks; add to lemon mixture.
Fold in egg whites.
Pour into 8 x 8 x 2 inch baking pan. Place in larger pan on oven rack.
Pour hot water into larger pan, 1 inch deep.
Bake at 350 degrees for 40 minutes.
Serve warm or chilled.
Serves 9.
recipes.text: Lemon Pudding Cake. Combine sugar, dash salt, and flour; stir in melted butter, lemon peel, and juice. Combine milk and egg yolks; add to lemon mixture. Fold in egg whites. Pour into 8 x 8 x 2 inch baking pan. Place in larger pan on oven rack. Pour hot water into larger pan, 1 inch deep. Bake at 350 degrees for 40 minutes. Serve warm or chilled. Serves 9.

recipes.title: Scalloped Potatoes
directions: Melt butter in saucepan.
Blend in flour, salt and pepper. Add milk all at once.
Cook and stir over medium heat.
Continue cooking until thick and bubbly. Cook and stir 2 minutes more.
Mix with sliced potatoes.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until tender.
recipes.text: Scalloped Potatoes. Melt butter in saucepan. Blend in flour, salt and pepper. Add milk all at once. Cook and stir over medium heat. Continue cooking until thick and bubbly. Cook and stir 2 minutes more. Mix with sliced potatoes. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until tender.

recipes.title: Sliced Baked Potatoes
ingredients: 2 to 3 Tbsp. melted butter or margarine
2 to 3 Tbsp. chopped fresh parsley, chives, thyme or sage or 2 to 3 Tbsp. dried herbs
directions: Peel potatoes and cut into thin slices, but do not cut all the way through.
Put potatoes in baking dish.
Fan them slightly. Sprinkle with salt; drizzle with butter and sprinkle with herbs. Bake potatoes at 425° for 50 minutes.
Remove from oven and sprinkle with cheeses.
Bake for another 10 to 15 minutes until lightly browned.
recipes.text: Sliced Baked Potatoes. Peel potatoes and cut into thin slices, but do not cut all the way through. Put potatoes in baking dish. Fan them slightly. Sprinkle with salt; drizzle with butter and sprinkle with herbs. Bake potatoes at 425° for 50 minutes. Remove from oven and sprinkle with cheeses. Bake for another 10 to 15 minutes until lightly browned.

recipes.title: Orange Jelly
directions: Add lemon juice to water.
Pour over oranges.
Let stand overnight.
Boil until soft; press through jelly bag and strain. To each 2 cups of juice, add 1 3/4 cups sugar.
Boil rapidly to jelly stage.
Pour into sterilized jelly glasses.
recipes.text: Orange Jelly. Add lemon juice to water. Pour over oranges. Let stand overnight. Boil until soft; press through jelly bag and strain. To each 2 cups of juice, add 1 3/4 cups sugar. Boil rapidly to jelly stage. Pour into sterilized jelly glasses.

recipes.title: Celery Seed Dressing
directions: Place above ingredients in blender except for the oil.
Blend short time, then add oil.
Beat 3 to 5 minutes.
recipes.text: Celery Seed Dressing. Place above ingredients in blender except for the oil. Blend short time, then add oil. Beat 3 to 5 minutes.

recipes.title: Shrimp, Peas And Rice Stir-Fry
directions: Cook black-eyed peas as directed on package.
Heat oil in wok or large skillet until hot.
Stir-fry carrots and onion for 1 minute.
Add mushrooms, garlic, thyme and red pepper; stir-fry vegetables about 2 minutes.
Add shrimp; stir-fry until shrimp are pink about 2 minutes.
Add rice, black-eyed peas and combine with shrimp mixture.
Season with salt and pepper.
Serve with green onions.
Yields 6 servings.
recipes.text: Shrimp, Peas And Rice Stir-Fry. Cook black-eyed peas as directed on package. Heat oil in wok or large skillet until hot. Stir-fry carrots and onion for 1 minute. Add mushrooms, garlic, thyme and red pepper; stir-fry vegetables about 2 minutes. Add shrimp; stir-fry until shrimp are pink about 2 minutes. Add rice, black-eyed peas and combine with shrimp mixture. Season with salt and pepper. Serve with green onions. Yields 6 servings.

recipes.title: Dave'S Mushroom Soup
directions: No salt needed in soup. Broth and bouillon have plenty.
recipes.text: Dave'S Mushroom Soup. No salt needed in soup. Broth and bouillon have plenty.

recipes.title: Chocolate Cake
directions: Cream butter and sugar; add eggs, one at a time.
Sift flour, cocoa and salt three times.
Dissolve soda in buttermilk; add alternately with flour to sugar-butter-egg mixture.
Add vanilla. Bake in 3 or 4 layers in a 325° oven for 25 minutes.
recipes.text: Chocolate Cake. Cream butter and sugar; add eggs, one at a time. Sift flour, cocoa and salt three times. Dissolve soda in buttermilk; add alternately with flour to sugar-butter-egg mixture. Add vanilla. Bake in 3 or 4 layers in a 325° oven for 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Cranberry Salad(Good)
ingredients: 2 small pkg. strawberry or cherry Jell-O
1 small can crushed pineapple (save juice for topping)
1 1/2 c. seeded and cut up grapes
directions: Cover fresh cranberries with water.
Cook until they stop popping.
Run through sieve or in blender, if you wish.
Add Jell-O.
Add sugar while hot.
Stir well.
Let cool and add crushed pineapple.
Add grapes and 1/2 cup chopped nuts.
Chill.
recipes.text: Cranberry Salad(Good). Cover fresh cranberries with water. Cook until they stop popping. Run through sieve or in blender, if you wish. Add Jell-O. Add sugar while hot. Stir well. Let cool and add crushed pineapple. Add grapes and 1/2 cup chopped nuts. Chill.

recipes.title: Broccoli Salad
ingredients: 3 stalks broccoli, chopped in bite-sized pieces
1 lb. bacon, fried crisp and crumbled
directions: Combine all ingredients in a large bowl.
Toss gently to coat. Cover and chill at least 2 hours.
Makes 6 to 8 servings.
recipes.text: Broccoli Salad. Combine all ingredients in a large bowl. Toss gently to coat. Cover and chill at least 2 hours. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

recipes.title: No Fail Pie Crust
directions: Combine 2 cups flour, 1 cup butter flavored Crisco and 1/2 cup cool water.
Use pastry dough kneader/cutter and cut until crumbly.
Do not overwork dough!
Roll as desired.
Makes one full pie crust.
recipes.text: No Fail Pie Crust. Combine 2 cups flour, 1 cup butter flavored Crisco and 1/2 cup cool water. Use pastry dough kneader/cutter and cut until crumbly. Do not overwork dough! Roll as desired. Makes one full pie crust.

recipes.title: Chicken Enchiladas
directions: Combine and heat soups, seasonings, onions and broth, mixing well.
Cover bottom of 9 x 13-inch baking dish with chips, then layer of chicken, half the sauce and cheese on top.
Repeat, ending with cheese.
Bake 25 to 30 minutes.
May be made ahead and refrigerated or frozen.
recipes.text: Chicken Enchiladas. Combine and heat soups, seasonings, onions and broth, mixing well. Cover bottom of 9 x 13-inch baking dish with chips, then layer of chicken, half the sauce and cheese on top. Repeat, ending with cheese. Bake 25 to 30 minutes. May be made ahead and refrigerated or frozen.

recipes.title: Gapirotada(Bread Pudding)
ingredients: 1/2 c. pine nuts or chopped almonds
directions: In the medium saucepan, bring the water, brown sugar and cinnamon to boiling.
Reduce heat and simmer, uncovered, for about 3 minutes.
Stir in butter.
Cut toast in 1-inch pieces. Fold into the sugar mixture along with raisins and nuts.
recipes.text: Gapirotada(Bread Pudding). In the medium saucepan, bring the water, brown sugar and cinnamon to boiling. Reduce heat and simmer, uncovered, for about 3 minutes. Stir in butter. Cut toast in 1-inch pieces. Fold into the sugar mixture along with raisins and nuts.

recipes.title: Zucchini Relish
directions: Let first 3 ingredients set overnight.
After setting overnight, drain and rinse, then add remaining ingredients. Bring to rolling boil, can and seal.
recipes.text: Zucchini Relish. Let first 3 ingredients set overnight. After setting overnight, drain and rinse, then add remaining ingredients. Bring to rolling boil, can and seal.

recipes.title: Gingered Fruit Salad
ingredients: 1 (16 oz.) pkg. frozen unsweetened peaches, thawed
1 c. coarsely chopped fresh pear, with or without peel
1 c. (medium size) coarsely chopped apple, with or without peel
2 Tbsp. frozen orange juice concentrate, thawed
directions: In large bowl, combine first 4 ingredients.
In small jar, stir together remaining ingredients; pour over fruits, tossing to blend.
Cover and refrigerate 4 to 8 hours.
Makes 8 servings.
recipes.text: Gingered Fruit Salad. In large bowl, combine first 4 ingredients. In small jar, stir together remaining ingredients; pour over fruits, tossing to blend. Cover and refrigerate 4 to 8 hours. Makes 8 servings.

recipes.title: Holiday Cheese Ball
directions: Cream cheese in bowl. Add pineapple, green pepper, onion and seasoned salt. Add pecans (reserving some to roll ball into). Form into a ball and chill. Roll in nuts just before serving.
recipes.text: Holiday Cheese Ball. Cream cheese in bowl. Add pineapple, green pepper, onion and seasoned salt. Add pecans (reserving some to roll ball into). Form into a ball and chill. Roll in nuts just before serving.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Pie
directions: Mix the first 6 ingredients together.
Separate egg; beat the yolk and add to ingredients.
Add hot milk.
Beat egg white and fold into mixture.
Pour in 9-inch pie crust shell.
Bake 10 minutes at 450°.
Bake another 30 minutes at 350°.
recipes.text: Pumpkin Pie. Mix the first 6 ingredients together. Separate egg; beat the yolk and add to ingredients. Add hot milk. Beat egg white and fold into mixture. Pour in 9-inch pie crust shell. Bake 10 minutes at 450°. Bake another 30 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Cheese Cake
directions: Beat cream cheese until fluffy.
Add milk. lemon juice, and vanilla.
Mix well and pour into graham cracker crust pie shell. Refrigerate for one hour.
Top with favorite pie filling.
recipes.text: Cheese Cake. Beat cream cheese until fluffy. Add milk. lemon juice, and vanilla. Mix well and pour into graham cracker crust pie shell. Refrigerate for one hour. Top with favorite pie filling.

recipes.title: Spiced Banana Coffee Ring
ingredients: 2/3 c. firmly packed dark brown sugar
directions: Preheat oven to 400°.
Grease a 9-cup Bundt pan.
Pour 1/4 cup of melted butter into prepared pan.
Sprinkle 1/3 cup of brown sugar and 1/3 cup of nuts evenly over butter.
Mix together mashed bananas, egg and sugar.
Stir in baking mix and milk.
Mix together brown sugar, nuts, cinnamon and nutmeg.
Spoon half of banana mixture into prepared pan.
Top with brown sugar-spice mixture. Drizzle with remaining melted butter.
Spoon over remaining banana mixture.
Smooth top.
Bake cake until a toothpick inserted near center comes out clean, about 25 minutes.
Immediately invert pan onto a serving plate for 3 to 4 minutes, allowing syrup to drizzle over cake.
Remove pan.
Cool.
recipes.text: Spiced Banana Coffee Ring. Preheat oven to 400°. Grease a 9-cup Bundt pan. Pour 1/4 cup of melted butter into prepared pan. Sprinkle 1/3 cup of brown sugar and 1/3 cup of nuts evenly over butter. Mix together mashed bananas, egg and sugar. Stir in baking mix and milk. Mix together brown sugar, nuts, cinnamon and nutmeg. Spoon half of banana mixture into prepared pan. Top with brown sugar-spice mixture. Drizzle with remaining melted butter. Spoon over remaining banana mixture. Smooth top. Bake cake until a toothpick inserted near center comes out clean, about 25 minutes. Immediately invert pan onto a serving plate for 3 to 4 minutes, allowing syrup to drizzle over cake. Remove pan. Cool.

recipes.title: Banana Bread
directions: Mix and bake at 350° for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Banana Bread. Mix and bake at 350° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Rocky Road Fudge
ingredients: 14 oz. can Eagle Brand sweetened condensed milk
directions: Combine in saucepan and melt and stir over medium heat just until morsels and margarine are melted.
In large bowl, combine 2 cups dry roasted peanuts and 1 (10 1/2 ounce) package miniature marshmallows.
Pour chocolate mixture into nut mixture.
Mix well. Spread into wax paper-lined 13 x 9-inch pan.
Chill 2 hours.
Cut in squares.
recipes.text: Rocky Road Fudge. Combine in saucepan and melt and stir over medium heat just until morsels and margarine are melted. In large bowl, combine 2 cups dry roasted peanuts and 1 (10 1/2 ounce) package miniature marshmallows. Pour chocolate mixture into nut mixture. Mix well. Spread into wax paper-lined 13 x 9-inch pan. Chill 2 hours. Cut in squares.

recipes.title: Puff Pie
directions: Strip cream out of cookies.
Crush cookies to coarse crumbs and set aside.
Dissolve unflavored gelatin in the cold water. Let stand 10 minutes.
Add hot water.
Stir and let cool.
Beat egg whites until stiff.
Add sugar; mix with electric mixer.
Fold in gelatin mixture.
Whip the whipping cream.
Fold it into egg whites and gelatin mixture.
Add vanilla to taste.
Layer half the crushed crumbs into a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan.
Pour mixture on top. Top with remaining half of crumbs.
Freeze overnight.
Serve frozen.
recipes.text: Puff Pie. Strip cream out of cookies. Crush cookies to coarse crumbs and set aside. Dissolve unflavored gelatin in the cold water. Let stand 10 minutes. Add hot water. Stir and let cool. Beat egg whites until stiff. Add sugar; mix with electric mixer. Fold in gelatin mixture. Whip the whipping cream. Fold it into egg whites and gelatin mixture. Add vanilla to taste. Layer half the crushed crumbs into a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Pour mixture on top. Top with remaining half of crumbs. Freeze overnight. Serve frozen.

recipes.title: Spaghetti Sauce
directions: Brown beef, onions and garlic.
Drain.
Mix with other ingredients and simmer at least 1 hour.
Serve over cooked spaghetti.
recipes.text: Spaghetti Sauce. Brown beef, onions and garlic. Drain. Mix with other ingredients and simmer at least 1 hour. Serve over cooked spaghetti.

recipes.title: Broccoli-Rice And Cheese Casserole
ingredients: 2 pkg. frozen chopped broccoli, thawed at least 2 hours.
directions: Saute onion.
Cook rice.
Combine all and bake at 350° for 40 minutes.
recipes.text: Broccoli-Rice And Cheese Casserole. Saute onion. Cook rice. Combine all and bake at 350° for 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Applesauce Donuts
directions: In large mixer bowl, combine all ingredients, except nuts. Beat at medium speed until well blended.
Stir in nuts.
Set in refrigerator for at least 1 hour.
Take out and stir down.
Add additional flour if needed.
Cut with donut cutter and fry in hot grease at 375°.
Brown on one side until brown and turn.
(Can drop by teaspoonfuls, if you wish.)
recipes.text: Applesauce Donuts. In large mixer bowl, combine all ingredients, except nuts. Beat at medium speed until well blended. Stir in nuts. Set in refrigerator for at least 1 hour. Take out and stir down. Add additional flour if needed. Cut with donut cutter and fry in hot grease at 375°. Brown on one side until brown and turn. (Can drop by teaspoonfuls, if you wish.)

recipes.title: Betty Ann Colombo'S Pecan Pie
directions: Preheat oven to 425°.
Line pie shell with pecans in a circular pattern.
Beat eggs in a bowl until well mixed (not whipped).
Set aside.
Put sugar and syrup into a heavy saucepan (small pot).
Cook over low heat, stirring until sugar is dissolved and mixture is smooth.
Pour hot syrup mixture gradually into eggs, constantly stirring.
Add the butter and keep stirring until butter is melted.
Stir in vanilla extract.
recipes.text: Betty Ann Colombo'S Pecan Pie. Preheat oven to 425°. Line pie shell with pecans in a circular pattern. Beat eggs in a bowl until well mixed (not whipped). Set aside. Put sugar and syrup into a heavy saucepan (small pot). Cook over low heat, stirring until sugar is dissolved and mixture is smooth. Pour hot syrup mixture gradually into eggs, constantly stirring. Add the butter and keep stirring until butter is melted. Stir in vanilla extract.

recipes.title: Zucchini Lasagna
ingredients: oregano and garlic flakes or Italian seasoning
directions: Mix all ingredients in large bowl.
Add zucchini slices.
Mix together.
Bake in 9 x 13-inch dish at 350° until done.
recipes.text: Zucchini Lasagna. Mix all ingredients in large bowl. Add zucchini slices. Mix together. Bake in 9 x 13-inch dish at 350° until done.

recipes.title: Pineapple Drop Cookies
directions: Blend shortening, salt and vanilla.
Add sugar and cream well. Add eggs and beat well.
Add flour and baking powder (which have been sifted together) and blend.
Add oatmeal, nuts and pineapple and blend.
Drop on cookie sheets.
Bake at 350° for 15 to 18 minutes.
recipes.text: Pineapple Drop Cookies. Blend shortening, salt and vanilla. Add sugar and cream well. Add eggs and beat well. Add flour and baking powder (which have been sifted together) and blend. Add oatmeal, nuts and pineapple and blend. Drop on cookie sheets. Bake at 350° for 15 to 18 minutes.

recipes.title: Broccoli Rice Whiz
directions: Cook rice in a large saucepan and drain.
Saute onion, bell pepper and celery in margarine.
Add onion, bell pepper and celery to the rice while still hot.
Fold in Cheez Whiz, chicken soup and milk.
Heat on low burner just until cheese and soup are well blended.
Fold in chopped broccoli.
Pour into a greased casserole and bake 30 to 35 minutes at 350°.
Serves 12.
recipes.text: Broccoli Rice Whiz. Cook rice in a large saucepan and drain. Saute onion, bell pepper and celery in margarine. Add onion, bell pepper and celery to the rice while still hot. Fold in Cheez Whiz, chicken soup and milk. Heat on low burner just until cheese and soup are well blended. Fold in chopped broccoli. Pour into a greased casserole and bake 30 to 35 minutes at 350°. Serves 12.

recipes.title: Iced Tea Nectar
directions: Dissolve tea in a large pitcher.
Stir in sugar until dissolved, then add pineapple juice, apricot nectar and orange and lemon juices.
Pour over ice in tall glasses.
recipes.text: Iced Tea Nectar. Dissolve tea in a large pitcher. Stir in sugar until dissolved, then add pineapple juice, apricot nectar and orange and lemon juices. Pour over ice in tall glasses.

recipes.title: Five Cup Salad
directions: Mix all together and refrigerate.
recipes.text: Five Cup Salad. Mix all together and refrigerate.

recipes.title: Green Chili Casserole
ingredients: 1 (10 oz.) can or 2 (4 oz.) cans chopped green chilies
directions: Saute onion and beef.
Mix chilies into soups with about 1/4 cup milk.
Season with garlic powder and oregano; heat and add olives.
Cut tortillas into quarters.
Pour small amount of soup mix in casserole.
Alternate layers of tortillas, meat and soup mixture.
Add cheese on top.
Cover and bake for 30 minutes until bubbly in 350° oven.
Serves 12.
recipes.text: Green Chili Casserole. Saute onion and beef. Mix chilies into soups with about 1/4 cup milk. Season with garlic powder and oregano; heat and add olives. Cut tortillas into quarters. Pour small amount of soup mix in casserole. Alternate layers of tortillas, meat and soup mixture. Add cheese on top. Cover and bake for 30 minutes until bubbly in 350° oven. Serves 12.

recipes.title: Butter Pecan Cheesecake
directions: Combine cracker crumbs, sugar, butter and pecans.
Reserve 1/3 cup of the mixture.
Firmly press remaining mixture into bottom of a 9-inch spring-form pan.
Beat cream cheese with an electric mixer until light and fluffy.
Gradually add 1 1/2 cups sugar, mixing well.
Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each addition.
Add sour cream and flavoring.
Mix well.
Stir in 1 cup pecans.
Spoon into prepared pan on top of crust.
Sprinkle with reserved crumb mixture.
Bake at 475° for 10 minutes.
Reduce temperature to 300° and bake for 50 minutes.
Let cool to room temperature on wire rack.
Chill.
recipes.text: Butter Pecan Cheesecake. Combine cracker crumbs, sugar, butter and pecans. Reserve 1/3 cup of the mixture. Firmly press remaining mixture into bottom of a 9-inch spring-form pan. Beat cream cheese with an electric mixer until light and fluffy. Gradually add 1 1/2 cups sugar, mixing well. Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each addition. Add sour cream and flavoring. Mix well. Stir in 1 cup pecans. Spoon into prepared pan on top of crust. Sprinkle with reserved crumb mixture. Bake at 475° for 10 minutes. Reduce temperature to 300° and bake for 50 minutes. Let cool to room temperature on wire rack. Chill.

recipes.title: Pineapple Casserole
ingredients: 1 (20 oz.) can pineapple chunks (in its own juice)
directions: Drain
pineapple;
reserve juice.
Mix flour and sugar. Add juice.
Add
pineapple and cheese, mixing well.
Put in a small (1 quart or 1 1/2 quart) casserole dish.
Mix butter and crackers. Sprinkle over casserole.
Bake at 350° for 20 to 30 minutes until brown.
Good!!!
Serves 6 to 8.
recipes.text: Pineapple Casserole. Drain pineapple; reserve juice. Mix flour and sugar. Add juice. Add pineapple and cheese, mixing well. Put in a small (1 quart or 1 1/2 quart) casserole dish. Mix butter and crackers. Sprinkle over casserole. Bake at 350° for 20 to 30 minutes until brown. Good!!! Serves 6 to 8.

recipes.title: Onion Pie
ingredients: 2 1/2 c. onions, sliced thin and cooked
directions: Melt 1 stick margarine in pie pan.
Add cracker crumbs; mix together.
Put in pie pan or casserole to form a base.
Put cooked onions on top of the crumbs (cracker).
Mix up the scalded milk, grated cheese, eggs, salt and pepper.
Pour this over the onions and cracker crumbs.
Bake at 325° for 40 minutes.
Good with barbecue chicken or steaks.
recipes.text: Onion Pie. Melt 1 stick margarine in pie pan. Add cracker crumbs; mix together. Put in pie pan or casserole to form a base. Put cooked onions on top of the crumbs (cracker). Mix up the scalded milk, grated cheese, eggs, salt and pepper. Pour this over the onions and cracker crumbs. Bake at 325° for 40 minutes. Good with barbecue chicken or steaks.

recipes.title: Lime Pickles
directions: Mix the lime with the 2 gallons water and pour over cucumbers. Let stand 24 hours.
Stir often, but gently.
Stir these several times so the lime mixes with the cucumbers.
Rinse well; cover with clean, cold water.
Let stand for 4 hours; drain well.
recipes.text: Lime Pickles. Mix the lime with the 2 gallons water and pour over cucumbers. Let stand 24 hours. Stir often, but gently. Stir these several times so the lime mixes with the cucumbers. Rinse well; cover with clean, cold water. Let stand for 4 hours; drain well.

recipes.title: Cherry Cherry Balls
ingredients: 2 c. old fashioned or quick cooking oats, uncooked
directions: Beat butter and brown sugar with mixer until light and fluffy. Combine flour, oats and baking soda.
Add to egg-sugar mixture, mixing until crumbly.
Spread 2/3 of the oat mixture into the bottom of an ungreased 9 x 13-inch pan.
Press down to make a firm layer.
Puree cherry pie filling in blender, food processor or mixer.
Put in medium saucepan.
recipes.text: Cherry Cherry Balls. Beat butter and brown sugar with mixer until light and fluffy. Combine flour, oats and baking soda. Add to egg-sugar mixture, mixing until crumbly. Spread 2/3 of the oat mixture into the bottom of an ungreased 9 x 13-inch pan. Press down to make a firm layer. Puree cherry pie filling in blender, food processor or mixer. Put in medium saucepan.

recipes.title: Colonial Pecan Carrot Cake With Orange Glaze
directions: Combine oil and sugar; mix well.
Sift together remaining dry ingredients.
Sift 1/2 of dry ingredients into the sugar mixture; blend well.
Then add the remaining dry ingredients alternately with eggs, one at a time, mixing well after each addition.
Add carrots and mix well, then mix in pecans.
Pour into lightly oiled 10-inch tube pan.
Bake in slow oven (325°) for about 1 hour and 10 minutes.
Cool with pan upright.
Frost with Orange Glaze.
recipes.text: Colonial Pecan Carrot Cake With Orange Glaze. Combine oil and sugar; mix well. Sift together remaining dry ingredients. Sift 1/2 of dry ingredients into the sugar mixture; blend well. Then add the remaining dry ingredients alternately with eggs, one at a time, mixing well after each addition. Add carrots and mix well, then mix in pecans. Pour into lightly oiled 10-inch tube pan. Bake in slow oven (325°) for about 1 hour and 10 minutes. Cool with pan upright. Frost with Orange Glaze.

recipes.title: Aggression Cookies
ingredients: 3 c. margarine or butter or half of each
directions: If you feel like throwing bricks or snarling at Santa, you can knead, mash, squeeze and beat the bejunior out of the dough.
recipes.text: Aggression Cookies. If you feel like throwing bricks or snarling at Santa, you can knead, mash, squeeze and beat the bejunior out of the dough.

recipes.title: Western Barbecue Sauce
directions: Add brown sugar, vinegar and Worcestershire to the all-purpose sauce.
Simmer 5 minutes.
Place chicken or ribs in baking pan. Brush meat with the Wesson oil. Season with salt and pepper.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes. Drain fat and turn meat. Spoon barbecue sauce over and bake 30 to 45 minutes or until tender, turning and basting with sauce.
Makes 4 servings.
recipes.text: Western Barbecue Sauce. Add brown sugar, vinegar and Worcestershire to the all-purpose sauce. Simmer 5 minutes. Place chicken or ribs in baking pan. Brush meat with the Wesson oil. Season with salt and pepper. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes. Drain fat and turn meat. Spoon barbecue sauce over and bake 30 to 45 minutes or until tender, turning and basting with sauce. Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: Sweet-Sour Red Cabbage
ingredients: 1 medium head red cabbage (about 5 c., shredded)
directions: Prepare and cook 5 cups shredded cabbage (be sure to add 2 tablespoons vinegar or lemon juice to the salted water).
recipes.text: Sweet-Sour Red Cabbage. Prepare and cook 5 cups shredded cabbage (be sure to add 2 tablespoons vinegar or lemon juice to the salted water).

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Cookies
directions: Heat oven to 400°.
Mix peanut butter, shortening, sugars, and water.
Stir in baking mix.
Shape dough by rounded teaspoonfuls into balls.
Place on ungreased cookie sheet. Flatten cookies in crisscross pattern with fork dipped in flour. Bake until set, 5-7 minutes.
Cool slightly; remove from cookie sheet.
Make about 4 doz. cookies.
recipes.text: Peanut Butter Cookies. Heat oven to 400°. Mix peanut butter, shortening, sugars, and water. Stir in baking mix. Shape dough by rounded teaspoonfuls into balls. Place on ungreased cookie sheet. Flatten cookies in crisscross pattern with fork dipped in flour. Bake until set, 5-7 minutes. Cool slightly; remove from cookie sheet. Make about 4 doz. cookies.

recipes.title: Pecan Pie
directions: Mix together and place in uncooked pie crust.
Bake for 10 minutes at 425°; then bake 25 minutes at 350° or until done.
recipes.text: Pecan Pie. Mix together and place in uncooked pie crust. Bake for 10 minutes at 425°; then bake 25 minutes at 350° or until done.

recipes.title: Mexican Wedding Cookies
directions: Mix together, press and roll into small balls.
Then flatten. Bake at 350° until lightly brown.
Let cool slightly.
Cover in sugar and cinnamon.
recipes.text: Mexican Wedding Cookies. Mix together, press and roll into small balls. Then flatten. Bake at 350° until lightly brown. Let cool slightly. Cover in sugar and cinnamon.

recipes.title: Barbecue Spice
directions: Mix together and use as seasoned salt.
Great for anyone on a salt restricted diet.
recipes.text: Barbecue Spice. Mix together and use as seasoned salt. Great for anyone on a salt restricted diet.

recipes.title: Lemon Pound Cake
directions: Cream shortening, butter or margarine and sugar.
Add eggs one at a time.
Beat well until lemon colored.
Combine flour, baking powder and milk.
Add flavoring.
Beat well.
Bake in a tube pan for 1 hour and 20 minutes at 325°.
recipes.text: Lemon Pound Cake. Cream shortening, butter or margarine and sugar. Add eggs one at a time. Beat well until lemon colored. Combine flour, baking powder and milk. Add flavoring. Beat well. Bake in a tube pan for 1 hour and 20 minutes at 325°.

recipes.title: Dump Cake
directions: Use a 10 x 15-inch pan.
Spray pan with Pam or other nonstick spray.
Spread the can of cherry pie filling in pan.
Spread can of pineapple on top of cherries.
Spread that with the dry cake mix.
Pour on the melted butter.
Top with nuts and then coconut. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Dump Cake. Use a 10 x 15-inch pan. Spray pan with Pam or other nonstick spray. Spread the can of cherry pie filling in pan. Spread can of pineapple on top of cherries. Spread that with the dry cake mix. Pour on the melted butter. Top with nuts and then coconut. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Waffles
ingredients: 5 tbsp. melted butter or salad oil
directions: Place first four dry ingredients in a large bowl.
Separate yolks and whites of eggs into separate bowls.
Beat egg yolks well, then add melted butter or oil.
Pour liquid ingredients into dry ingredients.
Combine with a few swift strokes.
The batter will have a pebbled look.
Beat until stiff, but not dry.
Add the three egg whites and fold into batter until barely blended.
recipes.text: Waffles. Place first four dry ingredients in a large bowl. Separate yolks and whites of eggs into separate bowls. Beat egg yolks well, then add melted butter or oil. Pour liquid ingredients into dry ingredients. Combine with a few swift strokes. The batter will have a pebbled look. Beat until stiff, but not dry. Add the three egg whites and fold into batter until barely blended.

recipes.title: Refrigerator Slaw
directions: Sprinkle salt and pepper over shredded cabbage.
Mix mustard and mayonnaise; mix with cabbage.
Mix vinegar, sugar and margarine.
Bring to a boil, then pour over cabbage and mix well. This will keep well in fridge for up to 2 months.
recipes.text: Refrigerator Slaw. Sprinkle salt and pepper over shredded cabbage. Mix mustard and mayonnaise; mix with cabbage. Mix vinegar, sugar and margarine. Bring to a boil, then pour over cabbage and mix well. This will keep well in fridge for up to 2 months.

recipes.title: Scalloped Corn
directions: Mix regular corn, creamed corn, corn meal, beaten eggs and sour cream.
Spray an 11 x 13-inch pan with Pam.
Pour mixture in pan.
Sprinkle cheese on top.
Sprinkle bread crumbs on top of cheese.
Cut up stick of margarine and sprinkle on top of bread crumbs.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Scalloped Corn. Mix regular corn, creamed corn, corn meal, beaten eggs and sour cream. Spray an 11 x 13-inch pan with Pam. Pour mixture in pan. Sprinkle cheese on top. Sprinkle bread crumbs on top of cheese. Cut up stick of margarine and sprinkle on top of bread crumbs. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Monkey Bread
directions: Quarter all biscuits.
Roll in sugar and cinnamon; put in greased Bundt pan.
Melt butter, brown sugar and water.
Let boil for 2 minutes at medium heat; do not overcook!
Do not let it crystallize.
Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.
recipes.text: Monkey Bread. Quarter all biscuits. Roll in sugar and cinnamon; put in greased Bundt pan. Melt butter, brown sugar and water. Let boil for 2 minutes at medium heat; do not overcook! Do not let it crystallize. Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Tomato Pie
ingredients: 3 lb. can whole tomatoes, strained and cut in half
directions: Mix first 5 ingredients together and pat into a pie plate. Fill with remaining ingredients.
Bake at 325° for 40 minutes. Serve hot or cold.
recipes.text: Tomato Pie. Mix first 5 ingredients together and pat into a pie plate. Fill with remaining ingredients. Bake at 325° for 40 minutes. Serve hot or cold.

recipes.title: Whoopie Pies
directions: Mix all ingredients with mixer in large bowl in listed order. Drop on greased cookie sheets, 1 tablespoon each cookie, 2 inches apart.
Makes 40 cakes (2 1/2-inches each) or 20 pies.
Bake in 350° oven for 15 minutes.
When cool, make Filling.
recipes.text: Whoopie Pies. Mix all ingredients with mixer in large bowl in listed order. Drop on greased cookie sheets, 1 tablespoon each cookie, 2 inches apart. Makes 40 cakes (2 1/2-inches each) or 20 pies. Bake in 350° oven for 15 minutes. When cool, make Filling.

recipes.title: Easy Custard Pie
directions: Heat oven to 450°.
Cover edge of pastry with 1 1/2-inch wide strip of aluminum foil.
Thoroughly mix eggs, sugar, salt and vanilla.
Slowly stir in hot milk.
Pour immediately into unbaked pie shell (to avoid spills, fill at oven).
Sprinkle top with nutmeg.
Bake about 20 minutes or until silver knife inserted from side of filling comes out clean.
Serve warm or cold.
recipes.text: Easy Custard Pie. Heat oven to 450°. Cover edge of pastry with 1 1/2-inch wide strip of aluminum foil. Thoroughly mix eggs, sugar, salt and vanilla. Slowly stir in hot milk. Pour immediately into unbaked pie shell (to avoid spills, fill at oven). Sprinkle top with nutmeg. Bake about 20 minutes or until silver knife inserted from side of filling comes out clean. Serve warm or cold.

recipes.title: Hot Sauce
ingredients: 2 to 3 tsp. red pepper (2 for mild and 3 for hot)
directions: Mix all ingredients in a saucepan and cook over low heat for 1 hour; stir occasionally.
recipes.text: Hot Sauce. Mix all ingredients in a saucepan and cook over low heat for 1 hour; stir occasionally.

recipes.title: Apricot Almond Chicken
ingredients: 1 c. uncooked long grain brown rice
directions: In a bowl, combine the first eight ingredients; mix well. Transfer to a greased 13 x 9 x 2 baking dish; top with chicken. Cover and bake at 350° for 55 to 60 minutes or until rice is tender.
Uncover.
Place a tablespoon of preserves on each chicken breast; sprinkle with almonds.
Bake 10 minutes longer or until chicken juices run clear.
Let stand 5 minutes before serving.
recipes.text: Apricot Almond Chicken. In a bowl, combine the first eight ingredients; mix well. Transfer to a greased 13 x 9 x 2 baking dish; top with chicken. Cover and bake at 350° for 55 to 60 minutes or until rice is tender. Uncover. Place a tablespoon of preserves on each chicken breast; sprinkle with almonds. Bake 10 minutes longer or until chicken juices run clear. Let stand 5 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Fruit Cake
ingredients: 2 (8 oz.) mincemeat (A & P) in a jar
directions: Mix all ingredients and bake at 350° for 1 hour.
Use well greased and floured Bundt pan.
recipes.text: Fruit Cake. Mix all ingredients and bake at 350° for 1 hour. Use well greased and floured Bundt pan.

recipes.title: Chocolate Pound Cake
directions: Cream butter and shortening.
Add sugar and eggs one at a time, beating after each addition.
Sift all dry ingredients together.
Add to creamed mixture alternately with milk.
Add vanilla and bake in a greased and floured tube pan at 325° for 1 hour and 20 minutes or until done.
recipes.text: Chocolate Pound Cake. Cream butter and shortening. Add sugar and eggs one at a time, beating after each addition. Sift all dry ingredients together. Add to creamed mixture alternately with milk. Add vanilla and bake in a greased and floured tube pan at 325° for 1 hour and 20 minutes or until done.

recipes.title: Larry'S German Sweet Chocolate Cake
ingredients: 1 pkg baker's german sweet baking chocolate
1 c (2 sticks) butter or margarine softened
2 c white lily self rising flour
directions: Heat oven to 350°.
Grease and flour 3 (9 inch) round cake pans.
Microwave chocolate and water in a large bowl on high 1 1/2 to 2 minutes or until chocolate is almost melted, stirring halfway through heating time.
Beat butter and sugar in large bowl with electric mixer on medium speed until light and fluffy.
Add egg yolks, one at a time beating well after each addition.
Stir in chocolate mixture and vanilla.
Add flour alternately with butter milk, beating after each addition until smooth.
Beat egg whites in another large bowl with electric mixer on high speed until stiff peaks form.
Gently stir into batter.
Pour into prepared pans.
Bake 30 minutes or until cakes springs back when lightly touched.
Immediately loosen cake from pan.
Cool 15 minutes, and remove from pans.
Cool completely.
Spread frosting on top of each layer.
Makes 12 servings use coconut pecan filling frosting.
recipes.text: Larry'S German Sweet Chocolate Cake. Heat oven to 350°. Grease and flour 3 (9 inch) round cake pans. Microwave chocolate and water in a large bowl on high 1 1/2 to 2 minutes or until chocolate is almost melted, stirring halfway through heating time. Beat butter and sugar in large bowl with electric mixer on medium speed until light and fluffy. Add egg yolks, one at a time beating well after each addition. Stir in chocolate mixture and vanilla. Add flour alternately with butter milk, beating after each addition until smooth. Beat egg whites in another large bowl with electric mixer on high speed until stiff peaks form. Gently stir into batter. Pour into prepared pans. Bake 30 minutes or until cakes springs back when lightly touched. Immediately loosen cake from pan. Cool 15 minutes, and remove from pans. Cool completely. Spread frosting on top of each layer. Makes 12 servings use coconut pecan filling frosting.

recipes.title: Baked Curried Fruit
directions: Drain fruits well in colander until all juice has run off, 1 to 2 hours.
Prepare shallow casserole (8 x 12-inches or similar size) by greasing it with margarine.
Add fruit; cover with mixture of brown sugar and curry powder.
Sprinkle with lemon juice and dot with margarine.
Cover and bake 1 hour in oven at 300°.
Yield:
12 servings, about 2 quarts.
Approximate calories/serving:
recipes.text: Baked Curried Fruit. Drain fruits well in colander until all juice has run off, 1 to 2 hours. Prepare shallow casserole (8 x 12-inches or similar size) by greasing it with margarine. Add fruit; cover with mixture of brown sugar and curry powder. Sprinkle with lemon juice and dot with margarine. Cover and bake 1 hour in oven at 300°. Yield: 12 servings, about 2 quarts. Approximate calories/serving: 1/2 cup = 115.

recipes.title: J. B.'S Sad Cake
directions: Grease and flour a large loaf pan (at least a 2-quart pan). Combine all ingredients and bake 40 to 50 minutes at 350°.
recipes.text: J. B.'S Sad Cake. Grease and flour a large loaf pan (at least a 2-quart pan). Combine all ingredients and bake 40 to 50 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Fiesta Brunch Casserole
directions: Heat oven to 400°.
Spray both halves of tortillas with cooking spray.
Place 2 tortillas into each of 2 loaf pans, gently shaping each into a "bowl".
In a medium saucepan heat chili. Stir in potatoes; cook until thoroughly heated.
Divide chili mixture among tortillas.
With back of spoon make an indentation in each chili mixture.
Break egg into each indentation.
Bake 10 minutes.
Cover loosely with foil.
Bake 5 to 10 minutes longer or until eggs are done.
Gently lift out of pans to serving plates. Spoon on tomato and onions.
Sprinkle with cheese.
Serve with salsa (optional).
recipes.text: Fiesta Brunch Casserole. Heat oven to 400°. Spray both halves of tortillas with cooking spray. Place 2 tortillas into each of 2 loaf pans, gently shaping each into a "bowl". In a medium saucepan heat chili. Stir in potatoes; cook until thoroughly heated. Divide chili mixture among tortillas. With back of spoon make an indentation in each chili mixture. Break egg into each indentation. Bake 10 minutes. Cover loosely with foil. Bake 5 to 10 minutes longer or until eggs are done. Gently lift out of pans to serving plates. Spoon on tomato and onions. Sprinkle with cheese. Serve with salsa (optional).

recipes.title: Blueberry Sour Cream Cake
ingredients: 1 qt. fresh or frozen blueberries (remove ice crystals)
directions: Grease and flour 9 or 10-inch spring-form pan.
Heat oven to 350°.
Combine flour, butter, 1 egg, 1/2 cup sugar, baking powder and 1 teaspoon vanilla; blend well.
Turn into prepared pan and sprinkle with blueberries.
recipes.text: Blueberry Sour Cream Cake. Grease and flour 9 or 10-inch spring-form pan. Heat oven to 350°. Combine flour, butter, 1 egg, 1/2 cup sugar, baking powder and 1 teaspoon vanilla; blend well. Turn into prepared pan and sprinkle with blueberries.

recipes.title: Coconut Pound Cake
directions: Cream butter and sugar.
Add eggs, one at a time and beat well.
Sift flour and salt.
Add to creamed mixture along with sour cream, vanilla and lemon flavorings.
Fold in coconut.
Bake at 325° for 1 hour and 20 minutes in tube pan.
recipes.text: Coconut Pound Cake. Cream butter and sugar. Add eggs, one at a time and beat well. Sift flour and salt. Add to creamed mixture along with sour cream, vanilla and lemon flavorings. Fold in coconut. Bake at 325° for 1 hour and 20 minutes in tube pan.

recipes.title: Veal Parmigiana
directions: Dip cutlets in mixture of beaten eggs, salt and pepper.
Pat coating of crumbs over meat surface.
Heat oil in large skillet; brown veal on both sides.
Place meat in large baking dish. Combine and heat remaining ingredients except cheeses for 10 minutes.
Pour over veal, sprinkle with Parmesan cheese and cover tightly.
Bake 30 minutes at 350°.
Remove cover, place slice of Mozzarella cheese over each cutlet and bake 10 to 15 minutes longer.
Serves 4 to 6.
recipes.text: Veal Parmigiana. Dip cutlets in mixture of beaten eggs, salt and pepper. Pat coating of crumbs over meat surface. Heat oil in large skillet; brown veal on both sides. Place meat in large baking dish. Combine and heat remaining ingredients except cheeses for 10 minutes. Pour over veal, sprinkle with Parmesan cheese and cover tightly. Bake 30 minutes at 350°. Remove cover, place slice of Mozzarella cheese over each cutlet and bake 10 to 15 minutes longer. Serves 4 to 6.

recipes.title: Liver In Herbed Tomato Sauce
directions: Cut liver into strips 1 inch wide.
Cover with boiling water. Then drain thoroughly.
Mix flour, seasoned salt and pepper in plastic bag.
Add liver, a few pieces at a time, and shake until coated.
Set aside.
recipes.text: Liver In Herbed Tomato Sauce. Cut liver into strips 1 inch wide. Cover with boiling water. Then drain thoroughly. Mix flour, seasoned salt and pepper in plastic bag. Add liver, a few pieces at a time, and shake until coated. Set aside.

recipes.title: Plantation Cake
directions: Bake gingerbread as directed on package.
Beat cream cheese until fluffy.
Heat lemon pudding until hot through.
Top warm gingerbread squares with cream cheese.
Spoon hot lemon pudding over top.
Serves 9.
recipes.text: Plantation Cake. Bake gingerbread as directed on package. Beat cream cheese until fluffy. Heat lemon pudding until hot through. Top warm gingerbread squares with cream cheese. Spoon hot lemon pudding over top. Serves 9.

recipes.title: Italian Chicken Casserole
directions: Cut up chicken breasts in small pieces.
Beat up eggs.
Put chicken in eggs and let set for 1 hour.
Dip chicken in bread crumbs; brown on both sides, using margarine.
Put in casserole dish and sprinkle with cheese, broth and mushrooms.
Cover with foil.
Bake 1 to 1 1/2 hours at 350°. Uncover for the last 10 minutes.
recipes.text: Italian Chicken Casserole. Cut up chicken breasts in small pieces. Beat up eggs. Put chicken in eggs and let set for 1 hour. Dip chicken in bread crumbs; brown on both sides, using margarine. Put in casserole dish and sprinkle with cheese, broth and mushrooms. Cover with foil. Bake 1 to 1 1/2 hours at 350°. Uncover for the last 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Mexicali Meat Loaf
ingredients: 1 (4 1/2 oz.) can diced mild green chilies or 1/2 can
8 oz. Monterey Jack cheese, cut into 1/4 to 1/2-inch cubes or shredded
3/4 c. salsa (mild, medium or hot, as desired)
directions: Preheat the oven to 350°. Combine all these ingredients in a really big bowl and then with clean hands, knead it all until it's thoroughly blended. Dump it out on a clean broiler rack and form into a loaf; it'll be a big loaf, about 3-inches thick. Bake for 1 1/2 hours. Yield: 8 servings.
recipes.text: Mexicali Meat Loaf. Preheat the oven to 350°. Combine all these ingredients in a really big bowl and then with clean hands, knead it all until it's thoroughly blended. Dump it out on a clean broiler rack and form into a loaf; it'll be a big loaf, about 3-inches thick. Bake for 1 1/2 hours. Yield: 8 servings.

recipes.title: Spinach Dip
directions: Unthaw spinach and mix all ingredients thoroughly.
Take one round loaf of baked bread and hollow out the entire center leaving only shell.
Pinch into bite size.
Pour dip in bread shell and arrange bite size pieces around outer edge.
(Dip pieces in dip mixture.)
recipes.text: Spinach Dip. Unthaw spinach and mix all ingredients thoroughly. Take one round loaf of baked bread and hollow out the entire center leaving only shell. Pinch into bite size. Pour dip in bread shell and arrange bite size pieces around outer edge. (Dip pieces in dip mixture.)

recipes.title: Mawmaw'S Fudge(The Best!)
ingredients: 1 to 2 c. chopped walnuts or pecans
directions: Place chocolate chips, butter and marshmallow cream in large bowl; set aside.
In heavy 4-quart saucepan bring to boil evaporated milk and sugar, stirring constantly.
When mixture reaches full rolling boil, start timing and cook 8 minutes, stirring constantly.
Remove from heat; pour over chocolate mixture in bowl, stirring until well mixed.
(Be careful - it's very hot!) Beat with electric mixer or wooden spoon until it begins to hold its shape.
Beat in vanilla.
Stir in nuts.
Pour in greased 15 x 10-inch jelly roll pan; spread evenly.
Chill; cut into 60 pieces. Store in airtight container.
Makes 5 pounds of mouth-watering melt-in-your-mouth fudge!
recipes.text: Mawmaw'S Fudge(The Best!). Place chocolate chips, butter and marshmallow cream in large bowl; set aside. In heavy 4-quart saucepan bring to boil evaporated milk and sugar, stirring constantly. When mixture reaches full rolling boil, start timing and cook 8 minutes, stirring constantly. Remove from heat; pour over chocolate mixture in bowl, stirring until well mixed. (Be careful - it's very hot!) Beat with electric mixer or wooden spoon until it begins to hold its shape. Beat in vanilla. Stir in nuts. Pour in greased 15 x 10-inch jelly roll pan; spread evenly. Chill; cut into 60 pieces. Store in airtight container. Makes 5 pounds of mouth-watering melt-in-your-mouth fudge!

recipes.title: Hot Bean-Venison Dip
ingredients: 1/2 lb. Monterey Jack or Cheddar cheese, shredded
directions: Saute
onions
in butter, then add meat and brown.
Add remaining
ingredients,
saving some of the cheese for the top and simmer
10	to 15 minutes.	Pour into a casserole dish and top with
remaining
cheese.
Bake
until cheese is melted. Serve with tostados or corn chips.
recipes.text: Hot Bean-Venison Dip. Saute onions in butter, then add meat and brown. Add remaining ingredients, saving some of the cheese for the top and simmer 10	to 15 minutes.	Pour into a casserole dish and top with remaining cheese. Bake at	350° until cheese is melted. Serve with tostados or corn chips.

recipes.title: Chicken Soup
ingredients: 1 c. carrots or as many as you like
directions: Bring water to a boil and then add onion salt, garlic salt and the chicken.
Let it cook until just about tender.
Add tomato sauce, cabbage, carrots and rice.
Cook until the rice is done. Serve in bowls with lemon and chile on the side.
recipes.text: Chicken Soup. Bring water to a boil and then add onion salt, garlic salt and the chicken. Let it cook until just about tender. Add tomato sauce, cabbage, carrots and rice. Cook until the rice is done. Serve in bowls with lemon and chile on the side.

recipes.title: Sausage Bread
ingredients: 1 small jar marinated artichoke hearts, cut up artichokes and save juice
1 lb. Italian sausage, take out of casing, fry and drain
directions: Slice Vienna bread in half long ways and take out middle. Shred or cut up middle of bread which you took out and mix with all ingredients.
Put back in bread.
Bake for approximately 1/2 hour at 350°.
recipes.text: Sausage Bread. Slice Vienna bread in half long ways and take out middle. Shred or cut up middle of bread which you took out and mix with all ingredients. Put back in bread. Bake for approximately 1/2 hour at 350°.

recipes.title: Gringo Chili
directions: Brown meat and onion; drain. Add back to skillet. Heat all ingredients together until cheese is melted. Serve with tortilla chips or taco shells.
recipes.text: Gringo Chili. Brown meat and onion; drain. Add back to skillet. Heat all ingredients together until cheese is melted. Serve with tortilla chips or taco shells.

recipes.title: Carrot And Orange Salad With Dill
ingredients: 6 carrots, about 1 1/4 lb., pared and grated
directions: Working over a bowl, peel and cut the white membrane away from the orange.
Slice it into segments and set aside.
recipes.text: Carrot And Orange Salad With Dill. Working over a bowl, peel and cut the white membrane away from the orange. Slice it into segments and set aside.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Cookies
directions: Have shortening at room temperature.
Grease cookie sheets. Mix together flour, soda and salt.
Beat next 7 ingredients.
Stop mixer; scrape bowl.
Add sifted flour mixture.
Beat on medium scraping bowl while beating.
Drop by teaspoonfuls on a cookie sheet.
Press lightly with a fork which has been dipped in flour to flatten cookies and make top ridged.
Bake at 325° for 15 to 20 minutes.
Makes about 3 1/2 dozen cookies.
recipes.text: Peanut Butter Cookies. Have shortening at room temperature. Grease cookie sheets. Mix together flour, soda and salt. Beat next 7 ingredients. Stop mixer; scrape bowl. Add sifted flour mixture. Beat on medium scraping bowl while beating. Drop by teaspoonfuls on a cookie sheet. Press lightly with a fork which has been dipped in flour to flatten cookies and make top ridged. Bake at 325° for 15 to 20 minutes. Makes about 3 1/2 dozen cookies.

recipes.title: Hot Potato Salad
directions: Mix first 6 ingredients well.
Put in casserole dish and top with bacon bits.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Hot Potato Salad. Mix first 6 ingredients well. Put in casserole dish and top with bacon bits. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Ding Dong Cake
directions: Bake in 2 round pans.
Split with thread when cooled.
recipes.text: Ding Dong Cake. Bake in 2 round pans. Split with thread when cooled.

recipes.title: Caramel Corn
ingredients: 1 c. light brown sugar or maple sugar, packed
directions: Melt butter; stir in brown sugar, corn syrup and salt.
Bring to a boil, stirring constantly.
Boil without stirring for 5 minutes.
Remove from heat; stir in soda and vanilla.
Gradually pour over popped corn, mixing well.
Turn into 2 large shallow baking pans.
Bake in 250° oven for 1 hour,
stirring every 15 minutes.
Remove from oven, cool completely.
Break apart.
Makes about 5 quarts caramel corn.
recipes.text: Caramel Corn. Melt butter; stir in brown sugar, corn syrup and salt. Bring to a boil, stirring constantly. Boil without stirring for 5 minutes. Remove from heat; stir in soda and vanilla. Gradually pour over popped corn, mixing well. Turn into 2 large shallow baking pans. Bake in 250° oven for 1 hour, stirring every 15 minutes. Remove from oven, cool completely. Break apart. Makes about 5 quarts caramel corn.

recipes.title: Strawberry Cake And Icing
directions: Mix together.
Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.
Let cool. Ice cake.
recipes.text: Strawberry Cake And Icing. Mix together. Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes. Let cool. Ice cake.

recipes.title: Venison Jerky
directions: Debone venison, removing as much fat and gristle as possible. Using very sharp knife or electric knife, slice venison into 1/8-inch strips.
recipes.text: Venison Jerky. Debone venison, removing as much fat and gristle as possible. Using very sharp knife or electric knife, slice venison into 1/8-inch strips.

recipes.title: Almond Slices
directions: Combine all ingredients in a large bowl.
Grease cookie sheet pan. Shape dough into loaves 1/2-inch in diameter, on cookie sheet.
Brush tops with beaten egg.
Bake 20 minutes at 350°. Cool and cut diagonally.
recipes.text: Almond Slices. Combine all ingredients in a large bowl. Grease cookie sheet pan. Shape dough into loaves 1/2-inch in diameter, on cookie sheet. Brush tops with beaten egg. Bake 20 minutes at 350°. Cool and cut diagonally.

recipes.title: Fruit Pizza
directions: Cut cookie dough into 1/8-inch slices and arrange on lightly greased pizza pan, letting slices overlap.
Press lightly together to seal.
Bake 10 minutes at 350° until edges begin to brown; top will not be brown.
Blend the cream cheese with whipped topping and add sugar and vanilla; spread evenly over crust.
Arrange fruit attractively over crust.
Pour glaze over all.
recipes.text: Fruit Pizza. Cut cookie dough into 1/8-inch slices and arrange on lightly greased pizza pan, letting slices overlap. Press lightly together to seal. Bake 10 minutes at 350° until edges begin to brown; top will not be brown. Blend the cream cheese with whipped topping and add sugar and vanilla; spread evenly over crust. Arrange fruit attractively over crust. Pour glaze over all.

recipes.title: Pizzeria Casserole
directions: Cook pasta for 7 minutes, drain.
Combine pizza sauce, pepperoni, and 1 c. cheese in 1-1/2 qt. casserole.
Sprinkle with remaining cheese and bake for 35 min. covered or until bubbly hot.
recipes.text: Pizzeria Casserole. Cook pasta for 7 minutes, drain. Combine pizza sauce, pepperoni, and 1 c. cheese in 1-1/2 qt. casserole. Sprinkle with remaining cheese and bake for 35 min. covered or until bubbly hot.

recipes.title: Pineapple Coconut Pie
directions: Mix flour with sugar and drain a small amount of pineapple juice.
Mix ingredients together and turn into pie shell.
Bake at 350° until rises to the top and turns golden brown.
recipes.text: Pineapple Coconut Pie. Mix flour with sugar and drain a small amount of pineapple juice. Mix ingredients together and turn into pie shell. Bake at 350° until rises to the top and turns golden brown.

recipes.title: Green Bean Special
directions: Combine sour cream and dressing; add remaining ingredients and mix well. Chill 4-5 hours before serving.
recipes.text: Green Bean Special. Combine sour cream and dressing; add remaining ingredients and mix well. Chill 4-5 hours before serving.

recipes.title: Oatmeal Cake
ingredients: 1 tsp. soda (even if using self-rising flour)
directions: Pour 1 1/2 cups boiling water over 1 cup quick cooking oatmeal. Set aside to cool while you prepare batter. Add all the ingredients well. Then mix oats mixture. Pour into greased and floured cake pan. Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes.
recipes.text: Oatmeal Cake. Pour 1 1/2 cups boiling water over 1 cup quick cooking oatmeal. Set aside to cool while you prepare batter. Add all the ingredients well. Then mix oats mixture. Pour into greased and floured cake pan. Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Cheesy Scalloped Potatoes
directions: Combine salad dressing, flour, salt and pepper.
Gradually add milk; cook, stirring constantly, over low heat until thickened. Add Cheddar cheese; stir until melted.
Place potatoes in a 10 x 6-inch baking dish and pour sauce over potatoes.
Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese.
Bake at 350° for 55 to 60 minutes or until potatoes are tender.
Serves 6.
recipes.text: Cheesy Scalloped Potatoes. Combine salad dressing, flour, salt and pepper. Gradually add milk; cook, stirring constantly, over low heat until thickened. Add Cheddar cheese; stir until melted. Place potatoes in a 10 x 6-inch baking dish and pour sauce over potatoes. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Bake at 350° for 55 to 60 minutes or until potatoes are tender. Serves 6.

recipes.title: Lentils And Rice
directions: Rinse lentils and place in a pan with water.
Boil for 20 minutes on medium fire.
Saute chopped (or julienned) onion in oil until light brown.
Add onion and residue, seasonings and rice to the lentils.
Cover and cook for 20 minutes.
Stir occasionally. Serve on a platter; this thickens as it cools.
recipes.text: Lentils And Rice. Rinse lentils and place in a pan with water. Boil for 20 minutes on medium fire. Saute chopped (or julienned) onion in oil until light brown. Add onion and residue, seasonings and rice to the lentils. Cover and cook for 20 minutes. Stir occasionally. Serve on a platter; this thickens as it cools.

recipes.title: Cottage Beef Bake
directions: Cook noodles.
Drain and rinse.
Set aside.
Saute ground beef. Drain fat.
Add tomato sauce, salt, garlic salt and pepper.
Simmer 5 minutes.
Add cottage cheese, sour cream and onions to noodles. Use a 2-quart round casserole dish and spray with Pam.
Spoon 1/2 noodle mixture into bottom of casserole, then spoon in 1/2 meat mixture over the noodles.
Repeat layers.
Sprinkle grated cheese on top.
Make 1 or 2 days early.
Keep refrigerated until ready to bake.
Freeze also.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
Serves 8 to 10 people.
recipes.text: Cottage Beef Bake. Cook noodles. Drain and rinse. Set aside. Saute ground beef. Drain fat. Add tomato sauce, salt, garlic salt and pepper. Simmer 5 minutes. Add cottage cheese, sour cream and onions to noodles. Use a 2-quart round casserole dish and spray with Pam. Spoon 1/2 noodle mixture into bottom of casserole, then spoon in 1/2 meat mixture over the noodles. Repeat layers. Sprinkle grated cheese on top. Make 1 or 2 days early. Keep refrigerated until ready to bake. Freeze also. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes. Serves 8 to 10 people.

recipes.title: "Smilie Face" Pancakes
directions: Mix Bisquick, milk and eggs together for pancake batter.
Cook pancakes on preheated griddle.
Add chocolate morsels when pouring the batter onto griddle.
When pancakes are done, take whipped cream and make a face on surface of pancake.
Garnish with chocolate chips.
recipes.text: "Smilie Face" Pancakes. Mix Bisquick, milk and eggs together for pancake batter. Cook pancakes on preheated griddle. Add chocolate morsels when pouring the batter onto griddle. When pancakes are done, take whipped cream and make a face on surface of pancake. Garnish with chocolate chips.

recipes.title: Marinated Garden Salad
directions: In a large bowl, combine the celery, cucumber, carrots and radishes.
Add the dressing and refrigerate for 1 hour.
Just before serving, add greens and toss.
Yields 5 servings.
recipes.text: Marinated Garden Salad. In a large bowl, combine the celery, cucumber, carrots and radishes. Add the dressing and refrigerate for 1 hour. Just before serving, add greens and toss. Yields 5 servings.

recipes.title: Shrimp Or Crab Bisque
ingredients: 1 lb. peeled shrimp or 1 lb. crab meat
directions: Make a roux of flour and butter. Slowly add milk, stirring constantly.
Add wine, half and half, lemon juice and seafood. Add cayenne, salt and pepper to taste,
Stir until thickened.
Serve with oyster crackers.
recipes.text: Shrimp Or Crab Bisque. Make a roux of flour and butter. Slowly add milk, stirring constantly. Add wine, half and half, lemon juice and seafood. Add cayenne, salt and pepper to taste, Stir until thickened. Serve with oyster crackers.

recipes.title: Lasagne
directions: Saute garlic and onion in small amount of fat.
Brown lean ground beef.
Add tomatoes, tomato paste, onion-garlic mixture, parsley, sugar, salt and ground basil and cook until thick.
Cook lasagne noodles according to package directions.
recipes.text: Lasagne. Saute garlic and onion in small amount of fat. Brown lean ground beef. Add tomatoes, tomato paste, onion-garlic mixture, parsley, sugar, salt and ground basil and cook until thick. Cook lasagne noodles according to package directions.

recipes.title: Chicken Casserole
directions: Melt butter in casserole dish. Crumble Ritz crackers and spread in bottom of dish, covering bottom good. Salt and pepper chicken to your taste.
Mix together the soups and sour cream. Pour over chicken. Sprinkle with a few more Ritz crackers. Bake 1 hour.
recipes.text: Chicken Casserole. Melt butter in casserole dish. Crumble Ritz crackers and spread in bottom of dish, covering bottom good. Salt and pepper chicken to your taste. Mix together the soups and sour cream. Pour over chicken. Sprinkle with a few more Ritz crackers. Bake 1 hour.

recipes.title: Lowfat Spanish Rice With Smoked Sausage
ingredients: 1 1/2 c. chopped low fat smoked sausage
directions: Combine the bell pepper, onion, and broth.
Cook until peppers and onions are tender.
Add sausage, rice, tomato sauce, water, salt, and black pepper.
Cover and cook over low heat for about 8 to 10 minutes or until the rice has absorbed the liquid. Taste and adjust seasoning, if needed.
Makes 6 generous servings. with about 1 gram of fat per serving.
recipes.text: Lowfat Spanish Rice With Smoked Sausage. Combine the bell pepper, onion, and broth. Cook until peppers and onions are tender. Add sausage, rice, tomato sauce, water, salt, and black pepper. Cover and cook over low heat for about 8 to 10 minutes or until the rice has absorbed the liquid. Taste and adjust seasoning, if needed. Makes 6 generous servings. with about 1 gram of fat per serving.

recipes.title: Strawberry Cooler
ingredients: 1 (6 oz.) can frozen lemonade concentrate, thawed
directions: In 2-quart pitcher, combine sugar, water, strawberries and lemonade.
Gradually stir in club soda just before serving. Serve over ice.
Serves 6.
recipes.text: Strawberry Cooler. In 2-quart pitcher, combine sugar, water, strawberries and lemonade. Gradually stir in club soda just before serving. Serve over ice. Serves 6.

recipes.title: Caramel Corn
directions: Slightly beat first 5 ingredients; cook in microwave until thick, then add remaining ingredients.
Cool.
Pour into your baked pie crust.
Add meringue.
Bake.
recipes.text: Caramel Corn. Slightly beat first 5 ingredients; cook in microwave until thick, then add remaining ingredients. Cool. Pour into your baked pie crust. Add meringue. Bake.

recipes.title: Spiced Tea
directions: Mix well.
Place 2 to 3 teaspoons in cup.
Add hot water; stir.
recipes.text: Spiced Tea. Mix well. Place 2 to 3 teaspoons in cup. Add hot water; stir.

recipes.title: Green Tomato Pickle
directions: In large pot, place a layer of tomatoes and sprinkle with salt. Then add a layer of onions and red peppers; salt.
Continue layers until vegetables are done.
Let stand overnight; drain well.
Cover with vinegar and spices.
Boil slowly 4 or 5 hours.
recipes.text: Green Tomato Pickle. In large pot, place a layer of tomatoes and sprinkle with salt. Then add a layer of onions and red peppers; salt. Continue layers until vegetables are done. Let stand overnight; drain well. Cover with vinegar and spices. Boil slowly 4 or 5 hours.

recipes.title: Microwave Fudge
directions: Mix cocoa and sugar.
Add milk and butter, cut in fourths. Cook on high for 2 minutes.
Mix well.
Add vanilla and nuts. Stir. Cool.
Cut into squares.
recipes.text: Microwave Fudge. Mix cocoa and sugar. Add milk and butter, cut in fourths. Cook on high for 2 minutes. Mix well. Add vanilla and nuts. Stir. Cool. Cut into squares.

recipes.title: Pot-Roasted Beef Dinner
ingredients: 1 (1 1/2 to 2 lb.) beef top round roast (trimmed of all visible fat)
8 tiny boiling onions or 2 small onions (quartered)
directions: Preheat oven to 325°.
Peel a strip around tiny potatoes. If using medium potatoes, cut in chunks.
Lightly spray an unheated Dutch oven with no-stick spray.
Add the meat and brown. Drain drippings from pan.
recipes.text: Pot-Roasted Beef Dinner. Preheat oven to 325°. Peel a strip around tiny potatoes. If using medium potatoes, cut in chunks. Lightly spray an unheated Dutch oven with no-stick spray. Add the meat and brown. Drain drippings from pan.

recipes.title: Michael'S Danish Chocolate Chip Tart A' L'Orange
ingredients: 2 (4 oz.) pkg. graham crackers (mini tart crusts)
directions: Preheat oven to 350°.
In large bowl, combine Ricotta, eggs, sugar, butter and vanilla; beat well.
Stir in chocolate chips. Spoon 1/4 cup into each crust (mini).
Place on cookie sheet. Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes (center will be soft).
Cool completely.
recipes.text: Michael'S Danish Chocolate Chip Tart A' L'Orange. Preheat oven to 350°. In large bowl, combine Ricotta, eggs, sugar, butter and vanilla; beat well. Stir in chocolate chips. Spoon 1/4 cup into each crust (mini). Place on cookie sheet. Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes (center will be soft). Cool completely.

recipes.title: Sweet Dill Refrigerator Pickles
directions: In a saucepan, combine sugar, vinegar, water and salt.
Bring to a boil and boil 1 minute.
In a large nonmetallic container, combine cucumbers, onion and dill.
Pour dressing over; cool. Cover and refrigerate at least 3 days before serving.
Stir occasionally.
Yields 3 1/2 quarts.
recipes.text: Sweet Dill Refrigerator Pickles. In a saucepan, combine sugar, vinegar, water and salt. Bring to a boil and boil 1 minute. In a large nonmetallic container, combine cucumbers, onion and dill. Pour dressing over; cool. Cover and refrigerate at least 3 days before serving. Stir occasionally. Yields 3 1/2 quarts.

recipes.title: Jewish Coffee Cake
directions: Combine together with mixer on medium speed.
recipes.text: Jewish Coffee Cake. Combine together with mixer on medium speed.

recipes.title: Beaten Biscuits(Alabama Tech Extension Service)
directions: Mix and sift flour and salt.
Work in fat with pastry blender. Moisten to a stiff dough.
Grind in a kneader 15 minutes or beat with a rolling pin until smooth and well blistered, continuing folding over the dough to incorporate air.
Roll about 1/3-inch thick.
Cut with a small biscuit cutter and prick with a fork. Bake at 425° for 20 minutes or until golden brown.
recipes.text: Beaten Biscuits(Alabama Tech Extension Service). Mix and sift flour and salt. Work in fat with pastry blender. Moisten to a stiff dough. Grind in a kneader 15 minutes or beat with a rolling pin until smooth and well blistered, continuing folding over the dough to incorporate air. Roll about 1/3-inch thick. Cut with a small biscuit cutter and prick with a fork. Bake at 425° for 20 minutes or until golden brown.

recipes.title: Cherry Crunch
directions: Layer pie filling.
Sprinkle with a pinch of sugar.
Spread nuts on pie filling.
Mix melted butter and cake mix until crumbly.
Put on pie filling.
Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Cherry Crunch. Layer pie filling. Sprinkle with a pinch of sugar. Spread nuts on pie filling. Mix melted butter and cake mix until crumbly. Put on pie filling. Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Pineapple-Lime Float
ingredients: 1 (12 oz.) can pineapple juice, chilled (1 1/2 c.)
1/2 (6 oz.) can frozen limeade concentrate, thawed (1/3 c.)
directions: Combine pineapple juice, water and limeade concentrate. Divide pineapple mixture among 6 tall glasses.
Spoon half of the lime sherbet into the glasses; stir gently.
Carefully pour chilled ginger ale into each glass.
Top with scoops of remaining lime sherbet.
Garnish with mint leaves, if desired.
Makes 6 servings.
recipes.text: Pineapple-Lime Float. Combine pineapple juice, water and limeade concentrate. Divide pineapple mixture among 6 tall glasses. Spoon half of the lime sherbet into the glasses; stir gently. Carefully pour chilled ginger ale into each glass. Top with scoops of remaining lime sherbet. Garnish with mint leaves, if desired. Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Dirt Dessert
directions: Mix butter, cream cheese and 10x sugar.
Mix instant chocolate pudding and 3 1/2 cups milk.
Mix Cool Whip into pudding mix and combine with first mixture. Crush Oreo cookies and keep separated.
In plastic flowerpot alternate with cookie mixture and pudding mixture, beginning and ending with cookies.
Decorate. Serve with shovel and put flower into last mixture.
It will look as if this is a flowerpot.
recipes.text: Dirt Dessert. Mix butter, cream cheese and 10x sugar. Mix instant chocolate pudding and 3 1/2 cups milk. Mix Cool Whip into pudding mix and combine with first mixture. Crush Oreo cookies and keep separated. In plastic flowerpot alternate with cookie mixture and pudding mixture, beginning and ending with cookies. Decorate. Serve with shovel and put flower into last mixture. It will look as if this is a flowerpot.

recipes.title: Corn Fritters(Amish)
ingredients: 2 c. freshly grated or frozen corn, blended slightly
directions: Beat egg whites until stiff; set aside.
Beat egg yolks, flour, baking powder, salt, pepper, milk and sugar and add to the grated corn.
Mix thoroughly.
Fold in egg whites.
Drop by spoonfuls into greased frying pan.
Turn when golden brown on bottom, then brown top.
Serve warm with syrup.
Makes 4 servings.
recipes.text: Corn Fritters(Amish). Beat egg whites until stiff; set aside. Beat egg yolks, flour, baking powder, salt, pepper, milk and sugar and add to the grated corn. Mix thoroughly. Fold in egg whites. Drop by spoonfuls into greased frying pan. Turn when golden brown on bottom, then brown top. Serve warm with syrup. Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: Vegetable Pizza
ingredients: 1 (8 oz.) pkg. cream cheese plus additional 3 oz. (11 oz. all together)
directions: Using a cookie sheet or similar sheet pan, unroll crescent rolls and lay dough side by side, overlapping dough and covering bottom of pan.
Bake at 350° for 10 minutes.
recipes.text: Vegetable Pizza. Using a cookie sheet or similar sheet pan, unroll crescent rolls and lay dough side by side, overlapping dough and covering bottom of pan. Bake at 350° for 10 minutes.

recipes.title: 1, 2, 3, 4 Cake
directions: Cream butter and sugar until creamy.
Add eggs, one at a time. Sift together flour, baking powder and salt.
Gradually add flour mixture and milk.
Mix until well blended.
Add vanilla. Bake on 350° until toothpick inserted comes out clean, approximately 1 hour.
recipes.text: 1, 2, 3, 4 Cake. Cream butter and sugar until creamy. Add eggs, one at a time. Sift together flour, baking powder and salt. Gradually add flour mixture and milk. Mix until well blended. Add vanilla. Bake on 350° until toothpick inserted comes out clean, approximately 1 hour.

recipes.title: Chocolate Covered Rice Krispies Treats
ingredients: 1 c. peanut butter (smooth or crunchy style)
directions: In a large pot, over medium heat, mix the sugar and Karo syrup together.
Heat until sugar is liquified.
Remove from heat and add peanut butter.
Mix together.
Fold in the Rice Krispies, mixing until they are all covered.
Place in a greased 9 x 13-inch pan.
Flatten evenly into pan, using wax paper.
recipes.text: Chocolate Covered Rice Krispies Treats. In a large pot, over medium heat, mix the sugar and Karo syrup together. Heat until sugar is liquified. Remove from heat and add peanut butter. Mix together. Fold in the Rice Krispies, mixing until they are all covered. Place in a greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Flatten evenly into pan, using wax paper.

recipes.title: Spider Sandwiches
directions: With a 2 1/2-inch round cutter, cut a circle from each bread slice.
Spread about 2 tablespoons of peanut butter on half of bread rounds; top with remaining bread rounds.
Make 2 small indentations on top of sandwiches for "eyes".
Using peanut butter as glue, push one raisin into each indentation.
recipes.text: Spider Sandwiches. With a 2 1/2-inch round cutter, cut a circle from each bread slice. Spread about 2 tablespoons of peanut butter on half of bread rounds; top with remaining bread rounds. Make 2 small indentations on top of sandwiches for "eyes". Using peanut butter as glue, push one raisin into each indentation.

recipes.title: Hot Artichoke Dip
directions: Preheat oven to 350°.
Combine all ingredients.
Bake in Bake 'N Serve dish 30 minutes.
Serve warm with Triscuits or Trumpets.
recipes.text: Hot Artichoke Dip. Preheat oven to 350°. Combine all ingredients. Bake in Bake 'N Serve dish 30 minutes. Serve warm with Triscuits or Trumpets.

recipes.title: Spanish Rice
ingredients: few sprinkles crushed red pepper flakes (if desired)
directions: Saute onions in oil.
Add rice, then remaining ingredients. Cook about 1/2 hour on low heat.
