recipes.text: Spanish Rice. Saute onions in oil. Add rice, then remaining ingredients. Cook about 1/2 hour on low heat.

recipes.title: Chicken Parmesan(Low Calorie Recipe)
directions: Dip chicken breasts in imitation eggs and coat with bread crumbs (prefer homemade crumbs rather than store bought).
Spray frying pan with vegetable spray and fry chicken breasts.
Empty 1/2 tomato sauce into ovenproof casserole.
Place chicken; spread remaining sauce.
Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese and top with Mozzarella cheese.
Bake in oven or microwave until cheese is melted and hot.
Bake in 350° oven or about 10 minutes in microwave.
One chicken breast equals 150 calories.
recipes.text: Chicken Parmesan(Low Calorie Recipe). Dip chicken breasts in imitation eggs and coat with bread crumbs (prefer homemade crumbs rather than store bought). Spray frying pan with vegetable spray and fry chicken breasts. Empty 1/2 tomato sauce into ovenproof casserole. Place chicken; spread remaining sauce. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese and top with Mozzarella cheese. Bake in oven or microwave until cheese is melted and hot. Bake in 350° oven or about 10 minutes in microwave. One chicken breast equals 150 calories.

recipes.title: Chocolate Cheese Cake
directions: Reserve 1 cup cake mix; mix rest of cake mix, oil and 1 egg. Press in bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan.
Cream together cheese, eggs and sugar (cream well).
Add milk, vanilla and cup of cake mix (it will be runny).
Pour over cake crust.
Bake 1 hour at 325°.
Let cool.
Put Cool Whip on top.
Top with grated candy bar.
recipes.text: Chocolate Cheese Cake. Reserve 1 cup cake mix; mix rest of cake mix, oil and 1 egg. Press in bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan. Cream together cheese, eggs and sugar (cream well). Add milk, vanilla and cup of cake mix (it will be runny). Pour over cake crust. Bake 1 hour at 325°. Let cool. Put Cool Whip on top. Top with grated candy bar.

recipes.title: T'S Fried Steak
directions: Rub steak with salt and pepper.
Pound as much flour in steak as possible.
Brown slowly on both sides in hot cooking oil.
Add water.
Cover and steam.
Simmer a few minutes until tender. Makes 6 servings.
recipes.text: T'S Fried Steak. Rub steak with salt and pepper. Pound as much flour in steak as possible. Brown slowly on both sides in hot cooking oil. Add water. Cover and steam. Simmer a few minutes until tender. Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Risotto
directions: Lightly brown rice and onion in shortening.
Bring soup to a boil. Add rice, onion, bay leaf, cloves and thyme. Salt and pepper to taste. Cook, covered, on low heat until rice is tender.
Add cheese just before serving.
Serve with chicken.
recipes.text: Risotto. Lightly brown rice and onion in shortening. Bring soup to a boil. Add rice, onion, bay leaf, cloves and thyme. Salt and pepper to taste. Cook, covered, on low heat until rice is tender. Add cheese just before serving. Serve with chicken.

recipes.title: Lemon Glaze
directions: Put all ingredients in bowl and blend until sugar is liquefied. Pour over bread.
recipes.text: Lemon Glaze. Put all ingredients in bowl and blend until sugar is liquefied. Pour over bread.

recipes.title: Karen'S Nachos
directions: Brown ground turkey with onion and mushrooms; drain.
Spread chips on cookie sheet.
Spoon salsa over chips.
Cut olives in pieces and arrange over salsa.
Put meat mixture over olives. Layer Cheddar and Mozzarella cheeses on top.
Warm under broiler until cheeses are melted.
Serve immediately.
recipes.text: Karen'S Nachos. Brown ground turkey with onion and mushrooms; drain. Spread chips on cookie sheet. Spoon salsa over chips. Cut olives in pieces and arrange over salsa. Put meat mixture over olives. Layer Cheddar and Mozzarella cheeses on top. Warm under broiler until cheeses are melted. Serve immediately.

recipes.title: New Orleans Pecan Pie
directions: In saucepan, combine egg yolks, sour cream, granulated sugar, flour, vanilla and salt.
Cook and stir over medium heat until thickened, about 5 minutes.
Pour into baked pie shell; set aside.
recipes.text: New Orleans Pecan Pie. In saucepan, combine egg yolks, sour cream, granulated sugar, flour, vanilla and salt. Cook and stir over medium heat until thickened, about 5 minutes. Pour into baked pie shell; set aside.

recipes.title: Chicken And Steamed Vegetables
ingredients: 1 lb. boneless chicken breast, cut into 1-inch pieces
directions: Combine lemon juice, garlic and parsley in bowl.
Mix well. Combine chicken and vegetables in large bowl.
Pour lemon juice mixture over chicken.
Toss to coat well.
Cover and refrigerate for 10 minutes.
Heat oil in medium-sized skillet.
Add chicken; cook for 5 minutes.
Add vegetables with lemon juice and cook until tender.
Serve over noodles or rice.
recipes.text: Chicken And Steamed Vegetables. Combine lemon juice, garlic and parsley in bowl. Mix well. Combine chicken and vegetables in large bowl. Pour lemon juice mixture over chicken. Toss to coat well. Cover and refrigerate for 10 minutes. Heat oil in medium-sized skillet. Add chicken; cook for 5 minutes. Add vegetables with lemon juice and cook until tender. Serve over noodles or rice.

recipes.title: Hot Cheese Dip
ingredients: 1 lb. ground beef, browned and drained
directions: Brown meats in a large skillet and drain.
Add the other ingredients one at a time and mix thoroughly.
Makes a large amount and is very good with nachos and tortilla chips.
recipes.text: Hot Cheese Dip. Brown meats in a large skillet and drain. Add the other ingredients one at a time and mix thoroughly. Makes a large amount and is very good with nachos and tortilla chips.

recipes.title: Spinach Lasagna
ingredients: 1 pkg. frozen chopped spinach, thawed (save cooking juice)
directions: Cook spinach and reserve liquid (strain spinach). Mix spinach, Ricotta, Mozzarella and eggs together.

Place 1 layer of uncooked noodles into a 9 x 13 pan. (I always spray with cooking spray first and put a bit of sauce on pan bottom.) Spread with a layer of cheese mixture. Sprinkle top with garlic, oregano and Parmesan. Repeat process and end with top layer of noodles. Pour jar of sauce on top. Use spinach juice and added water to make 1 cup of liquid. Pour liquid along the perimeter of noodles. Cover tightly with foil. Cook 45 minutes to 1 1/2 hours at 350°.
recipes.text: Spinach Lasagna. Cook spinach and reserve liquid (strain spinach). Mix spinach, Ricotta, Mozzarella and eggs together. Place 1 layer of uncooked noodles into a 9 x 13 pan. (I always spray with cooking spray first and put a bit of sauce on pan bottom.) Spread with a layer of cheese mixture. Sprinkle top with garlic, oregano and Parmesan. Repeat process and end with top layer of noodles. Pour jar of sauce on top. Use spinach juice and added water to make 1 cup of liquid. Pour liquid along the perimeter of noodles. Cover tightly with foil. Cook 45 minutes to 1 1/2 hours at 350°.

recipes.title: Mexican Corn Bread
ingredients: 2 to 3 small jalapeno peppers, chopped fine
directions: Mix ingredients, adding cheese last. Pour into greased baking pan.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour and 10 minutes.
Serves 6 to 8.
recipes.text: Mexican Corn Bread. Mix ingredients, adding cheese last. Pour into greased baking pan. Bake at 350° for 1 hour and 10 minutes. Serves 6 to 8.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Krispies
directions: Combine margarine, sugar and syrup in saucepan. Bring to a boil. Remove from heat. Stir in peanut butter and cereal.
Drop by teaspoons on waxed paper. Cool.
Makes 2 dozen.
recipes.text: Peanut Butter Krispies. Combine margarine, sugar and syrup in saucepan. Bring to a boil. Remove from heat. Stir in peanut butter and cereal. Drop by teaspoons on waxed paper. Cool. Makes 2 dozen.

recipes.title: Fruit Dessert
ingredients: 1/3 c. orange juice concentrate (half 6 oz. can)
directions: Combine fruit in large bowl.
In small bowl, combine dry pudding mix, milk and orange concentrate.
Beat well 1 to 2 minutes.
Beat in sour cream.
Fold in fruit mix.
Put in large bowl.
Cover and refrigerate.
Serve on lettuce or in cups.
recipes.text: Fruit Dessert. Combine fruit in large bowl. In small bowl, combine dry pudding mix, milk and orange concentrate. Beat well 1 to 2 minutes. Beat in sour cream. Fold in fruit mix. Put in large bowl. Cover and refrigerate. Serve on lettuce or in cups.

recipes.title: Apple Crisp
ingredients: 1 (20 oz.) can sliced apples, mixed with 1/2 c. sugar and 1 tsp. cinnamon
directions: Combine first 5 ingredients; set aside.
Place apples in a greased 8-inch square baking dish.
Top with oat mixture.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes or until lightly brown.
Enjoy.
recipes.text: Apple Crisp. Combine first 5 ingredients; set aside. Place apples in a greased 8-inch square baking dish. Top with oat mixture. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes or until lightly brown. Enjoy.

recipes.title: Shrimp Dip #1
ingredients: 1 c. finely chopped tiny cooked shrimp
directions: Mix cream cheese and mayonnaise thoroughly.
Add other ingredients.
Add shrimp last.
Refrigerate at least 4 hours, preferably overnight, before serving.
recipes.text: Shrimp Dip #1. Mix cream cheese and mayonnaise thoroughly. Add other ingredients. Add shrimp last. Refrigerate at least 4 hours, preferably overnight, before serving.

recipes.title: Caramel Glazed Apple Chunk Cake
directions: Mix together dry ingredients.
In mixer, blend oil, sugar, eggs and vanilla.
Add apples and pecans to dry ingredients.
Add orange juice and dry ingredients to mixer.
Blend.
Pour into greased and floured Bundt pan.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Caramel Glazed Apple Chunk Cake. Mix together dry ingredients. In mixer, blend oil, sugar, eggs and vanilla. Add apples and pecans to dry ingredients. Add orange juice and dry ingredients to mixer. Blend. Pour into greased and floured Bundt pan. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Ranch Potato Salad
ingredients: 2 Tbsp. snipped fresh dill or substitute 1 tsp. dried dill
3 lb. red or new potatoes, cooked and cut into chunks (skin on)
directions: In a large salad bowl, thoroughly combine all ingredients except potatoes.
Toss with warm potatoes, cover and chill. Makes about 10 side dish servings.
recipes.text: Ranch Potato Salad. In a large salad bowl, thoroughly combine all ingredients except potatoes. Toss with warm potatoes, cover and chill. Makes about 10 side dish servings.

recipes.title: Pork Chop And Rice Bake
directions: Brown chops on both sides and season.
In 8 x 8 x 2-inch pan, combine soup, water and wine.
Stir in uncooked rice, mushrooms and bouillon, Worcestershire sauce, garlic and thyme.
Top with pork chops and add onion rings.
Cover and bake at 375° for 60 minutes.
recipes.text: Pork Chop And Rice Bake. Brown chops on both sides and season. In 8 x 8 x 2-inch pan, combine soup, water and wine. Stir in uncooked rice, mushrooms and bouillon, Worcestershire sauce, garlic and thyme. Top with pork chops and add onion rings. Cover and bake at 375° for 60 minutes.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Dream Bars
directions: Combine oats, flour, peanuts, soda and salt; mix well.
Add margarine.
Mix until dry ingredients are moist (reserve 1 1/2 cups crumbs).
Press mixture into bottom of greased jelly roll pan.
Bake at 375° for 12 minutes.
recipes.text: Peanut Butter Dream Bars. Combine oats, flour, peanuts, soda and salt; mix well. Add margarine. Mix until dry ingredients are moist (reserve 1 1/2 cups crumbs). Press mixture into bottom of greased jelly roll pan. Bake at 375° for 12 minutes.

recipes.title: Mom'S Peanut Butter Crisscrosses
directions: Cream together shortening, sugars, eggs and vanilla thoroughly. Stir in peanut butter. Sift dry ingredients together, then stir into creamed mixture. Drop by teaspoons on ungreased cookie sheets. Press with the back of a fork to make crisscross. Bake in oven at 350° for about 10 minutes or until lightly brown. Makes about 10 dozen cookies.
recipes.text: Mom'S Peanut Butter Crisscrosses. Cream together shortening, sugars, eggs and vanilla thoroughly. Stir in peanut butter. Sift dry ingredients together, then stir into creamed mixture. Drop by teaspoons on ungreased cookie sheets. Press with the back of a fork to make crisscross. Bake in oven at 350° for about 10 minutes or until lightly brown. Makes about 10 dozen cookies.

recipes.title: Double Chocolate Cloud Cookies
ingredients: Parchment paper to line your cookie sheets
directions: Preheat oven to 300°, place parchment paper on cookie sheets. In a mixing bowl fluff 3 egg whites, and cream of tartar.
Slowly add your sugar and then put the tsp. of vanilla extract in the mixture making sure that the vanilla is thoroughly mixed in.
Then take the 2 Tbsp. of cocoa and sprinkle it on top of the mixture. Next you fold the cocoa in and after the cocoa is evenly folded you fold in the 3/4 c. of chocolate chips.
The next step is to spoon out tablespoon size cookies on your cookie sheet.
Bake approx. 12 minutes.
This recipe makes about 24 cookies.
You can have 3 cookies for only 2 points.
Weight Watchers.
recipes.text: Double Chocolate Cloud Cookies. Preheat oven to 300°, place parchment paper on cookie sheets. In a mixing bowl fluff 3 egg whites, and cream of tartar. Slowly add your sugar and then put the tsp. of vanilla extract in the mixture making sure that the vanilla is thoroughly mixed in. Then take the 2 Tbsp. of cocoa and sprinkle it on top of the mixture. Next you fold the cocoa in and after the cocoa is evenly folded you fold in the 3/4 c. of chocolate chips. The next step is to spoon out tablespoon size cookies on your cookie sheet. Bake approx. 12 minutes. This recipe makes about 24 cookies. You can have 3 cookies for only 2 points. Weight Watchers.

recipes.title: Apple Cake
directions: Beat eggs, sugar and oil.
Add flour, soda, salt and cinnamon. Then add apples, nuts and coconut.
Bake at 375° for 25 to 35 minutes.
recipes.text: Apple Cake. Beat eggs, sugar and oil. Add flour, soda, salt and cinnamon. Then add apples, nuts and coconut. Bake at 375° for 25 to 35 minutes.

recipes.title: Pie Crust
ingredients: 2 c. shortening = 1 c. butter/1 cup crisco
directions: Beat the egg and add water to make 3/4 c. liquid, add vinegar and baking pwd. to egg mixture, stir into flour and shortening mixture.
Refrigerate for 30 min. before rolling out.
This is excellent and can be worked over and over.
Also if not all used, it can be wrapped and frozen for later use.
Enjoy.
Makes 2 double pies.
recipes.text: Pie Crust. Beat the egg and add water to make 3/4 c. liquid, add vinegar and baking pwd. to egg mixture, stir into flour and shortening mixture. Refrigerate for 30 min. before rolling out. This is excellent and can be worked over and over. Also if not all used, it can be wrapped and frozen for later use. Enjoy. Makes 2 double pies.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Balls
ingredients: 2 c. or 18 oz. crunchy peanut butter
directions: Mix ingredients well.
Roll into small balls.
Dip in 12 ounces melted chocolate chips.
Cool on wax paper.
recipes.text: Peanut Butter Balls. Mix ingredients well. Roll into small balls. Dip in 12 ounces melted chocolate chips. Cool on wax paper.

recipes.title: Salad Louise (Spinach Salad)
ingredients: 1 bag spinach, washed and torn into pieces
directions: Mix ingredients and add Sweet-Sour Dressing.
recipes.text: Salad Louise (Spinach Salad). Mix ingredients and add Sweet-Sour Dressing.

recipes.title: Chicken Parmesan With Spaghetti
ingredients: 4 skinless, boneless chicken breast halves (1 lb.)
1 tsp. dried parsley flakes (8 oz. dry)
directions: Flatten chicken to an even thickness, using palm of hand or meat mallet.
Dip chicken in egg; coat with bread crumbs.
In 10-inch skillet over medium heat, in hot margarine, cook chicken until browned on both sides.
Add spaghetti sauce.
Reduce heat to low.
Cover and simmer 10 minutes.
Sprinkle with cheeses and parsley.
Cover and simmer 5 minutes or until cheese melts.
Serve over hot spaghetti.
recipes.text: Chicken Parmesan With Spaghetti. Flatten chicken to an even thickness, using palm of hand or meat mallet. Dip chicken in egg; coat with bread crumbs. In 10-inch skillet over medium heat, in hot margarine, cook chicken until browned on both sides. Add spaghetti sauce. Reduce heat to low. Cover and simmer 10 minutes. Sprinkle with cheeses and parsley. Cover and simmer 5 minutes or until cheese melts. Serve over hot spaghetti.

recipes.title: Chunky Potato Soup
directions: Peel potatoes and cut into 1 inch cubes.
Bring water to a boil in large saucepan.
Add potatoes and cook until tender. Drain, reserving 1 cup of the liquid.
Set aside potatoes and the liquid.
recipes.text: Chunky Potato Soup. Peel potatoes and cut into 1 inch cubes. Bring water to a boil in large saucepan. Add potatoes and cook until tender. Drain, reserving 1 cup of the liquid. Set aside potatoes and the liquid.

recipes.title: Bacon And Lettuce Stuffed Tomatoes
ingredients: salt and freshly ground pepper to taste
directions: Cut the top off each tomato.
Scoop out pulp and seed.
Salt inside of each tomato.
Invert tomatoes and drain 15 minutes.
In a small bowl combine the remaining ingredients.
Fill each tomato with mixture.
recipes.text: Bacon And Lettuce Stuffed Tomatoes. Cut the top off each tomato. Scoop out pulp and seed. Salt inside of each tomato. Invert tomatoes and drain 15 minutes. In a small bowl combine the remaining ingredients. Fill each tomato with mixture.

recipes.title: Rhubarb Salad
ingredients: 1 large or 2 small boxes cherry jello
directions: Cook rhubarb and stir very well.
Add sugar, crushed pineapple, juice and nuts.
Mix well and pour into a mold or shallow pan which has been rubbed with salad dressing.
Keep in refrigerator until ready to use.
This salad will keep for several days.
recipes.text: Rhubarb Salad. Cook rhubarb and stir very well. Add sugar, crushed pineapple, juice and nuts. Mix well and pour into a mold or shallow pan which has been rubbed with salad dressing. Keep in refrigerator until ready to use. This salad will keep for several days.

recipes.title: Cauliflower Layered Salad
ingredients: 1 lb. bacon, fried, cooled and crumbled
directions: Break up lettuce and put in large bowl.
Break up cauliflower in small pieces and layer over lettuce.
Spread mayonnaise over cauliflower.
Add crumbled bacon and spread evenly over mayonnaise.
Sprinkle sugar over mixture and, lastly, sprinkle Parmesan cheese over top.
Make the day before and cover with Saran Wrap.
Refrigerate for 24 hours.
Mix completely about 1/2 hour before serving.
recipes.text: Cauliflower Layered Salad. Break up lettuce and put in large bowl. Break up cauliflower in small pieces and layer over lettuce. Spread mayonnaise over cauliflower. Add crumbled bacon and spread evenly over mayonnaise. Sprinkle sugar over mixture and, lastly, sprinkle Parmesan cheese over top. Make the day before and cover with Saran Wrap. Refrigerate for 24 hours. Mix completely about 1/2 hour before serving.

recipes.title: Russian Tea
directions: Mix all ingredients together. Store in a cool, dry place.
recipes.text: Russian Tea. Mix all ingredients together. Store in a cool, dry place.

recipes.title: Texas Panhandle Yum Yum
directions: Mix and pat into 9 x 13-inch glass loaf dish.
Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.
Cool.
recipes.text: Texas Panhandle Yum Yum. Mix and pat into 9 x 13-inch glass loaf dish. Bake at 350° for 20 minutes. Cool.

recipes.title: Hidden Valley Ranch Quiche
ingredients: 1 (8 inch) baked and cooled pie shell
1 pkg. Hidden Valley Ranch milk recipe mix (original)
directions: Preheat oven to 400°.
Sprinkle cheese in pie crust.
Whisk eggs until frothy.
Add other ingredients and mix.
Pour over cheese.
Bake at 15 minutes.
Reduce heat to 350° and bake an additional 15 to 20 minutes or until center is set.
recipes.text: Hidden Valley Ranch Quiche. Preheat oven to 400°. Sprinkle cheese in pie crust. Whisk eggs until frothy. Add other ingredients and mix. Pour over cheese. Bake at 15 minutes. Reduce heat to 350° and bake an additional 15 to 20 minutes or until center is set.

recipes.title: Oatmeal Cookies
directions: Mix together and put on cookie sheets.
Bake at 350° to 375° for 10 minutes.
Makes 4 dozen.
recipes.text: Oatmeal Cookies. Mix together and put on cookie sheets. Bake at 350° to 375° for 10 minutes. Makes 4 dozen.

recipes.title: Spam Stuffed Shells
ingredients: 1/2 (12 oz. size) pkg. jumbo pasta shells
directions: Cook pasta according to package.
Drain.
Rinse in cold water.
recipes.text: Spam Stuffed Shells. Cook pasta according to package. Drain. Rinse in cold water.

recipes.title: Chocolate-Chip Cake
directions: Heat oven to 350° (325° glass pan).
Grease 13 x 9-inch pan. In large bowl, combine first 9 ingredients.
Blend 1 minute at low speed.
Beat 3 minutes at medium speed.
Pour 1/2 the batter (2 1/2 cups) into greased pan.
recipes.text: Chocolate-Chip Cake. Heat oven to 350° (325° glass pan). Grease 13 x 9-inch pan. In large bowl, combine first 9 ingredients. Blend 1 minute at low speed. Beat 3 minutes at medium speed. Pour 1/2 the batter (2 1/2 cups) into greased pan.

recipes.title: Microwave Broccoli Chowder
directions: In 2-quart microwave bowl, combine broccoli, onion and water. Cook, covered, on High for 5 to 6 minutes or until veggies are tender.
Stir twice, breaking broccoli.
Stir in soup, milk, cheese and pepper.
Cook, uncovered, on High for 7 to 9 minutes, until well heated, stirring twice.
Top each serving with chopped peanuts.
Serves 4.
recipes.text: Microwave Broccoli Chowder. In 2-quart microwave bowl, combine broccoli, onion and water. Cook, covered, on High for 5 to 6 minutes or until veggies are tender. Stir twice, breaking broccoli. Stir in soup, milk, cheese and pepper. Cook, uncovered, on High for 7 to 9 minutes, until well heated, stirring twice. Top each serving with chopped peanuts. Serves 4.

recipes.title: Low-Fat Whipped Topping
directions: Scald the evaporated milk.
Cool slightly.
Soften gelatin in cold water.
Stir gelatin into warm milk and stir until dissolved. Pour milk into small, deep bowl.
Freeze until ice crystals form around edges and mixture is completely jellied.
Whip at high speed of mixer until peaks form.
Gradually add sugar and vanilla. Beat until stiff peaks form.
recipes.text: Low-Fat Whipped Topping. Scald the evaporated milk. Cool slightly. Soften gelatin in cold water. Stir gelatin into warm milk and stir until dissolved. Pour milk into small, deep bowl. Freeze until ice crystals form around edges and mixture is completely jellied. Whip at high speed of mixer until peaks form. Gradually add sugar and vanilla. Beat until stiff peaks form.

recipes.title: Hamburger Casserole
directions: Brown meat in butter.
Add remaining ingredients, except noodles and cheese; simmer.
recipes.text: Hamburger Casserole. Brown meat in butter. Add remaining ingredients, except noodles and cheese; simmer.

recipes.title: Mincemeat Upside-Down Cake
ingredients: 1 small box (1 layer size) yellow cake mix
directions: Melt butter in a 9-inch square pan.
Spread mincemeat and nuts over butter.
recipes.text: Mincemeat Upside-Down Cake. Melt butter in a 9-inch square pan. Spread mincemeat and nuts over butter.

recipes.title: Wild Rice Chicken Salad
ingredients: 2/3 c. wild rice, cooked in 3 c. boiling water 45 to 50 minutes, drained and cooled
directions: Combine mayonnaise, milk, lemon juice and onion.
Stir in rice, chicken and water chestnuts.
Refrigerate until cold.
Just before serving, stir in grapes and cashews.
recipes.text: Wild Rice Chicken Salad. Combine mayonnaise, milk, lemon juice and onion. Stir in rice, chicken and water chestnuts. Refrigerate until cold. Just before serving, stir in grapes and cashews.

recipes.title: Shoestring Beet Salad
directions: Drain the liquid from the beets and pineapple. Save liquid.
recipes.text: Shoestring Beet Salad. Drain the liquid from the beets and pineapple. Save liquid.

recipes.title: Casserole Italiano
directions: In skillet, brown ground beef with onion, garlic and seasonings.
Stir to separate meat.
Mix meat mixture, soup, water and noodles.
Place in 1/2-quart casserole dish.
Place cheese around edge of casserole.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Casserole Italiano. In skillet, brown ground beef with onion, garlic and seasonings. Stir to separate meat. Mix meat mixture, soup, water and noodles. Place in 1/2-quart casserole dish. Place cheese around edge of casserole. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Macaroon Pound Cake
directions: Cream sugar and margarine together and beat until fluffy.
Add eggs, one at a time, beating after each addition.
Then beat for 3 minutes.
Add flavoring and then add flour and whipping cream in thirds alternately.
Bake in a greased and floured 10-inch tube pan at 300° in a cold oven for 1 1/2 hours or until golden brown.
recipes.text: Macaroon Pound Cake. Cream sugar and margarine together and beat until fluffy. Add eggs, one at a time, beating after each addition. Then beat for 3 minutes. Add flavoring and then add flour and whipping cream in thirds alternately. Bake in a greased and floured 10-inch tube pan at 300° in a cold oven for 1 1/2 hours or until golden brown.

recipes.title: Chocolate Cake With Sprinkles
directions: You get all the dough from the box and pour it into a bowl. You get 2 eggs.
You get some milk that goes to the top of one glass.
Then you mix it and pour it into a round kind of pan. Then you put in the oven at 30°.
Two hours are good.
When it comes out, you put on sprinkles and 2 scoops of whipped cream (like a sand castle).
Then you put in about 5 candles.
Then you eat!
recipes.text: Chocolate Cake With Sprinkles. You get all the dough from the box and pour it into a bowl. You get 2 eggs. You get some milk that goes to the top of one glass. Then you mix it and pour it into a round kind of pan. Then you put in the oven at 30°. Two hours are good. When it comes out, you put on sprinkles and 2 scoops of whipped cream (like a sand castle). Then you put in about 5 candles. Then you eat!

recipes.title: Squash Casserole
directions: Salt and cook sliced squash and onions over medium heat with no water.
Mash and drain.
Add sour cream, pimentos, soup and carrots.
Melt 1 stick margarine and mix with stuffing.
Line bottom of casserole dish with stuffing.
Pour other ingredients over top.
Bake at 325° for 30 minutes.
Serves 12.
recipes.text: Squash Casserole. Salt and cook sliced squash and onions over medium heat with no water. Mash and drain. Add sour cream, pimentos, soup and carrots. Melt 1 stick margarine and mix with stuffing. Line bottom of casserole dish with stuffing. Pour other ingredients over top. Bake at 325° for 30 minutes. Serves 12.

recipes.title: Apple Marmalade
ingredients: 6 tart apples, peeled, cored and chopped
directions: Quarter unpeeled orange.
Remove seeds.
Slice orange to thick slices.
In a large kettle combine first three ingredients and 2 cups water.
Bring to a boil and simmer 10 minutes.
Add sugar and bring to a rolling boil, stirring constantly.
Continue cooking and stirring until thickened and clear.
Remove from heat and add Certo.
Skim off the foam. Pour into hot, sterile jars and seal.
recipes.text: Apple Marmalade. Quarter unpeeled orange. Remove seeds. Slice orange to thick slices. In a large kettle combine first three ingredients and 2 cups water. Bring to a boil and simmer 10 minutes. Add sugar and bring to a rolling boil, stirring constantly. Continue cooking and stirring until thickened and clear. Remove from heat and add Certo. Skim off the foam. Pour into hot, sterile jars and seal.

recipes.title: Cream Cheese Frosting
directions: Cream cheese until soft.
Add sugar, a little at a time, creaming thoroughly.
Add vanilla and mix well.
Enough for 1 loaf cake.
recipes.text: Cream Cheese Frosting. Cream cheese until soft. Add sugar, a little at a time, creaming thoroughly. Add vanilla and mix well. Enough for 1 loaf cake.

recipes.title: Snowballs
directions: Cream sugar and butter.
Add egg yolks and nuts.
Blend well. Fold in whipped egg whites and pineapple.
Spread mixture (1/2-inch thick) on alternating wafers (3 layers).
Refrigerate overnight.
Cover with whipped cream; sprinkle with coconut.
Use cupcake liners for each snowball.
recipes.text: Snowballs. Cream sugar and butter. Add egg yolks and nuts. Blend well. Fold in whipped egg whites and pineapple. Spread mixture (1/2-inch thick) on alternating wafers (3 layers). Refrigerate overnight. Cover with whipped cream; sprinkle with coconut. Use cupcake liners for each snowball.

recipes.title: Taco Casserole
ingredients: 2 c. crushed taco shells or corn chips
directions: Mix meat, onion, corn, sauce, water and seasoning; simmer for 20 minutes.
recipes.text: Taco Casserole. Mix meat, onion, corn, sauce, water and seasoning; simmer for 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Potato Casserole
ingredients: 6 medium potatoes, peeled and grated or 36 oz. shredded hash browns, thawed
directions: Melt 1/2 cup butter and saute green onions.
Add soup, salt, sour cream and cheese.
Using 3-quart Pyrex pan, layer potatoes in pan evenly.
Gently stir in sauteed mixture.
Melt 2 tablespoons butter and mix in cornflake crumbs.
Pour over top of casserole and bake at 350° for 1 hour.
Serves 8 to 10.
recipes.text: Potato Casserole. Melt 1/2 cup butter and saute green onions. Add soup, salt, sour cream and cheese. Using 3-quart Pyrex pan, layer potatoes in pan evenly. Gently stir in sauteed mixture. Melt 2 tablespoons butter and mix in cornflake crumbs. Pour over top of casserole and bake at 350° for 1 hour. Serves 8 to 10.

recipes.title: Crab Dip
directions: Heat soup and cream cheese until soup is dissolved.
Soften gelatin in cold water.
Add the gelatin mix and other ingredients to cheese mixture.
Refrigerate until hard.
recipes.text: Crab Dip. Heat soup and cream cheese until soup is dissolved. Soften gelatin in cold water. Add the gelatin mix and other ingredients to cheese mixture. Refrigerate until hard.

recipes.title: Cherry Flakes
directions: Thoroughly cream together first 4 ingredients.
Add egg and milk.
Beat well.
Add dry ingredients, mixing well.
Stir in raisins and nuts.
Drop by teaspoons onto crushed corn flakes. Toss lightly to coat.
Place on greased cookie sheet, about 2-inches apart.
Top each with maraschino cherry. Bake at 400° about 12 minutes.
Yield: About 3 dozen.
recipes.text: Cherry Flakes. Thoroughly cream together first 4 ingredients. Add egg and milk. Beat well. Add dry ingredients, mixing well. Stir in raisins and nuts. Drop by teaspoons onto crushed corn flakes. Toss lightly to coat. Place on greased cookie sheet, about 2-inches apart. Top each with maraschino cherry. Bake at 400° about 12 minutes. Yield: About 3 dozen.

recipes.title: Haystacks
directions: Melt butterscotch chips.
Add noodles and peanuts.
Drop onto wax paper by teaspoonful.
Chill.
recipes.text: Haystacks. Melt butterscotch chips. Add noodles and peanuts. Drop onto wax paper by teaspoonful. Chill.

recipes.title: Chess Bars
directions: Mix all ingredients and press in a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Bake for 30 minutes at 350°.
recipes.text: Chess Bars. Mix all ingredients and press in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake for 30 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Pecan Pie
directions: Combine dry ingredients in large mixing bowl.
Add eggs, syrup, vanilla and margarine; beat with electric mixer until blended.
Either put pecans in mixture or place on bottom of pie shell.
Pour in mixture.
Bake at 350° for 50 minutes.
Yield: One 9-inch pie.
recipes.text: Pecan Pie. Combine dry ingredients in large mixing bowl. Add eggs, syrup, vanilla and margarine; beat with electric mixer until blended. Either put pecans in mixture or place on bottom of pie shell. Pour in mixture. Bake at 350° for 50 minutes. Yield: One 9-inch pie.

recipes.title: Quick Fruit Crisps
ingredients: 2 cans fruit pie filling (can use apple, cherry or peach)
directions: Put fruit filling in ovenproof dish, about 2-inches deep. Layer cake mix lightly on top (do not sift or break up lumps). Poke with fork in several places to allow some mix into the filling. Layer again with cake mix. Drizzle melted butter over cake mix. Try not to puddle butter. You may add more cake mix and butter until desired crust thickness. Bake for 10 minutes at 400°. Broil for 2 minutes or until crust browns slightly.
recipes.text: Quick Fruit Crisps. Put fruit filling in ovenproof dish, about 2-inches deep. Layer cake mix lightly on top (do not sift or break up lumps). Poke with fork in several places to allow some mix into the filling. Layer again with cake mix. Drizzle melted butter over cake mix. Try not to puddle butter. You may add more cake mix and butter until desired crust thickness. Bake for 10 minutes at 400°. Broil for 2 minutes or until crust browns slightly.

recipes.title: Chocolate Oatmeal Cookies
directions: Cream together sugar and Crisco.
Add soda to water and gradually add all remaining ingredients.
Drop by spoonfuls on greased pan.
Bake at 350° until edges brown slightly.
recipes.text: Chocolate Oatmeal Cookies. Cream together sugar and Crisco. Add soda to water and gradually add all remaining ingredients. Drop by spoonfuls on greased pan. Bake at 350° until edges brown slightly.

recipes.title: Sausage Casserole
directions: Crumble and fry 1 pound sausage; drain.
Put in baking dish. Mix all ingredients except cheese together; top with cheese.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Sausage Casserole. Crumble and fry 1 pound sausage; drain. Put in baking dish. Mix all ingredients except cheese together; top with cheese. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Hamburger Goulash
ingredients: 1 qt. canned green beans, almost drained
1 c. rice, cooked by pkg. directions
directions: Brown hamburger in oil.
Add diced onion to saute.
Add tomatoes, green beans and basil.
Salt and pepper to taste. Simmer 15 minutes.
Serve with rice as bed for mixture.
recipes.text: Hamburger Goulash. Brown hamburger in oil. Add diced onion to saute. Add tomatoes, green beans and basil. Salt and pepper to taste. Simmer 15 minutes. Serve with rice as bed for mixture.

recipes.title: Cereal Crunchies
directions: Arrange fruit on top of any ready-to-eat cereal to represent a funny face.
(Use bananas for ears or eyes, apple or pineapple for whole face, strawberry for nose, raisins for eyes or beard, peach slice for mouth.)
Serve with milk.
recipes.text: Cereal Crunchies. Arrange fruit on top of any ready-to-eat cereal to represent a funny face. (Use bananas for ears or eyes, apple or pineapple for whole face, strawberry for nose, raisins for eyes or beard, peach slice for mouth.) Serve with milk.

recipes.title: Microwave Chocolate Peanut Clusters
directions: Place almond bark in large microwave dish.
Microwave on High about 2 minutes or until melted.
Add chocolate chips and stir until melted.
Pour in peanuts; stir until well coated.
Drop by spoonfuls onto wax paper.
Cool and store in airtight container.
recipes.text: Microwave Chocolate Peanut Clusters. Place almond bark in large microwave dish. Microwave on High about 2 minutes or until melted. Add chocolate chips and stir until melted. Pour in peanuts; stir until well coated. Drop by spoonfuls onto wax paper. Cool and store in airtight container.

recipes.title: Tang Pie
ingredients: 1 (8 oz.) pkg. of Philly cream cheese softened
2 cans of Eagle Brand sweetened condensed milk
2/3 c. of Tang powdered drink mix
directions: Hand mixed. Mix softened cream cheese until creamy. Add Eagle Brand milk slowly while mixing. Add sour cream and mix thoroughly. Add Tang and mix until completely dissolved. Mixture will be pale orange. Add lemon juice and mix until it is completely blended in with the mixture. Pour into pie shell and refrigerate for at least 6 hours. Preferably overnight so pies can set up well.
recipes.text: Tang Pie. Hand mixed. Mix softened cream cheese until creamy. Add Eagle Brand milk slowly while mixing. Add sour cream and mix thoroughly. Add Tang and mix until completely dissolved. Mixture will be pale orange. Add lemon juice and mix until it is completely blended in with the mixture. Pour into pie shell and refrigerate for at least 6 hours. Preferably overnight so pies can set up well.

recipes.title: Hush Puppies
directions: Mix dry ingredients together and set aside.
Mix milk and egg. Add chopped onion and jalapeno.
Mix with dry ingredients.
Drop by teaspoonfuls into hot oil.
Fry until golden brown.
recipes.text: Hush Puppies. Mix dry ingredients together and set aside. Mix milk and egg. Add chopped onion and jalapeno. Mix with dry ingredients. Drop by teaspoonfuls into hot oil. Fry until golden brown.

recipes.title: 4-Layer Chocolate Pie
directions: Melt the margarine in Pyrex casserole. Add the cracker crumbs. Press into crust around bottom of casserole.
Let cool.
recipes.text: 4-Layer Chocolate Pie. Melt the margarine in Pyrex casserole. Add the cracker crumbs. Press into crust around bottom of casserole. Let cool.

recipes.title: Joe Obey'S Bread
directions: Mix ingredients together and knead until firm and elastic. Let raise 10 minutes.
Punch down.
Let raise until double.
Put in bread pan and raise again.
Bake 25 to 30 minutes in 350° oven.
recipes.text: Joe Obey'S Bread. Mix ingredients together and knead until firm and elastic. Let raise 10 minutes. Punch down. Let raise until double. Put in bread pan and raise again. Bake 25 to 30 minutes in 350° oven.

recipes.title: Grandma'S Banana Cake
ingredients: 1/2 c. buttermilk or sour cream thinned with milk
directions: Cream butter; add sugar.
Add eggs one at a time.
Beat well. Add dry ingredients alternately with buttermilk.
Stir in bananas and vanilla.
Bake in greased tube pan at 350° for 1 hour or until done.
recipes.text: Grandma'S Banana Cake. Cream butter; add sugar. Add eggs one at a time. Beat well. Add dry ingredients alternately with buttermilk. Stir in bananas and vanilla. Bake in greased tube pan at 350° for 1 hour or until done.

recipes.title: Barbecue Beef On The Grill
ingredients: 4 to 6 lb. loin-eye or rib-eye beef roast
directions: Salt and pepper roast, using a liberal amount of garlic salt. Marinate in Worcestershire sauce 24 hours or more.
Use enough Worcestershire sauce to cover meat.
You may use a plastic bag to help keep sauce in contact with meat.
Cook in covered charcoal grill for 2 1/2 to 3 hours or until done.
Slice in 1/2 to 3/4 inch thick slices and serve hot.
recipes.text: Barbecue Beef On The Grill. Salt and pepper roast, using a liberal amount of garlic salt. Marinate in Worcestershire sauce 24 hours or more. Use enough Worcestershire sauce to cover meat. You may use a plastic bag to help keep sauce in contact with meat. Cook in covered charcoal grill for 2 1/2 to 3 hours or until done. Slice in 1/2 to 3/4 inch thick slices and serve hot.

recipes.title: Tortilla Chip Dip
ingredients: 1 clove garlic or some garlic powder
directions: Brown ground beef, sausage and onion.
Drain.
Mix all together in crock-pot and let simmer.
recipes.text: Tortilla Chip Dip. Brown ground beef, sausage and onion. Drain. Mix all together in crock-pot and let simmer.

recipes.title: Fruit Salad
directions: Drain all fruit juices in saucepan.
Stir in pudding.
Cook on low heat until thick.
Let cool.
When cooled, pour over fruit, then slice bananas on top and serve.
recipes.text: Fruit Salad. Drain all fruit juices in saucepan. Stir in pudding. Cook on low heat until thick. Let cool. When cooled, pour over fruit, then slice bananas on top and serve.

recipes.title: Watergate Salad
ingredients: 1 large can pineapple (crushed), juice and all
directions: Combine all ingredients together.
Chill in refrigerator for 30 minutes before serving.
recipes.text: Watergate Salad. Combine all ingredients together. Chill in refrigerator for 30 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: 7-Up Cake
ingredients: 1 Duncan Hines lemon supreme cake mix
1 small box instant vanilla pudding mix
directions: Beat all ingredients together except 7-Up.
Add it last and beat well.
Bake in greased and
floured
pan,
x
9 x 2-inch, about 40 minutes at 350°.
Remove
from oven and frost with topping on hot cake.
recipes.text: 7-Up Cake. Beat all ingredients together except 7-Up. Add it last and beat well. Bake in greased and floured pan, 13 x 9 x 2-inch, about 40 minutes at 350°. Remove from oven and frost with topping on hot cake.

recipes.title: Buttermilk Pie
directions: Combine flour and sugar and add to melted margarine.
Blend in beaten eggs, buttermilk and vanilla.
Pour into 2 unbaked pie shells.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Buttermilk Pie. Combine flour and sugar and add to melted margarine. Blend in beaten eggs, buttermilk and vanilla. Pour into 2 unbaked pie shells. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Grandma'S Goulash
directions: Brown hamburger; salt, pepper and onion to your taste.
Drain grease.
Add stewed tomatoes and tomato soup.
Simmer while macaroni cooks.
Add cooked macaroni to meat mixture and serve. Serves 4 to 6 people.
recipes.text: Grandma'S Goulash. Brown hamburger; salt, pepper and onion to your taste. Drain grease. Add stewed tomatoes and tomato soup. Simmer while macaroni cooks. Add cooked macaroni to meat mixture and serve. Serves 4 to 6 people.

recipes.title: Sour Cream Biscuits
directions: Melt margarine; add Bisquick and sour cream.
Mix well.
Drop into greased muffin tin.
Bake at 450° for 10 to 20 minutes.
recipes.text: Sour Cream Biscuits. Melt margarine; add Bisquick and sour cream. Mix well. Drop into greased muffin tin. Bake at 450° for 10 to 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Mushroom Rice(Serves 4 To 5)
directions: Saute onion in small bowl in microwave for 1 to 2 minutes at High.
Heat water about 4 minutes in microwave.
Dissolve bouillon in hot water.
Add rice and onion and mushrooms to water. Microwave at 30% for 20 to 25 minutes.
Times may vary with different microwaves.
recipes.text: Mushroom Rice(Serves 4 To 5). Saute onion in small bowl in microwave for 1 to 2 minutes at High. Heat water about 4 minutes in microwave. Dissolve bouillon in hot water. Add rice and onion and mushrooms to water. Microwave at 30% for 20 to 25 minutes. Times may vary with different microwaves.

recipes.title: Hot And Spicy Cinnamon Sauce For Apple Dumplings
directions: Mix all ingredients together in saucepan over medium heat. Bring to a boil, stirring.
Serve warm over apple dumplings.
Makes 2/3 cup, for 6 to 8 dumplings.
recipes.text: Hot And Spicy Cinnamon Sauce For Apple Dumplings. Mix all ingredients together in saucepan over medium heat. Bring to a boil, stirring. Serve warm over apple dumplings. Makes 2/3 cup, for 6 to 8 dumplings.

recipes.title: Cowboy Cookies
directions: Cream shortening, sugars, eggs and vanilla together.
Mix in the rest of the ingredients.
Drop by spoonfuls on a greased baking sheet at 350° for 10 minutes.
recipes.text: Cowboy Cookies. Cream shortening, sugars, eggs and vanilla together. Mix in the rest of the ingredients. Drop by spoonfuls on a greased baking sheet at 350° for 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Cheesy Chicken Casserole
directions: Combine all ingredients except cheese.
Bring to a boil.
Turn off stove, cover and let sit for 5 minutes.
Add 1/2 cup cheese. Place in casserole dish.
Sprinkle remaining cheese evenly over mixture.
Place in warm oven to melt cheese.
recipes.text: Cheesy Chicken Casserole. Combine all ingredients except cheese. Bring to a boil. Turn off stove, cover and let sit for 5 minutes. Add 1/2 cup cheese. Place in casserole dish. Sprinkle remaining cheese evenly over mixture. Place in warm oven to melt cheese.

recipes.title: Oatmeal Brownies
directions: In a bowl, combine the first 7 ingredients; mix well. Set aside 1 cup for topping. Pat the remaining mixture into a greased 15 x 10 x 1 baking pan. Prepare brownie batter according to package directions. Spread over the crust. Sprinkle with reserved oat mixture. Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes or until toothpick inserted near the center comes out clean. Cool on a wire rack. Cut into bars.
recipes.text: Oatmeal Brownies. In a bowl, combine the first 7 ingredients; mix well. Set aside 1 cup for topping. Pat the remaining mixture into a greased 15 x 10 x 1 baking pan. Prepare brownie batter according to package directions. Spread over the crust. Sprinkle with reserved oat mixture. Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes or until toothpick inserted near the center comes out clean. Cool on a wire rack. Cut into bars.

recipes.title: Tossed Greens With Strawberries
directions: Combine first 3 ingredients in small bowl; stir well.
recipes.text: Tossed Greens With Strawberries. Combine first 3 ingredients in small bowl; stir well.

recipes.title: Hot Pineapple Salad
directions: Drain pineapple.
Reserve liquid.
Mix sugar, flour and 1/3 cup of reserved juice.
Add cheese and pineapple and mix well. Pour in greased casserole dish.
Mix Cheez-Its with melted margarine; sprinkle on top of pineapple mixture.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Hot Pineapple Salad. Drain pineapple. Reserve liquid. Mix sugar, flour and 1/3 cup of reserved juice. Add cheese and pineapple and mix well. Pour in greased casserole dish. Mix Cheez-Its with melted margarine; sprinkle on top of pineapple mixture. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Pinto Bean - Sausage Stew
ingredients: 2 c. picante sauce (heat range your choice)
directions: Combine all ingredients in a large cooking pot.
Bring to a boil over medium heat, stirring occasionally.
Reduce heat. Cover and simmer for 45 minutes. Yields 12 cups.
Serve with additional picante sauce, if desired.
recipes.text: Pinto Bean - Sausage Stew. Combine all ingredients in a large cooking pot. Bring to a boil over medium heat, stirring occasionally. Reduce heat. Cover and simmer for 45 minutes. Yields 12 cups. Serve with additional picante sauce, if desired.

recipes.title: Spicy Pumpkin Bars
directions: Preheat oven to 350°. Beat with mixer the eggs until frothy; beat in sugar and beat for 2 minutes. Beat in the oil and pumpkin. Sift dry ingredients over the raisins and nuts and fold dry mixture into egg mixture; do not overmix. Pour into a greased 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake for 35 to 40 minutes. Cool on rack.
recipes.text: Spicy Pumpkin Bars. Preheat oven to 350°. Beat with mixer the eggs until frothy; beat in sugar and beat for 2 minutes. Beat in the oil and pumpkin. Sift dry ingredients over the raisins and nuts and fold dry mixture into egg mixture; do not overmix. Pour into a greased 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake for 35 to 40 minutes. Cool on rack.

recipes.title: Lemony Potatoes
directions: Wash potatoes and slice into wedges.
Arrange in buttered pie pan.
Combine butter, lemon juice and salt.
Heat in saucepan. Pour mixture over potatoes.
Sprinkle cheese on top.
Sprinkle paprika on top.
Bake at 400° for 40 minutes.
Garnish with parsley.
recipes.text: Lemony Potatoes. Wash potatoes and slice into wedges. Arrange in buttered pie pan. Combine butter, lemon juice and salt. Heat in saucepan. Pour mixture over potatoes. Sprinkle cheese on top. Sprinkle paprika on top. Bake at 400° for 40 minutes. Garnish with parsley.

recipes.title: Witchie Poo'S Chocolate Chip Cookies
ingredients: 1 1/2 c. (3 sticks) butter or margarine, softened
directions: Heat oven to 350°. Mix butter, sugars, vanilla and eggs in large bowl. Stir in flour, baking soda and salt. Stir in chocolate chips. Drop dough by rounded measuring tablespoonfuls about 2-inches apart onto ungreased cookie sheet. Bake 12 to 15 minutes or until light brown. Cool slightly. Remove from cookie sheet. Cool on wire rack. Makes about 3 1/2 dozen cookies.
recipes.text: Witchie Poo'S Chocolate Chip Cookies. Heat oven to 350°. Mix butter, sugars, vanilla and eggs in large bowl. Stir in flour, baking soda and salt. Stir in chocolate chips. Drop dough by rounded measuring tablespoonfuls about 2-inches apart onto ungreased cookie sheet. Bake 12 to 15 minutes or until light brown. Cool slightly. Remove from cookie sheet. Cool on wire rack. Makes about 3 1/2 dozen cookies.

recipes.title: Protein Raisin-Gem Cookies
ingredients: sugar substitute to equal 8 Tbsp. sugar
directions: Sift flour, soy flour, baking soda and salt onto wax paper. Beat diet margarine, brown sugar, sugar substitute, vanilla and egg until well blended.
Add sifted dry ingredients to margarine mixture; mix well.
Stir in raisins.
recipes.text: Protein Raisin-Gem Cookies. Sift flour, soy flour, baking soda and salt onto wax paper. Beat diet margarine, brown sugar, sugar substitute, vanilla and egg until well blended. Add sifted dry ingredients to margarine mixture; mix well. Stir in raisins.

recipes.title: Westernized Tempura
directions: Beat egg.
Add water, sugar and salt.
Combine flour and baking powder; sift into first mixture.
Fold in.
Add remaining ingredients.
Drop in hot oil by spoonfuls.
Fry until golden; turn once to brown.
recipes.text: Westernized Tempura. Beat egg. Add water, sugar and salt. Combine flour and baking powder; sift into first mixture. Fold in. Add remaining ingredients. Drop in hot oil by spoonfuls. Fry until golden; turn once to brown.

recipes.title: Old Fashioned Peanut Butter Sheet Cookies
directions: Optional:
You can add M&M's, Reese's pieces or butterscotch chips or all of these.
recipes.text: Old Fashioned Peanut Butter Sheet Cookies. Optional: You can add M&M's, Reese's pieces or butterscotch chips or all of these.

recipes.title: Egg Salad-Cheese Spread
directions: Combine first 5 ingredients in a mixing bowl; season with salt and pepper.
Mix thoroughly.
This spread can be used on your favorite bread, rolls or crackers.
recipes.text: Egg Salad-Cheese Spread. Combine first 5 ingredients in a mixing bowl; season with salt and pepper. Mix thoroughly. This spread can be used on your favorite bread, rolls or crackers.

recipes.title: Strawberry Cake
directions: Mix cream cheese, powdered sugar, milk and Cool Whip together until smooth.
Pour over cake.
Pour pie filling on top.
recipes.text: Strawberry Cake. Mix cream cheese, powdered sugar, milk and Cool Whip together until smooth. Pour over cake. Pour pie filling on top.

recipes.title: Hush Puppies
directions: Sift dry ingredients.
Add onions and mix.
Add egg and milk. Stir.
Drop from teaspoon into hot oil.
Cook until golden brown.
recipes.text: Hush Puppies. Sift dry ingredients. Add onions and mix. Add egg and milk. Stir. Drop from teaspoon into hot oil. Cook until golden brown.

recipes.title: Sugar Cake
directions: Cream together shortening, sugar and eggs.
Add baking soda to milk.
Alternate milk with dry ingredients, beginning and ending with flour.
Stir in flavorings.
Bake at 350° for 25 to 35 minutes.
recipes.text: Sugar Cake. Cream together shortening, sugar and eggs. Add baking soda to milk. Alternate milk with dry ingredients, beginning and ending with flour. Stir in flavorings. Bake at 350° for 25 to 35 minutes.

recipes.title: Date Nut Bread(Bread And Butter Sandwiches)
directions: Cut up dates and pour the boiling water over.
Add baking soda and cool for 20 minutes.
Beat in sugar, eggs and pecans.
Sift together remaining dry ingredients and add to date mixture.
Stir until just blended.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour and 20 minutes. Slice thinly and spread with butter (not margarine).
Cut into dainty little sandwiches.
recipes.text: Date Nut Bread(Bread And Butter Sandwiches). Cut up dates and pour the boiling water over. Add baking soda and cool for 20 minutes. Beat in sugar, eggs and pecans. Sift together remaining dry ingredients and add to date mixture. Stir until just blended. Bake at 350° for 1 hour and 20 minutes. Slice thinly and spread with butter (not margarine). Cut into dainty little sandwiches.

recipes.title: 6 Weeks Muffins
directions: Cream the Crisco oil, sugar and eggs.
Add the buttermilk, flour, soda and salt.
Mix ingredients together.
Add Raisin Bran last.
Fill tins 2/3 full.
Bake at 375° for 15 to 20 minutes. Will keep for 6 weeks.
recipes.text: 6 Weeks Muffins. Cream the Crisco oil, sugar and eggs. Add the buttermilk, flour, soda and salt. Mix ingredients together. Add Raisin Bran last. Fill tins 2/3 full. Bake at 375° for 15 to 20 minutes. Will keep for 6 weeks.

recipes.title: Sweet And Sour Pork
ingredients: 1 small green pepper, cut in strips
1 small red pepper, cut in strips
directions: Brown pork well in oil in skillet.
Add onion; cover and simmer 20 minutes.
Combine vinegar, cornstarch, salt, ginger and pepper.
Add jelly to mixture and pepper strips.
Place into skillet; bring to a boil, stirring.
Cover and simmer 5 minutes. Add pineapple chunks and heat.
Serve over a bed of rice.
recipes.text: Sweet And Sour Pork. Brown pork well in oil in skillet. Add onion; cover and simmer 20 minutes. Combine vinegar, cornstarch, salt, ginger and pepper. Add jelly to mixture and pepper strips. Place into skillet; bring to a boil, stirring. Cover and simmer 5 minutes. Add pineapple chunks and heat. Serve over a bed of rice.

recipes.title: Dutch Oven Dinner
directions: Cut steak into 6 individual servings.
Rub with salt and pepper.
Dredge with flour.
Pound slightly as for Swiss steak. On each piece of meat, place a small carrot, cut into quarters, slice onion and celery.
Wrap steak around vegetables.
Fasten with toothpick.
Brown on all sides in bacon fat.
Add the halved potatoes and 3/4 cup water.
Cover and when boiling, turn to simmer for 1 hour.
Remove to heated platter.
Thicken the drippings with flour blended with 2 tablespoons water.
Serve over each portion.
Serves 6.
recipes.text: Dutch Oven Dinner. Cut steak into 6 individual servings. Rub with salt and pepper. Dredge with flour. Pound slightly as for Swiss steak. On each piece of meat, place a small carrot, cut into quarters, slice onion and celery. Wrap steak around vegetables. Fasten with toothpick. Brown on all sides in bacon fat. Add the halved potatoes and 3/4 cup water. Cover and when boiling, turn to simmer for 1 hour. Remove to heated platter. Thicken the drippings with flour blended with 2 tablespoons water. Serve over each portion. Serves 6.

recipes.title: Ham And Cheese Roll-Ups
directions: In small bowl, combine Cheddar cheese, cream cheese and margarine until well blended.
Spread 1/4 of mixture on one ham slice.
Repeat with remaining mixture and ham slices.
Roll up from short sides.
Chill for several hours or wrap and freeze if desired.
To serve, slice rolls into 1/2-inch thick slices. Arrange slices on top of crackers.
If frozen, let stand at room temperature for 20 minutes before serving.
recipes.text: Ham And Cheese Roll-Ups. In small bowl, combine Cheddar cheese, cream cheese and margarine until well blended. Spread 1/4 of mixture on one ham slice. Repeat with remaining mixture and ham slices. Roll up from short sides. Chill for several hours or wrap and freeze if desired. To serve, slice rolls into 1/2-inch thick slices. Arrange slices on top of crackers. If frozen, let stand at room temperature for 20 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Baked Spaghetti
ingredients: 1/2 lb. spaghetti, cooked until just tender
directions: Brown beef in oil.
Add onions, basil, thyme and garlic.
Cook until tender.
Stir in soup, tomato paste, water, 1/4 cup cheese, salt, pepper and bay leaf.
Cook over low heat 15 minutes.
Remove bay leaf.
Combine with spaghetti.
Pour into 2-quart 12 x 8 x 2-inch baking dish.
Sprinkle with remaining cheese.
Bake at 350° for 25 minutes or until hot.
Stir before serving.
recipes.text: Baked Spaghetti. Brown beef in oil. Add onions, basil, thyme and garlic. Cook until tender. Stir in soup, tomato paste, water, 1/4 cup cheese, salt, pepper and bay leaf. Cook over low heat 15 minutes. Remove bay leaf. Combine with spaghetti. Pour into 2-quart 12 x 8 x 2-inch baking dish. Sprinkle with remaining cheese. Bake at 350° for 25 minutes or until hot. Stir before serving.

recipes.title: Picante Sauce
directions: Add all ingredients together.
recipes.text: Picante Sauce. Add all ingredients together.

recipes.title: Grandma Hills Rolls
directions: Scald milk; let cool and add yeast.
Add rest of ingredients except last flour.
Let rise for 1 hour.
Knead flour into mixture. Let rise until double in size; knead down.
Rest for 10 minutes. Shape into rolls.
Place in greased pan.
Bake at 350°. (Cloverleaf for 12 to 15 minutes and Parker House for 20 to 25 minutes.)
recipes.text: Grandma Hills Rolls. Scald milk; let cool and add yeast. Add rest of ingredients except last flour. Let rise for 1 hour. Knead flour into mixture. Let rise until double in size; knead down. Rest for 10 minutes. Shape into rolls. Place in greased pan. Bake at 350°. (Cloverleaf for 12 to 15 minutes and Parker House for 20 to 25 minutes.)

recipes.title: Egg Custard
directions: Mix eggs, flour and sugar together.
Add milk and flavoring. Pour in 9-inch unbaked pie shell and bake at 325° until firm in center, approximately 35 to 40 minutes.
recipes.text: Egg Custard. Mix eggs, flour and sugar together. Add milk and flavoring. Pour in 9-inch unbaked pie shell and bake at 325° until firm in center, approximately 35 to 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Orange Slush
directions: Mix all ingredients in a gallon milk jug.
Freeze overnight. Thaw to a slushy consistency.
Shaking the jug every 15 minutes will help.
recipes.text: Orange Slush. Mix all ingredients in a gallon milk jug. Freeze overnight. Thaw to a slushy consistency. Shaking the jug every 15 minutes will help.

recipes.title: Marshmallow Crispies
directions: Grease large saucepan with vegetable spray.
Add marshmallows and melt over low heat.
Stir in cereal.
Mix well.
Spray spoon with vegetable spray and press mixture in an 8 x 8 x 2-inch pan. Cut into 30 squares.
recipes.text: Marshmallow Crispies. Grease large saucepan with vegetable spray. Add marshmallows and melt over low heat. Stir in cereal. Mix well. Spray spoon with vegetable spray and press mixture in an 8 x 8 x 2-inch pan. Cut into 30 squares.

recipes.title: Hot And Spicy Macaroni Casserole
ingredients: 1 (7 1/2 oz.) pkg. macaroni and cheese dinner
directions: Prepare dinner as directed on package, except using 1/2 cup milk.
Saute red pepper flakes and green peppers in margarine until tender.
Add vegetables and ham to dinner.
Mix well.
Pour into 1 1/2-quart casserole.
Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes or until hot.
Makes 4 to 6 servings.
recipes.text: Hot And Spicy Macaroni Casserole. Prepare dinner as directed on package, except using 1/2 cup milk. Saute red pepper flakes and green peppers in margarine until tender. Add vegetables and ham to dinner. Mix well. Pour into 1 1/2-quart casserole. Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes or until hot. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

recipes.title: Crazy Beans
directions: Saute onion, celery, ground beef and pork sausage.
Add brown sugar, tomato soup and tomato paste to sauteed mixture.
Mix all ingredients together and bake for 1 1/2 hours at 350°.
recipes.text: Crazy Beans. Saute onion, celery, ground beef and pork sausage. Add brown sugar, tomato soup and tomato paste to sauteed mixture. Mix all ingredients together and bake for 1 1/2 hours at 350°.

recipes.title: Parmesan Potatoes
directions: Pare potatoes, cut into quarters.
Combine flour, cheese, salt and pepper in a bag.
Moisten potatoes with water and shake a few at a time in the bag, coating potatoes with the dry mixture.
Melt butter in a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Place potatoes in the pan.
Bake 1 hour at 375°.
Turn during baking.
Sprinkle with chopped parsley when browned and tender.
Serves 6 to 8.
recipes.text: Parmesan Potatoes. Pare potatoes, cut into quarters. Combine flour, cheese, salt and pepper in a bag. Moisten potatoes with water and shake a few at a time in the bag, coating potatoes with the dry mixture. Melt butter in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Place potatoes in the pan. Bake 1 hour at 375°. Turn during baking. Sprinkle with chopped parsley when browned and tender. Serves 6 to 8.

recipes.title: Spice Tea
directions: Mix together well.
To serve, put 2 tablespoons in each mug of hot water.
Stir until dissolved.
recipes.text: Spice Tea. Mix together well. To serve, put 2 tablespoons in each mug of hot water. Stir until dissolved.

recipes.title: Hot Dog Octopus
ingredients: 1 pkg. regular Oscar Meyer hot dogs
directions: Cut hot dogs in half.
Cut in half 3/4 way up hot dog.
Cut four times.
Place into pan with 1/4 full of boiling water, with strips down.
Boil 1 to 2 minutes.
Legs will curl up like an octopus.
Kids love it!
recipes.text: Hot Dog Octopus. Cut hot dogs in half. Cut in half 3/4 way up hot dog. Cut four times. Place into pan with 1/4 full of boiling water, with strips down. Boil 1 to 2 minutes. Legs will curl up like an octopus. Kids love it!

recipes.title: Six Hour Stew
ingredients: 4 ribs celery, cut in large pieces
1 large onion, cut in large pieces
4 or 5 carrots, cut in large pieces
4 or 5 potatoes, cut in large pieces
directions: Place all ingredients in a large roaster.
Cover and place in a preheated 250° oven for 6 hours.
recipes.text: Six Hour Stew. Place all ingredients in a large roaster. Cover and place in a preheated 250° oven for 6 hours.

recipes.title: Oatmeal Applesauce Cookies
directions: Preheat oven to 375°.
In large bowl, combine flour, oats, baking soda, cinnamon and cloves; set aside.
With mixer at low speed cream oil and sugar until light and fluffy; beat in egg whites and applesauce.
Stir in dry ingredients until smooth. Spray baking sheet with vegetable spray; drop dough on cookie sheet.
Bake 6 to 8 minutes or until brown.
Makes 8 servings.
recipes.text: Oatmeal Applesauce Cookies. Preheat oven to 375°. In large bowl, combine flour, oats, baking soda, cinnamon and cloves; set aside. With mixer at low speed cream oil and sugar until light and fluffy; beat in egg whites and applesauce. Stir in dry ingredients until smooth. Spray baking sheet with vegetable spray; drop dough on cookie sheet. Bake 6 to 8 minutes or until brown. Makes 8 servings.

recipes.title: Cheesy Potato Casserole
ingredients: 2 lb. pkg. Southern style hash browns
directions: Spread frozen potatoes in a buttered 13 x 9-inch pan.
Add onion (frozen works well) and mix.
Sprinkle cheese over potatoes. In separate bowl, mix chicken soup, sour cream and milk.
Spread over entire casserole.
Sprinkle corn flake crumbs over mixture, then drizzle melted butter over corn flakes.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour and 15 minutes, uncovered.
Goes very well with baked ham.
recipes.text: Cheesy Potato Casserole. Spread frozen potatoes in a buttered 13 x 9-inch pan. Add onion (frozen works well) and mix. Sprinkle cheese over potatoes. In separate bowl, mix chicken soup, sour cream and milk. Spread over entire casserole. Sprinkle corn flake crumbs over mixture, then drizzle melted butter over corn flakes. Bake at 350° for 1 hour and 15 minutes, uncovered. Goes very well with baked ham.

recipes.title: Sugar Cookies(Rolled)
directions: Cream butter and add sugar gradually.
Add eggs, milk and vanilla and cream well.
Then add flour and baking powder sifted together.
Chill for 10 minutes.
Roll and cut into desired shape. Bake at 400° until very light brown.
May be frosted with granulated sugar, if desired or just left plain.
recipes.text: Sugar Cookies(Rolled). Cream butter and add sugar gradually. Add eggs, milk and vanilla and cream well. Then add flour and baking powder sifted together. Chill for 10 minutes. Roll and cut into desired shape. Bake at 400° until very light brown. May be frosted with granulated sugar, if desired or just left plain.

recipes.title: Buckeyes(Candy)
ingredients: dipping chocolate or 1 (12 oz.) bag chocolate chips and 1/2 bar paraffin
directions: Soften margarine to room temperature.
Mix with peanut butter and add powdered sugar until well mixed and can be kneaded.
Knead until smooth and pinch small amounts off.
Roll into balls.
Set on wax paper lined cookie sheet.
Refrigerate about 1 hour.
recipes.text: Buckeyes(Candy). Soften margarine to room temperature. Mix with peanut butter and add powdered sugar until well mixed and can be kneaded. Knead until smooth and pinch small amounts off. Roll into balls. Set on wax paper lined cookie sheet. Refrigerate about 1 hour.

recipes.title: Corn Flake Cookies
directions: Combine syrup and sugar and melt.
Add peanut butter and melt it, then stir in corn flakes.
Drop by spoonfuls on waxed paper.
recipes.text: Corn Flake Cookies. Combine syrup and sugar and melt. Add peanut butter and melt it, then stir in corn flakes. Drop by spoonfuls on waxed paper.

recipes.title: Baked Chicken Pie
directions: In butter saute onions until soft, but not brown.
Add flour, salt and pepper.
Gradually stir in broth; cook until sauce starts to thicken.
Place chicken and vegetables in 2 quart casserole. Pour broth mixture over chicken and vegetables.
Top with ready mix biscuits or use a butter crust.
Bake 375° for 25 minutes or until biscuits are done.
Serves 6.
recipes.text: Baked Chicken Pie. In butter saute onions until soft, but not brown. Add flour, salt and pepper. Gradually stir in broth; cook until sauce starts to thicken. Place chicken and vegetables in 2 quart casserole. Pour broth mixture over chicken and vegetables. Top with ready mix biscuits or use a butter crust. Bake 375° for 25 minutes or until biscuits are done. Serves 6.

recipes.title: Coconut Oat Drops
directions: Beat egg, add sugar gradually, then melted shortening and vanilla.
Combine with remaining ingredients.
Drop by teaspoon onto greased cookie sheet and flatten with fork.
Bake in oven at 375° for 10 to 12 minutes.
Makes 60 cookies.
recipes.text: Coconut Oat Drops. Beat egg, add sugar gradually, then melted shortening and vanilla. Combine with remaining ingredients. Drop by teaspoon onto greased cookie sheet and flatten with fork. Bake in oven at 375° for 10 to 12 minutes. Makes 60 cookies.

recipes.title: Banana Flip
directions: Mix 7 tablespoons butter and graham cracker crumbs; put in 9 x 13-inch pan and refrigerate until firm.
recipes.text: Banana Flip. Mix 7 tablespoons butter and graham cracker crumbs; put in 9 x 13-inch pan and refrigerate until firm.

recipes.title: Mom'S Chocolate Pie
directions: Combine in a double boiler sugar, flour, salt, milk and cocoa; boil 10 minutes.
Add egg yolks and cook until mixture is thick. Remove from heat and add vanilla and margarine.
Let cool and pour in pie shells.
Spread meringue lightly on the pies or chill 2 hours and top with Cool Whip.
Makes 2 pies.
recipes.text: Mom'S Chocolate Pie. Combine in a double boiler sugar, flour, salt, milk and cocoa; boil 10 minutes. Add egg yolks and cook until mixture is thick. Remove from heat and add vanilla and margarine. Let cool and pour in pie shells. Spread meringue lightly on the pies or chill 2 hours and top with Cool Whip. Makes 2 pies.

recipes.title: Easy Chicken And Dressing
directions: Boil chicken and debone.
Add cup of water to broth.
Slice onion in broth.
Put seasoning packet from Stove Top stuffing in broth; bring to boil.
Take out a cup of the broth and add corn bread packet to your corn bread slowly.
Add sage and your chicken. Put in crock-pot until ready to serve (low heat).
recipes.text: Easy Chicken And Dressing. Boil chicken and debone. Add cup of water to broth. Slice onion in broth. Put seasoning packet from Stove Top stuffing in broth; bring to boil. Take out a cup of the broth and add corn bread packet to your corn bread slowly. Add sage and your chicken. Put in crock-pot until ready to serve (low heat).

recipes.title: Banana Fruit Loaf
directions: Beat eggs, bananas, vanilla, spices and honey together.
Stir together the flour, baking powder, soda and salt.
Add flour mixture to banana mixture; beat until smooth.
Fold in raisins and apples.
Spoon into a nonstick pan sprayed with cooking spray. Bake at 375° for 40 to 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Banana Fruit Loaf. Beat eggs, bananas, vanilla, spices and honey together. Stir together the flour, baking powder, soda and salt. Add flour mixture to banana mixture; beat until smooth. Fold in raisins and apples. Spoon into a nonstick pan sprayed with cooking spray. Bake at 375° for 40 to 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Spaghetti Pie
ingredients: 1/2 c. grated Swiss, Mozzarella or Cheddar cheese
directions: Cook spaghetti and mix with eggs, margarine and Parmesan cheese.
Shape into crust in buttered pan.
Cook ground beef and onion.
Add tomato, garlic and sugar.
Cook 20 minutes.
Spread cottage cheese over spaghetti, then top with meat and grated cheese.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
Makes 9 x 9-inch pan.
recipes.text: Spaghetti Pie. Cook spaghetti and mix with eggs, margarine and Parmesan cheese. Shape into crust in buttered pan. Cook ground beef and onion. Add tomato, garlic and sugar. Cook 20 minutes. Spread cottage cheese over spaghetti, then top with meat and grated cheese. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes. Makes 9 x 9-inch pan.

recipes.title: Breakfast Casserole
directions: Trim crusts from bread.
Crumble bread.
Mix cheese and bread, and spread in bottom of greased 7 1/2 x 12-inch baking dish.
Beat eggs and milk together and stir in seasonings.
Pour this over bread and cheese mixture.
Lay bacon on top.
Refrigerate overnight.
Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 50 to 55 minutes.
Remove from oven just after guests sit down, otherwise it may tend to fall.
recipes.text: Breakfast Casserole. Trim crusts from bread. Crumble bread. Mix cheese and bread, and spread in bottom of greased 7 1/2 x 12-inch baking dish. Beat eggs and milk together and stir in seasonings. Pour this over bread and cheese mixture. Lay bacon on top. Refrigerate overnight. Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 50 to 55 minutes. Remove from oven just after guests sit down, otherwise it may tend to fall.

recipes.title: Vegetable Squares
directions: Mix cheese, mayonnaise and dill weed.
Spread on baked crust while still warm; sprinkle with vegetables.
Pat slightly. Refrigerate 2 to 3 hours.
Cut into squares, tiny pieces or flowerets.
recipes.text: Vegetable Squares. Mix cheese, mayonnaise and dill weed. Spread on baked crust while still warm; sprinkle with vegetables. Pat slightly. Refrigerate 2 to 3 hours. Cut into squares, tiny pieces or flowerets.

recipes.title: Spinach Dip
ingredients: 1 c. chopped frozen spinach, thawed and drained
directions: Mix above ingredients together and serve inside a hollow loaf of French or sourdough bread.
recipes.text: Spinach Dip. Mix above ingredients together and serve inside a hollow loaf of French or sourdough bread.

recipes.title: Breakfast Pizza
directions: Cook and drain sausage; set aside.
Separate dough and make pizza on greased 12-inch pan.
Press and seal.
Bake at 375° for 5 minutes.
Reduce temperature to 350°.
Spoon sausage over dough and sprinkle with cheeses.
Combine eggs, milk, oregano, and peppers and pour over sausage.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes. Makes 6 to 8 servings.
recipes.text: Breakfast Pizza. Cook and drain sausage; set aside. Separate dough and make pizza on greased 12-inch pan. Press and seal. Bake at 375° for 5 minutes. Reduce temperature to 350°. Spoon sausage over dough and sprinkle with cheeses. Combine eggs, milk, oregano, and peppers and pour over sausage. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

recipes.title: Chicken Breasts With Artichokes And Peas
ingredients: 3 whole chicken breasts, skinned, boned and cut into strips
9 oz. pkg. frozen artichoke hearts, thawed
directions: Coat chicken strips with flour, salt and pepper mixture.
In a large skillet over medium-high heat, add oil and cook chicken until lightly browned.
Add broth, wine, artichoke hearts and ham; heat to boiling.
Reduce heat to low; cover and simmer for 5 minutes.
Stir in peas.
Cook for 5 minutes more or until chicken is tender.
Sprinkle with parsley.
Makes 4 servings.
Serve with rice.
recipes.text: Chicken Breasts With Artichokes And Peas. Coat chicken strips with flour, salt and pepper mixture. In a large skillet over medium-high heat, add oil and cook chicken until lightly browned. Add broth, wine, artichoke hearts and ham; heat to boiling. Reduce heat to low; cover and simmer for 5 minutes. Stir in peas. Cook for 5 minutes more or until chicken is tender. Sprinkle with parsley. Makes 4 servings. Serve with rice.

recipes.title: Fresh Apple Pie
ingredients: 2 lb. Winesap or Jonathan cooking apples
directions: Mix flour, sugar and cinnamon.
Set aside.
Core and slice apples.
Layer apples in bottom of pie crust.
Sprinkle with flour mixture.
Repeat, ending with flour mixture.
Dot with butter. Cover with top crust and perforate.
Bake 10 minutes at 450°. Reduce heat to 350° and bake 30 to 35 minutes.
recipes.text: Fresh Apple Pie. Mix flour, sugar and cinnamon. Set aside. Core and slice apples. Layer apples in bottom of pie crust. Sprinkle with flour mixture. Repeat, ending with flour mixture. Dot with butter. Cover with top crust and perforate. Bake 10 minutes at 450°. Reduce heat to 350° and bake 30 to 35 minutes.

recipes.title: Southwestern Lasagna
directions: In a large skillet, heat oil over medium to high heat.
Add onion and saute until translucent.
Add turkey and cook until no longer pink.
Drain off any liquid, add chili powder and cumin. Mix well and add spaghetti sauce.
Simmer for 10 to 15 minutes. Meanwhile, cook lasagna noodles, following package directions. Drain and reserve.
Spread 1/3 cup meat sauce in the bottom of a deep 4 x 9 inch baking dish.
Place 2 noodles on top of sauce, overlapping slightly.
Spread noodles with half the sour cream; then sprinkle with 1/3 of the cheese. Repeat layers once more, topping with the chilies.
Layer with noodles.
Spoon remainder of sauce over noodles, and top with cheese.
Cover and bake in a preheated 350 degree oven for 25 to 30 minutes.
Uncover and bake 10 to 15 minutes longer.
Serve hot.
Serves 4.
recipes.text: Southwestern Lasagna. In a large skillet, heat oil over medium to high heat. Add onion and saute until translucent. Add turkey and cook until no longer pink. Drain off any liquid, add chili powder and cumin. Mix well and add spaghetti sauce. Simmer for 10 to 15 minutes. Meanwhile, cook lasagna noodles, following package directions. Drain and reserve. Spread 1/3 cup meat sauce in the bottom of a deep 4 x 9 inch baking dish. Place 2 noodles on top of sauce, overlapping slightly. Spread noodles with half the sour cream; then sprinkle with 1/3 of the cheese. Repeat layers once more, topping with the chilies. Layer with noodles. Spoon remainder of sauce over noodles, and top with cheese. Cover and bake in a preheated 350 degree oven for 25 to 30 minutes. Uncover and bake 10 to 15 minutes longer. Serve hot. Serves 4.

recipes.title: Pork Chop Casserole
ingredients: uncooked rice (1/2 to 1 c. for 4 chops)
directions: Place a layer of
pork	chops
in ovenproof dish.
(May brown pork chops, if
desired.) Salt and pepper chops.
Sprinkle uncooked rice on top of chops.
Pour chicken rice soup on top. Bake in a 350° oven for 45 minutes or until done.
recipes.text: Pork Chop Casserole. Place a layer of pork	chops in ovenproof dish. (May brown pork chops, if desired.) Salt and pepper chops. Sprinkle uncooked rice on top of chops. Pour chicken rice soup on top. Bake in a 350° oven for 45 minutes or until done.

recipes.title: Cheesy-Potatoes
directions: Mix all ingredients except the corn flakes and butter in a large bowl. Grease a large casserole dish; add mixture.
Add the corn flakes and melted butter; mix, then add to the top of mixture. Bake at 375° for 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Cheesy-Potatoes. Mix all ingredients except the corn flakes and butter in a large bowl. Grease a large casserole dish; add mixture. Add the corn flakes and melted butter; mix, then add to the top of mixture. Bake at 375° for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Wrapped Water Chestnuts
ingredients: 1 lb. bacon, cut strips in half
directions: Wrap bacon around water chestnuts and secure with toothpicks. Bake at 350° for 1/2 hour; drain.
Mix ketchup and brown sugar. Pour over water chestnuts and bake another 1/2 hour or less.
recipes.text: Wrapped Water Chestnuts. Wrap bacon around water chestnuts and secure with toothpicks. Bake at 350° for 1/2 hour; drain. Mix ketchup and brown sugar. Pour over water chestnuts and bake another 1/2 hour or less.

recipes.title: Spinach Appetizer Pinwheels
ingredients: 1 (10 oz.) pkg. frozen chopped spinach, thawed and drained
1 (8 oz.) can refrigerated crescent dinner rolls (use 2 cans)
directions: Combine spinach, cream cheese, Parmesan cheese, pimento and nutmeg, mixing until well blended.
Unroll dough; separate into 4 rectangles.
Firmly press perforations together to seal.
Spread with spinach mixture.
Roll up, starting at short end.
Cut each roll into 8 slices.
Place cut side down on ungreased cookie sheet.
Bake at 375° for 10 to 12 minutes or until golden brown. Makes 32 appetizers.
recipes.text: Spinach Appetizer Pinwheels. Combine spinach, cream cheese, Parmesan cheese, pimento and nutmeg, mixing until well blended. Unroll dough; separate into 4 rectangles. Firmly press perforations together to seal. Spread with spinach mixture. Roll up, starting at short end. Cut each roll into 8 slices. Place cut side down on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 375° for 10 to 12 minutes or until golden brown. Makes 32 appetizers.

recipes.title: Refrigerator Pickles
directions: Slice cucumbers.
Add onion and green pepper.
Let stand for 1 hour in water to cover to which the salt has been added.
After 1 hour, drain and add the remaining ingredients.
recipes.text: Refrigerator Pickles. Slice cucumbers. Add onion and green pepper. Let stand for 1 hour in water to cover to which the salt has been added. After 1 hour, drain and add the remaining ingredients.

recipes.title: Casserole Date Cookies
directions: Beat eggs well; add sugar gradually and beat until fluffy. Stir remaining ingredients in; turn into ungreased 2-quart casserole.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
Remove from oven and stir well with wooden spoon while hot.
Cool; form into small balls.
Roll in granulated sugar.
recipes.text: Casserole Date Cookies. Beat eggs well; add sugar gradually and beat until fluffy. Stir remaining ingredients in; turn into ungreased 2-quart casserole. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes. Remove from oven and stir well with wooden spoon while hot. Cool; form into small balls. Roll in granulated sugar.

recipes.title: White Chocolate Fudge
ingredients: 12 oz. vanilla flavored candy coating, melted or vanilla chips
directions: Beat cream cheese (medium speed) until smooth.
Gradually add sugar and vanilla, beating well.
Stir in candy coating and pecans.
Spread into a buttered 8-inch square pan.
Refrigerate until firm.
Cut into small squares.
Makes 2 pounds.
recipes.text: White Chocolate Fudge. Beat cream cheese (medium speed) until smooth. Gradually add sugar and vanilla, beating well. Stir in candy coating and pecans. Spread into a buttered 8-inch square pan. Refrigerate until firm. Cut into small squares. Makes 2 pounds.

recipes.title: Self-Filled Cupcakes
directions: Prepare cake mix according to package directions.
Fill cupcake papers 1/2 full; set aside.
In separate bowl, mix the cream cheese, sugar, egg, salt and chocolate chips.
Beat this mixture and put 1 teaspoon on top of uncooked cake batter.
Bake at 350° until done.
Top with cream cheese icing, if desired.
recipes.text: Self-Filled Cupcakes. Prepare cake mix according to package directions. Fill cupcake papers 1/2 full; set aside. In separate bowl, mix the cream cheese, sugar, egg, salt and chocolate chips. Beat this mixture and put 1 teaspoon on top of uncooked cake batter. Bake at 350° until done. Top with cream cheese icing, if desired.

recipes.title: Chili
directions: Fry hamburger, onions and garlic in skillet.
Make a gravy of flour, ground chili and water.
Pour this over the cooked meat and add remaining ingredients.
Cook slowly for 1 hour.
Very hot.
