recipes.text: Chili. Fry hamburger, onions and garlic in skillet. Make a gravy of flour, ground chili and water. Pour this over the cooked meat and add remaining ingredients. Cook slowly for 1 hour. Very hot.

recipes.title: Cheese Balls
ingredients: 1 heaping c. grated cheese (Swiss or Cheddar)
directions: With your fingers, mix cheese, flour, butter and just enough water to make a stiff dough.
Roll dough into small (3/4 inch) balls.
Place on greased cookie sheet and bake at 400° until lightly brown (about 15 minutes).
recipes.text: Cheese Balls. With your fingers, mix cheese, flour, butter and just enough water to make a stiff dough. Roll dough into small (3/4 inch) balls. Place on greased cookie sheet and bake at 400° until lightly brown (about 15 minutes).

recipes.title: Old Fashion Rolls
directions: Combine 2 1/2 cups flour and yeast.
Heat milk, sugar, Crisco and salt until warm (115° to 120°).
Stir until Crisco melts; add dry mixture.
Add eggs.
Beat with mixer at low speed for 1/2 minute.
By hand stir in enough remaining flour to make moderately stiff dough.
Shape in ball.
Place in a greased bowl.
Let rise in a warm place until double, about 1 1/4 hours.
Punch down and shape into ball.
Let rise 45 minutes.
Brush with melted Crisco. Bake in a 400° oven for 10 to 12 minutes.
recipes.text: Old Fashion Rolls. Combine 2 1/2 cups flour and yeast. Heat milk, sugar, Crisco and salt until warm (115° to 120°). Stir until Crisco melts; add dry mixture. Add eggs. Beat with mixer at low speed for 1/2 minute. By hand stir in enough remaining flour to make moderately stiff dough. Shape in ball. Place in a greased bowl. Let rise in a warm place until double, about 1 1/4 hours. Punch down and shape into ball. Let rise 45 minutes. Brush with melted Crisco. Bake in a 400° oven for 10 to 12 minutes.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Pie
ingredients: 1 (16 oz.) can Betty Crocker Creamy Deluxe milk chocolate frosting
directions: Mix first 5 ingredients together, saving enough Cool Whip to put on top of each pie.
Pour into pie crusts.
Spread each pie with 1/2 can of frosting and top with remaining Cool Whip. Refrigerate.
Enjoy!!
recipes.text: Peanut Butter Pie. Mix first 5 ingredients together, saving enough Cool Whip to put on top of each pie. Pour into pie crusts. Spread each pie with 1/2 can of frosting and top with remaining Cool Whip. Refrigerate. Enjoy!!

recipes.title: Hot Fruit Crock-Pot Punch
directions: Heat in crock-pot until hot and steamy.
Makes the house smell great.
recipes.text: Hot Fruit Crock-Pot Punch. Heat in crock-pot until hot and steamy. Makes the house smell great.

recipes.title: Sweet Potato Pie
ingredients: 1 1/2 c. boiled, peeled and beaten sweet potatoes
directions: Blend sugar, spices and salt together.
Beat eggs with milk and combine with sugar mixture.
Add this mixture to beaten sweet potatoes and heat in medium saucepan until almost boiling.
Remove from heat and pour into unbaked pie shell.
Bake at 425° for 15 minutes.
Reduce heat to 350° and continue to bake until knife inserted in center comes out clean.
Serve with whipped cream or Cool Whip.
Makes 8 servings.
recipes.text: Sweet Potato Pie. Blend sugar, spices and salt together. Beat eggs with milk and combine with sugar mixture. Add this mixture to beaten sweet potatoes and heat in medium saucepan until almost boiling. Remove from heat and pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake at 425° for 15 minutes. Reduce heat to 350° and continue to bake until knife inserted in center comes out clean. Serve with whipped cream or Cool Whip. Makes 8 servings.

recipes.title: Frozen Banana Mousse
directions: Peel and place bananas in heavy plastic bag.
Freeze at least 6 hours.
Remove from freezer and cut each into 5 or 6 pieces.
In the work bowl of a food processor fitted with a metal blade, process banana pieces and remaining ingredients, scraping sides until smooth and creamy.
recipes.text: Frozen Banana Mousse. Peel and place bananas in heavy plastic bag. Freeze at least 6 hours. Remove from freezer and cut each into 5 or 6 pieces. In the work bowl of a food processor fitted with a metal blade, process banana pieces and remaining ingredients, scraping sides until smooth and creamy.

recipes.title: Creamy Lemon Cheese Cake
directions: Measure 1 cup dry cake mix, set aside.
Combine remaining cake mix with 1 egg and 1/3 cup oil.
Press in a greased 13 x 9-inch pan; bake at 350° for 10 minutes.
Combine reserved mix, 2 eggs, sugar, cream cheese and sour cream.
Beat at low speed for 2 minutes.
Spread over crust.
Bake at 350° about 35 minutes longer.
Cool.
recipes.text: Creamy Lemon Cheese Cake. Measure 1 cup dry cake mix, set aside. Combine remaining cake mix with 1 egg and 1/3 cup oil. Press in a greased 13 x 9-inch pan; bake at 350° for 10 minutes. Combine reserved mix, 2 eggs, sugar, cream cheese and sour cream. Beat at low speed for 2 minutes. Spread over crust. Bake at 350° about 35 minutes longer. Cool.

recipes.title: Chicken Tortilla Casserole
ingredients: 10 flour tortillas (cut tortillas into 8 wedges), or corn tortillas may be used
directions: Cook
chicken; debone and cut in pieces.
Combine soup, milk, onion and green chilies along with chicken broth and mix well. Grease casserole and add in layers:
liquid first, then chicken, cheese
and
tortilla wedges, ending with liquid and cheese
on top.
Use
2-quart
casserole.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Chicken Tortilla Casserole. Cook chicken; debone and cut in pieces. Combine soup, milk, onion and green chilies along with chicken broth and mix well. Grease casserole and add in layers: liquid first, then chicken, cheese and tortilla wedges, ending with liquid and cheese on top. Use 2-quart casserole. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Quick Cinnamon Rolls
directions: Take biscuits and roll each between hands until forms a long piece of dough.
Take fork and stir each piece of dough in butter and then in cinnamon and sugar mixture until completely covered and then tie each in a knot.
Place in baking dish and bake 8 minutes at 400°.
recipes.text: Quick Cinnamon Rolls. Take biscuits and roll each between hands until forms a long piece of dough. Take fork and stir each piece of dough in butter and then in cinnamon and sugar mixture until completely covered and then tie each in a knot. Place in baking dish and bake 8 minutes at 400°.

recipes.title: Dinette Cake
directions: Heat oven to 350°.
Grease and flour square pan.
Measure all ingredients into large mixer bowl.
Blend 1/2 minute on low speed, scraping bowl constantly.
Beat 3 minutes on high speed, scraping bowl occasionally.
Pour into pan.
Bake 35 to 40 minutes.
Cool.
recipes.text: Dinette Cake. Heat oven to 350°. Grease and flour square pan. Measure all ingredients into large mixer bowl. Blend 1/2 minute on low speed, scraping bowl constantly. Beat 3 minutes on high speed, scraping bowl occasionally. Pour into pan. Bake 35 to 40 minutes. Cool.

recipes.title: Chocolate Pudding Sandwiches(Makes 22 Sandwiches)
ingredients: 1 (4 serving size) pkg. chocolate sugar-free instant pudding
1 (9 oz.) pkg. chocolate wafer cookies (44 cookies)
directions: Pour milk into large bowl.
Add pudding mix; beat with wire whisk until well blended.
Gently stir in Cool Whip and marshmallows.
recipes.text: Chocolate Pudding Sandwiches(Makes 22 Sandwiches). Pour milk into large bowl. Add pudding mix; beat with wire whisk until well blended. Gently stir in Cool Whip and marshmallows.

recipes.title: Banana Nut Bread
directions: Mix well together and put into a greased loaf pan; bake at 300° until brown.
recipes.text: Banana Nut Bread. Mix well together and put into a greased loaf pan; bake at 300° until brown.

recipes.title: Turtle Cake
directions: Mix cake as directed.
Grease or spray Pam on a 9 x 13-inch pan (or two 8 x 8-inch pans).
Pour half of batter into pans. Bake at 350° for 15 minutes. Meanwhile, melt butter, milk and caramels together.
Remove cake from oven.
Pour caramel mix over cake.
Sprinkle with chips and nuts.
Pour other half of cake batter on top.
Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.
When cool, may dust cake with confectioners sugar or each piece with a dollop of Cool Whip.
recipes.text: Turtle Cake. Mix cake as directed. Grease or spray Pam on a 9 x 13-inch pan (or two 8 x 8-inch pans). Pour half of batter into pans. Bake at 350° for 15 minutes. Meanwhile, melt butter, milk and caramels together. Remove cake from oven. Pour caramel mix over cake. Sprinkle with chips and nuts. Pour other half of cake batter on top. Bake at 350° for 20 minutes. When cool, may dust cake with confectioners sugar or each piece with a dollop of Cool Whip.

recipes.title: Banana Split Ice Cream
directions: For a smoother ice cream, separate the eggs and beat the whites until stiff before adding to the mix.
Mix sugar, eggs, milk and ice cream mix.
Add other ingredients. Stir well.
Pour in freezer. Add milk to freezing line.
recipes.text: Banana Split Ice Cream. For a smoother ice cream, separate the eggs and beat the whites until stiff before adding to the mix. Mix sugar, eggs, milk and ice cream mix. Add other ingredients. Stir well. Pour in freezer. Add milk to freezing line.

recipes.title: Lemon Delight
directions: Mix together flour, margarine and walnuts.
Put on bottom of 7 x 11-inch pan.
Next, in separate bowl, beat together cream cheese, confectioners sugar and Cool Whip.
Spread over crust. Lastly, mix lemon instant pudding with milk.
Pour on top of second layer.
Chill and top with Cool Whip and chopped walnuts. Serve.
recipes.text: Lemon Delight. Mix together flour, margarine and walnuts. Put on bottom of 7 x 11-inch pan. Next, in separate bowl, beat together cream cheese, confectioners sugar and Cool Whip. Spread over crust. Lastly, mix lemon instant pudding with milk. Pour on top of second layer. Chill and top with Cool Whip and chopped walnuts. Serve.

recipes.title: Special K Bars
directions: Combine sugar and syrup in saucepan and bring to a complete boil. Turn off heat and stir in cereal and peanut butter until well combined. Turn out into a bowl. Form into balls immediately. May also be dropped by spoonfuls onto wax paper or pressed lightly into a greased 8 x 8-inch pan. Let cool and cut into squares.
recipes.text: Special K Bars. Combine sugar and syrup in saucepan and bring to a complete boil. Turn off heat and stir in cereal and peanut butter until well combined. Turn out into a bowl. Form into balls immediately. May also be dropped by spoonfuls onto wax paper or pressed lightly into a greased 8 x 8-inch pan. Let cool and cut into squares.

recipes.title: Cinnamon Rolls
directions: Dissolve yeast in warm water.
Add about one tablespoon sugar. Set aside.
In large bowl, put milk, sugar, salt, egg and shortening (stir well).
Add flour.
Knead dough about 5 minutes. Let rise 1 hour.
recipes.text: Cinnamon Rolls. Dissolve yeast in warm water. Add about one tablespoon sugar. Set aside. In large bowl, put milk, sugar, salt, egg and shortening (stir well). Add flour. Knead dough about 5 minutes. Let rise 1 hour.

recipes.title: Sour Cream Coffee Cake
directions: Cream 1 cup sugar and margarine.
Add eggs.
Add sour cream and vanilla to dry ingredients; add to creamed mixture.
Combine remaining sugar and nuts.
Put half of batter in well-greased tube pan.
Pour in half of sugar-nut mixture.
Add remaining batter and remaining topping.
Bake at 375° for 45 minutes in a 10-inch tube pan.
Invert on plate when cool.
recipes.text: Sour Cream Coffee Cake. Cream 1 cup sugar and margarine. Add eggs. Add sour cream and vanilla to dry ingredients; add to creamed mixture. Combine remaining sugar and nuts. Put half of batter in well-greased tube pan. Pour in half of sugar-nut mixture. Add remaining batter and remaining topping. Bake at 375° for 45 minutes in a 10-inch tube pan. Invert on plate when cool.

recipes.title: Virginia Pound Cake
directions: Cream butter and sugar together.
Add 3 eggs.
Sift baking powder and flour together and add to egg and sugar mixture alternately with milk.
Add vanilla.
Add the remaining egg.
Beat into the batter just a little to mix.
Pour mixture into pan and set in refrigerator for 1 hour.
Place in cold oven and set temperature to 275°.
Bake for 1 hour.
Turn temperature up to 300°; bake 40 minutes.
recipes.text: Virginia Pound Cake. Cream butter and sugar together. Add 3 eggs. Sift baking powder and flour together and add to egg and sugar mixture alternately with milk. Add vanilla. Add the remaining egg. Beat into the batter just a little to mix. Pour mixture into pan and set in refrigerator for 1 hour. Place in cold oven and set temperature to 275°. Bake for 1 hour. Turn temperature up to 300°; bake 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Spiced Tea
directions: Boil water, sugar, orange juice and lemon juice.
Add tea bags; steep for several minutes.
Add pineapple juice.
Serves 10 to 12.
recipes.text: Spiced Tea. Boil water, sugar, orange juice and lemon juice. Add tea bags; steep for several minutes. Add pineapple juice. Serves 10 to 12.

recipes.title: Jigglers
directions: Stir boiling water into gelatin.
Dissolve completely.
Pour mixture slowly into 13 x 9-inch pan.
Chill at least 3 hours.
Cut in any shape.
Use any flavors.
It is a wonderful healthy snack.
recipes.text: Jigglers. Stir boiling water into gelatin. Dissolve completely. Pour mixture slowly into 13 x 9-inch pan. Chill at least 3 hours. Cut in any shape. Use any flavors. It is a wonderful healthy snack.

recipes.title: Monkey Bread
directions: Mix 1 cup sugar and 1 teaspoon cinnamon; roll biscuit quarters in the mixture.
Place in buttered pan.
Mix 1 cup brown sugar and 1 stick melted butter.
Pour over biscuits.
Bake at 350° until brown.
recipes.text: Monkey Bread. Mix 1 cup sugar and 1 teaspoon cinnamon; roll biscuit quarters in the mixture. Place in buttered pan. Mix 1 cup brown sugar and 1 stick melted butter. Pour over biscuits. Bake at 350° until brown.

recipes.title: Bird'S Nest
directions: Bring peanut butter, brown sugar and vanilla to a boil.
Stir into cereal and coconut.
Let cool.
Shape into bird's nests and fill with jelly bean eggs.
recipes.text: Bird'S Nest. Bring peanut butter, brown sugar and vanilla to a boil. Stir into cereal and coconut. Let cool. Shape into bird's nests and fill with jelly bean eggs.

recipes.title: Cornbread Dressing
ingredients: 1 qt. loaf bread (don't use brown edges)
directions: Mix all dry ingredients together.
Put aside.
Mix broth and soup.
Bring to a boil.
Pour over dry ingredients.
Add eggs last.
Mix well with a potato masher.
Add finely chopped onions. Microwave at Medium-high for 13 to 15 minutes.
Cover with Saran Wrap.
recipes.text: Cornbread Dressing. Mix all dry ingredients together. Put aside. Mix broth and soup. Bring to a boil. Pour over dry ingredients. Add eggs last. Mix well with a potato masher. Add finely chopped onions. Microwave at Medium-high for 13 to 15 minutes. Cover with Saran Wrap.

recipes.title: Artichoke Dip
directions: Mash and mix.
Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.
recipes.text: Artichoke Dip. Mash and mix. Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Chicken Cabbage Salad
ingredients: 1 whole chicken breast, boiled, skinned and cut into pieces
directions: Toss chicken, cabbage, onions, sesame seed, almonds and noodles.
Heat sugar, oil, salt, Accent, pepper and vinegar until just boiling.
Pour over salad mixture and refrigerate overnight.
recipes.text: Chicken Cabbage Salad. Toss chicken, cabbage, onions, sesame seed, almonds and noodles. Heat sugar, oil, salt, Accent, pepper and vinegar until just boiling. Pour over salad mixture and refrigerate overnight.

recipes.title: Barbecue Bean Salad
ingredients: 1 lb. can cut green beans (No. 2 can)
1 lb. can cut red kidney beans
directions: Drain the first 4 ingredients well. Add the celery, green peppers and onions.
recipes.text: Barbecue Bean Salad. Drain the first 4 ingredients well. Add the celery, green peppers and onions.

recipes.title: No Bake Cookies
directions: Cook first five ingredients for 3 to 4 minutes.
Add remaining ingredients and spoon onto waxed paper.
Let harden and cool.
recipes.text: No Bake Cookies. Cook first five ingredients for 3 to 4 minutes. Add remaining ingredients and spoon onto waxed paper. Let harden and cool.

recipes.title: Crab Spread
directions: Blend softened cream cheese.
Sprinkle Worcestershire sauce over the cream cheese.
Pull the mock crab legs in small pieces and add to cheese mixture.
Cut up diced purple onion into cream cheese mixture.
Mix well.
Make into a ball.
Pour cocktail sauce over the ball when ready to serve.
recipes.text: Crab Spread. Blend softened cream cheese. Sprinkle Worcestershire sauce over the cream cheese. Pull the mock crab legs in small pieces and add to cheese mixture. Cut up diced purple onion into cream cheese mixture. Mix well. Make into a ball. Pour cocktail sauce over the ball when ready to serve.

recipes.title: Blue Cheese Mousse
directions: Mix all ingredients together; refrigerate until use.
Use as a dip, on crackers, or my favorite, as a steak sauce.
recipes.text: Blue Cheese Mousse. Mix all ingredients together; refrigerate until use. Use as a dip, on crackers, or my favorite, as a steak sauce.

recipes.title: Bavarian Brownies
ingredients: 1 pkg. pudding included German cake mix
directions: Heat oven to 350°.
Grease and flour 9 x 13-inch pan.
In large bowl, combine cake mix, milk, butter and egg.
Stir in chocolate chips and nuts.
Batter is quite thick.
Spread in prepared pan.
Bake for 20 to 30 minutes.
Frost if desired.
recipes.text: Bavarian Brownies. Heat oven to 350°. Grease and flour 9 x 13-inch pan. In large bowl, combine cake mix, milk, butter and egg. Stir in chocolate chips and nuts. Batter is quite thick. Spread in prepared pan. Bake for 20 to 30 minutes. Frost if desired.

recipes.title: Pie Crust(Makes Enough For 5 Or 6 Crusts)
directions: Blend flour, baking powder, salt, and Crisco.
Beat egg and vinegar and add enough water to make 1 cup.
Mix together all ingredients.
Make into 5 or 6 balls and freeze until ready to use.
recipes.text: Pie Crust(Makes Enough For 5 Or 6 Crusts). Blend flour, baking powder, salt, and Crisco. Beat egg and vinegar and add enough water to make 1 cup. Mix together all ingredients. Make into 5 or 6 balls and freeze until ready to use.

recipes.title: Incredible Cake
directions: Mix together brown sugar and cocoa; add water and marshmallows. Spread in 9 x 13-inch ungreased pan (at this point it looks awful). Make cake mix according to directions on the box; pour evenly over mixture in pan.
(Be sure and pour as evenly as possible because you can't spread it at all after it is poured.)
Spread nuts over cake mix and bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes.
Cool.
Cut into squares; remove from pan with a spatula and turn so that pudding is on top.
recipes.text: Incredible Cake. Mix together brown sugar and cocoa; add water and marshmallows. Spread in 9 x 13-inch ungreased pan (at this point it looks awful). Make cake mix according to directions on the box; pour evenly over mixture in pan. (Be sure and pour as evenly as possible because you can't spread it at all after it is poured.) Spread nuts over cake mix and bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes. Cool. Cut into squares; remove from pan with a spatula and turn so that pudding is on top.

recipes.title: Old-Fashioned Egg Custard Pie
directions: Cream butter; gradually add sugar, beating well.
Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each addition.
Add flour and mix thoroughly.
Stir in milk, water and vanilla.
recipes.text: Old-Fashioned Egg Custard Pie. Cream butter; gradually add sugar, beating well. Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each addition. Add flour and mix thoroughly. Stir in milk, water and vanilla.

recipes.title: Cool & Colorful Salad
directions: Cook pasta according to package directions.
Do not overcook. Rinse with cold water.
As pasta cooks, cut up vegetables into bite size chunks.
Mix with pasta.
Add salad dressing and seasoning.
Chill at least 2 hours before serving.
Serves 6-8.
recipes.text: Cool & Colorful Salad. Cook pasta according to package directions. Do not overcook. Rinse with cold water. As pasta cooks, cut up vegetables into bite size chunks. Mix with pasta. Add salad dressing and seasoning. Chill at least 2 hours before serving. Serves 6-8.

recipes.title: Blueberry Pizza
directions: Mix and pat into a 9 x 13-inch pan and bake at 350° for 15 minutes or until golden brown.
Let cool.
recipes.text: Blueberry Pizza. Mix and pat into a 9 x 13-inch pan and bake at 350° for 15 minutes or until golden brown. Let cool.

recipes.title: Tex-Mex Lasagna
directions: In a large skillet, make the sauce by browning the beef with the onion, drain the liquid; add the tomato paste, picante sauce, water, oregano and basil.
Mix well and set aside.
In a large bowl, combine the Ricotta cheese and 3/4 cup of Mozzarella cheese; set aside.
Coat a 7 x 11-inch baking pan with non-stick vegetable spray.
Layer the ingredients in the pan as follows:
1/3 cup of sauce, half of the uncooked noodles and half of the Ricotta cheese mixture; repeat the layers and top with remaining sauce then the remaining 1 1/2 cups Mozzarella cheese.
Cover and refrigerate overnight.
The next day, uncover and bake in a pre-heated 350° oven for 1 hour, or until light golden, remove from the oven and let stand for 20 minutes for easier serving.
recipes.text: Tex-Mex Lasagna. In a large skillet, make the sauce by browning the beef with the onion, drain the liquid; add the tomato paste, picante sauce, water, oregano and basil. Mix well and set aside. In a large bowl, combine the Ricotta cheese and 3/4 cup of Mozzarella cheese; set aside. Coat a 7 x 11-inch baking pan with non-stick vegetable spray. Layer the ingredients in the pan as follows: 1/3 cup of sauce, half of the uncooked noodles and half of the Ricotta cheese mixture; repeat the layers and top with remaining sauce then the remaining 1 1/2 cups Mozzarella cheese. Cover and refrigerate overnight. The next day, uncover and bake in a pre-heated 350° oven for 1 hour, or until light golden, remove from the oven and let stand for 20 minutes for easier serving.

recipes.title: Spaghetti Pie(Serves 4 To 6)
ingredients: 1 (15 oz.) jar Prego or your favorite spaghetti sauce
directions: Mix together cooked spaghetti, eggs, melted butter and Parmesan cheese.
Mold into buttered pie plate.
Top with cottage cheese.
Mix browned meat into sauce.
Spread on top of cottage cheese.
Sprinkle top with Mozzarella cheese.
Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.
recipes.text: Spaghetti Pie(Serves 4 To 6). Mix together cooked spaghetti, eggs, melted butter and Parmesan cheese. Mold into buttered pie plate. Top with cottage cheese. Mix browned meat into sauce. Spread on top of cottage cheese. Sprinkle top with Mozzarella cheese. Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Angel Food Bars
ingredients: 1 pkg. angel food cake mix (1 step)
directions: Mix together, but do not beat.
Use jelly roll pan.
Bake in 350° oven 20 minutes.
Frost with cream cheese frosting.
recipes.text: Angel Food Bars. Mix together, but do not beat. Use jelly roll pan. Bake in 350° oven 20 minutes. Frost with cream cheese frosting.

recipes.title: Chocolate Peanut Butter Bars
ingredients: 2 c. (about 12 oz.) milk chocolate or semi-sweet chocolate chips, melted
directions: Have ready a 13 x 9-inch baking pan.
Mix confectioners sugar, cracker crumbs, peanut butter and butter in medium-size bowl until blended.
Scrape into ungreased baking pan and press into an even layer.
Spread melted chocolate over top.
Refrigerate at least 2 hours until chocolate is firm.
Let stand at room temperature 15 to 20 minutes before cutting with sharp knife into bars.
Makes 36 bars at 173 calories per bar.
recipes.text: Chocolate Peanut Butter Bars. Have ready a 13 x 9-inch baking pan. Mix confectioners sugar, cracker crumbs, peanut butter and butter in medium-size bowl until blended. Scrape into ungreased baking pan and press into an even layer. Spread melted chocolate over top. Refrigerate at least 2 hours until chocolate is firm. Let stand at room temperature 15 to 20 minutes before cutting with sharp knife into bars. Makes 36 bars at 173 calories per bar.

recipes.title: Cheesecake Cupcakes
directions: Put a cupcake liner in cupcake pan; place a wafer in each liner (for crust).
Mix well next 3 ingredients.
Fill each liner 1/2 full with mixture; sprinkle on a little colored sugar.
Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.
Makes 2 1/2 dozen.
recipes.text: Cheesecake Cupcakes. Put a cupcake liner in cupcake pan; place a wafer in each liner (for crust). Mix well next 3 ingredients. Fill each liner 1/2 full with mixture; sprinkle on a little colored sugar. Bake at 350° for 20 minutes. Makes 2 1/2 dozen.

recipes.title: Crazy Cake
directions: Sift the dry ingredients into an ungreased 8-inch square pan. Make three little "wells" in dry ingredients.
Pour salad oil in one, vinegar in the second and vanilla in the third.
Add milk and stir with a fork until mixture is well blended.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
Cool.
Frost with your favorite frosting.
recipes.text: Crazy Cake. Sift the dry ingredients into an ungreased 8-inch square pan. Make three little "wells" in dry ingredients. Pour salad oil in one, vinegar in the second and vanilla in the third. Add milk and stir with a fork until mixture is well blended. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes. Cool. Frost with your favorite frosting.

recipes.title: Sour Cream Salad
directions: Dissolve jello in boiling water.
Add sour cream and stir until dissolved.
Place in refrigerator.
Chill until mixture gets to the thickness of egg whites.
Add remaining ingredients.
Place in mold and refrigerate until set.
recipes.text: Sour Cream Salad. Dissolve jello in boiling water. Add sour cream and stir until dissolved. Place in refrigerator. Chill until mixture gets to the thickness of egg whites. Add remaining ingredients. Place in mold and refrigerate until set.

recipes.title: Sausage Balls
directions: Mix all together and roll into little balls (1-inch).
Bake at 425° until brown on ungreased cookie sheet.
recipes.text: Sausage Balls. Mix all together and roll into little balls (1-inch). Bake at 425° until brown on ungreased cookie sheet.

recipes.title: Bean Casserole
directions: Brown meat and add onions.
Add all other ingredients in crock-pot and simmer for 4 hours.
recipes.text: Bean Casserole. Brown meat and add onions. Add all other ingredients in crock-pot and simmer for 4 hours.

recipes.title: Shrimp Etouffee
directions: Peel fresh shrimp.
Make light incision along outer back and remove black vein.
Wash; place in colander and season generously with salt and pepper.
Set aside.
Melt oleo.
Add onions, celery and bell pepper, if desired, and parsley.
Wilt.

Add tomato sauce and cook slowly in uncovered heavy iron pot about 45 minutes. Dissolve cornstarch in the cup of water and add to mixture. Simmer another 5 minutes, then add seasoned shrimp and green onions and cook until shrimp are done, usually about 20 to 30 minutes.
Salt, pepper, Worcestershire sauce and especially Tabasco are used generously in this dish.

(If a little more sauce is desired, an additional teaspoon of cornstarch in 1/2 cup of water may be added, but remember that as the shrimp begin to cook, they will create quite a bit of liquid themselves.)
Serve over mounds of steamed white long grain rice.
Serves 6.
recipes.text: Shrimp Etouffee. Peel fresh shrimp. Make light incision along outer back and remove black vein. Wash; place in colander and season generously with salt and pepper. Set aside. Melt oleo. Add onions, celery and bell pepper, if desired, and parsley. Wilt. Add tomato sauce and cook slowly in uncovered heavy iron pot about 45 minutes. Dissolve cornstarch in the cup of water and add to mixture. Simmer another 5 minutes, then add seasoned shrimp and green onions and cook until shrimp are done, usually about 20 to 30 minutes. Salt, pepper, Worcestershire sauce and especially Tabasco are used generously in this dish. (If a little more sauce is desired, an additional teaspoon of cornstarch in 1/2 cup of water may be added, but remember that as the shrimp begin to cook, they will create quite a bit of liquid themselves.) Serve over mounds of steamed white long grain rice. Serves 6.

recipes.title: Better Than Sex Cake
directions: Mix cake according to directions, using milk instead of water. Bake in 9 x 13-inch pan.
Remove from oven.
Poke holes with large fork in cake.
Heat pineapple and sugar to just boiling. Pour into cake, let cool.
Mix pudding according to directions. Blend in cream cheese.
Spread this mixture on cake.
Refrigerate until set.
Slice 3 to 4 bananas on top of pudding.
Cover with Cool Whip.
Sprinkle with coconut and chopped pecans.
recipes.text: Better Than Sex Cake. Mix cake according to directions, using milk instead of water. Bake in 9 x 13-inch pan. Remove from oven. Poke holes with large fork in cake. Heat pineapple and sugar to just boiling. Pour into cake, let cool. Mix pudding according to directions. Blend in cream cheese. Spread this mixture on cake. Refrigerate until set. Slice 3 to 4 bananas on top of pudding. Cover with Cool Whip. Sprinkle with coconut and chopped pecans.

recipes.title: Shake-It-Up Chicken Nuggets
directions: Crush crumbs by placing in Ziploc bag and rolling a rolling pin over bag.
Open bag and add Parmesan cheese.
Re-seal bag and shake to mix.
recipes.text: Shake-It-Up Chicken Nuggets. Crush crumbs by placing in Ziploc bag and rolling a rolling pin over bag. Open bag and add Parmesan cheese. Re-seal bag and shake to mix.

recipes.title: Marinated Italian Chicken
directions: Pour dressing over chicken breasts.
Let marinate for 15 minutes.
Place on rack in broiler pan.
Broil 5 to 7 minutes on each side until juices are clear.
recipes.text: Marinated Italian Chicken. Pour dressing over chicken breasts. Let marinate for 15 minutes. Place on rack in broiler pan. Broil 5 to 7 minutes on each side until juices are clear.

recipes.title: Cheese Fondue
ingredients: 1 c. grated Cheddar or Swiss cheese
1/2 loaf French bread, cut into 1-inch cubes
directions: Melt the first 3 ingredients in a fondue pot or crock-pot.
Use wooden meat skewers or forks to dip the bread into the cheese.
Eat one piece of cheese covered bread at a time, just after it is dipped in the cheese.
recipes.text: Cheese Fondue. Melt the first 3 ingredients in a fondue pot or crock-pot. Use wooden meat skewers or forks to dip the bread into the cheese. Eat one piece of cheese covered bread at a time, just after it is dipped in the cheese.

recipes.title: Squash Casserole
directions: Cook squash and onion until tender, 15 minutes. Drain and mash lightly. Beat the eggs with the butter, sugar and salt.
Mix with the cheese.
Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.
recipes.text: Squash Casserole. Cook squash and onion until tender, 15 minutes. Drain and mash lightly. Beat the eggs with the butter, sugar and salt. Mix with the cheese. Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Pot Roast
directions: Put all ingredients in a pot and cover.
Cook 2 1/2 hours on medium to low light on the stove top.
Do not open pot before 2 1/2 hours.
Keep pot tightly covered.
recipes.text: Pot Roast. Put all ingredients in a pot and cover. Cook 2 1/2 hours on medium to low light on the stove top. Do not open pot before 2 1/2 hours. Keep pot tightly covered.

recipes.title: Waldorf Salad
directions: Cut apples after coring and paring, if skins are tough, into fairly large pieces.
Some apples, like Cortlands, do not darken as quickly when cut for a salad.
Add lemon juice, chopped celery and walnuts; toss to mix.
Chill.
Mix with mayonnaise for serving on a bed of lettuce.
Chopped candied ginger also may be added to the salad.
recipes.text: Waldorf Salad. Cut apples after coring and paring, if skins are tough, into fairly large pieces. Some apples, like Cortlands, do not darken as quickly when cut for a salad. Add lemon juice, chopped celery and walnuts; toss to mix. Chill. Mix with mayonnaise for serving on a bed of lettuce. Chopped candied ginger also may be added to the salad.

recipes.title: Skillet Supper
directions: Brown pork chops; add onion and bell pepper.
Sprinkle rice around chops, add tomatoes and season with salt and pepper.
Cover and bake 1 hour.
recipes.text: Skillet Supper. Brown pork chops; add onion and bell pepper. Sprinkle rice around chops, add tomatoes and season with salt and pepper. Cover and bake 1 hour.

recipes.title: Pork Chop Casserole
directions: Wash rice and drain. Place in greased casserole dish. Add soups and water. Place pork chops on top. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes or until meat is tender.
recipes.text: Pork Chop Casserole. Wash rice and drain. Place in greased casserole dish. Add soups and water. Place pork chops on top. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes or until meat is tender.

recipes.title: Hot Chocolate Mix
directions: Mix all ingredients thoroughly and store tightly covered.
Use 3 to 4 heaping teaspoonfuls with an 8 ounce mug of boiling water.
recipes.text: Hot Chocolate Mix. Mix all ingredients thoroughly and store tightly covered. Use 3 to 4 heaping teaspoonfuls with an 8 ounce mug of boiling water.

recipes.title: Best-Ever Fruitcake
directions: Cream margarine and sugar.
Put dry ingredients in sifter. Alternately add an egg at a time, with part of the sifted dry ingredients, till all is combined, then add the wiskey.
Chop the cherries and pineapple (not too small) and rub a little flour on them so they don't float to the top.
Add the fruit and nuts.
Put into a greased tube pan.
Bake at 250° for 2 hours.
Cool completely before removing from pan.
Wrap well.
Keeps for weeks.
recipes.text: Best-Ever Fruitcake. Cream margarine and sugar. Put dry ingredients in sifter. Alternately add an egg at a time, with part of the sifted dry ingredients, till all is combined, then add the wiskey. Chop the cherries and pineapple (not too small) and rub a little flour on them so they don't float to the top. Add the fruit and nuts. Put into a greased tube pan. Bake at 250° for 2 hours. Cool completely before removing from pan. Wrap well. Keeps for weeks.

recipes.title: Pineapple Cheese Pie
ingredients: 1 (20 oz.) can crushed pineapple, drained well
3 small or 2 regular uncooked pie shells
directions: Mix pineapple, sugar and flour in a saucepan and cook until thickened.
Remove from heat and let cool.
Mix cream cheese, butter and sugar well.
Add eggs and whip until fluffy.
Spread pineapple pie filling in uncooked pie shells until half full, then pour cream cheese mixture on top of filling.
Sprinkle almonds on top.
Bake at 325° for 4O to 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Pineapple Cheese Pie. Mix pineapple, sugar and flour in a saucepan and cook until thickened. Remove from heat and let cool. Mix cream cheese, butter and sugar well. Add eggs and whip until fluffy. Spread pineapple pie filling in uncooked pie shells until half full, then pour cream cheese mixture on top of filling. Sprinkle almonds on top. Bake at 325° for 4O to 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Chocolate Cheese Cake
directions: In large bowl, combine cream cheese and sugar; beat well. Blend in cocoa.
Add eggs and vanilla; blend well.
Blend in whipped cream.
Pour into crust.
Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes; cool to room temperature.
Cover and chill for several hours.
Top with cherry pie filling before serving.
recipes.text: Chocolate Cheese Cake. In large bowl, combine cream cheese and sugar; beat well. Blend in cocoa. Add eggs and vanilla; blend well. Blend in whipped cream. Pour into crust. Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes; cool to room temperature. Cover and chill for several hours. Top with cherry pie filling before serving.

recipes.title: Tomato Wedge Salad(Serves 8)
ingredients: 1 (10 oz.) pkg. frozen baby lima beans
directions: In a glass dish, place tomatoes and marinate in half the salad dressing; stir often.
Chill.
In another bowl, place lima beans and remaining dressing.
Chill.
recipes.text: Tomato Wedge Salad(Serves 8). In a glass dish, place tomatoes and marinate in half the salad dressing; stir often. Chill. In another bowl, place lima beans and remaining dressing. Chill.

recipes.title: Oklahoma Dip
ingredients: 2 (10 oz.) cans Ro-Tel tomatoes with chiles
directions: Brown first 3 ingredients together and drain. Add two 10-ounce cans Ro-Tel tomatoes and 2 pounds Velveeta cheese.
Cook slowly until cheese melts. Serve warm with Fritos or Doritos.
recipes.text: Oklahoma Dip. Brown first 3 ingredients together and drain. Add two 10-ounce cans Ro-Tel tomatoes and 2 pounds Velveeta cheese. Cook slowly until cheese melts. Serve warm with Fritos or Doritos.

recipes.title: Turkey Loaf
directions: Combine all ingredients and press into greased 9 x 6-inch loaf pan.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
Contains 180 calories per serving.
recipes.text: Turkey Loaf. Combine all ingredients and press into greased 9 x 6-inch loaf pan. Bake at 350° for 1 hour. Contains 180 calories per serving.

recipes.title: Curried Fruit
directions: Drain fruits.
Arrange in 1 1/2-quart casserole.
Melt butter, add brown sugar and curry; spoon over fruit.
Bake for 1 hour, uncovered, at 350°.
recipes.text: Curried Fruit. Drain fruits. Arrange in 1 1/2-quart casserole. Melt butter, add brown sugar and curry; spoon over fruit. Bake for 1 hour, uncovered, at 350°.

recipes.title: Cheese Roll(Club Member: Brandi Cook)
directions: Mix all ingredients together, except peanuts. Make sure it's mixed well, then roll it into a ball. Roll onto wax paper with the peanuts. Keep it cool.
recipes.text: Cheese Roll(Club Member: Brandi Cook). Mix all ingredients together, except peanuts. Make sure it's mixed well, then roll it into a ball. Roll onto wax paper with the peanuts. Keep it cool.

recipes.title: Jolly Old St. Nick Cake
ingredients: 1 pkg. Pillsbury Plus cake mix (any flavor)
directions: Preheat oven to 350°.
Angel food cake mix and 2 2/3 cups water.
Add "A" mix and mix in large stainless steel bowl (Kitchen Aid).
Mix for 2 minutes on slow.
Whip until peaks don't fall. Put into large bowl.
Sprinkle 1/4 flour ("B" package) onto whipped eggs at a time, then fold.
Pour into 13 x 9-inch pan.
Spread evenly.
Cook for 30 to 40 minutes.
Let cool 35 to 45 minutes. Marshmallows should be spread like a beard; gumdrops as eyes.
Ice cake with icing evenly, then chow.
recipes.text: Jolly Old St. Nick Cake. Preheat oven to 350°. Angel food cake mix and 2 2/3 cups water. Add "A" mix and mix in large stainless steel bowl (Kitchen Aid). Mix for 2 minutes on slow. Whip until peaks don't fall. Put into large bowl. Sprinkle 1/4 flour ("B" package) onto whipped eggs at a time, then fold. Pour into 13 x 9-inch pan. Spread evenly. Cook for 30 to 40 minutes. Let cool 35 to 45 minutes. Marshmallows should be spread like a beard; gumdrops as eyes. Ice cake with icing evenly, then chow.

recipes.title: Juicy Chicken Meatballs
directions: Mix together hamburger (uncooked), water, salt and uncooked oatmeal.
Chill for 30 minutes.
After meat mixture is chilled, roll into balls.
Coat all sides of meatballs with flour.
Brown on all sides in a skillet with small amount of oil.
Add undiluted chicken soup to top of meatballs and simmer for 20 minutes, making sure balls don't stick to pan.
Keep soup scooped onto top of meatballs so they are seasoned well.
recipes.text: Juicy Chicken Meatballs. Mix together hamburger (uncooked), water, salt and uncooked oatmeal. Chill for 30 minutes. After meat mixture is chilled, roll into balls. Coat all sides of meatballs with flour. Brown on all sides in a skillet with small amount of oil. Add undiluted chicken soup to top of meatballs and simmer for 20 minutes, making sure balls don't stick to pan. Keep soup scooped onto top of meatballs so they are seasoned well.

recipes.title: Fresh Strawberry Dip
directions: Mix marshmallow cream and cream cheese together.
recipes.text: Fresh Strawberry Dip. Mix marshmallow cream and cream cheese together.

recipes.title: Wild Rice And Seafood Casserole
ingredients: 1 box cooked Uncle Ben's wild rice
directions: Mix all ingredients together and bake, uncovered, 1 to 1 1/2 hours at 350°.
recipes.text: Wild Rice And Seafood Casserole. Mix all ingredients together and bake, uncovered, 1 to 1 1/2 hours at 350°.

recipes.title: Squash Dressing
ingredients: 2 Tbsp. poultry seasoning or to taste
directions: Saute onion and celery in butter until tender.
Add to corn bread and squash and stir well.
Stir in remaining ingredients, mixing well.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes until lightly browned.
recipes.text: Squash Dressing. Saute onion and celery in butter until tender. Add to corn bread and squash and stir well. Stir in remaining ingredients, mixing well. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes until lightly browned.

recipes.title: Blueberry Muffins
directions: Beat egg.
Add milk, margarine and sugar; mix well.
Sift flour and baking powder and fold in.
Mix in blueberries.
Spoon into greased muffin pans.
Bake in 375° oven for 30 minutes. Makes 12.
recipes.text: Blueberry Muffins. Beat egg. Add milk, margarine and sugar; mix well. Sift flour and baking powder and fold in. Mix in blueberries. Spoon into greased muffin pans. Bake in 375° oven for 30 minutes. Makes 12.

recipes.title: Mexican Casserole
ingredients: 1 can or 3 oz. chopped green chilies
directions: Brown hamburger meat with onion.
Add Ranch Style beans.
Mix Ro-Tel sauce, chilies and soup.
Heat corn tortillas in hot oil until crisp.
Put tortilla on bottom of casserole dish.
Layer hamburger mixture, then Ro-Tel mixture, then cheese.
Repeat until all is gone.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Mexican Casserole. Brown hamburger meat with onion. Add Ranch Style beans. Mix Ro-Tel sauce, chilies and soup. Heat corn tortillas in hot oil until crisp. Put tortilla on bottom of casserole dish. Layer hamburger mixture, then Ro-Tel mixture, then cheese. Repeat until all is gone. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Pound Cake
directions: Sift dry ingredients.
Cream butter and sugar.
Add eggs and mix well.
Alternately add flour and milk with vanilla added.
Bake at 325° for 1 hour and 15 minutes.
recipes.text: Pound Cake. Sift dry ingredients. Cream butter and sugar. Add eggs and mix well. Alternately add flour and milk with vanilla added. Bake at 325° for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Miniature Cheese Cupcakes
directions: Place vanilla wafers into foil cupcake cups.
Beat the remaining ingredients; beat well.
Pour in cups.
Bake 15 minutes at 350°.
recipes.text: Miniature Cheese Cupcakes. Place vanilla wafers into foil cupcake cups. Beat the remaining ingredients; beat well. Pour in cups. Bake 15 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Orange Jello
directions: Make Jell-O according to package, but use 1/2 cup less water. When Jell-O starts to jell, add mandarin oranges and whipping cream.
Stir until smooth.
Add cottage cheese and nuts.
Stir and put back into refrigerator until jelled.
recipes.text: Orange Jello. Make Jell-O according to package, but use 1/2 cup less water. When Jell-O starts to jell, add mandarin oranges and whipping cream. Stir until smooth. Add cottage cheese and nuts. Stir and put back into refrigerator until jelled.

recipes.title: Cornbread Salad
ingredients: 2 boxes Jiffy cornbread mix, baked and cooled
directions: Crumble the cornbread and mix with the next 4 ingredients. Mix the mayonnaise and creamy cucumber dressing together; pour over the cornbread mixture.
recipes.text: Cornbread Salad. Crumble the cornbread and mix with the next 4 ingredients. Mix the mayonnaise and creamy cucumber dressing together; pour over the cornbread mixture.

recipes.title: Punch
directions: Dissolve Jell-O and sugar in boiling water.
Add pineapple juice.
Pour into 1 gallon milk jug and fill with water within 3-inches of top, then place in freezer.
Take out of freezer 5 or 6 hours before you are ready to serve it.
It will be like an "Icee".
recipes.text: Punch. Dissolve Jell-O and sugar in boiling water. Add pineapple juice. Pour into 1 gallon milk jug and fill with water within 3-inches of top, then place in freezer. Take out of freezer 5 or 6 hours before you are ready to serve it. It will be like an "Icee".

recipes.title: Best Icing
directions: Cream sugar, oleo, crisco.
Add salt,
vanilla, milk and flour.
Beat high speed 12 minutes.
recipes.text: Best Icing. Cream sugar, oleo, crisco. Add salt, vanilla, milk and flour. Beat high speed 12 minutes.

recipes.title: Appetizer Franks
ingredients: 1 lb. frankfurters, cut into bite-sie pieces
directions: Combine first 6 ingredients; stir in franks.
Cook for 30 minutes; serve in chafing dish.
recipes.text: Appetizer Franks. Combine first 6 ingredients; stir in franks. Cook for 30 minutes; serve in chafing dish.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Pie
ingredients: 1 (9 oz.) carton frozen whipped topping, thawed
directions: In small mixing bowl, beat cream cheese and sugar until fluffy.
Add peanut butter and beat well.
Gradually beat in milk. Fold in topping.
Pile into pie shell.
Sprinkle with peanuts. Freeze until firm, then wrap in moisture proof wrap.
recipes.text: Peanut Butter Pie. In small mixing bowl, beat cream cheese and sugar until fluffy. Add peanut butter and beat well. Gradually beat in milk. Fold in topping. Pile into pie shell. Sprinkle with peanuts. Freeze until firm, then wrap in moisture proof wrap.

recipes.title: Flossie'S Yeast Bread
directions: Mix and pour out on floured cloth.
Knead 10 minutes.
Put in warm place to rise until double in bulk.
Punch down, cover and let rest a few minutes.
Divide.
Roll out into oblong rolls about 18 inches.
Roll up and put in greased loaf pan.
Put seam in batter.
Makes 2 loaves.
Let rise again.
Bake at 400° until brown.
May have to put foil over top to keep it from browning too much.
recipes.text: Flossie'S Yeast Bread. Mix and pour out on floured cloth. Knead 10 minutes. Put in warm place to rise until double in bulk. Punch down, cover and let rest a few minutes. Divide. Roll out into oblong rolls about 18 inches. Roll up and put in greased loaf pan. Put seam in batter. Makes 2 loaves. Let rise again. Bake at 400° until brown. May have to put foil over top to keep it from browning too much.

recipes.title: Mushroom Scalloped Potatoes
ingredients: 4 oz. can mushroom stems and pieces, drained
directions: Mix soup, cheese, pimiento, salt and mushroom stems and pieces.
Gradually stir in cream and potatoes.
Pour into a shallow baking dish.
Top with 1/2 cup grated cheese.
Cover and bake 1 hour at 350°.
recipes.text: Mushroom Scalloped Potatoes. Mix soup, cheese, pimiento, salt and mushroom stems and pieces. Gradually stir in cream and potatoes. Pour into a shallow baking dish. Top with 1/2 cup grated cheese. Cover and bake 1 hour at 350°.

recipes.title: Freezer Ice Cream(5-Quart)
directions: Mix all together and pour into freezer.
Finish filling with milk.
Freeze according to freezer instructions.
recipes.text: Freezer Ice Cream(5-Quart). Mix all together and pour into freezer. Finish filling with milk. Freeze according to freezer instructions.

recipes.title: Mexican Flan
directions: Preheat oven to 325°.
Melt 2 c. sugar in saucepan over low heat, cooking until golden, stirring continuously for 5 to 8 minutes.
Watch sugar carefully as it can burn quickly.
Put the caramel into custard cups to cover the bottoms.
In mixing bowl, add remaining sugar, eggs and vanilla.
Boil the milk, then slowly add to sugar-egg mixture, whisking well.
Strain through a fine strainer.
Ladle the mixture into the caramel coated custard cups, filling 3/4 full.
Put the filled cups into a water bath and cover.
Cook 35 to 40 minutes.
Check after 30 minutes.
Cool to room temperature.
To serve, run a knife around edges, loosen and invert on to plates.
recipes.text: Mexican Flan. Preheat oven to 325°. Melt 2 c. sugar in saucepan over low heat, cooking until golden, stirring continuously for 5 to 8 minutes. Watch sugar carefully as it can burn quickly. Put the caramel into custard cups to cover the bottoms. In mixing bowl, add remaining sugar, eggs and vanilla. Boil the milk, then slowly add to sugar-egg mixture, whisking well. Strain through a fine strainer. Ladle the mixture into the caramel coated custard cups, filling 3/4 full. Put the filled cups into a water bath and cover. Cook 35 to 40 minutes. Check after 30 minutes. Cool to room temperature. To serve, run a knife around edges, loosen and invert on to plates.

recipes.title: Strawberry-Nut Cake
directions: Preheat oven to 350°.
Grease and flour 3 (8 1/2 or 9-inch) cake pans.
Mix all ingredients together and bake 25 to 30 minutes.
Frost layers.
recipes.text: Strawberry-Nut Cake. Preheat oven to 350°. Grease and flour 3 (8 1/2 or 9-inch) cake pans. Mix all ingredients together and bake 25 to 30 minutes. Frost layers.

recipes.title: Lo-Cal Fruit Salad
ingredients: 1 (20 oz.) bag frozen strawberries or 1 qt. fresh berries, trimmed and sliced
2 (16 oz.) cans lite peaches, drained and cut into thirds
1 (15 oz.) can pineapple tidbits with juice
2 bananas, sliced and sprinkled with Fruit-Fresh
directions: Put all fruit in a large mixing bowl.
Sprinkle with 1 teaspoon sugar-free Tang and mix well but gently.
Then add 1 small box sugar-free vanilla or lemon instant pudding.
Again, mix well but gently.
Chill before serving.
Flavor improves overnight.
recipes.text: Lo-Cal Fruit Salad. Put all fruit in a large mixing bowl. Sprinkle with 1 teaspoon sugar-free Tang and mix well but gently. Then add 1 small box sugar-free vanilla or lemon instant pudding. Again, mix well but gently. Chill before serving. Flavor improves overnight.

recipes.title: Canned Spaghetti Sauce
directions: Flavor is enhanced when vegetables are chopped in food processor.
recipes.text: Canned Spaghetti Sauce. Flavor is enhanced when vegetables are chopped in food processor.

recipes.title: Chinese Coleslaw
directions: Break and separate Ramen noodles.
Combine all of the ingredients.
recipes.text: Chinese Coleslaw. Break and separate Ramen noodles. Combine all of the ingredients.

recipes.title: Southwestern Stew
ingredients: 1 (28 oz.) can tomatoes with juice, chopped
1 (17 oz.) can whole kernel corn, drained
directions: In skillet, brown ground beef and onion.
Drain off fat.
Add remaining ingredients and bring to a boil.
Simmer, covered, for 20 minutes.
Garnish with shredded Cheddar cheese.
Makes 8 servings.
recipes.text: Southwestern Stew. In skillet, brown ground beef and onion. Drain off fat. Add remaining ingredients and bring to a boil. Simmer, covered, for 20 minutes. Garnish with shredded Cheddar cheese. Makes 8 servings.

recipes.title: Lazy Day Cobbler
ingredients: 2 c. cooked fruit (and juice) or 1 can unsweetened fruit, not drained
directions: Put the margarine in a deep Pyrex dish.
Place in oven to melt.
Beat together the sugar, flour and milk.
Pour over the melted margarine (do not stir).
Pour the fruit over the batter. Sprinkle with the sugar.
Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes or until golden brown.
(Batter will rise to the top.)
recipes.text: Lazy Day Cobbler. Put the margarine in a deep Pyrex dish. Place in oven to melt. Beat together the sugar, flour and milk. Pour over the melted margarine (do not stir). Pour the fruit over the batter. Sprinkle with the sugar. Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes or until golden brown. (Batter will rise to the top.)

recipes.title: Pickled Beets
directions: Scrub beets, leaving small amount of green top on. Cook beets until soft. Rub off skin and green top. Cut beets in chunks or if small, put in jars. Then boil the vinegar, beet juice (you get from pot you cooked beets in), sugar and salt. Pour over beets in jar. Add 3 to 4 cloves per jar. Makes about 5 quarts. Can in hot water bath 10 minutes.
recipes.text: Pickled Beets. Scrub beets, leaving small amount of green top on. Cook beets until soft. Rub off skin and green top. Cut beets in chunks or if small, put in jars. Then boil the vinegar, beet juice (you get from pot you cooked beets in), sugar and salt. Pour over beets in jar. Add 3 to 4 cloves per jar. Makes about 5 quarts. Can in hot water bath 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Pineapple Cake
directions: Mix cake mix, Seven-Up, pudding mix, Crisco oil and eggs. Beat for 2 minutes on medium speed with mixer.
Bake in 3 layer pan or 9 x 13 x 2-inch pan at 350° until golden brown.
Cool and frost.
recipes.text: Pineapple Cake. Mix cake mix, Seven-Up, pudding mix, Crisco oil and eggs. Beat for 2 minutes on medium speed with mixer. Bake in 3 layer pan or 9 x 13 x 2-inch pan at 350° until golden brown. Cool and frost.

recipes.title: Curried Honey Glazed Chicken
directions: In a shallow pan, place chicken with skin side up.
recipes.text: Curried Honey Glazed Chicken. In a shallow pan, place chicken with skin side up.

recipes.title: Apple Cranberry Crunch
directions: Combine brown sugar, 1/4 cup
sugar, 1/3 cup
flour and cinnamon with apples and fresh cranberries.
Put in an ungreased dish.
Combine and crumble on top 1 1/2 sticks margarine, 2/3 cup sugar, 1 1/2 cups flour, walnuts and enough oatmeal to crumble.
Bake at 350° for 40 to 50 minutes until apples are tender and top is browned.
Use a 7 1/2 x 11-inch dish.
Good served warm with ice cream.
recipes.text: Apple Cranberry Crunch. Combine brown sugar, 1/4 cup sugar, 1/3 cup flour and cinnamon with apples and fresh cranberries. Put in an ungreased dish. Combine and crumble on top 1 1/2 sticks margarine, 2/3 cup sugar, 1 1/2 cups flour, walnuts and enough oatmeal to crumble. Bake at 350° for 40 to 50 minutes until apples are tender and top is browned. Use a 7 1/2 x 11-inch dish. Good served warm with ice cream.

recipes.title: Cream Pie
directions: Combine sugar, cornstarch (or flour) and salt in top of double boiler.
Stir in cold milk.
Cook over boiling water until thickened, stirring constantly.
Stir a little of the hot mixture into slightly beaten egg yolks; add to remaining mixture in double boiler.
Cook for 2 minutes more, stirring constantly.
Cool and stir in vanilla for cream pie.
Pour into pie shell.
Cover with meringue and brown.
recipes.text: Cream Pie. Combine sugar, cornstarch (or flour) and salt in top of double boiler. Stir in cold milk. Cook over boiling water until thickened, stirring constantly. Stir a little of the hot mixture into slightly beaten egg yolks; add to remaining mixture in double boiler. Cook for 2 minutes more, stirring constantly. Cool and stir in vanilla for cream pie. Pour into pie shell. Cover with meringue and brown.

recipes.title: No Cook Fudge
ingredients: 1/2 c. cocoa mix (sugar and cocoa mix)
directions: Just mix and you're set to go.
recipes.text: No Cook Fudge. Just mix and you're set to go.

recipes.title: Pie Crust
directions: Sift together flour, sugar and salt. Add Crisco and mix well. Add egg, vinegar and water; mix until well blended. Place in covered bowl or wrap in wax paper and place in plastic bag. Store in refrigerator. This will keep for 2 weeks or longer. Yield: 3 to 4 pie shells (9-inch) or 2 two-crust pies.
recipes.text: Pie Crust. Sift together flour, sugar and salt. Add Crisco and mix well. Add egg, vinegar and water; mix until well blended. Place in covered bowl or wrap in wax paper and place in plastic bag. Store in refrigerator. This will keep for 2 weeks or longer. Yield: 3 to 4 pie shells (9-inch) or 2 two-crust pies.

recipes.title: Joyce'S Barbecue Sauce
ingredients: 1 qt. Open Pit barbecue sauce (hickory smoked)
directions: Mix all ingredients in a saucepan over low heat.
Heat to boil.
Remove from heat and let stand at room temperature until cool.
Store, covered, in refrigerator.
Use over ribs, pork chops or chicken.
Makes 7 cups.
recipes.text: Joyce'S Barbecue Sauce. Mix all ingredients in a saucepan over low heat. Heat to boil. Remove from heat and let stand at room temperature until cool. Store, covered, in refrigerator. Use over ribs, pork chops or chicken. Makes 7 cups.

recipes.title: Whipped Syllabub(Serving Size: 6)
directions: Measure the whipping cream into the large mixing bowl and beat it with a wire whisk or eggbeater until it is thick.
Set the bowl aside.
recipes.text: Whipped Syllabub(Serving Size: 6). Measure the whipping cream into the large mixing bowl and beat it with a wire whisk or eggbeater until it is thick. Set the bowl aside.

recipes.title: Imitation Guacamole
directions: In a small bowl, mash cactus with fork.
Do not blend or process.
Place asparagus in blender or food processor and blend until smooth.
Add to cactus with remaining ingredients and mix lightly.
Serves 6 to 8.
recipes.text: Imitation Guacamole. In a small bowl, mash cactus with fork. Do not blend or process. Place asparagus in blender or food processor and blend until smooth. Add to cactus with remaining ingredients and mix lightly. Serves 6 to 8.

recipes.title: Congealed Salad
ingredients: 1 box jello (flavor depends on color you want)
directions: Mix together cream cheese, crushed pineapple, maraschino cherries after cheese is soft.
Dissolve jello in boiling water. Let cool to room temperance, then place in refrigerator or until consistency of egg white.
Add cream cheese mixture.
Stir well to get all cream cheese lumps out.
Add Cool Whip last.
Serves 6.
recipes.text: Congealed Salad. Mix together cream cheese, crushed pineapple, maraschino cherries after cheese is soft. Dissolve jello in boiling water. Let cool to room temperance, then place in refrigerator or until consistency of egg white. Add cream cheese mixture. Stir well to get all cream cheese lumps out. Add Cool Whip last. Serves 6.

recipes.title: Puppy Dog Trash
directions: Melt first 3 ingredients in microwave.
Put cereal in bowl; pour melted ingredients in bowl.
Mix well.
Put powdered sugar in paper bag; add cereal mixture and shake bag well.
Put in airtight container to store.
recipes.text: Puppy Dog Trash. Melt first 3 ingredients in microwave. Put cereal in bowl; pour melted ingredients in bowl. Mix well. Put powdered sugar in paper bag; add cereal mixture and shake bag well. Put in airtight container to store.

recipes.title: Vanilla Extract
directions: Place the vanilla bean in the liqueur and let stand for 1 to 2 months.
This makes an exceptional extract and will enhance any recipe.
It is a strong vanilla so use less of it to taste.
recipes.text: Vanilla Extract. Place the vanilla bean in the liqueur and let stand for 1 to 2 months. This makes an exceptional extract and will enhance any recipe. It is a strong vanilla so use less of it to taste.

recipes.title: Party Chicken
directions: Wrap each chicken breast with a piece of bacon.
Cover bottom of flat greased baking dish with beef.
Arrange breasts over beef. Mix soup and sour cream and pour over all.
Cover and refrigerate overnight if possible.
When ready, bake at 275° for 3 hours, uncovered.
Serves 8.
recipes.text: Party Chicken. Wrap each chicken breast with a piece of bacon. Cover bottom of flat greased baking dish with beef. Arrange breasts over beef. Mix soup and sour cream and pour over all. Cover and refrigerate overnight if possible. When ready, bake at 275° for 3 hours, uncovered. Serves 8.

recipes.title: Clam Chowder
ingredients: salt, hot sauce and Worcestershire sauce to taste
directions: Use a heavy pot. Fry fatback and saute onion.
Add liquid, tomatoes, potatoes and seasoning.
Cook until potatoes are done, then add clams and continue to cook for 10 to 15 minutes. Serves 8.
(For larger amounts, increase proportionately.)
recipes.text: Clam Chowder. Use a heavy pot. Fry fatback and saute onion. Add liquid, tomatoes, potatoes and seasoning. Cook until potatoes are done, then add clams and continue to cook for 10 to 15 minutes. Serves 8. (For larger amounts, increase proportionately.)

recipes.title: Secret Vegetable Casserole
directions: Cook celery and onion in butter until tender (save portion of butter for topping).
Cook vegetables according to package directions.
Drain well and mix with celery, onion, water chestnuts, cheese and mayonnaise.
Put in buttered casserole dish and top with crumbled Ritz crackers, mixed with remaining butter. Bake at 325° for 30 minutes or until casserole is hot and bubbly and cheese has melted.
recipes.text: Secret Vegetable Casserole. Cook celery and onion in butter until tender (save portion of butter for topping). Cook vegetables according to package directions. Drain well and mix with celery, onion, water chestnuts, cheese and mayonnaise. Put in buttered casserole dish and top with crumbled Ritz crackers, mixed with remaining butter. Bake at 325° for 30 minutes or until casserole is hot and bubbly and cheese has melted.

recipes.title: Aebleskiver (Dutch Treat)
ingredients: 2 tsp. food coloring (Kool-Aid works wonders too)
directions: Combine dry ingredients.
Add water and food coloring or Kool-Aid.
Stir well.
Put everything in a nonstick cooking pot. Cook slowly.
Keep on stirring until well blended.
Play dough is done when it doesn't stick to the pan.
Cool and knead.
Store in an airtight container.
You can freeze or refrigerate for months.
recipes.text: Aebleskiver (Dutch Treat). Combine dry ingredients. Add water and food coloring or Kool-Aid. Stir well. Put everything in a nonstick cooking pot. Cook slowly. Keep on stirring until well blended. Play dough is done when it doesn't stick to the pan. Cool and knead. Store in an airtight container. You can freeze or refrigerate for months.

recipes.title: Baked Oatmeal
directions: Thoroughly mix all ingredients together.
Pour into a buttered 8 x 8 inch pan and bake at 350° for 40 to 60 minutes. Serve hot with cold milk, tastes great with cinnamon or fried apples.
recipes.text: Baked Oatmeal. Thoroughly mix all ingredients together. Pour into a buttered 8 x 8 inch pan and bake at 350° for 40 to 60 minutes. Serve hot with cold milk, tastes great with cinnamon or fried apples.

recipes.title: Banana Split Cake
directions: Mix and press into bottom of large oblong pan.
recipes.text: Banana Split Cake. Mix and press into bottom of large oblong pan.

recipes.title: Jello Ice Cream
directions: Mix Jell-O and water thoroughly.
Add vanilla ice cream and nuts.
Mix well and freeze.
recipes.text: Jello Ice Cream. Mix Jell-O and water thoroughly. Add vanilla ice cream and nuts. Mix well and freeze.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Frosting
directions: Blend peanut butter, milk and vanilla.
Gradually add sugar. Will frost two 9-inch layers.
recipes.text: Peanut Butter Frosting. Blend peanut butter, milk and vanilla. Gradually add sugar. Will frost two 9-inch layers.

recipes.title: Homemade Chili
directions: Brown hamburger; drain in large kettle.
Add all ingredients. Bring to boil; lower heat and cook until onions are tender, stirring constantly.
Spaghetti may be added, if desired.
Serve hot.
recipes.text: Homemade Chili. Brown hamburger; drain in large kettle. Add all ingredients. Bring to boil; lower heat and cook until onions are tender, stirring constantly. Spaghetti may be added, if desired. Serve hot.

recipes.title: Fudge Sauce
directions: Combine cocoa and sugar.
Stir in milk and bring to a boil. Stir constantly.
Remove from heat.
Add butter and vanilla. Yields 2 cups.
recipes.text: Fudge Sauce. Combine cocoa and sugar. Stir in milk and bring to a boil. Stir constantly. Remove from heat. Add butter and vanilla. Yields 2 cups.

recipes.title: Individual Raspberry Cheesecakes
directions: Line 24 muffin pans with paper or foil baking cups.
Place one wafer in bottom of each pan.
In a large bowl, combine cream cheese, sugar, eggs, vanilla and nutmeg.
Beat at medium speed until smooth, scraping sides of bowl occasionally.
Pour mixture into prepared muffin pans, filling 2/3 full.
Bake at 325° for 15 to 20 minutes, or until set.
Cool.
Cover pan; refrigerate overnight.
Before serving, spoon 1 heaping teaspoonful preserves over each cheesecake.
Remove paper baking cups.
Yields 24 cheesecakes.
recipes.text: Individual Raspberry Cheesecakes. Line 24 muffin pans with paper or foil baking cups. Place one wafer in bottom of each pan. In a large bowl, combine cream cheese, sugar, eggs, vanilla and nutmeg. Beat at medium speed until smooth, scraping sides of bowl occasionally. Pour mixture into prepared muffin pans, filling 2/3 full. Bake at 325° for 15 to 20 minutes, or until set. Cool. Cover pan; refrigerate overnight. Before serving, spoon 1 heaping teaspoonful preserves over each cheesecake. Remove paper baking cups. Yields 24 cheesecakes.

recipes.title: Cabbage And Noodles
directions: Cook cabbage and onion in butter until soft.
Season as desired.
Add cooked noodles and toss.
recipes.text: Cabbage And Noodles. Cook cabbage and onion in butter until soft. Season as desired. Add cooked noodles and toss.

recipes.title: Chili Dip
directions: Mix in medium saucepan on low to medium heat.
Warm enough to melt cream cheese.
Serve warm with tortilla chips.
recipes.text: Chili Dip. Mix in medium saucepan on low to medium heat. Warm enough to melt cream cheese. Serve warm with tortilla chips.

recipes.title: Baked Eggplant
directions: Peel and soak eggplant in salt water for 6 to 12 hours, overnight
if
possible.
Soak
bread
crumbs
in milk.
Saute onions,
celery and bell pepper in oleo for 15 minutes.
Place eggplant
in

together.
Add eggs, pimiento and seasonings.
Blend well.
Place

and top with grated Cheddar cheese.
Bake

Serve at once

recipes.text: Baked Eggplant. Peel and soak eggplant in salt water for 6 to 12 hours, overnight if possible. Soak bread crumbs in milk. Saute onions, celery and bell pepper in oleo for 15 minutes. Place eggplant in a large pan to boil covered with water and cook until almost done.	Mix bread crumbs, sauteed ingredients, and eggplant together. Add eggs, pimiento and seasonings. Blend well. Place in a baking dish and top with grated Cheddar cheese. Bake in a 350°	oven until golden brown. Serve at once or keep in	a warm oven until ready to serve, not too long. Yields 6 to 8 servings.

recipes.title: Beef Casserole
directions: Brown meat and seasoning.
Drain meat.
Brown onions and pepper.
Mix with meat in skillet.
Pour soups and a can of water. Simmer 10 minutes. Mix with noodles.
Top with grated cheese. Put in a long casserole dish.
Cover and bake about 25 minutes. Uncover about 10 minutes.
When you cook noodles, let them get tender and drain.
Set aside until the meat is ready.
Makes 6 servings.
recipes.text: Beef Casserole. Brown meat and seasoning. Drain meat. Brown onions and pepper. Mix with meat in skillet. Pour soups and a can of water. Simmer 10 minutes. Mix with noodles. Top with grated cheese. Put in a long casserole dish. Cover and bake about 25 minutes. Uncover about 10 minutes. When you cook noodles, let them get tender and drain. Set aside until the meat is ready. Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Mushroom Croustades
directions: Make bread cups; cut circles of bread, missing crusts.
Butter both sides and put into muffin tins.
Bake at 325° for 10 to 15 minutes.
Saute 3 tablespoons chopped green onions in 4 tablespoons of butter.
While in foam stage, not brown, add fresh mushrooms.
Cook until moisture is evaporated 10 to 15 minutes. Sprinkle flour over mixture.
Pour whipping cream over this mixture and bring to a boil.
It will thicken heavily.
Add seasonings and lemon juice.
Cook 1 to 2 minutes.
Fill bread cups and sprinkle with Parmesan cheese.
Dot with butter.
Bake at 350° until hot.
recipes.text: Mushroom Croustades. Make bread cups; cut circles of bread, missing crusts. Butter both sides and put into muffin tins. Bake at 325° for 10 to 15 minutes. Saute 3 tablespoons chopped green onions in 4 tablespoons of butter. While in foam stage, not brown, add fresh mushrooms. Cook until moisture is evaporated 10 to 15 minutes. Sprinkle flour over mixture. Pour whipping cream over this mixture and bring to a boil. It will thicken heavily. Add seasonings and lemon juice. Cook 1 to 2 minutes. Fill bread cups and sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Dot with butter. Bake at 350° until hot.

recipes.title: Artichoke Dip
ingredients: 12 to 14 oz. plain artichoke hearts, chopped finely (food processor)
directions: Combine and bake until golden on top at 350°, approximately 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Artichoke Dip. Combine and bake until golden on top at 350°, approximately 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Apple Torte
directions: Beat eggs, add sugar and beat until creamy.
Add dry ingredients gradually and fold in nuts and apples.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.
Makes 9 x 13-inch pan.
Serve with whipped cream. Better served warm.
recipes.text: Apple Torte. Beat eggs, add sugar and beat until creamy. Add dry ingredients gradually and fold in nuts and apples. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes. Makes 9 x 13-inch pan. Serve with whipped cream. Better served warm.

recipes.title: Spanish Rice
directions: In a 10-inch skillet, cook bacon until crisp.
Drain on paper toweling, crumble and set aside.
Drain fat from pan, reserving 2 tablespoons drippings in skillet.
In the bacon drippings, cook onion and green pepper until tender.
Stir in undrained tomatoes, water, rice, brown sugar, Worcestershire sauce, salt, chili powder, pepper and hot pepper sauce.
Cover and simmer about 30 minutes or until rice is done and most of the liquid is absorbed. Top with the crumbled bacon.
Sprinkle with shredded Cheddar cheese, if desired.
Makes 6 servings.
recipes.text: Spanish Rice. In a 10-inch skillet, cook bacon until crisp. Drain on paper toweling, crumble and set aside. Drain fat from pan, reserving 2 tablespoons drippings in skillet. In the bacon drippings, cook onion and green pepper until tender. Stir in undrained tomatoes, water, rice, brown sugar, Worcestershire sauce, salt, chili powder, pepper and hot pepper sauce. Cover and simmer about 30 minutes or until rice is done and most of the liquid is absorbed. Top with the crumbled bacon. Sprinkle with shredded Cheddar cheese, if desired. Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Seafood Salad
ingredients: 1 box crab and shrimp boil in bag (1 bag)
12 basil leaves, chopped, or dried basil to taste
directions: Cook shrimp and scallops according to package directions. Cool in ice water; drain well.
Peel and remove shells and tails from shrimp.
Chop shrimp coarsely.
Cut scallops into fourths, if large.
Add remaining ingredients; mix well.
Chill.
Taste.
Add salt, if needed.
recipes.text: Seafood Salad. Cook shrimp and scallops according to package directions. Cool in ice water; drain well. Peel and remove shells and tails from shrimp. Chop shrimp coarsely. Cut scallops into fourths, if large. Add remaining ingredients; mix well. Chill. Taste. Add salt, if needed.

recipes.title: Beef Brisket Pot Roast
directions: Heat large heavy pot.
Add meat.
Brown on all sides without oil.
Pour off any fat.
Sprinkle onion around meat.
Cover tightly.
Cook over low heat for 1 hour.
Remove from heat.
Keep covered and let meat cool to lukewarm.
When cool, slice across grain for serving.
Return meat to pot.
Sprinkle with salt and pepper.
Cover and simmer 1 to 2 hours longer or until tender, turning slices once.
recipes.text: Beef Brisket Pot Roast. Heat large heavy pot. Add meat. Brown on all sides without oil. Pour off any fat. Sprinkle onion around meat. Cover tightly. Cook over low heat for 1 hour. Remove from heat. Keep covered and let meat cool to lukewarm. When cool, slice across grain for serving. Return meat to pot. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Cover and simmer 1 to 2 hours longer or until tender, turning slices once.

recipes.title: Seafood Dip
directions: Blend first 6 ingredients.
Spread in a 9-inch pie plate.
Top with walnuts and sprinkle paprika.
Bake at 375° for 25 minutes.
recipes.text: Seafood Dip. Blend first 6 ingredients. Spread in a 9-inch pie plate. Top with walnuts and sprinkle paprika. Bake at 375° for 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Donnie Duke Clark'S Corn Bread Dressing
ingredients: 1/2 tsp. baking soda (use 1/4 tsp. more if old buttermilk)
directions: Mix dry ingredients together and add buttermilk until you have the consistency of pancake batter.
Add bacon drippings and 1 egg. Mix together and pour into a hot skillet with enough oil to barely cover bottom of skillet.
Bake at 425° for 20 to 25 minutes, until cornbread is lightly browned and firm.
Makes enough dressing for 4 people.
recipes.text: Donnie Duke Clark'S Corn Bread Dressing. Mix dry ingredients together and add buttermilk until you have the consistency of pancake batter. Add bacon drippings and 1 egg. Mix together and pour into a hot skillet with enough oil to barely cover bottom of skillet. Bake at 425° for 20 to 25 minutes, until cornbread is lightly browned and firm. Makes enough dressing for 4 people.

recipes.title: Country Herb Roasted Chicken
ingredients: 2 1/2 to 3 lb. chicken, cut into serving pieces
1 envelope Lipton Recipe Secrets herb with garlic soup mix
directions: Preheat oven to 375°.
In 13 x 9-inch baking pan arrange chicken.
In small bowl, combine remaining ingredients.
Brush on chicken.
Bake 45 minutes or until chicken is done.
recipes.text: Country Herb Roasted Chicken. Preheat oven to 375°. In 13 x 9-inch baking pan arrange chicken. In small bowl, combine remaining ingredients. Brush on chicken. Bake 45 minutes or until chicken is done.

recipes.title: Waffle Cookies
ingredients: vanilla to taste (4 or more tsp.)
directions: Mix together butter and eggs.
Add vanilla.
Add flour and sugar.
Place 4 portions (about a heaping teaspoonful) in a preheated waffle iron.
Cook until brown, about 1 minute.
Sprinkle with powdered sugar.
Makes about 10 dozen.
recipes.text: Waffle Cookies. Mix together butter and eggs. Add vanilla. Add flour and sugar. Place 4 portions (about a heaping teaspoonful) in a preheated waffle iron. Cook until brown, about 1 minute. Sprinkle with powdered sugar. Makes about 10 dozen.

recipes.title: Chicken Simon And Garfunkel(From Recipe Box Of Judy Thompson, Houston, Texas)
ingredients: salt, pepper and paprika (as you like)
1/4 tsp. each: sage, rosemary and thyme
directions: Add salt, pepper and paprika as you like to bread crumbs. Make spice mixture of parsley, sage, rosemary and thyme; set aside.
Wrap chicken breasts in cheese slices.
Roll in bread crumb mixture.
Place in greased baking dish.
Pour butter and spice mixture over chicken pieces.
Bake at 350°, uncovered, for 30 minutes.
Add wine and bake another 30 minutes.
Time may be shortened for small pieces, such as tenders.
recipes.text: Chicken Simon And Garfunkel(From Recipe Box Of Judy Thompson, Houston, Texas). Add salt, pepper and paprika as you like to bread crumbs. Make spice mixture of parsley, sage, rosemary and thyme; set aside. Wrap chicken breasts in cheese slices. Roll in bread crumb mixture. Place in greased baking dish. Pour butter and spice mixture over chicken pieces. Bake at 350°, uncovered, for 30 minutes. Add wine and bake another 30 minutes. Time may be shortened for small pieces, such as tenders.

recipes.title: Vanilla Wafer Fruit Cake
directions: Mix fruit, crushed wafers and nuts.
Mix eggs, sugar and cream. Add spice, flavor and pour over fruit, wafers and nuts.
Mix well. Press into a greased Bundt (or tube) pan.
Bake 1 hour at 325°. Cool for 15 minutes only and remove from pan.
recipes.text: Vanilla Wafer Fruit Cake. Mix fruit, crushed wafers and nuts. Mix eggs, sugar and cream. Add spice, flavor and pour over fruit, wafers and nuts. Mix well. Press into a greased Bundt (or tube) pan. Bake 1 hour at 325°. Cool for 15 minutes only and remove from pan.

recipes.title: Homemilled Corn Meal Corn Bread
directions: Sift together all the dry ingredients.
Add egg, buttermilk, and oil.
Mix well and pour into hot iron skillet.
Preheat oven to 400°.
Bake 15 minutes.
Flip in pan and brown.
recipes.text: Homemilled Corn Meal Corn Bread. Sift together all the dry ingredients. Add egg, buttermilk, and oil. Mix well and pour into hot iron skillet. Preheat oven to 400°. Bake 15 minutes. Flip in pan and brown.

recipes.title: Cranberry Bread
directions: Mix dry ingredients together.
Mix liquid ingredients separately and pour into dry.
Stir together well.
Pour into an 8 x 4-inch greased and floured loaf pan.
Bake at 400° for 1 hour. Doubled recipe makes 5 gift loaf pans.
recipes.text: Cranberry Bread. Mix dry ingredients together. Mix liquid ingredients separately and pour into dry. Stir together well. Pour into an 8 x 4-inch greased and floured loaf pan. Bake at 400° for 1 hour. Doubled recipe makes 5 gift loaf pans.

recipes.title: Fudge Cookies(Made On Top Of Stove.)
directions: Boil first 4 ingredients 2 minutes in saucepan.
Add peanut butter, vanilla and oats.
Spoon onto waxed paper and let harden.
recipes.text: Fudge Cookies(Made On Top Of Stove.). Boil first 4 ingredients 2 minutes in saucepan. Add peanut butter, vanilla and oats. Spoon onto waxed paper and let harden.

recipes.title: Sponge Cake(From 1975 Edition)
directions: Put cornstarch and baking powder in cup; fill cup with flour. Separate eggs; beat yolks with sugar, water and lemon juice until light and lemon colored with no trace of grains of sugar.
Add flour to egg yolk mixture; stir lightly.
Beat egg whites until very stiff, then fold in yolk mixture.
Pour in small tube pan. Bake at 350° until done.
recipes.text: Sponge Cake(From 1975 Edition). Put cornstarch and baking powder in cup; fill cup with flour. Separate eggs; beat yolks with sugar, water and lemon juice until light and lemon colored with no trace of grains of sugar. Add flour to egg yolk mixture; stir lightly. Beat egg whites until very stiff, then fold in yolk mixture. Pour in small tube pan. Bake at 350° until done.

recipes.title: Sumi Salad
directions: Add cabbage and green onions to large salad bowl.
Break up Top Ramen noodles (uncooked) into small pieces over top of salad. Toast almond slivers by cooking in a small, dry pan for a few minutes, stirring constantly until lightly browned.
Add to salad. Mix sesame oil, rice vinegar and sugar together.
Add to salad (you may not need all of the dressing) and toss.
recipes.text: Sumi Salad. Add cabbage and green onions to large salad bowl. Break up Top Ramen noodles (uncooked) into small pieces over top of salad. Toast almond slivers by cooking in a small, dry pan for a few minutes, stirring constantly until lightly browned. Add to salad. Mix sesame oil, rice vinegar and sugar together. Add to salad (you may not need all of the dressing) and toss.

recipes.title: Meat Loaf
ingredients: 3 slices bread, toasted and put in blender
directions: Soften bread crumbs with milk; mix and bake in 350° oven for 1 hour or until done.
Put catsup on top, if desired.
recipes.text: Meat Loaf. Soften bread crumbs with milk; mix and bake in 350° oven for 1 hour or until done. Put catsup on top, if desired.

recipes.title: Sydnie'S Green Pepper Steak
directions: Allow steak to soak in ginger, garlic and soy sauce. Heat oil until hot. Cook steak in oil until brown. Turn heat to low and simmer steak 25 to 30 minutes. Add green onions and green pepper. Cook on high 10 minutes. Mix cornstarch with water. Add to steak and vegetables. Add the tomato. Let set for 10 minutes. Serve with white rice.
recipes.text: Sydnie'S Green Pepper Steak. Allow steak to soak in ginger, garlic and soy sauce. Heat oil until hot. Cook steak in oil until brown. Turn heat to low and simmer steak 25 to 30 minutes. Add green onions and green pepper. Cook on high 10 minutes. Mix cornstarch with water. Add to steak and vegetables. Add the tomato. Let set for 10 minutes. Serve with white rice.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Bars
ingredients: 2 c. chocolate chips or 8 oz. chocolate Hershey bar
directions: Combine crumbs, butter, peanut butter and sugar.
Work together until smooth.
Press firmly into 9-inch square buttered pan.
Melt chocolate and spread on top.
Refrigerate until firm and cut into squares.
