recipes.text: Peanut Butter Bars. Combine crumbs, butter, peanut butter and sugar. Work together until smooth. Press firmly into 9-inch square buttered pan. Melt chocolate and spread on top. Refrigerate until firm and cut into squares.

recipes.title: Sour Cream Cornbread
directions: Preheat oven to 350°.
Grease a 9-inch round pie pan.
recipes.text: Sour Cream Cornbread. Preheat oven to 350°. Grease a 9-inch round pie pan.

recipes.title: Ono Salad Dressing
directions: Place all ingredients in a blender and mix.
Yield: approximately 2 1/2 cups.
recipes.text: Ono Salad Dressing. Place all ingredients in a blender and mix. Yield: approximately 2 1/2 cups.

recipes.title: Black-Eyed Peas
directions: Cut up and brown bacon, green pepper and onion.
Drain off fat.
Add peas, tomatoes and spices to taste.
Simmer and serve.
recipes.text: Black-Eyed Peas. Cut up and brown bacon, green pepper and onion. Drain off fat. Add peas, tomatoes and spices to taste. Simmer and serve.

recipes.title: Million Dollar Cake
directions: Cream shortening and sugar.
Add eggs and food coloring.
Sift together flour, salt and cocoa.
Add alternately with buttermilk after each addition.
On medium speed, add vanilla.
Mix baking soda and vinegar and add to batter without beating; mix by hand. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
Makes 2 (9-inch) layers.
Frost with whipped cream frosting.
recipes.text: Million Dollar Cake. Cream shortening and sugar. Add eggs and food coloring. Sift together flour, salt and cocoa. Add alternately with buttermilk after each addition. On medium speed, add vanilla. Mix baking soda and vinegar and add to batter without beating; mix by hand. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes. Makes 2 (9-inch) layers. Frost with whipped cream frosting.

recipes.title: Creole Meat Loaf
ingredients: 1 c. spanish rice (I use Van Camps 15 oz. can)
directions: Combine beef, rice, eggs, salt, pepper and Texas Pete.
Place 1/2 of the meat mixture in a baking dish; place cheese slices on top.
Put the rest of the meat mixture over the cheese slices. Mix the ketchup, sugar, water, vinegar and worcestershire; put this sauce mixture on top.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour and 15 minutes.
recipes.text: Creole Meat Loaf. Combine beef, rice, eggs, salt, pepper and Texas Pete. Place 1/2 of the meat mixture in a baking dish; place cheese slices on top. Put the rest of the meat mixture over the cheese slices. Mix the ketchup, sugar, water, vinegar and worcestershire; put this sauce mixture on top. Bake at 350° for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Fillet Of Sole With Crabmeat Stuffing
directions: Preheat oven to 350°.
Butter a baking dish large enough to hold the fillets in 1 layer.
Mix the bread crumbs, crabmeat and sherry together in a bowl.
Then add the lemon juice.
(The mixture should be moist, but not wet.)
Place one-fourth of the stuffing on each fillet and roll the fillets up around the stuffing, keeping it tucked inside.
Secure with a toothpick. Place the rolls in the prepared baking dish, seam side down. Sprinkle them lightly with paprika and dot each with 1 tablespoon butter.
Bake for 10 minutes at 350° or until fish flakes when gently prodded with a fork.
Serve immediately.
Serves 4.
recipes.text: Fillet Of Sole With Crabmeat Stuffing. Preheat oven to 350°. Butter a baking dish large enough to hold the fillets in 1 layer. Mix the bread crumbs, crabmeat and sherry together in a bowl. Then add the lemon juice. (The mixture should be moist, but not wet.) Place one-fourth of the stuffing on each fillet and roll the fillets up around the stuffing, keeping it tucked inside. Secure with a toothpick. Place the rolls in the prepared baking dish, seam side down. Sprinkle them lightly with paprika and dot each with 1 tablespoon butter. Bake for 10 minutes at 350° or until fish flakes when gently prodded with a fork. Serve immediately. Serves 4.

recipes.title: Church Punch
directions: Combine all ingredients in punch bowl over ice.
If too strong, you may add a little water for taste.
recipes.text: Church Punch. Combine all ingredients in punch bowl over ice. If too strong, you may add a little water for taste.

recipes.title: Easy Chocolate Chip Cheesecake!
directions: Mix cream cheese, sugar and vanilla at medium speed with mixer until well blended.
Add eggs and blend again.
Stir in 3/4 cup chips.
Pour into pie crust and sprinkle top of mixture with remaining 1/4 cup chips.
Bake at 350° for approximately 40 minutes or until center is almost firm.
Cool and refrigerate at least 4 hours, overnight is fine.
Garnish with additional chips and/or chocolate Cool Whip.
recipes.text: Easy Chocolate Chip Cheesecake!. Mix cream cheese, sugar and vanilla at medium speed with mixer until well blended. Add eggs and blend again. Stir in 3/4 cup chips. Pour into pie crust and sprinkle top of mixture with remaining 1/4 cup chips. Bake at 350° for approximately 40 minutes or until center is almost firm. Cool and refrigerate at least 4 hours, overnight is fine. Garnish with additional chips and/or chocolate Cool Whip.

recipes.title: Izena Dip
directions: Mix together and use it for fresh vegetables.
recipes.text: Izena Dip. Mix together and use it for fresh vegetables.

recipes.title: Casserole
directions: Put 1 can cream of celery soup (undiluted) in electric skillet.
Slice potatoes on top of soup.
Put cabbage on top of potatoes, then green chilies on top of cabbage.
Put another can of undiluted cream of celery soup on top of this.
Cook until vegetables are done.
Slice German sausage on top of this; cook just until sausage is warmed.
recipes.text: Casserole. Put 1 can cream of celery soup (undiluted) in electric skillet. Slice potatoes on top of soup. Put cabbage on top of potatoes, then green chilies on top of cabbage. Put another can of undiluted cream of celery soup on top of this. Cook until vegetables are done. Slice German sausage on top of this; cook just until sausage is warmed.

recipes.title: Bread Pudding
directions: Mix the first 5 ingredients together.
Tear bread in small pieces, then pour liquid over bread.
Sprinkle with nutmeg on top. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Bread Pudding. Mix the first 5 ingredients together. Tear bread in small pieces, then pour liquid over bread. Sprinkle with nutmeg on top. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Hawaiian Cake
ingredients: 20 oz. can crushed pineapple, well drained
1/2 c. maraschino cherries, drained and chopped
directions: Prepare cake according to directions on package.
Pour into greased 10 x 15-inch jelly roll pan.
Bake in preheated oven of 350° for 15 to 20 minutes or until done.
Cool in pan.
Blend pudding mix with milk; beat in cream cheese (room temperature), then fold in Cool Whip.
Spread on cooled cake.
Sprinkle drained pineapple over pudding, then cherries, nuts and coconut. Refrigerate until ready to cut.
Can be made a day ahead.
recipes.text: Hawaiian Cake. Prepare cake according to directions on package. Pour into greased 10 x 15-inch jelly roll pan. Bake in preheated oven of 350° for 15 to 20 minutes or until done. Cool in pan. Blend pudding mix with milk; beat in cream cheese (room temperature), then fold in Cool Whip. Spread on cooled cake. Sprinkle drained pineapple over pudding, then cherries, nuts and coconut. Refrigerate until ready to cut. Can be made a day ahead.

recipes.title: Rene'S Lemonade
directions: Put water in cup.
Put spoon of lemonade mix in cup.
Stir it. Drink it.
recipes.text: Rene'S Lemonade. Put water in cup. Put spoon of lemonade mix in cup. Stir it. Drink it.

recipes.title: Fried Green Tomatoes
ingredients: 4 to 6 green tomatoes, sliced 1/2-inch thick (do not peel)
3/4 c. fine dry bread crumbs/corn meal
directions: Slice green tomatoes 1/2 inch thick (do not peel).
Dip in milk, then in plain flour mixed with salt and pepper, then in the beaten eggs, then in the bread crumbs or corn meal.
Fry over medium-low heat for 8 to 10 minutes on each side, or until brown. Use a heavy pan and 1/2 cup shortening.
Add more shortening as needed.
recipes.text: Fried Green Tomatoes. Slice green tomatoes 1/2 inch thick (do not peel). Dip in milk, then in plain flour mixed with salt and pepper, then in the beaten eggs, then in the bread crumbs or corn meal. Fry over medium-low heat for 8 to 10 minutes on each side, or until brown. Use a heavy pan and 1/2 cup shortening. Add more shortening as needed.

recipes.title: Poor Man'S Steak
directions: In large bowl, combine first 5 ingredients.
Pat mixture on a cookie sheet, refrigerate overnight.
Cut into 6 squares, roll each square in flour and brown in large skillet coated with vegetable cooking spray.
Place in 9 x 13-inch baking pan.
Cover with mushroom soup.
Bake 40 to 50 minutes at 350°.
Yields 6 servings.
recipes.text: Poor Man'S Steak. In large bowl, combine first 5 ingredients. Pat mixture on a cookie sheet, refrigerate overnight. Cut into 6 squares, roll each square in flour and brown in large skillet coated with vegetable cooking spray. Place in 9 x 13-inch baking pan. Cover with mushroom soup. Bake 40 to 50 minutes at 350°. Yields 6 servings.

recipes.title: Chicken A La King With Pepper Biscuits
ingredients: 1 x 10-11 oz. pkg. Large refrigerated buttermilk biscuits
5 medium size skinless, boneless chicken breasts
2 Medium red bell peppers, chopped into 1 1/2-inch pieces
1 x 12 oz. jar Chicken flavor gravy
directions: Preheat oven to 375°f. 190°c. gas mark 5. Prepare biscuits as label directs but brush biscuit tops with egg white and sprinkle with the black pepper.
Bake as directed and keep warm.
Cut the chicken into 2 cubes, and in a non stick 12-inch skillet over a medium heat, in 1 tablespoon of hot oil, cook the chicken until browned and the juices run clear.
Remove chicken to a bowl.

In the same skillet add 1 more tablespoon of hot oil and 2 tablespoons of water, cook the red pepper and onion until browned and tender. Return the chicken to the skillet with any accumulated juices from the bowl.
Stir in the gravy, milk and frozen peas; heat through. Serve with the warm biscuits.
Serves 5.
recipes.text: Chicken A La King With Pepper Biscuits. Preheat oven to 375°f. 190°c. gas mark 5. Prepare biscuits as label directs but brush biscuit tops with egg white and sprinkle with the black pepper. Bake as directed and keep warm. Cut the chicken into 2 cubes, and in a non stick 12-inch skillet over a medium heat, in 1 tablespoon of hot oil, cook the chicken until browned and the juices run clear. Remove chicken to a bowl. In the same skillet add 1 more tablespoon of hot oil and 2 tablespoons of water, cook the red pepper and onion until browned and tender. Return the chicken to the skillet with any accumulated juices from the bowl. Stir in the gravy, milk and frozen peas; heat through. Serve with the warm biscuits. Serves 5.

recipes.title: Irish Cream
ingredients: 1 (14 oz.) can Eagle Brand sweetened condensed milk
directions: Blend ingredients in blender until smooth.
Keeps for 1 month in refrigerator.
recipes.text: Irish Cream. Blend ingredients in blender until smooth. Keeps for 1 month in refrigerator.

recipes.title: Five Cup Fruit Salad
directions: Drain fruit real good before mixing with other ingredients. Prepare night before and place in refrigerator.
recipes.text: Five Cup Fruit Salad. Drain fruit real good before mixing with other ingredients. Prepare night before and place in refrigerator.

recipes.title: Date Sticks
ingredients: 2 c. dates, pitted and finely cut
directions: Sift flour once; add baking powder and salt gradually to eggs; add butter.
Beat in dates and nuts.
Add flour alternately with hot water, beating well.
Divide mixture into two greased pans, 8 x 8 x 2-inches, spreading batter thin.
Bake in slow oven, 325°, for 30 to 35 minutes.
Cool; cut in strips, 2 3/4 x 1-inch. Remove from pans and roll in powdered sugar.
Makes about 48.
recipes.text: Date Sticks. Sift flour once; add baking powder and salt gradually to eggs; add butter. Beat in dates and nuts. Add flour alternately with hot water, beating well. Divide mixture into two greased pans, 8 x 8 x 2-inches, spreading batter thin. Bake in slow oven, 325°, for 30 to 35 minutes. Cool; cut in strips, 2 3/4 x 1-inch. Remove from pans and roll in powdered sugar. Makes about 48.

recipes.title: Italian Pannettone
directions: Scald milk; stir in sugar, salt and butter.
Slightly cool. Measure warm water into a bowl.
Dissolve yeast into warm water. Stir in milk mixture.
Stir in eggs and 2 cups flour.
Make smooth batter.
stir in fruits, nuts and anise.
Now, add more flour to make stiff dough.
Turn onto lightly floured board.
Knead until smooth and elastic.
Cover and let rise in a greased bowl (about 1 hour).
Punch down, cover and rise 1/2 hour again.
recipes.text: Italian Pannettone. Scald milk; stir in sugar, salt and butter. Slightly cool. Measure warm water into a bowl. Dissolve yeast into warm water. Stir in milk mixture. Stir in eggs and 2 cups flour. Make smooth batter. stir in fruits, nuts and anise. Now, add more flour to make stiff dough. Turn onto lightly floured board. Knead until smooth and elastic. Cover and let rise in a greased bowl (about 1 hour). Punch down, cover and rise 1/2 hour again.

recipes.title: Chinese Casserole
ingredients: 1 stalk celery, chopped with tops on
1 box wild rice (don't use seasoning pkg.)
directions: Brown sausage and remove from fat.
Saute vegetables in fat. Add soup and rice to 4 1/2 cups of water.
Cook until done.
Drain off excess water.
Add vegetables and water chestnuts to sausage. Put in large casserole dish.
Top with almonds.
Bake in 350° oven for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Chinese Casserole. Brown sausage and remove from fat. Saute vegetables in fat. Add soup and rice to 4 1/2 cups of water. Cook until done. Drain off excess water. Add vegetables and water chestnuts to sausage. Put in large casserole dish. Top with almonds. Bake in 350° oven for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Supper Sandwich Bake
directions: Spread butter on bread; put in pan and toast.
Combine beef, catsup and salt and spread on toast.
Top with frankfurters, cut almost in half lengthwise.
Add onion slices and cheese slices. Combine eggs and milk; pour over the bread.
Bake in moderate oven for 50 minutes.
Makes 6 sandwiches.
This is a meal in itself.
recipes.text: Supper Sandwich Bake. Spread butter on bread; put in pan and toast. Combine beef, catsup and salt and spread on toast. Top with frankfurters, cut almost in half lengthwise. Add onion slices and cheese slices. Combine eggs and milk; pour over the bread. Bake in moderate oven for 50 minutes. Makes 6 sandwiches. This is a meal in itself.

recipes.title: Stove Top Baked Beans
directions: Drain sauce from pork and beans.
Put beans, brown sugar, ketchup, onion and bacon bits in a 3-quart saucepan.
Bring to a full boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 15 to 20 minutes, until thick.
Serve hot or warm.
recipes.text: Stove Top Baked Beans. Drain sauce from pork and beans. Put beans, brown sugar, ketchup, onion and bacon bits in a 3-quart saucepan. Bring to a full boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 15 to 20 minutes, until thick. Serve hot or warm.

recipes.title: Thumbprint Cookies
ingredients: 1 egg white, beaten slightly with fork
directions: Mix together first 6 ingredients and put in refrigerator overnight.
Remove and roll into little balls; dip into egg white, then into ground nuts.
Put on greased cookie sheet.
Press thumb in cookie dough and bake at 350° for 12 to 15 minutes.
recipes.text: Thumbprint Cookies. Mix together first 6 ingredients and put in refrigerator overnight. Remove and roll into little balls; dip into egg white, then into ground nuts. Put on greased cookie sheet. Press thumb in cookie dough and bake at 350° for 12 to 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Chicken Salad Casserole
directions: Combine all except cheese, potato chips and almonds.
Place in a large rectangular dish.
Top with cheese, almonds and potato chips.
recipes.text: Chicken Salad Casserole. Combine all except cheese, potato chips and almonds. Place in a large rectangular dish. Top with cheese, almonds and potato chips.

recipes.title: Zucchini Bake
directions: Cook the first 4 ingredients until almost tender.
Beat the eggs and add to above.
Add the salt and Italian seasoning.
Cover until firm.
Can be put in a 350° oven at this point.
Cook for 25 minutes, or until bubbly.
Makes 6 servings.
recipes.text: Zucchini Bake. Cook the first 4 ingredients until almost tender. Beat the eggs and add to above. Add the salt and Italian seasoning. Cover until firm. Can be put in a 350° oven at this point. Cook for 25 minutes, or until bubbly. Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Banana Nut Bread
ingredients: 1 c. banana pulp (2 or 3 bananas mashed)
directions: Sift flour and dry ingredients.
Add sugar to Crisco and cream until fluffy. Blend in one egg at a time.
Mix until smooth and light after each.
Stir in nuts and lemon rind.
Add flour alternately with banana pulp. Blend well.
Pour into a well-greased loaf pan.
Bake at 350° for 55 minutes or until brown. Cool on wire rack.
recipes.text: Banana Nut Bread. Sift flour and dry ingredients. Add sugar to Crisco and cream until fluffy. Blend in one egg at a time. Mix until smooth and light after each. Stir in nuts and lemon rind. Add flour alternately with banana pulp. Blend well. Pour into a well-greased loaf pan. Bake at 350° for 55 minutes or until brown. Cool on wire rack.

recipes.title: Cheese Ball
ingredients: 2 pkg. chipped or corned beef, chopped fine
directions: Combine all ingredients and one package chipped or corned beef.
The second package is used for outside of cheese ball.
recipes.text: Cheese Ball. Combine all ingredients and one package chipped or corned beef. The second package is used for outside of cheese ball.

recipes.title: Kraut Salad
directions: Heat vinegar, oil and sugar until sugar dissolves. Pour over salad ingredients and toss until well coated. Refrigerate at least 3 hours.
recipes.text: Kraut Salad. Heat vinegar, oil and sugar until sugar dissolves. Pour over salad ingredients and toss until well coated. Refrigerate at least 3 hours.

recipes.title: German Chocolate Upside-Down Cake
directions: Grease and flour a 9 x 13 x 2-inch cake pan.
Mix the nuts and coconut and place in bottom of pan.
Mix the cake mix as directed on box and pour over first layer.
Mix the remaining ingredients and spoon on top of the chocolate.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.
recipes.text: German Chocolate Upside-Down Cake. Grease and flour a 9 x 13 x 2-inch cake pan. Mix the nuts and coconut and place in bottom of pan. Mix the cake mix as directed on box and pour over first layer. Mix the remaining ingredients and spoon on top of the chocolate. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Chocolate Marshmallow Dominoes
directions: Line an 8-inch square pan with aluminum foil.
Arrange marshmallows in rows over foil.
Melt chocolate chips on very low heat.
Add peanut butter and butter.
Blend well.
Pour chocolate mixture over marshmallows.
With back of spoon, work chocolate into spaces on all sides of marshmallows.
Chill for 2 hours or until chocolate hardens.
Turn candy out of pan upside down.
Pull off foil.
Cut into 36 pieces with a marshmallow in center of each.
recipes.text: Chocolate Marshmallow Dominoes. Line an 8-inch square pan with aluminum foil. Arrange marshmallows in rows over foil. Melt chocolate chips on very low heat. Add peanut butter and butter. Blend well. Pour chocolate mixture over marshmallows. With back of spoon, work chocolate into spaces on all sides of marshmallows. Chill for 2 hours or until chocolate hardens. Turn candy out of pan upside down. Pull off foil. Cut into 36 pieces with a marshmallow in center of each.

recipes.title: Chocolate Chip Butterscotch Bars
ingredients: 1 c. dark brown sugar, firmly packed
directions: Preheat oven to 300°.
Grease an 8 x 8-inch baking pan. Combine flour and soda in a medium bowl; mix well with wire whisk. Set aside.
In a
large bowl, use an electric mixer to blend the sugar and butter.
Add egg and vanilla.
Beat at medium speed until light and smooth. Scrape down sides of bowl, then add the flour mixture, pecans and chocolate chips.
Blend at low speed until just combined.
Do not overmix.
Place batter in pan.
Level evenly.
Bake for 35 to 45 minutes.
Cool and cut into 1 x 2-inch bars.
Yields 16 bars.
recipes.text: Chocolate Chip Butterscotch Bars. Preheat oven to 300°. Grease an 8 x 8-inch baking pan. Combine flour and soda in a medium bowl; mix well with wire whisk. Set aside. In a large bowl, use an electric mixer to blend the sugar and butter. Add egg and vanilla. Beat at medium speed until light and smooth. Scrape down sides of bowl, then add the flour mixture, pecans and chocolate chips. Blend at low speed until just combined. Do not overmix. Place batter in pan. Level evenly. Bake for 35 to 45 minutes. Cool and cut into 1 x 2-inch bars. Yields 16 bars.

recipes.title: Garlic And Dill Pickles
directions: Boil your vinegar, water and salt; put your grapes, dill and garlic in bottom of your jars.
Put your cucumbers in.
Pour your boiling ingredients over pickles and seal.
recipes.text: Garlic And Dill Pickles. Boil your vinegar, water and salt; put your grapes, dill and garlic in bottom of your jars. Put your cucumbers in. Pour your boiling ingredients over pickles and seal.

recipes.title: Spaghetti Sauce
directions: Saute onion and bell pepper in butter until tender. Add ground beef.
Cook until meat loses pink color.
Add tomato paste, Worcestershire sauce, red pepper sauce, chili pepper and garlic. Mix well.
Simmer over low heat 3 to 4 hours.
Thin with tomato juice, if needed.
recipes.text: Spaghetti Sauce. Saute onion and bell pepper in butter until tender. Add ground beef. Cook until meat loses pink color. Add tomato paste, Worcestershire sauce, red pepper sauce, chili pepper and garlic. Mix well. Simmer over low heat 3 to 4 hours. Thin with tomato juice, if needed.

recipes.title: No Cholesterol Orange Pound Cake
directions: Preheat oven to 350°.
Grease and flour bottom of 8 1/2 x 4 1/2 x 2 1/2-inch loaf pan.
In large bowl, stir together flour, sugar, baking powder and salt.
Add oil and orange juice.
Beat on medium speed until smooth.
Add peel.
In small bowl beat egg whites on high speed until stiff peaks form.
Fold egg whites into flour mixture.
Turn into pan.
Bake 50 minutes or until cake springs back when slightly touched.
Cool 10 minutes in pan.
Remove and cool completely on rack.
One loaf contains about 160 calories per 1/2-inch slice.
recipes.text: No Cholesterol Orange Pound Cake. Preheat oven to 350°. Grease and flour bottom of 8 1/2 x 4 1/2 x 2 1/2-inch loaf pan. In large bowl, stir together flour, sugar, baking powder and salt. Add oil and orange juice. Beat on medium speed until smooth. Add peel. In small bowl beat egg whites on high speed until stiff peaks form. Fold egg whites into flour mixture. Turn into pan. Bake 50 minutes or until cake springs back when slightly touched. Cool 10 minutes in pan. Remove and cool completely on rack. One loaf contains about 160 calories per 1/2-inch slice.

recipes.title: Jello Popcorn Balls
directions: Bring Jell-O, white syrup and sugar to a boil for 1 minute; pour over popcorn and form into balls with butter on hands.
Wrap and store away.
recipes.text: Jello Popcorn Balls. Bring Jell-O, white syrup and sugar to a boil for 1 minute; pour over popcorn and form into balls with butter on hands. Wrap and store away.

recipes.title: Pineapple Delight Pie
directions: This makes 2 pies (reduce ingredients in half for 1 pie).
recipes.text: Pineapple Delight Pie. This makes 2 pies (reduce ingredients in half for 1 pie).

recipes.title: Mexican Hot Dip
directions: In casserole dish, put 8 ounces cream cheese on bottom, then the chili and green chilies.
Sprinkle with the shredded cheese. Bake at 325° until bubbly.
Serve with corn chips.
recipes.text: Mexican Hot Dip. In casserole dish, put 8 ounces cream cheese on bottom, then the chili and green chilies. Sprinkle with the shredded cheese. Bake at 325° until bubbly. Serve with corn chips.

recipes.title: Choco-Peanut Oat Bars
directions: Preheat oven to 350°.
Place 2-quart pan on burner; add butter and melt over low heat, stirring.
Turn off burner.
Place flour, oats, brown sugar, coconut and peanuts in bowl and mix.
Add butter to flour mixture and mix well.
Spoon into ungreased baking pan, scraping bowl.
Press mixture evenly into pan.
Bake about 20 minutes.
Turn off oven.
Sprinkle chocolate chips over warm cookie and spread evenly with spatula.
Let cool.
Makes 30 cookies.
recipes.text: Choco-Peanut Oat Bars. Preheat oven to 350°. Place 2-quart pan on burner; add butter and melt over low heat, stirring. Turn off burner. Place flour, oats, brown sugar, coconut and peanuts in bowl and mix. Add butter to flour mixture and mix well. Spoon into ungreased baking pan, scraping bowl. Press mixture evenly into pan. Bake about 20 minutes. Turn off oven. Sprinkle chocolate chips over warm cookie and spread evenly with spatula. Let cool. Makes 30 cookies.

recipes.title: Louisiana Dirty Rice
ingredients: 1 lb. beef or pork sausage, chopped up well
1 tsp. red pepper or to taste
directions: Cook rice separate.
Cook all other ingredients together.
Mix with rice and green onions.
Salt and pepper as desired.
Serve very hot.
recipes.text: Louisiana Dirty Rice. Cook rice separate. Cook all other ingredients together. Mix with rice and green onions. Salt and pepper as desired. Serve very hot.

recipes.title: Chicken Bites
directions: Heat oven to 400°.
Cut chicken into 1-inch pieces.
Dip pieces into melted margarine, then into bread crumbs.
Place chicken pieces, about 1/2-inch apart on cookie sheets.
Bake uncovered until golden brown, 20 to 25 minutes.
Makes about 6 dozen appetizers.
recipes.text: Chicken Bites. Heat oven to 400°. Cut chicken into 1-inch pieces. Dip pieces into melted margarine, then into bread crumbs. Place chicken pieces, about 1/2-inch apart on cookie sheets. Bake uncovered until golden brown, 20 to 25 minutes. Makes about 6 dozen appetizers.

recipes.title: Football Party Dip
ingredients: 2 pkg. Hidden Valley Ranch (Original Ranch party dip)
directions: Blend cream cheese and party dip together. Stir in diced red peppers and diced black olives. Chill an hour. Using a spatula, form a football shape on a platter; chill 4 hours or overnight. Decorate football using vegetable slices and cheese strips. If you have to, look at a football.
recipes.text: Football Party Dip. Blend cream cheese and party dip together. Stir in diced red peppers and diced black olives. Chill an hour. Using a spatula, form a football shape on a platter; chill 4 hours or overnight. Decorate football using vegetable slices and cheese strips. If you have to, look at a football.

recipes.title: Cheese Scalloped Carrots
directions: Cook carrots until tender.
Layer carrots and cheese slices in a 2 quart casserole.
Saute onion in oleo.
Stir in flour, salt, mustard and milk.
Cook until thickened, stirring constantly. Add pepper and celery salt.
Bake 35 to 45 minutes at 350° after pouring over carrots and cheese.
recipes.text: Cheese Scalloped Carrots. Cook carrots until tender. Layer carrots and cheese slices in a 2 quart casserole. Saute onion in oleo. Stir in flour, salt, mustard and milk. Cook until thickened, stirring constantly. Add pepper and celery salt. Bake 35 to 45 minutes at 350° after pouring over carrots and cheese.

recipes.title: Crab Spread
directions: Combine sour cream, cream cheese, lemon juice, horseradish and Old Bay.
Stir over low heat until bubbly.
Add green pepper and flaked crab meat.
Continue to heat until crab is heated through. Serve with variety of crackers, chunks of bread or fresh vegetables.
recipes.text: Crab Spread. Combine sour cream, cream cheese, lemon juice, horseradish and Old Bay. Stir over low heat until bubbly. Add green pepper and flaked crab meat. Continue to heat until crab is heated through. Serve with variety of crackers, chunks of bread or fresh vegetables.

recipes.title: Snickerdoodles
directions: Preheat oven to 400°.
Combine shortening, sugar and eggs; mix together.
Sift together the flour, cream of tartar, soda and salt; add to shortening mixture.
Roll the dough into small balls; roll in mixture of sugar and cinnamon.
Place on ungreased cookie sheet.
Bake for 8 to 10 minutes.
recipes.text: Snickerdoodles. Preheat oven to 400°. Combine shortening, sugar and eggs; mix together. Sift together the flour, cream of tartar, soda and salt; add to shortening mixture. Roll the dough into small balls; roll in mixture of sugar and cinnamon. Place on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake for 8 to 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Coke Congealed Salad
directions: Bring cherries and jello to a boil.
Add Cokes and cream cheese.
Let stand until room temperature.
Add pineapple and pecans.
Refrigerate.
recipes.text: Coke Congealed Salad. Bring cherries and jello to a boil. Add Cokes and cream cheese. Let stand until room temperature. Add pineapple and pecans. Refrigerate.

recipes.title: Crisp Pickle Slices(Bread And Butter)
directions: Combine the first 5 ingredients; cover with cracked ice or ice cubes.
Mix thoroughly.
Let stand 3 hours; drain thoroughly. Combine remaining ingredients and pour over cucumbers, onions and peppers.
Heat just to boil.
Seal in hot, sterilized jars. Yield:
5 pints.
recipes.text: Crisp Pickle Slices(Bread And Butter). Combine the first 5 ingredients; cover with cracked ice or ice cubes. Mix thoroughly. Let stand 3 hours; drain thoroughly. Combine remaining ingredients and pour over cucumbers, onions and peppers. Heat just to boil. Seal in hot, sterilized jars. Yield: 5 pints.

recipes.title: Ricotta Cheese Pancakes
directions: In a blender jar, combine Ricotta, eggs, salad oil, flour, sugar and salt.
Cover and blend until smooth; push ingredients from sides of blender or food processor with rubber spatula.
Pour batter in about 3-inch rounds on a lightly greased griddle or wide frying pan over medium-low heat.
Turn cakes with a spatula when bubbles form on the surface.
When browned lightly on both sides, remove from pan.
Keep warm until all are cooked.
To make ahead, cool pancakes or wire racks, then to reheat, place in a single layer on a baking sheet.
Cover and bake 5 minutes at 375°. Serve with fruit and powdered sugar.
recipes.text: Ricotta Cheese Pancakes. In a blender jar, combine Ricotta, eggs, salad oil, flour, sugar and salt. Cover and blend until smooth; push ingredients from sides of blender or food processor with rubber spatula. Pour batter in about 3-inch rounds on a lightly greased griddle or wide frying pan over medium-low heat. Turn cakes with a spatula when bubbles form on the surface. When browned lightly on both sides, remove from pan. Keep warm until all are cooked. To make ahead, cool pancakes or wire racks, then to reheat, place in a single layer on a baking sheet. Cover and bake 5 minutes at 375°. Serve with fruit and powdered sugar.

recipes.title: Scalloped Potatoes In A Hurry
directions: Peel and slice potatoes.
In pan, add soup and 1/2 can milk. Heat until smooth.
Place potatoes in casserole alternately with onion.
Add soup and cover.
Bake at 350° in oven for 1 1/2 hours or until done.
Remove cover last 20 minutes.
(May substitute cream of mushroom soup.)
recipes.text: Scalloped Potatoes In A Hurry. Peel and slice potatoes. In pan, add soup and 1/2 can milk. Heat until smooth. Place potatoes in casserole alternately with onion. Add soup and cover. Bake at 350° in oven for 1 1/2 hours or until done. Remove cover last 20 minutes. (May substitute cream of mushroom soup.)

recipes.title: Baked Lasagne
ingredients: 1 lb. pkg. Mueller's Italian style lasagne
pinch of oregano or 1 Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
directions: Boil Mueller's Italian style lasagne
in 4 quarts of rapidly boiling water (add 1 tablespoon salt to water) for 12 minutes. Stir gently. Drain. Add 1 tablespoon olive oil to prevent sticking. Let cool.
recipes.text: Baked Lasagne. Boil Mueller's Italian style lasagne in 4 quarts of rapidly boiling water (add 1 tablespoon salt to water) for 12 minutes. Stir gently. Drain. Add 1 tablespoon olive oil to prevent sticking. Let cool.

recipes.title: Christmas Punch
directions: Mix together and pour over ice in punch bowl.
Smaller amounts may be used.
recipes.text: Christmas Punch. Mix together and pour over ice in punch bowl. Smaller amounts may be used.

recipes.title: Jelly-Jam
directions: Let rhubarb and sugar set 2 or 3 hours, then boil until done. Add strawberry Jell-O and Kool-Aid.
Put into glasses.
recipes.text: Jelly-Jam. Let rhubarb and sugar set 2 or 3 hours, then boil until done. Add strawberry Jell-O and Kool-Aid. Put into glasses.

recipes.title: Cheese Straws
ingredients: 2 c. self-rising flour, unsifted when measured
directions: Cream grated cheese and margarine.
Sift flour and salt and pepper together.
Add the dry mixture to cheese and margarine. (Use hands or mixer to work until well mixed.) Use pastry tube with "star" plate to make straws.
Bake 12 minutes in a preheated 375° oven.
(Yields approximately 100 three-inch straws; this allows for some broken straws.)
recipes.text: Cheese Straws. Cream grated cheese and margarine. Sift flour and salt and pepper together. Add the dry mixture to cheese and margarine. (Use hands or mixer to work until well mixed.) Use pastry tube with "star" plate to make straws. Bake 12 minutes in a preheated 375° oven. (Yields approximately 100 three-inch straws; this allows for some broken straws.)

recipes.title: Coffee-Time Twists
ingredients: 1/4 c. light cream, soured with 1 Tbsp. vinegar
directions: Soften yeast in warm water.
Heat cream to lukewarm; combine with sugar, shortening, salt and soda.
Add 1 cup flour.
Beat. Add yeast and eggs.
Beat well.
Stir in rest of flour.
Turn out on floured board.
Knead until smooth.
Roll into 24 x 6-inch rectangle, 1/4-inch thick.
Fold over lengthwise half of dough. After combining brown sugar and cinnamon, butter dough; spread sugar mix on half.
Cut into 1-inch strips.
To form rolls, hold strips at both ends and twist in opposite directions.
Place on greased pan; set in warm place to rise.
Bake at 350° for 12 to 15 minutes.
While warm, ice with powdered sugar icing.
recipes.text: Coffee-Time Twists. Soften yeast in warm water. Heat cream to lukewarm; combine with sugar, shortening, salt and soda. Add 1 cup flour. Beat. Add yeast and eggs. Beat well. Stir in rest of flour. Turn out on floured board. Knead until smooth. Roll into 24 x 6-inch rectangle, 1/4-inch thick. Fold over lengthwise half of dough. After combining brown sugar and cinnamon, butter dough; spread sugar mix on half. Cut into 1-inch strips. To form rolls, hold strips at both ends and twist in opposite directions. Place on greased pan; set in warm place to rise. Bake at 350° for 12 to 15 minutes. While warm, ice with powdered sugar icing.

recipes.title: Easy Clam Chowder
directions: Drain clams.
Mix all ingredients.
Heat and serve with crackers.
recipes.text: Easy Clam Chowder. Drain clams. Mix all ingredients. Heat and serve with crackers.

recipes.title: Pizzeria Macaroni
directions: Preheat oven to 350°.
Brown meat; pour off fat.
Add onion, stir until tender.
Stir in sauce and all of the seasonings. Simmer uncovered for 10 minutes.
Then mix egg, milk and beat together and pour over macaroni.
Mix well.
Pour macaroni mixture in 13 x 9-inch pan; add sauce with meat and spices over macaroni. Over top put shredded Mozzarella cheese.
Bake 1/2 hour and let stand 10 minutes before cutting.
recipes.text: Pizzeria Macaroni. Preheat oven to 350°. Brown meat; pour off fat. Add onion, stir until tender. Stir in sauce and all of the seasonings. Simmer uncovered for 10 minutes. Then mix egg, milk and beat together and pour over macaroni. Mix well. Pour macaroni mixture in 13 x 9-inch pan; add sauce with meat and spices over macaroni. Over top put shredded Mozzarella cheese. Bake 1/2 hour and let stand 10 minutes before cutting.

recipes.title: Angel Biscuits
directions: Sift dry ingredients together.
Blend in Crisco; dissolve yeast in warm water.
Let yeast stand 5 minutes.
Then mix buttermilk and yeast to flour mixture.
Mix well.
Turn out on floured pastry sheet.
Roll out to desired thickness.
Cut out. Place on greased pan.
Place a pat of butter on top.
Bake at 450° for 12 minutes.
recipes.text: Angel Biscuits. Sift dry ingredients together. Blend in Crisco; dissolve yeast in warm water. Let yeast stand 5 minutes. Then mix buttermilk and yeast to flour mixture. Mix well. Turn out on floured pastry sheet. Roll out to desired thickness. Cut out. Place on greased pan. Place a pat of butter on top. Bake at 450° for 12 minutes.

recipes.title: Broccoli Casserole
directions: Cook broccoli 5 minutes; drain well.
Combine all remaining ingredients, except cracker crumbs for sauce.
Add broccoli.
Pour into greased casserole.
Top with crumbs.
Bake 20 or 30 minutes at 350°.
recipes.text: Broccoli Casserole. Cook broccoli 5 minutes; drain well. Combine all remaining ingredients, except cracker crumbs for sauce. Add broccoli. Pour into greased casserole. Top with crumbs. Bake 20 or 30 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Pinch Bread
directions: Pinch bread into small pieces and place in loaf pan.
Combine parsley, salt, garlic salt and egg; beat with fork.
Pour over pinched bread.
(Do not let bread rise.)
Bake at 350° for 25 to 35 minutes.
recipes.text: Pinch Bread. Pinch bread into small pieces and place in loaf pan. Combine parsley, salt, garlic salt and egg; beat with fork. Pour over pinched bread. (Do not let bread rise.) Bake at 350° for 25 to 35 minutes.

recipes.title: Poor Man'S Filet Mignon
directions: Combine first 8 ingredients and 2 tablespoons barbecue sauce. Form into 12 thick patties.

Wrap bacon slice around the sides of each patty and secure with a toothpick. Bake on a rack at 350° for 50 to 60 minutes or until done. Baste frequently with barbecue sauce the last 30 minutes. Serves 12.
recipes.text: Poor Man'S Filet Mignon. Combine first 8 ingredients and 2 tablespoons barbecue sauce. Form into 12 thick patties. Wrap bacon slice around the sides of each patty and secure with a toothpick. Bake on a rack at 350° for 50 to 60 minutes or until done. Baste frequently with barbecue sauce the last 30 minutes. Serves 12.

recipes.title: Cheesecake
directions: Cream the cream cheese with the sugar.
Add eggs, beating until smooth.
Stir in sour cream and vanilla.
Pour into prepared pan. Bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours.
Cool and then chill.
recipes.text: Cheesecake. Cream the cream cheese with the sugar. Add eggs, beating until smooth. Stir in sour cream and vanilla. Pour into prepared pan. Bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours. Cool and then chill.

recipes.title: New Baby Chicken(Easy To Prepare - Good Dish To Bring To The "New Mom")
ingredients: 1/4 c. white wine or dry vermouth
directions: Arrange chicken in bottom of 9 x 13-inch dish.
Place a slice of cheese on each breast.
Top with mushrooms.
Mix soup and wine; pour over chicken.
Sprinkle stuffing on top, then drizzle with butter.
Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 50 to 55 minutes.
Serves 8.
recipes.text: New Baby Chicken(Easy To Prepare - Good Dish To Bring To The "New Mom"). Arrange chicken in bottom of 9 x 13-inch dish. Place a slice of cheese on each breast. Top with mushrooms. Mix soup and wine; pour over chicken. Sprinkle stuffing on top, then drizzle with butter. Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 50 to 55 minutes. Serves 8.

recipes.title: Christmas Tree Salad
directions: Dissolve Jello in 1 cup boiling water.
Let cool.
Add Philadelphia cream cheese, pineapple and Cool Whip.
Mix with beater.
Add nuts.
For tree effect pour salad mixture in coffee cup liners.
Gel.
Dip in hot water to loosen.
Turn upside down on leaf of lettuce.
Top with Cool Whip.
Place a Maraschino cherry on top of tree for effect, or pour into small square pan.
recipes.text: Christmas Tree Salad. Dissolve Jello in 1 cup boiling water. Let cool. Add Philadelphia cream cheese, pineapple and Cool Whip. Mix with beater. Add nuts. For tree effect pour salad mixture in coffee cup liners. Gel. Dip in hot water to loosen. Turn upside down on leaf of lettuce. Top with Cool Whip. Place a Maraschino cherry on top of tree for effect, or pour into small square pan.

recipes.title: Chocolate Mint Meltaways
directions: In a large mixer bowl, beat butter and sugar, add egg and vanilla, blending well.
In a separate bowl, combine flour, cocoa, baking soda and salt.
Add to butter mixture alternately with milk; blend well.
Refrigerate for 1 hour or until firm.
Mold dough over patties and cover completely.
Place on a greased cookie sheet.
Bake at 350° for 10 to 12 minutes.
Cool for 1 minute on cookie tray, then remove to wire rack.
Cool completely.
recipes.text: Chocolate Mint Meltaways. In a large mixer bowl, beat butter and sugar, add egg and vanilla, blending well. In a separate bowl, combine flour, cocoa, baking soda and salt. Add to butter mixture alternately with milk; blend well. Refrigerate for 1 hour or until firm. Mold dough over patties and cover completely. Place on a greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350° for 10 to 12 minutes. Cool for 1 minute on cookie tray, then remove to wire rack. Cool completely.

recipes.title: Chocolate Fudge Or Frosting
directions: Mix all ingredients, except vanilla, together thoroughly. Stir over low heat until chocolate and margarine are melted. Then, stirring constantly, bring rapidly to a full boil.
Boil to 220° or until a small amount forms a soft ball when dropped in cold water.
recipes.text: Chocolate Fudge Or Frosting. Mix all ingredients, except vanilla, together thoroughly. Stir over low heat until chocolate and margarine are melted. Then, stirring constantly, bring rapidly to a full boil. Boil to 220° or until a small amount forms a soft ball when dropped in cold water.

recipes.title: Lyons Burgers
ingredients: 1 to 2 lb. ground chuck or sirloin
directions: Put ground meat into large bowl.
Add garlic powder, seasoned salt, bread crumbs, dry onion soup mix, egg and onion plus 1/2 cup warm water.
Mix well.
Mold into 8 to 10 patties.
Broil
recipes.text: Lyons Burgers. Put ground meat into large bowl. Add garlic powder, seasoned salt, bread crumbs, dry onion soup mix, egg and onion plus 1/2 cup warm water. Mix well. Mold into 8 to 10 patties. Broil

recipes.title: White Frosting
ingredients: 2 tsp. imitation vanilla or almond extract
directions: Cream the egg white and shortening with electric mixer.
Add vanilla or almond extract, sugar and milk; beat until smooth and creamy.
Makes enough to frost a large layer cake. Sets in seconds and refrigerates well.
recipes.text: White Frosting. Cream the egg white and shortening with electric mixer. Add vanilla or almond extract, sugar and milk; beat until smooth and creamy. Makes enough to frost a large layer cake. Sets in seconds and refrigerates well.

recipes.title: Marbled Cheesecake Bars
ingredients: 1 (14 oz.) can Eagle Brand sweetened milk
2 sq. (2 oz.) unsweetened baking chocolate, melted
directions: Preheat oven to 300°.
Combine crumbs, cocoa, sugar and margarine; press firmly on bottom of 13 x 9-inch pan.
In large bowl, beat cheese until smooth.
Add eggs and vanilla; mix well. Pour half batter evenly over prepared crust.
Stir melted chocolate into remaining batter.
Spoon over vanilla batter.
With table knife swirl through batter.
Bake 45 to 50 minutes or until set. Cool.
Cut in bars.
Refrigerate.
recipes.text: Marbled Cheesecake Bars. Preheat oven to 300°. Combine crumbs, cocoa, sugar and margarine; press firmly on bottom of 13 x 9-inch pan. In large bowl, beat cheese until smooth. Add eggs and vanilla; mix well. Pour half batter evenly over prepared crust. Stir melted chocolate into remaining batter. Spoon over vanilla batter. With table knife swirl through batter. Bake 45 to 50 minutes or until set. Cool. Cut in bars. Refrigerate.

recipes.title: Onion Soup
directions: Heat butter; add onions.
Cook until soft.
Add bouillon and simmer 30 minutes.
Salt and pepper to taste.
Put toast in bowl. Pour soup over toast and top with Parmesan cheese.
recipes.text: Onion Soup. Heat butter; add onions. Cook until soft. Add bouillon and simmer 30 minutes. Salt and pepper to taste. Put toast in bowl. Pour soup over toast and top with Parmesan cheese.

recipes.title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
directions: Heat oven to 375°.
Place sheets of foil on countertop for cooling cookies.
Combine shortening, brown sugar, milk and vanilla in large bowl.
Beat at medium speed until well blended.
Beat egg into creamed mixture.
Combine flour, salt and baking soda.
Mix into creamed mixture just until blended.
Stir in chocolate chips. Drop rounded tablespoonfuls of dough 3 inches apart onto ungreased baking sheet.
Bake one baking sheet at a time for 8 to 10 minutes.
recipes.text: Chocolate Chip Cookies. Heat oven to 375°. Place sheets of foil on countertop for cooling cookies. Combine shortening, brown sugar, milk and vanilla in large bowl. Beat at medium speed until well blended. Beat egg into creamed mixture. Combine flour, salt and baking soda. Mix into creamed mixture just until blended. Stir in chocolate chips. Drop rounded tablespoonfuls of dough 3 inches apart onto ungreased baking sheet. Bake one baking sheet at a time for 8 to 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Rocky Road Candy
directions: Melt margarine and semi-sweet chocolate chips over low heat until melted.
In a large bowl, combine all the ingredients together and pour into a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Let cool for 2 to 3 hours.
recipes.text: Rocky Road Candy. Melt margarine and semi-sweet chocolate chips over low heat until melted. In a large bowl, combine all the ingredients together and pour into a 9 x 13-inch pan. Let cool for 2 to 3 hours.

recipes.title: Chocolate Cake
directions: Put all ingredients into a large bowl and mix for 5 minutes. Pour into a 10-inch tube pan (greased and floured).
Bake in a 350° oven for 50 to 70 minutes.
Cool and frost with butter icing.
recipes.text: Chocolate Cake. Put all ingredients into a large bowl and mix for 5 minutes. Pour into a 10-inch tube pan (greased and floured). Bake in a 350° oven for 50 to 70 minutes. Cool and frost with butter icing.

recipes.title: Five-Cheese Lasagna
ingredients: 1 lb. ground beef or meatball mixture
directions: In a large saucepan, cook lasagna noodles, boiling for 4 to 5 minutes; drain and set aside.
In a medium-sized skillet, cook ground beef or meatball mixture, ground sausage, chopped onion and minced garlic until meat is brown and vegetables are tender; drain off fat.
Set aside.
Combine the cubed cream cheese and light cream or milk with the parsley, basil, oregano, salt and pepper in a medium saucepan.
Cook and stir over low heat until cheese is melted.
Stir in dry white wine.
Gradually add the shredded Cheddar cheese.
Cook and stir until cheese is nearly melted; remove from heat.
recipes.text: Five-Cheese Lasagna. In a large saucepan, cook lasagna noodles, boiling for 4 to 5 minutes; drain and set aside. In a medium-sized skillet, cook ground beef or meatball mixture, ground sausage, chopped onion and minced garlic until meat is brown and vegetables are tender; drain off fat. Set aside. Combine the cubed cream cheese and light cream or milk with the parsley, basil, oregano, salt and pepper in a medium saucepan. Cook and stir over low heat until cheese is melted. Stir in dry white wine. Gradually add the shredded Cheddar cheese. Cook and stir until cheese is nearly melted; remove from heat.

recipes.title: Marinated Carrots
ingredients: 4 to 6 c. sliced carrots, cooked until just fork-tender
directions: Heat together soup, sugar, salt, mustard, oil, vinegar and Worcestershire.
Mix well.
Pour over carrots, onions and pepper. Marinate overnight.
Heat before serving.
recipes.text: Marinated Carrots. Heat together soup, sugar, salt, mustard, oil, vinegar and Worcestershire. Mix well. Pour over carrots, onions and pepper. Marinate overnight. Heat before serving.

recipes.title: Hush Puppies
directions: Mix well
with	buttermilk,
leaving
thick.
Dip
with teaspoon and cook at
300° to 350° (with enough cooking oil to float) until golden brown.	Makes approximately 4 dozen.
recipes.text: Hush Puppies. Mix well with	buttermilk, leaving thick. Dip with teaspoon and cook at 300° to 350° (with enough cooking oil to float) until golden brown.	Makes approximately 4 dozen.

recipes.title: Apple Salad
ingredients: 6 c. unpeeled apples, cored and diced
2 (3 oz.) pkg. vanilla cook and serve pudding mix
directions: Mix pineapple juice with pudding mix in medium saucepan. Cook until starts to boil, then remove from heat. Allow to cool until clear. Place apples, pineapple and grapes in large bowl. Add pudding mixture and stir gently. Add bananas shortly before serving; stir gently. Decorate top with cherries.
recipes.text: Apple Salad. Mix pineapple juice with pudding mix in medium saucepan. Cook until starts to boil, then remove from heat. Allow to cool until clear. Place apples, pineapple and grapes in large bowl. Add pudding mixture and stir gently. Add bananas shortly before serving; stir gently. Decorate top with cherries.

recipes.title: Extra Easy Pie Crust
directions: Mix ingredients together.
Roll 1/2 the dough between 2 pieces of lightly floured wax paper.
Loosen top wax paper from dough; flip and loosen other wax paper.
Remove top wax paper and flip onto greased pie tin.
Cook with pie filling at 375° for 10 to 12 minutes.
Makes enough for lower and upper crust or 2 lower crusts.
recipes.text: Extra Easy Pie Crust. Mix ingredients together. Roll 1/2 the dough between 2 pieces of lightly floured wax paper. Loosen top wax paper from dough; flip and loosen other wax paper. Remove top wax paper and flip onto greased pie tin. Cook with pie filling at 375° for 10 to 12 minutes. Makes enough for lower and upper crust or 2 lower crusts.

recipes.title: Swiss Vegetable Medley
ingredients: 1 lb. broccoli, carrots and cauliflower mixed
1-1/3 cup canned French fried onion rings
directions: Cook vegetables until fork tender.
Drain.
Combine soup, 1/2 cup of Swiss cheese, pimentos and 2/3 cup of onions.
Mix with vegetables and pour into a baking dish.
Cover and bake at 350 degrees for 30 minutes.
Remove from oven and sprinkle with rest of cheese and remainder of onions.
Return to oven and bake uncovered for 5 minutes or until brown.
recipes.text: Swiss Vegetable Medley. Cook vegetables until fork tender. Drain. Combine soup, 1/2 cup of Swiss cheese, pimentos and 2/3 cup of onions. Mix with vegetables and pour into a baking dish. Cover and bake at 350 degrees for 30 minutes. Remove from oven and sprinkle with rest of cheese and remainder of onions. Return to oven and bake uncovered for 5 minutes or until brown.

recipes.title: Summer Fruit Salad
directions: Mix cream cheese and mayonnaise in a large bowl.
Drain fruit and add to cream cheese mixture.
Mix thoroughly.
If the mixture is too stiff, add 2 tablespoons of fruit juice (your choice). Chill for 1 hour before serving.
recipes.text: Summer Fruit Salad. Mix cream cheese and mayonnaise in a large bowl. Drain fruit and add to cream cheese mixture. Mix thoroughly. If the mixture is too stiff, add 2 tablespoons of fruit juice (your choice). Chill for 1 hour before serving.

recipes.title: Russian Tea Cookies
directions: Cream butter and sugar.
Add vanilla, flour, salt and nuts. Mix well.
Form into dime sized balls or flattened, if preferred. Place on ungreased baking sheet.
Bake at 250° for 25 minutes. While still warm, roll in confectioners sugar.
Makes 7 dozen cookies.
recipes.text: Russian Tea Cookies. Cream butter and sugar. Add vanilla, flour, salt and nuts. Mix well. Form into dime sized balls or flattened, if preferred. Place on ungreased baking sheet. Bake at 250° for 25 minutes. While still warm, roll in confectioners sugar. Makes 7 dozen cookies.

recipes.title: Caramel Filling
directions: Put all ingredients into a pan; let boil hard for 2 minutes by the clock. Add pinch of soda. Remove from fire and beat until cold. Nuts may be added.
recipes.text: Caramel Filling. Put all ingredients into a pan; let boil hard for 2 minutes by the clock. Add pinch of soda. Remove from fire and beat until cold. Nuts may be added.

recipes.title: Carrot Souffl
directions: Cook baby carrots in salted water until tender. Drain well.
recipes.text: Carrot Souffl. Cook baby carrots in salted water until tender. Drain well.

recipes.title: Deep Dish Old Fashioned Custard Pie
directions: Beat well.
Pour into unbaked pie crust.
Bake 20 to 25 minutes at 400° until a silver knife comes out clean.
recipes.text: Deep Dish Old Fashioned Custard Pie. Beat well. Pour into unbaked pie crust. Bake 20 to 25 minutes at 400° until a silver knife comes out clean.

recipes.title: Chocolate Chip Pecan Pie
directions: Mix everything, except pecans and bananas, in a bowl.
Add pecans and bananas.
Stir.
Sprinkle chocolate chips on top.
Bake 45 minutes at 350°.
Serve with ice cream or whipped cream.
recipes.text: Chocolate Chip Pecan Pie. Mix everything, except pecans and bananas, in a bowl. Add pecans and bananas. Stir. Sprinkle chocolate chips on top. Bake 45 minutes at 350°. Serve with ice cream or whipped cream.

recipes.title: Enchilada Casserole
directions: Brown meat and onions.
Add sauce and olives.
Line baking pan (9 x 13-inch) with tortillas.
Pour in half of meat mixture carefully.
Add half of cheese.
Repeat layers.
Bake at 350° to melt cheese.
recipes.text: Enchilada Casserole. Brown meat and onions. Add sauce and olives. Line baking pan (9 x 13-inch) with tortillas. Pour in half of meat mixture carefully. Add half of cheese. Repeat layers. Bake at 350° to melt cheese.

recipes.title: Brownies
directions: Melt chocolate and shortening over warm water.
Cool slightly. Mix together eggs, sugar, vanilla and salt.
Blend in chocolate mixture.
Mix in flour.
Fold in walnuts.
Bake in a 13 x 9-inch pan at 325° for about 20 to 25 minutes or until done.
Cut into bars.
recipes.text: Brownies. Melt chocolate and shortening over warm water. Cool slightly. Mix together eggs, sugar, vanilla and salt. Blend in chocolate mixture. Mix in flour. Fold in walnuts. Bake in a 13 x 9-inch pan at 325° for about 20 to 25 minutes or until done. Cut into bars.

recipes.title: Long-Awaited Chicken Divan
ingredients: 1 whole chicken, cooked, skin and bones removed and cut into bite size pieces
1 c. sharp Cheddar cheese (can substitute 1 can Cheddar cheese soup)
directions: Combine soup, mayonnaise, sour cream, lemon juice, water chestnuts, curry and cheese.
Drain broccoli; arrange in bottom of greased casserole.
Spread chicken over broccoli.
Spread soup mixture over chicken.
Sprinkle with Parmesan and paprika.
Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes until bubbly.
Serves 6.
recipes.text: Long-Awaited Chicken Divan. Combine soup, mayonnaise, sour cream, lemon juice, water chestnuts, curry and cheese. Drain broccoli; arrange in bottom of greased casserole. Spread chicken over broccoli. Spread soup mixture over chicken. Sprinkle with Parmesan and paprika. Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes until bubbly. Serves 6.

recipes.title: Barbecue Sauce
directions: Mix all ingredients and boil 5 minutes.
This is very good on any meat.
recipes.text: Barbecue Sauce. Mix all ingredients and boil 5 minutes. This is very good on any meat.

recipes.title: Sorry Cake
directions: Mix well and bake in 9 x 13-inch well-greased and floured pan at 350° for 30 minutes.
Sprinkle with powdered sugar.
recipes.text: Sorry Cake. Mix well and bake in 9 x 13-inch well-greased and floured pan at 350° for 30 minutes. Sprinkle with powdered sugar.

recipes.title: Scrambled Eggs, Bacon And Tortillas
ingredients: 3 to 4 slices bacon, fried and crumbled or 1/2 c. diced ham (optional)
directions: In a medium sized pan, fry tortillas in cooking oil, stirring until browned. Add crumbled bacon or diced ham (if desired) and warm.
Add eggs and scramble entire mixture over medium heat until eggs are cooked through.
Serves 4.
recipes.text: Scrambled Eggs, Bacon And Tortillas. In a medium sized pan, fry tortillas in cooking oil, stirring until browned. Add crumbled bacon or diced ham (if desired) and warm. Add eggs and scramble entire mixture over medium heat until eggs are cooked through. Serves 4.

recipes.title: Pistachio Dessert
directions: Mix together and pat into a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Bake at 350° for 10 minutes.
Cool.
recipes.text: Pistachio Dessert. Mix together and pat into a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350° for 10 minutes. Cool.

recipes.title: Oat "Meal" Raw Bran Cookies
directions: Preheat oven to 400°.
Mix in large bowl cream and sugar. Stir in oats and bran.
Add sugar and vanilla and mix them.
Let stand until it is all soaked and drop on a greased cookie sheet. Bake 8 to 10 minutes until golden brown.
Makes 12 regular sized cookies.
recipes.text: Oat "Meal" Raw Bran Cookies. Preheat oven to 400°. Mix in large bowl cream and sugar. Stir in oats and bran. Add sugar and vanilla and mix them. Let stand until it is all soaked and drop on a greased cookie sheet. Bake 8 to 10 minutes until golden brown. Makes 12 regular sized cookies.

recipes.title: Quick Chocolate Cookies
ingredients: 1 box yellow or white cake mix (any brand)
directions: Preheat oven to 350°.
Place dry ingredients in a large bowl. Melt margarine; pour into dry ingredients.
Mix together.
Add vanilla and eggs.
Mix again.
Stir in the chips and nuts.
Drop by teaspoonfuls on an ungreased cookie sheet about 2 inches apart. Bake in oven for 10 to 12 minutes.
Centers will be soft because of cake mix.
Cool on baking rack.
Makes 5 dozen cookies.
recipes.text: Quick Chocolate Cookies. Preheat oven to 350°. Place dry ingredients in a large bowl. Melt margarine; pour into dry ingredients. Mix together. Add vanilla and eggs. Mix again. Stir in the chips and nuts. Drop by teaspoonfuls on an ungreased cookie sheet about 2 inches apart. Bake in oven for 10 to 12 minutes. Centers will be soft because of cake mix. Cool on baking rack. Makes 5 dozen cookies.

recipes.title: Fresh Squeezed Lemonade
ingredients: 1 c. fresh lemon juice, chilled (about 6 lemons)
directions: Combine water and sugar in a medium saucepan; bring to a boil and cook for 1 minute.
Remove from heat; let cool.
Pour sugar mixture into a pitcher; chill.
Add lemon juice to sugar mixture; stir well.
Serve over ice.
Garnish with lemon wedges, if desired.
Yields 1 quart (serving size:
1 cup).
recipes.text: Fresh Squeezed Lemonade. Combine water and sugar in a medium saucepan; bring to a boil and cook for 1 minute. Remove from heat; let cool. Pour sugar mixture into a pitcher; chill. Add lemon juice to sugar mixture; stir well. Serve over ice. Garnish with lemon wedges, if desired. Yields 1 quart (serving size: 1 cup).

recipes.title: Applesauce Cake
directions: Cream together sugar and shortening.
Add applesauce.
Sift together first 7 items.
Mix raisins and optional nuts to applesauce.
Add dry ingredients and mix well.
Put in well-greased tube pan.
Place in a heated 350° oven for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Applesauce Cake. Cream together sugar and shortening. Add applesauce. Sift together first 7 items. Mix raisins and optional nuts to applesauce. Add dry ingredients and mix well. Put in well-greased tube pan. Place in a heated 350° oven for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Orange Praline Yams Casserole
directions: In a mixing bowl with electric mixer, beat yams until smooth. Add orange juice and peel, brandy, salt, pepper to taste, ginger, 1/4 cup melted butter, 1/3 cup brown sugar and egg yolks, beating until mixture is light and fluffy.
Pour into buttered shallow 2-quart casserole.
In a small bowl combine remaining melted butter, remaining brown sugar, pecans and cinnamon.
Spread evenly over yams (at this point casserole may be refrigerated overnight). Bake at 350° for 45 to 50 minutes or until golden brown and bubbly.
Let stand 10 minutes before serving.
Serves 10 to 12.
recipes.text: Orange Praline Yams Casserole. In a mixing bowl with electric mixer, beat yams until smooth. Add orange juice and peel, brandy, salt, pepper to taste, ginger, 1/4 cup melted butter, 1/3 cup brown sugar and egg yolks, beating until mixture is light and fluffy. Pour into buttered shallow 2-quart casserole. In a small bowl combine remaining melted butter, remaining brown sugar, pecans and cinnamon. Spread evenly over yams (at this point casserole may be refrigerated overnight). Bake at 350° for 45 to 50 minutes or until golden brown and bubbly. Let stand 10 minutes before serving. Serves 10 to 12.

recipes.title: Cocktail Wieners
directions: Mix mustard and jelly in saucepan over low heat.
Slice hot dogs into bite-size pieces.
Add to sauce and heat through.
Serve hot.
recipes.text: Cocktail Wieners. Mix mustard and jelly in saucepan over low heat. Slice hot dogs into bite-size pieces. Add to sauce and heat through. Serve hot.

recipes.title: Corn-Yellow Rice Casserole
ingredients: 1 c. shredded cheese (sharp Cheddar or kind you prefer)
directions: Cook rice according to directions on package.
When rice is done, add margarine, corn with liquid and cream of chicken soup. Mix and pour into a casserole dish.
Bake until done (about 20 minutes).
Do not cover dish.
When done, spread cheese over top and return to oven for cheese to melt.
Bake at 350°.
Serves 8.
recipes.text: Corn-Yellow Rice Casserole. Cook rice according to directions on package. When rice is done, add margarine, corn with liquid and cream of chicken soup. Mix and pour into a casserole dish. Bake until done (about 20 minutes). Do not cover dish. When done, spread cheese over top and return to oven for cheese to melt. Bake at 350°. Serves 8.

recipes.title: Apple Stuffed Chicken With Applejack Sauce
ingredients: 6 Granny Smith apples, peeled, cored and thinly sliced
directions: Put wine, applejack and shallots in a pan and cook until reduced by half.
Add chicken broth and reduce again by half.
Add cream and 2/3 of apples; simmer for about 5 minutes.
Salt may be added, if desired.
Makes 2 1/2 to 3 cups.
recipes.text: Apple Stuffed Chicken With Applejack Sauce. Put wine, applejack and shallots in a pan and cook until reduced by half. Add chicken broth and reduce again by half. Add cream and 2/3 of apples; simmer for about 5 minutes. Salt may be added, if desired. Makes 2 1/2 to 3 cups.

recipes.title: Cream Cheese Potatoes
directions: Place softened cream cheese in large bowl.
Add salt and pepper.
If using cooked potatoes for mashing, add them while hot to the cream cheese.
If using instant potatoes, proceed to add your hot liquid and potatoes to the cream cheese as on instant potato package directions.
Beat until well mixed and smooth.
recipes.text: Cream Cheese Potatoes. Place softened cream cheese in large bowl. Add salt and pepper. If using cooked potatoes for mashing, add them while hot to the cream cheese. If using instant potatoes, proceed to add your hot liquid and potatoes to the cream cheese as on instant potato package directions. Beat until well mixed and smooth.

recipes.title: Gram'S Cheese Pie
ingredients: 1 (9-inch) deep dish pie pan with graham cracker crust
directions: Beat all ingredients on high until well mixed.
Pour into graham cracker pie crust.
Bake fast for 15 minutes at 425°, then slow for 45 minutes at 350° until crust is brown and custard is set.
recipes.text: Gram'S Cheese Pie. Beat all ingredients on high until well mixed. Pour into graham cracker pie crust. Bake fast for 15 minutes at 425°, then slow for 45 minutes at 350° until crust is brown and custard is set.

recipes.title: Lazy-Way Beef Burgundy
directions: Place beef cubes, onion, wine and consomme in a 2 1/2 qt. casserole.
Mix flour and bread crumbs together; add to casserole. Stir all ingredients together until completely blended. Cover.
Bake at 325 degrees for 3 to 3 1/2 hours or until meat is tender...stirring once every hour.
recipes.text: Lazy-Way Beef Burgundy. Place beef cubes, onion, wine and consomme in a 2 1/2 qt. casserole. Mix flour and bread crumbs together; add to casserole. Stir all ingredients together until completely blended. Cover. Bake at 325 degrees for 3 to 3 1/2 hours or until meat is tender...stirring once every hour.

recipes.title: Chess Cake
directions: Combine the first 3 ingredients and press into 13 x 9-inch pan, forming slight ridge at side.
recipes.text: Chess Cake. Combine the first 3 ingredients and press into 13 x 9-inch pan, forming slight ridge at side.

recipes.title: Homemade Wine
directions: Squeeze and mash fruit until it is broken to release juices. Add sugar and mix.
Put in large, airtight container, glass, crock or plastic bucket with plastic tubing leading to a gallon jug of water.
Allow to ferment in warm place (70° to 90°) for 12 to 20 days, depending on temperature.
Strain well and repeat fermenting process with strained juice.
Add sugar (12 to 15 days).
Pour in wine bottles and cork.
recipes.text: Homemade Wine. Squeeze and mash fruit until it is broken to release juices. Add sugar and mix. Put in large, airtight container, glass, crock or plastic bucket with plastic tubing leading to a gallon jug of water. Allow to ferment in warm place (70° to 90°) for 12 to 20 days, depending on temperature. Strain well and repeat fermenting process with strained juice. Add sugar (12 to 15 days). Pour in wine bottles and cork.

recipes.title: Rave Reviews Coconut Cake
directions: Blend cake mix, pudding mix, water, eggs and oil in large bowl.
Beat at medium speed for 4 minutes.
Stir in coconut and walnuts.
Pour into 3 greased and floured 9-inch pans.
Bake at 350° for 35 minutes.
Cool in pans 15 minutes.
Remove and frost.
recipes.text: Rave Reviews Coconut Cake. Blend cake mix, pudding mix, water, eggs and oil in large bowl. Beat at medium speed for 4 minutes. Stir in coconut and walnuts. Pour into 3 greased and floured 9-inch pans. Bake at 350° for 35 minutes. Cool in pans 15 minutes. Remove and frost.

recipes.title: Eastern North Carolina Barbecue Sauce
directions: *Add pepper to taste, I like it hot.
recipes.text: Eastern North Carolina Barbecue Sauce. *Add pepper to taste, I like it hot.

recipes.title: Molded Salad
directions: Grind orange, carrot and apples and add pineapple and sugar. Let set 1 hour.
Mix Jell-O and boiling water well and add fruit, etc. and set until firm.
recipes.text: Molded Salad. Grind orange, carrot and apples and add pineapple and sugar. Let set 1 hour. Mix Jell-O and boiling water well and add fruit, etc. and set until firm.

recipes.title: Apple Cake
directions: Mix well the diced, raw apples and sugar.
Add cooking oil, beaten eggs, chopped nuts and vanilla.
Add sifted flour, cinnamon, baking soda and salt.
Bake for 1 hour in a 9 x 13 x 2-inch pan at 350°.
Frost with Cream Cheese Frosting when cooled.
recipes.text: Apple Cake. Mix well the diced, raw apples and sugar. Add cooking oil, beaten eggs, chopped nuts and vanilla. Add sifted flour, cinnamon, baking soda and salt. Bake for 1 hour in a 9 x 13 x 2-inch pan at 350°. Frost with Cream Cheese Frosting when cooled.

recipes.title: Butter Crescents
directions: Preheat oven to 350°.
In large mixer bowl at high speed, beat butter and sugar until light and fluffy.
Beat in water and vanilla.
Add flour, nuts and salt.
Beat at low speed until well blended. (If dough is too soft, chill for easier handling.)
recipes.text: Butter Crescents. Preheat oven to 350°. In large mixer bowl at high speed, beat butter and sugar until light and fluffy. Beat in water and vanilla. Add flour, nuts and salt. Beat at low speed until well blended. (If dough is too soft, chill for easier handling.)

recipes.title: Meringue Kisses Or "Forgotten Cookies"
directions: Preheat oven to 325°.
With electric mixer on high speed, beat egg whites until they stand up with stiff peaks.
Slowly, gradually add sugar, beating well after each addition.
Add vanilla.
Stir in nuts and morsels.
Drop by small spoonfuls onto ungreased cookie sheet and place in hot oven.
Turn off oven. Leave cookies in oven overnight or "forget" about them for at least 8 hours.
recipes.text: Meringue Kisses Or "Forgotten Cookies". Preheat oven to 325°. With electric mixer on high speed, beat egg whites until they stand up with stiff peaks. Slowly, gradually add sugar, beating well after each addition. Add vanilla. Stir in nuts and morsels. Drop by small spoonfuls onto ungreased cookie sheet and place in hot oven. Turn off oven. Leave cookies in oven overnight or "forget" about them for at least 8 hours.

recipes.title: Ms. Eva'S Meat Loaf
directions: Mix ingredients together and place in loaf pan.
recipes.text: Ms. Eva'S Meat Loaf. Mix ingredients together and place in loaf pan.

recipes.title: Taco Salad
ingredients: 13 oz. can chili hot red beans
directions: Brown ground beef and drain.
Add other ingredients, except taco chips.
Add taco chips right before serving.
recipes.text: Taco Salad. Brown ground beef and drain. Add other ingredients, except taco chips. Add taco chips right before serving.

recipes.title: Gazpacho
directions: Put oil, lemon juice, onion, celery, Tabasco, salt, peppers and chilies in blender or food processor.
Add beef broth and process.
Put tomato juice in a gallon container.
Add mixture from blender and stir.
Put chopped cucumber and tomatoes on top. Refrigerate.
Stir before ladling into bowls.
Serve with croutons on top.
Makes a delicious summer meal.
recipes.text: Gazpacho. Put oil, lemon juice, onion, celery, Tabasco, salt, peppers and chilies in blender or food processor. Add beef broth and process. Put tomato juice in a gallon container. Add mixture from blender and stir. Put chopped cucumber and tomatoes on top. Refrigerate. Stir before ladling into bowls. Serve with croutons on top. Makes a delicious summer meal.

recipes.title: Apple Dumplings
directions: Roll dough into 6-inch circles.
Place diced apples in center. Add dot of butter and dash of cinnamon.
Pull edges together at top and pinch together.
Place in greased baking dish.
Make syrup of sugar and water by bringing to a boil. Pour over dumplings. Bake at 350° until golden brown and apples are tender.
Good served with vanilla ice cream or Cool Whip.
recipes.text: Apple Dumplings. Roll dough into 6-inch circles. Place diced apples in center. Add dot of butter and dash of cinnamon. Pull edges together at top and pinch together. Place in greased baking dish. Make syrup of sugar and water by bringing to a boil. Pour over dumplings. Bake at 350° until golden brown and apples are tender. Good served with vanilla ice cream or Cool Whip.

recipes.title: "Grandma'S Vienna Bars"
directions: Mix first 4 ingredients together and spread in a 9 x 13-inch pan.
recipes.text: "Grandma'S Vienna Bars". Mix first 4 ingredients together and spread in a 9 x 13-inch pan.

recipes.title: Cheese Potatoes
directions: Mix together in casserole dish.
Keep enough cheese to top. Sprinkle with parsley and pepper.
Bake at 350° for 45 to 60 minutes or until it bubbles up in the middle.
If potatoes start to look dry, cover to finish baking.
recipes.text: Cheese Potatoes. Mix together in casserole dish. Keep enough cheese to top. Sprinkle with parsley and pepper. Bake at 350° for 45 to 60 minutes or until it bubbles up in the middle. If potatoes start to look dry, cover to finish baking.

recipes.title: No Bake Cookies
directions: Cook together the first 3 ingredients.
When it starts to boil, add butter.
Boil 3 minutes.
Add peanut butter, rolled oats and vanilla.
Stir well.
Drop onto wax paper.
Let stand for 1 hour.
recipes.text: No Bake Cookies. Cook together the first 3 ingredients. When it starts to boil, add butter. Boil 3 minutes. Add peanut butter, rolled oats and vanilla. Stir well. Drop onto wax paper. Let stand for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Chicken Tetrazzini
ingredients: 1 c. fresh mushrooms, sauteed in butter 5 minutes
6 c. cooked spaghetti, washed and drained
directions: Make sauce of butter, flour, milk and Velveeta cheese.
Mix with other ingredients.
Pour into shallow buttered casserole. Cover with Parmesan cheese.
Sprinkle with paprika.
Bake at 350° until light brown.
Serves 12.
recipes.text: Chicken Tetrazzini. Make sauce of butter, flour, milk and Velveeta cheese. Mix with other ingredients. Pour into shallow buttered casserole. Cover with Parmesan cheese. Sprinkle with paprika. Bake at 350° until light brown. Serves 12.

recipes.title: Potato Casserole
directions: Mix together.
Bake at 350 degrees for 45-60 minutes.
recipes.text: Potato Casserole. Mix together. Bake at 350 degrees for 45-60 minutes.

recipes.title: Cheddar Cornbread
directions: Combine cornmeal, flour, baking powder, salt and 1 cup cheese into mixing bowl.
Combine milk, oleo and eggs; add to dry ingredients.
Stir until flour is moistened.
Pour into greased 9-inch round pan.
Sprinkle with remaining cheese and bacon; top with green pepper.
Bake at 425° for 30 minutes or until done.
recipes.text: Cheddar Cornbread. Combine cornmeal, flour, baking powder, salt and 1 cup cheese into mixing bowl. Combine milk, oleo and eggs; add to dry ingredients. Stir until flour is moistened. Pour into greased 9-inch round pan. Sprinkle with remaining cheese and bacon; top with green pepper. Bake at 425° for 30 minutes or until done.

recipes.title: Corn Casserole
directions: Cook rice according to directions on package.
Mix with other ingredients.
Bake at 350° until cheese bubbles, about 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Corn Casserole. Cook rice according to directions on package. Mix with other ingredients. Bake at 350° until cheese bubbles, about 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Summer Squash Casserole
directions: Add squash to boiling water and cook until tender.
recipes.text: Summer Squash Casserole. Add squash to boiling water and cook until tender.

recipes.title: Hot Crab Souffle
ingredients: 1 (1 c.) can cream of mushroom soup
directions: Cook celery slowly 10 minutes in a little water; drain.
Dice half the bread in 11-inch square baking dish.
Mix crab meat, mayonnaise, onion, green pepper and celery together.
Spread over bread.
Place remaining diced bread over crab mixture.
Mix eggs and milk.
Pour over casserole.
Place in refrigerator overnight. Bake at 325° for 15 minutes.
Spoon soup over top.
Sprinkle with small amount of cheese and paprika.
Bake 45 minutes to 1 hour longer.
Yield:
8 servings.
recipes.text: Hot Crab Souffle. Cook celery slowly 10 minutes in a little water; drain. Dice half the bread in 11-inch square baking dish. Mix crab meat, mayonnaise, onion, green pepper and celery together. Spread over bread. Place remaining diced bread over crab mixture. Mix eggs and milk. Pour over casserole. Place in refrigerator overnight. Bake at 325° for 15 minutes. Spoon soup over top. Sprinkle with small amount of cheese and paprika. Bake 45 minutes to 1 hour longer. Yield: 8 servings.

recipes.title: Chicken Cacciatore
ingredients: 2 medium onions, thinly sliced into rings
1 small green bell pepper, thinly sliced
directions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet, season the chicken with salt and pepper, then fry, skin-side down for 5 minutes or until lightly browned.
Turn and brown other side.
Set chicken aside.
Add onions to pan and cook for 5 minutes.
Add garlic, mushrooms and peppers.
Cook another 3 - 4 minutes or until onions are golden.
Mix in tomatoes paste and cook 1 - 2 minutes, add wine.
Bring to a boil, stirring constantly, add the tomatoes, breaking them down with a wooden spoon.
Sprinkle in the rosemary and oregano and return chicken to the pan.
Season with salt and pepper, cover and simmer 20 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Check chicken to see if tender - if not cook another 10 minutes. Transfer with a slotted spoon to serving plate.
If sauce is to liquidly boil uncovered for 5 minutes.
Season to taste.
Pour over chicken.
Serve immediately.
recipes.text: Chicken Cacciatore. Heat the olive oil in a large skillet, season the chicken with salt and pepper, then fry, skin-side down for 5 minutes or until lightly browned. Turn and brown other side. Set chicken aside. Add onions to pan and cook for 5 minutes. Add garlic, mushrooms and peppers. Cook another 3 - 4 minutes or until onions are golden. Mix in tomatoes paste and cook 1 - 2 minutes, add wine. Bring to a boil, stirring constantly, add the tomatoes, breaking them down with a wooden spoon. Sprinkle in the rosemary and oregano and return chicken to the pan. Season with salt and pepper, cover and simmer 20 minutes, stirring occasionally. Check chicken to see if tender - if not cook another 10 minutes. Transfer with a slotted spoon to serving plate. If sauce is to liquidly boil uncovered for 5 minutes. Season to taste. Pour over chicken. Serve immediately.

recipes.title: Cranberry Jello Salad
directions: Grind berries and peeling of one orange. Dissolve jello, sugar and water. Let cool. Add fruit and nuts.
recipes.text: Cranberry Jello Salad. Grind berries and peeling of one orange. Dissolve jello, sugar and water. Let cool. Add fruit and nuts.

recipes.title: Vegetable Dip
ingredients: salt, pepper and parsley to taste
directions: In blender, mix onion and cheese, then add mayo.
Mix well. Add egg, then salt, pepper and parsley.
Blend.
Chill 15 minutes before serving.
recipes.text: Vegetable Dip. In blender, mix onion and cheese, then add mayo. Mix well. Add egg, then salt, pepper and parsley. Blend. Chill 15 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Corn Pudding
directions: Mix all ingredients together well and bake until firm and brown.
recipes.text: Corn Pudding. Mix all ingredients together well and bake until firm and brown.

recipes.title: Hamburger Hot Dish
directions: Brown hamburger, onions and celery.
Add salt and pepper.
Put in roaster and add mushroom soup and chicken soup, Worcestershire sauce and soy sauce, rice and water.
Bake 1 1/2 hours at 350° to 375°, uncovered.
Add more water, if necessary, during baking time, and stir several times.
Add chow mein noodles on top the last 15 minutes.
recipes.text: Hamburger Hot Dish. Brown hamburger, onions and celery. Add salt and pepper. Put in roaster and add mushroom soup and chicken soup, Worcestershire sauce and soy sauce, rice and water. Bake 1 1/2 hours at 350° to 375°, uncovered. Add more water, if necessary, during baking time, and stir several times. Add chow mein noodles on top the last 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Sprouts For Dinnerdallas, Texas
directions: Stir fry 8 oz. of sprouts for 2 to 3 minutes.
recipes.text: Sprouts For Dinnerdallas, Texas. Stir fry 8 oz. of sprouts for 2 to 3 minutes.

recipes.title: Banana-Nut Bread
directions: Cream shortening and sugar until fluffy.
Add eggs and blend well.
Mix flour, soda and salt; add to mixture.
Stir in mashed bananas, walnuts and vanilla.
Pour into a greased 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour or until firm.
Cool 5 minutes; remove from pan and cool completely.
Wrap and let stand for 24 hours.
recipes.text: Banana-Nut Bread. Cream shortening and sugar until fluffy. Add eggs and blend well. Mix flour, soda and salt; add to mixture. Stir in mashed bananas, walnuts and vanilla. Pour into a greased 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan. Bake at 350° for 1 hour or until firm. Cool 5 minutes; remove from pan and cool completely. Wrap and let stand for 24 hours.

recipes.title: Broccoli Salad
ingredients: 1/2 lb. bacon, crumbled or 1 jar bacon bits
directions: Mix all vegetables together with the bacon.
Mix all into the dressing.
recipes.text: Broccoli Salad. Mix all vegetables together with the bacon. Mix all into the dressing.

recipes.title: Chicken Or Tuna Macaroni Casserole
ingredients: 1 1/2 c. cooked chicken (or turkey) chunks or tuna
directions: Combine all ingredients together.
Bake at 350°, covered, for 1 hour.
(This is a great way to get that Thanksgiving turkey used up.)
