recipes.text: Chicken Or Tuna Macaroni Casserole. Combine all ingredients together. Bake at 350°, covered, for 1 hour. (This is a great way to get that Thanksgiving turkey used up.)

recipes.title: Chicken Casserole
directions: Microwave celery and onion with a tablespoon margarine 4 minutes.
Stir in large bowl chopped chicken breast, rice, celery, onions, cream of chicken soup, mayo and chicken broth.
Mix altogether.
Pour into large casserole dish.
Crush corn flakes on top.
Bake 45 minutes at 350°.
Enjoy.
recipes.text: Chicken Casserole. Microwave celery and onion with a tablespoon margarine 4 minutes. Stir in large bowl chopped chicken breast, rice, celery, onions, cream of chicken soup, mayo and chicken broth. Mix altogether. Pour into large casserole dish. Crush corn flakes on top. Bake 45 minutes at 350°. Enjoy.

recipes.title: Green Rice
directions: Cook rice.
Cook broccoli in small amount of water until tender; drain.
Saute onion in butter or oil.
Mix all ingredients, except cheese, together and turn into 1 1/2-quart casserole dish.
Top with cheese.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Green Rice. Cook rice. Cook broccoli in small amount of water until tender; drain. Saute onion in butter or oil. Mix all ingredients, except cheese, together and turn into 1 1/2-quart casserole dish. Top with cheese. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Belle Helene(Chocolate Strawberry Dip)
directions: Heat whipping cream until hot (do not boil!).
Remove from heat, add chocolate and stir until melted.
Stir in extract and rind, chill.
Can be stored and is delicious on ice cream.
recipes.text: Belle Helene(Chocolate Strawberry Dip). Heat whipping cream until hot (do not boil!). Remove from heat, add chocolate and stir until melted. Stir in extract and rind, chill. Can be stored and is delicious on ice cream.

recipes.title: Hungarian Cabbage
directions: Fry bacon until crisp; remove from pan.
Add remaining ingredients to fat in pan.
Cover tightly and cook over low heat, stirring occasionally, for 20 to 25 minutes.
Cabbage should be tender, but crisp.
Crumble bacon over top before serving.
recipes.text: Hungarian Cabbage. Fry bacon until crisp; remove from pan. Add remaining ingredients to fat in pan. Cover tightly and cook over low heat, stirring occasionally, for 20 to 25 minutes. Cabbage should be tender, but crisp. Crumble bacon over top before serving.

recipes.title: Eggplant Parmesan
ingredients: 1 or 2 (8 oz.) cans tomato sauce (Hunt's herbs and spices is good)
directions: Slice cheese in thin slices.
Beat eggs in a small flat bowl, adding salt and pepper.
Wash and dry the eggplant and cut into 1/4-inch slices.
Dip the eggplant in the egg mixture and brown in oil about 10 minutes.
Drain on paper towels.
Place a row of eggplant in the bottom of a 3 or 4-quart casserole.
Then place cheese slices to cover the eggplant and sprinkle Parmesan cheese. Pour part of the tomato sauce over this.
Alternate layers to the top of the dish.
Optional: Sprinkle sesame seed about each layer. End up with cheese layer on top of casserole.
Pour leftover egg mixture on top of casserole. Cover and bake 45 minutes at 325°. Let stand for about 15 minutes before eating.
recipes.text: Eggplant Parmesan. Slice cheese in thin slices. Beat eggs in a small flat bowl, adding salt and pepper. Wash and dry the eggplant and cut into 1/4-inch slices. Dip the eggplant in the egg mixture and brown in oil about 10 minutes. Drain on paper towels. Place a row of eggplant in the bottom of a 3 or 4-quart casserole. Then place cheese slices to cover the eggplant and sprinkle Parmesan cheese. Pour part of the tomato sauce over this. Alternate layers to the top of the dish. Optional: Sprinkle sesame seed about each layer. End up with cheese layer on top of casserole. Pour leftover egg mixture on top of casserole. Cover and bake 45 minutes at 325°. Let stand for about 15 minutes before eating.

recipes.title: Jellied Salad
directions: Dissolve jello in boiling water.
Add sour cream and cold water; then add drained pineapple and oranges.
Stir ingredients together and set in a salad mold.
recipes.text: Jellied Salad. Dissolve jello in boiling water. Add sour cream and cold water; then add drained pineapple and oranges. Stir ingredients together and set in a salad mold.

recipes.title: Finger Paint
directions: Put in a double boiler and cook until thick.
Beat with eggbeater and divide into 3 parts.
Tint with food coloring.
recipes.text: Finger Paint. Put in a double boiler and cook until thick. Beat with eggbeater and divide into 3 parts. Tint with food coloring.

recipes.title: Maggie'S Snickerdoodles
directions: Heat oven to 400°.
Mix 1 1/2 cups sugar, margarine, shortening and eggs.
Stir in flour, cream of tartar, baking soda and salt.
Shape dough by rounded teaspoonful into balls.
Mix 2 tablespoons sugar and cinnamon.
Roll balls in mixture until coated.
Place 2-inches apart on ungreased cookie sheet.
Bake 8 to 10 minutes.
Immediately remove cookies from sheet.
recipes.text: Maggie'S Snickerdoodles. Heat oven to 400°. Mix 1 1/2 cups sugar, margarine, shortening and eggs. Stir in flour, cream of tartar, baking soda and salt. Shape dough by rounded teaspoonful into balls. Mix 2 tablespoons sugar and cinnamon. Roll balls in mixture until coated. Place 2-inches apart on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake 8 to 10 minutes. Immediately remove cookies from sheet.

recipes.title: Glazed Onions Amandine
ingredients: 36 small pearl onions or 3 c. sliced sweet onions
1/4 tsp. black pepper or lemon pepper
directions: Cook onions in lightly salted boiling water until tender. Drain.
In skillet, melt oleo.
Add rest of ingredients and cook slowly, stirring until onions are glazed and lightly browned, about 15 minutes.
Delicious with roast beef or chicken.
I use lemon pepper in this.
Serves 4 to 6.
recipes.text: Glazed Onions Amandine. Cook onions in lightly salted boiling water until tender. Drain. In skillet, melt oleo. Add rest of ingredients and cook slowly, stirring until onions are glazed and lightly browned, about 15 minutes. Delicious with roast beef or chicken. I use lemon pepper in this. Serves 4 to 6.

recipes.title: Fettucine
directions: Saute mushrooms in 1/2 stick butter.
Add zucchini, cream and 1 stick butter.
Bring to boil.
Simmer 3 minutes.
Add cooked fettucine, Parmesan cheese, parsley, salt and pepper.
(Recipe makes a lot of sauce; you can double the amount of pasta and still have plenty of the vegetables to toss with it.)
recipes.text: Fettucine. Saute mushrooms in 1/2 stick butter. Add zucchini, cream and 1 stick butter. Bring to boil. Simmer 3 minutes. Add cooked fettucine, Parmesan cheese, parsley, salt and pepper. (Recipe makes a lot of sauce; you can double the amount of pasta and still have plenty of the vegetables to toss with it.)

recipes.title: Apple Squares
directions: Sift flour, baking powder, salt and cinnamon.
Melt butter in medium-sized saucepan over moderate heat.
Remove; beat in sugars, egg and vanilla with wooden spoon until smooth.
Stir in flour mixtures, apple and walnuts until combined.
Spread into greased 9 x 9-inch pan.
Sprinkle with cinnamon-sugar.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes until top springs back when lightly pressed.
Cool before cutting.
Makes 16 servings.
recipes.text: Apple Squares. Sift flour, baking powder, salt and cinnamon. Melt butter in medium-sized saucepan over moderate heat. Remove; beat in sugars, egg and vanilla with wooden spoon until smooth. Stir in flour mixtures, apple and walnuts until combined. Spread into greased 9 x 9-inch pan. Sprinkle with cinnamon-sugar. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes until top springs back when lightly pressed. Cool before cutting. Makes 16 servings.

recipes.title: Texas Hash
directions: Brown beef in skillet and drain off fat.
Put all ingredients in crock-pot.
Stir thoroughly.
Cover and cook on low 6 to 8 hours.
(High 4 hours.)
recipes.text: Texas Hash. Brown beef in skillet and drain off fat. Put all ingredients in crock-pot. Stir thoroughly. Cover and cook on low 6 to 8 hours. (High 4 hours.)

recipes.title: Aunt Mary'S Fruit Punch
directions: Mix the first 5 ingredients real good.
Then, add the recommended amount of water for each can of orange juice and mix well.
After this, I usually put 1 quart of water and 1 cup of sugar and then stir and taste.
I continue putting 1 quart of water and then some sugar (doesn't have to be a cup each time, maybe 1/2 cup) and taste each time until I get it to taste like I want it.
Everyone has their own taste.
recipes.text: Aunt Mary'S Fruit Punch. Mix the first 5 ingredients real good. Then, add the recommended amount of water for each can of orange juice and mix well. After this, I usually put 1 quart of water and 1 cup of sugar and then stir and taste. I continue putting 1 quart of water and then some sugar (doesn't have to be a cup each time, maybe 1/2 cup) and taste each time until I get it to taste like I want it. Everyone has their own taste.

recipes.title: Sugar Cookies
ingredients: nuts and chocolate bites to taste
directions: Beat ingredients until stiff.
Drop by tablespoon on lightly greased cookie sheet.
Bake at 300° for 35 minutes.
recipes.text: Sugar Cookies. Beat ingredients until stiff. Drop by tablespoon on lightly greased cookie sheet. Bake at 300° for 35 minutes.

recipes.title: Hamburger Pot Pie
directions: Cut Crisco into flour.
Mix onion salt and water.
Sprinkle on water, a tablespoon at a time.
Toss lightly with work.
Work dough into a firm ball with your hands.
recipes.text: Hamburger Pot Pie. Cut Crisco into flour. Mix onion salt and water. Sprinkle on water, a tablespoon at a time. Toss lightly with work. Work dough into a firm ball with your hands.

recipes.title: Chicken Poulet De Normande
ingredients: 2 1/2 c. cooked chicken breasts, diced (4 breasts)
1 pkg. Pepperidge Farm corn bread stuffing
directions: Mix chicken, mayonnaise, onion, celery and salt together.
Set aside.
Mix broth, oleo and dressing together.
Spray a 9 x 13-inch Pyrex pan with Pam; put half of dressing in bottom of pan. Place chicken mixture on top.
Put remaining dressing on top. Beat eggs and milk together and pour over casserole.
Cover and refrigerate overnight.
Take out of refrigerator 1 hour before baking; spread soup on top.
Bake at 375° for 40 minutes.
Take out, sprinkle with cheese and return to oven for 10 minutes.
recipes.text: Chicken Poulet De Normande. Mix chicken, mayonnaise, onion, celery and salt together. Set aside. Mix broth, oleo and dressing together. Spray a 9 x 13-inch Pyrex pan with Pam; put half of dressing in bottom of pan. Place chicken mixture on top. Put remaining dressing on top. Beat eggs and milk together and pour over casserole. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Take out of refrigerator 1 hour before baking; spread soup on top. Bake at 375° for 40 minutes. Take out, sprinkle with cheese and return to oven for 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Avocado Tossed Salad
ingredients: 1 small head lettuce, washed and chilled
1/2 c. bottled creamy Italian salad dressing
directions: Prepare lettuce into bite size pieces (about 4 cups).
Cut avocado lengthwise in half.
Remove pit, peel and slice crosswise into bowl.
Pour salad dressing over lettuce and toss.
Divide mixture among 5 individual salad bowl servings.
recipes.text: Avocado Tossed Salad. Prepare lettuce into bite size pieces (about 4 cups). Cut avocado lengthwise in half. Remove pit, peel and slice crosswise into bowl. Pour salad dressing over lettuce and toss. Divide mixture among 5 individual salad bowl servings.

recipes.title: Cranberry Walnut Relish
ingredients: 1 c. coarsely broken English walnuts, toasted
directions: Wash cranberries and drain.
In shallow pan, stir cranberries with sugar.
Cover tightly with aluminum foil.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
Spread walnuts in separate pan.
Toast in oven until light golden brown, about 12 minutes.
Stir together baked cranberries, walnuts, marmalade and juice until well mixed.
Chill.
recipes.text: Cranberry Walnut Relish. Wash cranberries and drain. In shallow pan, stir cranberries with sugar. Cover tightly with aluminum foil. Bake at 350° for 1 hour. Spread walnuts in separate pan. Toast in oven until light golden brown, about 12 minutes. Stir together baked cranberries, walnuts, marmalade and juice until well mixed. Chill.

recipes.title: Poppy Seed Dressing
directions: Mix well the sugar, dry mustard, salt and grated onion.
Add and mix well the vinegar.
Add slowly while stirring the sunflower oil.
Add poppy seed and mix.
recipes.text: Poppy Seed Dressing. Mix well the sugar, dry mustard, salt and grated onion. Add and mix well the vinegar. Add slowly while stirring the sunflower oil. Add poppy seed and mix.

recipes.title: Shrimp Mariniere
directions: Saute mushrooms in 2 tablespoons butter and set aside.
In large heavy skillet or Dutch oven, melt remaining butter and saute onions until tender.
Blend in flour and cook slowly for 5 minutes, stirring constantly.
Remove from heat; gradually stir in milk until smooth.
Add salt, pepper and wine.
Bring to boil. Reduce heat; simmer and stir 10 minutes to thicken sauce.
Add shrimp and mushrooms, stirring lightly for 1 minute.
Remove from heat and quickly beat in egg yolks.
Spoon into 6 large ramekins or 12 small ramekins (as appetizers).
Sprinkle with paprika and heat under broiler.
This can also be served from a chafing dish over toast points.
Freezes well.
recipes.text: Shrimp Mariniere. Saute mushrooms in 2 tablespoons butter and set aside. In large heavy skillet or Dutch oven, melt remaining butter and saute onions until tender. Blend in flour and cook slowly for 5 minutes, stirring constantly. Remove from heat; gradually stir in milk until smooth. Add salt, pepper and wine. Bring to boil. Reduce heat; simmer and stir 10 minutes to thicken sauce. Add shrimp and mushrooms, stirring lightly for 1 minute. Remove from heat and quickly beat in egg yolks. Spoon into 6 large ramekins or 12 small ramekins (as appetizers). Sprinkle with paprika and heat under broiler. This can also be served from a chafing dish over toast points. Freezes well.

recipes.title: No Fail Crust
directions: Combine dry ingredients together.
Cut in the Crisco.
Add enough water (ice cold) to egg yolks to make 1 cup.
Pour over flour.
Makes 6 crusts.
recipes.text: No Fail Crust. Combine dry ingredients together. Cut in the Crisco. Add enough water (ice cold) to egg yolks to make 1 cup. Pour over flour. Makes 6 crusts.

recipes.title: Turkey Carcass Soup
directions: Combine the turkey carcass, water, poultry seasoning and thyme in large pot.
Bring to a boil.
Cover.
Reduce heat and simmer 40 minutes.
recipes.text: Turkey Carcass Soup. Combine the turkey carcass, water, poultry seasoning and thyme in large pot. Bring to a boil. Cover. Reduce heat and simmer 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Chocolate Layer Cake
directions: Combine flour, salt, soda and sugar in sifter.
Stir butter to soften.
Sift in dry ingredients.
Add water and mix until all flour is dampened.
Add chocolate and eggs.
Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Chocolate Layer Cake. Combine flour, salt, soda and sugar in sifter. Stir butter to soften. Sift in dry ingredients. Add water and mix until all flour is dampened. Add chocolate and eggs. Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Mints
directions: Cut butter into sugar.
Add milk and mint flavor.
Use your favorite food coloring to fit the occasion; form into shapes. Store in airtight container in refrigerator.
recipes.text: Mints. Cut butter into sugar. Add milk and mint flavor. Use your favorite food coloring to fit the occasion; form into shapes. Store in airtight container in refrigerator.

recipes.title: Family Favorite Chicken
ingredients: 3 skinless chicken breasts, split in half
directions: Brown chicken in margarine.
Saute onion.
Set aside.
Combine dry chicken noodle soup with all rice, rosemary and 2 cups water. Bring to a boil and put in a 9 x 9-inch pan.
Top with browned chicken and onion.
Cover.
recipes.text: Family Favorite Chicken. Brown chicken in margarine. Saute onion. Set aside. Combine dry chicken noodle soup with all rice, rosemary and 2 cups water. Bring to a boil and put in a 9 x 9-inch pan. Top with browned chicken and onion. Cover.

recipes.title: Sauerkraut Salad
directions: Drain sauerkraut 15 minutes in a colander.
Cut with scissors into one-inch pieces.
Mix all ingredients together in a large bowl.
Cover and store in refrigerator for 24 hours.
Yields 10 servings.
recipes.text: Sauerkraut Salad. Drain sauerkraut 15 minutes in a colander. Cut with scissors into one-inch pieces. Mix all ingredients together in a large bowl. Cover and store in refrigerator for 24 hours. Yields 10 servings.

recipes.title: Hamburger Pie
ingredients: 1 small bag frozen French-style green beans
directions: Brown hamburger; drain.
Cook green beans according to directions.
Boil potatoes and mash.
Mix hamburger, soup and green beans.
Place in a casserole dish.
Place mashed potatoes on top.
Add cheese, if desired.
Bake in 350° oven for 20 to 30 minutes or until mashed potatoes are crisp on top.
recipes.text: Hamburger Pie. Brown hamburger; drain. Cook green beans according to directions. Boil potatoes and mash. Mix hamburger, soup and green beans. Place in a casserole dish. Place mashed potatoes on top. Add cheese, if desired. Bake in 350° oven for 20 to 30 minutes or until mashed potatoes are crisp on top.

recipes.title: Biscuits
directions: Mix the Crisco into the flour until crumbly.
Add milk.
Knead for about 1 minute on floured wax paper until the dough is no longer sticky.
Roll out and cut with biscuit cutter.
Bake on ungreased baking sheet for 8 to 10 minutes at 450°.
recipes.text: Biscuits. Mix the Crisco into the flour until crumbly. Add milk. Knead for about 1 minute on floured wax paper until the dough is no longer sticky. Roll out and cut with biscuit cutter. Bake on ungreased baking sheet for 8 to 10 minutes at 450°.

recipes.title: Onion Rings
ingredients: large dry onions, silver skinned or yellow
directions: Peel the onions.
Cut them into thick slices between 1/4 and 1/8 inch
in thickness.
Separate the slices into rings, using only the larger ones for frying.
Keep the rings that are to be fried dry.
recipes.text: Onion Rings. Peel the onions. Cut them into thick slices between 1/4 and 1/8 inch in thickness. Separate the slices into rings, using only the larger ones for frying. Keep the rings that are to be fried dry.

recipes.title: Spinach Dip
ingredients: 1 can water chestnuts, chopped and drained
1 pkg. Knorr Swiss vegetable soup mix
1 pkg. frozen spinach, cooked and drained
directions: Mix all ingredients and refrigerate overnight.
Serve with fresh vegetables, especially good with celery sticks.
This will keep for a long time in the refrigerator.
recipes.text: Spinach Dip. Mix all ingredients and refrigerate overnight. Serve with fresh vegetables, especially good with celery sticks. This will keep for a long time in the refrigerator.

recipes.title: Applesauce Cake
directions: Bake at 350° in a 9 x 13-inch pan for 35 to 45 minutes.
Cool. Top with applesauce.
recipes.text: Applesauce Cake. Bake at 350° in a 9 x 13-inch pan for 35 to 45 minutes. Cool. Top with applesauce.

recipes.title: Cereal Nut Cookies
directions: Beat together butter, egg, sugar, brown sugar, oil and vanilla.
Mix together flour, soda, salt and cream of tartar; mix with butter mixture until well mixed.
Stir in oatmeal, Rice Krispies, coconut and nuts.
Let stand 1 1/2 hours.
Roll in balls and flatten with glass with sugar on the bottom.
Bake at 350° for 12 minutes.
recipes.text: Cereal Nut Cookies. Beat together butter, egg, sugar, brown sugar, oil and vanilla. Mix together flour, soda, salt and cream of tartar; mix with butter mixture until well mixed. Stir in oatmeal, Rice Krispies, coconut and nuts. Let stand 1 1/2 hours. Roll in balls and flatten with glass with sugar on the bottom. Bake at 350° for 12 minutes.

recipes.title: Snoopy Snack Candy
ingredients: 1/2 c. smooth or crunchy peanut butter
directions: Melt chips on low heat.
When melted, stir in peanut butter, nuts and raisins.
Drop by teaspoonfuls on a greased cookie sheet. Refrigerate until firm.
recipes.text: Snoopy Snack Candy. Melt chips on low heat. When melted, stir in peanut butter, nuts and raisins. Drop by teaspoonfuls on a greased cookie sheet. Refrigerate until firm.

recipes.title: Caramel Popcorn
directions: Boil first 3 ingredients, then add next 3 ingredients.
Pour over popped popcorn.
Pile on greased cookie sheets.
Bake at 250° for 1 hour.
Stir often.
Yields 6 to 8 quarts.
Put in decorator canister for a great gift idea.
recipes.text: Caramel Popcorn. Boil first 3 ingredients, then add next 3 ingredients. Pour over popped popcorn. Pile on greased cookie sheets. Bake at 250° for 1 hour. Stir often. Yields 6 to 8 quarts. Put in decorator canister for a great gift idea.

recipes.title: Mexican Casserole
directions: Fry ground meat until brown.
Add onion and garlic.
Put in enchilada and taco sauces.
Cook 10 to 15 minutes.
recipes.text: Mexican Casserole. Fry ground meat until brown. Add onion and garlic. Put in enchilada and taco sauces. Cook 10 to 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Cheese Bunnies
directions: You will need a round cookie cutter for this recipe.
recipes.text: Cheese Bunnies. You will need a round cookie cutter for this recipe.

recipes.title: Twice Baked Potatoes
directions: Bake potatoes for 1 hour or until done.
Let cool.
Slice in half lengthwise and scoop out potato, leaving 1/4 in skin.
Put potato in bowl; add Mozzarella cheese, milk and butter.
Mix as for mashed potatoes.
Refill potato skins; decorate with any of the following:
chopped green or red pepper, chopped chives, shredded Cheddar cheese, chopped bacon, paprika, spices as desired.
Before serving, bake at 325° for 20 minutes.
recipes.text: Twice Baked Potatoes. Bake potatoes for 1 hour or until done. Let cool. Slice in half lengthwise and scoop out potato, leaving 1/4 in skin. Put potato in bowl; add Mozzarella cheese, milk and butter. Mix as for mashed potatoes. Refill potato skins; decorate with any of the following: chopped green or red pepper, chopped chives, shredded Cheddar cheese, chopped bacon, paprika, spices as desired. Before serving, bake at 325° for 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Five Flavor Cake
directions: Cream butter and shortening until light.
Add eggs which have been beaten; combine flour and baking powder.
Add to cream mixture.
Mix milk alternately; stir in flavoring.
Spoon into 10-inch tube pan.
Bake at 325° for 1 1/2 hours or until done. Add glaze while in pan.
recipes.text: Five Flavor Cake. Cream butter and shortening until light. Add eggs which have been beaten; combine flour and baking powder. Add to cream mixture. Mix milk alternately; stir in flavoring. Spoon into 10-inch tube pan. Bake at 325° for 1 1/2 hours or until done. Add glaze while in pan.

recipes.title: Squash Casserole
directions: In
casserole
dish, melt margarine and mix with stuffing. Remove
cup of stuffing for top of casserole.	Line bottom of	casserole with remaining stuffing.
Add squash and other ingredients.
Spread
the
cup stuffing on top and bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes.
recipes.text: Squash Casserole. In casserole dish, melt margarine and mix with stuffing. Remove 3/4 cup of stuffing for top of casserole.	Line bottom of	casserole with remaining stuffing. Add squash and other ingredients. Spread the 3/4 cup stuffing on top and bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Moist Pound Cake
directions: Mix oil, sugar and eggs.
Add flour; beat well, then add nuts, pineapple, coconut and flavoring.
Grease tube pan.
Bake 1 hour at about 350°.
recipes.text: Moist Pound Cake. Mix oil, sugar and eggs. Add flour; beat well, then add nuts, pineapple, coconut and flavoring. Grease tube pan. Bake 1 hour at about 350°.

recipes.title: Sausage Jambalaya
directions: Saute sausage, onions, peppers and garlic. Combine with remaining ingredients. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat; stir, cover and simmer for 25 minutes.
recipes.text: Sausage Jambalaya. Saute sausage, onions, peppers and garlic. Combine with remaining ingredients. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat; stir, cover and simmer for 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Peach Cobbler
directions: Mix together margarine, 3/4 c. sugar, baking powder, salt, and flour.
Put fresh peaches in bottom of 9x9 baking dish.
Put batter on top of peaches.
Mix together sugar, cornstarch, and salt, and put over batter.
Pour in 1 c. boiling water.
Do not mix.
Bake 350°.
recipes.text: Peach Cobbler. Mix together margarine, 3/4 c. sugar, baking powder, salt, and flour. Put fresh peaches in bottom of 9x9 baking dish. Put batter on top of peaches. Mix together sugar, cornstarch, and salt, and put over batter. Pour in 1 c. boiling water. Do not mix. Bake 350°.

recipes.title: Baked Spaghetti
ingredients: small can Durkee French fried onion
directions: Brown ground beef and drain.
Add jar of spaghetti sauce.
Mix half the sauce mixture with spaghetti and place in 9 x 13 x 2-inch baking dish.
Saute green peppers and onions in margarine until tender.
Add cream cheese and enough milk to make smooth.
Spread cheese over spaghetti.
Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese.
Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.
Top with Durkee onions.
Bake 5 minutes more.
Serves 8.
recipes.text: Baked Spaghetti. Brown ground beef and drain. Add jar of spaghetti sauce. Mix half the sauce mixture with spaghetti and place in 9 x 13 x 2-inch baking dish. Saute green peppers and onions in margarine until tender. Add cream cheese and enough milk to make smooth. Spread cheese over spaghetti. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Bake at 350° for 25 minutes. Top with Durkee onions. Bake 5 minutes more. Serves 8.

recipes.title: Pineapple Cheese Cake
directions: Crush
crackers and mix with butter and powdered sugar. Dissolve Jell-O in 1 cup hot water, add pineapple.
Cool until syrupy.
Cream
together cream cheese and sugar.
Whip chilled Pet milk,
add
cheese mix to whipped Pet milk and beat.
Pour into lined
pan
of
graham crackers and add 1/2 cup of graham crackers on
top.
Chill
at
least
1/2 hour before serving.
recipes.text: Pineapple Cheese Cake. Crush crackers and mix with butter and powdered sugar. Dissolve Jell-O in 1 cup hot water, add pineapple. Cool until syrupy. Cream together cream cheese and sugar. Whip chilled Pet milk, add cheese mix to whipped Pet milk and beat. Pour into lined pan of graham crackers and add 1/2 cup of graham crackers on top. Chill at least 1/2 hour before serving.

recipes.title: Savory Pepper Steak
directions: Cut steak into strips and coat with mixture of flour, salt and pepper. Brown strips in oil in large skillet.
Drain tomatoes, reserving liquid.
recipes.text: Savory Pepper Steak. Cut steak into strips and coat with mixture of flour, salt and pepper. Brown strips in oil in large skillet. Drain tomatoes, reserving liquid.

recipes.title: Nut Roll
directions: Crumble vanilla wafers fine.
Add Eagle Brand milk and margarine.
Mix well.
Add pecans and raisins.
Mix well.
Divide dough.
Roll in 2 rolls.
Chill.
recipes.text: Nut Roll. Crumble vanilla wafers fine. Add Eagle Brand milk and margarine. Mix well. Add pecans and raisins. Mix well. Divide dough. Roll in 2 rolls. Chill.

recipes.title: Bubbly Apple Drink
ingredients: 1 (7 oz.) bottle lemon-lime carbonated beverage, chilled (about 1 c.)
directions: For each serving, place 1 scoop of lemon, lime or orange sherbet or vanilla ice cream in a tall glass.
Fill with cranberry juice cocktail, chilled.
recipes.text: Bubbly Apple Drink. For each serving, place 1 scoop of lemon, lime or orange sherbet or vanilla ice cream in a tall glass. Fill with cranberry juice cocktail, chilled.

recipes.title: Super Soup
ingredients: 1 can vegetable soup or any favorite soup
1 c. rice, cooked according to pkg.
directions: Stir together soup and cooked rice.
This is a quick, easy favorite dish of mine.
recipes.text: Super Soup. Stir together soup and cooked rice. This is a quick, easy favorite dish of mine.

recipes.title: Frozen Strawberry Pie
directions: READ COMPLETE INSTRUCTIONS BEFORE STARTING.
BE SURE PECANS ARE FREE OF HULLS AND TRASH.
recipes.text: Frozen Strawberry Pie. READ COMPLETE INSTRUCTIONS BEFORE STARTING. BE SURE PECANS ARE FREE OF HULLS AND TRASH.

recipes.title: Tuna Salad
directions: Mix all together and refrigerate.
recipes.text: Tuna Salad. Mix all together and refrigerate.

recipes.title: Fruit Dip
directions: Mix well and store in refrigerator.
recipes.text: Fruit Dip. Mix well and store in refrigerator.

recipes.title: Portuguese Bean Soup
ingredients: 1 medium green bell pepper, seeded, deveined and chopped
2 (15 oz.) cans kidney beans, rinsed and drained
1 tsp. hot pepper sauce or to taste
directions: Combine ham hocks and sausage in heavy large saucepan over medium-high heat and saute for 4 minutes.
Add remaining ingredients with enough water to cover.
Bring to a boil, skimming foam from surface.
Reduce heat to medium-low and simmer about 2 hours.
Remove ham hocks from soup; discard bones and cut
meat into bite-size pieces.
Blend into soup.
Ladle into bowls and serve hot.
Makes 8 servings.
recipes.text: Portuguese Bean Soup. Combine ham hocks and sausage in heavy large saucepan over medium-high heat and saute for 4 minutes. Add remaining ingredients with enough water to cover. Bring to a boil, skimming foam from surface. Reduce heat to medium-low and simmer about 2 hours. Remove ham hocks from soup; discard bones and cut meat into bite-size pieces. Blend into soup. Ladle into bowls and serve hot. Makes 8 servings.

recipes.title: Alta'S Cowboy Cookies
directions: Mix all ingredients in order listed.
Mix well.
Drop by teaspoon onto cookie sheets.
Bake at 350° for 15 minutes.
Lay on paper sack to cool.
recipes.text: Alta'S Cowboy Cookies. Mix all ingredients in order listed. Mix well. Drop by teaspoon onto cookie sheets. Bake at 350° for 15 minutes. Lay on paper sack to cool.

recipes.title: Spaghetti Sauce
directions: Crumble ground beef in heated frying pan.
Cook and stir until lightly browned.
Finely chop onion, green pepper and celery; add to ground beef and cook until tender.
Add tomato sauce, tomatoes, salt and pepper.
Cover and cook slowly, about 1 hour until thickened.
Serve over hot, cooked spaghetti or macaroni.
recipes.text: Spaghetti Sauce. Crumble ground beef in heated frying pan. Cook and stir until lightly browned. Finely chop onion, green pepper and celery; add to ground beef and cook until tender. Add tomato sauce, tomatoes, salt and pepper. Cover and cook slowly, about 1 hour until thickened. Serve over hot, cooked spaghetti or macaroni.

recipes.title: Buttermilk Pound Cake
ingredients: 3 c. plain flour, sifted three times
directions: Thoroughly cream shortening and 2 cups of sugar.
Add the five egg yolks, vanilla and lemon extract.
Beat thoroughly.
Then add dry ingredients, alternating with buttermilk.
Beat smooth after each addition.
Beat the egg whites until stiff and add final cup of sugar.
Beat until stiff.
Fold into the batter. Bake in a well-greased tube pan at 350° for 1 hour and 15 minutes or until done.
recipes.text: Buttermilk Pound Cake. Thoroughly cream shortening and 2 cups of sugar. Add the five egg yolks, vanilla and lemon extract. Beat thoroughly. Then add dry ingredients, alternating with buttermilk. Beat smooth after each addition. Beat the egg whites until stiff and add final cup of sugar. Beat until stiff. Fold into the batter. Bake in a well-greased tube pan at 350° for 1 hour and 15 minutes or until done.

recipes.title: Cabbage-Burger Bake
directions: *One and 1/2 pounds total.
recipes.text: Cabbage-Burger Bake. *One and 1/2 pounds total.

recipes.title: Microwave Lemon Chicken And Rice
ingredients: 1 lb. boneless, skinless chicken breast, cut into 1/2-inch chunks
directions: Mix chicken, broth, rice, pepper, zucchini, lemon peel, lemon juice, butter, cornstarch and garlic powder in 2-quart microwave casserole.
Cover.
Microwave on High 10 minutes or until chicken is cooked through, stirring halfway through cooking time.
Let stand 5 minutes.
Stir.
recipes.text: Microwave Lemon Chicken And Rice. Mix chicken, broth, rice, pepper, zucchini, lemon peel, lemon juice, butter, cornstarch and garlic powder in 2-quart microwave casserole. Cover. Microwave on High 10 minutes or until chicken is cooked through, stirring halfway through cooking time. Let stand 5 minutes. Stir.

recipes.title: Chili(Second Place Winner - Chili Cook Off - 1994)
ingredients: 1 1/2 Tbsp. chili powder or to taste
directions: Mix all ingredients and simmer at least 1 hour after bringing to a boil.
Also good in slow cooker on low setting all day.
recipes.text: Chili(Second Place Winner - Chili Cook Off - 1994). Mix all ingredients and simmer at least 1 hour after bringing to a boil. Also good in slow cooker on low setting all day.

recipes.title: Veggie Pizza
ingredients: 3/4 c. each: broccoli, green onions, cauliflower, green pepper, carrots, tomatoes and Cheddar cheese
directions: Pat crescent rolls in jelly roll pan.
Bake at 350° for 7 to 8 minutes until brown.
Mix and spread the sour cream, cream cheese, dressing and mayo.
Top with remaining ingredients.
Wrap tight with Saran Wrap.
Refrigerate 4 to 5 hours.
recipes.text: Veggie Pizza. Pat crescent rolls in jelly roll pan. Bake at 350° for 7 to 8 minutes until brown. Mix and spread the sour cream, cream cheese, dressing and mayo. Top with remaining ingredients. Wrap tight with Saran Wrap. Refrigerate 4 to 5 hours.

recipes.title: Carrots L'Orange
directions: Cook carrots in water until tender.
Drain.
Blend orange juice, sugar, lemon and cornstarch in pan.
Cook until thickened, stirring constantly.
Fold in carrots and orange sections.
Pour into serving dish.
Sprinkle parsley on top and add cayenne if you like it zippy!
recipes.text: Carrots L'Orange. Cook carrots in water until tender. Drain. Blend orange juice, sugar, lemon and cornstarch in pan. Cook until thickened, stirring constantly. Fold in carrots and orange sections. Pour into serving dish. Sprinkle parsley on top and add cayenne if you like it zippy!

recipes.title: Crabmeat Dip
directions: Place cream cheese, cottage cheese and mayonnaise in bowl. Beat well.
Add remaining ingredients.
Beat well.
Refrigerate until served.
Serve with crackers or raw vegetables.
recipes.text: Crabmeat Dip. Place cream cheese, cottage cheese and mayonnaise in bowl. Beat well. Add remaining ingredients. Beat well. Refrigerate until served. Serve with crackers or raw vegetables.

recipes.title: Easy As Pie Pineapple Pie
directions: Mix all ingredients.
Pour into graham cracker crust.
Freeze for 2 hours before serving.
recipes.text: Easy As Pie Pineapple Pie. Mix all ingredients. Pour into graham cracker crust. Freeze for 2 hours before serving.

recipes.title: Baked Ziti
ingredients: 12 oz. (about 3 c.) ziti, cooked and drained
directions: Heat oven to 350°.
Have a
2-quart casserole dish ready.
Mix ziti, 1 cup marinara sauce, 1/2 cup Mozzarella, the Ricotta and Parmesan in the casserole.
Top with remaining sauce and Mozzarella.
Cover and bake 45 minutes.
Serves 6.
recipes.text: Baked Ziti. Heat oven to 350°. Have a 2-quart casserole dish ready. Mix ziti, 1 cup marinara sauce, 1/2 cup Mozzarella, the Ricotta and Parmesan in the casserole. Top with remaining sauce and Mozzarella. Cover and bake 45 minutes. Serves 6.

recipes.title: Bonnie'S Cheese Ball
directions: Mix all together well.
Chill, then roll in black walnuts.
recipes.text: Bonnie'S Cheese Ball. Mix all together well. Chill, then roll in black walnuts.

recipes.title: Polish Bow Ties(Kruiciki)
directions: Combine yolks, sour cream, sugar, vanilla and salt.
Add flour and make a stiff dough.
Place on floured board and knead until smooth, but not sticky.
Divide dough in two or three parts. Cover the parts with bowl.
Roll one part of dough very thin.
Cut into strips.
Cut each piece in center and pull through center. Fry in deep fat.
Cool and sprinkle with powdered sugar.
recipes.text: Polish Bow Ties(Kruiciki). Combine yolks, sour cream, sugar, vanilla and salt. Add flour and make a stiff dough. Place on floured board and knead until smooth, but not sticky. Divide dough in two or three parts. Cover the parts with bowl. Roll one part of dough very thin. Cut into strips. Cut each piece in center and pull through center. Fry in deep fat. Cool and sprinkle with powdered sugar.

recipes.title: Hot Spiced Punch
directions: Put apple juice and sugar in a saucepan.
Stir to dissolve sugar; add spices, cover and boil 5 minutes.
Remove spices, lower heat and simmer.
An orange or lemon slice may be used to garnish each cup.
Serves approximately 24.
recipes.text: Hot Spiced Punch. Put apple juice and sugar in a saucepan. Stir to dissolve sugar; add spices, cover and boil 5 minutes. Remove spices, lower heat and simmer. An orange or lemon slice may be used to garnish each cup. Serves approximately 24.

recipes.title: French Onion Soup
directions: In covered large saucepan, cook onion in butter over low heat, about 30 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add beef broth, water and Worcestershire sauce; heat to boiling.
Reduce heat; cover and simmer about 30 minutes.
Place 1/2 slice toasted bread in each of 4 soup bowls.
Pour hot soup over bread and sprinkle with cheese. Makes 4 servings (1 cup each).
recipes.text: French Onion Soup. In covered large saucepan, cook onion in butter over low heat, about 30 minutes, stirring occasionally. Add beef broth, water and Worcestershire sauce; heat to boiling. Reduce heat; cover and simmer about 30 minutes. Place 1/2 slice toasted bread in each of 4 soup bowls. Pour hot soup over bread and sprinkle with cheese. Makes 4 servings (1 cup each).

recipes.title: Monkey Bread
directions: Cut biscuits into quarters.
Mix the sugar and cinnamon.
Coat biscuit quarters in sugar mixture and put in a greased Bundt pan. In a saucepan, combine brown sugar, margarine and nuts.
Cook over low heat until sugar is melted.
Drizzle this over biscuits in Bundt pan.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
Let stand about 15 minutes to cool.
recipes.text: Monkey Bread. Cut biscuits into quarters. Mix the sugar and cinnamon. Coat biscuit quarters in sugar mixture and put in a greased Bundt pan. In a saucepan, combine brown sugar, margarine and nuts. Cook over low heat until sugar is melted. Drizzle this over biscuits in Bundt pan. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes. Let stand about 15 minutes to cool.

recipes.title: Easy Holiday Cherry Salad
directions: Mix together and refrigerate overnight.
recipes.text: Easy Holiday Cherry Salad. Mix together and refrigerate overnight.

recipes.title: Squash Casserole
directions: Cook squash and onion until tender, then drain.
Mix other ingredients into squash mixture until of custard consistency.
Put in buttered casserole.
Sprinkle buttered Ritz crackers on top of casserole.
Freeze or bake at 400° for 50 minutes.
recipes.text: Squash Casserole. Cook squash and onion until tender, then drain. Mix other ingredients into squash mixture until of custard consistency. Put in buttered casserole. Sprinkle buttered Ritz crackers on top of casserole. Freeze or bake at 400° for 50 minutes.

recipes.title: California Spaghetti Salad
ingredients: 1/2 (2.75 oz.) jar McCormick seasoning (or less to taste)
directions: Chop all vegetables very small.
Cook spaghetti and let cool. Toss all ingredients into spaghetti.
Refrigerate for 8 hours before serving.
Serve cold.
This is a really good salad!
recipes.text: California Spaghetti Salad. Chop all vegetables very small. Cook spaghetti and let cool. Toss all ingredients into spaghetti. Refrigerate for 8 hours before serving. Serve cold. This is a really good salad!

recipes.title: Beef Stew
directions: Cut
potatoes	and
carrots
in
chunks.
Combine
all ingredients together in roasting pan with tightly covered lid. Bake in a 250° oven for 8 hours.
recipes.text: Beef Stew. Cut potatoes	and carrots in chunks. Combine all ingredients together in roasting pan with tightly covered lid. Bake in a 250° oven for 8 hours.

recipes.title: "Try-And-Guess" Salad-Theresa Shea
ingredients: 3 (1 lb. each) cans stewed tomatoes, containing onion, celery and peppers
directions: Dissolve gelatin in the hot water.
Stir in the stewed tomatoes, breaking them into bits with a spoon.
Add the hot pepper sauce.
Pour into a lightly oiled 3-quart mold and chill until firm.
Unmold on greens.
Place a small bowl in the center and fill with the sour cream, horseradish, salt and sugar.
Serves 12.
recipes.text: "Try-And-Guess" Salad-Theresa Shea. Dissolve gelatin in the hot water. Stir in the stewed tomatoes, breaking them into bits with a spoon. Add the hot pepper sauce. Pour into a lightly oiled 3-quart mold and chill until firm. Unmold on greens. Place a small bowl in the center and fill with the sour cream, horseradish, salt and sugar. Serves 12.

recipes.title: Fun Fudge
directions: Can substitute any flavor chips.
recipes.text: Fun Fudge. Can substitute any flavor chips.

recipes.title: Chicken Fillets
ingredients: boneless chicken breast, pound and cut into pieces
directions: Dip chicken pieces in egg mixture and then coat with bread crumbs.
Heat in pan of oil for about 3 minutes on each side. Place in a baking pan layered, overlapping and sprinkle with Parmesan cheese.
Heat in oven for 10 to 15 minutes at 350°.
recipes.text: Chicken Fillets. Dip chicken pieces in egg mixture and then coat with bread crumbs. Heat in pan of oil for about 3 minutes on each side. Place in a baking pan layered, overlapping and sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Heat in oven for 10 to 15 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Cheese Sausage Squares
ingredients: 1 lb. bulk sausage, fried and drained
directions: Add sausage to eggs and 2 cups cheese.
Line an 8 x 12-inch baking dish with 1 package rolls.
Spread sausage mixture on top. Place another package of rolls on top of sausage mixture.
Melt butter and spread on top of rolls.
Sprinkle with sesame seed. Follow baking directions on package of rolls.
Cut in squares.
recipes.text: Cheese Sausage Squares. Add sausage to eggs and 2 cups cheese. Line an 8 x 12-inch baking dish with 1 package rolls. Spread sausage mixture on top. Place another package of rolls on top of sausage mixture. Melt butter and spread on top of rolls. Sprinkle with sesame seed. Follow baking directions on package of rolls. Cut in squares.

recipes.title: Cheddary Scalloped Potatoes
ingredients: 4 medium potatoes, cooked and sliced (about 3 1/2 c.)
directions: In a skillet over medium heat in hot margarine, cook onion until tender. Add remaining ingredients, except parsley. Heat to boiling. Reduce heat to low. Cover; simmer 5 minutes or until hot and bubbly. Garnish with parsley. Makes 4 servings.
recipes.text: Cheddary Scalloped Potatoes. In a skillet over medium heat in hot margarine, cook onion until tender. Add remaining ingredients, except parsley. Heat to boiling. Reduce heat to low. Cover; simmer 5 minutes or until hot and bubbly. Garnish with parsley. Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: Miniature Peanut Butter Treats
directions: Combine butter, sugars, egg, peanut butter and vanilla in mixing bowl; beat until smooth.
In separate bowl, combine flour, baking soda and salt; add to creamed mixture.
Cover dough and chill.
When cold enough to handle easily, roll in small (walnut-sized) balls; place each ball in paper lined miniature muffin tin.
Bake at 375° for 8 to 9 minutes.
Remove from oven; gently press 1 peanut butter cup into each cookie to make depression.
Cool in pan 10 minutes; remove from pan and cool on rack.
Store in cool place until serving time.
recipes.text: Miniature Peanut Butter Treats. Combine butter, sugars, egg, peanut butter and vanilla in mixing bowl; beat until smooth. In separate bowl, combine flour, baking soda and salt; add to creamed mixture. Cover dough and chill. When cold enough to handle easily, roll in small (walnut-sized) balls; place each ball in paper lined miniature muffin tin. Bake at 375° for 8 to 9 minutes. Remove from oven; gently press 1 peanut butter cup into each cookie to make depression. Cool in pan 10 minutes; remove from pan and cool on rack. Store in cool place until serving time.

recipes.title: Anisette Cookies
directions: Beat eggs until smooth.
Add rest of ingredients.
Work batter until firm.
Drop by teaspoonfuls onto ungreased cookie sheet. Bake for 10 minutes in a 375° oven.
recipes.text: Anisette Cookies. Beat eggs until smooth. Add rest of ingredients. Work batter until firm. Drop by teaspoonfuls onto ungreased cookie sheet. Bake for 10 minutes in a 375° oven.

recipes.title: Broccoli Salad
ingredients: 10 slices bacon, fried crisp and crumbled
directions: Mix salad ingredients and refrigerate until ready to serve.
recipes.text: Broccoli Salad. Mix salad ingredients and refrigerate until ready to serve.

recipes.title: 24-Hour Bean Salad
ingredients: 1 small jar pimiento, cut up and drained
directions: Mix together green beans, kidney beans, celery, green pepper and pimiento.
Mix well sugar, vinegar, oil, water, salt and paprika and pour over salad.
Chill and drain before serving.
recipes.text: 24-Hour Bean Salad. Mix together green beans, kidney beans, celery, green pepper and pimiento. Mix well sugar, vinegar, oil, water, salt and paprika and pour over salad. Chill and drain before serving.

recipes.title: Royal Zucchini
directions: Saute meat and onions in oil until brown; drain.
Add tomato paste, tomato sauce, tomatoes and green peppers.
Simmer 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Blend cheese, seasonings and zucchini in.
Simmer for 5 minutes.
Pour mixture into 8 x 12-inch baking dish.
Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese.
Bake 45 minutes at 350°.
recipes.text: Royal Zucchini. Saute meat and onions in oil until brown; drain. Add tomato paste, tomato sauce, tomatoes and green peppers. Simmer 10 minutes, stirring occasionally. Blend cheese, seasonings and zucchini in. Simmer for 5 minutes. Pour mixture into 8 x 12-inch baking dish. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Bake 45 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Cheddar Cabbage Wedges
directions: Cut the cabbage into 8 wedges, leaving a portion of the core on each wedge, leaving
a portion of the core on each wedge. Steam wedges in boiling salted water in large kettle for 10-15 minutes or until crisp tender.
Drain and remove core, place wedges in a greased 3 qt. baking dish.
In a medium saucepan, saute green pepper and onion in butter until tender.
Stir in flour, salt and pepper.
Cook until bubbly, gradually add milk and cook and stir until thickened.
Pour over cabbage, bake uncovered at 375° for 15 minutes.
In a small bowl, combine cheese, mayonnaise and chili sauce, spoon over wedges and return to oven for 5 minutes.
recipes.text: Cheddar Cabbage Wedges. Cut the cabbage into 8 wedges, leaving a portion of the core on each wedge, leaving a portion of the core on each wedge. Steam wedges in boiling salted water in large kettle for 10-15 minutes or until crisp tender. Drain and remove core, place wedges in a greased 3 qt. baking dish. In a medium saucepan, saute green pepper and onion in butter until tender. Stir in flour, salt and pepper. Cook until bubbly, gradually add milk and cook and stir until thickened. Pour over cabbage, bake uncovered at 375° for 15 minutes. In a small bowl, combine cheese, mayonnaise and chili sauce, spoon over wedges and return to oven for 5 minutes.

recipes.title: Taco Pie
directions: Brown hamburger and onion.
Drain, if necessary.
To make grease pie plate and press 1 package of crescent rolls.
Put a layer of crushed taco or corn chips on crust.
Layer alternately with meat mixture, cheddar cheese, mozzarella cheese, sour cream and olives, if desired.
Top with small amount of crushed chips. Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Taco Pie. Brown hamburger and onion. Drain, if necessary. To make grease pie plate and press 1 package of crescent rolls. Put a layer of crushed taco or corn chips on crust. Layer alternately with meat mixture, cheddar cheese, mozzarella cheese, sour cream and olives, if desired. Top with small amount of crushed chips. Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Ground Beef And Okra
ingredients: 1 can Rotel tomatoes with green chilies
directions: Season ground meat and place in a cast iron pot; add onions and brown; drain off excess grease. Add tomatoes, tomato sauce, and frozen okra. Add enough water to cover okra and simmer over medium heat until okra is tender. Add salt and pepper to taste. Serve over rice with a slice of cornbread. Lip smackin' good!
recipes.text: Ground Beef And Okra. Season ground meat and place in a cast iron pot; add onions and brown; drain off excess grease. Add tomatoes, tomato sauce, and frozen okra. Add enough water to cover okra and simmer over medium heat until okra is tender. Add salt and pepper to taste. Serve over rice with a slice of cornbread. Lip smackin' good!

recipes.title: Raspberry Cranberry Jello Salad
directions: Grind cranberries and drain.
Add sugar and let stand.
Heat 2 cups water to dissolve jello.
Let partially set, about 20 to 30 minutes.
Then add all other ingredients, including cranberries. Cool and serve.
Serves 8 to 10.
recipes.text: Raspberry Cranberry Jello Salad. Grind cranberries and drain. Add sugar and let stand. Heat 2 cups water to dissolve jello. Let partially set, about 20 to 30 minutes. Then add all other ingredients, including cranberries. Cool and serve. Serves 8 to 10.

recipes.title: Huckleberry Muffins
directions: Sprinkle berries with a little of the flour.
Sift remaining flour with other dry ingredients.
Melt shortening; combine with milk and beaten egg yolks.
Mix dry and liquid mixtures quickly; fold in stiffly beaten egg white.
Bake for 1/2 hour in a 400° oven.
recipes.text: Huckleberry Muffins. Sprinkle berries with a little of the flour. Sift remaining flour with other dry ingredients. Melt shortening; combine with milk and beaten egg yolks. Mix dry and liquid mixtures quickly; fold in stiffly beaten egg white. Bake for 1/2 hour in a 400° oven.

recipes.title: Chicken And Rice Casserole
directions: Mix together all ingredients and put in a well-greased casserole dish.
Bake for 2 hours at 350°.
recipes.text: Chicken And Rice Casserole. Mix together all ingredients and put in a well-greased casserole dish. Bake for 2 hours at 350°.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter 'N Banana Bread
directions: Preheat oven to 350°.
With electric beater, cream together sugar and butter until light and fluffy.
Add bananas and eggs, beating until well mixed.
Sift together dry ingredients 3 times. Blend with banana mixture but do not overmix.
Pour into 2 lightly greased loaf pans.
Bake for 45 minutes to 1 hour, until firm in the centers and the edges begin to separate from pans.
Cool on a rack for 10 minutes before removing from pans.
These freeze beautifully.
recipes.text: Peanut Butter 'N Banana Bread. Preheat oven to 350°. With electric beater, cream together sugar and butter until light and fluffy. Add bananas and eggs, beating until well mixed. Sift together dry ingredients 3 times. Blend with banana mixture but do not overmix. Pour into 2 lightly greased loaf pans. Bake for 45 minutes to 1 hour, until firm in the centers and the edges begin to separate from pans. Cool on a rack for 10 minutes before removing from pans. These freeze beautifully.

recipes.title: Potatoes Au Gratin
directions: Preheat oven to 375°. Peel and slice potatoes; boil for approximately 5 to 8 minutes. While potatoes are boiling, grease an 8-inch square baking dish. In a medium saucepan, combine the cornstarch, milk, salt, pepper and butter and bring to a boil, stirring constantly until sauce thickens, about 5 minutes. Once sauce thickens, stir in 2 cups of the shredded cheese. Pour over potatoes. Sprinkle with bread crumbs and 1/4 cup shredded cheese. Bake in preheated oven until brown (about 30 to 40 minutes).
recipes.text: Potatoes Au Gratin. Preheat oven to 375°. Peel and slice potatoes; boil for approximately 5 to 8 minutes. While potatoes are boiling, grease an 8-inch square baking dish. In a medium saucepan, combine the cornstarch, milk, salt, pepper and butter and bring to a boil, stirring constantly until sauce thickens, about 5 minutes. Once sauce thickens, stir in 2 cups of the shredded cheese. Pour over potatoes. Sprinkle with bread crumbs and 1/4 cup shredded cheese. Bake in preheated oven until brown (about 30 to 40 minutes).

recipes.title: Brown Rice
directions: Mix all ingredients together. (Do not salt.) Put into baking dish, and bake covered at 350 degrees for one hour.
recipes.text: Brown Rice. Mix all ingredients together. (Do not salt.) Put into baking dish, and bake covered at 350 degrees for one hour.

recipes.title: Taco Salad
directions: Brown hamburger and drain.
Chop up lettuce; add diced tomatoes, diced onions and cheese.
Drain beans and add to mixture, along with hamburger.
Mix together with full bottle of dressing.
Crush corn chips to place on top of individual serving.
recipes.text: Taco Salad. Brown hamburger and drain. Chop up lettuce; add diced tomatoes, diced onions and cheese. Drain beans and add to mixture, along with hamburger. Mix together with full bottle of dressing. Crush corn chips to place on top of individual serving.

recipes.title: Joshua'S Favorite Chinese Chicken
directions: In a large saucepan or Dutch oven, combine the soy sauce, chili powder and garlic.
Add skinned and cut up chicken and scallions (cut into 1-inch sections with green tops), and stir to coat the chicken well.
recipes.text: Joshua'S Favorite Chinese Chicken. In a large saucepan or Dutch oven, combine the soy sauce, chili powder and garlic. Add skinned and cut up chicken and scallions (cut into 1-inch sections with green tops), and stir to coat the chicken well.

recipes.title: Peach Crisp
ingredients: 3/4 c. light brown sugar, packed firmly
directions: Arrange peaches in a slightly greased dish.
Blend sugar, flour, spices and butter until crumbly.
Sprinkle over peaches. Bake in 375° oven for 25 minutes.
Serve with whipped topping, if desired.
recipes.text: Peach Crisp. Arrange peaches in a slightly greased dish. Blend sugar, flour, spices and butter until crumbly. Sprinkle over peaches. Bake in 375° oven for 25 minutes. Serve with whipped topping, if desired.

recipes.title: Chicken And Rice
directions: Put rice in bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Arrange chicken pieces over rice.
Boil together Lipton onion soup, cream of chicken soup and water.
Pour mixture over chicken and rice. Bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours.
recipes.text: Chicken And Rice. Put rice in bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan. Arrange chicken pieces over rice. Boil together Lipton onion soup, cream of chicken soup and water. Pour mixture over chicken and rice. Bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours.

recipes.title: Pretzel Salad
directions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees.
recipes.text: Pretzel Salad. Preheat oven to 400 degrees.

recipes.title: Tom Selleck Cake
ingredients: 1 German chocolate cake mix, baked in a 9 x 13-inch pan
1 jar butterscotch caramel ice cream topping
directions: Poke holes in baked cake and pour Eagle Brand milk over evenly.
Pour topping over cake.
Frost with Cool Whip and then sprinkle crushed Heath bars over all.
Chill.
recipes.text: Tom Selleck Cake. Poke holes in baked cake and pour Eagle Brand milk over evenly. Pour topping over cake. Frost with Cool Whip and then sprinkle crushed Heath bars over all. Chill.

recipes.title: Gadsby'S Sally Lunn Bread
directions: Butter cookie sheet.
Heat milk and shortening to the temperature of a warm baby bottle.
Mix flour, salt and sugar in a separate bowl.
Add the warm milk and melted shortening to the bowl of flour, salt and sugar.
Add the eggs, yeast and water. Beat the entire mixture until it comes off the side of the bowl which should be clean.
Cover; let rise in a warm place until double in size, about 1 1/2 hours.
Knead the bread down in size and shape into a round loaf.
Place on the cookie sheet and let rise again to 1/2 again as big, about 45 minutes.
Bake bread at 300° for approximately 45 minutes.
After 30 minutes, baste the top of the bread with butter and also again after it has finished baking.
Serves 8.
Preparation Time:
recipes.text: Gadsby'S Sally Lunn Bread. Butter cookie sheet. Heat milk and shortening to the temperature of a warm baby bottle. Mix flour, salt and sugar in a separate bowl. Add the warm milk and melted shortening to the bowl of flour, salt and sugar. Add the eggs, yeast and water. Beat the entire mixture until it comes off the side of the bowl which should be clean. Cover; let rise in a warm place until double in size, about 1 1/2 hours. Knead the bread down in size and shape into a round loaf. Place on the cookie sheet and let rise again to 1/2 again as big, about 45 minutes. Bake bread at 300° for approximately 45 minutes. After 30 minutes, baste the top of the bread with butter and also again after it has finished baking. Serves 8. Preparation Time: 3:30.

recipes.title: Chocolate Crinkle Cookies
directions: Combine melted chocolate, oil and sugar.
Add eggs, one at
a time, beating after each addition.
Combine flour, baking powder and salt. Add to chocolate mixture, mixing well.
Chill several hours or overnight.
Roll dough into 1-inch balls. Roll each in powdered sugar and roll again between palms of hands.
Place 2-inches apart on lightly greased cookie sheet.
Bake at 350° for 10 to 12 minutes (center will be somewhat soft).
Remove from rack to cool.
Yields 6 dozen.
recipes.text: Chocolate Crinkle Cookies. Combine melted chocolate, oil and sugar. Add eggs, one at a time, beating after each addition. Combine flour, baking powder and salt. Add to chocolate mixture, mixing well. Chill several hours or overnight. Roll dough into 1-inch balls. Roll each in powdered sugar and roll again between palms of hands. Place 2-inches apart on lightly greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350° for 10 to 12 minutes (center will be somewhat soft). Remove from rack to cool. Yields 6 dozen.

recipes.title: Squash Casserole
directions: Mix all ingredients together; pour into greased casserole. Place in pan of water in a 350° oven.
Bake 45 minutes to 1 hour. Top with grated cheese last 10 minutes.
recipes.text: Squash Casserole. Mix all ingredients together; pour into greased casserole. Place in pan of water in a 350° oven. Bake 45 minutes to 1 hour. Top with grated cheese last 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Zesty Bacon Dip
directions: Mix cottage cheese and cream cheese in a bowl.
Stir in bacon, horseradish, scallions, parsley and pimento.
Chill for 1 hour. Serve with vegetables or crackers.
Yield:
2 cups.
recipes.text: Zesty Bacon Dip. Mix cottage cheese and cream cheese in a bowl. Stir in bacon, horseradish, scallions, parsley and pimento. Chill for 1 hour. Serve with vegetables or crackers. Yield: 2 cups.

recipes.title: Peach Delight Salad
directions: Dissolve jello in boiling water.
Add cold water.
Stir in drained, crushed pineapple and pie filling.
Mix well and allow to congeal.
recipes.text: Peach Delight Salad. Dissolve jello in boiling water. Add cold water. Stir in drained, crushed pineapple and pie filling. Mix well and allow to congeal.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Bread
directions: Sift dry ingredients into bowl; add peanut butter, blending with fork.
Stir in milk and egg.
Pour into greased loaf pan. Bake at 350° for about 50 minutes.
Makes 1 (9 x 5-inch) loaf.
recipes.text: Peanut Butter Bread. Sift dry ingredients into bowl; add peanut butter, blending with fork. Stir in milk and egg. Pour into greased loaf pan. Bake at 350° for about 50 minutes. Makes 1 (9 x 5-inch) loaf.

recipes.title: Chicken Special
ingredients: 2 tsp. chicken bouillon cubes or crushed cubes
directions: Cover chicken in water, adding soda.
Soak overnight.
Drain. Combine beaten egg with lemon juice, vinegar and milk.
Cover chicken and soak overnight; drain.
recipes.text: Chicken Special. Cover chicken in water, adding soda. Soak overnight. Drain. Combine beaten egg with lemon juice, vinegar and milk. Cover chicken and soak overnight; drain.

recipes.title: Peggy'S Bread Pudding
directions: Heat milk to scalding.
Remove from heat and add butter and sugar.
Cool mixture in sink with cold water.
Add eggs, raisins and vanilla.
Pour over bread.
Bake at 350° for 55 minutes.
recipes.text: Peggy'S Bread Pudding. Heat milk to scalding. Remove from heat and add butter and sugar. Cool mixture in sink with cold water. Add eggs, raisins and vanilla. Pour over bread. Bake at 350° for 55 minutes.

recipes.title: "Ali'S Black Bottom Cupcakes"
directions: Preheat oven to 325°.
Beat together cream cheese, egg, 1/3 cup sugar and 1/8 teaspoon salt.
Add 6 ounces semi-sweet chocolate morsels.
Set aside.
recipes.text: "Ali'S Black Bottom Cupcakes". Preheat oven to 325°. Beat together cream cheese, egg, 1/3 cup sugar and 1/8 teaspoon salt. Add 6 ounces semi-sweet chocolate morsels. Set aside.

recipes.title: Pecan Pie
directions: In a large bowl, stir together first 5 ingredients until well blended.
Stir in pecan halves.
Pour mixture into pie shell and bake at 350° for 50 to 55 minutes, or until a knife inserted halfway between center and edge comes out clean.
Cool.
Serves 6.
recipes.text: Pecan Pie. In a large bowl, stir together first 5 ingredients until well blended. Stir in pecan halves. Pour mixture into pie shell and bake at 350° for 50 to 55 minutes, or until a knife inserted halfway between center and edge comes out clean. Cool. Serves 6.

recipes.title: Spanish Rice
directions: Brown the hamburger. Saute the green pepper and onion. Mix all ingredients and bake at 350° for 40 minutes.
recipes.text: Spanish Rice. Brown the hamburger. Saute the green pepper and onion. Mix all ingredients and bake at 350° for 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Jewel Salad
directions: Soak gelatin in cold water for 5 minutes.
Then dissolve in boiling water, stirring in sugar and salt.
Add pineapple juice, lemon juice and vinegar; let cool.
Chill to consistency of unbeaten egg whites; then add the drained cucumber and pineapple.
recipes.text: Jewel Salad. Soak gelatin in cold water for 5 minutes. Then dissolve in boiling water, stirring in sugar and salt. Add pineapple juice, lemon juice and vinegar; let cool. Chill to consistency of unbeaten egg whites; then add the drained cucumber and pineapple.

recipes.title: Graham Crackers
directions: Cream butter, sugar and honey.
Mix the next 4 ingredients together.
Add to butter mixture.
Alternate with water.
Mix well and then let it stand for 30 minutes.
Flour tabletop and roll out dough to 1/4 to 1/2-inch thick.
Cut into 2-inch squares, using a serrated knife or use cookie cutter for fun shapes.
Place crackers on oiled cookie sheets.
Bake for 10 to 20 minutes at 350°.
Makes 3 dozen crackers.
recipes.text: Graham Crackers. Cream butter, sugar and honey. Mix the next 4 ingredients together. Add to butter mixture. Alternate with water. Mix well and then let it stand for 30 minutes. Flour tabletop and roll out dough to 1/4 to 1/2-inch thick. Cut into 2-inch squares, using a serrated knife or use cookie cutter for fun shapes. Place crackers on oiled cookie sheets. Bake for 10 to 20 minutes at 350°. Makes 3 dozen crackers.

recipes.title: Banana Bread
directions: Beat eggs with sugar.
Add oil.
Add bananas and mix well.
Add remaining ingredients and mix well.
Bake at 350° in greased and floured bread pans for 1 hour.
Makes 2 loaves.
recipes.text: Banana Bread. Beat eggs with sugar. Add oil. Add bananas and mix well. Add remaining ingredients and mix well. Bake at 350° in greased and floured bread pans for 1 hour. Makes 2 loaves.

recipes.title: Soy Sauce
directions: In a small saucepan, combine all ingredients; boil gently, uncovered, 5 minutes, until reduced to 1/2 cup.
Chill to store; stir before using.
This sauce has 120 mil. of sodium per teaspoon.
recipes.text: Soy Sauce. In a small saucepan, combine all ingredients; boil gently, uncovered, 5 minutes, until reduced to 1/2 cup. Chill to store; stir before using. This sauce has 120 mil. of sodium per teaspoon.

recipes.title: Hot Pineapple
directions: Combine the pineapple, sugar, flour and Cheddar cheese; mix well.
Put into buttered casserole dish.
Mix the crushed crackers with the melted margarine and sprinkle on top.
Cover and bake 45 minutes at 350°.
recipes.text: Hot Pineapple. Combine the pineapple, sugar, flour and Cheddar cheese; mix well. Put into buttered casserole dish. Mix the crushed crackers with the melted margarine and sprinkle on top. Cover and bake 45 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Hot Chicken Salad
ingredients: 1/2 c. shredded cheese or Swiss cheese
directions: Heat oven to 450°.
Mix all ingredients, except cheese and potato chips.
Spoon into 6 ungreased 1-cup baking dishes. Sprinkle with cheese and potato chips.
Bake, uncovered, 10 to 15 minutes or until bubbly.
recipes.text: Hot Chicken Salad. Heat oven to 450°. Mix all ingredients, except cheese and potato chips. Spoon into 6 ungreased 1-cup baking dishes. Sprinkle with cheese and potato chips. Bake, uncovered, 10 to 15 minutes or until bubbly.

recipes.title: Chile-Cheese Squares
ingredients: 2 (4 oz.) cans chopped green chilies, drained
directions: Mix together the cheeses.
Sprinkle half of the cheeses into a greased 9 x 13-inch baking dish.
Layer the green chilies over the cheese.
Top with remaining cheese.
Pour beaten eggs over the top and bake in a preheated 350° oven for 45 minutes.
Let stand for at least 10 minutes before cutting into squares to serve.
Can be served at room temperature.
recipes.text: Chile-Cheese Squares. Mix together the cheeses. Sprinkle half of the cheeses into a greased 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Layer the green chilies over the cheese. Top with remaining cheese. Pour beaten eggs over the top and bake in a preheated 350° oven for 45 minutes. Let stand for at least 10 minutes before cutting into squares to serve. Can be served at room temperature.

recipes.title: Sawdust Salad
directions: Dissolve orange and lemon jello in boiling water.
Add bananas and marshmallows while hot.
After marshmallows melt (or almost melt), add cold water.
Pour into oblong baking dish; let set until firm.
recipes.text: Sawdust Salad. Dissolve orange and lemon jello in boiling water. Add bananas and marshmallows while hot. After marshmallows melt (or almost melt), add cold water. Pour into oblong baking dish; let set until firm.

recipes.title: Magic Cookie Bars
directions: Preheat oven to 350° (325° glass).
In a 13 x 9-inch baking pan, melt margarine in oven.
Sprinkle crumbs over margarine. Pour milk evenly over crumbs.
Top with remaining ingredients in order.
Press down firmly.
Bake 25 to 30 minutes or until lightly brown.
Cool.
Chill, if desired.
Cut into bars.
Store loosely covered at room temperature.
Makes 24 to 36 bars.
recipes.text: Magic Cookie Bars. Preheat oven to 350° (325° glass). In a 13 x 9-inch baking pan, melt margarine in oven. Sprinkle crumbs over margarine. Pour milk evenly over crumbs. Top with remaining ingredients in order. Press down firmly. Bake 25 to 30 minutes or until lightly brown. Cool. Chill, if desired. Cut into bars. Store loosely covered at room temperature. Makes 24 to 36 bars.

recipes.title: Shrimp Fandango
ingredients: 1/4 c. each: diced yellow and red bell peppers (large dice)
10 oz. shelled and deveined large shrimp
1/2 c. Chinese snow peas (stem ends and strings removed), steamed until tender-crisp
1/2 c. julienne cut carrots (matchstick pieces), steamed until tender-crisp
dash of each: salt and hot sauce
1 c. cooked long grain rice, hot (optional)
directions: In 10-inch skillet, heat oil over medium heat.
Add peppers and garlic and saute until peppers are tender, about 2 minutes. Increase heat to high.
Add shrimp and cook, stirring constantly, until shrimp begin to turn pink, about 2 minutes.
Add vermouth; continue to stir and cook until liquid is reduced, about 2 minutes. Add remaining ingredients, except rice.
Cook, stirring constantly, until heated through.
If desired, serve over hot rice.
recipes.text: Shrimp Fandango. In 10-inch skillet, heat oil over medium heat. Add peppers and garlic and saute until peppers are tender, about 2 minutes. Increase heat to high. Add shrimp and cook, stirring constantly, until shrimp begin to turn pink, about 2 minutes. Add vermouth; continue to stir and cook until liquid is reduced, about 2 minutes. Add remaining ingredients, except rice. Cook, stirring constantly, until heated through. If desired, serve over hot rice.

recipes.title: Potato Chip Cookies
ingredients: 1 pkg. butterscotch chips or chocolate chips (12 oz. bag = 2 c.)
directions: Mix in order given.
Roll in balls and flatten with a buttered glass bottom dipped in sugar.
Bake at 350° for 17 minutes.
recipes.text: Potato Chip Cookies. Mix in order given. Roll in balls and flatten with a buttered glass bottom dipped in sugar. Bake at 350° for 17 minutes.

recipes.title: Bodacious Bulgar
ingredients: 1 can diced green chili peppers or fresh
1 large can whole or stewed tomatoes
1 can garbanzo or red kidney beans
spices to taste: cayenne pepper, chili powder, curry powder, etc.
directions: Saute garlic, onions, peppers and bulgar in oil until onions are soft and bulgar is coated with oil.
Add spices, tomatoes and beans.
Cover and bring to a low boil.
Simmer 15 minutes or until liquid is absorbed and bulgar is tender.
recipes.text: Bodacious Bulgar. Saute garlic, onions, peppers and bulgar in oil until onions are soft and bulgar is coated with oil. Add spices, tomatoes and beans. Cover and bring to a low boil. Simmer 15 minutes or until liquid is absorbed and bulgar is tender.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Drops
directions: Combine all ingredients and mix well.
Roll in
balls and place on waxed paper
to chill.
Dip in chocolate chips and wax which have been melted together.
recipes.text: Peanut Butter Drops. Combine all ingredients and mix well. Roll in balls and place on waxed paper to chill. Dip in chocolate chips and wax which have been melted together.

recipes.title: Meat Loaf
directions: Mix all ingredients.
Put in a loaf pan and bake at 400° for 30 to 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Meat Loaf. Mix all ingredients. Put in a loaf pan and bake at 400° for 30 to 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Fresh Apple Cake
ingredients: 3 c. apples, peeled and cut into pieces
directions: Combine oil, sugar, eggs and vanilla in large mixing bowl. Sift flour, salt, baking soda and cinnamon and stir into oil/egg mixture.
(Batter will be very stiff).
Add apples and walnuts and mix.
Bake at 350°.
A tube pan takes 1 1/4 hours; or makes 5 small loaf pans, baked for about 30 minutes.
Similar to fruit cake. Tastes best after it's been frozen or wrapped in foil or plastic wrap for a few days.
recipes.text: Fresh Apple Cake. Combine oil, sugar, eggs and vanilla in large mixing bowl. Sift flour, salt, baking soda and cinnamon and stir into oil/egg mixture. (Batter will be very stiff). Add apples and walnuts and mix. Bake at 350°. A tube pan takes 1 1/4 hours; or makes 5 small loaf pans, baked for about 30 minutes. Similar to fruit cake. Tastes best after it's been frozen or wrapped in foil or plastic wrap for a few days.

recipes.title: Layered Twenty-Four Hour Salad
ingredients: 3 c. shredded iceberg lettuce or any combination of lettuce
1 1/2 c. frozen Birds Eye green peas
2 c. Alpine Lace nonfat Mozzarella cheese, grated
1 qt. Kraft fat-free mayonnaise or Miracle Whip
directions: In a very large salad bowl, line the bottom with bite size pieces of lettuce.
Cover the lettuce with carrots, celery, onions, water chestnuts and peas.
Spread the quart of mayonnaise on top as if you are icing a cake.
Sprinkle Mozzarella and Parmesan cheeses on top.
Cover and refrigerate for 24 hours. Serves 16.
recipes.text: Layered Twenty-Four Hour Salad. In a very large salad bowl, line the bottom with bite size pieces of lettuce. Cover the lettuce with carrots, celery, onions, water chestnuts and peas. Spread the quart of mayonnaise on top as if you are icing a cake. Sprinkle Mozzarella and Parmesan cheeses on top. Cover and refrigerate for 24 hours. Serves 16.

recipes.title: Beef And Vegetable Casserole
directions: Brown beef, onion and pepper together; drain.
Combine next 3 ingredients; simmer for 10 minutes.
Add 1 1/2 cups cheese and mixed vegetables; salt to taste.
Pour into a greased bake dish. Separate biscuits into 20 pieces; overlap biscuits around outside edge of dish.
Spread 1/2 cup Mozzarella cheese in center of biscuits.
Bake for 25 minutes at 375°.
recipes.text: Beef And Vegetable Casserole. Brown beef, onion and pepper together; drain. Combine next 3 ingredients; simmer for 10 minutes. Add 1 1/2 cups cheese and mixed vegetables; salt to taste. Pour into a greased bake dish. Separate biscuits into 20 pieces; overlap biscuits around outside edge of dish. Spread 1/2 cup Mozzarella cheese in center of biscuits. Bake for 25 minutes at 375°.

recipes.title: Chicken-Dressing Casserole
directions: Cook and debone chicken.
In a 13 x 9-inch baking dish, combine soups.
Lay chicken on top of soups.
Put in frozen peas. Mix stuffing by directions on box; spread over chicken mixture. Cover with foil and bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
Good to make ahead and freeze.
recipes.text: Chicken-Dressing Casserole. Cook and debone chicken. In a 13 x 9-inch baking dish, combine soups. Lay chicken on top of soups. Put in frozen peas. Mix stuffing by directions on box; spread over chicken mixture. Cover with foil and bake at 350° for 30 minutes. Good to make ahead and freeze.

recipes.title: Cauliflower Dip
directions: Mix all ingredients and refrigerate.
Split a head of cauliflower and serve with dip.
recipes.text: Cauliflower Dip. Mix all ingredients and refrigerate. Split a head of cauliflower and serve with dip.

recipes.title: Meat Loaf
directions: Mix beef, bread crumbs, sweet pepper, onion, egg, sugar, salt and 1/2 can tomato sauce. Mix remaining tomato sauce, brown sugar, vinegar and dry mustard. Pour over meat. Cross 2 slices of bacon over meat. Bake in 350° oven for 35 to 40 minutes.
recipes.text: Meat Loaf. Mix beef, bread crumbs, sweet pepper, onion, egg, sugar, salt and 1/2 can tomato sauce. Mix remaining tomato sauce, brown sugar, vinegar and dry mustard. Pour over meat. Cross 2 slices of bacon over meat. Bake in 350° oven for 35 to 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Corn Bake
directions: Pour in casserole and bake for 35 minutes at 350°.
recipes.text: Corn Bake. Pour in casserole and bake for 35 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Zucchini Bread
directions: Beat eggs until light and foamy.
Add oil, sugar, zucchini and vanilla.
Mix lightly, but well.
Sift flour, spices, soda and baking powder.
Add to zucchini mixture and blend well.
Add nuts. Pour batter into 2 (8 x 4-inch) greased and floured pans.
Bake at 325° for 1 hour or until done.
recipes.text: Zucchini Bread. Beat eggs until light and foamy. Add oil, sugar, zucchini and vanilla. Mix lightly, but well. Sift flour, spices, soda and baking powder. Add to zucchini mixture and blend well. Add nuts. Pour batter into 2 (8 x 4-inch) greased and floured pans. Bake at 325° for 1 hour or until done.

recipes.title: Six Week Raisin Bran Muffins
directions: Pour 2 cups
hot water over bran and let it stand while mixing muffins.	 Mix
wet
ingredients	together.
Add	wet ingredients to dry ingredients.
Add soaked bran and mix well. Store in
refrigerator.
Will
keep
weeks. Bake at 350° in oiled muffin tins
or
cup	cases,	15
to 20 minutes.
Do not overcook.
Yields 6 dozen.
recipes.text: Six Week Raisin Bran Muffins. Pour 2 cups hot water over bran and let it stand while mixing muffins.	 Mix wet ingredients	together. Add	wet ingredients to dry ingredients. Add soaked bran and mix well. Store in refrigerator. Will keep 6 weeks. Bake at 350° in oiled muffin tins or cup	cases,	15 to 20 minutes. Do not overcook. Yields 6 dozen.

recipes.title: Egg And Tomato Sandwich
directions: Mix egg, tomato, salt and pepper together.
In frying pan, melt butter and add egg.
Mix.
When egg is cooked, lay cheese on top, just to melt a little.
Place on toast with mayonnaise or butter.
recipes.text: Egg And Tomato Sandwich. Mix egg, tomato, salt and pepper together. In frying pan, melt butter and add egg. Mix. When egg is cooked, lay cheese on top, just to melt a little. Place on toast with mayonnaise or butter.

recipes.title: Pineapple Walnut Cake
ingredients: 1 (20 oz.) can crushed pineapple in juice
directions: Mix by hand in large bowl.
Pour into ungreased 13 x 9-inch pan and bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes.
recipes.text: Pineapple Walnut Cake. Mix by hand in large bowl. Pour into ungreased 13 x 9-inch pan and bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Vegetable Sandwich Spread
directions: Drain vegetables after chopping.
Beat together cheese and lemon juice.
Stir in vegetables.
Great on crackers or in sandwiches.
recipes.text: Vegetable Sandwich Spread. Drain vegetables after chopping. Beat together cheese and lemon juice. Stir in vegetables. Great on crackers or in sandwiches.

recipes.title: Broccoli Casserole
directions: Melt margarine and saute onion.
Pour soup and Cheez Whiz into this.
Stir well until all is melted.
Add black pepper and several dashes of hot sauce.
recipes.text: Broccoli Casserole. Melt margarine and saute onion. Pour soup and Cheez Whiz into this. Stir well until all is melted. Add black pepper and several dashes of hot sauce.

recipes.title: Hearty Casserole
ingredients: 1/2 lb. American process cheese, cut into 1/4-inch cubes
1 (8 oz.) pkg. elbow macaroni, cooked in 3 qt. salted, boiling water
directions: Melt butter in skillet; add onion and cook until transparent. Then add meat and continue to cook until meat loses its reddish color.
Set aside to cool.
Mix the cheese, drained macaroni, mustard, corn, salt, pepper and tomato soup.
Stir in the mixture of meat and onion.
Place in a 1 1/2-quart buttered casserole dish and bake at 350° for 1 hour.
Serve piping hot.
recipes.text: Hearty Casserole. Melt butter in skillet; add onion and cook until transparent. Then add meat and continue to cook until meat loses its reddish color. Set aside to cool. Mix the cheese, drained macaroni, mustard, corn, salt, pepper and tomato soup. Stir in the mixture of meat and onion. Place in a 1 1/2-quart buttered casserole dish and bake at 350° for 1 hour. Serve piping hot.

recipes.title: White Potato Pie
directions: Put potatoes in bowl; add butter, sugar, flour, eggs, milk, salt and flavoring.
Mix well and pour in an unbaked pie crust. Bake in 400° oven for 35 minutes, then lower temperature to 350° and continue to cook until browned.
recipes.text: White Potato Pie. Put potatoes in bowl; add butter, sugar, flour, eggs, milk, salt and flavoring. Mix well and pour in an unbaked pie crust. Bake in 400° oven for 35 minutes, then lower temperature to 350° and continue to cook until browned.

recipes.title: Meal In A Skillet
directions: Cook beef in skillet until it changes colors (almost done). Drain beef.
Add onions, celery and garlic clove.
Stir well while cooking for 15 minutes.
Add English peas, Spanish rice, salt and pepper to meat.
Cook 10 more minutes.
Dip up into serving plates and sprinkle with Parmesan cheese on top while meat is hot.
recipes.text: Meal In A Skillet. Cook beef in skillet until it changes colors (almost done). Drain beef. Add onions, celery and garlic clove. Stir well while cooking for 15 minutes. Add English peas, Spanish rice, salt and pepper to meat. Cook 10 more minutes. Dip up into serving plates and sprinkle with Parmesan cheese on top while meat is hot.

recipes.title: French Toast Souffl(Serves 12)
directions: Butter 1 (9 x 13) or 2 (7 x 11) glass baking dish(es) well. Fill dishes 1/2 to 3/4 full with bread cubes. In a small bowl, mix butter, cream cheese and syrup together.
