It is okay to leave a little lumpy. Spoon this mixture over bread crumbs distributing evenly to the edges. In a large bowl, beat eggs, half and half and vanilla. Pour this egg mixture over bread. Fill to 1/2-inch of the top of the dish(es) so that it does not overflow in cooking. Your breadcrumbs will be floating at this point. Dust with cinnamon, cover and store overnight in the refrigerator. Bake at 350° for 45 to 50 minutes. The souffl is done when the center is raised and firm.
recipes.text: French Toast Souffl(Serves 12). Butter 1 (9 x 13) or 2 (7 x 11) glass baking dish(es) well. Fill dishes 1/2 to 3/4 full with bread cubes. In a small bowl, mix butter, cream cheese and syrup together. It is okay to leave a little lumpy. Spoon this mixture over bread crumbs distributing evenly to the edges. In a large bowl, beat eggs, half and half and vanilla. Pour this egg mixture over bread. Fill to 1/2-inch of the top of the dish(es) so that it does not overflow in cooking. Your breadcrumbs will be floating at this point. Dust with cinnamon, cover and store overnight in the refrigerator. Bake at 350° for 45 to 50 minutes. The souffl is done when the center is raised and firm.

recipes.title: Calico Bean Casserole
ingredients: 1/8 c. white sugar or to taste
directions: Combine catsup, salt, brown sugar, dry mustard, vinegar, sugar and beans.
Fry bacon; drain.
Add hamburg and brown.
Add rest of ingredients.
Place in casserole and bake at 350° for 40 minutes.
recipes.text: Calico Bean Casserole. Combine catsup, salt, brown sugar, dry mustard, vinegar, sugar and beans. Fry bacon; drain. Add hamburg and brown. Add rest of ingredients. Place in casserole and bake at 350° for 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Ham Roll-Ups
directions: Clean mushrooms and chop finely.
Add to cream cheese and chives.
Place 1 teaspoon of mixture on ham slice, add green onion and roll up.
Serve chilled.
recipes.text: Ham Roll-Ups. Clean mushrooms and chop finely. Add to cream cheese and chives. Place 1 teaspoon of mixture on ham slice, add green onion and roll up. Serve chilled.

recipes.title: Spicy Hamburger Soup
directions: Brown beef and onions. Drain. Add cumin and pepper to beef and stir. Put beef in large saucepan and add remaining ingredients. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer, uncovered, for 10 minutes.
recipes.text: Spicy Hamburger Soup. Brown beef and onions. Drain. Add cumin and pepper to beef and stir. Put beef in large saucepan and add remaining ingredients. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer, uncovered, for 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Chicken Enchiladas
directions: Combine soup, sour cream and onions.
Add half of each cheese. Divide this into 2 unequal halves.
Add chicken to the smaller half.
Use this to fill the tortillas, rolling up each around some of the filling.
Spread half of the remaining soup mixture in bottom of 10 x 13-inch pan.
Add filled tortillas.
Top with remaining soup mixture.
Top with remaining cheese.
Bake at 350° for 20 to 30 minutes until hot.
Serves 10.
recipes.text: Chicken Enchiladas. Combine soup, sour cream and onions. Add half of each cheese. Divide this into 2 unequal halves. Add chicken to the smaller half. Use this to fill the tortillas, rolling up each around some of the filling. Spread half of the remaining soup mixture in bottom of 10 x 13-inch pan. Add filled tortillas. Top with remaining soup mixture. Top with remaining cheese. Bake at 350° for 20 to 30 minutes until hot. Serves 10.

recipes.title: Party Potato Casserole
ingredients: 6 to 8 oz. sharp Cheddar cheese, grated
directions: Bake potatoes.
Scoop potato out of shell when cool enough to handle.
Discard shell.
Leave potatoes chunky, do not mash.
Add sour cream, chives, salt, pepper, 1/2 cheese and milk.
Add enough milk to make mixture soft, but not soupy; mix ingredients lightly.
recipes.text: Party Potato Casserole. Bake potatoes. Scoop potato out of shell when cool enough to handle. Discard shell. Leave potatoes chunky, do not mash. Add sour cream, chives, salt, pepper, 1/2 cheese and milk. Add enough milk to make mixture soft, but not soupy; mix ingredients lightly.

recipes.title: Bbq Sauce
directions: Mix all ingredients together and bring to a boil, stirring occasionally.
Lower heat and boil gently 15 minutes, until thickened.
recipes.text: Bbq Sauce. Mix all ingredients together and bring to a boil, stirring occasionally. Lower heat and boil gently 15 minutes, until thickened.

recipes.title: Claire'S Chicken Wings
directions: Marinate chicken overnight. Bake chicken for 1/2 hour at 350°; turn over onto other side. Bake for 1/2 hour at 350°.
recipes.text: Claire'S Chicken Wings. Marinate chicken overnight. Bake chicken for 1/2 hour at 350°; turn over onto other side. Bake for 1/2 hour at 350°.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Bread
directions: Add sugar to oil.
Add eggs and pumpkin.
Sift together dry ingredients.
Then add water.
Place in greased and floured pan. Add nuts, if desired.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
Makes 2 loaves.
recipes.text: Pumpkin Bread. Add sugar to oil. Add eggs and pumpkin. Sift together dry ingredients. Then add water. Place in greased and floured pan. Add nuts, if desired. Bake at 350° for 1 hour. Makes 2 loaves.

recipes.title: Hearty Cheese Grits
ingredients: 4 c. (1 lb.) shredded medium-sharp Cheddar cheese, divided
directions: Combine water and salt; bring to a boil.
Stir in grits; cook until done, following package directions.
Remove from heat.
Add butter and 3 3/4 cups cheese; stir until cheese melts.
Add a small amount of hot grits to eggs, stirring well; stir egg mixture into remaining hot grits.
Pour grits into a lightly greased 2 1/2-quart baking dish.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour and 10 minutes.
Sprinkle with remaining 1/4 cup cheese; bake an additional 5 minutes. Yields 8 servings.
recipes.text: Hearty Cheese Grits. Combine water and salt; bring to a boil. Stir in grits; cook until done, following package directions. Remove from heat. Add butter and 3 3/4 cups cheese; stir until cheese melts. Add a small amount of hot grits to eggs, stirring well; stir egg mixture into remaining hot grits. Pour grits into a lightly greased 2 1/2-quart baking dish. Bake at 350° for 1 hour and 10 minutes. Sprinkle with remaining 1/4 cup cheese; bake an additional 5 minutes. Yields 8 servings.

recipes.title: Vegetable Spread
directions: In food processor, chop together carrots, red pepper, celery and walnuts to coarse consistency. Add ginger, lemon rind and enough mayonnaise to hold mixture together. Chill before serving. Makes 1 1/2 cups.
recipes.text: Vegetable Spread. In food processor, chop together carrots, red pepper, celery and walnuts to coarse consistency. Add ginger, lemon rind and enough mayonnaise to hold mixture together. Chill before serving. Makes 1 1/2 cups.

recipes.title: Graham Toffee Bars
ingredients: chopped nuts to your taste (I like lots of pecans)
directions: Prepare cookie sheet first. May want to spray with Pam for easy cleaning. Line cookie sheet with graham crackers in a single layer. Bring butter, oleo and sugar to slow boil and boil for 5 minutes. Immediately spoon butter mixture over graham crackers, spreading with back of large spoon to make sure all crackers are coated. Sprinkle the nuts generously over the crackers. Bake at 350° for 10 minutes. Adjust to your oven as these have a tendency to overcook around the edges of the pan. Remove from oven and transfer immediately to wax paper to cool. When cool, break into pieces and store in airtight container.
recipes.text: Graham Toffee Bars. Prepare cookie sheet first. May want to spray with Pam for easy cleaning. Line cookie sheet with graham crackers in a single layer. Bring butter, oleo and sugar to slow boil and boil for 5 minutes. Immediately spoon butter mixture over graham crackers, spreading with back of large spoon to make sure all crackers are coated. Sprinkle the nuts generously over the crackers. Bake at 350° for 10 minutes. Adjust to your oven as these have a tendency to overcook around the edges of the pan. Remove from oven and transfer immediately to wax paper to cool. When cool, break into pieces and store in airtight container.

recipes.title: Red Velvet Cake
ingredients: 1 c. buttermilk with 1 tsp. vinegar and 1 tsp. soda
2 1/2 c. plain flour with 1 tsp. cocoa
directions: Mix ingredients in order given.
Divide into 2 (9-inch) greased and floured layer cake pans.
Bake at 350° for approximately 1 hour or until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean.
recipes.text: Red Velvet Cake. Mix ingredients in order given. Divide into 2 (9-inch) greased and floured layer cake pans. Bake at 350° for approximately 1 hour or until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean.

recipes.title: Homemade Coconut Pie
directions: Mix sugar, flour, egg yolks and vanilla.
Cook slowly and stir constantly until mixture becomes thick.
Add coconut to mixture. Pour into browned pie shells.
recipes.text: Homemade Coconut Pie. Mix sugar, flour, egg yolks and vanilla. Cook slowly and stir constantly until mixture becomes thick. Add coconut to mixture. Pour into browned pie shells.

recipes.title: Orange Biscuits
directions: Sift flour, salt and baking powder. Add orange rind. Cut in shortening. Add juice and sour cream. Roll to 3/4-inch on floured board. Cut and bake on nonstick cookie sheet 8 minutes at 425°. Cool on wire rack or serve warm. Good with orange marmalade.
recipes.text: Orange Biscuits. Sift flour, salt and baking powder. Add orange rind. Cut in shortening. Add juice and sour cream. Roll to 3/4-inch on floured board. Cut and bake on nonstick cookie sheet 8 minutes at 425°. Cool on wire rack or serve warm. Good with orange marmalade.

recipes.title: Date Nut Bread
directions: Add sugar, soda, butter, dates and nuts.
Pour boiling water over ingredients and let stand 5 minutes.
When cool, add remaining ingredients.
Pour into a greased bread pan.
Bake at 350° for 50 to 60 minutes.
Freezes well.
recipes.text: Date Nut Bread. Add sugar, soda, butter, dates and nuts. Pour boiling water over ingredients and let stand 5 minutes. When cool, add remaining ingredients. Pour into a greased bread pan. Bake at 350° for 50 to 60 minutes. Freezes well.

recipes.title: Applesauce Delight
directions: Whip Dream Whip as directed on package and add softened cream cheese.
Then add marshmallows.
Let stand in refrigerator until needed.
recipes.text: Applesauce Delight. Whip Dream Whip as directed on package and add softened cream cheese. Then add marshmallows. Let stand in refrigerator until needed.

recipes.title: Pepperoni Rolls
ingredients: 7 c. flour or enough to make soft dough
2 or 3 cans or jars pizza sauce
1 lb. pepperoni, sliced and cut in small pieces
directions: Mix dough and put in greased bowl to rise.
(I let it rise 3 times.)
Divide into balls about the size of golf balls.
Put spoon of pizza sauce on cutting board and press ball of dough to make it flat.
Put spoon of sauce on it and pepperoni and cheese, if you want, and roll up.
Put side by side on greased cookie sheet.
After pan is full, brush top with pizza sauce.
Bake at 375° for 25 minutes.
Brush with oleo and let cool.
Makes about 200 rolls.
recipes.text: Pepperoni Rolls. Mix dough and put in greased bowl to rise. (I let it rise 3 times.) Divide into balls about the size of golf balls. Put spoon of pizza sauce on cutting board and press ball of dough to make it flat. Put spoon of sauce on it and pepperoni and cheese, if you want, and roll up. Put side by side on greased cookie sheet. After pan is full, brush top with pizza sauce. Bake at 375° for 25 minutes. Brush with oleo and let cool. Makes about 200 rolls.

recipes.title: Broccoli, Turkey And Rice Casserole
ingredients: 1 pkg. frozen chopped broccoli, thawed (or can use fresh broccoli)
directions: Mix all together except 1/2 cup cheese.
Put in 1 1/2-quart casserole dish.
Sprinkle 1/2 cup cheese on top.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Broccoli, Turkey And Rice Casserole. Mix all together except 1/2 cup cheese. Put in 1 1/2-quart casserole dish. Sprinkle 1/2 cup cheese on top. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Low-Fat Spinach Dip
directions: Thaw spinach in strainer; squeeze out excess water.
Mix together all ingredients, except noodles.
Break noodles into 1/2-inch pieces and add to dip.
Add noodles less than 1 hour before serving so they don't get soggy.
recipes.text: Low-Fat Spinach Dip. Thaw spinach in strainer; squeeze out excess water. Mix together all ingredients, except noodles. Break noodles into 1/2-inch pieces and add to dip. Add noodles less than 1 hour before serving so they don't get soggy.

recipes.title: Mushroom-Macaroni Casserole
ingredients: 1 (10 3/4 oz.) can cream of mushroom soup (undiluted)
2 c. (8 oz.) shredded sharp Cheddar cheese
directions: Bring water and salt to boil in large Dutch oven; stir in macaroni.
Return to a rapid boil and cook 8 to 10 minutes.
Drain. Rinse in cold water.
Drain.
Combine macaroni, soup, mayonnaise, cheese and mushrooms.
Add pimentos.
Spoon into a lightly greased 2-quart casserole dish.
Combine cracker crumbs and butter. Sprinkle evenly over macaroni mixture.
Bake at 300° for 30 minutes.
Yield:
6 to 8 servings.
recipes.text: Mushroom-Macaroni Casserole. Bring water and salt to boil in large Dutch oven; stir in macaroni. Return to a rapid boil and cook 8 to 10 minutes. Drain. Rinse in cold water. Drain. Combine macaroni, soup, mayonnaise, cheese and mushrooms. Add pimentos. Spoon into a lightly greased 2-quart casserole dish. Combine cracker crumbs and butter. Sprinkle evenly over macaroni mixture. Bake at 300° for 30 minutes. Yield: 6 to 8 servings.

recipes.title: Soybean Loaf
directions: Soak soybeans all night.
Simmer until tender. Grind or mash. Form into loaf.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Soybean Loaf. Soak soybeans all night. Simmer until tender. Grind or mash. Form into loaf. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Favorite Green Bean Casserole
directions: Combine green beans, soup and onions (reserving a few onions for garnish) in a 1 1/2-quart casserole.
Bake 30 minutes at 350°. Serves 6.
recipes.text: Favorite Green Bean Casserole. Combine green beans, soup and onions (reserving a few onions for garnish) in a 1 1/2-quart casserole. Bake 30 minutes at 350°. Serves 6.

recipes.title: Mexican Hot Sauce Dip
directions: Mix all together in a blender until smooth.
Serve with Doritos.
Makes 1 quart.
Very good on all Mexican food and as a dip.
recipes.text: Mexican Hot Sauce Dip. Mix all together in a blender until smooth. Serve with Doritos. Makes 1 quart. Very good on all Mexican food and as a dip.

recipes.title: Quick Spaghetti
directions: Lightly brown the ground beef.
Add to the cheese flavored spaghetti, the ground beef, catsup and barbecue sauce.
Put all ingredients in a large pan and simmer on a very low heat for several hours.
Makes a yummy spaghetti that kids especially like.
recipes.text: Quick Spaghetti. Lightly brown the ground beef. Add to the cheese flavored spaghetti, the ground beef, catsup and barbecue sauce. Put all ingredients in a large pan and simmer on a very low heat for several hours. Makes a yummy spaghetti that kids especially like.

recipes.title: Strawberry Salad
directions: Mix pretzels, butter and 3 tablespoons sugar; press into a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Bake for 10 minutes at 350°; cool.
recipes.text: Strawberry Salad. Mix pretzels, butter and 3 tablespoons sugar; press into a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake for 10 minutes at 350°; cool.

recipes.title: Cool Whip Pie
directions: Put lemon juice in the milk and stir well.
Add Cool Whip, pineapple and nuts.
If not thick enough, add more lemon juice. Put into shells and chill.
recipes.text: Cool Whip Pie. Put lemon juice in the milk and stir well. Add Cool Whip, pineapple and nuts. If not thick enough, add more lemon juice. Put into shells and chill.

recipes.title: Barbecue
directions: Brown hamburger and mix rest of ingredients.
Boil 15 minutes.
recipes.text: Barbecue. Brown hamburger and mix rest of ingredients. Boil 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Chicken Cacciatore
directions: In large skillet, lightly brown chicken in olive oil.
Remove chicken.
Saute onion, mushrooms, green pepper and garlic in oil until onion is clear.
Drain any remaining oil from skillet.
Add remaining ingredients to skillet (sherry is optional) and stir thoroughly.
Add chicken to sauce.
Simmer slowly with lid for about 1 hour.
Remove lid and simmer, uncovered, to thicken. Serve over rice or spaghetti.
recipes.text: Chicken Cacciatore. In large skillet, lightly brown chicken in olive oil. Remove chicken. Saute onion, mushrooms, green pepper and garlic in oil until onion is clear. Drain any remaining oil from skillet. Add remaining ingredients to skillet (sherry is optional) and stir thoroughly. Add chicken to sauce. Simmer slowly with lid for about 1 hour. Remove lid and simmer, uncovered, to thicken. Serve over rice or spaghetti.

recipes.title: Pink Punch
directions: Add boiling water to jello.
Stir until dissolved.
Add cold water, juice and sugar.
Chill.
When ready to serve, add ginger ale.
Makes 1 1/2 gallons.
recipes.text: Pink Punch. Add boiling water to jello. Stir until dissolved. Add cold water, juice and sugar. Chill. When ready to serve, add ginger ale. Makes 1 1/2 gallons.

recipes.title: Frosted Chews
ingredients: 1 (6 oz.) pkg. butterscotch morsels, or 12 oz. pkg. semi-sweet morsels
directions: Place sugar and corn syrup in medium-size saucepan and stir to combine.
Cook over medium heat, stirring frequently, until mixture boils.
Remove from heat.
Add peanut butter.
Mix well. Add Special K cereal.
Stir until evenly coated.
Press mixture evenly and firmly into buttered 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan.
Cool.
recipes.text: Frosted Chews. Place sugar and corn syrup in medium-size saucepan and stir to combine. Cook over medium heat, stirring frequently, until mixture boils. Remove from heat. Add peanut butter. Mix well. Add Special K cereal. Stir until evenly coated. Press mixture evenly and firmly into buttered 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan. Cool.

recipes.title: Church Punch
directions: Mix well and add crushed ice.
recipes.text: Church Punch. Mix well and add crushed ice.

recipes.title: Seafood Gumbo
ingredients: 2 c. stock (seafood, chicken or canned chicken broth)
1 tsp. each: salt, crushed bay leaves and thyme
2 to 3 lb. raw seafood (shrimp, crayfish tails, crabmeat, etc.)
directions: Brown flour in oil in large heavy pot slowly, stirring to make mahogany brown roux. Add chopped vegetables and saut until soft. Add tomato sauce, tomatoes, chicken stock, water, okra and seasoning. Stir and simmer about 45 minutes. Add seafood and cook another 20 to 30 minutes. Serve around scoop of hot rice. Offer file at table. Serves 8 to 10.
recipes.text: Seafood Gumbo. Brown flour in oil in large heavy pot slowly, stirring to make mahogany brown roux. Add chopped vegetables and saut until soft. Add tomato sauce, tomatoes, chicken stock, water, okra and seasoning. Stir and simmer about 45 minutes. Add seafood and cook another 20 to 30 minutes. Serve around scoop of hot rice. Offer file at table. Serves 8 to 10.

recipes.title: Chicken Meal - In- One
ingredients: 4-1/2 cups frozen shredded hash brown potatoes
1 can condensed cream of chicken soup, undiluted
directions: In an ungreased 13 x 9 x2 inch baking dish, combine hash browns, beans, and carrots. Top with chicken. Combine remaining ingredients, pour over chicken and vegetables. Cover and bake at 375° for 50 minutes. Uncover, bake 25 to 30 minutes longer or until chicken is done.
recipes.text: Chicken Meal - In- One. In an ungreased 13 x 9 x2 inch baking dish, combine hash browns, beans, and carrots. Top with chicken. Combine remaining ingredients, pour over chicken and vegetables. Cover and bake at 375° for 50 minutes. Uncover, bake 25 to 30 minutes longer or until chicken is done.

recipes.title: Holiday Ham Spread
directions: Combine ham, 1/2 cup mayonnaise, onion, sweet pickle relish and 4 ounces of cream cheese; chill.
recipes.text: Holiday Ham Spread. Combine ham, 1/2 cup mayonnaise, onion, sweet pickle relish and 4 ounces of cream cheese; chill.

recipes.title: Six Cup Salad
directions: Stir together and refrigerate.
recipes.text: Six Cup Salad. Stir together and refrigerate.

recipes.title: Cream Of Broccoli Soup
ingredients: 1 lb. fresh or 1 (20 oz.) pkg. frozen broccoli
directions: Cut broccoli into 1/2-inch slices, paring main stems and removing leaves.
In a medium saucepan, combine fresh broccoli and 1 cup water (1/2 cup for frozen) and steam uncovered for 15 minutes.
In a large soup pot, melt 4 tablespoons butter.
Add onion and celery and cook until soft (about 6 minutes).
Add flour and stir until thoroughly mixed.
Slowly add chicken broth until mixture slightly thickens.
Add broccoli and simmer 5 minutes.
In small batches, puree soup in blender.
Add cream, salt, pepper and tarragon.
If desired, stir in 1 cup chopped ham and simmer.
Serve with grated Cheddar cheese, sprinkled on top.
recipes.text: Cream Of Broccoli Soup. Cut broccoli into 1/2-inch slices, paring main stems and removing leaves. In a medium saucepan, combine fresh broccoli and 1 cup water (1/2 cup for frozen) and steam uncovered for 15 minutes. In a large soup pot, melt 4 tablespoons butter. Add onion and celery and cook until soft (about 6 minutes). Add flour and stir until thoroughly mixed. Slowly add chicken broth until mixture slightly thickens. Add broccoli and simmer 5 minutes. In small batches, puree soup in blender. Add cream, salt, pepper and tarragon. If desired, stir in 1 cup chopped ham and simmer. Serve with grated Cheddar cheese, sprinkled on top.

recipes.title: Hello Dolly Cookies
directions: In a 9 x 13-inch pan, melt margarine.
Spread graham cracker crumbs over margarine.
Next, spread chocolate chips over crumbs and then
spread oats.
Next, spread nuts over oats and pour milk over all.
Bake about 30 minutes at 350°.
recipes.text: Hello Dolly Cookies. In a 9 x 13-inch pan, melt margarine. Spread graham cracker crumbs over margarine. Next, spread chocolate chips over crumbs and then spread oats. Next, spread nuts over oats and pour milk over all. Bake about 30 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Pound Cake
directions: Whip the Crisco and margarine together.
Blend in sugar.
Add eggs, one at a time; beat well after each.
Add sifted flour alternately with milk.
Beat well.
Add vanilla.
Beat 2 minutes. Bake 1 1/2 hours at 300°.
recipes.text: Pound Cake. Whip the Crisco and margarine together. Blend in sugar. Add eggs, one at a time; beat well after each. Add sifted flour alternately with milk. Beat well. Add vanilla. Beat 2 minutes. Bake 1 1/2 hours at 300°.

recipes.title: Chewy Crisps
directions: Blend all ingredients thoroughly.
Drop by teaspoonfuls onto greased cookie sheet.
Flatten with fork dipped in water.
Bake in moderate oven at 325° for 15 minutes.
Remove from oven.
Cool 1 minute before removing from baking sheet.
Yields 3 dozen.
recipes.text: Chewy Crisps. Blend all ingredients thoroughly. Drop by teaspoonfuls onto greased cookie sheet. Flatten with fork dipped in water. Bake in moderate oven at 325° for 15 minutes. Remove from oven. Cool 1 minute before removing from baking sheet. Yields 3 dozen.

recipes.title: Radish Dip
directions: Spoon plain low-fat yogurt onto several layers of heavy-duty paper towels.
Spread to 1/2-inch thickness.
Cover with additional paper towels and let stand 5 minutes.
Scrape into a small bowl, using a rubber spatula and set aside.
Position knife blade in food processor bowl.
Add radishes and pulse 5 times or until coarsely chopped. Add mayonnaise and next 3 ingredients and pulse 5 times or until combined. Add to yogurt. Stir well.
Cover and chill.
Garnish with sliced radish, if desired.
Serve with assorted vegetables, such as steamed asparagus, steamed green beans, carrot strips, sliced yellow squash and sliced radishes. Yields 1 1/4 cups.
recipes.text: Radish Dip. Spoon plain low-fat yogurt onto several layers of heavy-duty paper towels. Spread to 1/2-inch thickness. Cover with additional paper towels and let stand 5 minutes. Scrape into a small bowl, using a rubber spatula and set aside. Position knife blade in food processor bowl. Add radishes and pulse 5 times or until coarsely chopped. Add mayonnaise and next 3 ingredients and pulse 5 times or until combined. Add to yogurt. Stir well. Cover and chill. Garnish with sliced radish, if desired. Serve with assorted vegetables, such as steamed asparagus, steamed green beans, carrot strips, sliced yellow squash and sliced radishes. Yields 1 1/4 cups.

recipes.title: Cheeseburger Casserole
ingredients: 1 (8 oz.) can tomato sauce or soup
directions: Brown hamburger and onion in skillet and drain; add salt, pepper and ketchup. heat thoroughly. Place in casserole dish. Sprinkle cheese on top! Place biscuits on top of the cheese. Bake at 325° for 25 to 30 minutes or until golden brown.
recipes.text: Cheeseburger Casserole. Brown hamburger and onion in skillet and drain; add salt, pepper and ketchup. heat thoroughly. Place in casserole dish. Sprinkle cheese on top! Place biscuits on top of the cheese. Bake at 325° for 25 to 30 minutes or until golden brown.

recipes.title: Crunchy Bacon Coleslaw
ingredients: 4 slices bacon, crisply cooked and crumbled
directions: Mix mayo and sugar in large bowl.
Add remaining ingredients and mix.
Refrigerate.
recipes.text: Crunchy Bacon Coleslaw. Mix mayo and sugar in large bowl. Add remaining ingredients and mix. Refrigerate.

recipes.title: Hot Cocoa Mix
directions: Mix in large bowl or container.
Use 2 tablespoons per cup of hot water.
recipes.text: Hot Cocoa Mix. Mix in large bowl or container. Use 2 tablespoons per cup of hot water.

recipes.title: Beef Balls Stroganoff
directions: Lightly toss first 6 ingredients.
Shape into 18 meat balls. Brown in oleo.
Reduce heat and simmer 8 minutes.
Remove meat balls.
In pan drippings, saute onion and drained mushrooms. Remove from heat.
Stir in mushroom soup.
Add meat balls.
Simmer until thoroughly cooked.
Stir in sour cream.
Cook stirring over low heat for 3 minutes.
Serve over rice.
recipes.text: Beef Balls Stroganoff. Lightly toss first 6 ingredients. Shape into 18 meat balls. Brown in oleo. Reduce heat and simmer 8 minutes. Remove meat balls. In pan drippings, saute onion and drained mushrooms. Remove from heat. Stir in mushroom soup. Add meat balls. Simmer until thoroughly cooked. Stir in sour cream. Cook stirring over low heat for 3 minutes. Serve over rice.

recipes.title: Sweet Potato Casserole
directions: Mix together.
Pour into 9 x 13 x 2-inch baking dish.
Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.
Add topping.
recipes.text: Sweet Potato Casserole. Mix together. Pour into 9 x 13 x 2-inch baking dish. Bake at 350° for 25 minutes. Add topping.

recipes.title: Dip Batter For Shrimp
directions: Use ice water and the batter doesn't start rising until you start frying.
You might not use all of the water.
You want batter to just cling and coat shrimp lightly.
Shrimp is dipped into batter, then dropped in deep fat to fry.
Frying only takes a couple minutes.
recipes.text: Dip Batter For Shrimp. Use ice water and the batter doesn't start rising until you start frying. You might not use all of the water. You want batter to just cling and coat shrimp lightly. Shrimp is dipped into batter, then dropped in deep fat to fry. Frying only takes a couple minutes.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Balls
directions: Mix first 3 ingredients with an electric mixer.
Shape into balls and chill.
Dip chilled balls into the chocolate chips, 2 teaspoons of butter and paraffin which have been melted together. Chill.
recipes.text: Peanut Butter Balls. Mix first 3 ingredients with an electric mixer. Shape into balls and chill. Dip chilled balls into the chocolate chips, 2 teaspoons of butter and paraffin which have been melted together. Chill.

recipes.title: Picoso(Hot Sauce)
ingredients: 2 to 5 pods garlic, chopped very fine
directions: Bring all ingredients to boil and cook for 5 minutes.
Put in sterilized jars and seal.
Process for 15 minutes in hot boiling water bath or in pressure cooker at 10 pounds pressure.
recipes.text: Picoso(Hot Sauce). Bring all ingredients to boil and cook for 5 minutes. Put in sterilized jars and seal. Process for 15 minutes in hot boiling water bath or in pressure cooker at 10 pounds pressure.

recipes.title: Pig-Licking Cake
directions: Mix cake mix by directions on the box. Add the small box of pudding mix and blend. Fold in the mandarin oranges and bake.
recipes.text: Pig-Licking Cake. Mix cake mix by directions on the box. Add the small box of pudding mix and blend. Fold in the mandarin oranges and bake.

recipes.title: Broken Glass Gelatin Salad
directions: Prepare red, orange and lime Jell-O separately, using 1 cup boiling water and 1/2 cup cold water for each flavor.
Pour each flavor separately into 8-inch pans.
Chill until firm or overnight.
recipes.text: Broken Glass Gelatin Salad. Prepare red, orange and lime Jell-O separately, using 1 cup boiling water and 1/2 cup cold water for each flavor. Pour each flavor separately into 8-inch pans. Chill until firm or overnight.

recipes.title: Strawberry Bread
ingredients: 2 (10 oz.) pkg. frozen, sliced strawberries, thawed
directions: Sift together dry ingredients.
Add sugar, eggs, oil and strawberries.
Mix well.
Divide into 2 greased loaf pans.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Strawberry Bread. Sift together dry ingredients. Add sugar, eggs, oil and strawberries. Mix well. Divide into 2 greased loaf pans. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Potato Soup
ingredients: 6 slices bacon, cut in small pieces
directions: Slowly cook bacon and drain.
Meanwhile, peel and dice onion and celery.
Cook onion and celery (covered with water).
Peel and cube potatoes.
Add to celery mixture.
Again cover with water and add salt.
When celery and onions are tender (potatoes will be mushy) add milk and heat slowly.
Do not boil!
Salt and pepper to taste.
recipes.text: Potato Soup. Slowly cook bacon and drain. Meanwhile, peel and dice onion and celery. Cook onion and celery (covered with water). Peel and cube potatoes. Add to celery mixture. Again cover with water and add salt. When celery and onions are tender (potatoes will be mushy) add milk and heat slowly. Do not boil! Salt and pepper to taste.

recipes.title: Dixie'S Dill Pickles
directions: Take clean quart canning jars and place 1 bunch fresh dill, 1 clove fresh garlic, 1 hot pepper (more if you like hotter pickles) and slice of onion (if desired) into each jar.
Pack fresh green cucumbers into jars.
Bring brine (vinegar, water, salt and alum) to a boil and cover pickles.
Seal with hot, scalded lid and screw band firmly tight.
If mine seal, I don't hot water bath them.
If they don't seal overnight, I hot water bath them 15 minutes.
recipes.text: Dixie'S Dill Pickles. Take clean quart canning jars and place 1 bunch fresh dill, 1 clove fresh garlic, 1 hot pepper (more if you like hotter pickles) and slice of onion (if desired) into each jar. Pack fresh green cucumbers into jars. Bring brine (vinegar, water, salt and alum) to a boil and cover pickles. Seal with hot, scalded lid and screw band firmly tight. If mine seal, I don't hot water bath them. If they don't seal overnight, I hot water bath them 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Whipped Honey Lemon Yogurt
ingredients: grated rind and juice of 1/2 lemon
directions: Mix together the yogurt, honey, lemon rind and juice.
Beat the egg white until stiff and fold into yogurt mixture.
Spoon into 4 glasses and top each with thin curls of lemon rind.
Serve chilled.
Serves 4.
recipes.text: Whipped Honey Lemon Yogurt. Mix together the yogurt, honey, lemon rind and juice. Beat the egg white until stiff and fold into yogurt mixture. Spoon into 4 glasses and top each with thin curls of lemon rind. Serve chilled. Serves 4.

recipes.title: Stuffed Tomatoes With Chicken Salad
directions: Scoop out seeds and membranes from tomatoes.
Season inside with salt.
Fill each tomato with chicken salad.
recipes.text: Stuffed Tomatoes With Chicken Salad. Scoop out seeds and membranes from tomatoes. Season inside with salt. Fill each tomato with chicken salad.

recipes.title: Prune Cake
directions: Sift flour, sugar, soda and salt together.
Pour in large mixing bowl.
Add oil, eggs, milk and spices.
Beat batter well before adding nuts and prunes.
Stir well and put cake in round tube pan.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Prune Cake. Sift flour, sugar, soda and salt together. Pour in large mixing bowl. Add oil, eggs, milk and spices. Beat batter well before adding nuts and prunes. Stir well and put cake in round tube pan. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Homemade Vegetable Soup
directions: Cook hamburger and drain.
Boil vegetables and potatoes together until done.
Stir in tomatoes and hamburger.
Add other ingredients and boil about 20 to 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Homemade Vegetable Soup. Cook hamburger and drain. Boil vegetables and potatoes together until done. Stir in tomatoes and hamburger. Add other ingredients and boil about 20 to 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Dad'S Italian Meatballs And Spaghetti
ingredients: 2 large cans peeled tomatoes with basil
directions: In a large pot, empty contents of all tomatoes and tomato paste.
Add 1 large can of water.
Set heat on simmer.
Slice mushrooms and add to pot.
Chop garlic and add half to sauce. Save other half for meatballs.
Add pinch each of all seasonings to sauce.
recipes.text: Dad'S Italian Meatballs And Spaghetti. In a large pot, empty contents of all tomatoes and tomato paste. Add 1 large can of water. Set heat on simmer. Slice mushrooms and add to pot. Chop garlic and add half to sauce. Save other half for meatballs. Add pinch each of all seasonings to sauce.

recipes.title: Carrot Cake
directions: Stir sugar, oil and eggs to blend well.
Add sifted dry ingredients.
Mix in carrots and nuts.
Bake in greased and floured loaf pan 55 minutes at 375° or until cake tests done.
recipes.text: Carrot Cake. Stir sugar, oil and eggs to blend well. Add sifted dry ingredients. Mix in carrots and nuts. Bake in greased and floured loaf pan 55 minutes at 375° or until cake tests done.

recipes.title: Chocolate Curls
directions: Put white chocolate and dark chocolate in separate saucepans. Add 1 tablespoon shortening in each pan.
Stir over very low heat until melted.
Pour each mixture into small square plastic container.
Freeze until firm.
Remove chocolate from the containers and using cheese slicer or vegetable peeler, scrape across the surface of each to make curls.
recipes.text: Chocolate Curls. Put white chocolate and dark chocolate in separate saucepans. Add 1 tablespoon shortening in each pan. Stir over very low heat until melted. Pour each mixture into small square plastic container. Freeze until firm. Remove chocolate from the containers and using cheese slicer or vegetable peeler, scrape across the surface of each to make curls.

recipes.title: Tony'S Macaronies
directions: Cook macaroni according to package instructions until tender. Drain.
Rinse the dry cottage cheese thoroughly.
Saute onions in butter.
Add cottage cheese and macaroni and simmer for 5 minutes, stirring constantly.
recipes.text: Tony'S Macaronies. Cook macaroni according to package instructions until tender. Drain. Rinse the dry cottage cheese thoroughly. Saute onions in butter. Add cottage cheese and macaroni and simmer for 5 minutes, stirring constantly.

recipes.title: Authentic Italian Pizza
directions: Dissolve the warm water and yeast together and let stand 5 minutes.
Stir in the remaining ingredients.
Let rise until doubled.
Pat into 12-inch pizza pan, forming sides.
recipes.text: Authentic Italian Pizza. Dissolve the warm water and yeast together and let stand 5 minutes. Stir in the remaining ingredients. Let rise until doubled. Pat into 12-inch pizza pan, forming sides.

recipes.title: Honey Glazed Carrots
directions: Arrange carrots in a vegetable steamer over boiling water. Cover and steam for 4 to 8 minutes or until desired tenderness. Remove from steamer, keep warm.
recipes.text: Honey Glazed Carrots. Arrange carrots in a vegetable steamer over boiling water. Cover and steam for 4 to 8 minutes or until desired tenderness. Remove from steamer, keep warm.

recipes.title: Can'T Fail 5 Minute Fudge
ingredients: 2/3 c. (1 small can) Carnation evaporated milk
directions: Combine marshmallows, evaporated milk, butter, sugar and salt in a saucepan.
Cook and stir over medium heat until mixture comes to a full boil, then boil for 5 minutes over medium heat, stirring constantly.
Remove from heat and beat in chocolate chips until melted.
Add vanilla and nuts; beat until blended.
Pour into greased 9 x 9 x 2-inch pan.
Chill until firm.
recipes.text: Can'T Fail 5 Minute Fudge. Combine marshmallows, evaporated milk, butter, sugar and salt in a saucepan. Cook and stir over medium heat until mixture comes to a full boil, then boil for 5 minutes over medium heat, stirring constantly. Remove from heat and beat in chocolate chips until melted. Add vanilla and nuts; beat until blended. Pour into greased 9 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Chill until firm.

recipes.title: Cottage Cheese Cookies
directions: Melt margarine.
Add flour, cottage cheese, eggs and salt. Mix all together and refrigerate overnight.
Then roll out and cut into strips.
recipes.text: Cottage Cheese Cookies. Melt margarine. Add flour, cottage cheese, eggs and salt. Mix all together and refrigerate overnight. Then roll out and cut into strips.

recipes.title: Swiss Steak
directions: Season steak with salt and pepper.
Brown steak in hot oil in heavy skillet on both sides.
Remove steak and brown onions in the oil.
Remove onions.
recipes.text: Swiss Steak. Season steak with salt and pepper. Brown steak in hot oil in heavy skillet on both sides. Remove steak and brown onions in the oil. Remove onions.

recipes.title: Hot Dog Sauce
directions: Cook beef; drain off grease.
Add all ingredients; simmer for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Hot Dog Sauce. Cook beef; drain off grease. Add all ingredients; simmer for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Chocolate Candy
directions: Bring ingredients to a boil and continue to do so until soft ball stage.
Add 1 1/4 cups oats for chocolate oatmeal candy. Drop by spoonfuls on wax paper.
Let form.
recipes.text: Chocolate Candy. Bring ingredients to a boil and continue to do so until soft ball stage. Add 1 1/4 cups oats for chocolate oatmeal candy. Drop by spoonfuls on wax paper. Let form.

recipes.title: Banana Cream Pie
directions: Mix sugar, cornstarch, salt and egg yolks together thoroughly in saucepan.
Combine evaporated milk and water; stir into sugar mixture until smooth.
Cook over low heat, stirring until thickened, about 10 minutes.
Remove from heat; stir in vanilla and let cool completely.
Arrange bananas in baked pie shell.
Cover with cool mixture.
Spread with whipped cream or whipped topping and refrigerate.
recipes.text: Banana Cream Pie. Mix sugar, cornstarch, salt and egg yolks together thoroughly in saucepan. Combine evaporated milk and water; stir into sugar mixture until smooth. Cook over low heat, stirring until thickened, about 10 minutes. Remove from heat; stir in vanilla and let cool completely. Arrange bananas in baked pie shell. Cover with cool mixture. Spread with whipped cream or whipped topping and refrigerate.

recipes.title: Russell Stover Candy
directions: Mix together; chill 2 hours or overnight.
Roll in balls and chill again.
Dip in chocolate.
recipes.text: Russell Stover Candy. Mix together; chill 2 hours or overnight. Roll in balls and chill again. Dip in chocolate.

recipes.title: Simple Salisbury Steak
directions: Mix 1/4 cup gravy, beef, bread crumbs, onion and egg thoroughly.
Shape firmly into 4 patties.
In skillet over medium-high heat, heat 1 tablespoon oil.
Brown patties.
Pour off fat.
Add remaining gravy.
Heat to a boil.
Cover; reduce heat and simmer for 10 minutes or until done.
recipes.text: Simple Salisbury Steak. Mix 1/4 cup gravy, beef, bread crumbs, onion and egg thoroughly. Shape firmly into 4 patties. In skillet over medium-high heat, heat 1 tablespoon oil. Brown patties. Pour off fat. Add remaining gravy. Heat to a boil. Cover; reduce heat and simmer for 10 minutes or until done.

recipes.title: Fruit Pies
directions: Drain all fruit.
Mix milk, lemon juice, Cool Whip and fruit (in this order).
Pour into pie crust and chill.
recipes.text: Fruit Pies. Drain all fruit. Mix milk, lemon juice, Cool Whip and fruit (in this order). Pour into pie crust and chill.

recipes.title: Barbecue Beef
directions: Cook roast in crock-pot.
Add about 1/3 cup water.
Cook for about 12 hours on medium.
Take fork and stir.
Add barbecue sauce and cook for about another hour.
Serve on hamburger buns as sandwiches or by itself.
recipes.text: Barbecue Beef. Cook roast in crock-pot. Add about 1/3 cup water. Cook for about 12 hours on medium. Take fork and stir. Add barbecue sauce and cook for about another hour. Serve on hamburger buns as sandwiches or by itself.

recipes.title: Vanilla Wafer Cake
directions: Cream butter and sugar; add eggs, one at a time, and beat well.
In a plastic bag, crush vanilla wafers.
Add wafers and milk to mixture and beat 1 minute.
Add remaining ingredients and mix well.
In a Bundt pan, bake 1 hour and 15 minutes at 325°.
recipes.text: Vanilla Wafer Cake. Cream butter and sugar; add eggs, one at a time, and beat well. In a plastic bag, crush vanilla wafers. Add wafers and milk to mixture and beat 1 minute. Add remaining ingredients and mix well. In a Bundt pan, bake 1 hour and 15 minutes at 325°.

recipes.title: Oatmeal Waffles
directions: In a large mixing bowl, stir together flour, oats, baking powder, cinnamon and salt.
In a small bowl, stir together eggs, milk, margarine (or butter) and brown sugar.
Add flour mixture and stir until blended.
Pour batter into grids of preheated, lightly greased waffle baker.
Close lid quickly; do not open during baking.
Use fork to remove baked waffle.
Top with fruit and yogurt.
Serving Size: 12.
Preparation Time:
recipes.text: Oatmeal Waffles. In a large mixing bowl, stir together flour, oats, baking powder, cinnamon and salt. In a small bowl, stir together eggs, milk, margarine (or butter) and brown sugar. Add flour mixture and stir until blended. Pour batter into grids of preheated, lightly greased waffle baker. Close lid quickly; do not open during baking. Use fork to remove baked waffle. Top with fruit and yogurt. Serving Size: 12. Preparation Time: 0:20.

recipes.title: Chicken Italiano
directions: Mix Italian dressing and chicken breasts in a casserole dish and bake at 350° for about 45 minutes.
Make rice as directed and serve chicken breasts with Italian dressing over rice.
recipes.text: Chicken Italiano. Mix Italian dressing and chicken breasts in a casserole dish and bake at 350° for about 45 minutes. Make rice as directed and serve chicken breasts with Italian dressing over rice.

recipes.title: Cheeseburger Pie
ingredients: 1/2 to 1 lb. ground beef, cooked and drained (option: ground turkey)
1 envelope beef seasoning (I use Weight Watchers brand)
directions: Combine ingredients.
Pour into greased pie pan.
Bake in a 375° oven until cheese is melted and pie is hot.
Let sit for 10 to 15 minutes before serving.
recipes.text: Cheeseburger Pie. Combine ingredients. Pour into greased pie pan. Bake in a 375° oven until cheese is melted and pie is hot. Let sit for 10 to 15 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Banana Split Cake
directions: Mix together and press into the bottom of a 10 x 13-inch dish the graham cracker crumbs, 1 stick of butter and sugar.
recipes.text: Banana Split Cake. Mix together and press into the bottom of a 10 x 13-inch dish the graham cracker crumbs, 1 stick of butter and sugar.

recipes.title: Southern Spoon Bread
directions: Stir together corn meal, baking powder and salt. In greased (1-quart size) casserole pour beaten egg and melted butter. In medium size pan, heat milk; stir to avoid scorching. As it starts boiling, sprinkle in the dry ingredients, stirring vigorously with wooden spoon. Cook and stir for 2 or 3 minutes, as it thickens. Mix with eggs in casserole. Bake at 425° for 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Southern Spoon Bread. Stir together corn meal, baking powder and salt. In greased (1-quart size) casserole pour beaten egg and melted butter. In medium size pan, heat milk; stir to avoid scorching. As it starts boiling, sprinkle in the dry ingredients, stirring vigorously with wooden spoon. Cook and stir for 2 or 3 minutes, as it thickens. Mix with eggs in casserole. Bake at 425° for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Easy Pound Cake
directions: Mix sugar and butter; add eggs 1 at a time.
Mix well; stir in 1/4 teaspoon baking soda.
Add sour cream, then add one flavor or all three, 1 teaspoon each.
Mix 1 cup of flour at a time.
Pour into greased and floured Bundt pan.
Place in cold oven.
Bake at 325° for 1 1/2 hours.
recipes.text: Easy Pound Cake. Mix sugar and butter; add eggs 1 at a time. Mix well; stir in 1/4 teaspoon baking soda. Add sour cream, then add one flavor or all three, 1 teaspoon each. Mix 1 cup of flour at a time. Pour into greased and floured Bundt pan. Place in cold oven. Bake at 325° for 1 1/2 hours.

recipes.title: Baked Cranberries
directions: Preheat oven to 350°.
Mix all ingredients and place in baking dish, lightly greased.
Bake for 30 to 35 minutes.
Serve warm.
recipes.text: Baked Cranberries. Preheat oven to 350°. Mix all ingredients and place in baking dish, lightly greased. Bake for 30 to 35 minutes. Serve warm.

recipes.title: Lemon Cake
directions: Heat oven to 350°.
Bake for 40 minutes.
Do not open oven until time is up.
recipes.text: Lemon Cake. Heat oven to 350°. Bake for 40 minutes. Do not open oven until time is up.

recipes.title: Cold Veggie Salad
ingredients: 1 (12 oz.) can whole kernel corn, drained
directions: Combine the first 5 ingredients; set aside.
Combine remaining ingredients, mixing well.
Pour over vegetables; toss lightly. Refrigerate several hours.
recipes.text: Cold Veggie Salad. Combine the first 5 ingredients; set aside. Combine remaining ingredients, mixing well. Pour over vegetables; toss lightly. Refrigerate several hours.

recipes.title: Orange Bread(Yields 30 Muffins Or 2 Loaves)
directions: Quarter a Valencia orange; remove seeds.
Put it through a blender or processor until very finely chopped (nearly pureed). Don't remove peel; "trust me!"
Beat eggs until frothy; add sugar, orange and oil.
Add all dry ingredients and mix well.
Stir in pineapple and nuts.
Pour into muffin tins or 2 large loaf pans. Bake at 325° for 30 minutes or 1 hour for loaf.
recipes.text: Orange Bread(Yields 30 Muffins Or 2 Loaves). Quarter a Valencia orange; remove seeds. Put it through a blender or processor until very finely chopped (nearly pureed). Don't remove peel; "trust me!" Beat eggs until frothy; add sugar, orange and oil. Add all dry ingredients and mix well. Stir in pineapple and nuts. Pour into muffin tins or 2 large loaf pans. Bake at 325° for 30 minutes or 1 hour for loaf.

recipes.title: Supper A La King
directions: In 10-inch skillet over medium heat, in hot butter, cook green pepper and onion until tender, stirring occasionally.
Stir in soup and milk; blend well.
Stir in meat and pimento.
Cook 5 minutes more or until heated through.
recipes.text: Supper A La King. In 10-inch skillet over medium heat, in hot butter, cook green pepper and onion until tender, stirring occasionally. Stir in soup and milk; blend well. Stir in meat and pimento. Cook 5 minutes more or until heated through.

recipes.title: Squash Dressing
directions: Mix all ingredients except egg, then add egg and bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Squash Dressing. Mix all ingredients except egg, then add egg and bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Cranberry Relish Mold
ingredients: 1 (No. 2) large can crushed pineapple, drained and syrup reserved
1/2 c. pecans or English walnuts, chopped
directions: Combine gelatin and sugar; dissolve in hot water.
Add cold water, lemon juice and pineapple syrup.
Chill until mixture begins to set.
Add pineapple and remaining ingredients; turn into 2-quart mold.
Yields 12 servings.
recipes.text: Cranberry Relish Mold. Combine gelatin and sugar; dissolve in hot water. Add cold water, lemon juice and pineapple syrup. Chill until mixture begins to set. Add pineapple and remaining ingredients; turn into 2-quart mold. Yields 12 servings.

recipes.title: Crock-Pot Stew
directions: Mix all of the ingredients in your crock-pot.
Cook at 212° for 10 to 12 hours.
Makes 4 large servings.
recipes.text: Crock-Pot Stew. Mix all of the ingredients in your crock-pot. Cook at 212° for 10 to 12 hours. Makes 4 large servings.

recipes.title: Blender Broccoli Soup
ingredients: 1 c. light cream or evaporated milk
directions: * Sour cream is for top of soup in bowl.
recipes.text: Blender Broccoli Soup. * Sour cream is for top of soup in bowl.

recipes.title: Scalloped Potato Casserole(Makes 10 Servings)
ingredients: 1 (10 3/4 oz.) condensed cream of mushroom soup
3 lb. potatoes, peeled, boiled and cubed
directions: Mix sour cream, soup, butter, green onions and 1 cup cheese in a lightly greased, deep 3-quart casserole dish.
Gently stir in potatoes, salt and pepper.
Top with remaining 1/2 cup cheese and the crumbs.
Bake in preheated 350° oven for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Scalloped Potato Casserole(Makes 10 Servings). Mix sour cream, soup, butter, green onions and 1 cup cheese in a lightly greased, deep 3-quart casserole dish. Gently stir in potatoes, salt and pepper. Top with remaining 1/2 cup cheese and the crumbs. Bake in preheated 350° oven for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Chicken Rotel
directions: Boil chicken and remove bones, saving broth.
Cook noodles in broth.

Meanwhile, saute onions and pepper in butter. After spaghetti is cooked, save 1 quart of broth; discard the rest. Add Ro-Tel and Worcestershire sauce to the broth and noodles. Then add the cheese and cook until melted.
Add the onion, peppers and deboned chicken. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until brown.
recipes.text: Chicken Rotel. Boil chicken and remove bones, saving broth. Cook noodles in broth. Meanwhile, saute onions and pepper in butter. After spaghetti is cooked, save 1 quart of broth; discard the rest. Add Ro-Tel and Worcestershire sauce to the broth and noodles. Then add the cheese and cook until melted. Add the onion, peppers and deboned chicken. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until brown.

recipes.title: Dutch Beans
ingredients: 4 cans whole or cut green beans
directions: Drain beans and save juice.
Cook bacon in Dutch oven and leave grease.
Saute onion in bacon drippings.
Add sugar, vinegar and mustard.
Cook on low heat for 2 hours.
Crumble bacon; top when ready to serve.
recipes.text: Dutch Beans. Drain beans and save juice. Cook bacon in Dutch oven and leave grease. Saute onion in bacon drippings. Add sugar, vinegar and mustard. Cook on low heat for 2 hours. Crumble bacon; top when ready to serve.

recipes.title: Potato-Carrot Soup
directions: Melt butter in large saucepan.
Add onion and saute until browned.
Dissolve bouillon cubes in boiling water.
Add to onion with potatoes and carrots.
Add salt, pepper, celery salt and bay leaf; simmer until potatoes are tender.
Stir in evaporated milk. Blend water with flour and stir into soup.
Heat and stir until slightly thickened.
recipes.text: Potato-Carrot Soup. Melt butter in large saucepan. Add onion and saute until browned. Dissolve bouillon cubes in boiling water. Add to onion with potatoes and carrots. Add salt, pepper, celery salt and bay leaf; simmer until potatoes are tender. Stir in evaporated milk. Blend water with flour and stir into soup. Heat and stir until slightly thickened.

recipes.title: Rice And Vegetable Salad
ingredients: 2 pkg. Near East brand long grain and wild rice pilaf, cooked or 8 c. hot cooked rice
1 sweet red pepper, stemmed, cored and cut into thin julienne (may substitute chopped tomato)
1 medium size purple onion, peeled and diced
6 scallions (green onions), cleaned and finely sliced
1 (10 oz.) pkg. frozen peas, thawed and blanched in boiling salted water for 3 minutes
1/2 c. pitted black olives, finely chopped
1/4 c. chopped parsley (omit if using Near East rice)
1/2 c. chopped fresh dill or 2 rounded Tbsp. dry
salt and freshly ground pepper to taste
directions: Transfer rice to a mixing bowl and pour 1 1/2 cups vinaigrette into rice; toss thoroughly.
Cool to room temperature.
Add remaining ingredients and toss thoroughly.
Taste, correct seasoning and add additional vinaigrette if you like.
Serve immediately or cover and refrigerate up to 4 hours.
Return to room temperature before servings.
Makes 8 to 10 portions.
recipes.text: Rice And Vegetable Salad. Transfer rice to a mixing bowl and pour 1 1/2 cups vinaigrette into rice; toss thoroughly. Cool to room temperature. Add remaining ingredients and toss thoroughly. Taste, correct seasoning and add additional vinaigrette if you like. Serve immediately or cover and refrigerate up to 4 hours. Return to room temperature before servings. Makes 8 to 10 portions.

recipes.title: Kiwi Coolers
directions: Peel kiwis and cut into small pieces.
Place half in a blender with 2 cups of juice and 4 ice cubes.
Blend until smooth, stir in 1 cup sparkling water.
Repeat with the remaining kiwis, 2 cups juice, 4 ice cubes and 1 cup sparkling water. Garnish each serving with a strawberry.
Low-fat.
Serves 8.
recipes.text: Kiwi Coolers. Peel kiwis and cut into small pieces. Place half in a blender with 2 cups of juice and 4 ice cubes. Blend until smooth, stir in 1 cup sparkling water. Repeat with the remaining kiwis, 2 cups juice, 4 ice cubes and 1 cup sparkling water. Garnish each serving with a strawberry. Low-fat. Serves 8.

recipes.title: Chocolate Philly Fudge
ingredients: 1 (8 oz.) pkg. Philadelphia Brand cream cheese
directions: Gradually add sugar to softened cream cheese, mixing well after each addition.
Add remaining ingredients; mix well.
Spread into greased 8-inch square pan.
Chill several hours or overnight. Cut into squares.
Garnish with additional nuts, if desired. Makes 1 3/4 pounds.
recipes.text: Chocolate Philly Fudge. Gradually add sugar to softened cream cheese, mixing well after each addition. Add remaining ingredients; mix well. Spread into greased 8-inch square pan. Chill several hours or overnight. Cut into squares. Garnish with additional nuts, if desired. Makes 1 3/4 pounds.

recipes.title: Twice Baked Potatoes
directions: Bake potatoes.
When cool enough to work with, scoop out potato centers.
Mash potatoes and save potato shells.
Fry bacon until crisp.
Leave 3 tablespoons of bacon fat in pan.
Add onions to bacon fat and cook until clear.
Drain off all fat.
Mix together potatoes, crumbled bacon, onion, cheeses, sour cream, salt and pepper.
Stuff into potato shells.
Sprinkle with parsley flakes.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Twice Baked Potatoes. Bake potatoes. When cool enough to work with, scoop out potato centers. Mash potatoes and save potato shells. Fry bacon until crisp. Leave 3 tablespoons of bacon fat in pan. Add onions to bacon fat and cook until clear. Drain off all fat. Mix together potatoes, crumbled bacon, onion, cheeses, sour cream, salt and pepper. Stuff into potato shells. Sprinkle with parsley flakes. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Peanut Clusters
directions: Melt chocolate chips in double boiler.
Stir in Eagle Brand milk; then add peanuts.
Mix well.
Drop by teaspoonfuls on wax paper.
recipes.text: Peanut Clusters. Melt chocolate chips in double boiler. Stir in Eagle Brand milk; then add peanuts. Mix well. Drop by teaspoonfuls on wax paper.

recipes.title: Jet Age Gnocches(Potato Dumplings)
directions: Bring water and salt to a boil.
Remove from heat; stir in instant potatoes.
Gradually stir in enough flour to form a soft dough.
Turn out dough onto a floured surface and knead gently until smooth.
Shape dough into ropes about 1/2 inch in diameter. Cut pieces in oval shapes.
Drop a few at a time into large kettle of boiling salted water.
Simmer 5 minutes.
Remove from water with slotted spoon.
Keep gnocchi hot.
Serve with any sauce, butter or cheese.
recipes.text: Jet Age Gnocches(Potato Dumplings). Bring water and salt to a boil. Remove from heat; stir in instant potatoes. Gradually stir in enough flour to form a soft dough. Turn out dough onto a floured surface and knead gently until smooth. Shape dough into ropes about 1/2 inch in diameter. Cut pieces in oval shapes. Drop a few at a time into large kettle of boiling salted water. Simmer 5 minutes. Remove from water with slotted spoon. Keep gnocchi hot. Serve with any sauce, butter or cheese.

recipes.title: Chicken And Shrimp Paella
ingredients: 1 to 1 1/2 lb. chicken pieces or 2 boneless breasts
1/2 pkg. (6 oz.) or 1/2 c. saffron rice
4 1/2 oz. or small can medium shrimp
directions: Heat oil in Dutch oven; brown chicken.
Remove and set aside. Drain fat.
Heat oven to 350°.
Cook and stir onion, tomatoes and seasonings in Dutch oven until onion is tender, about 5 minutes. Stir in rice and broth.
Heat to boil.
Add chicken.
Cover.
Bake 35 minutes.
Add shrimp and peas.
Bake another 10 minutes or until shrimp is done.
Garnish with pimento and parsley.
recipes.text: Chicken And Shrimp Paella. Heat oil in Dutch oven; brown chicken. Remove and set aside. Drain fat. Heat oven to 350°. Cook and stir onion, tomatoes and seasonings in Dutch oven until onion is tender, about 5 minutes. Stir in rice and broth. Heat to boil. Add chicken. Cover. Bake 35 minutes. Add shrimp and peas. Bake another 10 minutes or until shrimp is done. Garnish with pimento and parsley.

recipes.title: Toasted Pecans
directions: Toast pecans for 30 minutes at 250°. Slice butter over top of pecans. Stir until coated. Sprinkle with salt and toast for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Toasted Pecans. Toast pecans for 30 minutes at 250°. Slice butter over top of pecans. Stir until coated. Sprinkle with salt and toast for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Yorkshire Pudding
directions: Gradually add milk to flour and when smooth, add eggs and salt.
(Best when with an egg beater.)
Pour melted butter or beef drippings 1/2-inch thick over bottom of 2 bread pans.
Pour half of mixture in each pan.
Bake in a hot oven, 400°, for 20 minutes, then reduce heat to 350° and bake 10 minutes longer.
Cut in squares and serve with roast beef.
recipes.text: Yorkshire Pudding. Gradually add milk to flour and when smooth, add eggs and salt. (Best when with an egg beater.) Pour melted butter or beef drippings 1/2-inch thick over bottom of 2 bread pans. Pour half of mixture in each pan. Bake in a hot oven, 400°, for 20 minutes, then reduce heat to 350° and bake 10 minutes longer. Cut in squares and serve with roast beef.

recipes.title: Bacon Quiche
directions: Make pie shell. Spread butter over inside of shell. Refrigerate until ready for use. Fry bacon; crumble. Shred cheese. Mix the remaining ingredients with rotary beater until blended. Sprinkle crumbled bacon and shredded cheese on bottom of unbaked pie shell. Slowly pour in cream mixture. Bake at 425° for 40 minutes until inserted knife comes out clean.
recipes.text: Bacon Quiche. Make pie shell. Spread butter over inside of shell. Refrigerate until ready for use. Fry bacon; crumble. Shred cheese. Mix the remaining ingredients with rotary beater until blended. Sprinkle crumbled bacon and shredded cheese on bottom of unbaked pie shell. Slowly pour in cream mixture. Bake at 425° for 40 minutes until inserted knife comes out clean.

recipes.title: Pineapple-Orange Mold
directions: Dissolve large package apricot jello in 2 cups boiling water. Drain crushed pineapple and mandarin oranges; reserve syrup.
Add syrup plus 1/2 cup water to jello mixture.
Add sour cream and beat until smooth.
Add fruit; chill until firm.
recipes.text: Pineapple-Orange Mold. Dissolve large package apricot jello in 2 cups boiling water. Drain crushed pineapple and mandarin oranges; reserve syrup. Add syrup plus 1/2 cup water to jello mixture. Add sour cream and beat until smooth. Add fruit; chill until firm.

recipes.title: Combined Dressing
directions: Crumble bread into large pan or bowl.
Melt butter and saute onion and celery.
Add to bread with other ingredients and mix well.
If dressing seems too dry, add a little more broth.
Bake in shallow pan at 400° for 15 to 20 minutes.
recipes.text: Combined Dressing. Crumble bread into large pan or bowl. Melt butter and saute onion and celery. Add to bread with other ingredients and mix well. If dressing seems too dry, add a little more broth. Bake in shallow pan at 400° for 15 to 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Chili
ingredients: 1 or 2 Tbsp. crushed hot red pepper
directions: In large heavy
skillet, over medium heat, saute ground beef, stirring occasionally, until red color disappears.
Pour off fat. Add onion, green pepper, garlic, crushed red pepper, chili powder,
cumin,
oregano
and
salt;
mix
well.
Cook, stirring, until onion and green pepper are tender.
Add beans, tomatoes, corn and tomato sauce; stir to mix well, breaking up tomatoes with
fork.
Simmer
slowly,
covered
and
stirring occasionally, until
thickened
and flavors are blended, about 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Chili. In large heavy skillet, over medium heat, saute ground beef, stirring occasionally, until red color disappears. Pour off fat. Add onion, green pepper, garlic, crushed red pepper, chili powder, cumin, oregano and salt; mix well. Cook, stirring, until onion and green pepper are tender. Add beans, tomatoes, corn and tomato sauce; stir to mix well, breaking up tomatoes with fork. Simmer slowly, covered and stirring occasionally, until thickened and flavors are blended, about 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Barbecued Corn
directions: Pull shuck back carefully.
Remove silk.
Brush on melted oleo.
Put shuck back into place.
Place ears of corn on outer edges of fire.
Roast, turning now and then for 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Barbecued Corn. Pull shuck back carefully. Remove silk. Brush on melted oleo. Put shuck back into place. Place ears of corn on outer edges of fire. Roast, turning now and then for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Mexican Wedding Cakes
directions: Cream butter.
Add sugar and vanilla, cream until light and fluffy.
Add flour and walnuts; mix well.
Roll into 2 inch balls and place on ungreased cookie sheet.
Bake at 325 for 18-20 minutes or until lightly browned.
recipes.text: Mexican Wedding Cakes. Cream butter. Add sugar and vanilla, cream until light and fluffy. Add flour and walnuts; mix well. Roll into 2 inch balls and place on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 325 for 18-20 minutes or until lightly browned.

recipes.title: Pastry
directions: Cut shortening into flour until fine.
Beat egg and add vinegar, while stirring briskly.
Add about 2/3 cup ice water. Mix the ingredients together until a soft dough (may need more water).
Let chill until the next day or several hours.
Roll out into assorted pie pans.
May freeze some until needed.
recipes.text: Pastry. Cut shortening into flour until fine. Beat egg and add vinegar, while stirring briskly. Add about 2/3 cup ice water. Mix the ingredients together until a soft dough (may need more water). Let chill until the next day or several hours. Roll out into assorted pie pans. May freeze some until needed.

recipes.title: Easy Chess Bars
directions: Measure 2/3 cup dry cake mix; set aside.
Combine remaining mix, melted margarine and 1 egg; stir with fork to mix.
Press evenly into a greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan.
Bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes, or until light brown.
recipes.text: Easy Chess Bars. Measure 2/3 cup dry cake mix; set aside. Combine remaining mix, melted margarine and 1 egg; stir with fork to mix. Press evenly into a greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes, or until light brown.

recipes.title: Raisin Cake
directions: Place in saucepan the shortening, boiling water and raisins. Boil together for 15 minutes.
Add other ingredients.
Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.
recipes.text: Raisin Cake. Place in saucepan the shortening, boiling water and raisins. Boil together for 15 minutes. Add other ingredients. Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Party Eggs
directions: Crack eggs, pouring whites into a mixing bowl and leaving yolks in one half of each shell.
Place in an egg carton or small muffin tin to keep upright until ready to use.
Beat egg whites until stiff; season with salt and pepper.
Place toast on a baking sheet and butter.
Distribute bacon and divide the egg whites between the toast, mounding the egg whites high on each.
Make an indentation in the center of the egg whites and slip the yolks into the indentions.
Top with grated cheese.
Bake 7 to 10 minutes, until whites are browned and yolks are set to your preference.
Serves 4 to 6.
recipes.text: Party Eggs. Crack eggs, pouring whites into a mixing bowl and leaving yolks in one half of each shell. Place in an egg carton or small muffin tin to keep upright until ready to use. Beat egg whites until stiff; season with salt and pepper. Place toast on a baking sheet and butter. Distribute bacon and divide the egg whites between the toast, mounding the egg whites high on each. Make an indentation in the center of the egg whites and slip the yolks into the indentions. Top with grated cheese. Bake 7 to 10 minutes, until whites are browned and yolks are set to your preference. Serves 4 to 6.

recipes.title: Spicy Raisin Cake
directions: Heat oven to 350°.
Grease and flour square pan (8 x 8 x 2-inch or 9 x 9 x 2-inch).
recipes.text: Spicy Raisin Cake. Heat oven to 350°. Grease and flour square pan (8 x 8 x 2-inch or 9 x 9 x 2-inch).

recipes.title: Baked Alaskan Salmon
ingredients: 4 lb. fresh salmon in one piece
directions: Wash and dry salmon.
Split the fish open; leave skin intact. In a bowl, combine bread, onion, parsley, salt, pepper and sage; mix well.
Add the butter and broth and mix.
Stuff the fish with the mixture carefully.
Do not pack down or filling will become heavy; fasten the edges with skewers or thread.
Place on buttered baking dish; arrange
bacon across the top.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Baked Alaskan Salmon. Wash and dry salmon. Split the fish open; leave skin intact. In a bowl, combine bread, onion, parsley, salt, pepper and sage; mix well. Add the butter and broth and mix. Stuff the fish with the mixture carefully. Do not pack down or filling will become heavy; fasten the edges with skewers or thread. Place on buttered baking dish; arrange bacon across the top. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Baked Stuffed Jumbo Shells
ingredients: salt and freshly ground pepper to taste
2 (1 lb.) jars Ragu chunky garden style sauce or sauce of your choice
directions: Cook shells as directed on box and drain well.
Mix Ricotta, eggs, parsley, Parmesan, Romano and Mozzarella cheeses together. Add salt and pepper to taste.
Fill each shell with the Ricotta mixture.
Pour the Ragu sauce, just enough to cover bottom of baking dish.
Lay shells side by side and drizzle more of the Ragu sauce over them.
Cover with foil.
Bake in 325° oven for 1 hour. Heat remaining sauce and set on table so each person can add more if they desire.
This recipe fills 40 shells.
recipes.text: Baked Stuffed Jumbo Shells. Cook shells as directed on box and drain well. Mix Ricotta, eggs, parsley, Parmesan, Romano and Mozzarella cheeses together. Add salt and pepper to taste. Fill each shell with the Ricotta mixture. Pour the Ragu sauce, just enough to cover bottom of baking dish. Lay shells side by side and drizzle more of the Ragu sauce over them. Cover with foil. Bake in 325° oven for 1 hour. Heat remaining sauce and set on table so each person can add more if they desire. This recipe fills 40 shells.

recipes.title: Jambalaya
ingredients: 1 lb. Italian sausage (hot, sweet or turkey)
directions: Brown and crumble sausage (use 1 tablespoon oil if browning turkey sausage).
Add one chopped medium
onion and one chopped bell pepper and saute until softened.
Add all remaining ingredients.
Cover and simmer on top of stove for 20 to 30 minutes until rice is cooked through.
Serves 6 to 8.
May be frozen and takes well to reheating in the microwave.
recipes.text: Jambalaya. Brown and crumble sausage (use 1 tablespoon oil if browning turkey sausage). Add one chopped medium onion and one chopped bell pepper and saute until softened. Add all remaining ingredients. Cover and simmer on top of stove for 20 to 30 minutes until rice is cooked through. Serves 6 to 8. May be frozen and takes well to reheating in the microwave.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Bars
directions: Follow directions on spice cake mix, except reduce water to 1/2 cup.
Add pumpkin and cinnamon.
Spread in greased 9 x 13-inch pan and bake as directed.
Cool and frost with cream cheese frosting.
recipes.text: Pumpkin Bars. Follow directions on spice cake mix, except reduce water to 1/2 cup. Add pumpkin and cinnamon. Spread in greased 9 x 13-inch pan and bake as directed. Cool and frost with cream cheese frosting.

recipes.title: Summer Sausage
directions: Mix well with hands and shape into 3 or 4 long rolls.
Wrap in Saran Wrap and refrigerate for 24 hours.
Then bake at 300° for 1 hour and 15 minutes.
recipes.text: Summer Sausage. Mix well with hands and shape into 3 or 4 long rolls. Wrap in Saran Wrap and refrigerate for 24 hours. Then bake at 300° for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Microwave Caramel Sauce
directions: In a 4-cup glass measure, blend butter, brown sugar, milk and corn syrup.
Cook 3 to 4 minutes, stirring every minute.
Add vanilla extract and salt; stir to blend.
Serve warm or cold. Makes 1 1/2 cups.
recipes.text: Microwave Caramel Sauce. In a 4-cup glass measure, blend butter, brown sugar, milk and corn syrup. Cook 3 to 4 minutes, stirring every minute. Add vanilla extract and salt; stir to blend. Serve warm or cold. Makes 1 1/2 cups.

recipes.title: Cranberry Cream Pie
ingredients: 2 (8 or 9-inch) pie shells, baked and cooled or 2 graham cracker crusts
directions: Whip cream cheese until soft and fluffy.
Beat in powdered sugar.
Stir in cranberry sauce.
Fold in thawed Cool Whip. Divide filling between the two pie crusts.
Freeze.
recipes.text: Cranberry Cream Pie. Whip cream cheese until soft and fluffy. Beat in powdered sugar. Stir in cranberry sauce. Fold in thawed Cool Whip. Divide filling between the two pie crusts. Freeze.

recipes.title: Eggplant Casserole
ingredients: 1 c. grated Cheddar cheese or Velveeta
directions: Peel eggplant and cut in cubes.
Boil in salted water until tender; drain and mash.
Heat 6 tablespoons margarine in skillet; add onions and saute until tender, but not brown.
Add mashed eggplant, tomatoes, cheese and 1/3 cup crumbs.
When hot, add eggs. Cook and stir until eggs are done.
Add salt and pepper.
Pour into 2-quart baking dish.
Heat 1 cup dry crumbs in 1/4 cup margarine in oven until light browned to make buttered crumbs for topping the casserole.
Bake about 1 hour at 350°.
recipes.text: Eggplant Casserole. Peel eggplant and cut in cubes. Boil in salted water until tender; drain and mash. Heat 6 tablespoons margarine in skillet; add onions and saute until tender, but not brown. Add mashed eggplant, tomatoes, cheese and 1/3 cup crumbs. When hot, add eggs. Cook and stir until eggs are done. Add salt and pepper. Pour into 2-quart baking dish. Heat 1 cup dry crumbs in 1/4 cup margarine in oven until light browned to make buttered crumbs for topping the casserole. Bake about 1 hour at 350°.

recipes.title: Squash Pudding
ingredients: 3 small squash, boiled and mashed (2 c.)
directions: Mix together flour and eggs and add to mashed squash.
Add evaporated milk and vanilla.
Pour into dish and sprinkle with nutmeg and cook for 35 minutes at 350°.
recipes.text: Squash Pudding. Mix together flour and eggs and add to mashed squash. Add evaporated milk and vanilla. Pour into dish and sprinkle with nutmeg and cook for 35 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Green Pepper Steak
ingredients: 1 c. red or green peppers, cut into 1-inch squares
directions: Cut beef across grain into thin slices.
Combine soy sauce, garlic and ginger; add beef.
Toss and set aside while preparing vegetables.
Heat oil in large frypan.
Add beef and toss over high heat until brown.
If meat is not tender, cover and simmer over low heat for 30 minutes.
Turn heat up and add vegetables.
Toss until vegetables are tender-crisp.
Mix cornstarch and water.
Add to pan; stir and cook until thickened.
Add tomatoes and heat through.
recipes.text: Green Pepper Steak. Cut beef across grain into thin slices. Combine soy sauce, garlic and ginger; add beef. Toss and set aside while preparing vegetables. Heat oil in large frypan. Add beef and toss over high heat until brown. If meat is not tender, cover and simmer over low heat for 30 minutes. Turn heat up and add vegetables. Toss until vegetables are tender-crisp. Mix cornstarch and water. Add to pan; stir and cook until thickened. Add tomatoes and heat through.

recipes.title: Spinach Casserole
ingredients: 2 pkg. frozen spinach, thawed and squeezed
directions: Reserve 1/2 cup cheese for top. Mix all ingredients together. Bake in 13 x 9-inch pan at 350° for 30 minutes or so.
recipes.text: Spinach Casserole. Reserve 1/2 cup cheese for top. Mix all ingredients together. Bake in 13 x 9-inch pan at 350° for 30 minutes or so.

recipes.title: Chicken And Rice Casserole
directions: Pour rice into bottom of 3-quart casserole dish.
Place chicken pieces on top.
Heat 3 soups, margarine and 1 cup water on stove top.
Pour over chicken and rice.
Bake at 350° for about 1 hour.
recipes.text: Chicken And Rice Casserole. Pour rice into bottom of 3-quart casserole dish. Place chicken pieces on top. Heat 3 soups, margarine and 1 cup water on stove top. Pour over chicken and rice. Bake at 350° for about 1 hour.

recipes.title: Broccoli Casserole
directions: Cook broccoli about 10 minutes and drain.
Put in a square glass dish.
Cut cheese in chunks and place about in broccoli. Melt margarine and mix with Ritz cracker crumbs.
Use these as a topping for broccoli.
Bake in a 350° oven for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Broccoli Casserole. Cook broccoli about 10 minutes and drain. Put in a square glass dish. Cut cheese in chunks and place about in broccoli. Melt margarine and mix with Ritz cracker crumbs. Use these as a topping for broccoli. Bake in a 350° oven for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Society Soup
ingredients: 2 lb. lean ground beef, browned with 1 crushed garlic clove
1 large can Italian-style tomatoes, pureed in blender
directions: Simmer ingredients 30 minutes, covered.
Add 1/3 cup of barley and simmer 30 minutes more, covered.
Add 1/2 cup alphabet macaroni and simmer 15 more minutes, covered.
Serve with croutons and Parmesan cheese, if desired.
recipes.text: Society Soup. Simmer ingredients 30 minutes, covered. Add 1/3 cup of barley and simmer 30 minutes more, covered. Add 1/2 cup alphabet macaroni and simmer 15 more minutes, covered. Serve with croutons and Parmesan cheese, if desired.

recipes.title: Double Chocolate Rebels
directions: Sift together flour, soda, cocoa and salt; set aside.
Cream butter and vanilla.
Add sugar gradually, creaming until fluffy. Add egg and beat thoroughly.
Alternately add water and dry ingredients to creamed mixture.
Gradually add oats, stirring well.
Mix in chocolate chips.
Drop 2 inches apart on greased cookie sheet.
Bake at 350° until done.
Don't overbake!
recipes.text: Double Chocolate Rebels. Sift together flour, soda, cocoa and salt; set aside. Cream butter and vanilla. Add sugar gradually, creaming until fluffy. Add egg and beat thoroughly. Alternately add water and dry ingredients to creamed mixture. Gradually add oats, stirring well. Mix in chocolate chips. Drop 2 inches apart on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350° until done. Don't overbake!

recipes.title: Scallops A La Provencale
directions: Heat peanut oil in 9-inch skillet over medium heat. Add scallops, onions, garlic, lemon juice, salt and pepper.
Cook, stirring occasionally, until scallops are done, about 5 minutes. Combine sherry and cornstarch. Add to scallop mixture and cook until thickened.
Garnish with parsley and lemon wedges.
Makes 4 servings.
recipes.text: Scallops A La Provencale. Heat peanut oil in 9-inch skillet over medium heat. Add scallops, onions, garlic, lemon juice, salt and pepper. Cook, stirring occasionally, until scallops are done, about 5 minutes. Combine sherry and cornstarch. Add to scallop mixture and cook until thickened. Garnish with parsley and lemon wedges. Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: Chicken On Rice
ingredients: 1 chicken, cut up, or you can use all breast or whatever
directions: Mix soup with milk.
Add can of mushrooms and package of onion soup mix.
Put rice in oblong pan, then arrange chicken on top of rice.
Pour soup mixture over chicken.
Make sure soup mixture gets under chicken and the rice is wet with mixture.
Cover; bake for 1 hour at 350°, then uncover and bake 15 minutes longer.
recipes.text: Chicken On Rice. Mix soup with milk. Add can of mushrooms and package of onion soup mix. Put rice in oblong pan, then arrange chicken on top of rice. Pour soup mixture over chicken. Make sure soup mixture gets under chicken and the rice is wet with mixture. Cover; bake for 1 hour at 350°, then uncover and bake 15 minutes longer.

recipes.title: Italiano Vegetables
directions: In a large skillet or Dutch oven, combine all ingredients, except olives.
Bring to a boil.
Reduce heat, cover and simmer 5 minutes, until vegetables are tender-crisp.
Cool slightly.
Add olives.
Transfer to bowl.
Cover.
Chill 6 hours or overnight. Makes about 9 cups.
recipes.text: Italiano Vegetables. In a large skillet or Dutch oven, combine all ingredients, except olives. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat, cover and simmer 5 minutes, until vegetables are tender-crisp. Cool slightly. Add olives. Transfer to bowl. Cover. Chill 6 hours or overnight. Makes about 9 cups.

recipes.title: Sour Cream Potato Salad
directions: In advance cook potatoes in water with 3/4 teaspoon salt. Drain; cool 10 minutes.
Peel potatoes and slice.
Pour Italian dressing over potatoes and refrigerate for at least 2 hours. Remove egg yolks from egg and set aside.
Chop whites.

Mix egg whites, celery and 1 cup green onions with potatoes and set aside. Press egg yolks through sieve reserving 3 tablespoons for garnish. Combine remaining egg yolk, mayo, sour cream, mustard, salt, horseradish, celery seed and pepper in bowl.
Mix with potatoes. Cover and refrigerate 2 hours before serving.
recipes.text: Sour Cream Potato Salad. In advance cook potatoes in water with 3/4 teaspoon salt. Drain; cool 10 minutes. Peel potatoes and slice. Pour Italian dressing over potatoes and refrigerate for at least 2 hours. Remove egg yolks from egg and set aside. Chop whites. Mix egg whites, celery and 1 cup green onions with potatoes and set aside. Press egg yolks through sieve reserving 3 tablespoons for garnish. Combine remaining egg yolk, mayo, sour cream, mustard, salt, horseradish, celery seed and pepper in bowl. Mix with potatoes. Cover and refrigerate 2 hours before serving.

recipes.title: Apple Cake
ingredients: 5 or 6 medium apples, peeled, cored and quartered
directions: Place eggs, orange juice, vanilla, oil and 2 cups sugar in large mixer bowl.
Sift flour, salt and baking powder in large bowl.
Turn mixer on low to start; increase speed to moderate. Beat for 10 minutes.
Cut each apple quarter into 3 slices.
Spoon half the flour mixture into greased and floured tube pan; arrange half the apple slices over.
Sprinkle with half the 4 tablespoons sugar and cinnamon mixture.
Add remaining batter, apples and sugar mixture.
