Bake at 350° for 1 hour and 15 minutes.
Cool in pan before turning out.
recipes.text: Apple Cake. Place eggs, orange juice, vanilla, oil and 2 cups sugar in large mixer bowl. Sift flour, salt and baking powder in large bowl. Turn mixer on low to start; increase speed to moderate. Beat for 10 minutes. Cut each apple quarter into 3 slices. Spoon half the flour mixture into greased and floured tube pan; arrange half the apple slices over. Sprinkle with half the 4 tablespoons sugar and cinnamon mixture. Add remaining batter, apples and sugar mixture. Bake at 350° for 1 hour and 15 minutes. Cool in pan before turning out.

recipes.title: Meat Loaf(For Those Who Don'T Like Dry Meat Loaf)
ingredients: 1/4 c. celery, chopped or 1/4 tsp. celery salt
4 slices soft white bread or whatever you have
directions: In medium bowl, mix milk, eggs and all spices (not tomato sauce).
Add bite size bread chunks and let soak.
In a large bowl, mix meat and vegetables; add milk, bread and spice mixture. Blend well (hands work best).
Turn into a 9 x 13-inch baking dish; hand form into 2 low meat loaves.
Press 4 fingers in a line into meat loaf to make 3 channels in the top of each loaf.
Cover top of loaves with cracker crumbs, then tomato sauce.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
Serves 8 to 10; can be cut in half.
Can be doubled for a crowd.
Very moist if directions followed. Wonderful!
recipes.text: Meat Loaf(For Those Who Don'T Like Dry Meat Loaf). In medium bowl, mix milk, eggs and all spices (not tomato sauce). Add bite size bread chunks and let soak. In a large bowl, mix meat and vegetables; add milk, bread and spice mixture. Blend well (hands work best). Turn into a 9 x 13-inch baking dish; hand form into 2 low meat loaves. Press 4 fingers in a line into meat loaf to make 3 channels in the top of each loaf. Cover top of loaves with cracker crumbs, then tomato sauce. Bake at 350° for 1 hour. Serves 8 to 10; can be cut in half. Can be doubled for a crowd. Very moist if directions followed. Wonderful!

recipes.title: Chocolate Heaven
directions: Mix together and press in bottom of large baking dish.
Bake for about 10 to 15 minutes at 350°.
Cool completely.
recipes.text: Chocolate Heaven. Mix together and press in bottom of large baking dish. Bake for about 10 to 15 minutes at 350°. Cool completely.

recipes.title: Bread Stuffing
ingredients: 1 1/2 c. chopped celery stalks and leaves
directions: In a large skillet, cook onion and celery in butter, stirring often, until onion is tender.
Stir in about 1/3 of the bread cubes.
Turn into deep bowl.
Add remaining ingredients and toss. Stuff turkey just before roasting.
Makes 9 cups (12 pound turkey).
recipes.text: Bread Stuffing. In a large skillet, cook onion and celery in butter, stirring often, until onion is tender. Stir in about 1/3 of the bread cubes. Turn into deep bowl. Add remaining ingredients and toss. Stuff turkey just before roasting. Makes 9 cups (12 pound turkey).

recipes.title: Potato Casserole
ingredients: 1 (10 oz.) can cream of chicken soup
1 large bag frozen shredded hash browns
directions: Mix all ingredients in large bowl except corn flakes and butter.
Place mixed ingredients in large baking dish.
Mix butter and corn flakes in small bowl, then spread evenly over the potatoes.
Bake at 350° for one hour.
recipes.text: Potato Casserole. Mix all ingredients in large bowl except corn flakes and butter. Place mixed ingredients in large baking dish. Mix butter and corn flakes in small bowl, then spread evenly over the potatoes. Bake at 350° for one hour.

recipes.title: Instant Cocoa Mix
directions: Note:
Makes enough mix for many jars.
recipes.text: Instant Cocoa Mix. Note: Makes enough mix for many jars.

recipes.title: Hot Cocoa
directions: In a saucepan, combine cocoa, sugar and water.
Stir until sugar is dissolved.
Add milk.
Heat thoroughly but do not boil. Pour into mugs and top with marshmallows or marshmallow cream.
recipes.text: Hot Cocoa. In a saucepan, combine cocoa, sugar and water. Stir until sugar is dissolved. Add milk. Heat thoroughly but do not boil. Pour into mugs and top with marshmallows or marshmallow cream.

recipes.title: Cream Cheese Brownies
directions: Heat oven to 350°.
Microwave chocolate and butter in large bowl on High for 2 minutes.
Stir until both are completely melted.
Stir in 2 cups of sugar. Mix in 4 eggs and vanilla.
Stir in 1 cup of flour and walnuts until well blended.
Spread into greased foil lined 13 x 9-inch pan.
recipes.text: Cream Cheese Brownies. Heat oven to 350°. Microwave chocolate and butter in large bowl on High for 2 minutes. Stir until both are completely melted. Stir in 2 cups of sugar. Mix in 4 eggs and vanilla. Stir in 1 cup of flour and walnuts until well blended. Spread into greased foil lined 13 x 9-inch pan.

recipes.title: Vinegar Pie Crust
directions: Combine flour, sugar and salt.
With a pastry blender, cut shortening into flour.
In a small bowl, combine water, vinegar and egg.
Beat this mixture.
Pour liquid mixture into flour mixture.
Use a fork to lift ingredients until enough moisture is spread to form a ball with your hands.
This makes a flaky and tender pie crust and forms much easier than most.
recipes.text: Vinegar Pie Crust. Combine flour, sugar and salt. With a pastry blender, cut shortening into flour. In a small bowl, combine water, vinegar and egg. Beat this mixture. Pour liquid mixture into flour mixture. Use a fork to lift ingredients until enough moisture is spread to form a ball with your hands. This makes a flaky and tender pie crust and forms much easier than most.

recipes.title: Bran Muffins
directions: Stir together the flour, sugar, salt and baking powder; set aside.
Combine cereal and milk; let stand about 3 minutes or until cereal softens.
Add egg and oil; mix well.
Add flour mixture, stirring only until combined.
Pour batter into 12 lightly-greased 2 1/2-inch muffin pan cups.
Bake at 400° for about 20 minutes.
Serve warm.
recipes.text: Bran Muffins. Stir together the flour, sugar, salt and baking powder; set aside. Combine cereal and milk; let stand about 3 minutes or until cereal softens. Add egg and oil; mix well. Add flour mixture, stirring only until combined. Pour batter into 12 lightly-greased 2 1/2-inch muffin pan cups. Bake at 400° for about 20 minutes. Serve warm.

recipes.title: Hush Puppies
directions: Mix well.
Spoon into hot fish grease.
recipes.text: Hush Puppies. Mix well. Spoon into hot fish grease.

recipes.title: Apple Crisp
directions: Mix the first 4 ingredients together.
Make 2 holes in flour. Put egg in one and margarine in other.
Add vanilla and mix. Combine apples, 1/2 cup sugar and tapioca.
Grease a 9 x 9 x 2-inch pan with margarine.
Put apple mixture in.
On wax paper, pat out batter.
Place on top of apples.
Bake at 350° for 1/2 hour.
Serve warm or cold.
recipes.text: Apple Crisp. Mix the first 4 ingredients together. Make 2 holes in flour. Put egg in one and margarine in other. Add vanilla and mix. Combine apples, 1/2 cup sugar and tapioca. Grease a 9 x 9 x 2-inch pan with margarine. Put apple mixture in. On wax paper, pat out batter. Place on top of apples. Bake at 350° for 1/2 hour. Serve warm or cold.

recipes.title: Peach Cobbler
directions: Slice peaches and cover with sugar and cinnamon in a 9 x 9-inch pan.
Mix well the biscuit mix, egg, milk, sugar, vegetable oil and cinnamon; spread over peaches and bake at 350° for 20 minutes.
recipes.text: Peach Cobbler. Slice peaches and cover with sugar and cinnamon in a 9 x 9-inch pan. Mix well the biscuit mix, egg, milk, sugar, vegetable oil and cinnamon; spread over peaches and bake at 350° for 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Brian Bentley'S Savory Spinach And Rice Soup
ingredients: 1 (10 oz.) bag fresh spinach, washed and trimmed
1/2 c. minced chives or green onions
directions: In large saucepot, heat oil.
Add onion and cook 5 minutes or until soft, but not browned.
Add tomato puree, spinach, broth, tomato, rice, oregano and Tabasco sauce.
Cover and simmer 30 minutes or until rice is tender.
Stir in chives.
recipes.text: Brian Bentley'S Savory Spinach And Rice Soup. In large saucepot, heat oil. Add onion and cook 5 minutes or until soft, but not browned. Add tomato puree, spinach, broth, tomato, rice, oregano and Tabasco sauce. Cover and simmer 30 minutes or until rice is tender. Stir in chives.

recipes.title: Poppy Seed Cake
directions: Soak poppy seed in the cup of water about 2 hours.
Add this and other ingredients to cake mix and mix well.
Pour into ungreased tube pan.
Bake about 35 minutes at 325°.
Turn pan upside down to cool.
Glaze with your favorite glaze.
recipes.text: Poppy Seed Cake. Soak poppy seed in the cup of water about 2 hours. Add this and other ingredients to cake mix and mix well. Pour into ungreased tube pan. Bake about 35 minutes at 325°. Turn pan upside down to cool. Glaze with your favorite glaze.

recipes.title: Chicken Gumbo
ingredients: 2/3 c. chopped green onions and tops
directions: Saut okra in fat, stirring constantly about 10 minutes or until okra appears dry.
Add onions, celery, garlic, salt, pepper and chicken to okra mixture.
Add water, tomatoes and bay leaves. Cover and simmer 20 minutes.
recipes.text: Chicken Gumbo. Saut okra in fat, stirring constantly about 10 minutes or until okra appears dry. Add onions, celery, garlic, salt, pepper and chicken to okra mixture. Add water, tomatoes and bay leaves. Cover and simmer 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Breaded Chicken With Lemon Juice
ingredients: egg, beaten with small amount of water added
directions: Wash chicken pieces, dredge in flour, dip in egg-water, coat thoroughly with bread crumbs.
In frypan heat oil and butter to medium heat.
Carefully place chicken in pan, turning when brown. Cook until juices run clear.
Serve hot with a few drops of lemon juice sprinkled on top.
Try lemon juice on the vegetables also.
recipes.text: Breaded Chicken With Lemon Juice. Wash chicken pieces, dredge in flour, dip in egg-water, coat thoroughly with bread crumbs. In frypan heat oil and butter to medium heat. Carefully place chicken in pan, turning when brown. Cook until juices run clear. Serve hot with a few drops of lemon juice sprinkled on top. Try lemon juice on the vegetables also.

recipes.title: Mom'S Strawberry Shortcake
directions: In a mixing bowl, beat the eggs on medium speed for 3 minutes. Gradually add 1 cup sugar, beating until thick and lemon-colored. Combine the flour, baking powder and salt. Beat into egg mixture. Heat the milk and butter just until butter begins to melt. Beat into batter with vanilla (batter will be thin). Pour into a greased 8-inch square baking pan. Bake at 350° for 25 minutes or until a toothpick inserted near the center comes out clean. Cool for at least 10 minutes.
recipes.text: Mom'S Strawberry Shortcake. In a mixing bowl, beat the eggs on medium speed for 3 minutes. Gradually add 1 cup sugar, beating until thick and lemon-colored. Combine the flour, baking powder and salt. Beat into egg mixture. Heat the milk and butter just until butter begins to melt. Beat into batter with vanilla (batter will be thin). Pour into a greased 8-inch square baking pan. Bake at 350° for 25 minutes or until a toothpick inserted near the center comes out clean. Cool for at least 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Holiday Truffles
ingredients: 1 (12 oz.) pkg. (2 c.) semi-sweet chocolate chips
1/4 c. orange flavored liqueur or 1 tsp. orange extract
1 can Pillsbury chocolate fudge or chocolate frosting supreme
directions: Melt chocolate chips in medium saucepan over low heat, stirring constantly; remove from heat.
Stir in orange liqueur and frosting; blend well.
Refrigerate 1 to 2 hours or until firm. Place coconut in pie pan.
Scoop mixture into 1-inch balls; drop onto coconut.
(Mixture will be sticky.)
Roll to coat.
Place in foil candy cups, if desired.
Store in refrigerator.
Makes 6 dozen candies.
recipes.text: Holiday Truffles. Melt chocolate chips in medium saucepan over low heat, stirring constantly; remove from heat. Stir in orange liqueur and frosting; blend well. Refrigerate 1 to 2 hours or until firm. Place coconut in pie pan. Scoop mixture into 1-inch balls; drop onto coconut. (Mixture will be sticky.) Roll to coat. Place in foil candy cups, if desired. Store in refrigerator. Makes 6 dozen candies.

recipes.title: Chocolate Coconutty Delights
directions: Note:
To make drizzling with chocolate easier, put thin melted mixture in a plastic bag.
Snip off a corner of the bag and drizzle chocolate coating through the hole.
recipes.text: Chocolate Coconutty Delights. Note: To make drizzling with chocolate easier, put thin melted mixture in a plastic bag. Snip off a corner of the bag and drizzle chocolate coating through the hole.

recipes.title: 5-Cup Salad
directions: Mix together and top with maraschino cherries and chill.
recipes.text: 5-Cup Salad. Mix together and top with maraschino cherries and chill.

recipes.title: Clam Chowder
directions: Fry bacon and set aside to drain.
Pour off bacon fat.
Add onions to pan and saute until translucent.
Add potatoes and water or clam juice.
Simmer for 15 to 20 minutes or until potatoes are tender.
Add milk, clams with juice, salt and pepper.
Simmer for 10 minutes (do not boil).
Add butter just prior to serving. Garnish with crumbled bacon.
recipes.text: Clam Chowder. Fry bacon and set aside to drain. Pour off bacon fat. Add onions to pan and saute until translucent. Add potatoes and water or clam juice. Simmer for 15 to 20 minutes or until potatoes are tender. Add milk, clams with juice, salt and pepper. Simmer for 10 minutes (do not boil). Add butter just prior to serving. Garnish with crumbled bacon.

recipes.title: Glazed Pineapple Chicken
directions: Combine all ingredients in bowl.
Pour into Ziploc bag and add chicken to marinade.
Cook chicken on grill.
recipes.text: Glazed Pineapple Chicken. Combine all ingredients in bowl. Pour into Ziploc bag and add chicken to marinade. Cook chicken on grill.

recipes.title: Eggplant Casserole
directions: Peel eggplant; cut in cubes and boil in salted water until tender, approximately 20 minutes.
Drain and mash with fork. Brown ground chuck, onion and bell pepper; stir in eggplant and 2 cups cooked rice.
Pour into 2-quart baking dish.
Top with buttered cracker crumbs (I prefer Ritz).
Bake at 375° for 20 minutes.
recipes.text: Eggplant Casserole. Peel eggplant; cut in cubes and boil in salted water until tender, approximately 20 minutes. Drain and mash with fork. Brown ground chuck, onion and bell pepper; stir in eggplant and 2 cups cooked rice. Pour into 2-quart baking dish. Top with buttered cracker crumbs (I prefer Ritz). Bake at 375° for 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Sweet Spice Cake Lotte
directions: Cream the first 3 ingredients until smooth.
Add the flour, baking powder, milk, cocoa, cloves, cinnamon, nutmeg and salt to the butter mixture, mixing thoroughly.
Beat the egg whites until stiff and gently fold into the cake mixture.
Pour into a well buttered large cookie sheet or round spring-form pan.
Bake in a 200° C (390° F) oven for about 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Sweet Spice Cake Lotte. Cream the first 3 ingredients until smooth. Add the flour, baking powder, milk, cocoa, cloves, cinnamon, nutmeg and salt to the butter mixture, mixing thoroughly. Beat the egg whites until stiff and gently fold into the cake mixture. Pour into a well buttered large cookie sheet or round spring-form pan. Bake in a 200° C (390° F) oven for about 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Calico Beans
directions: Cook hamburger and onion.
Drain butter and lima beans; mix meat, beans and other vegetables.
Bake at 350° for 1 1/2 to 2 hours.
recipes.text: Calico Beans. Cook hamburger and onion. Drain butter and lima beans; mix meat, beans and other vegetables. Bake at 350° for 1 1/2 to 2 hours.

recipes.title: Molded Cranberry Salad
directions: Heat cranberry sauce in pan.
Add all ingredients.
Pour in mold.
Let set in refrigerator until firm, overnight.
recipes.text: Molded Cranberry Salad. Heat cranberry sauce in pan. Add all ingredients. Pour in mold. Let set in refrigerator until firm, overnight.

recipes.title: Buttermilk Pecan Pie
directions: In mixing bowl, cream butter and sugar.
Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each egg.
Blend in flour, lemon juice and vanilla.
Stir in buttermilk and pecans.
Pour into pie shell. Bake at 325° for 55 minutes or until set.
Cool on wire rack. Store in refrigerator.
recipes.text: Buttermilk Pecan Pie. In mixing bowl, cream butter and sugar. Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each egg. Blend in flour, lemon juice and vanilla. Stir in buttermilk and pecans. Pour into pie shell. Bake at 325° for 55 minutes or until set. Cool on wire rack. Store in refrigerator.

recipes.title: Hurry Up Rolls
directions: Combine all ingredients together and spoon into a greased muffin pan.
Bake at 400° for 10 to 12 minutes.
recipes.text: Hurry Up Rolls. Combine all ingredients together and spoon into a greased muffin pan. Bake at 400° for 10 to 12 minutes.

recipes.title: Cinnamon Flop
ingredients: brown sugar, cinnamon and butter (for top)
directions: Sift sugar, flour and baking powder together.
Add melted butter and milk; stir until well blended.
Divide mixture between 2 (9-inch) pie or cake pans, well-greased.
Sprinkle tops with flour, then brown sugar, then cinnamon.
Push chunks of butter into the dough.
This makes holes and later gets gooey as it bakes.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Cinnamon Flop. Sift sugar, flour and baking powder together. Add melted butter and milk; stir until well blended. Divide mixture between 2 (9-inch) pie or cake pans, well-greased. Sprinkle tops with flour, then brown sugar, then cinnamon. Push chunks of butter into the dough. This makes holes and later gets gooey as it bakes. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: String Bean Supreme
directions: Combine and let stand 1 hour.
Cover with buttered crumbs. Bake 45 minutes at 350°.
recipes.text: String Bean Supreme. Combine and let stand 1 hour. Cover with buttered crumbs. Bake 45 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Amish Salad
directions: Wash and drain sauerkraut.
Mix sugar, salad oil, vinegar and water well.
Pour over salad and marinate overnight.
Drain before serving.
recipes.text: Amish Salad. Wash and drain sauerkraut. Mix sugar, salad oil, vinegar and water well. Pour over salad and marinate overnight. Drain before serving.

recipes.title: Black-Eyed Peas
directions: Combine all ingredients in a 4 quart
Dutch oven; bring to boil.
Reduce heat; cover and simmer 1 to
hours or until peas are tender (add more water as
needed).
Remove ham hock and take meat from bones.
Add to peas.
Yields
to
8 servings.
recipes.text: Black-Eyed Peas. Combine all ingredients in a 4 quart Dutch oven; bring to boil. Reduce heat; cover and simmer 1 to 1 1/2 hours or until peas are tender (add more water as needed). Remove ham hock and take meat from bones. Add to peas. Yields 6 to 8 servings.

recipes.title: Mexican Lasagna
directions: Add first 6 ingredients and simmer 10 minutes.
Mix remaining ingredients, except Monterey Jack cheese and tortillas, together. Layer 1/2 meat mixture and top with 1/2 shells.
Spread cheese mixture.
Add 1/2 Monterey Jack cheese.
Repeat layers.
Bake uncovered 20 to 30 minutes at 350° in 9 x 13-inch pan.
recipes.text: Mexican Lasagna. Add first 6 ingredients and simmer 10 minutes. Mix remaining ingredients, except Monterey Jack cheese and tortillas, together. Layer 1/2 meat mixture and top with 1/2 shells. Spread cheese mixture. Add 1/2 Monterey Jack cheese. Repeat layers. Bake uncovered 20 to 30 minutes at 350° in 9 x 13-inch pan.

recipes.title: Bonita Marie
ingredients: Dawn fresh mushroom steak sauce (comes in cans)
directions: Precook bacon in either microwave or regular oven to remove some of the fat, without making it too crisp to roll.
Cut round steak into strips.
Roll a slice of bacon with each strip of round steak and fasten with a toothpick.
Place rolls, side by side, in a covered roaster or casserole dish.
recipes.text: Bonita Marie. Precook bacon in either microwave or regular oven to remove some of the fat, without making it too crisp to roll. Cut round steak into strips. Roll a slice of bacon with each strip of round steak and fasten with a toothpick. Place rolls, side by side, in a covered roaster or casserole dish.

recipes.title: Pasta-Bean Salad
ingredients: 1 (15 oz.) can red kidney beans, rinsed and drained
1 c. frozen peas, thawed and drained
directions: Combine macaroni, beans, peas and carrots in a large bowl; toss gently.
Combine mayonnaise, parsley, cheese, lemon juice, garlic and basil, mixing well.
Add to macaroni mixture, tossing gently to coat.
Cover and chill 2 hours.
Serve on lettuce leaves, if desired.
recipes.text: Pasta-Bean Salad. Combine macaroni, beans, peas and carrots in a large bowl; toss gently. Combine mayonnaise, parsley, cheese, lemon juice, garlic and basil, mixing well. Add to macaroni mixture, tossing gently to coat. Cover and chill 2 hours. Serve on lettuce leaves, if desired.

recipes.title: Dirty Rice
directions: Simmer livers, peppers, onions and celery in oil with 2 cups water until tender and water is cooked out. Add 1/8 teaspoon red pepper, salt and black pepper to taste.
Place in blender and blend well. Add to cooked rice.
Reheat and serve. Double this for large crowds. Also this freezes well.
recipes.text: Dirty Rice. Simmer livers, peppers, onions and celery in oil with 2 cups water until tender and water is cooked out. Add 1/8 teaspoon red pepper, salt and black pepper to taste. Place in blender and blend well. Add to cooked rice. Reheat and serve. Double this for large crowds. Also this freezes well.

recipes.title: Sweet Potato Casserole #2
directions: Mix above ingredients and place in buttered casserole.
recipes.text: Sweet Potato Casserole #2. Mix above ingredients and place in buttered casserole.

recipes.title: Grrreat Punch
directions: Add ingredients to bowl.
If desired, pineapple sherbet may be added for creamy punch.
recipes.text: Grrreat Punch. Add ingredients to bowl. If desired, pineapple sherbet may be added for creamy punch.

recipes.title: Artichoke Squares
ingredients: 1/8 tsp. each: pepper, oregano and Tabasco sauce
directions: Drain 1 jar artichoke hearts and use juice to saute onion and garlic.
Chop hearts and add to sauteed mixture.
Beat eggs in bowl; add bread crumbs, salt, pepper, oregano, Tabasco sauce and parsley.
Add sauteed mixture.
Mix well and add cheese.
Bake at 325° in a 7 x 11-inch baking dish for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Artichoke Squares. Drain 1 jar artichoke hearts and use juice to saute onion and garlic. Chop hearts and add to sauteed mixture. Beat eggs in bowl; add bread crumbs, salt, pepper, oregano, Tabasco sauce and parsley. Add sauteed mixture. Mix well and add cheese. Bake at 325° in a 7 x 11-inch baking dish for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Cheese Cake
directions: Use a round 9-inch spring-form pan.
Beat 4 egg whites until stiff.
Gradually blend in 1 cup sugar.
Set aside.
Then mix cream cheese with 1 teaspoon of vanilla.
Mix this with egg whites and blend.
Pour into pan that you have prepared a graham cracker crust.
You can put cherry filling on crust, if you wish.
Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.
recipes.text: Cheese Cake. Use a round 9-inch spring-form pan. Beat 4 egg whites until stiff. Gradually blend in 1 cup sugar. Set aside. Then mix cream cheese with 1 teaspoon of vanilla. Mix this with egg whites and blend. Pour into pan that you have prepared a graham cracker crust. You can put cherry filling on crust, if you wish. Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Porcupine Meatballs
directions: Mix 1/4 cup tomato soup with the ground beef.
Add the rice, egg, onion, parsley and salt.
Shape into meatballs about 1 1/2-inches in diameter.
Brown in the shortening with the minced garlic.
Blend in the rest of the can of soup and the water. Cover.
Simmer about 40 minutes or until the rice is tender, stirring now and then.
recipes.text: Porcupine Meatballs. Mix 1/4 cup tomato soup with the ground beef. Add the rice, egg, onion, parsley and salt. Shape into meatballs about 1 1/2-inches in diameter. Brown in the shortening with the minced garlic. Blend in the rest of the can of soup and the water. Cover. Simmer about 40 minutes or until the rice is tender, stirring now and then.

recipes.title: Squash Pie
directions: Cut squash in pieces and boil until tender, then put in blender and then measure.
Mix all ingredients.
Bake at 325° for 1 1/2 hours. Pour in 2 (9-inch) deep crusts.
recipes.text: Squash Pie. Cut squash in pieces and boil until tender, then put in blender and then measure. Mix all ingredients. Bake at 325° for 1 1/2 hours. Pour in 2 (9-inch) deep crusts.

recipes.title: Banana Shake(Yield: 3 Large Shakes)
directions: 1. Unpeel bananas and put in a blender.
recipes.text: Banana Shake(Yield: 3 Large Shakes). 1. Unpeel bananas and put in a blender.

recipes.title: Sausage And Cheese Dip
ingredients: 1 (10 oz.) block jalapeno cheese (Monterey hot or white cheese with chopped pepper in it)
directions: Fry sausage.
Mash up as for chili.
Drain all grease from sausage.
Pat with paper towels.
In a crock-pot, add grated cheese, soup, 3/4 can of water and sausage.
Cook approximately 2 hours or until cheese has melted.
I put my cheese and soup mix in the microwave and melt the cheese (5 to 10 minutes), then add the sausage and it is ready.
Serve warm with chips.
recipes.text: Sausage And Cheese Dip. Fry sausage. Mash up as for chili. Drain all grease from sausage. Pat with paper towels. In a crock-pot, add grated cheese, soup, 3/4 can of water and sausage. Cook approximately 2 hours or until cheese has melted. I put my cheese and soup mix in the microwave and melt the cheese (5 to 10 minutes), then add the sausage and it is ready. Serve warm with chips.

recipes.title: Twin Mountain Muffins
directions: Cream sugar and butter together.
Add egg.
Sift flour, salt and baking powder together.
Add flour mixture alternately with milk to creamed mixture.
Blend well.
Bake in greased tins at 400° for 20 minutes.
(If any shortening other than butter is used, increase salt to 1/2 teaspoon.)
recipes.text: Twin Mountain Muffins. Cream sugar and butter together. Add egg. Sift flour, salt and baking powder together. Add flour mixture alternately with milk to creamed mixture. Blend well. Bake in greased tins at 400° for 20 minutes. (If any shortening other than butter is used, increase salt to 1/2 teaspoon.)

recipes.title: Piggie Peach Custard Pie
directions: Slice the peaches on the bottom of an unbaked pie shell.
Mix well the sugar, eggs, flour and butter and pour slowly over peaches.
Bake 15 minutes at 425° or bake 45 minutes at 325°.
recipes.text: Piggie Peach Custard Pie. Slice the peaches on the bottom of an unbaked pie shell. Mix well the sugar, eggs, flour and butter and pour slowly over peaches. Bake 15 minutes at 425° or bake 45 minutes at 325°.

recipes.title: Cereal Cookies
ingredients: 1 c. margarine or butter flavored shortening
1 c. flake cereal (I've used Special K, Wheaties, Total and corn flakes)
directions: Cream together margarine or shortening and sugars.
Add eggs. Mix in dry ingredients, then cereals and chocolate chips or raisins. Drop by teaspoon on greased cookie sheet.
Bake at 350° for 8 to 10 minutes.
recipes.text: Cereal Cookies. Cream together margarine or shortening and sugars. Add eggs. Mix in dry ingredients, then cereals and chocolate chips or raisins. Drop by teaspoon on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350° for 8 to 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Chili
ingredients: 1 large (19 oz.) can red kidney beans
directions: Saute onion and meat in oil until brown.
Add remaining ingredients and simmer about 1 hour.
recipes.text: Chili. Saute onion and meat in oil until brown. Add remaining ingredients and simmer about 1 hour.

recipes.title: Ham Delights
directions: Preheat oven to 400°.
Cream butter, poppy seeds, Worcestershire sauce, mustard and onions together.
Spread tops and bottoms of rolls with creamed mixture.
Add sliced ham and Swiss cheese slices.
Close rolls and slice into individual roll servings.
Wrap in aluminum foil and bake at 400° for 10 minutes.
recipes.text: Ham Delights. Preheat oven to 400°. Cream butter, poppy seeds, Worcestershire sauce, mustard and onions together. Spread tops and bottoms of rolls with creamed mixture. Add sliced ham and Swiss cheese slices. Close rolls and slice into individual roll servings. Wrap in aluminum foil and bake at 400° for 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Fruity Yogurt Parfaits
ingredients: 1 c. plain or vanilla low-fat yogurt
1/2 c. chopped fresh or unsweetened canned fruit (apples, bananas, pineapple and strawberries work well)
directions: Layer yogurt, fruit and graham cracker crumbs in cups or glasses to make parfaits.
recipes.text: Fruity Yogurt Parfaits. Layer yogurt, fruit and graham cracker crumbs in cups or glasses to make parfaits.

recipes.title: Broken Glass Jello Salad
directions: Prepare the raspberry jello, orange jello and lime jello using 1 cup boiling water and 1/2 cup cold water for each.
Pour into 8-inch pans and chill until very firm. Cut each into squares. Dissolve the lemon jello and the sugar in 1 cup boiling water. Stir in 1/2 cup pineapple juice.
Chill until slightly thick. Blend in the Cool Whip.
Fold in the jello cubes. Carefully pour into a
mold or a large glass bowl. Chill.
recipes.text: Broken Glass Jello Salad. Prepare the raspberry jello, orange jello and lime jello using 1 cup boiling water and 1/2 cup cold water for each. Pour into 8-inch pans and chill until very firm. Cut each into squares. Dissolve the lemon jello and the sugar in 1 cup boiling water. Stir in 1/2 cup pineapple juice. Chill until slightly thick. Blend in the Cool Whip. Fold in the jello cubes. Carefully pour into a mold or a large glass bowl. Chill.

recipes.title: Tuna Goulash
directions: Mix in baking dish and pour 1 can mushroom soup over top. Bake 35 to 40 minutes.
recipes.text: Tuna Goulash. Mix in baking dish and pour 1 can mushroom soup over top. Bake 35 to 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Cheeseburger Casserole
directions: Cook beef and onion until meat is slightly browned.
Drain. Add salt and pepper.
Stir in catsup and tomato sauce.
Heat thoroughly.
Turn into pan.
Cut cheese into 3-inch strips; place over meat.
Bake at 425° for 20 to 25 minutes.
recipes.text: Cheeseburger Casserole. Cook beef and onion until meat is slightly browned. Drain. Add salt and pepper. Stir in catsup and tomato sauce. Heat thoroughly. Turn into pan. Cut cheese into 3-inch strips; place over meat. Bake at 425° for 20 to 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Wet Burritos
directions: Brown meat.
Add onion, tomato soup and Tabasco sauce.
Simmer 1 1/2 hours.
Chop lettuce.
Mix enchilada sauce with tomato paste and water as package instructs.
Heat up beans.
Fold into shells the meat, beans and lettuce.
Place in a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Top with sauce and cheese.
Bake at 375° for 10 minutes.
recipes.text: Wet Burritos. Brown meat. Add onion, tomato soup and Tabasco sauce. Simmer 1 1/2 hours. Chop lettuce. Mix enchilada sauce with tomato paste and water as package instructs. Heat up beans. Fold into shells the meat, beans and lettuce. Place in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Top with sauce and cheese. Bake at 375° for 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Spinach Dip
ingredients: 1 box frozen, chopped spinach, thawed and drained very well
directions: Mix all ingredients together.
Dip fresh vegetables in dip. Best if made day before.
recipes.text: Spinach Dip. Mix all ingredients together. Dip fresh vegetables in dip. Best if made day before.

recipes.title: Spinach-Cheese Savory
directions: Preheat oven to 350°.
Combine all ingredients except spinach. Pour into buttered casserole dish with lid.
Take a box of frozen chopped spinach; carve little chunks off and let fall on top of the cheese/egg mixture.
Bake one hour.
Let sit for 5 minutes before eating.
recipes.text: Spinach-Cheese Savory. Preheat oven to 350°. Combine all ingredients except spinach. Pour into buttered casserole dish with lid. Take a box of frozen chopped spinach; carve little chunks off and let fall on top of the cheese/egg mixture. Bake one hour. Let sit for 5 minutes before eating.

recipes.title: Tomato Pie
directions: Mix Bisquick and milk.
Form into crust.
Spread and press mixture into lightly oiled pie dish.
Slice tomatoes into crust. Sprinkle basil, salt and pepper over the tomatoes.
Spread mayonnaise over tomatoes.
Sprinkle cheese on top of mayonnaise. Bake in 375° oven for approximately 20 minutes or until crust has browned.
Bacon bits may also be added along with the basil and salt and pepper.
recipes.text: Tomato Pie. Mix Bisquick and milk. Form into crust. Spread and press mixture into lightly oiled pie dish. Slice tomatoes into crust. Sprinkle basil, salt and pepper over the tomatoes. Spread mayonnaise over tomatoes. Sprinkle cheese on top of mayonnaise. Bake in 375° oven for approximately 20 minutes or until crust has browned. Bacon bits may also be added along with the basil and salt and pepper.

recipes.title: Layered Vegetable Salad
directions: Layer evenly in large glass bowl, the lettuce, bell pepper, grated carrots, onions, frozen peas and boiled eggs.
Mix mayonnaise, sugar, salt, garlic powder and pepper in a separate bowl.
Spread mayonnaise mixture over layered vegetables.
Top with cheddar cheese and bacon bits.
Garnish with tomato wedges. Can be made up to 24 hours in advance.
recipes.text: Layered Vegetable Salad. Layer evenly in large glass bowl, the lettuce, bell pepper, grated carrots, onions, frozen peas and boiled eggs. Mix mayonnaise, sugar, salt, garlic powder and pepper in a separate bowl. Spread mayonnaise mixture over layered vegetables. Top with cheddar cheese and bacon bits. Garnish with tomato wedges. Can be made up to 24 hours in advance.

recipes.title: Italian Cole Slaw
directions: Grate cabbage and carrot. Chop onion.
Pour 3/4 cup sugar over and mix.
Bring rest of ingredients to a boil and pour over cabbage mixture.
Mix.
Will keep weeks in refrigerator.
recipes.text: Italian Cole Slaw. Grate cabbage and carrot. Chop onion. Pour 3/4 cup sugar over and mix. Bring rest of ingredients to a boil and pour over cabbage mixture. Mix. Will keep weeks in refrigerator.

recipes.title: Mock Chicken Chow Mein
ingredients: 1 c. milk or one can evaporated milk
1 (5 oz.) can chow mein noodles (reserve 1/4 to 1/2 c.)
directions: Mix all together; place in a small casserole.
Sprinkle 1/4 to 1/2 cup noodles
on
top.
Cashew
nuts
may be used on top.
Bake at 325° for 35 minutes.
recipes.text: Mock Chicken Chow Mein. Mix all together; place in a small casserole. Sprinkle 1/4 to 1/2 cup noodles on top. Cashew nuts may be used on top. Bake at 325° for 35 minutes.

recipes.title: Rumaki
directions: You also need toothpicks.
recipes.text: Rumaki. You also need toothpicks.

recipes.title: Kale Soup
ingredients: 1 can shell beans or kidney beans
directions: Cover kale, onions and meat with water.
Cook about 20 minutes.
Add potatoes.
Cook about 10 minutes.
Add can of beans. Cook last 5 minutes.
Enjoy with Portuguese bread.
recipes.text: Kale Soup. Cover kale, onions and meat with water. Cook about 20 minutes. Add potatoes. Cook about 10 minutes. Add can of beans. Cook last 5 minutes. Enjoy with Portuguese bread.

recipes.title: Pizza Bread
directions: Toast bread lightly.
Sprinkle with oregano, garlic and oil. Spread toast with tomato paste.
Top with cheese.
Place pizza under hot grill (broiler) until the cheese is bubbly and golden. Serve immediately with a little extra oregano sprinkled on top, if desired.
recipes.text: Pizza Bread. Toast bread lightly. Sprinkle with oregano, garlic and oil. Spread toast with tomato paste. Top with cheese. Place pizza under hot grill (broiler) until the cheese is bubbly and golden. Serve immediately with a little extra oregano sprinkled on top, if desired.

recipes.title: Rice Casserole
directions: Brown hamburger and drain.
Mix all ingredients together and place in casserole dish (will take a large one or two small casserole dishes).
Bake for 2 hours in 325° oven.
recipes.text: Rice Casserole. Brown hamburger and drain. Mix all ingredients together and place in casserole dish (will take a large one or two small casserole dishes). Bake for 2 hours in 325° oven.

recipes.title: Rutabaga Casserole
directions: Cover rutabaga with water.
Cook until tender, drain and mash. Add the remaining ingredients.
Place in buttered casserole. Set in a pan of hot water. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes or until knife inserted in center comes out clean.
recipes.text: Rutabaga Casserole. Cover rutabaga with water. Cook until tender, drain and mash. Add the remaining ingredients. Place in buttered casserole. Set in a pan of hot water. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes or until knife inserted in center comes out clean.

recipes.title: Five Week Sweet Pickle
directions: Put cucumbers in gallon jar with remaining ingredients.
Cover with vinegar.
Let stand 5 weeks.
Makes its own syrup.
Let stand overnight.
Pack in clean jars.
Heat lids and seal.
recipes.text: Five Week Sweet Pickle. Put cucumbers in gallon jar with remaining ingredients. Cover with vinegar. Let stand 5 weeks. Makes its own syrup. Let stand overnight. Pack in clean jars. Heat lids and seal.

recipes.title: Never Fail Frosting
directions: Beat until light and fluffy.
recipes.text: Never Fail Frosting. Beat until light and fluffy.

recipes.title: Skoby'S Corn
directions: Combine ingredients.
Heat and stir until mixture comes to a boil.
Pour into an oven-safe casserole dish.
Top with bread crumbs and bake at 350° for approximately 20 minutes.
recipes.text: Skoby'S Corn. Combine ingredients. Heat and stir until mixture comes to a boil. Pour into an oven-safe casserole dish. Top with bread crumbs and bake at 350° for approximately 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Lavanda Burns Cheese Cake
directions: Mix Jell-O and hot water and let slightly thicken.
Cream cream cheese, sugar, salt and lemon juice.
Whip chilled milk and add Jell-O and cheese mixture.
Crush graham crackers, add powdered sugar and melted butter.
Put 1/2 of cracker mixture on bottom of oblong pan.
Pour cream cheese mixture on that and then top with graham cracker mixture.
recipes.text: Lavanda Burns Cheese Cake. Mix Jell-O and hot water and let slightly thicken. Cream cream cheese, sugar, salt and lemon juice. Whip chilled milk and add Jell-O and cheese mixture. Crush graham crackers, add powdered sugar and melted butter. Put 1/2 of cracker mixture on bottom of oblong pan. Pour cream cheese mixture on that and then top with graham cracker mixture.

recipes.title: Shrimp Dip
directions: Mix cream cheese and cocktail sauce together until smooth, then fold in shrimp.
recipes.text: Shrimp Dip. Mix cream cheese and cocktail sauce together until smooth, then fold in shrimp.

recipes.title: Snickerdoodles
directions: Baking Temperature: 350°.
Baking Time: 8 minutes.
recipes.text: Snickerdoodles. Baking Temperature: 350°. Baking Time: 8 minutes.

recipes.title: Tomato Salsa
ingredients: 1 or 2 jalapeno chilies, stemmed, seeded and chopped
1/4 c. packed fresh cilantro, cut up
directions: Use a non-metallic bowl and mix all ingredients.
Season with salt and pepper.
recipes.text: Tomato Salsa. Use a non-metallic bowl and mix all ingredients. Season with salt and pepper.

recipes.title: Canada War Cake
directions: Boil all ingredients for 5 minutes after they begin to bubble. When cold, add 3 cups flour, 1 teaspoon baking powder and 1 scant teaspoon soda (dissolved in 1 tablespoon hot water).
Bake into loaves in a slow oven for 45 minutes, or until a toothpick comes out clean.
You may add nutmeats also if you like.
recipes.text: Canada War Cake. Boil all ingredients for 5 minutes after they begin to bubble. When cold, add 3 cups flour, 1 teaspoon baking powder and 1 scant teaspoon soda (dissolved in 1 tablespoon hot water). Bake into loaves in a slow oven for 45 minutes, or until a toothpick comes out clean. You may add nutmeats also if you like.

recipes.title: Barbecue Pork Roast
directions: Place all ingredients in crock-pot and cook on low for 8 to 10 hours.
Remove roast and slice or shred meat.
Put back in crock-pot
with sauce.
Serve on buns.
recipes.text: Barbecue Pork Roast. Place all ingredients in crock-pot and cook on low for 8 to 10 hours. Remove roast and slice or shred meat. Put back in crock-pot with sauce. Serve on buns.

recipes.title: Spicy Fried Chicken
directions: Dip chicken in egg.
Coat with remaining ingredients mixed together.
Place in shallow pan and bake at 400° for 20 to 25 minutes.
recipes.text: Spicy Fried Chicken. Dip chicken in egg. Coat with remaining ingredients mixed together. Place in shallow pan and bake at 400° for 20 to 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Tuna Casserole
directions: Preheat oven to 350°.
Cook noodles according to package. Drain and put in rectangular pan.
Cut stick of butter up and put on noodles.
Mix.
Empty drained can of peas on top of noodles.
recipes.text: Tuna Casserole. Preheat oven to 350°. Cook noodles according to package. Drain and put in rectangular pan. Cut stick of butter up and put on noodles. Mix. Empty drained can of peas on top of noodles.

recipes.title: Chicken Fajita Casserole
directions: Cut chicken into strips and cook in olive oil.
Add peppers and onions to chicken.
Add taco seasoning.
Cook until chicken is done.
Place chicken in casserole dish and add peppers and onions on top.
Pour salsa over this and add cheese.
Place under broiler until cheese is bubbly.
Serve with sour cream.
recipes.text: Chicken Fajita Casserole. Cut chicken into strips and cook in olive oil. Add peppers and onions to chicken. Add taco seasoning. Cook until chicken is done. Place chicken in casserole dish and add peppers and onions on top. Pour salsa over this and add cheese. Place under broiler until cheese is bubbly. Serve with sour cream.

recipes.title: Nancy Mccorkle'S Scotch Sausage Pie
ingredients: 2 1/2 c. tomatoes, coarsely chopped and drained
directions: Chop finely the green pepper and onion and mix with the chopped parsley.
Combine with pork sausage.
recipes.text: Nancy Mccorkle'S Scotch Sausage Pie. Chop finely the green pepper and onion and mix with the chopped parsley. Combine with pork sausage.

recipes.title: Cranberry Surprise Corn Muffins
directions: Heat oven to 425°.
Grease 12 medium muffin cups.
Combine cornmeal, flour, sugar, baking powder and salt.
Combine milk, egg and oil; add to dry ingredients, mixing just until dry ingredients are moistened.
Fill prepared muffin cups 2/3 full.
Place 1 1/2 teaspoons of relish in center of each muffin cup.
With tip of spoon, press lightly into batter.
Bake for 15 to 20 minutes.
Cool 5 minutes in muffin pan; remove to wire cooling rack.
Makes 1 dozen muffins.
recipes.text: Cranberry Surprise Corn Muffins. Heat oven to 425°. Grease 12 medium muffin cups. Combine cornmeal, flour, sugar, baking powder and salt. Combine milk, egg and oil; add to dry ingredients, mixing just until dry ingredients are moistened. Fill prepared muffin cups 2/3 full. Place 1 1/2 teaspoons of relish in center of each muffin cup. With tip of spoon, press lightly into batter. Bake for 15 to 20 minutes. Cool 5 minutes in muffin pan; remove to wire cooling rack. Makes 1 dozen muffins.

recipes.title: 7-Up Salad
directions: Dissolve jello and sugar in boiling water.
Let chill.
Beat cream cheese, vanilla and 7-Up.
Beat all together until creamy, then add to jello mixture with small can of crushed pineapple and nuts.
Chill.
recipes.text: 7-Up Salad. Dissolve jello and sugar in boiling water. Let chill. Beat cream cheese, vanilla and 7-Up. Beat all together until creamy, then add to jello mixture with small can of crushed pineapple and nuts. Chill.

recipes.title: Cold Lemon Souffle
directions: Sprinkle gelatin over cold water to soften.
Mix egg yolks with lemon juice, rind and 3/4 cup of the sugar.
Place in double boiler over boiling water and cook, stirring constantly, until lemon mixture is slightly thickened (about 8 minutes).
Remove from heat and stir in gelatin until dissolved.
Chill 30 to 40 minutes.
Beat egg whites until they begin to hold their shape, then gradually hold their shape, then add 3/4 cup sugar until all has been added and whites are stiff.
Beat cream until stiff; fold whites and cream into yolk mixture.
Pour into a 2-quart souffle dish and chill 4 hours or more.
Whipped cream may be put on top.
recipes.text: Cold Lemon Souffle. Sprinkle gelatin over cold water to soften. Mix egg yolks with lemon juice, rind and 3/4 cup of the sugar. Place in double boiler over boiling water and cook, stirring constantly, until lemon mixture is slightly thickened (about 8 minutes). Remove from heat and stir in gelatin until dissolved. Chill 30 to 40 minutes. Beat egg whites until they begin to hold their shape, then gradually hold their shape, then add 3/4 cup sugar until all has been added and whites are stiff. Beat cream until stiff; fold whites and cream into yolk mixture. Pour into a 2-quart souffle dish and chill 4 hours or more. Whipped cream may be put on top.

recipes.title: Puppy Chow
directions: In a saucepan, melt chocolate bits, peanut butter and butter. Pour mixture over Rice Chex and stir so that all the cereal is covered.
Put one cup of confectioners sugar in a paper bag and put in the cereal mixture.
Top with the other cup of sugar and shake the bag to thoroughly coat the cereal.
Serve in a dog dish.
recipes.text: Puppy Chow. In a saucepan, melt chocolate bits, peanut butter and butter. Pour mixture over Rice Chex and stir so that all the cereal is covered. Put one cup of confectioners sugar in a paper bag and put in the cereal mixture. Top with the other cup of sugar and shake the bag to thoroughly coat the cereal. Serve in a dog dish.

recipes.title: Crazy Crust Pizza
ingredients: 1 cup of your favorite cheese, shredded
directions: Chop one medium-size onion and brown in small amount of olive oil
Drain onions and remove from skillet.
Brown 1 1/2 pounds hamburger, drain and set aside.
Mix together 1 cup flour, 1 tsp. salt, 1 tsp. oregano, 1/8 tsp. pepper, 1/4 tsp. basil,
1/4 tsp. garlic powder, 2 eggs and 2/3 cup milk. Pour mixture into greased and floured pizza pan.
Spread hamburger and onions over batter. Spread one jar pizza sauce over hamburger mixture; add mushroom pieces if desired.
Bake at 425 degrees for 30-40 minutes.
Add cheese the last 5 minutes of baking.
6 servings.
recipes.text: Crazy Crust Pizza. Chop one medium-size onion and brown in small amount of olive oil Drain onions and remove from skillet. Brown 1 1/2 pounds hamburger, drain and set aside. Mix together 1 cup flour, 1 tsp. salt, 1 tsp. oregano, 1/8 tsp. pepper, 1/4 tsp. basil, 1/4 tsp. garlic powder, 2 eggs and 2/3 cup milk. Pour mixture into greased and floured pizza pan. Spread hamburger and onions over batter. Spread one jar pizza sauce over hamburger mixture; add mushroom pieces if desired. Bake at 425 degrees for 30-40 minutes. Add cheese the last 5 minutes of baking. 6 servings.

recipes.title: Pizza Burger Pie
directions: Mix flour, sugar, yeast and salt.
Heat sour cream, water and shortening until warm.
Add beaten egg; stir in until smooth. Spread batter into 10-inch greased pie pan.
Mix beef, salt, pepper, onion, Italian seasoning and tomato paste; spoon onto batter.
Sprinkle with Mozzarella; add mushrooms.
Bake 30 to 35 minutes at 350°.
Cut into wedges.
recipes.text: Pizza Burger Pie. Mix flour, sugar, yeast and salt. Heat sour cream, water and shortening until warm. Add beaten egg; stir in until smooth. Spread batter into 10-inch greased pie pan. Mix beef, salt, pepper, onion, Italian seasoning and tomato paste; spoon onto batter. Sprinkle with Mozzarella; add mushrooms. Bake 30 to 35 minutes at 350°. Cut into wedges.

recipes.title: Chicken Enchilada
directions: Saute onion in butter.
Combine with soups, broth and chiles. Add chicken and beat well.
recipes.text: Chicken Enchilada. Saute onion in butter. Combine with soups, broth and chiles. Add chicken and beat well.

recipes.title: Eggs A'La Texas
ingredients: pinch each of: cinnamon, cayenne, onion salt, oregano
directions: Chop beef very fine.
Melt butter.
Add all ingredients, except eggs.
Heat and then add eggs.
Cook like scrambled eggs. Serves 4.
recipes.text: Eggs A'La Texas. Chop beef very fine. Melt butter. Add all ingredients, except eggs. Heat and then add eggs. Cook like scrambled eggs. Serves 4.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Custard Pie
directions: Mix in order listed and pour into unbaked pie shell.
Bake in 350° to 400° oven for about 25 minutes.
I bake longer, more like an hour.
recipes.text: Pumpkin Custard Pie. Mix in order listed and pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake in 350° to 400° oven for about 25 minutes. I bake longer, more like an hour.

recipes.title: Beef Stew
ingredients: 2 1/2 to 3 lb. chuck roast, cut in 1 1/2-inch cubes (trim fat)
directions: Heat oil in heavy kettle.
Saute garlic and onions until golden.
Remove.
Mix flour, salt and pepper.
Dredge meat in mixture and brown well in the same oil, adding more if needed. Return onion to pot.
Add carrots, dill weed, wine and consomme. Cover tightly and simmer about 1 1/2 hours or until tender.
Melt butter.
Add mushrooms and saute 5 minutes.
Add to meat.
Mix gently and pour into large baking pan.
Crown with biscuits and bake 15 to 20 minutes at 400° for 5 minutes.
Before done, brush with butter and sprinkle with cheese.
recipes.text: Beef Stew. Heat oil in heavy kettle. Saute garlic and onions until golden. Remove. Mix flour, salt and pepper. Dredge meat in mixture and brown well in the same oil, adding more if needed. Return onion to pot. Add carrots, dill weed, wine and consomme. Cover tightly and simmer about 1 1/2 hours or until tender. Melt butter. Add mushrooms and saute 5 minutes. Add to meat. Mix gently and pour into large baking pan. Crown with biscuits and bake 15 to 20 minutes at 400° for 5 minutes. Before done, brush with butter and sprinkle with cheese.

recipes.title: Dumplings
directions: Mix ingredients quickly.
Drop on boiling stew.
Cook covered for 12 minutes.
recipes.text: Dumplings. Mix ingredients quickly. Drop on boiling stew. Cook covered for 12 minutes.

recipes.title: Spearmint Tea
ingredients: 2 C. packed fresh or 2/3 c. dried spearmint leaves
1 qt. boiling water plus 3 qts. cold water
directions: Add spearmint leaves to 1 qt. boiling water.
Let steep 15-20 minutes. Strain.
Add the 3 qts. cold water and sweeten to taste. Serve over ice.
Makes 1 gallon.
recipes.text: Spearmint Tea. Add spearmint leaves to 1 qt. boiling water. Let steep 15-20 minutes. Strain. Add the 3 qts. cold water and sweeten to taste. Serve over ice. Makes 1 gallon.

recipes.title: Cheese Ring
directions: Mix all ingredients, except strawberry preserves.
Mold into desired shape (with hands).
I mold into a ring.
Place into refrigerator until chilled.
When ready to serve, fill center with strawberry preserves.
Serve with biscuit type crackers.
recipes.text: Cheese Ring. Mix all ingredients, except strawberry preserves. Mold into desired shape (with hands). I mold into a ring. Place into refrigerator until chilled. When ready to serve, fill center with strawberry preserves. Serve with biscuit type crackers.

recipes.title: Strever Oyster Dressing
ingredients: 1 pt. oysters, cut away white, hard piece attached to oyster
directions: Break up crackers.
Cut up oysters.
Use oyster juice, too. Combine together.
Grease casserole dish with Pam cooking spray. Add milk to cracker/oyster mixture.
Add small amounts of milk if more is needed.
Not mushy, not soggy, just damp.
Combine gently. Place in casserole.
Bake at 350° for 1/2 hour.
recipes.text: Strever Oyster Dressing. Break up crackers. Cut up oysters. Use oyster juice, too. Combine together. Grease casserole dish with Pam cooking spray. Add milk to cracker/oyster mixture. Add small amounts of milk if more is needed. Not mushy, not soggy, just damp. Combine gently. Place in casserole. Bake at 350° for 1/2 hour.

recipes.title: Burritos
ingredients: 2 c. dry pinto beans, soaked and cooked
directions: Add 1/2 teaspoon garlic salt to mashed beans, 1/2 teaspoon salt and 1 tablespoon dry onions.
Cook hamburger and add taco seasonings.
Mix beans, meat and shredded cheese.
Butter 1 side of tortillas; fill with 1 to 2 tablespoons filling.
Roll up and place margarine side out in 2 (9 x 13-inch) pans.
Bake at 500° for 7 to 8 minutes.
Roll in plastic wrap and freeze.
Microwave for 2 minutes.
recipes.text: Burritos. Add 1/2 teaspoon garlic salt to mashed beans, 1/2 teaspoon salt and 1 tablespoon dry onions. Cook hamburger and add taco seasonings. Mix beans, meat and shredded cheese. Butter 1 side of tortillas; fill with 1 to 2 tablespoons filling. Roll up and place margarine side out in 2 (9 x 13-inch) pans. Bake at 500° for 7 to 8 minutes. Roll in plastic wrap and freeze. Microwave for 2 minutes.

recipes.title: Dirty Rice
directions: Lightly brown sausage in large frying pan.
Chop vegetables and add to sausage.
Add 1/2 teaspoon salt and stir until vegetables are tender, approximately 15 minutes.
recipes.text: Dirty Rice. Lightly brown sausage in large frying pan. Chop vegetables and add to sausage. Add 1/2 teaspoon salt and stir until vegetables are tender, approximately 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Cookie Crackers
directions: Grease a cookie sheet with butter.
Line cookie sheet with crackers.
In a saucepan, melt 2 sticks butter and brown sugar. Pour over crackers.
Bake at 450° for 3 minutes.
Cool.
Melt chocolate chips and spread over cooled crackers.
Sprinkle with nuts.
Never refrigerate!
recipes.text: Cookie Crackers. Grease a cookie sheet with butter. Line cookie sheet with crackers. In a saucepan, melt 2 sticks butter and brown sugar. Pour over crackers. Bake at 450° for 3 minutes. Cool. Melt chocolate chips and spread over cooled crackers. Sprinkle with nuts. Never refrigerate!

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Fudge
directions: Melt almond bark in Dutch oven in oven at 250° until soft. Add peanut butter, vanilla and Rice Krispies.
Put in buttered dish until firm.
recipes.text: Peanut Butter Fudge. Melt almond bark in Dutch oven in oven at 250° until soft. Add peanut butter, vanilla and Rice Krispies. Put in buttered dish until firm.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Squares
directions: Combine crumbs, oleo, peanut butter and sugar. Work together until smooth with hands. Press mixture into a 12 x 18-inch buttered pan. Melt chocolate chips over hot water.
Spread firm. Set out to room temperature before cutting into squares.
recipes.text: Peanut Butter Squares. Combine crumbs, oleo, peanut butter and sugar. Work together until smooth with hands. Press mixture into a 12 x 18-inch buttered pan. Melt chocolate chips over hot water. Spread firm. Set out to room temperature before cutting into squares.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Balls
directions: Mix
and form into bite-size balls.
Then dip in chocolate mixture, 1 large package (12 ounces) chocolate chips and 1/2 stick paraffin melted together in a saucepan.
recipes.text: Peanut Butter Balls. Mix and form into bite-size balls. Then dip in chocolate mixture, 1 large package (12 ounces) chocolate chips and 1/2 stick paraffin melted together in a saucepan.

recipes.title: Cathedral Cookies
directions: Melt chocolate chips with butter and allow to cool.
Add marshmallows and nuts.
Mix well and place on waxed paper sprinkled with powdered sugar.
Form into roll and chill well. Slice into thin slices.
Looks very pretty and are good.
recipes.text: Cathedral Cookies. Melt chocolate chips with butter and allow to cool. Add marshmallows and nuts. Mix well and place on waxed paper sprinkled with powdered sugar. Form into roll and chill well. Slice into thin slices. Looks very pretty and are good.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Fudge
ingredients: 1 (14 oz.) can Eagle Brand sweetened condensed milk
directions: Mix first 2 ingredients.
Put in microwave until smooth.
Add nuts and vanilla; spread on buttered plate.
recipes.text: Peanut Butter Fudge. Mix first 2 ingredients. Put in microwave until smooth. Add nuts and vanilla; spread on buttered plate.

recipes.title: Hamburger Soup
ingredients: potatoes (the amount you desire), cut small
directions: Use large pot.
Fill 1/2 full with water.
Put ground meat in water and start cooking.
Add all remaining items; bring to a boil.
Turn down heat.
Continue cooking real slow for approximately 1 hour.
recipes.text: Hamburger Soup. Use large pot. Fill 1/2 full with water. Put ground meat in water and start cooking. Add all remaining items; bring to a boil. Turn down heat. Continue cooking real slow for approximately 1 hour.

recipes.title: Squash Casserole
ingredients: 1 pkg. Pepperidge Farm bread crumbs, divided
directions: Combine ingredients, using only 1/2 package of bread crumbs. Top with remaining crumbs and bake at 350° for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Squash Casserole. Combine ingredients, using only 1/2 package of bread crumbs. Top with remaining crumbs and bake at 350° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Party Puffs
directions: Preheat oven to 425°.
Cut each biscuit into 4 pieces.
Melt oleo in saucepan.
Over very low heat, stir in onion soup mix and pieces of biscuits.
Toss gently.
Place biscuits on a cookie sheet lined with brown paper and bake 5 minutes.
Serve hot. Serves 40.
recipes.text: Party Puffs. Preheat oven to 425°. Cut each biscuit into 4 pieces. Melt oleo in saucepan. Over very low heat, stir in onion soup mix and pieces of biscuits. Toss gently. Place biscuits on a cookie sheet lined with brown paper and bake 5 minutes. Serve hot. Serves 40.

recipes.title: Pork Fried Rice
ingredients: 3 pork loin chops, cut into small pieces
1 lb. white rice, cook day before and refrigerate
directions: In Dutch oven, cook pork chops in oil and 1/4 cup soy sauce. Remove and set aside.
Fry rice in remaining liquid.
Add more soy sauce slowly until light brown in color.
Put pork on top of rice and set aside.
Put more soy sauce in deep pan and saute coleslaw and onion powder.
Scramble eggs loosely.
Remove and chop.
Mix all together.
Serve with duck sauce and sweet and sour sauce.
Recipe may be doubled, except for eggs.
recipes.text: Pork Fried Rice. In Dutch oven, cook pork chops in oil and 1/4 cup soy sauce. Remove and set aside. Fry rice in remaining liquid. Add more soy sauce slowly until light brown in color. Put pork on top of rice and set aside. Put more soy sauce in deep pan and saute coleslaw and onion powder. Scramble eggs loosely. Remove and chop. Mix all together. Serve with duck sauce and sweet and sour sauce. Recipe may be doubled, except for eggs.

recipes.title: Rice Casserole
ingredients: 1 large bottle Green Giant sliced mushrooms
1 (16 oz.) box Uncle Ben's converted rice
directions: Mix all ingredients together; chip butter on top.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
Use Pyrex dish with lid on top (or Corning Ware).
recipes.text: Rice Casserole. Mix all ingredients together; chip butter on top. Bake at 350° for 1 hour. Use Pyrex dish with lid on top (or Corning Ware).

recipes.title: Lemon Poppy Seed Bread Or Cake
directions: Put ingredients in bowl as given.
Mix for 4 minutes.
Place in 3 small bread pans or 1 cake pan.
Bake at 325° to 350° for 35 minutes.
recipes.text: Lemon Poppy Seed Bread Or Cake. Put ingredients in bowl as given. Mix for 4 minutes. Place in 3 small bread pans or 1 cake pan. Bake at 325° to 350° for 35 minutes.

recipes.title: Broccoli And Cheese Muffins
directions: Mix all ingredients well and spoon into muffin tin which has been sprayed with Baker's Joy.
Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes or until done.
recipes.text: Broccoli And Cheese Muffins. Mix all ingredients well and spoon into muffin tin which has been sprayed with Baker's Joy. Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes or until done.

recipes.title: Vegetable Dip
directions: Mix together and chill.
Use as a dip for raw vegetables.
recipes.text: Vegetable Dip. Mix together and chill. Use as a dip for raw vegetables.

recipes.title: Southern Pecan Pie
directions: Cream butter and sugar together until fluffy.
Add the next four ingredients.
Sprinkle pecans on bottom of pie shell; pour filling over pecans.
Bake at 450° for 10 minutes.
Reduce temperature to 350°.
Bake for 35 minutes longer.
recipes.text: Southern Pecan Pie. Cream butter and sugar together until fluffy. Add the next four ingredients. Sprinkle pecans on bottom of pie shell; pour filling over pecans. Bake at 450° for 10 minutes. Reduce temperature to 350°. Bake for 35 minutes longer.

recipes.title: Barbecued Pork Chops
directions: Mix all but chops; simmer for 15 minutes.
Pour over chops; refrigerate for several hours.
Baste and barbecue.
Bake in oven for 35 to 40 minutes at 350°.
recipes.text: Barbecued Pork Chops. Mix all but chops; simmer for 15 minutes. Pour over chops; refrigerate for several hours. Baste and barbecue. Bake in oven for 35 to 40 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Apple Fiber Oatmeal Cookies
directions: It's so delicious and awful (wait until you read the ingredients!).
Thank goodness we were biking our way through the San Juan Islands when we found this recipe for a local delicacy at the tourist office in Nanaimo on Vancouver Island.
recipes.text: Apple Fiber Oatmeal Cookies. It's so delicious and awful (wait until you read the ingredients!). Thank goodness we were biking our way through the San Juan Islands when we found this recipe for a local delicacy at the tourist office in Nanaimo on Vancouver Island.

recipes.title: Mushroom Sandwich Filling
directions: Saute mushrooms in butter or margarine.
Add Worcestershire sauce while cooking.
Add heavy cream and salt to taste.
Thicken mixture with flour, adding additional flour, if needed. Refrigerate.
This filling is best made the day before using.
recipes.text: Mushroom Sandwich Filling. Saute mushrooms in butter or margarine. Add Worcestershire sauce while cooking. Add heavy cream and salt to taste. Thicken mixture with flour, adding additional flour, if needed. Refrigerate. This filling is best made the day before using.

recipes.title: Summer Squash Casserole
directions: Cook squash and onions until slightly tender; drain.
In casserole dish, alternate squash and cheese.
Cover with cracker crumbs.
Sprinkle melted butter over crumbs.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until golden and squash is bubbly.
Serves 4 to 6 people.
recipes.text: Summer Squash Casserole. Cook squash and onions until slightly tender; drain. In casserole dish, alternate squash and cheese. Cover with cracker crumbs. Sprinkle melted butter over crumbs. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until golden and squash is bubbly. Serves 4 to 6 people.

recipes.title: Cinnamon Coffee Cake
directions: Cream sugar, butter and egg; add dry ingredients and milk. Divide into 2 ungreased 9-inch pans.
On top, spread 3/4 pound dark brown sugar.
Sprinkle generously with cinnamon.
Dot closely with 1/4 pound butter, bake 25 minutes at 350°.
recipes.text: Cinnamon Coffee Cake. Cream sugar, butter and egg; add dry ingredients and milk. Divide into 2 ungreased 9-inch pans. On top, spread 3/4 pound dark brown sugar. Sprinkle generously with cinnamon. Dot closely with 1/4 pound butter, bake 25 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Fluffy Green Tea-Mandarin Mold
directions: Drain juice from mandarins and grapes.
Reserve juices; refrigerate fruits.
Combine juices with water to make 2 1/2 cups; bring to boil.
Pour over gelatin; stir until dissolved.
Add lemon rind and tea bags.
Steep 5 minutes.
Press liquid from tea bags. Add lemon juice.
Tint with green food coloring (if desired). Refrigerate gelatin mixture until syrupy.
Beat until light and foamy.
recipes.text: Fluffy Green Tea-Mandarin Mold. Drain juice from mandarins and grapes. Reserve juices; refrigerate fruits. Combine juices with water to make 2 1/2 cups; bring to boil. Pour over gelatin; stir until dissolved. Add lemon rind and tea bags. Steep 5 minutes. Press liquid from tea bags. Add lemon juice. Tint with green food coloring (if desired). Refrigerate gelatin mixture until syrupy. Beat until light and foamy.

recipes.title: Pan De Elote
directions: Mix corn, bisquick, sugar, milk and butter.
Stir to remove lumps.
Pour 1/2 batter into a greased 8 x 8 pan.
Top with green chiles and lay cheese slices on top.
Pour rest of batter over all.
Bake at 375 degrees for 30 minutes or until top is brown.
recipes.text: Pan De Elote. Mix corn, bisquick, sugar, milk and butter. Stir to remove lumps. Pour 1/2 batter into a greased 8 x 8 pan. Top with green chiles and lay cheese slices on top. Pour rest of batter over all. Bake at 375 degrees for 30 minutes or until top is brown.

recipes.title: Dump Cake
ingredients: 1 pkg. yellow or white cake mix
directions: Dump all ingredients in order as listed above into an 8 x 12-inch ungreased baking pan.
Bake at 325° for 1 hour.
Do not mix at any time; just dump in layers.
recipes.text: Dump Cake. Dump all ingredients in order as listed above into an 8 x 12-inch ungreased baking pan. Bake at 325° for 1 hour. Do not mix at any time; just dump in layers.

recipes.title: Lemon Icebox Pie
directions: Stir lemonade mix and milk together.
Add Cool Whip and stir until smooth.
Pour into graham cracker crusts and refrigerate for at least one hour.
recipes.text: Lemon Icebox Pie. Stir lemonade mix and milk together. Add Cool Whip and stir until smooth. Pour into graham cracker crusts and refrigerate for at least one hour.

recipes.title: Orange Banana Shake
directions: Blend all ingredients except fruit slices until smooth and pour into chilled glasses.
Decorate with orange and lime slices.
recipes.text: Orange Banana Shake. Blend all ingredients except fruit slices until smooth and pour into chilled glasses. Decorate with orange and lime slices.

recipes.title: Cucumber Dip
directions: Mash cream cheese with fork and add mayonnaise to make an easy consistency.
Add spices.
Remove peeling and seeds from cucumber and chop fine.
Add to cheese mixture.
Good for a spread on bread cut in rounds (served open-faced) or stuffed in cherry tomatoes. Sprinkle bread rounds or tomatoes with paprika.
Makes about 36 rounds of bread or 36 cherry tomatoes.
Scoop out pulp of cherry tomatoes and drain cherry tomatoes if used for stuffing.
recipes.text: Cucumber Dip. Mash cream cheese with fork and add mayonnaise to make an easy consistency. Add spices. Remove peeling and seeds from cucumber and chop fine. Add to cheese mixture. Good for a spread on bread cut in rounds (served open-faced) or stuffed in cherry tomatoes. Sprinkle bread rounds or tomatoes with paprika. Makes about 36 rounds of bread or 36 cherry tomatoes. Scoop out pulp of cherry tomatoes and drain cherry tomatoes if used for stuffing.

recipes.title: Pink Punch
directions: Mix Kool-Aid, sugar and water.
Add Hi-C and pineapple juice. Freeze.
recipes.text: Pink Punch. Mix Kool-Aid, sugar and water. Add Hi-C and pineapple juice. Freeze.

recipes.title: Nacho Dip
ingredients: 2 medium Velveeta (1 regular and 1 medium jalapeno)
1 small jar chunky salsa, mild or medium
directions: Cube Velveeta and put in crock-pot with slab (approximately 2 tablespoons) butter and let melt.
Add small jar of chunky salsa, mild or medium, thin with milk.
recipes.text: Nacho Dip. Cube Velveeta and put in crock-pot with slab (approximately 2 tablespoons) butter and let melt. Add small jar of chunky salsa, mild or medium, thin with milk.

recipes.title: Apple Tarts
ingredients: 1 can or more canned biscuits (depends on how many tarts you want to make)
directions: Roll biscuits out thin.
Add 1 tablespoon of applesauce in middle of dough.
Fold dough over and crimp edges with a fork. Fry with butter in pan on top of stove.
recipes.text: Apple Tarts. Roll biscuits out thin. Add 1 tablespoon of applesauce in middle of dough. Fold dough over and crimp edges with a fork. Fry with butter in pan on top of stove.

recipes.title: Turkey In A Sack
directions: Dissolve salt and paprika in water and mix with oil.
Rub turkey inside and out with mixture.
Take remaining mixture and pour into large brown paper grocery sack.
Use additional oil if necessary to cover entire inside of sack.
Place turkey into sack.
Fold open end tightly closed; staple.
Cook at 350° allowing 10 minutes per pound of turkey.
The turkey will be a nice golden brown and not dry and completely done if cooked as directed.
recipes.text: Turkey In A Sack. Dissolve salt and paprika in water and mix with oil. Rub turkey inside and out with mixture. Take remaining mixture and pour into large brown paper grocery sack. Use additional oil if necessary to cover entire inside of sack. Place turkey into sack. Fold open end tightly closed; staple. Cook at 350° allowing 10 minutes per pound of turkey. The turkey will be a nice golden brown and not dry and completely done if cooked as directed.

recipes.title: Country Casserole
directions: Place potatoes and carrots in casserole dish.
Brown ground beef, onion and bell pepper.
Pour over potatoes and carrots.
On top of meat, mix and pour 1 can tomato sauce.
Bake for 1 hour. First 30 minutes, bake with lid on and last 30 minutes take lid off.
recipes.text: Country Casserole. Place potatoes and carrots in casserole dish. Brown ground beef, onion and bell pepper. Pour over potatoes and carrots. On top of meat, mix and pour 1 can tomato sauce. Bake for 1 hour. First 30 minutes, bake with lid on and last 30 minutes take lid off.

recipes.title: Spanish Casserole
directions: Brown first 3 ingredients and drain excess grease.
Add the remaining ingredients, mixing well.
Line bottom of casserole dish with tortilla chips.
Add a layer of the mixture.
Alternate layers of tortilla chips with layers of mixture, but have a layer of tortilla chips on top.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
Sprinkle with grated cheese and continue cooking until cheese melts.
recipes.text: Spanish Casserole. Brown first 3 ingredients and drain excess grease. Add the remaining ingredients, mixing well. Line bottom of casserole dish with tortilla chips. Add a layer of the mixture. Alternate layers of tortilla chips with layers of mixture, but have a layer of tortilla chips on top. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes. Sprinkle with grated cheese and continue cooking until cheese melts.

recipes.title: Grape Salad
ingredients: chopped up red grapes to taste
directions: Mix all together.
If not red, add red food coloring.
recipes.text: Grape Salad. Mix all together. If not red, add red food coloring.

recipes.title: Mashed Potato Casserole
directions: Cook potatoes, drain and mash.	Beat cheese until smooth. Add potatoes and other ingredients except paprika. Slowly add sour cream (quit early if soupy). Spoon into lightly buttered casserole dish.
recipes.text: Mashed Potato Casserole. Cook potatoes, drain and mash.	Beat cheese until smooth. Add potatoes and other ingredients except paprika. Slowly add sour cream (quit early if soupy). Spoon into lightly buttered casserole dish.

recipes.title: Hot Fudge Pie
directions: Melt butter and mix with other ingredients.
Pour into unbaked pie crust.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
Top with Cool Whip or vanilla ice cream.
recipes.text: Hot Fudge Pie. Melt butter and mix with other ingredients. Pour into unbaked pie crust. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes. Top with Cool Whip or vanilla ice cream.

recipes.title: Rolled Sugar Cookies
directions: Sift together 1 1/2 cups flour, baking powder and salt.
Cream butter; add sugar gradually and cream until light and fluffy.
Add egg, vanilla and milk.
Add sifted dry ingredients, then gradually add remaining flour until dough is stiff enough to handle.
Chill at least 1 hour.
Roll 1/8-inch thick on lightly floured board and shape with floured cookie cutters.
Place on ungreased cookie sheets.
Sprinkle with plain or tinted sugar.
Bake at 375° for 8 to 10 minutes.
recipes.text: Rolled Sugar Cookies. Sift together 1 1/2 cups flour, baking powder and salt. Cream butter; add sugar gradually and cream until light and fluffy. Add egg, vanilla and milk. Add sifted dry ingredients, then gradually add remaining flour until dough is stiff enough to handle. Chill at least 1 hour. Roll 1/8-inch thick on lightly floured board and shape with floured cookie cutters. Place on ungreased cookie sheets. Sprinkle with plain or tinted sugar. Bake at 375° for 8 to 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Lamagna'S Cassata
ingredients: 1 fresh or frozen pound cake (9 x 13-inch)
3 Tbsp. chopped citron or mixed candy fruit (optional)
4 oz. semi-sweet chocolate chips (or coarsely chopped semi-sweet chocolate)
directions: With serrated knife, slice crust off pound cake on all sides, then slice cake lengthwise into 1/4-inch slice, rectangular.
recipes.text: Lamagna'S Cassata. With serrated knife, slice crust off pound cake on all sides, then slice cake lengthwise into 1/4-inch slice, rectangular.

recipes.title: Chicken Noodle Casserole
directions: Cook and cube chicken.
Reserve 1 cup of broth.
Melt butter; add onion and celery.
Saute until tender.
Add soup, chicken and 1 cup of broth.
Stir and simmer.
Add salt and pepper to taste. Cook noodles until they're almost soft and drain.
Add soup mixture and stir.
Put in casserole dish and bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Chicken Noodle Casserole. Cook and cube chicken. Reserve 1 cup of broth. Melt butter; add onion and celery. Saute until tender. Add soup, chicken and 1 cup of broth. Stir and simmer. Add salt and pepper to taste. Cook noodles until they're almost soft and drain. Add soup mixture and stir. Put in casserole dish and bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: German Chocolate Cake(Easy)
directions: Flour and grease 9 x 13-inch pan.
Spread coconut and pecans on bottom.
Mix cake batter according to directions and pour over nut mixture.
Mix together cream cheese, powdered sugar and vanilla. Spread over cake mix.
Bake at 325° for 40 to 45 minutes.
recipes.text: German Chocolate Cake(Easy). Flour and grease 9 x 13-inch pan. Spread coconut and pecans on bottom. Mix cake batter according to directions and pour over nut mixture. Mix together cream cheese, powdered sugar and vanilla. Spread over cake mix. Bake at 325° for 40 to 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Glorified Cabbage
directions: Cut cabbage coarse and boil in salted water for 8 minutes; drain.
Melt butter in saucepan.
Add flour and blend. Gradually add milk and stir in cheese.
Stir until thick and smooth.
Spray casserole with Pam.
Alternate cabbage and sauce in casserole.
Top with croutons and bake for 30 minutes in 350° oven.
recipes.text: Glorified Cabbage. Cut cabbage coarse and boil in salted water for 8 minutes; drain. Melt butter in saucepan. Add flour and blend. Gradually add milk and stir in cheese. Stir until thick and smooth. Spray casserole with Pam. Alternate cabbage and sauce in casserole. Top with croutons and bake for 30 minutes in 350° oven.

recipes.title: Turkey Rice Casserole
ingredients: 2 turkey legs or 1 leg and 1 wing
directions: Roast turkey.
Cool, bone and cut into small bite size pieces. To turkey broth add garlic salt, seasoned pepper, thyme, onion, spinach, turkey meat and rice.
Add enough water to a little more than cover rice.
Cook until rice is just done (10 to 20 minutes). Add soup, mix well.
Put grated cheese on top.
recipes.text: Turkey Rice Casserole. Roast turkey. Cool, bone and cut into small bite size pieces. To turkey broth add garlic salt, seasoned pepper, thyme, onion, spinach, turkey meat and rice. Add enough water to a little more than cover rice. Cook until rice is just done (10 to 20 minutes). Add soup, mix well. Put grated cheese on top.

recipes.title: Waldorf Salad
ingredients: 4 c. apples, chopped in finger size chunks
1 1/2 c. celery, chopped in small size
1/2 c. pecans, broken in small chunks
directions: Sprinkle with Fruit Fresh to maintain color and apples won't turn brown.
mix well.
recipes.text: Waldorf Salad. Sprinkle with Fruit Fresh to maintain color and apples won't turn brown. mix well.

recipes.title: Browned Chicken And Dumplings
directions: In large pot, place hen and cover with water and seasonings (salt and pepper to taste).
Boil for approximately 1 hour or until tender.
Remove meat from pot, cool and debone chicken.
Skim fat from chicken broth; set aside.
Should have enough broth for 1 1/2 cups; if not, add hot water andl.
Add flour, salt and fat from chicken broth and enough broth to have dough consistency of pie dough.
Roll out on floured board about as thin as pie crust; cut in strips and let dry out while making gravy for dumplings.
recipes.text: Browned Chicken And Dumplings. In large pot, place hen and cover with water and seasonings (salt and pepper to taste). Boil for approximately 1 hour or until tender. Remove meat from pot, cool and debone chicken. Skim fat from chicken broth; set aside. Should have enough broth for 1 1/2 cups; if not, add hot water andl. Add flour, salt and fat from chicken broth and enough broth to have dough consistency of pie dough. Roll out on floured board about as thin as pie crust; cut in strips and let dry out while making gravy for dumplings.

recipes.title: Dilly Casserole Bread
ingredients: 1 c. large curd creamed cottage cheese
directions: Sprinkle yeast over warm water; stir to dissolve.
Heat cottage cheese until warm.
Combine in mixing bowl the sugar, onion, butter, dill seed, salt, baking soda, egg and yeast.
Add flour, a little at a time, to make a stiff batter, beating well after each addition.
Cover and let rise in warm place until doubled (50 to 60 minutes).
Stir down with 25 vigorous strokes.
recipes.text: Dilly Casserole Bread. Sprinkle yeast over warm water; stir to dissolve. Heat cottage cheese until warm. Combine in mixing bowl the sugar, onion, butter, dill seed, salt, baking soda, egg and yeast. Add flour, a little at a time, to make a stiff batter, beating well after each addition. Cover and let rise in warm place until doubled (50 to 60 minutes). Stir down with 25 vigorous strokes.

recipes.title: Chocolate Mini-Mousse
directions: Combine 1/3 cup skim milk and gelatin in blender container and wait one minute before adding water.
Blend until gelatin is dissolved.
Add remaining milk, sugar, cocoa and vanilla; blend. Add ice milk and blend until smooth and creamy.
Spoon into dessert cups.
Chill until set.
Contains 70 calories per 4 ounce serving. Yields 8 servings.
recipes.text: Chocolate Mini-Mousse. Combine 1/3 cup skim milk and gelatin in blender container and wait one minute before adding water. Blend until gelatin is dissolved. Add remaining milk, sugar, cocoa and vanilla; blend. Add ice milk and blend until smooth and creamy. Spoon into dessert cups. Chill until set. Contains 70 calories per 4 ounce serving. Yields 8 servings.

recipes.title: Orange Tapioca Salad
ingredients: 1 - 8 oz. container frozen whipped topping, thawed
directions: In a saucepan, bring water to a boil. Whisk in gelatin and pudding mixes. Return to a boil, stirring constantly. Boil for 1 minute. Remove from heat and cool completely. Fold in oranges, pineapple and whipped topping. Spoon into a serving bowl. Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours. Serves 12-14.
recipes.text: Orange Tapioca Salad. In a saucepan, bring water to a boil. Whisk in gelatin and pudding mixes. Return to a boil, stirring constantly. Boil for 1 minute. Remove from heat and cool completely. Fold in oranges, pineapple and whipped topping. Spoon into a serving bowl. Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours. Serves 12-14.

recipes.title: Chicken Divan
directions: Cook broccoli 2 minutes less than package directions.
Drain and place in a shallow baking dish.
Mix the cornstarch with a small amount of chicken broth in a saucepan at medium heat. Gradually add the remaining broth.
Cook about 5 minutes more. Stir in the milk and cheese.
Pour half the mixture over the broccoli.
