Then layer the chicken slices over the sauce.
Pour the remaining sauce over the chicken slices.
Bake at 475° for 10 minutes.
Serves 6.
recipes.text: Chicken Divan. Cook broccoli 2 minutes less than package directions. Drain and place in a shallow baking dish. Mix the cornstarch with a small amount of chicken broth in a saucepan at medium heat. Gradually add the remaining broth. Cook about 5 minutes more. Stir in the milk and cheese. Pour half the mixture over the broccoli. Then layer the chicken slices over the sauce. Pour the remaining sauce over the chicken slices. Bake at 475° for 10 minutes. Serves 6.

recipes.title: Cheese Strata
ingredients: 1 loaf white sliced bread, crust removed
directions: Make 1 layer of bread on bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Add a layer of cheese and another layer of bread. Top with layer of cheese.
Combine eggs, milk, minced onion, salt and dry mustard. Pour over cheese and bread and refrigerate at least 6 hours or overnight.
Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 55 minutes.
Let stand 10 minutes before cutting.
recipes.text: Cheese Strata. Make 1 layer of bread on bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan. Add a layer of cheese and another layer of bread. Top with layer of cheese. Combine eggs, milk, minced onion, salt and dry mustard. Pour over cheese and bread and refrigerate at least 6 hours or overnight. Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 55 minutes. Let stand 10 minutes before cutting.

recipes.title: Lunch Box Muffins
ingredients: 1 tsp. each soda and baking powder
directions: Mix all ingredients and bake at 400° for about 15 minutes.
recipes.text: Lunch Box Muffins. Mix all ingredients and bake at 400° for about 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Vinegar Pie
directions: Mix all ingredients well.
Simmer until thickened.
Pour into shell and bake until brown.
recipes.text: Vinegar Pie. Mix all ingredients well. Simmer until thickened. Pour into shell and bake until brown.

recipes.title: "Dr. Ziment'S Prescription Garlic Chicken Soup For Colds And
directions: Peel garlic cloves and place with other ingredients in a medium-size saucepan.
Heat to boiling, then reduce to simmer. Simmer for 30 minutes, breathing fumes during cooking.
If desired, strain soup, discarding solid ingredients, or puree it after removing bay leaf.
Divide the soup into 4 portions, each of which should be taken at the beginning of a meal, one to three times a day.
recipes.text: "Dr. Ziment'S Prescription Garlic Chicken Soup For Colds And. Peel garlic cloves and place with other ingredients in a medium-size saucepan. Heat to boiling, then reduce to simmer. Simmer for 30 minutes, breathing fumes during cooking. If desired, strain soup, discarding solid ingredients, or puree it after removing bay leaf. Divide the soup into 4 portions, each of which should be taken at the beginning of a meal, one to three times a day.

recipes.title: Pound Cake
directions: Mix together.
Bake at 300° for 1 hour and 40 minutes.
recipes.text: Pound Cake. Mix together. Bake at 300° for 1 hour and 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Cranberry Orange Scones
ingredients: 1/2 c. fresh, dried or thawed frozen cranberries
directions: Baking Temperature: 400°.
Baking Time: 20 to 25 minutes.
recipes.text: Cranberry Orange Scones. Baking Temperature: 400°. Baking Time: 20 to 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Buttermilk-Chive Biscuits
directions: In a medium mixing bowl, combine the flour, chives, baking powder, baking soda, salt and pepper.
Stir together the buttermilk and oil; pour into flour mixture.
Stir with a fork until combined.
Drop onto a greased baking sheet in 6 mounds. Bake in 450° oven for 8 to 10 minutes or until golden.
Serve warm.
Makes 6 biscuits, 95 calories and 0 mg cholesterol per biscuit.
recipes.text: Buttermilk-Chive Biscuits. In a medium mixing bowl, combine the flour, chives, baking powder, baking soda, salt and pepper. Stir together the buttermilk and oil; pour into flour mixture. Stir with a fork until combined. Drop onto a greased baking sheet in 6 mounds. Bake in 450° oven for 8 to 10 minutes or until golden. Serve warm. Makes 6 biscuits, 95 calories and 0 mg cholesterol per biscuit.

recipes.title: Chunky Chicken Chili
ingredients: 2 c. bite size cooked chicken breasts
2 c. bite size cooked chicken thigh
1 (16 oz.) can Great Northern beans, drained
1/2 c. plus 2 Tbsp. plain nonfat yogurt (optional)
directions: Coat Dutch oven with cooking spray; place over medium heat until hot.
Add onion, green pepper, jalapeno peppers and saute 5 minutes.

Add chili powder, cumin and oregano; cook 2 minutes. Add chicken, 1 cup water, red pepper, black pepper, Worcestershire sauce, mustard, stewed tomatoes, chicken broth, and chili sauce and bring to a boil.
Cover, reduce heat and simmer 20 minutes. Add beans and cook 5 minutes.
Ladle chili into soup bowls; top each with avocado, onion and yogurt.
Yield 9 cups.
recipes.text: Chunky Chicken Chili. Coat Dutch oven with cooking spray; place over medium heat until hot. Add onion, green pepper, jalapeno peppers and saute 5 minutes. Add chili powder, cumin and oregano; cook 2 minutes. Add chicken, 1 cup water, red pepper, black pepper, Worcestershire sauce, mustard, stewed tomatoes, chicken broth, and chili sauce and bring to a boil. Cover, reduce heat and simmer 20 minutes. Add beans and cook 5 minutes. Ladle chili into soup bowls; top each with avocado, onion and yogurt. Yield 9 cups.

recipes.title: Frozen Fruit Salad
directions: Cream cheese, mayonnaise and sugar in mixer.
Mix bananas with lemon juice.
Fold in fruit, nuts and marshmallows.
Stir in Cool Whip and freeze.
Serve frozen.
recipes.text: Frozen Fruit Salad. Cream cheese, mayonnaise and sugar in mixer. Mix bananas with lemon juice. Fold in fruit, nuts and marshmallows. Stir in Cool Whip and freeze. Serve frozen.

recipes.title: Susan'S No-Knead Rolls
directions: Mix together thoroughly and add 5 to 7 cups flour, enough so dough pulls away from bowl. Cover with damp cloth and let rise for 30 minutes in a warm place.
Spoon into greased muffin pans and let rise another 30 minutes. Bake at 400° for 20 minutes (until golden brown).
recipes.text: Susan'S No-Knead Rolls. Mix together thoroughly and add 5 to 7 cups flour, enough so dough pulls away from bowl. Cover with damp cloth and let rise for 30 minutes in a warm place. Spoon into greased muffin pans and let rise another 30 minutes. Bake at 400° for 20 minutes (until golden brown).

recipes.title: Harvard Beets
directions: Heat together beets and beet juice and water; mix together and stir in flour, sugar salt, pepper and vinegar.
Cook, stirring constantly until smoothly blended and thickened.
recipes.text: Harvard Beets. Heat together beets and beet juice and water; mix together and stir in flour, sugar salt, pepper and vinegar. Cook, stirring constantly until smoothly blended and thickened.

recipes.title: Kool-Aid Pie
directions: Chill evaporated milk.
Then beat with mixer until nearly doubled.
Add sugar and Kool-Aid.
Mix real well.
Pour into graham cracker crust.
Freeze until ready to serve.
recipes.text: Kool-Aid Pie. Chill evaporated milk. Then beat with mixer until nearly doubled. Add sugar and Kool-Aid. Mix real well. Pour into graham cracker crust. Freeze until ready to serve.

recipes.title: Sour Lima Bean Salad
directions: Drain the lima beans thoroughly.
Add onion rings and celery. Combine sour cream, vinegar, sugar, horseradish, salt and pepper, mixing well.
Toss gently with the beans.
Chill several hours or overnight.
Serve cold.
recipes.text: Sour Lima Bean Salad. Drain the lima beans thoroughly. Add onion rings and celery. Combine sour cream, vinegar, sugar, horseradish, salt and pepper, mixing well. Toss gently with the beans. Chill several hours or overnight. Serve cold.

recipes.title: Springerle(Traditional Anise Christmas Cookies)
ingredients: 1/2 c. mixed fruit peel, finely chopped (candied)
1 tsp. soda, dissolved in 1 Tbsp. milk
3/4 tsp. oil of anise (more if anise flavoring)
flour (up to 5 c., lease amount possible to roll)
directions: Need wooden pattern of springerle rolling pin or other mold (glass dish bottom).
recipes.text: Springerle(Traditional Anise Christmas Cookies). Need wooden pattern of springerle rolling pin or other mold (glass dish bottom).

recipes.title: Date Balls
directions: Mix together in saucepan the egg, sugar, dates and butter. Simmer on top of stove, approximately 10 minutes, stirring constantly.
Let cool one minute.
Add Rice Krispies.
Stir until thoroughly mixed.
Shape into balls.
Roll in chopped nuts.
recipes.text: Date Balls. Mix together in saucepan the egg, sugar, dates and butter. Simmer on top of stove, approximately 10 minutes, stirring constantly. Let cool one minute. Add Rice Krispies. Stir until thoroughly mixed. Shape into balls. Roll in chopped nuts.

recipes.title: Red Velvet Cake
directions: Cream shortening and sugar.
Add eggs and mix well.
Add red food coloring and vanilla.
Sift flour, salt, cocoa and baking soda.
Add the flour mixture to the sugar and egg mixture alternately with buttermilk.
Fold in the vinegar.
Bake at 350° for 20 to 30 minutes.
Makes three 8-inch layers.
recipes.text: Red Velvet Cake. Cream shortening and sugar. Add eggs and mix well. Add red food coloring and vanilla. Sift flour, salt, cocoa and baking soda. Add the flour mixture to the sugar and egg mixture alternately with buttermilk. Fold in the vinegar. Bake at 350° for 20 to 30 minutes. Makes three 8-inch layers.

recipes.title: Fresh Strawberry Pie
directions: Cook and stir the ingredients, except for the jello, until thick and clear.
Remove from heat and add 1/2 small jello.
Cool and pour over 1 quart of strawberries in pie shell.
Cover with Cool Whip.
recipes.text: Fresh Strawberry Pie. Cook and stir the ingredients, except for the jello, until thick and clear. Remove from heat and add 1/2 small jello. Cool and pour over 1 quart of strawberries in pie shell. Cover with Cool Whip.

recipes.title: Best Chocolate Cake
ingredients: 2 tsp. soda, dissolved in 1 c. boiling water
directions: Mix all together well. Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes.
recipes.text: Best Chocolate Cake. Mix all together well. Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Bing Cherry Salad
directions: Dissolve raspberry gelatin in hot cherry juice.
Add gelatin, softened in the pineapple juice.
Stir until dissolved.
Chill until thickened.
Add fruits, nuts and cola.
Combine cream and mayonnaise.
Fold into gelatin mixture.
Chill.
recipes.text: Bing Cherry Salad. Dissolve raspberry gelatin in hot cherry juice. Add gelatin, softened in the pineapple juice. Stir until dissolved. Chill until thickened. Add fruits, nuts and cola. Combine cream and mayonnaise. Fold into gelatin mixture. Chill.

recipes.title: Homemade Herb Mix
directions: Combine all ingredients.
Mix well.
Store in tight jar.
Stir or shake before using.
recipes.text: Homemade Herb Mix. Combine all ingredients. Mix well. Store in tight jar. Stir or shake before using.

recipes.title: Fettuccine Alfredo
ingredients: 2 tsp. chopped fresh parsley, if desired
directions: Cook fettuccine to desired doneness as directed on package. Drain, rinse with hot water.
Set aside.
Meanwhile, melt margarine in 6 quart Dutch oven.
Stir in cream and pepper.
Cook over low heat about 5 minutes or until mixture thickens slightly, stirring frequently.
Stir in parmesan cheese and cook over low heat just until cheese is melted, stirring constantly. Immediately stir in cooked fettuccine; toss to coat with sauce. Stir in parsley and nutmeg.
If sauce begins to separate, stir in a little more cream and cook over low heat until smooth.
Makes 6 servings.
recipes.text: Fettuccine Alfredo. Cook fettuccine to desired doneness as directed on package. Drain, rinse with hot water. Set aside. Meanwhile, melt margarine in 6 quart Dutch oven. Stir in cream and pepper. Cook over low heat about 5 minutes or until mixture thickens slightly, stirring frequently. Stir in parmesan cheese and cook over low heat just until cheese is melted, stirring constantly. Immediately stir in cooked fettuccine; toss to coat with sauce. Stir in parsley and nutmeg. If sauce begins to separate, stir in a little more cream and cook over low heat until smooth. Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Deluxe Pecan Pie
directions: Beat eggs slightly, then beat in other items.
Pour into pie shells.
Bake at 350° until done.
Makes 2 pies.
recipes.text: Deluxe Pecan Pie. Beat eggs slightly, then beat in other items. Pour into pie shells. Bake at 350° until done. Makes 2 pies.

recipes.title: Raisin Pie
directions: In a saucepan, stir together sugar and flour.
Add water and mix well.
Stir in raisins, salt and cinnamon.
Cook and stir over medium heat until bubbly.
Cook and stir 1 minute longer.
Remove from heat;
stir in butter.
Bake at 375° for about 45 minutes or until crust is golden brown.
recipes.text: Raisin Pie. In a saucepan, stir together sugar and flour. Add water and mix well. Stir in raisins, salt and cinnamon. Cook and stir over medium heat until bubbly. Cook and stir 1 minute longer. Remove from heat; stir in butter. Bake at 375° for about 45 minutes or until crust is golden brown.

recipes.title: Baked Beans
directions: Cut bacon in small pieces and cook with onion until bacon is crisp.
While cooking bacon, mix all other ingredients together, add drained bacon and onions to bean mixture.
Bake at 350° for 3 hours, stirring occasionally.
recipes.text: Baked Beans. Cut bacon in small pieces and cook with onion until bacon is crisp. While cooking bacon, mix all other ingredients together, add drained bacon and onions to bean mixture. Bake at 350° for 3 hours, stirring occasionally.

recipes.title: Beans And Stuff
ingredients: 1 (15 oz.) can pork and beans, drained
1 (15 oz.) can red kidney beans, drained
1 (15 oz.) can Libby's chili without beans
directions: Fry bacon until crisp.
Remove.
Brown onion and green pepper in drippings.
Add to the rest of the ingredients.
Pour into 4-quart casserole dish.
Bake, covered, at 350° for 50 to 60 minutes.
recipes.text: Beans And Stuff. Fry bacon until crisp. Remove. Brown onion and green pepper in drippings. Add to the rest of the ingredients. Pour into 4-quart casserole dish. Bake, covered, at 350° for 50 to 60 minutes.

recipes.title: Spaghetti Pie
ingredients: 2 eggs, well beaten or equivalent egg substitute
directions: Cook spaghetti (about 3 cups).
Stir olive oil into hot spaghetti.
Stir in Parmesan cheese and eggs.
Form spaghetti mixture into a "crust" in a 10-inch pie plate sprayed with Pam. Spread cottage cheese over bottom of spaghetti crust.
recipes.text: Spaghetti Pie. Cook spaghetti (about 3 cups). Stir olive oil into hot spaghetti. Stir in Parmesan cheese and eggs. Form spaghetti mixture into a "crust" in a 10-inch pie plate sprayed with Pam. Spread cottage cheese over bottom of spaghetti crust.

recipes.title: Chicken And Broccoli Casserole
ingredients: 1 c. Pepperidge Farm herb bread crumbs
directions: Boil chicken until tender; cut up into small pieces.
Thaw broccoli just enough to separate into small pieces.
Arrange broccoli on bottom of casserole dish and cover with chicken; set aside.
Heat soup and mayonnaise and stir well.
Pour over chicken.
Top with cheese and bread crumbs.
Bake uncovered at 350° for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Chicken And Broccoli Casserole. Boil chicken until tender; cut up into small pieces. Thaw broccoli just enough to separate into small pieces. Arrange broccoli on bottom of casserole dish and cover with chicken; set aside. Heat soup and mayonnaise and stir well. Pour over chicken. Top with cheese and bread crumbs. Bake uncovered at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Ruthie'S Yummy Cookies
ingredients: whole graham crackers (use enough to cover bottom of pan)
directions: Melt oleo in 10 x 16-inch pan.
Lay graham crackers over entire bottom of pan.
Sprinkle chocolate chips, butterscotch chips, nuts and coconut over crackers.
Drizzle 1/2 can of Eagle Brand milk over all.
Bake 15 minutes at 350°.
Cut when cool. "Quick and good."
recipes.text: Ruthie'S Yummy Cookies. Melt oleo in 10 x 16-inch pan. Lay graham crackers over entire bottom of pan. Sprinkle chocolate chips, butterscotch chips, nuts and coconut over crackers. Drizzle 1/2 can of Eagle Brand milk over all. Bake 15 minutes at 350°. Cut when cool. "Quick and good."

recipes.title: Melissa'S Chicken
ingredients: 2/3 c. white wine Worcestershire sauce (Lea & Perrins)
directions: Cut chicken into strips, set aside.
Heat skillet and spray generously with Pam.
Add garlic and stir; add chicken and spray chicken with Pam.
Season with lemon pepper and cook completely. About 25 minutes.
Add white wine Worcestershire sauce and cook about 5 minutes longer; arrange on platter and serve.
recipes.text: Melissa'S Chicken. Cut chicken into strips, set aside. Heat skillet and spray generously with Pam. Add garlic and stir; add chicken and spray chicken with Pam. Season with lemon pepper and cook completely. About 25 minutes. Add white wine Worcestershire sauce and cook about 5 minutes longer; arrange on platter and serve.

recipes.title: Porcupine Meat Balls
directions: Mix all ingredients.
Shape into balls 1 1/2-inches.
Brown in 2 tablespoons fat with small garlic clove.
Cover with rest of soup and 1 cup water.
Simmer about 40 minutes.
recipes.text: Porcupine Meat Balls. Mix all ingredients. Shape into balls 1 1/2-inches. Brown in 2 tablespoons fat with small garlic clove. Cover with rest of soup and 1 cup water. Simmer about 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Green Bean Dish
directions: Mix all; cover and
let
marinate in refrigrator for 24 hours.
recipes.text: Green Bean Dish. Mix all; cover and let marinate in refrigrator for 24 hours.

recipes.title: Sauerkraut Salad
directions: Mix sauerkraut, green bell pepper, celery, pimento and onion together.
recipes.text: Sauerkraut Salad. Mix sauerkraut, green bell pepper, celery, pimento and onion together.

recipes.title: Squash Patties
directions: Melt 2 tablespoons butter in skillet, using medium heat.
Drop mixture into butter by tablespoon.
Fry until brown.
recipes.text: Squash Patties. Melt 2 tablespoons butter in skillet, using medium heat. Drop mixture into butter by tablespoon. Fry until brown.

recipes.title: Tacos
directions: First you need sticking spray on the pan so it won't stick. Then you make the dough into a flat circle.
Put some cheese on and then sauce and then pepperonis.
The sauce is sauce is spaghetti sauce.
Cook it for 15 minutes at 100°.
That's how my mommy makes my pizza for lunch.
recipes.text: Tacos. First you need sticking spray on the pan so it won't stick. Then you make the dough into a flat circle. Put some cheese on and then sauce and then pepperonis. The sauce is sauce is spaghetti sauce. Cook it for 15 minutes at 100°. That's how my mommy makes my pizza for lunch.

recipes.title: Chicken Pie
directions: Place hen in large pot.
Cook with all seasonings and 3 cups water on high until steaming, on low until tender.
When chicken is done, remove meat and dice into small pieces.
Place chicken in large baking dish.
Brown flour and fat in skillet; add stock and cook until thickened.
Pour over chicken.
When pie dough is ready, pour chicken mixture into pie shell.
Bake at 400° for 10 minutes; 350° for 30 minutes more.
recipes.text: Chicken Pie. Place hen in large pot. Cook with all seasonings and 3 cups water on high until steaming, on low until tender. When chicken is done, remove meat and dice into small pieces. Place chicken in large baking dish. Brown flour and fat in skillet; add stock and cook until thickened. Pour over chicken. When pie dough is ready, pour chicken mixture into pie shell. Bake at 400° for 10 minutes; 350° for 30 minutes more.

recipes.title: Applesauce Cake
ingredients: 1 c. raisins, dredged in 1/4 c. flour
directions: Cream until light and fluffy oleo and sugar.
Add applesauce, raisins and pecans.
Sift together and add flour, nutmeg, cinnamon and soda.
Pour into lightly greased 9 x 13-inch cake pan and bake 45 minutes to 1 hour, depending on your oven.
This cake stays very moist.
If you have nonraisin lovers, it will work without the raisins.
recipes.text: Applesauce Cake. Cream until light and fluffy oleo and sugar. Add applesauce, raisins and pecans. Sift together and add flour, nutmeg, cinnamon and soda. Pour into lightly greased 9 x 13-inch cake pan and bake 45 minutes to 1 hour, depending on your oven. This cake stays very moist. If you have nonraisin lovers, it will work without the raisins.

recipes.title: Cream Of Crab Soup
directions: Remove cartilage from crabmeat.
Melt butter in a 3-quart pan. Blend in flour and stir until smooth.
Slowly stir in chicken broth and pepper.
Simmer for 2 minutes.
Add milk and cook slowly, stirring constantly until thickened.
Do not boil.
Add crabmeat to milk mixture and salt to taste.
Yields approximately 10 cups.
recipes.text: Cream Of Crab Soup. Remove cartilage from crabmeat. Melt butter in a 3-quart pan. Blend in flour and stir until smooth. Slowly stir in chicken broth and pepper. Simmer for 2 minutes. Add milk and cook slowly, stirring constantly until thickened. Do not boil. Add crabmeat to milk mixture and salt to taste. Yields approximately 10 cups.

recipes.title: Banana Bread
directions: Cream together the margarine and sugar until fluffy.
Mix in the eggs and bananas.
In another bowl, sift together the flour and soda.
Add alternately with the buttermilk to the other mixture. Add the pecans.
Pour into greased loaf pans.
Bake at 325° for 40 minutes.
recipes.text: Banana Bread. Cream together the margarine and sugar until fluffy. Mix in the eggs and bananas. In another bowl, sift together the flour and soda. Add alternately with the buttermilk to the other mixture. Add the pecans. Pour into greased loaf pans. Bake at 325° for 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Cheese Potatoes
ingredients: 1 (2 lb.) pkg. frozen hash browns, thawed
directions: Combine all ingredients and spoon into a 9 x 15-inch greased baking dish.
Top with buttered cracker or bread crumbs.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.
Serves 6.
recipes.text: Cheese Potatoes. Combine all ingredients and spoon into a 9 x 15-inch greased baking dish. Top with buttered cracker or bread crumbs. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes. Serves 6.

recipes.title: Yule Log
ingredients: 1 lb. vanilla wafers (extra wafers to roll them in)
directions: (Can use 1/2 pound cherries and pineapple as an option instead of the mixed fruit.)
recipes.text: Yule Log. (Can use 1/2 pound cherries and pineapple as an option instead of the mixed fruit.)

recipes.title: Chicken Casserole Armistine
directions: Mix all together
and
bake at 275° to 300° for 1 hour. Serves 12 to 14 people.
Better if you cook the day before and reheat.
recipes.text: Chicken Casserole Armistine. Mix all together and bake at 275° to 300° for 1 hour. Serves 12 to 14 people. Better if you cook the day before and reheat.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Chocolate Chip Brownies
directions: Mix flour, baking powder and salt; set aside.
Cream butter and sugars.
Add eggs; beat until fluffy.
Add flour mixture until well blended.
Stir in chocolate chips and vanilla.
Pour into an 8 x 8 x 2-inch greased pan.
Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.
recipes.text: Peanut Butter Chocolate Chip Brownies. Mix flour, baking powder and salt; set aside. Cream butter and sugars. Add eggs; beat until fluffy. Add flour mixture until well blended. Stir in chocolate chips and vanilla. Pour into an 8 x 8 x 2-inch greased pan. Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.

recipes.title: Golden Punch
directions: Boil sugar and 2 quarts water together.
Add mint leaves; cook and strain.
Add tea, water and fruit juices to the other mixture. Just before serving, add 2 quarts ginger ale.
Top with orange and lemon slices.
recipes.text: Golden Punch. Boil sugar and 2 quarts water together. Add mint leaves; cook and strain. Add tea, water and fruit juices to the other mixture. Just before serving, add 2 quarts ginger ale. Top with orange and lemon slices.

recipes.title: Double Chocolate Mocha Trifle
ingredients: 1 (18.25 oz.) pkg. brownie mix plus ingredients to make brownies
2 pkg. (3.4 oz. each) white chocolate instant pudding mix
directions: Prepare brownies according to package directions.
Bake. Allow to cool.
recipes.text: Double Chocolate Mocha Trifle. Prepare brownies according to package directions. Bake. Allow to cool.

recipes.title: Tamale Pie
directions: Mix all ingredients in a large 14 x 10-inch casserole and bake for 2 hours at 325°, covered.
Uncover the last 1/2 hour if you want a browned top. Do not add salt as olive juice and Fritos have enough. Serve hot.
recipes.text: Tamale Pie. Mix all ingredients in a large 14 x 10-inch casserole and bake for 2 hours at 325°, covered. Uncover the last 1/2 hour if you want a browned top. Do not add salt as olive juice and Fritos have enough. Serve hot.

recipes.title: Carlucci Stew
directions: Pare and slice carrots.
Cube potatoes and sirloin tips. Place all, but barley, in a 4 1/2-quart Dutch oven or crock-pot. Add 2 cups water.
In the crock-pot, cook 6 hours on low or 3 on high.
Using a Dutch oven, bring to a boil, then cover and simmer 2 1/2 to 3 1/2 hours.
During the last hour, add barley.
recipes.text: Carlucci Stew. Pare and slice carrots. Cube potatoes and sirloin tips. Place all, but barley, in a 4 1/2-quart Dutch oven or crock-pot. Add 2 cups water. In the crock-pot, cook 6 hours on low or 3 on high. Using a Dutch oven, bring to a boil, then cover and simmer 2 1/2 to 3 1/2 hours. During the last hour, add barley.

recipes.title: Avocado Ice Cream
ingredients: 1 qt. soy milk or nondairy milk
directions: Peel avocado and blend in blender with other ingredients until smooth.
Put into electric ice cream maker and freeze as directions per freezer directions.
recipes.text: Avocado Ice Cream. Peel avocado and blend in blender with other ingredients until smooth. Put into electric ice cream maker and freeze as directions per freezer directions.

recipes.title: Fudgy Zucchini Brownies
ingredients: 2 sq. (1 oz. each) unsweetened baking chocolate
directions: Preheat oven to 350°.
Coat an 8-inch pan with vegetable cooking spray.
Melt chocolate and butter in the top of a double boiler.
Add sugar and mix well.
Add egg, salt, baking powder and vanilla; mix until well combined.
recipes.text: Fudgy Zucchini Brownies. Preheat oven to 350°. Coat an 8-inch pan with vegetable cooking spray. Melt chocolate and butter in the top of a double boiler. Add sugar and mix well. Add egg, salt, baking powder and vanilla; mix until well combined.

recipes.title: Meatballs
directions: Mix together and roll into balls and brown in skillet.
Remove balls and make gravy.
Put flour in drippings as for milk gravy only use water.
Add mushroom soup.
Simmer 20 minutes.
recipes.text: Meatballs. Mix together and roll into balls and brown in skillet. Remove balls and make gravy. Put flour in drippings as for milk gravy only use water. Add mushroom soup. Simmer 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Date Loaf
directions: Mix dates, nuts and salt with flour and baking powder.
Beat eggs separately.
Add sugar to yolks.
Beat well and add whites. Pour in dry ingredients; work well.
Bake slowly for 1 1/2 hours in greased pan.
Line pan with wax paper.
recipes.text: Date Loaf. Mix dates, nuts and salt with flour and baking powder. Beat eggs separately. Add sugar to yolks. Beat well and add whites. Pour in dry ingredients; work well. Bake slowly for 1 1/2 hours in greased pan. Line pan with wax paper.

recipes.title: Oklahoma Cherry Surprise
directions: Melt oleo; mix flour, sugar and pecans and press in a 13 x 9-inch pan.
Bake at 350° for 15 minutes.
Let cool.
Mix cream cheese, powdered sugar and Cool Whip and spread over crust.
Then top with pie filling and chill.
recipes.text: Oklahoma Cherry Surprise. Melt oleo; mix flour, sugar and pecans and press in a 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake at 350° for 15 minutes. Let cool. Mix cream cheese, powdered sugar and Cool Whip and spread over crust. Then top with pie filling and chill.

recipes.title: Icebox Cookies
ingredients: 1 1/2 c. shortening (Wesson oil, butter or margarine)
1 1/2 c. brown sugar (may be all white)
1 tsp. each: allspice, cinnamon and nutmeg
directions: Cream shortening and sugars.
Add well beaten eggs.
Add flour, soda, baking powder and spices, sifted together.
If nuts are used, add to mixture after flouring.
Knead well on floured board. Divide into several portions.
Roll and chill.
Slice thinly.
Bake in a 325° to 350° oven for about 10 to 15 minutes.
You may freeze these rolls of cookie dough and cook as you wish at later dates.
recipes.text: Icebox Cookies. Cream shortening and sugars. Add well beaten eggs. Add flour, soda, baking powder and spices, sifted together. If nuts are used, add to mixture after flouring. Knead well on floured board. Divide into several portions. Roll and chill. Slice thinly. Bake in a 325° to 350° oven for about 10 to 15 minutes. You may freeze these rolls of cookie dough and cook as you wish at later dates.

recipes.title: My Mom'S Pizza
ingredients: 3/4 to 1 c. shredded cheese of your choice
directions: Buy pizza crust at the Farmer's Market, Bun Basket or make your own.
recipes.text: My Mom'S Pizza. Buy pizza crust at the Farmer's Market, Bun Basket or make your own.

recipes.title: Manicotti
directions: Brown ground beef and onion.
Drain off grease.
Add garlic salt, pepper, parsley and oregano.
Mix well.
In a bowl, crumble the bread. Add milk, egg and 8 ounces Mozzarella cheese.
Mix well. Add this to the ground beef mixture. Cook until cheese melts.
recipes.text: Manicotti. Brown ground beef and onion. Drain off grease. Add garlic salt, pepper, parsley and oregano. Mix well. In a bowl, crumble the bread. Add milk, egg and 8 ounces Mozzarella cheese. Mix well. Add this to the ground beef mixture. Cook until cheese melts.

recipes.title: Pineapple Icebox Pie
directions: Blend all ingredients, except pecans, together in mixer and pour into 2 graham cracker crusts.
Sprinkle cut-up pecans over top of pies.
Let stand in refrigerator overnight.
Makes 2 pies.
recipes.text: Pineapple Icebox Pie. Blend all ingredients, except pecans, together in mixer and pour into 2 graham cracker crusts. Sprinkle cut-up pecans over top of pies. Let stand in refrigerator overnight. Makes 2 pies.

recipes.title: Beef Sherry
directions: Bake at 325° for 3 hours or in crock-pot on low all day.
Serve with egg noodles or rice.
recipes.text: Beef Sherry. Bake at 325° for 3 hours or in crock-pot on low all day. Serve with egg noodles or rice.

recipes.title: Roast Cornish Hen
directions: Coat both inside and outside of Cornish hen with extra virgin olive oil.
Apply salt, pepper and chili powder inside and outside.
Roast on roasting rack (especially for birds) or roasting pan with rack for 45 to 50 minutes at 425°.
To check doneness, remove a leg, making certain clear liquid runs out.
The more hens cooked, the more roasting time is increased.
These birds are crispy and delicious!
recipes.text: Roast Cornish Hen. Coat both inside and outside of Cornish hen with extra virgin olive oil. Apply salt, pepper and chili powder inside and outside. Roast on roasting rack (especially for birds) or roasting pan with rack for 45 to 50 minutes at 425°. To check doneness, remove a leg, making certain clear liquid runs out. The more hens cooked, the more roasting time is increased. These birds are crispy and delicious!

recipes.title: Appetizer Meatballs
directions: Mix lemon juice, jelly and ketchup in saucepan or crock-pot. While sauce is cooking, mix ground chuck, egg, onion, seasoned salt, milk and oatmeal together.
Form into 1-inch balls and brown in skillet.
Drain and put with sauce and simmer for at least 1/2 hour.
recipes.text: Appetizer Meatballs. Mix lemon juice, jelly and ketchup in saucepan or crock-pot. While sauce is cooking, mix ground chuck, egg, onion, seasoned salt, milk and oatmeal together. Form into 1-inch balls and brown in skillet. Drain and put with sauce and simmer for at least 1/2 hour.

recipes.title: Molded Cucumber Salad
directions: Dissolve gelatin in boiling water.
Stir in remaining ingredients.
Blend well.
Pour into 3 or 4-cup mold.
Refrigerate until firm.
Unmold by setting the bottom of mold in tap water for a few minutes.
This is not only tasty, but also adds color to the meal.
recipes.text: Molded Cucumber Salad. Dissolve gelatin in boiling water. Stir in remaining ingredients. Blend well. Pour into 3 or 4-cup mold. Refrigerate until firm. Unmold by setting the bottom of mold in tap water for a few minutes. This is not only tasty, but also adds color to the meal.

recipes.title: Western Meat-In-One
directions: Brown meat in oil.
Add garlic, salt, onion, green pepper and chili powder and saute for 5 minutes or until vegetables are limp. Mix in tomatoes, kidney beans and rice and turn into a 2-quart casserole.
Bake, uncovered, in a 350° oven for 45 minutes. Sprinkle with olives and cheese.
Continue baking for 15 minutes or until cheese is melted.
Serves 6 to 8 people.
recipes.text: Western Meat-In-One. Brown meat in oil. Add garlic, salt, onion, green pepper and chili powder and saute for 5 minutes or until vegetables are limp. Mix in tomatoes, kidney beans and rice and turn into a 2-quart casserole. Bake, uncovered, in a 350° oven for 45 minutes. Sprinkle with olives and cheese. Continue baking for 15 minutes or until cheese is melted. Serves 6 to 8 people.

recipes.title: Preacher'S Wives' Peachy Sunday Special
ingredients: 1/2 pt. whipping cream, whipped or Cool Whip
directions: Add sugar slowly to beaten egg whites.
Add baking powder, vanilla and crackers.
Add nuts.
Place in a small loaf pan and bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
Cool.
Slice and top with peaches and cream.
recipes.text: Preacher'S Wives' Peachy Sunday Special. Add sugar slowly to beaten egg whites. Add baking powder, vanilla and crackers. Add nuts. Place in a small loaf pan and bake at 350° for 30 minutes. Cool. Slice and top with peaches and cream.

recipes.title: Fried Cheese Meltaways
ingredients: 1 lb. Jack, Cheddar, American, Swiss or Mozzarella cheese, cut into 3/4-inch squares
directions: Heat 2 inches of oil in deep fat fryer to 375°.
Beat 1 cup of baking mix, milk and egg with hand beater until smooth.
Coat cheese lightly with baking mix.
Insert a round wooden toothpick in each cube.
Dip into batter, covering cheese completely.
Fry several cubes at a time, turning carefully until golden brown,
1 to 2 minutes.
Drain on paper towel.
(Leave toothpicks in.
Keep oil moving with basket or slotted spoon.)
recipes.text: Fried Cheese Meltaways. Heat 2 inches of oil in deep fat fryer to 375°. Beat 1 cup of baking mix, milk and egg with hand beater until smooth. Coat cheese lightly with baking mix. Insert a round wooden toothpick in each cube. Dip into batter, covering cheese completely. Fry several cubes at a time, turning carefully until golden brown, 1 to 2 minutes. Drain on paper towel. (Leave toothpicks in. Keep oil moving with basket or slotted spoon.)

recipes.title: Hot Crab Dip
directions: Place all ingredients in bowl and microwave for 2 minutes. Stop and mix well, then microwave approximately 1 minute.
Serve hot with crackers.
Easy!
recipes.text: Hot Crab Dip. Place all ingredients in bowl and microwave for 2 minutes. Stop and mix well, then microwave approximately 1 minute. Serve hot with crackers. Easy!

recipes.title: Peppy Potatoes
directions: Mix tomatoes, water and oregano in a 2-quart ovenware casserole dish.
Heat to boiling, about 8 to 10 minutes.
Stir in seasoning mix and potatoes.
Cook for 5 minutes at medium heat. Stir.
Place cheese and pepperoni on top.
Turn oven to 350° and cook for an additional 10 to 15 minutes or until potatoes are tender and cheese is melted.
recipes.text: Peppy Potatoes. Mix tomatoes, water and oregano in a 2-quart ovenware casserole dish. Heat to boiling, about 8 to 10 minutes. Stir in seasoning mix and potatoes. Cook for 5 minutes at medium heat. Stir. Place cheese and pepperoni on top. Turn oven to 350° and cook for an additional 10 to 15 minutes or until potatoes are tender and cheese is melted.

recipes.title: Mexican Goup
directions: Brown
ground beef and onion in skillet.
In large pot, add beef,
chili beans, tomato juice, rice, onion, chili mix, salt and pepper together and mix well.
If too thin, add rice (up
to 1/2 cup) to thicken.
Stir often until rice is tender and
mixture boils.
On your serving plate, place a small bed of
lettuce.
On top of that, place some Frito chips and your goup.
Sprinkle cheese on top and serve.
recipes.text: Mexican Goup. Brown ground beef and onion in skillet. In large pot, add beef, chili beans, tomato juice, rice, onion, chili mix, salt and pepper together and mix well. If too thin, add rice (up to 1/2 cup) to thicken. Stir often until rice is tender and mixture boils. On your serving plate, place a small bed of lettuce. On top of that, place some Frito chips and your goup. Sprinkle cheese on top and serve.

recipes.title: Baked Stuffed Cucumbers
ingredients: 2 1/2 lb. potatoes (about 5 large), peeled and quartered
directions: In a large saucepan, cover potatoes with cold, salted water; cover and bring to a boil.
Drain immediately and plunge into cold water.
Drain.
Grate the potatoes into a bowl.
Toss with salt and pepper.
Heat 1 1/2 teaspoons butter and 1 1/2 teaspoons oil in a 12-inch nonstick skillet over medium-high heat until sizzling.
Tilt to coat the surface of the pan.
Add potatoes and press firmly into a large pancake, using the back of a wooden spoon or a spatula.
Cook for about 5 minutes or until bottom is golden brown.
Using a knife or a spatula, loosen the potato cake and slide it onto a large plate.
Drizzle the remaining butter and oil over the uncooked side.
Invert the skillet over the potato cake and carefully turn over so that the potato cake falls into the skillet.
Cook for 5 to 7 minutes longer over medium-high heat or until the underside is golden brown.
Loosen and slice onto a serving platter.
Serve immediately.
Serves 6.
recipes.text: Baked Stuffed Cucumbers. In a large saucepan, cover potatoes with cold, salted water; cover and bring to a boil. Drain immediately and plunge into cold water. Drain. Grate the potatoes into a bowl. Toss with salt and pepper. Heat 1 1/2 teaspoons butter and 1 1/2 teaspoons oil in a 12-inch nonstick skillet over medium-high heat until sizzling. Tilt to coat the surface of the pan. Add potatoes and press firmly into a large pancake, using the back of a wooden spoon or a spatula. Cook for about 5 minutes or until bottom is golden brown. Using a knife or a spatula, loosen the potato cake and slide it onto a large plate. Drizzle the remaining butter and oil over the uncooked side. Invert the skillet over the potato cake and carefully turn over so that the potato cake falls into the skillet. Cook for 5 to 7 minutes longer over medium-high heat or until the underside is golden brown. Loosen and slice onto a serving platter. Serve immediately. Serves 6.

recipes.title: Apricot Salad
ingredients: 1 pkg. (large) Cool Whip or Dream Whip
directions: Add boiling water to
jello
and
1 cup pineapple juice from crushed pineapple.
Let jello set, not solid, just loose, and then whip in the
cream
cheese,
Cool
Whip,
celery
and pineapple. Garnish with nuts and chill.
recipes.text: Apricot Salad. Add boiling water to jello and 1 cup pineapple juice from crushed pineapple. Let jello set, not solid, just loose, and then whip in the cream cheese, Cool Whip, celery and pineapple. Garnish with nuts and chill.

recipes.title: Corey'S Peanut Butter Bars
directions: Cream peanut butter, margarine, vanilla and brown sugar.
Add eggs and flour.
Mix well.
Spread into an 8 x 8-inch pan, greased well.
Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Corey'S Peanut Butter Bars. Cream peanut butter, margarine, vanilla and brown sugar. Add eggs and flour. Mix well. Spread into an 8 x 8-inch pan, greased well. Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Spaghetti Pie
ingredients: 1 large carton fat free cottage cheese
directions: Brown ground beef; drain and add marinara sauce. Cook spaghetti; drain and return to pot. Add margarine. Whisk eggs in a small bowl; add spaghetti. Divide noodles among two 9 x 13 inch dishes sprayed with Pam. Spread half carton of cottage cheese on top of each pie. Divide meat sauce equally and spread on cottage cheese layer (I use my hands to spread cottage cheese and meat sauce.) Bake 30 minutes at 350°. Sprinkle mozzarella (or Vege Shreds) on each pie. Bake 10 minutes or until cheese melts. Yield: 2 pies, 6 servings in each pie.
recipes.text: Spaghetti Pie. Brown ground beef; drain and add marinara sauce. Cook spaghetti; drain and return to pot. Add margarine. Whisk eggs in a small bowl; add spaghetti. Divide noodles among two 9 x 13 inch dishes sprayed with Pam. Spread half carton of cottage cheese on top of each pie. Divide meat sauce equally and spread on cottage cheese layer (I use my hands to spread cottage cheese and meat sauce.) Bake 30 minutes at 350°. Sprinkle mozzarella (or Vege Shreds) on each pie. Bake 10 minutes or until cheese melts. Yield: 2 pies, 6 servings in each pie.

recipes.title: Turkey Tetrazzini
directions: Saute onion in oil until soft.
Add milk, flour, cloves and bay leaves.
Cook over medium-low heat until thick and creamy. Add turkey with salt and pepper to taste.
(Fry turkey before adding.)
Serve over spaghetti.
Serves 3 to 4 people.
recipes.text: Turkey Tetrazzini. Saute onion in oil until soft. Add milk, flour, cloves and bay leaves. Cook over medium-low heat until thick and creamy. Add turkey with salt and pepper to taste. (Fry turkey before adding.) Serve over spaghetti. Serves 3 to 4 people.

recipes.title: Company Cheese Soup
ingredients: Cauliflower and broccoli flowerettes or 1 pkg. frozen California Mixed vegetables
directions: In a large pot or kettle, boil potatoes, onions, celery (with water) and bouillon cubes for 20 minutes.
Add cauliflower and broccoli and boil 10 more minutes.
Add chicken soup and cheese. Cook until the cheese is melted (do not boil).
Serve with crusty French bread.
recipes.text: Company Cheese Soup. In a large pot or kettle, boil potatoes, onions, celery (with water) and bouillon cubes for 20 minutes. Add cauliflower and broccoli and boil 10 more minutes. Add chicken soup and cheese. Cook until the cheese is melted (do not boil). Serve with crusty French bread.

recipes.title: White Chocolate Macadamia Nut Cookies
ingredients: 6 oz. white chocolate in small chunks or 6 oz. white chocolate morsels (Nestle)
directions: Preheat oven to 375°.
Mix butter and sugars together at medium speed.
Add egg and all other ingredients except nuts and white chocolate.
Mix until well blended, then add nuts and white chocolate.
Drop by teaspoonfuls 2 inches apart onto lightly greased cookie sheets (may use vegetable spray).
Bake 8 to 10 minutes or until lightly browned.
Let cool 5 minutes.
Transfer to wire rack to finish cooling.
Makes approximately 4 dozen.
recipes.text: White Chocolate Macadamia Nut Cookies. Preheat oven to 375°. Mix butter and sugars together at medium speed. Add egg and all other ingredients except nuts and white chocolate. Mix until well blended, then add nuts and white chocolate. Drop by teaspoonfuls 2 inches apart onto lightly greased cookie sheets (may use vegetable spray). Bake 8 to 10 minutes or until lightly browned. Let cool 5 minutes. Transfer to wire rack to finish cooling. Makes approximately 4 dozen.

recipes.title: Backyard Bean Salad
ingredients: 2 c. (1 lb. can) kidney beans, drained
directions: Combine beans, eggs, celery, onion and enough dressing to moisten.
Toss lightly.
Season to taste; chill.
Makes 4 servings.
recipes.text: Backyard Bean Salad. Combine beans, eggs, celery, onion and enough dressing to moisten. Toss lightly. Season to taste; chill. Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: Lemon Pie
directions: Mix sugar, salt and cornstarch together in a saucepan.
Add hot water, switch to hot until steaming; turn to low and cook until thick and clear.
Stir constantly 6 minutes.
Remove from heat and stir in 1/2 cup of this hot mixture into the egg yolks, stir this back into pan with the rest of hot mixture.
Cook for 6 more minutes on warm, stirring constantly.
Remove and add lemon juice and lemon rind.
Cool, pour into cool baked pie shell and top with meringue.
recipes.text: Lemon Pie. Mix sugar, salt and cornstarch together in a saucepan. Add hot water, switch to hot until steaming; turn to low and cook until thick and clear. Stir constantly 6 minutes. Remove from heat and stir in 1/2 cup of this hot mixture into the egg yolks, stir this back into pan with the rest of hot mixture. Cook for 6 more minutes on warm, stirring constantly. Remove and add lemon juice and lemon rind. Cool, pour into cool baked pie shell and top with meringue.

recipes.title: Snicker Apple Salad
ingredients: 3 large Granny Smith apples, peeled, sliced thin and cut into bite-size pieces
3 regular size Snickers candy bars, cut into small pieces
directions: Stir all together and chill before serving.
Can be made day ahead.
The recipe doubled fills large Tupperware salad bowl.
recipes.text: Snicker Apple Salad. Stir all together and chill before serving. Can be made day ahead. The recipe doubled fills large Tupperware salad bowl.

recipes.title: Lasagna
directions: Brown ground meat, drain fat.
In a deep pan or pot add meat, onion, garlic, tomato paste, tomato sauce and spaghetti mix.
Add 1/2 to 1 cup water.
Stir.
Heat on high until it begins to bubble, then turn on low and simmer for about 45 minutes.
You'll need a deep, oblong pan.
Slightly grease bottom.
Put a layer of noodles, layer of meat and layer of cheeses.
Repeat again.
Turn oven to 350° and cook about 30 to 40 minutes.
Serves 6.
recipes.text: Lasagna. Brown ground meat, drain fat. In a deep pan or pot add meat, onion, garlic, tomato paste, tomato sauce and spaghetti mix. Add 1/2 to 1 cup water. Stir. Heat on high until it begins to bubble, then turn on low and simmer for about 45 minutes. You'll need a deep, oblong pan. Slightly grease bottom. Put a layer of noodles, layer of meat and layer of cheeses. Repeat again. Turn oven to 350° and cook about 30 to 40 minutes. Serves 6.

recipes.title: Toasty Breakfast Pockets
ingredients: 2 oz. sliced deli turkey breast, chopped (1/2 c.)
24 slices soft wheat or white bread
directions: Preheat oven to 400°. Using 3-inch Cut-N-Seal, cut 6 circles from cheese slices on Cutting Board. Cut each circle into quarters using My Safe Cutter. Wrap in plastic wrap and refrigerate. Cut the remaining scraps of cheese into small pieces and place in Classic 2-Quart Batter Bowl.
recipes.text: Toasty Breakfast Pockets. Preheat oven to 400°. Using 3-inch Cut-N-Seal, cut 6 circles from cheese slices on Cutting Board. Cut each circle into quarters using My Safe Cutter. Wrap in plastic wrap and refrigerate. Cut the remaining scraps of cheese into small pieces and place in Classic 2-Quart Batter Bowl.

recipes.title: Pecan Stuffed Chicken Breast
directions: Prepare favorite bread stuffing (excluding seasonings such as sage, poultry, etc.).
Mix chopped pecans into stuffing.
Tenderize the chicken breasts and sprinkle with salt and pepper.
Take an egg-sized helping of the stuffing and wrap breast around it.
Brush a mixture of butter and lemon juice over breast.
Bake breasts in 350 degree oven until internal temperature (probe must enter stuffing) equals 170 degrees.
Remove from oven.
Serve with your favorite chicken sauce (cream of chicken soup may be used).
recipes.text: Pecan Stuffed Chicken Breast. Prepare favorite bread stuffing (excluding seasonings such as sage, poultry, etc.). Mix chopped pecans into stuffing. Tenderize the chicken breasts and sprinkle with salt and pepper. Take an egg-sized helping of the stuffing and wrap breast around it. Brush a mixture of butter and lemon juice over breast. Bake breasts in 350 degree oven until internal temperature (probe must enter stuffing) equals 170 degrees. Remove from oven. Serve with your favorite chicken sauce (cream of chicken soup may be used).

recipes.title: Super Seafood Spread
ingredients: 7 oz. drained tuna or 7 oz. shrimp or crab meat
1 (7 oz.) envelope Italian salad dressing mix
directions: Place seafood of your choice in mixing bowl.
Break up finely with fork.
Add remaining ingredients except olives.
Mix well. Chill.
Garnish with olives and additional picante sauce if desired.
Serve with crackers, chips or raw vegetables.
Makes about 2 1/2 cups of dip.
recipes.text: Super Seafood Spread. Place seafood of your choice in mixing bowl. Break up finely with fork. Add remaining ingredients except olives. Mix well. Chill. Garnish with olives and additional picante sauce if desired. Serve with crackers, chips or raw vegetables. Makes about 2 1/2 cups of dip.

recipes.title: Eggplant Casserole
directions: Cook eggplant in salted water for 10 minutes. Drain.
Combine with remaining ingredients.
Put into 1-quart casserole. Bake in a 350° oven for 45 minutes.
Makes 6 to 8 servings.
recipes.text: Eggplant Casserole. Cook eggplant in salted water for 10 minutes. Drain. Combine with remaining ingredients. Put into 1-quart casserole. Bake in a 350° oven for 45 minutes. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

recipes.title: Berry Mousse
directions: Mix gelatin according to package.
Add Cool Whip and blend. Stir in strawberries gently.
Pour or spoon into dessert glasses or cups.
Top with a strawberry.
Chill about 2 hours.
recipes.text: Berry Mousse. Mix gelatin according to package. Add Cool Whip and blend. Stir in strawberries gently. Pour or spoon into dessert glasses or cups. Top with a strawberry. Chill about 2 hours.

recipes.title: Turtle Cake
directions: Mix cake as directed on box.
Bake half the batter for 15 minutes at 350° in a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Cool completely.
Mix caramels, butter and milk; melt.
Pour over baked, cooled cake. Sprinkle with chocolate chips.
Cover with remaining batter.
Bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes.
recipes.text: Turtle Cake. Mix cake as directed on box. Bake half the batter for 15 minutes at 350° in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Cool completely. Mix caramels, butter and milk; melt. Pour over baked, cooled cake. Sprinkle with chocolate chips. Cover with remaining batter. Bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Yummy Potatoes
directions: Boil 8 to 10 potatoes in skin, let cool.
Slice or chunk potatoes into a greased 9 x 13-inch pan.
Combine sour cream, cream of chicken soup, melted margarine, salt, pepper and 1 1/2 cups shredded Cheddar cheese.
Spread over potatoes and bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
Sprinkle with 1 cup shredded cheese and bake for 15 minutes.
(Cream of mushroom soup can be substituted.)
recipes.text: Yummy Potatoes. Boil 8 to 10 potatoes in skin, let cool. Slice or chunk potatoes into a greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Combine sour cream, cream of chicken soup, melted margarine, salt, pepper and 1 1/2 cups shredded Cheddar cheese. Spread over potatoes and bake at 350° for 30 minutes. Sprinkle with 1 cup shredded cheese and bake for 15 minutes. (Cream of mushroom soup can be substituted.)

recipes.title: Corn Casserole
directions: Mix all of the above ingredients and pour into a 2-quart casserole dish.
Bake at 350° if glass casserole or 375° if metal pan for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Corn Casserole. Mix all of the above ingredients and pour into a 2-quart casserole dish. Bake at 350° if glass casserole or 375° if metal pan for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Corn Chowder
ingredients: 1 can whole kernel corn (I put in food processor just a short time)
directions: Cut up potatoes and onions, cover with water, salt to taste and cook until mushy.
Do not drain off water.
Add next 3 ingredients.
To the completed chowder, add the oleo.
recipes.text: Corn Chowder. Cut up potatoes and onions, cover with water, salt to taste and cook until mushy. Do not drain off water. Add next 3 ingredients. To the completed chowder, add the oleo.

recipes.title: Antipasto Of Scampi Shrimp Hors D'Oeuvre
ingredients: 1/2 c. heavy cream or thick soured cream called "chef style"
directions: Make a stiff mayonnaise with egg yolk, the juice of lemon, salt and olive oil.
Combine it with heavy cream or thick soured cream called "Chef style", brandy and tomato ketchup.
Boil, cool, peel and devein shrimp.
Combine them with the mayonnaise.
Line bottom of large serving dish with a finely shredded chicory, using the tender leaves from the heart.
Place shrimp over this and chill in refrigerator until ready to serve.
Can be served in individual small dishes as a first course.
recipes.text: Antipasto Of Scampi Shrimp Hors D'Oeuvre. Make a stiff mayonnaise with egg yolk, the juice of lemon, salt and olive oil. Combine it with heavy cream or thick soured cream called "Chef style", brandy and tomato ketchup. Boil, cool, peel and devein shrimp. Combine them with the mayonnaise. Line bottom of large serving dish with a finely shredded chicory, using the tender leaves from the heart. Place shrimp over this and chill in refrigerator until ready to serve. Can be served in individual small dishes as a first course.

recipes.title: Apple Brandy Cake
directions: Combine mixture, then add vanilla, brandy, apples and nuts. Spread into lightly greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan.
Bake at 350° for abut 40 minutes.
This cake needs no icing and you don't have to use a mixer.
recipes.text: Apple Brandy Cake. Combine mixture, then add vanilla, brandy, apples and nuts. Spread into lightly greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Bake at 350° for abut 40 minutes. This cake needs no icing and you don't have to use a mixer.

recipes.title: Broccoli Egg Puff
ingredients: 16 oz. creamed small curd cottage cheese
directions: Spread cooked broccoli in buttered 13 x 9-inch pan.
Beat eggs until fluffy.
Add flour, salt, baking powder, cottage cheese, Mozzarella and butter.
Mix well.
Stir in bacon and pour over broccoli.
Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.
Do not overcook as it will be dry.
recipes.text: Broccoli Egg Puff. Spread cooked broccoli in buttered 13 x 9-inch pan. Beat eggs until fluffy. Add flour, salt, baking powder, cottage cheese, Mozzarella and butter. Mix well. Stir in bacon and pour over broccoli. Bake at 350° for 40 minutes. Do not overcook as it will be dry.

recipes.title: Chicken Casserole
ingredients: 1 small pkg. corn bread dressing (Stove Top)
directions: Cook chicken in water with onion, salt and pepper for 45 minutes.
Cool and bone.
Break chicken in large chunks and put in buttered casserole, mixed well with soup and sour cream
recipes.text: Chicken Casserole. Cook chicken in water with onion, salt and pepper for 45 minutes. Cool and bone. Break chicken in large chunks and put in buttered casserole, mixed well with soup and sour cream

recipes.title: Strawberry Shortcake
directions: Slice strawberries and sprinkle with 1 cup of sugar.
Let stand 1 hour.
Heat oven to 450°.
Grease round layer pan, 8 x 1 1/2-inches.
Measure flour, 2 tablespoons of sugar, baking powder and salt into a bowl.
Cut in shortening thoroughly until mixture looks like meal.
Stir in milk just until blended. Put into pan. Bake 15 to 20 minutes or until golden brown.
Split shortcake while warm. Spread with butter. Fill and top with berries.
Serve warm with cream.
recipes.text: Strawberry Shortcake. Slice strawberries and sprinkle with 1 cup of sugar. Let stand 1 hour. Heat oven to 450°. Grease round layer pan, 8 x 1 1/2-inches. Measure flour, 2 tablespoons of sugar, baking powder and salt into a bowl. Cut in shortening thoroughly until mixture looks like meal. Stir in milk just until blended. Put into pan. Bake 15 to 20 minutes or until golden brown. Split shortcake while warm. Spread with butter. Fill and top with berries. Serve warm with cream.

recipes.title: Pizza Breadsticks
ingredients: 1 (16 oz.) loaf frozen bread dough, thawed
directions: Preheat oven to 400°.
Knead dough over baking stone.
Cover dough and let rest 15 minutes.
Stretch dough over stone again. Brush dough with olive oil.
Press garlic and spread over dough. Grate cheese over dough.
Bake 12 to 15 minutes or until light brown.
Cut with pizza cutter and dip in sauce.
recipes.text: Pizza Breadsticks. Preheat oven to 400°. Knead dough over baking stone. Cover dough and let rest 15 minutes. Stretch dough over stone again. Brush dough with olive oil. Press garlic and spread over dough. Grate cheese over dough. Bake 12 to 15 minutes or until light brown. Cut with pizza cutter and dip in sauce.

recipes.title: Cheese Squares
directions: Grate cheese; spread cheese evenly in pan.
Beat eggs and add chilies.
Pour over cheese.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
Cut in squares.
recipes.text: Cheese Squares. Grate cheese; spread cheese evenly in pan. Beat eggs and add chilies. Pour over cheese. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes. Cut in squares.

recipes.title: Punch
ingredients: 1 (6 oz.) can frozen orange juice concentrate
1 (3 litre) bottle of Sprite or Ginger Ale
directions: Dissolve Jell-O in 2 cups boiling water.
Add frozen orange juice concentrate and pineapple juice; then add apple juice. Freeze in plastic jugs.
Before serving, thaw to a slush and add 3 litre bottle of Sprite or Ginger Ale. Serves 20 - 25.
recipes.text: Punch. Dissolve Jell-O in 2 cups boiling water. Add frozen orange juice concentrate and pineapple juice; then add apple juice. Freeze in plastic jugs. Before serving, thaw to a slush and add 3 litre bottle of Sprite or Ginger Ale. Serves 20 - 25.

recipes.title: Praline Bars
ingredients: 12 unbroken graham crackers (4 sq. to each)
directions: Place graham crackers on pan with sides.
Melt margarine in saucepan.
Add sugar and pecans.
Bring to boil and boil slowly 2 minutes.
Pour over graham crackers.
Bake at 300° for 15 minutes. Cool 10 minutes and remove from pan.
Enjoy!!
recipes.text: Praline Bars. Place graham crackers on pan with sides. Melt margarine in saucepan. Add sugar and pecans. Bring to boil and boil slowly 2 minutes. Pour over graham crackers. Bake at 300° for 15 minutes. Cool 10 minutes and remove from pan. Enjoy!!

recipes.title: Orange Smoothie
directions: Put all of the ingredients in a blender, except ice cubes, and blend for 4 seconds.
Then, add ice cubes, one at a time, to the blender and blend them.
Then, enjoy!
Makes 5 servings.
recipes.text: Orange Smoothie. Put all of the ingredients in a blender, except ice cubes, and blend for 4 seconds. Then, add ice cubes, one at a time, to the blender and blend them. Then, enjoy! Makes 5 servings.

recipes.title: Dixie Stew
directions: Combine grapefruit juice, salt and garlic.
Add beef cubes and refrigerate overnight.
Drain beef, reserving marinade.
Heat oil in skillet; brown beef on all sides.
Add green pepper and onion and saute 3 minutes.
Add tomato.
Combine marinade with brown sugar, vinegar, rosemary, cayenne and bay leaf.
Add beef and vegetables.
Cover and simmer 45 to 55 minutes or until beef is tender.
recipes.text: Dixie Stew. Combine grapefruit juice, salt and garlic. Add beef cubes and refrigerate overnight. Drain beef, reserving marinade. Heat oil in skillet; brown beef on all sides. Add green pepper and onion and saute 3 minutes. Add tomato. Combine marinade with brown sugar, vinegar, rosemary, cayenne and bay leaf. Add beef and vegetables. Cover and simmer 45 to 55 minutes or until beef is tender.

recipes.title: Bran Muffins
directions: Mix together flour, oat bran, baking powder, wheat germ and sugar.
In a large mixing bowl, soak wheat bran in milk for a couple of minutes.
Combine vegetable oil and egg.
Add to bran mixture and stir thoroughly.
Add flour mixture and stir until just moistened through.
Add soy beans and sunflower seeds.
Spoon into greased muffin pans, 2/3 to 3/4 full and bake on second shelf in oven for 18 minutes or until done.
Can be frozen.
Defrost in microwave 75 seconds at Defrost.
Makes an excellent breakfast muffin.
recipes.text: Bran Muffins. Mix together flour, oat bran, baking powder, wheat germ and sugar. In a large mixing bowl, soak wheat bran in milk for a couple of minutes. Combine vegetable oil and egg. Add to bran mixture and stir thoroughly. Add flour mixture and stir until just moistened through. Add soy beans and sunflower seeds. Spoon into greased muffin pans, 2/3 to 3/4 full and bake on second shelf in oven for 18 minutes or until done. Can be frozen. Defrost in microwave 75 seconds at Defrost. Makes an excellent breakfast muffin.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Sandwich
directions: If you still crave
a
peanut butter sandwich, try this one.
recipes.text: Peanut Butter Sandwich. If you still crave a peanut butter sandwich, try this one.

recipes.title: Potato Chip Chicken
directions: Mix crushed chips with garlic salt.
Dip chicken in melted margarine.
Roll in potato chips.
Place on baking sheet and pour remaining margarine and chips over chicken.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
Serves 4 to 6.
recipes.text: Potato Chip Chicken. Mix crushed chips with garlic salt. Dip chicken in melted margarine. Roll in potato chips. Place on baking sheet and pour remaining margarine and chips over chicken. Bake at 350° for 1 hour. Serves 4 to 6.

recipes.title: It'S A Snap Apple Pie
directions: Line medium size pan with graham crackers.
Add spices and sugar to taste to the applesauce.
Pour thin layer of applesauce mixture over graham crackers, then put another layer of graham crackers and then another layer of sauce.
Put a layer of graham crackers on top and top with Cool Whip.
Cover and refrigerate for 12 to 24 hours before serving.
recipes.text: It'S A Snap Apple Pie. Line medium size pan with graham crackers. Add spices and sugar to taste to the applesauce. Pour thin layer of applesauce mixture over graham crackers, then put another layer of graham crackers and then another layer of sauce. Put a layer of graham crackers on top and top with Cool Whip. Cover and refrigerate for 12 to 24 hours before serving.

recipes.title: Sweet Potato Casserole(In Honor Of Lady Posey)
ingredients: 3 c. cooked, mashed sweet potatoes, drained if canned
directions: Lightly grease the bottoms and sides of a glass 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish with butter or margarine.
It is important that only "lightly" greased.
Spoon well mixed mixture into the baking dish and prepare topping.
recipes.text: Sweet Potato Casserole(In Honor Of Lady Posey). Lightly grease the bottoms and sides of a glass 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish with butter or margarine. It is important that only "lightly" greased. Spoon well mixed mixture into the baking dish and prepare topping.

recipes.title: Crock-Pot Pepper Steak
directions: Cut beef into strips; brown in oil in skillet.
Put in crock-pot.
Combine next seven items; pour over beef.
Cook on low for 6 hours.
Add tomatoes and green peppers and cook 1 hour longer.
Combine water and cornstarch to make paste; stir into liquid in slow cooker and cook on high until thickened.
Serve over noodles or rice.
recipes.text: Crock-Pot Pepper Steak. Cut beef into strips; brown in oil in skillet. Put in crock-pot. Combine next seven items; pour over beef. Cook on low for 6 hours. Add tomatoes and green peppers and cook 1 hour longer. Combine water and cornstarch to make paste; stir into liquid in slow cooker and cook on high until thickened. Serve over noodles or rice.

recipes.title: Never-Fail Beef Casserole
directions: Brown meat. Drain and combine with rice, celery, soy sauce and mushrooms. Combine soup and water. Blend into meat mixture. Bake uncovered at 350° until bubbly, about 1 1/2 hrs. Serves 6-8.
recipes.text: Never-Fail Beef Casserole. Brown meat. Drain and combine with rice, celery, soy sauce and mushrooms. Combine soup and water. Blend into meat mixture. Bake uncovered at 350° until bubbly, about 1 1/2 hrs. Serves 6-8.

recipes.title: Strawberry Bread
ingredients: 1 c. fresh or frozen strawberries, mashed
directions: Preheat oven to 350°.
Beat shortening until creamy.
Add sugar and beat until creamy.
Add eggs and dry ingredients.
Fold in strawberries.
Pour into greased loaf pan.
Bake for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Strawberry Bread. Preheat oven to 350°. Beat shortening until creamy. Add sugar and beat until creamy. Add eggs and dry ingredients. Fold in strawberries. Pour into greased loaf pan. Bake for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Red Rice
directions: Place rice in frying pan with oil or bacon fat.
Add onion and garlic, minced.
Fry 10 minutes; add rest of ingredients.
Cook slowly about 1 hour.
Add water as needed until rice is tender.
recipes.text: Red Rice. Place rice in frying pan with oil or bacon fat. Add onion and garlic, minced. Fry 10 minutes; add rest of ingredients. Cook slowly about 1 hour. Add water as needed until rice is tender.

recipes.title: Mississippi Mud Texas Sheet Cake
directions: Mix together sugar, flour, salt and baking soda and set aside. In a separate saucepan mix together water, Crisco, butter and cocoa.
Bring to a boil and pour over flour mixture and beat well. Add vanilla, eggs, and buttermilk.
Beat again and pour into well greased pan, 15 x 10 x 1. Bake for 20-25 minutes at 350°.
Ice.
recipes.text: Mississippi Mud Texas Sheet Cake. Mix together sugar, flour, salt and baking soda and set aside. In a separate saucepan mix together water, Crisco, butter and cocoa. Bring to a boil and pour over flour mixture and beat well. Add vanilla, eggs, and buttermilk. Beat again and pour into well greased pan, 15 x 10 x 1. Bake for 20-25 minutes at 350°. Ice.

recipes.title: Sugar-Free Banana Nut Bread
directions: Mix mashed bananas, oil, egg and sweetener.
Add dry ingredients.
Last, stir in nuts and raisins.
Bake in 350° oven for 35 or 40 minutes.
recipes.text: Sugar-Free Banana Nut Bread. Mix mashed bananas, oil, egg and sweetener. Add dry ingredients. Last, stir in nuts and raisins. Bake in 350° oven for 35 or 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Fettucini Alfredo
directions: Put 2/3 cup of cream and all of butter in saucepan and simmer over medium heat until thickened.
Turn off heat.
recipes.text: Fettucini Alfredo. Put 2/3 cup of cream and all of butter in saucepan and simmer over medium heat until thickened. Turn off heat.

recipes.title: Rice Pilaf
directions: Chop mushrooms and saute with onions in 1/2 stick margarine. Cover rice with mushrooms and onions; add beef broth.
Bake in a 2-quart casserole dish, uncovered, for 1 hour at 350°.
recipes.text: Rice Pilaf. Chop mushrooms and saute with onions in 1/2 stick margarine. Cover rice with mushrooms and onions; add beef broth. Bake in a 2-quart casserole dish, uncovered, for 1 hour at 350°.

recipes.title: Fruit Salad
ingredients: 1 large can chunk pineapple in own juice
1 large pkg. unsweetened large frozen strawberries
directions: Mix all ingredients in a large bowl and refrigerate.
recipes.text: Fruit Salad. Mix all ingredients in a large bowl and refrigerate.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Crumb Pie
directions: Place powdered sugar and peanut butter in small bowl.
Cut with pastry cutter until it resembles crumbs (size of very small peas).
Sprinkle 1/2 mixture in bottom of pie crust; reserve the rest for later.
Prepare pudding according to directions on box; pour over crumbs in crust.
Cover top with thawed Cool Whip. Cover Cool Whip with reserved crumbs.
Refrigerate 3 to 4 hours before serving.
recipes.text: Peanut Butter Crumb Pie. Place powdered sugar and peanut butter in small bowl. Cut with pastry cutter until it resembles crumbs (size of very small peas). Sprinkle 1/2 mixture in bottom of pie crust; reserve the rest for later. Prepare pudding according to directions on box; pour over crumbs in crust. Cover top with thawed Cool Whip. Cover Cool Whip with reserved crumbs. Refrigerate 3 to 4 hours before serving.

recipes.title: White Chocolate Cake
directions: Melt chocolate in hot water and cool.
Cream butter and sugar; add egg yolks one at a time, beating after each.
Add chocolate mixture and vanilla, adding alternately.
Sift flour and baking soda together.
Add with butter and milk.
Don't overheat.
recipes.text: White Chocolate Cake. Melt chocolate in hot water and cool. Cream butter and sugar; add egg yolks one at a time, beating after each. Add chocolate mixture and vanilla, adding alternately. Sift flour and baking soda together. Add with butter and milk. Don't overheat.

recipes.title: Spicy Zucchini Corn Bread
directions: Heat oven to 400°.
Coat 10-inch cast-iron skillet with oil. Heat over medium heat.
Whisk milk, eggs, and chipotle in large bowl.
Stir in corn muffin mix, zucchini, and cheese until just combined.
Spread in hot skillet.
Bake 21-23 minutes until set in center and top is evenly browned.
Cool in skillet on wire rack at least 15 minutes before serving.
Serves 6-8.
recipes.text: Spicy Zucchini Corn Bread. Heat oven to 400°. Coat 10-inch cast-iron skillet with oil. Heat over medium heat. Whisk milk, eggs, and chipotle in large bowl. Stir in corn muffin mix, zucchini, and cheese until just combined. Spread in hot skillet. Bake 21-23 minutes until set in center and top is evenly browned. Cool in skillet on wire rack at least 15 minutes before serving. Serves 6-8.

recipes.title: Mama'S Macaroni And Cheese
directions: Cook vermicelli according to package directions.
Drain and combine
all
ingredients; mix well.
Pour into casserole dish. Place sliced
cheese on top.
Bake at 350° for 20 to 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Mama'S Macaroni And Cheese. Cook vermicelli according to package directions. Drain and combine all ingredients; mix well. Pour into casserole dish. Place sliced cheese on top. Bake at 350° for 20 to 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Quick Green Beans
ingredients: 2 lb. snap beans or 2 cans or 2 pkg. frozen
directions: If fresh beans, wash well, snip off stems, then sliver, French-style.
Put fresh beans into a pan, adding boiling water to not quite cover beans.
Cover tightly; bring to boiling over high heat, then remove the lid and cook until crisp-tender.
(For canned beans, drain and cook the liquid down to half over high heat.) For all, turn a few times during cooking; you want to prevent scorching as the liquid cooks away.
When finished, there should be barely a spoonful of liquid in the pot.
While the beans are cooking, saute pecans in butter over low heat until very crisp.
When beans are tender-crisp, add 2 tablespoons butter, salt and pepper to taste, then the Accent.
Add the pecans; toss slightly.
Serve at once.
Serves 4 to 6.
recipes.text: Quick Green Beans. If fresh beans, wash well, snip off stems, then sliver, French-style. Put fresh beans into a pan, adding boiling water to not quite cover beans. Cover tightly; bring to boiling over high heat, then remove the lid and cook until crisp-tender. (For canned beans, drain and cook the liquid down to half over high heat.) For all, turn a few times during cooking; you want to prevent scorching as the liquid cooks away. When finished, there should be barely a spoonful of liquid in the pot. While the beans are cooking, saute pecans in butter over low heat until very crisp. When beans are tender-crisp, add 2 tablespoons butter, salt and pepper to taste, then the Accent. Add the pecans; toss slightly. Serve at once. Serves 4 to 6.

recipes.title: Wanda'S Seven Layer Salad
directions: Layer the above ingredients in the order given or toss the ingredients all together.
recipes.text: Wanda'S Seven Layer Salad. Layer the above ingredients in the order given or toss the ingredients all together.

recipes.title: Tropical Fruit Cake
ingredients: 1 box Duncan Hines butter cake mix
directions: Beat these ingredients.
Grease and flour pans.
Bake in three layers for 30 minutes at 325°.
Cool.
recipes.text: Tropical Fruit Cake. Beat these ingredients. Grease and flour pans. Bake in three layers for 30 minutes at 325°. Cool.

recipes.title: Dill Pickles
directions: Wash fresh picked small cucumbers and pack in sterilized quart jars.
Add 1 clove garlic, 1 sprig fresh dill and 1/4 teaspoon mustard seed.
recipes.text: Dill Pickles. Wash fresh picked small cucumbers and pack in sterilized quart jars. Add 1 clove garlic, 1 sprig fresh dill and 1/4 teaspoon mustard seed.

recipes.title: Golden Chicken Surprise
directions: Preheat oven to 350°.
Remove skin from chicken; wipe dry. Melt butter with garlic, salt, poultry seasoning and pepper.
Mix potato chips and cornflakes together.
Dip chicken in butter mixture and then into crumbs. Arrange in baking pan.
Remove garlic from butter mixture.
Pour butter over chicken.
Bake for about 1 hour.
recipes.text: Golden Chicken Surprise. Preheat oven to 350°. Remove skin from chicken; wipe dry. Melt butter with garlic, salt, poultry seasoning and pepper. Mix potato chips and cornflakes together. Dip chicken in butter mixture and then into crumbs. Arrange in baking pan. Remove garlic from butter mixture. Pour butter over chicken. Bake for about 1 hour.

recipes.title: Pepper Cabbage
directions: Mix together the sugar, vinegar, pepper, salt and celery seed. Pour over the prepared vegetables and mix well.
recipes.text: Pepper Cabbage. Mix together the sugar, vinegar, pepper, salt and celery seed. Pour over the prepared vegetables and mix well.

recipes.title: Beef And Zucchini
ingredients: 1 to 2 lb. lean boneless round steak strips
directions: Heat oil
in
skillet, add onions and garlic and saute. Add meat
and
cook
through.
Add zucchini, oregano, salt and pepper (zucchini
should be tender, but crisp).
Add tomatoes last and just
heat
through.
Sprinkle
all with parsley and lemon juice and toss gently.
Serve with rice.
recipes.text: Beef And Zucchini. Heat oil in skillet, add onions and garlic and saute. Add meat and cook through. Add zucchini, oregano, salt and pepper (zucchini should be tender, but crisp). Add tomatoes last and just heat through. Sprinkle all with parsley and lemon juice and toss gently. Serve with rice.

recipes.title: Italian Cream Cake
directions: Cream margarine, Crisco and sugar well. Add egg yolks 1 at a time (beat well after each addition). Sift soda and flour together. Add to creamed mixture alternating with buttermilk. Beat in coconut, nuts and vanilla. Beat egg whites until stiff and then fold into cake mixture. This will make 3 layers. Bake at 350° for 25 minutes. This will depend on your oven. Cool.
recipes.text: Italian Cream Cake. Cream margarine, Crisco and sugar well. Add egg yolks 1 at a time (beat well after each addition). Sift soda and flour together. Add to creamed mixture alternating with buttermilk. Beat in coconut, nuts and vanilla. Beat egg whites until stiff and then fold into cake mixture. This will make 3 layers. Bake at 350° for 25 minutes. This will depend on your oven. Cool.

recipes.title: Old Fashioned Molasses Cookies
directions: Mix oil, molasses, egg and sugar.
Sift all dry ingredients into oil mixture.
Blend thoroughly.
Chill dough at least 1 hour. Roll into balls (about 1 teaspoon), then roll each ball in white granulated sugar.
Bake on greased cookie sheet for about 10 minutes.
Try not to overbake.
Bake in 350° oven.
recipes.text: Old Fashioned Molasses Cookies. Mix oil, molasses, egg and sugar. Sift all dry ingredients into oil mixture. Blend thoroughly. Chill dough at least 1 hour. Roll into balls (about 1 teaspoon), then roll each ball in white granulated sugar. Bake on greased cookie sheet for about 10 minutes. Try not to overbake. Bake in 350° oven.

recipes.title: Zucchini Pineapple Bread
ingredients: 1 (8 1/2 oz.) can crushed pineapple, well drained
directions: Beat together eggs, oil, sugar and vanilla until thick.
Stir in remaining ingredients; mix well.
Pour into 2 greased and floured loaf pans.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
Cool on rack 10 minutes.
Remove from pans.
Cool completely before slicing.
recipes.text: Zucchini Pineapple Bread. Beat together eggs, oil, sugar and vanilla until thick. Stir in remaining ingredients; mix well. Pour into 2 greased and floured loaf pans. Bake at 350° for 1 hour. Cool on rack 10 minutes. Remove from pans. Cool completely before slicing.

recipes.title: Cucumber Salad
directions: Dissolve gelatin in boiling water in bowl.
Add cucumber, onion, green pepper, vinegar, mayonnaise and cottage cheese; mix well.
Pour into serving bowl.
Chill until set.
Yield:
6 servings.
recipes.text: Cucumber Salad. Dissolve gelatin in boiling water in bowl. Add cucumber, onion, green pepper, vinegar, mayonnaise and cottage cheese; mix well. Pour into serving bowl. Chill until set. Yield: 6 servings.

recipes.title: Pecan Sandies
directions: Cream butter and sugar.
Gradually work flour into creamed mixture.
Stir in vanilla and nuts.
Form into small balls.
Bake on an ungreased sheet in a 325° gas oven for 20 to 25 minutes. Cool slightly and roll in powdered sugar.
Makes 5 to 6 dozen.
recipes.text: Pecan Sandies. Cream butter and sugar. Gradually work flour into creamed mixture. Stir in vanilla and nuts. Form into small balls. Bake on an ungreased sheet in a 325° gas oven for 20 to 25 minutes. Cool slightly and roll in powdered sugar. Makes 5 to 6 dozen.

recipes.title: Pudding Delight
directions: Boil together water and butter, then add flour.
Blend and cool for 10 minutes.
Add eggs, one at a time, beating well.
Spread on a greased jelly roll pan but don't go to the edges.
It spreads during baking.
Bake at 400° for 20 to 25 minutes.
Leave cool, then press down.
recipes.text: Pudding Delight. Boil together water and butter, then add flour. Blend and cool for 10 minutes. Add eggs, one at a time, beating well. Spread on a greased jelly roll pan but don't go to the edges. It spreads during baking. Bake at 400° for 20 to 25 minutes. Leave cool, then press down.

recipes.title: De Walt Cooked Coleslaw Sauce
directions: Mix sugar and mayonnaise in a small skillet.
Add vinegar and cook over medium heat until it bubbles a bit.
If you'd like, add a tablespoon of celery seed to mixture before cooking.
Add sauce to cabbage, carrot and onion.
recipes.text: De Walt Cooked Coleslaw Sauce. Mix sugar and mayonnaise in a small skillet. Add vinegar and cook over medium heat until it bubbles a bit. If you'd like, add a tablespoon of celery seed to mixture before cooking. Add sauce to cabbage, carrot and onion.

recipes.title: Ten-Cup Salad
directions: Combine pineapple, oranges, coconut and marshmallows. Mix sour cream, mayonnaise and sugar; fold into the fruit mixture. Store in a bowl overnight. Serve chilled. This makes a BIG salad for a crowd.
recipes.text: Ten-Cup Salad. Combine pineapple, oranges, coconut and marshmallows. Mix sour cream, mayonnaise and sugar; fold into the fruit mixture. Store in a bowl overnight. Serve chilled. This makes a BIG salad for a crowd.

recipes.title: Cheese Thins
directions: Mix pepper and margarine (cream).
Add flour.
Mix well.
Add cheese and Rice Krispies.
Form into small balls.
Place on greased cookie sheet.
Press with fork dipped in ice water.
Bake at 350° for 10 minutes.
recipes.text: Cheese Thins. Mix pepper and margarine (cream). Add flour. Mix well. Add cheese and Rice Krispies. Form into small balls. Place on greased cookie sheet. Press with fork dipped in ice water. Bake at 350° for 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Diet Apple Pie
ingredients: 1 (6 oz.) can frozen apple juice concentrate
directions: Combine spices, margarine and cornstarch in bowl.
Set aside. Put apple juice in saucepan and bring to boil.
Add small amount of spice mixture until all blends.
Add Equal and mix well.
Put apples in pie crust.
Pour mixture over apples and cover with a crust.
Bake for 30 minutes at 450°, then reduce heat to 370° and cook for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Diet Apple Pie. Combine spices, margarine and cornstarch in bowl. Set aside. Put apple juice in saucepan and bring to boil. Add small amount of spice mixture until all blends. Add Equal and mix well. Put apples in pie crust. Pour mixture over apples and cover with a crust. Bake for 30 minutes at 450°, then reduce heat to 370° and cook for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: French Fried Potato Salad
