directions: In a large saucepan, bring the 4 cups water to a rolling boil. Carefully drop frozen potatoes into water; remove from heat. Immediately cover and let stand 4 to 5 minutes.
Drain potatoes at once. Spread on paper towel.
Cut up any large pieces.
Sprinkle salt on the potatoes; cool.
In a bowl, combine eggs, radishes, celery, green onion and snipped parsley. Add mayonnaise, vinegar and potatoes. Toss mixture gently. Chill.
recipes.text: French Fried Potato Salad. In a large saucepan, bring the 4 cups water to a rolling boil. Carefully drop frozen potatoes into water; remove from heat. Immediately cover and let stand 4 to 5 minutes. Drain potatoes at once. Spread on paper towel. Cut up any large pieces. Sprinkle salt on the potatoes; cool. In a bowl, combine eggs, radishes, celery, green onion and snipped parsley. Add mayonnaise, vinegar and potatoes. Toss mixture gently. Chill.

recipes.title: Chicken Kellaguin
directions: Using a fork, separate chicken from bones.
Remove skin, if you desire, and then shred chicken.
Add chicken, coconut, green onions and red pepper flakes.
Mix thoroughly.
When dish is ready to be served, add lemon juice; mix well.
Add salt and pepper to taste. Serves 4.
recipes.text: Chicken Kellaguin. Using a fork, separate chicken from bones. Remove skin, if you desire, and then shred chicken. Add chicken, coconut, green onions and red pepper flakes. Mix thoroughly. When dish is ready to be served, add lemon juice; mix well. Add salt and pepper to taste. Serves 4.

recipes.title: Congo Squares
ingredients: 1 (6 oz.) pkg. chocolate or butterscotch bits
directions: Mix melted margarine, eggs and sugar.
Cool slightly.
Add dry ingredients and vanilla. Mix well.
Stir in chocolate bits and nuts.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes in a long flat casserole.
recipes.text: Congo Squares. Mix melted margarine, eggs and sugar. Cool slightly. Add dry ingredients and vanilla. Mix well. Stir in chocolate bits and nuts. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes in a long flat casserole.

recipes.title: Reese'S Peanut Butter Pie
directions: Mix brownie mix according to directions on package.
Divide brownie mix into 2 unbaked pie crusts.
Bake 15 minutes or until pie crust is brown.
Combine peanut butter and 8 ounces cream cheese with 1 cup milk until smooth.
Gradually add rest of milk. Add pudding and blend until thick.
Pour over baked brownie mix in pie shell.
Refrigerate.
Top with whipped cream or Cool Whip. Sprinkle with cut up Reese's peanut butter cups.
recipes.text: Reese'S Peanut Butter Pie. Mix brownie mix according to directions on package. Divide brownie mix into 2 unbaked pie crusts. Bake 15 minutes or until pie crust is brown. Combine peanut butter and 8 ounces cream cheese with 1 cup milk until smooth. Gradually add rest of milk. Add pudding and blend until thick. Pour over baked brownie mix in pie shell. Refrigerate. Top with whipped cream or Cool Whip. Sprinkle with cut up Reese's peanut butter cups.

recipes.title: Coca-Cola Cake
directions: Combine flour, sugar and marshmallows in a mixing bowl.
Heat butter, cocoa and Coca-Cola to boiling and combine with the first mixture.
Add buttermilk, eggs, soda and vanilla which have been beaten together first and mix well.
This will be a thin batter with some marshmallows floating on top.
Bake in greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan for 30 to 35 minutes at 350°.
Ice while hot.
recipes.text: Coca-Cola Cake. Combine flour, sugar and marshmallows in a mixing bowl. Heat butter, cocoa and Coca-Cola to boiling and combine with the first mixture. Add buttermilk, eggs, soda and vanilla which have been beaten together first and mix well. This will be a thin batter with some marshmallows floating on top. Bake in greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan for 30 to 35 minutes at 350°. Ice while hot.

recipes.title: Eggplant Dressing
directions: Brown onion and green pepper in oil until soft.
Add turkey and cook.
Add a cup of hot water and rice.
Put eggplant in casserole sliced in cubes.
Put mixture over eggplant.
Cover and cook at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Eggplant Dressing. Brown onion and green pepper in oil until soft. Add turkey and cook. Add a cup of hot water and rice. Put eggplant in casserole sliced in cubes. Put mixture over eggplant. Cover and cook at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Mallow-Whip Sweet Potatoes
ingredients: 2 (17 oz.) cans sweet potatoes, drained and mashed
directions: Reserve 1/2 cup marshmallows.
Combine remaining ingredients; mix lightly.
Spoon into 1-quart casserole.
Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.
Sprinkle with reserved marshmallows and broil until lightly browned.
Makes 6 servings.
recipes.text: Mallow-Whip Sweet Potatoes. Reserve 1/2 cup marshmallows. Combine remaining ingredients; mix lightly. Spoon into 1-quart casserole. Bake at 350° for 20 minutes. Sprinkle with reserved marshmallows and broil until lightly browned. Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Sweet-N-Sour Chicken
ingredients: 1 (8 oz.) bottle Thousand Island salad dressing
1 pkg. chicken breasts (can be cut in pieces or left whole)
directions: Bake chicken breasts at 350° until done.
Stir in remaining ingredients and continue cooking until bubbling.
Good to serve over noodles.
recipes.text: Sweet-N-Sour Chicken. Bake chicken breasts at 350° until done. Stir in remaining ingredients and continue cooking until bubbling. Good to serve over noodles.

recipes.title: Chicken And Rice Delight
directions: Combine soups, rice and water in large casserole dish.
Place pieces of chicken on top of mixture.
Bake at 350° covered for one hour.
Uncover.
Sprinkle with paprika.
Continue cooking uncovered for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Chicken And Rice Delight. Combine soups, rice and water in large casserole dish. Place pieces of chicken on top of mixture. Bake at 350° covered for one hour. Uncover. Sprinkle with paprika. Continue cooking uncovered for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Sweet And Sour Chicken
directions: Mix well and pour over 2 chickens, cut up.
Bake in casserole dish at 350° for 1 to 1 1/2 hours.
Baste once during cooking. Serve over rice.
recipes.text: Sweet And Sour Chicken. Mix well and pour over 2 chickens, cut up. Bake in casserole dish at 350° for 1 to 1 1/2 hours. Baste once during cooking. Serve over rice.

recipes.title: Frozen Fruit Salad
directions: Mix all together and freeze.
May substitute peaches, melon or grapes for fruit choices.
recipes.text: Frozen Fruit Salad. Mix all together and freeze. May substitute peaches, melon or grapes for fruit choices.

recipes.title: Phyllis'S Chicken Casserole
directions: Preheat oven to 350°.
Mix all ingredients together.
Top with crushed potato chips.
Pour into 9 x 13-inch pan.
Bake for 1/2 hour at 350°.
recipes.text: Phyllis'S Chicken Casserole. Preheat oven to 350°. Mix all ingredients together. Top with crushed potato chips. Pour into 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake for 1/2 hour at 350°.

recipes.title: Layered Southwestern Dip
ingredients: 1 can (28-oz.) Spicy Refried Beans with Jalapenos (Rosarita brand preferred)
1/2 envelope dry chili or taco seasoning mix
2 medium tomatoes, peeled, seeded and diced
2 c. (8 oz.) Cheddar or Monterrey Jack cheese, shredded
directions: In a small bowl mix chili seasoning with 1 1/2 cups of the sour cream; set aside.
In another small bowl mix 1/2 cup sour cream into the guacamole.
Layer the refried beans, guacamole, and sour cream mixture (one layer each) in a large deep dish in the order listed.
Sprinkle with the shredded cheese, chopped green onions, olives, and diced tomatoes.
Chill for 1 hour to blend flavors.
Serve with your favorite chips.
Makes 8-10 servings.
recipes.text: Layered Southwestern Dip. In a small bowl mix chili seasoning with 1 1/2 cups of the sour cream; set aside. In another small bowl mix 1/2 cup sour cream into the guacamole. Layer the refried beans, guacamole, and sour cream mixture (one layer each) in a large deep dish in the order listed. Sprinkle with the shredded cheese, chopped green onions, olives, and diced tomatoes. Chill for 1 hour to blend flavors. Serve with your favorite chips. Makes 8-10 servings.

recipes.title: Shrimp Or Crab Salad
ingredients: 1 lb. fresh shrimp or imitation crab
directions: Mix all ingredients together.
Needs to set several hours (refrigerated).
recipes.text: Shrimp Or Crab Salad. Mix all ingredients together. Needs to set several hours (refrigerated).

recipes.title: Wine Coolers
directions: Mix one part wine with two parts seltzer and add a splash of fruit juice (such as orange or pineapple).
Has 8 calories per ounce.
recipes.text: Wine Coolers. Mix one part wine with two parts seltzer and add a splash of fruit juice (such as orange or pineapple). Has 8 calories per ounce.

recipes.title: Banana Muffins
directions: Cream together butter, sugar, eggs, vanilla, bananas and sour cream.
Mix flour, soda, baking powder and salt.
Blend into cream mixture.
Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.
Makes 28 muffins.
recipes.text: Banana Muffins. Cream together butter, sugar, eggs, vanilla, bananas and sour cream. Mix flour, soda, baking powder and salt. Blend into cream mixture. Bake at 350° for 20 minutes. Makes 28 muffins.

recipes.title: Country Or Cured Ham
directions: Use a 15 gallon pot.
recipes.text: Country Or Cured Ham. Use a 15 gallon pot.

recipes.title: Coconut Pie(Self Crust)
directions: Mix ingredients as listed.
Pour into greased pie pan.
Bake for 45 minutes at 350°.
recipes.text: Coconut Pie(Self Crust). Mix ingredients as listed. Pour into greased pie pan. Bake for 45 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Chocolate Velvet Cheesecake
ingredients: 2 (8 oz.) pkg. Philadelphia cream cheese, softened
directions: Combine crumbs, nuts, 3 tablespoons granulated sugar and margarine.
Press onto bottom of 9-inch spring-form pan.
Bake at 325° for 10 minutes.
Combine cream cheese and brown sugar, mixing at medium speed with electric mixer until well blended.
Add eggs, one at a time, mixing well after each.
Blend in chocolate, milk, and vanilla extract; pour over crust.
Bake at 325° for 35 minutes. Combine sour cream and 2 tablespoons granulated sugar; carefully spread over cheesecake.
Bake at 425° for 10 minutes.
Loosen cake from rim of pan.
Cool before removing rim of pan.
Chill.
Garnish with mint candies.
recipes.text: Chocolate Velvet Cheesecake. Combine crumbs, nuts, 3 tablespoons granulated sugar and margarine. Press onto bottom of 9-inch spring-form pan. Bake at 325° for 10 minutes. Combine cream cheese and brown sugar, mixing at medium speed with electric mixer until well blended. Add eggs, one at a time, mixing well after each. Blend in chocolate, milk, and vanilla extract; pour over crust. Bake at 325° for 35 minutes. Combine sour cream and 2 tablespoons granulated sugar; carefully spread over cheesecake. Bake at 425° for 10 minutes. Loosen cake from rim of pan. Cool before removing rim of pan. Chill. Garnish with mint candies.

recipes.title: Zucchini Casserole
directions: Beat eggs.
Add salt and pepper.
Mix with other ingredients. Pour into greased 9-inch pie pan.
Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.
recipes.text: Zucchini Casserole. Beat eggs. Add salt and pepper. Mix with other ingredients. Pour into greased 9-inch pie pan. Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Aunt Bea'S Potatoes
directions: In skillet, saute onions in oil or margarine.
Combine with hash browns, soup, sour cream and cheese.
Spread in lightly greased 9 x 13-inch pan.
Combine cornflakes and melted butter. Sprinkle over top.
Bake in 350° oven for 1 hour and 15 minutes.
recipes.text: Aunt Bea'S Potatoes. In skillet, saute onions in oil or margarine. Combine with hash browns, soup, sour cream and cheese. Spread in lightly greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Combine cornflakes and melted butter. Sprinkle over top. Bake in 350° oven for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Pineapple Cookies
directions: Sift together the first 4 ingredients.
Mix shortening, sugar, egg and vanilla until creamy.
Mix in pineapple and then flour mixture. Drop by teaspoon 2-inches apart on greased cookie sheet. Sprinkle cookies with a mixture of the nutmeg and 1 tablespoon sugar.
Bake at 375° until golden brown for 12 minutes.
Makes 3 dozen.
recipes.text: Pineapple Cookies. Sift together the first 4 ingredients. Mix shortening, sugar, egg and vanilla until creamy. Mix in pineapple and then flour mixture. Drop by teaspoon 2-inches apart on greased cookie sheet. Sprinkle cookies with a mixture of the nutmeg and 1 tablespoon sugar. Bake at 375° until golden brown for 12 minutes. Makes 3 dozen.

recipes.title: Poppy Seed Chicken
ingredients: 6 to 8 chicken breasts, cooked and chopped
directions: Grease a 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Layer chicken on bottom of pan.
Mix soup and sour cream.
Layer over chicken.
Place cracker crumbs on top of soup layer.
Sprinkle poppy seed on top.
Pour melted margarine over the entire mixture.
Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.
recipes.text: Poppy Seed Chicken. Grease a 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Layer chicken on bottom of pan. Mix soup and sour cream. Layer over chicken. Place cracker crumbs on top of soup layer. Sprinkle poppy seed on top. Pour melted margarine over the entire mixture. Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.

recipes.title: Hanukkah Fruit Balls
ingredients: 1 lb. candied red or green cherries, cut up
directions: Combine all ingredients in mixing bowl.
Wet hands and shape balls.
Put 1-inch apart on cookie sheet and bake at 350° for 15 or 20 minutes.
recipes.text: Hanukkah Fruit Balls. Combine all ingredients in mixing bowl. Wet hands and shape balls. Put 1-inch apart on cookie sheet and bake at 350° for 15 or 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Chicken Casserole
ingredients: 1 can chicken stock (utilize the broth from cooked chicken)
directions: In saucepan, saute onion in margarine until clear.
Add soups, stock, chilies and seasonings.
In 9 x 13-inch pan, put layer of chunked tortillas, 1/2 of sauce and 1/2 of chicken.
Repeat layers. Top with grated cheese and bake about 30 minutes in medium oven. Let set about 15 minutes before serving.
recipes.text: Chicken Casserole. In saucepan, saute onion in margarine until clear. Add soups, stock, chilies and seasonings. In 9 x 13-inch pan, put layer of chunked tortillas, 1/2 of sauce and 1/2 of chicken. Repeat layers. Top with grated cheese and bake about 30 minutes in medium oven. Let set about 15 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Cucumber Sour Cream Salad
directions: Sprinkle cucumbers with salt.
Chill.
Mix sour cream with remaining ingredients.
Drain cucumbers thoroughly; add to sour cream and mix well.
Serve immediately.
Serves 8.
recipes.text: Cucumber Sour Cream Salad. Sprinkle cucumbers with salt. Chill. Mix sour cream with remaining ingredients. Drain cucumbers thoroughly; add to sour cream and mix well. Serve immediately. Serves 8.

recipes.title: Potato Soup
directions: Cook potatoes and carrots until tender in small amount of water.
Fry bacon until crisp and crumble.
Save 2 tablespoons bacon fat and saute onion and celery.
Combine onion, celery, salt, pepper and crumbled bacon.
Add to potatoes.
Add half and half and milk.
Simmer 30 minutes.
Sprinkle cheese and parsley on before serving.
recipes.text: Potato Soup. Cook potatoes and carrots until tender in small amount of water. Fry bacon until crisp and crumble. Save 2 tablespoons bacon fat and saute onion and celery. Combine onion, celery, salt, pepper and crumbled bacon. Add to potatoes. Add half and half and milk. Simmer 30 minutes. Sprinkle cheese and parsley on before serving.

recipes.title: Cheese Cake(High Cholesterol)
directions: Mix graham cracker crumbs, butter, walnuts and cinnamon and place in bottom of cake pan.
Mix remaining ingredients and pour into pan.
Bake at 375° for 35 minutes.
recipes.text: Cheese Cake(High Cholesterol). Mix graham cracker crumbs, butter, walnuts and cinnamon and place in bottom of cake pan. Mix remaining ingredients and pour into pan. Bake at 375° for 35 minutes.

recipes.title: Cranberry Chicken
directions: Mix everything and spread on chicken.
Bake in oven at 350° to 400° for 1 1/2 hours.
recipes.text: Cranberry Chicken. Mix everything and spread on chicken. Bake in oven at 350° to 400° for 1 1/2 hours.

recipes.title: Rhubarb Custard Pie
directions: Cut rhubarb in small pieces. Beat the eggs. Add the sugar, salt and flour.
Mix well. Add the rhubarb.
Pour into unbaked pie shell (9-inch).
Roll out dough for top crust.
Put on top.
Seal tightly the edges of the pie.
Make slits in crust to allow steam to escape.
Brush milk lightly over crust and sprinkle with sugar (optional).
Bake at 425° for 15 minutes, then reduce heat to 375° for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Rhubarb Custard Pie. Cut rhubarb in small pieces. Beat the eggs. Add the sugar, salt and flour. Mix well. Add the rhubarb. Pour into unbaked pie shell (9-inch). Roll out dough for top crust. Put on top. Seal tightly the edges of the pie. Make slits in crust to allow steam to escape. Brush milk lightly over crust and sprinkle with sugar (optional). Bake at 425° for 15 minutes, then reduce heat to 375° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Chocolate Mint Bars
ingredients: 6 sq. unsweetened chocolate (save 2 sq. to drizzle over frosting)
directions: Melt margarine and chocolate in saucepan.
Beat eggs and sugar well and add chocolate mixture to this.
Add flour, vanilla, salt and chopped walnuts to mixture.
Bake in greased 13 x 9-inch pan at 350° for 35 minutes.
Cool in pan.
When cool, frost with Peppermint Frosting.
recipes.text: Chocolate Mint Bars. Melt margarine and chocolate in saucepan. Beat eggs and sugar well and add chocolate mixture to this. Add flour, vanilla, salt and chopped walnuts to mixture. Bake in greased 13 x 9-inch pan at 350° for 35 minutes. Cool in pan. When cool, frost with Peppermint Frosting.

recipes.title: Potato Soup
directions: Boil onion, celery and potatoes until tender.
Save water. (Mash potatoes if you want.)
Add salt, butter and canned milk. Add instant potatoes to thicken.
recipes.text: Potato Soup. Boil onion, celery and potatoes until tender. Save water. (Mash potatoes if you want.) Add salt, butter and canned milk. Add instant potatoes to thicken.

recipes.title: Oat Crunch
directions: Grease bottom of a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan.
Prepare brownie mix. Spoon into prepared pan.
recipes.text: Oat Crunch. Grease bottom of a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Prepare brownie mix. Spoon into prepared pan.

recipes.title: Apple Cinnamon Walnut Bread
directions: Mix yeast, sugar and warm water.
Proof 5 minutes.
Add warm milk, butter, cinnamon, baking soda, orange rind, apples and walnuts.
Add flours.
Knead 10 minutes.
Let rise until double. Divide into two.
Roll into rectangle.
Add 1/2 cup raisins soaked in Grand Marnier.
Put in pans (bread).
Let rise.
Bake at 425° for 10 minutes and 350° for 20 to 25 minutes.
Sprinkle with powdered sugar.
recipes.text: Apple Cinnamon Walnut Bread. Mix yeast, sugar and warm water. Proof 5 minutes. Add warm milk, butter, cinnamon, baking soda, orange rind, apples and walnuts. Add flours. Knead 10 minutes. Let rise until double. Divide into two. Roll into rectangle. Add 1/2 cup raisins soaked in Grand Marnier. Put in pans (bread). Let rise. Bake at 425° for 10 minutes and 350° for 20 to 25 minutes. Sprinkle with powdered sugar.

recipes.title: Aloha Punch
directions: Thaw concentrated juices and combine in large jar.
Add water and sugar.
Stir until sugar dissolves.
Chill well.
Add ginger ale.
Pour punch into punch bowl with blocks of ice.
With toothpick fix maraschino cherries in centers of pineapple slices. Float pineapple, banana and lime slices on punch.
Makes about 20 servings.
recipes.text: Aloha Punch. Thaw concentrated juices and combine in large jar. Add water and sugar. Stir until sugar dissolves. Chill well. Add ginger ale. Pour punch into punch bowl with blocks of ice. With toothpick fix maraschino cherries in centers of pineapple slices. Float pineapple, banana and lime slices on punch. Makes about 20 servings.

recipes.title: Fool'S Toffee
directions: In small saucepan, over medium high heat, blend butter and brown sugar.
Heat to boiling and boil for 4 minutes.
Cover 10 x 15-inch jelly roll pan with foil and butter lightly.
Place single layer of saltine crackers on foil close together.
Pour butter mixture over crackers spreading evenly.
Bake at 375° for 5 minutes.
Immediately sprinkle chocolate chips on top.
Allow to soften.
Spread evenly over cooked crackers.
Sprinkle with nuts. Refrigerate until cool.
Break into pieces and store in tin container in refrigerator.
Can be kept in refrigerator for 1 to 2 weeks.
recipes.text: Fool'S Toffee. In small saucepan, over medium high heat, blend butter and brown sugar. Heat to boiling and boil for 4 minutes. Cover 10 x 15-inch jelly roll pan with foil and butter lightly. Place single layer of saltine crackers on foil close together. Pour butter mixture over crackers spreading evenly. Bake at 375° for 5 minutes. Immediately sprinkle chocolate chips on top. Allow to soften. Spread evenly over cooked crackers. Sprinkle with nuts. Refrigerate until cool. Break into pieces and store in tin container in refrigerator. Can be kept in refrigerator for 1 to 2 weeks.

recipes.title: Carrot Cake
directions: First, mix sugar, oil and eggs.
Then mix soda, salt, cinnamon and flour.
Add to first mixture, then add the grated carrots. Mix and bake in moderate oven about 350° until done.
This makes 3 layers.
recipes.text: Carrot Cake. First, mix sugar, oil and eggs. Then mix soda, salt, cinnamon and flour. Add to first mixture, then add the grated carrots. Mix and bake in moderate oven about 350° until done. This makes 3 layers.

recipes.title: Banana Split Cake
directions: Mix graham crackers and butter; make a crust in the bottom of a long cake pan.
Mix powdered sugar and 3 eggs and beat with an electric mixer and pour over crust.
Add sliced bananas; top with Cool Whip, then sprinkle with cherries and pecans.
Refrigerate for at least 3 hours.
recipes.text: Banana Split Cake. Mix graham crackers and butter; make a crust in the bottom of a long cake pan. Mix powdered sugar and 3 eggs and beat with an electric mixer and pour over crust. Add sliced bananas; top with Cool Whip, then sprinkle with cherries and pecans. Refrigerate for at least 3 hours.

recipes.title: Deviled Ham Spread
directions: Blend all ingredients and spread on crackers.
Broil until cheese is melted.
recipes.text: Deviled Ham Spread. Blend all ingredients and spread on crackers. Broil until cheese is melted.

recipes.title: Jellied Chicken Salad
directions: Soften gelatin in 1/2 cup
cold water.	Dissolve in hot broth. Add lemon juice and
salt.
Chill until partially set. Stir in remaining ingredients;
pour
into	5 to 12 individual molds or 5 1/2-cup ring mold.	Mold
until firm.
Unmold; pass mayonnaise.
recipes.text: Jellied Chicken Salad. Soften gelatin in 1/2 cup cold water.	Dissolve in hot broth. Add lemon juice and salt. Chill until partially set. Stir in remaining ingredients; pour into	5 to 12 individual molds or 5 1/2-cup ring mold.	Mold until firm. Unmold; pass mayonnaise.

recipes.title: Three Cheese Enchiladas
directions: Combine 3 cheeses, saving 1/4 cup each of Cheddar and Monterey Jack cheeses.
Add picante sauce and mix well.
Put 1/4 cup of mixture on each tortilla shell.
Roll up, placing fold on bottom of pan.
Sprinkle remaining cheese on top.
Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 20 minutes.
Top with lettuce, tomatoes, onions and olives. Serves 4.
recipes.text: Three Cheese Enchiladas. Combine 3 cheeses, saving 1/4 cup each of Cheddar and Monterey Jack cheeses. Add picante sauce and mix well. Put 1/4 cup of mixture on each tortilla shell. Roll up, placing fold on bottom of pan. Sprinkle remaining cheese on top. Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 20 minutes. Top with lettuce, tomatoes, onions and olives. Serves 4.

recipes.title: German Potato Salad
ingredients: 3 to 4 lb. potatoes, boiled, peeled and sliced
directions: Fry bacon (diced) until crisp and leave enough grease in skillet to mix flour, vinegar, sugar, mustard and water.
Cook until thick and add sliced, cooked potatoes, onion and green pepper.
Stir.
Serve warm or cold.
Decorate with sliced, hard-boiled eggs.
recipes.text: German Potato Salad. Fry bacon (diced) until crisp and leave enough grease in skillet to mix flour, vinegar, sugar, mustard and water. Cook until thick and add sliced, cooked potatoes, onion and green pepper. Stir. Serve warm or cold. Decorate with sliced, hard-boiled eggs.

recipes.title: Marie'S Black Bean Soup
directions: First, soak beans overnight.
Boil with full quart of hot water.
Fry chopped onion, garlic, chopped green pepper and bacon. Add to beans; salt and pepper to taste.
Do not salt until tender.
Add mixture to beans, which should have some liquid, and let simmer for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Marie'S Black Bean Soup. First, soak beans overnight. Boil with full quart of hot water. Fry chopped onion, garlic, chopped green pepper and bacon. Add to beans; salt and pepper to taste. Do not salt until tender. Add mixture to beans, which should have some liquid, and let simmer for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Ranger Cookies
directions: Mix and drop 1 teaspoon of dough on a slightly greased pan. Bake 15 minutes at 350°.
Drop 1 inch apart.
recipes.text: Ranger Cookies. Mix and drop 1 teaspoon of dough on a slightly greased pan. Bake 15 minutes at 350°. Drop 1 inch apart.

recipes.title: Fruit Party Pizza
ingredients: 2 (17 oz.) pkg. refrigerated sugar cookie dough
4 c. fresh fruit (strawberries, kiwi, blueberries, grapes, plums, etc.)
directions: Preheat oven to 400°.
Slice cookie dough about 1/4-inch thick.
Place in circles in 10-inch pizza pan. Overlap slices slightly.
Press dough together with fingers to form crust.
Bake 10 minutes. Remove from oven, but leave oven on.
recipes.text: Fruit Party Pizza. Preheat oven to 400°. Slice cookie dough about 1/4-inch thick. Place in circles in 10-inch pizza pan. Overlap slices slightly. Press dough together with fingers to form crust. Bake 10 minutes. Remove from oven, but leave oven on.

recipes.title: Hungarian Stew
directions: Saute onions in oil.
Add peppers; saute 1 minute.
Add tomatoes and meat.
Cover stew for 15 minutes.
Can be made a day ahead and reheated.
recipes.text: Hungarian Stew. Saute onions in oil. Add peppers; saute 1 minute. Add tomatoes and meat. Cover stew for 15 minutes. Can be made a day ahead and reheated.

recipes.title: Coconut Pound Cake
directions: Mix oil, sugar, flour, eggs and baking powder.
Mix together buttermilk and salt.
Add buttermilk mixture to flavoring and coconut.
Bake 40 minutes in a 350° cold oven.
Use a Bundt pan or tube pan, greased and floured.
recipes.text: Coconut Pound Cake. Mix oil, sugar, flour, eggs and baking powder. Mix together buttermilk and salt. Add buttermilk mixture to flavoring and coconut. Bake 40 minutes in a 350° cold oven. Use a Bundt pan or tube pan, greased and floured.

recipes.title: Steak Marinade
directions: Mix all ingredients well.
Place steak in a shallow pan or baking dish.
Pour marinade over; let stand 3 to 5 hours, or refrigerate for a longer period of time.
Grill steak over charcoal.
recipes.text: Steak Marinade. Mix all ingredients well. Place steak in a shallow pan or baking dish. Pour marinade over; let stand 3 to 5 hours, or refrigerate for a longer period of time. Grill steak over charcoal.

recipes.title: Chocolate Dipped Strawberries
ingredients: fresh whole strawberries, rinsed and patted dry
directions: Melt semi-sweet chips, vanilla chips and oil together.
Stir often until smooth.
Holding by top, dip strawberries into melted chocolate and place on wax paper-lined baking sheet.
Cover loosely and chill until firm, about 1 hour.
recipes.text: Chocolate Dipped Strawberries. Melt semi-sweet chips, vanilla chips and oil together. Stir often until smooth. Holding by top, dip strawberries into melted chocolate and place on wax paper-lined baking sheet. Cover loosely and chill until firm, about 1 hour.

recipes.title: Caramel Corn
directions: Bring to a boil: brown sugar, margarine and white syrup and boil for 5 minutes.
Then add the baking soda, cream of tartar and salt.
Mix well and pour over the popped corn.
recipes.text: Caramel Corn. Bring to a boil: brown sugar, margarine and white syrup and boil for 5 minutes. Then add the baking soda, cream of tartar and salt. Mix well and pour over the popped corn.

recipes.title: Cheeseburger Pie
directions: Mix beef, onions and soup together and put into a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Cover mixture with a layer of cheese slices, then cover with your favorite pie crust.
Bake in 325° oven for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Cheeseburger Pie. Mix beef, onions and soup together and put into a 9 x 13-inch pan. Cover mixture with a layer of cheese slices, then cover with your favorite pie crust. Bake in 325° oven for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Waldorf Salad A La Eunice(Makes 8 To 10 Servings)
directions: Core and dice apples (do not peel).
In a large bowl, sprinkle cut up apples with 1 tablespoon of lemon juice to flavor and keep from discoloring.
Add celery, pineapple and walnuts.
recipes.text: Waldorf Salad A La Eunice(Makes 8 To 10 Servings). Core and dice apples (do not peel). In a large bowl, sprinkle cut up apples with 1 tablespoon of lemon juice to flavor and keep from discoloring. Add celery, pineapple and walnuts.

recipes.title: Civil War Cake Or Grandmama Pound Cake
directions: Beat egg yolks separately.
Add butter and sugar.
Add flour and nutmeg.
Fold in beaten egg whites.
Bake at 350° until a knife comes out clean.
recipes.text: Civil War Cake Or Grandmama Pound Cake. Beat egg yolks separately. Add butter and sugar. Add flour and nutmeg. Fold in beaten egg whites. Bake at 350° until a knife comes out clean.

recipes.title: Potatoes Romanoff
directions: Bake the potatoes until tender.
Peel and shred into a large bowl.
Turn into a 2-quart greased casserole.
Refrigerate overnight.
Set out one hour before baking.
Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.
recipes.text: Potatoes Romanoff. Bake the potatoes until tender. Peel and shred into a large bowl. Turn into a 2-quart greased casserole. Refrigerate overnight. Set out one hour before baking. Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Sparklin Strawberry Pie
directions: Dissolve jello in water.
Add frozen berries and allow to set a few minutes to thicken.
When partially set, spoon into cooked crust.
Top with Cool Whip.
Refrigerate.
recipes.text: Sparklin Strawberry Pie. Dissolve jello in water. Add frozen berries and allow to set a few minutes to thicken. When partially set, spoon into cooked crust. Top with Cool Whip. Refrigerate.

recipes.title: Fruit Salad Dressing
directions: Cook all ingredients except whipping cream until thick, cool. Add whipping cream; beat well.
Refrigerate.
recipes.text: Fruit Salad Dressing. Cook all ingredients except whipping cream until thick, cool. Add whipping cream; beat well. Refrigerate.

recipes.title: Molasses Custard Tart
directions: Beat eggs.
Add sugar, flour, molasses and butter.
Put in unbaked tart shells.
Makes 6 small tarts.
Bake at 325° to 350° until appears done as the consistency of a chess pie.
recipes.text: Molasses Custard Tart. Beat eggs. Add sugar, flour, molasses and butter. Put in unbaked tart shells. Makes 6 small tarts. Bake at 325° to 350° until appears done as the consistency of a chess pie.

recipes.title: Hot Crabmeat Chip Dip
directions: Mix all ingredients together and heat in chafing dish.
recipes.text: Hot Crabmeat Chip Dip. Mix all ingredients together and heat in chafing dish.

recipes.title: Chicken-Veggie Soup
directions: The purchase weight of 10 pounds of chicken decreases after boiling and removing bones, skin and fat.
Chop all vegetables. Boil all ingredients in at least 1 gallon of water. Add more water, if necessary.
Boil for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Chicken-Veggie Soup. The purchase weight of 10 pounds of chicken decreases after boiling and removing bones, skin and fat. Chop all vegetables. Boil all ingredients in at least 1 gallon of water. Add more water, if necessary. Boil for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Bean Salad
ingredients: 1 can French cut green beans, drained
directions: Mix above ingredients.
Pour dressing over bean mixture and chill for a few hours.
recipes.text: Bean Salad. Mix above ingredients. Pour dressing over bean mixture and chill for a few hours.

recipes.title: Navy Bean Soup
directions: Soak beans in boiling water in large Dutch oven for 30 minutes; stir in salt.
Cover and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat and simmer 2 hours.
Saute diced onion and celery in melted margarine until tender.
Add sauteed vegetables and tomatoes to bean mixture, stirring well.
Simmer, uncovered, 1 hour or until beans are tender.
Serve hot.
Yields 11 servings (1 cup each). Calories:
Exchanges:
2 starch.
recipes.text: Navy Bean Soup. Soak beans in boiling water in large Dutch oven for 30 minutes; stir in salt. Cover and bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer 2 hours. Saute diced onion and celery in melted margarine until tender. Add sauteed vegetables and tomatoes to bean mixture, stirring well. Simmer, uncovered, 1 hour or until beans are tender. Serve hot. Yields 11 servings (1 cup each). Calories: 159. Exchanges: 2 starch.

recipes.title: Hummingbird Cake
directions: Mix dry ingredients.
Add eggs and oil; stir to wet mixture. Do not beat.
Add other ingredients and mix.
Do not beat.
Put in 3 greased and floured pans.
Cook at 350° for about 25 to 35 minutes.
recipes.text: Hummingbird Cake. Mix dry ingredients. Add eggs and oil; stir to wet mixture. Do not beat. Add other ingredients and mix. Do not beat. Put in 3 greased and floured pans. Cook at 350° for about 25 to 35 minutes.

recipes.title: Easy Deep Dish Pizza
directions: Heat oven to 425°.
Lightly grease a 15 1/2 x 10 1/2 x 1-inch jelly roll pan or cookie sheet.
Mix baking mix and water until soft dough forms; beat vigorously 20 strokes.
Gently smooth dough into ball on floured cloth-covered board.
Knead 20 times.
Pat dough in bottom and up sides of pan with floured hands.
Or roll into 13 x 10-inch rectangle and place on cookie sheet; pinch edges of rectangle, forming 3/4-inch rim.
recipes.text: Easy Deep Dish Pizza. Heat oven to 425°. Lightly grease a 15 1/2 x 10 1/2 x 1-inch jelly roll pan or cookie sheet. Mix baking mix and water until soft dough forms; beat vigorously 20 strokes. Gently smooth dough into ball on floured cloth-covered board. Knead 20 times. Pat dough in bottom and up sides of pan with floured hands. Or roll into 13 x 10-inch rectangle and place on cookie sheet; pinch edges of rectangle, forming 3/4-inch rim.

recipes.title: Seafood Chowder
directions: Combine soups and milk in blender.
Blend until smooth.
Pour into saucepan and stir in cream and chives.
Heat just to boiling. Stir occasionally and stir in heated seafood and dash of Old Bay seasoning.
recipes.text: Seafood Chowder. Combine soups and milk in blender. Blend until smooth. Pour into saucepan and stir in cream and chives. Heat just to boiling. Stir occasionally and stir in heated seafood and dash of Old Bay seasoning.

recipes.title: Deluxe Brownies
directions: Make one day before serving.
recipes.text: Deluxe Brownies. Make one day before serving.

recipes.title: Beef And Cabbage Dish
directions: Shred cabbage.
Spread 1/2 cabbage in a baking dish.
Brown ground beef, pepper and onion in skillet.
Put 1/2 the mixture over the cabbage.
Add rest of the cabbage and top with meat.
Spread tomato soup over top.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.
Delicious.
recipes.text: Beef And Cabbage Dish. Shred cabbage. Spread 1/2 cabbage in a baking dish. Brown ground beef, pepper and onion in skillet. Put 1/2 the mixture over the cabbage. Add rest of the cabbage and top with meat. Spread tomato soup over top. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes. Delicious.

recipes.title: Doughnuts
directions: Soften butter with a fork, add sugar and well beaten eggs.
Mix 3 cups of flour with the other dry ingredients and add alternately with milk and mix to the first mixture.
If necessary, add more flour until the dough is soft.
Form a ball and refrigerate 1/2 to one hour to firm.
Roll dough 1/8-inch thick on a slightly floured board or table.
Cut with a pastry cutter in the shape of a doughnut.

When all the doughnuts are shaped and cut, cook in a deep fryer or a large skillet in which three inches of fat or shortening or vegetable oil has been heated to 325° approximately. Place 3 to 4 (depending on the size of the doughnuts and the surface of the frying pot available) gently into the heated fat/oil.
Cook one side until gold color shows on the edge, turn, cook the other side until golden; remove from pot and continue to cook rest of doughnuts.
Makes approximately 50 doughnuts.
recipes.text: Doughnuts. Soften butter with a fork, add sugar and well beaten eggs. Mix 3 cups of flour with the other dry ingredients and add alternately with milk and mix to the first mixture. If necessary, add more flour until the dough is soft. Form a ball and refrigerate 1/2 to one hour to firm. Roll dough 1/8-inch thick on a slightly floured board or table. Cut with a pastry cutter in the shape of a doughnut. When all the doughnuts are shaped and cut, cook in a deep fryer or a large skillet in which three inches of fat or shortening or vegetable oil has been heated to 325° approximately. Place 3 to 4 (depending on the size of the doughnuts and the surface of the frying pot available) gently into the heated fat/oil. Cook one side until gold color shows on the edge, turn, cook the other side until golden; remove from pot and continue to cook rest of doughnuts. Makes approximately 50 doughnuts.

recipes.title: Tortellini Ala Panna
ingredients: 1 tsp. dry or fresh basil to taste
directions: In a deep saute pan, melt 1/2 butter.
Add onion and garlic; saute 3 to 4 minutes.
Add mushrooms and tomatoes.
Saute another 3 to 4 minutes.
Add remainder of butter and thyme.
Add cream. If using dry basil, add now.
Reduce mixture in half.
If using fresh basil, add after cream is reduced.
recipes.text: Tortellini Ala Panna. In a deep saute pan, melt 1/2 butter. Add onion and garlic; saute 3 to 4 minutes. Add mushrooms and tomatoes. Saute another 3 to 4 minutes. Add remainder of butter and thyme. Add cream. If using dry basil, add now. Reduce mixture in half. If using fresh basil, add after cream is reduced.

recipes.title: Green Bean Casserole
ingredients: 1 large or 2 small cans green beans
directions: Drain green beans.
Mix green beans, salt, pepper and cream of mushroom soup in casserole dish.
Bake 20 minutes at 325°.
Take out of oven and top with dried onions.
Bake 5 minutes longer or until onions are browned.
recipes.text: Green Bean Casserole. Drain green beans. Mix green beans, salt, pepper and cream of mushroom soup in casserole dish. Bake 20 minutes at 325°. Take out of oven and top with dried onions. Bake 5 minutes longer or until onions are browned.

recipes.title: Apple Pie
directions: Melt butter.
Mix cinnamon and salt with sugar and well beaten egg and apples.
Preheat oven at 400°.
Cook for 15 minutes; turn temperature down to 350° and bake until golden brown, probably about 1 hour total baking.
recipes.text: Apple Pie. Melt butter. Mix cinnamon and salt with sugar and well beaten egg and apples. Preheat oven at 400°. Cook for 15 minutes; turn temperature down to 350° and bake until golden brown, probably about 1 hour total baking.

recipes.title: Basic Cookie Mix(About 16 Cups)
directions: In a large bowl, combine flour, granulated sugar, brown sugar, salt and baking soda until well blended.
With a pastry blender, cut in shortening until evenly distributed.
Put in a large airtight container.
Label.
Store in a cool, dry place.
Use within 10 to 12 weeks.
Makes about 16 cups of Basic Cookie Mix.
recipes.text: Basic Cookie Mix(About 16 Cups). In a large bowl, combine flour, granulated sugar, brown sugar, salt and baking soda until well blended. With a pastry blender, cut in shortening until evenly distributed. Put in a large airtight container. Label. Store in a cool, dry place. Use within 10 to 12 weeks. Makes about 16 cups of Basic Cookie Mix.

recipes.title: Easy Puff Pastry
directions: Add salt and sugar to flour in mixing bowl; cut butter into flour as fine as possible, having butter very cold.
Beat eggs for 5 minutes; add lemon juice to eggs.
Add the cold water and mix flour into a stiff dough.
Lift dough to well floured board.
Roll out into rectangular shape; fold all four sides onto the dough. Roll again; repeat this process 4 times.
Fold again and wrap in a napkin, place on plate and stand on ice or let stand in refrigerator until thoroughly chilled.
Roll out again and use for patties, pie crust or tart shells.
recipes.text: Easy Puff Pastry. Add salt and sugar to flour in mixing bowl; cut butter into flour as fine as possible, having butter very cold. Beat eggs for 5 minutes; add lemon juice to eggs. Add the cold water and mix flour into a stiff dough. Lift dough to well floured board. Roll out into rectangular shape; fold all four sides onto the dough. Roll again; repeat this process 4 times. Fold again and wrap in a napkin, place on plate and stand on ice or let stand in refrigerator until thoroughly chilled. Roll out again and use for patties, pie crust or tart shells.

recipes.title: Jar Slaw
directions: Process vegetables.
Mix with remaining ingredients.
Bring to a boil.
Pack in sterile jars and seal.
recipes.text: Jar Slaw. Process vegetables. Mix with remaining ingredients. Bring to a boil. Pack in sterile jars and seal.

recipes.title: Custard Pie
directions: Dilute milk with hot water.
Beat eggs very slightly and add to milk.
Add salt and vanilla.
Pour into 9-inch unbaked pie shell and sprinkle with nutmeg.
Bake at 450° for 30 minutes or until knife comes out clean.
This custard will never get runny or weep if you beat the eggs very slightly.
recipes.text: Custard Pie. Dilute milk with hot water. Beat eggs very slightly and add to milk. Add salt and vanilla. Pour into 9-inch unbaked pie shell and sprinkle with nutmeg. Bake at 450° for 30 minutes or until knife comes out clean. This custard will never get runny or weep if you beat the eggs very slightly.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Candy
directions: Mix sugar, milk and butter in pan.
Cook 5 or 6 minutes.
Add peanut butter, Marshmallow Creme and vanilla.
Pour in buttered cake pan or plate.
Let cool!
recipes.text: Peanut Butter Candy. Mix sugar, milk and butter in pan. Cook 5 or 6 minutes. Add peanut butter, Marshmallow Creme and vanilla. Pour in buttered cake pan or plate. Let cool!

recipes.title: Squash Casserole
directions: Parboil squash until tender.
Don't cook too long.
Mix squash, onions, salt, pepper, cheese, egg and crackers; mix lightly with melted margarine.
Sprinkle 5 or 6 crushed crackers on top.
Bake 30 minutes or until browned on top and bubbly.
recipes.text: Squash Casserole. Parboil squash until tender. Don't cook too long. Mix squash, onions, salt, pepper, cheese, egg and crackers; mix lightly with melted margarine. Sprinkle 5 or 6 crushed crackers on top. Bake 30 minutes or until browned on top and bubbly.

recipes.title: Pizzelles
directions: Beat eggs.
Add sugar; beat until smooth.
Add anise extract and seed.
Add oil.
Add flour and baking powder.
Mix until smooth.
Batter will be sticky, but loose enough to be dropped by rounded teaspoonfuls.
(You can add more flour to reach consistency you want.)
Cook according to pizzelle maker instructions.
Makes about 36 to 40 pizzelles.
recipes.text: Pizzelles. Beat eggs. Add sugar; beat until smooth. Add anise extract and seed. Add oil. Add flour and baking powder. Mix until smooth. Batter will be sticky, but loose enough to be dropped by rounded teaspoonfuls. (You can add more flour to reach consistency you want.) Cook according to pizzelle maker instructions. Makes about 36 to 40 pizzelles.

recipes.title: Apple Cake
directions: Break eggs over apples.
Mix with fork.
Add sugar, nuts, oil, cinnamon and vanilla.
Sift flour, salt and soda, add to apples. Pour into 9 x 12-inch glass pan, bake at 350° for 50 minutes.
recipes.text: Apple Cake. Break eggs over apples. Mix with fork. Add sugar, nuts, oil, cinnamon and vanilla. Sift flour, salt and soda, add to apples. Pour into 9 x 12-inch glass pan, bake at 350° for 50 minutes.

recipes.title: Gumbo
ingredients: salt, pepper and garlic powder to taste
directions: Make roux (light or dark as desired) with small amount of grease, flour, salt, pepper and garlic powder.
Set aside.
Saute bell pepper, onion and sausage in large stainless pot.
Add salt, pepper, garlic powder, bay leaves, file and cayenne pepper.
Add water until desired quantity of gumbo is reached.
Bring to a boil; reduce heat to medium for 2 hours.
Add shrimp.
Cook on medium heat until shrimp is done.
Serve over bed of rice.
recipes.text: Gumbo. Make roux (light or dark as desired) with small amount of grease, flour, salt, pepper and garlic powder. Set aside. Saute bell pepper, onion and sausage in large stainless pot. Add salt, pepper, garlic powder, bay leaves, file and cayenne pepper. Add water until desired quantity of gumbo is reached. Bring to a boil; reduce heat to medium for 2 hours. Add shrimp. Cook on medium heat until shrimp is done. Serve over bed of rice.

recipes.title: Yeast Rolls
directions: Mix water and yeast; let stand while you mix dry ingredients together.
Add yeast mixture and oil to dry ingredients.
Grease another large bowl and put mixture in it.
Cover and let rise in warm place.
Knead down and place in rolls.
Let rise again.
Cook at 400° for about 25 minutes.
recipes.text: Yeast Rolls. Mix water and yeast; let stand while you mix dry ingredients together. Add yeast mixture and oil to dry ingredients. Grease another large bowl and put mixture in it. Cover and let rise in warm place. Knead down and place in rolls. Let rise again. Cook at 400° for about 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Chocolate Syrup Cake
directions: Combine all ingredients well.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until toothpick inserted in middle comes out clean.
recipes.text: Chocolate Syrup Cake. Combine all ingredients well. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until toothpick inserted in middle comes out clean.

recipes.title: Eggplant Casserole
ingredients: 1 (15 oz.) can Hunt's tomato sauce (Hunt's Ready Chunky Special tomato sauce)
directions: Peel and cut up eggplant and onion.
Boil or steam the eggplant in salted water until tender.
Add onion.
recipes.text: Eggplant Casserole. Peel and cut up eggplant and onion. Boil or steam the eggplant in salted water until tender. Add onion.

recipes.title: Graham Cracker Cake
directions: Mix egg yolks and lemon juice together.
Add cream cheese and condensed milk.
Mix on high speed.
Place layer of crackers on a plate or Pyrex dish.
Place a layer of filling and layer of crackers until all filling is used.
Do not cook.
recipes.text: Graham Cracker Cake. Mix egg yolks and lemon juice together. Add cream cheese and condensed milk. Mix on high speed. Place layer of crackers on a plate or Pyrex dish. Place a layer of filling and layer of crackers until all filling is used. Do not cook.

recipes.title: Quick And Easy Apple Cobbler
directions: Spread apples in two 9 x 13-inch pans.
Mix together 3/4 cup sugar, cinnamon and nutmeg.
Sprinkle over apples.
recipes.text: Quick And Easy Apple Cobbler. Spread apples in two 9 x 13-inch pans. Mix together 3/4 cup sugar, cinnamon and nutmeg. Sprinkle over apples.

recipes.title: Pecan Petites
directions: Cream margarine and sugar.
Blend in vanilla.
Stir in flour and mix well.
Add nuts and shape rounded teaspoonfuls of dough into balls.
Bake on ungreased cookie sheet at 325° for 20 to 25 minutes. Cool slightly and roll in confectioners sugar.
recipes.text: Pecan Petites. Cream margarine and sugar. Blend in vanilla. Stir in flour and mix well. Add nuts and shape rounded teaspoonfuls of dough into balls. Bake on ungreased cookie sheet at 325° for 20 to 25 minutes. Cool slightly and roll in confectioners sugar.

recipes.title: Apricot Bread
directions: Cover apricots with warm water and soak for 30 minutes. Drain and cut with scissors into 1/4 inch pieces. Mix together sugar, butter and egg. Stir in water and orange juice. Sift together flour, baking powder, salt and blend in. Add nuts and apricots. Pour into glass bread pan. Let stand for about 20 minutes. Bake at 350 degrees for about an hour.
recipes.text: Apricot Bread. Cover apricots with warm water and soak for 30 minutes. Drain and cut with scissors into 1/4 inch pieces. Mix together sugar, butter and egg. Stir in water and orange juice. Sift together flour, baking powder, salt and blend in. Add nuts and apricots. Pour into glass bread pan. Let stand for about 20 minutes. Bake at 350 degrees for about an hour.

recipes.title: Hot Artichoke Dip
ingredients: 2 (14 oz.) cans artichoke hearts, drained and chopped
2 c. mayonnaise (1/2 c. plain yogurt may be substituted)
directions: Combine all ingredients, stirring well.
Spoon into lightly greased 1-quart casserole or souffle dish.
Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.
Serve hot with crackers.
Yield: about 5 cups.
One-half of the recipe will serve 4 people and fit into a 9-inch pie dish.
recipes.text: Hot Artichoke Dip. Combine all ingredients, stirring well. Spoon into lightly greased 1-quart casserole or souffle dish. Bake at 350° for 20 minutes. Serve hot with crackers. Yield: about 5 cups. One-half of the recipe will serve 4 people and fit into a 9-inch pie dish.

recipes.title: Oven Swiss Steak
ingredients: 1 1/2 lb. boneless beef round steak (3/4-inch thick)
1/4 c. shredded processed American cheese (1 oz.)
directions: Cut meat in 4 portions.
Combine flour and salt; pound into meat.
Reserve remaining flour for sauce.
Brown meat in Crisco; transfer meat to shallow baking dish.
Blend reserved flour mixture into pan drippings in skillet.
Add tomatoes, celery, carrot, onion and Worcestershire sauce to drippings in skillet and cook.
Stir constantly until mixture boils.
Pour over meat. Cover and bake at 350° for 2 hours or until meat and vegetables are tender.
Sprinkle cheese over meat.
Return to oven for a few minutes to melt cheese.
Serves 4.
recipes.text: Oven Swiss Steak. Cut meat in 4 portions. Combine flour and salt; pound into meat. Reserve remaining flour for sauce. Brown meat in Crisco; transfer meat to shallow baking dish. Blend reserved flour mixture into pan drippings in skillet. Add tomatoes, celery, carrot, onion and Worcestershire sauce to drippings in skillet and cook. Stir constantly until mixture boils. Pour over meat. Cover and bake at 350° for 2 hours or until meat and vegetables are tender. Sprinkle cheese over meat. Return to oven for a few minutes to melt cheese. Serves 4.

recipes.title: Fruit Ham Steak
ingredients: 1 (2 lb.) smoked center-cut ham, sliced (1-inch thick)
directions: Combine butter, orange juice, brown sugar and curry powder. Peel bananas and cut into 1-inch chunks.
Peel and slice peaches. Add bananas, peaches and pineapple to curry mixture.
Stir to coat. Place ham in baking dish.
Spoon fruit mix over ham.
Sprinkle coconut and cherries over fruit.
Bake at 350° for 35 minutes or until ham and fruit are cooked and coconut is lightly browned.
recipes.text: Fruit Ham Steak. Combine butter, orange juice, brown sugar and curry powder. Peel bananas and cut into 1-inch chunks. Peel and slice peaches. Add bananas, peaches and pineapple to curry mixture. Stir to coat. Place ham in baking dish. Spoon fruit mix over ham. Sprinkle coconut and cherries over fruit. Bake at 350° for 35 minutes or until ham and fruit are cooked and coconut is lightly browned.

recipes.title: Cowboy Cornbread
directions: Add cream-style corn to cornbread mixture and set aside. Brown hamburger meat, drain and add onion, salt and pepper.
Add jalapeno pepper.
Pour half of the cornbread mixture in a hot greased pan, then add the meat and onion.
Top with cheese and then pour the rest of the cornbread mixture over top.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes to 1 hour.
Let set 15 minutes before serving.
recipes.text: Cowboy Cornbread. Add cream-style corn to cornbread mixture and set aside. Brown hamburger meat, drain and add onion, salt and pepper. Add jalapeno pepper. Pour half of the cornbread mixture in a hot greased pan, then add the meat and onion. Top with cheese and then pour the rest of the cornbread mixture over top. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes to 1 hour. Let set 15 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Rainbow Stew
directions: Cook on medium heat, stirring constantly until thick.
Divide mixture into three containers. Add food coloring to all three. Place small amounts of rainbow stew into several Ziploc bags. Reinforce closure with packing tape.
Let the children write on bags with the fingers.
They can also mix two colors together and discover a new color. If you want to extend their shelf life, refrigerate.
recipes.text: Rainbow Stew. Cook on medium heat, stirring constantly until thick. Divide mixture into three containers. Add food coloring to all three. Place small amounts of rainbow stew into several Ziploc bags. Reinforce closure with packing tape. Let the children write on bags with the fingers. They can also mix two colors together and discover a new color. If you want to extend their shelf life, refrigerate.

recipes.title: Hot Chicken Salad
ingredients: 9 c. cooked chicken, cut in small pieces
directions: Add this topping on top before baking.
recipes.text: Hot Chicken Salad. Add this topping on top before baking.

recipes.title: Hot Ham Sandwiches
directions: Melt margarine; add mustard, Worcestershire sauce, poppy seed and onion flakes.
Stir well.
recipes.text: Hot Ham Sandwiches. Melt margarine; add mustard, Worcestershire sauce, poppy seed and onion flakes. Stir well.

recipes.title: Double Chocolate Chip Cookies
ingredients: 1 pkg. Butter Recipe fudge cake mix
directions: Preheat oven to 375°.
Blend cake mix, flour, oil and eggs. Stir in chips.
Drop from a teaspoon onto ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 375° for 9 to 11 minutes. Do not overbake. Cool on cookie sheet about 1 minute, then transfer to rack to finish cooling.
recipes.text: Double Chocolate Chip Cookies. Preheat oven to 375°. Blend cake mix, flour, oil and eggs. Stir in chips. Drop from a teaspoon onto ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 375° for 9 to 11 minutes. Do not overbake. Cool on cookie sheet about 1 minute, then transfer to rack to finish cooling.

recipes.title: Fido'S Favorite Treats(Dog Biscuits)
ingredients: 1 to 2 tsp. chicken or beef flavored instant bouillon
2 to 3 c. all-purpose or whole wheat flour
directions: Heat oven to 325°.
Grease cookie sheets.
In a large bowl, combine rolled oats, margarine and boiling water; let stand 10 minutes.
Stir in cornmeal, sugar, bouillon, milk, cheese and egg; mix well.
recipes.text: Fido'S Favorite Treats(Dog Biscuits). Heat oven to 325°. Grease cookie sheets. In a large bowl, combine rolled oats, margarine and boiling water; let stand 10 minutes. Stir in cornmeal, sugar, bouillon, milk, cheese and egg; mix well.

recipes.title: Macaroni Salad
directions: Combine all ingredients and chill.
recipes.text: Macaroni Salad. Combine all ingredients and chill.

recipes.title: Squash Casserole
directions: Cook squash and onion together; drain well.
Add soup and season; put into a buttered casserole dish.
Top with cracker crumbs and cheese.
Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.
recipes.text: Squash Casserole. Cook squash and onion together; drain well. Add soup and season; put into a buttered casserole dish. Top with cracker crumbs and cheese. Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Apricot Nut Squares
directions: Heat water, milk and 1 tablespoon sugar; let cool and put aside.
When cool, dissolve 1 package dry yeast.
Mix as pie dough the flour, oleo and egg yolks.
Add yeast mixture and divide into 3 parts.
Roll between wax paper and lay on pan, 15 1/2 x 10 1/2 x 1-inch.
Mix ground nuts, cinnamon and 1 cup sugar and put 1 cup aside.
recipes.text: Apricot Nut Squares. Heat water, milk and 1 tablespoon sugar; let cool and put aside. When cool, dissolve 1 package dry yeast. Mix as pie dough the flour, oleo and egg yolks. Add yeast mixture and divide into 3 parts. Roll between wax paper and lay on pan, 15 1/2 x 10 1/2 x 1-inch. Mix ground nuts, cinnamon and 1 cup sugar and put 1 cup aside.

recipes.title: Classic Lasagna
directions: Mix Ricotta, Mozzarella, 1/2 cup Parmesan cheese and eggs. Brown beef.
Pour off fat.
Stir in spaghetti sauce.
Layer in long baking dish in the following order: spaghetti sauce mixture, noodles and cheese mixture.
Repeat layers.
Bake at 400° for 30 minutes.
Let stand 10 minutes before serving.
recipes.text: Classic Lasagna. Mix Ricotta, Mozzarella, 1/2 cup Parmesan cheese and eggs. Brown beef. Pour off fat. Stir in spaghetti sauce. Layer in long baking dish in the following order: spaghetti sauce mixture, noodles and cheese mixture. Repeat layers. Bake at 400° for 30 minutes. Let stand 10 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Gooseberry Pie
directions: Preheat oven to 450°.
Roll out one crust to fit 9-inch pie pan.
Mix the berries, sugar, tapioca and salt together in large bowl.
Pour into prepared shell.
Dot filling with butter.
Roll out remaining crust to form top crust.
Place over filling. Moisten, seal and flute edges; cut slits in top.
Bake at 450° for 10 minutes.
Reduce heat to 350°.
Bake an additional 30 minutes, or until crust is golden brown.
recipes.text: Gooseberry Pie. Preheat oven to 450°. Roll out one crust to fit 9-inch pie pan. Mix the berries, sugar, tapioca and salt together in large bowl. Pour into prepared shell. Dot filling with butter. Roll out remaining crust to form top crust. Place over filling. Moisten, seal and flute edges; cut slits in top. Bake at 450° for 10 minutes. Reduce heat to 350°. Bake an additional 30 minutes, or until crust is golden brown.

recipes.title: Cheese-Baked Halibut
directions: Arrange steaks in greased baking dish.
Sprinkle with vinegar, salt, pepper and basil.
Bake at 375° for 20 minutes.
Remove from oven.
Combine bread crumbs and cheese.
Spread over steaks; sprinkle with melted butter.
Return to oven and bake 10 minutes longer or until halibut flakes easily.
Serve 6 on a heated platter garnished with parsley.
recipes.text: Cheese-Baked Halibut. Arrange steaks in greased baking dish. Sprinkle with vinegar, salt, pepper and basil. Bake at 375° for 20 minutes. Remove from oven. Combine bread crumbs and cheese. Spread over steaks; sprinkle with melted butter. Return to oven and bake 10 minutes longer or until halibut flakes easily. Serve 6 on a heated platter garnished with parsley.

recipes.title: Blueberry Cake
directions: Combine first 7 ingredients.
Mix well.
Fold in blueberries. Place in well greased and floured tube pan.
Bake at 350° for 1 1/4 to 1 1/2 hours.
recipes.text: Blueberry Cake. Combine first 7 ingredients. Mix well. Fold in blueberries. Place in well greased and floured tube pan. Bake at 350° for 1 1/4 to 1 1/2 hours.

recipes.title: Chocolate Cinnamon Drink
directions: Bring water and cinnamon candies to a boil over medium-high heat in medium saucepan, stirring until candies melt.
Add milk; whisk in drink mix.
Bring to a simmer over medium-high heat. Pour into mugs.
Serve warm.
recipes.text: Chocolate Cinnamon Drink. Bring water and cinnamon candies to a boil over medium-high heat in medium saucepan, stirring until candies melt. Add milk; whisk in drink mix. Bring to a simmer over medium-high heat. Pour into mugs. Serve warm.

recipes.title: Swedish Meatballs
directions: When mixture is hot, add meatballs and simmer for 10 to 15 minutes.
recipes.text: Swedish Meatballs. When mixture is hot, add meatballs and simmer for 10 to 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Rice Krispies Cake
ingredients: 6 c. Rice Krispies (regular, Cocoa Krispies or seasonal Rice Krispies cereal)
directions: Spray a Bundt pan or any kind of mold with cooking spray. Microwave margarine and marshmallows on High for 2 minutes in a large microwave-safe mixing bowl.
Stir to combine.
Microwave 1 minute longer.
Stir until smooth.
Add cereal; stir until well coated.
Press firmly into into Bundt pan (I spray the back of a large spoon or spatula with cooking spray).
You may need more than one recipe.
I alternate recipes, using Cocoa Krispies.
Turn out onto serving plate.
Decorate with M&M's, gumdrops, or as desired!
recipes.text: Rice Krispies Cake. Spray a Bundt pan or any kind of mold with cooking spray. Microwave margarine and marshmallows on High for 2 minutes in a large microwave-safe mixing bowl. Stir to combine. Microwave 1 minute longer. Stir until smooth. Add cereal; stir until well coated. Press firmly into into Bundt pan (I spray the back of a large spoon or spatula with cooking spray). You may need more than one recipe. I alternate recipes, using Cocoa Krispies. Turn out onto serving plate. Decorate with M&M's, gumdrops, or as desired!

recipes.title: Chicken 'N Rice In A Bag
ingredients: 3 lb. fryer, cut into serving pieces (remove skin, if desired)
1 (10 3/4 oz.) can Heart Healthy cream of chicken soup
1 (1 1/2 oz.) envelope dry onion soup mix
directions: Rinse chicken pieces and pat dry.
Set aside.
Combine rice, chicken soup and water in crock-pot.
Stir well to mix in soup. Place chicken pieces in a see-through browning bag.
Add onion soup mix.
Shake bag to coat chicken pieces thoroughly.
Puncture 4 to 6 holes in bottom of bag.
Fold top of bag over and place in crock-pot on top of rice.
Cover and cook on low for 8 to 10 hours. Remove chicken pieces to warm platter.
Serve with rice.
ner: heart healthy cream of chicken soup
recipes.text: Chicken 'N Rice In A Bag. Rinse chicken pieces and pat dry. Set aside. Combine rice, chicken soup and water in crock-pot. Stir well to mix in soup. Place chicken pieces in a see-through browning bag. Add onion soup mix. Shake bag to coat chicken pieces thoroughly. Puncture 4 to 6 holes in bottom of bag. Fold top of bag over and place in crock-pot on top of rice. Cover and cook on low for 8 to 10 hours. Remove chicken pieces to warm platter. Serve with rice.

recipes.title: Party Spinach Dip(Low-Fat)
ingredients: 1 (10 oz.) pkg. frozen, chopped spinach, thawed and drained
1/2 c. Land O Lakes fat-free sour cream
1 (8 oz.) can water chestnuts, drained and chopped
directions: Process cottage cheese in a blender until smooth.
Press spinach between paper towels until almost dry.
Put cottage cheese, spinach and remaining ingredients into a bowl.
Blend well, folding ingredients together.
Cover and refrigerate 3 hours.
Yields 3 cups.
Has 14 calories and a trace of fat per tablespoon.
recipes.text: Party Spinach Dip(Low-Fat). Process cottage cheese in a blender until smooth. Press spinach between paper towels until almost dry. Put cottage cheese, spinach and remaining ingredients into a bowl. Blend well, folding ingredients together. Cover and refrigerate 3 hours. Yields 3 cups. Has 14 calories and a trace of fat per tablespoon.

recipes.title: Spinach Noodles
directions: Cook, drain and puree spinach in the blender.
Combine spinach puree, egg and salt.
Stir in gradually the flour, then knead until smooth.
Place dough in covered container for 30 minutes. Roll out very thin on floured surface.
Let this dry some, not too dry to roll up.
Roll up and cut into very thin strips.
Toss apart and let dry throughly.
Store in airtight container or let dry at least 2 hours and cook, uncovered, 10 minutes in boiling water.
recipes.text: Spinach Noodles. Cook, drain and puree spinach in the blender. Combine spinach puree, egg and salt. Stir in gradually the flour, then knead until smooth. Place dough in covered container for 30 minutes. Roll out very thin on floured surface. Let this dry some, not too dry to roll up. Roll up and cut into very thin strips. Toss apart and let dry throughly. Store in airtight container or let dry at least 2 hours and cook, uncovered, 10 minutes in boiling water.

recipes.title: Creamed Squirrel
directions: Roll squirrel in flour mixture.
Heat oil and brown squirrel in frying pan.
Remove squirrel.
Add onions and mushrooms and fry 5 minutes.
Add squirrel, wine, thyme and parsley.
Mix well. Cover and simmer for 1 to 1 1/2 hours.
Remove squirrel from pan and cool.
Add enough water to pan to give 1 cup liquid.
Add cream to this.
Bring to a boil and thicken with flour.
Add meat to sauce.
Simmer, then serve.
recipes.text: Creamed Squirrel. Roll squirrel in flour mixture. Heat oil and brown squirrel in frying pan. Remove squirrel. Add onions and mushrooms and fry 5 minutes. Add squirrel, wine, thyme and parsley. Mix well. Cover and simmer for 1 to 1 1/2 hours. Remove squirrel from pan and cool. Add enough water to pan to give 1 cup liquid. Add cream to this. Bring to a boil and thicken with flour. Add meat to sauce. Simmer, then serve.

recipes.title: Broccoli & Corn Casserole
ingredients: 1 pkg. frozen broccoli, thawed, and crumbled into bowl
3/4 c. crushed saltine crackers (save 1/2 for topping)
1 c. grated longhorn cheese (save 1/4 for topping)
directions: Mix together all ingredients.
Place reserved crackers and cheese on top.
Bake at 350 degrees for 45 minutes uncovered.
recipes.text: Broccoli & Corn Casserole. Mix together all ingredients. Place reserved crackers and cheese on top. Bake at 350 degrees for 45 minutes uncovered.

recipes.title: Chocolate Chip Squares
directions: Mix sugars with butter.
Add the egg.
Mix in flour until well blended.
Stir in chocolate chips.
Spread in a greased 13 x 9-inch cake pan and cook at 350° until golden brown.
Let them completely cool before cutting into squares.
recipes.text: Chocolate Chip Squares. Mix sugars with butter. Add the egg. Mix in flour until well blended. Stir in chocolate chips. Spread in a greased 13 x 9-inch cake pan and cook at 350° until golden brown. Let them completely cool before cutting into squares.

recipes.title: Steak With Mushroom Sauce
ingredients: 8 oz. fresh baby portabella mushrooms, sliced or diced (depending on size)
directions: Rub tenderloins with olive oil; salt and pepper them and set aside.
In a large skillet or electric skillet, heat butter over medium heat.
Add garlic, shallots and thyme, cooking in butter for 1 minute.
Turn heat up to medium-high and add tenderloins, browning on both sides to desired level of doneness.
Remove tenderloins to a plate set in a warm place.
Add mushrooms to skillet and saut until tender.
Pour in beef broth and Madeira and bring to a boil.
Let liquid reduce to half.
Add heavy cream and let heat thoroughly and thicken, stirring constantly.
Serve mushroom sauce over tenderloins, using extra sauce for potatoes or rice on the side.
recipes.text: Steak With Mushroom Sauce. Rub tenderloins with olive oil; salt and pepper them and set aside. In a large skillet or electric skillet, heat butter over medium heat. Add garlic, shallots and thyme, cooking in butter for 1 minute. Turn heat up to medium-high and add tenderloins, browning on both sides to desired level of doneness. Remove tenderloins to a plate set in a warm place. Add mushrooms to skillet and saut until tender. Pour in beef broth and Madeira and bring to a boil. Let liquid reduce to half. Add heavy cream and let heat thoroughly and thicken, stirring constantly. Serve mushroom sauce over tenderloins, using extra sauce for potatoes or rice on the side.

recipes.title: Zesty Italian Chicken Breasts
directions: Marinate
chicken
in dressing for 6 hours or longer if you desire.
Take
chicken
out
and fry in a little oil until both sides
are	lightly brown.	Add a little margarine to fry before removing
chicken to platter or dish.
This can also be grilled on the grill.
recipes.text: Zesty Italian Chicken Breasts. Marinate chicken in dressing for 6 hours or longer if you desire. Take chicken out and fry in a little oil until both sides are	lightly brown.	Add a little margarine to fry before removing chicken to platter or dish. This can also be grilled on the grill.

recipes.title: Macaroni Salad
directions: Boil macaroni to directions.
Drain.
Put in a bowl hot.
Add cheese and veggies, chopped to bite-size.
Add spices and mayo. Chill and serve.
recipes.text: Macaroni Salad. Boil macaroni to directions. Drain. Put in a bowl hot. Add cheese and veggies, chopped to bite-size. Add spices and mayo. Chill and serve.

recipes.title: Kraut Salad
directions: Mix, let stand for 24 hours and drain.
Ready to serve.
recipes.text: Kraut Salad. Mix, let stand for 24 hours and drain. Ready to serve.

recipes.title: English Muffin Pizza
directions: Place split English muffin halves on a cookie sheet.
Spoon spaghetti sauce onto English muffins.
Place other ingredients onto each English muffin half.
(Put what you like on the muffins.) Cover with shredded cheese.
Place in oven for 10 to 15 minutes with oven at 350°.
Makes 12 mini pizzas.
recipes.text: English Muffin Pizza. Place split English muffin halves on a cookie sheet. Spoon spaghetti sauce onto English muffins. Place other ingredients onto each English muffin half. (Put what you like on the muffins.) Cover with shredded cheese. Place in oven for 10 to 15 minutes with oven at 350°. Makes 12 mini pizzas.

recipes.title: Lemon Bread
ingredients: 1 tsp. grated lemon peel plus 1 tsp. lemon extract
directions: Grease a loaf pan.
Preheat oven to 350°.
In a large bowl combine flour ingredients.
Mix butter, milk, eggs, lemon peel and lemon extract until smooth.
Add this to flour mix.
Stir just until flour is moistened.
Pour into pan.
Bake 45 to 50 minutes or until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean.
Cool in pan 10 minutes.
Remove from pan and cool completely.
Makes 1 loaf.
recipes.text: Lemon Bread. Grease a loaf pan. Preheat oven to 350°. In a large bowl combine flour ingredients. Mix butter, milk, eggs, lemon peel and lemon extract until smooth. Add this to flour mix. Stir just until flour is moistened. Pour into pan. Bake 45 to 50 minutes or until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean. Cool in pan 10 minutes. Remove from pan and cool completely. Makes 1 loaf.

recipes.title: Coconut Chocolate Cookies
directions: Mix all ingredients.
Place mixture in greased and floured 15 X 10 X 1 inch pan.
Bake for 15 to 20 minutes at 350 degrees. Cool and cut into bars.
recipes.text: Coconut Chocolate Cookies. Mix all ingredients. Place mixture in greased and floured 15 X 10 X 1 inch pan. Bake for 15 to 20 minutes at 350 degrees. Cool and cut into bars.

recipes.title: Cucumber Pickles
directions: Mix together well.
Wash 2 or 3 cucumbers.
Do not peel, but score down sides.
Add to brine and refrigerate.
recipes.text: Cucumber Pickles. Mix together well. Wash 2 or 3 cucumbers. Do not peel, but score down sides. Add to brine and refrigerate.

recipes.title: Jean Terry'S Batter For Onion Rings, Eggplant Or Squash
directions: Beat egg.
Add shortening, water and lemon juice.
Sift together flour, baking powder and salt and add.
This batter will thicken in just a few minutes.
Slice your onions; dip in batter. Fry in hot, deep fat.
recipes.text: Jean Terry'S Batter For Onion Rings, Eggplant Or Squash. Beat egg. Add shortening, water and lemon juice. Sift together flour, baking powder and salt and add. This batter will thicken in just a few minutes. Slice your onions; dip in batter. Fry in hot, deep fat.

recipes.title: Aunt Louise'S Quick Light Corn Bread
directions: Mix all ingredients together; pour into greased skillet or 9 x 13-inch pan.
Bake at 425° for 20 minutes, or until done.
recipes.text: Aunt Louise'S Quick Light Corn Bread. Mix all ingredients together; pour into greased skillet or 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 425° for 20 minutes, or until done.

recipes.title: Squash Casserole
directions: Slice onion and squash; steam together for 5 to 8 minutes. Mix rest of ingredients, except stuffing.
Spread half of stuffing on bottom of a casserole dish.
Add squash mixture on top.
Spread remaining stuffing on top of squash.
Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.
recipes.text: Squash Casserole. Slice onion and squash; steam together for 5 to 8 minutes. Mix rest of ingredients, except stuffing. Spread half of stuffing on bottom of a casserole dish. Add squash mixture on top. Spread remaining stuffing on top of squash. Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Cinnamon Rice
directions: Melt 2 tablespoons butter. Add carrots, celery and onion. Cover and cook for 10 minutes over low heat, stirring occasionally. Add rice, salt, cinnamon sticks, currants and water to pan and bring to boil over high heat.
Stir rice and lower heat to simmer. Cover and cook 10 to 15 minutes more. Remove cinnamon. Add 2 tablespoons butter and adjust seasonings.
recipes.text: Cinnamon Rice. Melt 2 tablespoons butter. Add carrots, celery and onion. Cover and cook for 10 minutes over low heat, stirring occasionally. Add rice, salt, cinnamon sticks, currants and water to pan and bring to boil over high heat. Stir rice and lower heat to simmer. Cover and cook 10 to 15 minutes more. Remove cinnamon. Add 2 tablespoons butter and adjust seasonings.

recipes.title: Cheese Fritters
directions: Heat milk just enough to dissolve Blue cheese.
Mix dry ingredients, then stir in milk mixture to blend.
Add 4 eggs and blend.
Stir in
Cheddar cheese.
Chill well (preferably overnight).
Drop by teaspoonfuls into hot oil and fry until golden.
Serve with a sauce of sour cream mixed with a little honey and prepared mustard.
recipes.text: Cheese Fritters. Heat milk just enough to dissolve Blue cheese. Mix dry ingredients, then stir in milk mixture to blend. Add 4 eggs and blend. Stir in Cheddar cheese. Chill well (preferably overnight). Drop by teaspoonfuls into hot oil and fry until golden. Serve with a sauce of sour cream mixed with a little honey and prepared mustard.

recipes.title: Apple Surprise
ingredients: 1 apple, cored and cut into 8 pieces
directions: You will need 1 plastic bag, scissors and aluminum foil.
recipes.text: Apple Surprise. You will need 1 plastic bag, scissors and aluminum foil.

recipes.title: Bi-Cracky Bars
directions: Cream the margarine and sugar.
Add eggs and vanilla.
Blend in dry ingredients with creamed mixture.
Place 1/3 of the batter in a small bowl and add 1 ounce of unsweetened chocolate and walnuts.
In 2/3 batter bowl, add the chocolate chips.
Spread the 1/3 chocolate batter mixture in a well-greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan.
Arrange graham crackers on top of chocolate batter, then spread white batter
with chocolate chips on top of graham crackers.
Bake at 375° for 20 to 25 minutes.
Cut into bars. Makes about 3 dozen.
recipes.text: Bi-Cracky Bars. Cream the margarine and sugar. Add eggs and vanilla. Blend in dry ingredients with creamed mixture. Place 1/3 of the batter in a small bowl and add 1 ounce of unsweetened chocolate and walnuts. In 2/3 batter bowl, add the chocolate chips. Spread the 1/3 chocolate batter mixture in a well-greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Arrange graham crackers on top of chocolate batter, then spread white batter with chocolate chips on top of graham crackers. Bake at 375° for 20 to 25 minutes. Cut into bars. Makes about 3 dozen.

recipes.title: Turkey Broccoli Casserole(Day After Christmas Main Dish)
ingredients: 2 pkg. (about 9 oz. each) frozen broccoli, cooked and drained
1 can Campbell's cream of mushroom soup
1 can (about 3 oz.) French fried onions rings
directions: In a large casserole, combine 1/2 cup of onion rings and all other ingredients, keeping enough grated cheese and pimento to decorate top.
Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.
Stir; top with remaining onions, cheese and pimento and bake 5 minutes more. Serves 6.
recipes.text: Turkey Broccoli Casserole(Day After Christmas Main Dish). In a large casserole, combine 1/2 cup of onion rings and all other ingredients, keeping enough grated cheese and pimento to decorate top. Bake at 350° for 25 minutes. Stir; top with remaining onions, cheese and pimento and bake 5 minutes more. Serves 6.

recipes.title: Butterscotch Squares
ingredients: butterscotch pudding and pie filling (2 cup size)
directions: Preheat oven to 350°.
Cook pie filling as directed.
Pour into dry yellow cake mix.
Beat with mixer until smooth.
Pour into greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan.
Sprinkle butterscotch chips and pecans over cake mixture.
Bake for 35 minutes.
recipes.text: Butterscotch Squares. Preheat oven to 350°. Cook pie filling as directed. Pour into dry yellow cake mix. Beat with mixer until smooth. Pour into greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan. Sprinkle butterscotch chips and pecans over cake mixture. Bake for 35 minutes.

recipes.title: Corn Chowder
ingredients: 2 1/2 c. frozen or fresh corn kernels
directions: Saute the onion, garlic, green pepper and celery in
olive oil for 2 minutes; add potatoes and vegetable stock and simmer over low heat until potatoes are tender.
Add corn kernels, milk and herbs; simmer for an additional 5 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper.
recipes.text: Corn Chowder. Saute the onion, garlic, green pepper and celery in olive oil for 2 minutes; add potatoes and vegetable stock and simmer over low heat until potatoes are tender. Add corn kernels, milk and herbs; simmer for an additional 5 minutes. Season with salt and pepper.

recipes.title: Lasagna
ingredients: 1 large can chopped or pureed tomatoes
directions: Cook lasagna al dente; drain.
Mix Ricotta, Mozzarella and Italian cheeses, 3 eggs and salt and pepper; set aside.
Brown and crumble ground beef in oil with garlic and onion.
Mix tomatoes and tomato paste (add spices and herbs as desired).
Add browned meat mixture; cook at low temperature.
recipes.text: Lasagna. Cook lasagna al dente; drain. Mix Ricotta, Mozzarella and Italian cheeses, 3 eggs and salt and pepper; set aside. Brown and crumble ground beef in oil with garlic and onion. Mix tomatoes and tomato paste (add spices and herbs as desired). Add browned meat mixture; cook at low temperature.

recipes.title: Easy Macaroni And Cheese
ingredients: 1 (12 oz.) pkg. macaroni, cooked and drained (any kind)
directions: In a saucepan, over medium-high heat, melt 1/4 cup spread (butter or oleo).
Blend in flour.
Gradually add milk, stirring constantly until mixture begins to boil and thickens.
Cook and stir 1 minute.
Stir in cheese until melted.
Combine cheese sauce and macaroni in a 2-quart casserole.
Melt remaining butter; stir in cracker crumbs.
Sprinkle over casserole.
Bake at 400° for 20 to 30 minutes or until hot.
recipes.text: Easy Macaroni And Cheese. In a saucepan, over medium-high heat, melt 1/4 cup spread (butter or oleo). Blend in flour. Gradually add milk, stirring constantly until mixture begins to boil and thickens. Cook and stir 1 minute. Stir in cheese until melted. Combine cheese sauce and macaroni in a 2-quart casserole. Melt remaining butter; stir in cracker crumbs. Sprinkle over casserole. Bake at 400° for 20 to 30 minutes or until hot.

recipes.title: Cajun Shrimp Gumbo
ingredients: 2 tsp. each: garlic salt and pepper
liquid hot pepper sauce to taste
directions: To make roux, heat oil in a large cast-iron kettle, if available.
When very hot, but not smoking, add half the flour. Stir constantly with a wire whisk.
Add remaining flour.
Stir rapidly with whisk until dark and smooth.
recipes.text: Cajun Shrimp Gumbo. To make roux, heat oil in a large cast-iron kettle, if available. When very hot, but not smoking, add half the flour. Stir constantly with a wire whisk. Add remaining flour. Stir rapidly with whisk until dark and smooth.

recipes.title: Pineapple And Cream Cheese Mold
directions: Cook the pineapple and sugar together 3 minutes after it comes to a boil.
Add the Jell-O and dissolve. Add softened cream cheese and mix until cheese is blended thoroughly.
Set aside to cool. When cool, add the whipping cream (maraschino cherries, if you desire).
Pour into buttered mold and refrigerate for several hours.
