recipes.text: Pineapple And Cream Cheese Mold. Cook the pineapple and sugar together 3 minutes after it comes to a boil. Add the Jell-O and dissolve. Add softened cream cheese and mix until cheese is blended thoroughly. Set aside to cool. When cool, add the whipping cream (maraschino cherries, if you desire). Pour into buttered mold and refrigerate for several hours.

recipes.title: John'S Specialty 1 Pan Feast
directions: Clean and cut carrots, peppers and onion.
Dice garlic small. Put roast beef and pork in large pan.
Place onions, peppers, carrots, potatoes and garlic around meat.
Add 2 cups water.
Add salt and pepper to taste.
Bake at 375° for 2 to 3 hours or until done.
Add water as needed.
Serve with Italian bread, applesauce and tossed salad.
recipes.text: John'S Specialty 1 Pan Feast. Clean and cut carrots, peppers and onion. Dice garlic small. Put roast beef and pork in large pan. Place onions, peppers, carrots, potatoes and garlic around meat. Add 2 cups water. Add salt and pepper to taste. Bake at 375° for 2 to 3 hours or until done. Add water as needed. Serve with Italian bread, applesauce and tossed salad.

recipes.title: Cheese Straws
directions: Mix ingredients; add water to form a ball.
Chill; roll out pastry to 1/4-inch thickness.
Cut in thin strips and twist.
Lay on papered tray and bake at 400° for 5 minutes.
Makes 2 1/2 dozen.
recipes.text: Cheese Straws. Mix ingredients; add water to form a ball. Chill; roll out pastry to 1/4-inch thickness. Cut in thin strips and twist. Lay on papered tray and bake at 400° for 5 minutes. Makes 2 1/2 dozen.

recipes.title: Summer Zucchini In Italian Beer Batter
ingredients: 1 1/4 c. flat beer...pour into dish and let sit for one hour
directions: Beat everything together except egg whites and zucchini. Beat till smooth, fold in egg whites.
Dip zucchini into batter and fry in deep hot fat (about 375°) for 2 to 5 minutes.
Drain and serve immediately.
recipes.text: Summer Zucchini In Italian Beer Batter. Beat everything together except egg whites and zucchini. Beat till smooth, fold in egg whites. Dip zucchini into batter and fry in deep hot fat (about 375°) for 2 to 5 minutes. Drain and serve immediately.

recipes.title: Easy Custard Pie
directions: Mix together and pour into unbaked pie shell.
Bake in preheated oven at 425° for 25 to 30 minutes or test with a knife when inserted in center of pie comes out clean.
recipes.text: Easy Custard Pie. Mix together and pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake in preheated oven at 425° for 25 to 30 minutes or test with a knife when inserted in center of pie comes out clean.

recipes.title: Orange Salad(Or Dessert)
ingredients: 1 (3 oz.) pkg. orange Jell-O, sprinkled over the cheese
1 small can mandarin orange slices, drained well
directions: Mix well and chill for at least one hour.
recipes.text: Orange Salad(Or Dessert). Mix well and chill for at least one hour.

recipes.title: Yummers(For Kids To Make)
directions: Mix all ingredients together and form into balls.
Bake at 375° for 10 minutes.
recipes.text: Yummers(For Kids To Make). Mix all ingredients together and form into balls. Bake at 375° for 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Bread
directions: Mix sugar, oil, eggs and pumpkin in a bowl.
Sift dry ingredients and add to bowl.
Mix in 2/3 cup water.
Fill soup can 2/3 full for individual loaves or 9 x 5-inch baking pan.
Bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes.
recipes.text: Pumpkin Bread. Mix sugar, oil, eggs and pumpkin in a bowl. Sift dry ingredients and add to bowl. Mix in 2/3 cup water. Fill soup can 2/3 full for individual loaves or 9 x 5-inch baking pan. Bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Coconut Pie
directions: Mix all ingredients together and pour into unbaked pie crust. Bake until firm.
recipes.text: Coconut Pie. Mix all ingredients together and pour into unbaked pie crust. Bake until firm.

recipes.title: Southern Fried Green Tomatoes(Makes 6 Servings)
ingredients: 4 ripe plum tomatoes, seeded and chopped
directions: Dip eggplant slices into egg; coat with crumbs. Heat 2 tablespoons oil in large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat. Cook eggplant in 3 batches until browned, 2 minutes each side; add oil as needed. Transfer to plate. Let skillet cool slightly; wipe clean. Spread 3/4 cup marinara sauce in skillet; arrange half of eggplant on top.
recipes.text: Southern Fried Green Tomatoes(Makes 6 Servings). Dip eggplant slices into egg; coat with crumbs. Heat 2 tablespoons oil in large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat. Cook eggplant in 3 batches until browned, 2 minutes each side; add oil as needed. Transfer to plate. Let skillet cool slightly; wipe clean. Spread 3/4 cup marinara sauce in skillet; arrange half of eggplant on top.

recipes.title: Crust For Fried Pies
directions: Mix flour, salt and baking powder, then add shortening.
Use a fork to mix the shortening in.
Mix well.
Add milk and mix.
Make into 2-inch balls and roll out on floured surface.
Makes 10 fried pies.
recipes.text: Crust For Fried Pies. Mix flour, salt and baking powder, then add shortening. Use a fork to mix the shortening in. Mix well. Add milk and mix. Make into 2-inch balls and roll out on floured surface. Makes 10 fried pies.

recipes.title: Broccoli Casserole
directions: Cook rice; add soup and cheese to rice.
Saute onions in butter; add broccoli to onions.
Pour broccoli and then rice into casserole dish.
Bake at 325° for 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Broccoli Casserole. Cook rice; add soup and cheese to rice. Saute onions in butter; add broccoli to onions. Pour broccoli and then rice into casserole dish. Bake at 325° for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Easy Peach Cobbler
directions: Melt butter in 2 1/2-quart baking dish in 350° oven.
Combine dry ingredients and milk in bowl.
Mix well.
Pour over melted butter.
Do not stir.
Top with peaches.
Bake at 350° for 50 to 60 minutes.
Yield: 6 servings.
recipes.text: Easy Peach Cobbler. Melt butter in 2 1/2-quart baking dish in 350° oven. Combine dry ingredients and milk in bowl. Mix well. Pour over melted butter. Do not stir. Top with peaches. Bake at 350° for 50 to 60 minutes. Yield: 6 servings.

recipes.title: Golden Biscuits
directions: Combine the flour, baking powder, salt and sugar in bowl.
Cut in shortening until the mixture looks like coarse corn meal.
Add milk and mix until the dough holds together.
Knead a few strokes on a lightly floured flat surface.
Roll and cut with biscuit cutter.
Place on an ungreased baking sheet and bake at 425° for 12 to 15 minutes.
recipes.text: Golden Biscuits. Combine the flour, baking powder, salt and sugar in bowl. Cut in shortening until the mixture looks like coarse corn meal. Add milk and mix until the dough holds together. Knead a few strokes on a lightly floured flat surface. Roll and cut with biscuit cutter. Place on an ungreased baking sheet and bake at 425° for 12 to 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Grandma'S Wine Drop Cookies
directions: Beat eggs, butter and sugar.
Add molasses, then sour milk with soda.
Add remainder of ingredients.
Drop by large teaspoonful onto baking sheet.
Bake approximately 10 minutes.
recipes.text: Grandma'S Wine Drop Cookies. Beat eggs, butter and sugar. Add molasses, then sour milk with soda. Add remainder of ingredients. Drop by large teaspoonful onto baking sheet. Bake approximately 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Sugar Syrup
directions: Brown sugar in iron skillet, stirring all of the time to prevent scorching.
When brown, mix with boiling water and cook to a syrup.
recipes.text: Sugar Syrup. Brown sugar in iron skillet, stirring all of the time to prevent scorching. When brown, mix with boiling water and cook to a syrup.

recipes.title: Spinach Balls
ingredients: 2 c. Pepperidge Farm herb seasoned stuffing
directions: Cook spinach according to directions and drain thoroughly. Add remaining ingredients and mix well.
Pinch off and roll into bite-sized balls.
Freeze.
recipes.text: Spinach Balls. Cook spinach according to directions and drain thoroughly. Add remaining ingredients and mix well. Pinch off and roll into bite-sized balls. Freeze.

recipes.title: Wacky Cake
directions: Mix in pan you are going to bake it in.
Bake at 350° until done.
recipes.text: Wacky Cake. Mix in pan you are going to bake it in. Bake at 350° until done.

recipes.title: Schnitzel Beans
directions: Fry bacon until brown.
Crumble.
Add sugar and vinegar to crumbled bacon and fat.
Cook until sugar is dissolved.
Add greens beans and onion.
Simmer 20 minutes.
recipes.text: Schnitzel Beans. Fry bacon until brown. Crumble. Add sugar and vinegar to crumbled bacon and fat. Cook until sugar is dissolved. Add greens beans and onion. Simmer 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Hot Fudge Sauce
directions: Combine evaporated milk and chocolate pieces in top of double boiler.
Cook over hot water until chocolate is melted.
Serve hot.
recipes.text: Hot Fudge Sauce. Combine evaporated milk and chocolate pieces in top of double boiler. Cook over hot water until chocolate is melted. Serve hot.

recipes.title: Kopper Karrots
ingredients: 2 lb. carrots, sliced and cooked until just tender
directions: Bring pot of salted water to boil and add handful of dill stems.
Add new potatoes.
(Water should not entirely cover potatoes; it should cover only about 2/3 of each potato.) cover with lid and simmer for 15 minutes or until potatoes are just barely tender.
recipes.text: Kopper Karrots. Bring pot of salted water to boil and add handful of dill stems. Add new potatoes. (Water should not entirely cover potatoes; it should cover only about 2/3 of each potato.) cover with lid and simmer for 15 minutes or until potatoes are just barely tender.

recipes.title: Nina'S Fluffy Rice
directions: Place all ingredients in microwavable dish with tight fitting lid and place in microwave.
Cook on high power for 5 minutes.
Do not open container.
Then cook on 50 per cent power for 10 minutes.
Allow to set 5 minutes without opening.
Open, fluff, and serve.	Microwaves vary, so times may vary slightly.
recipes.text: Nina'S Fluffy Rice. Place all ingredients in microwavable dish with tight fitting lid and place in microwave. Cook on high power for 5 minutes. Do not open container. Then cook on 50 per cent power for 10 minutes. Allow to set 5 minutes without opening. Open, fluff, and serve.	Microwaves vary, so times may vary slightly.

recipes.title: Grandma'S Casserole
ingredients: 10 oz. ground turkey or turkey sausage
1/4 tsp. pepper, garlic and oregano to taste
directions: Saute onion, green pepper and celery in margarine until transparent; add remaining ingredients except cheese and noodles. Simmer 20 minutes.
Spoon enough of mixture to cover bottom of 8 x 11-inch pan.
Cover with uncooked noodles.
Cover with remaining mixture.
Sprinkle with cheese.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes. Makes 4 servings; 3 protein, 1 bread and 2 vegetables.
Let stand 15 minutes before serving.
recipes.text: Grandma'S Casserole. Saute onion, green pepper and celery in margarine until transparent; add remaining ingredients except cheese and noodles. Simmer 20 minutes. Spoon enough of mixture to cover bottom of 8 x 11-inch pan. Cover with uncooked noodles. Cover with remaining mixture. Sprinkle with cheese. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes. Makes 4 servings; 3 protein, 1 bread and 2 vegetables. Let stand 15 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Broccoli Cornbread
ingredients: 2 tsp. butter-flavored all natural dairy sprinkles
1 c. frozen chopped broccoli, thawed and drained
directions: Combine cornmeal and next 5 ingredients in a large bowl.
Make a well in center of mixture.
Combine broccoli and next 5 ingredients.
Stir well.
Add to dry ingredients, stirring until just moistened.
Place a 9-inch cast-iron skillet in a 425° oven for 5 minutes.
Remove from oven; heavily coat with cooking spray. Immediately spoon batter into skillet and bake at 425° for 28 minutes or until a wooden toothpick inserted in center comes out clean.
recipes.text: Broccoli Cornbread. Combine cornmeal and next 5 ingredients in a large bowl. Make a well in center of mixture. Combine broccoli and next 5 ingredients. Stir well. Add to dry ingredients, stirring until just moistened. Place a 9-inch cast-iron skillet in a 425° oven for 5 minutes. Remove from oven; heavily coat with cooking spray. Immediately spoon batter into skillet and bake at 425° for 28 minutes or until a wooden toothpick inserted in center comes out clean.

recipes.title: Breakfast Bread
directions: Preheat oven to 350°.
Measure corn flakes.
Crush to 3/4 cup. Stir in flour, baking powder and salt.
Set aside.
Measure butter and sugar into large bowl.
Beat until light and fluffy. Add eggs and orange peel.
Beat well.
Stir in juice.
Add dry ingredients, mixing only until combined.
Stir in nuts and raisins.
Spread in well-greased 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan.
Bake in oven at 350° about 50 minutes, or until toothpick inserted near center comes out clean.
Cool about 10 minutes before removing from pan.
Cool before slicing.
recipes.text: Breakfast Bread. Preheat oven to 350°. Measure corn flakes. Crush to 3/4 cup. Stir in flour, baking powder and salt. Set aside. Measure butter and sugar into large bowl. Beat until light and fluffy. Add eggs and orange peel. Beat well. Stir in juice. Add dry ingredients, mixing only until combined. Stir in nuts and raisins. Spread in well-greased 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan. Bake in oven at 350° about 50 minutes, or until toothpick inserted near center comes out clean. Cool about 10 minutes before removing from pan. Cool before slicing.

recipes.title: Zesty Peas
directions: Saute onion in butter until tender.
Add peas with juice and seasoning.
Simmer until peas are hot and juice is about gone.
recipes.text: Zesty Peas. Saute onion in butter until tender. Add peas with juice and seasoning. Simmer until peas are hot and juice is about gone.

recipes.title: Chicken Curry
directions: Cook bacon until crisp and break into small pieces.
Add celery, onion and garlic; cook until clear but not soft.
Blend in flour.
Stir in milk, water, applesauce, ketchup, curry and chicken broth.
Cook and stir until thick and bubbly.
Stir in chicken and simmer 15 or 20 minutes.
Add more chicken broth if too thick.
Serve over cooked rice and accompany with raisins, coconut, peanuts or chutney if desired.
recipes.text: Chicken Curry. Cook bacon until crisp and break into small pieces. Add celery, onion and garlic; cook until clear but not soft. Blend in flour. Stir in milk, water, applesauce, ketchup, curry and chicken broth. Cook and stir until thick and bubbly. Stir in chicken and simmer 15 or 20 minutes. Add more chicken broth if too thick. Serve over cooked rice and accompany with raisins, coconut, peanuts or chutney if desired.

recipes.title: Marinade For Chicken Or Pork
directions: Heat all ingredients to boiling point and cool thoroughly. Prick large pieces of meat with fork or cut into cubes for shish kabob.
Pour mixture over meat and marinate at least 4 hours. Charcoal broil.
recipes.text: Marinade For Chicken Or Pork. Heat all ingredients to boiling point and cool thoroughly. Prick large pieces of meat with fork or cut into cubes for shish kabob. Pour mixture over meat and marinate at least 4 hours. Charcoal broil.

recipes.title: Barbecued Shrimp
directions: Melt butter.
Add barbecue sauce, pepper, garlic and chopped green onions.
Bring to boil; remove from heat and let cool for 10 minutes.
Bring to a boil again.
Test shrimp to be sure they are cooked.
recipes.text: Barbecued Shrimp. Melt butter. Add barbecue sauce, pepper, garlic and chopped green onions. Bring to boil; remove from heat and let cool for 10 minutes. Bring to a boil again. Test shrimp to be sure they are cooked.

recipes.title: Frozen Fruit Salad(Alaska)
directions: Drain fruit cocktail and pineapple (save juices).
Soften gelatine in juices; heat to dissolve.
Cool; set aside.
Add fruit to gelatine mixture.
Let set until soft set; add nuts and mini marshmallows.
Fold in 1/2 pint whipping cream (whipped).
Pour into mold.
A large tube pan works well.
Freeze overnight.
Will keep frozen for quite some time; to loosen from mold, set in warm water.
Turn onto plate and slice.
recipes.text: Frozen Fruit Salad(Alaska). Drain fruit cocktail and pineapple (save juices). Soften gelatine in juices; heat to dissolve. Cool; set aside. Add fruit to gelatine mixture. Let set until soft set; add nuts and mini marshmallows. Fold in 1/2 pint whipping cream (whipped). Pour into mold. A large tube pan works well. Freeze overnight. Will keep frozen for quite some time; to loosen from mold, set in warm water. Turn onto plate and slice.

recipes.title: Coconut Black Walnut Cake
ingredients: 1 c. chopped black walnuts or can use pecans or walnuts
directions: Combine oil, sugar and eggs.
Add dry ingredients alternately. Add rest of ingredients and beat well.
Pour into greased and floured 10-inch tube pan.
Bake at 325° for 1 hour and 5 minutes. Pour hot Coconut Syrup over hot cake in pan.
Allow cake to remain in pan 4 hours to absorb syrup.
recipes.text: Coconut Black Walnut Cake. Combine oil, sugar and eggs. Add dry ingredients alternately. Add rest of ingredients and beat well. Pour into greased and floured 10-inch tube pan. Bake at 325° for 1 hour and 5 minutes. Pour hot Coconut Syrup over hot cake in pan. Allow cake to remain in pan 4 hours to absorb syrup.

recipes.title: Impossible Bacon Pie
directions: Grease a 9-inch pie pan.
Fry bacon and crumble into small pieces.
Put cheese, bacon and onion in pie plate.
Mix milk, eggs, Bisquick, salt and pepper.
Pour over cheese, bacon and onion. Bake at 400° for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Impossible Bacon Pie. Grease a 9-inch pie pan. Fry bacon and crumble into small pieces. Put cheese, bacon and onion in pie plate. Mix milk, eggs, Bisquick, salt and pepper. Pour over cheese, bacon and onion. Bake at 400° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: *Chocolate Pie
directions: Mix flour, sugar and salt.
Bring milk to scalding in a double boiler; add shaved chocolate to melt.
Then add milk mixture gradually to dry ingredients and stir constantly until filling thickens.
To this, add beaten egg yolks and butter or margarine. Continue to cook for 5 more minutes.
Add vanilla and cool.
Pour into baked 9-inch pie shell and cover with meringue.
recipes.text: *Chocolate Pie. Mix flour, sugar and salt. Bring milk to scalding in a double boiler; add shaved chocolate to melt. Then add milk mixture gradually to dry ingredients and stir constantly until filling thickens. To this, add beaten egg yolks and butter or margarine. Continue to cook for 5 more minutes. Add vanilla and cool. Pour into baked 9-inch pie shell and cover with meringue.

recipes.title: Florentine Casserole
ingredients: 1 pkg. florentine frozen vegetables (cauliflower, carrots and broccoli)
directions: Cook vegetables until tender; put in baking dish.
Melt 1/2 stick margarine and Velveeta cheese.
Pour over vegetables.
Melt remaining 1/2 stick margarine and mix with cracker crumbs.
Top vegetables with crumbs.
Bake at 350° for 30 to 45 minutes until brown.
recipes.text: Florentine Casserole. Cook vegetables until tender; put in baking dish. Melt 1/2 stick margarine and Velveeta cheese. Pour over vegetables. Melt remaining 1/2 stick margarine and mix with cracker crumbs. Top vegetables with crumbs. Bake at 350° for 30 to 45 minutes until brown.

recipes.title: Oriental Salad
ingredients: 1 c. sliced or slivered almonds or 2 pkg.
2 pkg. Ramen noodles, broken (do not use the seasoning packet included)
directions: Saute sunflower seeds, almonds and noodles until lightly brown in the oleo.
Mix romaine, that is torn in bite-size pieces, the broccoli and green onions together and then sprinkle the nut mixture on top.
Add the dressing and toss lightly.
recipes.text: Oriental Salad. Saute sunflower seeds, almonds and noodles until lightly brown in the oleo. Mix romaine, that is torn in bite-size pieces, the broccoli and green onions together and then sprinkle the nut mixture on top. Add the dressing and toss lightly.

recipes.title: Spice Applesauce Cake
directions: Grease and lightly flour a 9 x 13-inch baking pan.
Preheat oven to 350°.
recipes.text: Spice Applesauce Cake. Grease and lightly flour a 9 x 13-inch baking pan. Preheat oven to 350°.

recipes.title: Blueberry Salad
directions: First Layer:
Prepare 2 packages red raspberry Jell-O according to directions.
Let gel.
recipes.text: Blueberry Salad. First Layer: Prepare 2 packages red raspberry Jell-O according to directions. Let gel.

recipes.title: Breakfast Casserole
directions: Mix all ingredients in large bowl.
Put into greased pan and chill overnight.
Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Breakfast Casserole. Mix all ingredients in large bowl. Put into greased pan and chill overnight. Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Dream Bars
ingredients: 1 c. quick or old fashioned oats
1/2 c. Karo light or dark corn syrup
directions: Heat oven to 350°.
Grease 13 x 9-inch baking pan.
Beat margarine and sugar until fluffy.
Add combined oats and flour, mix well.
Spread evenly onto bottom of pan.
Bake 18-20 minutes or till light brown.
Cool slightly.
Beat cream cheese and sugar at medium speed till fluffy.
Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each.
Add remaining ingredients, mix till smooth.
Pour over partially cooled crust.
Bake an additional 45-50 minutes or till center appears set.
Cool completely on wire rack.
Chill.
Serve with whipped cream if desired.
Makes 20 bars.
recipes.text: Pumpkin Dream Bars. Heat oven to 350°. Grease 13 x 9-inch baking pan. Beat margarine and sugar until fluffy. Add combined oats and flour, mix well. Spread evenly onto bottom of pan. Bake 18-20 minutes or till light brown. Cool slightly. Beat cream cheese and sugar at medium speed till fluffy. Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each. Add remaining ingredients, mix till smooth. Pour over partially cooled crust. Bake an additional 45-50 minutes or till center appears set. Cool completely on wire rack. Chill. Serve with whipped cream if desired. Makes 20 bars.

recipes.title: Olive Bread
directions: Preheat oven to 350°.
Combine first 5 ingredients in bowl; mix well.
Slice bread into halves lengthwise.
Spread mixture on bottom halves of bread.
Replace tops.
Slice bread to, but not through, bottom.
Wrap in foil.
Bake for 20 to 25 minutes. Yield: 20 servings.
recipes.text: Olive Bread. Preheat oven to 350°. Combine first 5 ingredients in bowl; mix well. Slice bread into halves lengthwise. Spread mixture on bottom halves of bread. Replace tops. Slice bread to, but not through, bottom. Wrap in foil. Bake for 20 to 25 minutes. Yield: 20 servings.

recipes.title: Microwave "Tater Tot Casserole"
directions: Crumble and microwave beef on High for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Salt and pepper to taste.
Add Tater Tots on top of beef.
recipes.text: Microwave "Tater Tot Casserole". Crumble and microwave beef on High for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally. Salt and pepper to taste. Add Tater Tots on top of beef.

recipes.title: Fruit Cake Squares
ingredients: 1/2 lb. each: cherry, pineapple and mixed crystallized fruit
directions: Grease 10 x 15 pan. Dust lightly with flour. Spread 2 cups nuts on bottom of pan. Cream butter and sugar. Add eggs and beat well. Add flour, salt and flavoring. Spoon over nuts. Wet hands and pat gently to smooth out butter. Mix all fruit together. Spoon fruit mixture over batter. Again, pat fruit into batter using wet hands. Bake 1 hour at 290°. Cut while hot. Let cool.
recipes.text: Fruit Cake Squares. Grease 10 x 15 pan. Dust lightly with flour. Spread 2 cups nuts on bottom of pan. Cream butter and sugar. Add eggs and beat well. Add flour, salt and flavoring. Spoon over nuts. Wet hands and pat gently to smooth out butter. Mix all fruit together. Spoon fruit mixture over batter. Again, pat fruit into batter using wet hands. Bake 1 hour at 290°. Cut while hot. Let cool.

recipes.title: Mirjham'S German Turtle Cake
directions: Unwrap caramels first.
Make cake mix according to directions. Pour 1/2 the batter into 13 x 9-inch ungreased pan.
Bake at 350° for 15 minutes.
recipes.text: Mirjham'S German Turtle Cake. Unwrap caramels first. Make cake mix according to directions. Pour 1/2 the batter into 13 x 9-inch ungreased pan. Bake at 350° for 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Punch Bowl Cake
ingredients: 1 yellow cake (9 x 13-inch) or 2 (8 x 9-inch) round cake layers, prepared as directed from yellow cake mix
1 large family size pkg. instant vanilla pudding, prepared as directed on box
1 (20 oz.) can chunk or tidbits drained pineapple
directions: Place one cake layer or one-half of 9 x 13-inch cake in bottom of a 1 gallon or larger punch bowl.
(I use Tupperware cake box because I make 2 round layers.)
Cover with 1/2 of instant vanilla pudding, 1/2 can cherry pie filling, 1/2 can of fruit cocktail, 1/2 pineapple and coconut and 1/2 of the Cool Whip.
Sprinkle with 1/2 cup nuts.
recipes.text: Punch Bowl Cake. Place one cake layer or one-half of 9 x 13-inch cake in bottom of a 1 gallon or larger punch bowl. (I use Tupperware cake box because I make 2 round layers.) Cover with 1/2 of instant vanilla pudding, 1/2 can cherry pie filling, 1/2 can of fruit cocktail, 1/2 pineapple and coconut and 1/2 of the Cool Whip. Sprinkle with 1/2 cup nuts.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Dessert
directions: In a mixing bowl, combine the first five ingredients.
Put this mixture in a greased 9 x 13-inch pan.	Sprinkle with dry cake mix and drizzle with melted margarine.
Top with walnuts.
Bake at 350° for one hour or until knife comes out clean.
Serve with ice cream or Cool Whip.
recipes.text: Pumpkin Dessert. In a mixing bowl, combine the first five ingredients. Put this mixture in a greased 9 x 13-inch pan.	Sprinkle with dry cake mix and drizzle with melted margarine. Top with walnuts. Bake at 350° for one hour or until knife comes out clean. Serve with ice cream or Cool Whip.

recipes.title: Inexpensive Party Punch
directions: Mix all together.
Add ginger ale just before serving.
Serves approximately 50.
recipes.text: Inexpensive Party Punch. Mix all together. Add ginger ale just before serving. Serves approximately 50.

recipes.title: M&M Cookies
directions: Mix shortening, brown sugar, sugar, vanilla and eggs. Add dry ingredients. Put in 1/2 c. M&Ms. drop by teaspoons on ungreased cookie sheet. Decorate tops of cookies with 1 cup M&Ms. Bake at 375 degrees for 10 to 12 minutes.
recipes.text: M&M Cookies. Mix shortening, brown sugar, sugar, vanilla and eggs. Add dry ingredients. Put in 1/2 c. M&Ms. drop by teaspoons on ungreased cookie sheet. Decorate tops of cookies with 1 cup M&Ms. Bake at 375 degrees for 10 to 12 minutes.

recipes.title: Breakfast Ham Ring(Yields 8 Servings)
directions: In a large bowl lightly beat 2 eggs.
Add ham, sausage, bread crumbs, milk, parsley and horseradish and mix well.
Press into a greased 6 cup ring mold.
Bake at 350° for 1 1/4 hours.
Toward end of baking time, prepare scrambled eggs with remaining eggs. Remove ring from oven and drain juices.
Unmold onto serving platter.
Fill center with scrambled eggs.
Serve immediately.
recipes.text: Breakfast Ham Ring(Yields 8 Servings). In a large bowl lightly beat 2 eggs. Add ham, sausage, bread crumbs, milk, parsley and horseradish and mix well. Press into a greased 6 cup ring mold. Bake at 350° for 1 1/4 hours. Toward end of baking time, prepare scrambled eggs with remaining eggs. Remove ring from oven and drain juices. Unmold onto serving platter. Fill center with scrambled eggs. Serve immediately.

recipes.title: Open-Faced Vegetable Melt
ingredients: 1/2 small zucchini, halved lengthwise and sliced (about 1/2 c.)
1/2 c. seeded, coarsely chopped, unpeeled tomato
1/4 c. commercial, roasted red bell peppers, drained and coarsely chopped
1 (5-inch) piece Italian bread, split lengthwise and toasted (about 1/4 lb.)
directions: This meatless sandwich resembles a French bread pizza.
recipes.text: Open-Faced Vegetable Melt. This meatless sandwich resembles a French bread pizza.

recipes.title: Egg Salad Mold
directions: Sprinkle gelatin over water in saucepan.
Place over low heat; stir constantly until gelatin dissolves, about 3 minutes.
Remove from heat; stir in salt, lemon juice and Tabasco.
Gradually blend into mayonnaise.
Chill, stirring occasionally, until mixture mounds slightly when dropped from a spoon.
Stir in remaining ingredients.
Turn into a 3-cup mold.
Chill until firm.
Unmold and garnish with salad greens.
Makes 4 servings.
recipes.text: Egg Salad Mold. Sprinkle gelatin over water in saucepan. Place over low heat; stir constantly until gelatin dissolves, about 3 minutes. Remove from heat; stir in salt, lemon juice and Tabasco. Gradually blend into mayonnaise. Chill, stirring occasionally, until mixture mounds slightly when dropped from a spoon. Stir in remaining ingredients. Turn into a 3-cup mold. Chill until firm. Unmold and garnish with salad greens. Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: Beth'S Honey Chicken
directions: Melt butter in pan you plan to cook chicken in.
Combine other ingredients.
Roll chicken in this mixture and place in pan.
Bake at 375° for about 1 hour.
recipes.text: Beth'S Honey Chicken. Melt butter in pan you plan to cook chicken in. Combine other ingredients. Roll chicken in this mixture and place in pan. Bake at 375° for about 1 hour.

recipes.title: Carrot Pennies
ingredients: 2 lb. carrots, peeled and sliced thin (about 1/8 inch)
directions: Cook carrots until tender (about 7 minutes).
Drain and cool. Divide
carrots
into
half, peppers into half portions and onions into half portion.	Place layers of carrots, layers of
onions and
layers
of peppers in a buttered baking dish. Repeat with the remaining carrots, peppers and onions.
recipes.text: Carrot Pennies. Cook carrots until tender (about 7 minutes). Drain and cool. Divide carrots into half, peppers into half portions and onions into half portion.	Place layers of carrots, layers of onions and layers of peppers in a buttered baking dish. Repeat with the remaining carrots, peppers and onions.

recipes.title: Impossible Quiche
directions: Put first four ingredients in greased dish.
Blend or mix together remaining ingredients.
Pour over rest and bake at 400° for 35 minutes.
recipes.text: Impossible Quiche. Put first four ingredients in greased dish. Blend or mix together remaining ingredients. Pour over rest and bake at 400° for 35 minutes.

recipes.title: Pumpple Butter
directions: Combine ingredients and cook over low heat 4 to 5 hours or until desired thickness.
Keep refrigerated.
The amount of sugar to be used depends on whether using sweetened or unsweetened applesauce.
recipes.text: Pumpple Butter. Combine ingredients and cook over low heat 4 to 5 hours or until desired thickness. Keep refrigerated. The amount of sugar to be used depends on whether using sweetened or unsweetened applesauce.

recipes.title: Shrimp Spread Appetizer
ingredients: 1 (4.5 oz.) can shrimp, drained and chopped
directions: Mix together and refrigerate.
recipes.text: Shrimp Spread Appetizer. Mix together and refrigerate.

recipes.title: Cranberry Pineapple Fluff
directions: Mix all ingredients together and pour into 9 x 13 casserole dish.
Chill and serve.
May be frozen for later use.
recipes.text: Cranberry Pineapple Fluff. Mix all ingredients together and pour into 9 x 13 casserole dish. Chill and serve. May be frozen for later use.

recipes.title: Shrimp Stir-Fry
directions: Peel
and
devein
shrimp;
combine
soy sauce, sherry, ketchup, sugar
and
pepper.
Heat oil in wok or skillet.
Add garlic;
stir-fry for 30 seconds;
remove garlic.
Add ginger; stir-fry for 30 seconds; add shrimp, stir-fry for 5 minutes or until shrimp
turn	pink.
Add onion, celery, mushrooms, water chestnuts and bamboo shoots.
Stir-fry 30 seconds; stir in soy sauce mixture.
Add pimento and pea pods; heat through.
recipes.text: Shrimp Stir-Fry. Peel and devein shrimp; combine soy sauce, sherry, ketchup, sugar and pepper. Heat oil in wok or skillet. Add garlic; stir-fry for 30 seconds; remove garlic. Add ginger; stir-fry for 30 seconds; add shrimp, stir-fry for 5 minutes or until shrimp turn	pink. Add onion, celery, mushrooms, water chestnuts and bamboo shoots. Stir-fry 30 seconds; stir in soy sauce mixture. Add pimento and pea pods; heat through.

recipes.title: Chicken And Vegetables(Serves 1)
directions: Boil chicken.
Coat wok with vegetable cooking spray and heat. Dissolve chicken soup in water; pour into pan.
Add chicken and remaining ingredients.
Serve when chicken is hot.
recipes.text: Chicken And Vegetables(Serves 1). Boil chicken. Coat wok with vegetable cooking spray and heat. Dissolve chicken soup in water; pour into pan. Add chicken and remaining ingredients. Serve when chicken is hot.

recipes.title: Mexican Casserole
directions: Saute meat and onion in a little oil.
Add Ro-Tel tomatoes, broth and taco mix.
Heat this real good. Pour chips in baking dish and pour this mixture over them.
Put Mozzarella cheese on top. Place in a 400° oven and heat until mixture begins to bubble. Serve hot.
recipes.text: Mexican Casserole. Saute meat and onion in a little oil. Add Ro-Tel tomatoes, broth and taco mix. Heat this real good. Pour chips in baking dish and pour this mixture over them. Put Mozzarella cheese on top. Place in a 400° oven and heat until mixture begins to bubble. Serve hot.

recipes.title: Chocolate Pie
directions: Mix dry ingredients and add milk, eggs and vanilla.
Pour in a baked 9-inch pie crust.
Beat egg whites and brown on top of pie.
recipes.text: Chocolate Pie. Mix dry ingredients and add milk, eggs and vanilla. Pour in a baked 9-inch pie crust. Beat egg whites and brown on top of pie.

recipes.title: Carrot Cake
directions: Sift together flour, sugar, baking powder, soda and cinnamon. Add Wesson oil and eggs; mix for 3 minutes. Mix in 3 cups of finely grated carrots and 1 cup chopped nuts. Stir with spoon. Bake at 300°.
recipes.text: Carrot Cake. Sift together flour, sugar, baking powder, soda and cinnamon. Add Wesson oil and eggs; mix for 3 minutes. Mix in 3 cups of finely grated carrots and 1 cup chopped nuts. Stir with spoon. Bake at 300°.

recipes.title: Stuffed Shells
directions: Boil shells until done. Mix Ricotta cheese, Parmesan cheese and eggs in bowl. Stuff shells with mixture. Line in a 9 x 12- inch baking dish. Pour spaghetti sauce over stuffed shells and top with cheese. Bake at 350 for 30 minutes. Let sit for 15 minutes, then serve.
recipes.text: Stuffed Shells. Boil shells until done. Mix Ricotta cheese, Parmesan cheese and eggs in bowl. Stuff shells with mixture. Line in a 9 x 12- inch baking dish. Pour spaghetti sauce over stuffed shells and top with cheese. Bake at 350 for 30 minutes. Let sit for 15 minutes, then serve.

recipes.title: Beef Pie
ingredients: 6 serving recipe for instant mashed potatoes
directions: Prepare mashed potatoes, except reduce water to 1 cup. Stir in egg; spread on bottom and sides of a well-greased 9-inch pie pan. Bake in 400° oven 15 minutes. Brown beef and celery (some like a little onion, too) in large skillet. Pour off liquid. Stir in water, tomato paste, sugar and salt. Bring to boil. Spoon into potato crust. Sprinkle with topping. Continue baking at 400° for 10 to 15 minutes, until top is brown.
recipes.text: Beef Pie. Prepare mashed potatoes, except reduce water to 1 cup. Stir in egg; spread on bottom and sides of a well-greased 9-inch pie pan. Bake in 400° oven 15 minutes. Brown beef and celery (some like a little onion, too) in large skillet. Pour off liquid. Stir in water, tomato paste, sugar and salt. Bring to boil. Spoon into potato crust. Sprinkle with topping. Continue baking at 400° for 10 to 15 minutes, until top is brown.

recipes.title: Yorkshire Potato Pudding
directions: Boil and mash potatoes.
Combine bouillon cube, hot milk, butter, salt and pepper.
Beat into potatoes.
Reserve 1 1/2 tablespoons of the beaten egg and beat the remainder into the potatoes.
Pile into a buttered 9-inch cake pan and brush with reserved egg.
Sprinkle with paprika and broil until the top is browned.
Cut into wedges to serve.
Serves 8.
recipes.text: Yorkshire Potato Pudding. Boil and mash potatoes. Combine bouillon cube, hot milk, butter, salt and pepper. Beat into potatoes. Reserve 1 1/2 tablespoons of the beaten egg and beat the remainder into the potatoes. Pile into a buttered 9-inch cake pan and brush with reserved egg. Sprinkle with paprika and broil until the top is browned. Cut into wedges to serve. Serves 8.

recipes.title: Easy Chocolate Pie
directions: Cook all the ingredients together until thick.
Then add 1/4 cup oleo and 1 tablespoon vanilla.
Pour into baked pie crust.
recipes.text: Easy Chocolate Pie. Cook all the ingredients together until thick. Then add 1/4 cup oleo and 1 tablespoon vanilla. Pour into baked pie crust.

recipes.title: Peppermint Crunch
directions: Cover a cookie sheet with wax paper.
In a double boiler, melt chocolate.
Mix in peppermint and pour onto wax paper.
Spread into a thin layer by shaking cookie sheet or dropping cooking sheet onto counter.
Place in freezer for 5 minutes.
Break into bite-size pieces.
recipes.text: Peppermint Crunch. Cover a cookie sheet with wax paper. In a double boiler, melt chocolate. Mix in peppermint and pour onto wax paper. Spread into a thin layer by shaking cookie sheet or dropping cooking sheet onto counter. Place in freezer for 5 minutes. Break into bite-size pieces.

recipes.title: English Muffins
directions: Mix dry ingredients in medium mixing bowl.
Beat wet ingredients together with a fork.
Add wet ingredients with dry and mix until moist and lumpy.
Don't overbeat.
Fill muffin tins 1/2 to 2/3 full and bake at 400° for 20 to 25 minutes.
recipes.text: English Muffins. Mix dry ingredients in medium mixing bowl. Beat wet ingredients together with a fork. Add wet ingredients with dry and mix until moist and lumpy. Don't overbeat. Fill muffin tins 1/2 to 2/3 full and bake at 400° for 20 to 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Deep-Dish Pizza Casserole
directions: Cook hamburger and onion. Drain grease. Add water and tomato paste. Simmer 10 minutes. Spread biscuits in dish that is greased to make crust. Pour mixture over biscuits and add cheese. Cook at 350° for 20 minutes.
recipes.text: Deep-Dish Pizza Casserole. Cook hamburger and onion. Drain grease. Add water and tomato paste. Simmer 10 minutes. Spread biscuits in dish that is greased to make crust. Pour mixture over biscuits and add cheese. Cook at 350° for 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Broccoli Casserole
directions: Place cooked broccoli in casserole dish.
Top with sliced eggs and cheese.
Mix soup with milk and 1/2 of the onions.
Add this to casserole.
Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.
The last 5 minutes of baking, top with remaining onions.
recipes.text: Broccoli Casserole. Place cooked broccoli in casserole dish. Top with sliced eggs and cheese. Mix soup with milk and 1/2 of the onions. Add this to casserole. Bake at 350° for 25 minutes. The last 5 minutes of baking, top with remaining onions.

recipes.title: Fresh Apple Cake
directions: Preheat oven to 325°.
Grease and flour tube pan.
Combine sugar, eggs, oil, vanilla, lemon juice, salt and soda.
Add flour, apples and nuts; mix well.
Bake in preheated oven 1 hour 15 minutes.
Check after 1 hour.
Cool on rack.
Ga.
Ga.
recipes.text: Fresh Apple Cake. Preheat oven to 325°. Grease and flour tube pan. Combine sugar, eggs, oil, vanilla, lemon juice, salt and soda. Add flour, apples and nuts; mix well. Bake in preheated oven 1 hour 15 minutes. Check after 1 hour. Cool on rack. Ga. Ga.

recipes.title: Ranch Beans
directions: Melt butter. Brown hamburger, drain. Stir in soup mix and all other ingredients. Bake in a 2 qt. skillet at 400 degrees for 30-40 minutes. Can put in a crock pot and let it simmer quite awhile. This is great for a potluck!
recipes.text: Ranch Beans. Melt butter. Brown hamburger, drain. Stir in soup mix and all other ingredients. Bake in a 2 qt. skillet at 400 degrees for 30-40 minutes. Can put in a crock pot and let it simmer quite awhile. This is great for a potluck!

recipes.title: Strawberry And Pineapple Dip
ingredients: 1 (8 oz.) cream cheese or Neufchatel cheese (less calories)
1/3 c. sugar, powdered sugar or fructose (less calories)
directions: Let cheese soften at room temperature; mix in sugar and vanilla. Serve with strawberries or pineapple of piccolo cookies (Nabisco).
recipes.text: Strawberry And Pineapple Dip. Let cheese soften at room temperature; mix in sugar and vanilla. Serve with strawberries or pineapple of piccolo cookies (Nabisco).

recipes.title: Broccoli And Rice
ingredients: 1 large jar Cheez Whiz or 1 small jar regular and 1 small jar hot
directions: Saute onion in small amount of oleo.
Cook broccoli and drain. Mix the Cheez Whiz and soup; heat.
Mix all together rice, broccoli, onion and soup mixture.
Pour into a baking dish that has been sprayed with Pam.
Heat in oven for a few minutes.
recipes.text: Broccoli And Rice. Saute onion in small amount of oleo. Cook broccoli and drain. Mix the Cheez Whiz and soup; heat. Mix all together rice, broccoli, onion and soup mixture. Pour into a baking dish that has been sprayed with Pam. Heat in oven for a few minutes.

recipes.title: Chillin' Out Pasta Salad
ingredients: 1 (8 oz.) carton (1 c. ) plain nonfat yogurt
directions: Cook pasta according to package directions.
Drain.
Cool. In a large bowl, stir together yogurt, mustard and herb seasoning. Add pasta, celery and green onions.
Mix well.
Chill at least 2 hours.
Just before serving, carefully stir in shrimp and tomatoes.
Makes 12 servings.
Calories 140, total fat 1 g.
recipes.text: Chillin' Out Pasta Salad. Cook pasta according to package directions. Drain. Cool. In a large bowl, stir together yogurt, mustard and herb seasoning. Add pasta, celery and green onions. Mix well. Chill at least 2 hours. Just before serving, carefully stir in shrimp and tomatoes. Makes 12 servings. Calories 140, total fat 1 g.

recipes.title: 5 Cup Salad
directions: Blend all ingredients.
Refrigerate at least 1 hour before serving.
recipes.text: 5 Cup Salad. Blend all ingredients. Refrigerate at least 1 hour before serving.

recipes.title: Slush Punch
directions: Boil sugar, water and cherry jello.
Then add almond flavor and pineapple juice.
Place in large container and freeze.
Serve slightly thawed.
Great for parties!
recipes.text: Slush Punch. Boil sugar, water and cherry jello. Then add almond flavor and pineapple juice. Place in large container and freeze. Serve slightly thawed. Great for parties!

recipes.title: Mushroom Stuffing
directions: In a skillet, cook bacon until crisp; remove with a slotted spoon to paper towels.
Drain, reserving 2 tablespoons drippings. Saute celery and onion in the drippings until tender.
Add mushrooms, sage, salt and pepper; saute for 5 minutes.
Remove from the heat.
Stir in stuffing, celery leaves, parsley and bacon; mix well.
recipes.text: Mushroom Stuffing. In a skillet, cook bacon until crisp; remove with a slotted spoon to paper towels. Drain, reserving 2 tablespoons drippings. Saute celery and onion in the drippings until tender. Add mushrooms, sage, salt and pepper; saute for 5 minutes. Remove from the heat. Stir in stuffing, celery leaves, parsley and bacon; mix well.

recipes.title: Cheesecake Topped Brownies
directions: Preheat oven to 350°.
Prepare brownie mix as directed.
Spread in well-greased 9 x 13-inch baking pan.
In small mixing bowl, beat cheese, margarine and cornstarch until fluffy.
Gradually beat in canned milk, egg and vanilla until smooth.
Pour evenly over brownie batter.
Bake 45 minutes or until top is lightly browned. Cool.
Spread with frosting.
Cut in bars.
Store covered in refrigerator.
Makes 40 brownies.
recipes.text: Cheesecake Topped Brownies. Preheat oven to 350°. Prepare brownie mix as directed. Spread in well-greased 9 x 13-inch baking pan. In small mixing bowl, beat cheese, margarine and cornstarch until fluffy. Gradually beat in canned milk, egg and vanilla until smooth. Pour evenly over brownie batter. Bake 45 minutes or until top is lightly browned. Cool. Spread with frosting. Cut in bars. Store covered in refrigerator. Makes 40 brownies.

recipes.title: Cream Tacos
ingredients: 1 to 2 lb. cooked and drained ground chuck
1 onion, diced and cooked with meat
directions: Mix beans and chili in large pot.
Add meat mix and cheese. Stir often so it won't stick.
When cheese is melted and mixed in good, add whipping cream (unwhipped).
Simmer until hot and bubbly, stirring frequently.
Serve with tortilla chips.
recipes.text: Cream Tacos. Mix beans and chili in large pot. Add meat mix and cheese. Stir often so it won't stick. When cheese is melted and mixed in good, add whipping cream (unwhipped). Simmer until hot and bubbly, stirring frequently. Serve with tortilla chips.

recipes.title: Microwave Party Mix
ingredients: 1 1/2 c. each: Corn Chex, Rice Chex, Wheat Chex, Cheerios, Cheese Squares and pretzels
directions: Combine cereals, crackers, pretzels and nuts in a large glass, microwavable
bowl.
Mix
margarine
and seasonings in small bowl.
Pour over cereal mixture to coat well.
Microwave on
High for 4 minutes.
Stir once.	Spread on paper towels or put in paper bag to drain.
Cool.
Yields 3 to 4 quarts.
recipes.text: Microwave Party Mix. Combine cereals, crackers, pretzels and nuts in a large glass, microwavable bowl. Mix margarine and seasonings in small bowl. Pour over cereal mixture to coat well. Microwave on High for 4 minutes. Stir once.	Spread on paper towels or put in paper bag to drain. Cool. Yields 3 to 4 quarts.

recipes.title: Jello Punch
directions: Dissolve Jell-O in 9 cups of boiling water.
Set aside and let cool.
Dissolve sugar in 4 cups of warm water and add Jell-O. Cool.
Add lemon juice and pineapple juice.
Mix well.
recipes.text: Jello Punch. Dissolve Jell-O in 9 cups of boiling water. Set aside and let cool. Dissolve sugar in 4 cups of warm water and add Jell-O. Cool. Add lemon juice and pineapple juice. Mix well.

recipes.title: Southern Sweet Potato Pie
directions: In a large mixing bowl combine flour, sugar; add potatoes, eggs, corn syrup and evaporated milk. Beat well. Pour into pastry shell.
Bake at 350°F for 55-60 minutes. Serves 8.
recipes.text: Southern Sweet Potato Pie. In a large mixing bowl combine flour, sugar; add potatoes, eggs, corn syrup and evaporated milk. Beat well. Pour into pastry shell. Bake at 350°F for 55-60 minutes. Serves 8.

recipes.title: Velvet Pound Cake
ingredients: 1 (5 oz.) can evaporated milk plus enough sweet milk to make 1 c.
directions: Cream butter and
sugar
together.
Add
eggs, one at a time. Add remaining ingredients.
Bake in greased and floured 10-inch tube pan at 300° for 1 1/2 hours.
recipes.text: Velvet Pound Cake. Cream butter and sugar together. Add eggs, one at a time. Add remaining ingredients. Bake in greased and floured 10-inch tube pan at 300° for 1 1/2 hours.

recipes.title: Apple Pound Cake
ingredients: 1/4 c. buttermilk or plain nonfat yogurt
2 medium apples, peeled and diced (2 c.)
directions: Heat oven to 350°.
Spray a 10-inch tube pan with Pam.
Mix flour, baking powder and soda until blended.
In a large bowl, beat sugar, margarine and buttermilk about 4 minutes.
With a mixer on medium speed, alternately add flour mixture and egg substitute.
Beat until well blended and fluffy.
Stir in apples and vanilla.
Spread in pan.
Bake 1 hour or until golden brown and a pick inserted in center of cake comes out clean.
Cool on wire rack 10 minutes.
Turn out onto rack and cool completely. Dust with confectioners sugar.
recipes.text: Apple Pound Cake. Heat oven to 350°. Spray a 10-inch tube pan with Pam. Mix flour, baking powder and soda until blended. In a large bowl, beat sugar, margarine and buttermilk about 4 minutes. With a mixer on medium speed, alternately add flour mixture and egg substitute. Beat until well blended and fluffy. Stir in apples and vanilla. Spread in pan. Bake 1 hour or until golden brown and a pick inserted in center of cake comes out clean. Cool on wire rack 10 minutes. Turn out onto rack and cool completely. Dust with confectioners sugar.

recipes.title: Easy Chocolate Bars
directions: In 15 1/2 x 10 1/2-inch jelly roll pan, melt oleo while heating oven to 350°.
Sprinkle and pat dry cake mix over oleo. Sprinkle with marshmallows, chocolate chips, cherries and pecans. Drizzle condensed milk over the top.
recipes.text: Easy Chocolate Bars. In 15 1/2 x 10 1/2-inch jelly roll pan, melt oleo while heating oven to 350°. Sprinkle and pat dry cake mix over oleo. Sprinkle with marshmallows, chocolate chips, cherries and pecans. Drizzle condensed milk over the top.

recipes.title: Spanakopita(Greek Spinach Pie)
ingredients: 1 c. cottage, Ricotta or Feta cheese
directions: Mix spinach, onion, eggs, crumbs, parsley, oil and cheeses in large bowl.
Melt butter.
Grease a 9 x 13-inch pan; dust with some bread crumbs.
Unroll phyllo and lay out 1 sheet into pan. Brush with melted butter.
Keep remaining phyllo covered with damp cloth.
Continue with 5 more sheets, brushing each with butter. Place mixture into pan; smooth top.
Arrange 6 more buttered sheets, one at a time.
Using razor blade, cut squares through top layers only.
Bake at 375° for 1 hour.
Finish cutting squares through to bottom layers.
recipes.text: Spanakopita(Greek Spinach Pie). Mix spinach, onion, eggs, crumbs, parsley, oil and cheeses in large bowl. Melt butter. Grease a 9 x 13-inch pan; dust with some bread crumbs. Unroll phyllo and lay out 1 sheet into pan. Brush with melted butter. Keep remaining phyllo covered with damp cloth. Continue with 5 more sheets, brushing each with butter. Place mixture into pan; smooth top. Arrange 6 more buttered sheets, one at a time. Using razor blade, cut squares through top layers only. Bake at 375° for 1 hour. Finish cutting squares through to bottom layers.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Temptations
ingredients: 1 bag (48) Reese's miniature peanut butter cups, unwrapped
directions: Cream the butter, peanut butter and sugars.
Add egg and vanilla. Stir together flour, baking soda and salt.
Blend into creamed mixture to make dough.
Preheat oven to 375°.
Shape dough into 1-inch balls and place into ungreased mini muffin pans (tassi pans).
Bake 8 to 10 minutes.
Immediately after removing cookies from oven, press peanut butter cup into center until only top of cup shows.
Cool and store in airtight container. Makes 48 cookies.
recipes.text: Peanut Butter Temptations. Cream the butter, peanut butter and sugars. Add egg and vanilla. Stir together flour, baking soda and salt. Blend into creamed mixture to make dough. Preheat oven to 375°. Shape dough into 1-inch balls and place into ungreased mini muffin pans (tassi pans). Bake 8 to 10 minutes. Immediately after removing cookies from oven, press peanut butter cup into center until only top of cup shows. Cool and store in airtight container. Makes 48 cookies.

recipes.title: Baked Macaroni And Cheese
directions: Preheat oven to 375°.
Cook macaroni as package label directs; drain.
Meanwhile, melt butter in saucepan.
Remove from heat; stir in flour, salt and pepper until smooth.
Gradually stir in milk; bring to boiling, stirring constantly.
Reduce heat and simmer 1 minute.
Remove from heat; stir in 1 1/2 cups cheese and the macaroni.
Pour into 1 1/2-quart casserole.
Sprinkle remaining cheese on top.
Bake, uncovered, 20 minutes or until top is golden brown.
Makes 4 to 6 servings.
recipes.text: Baked Macaroni And Cheese. Preheat oven to 375°. Cook macaroni as package label directs; drain. Meanwhile, melt butter in saucepan. Remove from heat; stir in flour, salt and pepper until smooth. Gradually stir in milk; bring to boiling, stirring constantly. Reduce heat and simmer 1 minute. Remove from heat; stir in 1 1/2 cups cheese and the macaroni. Pour into 1 1/2-quart casserole. Sprinkle remaining cheese on top. Bake, uncovered, 20 minutes or until top is golden brown. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

recipes.title: Green Tomato Mincemeat
ingredients: 1 orange, grate rind and chop pulp (optional)
directions: Sprinkle salt over tomatoes and let set 1 hour; drain.
Cover with boiling water and let set 5 minutes.
Drain well.
Mix remaining ingredients and cook until mixture is boiling hot.
Put into jars and leave 1-inch headspace.
Put on lids and rings. Process 25 minutes at 10 pounds pressure or 2 hours in hot water bath.
recipes.text: Green Tomato Mincemeat. Sprinkle salt over tomatoes and let set 1 hour; drain. Cover with boiling water and let set 5 minutes. Drain well. Mix remaining ingredients and cook until mixture is boiling hot. Put into jars and leave 1-inch headspace. Put on lids and rings. Process 25 minutes at 10 pounds pressure or 2 hours in hot water bath.

recipes.title: Oatmeal Icebox Cookies
directions: Cream oleo and sugars.
Beat eggs and add to sugar.
Add the flour, soda, and salt.
Then add the vanilla, oatmeal and nuts or chips.
Mix well and make long rolls.
Refrigerate overnight, cut and bake at 350° for 12-15 minutes.
recipes.text: Oatmeal Icebox Cookies. Cream oleo and sugars. Beat eggs and add to sugar. Add the flour, soda, and salt. Then add the vanilla, oatmeal and nuts or chips. Mix well and make long rolls. Refrigerate overnight, cut and bake at 350° for 12-15 minutes.

recipes.title: Cucumber Dip
directions: Wash unpeeled cuke and shred it.
Squeeze as much water out of cuke as you can so dip won't be too runny.
Mix all together. Serve with broccoli or cauliflower.
recipes.text: Cucumber Dip. Wash unpeeled cuke and shred it. Squeeze as much water out of cuke as you can so dip won't be too runny. Mix all together. Serve with broccoli or cauliflower.

recipes.title: Pound Cake
ingredients: 3/4 c. to 1 c. nuts finely chopped (optional)
directions: Cream sugar and margarine. Alternately add eggs and flour (add 1 egg, mix well, then add approx. 1/3 c. flour, mix well and continue until all eggs and flour are mixed). Add flavorings and nuts. Bake in a 12 c. tube pan that has been greased and floured. Cut a ring of waxed paper to fit in the bottom of pan. Bake 25 minutes at 275 degrees, then 60 minutes at 300 degrees. Remove from pan immediately and wrap in foil.
recipes.text: Pound Cake. Cream sugar and margarine. Alternately add eggs and flour (add 1 egg, mix well, then add approx. 1/3 c. flour, mix well and continue until all eggs and flour are mixed). Add flavorings and nuts. Bake in a 12 c. tube pan that has been greased and floured. Cut a ring of waxed paper to fit in the bottom of pan. Bake 25 minutes at 275 degrees, then 60 minutes at 300 degrees. Remove from pan immediately and wrap in foil.

recipes.title: Zucchini Bread
ingredients: optional: raisins, dates, slivered almonds, etc.
directions: Preheat oven to 350°.
Cream together shortening and sugar. Beat in the eggs until smooth.
Add water, zucchini and vanilla. Mix together well.
recipes.text: Zucchini Bread. Preheat oven to 350°. Cream together shortening and sugar. Beat in the eggs until smooth. Add water, zucchini and vanilla. Mix together well.

recipes.title: Super Meat Loaf(Microwave)
directions: In a bowl mix the first seven ingredients.
Shape mixture on the roast rack in a 2-quart oblong dish.
Score the top with diagonal 1/2-inch valleys.
Combine brown sugar, dry mustard and catsup.
Spoon and spread over top of meat.
Microwave uncovered on High for 12 to 14 minutes, rotating dish once.
Remove and cover meat with waxed paper.
Let stand 10 minutes before serving.
recipes.text: Super Meat Loaf(Microwave). In a bowl mix the first seven ingredients. Shape mixture on the roast rack in a 2-quart oblong dish. Score the top with diagonal 1/2-inch valleys. Combine brown sugar, dry mustard and catsup. Spoon and spread over top of meat. Microwave uncovered on High for 12 to 14 minutes, rotating dish once. Remove and cover meat with waxed paper. Let stand 10 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Hot Fruit Casserole
ingredients: 1 (16 oz.) can white cherries, drained and pitted
directions: Arrange fruit in layers in buttered 3-quart casserole. Sprinkle each layer with brown sugar, cinnamon and nutmeg; dot with butter.
Bake in a 300° oven for about 30 minutes.
Yields 10 to 12 servings.
recipes.text: Hot Fruit Casserole. Arrange fruit in layers in buttered 3-quart casserole. Sprinkle each layer with brown sugar, cinnamon and nutmeg; dot with butter. Bake in a 300° oven for about 30 minutes. Yields 10 to 12 servings.

recipes.title: Turnovers
directions: For sour milk, add 1 tablespoon ReaLemon or vinegar to sweet milk.
recipes.text: Turnovers. For sour milk, add 1 tablespoon ReaLemon or vinegar to sweet milk.

recipes.title: Clam Dip
directions: Drain and save juice from clams.
Mix liquids and cream cheese until smooth.
Add clam juice until desired consistency is reached.
Stir in clams.
Refrigerate until ready to serve.
recipes.text: Clam Dip. Drain and save juice from clams. Mix liquids and cream cheese until smooth. Add clam juice until desired consistency is reached. Stir in clams. Refrigerate until ready to serve.

recipes.title: Lime Cottage Cheese Salad
ingredients: 1 c. drained, small curd cottage cheese
directions: Dissolve jello in boiling water; add marshmallows and let melt.
Stir in salt and pineapple.
Chill until slightly thickened.
Fold in cottage cheese, whipped cream and nuts.
Turn into 8 x 8-inch pan.
recipes.text: Lime Cottage Cheese Salad. Dissolve jello in boiling water; add marshmallows and let melt. Stir in salt and pineapple. Chill until slightly thickened. Fold in cottage cheese, whipped cream and nuts. Turn into 8 x 8-inch pan.

recipes.title: Venison Roast
directions: Soak roast in 1/2 c. vinegar and 3 Tbsp. salt in enough water to cover roast for about 4 hours.
Remove and pat dry.
Rub roast with seasoning salt or Cajun seasoning.
Cut slits in roast and insert cloves of garlic.
Put olive oil in pan and heat.
Quickly sear outside of roast.
Remove from pan and place in aluminum foil and seal well.
Pour on liquid smoke and worcestershire sauce. Seal well in foil.
Place in pan and roast at
300° for 3 to 4 hours.
Check after 3 hours.
Don't overcook.
Do just past medium rare or medium.
Serve with dripping juice from pan and vegetables.
recipes.text: Venison Roast. Soak roast in 1/2 c. vinegar and 3 Tbsp. salt in enough water to cover roast for about 4 hours. Remove and pat dry. Rub roast with seasoning salt or Cajun seasoning. Cut slits in roast and insert cloves of garlic. Put olive oil in pan and heat. Quickly sear outside of roast. Remove from pan and place in aluminum foil and seal well. Pour on liquid smoke and worcestershire sauce. Seal well in foil. Place in pan and roast at 300° for 3 to 4 hours. Check after 3 hours. Don't overcook. Do just past medium rare or medium. Serve with dripping juice from pan and vegetables.

recipes.title: Quaker Oat Bran Muffins
directions: Heat oven to 425°F.
Line 12 muffin cups with paper baking cups.
recipes.text: Quaker Oat Bran Muffins. Heat oven to 425°F. Line 12 muffin cups with paper baking cups.

recipes.title: Cherry Cheesecake
directions: Mix first 3 ingredients together and pat in graham cracker crust in a pan.
Cook at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes.
Mix together cream cheese and sugar until soft.
Pour on top of the mixture. Slice banana on top of cream cheese mixture.
Spread cherry pie filling on top.
Top with Cool Whip.
recipes.text: Cherry Cheesecake. Mix first 3 ingredients together and pat in graham cracker crust in a pan. Cook at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes. Mix together cream cheese and sugar until soft. Pour on top of the mixture. Slice banana on top of cream cheese mixture. Spread cherry pie filling on top. Top with Cool Whip.

recipes.title: Cranberry Bread
directions: Sift dry ingredients.
Add the rest and blend by hand, only until moist and well blended.
Bake in ungreased loaf pan for 1 hour or until done at 350°.
recipes.text: Cranberry Bread. Sift dry ingredients. Add the rest and blend by hand, only until moist and well blended. Bake in ungreased loaf pan for 1 hour or until done at 350°.

recipes.title: Coconut-Butterscotch Fudge
directions: Stir together Parkay, milk and sugar in a heavy 2 1/2 to 3-quart saucepan.
Bring to a full boil, stirring constantly. Boil 5 minutes over medium heat.
Stir to prevent scorching. Remove from heat.
Stir in marshmallow cream, then butterscotch chips until melted. Add coconut and extract.
Pour into greased 9 x 13-inch pan.
Cool and cut into squares.
Makes 3 pounds.
recipes.text: Coconut-Butterscotch Fudge. Stir together Parkay, milk and sugar in a heavy 2 1/2 to 3-quart saucepan. Bring to a full boil, stirring constantly. Boil 5 minutes over medium heat. Stir to prevent scorching. Remove from heat. Stir in marshmallow cream, then butterscotch chips until melted. Add coconut and extract. Pour into greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Cool and cut into squares. Makes 3 pounds.

recipes.title: Banana Cream Dessert
ingredients: 2 small pkg. instant banana or vanilla pudding
directions: Blend butter, flour and pecans.
Pat into a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake 15 minutes or until slightly browned in 350° oven.
Cool. Cream together cream cheese and powdered sugar; fold in whipped topping.
Spread on crust.
Slice bananas on mixture.
Mix pudding with milk; spread over bananas.
Top with whipped topping.
Garnish with a few chopped nuts.
recipes.text: Banana Cream Dessert. Blend butter, flour and pecans. Pat into a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake 15 minutes or until slightly browned in 350° oven. Cool. Cream together cream cheese and powdered sugar; fold in whipped topping. Spread on crust. Slice bananas on mixture. Mix pudding with milk; spread over bananas. Top with whipped topping. Garnish with a few chopped nuts.

recipes.title: Party Punch
ingredients: 2 cans orange juice concentrate (6 oz. cans)
directions: Mix well.
Garnish with orange slices, strawberries or maraschino cherries.
Makes 25 cups.
recipes.text: Party Punch. Mix well. Garnish with orange slices, strawberries or maraschino cherries. Makes 25 cups.

recipes.title: Frozen Punch
directions: Boil together 4 c. sugar and 6 c water until sugar is dissolved. Cool. Combine juices, lemonade and bananas with cooled sugar water. Mix well and freeze. When ready, mix with 7 Up, sour or your favorite mix to make slush consistency.
recipes.text: Frozen Punch. Boil together 4 c. sugar and 6 c water until sugar is dissolved. Cool. Combine juices, lemonade and bananas with cooled sugar water. Mix well and freeze. When ready, mix with 7 Up, sour or your favorite mix to make slush consistency.

recipes.title: Yummy Yummy Salad
ingredients: 1 (3 oz.) pkg. red or green gelatin
directions: Dissolve gelatin in 1/2 cup boiling water.
Chill until syrupy.
Add remaining ingredients; let set before serving.
recipes.text: Yummy Yummy Salad. Dissolve gelatin in 1/2 cup boiling water. Chill until syrupy. Add remaining ingredients; let set before serving.

recipes.title: Beans
ingredients: 1 (15 oz.) can each: Great Northern beans, butter beans and kidney beans
directions: Drain all but 1 can of beans.
Brown hamburger, onion and pepper.
Brown bacon.
Put all ingredients in crock-pot and cook until hot.
recipes.text: Beans. Drain all but 1 can of beans. Brown hamburger, onion and pepper. Brown bacon. Put all ingredients in crock-pot and cook until hot.

recipes.title: Swedish Slaw
directions: Shred 5 to 6 pounds of cabbage and sprinkle 1 cup of sugar over it; set to one side.
recipes.text: Swedish Slaw. Shred 5 to 6 pounds of cabbage and sprinkle 1 cup of sugar over it; set to one side.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Cake
directions: Beat eggs, pumpkin, oil and water together, then add remaining ingredients.
Pour into a 9 x 13-inch cake pan.
Bake for 1 hour or until done.
When cool, frost.
recipes.text: Pumpkin Cake. Beat eggs, pumpkin, oil and water together, then add remaining ingredients. Pour into a 9 x 13-inch cake pan. Bake for 1 hour or until done. When cool, frost.

recipes.title: Punch
directions: Mix first
4 ingredients together.
Freeze concentrate, then add ginger ale when you serve.
recipes.text: Punch. Mix first 4 ingredients together. Freeze concentrate, then add ginger ale when you serve.

recipes.title: Cabbage Casserole
directions: Cook cabbage until you can cut with fork.
Drain.
Stir in cheese and 1/2 margarine until melted.
Pour into buttered casserole dish.
Melt remaining margarine and stir in Ritz crackers.
Put cracker mixture over cabbage and bake until brown on top (about 25 minutes in 350° oven).
recipes.text: Cabbage Casserole. Cook cabbage until you can cut with fork. Drain. Stir in cheese and 1/2 margarine until melted. Pour into buttered casserole dish. Melt remaining margarine and stir in Ritz crackers. Put cracker mixture over cabbage and bake until brown on top (about 25 minutes in 350° oven).

recipes.title: Lasagna
ingredients: 1 pkg. Ricotta cheese, beaten with 1 egg until smooth
directions: Mash garlic clove with salt; brown with chopped onion in oil. Add ground beef and pork; cook until meat is done.
Add the tomato sauce, tomato paste and water.
Add Worcestershire sauce, Tabasco sauce, oregano, basil, bay leaf and pepper; simmer for 45 minutes. Cook and drain lasagna noodles (add small amount of oil to water while cooking).
Alternate layers of sauce, pasta, Mozzarella cheese and Ricotta cheese, beginning and ending with sauce.
Top with a generous sprinkling of grated Romano cheese.
Bake at 350° for 1/2 hour.
Cool 10 minutes before cutting.
recipes.text: Lasagna. Mash garlic clove with salt; brown with chopped onion in oil. Add ground beef and pork; cook until meat is done. Add the tomato sauce, tomato paste and water. Add Worcestershire sauce, Tabasco sauce, oregano, basil, bay leaf and pepper; simmer for 45 minutes. Cook and drain lasagna noodles (add small amount of oil to water while cooking). Alternate layers of sauce, pasta, Mozzarella cheese and Ricotta cheese, beginning and ending with sauce. Top with a generous sprinkling of grated Romano cheese. Bake at 350° for 1/2 hour. Cool 10 minutes before cutting.

recipes.title: German Sweet Sour Cabbage
directions: Quarter head of cabbage; chop coarsely, cutting out stem.
Put fat in frypan.
Saute onion in fat.
Put cabbage and cut apple in. Put sugar, vinegar, salt, red wine and sauteed onion in.
Put cinnamon stick in ingredients.
Cook in boiling pan.
Steam rather than boil.
Stir ingredients well and cook until done.
recipes.text: German Sweet Sour Cabbage. Quarter head of cabbage; chop coarsely, cutting out stem. Put fat in frypan. Saute onion in fat. Put cabbage and cut apple in. Put sugar, vinegar, salt, red wine and sauteed onion in. Put cinnamon stick in ingredients. Cook in boiling pan. Steam rather than boil. Stir ingredients well and cook until done.

recipes.title: Oven Fried Honey Chicken
ingredients: 2 tsp. balsamic or red wine vinegar
directions: In large bowl, whisk the honey and vinegar. Pour bread crumbs into separate bowl and set aside. Spread oil over foil-lined baking dish large enough to hold all chicken in single layer. Roll chicken in honey mixture, then bread crumbs and place in pan. Bake at 375° for 30 minutes or until cooked thoroughly.
recipes.text: Oven Fried Honey Chicken. In large bowl, whisk the honey and vinegar. Pour bread crumbs into separate bowl and set aside. Spread oil over foil-lined baking dish large enough to hold all chicken in single layer. Roll chicken in honey mixture, then bread crumbs and place in pan. Bake at 375° for 30 minutes or until cooked thoroughly.

recipes.title: Lydia'S Corn Chowder
ingredients: 3 medium potatoes, peeled and coarsely chopped
directions: In a large saucepan combine potatoes, water, bouillon, red pepper and black pepper.
Bring to boil, reduce heat.
Cover and simmer about 10 minutes or until potatoes are just tender, stirring occasionally.
Stir in 2 1/2 cups of the milk and corn.
recipes.text: Lydia'S Corn Chowder. In a large saucepan combine potatoes, water, bouillon, red pepper and black pepper. Bring to boil, reduce heat. Cover and simmer about 10 minutes or until potatoes are just tender, stirring occasionally. Stir in 2 1/2 cups of the milk and corn.

recipes.title: Guess-Again Cookies
directions: Beat butter, sugar and vanilla until fluffy.
Add flour, potato chips and pecans.
Mix well.
Drop by scant teaspoon 2 inches apart onto an ungreased baking sheet.
Flatten by pressing with bottom of glass, greased and dipped in sugar.
Place pecan half on top of each cookie.
Bake in moderate oven (350°) for 10 to 12 minutes.
recipes.text: Guess-Again Cookies. Beat butter, sugar and vanilla until fluffy. Add flour, potato chips and pecans. Mix well. Drop by scant teaspoon 2 inches apart onto an ungreased baking sheet. Flatten by pressing with bottom of glass, greased and dipped in sugar. Place pecan half on top of each cookie. Bake in moderate oven (350°) for 10 to 12 minutes.

recipes.title: Broccoli Soup
directions: Cook broccoli until tender and then set aside until later. Combine in saucepan Bisquick, milk, salt and margarine.
Cook until thickened and add chopped onion and shredded cheese.
Add broccoli last.
recipes.text: Broccoli Soup. Cook broccoli until tender and then set aside until later. Combine in saucepan Bisquick, milk, salt and margarine. Cook until thickened and add chopped onion and shredded cheese. Add broccoli last.

recipes.title: Easy Peach Cobbler
ingredients: 5 fresh peaches, cut up and sprinkled with sugar and cinnamon
directions: Combine all ingredients except peaches in baking dish.
Lay peaches on top.
Bake for 35 to 40 minutes at 350°.
recipes.text: Easy Peach Cobbler. Combine all ingredients except peaches in baking dish. Lay peaches on top. Bake for 35 to 40 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Meatballs
ingredients: 1 envelope dry Lipton onion soup mix
directions: Can add small pieces of pepperoni for an extra zip!!
recipes.text: Meatballs. Can add small pieces of pepperoni for an extra zip!!

recipes.title: Sweet Dill Pickles
directions: Put sliced pickles back in jar.
Bring to boil last four ingredients and pour over pickles.
Let stand overnight in refrigerator before serving.
recipes.text: Sweet Dill Pickles. Put sliced pickles back in jar. Bring to boil last four ingredients and pour over pickles. Let stand overnight in refrigerator before serving.

recipes.title: Congealed Cherry Salad
directions: Drain liquid from cherries, add enough water to make 2 cups of liquid; heat and pour over gelatin.
Stir and add cream cheese to hot mixture.
Add mayonnaise and put in blender.
Cool.
Add pineapple and pineapple juice, pitted cherries, coke and nuts. Stir to mix.
Spray mold with Pam Cooking Spray.
Pour mixture into mold.
Refrigerate to gel.
recipes.text: Congealed Cherry Salad. Drain liquid from cherries, add enough water to make 2 cups of liquid; heat and pour over gelatin. Stir and add cream cheese to hot mixture. Add mayonnaise and put in blender. Cool. Add pineapple and pineapple juice, pitted cherries, coke and nuts. Stir to mix. Spray mold with Pam Cooking Spray. Pour mixture into mold. Refrigerate to gel.

recipes.title: Broccoli Cheese Casserole
directions: "Tender quick" cook broccoli; drain and arrange broccoli in buttered casserole dish.
Mix soup, mayonnaise, juice, cheese and pimento; spoon over broccoli and top with crackers and nuts.
Bake at 350° for approximately 40 minutes.
recipes.text: Broccoli Cheese Casserole. "Tender quick" cook broccoli; drain and arrange broccoli in buttered casserole dish. Mix soup, mayonnaise, juice, cheese and pimento; spoon over broccoli and top with crackers and nuts. Bake at 350° for approximately 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Honey-Baked Beans
directions: Saute bacon and onion until onion is tender; combine with remaining ingredients in shallow 2-quart baking dish.
Cover with lid or aluminum foil and bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
Uncover and bake 45 minutes longer.
Makes 4 to 6 servings.
recipes.text: Honey-Baked Beans. Saute bacon and onion until onion is tender; combine with remaining ingredients in shallow 2-quart baking dish. Cover with lid or aluminum foil and bake at 350° for 30 minutes. Uncover and bake 45 minutes longer. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

recipes.title: Watergate Salad
directions: Mix pudding and pineapple.
Add Cool Whip.
Add marshmallows and nuts.
Chill several hours before serving.
recipes.text: Watergate Salad. Mix pudding and pineapple. Add Cool Whip. Add marshmallows and nuts. Chill several hours before serving.

recipes.title: Party Potatoes
directions: Stir 1/4 cup of the butter into the hot mashed potatoes.
Whip cream cheese with sour cream until smooth and fluffy in the blender.
Add cream cheese-sour cream mixture, salt and pepper to hot potatoes and mix well.
Spoon into buttered casserole.
Melt remaining butter and spread on top.
Sprinkle with paprika.
Bake at 325° for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Party Potatoes. Stir 1/4 cup of the butter into the hot mashed potatoes. Whip cream cheese with sour cream until smooth and fluffy in the blender. Add cream cheese-sour cream mixture, salt and pepper to hot potatoes and mix well. Spoon into buttered casserole. Melt remaining butter and spread on top. Sprinkle with paprika. Bake at 325° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Watergate Salad
ingredients: 1 (8 oz.) can crushed pineapple in heavy syrup (do not drain)
directions: Mix all ingredients.
Toast coconut in oven; sprinkle on top. Put red cherry on top.
recipes.text: Watergate Salad. Mix all ingredients. Toast coconut in oven; sprinkle on top. Put red cherry on top.

recipes.title: Breading
directions: You will need three bowls.
In one bowl, mix eggs, water and salt and pepper.
In a second bowl, put flour.
In third bowl, bread crumbs.
Whatever you are breading, start with dipping into flour, turning to insure all parts covered with flour.
Then dip into egg mixture.
Let drip a little and finally dip into bread crumbs. You should press the bread crumbs down into whatever you are breading so the crumbs will adhere.
recipes.text: Breading. You will need three bowls. In one bowl, mix eggs, water and salt and pepper. In a second bowl, put flour. In third bowl, bread crumbs. Whatever you are breading, start with dipping into flour, turning to insure all parts covered with flour. Then dip into egg mixture. Let drip a little and finally dip into bread crumbs. You should press the bread crumbs down into whatever you are breading so the crumbs will adhere.

recipes.title: No Cook Pickles
directions: Slice cucumbers and onions into large jar.
Mix all the other ingredients together to make a syrup.
Do not boil.
Pour over onions and cucumbers.
Refrigerate for 5 days before tasting. Will keep in refrigerator for 9 months.
recipes.text: No Cook Pickles. Slice cucumbers and onions into large jar. Mix all the other ingredients together to make a syrup. Do not boil. Pour over onions and cucumbers. Refrigerate for 5 days before tasting. Will keep in refrigerator for 9 months.

recipes.title: Broccoli And Chicken Casserole
ingredients: 2 c. cornbread crumbs from Pepperidge Farm
directions: Cook broccoli and set aside.
Cook chicken breasts, remove skin and bones after cooking.
Layer the cooked chicken and cooked broccoli in 9 x 13-inch dish. Mix cream of chicken soup, mayonnaise and lemon juice together, then spread over chicken and broccoli.
Sprinkle grated cheese over mixture.
Top with bread crumbs.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Broccoli And Chicken Casserole. Cook broccoli and set aside. Cook chicken breasts, remove skin and bones after cooking. Layer the cooked chicken and cooked broccoli in 9 x 13-inch dish. Mix cream of chicken soup, mayonnaise and lemon juice together, then spread over chicken and broccoli. Sprinkle grated cheese over mixture. Top with bread crumbs. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Peach Cobbler
directions: Melt butter in a casserole pan (9 x 9-inch).
Combine sugar, flour, milk and fluid; pour over melted butter.
Spoon cut up peaches on top.
Bake at 400° for 30 to 40 minutes, until brown.
recipes.text: Peach Cobbler. Melt butter in a casserole pan (9 x 9-inch). Combine sugar, flour, milk and fluid; pour over melted butter. Spoon cut up peaches on top. Bake at 400° for 30 to 40 minutes, until brown.

recipes.title: Gingerbread
directions: Mix ingredients in order given, sifting soda with the flour before adding it.
Bake in moderate 350° to 375° oven.
recipes.text: Gingerbread. Mix ingredients in order given, sifting soda with the flour before adding it. Bake in moderate 350° to 375° oven.

recipes.title: Cocoa Fudge
directions: Mix dry ingredients.
Add milk.
Heat to boiling.
Boil 8 minutes (don't stir) or until soft ball stage.
Remove from heat. Add butter and vanilla.
Beat until glossy.
Pour into pan.
recipes.text: Cocoa Fudge. Mix dry ingredients. Add milk. Heat to boiling. Boil 8 minutes (don't stir) or until soft ball stage. Remove from heat. Add butter and vanilla. Beat until glossy. Pour into pan.

recipes.title: Chicken Cacciatore
ingredients: 1 can (1 lb. 12 oz.) whole tomatoes, undrained
directions: Wash chicken, pat dry with paper towels.
Heat oil and butter in 6-quart Dutch oven.
Add chicken, a few pieces at a time, and brown well on all sides. Remove as browned.
Return chicken to Dutch oven; add tomato sauce, tomatoes, wine, basil, oregano, garlic, parsley, salt and pepper.
Simmer, covered for 45 to 50 minutes, or until chicken is tender.
Combine flour with 3 tablespoons water; stir into sauce.
Add mushrooms; cook 10 minutes longer or until sauce is thickened.
Makes 6 servings.
recipes.text: Chicken Cacciatore. Wash chicken, pat dry with paper towels. Heat oil and butter in 6-quart Dutch oven. Add chicken, a few pieces at a time, and brown well on all sides. Remove as browned. Return chicken to Dutch oven; add tomato sauce, tomatoes, wine, basil, oregano, garlic, parsley, salt and pepper. Simmer, covered for 45 to 50 minutes, or until chicken is tender. Combine flour with 3 tablespoons water; stir into sauce. Add mushrooms; cook 10 minutes longer or until sauce is thickened. Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Hot Fudge Sundae Cake
directions: Crush the Oreo cookies with fork.
Mix with 1/2 cup melted butter.
Press in a 9 x 13-inch pan (Tupperware). Freeze until firm.
Let ice cream soften.
Spread over cookie mixture and freeze until firm.
Mix 1 stick of butter, Eagle Brand milk and chocolate syrup. Boil for 5 minutes.
Let cool.
Pour over mixture and freeze until hard.
Spread Cool Whip over mixture. Sprinkle with nuts and freeze.
Let thaw about 10 minutes before serving, but is just as good frozen.
recipes.text: Hot Fudge Sundae Cake. Crush the Oreo cookies with fork. Mix with 1/2 cup melted butter. Press in a 9 x 13-inch pan (Tupperware). Freeze until firm. Let ice cream soften. Spread over cookie mixture and freeze until firm. Mix 1 stick of butter, Eagle Brand milk and chocolate syrup. Boil for 5 minutes. Let cool. Pour over mixture and freeze until hard. Spread Cool Whip over mixture. Sprinkle with nuts and freeze. Let thaw about 10 minutes before serving, but is just as good frozen.

recipes.title: Lucky Seven Rolls
directions: Pour milk over sugar, shortening and salt in a mixing bowl. Cool to lukewarm.
Soften yeast in lukewarm water; add egg and mix well.
Add to milk mixture.
Add about half the flour to yeast mixture and beat thoroughly.
Add remaining flour; mix well. Knead on a lightly floured board until smooth and elastic (about 5 minutes).
Place dough in a greased bowl.
Cover and let rise in a warm place until double about 1 hour.
Shape as desired.
Let rise again.
Bake in a 350° oven for 20 minutes.
recipes.text: Lucky Seven Rolls. Pour milk over sugar, shortening and salt in a mixing bowl. Cool to lukewarm. Soften yeast in lukewarm water; add egg and mix well. Add to milk mixture.
