Add about half the flour to yeast mixture and beat thoroughly. Add remaining flour; mix well. Knead on a lightly floured board until smooth and elastic (about 5 minutes). Place dough in a greased bowl. Cover and let rise in a warm place until double about 1 hour. Shape as desired. Let rise again. Bake in a 350° oven for 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Sausage Rolls
directions: When margarine is frozen, grate into flour. Mix with enough water to hold together. Roll out a small piece of dough. Put sausage inside and roll up. Bake at 400° for 10 minutes. Turn temperature down to 375° and bake for 15 minutes. Makes estimated 3 dozen.
recipes.text: Sausage Rolls. When margarine is frozen, grate into flour. Mix with enough water to hold together. Roll out a small piece of dough. Put sausage inside and roll up. Bake at 400° for 10 minutes. Turn temperature down to 375° and bake for 15 minutes. Makes estimated 3 dozen.

recipes.title: Garlic Croutons
ingredients: 1 (8 oz.) loaf French bread, cut into 1/2-inch cubes
directions: Heat oven to 300°.
Spray cookie sheet with Pam.
Spread cubes on cookie sheet.
Spray cubes with Pam.
Sprinkle with garlic powder.
Stir a little to coat.
Bake at 300° for 30 to 45 minutes until dry, crisp and golden brown.
Stir occasionally.
recipes.text: Garlic Croutons. Heat oven to 300°. Spray cookie sheet with Pam. Spread cubes on cookie sheet. Spray cubes with Pam. Sprinkle with garlic powder. Stir a little to coat. Bake at 300° for 30 to 45 minutes until dry, crisp and golden brown. Stir occasionally.

recipes.title: Barbecue Brisket
directions: Sprinkle the brisket with celery salt, onion salt and garlic salt.
Add 2 tablespoons liquid smoke.
Wrap in foil and marinate overnight.
recipes.text: Barbecue Brisket. Sprinkle the brisket with celery salt, onion salt and garlic salt. Add 2 tablespoons liquid smoke. Wrap in foil and marinate overnight.

recipes.title: Cheesy Potatoes
ingredients: 4 oz. can whole green chilies, seeded and chopped
directions: Microwave potatoes on High, 8 to 12 minutes.
Peel and slice. Melt butter; whisk in flour and add milk gradually.
Microwave on High 6 minutes.
Stir every 2 minutes until sauce thickens.
Add cheese, chilies and garlic powder.
Mix sauce with potatoes.
Top with bread crumbs.
Cover and microwave on High 7 minutes.
recipes.text: Cheesy Potatoes. Microwave potatoes on High, 8 to 12 minutes. Peel and slice. Melt butter; whisk in flour and add milk gradually. Microwave on High 6 minutes. Stir every 2 minutes until sauce thickens. Add cheese, chilies and garlic powder. Mix sauce with potatoes. Top with bread crumbs. Cover and microwave on High 7 minutes.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Kiss Cookies
directions: Mix sweetened condensed milk with peanut butter until smooth. Blend in Bisquick and vanilla.
Shape into 1-inch balls and roll in sugar.
recipes.text: Peanut Butter Kiss Cookies. Mix sweetened condensed milk with peanut butter until smooth. Blend in Bisquick and vanilla. Shape into 1-inch balls and roll in sugar.

recipes.title: Holiday Dip
directions: Combine all with mixer.
Chill overnight.
Serve with crackers, toast points and chips.
Makes 1 1/3 cups.
recipes.text: Holiday Dip. Combine all with mixer. Chill overnight. Serve with crackers, toast points and chips. Makes 1 1/3 cups.

recipes.title: Cream Cheese Pound Cake
directions: Have margarine, butter and cream cheese at room temperature. Cream all three together until creamy.
Add sugar and cream again. Add eggs, one at a time, beating after each.
Add flour a little at a time.
Add flavoring; beat again.
Pour into a 10-inch tube pan.
Bake at 300° for 1 hour and 30 minutes or until done.
recipes.text: Cream Cheese Pound Cake. Have margarine, butter and cream cheese at room temperature. Cream all three together until creamy. Add sugar and cream again. Add eggs, one at a time, beating after each. Add flour a little at a time. Add flavoring; beat again. Pour into a 10-inch tube pan. Bake at 300° for 1 hour and 30 minutes or until done.

recipes.title: Meat Balls In Chili Gravy
directions: Mix bread crumbs, milk, meat, onion, salt and pepper.
Form into small balls.
Brown balls in shortening.
Mix chili sauce, water, celery, horseradish and lemon juice.
Pour sauce over meat balls.
Cook covered 20 minutes, stirring and turning balls in sauce.
Beef, veal, lamb or lean pork can be used but beef is best.
recipes.text: Meat Balls In Chili Gravy. Mix bread crumbs, milk, meat, onion, salt and pepper. Form into small balls. Brown balls in shortening. Mix chili sauce, water, celery, horseradish and lemon juice. Pour sauce over meat balls. Cook covered 20 minutes, stirring and turning balls in sauce. Beef, veal, lamb or lean pork can be used but beef is best.

recipes.title: Zucchini And Parmesan Squares
directions: Heat oven to 350°.
Butter a 9 x 13-inch rectangular pan. Shred zucchini and onion.
Combine all ingredients, except eggs and oil.
Beat together eggs and oil and stir into zucchini mixture.
Pour into pan and smooth top.
Bake until edges are brown and center sets, about 25 minutes.
Cool 10 minutes before cutting into 48 squares.
Serve warm or at room temperature.
recipes.text: Zucchini And Parmesan Squares. Heat oven to 350°. Butter a 9 x 13-inch rectangular pan. Shred zucchini and onion. Combine all ingredients, except eggs and oil. Beat together eggs and oil and stir into zucchini mixture. Pour into pan and smooth top. Bake until edges are brown and center sets, about 25 minutes. Cool 10 minutes before cutting into 48 squares. Serve warm or at room temperature.

recipes.title: Fruit Cake
directions: Chop fruit and mix in pecans.
Sift flour, baking powder and salt over fruit and nuts.
Mix well.
Mix sugar and eggs until thick.
Pour over mixture of fruit and pecans; mix well.
Line tube pans with waxed paper and grease.
Bake at 275° for 1 hour and 20 minutes.
Makes 3 cakes.
recipes.text: Fruit Cake. Chop fruit and mix in pecans. Sift flour, baking powder and salt over fruit and nuts. Mix well. Mix sugar and eggs until thick. Pour over mixture of fruit and pecans; mix well. Line tube pans with waxed paper and grease. Bake at 275° for 1 hour and 20 minutes. Makes 3 cakes.

recipes.title: Fresh Apple Pound Cake
ingredients: 3 c. all-purpose flour, spooned into cup
directions: Preheat oven to 325°.
Sift flour, soda and salt onto a platter or waxed paper.
In a large bowl beat oil, sugar, eggs and vanilla at medium speed of electric mixer for 3 or 4 minutes until well blended.
Gradually add flour mixture; beat until smooth.
Fold in pecans and apples.
Pour batter into greased and floured Bundt pan.
Bake in a 325° oven for about 1 hour and 20 minutes, or until cake tests done.
Cool on wire rack 20 minutes. If desired, dribble Brown Sugar Topping over warm cake, however, the cake is marvelous plain.
Serve warm or cold.
recipes.text: Fresh Apple Pound Cake. Preheat oven to 325°. Sift flour, soda and salt onto a platter or waxed paper. In a large bowl beat oil, sugar, eggs and vanilla at medium speed of electric mixer for 3 or 4 minutes until well blended. Gradually add flour mixture; beat until smooth. Fold in pecans and apples. Pour batter into greased and floured Bundt pan. Bake in a 325° oven for about 1 hour and 20 minutes, or until cake tests done. Cool on wire rack 20 minutes. If desired, dribble Brown Sugar Topping over warm cake, however, the cake is marvelous plain. Serve warm or cold.

recipes.title: Apple Crisp
directions: Mix all ingredients and layer into a buttered 9 X 13 dish.
recipes.text: Apple Crisp. Mix all ingredients and layer into a buttered 9 X 13 dish.

recipes.title: Cocktail Meatballs
ingredients: 28 oz. pizza flavored or regular ketchup
directions: Mix together chuck, soup mix, egg, Accent and bread crumbs. Form into bite size meatballs.
Bake on a cookie sheet at 350° for 5 to 10 minutes.
In a large skillet, over medium heat, mix ketchup and apple jelly until blended.
Add meatballs, cover and simmer 25 minutes. Serve in chafing dish.
recipes.text: Cocktail Meatballs. Mix together chuck, soup mix, egg, Accent and bread crumbs. Form into bite size meatballs. Bake on a cookie sheet at 350° for 5 to 10 minutes. In a large skillet, over medium heat, mix ketchup and apple jelly until blended. Add meatballs, cover and simmer 25 minutes. Serve in chafing dish.

recipes.title: Zucchini Pie
ingredients: 3 c. sliced zucchini, cut thin in quarters
directions: Combine all ingredients except for tomato, bread crumbs and butter.
Season to taste with pepper, basil, garlic powder and oregano.
Place in a greased large pie pan.
Top with thinly sliced tomato, bread crumbs and butter.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Zucchini Pie. Combine all ingredients except for tomato, bread crumbs and butter. Season to taste with pepper, basil, garlic powder and oregano. Place in a greased large pie pan. Top with thinly sliced tomato, bread crumbs and butter. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Fabienne'S Orange Delight
ingredients: 1 pkg. Betty Crocker Sunkist orange cake mix
directions: Heat oven to 350°.
Mix all ingredients together and pour into ungreased pan.
Bake 40 to 45 minutes.
Serve with whipped cream.
recipes.text: Fabienne'S Orange Delight. Heat oven to 350°. Mix all ingredients together and pour into ungreased pan. Bake 40 to 45 minutes. Serve with whipped cream.

recipes.title: Sweet Fruit Dip
directions: Combine all ingredients in electric blender container; blend until smooth, stopping to scrape down sides, if necessary.
Chill 1 hour.
Serve with assorted fruits.
Makes 4 cups.
recipes.text: Sweet Fruit Dip. Combine all ingredients in electric blender container; blend until smooth, stopping to scrape down sides, if necessary. Chill 1 hour. Serve with assorted fruits. Makes 4 cups.

recipes.title: Zucchini Appetizers
directions: Mix everything together in a large bowl.
Spread in a greased 11 x 7-inch or 13 x 9-inch pan.
Bake in 350° oven for 25 to 35 minutes.
recipes.text: Zucchini Appetizers. Mix everything together in a large bowl. Spread in a greased 11 x 7-inch or 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake in 350° oven for 25 to 35 minutes.

recipes.title: Red Eye Rice
directions: Preheat oven to 350°.
Combine rice, water, picante sauce, corn, cheese and sour cream in a 2-quart baking dish.
Bake for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Red Eye Rice. Preheat oven to 350°. Combine rice, water, picante sauce, corn, cheese and sour cream in a 2-quart baking dish. Bake for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Potatoes
directions: One cup cheese goes in mix; 1 cup goes on top.
Microwave for 8 minutes.
recipes.text: Potatoes. One cup cheese goes in mix; 1 cup goes on top. Microwave for 8 minutes.

recipes.title: Countryside Chicken Bake
ingredients: 1 c. uncooked rice (long grain and wild)
1 (10 3/4 oz.) can cream of mushroom soup
directions: Place rice in greased 8 x 12-inch casserole.
Cover with combined vegetables and seasoning.
Combine soup and mayonnaise and mix well.
Gradually add water to soup mixture.
Mix well until blended.
Pour half soup mixture over rice and vegetables. Top with chicken.
Pour remaining soup mixture over chicken.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour or until chicken is tender and rice is cooked. Sprinkle with paprika.
recipes.text: Countryside Chicken Bake. Place rice in greased 8 x 12-inch casserole. Cover with combined vegetables and seasoning. Combine soup and mayonnaise and mix well. Gradually add water to soup mixture. Mix well until blended. Pour half soup mixture over rice and vegetables. Top with chicken. Pour remaining soup mixture over chicken. Bake at 350° for 1 hour or until chicken is tender and rice is cooked. Sprinkle with paprika.

recipes.title: Barbecued Sauerkraut
ingredients: 1 large can kraut (1 lb. 11 oz. size)
directions: Brown onion and ground beef in skillet; drain off fat.
Drain 1/2 of the juice off kraut.
Combine onion and beef mixture, kraut, tomato sauce and brown sugar.
Turn into baking dish and bake at 350° for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Barbecued Sauerkraut. Brown onion and ground beef in skillet; drain off fat. Drain 1/2 of the juice off kraut. Combine onion and beef mixture, kraut, tomato sauce and brown sugar. Turn into baking dish and bake at 350° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Mexican Casserole
ingredients: 1 can cream of mushroom soup or your choice cream soup
directions: Saute ground chuck, bell pepper and onion.
Add chili with beans and diced Ro-Tel.
Blend in separate saucepan and heat thoroughly, the nacho cheese soup, cream of mushroom soup (or choice) and evaporated milk.
Layer in 2 layers in large oblong (9 x 13-inch) or larger pan:
tortillas, meat mixture, soup mixture and grated cheese.
Repeat layers.
Heat for about 20 minutes at 350°.
recipes.text: Mexican Casserole. Saute ground chuck, bell pepper and onion. Add chili with beans and diced Ro-Tel. Blend in separate saucepan and heat thoroughly, the nacho cheese soup, cream of mushroom soup (or choice) and evaporated milk. Layer in 2 layers in large oblong (9 x 13-inch) or larger pan: tortillas, meat mixture, soup mixture and grated cheese. Repeat layers. Heat for about 20 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Sea Stix
ingredients: 3 cloves garlic, crushed or 1/8 tsp. garlic powder
directions: Melt butter in microwave; add garlic, water and sea stix. Place all in microwavable dish.
Cover with wax paper and microwave on High for 2 minutes.
Turn stix over and repeat until stix are heated.
recipes.text: Sea Stix. Melt butter in microwave; add garlic, water and sea stix. Place all in microwavable dish. Cover with wax paper and microwave on High for 2 minutes. Turn stix over and repeat until stix are heated.

recipes.title: Pizza
ingredients: 1/2 lb. sausage or 1/2 lb. ground beef
directions: Heat oven to 450°.
Mix pizza dough and spread on pizza pan. Add tomato sauce.
Cook sausage or beef until brown.
Drain meat and spread on pan.
Add topping.
Add cheese.
Bake 15 to 20 minutes, until golden brown.
recipes.text: Pizza. Heat oven to 450°. Mix pizza dough and spread on pizza pan. Add tomato sauce. Cook sausage or beef until brown. Drain meat and spread on pan. Add topping. Add cheese. Bake 15 to 20 minutes, until golden brown.

recipes.title: Best Cornbread You'Ll Ever Eat
ingredients: 3 Tbsp. oil or fry 4 slices bacon and use fat
directions: Put oil (or bacon fat) in skillet to preheat.
Place heavy iron skillet in 400° oven to preheat.
Combine cornmeal and milks. Stir in sugar.
Add egg and mix well.
Gently stir in flour and soda (mix together before adding to wet) until moist.
Stir in crumbled bacon, if desired.
Bake 20 minutes at 400° or until golden brown.
recipes.text: Best Cornbread You'Ll Ever Eat. Put oil (or bacon fat) in skillet to preheat. Place heavy iron skillet in 400° oven to preheat. Combine cornmeal and milks. Stir in sugar. Add egg and mix well. Gently stir in flour and soda (mix together before adding to wet) until moist. Stir in crumbled bacon, if desired. Bake 20 minutes at 400° or until golden brown.

recipes.title: Honey Mustard Dressing
directions: Combine all ingredients.
Shake well.
Add lemon juice to taste.
recipes.text: Honey Mustard Dressing. Combine all ingredients. Shake well. Add lemon juice to taste.

recipes.title: Smoky Salmon Spread
ingredients: 2 to 3 drops natural hickory liquid smoke
directions: Drain and flake salmon in mixing bowl.
Beat cream cheese with lemon with mixer until blended light and fluffy.
Beat in flaked salmon and green onions until thoroughly combined.
Season with liquid smoke to taste; stir.
Chill several hours before serving to allow flavors to blend.
To serve, spread on crackers or French bread rounds.
Makes 20 servings.
Makes about 2 1/2 cups.
recipes.text: Smoky Salmon Spread. Drain and flake salmon in mixing bowl. Beat cream cheese with lemon with mixer until blended light and fluffy. Beat in flaked salmon and green onions until thoroughly combined. Season with liquid smoke to taste; stir. Chill several hours before serving to allow flavors to blend. To serve, spread on crackers or French bread rounds. Makes 20 servings. Makes about 2 1/2 cups.

recipes.title: Acorn Squash Casserole
ingredients: 2 c. cooked acorn squash (will need a 2 lb. squash)
directions: Split squash in half; scoop out seeds and fibers (discard). Place squash in small pan, cut side up; add water to bottom of pan.
Cover with foil; bake 35 to 40 minutes.
Remove squash from its shell; combine all ingredients, mixing with electric mixer. Put in 1 1/2-quart baking dish.
Bake 25 to 30 minutes at 375° or until set.
recipes.text: Acorn Squash Casserole. Split squash in half; scoop out seeds and fibers (discard). Place squash in small pan, cut side up; add water to bottom of pan. Cover with foil; bake 35 to 40 minutes. Remove squash from its shell; combine all ingredients, mixing with electric mixer. Put in 1 1/2-quart baking dish. Bake 25 to 30 minutes at 375° or until set.

recipes.title: Corn Casserole
directions: Mix ingredients together and pour into baking dish and bake for 1 hour at 350°.
recipes.text: Corn Casserole. Mix ingredients together and pour into baking dish and bake for 1 hour at 350°.

recipes.title: Shrimp Batter
directions: Beat egg well. Add sugar and salt. Add oil. Gradually beat in flour. Beat until smooth. Dip shrimp into batter to coat well. Drop shrimp in hot oil. Brown on both sides. DO NOT overcook!!! Makes enough for approximately 2 pounds shrimp.
recipes.text: Shrimp Batter. Beat egg well. Add sugar and salt. Add oil. Gradually beat in flour. Beat until smooth. Dip shrimp into batter to coat well. Drop shrimp in hot oil. Brown on both sides. DO NOT overcook!!! Makes enough for approximately 2 pounds shrimp.

recipes.title: Dill Bread
ingredients: 1 c. creamed cottage cheese, slightly heated
directions: Soften yeast in warm water for 5 minutes.
Combine cheese, butter, sugar, salt and soda.
Add onions, dill seed, egg and softened yeast.
Beat well to blend thoroughly.
Add flour; mix well.
Cover and let rise until double (about 1 hour).
Punch down and put in a greased loaf pan.
Let rise 30 to 40 minutes.
Bake at 350° for 35 to 45 minutes or until crust is golden brown. Brush with butter.
recipes.text: Dill Bread. Soften yeast in warm water for 5 minutes. Combine cheese, butter, sugar, salt and soda. Add onions, dill seed, egg and softened yeast. Beat well to blend thoroughly. Add flour; mix well. Cover and let rise until double (about 1 hour). Punch down and put in a greased loaf pan. Let rise 30 to 40 minutes. Bake at 350° for 35 to 45 minutes or until crust is golden brown. Brush with butter.

recipes.title: Salsa
directions: *For mild salsa use 1 cup banana peppers and 1 cup hot peppers.
recipes.text: Salsa. *For mild salsa use 1 cup banana peppers and 1 cup hot peppers.

recipes.title: Deviled Eggs
directions: Halve the eggs lengthwise.
Force the yolks through a sieve into a bowl and stir in the mustard, the mayonnaise, the vinegar, the Tabasco, the parsley and the capers.
Stir in enough of the water to reach the desired consistency.
Add salt and pepper to taste.
recipes.text: Deviled Eggs. Halve the eggs lengthwise. Force the yolks through a sieve into a bowl and stir in the mustard, the mayonnaise, the vinegar, the Tabasco, the parsley and the capers. Stir in enough of the water to reach the desired consistency. Add salt and pepper to taste.

recipes.title: Cheese And Herb Stuffed Mushroom Caps
ingredients: 1 (1 oz.) pkg. Hidden Valley Ranch dressing
2 lb. mushrooms, washed and stems removed
1 c. herb seasoned stuffing mix, crushed
directions: Mix cream cheese, dressing mix, mayonnaise, onion, parsley and Parmesan cheese. Fill mushrooms with mixture and dip in crushed stuffing.
Place on buttered baking dish.
Drizzle with melted butter.
Bake at 325° until heated through, about 10 to 15 minutes.
recipes.text: Cheese And Herb Stuffed Mushroom Caps. Mix cream cheese, dressing mix, mayonnaise, onion, parsley and Parmesan cheese. Fill mushrooms with mixture and dip in crushed stuffing. Place on buttered baking dish. Drizzle with melted butter. Bake at 325° until heated through, about 10 to 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Chocolate Cheesecake
ingredients: 1 (8 oz.) pkg. semi-sweet chocolate squares, melted
directions: In small bowl with mixer at low speed, beat butter, 1 1/4 cups flour, 1/4 cup sugar and 1 egg yolk until well mixed.
Cover; refrigerate 1 hour.
recipes.text: Chocolate Cheesecake. In small bowl with mixer at low speed, beat butter, 1 1/4 cups flour, 1/4 cup sugar and 1 egg yolk until well mixed. Cover; refrigerate 1 hour.

recipes.title: 7 Layer Cake
directions: Melt butter in a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Add cracker crumbs; press down.
Put coconut over top of this, then start layering all the rest, using Eagle Brand last.
Pour it evenly over top.
Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes.
recipes.text: 7 Layer Cake. Melt butter in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Add cracker crumbs; press down. Put coconut over top of this, then start layering all the rest, using Eagle Brand last. Pour it evenly over top. Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Corn Bread
directions: Combine corn meal, sugar and salt.
Mix well and add boiling water and margarine.
Cook until thick in a pan.
Remove the mixture from heat.
Add milk, eggs and baking powder and mix well. Bake in a 13 x 9-inch pan at 350° for 1 hour.
Remove from heat and set to cool 20 minutes before cutting.
Makes 24 servings.
recipes.text: Corn Bread. Combine corn meal, sugar and salt. Mix well and add boiling water and margarine. Cook until thick in a pan. Remove the mixture from heat. Add milk, eggs and baking powder and mix well. Bake in a 13 x 9-inch pan at 350° for 1 hour. Remove from heat and set to cool 20 minutes before cutting. Makes 24 servings.

recipes.title: Apple Muffins
directions: Sift together flour, baking powder, salt and sugar.
Cut in shortening.
Combine egg and milk.
Add to flour mixture.
Mix until flour is well moistened.
Do not overmix.
Fold in raisins and apples.
Fill greased muffin tins 2/3 full.
Combine brown sugar and cinnamon; sprinkle over batter.
Bake for 20 minutes in 375° oven.
Yields 12 muffins.
Serve hot.
recipes.text: Apple Muffins. Sift together flour, baking powder, salt and sugar. Cut in shortening. Combine egg and milk. Add to flour mixture. Mix until flour is well moistened. Do not overmix. Fold in raisins and apples. Fill greased muffin tins 2/3 full. Combine brown sugar and cinnamon; sprinkle over batter. Bake for 20 minutes in 375° oven. Yields 12 muffins. Serve hot.

recipes.title: Chicken Noodle Casserole
directions: Boil chicken; pick off bone.
Boil noodles in chicken broth; drain.
Mix both soups and Ro-Tel together.
Mix noodles, chicken and soup together.
Put in casserole dish.
Sprinkle cheese on top.
Bake until cheese melts.
recipes.text: Chicken Noodle Casserole. Boil chicken; pick off bone. Boil noodles in chicken broth; drain. Mix both soups and Ro-Tel together. Mix noodles, chicken and soup together. Put in casserole dish. Sprinkle cheese on top. Bake until cheese melts.

recipes.title: Cream Of Potato Soup
ingredients: 1 Tbsp. oil (bacon grease may also be used)
2 Tbsp. cornstarch, mixed in 1/4 c. water
directions: Fry bacon until crisp.
Crumble; set aside.
Place the potatoes in a large stockpot.
Add just enough water to cover. Add in the onion, instant broth, thyme, oil, bacon and ham.
Bring to a boil; reduce heat and simmer until potatoes are tender. Drain off excess water.
Return to heat; stir in the remaining ingredients.
Blend until smooth and heat through.
recipes.text: Cream Of Potato Soup. Fry bacon until crisp. Crumble; set aside. Place the potatoes in a large stockpot. Add just enough water to cover. Add in the onion, instant broth, thyme, oil, bacon and ham. Bring to a boil; reduce heat and simmer until potatoes are tender. Drain off excess water. Return to heat; stir in the remaining ingredients. Blend until smooth and heat through.

recipes.title: Taco Dip
directions: Layer ingredients in Pyrex dish starting with cream cheese, refried beans, salsa and then shredded cheese.
Heat in microwave about 2 to 3 minutes on High; serve with nacho chips.
Instead of jalapeno peppers, you can use sliced black olives.
recipes.text: Taco Dip. Layer ingredients in Pyrex dish starting with cream cheese, refried beans, salsa and then shredded cheese. Heat in microwave about 2 to 3 minutes on High; serve with nacho chips. Instead of jalapeno peppers, you can use sliced black olives.

recipes.title: Honey Burgers
directions: Mix all ingredients (except oil) in bowl.
Shape into patties 1/2-inch thick.
Heat oil in skillet over medium heat.
Place patties in oil 6 to 8 minutes, turn as needed, until brown.
Serve on buns, with rice or noodles.
Serves 4 to 6 people.
recipes.text: Honey Burgers. Mix all ingredients (except oil) in bowl. Shape into patties 1/2-inch thick. Heat oil in skillet over medium heat. Place patties in oil 6 to 8 minutes, turn as needed, until brown. Serve on buns, with rice or noodles. Serves 4 to 6 people.

recipes.title: Chicken Spread
directions: Blend together.
Add mayonnaise as needed to spread.
recipes.text: Chicken Spread. Blend together. Add mayonnaise as needed to spread.

recipes.title: Honey Ham
directions: Preheat oven to 325°.
Place ham on rack in an open roasting pan and bake 15 to 18 minutes per pound or until meat thermometer reaches 130°.
Remove ham from oven and increase temperature to 425°.
recipes.text: Honey Ham. Preheat oven to 325°. Place ham on rack in an open roasting pan and bake 15 to 18 minutes per pound or until meat thermometer reaches 130°. Remove ham from oven and increase temperature to 425°.

recipes.title: Green Beans Pennsylvania Dutch
directions: Fry bacon in skillet until crispy.
Remove bacon and crumble. Drain off all but 1 tablespoon drippings.
Add onions and brown lightly.
Stir in cornstarch, salt and dry mustard.
Cook green beans, reserving 1/2 cup liquid.
Stir reserved liquid in skillet. Cook, stirring until mixture boils.
Blend in brown sugar and vinegar.
Add green beans and heat thoroughly.
Turn into serving dish and garnish with egg and crumbled bacon.
Serves 4.
recipes.text: Green Beans Pennsylvania Dutch. Fry bacon in skillet until crispy. Remove bacon and crumble. Drain off all but 1 tablespoon drippings. Add onions and brown lightly. Stir in cornstarch, salt and dry mustard. Cook green beans, reserving 1/2 cup liquid. Stir reserved liquid in skillet. Cook, stirring until mixture boils. Blend in brown sugar and vinegar. Add green beans and heat thoroughly. Turn into serving dish and garnish with egg and crumbled bacon. Serves 4.

recipes.title: Calypso Pie
directions: Blend cookies and 1/4 cup butter.
Spread evenly in 10-inch pie plate.
Bake 5 minutes at 350°.
Cool.
recipes.text: Calypso Pie. Blend cookies and 1/4 cup butter. Spread evenly in 10-inch pie plate. Bake 5 minutes at 350°. Cool.

recipes.title: Mexican Corn Bread
directions: Heat iron skillet.
Add 1/4 cup of oil.
Mix all ingredients except cheese.
Pour half of mixture in heated skillet; cover with grated cheese.
Pour rest of mixture on top and bake at 475° for 40 minutes or
until well browned.
This is a big recipe so it's better to use two 8 or 10-inch skillets.
recipes.text: Mexican Corn Bread. Heat iron skillet. Add 1/4 cup of oil. Mix all ingredients except cheese. Pour half of mixture in heated skillet; cover with grated cheese. Pour rest of mixture on top and bake at 475° for 40 minutes or until well browned. This is a big recipe so it's better to use two 8 or 10-inch skillets.

recipes.title: Tropical Fruit Pie
directions: Bake
pie shell.
Line bottom with toasted pecans.
Slice bananas on top of this.
Boil together pineapple, sugar and cornstarch until thickens.
Cool.
Pour on top of bananas.
Top with Dream Whip.
recipes.text: Tropical Fruit Pie. Bake pie shell. Line bottom with toasted pecans. Slice bananas on top of this. Boil together pineapple, sugar and cornstarch until thickens. Cool. Pour on top of bananas. Top with Dream Whip.

recipes.title: Sausage Casserole
ingredients: 1 lb. hot sausage, cooked and drained
5 oz. box noodles, cooked and drained
directions: Mix
sausage,
noodles,
milk, pepper, soup and cheese. Pour in	casserole
dish.
Top with buttered crumbs.
Bake for 30 minutes in a 350° oven.
recipes.text: Sausage Casserole. Mix sausage, noodles, milk, pepper, soup and cheese. Pour in	casserole dish. Top with buttered crumbs. Bake for 30 minutes in a 350° oven.

recipes.title: Oatmeal Carmelitas
directions: Melt caramel topping, combined with 1/4 cup flour.
Combine remaining ingredients except chocolate chips and pecans in mixing bowl.
Press half of crumbs into bottom of greased 13 x 9 pan. Bake 10 minutes at 350°.
Remove from oven.
Sprinkle chocolate chips and pecans and spread caramel topping on cooked crumbs. Sprinkle remaining crumbs on top.
Bake 15 to 20 minutes longer or until golden brown.
Chill 1 to 2 hours.
recipes.text: Oatmeal Carmelitas. Melt caramel topping, combined with 1/4 cup flour. Combine remaining ingredients except chocolate chips and pecans in mixing bowl. Press half of crumbs into bottom of greased 13 x 9 pan. Bake 10 minutes at 350°. Remove from oven. Sprinkle chocolate chips and pecans and spread caramel topping on cooked crumbs. Sprinkle remaining crumbs on top. Bake 15 to 20 minutes longer or until golden brown. Chill 1 to 2 hours.

recipes.title: Pepper Relish
directions: Wash, dry and seed green and red peppers.
Chop peppers and cabbage finely, and mix together.
Add mustard seed, salt, sugar, and enough cider vinegar to cover.
recipes.text: Pepper Relish. Wash, dry and seed green and red peppers. Chop peppers and cabbage finely, and mix together. Add mustard seed, salt, sugar, and enough cider vinegar to cover.

recipes.title: Cowboy Roast
ingredients: 4 to 6 c. water (enough to cover roast)
directions: Brown all sides of roast.
Cover with water and add pinto beans (enough to fill in around roast).
Add green chilies.
Season to taste with dried mustard, seasoned salt, pepper and chili peppers. Cover and simmer 6 to 8 hours or all day.
recipes.text: Cowboy Roast. Brown all sides of roast. Cover with water and add pinto beans (enough to fill in around roast). Add green chilies. Season to taste with dried mustard, seasoned salt, pepper and chili peppers. Cover and simmer 6 to 8 hours or all day.

recipes.title: Ham-Broccoli Roll-Ups
ingredients: 2 c. broccoli spears, cooked and drained
directions: Place 1 broccoli spear on 1 slice ham and roll up.
Boil rest of ham slices around broccoli spears.
Place ham roll-ups in baking dish.
Pour cheese sauce over roll-ups.
Cover and bake in 350° oven for 10 minutes or until hot.
recipes.text: Ham-Broccoli Roll-Ups. Place 1 broccoli spear on 1 slice ham and roll up. Boil rest of ham slices around broccoli spears. Place ham roll-ups in baking dish. Pour cheese sauce over roll-ups. Cover and bake in 350° oven for 10 minutes or until hot.

recipes.title: Stained Glass Cookies
directions: Melt oleo and chocolate chips.
Let cool.
Add nuts, coconut and marshmallows.
Stir well.
Put on strip of wax paper and roll into a log shape.
Chill.
Slice when ready to serve.
recipes.text: Stained Glass Cookies. Melt oleo and chocolate chips. Let cool. Add nuts, coconut and marshmallows. Stir well. Put on strip of wax paper and roll into a log shape. Chill. Slice when ready to serve.

recipes.title: Mini Cheese Cakes
directions: Preheat oven to 325°.
Line cup cake pan with liners.
Place vanilla wafer in each.
Mix cream cheese, vanilla and sugar on medium speed until well blended.
Add eggs, mix well.
Pour over wafers, filling 3/4 full.
Bake 30 minutes.
Remove from pan. Cool on wire rack, chill thoroughly.
Add topping.
Enjoy!
recipes.text: Mini Cheese Cakes. Preheat oven to 325°. Line cup cake pan with liners. Place vanilla wafer in each. Mix cream cheese, vanilla and sugar on medium speed until well blended. Add eggs, mix well. Pour over wafers, filling 3/4 full. Bake 30 minutes. Remove from pan. Cool on wire rack, chill thoroughly. Add topping. Enjoy!

recipes.title: Vegetable Health Salad
directions: Combine cabbage, celery, carrots, green pepper, pecans and onion in large bowl; mix well.
Dissolve gelatin in boiling water in bowl.
Add lemon juice, mayonnaise and salt; mix well.
Pour over vegetables; mix well.
Pour into serving dish.
Chill until set.
Yield:
12 servings.
recipes.text: Vegetable Health Salad. Combine cabbage, celery, carrots, green pepper, pecans and onion in large bowl; mix well. Dissolve gelatin in boiling water in bowl. Add lemon juice, mayonnaise and salt; mix well. Pour over vegetables; mix well. Pour into serving dish. Chill until set. Yield: 12 servings.

recipes.title: Sour Cream Potatoes
directions: Mash potatoes (do not use any milk).
Add all other ingredients.
Beat thoroughly.
Grease a 9 x 13-inch pan and add mixture.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour, until slightly dry or brown looking on top.
It will probably bubble on sides.
recipes.text: Sour Cream Potatoes. Mash potatoes (do not use any milk). Add all other ingredients. Beat thoroughly. Grease a 9 x 13-inch pan and add mixture. Bake at 350° for 1 hour, until slightly dry or brown looking on top. It will probably bubble on sides.

recipes.title: Mexican Rice
ingredients: frozen corn, thawed or 1 small can whole kernel corn
directions: In a large pan saute rice and onion for a few minutes, stirring constantly.
Add tomato sauce, chicken broth and spices.
Heat to boiling, then reduce heat to simmer.
Cover and simmer for 25 minutes or until rice is tender and fluffy.
Stir in corn and green onions and heat.
Makes 4 or 5 servings.
recipes.text: Mexican Rice. In a large pan saute rice and onion for a few minutes, stirring constantly. Add tomato sauce, chicken broth and spices. Heat to boiling, then reduce heat to simmer. Cover and simmer for 25 minutes or until rice is tender and fluffy. Stir in corn and green onions and heat. Makes 4 or 5 servings.

recipes.title: Almond Nut Balls
ingredients: 1 c. Fleischmann's regular or sweet unsalted margarine, softened
directions: Cream the margarine and confectioners sugar until light and fluffy.
Mix in almonds, vanilla, lemon and almond extracts until well blended.
Stir in flour until well mixed. Shape mixture into 1-inch balls and place on ungreased baking sheets.
Bake at 325° until very lightly browned, about 18 minutes. Remove from sheets and cool on wire racks.
Makes 4 dozen.
recipes.text: Almond Nut Balls. Cream the margarine and confectioners sugar until light and fluffy. Mix in almonds, vanilla, lemon and almond extracts until well blended. Stir in flour until well mixed. Shape mixture into 1-inch balls and place on ungreased baking sheets. Bake at 325° until very lightly browned, about 18 minutes. Remove from sheets and cool on wire racks. Makes 4 dozen.

recipes.title: Tuna Noodle Casserole
directions: Mix and bake at 350° for 35 minutes.
recipes.text: Tuna Noodle Casserole. Mix and bake at 350° for 35 minutes.

recipes.title: Berry Cobbler
directions: Combine first 8 ingredients until well blended.
Spread in greased 9 x 13 inch cake pan.
Bring berries, water and 3/4 c. sugar to a boil in saucepan.
recipes.text: Berry Cobbler. Combine first 8 ingredients until well blended. Spread in greased 9 x 13 inch cake pan. Bring berries, water and 3/4 c. sugar to a boil in saucepan.

recipes.title: Chicken Rice Casserole
ingredients: 1 pkg. Uncle Ben's brown and wild rice (instant or long cooking)
3 c. cooked chicken, deboned and cubed
2 (16 oz.) cans French-style green beans, drained
directions: Cook rice according to package directions.
(I boil mine in chicken broth instead of adding margarine.)
Mix everything together.
Reserve some cheese for top.
Bake in 350° oven for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Chicken Rice Casserole. Cook rice according to package directions. (I boil mine in chicken broth instead of adding margarine.) Mix everything together. Reserve some cheese for top. Bake in 350° oven for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Pecan Pie Muffins
directions: Preheat oven to 350°.
Mix all ingredients in a bowl with a wooden spoon.
Pour into a greased mini-muffin pan.
Fill each cup 2/3 full.
Bake 12 to 15 minutes.
Garnish each muffin with a pecan half.
Makes 2 1/2 to 3 dozen.
recipes.text: Pecan Pie Muffins. Preheat oven to 350°. Mix all ingredients in a bowl with a wooden spoon. Pour into a greased mini-muffin pan. Fill each cup 2/3 full. Bake 12 to 15 minutes. Garnish each muffin with a pecan half. Makes 2 1/2 to 3 dozen.

recipes.title: Seven Layer Salad
ingredients: 1 pkg. Hidden Valley Ranch original dressing, prepared as directed on pkg.
directions: Start layering with lettuce, following with remaining ingredients in the order given.
Top with the Hidden Valley dressing.
May be fixed the night before and put in icebox.
recipes.text: Seven Layer Salad. Start layering with lettuce, following with remaining ingredients in the order given. Top with the Hidden Valley dressing. May be fixed the night before and put in icebox.

recipes.title: Three Layer Butter Cake
directions: Butter should be softened at room temperature.
Sift plain flour before measuring.
Cream butter well.
Add sugar; cream thoroughly.
Add eggs, one at a time.
Beat well after each addition.
Slowly add flour and baking powder.
Add milk and vanilla extract.
Increase speed on mixer and beat for several minutes.
Pour into well-greased layer pans.
Bake at 325°.
Frost with your favorite frosting or jelly.
recipes.text: Three Layer Butter Cake. Butter should be softened at room temperature. Sift plain flour before measuring. Cream butter well. Add sugar; cream thoroughly. Add eggs, one at a time. Beat well after each addition. Slowly add flour and baking powder. Add milk and vanilla extract. Increase speed on mixer and beat for several minutes. Pour into well-greased layer pans. Bake at 325°. Frost with your favorite frosting or jelly.

recipes.title: Hot And Spicy Mexican Dip
ingredients: 1 jar picante sauce (hot, chunky or salsa)
directions: Spread refried bean mixture over large plate.
Using approximately 1/3 jar picante sauce mixed in with beans, taste until you get the hot and spicy flavor desired.
Spread over top jalapenos, tomatoes, onions and cheese.
Decorate with spoonfuls of sour cream and enjoy with choice of tortilla chips.
recipes.text: Hot And Spicy Mexican Dip. Spread refried bean mixture over large plate. Using approximately 1/3 jar picante sauce mixed in with beans, taste until you get the hot and spicy flavor desired. Spread over top jalapenos, tomatoes, onions and cheese. Decorate with spoonfuls of sour cream and enjoy with choice of tortilla chips.

recipes.title: Apple Valley Cake(Sauce Makes The Difference)
directions: Beat together oil and sugar; beat 3 minutes, then add flour (2 cups) and soda.
Stir in eggs, vanilla and salt.
Stir in apples and nuts.
Pour batter into 9 x 13-inch greased and floured pan. Bake for 1 hour at 350°.
recipes.text: Apple Valley Cake(Sauce Makes The Difference). Beat together oil and sugar; beat 3 minutes, then add flour (2 cups) and soda. Stir in eggs, vanilla and salt. Stir in apples and nuts. Pour batter into 9 x 13-inch greased and floured pan. Bake for 1 hour at 350°.

recipes.title: Apple Cake
directions: Combine shortening, eggs and vanilla.
Pare apples and dice. Set aside with sugar over them in a bowl.
Mix flour, baking soda and cinnamon together.
Add nuts if desired.
Add apple mixture. Spread in 9 x 13-inch pan.
Bake at 350° for 45 to 50 minutes. Serve with ice cream or whipped cream.
Yum!
Yum!
Fattening!
recipes.text: Apple Cake. Combine shortening, eggs and vanilla. Pare apples and dice. Set aside with sugar over them in a bowl. Mix flour, baking soda and cinnamon together. Add nuts if desired. Add apple mixture. Spread in 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350° for 45 to 50 minutes. Serve with ice cream or whipped cream. Yum! Yum! Fattening!

recipes.title: Hot Tamales
directions: Mix all ingredients well.
Roll tamales about 1/2-inch thick and 4 to 6-inches long.
Wrap individually in foil, making sure it wraps around 3 times. Twist ends.
Place in boiling water. Cook for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Hot Tamales. Mix all ingredients well. Roll tamales about 1/2-inch thick and 4 to 6-inches long. Wrap individually in foil, making sure it wraps around 3 times. Twist ends. Place in boiling water. Cook for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Fruit Cake Cookies
directions: Mix all ingredients and drop by teaspoonful on greased cookie sheet.
Bake at 350° for 8 to 10 minutes.
recipes.text: Fruit Cake Cookies. Mix all ingredients and drop by teaspoonful on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350° for 8 to 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Fancy Sweet Potatoes
ingredients: 3 c. sweet potatoes, baked ahead and mashed well
directions: Combine sweet potatoes, 1 cup sugar, milk, butter, eggs and vanilla.
Blend well by hand or mixer.
Pour into baking dish.
recipes.text: Fancy Sweet Potatoes. Combine sweet potatoes, 1 cup sugar, milk, butter, eggs and vanilla. Blend well by hand or mixer. Pour into baking dish.

recipes.title: One Pot Pork Chop Supper
ingredients: 6 to 8 small potatoes or 3 large, quartered potatoes
directions: In skillet, brown chops and pour off fat.
Add rest of ingredients and simmer for 45 minutes or until tender.
recipes.text: One Pot Pork Chop Supper. In skillet, brown chops and pour off fat. Add rest of ingredients and simmer for 45 minutes or until tender.

recipes.title: Carrot Cake
directions: Sift dry ingredients.
Add oil, eggs and vanilla.
Fold in remaining ingredients.
Pour into greased and floured 13 x 9 x 2 5/8-inch pan.
Bake in a preheated 350° oven for 45 minutes.
Cool 3 hours.
recipes.text: Carrot Cake. Sift dry ingredients. Add oil, eggs and vanilla. Fold in remaining ingredients. Pour into greased and floured 13 x 9 x 2 5/8-inch pan. Bake in a preheated 350° oven for 45 minutes. Cool 3 hours.

recipes.title: Jack'S Sweet Potato Pie
directions: Mash and beat cooked potatoes until smooth and fluffy.
Add margarine and sugar; then beat.
Add eggs, flavor and spices.
If mixture is too dry, add sweet milk.
Bake in an uncooked pie crust at 325° for 45 minutes or until slightly brown.
recipes.text: Jack'S Sweet Potato Pie. Mash and beat cooked potatoes until smooth and fluffy. Add margarine and sugar; then beat. Add eggs, flavor and spices. If mixture is too dry, add sweet milk. Bake in an uncooked pie crust at 325° for 45 minutes or until slightly brown.

recipes.title: Pumpkin - Pecan Bread
directions: Cream shortening and sugar in bowl. Beat in eggs. Add pumpkin and 2/3 cup water, mixing well. Sift in dry ingredients, blending well. Stir in raisins and pecans. Pour into 2 greased and floured loaf pans. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Pumpkin - Pecan Bread. Cream shortening and sugar in bowl. Beat in eggs. Add pumpkin and 2/3 cup water, mixing well. Sift in dry ingredients, blending well. Stir in raisins and pecans. Pour into 2 greased and floured loaf pans. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Chicken Rice Italian
directions: Preheat oven to 375°.
Remove excess fat from chicken.
Season with salt and oregano.
Remove and reserve 1/4 cup tomato sauce. Combine remaining sauce, rice, zucchini, water and salt in a 12 x 8 x 2-inch baking dish.
Stir well.
Arrange chicken over rice mixture.
Cover tightly with foil and bake 1 hour.
Spoon reserved sauce over chicken.
Sprinkle with cheese.
Return to oven for 2 to 3 minutes to melt cheese.
recipes.text: Chicken Rice Italian. Preheat oven to 375°. Remove excess fat from chicken. Season with salt and oregano. Remove and reserve 1/4 cup tomato sauce. Combine remaining sauce, rice, zucchini, water and salt in a 12 x 8 x 2-inch baking dish. Stir well. Arrange chicken over rice mixture. Cover tightly with foil and bake 1 hour. Spoon reserved sauce over chicken. Sprinkle with cheese. Return to oven for 2 to 3 minutes to melt cheese.

recipes.title: Fudgsicles
ingredients: 1 (3 oz.) box chocolate pudding and pie filling
directions: Cook pudding as directed on box except increase the milk to 3 cups.
Cool. Freeze in popsicle molds or small waxed paper cups. Insert sticks into paper cup molds when partially frozen. To serve, peel off paper cup.
recipes.text: Fudgsicles. Cook pudding as directed on box except increase the milk to 3 cups. Cool. Freeze in popsicle molds or small waxed paper cups. Insert sticks into paper cup molds when partially frozen. To serve, peel off paper cup.

recipes.title: Salad
directions: Chop all ingredients and toss, then pour on your favorite dressing.
recipes.text: Salad. Chop all ingredients and toss, then pour on your favorite dressing.

recipes.title: Fudge
directions: Mix sugar and chocolate together.
Add milk.
Cook for about 10 minutes.
Add vanilla, marshmallows and nuts.
Pour in buttered dish.
recipes.text: Fudge. Mix sugar and chocolate together. Add milk. Cook for about 10 minutes. Add vanilla, marshmallows and nuts. Pour in buttered dish.

recipes.title: Hot Cider Wassail
directions: Simmer cider, lemons, cinnamon, cloves and brown sugar together for 15 minutes.
Add ginger ale and orange soda.
Serve hot.
Makes 30 servings.
(I put the cloves in the peel of the lemons.)
recipes.text: Hot Cider Wassail. Simmer cider, lemons, cinnamon, cloves and brown sugar together for 15 minutes. Add ginger ale and orange soda. Serve hot. Makes 30 servings. (I put the cloves in the peel of the lemons.)

recipes.title: Fay'S Banana Pudding
ingredients: 3 small boxes instant vanilla pudding mix
directions: Mix milk and pudding mix.
Stir in sour cream and Cool Whip. In bottom of dish, put a layer of wafers and bananas.
On top of that put 1/2 of the pudding mix.
Repeat with wafers, bananas and pudding mix.
Refrigerate.
That's all!
recipes.text: Fay'S Banana Pudding. Mix milk and pudding mix. Stir in sour cream and Cool Whip. In bottom of dish, put a layer of wafers and bananas. On top of that put 1/2 of the pudding mix. Repeat with wafers, bananas and pudding mix. Refrigerate. That's all!

recipes.title: Walnut Hermits
directions: Cream together shortening, brown sugar and eggs.
Add the dry ingredients and milk to creamed mixture.
Add walnuts, raisins and dates.
Drop on greased cookie sheet.
Bake at 375° for 10 to 12 minutes.
recipes.text: Walnut Hermits. Cream together shortening, brown sugar and eggs. Add the dry ingredients and milk to creamed mixture. Add walnuts, raisins and dates. Drop on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 375° for 10 to 12 minutes.

recipes.title: Mexican Chocolate
directions: Heat chocolate, sugar, coffee, cinnamon, nutmeg, salt and water in 1 1/2-quart saucepan over low heat, stirring constantly, until chocolate is melted and mixture is smooth.
Heat to boiling; reduce heat.
Simmer, uncovered, stirring constantly (4 minutes). Stir in milk and heat through.
Just before serving, beat with hand beater until frothy.
Top with whipped cream.
recipes.text: Mexican Chocolate. Heat chocolate, sugar, coffee, cinnamon, nutmeg, salt and water in 1 1/2-quart saucepan over low heat, stirring constantly, until chocolate is melted and mixture is smooth. Heat to boiling; reduce heat. Simmer, uncovered, stirring constantly (4 minutes). Stir in milk and heat through. Just before serving, beat with hand beater until frothy. Top with whipped cream.

recipes.title: Fudge Pudding Cake
directions: Combine flour, 1/2 cup sugar, 2 tablespoons cocoa, baking powder and salt.
Add milk, oil and vanilla.
Stir until smooth. Pour into greased 8 x 8-inch pan.
Combine 3/4 cup sugar, 1/4 cup cocoa and boiling water.
Pour over the batter.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
Best cooked up last minute and served warm.
Yum!
recipes.text: Fudge Pudding Cake. Combine flour, 1/2 cup sugar, 2 tablespoons cocoa, baking powder and salt. Add milk, oil and vanilla. Stir until smooth. Pour into greased 8 x 8-inch pan. Combine 3/4 cup sugar, 1/4 cup cocoa and boiling water. Pour over the batter. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes. Best cooked up last minute and served warm. Yum!

recipes.title: Summer Melon Chicken Salad
directions: Toss all ingredients with mayonnaise except lettuce and melon slices.
Place lettuce leaves on plate.
Place melon slices on lettuce.
Fill circle of melon with chicken melon salad.
recipes.text: Summer Melon Chicken Salad. Toss all ingredients with mayonnaise except lettuce and melon slices. Place lettuce leaves on plate. Place melon slices on lettuce. Fill circle of melon with chicken melon salad.

recipes.title: Mango Bread
directions: Sift together dry ingredients.
Gradually add the remaining ingredients.
Mix well.
Pour into 2 loaf pans or an 8 x 13-inch pan.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.
(Do toothpick test.
If pick comes out clean, it's done.)
recipes.text: Mango Bread. Sift together dry ingredients. Gradually add the remaining ingredients. Mix well. Pour into 2 loaf pans or an 8 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes. (Do toothpick test. If pick comes out clean, it's done.)

recipes.title: Crab Appetizer
directions: Mix cream cheese with lemon juice, onion and seasonings (this can be prepared a day ahead).
Spread on plate or tray; top with jar of chili sauce.
At last minute, top with crabmeat.
Garnish tray with parsley and serve with crackers of your choice.
recipes.text: Crab Appetizer. Mix cream cheese with lemon juice, onion and seasonings (this can be prepared a day ahead). Spread on plate or tray; top with jar of chili sauce. At last minute, top with crabmeat. Garnish tray with parsley and serve with crackers of your choice.

recipes.title: Apple Bread
directions: Mix sugar, oil, vanilla, flour, cinnamon and nutmeg.
Add eggs, sour cream, soda and salt.
Mix well.
Then add apples and pecans. Preheat oven to 350°.
Grease and flour 2 large juice cans.
Pour equal amount of batter in each can.
Bake 1 1/2 to 2 hours.
recipes.text: Apple Bread. Mix sugar, oil, vanilla, flour, cinnamon and nutmeg. Add eggs, sour cream, soda and salt. Mix well. Then add apples and pecans. Preheat oven to 350°. Grease and flour 2 large juice cans. Pour equal amount of batter in each can. Bake 1 1/2 to 2 hours.

recipes.title: Foil Meal
directions: *Can be replaced with steak, fish, sausage, etc.
recipes.text: Foil Meal. *Can be replaced with steak, fish, sausage, etc.

recipes.title: Chess Pie
directions: Cream butter and sugar.
Beat in flour and cornmeal.
Add remaining ingredients and beat well.
Pour into unbaked shell. Bake at 350° for 55 to 60 minutes.
recipes.text: Chess Pie. Cream butter and sugar. Beat in flour and cornmeal. Add remaining ingredients and beat well. Pour into unbaked shell. Bake at 350° for 55 to 60 minutes.

recipes.title: Icebox Vegetable Salad
ingredients: 1 can (16 oz.) cut green beans, drained
1 can (16 oz.) whole kernel corn or Shoepeg corn, drained
directions: Combine all vegetables in a large glass bowl; set aside.
In a saucepan, combine sugar, vinegar, oil, salt and pepper; bring to a boil.
Cool slightly and pour over vegetables.
Cover and refrigerate overnight.
Yields 6 to 8 servings.
recipes.text: Icebox Vegetable Salad. Combine all vegetables in a large glass bowl; set aside. In a saucepan, combine sugar, vinegar, oil, salt and pepper; bring to a boil. Cool slightly and pour over vegetables. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Yields 6 to 8 servings.

recipes.title: Corn Casserole
ingredients: 1 large can whole kernel corn, drained
directions: Saute onion in margarine.
Add drained whole kernel corn, creamed corn, bell pepper, pimentos, rice, sugar and egg.
Season to taste.
Pour into greased, shallow pan and cover with grated cheese.
Bake until bubbly at 350°.
Serves 8 to 10.
recipes.text: Corn Casserole. Saute onion in margarine. Add drained whole kernel corn, creamed corn, bell pepper, pimentos, rice, sugar and egg. Season to taste. Pour into greased, shallow pan and cover with grated cheese. Bake until bubbly at 350°. Serves 8 to 10.

recipes.title: Grinder Snacks
directions: Grind together raisins, figs and dates.
Add lemon juice to cracker crumbs.
Roll one rounded teaspoonful of fruit mixture into a ball.
Roll ball in cracker crumbs until coated.
Store in airtight container.
Yield 16.
Exchanges, 1 fruit.
recipes.text: Grinder Snacks. Grind together raisins, figs and dates. Add lemon juice to cracker crumbs. Roll one rounded teaspoonful of fruit mixture into a ball. Roll ball in cracker crumbs until coated. Store in airtight container. Yield 16. Exchanges, 1 fruit.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Bars
directions: Preheat oven to 300°.
Sift together flour, baking soda, ginger, allspice and cinnamon.
Set aside.
In a large bowl, cream butter or margarine.
Gradually add sugar and beat until light and fluffy.
Add egg and pumpkin.
Beat well.
Add dry ingredients. Mix until blended.
Add nuts.
Mix well.
Spread batter evenly in well-greased 15 1/2 x 10 1/2 x 1-inch jelly roll pan.
Bake 15 to 18 minutes.
recipes.text: Pumpkin Bars. Preheat oven to 300°. Sift together flour, baking soda, ginger, allspice and cinnamon. Set aside. In a large bowl, cream butter or margarine. Gradually add sugar and beat until light and fluffy. Add egg and pumpkin. Beat well. Add dry ingredients. Mix until blended. Add nuts. Mix well. Spread batter evenly in well-greased 15 1/2 x 10 1/2 x 1-inch jelly roll pan. Bake 15 to 18 minutes.

recipes.title: Lemon Icebox Pie
directions: Beat all together and put into pie shell.
Refrigerate.
recipes.text: Lemon Icebox Pie. Beat all together and put into pie shell. Refrigerate.

recipes.title: Porcupines
directions: In a bowl, blend peanut butter, condensed milk and confectioners sugar together thoroughly with a wooden spoon, then knead with your hands.
Divide candy mixture into small pieces. Roll each piece into ball about 1-inch in diameter, then roll candy balls in chopped peanuts.
recipes.text: Porcupines. In a bowl, blend peanut butter, condensed milk and confectioners sugar together thoroughly with a wooden spoon, then knead with your hands. Divide candy mixture into small pieces. Roll each piece into ball about 1-inch in diameter, then roll candy balls in chopped peanuts.

recipes.title: Strawberry Jello Salad
directions: Dissolve jello in boiling water.
Add drained pineapple and partially thawed strawberries.
Pour 1/2 of the mixture in a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Chill.
Spread sour cream on top and remaining jello mixture.
Chill until firm.
recipes.text: Strawberry Jello Salad. Dissolve jello in boiling water. Add drained pineapple and partially thawed strawberries. Pour 1/2 of the mixture in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Chill. Spread sour cream on top and remaining jello mixture. Chill until firm.

recipes.title: Ambrosia
directions: Drain juice from all canned fruit.
Pour fruit in a large bowl.
Add sour cream, coconut and marshmallows.
Stir and refrigerate until ready for use.
recipes.text: Ambrosia. Drain juice from all canned fruit. Pour fruit in a large bowl. Add sour cream, coconut and marshmallows. Stir and refrigerate until ready for use.

recipes.title: Potato Chip Butter Cookies
directions: Soften	butter;
mix
with
sugar and vanilla, then add chips and flour.	Drop
by
teaspoonfuls	on
ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes.	Dust with powdered sugar.
recipes.text: Potato Chip Butter Cookies. Soften	butter; mix with sugar and vanilla, then add chips and flour.	Drop by teaspoonfuls	on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes.	Dust with powdered sugar.

recipes.title: "Punch Bowl" Cake
directions: Bake cake according to directions on box; let cool.
While cake is cooling, prepare box of vanilla pudding.
In a large punch bowl, crumble up cake in bottom of bowl.
Next, layer with the following ingredients, being sure to spread evenly:
can of crushed pineapple, prepared vanilla pudding, can of cherry pie filling and Cool Whip on top.
Decorate with maraschino cherries on top.
recipes.text: "Punch Bowl" Cake. Bake cake according to directions on box; let cool. While cake is cooling, prepare box of vanilla pudding. In a large punch bowl, crumble up cake in bottom of bowl. Next, layer with the following ingredients, being sure to spread evenly: can of crushed pineapple, prepared vanilla pudding, can of cherry pie filling and Cool Whip on top. Decorate with maraschino cherries on top.

recipes.title: Tynes Family Oyster Casserole
directions: In buttered casserole dish, put 1 layer oysters, then 1 layer crushed crackers. Dot with margarine. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Repeat.
Pour Pet milk over all this.
Finish by pouring regular milk until all ingredients are covered. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until golden brown.
recipes.text: Tynes Family Oyster Casserole. In buttered casserole dish, put 1 layer oysters, then 1 layer crushed crackers. Dot with margarine. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Repeat. Pour Pet milk over all this. Finish by pouring regular milk until all ingredients are covered. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until golden brown.

recipes.title: Cooked Chocolate Icing
directions: Mix all ingredients together.
Bring to boil and cook just one minute, stirring constantly.
Let cool and spread.
recipes.text: Cooked Chocolate Icing. Mix all ingredients together. Bring to boil and cook just one minute, stirring constantly. Let cool and spread.

recipes.title: Biscuit Pizza
ingredients: pepperoni, green peppers, mushrooms or any topping desired
directions: Cut biscuits in quarters.
In a bowl mix sauce and biscuits. Add 1 1/2 cups cheese and toppings.
Mix together.
Pour in a deep-dish pie glass dish sprayed with cooking spray.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
In the last few minutes of cooking sprinkle the remaining 1/2 cup of cheese over the top and put back into the oven until cheese is melted.
recipes.text: Biscuit Pizza. Cut biscuits in quarters. In a bowl mix sauce and biscuits. Add 1 1/2 cups cheese and toppings. Mix together. Pour in a deep-dish pie glass dish sprayed with cooking spray. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes. In the last few minutes of cooking sprinkle the remaining 1/2 cup of cheese over the top and put back into the oven until cheese is melted.

recipes.title: Shrimp Dip
ingredients: 1 4 1/4 can shrimp, drained and finely chopped
directions: Mix above ingredients and chill.
Serve with crackers.
recipes.text: Shrimp Dip. Mix above ingredients and chill. Serve with crackers.

recipes.title: Cake
directions: First you pout the flower in a bowl, then you pout the eggs in it and vanala, then you pout sugar milk in it than you pout it in a pot.
Then you put it in a avin then you pout sprincels then your done.
recipes.text: Cake. First you pout the flower in a bowl, then you pout the eggs in it and vanala, then you pout sugar milk in it than you pout it in a pot. Then you put it in a avin then you pout sprincels then your done.

recipes.title: Macaroni And Cheese
directions: Cook noodles as directed; drain. Alternate layers of noodles and cheese in deep casserole dish, adding the tablespoons of butter in between layers. In a small dish, mix eggs with a little milk and salt and pepper. Pour mixture over noodles and cheese. Then add more milk to almost the top of noodles. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes to 1 hour.
recipes.text: Macaroni And Cheese. Cook noodles as directed; drain. Alternate layers of noodles and cheese in deep casserole dish, adding the tablespoons of butter in between layers. In a small dish, mix eggs with a little milk and salt and pepper. Pour mixture over noodles and cheese. Then add more milk to almost the top of noodles. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes to 1 hour.

recipes.title: Crawfish Or Shrimp Casserole
ingredients: 1 (10 3/4 oz.) can cream of mushroom soup
1 (4 oz.) jar pimiento, chopped with juice
directions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Cook onions, bell pepper, garlic and celery in oleo until tender. Add soup, parsley, green onions, crawfish or shrimp, chopped pimiento (and juice) and seasonings. Heat thoroughly. Stir in rice and some bread crumbs. Place in 3 quart casserole. Sprinkle bread crumbs on top. Bake for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Crawfish Or Shrimp Casserole. Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Cook onions, bell pepper, garlic and celery in oleo until tender. Add soup, parsley, green onions, crawfish or shrimp, chopped pimiento (and juice) and seasonings. Heat thoroughly. Stir in rice and some bread crumbs. Place in 3 quart casserole. Sprinkle bread crumbs on top. Bake for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Frozen Strawberry Delight
ingredients: 2 pkg. (3 oz. each) cream cheese, softened
directions: Preheat oven to 325°.
Combine muffin mix and butter.
Pat into an ungreased 8-inch square pan and bake 10 to 12 minutes.
recipes.text: Frozen Strawberry Delight. Preheat oven to 325°. Combine muffin mix and butter. Pat into an ungreased 8-inch square pan and bake 10 to 12 minutes.

recipes.title: Edwards' Seafood Chowder(Flavored With Hickory Smoked Bacon!)
ingredients: 6 strips Edwards hickory smoked Virginia bacon
12 to 16 oz. fresh or frozen fish fillets, thawed (sole, flounder, cod or haddock)
1 (10 to 15 oz.) can condensed New England clam chowder
directions: Cook bacon; drain and reserve 2 tablespoons drippings.
Saute celery and onion in bacon drippings; add potatoes, 2 cups water and bouillon cubes.
Cook 10 to 15 minutes or until potatoes are done.
Add bacon and fish and cook 5 minutes.
Stir in remaining ingredients except ground pepper and parsley.
Simmer 10 minutes. Do not boil.
Garnish with pepper and parsley.
Serves 6.
recipes.text: Edwards' Seafood Chowder(Flavored With Hickory Smoked Bacon!). Cook bacon; drain and reserve 2 tablespoons drippings. Saute celery and onion in bacon drippings; add potatoes, 2 cups water and bouillon cubes. Cook 10 to 15 minutes or until potatoes are done. Add bacon and fish and cook 5 minutes. Stir in remaining ingredients except ground pepper and parsley. Simmer 10 minutes. Do not boil. Garnish with pepper and parsley. Serves 6.

recipes.title: Chicken Adobo
directions: Clean and cut chicken in desired size.
Put in a medium size pot.
Combine ingredients together.
Cook on medium heat.
Simmer until done.
recipes.text: Chicken Adobo. Clean and cut chicken in desired size. Put in a medium size pot. Combine ingredients together. Cook on medium heat. Simmer until done.

recipes.title: Home Care Gingerbread Houses
directions: Bring butter or shortening, sugar, molasses and vinegar to a boil.
Cool, add egg.
Sift dry ingredients together; add to first mixture; mix well.
Chill.
On lightly floured surface, roll out to about 1/8 inch thickness for thin cookies or 1/4 inch for plump cookies.
Cut in disired shapes.
Place on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 375 F for 6-12 minutes.
Cool 5 minutes and remove from sheet.
recipes.text: Home Care Gingerbread Houses. Bring butter or shortening, sugar, molasses and vinegar to a boil. Cool, add egg. Sift dry ingredients together; add to first mixture; mix well. Chill. On lightly floured surface, roll out to about 1/8 inch thickness for thin cookies or 1/4 inch for plump cookies. Cut in disired shapes. Place on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 375 F for 6-12 minutes. Cool 5 minutes and remove from sheet.

recipes.title: Pound Cake
directions: Sift the confectioners sugar.
Beat the shortening creamy. If you use the butter for the shortening, reduce the milk by 1 tablespoon.
Gradually beat in the sifted sugar.
Add one egg at a time and beat each in thoroughly. Add and beat in vanilla. Measure flour and mix with baking powder.
Blend flour into beaten mixture in small amounts with alternate additions of milk.
After all is added, beat the batter hard.
Pour into lightly buttered and flour dusted tube pan, filling no more than 3/4 full.
Bake in preheated 350° oven for 1 1/4 to 1 1/2 hours until lightly browned and pulled slightly away from sides of pan.
recipes.text: Pound Cake. Sift the confectioners sugar. Beat the shortening creamy. If you use the butter for the shortening, reduce the milk by 1 tablespoon. Gradually beat in the sifted sugar. Add one egg at a time and beat each in thoroughly. Add and beat in vanilla. Measure flour and mix with baking powder. Blend flour into beaten mixture in small amounts with alternate additions of milk. After all is added, beat the batter hard. Pour into lightly buttered and flour dusted tube pan, filling no more than 3/4 full. Bake in preheated 350° oven for 1 1/4 to 1 1/2 hours until lightly browned and pulled slightly away from sides of pan.

recipes.title: Hamburger Vegetable Soup
directions: Lots of vegetables can be added or substituted for those listed. Examples are canned green beans, mixed vegetables, potatoes, mushrooms, etc., but I would go with either all fresh or all canned, not a mixture, except for the sliced onions.
recipes.text: Hamburger Vegetable Soup. Lots of vegetables can be added or substituted for those listed. Examples are canned green beans, mixed vegetables, potatoes, mushrooms, etc., but I would go with either all fresh or all canned, not a mixture, except for the sliced onions.

recipes.title: Snowball Jewels
ingredients: 1 1/2 c. M&M's plain or peanut chocolate candies
directions: Combine coconut, almond extract, M&M's, sweetened condensed milk and salt.
Mix well.
Drop by rounded tablespoonfuls onto greased cookie sheet.
Bake at 350° for 9 to 10 minutes, or until edges are very lightly browned.
Using moistened spatula, immediately remove from cookie sheet.
Cool thoroughly on wire rack.
Makes 3 dozen cookies.
recipes.text: Snowball Jewels. Combine coconut, almond extract, M&M's, sweetened condensed milk and salt. Mix well. Drop by rounded tablespoonfuls onto greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350° for 9 to 10 minutes, or until edges are very lightly browned. Using moistened spatula, immediately remove from cookie sheet. Cool thoroughly on wire rack. Makes 3 dozen cookies.

recipes.title: Dried Beef Cheese Ball
directions: Soften cream cheese.
Cut dried beef in small pieces.
Chop onions fine and mix with cream cheese and 2/3 of the dried beef together with other ingredients.
Roll into a ball or log with hands.
Roll ball in remaining dried beef.
Refrigerate and set out 30 minutes before serving.
recipes.text: Dried Beef Cheese Ball. Soften cream cheese. Cut dried beef in small pieces. Chop onions fine and mix with cream cheese and 2/3 of the dried beef together with other ingredients. Roll into a ball or log with hands. Roll ball in remaining dried beef. Refrigerate and set out 30 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Best Flank Steak
directions: Tenderize and stab with fork both sides of steak.
Mix all ingredients and add steak.
If marinade does not cover steak, add a little water.
Marinate 3 hours or overnight.
Broil 5 minutes per side for medium-rare.
recipes.text: Best Flank Steak. Tenderize and stab with fork both sides of steak. Mix all ingredients and add steak. If marinade does not cover steak, add a little water. Marinate 3 hours or overnight. Broil 5 minutes per side for medium-rare.

recipes.title: Caramels
directions: Boil first 3 ingredients for 30 minutes.
Add cream, boil (stir occasionally) over medium heat until firm ball stage (244° to 248°).
Add 2 cups chopped nuts (chop fine).
Pour in greased 9 x 13-inch pan.
Cool.
Cut in 1-inch squares.
Roll in waxed paper.
recipes.text: Caramels. Boil first 3 ingredients for 30 minutes. Add cream, boil (stir occasionally) over medium heat until firm ball stage (244° to 248°). Add 2 cups chopped nuts (chop fine). Pour in greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Cool. Cut in 1-inch squares. Roll in waxed paper.

recipes.title: Rio Grande Pork Roast
directions: Rub surfaces of roast with garlic pepper.
Place roast in a shallow pan and place in a preheated 350° oven; roast for 30 minutes.
To make basting sauce, combine remaining ingredients in a small bowl; stir to mix well.
Pour basting sauce over roast and continue to roast, basting occasionally, until meat thermometer inserted registers 155°, about 20 to 30 more minutes.
Remove roast from pan and let rest 10 minutes before slicing to serve.
Remove pan drippings to a small saucepan; add enough water to make one cup and bring to a boil.
Boil for 3 to 4 minutes.
Serve sauce on side with roast.
Serves four to six well, with leftovers.
recipes.text: Rio Grande Pork Roast. Rub surfaces of roast with garlic pepper. Place roast in a shallow pan and place in a preheated 350° oven; roast for 30 minutes. To make basting sauce, combine remaining ingredients in a small bowl; stir to mix well. Pour basting sauce over roast and continue to roast, basting occasionally, until meat thermometer inserted registers 155°, about 20 to 30 more minutes. Remove roast from pan and let rest 10 minutes before slicing to serve. Remove pan drippings to a small saucepan; add enough water to make one cup and bring to a boil. Boil for 3 to 4 minutes. Serve sauce on side with roast. Serves four to six well, with leftovers.

recipes.title: Poppy Seed Chicken
ingredients: 2 sticks butter or margarine, melted and cooled (save one cup)
2 cans of cream of chicken soup
directions: Mix crackers, butter and poppy seed together and pat into a 9 x 13-inch glass baking dish.
(Save one cup for topping.)
Parboil chicken with salt, black pepper, onions and celery.
Place chopped up chicken over cracker crust.
Cream sour cream, cream of chicken soup; spread over chicken.
Sprinkle 1 cup of cracker mixture on top and bake 45 minutes at 350°.
recipes.text: Poppy Seed Chicken. Mix crackers, butter and poppy seed together and pat into a 9 x 13-inch glass baking dish. (Save one cup for topping.) Parboil chicken with salt, black pepper, onions and celery. Place chopped up chicken over cracker crust. Cream sour cream, cream of chicken soup; spread over chicken. Sprinkle 1 cup of cracker mixture on top and bake 45 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Nacho Dip
ingredients: 1 can drained stewed tomatoes, cut into small pieces
directions: Mix bean dip, sour cream, mayonnaise and taco seasoning well. Spread this mixture into the bottom of a glass or Tupperware square dish.
Layer green onions, tomatoes, olives and cheese. Serve with nacho chips.
recipes.text: Nacho Dip. Mix bean dip, sour cream, mayonnaise and taco seasoning well. Spread this mixture into the bottom of a glass or Tupperware square dish. Layer green onions, tomatoes, olives and cheese. Serve with nacho chips.

recipes.title: Easy Peach Cobbler
ingredients: 3/4 c. sugar, if fresh peaches (1/2 c. sugar, if canned)
1 c. boiling water, if fresh peaches (for canned, 1/2 c. hot water and 21/2 c. peach syrup)
directions: Combine peeled and sliced peaches with sugar and water and set aside.
Mix together 1/2 cup sugar, flour, baking powder, salt, milk, melted butter and vanilla and
pour into greased 8 x 12-inch baking dish.
Spoon peaches over the mixture and pour remaining water (and syrup) on top.
Bake for 20 to 25 minutes or until golden brown in preheated 400° oven.
recipes.text: Easy Peach Cobbler. Combine peeled and sliced peaches with sugar and water and set aside. Mix together 1/2 cup sugar, flour, baking powder, salt, milk, melted butter and vanilla and pour into greased 8 x 12-inch baking dish. Spoon peaches over the mixture and pour remaining water (and syrup) on top. Bake for 20 to 25 minutes or until golden brown in preheated 400° oven.

recipes.title: Salmon Log
ingredients: 2 c. canned salmon, flaked and drained
directions: Combine all ingredients and chill several hours. Shape into a log and roll in parsley flakes and chopped nuts.
Serve with crackers of your choice.
recipes.text: Salmon Log. Combine all ingredients and chill several hours. Shape into a log and roll in parsley flakes and chopped nuts. Serve with crackers of your choice.

recipes.title: Pretzel Salad
directions: Dissolve jello in hot water.
Cool until partially set.
Stir in apples and nuts.
recipes.text: Pretzel Salad. Dissolve jello in hot water. Cool until partially set. Stir in apples and nuts.

recipes.title: Millie'S Roll-Ups
ingredients: Miracle Whip or Miracle Whip Light dressing
directions: Spread dressing and salsa on each tortilla; sprinkle with cheese.
Top with lettuce and meat.
Roll up.
recipes.text: Millie'S Roll-Ups. Spread dressing and salsa on each tortilla; sprinkle with cheese. Top with lettuce and meat. Roll up.

recipes.title: Creamed Chicken Breasts
ingredients: 4 whole, large chicken breasts, skinned and boned
1/4 c. dry white wine or water
1 c. herb seasoned stuffing mix, crumbled
directions: Arrange chicken in a greased 13 x 9-inch baking dish.
Place cheese slices over chicken.
Combine soup and wine.
Stir.
Spoon sauce evenly over chicken and cheese.
Sprinkle with stuffing. Drizzle butter over crumbs.
Bake at 350° for one hour.
recipes.text: Creamed Chicken Breasts. Arrange chicken in a greased 13 x 9-inch baking dish. Place cheese slices over chicken. Combine soup and wine. Stir. Spoon sauce evenly over chicken and cheese. Sprinkle with stuffing. Drizzle butter over crumbs. Bake at 350° for one hour.

recipes.title: Beef Stroganoff
ingredients: 4 oz. can mushroom stems and pieces
directions: Cut steak into 3 x 1-inch strips.
Brown strips in shortening in 10-inch skillet.
Add onion, salt and pepper.
Blend in flour, then tomato juice and mushroom stems and pieces, drained.
Cover; cook over low heat 1 hour, until meat is tender.
Stir in mixture of milk and lemon juice.
Heat until steaming, but do not boil. Serve over noodles or rice.
Makes 4 servings.
recipes.text: Beef Stroganoff. Cut steak into 3 x 1-inch strips. Brown strips in shortening in 10-inch skillet. Add onion, salt and pepper. Blend in flour, then tomato juice and mushroom stems and pieces, drained. Cover; cook over low heat 1 hour, until meat is tender. Stir in mixture of milk and lemon juice. Heat until steaming, but do not boil. Serve over noodles or rice. Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: Maria'S Pizza Bread(By Special Request From Friends Who Have Eaten It)
directions: Note:
Use fresh herbs when in season!
recipes.text: Maria'S Pizza Bread(By Special Request From Friends Who Have Eaten It). Note: Use fresh herbs when in season!

recipes.title: Almond Apple Wheat Stuffing
ingredients: 1/3 to 1/2 c. apple cider or juice
directions: Saute apples, almonds, onion and celery in butter for 5 minutes, stirring frequently. Remove from heat. Stir in cinnamon, poultry seasoning and salt. Toss together bread cubes and raisins. Add apple mixture.
Stir egg in 1/3 cup apple cider. Toss into bread mixture. Add remaining apple cider if a moister stuffing is desired.
This will stuff a 15 to 20 pound turkey or 2 large roasting chickens.
Spoon any remaining stuffing into a lightly greased 9 x 5-inch loaf pan. Bake, covered.
Makes 10 cups.
recipes.text: Almond Apple Wheat Stuffing. Saute apples, almonds, onion and celery in butter for 5 minutes, stirring frequently. Remove from heat. Stir in cinnamon, poultry seasoning and salt. Toss together bread cubes and raisins. Add apple mixture. Stir egg in 1/3 cup apple cider. Toss into bread mixture. Add remaining apple cider if a moister stuffing is desired. This will stuff a 15 to 20 pound turkey or 2 large roasting chickens. Spoon any remaining stuffing into a lightly greased 9 x 5-inch loaf pan. Bake, covered. Makes 10 cups.

recipes.title: Sante Fe Mushrooms
directions: Clean mushrooms; remove center portions.
Mix Cheddar cheese, sour cream, onions, parsley and chilies together.
Stuff mixture into center of each mushrooms.
Melt butter with garlic and brush onto mushroom caps.
Sprinkle each mushroom with Parmesan cheese and broil until bubbly.
Serves 8.
recipes.text: Sante Fe Mushrooms. Clean mushrooms; remove center portions. Mix Cheddar cheese, sour cream, onions, parsley and chilies together. Stuff mixture into center of each mushrooms. Melt butter with garlic and brush onto mushroom caps. Sprinkle each mushroom with Parmesan cheese and broil until bubbly. Serves 8.

recipes.title: Amaretto Punch
ingredients: 1 (12 oz.) can frozen orange juice concentrate, thawed and undiluted
1 (6 oz.) can frozen lemonade concentrate, thawed and undiluted
directions: Dissolve sugar in boiling water; stir in remaining ingredients.
Divide mixture evenly into 6-quart size, heavy-duty, Ziploc bags.
Freeze.
Reach each bag from freezer as needed.
Let stand at room temperature until mixture is slushy.
Yield:
about 6 quarts.
recipes.text: Amaretto Punch. Dissolve sugar in boiling water; stir in remaining ingredients. Divide mixture evenly into 6-quart size, heavy-duty, Ziploc bags. Freeze. Reach each bag from freezer as needed. Let stand at room temperature until mixture is slushy. Yield: about 6 quarts.

recipes.title: Orange Salad
directions: Mix jello and boiling water.
Add orange sherbet and mandarin oranges.
recipes.text: Orange Salad. Mix jello and boiling water. Add orange sherbet and mandarin oranges.

recipes.title: White Trash Candy
directions: Combine cereal (and nuts, if desired) into large bowl.
Place almond bark in microwavable dish.
Heat and stir at 1-minute intervals until completely melted (approximately 4 minutes).
Pour melted candy over mixture in bowl.
Using wooden spoon, stir until cereal is completely coated.
Pour mixture onto wax paper and spread with wooden spoon.
Let cool.
Break into pieces.
recipes.text: White Trash Candy. Combine cereal (and nuts, if desired) into large bowl. Place almond bark in microwavable dish. Heat and stir at 1-minute intervals until completely melted (approximately 4 minutes). Pour melted candy over mixture in bowl. Using wooden spoon, stir until cereal is completely coated. Pour mixture onto wax paper and spread with wooden spoon. Let cool. Break into pieces.

recipes.title: Sicilian Meat Loaf
directions: Combine first 8 ingredients, mixing well. On foil or wax paper, pat meat into 12 x 10 rectangle. Arrange ham slices on meat. Sprinkle shredded Mozzarella cheese over ham. Start from short end and roll up, using foil to lift. Seal edges and ends so cheese won't cook out. Place roll seam side down in 13 x 9 pan. Bake at 350° for 1 hour and 15 minutes.
recipes.text: Sicilian Meat Loaf. Combine first 8 ingredients, mixing well. On foil or wax paper, pat meat into 12 x 10 rectangle. Arrange ham slices on meat. Sprinkle shredded Mozzarella cheese over ham. Start from short end and roll up, using foil to lift. Seal edges and ends so cheese won't cook out. Place roll seam side down in 13 x 9 pan. Bake at 350° for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Santa'S Chocolate Martini
directions: Spoon a thin layer of cocoa mix onto a plate.
Dip the rim of a martini glass into a small plate of water.
Shake glass to remove excess water.
Dip the wet rim into the cocoa mix.
Stand the glass upright and chill in the freezer.
Combine gin and creme de cacao with ice in a small pitcher.
Stir gently to chill. Strain into a prepared glass.
Garnish.
Serve immediately.
recipes.text: Santa'S Chocolate Martini. Spoon a thin layer of cocoa mix onto a plate. Dip the rim of a martini glass into a small plate of water. Shake glass to remove excess water. Dip the wet rim into the cocoa mix. Stand the glass upright and chill in the freezer. Combine gin and creme de cacao with ice in a small pitcher. Stir gently to chill. Strain into a prepared glass. Garnish. Serve immediately.

recipes.title: Homemade Brownies
directions: Cream together oleo, sugar, eggs and vanilla.
Add to mixture, cocoa, flour, salt and nuts.
Put in a greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan and bake at 350° for 20 minutes.
recipes.text: Homemade Brownies. Cream together oleo, sugar, eggs and vanilla. Add to mixture, cocoa, flour, salt and nuts. Put in a greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan and bake at 350° for 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Borscht(Russian Soup)
ingredients: salt, pepper and pinch of dill
directions: Cover spareribs with water, salt, pepper and 1 whole onion. Boil and simmer 1 hour and a half.
Remove onion.
Chop one small head of cabbage.
Add remaining ingredients and simmer 20 minutes more.
Add additional vinegar, salt and pepper if needed.
Finally add as much sour cream as you wish.
