recipes.text: Borscht(Russian Soup). Cover spareribs with water, salt, pepper and 1 whole onion. Boil and simmer 1 hour and a half. Remove onion. Chop one small head of cabbage. Add remaining ingredients and simmer 20 minutes more. Add additional vinegar, salt and pepper if needed. Finally add as much sour cream as you wish.

recipes.title: Watergate Salad
directions: Put pudding in bowl and add pineapple and juice.
Stir well. Add other ingredients.
recipes.text: Watergate Salad. Put pudding in bowl and add pineapple and juice. Stir well. Add other ingredients.

recipes.title: Smoked Sausage With Black-Eyed Peas
ingredients: 2 lb. smoked sausage, cut into 1-inch pieces
directions: Soak peas overnight.
Add salt pork to peas; cover with water and cook over low heat for 45 minutes.
Add the next 13 ingredients.
Cover and cook over low heat for 45 minutes.
Add sausage.
Cook over low heat for 45 minutes.
Serve over rice. Great with French bread and salad.
recipes.text: Smoked Sausage With Black-Eyed Peas. Soak peas overnight. Add salt pork to peas; cover with water and cook over low heat for 45 minutes. Add the next 13 ingredients. Cover and cook over low heat for 45 minutes. Add sausage. Cook over low heat for 45 minutes. Serve over rice. Great with French bread and salad.

recipes.title: King Casserole
directions: Place in baking dish layer of chicken and Doritos.
Mix in chopped onion, soup and tomatoes together.
Pour over chicken and Doritos.
Sprinkle cheese on top.
Bake 30 minutes at 350°.
recipes.text: King Casserole. Place in baking dish layer of chicken and Doritos. Mix in chopped onion, soup and tomatoes together. Pour over chicken and Doritos. Sprinkle cheese on top. Bake 30 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Meatless Vegetable All Italian Soup
directions: Melt butter in 4-quart pot.
Stir in onions and cabbage.
Heat 2 minutes.
Add water, cover and simmer another 10 minutes.
Stir in veggies, tomatoes and seasonings. Simmer 10 minutes.
If using frozen or fresh veggies, simmer until tender.
recipes.text: Meatless Vegetable All Italian Soup. Melt butter in 4-quart pot. Stir in onions and cabbage. Heat 2 minutes. Add water, cover and simmer another 10 minutes. Stir in veggies, tomatoes and seasonings. Simmer 10 minutes. If using frozen or fresh veggies, simmer until tender.

recipes.title: Beef Parmigiana
directions: Combine bread crumbs and grated Parmesan cheese.
Dip steak in egg, then in bread crumb mixture.
Brown steak in oil.
Remove from skillet; put in lightly greased baking dish.
Add onion to pan drippings; saute until done.
Add tomato paste, water and spices.
Bring to boil; cook, uncovered, for 5 minutes, then pour mixture over steak.
Cover with foil; bake at 350° for 50 minutes. Top with cheese and put back in oven until cheese melts.
recipes.text: Beef Parmigiana. Combine bread crumbs and grated Parmesan cheese. Dip steak in egg, then in bread crumb mixture. Brown steak in oil. Remove from skillet; put in lightly greased baking dish. Add onion to pan drippings; saute until done. Add tomato paste, water and spices. Bring to boil; cook, uncovered, for 5 minutes, then pour mixture over steak. Cover with foil; bake at 350° for 50 minutes. Top with cheese and put back in oven until cheese melts.

recipes.title: Classic Pecan Pie
directions: Preheat oven and baking sheet to 350°.
In large bowl stir eggs, corn syrup, sugar, margarine and vanilla until well blended. Stir in pecans.
Pour into pastry shell and place pie on baking sheet in oven.
Bake 50 to 55 minutes or until knife inserted halfway between center and edge comes out clean.
Cool on wire rack.
Serves 8.
recipes.text: Classic Pecan Pie. Preheat oven and baking sheet to 350°. In large bowl stir eggs, corn syrup, sugar, margarine and vanilla until well blended. Stir in pecans. Pour into pastry shell and place pie on baking sheet in oven. Bake 50 to 55 minutes or until knife inserted halfway between center and edge comes out clean. Cool on wire rack. Serves 8.

recipes.title: Taco Dip
directions: Spread softened cream cheese on the bottom of a 12 x 8-inch dish.
Spread chili on top of cream cheese.
Cover with shredded Cheddar cheese.
Microwave until cheese melts and dip is hot. Serve with tortilla chips.
recipes.text: Taco Dip. Spread softened cream cheese on the bottom of a 12 x 8-inch dish. Spread chili on top of cream cheese. Cover with shredded Cheddar cheese. Microwave until cheese melts and dip is hot. Serve with tortilla chips.

recipes.title: Cucumber Dip
ingredients: 2 medium cucumbers, peeled, seeded and chopped
directions: Cream the cream cheese until smooth.
Stir in remaining ingredients.
Mix well.
Cover; chill.
recipes.text: Cucumber Dip. Cream the cream cheese until smooth. Stir in remaining ingredients. Mix well. Cover; chill.

recipes.title: English Muffins
directions: Dissolve dry yeast in the warm water.
Combine sugar, milk, shortening and salt in bowl and mix well.
Stir in 3 cups of flour; beat until smooth.
Add remaining flour; knead until smooth.
Place in a greased bowl, turning once so the greased side faces upward.
Let rise 1 hour to double.
Punch down and turn onto floured board.
Roll dough out and cut in 3-inch circles with cutter; transfer to heavy greased skillet.
Let rise to double. Bake in 350° oven for 12 to 15 minutes.
recipes.text: English Muffins. Dissolve dry yeast in the warm water. Combine sugar, milk, shortening and salt in bowl and mix well. Stir in 3 cups of flour; beat until smooth. Add remaining flour; knead until smooth. Place in a greased bowl, turning once so the greased side faces upward. Let rise 1 hour to double. Punch down and turn onto floured board. Roll dough out and cut in 3-inch circles with cutter; transfer to heavy greased skillet. Let rise to double. Bake in 350° oven for 12 to 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Chocolate Chip Oatmeal Cookies
directions: Preheat oven to 350°. Combine sugars and shortening. Cream well. Add eggs and vanilla. Add flour, baking soda, baking powder and salt. Mix well. Stir in oats, then chocolate chips and nuts. Drop by heaping teaspoonfuls on lightly greased cookie sheet. Bake in preheated oven for 12 to 14 minutes. Cool slightly on cookie sheet, then remove to finish cooling. Makes about 6 1/2 dozen cookies.
recipes.text: Chocolate Chip Oatmeal Cookies. Preheat oven to 350°. Combine sugars and shortening. Cream well. Add eggs and vanilla. Add flour, baking soda, baking powder and salt. Mix well. Stir in oats, then chocolate chips and nuts. Drop by heaping teaspoonfuls on lightly greased cookie sheet. Bake in preheated oven for 12 to 14 minutes. Cool slightly on cookie sheet, then remove to finish cooling. Makes about 6 1/2 dozen cookies.

recipes.title: Hot Dogs And Cheese
directions: Combine all ingredients and bake in oven at 325° for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Hot Dogs And Cheese. Combine all ingredients and bake in oven at 325° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Wassail
ingredients: 1 tall can (qt. or 12 oz.) apple juice
directions: Combine and simmer for 30 minutes.
Add red coloring if desired.
Will keep 2 to 3 weeks under refrigeration.
recipes.text: Wassail. Combine and simmer for 30 minutes. Add red coloring if desired. Will keep 2 to 3 weeks under refrigeration.

recipes.title: Sour Cream Crescent Rolls
directions: Scald sour cream.
Stir in sugar, salt and melted butter. Cool until lukewarm.
Measure warm water into large bowl. Sprinkle in yeast and stir.
Add lukewarm sour cream mixture, eggs and flour.
Mix until well blended.
Cover tightly and refrigerate overnight.
(This is very important.)
Next day, turn out dough onto a lightly floured board.
Divide into 4 parts.
Roll each part into a 10-inch circle.
Cut each circle into 12 wedge-shaped pieces.
Roll each piece up from wide end and place on greased baking sheet.
Cover and let rise in warm place until doubled, about 1 hour.
Bake at 375° for 15 minutes or until browned.
If desired, brush with butter when removed from oven.
recipes.text: Sour Cream Crescent Rolls. Scald sour cream. Stir in sugar, salt and melted butter. Cool until lukewarm. Measure warm water into large bowl. Sprinkle in yeast and stir. Add lukewarm sour cream mixture, eggs and flour. Mix until well blended. Cover tightly and refrigerate overnight. (This is very important.) Next day, turn out dough onto a lightly floured board. Divide into 4 parts. Roll each part into a 10-inch circle. Cut each circle into 12 wedge-shaped pieces. Roll each piece up from wide end and place on greased baking sheet. Cover and let rise in warm place until doubled, about 1 hour. Bake at 375° for 15 minutes or until browned. If desired, brush with butter when removed from oven.

recipes.title: Vegetable Soup
directions: Place in large pot (5 to 6-quart) and cook 3 to 4 hours over medium heat.
Serves 10.
recipes.text: Vegetable Soup. Place in large pot (5 to 6-quart) and cook 3 to 4 hours over medium heat. Serves 10.

recipes.title: Sausage Balls
directions: Mix together in skillet and heat, then pour over sausage balls.
recipes.text: Sausage Balls. Mix together in skillet and heat, then pour over sausage balls.

recipes.title: Asparagus Delight
ingredients: 2 (3 oz.) cans mushroom stems and pieces, drained
directions: Drain asparagus, reserving 1 cup liquid; set aside.
recipes.text: Asparagus Delight. Drain asparagus, reserving 1 cup liquid; set aside.

recipes.title: Pizza Snacks
ingredients: 1 lb. Velveeta cheese, cut in cubes
directions: Brown meat.
Drain.
Stir in cheese while hot.
Spoon onto party rye bread slices.
Spread out.
Broil 5 minutes on bake in oven 10 to 15 minutes at 350°.
Makes 35.
recipes.text: Pizza Snacks. Brown meat. Drain. Stir in cheese while hot. Spoon onto party rye bread slices. Spread out. Broil 5 minutes on bake in oven 10 to 15 minutes at 350°. Makes 35.

recipes.title: Tuna Casserole
ingredients: 1 small can tuna (2 cans for richer taste)
directions: Cook noodles as directed on package, then drain. Combine all other ingredients with noodles. Place in baking dish and top with grated cheese. Bake at 325° for 20 minutes.
recipes.text: Tuna Casserole. Cook noodles as directed on package, then drain. Combine all other ingredients with noodles. Place in baking dish and top with grated cheese. Bake at 325° for 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Pasta Salad
ingredients: 1 small bottle Seven Seas oil and vinegar salad dressing
directions: Cook pasta shells according to directions.
Chop onion, tomatoes, cucumber and black olives.
Mix all in bowl.
Add mushrooms, 1/2 jar of seasoning and all dressing.
Refrigerate for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Pasta Salad. Cook pasta shells according to directions. Chop onion, tomatoes, cucumber and black olives. Mix all in bowl. Add mushrooms, 1/2 jar of seasoning and all dressing. Refrigerate for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Vanilla Ice Cream
directions: Add sugar and eggs; beat until creamy.
Add can cream and vanilla.
Beat a little.
Finish filling churn with regular milk, then add fruit, if desired.
recipes.text: Vanilla Ice Cream. Add sugar and eggs; beat until creamy. Add can cream and vanilla. Beat a little. Finish filling churn with regular milk, then add fruit, if desired.

recipes.title: Perogies
directions: Filling:
Mix four cups cottage cheese with 2 eggs and 1 Tbsp. salt.
recipes.text: Perogies. Filling: Mix four cups cottage cheese with 2 eggs and 1 Tbsp. salt.

recipes.title: Chocolate Squares
directions: Melt chocolate.
Add remaining ingredients, saving out enough nuts to sprinkle on top of batter.
Spread thinly on cookie sheet. Bake at 400° approximately 15 minutes.
recipes.text: Chocolate Squares. Melt chocolate. Add remaining ingredients, saving out enough nuts to sprinkle on top of batter. Spread thinly on cookie sheet. Bake at 400° approximately 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Miss Edna'S Seafood Bisque
ingredients: 1/2 lb. crabmeat, picked over for shells
1/2 lb. cooked and peeled baby shrimp (frozen are fine, thaw and rinse them)
directions: Combine soups in heavy saucepan.
Whisk in milk, making sure mixture is smooth.
Bring to a boil, whisking occasionally, to keep from scorching.
Reduce heat to low; stir in crabmeat and shrimp.
Be careful not to scorch soup.
Before serving, add 1 tablespoon sherry (or to taste) to each soup bowl and stir to blend.
Float a thin slice of lemon on top to garnish.
recipes.text: Miss Edna'S Seafood Bisque. Combine soups in heavy saucepan. Whisk in milk, making sure mixture is smooth. Bring to a boil, whisking occasionally, to keep from scorching. Reduce heat to low; stir in crabmeat and shrimp. Be careful not to scorch soup. Before serving, add 1 tablespoon sherry (or to taste) to each soup bowl and stir to blend. Float a thin slice of lemon on top to garnish.

recipes.title: Minestrone
ingredients: 1 cup dried white navy beans (Great Northern)
directions: Day before in bowl cover beans with cold water.
Refrigerate, covered, overnight.
Next day drain.
Turn chicken broth into a 1 qt. measure.
Add water to make one quart.
Pour into 8-qt. kettle with 2 more quarts of water, 2 tsp. salt and the beans.
Bring to boiling, reduce heat, simmer, covered for 1 hour.
Meanwhile, wash cabbage and quarter and remove core with sharp knife.
Slice each quarter thinly.
Pare carrots, slice on diagonal, 1/4 inch thick. Pare potatoes, slice 1/2 inch thick, cut into 1/2 inch cubes.
Add to soup with canned tomatoes.
Cover, cook 1/2 hour longer. Meanwhile, peel onions, cut in half, slice thinly.
In 1/4 cup hot oil in medium skillet saute onions, stirring about 5 minutes. Remove from heat.
Slice celery on diagonal, 1/8 inch thick.
Wash zucchini, slice into rounds, 1/4 inch thick.
Hold tomatoes on fork over heat, just to split skin, then peel with knife.
Slice 1/2 thick cut into 1/2 inch cubes.
Press 1 clove garlic.
Add vegetables to onion with 1/2 tsp. salt and the pepper.
Cook slowly, uncovered, stirring occasionally, 20 minutes.
Add to bean mixture with 1/4 cup parsley and spaghetti.
Cover and cook slowly for 30 minutes, stirring occasionally.
recipes.text: Minestrone. Day before in bowl cover beans with cold water. Refrigerate, covered, overnight. Next day drain. Turn chicken broth into a 1 qt. measure. Add water to make one quart. Pour into 8-qt. kettle with 2 more quarts of water, 2 tsp. salt and the beans. Bring to boiling, reduce heat, simmer, covered for 1 hour. Meanwhile, wash cabbage and quarter and remove core with sharp knife. Slice each quarter thinly. Pare carrots, slice on diagonal, 1/4 inch thick. Pare potatoes, slice 1/2 inch thick, cut into 1/2 inch cubes. Add to soup with canned tomatoes. Cover, cook 1/2 hour longer. Meanwhile, peel onions, cut in half, slice thinly. In 1/4 cup hot oil in medium skillet saute onions, stirring about 5 minutes. Remove from heat. Slice celery on diagonal, 1/8 inch thick. Wash zucchini, slice into rounds, 1/4 inch thick. Hold tomatoes on fork over heat, just to split skin, then peel with knife. Slice 1/2 thick cut into 1/2 inch cubes. Press 1 clove garlic. Add vegetables to onion with 1/2 tsp. salt and the pepper. Cook slowly, uncovered, stirring occasionally, 20 minutes. Add to bean mixture with 1/4 cup parsley and spaghetti. Cover and cook slowly for 30 minutes, stirring occasionally.

recipes.title: Caramel Apple Dip
directions: Blend until smooth.
Serve with cut up apple.
recipes.text: Caramel Apple Dip. Blend until smooth. Serve with cut up apple.

recipes.title: Rocky Road
directions: In top of double boiler, over hot not boiling water, melt chips with milk.
Remove from heat.
Put in a long bowl with marshmallows, nuts and raisins.
Mix in chocolate and milk.
Drop by teaspoon onto wax paper lined baking sheet.
Chill 2 hours. Store loosely covered in cool, dry place.
This amount makes 5 dozen.
recipes.text: Rocky Road. In top of double boiler, over hot not boiling water, melt chips with milk. Remove from heat. Put in a long bowl with marshmallows, nuts and raisins. Mix in chocolate and milk. Drop by teaspoon onto wax paper lined baking sheet. Chill 2 hours. Store loosely covered in cool, dry place. This amount makes 5 dozen.

recipes.title: Vegetable Burger Soup
directions: Lightly brown meat; drain fat.
Add all ingredients.
Bring to a boil.
Reduce heat and simmer 20 minutes.
Can be made in crock-pot.
Good luck!
recipes.text: Vegetable Burger Soup. Lightly brown meat; drain fat. Add all ingredients. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer 20 minutes. Can be made in crock-pot. Good luck!

recipes.title: Fried Apples
directions: *Any kind except the green apples.
Amount of apples depends upon the amount of people.
recipes.text: Fried Apples. *Any kind except the green apples. Amount of apples depends upon the amount of people.

recipes.title: Applesauce Nut Bread
directions: Preheat oven to 350°.
Sift together dry ingredients and blend sugar and margarine together, then eggs and then mix dry ingredients.
Place in a greased bread pan and bake for 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Applesauce Nut Bread. Preheat oven to 350°. Sift together dry ingredients and blend sugar and margarine together, then eggs and then mix dry ingredients. Place in a greased bread pan and bake for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Farmer'S Bread With Ham, Cheese And White Sauce
directions: Arrange 8 slices of farmer's bread on cookie sheet.
Cover farmer's bread with 2 slices each of ham; top with 1/2 cup Monterey Jack cheese.
Salt and pepper all 8 slices.
Close sandwiches.
Spoon white sauce over each sandwich.
Sprinkle with remaining cheese.
Broil for 4 minutes in oven until bubbly. Serve at once.
Makes 4 servings.
recipes.text: Farmer'S Bread With Ham, Cheese And White Sauce. Arrange 8 slices of farmer's bread on cookie sheet. Cover farmer's bread with 2 slices each of ham; top with 1/2 cup Monterey Jack cheese. Salt and pepper all 8 slices. Close sandwiches. Spoon white sauce over each sandwich. Sprinkle with remaining cheese. Broil for 4 minutes in oven until bubbly. Serve at once. Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: Strawberry Yogurt Dip
directions: Combine Cool Whip and yogurt.
Add strawberries.
Mix well. Serve as a dip with fresh fruit.
Makes 5 cups.
recipes.text: Strawberry Yogurt Dip. Combine Cool Whip and yogurt. Add strawberries. Mix well. Serve as a dip with fresh fruit. Makes 5 cups.

recipes.title: No Fail Pie Crust
directions: Mix flour, shortening and salt.
Beat egg; add water and vinegar.
Add to flour mixture.
Work into ball.
recipes.text: No Fail Pie Crust. Mix flour, shortening and salt. Beat egg; add water and vinegar. Add to flour mixture. Work into ball.

recipes.title: Herb Cream Cheese Dip(For Fresh Vegetables)
directions: Mix all ingredients and chill.
This is a small recipe and should be doubled if you're expecting company.
recipes.text: Herb Cream Cheese Dip(For Fresh Vegetables). Mix all ingredients and chill. This is a small recipe and should be doubled if you're expecting company.

recipes.title: Sweet And Sour Meatballs
directions: Combine beef, oats, milk, onion, pepper and salt; mix well. Shape into about 30 small meatballs. Brown in melted (hot) shortening. Drain.
recipes.text: Sweet And Sour Meatballs. Combine beef, oats, milk, onion, pepper and salt; mix well. Shape into about 30 small meatballs. Brown in melted (hot) shortening. Drain.

recipes.title: Clam Casserole
directions: Mix together beaten egg, milk and juice from clams.
Place dry ingredients in greased loaf pan.
Pour milk mixture over dry ingredients.
Bake 40 to 50 minutes at 350°.
recipes.text: Clam Casserole. Mix together beaten egg, milk and juice from clams. Place dry ingredients in greased loaf pan. Pour milk mixture over dry ingredients. Bake 40 to 50 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Chicken Salad
directions: Combine all ingredients.
Moisten with mayonnaise.
Serve on lettuce and garnish with additional egg slices and olives.
recipes.text: Chicken Salad. Combine all ingredients. Moisten with mayonnaise. Serve on lettuce and garnish with additional egg slices and olives.

recipes.title: Chicken And Dumplings
ingredients: 1 pkg. flour tortillas, cut into squares
directions: Rinse chicken in cold water. Place in large pot with bay leaf over medium heat, covering chicken with water. Cook until the chicken falls apart. Remove from heat. Remove chicken from bone and chop. Remove bay leaf. Add water to pot. Add onion and 1 teaspoon salt. Sprinkle with black pepper. When chicken starts boiling, slowly place tortilla squares until done.
recipes.text: Chicken And Dumplings. Rinse chicken in cold water. Place in large pot with bay leaf over medium heat, covering chicken with water. Cook until the chicken falls apart. Remove from heat. Remove chicken from bone and chop. Remove bay leaf. Add water to pot. Add onion and 1 teaspoon salt. Sprinkle with black pepper. When chicken starts boiling, slowly place tortilla squares until done.

recipes.title: Low-Fat Chicken Salad
directions: Boil chicken in large pot to disperse fat.
Place whole pot in refrigerator overnight.
The fat will congeal and can be removed with a kitchen knife or spatula.
Remove meat from the bones; cut into 1-inch pieces.
Place in bowl with about 3 tablespoons of nonfat mayonnaise and celery; mix with spices.
recipes.text: Low-Fat Chicken Salad. Boil chicken in large pot to disperse fat. Place whole pot in refrigerator overnight. The fat will congeal and can be removed with a kitchen knife or spatula. Remove meat from the bones; cut into 1-inch pieces. Place in bowl with about 3 tablespoons of nonfat mayonnaise and celery; mix with spices.

recipes.title: Spaghetti Salad
ingredients: 1 (8 oz.) spaghetti, long and broken in 2-inch pieces
Tabasco, salt, pepper and red pepper to taste
directions: Cook spaghetti; while warm, cut in cheese.
Chop onion fine, celery and pepper, pimento and tomato; add to spaghetti, then seasoning to taste.
recipes.text: Spaghetti Salad. Cook spaghetti; while warm, cut in cheese. Chop onion fine, celery and pepper, pimento and tomato; add to spaghetti, then seasoning to taste.

recipes.title: Baked Apple Pudding
directions: Combine margarine, sugar and egg in mixer; beat until light. Gradually blend in combined flour, baking soda, salt, nutmeg and cinnamon.
Stir in vanilla, apples and walnuts.
Turn mixture into an ungreased 8-inch square baking pan.
Bake at 350° for 35 minutes or until done.
Serve warm or with Cool Whip.
Makes 8 to 10 servings.
recipes.text: Baked Apple Pudding. Combine margarine, sugar and egg in mixer; beat until light. Gradually blend in combined flour, baking soda, salt, nutmeg and cinnamon. Stir in vanilla, apples and walnuts. Turn mixture into an ungreased 8-inch square baking pan. Bake at 350° for 35 minutes or until done. Serve warm or with Cool Whip. Makes 8 to 10 servings.

recipes.title: Butterscotch Morsels
directions: Melt butterscotch in double boiler.
Then stir in peanut and noodles.
Drop by teaspoonfuls onto wax paper and let harden (about 45 minutes).
recipes.text: Butterscotch Morsels. Melt butterscotch in double boiler. Then stir in peanut and noodles. Drop by teaspoonfuls onto wax paper and let harden (about 45 minutes).

recipes.title: "Surprise" Sugar Cookies
directions: Mix up in a big bowl.
Make them into cookies.
Mash them in the pan.
Put stuff on top of them.
Put them in the oven.
Eat them.
I like them.
recipes.text: "Surprise" Sugar Cookies. Mix up in a big bowl. Make them into cookies. Mash them in the pan. Put stuff on top of them. Put them in the oven. Eat them. I like them.

recipes.title: Fresh Strawberry Pie
directions: Mix sugar, cornstarch and salt in medium saucepan.
Slowly stir in water and 2 cups strawberries.
Cook over low heat stirring constantly and mashing berries until mixture thickens and boils 3 minutes.
Remove from heat and cool slightly.
recipes.text: Fresh Strawberry Pie. Mix sugar, cornstarch and salt in medium saucepan. Slowly stir in water and 2 cups strawberries. Cook over low heat stirring constantly and mashing berries until mixture thickens and boils 3 minutes. Remove from heat and cool slightly.

recipes.title: Summer Asparagus Salad
directions: Bring water to boil.
Add celery and asparagus. Wait 5 minutes.
Quickly put celery and asparagus in ice bath, then add remaining ingredients and serve.
recipes.text: Summer Asparagus Salad. Bring water to boil. Add celery and asparagus. Wait 5 minutes. Quickly put celery and asparagus in ice bath, then add remaining ingredients and serve.

recipes.title: Molded Corned Beef Salad
directions: Dissolve gelatin in hot water.
When cool, mix in other ingredients.
Pour into mold and chill.
Arrange with lettuce on plate.
recipes.text: Molded Corned Beef Salad. Dissolve gelatin in hot water. When cool, mix in other ingredients. Pour into mold and chill. Arrange with lettuce on plate.

recipes.title: Chicken Corn Soup
ingredients: 3 1/2 lb. whole chicken, cut into pieces
2 c. corn, cut from the cob
directions: Cover chicken with water; add salt and saffron.
Boil; simmer, covered, until tender, about 2 hours.
recipes.text: Chicken Corn Soup. Cover chicken with water; add salt and saffron. Boil; simmer, covered, until tender, about 2 hours.

recipes.title: *Shrimp Mold
ingredients: 1 lb. fresh, cooked and chopped shrimp
directions: Heat can of undiluted soup.
Dissolve gelatin in cold water. Add gelatin mixture to soup.
Add cheese and blend well with wire whisk.
Add vegetables and shrimp and mix well.
Pour into well-greased mold or pan.
Refrigerate for 8 hours.
recipes.text: *Shrimp Mold. Heat can of undiluted soup. Dissolve gelatin in cold water. Add gelatin mixture to soup. Add cheese and blend well with wire whisk. Add vegetables and shrimp and mix well. Pour into well-greased mold or pan. Refrigerate for 8 hours.

recipes.title: Mushroom And Cheddar Soup
directions: Melt butter in saucepan.
Add onion and garlic.
Cook 2 to 3 minutes. Add mushrooms. Cook over high heat until browned and liquid has evaporated. Sprinkle flour over mushrooms.
Cook until flour is lightly browned.
Add stock and milk.
Bring to a boil. Add salt and pepper. Reduce heat, cover and simmer 15 minutes. Puree soup. Return to pot.
Add Cheddar. Cook gently until cheese has just melted.
Serve, sprinkled with parsley and cheese.
recipes.text: Mushroom And Cheddar Soup. Melt butter in saucepan. Add onion and garlic. Cook 2 to 3 minutes. Add mushrooms. Cook over high heat until browned and liquid has evaporated. Sprinkle flour over mushrooms. Cook until flour is lightly browned. Add stock and milk. Bring to a boil. Add salt and pepper. Reduce heat, cover and simmer 15 minutes. Puree soup. Return to pot. Add Cheddar. Cook gently until cheese has just melted. Serve, sprinkled with parsley and cheese.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Bran Muffins
ingredients: 1 c. Raisin Bran cereal or 1 c. shredded bran flake cereal
directions: Spray 12 muffin cups with a nonfat cooking spray.
In a medium bowl, combine flour, sugar, baking powder, baking soda, salt and cinnamon.
In a
large bowl, using a wire whisk, beat Egg Beaters. Stir in pumpkin, cereal, milk and corn syrup.
Add to flour mixture. Stir until well blended.
Spoon into prepared muffin cups. Bake at 400° for 18 to 20 minutes. Cool in pan 5 minutes. Yields 12 muffins.
recipes.text: Pumpkin Bran Muffins. Spray 12 muffin cups with a nonfat cooking spray. In a medium bowl, combine flour, sugar, baking powder, baking soda, salt and cinnamon. In a large bowl, using a wire whisk, beat Egg Beaters. Stir in pumpkin, cereal, milk and corn syrup. Add to flour mixture. Stir until well blended. Spoon into prepared muffin cups. Bake at 400° for 18 to 20 minutes. Cool in pan 5 minutes. Yields 12 muffins.

recipes.title: Southern Fried Chicken
directions: Wash and cut up chicken into service size pieces.
Remove all excess fat and skin.
Put flour, salt and pepper in plastic bag. Dip chicken in buttermilk and put in bag with flour.
Shake bag until chicken is coated well.
Heat oil in large skillet.
Shake off excess flour from chicken and put in hot oil to fry.
Cook chicken over medium heat 15 to 20 minutes, turning as needed until light brown.
Reduce heat, cover tightly and cook 30 to 40 minutes or until thickest pieces are fork tender.
Turn chicken once or twice to assure even cooking.
Remove cover for last 5 minutes of cooking to crisp chicken.
Remove from skillet and drain on paper towels before serving hot.
recipes.text: Southern Fried Chicken. Wash and cut up chicken into service size pieces. Remove all excess fat and skin. Put flour, salt and pepper in plastic bag. Dip chicken in buttermilk and put in bag with flour. Shake bag until chicken is coated well. Heat oil in large skillet. Shake off excess flour from chicken and put in hot oil to fry. Cook chicken over medium heat 15 to 20 minutes, turning as needed until light brown. Reduce heat, cover tightly and cook 30 to 40 minutes or until thickest pieces are fork tender. Turn chicken once or twice to assure even cooking. Remove cover for last 5 minutes of cooking to crisp chicken. Remove from skillet and drain on paper towels before serving hot.

recipes.title: Crumb-Coated Chicken
directions: In small bowl, beat together egg, butter and salt.
In shallow dish, place crumbs.
Coat chicken with crumbs, then egg mixture and crumbs again.
In 8-inch square dish, arrange chicken with meatiest pieces near edges of dish.
Cover with wax paper. Microwave at High 12 to 14 minutes.
Rotate dish 1/2 turn after half the cooking time.
Makes 2 to 3 servings.
recipes.text: Crumb-Coated Chicken. In small bowl, beat together egg, butter and salt. In shallow dish, place crumbs. Coat chicken with crumbs, then egg mixture and crumbs again. In 8-inch square dish, arrange chicken with meatiest pieces near edges of dish. Cover with wax paper. Microwave at High 12 to 14 minutes. Rotate dish 1/2 turn after half the cooking time. Makes 2 to 3 servings.

recipes.title: Dirt Cake
directions: Crush Oreos.
Blend butter and cream cheese.
Blend pudding and fold in Cool Whip.
Layer Oreos and pudding mix, beginning and ending with Oreos.
recipes.text: Dirt Cake. Crush Oreos. Blend butter and cream cheese. Blend pudding and fold in Cool Whip. Layer Oreos and pudding mix, beginning and ending with Oreos.

recipes.title: Cream Of Crab Soup
directions: Remove cartilage from crabmeat.
Melt butter in a large saucepan.
Blend in flour.
Stir until smooth.
Slowly stir in chicken broth and pepper.
Simmer 2 to 3 minutes.
Add half and half slowly, and then the milk, slowly.
Stir constantly until thick.
Do not let it boil.
Add crabmeat and salt.
Sprinkle Old Bay seasoning over soup after it has been put in bowl.
Serve hot.
recipes.text: Cream Of Crab Soup. Remove cartilage from crabmeat. Melt butter in a large saucepan. Blend in flour. Stir until smooth. Slowly stir in chicken broth and pepper. Simmer 2 to 3 minutes. Add half and half slowly, and then the milk, slowly. Stir constantly until thick. Do not let it boil. Add crabmeat and salt. Sprinkle Old Bay seasoning over soup after it has been put in bowl. Serve hot.

recipes.title: Crusty Beef Cheese And Noodle Casserole
ingredients: 6 1/4 oz. can meatless mushroom spaghetti sauce
1 1/2 lb. fine noodles, cooked and drained
directions: Heat oil. Add onion and cook until golden. Add meat and cook until meat loses its color. Add spaghetti sauce; simmer. Arrange in a large casserole dish (4 1/2-quart) half of the noodles, half of the sauce, half of the cheese.
Repeat layers. This can be prepared the night before. Cook for 1 hour at 325°.
recipes.text: Crusty Beef Cheese And Noodle Casserole. Heat oil. Add onion and cook until golden. Add meat and cook until meat loses its color. Add spaghetti sauce; simmer. Arrange in a large casserole dish (4 1/2-quart) half of the noodles, half of the sauce, half of the cheese. Repeat layers. This can be prepared the night before. Cook for 1 hour at 325°.

recipes.title: Sugar Cookies
ingredients: 1 c. milk (sweet, sour, buttermilk or canned)
nuts, raisins and chocolate chips if desired
directions: Cream or mix well, shortening, sugar, eggs and vanilla.
Add dry ingredients alternately with milk.
Mix well.
Drop on lightly greased cookie sheet.
Bake at 375° for 12 minutes.
These are a soft cookie.
recipes.text: Sugar Cookies. Cream or mix well, shortening, sugar, eggs and vanilla. Add dry ingredients alternately with milk. Mix well. Drop on lightly greased cookie sheet. Bake at 375° for 12 minutes. These are a soft cookie.

recipes.title: Finger Ham Biscuits
ingredients: thin sliced ham or ground ham
directions: Cook first four ingredients in saucepan 10 to 15 minutes, stirring well; baste on little finger dinner rolls that have been sliced in half horizontally.
Layer thin sliced ham (or ground ham), then Mozzarella cheese, more ham and more Mozzarella cheese; as many layers as you want.
Cook at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes.
recipes.text: Finger Ham Biscuits. Cook first four ingredients in saucepan 10 to 15 minutes, stirring well; baste on little finger dinner rolls that have been sliced in half horizontally. Layer thin sliced ham (or ground ham), then Mozzarella cheese, more ham and more Mozzarella cheese; as many layers as you want. Cook at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Wedding Cookies
directions: Mix margarine, flour and nuts.
Roll into 1-inch balls.
Put on ungreased cookie sheet.
Bake at 350° for 15 minutes.
While hot, roll gently in powdered sugar.
recipes.text: Wedding Cookies. Mix margarine, flour and nuts. Roll into 1-inch balls. Put on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 350° for 15 minutes. While hot, roll gently in powdered sugar.

recipes.title: Crab Cakes
directions: Saute first 6 ingredients until tender in the butter.
Combine rest of ingredients and add to sauteed mixture.
Shape into cakes. Roll in flour.
Brown quickly and cook 5 minutes.
recipes.text: Crab Cakes. Saute first 6 ingredients until tender in the butter. Combine rest of ingredients and add to sauteed mixture. Shape into cakes. Roll in flour. Brown quickly and cook 5 minutes.

recipes.title: Mocha
directions: Blend on high.
Mix 2 tablespoons or to taste in boiling water.
recipes.text: Mocha. Blend on high. Mix 2 tablespoons or to taste in boiling water.

recipes.title: Hot Spiced Cider
directions: Combine candies and cider.
Heat slowly, stirring, until candies have dissolved.
Hold at a simmer to serve.
A party percolator or stoneware slow cooker works well for both heating and serving.
recipes.text: Hot Spiced Cider. Combine candies and cider. Heat slowly, stirring, until candies have dissolved. Hold at a simmer to serve. A party percolator or stoneware slow cooker works well for both heating and serving.

recipes.title: Hot Mulled Cider
directions: Combine sugar and cider.
Tie spices in bag; slowly boil. Cover and simmer 20 minutes.
Remove spices.
Serve hot with cinnamon sticks.
recipes.text: Hot Mulled Cider. Combine sugar and cider. Tie spices in bag; slowly boil. Cover and simmer 20 minutes. Remove spices. Serve hot with cinnamon sticks.

recipes.title: Sweet-Sour Spareribs
directions: Blend cornstarch, vinegar and water in saucepan.
Add pineapple, sugar, catsup and soy sauce.
Cook, stirring constantly, until thickened.
Baste spareribs with sauce.
Bake at 350° for 1 to 1 1/2 hours, basting and turning several times.
recipes.text: Sweet-Sour Spareribs. Blend cornstarch, vinegar and water in saucepan. Add pineapple, sugar, catsup and soy sauce. Cook, stirring constantly, until thickened. Baste spareribs with sauce. Bake at 350° for 1 to 1 1/2 hours, basting and turning several times.

recipes.title: Easy Peach Cobbler
directions: Place peaches in an 8 x 12-inch or 10-inch square baking dish and sprinkle with lemon juice.
Combine flour, sugar, salt and egg until lumpy.
Spread this mixture over the peaches.
Pour melted butter over the top.
Bake at 375° for 30 to 35 minutes.
Makes 8 to 10 servings.
recipes.text: Easy Peach Cobbler. Place peaches in an 8 x 12-inch or 10-inch square baking dish and sprinkle with lemon juice. Combine flour, sugar, salt and egg until lumpy. Spread this mixture over the peaches. Pour melted butter over the top. Bake at 375° for 30 to 35 minutes. Makes 8 to 10 servings.

recipes.title: Christmas Morning Rolls
ingredients: 1 pkg. (24 frozen) Parker House dinner rolls
directions: Grease a tube (Bundt) pan.
Arrange rolls in pan.
Sprinkle dry pudding mix over top.
Cook butter, brown sugar and cinnamon over low heat until sugar is dissolved and mixture bubbles.
Pour over rolls.
Sprinkle chopped nuts over rolls.
Cover tightly with foil.
Place on cookie sheet and place on countertop overnight.
recipes.text: Christmas Morning Rolls. Grease a tube (Bundt) pan. Arrange rolls in pan. Sprinkle dry pudding mix over top. Cook butter, brown sugar and cinnamon over low heat until sugar is dissolved and mixture bubbles. Pour over rolls. Sprinkle chopped nuts over rolls. Cover tightly with foil. Place on cookie sheet and place on countertop overnight.

recipes.title: No-Knead Refrigerator Rolls
directions: Mix hot water, salt, sugar and shortening together.
Dissolve yeast in warm water (about 5 minutes).
Add 2 cups flour to water, sugar, shortening mixture.
Beat until smooth.
Add egg and dissolved yeast.
Beat until well blended.
Stir in remaining flour one cup at a time.
Place dough in greased bowl.
Brush top with soft shortening.
Cover tightly with foil or bowl cover. Store in refrigerator until double in bulk or until needed.
When ready to use, punch down and cut off dough.
Shape rolls, place cut side down, in pan.
Let rise until double in bulk.
Bake at 400° for 15 to 20 minutes.
Yield: 18 to 24 medium rolls.
Dough may be kept a week.
recipes.text: No-Knead Refrigerator Rolls. Mix hot water, salt, sugar and shortening together. Dissolve yeast in warm water (about 5 minutes). Add 2 cups flour to water, sugar, shortening mixture. Beat until smooth. Add egg and dissolved yeast. Beat until well blended. Stir in remaining flour one cup at a time. Place dough in greased bowl. Brush top with soft shortening. Cover tightly with foil or bowl cover. Store in refrigerator until double in bulk or until needed. When ready to use, punch down and cut off dough. Shape rolls, place cut side down, in pan. Let rise until double in bulk. Bake at 400° for 15 to 20 minutes. Yield: 18 to 24 medium rolls. Dough may be kept a week.

recipes.title: Sweet Potato Bread
directions: Mix sugar, potatoes, oil, eggs and vanilla.
Add remaining ingredients.
Put equal amounts into 4 greased 1 pound coffee cans.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Sweet Potato Bread. Mix sugar, potatoes, oil, eggs and vanilla. Add remaining ingredients. Put equal amounts into 4 greased 1 pound coffee cans. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Red Wine Chicken
directions: Mix everything together except chicken.
After browning chicken with flour, lay in roaster in sauce.
Cover and bake 1 hour at 400°.
Use gravy over noodles.
recipes.text: Red Wine Chicken. Mix everything together except chicken. After browning chicken with flour, lay in roaster in sauce. Cover and bake 1 hour at 400°. Use gravy over noodles.

recipes.title: Mock Maple Syrup
directions: Dissolve sugar in water in saucepan. Add salt. Boil 1 minute. Add vanilla and mix well. Serve warm.
recipes.text: Mock Maple Syrup. Dissolve sugar in water in saucepan. Add salt. Boil 1 minute. Add vanilla and mix well. Serve warm.

recipes.title: Earthquake Cake
directions: Chop pecans and mix with coconut.
Spread in bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan.
recipes.text: Earthquake Cake. Chop pecans and mix with coconut. Spread in bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan.

recipes.title: King Ranch Chicken
ingredients: 1 frying chicken (or equivalent white meat), skin removed
directions: Mix onions, peppers, mushrooms, soups, chili powder and milk in large bowl.
In 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan, crush Doritos and place them in single layer on the bottom of pan.
Place chicken in single layer on top of Doritos.
Cover chicken with mixture in bowl.
Cover mixture with cheese and bake at 350° for 45 minutes.
recipes.text: King Ranch Chicken. Mix onions, peppers, mushrooms, soups, chili powder and milk in large bowl. In 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan, crush Doritos and place them in single layer on the bottom of pan. Place chicken in single layer on top of Doritos. Cover chicken with mixture in bowl. Cover mixture with cheese and bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Heavenly Hash
directions: Blend cream cheese and mayonnaise.
Add cherries, pineapple and marshmallows.
Whip the cream and add last.
Put in container and freeze.
(Can use ice trays.)
recipes.text: Heavenly Hash. Blend cream cheese and mayonnaise. Add cherries, pineapple and marshmallows. Whip the cream and add last. Put in container and freeze. (Can use ice trays.)

recipes.title: Base Frosting
directions: Mix powdered sugar, butter, milk and vanilla in a large bowl. Beat with mixer.
Add more milk 1 teaspoon at a time.
Should be thin.
recipes.text: Base Frosting. Mix powdered sugar, butter, milk and vanilla in a large bowl. Beat with mixer. Add more milk 1 teaspoon at a time. Should be thin.

recipes.title: Chicken Casserole
ingredients: 1 can cream of mushroom or cream of chicken soup
directions: Grease a large Pyrex dish.
Pour in rice.
Dilute soup with 1 can water.
Pour over rice.
Sprinkle onion soup mix over rice and soup.
Salt to taste.
Brown chicken in butter.
Place on top of mixture.
Cover with foil.
Bake at 300° for 1 1/2 hours.
recipes.text: Chicken Casserole. Grease a large Pyrex dish. Pour in rice. Dilute soup with 1 can water. Pour over rice. Sprinkle onion soup mix over rice and soup. Salt to taste. Brown chicken in butter. Place on top of mixture. Cover with foil. Bake at 300° for 1 1/2 hours.

recipes.title: Chocolate Delights
ingredients: 1 c.chopped nuts or 1/2 c. white chocolate chips
directions: Mix first 4 ingredients well and place in a well greased, medium size cookie sheet, spreading thin.
Bake at 325° for 20 to 25 minutes.
While cookie is baking, melt chocolate chips.
As soon as dough is baked and removed from oven, spread chocolate on top.
Sprinkle with chopped nuts or white chocolate chips.
Cut into squares after cookie has cooled.
recipes.text: Chocolate Delights. Mix first 4 ingredients well and place in a well greased, medium size cookie sheet, spreading thin. Bake at 325° for 20 to 25 minutes. While cookie is baking, melt chocolate chips. As soon as dough is baked and removed from oven, spread chocolate on top. Sprinkle with chopped nuts or white chocolate chips. Cut into squares after cookie has cooled.

recipes.title: Forgotten Cookies
directions: Beat whites until stiff.
Add salt, sugar and vanilla.
Fold in chocolate chips and nuts.
Spoon onto cookie sheet covered with brown paper.
Bake at 375° for 1 minute.
Turn oven off.
Leave in oven 1 hour or overnight.
Do not open oven until finished.
recipes.text: Forgotten Cookies. Beat whites until stiff. Add salt, sugar and vanilla. Fold in chocolate chips and nuts. Spoon onto cookie sheet covered with brown paper. Bake at 375° for 1 minute. Turn oven off. Leave in oven 1 hour or overnight. Do not open oven until finished.

recipes.title: Best-Ever Crab Cakes
directions: Carefully pick over crab meat, removing all shells.
In a large mixing bowl, combine all ingredients.
Form into cakes and brown in butter until golden and crispy.
recipes.text: Best-Ever Crab Cakes. Carefully pick over crab meat, removing all shells. In a large mixing bowl, combine all ingredients. Form into cakes and brown in butter until golden and crispy.

recipes.title: Quick Chicken Casserole
directions: Boil chicken until done.
Then cut up into small pieces. Place half of the chicken in the bottom of casserole dish.
Then pour cream of mushroom soup over chicken.
Then
place remaining chicken in dish and cover with cream of chicken soup.
Crush Ritz crackers and sprinkle on top and drizzle with butter.
recipes.text: Quick Chicken Casserole. Boil chicken until done. Then cut up into small pieces. Place half of the chicken in the bottom of casserole dish. Then pour cream of mushroom soup over chicken. Then place remaining chicken in dish and cover with cream of chicken soup. Crush Ritz crackers and sprinkle on top and drizzle with butter.

recipes.title: Crispy Caramel Corn
directions: Measure the brown sugar, margarine, corn syrup and salt into saucepan.
Bring to a boil and boil 5 minutes.
Remove from heat and stir in the vanilla and baking soda.
Pour mixture over freshly popped corn and peanuts.
Mix well and turn out on cookie sheets or cake pans.
Place in 250° oven for 1 hour.
Stir occasionally while in oven.
When corn is removed from oven and cooled enough to handle, the kernels can easily be separated and stored in tightly covered containers.
recipes.text: Crispy Caramel Corn. Measure the brown sugar, margarine, corn syrup and salt into saucepan. Bring to a boil and boil 5 minutes. Remove from heat and stir in the vanilla and baking soda. Pour mixture over freshly popped corn and peanuts. Mix well and turn out on cookie sheets or cake pans. Place in 250° oven for 1 hour. Stir occasionally while in oven. When corn is removed from oven and cooled enough to handle, the kernels can easily be separated and stored in tightly covered containers.

recipes.title: Pudding Candy
ingredients: 1 small pkg. pudding (not instant; any flavor)
directions: Combine pudding mix, evaporated milk and sugar and bring to a boil for 5 minutes.
Stir in nuts and butter.
Let stand 10 minutes.
Stir until thick.
Drop by teaspoon on wax paper.
recipes.text: Pudding Candy. Combine pudding mix, evaporated milk and sugar and bring to a boil for 5 minutes. Stir in nuts and butter. Let stand 10 minutes. Stir until thick. Drop by teaspoon on wax paper.

recipes.title: Southern Fried Chicken
directions: Wash chicken breast.
Mix egg and seasonings.
Beat well and soak chicken for 2 to 3 hours in refrigerator.
Drain and roll chicken in flour and fry in hot grease.
Makes a crispy, delicious fried chicken.
recipes.text: Southern Fried Chicken. Wash chicken breast. Mix egg and seasonings. Beat well and soak chicken for 2 to 3 hours in refrigerator. Drain and roll chicken in flour and fry in hot grease. Makes a crispy, delicious fried chicken.

recipes.title: Cinnamon Ornaments(Makes 18 To 25 Small To Medium Ornaments)
directions: Combine spices blending well.
Stir in applesauce and mix well.
Mixture will be stiff.
Roll out to 1/4-inch thickness. Using small to medium cutters, cut dough into desired shapes.
Let ornaments dry 4 to 5 days.
recipes.text: Cinnamon Ornaments(Makes 18 To 25 Small To Medium Ornaments). Combine spices blending well. Stir in applesauce and mix well. Mixture will be stiff. Roll out to 1/4-inch thickness. Using small to medium cutters, cut dough into desired shapes. Let ornaments dry 4 to 5 days.

recipes.title: Cocktail Sandwiches
ingredients: 2 Tbsp. finely chopped small green onions
1 or 2 bunches fresh parsley, chopped fine
directions: Cut white bread in a circle using a doughnut cutter or a small glass.
Mix mayonnaise and onions and spread evenly on circles. Put two circles together to form a sandwich.
Spread outside edge with mayonnaise and roll edges in the parsley.
Makes 22 sandwiches.
recipes.text: Cocktail Sandwiches. Cut white bread in a circle using a doughnut cutter or a small glass. Mix mayonnaise and onions and spread evenly on circles. Put two circles together to form a sandwich. Spread outside edge with mayonnaise and roll edges in the parsley. Makes 22 sandwiches.

recipes.title: Chocolate Pecan Pie
directions: Prepare pastry shell; set aside.
Preheat oven to 325°.
In a medium saucepan, low heat, melt butter.
Add cocoa and stir until smooth.
Remove from heat; cool.
Stir in sugar, salt, slightly beaten eggs and corn syrup.
Blend well.
Stir in chopped nuts if desired and pour all into pie crust.
Place pecan halves on top. Bake 40 minutes.
Let cool and cover for 8 hours before serving.
recipes.text: Chocolate Pecan Pie. Prepare pastry shell; set aside. Preheat oven to 325°. In a medium saucepan, low heat, melt butter. Add cocoa and stir until smooth. Remove from heat; cool. Stir in sugar, salt, slightly beaten eggs and corn syrup. Blend well. Stir in chopped nuts if desired and pour all into pie crust. Place pecan halves on top. Bake 40 minutes. Let cool and cover for 8 hours before serving.

recipes.title: Banana Bread
directions: Beat egg, sugar, butter, bananas and vanilla until smooth. Sift flour and baking soda together.
Blend into banana mixture. Stir in nuts and dates.
Pour into greased and floured 9 x 5-inch loaf pan.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour and 15 minutes.
recipes.text: Banana Bread. Beat egg, sugar, butter, bananas and vanilla until smooth. Sift flour and baking soda together. Blend into banana mixture. Stir in nuts and dates. Pour into greased and floured 9 x 5-inch loaf pan. Bake at 350° for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Southern Scripture Cake
directions: Mix all together.
Bake in 300° oven about 2 1/2 hours.
recipes.text: Southern Scripture Cake. Mix all together. Bake in 300° oven about 2 1/2 hours.

recipes.title: Strawberry Sour Cream Salad
directions: Dissolve Jell-O in boiling water.
Add strawberries and sliced bananas with the drained pineapple.
Finally, add the chopped walnuts.
recipes.text: Strawberry Sour Cream Salad. Dissolve Jell-O in boiling water. Add strawberries and sliced bananas with the drained pineapple. Finally, add the chopped walnuts.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Pie
directions: Pour into unbaked pie shell and bake at 425° for approximately 20 minutes or until done.
recipes.text: Pumpkin Pie. Pour into unbaked pie shell and bake at 425° for approximately 20 minutes or until done.

recipes.title: Appetizer Chicken Wings
directions: Marinate wings in sauce (made by mixing balance of ingredients) at least 1 hour in glass bowl. Bake, uncovered, in liquid until it disappears and wings are brown at 350° (about 1 1/2 hours).
recipes.text: Appetizer Chicken Wings. Marinate wings in sauce (made by mixing balance of ingredients) at least 1 hour in glass bowl. Bake, uncovered, in liquid until it disappears and wings are brown at 350° (about 1 1/2 hours).

recipes.title: Chess Pie
directions: Cream sugar and butter.
Add eggs and milk and beat well.
Add the flour, cornmeal, lemon juice and grated rind.
Pour mixture into two pastry-lined pie plates and bake at 350° for about 30 minutes or until crust and filling are done.
This makes 2 pies.
recipes.text: Chess Pie. Cream sugar and butter. Add eggs and milk and beat well. Add the flour, cornmeal, lemon juice and grated rind. Pour mixture into two pastry-lined pie plates and bake at 350° for about 30 minutes or until crust and filling are done. This makes 2 pies.

recipes.title: Hash Brown Casserole
directions: Mix and bake at 350° for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Hash Brown Casserole. Mix and bake at 350° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Fruit Fritters
directions: Separate egg yolks from egg whites and beat the whites until stiff.
Add first 5 ingredients to the egg yolks in order.
Beat until smooth.
Fold egg whites into batter.
Cover with plastic wrap.
Dust fruit with flour and dip into batter.
Fry in an inch of hot oil about 5 minutes.
Remove from oil.
Dust with powdered sugar.
recipes.text: Fruit Fritters. Separate egg yolks from egg whites and beat the whites until stiff. Add first 5 ingredients to the egg yolks in order. Beat until smooth. Fold egg whites into batter. Cover with plastic wrap. Dust fruit with flour and dip into batter. Fry in an inch of hot oil about 5 minutes. Remove from oil. Dust with powdered sugar.

recipes.title: Hot Chicken Salad
directions: Heat oven to 450°.
Combine all ingredients except cheese and potato chips.
Put in baking dish; sprinkle with cheese and cover with crushed chips.
Bake for 15 minutes.
recipes.text: Hot Chicken Salad. Heat oven to 450°. Combine all ingredients except cheese and potato chips. Put in baking dish; sprinkle with cheese and cover with crushed chips. Bake for 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Crab Canapes
ingredients: 1 (6 1/2 oz.) can crabmeat, drained and flaked
directions: Cut 4 rounds from each slice of buttered bread with a small cookie cutter or glass.
(Plastic medicine cup is ideal.)
Place rounds on a cookie sheet and bake in a 400° oven for about 6 minutes; cool.
May store in a plastic bag, sealed.
Combine crab, cheese, ketchup, onion and lemon juice.
Mix well and chill.
Just before serving, spread crab mixture on each toasted round and place on a serving tray.
recipes.text: Crab Canapes. Cut 4 rounds from each slice of buttered bread with a small cookie cutter or glass. (Plastic medicine cup is ideal.) Place rounds on a cookie sheet and bake in a 400° oven for about 6 minutes; cool. May store in a plastic bag, sealed. Combine crab, cheese, ketchup, onion and lemon juice. Mix well and chill. Just before serving, spread crab mixture on each toasted round and place on a serving tray.

recipes.title: Lemon Chess Pie
directions: In small bowl, mix sugar, flour and cornmeal.
In large bowl, beat eggs, butter, milk, lemon juice, rind and salt.
Add dry ingredients and beat until smooth.
Pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake at 375° for 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Lemon Chess Pie. In small bowl, mix sugar, flour and cornmeal. In large bowl, beat eggs, butter, milk, lemon juice, rind and salt. Add dry ingredients and beat until smooth. Pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake at 375° for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Parmesan Chicken Wings
ingredients: 3 to 4 lb. chicken wings, cut up
directions: Dip chicken wings in butter then in combined dry ingredients. Put on foil-lined cookie sheet.
Bake at 350° for about 45 to 50 minutes.
Yum!
recipes.text: Parmesan Chicken Wings. Dip chicken wings in butter then in combined dry ingredients. Put on foil-lined cookie sheet. Bake at 350° for about 45 to 50 minutes. Yum!

recipes.title: Rice-A-Roni Salad
ingredients: 1 pkg. Rice-a-Roni with almonds, cooked and cooled
1 small jar marinated artichoke hearts, chopped
directions: Combine all ingredients and cool in refrigerator overnight.
recipes.text: Rice-A-Roni Salad. Combine all ingredients and cool in refrigerator overnight.

recipes.title: Family Meat Loaf
ingredients: 1 c. fortified oat flakes, slightly crushed
directions: Combine cereal, beef, celery, egg, onion, salt and pepper.
Add 1/2 cup tomato sauce; mix well.
Put in baking dish; bake 30 minutes.
Top with remaining tomato sauce and bake 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Family Meat Loaf. Combine cereal, beef, celery, egg, onion, salt and pepper. Add 1/2 cup tomato sauce; mix well. Put in baking dish; bake 30 minutes. Top with remaining tomato sauce and bake 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Broccoli Salad
directions: Cook broccoli and cut into bite-size pieces.
Pour oil over broccoli, green beans and onion.
Mix and let stand overnight.
recipes.text: Broccoli Salad. Cook broccoli and cut into bite-size pieces. Pour oil over broccoli, green beans and onion. Mix and let stand overnight.

recipes.title: Impossible Pie
directions: Beat altogether for 2 minutes.
Pour into 9-inch (greased) pie plate.
Bake at 350° for 55 minutes.
Do not open until done!
recipes.text: Impossible Pie. Beat altogether for 2 minutes. Pour into 9-inch (greased) pie plate. Bake at 350° for 55 minutes. Do not open until done!

recipes.title: Vegetarian Black Bean Chili
directions: Sort and clean beans.
Soak beans overnight.
Drain, cover with few inches fresh water.
Bring to boil with bay leaf.
Cook until beans are done.
Heat oil in large skillet; saute onion until soft.
Add cumin, cayenne pepper, coriander, garlic, salt and chili pepper.
Cook 5 minutes, add tomatoes in juice.
Simmer 15 minutes.
Add beans.
Season to taste with vinegar, brown sugar and cilantro.
Serve with grated cheese or sour cream.
recipes.text: Vegetarian Black Bean Chili. Sort and clean beans. Soak beans overnight. Drain, cover with few inches fresh water. Bring to boil with bay leaf. Cook until beans are done. Heat oil in large skillet; saute onion until soft. Add cumin, cayenne pepper, coriander, garlic, salt and chili pepper. Cook 5 minutes, add tomatoes in juice. Simmer 15 minutes. Add beans. Season to taste with vinegar, brown sugar and cilantro. Serve with grated cheese or sour cream.

recipes.title: Cajun Rice
directions: Over medium heat, cook rice, garlic and onion.
Cook ingredients in a medium skillet, until ingredients are lightly browned (must stir mixture).
Add 1 good dash of Tabasco sauce while browning.
Add remaining ingredients while stirring.
Bring to a full boil.
Place cover on top and remove from heat.
Let stand for 10 minutes.
recipes.text: Cajun Rice. Over medium heat, cook rice, garlic and onion. Cook ingredients in a medium skillet, until ingredients are lightly browned (must stir mixture). Add 1 good dash of Tabasco sauce while browning. Add remaining ingredients while stirring. Bring to a full boil. Place cover on top and remove from heat. Let stand for 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Angel Cookies
directions: Soak bread crumbs in condensed milk to which the extract and coloring have been added.
Add nuts.
Drop by spoonfuls onto greased cookie sheets.
Top each with a nut half; bake at 350° for 12 minutes.
recipes.text: Angel Cookies. Soak bread crumbs in condensed milk to which the extract and coloring have been added. Add nuts. Drop by spoonfuls onto greased cookie sheets. Top each with a nut half; bake at 350° for 12 minutes.

recipes.title: Egg Noodles
directions: Combine all ingredients.
Roll out as thin as you want.
Let stand for 20 minutes and cut into strips.
Drop in boiling broth for 10 minutes.
recipes.text: Egg Noodles. Combine all ingredients. Roll out as thin as you want. Let stand for 20 minutes and cut into strips. Drop in boiling broth for 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Sour Cream Lemon Pie
directions: Combine
sugar	and cornstarch in medium saucepan.
Add butter, lemon rind,
lemon	juice
and egg yolks.
Mix in milk and stir
constantly
over medium heat until thickened.
Cool. Fold in sour
cream
and fill crust.
Refrigerate at least one hour.
recipes.text: Sour Cream Lemon Pie. Combine sugar	and cornstarch in medium saucepan. Add butter, lemon rind, lemon	juice and egg yolks. Mix in milk and stir constantly over medium heat until thickened. Cool. Fold in sour cream and fill crust. Refrigerate at least one hour.

recipes.title: Brownies
ingredients: 2 sticks butter or oleo, melted (use 1 each)
directions: Melt butter in mixing bowl.
Stir in cocoa until dissolved. Add sugar and beaten eggs.
Mix well.
Sift together flour, salt and soda.
Add flour mixture to cocoa mixture.
Mix well and add vanilla and nuts.
Bake in 9 x 13-inch pan, greased and dusted with flour.
Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes.
recipes.text: Brownies. Melt butter in mixing bowl. Stir in cocoa until dissolved. Add sugar and beaten eggs. Mix well. Sift together flour, salt and soda. Add flour mixture to cocoa mixture. Mix well and add vanilla and nuts. Bake in 9 x 13-inch pan, greased and dusted with flour. Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Squash Pickle
directions: Combine squash and onions; sprinkle with enough salt to cover. Set 1 hour.
Drain off liquid.
Mix vinegar, sugar, seeds and pepper.
Bring to hard boil.
Add squash and onions.
Bring to boil again.
Put into sterilized jars and seal.
Makes 4 pints.
recipes.text: Squash Pickle. Combine squash and onions; sprinkle with enough salt to cover. Set 1 hour. Drain off liquid. Mix vinegar, sugar, seeds and pepper. Bring to hard boil. Add squash and onions. Bring to boil again. Put into sterilized jars and seal. Makes 4 pints.

recipes.title: Ham-And-Cheese Pie
directions: Unroll crescent rolls, separate into 8 triangles. Fit triangles into a 9-inch pie plate, pressing edges together to seal. Combine chopped ham and next 4 ingredients, spoon into pie plate. Cut remaining 3 triangles into thin strips; arrange over mixture. Bake on lower oven rack at 325 degrees for 1 hour. Let stand 5 minutes before serving.
recipes.text: Ham-And-Cheese Pie. Unroll crescent rolls, separate into 8 triangles. Fit triangles into a 9-inch pie plate, pressing edges together to seal. Combine chopped ham and next 4 ingredients, spoon into pie plate. Cut remaining 3 triangles into thin strips; arrange over mixture. Bake on lower oven rack at 325 degrees for 1 hour. Let stand 5 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Chicken And Broccoli Casserole
directions: Mix chicken broth that is thickened.
Combine the mayonnaise, lemon juice and cheese.
Pour mixture over chicken and rice.
Add bread crumbs on top.
Bake at 350° for 35 minutes.
recipes.text: Chicken And Broccoli Casserole. Mix chicken broth that is thickened. Combine the mayonnaise, lemon juice and cheese. Pour mixture over chicken and rice. Add bread crumbs on top. Bake at 350° for 35 minutes.

recipes.title: Soft Molasses Cookies
directions: In a large bowl, cream together butter, shortening and sugar until light and fluffy.
Beat in molasses and eggs; add flour and spices.
Roll into 1 1/2-inch balls.
Dip tops in sugar.
Place 2 1/2-inches apart on baking sheet.
Bake at 350° for 11 minutes. Do not overbake.
recipes.text: Soft Molasses Cookies. In a large bowl, cream together butter, shortening and sugar until light and fluffy. Beat in molasses and eggs; add flour and spices. Roll into 1 1/2-inch balls. Dip tops in sugar. Place 2 1/2-inches apart on baking sheet. Bake at 350° for 11 minutes. Do not overbake.

recipes.title: Lazy Tuna Casserole
directions: Prepare macaroni and cheese according to box.
Add tuna and mushroom soup; stir.
Top with grated cheese.
Bake at 375° until cheese is melted.
Can add 1 can sliced mushrooms.
recipes.text: Lazy Tuna Casserole. Prepare macaroni and cheese according to box. Add tuna and mushroom soup; stir. Top with grated cheese. Bake at 375° until cheese is melted. Can add 1 can sliced mushrooms.

recipes.title: Dutch-Oven Cobbler
directions: Line Dutch oven with foil.
Pour fruit on the bottom. Sprinkle cake mix on top of fruit.
Pour 7-Up on top of cake mix. Cover and cook over charcoals for approximately 1 hour.
While cooking, place 6 to 8 briquets
on the lid to cook the top.
Dab with ice cream or Cool Whip.
recipes.text: Dutch-Oven Cobbler. Line Dutch oven with foil. Pour fruit on the bottom. Sprinkle cake mix on top of fruit. Pour 7-Up on top of cake mix. Cover and cook over charcoals for approximately 1 hour. While cooking, place 6 to 8 briquets on the lid to cook the top. Dab with ice cream or Cool Whip.

recipes.title: Black Bottom Cupcakes
directions: Cream together cheese, egg, 1/3 cup sugar and 1/8 teaspoon salt.
Stir in chocolate chips.
Set aside.
Sift flour, sugar, cocoa, soda and 1/2 teaspoon salt.
Add water, oil, vinegar and vanilla.
Mix well.
Place second mixture on bottom of cupcake liners.
Drop large spoonful of cream cheese filling on top.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
Yield: 2 dozen.
recipes.text: Black Bottom Cupcakes. Cream together cheese, egg, 1/3 cup sugar and 1/8 teaspoon salt. Stir in chocolate chips. Set aside. Sift flour, sugar, cocoa, soda and 1/2 teaspoon salt. Add water, oil, vinegar and vanilla. Mix well. Place second mixture on bottom of cupcake liners. Drop large spoonful of cream cheese filling on top. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes. Yield: 2 dozen.

recipes.title: Spaghetti For Large Crowd
directions: In large kettle, saute onions, celery and peppers.
Add tomato paste, canned tomatoes, spaghetti sauce, bay leaves and garlic. Cook for 3 to 4 hours on simmer.
In another pan, brown the hamburger.
Add to sauce and simmer for 1 hour.
Serve over spaghetti noodles.
recipes.text: Spaghetti For Large Crowd. In large kettle, saute onions, celery and peppers. Add tomato paste, canned tomatoes, spaghetti sauce, bay leaves and garlic. Cook for 3 to 4 hours on simmer. In another pan, brown the hamburger. Add to sauce and simmer for 1 hour. Serve over spaghetti noodles.

recipes.title: Cream Cheese Pound Cake
directions: Cream margarine, sugar, cream cheese, and vanilla.
Add eggs one at a time alternating with flour and ending with flour.
Put in greased and floured tube pan.
Bake in cold oven set at 300° for 1 1/2 hours.
recipes.text: Cream Cheese Pound Cake. Cream margarine, sugar, cream cheese, and vanilla. Add eggs one at a time alternating with flour and ending with flour. Put in greased and floured tube pan. Bake in cold oven set at 300° for 1 1/2 hours.

recipes.title: Broccoli Casserole
directions: Mix all of the above ingredients together in a large bowl. Place mixture in a casserole dish and top with crushed Ritz crackers.
Dot with butter or margarine.
Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.
recipes.text: Broccoli Casserole. Mix all of the above ingredients together in a large bowl. Place mixture in a casserole dish and top with crushed Ritz crackers. Dot with butter or margarine. Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.

recipes.title: Chocolate Cream Cheese Cake
directions: Beat cream cheese.
Add egg and sugar; mix.
Add chocolate chips; stir and set aside.
recipes.text: Chocolate Cream Cheese Cake. Beat cream cheese. Add egg and sugar; mix. Add chocolate chips; stir and set aside.

recipes.title: Zucchini Quiche
ingredients: 1 c. milk or half and half
directions: Preheat oven to 400°.
Sprinkle salt on zucchini and let stand for 30 minutes.
Rinse, drain and set aside.
Saute onion and butter.
Add zucchini and flour.
Cook 1 minute.
Beat eggs and milk.
Add cheese, seasonings and zucchini mixture.
Pour in shell. Place in oven and reduce heat to 350°.
Bake 1 hour.
Let stand 15 minutes.
Serve with tossed salad.
Yum!
recipes.text: Zucchini Quiche. Preheat oven to 400°. Sprinkle salt on zucchini and let stand for 30 minutes. Rinse, drain and set aside. Saute onion and butter. Add zucchini and flour. Cook 1 minute. Beat eggs and milk. Add cheese, seasonings and zucchini mixture. Pour in shell. Place in oven and reduce heat to 350°. Bake 1 hour. Let stand 15 minutes. Serve with tossed salad. Yum!

recipes.title: Sawdust Salad
directions: First, dissolve box of lemon jello and box of orange jello in hot boiling water, then add cold water and bananas (chopped up). Add pineapple (drained) and add miniature marshmallows.
Second, cook until thickens, sugar, flour, egg and pineapple juice.
Let cool.
Spread over jello.
Third, mix Dream Whip and cream cheese; beat together and spread over mixture.
Cheese on top.
recipes.text: Sawdust Salad. First, dissolve box of lemon jello and box of orange jello in hot boiling water, then add cold water and bananas (chopped up). Add pineapple (drained) and add miniature marshmallows. Second, cook until thickens, sugar, flour, egg and pineapple juice. Let cool. Spread over jello. Third, mix Dream Whip and cream cheese; beat together and spread over mixture. Cheese on top.

recipes.title: Delicious Apple Cake
directions: Sift together dry ingredients (flour, baking powder and salt); set aside.
Mix eggs, 2 cups sugar, orange juice, vanilla and oil, then mix with dry ingredients.
Peel apples, cut into small pieces for inside of cake.
Add 1/2 cup sugar, nutmeg and cinnamon.
(Save some to sprinkle on top of cake when it is done.) Bake 1 hour at 300°.
recipes.text: Delicious Apple Cake. Sift together dry ingredients (flour, baking powder and salt); set aside. Mix eggs, 2 cups sugar, orange juice, vanilla and oil, then mix with dry ingredients. Peel apples, cut into small pieces for inside of cake. Add 1/2 cup sugar, nutmeg and cinnamon. (Save some to sprinkle on top of cake when it is done.) Bake 1 hour at 300°.

recipes.title: Country Cole Slaw
directions: Chop or shred cabbage.
Combine with onions and green pepper in large bowl.
Mix other ingredients and pour over cabbage.
Toss lightly.
Cover.
Chill 4 hours.
Makes 6 (3/4 cup) servings).
recipes.text: Country Cole Slaw. Chop or shred cabbage. Combine with onions and green pepper in large bowl. Mix other ingredients and pour over cabbage. Toss lightly. Cover. Chill 4 hours. Makes 6 (3/4 cup) servings).

recipes.title: Hamburger Stroganoff
ingredients: 1 can cream of mushroom or cream of chicken soup
directions: Chop onion small, place in frying pan (or large skillet) and add a little vegetable oil and brown.
Add ground beef and brown. Discard juices.
Put soup and sour cream in pan with ground beef and stir.
Let simmer about 5 minutes to warm and then use flour to thicken.
This Stroganoff should be thick almost like sauce.
Let simmer about another 5 minutes.
Serve over noodles with a side salad.
recipes.text: Hamburger Stroganoff. Chop onion small, place in frying pan (or large skillet) and add a little vegetable oil and brown. Add ground beef and brown. Discard juices. Put soup and sour cream in pan with ground beef and stir. Let simmer about 5 minutes to warm and then use flour to thicken. This Stroganoff should be thick almost like sauce. Let simmer about another 5 minutes. Serve over noodles with a side salad.

recipes.title: Baked Green Rice
directions: Combine all ingredients.
Pour into a greased 1-quart baking dish and bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
Makes 6 servings.
recipes.text: Baked Green Rice. Combine all ingredients. Pour into a greased 1-quart baking dish and bake at 350° for 30 minutes. Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Easy Chicken Casserole
ingredients: 3 chicken breasts, boiled, deboned and cut up
1 can cream of chicken soup or creamy chicken mushroom soup
directions: Place chicken in casserole dish.
Mix the milk and soup together and pour over the chicken.
Crush crackers and mix with melted margarine.
Put cracker mixture over top of chicken and bake at 350° for 20 minutes.
recipes.text: Easy Chicken Casserole. Place chicken in casserole dish. Mix the milk and soup together and pour over the chicken. Crush crackers and mix with melted margarine. Put cracker mixture over top of chicken and bake at 350° for 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Chicken Normandy
ingredients: 1 large pkg. Pepperidge Farm bread crumbs
1 can cream of celery or mushroom soup
directions: Mix together first 3 ingredients.
Place 1/2 of mixture in a greased casserole.
Combine chicken, mayonnaise, onion, celery and salt and put into casserole.
Put remainder of bread crumb mixture on top.
Beat eggs and milk together and pour over casserole. Cover and refrigerate overnight.
Take casserole out 1 hour before baking time and pour evenly on top the cream of celery or mushroom soup.
Bake, uncovered, 40 minutes at 325°.
Top with grated cheese and put back into oven for just a couple of minutes to melt.
recipes.text: Chicken Normandy. Mix together first 3 ingredients. Place 1/2 of mixture in a greased casserole. Combine chicken, mayonnaise, onion, celery and salt and put into casserole. Put remainder of bread crumb mixture on top. Beat eggs and milk together and pour over casserole. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Take casserole out 1 hour before baking time and pour evenly on top the cream of celery or mushroom soup. Bake, uncovered, 40 minutes at 325°. Top with grated cheese and put back into oven for just a couple of minutes to melt.

recipes.title: Diet Cookies
directions: Cream oleo.
Beat egg with orange juice, rind, sweetener and vanilla.
Add to oleo.
Reserve 1 tablespoon flour.
Sift the remaining flour with salt, baking powder and soda.
Add to egg mixture.
Add sour cream.
Mix reserved flour with the nuts and raisins.
Stir into batter.
Drop by tablespoon on greased cookie sheet.
Bake at 375° for 15 minutes.
recipes.text: Diet Cookies. Cream oleo. Beat egg with orange juice, rind, sweetener and vanilla. Add to oleo. Reserve 1 tablespoon flour. Sift the remaining flour with salt, baking powder and soda. Add to egg mixture. Add sour cream. Mix reserved flour with the nuts and raisins. Stir into batter. Drop by tablespoon on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 375° for 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Strawberry Slush
ingredients: 3 (.25) pkg. strawberry flavored unsweetened soft drink mix
directions: Combine all ingredients, stirring to dissolve sugar; freeze.
recipes.text: Strawberry Slush. Combine all ingredients, stirring to dissolve sugar; freeze.

recipes.title: Chicken Spectacular
ingredients: 3 c. cooked chicken, cut in bite size pieces
1 box Uncle Ben's long grain and wild rice, cooked
1 can water chestnuts, drained and diced
directions: Mix all ingredients together and place in greased casserole. Bake in preheated 325° oven for 35 to 40 minutes.
recipes.text: Chicken Spectacular. Mix all ingredients together and place in greased casserole. Bake in preheated 325° oven for 35 to 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Biscuits Supreme
directions: Sift dry ingredients together.
Cut in shortening until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
Add milk all at once and stir just until dough is mixed.
Roll out.
Cut with biscuit cutter. Place on cookie sheet.
Bake in hot oven at 450° for 10 to 12 minutes or until brown.
recipes.text: Biscuits Supreme. Sift dry ingredients together. Cut in shortening until mixture resembles coarse crumbs. Add milk all at once and stir just until dough is mixed. Roll out. Cut with biscuit cutter. Place on cookie sheet. Bake in hot oven at 450° for 10 to 12 minutes or until brown.

recipes.title: Caribbean Lamb Salad
ingredients: 1 lb. boneless sirloin of lamb, cooked and cut into 1-inch cubes
1 Tbsp. curry powder or to taste
directions: With long, sharp knife, halve pineapple lengthwise. (Pineapple shells will be used as bowls; handle carefully.)
Cut out core and discard.
Cut flesh into cubes or tidbits.
In a large bowl, combine lamb, pineapple, orzo, celery, raisins, cashews and scallions; mix well.
In small bowl, blend mayonnaise, mustard, curry and lemon juice.
Stir dressing into salad; toss to mix and coat.
Fill pineapple; sprinkle with coconut.
Makes 6 servings.
recipes.text: Caribbean Lamb Salad. With long, sharp knife, halve pineapple lengthwise. (Pineapple shells will be used as bowls; handle carefully.) Cut out core and discard. Cut flesh into cubes or tidbits. In a large bowl, combine lamb, pineapple, orzo, celery, raisins, cashews and scallions; mix well. In small bowl, blend mayonnaise, mustard, curry and lemon juice. Stir dressing into salad; toss to mix and coat. Fill pineapple; sprinkle with coconut. Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Hi Ho Meat Loaf
ingredients: 3 slices plain bread, broken into pieces
directions: Mix all ingredients and bake at 400° for 30 minutes, then turn oven down to 325° and bake 1 more hour.
recipes.text: Hi Ho Meat Loaf. Mix all ingredients and bake at 400° for 30 minutes, then turn oven down to 325° and bake 1 more hour.

recipes.title: Fluffy White Frosting
directions: Blend first 6 ingredients in top of double boiler.
Cook over rapidly boiling water, beating until mixture stands in peaks. Remove from heat.
Add vanilla and beat until thick enough to spread.
recipes.text: Fluffy White Frosting. Blend first 6 ingredients in top of double boiler. Cook over rapidly boiling water, beating until mixture stands in peaks. Remove from heat. Add vanilla and beat until thick enough to spread.

recipes.title: *Praline Pie
ingredients: 1 (3 1/4 oz.) pkg. Jell-O butterscotch pudding and pie filling
directions: Combine butter and sugar in a saucepan.
Cook and stir until sugar melts and mixture bubbles vigorously.
Remove from heat; stir in nuts.
Spread mixture over bottom of lightly baked (but not browned) pie shell.
Bake in a hot 425° oven for 5 minutes or until bubbly.
Remove from oven.
recipes.text: *Praline Pie. Combine butter and sugar in a saucepan. Cook and stir until sugar melts and mixture bubbles vigorously. Remove from heat; stir in nuts. Spread mixture over bottom of lightly baked (but not browned) pie shell. Bake in a hot 425° oven for 5 minutes or until bubbly. Remove from oven.

recipes.title: Fruit Cake
directions: Measure flour, soda, cinnamon, salt and sugar.
Sift all together.
Dice bananas, add to dry ingredients with oil, eggs, vanilla and pineapple with juice.
Stir to blend.
Do not beat. Bake in greased tube pan one hour and 20 minutes at 350 degrees.
recipes.text: Fruit Cake. Measure flour, soda, cinnamon, salt and sugar. Sift all together. Dice bananas, add to dry ingredients with oil, eggs, vanilla and pineapple with juice. Stir to blend. Do not beat. Bake in greased tube pan one hour and 20 minutes at 350 degrees.

recipes.title: Cereal Balls
directions: Melt first three ingredients in double boiler or microwave. Dip large marshmallows in mixture, then roll in Rice Krispies.
recipes.text: Cereal Balls. Melt first three ingredients in double boiler or microwave. Dip large marshmallows in mixture, then roll in Rice Krispies.

recipes.title: Pasta Salad
ingredients: 1 bottle Ken Steak House Italian marinade and dressing
directions: Cook pasta according to directions on package.
Run cool water over to chill.
Mix vegetables and pasta and refrigerate overnight.
Mix with dressing when ready to serve.
recipes.text: Pasta Salad. Cook pasta according to directions on package. Run cool water over to chill. Mix vegetables and pasta and refrigerate overnight. Mix with dressing when ready to serve.

recipes.title: French Chicken
directions: Salt and pepper chicken and put in roasting pan.
Cover with dressing.
Sprinkle soup over top and refrigerate overnight. Bake, covered, 2 hours at 300°, basting often.
recipes.text: French Chicken. Salt and pepper chicken and put in roasting pan. Cover with dressing. Sprinkle soup over top and refrigerate overnight. Bake, covered, 2 hours at 300°, basting often.

recipes.title: Chicken Dressing Casserole
directions: Boil chicken in 4 cups water, salt and pepper.
Save broth. Cut up cooled chicken.
Place chicken in bottom of casserole.
Mix 1 1/2 cups broth with soup.
Pour over chicken.
Mix 1 1/2 cups broth with croutons.
Put on top of chicken.
Bake 30 to 45 minutes at 350°.
recipes.text: Chicken Dressing Casserole. Boil chicken in 4 cups water, salt and pepper. Save broth. Cut up cooled chicken. Place chicken in bottom of casserole. Mix 1 1/2 cups broth with soup. Pour over chicken. Mix 1 1/2 cups broth with croutons. Put on top of chicken. Bake 30 to 45 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Crock-Pot Meatballs
directions: Prepare sauce first and put in crock-pot to simmer while preparing meatballs.
Turn crock-pot to high while preparing sauce.
Put all ingredients in pot; stir together well.
Leave simmering until meatballs are ready.
recipes.text: Crock-Pot Meatballs. Prepare sauce first and put in crock-pot to simmer while preparing meatballs. Turn crock-pot to high while preparing sauce. Put all ingredients in pot; stir together well. Leave simmering until meatballs are ready.

recipes.title: Shephard Pie
ingredients: 1 (10 oz.) pkg. frozen peas and carrots
directions: Brown ground beef and onion in skillet; salt.
Blend in gravy mix and water.
Add basil and vegetables.
Simmer 5 minutes.
Pour into 1 1/2-quart casserole.
Fold cheese into potatoes. Spoon in ring on top of casserole.
Bake at 450° for 15 minutes.
recipes.text: Shephard Pie. Brown ground beef and onion in skillet; salt. Blend in gravy mix and water. Add basil and vegetables. Simmer 5 minutes. Pour into 1 1/2-quart casserole. Fold cheese into potatoes. Spoon in ring on top of casserole. Bake at 450° for 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Coconut Pie
directions: Separate eggs, saving whites for meringue.
Beat egg yolks. Add sugar and cornstarch.
Mix with a little milk.
Then pour in rest of milk.
Cook over double boiler until thickened, stirring all the time.
Add vanilla and coconut.
Pour into baked pie shells.
recipes.text: Coconut Pie. Separate eggs, saving whites for meringue. Beat egg yolks. Add sugar and cornstarch. Mix with a little milk. Then pour in rest of milk. Cook over double boiler until thickened, stirring all the time. Add vanilla and coconut. Pour into baked pie shells.

recipes.title: Chicken Casserole *
ingredients: 1 pkg. frozen French-cut green beans or some canned beans
directions: Stew chicken with onion, garlic, salt and pepper to season. Butter casserole.
