Layer 2/3 cup dressing, half cooked frozen green beans, sliced almonds and chicken broken into large pieces.
Mix soup and milk and pour over layers.
Mix broth and melted oleo with 1 1/3 cups dressing mix and crumble over top of casserole.
Bake, uncovered, for 30 minutes at 375°.
Serves 8.
recipes.text: Chicken Casserole *. Stew chicken with onion, garlic, salt and pepper to season. Butter casserole. Layer 2/3 cup dressing, half cooked frozen green beans, sliced almonds and chicken broken into large pieces. Mix soup and milk and pour over layers. Mix broth and melted oleo with 1 1/3 cups dressing mix and crumble over top of casserole. Bake, uncovered, for 30 minutes at 375°. Serves 8.

recipes.title: Chocolate Chip Nut Cookies
ingredients: 1 c. butter (softened) or 1/2 c. Crisco shortening
directions: Mix butter, sugars and salt together; beat until fluffy.
Beat in eggs, one at a time.
Beat in vanilla.
Gradually stir in flour and baking soda.
Stir in chips and nuts.
Bake at 300° for 20 to 25 minutes or until brown.
recipes.text: Chocolate Chip Nut Cookies. Mix butter, sugars and salt together; beat until fluffy. Beat in eggs, one at a time. Beat in vanilla. Gradually stir in flour and baking soda. Stir in chips and nuts. Bake at 300° for 20 to 25 minutes or until brown.

recipes.title: Husband'S Delight
directions: Brown
ground
beef
and
drain
off
fat.
Add onions, tomato sauce
and
tomatoes.
Stir in pepper, salt and sugar. Simmer for 15 minutes.
Cook noodles;
drain and fold in sour cream
and cream cheese.
Stir into sauce mixture.
Pour into greased casserole dish and top with shredded cheese.
Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.
recipes.text: Husband'S Delight. Brown ground beef and drain off fat. Add onions, tomato sauce and tomatoes. Stir in pepper, salt and sugar. Simmer for 15 minutes. Cook noodles; drain and fold in sour cream and cream cheese. Stir into sauce mixture. Pour into greased casserole dish and top with shredded cheese. Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Southern Fried Chicken
directions: Salt and pepper chicken to taste.
Dip in buttermilk.
Roll in flour. For extra crusty chicken, repeat.
Fry in medium-hot oil just to brown, turning once.
Reduce heat and cook on medium-low heat for 10 minutes on each side or until juice runs clear.
Don't turn often to keep crust from coming off.
recipes.text: Southern Fried Chicken. Salt and pepper chicken to taste. Dip in buttermilk. Roll in flour. For extra crusty chicken, repeat. Fry in medium-hot oil just to brown, turning once. Reduce heat and cook on medium-low heat for 10 minutes on each side or until juice runs clear. Don't turn often to keep crust from coming off.

recipes.title: Vegetable Casserole
directions: Mix vegetables, soup, onion, water chestnuts and approximately 1/2 cup of cheese.
Place in greased large casserole dish. Sprinkle approximately 1 cup of grated cheese over vegetable layer.
Crush crackers and mix with 1 stick melted butter. Sprinkle over cheese layer.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Vegetable Casserole. Mix vegetables, soup, onion, water chestnuts and approximately 1/2 cup of cheese. Place in greased large casserole dish. Sprinkle approximately 1 cup of grated cheese over vegetable layer. Crush crackers and mix with 1 stick melted butter. Sprinkle over cheese layer. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Cheese Cake
directions: Beat together first four ingredients until very well mixed-several minutes.
Use electric mixer.
Pour into 7 or 8-inch round glass baking dish.
Bake in 350 oven for 30 minutes.
Leave oven on, set cake out to cool for 15 minutes.
Then mix 8 oz sour cream, 3 Tbsp sugar 1 1/2 tsp vanilla.
Pour over top of cake. Sprinkle with cinnamon, and put back in oven for 10 minutes.
Cool and then chill in refrigerator.
recipes.text: Cheese Cake. Beat together first four ingredients until very well mixed-several minutes. Use electric mixer. Pour into 7 or 8-inch round glass baking dish. Bake in 350 oven for 30 minutes. Leave oven on, set cake out to cool for 15 minutes. Then mix 8 oz sour cream, 3 Tbsp sugar 1 1/2 tsp vanilla. Pour over top of cake. Sprinkle with cinnamon, and put back in oven for 10 minutes. Cool and then chill in refrigerator.

recipes.title: Banana Nut Bread
directions: Cream together margarine and sugar.
Beat in eggs.
Sift together baking powder, baking soda, flour and salt.
Fold in with lemon juice and enough milk to make 3/4 cups.
Add bananas and black walnuts.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
Test with toothpick.
recipes.text: Banana Nut Bread. Cream together margarine and sugar. Beat in eggs. Sift together baking powder, baking soda, flour and salt. Fold in with lemon juice and enough milk to make 3/4 cups. Add bananas and black walnuts. Bake at 350° for 1 hour. Test with toothpick.

recipes.title: Venison Meatball Stroganoff
ingredients: salt, pepper and oregano to taste
directions: Mix the first 8 ingredients and form into balls.
Brown in hot fat.
Remove from skillet.
Put the onion in the skillet and saute. Add the mushrooms and enough flour to make a paste.
Stir, then add the bouillon, sour cream, catsup, Tabasco sauce, Worcestershire sauce and salt, pepper and oregano to taste.
Bring to a boil. Turn to simmer.
Add meatballs and simmer 1 hour.
recipes.text: Venison Meatball Stroganoff. Mix the first 8 ingredients and form into balls. Brown in hot fat. Remove from skillet. Put the onion in the skillet and saute. Add the mushrooms and enough flour to make a paste. Stir, then add the bouillon, sour cream, catsup, Tabasco sauce, Worcestershire sauce and salt, pepper and oregano to taste. Bring to a boil. Turn to simmer. Add meatballs and simmer 1 hour.

recipes.title: Fat-Free Brownies
directions: Mix all ingredients together.
Bake in a 350° oven for 20 minutes. Brownies should not be overcooked until dry, but should "glisten" on top after baking.
recipes.text: Fat-Free Brownies. Mix all ingredients together. Bake in a 350° oven for 20 minutes. Brownies should not be overcooked until dry, but should "glisten" on top after baking.

recipes.title: Brunswick Stew
ingredients: 2 cans corn (1 whole kernel and 1 cream-style)
directions: Cook pork roast in crock-pot overnight.
Remove meat from broth the next morning.
Place broth in separate bowl and refrigerate.
Tear meat in strips and remove fat.
When broth has completely cooled, skim fat from the top and pour remaining broth in with the meat.
Add remaining ingredients and simmer for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Brunswick Stew. Cook pork roast in crock-pot overnight. Remove meat from broth the next morning. Place broth in separate bowl and refrigerate. Tear meat in strips and remove fat. When broth has completely cooled, skim fat from the top and pour remaining broth in with the meat. Add remaining ingredients and simmer for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Potato Casserole
ingredients: 2 lb. frozen hash brown potatoes, slightly thawed
directions: Mix thawed hash browns, melted butter, salt, green pepper, chopped onion, cream of chicken soup and grated cheese.
Mix all together well; pour into a 9 x 13-inch pan.
recipes.text: Potato Casserole. Mix thawed hash browns, melted butter, salt, green pepper, chopped onion, cream of chicken soup and grated cheese. Mix all together well; pour into a 9 x 13-inch pan.

recipes.title: Crispy Cinnamon Baked Chicken
directions: Combine first 5 ingredients in a blender.
Preheat oven to 400°.
Dip chicken in buttermilk, then crumbs.
Place in greased pan.
Bake 30 minutes.
Makes 4 servings.
recipes.text: Crispy Cinnamon Baked Chicken. Combine first 5 ingredients in a blender. Preheat oven to 400°. Dip chicken in buttermilk, then crumbs. Place in greased pan. Bake 30 minutes. Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: Chicken Bog
directions: Wash chicken.
Cook chicken in covered pot approximately 1 hour.
Debone chicken.
Put back in pot.
Add salt and pepper. Add white and yellow rice.
Cook on medium high until rice dries out.
Cover; turn down on low heat for 10 minutes.
recipes.text: Chicken Bog. Wash chicken. Cook chicken in covered pot approximately 1 hour. Debone chicken. Put back in pot. Add salt and pepper. Add white and yellow rice. Cook on medium high until rice dries out. Cover; turn down on low heat for 10 minutes.

recipes.title: No Bake Chocolate Cookies
directions: Combine sugar, milk and cocoa; bring to a rolling boil.
Add remaining ingredients.
Drop by teaspoonful on cookie sheet or wax paper and let set until hard.
recipes.text: No Bake Chocolate Cookies. Combine sugar, milk and cocoa; bring to a rolling boil. Add remaining ingredients. Drop by teaspoonful on cookie sheet or wax paper and let set until hard.

recipes.title: Pecan Pie
directions: In large bowl, stir together first 5 ingredients until well blended.
Stir in nuts.
Pour in pie shell and bake 45 minutes at 325°.
recipes.text: Pecan Pie. In large bowl, stir together first 5 ingredients until well blended. Stir in nuts. Pour in pie shell and bake 45 minutes at 325°.

recipes.title: Peach Ice Cream
directions: In heavy pan, heat milk on low until hot, but not boiling. Stir in sugar and salt until dissolved. Gradually stir about a quarter of the hot mixture into the beaten eggs, mixing constantly.
Return all to the saucepan, stirring constantly. Continue to cook and stir for 10 to 12 minutes or until mixture coats the back of a metal spoon.
Remove from heat and cool. Chill for at least 2 hours or overnight.
In a large bowl, combine the cream, fruit, vanilla and almond extract.
Add the chilled milk mixture, stirring well.
Pour into a chilled freezer can of a 1 gallon ice cream freezer.
Freeze according to manufacturer's instructions.
recipes.text: Peach Ice Cream. In heavy pan, heat milk on low until hot, but not boiling. Stir in sugar and salt until dissolved. Gradually stir about a quarter of the hot mixture into the beaten eggs, mixing constantly. Return all to the saucepan, stirring constantly. Continue to cook and stir for 10 to 12 minutes or until mixture coats the back of a metal spoon. Remove from heat and cool. Chill for at least 2 hours or overnight. In a large bowl, combine the cream, fruit, vanilla and almond extract. Add the chilled milk mixture, stirring well. Pour into a chilled freezer can of a 1 gallon ice cream freezer. Freeze according to manufacturer's instructions.

recipes.title: Meat Loaf Pie
directions: Mix first 4 ingredients.
Bake meat loaf at 375° for 1/2 hour. Put mashed potatoes and cheese on meat loaf and bake until cheese is melted.
recipes.text: Meat Loaf Pie. Mix first 4 ingredients. Bake meat loaf at 375° for 1/2 hour. Put mashed potatoes and cheese on meat loaf and bake until cheese is melted.

recipes.title: Corn Casserole
directions: Mix the 2 cans of corn in a baking dish.
Add remaining ingredients, using only half of cheese.
Stir well and put other half of cheese on top.
Cook, uncovered, in preheated oven at 375° for 1 hour and 15 minutes.
recipes.text: Corn Casserole. Mix the 2 cans of corn in a baking dish. Add remaining ingredients, using only half of cheese. Stir well and put other half of cheese on top. Cook, uncovered, in preheated oven at 375° for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Jack-O-Lantern Bread
directions: Combine sugars, pumpkin, oil and eggs; beat until well blended.
Sift together the flour, soda, salt and spices.
Add and mix well.
Stir in raisins, nuts and water.
Bake in loaf pan at 350° for 65 minutes, or until done when tested.
recipes.text: Jack-O-Lantern Bread. Combine sugars, pumpkin, oil and eggs; beat until well blended. Sift together the flour, soda, salt and spices. Add and mix well. Stir in raisins, nuts and water. Bake in loaf pan at 350° for 65 minutes, or until done when tested.

recipes.title: Sauerkraut Casserole
ingredients: 6 strips crisp bacon, drained and crumbled
directions: Arrange kraut in greased baking dish.
Spread sugar over kraut.
Spread tomatoes over sugar.
Dot with butter.
Sprinkle with bacon crumbs on top.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
Let cool before serving.
recipes.text: Sauerkraut Casserole. Arrange kraut in greased baking dish. Spread sugar over kraut. Spread tomatoes over sugar. Dot with butter. Sprinkle with bacon crumbs on top. Bake at 350° for 1 hour. Let cool before serving.

recipes.title: Vegetable Cheese Casserole
directions: Preheat oven to 350. Place veggies in a 9 x 13 pan. Sprinkle with cubed Velveeta and pats of cold butter. Top with Ritz crackers and bake for 30 minutes or until veggies are tender.
recipes.text: Vegetable Cheese Casserole. Preheat oven to 350. Place veggies in a 9 x 13 pan. Sprinkle with cubed Velveeta and pats of cold butter. Top with Ritz crackers and bake for 30 minutes or until veggies are tender.

recipes.title: Sausage Rolls
directions: Brown and drain sausage.
Add cream cheese, stirring over low heat until melted and incorporated with the sausage.
The mixture will be rather bland looking.
Add hot sauce if desired.
(Note: We usually add fresh black pepper here as well.)
recipes.text: Sausage Rolls. Brown and drain sausage. Add cream cheese, stirring over low heat until melted and incorporated with the sausage. The mixture will be rather bland looking. Add hot sauce if desired. (Note: We usually add fresh black pepper here as well.)

recipes.title: Chocolate Cream Pie
ingredients: 2 c. milk (canned milk; use 1 c. milk and 1 c. water)
directions: Combine the ingredients and cook about 5 minutes until thick. Pour into a baked pie shell and top with meringue.
Bake until brown.
recipes.text: Chocolate Cream Pie. Combine the ingredients and cook about 5 minutes until thick. Pour into a baked pie shell and top with meringue. Bake until brown.

recipes.title: Fried Green Tomatoes
ingredients: green tomatoes (no yellow or orange spots)
directions: Slice tomatoes; dip in corn meal.
Put in skillet containing heated oil.
Fry until corn meal turns lightly brown.
Eat hot. Cook only what you can eat.
recipes.text: Fried Green Tomatoes. Slice tomatoes; dip in corn meal. Put in skillet containing heated oil. Fry until corn meal turns lightly brown. Eat hot. Cook only what you can eat.

recipes.title: Juicy Meat Loaf
directions: Combine all ingredients; mix thoroughly.
Shape firmly into loaf.
recipes.text: Juicy Meat Loaf. Combine all ingredients; mix thoroughly. Shape firmly into loaf.

recipes.title: Chicken Turnovers
directions: Cook onion and celery in butter until tender.
Stir in flour, gravy or cream, salt and chicken.
Roll out dough on lightly floured surface to about 1/8-inch thickness.
Cut dough into 4-inch squares.
Spoon chicken mixture onto 1/2 of each square and fold over to make triangles.
Press edges of dough together to seal.
Stick top with fork to let steam escape.
Bake in greased pan at 425° about 30 minutes until browned.
recipes.text: Chicken Turnovers. Cook onion and celery in butter until tender. Stir in flour, gravy or cream, salt and chicken. Roll out dough on lightly floured surface to about 1/8-inch thickness. Cut dough into 4-inch squares. Spoon chicken mixture onto 1/2 of each square and fold over to make triangles. Press edges of dough together to seal. Stick top with fork to let steam escape. Bake in greased pan at 425° about 30 minutes until browned.

recipes.title: 2 Step Chicken Broccoli Divan
ingredients: 1 (10 oz.) pkg. frozen broccoli spears, cooked and drained
directions: In shallow casserole, arrange broccoli.
Top with chicken. Combine soup and milk.
Pour over chicken.
Sprinkle with cheese. Combine oleo and bread crumbs; sprinkle with cheese.
Bake at 450° for 15 minutes or until hot.
Serves 4.
recipes.text: 2 Step Chicken Broccoli Divan. In shallow casserole, arrange broccoli. Top with chicken. Combine soup and milk. Pour over chicken. Sprinkle with cheese. Combine oleo and bread crumbs; sprinkle with cheese. Bake at 450° for 15 minutes or until hot. Serves 4.

recipes.title: Sunday Scrambled Eggs
ingredients: 3 Tbsp. canned chopped tomatoes and green chilies
Dash of hot sauce, to taste
directions: Fry onions.
Place in a bowl and mix in all other ingredients.
Beat mixture lightly enough to thoroughly mix.
In a frying pan, coated with cooking spray, heat to medium high and add the egg mixture.
Cook while stirring often to scramble and continue until the eggs attain a degree of dryness that you enjoy most.
Serve with buttered toast.
Bacon optional.
recipes.text: Sunday Scrambled Eggs. Fry onions. Place in a bowl and mix in all other ingredients. Beat mixture lightly enough to thoroughly mix. In a frying pan, coated with cooking spray, heat to medium high and add the egg mixture. Cook while stirring often to scramble and continue until the eggs attain a degree of dryness that you enjoy most. Serve with buttered toast. Bacon optional.

recipes.title: Pork Tenderloin In Tequila
directions: Heat oil and garlic in 10-inch skillet until hot.
Coat pork with mustard.
Cook pork over medium heat until brown.
Remove garlic.
Stir in remaining ingredients except parsley.
Heat to boiling; reduce heat.
Cover and simmer until pork is tender, about 30 minutes.
Sprinkle with parsley.
recipes.text: Pork Tenderloin In Tequila. Heat oil and garlic in 10-inch skillet until hot. Coat pork with mustard. Cook pork over medium heat until brown. Remove garlic. Stir in remaining ingredients except parsley. Heat to boiling; reduce heat. Cover and simmer until pork is tender, about 30 minutes. Sprinkle with parsley.

recipes.title: Bran Muffins
directions: Mix first 5 ingredients together.
Beat eggs; add oil and mix in dry ingredients.
Cook in muffin tin sprayed with Pam at 400° for 18 to 20 minutes.
recipes.text: Bran Muffins. Mix first 5 ingredients together. Beat eggs; add oil and mix in dry ingredients. Cook in muffin tin sprayed with Pam at 400° for 18 to 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Swedish Tea Ring
directions: Add shortening, sugar and salt to scalded milk.
When cooled to lukewarm, add yeast and half the flour and beat well.
Let rise until light in a warm, draft-free place.
Add egg and remaining flour.
Mix well and let rise.
Roll dough into oblong strip about 1/4-inch thick and 13 x 9 inches.
Spread with melted butter, brown sugar, nuts and raisins.
Roll up like a jelly roll and form into a ring on a greased baking sheet.
With scissors make cuts two-thirds of the way through ring at 2-inch intervals.
Turn each cut section on its side.
Cover and let rise until double in bulk.
Bake about 30 minutes in hot oven (375°).
Frost while hot with a thin icing made by combining the milk and confectioners sugar.
recipes.text: Swedish Tea Ring. Add shortening, sugar and salt to scalded milk. When cooled to lukewarm, add yeast and half the flour and beat well. Let rise until light in a warm, draft-free place. Add egg and remaining flour. Mix well and let rise. Roll dough into oblong strip about 1/4-inch thick and 13 x 9 inches. Spread with melted butter, brown sugar, nuts and raisins. Roll up like a jelly roll and form into a ring on a greased baking sheet. With scissors make cuts two-thirds of the way through ring at 2-inch intervals. Turn each cut section on its side. Cover and let rise until double in bulk. Bake about 30 minutes in hot oven (375°). Frost while hot with a thin icing made by combining the milk and confectioners sugar.

recipes.title: Breakfast Souffle
directions: Cook sausage; drain well.
Combine with other ingredients. Mix well.
Pour into 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan.
Refrigerate overnight. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Breakfast Souffle. Cook sausage; drain well. Combine with other ingredients. Mix well. Pour into 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Refrigerate overnight. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Taco Casserole
ingredients: 1 c. shredded Cheddar or Jack cheese
directions: Cook and stir ground beef until browned; drain.
Stir in chili beans, tomato sauce, taco sauce, chili powder and garlic.
Bring to a boil.
Arrange coarsely broken corn chips in 12 x 8 x 2-inch baking dish. Top with beef mixture; spread with sour cream.
Top with onion, tomato and cheese.
Bake, uncovered, at 350° until hot and bubbly, 25 to 30 minutes.
Arrange additional tortilla chips around edge of casserole.
Serve with garnishes of shredded lettuce and taco sauce, if desired.
Makes 16 servings.
recipes.text: Taco Casserole. Cook and stir ground beef until browned; drain. Stir in chili beans, tomato sauce, taco sauce, chili powder and garlic. Bring to a boil. Arrange coarsely broken corn chips in 12 x 8 x 2-inch baking dish. Top with beef mixture; spread with sour cream. Top with onion, tomato and cheese. Bake, uncovered, at 350° until hot and bubbly, 25 to 30 minutes. Arrange additional tortilla chips around edge of casserole. Serve with garnishes of shredded lettuce and taco sauce, if desired. Makes 16 servings.

recipes.title: Monkey Bread
ingredients: 1 small box pudding mix (vanilla or butterscotch)
directions: Spray bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan with Pam.
Sprinkle with nuts. Cut biscuits apart and roll in the cinnamon and sugar.
And put on nuts in pan.
recipes.text: Monkey Bread. Spray bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan with Pam. Sprinkle with nuts. Cut biscuits apart and roll in the cinnamon and sugar. And put on nuts in pan.

recipes.title: Chicken Crescent Squares
directions: Heat oven according to crescent roll package.
Mix cream cheese, 1 1/2 tablespoons butter and milk.
Add drained chicken and mix (salt and pepper to taste).
Unroll crescent rolls and break at perforations to form 4 squares (2 diamonds per square). Pinch perforations together.
Place chicken mixture on flattened roll.
Bring corners of rolls together; pinch to seal.
Melt remaining butter and drizzle over squares.
Sprinkle top with bread crumbs.
Bake as directed on crescent roll package (approximately 17 minutes).
recipes.text: Chicken Crescent Squares. Heat oven according to crescent roll package. Mix cream cheese, 1 1/2 tablespoons butter and milk. Add drained chicken and mix (salt and pepper to taste). Unroll crescent rolls and break at perforations to form 4 squares (2 diamonds per square). Pinch perforations together. Place chicken mixture on flattened roll. Bring corners of rolls together; pinch to seal. Melt remaining butter and drizzle over squares. Sprinkle top with bread crumbs. Bake as directed on crescent roll package (approximately 17 minutes).

recipes.title: Baked Beans(Fat-Free)
ingredients: 1 bottle ketchup or 1 can stewed tomatoes
directions: Soak beans overnight or use quick cook method on package. Drain off 1/2 the water after cooking.
Add remaining ingredients to cooked beans.
Put in a casserole dish and cover to bake.
Bake for 3 hours at 350°.
Let stand covered for 30 minutes before serving (to thicken sauce).
Serves 8 to 10.
recipes.text: Baked Beans(Fat-Free). Soak beans overnight or use quick cook method on package. Drain off 1/2 the water after cooking. Add remaining ingredients to cooked beans. Put in a casserole dish and cover to bake. Bake for 3 hours at 350°. Let stand covered for 30 minutes before serving (to thicken sauce). Serves 8 to 10.

recipes.title: Hamburger Casserole
directions: Rub butter around the inside of a 2 1/2-quart casserole dish. Crumble raw beef into dish, sprinkle rice and onion soup mix over meat.
Mix mushroom soup and water in small bowl, pour over the rice mixture.
Cover tightly with lid or foil.
Bake 1 hour at 350°.
Serve with green salad or baked potato.
recipes.text: Hamburger Casserole. Rub butter around the inside of a 2 1/2-quart casserole dish. Crumble raw beef into dish, sprinkle rice and onion soup mix over meat. Mix mushroom soup and water in small bowl, pour over the rice mixture. Cover tightly with lid or foil. Bake 1 hour at 350°. Serve with green salad or baked potato.

recipes.title: Apricot Barbecue Sauce(For "Sasha'S Favorite Meatballs")
directions: Mix all ingredients.
Bring to a boil.
recipes.text: Apricot Barbecue Sauce(For "Sasha'S Favorite Meatballs"). Mix all ingredients. Bring to a boil.

recipes.title: Broccoli Casserole
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup
directions: Mix together ingredients.
Bake for 45 to 60 minutes at 350°. Makes one casserole.
recipes.text: Broccoli Casserole. Mix together ingredients. Bake for 45 to 60 minutes at 350°. Makes one casserole.

recipes.title: Corn-Green Chile Casserole
ingredients: 1 large can chopped green chile peppers
directions: Saute onion and peppers slightly in butter.
Mix cornmeal with milk and mix into all ingredients.
Pour into buttered casserole and bake in preheated 350° oven about 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Corn-Green Chile Casserole. Saute onion and peppers slightly in butter. Mix cornmeal with milk and mix into all ingredients. Pour into buttered casserole and bake in preheated 350° oven about 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Dingbats
directions: Melt margarine, dates and sugar for 8 minutes in a saucepan. Add Rice Krispies and nuts.
Roll mixture into balls and dip in powdered sugar.
recipes.text: Dingbats. Melt margarine, dates and sugar for 8 minutes in a saucepan. Add Rice Krispies and nuts. Roll mixture into balls and dip in powdered sugar.

recipes.title: Mile-High Biscuits
directions: Combine dry ingredients
in mixing bowl.
Cut in shortening until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
Add egg and milk at once; mix until dough
forms
a ball.
Turn dough out on a lightly floured surface and
knead	10
to 12 times.
Roll out 3/4-inch thick and cut
with
a
1/2-inch cutter.
Place on ungreased sheet and freeze.
recipes.text: Mile-High Biscuits. Combine dry ingredients in mixing bowl. Cut in shortening until mixture resembles coarse crumbs. Add egg and milk at once; mix until dough forms a ball. Turn dough out on a lightly floured surface and knead	10 to 12 times. Roll out 3/4-inch thick and cut with a 2 1/2-inch cutter. Place on ungreased sheet and freeze.

recipes.title: Winter Vegetable Chowder(Lo-Fat)
directions: Bring 3 cups of water and salt to boiling in large saucepan. Peel parsnips, halve lengthwise and cut crosswise into 1/2-inch thick slices.
Peel sweet potatoes and cut into 1/2-inch cubes. Cut broccoli into stems and separate head into small flowerets. Peel stems and cut into 1/2-inch dice.
Add broccoli stems, parsnips, sweet potatoes and onion to boiling water.
Lower heat. Simmer 6 minutes.
Add broccoli flowerets; simmer 3 minutes or until vegetables are tender.
Combine Ricotta cheese, milk, potato flakes, pepper, nutmeg and sugar in blender until smooth.
Stir Ricotta mixture into vegetable mixture in saucepan until blended. Gently heat through.
Ladle into soup bowls and sprinkle with Parmesan cheese.
recipes.text: Winter Vegetable Chowder(Lo-Fat). Bring 3 cups of water and salt to boiling in large saucepan. Peel parsnips, halve lengthwise and cut crosswise into 1/2-inch thick slices. Peel sweet potatoes and cut into 1/2-inch cubes. Cut broccoli into stems and separate head into small flowerets. Peel stems and cut into 1/2-inch dice. Add broccoli stems, parsnips, sweet potatoes and onion to boiling water. Lower heat. Simmer 6 minutes. Add broccoli flowerets; simmer 3 minutes or until vegetables are tender. Combine Ricotta cheese, milk, potato flakes, pepper, nutmeg and sugar in blender until smooth. Stir Ricotta mixture into vegetable mixture in saucepan until blended. Gently heat through. Ladle into soup bowls and sprinkle with Parmesan cheese.

recipes.title: Lazy Day Lasagna(Make Recipe As Is)
ingredients: 8 oz. part skim Mozzarella cheese, grated or sliced
directions: Brown meat, pepper and onion.
Add next 7 ingredients.
Bring to a boil; reduce heat.
Simmer 15 minutes.
Put in 13 x 9-inch pan; layer 1/2 meat sauce and uncooked lasagna noodles.
Add remaining sauce.
Be sure noodles are covered by sauce.
Top with Mozzarella cheese.
Cover tightly with aluminum foil.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.
Freezes well.
recipes.text: Lazy Day Lasagna(Make Recipe As Is). Brown meat, pepper and onion. Add next 7 ingredients. Bring to a boil; reduce heat. Simmer 15 minutes. Put in 13 x 9-inch pan; layer 1/2 meat sauce and uncooked lasagna noodles. Add remaining sauce. Be sure noodles are covered by sauce. Top with Mozzarella cheese. Cover tightly with aluminum foil. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes. Freezes well.

recipes.title: Poinsettia Punch
ingredients: 2 (6 oz.) cans frozen concentrated pink lemonade, undiluted
2 large (28 oz.) bottles dry ginger ale, chilled
directions: Pour diluted lemonade into bowl. Pour in ginger ale.
Add a tray of ice cubes.
Stir in sherbet until well blended.
Makes 20 punch cup servings.
recipes.text: Poinsettia Punch. Pour diluted lemonade into bowl. Pour in ginger ale. Add a tray of ice cubes. Stir in sherbet until well blended. Makes 20 punch cup servings.

recipes.title: Sweet And Sour Sausage Balls
directions: Mix together the sausage, bread crumbs and eggs; form small balls.
Brown in skillet.
Remove.
In same skillet, brown pineapple and green pepper in sausage drippings.
recipes.text: Sweet And Sour Sausage Balls. Mix together the sausage, bread crumbs and eggs; form small balls. Brown in skillet. Remove. In same skillet, brown pineapple and green pepper in sausage drippings.

recipes.title: Pimento Cheese
directions: Leave cheese out overnight to soften.
Large grate the cheese and blend everything together.
recipes.text: Pimento Cheese. Leave cheese out overnight to soften. Large grate the cheese and blend everything together.

recipes.title: Southern Pecan Pie
directions: In mixer bowl, slightly beat eggs.
Add sugar, corn syrup, evaporated milk and vanilla.
Blend well.
Add pecans and pour into unbaked 9-inch pie shell.
Bake in a 400° oven for 10 minutes.
Reduce heat to 350° and bake for an additional 30 to 40 minutes or until filling is puffed in center and is well browned. Let pie cool before cutting.
recipes.text: Southern Pecan Pie. In mixer bowl, slightly beat eggs. Add sugar, corn syrup, evaporated milk and vanilla. Blend well. Add pecans and pour into unbaked 9-inch pie shell. Bake in a 400° oven for 10 minutes. Reduce heat to 350° and bake for an additional 30 to 40 minutes or until filling is puffed in center and is well browned. Let pie cool before cutting.

recipes.title: "Potatoes Chantilly"
directions: Put mashed potatoes in a baking dish.
Top with cream and sprinkle with cheese.
Bake in hot oven until cheese is melted and topping is golden brown and bubbling.
Serves 6 to 8. Can freeze. Easy, can do ahead.
recipes.text: "Potatoes Chantilly". Put mashed potatoes in a baking dish. Top with cream and sprinkle with cheese. Bake in hot oven until cheese is melted and topping is golden brown and bubbling. Serves 6 to 8. Can freeze. Easy, can do ahead.

recipes.title: Orzo Salad
directions: Cook orzo pasta in water with bouillon for approximately 8 minutes or until tender, but firm.
Drain well.
Whisk together vinegar, mustard and oil, adding the oil a few drops at a time. Toss orzo with the dressing.
Add diced peppers and currants.
recipes.text: Orzo Salad. Cook orzo pasta in water with bouillon for approximately 8 minutes or until tender, but firm. Drain well. Whisk together vinegar, mustard and oil, adding the oil a few drops at a time. Toss orzo with the dressing. Add diced peppers and currants.

recipes.title: Cornmeal Muffins
ingredients: 1 c. plus 1 Tbsp. melted butter, margarine or oil
directions: Mix sugar and cornmeal.
Add sifted dry ingredients.
Add egg, mixed with shortening and milk.
Mix well.
recipes.text: Cornmeal Muffins. Mix sugar and cornmeal. Add sifted dry ingredients. Add egg, mixed with shortening and milk. Mix well.

recipes.title: Taco Dip
directions: Mix cream cheese and mayonnaise.
Put in the bottom of a pie plate; top with taco sauce, then tomatoes.
Add optional ingredients if you'd like.
recipes.text: Taco Dip. Mix cream cheese and mayonnaise. Put in the bottom of a pie plate; top with taco sauce, then tomatoes. Add optional ingredients if you'd like.

recipes.title: Hungarian Veal Goulash
ingredients: 1 3/4 lb. boneless veal, cut in 1-inch cubes
directions: Saute meat in hot oil.
Add onion.
Saute 5 to 10 minutes, until almost all oil is gone.
Add paprika; stir, then add flour. Cook 5 minutes, blending well.
Place caraway seed, bay leaf and parsley in cheesecloth and add to pot with beef broth and puree. Bring to boil.
Cover and simmer 1 hour, or until meat is tender. Add salt and pepper to taste.
Discard seasoning bag.
(Half cup sour cream may be added just before serving.)
Is good over hot noodles.
recipes.text: Hungarian Veal Goulash. Saute meat in hot oil. Add onion. Saute 5 to 10 minutes, until almost all oil is gone. Add paprika; stir, then add flour. Cook 5 minutes, blending well. Place caraway seed, bay leaf and parsley in cheesecloth and add to pot with beef broth and puree. Bring to boil. Cover and simmer 1 hour, or until meat is tender. Add salt and pepper to taste. Discard seasoning bag. (Half cup sour cream may be added just before serving.) Is good over hot noodles.

recipes.title: Chicken And Rice Casserole
ingredients: 4 to 6 large chicken breasts (skinless and boneless)
1 can cream of chicken or cream of mushroom soup
directions: Heat oven to 325°.
Grease 9 x 13 pan.
Sprinkle rice in pan. Place chicken breasts on rice.
Mix canned soup
with water; pour over chicken and rice (lift chicken enough to allow liquid to reach rice underneath).
Sprinkle dry onion soup mix over chicken and rice.
Cover pan with foil.
Bake about 1 1/2 hours, or until chicken is done (juices run clear when poked with fork).
recipes.text: Chicken And Rice Casserole. Heat oven to 325°. Grease 9 x 13 pan. Sprinkle rice in pan. Place chicken breasts on rice. Mix canned soup with water; pour over chicken and rice (lift chicken enough to allow liquid to reach rice underneath). Sprinkle dry onion soup mix over chicken and rice. Cover pan with foil. Bake about 1 1/2 hours, or until chicken is done (juices run clear when poked with fork).

recipes.title: Pecan Pie
directions: Beat all ingredients together in large bowl.
Pour in unbaked pie shell.
Bake for 1 hour at 375° or until firm.
recipes.text: Pecan Pie. Beat all ingredients together in large bowl. Pour in unbaked pie shell. Bake for 1 hour at 375° or until firm.

recipes.title: Carrot And Pineapple Coleslaw
directions: Combine cabbage, pineapple chunks, carrots and almonds in a large bowl; toss gently.
Combine mayonnaise and remaining ingredients, stirring until smooth.
Pour dressing mixture over cabbage mixture; toss gently.
Cover and chill thoroughly.
Yields 6 to 8 servings.
recipes.text: Carrot And Pineapple Coleslaw. Combine cabbage, pineapple chunks, carrots and almonds in a large bowl; toss gently. Combine mayonnaise and remaining ingredients, stirring until smooth. Pour dressing mixture over cabbage mixture; toss gently. Cover and chill thoroughly. Yields 6 to 8 servings.

recipes.title: Oven-Fried Zucchini Spears
directions: Cut zucchini into halves, then crosswise to get finger lengths.
On wax paper, mix all seasonings.
In small bowl, mix oil and water.
Toss zucchini spears in water mixture, then in crumbs.
Arrange on greased cookie sheet.
Bake in 475° oven for 7 minutes until brown.
Turn over and bake 3 minutes more.
recipes.text: Oven-Fried Zucchini Spears. Cut zucchini into halves, then crosswise to get finger lengths. On wax paper, mix all seasonings. In small bowl, mix oil and water. Toss zucchini spears in water mixture, then in crumbs. Arrange on greased cookie sheet. Bake in 475° oven for 7 minutes until brown. Turn over and bake 3 minutes more.

recipes.title: Kentucky Prune Cake
directions: Blend together sugar, oil and eggs.
Sift together flour, soda, cinnamon, nutmeg and salt.
Add to sugar, eggs and oil. Beat well.
Add buttermilk, vanilla, prunes and nuts.
Bake 45 minutes to 1 hour at 350°.
Test until toothpick comes out clean.
recipes.text: Kentucky Prune Cake. Blend together sugar, oil and eggs. Sift together flour, soda, cinnamon, nutmeg and salt. Add to sugar, eggs and oil. Beat well. Add buttermilk, vanilla, prunes and nuts. Bake 45 minutes to 1 hour at 350°. Test until toothpick comes out clean.

recipes.title: Chicken And Dressing Casserole
directions: Mix together chicken, mayonnaise, onion and celery and set aside.
Mix together 2 eggs, broth, butter and stuffing mix.
In a casserole dish, put one layer of stuffing mix and then the chicken mixture and top with remaining stuffing mixture.
Beat together eggs and milk and pour over top.
Cover and refrigerate overnight. When ready to cook, add cream of chicken soup over top and cook at 350 degrees for 45 minutes.
Sprinkle with paprika to add color.
recipes.text: Chicken And Dressing Casserole. Mix together chicken, mayonnaise, onion and celery and set aside. Mix together 2 eggs, broth, butter and stuffing mix. In a casserole dish, put one layer of stuffing mix and then the chicken mixture and top with remaining stuffing mixture. Beat together eggs and milk and pour over top. Cover and refrigerate overnight. When ready to cook, add cream of chicken soup over top and cook at 350 degrees for 45 minutes. Sprinkle with paprika to add color.

recipes.title: Cinnamon Pudding Cake
directions: Mix first 3 items together and let come to a boil.
Set aside.
Cream the next 7 items together.
Mix with first ingredients.
(If too stiff, add small amount milk.)
Pour into pan.
Pour syrup mixture on top.
Do not mix.
Cover with nuts. Cook at 350° until done.
recipes.text: Cinnamon Pudding Cake. Mix first 3 items together and let come to a boil. Set aside. Cream the next 7 items together. Mix with first ingredients. (If too stiff, add small amount milk.) Pour into pan. Pour syrup mixture on top. Do not mix. Cover with nuts. Cook at 350° until done.

recipes.title: Easy Chicken Divan
ingredients: 1 bunch fresh broccoli or 1 lb. pkg. frozen broccoli spears
directions: Steam broccoli until just tender.
Melt butter in large frypan. Saute chicken breasts until lightly browned.
In mixing bowl, mix cream of mushroom soup and mayonnaise.
In casserole dish, drain butter from frypan.
Layer broccoli spears.
Spread half of soup and mayonnaise mixture over spears.
Top with 1/2 cup shredded cheese.
Layer chicken then top with remaining soup and mayonnaise mixture.
Sprinkle remaining cheese.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes, uncovered.
Serve with rice.
recipes.text: Easy Chicken Divan. Steam broccoli until just tender. Melt butter in large frypan. Saute chicken breasts until lightly browned. In mixing bowl, mix cream of mushroom soup and mayonnaise. In casserole dish, drain butter from frypan. Layer broccoli spears. Spread half of soup and mayonnaise mixture over spears. Top with 1/2 cup shredded cheese. Layer chicken then top with remaining soup and mayonnaise mixture. Sprinkle remaining cheese. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes, uncovered. Serve with rice.

recipes.title: Pineapple Shrimp Appetizers
ingredients: 1 or 2 chopped green onions (some of the greens also)
1 or 2 tsp. horseradish or Dijon mustard
directions: Combine everything together except the cukes.
Thick slice cukes and spoon heaping teaspoonful of filling on top of each slice.
Garnish with thin slices of green onion tops, if desired. No grams of fat in recipe.
recipes.text: Pineapple Shrimp Appetizers. Combine everything together except the cukes. Thick slice cukes and spoon heaping teaspoonful of filling on top of each slice. Garnish with thin slices of green onion tops, if desired. No grams of fat in recipe.

recipes.title: Green Tomato Raspberry Jam
directions: Combine green tomatoes and sugar in saucepan.
Boil 10 minutes. Add jello.
Mix well.
Refrigerate for 1/2 hour.
Pour into jars. Refrigerate or freeze.
Makes 4 1/2 pints.
recipes.text: Green Tomato Raspberry Jam. Combine green tomatoes and sugar in saucepan. Boil 10 minutes. Add jello. Mix well. Refrigerate for 1/2 hour. Pour into jars. Refrigerate or freeze. Makes 4 1/2 pints.

recipes.title: Better Than Sex Cake
ingredients: 1 box cake with pudding (white or yellow)
directions: Bake cake in 9 x 13 pan according to directions on box.
When done, poke holes in cake.
While cake is baking, combine pineapple and sugar and boil for 5 minutes.
Pour over cake while hot.
Let cake cool, then prepare instant pudding according to directions on box.
Spread pudding over cake.
Spread Cool Whip over pudding.
recipes.text: Better Than Sex Cake. Bake cake in 9 x 13 pan according to directions on box. When done, poke holes in cake. While cake is baking, combine pineapple and sugar and boil for 5 minutes. Pour over cake while hot. Let cake cool, then prepare instant pudding according to directions on box. Spread pudding over cake. Spread Cool Whip over pudding.

recipes.title: Cherry-Pie Cake
directions: Put the one cup sugar with can of cherries and boil for a few minutes.
Make the rest like cake batter and put in square pan, well-greased.
Then pour cherries on top and bake in moderate oven for 30 to 35 minutes.
recipes.text: Cherry-Pie Cake. Put the one cup sugar with can of cherries and boil for a few minutes. Make the rest like cake batter and put in square pan, well-greased. Then pour cherries on top and bake in moderate oven for 30 to 35 minutes.

recipes.title: Sauerkraut
ingredients: 3 strips bacon, chopped (need about 2 Tbsp. drippings)
directions: Cook kraut and water about 10 minutes.
Fry bacon.
Add onion to
drippings and cook until onion is glazed.
Add flour and stir well.
Pour
water from kraut into gravy mixture and add sugar. Add kraut.
Salt and pepper to taste.
Let mixture come to a boil, if too thick add more water.
recipes.text: Sauerkraut. Cook kraut and water about 10 minutes. Fry bacon. Add onion to drippings and cook until onion is glazed. Add flour and stir well. Pour water from kraut into gravy mixture and add sugar. Add kraut. Salt and pepper to taste. Let mixture come to a boil, if too thick add more water.

recipes.title: Cheese Ball
directions: Set cream cheese out ahead of
time to soften.
Crush bacon into small bacon bits and chop onions real fine.
I use a blender to chop bacon and onions.
Stir bacon bits, onions and pecans into cream cheese.
Form into ball.
Chill.
Serve on snack crackers.
recipes.text: Cheese Ball. Set cream cheese out ahead of time to soften. Crush bacon into small bacon bits and chop onions real fine. I use a blender to chop bacon and onions. Stir bacon bits, onions and pecans into cream cheese. Form into ball. Chill. Serve on snack crackers.

recipes.title: Baked Haddock With Shrimp Stuffing
directions: Grease pan and add fish.
Spread soup and shrimp on top.
Bake in 375° oven for 20 minutes.
Combine butter, seasonings, grated onion and crackers.
Sprinkle over fish and bake 10 minutes more.
recipes.text: Baked Haddock With Shrimp Stuffing. Grease pan and add fish. Spread soup and shrimp on top. Bake in 375° oven for 20 minutes. Combine butter, seasonings, grated onion and crackers. Sprinkle over fish and bake 10 minutes more.

recipes.title: Icebox Rolls
directions: Cream sugar
and Crisco in big mixing bowl; add boiling water. Stir
until Crisco is melted; add cold water which has yeast dissolved
in
it.	Add
salt.
Beat
eggs	and
add
to mixture. Add
flour,
making
soft
dough slowly.
Cover with greased paper and
put in refrigerator for 1 or 2 hours.
Let rise about 2 hours and bake in moderate oven.
recipes.text: Icebox Rolls. Cream sugar and Crisco in big mixing bowl; add boiling water. Stir until Crisco is melted; add cold water which has yeast dissolved in it.	Add salt. Beat eggs	and add to mixture. Add flour, making soft dough slowly. Cover with greased paper and put in refrigerator for 1 or 2 hours. Let rise about 2 hours and bake in moderate oven.

recipes.title: Easy Hermits
directions: Preheat oven to 375°.
Beat sugar, shortening, molasses and egg until smooth.
Mix spices, salt, soda, flour and raisins.
Add to the sugar shortening mixture with water to make a soft dough.
recipes.text: Easy Hermits. Preheat oven to 375°. Beat sugar, shortening, molasses and egg until smooth. Mix spices, salt, soda, flour and raisins. Add to the sugar shortening mixture with water to make a soft dough.

recipes.title: Zucchini-Artichoke Continental
ingredients: 3 medium zucchini (1 lb.), sliced 1/4-inch thick (4 c.)
2 medium tomatoes, cut into wedges and seeded
directions: In 2-quart microwave-safe casserole, microcook artichokes and water, covered, on 100% power (High) for 3 to 4 minutes or until thawed.
Stir.
Add next 3 ingredients.
Cover.
Cook on High for 9 to 11 minutes (low-wattage oven for 12 to 14 minutes) or just until tender; stir once.
Drain well.
Stir in garlic, 1/2 teaspoon salt and 1/4 teaspoon pepper.
Dot with margarine or butter.
Cover; cook on High for 1 minute.
Stir in tomatoes; sprinkle with cheese.
Let stand 2 minutes.
Makes 6 servings.
recipes.text: Zucchini-Artichoke Continental. In 2-quart microwave-safe casserole, microcook artichokes and water, covered, on 100% power (High) for 3 to 4 minutes or until thawed. Stir. Add next 3 ingredients. Cover. Cook on High for 9 to 11 minutes (low-wattage oven for 12 to 14 minutes) or just until tender; stir once. Drain well. Stir in garlic, 1/2 teaspoon salt and 1/4 teaspoon pepper. Dot with margarine or butter. Cover; cook on High for 1 minute. Stir in tomatoes; sprinkle with cheese. Let stand 2 minutes. Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Sweet Muffins
directions: Preheat the oven to 400°.
Grease a muffin tin.
Beat egg. Stir in milk and oil.
Add the remaining ingredients.
Beat for 20 to 25 minutes.
You can mix these the night before.
Kids love them.
recipes.text: Sweet Muffins. Preheat the oven to 400°. Grease a muffin tin. Beat egg. Stir in milk and oil. Add the remaining ingredients. Beat for 20 to 25 minutes. You can mix these the night before. Kids love them.

recipes.title: Ice Cream Dessert
directions: Combine first three ingredients.
Place 3/4 of the mix in a buttered 9 x 13-inch pan.
Spread ice cream on crumbs.
Sprinkle rest of crumbs on ice cream.
Place in freezer.
Cut in squares and serve with a cherry.
recipes.text: Ice Cream Dessert. Combine first three ingredients. Place 3/4 of the mix in a buttered 9 x 13-inch pan. Spread ice cream on crumbs. Sprinkle rest of crumbs on ice cream. Place in freezer. Cut in squares and serve with a cherry.

recipes.title: Pineapple Cookies
directions: Cream sugar and shortening until fluffy.
Add eggs and beat well.
Sift dry ingredients together.
Stir into sugar mixture. Add pineapple and vanilla; drop by teaspoon onto a greased cookie sheet.
Bake at 400° for 8 to 10 minutes.
recipes.text: Pineapple Cookies. Cream sugar and shortening until fluffy. Add eggs and beat well. Sift dry ingredients together. Stir into sugar mixture. Add pineapple and vanilla; drop by teaspoon onto a greased cookie sheet. Bake at 400° for 8 to 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Beef-Bean Combo
directions: Cook and stir hamburger and onion in 12-inch skillet or Dutch oven until hamburger is light brown; drain.
Stir in green beans (with liquid) and remaining ingredients.
Heat to boiling; reduce heat.
Cover and simmer, stirring occasionally until noodles are tender, 25 to 30 minutes or cover and cook in a 350° oven for 25 minutes.
Makes 6 servings.
recipes.text: Beef-Bean Combo. Cook and stir hamburger and onion in 12-inch skillet or Dutch oven until hamburger is light brown; drain. Stir in green beans (with liquid) and remaining ingredients. Heat to boiling; reduce heat. Cover and simmer, stirring occasionally until noodles are tender, 25 to 30 minutes or cover and cook in a 350° oven for 25 minutes. Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Orange-Pineapple Molded Salad
directions: Blend together the Cool Whip and cottage cheese.
Fold in dry the orange Jell-O.
Fold in oranges and pineapple.
Set in mold overnight.
recipes.text: Orange-Pineapple Molded Salad. Blend together the Cool Whip and cottage cheese. Fold in dry the orange Jell-O. Fold in oranges and pineapple. Set in mold overnight.

recipes.title: Mock Filet Mignon
directions: In a mixing bowl, combine ground beef, rice, onion, garlic powder, Worcestershire sauce, salt and pepper.
Mix thoroughly. Shape into 6 round patties.
Wrap a strip of bacon around each patty.
Fasten with a wooden toothpick.
Place in an ungreased, shallow baking dish.
Bake at 450° for 20 minutes or to desired doneness.
recipes.text: Mock Filet Mignon. In a mixing bowl, combine ground beef, rice, onion, garlic powder, Worcestershire sauce, salt and pepper. Mix thoroughly. Shape into 6 round patties. Wrap a strip of bacon around each patty. Fasten with a wooden toothpick. Place in an ungreased, shallow baking dish. Bake at 450° for 20 minutes or to desired doneness.

recipes.title: Butterfinger Cake
ingredients: 1 (8 oz.) jar caramel ice cream topping
directions: Prepare and bake cake mix using package directions using a 9 x 13-inch pan. Pierce cake with a fork. Mix milk and caramel topping together. Pour over baked cake. Sprinkle with half of candy crumbs. Spread with whipped topping and then rest of candy.
recipes.text: Butterfinger Cake. Prepare and bake cake mix using package directions using a 9 x 13-inch pan. Pierce cake with a fork. Mix milk and caramel topping together. Pour over baked cake. Sprinkle with half of candy crumbs. Spread with whipped topping and then rest of candy.

recipes.title: Egg Custard
directions: Mix all ingredients together, except pie crust.
Put in unbaked pie crust.
Bake at 350° until done, about 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Egg Custard. Mix all ingredients together, except pie crust. Put in unbaked pie crust. Bake at 350° until done, about 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Homemade Salsa
ingredients: 2 (16 oz.) cans whole peeled tomatoes, drained
3 or 4 jalapeno peppers or to taste
directions: Place all ingredients in a blender; blend to desired consistency.
Freezes well.
Makes 5 cups of salsa.
Keeps well in refrigerator for a week.
recipes.text: Homemade Salsa. Place all ingredients in a blender; blend to desired consistency. Freezes well. Makes 5 cups of salsa. Keeps well in refrigerator for a week.

recipes.title: Chicken Pot Pie
ingredients: 1 can cream of chicken or mushroom soup
directions: Mix pot pie mixture and pour into the greased casserole dish. Bake at
350° for 30 minutes or until done.
recipes.text: Chicken Pot Pie. Mix pot pie mixture and pour into the greased casserole dish. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until done.

recipes.title: Broccoli Soup
directions: Saute onion in margarine.
Cook broccoli as directed on package.
Slowly mix milk and soup in large saucepan.
Add remaining ingredients.
Simmer 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Broccoli Soup. Saute onion in margarine. Cook broccoli as directed on package. Slowly mix milk and soup in large saucepan. Add remaining ingredients. Simmer 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Banana Bread
directions: Mix together.
Put in loaf pan, greased and floured.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour and 15 minutes.
recipes.text: Banana Bread. Mix together. Put in loaf pan, greased and floured. Bake at 350° for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Salmon Patties
directions: Open salmon; pour juice into measuring cup and set aside. Dump drained salmon into bowl. Add egg. Use fork to break up salmon and mix thoroughly with egg. Add 1/2 cup flour. Take 1/4 cup of juice and add 1 heaping teaspoon of baking powder to the juice; beat with a fork. It foams. Pour mixture into salmon mixture. Fry in hot grease.
recipes.text: Salmon Patties. Open salmon; pour juice into measuring cup and set aside. Dump drained salmon into bowl. Add egg. Use fork to break up salmon and mix thoroughly with egg. Add 1/2 cup flour. Take 1/4 cup of juice and add 1 heaping teaspoon of baking powder to the juice; beat with a fork. It foams. Pour mixture into salmon mixture. Fry in hot grease.

recipes.title: Kool-Aid Pie
directions: Whip chilled milk until thick, then add sugar.
Beat for 1 minute more.
Add Kool-Aid and beat for another minute.
Pour into pie crust and chill.
recipes.text: Kool-Aid Pie. Whip chilled milk until thick, then add sugar. Beat for 1 minute more. Add Kool-Aid and beat for another minute. Pour into pie crust and chill.

recipes.title: Zucchini Patties
directions: Mix ingredients together.
Heat skillet with 3 Tbsp oil. Drop mixture by Tablespoonful into skillet on medium high heat. Turn and brown on both sides.
Remove and drain on paper towels.
recipes.text: Zucchini Patties. Mix ingredients together. Heat skillet with 3 Tbsp oil. Drop mixture by Tablespoonful into skillet on medium high heat. Turn and brown on both sides. Remove and drain on paper towels.

recipes.title: Cincinnati Chili
ingredients: minced garlic clove or garlic powder
directions: Reserve 1/2 of the diced onions to serve later with chili, if desired.
Brown beef with garlic and remaining onions.
Stir in chili powder, allspice, cinnamon, cumin and salt; cook 1 minute. Stir in tomato sauce, stewed tomatoes, Worcestershire sauce, vinegar and 3/4 cup water over high heat.
Heat to boiling. Reduce heat to low; cover and simmer for 1 hour, stirring occasionally.
Add drained kidney beans in last half hour.
About 25 minutes before chili is to be served, prepare spaghetti according to package directions.
Serve chili over spaghetti with grated cheese on top.
recipes.text: Cincinnati Chili. Reserve 1/2 of the diced onions to serve later with chili, if desired. Brown beef with garlic and remaining onions. Stir in chili powder, allspice, cinnamon, cumin and salt; cook 1 minute. Stir in tomato sauce, stewed tomatoes, Worcestershire sauce, vinegar and 3/4 cup water over high heat. Heat to boiling. Reduce heat to low; cover and simmer for 1 hour, stirring occasionally. Add drained kidney beans in last half hour. About 25 minutes before chili is to be served, prepare spaghetti according to package directions. Serve chili over spaghetti with grated cheese on top.

recipes.title: Corn Muffins(Makes 1 Dozen)
directions: Grease muffin pan generously with shortening.
Set in a 400° oven.
Sift cornmeal, salt, soda and baking powder into mixing bowl.
Add sour milk and stir well.
Add the beaten egg and melted butter.
Heat muffin pan very hot.
Fill each cup and bake in 400° oven for 20 to 25 minutes.
Serve hot.
recipes.text: Corn Muffins(Makes 1 Dozen). Grease muffin pan generously with shortening. Set in a 400° oven. Sift cornmeal, salt, soda and baking powder into mixing bowl. Add sour milk and stir well. Add the beaten egg and melted butter. Heat muffin pan very hot. Fill each cup and bake in 400° oven for 20 to 25 minutes. Serve hot.

recipes.title: Tuna Chipper Casserole
directions: Empty soup into 1-quart casserole.
Add milk and stir.
Drain tuna and add.
Crush potato chips and add all but 1/2 cup to soup mixture.
Add peas and stir.
Sprinkle remaining chips on top of casserole.
Bake 25 to 30 minutes at 350°.
recipes.text: Tuna Chipper Casserole. Empty soup into 1-quart casserole. Add milk and stir. Drain tuna and add. Crush potato chips and add all but 1/2 cup to soup mixture. Add peas and stir. Sprinkle remaining chips on top of casserole. Bake 25 to 30 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: No Eggs Chocolate Cake
directions: Combine all ingredients and mix well.
Pour into a greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan.
Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.
recipes.text: No Eggs Chocolate Cake. Combine all ingredients and mix well. Pour into a greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Nestle Fudge
directions: Combine margarine, milk, sugar and salt in medium size heavy saucepan.
Bring to a boil over medium heat, stirring constantly (about 5 minutes).
Remove from heat.
Stir in marshmallows, morsels, nuts and vanilla.
Stir vigorously for 1 minute or until marshmallows are melted.
Pour into foil-lined square baking pan. Chill until firm.
Cut into 1 1/2-inch squares.
recipes.text: Nestle Fudge. Combine margarine, milk, sugar and salt in medium size heavy saucepan. Bring to a boil over medium heat, stirring constantly (about 5 minutes). Remove from heat. Stir in marshmallows, morsels, nuts and vanilla. Stir vigorously for 1 minute or until marshmallows are melted. Pour into foil-lined square baking pan. Chill until firm. Cut into 1 1/2-inch squares.

recipes.title: Eggplant Parmesan
directions: Melt butter in baking dish.
Combine corn flakes, Parmesan, salt and pepper.
Stir and set aside.
Peel eggplant.
Cut into slices.
Dip each piece into egg and then coat with crumb mixture. Arrange in buttered casserole dish.
Bake at 400° for 20 minutes. Turn slices over and bake 15 more minutes.
Combine remaining ingredients except Mozzarella cheese in a saucepan.
Bring to a boil.
Pour over eggplant.
Top with Mozzarella cheese.
Bake until cheese melts.
recipes.text: Eggplant Parmesan. Melt butter in baking dish. Combine corn flakes, Parmesan, salt and pepper. Stir and set aside. Peel eggplant. Cut into slices. Dip each piece into egg and then coat with crumb mixture. Arrange in buttered casserole dish. Bake at 400° for 20 minutes. Turn slices over and bake 15 more minutes. Combine remaining ingredients except Mozzarella cheese in a saucepan. Bring to a boil. Pour over eggplant. Top with Mozzarella cheese. Bake until cheese melts.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Pie
ingredients: 1 Tbsp. sherry flavoring (use any or all)
directions: Mix all ingredients and pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake at 450° for 10 minutes. Reduce temperature to 350° and bake 50 minutes longer.
recipes.text: Pumpkin Pie. Mix all ingredients and pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake at 450° for 10 minutes. Reduce temperature to 350° and bake 50 minutes longer.

recipes.title: Chuck Wagon Surprise
ingredients: 8 oz. elbow macaroni, cooked and drained
directions: Brown ground beef with onion and green pepper in saucepan, stirring until ground beef is crumbly; drain.
Add macaroni, spaghetti sauce and cheese; mix well.
Simmer until heated through.
Serve with salad and garlic bread.
Yield:
8 servings.
recipes.text: Chuck Wagon Surprise. Brown ground beef with onion and green pepper in saucepan, stirring until ground beef is crumbly; drain. Add macaroni, spaghetti sauce and cheese; mix well. Simmer until heated through. Serve with salad and garlic bread. Yield: 8 servings.

recipes.title: Cranberry Souffle Salad
directions: In
a saucepan, combine 1 1/4 cups of the orange juice, cranberry
sauce
and gelatin.
Cook and stir over medium heat until
gelatin

in
remaining

recipes.text: Cranberry Souffle Salad. In a saucepan, combine 1 1/4 cups of the orange juice, cranberry sauce and gelatin. Cook and stir over medium heat until gelatin dissolves.	Stir in remaining orange juice. Transfer to medium mixing bowl. Apply a seal; chill until partially set (consistency of an unbeaten egg white). recipes.title: Fluffy Yam Souffle
directions: Drain and mash yams in large bowl.
Add all other ingredients, except marshmallows, and mix well.
Put into large casserole dish. Bake at 350° for 50 minutes.
Top casserole with marshmallows and bake an additional 10 minutes.
recipes.text: Fluffy Yam Souffle. Drain and mash yams in large bowl. Add all other ingredients, except marshmallows, and mix well. Put into large casserole dish. Bake at 350° for 50 minutes. Top casserole with marshmallows and bake an additional 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Salisbury Steak With Mushroom Gravy
ingredients: 1 lb. ground round steak or ground beef
directions: Combine meat, pepper and salt.
Shape into 3 or 4 plump oval patties.
Pan-fry in hot oil in a skillet or broil 4 to 6 minutes each side.
recipes.text: Salisbury Steak With Mushroom Gravy. Combine meat, pepper and salt. Shape into 3 or 4 plump oval patties. Pan-fry in hot oil in a skillet or broil 4 to 6 minutes each side.

recipes.title: Meatballs
directions: Mix all ingredients; add precooked meatballs and heat or cook in crock-pot.
recipes.text: Meatballs. Mix all ingredients; add precooked meatballs and heat or cook in crock-pot.

recipes.title: Harvey Wallbanger Cake
directions: Add pudding, oil and cake mix.
Beat eggs and add to mix. Add orange juice, vodka and Galliano; mix well.
Bake in 10-inch angel food pan for 45 to 55 minutes at 350°.
recipes.text: Harvey Wallbanger Cake. Add pudding, oil and cake mix. Beat eggs and add to mix. Add orange juice, vodka and Galliano; mix well. Bake in 10-inch angel food pan for 45 to 55 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Chicken Broccoli Casserole
directions: Cook the broccoli.
Put in bottom of 9 x 12-inch pan.
Add a layer of diced chicken.
Add the soups and grated cheese.
Top with bread crumbs; pour some melted oleo over top.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Chicken Broccoli Casserole. Cook the broccoli. Put in bottom of 9 x 12-inch pan. Add a layer of diced chicken. Add the soups and grated cheese. Top with bread crumbs; pour some melted oleo over top. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Turtle Cake Squares
directions: Melt caramels and 1/4 cup milk in heavy saucepan over low heat, stirring constantly; or melt this mixture in a microwave for 3 minutes, stirring after every minute. Set aside.
recipes.text: Turtle Cake Squares. Melt caramels and 1/4 cup milk in heavy saucepan over low heat, stirring constantly; or melt this mixture in a microwave for 3 minutes, stirring after every minute. Set aside.

recipes.title: Barbecue Sauce
directions: Mix all ingredients.
Heat until shortening and butter are melted.
recipes.text: Barbecue Sauce. Mix all ingredients. Heat until shortening and butter are melted.

recipes.title: Cousin Nina'S Cheese Cake(Easy And Good)
ingredients: 2- 8 oz. pkg. cream cheese, may use reduced fat for 1 pkg.
1 graham cracker crust, may use reduced fat
Cherry or blueberry pie filling, optional
directions: Soften cream cheese.
Mix with sugar, vanilla, and lemon juice.
Mix in eggs.
Pour into graham cracker crust.
Bake at 325° for 40 minutes or until center is set.
Refrigerate 3 hours or overnight.
Top with cherry or blueberry pie filling or serve plain.
recipes.text: Cousin Nina'S Cheese Cake(Easy And Good). Soften cream cheese. Mix with sugar, vanilla, and lemon juice. Mix in eggs. Pour into graham cracker crust. Bake at 325° for 40 minutes or until center is set. Refrigerate 3 hours or overnight. Top with cherry or blueberry pie filling or serve plain.

recipes.title: Cheese Wafers
ingredients: 1/4 tsp. cayenne pepper or to taste
directions: Mix cheese and softened oleo.
Add rest of ingredients.
Mix well with electric mixer.
Roll into 1-inch balls.
Place on ungreased cookie sheet.
Press with fork to flatten.
Bake at 350° for 12 to 15 minutes.
Do not overbake.
Makes 80 to 100 wafers.
Can freeze after baking.
recipes.text: Cheese Wafers. Mix cheese and softened oleo. Add rest of ingredients. Mix well with electric mixer. Roll into 1-inch balls. Place on ungreased cookie sheet. Press with fork to flatten. Bake at 350° for 12 to 15 minutes. Do not overbake. Makes 80 to 100 wafers. Can freeze after baking.

recipes.title: Baked Carrots
directions: Cut the carrots in a diagonal before cooking.
Cook until tender and drain.
Melt cheese and stir in soup.
Mix with carrots and pour into casserole.
Top with buttered crumbs.
Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.
recipes.text: Baked Carrots. Cut the carrots in a diagonal before cooking. Cook until tender and drain. Melt cheese and stir in soup. Mix with carrots and pour into casserole. Top with buttered crumbs. Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Raggedy Ann'S Magical Jello Cake
directions: Combine all of the ingredients.
Mix until blended.
Pour into greased Bundt pan or 9 x 13-inch pan.
Bake at 350° for 35 to 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Raggedy Ann'S Magical Jello Cake. Combine all of the ingredients. Mix until blended. Pour into greased Bundt pan or 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350° for 35 to 45 minutes.

recipes.title: L And S Bar-B-Q
ingredients: 2 Tbsp. dehydrated onion or 2 minced medium size onions
directions: Crumble ground beef into large roast pan.
Add ingredients. Bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours.
Stir frequently.
Serves approximately 60.
recipes.text: L And S Bar-B-Q. Crumble ground beef into large roast pan. Add ingredients. Bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours. Stir frequently. Serves approximately 60.

recipes.title: Gluten Steaks
directions: Gradually mix liquid ingredients into dry ingredients and knead dough.
Roll half at a time on board on wet surface.
Slice off 1/2-inch at a time.
Keep your hands wet and press slices flat.
Drop one at a time into broth and cook 25 minutes.
Keep cover on and stir once in awhile.
recipes.text: Gluten Steaks. Gradually mix liquid ingredients into dry ingredients and knead dough. Roll half at a time on board on wet surface. Slice off 1/2-inch at a time. Keep your hands wet and press slices flat. Drop one at a time into broth and cook 25 minutes. Keep cover on and stir once in awhile.

recipes.title: Broccoli Casserole
directions: Saute onions and celery in 2 tablespoons of oleo.
Add soup, milk and water; add rice and broccoli.
Bake 30 minutes at 350°; remove and cover with grated cheese.
Return to oven until cheese is melted.
recipes.text: Broccoli Casserole. Saute onions and celery in 2 tablespoons of oleo. Add soup, milk and water; add rice and broccoli. Bake 30 minutes at 350°; remove and cover with grated cheese. Return to oven until cheese is melted.

recipes.title: Swiss Vegetable Medley
ingredients: 1 (16 oz.) bag frozen broccoli, carrots and cauliflower combination, thawed and drained
1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup
1 c. (4 oz.) shredded Swiss cheese, divided
1 (2.8 oz.) can Durkee French fried onions, divided
directions: Combine
drained
vegetables, soup, 1/2 of cheese, sour cream, pepper
and
of
the onions.
Pour into a lightly greased 1-quart casserole with cover.
Bake, covered, at 350° for
30 minutes.
Top
with
remaining
cheese and onions and bake, uncovered, for 5 minutes longer.
Serves 6.
recipes.text: Swiss Vegetable Medley. Combine drained vegetables, soup, 1/2 of cheese, sour cream, pepper and 1/2 of the onions. Pour into a lightly greased 1-quart casserole with cover. Bake, covered, at 350° for 30 minutes. Top with remaining cheese and onions and bake, uncovered, for 5 minutes longer. Serves 6.

recipes.title: Caramel Apple Dip
directions: Place chips in microwavable bowl.
Heat on High until melted. Add cinnamon and sweetened condensed milk.
Heat 1 minute longer. Stir.
Slice apples and dip.
This can be kept in the refrigerator and can be reheated until all is gone.
recipes.text: Caramel Apple Dip. Place chips in microwavable bowl. Heat on High until melted. Add cinnamon and sweetened condensed milk. Heat 1 minute longer. Stir. Slice apples and dip. This can be kept in the refrigerator and can be reheated until all is gone.

recipes.title: Children'S Play Dough
directions: Place flour in a bowl.
Add hot water, salt, baking powder, oil and food coloring; stir thoroughly until well mixed and a dough ball is formed.
Knead ball on floured surface until smooth and workable.
Store in airtight container in the refrigerator.
recipes.text: Children'S Play Dough. Place flour in a bowl. Add hot water, salt, baking powder, oil and food coloring; stir thoroughly until well mixed and a dough ball is formed. Knead ball on floured surface until smooth and workable. Store in airtight container in the refrigerator.

recipes.title: Asparagus In Blankets
ingredients: 8 to 10 pieces thin sliced white sandwich bread
1 (15 oz.) can extra long green asparagus, drained
directions: Trim crusts from bread.
Spread each slice generously with Hollandaise Sauce.
Place 2 asparagus spears diagonally on each slice and sprinkle generously with shredded cheese.
Fold bread diagonally over asparagus and secure with toothpick.
Brush with melted butter and sprinkle with Parmesan cheese.
Bake on a cookie sheet in a preheated 400° oven for 12 minutes.
recipes.text: Asparagus In Blankets. Trim crusts from bread. Spread each slice generously with Hollandaise Sauce. Place 2 asparagus spears diagonally on each slice and sprinkle generously with shredded cheese. Fold bread diagonally over asparagus and secure with toothpick. Brush with melted butter and sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Bake on a cookie sheet in a preheated 400° oven for 12 minutes.

recipes.title: Peach Cobbler
directions: Melt butter in baking dish.
Mix flour, sugar and milk.
Pour into melted oleo.
Pour peaches and juice into this.
Bake at 375° until done.
recipes.text: Peach Cobbler. Melt butter in baking dish. Mix flour, sugar and milk. Pour into melted oleo. Pour peaches and juice into this. Bake at 375° until done.

recipes.title: Saute Carrots
directions: Place carrots, salt, pepper and water in a 2-quart saucepan. Cook on high until steam rises from the lid.
Then reduce to low for 10 to 15 minutes.
Drain well and roll carrots in bread crumbs and saute in skillet with butter until lightly browned.
recipes.text: Saute Carrots. Place carrots, salt, pepper and water in a 2-quart saucepan. Cook on high until steam rises from the lid. Then reduce to low for 10 to 15 minutes. Drain well and roll carrots in bread crumbs and saute in skillet with butter until lightly browned.

recipes.title: Bacon-Wrapped Shrimp
ingredients: 1 lb. fresh or frozen shrimp, shelled and deveined
directions: Thaw shrimp if frozen.
Place shrimp in plastic bag.
Set in bowl.
recipes.text: Bacon-Wrapped Shrimp. Thaw shrimp if frozen. Place shrimp in plastic bag. Set in bowl.

recipes.title: Cherry Salad
ingredients: 1 large can crushed pineapple (do not drain)
directions: Mix all ingredients together; pour in 8 x 10-inch dish and congeal.
recipes.text: Cherry Salad. Mix all ingredients together; pour in 8 x 10-inch dish and congeal.

recipes.title: Sliced Baked Potatoes
ingredients: 2 Tbsp. chopped fresh herbs (such as parsley, chives, thyme or sage)
directions: Peel potatoes if the skin is tough, otherwise just scrub and rinse them.
Cut potatoes into thin slices but not all the way through (use a handle of a spoon laid in front of the potato as you cut, to prevent knife from cutting all the way).
Put potatoes in a baking dish.
Fan them slightly.
Sprinkle with salt and drizzle with butter.
Sprinkle with herbs.
Bake potatoes at 425° for about 50 minutes.
Remove from oven.
Sprinkle with cheese. Bake potatoes for another 10 to 15 minutes until lightly browned, cheese is melted and potatoes are soft inside.
Serves 4.
recipes.text: Sliced Baked Potatoes. Peel potatoes if the skin is tough, otherwise just scrub and rinse them. Cut potatoes into thin slices but not all the way through (use a handle of a spoon laid in front of the potato as you cut, to prevent knife from cutting all the way). Put potatoes in a baking dish. Fan them slightly. Sprinkle with salt and drizzle with butter. Sprinkle with herbs. Bake potatoes at 425° for about 50 minutes. Remove from oven. Sprinkle with cheese. Bake potatoes for another 10 to 15 minutes until lightly browned, cheese is melted and potatoes are soft inside. Serves 4.

recipes.title: Poppy Seed Bread
ingredients: 1 (3 oz.) pkg. instant pudding (butterscotch is good)
directions: Mix in bowl in order listed.
Beat 2 minutes.
Put into 2 greased 9-inch loaf pans.
Bake in 350° oven for 55 to 60 minutes.
recipes.text: Poppy Seed Bread. Mix in bowl in order listed. Beat 2 minutes. Put into 2 greased 9-inch loaf pans. Bake in 350° oven for 55 to 60 minutes.

recipes.title: Vegetable Ball
ingredients: 1 medium can crushed pineapple, drain well
3 Tbsp. carrots, shredded, drain very well
1/4 c. bell pepper, shredded and drain very well
directions: Mix 1/4 cup of nuts with the other ingredients. Shape into a ball and coat it with the other 1/4 cup of nuts. Serve with your favorite crackers.
recipes.text: Vegetable Ball. Mix 1/4 cup of nuts with the other ingredients. Shape into a ball and coat it with the other 1/4 cup of nuts. Serve with your favorite crackers.

recipes.title: Cocktail Wieners
ingredients: 1 (12 oz.) jar currant or grape jelly
directions: Mix mustard and jelly together and cook on low heat until dissolved.
(A crock-pot is excellent for this dish.) Place the wieners into the mixture.
Cook for about 15 to 20 minutes.
recipes.text: Cocktail Wieners. Mix mustard and jelly together and cook on low heat until dissolved. (A crock-pot is excellent for this dish.) Place the wieners into the mixture. Cook for about 15 to 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Ham Delights
directions: Blend oleo, poppy seed, Worcestershire sauce, mustard and onion together.
Split party rolls.
Spread top and bottom with mix.
Chop very small the ham and cheese.
Spread ham and cheese on rolls.
Cut into small squares.
Wrap in foil.
Bake at 400° for 10 to 20 minutes.
recipes.text: Ham Delights. Blend oleo, poppy seed, Worcestershire sauce, mustard and onion together. Split party rolls. Spread top and bottom with mix. Chop very small the ham and cheese. Spread ham and cheese on rolls. Cut into small squares. Wrap in foil. Bake at 400° for 10 to 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Curried Fruit Casserole
ingredients: 1 (16 oz.) can each: pears, pineapple and apricots
directions: Drain fruit well.
Place in buttered casserole (6 1/2-cup or larger).
Dab with butter.
Sift over fruit 1 cup of sugar with 1 scant tablespoon of curry.
Let set 24 hours in refrigerator. Bake, covered, at 350° for 45 minutes.
Serve at once.
Leftovers are good cold.
recipes.text: Curried Fruit Casserole. Drain fruit well. Place in buttered casserole (6 1/2-cup or larger). Dab with butter. Sift over fruit 1 cup of sugar with 1 scant tablespoon of curry. Let set 24 hours in refrigerator. Bake, covered, at 350° for 45 minutes. Serve at once. Leftovers are good cold.

recipes.title: Broiled Stuffed Mushrooms
directions: Rinse mushrooms and wipe gently with a paper towel to dry. Remove stems and chop finely.
Saute stems in butter for 2-3 minutes.
Add bread crumbs, nuts, garlic chives, basil and tarragon.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
recipes.text: Broiled Stuffed Mushrooms. Rinse mushrooms and wipe gently with a paper towel to dry. Remove stems and chop finely. Saute stems in butter for 2-3 minutes. Add bread crumbs, nuts, garlic chives, basil and tarragon. Season with salt and pepper to taste.

recipes.title: Dinner Rolls
directions: Separate eggs.
Beat egg whites with cream of tartar until whites are stiff but not dry.
Fold in yolks, cottage cheese and sugar substitute.
Do not over mix.
Place mixture on sheet, placing one tablespoon on top of another until each roll is about 2 inches high.
Repeat until you have six piles.
Preheat oven to 300°.
Bake 1 hour.
Yield:
6 rolls.
Carbohydrate 0 g, protein 8 g, fat 6 g, calories 86.
Two rolls = 1 meat exchange.
recipes.text: Dinner Rolls. Separate eggs. Beat egg whites with cream of tartar until whites are stiff but not dry. Fold in yolks, cottage cheese and sugar substitute. Do not over mix. Place mixture on sheet, placing one tablespoon on top of another until each roll is about 2 inches high. Repeat until you have six piles. Preheat oven to 300°. Bake 1 hour. Yield: 6 rolls. Carbohydrate 0 g, protein 8 g, fat 6 g, calories 86. Two rolls = 1 meat exchange.

recipes.title: Cubed Minute Steaks With Mushroom Sauce
directions: In large skillet with garlic press, press garlic into 2 tablespoons butter.
Add mushrooms and cook, stirring occasionally, until tender.
With slotted spoon, remove mushrooms to small bowl and set aside.
In same skillet, in butter, cook steaks until done and remove to platter.
Keep warm.
recipes.text: Cubed Minute Steaks With Mushroom Sauce. In large skillet with garlic press, press garlic into 2 tablespoons butter. Add mushrooms and cook, stirring occasionally, until tender. With slotted spoon, remove mushrooms to small bowl and set aside. In same skillet, in butter, cook steaks until done and remove to platter. Keep warm.

recipes.title: Baked Corn
directions: Mix together.
Bake in greased 9 x 13 pan at 350° for 45 minutes.
Can be divided and frozen before baking.
recipes.text: Baked Corn. Mix together. Bake in greased 9 x 13 pan at 350° for 45 minutes. Can be divided and frozen before baking.

recipes.title: Cheesies
directions: Knead all ingredients together.
Make into desired shapes and bake at 350° for 10 to 12 minutes.
Makes a good snack.
recipes.text: Cheesies. Knead all ingredients together. Make into desired shapes and bake at 350° for 10 to 12 minutes. Makes a good snack.

recipes.title: Zucchini Squash Bread
directions: Combine first 4 ingredients in large bowl and mix until well blended. Blend flour, soda, cinnamon, nutmeg and baking powder into mixture on low speed until smooth. Add squash, carrots and nuts. Stir until well blended. Preheat oven to 350°. Bake 1 1/4 to 1 1/2 hours. Makes 2 loaves.
recipes.text: Zucchini Squash Bread. Combine first 4 ingredients in large bowl and mix until well blended. Blend flour, soda, cinnamon, nutmeg and baking powder into mixture on low speed until smooth. Add squash, carrots and nuts. Stir until well blended. Preheat oven to 350°. Bake 1 1/4 to 1 1/2 hours. Makes 2 loaves.

recipes.title: Microwave Peanut Brittle
directions: Mix peanuts, sugar, syrup and salt
in a microwave bowl.
Cook 6 to 9 minutes (until peanuts are light brown).
Stir in margarine and vanilla.
Cook 2 or 3 minutes longer.
Quickly stir in baking soda until mixture is foamy.
While foamy, pour onto greased cookie sheet to cool.
You need to work fast to be able to spread mixture out thin.
recipes.text: Microwave Peanut Brittle. Mix peanuts, sugar, syrup and salt in a microwave bowl. Cook 6 to 9 minutes (until peanuts are light brown). Stir in margarine and vanilla. Cook 2 or 3 minutes longer. Quickly stir in baking soda until mixture is foamy. While foamy, pour onto greased cookie sheet to cool. You need to work fast to be able to spread mixture out thin.

recipes.title: Carrot Cake Frosting
ingredients: 1/2 c. shortening (half butter and half shortening)
directions: Bring milk and flour to a boil; this will be very thick.
Cool. Cream sugar and shortening.
Add cooled mixture and mix at high speed with mixer; add vanilla.
Frosting will be light and fluffy.
recipes.text: Carrot Cake Frosting. Bring milk and flour to a boil; this will be very thick. Cool. Cream sugar and shortening. Add cooled mixture and mix at high speed with mixer; add vanilla. Frosting will be light and fluffy.

recipes.title: No Bake Cookies
directions: Mix sugar, cocoa, margarine and milk together; bring to a boil.
Add peanut butter, oats and vanilla.
Mix until oats are covered with chocolate mixture.
Drop on wax paper and let cool.
recipes.text: No Bake Cookies. Mix sugar, cocoa, margarine and milk together; bring to a boil. Add peanut butter, oats and vanilla. Mix until oats are covered with chocolate mixture. Drop on wax paper and let cool.

recipes.title: Mexican Seasoned Potatoes
directions: Cut each potato lengthwise into 4 equal wedges.
Set aside. Place butter in 10-inch square casserole.
Microwave on High for 1 to 1 1/2 minutes or until butter melts.
Add potatoes, turning to coat with butter.
In small bowl, combine remaining ingredients. Sprinkle over potatoes.
Cover.
Microwave on High for 14 to 18 minutes or until potatoes are tender, rearranging potatoes twice. Let stand covered for 5 minutes.
recipes.text: Mexican Seasoned Potatoes. Cut each potato lengthwise into 4 equal wedges. Set aside. Place butter in 10-inch square casserole. Microwave on High for 1 to 1 1/2 minutes or until butter melts. Add potatoes, turning to coat with butter. In small bowl, combine remaining ingredients. Sprinkle over potatoes. Cover. Microwave on High for 14 to 18 minutes or until potatoes are tender, rearranging potatoes twice. Let stand covered for 5 minutes.

recipes.title: Broccoli Casserole
directions: Melt oleo in skillet.
Add chopped onion and saute until clear.
Add broccoli.
Stir thoroughly.
Add mushroom soup.
Stir and simmer several minutes.
Add Cheez Whiz; mix and simmer a few more minutes.
Add rice; stir and simmer.
If too thick, add small amount of water.
Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.
