recipes.text: Broccoli Casserole. Melt oleo in skillet. Add chopped onion and saute until clear. Add broccoli. Stir thoroughly. Add mushroom soup. Stir and simmer several minutes. Add Cheez Whiz; mix and simmer a few more minutes. Add rice; stir and simmer. If too thick, add small amount of water. Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Crab Cakes
directions: Mix all ingredients together well with a fork.
Make into cakes.
Fry on both sides until golden brown.
Drain on paper towel to absorb the grease.
Serves 4.
recipes.text: Crab Cakes. Mix all ingredients together well with a fork. Make into cakes. Fry on both sides until golden brown. Drain on paper towel to absorb the grease. Serves 4.

recipes.title: Carrot Bars
directions: Beat together sugar, eggs, oil and carrots.
Add in the flour, soda, salt and cinnamon, then pour into a 9 x 13-inch plus an 8 x 8-inch pan or 15 1/2 x 11-inch pan and bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Carrot Bars. Beat together sugar, eggs, oil and carrots. Add in the flour, soda, salt and cinnamon, then pour into a 9 x 13-inch plus an 8 x 8-inch pan or 15 1/2 x 11-inch pan and bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Batter Fried Cheese
ingredients: 2 or 3 blocks cheese (Mozzarella, Cheddar or pepper cheese)
directions: Fill containers halfway with milk, flour and bread crumbs. Add 3 eggs to milk.
Cut cheese into log strips.
Add cheese to milk and eggs.
(Do a couple at a time.)
Take out of milk and completely roll in flour.
Take out of flour and replace in milk mixture.
Take out of milk and place in Italian bread crumbs. Make sure it is completely covered.
When finished take out only what you are going to fry and refrigerate the rest for later.
recipes.text: Batter Fried Cheese. Fill containers halfway with milk, flour and bread crumbs. Add 3 eggs to milk. Cut cheese into log strips. Add cheese to milk and eggs. (Do a couple at a time.) Take out of milk and completely roll in flour. Take out of flour and replace in milk mixture. Take out of milk and place in Italian bread crumbs. Make sure it is completely covered. When finished take out only what you are going to fry and refrigerate the rest for later.

recipes.title: Cherry Square
ingredients: 2 cans Thank You cherry pie filling
directions: Mix all ingredients together except pie filling to form dough; take 1/2 dough and roll on wax paper, then transfer to cookie sheet.
Dough should be big enough to cover whole cookie sheet with dough to hang over sides such as you would with a pie. Spread cherry pie filling over dough.
Take remaining dough and place on top; pinch together top and bottom dough.
Bake for 25 minutes at 350°.
recipes.text: Cherry Square. Mix all ingredients together except pie filling to form dough; take 1/2 dough and roll on wax paper, then transfer to cookie sheet. Dough should be big enough to cover whole cookie sheet with dough to hang over sides such as you would with a pie. Spread cherry pie filling over dough. Take remaining dough and place on top; pinch together top and bottom dough. Bake for 25 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: French Silk Pie
ingredients: 1 (1 oz.) sq. Baker's chocolate, melted and cooled
directions: Cream sugar and butter with electric mixer. Blend in chocolate and vanilla. Add one egg and beat 5 minutes. Add second egg and beat 5 minutes. Turn into a baked pie shell. Chill for 1 hour and serve.
recipes.text: French Silk Pie. Cream sugar and butter with electric mixer. Blend in chocolate and vanilla. Add one egg and beat 5 minutes. Add second egg and beat 5 minutes. Turn into a baked pie shell. Chill for 1 hour and serve.

recipes.title: Spam And Cheese Bake
ingredients: 6 to 8 medium sliced unpeeled potatoes, cooked
1 c. diced cheese (reserve enough to top with)
dry mustard, paprika, thyme, pepper (1/4 tsp.)
directions: Cook together in skillet Crisco or butter and onion.
Add potato juice, cooked potatoes and milk.
Add flour to thicken. Add Spam.
Add cheese.
Add spices.
Put potatoes in casserole. Add cooked ingredients and top with rest of cheese.
Bake 35 minutes in 350° oven.
recipes.text: Spam And Cheese Bake. Cook together in skillet Crisco or butter and onion. Add potato juice, cooked potatoes and milk. Add flour to thicken. Add Spam. Add cheese. Add spices. Put potatoes in casserole. Add cooked ingredients and top with rest of cheese. Bake 35 minutes in 350° oven.

recipes.title: Pasta Salad
directions: Cook pasta until done; drain.
Add Italian dressing and mix until pasta is well coated.
Add remaining ingredients, mixing after each addition.
Refrigerate before eating.
recipes.text: Pasta Salad. Cook pasta until done; drain. Add Italian dressing and mix until pasta is well coated. Add remaining ingredients, mixing after each addition. Refrigerate before eating.

recipes.title: Parks Fruit Cake
directions: Soak nuts and fruits in wine overnight.
Then mix.
Pour into 1 large or 2 medium tube cake pans.
Cook at 250°
for 5 hours with water in oven. Makes 10 pound cake.
recipes.text: Parks Fruit Cake. Soak nuts and fruits in wine overnight. Then mix. Pour into 1 large or 2 medium tube cake pans. Cook at 250° for 5 hours with water in oven. Makes 10 pound cake.

recipes.title: Hot Taco Dip
directions: Fry beef; drain grease.
Mix in taco seasoning.
Spread cream cheese on bottom of pan (for 2, use 2 pie plates; for 1, use 10 x 10-inch pan), then layer following in order: ground beef mixture, chili peppers, onions, tomatoes and cheese.
Bake at 350° for 20 minutes until cheese is bubbly.
Serve with taco chips.
recipes.text: Hot Taco Dip. Fry beef; drain grease. Mix in taco seasoning. Spread cream cheese on bottom of pan (for 2, use 2 pie plates; for 1, use 10 x 10-inch pan), then layer following in order: ground beef mixture, chili peppers, onions, tomatoes and cheese. Bake at 350° for 20 minutes until cheese is bubbly. Serve with taco chips.

recipes.title: Banana Nut Bread
directions: Cream butter, sugar, oil, eggs and crushed bananas; sift flour and all the spices.
Then add to mixture.
Add raisins and nuts last.
Beat well.
Bake at 350°.
Use tube pan or loaf pan.
Let cool on a rack in pan for 10 to 15 minutes.
Then dump.
recipes.text: Banana Nut Bread. Cream butter, sugar, oil, eggs and crushed bananas; sift flour and all the spices. Then add to mixture. Add raisins and nuts last. Beat well. Bake at 350°. Use tube pan or loaf pan. Let cool on a rack in pan for 10 to 15 minutes. Then dump.

recipes.title: Broccoli Cheddar Meat Loaf
ingredients: 1 (10 oz.) pkg. frozen chopped broccoli, thawed and drained
directions: Finely roll 12 crackers.
Mix cracker crumbs, turkey, onions, 2 tablespoons chili sauce, parsley and egg.
On waxed paper, pat meat mixture into 12 x 6-inch rectangle.
recipes.text: Broccoli Cheddar Meat Loaf. Finely roll 12 crackers. Mix cracker crumbs, turkey, onions, 2 tablespoons chili sauce, parsley and egg. On waxed paper, pat meat mixture into 12 x 6-inch rectangle.

recipes.title: Old Fashioned Chess Pie
directions: Mix all ingredients together and put in frozen pie shell. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Old Fashioned Chess Pie. Mix all ingredients together and put in frozen pie shell. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Beef Stroganoff
directions: Brown steak and saute with onions and mushrooms.
Add rest of the ingredients and then add sour cream.
Serve over buttered noodles with poppy seed.
recipes.text: Beef Stroganoff. Brown steak and saute with onions and mushrooms. Add rest of the ingredients and then add sour cream. Serve over buttered noodles with poppy seed.

recipes.title: Easy Pecan Pie
directions: In large bowl stir first 5 ingredients until well blended. Stir in pecans.
Pour into pie shell.
Bake in 350° oven for 50 to 55 minutes.
Cool.
recipes.text: Easy Pecan Pie. In large bowl stir first 5 ingredients until well blended. Stir in pecans. Pour into pie shell. Bake in 350° oven for 50 to 55 minutes. Cool.

recipes.title: Pineapple Cheese Ball
ingredients: 2 pkg. (8 oz. size) cream cheese, softened
directions: In medium bowl with fork, beat cream cheese until smooth. Gradually stir in crushed pineapple, 1 cup pecans, green pepper, onion and salt.
Shape into a ball. Roll in remaining nuts.
Wrap in plastic film or foil.
Refrigerate until well chilled, overnight.
recipes.text: Pineapple Cheese Ball. In medium bowl with fork, beat cream cheese until smooth. Gradually stir in crushed pineapple, 1 cup pecans, green pepper, onion and salt. Shape into a ball. Roll in remaining nuts. Wrap in plastic film or foil. Refrigerate until well chilled, overnight.

recipes.title: Delicious Meatballs And Gravy
directions: Chop onion; add garlic to oil in a large pot.
Saute until soft (do not burn).
Strain tomatoes.
Add this to the onions and garlic, plus puree, salt, black pepper, water and sugar.
Cook this for 1 hour, low to medium heat.
recipes.text: Delicious Meatballs And Gravy. Chop onion; add garlic to oil in a large pot. Saute until soft (do not burn). Strain tomatoes. Add this to the onions and garlic, plus puree, salt, black pepper, water and sugar. Cook this for 1 hour, low to medium heat.

recipes.title: Homemade Bisquick
directions: Mix well and store in tight container.
recipes.text: Homemade Bisquick. Mix well and store in tight container.

recipes.title: Mama'S Salad
directions: Slice lettuce and lay on a platter.
Spread on mayonnaise and sprinkle with cheese.
If salad is to be eaten as a dessert, add sliced pears or peaches on top.
recipes.text: Mama'S Salad. Slice lettuce and lay on a platter. Spread on mayonnaise and sprinkle with cheese. If salad is to be eaten as a dessert, add sliced pears or peaches on top.

recipes.title: Freezer Jam
directions: In large microwave-safe bowl, combine strawberries, sugar and lemon juice.
Cover loosely and microwave on High (100%) for 15 minutes.
Stir mixture to dissolve sugar.
Microwave on High (100%), uncovered, 50 minutes.
Stir mixture well and check for doneness.
recipes.text: Freezer Jam. In large microwave-safe bowl, combine strawberries, sugar and lemon juice. Cover loosely and microwave on High (100%) for 15 minutes. Stir mixture to dissolve sugar. Microwave on High (100%), uncovered, 50 minutes. Stir mixture well and check for doneness.

recipes.title: Hot Sauce
ingredients: 5 qt. tomatoes (20 lb., grocery bag full)
directions: Chop. Bring to a
boil and cook 15 to 20 minutes.
Put through blender.
Seal in sterilized jars.
recipes.text: Hot Sauce. Chop. Bring to a boil and cook 15 to 20 minutes. Put through blender. Seal in sterilized jars.

recipes.title: Aunt Kim'S Cheesy Chicken Spaghetti
directions: Boil chicken and remove.
Add soup, cheese and spaghetti to broth and bring to a boil.
Debone chicken and add to mixture. Simmer until cheese is melted and spaghetti is done.
recipes.text: Aunt Kim'S Cheesy Chicken Spaghetti. Boil chicken and remove. Add soup, cheese and spaghetti to broth and bring to a boil. Debone chicken and add to mixture. Simmer until cheese is melted and spaghetti is done.

recipes.title: Crock-Pot Beans
directions: Saute turkey bacon, ground beef and onion; put in crock-pot. Add all other ingredients.
Cook until heated to own satisfaction.
recipes.text: Crock-Pot Beans. Saute turkey bacon, ground beef and onion; put in crock-pot. Add all other ingredients. Cook until heated to own satisfaction.

recipes.title: Cherry Dessert
directions: Mix first 4 ingredients.
Melt butter; pour over mixture and mix well.
Reserve some crumbs for topping.
Press into bottom and sides of jelly roll pan.
Cover with cherry pie filling.
Sprinkle with crumbs.
Bake at 350° for 1/2 hour, then at 300° for 15 minutes.
Serves about 20.
recipes.text: Cherry Dessert. Mix first 4 ingredients. Melt butter; pour over mixture and mix well. Reserve some crumbs for topping. Press into bottom and sides of jelly roll pan. Cover with cherry pie filling. Sprinkle with crumbs. Bake at 350° for 1/2 hour, then at 300° for 15 minutes. Serves about 20.

recipes.title: Chocolate Cherry Cake
ingredients: 1 pkg. Duncan Hines fudge cake mix
directions: Mix all by hand until well mixed.
Pour into greased and floured 10 x 15-inch pan.
Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.
Test it.
recipes.text: Chocolate Cherry Cake. Mix all by hand until well mixed. Pour into greased and floured 10 x 15-inch pan. Bake at 350° for 25 minutes. Test it.

recipes.title: Vegetable Salad
directions: Mix ingredients and cook until thick.
Cool and pour over vegetables.
recipes.text: Vegetable Salad. Mix ingredients and cook until thick. Cool and pour over vegetables.

recipes.title: Venison Burgers
directions: Mix well all seasonings and the ground venison.
Form into patties and cook on gas grill or charcoal grill.
Wonderful and fat-free.
recipes.text: Venison Burgers. Mix well all seasonings and the ground venison. Form into patties and cook on gas grill or charcoal grill. Wonderful and fat-free.

recipes.title: Caramel Icing
directions: Melt butter until brown.
Add brown sugar and cook, stirring, until sugar is melted.
Pour in milk and stir.
Cool.
Add confectioners sugar and extract.
Beat.
recipes.text: Caramel Icing. Melt butter until brown. Add brown sugar and cook, stirring, until sugar is melted. Pour in milk and stir. Cool. Add confectioners sugar and extract. Beat.

recipes.title: Cheddar Apple Bread
ingredients: 2 c. (8 oz.) shredded sharp Cheddar cheese
directions: Combine dry ingredients.
Add combined eggs, milk and margarine.
Mix well.
Stir in remaining ingredients.
Spoon into well-greased and floured 9 x 5-inch loaf pan.
Bake at 350° for 65 to 70 minutes or until wooden toothpick inserted in center comes out clean.
Let stand 5 minutes before removing from pan.
Yield: 1 loaf.
recipes.text: Cheddar Apple Bread. Combine dry ingredients. Add combined eggs, milk and margarine. Mix well. Stir in remaining ingredients. Spoon into well-greased and floured 9 x 5-inch loaf pan. Bake at 350° for 65 to 70 minutes or until wooden toothpick inserted in center comes out clean. Let stand 5 minutes before removing from pan. Yield: 1 loaf.

recipes.title: Apricot Salad
ingredients: 1 large jar apricot baby food with tapioca
directions: Mix
Jell-O,
sugar and water and bring to a boil.
Add cream cheese,
pineapple	and
baby food.
Fold in Cool Whip. Pour mixture into a dish, top with chopped nuts and chill.
recipes.text: Apricot Salad. Mix Jell-O, sugar and water and bring to a boil. Add cream cheese, pineapple	and baby food. Fold in Cool Whip. Pour mixture into a dish, top with chopped nuts and chill.

recipes.title: Frozen Cherry Delight
ingredients: 1 can Eagle Brand sweetened condensed milk
directions: Combine pie filling, milk, pineapple, lemon juice, coconut and nuts.
Stir until well mixed.
Add Cool Whip and fold together. Pour into large Tupperware container and freeze.
recipes.text: Frozen Cherry Delight. Combine pie filling, milk, pineapple, lemon juice, coconut and nuts. Stir until well mixed. Add Cool Whip and fold together. Pour into large Tupperware container and freeze.

recipes.title: Apricot-Almond Upside Down Cake
ingredients: 1 pkg. 1 layer size yellow cake mix
directions: Drain apricots, reserving 2 tablespoons syrup.
Preheat oven to 350°.
Place butter or margarine in a 9x1 1/2-inch round baking pan.
Melt butter in pan in oven while preheating.
Remove pan.
recipes.text: Apricot-Almond Upside Down Cake. Drain apricots, reserving 2 tablespoons syrup. Preheat oven to 350°. Place butter or margarine in a 9x1 1/2-inch round baking pan. Melt butter in pan in oven while preheating. Remove pan.

recipes.title: Orange Slice Cake
directions: Chop orange slices, dates and nuts; with coconut, add to melted margarine.
Let stand.
recipes.text: Orange Slice Cake. Chop orange slices, dates and nuts; with coconut, add to melted margarine. Let stand.

recipes.title: French Onion Beef Au Jus(Good, Delicious, Worth The Time)
ingredients: 3 to 4 lb. roast (boneless rump, bottom round or tip)
directions: Lightly brown onion in butter.
Combine soy sauce, garlic, browning sauce, onion soup mix and 5 cups water.
Place roast in 4-quart casserole or Dutch oven.
Add soy sauce mixture and onions.
Cover tightly.
Bake for 2 1/2 hours at 325°.
recipes.text: French Onion Beef Au Jus(Good, Delicious, Worth The Time). Lightly brown onion in butter. Combine soy sauce, garlic, browning sauce, onion soup mix and 5 cups water. Place roast in 4-quart casserole or Dutch oven. Add soy sauce mixture and onions. Cover tightly. Bake for 2 1/2 hours at 325°.

recipes.title: Chocolate Delight
ingredients: 2 pkg. small (3 1/8 oz.) instant dark chocolate pudding
directions: Mix margarine, flour and pecans together and pat into a 9 x 13-inch dish or pan.
Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes.
Let cool. Mix cream cheese, powdered sugar and Cool Whip.
Spread over the crust.
Prepare chocolate pudding with milk until thick and spread over second layer.
Top with remaining Cool Whip and sprinkle with sweet chocolate shavings.
Chill.
recipes.text: Chocolate Delight. Mix margarine, flour and pecans together and pat into a 9 x 13-inch dish or pan. Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes. Let cool. Mix cream cheese, powdered sugar and Cool Whip. Spread over the crust. Prepare chocolate pudding with milk until thick and spread over second layer. Top with remaining Cool Whip and sprinkle with sweet chocolate shavings. Chill.

recipes.title: Spicy Vegetable Soup
ingredients: 1 (30 oz.) jar chunky garden style spaghetti sauce with mushrooms and green pepper
1 (10 oz.) can diced tomatoes and green chiles
directions: Saute onion and garlic.
Brown ground beef.
Mix other ingredients; simmer 30 to 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Spicy Vegetable Soup. Saute onion and garlic. Brown ground beef. Mix other ingredients; simmer 30 to 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Black Bean Salad
directions: Soak and cook beans according to package directions or substitute 2 cans black beans, drained.
Add all ingredients and stir.
This keeps well and is good warm or cold.
recipes.text: Black Bean Salad. Soak and cook beans according to package directions or substitute 2 cans black beans, drained. Add all ingredients and stir. This keeps well and is good warm or cold.

recipes.title: Jean'S Chicken
directions: Place rice in bottom of pan.
Place chicken on top.
Mix together soups, milk and water and pour over chicken and rice. Sprinkle onion soup over all.
Seal tightly with foil.
Bake at 325° for 1 hour and 15 minutes.
recipes.text: Jean'S Chicken. Place rice in bottom of pan. Place chicken on top. Mix together soups, milk and water and pour over chicken and rice. Sprinkle onion soup over all. Seal tightly with foil. Bake at 325° for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Chocolate Chews
directions: In saucepan, melt margarine over medium heat; stir in syrup and cocoa.
Bring to a boil.
Remove from heat.
Add vanilla, 2 cups powdered sugar and milk powder.
Mixture will be stiff.
Turn out onto surface dusted with confectioners sugar; knead 3 or 4 minutes or until stiff.
Divide into 4 pieces and roll into an 18-inch rope.
Cut into 3/4-inch pieces.
Wrap each in cellophane or waxed paper.
Store in refrigerator.
Makes 8 dozen.
recipes.text: Chocolate Chews. In saucepan, melt margarine over medium heat; stir in syrup and cocoa. Bring to a boil. Remove from heat. Add vanilla, 2 cups powdered sugar and milk powder. Mixture will be stiff. Turn out onto surface dusted with confectioners sugar; knead 3 or 4 minutes or until stiff. Divide into 4 pieces and roll into an 18-inch rope. Cut into 3/4-inch pieces. Wrap each in cellophane or waxed paper. Store in refrigerator. Makes 8 dozen.

recipes.title: Monkey Bread
ingredients: 1 pkg. frozen hot rolls (24 or more)
directions: Coat tube pan with Pam.
About 8 hours before serving (night before), put frozen rolls in tube pan.
Melt butter and pour over rolls.
Combine sugar and cinnamon.
Sprinkle over rolls.
Spread pecans and then pudding over rolls.
Spray Pam on waxed paper or Saran Wrap and place loosely over tube pan.
Leave at room temperature.
recipes.text: Monkey Bread. Coat tube pan with Pam. About 8 hours before serving (night before), put frozen rolls in tube pan. Melt butter and pour over rolls. Combine sugar and cinnamon. Sprinkle over rolls. Spread pecans and then pudding over rolls. Spray Pam on waxed paper or Saran Wrap and place loosely over tube pan. Leave at room temperature.

recipes.title: Cheese Biscuits
ingredients: 1 c. self-rising flour plus 1 tsp. baking flour
directions: Combine dry ingredients.
Cut in butter and cheese.
Add pimentos, milk; drop dough the size of an egg on greased cookie sheet.
Bake at 375° for 10 to 15 minutes.
Garlic powder can be used.
recipes.text: Cheese Biscuits. Combine dry ingredients. Cut in butter and cheese. Add pimentos, milk; drop dough the size of an egg on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 375° for 10 to 15 minutes. Garlic powder can be used.

recipes.title: Taco Salad
ingredients: 1/3 c. Ro-Tel tomatoes and green chilies
directions: Prepare taco filling with ground beef and taco sauce mix according to package directions. Melt cheese with tomatoes and green chilies.
Mix shredded lettuce, tomatoes, meat and 1/4 of the corn chips in a salad bowl.
Pour cheese mixture over top with remaining corn chips.
Serve immediately.
Serves 4.
recipes.text: Taco Salad. Prepare taco filling with ground beef and taco sauce mix according to package directions. Melt cheese with tomatoes and green chilies. Mix shredded lettuce, tomatoes, meat and 1/4 of the corn chips in a salad bowl. Pour cheese mixture over top with remaining corn chips. Serve immediately. Serves 4.

recipes.title: Soft Pretzels
directions: Stir water and yeast in bowl until dissolved.
Add salt, sugar and flour.
Mix.
Knead and roll into shapes.
Place on greased cookie sheets.
Sprinkle with salt, if desired.
Let rise 20 to 30 minutes.
Bake at 425° for 12 to 15 minutes.
recipes.text: Soft Pretzels. Stir water and yeast in bowl until dissolved. Add salt, sugar and flour. Mix. Knead and roll into shapes. Place on greased cookie sheets. Sprinkle with salt, if desired. Let rise 20 to 30 minutes. Bake at 425° for 12 to 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Old-Fashion Custard Pie
directions: Pour
into unbaked pie shell.
Bake until done or until inserted knife is removed clean.
Makes 1 (9-inch) pie.
recipes.text: Old-Fashion Custard Pie. Pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake until done or until inserted knife is removed clean. Makes 1 (9-inch) pie.

recipes.title: Tomato Scallop
directions: Melt 4 tablespoons margarine in skillet.
Stir in crumbs and toast until brown.
Set aside.
Melt 2 tablespoons margarine in pan.
Stir in onion.
Brown until golden.
Add tomatoes, tapioca and seasoning.
Cook 5 minutes.
Butter casserole and put in layer of crumbs.
Add tomato mixture, cheese and olives repeatedly.
Top with remaining crumbs.
Bake 40 minutes at 350°.
recipes.text: Tomato Scallop. Melt 4 tablespoons margarine in skillet. Stir in crumbs and toast until brown. Set aside. Melt 2 tablespoons margarine in pan. Stir in onion. Brown until golden. Add tomatoes, tapioca and seasoning. Cook 5 minutes. Butter casserole and put in layer of crumbs. Add tomato mixture, cheese and olives repeatedly. Top with remaining crumbs. Bake 40 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Pepper Steak
ingredients: 2 large green peppers, cut in strips
directions: Brown meat, draining off and discarding fat.
Heat oven to 350°.
Pour 1/2 cup sauce in the bottom of a 9 x 13-inch baking dish.
Top with 3 noodles (the noodles won't quite fill the bottom).
Just space them evenly and they will expand to fill gaps. Mix cottage cheese, eggs, salt, pepper, Italian seasoning, garlic powder and Parmesan cheese.
Top with 1/3 of the cheese mixture, mashing it with your fingers or a fork to spread it around the noodles.
It won't be even, but that's okay.
Top with 1/3 of the sauce.
Next layer:
3 noodles, cottage cheese, meat and sauce. Top layer:
3 noodles, cottage cheese, rest of sauce, 8 ounces grated Mozzarella cheese.
Cover the dish tightly with foil and bake for 1 hour.
Remove cover and bake 15 minutes longer.
Let sit 10 minutes before serving.
Serves 6.
recipes.text: Pepper Steak. Brown meat, draining off and discarding fat. Heat oven to 350°. Pour 1/2 cup sauce in the bottom of a 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Top with 3 noodles (the noodles won't quite fill the bottom). Just space them evenly and they will expand to fill gaps. Mix cottage cheese, eggs, salt, pepper, Italian seasoning, garlic powder and Parmesan cheese. Top with 1/3 of the cheese mixture, mashing it with your fingers or a fork to spread it around the noodles. It won't be even, but that's okay. Top with 1/3 of the sauce. Next layer: 3 noodles, cottage cheese, meat and sauce. Top layer: 3 noodles, cottage cheese, rest of sauce, 8 ounces grated Mozzarella cheese. Cover the dish tightly with foil and bake for 1 hour. Remove cover and bake 15 minutes longer. Let sit 10 minutes before serving. Serves 6.

recipes.title: Icing For Carrot Cake
directions: Cream together softened cream cheese and butter. Add salt and lemon juice. Slowly add powdered sugar.
Mix until smooth. Spread on cooled cake.
recipes.text: Icing For Carrot Cake. Cream together softened cream cheese and butter. Add salt and lemon juice. Slowly add powdered sugar. Mix until smooth. Spread on cooled cake.

recipes.title: Zucchini Lasagna
directions: In skillet, brown ground beef and onion.
Drain fat.
Add tomato sauce, salt, oregano, basil and pepper.
Bring to boil, simmer 5 minutes.
In small bowl, combine cottage cheese and egg. In a greased 12 x 8 x 2-inch pan, place 2 medium zucchini, sliced crosswise into 1/4-inch slices.
Sprinkle with 1 1/2 tablespoons flour. Top with cheese mixture and half the meat mixture.
Place 2 more zucchini sliced the same on top of this, sprinkled with another 1 1/2 tablespoons flour and sprinkle with Mozzarella cheese and then remaining meat mixture.
Bake at 375° for around 40 minutes.
Remove from oven and sprinkle with additional cheese. Let stand 10 minutes before cutting to serve.
recipes.text: Zucchini Lasagna. In skillet, brown ground beef and onion. Drain fat. Add tomato sauce, salt, oregano, basil and pepper. Bring to boil, simmer 5 minutes. In small bowl, combine cottage cheese and egg. In a greased 12 x 8 x 2-inch pan, place 2 medium zucchini, sliced crosswise into 1/4-inch slices. Sprinkle with 1 1/2 tablespoons flour. Top with cheese mixture and half the meat mixture. Place 2 more zucchini sliced the same on top of this, sprinkled with another 1 1/2 tablespoons flour and sprinkle with Mozzarella cheese and then remaining meat mixture. Bake at 375° for around 40 minutes. Remove from oven and sprinkle with additional cheese. Let stand 10 minutes before cutting to serve.

recipes.title: Sour Cream Banana Nut Bread
directions: Mix together in order as given.
Grease 9 x 5-inch loaf pan and smaller pan.
Put 2/3 of batter in 9 x 5-inch pan and remaining in smaller pan.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Sour Cream Banana Nut Bread. Mix together in order as given. Grease 9 x 5-inch loaf pan and smaller pan. Put 2/3 of batter in 9 x 5-inch pan and remaining in smaller pan. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Creamy Banana Pudding
ingredients: 3 medium bananas, sliced and dipped in lemon juice
directions: Combine condensed milk and water.
Add pudding mix and beat well.
Fold in whipping cream.
recipes.text: Creamy Banana Pudding. Combine condensed milk and water. Add pudding mix and beat well. Fold in whipping cream.

recipes.title: Broccoli Cheese Casserole
ingredients: 1 c. Cheddar cheese (up to 1 c. additional if desired)
directions: Cook broccoli per package directions.
Mix broccoli in casserole dish with mayonnaise, soup and cheese.
Brown bread crumbs in butter.
Place on top of casserole.
Bake until bubbling, about 45 minutes to an hour at 375°.
recipes.text: Broccoli Cheese Casserole. Cook broccoli per package directions. Mix broccoli in casserole dish with mayonnaise, soup and cheese. Brown bread crumbs in butter. Place on top of casserole. Bake until bubbling, about 45 minutes to an hour at 375°.

recipes.title: Impossible Broccoli Pie
ingredients: 2 pkg. (10 oz. each) frozen chopped broccoli
directions: Grease 10-inch pie plate.
Rinse broccoli under cold water to thaw.
Drain thoroughly.
Mix broccoli, 2 cups cheese and the onion in the pie plate.
Beat milk, eggs, baking mix, salt and pepper until smooth.
Pour into plate over broccoli.
Bake at 400° until a knife inserted in center comes out clean.
Top with remaining cheese.
Bake further until cheese melts.
Let stand 5 minutes before serving.
recipes.text: Impossible Broccoli Pie. Grease 10-inch pie plate. Rinse broccoli under cold water to thaw. Drain thoroughly. Mix broccoli, 2 cups cheese and the onion in the pie plate. Beat milk, eggs, baking mix, salt and pepper until smooth. Pour into plate over broccoli. Bake at 400° until a knife inserted in center comes out clean. Top with remaining cheese. Bake further until cheese melts. Let stand 5 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Cranberry Salad
ingredients: 1 bunch red grapes, pitted and quartered
directions: Mix jello and chill until slightly thickened.
Add remaining ingredients and chill until ready to serve.
Even makes a good dessert.
recipes.text: Cranberry Salad. Mix jello and chill until slightly thickened. Add remaining ingredients and chill until ready to serve. Even makes a good dessert.

recipes.title: Tasty Pastries
directions: Dissolve yeast in warm water and set aside.
Crumble pie crust into bowl and stir in granulated sugar, egg yolk and yeast mixture. Mix well.
Roll dough into balls the size of a small walnut.
Place on ungreased baking sheets.
Make a deep indentation in center of each ball, shaping into shells that are 1 1/2-inches in diameter and 1/4-inch deep.
Spoon 1 teaspoon preserves into each shell. Let rise in warm place for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Tasty Pastries. Dissolve yeast in warm water and set aside. Crumble pie crust into bowl and stir in granulated sugar, egg yolk and yeast mixture. Mix well. Roll dough into balls the size of a small walnut. Place on ungreased baking sheets. Make a deep indentation in center of each ball, shaping into shells that are 1 1/2-inches in diameter and 1/4-inch deep. Spoon 1 teaspoon preserves into each shell. Let rise in warm place for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Peaches And Cream
directions: Beat the cream cheese and preserves in a mixing bowl with an electric mixer until well blended. Stir in the pineapple. Place the peach halves cut side up on a lettuce-lined platter. Fill each half with some of the cream cheese mixture. Garnish with fresh mint if desired. Serves about 15.
recipes.text: Peaches And Cream. Beat the cream cheese and preserves in a mixing bowl with an electric mixer until well blended. Stir in the pineapple. Place the peach halves cut side up on a lettuce-lined platter. Fill each half with some of the cream cheese mixture. Garnish with fresh mint if desired. Serves about 15.

recipes.title: Bread Pudding
directions: Moisten bread with water and drain well.
Add the evaporated milk and knead it with your fingers.
Add eggs, 1 cup sugar, coconut milk, cinnamon, ginger, butter, raisins and vanilla.
recipes.text: Bread Pudding. Moisten bread with water and drain well. Add the evaporated milk and knead it with your fingers. Add eggs, 1 cup sugar, coconut milk, cinnamon, ginger, butter, raisins and vanilla.

recipes.title: Mashed Potato Casserole
directions: Boil potatoes and mash with sour cream and cream cheese. Place in baking dish.
Dot with butter.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Mashed Potato Casserole. Boil potatoes and mash with sour cream and cream cheese. Place in baking dish. Dot with butter. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Veg-All Casserole
directions: Mix all together except crackers and oleo.
Put in casserole dish.
Melt oleo and mix with crumbled crackers; spread over top of Veg-All mix.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Veg-All Casserole. Mix all together except crackers and oleo. Put in casserole dish. Melt oleo and mix with crumbled crackers; spread over top of Veg-All mix. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Potatoes Romanoff
directions: Cook potatoes until tender; drain.
Chop coarsely or shred. Combine with all the other ingredients except for 1/3 the cheese and paprika.
Pour in shallow baking dish.
Put remaining cheese and paprika on top.
Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.
recipes.text: Potatoes Romanoff. Cook potatoes until tender; drain. Chop coarsely or shred. Combine with all the other ingredients except for 1/3 the cheese and paprika. Pour in shallow baking dish. Put remaining cheese and paprika on top. Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Delicious Pecan Pie
directions: Combine oleo, sugar and syrup.
Cook over low heat, stirring constantly until sugar is dissolved (do not boil).
Let cool slightly.
Add to beaten eggs, vanilla, salt and pecans.
Pour in unbaked pie crust.
Bake in 325° oven for about 40 minutes or until brown.
recipes.text: Delicious Pecan Pie. Combine oleo, sugar and syrup. Cook over low heat, stirring constantly until sugar is dissolved (do not boil). Let cool slightly. Add to beaten eggs, vanilla, salt and pecans. Pour in unbaked pie crust. Bake in 325° oven for about 40 minutes or until brown.

recipes.title: Christmas Porridge(Risengrynsgrot)
directions: Put all 4 of the ingredients together in top of a double boiler.
Cover and cook over simmering water 2 1/2 to 3 hours, or until rice is entirely soft when a kernel is pressed between fingers and the mixture is quite thick.
Remove cover for last 10 minutes if mixture is not thick enough.
Serve with cool milk, sugar, cinnamon or serve with a fruit sauce.
recipes.text: Christmas Porridge(Risengrynsgrot). Put all 4 of the ingredients together in top of a double boiler. Cover and cook over simmering water 2 1/2 to 3 hours, or until rice is entirely soft when a kernel is pressed between fingers and the mixture is quite thick. Remove cover for last 10 minutes if mixture is not thick enough. Serve with cool milk, sugar, cinnamon or serve with a fruit sauce.

recipes.title: Chocolate Chip Pie
directions: Scald milk.
Beat 2 egg yolks.
Add 2 tablespoons scalded milk to yolks.
Mix well.
Add yolk to rest of scalded mix.
Cook until it coats a metal spoon.
Dissolve gelatine in cold water.
Add gelatine to milk.
Add 2 1/2 tablespoons sugar, salt and vanilla to milk.
Stir until well mixed.
Remove from heat.
Cool to room temperature.
Beat egg whites until stiff, gradually adding 3 tablespoons sugar.
Fold egg whites to cooled yolk mixture.
Pour in crust.
Sprinkle with chopped chips.
Refrigerate.
When served, top with whipped cream.
recipes.text: Chocolate Chip Pie. Scald milk. Beat 2 egg yolks. Add 2 tablespoons scalded milk to yolks. Mix well. Add yolk to rest of scalded mix. Cook until it coats a metal spoon. Dissolve gelatine in cold water. Add gelatine to milk. Add 2 1/2 tablespoons sugar, salt and vanilla to milk. Stir until well mixed. Remove from heat. Cool to room temperature. Beat egg whites until stiff, gradually adding 3 tablespoons sugar. Fold egg whites to cooled yolk mixture. Pour in crust. Sprinkle with chopped chips. Refrigerate. When served, top with whipped cream.

recipes.title: Asparagus Casserole
directions: Mix soup, milk, cheese and 1/2 the eggs together.
Gently toss with asparagus.
Top with remaining eggs and a little more cheese, crackers and a few pats of butter.
Bake at 375° until hot and bubbly.
recipes.text: Asparagus Casserole. Mix soup, milk, cheese and 1/2 the eggs together. Gently toss with asparagus. Top with remaining eggs and a little more cheese, crackers and a few pats of butter. Bake at 375° until hot and bubbly.

recipes.title: Pecan Pie
ingredients: 2 c. Karo or maple syrup (your choice)
directions: Mix together and bake in oven at 325° for 55 to 60 minutes.
recipes.text: Pecan Pie. Mix together and bake in oven at 325° for 55 to 60 minutes.

recipes.title: Ice Cream Sandwich Cake
directions: 1st Layer:
Place 4 to 6 ice cream sandwiches in bottom of dish.
Cover with Cool Whip.
Drizzle chocolate syrup on top. Sprinkle with nuts (optional).
recipes.text: Ice Cream Sandwich Cake. 1st Layer: Place 4 to 6 ice cream sandwiches in bottom of dish. Cover with Cool Whip. Drizzle chocolate syrup on top. Sprinkle with nuts (optional).

recipes.title: Strawberry Punch
ingredients: 2 small cans frozen lemonade plus water
directions: Dissolve jello in 2 cups hot water; add sugar and stir until dissolved.
Add 2 cups cold water and other ingredients.
Stir well.
Freeze mixture in 2 plastic containers.
Set out of freezer for 2 1/2 hours before serving.
Add ginger ale.
recipes.text: Strawberry Punch. Dissolve jello in 2 cups hot water; add sugar and stir until dissolved. Add 2 cups cold water and other ingredients. Stir well. Freeze mixture in 2 plastic containers. Set out of freezer for 2 1/2 hours before serving. Add ginger ale.

recipes.title: Mexican Layered Dip
ingredients: 1 c. (4 oz.) shredded Jack or Cheddar cheese
1 (2 1/4 oz.) can sliced ripe olives, drained
directions: In a 10-inch glass pie plate, spread beans.
Layer remaining ingredients in the order listed.
Serve with tortilla chips. Serves 8.
recipes.text: Mexican Layered Dip. In a 10-inch glass pie plate, spread beans. Layer remaining ingredients in the order listed. Serve with tortilla chips. Serves 8.

recipes.title: Italian Sausage
directions: Cut sausage into pieces.
Slice onion and pepper.
Fry in covered pan until browned.
Place noodles in 6 quarts boiling water.
Return to second boil, stirring occasionally, until tender.
Add sausage mixture and spaghetti sauce and pour over drained noodles.
Makes approximately 8 (1/2 cup) servings.
recipes.text: Italian Sausage. Cut sausage into pieces. Slice onion and pepper. Fry in covered pan until browned. Place noodles in 6 quarts boiling water. Return to second boil, stirring occasionally, until tender. Add sausage mixture and spaghetti sauce and pour over drained noodles. Makes approximately 8 (1/2 cup) servings.

recipes.title: Main Dish Tater Soup
directions: Cook potatoes, onion, butter and bay leaf over medium heat in a nonstick pan; stir almost constantly.
Add chicken broth.
Cook on medium heat for 30 minutes.
Mix milk and flour in blender; add to potato mixture and cook until thick.
Remove from heat.
Add sour cream and stir until smooth.
Garnish with Cheddar cheese and bacon bits.
Serves 4 to 6.
recipes.text: Main Dish Tater Soup. Cook potatoes, onion, butter and bay leaf over medium heat in a nonstick pan; stir almost constantly. Add chicken broth. Cook on medium heat for 30 minutes. Mix milk and flour in blender; add to potato mixture and cook until thick. Remove from heat. Add sour cream and stir until smooth. Garnish with Cheddar cheese and bacon bits. Serves 4 to 6.

recipes.title: Cherry Salad
directions: Mix cherries, sugar and jello.
Cook in saucepan until comes to a boil.
Let it cool and then add pineapple and nuts.
Stir well and refrigerate.
(May wish to use potato masher and mash cherries after cooking for better consistency.)
recipes.text: Cherry Salad. Mix cherries, sugar and jello. Cook in saucepan until comes to a boil. Let it cool and then add pineapple and nuts. Stir well and refrigerate. (May wish to use potato masher and mash cherries after cooking for better consistency.)

recipes.title: Spaghetti Pie
ingredients: 4 oz. Mozzarella cheese, sliced or grated
directions: Break spaghetti in half; cook in boiling water until done. Drain while warm.
Combine eggs and Parmesan with spaghetti.
Pour into greased pie plate and pat mixture up and around sides with a spoon.
Melt butter.
Add onion; saute until limp.
Stir in sour cream with onion and spoon over spaghetti "shell."
Brown sausage and beef in skillet; drain off fat.
Add tomato paste and water; simmer for 10 minutes.
Spoon meat over sour cream mixture.
Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.
recipes.text: Spaghetti Pie. Break spaghetti in half; cook in boiling water until done. Drain while warm. Combine eggs and Parmesan with spaghetti. Pour into greased pie plate and pat mixture up and around sides with a spoon. Melt butter. Add onion; saute until limp. Stir in sour cream with onion and spoon over spaghetti "shell." Brown sausage and beef in skillet; drain off fat. Add tomato paste and water; simmer for 10 minutes. Spoon meat over sour cream mixture. Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.

recipes.title: "Crabby" Alfredo(Cheap, Quick And Easy)
directions: Boil noodles according to directions.
Prepare alfredo sauce according to directions on package.
Heat imitation crab meat in microwave until very warm.
Mix crabby meat with alfredo sauce. Serve over fettucine noodles.
Add a tossed salad and you have a wonderful meal!
recipes.text: "Crabby" Alfredo(Cheap, Quick And Easy). Boil noodles according to directions. Prepare alfredo sauce according to directions on package. Heat imitation crab meat in microwave until very warm. Mix crabby meat with alfredo sauce. Serve over fettucine noodles. Add a tossed salad and you have a wonderful meal!

recipes.title: Cinnamon Roll
directions: Cut shortening into dry ingredients.
Dissolve yeast in 1/4 cup warm water.
Stir into buttermilk.
Divide dough in half. Roll out each half flat with rolling pin, brush melted butter on rolled out dough.
Sprinkle heavily with cinnamon, then sugar, then roll up dough long ways, lay in greased Bundt pan.
Bake at 450°.
recipes.text: Cinnamon Roll. Cut shortening into dry ingredients. Dissolve yeast in 1/4 cup warm water. Stir into buttermilk. Divide dough in half. Roll out each half flat with rolling pin, brush melted butter on rolled out dough. Sprinkle heavily with cinnamon, then sugar, then roll up dough long ways, lay in greased Bundt pan. Bake at 450°.

recipes.title: Sausage Skillet Express
ingredients: 1 lb. smoked sausage, cut into 1/4-inch slices
1 (4 oz.) can mushroom stems and pieces, undrained
directions: Combine sausage, celery and onions in a large skillet; cook over medium heat, stirring often, until vegetables are tender. Drain well.
Add the next 6 ingredients; bring to a boil.
Stir in rice.
Remove from heat.
Cover and let stand 10 minutes.
Makes 6 servings.
recipes.text: Sausage Skillet Express. Combine sausage, celery and onions in a large skillet; cook over medium heat, stirring often, until vegetables are tender. Drain well. Add the next 6 ingredients; bring to a boil. Stir in rice. Remove from heat. Cover and let stand 10 minutes. Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Crunch Graham Treats For A Party
ingredients: 1 (18 oz.) box honey graham cereal squares
directions: Combine cereal, raisins and nuts.
Melt chocolate pieces, peanut butter and margarine in medium sized saucepan over low flame, stirring frequently.
Turn off flame; stir in vanilla. Pour melted mixture over cereal; stir until coated.
Pour 10x sugar into food storage bag.
Add cereal mixture and shake until all pieces are coated.
Store in airtight container.
Makes about 25 cups.
recipes.text: Crunch Graham Treats For A Party. Combine cereal, raisins and nuts. Melt chocolate pieces, peanut butter and margarine in medium sized saucepan over low flame, stirring frequently. Turn off flame; stir in vanilla. Pour melted mixture over cereal; stir until coated. Pour 10x sugar into food storage bag. Add cereal mixture and shake until all pieces are coated. Store in airtight container. Makes about 25 cups.

recipes.title: Crabmeat Casserole
directions: Saute celery, onions and parsley in 3 tablespoons butter. Mix all ingredients, reserving half the bread crumbs to sprinkle on top.
Bake in casserole dish at 350° until bubbly.
recipes.text: Crabmeat Casserole. Saute celery, onions and parsley in 3 tablespoons butter. Mix all ingredients, reserving half the bread crumbs to sprinkle on top. Bake in casserole dish at 350° until bubbly.

recipes.title: Chocolate Diamonds
directions: Melt chocolate and butter over hot water.
Add remaining ingredients except nuts.
Mix well.
Spread in 15 x 10 x 1-inch pan.
Sprinkle with nuts.
Bake at 400° for 12 minutes.
Cool and cut.
recipes.text: Chocolate Diamonds. Melt chocolate and butter over hot water. Add remaining ingredients except nuts. Mix well. Spread in 15 x 10 x 1-inch pan. Sprinkle with nuts. Bake at 400° for 12 minutes. Cool and cut.

recipes.title: Mother'S Fine Sugar Cookies
directions: In large bowl beat butter, sugars and salt until well blended. Add egg and vanilla and beat until fluffy.
Sift together flour, baking soda and cream of tartar.
Add to creamed mixture and blend well.
Chill for at least 2 hours.
Shape into small balls about 3/4 inch size and place on ungreased baking sheet 2 inches apart.
recipes.text: Mother'S Fine Sugar Cookies. In large bowl beat butter, sugars and salt until well blended. Add egg and vanilla and beat until fluffy. Sift together flour, baking soda and cream of tartar. Add to creamed mixture and blend well. Chill for at least 2 hours. Shape into small balls about 3/4 inch size and place on ungreased baking sheet 2 inches apart.

recipes.title: Brandon'S Chili
directions: Brown meat with onion and drain.
In large pan add meat, juice, beans, Chili-O and tomatoes.
Let simmer 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Brandon'S Chili. Brown meat with onion and drain. In large pan add meat, juice, beans, Chili-O and tomatoes. Let simmer 45 minutes.

recipes.title: New England Corny Clam Chowder
directions: In a 3-quart saucepan, saute onion in oleo until soft, but not brown.
Add broth, potatoes, seasonings and clams.
Cook, covered, 15 to 20 minutes.
Add corn and milk.
Heat through.
For richer soup, use 1 cup half and half in place of milk.
Serves 4 or 6.
recipes.text: New England Corny Clam Chowder. In a 3-quart saucepan, saute onion in oleo until soft, but not brown. Add broth, potatoes, seasonings and clams. Cook, covered, 15 to 20 minutes. Add corn and milk. Heat through. For richer soup, use 1 cup half and half in place of milk. Serves 4 or 6.

recipes.title: Broccoli Salad
directions: Combine broccoli, onion, cheese and bacon bits in bowl.
Add sugar and vinegar to salad dressing.
Mix well.
Pour over salad, tossing to coat vegetables.
Chill until ready to serve.
recipes.text: Broccoli Salad. Combine broccoli, onion, cheese and bacon bits in bowl. Add sugar and vinegar to salad dressing. Mix well. Pour over salad, tossing to coat vegetables. Chill until ready to serve.

recipes.title: Chocolate Mounds
directions: Mix sugar, coconut, pecans and salt together.
Melt butter (don't get too hot).
Add milk and vanilla.
Mix ingredients together and then form into balls.
Chill 12 to 14 hours. Mix chips and paraffin in double boiler. Stir until melted.
Dip chilled mounds in chocolate and place on wax paper.
recipes.text: Chocolate Mounds. Mix sugar, coconut, pecans and salt together. Melt butter (don't get too hot). Add milk and vanilla. Mix ingredients together and then form into balls. Chill 12 to 14 hours. Mix chips and paraffin in double boiler. Stir until melted. Dip chilled mounds in chocolate and place on wax paper.

recipes.title: Sour Cream
directions: Mix in blender.
This makes a perfect sour cream that can be used in any recipe calling for sour cream.
recipes.text: Sour Cream. Mix in blender. This makes a perfect sour cream that can be used in any recipe calling for sour cream.

recipes.title: Bird'S Nests
directions: Cream together margarine and sugar.
Add and beat in egg yolk, flour and vanilla.
Form in balls the size of walnuts.
Roll in slightly beaten egg white and then roll in chopped nuts.
Place on cookie sheet and indent in middle with thumb.
Bake 8 minutes at 350°.
Remove and press again with thumb.
Bake 10 more minutes. While still warm, fill center with jelly or jam.
recipes.text: Bird'S Nests. Cream together margarine and sugar. Add and beat in egg yolk, flour and vanilla. Form in balls the size of walnuts. Roll in slightly beaten egg white and then roll in chopped nuts. Place on cookie sheet and indent in middle with thumb. Bake 8 minutes at 350°. Remove and press again with thumb. Bake 10 more minutes. While still warm, fill center with jelly or jam.

recipes.title: Fat Cakes - 2 Doz. Doughnuts
directions: Scald milk.
Add sugar, salt and margarine; set aside. Dissolve yeast in 1/4 cup warm water.
Add milk mixture.
Add 1 cup flour, beating well by hand.
Add eggs, vanilla and nutmeg. Beat well.
Add remaining flour and beat well until smooth.
Cover and let rise 1 hour.
Stir down.
recipes.text: Fat Cakes - 2 Doz. Doughnuts. Scald milk. Add sugar, salt and margarine; set aside. Dissolve yeast in 1/4 cup warm water. Add milk mixture. Add 1 cup flour, beating well by hand. Add eggs, vanilla and nutmeg. Beat well. Add remaining flour and beat well until smooth. Cover and let rise 1 hour. Stir down.

recipes.title: Ground Beef Gumbo
ingredients: 2/3 c. each, chopped: onion, celery and green pepper
1 tsp. each: oregano, chili powder and onion powder
directions: Cook beef, onion, celery, green pepper and garlic in heavy Dutch oven until meat is brown; drain.
Stir in remaining ingredients.
Simmer, uncovered, for 1 hour. Remove bay leaves. Serve over hot rice.
Makes 1 1/2 quarts gumbo.
recipes.text: Ground Beef Gumbo. Cook beef, onion, celery, green pepper and garlic in heavy Dutch oven until meat is brown; drain. Stir in remaining ingredients. Simmer, uncovered, for 1 hour. Remove bay leaves. Serve over hot rice. Makes 1 1/2 quarts gumbo.

recipes.title: Barbecue
directions: Fry beef and onion until done.
Add all other ingredients except catsup and mustard; bring to a boil.
Remove from heat and add the rest.
recipes.text: Barbecue. Fry beef and onion until done. Add all other ingredients except catsup and mustard; bring to a boil. Remove from heat and add the rest.

recipes.title: Chocolate Eclair Cake
directions: Line a 9 x 13-inch pan with crackers.
Make pudding with milk according to package directions.
Fold into Cool Whip.
recipes.text: Chocolate Eclair Cake. Line a 9 x 13-inch pan with crackers. Make pudding with milk according to package directions. Fold into Cool Whip.

recipes.title: Black Bottom Cupcakes
directions: Sift the flour, adding the sugar, cocoa, baking soda and salt. Add the water, oil, vinegar and vanilla. Fill cupcake liners with 1/3 batter. Add spoonful cream cheese mixture. Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.
recipes.text: Black Bottom Cupcakes. Sift the flour, adding the sugar, cocoa, baking soda and salt. Add the water, oil, vinegar and vanilla. Fill cupcake liners with 1/3 batter. Add spoonful cream cheese mixture. Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.

recipes.title: Zucchini Cookies
directions: Sift together dry ingredients and set aside. Cream sugar and shortening. Add eggs, molasses and zucchini. Beat until blended. Add dry ingredients and raisins. Mix well. Bake 10 minutes at 350°. Remove at once and store in tight cover containers. Freezes well.
recipes.text: Zucchini Cookies. Sift together dry ingredients and set aside. Cream sugar and shortening. Add eggs, molasses and zucchini. Beat until blended. Add dry ingredients and raisins. Mix well. Bake 10 minutes at 350°. Remove at once and store in tight cover containers. Freezes well.

recipes.title: Pizza Macaroni
ingredients: 2 (8 oz.) cans tomato sauce with bits
directions: Cook macaroni; drain.
Brown ground beef and onions; drain. Add tomato sauce and 1/2 teaspoon salt, Italian seasoning, oregano, pepper, garlic and ketchup.
Simmer 5 to 10 minutes. Beat milk, egg and 1/2 teaspoon salt together.
Blend into macaroni and spread on greased jelly roll pan.
Cover with meat mixture; top with cheese.
Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.
recipes.text: Pizza Macaroni. Cook macaroni; drain. Brown ground beef and onions; drain. Add tomato sauce and 1/2 teaspoon salt, Italian seasoning, oregano, pepper, garlic and ketchup. Simmer 5 to 10 minutes. Beat milk, egg and 1/2 teaspoon salt together. Blend into macaroni and spread on greased jelly roll pan. Cover with meat mixture; top with cheese. Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Chicken And Green Bean Bake
directions: Cook frozen green beans for 2 to 3 minutes.
Save 1/2 cup liquid.
Pour drained beans in bottom of 2-quart casserole dish. Place cooked chicken on green beans.
Put 2 soups plus bean liquid and cheese (cut into cubes) in saucepan.
Cook until cheese is melted, stirring continually.
Pour over chicken.
Sprinkle mushrooms over top.
Bake 1 hour at 350°.
Serves 6 to 8.
Serve over cooked rice.
recipes.text: Chicken And Green Bean Bake. Cook frozen green beans for 2 to 3 minutes. Save 1/2 cup liquid. Pour drained beans in bottom of 2-quart casserole dish. Place cooked chicken on green beans. Put 2 soups plus bean liquid and cheese (cut into cubes) in saucepan. Cook until cheese is melted, stirring continually. Pour over chicken. Sprinkle mushrooms over top. Bake 1 hour at 350°. Serves 6 to 8. Serve over cooked rice.

recipes.title: Date Nut Rolls
directions: Mix together sugar, margarine, 1 cup chopped nuts, egg and vanilla flavoring over medium heat about 10 minutes or until thick.
Add Rice Krispies and nuts.
Roll into ball and then roll in coconut.
recipes.text: Date Nut Rolls. Mix together sugar, margarine, 1 cup chopped nuts, egg and vanilla flavoring over medium heat about 10 minutes or until thick. Add Rice Krispies and nuts. Roll into ball and then roll in coconut.

recipes.title: Chess Cake
directions: Mix butter cake mix, butter, one egg and chopped pecans and press into a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Mix 8 ounce package cream cheese, 1 box confectioners sugar, 3 eggs, 1 teaspoon vanilla and 1 teaspoon salt.
Mix well and pour over cake.
Bake at 350° for 35 minutes.
recipes.text: Chess Cake. Mix butter cake mix, butter, one egg and chopped pecans and press into a 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix 8 ounce package cream cheese, 1 box confectioners sugar, 3 eggs, 1 teaspoon vanilla and 1 teaspoon salt. Mix well and pour over cake. Bake at 350° for 35 minutes.

recipes.title: Chow Mein Candy
directions: Melt butterscotch morsels in double boiler, then add remaining ingredients and stir until coated.
Then spoon out on wax paper. Let set until firm.
Keep at room temperature.
recipes.text: Chow Mein Candy. Melt butterscotch morsels in double boiler, then add remaining ingredients and stir until coated. Then spoon out on wax paper. Let set until firm. Keep at room temperature.

recipes.title: Easy Macaroni And Cheese
directions: Preheat oven to 350°.
Place margarine in a 2-quart casserole and place in oven to melt margarine.
Pour macaroni into casserole with melted margarine.
Stir to coat macaroni with margarine. Sprinkle salt and pepper and shredded cheese through macaroni, toss lightly.
Pour milk over all.
Do not stir.
Do not cover while baking.
Cooking time:
1 hour.
Serves 4 to 6.
Casserole size:
2 quarts.
recipes.text: Easy Macaroni And Cheese. Preheat oven to 350°. Place margarine in a 2-quart casserole and place in oven to melt margarine. Pour macaroni into casserole with melted margarine. Stir to coat macaroni with margarine. Sprinkle salt and pepper and shredded cheese through macaroni, toss lightly. Pour milk over all. Do not stir. Do not cover while baking. Cooking time: 1 hour. Serves 4 to 6. Casserole size: 2 quarts.

recipes.title: Broccoli Casserole
ingredients: 1 can cream of celery soup (or any flavor desired)
1 jar Cheez Whiz or any block hoop cheese
directions: Mix all ingredients except broccoli.
Cook as directed.
Put in baking dish. Pour mixture over.
Bake at 350° until light brown.
recipes.text: Broccoli Casserole. Mix all ingredients except broccoli. Cook as directed. Put in baking dish. Pour mixture over. Bake at 350° until light brown.

recipes.title: Stromboli
ingredients: crusty French bread dough (refrigerated tube or homemade)
directions: Roll out bread dough in rectangular shape.
Spread 4 ounces pizza sauce over dough, staying 1 inch from edges.
Place pepperoni, Canadian bacon and mushrooms over tomato sauce.
Cover these ingredients with cheese (both kinds).
Squeeze 4 tiny dots of mustard on cheese (space evenly).
Starting with one of the longer sides of the rectangle, roll bread into a tube.
Bake according to bread dough directions.
Pour remaining 4 ounces of pizza sauce over finished stromboli (reheat sauce if necessary). Serves 2.
recipes.text: Stromboli. Roll out bread dough in rectangular shape. Spread 4 ounces pizza sauce over dough, staying 1 inch from edges. Place pepperoni, Canadian bacon and mushrooms over tomato sauce. Cover these ingredients with cheese (both kinds). Squeeze 4 tiny dots of mustard on cheese (space evenly). Starting with one of the longer sides of the rectangle, roll bread into a tube. Bake according to bread dough directions. Pour remaining 4 ounces of pizza sauce over finished stromboli (reheat sauce if necessary). Serves 2.

recipes.title: Hershey Pie
directions: Melt Hershey bars in double boiler just until last pieces of chocolate have melted (do not overcook).
Mix melted Hershey bars with Cool Whip and pour in crust.
Place in freezer for at least 1 hour.
Better after 1 day in freezer.
recipes.text: Hershey Pie. Melt Hershey bars in double boiler just until last pieces of chocolate have melted (do not overcook). Mix melted Hershey bars with Cool Whip and pour in crust. Place in freezer for at least 1 hour. Better after 1 day in freezer.

recipes.title: Mexican Chicken
directions: Pour part of chicken soup and enchilada sauce in casserole. Break up frozen tortillas.
Layer tortillas, onion, green chilies, chicken, tortillas and rest of soup and enchilada sauce.
Grate Jack cheese and Cheddar cheese; spread on top after casserole has cooked for 30 to 45 minutes in 350° oven.
Heat until cheese is melted.
recipes.text: Mexican Chicken. Pour part of chicken soup and enchilada sauce in casserole. Break up frozen tortillas. Layer tortillas, onion, green chilies, chicken, tortillas and rest of soup and enchilada sauce. Grate Jack cheese and Cheddar cheese; spread on top after casserole has cooked for 30 to 45 minutes in 350° oven. Heat until cheese is melted.

recipes.title: Polish Pecan Cookies(Ciastka Kurche)
directions: Cream butter with vanilla extract; add confectioners sugar gradually, beating until fluffy.
Add water and beat thoroughly. Add flour in fourths, mixing until blended after each addition. If necessary, chill the dough until easy to handle.
recipes.text: Polish Pecan Cookies(Ciastka Kurche). Cream butter with vanilla extract; add confectioners sugar gradually, beating until fluffy. Add water and beat thoroughly. Add flour in fourths, mixing until blended after each addition. If necessary, chill the dough until easy to handle.

recipes.title: Frog-Eye Salad
ingredients: 2 cans each: 20 oz. pineapple chunks, drained and 20 oz. pineapple, crushed and drained
directions: Combine sugar, flour and 1/2 teaspoon salt.
Gradually stir in pineapple juice and egg over heat.
Stir until thick.
Add lemon juice.
Cool at room temperature.
Bring water to boil and cook acini de pepe done.
Drain and rinse well.
Cool to room temperature.
Combine with egg mixture.
Mix lightly and refrigerate.
Chill well.
recipes.text: Frog-Eye Salad. Combine sugar, flour and 1/2 teaspoon salt. Gradually stir in pineapple juice and egg over heat. Stir until thick. Add lemon juice. Cool at room temperature. Bring water to boil and cook acini de pepe done. Drain and rinse well. Cool to room temperature. Combine with egg mixture. Mix lightly and refrigerate. Chill well.

recipes.title: Caramel Rolls
directions: Butter Bundt pan and sprinkle with chopped pecans.
Throw in 24 Rhodes frozen dinner rolls.
Sprinkle with cinnamon and butterscotch pudding (not instant).
Pour melted butter and sprinkle on the brown sugar.
Cover with towel and set overnight. Brush top with butter.
Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.
Cover with foil and cook ten more minutes.
recipes.text: Caramel Rolls. Butter Bundt pan and sprinkle with chopped pecans. Throw in 24 Rhodes frozen dinner rolls. Sprinkle with cinnamon and butterscotch pudding (not instant). Pour melted butter and sprinkle on the brown sugar. Cover with towel and set overnight. Brush top with butter. Bake at 350° for 20 minutes. Cover with foil and cook ten more minutes.

recipes.title: Faye'S Cornbread
directions: Mix together well; bake in a 12-inch skillet at 375° for 35 minutes.
recipes.text: Faye'S Cornbread. Mix together well; bake in a 12-inch skillet at 375° for 35 minutes.

recipes.title: Banana Bread
directions: Mix ingredients together well and bake at 350° for one hour.
recipes.text: Banana Bread. Mix ingredients together well and bake at 350° for one hour.

recipes.title: Lemon Nut Cake
directions: Mix together pecans, cherries, pineapple and flour; set aside.
Cream together butter, sugar and salt. Add eggs, one at a time. Add flour and lemon extract. Add the nut and fruit mixture. Pour in greased and floured tube pan. Bake 2 hours at 300°.
recipes.text: Lemon Nut Cake. Mix together pecans, cherries, pineapple and flour; set aside. Cream together butter, sugar and salt. Add eggs, one at a time. Add flour and lemon extract. Add the nut and fruit mixture. Pour in greased and floured tube pan. Bake 2 hours at 300°.

recipes.title: Company Brussels Sprouts
ingredients: 1 doz. Brussels sprouts, trimmed and halved
1/3 c. chicken broth or dry white wine
directions: In a skillet, fry bacon just until cooked.
Drain, reserving 2 tablespoons drippings.
Add remaining ingredients; cook and stir over medium-high heat for 10 to 15 minutes or until Brussels sprouts are crisp-tender.
Yields 4 servings.
recipes.text: Company Brussels Sprouts. In a skillet, fry bacon just until cooked. Drain, reserving 2 tablespoons drippings. Add remaining ingredients; cook and stir over medium-high heat for 10 to 15 minutes or until Brussels sprouts are crisp-tender. Yields 4 servings.

recipes.title: Surprise Casserole
directions: Season ground beef with salt and pepper.
Shape into bite-size meatballs around cubes of cheese.
Cook meatballs in skillet until brown on all sides and drain.
recipes.text: Surprise Casserole. Season ground beef with salt and pepper. Shape into bite-size meatballs around cubes of cheese. Cook meatballs in skillet until brown on all sides and drain.

recipes.title: Holiday Orange Salad
directions: Drain oranges, reserving syrup; add enough water to syrup to make 2 cups liquid.
Place liquid in saucepan; bring to boil. Remove from heat; stir in gelatin.
Add sherbet, stirring until dissolved.
Chill until thick.
Stir in oranges.
Pour into a 2 quart ring mold; chill until firm.
Wrap in moisture proof paper; freeze.
Unwrap and thaw in refrigerator.
recipes.text: Holiday Orange Salad. Drain oranges, reserving syrup; add enough water to syrup to make 2 cups liquid. Place liquid in saucepan; bring to boil. Remove from heat; stir in gelatin. Add sherbet, stirring until dissolved. Chill until thick. Stir in oranges. Pour into a 2 quart ring mold; chill until firm. Wrap in moisture proof paper; freeze. Unwrap and thaw in refrigerator.

recipes.title: Quick And Easy Peas
directions: Drain peas.
Saute onion in butter.
Add remaining ingredients; heat and serve.
You may put this in a buttered casserole, top with grated Cheddar cheese and bake for 20 minutes in a 350° oven.
recipes.text: Quick And Easy Peas. Drain peas. Saute onion in butter. Add remaining ingredients; heat and serve. You may put this in a buttered casserole, top with grated Cheddar cheese and bake for 20 minutes in a 350° oven.

recipes.title: Cheese Twirls
ingredients: 1/2 lb. Mexican pasteurized process cheese spread with jalapeno pepper
directions: Roll process cheese spread between two pieces of wax paper to form a 9 x 12-inch rectangle.
Beat cream cheese, olives and cilantro until well blended.
Spread over process cheese spread. Roll up starting at narrow side to form 9-inch roll.
Garnish with additional cilantro, if desired.
Chill, covered, until firm. Serve with assorted crackers.
recipes.text: Cheese Twirls. Roll process cheese spread between two pieces of wax paper to form a 9 x 12-inch rectangle. Beat cream cheese, olives and cilantro until well blended. Spread over process cheese spread. Roll up starting at narrow side to form 9-inch roll. Garnish with additional cilantro, if desired. Chill, covered, until firm. Serve with assorted crackers.

recipes.title: Jellied Old-Fashioned Cole Slaw
directions: Dissolve gelatin and salt in hot water.
Add cold water and chill until syrupy.
Fold in remaining ingredients except cabbage. Chill until slightly thickened.
Fold in cabbage.
Chill until firm.
recipes.text: Jellied Old-Fashioned Cole Slaw. Dissolve gelatin and salt in hot water. Add cold water and chill until syrupy. Fold in remaining ingredients except cabbage. Chill until slightly thickened. Fold in cabbage. Chill until firm.

recipes.title: Scotch Parfait
directions: Blend honey and Scotch (this takes a little time to incorporate the Scotch into the honey).
Whip cream until stiff. Fold honey mixture into cream.
Spoon into parfait glasses and freeze overnight.
Prior to serving, top with grated chocolate, almonds, and a cherry.
If desired you may purchase chocolate dessert cups from a gourmet food shop
and spoon the mixture into cups prior to serving.
This needs to made 24 hours in advance. This does keep well in freezer.
recipes.text: Scotch Parfait. Blend honey and Scotch (this takes a little time to incorporate the Scotch into the honey). Whip cream until stiff. Fold honey mixture into cream. Spoon into parfait glasses and freeze overnight. Prior to serving, top with grated chocolate, almonds, and a cherry. If desired you may purchase chocolate dessert cups from a gourmet food shop and spoon the mixture into cups prior to serving. This needs to made 24 hours in advance. This does keep well in freezer.

recipes.title: Joe Froggers
directions: Mix and sift flour, baking soda, salt and spices.
Cream shortening and sugar.
Add molasses and rum extract; beat well. Add flour mixture and water alternately, beating until well blended after each addition.
Wrap dough in foil; chill overnight.
recipes.text: Joe Froggers. Mix and sift flour, baking soda, salt and spices. Cream shortening and sugar. Add molasses and rum extract; beat well. Add flour mixture and water alternately, beating until well blended after each addition. Wrap dough in foil; chill overnight.

recipes.title: 7-Up Strawberry Creme Cake
directions: Set oven at 350°.
Generously grease and lightly flour pans. Mix all ingredients in a large bowl.
Blend at low speed for 4 minutes.
Pour into prepared cake pans and bake for 30 to 35 minutes.
recipes.text: 7-Up Strawberry Creme Cake. Set oven at 350°. Generously grease and lightly flour pans. Mix all ingredients in a large bowl. Blend at low speed for 4 minutes. Pour into prepared cake pans and bake for 30 to 35 minutes.

recipes.title: Chocolate Banana Pudding Pie
ingredients: 2 (4 serving) pkg. Jell-O vanilla or banana cream instant pudding and pie filling (can use reduced calorie pudding)
directions: Microwave chocolate, milk and butter in bowl 1 to 2 minutes on High.
Stir every 30 seconds.
Remove from microwave and stir until chocolate is completely melted.
Spread evenly in the crust. Refrigerate 30 minutes.
Chocolate will be firm.
recipes.text: Chocolate Banana Pudding Pie. Microwave chocolate, milk and butter in bowl 1 to 2 minutes on High. Stir every 30 seconds. Remove from microwave and stir until chocolate is completely melted. Spread evenly in the crust. Refrigerate 30 minutes. Chocolate will be firm.

recipes.title: Fried Ice Cream
ingredients: 1 loaf sliced white bread, crusts removed
directions: Place a scoop of ice cream between two bread slices.
Form around the ice cream and pinch edges together.
Wrap in foil and return to freezer immediately, for at least 2 hours.
Heat oil to almost smoking.
Drop each ice cream bread ball into hot oil individually.
Cook for no more than 10 to 15 seconds per side. Remove.
Garnish with chocolate syrup and whipped topping.
recipes.text: Fried Ice Cream. Place a scoop of ice cream between two bread slices. Form around the ice cream and pinch edges together. Wrap in foil and return to freezer immediately, for at least 2 hours. Heat oil to almost smoking. Drop each ice cream bread ball into hot oil individually. Cook for no more than 10 to 15 seconds per side. Remove. Garnish with chocolate syrup and whipped topping.

recipes.title: Chocolate Pound Cake
directions: Cream oleo and shortening; add sugar and blend.
Add eggs one at a time, beat after each egg.
Sift flour and dry ingredients together three times.
Add alternately with milk and vanilla.
Pour into greased, lightly floured tube pan.
Bake at 325° for 1 hour and 20 minutes.
recipes.text: Chocolate Pound Cake. Cream oleo and shortening; add sugar and blend. Add eggs one at a time, beat after each egg. Sift flour and dry ingredients together three times. Add alternately with milk and vanilla. Pour into greased, lightly floured tube pan. Bake at 325° for 1 hour and 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Pizza With Monterey Jack And Garden Vegetables
ingredients: 3/4 lb. Monterey Jack cheese, shredded (3 c.)
directions: About 1 hour before serving, prepare Sicilian Pizza Dough.
recipes.text: Pizza With Monterey Jack And Garden Vegetables. About 1 hour before serving, prepare Sicilian Pizza Dough.

recipes.title: Beef Strudel
directions: Brown hamburg and onion in oil.
Pour package of egg noodles (uncooked) over top of hamburg/onion mixture.
Mix all the other ingredients together.
Pour this mixture over the noodles.
Cook for 1/2 to 3/4 of an hour, stirring occasionally.
Serve with a green salad.
recipes.text: Beef Strudel. Brown hamburg and onion in oil. Pour package of egg noodles (uncooked) over top of hamburg/onion mixture. Mix all the other ingredients together. Pour this mixture over the noodles. Cook for 1/2 to 3/4 of an hour, stirring occasionally. Serve with a green salad.

recipes.title: Apricot Pork Medallions
ingredients: 1 lb. pork tenderloin, cut into 1-inch slices
directions: Flatten each piece of pork slightly.
Heat the 1 tablespoon butter over medium-high heat in a skillet.
Saute pork about 2 minutes each side. Remove from pan.
recipes.text: Apricot Pork Medallions. Flatten each piece of pork slightly. Heat the 1 tablespoon butter over medium-high heat in a skillet. Saute pork about 2 minutes each side. Remove from pan.

recipes.title: Caramel Pecan Dream Bars
directions: Beat together.
Press in a 13 x 9-inch pan.
recipes.text: Caramel Pecan Dream Bars. Beat together. Press in a 13 x 9-inch pan.

recipes.title: Coconut Blizzard
directions: Using half of ingredients at a time, combine in blender or processor until smooth and creamy.
Serve in chilled daiquiri-type glasses.
Makes 12 servings.
recipes.text: Coconut Blizzard. Using half of ingredients at a time, combine in blender or processor until smooth and creamy. Serve in chilled daiquiri-type glasses. Makes 12 servings.

recipes.title: Spaghetti Sauce
directions: Brown hamburger lightly; add onions and garlic. Cook until onions are soft. Add spices; simmer 1 hour.
recipes.text: Spaghetti Sauce. Brown hamburger lightly; add onions and garlic. Cook until onions are soft. Add spices; simmer 1 hour.

recipes.title: Chicken Divan
ingredients: 2 (10 oz.) pkg. frozen broccoli or 1 large fresh broccoli
directions: Cook chicken breasts; remove bone and cut into chunks (may use whole chicken if you wish).
Cook broccoli until almost done, drain and cool (blanch and cool fresh broccoli).
Place broccoli in greased 9 x 13-inch pan.
Put chicken on top.
Mix mayonnaise, soup, curry, lemon juice and milk.
Pour over chicken.
Sprinkle top with croutons.
Bake, uncovered, at 350°
for 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Chicken Divan. Cook chicken breasts; remove bone and cut into chunks (may use whole chicken if you wish). Cook broccoli until almost done, drain and cool (blanch and cool fresh broccoli). Place broccoli in greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Put chicken on top. Mix mayonnaise, soup, curry, lemon juice and milk. Pour over chicken. Sprinkle top with croutons. Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Lemon Bars
ingredients: 1 box 1 step white angel food cake mix
directions: Use mixer and mix dry cake mix and lemon pie filling.
Pour into a floured and greased 9 x 13-inch cake pan or 10 x 15-inch cookie sheet.
Smooth out and make sure batter is even.
Bake 25 minutes at 350°.
Frost with a thin glaze, using powdered sugar and lemon extract.
recipes.text: Lemon Bars. Use mixer and mix dry cake mix and lemon pie filling. Pour into a floured and greased 9 x 13-inch cake pan or 10 x 15-inch cookie sheet. Smooth out and make sure batter is even. Bake 25 minutes at 350°. Frost with a thin glaze, using powdered sugar and lemon extract.

recipes.title: No Bake Peanut Butter Cookies
directions: Bring syrup and sugar to a boil in saucepan.
Remove from heat and stir in peanut butter and cereal.
Drop by spoonfuls on wax paper and cool.
recipes.text: No Bake Peanut Butter Cookies. Bring syrup and sugar to a boil in saucepan. Remove from heat and stir in peanut butter and cereal. Drop by spoonfuls on wax paper and cool.

recipes.title: Lemon Meringue Pie
directions: Cook and stir the first 4 ingredients until thick.
Pour small amount into yolks.
Pour yolks into pan; cook about 5 minutes. Add lemon juice, rind and butter; pour into shell.
Top with meringue.
Bake for 15 minutes in a 300° oven until brown.
recipes.text: Lemon Meringue Pie. Cook and stir the first 4 ingredients until thick. Pour small amount into yolks. Pour yolks into pan; cook about 5 minutes. Add lemon juice, rind and butter; pour into shell. Top with meringue. Bake for 15 minutes in a 300° oven until brown.

recipes.title: Kristina'S Favorite Vegetable Dip
directions: Combine all ingredients with hand mixer.
Serve with bite-size pieces of fresh vegetables.
Remember, no double dipping!!! Enough for party platter.
recipes.text: Kristina'S Favorite Vegetable Dip. Combine all ingredients with hand mixer. Serve with bite-size pieces of fresh vegetables. Remember, no double dipping!!! Enough for party platter.

recipes.title: Oreo Delight
ingredients: 2 boxes chocolate or vanilla instant pudding (your choice)
directions: Mix pudding as directed on boxes.
Crush Oreos into little pieces.
Mix the Cool Whip and the sour cream together.
Start with thin layer of Oreos on the bottom of the pan.
Then spread a layer of the pudding.
Then spread the cream cheese and Cool Whip mixture.
Then layer again with cookies.
Follow these steps until all the ingredients are gone.
recipes.text: Oreo Delight. Mix pudding as directed on boxes. Crush Oreos into little pieces. Mix the Cool Whip and the sour cream together. Start with thin layer of Oreos on the bottom of the pan. Then spread a layer of the pudding. Then spread the cream cheese and Cool Whip mixture. Then layer again with cookies. Follow these steps until all the ingredients are gone.

recipes.title: Josh And Todd'S Favorite Pound Cake
directions: Cream butter, Crisco and sugar until light and fluffy.
Add lemon or vanilla extract and blend well.
Add eggs one at a time and continue beating.
Add baking powder and salt.
Add flour and milk alternately to mixture.
Pour into a greased and floured tube pan.
Bake at 325° for 1 hour and 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Josh And Todd'S Favorite Pound Cake. Cream butter, Crisco and sugar until light and fluffy. Add lemon or vanilla extract and blend well. Add eggs one at a time and continue beating. Add baking powder and salt. Add flour and milk alternately to mixture. Pour into a greased and floured tube pan. Bake at 325° for 1 hour and 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Family Orange Jello Salad
directions: Dissolve jello in 1 cup boiling water.	Add mayonnaise and beat well with mixer.
Then add the remaining ingredients and refrigerate.
I usually double the recipe - it lasts for days. Great to make early.
recipes.text: Family Orange Jello Salad. Dissolve jello in 1 cup boiling water.	Add mayonnaise and beat well with mixer. Then add the remaining ingredients and refrigerate. I usually double the recipe - it lasts for days. Great to make early.

recipes.title: Oreo Cookie Ice Cream Pie
directions: Mix crushed cookies with melted butter; press into the bottom of a 12-inch pie taker.
Spread ice cream over top of cookies. Pour fudge topping in even layer over ice cream.
Spread whipped topping over fudge.
Garnish with chocolate curls or Oreo cookie mini's, if desired.
Put in freezer for 2 hours before serving.
recipes.text: Oreo Cookie Ice Cream Pie. Mix crushed cookies with melted butter; press into the bottom of a 12-inch pie taker. Spread ice cream over top of cookies. Pour fudge topping in even layer over ice cream. Spread whipped topping over fudge. Garnish with chocolate curls or Oreo cookie mini's, if desired. Put in freezer for 2 hours before serving.

recipes.title: Pasta Salad
directions: Break spaghetti in small pieces.
Cook; rinse in cold water. Mix all ingredients with salad dressing and chill overnight.
recipes.text: Pasta Salad. Break spaghetti in small pieces. Cook; rinse in cold water. Mix all ingredients with salad dressing and chill overnight.

recipes.title: Salmon Party Ball
directions: Drain salmon and flake with fork.
Add cream cheese, lemon juice, onion, horseradish and liquid smoke. Mix well.
Chill overnight.
Roll into log.
recipes.text: Salmon Party Ball. Drain salmon and flake with fork. Add cream cheese, lemon juice, onion, horseradish and liquid smoke. Mix well. Chill overnight. Roll into log.

recipes.title: Cowboy Casserole
directions: Brown beef and drain.
Add soups and sauce.
Layer in casserole dish, beginning with chips, meat and cheese.
Top with chips and cheese.
Bake at 350° for 15 minutes.
recipes.text: Cowboy Casserole. Brown beef and drain. Add soups and sauce. Layer in casserole dish, beginning with chips, meat and cheese. Top with chips and cheese. Bake at 350° for 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Vegetable Soup
directions: Brown beef and onion; drain.
Mix the rest of the ingredients; salt and pepper to taste.
Cook on low for about 1 hour.
The longer it cooks, the better.
recipes.text: Vegetable Soup. Brown beef and onion; drain. Mix the rest of the ingredients; salt and pepper to taste. Cook on low for about 1 hour. The longer it cooks, the better.

recipes.title: Pennsylvania Dutch Peach (Apple) Pie
directions: Mix flour, sugar and cinnamon together.
Cut in butter until crumbled.
Slice peaches in wedges.
Arrange peaches in shell. Put crumbled mixture on fruit and bake at 450° for 15 minutes. Change oven setting to 350° and open oven door until oven comes on again and bake there for 32 minutes.
Cool before serving as it will become more firm than coming out of the oven.
recipes.text: Pennsylvania Dutch Peach (Apple) Pie. Mix flour, sugar and cinnamon together. Cut in butter until crumbled. Slice peaches in wedges. Arrange peaches in shell. Put crumbled mixture on fruit and bake at 450° for 15 minutes. Change oven setting to 350° and open oven door until oven comes on again and bake there for 32 minutes. Cool before serving as it will become more firm than coming out of the oven.

recipes.title: Pickled Eggs
directions: Use one gallon jar.
Boil and peel four dozen eggs.
Use a heavy toothpick to poke a hole in yolk of boiled egg.
This helps pickling.
recipes.text: Pickled Eggs. Use one gallon jar. Boil and peel four dozen eggs. Use a heavy toothpick to poke a hole in yolk of boiled egg. This helps pickling.

recipes.title: Pear Relish
directions: Wash first 5 ingredients in cold water.
Peel and core the pears.
Remove stem and seeds from the peppers.
Clean the celery, peel the onion and put them through a food chopper.
Then add sugar, salt, vinegar and allspice.
