Mix and let stand overnight. Pack in preheated jars.
Process 20 minutes in hot water bath at simmering temperature.
recipes.text: Pear Relish. Wash first 5 ingredients in cold water. Peel and core the pears. Remove stem and seeds from the peppers. Clean the celery, peel the onion and put them through a food chopper. Then add sugar, salt, vinegar and allspice. Mix and let stand overnight. Pack in preheated jars. Process 20 minutes in hot water bath at simmering temperature.

recipes.title: Exotic Chicken Salad
directions: Combine chicken, water chestnuts, celery, grapes and almonds. Mix mayonnaise, curry powder, soy sauce and lemon juice; add to chicken mixture.
Chill for several hours.
Serve on lettuce leaf and top with pineapple chunks.
Serves 10 to 12.
recipes.text: Exotic Chicken Salad. Combine chicken, water chestnuts, celery, grapes and almonds. Mix mayonnaise, curry powder, soy sauce and lemon juice; add to chicken mixture. Chill for several hours. Serve on lettuce leaf and top with pineapple chunks. Serves 10 to 12.

recipes.title: Bacon And Cheese Pie
ingredients: 3/4 lb. sliced bacon, cooked until crisp
directions: Place onion on bottom of pie shell, then alternate bacon and cheese until used.
Combine rest of ingredients.
Pour slowly over.
Custard like consistency when done.
Test for doneness by inserting knife in center until it comes out clean.
recipes.text: Bacon And Cheese Pie. Place onion on bottom of pie shell, then alternate bacon and cheese until used. Combine rest of ingredients. Pour slowly over. Custard like consistency when done. Test for doneness by inserting knife in center until it comes out clean.

recipes.title: Man On The Moon Cake
directions: Beat eggs and oil until foamy.
Sift flour, salt, soda and cinnamon together.
Add to egg mixture.
Add remaining ingredients.
Pour into a 13 x 9-inch pan.
Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes.
Remove from oven and spread with Lunar Topping.
Cool before cutting.
recipes.text: Man On The Moon Cake. Beat eggs and oil until foamy. Sift flour, salt, soda and cinnamon together. Add to egg mixture. Add remaining ingredients. Pour into a 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes. Remove from oven and spread with Lunar Topping. Cool before cutting.

recipes.title: Pizza Waffles
directions: Mix tomato sauce, cheese, 1 teaspoon oregano and 1/4 cup of water in 1-quart saucepan.
Heat over medium heat, stirring constantly, until cheese is melted and sauce is bubbly.
recipes.text: Pizza Waffles. Mix tomato sauce, cheese, 1 teaspoon oregano and 1/4 cup of water in 1-quart saucepan. Heat over medium heat, stirring constantly, until cheese is melted and sauce is bubbly.

recipes.title: Yummy Cookies
directions: Cream the butter.
Add sugar; beat until fluffy.
Add vanilla. Stir in flour, salt and baking powder.
Mix until smooth.
Form into a small ball.
recipes.text: Yummy Cookies. Cream the butter. Add sugar; beat until fluffy. Add vanilla. Stir in flour, salt and baking powder. Mix until smooth. Form into a small ball.

recipes.title: Honey Apple Rings
ingredients: 4 medium cooking apples (unpeeled, cored and cut into 1/2-inch rings)
directions: Saute in wine, chicken broth, vermouth or flavored vinegar. Always use a nonstick pan to cook in and use a nonfat cooking spray.
Never use butter, lard, shortening or hydrogenated vegetable oil to cook with.
recipes.text: Honey Apple Rings. Saute in wine, chicken broth, vermouth or flavored vinegar. Always use a nonstick pan to cook in and use a nonfat cooking spray. Never use butter, lard, shortening or hydrogenated vegetable oil to cook with.

recipes.title: Sour Cream Pound Cake
directions: Eggs, sour cream and butter should be at room temperature.
recipes.text: Sour Cream Pound Cake. Eggs, sour cream and butter should be at room temperature.

recipes.title: Fat-Free Broccoli Dip
directions: In bowl, beat softened cream cheese, mustard and milk until well blended.
Stir in thawed broccoli, peppers and scallions. Add salt and pepper to taste.
Cover and chill.
Serve with rice cakes, crackers, breadsticks or vegetables.
recipes.text: Fat-Free Broccoli Dip. In bowl, beat softened cream cheese, mustard and milk until well blended. Stir in thawed broccoli, peppers and scallions. Add salt and pepper to taste. Cover and chill. Serve with rice cakes, crackers, breadsticks or vegetables.

recipes.title: Hazelnut Pavlova With Coffee Cream
directions: Preheat oven to 300°.
Draw two 8-inch circles on a boil-lined baking sheet.
In a large mixing bowl, combine egg whites, vanilla and cream of tartar.
Beat egg white mixture with an electric mixer on medium speed until soft peaks form (tips curl).
Gradually add 1 1/3 cups of the sugar, a tablespoon at a time, beating about 7 minutes on high speed until stiff peaks form (tips stand straight) and sugar is almost dissolved.
Gently fold in the 1 cup nuts.
Spread half of egg white mixture over each circle on baking sheet.
Bake 35 minutes.
Turn off oven.
Let meringues dry in oven, with door closed, 1 hour.
recipes.text: Hazelnut Pavlova With Coffee Cream. Preheat oven to 300°. Draw two 8-inch circles on a boil-lined baking sheet. In a large mixing bowl, combine egg whites, vanilla and cream of tartar. Beat egg white mixture with an electric mixer on medium speed until soft peaks form (tips curl). Gradually add 1 1/3 cups of the sugar, a tablespoon at a time, beating about 7 minutes on high speed until stiff peaks form (tips stand straight) and sugar is almost dissolved. Gently fold in the 1 cup nuts. Spread half of egg white mixture over each circle on baking sheet. Bake 35 minutes. Turn off oven. Let meringues dry in oven, with door closed, 1 hour.

recipes.title: Corn Muffins
directions: Heat oven to 425°.
Grease bottoms of 12 medium muffin cups. Blend all ingredients about 20 seconds.
Beat 1 minute.
Fill muffin cups 2/3 full.
Bake 15 minutes; immediately remove from pan.
Makes 12 muffins.
recipes.text: Corn Muffins. Heat oven to 425°. Grease bottoms of 12 medium muffin cups. Blend all ingredients about 20 seconds. Beat 1 minute. Fill muffin cups 2/3 full. Bake 15 minutes; immediately remove from pan. Makes 12 muffins.

recipes.title: Aunt Melba'S Jello
directions: Cook jello according to package.
Add grated carrots and sliced bananas.
Chill until firm.
Serve topped with whipping cream or spoonful of mayonnaise.
Very good for the holidays.
recipes.text: Aunt Melba'S Jello. Cook jello according to package. Add grated carrots and sliced bananas. Chill until firm. Serve topped with whipping cream or spoonful of mayonnaise. Very good for the holidays.

recipes.title: Cinnamon Yams
ingredients: 4 (1 lb.) cans yams, drained or use fresh baked or boiled yams
directions: Preheat oven to 350°.
Combine sugar, salt and cinnamon in small bowl.
Slice yams 1/4-inch thick; lay in greased ovenproof dish or pan.
Sprinkle melted butter on yams, then the sugar mixture.
Arrange another layer of yams and repeat the sprinkling procedure.
Continue until yams are gone.
Bake 25 minutes or until yams are hot and sugar is bubbly.
Great for the holidays.
recipes.text: Cinnamon Yams. Preheat oven to 350°. Combine sugar, salt and cinnamon in small bowl. Slice yams 1/4-inch thick; lay in greased ovenproof dish or pan. Sprinkle melted butter on yams, then the sugar mixture. Arrange another layer of yams and repeat the sprinkling procedure. Continue until yams are gone. Bake 25 minutes or until yams are hot and sugar is bubbly. Great for the holidays.

recipes.title: Sliced Baked Potatoes
ingredients: 2 or 3 Tbsp. chopped parsley or chives
directions: Peel and wash potatoes.
Cut potatoes into slices, but not all the way through.
Use a handle of a spoon to keep knife from cutting all the way through.
Put potatoes in baking dish. Sprinkle with salt and drizzle with butter; sprinkle with herbs.
recipes.text: Sliced Baked Potatoes. Peel and wash potatoes. Cut potatoes into slices, but not all the way through. Use a handle of a spoon to keep knife from cutting all the way through. Put potatoes in baking dish. Sprinkle with salt and drizzle with butter; sprinkle with herbs.

recipes.title: Zucchini Casserole
directions: Mix together all ingredients.
Spray 9-inch square cake pan with Pam.
Spread mixture into pan.
Sprinkle top with cheese. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Zucchini Casserole. Mix together all ingredients. Spray 9-inch square cake pan with Pam. Spread mixture into pan. Sprinkle top with cheese. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Bread Pudding
directions: Combine and place in buttered baking dish.
Bake for about 1 hour, until firm, in a 350° oven.
recipes.text: Bread Pudding. Combine and place in buttered baking dish. Bake for about 1 hour, until firm, in a 350° oven.

recipes.title: Maryann Sawyer'S Wassail
directions: Combine ingredients; except oranges; heat until steaming. Precook whole oranges (however many you want to float in your punch bowl) by boiling for 10 minutes.
Stick with whole cloves; float in punch bowl.
recipes.text: Maryann Sawyer'S Wassail. Combine ingredients; except oranges; heat until steaming. Precook whole oranges (however many you want to float in your punch bowl) by boiling for 10 minutes. Stick with whole cloves; float in punch bowl.

recipes.title: Broccoli Casserole
directions: Cook broccoli as directed, but not too done.
Partially drain. Mix 1/2 stick of margarine and all the cheese (does not have to be melted) and stir into broccoli.
Pour into greased baking dish. Mix other half of butter (melted) with cracker crumbs.
Spoon over broccoli.
Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.
recipes.text: Broccoli Casserole. Cook broccoli as directed, but not too done. Partially drain. Mix 1/2 stick of margarine and all the cheese (does not have to be melted) and stir into broccoli. Pour into greased baking dish. Mix other half of butter (melted) with cracker crumbs. Spoon over broccoli. Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Asparagus Mold
ingredients: 1 small can asparagus, drained and chopped
directions: Heat soup to a boil; add jello and stir until dissolved.
Add cream cheese; mix or beat until melted.
Add mayonnaise and water; stir until blended.
Stir in rest of ingredients.
Pour in mold and chill.
recipes.text: Asparagus Mold. Heat soup to a boil; add jello and stir until dissolved. Add cream cheese; mix or beat until melted. Add mayonnaise and water; stir until blended. Stir in rest of ingredients. Pour in mold and chill.

recipes.title: Peach Delight
directions: Roll peach halves in vanilla wafer crumbs until well coated. Place halves, cut side down, in sherbet glasses.
Top peach halves with spoonful of whipped cream and walnuts.
recipes.text: Peach Delight. Roll peach halves in vanilla wafer crumbs until well coated. Place halves, cut side down, in sherbet glasses. Top peach halves with spoonful of whipped cream and walnuts.

recipes.title: Squash Casserole
ingredients: 1 (10 3/4 oz.) can cream of chicken soup
directions: Mash squash; add sour cream, soup, carrots and onion.
Add butter to crumbs.
Sprinkle 1/2 of crumbs in casserole.
Spoon squash mixture over crumbs.
Cover with remaining crumbs.
Bake at 350° for 30 to 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Squash Casserole. Mash squash; add sour cream, soup, carrots and onion. Add butter to crumbs. Sprinkle 1/2 of crumbs in casserole. Spoon squash mixture over crumbs. Cover with remaining crumbs. Bake at 350° for 30 to 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Honey Dijon Ham
directions: Cook ham at 325° for 15 minutes per pound.
Cook 1 1/2 hours, then glace it.
Score diamonds in top.
Coat generously.
recipes.text: Honey Dijon Ham. Cook ham at 325° for 15 minutes per pound. Cook 1 1/2 hours, then glace it. Score diamonds in top. Coat generously.

recipes.title: Hamburger Cheese Bake
ingredients: 3 c. (12 oz.) Mozzarella or Cheddar cheese
directions: Preheat oven to 350°.
Cook noodles as directed.
In medium skillet, brown ground beef; drain.
Stir in tomato sauce, onion, parsley, garlic powder and oregano; simmer, stirring occasionally, 15 minutes.
Shred cheese and in 3-quart baking dish (oblong if available), layer 1/2 sauce, noodles and cheese; repeat, ending with cheese.
Bake 25 minutes or until heated through.
Serves about 4.
recipes.text: Hamburger Cheese Bake. Preheat oven to 350°. Cook noodles as directed. In medium skillet, brown ground beef; drain. Stir in tomato sauce, onion, parsley, garlic powder and oregano; simmer, stirring occasionally, 15 minutes. Shred cheese and in 3-quart baking dish (oblong if available), layer 1/2 sauce, noodles and cheese; repeat, ending with cheese. Bake 25 minutes or until heated through. Serves about 4.

recipes.title: Banana Split Dessert
directions: Beat eggs, powdered sugar, margarine and vanilla until stiff, about 20 minutes.
Spread this over crust.
Drain the crushed pineapple and spread over creamed mixture.
Slice bananas over pineapple, then a layer Cool Whip.
Top with nuts, cherries and chocolate syrup.
recipes.text: Banana Split Dessert. Beat eggs, powdered sugar, margarine and vanilla until stiff, about 20 minutes. Spread this over crust. Drain the crushed pineapple and spread over creamed mixture. Slice bananas over pineapple, then a layer Cool Whip. Top with nuts, cherries and chocolate syrup.

recipes.title: Parmesan Chicken
directions: Mix eggs and pepper.
Roll chicken in egg mixture and then in the bread crumbs.
Cook in oil until brown on both sides.
Set aside.
Mix tomato sauce, seasonings, Parmesan cheese and butter in saucepan.
Heat on stove.
Put chicken in casserole dish and pour sauce over top.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes, covered. Uncover and sprinkle Mozzarella cheese on top.
Return to oven and heat until cheese is melted.
recipes.text: Parmesan Chicken. Mix eggs and pepper. Roll chicken in egg mixture and then in the bread crumbs. Cook in oil until brown on both sides. Set aside. Mix tomato sauce, seasonings, Parmesan cheese and butter in saucepan. Heat on stove. Put chicken in casserole dish and pour sauce over top. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes, covered. Uncover and sprinkle Mozzarella cheese on top. Return to oven and heat until cheese is melted.

recipes.title: Quick Golden Stew
ingredients: 1 (10 3/4 oz.) can cream of celery soup (undiluted)
directions: In a large saucepan or Dutch oven, combine carrots, potatoes, onions and just enough water to cover.
Cook, covered, until vegetables are tender, about 10 minutes.
Add peas and ham; continue to cook 5 more minutes.
Drain water.
Stir in soup and cheese.
Heat through.
Yield:
4 to 6 servings.
recipes.text: Quick Golden Stew. In a large saucepan or Dutch oven, combine carrots, potatoes, onions and just enough water to cover. Cook, covered, until vegetables are tender, about 10 minutes. Add peas and ham; continue to cook 5 more minutes. Drain water. Stir in soup and cheese. Heat through. Yield: 4 to 6 servings.

recipes.title: Pistachio Dessert
ingredients: 1 (20 oz.) can crushed pineapple with juice
1 small pkg. instant pistachio pudding mix
directions: Add pudding mix to pineapple.
Fold in marshmallows and Cool Whip.
Let set overnight.
recipes.text: Pistachio Dessert. Add pudding mix to pineapple. Fold in marshmallows and Cool Whip. Let set overnight.

recipes.title: Hot Chicken Salad
directions: Combine all ingredients except cheese, crushed potato chips and almonds.
Place all other ingredients in a large rectangular 13 x 9 x 2-inch dish.
Top with cheese, potato chips and almonds. Let stand overnight in refrigerator.
Bake at 400° for 20 to 25 minutes.
recipes.text: Hot Chicken Salad. Combine all ingredients except cheese, crushed potato chips and almonds. Place all other ingredients in a large rectangular 13 x 9 x 2-inch dish. Top with cheese, potato chips and almonds. Let stand overnight in refrigerator. Bake at 400° for 20 to 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Waldorf Salad
directions: Combine cream cheese and Swiss all-purpose buttermilk. Gradually beat in water until smooth.
Set aside.
recipes.text: Waldorf Salad. Combine cream cheese and Swiss all-purpose buttermilk. Gradually beat in water until smooth. Set aside.

recipes.title: Low-Fat French Fries
directions: Cut the potatoes into strips.
Toss thoroughly in 2 large egg whites; sprinkle with spice
Put on cookie sheet pan sprayed with Pam cooking spray.
Bake in oven at 400°.
Turn French fries often.
Bake for about 15 to 20 minutes, until tender and golden brown.
(Can spray with Pam a couple of times while baking.)
recipes.text: Low-Fat French Fries. Cut the potatoes into strips. Toss thoroughly in 2 large egg whites; sprinkle with spice . Put on cookie sheet pan sprayed with Pam cooking spray. Bake in oven at 400°. Turn French fries often. Bake for about 15 to 20 minutes, until tender and golden brown. (Can spray with Pam a couple of times while baking.)

recipes.title: Sweetened Condensed Milk
directions: Place all ingredients in blender container.
Process at high speed until smooth.
Use in any recipe calling for the commercially sold sweetened condensed milk.
Makes 1 1/4 cups (10 ounces) and contains 1205 calories.
recipes.text: Sweetened Condensed Milk. Place all ingredients in blender container. Process at high speed until smooth. Use in any recipe calling for the commercially sold sweetened condensed milk. Makes 1 1/4 cups (10 ounces) and contains 1205 calories.

recipes.title: Tater Topped Casserole
directions: Preheat oven to 400°.
In skillet, cook onion, celery and ground beef until meat is brown and vegetables are tender.
Drain. Stir in salt and pepper.
Spoon mixture into a greased 12 x 8-inch baking dish.
Spread soup over meat mixture.
Top with frozen potatoes and bake about 40 minutes or until bubbly. Remove from oven and sprinkle with cheese.
Return to oven and bake until cheese melts.
Serves 4 to 6.
recipes.text: Tater Topped Casserole. Preheat oven to 400°. In skillet, cook onion, celery and ground beef until meat is brown and vegetables are tender. Drain. Stir in salt and pepper. Spoon mixture into a greased 12 x 8-inch baking dish. Spread soup over meat mixture. Top with frozen potatoes and bake about 40 minutes or until bubbly. Remove from oven and sprinkle with cheese. Return to oven and bake until cheese melts. Serves 4 to 6.

recipes.title: Easy Macaroons
directions: Mix all ingredients.
Drop from teaspoon onto well-greased cookie sheet.
Bake at 350° for 10 to 12 minutes.
Cool and serve. Makes about 4 dozen.
recipes.text: Easy Macaroons. Mix all ingredients. Drop from teaspoon onto well-greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350° for 10 to 12 minutes. Cool and serve. Makes about 4 dozen.

recipes.title: Pecan-Raisin Bars
ingredients: 1/2 c. light or dark corn syrup
directions: Preheat oven to 350°.
Mix 1 cup sugar, margarine, 1 teaspoon vanilla and 1 egg.
Stir in flour.
Press dough in ungreased rectangular pan, 13 x 9 x 2-inches.
Bake until edges are lightly brown, about 15 minutes.
recipes.text: Pecan-Raisin Bars. Preheat oven to 350°. Mix 1 cup sugar, margarine, 1 teaspoon vanilla and 1 egg. Stir in flour. Press dough in ungreased rectangular pan, 13 x 9 x 2-inches. Bake until edges are lightly brown, about 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Artichoke Heart Salad
ingredients: 1 jar drained and diced marinated artichoke hearts
directions: Cook Rice-A-Roni
as
directed and cool.
Add remaining ingredients.
After
adding
curry	powder,
taste,
and if it burns,
you have added too much!
(Curry powder is the success of this salad.) Place on lettuce leaves and top with a floral olive and pimento flower.
Enjoy!
(Best when chilled.)
recipes.text: Artichoke Heart Salad. Cook Rice-A-Roni as directed and cool. Add remaining ingredients. After adding curry	powder, taste, and if it burns, you have added too much! (Curry powder is the success of this salad.) Place on lettuce leaves and top with a floral olive and pimento flower. Enjoy! (Best when chilled.)

recipes.title: Pioneer Potato Candy
ingredients: 2 lb. powdered sugar (amount may vary according to water in the potatoes)
1 lb. dipping chocolate or semi-sweet chocolate
directions: Combine potatoes, salt and vanilla in a 4-quart mixing bowl. Sift powdered sugar over potatoes.
Cover with damp cloth and set until chilled.
Shape into small balls.
Dip into melted chocolate.
Roll into nuts.
Chill until firm.
recipes.text: Pioneer Potato Candy. Combine potatoes, salt and vanilla in a 4-quart mixing bowl. Sift powdered sugar over potatoes. Cover with damp cloth and set until chilled. Shape into small balls. Dip into melted chocolate. Roll into nuts. Chill until firm.

recipes.title: Baked Pears
directions: Preheat oven to 325°.
Cut slice off bottom of pear so it will stand upright.
Place, with stem up, in baking dish.
Mix remaining ingredients and pour over pears.
Bake, uncovered, about 1 1/2 hours, basting 3 or 4 times.
Serve cool with syrup.
recipes.text: Baked Pears. Preheat oven to 325°. Cut slice off bottom of pear so it will stand upright. Place, with stem up, in baking dish. Mix remaining ingredients and pour over pears. Bake, uncovered, about 1 1/2 hours, basting 3 or 4 times. Serve cool with syrup.

recipes.title: Baked Sole With Mushroom Sauce
ingredients: 3 Tbsp. Chablis or other dry white wine, divided
directions: Coat a large nonstick skillet with cooking spray; add margarine.
Place over medium-high heat until margarine melts. Add onion; saute until tender.
Add flour; cook 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add mushrooms, water and 1 tablespoon wine.
Cook over medium heat 5 to 7 minutes or until mushrooms are tender, stirring constantly and adding 1 tablespoon water, if necessary, to prevent sticking.
Stir in green onions.
Remove from heat; cover and set aside.
recipes.text: Baked Sole With Mushroom Sauce. Coat a large nonstick skillet with cooking spray; add margarine. Place over medium-high heat until margarine melts. Add onion; saute until tender. Add flour; cook 1 minute, stirring constantly. Add mushrooms, water and 1 tablespoon wine. Cook over medium heat 5 to 7 minutes or until mushrooms are tender, stirring constantly and adding 1 tablespoon water, if necessary, to prevent sticking. Stir in green onions. Remove from heat; cover and set aside.

recipes.title: Fun Dip
ingredients: 2 Tbsp. minced pimento, rinsed and drained
directions: Combine all ingredients and refrigerate for 2 hours to blend flavors.
Serve with crisp vegetables.
recipes.text: Fun Dip. Combine all ingredients and refrigerate for 2 hours to blend flavors. Serve with crisp vegetables.

recipes.title: 6-Cup Salad
directions: Combine all ingredients; cool and refrigerate until chilled.
recipes.text: 6-Cup Salad. Combine all ingredients; cool and refrigerate until chilled.

recipes.title: Macaroni By Catherine
ingredients: 2 lb. ground meat (1 lb. beef and 1 lb. sausage)
8 oz. Cheddar cheese, cut into cubes
1 lb. elbow macaroni, cooked and drained
directions: Cook macaroni; drain.
Dot with butter and set aside.
recipes.text: Macaroni By Catherine. Cook macaroni; drain. Dot with butter and set aside.

recipes.title: Old-Fashioned Meat Loaf
directions: In a large bowl, combine all ingredients except ketchup.
Mix well and place on drip pan.
Roasting pans will do if grease is drained every 20 minutes.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.
Remove from oven; spread ketchup thoroughly over top and bake for 15 minutes.
recipes.text: Old-Fashioned Meat Loaf. In a large bowl, combine all ingredients except ketchup. Mix well and place on drip pan. Roasting pans will do if grease is drained every 20 minutes. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes. Remove from oven; spread ketchup thoroughly over top and bake for 15 minutes.

recipes.title: South-Of-The-Border Special
ingredients: minced garlic or garlic powder to taste
directions: In large frypan, brown ground beef and onions, add green peppers, cooking slightly.
Then add tomato sauce and the next six ingredients.
Simmer at least five minutes.
Serve over tortilla chips and top with shredded lettuce, diced fresh tomatoes, chopped onions, green peppers, shredded sharp cheese, sour cream and salsa, if desired.
recipes.text: South-Of-The-Border Special. In large frypan, brown ground beef and onions, add green peppers, cooking slightly. Then add tomato sauce and the next six ingredients. Simmer at least five minutes. Serve over tortilla chips and top with shredded lettuce, diced fresh tomatoes, chopped onions, green peppers, shredded sharp cheese, sour cream and salsa, if desired.

recipes.title: French Dressing
directions: Blend in mixer or blender.
Makes 1 quart.
recipes.text: French Dressing. Blend in mixer or blender. Makes 1 quart.

recipes.title: Deviled Crab
ingredients: 1 small can mushrooms with liquid, sliced
directions: Mix all ingredients, except potato chips, in a 2-quart casserole.
Top with potato chips.
Bake in a 350° oven for 35 minutes, or until bubbly.
Makes 8 servings.
recipes.text: Deviled Crab. Mix all ingredients, except potato chips, in a 2-quart casserole. Top with potato chips. Bake in a 350° oven for 35 minutes, or until bubbly. Makes 8 servings.

recipes.title: Picadillo Soup
directions: Saute garlic with onions and tomatoes.
Add 2 bouillon cubes. Saute well on medium heat.
Add meat and potatoes with about 1/4 cup water.
Let boil; continue adding water to make soup consistency.
recipes.text: Picadillo Soup. Saute garlic with onions and tomatoes. Add 2 bouillon cubes. Saute well on medium heat. Add meat and potatoes with about 1/4 cup water. Let boil; continue adding water to make soup consistency.

recipes.title: Mexi Rice
directions: Mix all ingredients except cheese together.
Heat in microwave 3 minutes on High.
Add cheese.
Serve.
recipes.text: Mexi Rice. Mix all ingredients except cheese together. Heat in microwave 3 minutes on High. Add cheese. Serve.

recipes.title: Pizza Casserole
directions: Brown meat.
In casserole dish, layer the following: meat, macaroni, pizza sauce, pepperoni and cheese.
Repeat layers, ending with cheese.
Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Pizza Casserole. Brown meat. In casserole dish, layer the following: meat, macaroni, pizza sauce, pepperoni and cheese. Repeat layers, ending with cheese. Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Quick Mexican Corn Bread
directions: Combine first 3
ingredients.
Add
remaining
ingredients, mixing well.
Pour	into well-greased 8-inch baking pan. Bake at 450° for 20 to 25 minutes or until golden.
recipes.text: Quick Mexican Corn Bread. Combine first 3 ingredients. Add remaining ingredients, mixing well. Pour	into well-greased 8-inch baking pan. Bake at 450° for 20 to 25 minutes or until golden.

recipes.title: Cheese Carrots
directions: Soften gelatin in cold water for 5 minutes; melt over hot water.
Cool slightly.
Blend with the cheese, salt and Worcestershire sauce.
Chill just enough to stiffen slightly. Divide into 1/2 teaspoon portions; roll in the grated carrots until well coated.
Place on wax paper and chill.
Stick a sprig in the end of each.
recipes.text: Cheese Carrots. Soften gelatin in cold water for 5 minutes; melt over hot water. Cool slightly. Blend with the cheese, salt and Worcestershire sauce. Chill just enough to stiffen slightly. Divide into 1/2 teaspoon portions; roll in the grated carrots until well coated. Place on wax paper and chill. Stick a sprig in the end of each.

recipes.title: Grammy Mason'S Butter Cookies
directions: Mix all together, except red and green sprinkles.
Roll out very thin.
Cut with cookie cutters.
Decorate with red and green sprinkles.
Bake at 325° for 10 minutes.
recipes.text: Grammy Mason'S Butter Cookies. Mix all together, except red and green sprinkles. Roll out very thin. Cut with cookie cutters. Decorate with red and green sprinkles. Bake at 325° for 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Pound Cake
directions: Heat oven to 325°.
Cream sugar, shortening and butter.
Add eggs, one at a time.
Add dry ingredients alternately with milk. Add extracts and bake for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Pound Cake. Heat oven to 325°. Cream sugar, shortening and butter. Add eggs, one at a time. Add dry ingredients alternately with milk. Add extracts and bake for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Cherry Angel Food Cake
directions: Preheat oven to 375°.
Stir flour and 3/4 cup plus 2 tablespoons sugar together.
Beat egg whites, cream of tartar and salt until foamy; add remaining sugar, 2 tablespoons at a time. Beat until stiff peaks form; fold in flavorings.
Sprinkle flour mixture and cherries over top.
Fold in gently just until flour mixture disappears.
Push batter into ungreased tube pan.
Bake for 30 to 35 minutes.
recipes.text: Cherry Angel Food Cake. Preheat oven to 375°. Stir flour and 3/4 cup plus 2 tablespoons sugar together. Beat egg whites, cream of tartar and salt until foamy; add remaining sugar, 2 tablespoons at a time. Beat until stiff peaks form; fold in flavorings. Sprinkle flour mixture and cherries over top. Fold in gently just until flour mixture disappears. Push batter into ungreased tube pan. Bake for 30 to 35 minutes.

recipes.title: Turkey Chili
ingredients: 1 (16 oz.) can red kidney beans, drained
directions: Spray cold pan with canola oil.
Cook turkey and celery.
Use a meat fork to break turkey into pieces.
Cook until no longer pink.
Stir in remaining ingredients, tomatoes, juice, sauce, beans, spices and beef, if desired.
Bring to a boil.
Reduce heat and simmer at least 30 minutes.
Stir occasionally.
Discard bay leaf.
Serves 4.
Can be doubled easily.
(Serving has 4 grams of fat and 380 calories.)
recipes.text: Turkey Chili. Spray cold pan with canola oil. Cook turkey and celery. Use a meat fork to break turkey into pieces. Cook until no longer pink. Stir in remaining ingredients, tomatoes, juice, sauce, beans, spices and beef, if desired. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer at least 30 minutes. Stir occasionally. Discard bay leaf. Serves 4. Can be doubled easily. (Serving has 4 grams of fat and 380 calories.)

recipes.title: Finger Steak
directions: Cut steak into strips, about 1 to 2-inches wide and 5 to 6-inches long.
Beat two eggs, add garlic salt.
Dip steak in mixture, then roll in cracker crumbs and deep fry.
Very good, even cold.
recipes.text: Finger Steak. Cut steak into strips, about 1 to 2-inches wide and 5 to 6-inches long. Beat two eggs, add garlic salt. Dip steak in mixture, then roll in cracker crumbs and deep fry. Very good, even cold.

recipes.title: Christmas Custard
directions: Mix pudding mix with part of milk; beat.
Add whipping cream and sugar and beat again.
Add rest of milk or to the consistency you want.
You can add a little rum to it, if you like.
Store in refrigerator and shake before serving.
recipes.text: Christmas Custard. Mix pudding mix with part of milk; beat. Add whipping cream and sugar and beat again. Add rest of milk or to the consistency you want. You can add a little rum to it, if you like. Store in refrigerator and shake before serving.

recipes.title: Batinjan
ingredients: 10 oz lamb chops and boneless lamb cubes
directions: Trim and wash meat then place in medium saucepan and cover with boiling water

(meat must be completely covered). Boil for 5 minutes with lid uncovered, drain meat and discard water. Slice the egg plant about 1/2 inch thick and fry using 2 tablespoons of oil until golden brown. Drain on absorbent paper and set aside. In a medium saucepan place 1 tablespoon of oil. Place on medium heat and fry onions and garlic until brown. Add meat and fry together for 1-2 minutes. Pour boiling water, cover pan and boil for 30 minutes on medium heat.
Now add chopped tomatoes, tomato puree, lemon juice, salt and garam masala.
Add the egg plant to the pan and boil for 15 minutes on medium heat, then stir gently, simmer for a further 15 minutes. Serve with hot rice, salad or bread. Freezes well.
recipes.text: Batinjan. Trim and wash meat then place in medium saucepan and cover with boiling water (meat must be completely covered). Boil for 5 minutes with lid uncovered, drain meat and discard water. Slice the egg plant about 1/2 inch thick and fry using 2 tablespoons of oil until golden brown. Drain on absorbent paper and set aside. In a medium saucepan place 1 tablespoon of oil. Place on medium heat and fry onions and garlic until brown. Add meat and fry together for 1-2 minutes. Pour boiling water, cover pan and boil for 30 minutes on medium heat. Now add chopped tomatoes, tomato puree, lemon juice, salt and garam masala. Add the egg plant to the pan and boil for 15 minutes on medium heat, then stir gently, simmer for a further 15 minutes. Serve with hot rice, salad or bread. Freezes well.

recipes.title: Potato Breakfast Casserole
directions: Night before:
Empty hash browns in large bowl with 1 quart hot tap water.
Let stand 10 minutes; drain well.
Beat eggs; stir in potatoes, cheeses, onion and seasonings.
Turn into greased pie plate.
Scatter bacon top; refrigerate.
recipes.text: Potato Breakfast Casserole. Night before: Empty hash browns in large bowl with 1 quart hot tap water. Let stand 10 minutes; drain well. Beat eggs; stir in potatoes, cheeses, onion and seasonings. Turn into greased pie plate. Scatter bacon top; refrigerate.

recipes.title: Fish And Onions("If You Catch It, We Eat It!")
ingredients: small fresh ginger root (1/2 to 1 inch), peeled and minced
2 cloves fresh garlic, minced or crushed
directions: Save 1 egg and 1/4 cup water, then combine cooked and drained spinach with all other ingredients, except oysters and bread crumbs.
Let stand for 10 minutes.
Shape into balls (if using oysters, use small raw oysters or halve each of the large raw oysters).
Put oyster in bread crumbs and wrap oyster in spinach mixture.
Beat the saved egg and 1/4 cup water.
Dip spinach balls in egg-water, then roll once more in bread crumbs.
Yields 12 plus balls, depending on size; the smaller, the better!
recipes.text: Fish And Onions("If You Catch It, We Eat It!"). Save 1 egg and 1/4 cup water, then combine cooked and drained spinach with all other ingredients, except oysters and bread crumbs. Let stand for 10 minutes. Shape into balls (if using oysters, use small raw oysters or halve each of the large raw oysters). Put oyster in bread crumbs and wrap oyster in spinach mixture. Beat the saved egg and 1/4 cup water. Dip spinach balls in egg-water, then roll once more in bread crumbs. Yields 12 plus balls, depending on size; the smaller, the better!

recipes.title: Chocolate Crinkles
directions: Thoroughly cream shortening, sugar and vanilla.
Beat in eggs, then chocolate.
recipes.text: Chocolate Crinkles. Thoroughly cream shortening, sugar and vanilla. Beat in eggs, then chocolate.

recipes.title: Sweet Potato Casserole
directions: Mix potatoes, sugar, eggs, margarine, milk and vanilla. Pour into a greased casserole dish.
recipes.text: Sweet Potato Casserole. Mix potatoes, sugar, eggs, margarine, milk and vanilla. Pour into a greased casserole dish.

recipes.title: Peter Paul Mounds Cake
ingredients: 1 box Duncan Hines devil's food mix
directions: Mix all ingredients together.
Bake in oven at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.
This will make 3 layers.
Let cool; slit layers in half to make 6 layers.
recipes.text: Peter Paul Mounds Cake. Mix all ingredients together. Bake in oven at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes. This will make 3 layers. Let cool; slit layers in half to make 6 layers.

recipes.title: Broiled Lamb
directions: Combine all ingredients except for lamb.
Mix well and pour over lamb in glass dish.
Turn lamb to coat well.
Refrigerate overnight, turning occasionally.
recipes.text: Broiled Lamb. Combine all ingredients except for lamb. Mix well and pour over lamb in glass dish. Turn lamb to coat well. Refrigerate overnight, turning occasionally.

recipes.title: Broccoli Salad
directions: Combine all ingredients; mix well. This is a simple salad that keeps well. Better if made a day ahead.
recipes.text: Broccoli Salad. Combine all ingredients; mix well. This is a simple salad that keeps well. Better if made a day ahead.

recipes.title: Chicken Stir-Fry
ingredients: 2 whole boneless chicken breasts, thinly sliced
1/2 lb. broccoli or peapods (bite size pieces)
directions: Combine soy sauce, sherry, cornstarch, garlic and 1/4 cup water; set aside.
In wok, stir-fry chicken in hot oil 2 minutes. Add veggies, stir-fry for 4 minutes.
Add soy sauce mixture, cook and stir until slightly thickened.
recipes.text: Chicken Stir-Fry. Combine soy sauce, sherry, cornstarch, garlic and 1/4 cup water; set aside. In wok, stir-fry chicken in hot oil 2 minutes. Add veggies, stir-fry for 4 minutes. Add soy sauce mixture, cook and stir until slightly thickened.

recipes.title: Chili
directions: Brown hamburger and drain.
Add all ingredients and mix with enough water to mix good.
Cook to desired.
recipes.text: Chili. Brown hamburger and drain. Add all ingredients and mix with enough water to mix good. Cook to desired.

recipes.title: Coconut Pie
directions: Beat eggs slightly.
Add flour, butter and milk.
Add coconut. Pour into partially baked pie shell and bake about 45 minutes or until firm, at 325°.
recipes.text: Coconut Pie. Beat eggs slightly. Add flour, butter and milk. Add coconut. Pour into partially baked pie shell and bake about 45 minutes or until firm, at 325°.

recipes.title: Three Bean Casserole
directions: Brown Polish sausage and onion; drain.
Mix all ingredients in a large casserole and bake 45 minutes to 1 hour at 350°.
recipes.text: Three Bean Casserole. Brown Polish sausage and onion; drain. Mix all ingredients in a large casserole and bake 45 minutes to 1 hour at 350°.

recipes.title: Kay'S Casserole
ingredients: 2 Tbsp. butter, margarine or chicken fat
3 c. cooked rice, cooked in chicken broth
1 (10 3/4 oz.) can condensed cream of mushroom soup
directions: Cook onions and celery in butter until tender, but not brown. Stir in mushrooms, pimentos, chicken and rice.
Blend broth and soup.
Stir into chicken mixture.
Add salt and pepper to taste.
recipes.text: Kay'S Casserole. Cook onions and celery in butter until tender, but not brown. Stir in mushrooms, pimentos, chicken and rice. Blend broth and soup. Stir into chicken mixture. Add salt and pepper to taste.

recipes.title: Cookie Factory Chocolate Chip Cookies
directions: Cream together butter, sugar and brown sugar. Add eggs and vanilla. Mix together flour and oatmeal. Put small amount into blender until it turns to powder. Add salt, baking powder and baking soda. Mix all ingredients together. Add chocolate chips and nuts. Make golf ball sized cookies 2-inches apart. Bake at 375° on an ungreased cookie sheet for 8 minutes (or a little longer).
recipes.text: Cookie Factory Chocolate Chip Cookies. Cream together butter, sugar and brown sugar. Add eggs and vanilla. Mix together flour and oatmeal. Put small amount into blender until it turns to powder. Add salt, baking powder and baking soda. Mix all ingredients together. Add chocolate chips and nuts. Make golf ball sized cookies 2-inches apart. Bake at 375° on an ungreased cookie sheet for 8 minutes (or a little longer).

recipes.title: Cherry Dessert
directions: In a slightly greased 9 x 11-inch pan, spread a can of crushed pineapple (juice and all).
Next, sprinkle pecans evenly.
Add dry cake mix and sprinkle evenly.
Then pour melted butter over all. Bake for 1 hour at 350°.
recipes.text: Cherry Dessert. In a slightly greased 9 x 11-inch pan, spread a can of crushed pineapple (juice and all). Next, sprinkle pecans evenly. Add dry cake mix and sprinkle evenly. Then pour melted butter over all. Bake for 1 hour at 350°.

recipes.title: Sugared Nuts
directions: Boil first 4 ingredients to soft ball stage, 238° and remove from heat.
Pour in vanilla and walnuts; stir until thick and creamy.
Separate with fork.
recipes.text: Sugared Nuts. Boil first 4 ingredients to soft ball stage, 238° and remove from heat. Pour in vanilla and walnuts; stir until thick and creamy. Separate with fork.

recipes.title: Sugarless Christmas Pie
directions: Combine eggs, applesauce, milk, liquid sweetener, lemon juice and nutmeg.
Pour into unbaked pie shell.
Bake for 1 hour at 400° until knife comes out clean.
recipes.text: Sugarless Christmas Pie. Combine eggs, applesauce, milk, liquid sweetener, lemon juice and nutmeg. Pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake for 1 hour at 400° until knife comes out clean.

recipes.title: Microwave Rotel Chicken
ingredients: 4 cooked and deboned chicken leg quarters
directions: Boil and debone chicken. Saute onion and bell pepper.
Cook spaghetti.
In microwave dish, combine cheese, soup, Ro-Tel and mushrooms.
Heat until soupy.
Combine all ingredients in casserole dish.
Heat through and through in oven or microwave.
recipes.text: Microwave Rotel Chicken. Boil and debone chicken. Saute onion and bell pepper. Cook spaghetti. In microwave dish, combine cheese, soup, Ro-Tel and mushrooms. Heat until soupy. Combine all ingredients in casserole dish. Heat through and through in oven or microwave.

recipes.title: Green Goddess Vegetable Dip
directions: Put in blender and then serve with your favorite vegetable.
recipes.text: Green Goddess Vegetable Dip. Put in blender and then serve with your favorite vegetable.

recipes.title: Rum Cake
directions: Cream oleo and sugar well.
Add vanilla and eggs, one at a time.
Add sifted flour and mix well.
Bake in stem pan for 1 hour at 325°.
recipes.text: Rum Cake. Cream oleo and sugar well. Add vanilla and eggs, one at a time. Add sifted flour and mix well. Bake in stem pan for 1 hour at 325°.

recipes.title: Meat Noodle Casserole
directions: Brown meat.
Add onion, celery and green pepper.
Cook until tender.
Add salt and pepper.
Cook noodles; drain.
recipes.text: Meat Noodle Casserole. Brown meat. Add onion, celery and green pepper. Cook until tender. Add salt and pepper. Cook noodles; drain.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Pie
ingredients: 1 2/3 c. evaporated milk, top milk or light cream (about)
directions: Mix first 7 ingredients together and add milk.
Pour into pastry shell and bake 15 minutes at 425°.
Reduce heat to 350° to 375° and bake 45 minutes, or until done.
recipes.text: Pumpkin Pie. Mix first 7 ingredients together and add milk. Pour into pastry shell and bake 15 minutes at 425°. Reduce heat to 350° to 375° and bake 45 minutes, or until done.

recipes.title: Cabbage Au Gratin
directions: Cook cabbage in boiling salted water until tender, 5 to 7 minutes.
Drain.
recipes.text: Cabbage Au Gratin. Cook cabbage in boiling salted water until tender, 5 to 7 minutes. Drain.

recipes.title: Hash Brown Potato Casserole
ingredients: 2 lb. pkg. frozen hash brown potatoes
1/2 c. diced bell pepper (red and green mixed)
directions: Saut onions and peppers in margarine. Mix all ingredients, stirring gently. Pour into greased 3-quart baking dish. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Hash Brown Potato Casserole. Saut onions and peppers in margarine. Mix all ingredients, stirring gently. Pour into greased 3-quart baking dish. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Chili Pecan Roll
directions: Bring cheeses to room temperature; mix together until well blended.
Add next 6 ingredients.
Mix well.
Shape into rolls 4-inches long and 1 1/2-inches in diameter.
Chill 30 minutes. Roll each in chili powder and wrap in foil.
Chill until firm. Cut into slices 1/2-inch thick and serve on round crackers. Yields about 3 dozen canapes.
recipes.text: Chili Pecan Roll. Bring cheeses to room temperature; mix together until well blended. Add next 6 ingredients. Mix well. Shape into rolls 4-inches long and 1 1/2-inches in diameter. Chill 30 minutes. Roll each in chili powder and wrap in foil. Chill until firm. Cut into slices 1/2-inch thick and serve on round crackers. Yields about 3 dozen canapes.

recipes.title: Frozen Salad
directions: Mix all of the ingredients together.
Mix well.
Put in large Pyrex dish and freeze.
recipes.text: Frozen Salad. Mix all of the ingredients together. Mix well. Put in large Pyrex dish and freeze.

recipes.title: Baked Lasagna
directions: Boil noodles.
When done, add cold water until cool.
Mix eggs and cottage cheese together.
Season mixture with salt and pepper. Brown onion and ground beef; drain.
Add tomato sauce and paste to beef.
Simmer mixture for 15 minutes.
recipes.text: Baked Lasagna. Boil noodles. When done, add cold water until cool. Mix eggs and cottage cheese together. Season mixture with salt and pepper. Brown onion and ground beef; drain. Add tomato sauce and paste to beef. Simmer mixture for 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Clam Chowder
ingredients: 1 qt. clams, chopped in a can and juice
directions: Fry bacon, crumble and drain. Save 1 tablespoon of bacon grease to add to clams. Chop and saute lightly the onions.
Add all ingredients back to pot (12-quart). Add approximately 1 quart water. Cook over medium heat for 30 minutes, stirring, then simmer for 2 hours.
Grate raw potatoes and add to pot, if you want it thicker or add additional water if too thick after 30 minutes. Add salt to taste.
recipes.text: Clam Chowder. Fry bacon, crumble and drain. Save 1 tablespoon of bacon grease to add to clams. Chop and saute lightly the onions. Add all ingredients back to pot (12-quart). Add approximately 1 quart water. Cook over medium heat for 30 minutes, stirring, then simmer for 2 hours. Grate raw potatoes and add to pot, if you want it thicker or add additional water if too thick after 30 minutes. Add salt to taste.

recipes.title: Play Dough(Not Edible)
directions: Combine.
Cook 3 minutes.
Dump out and knead.
Store in a covered container at room temperature.
recipes.text: Play Dough(Not Edible). Combine. Cook 3 minutes. Dump out and knead. Store in a covered container at room temperature.

recipes.title: Pink Champagne Salad
directions: Mix cheese and sugar.
Add pineapple, strawberries, bananas and Cool Whip.
Place in a 9 x 13-inch pan and freeze.
Before use, take out 1 1/2 hours to soften.
recipes.text: Pink Champagne Salad. Mix cheese and sugar. Add pineapple, strawberries, bananas and Cool Whip. Place in a 9 x 13-inch pan and freeze. Before use, take out 1 1/2 hours to soften.

recipes.title: Hamburger Pie
directions: *Combine corn meal mix and milk and water; use recipe for corn bread. Add enough liquid to mixture so it will pour easily over other ingredients.
recipes.text: Hamburger Pie. *Combine corn meal mix and milk and water; use recipe for corn bread. Add enough liquid to mixture so it will pour easily over other ingredients.

recipes.title: Fresh Apple Cake
directions: Sift the flour, sugar, baking soda, cinnamon, nutmeg and salt into a large bowl. Stir in the apples, nuts, butter and lightly beaten eggs.
Mix ingredients thoroughly together.
The batter will be very thick.
Transfer to greased pan.
Bake in a 350° oven until cake springs back at touch, about 1 1/4 hours.
Serve warm topped with vanilla ice cream.
recipes.text: Fresh Apple Cake. Sift the flour, sugar, baking soda, cinnamon, nutmeg and salt into a large bowl. Stir in the apples, nuts, butter and lightly beaten eggs. Mix ingredients thoroughly together. The batter will be very thick. Transfer to greased pan. Bake in a 350° oven until cake springs back at touch, about 1 1/4 hours. Serve warm topped with vanilla ice cream.

recipes.title: Lemon Chess Pie
directions: Blend all ingredients together (don't beat) and pour into pie shell. Bake at 350° for 35 to 45 minutes.
Makes 8 servings.
recipes.text: Lemon Chess Pie. Blend all ingredients together (don't beat) and pour into pie shell. Bake at 350° for 35 to 45 minutes. Makes 8 servings.

recipes.title: Broccoli Casserole
directions: Combine all ingredients in casserole dish.
Bake at 350° for 45 to 60 minutes.
recipes.text: Broccoli Casserole. Combine all ingredients in casserole dish. Bake at 350° for 45 to 60 minutes.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Pudding
directions: Beat all ingredients for 1 minute. Put in dessert glasses or prebaked pie shell. Cool for 3 hours before serving.
recipes.text: Pumpkin Pudding. Beat all ingredients for 1 minute. Put in dessert glasses or prebaked pie shell. Cool for 3 hours before serving.

recipes.title: Low-Fat Microwave Lasagne
ingredients: 16 oz. spaghetti sauce (homemade or store bought)
1 (16 oz.) carton fat-free or low-fat cottage cheese
2 c. (about 8 oz.) shredded, fat-free or low-fat Mozzarella cheese
directions: Crumble turkey into 1 1/2-quart casserole.
Cover loosely and microwave on High (100%) for 3 minutes; break up and stir.
Cover and microwave another 2 to 3 minutes more; drain, if necessary. Add to turkey, spaghetti sauce, tomato sauce, 1 tablespoon parsley and the oregano; stir well.
Cover tightly and microwave on High to boiling, 3 to 4 minutes.
recipes.text: Low-Fat Microwave Lasagne. Crumble turkey into 1 1/2-quart casserole. Cover loosely and microwave on High (100%) for 3 minutes; break up and stir. Cover and microwave another 2 to 3 minutes more; drain, if necessary. Add to turkey, spaghetti sauce, tomato sauce, 1 tablespoon parsley and the oregano; stir well. Cover tightly and microwave on High to boiling, 3 to 4 minutes.

recipes.title: Easy Dill Dip
ingredients: salt and black pepper to taste
directions: Mix all ingredients until blended and smooth.
Chill a few hours or overnight.
Delicious with vegetables or crackers.
recipes.text: Easy Dill Dip. Mix all ingredients until blended and smooth. Chill a few hours or overnight. Delicious with vegetables or crackers.

recipes.title: Strawberry Square Salad
ingredients: 10 oz. frozen strawberries, thawed and drained
directions: Dissolve gelatin and water together.
Add pineapple juice. Place in the refrigerator until partially congealed.
Fold in fruit and marshmallows.
Pour into a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Place in refrigerator overnight to congeal.
Serves 24.
recipes.text: Strawberry Square Salad. Dissolve gelatin and water together. Add pineapple juice. Place in the refrigerator until partially congealed. Fold in fruit and marshmallows. Pour into a 9 x 13-inch pan. Place in refrigerator overnight to congeal. Serves 24.

recipes.title: Lasagna
directions: Boil noodles until tender.
Brown meat, then drain.
Pour meat back into pan.
Simmer meat with tomato sauce 20 minutes.
Add 2 pinches of seasoning.
recipes.text: Lasagna. Boil noodles until tender. Brown meat, then drain. Pour meat back into pan. Simmer meat with tomato sauce 20 minutes. Add 2 pinches of seasoning.

recipes.title: Lemon Frosting
directions: Mix sugar, salt and egg.
Blend in syrup.
Add shortening, vanilla, lemon juice and lemon peel. Mix until smooth and creamy.
recipes.text: Lemon Frosting. Mix sugar, salt and egg. Blend in syrup. Add shortening, vanilla, lemon juice and lemon peel. Mix until smooth and creamy.

recipes.title: Seafood Casserole
ingredients: celery, salt and pepper to taste
directions: Combine the rice with shrimp and crab meat.
Add pepper and mushrooms.
Add enough mayonnaise to hold casserole together.
Add salt, pepper and celery.
Top with crumbled potato chips.
Bake at 325° for 20 to 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Seafood Casserole. Combine the rice with shrimp and crab meat. Add pepper and mushrooms. Add enough mayonnaise to hold casserole together. Add salt, pepper and celery. Top with crumbled potato chips. Bake at 325° for 20 to 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Baked Beans
directions: Wash beans. Add boiling water. Cover and let stand 1 hour or longer. Cook in same water until tender (about 1 hour). Add more water as necessary. Add all ingredients to the beans. Blend. Pour beans into deep baking pan. Bake.
recipes.text: Baked Beans. Wash beans. Add boiling water. Cover and let stand 1 hour or longer. Cook in same water until tender (about 1 hour). Add more water as necessary. Add all ingredients to the beans. Blend. Pour beans into deep baking pan. Bake.

recipes.title: Hot Artichoke Dip
ingredients: 8 oz. cream cheese, softened and divided
directions: Chop artichokes coarsely in processor or blender.
Add 1/2 cup Parmesan cheese, 1/2 package cream cheese, 1/4 cup mayonnaise, 1/4 teaspoon dill weed, garlic and lemon juice.
Process until smooth. Smooth into 10-inch pie plate.
Process the balance of ingredients until smooth and add to plate.
Bake at 400° for 10 minutes.
recipes.text: Hot Artichoke Dip. Chop artichokes coarsely in processor or blender. Add 1/2 cup Parmesan cheese, 1/2 package cream cheese, 1/4 cup mayonnaise, 1/4 teaspoon dill weed, garlic and lemon juice. Process until smooth. Smooth into 10-inch pie plate. Process the balance of ingredients until smooth and add to plate. Bake at 400° for 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Ham And Potato Salad
directions: Cook and then cube potatoes.
Cook and then chop green beans. Combine potatoes, beans, ham and onions.
Mix vinegar, mayonnaise, sour cream, salt and pepper.
Add to vegetables and toss lightly.
recipes.text: Ham And Potato Salad. Cook and then cube potatoes. Cook and then chop green beans. Combine potatoes, beans, ham and onions. Mix vinegar, mayonnaise, sour cream, salt and pepper. Add to vegetables and toss lightly.

recipes.title: Chicken Breasts With Apple Stuffing
ingredients: 1 (16 oz.) pkg. seasoned corn stuffing mix
1 medium green apple, peeled and coarsely chopped
directions: In a large saucepan bring water, apple juice and 4 tablespoons of butter to a boil.
Remove from heat and add stuffing mix and 2 tablespoons of maple syrup.
Set aside.
recipes.text: Chicken Breasts With Apple Stuffing. In a large saucepan bring water, apple juice and 4 tablespoons of butter to a boil. Remove from heat and add stuffing mix and 2 tablespoons of maple syrup. Set aside.

recipes.title: Pasta Vegetable Salad
ingredients: bell pepper, cut into small pieces
directions: Combine all ingredients in a large bowl and top with dressing.
recipes.text: Pasta Vegetable Salad. Combine all ingredients in a large bowl and top with dressing.

recipes.title: Baked Beans
directions: Fry bacon; add other ingredients.
Simmer 20 minutes, covered. Add drained green beans, kidney beans, lima beans and pork and beans.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Baked Beans. Fry bacon; add other ingredients. Simmer 20 minutes, covered. Add drained green beans, kidney beans, lima beans and pork and beans. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Marsha'S Baked Beans
directions: Brown hamburger meat with pepper and onion in skillet.
Mix in all other ingredients and serve.
recipes.text: Marsha'S Baked Beans. Brown hamburger meat with pepper and onion in skillet. Mix in all other ingredients and serve.

recipes.title: Amadama Bread
directions: Heat oven to 350°.
Combine cornmeal, Crisco, molasses and salt.
Pour 2 cups boiling water over mixture; let cool.
Put 2 packages yeast in 1/2 cup warm water to dissolve.
Pour over mixture and add flour until dough forms a ball.
Knead for 8 minutes.
Place in greased bowl, double in size, punch down and rise 1 more hour.
Bake for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Amadama Bread. Heat oven to 350°. Combine cornmeal, Crisco, molasses and salt. Pour 2 cups boiling water over mixture; let cool. Put 2 packages yeast in 1/2 cup warm water to dissolve. Pour over mixture and add flour until dough forms a ball. Knead for 8 minutes. Place in greased bowl, double in size, punch down and rise 1 more hour. Bake for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Sun-Dried Tomatoes And Potatoes
ingredients: 1 1/2 lb. very small red skinned potatoes, quartered
directions: Simmer the dried tomatoes and potatoes in just enough water to cover. During the last 3 minutes of cooking time on the potatoes, add the broccoli florets. Dress tomato-potato combo with parsley, oil, salt and pepper.
recipes.text: Sun-Dried Tomatoes And Potatoes. Simmer the dried tomatoes and potatoes in just enough water to cover. During the last 3 minutes of cooking time on the potatoes, add the broccoli florets. Dress tomato-potato combo with parsley, oil, salt and pepper.

recipes.title: Congo Squares
directions: Mix and sift dry ingredients.
Add oil, eggs, chocolate chips and nuts.
Pour into greased pan and bake at 325° for 25 to 35 minutes.
Let cool and cut into squares.
recipes.text: Congo Squares. Mix and sift dry ingredients. Add oil, eggs, chocolate chips and nuts. Pour into greased pan and bake at 325° for 25 to 35 minutes. Let cool and cut into squares.

recipes.title: 1 - 2 - 3 Chocolate Sauce
directions: Mix and bring to a boil, stirring constantly.
Let it boil 1 minute, then add 1 teaspoon vanilla.
Mix well for 1 minute. Serve warm.
recipes.text: 1 - 2 - 3 Chocolate Sauce. Mix and bring to a boil, stirring constantly. Let it boil 1 minute, then add 1 teaspoon vanilla. Mix well for 1 minute. Serve warm.

recipes.title: Sausage Bar Casserole
directions: Brown sausage and drain really good. Add cream cheese and mix well. On a prepared baking sheet or casserole dish, lay 2 cans of crescent rolls out (DO NOT ROLL THEM), lay them where they form a single layer touching each other.
recipes.text: Sausage Bar Casserole. Brown sausage and drain really good. Add cream cheese and mix well. On a prepared baking sheet or casserole dish, lay 2 cans of crescent rolls out (DO NOT ROLL THEM), lay them where they form a single layer touching each other.

recipes.title: Microwave Peanut Brittle
directions: Stir peanuts, sugar, syrups and salt together in deep bowl. Cook on High 4 minutes.
Stir candy so all sugar is mixed and continue cooking on High 3 more minutes.
Add butter and vanilla to syrup, blending well.
Cook on High 1 to 3 minutes.
Add soda and stir until light and foamy.
Pour immediately onto lightly buttered surface, spreading it out.
Cool and break into pieces. Store in airtight container.
If roasted, salted peanuts are used, don't salt and add peanuts after first 4 minutes of cooking.
recipes.text: Microwave Peanut Brittle. Stir peanuts, sugar, syrups and salt together in deep bowl. Cook on High 4 minutes. Stir candy so all sugar is mixed and continue cooking on High 3 more minutes. Add butter and vanilla to syrup, blending well. Cook on High 1 to 3 minutes. Add soda and stir until light and foamy. Pour immediately onto lightly buttered surface, spreading it out. Cool and break into pieces. Store in airtight container. If roasted, salted peanuts are used, don't salt and add peanuts after first 4 minutes of cooking.

recipes.title: Broccoli Casserole
directions: Melt butter in skillet.
Saute onions and celery.
Stir in soup and Cheez Whiz.
Boil broccoli and Minute Rice.
Add these to the other mixture.
recipes.text: Broccoli Casserole. Melt butter in skillet. Saute onions and celery. Stir in soup and Cheez Whiz. Boil broccoli and Minute Rice. Add these to the other mixture.

recipes.title: Chicken Noodle Soup
directions: Boil chicken.
Add all seasonings.
After done, debone chicken and then add 1 can of broth and bouillon cubes.
(Cut up fine the celery stalks, carrots and onion.)
Cook until done.
Add noodles. Lastly add meat.
Great with cornbread.
recipes.text: Chicken Noodle Soup. Boil chicken. Add all seasonings. After done, debone chicken and then add 1 can of broth and bouillon cubes. (Cut up fine the celery stalks, carrots and onion.) Cook until done. Add noodles. Lastly add meat. Great with cornbread.

recipes.title: Stuffed Shells
directions: Mix spaghetti sauce and hamburger together.
Set aside.
Mix rest of ingredients to make filling.
Stuff shells with filling. Put 1/4 of sauce mixture in two 9 x 13-inch pans.
Place filled shells in pan and pour rest of sauce over shells.
Sprinkle with more Parmesan cheese.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
Makes 2 pans.
recipes.text: Stuffed Shells. Mix spaghetti sauce and hamburger together. Set aside. Mix rest of ingredients to make filling. Stuff shells with filling. Put 1/4 of sauce mixture in two 9 x 13-inch pans. Place filled shells in pan and pour rest of sauce over shells. Sprinkle with more Parmesan cheese. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes. Makes 2 pans.

recipes.title: Bailey'S Irish Cream
ingredients: 4 tsp. instant coffee, diluted in small amount hot water
directions: Mix all together and put in refrigerator.
recipes.text: Bailey'S Irish Cream. Mix all together and put in refrigerator.

recipes.title: Italian Slaw
directions: Shred cabbage, place in a large bowl, in alternate layers of cabbage and thinly sliced onion rings.
Top with 3/4 cup sugar. Bring to boil 1 cup sugar, vinegar, oil, salt, dry mustard and celery seed.
When mixture boils, pour over cabbage.
Do not stir. Cover; let stand overnight or at least 6 to 8 hours.
recipes.text: Italian Slaw. Shred cabbage, place in a large bowl, in alternate layers of cabbage and thinly sliced onion rings. Top with 3/4 cup sugar. Bring to boil 1 cup sugar, vinegar, oil, salt, dry mustard and celery seed. When mixture boils, pour over cabbage. Do not stir. Cover; let stand overnight or at least 6 to 8 hours.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Pinwheel Cookies
directions: Combine shortening, peanut butter, brown and white sugars, eggs and vanilla.
Add sifted flour, salt and soda.
Roll dough out to 1/4-inch thick in an oblong shape.
Spread with the melted chocolate chips.
Roll up the dough on a sheet of waxed paper and refrigerate.
(In rolling up the dough, it's a little hard to get it started, but persevere.)
After the dough is chilled, slice into 1/4 to 1/2-inch slices.
Bake on an ungreased cookie sheet at 350° for 10 minutes.
recipes.text: Peanut Butter Pinwheel Cookies. Combine shortening, peanut butter, brown and white sugars, eggs and vanilla. Add sifted flour, salt and soda. Roll dough out to 1/4-inch thick in an oblong shape. Spread with the melted chocolate chips. Roll up the dough on a sheet of waxed paper and refrigerate. (In rolling up the dough, it's a little hard to get it started, but persevere.) After the dough is chilled, slice into 1/4 to 1/2-inch slices. Bake on an ungreased cookie sheet at 350° for 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Fresh Fruit Dip
ingredients: 1/8 tsp. ground cinnamon or nutmeg or ginger
directions: Stir together yogurt, applesauce, powdered sugar, vanilla and cinnamon, nutmeg or ginger.
Chill until serving.
recipes.text: Fresh Fruit Dip. Stir together yogurt, applesauce, powdered sugar, vanilla and cinnamon, nutmeg or ginger. Chill until serving.

recipes.title: Cheese Cake
directions: Cream together cream cheese, vanilla and powdered sugar; set aside. Mix together Cool Whip and milk; fold cream cheese mixture into Cool Whip mixture. Top with pie filling.
recipes.text: Cheese Cake. Cream together cream cheese, vanilla and powdered sugar; set aside. Mix together Cool Whip and milk; fold cream cheese mixture into Cool Whip mixture. Top with pie filling.

recipes.title: Kahlua
directions: Mix all ingredients and shake several times a day until sugar is completely dissolved and mixture no longer separates.
recipes.text: Kahlua. Mix all ingredients and shake several times a day until sugar is completely dissolved and mixture no longer separates.

recipes.title: Cheese Crabmeat Sandwiches
directions: Mix first 4 ingredients.
Heat cheese, if necessary for easy mixing and spread on muffins.
Bake at 350° for 10 minutes.
recipes.text: Cheese Crabmeat Sandwiches. Mix first 4 ingredients. Heat cheese, if necessary for easy mixing and spread on muffins. Bake at 350° for 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Spring Salmon Dinner
ingredients: 1 to 1 1/4 lb. salmon fillets, skin removed
1 Tbsp. minced fresh dill or 1 tsp. dried dill weed
3 medium size zucchini (about 8 oz. each), cut into bite size chunks
directions: About 30 minutes before serving, preheat broiler if manufacturer directs.
Cut potatoes into 1/4-inch thick slices. Arrange potato slices in single layer at one end of rack in broiling pan.
In small saucepan over low heat, melt 2 tablespoons corn oil spread. Stir in pepper and 1/2 teaspoon salt. With pastry brush, lightly brush some light corn oil spread mixture over potato slices.
Place broiling pan in oven 5 to 7-inches from source of heat.
Broil potatoes 8 minutes.
recipes.text: Spring Salmon Dinner. About 30 minutes before serving, preheat broiler if manufacturer directs. Cut potatoes into 1/4-inch thick slices. Arrange potato slices in single layer at one end of rack in broiling pan. In small saucepan over low heat, melt 2 tablespoons corn oil spread. Stir in pepper and 1/2 teaspoon salt. With pastry brush, lightly brush some light corn oil spread mixture over potato slices. Place broiling pan in oven 5 to 7-inches from source of heat. Broil potatoes 8 minutes.

recipes.title: Scalloped Corn
directions: Mix all together.
Bake at 350° for about an hour.
recipes.text: Scalloped Corn. Mix all together. Bake at 350° for about an hour.

recipes.title: Chocolate Pie
directions: Mix salt, sifted flour, sugar and cocoa.
Pour milk into saucepan and add sifted flour mixture.
Stir over heat until very warm.
Add well beaten egg yolks.
Cook until thick, stirring often.
Remove from heat and add butter and vanilla.
recipes.text: Chocolate Pie. Mix salt, sifted flour, sugar and cocoa. Pour milk into saucepan and add sifted flour mixture. Stir over heat until very warm. Add well beaten egg yolks. Cook until thick, stirring often. Remove from heat and add butter and vanilla.

recipes.title: Fannie Wilson'S Mahogany Cake
ingredients: 4 level tsp. cocoa in 4 Tbsp. hot water
4 egg whites, beaten stiff (save extra yolk for frosting)
1 box plus 1 c. confectioners sugar, sifted
1 egg yolk, mixed with 2 level tsp. cocoa and 3 Tbsp. hot coffee
directions: Mix well.
Spread between layers and on top of cake.
recipes.text: Fannie Wilson'S Mahogany Cake. Mix well. Spread between layers and on top of cake.

recipes.title: Dirt Cake
ingredients: 1 (4 oz.) pkg. vanilla instant pudding mix
directions: Cream confectioners sugar and cream cheese in mixer bowl until light and fluffy.
Add pudding mix and milk.
Beat until smooth. Fold in whipped topping.
Sprinkle half the crushed cookies into clean decorative flower pot.
Spoon in cream cheese mixture. Sprinkle remaining crushed cookies over top to resemble "dirt". Chill until serving time.
Place silk flowers in mixture to resemble potted plant.
Yield:
15 servings.
recipes.text: Dirt Cake. Cream confectioners sugar and cream cheese in mixer bowl until light and fluffy. Add pudding mix and milk. Beat until smooth. Fold in whipped topping. Sprinkle half the crushed cookies into clean decorative flower pot. Spoon in cream cheese mixture. Sprinkle remaining crushed cookies over top to resemble "dirt". Chill until serving time. Place silk flowers in mixture to resemble potted plant. Yield: 15 servings.

recipes.title: Low-Fat Berry Bavarian
ingredients: 1 (8 oz.) pkg. or 2 (4 oz.) pkg. Jell-O brand raspberry or strawberry sugar-free Jell-O
2 3/4 c. thawed Cool Whip lite whipped topping
directions: Stir boiling water into gelatin in a large bowl 2 minutes or completely dissolved.
Mix cold water and ice cubes to make 2 cups.
Add to gelatin; stir until slightly thickened.
Remove remaining ice cubes.
recipes.text: Low-Fat Berry Bavarian. Stir boiling water into gelatin in a large bowl 2 minutes or completely dissolved. Mix cold water and ice cubes to make 2 cups. Add to gelatin; stir until slightly thickened. Remove remaining ice cubes.

recipes.title: Eggplant Souffle
directions: Peel eggplant; cut up into pieces.
Dice a small onion and boil together until tender.
Drain and mash.
Season with salt and pepper.
Mix butter, flour and milk.
Add cheese, bread crumbs, catsup and eggs.
Mix well and add all this to mashed eggplant. Bake in buttered casserole dish at 350° for about 40 minutes until brown on top.
recipes.text: Eggplant Souffle. Peel eggplant; cut up into pieces. Dice a small onion and boil together until tender. Drain and mash. Season with salt and pepper. Mix butter, flour and milk. Add cheese, bread crumbs, catsup and eggs. Mix well and add all this to mashed eggplant. Bake in buttered casserole dish at 350° for about 40 minutes until brown on top.

recipes.title: Hello Dolly Bars
directions: Preheat oven to 350°.
In a 13 x 9-inch pan, melt margarine in oven.
Sprinkle crumbs over margarine; mix together and press into pan.
Pour milk over crumbs.
Top with remaining ingredients. Press firmly.
Bake 25 minutes.
Cool before cutting.
recipes.text: Hello Dolly Bars. Preheat oven to 350°. In a 13 x 9-inch pan, melt margarine in oven. Sprinkle crumbs over margarine; mix together and press into pan. Pour milk over crumbs. Top with remaining ingredients. Press firmly. Bake 25 minutes. Cool before cutting.

recipes.title: Fried Bananas
directions: Select ripe bananas. Remove skins; cut bananas in halves lengthwise. Dip into batter made from the egg, flour, milk, sugar and salt. Roll bananas in bread crumbs. Fry the bananas until golden brown. Drain on paper towels; keep hot. Squeeze lemon juice over them before serving.
recipes.text: Fried Bananas. Select ripe bananas. Remove skins; cut bananas in halves lengthwise. Dip into batter made from the egg, flour, milk, sugar and salt. Roll bananas in bread crumbs. Fry the bananas until golden brown. Drain on paper towels; keep hot. Squeeze lemon juice over them before serving.

recipes.title: Barbecue Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 c. Heinz medium salsa style catsup
directions: Combine all in a saucepan.
Heat to boiling.
Reduce heat. Simmer 30 to 45 minutes or until sauce is slightly thickened. Refrigerate.
recipes.text: Barbecue Sauce. Combine all in a saucepan. Heat to boiling. Reduce heat. Simmer 30 to 45 minutes or until sauce is slightly thickened. Refrigerate.

recipes.title: Sourdough Bread Starter
directions: Mix well; feed starter every 5 to 7 days.
Cover lightly with paper towel; let stand out of refrigerator 8 to 12 hours.
Take 1 cup out.
Make bread; give to a friend or toss 1 cup out.
recipes.text: Sourdough Bread Starter. Mix well; feed starter every 5 to 7 days. Cover lightly with paper towel; let stand out of refrigerator 8 to 12 hours. Take 1 cup out. Make bread; give to a friend or toss 1 cup out.

recipes.title: Aunt Betty'S Dill Pickles
directions: Wash and sterilize jars. Put 1 sprig of dill in bottom of each jar. Pack cucumbers into jars. Bring water, vinegar and salt to a boil and boil for about 5 minutes. Pour over cucumbers and seal.
recipes.text: Aunt Betty'S Dill Pickles. Wash and sterilize jars. Put 1 sprig of dill in bottom of each jar. Pack cucumbers into jars. Bring water, vinegar and salt to a boil and boil for about 5 minutes. Pour over cucumbers and seal.

recipes.title: Lime Pineapple Salad
directions: Dissolve jello and marshmallows in water on top of stove. Crumble cream cheese and add to jello mixture.
Let this simmer for 2 minutes.
Remove from stove.
Add pineapple (juice also). Pour into mold or dish.
Add chopped pecans on top and chill.
recipes.text: Lime Pineapple Salad. Dissolve jello and marshmallows in water on top of stove. Crumble cream cheese and add to jello mixture. Let this simmer for 2 minutes. Remove from stove. Add pineapple (juice also). Pour into mold or dish. Add chopped pecans on top and chill.

recipes.title: Famous Crock Pot Macaroni And Cheese
ingredients: 8 oz. elbow macaroni, cooked and drained
directions: Put all ingredients in crock pot sprayed with Pam.
Cook on low for 2 1/2 to 3 hours.
Double recipe to fill a large crock pot.
recipes.text: Famous Crock Pot Macaroni And Cheese. Put all ingredients in crock pot sprayed with Pam. Cook on low for 2 1/2 to 3 hours. Double recipe to fill a large crock pot.

recipes.title: Ruby Red Strawberry Burst
ingredients: 8 oz. Ocean Spray ruby red and strawberry juice drink
directions: Put all ingredients in a blender.
Blend for a few seconds on high speed or until ingredients are thoroughly combined.
Pour into a large glass.
Garnish with a strawberry sliced halfway and placed on rim of glass.
Makes 1 serving.
recipes.text: Ruby Red Strawberry Burst. Put all ingredients in a blender. Blend for a few seconds on high speed or until ingredients are thoroughly combined. Pour into a large glass. Garnish with a strawberry sliced halfway and placed on rim of glass. Makes 1 serving.

recipes.title: Potato Patties
directions: In a bowl, combine mashed potatoes, finely chopped onion, flour and salt.
Shape into patties.
Cook in frying pan with a little cooking oil.
Turn only once; brown well.
recipes.text: Potato Patties. In a bowl, combine mashed potatoes, finely chopped onion, flour and salt. Shape into patties. Cook in frying pan with a little cooking oil. Turn only once; brown well.

recipes.title: Ma'S Christmas Bread
directions: Sift together the flour, powder, sugar and salt.
Add fruit and nuts.
Beat eggs and combine with milk and melted butter.
Add this to the flour mixture, stirring just enough to moisten the flour.
Pour into well-greased loaf pan and let stand for 30 minutes.
Bake for 1 hour at 375°.
recipes.text: Ma'S Christmas Bread. Sift together the flour, powder, sugar and salt. Add fruit and nuts. Beat eggs and combine with milk and melted butter. Add this to the flour mixture, stirring just enough to moisten the flour. Pour into well-greased loaf pan and let stand for 30 minutes. Bake for 1 hour at 375°.

recipes.title: Hearty Vegetable Soup
ingredients: 1 large can regular V-8 tomato juice
directions: Chop and mix all vegetables.
Put into large kettle to cook. Cover with V-8 juice and enough water to cover.
Bring to boil; simmer 1 to 2 hours.
Add salt and pepper to taste.
recipes.text: Hearty Vegetable Soup. Chop and mix all vegetables. Put into large kettle to cook. Cover with V-8 juice and enough water to cover. Bring to boil; simmer 1 to 2 hours. Add salt and pepper to taste.

recipes.title: Cheese 'N Wiener Crescents
ingredients: Cheddar cheese, cut into narrow strips
directions: Slit wieners to within 1/2-inch of ends; insert strips of cheese.
Place wiener on shortest side of crescent dough triangles. Roll up individual wiener in single triangle.
Bake at 375° for 12 to 15 minutes or until golden brown.
recipes.text: Cheese 'N Wiener Crescents. Slit wieners to within 1/2-inch of ends; insert strips of cheese. Place wiener on shortest side of crescent dough triangles. Roll up individual wiener in single triangle. Bake at 375° for 12 to 15 minutes or until golden brown.

recipes.title: Bacon-Wrapped Mushroom Caps
ingredients: 30 small to medium mushrooms, stems removed
directions: Cut the bacon strips in half and wrap each strip around the perimeter of each mushroom cap to create a small cuff.
Fasten the back with a toothpick.
Broil mushrooms 5 minutes or until the back becomes slightly crisp, drain.
Mix the cheese with onion and bread crumbs.
Place a small mound of mixture inside each mushroom cap within the bacon cuff.
Broil 3 minutes. Serve hot.
recipes.text: Bacon-Wrapped Mushroom Caps. Cut the bacon strips in half and wrap each strip around the perimeter of each mushroom cap to create a small cuff. Fasten the back with a toothpick. Broil mushrooms 5 minutes or until the back becomes slightly crisp, drain. Mix the cheese with onion and bread crumbs. Place a small mound of mixture inside each mushroom cap within the bacon cuff. Broil 3 minutes. Serve hot.

recipes.title: Four Layer Supper Dish
directions: Brown ground beef in a skillet, stirring to break up meat. Drain off fat.
Wash potatoes and cut into slices (do not peel). Place sliced potatoes in a large baking pan or casserole.
Spoon the green beans on top, then the ground beef and finally the cheese.
Pour the milk over all.
Cover and cook over low heat or bake in a 350° oven for 1 hour.
Makes 6 (1-cup) servings.
recipes.text: Four Layer Supper Dish. Brown ground beef in a skillet, stirring to break up meat. Drain off fat. Wash potatoes and cut into slices (do not peel). Place sliced potatoes in a large baking pan or casserole. Spoon the green beans on top, then the ground beef and finally the cheese. Pour the milk over all. Cover and cook over low heat or bake in a 350° oven for 1 hour. Makes 6 (1-cup) servings.

recipes.title: Tastee Burger
directions: Place ground beef in a kettle.
Combine ketchup, mustard, horseradish, Worcestershire sauce and salt in a 1-cup measuring cup.
Stir into beef.
Fill the same cup with warm water and add to meat mixture.
Use the same cup to measure onion; add to meat mixture.
Stir in Accent and cook on low heat, stirring constantly, 15 minutes or until meat is in fine pieces.
Increase heat slowly until mixture boils.
Boil 25 minutes.
Stir every few minutes to keep from sticking.
recipes.text: Tastee Burger. Place ground beef in a kettle. Combine ketchup, mustard, horseradish, Worcestershire sauce and salt in a 1-cup measuring cup. Stir into beef. Fill the same cup with warm water and add to meat mixture. Use the same cup to measure onion; add to meat mixture. Stir in Accent and cook on low heat, stirring constantly, 15 minutes or until meat is in fine pieces. Increase heat slowly until mixture boils. Boil 25 minutes. Stir every few minutes to keep from sticking.

recipes.title: Zucchini Cobbler
directions: Cut butter into flour and sugar until it resembles coarse crumbs.
Put half of mixture into 8-inch baking dish.
Bake at 350° for 10 minutes.
recipes.text: Zucchini Cobbler. Cut butter into flour and sugar until it resembles coarse crumbs. Put half of mixture into 8-inch baking dish. Bake at 350° for 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Cinnamon Twist Bread
ingredients: 1 1/2 c. rolled oats (Quick or Old Fashioned)
directions: Soften yeast in lukewarm water.
Pour milk over sugar, salt and shortening; cool to lukewarm.
Beat in half of flour and beaten eggs.
Stir in yeast, raisins and rolled oats.
Add enough flour to make a stiff dough.
Turn out on lightly floured board. Knead until satiny, about 10 minutes.
Round dough into ball and place in greased bowl.
Cover.
Let rise until double or 1 hour. Divide dough into 2 parts.
Cover and let rest for 10 minutes.
recipes.text: Cinnamon Twist Bread. Soften yeast in lukewarm water. Pour milk over sugar, salt and shortening; cool to lukewarm. Beat in half of flour and beaten eggs. Stir in yeast, raisins and rolled oats. Add enough flour to make a stiff dough. Turn out on lightly floured board. Knead until satiny, about 10 minutes. Round dough into ball and place in greased bowl. Cover. Let rise until double or 1 hour. Divide dough into 2 parts. Cover and let rest for 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Blender Ketchup
directions: Quarter tomatoes; remove stem ends.
Add peppers, seeded and cut in strips and onions, peeled and quartered.
Mix.
Put vegetables in blender container, filling jar 3/4 full.
Blend at high speed 4 seconds; pour into large kettle.
Repeat until all vegetables
are blended.
recipes.text: Blender Ketchup. Quarter tomatoes; remove stem ends. Add peppers, seeded and cut in strips and onions, peeled and quartered. Mix. Put vegetables in blender container, filling jar 3/4 full. Blend at high speed 4 seconds; pour into large kettle. Repeat until all vegetables are blended.

recipes.title: Apple Dip
directions: Blend first three ingredients until well mixed; fold in nuts, if desired.
Dip apple slices or other fresh fruit into the dip and enjoy!
recipes.text: Apple Dip. Blend first three ingredients until well mixed; fold in nuts, if desired. Dip apple slices or other fresh fruit into the dip and enjoy!

recipes.title: Banana Sour Cream Coffee Cake
directions: Cream together shortening and sugar.
Beat in eggs, bananas and vanilla.
Fold in sour cream.
Sift together flour, baking powder, baking soda and salt.
Fold gently into creamed mixture, stirring just to blend.
Mix together the nuts, 1/4 cup sugar and cinnamon.
Sprinkle half of it in a well-greased tube or Bundt pan.
Add rest of batter; sprinkle remaining cinnamon mixture on top.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes, or until cake tester comes out clean.
Let stand in pan or rack for 5 minutes.
Loosen around edges and turn out on plate.
recipes.text: Banana Sour Cream Coffee Cake. Cream together shortening and sugar. Beat in eggs, bananas and vanilla. Fold in sour cream. Sift together flour, baking powder, baking soda and salt.
