Fold gently into creamed mixture, stirring just to blend. Mix together the nuts, 1/4 cup sugar and cinnamon. Sprinkle half of it in a well-greased tube or Bundt pan. Add rest of batter; sprinkle remaining cinnamon mixture on top. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes, or until cake tester comes out clean. Let stand in pan or rack for 5 minutes. Loosen around edges and turn out on plate.

recipes.title: Pie Crust
directions: Sift dry ingredients together and cut in lard until like meal, then add water.
Press into ball and roll about 1/4-inch thick. Handle as little as possible.
Makes 2 crusts. Put in pie pan and bake at 450° until well browned.
recipes.text: Pie Crust. Sift dry ingredients together and cut in lard until like meal, then add water. Press into ball and roll about 1/4-inch thick. Handle as little as possible. Makes 2 crusts. Put in pie pan and bake at 450° until well browned.

recipes.title: Sweet Potatoes And Coconut
directions: Blend and bake in moderate oven until firm.
Use as a vegetable or dessert.
recipes.text: Sweet Potatoes And Coconut. Blend and bake in moderate oven until firm. Use as a vegetable or dessert.

recipes.title: Ramen Chicken Salad
ingredients: 2 pkg. chicken flavored Ramen noodles with seasoning pkg., uncooked and crumbled
directions: Mix cabbage, onion, chicken, noodles (uncooked and crumbled), oil, sugar, rice vinegar, salt, pepper and noodle seasoning; stir well and toss.
Refrigerate overnight.
Before serving, garnish with sesame seeds and almonds.
Serves 8.
recipes.text: Ramen Chicken Salad. Mix cabbage, onion, chicken, noodles (uncooked and crumbled), oil, sugar, rice vinegar, salt, pepper and noodle seasoning; stir well and toss. Refrigerate overnight. Before serving, garnish with sesame seeds and almonds. Serves 8.

recipes.title: Granny'S Sugar Cookies
directions: Cream together butter and sugar.
Blend in egg.
Sift together and add to mixture flour, baking powder, salt and vanilla.
recipes.text: Granny'S Sugar Cookies. Cream together butter and sugar. Blend in egg. Sift together and add to mixture flour, baking powder, salt and vanilla.

recipes.title: Cucumber Sandwiches
directions: Mix the cream cheese and mayonnaise, then squeeze the half of lemon twice into the bowl.
Dice cucumber to desired size into the mixture.
Stir and spread on your favorite bread.
recipes.text: Cucumber Sandwiches. Mix the cream cheese and mayonnaise, then squeeze the half of lemon twice into the bowl. Dice cucumber to desired size into the mixture. Stir and spread on your favorite bread.

recipes.title: Spanish Spaghetti
directions: Saute onion until lightly browned.
Stir in chili powder, salt and pepper.
Add tomatoes.
Simmer for about 20 minutes, stirring often.
Layer spaghetti and cheese in casserole, saving 1/2 cup cheese.
Pour sauce over top and sprinkle olives over sauce.
Top with remaining cheese.
Bake at 350° until cheese melts.
recipes.text: Spanish Spaghetti. Saute onion until lightly browned. Stir in chili powder, salt and pepper. Add tomatoes. Simmer for about 20 minutes, stirring often. Layer spaghetti and cheese in casserole, saving 1/2 cup cheese. Pour sauce over top and sprinkle olives over sauce. Top with remaining cheese. Bake at 350° until cheese melts.

recipes.title: Classic Pecan Pie
ingredients: 1 c. Karo corn syrup (light or dark)
directions: In large bowl, stir eggs, corn syrup, margarine and vanilla until well blended.
Stir in pecans.
Pour into pie shell.
Bake in 350° oven for 50 to 55 minutes or until knife inserted halfway between center and edges comes out clean.
Cool.
Serves 8.
recipes.text: Classic Pecan Pie. In large bowl, stir eggs, corn syrup, margarine and vanilla until well blended. Stir in pecans. Pour into pie shell. Bake in 350° oven for 50 to 55 minutes or until knife inserted halfway between center and edges comes out clean. Cool. Serves 8.

recipes.title: Cinnamon Toast In Oven
directions: Set oven at 400°.
Mix margarine, sugar and cinnamon in a small bowl.
With a knife, spread the mixture on one side of the bread.
Place the bread on an ungreased cookie sheet.
Toast in the oven for 8 minutes.
recipes.text: Cinnamon Toast In Oven. Set oven at 400°. Mix margarine, sugar and cinnamon in a small bowl. With a knife, spread the mixture on one side of the bread. Place the bread on an ungreased cookie sheet. Toast in the oven for 8 minutes.

recipes.title: Coconut Chew Cookies
directions: Beat 3/4 cup butter at medium speed with mixer until creamy. Gradually add 3/4 cup powdered sugar and 1 1/2 cups flour, beating well.
Press into ungreased 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan.
Bake at 350° for 12 minutes.
recipes.text: Coconut Chew Cookies. Beat 3/4 cup butter at medium speed with mixer until creamy. Gradually add 3/4 cup powdered sugar and 1 1/2 cups flour, beating well. Press into ungreased 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Bake at 350° for 12 minutes.

recipes.title: Egg Pie
directions: Mix butter, sugar and flour.
Add eggs, milk, vanilla and salt.
Pour in pie shell; bake at 350° for about 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Egg Pie. Mix butter, sugar and flour. Add eggs, milk, vanilla and salt. Pour in pie shell; bake at 350° for about 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Watergate Salad
ingredients: 1 pkg. pistachio pudding mix with almonds
directions: Dissolve pudding mix with crushed pineapple.
Stir in Cool Whip and other ingredients.
Refrigerate 1 hour before serving.
recipes.text: Watergate Salad. Dissolve pudding mix with crushed pineapple. Stir in Cool Whip and other ingredients. Refrigerate 1 hour before serving.

recipes.title: Cinnamon Rolls
directions: Dissolve yeast in warm water. Add cake mix and flour.
Knead dough.
Let rise until double. Roll out and sprinkle with brown sugar and cinnamon.
Roll up and slice.
Let rise.
Bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes until brown.
Frost with favorite icing.
(I use 1 cup powdered sugar and enough water to make a thin glaze.)
recipes.text: Cinnamon Rolls. Dissolve yeast in warm water. Add cake mix and flour. Knead dough. Let rise until double. Roll out and sprinkle with brown sugar and cinnamon. Roll up and slice. Let rise. Bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes until brown. Frost with favorite icing. (I use 1 cup powdered sugar and enough water to make a thin glaze.)

recipes.title: Tuna Burgers
directions: Mix all ingredients well. Shape into patties and fry in enough oil to cover bottom of pan until brown on both sides.
recipes.text: Tuna Burgers. Mix all ingredients well. Shape into patties and fry in enough oil to cover bottom of pan until brown on both sides.

recipes.title: Cheese Potatoes
ingredients: 2 lb. pkg. hash brown frozen potatoes
directions: Mix all ingredients together.
Put in baking dish.
Bake 1 hour at 350°.
Take out and top with a mixture of buttered cornflakes.
Cook 10 more minutes.
Freezes well.
recipes.text: Cheese Potatoes. Mix all ingredients together. Put in baking dish. Bake 1 hour at 350°. Take out and top with a mixture of buttered cornflakes. Cook 10 more minutes. Freezes well.

recipes.title: Ribbon Raspberry Mold
directions: Dissolve jello in water.
Add raspberries.
Stir until thawed. Add pineapple and banana.
Pour 1/2 of mixture into clear glass bowl.
(Do not refrigerate remaining mixture.) Refrigerate at least 2 hours.
Spread sour cream over chilled jello mixture. Pour remaining mixture over sour cream.
Refrigerate 2 hours.
recipes.text: Ribbon Raspberry Mold. Dissolve jello in water. Add raspberries. Stir until thawed. Add pineapple and banana. Pour 1/2 of mixture into clear glass bowl. (Do not refrigerate remaining mixture.) Refrigerate at least 2 hours. Spread sour cream over chilled jello mixture. Pour remaining mixture over sour cream. Refrigerate 2 hours.

recipes.title: Pepperoni Loaf
directions: Defrost dough on countertop overnight.
Preheat oven to 350°. Roll out dough on cookie sheet.
Open oven and place on oven door to rise for 15 to 20 minutes or until puffy.
Return to countertop and cover with cheese slices.
Next, cover cheese with pepperoni slices.
Roll up dough like you would a jelly roll.
Turn open side down and pinch ends to close.
Baste with egg white, then sprinkle with sesame seed.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
Serve slices plain or with your favorite tomato sauce.
recipes.text: Pepperoni Loaf. Defrost dough on countertop overnight. Preheat oven to 350°. Roll out dough on cookie sheet. Open oven and place on oven door to rise for 15 to 20 minutes or until puffy. Return to countertop and cover with cheese slices. Next, cover cheese with pepperoni slices. Roll up dough like you would a jelly roll. Turn open side down and pinch ends to close. Baste with egg white, then sprinkle with sesame seed. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes. Serve slices plain or with your favorite tomato sauce.

recipes.title: Hot Cocoa Mix
directions: Mix well.
Store in airtight canister.
Place 1/4 or 1/3 cup of mix in mug.
Add hot water; mix well (1 cup).
recipes.text: Hot Cocoa Mix. Mix well. Store in airtight canister. Place 1/4 or 1/3 cup of mix in mug. Add hot water; mix well (1 cup).

recipes.title: Regal Chicken On Rice
ingredients: 10 1/2 oz. can cream of mushroom soup
directions: Blend mushroom soup and milk; reserve 1/2 cup.
Combine remaining soup mix with rice, mushroom and onion soup mix and pour into a 2-quart baking dish.
Arrange chicken on top.
Pour reserved soup mixture over chicken and sprinkle with paprika. Cover.
Bake at 325° for 1 hour.
Uncover and bake 15 minutes longer.
recipes.text: Regal Chicken On Rice. Blend mushroom soup and milk; reserve 1/2 cup. Combine remaining soup mix with rice, mushroom and onion soup mix and pour into a 2-quart baking dish. Arrange chicken on top. Pour reserved soup mixture over chicken and sprinkle with paprika. Cover. Bake at 325° for 1 hour. Uncover and bake 15 minutes longer.

recipes.title: Sugar-Free Fruit Bars
directions: Boil together dates, raisins, prunes and 1 cup water.
When done, add margarine and vanilla; cool.
Beat the eggs.
Add cooled fruit mixture and the rest of the ingredients.
Pour into a greased 9 x 13-inch pan.
Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes. (Real good for diabetics.)
recipes.text: Sugar-Free Fruit Bars. Boil together dates, raisins, prunes and 1 cup water. When done, add margarine and vanilla; cool. Beat the eggs. Add cooled fruit mixture and the rest of the ingredients. Pour into a greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes. (Real good for diabetics.)

recipes.title: Pie Crust
ingredients: 5 lb. bag Gold Medal all-purpose flour
directions: Mix all ingredients together in a dishpan or very large mixing bowl.
recipes.text: Pie Crust. Mix all ingredients together in a dishpan or very large mixing bowl.

recipes.title: Chow Mein Casserole
directions: Brown ground beef in skillet, stirring until crumbly.
Add nest 3 ingredients, mixing well.
Place 1/4 of the noodles in greased 1 qt. baking dish.
Layer half the ground beef, half the soup and half the remaining noodles in casserole.
Bake at 350 degrees for 45 minutes.
Yields 6 servings.
recipes.text: Chow Mein Casserole. Brown ground beef in skillet, stirring until crumbly. Add nest 3 ingredients, mixing well. Place 1/4 of the noodles in greased 1 qt. baking dish. Layer half the ground beef, half the soup and half the remaining noodles in casserole. Bake at 350 degrees for 45 minutes. Yields 6 servings.

recipes.title: Bacon And Onion Muffins
directions: Fry bacon until crisp in skillet.
Remove with slotted spoon and drain on paper towels.
Saute onion in 1 tablespoon bacon drippings until tender (do not brown).
Set aside to cool.
recipes.text: Bacon And Onion Muffins. Fry bacon until crisp in skillet. Remove with slotted spoon and drain on paper towels. Saute onion in 1 tablespoon bacon drippings until tender (do not brown). Set aside to cool.

recipes.title: Cheese Ball
directions: Mix all ingredients except lemon pepper.
Form into one or two balls.
Roll in lemon pepper.
Wrap in plastic wrap and refrigerate at least overnight.
Allow to stand approximately 1 hour uncovered before serving.
recipes.text: Cheese Ball. Mix all ingredients except lemon pepper. Form into one or two balls. Roll in lemon pepper. Wrap in plastic wrap and refrigerate at least overnight. Allow to stand approximately 1 hour uncovered before serving.

recipes.title: Breakfast In A Biscuit
directions: Cook bacon in a frypan until crisp.
Drain and set aside. Beat eggs in a small bowl.
Coat frypan with a no-stick cooking spray and scramble eggs until soft.
Set aside.
recipes.text: Breakfast In A Biscuit. Cook bacon in a frypan until crisp. Drain and set aside. Beat eggs in a small bowl. Coat frypan with a no-stick cooking spray and scramble eggs until soft. Set aside.

recipes.title: Zucchini Bread
directions: Beat eggs until light and foamy.
Add oil, sugar, zucchini and vanilla.
Mix lightly but well.
Add dry ingredients until blended.
Add raisins and nuts.
Put in 3 greased and floured loaf pans.
Bake 1 hour at 325°.
recipes.text: Zucchini Bread. Beat eggs until light and foamy. Add oil, sugar, zucchini and vanilla. Mix lightly but well. Add dry ingredients until blended. Add raisins and nuts. Put in 3 greased and floured loaf pans. Bake 1 hour at 325°.

recipes.title: Annette'S Potato Salad
ingredients: 12 potatoes, peeled and cut into 1/4-inch slices
directions: In large pot, boil 6 cups water.
Add potatoes and cook 20 to 25 minutes.
Drain water and cool for 15 minutes.
In large bowl, add remaining ingredients with potatoes and toss gently.
Add additional mayonnaise, if needed, and refrigerate.
Salt and pepper to taste.
Makes 6 to 8 servings.
recipes.text: Annette'S Potato Salad. In large pot, boil 6 cups water. Add potatoes and cook 20 to 25 minutes. Drain water and cool for 15 minutes. In large bowl, add remaining ingredients with potatoes and toss gently. Add additional mayonnaise, if needed, and refrigerate. Salt and pepper to taste. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

recipes.title: Pattie'S Peanut Butter Pie
directions: Whip cream cheese until soft and fluffy. Beat in peanut butter and sugar. Slowly add milk into mixture, blending thoroughly. Fold in Cool Whip. Pour into prepared graham cracker crust (optional: sprinkle with chopped nuts). Freeze until firm and serve.
recipes.text: Pattie'S Peanut Butter Pie. Whip cream cheese until soft and fluffy. Beat in peanut butter and sugar. Slowly add milk into mixture, blending thoroughly. Fold in Cool Whip. Pour into prepared graham cracker crust (optional: sprinkle with chopped nuts). Freeze until firm and serve.

recipes.title: Baked Apple Crisp
ingredients: 5 c. peeled, cored and sliced baking apples
directions: Place apples in a buttered 1 1/2-quart baking dish.
Add water.
Combine the flour, sugar, butter, cinnamon and salt together in your food processor or by rubbing with your fingers until fine crumbs are formed.
Spread the mixture over the apples. Bake at 375° for about 45 minutes uncovered.
Serve cold topped with ice cream.
recipes.text: Baked Apple Crisp. Place apples in a buttered 1 1/2-quart baking dish. Add water. Combine the flour, sugar, butter, cinnamon and salt together in your food processor or by rubbing with your fingers until fine crumbs are formed. Spread the mixture over the apples. Bake at 375° for about 45 minutes uncovered. Serve cold topped with ice cream.

recipes.title: Brownies
directions: Mix all ingredients together (except chocolate chips) until well blended.
Pour into greased 9 x 13-inch pan.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
Top with chocolate chips and let cool.
recipes.text: Brownies. Mix all ingredients together (except chocolate chips) until well blended. Pour into greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes. Top with chocolate chips and let cool.

recipes.title: Bean Dip
directions: Heat oven to 350°.
Put 1 tablespoon oil in frypan and heat. Add onion and garlic.
Cook about 1 minute.
Add hamburger and cook until done.
Remove excess grease.
Mix refried beans into meat, add enchilada and salsa sauces.
Put into casserole and place in oven.
Cook about 15 minutes.
Remove and stir in sour cream.
Cover top with grated cheese.
Put back into oven until cheese melts.
Serve warm with tortilla chips.
recipes.text: Bean Dip. Heat oven to 350°. Put 1 tablespoon oil in frypan and heat. Add onion and garlic. Cook about 1 minute. Add hamburger and cook until done. Remove excess grease. Mix refried beans into meat, add enchilada and salsa sauces. Put into casserole and place in oven. Cook about 15 minutes. Remove and stir in sour cream. Cover top with grated cheese. Put back into oven until cheese melts. Serve warm with tortilla chips.

recipes.title: Night Before Casserole
ingredients: 1/2 lb. American cheese, soft and cut up
directions: Combine ingredients; refrigerate overnight.
Bake for 1 1/4 hours at 350°.
recipes.text: Night Before Casserole. Combine ingredients; refrigerate overnight. Bake for 1 1/4 hours at 350°.

recipes.title: Bar-B-Q Sauce
directions: Pour water, vinegar, syrup and mustard into a large pan. Beat with a portable mixer until smooth. Add butter and bring to a boil, stirring constantly until butter melts.
Lower heat and simmer for 30 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Makes enough sauce for 5
- 3 1/2 to 4 lb. whole fryers split down the breast and cooked over a charcoal fire.
Makes 1 gal. sauce.
recipes.text: Bar-B-Q Sauce. Pour water, vinegar, syrup and mustard into a large pan. Beat with a portable mixer until smooth. Add butter and bring to a boil, stirring constantly until butter melts. Lower heat and simmer for 30 minutes, stirring occasionally. Makes enough sauce for 5 - 3 1/2 to 4 lb. whole fryers split down the breast and cooked over a charcoal fire. Makes 1 gal. sauce.

recipes.title: Chicken And Broccoli Casserole
ingredients: 1 chicken or 4 breasts, deboned and cut up into small pieces
directions: Cook chicken.
Debone and cut into small pieces.
Set aside. Cook broccoli.
Mix together mayonnaise, broth and soups.
Mix in chicken and broccoli.
Put in casserole dish.
On top, add cheese and crumble Ritz crackers.
Bake at 350° until brown for about 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Chicken And Broccoli Casserole. Cook chicken. Debone and cut into small pieces. Set aside. Cook broccoli. Mix together mayonnaise, broth and soups. Mix in chicken and broccoli. Put in casserole dish. On top, add cheese and crumble Ritz crackers. Bake at 350° until brown for about 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Mini Cheesecakes
ingredients: 15 oz. Smucker's low sugar apricot spread
directions: Combine graham cracker crumbs and margarine, stirring well. Line muffin pans with foil baking cups.
Spoon approximately 1 teaspoon crumb mixture into each liner.
Gently press into bottom. Beat cream cheese at high speed of mixer until light and fluffy. Gradually add sugar and mix well.
Add egg and vanilla; beat well. Spoon mixture into liners.
Bake at 350° for 10 minutes.
Spoon 1 tablespoon apricot spread on each cheesecake.
Chill thoroughly. Yields 2 dozen.
recipes.text: Mini Cheesecakes. Combine graham cracker crumbs and margarine, stirring well. Line muffin pans with foil baking cups. Spoon approximately 1 teaspoon crumb mixture into each liner. Gently press into bottom. Beat cream cheese at high speed of mixer until light and fluffy. Gradually add sugar and mix well. Add egg and vanilla; beat well. Spoon mixture into liners. Bake at 350° for 10 minutes. Spoon 1 tablespoon apricot spread on each cheesecake. Chill thoroughly. Yields 2 dozen.

recipes.title: Baked Cranberry Sauce
directions: Wash and drain cranberries.
In large bowl, combine sugar and cinnamon.
Add cranberries and mix well.
Spoon into a 9-inch square pan and cover with foil.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.
Add orange marmalade, lemon juice and walnuts to hot cranberry mixture, stirring well.
Store in refrigerator.
recipes.text: Baked Cranberry Sauce. Wash and drain cranberries. In large bowl, combine sugar and cinnamon. Add cranberries and mix well. Spoon into a 9-inch square pan and cover with foil. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes. Add orange marmalade, lemon juice and walnuts to hot cranberry mixture, stirring well. Store in refrigerator.

recipes.title: Bran Muffins
directions: Pour boiling water over bran.
Stir well and let cool.
Mix all ingredients.
This will keep in refrigerator 6-8 weeks.
Bake 20 min. at 400 degrees in greased muffin pan.
recipes.text: Bran Muffins. Pour boiling water over bran. Stir well and let cool. Mix all ingredients. This will keep in refrigerator 6-8 weeks. Bake 20 min. at 400 degrees in greased muffin pan.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Fudge
ingredients: 1 c. peanut butter (may use a little more)
directions: Cook first two ingredients to 230° or soft ball stage.
Remove from heat.
Beat in marshmallow cream, peanut butter and vanilla.
recipes.text: Peanut Butter Fudge. Cook first two ingredients to 230° or soft ball stage. Remove from heat. Beat in marshmallow cream, peanut butter and vanilla.

recipes.title: Mimi'S Southern Dump Cake
directions: Put all ingredients in bowl and mix by hand.
Bake in greased and floured tube pan at 350° for 1 hour and 20 minutes, longer if needed.
recipes.text: Mimi'S Southern Dump Cake. Put all ingredients in bowl and mix by hand. Bake in greased and floured tube pan at 350° for 1 hour and 20 minutes, longer if needed.

recipes.title: Chicago Omelet
directions: Place an 8-inch omelet pan over moderate heat.
Do not overheat or butter will smoke and burn.
Beat eggs, water, salt and pepper thoroughly with a fork.
Add remaining ingredients, except butter. When pan is hot, add butter and stir around quickly to coat bottom of pan.
Pour in egg mixture and shake pan with one hand, stirring mixture with the other.
An omelet should remain soft and creamy in the center.
To turn out of pan, hold handle.
If a filling is used, place a small amount in upper half of omelet.
Raise pan to a 45° angle and using a fork, start to roll omelet from the top down. Turn onto a warm plate and serve immediately.
Makes 1 serving.
recipes.text: Chicago Omelet. Place an 8-inch omelet pan over moderate heat. Do not overheat or butter will smoke and burn. Beat eggs, water, salt and pepper thoroughly with a fork. Add remaining ingredients, except butter. When pan is hot, add butter and stir around quickly to coat bottom of pan. Pour in egg mixture and shake pan with one hand, stirring mixture with the other. An omelet should remain soft and creamy in the center. To turn out of pan, hold handle. If a filling is used, place a small amount in upper half of omelet. Raise pan to a 45° angle and using a fork, start to roll omelet from the top down. Turn onto a warm plate and serve immediately. Makes 1 serving.

recipes.title: Strawberry Dessert
ingredients: 1 pkg. yellow or white cake mix
1 large and 1 small pkg. instant vanilla pudding mix
directions: Bake cake in a jelly roll pan at 350° for 20 minutes.
Mix the milk with the 2 pudding mixes.
Add all the other ingredients; blend well.
Cover the cooled cake with this mixture.
recipes.text: Strawberry Dessert. Bake cake in a jelly roll pan at 350° for 20 minutes. Mix the milk with the 2 pudding mixes. Add all the other ingredients; blend well. Cover the cooled cake with this mixture.

recipes.title: Artichoke Bake
ingredients: 2 small jars marinated artichoke hearts, finely chopped
directions: Use marinade from 1 jar of artichokes to saute onion.
Drain other jar.
Add other ingredients.
Pour into baking dish (7 x 11-inch).
Bake at 325° for 30 minutes.
Cut into 1-inch squares when cooled.
Freeze, if desired, and reheat at 325° for 10 to 12 minutes.
recipes.text: Artichoke Bake. Use marinade from 1 jar of artichokes to saute onion. Drain other jar. Add other ingredients. Pour into baking dish (7 x 11-inch). Bake at 325° for 30 minutes. Cut into 1-inch squares when cooled. Freeze, if desired, and reheat at 325° for 10 to 12 minutes.

recipes.title: Stuffed Bell Peppers(For Two)
directions: Parboil peppers until color changes.
While pepper cooks, brown ground beef with onion until done.
Add rice to meat and add ketchup plus a few drops of Tabasco and mix well.
Drain and stuff pepper.
Add dollop of ketchup to top of each.
Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.
recipes.text: Stuffed Bell Peppers(For Two). Parboil peppers until color changes. While pepper cooks, brown ground beef with onion until done. Add rice to meat and add ketchup plus a few drops of Tabasco and mix well. Drain and stuff pepper. Add dollop of ketchup to top of each. Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Magic Pumpkin Pie
directions: In large bowl, add ingredients and mix well.
Bake at 375° for 1 hour.
Cool in refrigerator for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Magic Pumpkin Pie. In large bowl, add ingredients and mix well. Bake at 375° for 1 hour. Cool in refrigerator for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Jalapeno Cornbread
ingredients: 2 c. (8 oz.) shredded sharp Cheddar cheese
directions: Stir all ingredients together in a large bowl. Pour batter into a lightly greased 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake at 350° for 1 hour or until top is golden brown. Makes 12 to 15 servings.
recipes.text: Jalapeno Cornbread. Stir all ingredients together in a large bowl. Pour batter into a lightly greased 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake at 350° for 1 hour or until top is golden brown. Makes 12 to 15 servings.

recipes.title: Cranberry Punch
directions: Add cranberry juice to sugar.
Stir until dissolved.
Add pineapple juice.
Chill.
Put in punch bowl.
Add ginger ale and serve.
recipes.text: Cranberry Punch. Add cranberry juice to sugar. Stir until dissolved. Add pineapple juice. Chill. Put in punch bowl. Add ginger ale and serve.

recipes.title: Cranberry Snap Punch
directions: Combine all ingredients in large container, stirring well. Chill and then serve over crushed ice (2 quarts).
recipes.text: Cranberry Snap Punch. Combine all ingredients in large container, stirring well. Chill and then serve over crushed ice (2 quarts).

recipes.title: Old Fashioned Onions-Apples
directions: Squeeze the lemon juice over the sliced apples; let set while preparing the onions.
Melt the butter.
Place onions in butter; sprinkle apples on top.
Sprinkle the sugar and salt and pepper to taste.
Use tight lid and steam until apples are soft.
Stir all together and fry until slightly brown.
Good with pork.
recipes.text: Old Fashioned Onions-Apples. Squeeze the lemon juice over the sliced apples; let set while preparing the onions. Melt the butter. Place onions in butter; sprinkle apples on top. Sprinkle the sugar and salt and pepper to taste. Use tight lid and steam until apples are soft. Stir all together and fry until slightly brown. Good with pork.

recipes.title: 10-Layer Salad
ingredients: 1 head cauliflower or stalk celery, chopped fine (over pepper)
1 pkg. Italian Good Seasons dressing (over mayonnaise)
1/2 c. bacon bits, sprinkled over Seasons mix
directions: Cover with foil and refrigerate several hours before serving. Will keep for 4 days.
Make this recipe in a 13 x 9-inch Pyrex dish or suitable container.
recipes.text: 10-Layer Salad. Cover with foil and refrigerate several hours before serving. Will keep for 4 days. Make this recipe in a 13 x 9-inch Pyrex dish or suitable container.

recipes.title: Pepper Steak
ingredients: 2 lb. round steak, cut into strips
directions: Brown steak in oil in skillet.
Place in slow cooker.
Add soy sauce, bouillon cube, garlic, onion, bell pepper and 1 cup water. Cook for 5 to 6 hours or until tender.
Stir in mixture of cornstarch and 1/4 cup water until thickened.
Serve over hot brown rice.
recipes.text: Pepper Steak. Brown steak in oil in skillet. Place in slow cooker. Add soy sauce, bouillon cube, garlic, onion, bell pepper and 1 cup water. Cook for 5 to 6 hours or until tender. Stir in mixture of cornstarch and 1/4 cup water until thickened. Serve over hot brown rice.

recipes.title: Corned Beef Patties
directions: Mix all ingredients except flour. Form into patties; roll lightly in flour and fry in hot oil or butter or margarine until browned. Serve on toast or a bed of grits.
(Bahamian Cookery Cookbook.) |Anonymous
recipes.text: Corned Beef Patties. Mix all ingredients except flour. Form into patties; roll lightly in flour and fry in hot oil or butter or margarine until browned. Serve on toast or a bed of grits. (Bahamian Cookery Cookbook.) |Anonymous

recipes.title: Chunky Artichoke Salsa
directions: Drain marinade from artichokes.
Chop artichokes with onion, olives and tomatoes.
Add garlic, basil, salt and pepper and stir. Chill and serve.
Makes 2 cups.
recipes.text: Chunky Artichoke Salsa. Drain marinade from artichokes. Chop artichokes with onion, olives and tomatoes. Add garlic, basil, salt and pepper and stir. Chill and serve. Makes 2 cups.

recipes.title: Coconut Cake
ingredients: 1 yellow sheet cake, split in half longway
directions: Mix sour cream, sugar and coconut.
(This is the filling you spread between layers.)
Reserve 1 cup of this mixture for icing. Spread filling between layers.
Mix the 1 cup filling with 1 1/2 cups Cool Whip and ice entire cake.
recipes.text: Coconut Cake. Mix sour cream, sugar and coconut. (This is the filling you spread between layers.) Reserve 1 cup of this mixture for icing. Spread filling between layers. Mix the 1 cup filling with 1 1/2 cups Cool Whip and ice entire cake.

recipes.title: Mai-Tai Fruit Salad
directions: Cut pineapple in half lengthwise and remove fruit.
Cut this into chunks and combine with other fruit.
Combine other ingredients for dressing and pour over fruit.
Toss gently and spoon back into the shells.
Makes 4 to 6 servings.
recipes.text: Mai-Tai Fruit Salad. Cut pineapple in half lengthwise and remove fruit. Cut this into chunks and combine with other fruit. Combine other ingredients for dressing and pour over fruit. Toss gently and spoon back into the shells. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

recipes.title: Light Bread(3 Loaves Or Rolls)
directions: Mix all 5 ingredients.
Stir 3 cups of flour to mixture.
Let bubble (or rise), then work 7 cups flour in mixture.
Work 10 minutes.
Let rise again and make out loaves or rolls.
Bake at 350°.
recipes.text: Light Bread(3 Loaves Or Rolls). Mix all 5 ingredients. Stir 3 cups of flour to mixture. Let bubble (or rise), then work 7 cups flour in mixture. Work 10 minutes. Let rise again and make out loaves or rolls. Bake at 350°.

recipes.title: Lasagna In A Bun
ingredients: 1 jar Prego spaghetti sauce with meat only
directions: Cook ground beef until brown; drain.
Add spaghetti sauce. Cook, covered, over low heat 5 minutes.
Uncover.
Cook 10 to 15 minutes longer, stirring frequently.
In a bowl, combine egg and cheeses.
recipes.text: Lasagna In A Bun. Cook ground beef until brown; drain. Add spaghetti sauce. Cook, covered, over low heat 5 minutes. Uncover. Cook 10 to 15 minutes longer, stirring frequently. In a bowl, combine egg and cheeses.

recipes.title: Banana Split Heaven
directions: In 9 x 13-inch pan, combine crushed vanilla wafers and melted butter.
Mix and press into bottom of pan.
Top with vanilla pudding and slices bananas evenly over pudding.
Cover with Cool Whip.
Drizzle hot fudge over top.
Sprinkle with chopped nuts. Refrigerate.
recipes.text: Banana Split Heaven. In 9 x 13-inch pan, combine crushed vanilla wafers and melted butter. Mix and press into bottom of pan. Top with vanilla pudding and slices bananas evenly over pudding. Cover with Cool Whip. Drizzle hot fudge over top. Sprinkle with chopped nuts. Refrigerate.

recipes.title: Split Pea Soup
ingredients: 2 medium stalks celery, cut into 1/2-inch pieces
directions: Heat water and peas to boiling in a heavy saucepan.
Boil 2 minutes and remove from heat.
Cover and let stand for 1 hour. Stir in ham, onion, salt and pepper into peas.
Heat to boiling. Reduce heat, cover and simmer until peas are tender, about 1 hour. Skim fat, if necessary.
Remove ham, trim fat and bone from ham. Cut ham into 1/2-inch pieces.
Stir ham, carrots and celery into soup.
Heat to boiling, reduce heat.
Cover and simmer until vegetables are tender, about 45 minutes.
Serves 8.
recipes.text: Split Pea Soup. Heat water and peas to boiling in a heavy saucepan. Boil 2 minutes and remove from heat. Cover and let stand for 1 hour. Stir in ham, onion, salt and pepper into peas. Heat to boiling. Reduce heat, cover and simmer until peas are tender, about 1 hour. Skim fat, if necessary. Remove ham, trim fat and bone from ham. Cut ham into 1/2-inch pieces. Stir ham, carrots and celery into soup. Heat to boiling, reduce heat. Cover and simmer until vegetables are tender, about 45 minutes. Serves 8.

recipes.title: Baked Potato Soup
directions: Bake potatoes at 400° for 1 hour.
Cool slightly, cut potatoes in half and scoop out pulp.
Melt butter in a heavy saucepan over low heat.
Add flour stirring constantly until smooth.
Cook 1 minute.
Gradually add 6 cups of milk.
Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly until mixture is thickened and bubbly.
Add potato pulp and other ingredients except sour cream.
Cook until thoroughly heated.
Stir in sour cream.
Serve hot.
recipes.text: Baked Potato Soup. Bake potatoes at 400° for 1 hour. Cool slightly, cut potatoes in half and scoop out pulp. Melt butter in a heavy saucepan over low heat. Add flour stirring constantly until smooth. Cook 1 minute. Gradually add 6 cups of milk. Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly until mixture is thickened and bubbly. Add potato pulp and other ingredients except sour cream. Cook until thoroughly heated. Stir in sour cream. Serve hot.

recipes.title: Glazed Carrots(Microwave Dish)
directions: In 2-quart casserole, cook carrots in water on "High" for 9 to 10 minutes, stirring twice; drain.
Cover and set aside.
Melt butter on "High" for 30 seconds.
Stir in brown sugar, salt and mustard.
Pour over drained carrots; cover.
Heat on High for 2 minutes.
Serves 4.
recipes.text: Glazed Carrots(Microwave Dish). In 2-quart casserole, cook carrots in water on "High" for 9 to 10 minutes, stirring twice; drain. Cover and set aside. Melt butter on "High" for 30 seconds. Stir in brown sugar, salt and mustard. Pour over drained carrots; cover. Heat on High for 2 minutes. Serves 4.

recipes.title: Hush Puppies
directions: Dissolve yeast in warm water.
Mix meal and flour in bowl. Add buttermilk and mix thoroughly.
Add beaten egg, onion and yeast mixture.
Mix good and drop by teaspoon into hot fat.
Cook until golden brown.
Serve hot with fish and French fries.
recipes.text: Hush Puppies. Dissolve yeast in warm water. Mix meal and flour in bowl. Add buttermilk and mix thoroughly. Add beaten egg, onion and yeast mixture. Mix good and drop by teaspoon into hot fat. Cook until golden brown. Serve hot with fish and French fries.

recipes.title: Squash Medley
ingredients: 1 c. fresh tomatoes, diced and drained
directions: Cook squash just until tender and drain.
Saute onions in 1 stick of butter.
Take onions out of pan with a slotted spoon and save butter.
Using the butter from the onions, lightly brown the bread crumbs.
Combine squash, onions, tomatoes and cheese in a casserole dish.
Mix gently together.
Top with browned bread crumbs.
Bake at 350° for 1/2 hour, or until cheese is bubbly. Serves 6 to 8.
recipes.text: Squash Medley. Cook squash just until tender and drain. Saute onions in 1 stick of butter. Take onions out of pan with a slotted spoon and save butter. Using the butter from the onions, lightly brown the bread crumbs. Combine squash, onions, tomatoes and cheese in a casserole dish. Mix gently together. Top with browned bread crumbs. Bake at 350° for 1/2 hour, or until cheese is bubbly. Serves 6 to 8.

recipes.title: Fresh Raspberry, Strawberry Or Peach Pie
directions: Bake and cool pie crust.
Boil sugar and 1 1/4 cups water until the sugar is dissolved.
Mix cornstarch with 3 tablespoons water and add to sugar mixture.
Cook until thick.
I add a little crushed fruit to give it color.
Cool mixture a little, then carefully stir in fruit.
Pour into pie shell and refrigerate until ready to serve.
Superb!
recipes.text: Fresh Raspberry, Strawberry Or Peach Pie. Bake and cool pie crust. Boil sugar and 1 1/4 cups water until the sugar is dissolved. Mix cornstarch with 3 tablespoons water and add to sugar mixture. Cook until thick. I add a little crushed fruit to give it color. Cool mixture a little, then carefully stir in fruit. Pour into pie shell and refrigerate until ready to serve. Superb!

recipes.title: Red Cabbage With Raisins
directions: Combine all ingredients in large heavy skillet and cover. Simmer until cabbage is tender and most of the liquid has evaporated.
recipes.text: Red Cabbage With Raisins. Combine all ingredients in large heavy skillet and cover. Simmer until cabbage is tender and most of the liquid has evaporated.

recipes.title: Taco Casserole
ingredients: 1 lb. ground beef with onion, browned and drained
directions: Simmer for 10 minutes.
Put chips in casserole dish; crumble coarsely.
Pour mixture on top.
Sprinkle sharp Cheddar cheese over top.
Put in oven at 350° for 20 to 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Taco Casserole. Simmer for 10 minutes. Put chips in casserole dish; crumble coarsely. Pour mixture on top. Sprinkle sharp Cheddar cheese over top. Put in oven at 350° for 20 to 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Cheese Ball 'N Crackers
directions: Mix the first 4 ingredients together and make a large ball. Put nuts on waxed paper and roll ball in nuts until completely covered.
Refrigerate for at least 1 day ahead.
Serve with crackers.
recipes.text: Cheese Ball 'N Crackers. Mix the first 4 ingredients together and make a large ball. Put nuts on waxed paper and roll ball in nuts until completely covered. Refrigerate for at least 1 day ahead. Serve with crackers.

recipes.title: Crock-Pot Beans
directions: All cans of beans should be 16 ounce size.
recipes.text: Crock-Pot Beans. All cans of beans should be 16 ounce size.

recipes.title: Low-Fat Bread
directions: Preheat oven to 350°.
Combine all ingredients and divide into two loaf pans.
Bake for 40 minutes.
recipes.text: Low-Fat Bread. Preheat oven to 350°. Combine all ingredients and divide into two loaf pans. Bake for 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Fried Vegetable Plate
directions: Add beaten egg to vegetables.
Mix in flour to coat vegetables.
Place vegetables and flour in strainer and shake out extra flour.
Flour should only coat vegetables.
Fry on medium heat until the vegetables are tender.
Add salt and pepper to taste.
recipes.text: Fried Vegetable Plate. Add beaten egg to vegetables. Mix in flour to coat vegetables. Place vegetables and flour in strainer and shake out extra flour. Flour should only coat vegetables. Fry on medium heat until the vegetables are tender. Add salt and pepper to taste.

recipes.title: Lowell Inn Crescent Rolls
directions: In a bowl, dissolve yeast in water (plus 1 teaspoon sugar). Mix ingredients.
Add rest of flour until smooth.
Cover.
Let rise in a warm place until double, 1 1/2 hours.
Divide.
Shape. Let rise until double, 1 hour.
Brush with butter.
Bake in oven at 400° for 12 to 15 minutes, until rich golden brown.
Makes 32 rolls.
recipes.text: Lowell Inn Crescent Rolls. In a bowl, dissolve yeast in water (plus 1 teaspoon sugar). Mix ingredients. Add rest of flour until smooth. Cover. Let rise in a warm place until double, 1 1/2 hours. Divide. Shape. Let rise until double, 1 hour. Brush with butter. Bake in oven at 400° for 12 to 15 minutes, until rich golden brown. Makes 32 rolls.

recipes.title: "Hearty Soup"
ingredients: 1/2 lb. chourico, a ham bone or pepperoni
directions: Saute garlic with chourico in enough olive oil to cover bottom of
pan.
Quart
pan is good.
Add broth, 1 can water, celery, carrots, beans, bay leaves and tomato sauce.
Cook for 20 minutes. Add
cut
up escarole, salt, pepper and a few dry red pepper flakes.
Add cooked rice or orso.
recipes.text: "Hearty Soup". Saute garlic with chourico in enough olive oil to cover bottom of pan. Quart pan is good. Add broth, 1 can water, celery, carrots, beans, bay leaves and tomato sauce. Cook for 20 minutes. Add cut up escarole, salt, pepper and a few dry red pepper flakes. Add cooked rice or orso.

recipes.title: Chocolate Glaze
directions: Melt chocolate and butter over low heat, stirring constantly. Remove from heat.
Stir in sugar and vanilla until crumbly.
Blend in 3 tablespoons boiling water.
Add enough water (about 2 teaspoons), a teaspoon at a time, to form medium glaze of pouring consistency.
Pour quickly over top of cake.
Spread glaze evenly over top and sides.
recipes.text: Chocolate Glaze. Melt chocolate and butter over low heat, stirring constantly. Remove from heat. Stir in sugar and vanilla until crumbly. Blend in 3 tablespoons boiling water. Add enough water (about 2 teaspoons), a teaspoon at a time, to form medium glaze of pouring consistency. Pour quickly over top of cake. Spread glaze evenly over top and sides.

recipes.title: Lemon Squares
ingredients: 1 box Betty Crocker angel food cake mix
directions: Mix cake mix and pie filling.
Spread in oblong pan and bake 15 minutes at 350°.
Sprinkle with powdered sugar and cool.
Cut into squares.
recipes.text: Lemon Squares. Mix cake mix and pie filling. Spread in oblong pan and bake 15 minutes at 350°. Sprinkle with powdered sugar and cool. Cut into squares.

recipes.title: Swedish Drommar (Dreams)
ingredients: 1 tsp. pulverized baking ammonia or 1/2 tsp. cream of tartar and 1/2 tsp. baking soda
directions: Beat the butter for 30 seconds.
Add sugar and beat until fluffy.
Combine flour and baking ammonia or cream of tartar and soda.
Add the dry ingredients to the butter mixture and beat until well combined.
Shape the dough into 3/4-inch balls.
Place the balls on ungreased cookie sheets.
Using your fingers, press lightly in centers of the cookies.
Bake in a 375° oven for 7 to 9 minutes or until done.
Open oven door carefully to avoid fumes if you use baking ammonia.
Makes 80 to 90 cookies.
recipes.text: Swedish Drommar (Dreams). Beat the butter for 30 seconds. Add sugar and beat until fluffy. Combine flour and baking ammonia or cream of tartar and soda. Add the dry ingredients to the butter mixture and beat until well combined. Shape the dough into 3/4-inch balls. Place the balls on ungreased cookie sheets. Using your fingers, press lightly in centers of the cookies. Bake in a 375° oven for 7 to 9 minutes or until done. Open oven door carefully to avoid fumes if you use baking ammonia. Makes 80 to 90 cookies.

recipes.title: Blueberry Streusel Muffins
ingredients: 2 c. fresh or frozen unsweetened blueberries (do not defrost)
directions: Combine flour with sugar and baking powder in large bowl.
Cut in butter until it is in tiny pieces.
Remove 3/4 cup of mixture to a small bowl.
Stir in cinnamon; reserve.
Combine milk with eggs and vanilla; add to flour mixture in large bowl.
Stir just until moistened.
Gently stir in blueberries.
Spoon batter into butter or paper-lined muffin cups.
Sprinkle each with the reserved cinnamon/crumb mixture.
Bake 30 to 35 minutes in a preheated 350° oven.
Wrap each muffin individually in plastic wrap, then put all muffins together in foil to freeze.
They make a great "driving to work" breakfast.
recipes.text: Blueberry Streusel Muffins. Combine flour with sugar and baking powder in large bowl. Cut in butter until it is in tiny pieces. Remove 3/4 cup of mixture to a small bowl. Stir in cinnamon; reserve. Combine milk with eggs and vanilla; add to flour mixture in large bowl. Stir just until moistened. Gently stir in blueberries. Spoon batter into butter or paper-lined muffin cups. Sprinkle each with the reserved cinnamon/crumb mixture. Bake 30 to 35 minutes in a preheated 350° oven. Wrap each muffin individually in plastic wrap, then put all muffins together in foil to freeze. They make a great "driving to work" breakfast.

recipes.title: Strawberry Pie
directions: In a pan, combine sugar, Jell-O and cornstarch.
Add water and food coloring, then cook over low heat until thick.
Let cool. Line prebaked pie crust with strawberries and cover with glaze, then repeat.
Refrigerate 4 to 6 hours before serving.
recipes.text: Strawberry Pie. In a pan, combine sugar, Jell-O and cornstarch. Add water and food coloring, then cook over low heat until thick. Let cool. Line prebaked pie crust with strawberries and cover with glaze, then repeat. Refrigerate 4 to 6 hours before serving.

recipes.title: Oatmeal Cake
directions: Pour hot water over oats and let stand.
Cream white and brown sugars and oil.
Beat eggs into creamed mixture.
Add flour, cinnamon and salt into oats; beat well.
Bake at 350° for 35 minutes.
Don't use mixer.
Sprinkle coconut on top of cake before baking.
recipes.text: Oatmeal Cake. Pour hot water over oats and let stand. Cream white and brown sugars and oil. Beat eggs into creamed mixture. Add flour, cinnamon and salt into oats; beat well. Bake at 350° for 35 minutes. Don't use mixer. Sprinkle coconut on top of cake before baking.

recipes.title: Mom'S Pear Relish
ingredients: 1 tsp. each: cinnamon, cloves and allspice
directions: Grind pears, onions and peppers; mix together with cinnamon, cloves, allspice, vinegar, water, salt and sugar.
Bring to boil and simmer until tender.
Put in sterilized jars; seal while hot.
recipes.text: Mom'S Pear Relish. Grind pears, onions and peppers; mix together with cinnamon, cloves, allspice, vinegar, water, salt and sugar. Bring to boil and simmer until tender. Put in sterilized jars; seal while hot.

recipes.title: Frozen Yogurt Pie
directions: Fold
yogurt into topping well.
Add fruit.
Spoon into crust. Freeze until firm (4 hours).
Remove 30 minutes before serving (for softer texture).
Garnish with fruit and serve.
recipes.text: Frozen Yogurt Pie. Fold yogurt into topping well. Add fruit. Spoon into crust. Freeze until firm (4 hours). Remove 30 minutes before serving (for softer texture). Garnish with fruit and serve.

recipes.title: Breakfast Special
directions: Layer in a 9 x 13-inch greased pan the bread, sausage, cheese and eggs.
Refrigerate overnight.
In the morning before baking, combine cream of mushroom soup and 1/2 cup milk.
Pour over the top.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes until brown on top.
recipes.text: Breakfast Special. Layer in a 9 x 13-inch greased pan the bread, sausage, cheese and eggs. Refrigerate overnight. In the morning before baking, combine cream of mushroom soup and 1/2 cup milk. Pour over the top. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes until brown on top.

recipes.title: Potato Chowder
ingredients: 1 (10 1/2 to 11 oz.) can condensed chicken soup
directions: Cook potatoes, onion and garlic in hot oil until potatoes are transparent (not tender), stirring occasionally. Add chicken soup, tomatoes and seasonings. Cover. Simmer until potatoes are tender, about 25 minutes. Add cream. Heat and serve at once. Serves 4.
recipes.text: Potato Chowder. Cook potatoes, onion and garlic in hot oil until potatoes are transparent (not tender), stirring occasionally. Add chicken soup, tomatoes and seasonings. Cover. Simmer until potatoes are tender, about 25 minutes. Add cream. Heat and serve at once. Serves 4.

recipes.title: Fudge Brownie Pie
directions: In
saucepan
over
low heat melt chips with margarine. In mixer bowl beat chocolate in mixture with remaining ingredients, except
nuts, until smooth.
Add nuts.
Pour into pie shell.
Bake 35
to
minutes at 325° until center is set. Refrigerate leftovers.
recipes.text: Fudge Brownie Pie. In saucepan over low heat melt chips with margarine. In mixer bowl beat chocolate in mixture with remaining ingredients, except nuts, until smooth. Add nuts. Pour into pie shell. Bake 35 to 40 minutes at 325° until center is set. Refrigerate leftovers.

recipes.title: Hawaiian Cake
ingredients: 1 (15 oz.) can crushed pineapple, drained (save juice to use in cake mix)
directions: Mix cake mix as directed.
Use reserved juice.
Grease large cake pan, 9 x 13-inch, that has edges.
Pour cake batter into prepared pan.
Bake 15 to 20 minutes until done.
Let cool.
Mix pudding mix with 1 cup milk.
Beat cream cheese into pudding mix. Fold by hand the Cool Whip into the mixture. Spread mixture onto cool cake. Sprinkle pineapple on top of pudding, then chopped cherries, nuts and coconut.
Refrigerate until ready to use.
recipes.text: Hawaiian Cake. Mix cake mix as directed. Use reserved juice. Grease large cake pan, 9 x 13-inch, that has edges. Pour cake batter into prepared pan. Bake 15 to 20 minutes until done. Let cool. Mix pudding mix with 1 cup milk. Beat cream cheese into pudding mix. Fold by hand the Cool Whip into the mixture. Spread mixture onto cool cake. Sprinkle pineapple on top of pudding, then chopped cherries, nuts and coconut. Refrigerate until ready to use.

recipes.title: Mixed Pickle
ingredients: 1 pt. sweet peppers (red, green and yellow)
directions: Simmer water, vinegar, sugar, salt, mustard seed and turmeric 5 minutes.
recipes.text: Mixed Pickle. Simmer water, vinegar, sugar, salt, mustard seed and turmeric 5 minutes.

recipes.title: Banana Nut Bread
directions: Cream butter and sugar together.
Add egg and blend with milk; add lemon, bananas, flour and nuts.
Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes in a loaf pan.
Cool completely before slicing.
recipes.text: Banana Nut Bread. Cream butter and sugar together. Add egg and blend with milk; add lemon, bananas, flour and nuts. Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes in a loaf pan. Cool completely before slicing.

recipes.title: Veggie Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 pkg. Hidden Valley Ranch dressing mix
directions: Unroll crescent rolls and press on a cookie sheet.
Bake at 350° for 8 to 12 minutes.
Gently press, if puffy.
Cool completely.
recipes.text: Veggie Sandwiches. Unroll crescent rolls and press on a cookie sheet. Bake at 350° for 8 to 12 minutes. Gently press, if puffy. Cool completely.

recipes.title: Millionaire Pies
directions: Mix all
ingredients well and pour into 2 graham crusts. Refrigerate to set.
May top with additional Cool Whip.
recipes.text: Millionaire Pies. Mix all ingredients well and pour into 2 graham crusts. Refrigerate to set. May top with additional Cool Whip.

recipes.title: Lasagna(Low Cholesterol)
ingredients: 1 lb. Healthy Choice ground beef (4% fat)
1 (15 to 16 oz.) container low-fat cottage cheese
1 1/2 c. grated Parmesan or Romano cheese (or 1/2 c. each)
directions: Brown beef in electric frypan with chopped onion.
Add tomato juice, tomato paste, Worcestershire sauce and spices.
Simmer 30 minutes, stirring occasionally. In a 9 x 13-inch baking pan, layer 1/2 noodles, 1/2 sauce, 1/2 cottage cheese and 1/2 Parmesan cheese.
Repeat all layers and sprinkle with parsley flakes. Cover with foil and let set at least 1/2 hour, longer if desired. Bake covered for 30 minutes at 350°.
Remove foil and bake an additional 15 to 25 minutes until top is brown.
Let stand 20 minutes before cutting into 8 servings.
recipes.text: Lasagna(Low Cholesterol). Brown beef in electric frypan with chopped onion. Add tomato juice, tomato paste, Worcestershire sauce and spices. Simmer 30 minutes, stirring occasionally. In a 9 x 13-inch baking pan, layer 1/2 noodles, 1/2 sauce, 1/2 cottage cheese and 1/2 Parmesan cheese. Repeat all layers and sprinkle with parsley flakes. Cover with foil and let set at least 1/2 hour, longer if desired. Bake covered for 30 minutes at 350°. Remove foil and bake an additional 15 to 25 minutes until top is brown. Let stand 20 minutes before cutting into 8 servings.

recipes.title: Chicken And Dressing
ingredients: 1 hen, deboned and torn into pieces
directions: Boil hen for 1 hour or longer.
Salt it as you're boiling it. Keep the good, rich broth.
Mix all the remaining ingredients together, adding the broth slowly until it is a little mushy.
Salt and pepper to your taste.
Cook the pan of dressing for 30 minutes or more at 450°.
Put the chicken on top the last 10 minutes. Cooking time can depend on how mushy you make the dressing from the broth.
You don't want it to get too dry.
recipes.text: Chicken And Dressing. Boil hen for 1 hour or longer. Salt it as you're boiling it. Keep the good, rich broth. Mix all the remaining ingredients together, adding the broth slowly until it is a little mushy. Salt and pepper to your taste. Cook the pan of dressing for 30 minutes or more at 450°. Put the chicken on top the last 10 minutes. Cooking time can depend on how mushy you make the dressing from the broth. You don't want it to get too dry.

recipes.title: Artichoke Hors D'Oeuvres
ingredients: 2 jars artichoke hearts, drained and chopped
directions: Cook onion in water; drain.
Mix remaining ingredients. Spread in greased 7 1/2 x 7 1/2 x 1 1/2-inch pan.
Bake at 350° for 18 minutes.
Cut in 1-inch squares.
recipes.text: Artichoke Hors D'Oeuvres. Cook onion in water; drain. Mix remaining ingredients. Spread in greased 7 1/2 x 7 1/2 x 1 1/2-inch pan. Bake at 350° for 18 minutes. Cut in 1-inch squares.

recipes.title: Crabmeat Dip
ingredients: 1 can crab meat, drained and flaked
directions: Mix all ingredients together and chill.
Good with chips or fresh vegetable pieces.
recipes.text: Crabmeat Dip. Mix all ingredients together and chill. Good with chips or fresh vegetable pieces.

recipes.title: Grandma'S Ginger Cookies
ingredients: 1 1/2 tsp. baking soda, mixed with 3 Tbsp. boiling water
3 c. flour (to start, add more later)
directions: Mix all ingredients together. Chill dough as it will roll easier. May need to add flour as you roll out dough.
Cut with cookie cutter.
Bake at 365° for 6 to 7 minutes.
These are chewy.
recipes.text: Grandma'S Ginger Cookies. Mix all ingredients together. Chill dough as it will roll easier. May need to add flour as you roll out dough. Cut with cookie cutter. Bake at 365° for 6 to 7 minutes. These are chewy.

recipes.title: Broccoli Casserole
directions: Stir all together and put in greased dish.
Bake at 325° for 25 minutes.
recipes.text: Broccoli Casserole. Stir all together and put in greased dish. Bake at 325° for 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Smoothie
directions: Melt white chocolate and butterscotch in top of double boiler. Stir in peanut butter.
Put in little papers and cool.
recipes.text: Smoothie. Melt white chocolate and butterscotch in top of double boiler. Stir in peanut butter. Put in little papers and cool.

recipes.title: Oyster Cracker Tidbits
ingredients: 1 (10 or 12 oz.) pkg. oyster crackers (small; I prefer 12 oz. Bremner crackers from Kroger)
1 (1.0 oz.) envelope original Ranch salad dressing mix (dry)
directions: Mix dry ingredients together.
Stir in crackers.
Pour oil over cracker mix and stir from bottom, mixing well.
Pour crackers into baking pan and heat in 225° oven for 5 minutes; stir and heat for another 5 minutes.
Store in airtight containers and will keep several weeks.
recipes.text: Oyster Cracker Tidbits. Mix dry ingredients together. Stir in crackers. Pour oil over cracker mix and stir from bottom, mixing well. Pour crackers into baking pan and heat in 225° oven for 5 minutes; stir and heat for another 5 minutes. Store in airtight containers and will keep several weeks.

recipes.title: Impossible Quiche
ingredients: 12 slices bacon (1/2 lb. fried and crumbled)
1 c. (4 oz.) natural Swiss cheese, shredded
directions: Grease pie plate, sprinkle bacon, cheese and onion over bottom.
Place remainder in blender, blend 1 minute.
Pour into plate.
Bake at 350° in oven for 30 minutes.
Let stand 5 minutes before cutting.
recipes.text: Impossible Quiche. Grease pie plate, sprinkle bacon, cheese and onion over bottom. Place remainder in blender, blend 1 minute. Pour into plate. Bake at 350° in oven for 30 minutes. Let stand 5 minutes before cutting.

recipes.title: Shrimp Stew
directions: Saute onions, garlic and bell pepper in butter in large pot. Add tomato sauce, 2 cans water, shrimp and Creole seasoning. Simmer 1 hour.
Thicken with cornstarch and serve over rice.
recipes.text: Shrimp Stew. Saute onions, garlic and bell pepper in butter in large pot. Add tomato sauce, 2 cans water, shrimp and Creole seasoning. Simmer 1 hour. Thicken with cornstarch and serve over rice.

recipes.title: Bombay Curry
directions: Brown onion and celery in hot fat.
Add meat, seasonings and gravy.
You may stretch gravy with canned gravy or bouillon.
Cover and simmer for 1 hour.
Serve in ring of cooked rice.
recipes.text: Bombay Curry. Brown onion and celery in hot fat. Add meat, seasonings and gravy. You may stretch gravy with canned gravy or bouillon. Cover and simmer for 1 hour. Serve in ring of cooked rice.

recipes.title: Stuffed Green Peppers
directions: Place tomato juice, rice and onion over low heat until juice is absorbed.
Mix with other ingredients and fill peppers.
Place in pan with lid.
Cover and bake in oven at 300° for 30 minutes. No need to precook peppers if you like them firm.
Peppers are usually large so I cut them across like you would an orange and fill the 2 sides.
Very good.
recipes.text: Stuffed Green Peppers. Place tomato juice, rice and onion over low heat until juice is absorbed. Mix with other ingredients and fill peppers. Place in pan with lid. Cover and bake in oven at 300° for 30 minutes. No need to precook peppers if you like them firm. Peppers are usually large so I cut them across like you would an orange and fill the 2 sides. Very good.

recipes.title: Cocoa
directions: Mix cocoa and sugar.
Pour into 1/3 cup of hot water in medium saucepan.
Bring to a boil and stir constantly.
Boil and stir for 2 minutes.
Add milk.
Stir and heat (do not boil).
Remove from heat.
Add vanilla and mix well.
Serve hot with marshmallows, if desired.
Refrigerate until cold.
Shake well before serving. Tastes like "Dutch" chocolate milk.
Use 1/2 teaspoon mint extract instead of vanilla for mint cocoa.
recipes.text: Cocoa. Mix cocoa and sugar. Pour into 1/3 cup of hot water in medium saucepan. Bring to a boil and stir constantly. Boil and stir for 2 minutes. Add milk. Stir and heat (do not boil). Remove from heat. Add vanilla and mix well. Serve hot with marshmallows, if desired. Refrigerate until cold. Shake well before serving. Tastes like "Dutch" chocolate milk. Use 1/2 teaspoon mint extract instead of vanilla for mint cocoa.

recipes.title: Chocolate Silk Pie
directions: Whip the butter
and sugar until light.
Add the chocolate and vanilla.
Beat until blended. Add 1 egg and beat 5 minutes. Add the other egg and beat 5 more minutes. Fill baked pie shell. Chill.
recipes.text: Chocolate Silk Pie. Whip the butter and sugar until light. Add the chocolate and vanilla. Beat until blended. Add 1 egg and beat 5 minutes. Add the other egg and beat 5 more minutes. Fill baked pie shell. Chill.

recipes.title: Linzer Augen Cookies
directions: Mix ingredients together in bowl; chill for 1 hour.
Remove; shape into large or small marble-size balls in the palm of your hands.
Place on lightly greased baking sheet, about 2 inches apart.
Make a depression in each with your index finger, fill with a bit of thick jam (apricot, plum or raspberry).
Bake in hot oven at 400° for about 8 minutes or until delicately browned. Remove from sheet while still warm.
Cool (on racks for best results), then sprinkle with powdered sugar.
Store in airtight containers; keep in cool place.
Flavor, like people improves with aging!
recipes.text: Linzer Augen Cookies. Mix ingredients together in bowl; chill for 1 hour. Remove; shape into large or small marble-size balls in the palm of your hands. Place on lightly greased baking sheet, about 2 inches apart. Make a depression in each with your index finger, fill with a bit of thick jam (apricot, plum or raspberry). Bake in hot oven at 400° for about 8 minutes or until delicately browned. Remove from sheet while still warm. Cool (on racks for best results), then sprinkle with powdered sugar. Store in airtight containers; keep in cool place. Flavor, like people improves with aging!

recipes.title: Dream Cake
ingredients: 1 pkg. lemon or yellow cake mix
directions: Combine cake mix (use whatever flavor cake mix), Dream Whip, eggs and water in large bowl.
Blend until moistened.
Beat 4 minutes at medium speed.
Pour batter into greased and floured pans.
Bake at 350° as directed on cake mix box for size of pans.
recipes.text: Dream Cake. Combine cake mix (use whatever flavor cake mix), Dream Whip, eggs and water in large bowl. Blend until moistened. Beat 4 minutes at medium speed. Pour batter into greased and floured pans. Bake at 350° as directed on cake mix box for size of pans.

recipes.title: Bill'S Buttermilk Coconut Pie
directions: Pour coconut into frozen pie shell.
Melt butter and pour over coconut.
Mix eggs, sugar, flour, buttermilk and vanilla; beat well.
Pour over coconut in pie shell.
Bake until brown.
recipes.text: Bill'S Buttermilk Coconut Pie. Pour coconut into frozen pie shell. Melt butter and pour over coconut. Mix eggs, sugar, flour, buttermilk and vanilla; beat well. Pour over coconut in pie shell. Bake until brown.

recipes.title: Spaghetti Fruit Salad
ingredients: 1 (8 oz.) carton frozen whipped topping, thawed
directions: In a saucepan, combine sugar, eggs, lemon juice and salt. Cook and stir over medium heat until temperature reaches 160° and mixture is thickened, about 4 minutes. Cool completely. Cook spaghetti according to package directions. Drain and rinse in cold water. Place in a large bowl. Drain pineapple, reserving juice. Pour juice over the spaghetti. Stir in the apples. Toss gently. Drain. Stir in the egg mixture and pineapple. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Fold in whipped topping before serving. Garnish with walnuts and cherries. Makes 12 to 14 servings.
recipes.text: Spaghetti Fruit Salad. In a saucepan, combine sugar, eggs, lemon juice and salt. Cook and stir over medium heat until temperature reaches 160° and mixture is thickened, about 4 minutes. Cool completely. Cook spaghetti according to package directions. Drain and rinse in cold water. Place in a large bowl. Drain pineapple, reserving juice. Pour juice over the spaghetti. Stir in the apples. Toss gently. Drain. Stir in the egg mixture and pineapple. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Fold in whipped topping before serving. Garnish with walnuts and cherries. Makes 12 to 14 servings.

recipes.title: Berry-Mandarin Tossed Salad
ingredients: 1 medium sweet onion, sliced into rings
4 bacon strips, cooked, drained and crumbled
directions: Combine first 9 ingredients. Microwave, uncovered, on High 1 1/2 to 2 minutes. Stir until sugar dissolves. Whisk in vegetable oil. Cover and refrigerate until serving.
recipes.text: Berry-Mandarin Tossed Salad. Combine first 9 ingredients. Microwave, uncovered, on High 1 1/2 to 2 minutes. Stir until sugar dissolves. Whisk in vegetable oil. Cover and refrigerate until serving.

recipes.title: Kallaloo
ingredients: 1 1/2 lb. salt meat, ham bone, pigs tail
directions: Boil salt meat until tender in 3 quarts of water.
Boil fish; remove bones and add to stock.
Add crabs or conch.
Put spinach, okra (from which stems and tips have been removed), onion and garlic through grinder.
Add to stock and boil rapidly about 30 minutes.
The addition of vinegar prevents the appearance of slime.
Do not skim while boiling.
Serve hot with fungi.
recipes.text: Kallaloo. Boil salt meat until tender in 3 quarts of water. Boil fish; remove bones and add to stock. Add crabs or conch. Put spinach, okra (from which stems and tips have been removed), onion and garlic through grinder. Add to stock and boil rapidly about 30 minutes. The addition of vinegar prevents the appearance of slime. Do not skim while boiling. Serve hot with fungi.

recipes.title: Mom'S White Cookies
directions: Mix ingredients together, adding flour gradually, enough to make a soft dough. Roll and cut with cookie cutters.
Sprinkle with sugar and place a raisin in the center. Bake at 375° for 8 to 10 minutes. These cookies remain soft.
Makes 36.
recipes.text: Mom'S White Cookies. Mix ingredients together, adding flour gradually, enough to make a soft dough. Roll and cut with cookie cutters. Sprinkle with sugar and place a raisin in the center. Bake at 375° for 8 to 10 minutes. These cookies remain soft. Makes 36.

recipes.title: Sweet Sour Pickle Solution
directions: Heat and pour hot over dill pickles. Add spices and green coloring.
recipes.text: Sweet Sour Pickle Solution. Heat and pour hot over dill pickles. Add spices and green coloring.

recipes.title: Lazy Man'S Cobbler
directions: Preheat oven to 350°.
Melt butter in dish.
Mix sugar, flour and milk in bowl (separately).
Then pour batter over butter; do not stir.
Spoon peach pie filling over batter.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour or until brown.
recipes.text: Lazy Man'S Cobbler. Preheat oven to 350°. Melt butter in dish. Mix sugar, flour and milk in bowl (separately). Then pour batter over butter; do not stir. Spoon peach pie filling over batter. Bake at 350° for 1 hour or until brown.

recipes.title: Three-Vegetable Gratin
ingredients: 1 1/2 lb. butternut squash, pared and seeded
directions: Boil a large pot of salted water.
Slice vegetables to 1/8-inch thick, keeping separate.
Boil potatoes 5 minutes. Remove with slotted spoon to colander to cool.
Repeat with parsnips, boiling 6 minutes.
Repeat with squash, boiling 2 minutes.
recipes.text: Three-Vegetable Gratin. Boil a large pot of salted water. Slice vegetables to 1/8-inch thick, keeping separate. Boil potatoes 5 minutes. Remove with slotted spoon to colander to cool. Repeat with parsnips, boiling 6 minutes. Repeat with squash, boiling 2 minutes.

recipes.title: Eggplant Fritters
directions: Peel eggplant and boil until very tender.
Drain and mash well.
In another bowl, beat the egg adding the sugar, salt, baking powder and flour.
Mix well.
Add mashed eggplant and mix. Drop mixture by teaspoonfuls into hot oil and fry until golden brown.
Drain on paper towels.
Serve hot.
recipes.text: Eggplant Fritters. Peel eggplant and boil until very tender. Drain and mash well. In another bowl, beat the egg adding the sugar, salt, baking powder and flour. Mix well. Add mashed eggplant and mix. Drop mixture by teaspoonfuls into hot oil and fry until golden brown. Drain on paper towels. Serve hot.

recipes.title: Sweet Pepper Casserole
ingredients: 3 each yellow, red, and green bell peppers
1 c. grated cheese plus a 1/2 c.
directions: Cook peppers until tender, drain. In a bowl mix salt, sugar flour, milk, cheese, and peppers put in a oblong baking dish put crumbled crackers on top and top with cheese bake in a 350° oven just until cheese is melted.
recipes.text: Sweet Pepper Casserole. Cook peppers until tender, drain. In a bowl mix salt, sugar flour, milk, cheese, and peppers put in a oblong baking dish put crumbled crackers on top and top with cheese bake in a 350° oven just until cheese is melted.

recipes.title: Grandma'S Cheesecake
directions: Pour condensed milk and cream cheese into bowl.
Stir until smooth.
Add lemon juice as you like.
Pour into pie crust. Refrigerate 45 minutes before serving.
recipes.text: Grandma'S Cheesecake. Pour condensed milk and cream cheese into bowl. Stir until smooth. Add lemon juice as you like. Pour into pie crust. Refrigerate 45 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Play Dough
ingredients: 1 Tbsp. alum (powdered, as used in dill pickles)
directions: Pour salt, alum, oil and food coloring into boiling water and stir.
Add flour; stir well, then knead until well blended. Mixture will be hot.
Store in plastic bag when cool.
recipes.text: Play Dough. Pour salt, alum, oil and food coloring into boiling water and stir. Add flour; stir well, then knead until well blended. Mixture will be hot. Store in plastic bag when cool.

recipes.title: Orange Glazed Carrots
ingredients: 3 c. carrots, sliced into 1 inch pieces
directions: Cook carrots just until tender, drain.
recipes.text: Orange Glazed Carrots. Cook carrots just until tender, drain.

recipes.title: Oatburgers
ingredients: 3/4 c. cooked rice or bread crumbs
directions: Cover oats and soy sauce with boiling water; cool.
Add all rest and mix well.
Form into burgers and bake, browning both sides, in 350° oven.
Serve on buns or in gravy.
Can be browned in skillet first, then put in a casserole in oven and baked with 2 cans mushroom soup, diluted with 1 to 1 1/2 cups milk.
Bake at 350° for 30 to 45 minutes, until mushroom soup begins to bubble. Serves 4 to 6.
recipes.text: Oatburgers. Cover oats and soy sauce with boiling water; cool. Add all rest and mix well. Form into burgers and bake, browning both sides, in 350° oven. Serve on buns or in gravy. Can be browned in skillet first, then put in a casserole in oven and baked with 2 cans mushroom soup, diluted with 1 to 1 1/2 cups milk. Bake at 350° for 30 to 45 minutes, until mushroom soup begins to bubble. Serves 4 to 6.

recipes.title: Potato Flake Cookies
directions: Mix all ingredients and spoon onto cookie sheet.
Bake at 350° until golden brown.
recipes.text: Potato Flake Cookies. Mix all ingredients and spoon onto cookie sheet. Bake at 350° until golden brown.

recipes.title: Beef Enchiladas
directions: Brown the ground beef in a skillet and pour off excess fat. Add taco seasoning and water.
Simmer until reduced.
Place equal amounts of taco meat on each tortilla.
Add some refried beans, if desired.
Put some salsa in bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Roll up tortillas and place seam down in pan.
Top with more salsa and the cheese.
Put in oven at 300° for 20 minutes or microwave 6 to 8 minutes until cheese melts.
recipes.text: Beef Enchiladas. Brown the ground beef in a skillet and pour off excess fat. Add taco seasoning and water. Simmer until reduced. Place equal amounts of taco meat on each tortilla. Add some refried beans, if desired. Put some salsa in bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan. Roll up tortillas and place seam down in pan. Top with more salsa and the cheese. Put in oven at 300° for 20 minutes or microwave 6 to 8 minutes until cheese melts.

recipes.title: Barbecue Sauce
directions: Combine and cook over low heat for 1 1/2 to 2 hours.
recipes.text: Barbecue Sauce. Combine and cook over low heat for 1 1/2 to 2 hours.

recipes.title: Settlers Beans
directions: In skillet, brown bacon, ground beef and onion.
Drain fat. Mix all ingredients in crock-pot.
Cook on high couple hours (until boils).
Cook a couple more hours on low or simmer 6 to 8 hours.
recipes.text: Settlers Beans. In skillet, brown bacon, ground beef and onion. Drain fat. Mix all ingredients in crock-pot. Cook on high couple hours (until boils). Cook a couple more hours on low or simmer 6 to 8 hours.

recipes.title: Jalopies
directions: Layer ingredients in order given.
(It is easier if you mix the soup and the sour cream together.)
Be sure to have the grated cheese as your final layer.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until bubbly.
recipes.text: Jalopies. Layer ingredients in order given. (It is easier if you mix the soup and the sour cream together.) Be sure to have the grated cheese as your final layer. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until bubbly.

recipes.title: Vegetable Casserole
directions: Make as much as you need.
Spray casserole dish the size to fit your family.
Slice potatoes to make first layer in dish. Slice onions to make second layer.
Slice squash for third layer; slice peeled fresh tomatoes for fourth layer.
Sprinkle with margarine, salt and pepper.
Add layers in order to fill your dish.
Bake, covered, at 350° for 30 to 45 minutes, or until potatoes are tender.
Works well in microwave.
recipes.text: Vegetable Casserole. Make as much as you need. Spray casserole dish the size to fit your family. Slice potatoes to make first layer in dish. Slice onions to make second layer. Slice squash for third layer; slice peeled fresh tomatoes for fourth layer. Sprinkle with margarine, salt and pepper. Add layers in order to fill your dish. Bake, covered, at 350° for 30 to 45 minutes, or until potatoes are tender. Works well in microwave.

recipes.title: Pea Soup
ingredients: 1 lb. (2 c.) dry whole green peas (available at Keaau Natural Foods)
directions: Wash peas well.
Soak peas overnight in water to cover and then drain.
Put peas in soup kettle with 2 1/2 quarts of water, the cut up ham hocks and the sliced onion.
Add freshly ground black pepper to taste.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat so soup just simmers and cook for 2 hours.
I serve this with dark rye bread and butter.
recipes.text: Pea Soup. Wash peas well. Soak peas overnight in water to cover and then drain. Put peas in soup kettle with 2 1/2 quarts of water, the cut up ham hocks and the sliced onion. Add freshly ground black pepper to taste. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat so soup just simmers and cook for 2 hours. I serve this with dark rye bread and butter.

recipes.title: Chocolate Chip Pound Cake
ingredients: 1 yellow cake mix (not with pudding added)
directions: Mix sugar, oil and water.
Add cake mix, instant chocolate pudding, eggs, and sour cream.
Mix well.
Stir in chocolate chips.
Pour into a greased and floured tube pan.
Bake at 325° for 50 to 60 minutes.
Cool in pan a few minutes and then turn out onto serving plate.
Either sprinkle with powdered sugar or ice immediately while still hot with Chocolate Frosting.
recipes.text: Chocolate Chip Pound Cake. Mix sugar, oil and water. Add cake mix, instant chocolate pudding, eggs, and sour cream. Mix well. Stir in chocolate chips. Pour into a greased and floured tube pan. Bake at 325° for 50 to 60 minutes. Cool in pan a few minutes and then turn out onto serving plate. Either sprinkle with powdered sugar or ice immediately while still hot with Chocolate Frosting.

recipes.title: Mounds Candy Bar Cake
directions: Bake according to package directions.
recipes.text: Mounds Candy Bar Cake. Bake according to package directions.

recipes.title: Angel Cordial Delight Cake
ingredients: 1 c. blanched sliced almonds or walnuts
directions: Cut cherries in quarters and marshmallows into small pieces. Drain pineapple and combine with cherries and marshmallows.
Let stand about 2 hours.
Soften gelatin in 1/2 cup cold milk.
Heat remaining 1/2 cup milk and add to softened gelatin.
Refrigerate until gelatin is partially set.
Add fruit mixture and nuts.
Fold into whipped cream.
Slice cake horizontally into 3 equal sized layers.
Spread fruit filling between cake layers and over the top and sides of the cake.
Chill until mixture is firm.
Refrigerate until served.
May be made 1 day prior to serving.
Yield:
16 servings.
recipes.text: Angel Cordial Delight Cake. Cut cherries in quarters and marshmallows into small pieces. Drain pineapple and combine with cherries and marshmallows. Let stand about 2 hours. Soften gelatin in 1/2 cup cold milk. Heat remaining 1/2 cup milk and add to softened gelatin. Refrigerate until gelatin is partially set. Add fruit mixture and nuts. Fold into whipped cream. Slice cake horizontally into 3 equal sized layers. Spread fruit filling between cake layers and over the top and sides of the cake. Chill until mixture is firm. Refrigerate until served. May be made 1 day prior to serving. Yield: 16 servings.

recipes.title: Ranger Cookies
directions: Mix butter, sugar, brown sugar and eggs.
Mix and add flour, baking powder, salt and baking soda.
Add vanilla, oatmeal, cornflakes and coconut and mix well.
Drop by teaspoons on greased cookie sheet.
Bake at 375° to 400° for 10 to 15 minutes.
recipes.text: Ranger Cookies. Mix butter, sugar, brown sugar and eggs. Mix and add flour, baking powder, salt and baking soda. Add vanilla, oatmeal, cornflakes and coconut and mix well. Drop by teaspoons on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 375° to 400° for 10 to 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Fresh Apple Cake
directions: Mix together.
Bake at 350° in 9 x 13-inch pan for 55 to 60 minutes.
Rub butter around pan.
recipes.text: Fresh Apple Cake. Mix together. Bake at 350° in 9 x 13-inch pan for 55 to 60 minutes. Rub butter around pan.

recipes.title: Delicious Broccoli Bread
ingredients: 1 box chopped broccoli, thawed and drained
directions: Saute onions in butter or margarine. Mix Jiffy mix with eggs, cottage cheese and broccoli. Add onion and butter. Put into oblong casserole dish. Bake at 400° for 25-30 minutes; until a nice brown on top and doesn't jiggle.
recipes.text: Delicious Broccoli Bread. Saute onions in butter or margarine. Mix Jiffy mix with eggs, cottage cheese and broccoli. Add onion and butter. Put into oblong casserole dish. Bake at 400° for 25-30 minutes; until a nice brown on top and doesn't jiggle.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Pie
directions: Combine first 7 ingredients and stir until smooth.
Then add pumpkin, milk and egg.
Pour mixture into 9-inch unbaked pastry crust.
Bake at 350° until firm.
recipes.text: Pumpkin Pie. Combine first 7 ingredients and stir until smooth. Then add pumpkin, milk and egg. Pour mixture into 9-inch unbaked pastry crust. Bake at 350° until firm.

recipes.title: Chicken Curry
directions: Melt butter and brown curry powder in it. Add onion, mushrooms, celery and apple to curried butter; mix thoroughly. Add beef broth and bring to just a boil.
Add lite cream and milk. Return to a boil.
Mix cornstarch and water; add to sauce until thickened. Salt to taste.
Add diced, cooked chicken and heat. Serve over hot rice with condiments (raisins, sauteed onions, nuts, chutney, coconut, etc.).
Serves 4 to 6.
recipes.text: Chicken Curry. Melt butter and brown curry powder in it. Add onion, mushrooms, celery and apple to curried butter; mix thoroughly. Add beef broth and bring to just a boil. Add lite cream and milk. Return to a boil. Mix cornstarch and water; add to sauce until thickened. Salt to taste. Add diced, cooked chicken and heat. Serve over hot rice with condiments (raisins, sauteed onions, nuts, chutney, coconut, etc.). Serves 4 to 6.

recipes.title: Vegetable Soup
ingredients: 1 lg. can of tomato sauce or a jar of canned tomatoes
4 potatoes diced into bite size pieces
3 carrots cut into bite size pieces
directions: Cook potatoes and carrots in the juices from the canned vegetables until tender. Saute the hamburger with the onions and garlic, drain well. Place the hamburger into the pot with the potatoes and carrots, add the tomato sauce and vegetables. Add worcestershire sauce, cilantro, and bay leaf. (Can also add rosemary, thyme, or other herbs to taste.) Let soup simmer for about an hour. It ends up being more of a stew than a soup. Great with cornbread.
recipes.text: Vegetable Soup. Cook potatoes and carrots in the juices from the canned vegetables until tender. Saute the hamburger with the onions and garlic, drain well. Place the hamburger into the pot with the potatoes and carrots, add the tomato sauce and vegetables. Add worcestershire sauce, cilantro, and bay leaf. (Can also add rosemary, thyme, or other herbs to taste.) Let soup simmer for about an hour. It ends up being more of a stew than a soup. Great with cornbread.

recipes.title: Great Leftover Chicken Casserole
directions: In
a greased
casserole
dish,
layer
chicken,
bread filling and gravy (small
amount of chopped onions if desired) until dish is full.
Top
with bread crumbs.
Bake in moderate oven at 350° until top
is
brown.
Served
with
side dish of peas or salads this is a good, fast meal.
recipes.text: Great Leftover Chicken Casserole. In a greased casserole dish, layer chicken, bread filling and gravy (small amount of chopped onions if desired) until dish is full. Top with bread crumbs. Bake in moderate oven at 350° until top is brown. Served with side dish of peas or salads this is a good, fast meal.

recipes.title: Edible Play Dough
directions: Mix equal parts of all ingredients.
Keep in airtight container.
recipes.text: Edible Play Dough. Mix equal parts of all ingredients. Keep in airtight container.

recipes.title: Sweet Potato Casserole
directions: Sprinkle on top of casserole.
Pour evenly 1/2 cup melted butter over top and bake at 350° for 20 minutes.
recipes.text: Sweet Potato Casserole. Sprinkle on top of casserole. Pour evenly 1/2 cup melted butter over top and bake at 350° for 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Southern Fried Chicken
