directions: In shallow pan, mix about 1 cup flour with salt and pepper to taste.
In separate bowl, slightly beat egg.
Add some milk and a sprinkle of flour.
Cut up chicken.
For each piece, individually coat with flour mixture, then dip into egg mixture.
Add another coating of the flour mixture.
Fry over medium heat until golden brown and well done.
It's best to use a cast-iron skillet.
recipes.text: Southern Fried Chicken. In shallow pan, mix about 1 cup flour with salt and pepper to taste. In separate bowl, slightly beat egg. Add some milk and a sprinkle of flour. Cut up chicken. For each piece, individually coat with flour mixture, then dip into egg mixture. Add another coating of the flour mixture. Fry over medium heat until golden brown and well done. It's best to use a cast-iron skillet.

recipes.title: Pizza Casserole
directions: Brown hamburg with onion, drain and season with salt and pepper.
Cook macaroni; mix with pizza sauce, macaroni and hamburg.
Place in 2 1/2-quart casserole dish.
Alternate layers with pepperoni and cheese.
Bake, uncovered, 30 minutes at 350°.
recipes.text: Pizza Casserole. Brown hamburg with onion, drain and season with salt and pepper. Cook macaroni; mix with pizza sauce, macaroni and hamburg. Place in 2 1/2-quart casserole dish. Alternate layers with pepperoni and cheese. Bake, uncovered, 30 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Key Lime Pie
ingredients: 3 to 4 oz. Key West lime juice
directions: Pour into 9-inch graham cracker pie shell.
Refrigerate overnight.
If preferred, pie may be baked at 350° for 8 minutes. Top with whipped cream or meringue.
recipes.text: Key Lime Pie. Pour into 9-inch graham cracker pie shell. Refrigerate overnight. If preferred, pie may be baked at 350° for 8 minutes. Top with whipped cream or meringue.

recipes.title: Layered Salad
ingredients: 1/2 pkg. spinach, washed, torn and drained
1/2 head lettuce, washed, torn and drained
dash of salt, pepper and sugar
directions: Layer one at a time in 9 x 13-inch serving dish the spinach, lettuce, bacon, eggs, peas, salt, pepper, sugar, onion and carrots.
recipes.text: Layered Salad. Layer one at a time in 9 x 13-inch serving dish the spinach, lettuce, bacon, eggs, peas, salt, pepper, sugar, onion and carrots.

recipes.title: Beany Weany Burger Biscuit Pie
ingredients: 31 oz. can pork and beans with tomato sauce
directions: Heat oven to 400°. Separate dough into biscuits and arrange around sides and bottom of 9 x 14-inch pan. Press dough to form crust. In a large skillet, brown ground beef and onion. Drain. Stir in beans, brown sugar, hot dogs and syrup. Simmer for 5 minutes over low heat until slightly thickened. Spoon mixture over prepared crust. Bake at 400° for 12 to 16 minutes or until crust is golden brown. Remove from oven. Sprinkle with cheese. Return to oven and bake 3 to 4 minutes more until cheese melts. Allow to cool 10 minutes before cutting into wedges.
recipes.text: Beany Weany Burger Biscuit Pie. Heat oven to 400°. Separate dough into biscuits and arrange around sides and bottom of 9 x 14-inch pan. Press dough to form crust. In a large skillet, brown ground beef and onion. Drain. Stir in beans, brown sugar, hot dogs and syrup. Simmer for 5 minutes over low heat until slightly thickened. Spoon mixture over prepared crust. Bake at 400° for 12 to 16 minutes or until crust is golden brown. Remove from oven. Sprinkle with cheese. Return to oven and bake 3 to 4 minutes more until cheese melts. Allow to cool 10 minutes before cutting into wedges.

recipes.title: Cheesy Oat Wafers
directions: Beat together Mozzarella cheese, 1/2 cup Parmesan cheese, butter and water until well blended.
Add combined flour, oregano, paprika and salt; mix well.
Stir in oats, mixing until blended. Shape into 12-inch roll.
Wrap securely.
Refrigerate 4 hours or up to 1 week.
Cut in 1/8-inch slices.
Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese.
Bake on greased cookie sheet in 400° oven about 10 minutes or until golden.
Immediately remove from cookie sheet and cool.
Makes about 6 dozen wafers.
Store in airtight container.
recipes.text: Cheesy Oat Wafers. Beat together Mozzarella cheese, 1/2 cup Parmesan cheese, butter and water until well blended. Add combined flour, oregano, paprika and salt; mix well. Stir in oats, mixing until blended. Shape into 12-inch roll. Wrap securely. Refrigerate 4 hours or up to 1 week. Cut in 1/8-inch slices. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Bake on greased cookie sheet in 400° oven about 10 minutes or until golden. Immediately remove from cookie sheet and cool. Makes about 6 dozen wafers. Store in airtight container.

recipes.title: Pineapple Au Gratin
ingredients: 2 large cans pineapple chunks, drained (save 1 c.)
directions: Mix flour, sugar, 1 cup juice, and pineapple chunks.
Place in pan.
Cover with cheese, then crackers, then margarine.
Bake at 350° for 35 minutes.
recipes.text: Pineapple Au Gratin. Mix flour, sugar, 1 cup juice, and pineapple chunks. Place in pan. Cover with cheese, then crackers, then margarine. Bake at 350° for 35 minutes.

recipes.title: Chicken Piccata
directions: Unfold fillets and place, one at a time, between 2 sheets of wax paper; pound with a flat-surfaced mallet until about 1/4-inch thick.
Combine flour, salt and pepper; coat breast fillets with mixture.
Melt margarine in large skillet over medium heat; add chicken and cook 3 to 4 minutes per side until done.
recipes.text: Chicken Piccata. Unfold fillets and place, one at a time, between 2 sheets of wax paper; pound with a flat-surfaced mallet until about 1/4-inch thick. Combine flour, salt and pepper; coat breast fillets with mixture. Melt margarine in large skillet over medium heat; add chicken and cook 3 to 4 minutes per side until done.

recipes.title: Bread And Butter Pickles
directions: Combine cucumbers, onions, peppers and garlic in pan.
Mix salt in.
Mix in 2 trays of ice.
Put one tray of ice on top.
Let stand 3 hours.
Drain ice water and remove garlic cloves.
recipes.text: Bread And Butter Pickles. Combine cucumbers, onions, peppers and garlic in pan. Mix salt in. Mix in 2 trays of ice. Put one tray of ice on top. Let stand 3 hours. Drain ice water and remove garlic cloves.

recipes.title: Gravy Baked Venison
directions: Melt butter in skillet. Add chopped onion. Coat steaks with flour & saute.
Remove all and place in baking dish. Pour mushroom soup over steak. Cover & bake at 350 degrees for 1 to 1 1/2 hours. Fry mushrooms and serve over steaks.
recipes.text: Gravy Baked Venison. Melt butter in skillet. Add chopped onion. Coat steaks with flour & saute. Remove all and place in baking dish. Pour mushroom soup over steak. Cover & bake at 350 degrees for 1 to 1 1/2 hours. Fry mushrooms and serve over steaks.

recipes.title: Peach Crisp
directions: Layer ingredients in order listed in a greased 9 x 13 dish. Bake at 325° for 50 to 60 minutes.
recipes.text: Peach Crisp. Layer ingredients in order listed in a greased 9 x 13 dish. Bake at 325° for 50 to 60 minutes.

recipes.title: German Chocolate Upside-Down Cake
directions: Generously grease a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Sprinkle 1 cup coconut and 1 cup pecans in bottom.
Mix cake mix as directed and pour over coconut and pecans.
recipes.text: German Chocolate Upside-Down Cake. Generously grease a 9 x 13-inch pan. Sprinkle 1 cup coconut and 1 cup pecans in bottom. Mix cake mix as directed and pour over coconut and pecans.

recipes.title: Salsa Fria
directions: Mix all ingredients together.
Chill and serve very cold. Serve with hot barbecued steaks or hamburgers.
Makes 2 cups.
recipes.text: Salsa Fria. Mix all ingredients together. Chill and serve very cold. Serve with hot barbecued steaks or hamburgers. Makes 2 cups.

recipes.title: Pie Crust
directions: Cut shortening into dry ingredients until well mixed.
Then beat 1 egg, 1 tbsp vinegar and 1/2 cup water and add all at once to flour mixture and mix to consistency for rolling.
(This can be stored in plastic bag in refrigerator for later use if not all used at once.)
recipes.text: Pie Crust. Cut shortening into dry ingredients until well mixed. Then beat 1 egg, 1 tbsp vinegar and 1/2 cup water and add all at once to flour mixture and mix to consistency for rolling. (This can be stored in plastic bag in refrigerator for later use if not all used at once.)

recipes.title: Baptist Cocktail
directions: Blend all ingredients together in blender. Serve immediately.
recipes.text: Baptist Cocktail. Blend all ingredients together in blender. Serve immediately.

recipes.title: Vegetable Manicotti(Serves 6)
directions: Heat oven to 350°.
Spray 13 x 9-inch baking dish with Pam. Combine Ricotta, egg whites, Parmesan, Italian seasoning and salt. Fill each manicotti with cheese mixture.
Top with vegetables. Cover with combined sauce and wine.
Cover dish with foil and bake 40 minutes or until pasta is tender.
recipes.text: Vegetable Manicotti(Serves 6). Heat oven to 350°. Spray 13 x 9-inch baking dish with Pam. Combine Ricotta, egg whites, Parmesan, Italian seasoning and salt. Fill each manicotti with cheese mixture. Top with vegetables. Cover with combined sauce and wine. Cover dish with foil and bake 40 minutes or until pasta is tender.

recipes.title: Mexican Casserole
directions: When Rice-A-Roni gets to "add 2 cups of water stage", add ground beef and stewed tomatoes.
Bring to a boil, then simmer for 15 minutes.
Add grated cheese and olives.
Put in oven and melt.
recipes.text: Mexican Casserole. When Rice-A-Roni gets to "add 2 cups of water stage", add ground beef and stewed tomatoes. Bring to a boil, then simmer for 15 minutes. Add grated cheese and olives. Put in oven and melt.

recipes.title: Jam Cake
directions: Mix all ingredients.
Put soda in buttermilk.
Mix well all together.
Bake in a tube pan at 325° for 50 to 60 minutes.
recipes.text: Jam Cake. Mix all ingredients. Put soda in buttermilk. Mix well all together. Bake in a tube pan at 325° for 50 to 60 minutes.

recipes.title: Quiche
ingredients: 1/2 lb. each: Mozzarella, Colby and American cheese, grated*
directions: *Sharp cheese is also good.
recipes.text: Quiche. *Sharp cheese is also good.

recipes.title: Spinach Salad With Strawberries And Pecans
directions: Combine first 3 ingredients; drizzle with poppy seed dressing. Serve immediately. Serves 6.
recipes.text: Spinach Salad With Strawberries And Pecans. Combine first 3 ingredients; drizzle with poppy seed dressing. Serve immediately. Serves 6.

recipes.title: Norwegian Fattigman
directions: Mix all of the ingredients using enough flour to make a soft dough.
Roll out thin and cut in strips in the shape of diamonds. Make a one inch slit in the middle of each diamond.
Loop one tip of the diamond through slit to make the cookie look like a diamond with a knot in the middle.
Fry in hot lard turning once.
Drain well on paper towels.
Cool and sprinkle with powdered sugar.
recipes.text: Norwegian Fattigman. Mix all of the ingredients using enough flour to make a soft dough. Roll out thin and cut in strips in the shape of diamonds. Make a one inch slit in the middle of each diamond. Loop one tip of the diamond through slit to make the cookie look like a diamond with a knot in the middle. Fry in hot lard turning once. Drain well on paper towels. Cool and sprinkle with powdered sugar.

recipes.title: Avocado-Shrimp Salad
ingredients: 1 small avocado, halved, pitted, peeled and cut up
dash of bottled hot pepper sauce
1 lb. peeled and deveined shrimp, cooked and chilled
4 oz. Swiss or Gruyere cheese, cut into julienne strips
directions: For dressing, in a blender container combine avocado, buttermilk, cream cheese, lemon juice, garlic, salt and hot pepper sauce.
Cover and blend until smooth.
Arrange shrimp, tomatoes and cheese strips over lettuce.
If desired, sprinkle with pepper. Drizzle with dressing.
Makes 6 main dish servings.
recipes.text: Avocado-Shrimp Salad. For dressing, in a blender container combine avocado, buttermilk, cream cheese, lemon juice, garlic, salt and hot pepper sauce. Cover and blend until smooth. Arrange shrimp, tomatoes and cheese strips over lettuce. If desired, sprinkle with pepper. Drizzle with dressing. Makes 6 main dish servings.

recipes.title: Dirt Cake
directions: Make pudding according to directions on the box.
Add the cream cheese and whipped cream.
Crunch the cookies up in to little crumbs like dirt.
Layer the pudding and cookies one after another.
Refrigerate for 30-40 minutes or until cold.
recipes.text: Dirt Cake. Make pudding according to directions on the box. Add the cream cheese and whipped cream. Crunch the cookies up in to little crumbs like dirt. Layer the pudding and cookies one after another. Refrigerate for 30-40 minutes or until cold.

recipes.title: Cabbage Pie
directions: Preheat oven to 350°.
Heat 1 1/2 teaspoons oil in skillet over medium heat.
Saute onion until translucent, almost tender, approximately 3 minutes.
Add caraway and dill.
Cook briefly. Remove from heat.
Transfer to bowl.
In food processor, blend tofu, salt, lemon juice, 1 tablespoon oil and tahini until smooth. Fold into sauteed vegetables.
Pour into pie crust and bake 20 to 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Cabbage Pie. Preheat oven to 350°. Heat 1 1/2 teaspoons oil in skillet over medium heat. Saute onion until translucent, almost tender, approximately 3 minutes. Add caraway and dill. Cook briefly. Remove from heat. Transfer to bowl. In food processor, blend tofu, salt, lemon juice, 1 tablespoon oil and tahini until smooth. Fold into sauteed vegetables. Pour into pie crust and bake 20 to 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Tamale Casserole
ingredients: 6 oz mild cheddar cheese sliced thin
directions: Unwrap tamales cut crosswise into 1/2 inch slices.
Line 11/2 qt. casserole with half tamales slices.
Spread half chili over top.
Cover with half of the onions hen half of chips and half of cheese.
Repeat except for the cheese.
Bake uncovered for 25 minutes.
Top with remaining cheese.
Bake 10 minutes longer. Makes 4 to 6 large servings.
recipes.text: Tamale Casserole. Unwrap tamales cut crosswise into 1/2 inch slices. Line 11/2 qt. casserole with half tamales slices. Spread half chili over top. Cover with half of the onions hen half of chips and half of cheese. Repeat except for the cheese. Bake uncovered for 25 minutes. Top with remaining cheese. Bake 10 minutes longer. Makes 4 to 6 large servings.

recipes.title: Party Potatoes
directions: Mix all ingredients together and pour into a sprayed 9 x 13-inch baking pan.
Drizzle over the top 1 stick of melted butter.
Bake for 1 hour in a 350° oven.
Serves 12.
recipes.text: Party Potatoes. Mix all ingredients together and pour into a sprayed 9 x 13-inch baking pan. Drizzle over the top 1 stick of melted butter. Bake for 1 hour in a 350° oven. Serves 12.

recipes.title: Hot Deviled Potatoes
directions: Prepare 2 servings potatoes to package directions.
Stir in remaining ingredients.
Spoon into 2 foil baking shells. Sprinkle with paprika.
Bake at 350° about 20 minutes or until heated thoroughly.
Makes 2 servings.
recipes.text: Hot Deviled Potatoes. Prepare 2 servings potatoes to package directions. Stir in remaining ingredients. Spoon into 2 foil baking shells. Sprinkle with paprika. Bake at 350° about 20 minutes or until heated thoroughly. Makes 2 servings.

recipes.title: Peeto'S Brownies
directions: Mix sugar, cocoa, shortening, eggs and vanilla; beat.
Add dry ingredients.
Bake at 350° for 25 minutes in 8 x 13-inch greased pan.
recipes.text: Peeto'S Brownies. Mix sugar, cocoa, shortening, eggs and vanilla; beat. Add dry ingredients. Bake at 350° for 25 minutes in 8 x 13-inch greased pan.

recipes.title: Tent Dinner
directions: Cook gizzards and livers in water with seasonings.
Boil 20 to 30 minutes or until tender.
Grind and set aside.
Save broth.
recipes.text: Tent Dinner. Cook gizzards and livers in water with seasonings. Boil 20 to 30 minutes or until tender. Grind and set aside. Save broth.

recipes.title: Washington Cottage Pudding *
directions: *A speedy cake that is perfect with a fruit dessert sauce spooned atop.
recipes.text: Washington Cottage Pudding *. *A speedy cake that is perfect with a fruit dessert sauce spooned atop.

recipes.title: Coleslaw Dressing
directions: Combine mayonnaise and sour cream. Whisk until well blended. Add remaining ingredients and mix well. Refrigerate.
recipes.text: Coleslaw Dressing. Combine mayonnaise and sour cream. Whisk until well blended. Add remaining ingredients and mix well. Refrigerate.

recipes.title: Spinach Dip
ingredients: 2 c. fresh spinach or 1 (10 oz.) pkg. frozen chopped spinach
1 round loaf rye, pumpernickel or sourdough bread for serving (if desired)
directions: If using frozen spinach, thaw and squeeze out water.
Combine all ingredients (except bread) and chill in refrigerator for at least 3 hours before serving.
Shredded carrots can be added for more color.
Serve in a hollowed-out loaf of bread.
Use vegetable sticks or bread cubes for dipping.
Makes 3 1/2 cups of dip. Contains 20 calories and .6 gram of fat per 1/4 cup.
recipes.text: Spinach Dip. If using frozen spinach, thaw and squeeze out water. Combine all ingredients (except bread) and chill in refrigerator for at least 3 hours before serving. Shredded carrots can be added for more color. Serve in a hollowed-out loaf of bread. Use vegetable sticks or bread cubes for dipping. Makes 3 1/2 cups of dip. Contains 20 calories and .6 gram of fat per 1/4 cup.

recipes.title: Shrimp Cheese Ball
directions: Mix cream cheese, mustard, lemon juice and onion.
Stir in shrimp.
Shape into ball.
Roll in pecans.
Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate overnight for best flavor.
recipes.text: Shrimp Cheese Ball. Mix cream cheese, mustard, lemon juice and onion. Stir in shrimp. Shape into ball. Roll in pecans. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate overnight for best flavor.

recipes.title: Old Southern Grated Sweet Potato Pudding
directions: In a heavy iron skillet, melt butter.
Mix all ingredients, adding the beaten eggs last.
Bake in skillet at 375°.
Stir several times while baking.
Bake 40 minutes.
The iron skillet makes a crunchier crust.
recipes.text: Old Southern Grated Sweet Potato Pudding. In a heavy iron skillet, melt butter. Mix all ingredients, adding the beaten eggs last. Bake in skillet at 375°. Stir several times while baking. Bake 40 minutes. The iron skillet makes a crunchier crust.

recipes.title: Creamy Carrot Casserole
ingredients: 1 (20 oz.) bag carrots, peeled and sliced
directions: Cook carrots until crisp-tender.
Drain, reserving 1/4 cup cooking liquid.
Place carrots in a 1 1/2-quart baking dish. Combine mayonnaise, onion, horseradish and reserved liquid. Spread over carrots.
Sprinkle with Cheddar cheese.
Top with bread crumbs.
Bake, uncovered, 30 minutes at 350°.
recipes.text: Creamy Carrot Casserole. Cook carrots until crisp-tender. Drain, reserving 1/4 cup cooking liquid. Place carrots in a 1 1/2-quart baking dish. Combine mayonnaise, onion, horseradish and reserved liquid. Spread over carrots. Sprinkle with Cheddar cheese. Top with bread crumbs. Bake, uncovered, 30 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Spaghetti Carbonara
ingredients: 1 c. heavy or sour cream, warmed slightly
directions: Cook bacon slices until crisp.
Drain on paper towels.
Leave 3 tablespoons bacon fat in skillet.
Saute onions in bacon fat until golden and soft.
Add wine and cook until wine evaporates. Beat together eggs, butter, cream, Parmesan and parsley.
Add onions.
Cook spaghetti in boiling salted water as directed on package.
Transfer with slotted spoon to large warmed bowl.
Add egg-and-cheese mixture and toss.
Crumble bacon and sprinkle over top.
Grind black pepper over all and serve.
Serves 8.
recipes.text: Spaghetti Carbonara. Cook bacon slices until crisp. Drain on paper towels. Leave 3 tablespoons bacon fat in skillet. Saute onions in bacon fat until golden and soft. Add wine and cook until wine evaporates. Beat together eggs, butter, cream, Parmesan and parsley. Add onions. Cook spaghetti in boiling salted water as directed on package. Transfer with slotted spoon to large warmed bowl. Add egg-and-cheese mixture and toss. Crumble bacon and sprinkle over top. Grind black pepper over all and serve. Serves 8.

recipes.title: Seelbach Cookies
directions: Cream butter and both sugars together with a paddle.
Add eggs, one at a time.
Add vanilla and lemon.
Mix all dry ingredients and incorporate into sugar mixture.
Add chocolate chips and pecans; mix just long enough to incorporate evenly. Bake at 350° until outside layer is slightly firm and inside is soft.
Makes approximately 2 dozen.
recipes.text: Seelbach Cookies. Cream butter and both sugars together with a paddle. Add eggs, one at a time. Add vanilla and lemon. Mix all dry ingredients and incorporate into sugar mixture. Add chocolate chips and pecans; mix just long enough to incorporate evenly. Bake at 350° until outside layer is slightly firm and inside is soft. Makes approximately 2 dozen.

recipes.title: Better Than Sex Cake
ingredients: 1 box yellow cake mix (most use Duncan Hines)
1 (6 oz.) bar Baker's sweet chocolate, grated
directions: In electric mixer bowl, mix together cake mix, instant pudding, oil and water. Add eggs, one at a time, beating after each. Stir in sour cream, chocolate chips, pecans, grated chocolate and coconut. Bake at 350° in well-greased Bundt pan about 55 minutes or until a toothpick comes out clean.
recipes.text: Better Than Sex Cake. In electric mixer bowl, mix together cake mix, instant pudding, oil and water. Add eggs, one at a time, beating after each. Stir in sour cream, chocolate chips, pecans, grated chocolate and coconut. Bake at 350° in well-greased Bundt pan about 55 minutes or until a toothpick comes out clean.

recipes.title: Tangy Lemon Squares
ingredients: 1/3 c. Minute Maid 100% pure lemon juice
directions: Cream together butter and 1/2 cup of powdered sugar until fluffy.
Add 2 cups of flour; beat until blended.
Spread evenly over bottom of a well-greased 9 x 13-inch baking pan.
Bake in preheated oven at 350° for 20 minutes.
recipes.text: Tangy Lemon Squares. Cream together butter and 1/2 cup of powdered sugar until fluffy. Add 2 cups of flour; beat until blended. Spread evenly over bottom of a well-greased 9 x 13-inch baking pan. Bake in preheated oven at 350° for 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Creamy Peanut Butter Cookies
directions: Mix ingredients well.
Drop onto greased cookie sheet; press with fork dipped in flour.
Bake at 350° for 5 to 8 minutes. Makes 5 dozen cookies.
recipes.text: Creamy Peanut Butter Cookies. Mix ingredients well. Drop onto greased cookie sheet; press with fork dipped in flour. Bake at 350° for 5 to 8 minutes. Makes 5 dozen cookies.

recipes.title: Danny'S Dirt Cake
directions: Will also need 1 artificial stem flower and 1 flowerpot.
recipes.text: Danny'S Dirt Cake. Will also need 1 artificial stem flower and 1 flowerpot.

recipes.title: Tater Tot Casserole
directions: Spread in 9 x 13 x 2 pan the ground beef. Sprinkle with salt, pepper and garlic powder. Spread soup (mixed with small amount of water and warmed) over meat. Cover with Tater Tots. Spread cheese over top. Cover with foil. Bake at 350° for 1 hour. Enjoy!
recipes.text: Tater Tot Casserole. Spread in 9 x 13 x 2 pan the ground beef. Sprinkle with salt, pepper and garlic powder. Spread soup (mixed with small amount of water and warmed) over meat. Cover with Tater Tots. Spread cheese over top. Cover with foil. Bake at 350° for 1 hour. Enjoy!

recipes.title: Unbaked Butterscotch Cookies
directions: In a large saucepan, combine sugar, butter or margarine and canned milk.
Bring mixture to a boil, stirring frequently. Remove from stove and add pudding, rolled oats, coconut and nuts. Mix together thoroughly.
Cool.
Drop dough by teaspoon on wax paper.
Makes about 5 dozen cookies.
recipes.text: Unbaked Butterscotch Cookies. In a large saucepan, combine sugar, butter or margarine and canned milk. Bring mixture to a boil, stirring frequently. Remove from stove and add pudding, rolled oats, coconut and nuts. Mix together thoroughly. Cool. Drop dough by teaspoon on wax paper. Makes about 5 dozen cookies.

recipes.title: Grapefruit Salad
ingredients: 2 c. drained grapefruit sections, in bite sized pieces
directions: Dissolve lemon gelatin in boiling water.
Dissolve plain gelatin in cold water.
Mix them together.
Add grapefruit juice, ginger ale and sugar; mix all.
When it starts to set, add grapefruit sections.
Pour into oblong dish or mold and refrigerate.
recipes.text: Grapefruit Salad. Dissolve lemon gelatin in boiling water. Dissolve plain gelatin in cold water. Mix them together. Add grapefruit juice, ginger ale and sugar; mix all. When it starts to set, add grapefruit sections. Pour into oblong dish or mold and refrigerate.

recipes.title: Chocolate Cake
directions: Sift dry ingredients together.
Mix butter and eggs, then add dry ingredients and boiling water alternately.
Bake for 30 to 35 minutes at 350°.
recipes.text: Chocolate Cake. Sift dry ingredients together. Mix butter and eggs, then add dry ingredients and boiling water alternately. Bake for 30 to 35 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Corn Casserole
directions: Melt butter in baking dish.
Mix other ingredients.
Pour into baking dish. Bake 40 minutes at 350°.
recipes.text: Corn Casserole. Melt butter in baking dish. Mix other ingredients. Pour into baking dish. Bake 40 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Scotch Scones
directions: Cream sugar and margarine.
Add other ingredients.
Form into balls and pat flat about 1/2-inch thick.
Bake slowly at 300° about 1 hour until pale tan in color.
While warm, sprinkle with confectioners sugar.
Store in tins.
They are better when aged.
recipes.text: Scotch Scones. Cream sugar and margarine. Add other ingredients. Form into balls and pat flat about 1/2-inch thick. Bake slowly at 300° about 1 hour until pale tan in color. While warm, sprinkle with confectioners sugar. Store in tins. They are better when aged.

recipes.title: Hearty Potato Soup
directions: Cook potatoes and carrots in water until tender.
Drain liquid into a bowl and set aside.
Put vegetables in another bowl and set aside.
In original pot, saute onion in nonstick spray until soft. Add a little reserved liquid and stir in flour, salt and pepper. Gradually add milk, stirring until thickened.
Gently stir in vegetables.
Add reserved liquid until consistency is as desired. Freezes well.
Very low-fat!
recipes.text: Hearty Potato Soup. Cook potatoes and carrots in water until tender. Drain liquid into a bowl and set aside. Put vegetables in another bowl and set aside. In original pot, saute onion in nonstick spray until soft. Add a little reserved liquid and stir in flour, salt and pepper. Gradually add milk, stirring until thickened. Gently stir in vegetables. Add reserved liquid until consistency is as desired. Freezes well. Very low-fat!

recipes.title: Applesauce Cake
directions: Preheat oven to 350°.
Grease and flour a tube pan.
Add all ingredients to a large mixing bowl and mix very well.
Bake until cake tests done.
recipes.text: Applesauce Cake. Preheat oven to 350°. Grease and flour a tube pan. Add all ingredients to a large mixing bowl and mix very well. Bake until cake tests done.

recipes.title: Date Nut Balls
directions: Melt
butter
with
sugar
and
dates.
When sugar dissolves, cook slowly 10 minutes.
Stir often.
Remove from heat and add other ingredients.
Let cool.
Roll into small balls. Roll or shake
in
powdered sugar or coconut.
Makes 12 dozen balls. Keeps well in a tight container.
May be frozen.
recipes.text: Date Nut Balls. Melt butter with sugar and dates. When sugar dissolves, cook slowly 10 minutes. Stir often. Remove from heat and add other ingredients. Let cool. Roll into small balls. Roll or shake in powdered sugar or coconut. Makes 12 dozen balls. Keeps well in a tight container. May be frozen.

recipes.title: Broccoli Quiche In Hash Brown Potato Crust
directions: Preheat oven to 350°.
Spray 9 to 10-inch glass pie plate with nonstick spray.
Drain shredded potatoes on paper towels and squeeze out excess moisture.
Place in medium bowl and mix with onion and Egg Beaters.
Mix flour and seasoned salt together; then mix into potato mixture until evenly distributed.
Pat this mixture in pie plate so it is evenly spread over bottom and sides to the top.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
Cool and refrigerate if not using immediately.
recipes.text: Broccoli Quiche In Hash Brown Potato Crust. Preheat oven to 350°. Spray 9 to 10-inch glass pie plate with nonstick spray. Drain shredded potatoes on paper towels and squeeze out excess moisture. Place in medium bowl and mix with onion and Egg Beaters. Mix flour and seasoned salt together; then mix into potato mixture until evenly distributed. Pat this mixture in pie plate so it is evenly spread over bottom and sides to the top. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes. Cool and refrigerate if not using immediately.

recipes.title: Fish Chowder
directions: Saute onion and celery in olive oil until tender.
Add potatoes and cover with boiling water.
Add bay leaf, salt and pepper.
Cook ten minutes. Then add cubed fish.
When all is cooked, add evaporated milk and heat through.
Add butter and sprinkle paprika on top.
Serve with crackers and salad.
recipes.text: Fish Chowder. Saute onion and celery in olive oil until tender. Add potatoes and cover with boiling water. Add bay leaf, salt and pepper. Cook ten minutes. Then add cubed fish. When all is cooked, add evaporated milk and heat through. Add butter and sprinkle paprika on top. Serve with crackers and salad.

recipes.title: Karo Pecan Pie
directions: Mix
all
ingredients together, adding nuts last.
Pour into an	unbaked
pie crust.
Then place in 350° oven, cooking until you think it is completely cooked.
recipes.text: Karo Pecan Pie. Mix all ingredients together, adding nuts last. Pour into an	unbaked pie crust. Then place in 350° oven, cooking until you think it is completely cooked.

recipes.title: Beef Stroganoff
directions: Cook onions in butter, add meat and cook about 10 minutes. Add soup, sour cream and seasoning.
Salt and pepper to taste.
recipes.text: Beef Stroganoff. Cook onions in butter, add meat and cook about 10 minutes. Add soup, sour cream and seasoning. Salt and pepper to taste.

recipes.title: Frozen Grapes
directions: Wash and clean the grapes.
Take grapes off stem and put in Ziploc bag.
Put in freezer.
Enjoy as a snack.
recipes.text: Frozen Grapes. Wash and clean the grapes. Take grapes off stem and put in Ziploc bag. Put in freezer. Enjoy as a snack.

recipes.title: Ham, Swiss And Mushroom Pizza
ingredients: 1/2 c. green pepper, cut in strips
directions: Heat oven to 425°.
Grease 15 x 10 x 1-inch baking pan.
Make pizza dough according to directions.
Place in center of pan and press out.
Bake for 5 to 10 minutes until a light golden brown. In a small bowl, combine mayonnaise, horseradish, mustard and poppy seed.
Blend well.
Spread over partially baked crust.
Top with green peppers, onions, ham and mushrooms.
Sprinkle with cheeses. Bake for 10 to 15 minutes or until crust is a golden brown and cheese is melted.
recipes.text: Ham, Swiss And Mushroom Pizza. Heat oven to 425°. Grease 15 x 10 x 1-inch baking pan. Make pizza dough according to directions. Place in center of pan and press out. Bake for 5 to 10 minutes until a light golden brown. In a small bowl, combine mayonnaise, horseradish, mustard and poppy seed. Blend well. Spread over partially baked crust. Top with green peppers, onions, ham and mushrooms. Sprinkle with cheeses. Bake for 10 to 15 minutes or until crust is a golden brown and cheese is melted.

recipes.title: Hummingbird Cake
directions: Grease and flour 4 round cake pans. Preheat oven to 325°.
recipes.text: Hummingbird Cake. Grease and flour 4 round cake pans. Preheat oven to 325°.

recipes.title: Chicken Dijon
ingredients: 2 boneless chicken breast portions (about 4 oz. each)
directions: Season chicken breasts lightly with salt and pepper.
Heat butter in skillet and brown chicken about 5 minutes on each side, pressing flat with spatula.
While chicken browns, combine sour cream, Worcestershire sauce and mustard.
Spoon over chicken and warm through a minute or two.
Sprinkle with chopped chives, if desired, and serve.
recipes.text: Chicken Dijon. Season chicken breasts lightly with salt and pepper. Heat butter in skillet and brown chicken about 5 minutes on each side, pressing flat with spatula. While chicken browns, combine sour cream, Worcestershire sauce and mustard. Spoon over chicken and warm through a minute or two. Sprinkle with chopped chives, if desired, and serve.

recipes.title: Baked Beans
directions: Soak beans overnight.
In same liquid, bring beans to boil and simmer until tender (about 1 1/2 hours).
Drain, reserving liquid. Preheat oven to 275° to 300°.
recipes.text: Baked Beans. Soak beans overnight. In same liquid, bring beans to boil and simmer until tender (about 1 1/2 hours). Drain, reserving liquid. Preheat oven to 275° to 300°.

recipes.title: Sour Cream Pound Cake
directions: Cream butter and sugar.
Add eggs, one at a time, until fluffy.
Add flour, one cup at a time, stirring to combine.
Add soda to last cup of flour.
Add vanilla and almond extracts.
Bake in tube pan for 1 1/2 hours at 300°.
Great served with lemon sauce or any fruit sauce.
Wonderful just plain!
recipes.text: Sour Cream Pound Cake. Cream butter and sugar. Add eggs, one at a time, until fluffy. Add flour, one cup at a time, stirring to combine. Add soda to last cup of flour. Add vanilla and almond extracts. Bake in tube pan for 1 1/2 hours at 300°. Great served with lemon sauce or any fruit sauce. Wonderful just plain!

recipes.title: Chili Cheese Dip
ingredients: 8 oz. shredded Cheddar or Monterey Jack (may use both)
directions: Spread cream cheese in bottom of pan.
Add chili; spread over cream cheese.
Spread cheese over chili.
Bake 10 to 15 minutes at 350°.
Sprinkle with paprika and parsley.
recipes.text: Chili Cheese Dip. Spread cream cheese in bottom of pan. Add chili; spread over cream cheese. Spread cheese over chili. Bake 10 to 15 minutes at 350°. Sprinkle with paprika and parsley.

recipes.title: Barbecue Spareribs
directions: Saute onion and celery in butter until soft.
Add other ingredients and simmer 30 minutes.
Pour over ribs and cook until tender at 350°.
recipes.text: Barbecue Spareribs. Saute onion and celery in butter until soft. Add other ingredients and simmer 30 minutes. Pour over ribs and cook until tender at 350°.

recipes.title: Cookie Press Cookies
directions: Mix together first 4 ingredients; add flour.
Fill a cookie press; press on a cookie sheet.
Bake at 400° for 8 to 10 minutes.
recipes.text: Cookie Press Cookies. Mix together first 4 ingredients; add flour. Fill a cookie press; press on a cookie sheet. Bake at 400° for 8 to 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Cream Puffs
ingredients: 1/2 pt. heavy cream or Cool Whip or chocolate pudding
directions: Boil water; add butter.
Let butter melt.
After melted, add flour; stir into ball.
Take off heat, place in bowl and let cool. Add eggs, one at a time.
Then spoon out dough into small balls on cookie sheet.
Cook for 30 minutes, until golden brown, at 350°.
Stuff with cream and add powdered sugar on top.
recipes.text: Cream Puffs. Boil water; add butter. Let butter melt. After melted, add flour; stir into ball. Take off heat, place in bowl and let cool. Add eggs, one at a time. Then spoon out dough into small balls on cookie sheet. Cook for 30 minutes, until golden brown, at 350°. Stuff with cream and add powdered sugar on top.

recipes.title: Italian Pie
ingredients: 1/2 c. chopped parsley or 2 Tbsp. parsley flakes
directions: Preheat oven to 375°.
Thaw broccoli and drain well.
Line a 9-inch pie pan with crescent rolls.
Mix all remaining ingredients with broccoli.
Pour into pie pan.
Bake 18 to 25 minutes.
Let stand 10 minutes before serving.
recipes.text: Italian Pie. Preheat oven to 375°. Thaw broccoli and drain well. Line a 9-inch pie pan with crescent rolls. Mix all remaining ingredients with broccoli. Pour into pie pan. Bake 18 to 25 minutes. Let stand 10 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Portuguese Kidney Bean Soup
ingredients: 1 can red kidney beans (1 lb. works)
directions: Put beans in a large pan with 4 cups water. Saut onion and garlic in bacon fat in another pan. Add to pot and add potatoes, tomato paste, bay leaves, allspice, salt and pepper. Simmer 45 minutes to an hour, adding more liquid if necessary; it should be thick. This should serve four. You improvise sometimes by adding corn, ground meat, anything that sounds good.
recipes.text: Portuguese Kidney Bean Soup. Put beans in a large pan with 4 cups water. Saut onion and garlic in bacon fat in another pan. Add to pot and add potatoes, tomato paste, bay leaves, allspice, salt and pepper. Simmer 45 minutes to an hour, adding more liquid if necessary; it should be thick. This should serve four. You improvise sometimes by adding corn, ground meat, anything that sounds good.

recipes.title: Shortbread
directions: Combine butter and sugar; blend well, being careful not to let butter get too soft.
(Best to mix with hands.) Gradually blend in flour; mix well.
Pat and press in 9 x 13-inch jelly roll pan. Prick with fork.
Put in fridge for 1/2 hour.
Bake at 375° for 5 minutes, then at 300° for 30 minutes, or until light brown. (Watch closely; don't let it get too brown.)
Remove from oven; cut into squares.
Sprinkle with white sugar.
Store in tin, not in Tupperware!
recipes.text: Shortbread. Combine butter and sugar; blend well, being careful not to let butter get too soft. (Best to mix with hands.) Gradually blend in flour; mix well. Pat and press in 9 x 13-inch jelly roll pan. Prick with fork. Put in fridge for 1/2 hour. Bake at 375° for 5 minutes, then at 300° for 30 minutes, or until light brown. (Watch closely; don't let it get too brown.) Remove from oven; cut into squares. Sprinkle with white sugar. Store in tin, not in Tupperware!

recipes.title: Hot German Potato Salad
directions: Cook whole potatoes in skin; cool and slice after taking off skins.
In skillet, fry bacon; drain.
Cook and stir onion in bacon drippings until golden brown.
Stir in flour, sugar, salt, celery seed and pepper.
Cook over low heat, stirring until bubbling.
Remove from heat.
Stir in water and vinegar.
Heat to boiling, stirring constantly.
Boil and stir 1 minute.
Crumble bacon.
Carefully stir bacon and potatoes into hot mixture.
Stir lightly to coat potato slices.
recipes.text: Hot German Potato Salad. Cook whole potatoes in skin; cool and slice after taking off skins. In skillet, fry bacon; drain. Cook and stir onion in bacon drippings until golden brown. Stir in flour, sugar, salt, celery seed and pepper. Cook over low heat, stirring until bubbling. Remove from heat. Stir in water and vinegar. Heat to boiling, stirring constantly. Boil and stir 1 minute. Crumble bacon. Carefully stir bacon and potatoes into hot mixture. Stir lightly to coat potato slices.

recipes.title: Apricot Nut Supreme Brownies
ingredients: 1 c. dried apricots, quartered and divided
directions: Preheat
oven
In small saucepan, melt chocolate and
margarine
over
low
heat.
Stir
constantly until mixture becomes a curdling consistency; remove from heat.
Add sugar, eggs and extract; stir quickly to blend.
recipes.text: Apricot Nut Supreme Brownies. Preheat oven to 350°. In small saucepan, melt chocolate and margarine over low heat. Stir constantly until mixture becomes a curdling consistency; remove from heat. Add sugar, eggs and extract; stir quickly to blend.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Bread
ingredients: 1 large can pumpkin or 3 c. fresh
directions: Mix first 5 ingredients in large bowl.
Sift together next 7 ingredients and stir into pumpkin mixture.
recipes.text: Pumpkin Bread. Mix first 5 ingredients in large bowl. Sift together next 7 ingredients and stir into pumpkin mixture.

recipes.title: Belgian Chicken Normandy
ingredients: 8 green or yellow apples, washed, peeled, cored and sliced
10 to 12 small white potatoes, washed and thinly sliced (do not peel)
directions: Melt butter in a large baking pan. Add chicken. Add apples to the pan with the chicken.
Pour the apple brandy and cream over the chicken and apples.
Put in a 350° oven and bake for 1 1/2 hours or until chicken is done.
recipes.text: Belgian Chicken Normandy. Melt butter in a large baking pan. Add chicken. Add apples to the pan with the chicken. Pour the apple brandy and cream over the chicken and apples. Put in a 350° oven and bake for 1 1/2 hours or until chicken is done.

recipes.title: Oven Fried Chicken
directions: In a paper bag, combine flour, salt, paprika and pepper. Add chicken pieces one at a time. Shake to coat evenly. Dip both sides of chicken in melted butter. Place chicken in a single layer, skin side down, in 13 x 9-inch baking pan. Bake 30 minutes at 400°. Turn chicken skin side up and bake 20 to 30 minutes longer or until chicken is tender.
recipes.text: Oven Fried Chicken. In a paper bag, combine flour, salt, paprika and pepper. Add chicken pieces one at a time. Shake to coat evenly. Dip both sides of chicken in melted butter. Place chicken in a single layer, skin side down, in 13 x 9-inch baking pan. Bake 30 minutes at 400°. Turn chicken skin side up and bake 20 to 30 minutes longer or until chicken is tender.

recipes.title: Italian Chicken
directions: Coat chicken with flour and seasoned salt mixture.
Brown in oil on both sides; set aside.
Drain oil.
Add tomato sauce, mushrooms and garlic powder; mix well.
Simmer 3 to 4 minutes. Add chicken.
Heat 4 to 5 minutes.
Sprinkle chicken with cheese; simmer until done.
recipes.text: Italian Chicken. Coat chicken with flour and seasoned salt mixture. Brown in oil on both sides; set aside. Drain oil. Add tomato sauce, mushrooms and garlic powder; mix well. Simmer 3 to 4 minutes. Add chicken. Heat 4 to 5 minutes. Sprinkle chicken with cheese; simmer until done.

recipes.title: Baked Onion-Flavored Chicken
directions: Grease bottom of shallow 2-quart baking dish.
Sprinkle half the soup mix on bottom of dish.
Place chicken pieces over it, then drizzle margarine over chicken.
Sprinkle with remaining soup mix.
Cover with foil and bake in preheated 425° oven for an hour or more.
Reserve pan juices (about 1/2 cup) and combine with sour cream.
Heat gently and serve with chicken.
recipes.text: Baked Onion-Flavored Chicken. Grease bottom of shallow 2-quart baking dish. Sprinkle half the soup mix on bottom of dish. Place chicken pieces over it, then drizzle margarine over chicken. Sprinkle with remaining soup mix. Cover with foil and bake in preheated 425° oven for an hour or more. Reserve pan juices (about 1/2 cup) and combine with sour cream. Heat gently and serve with chicken.

recipes.title: Baked Macaroni And Cheese
directions: Preheat oven to 375°.
Cook macaroni as package label directs and drain.
Melt butter in medium saucepan.
Remove from heat. Stir in flour, salt and pepper until smooth.
Gradually stir in milk.
Bring to boil, reduce heat and simmer mixture 1 minute. Remove from heat.
recipes.text: Baked Macaroni And Cheese. Preheat oven to 375°. Cook macaroni as package label directs and drain. Melt butter in medium saucepan. Remove from heat. Stir in flour, salt and pepper until smooth. Gradually stir in milk. Bring to boil, reduce heat and simmer mixture 1 minute. Remove from heat.

recipes.title: House'S Egg Nog(Low Fat Version)
directions: Mix ingredients in food processor.
Garnish with nutmeg and cinnamon.
recipes.text: House'S Egg Nog(Low Fat Version). Mix ingredients in food processor. Garnish with nutmeg and cinnamon.

recipes.title: Frijoles Negros(Spanish For Black Beans)
directions: Wash beans thoroughly then soak black beans and one green pepper in 10 cups water in large pot.
When the beans are plump, cook mixture for approximately 45 minutes or until soft.
recipes.text: Frijoles Negros(Spanish For Black Beans). Wash beans thoroughly then soak black beans and one green pepper in 10 cups water in large pot. When the beans are plump, cook mixture for approximately 45 minutes or until soft.

recipes.title: Candy'S Old Fashion Banana Pudding
ingredients: 2 large boxes vanilla cook and serve pudding and pie filling
directions: About 1 hour ahead, separate egg whites from yolk, set aside.
recipes.text: Candy'S Old Fashion Banana Pudding. About 1 hour ahead, separate egg whites from yolk, set aside.

recipes.title: Cheese Vegetable Chowder
directions: In Dutch oven or large saucepan, melt margarine; add cabbage, onions, celery, carrots and peas.
Saute for 8 to 10 minutes or until crisp-tender.
Add corn, milk, salt, pepper and thyme. Reduce heat and simmer for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally; add cheese and stir until melted.
Makes six 1 1/3 cup servings.
recipes.text: Cheese Vegetable Chowder. In Dutch oven or large saucepan, melt margarine; add cabbage, onions, celery, carrots and peas. Saute for 8 to 10 minutes or until crisp-tender. Add corn, milk, salt, pepper and thyme. Reduce heat and simmer for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally; add cheese and stir until melted. Makes six 1 1/3 cup servings.

recipes.title: Applesauce Loaf
directions: Cream butter and sugar until light.
Beat in egg.
Stir together dry ingredients.
Gradually add to creamed mixture.
Beat applesauce into batter.
Stir in raisins and nuts.
Pour into greased and floured 9 x 5-inch loaf pan.
Bake for 1 hour at 350°. Cool in pan 10 minutes.
Remove from pan.
Cool on wire rack. Sprinkle with confectioners sugar.
Makes 1 loaf.
recipes.text: Applesauce Loaf. Cream butter and sugar until light. Beat in egg. Stir together dry ingredients. Gradually add to creamed mixture. Beat applesauce into batter. Stir in raisins and nuts. Pour into greased and floured 9 x 5-inch loaf pan. Bake for 1 hour at 350°. Cool in pan 10 minutes. Remove from pan. Cool on wire rack. Sprinkle with confectioners sugar. Makes 1 loaf.

recipes.title: Harvard Beets
directions: In saucepan, cook onion in butter until tender.
Add sugar and flour to saucepan.
Stir in vinegar and beet liquid until there are no lumps.
Cook over medium heat until thickened, stirring constantly.
Add beets; salt to taste.
Heat.
recipes.text: Harvard Beets. In saucepan, cook onion in butter until tender. Add sugar and flour to saucepan. Stir in vinegar and beet liquid until there are no lumps. Cook over medium heat until thickened, stirring constantly. Add beets; salt to taste. Heat.

recipes.title: Banana Bread
directions: Mix sugar, eggs, bananas and butter, then add salt, soda and cinnamon.
Mix well, then add flour.
Mix well.
Bake in greased loaf pan at 350° for 35 to 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Banana Bread. Mix sugar, eggs, bananas and butter, then add salt, soda and cinnamon. Mix well, then add flour. Mix well. Bake in greased loaf pan at 350° for 35 to 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Apple Butter
directions: Combine and cook slow for abut 1 1/2 hours until dark and thick.
Put in hot jars and seal.
recipes.text: Apple Butter. Combine and cook slow for abut 1 1/2 hours until dark and thick. Put in hot jars and seal.

recipes.title: Angel Biscuits
directions: Mix yeast, water and sugar.
Let rest 10 minutes.
Sift dry ingredients together.
Cut shortening into flour mixture.
Add just enough extra flour to roll out.
Roll into 1/2-inch thickness.
Cut into circles and place in greased 9 x 13-inch baking pans.
Brush with melted butter and let rise for 30 minutes.
Bake at 425° for 10 to 12 minutes or until done.
Yields 2 dozen.
recipes.text: Angel Biscuits. Mix yeast, water and sugar. Let rest 10 minutes. Sift dry ingredients together. Cut shortening into flour mixture. Add just enough extra flour to roll out. Roll into 1/2-inch thickness. Cut into circles and place in greased 9 x 13-inch baking pans. Brush with melted butter and let rise for 30 minutes. Bake at 425° for 10 to 12 minutes or until done. Yields 2 dozen.

recipes.title: Deviled Eggs
directions: Boil eggs in pot of salted water 15 minutes.
Drain eggs.
Let cool.
Cut eggs in half lengthwise.
Remove egg yolks.
Mash them together with the remaining ingredients except paprika.
Spoon mixture into egg whites.
Sprinkle top of eggs with paprika.
recipes.text: Deviled Eggs. Boil eggs in pot of salted water 15 minutes. Drain eggs. Let cool. Cut eggs in half lengthwise. Remove egg yolks. Mash them together with the remaining ingredients except paprika. Spoon mixture into egg whites. Sprinkle top of eggs with paprika.

recipes.title: Sweet Potato Casserole
ingredients: 4 to 6 c. cooked, mashed sweet potatoes (or substitute 2 large cans of yams, drained and mashed)
1/3 to 1/2 c. margarine, cut into slices or patties
directions: Mix together potatoes, white sugar, salt, eggs, margarine and vanilla and spread into shallow baking dish.
Mix together brown sugar, flour and pecans; sprinkle over potato mixture and dot with patties of butter or margarine (approximately 1/3 to 1/2 cup). Bake at 350 degrees for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Sweet Potato Casserole. Mix together potatoes, white sugar, salt, eggs, margarine and vanilla and spread into shallow baking dish. Mix together brown sugar, flour and pecans; sprinkle over potato mixture and dot with patties of butter or margarine (approximately 1/3 to 1/2 cup). Bake at 350 degrees for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Wedding Punch
directions: Mix chilled ingredients.
Pour into punch bowl with decorated ice mold.
recipes.text: Wedding Punch. Mix chilled ingredients. Pour into punch bowl with decorated ice mold.

recipes.title: Jean Sanders' Pumpkin Nut Bread
directions: Mix first seven dry ingredients well, saving a little flour to sprinkle over nuts and raisins.
Make a well in center of dry ingredients.
Into the well, add oil, eggs, water and pumpkin. Mix well, then add nuts and raisins.
Mix well and pour into 3 loaf pans or 6 small greased and floured pans.
Bake in preheated 350° oven for 40 to 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Jean Sanders' Pumpkin Nut Bread. Mix first seven dry ingredients well, saving a little flour to sprinkle over nuts and raisins. Make a well in center of dry ingredients. Into the well, add oil, eggs, water and pumpkin. Mix well, then add nuts and raisins. Mix well and pour into 3 loaf pans or 6 small greased and floured pans. Bake in preheated 350° oven for 40 to 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Cheese And Sausage Snacks
directions: Mix together and shape into balls. Freeze. When required, bake in oven at 450° for 10 to 15 minutes.
recipes.text: Cheese And Sausage Snacks. Mix together and shape into balls. Freeze. When required, bake in oven at 450° for 10 to 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Grilled Chicken Breasts
directions: Marinate chicken overnight.
Brush with olive oil before grilling.
recipes.text: Grilled Chicken Breasts. Marinate chicken overnight. Brush with olive oil before grilling.

recipes.title: Virginia Corn Relish
directions: Combine vinegar, sugar, celery seed, mustard seed and Tabasco sauce, mixing well.
Bring to a boil and boil 2 minutes or until sugar dissolves.
Remove from heat; stir in corn, green pepper, onion and pimiento.
Refrigerate in airtight container for 48 hours.
recipes.text: Virginia Corn Relish. Combine vinegar, sugar, celery seed, mustard seed and Tabasco sauce, mixing well. Bring to a boil and boil 2 minutes or until sugar dissolves. Remove from heat; stir in corn, green pepper, onion and pimiento. Refrigerate in airtight container for 48 hours.

recipes.title: Daretown Presbyterian Church Oyster Pie
directions: Hard-boil 3 eggs.
Slice and lay in bottom of 9-inch pie crust. Chop up boiled potatoes.
Put dots of butter on potatoes.
Pour in oysters to fill pie.
Cover with top crust.
Prick top of pie crust before baking.
Bake 1 hour at 375° in 9-inch pie plate.
Make a thin White Sauce using 2 tablespoons oyster juice mixed in milk. Bottled clam juice can be used if oysters don't have enough juice. Pour hot White Sauce over hot pie to serve.
recipes.text: Daretown Presbyterian Church Oyster Pie. Hard-boil 3 eggs. Slice and lay in bottom of 9-inch pie crust. Chop up boiled potatoes. Put dots of butter on potatoes. Pour in oysters to fill pie. Cover with top crust. Prick top of pie crust before baking. Bake 1 hour at 375° in 9-inch pie plate. Make a thin White Sauce using 2 tablespoons oyster juice mixed in milk. Bottled clam juice can be used if oysters don't have enough juice. Pour hot White Sauce over hot pie to serve.

recipes.title: Grape Macaroon Salad
directions: Dissolve jello, sugar and salt in boiling water.
Chill until thickened.	Blend in remaining ingredients.
Chill until firm.
recipes.text: Grape Macaroon Salad. Dissolve jello, sugar and salt in boiling water. Chill until thickened.	Blend in remaining ingredients. Chill until firm.

recipes.title: Italian Wedding Soup
directions: Wash spinach and chop in small pieces.
Cook in small amount of water until barely soft.
Drain and press out all water.
Cook pastina.
Heat broth until boiling.
recipes.text: Italian Wedding Soup. Wash spinach and chop in small pieces. Cook in small amount of water until barely soft. Drain and press out all water. Cook pastina. Heat broth until boiling.

recipes.title: Steak Sauce
ingredients: 3 cubes beef bouillon (with 3 c. hot water or 1 can beef bouillon)
directions: In a skillet, brown chopped onion in a little butter.
Add beef bouillon.
Simmer.
Add garlic seasoning, salt, pepper and drained mushrooms.
Add Worcestershire sauce.
Add flour (the old-fashioned way:
add some hot liquid from skillet to the flour in a cup; when flour and liquid are a thin and smooth consistency, add to skillet mixture).
Add red wine.
Makes 2 to 3 cups of sauce, enough for 8 steaks.
recipes.text: Steak Sauce. In a skillet, brown chopped onion in a little butter. Add beef bouillon. Simmer. Add garlic seasoning, salt, pepper and drained mushrooms. Add Worcestershire sauce. Add flour (the old-fashioned way: add some hot liquid from skillet to the flour in a cup; when flour and liquid are a thin and smooth consistency, add to skillet mixture). Add red wine. Makes 2 to 3 cups of sauce, enough for 8 steaks.

recipes.title: Chicken And Broccoli Casserole
ingredients: 1 pkg. frozen broccoli, cooked and drained
directions: Make a white sauce.
Put in broiler until browned at 350°, 10 to 15 minutes.
recipes.text: Chicken And Broccoli Casserole. Make a white sauce. Put in broiler until browned at 350°, 10 to 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Chicken Broccoli Orientale
ingredients: 1 lb. skinless chicken, cut into strips
1 medium bell pepper or sweet red pepper
1 (10 1/4 oz.) can cream of broccoli soup
directions: In a 10-inch skillet over medium-high heat in hot oil, cook chicken, half at a time, until browned.
Add onion and pepper; cook about 5 minutes, until vegetables are tender-crisp.
Stir in soup, water and soy sauce.
Heat to boiling.
Reduce heat to low. Cover; simmer for 5 minutes.
Serve over rice.
recipes.text: Chicken Broccoli Orientale. In a 10-inch skillet over medium-high heat in hot oil, cook chicken, half at a time, until browned. Add onion and pepper; cook about 5 minutes, until vegetables are tender-crisp. Stir in soup, water and soy sauce. Heat to boiling. Reduce heat to low. Cover; simmer for 5 minutes. Serve over rice.

recipes.title: Date Cake
directions: Mix all ingredients.
Bake at 350° for 50 minutes.
Can be frosted with powdered sugar icing or your favorite icing.
recipes.text: Date Cake. Mix all ingredients. Bake at 350° for 50 minutes. Can be frosted with powdered sugar icing or your favorite icing.

recipes.title: Hush Puppies
directions: Mix all ingredients well.
Drop by spoonfuls into hot oil. Cook until browned.
recipes.text: Hush Puppies. Mix all ingredients well. Drop by spoonfuls into hot oil. Cook until browned.

recipes.title: Coconut Icebox Cake
directions: Prepare and bake cake mix according to package directions using a 13 x 9-inch pan. Mix the sugar and milk and bring to a boil. Stir in 1 package coconut and then pour over the cake while it's still hot. Cover cake tightly until cool.
When cool, spread whipped topping over cake and sprinkle with other package of coconut.
Cover tightly and refrigerate.
recipes.text: Coconut Icebox Cake. Prepare and bake cake mix according to package directions using a 13 x 9-inch pan. Mix the sugar and milk and bring to a boil. Stir in 1 package coconut and then pour over the cake while it's still hot. Cover cake tightly until cool. When cool, spread whipped topping over cake and sprinkle with other package of coconut. Cover tightly and refrigerate.

recipes.title: Salad Dressing Chocolate Cake
directions: Beat all ingredients, mixing well.
Bake in moderate (350°) oven for 30 to 40 minutes.
recipes.text: Salad Dressing Chocolate Cake. Beat all ingredients, mixing well. Bake in moderate (350°) oven for 30 to 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Wanda'S Lasagna
directions: Boil noodles until done.
Brown hamburger meat.
In a large bowl, combine hamburger meat, Ragu sauce, sour cream, cottage cheese, salt and garlic powder.
recipes.text: Wanda'S Lasagna. Boil noodles until done. Brown hamburger meat. In a large bowl, combine hamburger meat, Ragu sauce, sour cream, cottage cheese, salt and garlic powder.

recipes.title: Moon Cake
directions: Mix water and margarine together.
Bring to a boil. Add flour all at once and stir rapidly until mixture forms a ball.
Remove from heat and cool a little while.
Beat in eggs, one at a time, beating well with spoon or mixer.
Spread on ungreased cookie sheet, 11 x 15-inches.
Bake at 400° for 30 minutes.
Cool.
(It will look like the moon's surface, all lumpy and bumpy, that's why it's called Moon Cake!)
Don't prick, leave cake as is.
recipes.text: Moon Cake. Mix water and margarine together. Bring to a boil. Add flour all at once and stir rapidly until mixture forms a ball. Remove from heat and cool a little while. Beat in eggs, one at a time, beating well with spoon or mixer. Spread on ungreased cookie sheet, 11 x 15-inches. Bake at 400° for 30 minutes. Cool. (It will look like the moon's surface, all lumpy and bumpy, that's why it's called Moon Cake!) Don't prick, leave cake as is.

recipes.title: Peppermint Pie
directions: Heat milk and marshmallows (halved) and a little salt.
Let melt, then cool.
Crush cookies and add enough melted margarine to hold cookies together.
Press or pat cookies to form a crust into the pie plate.
Add a few drops of food coloring to milk and marshmallows, then peppermint extract, taste and add more, if desired.
Add the whipped cream and pour into pie crust slowly. Return to refrigerator until set.
Serve with whipped cream on top or evenly spread whipped cream over the whole top.
recipes.text: Peppermint Pie. Heat milk and marshmallows (halved) and a little salt. Let melt, then cool. Crush cookies and add enough melted margarine to hold cookies together. Press or pat cookies to form a crust into the pie plate. Add a few drops of food coloring to milk and marshmallows, then peppermint extract, taste and add more, if desired. Add the whipped cream and pour into pie crust slowly. Return to refrigerator until set. Serve with whipped cream on top or evenly spread whipped cream over the whole top.

recipes.title: Perky Pecans
directions: Beat egg whites and water until frosty.
Add pecans and coat well.
Mix sugar, salt and cinnamon in a bowl.
Add nuts and mix. Bake in a jelly roll pan at 225° for 1 hour, stirring every 15 minutes.
recipes.text: Perky Pecans. Beat egg whites and water until frosty. Add pecans and coat well. Mix sugar, salt and cinnamon in a bowl. Add nuts and mix. Bake in a jelly roll pan at 225° for 1 hour, stirring every 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Lemon Squares
directions: Mix the first 3 ingredients well and pat into an 8 1/2 x 11-inch pan.
Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.
recipes.text: Lemon Squares. Mix the first 3 ingredients well and pat into an 8 1/2 x 11-inch pan. Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Unbaked Chocolate Cookies
directions: Bring sugar, butter and milk to a boil; remove from heat immediately.
Add oats, coconut, salt and chocolate.
Mix.
Drop by teaspoons on waxed paper.
(If batter is too sticky, add more oats until it is the correct consistency.)
Cool.
No baking needed!
recipes.text: Unbaked Chocolate Cookies. Bring sugar, butter and milk to a boil; remove from heat immediately. Add oats, coconut, salt and chocolate. Mix. Drop by teaspoons on waxed paper. (If batter is too sticky, add more oats until it is the correct consistency.) Cool. No baking needed!

recipes.title: Baked Bananas
directions: Spread melted butter and lemon juice over bottom of shallow baking dish that will hold 6 bananas. Stir butter and lemon juice together until blended. Turn bananas in dish until well coated with butter mixture. Put sugar and cinnamon in small bowl and stir with fork to blend thoroughly. Sprinkle sugar mixture evenly over bananas. Bake at 375° until butter begins to bubble, 18 to 20 minutes. Turn bananas over once after 10 minutes. Sprinkle coconut over bananas about 5 minutes before they finish cooking. Makes 6 servings.
recipes.text: Baked Bananas. Spread melted butter and lemon juice over bottom of shallow baking dish that will hold 6 bananas. Stir butter and lemon juice together until blended. Turn bananas in dish until well coated with butter mixture. Put sugar and cinnamon in small bowl and stir with fork to blend thoroughly. Sprinkle sugar mixture evenly over bananas. Bake at 375° until butter begins to bubble, 18 to 20 minutes. Turn bananas over once after 10 minutes. Sprinkle coconut over bananas about 5 minutes before they finish cooking. Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Buffalo Wings
directions: Cut wing tips off at joint and discard; cut each wing in half at joint.
On rack in broiler pan, arrange wings.
Broil 6-inches from heat for 25 minutes or until browned, turning occasionally. Transfer to serving dish.
recipes.text: Buffalo Wings. Cut wing tips off at joint and discard; cut each wing in half at joint. On rack in broiler pan, arrange wings. Broil 6-inches from heat for 25 minutes or until browned, turning occasionally. Transfer to serving dish.

recipes.title: Tea Cake
directions: Mix eggs, sugar, soda, cream of tartar and butter; use 4 cups flour.
Knead well; roll thin and bake in 350° oven quickly.
recipes.text: Tea Cake. Mix eggs, sugar, soda, cream of tartar and butter; use 4 cups flour. Knead well; roll thin and bake in 350° oven quickly.

recipes.title: Peanut Brittle
directions: Grease baking sheet.
In heavy 3-quart saucepan, stir together corn syrup, sugar, water and margarine.
Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly until sugar is dissolved and mixture comes to a boil.
Continue cooking, without stirring, until temperature reaches 280° on candy thermometer or until small amount dropped into very cold water separates into threads which are hard, but not brittle.
Gradually stir in peanuts; continue cooking, stirring frequently until temperature reaches 300°.
Remove from heat; stir in baking soda.
Immediately pour mixture onto baking sheet. Spread mixture evenly to edges of sheet.
Cool.
Makes about 1 1/2 pounds.
recipes.text: Peanut Brittle. Grease baking sheet. In heavy 3-quart saucepan, stir together corn syrup, sugar, water and margarine. Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly until sugar is dissolved and mixture comes to a boil. Continue cooking, without stirring, until temperature reaches 280° on candy thermometer or until small amount dropped into very cold water separates into threads which are hard, but not brittle. Gradually stir in peanuts; continue cooking, stirring frequently until temperature reaches 300°. Remove from heat; stir in baking soda. Immediately pour mixture onto baking sheet. Spread mixture evenly to edges of sheet. Cool. Makes about 1 1/2 pounds.

recipes.title: Cheesy Green Bean Casserole(Club Member: Lee Ann Mcraney)
directions: Cook bacon. Reserve 1/4 cup drippings. Cook beans 10 minutes with drippings; drain. Add pepper and onions to beans. Mix lightly. Add mushrooms. Spoon into serving dish.
Microwave cheese spread; pour over beans. Sprinkle with bacon and bake at 350°.
recipes.text: Cheesy Green Bean Casserole(Club Member: Lee Ann Mcraney). Cook bacon. Reserve 1/4 cup drippings. Cook beans 10 minutes with drippings; drain. Add pepper and onions to beans. Mix lightly. Add mushrooms. Spoon into serving dish. Microwave cheese spread; pour over beans. Sprinkle with bacon and bake at 350°.

recipes.title: Lemon Filling
directions: Beat all together and boil until thick in a double boiler. Spread between layers of cake.
Put grated rind in batter.
Makes filling for 3 layers.
recipes.text: Lemon Filling. Beat all together and boil until thick in a double boiler. Spread between layers of cake. Put grated rind in batter. Makes filling for 3 layers.

recipes.title: Cooked Play Dough
directions: Combine all ingredients in a saucepan.
Cook over medium heat. Stir constantly until mixture forms a ball.
Knead until smooth. Store in covered container.
recipes.text: Cooked Play Dough. Combine all ingredients in a saucepan. Cook over medium heat. Stir constantly until mixture forms a ball. Knead until smooth. Store in covered container.

recipes.title: Special Lamb Roast
directions: You will also need cheesecloth.
recipes.text: Special Lamb Roast. You will also need cheesecloth.

recipes.title: Broccoli Casserole
directions: Layer in order given in casserole dish.
Bake in 350° oven for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Broccoli Casserole. Layer in order given in casserole dish. Bake in 350° oven for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Florentine Turkey Or Chicken
ingredients: 2 c. cooked turkey or chicken chunks
directions: Early In The Day:
Cook spinach as label directs. Drain well. Arrange in a 1 1/2-quart casserole.
recipes.text: Florentine Turkey Or Chicken. Early In The Day: Cook spinach as label directs. Drain well. Arrange in a 1 1/2-quart casserole.

recipes.title: John Mazetti
directions: Saute together ground beef, onions and green pepper.
Add mushrooms, soup, noodles and cream cheese. Mix well and put into a large casserole.
Sprinkle cheese on top and bake one hour, uncovered, at 350°.
Serves 8 to 12.
recipes.text: John Mazetti. Saute together ground beef, onions and green pepper. Add mushrooms, soup, noodles and cream cheese. Mix well and put into a large casserole. Sprinkle cheese on top and bake one hour, uncovered, at 350°. Serves 8 to 12.

recipes.title: Bridal Punch
directions: All ingredients must be at room temperature when mixing. Freeze until ready to serve in a plastic jug.
Needs to thaw approximately 4 hours before ready to serve.
recipes.text: Bridal Punch. All ingredients must be at room temperature when mixing. Freeze until ready to serve in a plastic jug. Needs to thaw approximately 4 hours before ready to serve.

recipes.title: Raisin Bran Muffins
directions: Mix all dry ingredients and add remaining.
Bake in muffin pan for 20 minutes at 400°.
Batter will keep 5 to 6 weeks in refrigerator; just use it as you need it.
recipes.text: Raisin Bran Muffins. Mix all dry ingredients and add remaining. Bake in muffin pan for 20 minutes at 400°. Batter will keep 5 to 6 weeks in refrigerator; just use it as you need it.

recipes.title: Vegetable Christmas Tree
ingredients: whatever other vegetables are in season you like
directions: Cut all vegetables into chunks.
Place wooden picks in cut vegetables.
Arrange in cone from bottom up.
Arrange remainder of vegetables around base in plate.
Serve with low-calorie dip.
recipes.text: Vegetable Christmas Tree. Cut all vegetables into chunks. Place wooden picks in cut vegetables. Arrange in cone from bottom up. Arrange remainder of vegetables around base in plate. Serve with low-calorie dip.

recipes.title: Easy Fruit Cobbler
directions: Cream together oleo, flour and sugar.
Alternate layers of fruit and mixture.
Bake at 350° until brown.
recipes.text: Easy Fruit Cobbler. Cream together oleo, flour and sugar. Alternate layers of fruit and mixture. Bake at 350° until brown.

recipes.title: Buttermilk Biscuits
directions: Combine flour, baking powder, soda, salt and sugar.
Cut in 2/3 cup margarine until mixture resembles coarse meal.
Add buttermilk, stirring until dry ingredients are moistened.
Turn dough out onto a lightly floured surface; knead lightly 4 or 5 times.
Roll dough to 3/4-inch thick; cut with a biscuit cutter. Place biscuits on a lightly greased baking sheet; brush tops with melted margarine.
Bake at 450° for 15 minutes.
Yields 15 biscuits.
recipes.text: Buttermilk Biscuits. Combine flour, baking powder, soda, salt and sugar. Cut in 2/3 cup margarine until mixture resembles coarse meal. Add buttermilk, stirring until dry ingredients are moistened. Turn dough out onto a lightly floured surface; knead lightly 4 or 5 times. Roll dough to 3/4-inch thick; cut with a biscuit cutter. Place biscuits on a lightly greased baking sheet; brush tops with melted margarine. Bake at 450° for 15 minutes. Yields 15 biscuits.

recipes.title: Sinfully Delicious Pink Fluff
directions: Mix cream cheese and sugar until creamy. Beat in 1 tub Cool Whip. Pour over cooled crust and smooth evenly. Drain 1 package thawed frozen strawberries and put on top of mixture. Smooth another 8-ounce container of Cool Whip over top.
recipes.text: Sinfully Delicious Pink Fluff. Mix cream cheese and sugar until creamy. Beat in 1 tub Cool Whip. Pour over cooled crust and smooth evenly. Drain 1 package thawed frozen strawberries and put on top of mixture. Smooth another 8-ounce container of Cool Whip over top.

recipes.title: Raw Relish
directions: Mix vinegar, sugar, celery seed, mustard seed and salt, stirring occasionally.
Mix the rest in the vinegar mixture.
Let stand 3 or 4 hours.
recipes.text: Raw Relish. Mix vinegar, sugar, celery seed, mustard seed and salt, stirring occasionally. Mix the rest in the vinegar mixture. Let stand 3 or 4 hours.

recipes.title: Pineapple-Carrot Bread
directions: Sift dry ingredients; add other ingredients as given. Line bottom of 2 large loaf pans with waxed paper. Bake 1 hour in 325° oven.
recipes.text: Pineapple-Carrot Bread. Sift dry ingredients; add other ingredients as given. Line bottom of 2 large loaf pans with waxed paper. Bake 1 hour in 325° oven.

recipes.title: Funnel Cake
directions: Combine eggs and milk.
Sift together dry ingredients.
Mix with egg and milk until smooth.
Must be liquid enough to flow through a funnel.
If too thick, add more milk.
If too thin, add flour.
recipes.text: Funnel Cake. Combine eggs and milk. Sift together dry ingredients. Mix with egg and milk until smooth. Must be liquid enough to flow through a funnel. If too thick, add more milk. If too thin, add flour.

recipes.title: Curried Chicken And Broccoli
directions: Line casserole dish with thawed broccoli and arrange chicken over it.
Mix together soup, mayonnaise, curry powder and lemon juice.
Pour over chicken and broccoli.
Mix bread crumbs with melted butter and spread over the top.
Sprinkle grated cheese on bread crumbs.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
Recipe can be doubled.
recipes.text: Curried Chicken And Broccoli. Line casserole dish with thawed broccoli and arrange chicken over it. Mix together soup, mayonnaise, curry powder and lemon juice. Pour over chicken and broccoli. Mix bread crumbs with melted butter and spread over the top. Sprinkle grated cheese on bread crumbs. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes. Recipe can be doubled.

recipes.title: Heavenly Dip
directions: Combine first 5 ingredients.
Cook over medium heat until smooth and thick.
Cool completely.
Fold in whipped cream. Delicious with fresh fruit.
recipes.text: Heavenly Dip. Combine first 5 ingredients. Cook over medium heat until smooth and thick. Cool completely. Fold in whipped cream. Delicious with fresh fruit.

recipes.title: Taco Plate For Two
directions: In a skillet, cook beef and onions over medium heat until meat is no longer pink.
Drain.
Stir in taco sauce, chilies and salt. Cover and cook over medium-low heat for 6 to 8 minutes or until heated through.
Spoon over chips.
Sprinkle with cheese Yield:
2 servings.
recipes.text: Taco Plate For Two. In a skillet, cook beef and onions over medium heat until meat is no longer pink. Drain. Stir in taco sauce, chilies and salt. Cover and cook over medium-low heat for 6 to 8 minutes or until heated through. Spoon over chips. Sprinkle with cheese Yield: 2 servings.

recipes.title: Chicken Curry Casserole
ingredients: 1 1/2 lb. chicken breasts, cooked and cut in bite-size pieces
directions: Cook rice according to directions; spread in bottom of large baking dish. Cover with frozen peas.
In separate bowl, combine soups, mayonnaise and curry powder; then spread 1/2 this mixture over peas.
Next, place chicken pieces in dish.
Spread remaining mixture over top.
Sprinkle cheese and bake in 375° oven until heated through, about 45 minutes to 1 hour.
Great dish to make ahead of time and freeze.
Serves 8.
recipes.text: Chicken Curry Casserole. Cook rice according to directions; spread in bottom of large baking dish. Cover with frozen peas. In separate bowl, combine soups, mayonnaise and curry powder; then spread 1/2 this mixture over peas. Next, place chicken pieces in dish. Spread remaining mixture over top. Sprinkle cheese and bake in 375° oven until heated through, about 45 minutes to 1 hour. Great dish to make ahead of time and freeze. Serves 8.

recipes.title: Cinnamon Fluff
directions: In large bowl, mix ingredients together.
After in the pan, cover top with brown sugar and cinnamon and dot with butter.
Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.
A quick breakfast treat.
recipes.text: Cinnamon Fluff. In large bowl, mix ingredients together. After in the pan, cover top with brown sugar and cinnamon and dot with butter. Bake at 350° for 25 minutes. A quick breakfast treat.

recipes.title: Super Bowl Brunch
ingredients: Little Sizzlers (sausage or ham), pinched into pieces
onions, green onions, peppers and mushrooms (optional)
directions: Lightly butter a 9 x 13-inch casserole dish.
Lay rolls in the bottom and flatten.
Mix eggs, salt, pepper and milk to suit your taste (like an omelette); pour mixture over rolls.
Drop meat into egg mixture and sprinkle cheese on tops.
Bake at 350° for 35 to 45 minutes, until firm.
recipes.text: Super Bowl Brunch. Lightly butter a 9 x 13-inch casserole dish. Lay rolls in the bottom and flatten. Mix eggs, salt, pepper and milk to suit your taste (like an omelette); pour mixture over rolls. Drop meat into egg mixture and sprinkle cheese on tops. Bake at 350° for 35 to 45 minutes, until firm.

recipes.title: Crunchy Mingle Mix
ingredients: 2 1/2 c. pretzel sticks or small rings
1 (1 oz.) pkg. dry Ranch salad dressing mix
directions: In a large microwave-safe bowl, combine cereal, crackers and pretzels.
Pour oil over mixture and stir until coated.
Heat in microwave on High for 1 minute.
Pour dressing in a 2-gallon storage bag.
Add cereal mixture and close securely.
Gently shake bag until cereal is evenly coated with dressing.
Store in airtight container.
recipes.text: Crunchy Mingle Mix. In a large microwave-safe bowl, combine cereal, crackers and pretzels. Pour oil over mixture and stir until coated. Heat in microwave on High for 1 minute. Pour dressing in a 2-gallon storage bag. Add cereal mixture and close securely. Gently shake bag until cereal is evenly coated with dressing. Store in airtight container.

recipes.title: Nutty Rice
ingredients: salt and black pepper to taste
directions: Saute green pepper and onion in butter.
Press this into 8 x 12-inch casserole dish.
Add to this the can of beef consomme and beef bouillon.
With one of the empty cans, add 1 can of water, 1 cup rice, salt, pepper and 1 package of slivered almonds.
Stir mixture together.
Bake in a covered dish for 1 hour at 350°. Serves 8.
recipes.text: Nutty Rice. Saute green pepper and onion in butter. Press this into 8 x 12-inch casserole dish. Add to this the can of beef consomme and beef bouillon. With one of the empty cans, add 1 can of water, 1 cup rice, salt, pepper and 1 package of slivered almonds. Stir mixture together. Bake in a covered dish for 1 hour at 350°. Serves 8.

recipes.title: Nutty Peach Crisp
ingredients: 1 pkg. Betty Crocker butter pecan (dry) cake mix
directions: Layer all ingredients in ungreased 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan.
Bake 55 to 60 minutes at 325°.
Let stand at least for 15 minutes.
Top with whipped cream or ice cream.
recipes.text: Nutty Peach Crisp. Layer all ingredients in ungreased 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Bake 55 to 60 minutes at 325°. Let stand at least for 15 minutes. Top with whipped cream or ice cream.

recipes.title: Key Lime Pie
directions: Combine egg, yolks and milk.
Slowly add the lime juice. Pour into a baked pastry shell.
Chill for 4 hours in the freezer. Before serving, top with whip cream or meringue.
recipes.text: Key Lime Pie. Combine egg, yolks and milk. Slowly add the lime juice. Pour into a baked pastry shell. Chill for 4 hours in the freezer. Before serving, top with whip cream or meringue.

recipes.title: Tasty Chow Chow
directions: Mix and cook 20 minutes.
One or two hot peppers can be added. Makes 11 or 12 pints.
recipes.text: Tasty Chow Chow. Mix and cook 20 minutes. One or two hot peppers can be added. Makes 11 or 12 pints.

recipes.title: Coconut-Pecan Frosting
ingredients: 2 c. walnut or pecans, chopped fine
directions: Combine evaporated milk, sugar, egg yolks, margarine and vanilla in saucepan.
Cook and stir over medium heat until thick. Remove from heat.
Stir in coconut and chopped nuts.
Cool until thick enough to spread.
recipes.text: Coconut-Pecan Frosting. Combine evaporated milk, sugar, egg yolks, margarine and vanilla in saucepan. Cook and stir over medium heat until thick. Remove from heat. Stir in coconut and chopped nuts. Cool until thick enough to spread.

recipes.title: Microwave Pecan Brittle
directions: In a 2-quart glass dish or bowl, combine sugar, syrup and salt.
Cover and microwave on High for 4 minutes.
Add pecans and stir.
Cover and microwave on High for another 4 minutes.
Stir in vanilla and butter.
Add baking soda and stir quickly.
Pour onto greased cookie sheet and spread evenly.
Allow to cool, then break into pieces.
recipes.text: Microwave Pecan Brittle. In a 2-quart glass dish or bowl, combine sugar, syrup and salt. Cover and microwave on High for 4 minutes. Add pecans and stir. Cover and microwave on High for another 4 minutes. Stir in vanilla and butter. Add baking soda and stir quickly. Pour onto greased cookie sheet and spread evenly. Allow to cool, then break into pieces.

recipes.title: Mississippi Fried Chicken
directions: In colander, rinse chicken; salt and pepper and let stand to drain.
In plastic bag, combine flour, salt, pepper and baking powder.
Shake chicken in mixture until well coated.
Refrigerate for 6 hours; put 1-inch of cooking oil in skillet.
Cook on medium to high heat.
recipes.text: Mississippi Fried Chicken. In colander, rinse chicken; salt and pepper and let stand to drain. In plastic bag, combine flour, salt, pepper and baking powder. Shake chicken in mixture until well coated. Refrigerate for 6 hours; put 1-inch of cooking oil in skillet. Cook on medium to high heat.

recipes.title: Mandarin Orange Cake
directions: Combine first 4 ingredients; beat for 30 seconds on low speed, then medium speed for 2 minutes.
Pour batter into two 9-inch greased cake pans.
Bake for 30 minutes or until toothpick comes out clean.
Cool pans for 10 minutes; remove from pans and cool on the wire rack.
Mix together the pudding and the pineapple; stir 2 minutes.
Mix in Cool Whip and then frost the cake; keep refrigerated.
recipes.text: Mandarin Orange Cake. Combine first 4 ingredients; beat for 30 seconds on low speed, then medium speed for 2 minutes. Pour batter into two 9-inch greased cake pans.
