Bake for 30 minutes or until toothpick comes out clean. Cool pans for 10 minutes; remove from pans and cool on the wire rack. Mix together the pudding and the pineapple; stir 2 minutes. Mix in Cool Whip and then frost the cake; keep refrigerated.

recipes.title: Easy Chicken Divan
directions: Cook broccoli in boiling, salted water until tender.
Drain. Arrange stalks in a greased 10 x 10-inch baking dish.
Place chicken on top.
recipes.text: Easy Chicken Divan. Cook broccoli in boiling, salted water until tender. Drain. Arrange stalks in a greased 10 x 10-inch baking dish. Place chicken on top.

recipes.title: Brown Sugar Squash
directions: Clean squash and cut in half.
Clean out seeds with a spoon. Remove stem.
Fill a 13 x 9-inch baking dish with 1/4 cup water. Place squash upside-down in pan.
Bake at 350° for 1/2 hour. While squash is baking, melt butter in pan.
Stir in brown sugar, salt and nutmeg.
Leave mixture on low heat until 1/2 hour is up. Take out squash, turn them right side up and fill them with butter mixture.
Place squash back in oven for 1/2 hour.
recipes.text: Brown Sugar Squash. Clean squash and cut in half. Clean out seeds with a spoon. Remove stem. Fill a 13 x 9-inch baking dish with 1/4 cup water. Place squash upside-down in pan. Bake at 350° for 1/2 hour. While squash is baking, melt butter in pan. Stir in brown sugar, salt and nutmeg. Leave mixture on low heat until 1/2 hour is up. Take out squash, turn them right side up and fill them with butter mixture. Place squash back in oven for 1/2 hour.

recipes.title: Mashed Potato Casserole
directions: Cover potatoes with water and boil until tender; drain well. Mash potatoes and stir in salad dressing, softened cream cheese and onion flakes.
Mix well and add salt and pepper to taste.
Spoon into casserole dish that has been sprayed with Pam.
Sprinkle paprika over potatoes and bake at 350° for 1 hour.
May be prepared and frozen for future use.
recipes.text: Mashed Potato Casserole. Cover potatoes with water and boil until tender; drain well. Mash potatoes and stir in salad dressing, softened cream cheese and onion flakes. Mix well and add salt and pepper to taste. Spoon into casserole dish that has been sprayed with Pam. Sprinkle paprika over potatoes and bake at 350° for 1 hour. May be prepared and frozen for future use.

recipes.title: Jean Walsh'S Crumb Cake
ingredients: 1 box Duncan Hines yellow cake mix
directions: Prepare the cake mix as directed on box.
Add vanilla.
Pour into 12 x 18-inch greased and floured pan and bake for 20 minutes at 350°.
recipes.text: Jean Walsh'S Crumb Cake. Prepare the cake mix as directed on box. Add vanilla. Pour into 12 x 18-inch greased and floured pan and bake for 20 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Pecan Pie
directions: Heat oven to 375°.
Prepare pastry.
Beat eggs, sugar, salt, margarine and corn syrup with mixer.
Stir in pecans.
Pour into pastry shell.
Bake 40 to 50 minutes, or until set.
Cool slightly.
Serve warm or refrigerate.
recipes.text: Pecan Pie. Heat oven to 375°. Prepare pastry. Beat eggs, sugar, salt, margarine and corn syrup with mixer. Stir in pecans. Pour into pastry shell. Bake 40 to 50 minutes, or until set. Cool slightly. Serve warm or refrigerate.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Roll
directions: Preheat oven to 375°. Grease 15 x 10-inch jellyroll pan; line with waxed paper. Grease and flour paper. Sprinkle tea towel with powdered sugar. Combine flour, soda, baking powder, cinnamon, cloves and salt in a small bowl. Beat eggs and sugar in a large bowl until thick. Beat in pumpkin. Stir in flour mixture. Spread evenly into prepared pan. Sprinkle with nuts, if desired. Bake for 13 to 15 minutes or until top of cake springs back when touched. Immediately loosen and turn cake onto prepared towel. Carefully peel off paper. Roll up cake and towel, starting with narrow end. Cool on wire rack.
recipes.text: Pumpkin Roll. Preheat oven to 375°. Grease 15 x 10-inch jellyroll pan; line with waxed paper. Grease and flour paper. Sprinkle tea towel with powdered sugar. Combine flour, soda, baking powder, cinnamon, cloves and salt in a small bowl. Beat eggs and sugar in a large bowl until thick. Beat in pumpkin. Stir in flour mixture. Spread evenly into prepared pan. Sprinkle with nuts, if desired. Bake for 13 to 15 minutes or until top of cake springs back when touched. Immediately loosen and turn cake onto prepared towel. Carefully peel off paper. Roll up cake and towel, starting with narrow end. Cool on wire rack.

recipes.title: Barbecue Sauce
directions: Combine and cook to desired thickness.
recipes.text: Barbecue Sauce. Combine and cook to desired thickness.

recipes.title: Stuffed Green Peppers
directions: Heat oven to 350°.
Remove seeds from peppers.
Boil the pepper halves in salted water for 5 minutes.
Drain.
Brown ground beef and onions.
Mix remaining ingredients with the beef.
Stuff peppers with this mixture.
Bake, covered, for about 20 minutes. Top with sliced cheese, if desired, and bake 10 minutes, uncovered.
recipes.text: Stuffed Green Peppers. Heat oven to 350°. Remove seeds from peppers. Boil the pepper halves in salted water for 5 minutes. Drain. Brown ground beef and onions. Mix remaining ingredients with the beef. Stuff peppers with this mixture. Bake, covered, for about 20 minutes. Top with sliced cheese, if desired, and bake 10 minutes, uncovered.

recipes.title: Curried Lima Bean Casserole
ingredients: 1 pkg. frozen or canned baby limas
1/2 c. bean juice and water (mix together)
2 strips bacon, fried crisp and crumbled
directions: Cook limas as directed.
Drain and save liquid.
Combine onion, red pepper, soup and water in saucepan.
Heat thoroughly. Remove from heat; blend sour cream and curry powder into soup mixture.
Stir in limas.
Turn mixture into 2-quart casserole dish.
Combine crumbs with melted butter.
Add crumbled bacon. Sprinkle over mixture.
Bake uncovered at 350° for 25 minutes or until lightly browned.
recipes.text: Curried Lima Bean Casserole. Cook limas as directed. Drain and save liquid. Combine onion, red pepper, soup and water in saucepan. Heat thoroughly. Remove from heat; blend sour cream and curry powder into soup mixture. Stir in limas. Turn mixture into 2-quart casserole dish. Combine crumbs with melted butter. Add crumbled bacon. Sprinkle over mixture. Bake uncovered at 350° for 25 minutes or until lightly browned.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Balls
ingredients: 4 c. Special K or Rice Krispies cereal
directions: Boil Karo and sugar, just until it comes to a boil.
Turn off and add peanut butter and cereal.
Shape into balls.
recipes.text: Peanut Butter Balls. Boil Karo and sugar, just until it comes to a boil. Turn off and add peanut butter and cereal. Shape into balls.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Bread
directions: Combine ingredients and mix well.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour in loaf pans.
recipes.text: Pumpkin Bread. Combine ingredients and mix well. Bake at 350° for 1 hour in loaf pans.

recipes.title: Silly Putty
ingredients: 4 oz. Elmer's school glue (this brand works best)
directions: Mix ingredients; stir with a spoon and then knead with fingers, until all the liquid starch is absorbed.
Store in a covered container. If mixture is sticky, this indicates too much glue.
A hard mixture indicates too much starch.
recipes.text: Silly Putty. Mix ingredients; stir with a spoon and then knead with fingers, until all the liquid starch is absorbed. Store in a covered container. If mixture is sticky, this indicates too much glue. A hard mixture indicates too much starch.

recipes.title: Mincemeat Drops
ingredients: 2/3 c. (4 1/2 oz.) dried mincemeat or 3/4 c. moist mincemeat
directions: Cream shortening; add sugar gradually and blend well.
Add egg; mix.
Add dry ingredients that have been sifted together.
Fold in mincemeat; add vanilla and thoroughly mix.
(If dry mincemeat is used, add 1/2 cup water and cook until water is absorbed, about 8 minutes; cool.)
Drop by teaspoonfuls on greased cookie sheet 2 inches apart and bake at 400° from 8 to 10 minutes.
Makes 4 dozen.
recipes.text: Mincemeat Drops. Cream shortening; add sugar gradually and blend well. Add egg; mix. Add dry ingredients that have been sifted together. Fold in mincemeat; add vanilla and thoroughly mix. (If dry mincemeat is used, add 1/2 cup water and cook until water is absorbed, about 8 minutes; cool.) Drop by teaspoonfuls on greased cookie sheet 2 inches apart and bake at 400° from 8 to 10 minutes. Makes 4 dozen.

recipes.title: Chicken Soup
directions: In a large pot, combine the chicken, onions, garlic and 4 quarts cold water.
Bring to a boil, skimming and discarding foam from surface.
Reduce heat to low.
Cover and simmer for 1 hour. Add carrots, parsnips, celery, salt and pepper to the pot.
Cover and continue to simmer until vegetables are tender, about 30 minutes longer.
Remove pot from heat and take chicken from soup. When the chicken is cool enough to handle, remove meat from bones and shred it.
Return soup to a simmer.
Add shredded chicken and parsley; heat through, about 5 minutes.
Makes about 3 quarts.
recipes.text: Chicken Soup. In a large pot, combine the chicken, onions, garlic and 4 quarts cold water. Bring to a boil, skimming and discarding foam from surface. Reduce heat to low. Cover and simmer for 1 hour. Add carrots, parsnips, celery, salt and pepper to the pot. Cover and continue to simmer until vegetables are tender, about 30 minutes longer. Remove pot from heat and take chicken from soup. When the chicken is cool enough to handle, remove meat from bones and shred it. Return soup to a simmer. Add shredded chicken and parsley; heat through, about 5 minutes. Makes about 3 quarts.

recipes.title: Stuffed Pasta Shells
directions: Cook pasta shells as directed.
Preheat oven to 350°.
Melt butter.
Add flour, salt, pepper and nutmeg (will be a paste). Add milk; cook on low until thick.
Add spinach to sauce.
Put in baking dish.
Mix tuna and Ricotta cheese.
Fill shells with mixture.
Arrange shells on top of spinach mixture.
Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese.
Bake 20 to 25 minutes.
Garnish with paprika.
recipes.text: Stuffed Pasta Shells. Cook pasta shells as directed. Preheat oven to 350°. Melt butter. Add flour, salt, pepper and nutmeg (will be a paste). Add milk; cook on low until thick. Add spinach to sauce. Put in baking dish. Mix tuna and Ricotta cheese. Fill shells with mixture. Arrange shells on top of spinach mixture. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Bake 20 to 25 minutes. Garnish with paprika.

recipes.title: Spicy Bread Pudding
directions: Beat eggs lightly.
Add sugar, spice, salt, milk and vanilla. Heat 1 3/4 cups milk; stir into egg mixture.
Blend in bread crumbs; mix well.
Turn into buttered 1-quart casserole.
Place in pan of hot water.
Bake, uncovered, in a 325° oven for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Spicy Bread Pudding. Beat eggs lightly. Add sugar, spice, salt, milk and vanilla. Heat 1 3/4 cups milk; stir into egg mixture. Blend in bread crumbs; mix well. Turn into buttered 1-quart casserole. Place in pan of hot water. Bake, uncovered, in a 325° oven for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Sweetened Condensed Milk
directions: Mix all ingredients in blender.
Refrigerate until ready to use.
Makes 1 can.
recipes.text: Sweetened Condensed Milk. Mix all ingredients in blender. Refrigerate until ready to use. Makes 1 can.

recipes.title: Tuna Cakes
ingredients: 1/2 c. finely chopped green bell pepper or onion
directions: Set aside 3/4 cup bread crumbs.
Combine all ingredients except oil.
Form eight patties, coating each side with reserved bread crumbs.
Heat 1 tablespoon oil over medium heat.
Cook 4 patties for 4 to 5 minutes on each side.
Add other tablespoon oil and cook remaining tuna cakes.
makes 4 to 6 servings.
Total time:
25 minutes.
recipes.text: Tuna Cakes. Set aside 3/4 cup bread crumbs. Combine all ingredients except oil. Form eight patties, coating each side with reserved bread crumbs. Heat 1 tablespoon oil over medium heat. Cook 4 patties for 4 to 5 minutes on each side. Add other tablespoon oil and cook remaining tuna cakes. makes 4 to 6 servings. Total time: 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Hamburger And Rice Casserole
directions: Brown and drain ground beef. Cook next 3 ingredients in pan for 7 to 8 minutes. Add remaining ingredients. Mix all together in casserole. Bake, covered, at 400° for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Hamburger And Rice Casserole. Brown and drain ground beef. Cook next 3 ingredients in pan for 7 to 8 minutes. Add remaining ingredients. Mix all together in casserole. Bake, covered, at 400° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Lucky Chicken
ingredients: 2 Tbsp. vegetable oil (or enough to cover bottom of pan)
1 Tbsp. butter or margarine, microwaved to melt
directions: Chop chicken into bite size chunks.
Heat oil in pan.
Mix flour, salt and pepper.
Dip chicken in melted butter, then flour mixture.
Brown chicken.
Mix wet ingredients and vegetables.
Add to chicken; simmer 30 minutes.
Serve over rice; garnish with green and red pepper slices.
Serves 4.
recipes.text: Lucky Chicken. Chop chicken into bite size chunks. Heat oil in pan. Mix flour, salt and pepper. Dip chicken in melted butter, then flour mixture. Brown chicken. Mix wet ingredients and vegetables. Add to chicken; simmer 30 minutes. Serve over rice; garnish with green and red pepper slices. Serves 4.

recipes.title: Cookie Frosting
directions: Mix all together and frost cut-out sugar cookies.
recipes.text: Cookie Frosting. Mix all together and frost cut-out sugar cookies.

recipes.title: Watergate Salad
directions: Mix pudding with pineapple and juice.
Add other ingredients and mix well.
Chill before serving.
recipes.text: Watergate Salad. Mix pudding with pineapple and juice. Add other ingredients and mix well. Chill before serving.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Balls
directions: Cream butter or margarine, peanut butter, powdered sugar and vanilla.
Roll in small balls.
Melt paraffin and semi-sweet chocolate together.
Use toothpick to dip each ball in chocolate; place on wax paper.
recipes.text: Peanut Butter Balls. Cream butter or margarine, peanut butter, powdered sugar and vanilla. Roll in small balls. Melt paraffin and semi-sweet chocolate together. Use toothpick to dip each ball in chocolate; place on wax paper.

recipes.title: Cold Oven Pound Cake
ingredients: 1/2 pt. whipping cream (pour directly from container, do not whip)
directions: Cream butter and sugar.
Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each addition.
Add flour and whipping cream alternately. Blend well after each addition.
Pour into well-greased and floured 10-inch tube pan and place in cold oven.
Bake at 325° for 1 hour and 25 minutes or until done.
recipes.text: Cold Oven Pound Cake. Cream butter and sugar. Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each addition. Add flour and whipping cream alternately. Blend well after each addition. Pour into well-greased and floured 10-inch tube pan and place in cold oven. Bake at 325° for 1 hour and 25 minutes or until done.

recipes.title: Spoon Rolls
directions: Place yeast in 2 cups warm water. Melt butter. Combine yeast mixture, butter, sugar and egg. Add flour and mix well.
recipes.text: Spoon Rolls. Place yeast in 2 cups warm water. Melt butter. Combine yeast mixture, butter, sugar and egg. Add flour and mix well.

recipes.title: Guacamole
directions: Mash avocados.
Add onions, pepper, lemon juice, salt and pepper.
Beat until creamy.
Gently fold in tomato.
Cover and refrigerate until serving time.
Makes about 2 cups.
recipes.text: Guacamole. Mash avocados. Add onions, pepper, lemon juice, salt and pepper. Beat until creamy. Gently fold in tomato. Cover and refrigerate until serving time. Makes about 2 cups.

recipes.title: Never Fail Pie Crust
directions: Beat egg, vinegar and water. Mix flour, salt and Crisco with fork. Add liquids to form dough. Roll out. Freeze what you don't use for later.
recipes.text: Never Fail Pie Crust. Beat egg, vinegar and water. Mix flour, salt and Crisco with fork. Add liquids to form dough. Roll out. Freeze what you don't use for later.

recipes.title: Poppy Seed Cake
directions: Sift dry ingredients and set aside.
Cream butter and sugar; add beaten egg yolks.
Add flour mixture alternately with sour cream, vanilla and poppy seed.
Fold in stiffly beaten egg whites. Bake in ungreased angel cake pan at 350° for 1 hour.
Do not frost.
recipes.text: Poppy Seed Cake. Sift dry ingredients and set aside. Cream butter and sugar; add beaten egg yolks. Add flour mixture alternately with sour cream, vanilla and poppy seed. Fold in stiffly beaten egg whites. Bake in ungreased angel cake pan at 350° for 1 hour. Do not frost.

recipes.title: Italian Sausage Stuffed Mushrooms
ingredients: 2 tsp. chopped Italian flat leaf parsley
directions: Preheat oven to 375°.
Carefully remove mushroom stems; set stems aside.
Spray a 13x9x2 inch baking dish lightly with non stick vegetable spray.
Place mushroom caps in dish open side up. Set aside.
Combine sausage and garlic in a heavy skillet.
Brown, stirring to crumble.
Drain any excess fat.
recipes.text: Italian Sausage Stuffed Mushrooms. Preheat oven to 375°. Carefully remove mushroom stems; set stems aside. Spray a 13x9x2 inch baking dish lightly with non stick vegetable spray. Place mushroom caps in dish open side up. Set aside. Combine sausage and garlic in a heavy skillet. Brown, stirring to crumble. Drain any excess fat.

recipes.title: Amaretto Cheesecake
ingredients: 1 1/2 lb. (three 8 oz. bars) cream cheese, softened
directions: Bake an additional 15 minutes.
Remove and place slivered almonds on top.
recipes.text: Amaretto Cheesecake. Bake an additional 15 minutes. Remove and place slivered almonds on top.

recipes.title: Mother'S Dumplings
directions: In large mixing bowl, add flour.
Cut in shortening and add milk to form dough.
Roll out
onto
floured surface.
Cut into strips.
Bring broth, soup and bouillon
cubes to a boil. Drop in strips, one at a time.
Reduce
heat.
Never stir; you must shake the dumplings.
recipes.text: Mother'S Dumplings. In large mixing bowl, add flour. Cut in shortening and add milk to form dough. Roll out onto floured surface. Cut into strips. Bring broth, soup and bouillon cubes to a boil. Drop in strips, one at a time. Reduce heat. Never stir; you must shake the dumplings.

recipes.title: Corned Beef Ball
directions: Combine all ingredients and form into a ball.
Roll in pecans.
recipes.text: Corned Beef Ball. Combine all ingredients and form into a ball. Roll in pecans.

recipes.title: Carolina Peach Pie
ingredients: 6 to 8 large peaches, peeled and sliced thin (about 5 c.)
2 Tbsp. butter or margarine, cut in pieces
directions: Preheat oven to 425°.
You will need pastry for 9-inch double crust.
recipes.text: Carolina Peach Pie. Preheat oven to 425°. You will need pastry for 9-inch double crust.

recipes.title: Crab Cakes
directions: Mix all ingredients together.
Spread on muffins.
Broil until brown and bubbly.
recipes.text: Crab Cakes. Mix all ingredients together. Spread on muffins. Broil until brown and bubbly.

recipes.title: Pound Cake
directions: Cream the sugar, shortening and butter together. Add flour and eggs, a little at a time, alternately to sugar mixture.
Add lemon extract and pour into floured pan.
Cook at 350° for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Pound Cake. Cream the sugar, shortening and butter together. Add flour and eggs, a little at a time, alternately to sugar mixture. Add lemon extract and pour into floured pan. Cook at 350° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Meat Loaf
directions: Beat egg in bowl. Stir ketchup, water, soup mix, bread crumbs and ground beef. Mix well. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Meat Loaf. Beat egg in bowl. Stir ketchup, water, soup mix, bread crumbs and ground beef. Mix well. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Pineapple Casserole
ingredients: 2 (20 oz.) cans pineapple chunky and juice
directions: Mix and put in greased casserole dish.
recipes.text: Pineapple Casserole. Mix and put in greased casserole dish.

recipes.title: Chicken And Rice Casserole
ingredients: 1 c. precooked rice (extra good cooked in chicken broth)
directions: Mix and cook at 325° for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Chicken And Rice Casserole. Mix and cook at 325° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Swedish Apple Pie(Regular And Low-Fat)
ingredients: 3/4 c. butter or margarine (for low-fat substitute 3/4 c. applesauce)
directions: Grease or spray a 9-inch pie pan.
Fill it 2/3 full of sliced apples (peeling is optional).
Sprinkle 1 teaspoon cinnamon and 1 teaspoon sugar over apples.
If using margarine or butter, melt it.
Combine butter or margarine or applesauce* with flour, rest of sugar, 1 egg and pinch of salt.
Add raisins, nuts or both.
It will be thick.
Spread over top of apples (does not have to cover completely).
Bake at 350° for 45 to 50 minutes.
recipes.text: Swedish Apple Pie(Regular And Low-Fat). Grease or spray a 9-inch pie pan. Fill it 2/3 full of sliced apples (peeling is optional). Sprinkle 1 teaspoon cinnamon and 1 teaspoon sugar over apples. If using margarine or butter, melt it. Combine butter or margarine or applesauce* with flour, rest of sugar, 1 egg and pinch of salt. Add raisins, nuts or both. It will be thick. Spread over top of apples (does not have to cover completely). Bake at 350° for 45 to 50 minutes.

recipes.title: Italian Spaghetti Sauce
directions: Brown meat in butter in iron skillet.
Add onions, garlic and pepper.
Cook until slightly brown.
Add tomato puree, catsup, 1/2 cup water, Worcestershire sauce, salt and pepper.
Simmer, covered, 1 1/2 hours.
recipes.text: Italian Spaghetti Sauce. Brown meat in butter in iron skillet. Add onions, garlic and pepper. Cook until slightly brown. Add tomato puree, catsup, 1/2 cup water, Worcestershire sauce, salt and pepper. Simmer, covered, 1 1/2 hours.

recipes.title: Sweet Potato Casserole
directions: Combine first 7 ingredients in casserole dish.
Then do topping by mixing next 3 ingredients.
Then place on top of potato mixture.
Bake, uncovered, in 350° oven 30 minutes or until easily speared with fork.
recipes.text: Sweet Potato Casserole. Combine first 7 ingredients in casserole dish. Then do topping by mixing next 3 ingredients. Then place on top of potato mixture. Bake, uncovered, in 350° oven 30 minutes or until easily speared with fork.

recipes.title: Green Beans And Sausage
directions: Cut smoked sausage in to 1/2-inch pieces.
Saute sliced onion with sausage.
Add tomato sauce.
Add 1 can of water or more.
Add basil and garlic powder.
Cut up the peeled potatoes in bite-size pieces and add to sausage.
Simmer until potatoes are about half done.
Add drained green beans.
Stir and simmer, covered.
If it looks dry, add more water.
recipes.text: Green Beans And Sausage. Cut smoked sausage in to 1/2-inch pieces. Saute sliced onion with sausage. Add tomato sauce. Add 1 can of water or more. Add basil and garlic powder. Cut up the peeled potatoes in bite-size pieces and add to sausage. Simmer until potatoes are about half done. Add drained green beans. Stir and simmer, covered. If it looks dry, add more water.

recipes.title: Chicken Casserole
ingredients: 1 (10 oz.) can cream of chicken soup
directions: Cook chicken breasts until tender.
Take off bone.
Cut in small bite-size pieces.
Place chicken with broth in large baking pan.
Add cream of chicken soup and all vegetables.
Top with Bisquick (recipe on box). Bake 1 hour.
Serves 4 to 6.
recipes.text: Chicken Casserole. Cook chicken breasts until tender. Take off bone. Cut in small bite-size pieces. Place chicken with broth in large baking pan. Add cream of chicken soup and all vegetables. Top with Bisquick (recipe on box). Bake 1 hour. Serves 4 to 6.

recipes.title: Chocolate Upside-Down Cake
ingredients: 1 dark chocolate cake mix, mixed as directed
directions: Melt butter in 9 x 13-inch pan.
Add water; sprinkle sugar evenly in pan.
Arrange nuts and coconut on sugar mixture.
Mix cake mix as directed on box.
Pour over mixture in pan.
Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.
Let stand for 5 minutes for topping to begin to set.
Turn upside down onto large plate or cookie sheet.
Serve with whipped cream.
recipes.text: Chocolate Upside-Down Cake. Melt butter in 9 x 13-inch pan. Add water; sprinkle sugar evenly in pan. Arrange nuts and coconut on sugar mixture. Mix cake mix as directed on box. Pour over mixture in pan. Bake at 350° for 40 minutes. Let stand for 5 minutes for topping to begin to set. Turn upside down onto large plate or cookie sheet. Serve with whipped cream.

recipes.title: Easy Beef Casserole
ingredients: 10 oz. pkg. Fiesta Brand frozen vegetables, thawed and drained
directions: Preheat oven to 400°.
In an 8 x 12-inch pan, combine potatoes, oil and pepper.
Spread evenly in pan.
Bake at 400° for 15 to 20 minutes until slightly browned.
recipes.text: Easy Beef Casserole. Preheat oven to 400°. In an 8 x 12-inch pan, combine potatoes, oil and pepper. Spread evenly in pan. Bake at 400° for 15 to 20 minutes until slightly browned.

recipes.title: Chinese Slaw
directions: Combine peas, mushrooms, water chestnuts, green beans, Chinese vegetables, celery and onion.
recipes.text: Chinese Slaw. Combine peas, mushrooms, water chestnuts, green beans, Chinese vegetables, celery and onion.

recipes.title: Cheese-Smothered Chicken
directions: In skillet, slowly brown chicken in butter, about 30 minutes. Add remaining ingredients.
Cover and simmer 15 minutes or until well done.
Stir occasionally.
Makes 4 servings.
recipes.text: Cheese-Smothered Chicken. In skillet, slowly brown chicken in butter, about 30 minutes. Add remaining ingredients. Cover and simmer 15 minutes or until well done. Stir occasionally. Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: 5 Minute Pie
directions: Beat cream cheese until smooth.
Gradually add condensed milk and evaporated milk.
Beat until smooth.
Add lime juice.
Blend slowly until thickened.
Pour into pie shell.
Chill
1 1/2 to 2 hours until firm.
Garnish with lime slices and berries.
recipes.text: 5 Minute Pie. Beat cream cheese until smooth. Gradually add condensed milk and evaporated milk. Beat until smooth. Add lime juice. Blend slowly until thickened. Pour into pie shell. Chill 1 1/2 to 2 hours until firm. Garnish with lime slices and berries.

recipes.title: Green Enchiladas
ingredients: 1/2 pkg. green onion powdered chip mix
1 small can chopped green chili peppers
directions: Brown the ground beef and onion in skillet. Mix separately the cheese, milk, chip mix, chili peppers, pimento and chicken soup. Layer the tortillas on the bottom of 9 x 13 Pyrex baking dish. Add mixture, then meat. Top with grated cheese. Bake 20 minutes at 350° until bubbly hot.
recipes.text: Green Enchiladas. Brown the ground beef and onion in skillet. Mix separately the cheese, milk, chip mix, chili peppers, pimento and chicken soup. Layer the tortillas on the bottom of 9 x 13 Pyrex baking dish. Add mixture, then meat. Top with grated cheese. Bake 20 minutes at 350° until bubbly hot.

recipes.title: Meat Loaf
directions: Heat oven to 350°. Combine all ingredients except ground beef. Mix well. Add ground beef. Bake for 1 to 1 1/2 hours.
recipes.text: Meat Loaf. Heat oven to 350°. Combine all ingredients except ground beef. Mix well. Add ground beef. Bake for 1 to 1 1/2 hours.

recipes.title: Graham Balls
directions: Grind crackers in food processor.
In a mixing bowl stir with a wooden spoon the softened butter with the powdered sugar for 1 minute until soft.
Mix the ground crackers with the butter mixture and egg.
Spread coconut all over a sheet of wax paper. Roll the mixture into balls and then roll into coconut until the ball is fully covered.
Refrigerate for better taste.
recipes.text: Graham Balls. Grind crackers in food processor. In a mixing bowl stir with a wooden spoon the softened butter with the powdered sugar for 1 minute until soft. Mix the ground crackers with the butter mixture and egg. Spread coconut all over a sheet of wax paper. Roll the mixture into balls and then roll into coconut until the ball is fully covered. Refrigerate for better taste.

recipes.title: Divinity Fudge
directions: Cook sugar, corn syrup and water until a soft ball is formed or until syrup holds shape when dropped in cold water.
Pour syrup into stiffly beaten egg whites and beat until mixture is too stiff to handle with ease.
Add nuts and vanilla.
Pour on a well-greased platter.
recipes.text: Divinity Fudge. Cook sugar, corn syrup and water until a soft ball is formed or until syrup holds shape when dropped in cold water. Pour syrup into stiffly beaten egg whites and beat until mixture is too stiff to handle with ease. Add nuts and vanilla. Pour on a well-greased platter.

recipes.title: Special K Bars
directions: Grease a mixing bowl.
Put Special K in it.
Bring sugar and Karo to boiling point.
Blend in peanut butter.
Pour over Special K; mix well.
Press into buttered 13 x 9-inch pan.
Cool.
Melt the chocolate chips, adding a little milk, if needed.
Spread over mixture.
recipes.text: Special K Bars. Grease a mixing bowl. Put Special K in it. Bring sugar and Karo to boiling point. Blend in peanut butter. Pour over Special K; mix well. Press into buttered 13 x 9-inch pan. Cool. Melt the chocolate chips, adding a little milk, if needed. Spread over mixture.

recipes.title: Banana Bread(Low-Fat)
directions: Spray 2 bread pans.
Mix ingredients; pour into pans.
Bake at 350° for about 1 hour.
Freezes well.
recipes.text: Banana Bread(Low-Fat). Spray 2 bread pans. Mix ingredients; pour into pans. Bake at 350° for about 1 hour. Freezes well.

recipes.title: Homemade Tortilla Chips
directions: Cut stack of tortillas into 8 wedges each.
Spread wedges in a single layer on a baking sheet.
Sprinkle with cumin and salt. Bake at 375° about 10 minutes or until dry and crisp.
Monitor your chips as to not overbrown.
Store in an airtight container. Serve with salsa.
recipes.text: Homemade Tortilla Chips. Cut stack of tortillas into 8 wedges each. Spread wedges in a single layer on a baking sheet. Sprinkle with cumin and salt. Bake at 375° about 10 minutes or until dry and crisp. Monitor your chips as to not overbrown. Store in an airtight container. Serve with salsa.

recipes.title: Low-Fat Soft Tacos
directions: Brown meat, then rinse in a colander under hot water.
Let drain.
Return meat to pan, add taco mix and follow instructions on mix package to prepare taco meat.
Steam tortillas, and assemble tacos.
Makes about 6 to 8 tacos.
recipes.text: Low-Fat Soft Tacos. Brown meat, then rinse in a colander under hot water. Let drain. Return meat to pan, add taco mix and follow instructions on mix package to prepare taco meat. Steam tortillas, and assemble tacos. Makes about 6 to 8 tacos.

recipes.title: Doris'S Quiche
directions: Mix Bisquick, cheese, garlic, parsley and scallion.
Add oil and beaten eggs.
Add vegetables of choice.
Put in greased pie plate. Add pinches on top.
Bake in a 350° oven for 1/2 hour to 35 minutes.
recipes.text: Doris'S Quiche. Mix Bisquick, cheese, garlic, parsley and scallion. Add oil and beaten eggs. Add vegetables of choice. Put in greased pie plate. Add pinches on top. Bake in a 350° oven for 1/2 hour to 35 minutes.

recipes.title: Eggplant-Tomato Casserole
directions: Peel and cut eggplant into 1/4-inch slices.
Peel tomatoes and slice.
In a 2-quart casserole dish, arrange a layer of eggplant; sprinkle with salt and pepper.
Put a layer of tomatoes on top; sprinkle with salt, pepper and oregano flakes you have crushed with your fingers and cheese.
Repeat layers until casserole is full, ending with cheese on top.
Cover; bake in a 400° oven for 30 to 40 minutes, or until eggplant is tender when tested with fork.
recipes.text: Eggplant-Tomato Casserole. Peel and cut eggplant into 1/4-inch slices. Peel tomatoes and slice. In a 2-quart casserole dish, arrange a layer of eggplant; sprinkle with salt and pepper. Put a layer of tomatoes on top; sprinkle with salt, pepper and oregano flakes you have crushed with your fingers and cheese. Repeat layers until casserole is full, ending with cheese on top. Cover; bake in a 400° oven for 30 to 40 minutes, or until eggplant is tender when tested with fork.

recipes.title: Tortellini Soup
directions: In a large pot, heat oil until hot.
Add leeks and saute 5 minutes.
Add carrots and celery.
Cover; simmer 5 minutes.
Stir occasionally.
Add tomatoes and liquid; simmer 10 minutes.
recipes.text: Tortellini Soup. In a large pot, heat oil until hot. Add leeks and saute 5 minutes. Add carrots and celery. Cover; simmer 5 minutes. Stir occasionally. Add tomatoes and liquid; simmer 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Rotini (Worm) Salad
ingredients: 1 (8 oz.) brick Colby-Jack cheese, cut in small pieces
1 1/2 c. Miracle Whip or enough to moisten the other ingredients
directions: Combine all ingredients in a large Tupperware bowl; chill before serving.
recipes.text: Rotini (Worm) Salad. Combine all ingredients in a large Tupperware bowl; chill before serving.

recipes.title: Punch Bowl Cake
ingredients: 1 pkg. (2 c.) pecan halves or more if desired
directions: Mix cake according to directions on box.
Bake in 2 round cake pans.
Cool.
Mix pudding according to directions on box.
Put one cake layer in bottom of punch bowl.
Cover with 1/2 of the pudding.
Cover with 1/2 cherry pie filling, then 1/2 of the pineapple, 1/2 of the coconut, 1 carton Cool Whip and 1 cup of pecan halves.
Repeat with second cake layer and remaining ingredients.
recipes.text: Punch Bowl Cake. Mix cake according to directions on box. Bake in 2 round cake pans. Cool. Mix pudding according to directions on box. Put one cake layer in bottom of punch bowl. Cover with 1/2 of the pudding. Cover with 1/2 cherry pie filling, then 1/2 of the pineapple, 1/2 of the coconut, 1 carton Cool Whip and 1 cup of pecan halves. Repeat with second cake layer and remaining ingredients.

recipes.title: Green Bean Casserole
directions: Butter a small casserole dish and put in drained green beans. Slice hard-boiled eggs on top.
Pour a mixture of mushroom soup and milk that has been heated.
Place in 325° oven for about 20 minutes.
recipes.text: Green Bean Casserole. Butter a small casserole dish and put in drained green beans. Slice hard-boiled eggs on top. Pour a mixture of mushroom soup and milk that has been heated. Place in 325° oven for about 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Cleo'S Health Bread
directions: In a small bowl, proof yeast by mixing with 1/2 cup warm water and sugar.
Set aside.
In a large bowl, mix together the second amount of warm water, honey, molasses, oil, eggs, and lemon juice. Mix well.
Add yeast mixture and stir.
recipes.text: Cleo'S Health Bread. In a small bowl, proof yeast by mixing with 1/2 cup warm water and sugar. Set aside. In a large bowl, mix together the second amount of warm water, honey, molasses, oil, eggs, and lemon juice. Mix well. Add yeast mixture and stir.

recipes.title: Hot Chocolate Mix
directions: Mix and store tightly covered.
Use 1/3 cup of mixture in 1 cup hot water.
recipes.text: Hot Chocolate Mix. Mix and store tightly covered. Use 1/3 cup of mixture in 1 cup hot water.

recipes.title: Do Not Stir Cobbler
directions: Melt margarine in 9 x 12-inch casserole.
Make batter of 1 cup sugar, flour, salt, baking powder and milk.
Pour batter into melted margarine in casserole dish.
Add fruit and juice. Sprinkle with 1/2 cup sugar; do not stir.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Do Not Stir Cobbler. Melt margarine in 9 x 12-inch casserole. Make batter of 1 cup sugar, flour, salt, baking powder and milk. Pour batter into melted margarine in casserole dish. Add fruit and juice. Sprinkle with 1/2 cup sugar; do not stir. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Pound Cake
directions: Beat margarine and sugar together.
Add eggs, beaten.
Last, add flour and vanilla.
Pour in greased tube pan.
Bake 1 hour in oven at 350°.
recipes.text: Pound Cake. Beat margarine and sugar together. Add eggs, beaten. Last, add flour and vanilla. Pour in greased tube pan. Bake 1 hour in oven at 350°.

recipes.title: Eggplant With Garlic Sauce(Szechuan Style)
directions: In a small bowl, mix together the ginger, garlic, soy sauce, sugar, vinegar, cornstarch and chili pepper.
Set aside.
Heat oil in frying pan until hot.
Add eggplant and fry until soft.
Set aside and pat with paper towel to remove excess oil.
Pour out all but 1 teaspoon oil and fry meat until cooked.
Set meat aside and drain excess oil.
Heat ginger/garlic mixture in pan until near boiling.
Add eggplant and meat.
Mix together and cook 1 minute. Makes 6 servings.
recipes.text: Eggplant With Garlic Sauce(Szechuan Style). In a small bowl, mix together the ginger, garlic, soy sauce, sugar, vinegar, cornstarch and chili pepper. Set aside. Heat oil in frying pan until hot. Add eggplant and fry until soft. Set aside and pat with paper towel to remove excess oil. Pour out all but 1 teaspoon oil and fry meat until cooked. Set meat aside and drain excess oil. Heat ginger/garlic mixture in pan until near boiling. Add eggplant and meat. Mix together and cook 1 minute. Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Pastor Groover'S Barbecue Sauce
ingredients: 1 Tbsp. crushed red pepper or amount to taste
directions: Mix all ingredients together well and simmer over low heat until onions are tender.
Recipe can be doubled.
recipes.text: Pastor Groover'S Barbecue Sauce. Mix all ingredients together well and simmer over low heat until onions are tender. Recipe can be doubled.

recipes.title: Cheese Cornbread
directions: Mix all ingredients together and bake at 275° for 35 to 40 minutes in medium size skillet.
Goes best with homemade chili, spaghetti, or baked potato soup.
recipes.text: Cheese Cornbread. Mix all ingredients together and bake at 275° for 35 to 40 minutes in medium size skillet. Goes best with homemade chili, spaghetti, or baked potato soup.

recipes.title: Pasta Salad
directions: Cook the pasta noodles until almost done (you'll want them a little firm for stirring).
Then use cold water to rinse and let them sit in the refrigerator while doing rest of cutting and chopping of other ingredients.
recipes.text: Pasta Salad. Cook the pasta noodles until almost done (you'll want them a little firm for stirring). Then use cold water to rinse and let them sit in the refrigerator while doing rest of cutting and chopping of other ingredients.

recipes.title: Frijoles Colorados - Red Beans
ingredients: 1 piece beef, short rib or flank
directions: Soak beans overnight covered in water.
Or use quick softening method:
bring beans to boil, boil for 5 minutes, cover and turn off heat.
Let beans sit for 1 hour and then begin recipe.
Make sure beans are covered by 2 fingers of water.
Cook beans on simmer with meat until tender.
In small frying pan, saute onion, green pepper and garlic in the olive oil with bay leaf.
Be careful not to burn garlic.
Add can of tomato sauce and the remaining ingredients.
Stir to mix well and add to beans.
Continue to cook beans until seasoning is well absorbed and beans are soft.
If using chorizo, add whole to sauce before adding to beans.
recipes.text: Frijoles Colorados - Red Beans. Soak beans overnight covered in water. Or use quick softening method: bring beans to boil, boil for 5 minutes, cover and turn off heat. Let beans sit for 1 hour and then begin recipe. Make sure beans are covered by 2 fingers of water. Cook beans on simmer with meat until tender. In small frying pan, saute onion, green pepper and garlic in the olive oil with bay leaf. Be careful not to burn garlic. Add can of tomato sauce and the remaining ingredients. Stir to mix well and add to beans. Continue to cook beans until seasoning is well absorbed and beans are soft. If using chorizo, add whole to sauce before adding to beans.

recipes.title: Diabetic Orange Salad
directions: Combine all ingredients and chill.
recipes.text: Diabetic Orange Salad. Combine all ingredients and chill.

recipes.title: Artichoke Dip
directions: Mash artichoke hearts and mix with mayonnaise, cheese and garlic powder.
Put mixture in casserole and sprinkle with a few bread crumbs.
Bake at 325° for 25 minutes.
Serve with crackers.
recipes.text: Artichoke Dip. Mash artichoke hearts and mix with mayonnaise, cheese and garlic powder. Put mixture in casserole and sprinkle with a few bread crumbs. Bake at 325° for 25 minutes. Serve with crackers.

recipes.title: Coconut Pie
directions: Mix all ingredients together, except coconut.
Pour in blender for 10 seconds.
Add the flaked coconut.
Pour into a 9-inch buttered baking dish.
Bake at 350° for 40 to 50 minutes.
It makes its own crust.
recipes.text: Coconut Pie. Mix all ingredients together, except coconut. Pour in blender for 10 seconds. Add the flaked coconut. Pour into a 9-inch buttered baking dish. Bake at 350° for 40 to 50 minutes. It makes its own crust.

recipes.title: Sliced Baked Potatoes
ingredients: 1/2 tsp. dried dill weed, basil or thyme, crushed
directions: Wash potatoes; do not peel.
Cut potatoes into 1/2-inch slices.
Arrange slices in a 10 x 6 x 2-inch baking dish or a 9-inch pie pan.
Melt butter; stir in onion and dill weed, basil or thyme.
Drizzle over potatoes.
Sprinkle with cheese.
Sprinkle with salt and pepper.
Cover tightly with foil.
Bake in a 375° oven for 60 to 70 minutes or until potatoes are tender.
Makes 4 to 6 servings.
recipes.text: Sliced Baked Potatoes. Wash potatoes; do not peel. Cut potatoes into 1/2-inch slices. Arrange slices in a 10 x 6 x 2-inch baking dish or a 9-inch pie pan. Melt butter; stir in onion and dill weed, basil or thyme. Drizzle over potatoes. Sprinkle with cheese. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Cover tightly with foil. Bake in a 375° oven for 60 to 70 minutes or until potatoes are tender. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

recipes.title: Karo Winter Casserole
ingredients: 1 lb. or 12 oz. can tomatoes, drained
3 c. cooked shell macaroni or rice
directions: Brown meat, onion and green pepper in oil; drain.
Add other ingredients.
Add half of the cheese.
Simmer 15 minutes.
Put in casserole.
Sprinkle remaining cheese on top.
Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes.
This freezes well.
recipes.text: Karo Winter Casserole. Brown meat, onion and green pepper in oil; drain. Add other ingredients. Add half of the cheese. Simmer 15 minutes. Put in casserole. Sprinkle remaining cheese on top. Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes. This freezes well.

recipes.title: No Bake Cookies
directions: Mix first 4 ingredients in medium saucepan; bring to boil. Boil about 5 minutes until syrup forms.
Add peanut butter and vanilla.
Stir until mixed.
Remove from heat and stir in oatmeal. Spoon out onto greased pan or waxed paper with butter; let cool.
recipes.text: No Bake Cookies. Mix first 4 ingredients in medium saucepan; bring to boil. Boil about 5 minutes until syrup forms. Add peanut butter and vanilla. Stir until mixed. Remove from heat and stir in oatmeal. Spoon out onto greased pan or waxed paper with butter; let cool.

recipes.title: Chicken Stroganoff Casserole
ingredients: 1 can Campbell's cream of celery or chicken soup
1 c. cubed, cooked chicken or 7 oz. can tuna, drained and flaked
directions: Blend soup and sour
cream.
Stir in milk.
Add chicken or tuna, parsley, pimento,
seasonings and noodles.
Pour into 1 1/2 quart shallow baking
dish.
Top
with
crumbs.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
Makes 3
to 4 servings.
All you need to complete the meal is tossed salad, rolls and dessert.
recipes.text: Chicken Stroganoff Casserole. Blend soup and sour cream. Stir in milk. Add chicken or tuna, parsley, pimento, seasonings and noodles. Pour into 1 1/2 quart shallow baking dish. Top with crumbs. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes. Makes 3 to 4 servings. All you need to complete the meal is tossed salad, rolls and dessert.

recipes.title: Tomato Crabmeat Aspic
directions: Heat tomato juice with onion, bay leaf and celery; strain and add gelatin, softened in cold water.
Stir until gelatin is dissolved.
Add beef consomme, lemon juice and seasonings.
Cool until partially set.
Add crabmeat and sliced olives.
Chill until firm in individual molds.
Unmold on lettuce; serve with mayonnaise.
If desired, make in oblong mold and cut in squares. Makes 6 servings.
recipes.text: Tomato Crabmeat Aspic. Heat tomato juice with onion, bay leaf and celery; strain and add gelatin, softened in cold water. Stir until gelatin is dissolved. Add beef consomme, lemon juice and seasonings. Cool until partially set. Add crabmeat and sliced olives. Chill until firm in individual molds. Unmold on lettuce; serve with mayonnaise. If desired, make in oblong mold and cut in squares. Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Banana Nut Bread
directions: Mix nuts in flour.
Mix all ingredients and cook in greased tube pan for 1 hour at 350°.
recipes.text: Banana Nut Bread. Mix nuts in flour. Mix all ingredients and cook in greased tube pan for 1 hour at 350°.

recipes.title: Wedding Punch (Diabetic)
directions: Mix in 1 gallon container.
Serve over ice and add 1 (2 liter) bottle Sprite or any lemon lime soda.
May be frozen and served mushy.
recipes.text: Wedding Punch (Diabetic). Mix in 1 gallon container. Serve over ice and add 1 (2 liter) bottle Sprite or any lemon lime soda. May be frozen and served mushy.

recipes.title: Apple Stuffing
directions: Melt margarine in skillet.
Add onions, celery, apples and raisins.
Cook and stir frequently for 5 minutes until softened. Remove from heat; stir in stuffing mix and seasonings.
Add cider to moisten.
Put into greased casserole.
Bake, covered, at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes.
For crisp top, remove cover the last 5 minutes.
recipes.text: Apple Stuffing. Melt margarine in skillet. Add onions, celery, apples and raisins. Cook and stir frequently for 5 minutes until softened. Remove from heat; stir in stuffing mix and seasonings. Add cider to moisten. Put into greased casserole. Bake, covered, at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes. For crisp top, remove cover the last 5 minutes.

recipes.title: Japanese Fudge Pie
ingredients: 1 to 1 1/2 c. nuts, chopped very fine
directions: Melt margarine and chips; mix sugar and eggs well.
Combine all ingredients and mix well.
Bake in 2 pie shells at 350° for 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Japanese Fudge Pie. Melt margarine and chips; mix sugar and eggs well. Combine all ingredients and mix well. Bake in 2 pie shells at 350° for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Souper Scalloped Potatoes
directions: Blend soup with milk and a dash of pepper. In a casserole, arrange sliced potatoes, minced onion and soup sauce in alternate layers. Dab top with butter, sprinkle with paprika.
recipes.text: Souper Scalloped Potatoes. Blend soup with milk and a dash of pepper. In a casserole, arrange sliced potatoes, minced onion and soup sauce in alternate layers. Dab top with butter, sprinkle with paprika.

recipes.title: Spaghetti Sauce(Diabetic Meal)
directions: Brown meat, onion and green pepper; drain off fat.
Add all other ingredients.
Cover and simmer for about 2 hours, stirring occasionally.
recipes.text: Spaghetti Sauce(Diabetic Meal). Brown meat, onion and green pepper; drain off fat. Add all other ingredients. Cover and simmer for about 2 hours, stirring occasionally.

recipes.title: Caramel Frosting
directions: Melt butter in saucepan and add brown sugar.
Cook over low heat 2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add milk and cook and stir until comes to a boil.
Remove from heat and cool about 10 minutes.
Then add confectioners sugar, beating well, until cool enough to spread.
recipes.text: Caramel Frosting. Melt butter in saucepan and add brown sugar. Cook over low heat 2 minutes, stirring constantly. Add milk and cook and stir until comes to a boil. Remove from heat and cool about 10 minutes. Then add confectioners sugar, beating well, until cool enough to spread.

recipes.title: Blueberry Delight
directions: Crumble angel food cake in medium pieces and place in bottom of 9 x 12-inch dish.
Blend cream cheese, sugar, evaporated milk with mixer until creamy.
Add pecans and stir into mixture.
Pour mixture over angel food cake pieces.
Spread blueberry pie filling over mixture.
Top with Cool Whip.
Refrigerate before serving.
recipes.text: Blueberry Delight. Crumble angel food cake in medium pieces and place in bottom of 9 x 12-inch dish. Blend cream cheese, sugar, evaporated milk with mixer until creamy. Add pecans and stir into mixture. Pour mixture over angel food cake pieces. Spread blueberry pie filling over mixture. Top with Cool Whip. Refrigerate before serving.

recipes.title: Chocolate Fudge I
directions: Melt chocolate in heavy saucepan over low heat.
Add powdered sugar and milk, stirring until dissolved.
Bring to a hard boil and when candy gets to a rolling boil, time for 20 minutes or 240° on candy thermometer.
Take off heat and add butter, marshmallow cream and vanilla.
Beat and add nuts.
As it begins to harden, pour into a buttered pan.
Work fast or it will harden.
Let cool. Cut into squares before totally hard.
Store in airtight container.
recipes.text: Chocolate Fudge I. Melt chocolate in heavy saucepan over low heat. Add powdered sugar and milk, stirring until dissolved. Bring to a hard boil and when candy gets to a rolling boil, time for 20 minutes or 240° on candy thermometer. Take off heat and add butter, marshmallow cream and vanilla. Beat and add nuts. As it begins to harden, pour into a buttered pan. Work fast or it will harden. Let cool. Cut into squares before totally hard. Store in airtight container.

recipes.title: Molasses Cookies
directions: Mix together shortening, brown sugar and dark molasses.
Then stir in cold water.
Sift together and add flour and all other ingredients.
Chill dough.
Roll out very thick (1/2-inch).
Cut with 2 1/2-inch round cutter.
Place far apart on lightly greased baking sheet.
Bake at 350° for about 15 minutes.
recipes.text: Molasses Cookies. Mix together shortening, brown sugar and dark molasses. Then stir in cold water. Sift together and add flour and all other ingredients. Chill dough. Roll out very thick (1/2-inch). Cut with 2 1/2-inch round cutter. Place far apart on lightly greased baking sheet. Bake at 350° for about 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Easy Apple Dumplings
directions: Roll out biscuits.
Place apples in center.
Sprinkle with cinnamon and nutmeg.
Fold and pinch dough to seal edges.
Place in Pyrex dish.
Place remaining chopped apples, if any, around dumplings.
Bring 7-Up, margarine and sugar to a boil until melted and pour over dumplings.
Bake at 350° for 40 minutes or just until browned well and apples are tender.
recipes.text: Easy Apple Dumplings. Roll out biscuits. Place apples in center. Sprinkle with cinnamon and nutmeg. Fold and pinch dough to seal edges. Place in Pyrex dish. Place remaining chopped apples, if any, around dumplings. Bring 7-Up, margarine and sugar to a boil until melted and pour over dumplings. Bake at 350° for 40 minutes or just until browned well and apples are tender.

recipes.title: Chicken Pot Pie
directions: Put in a pan.
Mix well.
Place biscuits on top.
Bake at 350° until bread is done.
recipes.text: Chicken Pot Pie. Put in a pan. Mix well. Place biscuits on top. Bake at 350° until bread is done.

recipes.title: Norwegian Coffee Cake
directions: Mix dry ingredients and cut in margarine.
Set aside 1 cup of this mixture.
Blend liquid ingredients and gently mix with dry ingredients, only until moistened.
(Batter will be lumpy.) Spread in a greased and floured 11 x 15-inch jelly roll pan. Sprinkle remaining cup of crumbs over batter.
Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Norwegian Coffee Cake. Mix dry ingredients and cut in margarine. Set aside 1 cup of this mixture. Blend liquid ingredients and gently mix with dry ingredients, only until moistened. (Batter will be lumpy.) Spread in a greased and floured 11 x 15-inch jelly roll pan. Sprinkle remaining cup of crumbs over batter. Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Caper'S Dip
directions: Arrange cling peach halves in a baking dish.
Put a heaping spoonful of mincemeat with brandy on each one.
Heat for about 15 to 20 minutes.
This can be served hot or room temperature.
Allow one peach half per person.
recipes.text: Caper'S Dip. Arrange cling peach halves in a baking dish. Put a heaping spoonful of mincemeat with brandy on each one. Heat for about 15 to 20 minutes. This can be served hot or room temperature. Allow one peach half per person.

recipes.title: Million Dollar Pie
ingredients: 1 (No. 2) size can crushed pineapple, drained well
directions: Fold Cool Whip into milk and lemon juice mixture.
Add remaining ingredients.
Pour into crust and refrigerate at least 2 hours before serving.
recipes.text: Million Dollar Pie. Fold Cool Whip into milk and lemon juice mixture. Add remaining ingredients. Pour into crust and refrigerate at least 2 hours before serving.

recipes.title: One Dish Meal
directions: Note:
Any meat may be substituted for chicken.
recipes.text: One Dish Meal. Note: Any meat may be substituted for chicken.

recipes.title: Cherry Raisin Walnut Shortbread Bars
directions: Preheat oven to 350°.
Lightly grease an 8-inch square pan. Combine flour and sugar, cut in margarine until mixture resembles fine meal.
Press into greased pan and bake 20 minutes or until edges are golden brown.
Meanwhile, mix eggs, brown sugar and vanilla beating well.
Stir in soda, walnuts, raisins and coconut. Spoon over hot crust, spread evenly.
Return to oven; bake an additional 20 to 25 minutes or until top is set.
Cool, cut into bars and serve.
recipes.text: Cherry Raisin Walnut Shortbread Bars. Preheat oven to 350°. Lightly grease an 8-inch square pan. Combine flour and sugar, cut in margarine until mixture resembles fine meal. Press into greased pan and bake 20 minutes or until edges are golden brown. Meanwhile, mix eggs, brown sugar and vanilla beating well. Stir in soda, walnuts, raisins and coconut. Spoon over hot crust, spread evenly. Return to oven; bake an additional 20 to 25 minutes or until top is set. Cool, cut into bars and serve.

recipes.title: Creamy Potato Soup
directions: Peel and dice potatoes.
Add 3 cups water, onion, celery, 1 teaspoon of salt and 1/8 teaspoon of pepper.
Bring to boiling point.
Reduce heat and simmer 20 to 25 minutes.
recipes.text: Creamy Potato Soup. Peel and dice potatoes. Add 3 cups water, onion, celery, 1 teaspoon of salt and 1/8 teaspoon of pepper. Bring to boiling point. Reduce heat and simmer 20 to 25 minutes.

recipes.title: English Muffin Loaves
ingredients: 2 pkg. (1/4 oz. each) active Dry Yeast
directions: In a mixing bowl, combine 2 cups Flour, Yeast, Sugar, Cinnamon, Salt and Baking Soda.
Add Orange Juice, Water and Oil; beat on low speed until moistened.
Beat on high 3 minutes.
Stir in the Pecans, Apricots and remaining Flour to form a stiff batter.
Do not knead.
Grease two 8 x 4 x 2 inch loaf pans; sprinkle with cornmeal.
Spoon batter into pans; sprinkle with cornmeal.
Cover and let rise in a warm place until doubled, about 45 minutes.
Bake at 350 for 35 - 40 minutes or until golden brown.
Immediately remove from pans to cool on wire racks.
Slice and toast.
Yield 2 loaves.
recipes.text: English Muffin Loaves. In a mixing bowl, combine 2 cups Flour, Yeast, Sugar, Cinnamon, Salt and Baking Soda. Add Orange Juice, Water and Oil; beat on low speed until moistened. Beat on high 3 minutes. Stir in the Pecans, Apricots and remaining Flour to form a stiff batter. Do not knead. Grease two 8 x 4 x 2 inch loaf pans; sprinkle with cornmeal. Spoon batter into pans; sprinkle with cornmeal. Cover and let rise in a warm place until doubled, about 45 minutes. Bake at 350 for 35 - 40 minutes or until golden brown. Immediately remove from pans to cool on wire racks. Slice and toast. Yield 2 loaves.

recipes.title: Stew Beef Casserole
ingredients: 2 lb. beef stew, thin and cubed
directions: Place beef in covered Pyrex casserole dish.
Cover with onion soup.
Add mushroom soup and 1 can of water.
Cook at 300° for 3 hours.
Serve over cooked rice.
This can be frozen.
recipes.text: Stew Beef Casserole. Place beef in covered Pyrex casserole dish. Cover with onion soup. Add mushroom soup and 1 can of water. Cook at 300° for 3 hours. Serve over cooked rice. This can be frozen.

recipes.title: Pepernota Pizza
ingredients: 2 to 3 large red sweet peppers, thinly sliced
directions: Saute onions and garlic in 1 tablespoon olive oil until lightly browned.
Set aside.
In another frypan saute peppers, wine vinegar, pepper and salt, if desired, until tender.
Spread pizza sauce on pizza crust, then onions, then peppers.
Bake at 400° about 8 to 10 minutes for prebaked pizza crust, 25 minutes for fresh pizza dough.
recipes.text: Pepernota Pizza. Saute onions and garlic in 1 tablespoon olive oil until lightly browned. Set aside. In another frypan saute peppers, wine vinegar, pepper and salt, if desired, until tender. Spread pizza sauce on pizza crust, then onions, then peppers. Bake at 400° about 8 to 10 minutes for prebaked pizza crust, 25 minutes for fresh pizza dough.

recipes.title: Heath Bar Crunch Fudge
ingredients: 2 c. (16 pieces) crushed mini Heath bars*
directions: *You can use the same recipe with any 2 cups of
your favorite candy bar or mini peppermint patties.
recipes.text: Heath Bar Crunch Fudge. *You can use the same recipe with any 2 cups of your favorite candy bar or mini peppermint patties.

recipes.title: Mexican Wedding Cakes
directions: Mix flour, sugar and salt.
Work in butter and vanilla.
Add nuts.
Form dough into 1-inch balls.
Place on a greased cookie sheet.
Bake at 325° for 20 to 30 minutes, until bottoms are slightly browned.
Roll warm cookies in confectioners sugar.
recipes.text: Mexican Wedding Cakes. Mix flour, sugar and salt. Work in butter and vanilla. Add nuts. Form dough into 1-inch balls. Place on a greased cookie sheet. Bake at 325° for 20 to 30 minutes, until bottoms are slightly browned. Roll warm cookies in confectioners sugar.

recipes.title: Stir-Fried Gumbo
ingredients: 2 c. ground beef, chicken breast or ham
1 medium carrot or 3/4 c. thinly sliced
directions: In a large skillet, melt butter and saute bell peppers, jalapeno, onion and carrot; cook until onion is clear.
Add the stewed tomatoes; stir and cook about 5 minutes.
Add 3/4 cup water, stirring until mixture boils.
Add meat, stirring well.
recipes.text: Stir-Fried Gumbo. In a large skillet, melt butter and saute bell peppers, jalapeno, onion and carrot; cook until onion is clear. Add the stewed tomatoes; stir and cook about 5 minutes. Add 3/4 cup water, stirring until mixture boils. Add meat, stirring well.

recipes.title: Corned Beef Casserole
directions: Boil pasta in salted water until tender; drain.
Mix pasta, cream of mushroom soup and milk.
Add the cubed cheese and corned beef.
Pour into buttered casserole; top with buttered bread crumbs.
Bake at 350° until brown.
recipes.text: Corned Beef Casserole. Boil pasta in salted water until tender; drain. Mix pasta, cream of mushroom soup and milk. Add the cubed cheese and corned beef. Pour into buttered casserole; top with buttered bread crumbs. Bake at 350° until brown.

recipes.title: Speedy Orange Rolls
directions: Dissolve yeast in warm water in a large mixing bowl and let stand 5 minutes.
Add 1 cup flour and next 4 ingredients.
Beat at medium speed with mixer until smooth.
Stir in remaining flour to make a soft dough.
Turn dough out onto a lightly floured surface; knead until smooth (about 2 minutes).
Cover and let stand 15 minutes.
Roll dough into a 14 x 7-inch rectangle; spread with 1/2 of Orange Filling, leaving a 1 inch margin on long sides.
Roll jelly roll fashion, starting at long side.
Pinch seam.
Cut into 12 equal slices.
Place cut-side down in greased muffin pans. Cover and let rise in warm place, free from drafts, 30 minutes. Bake at 400° for 16 to 18 minutes.
Spread remaining Orange Filling over tops of rolls.
Yield:
12 rolls.
recipes.text: Speedy Orange Rolls. Dissolve yeast in warm water in a large mixing bowl and let stand 5 minutes. Add 1 cup flour and next 4 ingredients. Beat at medium speed with mixer until smooth. Stir in remaining flour to make a soft dough. Turn dough out onto a lightly floured surface; knead until smooth (about 2 minutes). Cover and let stand 15 minutes. Roll dough into a 14 x 7-inch rectangle; spread with 1/2 of Orange Filling, leaving a 1 inch margin on long sides. Roll jelly roll fashion, starting at long side. Pinch seam. Cut into 12 equal slices. Place cut-side down in greased muffin pans. Cover and let rise in warm place, free from drafts, 30 minutes. Bake at 400° for 16 to 18 minutes. Spread remaining Orange Filling over tops of rolls. Yield: 12 rolls.

recipes.title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
directions: Cream butter, shortening, sugar and brown sugar.
Add flour, Bisquick, eggs, vanilla, milk, soda, chocolate chips and nuts. Bake at 375°.
recipes.text: Chocolate Chip Cookies. Cream butter, shortening, sugar and brown sugar. Add flour, Bisquick, eggs, vanilla, milk, soda, chocolate chips and nuts. Bake at 375°.

recipes.title: 7-Layer Dip
directions: In a 9 x 13-inch pan, spread refried beans.
Sprinkle with sour cream, then picante sauce.
Mash avocados and sprinkle with lemon juice.
Add on top of picante sauce.
Then add diced tomatoes.
Sprinkle top with cheese, then olives.
Chill.
recipes.text: 7-Layer Dip. In a 9 x 13-inch pan, spread refried beans. Sprinkle with sour cream, then picante sauce. Mash avocados and sprinkle with lemon juice. Add on top of picante sauce. Then add diced tomatoes. Sprinkle top with cheese, then olives. Chill.

recipes.title: Quick Pumpkin Pie
directions: Mix vanilla pudding and milk.
Stir until thickened.
Then add pumpkin, Cool Whip, pumpkin pie spice and sugar.
Mix well and put in baked pie crust or graham cracker crust.
Cover with Cool Whip. Sprinkle with chopped pecans.
recipes.text: Quick Pumpkin Pie. Mix vanilla pudding and milk. Stir until thickened. Then add pumpkin, Cool Whip, pumpkin pie spice and sugar. Mix well and put in baked pie crust or graham cracker crust. Cover with Cool Whip. Sprinkle with chopped pecans.

recipes.title: Shrimp Creole
directions: Cook and stir onion, celery, green pepper and garlic in oil until tender, not brown.
Add tomatoes, tomato sauce and seasoning.
Simmer, uncovered, 45 minutes.
Cook over low heat. Mix cornstarch with 2 teaspoons water.
Stir into sauce.
Add shrimp.
Cover and simmer until tender, about 5 minutes.
Serve over rice.
Makes 6 servings.
recipes.text: Shrimp Creole. Cook and stir onion, celery, green pepper and garlic in oil until tender, not brown. Add tomatoes, tomato sauce and seasoning. Simmer, uncovered, 45 minutes. Cook over low heat. Mix cornstarch with 2 teaspoons water. Stir into sauce. Add shrimp. Cover and simmer until tender, about 5 minutes. Serve over rice. Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Rotel Casserole
ingredients: 1 small pkg. macaroni, cooked and drained
directions: Chop pepper; mix with hamburger and brown.
Mix together. Pour into large casserole dish.
Cover with cheese.
Bake for 1/2 hour.
recipes.text: Rotel Casserole. Chop pepper; mix with hamburger and brown. Mix together. Pour into large casserole dish. Cover with cheese. Bake for 1/2 hour.

recipes.title: Esther'S Stuffed Sopaipillas
directions: Brown ground beef with diced potatoes in skillet.
Add 1/2 to 1 cup salsa with 1/2 cup hot water to skillet.
Cover and simmer on low until potatoes are soft, adding salt and pepper to taste.
Dice lettuce and tomatoes; set aside in bowl.
Grate cheese and set aside.
Fix masa trigo as for sopaipillas (follow directions on bag).
recipes.text: Esther'S Stuffed Sopaipillas. Brown ground beef with diced potatoes in skillet. Add 1/2 to 1 cup salsa with 1/2 cup hot water to skillet. Cover and simmer on low until potatoes are soft, adding salt and pepper to taste. Dice lettuce and tomatoes; set aside in bowl. Grate cheese and set aside. Fix masa trigo as for sopaipillas (follow directions on bag).

recipes.title: Dirt Cake
directions: Cream together the cream cheese, powdered sugar and butter; set aside.
Mix together the vanilla pudding and milk.
Fold Cool Whip into pudding mixture.
Mix pudding mixture with cheese mixture.
recipes.text: Dirt Cake. Cream together the cream cheese, powdered sugar and butter; set aside. Mix together the vanilla pudding and milk. Fold Cool Whip into pudding mixture. Mix pudding mixture with cheese mixture.

recipes.title: Salsa
directions: Combine ingredients and refrigerate overnight.
recipes.text: Salsa. Combine ingredients and refrigerate overnight.

recipes.title: Mardi Gras Punch
ingredients: 1 (6 oz.) can frozen orange juice, thawed
directions: In punch bowl, stir together orange juice, lemonade and apple juice.
Stir in ginger ale; scoop sherbet into balls and spoon into punch.
recipes.text: Mardi Gras Punch. In punch bowl, stir together orange juice, lemonade and apple juice. Stir in ginger ale; scoop sherbet into balls and spoon into punch.

recipes.title: Angel Crisps Cookies
directions: Cream sugar, shortening, egg and vanilla.
Add sifted dry ingredients and coconut.
Form into balls the size of walnuts. Dip top half in water, then in granulated sugar.
Bake on ungreased baking sheet.
Press down in center with fingers.
Bake at 425° for 6 to 10 minutes.
Yields 4 dozen.
recipes.text: Angel Crisps Cookies. Cream sugar, shortening, egg and vanilla. Add sifted dry ingredients and coconut. Form into balls the size of walnuts. Dip top half in water, then in granulated sugar. Bake on ungreased baking sheet. Press down in center with fingers. Bake at 425° for 6 to 10 minutes. Yields 4 dozen.

recipes.title: Page'S Punch
directions: For 1 gallon have ready 2 (1/2 gallon) containers.
Makeup lemonade as directed on can.
Put one quart in each container. Add 2 cups white grape juice to each container.

Refrigerate. Just before serving, add cold ginger ale to fill each container. Ice cubes can be made of ginger ale, or lemonade, or punch mixture. Add tiny wedge of lemon and 1/2 a cherry for color to each.
recipes.text: Page'S Punch. For 1 gallon have ready 2 (1/2 gallon) containers. Makeup lemonade as directed on can. Put one quart in each container. Add 2 cups white grape juice to each container. Refrigerate. Just before serving, add cold ginger ale to fill each container. Ice cubes can be made of ginger ale, or lemonade, or punch mixture. Add tiny wedge of lemon and 1/2 a cherry for color to each.

recipes.title: Pink Lemonade Pie
ingredients: 1 can frozen (6 oz.) concentrated pink lemonade, partially thawed
1 can (14 oz.) Borden sweet condensed milk
1 (6 oz.) prepared graham cracker crumb crust
directions: Beat lemonade in large bowl about 30 seconds.
Gradually spoon in Cool Whip, blending well.
Add condensed milk until well mixed. Pour mixture into graham cracker pie crust, smooth over.
Freeze overnight.
Makes 8 to 10 servings.
recipes.text: Pink Lemonade Pie. Beat lemonade in large bowl about 30 seconds. Gradually spoon in Cool Whip, blending well. Add condensed milk until well mixed. Pour mixture into graham cracker pie crust, smooth over. Freeze overnight. Makes 8 to 10 servings.

recipes.title: Orange Sherbet Salad
directions: Dissolve jello in boiling water.
Add sherbet and let thicken slightly.
Add bananas, oranges and pineapple.
Fold in whipped cream.
recipes.text: Orange Sherbet Salad. Dissolve jello in boiling water. Add sherbet and let thicken slightly. Add bananas, oranges and pineapple. Fold in whipped cream.

recipes.title: Spinach Vegetable Dip
ingredients: 2 1/2 oz. frozen chopped spinach, placed in blender while still frozen
directions: Mix well.
Let stand overnight.
Use as a dip for a vegetable tray.
recipes.text: Spinach Vegetable Dip. Mix well. Let stand overnight. Use as a dip for a vegetable tray.

recipes.title: Pretzel Salad
directions: Crush pretzels (not too fine).
Mix with butter or margarine and brown sugar.
Pack into large 9 x 12-inch pan.
Bake at 350° for 10 minutes.
Remove from oven and cool.
(This is the crust or base.)
recipes.text: Pretzel Salad. Crush pretzels (not too fine). Mix with butter or margarine and brown sugar. Pack into large 9 x 12-inch pan. Bake at 350° for 10 minutes. Remove from oven and cool. (This is the crust or base.)

recipes.title: Exalee'S Vanilla Wafer Cake
directions: Cream oleo and sugar.
Add eggs, vanilla and coconut.
Mix well.
Add crushed vanilla wafers, milk and pecans.
Pour into 10-inch tube pan.
Bake at 325° for 1 1/2 hours.
Cool 10 minutes in pan, then remove.
recipes.text: Exalee'S Vanilla Wafer Cake. Cream oleo and sugar. Add eggs, vanilla and coconut. Mix well. Add crushed vanilla wafers, milk and pecans. Pour into 10-inch tube pan. Bake at 325° for 1 1/2 hours. Cool 10 minutes in pan, then remove.

recipes.title: Roast Leg Of Lamb
directions: Preheat oven to 450°.
Generously grease a roasting pan with Crisco, then sprinkle liberally with flour.
I use approximately 1/4 cup of flour.
Place the rack in the pan.
The Crisco and flour will brown and combine with the pan drippings to make a brown gravy. Remove excess fat and fell from lamb.
(The fell is the paper like membrane covering the meat.)
Cut small slits in the lamb and insert slivers of garlic into the meat.
Rub the meat with freshly ground pepper, rosemary and olive oil. Spread the mustard generously over the surface of the meat.
Place the lamb on the rack in the roasting pan.
Place leg of lamb in oven and immediately reduce heat to 325°.
Roast approximately 30 minutes per pound.
recipes.text: Roast Leg Of Lamb. Preheat oven to 450°. Generously grease a roasting pan with Crisco, then sprinkle liberally with flour. I use approximately 1/4 cup of flour. Place the rack in the pan. The Crisco and flour will brown and combine with the pan drippings to make a brown gravy. Remove excess fat and fell from lamb. (The fell is the paper like membrane covering the meat.) Cut small slits in the lamb and insert slivers of garlic into the meat. Rub the meat with freshly ground pepper, rosemary and olive oil. Spread the mustard generously over the surface of the meat. Place the lamb on the rack in the roasting pan. Place leg of lamb in oven and immediately reduce heat to 325°. Roast approximately 30 minutes per pound.

recipes.title: Chocolate Mousse Cake
ingredients: additional chocolate and cream for decorating
directions: Prepare angel food cake according to package directions, except add grated square of chocolate to batter before pouring into tube pan.
Bake for 30 to 40 minutes.
Cool in pan by inverting over bottle.
Mix the cream, sugar and cocoa; refrigerate until very cold.
Sprinkle gelatin over 2 tablespoons cold water; let stand 5 minutes, then heat, stirring, over hot water until dissolved.
Let cool.
recipes.text: Chocolate Mousse Cake. Prepare angel food cake according to package directions, except add grated square of chocolate to batter before pouring into tube pan. Bake for 30 to 40 minutes. Cool in pan by inverting over bottle. Mix the cream, sugar and cocoa; refrigerate until very cold. Sprinkle gelatin over 2 tablespoons cold water; let stand 5 minutes, then heat, stirring, over hot water until dissolved. Let cool.

recipes.title: Beef And Pinwheel Casserole
directions: Brown beef and onion in butter; sprinkle with salt, pepper and flour.
Stir in peas and pour in greased shallow casserole and set aside.
Make biscuit dough and turn out on lightly floured board and knead gently 1/2 minute; roll or pat 1/2 inch thick and spread with melted butter.
Sprinkle with chopped parsley and roll up like a jellyroll.
Cut in 1/2 inch slices and place cut side down on top of meat and vegetable mixture.
Bake at 400° for 20 to 25 minutes.
Serves 6.
recipes.text: Beef And Pinwheel Casserole. Brown beef and onion in butter; sprinkle with salt, pepper and flour. Stir in peas and pour in greased shallow casserole and set aside. Make biscuit dough and turn out on lightly floured board and knead gently 1/2 minute; roll or pat 1/2 inch thick and spread with melted butter. Sprinkle with chopped parsley and roll up like a jellyroll. Cut in 1/2 inch slices and place cut side down on top of meat and vegetable mixture. Bake at 400° for 20 to 25 minutes. Serves 6.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Swirl Brownies
ingredients: 1/4 c. plus 2 Tbsp. reduced calorie stick margarine, melted
1/4 c. 25% less fat creamy peanut butter
directions: Combine margarine and brown sugar in a medium bowl; add egg substitute.
Beat at medium speed of an electric mixer until thoroughly combined.
Add vanilla; beat well.
Combine flour, baking powder and salt; add to sugar mixture, stirring well. Divide batter in half.
Stir cocoa into 1 half; stir peanut butter into other half (peanut butter mixture will be thick).
Spoon dollops of each batter alternately into a 9-inch square pan coated with cooking spray.
Cut through batters in pan with knife to create a swirled pattern.
Bake at 350° for 25 minutes or until a wooden pick inserted in center comes out clean.
Remove from oven, and let cool completely on wire rack.
Yields 16 brownies.
recipes.text: Peanut Butter Swirl Brownies. Combine margarine and brown sugar in a medium bowl; add egg substitute. Beat at medium speed of an electric mixer until thoroughly combined. Add vanilla; beat well. Combine flour, baking powder and salt; add to sugar mixture, stirring well. Divide batter in half. Stir cocoa into 1 half; stir peanut butter into other half (peanut butter mixture will be thick). Spoon dollops of each batter alternately into a 9-inch square pan coated with cooking spray. Cut through batters in pan with knife to create a swirled pattern. Bake at 350° for 25 minutes or until a wooden pick inserted in center comes out clean. Remove from oven, and let cool completely on wire rack. Yields 16 brownies.

recipes.title: Apple Tart
directions: Combine flour and salt in a medium bowl.
Cut in butter until crumbly.
Add 3 tablespoons water, mixing to form ball.
Let stand in lightly floured cloth for 1 hour.
Roll until thin on floured surface.
Line buttered and floured 10-inch pie pan with dough. Cut to fit and prick bottom with fork.
Arrange apples slightly, overlapping on dough.
Sprinkle with sugar.
Bake at 400° for 35 to 40 minutes or until brown.
Spread jelly over hot apples.
recipes.text: Apple Tart. Combine flour and salt in a medium bowl. Cut in butter until crumbly. Add 3 tablespoons water, mixing to form ball. Let stand in lightly floured cloth for 1 hour. Roll until thin on floured surface. Line buttered and floured 10-inch pie pan with dough. Cut to fit and prick bottom with fork. Arrange apples slightly, overlapping on dough. Sprinkle with sugar. Bake at 400° for 35 to 40 minutes or until brown. Spread jelly over hot apples.

recipes.title: Hawaiian Nut Bread
directions: Combine dry ingredients; stir in nuts and set aside.
Combine remaining ingredients.
Add to dry ingredients, stirring just until batter is moistened.
Spoon batter into 2 greased and floured 9x5x3 inch loaf pans.
Bake at 350° for 60 to 65 minutes.
Cool 10 minutes before removing from pans.	Serve cold with ice cream or toasted with butter.
Yield:
2 loaves.
recipes.text: Hawaiian Nut Bread. Combine dry ingredients; stir in nuts and set aside. Combine remaining ingredients. Add to dry ingredients, stirring just until batter is moistened. Spoon batter into 2 greased and floured 9x5x3 inch loaf pans. Bake at 350° for 60 to 65 minutes. Cool 10 minutes before removing from pans.	Serve cold with ice cream or toasted with butter. Yield: 2 loaves.

recipes.title: Pork Tenderloin
directions: Pat dry pork tenderloin (usually long tubular in shape and packaged with two together).
Rub on Dijon mustard to meat; coat approximately 1/8-inch thick.
Sprinkle with tarragon, approximately 1 teaspoon per pound. Wrap tenderloin with bacon. Use toothpicks to secure two pieces together. Bake at 350° for 20 minutes per pound or until cooked to 160°.
recipes.text: Pork Tenderloin. Pat dry pork tenderloin (usually long tubular in shape and packaged with two together). Rub on Dijon mustard to meat; coat approximately 1/8-inch thick. Sprinkle with tarragon, approximately 1 teaspoon per pound. Wrap tenderloin with bacon. Use toothpicks to secure two pieces together. Bake at 350° for 20 minutes per pound or until cooked to 160°.

recipes.title: Mama'S Fudge
directions: Pour boiling ingredients in bowl and stir until chocolate is melted.
Pour into 9 x 13-inch pan.
Let stand a few hours before cutting.
Store in tin box.
recipes.text: Mama'S Fudge. Pour boiling ingredients in bowl and stir until chocolate is melted. Pour into 9 x 13-inch pan. Let stand a few hours before cutting. Store in tin box.

recipes.title: Sweet And Sour Pork(Microwave)
directions: In a 2-quart casserole combine the oil, garlic and scallions. Cook on High for 1 minute.
Drain the pineapple chunks, reserving the liquid.
Stir the pineapple chunks and pork into the garlic and scallions.
In a small bowl, stir the reserved pineapple juice, brown sugar, vinegar, and cornstarch until smooth.
Stir into the pork mixture.
Cook on High for 2 to 4 minutes, or until heated through, stirring each minute.
recipes.text: Sweet And Sour Pork(Microwave). In a 2-quart casserole combine the oil, garlic and scallions. Cook on High for 1 minute. Drain the pineapple chunks, reserving the liquid. Stir the pineapple chunks and pork into the garlic and scallions. In a small bowl, stir the reserved pineapple juice, brown sugar, vinegar, and cornstarch until smooth. Stir into the pork mixture. Cook on High for 2 to 4 minutes, or until heated through, stirring each minute.

recipes.title: Spinach Quiche(Microwave)
ingredients: 1 (10 oz.) pkg. frozen chopped spinach, thawed and squeezed dry
directions: Cook first three ingredients on High until onion is soft, about 3 to 4 minutes.
Combine next five ingredients in bowl and beat until well blended.
Add cheese, spinach and seasoning and mix thoroughly.
Pour into pie shell.
Cook on 70% power until center is barely set, about 15 to 20 minutes.
Let stand 5 minutes before serving.
Yields 6 servings.
Total cooking time is 15 to 20 minutes.
recipes.text: Spinach Quiche(Microwave). Cook first three ingredients on High until onion is soft, about 3 to 4 minutes. Combine next five ingredients in bowl and beat until well blended. Add cheese, spinach and seasoning and mix thoroughly. Pour into pie shell. Cook on 70% power until center is barely set, about 15 to 20 minutes. Let stand 5 minutes before serving. Yields 6 servings. Total cooking time is 15 to 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Strawberry Cheesecake
directions: Fix Dream Whip as directed.
Blend cream cheese with 1/2 cup of powdered sugar.
Mix cream cheese mixture with Dream Whip and spread over graham cracker crust.
Then dissolve jello in boiling water.
Add frozen strawberries.
Stir until thick.
Pour over cream cheese and Dream Whip mixture and chill.
recipes.text: Strawberry Cheesecake. Fix Dream Whip as directed. Blend cream cheese with 1/2 cup of powdered sugar. Mix cream cheese mixture with Dream Whip and spread over graham cracker crust. Then dissolve jello in boiling water. Add frozen strawberries. Stir until thick. Pour over cream cheese and Dream Whip mixture and chill.

recipes.title: Sweet Potato Casserole
directions: Cook sweet potatoes until soft; mash well, then add sugar, melted butter, 2 well beaten eggs, vanilla and milk.
Pour in casserole, then add topping.
recipes.text: Sweet Potato Casserole. Cook sweet potatoes until soft; mash well, then add sugar, melted butter, 2 well beaten eggs, vanilla and milk. Pour in casserole, then add topping.

recipes.title: Pistachio Cake
ingredients: 1 small box pistachio instant pudding mix
1/2 c. chopped nuts, pecans or walnuts
directions: Preheat oven to 350°.
Mix cake and pudding mixes, eggs, water, oil and sugar, reserving 1 cup batter.
Pour nuts and chocolate bits into bottom of greased Bundt or tube pan, flat bottom.
