Pour Hershey's syrup into reserved batter; mix well. Pour big batch of batter in pan, then pour syrup and batter mixture on top.
Bake 1 hour; cool for 20 minutes.
Remove from the pan.
recipes.text: Pistachio Cake. Preheat oven to 350°. Mix cake and pudding mixes, eggs, water, oil and sugar, reserving 1 cup batter. Pour nuts and chocolate bits into bottom of greased Bundt or tube pan, flat bottom. Pour Hershey's syrup into reserved batter; mix well. Pour big batch of batter in pan, then pour syrup and batter mixture on top. Bake 1 hour; cool for 20 minutes. Remove from the pan.

recipes.title: Spiced Tea Mix
ingredients: 1 (.31 oz.) pkg. unsweetened lemon flavored drink mix
directions: Combine all ingredients in a large bowl; stir well.
Store mix in an airtight container at room temperature.
recipes.text: Spiced Tea Mix. Combine all ingredients in a large bowl; stir well. Store mix in an airtight container at room temperature.

recipes.title: Plantation Casserole
ingredients: 1 stick Cracker Barrel sharp cheese, grated
directions: Layer Rice Krispies, sausage, rice and grated cheese in 9 x 13-inch pan.
Combine eggs, soup and milk.
Pour over mixture. Punch holes in mixture (I use handle of wooden spoon).
Sprinkle last 1/2 cup Rice Krispies on top.
Refrigerate overnight, if desired.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Plantation Casserole. Layer Rice Krispies, sausage, rice and grated cheese in 9 x 13-inch pan. Combine eggs, soup and milk. Pour over mixture. Punch holes in mixture (I use handle of wooden spoon). Sprinkle last 1/2 cup Rice Krispies on top. Refrigerate overnight, if desired. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Christmas Salad
directions: Dissolve jello with water and add all other ingredients except sour cream.

Pour half of mixture into long dish and congeal. When this is congealed, spread sour cream over entire portion and then spread the remaining mixture of jello over the sour cream. Place in refrigerator to congeal.
recipes.text: Christmas Salad. Dissolve jello with water and add all other ingredients except sour cream. Pour half of mixture into long dish and congeal. When this is congealed, spread sour cream over entire portion and then spread the remaining mixture of jello over the sour cream. Place in refrigerator to congeal.

recipes.title: Broccoli Casserole
directions: Parboil broccoli in least amount of water possible.
Salt to taste.
Place cooked broccoli in a 9 x 13-inch greased pan.
Cover with 1 can cream of celery soup.
Lay cheese slices over all. Prepare a large box of stuffing mix and spoon over ingredients in pan.
Bake at 350° for 35 minutes.
recipes.text: Broccoli Casserole. Parboil broccoli in least amount of water possible. Salt to taste. Place cooked broccoli in a 9 x 13-inch greased pan. Cover with 1 can cream of celery soup. Lay cheese slices over all. Prepare a large box of stuffing mix and spoon over ingredients in pan. Bake at 350° for 35 minutes.

recipes.title: Hearty Potato Soup
directions: In a
large kettle, cook potatoes, carrots and celery in water until tender, about 20 minutes.
Drain, reserving liquid, and setting vegetables aside.
In the same kettle, saute onion in butter until soft.
Stir in flour, salt and pepper; gradually add milk, stirring constantly, until thickened.
Gently stir in cooked vegetables.
Add one cup or more of reserved cooking liquid until soup is desired consistency.
Yield:
8 to 10 servings.
recipes.text: Hearty Potato Soup. In a large kettle, cook potatoes, carrots and celery in water until tender, about 20 minutes. Drain, reserving liquid, and setting vegetables aside. In the same kettle, saute onion in butter until soft. Stir in flour, salt and pepper; gradually add milk, stirring constantly, until thickened. Gently stir in cooked vegetables. Add one cup or more of reserved cooking liquid until soup is desired consistency. Yield: 8 to 10 servings.

recipes.title: Rice Pudding
directions: Combine first 4 ingredients.
Pour into a greased 1 1/2-quart baking dish.
Bake at 300° for 1 hour.
Stir several times.
Add nutmeg, cinnamon and raisins.
Bake 2 to 2 1/2 hours.
recipes.text: Rice Pudding. Combine first 4 ingredients. Pour into a greased 1 1/2-quart baking dish. Bake at 300° for 1 hour. Stir several times. Add nutmeg, cinnamon and raisins. Bake 2 to 2 1/2 hours.

recipes.title: Whole Wheat Bread
ingredients: 1/2 c. sugar (3/4 c. honey = 1 c. sugar)
directions: Combine water, sugar or honey, dry milk, salt and oil in pan. Heat to 120° to 130°.
Stir together whole wheat flour and yeast in bowl.
Add warm liquid and beaten eggs.
Beat at low speed with electric mixer 1/2 minute.
Scrape sides and bottom.
Then beat high speed 3 minutes.
Stir in rest of flour to make a moderately soft dough.
Knead 5 minutes.
Place in greased bowl.
Let rise 1 1/2 hours, punch down.
Let rest 5 minutes.
Make into loaves or rolls.
Bake at 350°.
recipes.text: Whole Wheat Bread. Combine water, sugar or honey, dry milk, salt and oil in pan. Heat to 120° to 130°. Stir together whole wheat flour and yeast in bowl. Add warm liquid and beaten eggs. Beat at low speed with electric mixer 1/2 minute. Scrape sides and bottom. Then beat high speed 3 minutes. Stir in rest of flour to make a moderately soft dough. Knead 5 minutes. Place in greased bowl. Let rise 1 1/2 hours, punch down. Let rest 5 minutes. Make into loaves or rolls. Bake at 350°.

recipes.title: Macaroni Salad
directions: Cook macaroni and drain.
Chop onion, bell pepper and carrots. Mix all ingredients and chill overnight.
recipes.text: Macaroni Salad. Cook macaroni and drain. Chop onion, bell pepper and carrots. Mix all ingredients and chill overnight.

recipes.title: Date Cake
directions: Soak chopped dates in boiling water and then mash.
Cream together the shortening and sugar.
Beat in the egg.
Add dry ingredients and mix well.
recipes.text: Date Cake. Soak chopped dates in boiling water and then mash. Cream together the shortening and sugar. Beat in the egg. Add dry ingredients and mix well.

recipes.title: Never Fail Chocolate Frosting
directions: Combine sugar, milk and butter.
Bring to a full boil (a boil that can't be stirred down).
Time it 1 1/2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Remove from heat.
Add chips and marshmallows.
Stir until thick.
recipes.text: Never Fail Chocolate Frosting. Combine sugar, milk and butter. Bring to a full boil (a boil that can't be stirred down). Time it 1 1/2 minutes, stirring constantly. Remove from heat. Add chips and marshmallows. Stir until thick.

recipes.title: Cabbage Casserole
directions: Heat mixture to boiling; reduce heat, cover and simmer about 25 minutes or until rice is tender.
Stir once or twice.
Makes 4 to 6 servings.
recipes.text: Cabbage Casserole. Heat mixture to boiling; reduce heat, cover and simmer about 25 minutes or until rice is tender. Stir once or twice. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

recipes.title: Peach Marmalade
ingredients: 1 orange with peel (put in blender and puree)
directions: Mix all ingredients together.
Bring to a boil for 12 minutes. Ladle into hot jars and seal tightly.
recipes.text: Peach Marmalade. Mix all ingredients together. Bring to a boil for 12 minutes. Ladle into hot jars and seal tightly.

recipes.title: Banana Nut Bread
directions: Mix ingredients in order.
Pour in greased long bread pan. Bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Banana Nut Bread. Mix ingredients in order. Pour in greased long bread pan. Bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Grandma Miller'S Dressing
directions: Beat and cook first five ingredients until thickened.
Beat the cream cheese until soft.
Add the grated onion.
Add the cooked ingredients.
Mix well and add pepper to taste.
Great served on sliced cucumbers.
recipes.text: Grandma Miller'S Dressing. Beat and cook first five ingredients until thickened. Beat the cream cheese until soft. Add the grated onion. Add the cooked ingredients. Mix well and add pepper to taste. Great served on sliced cucumbers.

recipes.title: Broccoli Salad
ingredients: 4 c. chopped fresh broccoli flowers and stems
directions: Mix together mayonnaise, vinegar and sugar.
Put bacon into mixture.
Mix all ingredients together and toss.
You may mix all ingredients except the mayonnaise mixture the night before. Serves 10.
recipes.text: Broccoli Salad. Mix together mayonnaise, vinegar and sugar. Put bacon into mixture. Mix all ingredients together and toss. You may mix all ingredients except the mayonnaise mixture the night before. Serves 10.

recipes.title: "Fit For Company Chicken"(Or 3 Meat Dinner)
directions: Slice the 4 breasts in half.
Roll the 8 pieces of chicken with the 1/2 slices of bacon; 2 half slices per breast in either direction.,
Place atop a dried beef lined baking dish, 8 x 8 x 2-inch.
Combine soups and sour cream; pour over the top of rolled chicken breasts. Cover with remaining slices of dried beef. Bake at 275° for 2 hours.
Serve over rice or with mashed potatoes.
recipes.text: "Fit For Company Chicken"(Or 3 Meat Dinner). Slice the 4 breasts in half. Roll the 8 pieces of chicken with the 1/2 slices of bacon; 2 half slices per breast in either direction., Place atop a dried beef lined baking dish, 8 x 8 x 2-inch. Combine soups and sour cream; pour over the top of rolled chicken breasts. Cover with remaining slices of dried beef. Bake at 275° for 2 hours. Serve over rice or with mashed potatoes.

recipes.title: Northern-Style Dumplings
directions: Combine flour, salt and baking powder.
Cut in shortening until mixture is crumbly.
Pour in milk and add egg.
Mix only until flour is dampened.
Don't worry about lumps.
Drop by spoonfuls on top of boiling meat or fruit.
Cover tightly and steam for 12 minutes without raising cover.
recipes.text: Northern-Style Dumplings. Combine flour, salt and baking powder. Cut in shortening until mixture is crumbly. Pour in milk and add egg. Mix only until flour is dampened. Don't worry about lumps. Drop by spoonfuls on top of boiling meat or fruit. Cover tightly and steam for 12 minutes without raising cover.

recipes.title: Peach Cobbler
directions: Melt oleo in saucepan.
Sift flour and baking powder together; add sugar, then milk and oleo.
Mix well.
Put in Pyrex baking dish; put can of peaches on top of mixture.
DO NOT STIR. Cinnamon can be used on top.
Bake at 400° until done.
recipes.text: Peach Cobbler. Melt oleo in saucepan. Sift flour and baking powder together; add sugar, then milk and oleo. Mix well. Put in Pyrex baking dish; put can of peaches on top of mixture. DO NOT STIR. Cinnamon can be used on top. Bake at 400° until done.

recipes.title: Hamburger Skillet Dish
directions: Brown rice in shortening in heavy skillet, stirring frequently.
Add ground round, onion and celery; brown well.
Add tomatoes and other ingredients.
Cover and simmer until rice is tender, about 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Hamburger Skillet Dish. Brown rice in shortening in heavy skillet, stirring frequently. Add ground round, onion and celery; brown well. Add tomatoes and other ingredients. Cover and simmer until rice is tender, about 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Three Cheese Chicken Bake
ingredients: 1 (10 3/4 oz.) can condensed cream of chicken soup (undiluted)
1 (8 oz.) pkg. noodles, cooked and drained
directions: In a skillet, saute onion and green pepper in margarine until tender.
Remove from heat.
Stir in soup, mushrooms, pimientos and basil; set aside.
In large bowl combine noodles, chicken and cheese.
Add mushroom sauce and mix well.
Transfer to a greased 9 x 13-inch pan.
Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes or until bubbly.
Sprinkle with crumbs.
Bake 15 minutes longer. Yield:
12 to 15 servings.
recipes.text: Three Cheese Chicken Bake. In a skillet, saute onion and green pepper in margarine until tender. Remove from heat. Stir in soup, mushrooms, pimientos and basil; set aside. In large bowl combine noodles, chicken and cheese. Add mushroom sauce and mix well. Transfer to a greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes or until bubbly. Sprinkle with crumbs. Bake 15 minutes longer. Yield: 12 to 15 servings.

recipes.title: Shrimp Spread
ingredients: 1/2 tsp. Old Bay seasoning or seafood seasoning
1 lb. small shrimp, cleaned, cooked and chopped
directions: Combine all ingredients in a large bowl and mix well. Refrigerate until ready to serve. Serve with crackers or toast points.
recipes.text: Shrimp Spread. Combine all ingredients in a large bowl and mix well. Refrigerate until ready to serve. Serve with crackers or toast points.

recipes.title: Vegetable Dip
ingredients: 1 Tbsp. Beau Monde (Spice Islands seasoning, sold at UKrops)
directions: Mix all ingredients.
Serve with fresh vegetables.
recipes.text: Vegetable Dip. Mix all ingredients. Serve with fresh vegetables.

recipes.title: Golden Cream Soup
directions: In large saucepan, add everything but cheese, milk and cornstarch.
Cover with cold water and lid.
Simmer until tender; let set 7 to 10 minutes.
Mix milk and cornstarch and add to vegetables.
Cook until slightly thickened.
Stir in cheese until melted.
Delicious and hearty!
Makes about 3 quarts.
recipes.text: Golden Cream Soup. In large saucepan, add everything but cheese, milk and cornstarch. Cover with cold water and lid. Simmer until tender; let set 7 to 10 minutes. Mix milk and cornstarch and add to vegetables. Cook until slightly thickened. Stir in cheese until melted. Delicious and hearty! Makes about 3 quarts.

recipes.title: Fannie May Fudge
directions: Combine butter, sugar and milk in large pan on medium-high heat.
Stir until melted. Add marshmallows and stir until boiling. Turn off heat.
Add chocolate chips, Hershey bars and unsweetened chocolate.
Stir well until mixed. Pour into well-greased jelly roll pan or 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan.
Cool and cut into bite size squares.
recipes.text: Fannie May Fudge. Combine butter, sugar and milk in large pan on medium-high heat. Stir until melted. Add marshmallows and stir until boiling. Turn off heat. Add chocolate chips, Hershey bars and unsweetened chocolate. Stir well until mixed. Pour into well-greased jelly roll pan or 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan. Cool and cut into bite size squares.

recipes.title: Millionaires Bars
directions: Melt caramels in milk over low heat; stir in pecans.
Drop by teaspoon onto waxed paper.
Chill.
Melt butter and chocolate over low heat or double boiler.
Remove from heat.
Dip caramel into chocolate and return to wax paper.
recipes.text: Millionaires Bars. Melt caramels in milk over low heat; stir in pecans. Drop by teaspoon onto waxed paper. Chill. Melt butter and chocolate over low heat or double boiler. Remove from heat. Dip caramel into chocolate and return to wax paper.

recipes.title: Pot Roast And Vegetables
directions: Put roast in pan of water.
Add green beans, potatoes, onion, salt and pepper.
Cook for 3 hours or until roast is tender.
recipes.text: Pot Roast And Vegetables. Put roast in pan of water. Add green beans, potatoes, onion, salt and pepper. Cook for 3 hours or until roast is tender.

recipes.title: Ed'S Bourbon Balls
directions: Place chopped pecans in a glass bowl and cover with whiskey. Let stand overnight.
Melt butter and combine with confectioners sugar and pecan/bourbon mixture.
Mix with wooden spoon.
Let batter cool (1 hour to overnight).
Roll into balls.
Let stand in refrigerator for 1 hour or in freezer for 30 minutes.
Melt the chocolate and keep it at minimum heat.
Using toothpicks, dip balls into chocolate and place onto wax paper.
Makes 90 to 160, depending on the size.
recipes.text: Ed'S Bourbon Balls. Place chopped pecans in a glass bowl and cover with whiskey. Let stand overnight. Melt butter and combine with confectioners sugar and pecan/bourbon mixture. Mix with wooden spoon. Let batter cool (1 hour to overnight). Roll into balls. Let stand in refrigerator for 1 hour or in freezer for 30 minutes. Melt the chocolate and keep it at minimum heat. Using toothpicks, dip balls into chocolate and place onto wax paper. Makes 90 to 160, depending on the size.

recipes.title: Pound Cake 2
directions: Cream butter, sugar and Crisco.
Add sour cream and blend.
Add eggs, one at a time.
Mix in vanilla.
Sift flour, baking powder and salt.
Add alternately with milk.
Bake at 325° for 1 hour and 20 minutes in 10-inch tube pan.
recipes.text: Pound Cake 2. Cream butter, sugar and Crisco. Add sour cream and blend. Add eggs, one at a time. Mix in vanilla. Sift flour, baking powder and salt. Add alternately with milk. Bake at 325° for 1 hour and 20 minutes in 10-inch tube pan.

recipes.title: Mashed Potato Casserole(Twice Baked)
directions: Boil and mash potatoes.
Add remaining ingredients.
Put in a casserole; put in oven on low heat, depending on when you are ready to eat.
This saves mashing the potatoes the last minute. Can also use broccoli.
recipes.text: Mashed Potato Casserole(Twice Baked). Boil and mash potatoes. Add remaining ingredients. Put in a casserole; put in oven on low heat, depending on when you are ready to eat. This saves mashing the potatoes the last minute. Can also use broccoli.

recipes.title: Orange Salad
ingredients: 1 (8 oz.) carton small curd cottage cheese
directions: Put cottage cheese in a bowl; pour the dry Jell-O over the top and mix with a spoon.
Add pineapple and oranges, which have been drained good.
Lightly mix the tub of Cool Whip into this mixture and put in refrigerator to set up.
Will be ready to serve in a few hours.
recipes.text: Orange Salad. Put cottage cheese in a bowl; pour the dry Jell-O over the top and mix with a spoon. Add pineapple and oranges, which have been drained good. Lightly mix the tub of Cool Whip into this mixture and put in refrigerator to set up. Will be ready to serve in a few hours.

recipes.title: Orange Cranberry Bread
directions: Chop cranberries until coarse.
Chop pecans coarsely; reserve. In a bowl, cream sugar, butter and orange rind until smooth.
In another bowl, combine the flour, baking powder, salt and baking soda.
Mix the orange juice and egg together until well blended. Stir the flour mixture into the sugar mixture until blended.
Add the orange juice and egg.
Stir until blended but do not overmix. It will be rather stiff.
Add the cranberries and pecans.
Turn into a lightly greased 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour or until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean.
Cool bread in pan 15 minutes.
Remove from pan.
Cool on wire rack.
recipes.text: Orange Cranberry Bread. Chop cranberries until coarse. Chop pecans coarsely; reserve. In a bowl, cream sugar, butter and orange rind until smooth. In another bowl, combine the flour, baking powder, salt and baking soda. Mix the orange juice and egg together until well blended. Stir the flour mixture into the sugar mixture until blended. Add the orange juice and egg. Stir until blended but do not overmix. It will be rather stiff. Add the cranberries and pecans. Turn into a lightly greased 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan. Bake at 350° for 1 hour or until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean. Cool bread in pan 15 minutes. Remove from pan. Cool on wire rack.

recipes.title: T.T.'S Party Punch
ingredients: 1/2 gal. any kind sherbet ice cream
directions: Mix punch and 7-Up in punch bowl and float sherbet.
recipes.text: T.T.'S Party Punch. Mix punch and 7-Up in punch bowl and float sherbet.

recipes.title: Glazed Carrots(Microwave)
directions: Place
carrots	in
quart casserole dish.
Add brown sugar and
butter.
Microwave on High for 5 minutes, covered. Stir and recover
and cook additional 5 minutes on High.
Mix water and cornstarch.
Stir in cornstarch and nuts.
Microwave on High until
carrot
mixture has thickened, 3 to 4 minutes. Serves 4.
recipes.text: Glazed Carrots(Microwave). Place carrots	in 1 quart casserole dish. Add brown sugar and butter. Microwave on High for 5 minutes, covered. Stir and recover and cook additional 5 minutes on High. Mix water and cornstarch. Stir in cornstarch and nuts. Microwave on High until carrot mixture has thickened, 3 to 4 minutes. Serves 4.

recipes.title: Rice Casserole
ingredients: 1 beef bouillon cube, dissolved in 1 c. hot water
directions: Mix all ingredients together.
Put in a casserole dish.
Bake, covered, one hour at 325°.
recipes.text: Rice Casserole. Mix all ingredients together. Put in a casserole dish. Bake, covered, one hour at 325°.

recipes.title: Hazel'S Hassenpfeffer(Rabbit)
directions: Skin, dress, draw and clean hare.
Cut meat from bones.
Melt butter in saucepan.
Add bacon, carrots, bay leaf, cloves, garlic, salt, pepper, mustard seed, onion, mushrooms and hare meat.
Brown well.
Add 1 cup water or vinegar.
Cover and simmer until tender, about an hour.
Add cream; mix well and serve.
Use young rabbits and hares weighing 2 to 3 pounds.
Do not eat those with unpleasant odors.
They should be drawn and cleaned as soon as possible after killing, but need not be skinned until time to cook.
We used cottontail rabbits; never did have to raise rabbits, as we always found them around the hay fields.
recipes.text: Hazel'S Hassenpfeffer(Rabbit). Skin, dress, draw and clean hare. Cut meat from bones. Melt butter in saucepan. Add bacon, carrots, bay leaf, cloves, garlic, salt, pepper, mustard seed, onion, mushrooms and hare meat. Brown well. Add 1 cup water or vinegar. Cover and simmer until tender, about an hour. Add cream; mix well and serve. Use young rabbits and hares weighing 2 to 3 pounds. Do not eat those with unpleasant odors. They should be drawn and cleaned as soon as possible after killing, but need not be skinned until time to cook. We used cottontail rabbits; never did have to raise rabbits, as we always found them around the hay fields.

recipes.title: Homestyle Chicken Vegetable Soup
ingredients: 2 (10 1/2 oz.) cans condensed cream of chicken soup
10 oz. pkg. frozen peas and carrots
directions: Combine all ingredients in saucepan.
Bring to a boil.
Cover; simmer until vegetables are tender (approximately 10 minutes). Makes 6 to 8 servings.
recipes.text: Homestyle Chicken Vegetable Soup. Combine all ingredients in saucepan. Bring to a boil. Cover; simmer until vegetables are tender (approximately 10 minutes). Makes 6 to 8 servings.

recipes.title: Chicken And Wild Rice
ingredients: 1 box Uncle Ben's original brown wild rice
directions: Cook chicken; skin and debone.
Pull apart in chunks.
Melt butter and saute onion.
Add soup, milk, flour and salt and pepper.
Cook until thick.
Cook wild rice as directed on box.
In baking dish, put 1 layer of rice and 1 layer of chicken, then add sauce.
(May make 2 layers.) Bake, uncovered, in oven at 350° for 20 minutes.
Add grated cheese.
recipes.text: Chicken And Wild Rice. Cook chicken; skin and debone. Pull apart in chunks. Melt butter and saute onion. Add soup, milk, flour and salt and pepper. Cook until thick. Cook wild rice as directed on box. In baking dish, put 1 layer of rice and 1 layer of chicken, then add sauce. (May make 2 layers.) Bake, uncovered, in oven at 350° for 20 minutes. Add grated cheese.

recipes.title: Easy Gingerbread Cookies
directions: Heat oven to 375°.
By hand, mix dry cake mix, water, flour and butter.
Roll into balls and roll in sugar, then flatten slightly.
Or, roll out on floured surface and cut with cookie cutter.
Bake 6 to 9 minutes on ungreased cookie sheet.
recipes.text: Easy Gingerbread Cookies. Heat oven to 375°. By hand, mix dry cake mix, water, flour and butter. Roll into balls and roll in sugar, then flatten slightly. Or, roll out on floured surface and cut with cookie cutter. Bake 6 to 9 minutes on ungreased cookie sheet.

recipes.title: Honey Of A Cornbread
directions: In a medium bowl, thoroughly mix cornmeal, flour, baking powder and baking soda.
In another bowl, whisk the egg whites until frothy.
Whisk in skim milk, yogurt and honey.
Pour over the dry ingredients.
Stir until all the dry ingredients are moistened.
Do not overmix.
Coat an 8 x 8-inch baking pan with no-stick spray.
Pour the batter into the pan.
Bake at 400° for 20 to 25 minutes, or until golden brown.
Serve warm or cold.
recipes.text: Honey Of A Cornbread. In a medium bowl, thoroughly mix cornmeal, flour, baking powder and baking soda. In another bowl, whisk the egg whites until frothy. Whisk in skim milk, yogurt and honey. Pour over the dry ingredients. Stir until all the dry ingredients are moistened. Do not overmix. Coat an 8 x 8-inch baking pan with no-stick spray. Pour the batter into the pan. Bake at 400° for 20 to 25 minutes, or until golden brown. Serve warm or cold.

recipes.title: Sugared Pecans
directions: Beat egg white and water until frothy.
Stir in pecan halves. Roll in sugar and cinnamon.
Bake 1 hour at 225°.
Mix up every 15 minutes.
Cool and eat.
recipes.text: Sugared Pecans. Beat egg white and water until frothy. Stir in pecan halves. Roll in sugar and cinnamon. Bake 1 hour at 225°. Mix up every 15 minutes. Cool and eat.

recipes.title: Spinach Dip
ingredients: 1 can chopped and drained water chestnuts
1 pkg. chopped spinach, thawed and well drained
directions: Mix all ingredients.
Stir well, cover and refrigerate for 2 to 3 hours.
Serve with vegetables or Snackwell pepper crackers.
recipes.text: Spinach Dip. Mix all ingredients. Stir well, cover and refrigerate for 2 to 3 hours. Serve with vegetables or Snackwell pepper crackers.

recipes.title: Almond Cookies
directions: Cream shortening; gradually add sugar, beating well.
Add eggs and extract, beating well.
Combine flour, baking powder, soda and salt.
Stir into creamed mixture.
Shape dough into 1-inch balls. Flatten slightly.
Brush with egg white.
Place sliced almonds on center of each cookie.
Bake at 375° for 12 minutes or until lightly browned.
Yield:
4 dozen.
recipes.text: Almond Cookies. Cream shortening; gradually add sugar, beating well. Add eggs and extract, beating well. Combine flour, baking powder, soda and salt. Stir into creamed mixture. Shape dough into 1-inch balls. Flatten slightly. Brush with egg white. Place sliced almonds on center of each cookie. Bake at 375° for 12 minutes or until lightly browned. Yield: 4 dozen.

recipes.title: Pudding Cookies
directions: Combine oleo, sugars, vanilla and pudding; beat until smooth. Beat in eggs.
Gradually stir in dry ingredients, chips and nuts. Batter will be stiff.
Drop by spoonfuls on ungreased cookie sheet.
Bake at 375° for 8 to 10 minutes.
recipes.text: Pudding Cookies. Combine oleo, sugars, vanilla and pudding; beat until smooth. Beat in eggs. Gradually stir in dry ingredients, chips and nuts. Batter will be stiff. Drop by spoonfuls on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 375° for 8 to 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Amanda'S Onion Soup
ingredients: 4 Large White Onions (halved and thinly sliced)
directions: Heat Broiler.
Melt 1/4 cup unsalted butter in 5 quart saucepan over medium-high heat.
Add 4 large white onions, halved and thinly sliced; stir to coat with butter.
Cover and cook 8 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add 1 tsp. sugar, cook uncovered stirring onions until slightly golden, about 6 minutes.
Add 1 Tbsp. flour, cook 1 minute longer.
Stir in 3 cans condensed Beef Broth, 1 can of water and 1/4 cup red wine, cover and simmer for 5 minutes.
recipes.text: Amanda'S Onion Soup. Heat Broiler. Melt 1/4 cup unsalted butter in 5 quart saucepan over medium-high heat. Add 4 large white onions, halved and thinly sliced; stir to coat with butter. Cover and cook 8 minutes, stirring occasionally. Add 1 tsp. sugar, cook uncovered stirring onions until slightly golden, about 6 minutes. Add 1 Tbsp. flour, cook 1 minute longer. Stir in 3 cans condensed Beef Broth, 1 can of water and 1/4 cup red wine, cover and simmer for 5 minutes.

recipes.title: Crock-Pot Roast
directions: Season roast with the listed seasoning.
Wrap in 2 layers of foil.
Put in crock-pot and cook on low for 12 to 16 hours.
recipes.text: Crock-Pot Roast. Season roast with the listed seasoning. Wrap in 2 layers of foil. Put in crock-pot and cook on low for 12 to 16 hours.

recipes.title: Shrimp Dip
directions: Wash and drain shrimp.
Mix with cream cheese and Worcestershire sauce.
Dip away!
recipes.text: Shrimp Dip. Wash and drain shrimp. Mix with cream cheese and Worcestershire sauce. Dip away!

recipes.title: Delicious Cookies
directions: Cream sugar and butter.
Add egg, nuts and flour with baking powder.
Add chocolate and vanilla.
Drop on cookie sheet.
Bake at 400° for 7 to 9 minutes.
recipes.text: Delicious Cookies. Cream sugar and butter. Add egg, nuts and flour with baking powder. Add chocolate and vanilla. Drop on cookie sheet. Bake at 400° for 7 to 9 minutes.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter And Carrot Cookies
ingredients: 1/2 c. shredded carrots (3/4 c. won't hurt)
directions: In a
small
bowl
mix
flour and soda together and set aside. In
large
bowl
beat oleo for 30 seconds.
Add peanut butter and sugars and beat until fluffy, then add carrots, egg whites
and vanilla.
Then add dry ingredients.
Stir in oats. Drop
by teaspoonful
on
ungreased cookie sheet and bake for about 8 to 10 minutes at 350°.
Makes about 2 1/2 dozen.
recipes.text: Peanut Butter And Carrot Cookies. In a small bowl mix flour and soda together and set aside. In large bowl beat oleo for 30 seconds. Add peanut butter and sugars and beat until fluffy, then add carrots, egg whites and vanilla. Then add dry ingredients. Stir in oats. Drop by teaspoonful on ungreased cookie sheet and bake for about 8 to 10 minutes at 350°. Makes about 2 1/2 dozen.

recipes.title: Coconut Cake
directions: Make yellow cake mix by directions on box into sheet cake. Punch holes in cake while hot.
Pour cream of coconut and Eagle Brand milk over cake while hot.
Cool and put Cool Whip and frozen coconut on top.
recipes.text: Coconut Cake. Make yellow cake mix by directions on box into sheet cake. Punch holes in cake while hot. Pour cream of coconut and Eagle Brand milk over cake while hot. Cool and put Cool Whip and frozen coconut on top.

recipes.title: Streusel-Topped Sweet Potato Casserole(Low Calorie)
ingredients: 1/2 c. plus 1 Tbsp. unsweetened orange juice
directions: Mash sweet potatoes.
Add 1/2 cup orange juice and next 6 ingredients.
Stir well and set aside.
Beat egg whites at high speed until soft peaks form.
Gradually add 1/4 cup brown sugar, beating until stiff peaks form.
Gently stir 1/4 cup of egg white mixture into potato mixture.
Gently fold remaining egg mixture. Spoon potatoes in an 11 x 7 x 2-inch baking dish coated with spray; set aside.
recipes.text: Streusel-Topped Sweet Potato Casserole(Low Calorie). Mash sweet potatoes. Add 1/2 cup orange juice and next 6 ingredients. Stir well and set aside. Beat egg whites at high speed until soft peaks form. Gradually add 1/4 cup brown sugar, beating until stiff peaks form. Gently stir 1/4 cup of egg white mixture into potato mixture. Gently fold remaining egg mixture. Spoon potatoes in an 11 x 7 x 2-inch baking dish coated with spray; set aside.

recipes.title: No Fail Pie Crust
directions: Blend flour and salt.
Cut in Crisco until fine crumbs.
Add water; press into ball.
Roll out on floured surface.
Makes 1 (12-inch) crust.
recipes.text: No Fail Pie Crust. Blend flour and salt. Cut in Crisco until fine crumbs. Add water; press into ball. Roll out on floured surface. Makes 1 (12-inch) crust.

recipes.title: Cilantro-Tomato Salad
directions: Cube tomatoes.
Dice onion; combine.
Add celery, cilantro and seasonings.
This is great with meats or as a simple summer salad.
recipes.text: Cilantro-Tomato Salad. Cube tomatoes. Dice onion; combine. Add celery, cilantro and seasonings. This is great with meats or as a simple summer salad.

recipes.title: Asparagus Casserole
ingredients: 2 cans asparagus, drain and reserve liquid
directions: Spread 2/3 of crackers over asparagus in baking dish.
Mix reserved liquid with soup and spread over mixture.
Top with remaining cracker crumbs and dot with butter.
Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes, until bubbly.
Top with sliced, boiled eggs and serve.
recipes.text: Asparagus Casserole. Spread 2/3 of crackers over asparagus in baking dish. Mix reserved liquid with soup and spread over mixture. Top with remaining cracker crumbs and dot with butter. Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes, until bubbly. Top with sliced, boiled eggs and serve.

recipes.title: Ma And Pa Green Beans
ingredients: 1/2 slab of bacon or pork, diced
about 10 to 12 red potatoes, peeled and quartered
salt and pepper to desired taste
directions: Fill very large pot with ingredients.
Fill with water just above ingredients.
Cover and bring to boil, then uncover and simmer until green beans darken and soften (about an hour or so)!
recipes.text: Ma And Pa Green Beans. Fill very large pot with ingredients. Fill with water just above ingredients. Cover and bring to boil, then uncover and simmer until green beans darken and soften (about an hour or so)!

recipes.title: Texas Melt
directions: Brown ground beef and drain.
Add enchilada sauce, stewed tomatoes, onions, salt and pepper; bring to a boil and simmer. Spread sour cream on tortillas and fold in half.
In a 13 x 9-inch baking dish, spread enough sauce to cover bottom of pan.
Place tortillas on top of meat mixture (sauce) and pour remaining sauce over tortillas.
Top with cheeses.
Bake at 350° for 15 minutes.
recipes.text: Texas Melt. Brown ground beef and drain. Add enchilada sauce, stewed tomatoes, onions, salt and pepper; bring to a boil and simmer. Spread sour cream on tortillas and fold in half. In a 13 x 9-inch baking dish, spread enough sauce to cover bottom of pan. Place tortillas on top of meat mixture (sauce) and pour remaining sauce over tortillas. Top with cheeses. Bake at 350° for 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Caramel Popcorn Pie
directions: Melt caramels in water in double boiler.
Mix with corn until well coated.
Slightly moisten hands.
Pack in rinsed 10-inch pie pan.
When top is dry, cut with knife dipped in cold water.
Also makes wonderful popcorn balls.
Wrap in waxed paper.
recipes.text: Caramel Popcorn Pie. Melt caramels in water in double boiler. Mix with corn until well coated. Slightly moisten hands. Pack in rinsed 10-inch pie pan. When top is dry, cut with knife dipped in cold water. Also makes wonderful popcorn balls. Wrap in waxed paper.

recipes.title: Easy Pie
directions: Make pudding according to directions.
Put in pie shell.
Top with Cool Whip and serve.
recipes.text: Easy Pie. Make pudding according to directions. Put in pie shell. Top with Cool Whip and serve.

recipes.title: Hot Mexican Cheese Dip
ingredients: 1 (10 oz.) can green chilies and tomatoes
directions: Combine cheese and chilies in a 1 1/2-quart microwave-proof casserole.
Cover and cook on 80 (Reheat) for 5 minutes.
Mix thoroughly with portable mixer until smooth.
Keep hot on a heated tray or candle warmer and serve with corn chips or potato chips or with crisp raw vegetables.
recipes.text: Hot Mexican Cheese Dip. Combine cheese and chilies in a 1 1/2-quart microwave-proof casserole. Cover and cook on 80 (Reheat) for 5 minutes. Mix thoroughly with portable mixer until smooth. Keep hot on a heated tray or candle warmer and serve with corn chips or potato chips or with crisp raw vegetables.

recipes.title: Toasted Coconut Cake
directions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees. Grease and lightly flour three 9-inch cake pans. Spread the coconut on a baking sheet and toast in the oven for 3 to 4 minutes, stirring about every 30 seconds, until the coconut begins to brown slightly. Remove immediately from the pan to prevent further browning. Beat the egg whites until stiff peaks form. Set aside. In another bowl, cream together the butter, sugar, and extracts. Add the egg yolks, one at a time, beating well after each addition. Combine the flour, baking soda, and salt and stir to mix. Add to the creamed mixture alternately with the buttermilk. Fold in the beaten egg whites and 1 cup of the toasted coconut. Spoon the batter into the prepared pans. Bake for about 25 minutes or until a toothpick comes out clean when inserted into center of one of the layers. Remove the layers from the pans immediately and cool completely on rack.
recipes.text: Toasted Coconut Cake. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees. Grease and lightly flour three 9-inch cake pans. Spread the coconut on a baking sheet and toast in the oven for 3 to 4 minutes, stirring about every 30 seconds, until the coconut begins to brown slightly. Remove immediately from the pan to prevent further browning. Beat the egg whites until stiff peaks form. Set aside. In another bowl, cream together the butter, sugar, and extracts. Add the egg yolks, one at a time, beating well after each addition. Combine the flour, baking soda, and salt and stir to mix. Add to the creamed mixture alternately with the buttermilk. Fold in the beaten egg whites and 1 cup of the toasted coconut. Spoon the batter into the prepared pans. Bake for about 25 minutes or until a toothpick comes out clean when inserted into center of one of the layers. Remove the layers from the pans immediately and cool completely on rack.

recipes.title: Festive Turkey With Peppers
ingredients: 1 pkg. (about 1 lb.) Turkey Select fresh boneless turkey strips
1 medium red pepper, cut into 1-inch chunks
1 medium green pepper, cut into 1-inch chunks
4 green onions, cut diagonally into 1-inch pieces
directions: In large bowl, combine brown sugar, soy sauce and cornstarch. Add turkey and turn to coat.
In large skillet, heat oil and cook garlic and turkey mixture over high heat, stirring constantly, 3 minutes.
Stir in peppers and onions. Cook over medium-high heat, stirring constantly, 5 minutes or until vegetables are crisp-tender.
recipes.text: Festive Turkey With Peppers. In large bowl, combine brown sugar, soy sauce and cornstarch. Add turkey and turn to coat. In large skillet, heat oil and cook garlic and turkey mixture over high heat, stirring constantly, 3 minutes. Stir in peppers and onions. Cook over medium-high heat, stirring constantly, 5 minutes or until vegetables are crisp-tender.

recipes.title: Italian Cream Cake
directions: Cream margarine, shortening and sugar until light and fluffy. Add egg yolks; mix well.
Sift flour and soda together; add to creamed mixture, alternately with buttermilk, beginning and ending with dry ingredients.
Add vanilla, coconut and nuts.
Fold in stiffly beaten egg whites.
Pour into three 9-inch greased and floured cake pans.
Bake in 350° oven for 30 to 35 minutes or until done.
Fill and frost with the following icing.
recipes.text: Italian Cream Cake. Cream margarine, shortening and sugar until light and fluffy. Add egg yolks; mix well. Sift flour and soda together; add to creamed mixture, alternately with buttermilk, beginning and ending with dry ingredients. Add vanilla, coconut and nuts. Fold in stiffly beaten egg whites. Pour into three 9-inch greased and floured cake pans. Bake in 350° oven for 30 to 35 minutes or until done. Fill and frost with the following icing.

recipes.title: Lasagne
directions: Brown meat; drain.
Add bell pepper, onion and mushrooms. Simmer for 1 hour.
Add tomato sauce and spaghetti sauce mix. Simmer 15 minutes more.
Boil noodles according to directions on box.
Place in a 9 x 13-inch pan, starting with noodles, meat, cottage cheese and Mozzarella cheese.
Continue layering until all mix is used.
Place in 350° oven until hot and bubbling.
recipes.text: Lasagne. Brown meat; drain. Add bell pepper, onion and mushrooms. Simmer for 1 hour. Add tomato sauce and spaghetti sauce mix. Simmer 15 minutes more. Boil noodles according to directions on box. Place in a 9 x 13-inch pan, starting with noodles, meat, cottage cheese and Mozzarella cheese. Continue layering until all mix is used. Place in 350° oven until hot and bubbling.

recipes.title: String Bean Casserole
directions: Cook string beans according to directions and drain.
In casserole, combine beans, soup and 1/2 can onions; do not dilute soup. Top with remaining onions. Bake at 350° until bubbly and onions are golden brown.
recipes.text: String Bean Casserole. Cook string beans according to directions and drain. In casserole, combine beans, soup and 1/2 can onions; do not dilute soup. Top with remaining onions. Bake at 350° until bubbly and onions are golden brown.

recipes.title: Baked Bluefish Fillets With Creole Sauce
directions: Mix the first 5 ingredients together in a 2-quart pan and saute together for 10 minutes over medium heat.
Add remaining ingredients, all but bluefish fillets and mix well over medium-low heat until vegetables are fully cooked, about 15 minutes.
While this is cooking, bake bluefish fillets in a 400° oven until fully cooked, approximately 30 minutes.
When fish is cooked, portion on plates and top with Creole sauce.
recipes.text: Baked Bluefish Fillets With Creole Sauce. Mix the first 5 ingredients together in a 2-quart pan and saute together for 10 minutes over medium heat. Add remaining ingredients, all but bluefish fillets and mix well over medium-low heat until vegetables are fully cooked, about 15 minutes. While this is cooking, bake bluefish fillets in a 400° oven until fully cooked, approximately 30 minutes. When fish is cooked, portion on plates and top with Creole sauce.

recipes.title: Pasta Salad
directions: Cook noodles as directed on package.
Cut up small or diced vegetables and mix together.
Pour Italian dressing and Salad Supreme over top and mix well.
recipes.text: Pasta Salad. Cook noodles as directed on package. Cut up small or diced vegetables and mix together. Pour Italian dressing and Salad Supreme over top and mix well.

recipes.title: Beef And Noodle Casserole
directions: Brown ground beef; drain.
Stir in garlic, oregano and tomato sauce.
Salt and pepper to taste.
Simmer sauce while cooking egg noodles according to package instructions.
When noodles are done, drain and stir in sour cream.
In greased baking dish, layer noodle mixture, sauce and cheese until dish is full.
End with layer of cheese on top.
Bake at 400° until cheese melts and casserole is bubbly.
recipes.text: Beef And Noodle Casserole. Brown ground beef; drain. Stir in garlic, oregano and tomato sauce. Salt and pepper to taste. Simmer sauce while cooking egg noodles according to package instructions. When noodles are done, drain and stir in sour cream. In greased baking dish, layer noodle mixture, sauce and cheese until dish is full. End with layer of cheese on top. Bake at 400° until cheese melts and casserole is bubbly.

recipes.title: Strawberry Cheese Pie
ingredients: 1 (9-inch) baked pastry shell or graham cracker crumb crust
1 (14 oz.) can Eagle Brand sweetened condensed milk (not evaporated milk)
1/3 c. ReaLemon lemon juice from concentrate
1 qt. fresh strawberries, cleaned and hulled
1 (16 oz.) pkg. prepared strawberry glaze, chilled
directions: In large bowl, beat cheese until fluffy.
Gradually beat in sweetened condensed milk until smooth.
Stir in ReaLemon brand and vanilla.
Pour into prepared pastry shell.
Chill 3 hours or until set.
recipes.text: Strawberry Cheese Pie. In large bowl, beat cheese until fluffy. Gradually beat in sweetened condensed milk until smooth. Stir in ReaLemon brand and vanilla. Pour into prepared pastry shell. Chill 3 hours or until set.

recipes.title: Foolproof Pie Crust
directions: With fork or pastry blender mix together dry ingredients. Combine remaining ingredients and mix with dry ingredients, stirring until moistened.
Use hands to make dough into balls. Chill for 15 minutes before rolling or freeze until ready to use. Dough will remain soft in refrigerator and can be taken out and rolled at once.
No matter how much you handle this dough, it will always be flaky and will do exactly as you want it to.
Makes 2 double crusts or enough for a large (Watts Family Picnic Size) cobbler.
recipes.text: Foolproof Pie Crust. With fork or pastry blender mix together dry ingredients. Combine remaining ingredients and mix with dry ingredients, stirring until moistened. Use hands to make dough into balls. Chill for 15 minutes before rolling or freeze until ready to use. Dough will remain soft in refrigerator and can be taken out and rolled at once. No matter how much you handle this dough, it will always be flaky and will do exactly as you want it to. Makes 2 double crusts or enough for a large (Watts Family Picnic Size) cobbler.

recipes.title: Homemade Turkey Chili
ingredients: 1 (1 lb.) can tomatoes, chopped with juice
directions: Brown turkey in wok.
Stir to break up. Add onions and garlic. Saute until soft. Add chili mix.
Stir to blend.
Stir in remaining ingredients.
Cover and simmer over low heat for 35 to 40 minutes.
Add water, if chili becomes too thick.
Serves 4 to 6.
recipes.text: Homemade Turkey Chili. Brown turkey in wok. Stir to break up. Add onions and garlic. Saute until soft. Add chili mix. Stir to blend. Stir in remaining ingredients. Cover and simmer over low heat for 35 to 40 minutes. Add water, if chili becomes too thick. Serves 4 to 6.

recipes.title: Chicken And Rice
directions: In baking dish, mix together the soups and water.
Sprinkle rice over mixture.
Place chicken on top.
Cover tightly with foil (do not open) and bake in oven for 2 hours at 350°.
recipes.text: Chicken And Rice. In baking dish, mix together the soups and water. Sprinkle rice over mixture. Place chicken on top. Cover tightly with foil (do not open) and bake in oven for 2 hours at 350°.

recipes.title: Seafood And Asparagus Pasta
ingredients: 3/4 lb. pene pasta (add oil to water)
directions: Saute garlic in melted butter and olive oil.
Rinse asparagus and cut in 1-inch pieces.
Saute asparagus until crisp-tender.
recipes.text: Seafood And Asparagus Pasta. Saute garlic in melted butter and olive oil. Rinse asparagus and cut in 1-inch pieces. Saute asparagus until crisp-tender.

recipes.title: Mayonnaise Biscuits
directions: Mix all ingredients together.
Let set 3 to 5 minutes.
Drop by spoonful onto greased cookie sheet.
Bake at 350° until done.
recipes.text: Mayonnaise Biscuits. Mix all ingredients together. Let set 3 to 5 minutes. Drop by spoonful onto greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350° until done.

recipes.title: Sweet Potato Bread
directions: Mash potatoes very well.
Add sugar, butter, vanilla, allspice, flour, milk and egg.
Mix thoroughly.
Pat into pan and bake in slow oven until very brown.
Cut into squares and serve.
recipes.text: Sweet Potato Bread. Mash potatoes very well. Add sugar, butter, vanilla, allspice, flour, milk and egg. Mix thoroughly. Pat into pan and bake in slow oven until very brown. Cut into squares and serve.

recipes.title: Ham Cole Slaw
ingredients: 1 c. slivered or diced cooked ham
directions: Place ham, cabbage, green pepper and pimento in a serving bowl.
Combine seasonings, salad oil and vinegar.
Just before serving, pour on dressing and toss lightly.
recipes.text: Ham Cole Slaw. Place ham, cabbage, green pepper and pimento in a serving bowl. Combine seasonings, salad oil and vinegar. Just before serving, pour on dressing and toss lightly.

recipes.title: Hamburger One Dish Meal
ingredients: Velveeta cheese in 1/4 inch thick slices, enough to cover meat
chopped onion, enough to cover in a thin layer
tater tots, enough to cover onion completely
directions: Cook meat until gray and drain well.
Place in square pyrex dish.
Completely cover top of meet with 1/4 inch slices of velveeta cheese.
Sprinkle onion on top of cheese and cover top with a layer of tater tots.
Pour a can of celery soup on top (do not add water).
Bake for 35 minutes at 350°.
recipes.text: Hamburger One Dish Meal. Cook meat until gray and drain well. Place in square pyrex dish. Completely cover top of meet with 1/4 inch slices of velveeta cheese. Sprinkle onion on top of cheese and cover top with a layer of tater tots. Pour a can of celery soup on top (do not add water). Bake for 35 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Quesadillas(Appetizers)
ingredients: 1 small bag shredded Monterey Jack cheese
1 small bag shredded sharp Cheddar cheese
dried cilantro (in a jar) or fresh minced
directions: Fry
each
tortilla
in 1/4 inch of hot oil until crisp and golden, turning once.
Drain and place tortillas on paper towels. Sprinkle
each
tortilla
with
combined cheese, then tomato pieces and sprinkle of dried cilantro.
Microwave each tortilla approximately 1 minute until cheese is melted.* Using scissors cut tortillas into quarters.
Serve warm.
recipes.text: Quesadillas(Appetizers). Fry each tortilla in 1/4 inch of hot oil until crisp and golden, turning once. Drain and place tortillas on paper towels. Sprinkle each tortilla with combined cheese, then tomato pieces and sprinkle of dried cilantro. Microwave each tortilla approximately 1 minute until cheese is melted.* Using scissors cut tortillas into quarters. Serve warm.

recipes.title: 7-Up Salad
directions: Dissolve jello in hot water.
Add cream cheese and mix until well blended and smooth.
Add pineapple, nuts and 7-Up.
Pour into dish.
recipes.text: 7-Up Salad. Dissolve jello in hot water. Add cream cheese and mix until well blended and smooth. Add pineapple, nuts and 7-Up. Pour into dish.

recipes.title: Bell Pepper-Fresh Corn Pancakes
ingredients: 1 small red pepper, seeded and chopped
1 small green pepper, seeded and chopped
directions: Combine corn, egg yolk, cornmeal, flour, salt and pepper. Beat egg whites until soft peaks form.
Fold half of egg whites into cornmeal mixture, then fold in the rest.
(Do not overmix.) Coat medium-hot skillet with oil.
Drop batter into skillet. Spread round like pancake and cook until golden brown on both sides.
recipes.text: Bell Pepper-Fresh Corn Pancakes. Combine corn, egg yolk, cornmeal, flour, salt and pepper. Beat egg whites until soft peaks form. Fold half of egg whites into cornmeal mixture, then fold in the rest. (Do not overmix.) Coat medium-hot skillet with oil. Drop batter into skillet. Spread round like pancake and cook until golden brown on both sides.

recipes.title: Old-Fashioned Tea Cakes
directions: Cream
sugar and butter thoroughly.
Beat in eggs.
Mix soda and
flour together and add to mixture along with buttermilk
and vanilla.
Chill dough overnight.
Roll out and cut. Cook for 8 to 10 minutes at 400°.
recipes.text: Old-Fashioned Tea Cakes. Cream sugar and butter thoroughly. Beat in eggs. Mix soda and flour together and add to mixture along with buttermilk and vanilla. Chill dough overnight. Roll out and cut. Cook for 8 to 10 minutes at 400°.

recipes.title: Squash Pudding
directions: Cook and mash squash.
Mix all ingredients together in greased baking dish.
Bake at 425° for 15 minutes, then at 350° for 35 minutes.
recipes.text: Squash Pudding. Cook and mash squash. Mix all ingredients together in greased baking dish. Bake at 425° for 15 minutes, then at 350° for 35 minutes.

recipes.title: Herbed Pork And Apples
ingredients: 1 pork loin roast with bone (about 6 lb.)
directions: Combine herbs, salt and pepper; rub over roast.
Cover and refrigerate for several hours or overnight.
Bake, uncovered, at 325° for 1 1/2 hours.
Drain fat.
recipes.text: Herbed Pork And Apples. Combine herbs, salt and pepper; rub over roast. Cover and refrigerate for several hours or overnight. Bake, uncovered, at 325° for 1 1/2 hours. Drain fat.

recipes.title: Velvet Angel Pie
directions: Melt chocolate with the coffee in saucepan over low heat until blended; cool.
Stir in vanilla, then fold into whipped cream. Fill meringue shell.
Refrigerate overnight or approximately 12 hours.
Garnish with additional whipped cream, shaved chocolate and pecan halves.
recipes.text: Velvet Angel Pie. Melt chocolate with the coffee in saucepan over low heat until blended; cool. Stir in vanilla, then fold into whipped cream. Fill meringue shell. Refrigerate overnight or approximately 12 hours. Garnish with additional whipped cream, shaved chocolate and pecan halves.

recipes.title: Dreamsickle Cake
directions: Add envelope of orange kool-aid to cake mix and bake according to package directions.
Poke holes in cake when done.
Mix one box of orange jello as directed.
Pour over cake.
Refrigerate to cool.
recipes.text: Dreamsickle Cake. Add envelope of orange kool-aid to cake mix and bake according to package directions. Poke holes in cake when done. Mix one box of orange jello as directed. Pour over cake. Refrigerate to cool.

recipes.title: One Pan Meal Deal For The Jury
ingredients: 1 can black-eyed peas or dry black-eyed peas, cooked
directions: Start with sliced sausage.
Cut them bite size.
Brown sausage in large skillet.
Add onion and saute with sausage.
Add peas and water; stir.
Add rice.
Stir.
Cover pan with lid.
Stir occasionally.
With heat turned very low, simmer approximately 1 hour.
Serves 6 to 8.
recipes.text: One Pan Meal Deal For The Jury. Start with sliced sausage. Cut them bite size. Brown sausage in large skillet. Add onion and saute with sausage. Add peas and water; stir. Add rice. Stir. Cover pan with lid. Stir occasionally. With heat turned very low, simmer approximately 1 hour. Serves 6 to 8.

recipes.title: Banana-Nut Bread
directions: Heat oven to 350°. Grease bottoms only of 2 loaf pans, 9 x 5 x 3 or 8 1/2 x 4 1/2 x 2 1/2-inches.
recipes.text: Banana-Nut Bread. Heat oven to 350°. Grease bottoms only of 2 loaf pans, 9 x 5 x 3 or 8 1/2 x 4 1/2 x 2 1/2-inches.

recipes.title: Bacon-Vegetable Hash
ingredients: 6 medium Russet potatoes, unpeeled and diced
directions: Saute bacon in large skillet and saute over low heat.
When evenly browned and the fat is rendered, drain the bacon on paper towels and set it aside.
Pour off all but 3 tablespoons of the bacon drippings and discard.
Melt the butter in the pan with the remaining bacon drippings.
Add the potatoes, green pepper, onion and mushrooms.
Saute over medium heat until the potatoes are tender, about 20 to 25 minutes, making sure to stir frequently. Add a bit more butter, if necessary, to prevent sticking.
Add the reserved bacon, salt to taste, and plenty of fresh black pepper. Saute for an additional 5 minutes, to allow flavors to blend. Serve warm.
recipes.text: Bacon-Vegetable Hash. Saute bacon in large skillet and saute over low heat. When evenly browned and the fat is rendered, drain the bacon on paper towels and set it aside. Pour off all but 3 tablespoons of the bacon drippings and discard. Melt the butter in the pan with the remaining bacon drippings. Add the potatoes, green pepper, onion and mushrooms. Saute over medium heat until the potatoes are tender, about 20 to 25 minutes, making sure to stir frequently. Add a bit more butter, if necessary, to prevent sticking. Add the reserved bacon, salt to taste, and plenty of fresh black pepper. Saute for an additional 5 minutes, to allow flavors to blend. Serve warm.

recipes.title: Rosemary Carrots
directions: Place carrots in 2-quart casserole.
In small bowl or 2-cup measure, combine bouillon, water, sugar and seasonings.
Pour over carrots.
Toss to coat; cover.
Microwave at High 5 to 8 minutes or until fork-tender, stirring once after half the cooking time.
recipes.text: Rosemary Carrots. Place carrots in 2-quart casserole. In small bowl or 2-cup measure, combine bouillon, water, sugar and seasonings. Pour over carrots. Toss to coat; cover. Microwave at High 5 to 8 minutes or until fork-tender, stirring once after half the cooking time.

recipes.title: Cherry Pudding
directions: Baking Temperature: 350°.
Baking Time: 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Cherry Pudding. Baking Temperature: 350°. Baking Time: 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Egg Custard Pie(Makes One 9-Inch Pie)
directions: Melt butter.
Beat eggs with fork and add to milk.
Combine with butter mixture.
Add vanilla.
Pour into unbaked pie shell and bake in a 350° oven for 40 minutes.
recipes.text: Egg Custard Pie(Makes One 9-Inch Pie). Melt butter. Beat eggs with fork and add to milk. Combine with butter mixture. Add vanilla. Pour into unbaked pie shell and bake in a 350° oven for 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Hot Antipasto
ingredients: 2 cans artichoke hearts, drained and quartered
handful of Parmesan cheese and fresh parsley
directions: Drain all ingredients; mix all together. Bake in casserole for 30 minutes at 400°.
recipes.text: Hot Antipasto. Drain all ingredients; mix all together. Bake in casserole for 30 minutes at 400°.

recipes.title: Pickle-In-The-Middle
directions: In medium bowl, stir together cream cheese and American cheese.
Spread about 1 tablespoon cheese mixture on each piece of bologna.
Place 2 pickles on bologna slices.
Roll.
Refrigerate for at least an hour to chill.
Cut each bologna slice into 3/4 slices.
Yield: 40.
recipes.text: Pickle-In-The-Middle. In medium bowl, stir together cream cheese and American cheese. Spread about 1 tablespoon cheese mixture on each piece of bologna. Place 2 pickles on bologna slices. Roll. Refrigerate for at least an hour to chill. Cut each bologna slice into 3/4 slices. Yield: 40.

recipes.title: 13 Layer Chocolate Cake
directions: Cream sugar and shortening together.
Add eggs, one at a time. Sift flour and add alternately with milk to the batter.
Add vanilla.
Grease and flour 9-inch cake pans.
Pour 1/2 cup batter in each pan.
Bake at 375° until light brown.
Cool on cake racks.
recipes.text: 13 Layer Chocolate Cake. Cream sugar and shortening together. Add eggs, one at a time. Sift flour and add alternately with milk to the batter. Add vanilla. Grease and flour 9-inch cake pans. Pour 1/2 cup batter in each pan. Bake at 375° until light brown. Cool on cake racks.

recipes.title: Snow Ice Cream
directions: In a 2-quart bowl mix beaten eggs and milk.
Blend in sugar; mixing well.
Add vanilla, salt and flavoring if desired.
Put into a gallon container and gradually add snow; mixing well until of desired consistency.
Serve immediately or freeze.
recipes.text: Snow Ice Cream. In a 2-quart bowl mix beaten eggs and milk. Blend in sugar; mixing well. Add vanilla, salt and flavoring if desired. Put into a gallon container and gradually add snow; mixing well until of desired consistency. Serve immediately or freeze.

recipes.title: "Grannie Wood'S" Cornbread
ingredients: 1 c. thick sour top cream from milk (you can substitute buttermilk + 1 tsp. butter)
directions: Sift dry ingredients; add sour cream and hot water.
(Add more hot water if needed).
Add eggs and mix.
Bake at 375° until done.
recipes.text: "Grannie Wood'S" Cornbread. Sift dry ingredients; add sour cream and hot water. (Add more hot water if needed). Add eggs and mix. Bake at 375° until done.

recipes.title: Chinese Noodle Skillet
ingredients: 1 (16 oz.) pkg. frozen mixed vegetables (broccoli, carrots and water chestnuts)
2 c. (8 oz.) cooked ham, cut in strips
directions: Cook noodles according to directions; drain well.
Return to pan and toss with a little butter and sauteed garlic.
Cover. Thaw vegetables under warm water.
recipes.text: Chinese Noodle Skillet. Cook noodles according to directions; drain well. Return to pan and toss with a little butter and sauteed garlic. Cover. Thaw vegetables under warm water.

recipes.title: Linguine And Clam Sauce
directions: Heat oil and butter until butter melts.
Add garlic; cook until golden.
Stir in clams with liquid, oregano, pepper and parsley.
Cook about 5 minutes.
Pour over linguine.
recipes.text: Linguine And Clam Sauce. Heat oil and butter until butter melts. Add garlic; cook until golden. Stir in clams with liquid, oregano, pepper and parsley. Cook about 5 minutes. Pour over linguine.

recipes.title: Gingerbread Cookie Dough
directions: Cream margarine, sugar, eggs and molasses.
Sift flour, baking soda and spices and add to creamed mixture.
Mix and shape.
Dough is enough for 15 eight-inch gingerbread men.
Bake at 375° for 10 to 12 minutes.
recipes.text: Gingerbread Cookie Dough. Cream margarine, sugar, eggs and molasses. Sift flour, baking soda and spices and add to creamed mixture. Mix and shape. Dough is enough for 15 eight-inch gingerbread men. Bake at 375° for 10 to 12 minutes.

recipes.title: Chicken Spaghetti
directions: Bone chicken and chip up meat.
Boil spaghetti in chicken broth.
Cook vegetables in margarine until onions are transparent. Mix chicken, spaghetti and vegetables with mushroom soup.
Cook around 40 minutes in a 300° oven.
recipes.text: Chicken Spaghetti. Bone chicken and chip up meat. Boil spaghetti in chicken broth. Cook vegetables in margarine until onions are transparent. Mix chicken, spaghetti and vegetables with mushroom soup. Cook around 40 minutes in a 300° oven.

recipes.title: Instant Cookies
directions: Mix together and drop by spoonfuls on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake in a 375° oven for 6 to 7 minutes.
recipes.text: Instant Cookies. Mix together and drop by spoonfuls on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake in a 375° oven for 6 to 7 minutes.

recipes.title: Zucchini Bake
ingredients: 4 c. grated zucchini (do not peel, use cheese grater)
directions: Preheat oven to 350°.
Grease 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan.
Mix all of above ingredients thoroughly.
Pour in pan and bake 45 minutes or until golden brown.
Serve hot.
Yields 9 large servings.
recipes.text: Zucchini Bake. Preheat oven to 350°. Grease 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Mix all of above ingredients thoroughly. Pour in pan and bake 45 minutes or until golden brown. Serve hot. Yields 9 large servings.

recipes.title: Chicken Chow Mein
ingredients: 1 (10 1/2 oz.) can condensed cream of chicken soup
directions: In saucepan, cook green pepper and celery in oleo until crisp. Stir in soup, water and soy sauce.
Add vegetables and chicken; heat through.
Serve with rice.
recipes.text: Chicken Chow Mein. In saucepan, cook green pepper and celery in oleo until crisp. Stir in soup, water and soy sauce. Add vegetables and chicken; heat through. Serve with rice.

recipes.title: Pickled Black-Eyed Peas
directions: Drain the peas. Put peas in a shaker jar.
Add remaining ingredients and shake well.
Tastes better if left in refrigerator for at least 2 days before serving.
Will keep in refrigerator for about a month.
Makes 2 cups.
recipes.text: Pickled Black-Eyed Peas. Drain the peas. Put peas in a shaker jar. Add remaining ingredients and shake well. Tastes better if left in refrigerator for at least 2 days before serving. Will keep in refrigerator for about a month. Makes 2 cups.

recipes.title: Key Lime Pie
ingredients: 1 can Eagle Brand sweetened condensed milk
directions: Whip condensed milk, limeade and food coloring until stiff. Fold in whipped topping.
Pour into prepared crust and chill until set.
Garnish with lime slices, if desired.
recipes.text: Key Lime Pie. Whip condensed milk, limeade and food coloring until stiff. Fold in whipped topping. Pour into prepared crust and chill until set. Garnish with lime slices, if desired.

recipes.title: Heavenly Hash Cake
ingredients: 1 bag large marshmallows, cut in half
directions: Cake:
Combine flour, sugar, baking powder, eggs, vanilla and pecans in large bowl.
Melt 1 stick butter with 3 tablespoons cocoa.
Pour in with ingredients and mix well.
Place in greased pan.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
When finished and cool, put (half) marshmallows on top of cake.
recipes.text: Heavenly Hash Cake. Cake: Combine flour, sugar, baking powder, eggs, vanilla and pecans in large bowl. Melt 1 stick butter with 3 tablespoons cocoa. Pour in with ingredients and mix well. Place in greased pan. Bake at 350° for 1 hour. When finished and cool, put (half) marshmallows on top of cake.

recipes.title: Potato Pancakes
directions: Grate potatoes and onion finely.
Put into bowl.
Stir in rest of ingredients.
Drop into 1/4-inch deep fat in skillet.
Brown; drain on paper towels.
recipes.text: Potato Pancakes. Grate potatoes and onion finely. Put into bowl. Stir in rest of ingredients. Drop into 1/4-inch deep fat in skillet. Brown; drain on paper towels.

recipes.title: Stuffed Squash
ingredients: 1 c. or more Cheddar cheese, grated
directions: Cut off each end of squash; boil whole until tender.
After cooled, cut squash lengthwise, scoop out inside and save.
Saute onion in butter until tender; mix together with all remaining ingredients, except squash shells.
Put mixture back into squash shells.
Bake, covered, at 350° for 30 to 45 minutes, until golden brown.
Serves 6 to 8.
recipes.text: Stuffed Squash. Cut off each end of squash; boil whole until tender. After cooled, cut squash lengthwise, scoop out inside and save. Saute onion in butter until tender; mix together with all remaining ingredients, except squash shells. Put mixture back into squash shells. Bake, covered, at 350° for 30 to 45 minutes, until golden brown. Serves 6 to 8.

recipes.title: French Fried Onion Rings
directions: Combine egg, milk, flour and salt.
Dip onions in batter.
Fry in hot shortening.
Drain on absorbent paper.
Sprinkle with salt. Yields 5 to 6 servings.
recipes.text: French Fried Onion Rings. Combine egg, milk, flour and salt. Dip onions in batter. Fry in hot shortening. Drain on absorbent paper. Sprinkle with salt. Yields 5 to 6 servings.

recipes.title: Red Beans & Rice
ingredients: 1 lb. Ziegler's plantation smoked sausage (sliced in bite size pieces)
directions: Rinse red beans and pour into a large pot of boiling water. Remove from heat cover and let stand until cool.
Return to heat and cook slowly.
Add chopped onion, parsley, garlic, bay leaf, salt & pepper and sausage to beans.
When beans are tender stir in dark roux made by using vegetable oil and flour.
Cook slowly 20-30 minutes until it's a dark brown color, stirring often. Allow beans to cook about 30 minutes more. Serve hot over rice.
recipes.text: Red Beans & Rice. Rinse red beans and pour into a large pot of boiling water. Remove from heat cover and let stand until cool. Return to heat and cook slowly. Add chopped onion, parsley, garlic, bay leaf, salt & pepper and sausage to beans. When beans are tender stir in dark roux made by using vegetable oil and flour. Cook slowly 20-30 minutes until it's a dark brown color, stirring often. Allow beans to cook about 30 minutes more. Serve hot over rice.

recipes.title: Stuffed Peppers
directions: Slice off tops of peppers; take out seeds.
Place peppers in enough boiling water to cover and cook for 15 minutes.
Cook hamburger and onions until brown.
Drain off grease.
Add remaining ingredients and heat through.
Fill peppers with stuffing.
Cover and cook in a 350° oven for 45 minutes.
Uncover and cook for 15 minutes longer.
Serves 6.
recipes.text: Stuffed Peppers. Slice off tops of peppers; take out seeds. Place peppers in enough boiling water to cover and cook for 15 minutes. Cook hamburger and onions until brown. Drain off grease. Add remaining ingredients and heat through. Fill peppers with stuffing. Cover and cook in a 350° oven for 45 minutes. Uncover and cook for 15 minutes longer. Serves 6.

recipes.title: Easy Swiss Steak
directions: Pound steak. Cut into bite size pieces. In skillet, brown steak in shortening. Pour off fat. Add remaining ingredients. Cover; simmer 1 1/2 hours or until tender.
recipes.text: Easy Swiss Steak. Pound steak. Cut into bite size pieces. In skillet, brown steak in shortening. Pour off fat. Add remaining ingredients. Cover; simmer 1 1/2 hours or until tender.

recipes.title: Oatmeal Cookies
directions: Sift together flour, baking powder, soda and salt.
Cream butter and sugar.
Add eggs and vanilla.
Beat well.
Blend in dry ingredients.
Stir in oatmeal and nuts.
Bake in 350° oven for 8 to 10 minutes.
recipes.text: Oatmeal Cookies. Sift together flour, baking powder, soda and salt. Cream butter and sugar. Add eggs and vanilla. Beat well. Blend in dry ingredients. Stir in oatmeal and nuts. Bake in 350° oven for 8 to 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Lemon Chess Pie
directions: Mix sugar and flour in large bowl.
Add remaining ingredients. Beat with mixer until well blended.
Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes.
recipes.text: Lemon Chess Pie. Mix sugar and flour in large bowl. Add remaining ingredients. Beat with mixer until well blended. Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Cheezy Biscuits
directions: Heat oven to 400°.
Microwave Cheez Whiz as directed on package; pour into a small bowl.
Dip each biscuit top in the Cheez Whiz.
Dip biscuits in Parmesan cheese, coating tops completely.
Sprinkle with herbs.
recipes.text: Cheezy Biscuits. Heat oven to 400°. Microwave Cheez Whiz as directed on package; pour into a small bowl. Dip each biscuit top in the Cheez Whiz. Dip biscuits in Parmesan cheese, coating tops completely. Sprinkle with herbs.

recipes.title: Baked Cup Custard
directions: Beat eggs, sugar, salt and vanilla until blended, about 1 minute.
Add slowly while beating scalded milk.
Beat only until blended. Pour into custard cups.
Sprinkle with nutmeg, if desired.
Set cups in pan of hot water.
Bake in preheated oven (325°) about 45 minutes or until a silver knife inserted in center comes out clean.
Makes 6 servings.
recipes.text: Baked Cup Custard. Beat eggs, sugar, salt and vanilla until blended, about 1 minute. Add slowly while beating scalded milk. Beat only until blended. Pour into custard cups. Sprinkle with nutmeg, if desired. Set cups in pan of hot water. Bake in preheated oven (325°) about 45 minutes or until a silver knife inserted in center comes out clean. Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Stuffed Mushrooms
directions: Remove mushroom stems and finely chop 1 cup; reserve.
Combine bacon and onion in a medium glass bowl.
Cook at High 3 to 4 minutes or until crisp; stir once.
Drain.
Stir in reserved mushroom stems, bread crumbs, cheese and pepper.
Stuff mushroom caps with bread crumb mixture.
On a glass platter arrange 12 in circular pattern.
Cook covered at High 6 to 7 minutes.
Let stand uncovered 2 minutes.
Serve.
Repeat for remaining mushrooms.
recipes.text: Stuffed Mushrooms. Remove mushroom stems and finely chop 1 cup; reserve. Combine bacon and onion in a medium glass bowl. Cook at High 3 to 4 minutes or until crisp; stir once. Drain. Stir in reserved mushroom stems, bread crumbs, cheese and pepper. Stuff mushroom caps with bread crumb mixture. On a glass platter arrange 12 in circular pattern. Cook covered at High 6 to 7 minutes. Let stand uncovered 2 minutes. Serve. Repeat for remaining mushrooms.

recipes.title: Squash Casserole
directions: Melt margarine; stir in dressing mix.
Use 1/2 of this mixture to line casserole.
Mix all other ingredients and pour into lined casserole.
Sprinkle remaining mixture on top.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Squash Casserole. Melt margarine; stir in dressing mix. Use 1/2 of this mixture to line casserole. Mix all other ingredients and pour into lined casserole. Sprinkle remaining mixture on top. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Ginger Raz Freeze
directions: Combine all ingredients.
Pour into blender; blend until smooth.
Serve immediately.
Yield: 2 cups.
recipes.text: Ginger Raz Freeze. Combine all ingredients. Pour into blender; blend until smooth. Serve immediately. Yield: 2 cups.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Popcorn
directions: Mix together; heat
until peanut butter is melted.
Pour over popcorn.
recipes.text: Peanut Butter Popcorn. Mix together; heat until peanut butter is melted. Pour over popcorn.

recipes.title: Fast, Easy Baked Beans
ingredients: 1 can pork and beans in tomato sauce
directions: Drain about 1/2 the liquid off each can of beans.
Mix all ingredients.
Place in baking or casserole dish.
Top with 3 or 4 strips of bacon.
Bake at 300° for 2 hours.
Serves 8 to 10.
recipes.text: Fast, Easy Baked Beans. Drain about 1/2 the liquid off each can of beans. Mix all ingredients. Place in baking or casserole dish. Top with 3 or 4 strips of bacon. Bake at 300° for 2 hours. Serves 8 to 10.

recipes.title: Party Chicken
ingredients: 8 large split chicken breasts, boned and skinned or use boneless halves
1 (10 1/2 oz.) can cream of mushroom soup
directions: Wrap each chicken breast with a slice of bacon.
Arrange dried beef in a 9 x 13-inch pan (or smaller).
Place chicken on dried beef.
Combine soup and sour cream.
Pour over chicken. Bake, uncovered, at 275° for 3 hours.
Serves 8.
recipes.text: Party Chicken. Wrap each chicken breast with a slice of bacon. Arrange dried beef in a 9 x 13-inch pan (or smaller). Place chicken on dried beef. Combine soup and sour cream. Pour over chicken. Bake, uncovered, at 275° for 3 hours. Serves 8.

recipes.title: Cranberry Chutney
directions: Wash and sort cranberries.
Mix sugar, marmalade, lemon juice and walnuts.
Spread all over cranberries.
Cover with foil; refrigerate 6 hours or overnight.
Bake at 350° for 10 minutes.
recipes.text: Cranberry Chutney. Wash and sort cranberries. Mix sugar, marmalade, lemon juice and walnuts. Spread all over cranberries. Cover with foil; refrigerate 6 hours or overnight. Bake at 350° for 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Frozen Chocolate Pie
ingredients: 1 ready made chocolate or graham pie crust
directions: Slowly	melt chocolate squares in small saucepan with 3 tablespoons milk, stirring frequently over very low heat.
recipes.text: Frozen Chocolate Pie. Slowly	melt chocolate squares in small saucepan with 3 tablespoons milk, stirring frequently over very low heat.

recipes.title: Crab Dip
directions: Melt all together.
Serve warm with cracker of your choice.
recipes.text: Crab Dip. Melt all together. Serve warm with cracker of your choice.

recipes.title: Broccoli Casserole
directions: Cook broccoli. Add other ingredients and mix well.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Broccoli Casserole. Cook broccoli. Add other ingredients and mix well. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: 1930'S Casserole
directions: Saute ground beef and onion until brown.
Drain.
Mix in a casserole with remaining ingredients, except bread crumbs. Sprinkle bread crumbs on top.
Bake for 1/2 hour at 350°.
recipes.text: 1930'S Casserole. Saute ground beef and onion until brown. Drain. Mix in a casserole with remaining ingredients, except bread crumbs. Sprinkle bread crumbs on top. Bake for 1/2 hour at 350°.

recipes.title: Tiger Butter
ingredients: 1 lb. white chocolate or almond bark
directions: Melt white chocolate or almond bark in top of double boiler. Stir in peanut butter.
When completely melted, pour onto cookie sheet.
Spread very thin.
Melt chocolate chips in double boiler. When melted, spoon onto white chocolate and peanut butter mixture. Swirl on top.
Cool completely or put in freezer for 10 minutes. Take out and break into small pieces.
recipes.text: Tiger Butter. Melt white chocolate or almond bark in top of double boiler. Stir in peanut butter. When completely melted, pour onto cookie sheet. Spread very thin. Melt chocolate chips in double boiler. When melted, spoon onto white chocolate and peanut butter mixture. Swirl on top. Cool completely or put in freezer for 10 minutes. Take out and break into small pieces.

recipes.title: Raspberry Cooler
directions: In blender combine sherbet, ice cream, syrup and milk.
Blend until smooth.
Add cream of coconut if desired.
Garnish with whole raspberries.
Makes 3 servings.
recipes.text: Raspberry Cooler. In blender combine sherbet, ice cream, syrup and milk. Blend until smooth. Add cream of coconut if desired. Garnish with whole raspberries. Makes 3 servings.

recipes.title: Blackberry Syrup
directions: Boil berries and water.
Strain and press through strainer. Add sugar to juice.
Discard berries.
Boil juice mixture 5 to 8 minutes.
Keep in refrigerator.
recipes.text: Blackberry Syrup. Boil berries and water. Strain and press through strainer. Add sugar to juice. Discard berries. Boil juice mixture 5 to 8 minutes. Keep in refrigerator.

recipes.title: Company Sausage Gravy(Low-Fat)
ingredients: dash of hot pepper sauce (about 7 drops)
directions: Crumble sausage into large saucepan; cook over medium-low heat until brown.
Add onion; cook and stir until transparent.
Stir flour into cooked sausage mixture until golden brown.
Stir in milk; cook about 6 minutes or until mixture bubbles.
Add seasoning; cook, stirring, until thickened.
To serve, spoon over biscuit halves.
recipes.text: Company Sausage Gravy(Low-Fat). Crumble sausage into large saucepan; cook over medium-low heat until brown. Add onion; cook and stir until transparent. Stir flour into cooked sausage mixture until golden brown. Stir in milk; cook about 6 minutes or until mixture bubbles. Add seasoning; cook, stirring, until thickened. To serve, spoon over biscuit halves.

recipes.title: Barbecued Duck Breasts
ingredients: 4 boneless duck breasts (split from 2 wild ducks)
1 or 2 slices bacon for each breast
directions: Dissolve soda and salt in bowl of water.
Soak duck breasts in this water 3 hours.
Remove, pat dry, and place in shallow pan. Combine next 5 ingredients in plastic bag.
Add duck breasts, close bag and marinate at least 1
1/2 hours (or overnight in refrigerator).
Remove breasts form marinade.
Wrap each in bacon and secure with toothpicks.
Cook on grill for about 5 minutes on each side, basting with marinade.
Serves 4.
recipes.text: Barbecued Duck Breasts. Dissolve soda and salt in bowl of water. Soak duck breasts in this water 3 hours. Remove, pat dry, and place in shallow pan. Combine next 5 ingredients in plastic bag. Add duck breasts, close bag and marinate at least 1 1/2 hours (or overnight in refrigerator). Remove breasts form marinade. Wrap each in bacon and secure with toothpicks. Cook on grill for about 5 minutes on each side, basting with marinade. Serves 4.

recipes.title: Canned Dill Pickles
directions: Bring above ingredients to a boil; add pickles a few at a time to gently heat. Put hot pickles in hot jars and cover with boiling brine. Put dill on top of packed pickles and seal. A piece or two of garlic in each jar also makes a nice flavor. Let rest about 2 weeks before sampling.
recipes.text: Canned Dill Pickles. Bring above ingredients to a boil; add pickles a few at a time to gently heat. Put hot pickles in hot jars and cover with boiling brine. Put dill on top of packed pickles and seal. A piece or two of garlic in each jar also makes a nice flavor. Let rest about 2 weeks before sampling.

recipes.title: Carrot Cake
directions: Cake:
Grease and flour 9 x 13-inch pan.
Sift together flour, cinnamon and baking soda.
In another bowl cream together sugar and corn oil.
Combine ingredients and add the eggs and grated carrots.
Fold and mix well.
Bake at 350° for 45 to 50 minutes.
recipes.text: Carrot Cake. Cake: Grease and flour 9 x 13-inch pan. Sift together flour, cinnamon and baking soda. In another bowl cream together sugar and corn oil. Combine ingredients and add the eggs and grated carrots. Fold and mix well. Bake at 350° for 45 to 50 minutes.

recipes.title: Raisin Pie
directions: Boil raisins, margarine and water for 5 minutes.
In a separate bowl, combine the remaining ingredients.
Add the raisin mixture to the dry ingredients and blend well. Pour into an unbaked shell and bake at 350°.
recipes.text: Raisin Pie. Boil raisins, margarine and water for 5 minutes. In a separate bowl, combine the remaining ingredients. Add the raisin mixture to the dry ingredients and blend well. Pour into an unbaked shell and bake at 350°.

recipes.title: Strawberry Salad
directions: Make jello with hot water and drained pineapple juice.
Add all but sour cream.
Put 1/2 of mix in a 7 x 9-inch pan (about 2 1/2 cups).
Refrigerate.
Keep other 1/2 at room temperature. When set, spread sour cream on top and put remaining mix on top. Refrigerate until serving time.
Keep unserved part in refrigerator.
recipes.text: Strawberry Salad. Make jello with hot water and drained pineapple juice. Add all but sour cream. Put 1/2 of mix in a 7 x 9-inch pan (about 2 1/2 cups). Refrigerate. Keep other 1/2 at room temperature. When set, spread sour cream on top and put remaining mix on top. Refrigerate until serving time. Keep unserved part in refrigerator.

recipes.title: Orange Sherbet Dessert
ingredients: 4 oranges, washed and cut in half
