directions: Remove and reserve pulp and juice from oranges. Mix sherbet, pulp and juice. Fill each half heaping with sherbet mixture; place in freezer. Before serving, top each orange with Cool Whip.
recipes.text: Orange Sherbet Dessert. Remove and reserve pulp and juice from oranges. Mix sherbet, pulp and juice. Fill each half heaping with sherbet mixture; place in freezer. Before serving, top each orange with Cool Whip.

recipes.title: Crinkle Cookies
directions: Mix and drop in spoonfuls in powdered sugar.
Bake 8 to 10 minutes at 350°.
recipes.text: Crinkle Cookies. Mix and drop in spoonfuls in powdered sugar. Bake 8 to 10 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Eggplant Mozzarella
directions: Slice eggplant 1/4 inch thick; dip in beaten eggs, then in bread crumbs (2 times).
Fry in oil until brown.
Drain on paper towels.
In a large baking pan (sprayed with Pam) layer the eggplant, then spaghetti sauce and the Mozzarella cheese.
Bake for 30 minutes in a 350° oven.
recipes.text: Eggplant Mozzarella. Slice eggplant 1/4 inch thick; dip in beaten eggs, then in bread crumbs (2 times). Fry in oil until brown. Drain on paper towels. In a large baking pan (sprayed with Pam) layer the eggplant, then spaghetti sauce and the Mozzarella cheese. Bake for 30 minutes in a 350° oven.

recipes.title: Broccoli Casserole
ingredients: 1 (1 lb.) pkg. frozen chopped broccoli, thawed
1 (10 3/4 oz.) can cream of mushroom soup, undiluted
directions: Cook broccoli for 5 minutes.
Drain well.
Mix together broccoli, soup, eggs, cheese and mayonnaise.
Place in a lightly greased 2-quart casserole.
Mix melted butter and cracker crumbs. Sprinkle crumbs over top of casserole.
Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 35 minutes or until casserole is set and lightly browned.
recipes.text: Broccoli Casserole. Cook broccoli for 5 minutes. Drain well. Mix together broccoli, soup, eggs, cheese and mayonnaise. Place in a lightly greased 2-quart casserole. Mix melted butter and cracker crumbs. Sprinkle crumbs over top of casserole. Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 35 minutes or until casserole is set and lightly browned.

recipes.title: Muffins
directions: Sift together the dry ingredients.
In a bowl, mix the beaten egg, milk and Wesson oil.
Add the dry ingredients.
Bake in greased muffin tins at 400° for 20 to 25 minutes.
recipes.text: Muffins. Sift together the dry ingredients. In a bowl, mix the beaten egg, milk and Wesson oil. Add the dry ingredients. Bake in greased muffin tins at 400° for 20 to 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Pastry(Serves 10)
directions: Sift flour, baking powder and salt. Pour boiling chicken broth over flour mixture. Let stand until cold. Add egg. If dough is too soft, add flour. If too stiff, add some milk. Roll and cut. Drop in boiling chicken broth. Cover and cook 12 to 15 minutes.
recipes.text: Pastry(Serves 10). Sift flour, baking powder and salt. Pour boiling chicken broth over flour mixture. Let stand until cold. Add egg. If dough is too soft, add flour. If too stiff, add some milk. Roll and cut. Drop in boiling chicken broth. Cover and cook 12 to 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Breakfast Casserole
ingredients: 6 eggs, beaten with a little milk
directions: Press crescent rolls in bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan.
Spread cooked sausage evenly over rolls.
Pour beaten eggs over sausage; sprinkle with garlic powder.
Top with grated cheese.
Bake 25 to 30 minutes at 350°.
recipes.text: Breakfast Casserole. Press crescent rolls in bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan. Spread cooked sausage evenly over rolls. Pour beaten eggs over sausage; sprinkle with garlic powder. Top with grated cheese. Bake 25 to 30 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Never-Fail Peanut Butter Fudge
directions: Butter an 8x8x2 pan or a 10 3/4x7x1 1/2 pan. In a medium saucepan, stir together sugar, milk and salt. Boil until it forms a soft ball when tested in cold water. Remove from heat; add vanilla and peanut butter. Beat and pour into buttered pan.
recipes.text: Never-Fail Peanut Butter Fudge. Butter an 8x8x2 pan or a 10 3/4x7x1 1/2 pan. In a medium saucepan, stir together sugar, milk and salt. Boil until it forms a soft ball when tested in cold water. Remove from heat; add vanilla and peanut butter. Beat and pour into buttered pan.

recipes.title: Dach(German Pancakes)
directions: Mix together all ingredients.
Spread batter thinly on a griddle and cook; turn when edges curl.
Serve with fried potatoes and onions.
recipes.text: Dach(German Pancakes). Mix together all ingredients. Spread batter thinly on a griddle and cook; turn when edges curl. Serve with fried potatoes and onions.

recipes.title: Taco Salad
ingredients: 1 large container (2 c.) Cheddar cheese, shredded
directions: Brown ground beef;
add taco seasoning.
Add to lettuce mixture and pour on 2 bottles mild taco sauce.
Mix.
recipes.text: Taco Salad. Brown ground beef; add taco seasoning. Add to lettuce mixture and pour on 2 bottles mild taco sauce. Mix.

recipes.title: Artichoke Dip
directions: Mix all ingredients together and bake at 350° for 20 to 30 minutes.
Serve with crackers or Doritos.
recipes.text: Artichoke Dip. Mix all ingredients together and bake at 350° for 20 to 30 minutes. Serve with crackers or Doritos.

recipes.title: Italian Torta(A-La-Venito)
directions: Crush crackers fine; add lukewarm milk and refrigerate overnight.
Next morning in separate bowl, beat eggs well, adding sugar, vanilla and brandy.
Combine this with cracker mixture.
If thick, add small amount of milk to consistency of cake batter. Add fruit mix, raisins and nuts.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour in a well-greased pan.
Test middle of cake for doneness.
Remove from oven and when slightly cooled, sprinkle with sugar.
recipes.text: Italian Torta(A-La-Venito). Crush crackers fine; add lukewarm milk and refrigerate overnight. Next morning in separate bowl, beat eggs well, adding sugar, vanilla and brandy. Combine this with cracker mixture. If thick, add small amount of milk to consistency of cake batter. Add fruit mix, raisins and nuts. Bake at 350° for 1 hour in a well-greased pan. Test middle of cake for doneness. Remove from oven and when slightly cooled, sprinkle with sugar.

recipes.title: Taco Casserole
directions: Cook ground chuck and onion in a large skillet. Add taco seasoning, tomatoes, tomato sauce and nacho cheese soup.
Let simmer for 10 minutes.
In casserole dish, add crushed chips. Pour hot mixture on top of chips. Stir well.
If too dry, add about 1 cup water or tomato juice. Top with cheese and microwave 5 minutes.
recipes.text: Taco Casserole. Cook ground chuck and onion in a large skillet. Add taco seasoning, tomatoes, tomato sauce and nacho cheese soup. Let simmer for 10 minutes. In casserole dish, add crushed chips. Pour hot mixture on top of chips. Stir well. If too dry, add about 1 cup water or tomato juice. Top with cheese and microwave 5 minutes.

recipes.title: Cheesy Cocktail Meatballs
directions: Mix all ingredients in a large bowl.
Shape into small balls (1-inch).
Place on lightly greased baking sheets.
Bake at 350° for 10 to 12 minutes.
Serve in chafing dish to keep warm.
recipes.text: Cheesy Cocktail Meatballs. Mix all ingredients in a large bowl. Shape into small balls (1-inch). Place on lightly greased baking sheets. Bake at 350° for 10 to 12 minutes. Serve in chafing dish to keep warm.

recipes.title: Orange Balls
ingredients: 1 c. pecans or walnuts, finely chopped
1 (6 oz.) can frozen orange juice, thawed and undiluted
directions: Mix crushed wafers, powdered sugar and pecans.
Add melted butter and thawed orange juice.
Mix well.
Roll into small balls. Roll them in finely grated coconut.
Store in refrigerator overnight.
They freeze well if you can keep them long enough. Makes about 5 to 6 dozen.
recipes.text: Orange Balls. Mix crushed wafers, powdered sugar and pecans. Add melted butter and thawed orange juice. Mix well. Roll into small balls. Roll them in finely grated coconut. Store in refrigerator overnight. They freeze well if you can keep them long enough. Makes about 5 to 6 dozen.

recipes.title: Frozen Dessert
ingredients: 1 can Thank You cherry pie filling
directions: Mix all ingredients together in bowl until well blended.
Pour into 9 x 13-inch pan.
Freeze.
Let set at room temperature at least 30 minutes before serving.
recipes.text: Frozen Dessert. Mix all ingredients together in bowl until well blended. Pour into 9 x 13-inch pan. Freeze. Let set at room temperature at least 30 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Hot Pepper Jelly
ingredients: 3 large bell peppers, cut and seeded
12 to 13 hot jalapeno peppers, not seeded
directions: Pulverize peppers in blender with water.
Put in large cooking pot and add other ingredients except Certo and food coloring. Boil hard for 5 minutes.
Add Certo and coloring and pour into sterilized glasses and seal.
Makes approximately 12 jelly glasses.
recipes.text: Hot Pepper Jelly. Pulverize peppers in blender with water. Put in large cooking pot and add other ingredients except Certo and food coloring. Boil hard for 5 minutes. Add Certo and coloring and pour into sterilized glasses and seal. Makes approximately 12 jelly glasses.

recipes.title: Toffee Bars
ingredients: 1 to 2 c. pecan, almond or walnut pieces
directions: Layer graham crackers on cookie sheet (they should almost fit exactly).
Melt butter with sugar. Bring to a boil and cook 2 minutes.
Pour syrup over crackers.
Sprinkle with nuts and bake 10 to 12 minutes at 350°.
Remove from pan immediately and cool on waxed paper.
recipes.text: Toffee Bars. Layer graham crackers on cookie sheet (they should almost fit exactly). Melt butter with sugar. Bring to a boil and cook 2 minutes. Pour syrup over crackers. Sprinkle with nuts and bake 10 to 12 minutes at 350°. Remove from pan immediately and cool on waxed paper.

recipes.title: Chocolate Meringue Pie
directions: Sift dry ingredients into large, heavy saucepan.
Add egg yolks and enough of the milk to make a thick paste.
Gradually add all the milk and cook, stirring constantly, until thickened. Remove from heat.
Add vanilla and butter; beat with mixer until smooth.
Pour into baked pie shells.
Add meringue and brown in hot oven.
Cool several hours before cutting.
(Makes excellent chocolate pudding, too!)
recipes.text: Chocolate Meringue Pie. Sift dry ingredients into large, heavy saucepan. Add egg yolks and enough of the milk to make a thick paste. Gradually add all the milk and cook, stirring constantly, until thickened. Remove from heat. Add vanilla and butter; beat with mixer until smooth. Pour into baked pie shells. Add meringue and brown in hot oven. Cool several hours before cutting. (Makes excellent chocolate pudding, too!)

recipes.title: Swedish Meatballs And Sauce
directions: Preheat oven to 350°.
In large bowl, combine ground beef, onion, bread crumbs, milk, egg, salt, allspice and pepper until blended.
Shape meat mixture into the size of large marbles using 1 teaspoon mixture each.
Arrange meatballs on one or more shallow baking pans.
Bake 4 to 5 minutes or until brown.
Remove and add to sauce.
Makes 80 meatballs.
recipes.text: Swedish Meatballs And Sauce. Preheat oven to 350°. In large bowl, combine ground beef, onion, bread crumbs, milk, egg, salt, allspice and pepper until blended. Shape meat mixture into the size of large marbles using 1 teaspoon mixture each. Arrange meatballs on one or more shallow baking pans. Bake 4 to 5 minutes or until brown. Remove and add to sauce. Makes 80 meatballs.

recipes.title: Coconut Macaroons
directions: Mix all by hand.
Drop by teaspoon onto well-greased cookie sheet.
Flatten just a little.
Bake at 350° for 10 to 12 minutes. Cool on wire rack.
recipes.text: Coconut Macaroons. Mix all by hand. Drop by teaspoon onto well-greased cookie sheet. Flatten just a little. Bake at 350° for 10 to 12 minutes. Cool on wire rack.

recipes.title: Red Rouser
directions: Place ice cream in tall glass.
Fill glass with cranberry juice.
recipes.text: Red Rouser. Place ice cream in tall glass. Fill glass with cranberry juice.

recipes.title: Tartar Sauce
directions: Combine all ingredients and chill.
recipes.text: Tartar Sauce. Combine all ingredients and chill.

recipes.title: Peanut Blossoms Cookies
ingredients: 1 3/4 c. (10 oz. pkg.) Hershey's mini kisses
directions: Heat oven to 375°.
Beat shortening and peanut butter until well blended.
Add 1 1/2 cups sugar and brown sugar; beat until fluffy.
Add egg, milk and vanilla; beat well.
Combine flour, baking soda and salt; gradually add to peanut mixture, beating until well blended.
Shape dough into 1-inch balls.
Roll in granulated sugar.
Place on ungreased cookie sheet.
Bake 8 to 10 minutes or until lightly browned.
Place 3 mini kisses on each cookie, pressing down lightly.
Makes about 4 dozen cookies.
recipes.text: Peanut Blossoms Cookies. Heat oven to 375°. Beat shortening and peanut butter until well blended. Add 1 1/2 cups sugar and brown sugar; beat until fluffy. Add egg, milk and vanilla; beat well. Combine flour, baking soda and salt; gradually add to peanut mixture, beating until well blended. Shape dough into 1-inch balls. Roll in granulated sugar. Place on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake 8 to 10 minutes or until lightly browned. Place 3 mini kisses on each cookie, pressing down lightly. Makes about 4 dozen cookies.

recipes.title: Irmik Tatlisi(Farina Dessert)
directions: Pour milk, farina and sugar in a medium pan.
Boil at medium heat.
Put half of the mixture into small cups.
Put grated apples and walnuts onto it.
Put the remaining mixture.
Wait until the mixture thickens.
Dress the dessert with cinnamon and coconut.
recipes.text: Irmik Tatlisi(Farina Dessert). Pour milk, farina and sugar in a medium pan. Boil at medium heat. Put half of the mixture into small cups. Put grated apples and walnuts onto it. Put the remaining mixture. Wait until the mixture thickens. Dress the dessert with cinnamon and coconut.

recipes.title: Blueberry Pie
directions: Boil 1 C. blueberries with 1 C. sugar, 1/2 cup water.
Blend together water, flour and salt to make a smooth paste. Add to the blueberries and stir until thick.
Remove from stove, cool, add 3 C. blueberries, put in baked pie shell.
Cover with Cool Whip. Chill and serve.
recipes.text: Blueberry Pie. Boil 1 C. blueberries with 1 C. sugar, 1/2 cup water. Blend together water, flour and salt to make a smooth paste. Add to the blueberries and stir until thick. Remove from stove, cool, add 3 C. blueberries, put in baked pie shell. Cover with Cool Whip. Chill and serve.

recipes.title: French Coconut Pie
directions: Preheat oven to 350°.
Combine all ingredients and pour into pie shell.
Bake about 1 hour.
recipes.text: French Coconut Pie. Preheat oven to 350°. Combine all ingredients and pour into pie shell. Bake about 1 hour.

recipes.title: Rocky'S Meat Marinade
directions: Mix all together. This is good for chicken or beef.
One hour or so for chicken and 2 to 4 hours for beef.
recipes.text: Rocky'S Meat Marinade. Mix all together. This is good for chicken or beef. One hour or so for chicken and 2 to 4 hours for beef.

recipes.title: Praline Grahams
directions: Place graham crackers side by side on a 15 x 10-inch greased cookie sheet with raised sides.
Boil butter and sugar together for 2 minutes.
Remove from heat.
Add vanilla and nuts.
Spread over crackers.
Bake in preheated 350° oven for 10 minutes.
Remove from oven; let settle a few seconds.
Spoon excess on crackers and remove each cracker individually to another cookie sheet to cool. Makes 40 cookies.
recipes.text: Praline Grahams. Place graham crackers side by side on a 15 x 10-inch greased cookie sheet with raised sides. Boil butter and sugar together for 2 minutes. Remove from heat. Add vanilla and nuts. Spread over crackers. Bake in preheated 350° oven for 10 minutes. Remove from oven; let settle a few seconds. Spoon excess on crackers and remove each cracker individually to another cookie sheet to cool. Makes 40 cookies.

recipes.title: Bundt Coffee Cake
directions: Place frozen rolls randomly in Bundt pan.
Mix pudding mix, brown sugar and nuts.
Sprinkle over rolls.
Melt oleo and drizzle over rolls.
Mix sugar and cinnamon and sprinkle over rolls.
Let set overnight or 8 to 10 hours to allow rolls to rise.
Bake 30 minutes at 350°.
recipes.text: Bundt Coffee Cake. Place frozen rolls randomly in Bundt pan. Mix pudding mix, brown sugar and nuts. Sprinkle over rolls. Melt oleo and drizzle over rolls. Mix sugar and cinnamon and sprinkle over rolls. Let set overnight or 8 to 10 hours to allow rolls to rise. Bake 30 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Hot Chicken Salad
ingredients: 1/2 c. sliced water chestnuts or almonds
directions: Mix all ingredients, except potato chips.
Put in a large baking dish.
Top with crushed chips.
Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes or until bubbly.
recipes.text: Hot Chicken Salad. Mix all ingredients, except potato chips. Put in a large baking dish. Top with crushed chips. Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes or until bubbly.

recipes.title: Butterscotch Pudding Cake(World War Ii, Sugarless)
ingredients: 2 eggs, beaten in mixture one at a time
3/4 c. sour milk, mixed with 1/2 tsp. soda
directions: Mix together margarine and pudding mix.
Add eggs and syrup, then milk with soda, then dry ingredients and vanilla.
Bake in 350° oven for 20 to 30 minutes or until a toothpick comes out clean when stuck in the middle of cake.
recipes.text: Butterscotch Pudding Cake(World War Ii, Sugarless). Mix together margarine and pudding mix. Add eggs and syrup, then milk with soda, then dry ingredients and vanilla. Bake in 350° oven for 20 to 30 minutes or until a toothpick comes out clean when stuck in the middle of cake.

recipes.title: Spinach Dip
ingredients: 1 (10 oz.) pkg. chopped spinach, thawed and drained well (not cooked)
directions: Mix all ingredients together.
Chill at least 4 hours.
Serve with crackers or vegetables.
recipes.text: Spinach Dip. Mix all ingredients together. Chill at least 4 hours. Serve with crackers or vegetables.

recipes.title: German Chocolate Upside-Down Cake
directions: Preheat oven to 350°.
Grease a 9 x 13-inch cake pan.
Prepare cake mix as directed on package.
Stir in nuts and pour batter into pan.
recipes.text: German Chocolate Upside-Down Cake. Preheat oven to 350°. Grease a 9 x 13-inch cake pan. Prepare cake mix as directed on package. Stir in nuts and pour batter into pan.

recipes.title: Sausy Strawberry Shake
ingredients: 2 c. ice cream or frozen yogurt
directions: Put strawberries in blender container.
Blend until smooth; add milk.
Cover and blend.
Add ice cream and process.
Pour into glasses.
recipes.text: Sausy Strawberry Shake. Put strawberries in blender container. Blend until smooth; add milk. Cover and blend. Add ice cream and process. Pour into glasses.

recipes.title: Truffle
ingredients: 1 pound cake or angel food cake, cut in squares
directions: Arrange the ingredients in order given, with Dream Whip on top.
Refrigerate to set.
recipes.text: Truffle. Arrange the ingredients in order given, with Dream Whip on top. Refrigerate to set.

recipes.title: Hummingbird Cake
ingredients: butter, room temperature for pans and racks
3 c. all-purpose flour, plus more for pans
Dried Pineapple Flowers (see recipe below), optional
directions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees, with rack in center. Butter two 9x2 inch round cake pans. Line bottoms of the pans with parchment (or wax) paper. Butter paper and dust the pans with flour, tapping out any excess. Set aside. In medium bowl, sift together flour, baking soda, cinnamon and salt; set aside. In mixer bowl, beat oil, vanilla and sugar until combined, about 2 minutes. Add eggs one at a time, incorporating each before adding the next. Beat at medium speed until mixture is pale yellow and fluffy, about 3 minutes. In a medium bowl, mix together bananas, pineapple, walnuts and coconut. Add to egg mixture, stir until well combined. Add flour mixture and blend well. Divide batter between pans. Bake until golden brown and a cake tester inserted in the center comes out clean, 30 to 40 minutes. Transfer pans to greased wire rack. Let cool 15 minutes. Run a knife around edges to loosen. Invert onto racks; reinvert, top side up. Cool completely. Assemble cake, or wrap each layer well and freeze. With serrated knife, trim and discard rounded top off one layer. Place layer on serving platter. Using an offset spatula, spread top of layer with 1/4 inch of frosting. Top with untrimmed layer. Frost sides and top with remaining frosting. Decorate with pineapple flowers, if desired. Serve at room temperature (cake can be refrigerated up to 3 days).
recipes.text: Hummingbird Cake. Preheat oven to 350 degrees, with rack in center. Butter two 9x2 inch round cake pans. Line bottoms of the pans with parchment (or wax) paper. Butter paper and dust the pans with flour, tapping out any excess. Set aside. In medium bowl, sift together flour, baking soda, cinnamon and salt; set aside. In mixer bowl, beat oil, vanilla and sugar until combined, about 2 minutes. Add eggs one at a time, incorporating each before adding the next. Beat at medium speed until mixture is pale yellow and fluffy, about 3 minutes. In a medium bowl, mix together bananas, pineapple, walnuts and coconut. Add to egg mixture, stir until well combined. Add flour mixture and blend well. Divide batter between pans. Bake until golden brown and a cake tester inserted in the center comes out clean, 30 to 40 minutes. Transfer pans to greased wire rack. Let cool 15 minutes. Run a knife around edges to loosen. Invert onto racks; reinvert, top side up. Cool completely. Assemble cake, or wrap each layer well and freeze. With serrated knife, trim and discard rounded top off one layer. Place layer on serving platter. Using an offset spatula, spread top of layer with 1/4 inch of frosting. Top with untrimmed layer. Frost sides and top with remaining frosting. Decorate with pineapple flowers, if desired. Serve at room temperature (cake can be refrigerated up to 3 days).

recipes.title: Tomato Pudding
ingredients: 2 c. dry bread cubes (Pepperidge Farm corn bread stuffing)
directions: Melt puree, brown sugar and butter.
Cook until it comes to a boil, then add salt and cinnamon.
Spray medium size casserole dish.
Put in bread crumbs and pour puree mixture over crumbs; stir until covered.
Bake at 300° to 325° for 45 minutes.
This side dish serves 10 to 14.
recipes.text: Tomato Pudding. Melt puree, brown sugar and butter. Cook until it comes to a boil, then add salt and cinnamon. Spray medium size casserole dish. Put in bread crumbs and pour puree mixture over crumbs; stir until covered. Bake at 300° to 325° for 45 minutes. This side dish serves 10 to 14.

recipes.title: Cherry Cheesecake Cupcakes
directions: You will need 12 cupcake papers and 2 cupcake pans.
recipes.text: Cherry Cheesecake Cupcakes. You will need 12 cupcake papers and 2 cupcake pans.

recipes.title: Oriental Slaw
ingredients: 1/2 head cabbage, chopped or 1/2 bag slaw cabbage
1 pkg. chicken flavored Ramen noodles (save flavoring packet for later)
directions: Bake sesame seed and almonds for 5 minutes at 350°.
recipes.text: Oriental Slaw. Bake sesame seed and almonds for 5 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Debbie'S Fried Dill Pickles
directions: Beat eggs with milk, Lea & Perrins sauce, Tabasco, 1 tablespoon flour, salt and pepper to taste.
Mix 2 cups flour with salt and pepper in separate bowl.
Dip pickles in the egg mixture and then into flour.
Deep-fry until golden brown at 350°.
recipes.text: Debbie'S Fried Dill Pickles. Beat eggs with milk, Lea & Perrins sauce, Tabasco, 1 tablespoon flour, salt and pepper to taste. Mix 2 cups flour with salt and pepper in separate bowl. Dip pickles in the egg mixture and then into flour. Deep-fry until golden brown at 350°.

recipes.title: Spinach Pie
directions: Mix all together.
Pour into casserole dish.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Spinach Pie. Mix all together. Pour into casserole dish. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Sweet Potato Pie
directions: Blend all ingredients together and pour in pie shells.
Bake in moderate oven at 325° for 45 minutes.
Makes 2 pies.
recipes.text: Sweet Potato Pie. Blend all ingredients together and pour in pie shells. Bake in moderate oven at 325° for 45 minutes. Makes 2 pies.

recipes.title: Impossible Chicken N' Broccoli Pie(The Pie That Makes Its Own Crust)
directions: Heat oven to 400°.
Grease pie plate (10 x 1 1/2-inches). Rinse broccoli under running cold water to thaw; drain thoroughly. Mix broccoli, 2 cups of Cheddar cheese, chicken and onion in pie plate.
Beat milk, eggs, baking mix, salt and pepper.
Bake until knife inserted in center comes out clean, 25 to 35 minutes.
Top with remaining cheese.
Bake just until cheese is melted, 1 to 2 minutes longer.
Cool 5 minutes.
Serves 6 to 8.
recipes.text: Impossible Chicken N' Broccoli Pie(The Pie That Makes Its Own Crust). Heat oven to 400°. Grease pie plate (10 x 1 1/2-inches). Rinse broccoli under running cold water to thaw; drain thoroughly. Mix broccoli, 2 cups of Cheddar cheese, chicken and onion in pie plate. Beat milk, eggs, baking mix, salt and pepper. Bake until knife inserted in center comes out clean, 25 to 35 minutes. Top with remaining cheese. Bake just until cheese is melted, 1 to 2 minutes longer. Cool 5 minutes. Serves 6 to 8.

recipes.title: Mom'S Cinnamon Rolls
directions: Warm milk and water; add sugar and yeast.
Stir until yeast dissolves.
Add 2 cups flour and beat until smooth.
Leave in warm place 20 minutes or 1 hour.
Add sugar, shortening, warm water, 3 1/2 cups flour and salt.
Use a big spoon to mix.
Set back and let rise until double.
Punch down; roll out and spread with butter, sugar and cinnamon.
Roll up into long roll; cut off 1-inch pieces. Place, spaced apart, in greased pans.
Let rise again.
Bake at 350°.
recipes.text: Mom'S Cinnamon Rolls. Warm milk and water; add sugar and yeast. Stir until yeast dissolves. Add 2 cups flour and beat until smooth. Leave in warm place 20 minutes or 1 hour. Add sugar, shortening, warm water, 3 1/2 cups flour and salt. Use a big spoon to mix. Set back and let rise until double. Punch down; roll out and spread with butter, sugar and cinnamon. Roll up into long roll; cut off 1-inch pieces. Place, spaced apart, in greased pans. Let rise again. Bake at 350°.

recipes.title: Bar-B-Que'D Pork Chops
directions: Place pork chops in a large skillet and cover with water. Brown the chops.
Remove from skillet and brown the onions.
Put chops back in the skillet with the onions and add vinegar, brown sugar, and ketchup.
Add water to cover.
Cook over high heat until it starts to boil.
Reduce heat to low, let simmer until gravy thickens, about 2 hours.
recipes.text: Bar-B-Que'D Pork Chops. Place pork chops in a large skillet and cover with water. Brown the chops. Remove from skillet and brown the onions. Put chops back in the skillet with the onions and add vinegar, brown sugar, and ketchup. Add water to cover. Cook over high heat until it starts to boil. Reduce heat to low, let simmer until gravy thickens, about 2 hours.

recipes.title: Congealed Ambrosia
ingredients: 2 (11 oz.) can mandarin oranges, divide and halved
directions: Drain pineapple; reserve juice and add enough water to make 2 cups.
Place juice in saucepan and bring to a boil.
Add jello stirring until dissolved.
Remove from heat and add sherbet; stir until sherbet is melted.
Chill until consistency of unbeaten egg whites.
Add pineapple and 1/2 of the oranges.
Spoon into 6 oiled cups or a mold.
Cover and chill until firm.
recipes.text: Congealed Ambrosia. Drain pineapple; reserve juice and add enough water to make 2 cups. Place juice in saucepan and bring to a boil. Add jello stirring until dissolved. Remove from heat and add sherbet; stir until sherbet is melted. Chill until consistency of unbeaten egg whites. Add pineapple and 1/2 of the oranges. Spoon into 6 oiled cups or a mold. Cover and chill until firm.

recipes.title: Mayonnaise Cake
directions: Sift together the first five (5) ingredients.
Add the next four (4) ingredients;
mixing well after each addition.
recipes.text: Mayonnaise Cake. Sift together the first five (5) ingredients. Add the next four (4) ingredients; mixing well after each addition.

recipes.title: Cucumber Relish
ingredients: 1/2 c. coarse ground sweet red bell peppers
directions: Use a coarse grader or grinder for vegetables.
Combine all vegetables in large pan.
Sprinkle with salt; cover with cold water.
Let stand 4 hours.
Drain thoroughly in colander.
Press out all excess liquid.
Combine sugar, vinegar and seed.
Bring to a boil and stir until sugar is dissolved.
Stir in drained vegetables and let simmer 10 minutes.
Pack in hot jars.
Yield:
6 pints.
ner: coarse ground sweet red bell peppers
recipes.text: Cucumber Relish. Use a coarse grader or grinder for vegetables. Combine all vegetables in large pan. Sprinkle with salt; cover with cold water. Let stand 4 hours. Drain thoroughly in colander. Press out all excess liquid. Combine sugar, vinegar and seed. Bring to a boil and stir until sugar is dissolved. Stir in drained vegetables and let simmer 10 minutes. Pack in hot jars. Yield: 6 pints.

recipes.title: Cheesy Broccoli Soup
ingredients: 3/4 lb. Velveeta pasteurized prepared cheese product, cut up
1 pkg. frozen chopped broccoli, thawed and drained
directions: Melt butter in large saucepan on medium heat.
Add onion; cook and stir 5 minutes or until onion is tender.
Add flour; cook 1 minute or until bubbly, stirring constantly.
Stir in milk. Bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to medium-low; simmer 1 minute.
Add remaining ingredients.
Cook until Velveeta is melted and soup is heated through, stirring occasionally.
recipes.text: Cheesy Broccoli Soup. Melt butter in large saucepan on medium heat. Add onion; cook and stir 5 minutes or until onion is tender. Add flour; cook 1 minute or until bubbly, stirring constantly. Stir in milk. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat to medium-low; simmer 1 minute. Add remaining ingredients. Cook until Velveeta is melted and soup is heated through, stirring occasionally.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Pie
directions: Blend pudding, peanut butter, milk and Cool Whip together and pour in graham cracker shell.
Keep in refrigerator.
recipes.text: Peanut Butter Pie. Blend pudding, peanut butter, milk and Cool Whip together and pour in graham cracker shell. Keep in refrigerator.

recipes.title: Oatmeal Bars
directions: Mix oatmeal and boiling water and let stand for 20 minutes. Cream together sugars and shortening.
Add eggs, flour, soda and salt.
Add oatmeal mixture and beat well.
Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.
Frost with topping.
recipes.text: Oatmeal Bars. Mix oatmeal and boiling water and let stand for 20 minutes. Cream together sugars and shortening. Add eggs, flour, soda and salt. Add oatmeal mixture and beat well. Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes. Frost with topping.

recipes.title: Four Minute Cookies(No Bake)
directions: Mix together oleo, sugar and cocoa, then add milk.
Bring to boil in saucepan for 1 minute.
(Mix in pan.)
Add quickly, vanilla and peanut butter.
Add oatmeal all at once and stir well to combine mixture.
Drop on waxed paper.
recipes.text: Four Minute Cookies(No Bake). Mix together oleo, sugar and cocoa, then add milk. Bring to boil in saucepan for 1 minute. (Mix in pan.) Add quickly, vanilla and peanut butter. Add oatmeal all at once and stir well to combine mixture. Drop on waxed paper.

recipes.title: Gooey Butter Cake
directions: Mix together by hand the cake mix, 2 eggs and melted butter. Pat into a well-greased and floured 9 x 12-inch pan.
Set aside, then mix 2 eggs, 1 box powdered sugar and cream cheese until well blended.
Pour over cake mixture.
Preheat oven to 350°.
Bake for 45 to 55 minutes at 350°.
Remove from oven, let cool and sprinkle with 1/4 cup powdered sugar.
recipes.text: Gooey Butter Cake. Mix together by hand the cake mix, 2 eggs and melted butter. Pat into a well-greased and floured 9 x 12-inch pan. Set aside, then mix 2 eggs, 1 box powdered sugar and cream cheese until well blended. Pour over cake mixture. Preheat oven to 350°. Bake for 45 to 55 minutes at 350°. Remove from oven, let cool and sprinkle with 1/4 cup powdered sugar.

recipes.title: Hot Chocolate Mix
directions: Mix all ingredients and store in a tightly covered container. Use 1/3 cup mix to 8 ounces hot water.
Makes 54 cups or 3 1/2 gallons of drink.
recipes.text: Hot Chocolate Mix. Mix all ingredients and store in a tightly covered container. Use 1/3 cup mix to 8 ounces hot water. Makes 54 cups or 3 1/2 gallons of drink.

recipes.title: East Side House Dressing
directions: Mix all ingredients together, vinegar last.
Beat for 4 minutes with electric beater.
Makes one quart of dressing. Refrigerate and use as needed.
recipes.text: East Side House Dressing. Mix all ingredients together, vinegar last. Beat for 4 minutes with electric beater. Makes one quart of dressing. Refrigerate and use as needed.

recipes.title: Banana Pudding
directions: Line bottom of a casserole dish with wafers.
Cover with banana slices.
Repeat with alternating layers until casserole is filled.
Set aside.
recipes.text: Banana Pudding. Line bottom of a casserole dish with wafers. Cover with banana slices. Repeat with alternating layers until casserole is filled. Set aside.

recipes.title: 1949 Steak, Country Style(American)
ingredients: 1/2 lb. peeled fresh or canned mushrooms, sliced
directions: Cut steak into serving pieces and dredge with the seasoned flour.
Melt 1/4 cup butter in a large frying pan and add the onions and mushrooms.
Cook until the onions are tender and the mushrooms are just slightly browned.
Remove the onions and mushrooms from the pan and set aside.
Add the remaining 1/4 cup butter and when melted, add the steak and brown on both sides. Stir in the rest of the ingredients, along with the mushroom mixture.
Cover and cook until meat is tender enough to cut with a fork.
Serves 6.
recipes.text: 1949 Steak, Country Style(American). Cut steak into serving pieces and dredge with the seasoned flour. Melt 1/4 cup butter in a large frying pan and add the onions and mushrooms. Cook until the onions are tender and the mushrooms are just slightly browned. Remove the onions and mushrooms from the pan and set aside. Add the remaining 1/4 cup butter and when melted, add the steak and brown on both sides. Stir in the rest of the ingredients, along with the mushroom mixture. Cover and cook until meat is tender enough to cut with a fork. Serves 6.

recipes.title: Freezer Spaghetti Sauce
ingredients: 20 large tomatoes, pitted and chopped in chunks
directions: Bring slowly to boil, stirring often.
Lower heat; simmer 30 minutes or until mixture thickens.
Cool slightly.
Measure 3 cups at a time into a blender; whip 1 minute at high speed.
Pour into freezer container, leaving 1 inch on top.
Yields 16 cups.
recipes.text: Freezer Spaghetti Sauce. Bring slowly to boil, stirring often. Lower heat; simmer 30 minutes or until mixture thickens. Cool slightly. Measure 3 cups at a time into a blender; whip 1 minute at high speed. Pour into freezer container, leaving 1 inch on top. Yields 16 cups.

recipes.title: Barbecue Ribs
directions: Mix catsup, brown sugar, liquid smoke, garlic powder and onion powder.
Cut ribs into single pieces.
Broil each side 15 minutes. Place in crock-pot.
Cover with sauce.
Cook on low 8 to 10 hours.
(High temperature is too hot.
It burns the sauce and ribs.)
recipes.text: Barbecue Ribs. Mix catsup, brown sugar, liquid smoke, garlic powder and onion powder. Cut ribs into single pieces. Broil each side 15 minutes. Place in crock-pot. Cover with sauce. Cook on low 8 to 10 hours. (High temperature is too hot. It burns the sauce and ribs.)

recipes.title: Chicken Casserole
ingredients: 1 pkg. chicken flavored Stove Top stuffing
directions: Cook chicken until done.
Pull off the bone.
Mix soup and water; put into casserole bowl.
Add chicken on top of that, then fix Stove Top stuffing on top of chicken.
Bake at 375° for 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Chicken Casserole. Cook chicken until done. Pull off the bone. Mix soup and water; put into casserole bowl. Add chicken on top of that, then fix Stove Top stuffing on top of chicken. Bake at 375° for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Company Cabbage Casserole
directions: Cook cabbage in boiling, salted water for 10 minutes.
Drain well.
Place 9 x 13 dish.
Saute onion in margarine until tender, then mix in cheese and soup.
Pour this sauce mixture over cabbage and top with bread crumbs.
Bake at 325° for 30 minutes or until bubbly.
Serves 8 to 10.
recipes.text: Company Cabbage Casserole. Cook cabbage in boiling, salted water for 10 minutes. Drain well. Place 9 x 13 dish. Saute onion in margarine until tender, then mix in cheese and soup. Pour this sauce mixture over cabbage and top with bread crumbs. Bake at 325° for 30 minutes or until bubbly. Serves 8 to 10.

recipes.title: No Bake Cookies
directions: Mix first 4 ingredients and cook on medium heat.
When it comes to a boil, boil for about 2 minutes.
Remove from heat and quickly add peanut butter, oats and vanilla.
Stir thoroughly and drop by spoonfuls onto waxed paper.
Let harden.
recipes.text: No Bake Cookies. Mix first 4 ingredients and cook on medium heat. When it comes to a boil, boil for about 2 minutes. Remove from heat and quickly add peanut butter, oats and vanilla. Stir thoroughly and drop by spoonfuls onto waxed paper. Let harden.

recipes.title: Layer Dip
directions: Mix in a bowl the sour cream and package of taco mix.
In a bowl or deep dish plate, layer bean dip, then pour over sour cream and taco mix mixture.
Shred lettuce and put on next.
Next, chop onion and also layer that.
Apply avocado dip. Top that with grated cheese. Apply chopped olives and then garnish with some chopped tomatoes.
recipes.text: Layer Dip. Mix in a bowl the sour cream and package of taco mix. In a bowl or deep dish plate, layer bean dip, then pour over sour cream and taco mix mixture. Shred lettuce and put on next. Next, chop onion and also layer that. Apply avocado dip. Top that with grated cheese. Apply chopped olives and then garnish with some chopped tomatoes.

recipes.title: Vegetable Casserole
directions: Mix first five ingredients and pour into a large casserole. Coat the crumbs with margarine and place on top.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Vegetable Casserole. Mix first five ingredients and pour into a large casserole. Coat the crumbs with margarine and place on top. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Chicken Divan
ingredients: 2 (10 oz.) pkg. broccoli, cooked and drained
directions: Layer broccoli and chicken in a utility dish.
Cover with cheese slices.
Mix together evaporated milk and soup.
Pour over broccoli, chicken and cheese.
Bake uncovered at 350° for 30 minutes.
Top with onion rings and bake 15 minutes more.
Let stand 10 minutes before serving.
recipes.text: Chicken Divan. Layer broccoli and chicken in a utility dish. Cover with cheese slices. Mix together evaporated milk and soup. Pour over broccoli, chicken and cheese. Bake uncovered at 350° for 30 minutes. Top with onion rings and bake 15 minutes more. Let stand 10 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Stir Crazy Cake
directions: Pour flour, 1 1/2 cups sugar, cocoa, soda and salt into a 9 x 12-inch pan.
Stir with a fork.
Form 3 wells.
Pour oil in one, vinegar in one and vanilla in one.
Pour cold water over all and stir.
Combine 1/4 cup sugar and the cinnamon; sprinkle over top. Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes.
recipes.text: Stir Crazy Cake. Pour flour, 1 1/2 cups sugar, cocoa, soda and salt into a 9 x 12-inch pan. Stir with a fork. Form 3 wells. Pour oil in one, vinegar in one and vanilla in one. Pour cold water over all and stir. Combine 1/4 cup sugar and the cinnamon; sprinkle over top. Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Chicken Pot Pie
ingredients: Pastry for 9-inch 2-crust pie (I use a frozen crust for the bottom and a refrigerated crust for the top)
directions: Heat oven to 425. Melt butter in large saucepan over low heat.
Mix in flour and spices.
Cook over low heat and stir until mixture is smooth and bubbly.
Remove from heat.
Add broth and milk.
Heat to boiling stirring constantly.
Boil and stir 1 minute.
Remove from heat.
Add chicken and vegetables. Pour mixture into pie crust bottom.
Place refrigerated crust on top, trim, and seal edges.
Cover edge of pie with foil strips and bake for 35 to 40 minutes.
(Remove foil strips during last 15 minutes of baking.)
recipes.text: Chicken Pot Pie. Heat oven to 425. Melt butter in large saucepan over low heat. Mix in flour and spices. Cook over low heat and stir until mixture is smooth and bubbly. Remove from heat. Add broth and milk. Heat to boiling stirring constantly. Boil and stir 1 minute. Remove from heat. Add chicken and vegetables. Pour mixture into pie crust bottom. Place refrigerated crust on top, trim, and seal edges. Cover edge of pie with foil strips and bake for 35 to 40 minutes. (Remove foil strips during last 15 minutes of baking.)

recipes.title: Glazed Orange Pork Chops
directions: Brown chops on both sides.
Place an orange slice on each chop; sprinkle with cinnamon and nutmeg.
Add broth and sugar. Cover; cook over low heat 35 minutes.
recipes.text: Glazed Orange Pork Chops. Brown chops on both sides. Place an orange slice on each chop; sprinkle with cinnamon and nutmeg. Add broth and sugar. Cover; cook over low heat 35 minutes.

recipes.title: Old Fashioned Amber Pie
directions: Cream sugar, flour and butter.
Add well beaten egg yolks and the other ingredients in the order given.
Cook slowly until thick.
Pour into baked pie shell.
Cover with meringue made with the 4 egg whites and brown at 350°.
recipes.text: Old Fashioned Amber Pie. Cream sugar, flour and butter. Add well beaten egg yolks and the other ingredients in the order given. Cook slowly until thick. Pour into baked pie shell. Cover with meringue made with the 4 egg whites and brown at 350°.

recipes.title: Butterscotch Cookies
directions: Mix all ingredients together; knead last cup of flour.
Make into a roll; leave in refrigerator overnight.
Slice and bake at 375° for 10 minutes.
recipes.text: Butterscotch Cookies. Mix all ingredients together; knead last cup of flour. Make into a roll; leave in refrigerator overnight. Slice and bake at 375° for 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Potato Soup
directions: Bake potatoes and cool.
Cook bacon (crisp).
In heavy pot melt margarine; add flour.
Add milk and cook 5 to 6 minutes to let it thicken.
Scoop pulp out of potatoes (I chopped my potatoes).
Add cheese and green onions; salt and pepper to taste. On very low heat add sour cream.
When serving add chopped bacon and cheese.
recipes.text: Potato Soup. Bake potatoes and cool. Cook bacon (crisp). In heavy pot melt margarine; add flour. Add milk and cook 5 to 6 minutes to let it thicken. Scoop pulp out of potatoes (I chopped my potatoes). Add cheese and green onions; salt and pepper to taste. On very low heat add sour cream. When serving add chopped bacon and cheese.

recipes.title: Eight Minute Cake
directions: Put everything in bowl at one time and cut the oleo into little pieces.
Beat for 8 minutes.
Grease and flour two (9-inch) pans.
Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.
recipes.text: Eight Minute Cake. Put everything in bowl at one time and cut the oleo into little pieces. Beat for 8 minutes. Grease and flour two (9-inch) pans. Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.

recipes.title: Caramel Popcorn Bars
directions: In a large bowl, combine popcorn, cereal, M&M's and pretzels. Set aside.
recipes.text: Caramel Popcorn Bars. In a large bowl, combine popcorn, cereal, M&M's and pretzels. Set aside.

recipes.title: Waldorf Salad
directions: In medium bowl, mix mayonnaise with lemon juice.
With small sharp knife, dice apples (do not peel).
Add diced apples to mayonnaise and lemon juice mixture.
Stir to coat well.
Add sliced celery, walnuts and raisins.
Toss gently to mix well. Arrange lettuce leaves on serving platter.
Spoon salad into center.
recipes.text: Waldorf Salad. In medium bowl, mix mayonnaise with lemon juice. With small sharp knife, dice apples (do not peel). Add diced apples to mayonnaise and lemon juice mixture. Stir to coat well. Add sliced celery, walnuts and raisins. Toss gently to mix well. Arrange lettuce leaves on serving platter. Spoon salad into center.

recipes.title: Holiday Baked Chicken Or Turkey
ingredients: 2 c. cooked, diced chicken or turkey
directions: Mix together all ingredients (except cheese).
Place in oblong baking dish.
Top with cheese.
Bake at 300° until heated through. Do not freeze.
recipes.text: Holiday Baked Chicken Or Turkey. Mix together all ingredients (except cheese). Place in oblong baking dish. Top with cheese. Bake at 300° until heated through. Do not freeze.

recipes.title: Company Casserole
directions: Cook noodles according to directions.
Drain.
Brown beef in 3 tablespoons margarine.
Stir in tomato sauce.
Remove from heat. Combine cheeses and sour cream.
Add onion, parsley and pepper to taste.
recipes.text: Company Casserole. Cook noodles according to directions. Drain. Brown beef in 3 tablespoons margarine. Stir in tomato sauce. Remove from heat. Combine cheeses and sour cream. Add onion, parsley and pepper to taste.

recipes.title: Tuna Casserole
directions: Saute onion and bell pepper in butter until clear.
Add tuna, water, soup and salt and pepper to taste.
Mix well and then add cooked spaghetti.
Mix part of the cheese in the mixture and reserve part to cover the top.
Cook at 350° for 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Tuna Casserole. Saute onion and bell pepper in butter until clear. Add tuna, water, soup and salt and pepper to taste. Mix well and then add cooked spaghetti. Mix part of the cheese in the mixture and reserve part to cover the top. Cook at 350° for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Zucchini Bread
directions: Beat eggs until fluffy. Add sugar, zucchini, vanilla, oil, salt, soda, powder and cinnamon. Add nuts, if desired.
Pour into greased and floured pan. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Zucchini Bread. Beat eggs until fluffy. Add sugar, zucchini, vanilla, oil, salt, soda, powder and cinnamon. Add nuts, if desired. Pour into greased and floured pan. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Hamburger Stew
directions: Brown hamburger in skillet.
Drain mixed vegetables.
Put in large pot.
Add hamburger and tomato juice.
Stir in brown gravy mix.
Simmer for 15 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Serve with hot biscuits.
recipes.text: Hamburger Stew. Brown hamburger in skillet. Drain mixed vegetables. Put in large pot. Add hamburger and tomato juice. Stir in brown gravy mix. Simmer for 15 minutes, stirring occasionally. Serve with hot biscuits.

recipes.title: Fruit Salad
directions: In a large bowl, combine fruit, nuts and sour cream.
Fold in cool whip and marshmallows.
Refrigerate.
Yields 10-12.
recipes.text: Fruit Salad. In a large bowl, combine fruit, nuts and sour cream. Fold in cool whip and marshmallows. Refrigerate. Yields 10-12.

recipes.title: Apple Cake
directions: Put apples in bowl and add next 5 ingredients.
Mix.
Add dry ingredients and mix.
Add nuts.
Bake in 9 x 13-inch pan at 350° for minutes.
recipes.text: Apple Cake. Put apples in bowl and add next 5 ingredients. Mix. Add dry ingredients and mix. Add nuts. Bake in 9 x 13-inch pan at 350° for minutes.

recipes.title: Corn Fritters
directions: Mix all ingredients together.
Fry in skillet (make about pancake size).
Serve with syrup.
recipes.text: Corn Fritters. Mix all ingredients together. Fry in skillet (make about pancake size). Serve with syrup.

recipes.title: Nut Meat Balls(233 Calories Per Serving)
directions: Combine all ingredients,
mixing well.
Roll into balls. Sprinkle with paprika.
Bake
on
oiled cookie sheet 30 minutes at 325°.
Serve with gravy or tomato sauce.
Serves 4.
recipes.text: Nut Meat Balls(233 Calories Per Serving). Combine all ingredients, mixing well. Roll into balls. Sprinkle with paprika. Bake on oiled cookie sheet 30 minutes at 325°. Serve with gravy or tomato sauce. Serves 4.

recipes.title: Zucchini Chocolate Cake
directions: Cream the margarine and sugar. Add eggs and oil; beat well. Add dry ingredients, milk and vanilla.
Beat in zucchini. Bake in greased and floured 13 x 9-inch pan.
recipes.text: Zucchini Chocolate Cake. Cream the margarine and sugar. Add eggs and oil; beat well. Add dry ingredients, milk and vanilla. Beat in zucchini. Bake in greased and floured 13 x 9-inch pan.

recipes.title: Chocolate Meringue Pie
directions: Combine graham cracker crumbs, honey and oil.
Mix well and press into a 9-inch pie pan.
Bake for 10 minutes at 350°.
recipes.text: Chocolate Meringue Pie. Combine graham cracker crumbs, honey and oil. Mix well and press into a 9-inch pie pan. Bake for 10 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Apple Cobbler Cake
directions: Blend oil, sugar, eggs and vanilla.
Sift flour, salt and soda and add to creamed mixture.
Fold in nuts and apples.
Pour into well-greased and floured Bundt pan.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Apple Cobbler Cake. Blend oil, sugar, eggs and vanilla. Sift flour, salt and soda and add to creamed mixture. Fold in nuts and apples. Pour into well-greased and floured Bundt pan. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Oatmeal Superchip Cookies
directions: Mix the first 5 ingredients together. Sift baking soda, salt and flour together. Then add to creamed mixture along with the oatmeal and then the chips. Make round balls; flatten. Bake at 375° for 8 to 10 minutes. Cool on cookie sheet 1 minute.
recipes.text: Oatmeal Superchip Cookies. Mix the first 5 ingredients together. Sift baking soda, salt and flour together. Then add to creamed mixture along with the oatmeal and then the chips. Make round balls; flatten. Bake at 375° for 8 to 10 minutes. Cool on cookie sheet 1 minute.

recipes.title: Sweet And Sour Sauce
directions: Drain pineapple reserving 1/3 cup juice.
Halve pineapple chunks.
In a medium saucepan, combine tomato sauce, reserved pineapple juice, brown sugar, vinegar, onion and green peppers. Stir over medium-high heat until mixture boils.
Reduce heat and simmer, uncovered, 5 minutes.
In a small bowl, combine cornstarch and water.
Stir mixture until smooth.
Add pineapple, cornstarch mixture and chicken into tomato mixture.
Stir over medium-high until thickened and bubbles.
Makes 3 cups.
Serve over rice.
recipes.text: Sweet And Sour Sauce. Drain pineapple reserving 1/3 cup juice. Halve pineapple chunks. In a medium saucepan, combine tomato sauce, reserved pineapple juice, brown sugar, vinegar, onion and green peppers. Stir over medium-high heat until mixture boils. Reduce heat and simmer, uncovered, 5 minutes. In a small bowl, combine cornstarch and water. Stir mixture until smooth. Add pineapple, cornstarch mixture and chicken into tomato mixture. Stir over medium-high until thickened and bubbles. Makes 3 cups. Serve over rice.

recipes.title: Cheddar Dill Popovers
directions: Beat eggs slightly and add remaining ingredients (do not overbeat).
Divide into 10 greased muffin cups.
Bake in a 450° oven for 20 minutes.
Decrease temperature to 350° and bake 20 minutes longer.
recipes.text: Cheddar Dill Popovers. Beat eggs slightly and add remaining ingredients (do not overbeat). Divide into 10 greased muffin cups. Bake in a 450° oven for 20 minutes. Decrease temperature to 350° and bake 20 minutes longer.

recipes.title: Rainbow Shrimp Salad
ingredients: 3 Tbsp. mayonnaise or salad dressing (or to taste)
directions: Split each shrimp lengthwise.

Combine shrimp, rice, celery, green pepper, onion, mayonnaise, salt and pepper; cover and chill. Before serving, spoon mixture onto lettuce; garnish with tomato wedges and, if desired, with whole shrimp.
Serve with lemon wedges and French dressing (optional).
recipes.text: Rainbow Shrimp Salad. Split each shrimp lengthwise. Combine shrimp, rice, celery, green pepper, onion, mayonnaise, salt and pepper; cover and chill. Before serving, spoon mixture onto lettuce; garnish with tomato wedges and, if desired, with whole shrimp. Serve with lemon wedges and French dressing (optional).

recipes.title: Banana Split Cake
ingredients: 1/2 c. cherries, drained and cut up
directions: Mix crumbs with 1 stick butter; press into 13 x 9-inch pan. Mix the sugar with 2 sticks butter and 2 eggs; blend together and beat for 10 to 15 minutes.
Spread over cracker crust.
Layer the sliced bananas over filling.
Put pineapple (well drained) over nest.
Put Cool Whip over all.
Top with cherries and sprinkle nuts last.
Refrigerate 7 hours.
recipes.text: Banana Split Cake. Mix crumbs with 1 stick butter; press into 13 x 9-inch pan. Mix the sugar with 2 sticks butter and 2 eggs; blend together and beat for 10 to 15 minutes. Spread over cracker crust. Layer the sliced bananas over filling. Put pineapple (well drained) over nest. Put Cool Whip over all. Top with cherries and sprinkle nuts last. Refrigerate 7 hours.

recipes.title: Butterscotch Lush
directions: Mix margarine, flour and 1/2 cup chopped nuts; press in a 9 x 13-inch cake pan.
Bake at 350° for 15 minutes.
Let cool.
recipes.text: Butterscotch Lush. Mix margarine, flour and 1/2 cup chopped nuts; press in a 9 x 13-inch cake pan. Bake at 350° for 15 minutes. Let cool.

recipes.title: Carmen'S Daffodil Dessert
ingredients: 1 small pkg. vanilla instant pudding mix
directions: Prepare and bake cake according to package directions for a 9 x 13-inch cake pan.
Cool.
Combine the cream cheese and 1/2 cup milk in bowl; beat until smooth.
Prepare pudding mix according to package directions, using 1 1/2 cups milk.
Add to cream cheese mixture; mix well.
Spread over cake.
Chill for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Carmen'S Daffodil Dessert. Prepare and bake cake according to package directions for a 9 x 13-inch cake pan. Cool. Combine the cream cheese and 1/2 cup milk in bowl; beat until smooth. Prepare pudding mix according to package directions, using 1 1/2 cups milk. Add to cream cheese mixture; mix well. Spread over cake. Chill for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Spinach Salad
ingredients: several slices bacon, fried and crumbled
directions: Combine the first 3 ingredients.
In skillet, cook until thickened slightly the remaining ingredients.
Pour dressing over salad and toss well.
May add hard-cooked eggs and extra bacon for garnish, if desired.
recipes.text: Spinach Salad. Combine the first 3 ingredients. In skillet, cook until thickened slightly the remaining ingredients. Pour dressing over salad and toss well. May add hard-cooked eggs and extra bacon for garnish, if desired.

recipes.title: Chocolate Pie
directions: Mix dry ingredients; add milk, egg yolks and butter.
Cook in double boiler until thick.
Add vanilla.
Put into browned pie shell.
Top with meringue and brown in 375° oven.
recipes.text: Chocolate Pie. Mix dry ingredients; add milk, egg yolks and butter. Cook in double boiler until thick. Add vanilla. Put into browned pie shell. Top with meringue and brown in 375° oven.

recipes.title: Apricot Gelatin Salad
directions: Combine pineapple juice, water and sugar in saucepan.
Bring to boil.
Stir in jello and let cool for a few minutes.
Add cream cheese, celery, nuts and blend.
Fold in Cool Whip after jello has slightly thickened.
Refrigerate several hours to set.
recipes.text: Apricot Gelatin Salad. Combine pineapple juice, water and sugar in saucepan. Bring to boil. Stir in jello and let cool for a few minutes. Add cream cheese, celery, nuts and blend. Fold in Cool Whip after jello has slightly thickened. Refrigerate several hours to set.

recipes.title: Barbecued Pork Chops
directions: Brown pork chops in skillet.
Place in a shallow pan.
Place onions in skillet and cook until soft.
Add water, vinegar, sugar, salt, chili sauce, mustard and Tabasco sauce; mix well.
Pour sauce over chops and bake, covered, in a 350° oven, about 1 hour. Yields 4 servings.
recipes.text: Barbecued Pork Chops. Brown pork chops in skillet. Place in a shallow pan. Place onions in skillet and cook until soft. Add water, vinegar, sugar, salt, chili sauce, mustard and Tabasco sauce; mix well. Pour sauce over chops and bake, covered, in a 350° oven, about 1 hour. Yields 4 servings.

recipes.title: Spicy Corn Salsa
ingredients: 2 (17 oz.) cans whole kernel corn, rinsed and drained
1 (4 oz.) can chopped green chiles, drained
1 (2 1/4 ox.) can sliced pitted ripe olives, drained
2 to 3 jalapeno peppers, seeded and finely chopped
1/3 c. olive oil or vegetable oil
directions: Combine first 8 ingredients in a nonaluminum bowl; add cilantro, if desired.
Cover and chill at least 2 hours, stirring often.
serve with tortilla chips or as a relish with grilled beef or chicken.
Yields 6 cups.
recipes.text: Spicy Corn Salsa. Combine first 8 ingredients in a nonaluminum bowl; add cilantro, if desired. Cover and chill at least 2 hours, stirring often. serve with tortilla chips or as a relish with grilled beef or chicken. Yields 6 cups.

recipes.title: Fish Patties
directions: Mix all ingredients and cook in skillet 5 minutes on each side.
recipes.text: Fish Patties. Mix all ingredients and cook in skillet 5 minutes on each side.

recipes.title: Norwegian Cole Slaw
directions: Shred cabbage and toss with salt.
Cover and refrigerate at least 2 hours.
In a saucepan, heat sugar, vinegar, mustard and celery seed.
Cook until the sugar dissolves, about 10 minutes. Cool completely.
Add to the cabbage along with remaining vegetables; toss.
Cover and refrigerate at least 1 week before serving.
Keeps for 4 to 6 weeks in the refrigerator.
Yields 12 to 16 servings.
recipes.text: Norwegian Cole Slaw. Shred cabbage and toss with salt. Cover and refrigerate at least 2 hours. In a saucepan, heat sugar, vinegar, mustard and celery seed. Cook until the sugar dissolves, about 10 minutes. Cool completely. Add to the cabbage along with remaining vegetables; toss. Cover and refrigerate at least 1 week before serving. Keeps for 4 to 6 weeks in the refrigerator. Yields 12 to 16 servings.

recipes.title: Coconut Pie
directions: Mix egg yolks and milk. Mix sugar and cornstarch to milk and eggs. Cook until thick. Add the lemon flavoring.
Add coconut to cooked ingredients.
Pour into baked pie shell.
recipes.text: Coconut Pie. Mix egg yolks and milk. Mix sugar and cornstarch to milk and eggs. Cook until thick. Add the lemon flavoring. Add coconut to cooked ingredients. Pour into baked pie shell.

recipes.title: Ant Killer
directions: Mix into a paste.
Coat one side of small squares of cardboard and put them where the ants are.
When the paste gets dry, replace with the fresh paste.
Continue until all gone.
recipes.text: Ant Killer. Mix into a paste. Coat one side of small squares of cardboard and put them where the ants are. When the paste gets dry, replace with the fresh paste. Continue until all gone.

recipes.title: Spanish Rice
directions: Cook bacon until crispy.
Set aside.
Cook hamburger, green pepper, mushrooms and onion until done.
Add stewed tomatoes; simmer.
Cook rice; break up bacon and add to hamburger mixture. When rice is done, use your favorite spaghetti sauce.
Mix all together.
Add cheese if you want.
Smaller portions use less time to make.
This takes 1 1/2 hours.
recipes.text: Spanish Rice. Cook bacon until crispy. Set aside. Cook hamburger, green pepper, mushrooms and onion until done. Add stewed tomatoes; simmer. Cook rice; break up bacon and add to hamburger mixture. When rice is done, use your favorite spaghetti sauce. Mix all together. Add cheese if you want. Smaller portions use less time to make. This takes 1 1/2 hours.

recipes.title: Garden Macaroni Salad
ingredients: 2 c. elbow macaroni, cooked and drained
directions: Gradually add mayonnaise to cream cheese, mixing until well blended.
Stir in relish and mustard.
Add remaining ingredients; mix lightly.
recipes.text: Garden Macaroni Salad. Gradually add mayonnaise to cream cheese, mixing until well blended. Stir in relish and mustard. Add remaining ingredients; mix lightly.

recipes.title: Tuna Macaroni Salad
directions: Cook macaroni in boiling, salted water for 8 minutes.
Drain and rinse in cold water.
Combine tuna and all other ingredients with macaroni.
Add mayonnaise and/or horseradish to tuna/macaroni mixture.
Toss gently.
Add more mayonnaise, if desired.
Chill thoroughly.
Serve in lettuce cups.
Garnish with green pepper strips and tomato slices.
recipes.text: Tuna Macaroni Salad. Cook macaroni in boiling, salted water for 8 minutes. Drain and rinse in cold water. Combine tuna and all other ingredients with macaroni. Add mayonnaise and/or horseradish to tuna/macaroni mixture. Toss gently. Add more mayonnaise, if desired. Chill thoroughly. Serve in lettuce cups. Garnish with green pepper strips and tomato slices.

recipes.title: Southern Cornbread Stuffing
ingredients: 1 pkg. herb seasoned stuffing mix (about 4 c.)
directions: In large saucepan or Dutch oven, melt bacon drippings until hot.
Add celery and onions.
Cook over medium-low heat until tender.
Stir in stuffing mix, cornbread, pecans and seasonings. Add eggs and toss lightly.
Pour hot broth over entire mixture. Toss.
Makes about 14 cups, about 220 calories per 1/2 cup serving.
recipes.text: Southern Cornbread Stuffing. In large saucepan or Dutch oven, melt bacon drippings until hot. Add celery and onions. Cook over medium-low heat until tender. Stir in stuffing mix, cornbread, pecans and seasonings. Add eggs and toss lightly. Pour hot broth over entire mixture. Toss. Makes about 14 cups, about 220 calories per 1/2 cup serving.

recipes.title: Red Velvet Cake
ingredients: 1 c. buttermilk (1 c. milk plus 1 1/4 tsp. vinegar)
directions: Cream sugar, Crisco and eggs.
Make paste of cocoa and coloring; add to mixture.
Add salt to flour and sift.
Add this, buttermilk and vanilla.
Beat.
Put soda in vinegar.
Lightly fold in (this foams up).
Bake in 3 layers at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.
Cool, icing with French Creme Icing.
recipes.text: Red Velvet Cake. Cream sugar, Crisco and eggs. Make paste of cocoa and coloring; add to mixture. Add salt to flour and sift. Add this, buttermilk and vanilla. Beat. Put soda in vinegar. Lightly fold in (this foams up). Bake in 3 layers at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes. Cool, icing with French Creme Icing.

recipes.title: Queen Elizabeth Cake(Date Nut Cake)
ingredients: 1/3 c nuts broken (I use english walnuts)
directions: Pour boiling water over dates and soda, let stand about 5 minutes.
Mix together
sugar, butter, egg, salt, and nuts.
Add vanilla, baking powder, flour-mix to gather then ad to date mixture.
Pour into a greased 9 x 12 pan. Bake in 350 oven for 35 minutes.
recipes.text: Queen Elizabeth Cake(Date Nut Cake). Pour boiling water over dates and soda, let stand about 5 minutes. Mix together sugar, butter, egg, salt, and nuts. Add vanilla, baking powder, flour-mix to gather then ad to date mixture. Pour into a greased 9 x 12 pan. Bake in 350 oven for 35 minutes.

recipes.title: Mississippi Mud Slide
directions: Combine margarine, flour and nuts.
Mix well.
Press in bottom of 9 x 13 x 2-inch pan.
Bake at 350° for 12 to 15 minutes (or use graham cracker crust).
recipes.text: Mississippi Mud Slide. Combine margarine, flour and nuts. Mix well. Press in bottom of 9 x 13 x 2-inch pan. Bake at 350° for 12 to 15 minutes (or use graham cracker crust).

recipes.title: Uncle Mike'S Hamburgers
ingredients: 1 package of Lipton Onion Soup mix
directions: Mix ingredients in bowl and form patties.
Grill to desired doneness.
recipes.text: Uncle Mike'S Hamburgers. Mix ingredients in bowl and form patties. Grill to desired doneness.

recipes.title: Frank'S Famous Spaghetti Salad
ingredients: 2 blocks New York sharp Cheddar cheese
3 pkg. Good Seasons Italian dressing mix, prepared as directed on pkg.
directions: Cook and drain spaghetti.
Chop tomatoes, onion, pepperoni, cheese and olives.
Mix all ingredients with the dressing.
Chill.
recipes.text: Frank'S Famous Spaghetti Salad. Cook and drain spaghetti. Chop tomatoes, onion, pepperoni, cheese and olives. Mix all ingredients with the dressing. Chill.

recipes.title: Chow Mein
directions: Cook celery, onions and sprouts in broth until tender.
Add chicken.
Mix soy sauce, cornstarch and water together.
Add to chicken mixture.
Cook until thickened.
May serve over rice and top with chow mein noodles.
Will serve 10.
recipes.text: Chow Mein. Cook celery, onions and sprouts in broth until tender. Add chicken. Mix soy sauce, cornstarch and water together. Add to chicken mixture. Cook until thickened. May serve over rice and top with chow mein noodles. Will serve 10.

recipes.title: Sponge Cake
directions: Last add boiling water.
Mix and bake at 350°.
recipes.text: Sponge Cake. Last add boiling water. Mix and bake at 350°.

recipes.title: Sour Cream Coffee Cake
directions: Grease and flour 10-inch tube pan.
Combine brown sugar, cinnamon and 1/2 cup of pecans in a small bowl.
Set aside. Combine cake mix, salad oil, sugar, vanilla, eggs and sour cream. Beat two minutes at medium speed.
Stir in 1/2 cup pecans.
Pour half of batter into prepared pan.
Sprinkle with half of brown sugar mixture.
Pour remaining batter in pan and sprinkle with remaining brown sugar mixture.
Bake at 325° for 50 to 60 minutes.
recipes.text: Sour Cream Coffee Cake. Grease and flour 10-inch tube pan. Combine brown sugar, cinnamon and 1/2 cup of pecans in a small bowl. Set aside. Combine cake mix, salad oil, sugar, vanilla, eggs and sour cream. Beat two minutes at medium speed. Stir in 1/2 cup pecans. Pour half of batter into prepared pan. Sprinkle with half of brown sugar mixture. Pour remaining batter in pan and sprinkle with remaining brown sugar mixture. Bake at 325° for 50 to 60 minutes.

recipes.title: Mayonnaise Cake
directions: Mix together, put in greased and floured 9 x 13-inch cake pan. Bake at 350° until done.
recipes.text: Mayonnaise Cake. Mix together, put in greased and floured 9 x 13-inch cake pan. Bake at 350° until done.

recipes.title: Mandarin Orange Pie
directions: Mash oranges with condensed milk.
Add other ingredients and pour into pie shell.
Chill in refrigerator.
recipes.text: Mandarin Orange Pie. Mash oranges with condensed milk. Add other ingredients and pour into pie shell. Chill in refrigerator.

recipes.title: Deep Dish Chicken Pie
directions: Mash potatoes with milk, oleo, salt, pepper and nutmeg until light and fluffy.
In another large bowl, mix remaining ingredients.
Turn this mixture into a deep 4-inch pie plate. Cover with the mashed potatoes.
Bake at 375° for 30 minutes. Makes 6 servings.
recipes.text: Deep Dish Chicken Pie. Mash potatoes with milk, oleo, salt, pepper and nutmeg until light and fluffy. In another large bowl, mix remaining ingredients. Turn this mixture into a deep 4-inch pie plate. Cover with the mashed potatoes. Bake at 375° for 30 minutes. Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Lasagne Casserole
directions: Brown meat slowly; spoon off fat.
Add next 6 ingredients. Simmer until sauce is thick, 45 minutes to 1 hour, stirring occasionally.
Cook noodles in boiling water until tender; drain. Rinse in cold water.
recipes.text: Lasagne Casserole. Brown meat slowly; spoon off fat. Add next 6 ingredients. Simmer until sauce is thick, 45 minutes to 1 hour, stirring occasionally. Cook noodles in boiling water until tender; drain. Rinse in cold water.

recipes.title: Pineapple Rise
directions: Drain and grind or puree pineapple.
Add half sweetener. Remove 1 cup of puree and sprinkle gelatin over the top of it to soften.

Combine just egg yolks and rest of the sugar and cook over low heat in double boiler, stirring until mixture thickens. Add the gelatin mixture and stir until the gelatin dissolves. Cool to lukewarm and add remaining puree.
Whip egg whites and salt in a bowl until foamy.
Fold in whipped cream.
Gently fold in pineapple mixture.
Pour into mold or oblong pan.
Chill until firm, about 2 hours.
Garnish with whipped cream and strawberries.
recipes.text: Pineapple Rise. Drain and grind or puree pineapple. Add half sweetener. Remove 1 cup of puree and sprinkle gelatin over the top of it to soften. Combine just egg yolks and rest of the sugar and cook over low heat in double boiler, stirring until mixture thickens. Add the gelatin mixture and stir until the gelatin dissolves. Cool to lukewarm and add remaining puree. Whip egg whites and salt in a bowl until foamy. Fold in whipped cream. Gently fold in pineapple mixture. Pour into mold or oblong pan. Chill until firm, about 2 hours. Garnish with whipped cream and strawberries.

recipes.title: Potato Dish
directions: Dice and boil potatoes. Drain. Add mayonnaise, cheese and onion. Spread in baking dish. Top with bacon and olives. Bake 45 to 60 minutes in a 350° oven.
recipes.text: Potato Dish. Dice and boil potatoes. Drain. Add mayonnaise, cheese and onion. Spread in baking dish. Top with bacon and olives. Bake 45 to 60 minutes in a 350° oven.

recipes.title: Orange Fruit Salad
directions: Mix together in large bowl.
Amounts of cottage cheese, fruit cocktail and Cool Whip may be adjusted.
May use large or small containers of these.
recipes.text: Orange Fruit Salad. Mix together in large bowl. Amounts of cottage cheese, fruit cocktail and Cool Whip may be adjusted. May use large or small containers of these.

recipes.title: Breakfast Pie
directions: Boil ingredients for 10 minutes and pour into pie crust.
Cut a circle in the center of the top pie crust.
Bake at 350° for 40 minutes until crust is brown.
recipes.text: Breakfast Pie. Boil ingredients for 10 minutes and pour into pie crust. Cut a circle in the center of the top pie crust. Bake at 350° for 40 minutes until crust is brown.

recipes.title: Vanilla Peanut Butter Fudge
directions: In a saucepan, mix white sugar, brown sugar and milk.
Cook 1 1/2 minutes.
After it boils, add peanut butter, walnuts and Marshmallow Fluff; mix well.
Pour into large 13 x 9 x 2-inch lightly greased pan.
Cool.
recipes.text: Vanilla Peanut Butter Fudge. In a saucepan, mix white sugar, brown sugar and milk. Cook 1 1/2 minutes. After it boils, add peanut butter, walnuts and Marshmallow Fluff; mix well. Pour into large 13 x 9 x 2-inch lightly greased pan. Cool.

recipes.title: Stuffed Mushrooms
directions: Remove stems of mushrooms and chop.
Combine stems, cheese, butter and onion.
Fill mushroom caps with mixture.
Place on rack of broiler pan.
Broil until filling is slightly crusty, 2 to 3 minutes.
recipes.text: Stuffed Mushrooms. Remove stems of mushrooms and chop. Combine stems, cheese, butter and onion. Fill mushroom caps with mixture. Place on rack of broiler pan. Broil until filling is slightly crusty, 2 to 3 minutes.

recipes.title: Coconut Pound Cake
directions: Have all ingredients at room temperature.
Cream margarine or butter, shortening and sugar until fluffy.
Add eggs one at a time, beating well after each addition.
Sift flour and fold in small amounts at a time.
Blend in lemon juice, lemon rind and coconut. Bake in greased and floured 10 inch tube pan at 350 degrees about 45 minutes.
Cool before removing from pan.
recipes.text: Coconut Pound Cake. Have all ingredients at room temperature. Cream margarine or butter, shortening and sugar until fluffy. Add eggs one at a time, beating well after each addition. Sift flour and fold in small amounts at a time. Blend in lemon juice, lemon rind and coconut. Bake in greased and floured 10 inch tube pan at 350 degrees about 45 minutes. Cool before removing from pan.

recipes.title: Diced Apple Cake
directions: Mix dry ingredients together.
Add remainder and mix well. Bake in greased loaf pan 1 hour at 325°.
recipes.text: Diced Apple Cake. Mix dry ingredients together. Add remainder and mix well. Bake in greased loaf pan 1 hour at 325°.

recipes.title: Blue Cheese Dressing
ingredients: 2 Tbsp. garlic powder (use less, if desired)
directions: Crumble the Blue cheese and blend all ingredients; keep refrigerated.
recipes.text: Blue Cheese Dressing. Crumble the Blue cheese and blend all ingredients; keep refrigerated.

recipes.title: Fresh Peach Pie
ingredients: 2 small or 1 large graham Ready Crust
directions: Chop peaches, add lemon juice; set aside.
Fold Eagle Brand milk with Cool Whip.
Fold in peach mixture.
Spoon in Ready Crust.
Chill at least 4 hours.
recipes.text: Fresh Peach Pie. Chop peaches, add lemon juice; set aside. Fold Eagle Brand milk with Cool Whip. Fold in peach mixture. Spoon in Ready Crust. Chill at least 4 hours.

recipes.title: Ground Beef Casserole
directions: Brown chuck in skillet until crumbly.
Stir in garlic, salt, pepper, sugar and tomato sauce.
Simmer 15 minutes.
Combine sour cream, softened cream cheese, green onions and 1 1/2 cups shredded cheese.
Mix well.
Cook noodles according to package directions. Drain.
Alternate layers of noodles, meat mixture and cheese mixture in 8 x 8 x 2 baking pan or dish until all ingredients are used, ending with cheese mixture.
Sprinkle 1 cup cheese over top. Bake at 350°, uncovered, for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Ground Beef Casserole. Brown chuck in skillet until crumbly. Stir in garlic, salt, pepper, sugar and tomato sauce. Simmer 15 minutes. Combine sour cream, softened cream cheese, green onions and 1 1/2 cups shredded cheese. Mix well. Cook noodles according to package directions. Drain. Alternate layers of noodles, meat mixture and cheese mixture in 8 x 8 x 2 baking pan or dish until all ingredients are used, ending with cheese mixture. Sprinkle 1 cup cheese over top. Bake at 350°, uncovered, for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Butterscotch Crisp Balls
directions: Melt butter in saucepan over low heat.
Add marshmallows. Stir until butter is melted.
Remove from heat.
Add sugar-coated flakes.
Add butterscotch chips and coconut.
Mix well.
Roll into balls about 1 1/2-inches around with greased hands.
Allow to stand at room temperature until set, about 1 hour.
Makes about 3 dozen.
Very good.
recipes.text: Butterscotch Crisp Balls. Melt butter in saucepan over low heat. Add marshmallows. Stir until butter is melted. Remove from heat. Add sugar-coated flakes. Add butterscotch chips and coconut. Mix well. Roll into balls about 1 1/2-inches around with greased hands. Allow to stand at room temperature until set, about 1 hour. Makes about 3 dozen. Very good.

recipes.title: Popovers
directions: Beat eggs and add milk, shortening and dry ingredients in a blender.
Beat until smooth.
Fill greased muffin pans 1/2 full and bake in preheated oven at 450° for 20 minutes.
Reduce temperature to 350° and bake 10 minutes longer or until golden brown.
Serve with butter and jam or jelly.
recipes.text: Popovers. Beat eggs and add milk, shortening and dry ingredients in a blender. Beat until smooth. Fill greased muffin pans 1/2 full and bake in preheated oven at 450° for 20 minutes. Reduce temperature to 350° and bake 10 minutes longer or until golden brown. Serve with butter and jam or jelly.

recipes.title: Strawberry Punch Bowl Cake
ingredients: 1 (6 oz.) pkg. instant vanilla pudding mix
2 (10 oz.) pkg. frozen strawberries or fresh strawberries, sliced and slightly sweetened
directions: Bake cake in 2 round cake pans according to directions.
Cool and refrigerate to chill.
Cut 1 layer into small pieces and place in punch bowl.
Mix pudding according to package.
Spread 1/2 pudding on top of cake.
Add 1/2 berries; layer 1/2 of pineapple (drained) on top and add 1 sliced banana.
Repeat with other cake layer, ending with whipped topping.
Chill overnight in refrigerator.
recipes.text: Strawberry Punch Bowl Cake. Bake cake in 2 round cake pans according to directions. Cool and refrigerate to chill. Cut 1 layer into small pieces and place in punch bowl. Mix pudding according to package. Spread 1/2 pudding on top of cake. Add 1/2 berries; layer 1/2 of pineapple (drained) on top and add 1 sliced banana. Repeat with other cake layer, ending with whipped topping. Chill overnight in refrigerator.

recipes.title: Orange Jello Salad
directions: Make jello as directed.
Wait for jello to congeal.
Mix fruit cocktail and Cool Whip together.
Then add jello and pour into a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Chill overnight.
recipes.text: Orange Jello Salad. Make jello as directed. Wait for jello to congeal. Mix fruit cocktail and Cool Whip together. Then add jello and pour into a 9 x 13-inch pan. Chill overnight.

recipes.title: Parmesan Vidalia In Foil
directions: Will also need heavy duty aluminum foil.
recipes.text: Parmesan Vidalia In Foil. Will also need heavy duty aluminum foil.

recipes.title: Crazy Cake
directions: Makes
(9 x 13-inch)
pan,
or
(8-inch)	layers. Grease and flour pans.
Put all ingredients in a bowl and stir until well mixed.
Batter will be
very liquid; pour into pan. Bake at 375° for 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Crazy Cake. Makes 1 (9 x 13-inch) pan, or 2 (8-inch)	layers. Grease and flour pans. Put all ingredients in a bowl and stir until well mixed. Batter will be very liquid; pour into pan. Bake at 375° for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Berried Delight
ingredients: 2 (3.4 oz.) pkg. Jell-O vanilla instant pudding
directions: Combine crumbs, 1/4 cup sugar and butter.
Press firmly into a 13 x 9-inch pan.
Chill.
recipes.text: Berried Delight. Combine crumbs, 1/4 cup sugar and butter. Press firmly into a 13 x 9-inch pan. Chill.

recipes.title: Quickie Fruit Cobbler
directions: Pour fruit in baking dish.
Pour cake mix on top of fruit, sprinkle melted margarine over top.
Bake at 350° until brown, approximately 40 to 50 minutes.
recipes.text: Quickie Fruit Cobbler. Pour fruit in baking dish. Pour cake mix on top of fruit, sprinkle melted margarine over top. Bake at 350° until brown, approximately 40 to 50 minutes.

recipes.title: Cranberry Broccoli Salad
ingredients: 1 1/4 c. fresh or frozen cranberries, halved and slightly sugared
4 c. shredded cabbage (you may use half purple cabbage to add color)
directions: In a large glass bowl, combine cranberries, broccoli, cabbage, walnuts, raisins, onion and bacon. Combine remaining ingredients and pour over cranberry mixture. Toss well. Cover and refrigerate for up to 24 hours. Serve on leafy lettuce. Yield: 6 to 8 servings.
recipes.text: Cranberry Broccoli Salad. In a large glass bowl, combine cranberries, broccoli, cabbage, walnuts, raisins, onion and bacon. Combine remaining ingredients and pour over cranberry mixture. Toss well. Cover and refrigerate for up to 24 hours. Serve on leafy lettuce. Yield: 6 to 8 servings.

recipes.title: Holiday Punch
directions: Whip lemonade, pineapple and juice and strawberries in blender at high speed.
Add ginger ale and pour over ice.
recipes.text: Holiday Punch. Whip lemonade, pineapple and juice and strawberries in blender at high speed. Add ginger ale and pour over ice.

recipes.title: Broccoli Casserole
directions: Combine all ingredients and place in a buttered casserole. Bake at 325° for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Broccoli Casserole. Combine all ingredients and place in a buttered casserole. Bake at 325° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Strawberry Cake
directions: Wash strawberries; set aside to drain while preparing cake. Cut angel food cake; tear out some cake in the middle to add ingredients.
Spread a layer of Cool Whip followed by a layer of glaze and strawberries, then replace cake.
Add Cool Whip, glaze and strawberries.
Take top part of cake; place on cake and cover with same steps as before until all ingredients are gone.
Can spoon some juice over finished cake to add moisture if desired.
recipes.text: Strawberry Cake. Wash strawberries; set aside to drain while preparing cake. Cut angel food cake; tear out some cake in the middle to add ingredients. Spread a layer of Cool Whip followed by a layer of glaze and strawberries, then replace cake. Add Cool Whip, glaze and strawberries.
