Take top part of cake; place on cake and cover with same steps as before until all ingredients are gone. Can spoon some juice over finished cake to add moisture if desired.

recipes.title: Fettucini Ala Carbonara
directions: Note:
The heat from the pasta cooks the eggs and thickens the cream sauce.
recipes.text: Fettucini Ala Carbonara. Note: The heat from the pasta cooks the eggs and thickens the cream sauce.

recipes.title: Morning Glory Muffins
directions: Preheat oven to 350°.
Combine flour, sugar, soda, cinnamon and nutmeg in a large bowl.
Add apple, raisins, coconut, pecans and carrots.
Mix thoroughly.
Beat eggs slightly in a separate bowl. Add oil and vanilla to eggs; beat well.
Pour egg mixture into dry ingredients and combine quickly.
Do not overbeat.
Spoon into greased muffin tins.
Bake 20 to 25 minutes or until golden brown. Makes 18 muffins.
recipes.text: Morning Glory Muffins. Preheat oven to 350°. Combine flour, sugar, soda, cinnamon and nutmeg in a large bowl. Add apple, raisins, coconut, pecans and carrots. Mix thoroughly. Beat eggs slightly in a separate bowl. Add oil and vanilla to eggs; beat well. Pour egg mixture into dry ingredients and combine quickly. Do not overbeat. Spoon into greased muffin tins. Bake 20 to 25 minutes or until golden brown. Makes 18 muffins.

recipes.title: Chicken With Lemon-Caper Cream
ingredients: 1 lb. boned and skinned chicken breasts, cut crosswise into 1/2 inch wide strips
directions: In large skillet, melt butter over medium heat.
Add shallots, saute for 1 minute.
Raise heat and add chicken.
Saute until they are lightly browned.
Add lemon juice, stir and scrape bottom of pan with wooden spoon to remove lumps or brown bits.
When most of lemon juice has evaporated, add cream.
Gently boil until thick, 10 to 12 minutes.
Stir in capers and serve over hot pasta. Garnish with parsley.
recipes.text: Chicken With Lemon-Caper Cream. In large skillet, melt butter over medium heat. Add shallots, saute for 1 minute. Raise heat and add chicken. Saute until they are lightly browned. Add lemon juice, stir and scrape bottom of pan with wooden spoon to remove lumps or brown bits. When most of lemon juice has evaporated, add cream. Gently boil until thick, 10 to 12 minutes. Stir in capers and serve over hot pasta. Garnish with parsley.

recipes.title: Oven Fried Parmesan Chicken
directions: Combine first 6 ingredients.
Stir well.
Rinse chicken with cold water and pat dry.
Dip chicken in butter and dredge in cracker crumb mixture.
Place chicken in 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
Yield: 4 to 6 servings.
recipes.text: Oven Fried Parmesan Chicken. Combine first 6 ingredients. Stir well. Rinse chicken with cold water and pat dry. Dip chicken in butter and dredge in cracker crumb mixture. Place chicken in 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Bake at 350° for 1 hour. Yield: 4 to 6 servings.

recipes.title: Mushroom Casserole
ingredients: 7 slices whole wheat bread, buttered and cut in cubes
directions: Place half of the cubes into a buttered casserole.
Combine mushrooms, onions, celery and mayonnaise.
Place on top of cubes. Top with remaining cubes and spread cheese soup over all.
Cover and refrigerate several hours or overnight.
Bake for 1 hour at 350°, covered.
Then top with shredded cheese and bake 10 minutes more, uncovered.
recipes.text: Mushroom Casserole. Place half of the cubes into a buttered casserole. Combine mushrooms, onions, celery and mayonnaise. Place on top of cubes. Top with remaining cubes and spread cheese soup over all. Cover and refrigerate several hours or overnight. Bake for 1 hour at 350°, covered. Then top with shredded cheese and bake 10 minutes more, uncovered.

recipes.title: Salisbury Steak
directions: Beat eggs; add milk and crumbled bread and let soak.
Mix all ingredients except bread crumbs.
Shape into 1/2 inch thick patties.
Coat with bread crumbs.
Fry in skillet.
Mix mushroom soup with water and pour over fried patties.
Heat until bubbly. Serve with mashed potatoes or rice.
recipes.text: Salisbury Steak. Beat eggs; add milk and crumbled bread and let soak. Mix all ingredients except bread crumbs. Shape into 1/2 inch thick patties. Coat with bread crumbs. Fry in skillet. Mix mushroom soup with water and pour over fried patties. Heat until bubbly. Serve with mashed potatoes or rice.

recipes.title: Strawberry Pretzel Jello
directions: Mix together the pretzels, margarine and 3 tablespoons sugar. Press into a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Bake at 400° for 8 minutes.
Let cool completely.
recipes.text: Strawberry Pretzel Jello. Mix together the pretzels, margarine and 3 tablespoons sugar. Press into a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 400° for 8 minutes. Let cool completely.

recipes.title: Strawberry Pizza
directions: Mix first 3 ingredients and press into pizza pan.
Bake at 350° for 12 minutes; cool.
Mix Eagle Brand, lemon juice and cream cheese together and spread over cooled crust.
Mix sugar, cornstarch and water; cook until thickened.
Add Jell-O, food coloring and strawberries.
Spread over cream cheese mixture. Cover with Cool Whip.
Keep refrigerated.
recipes.text: Strawberry Pizza. Mix first 3 ingredients and press into pizza pan. Bake at 350° for 12 minutes; cool. Mix Eagle Brand, lemon juice and cream cheese together and spread over cooled crust. Mix sugar, cornstarch and water; cook until thickened. Add Jell-O, food coloring and strawberries. Spread over cream cheese mixture. Cover with Cool Whip. Keep refrigerated.

recipes.title: Chex Party Mix
directions: Melt butter in a roasting pan. Mix in salt and Worcestershire sauce. Mix in remaining ingredients. Stir well. Bake at 250° for 1 hour. Pour out on towel and let cool.
recipes.text: Chex Party Mix. Melt butter in a roasting pan. Mix in salt and Worcestershire sauce. Mix in remaining ingredients. Stir well. Bake at 250° for 1 hour. Pour out on towel and let cool.

recipes.title: Party Pizza Snacks
directions: Brown sausage; drain well.
In saucepan place all ingredients and heat until cheese melts.
Place on rye bread.
Bake at 400° for 10 minutes and serve.
recipes.text: Party Pizza Snacks. Brown sausage; drain well. In saucepan place all ingredients and heat until cheese melts. Place on rye bread. Bake at 400° for 10 minutes and serve.

recipes.title: Raisin Pie
directions: Cook all ingredients together for about 10 minutes until it thickens.
Cool and place in cooked pie shell.
Top with real or lite whipped cream.
Cook on low fire and stir continuously.
recipes.text: Raisin Pie. Cook all ingredients together for about 10 minutes until it thickens. Cool and place in cooked pie shell. Top with real or lite whipped cream. Cook on low fire and stir continuously.

recipes.title: Wilma'S Oatmeal Scotchies(Pan Cookies)
directions: Combine butter, sugar, brown sugar, eggs and vanilla extract; gradually add remaining ingredients (flour, baking soda, salt and cinnamon).
Stir in oats and butterscotch morsels.
Spread into baking pan.
Bake in preheated 375° oven for 20 to 25 minutes. Cool.
Cut into 2-inch squares.
Makes 35 (2-inch) squares.
recipes.text: Wilma'S Oatmeal Scotchies(Pan Cookies). Combine butter, sugar, brown sugar, eggs and vanilla extract; gradually add remaining ingredients (flour, baking soda, salt and cinnamon). Stir in oats and butterscotch morsels. Spread into baking pan. Bake in preheated 375° oven for 20 to 25 minutes. Cool. Cut into 2-inch squares. Makes 35 (2-inch) squares.

recipes.title: Baked Fish Steaks
directions: Preheat oven to 450°.
Remove skin from fish, cut meat from bones.
Cut 4 (10 x 12-inch) pieces of heavy-duty foil, use oil to grease center of each piece of foil.
Place a steak on each piece of foil.
Top each steak with slices of onion, potato and carrot. Salt and pepper.
Using drugstore wrap, fold each piece separately. Put on cookie sheet and bake until fish flakes and is tender, approximately 20 minutes.
Garnish with parsley.
recipes.text: Baked Fish Steaks. Preheat oven to 450°. Remove skin from fish, cut meat from bones. Cut 4 (10 x 12-inch) pieces of heavy-duty foil, use oil to grease center of each piece of foil. Place a steak on each piece of foil. Top each steak with slices of onion, potato and carrot. Salt and pepper. Using drugstore wrap, fold each piece separately. Put on cookie sheet and bake until fish flakes and is tender, approximately 20 minutes. Garnish with parsley.

recipes.title: S. O. S.
ingredients: black pepper and seasoned salt to taste
directions: Brown ground beef until it crumbles and is very brown.
Remove all juices.
Add onion and continue browning, then add garlic. Add pepper and salt.
Mix 1/2 cup flour and 1 cup milk together and pour in meat mixture.
Add milk and water to make it the thickness you desire.
Add the margarine and stir until it is melted.
Serve over toast.
recipes.text: S. O. S.. Brown ground beef until it crumbles and is very brown. Remove all juices. Add onion and continue browning, then add garlic. Add pepper and salt. Mix 1/2 cup flour and 1 cup milk together and pour in meat mixture. Add milk and water to make it the thickness you desire. Add the margarine and stir until it is melted. Serve over toast.

recipes.title: Dietetic Cake
directions: Cream oleo well.
Add Sucaryl and eggs; beat well.
Add applesauce and dates.
Mix well.
Add remaining ingredients and bake in a loaf pan for 1 hour at 350°.
recipes.text: Dietetic Cake. Cream oleo well. Add Sucaryl and eggs; beat well. Add applesauce and dates. Mix well. Add remaining ingredients and bake in a loaf pan for 1 hour at 350°.

recipes.title: Caramel Corn
directions: Mix sugar, syrup and butter.
Bring to a rolling boil. Stirring constantly, cook 5 minutes more.
Add baking soda and cream of tartar.
Pour and mix over popcorn in a large soup pot. After mixed well, place in a large roaster pan, cookie sheet or shallow pan and bake in 200° oven for 1 hour.
Pour on waxed paper and separate to cool.
Store in sealed Tupperware to keep crisp.
recipes.text: Caramel Corn. Mix sugar, syrup and butter. Bring to a rolling boil. Stirring constantly, cook 5 minutes more. Add baking soda and cream of tartar. Pour and mix over popcorn in a large soup pot. After mixed well, place in a large roaster pan, cookie sheet or shallow pan and bake in 200° oven for 1 hour. Pour on waxed paper and separate to cool. Store in sealed Tupperware to keep crisp.

recipes.title: Chocolate Popcorn
directions: Over medium heat, using a 4-quart pot, combine the sugar, butter, corn syrup, cocoa and salt and bring to a boil. Once the mixture is well mixed, add the popped corn. Cook and stir until popcorn is coated, approximately 2 minutes. Cool mixture and shape into 3-inch balls.
recipes.text: Chocolate Popcorn. Over medium heat, using a 4-quart pot, combine the sugar, butter, corn syrup, cocoa and salt and bring to a boil. Once the mixture is well mixed, add the popped corn. Cook and stir until popcorn is coated, approximately 2 minutes. Cool mixture and shape into 3-inch balls.

recipes.title: Taco Soup
ingredients: 1 (16 oz.) can dark red kidney beans
1 pkg. Hidden Valley Ranch Style dressing (dry)
3 cans of water (use corn can for water)
directions: Brown beef and onions; drain. Add all other ingredients. Bring to boil; reduce heat and simmer for approximately 35 minutes. Makes 17 cups.
recipes.text: Taco Soup. Brown beef and onions; drain. Add all other ingredients. Bring to boil; reduce heat and simmer for approximately 35 minutes. Makes 17 cups.

recipes.title: No Knead Refrigerator Rolls
directions: Mix all ingredients and store in refrigerator.
Will keep for a week.
When ready to bake, pinch off desired amount of dough.
Let rise and bake at 450 degrees until brown.
recipes.text: No Knead Refrigerator Rolls. Mix all ingredients and store in refrigerator. Will keep for a week. When ready to bake, pinch off desired amount of dough. Let rise and bake at 450 degrees until brown.

recipes.title: Creole Cream  Cheese Cheesecake
directions: To make the crust, preheat the oven to 225°. Break up the crackers and grind them into a fine meal in a blender or food processor or under a rolling pin. In a large bowl, blend together the crumbs, butter and sugar. Press into the bottom and sides of a 10-inch spring-form pan.
recipes.text: Creole Cream  Cheese Cheesecake. To make the crust, preheat the oven to 225°. Break up the crackers and grind them into a fine meal in a blender or food processor or under a rolling pin. In a large bowl, blend together the crumbs, butter and sugar. Press into the bottom and sides of a 10-inch spring-form pan.

recipes.title: Heavenly Hash Cake
directions: Break cake into pieces size of walnuts.
Melt chocolate chips and cool slightly.
Dissolve gelatine in water, add to melted chips.
In separate bowl, beat eggs until foamy, then mix in with chocolate.
Butter the bottom of 9 x 13-inch baking dish.
Then add a layer of cake pieces.
Pour half the chocolate mixture over the cake, then add another layer of cake and the rest of the chocolate.
Spread cake with Cool Whip and chopped nuts.
Chill for 24 hours.
Cover with foil.
recipes.text: Heavenly Hash Cake. Break cake into pieces size of walnuts. Melt chocolate chips and cool slightly. Dissolve gelatine in water, add to melted chips. In separate bowl, beat eggs until foamy, then mix in with chocolate. Butter the bottom of 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Then add a layer of cake pieces. Pour half the chocolate mixture over the cake, then add another layer of cake and the rest of the chocolate. Spread cake with Cool Whip and chopped nuts. Chill for 24 hours. Cover with foil.

recipes.title: Pasta And Broccoli
directions: Note:
Crush up tomatoes with your hands.
recipes.text: Pasta And Broccoli. Note: Crush up tomatoes with your hands.

recipes.title: Hummingbird Cake
directions: Combine flour, sugar, soda, salt and cinnamon in a large mixing bowl.
Add eggs and oil.
Stir until dry ingredients are moistened.
Do not beat.
Add vanilla, pineapple, pecans and bananas.
Spoon batter into a Bundt pan that has been greased and floured.
Bake in a 350° oven for 1 hour or until inserted toothpick comes out clean.
Cool in pan.
Put on cake plate and frost.
recipes.text: Hummingbird Cake. Combine flour, sugar, soda, salt and cinnamon in a large mixing bowl. Add eggs and oil. Stir until dry ingredients are moistened. Do not beat. Add vanilla, pineapple, pecans and bananas. Spoon batter into a Bundt pan that has been greased and floured. Bake in a 350° oven for 1 hour or until inserted toothpick comes out clean. Cool in pan. Put on cake plate and frost.

recipes.title: Chicken Wrap-Ups
ingredients: garlic powder to taste (may substitute curry powder)
directions: Mix cream cheese, green onions and seasoning in small bowl. Roll mixture into 6 balls.
Place balls in center of flattened chicken breasts.
Fold chicken around ball.
Wrap two bacon strips around each chicken breast, securing with toothpicks.
Place in baking dish.
Bake at 350° for about 1 hour.
Serves 6.
recipes.text: Chicken Wrap-Ups. Mix cream cheese, green onions and seasoning in small bowl. Roll mixture into 6 balls. Place balls in center of flattened chicken breasts. Fold chicken around ball. Wrap two bacon strips around each chicken breast, securing with toothpicks. Place in baking dish. Bake at 350° for about 1 hour. Serves 6.

recipes.title: Stuffed Cabbage Rolls
directions: Cut center from
cabbage, chop it and set aside.
Plunk the head of cabbage into
a
large pot with a cup of water and steam a couple of minutes.	Separate the leaves.
Mix together hamburger, browned
slightly, sausage, salt, spices, rice, egg and onion. Plunk
large spoonfuls into each leaf and roll up. Put the chopped cabbage
heart
in bottom of a large pot.
Top with cabbage rolls, seam side down.
Pour V-8 juice and water over the top, bring
to a boil.
Reduce heat, cover and barely simmer for 1 1/2 hours.
recipes.text: Stuffed Cabbage Rolls. Cut center from cabbage, chop it and set aside. Plunk the head of cabbage into a large pot with a cup of water and steam a couple of minutes.	Separate the leaves. Mix together hamburger, browned slightly, sausage, salt, spices, rice, egg and onion. Plunk large spoonfuls into each leaf and roll up. Put the chopped cabbage heart in bottom of a large pot. Top with cabbage rolls, seam side down. Pour V-8 juice and water over the top, bring to a boil. Reduce heat, cover and barely simmer for 1 1/2 hours.

recipes.title: Jello Bread
ingredients: 1 box yellow or white cake mix
directions: Mix all ingredients; beat well.
Pour into well-greased loaf pans.
Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes.
Let cool before removing from pans.
Makes 2 loaves.
recipes.text: Jello Bread. Mix all ingredients; beat well. Pour into well-greased loaf pans. Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes. Let cool before removing from pans. Makes 2 loaves.

recipes.title: Lime Salad
directions: Mix water and Jell-O.
Chill until thick as an egg white.
Mix all other ingredients and add to Jell-O.
Congeal until firm.
recipes.text: Lime Salad. Mix water and Jell-O. Chill until thick as an egg white. Mix all other ingredients and add to Jell-O. Congeal until firm.

recipes.title: Old Fashioned Applesauce Cake
directions: Cream together oleo, sugar, egg and applesauce.
Sift flour and soda and add cinnamon, allspice, cloves, salt, lemon juice and orange juice.
Add flour, raisins, nuts and vanilla and pour into 2 cake pans.
Bake at 350 degrees for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Old Fashioned Applesauce Cake. Cream together oleo, sugar, egg and applesauce. Sift flour and soda and add cinnamon, allspice, cloves, salt, lemon juice and orange juice. Add flour, raisins, nuts and vanilla and pour into 2 cake pans. Bake at 350 degrees for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Broccoli Casserole
directions: Mix soup and cheese together.
Layer all ingredients after cooking and draining the broccoli in a baking dish.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Broccoli Casserole. Mix soup and cheese together. Layer all ingredients after cooking and draining the broccoli in a baking dish. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Chicken And Rice Dish
ingredients: enough chicken to cover pan, browned
directions: Mix all ingredients, except chicken, oleo and lemon juice. Put in 9 x 13-inch pan. Place chicken over rice, covering well. Melt oleo and add lemon juice to it. Brush over chicken. Bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours. Baste with rest of oleo and lemon juice.
recipes.text: Chicken And Rice Dish. Mix all ingredients, except chicken, oleo and lemon juice. Put in 9 x 13-inch pan. Place chicken over rice, covering well. Melt oleo and add lemon juice to it. Brush over chicken. Bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours. Baste with rest of oleo and lemon juice.

recipes.title: Zippy Beef Casserole
ingredients: 3/4 c. shredded Cheddar cheese (you may add more)
directions: Preheat oven to 350°.
Brown ground beef and drain fat.
Cook and drain macaroni.
Combine all ingredients in an ungreased 2 quart casserole dish.
Bake 40 minutes, covered, and then 5 minutes, uncovered.
recipes.text: Zippy Beef Casserole. Preheat oven to 350°. Brown ground beef and drain fat. Cook and drain macaroni. Combine all ingredients in an ungreased 2 quart casserole dish. Bake 40 minutes, covered, and then 5 minutes, uncovered.

recipes.title: Cilla'S Blueberry Cake
ingredients: 2 c. berries (flour berries before adding to mixture and then mix by hand)
directions: Preheat oven to 350° and grease and flour an 8-inch square pan. Mix all ingredients in the order given except blueberries.
When ingredients have been mixed thoroughly, add blueberries.
Bake for 40 to 60 minutes, as needed.
Cool and slice.
Serve covered with a generous helping of lemon sauce.
recipes.text: Cilla'S Blueberry Cake. Preheat oven to 350° and grease and flour an 8-inch square pan. Mix all ingredients in the order given except blueberries. When ingredients have been mixed thoroughly, add blueberries. Bake for 40 to 60 minutes, as needed. Cool and slice. Serve covered with a generous helping of lemon sauce.

recipes.title: Cheese Melts
ingredients: dash of basil, oregano, thyme, dill weed and/or Italian seasoning
directions: Cut bread in half lengthwise, then into quarters.
Top with cheese and broil until cheese melts.
Shake on one or any combination of seasonings.
recipes.text: Cheese Melts. Cut bread in half lengthwise, then into quarters. Top with cheese and broil until cheese melts. Shake on one or any combination of seasonings.

recipes.title: Chocolate Coffee Cake
directions: Mix flour, sugar, eggs, salt and cocoa, then add oil, milk and baking powder.
Put baking soda in boiling coffee.
Add to the rest.
Bake at 350°.
Pour into 2 round or square cake pans.
Bake for 35 minutes.
recipes.text: Chocolate Coffee Cake. Mix flour, sugar, eggs, salt and cocoa, then add oil, milk and baking powder. Put baking soda in boiling coffee. Add to the rest. Bake at 350°. Pour into 2 round or square cake pans. Bake for 35 minutes.

recipes.title: Marinated Carrots
directions: Mix and set overnight in the refrigerator.
recipes.text: Marinated Carrots. Mix and set overnight in the refrigerator.

recipes.title: Never-Fail Pie Crust
directions: Cut shortening into flour.
Combine egg, water and vinegar; pour liquid into flour mixture all at once. Blend with a spoon just until flour is all moistened. Yield: 2 double crusts.
recipes.text: Never-Fail Pie Crust. Cut shortening into flour. Combine egg, water and vinegar; pour liquid into flour mixture all at once. Blend with a spoon just until flour is all moistened. Yield: 2 double crusts.

recipes.title: Chocolate Raisin Chewies
ingredients: 1 1/2 c. firmly packed light brown sugar
1 1/2 c. raisins or combination of raisins and chopped walnuts
directions: Heat oven to 375°.
Combine shortening, brown sugar, water and vanilla in large bowl.
Beat at medium speed of electric mixer until well blended.
Beat in eggs.
Combine flour, cocoa powder, salt and baking soda. Add to creamed mixture at low speed until just blended.
Stir in raisins.
Drop by rounded measuring tablespoonfuls 2 inches apart onto ungreased baking sheet.
Bake one baking sheet at a time at 375° for 7 to 9 minutes, or until cookies are set.
Do not overbake.
Cookies should be soft and moist.
Cool on baking sheet 2 minutes.
Remove to kitchen counter.
recipes.text: Chocolate Raisin Chewies. Heat oven to 375°. Combine shortening, brown sugar, water and vanilla in large bowl. Beat at medium speed of electric mixer until well blended. Beat in eggs. Combine flour, cocoa powder, salt and baking soda. Add to creamed mixture at low speed until just blended. Stir in raisins. Drop by rounded measuring tablespoonfuls 2 inches apart onto ungreased baking sheet. Bake one baking sheet at a time at 375° for 7 to 9 minutes, or until cookies are set. Do not overbake. Cookies should be soft and moist. Cool on baking sheet 2 minutes. Remove to kitchen counter.

recipes.title: Casey'S Vinegar Pie
directions: Bring sugar, water and vinegar to boiling.
Stir in butter until melted.
Mix flour with a little cold water until smooth. Add to boiling liquid slowly and stir until thickened.
Allow to cool slightly.
Pour into shell.
Cover top lattice-fashion with pastry strips.
Bake at 450° for 10 minutes; reduce to 350° and bake about 25 minutes.
recipes.text: Casey'S Vinegar Pie. Bring sugar, water and vinegar to boiling. Stir in butter until melted. Mix flour with a little cold water until smooth. Add to boiling liquid slowly and stir until thickened. Allow to cool slightly. Pour into shell. Cover top lattice-fashion with pastry strips. Bake at 450° for 10 minutes; reduce to 350° and bake about 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Chocolate Cake
directions: Bowl, break the eggs up (take shells off).
Flour next, vanilla, sugar.
Mix up with a spoon and stir up real fast, mix up good, butter cinnamon, chocolate drops.
Then sugar - stir a little bit more.
Put in two circle pans.
Heat oven to 400°; don't want to burn it, cook 3 minutes until done.
Then ice, and eat, and then go brush teeth, watch TV and go to bed.
Don't forget to read a book!
recipes.text: Chocolate Cake. Bowl, break the eggs up (take shells off). Flour next, vanilla, sugar. Mix up with a spoon and stir up real fast, mix up good, butter cinnamon, chocolate drops. Then sugar - stir a little bit more. Put in two circle pans. Heat oven to 400°; don't want to burn it, cook 3 minutes until done. Then ice, and eat, and then go brush teeth, watch TV and go to bed. Don't forget to read a book!

recipes.title: Authentic Mexican Pralines
directions: Put 2 cups sugar, water, pecans and salt in pan; bring to a boil.
In meantime, brown 1/2 cup sugar in a small iron skillet; let it melt and get to light caramel color.
Pour into first mixture and continue to cook until it forms a ball when dropped in cold water.
Add butter and beat until it cools and thickens a little; drop by spoonfuls on waxed paper, which has been laid over newspaper.
When cool and hard, candy will lift easily from paper.
recipes.text: Authentic Mexican Pralines. Put 2 cups sugar, water, pecans and salt in pan; bring to a boil. In meantime, brown 1/2 cup sugar in a small iron skillet; let it melt and get to light caramel color. Pour into first mixture and continue to cook until it forms a ball when dropped in cold water. Add butter and beat until it cools and thickens a little; drop by spoonfuls on waxed paper, which has been laid over newspaper. When cool and hard, candy will lift easily from paper.

recipes.title: Quick Shrimp Scampi
ingredients: 1 T Sliced Green Onions or Dried Onions
directions: Peel and devein shrimp, set aside.
recipes.text: Quick Shrimp Scampi. Peel and devein shrimp, set aside.

recipes.title: Dilly Beans
directions: Pack raw green beans in hot pints. To each pint add 1/2 tsp. red cayenne pepper, 1 clove garlic and 1 head dill.
Put 2 c. water, 2 c. cider vinegar (not white) and 1/4 c. canning salt in saucepan and boil a minute or two. Pour this into jars and seal. No need to process, just let set a week or so and enjoy.
recipes.text: Dilly Beans. Pack raw green beans in hot pints. To each pint add 1/2 tsp. red cayenne pepper, 1 clove garlic and 1 head dill. Put 2 c. water, 2 c. cider vinegar (not white) and 1/4 c. canning salt in saucepan and boil a minute or two. Pour this into jars and seal. No need to process, just let set a week or so and enjoy.

recipes.title: Chess Cake
directions: Mix the first 3 ingredients and press into a 9 x 13-inch sheet cake pan.
Mix the last 3 ingredients and pour over cake mixture in pan. Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes. Cut into squares when cooled.
recipes.text: Chess Cake. Mix the first 3 ingredients and press into a 9 x 13-inch sheet cake pan. Mix the last 3 ingredients and pour over cake mixture in pan. Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes. Cut into squares when cooled.

recipes.title: Dilled Green Beans
ingredients: hot red pepper, crushed, 1/4 tsp. per pt. jar
whole mustard seed, 1/2 tsp. per pt. jar
dill seed, 1/2 tsp. per pt. jar
directions: Wash beans and drain.
Pack beans into clean, hot jars; add pepper, mustard seed, dill seed and garlic.
Combine vinegar, water and salt.
Heat to boiling.
Pour boiling liquid over beans, filling to 1/2 inch from top of jar.
Adjust jar lids.
Process in boiling water for 5 minutes.
(Jars will cool the water, so start to count processing time as soon as water in canner returns to boiling.) Remove jars and re-tighten lids if necessary.
Set jars upright several inches apart on a wire rack to cool.
recipes.text: Dilled Green Beans. Wash beans and drain. Pack beans into clean, hot jars; add pepper, mustard seed, dill seed and garlic. Combine vinegar, water and salt. Heat to boiling. Pour boiling liquid over beans, filling to 1/2 inch from top of jar. Adjust jar lids. Process in boiling water for 5 minutes. (Jars will cool the water, so start to count processing time as soon as water in canner returns to boiling.) Remove jars and re-tighten lids if necessary. Set jars upright several inches apart on a wire rack to cool.

recipes.title: Danny'S Christmas Cookies
directions: Mix dry ingredients.
Beat butter, sugar, fructose and vanilla until fluffy.
Beat in eggs until smooth.
Gradually add flour mixture and beat.
Stir in candy.
Drop by 1/2 teaspoon onto ungreased cookie sheet.
Bake at 350° for 10 to 12 minutes.
recipes.text: Danny'S Christmas Cookies. Mix dry ingredients. Beat butter, sugar, fructose and vanilla until fluffy. Beat in eggs until smooth. Gradually add flour mixture and beat. Stir in candy. Drop by 1/2 teaspoon onto ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 350° for 10 to 12 minutes.

recipes.title: Cheese Biscuits
directions: Cream margarine and cheese.
Add dry ingredients.
Mix with hands (will be stiff).
Roll in small ball.
Press in nut half or press down with fork dipped in flour.
Bake 20 or 25 minutes on ungreased tin at 350°.
Makes about 5 dozen.
recipes.text: Cheese Biscuits. Cream margarine and cheese. Add dry ingredients. Mix with hands (will be stiff). Roll in small ball. Press in nut half or press down with fork dipped in flour. Bake 20 or 25 minutes on ungreased tin at 350°. Makes about 5 dozen.

recipes.title: Pork Chops, Apples & Stuffin'
directions: Place pork chops in bottom of baking dish. Put apple pie filling on top of pork chops. Mix stuff according to package. Cover apples with stuffing mix.
recipes.text: Pork Chops, Apples & Stuffin'. Place pork chops in bottom of baking dish. Put apple pie filling on top of pork chops. Mix stuff according to package. Cover apples with stuffing mix.

recipes.title: Corn Salad
ingredients: 1/2 tsp. hot paprika (hot pepper sauce okay)
directions: Combine salad ingredients.
Toss with dressing which has been whisked together (oil, lime juice and spices).
Serve at room temperature.
recipes.text: Corn Salad. Combine salad ingredients. Toss with dressing which has been whisked together (oil, lime juice and spices). Serve at room temperature.

recipes.title: Strawberry Jello Mold
directions: Combine jello and cottage cheese.
Fold in berries and Cool Whip.
Let set.
Very good.
recipes.text: Strawberry Jello Mold. Combine jello and cottage cheese. Fold in berries and Cool Whip. Let set. Very good.

recipes.title: Chicken And Shrimp
ingredients: 1 to 1 1/2 lb. raw shrimp, cleaned and deveined
directions: In large frying pan, brown chicken and onion in olive oil. When browned, add rest of ingredients except shrimp.
Cover and simmer about 45 minutes until chicken is tender.
Add shrimp and simmer about ten minutes longer.
Serve over rice.
Makes 4 to 6 servings.
recipes.text: Chicken And Shrimp. In large frying pan, brown chicken and onion in olive oil. When browned, add rest of ingredients except shrimp. Cover and simmer about 45 minutes until chicken is tender. Add shrimp and simmer about ten minutes longer. Serve over rice. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

recipes.title: Overnight Caramel French Toast
directions: Combine sugar, butter and corn syrup in a small saucepan. Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, about 5 minutes. Pour syrup mixture in a 9 x 13-inch cake pan. Cut bread in thick slices and place on top of syrup mixture. Combine eggs, milk, vanilla and salt. Beat well. Pour over bread slices. Cover and chill overnight. Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 40 to 50 minutes or until lightly browned. Serve with warm syrup.
recipes.text: Overnight Caramel French Toast. Combine sugar, butter and corn syrup in a small saucepan. Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, about 5 minutes. Pour syrup mixture in a 9 x 13-inch cake pan. Cut bread in thick slices and place on top of syrup mixture. Combine eggs, milk, vanilla and salt. Beat well. Pour over bread slices. Cover and chill overnight. Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 40 to 50 minutes or until lightly browned. Serve with warm syrup.

recipes.title: Pasta Salad
directions: Cook pasta; drain and cool.
Add whole bottle of dressing. Mix and refrigerate overnight, then add green pepper, celery, tomatoes and cucumbers.
Add 1/2 jar McCormick Salad Supreme.
Mix well.
recipes.text: Pasta Salad. Cook pasta; drain and cool. Add whole bottle of dressing. Mix and refrigerate overnight, then add green pepper, celery, tomatoes and cucumbers. Add 1/2 jar McCormick Salad Supreme. Mix well.

recipes.title: Tandori Turkey
ingredients: 6 (6 oz.) skinned, boneless turkey or chicken breasts
directions: Blend all ingredients, except turkey or chicken, well.
Pour over turkey breasts.
Cover both sides.
Cover; refrigerate at least 12 hours.
Grill until done.
recipes.text: Tandori Turkey. Blend all ingredients, except turkey or chicken, well. Pour over turkey breasts. Cover both sides. Cover; refrigerate at least 12 hours. Grill until done.

recipes.title: Butterscotch Nut Fudge
directions: Melt butter in heavy saucepan, add brown sugar and heat to boiling.
Add granulated sugar and sour cream.
Cook over low heat, stirring until sugar dissolves, to soft ball stage (235°). Cool at room temperature, without stirring, until lukewarm (110°). Beat until mixture holds its shape.
Add vanilla and nuts, quickly spread in greased pan.
Cool and cut in squares.
recipes.text: Butterscotch Nut Fudge. Melt butter in heavy saucepan, add brown sugar and heat to boiling. Add granulated sugar and sour cream. Cook over low heat, stirring until sugar dissolves, to soft ball stage (235°). Cool at room temperature, without stirring, until lukewarm (110°). Beat until mixture holds its shape. Add vanilla and nuts, quickly spread in greased pan. Cool and cut in squares.

recipes.title: Cheese Ball
directions: Mix together the cheese at room temperature.
Roll in chopped parsley or paprika.
recipes.text: Cheese Ball. Mix together the cheese at room temperature. Roll in chopped parsley or paprika.

recipes.title: Deluxe Spiced Tea Mix
ingredients: 2 (26 oz.) jars instant orange flavored breakfast drink
1 (6 oz.) pkg. sweetened lemonade drink mix
directions: Combine all the ingredients, stirring well. Store mixture in an airtight container.
To serve, place 1 tablespoon plus 1 teaspoon mixture in a cup.
Add 1 cup boiling water, stirring well.
Yields 14 cups.
recipes.text: Deluxe Spiced Tea Mix. Combine all the ingredients, stirring well. Store mixture in an airtight container. To serve, place 1 tablespoon plus 1 teaspoon mixture in a cup. Add 1 cup boiling water, stirring well. Yields 14 cups.

recipes.title: Microwave Cheesy Chili Dip
directions: In 2-quart glass baking dish. Spread softened cream cheese. Spread chili over cream cheese. Sprinkle with cheese.
Microwave until cheese is melted. Favorite chip is Tostitos to serve with.
recipes.text: Microwave Cheesy Chili Dip. In 2-quart glass baking dish. Spread softened cream cheese. Spread chili over cream cheese. Sprinkle with cheese. Microwave until cheese is melted. Favorite chip is Tostitos to serve with.

recipes.title: Chicken Soup Mother Didn'T Make
ingredients: 1 1/2 c. frozen vegetables for seasoning (in freezer case close to onions and peppers)
directions: Boil chicken, including heart, gizzard and liver for about 45 minutes.
Use enough water to just float the chicken.
Remove pan from heat.
Take chicken out and let it cool.
Save the pot of water.
When chicken is cool, pick the meat off the bones (don't start too early or you will invent words the dog won't stay around to hear).
Put chicken meat back into the pot of water.
Add the complete soup starter, the vegetables for seasoning and the sliced carrots.
Add any leftover veggies found in the fridge.
Cover pot and simmer at least 2 hours.
Serve with cornbread.
It will fix what ails you!
recipes.text: Chicken Soup Mother Didn'T Make. Boil chicken, including heart, gizzard and liver for about 45 minutes. Use enough water to just float the chicken. Remove pan from heat. Take chicken out and let it cool. Save the pot of water. When chicken is cool, pick the meat off the bones (don't start too early or you will invent words the dog won't stay around to hear). Put chicken meat back into the pot of water. Add the complete soup starter, the vegetables for seasoning and the sliced carrots. Add any leftover veggies found in the fridge. Cover pot and simmer at least 2 hours. Serve with cornbread. It will fix what ails you!

recipes.title: Green Bean Casserole
directions: Pour green beans and juice into a microwave safe dish and cook for ten minutes on high.
recipes.text: Green Bean Casserole. Pour green beans and juice into a microwave safe dish and cook for ten minutes on high.

recipes.title: Cherry Crunch Cake
ingredients: 1 (12 oz.) can crushed pineapple (in own juice)
directions: In a 12 x 18-inch Pyrex dish, layer pineapple, cake mix and cherries in this order.
Melt butter and pour over top and sprinkle with pecans.
Bake at 350° until brown, 20 to 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Cherry Crunch Cake. In a 12 x 18-inch Pyrex dish, layer pineapple, cake mix and cherries in this order. Melt butter and pour over top and sprinkle with pecans. Bake at 350° until brown, 20 to 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Macaroni Salad
directions: Cook macaroni according to package; drain well.
Cool.
Add vegetables and eggs.
Stir in salad dressing, salt and pepper. Chill.
recipes.text: Macaroni Salad. Cook macaroni according to package; drain well. Cool. Add vegetables and eggs. Stir in salad dressing, salt and pepper. Chill.

recipes.title: Cornmeal Muffins
directions: In a large mixing bowl combine dry ingredients.
Make a well in the center; add all remaining ingredients.
Stir just until mixed.
Spoon into 12 greased muffin tins.
Bake at 400° for 20 minutes.
recipes.text: Cornmeal Muffins. In a large mixing bowl combine dry ingredients. Make a well in the center; add all remaining ingredients. Stir just until mixed. Spoon into 12 greased muffin tins. Bake at 400° for 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Jello Popcorn Balls
directions: Cook sugar, Jell-O, Karo, margarine and water to soft ball stage.
Remove from heat and pour over popped corn.
Mix.
When cool enough to handle, form into balls with greased hands.
recipes.text: Jello Popcorn Balls. Cook sugar, Jell-O, Karo, margarine and water to soft ball stage. Remove from heat and pour over popped corn. Mix. When cool enough to handle, form into balls with greased hands.

recipes.title: Chicken And Dumplings
directions: Cook
chicken and take off of the bone.
Cut soft margarine into
flour
until
it feels like corn meal.
Mix boiling liquid into
flour mixture, as if it were biscuit dough.
Roll out on a floured board, 1/4-inch thick.
Cut into 1-inch square pieces. Sprinkle flour over pieces before cooking.
recipes.text: Chicken And Dumplings. Cook chicken and take off of the bone. Cut soft margarine into flour until it feels like corn meal. Mix boiling liquid into flour mixture, as if it were biscuit dough. Roll out on a floured board, 1/4-inch thick. Cut into 1-inch square pieces. Sprinkle flour over pieces before cooking.

recipes.title: Mushroom-Spinach Pasta
ingredients: 1 or 2 (3 oz.) cans chopped mushrooms, drained
1 (10 oz.) pkg. frozen spinach, cooked and well drained
directions: With an electric mixer beat cottage cheese and cream cheese until nearly smooth.
In a saucepan, cook onion in butter or margarine until tender but not brown.
Add mushrooms, wine, thyme, salt and pepper.
Stir in cheese mixture, evaporated milk and drained spinach.
Heat through, but don't let it boil or it will separate.
Place hot spaghetti on large platter and top with sauce; toss gently.
Serves 4 as a main course.
recipes.text: Mushroom-Spinach Pasta. With an electric mixer beat cottage cheese and cream cheese until nearly smooth. In a saucepan, cook onion in butter or margarine until tender but not brown. Add mushrooms, wine, thyme, salt and pepper. Stir in cheese mixture, evaporated milk and drained spinach. Heat through, but don't let it boil or it will separate. Place hot spaghetti on large platter and top with sauce; toss gently. Serves 4 as a main course.

recipes.title: Golden Corn Bread
directions: Sift together in bowl the flour, sugar, baking powder and salt.
Stir in corn meal.
In a small bowl,
beat eggs, milk and shortening.
Add all at once to corn meal mixture.
Stir with fork until flour is just moistened.
Even if batter is lumpy, do not stir anymore.
Pour into well-greased 9 x 9 x 2-inch pan.
Bake in a 425° oven for 20 to 25 minutes, or until done.
recipes.text: Golden Corn Bread. Sift together in bowl the flour, sugar, baking powder and salt. Stir in corn meal. In a small bowl, beat eggs, milk and shortening. Add all at once to corn meal mixture. Stir with fork until flour is just moistened. Even if batter is lumpy, do not stir anymore. Pour into well-greased 9 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Bake in a 425° oven for 20 to 25 minutes, or until done.

recipes.title: Fiesta Taco Dip
directions: Mix sour cream, bean dip and taco seasoning. Spread onto cookie sheet and refrigerate overnight. Sprinkle remaining ingredients the next day before serving.
recipes.text: Fiesta Taco Dip. Mix sour cream, bean dip and taco seasoning. Spread onto cookie sheet and refrigerate overnight. Sprinkle remaining ingredients the next day before serving.

recipes.title: Fruit Pizza
ingredients: 1 box Duncan Hines sugar cookie mix
directions: Mix cookie mix according to directions on box.
Make 1 big cookie on regular pizza pan.
Let cool after baking.
recipes.text: Fruit Pizza. Mix cookie mix according to directions on box. Make 1 big cookie on regular pizza pan. Let cool after baking.

recipes.title: Cheese Wafers
directions: Mix the ingredients and bake at 350° until lightly brown.
recipes.text: Cheese Wafers. Mix the ingredients and bake at 350° until lightly brown.

recipes.title: Aunt Penny'S Oatmeal Pie
directions: Beat eggs, sugar and margarine.
Mix with remaining ingredients and pour into an unbaked pie shell.
Bake at 300° for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Aunt Penny'S Oatmeal Pie. Beat eggs, sugar and margarine. Mix with remaining ingredients and pour into an unbaked pie shell. Bake at 300° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Breakfast Muffins
directions: Stir and put in 6 muffin tins sprayed with Pam. Bake at 350° for 20 to 30 minutes. Six muffins equal 1 bread, 1 protein, 1 fruit and 1 milk.
recipes.text: Breakfast Muffins. Stir and put in 6 muffin tins sprayed with Pam. Bake at 350° for 20 to 30 minutes. Six muffins equal 1 bread, 1 protein, 1 fruit and 1 milk.

recipes.title: Chicken Divan
ingredients: 2 cans condensed cream of chicken soup
1/2 c. shredded sharp processed American cheese
directions: Cook broccoli in boiling, salted water until tender; drain. Arrange broccoli in greased 11 1/2 x 7 1/2-inch baking dish. Place cooked chicken on top.
Combine soup, mayonnaise and lemon juice; pour over chicken.
Sprinkle with cheese.
Combine bread crumbs and butter.
Sprinkle over top.
Bake 30 to 40 minutes at 350° or until thoroughly heated.
This dish can be prepared a day ahead and put in the refrigerator.
It also freezes very well. Dish can also be made substituting asparagus for broccoli.
recipes.text: Chicken Divan. Cook broccoli in boiling, salted water until tender; drain. Arrange broccoli in greased 11 1/2 x 7 1/2-inch baking dish. Place cooked chicken on top. Combine soup, mayonnaise and lemon juice; pour over chicken. Sprinkle with cheese. Combine bread crumbs and butter. Sprinkle over top. Bake 30 to 40 minutes at 350° or until thoroughly heated. This dish can be prepared a day ahead and put in the refrigerator. It also freezes very well. Dish can also be made substituting asparagus for broccoli.

recipes.title: Chicken Tortilla Casserole
directions: Mash chilies and add to soups and milk.
Heat to blend.
Put one layer of tortillas and one layer of chicken.
Cover with sauce, then cheese.
Repeat until all ingredients are used.
Bake 1 hour, covered in a 350° oven.
recipes.text: Chicken Tortilla Casserole. Mash chilies and add to soups and milk. Heat to blend. Put one layer of tortillas and one layer of chicken. Cover with sauce, then cheese. Repeat until all ingredients are used. Bake 1 hour, covered in a 350° oven.

recipes.title: Chocolate Pie
directions: Cook pudding and mix with half of Cool Whip.
Chill until set in crust.
Remaining Cool Whip can be used on top if desired.
recipes.text: Chocolate Pie. Cook pudding and mix with half of Cool Whip. Chill until set in crust. Remaining Cool Whip can be used on top if desired.

recipes.title: Butterscotch Pecan Fudge
directions: Combine pudding mix, brown sugar, milk, sugar, pecans, butter and vanilla in saucepan.
Bring to a boil; cook for 5 minutes, stirring constantly.
Remove from heat.
Beat until cool.
Pour into buttered pan.
Cut into squares.
recipes.text: Butterscotch Pecan Fudge. Combine pudding mix, brown sugar, milk, sugar, pecans, butter and vanilla in saucepan. Bring to a boil; cook for 5 minutes, stirring constantly. Remove from heat. Beat until cool. Pour into buttered pan. Cut into squares.

recipes.title: Tea Cakes
directions: Cream shortening
and sugar.
Add eggs and dry ingredients. Roll, cut and bake at 350°.
recipes.text: Tea Cakes. Cream shortening and sugar. Add eggs and dry ingredients. Roll, cut and bake at 350°.

recipes.title: Baked Chicken Breast With Dressing
ingredients: 1 pkg. dressing mix (prepare according to pkg. instructions)
directions: Place chicken breasts in bottom of baking dish and cook approximately 12 to 15 minutes.

While this is baking, mix the package dressing mix according to instructions on the package. After chicken breasts have cooled slightly, place a patty of dressing on top of the chicken breasts, cupping your hand over it to make it fit to the top.
Place slice of Swiss cheese over dressing.
Mix contents of the can of cream of mushroom soup (or cream of chicken or cream of celery) with 1/2 cup milk.
Pour over top of chicken.
Cover with a lid and cook for an additional 30 minutes at 350°.
recipes.text: Baked Chicken Breast With Dressing. Place chicken breasts in bottom of baking dish and cook approximately 12 to 15 minutes. While this is baking, mix the package dressing mix according to instructions on the package. After chicken breasts have cooled slightly, place a patty of dressing on top of the chicken breasts, cupping your hand over it to make it fit to the top. Place slice of Swiss cheese over dressing. Mix contents of the can of cream of mushroom soup (or cream of chicken or cream of celery) with 1/2 cup milk. Pour over top of chicken. Cover with a lid and cook for an additional 30 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Pie
directions: Mix all ingredients together.
Beat with hand mixer or blender.
Pour in greased pie pan.	Bake at 350° until done 50 to 55 minutes.
recipes.text: Pumpkin Pie. Mix all ingredients together. Beat with hand mixer or blender. Pour in greased pie pan.	Bake at 350° until done 50 to 55 minutes.

recipes.title: Steamed New Potatoes
ingredients: 3 or 5 lbs new potatoes (you can use quartered red potatoes)
directions: Wash potatoes and place them in a large steam pan. Fill the bottom pan with water (halfway to top). Put garlic and onion in the water. Bring to a boil. Place the steam pan with potatoes over the water pan. Cut the butter up and drop on top of potatoes. Salt and pepper to taste. Cover steam pan, reduce heat to a simmer and let steam for about 30 to 45 minutes. Check for doneness by pricking with a fork. Before you serve, sprinkle with parsley flakes, and more butter if desired.
recipes.text: Steamed New Potatoes. Wash potatoes and place them in a large steam pan. Fill the bottom pan with water (halfway to top). Put garlic and onion in the water. Bring to a boil. Place the steam pan with potatoes over the water pan. Cut the butter up and drop on top of potatoes. Salt and pepper to taste. Cover steam pan, reduce heat to a simmer and let steam for about 30 to 45 minutes. Check for doneness by pricking with a fork. Before you serve, sprinkle with parsley flakes, and more butter if desired.

recipes.title: Yeast Rolls
directions: Mix flours together.
Combine 1 1/2 cups flour, sugar, salt and yeast; mix well.
Heat milk, water and margarine together to 120° to 130°.
Pour in yeast mixture and beat for two minutes at medium speed.
Add eggs and 1/2 cup flour and beat 2 minutes at high speed.
Add enough remaining flour to make stiff batter.
Cover bowl tightly with foil or plastic wrap.
Refrigerate 4 hours.
Roll dough on floured board.
Cut rolls and place on buttered pans. Brush butter on tops of rolls.
Cover and let rise for about 1 hour.
Bake at 375° for 20 minutes or until golden brown.
recipes.text: Yeast Rolls. Mix flours together. Combine 1 1/2 cups flour, sugar, salt and yeast; mix well. Heat milk, water and margarine together to 120° to 130°. Pour in yeast mixture and beat for two minutes at medium speed. Add eggs and 1/2 cup flour and beat 2 minutes at high speed. Add enough remaining flour to make stiff batter. Cover bowl tightly with foil or plastic wrap. Refrigerate 4 hours. Roll dough on floured board. Cut rolls and place on buttered pans. Brush butter on tops of rolls. Cover and let rise for about 1 hour. Bake at 375° for 20 minutes or until golden brown.

recipes.title: Broiled Crabmeat Canapes
directions: In large bowl, blend together softened butter and cheese.
Stir in the mayonnaise, salts and crabmeat.
Spread on muffin halves. Cut each muffin into four pieces.
Spread on cookie sheet and freeze.
Place in plastic bags until ready to serve.
At serving time, broil until brown and bubbly.
Yields 48 hors d'oeuvres.
recipes.text: Broiled Crabmeat Canapes. In large bowl, blend together softened butter and cheese. Stir in the mayonnaise, salts and crabmeat. Spread on muffin halves. Cut each muffin into four pieces. Spread on cookie sheet and freeze. Place in plastic bags until ready to serve. At serving time, broil until brown and bubbly. Yields 48 hors d'oeuvres.

recipes.title: Broccoli Casserole
directions: Empty broccoli into a well-greased 2-quart casserole.
Mix soup, eggs, onion, mayonnaise, salt and pepper.
Pour over broccoli, but do not mix.
Top with Parmesan cheese and bread crumbs.
Bake at 325° for 45 minutes, uncovered.
recipes.text: Broccoli Casserole. Empty broccoli into a well-greased 2-quart casserole. Mix soup, eggs, onion, mayonnaise, salt and pepper. Pour over broccoli, but do not mix. Top with Parmesan cheese and bread crumbs. Bake at 325° for 45 minutes, uncovered.

recipes.title: Fresh Peach Pie
directions: Cook the first 3 ingredients over low heat until thick. Remove from heat; stir in the jello.
Cool and pour over sliced peaches.
Pour mixture into baked pie shell.
Spread whipped cream on top, or serve with ice cream.
recipes.text: Fresh Peach Pie. Cook the first 3 ingredients over low heat until thick. Remove from heat; stir in the jello. Cool and pour over sliced peaches. Pour mixture into baked pie shell. Spread whipped cream on top, or serve with ice cream.

recipes.title: Forgotten Cookies
directions: Beat egg whites until stiff, add sugar and continue beating. Add chips and nuts.
Drop by spoonfuls on cookie sheet.
recipes.text: Forgotten Cookies. Beat egg whites until stiff, add sugar and continue beating. Add chips and nuts. Drop by spoonfuls on cookie sheet.

recipes.title: Ham And Broccoli Roll-Ups
ingredients: 1 bunch broccoli (fresh or frozen), cooked and drained (10 oz. pkg. frozen)
1/3 c. grated Parmesan or Cheddar cheese
directions: Roll ham around broccoli spears.
Place rolls in shallow casserole dish.
In a small saucepan, stir together mayonnaise, flour, salt and pepper.
Gradually stir in milk.
Cook over low heat, stirring constantly, until thickened.
Add cheese, stirring until blended.
Pour sauce over rolls.
Sprinkle with bread crumbs. Broil 6 inches from source of heat for 2 minutes, or until bubbly. Serve.
Serves 2 1/2.
recipes.text: Ham And Broccoli Roll-Ups. Roll ham around broccoli spears. Place rolls in shallow casserole dish. In a small saucepan, stir together mayonnaise, flour, salt and pepper. Gradually stir in milk. Cook over low heat, stirring constantly, until thickened. Add cheese, stirring until blended. Pour sauce over rolls. Sprinkle with bread crumbs. Broil 6 inches from source of heat for 2 minutes, or until bubbly. Serve. Serves 2 1/2.

recipes.title: Neiman-Marcus Cookies
directions: Cream the margarine and sugars.
Add eggs and vanilla.
Mix together with flour and oats.
Add salt, baking soda and baking powder.
Last add chips, grated chocolate and nuts.
Roll into balls.
Place 2-inches apart. Bake 8 to 10
minutes at 375°.
Will not look done. Take out and let rest a few minutes, then take off sheet.
Will firm up as they cool.
Makes 200 cookies.
recipes.text: Neiman-Marcus Cookies. Cream the margarine and sugars. Add eggs and vanilla. Mix together with flour and oats. Add salt, baking soda and baking powder. Last add chips, grated chocolate and nuts. Roll into balls. Place 2-inches apart. Bake 8 to 10 minutes at 375°. Will not look done. Take out and let rest a few minutes, then take off sheet. Will firm up as they cool. Makes 200 cookies.

recipes.title: Pineapple Nut Pies
directions: Mix
Eagle
Brand milk and lemon juice.
Add Cool Whip, pineapple
and
pecans.
Pour into 2 graham cracker crusts and refrigerate until ready to serve.
recipes.text: Pineapple Nut Pies. Mix Eagle Brand milk and lemon juice. Add Cool Whip, pineapple and pecans. Pour into 2 graham cracker crusts and refrigerate until ready to serve.

recipes.title: Swiss Vegetable Medley
ingredients: 16 oz. bag frozen vegetable combination (like broccoli, carrot, cauliflower, etc.)
directions: Preheat oven to 350°.

Combine vegetables, soup, 1/2 cup cheese, sour cream, pepper, pimentos and 1/2 can fried onions. Pour into casserole. Bake, covered, at 350° for 30 minutes or until vegetables are done. Sprinkle remaining cheese and onions in diagonal rows across top. Bake, uncovered, 5 minutes or until onions are golden brown.
recipes.text: Swiss Vegetable Medley. Preheat oven to 350°. Combine vegetables, soup, 1/2 cup cheese, sour cream, pepper, pimentos and 1/2 can fried onions. Pour into casserole. Bake, covered, at 350° for 30 minutes or until vegetables are done. Sprinkle remaining cheese and onions in diagonal rows across top. Bake, uncovered, 5 minutes or until onions are golden brown.

recipes.title: Apple Crisp(From 1975 Edition)
directions: Preheat oven to 400°.
Sift first 3 ingredients into a bowl; add egg.
Mix lightly with a fork until mixture is crumbly. Wash, peel and slice apples.
Arrange in a greased 8-inch square pan.
Top with crumbs.
Pour margarine over all.
Sprinkle with cinnamon.
Bake for 40 minutes.
recipes.text: Apple Crisp(From 1975 Edition). Preheat oven to 400°. Sift first 3 ingredients into a bowl; add egg. Mix lightly with a fork until mixture is crumbly. Wash, peel and slice apples. Arrange in a greased 8-inch square pan. Top with crumbs. Pour margarine over all. Sprinkle with cinnamon. Bake for 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Apricot Nut Snack Loaf(Recipe From England)
directions: Sift together flour, baking powder, salt and sugar.
Add nuts, apricots and cherries.
Combine egg, milk and salad oil.
Add liquid to dry ingredients.
Stir only until flour is dampened. Turn into a well-greased 9 x 4 x 3-inch loaf pan.
Push batter up into corners of pan, leaving the center slightly hollowed.
For a well-rounded loaf, allow batter to stand in pan 20 minutes before baking.
Bake at 375° for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Apricot Nut Snack Loaf(Recipe From England). Sift together flour, baking powder, salt and sugar. Add nuts, apricots and cherries. Combine egg, milk and salad oil. Add liquid to dry ingredients. Stir only until flour is dampened. Turn into a well-greased 9 x 4 x 3-inch loaf pan. Push batter up into corners of pan, leaving the center slightly hollowed. For a well-rounded loaf, allow batter to stand in pan 20 minutes before baking. Bake at 375° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Broccoli Bread
ingredients: 1 (10 oz.) pkg. chopped broccoli, thawed and drained
directions: Mix all of the ingredients together.
Pour into ungreased 9 x 13-inch pan.
Bake at 400° for 35 to 40 minutes.
Let stand a few minutes before cutting.
recipes.text: Broccoli Bread. Mix all of the ingredients together. Pour into ungreased 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 400° for 35 to 40 minutes. Let stand a few minutes before cutting.

recipes.title: Zucchini Appetizer
ingredients: 1/2 c. grated Parmesan or Romano cheese
directions: Combine all ingredients in a large bowl.
Mix well and pour into a greased 9 x 13-inch pan.
Bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes or until golden.
Let stand for 10 minutes and cut into squares. Can be eaten hot or cold.
recipes.text: Zucchini Appetizer. Combine all ingredients in a large bowl. Mix well and pour into a greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes or until golden. Let stand for 10 minutes and cut into squares. Can be eaten hot or cold.

recipes.title: Beef, Bean And Noodle Skillet
directions: In a 10-inch skillet with cover, saute beef for about 5 minutes, stirring until meat loses its red color.
Add onion, green pepper and celery.
Saute 5 minutes longer.
Sprinkle with salt, pepper, Worcestershire sauce and basil.
recipes.text: Beef, Bean And Noodle Skillet. In a 10-inch skillet with cover, saute beef for about 5 minutes, stirring until meat loses its red color. Add onion, green pepper and celery. Saute 5 minutes longer. Sprinkle with salt, pepper, Worcestershire sauce and basil.

recipes.title: Mother'S Pound Cake
directions: Sift flour and baking powder.
Mix shortening and sugar.
Then add eggs to shortening and sugar and mix well.
Add flour and milk alternately.
Add flavoring.
Bake 1 hour or until done at 350°.
recipes.text: Mother'S Pound Cake. Sift flour and baking powder. Mix shortening and sugar. Then add eggs to shortening and sugar and mix well. Add flour and milk alternately. Add flavoring. Bake 1 hour or until done at 350°.

recipes.title: Epiphany Tea
directions: Mix all ingredients together.
To serve, use 2 teaspoons of mix to 1 cup boiling water.
recipes.text: Epiphany Tea. Mix all ingredients together. To serve, use 2 teaspoons of mix to 1 cup boiling water.

recipes.title: Hearty Chicken Stew
ingredients: 1 Tbsp. minced fresh ginger or 1 tsp. ground ginger
directions: In a deep skillet or Dutch oven, heat oil over medium-high heat.
Saute onion and garlic until onion is soft, about 3 minutes.
Add flour and cook 1 minute, stirring quickly to prevent sticking.
Stir in tomatoes and allow to cook another 2 minutes. Wrap peppercorns, cloves and cinnamon in a small piece of cheesecloth.
Add chicken, cheesecloth package, water and Worcestershire sauce to onion mixture.
Reduce heat and simmer, covered, for 20 minutes.
recipes.text: Hearty Chicken Stew. In a deep skillet or Dutch oven, heat oil over medium-high heat. Saute onion and garlic until onion is soft, about 3 minutes. Add flour and cook 1 minute, stirring quickly to prevent sticking. Stir in tomatoes and allow to cook another 2 minutes. Wrap peppercorns, cloves and cinnamon in a small piece of cheesecloth. Add chicken, cheesecloth package, water and Worcestershire sauce to onion mixture. Reduce heat and simmer, covered, for 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Spicy Cheese Ball
directions: Dice cheese and let soften at room temperature (2 hours). Dice peppers and garlic.
Put cottage cheese through blender and blend smooth; thin, if necessary, with lemon juice.
Mix all together until smooth.
Add pecans and evaporated skim milk necessary to reach desired consistency.
Form into ball and decorate with nuts and pimento.
Chill.
recipes.text: Spicy Cheese Ball. Dice cheese and let soften at room temperature (2 hours). Dice peppers and garlic. Put cottage cheese through blender and blend smooth; thin, if necessary, with lemon juice. Mix all together until smooth. Add pecans and evaporated skim milk necessary to reach desired consistency. Form into ball and decorate with nuts and pimento. Chill.

recipes.title: Banana Nut Squares
directions: Combine flour, baking soda and salt.
Set aside.
In a separate bowl beat butter and brown sugar until light and fluffy. Add peanut butter, bananas, eggs and milk.
Beat well.
Add flour mixture and peanut granules, mixing until combined.
Spread evenly into lightly greased 18 x 26-inch bun pan.
Bake at 350° about 35 minutes or until center is firm.
Cool.
Dust with confectioners sugar if desired.
recipes.text: Banana Nut Squares. Combine flour, baking soda and salt. Set aside. In a separate bowl beat butter and brown sugar until light and fluffy. Add peanut butter, bananas, eggs and milk. Beat well. Add flour mixture and peanut granules, mixing until combined. Spread evenly into lightly greased 18 x 26-inch bun pan. Bake at 350° about 35 minutes or until center is firm. Cool. Dust with confectioners sugar if desired.

recipes.title: Combination Rolls
directions: Let milk come to boil, then cool before adding yeast.
Mix as you would for bread.
After the dough has risen three times, shape into rolls.
Place on a greased baking sheet.
Brush well with melted fat; cover and let rise again.
Then bake in a moderate oven (400° to 450°) for 15 to 20 minutes.
recipes.text: Combination Rolls. Let milk come to boil, then cool before adding yeast. Mix as you would for bread. After the dough has risen three times, shape into rolls. Place on a greased baking sheet. Brush well with melted fat; cover and let rise again. Then bake in a moderate oven (400° to 450°) for 15 to 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Shrimp Ball
ingredients: 1 small can shrimp or use fresh
directions: Let cream cheese soften.
Mix all ingredients except parsley. Roll into a ball.
Then roll in parsley.
Chill.
Serve with crackers.
recipes.text: Shrimp Ball. Let cream cheese soften. Mix all ingredients except parsley. Roll into a ball. Then roll in parsley. Chill. Serve with crackers.

recipes.title: Corned Beef Casserole
ingredients: 1/4 lb. sharp Cheddar cheese (you may use less)
directions: Mix all ingredients and place in a casserole dish.
Top with buttered bread crumbs.
Bake 1 hour at 300°.
Serves 8 to 10.
recipes.text: Corned Beef Casserole. Mix all ingredients and place in a casserole dish. Top with buttered bread crumbs. Bake 1 hour at 300°. Serves 8 to 10.

recipes.title: Sweet Potato Biscuits
directions: Cut Crisco into flour.
Add sweet potatoes and milk; stir until moistened.
Roll out dough on a lightly floured surface to 1/2-inch thickness.
Cut out biscuits with a 2-inch cutter and place on a lightly greased cookie sheet.
Bake at 450° for 12 minutes.
Yields 18 biscuits.
recipes.text: Sweet Potato Biscuits. Cut Crisco into flour. Add sweet potatoes and milk; stir until moistened. Roll out dough on a lightly floured surface to 1/2-inch thickness. Cut out biscuits with a 2-inch cutter and place on a lightly greased cookie sheet. Bake at 450° for 12 minutes. Yields 18 biscuits.

recipes.title: Zucchini Casserole
directions: Place sliced zucchini, onion and butter or margarine in skillet and brown.
Stir stewed tomatoes, spaghetti sauce mix and mushrooms together.
Gently stir into the zucchini mixture.
Pour into casserole dish and top with Mozzarella cheese.
Bake at 325° until cheese melts.
recipes.text: Zucchini Casserole. Place sliced zucchini, onion and butter or margarine in skillet and brown. Stir stewed tomatoes, spaghetti sauce mix and mushrooms together. Gently stir into the zucchini mixture. Pour into casserole dish and top with Mozzarella cheese. Bake at 325° until cheese melts.

recipes.title: Mayonnaise Cake
directions: Sprinkle soda over raisins.
Pour hot water over them.
Stir in sugar.
Break egg yolks in measuring cup; add to measuring cup with eggs enough mayonnaise to equal 3/4 cup.
Combine eggs, mayonnaise and sugar.
Stir in flour.
Save 1/2 cup flour and roll nuts in flour.
Add nuts to batter.
Bake in 3 layers at 325° until done.
Frost with 7-Minute Frosting or favorite frosting.
recipes.text: Mayonnaise Cake. Sprinkle soda over raisins. Pour hot water over them. Stir in sugar. Break egg yolks in measuring cup; add to measuring cup with eggs enough mayonnaise to equal 3/4 cup. Combine eggs, mayonnaise and sugar. Stir in flour. Save 1/2 cup flour and roll nuts in flour. Add nuts to batter. Bake in 3 layers at 325° until done. Frost with 7-Minute Frosting or favorite frosting.

recipes.title: Sherbet Punch
ingredients: 1 gallon Kool-aid (used 1/2 lemon and 1/2 lime) plus water and sugar
directions: Mix together prepared Kool-Aid and lemonade.
Chill.
Pour into punch bowl.
Spoon sherbet into mixture.
Pour 7-Up over. Serve.
Serves 25-30.
recipes.text: Sherbet Punch. Mix together prepared Kool-Aid and lemonade. Chill. Pour into punch bowl. Spoon sherbet into mixture. Pour 7-Up over. Serve. Serves 25-30.

recipes.title: Apple Bread
directions: Mix sugar, shortening, eggs and vanilla.
Stir in flour, baking powder, soda and salt.
Stir in apples and nuts.
Grease and flour a 9 x 5 x 3-inch pan.
Preheat oven to 350°.
Bake 60 to 65 minutes.
Sprinkle with 1 tablespoon sugar and 1/4 teaspoon cinnamon on top.
Store tightly in covered container.
Makes 1 loaf.
recipes.text: Apple Bread. Mix sugar, shortening, eggs and vanilla. Stir in flour, baking powder, soda and salt. Stir in apples and nuts. Grease and flour a 9 x 5 x 3-inch pan. Preheat oven to 350°. Bake 60 to 65 minutes. Sprinkle with 1 tablespoon sugar and 1/4 teaspoon cinnamon on top. Store tightly in covered container. Makes 1 loaf.

recipes.title: Divinity
directions: Combine sugar, syrup and water in saucepan; bring to a full rolling boil.
Slowly pour one-third of mixture over stiffly beaten egg whites, beating constantly.
Continue boiling remaining syrup mixture until it forms a hard ball when dropped in cold water.
Add remaining syrup gradually to egg mixture, beating constantly until cool and thickened.
Add vanilla flavoring and nuts; beat until mixture holds its shape.
Drop by spoonfuls onto waxed paper.
Cool thoroughly.
Yield:
Approximately 36 pieces.
recipes.text: Divinity. Combine sugar, syrup and water in saucepan; bring to a full rolling boil. Slowly pour one-third of mixture over stiffly beaten egg whites, beating constantly. Continue boiling remaining syrup mixture until it forms a hard ball when dropped in cold water. Add remaining syrup gradually to egg mixture, beating constantly until cool and thickened. Add vanilla flavoring and nuts; beat until mixture holds its shape. Drop by spoonfuls onto waxed paper. Cool thoroughly. Yield: Approximately 36 pieces.

recipes.title: Angel Biscuits
directions: Dissolve yeast in warm water.
Combine dry ingredients in a bowl.
Stir in yeast mixture, oil and buttermilk.
(If using shortening, cut into dry ingredients to resemble coarse cornmeal before adding yeast mixture and buttermilk.)
Keep dough in refrigerator up to two weeks.
recipes.text: Angel Biscuits. Dissolve yeast in warm water. Combine dry ingredients in a bowl. Stir in yeast mixture, oil and buttermilk. (If using shortening, cut into dry ingredients to resemble coarse cornmeal before adding yeast mixture and buttermilk.) Keep dough in refrigerator up to two weeks.

recipes.title: Seafood Pasta Salad
ingredients: 16 oz. tri-color corkscrew pasta, cooked and drained
2 lb. shrimp, cooked, shelled and deveined
2 lb. bay scallops, cooked and drained
1 large bottle Hidden Valley Ranch Italian Parmesan salad dressing
Old Bay seasoning, pepper, basil and oregano
directions: In a large bowl, combine pasta, celery, onion, seafood and olives.
Mix and coat well with salad dressing.
Add spices to taste.
Chill for several hours before serving.
recipes.text: Seafood Pasta Salad. In a large bowl, combine pasta, celery, onion, seafood and olives. Mix and coat well with salad dressing. Add spices to taste. Chill for several hours before serving.

recipes.title: Green Bean Salad
directions: Cook beans for approximately 8 minutes.
Rinse with cold water and transfer to bowl.
Combine shallots and vinegar gradually. Mix in oil.
Add basil.
Add enough dressing to beans to coat. Gently mix in 2/3 cup cheese.
Season with salt and pepper.
Top with cheese.
recipes.text: Green Bean Salad. Cook beans for approximately 8 minutes. Rinse with cold water and transfer to bowl. Combine shallots and vinegar gradually. Mix in oil. Add basil. Add enough dressing to beans to coat. Gently mix in 2/3 cup cheese. Season with salt and pepper. Top with cheese.

recipes.title: Clam Chowder
directions: Cut up fine or grind clams.
Dice potatoes.
Add onion, salt and pepper to taste.
Cook until potatoes are tender.
Fry bacon to crisp.
Remove bacon and pour essence in pot.
Let simmer for about 10 minutes.
recipes.text: Clam Chowder. Cut up fine or grind clams. Dice potatoes. Add onion, salt and pepper to taste. Cook until potatoes are tender. Fry bacon to crisp. Remove bacon and pour essence in pot. Let simmer for about 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Scalloped Corn
ingredients: 1 can whole kernel corn, well drained
directions: In a 2-quart casserole dish, mix all ingredients together until well blended.
Bake in oven at 350° for 45 to 50 minutes or until liquid is set and top is a golden brown.
Cool for 5 minutes before serving.
recipes.text: Scalloped Corn. In a 2-quart casserole dish, mix all ingredients together until well blended. Bake in oven at 350° for 45 to 50 minutes or until liquid is set and top is a golden brown. Cool for 5 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Pecan Pie
directions: Beat eggs slightly.
Add sugar, flour and margarine (melted). Add sugar and flavoring.
Add nuts and mix well, then pour into crust.
Bake at 325° for 45 or 50 minutes.
Makes a large pie.
recipes.text: Pecan Pie. Beat eggs slightly. Add sugar, flour and margarine (melted). Add sugar and flavoring. Add nuts and mix well, then pour into crust. Bake at 325° for 45 or 50 minutes. Makes a large pie.

recipes.title: Party Dogs
directions: You will need toothpicks.
recipes.text: Party Dogs. You will need toothpicks.

recipes.title: Onion Pie
directions: Combine cracker crumbs and butter and press into 8-inch deep dish pie pan.
Bake in preheated oven at 350° for about 8 minutes.
recipes.text: Onion Pie. Combine cracker crumbs and butter and press into 8-inch deep dish pie pan. Bake in preheated oven at 350° for about 8 minutes.

recipes.title: Enchilada Casserole
ingredients: 2 cans taco sauce (Old El Paso, 4 oz.)
directions: Fry hamburger with onions.
Drain meat.
Add soups, taco sauce and chilies.
Heat until hot.
Place a layer of tortillas in casserole dish.
Pour part of mixture on top.
Layer cheese, tortillas, meat mixture and cheese until everything is used.
End with cheese.
Place in 350° oven.
Bake until cheese is melted good.
recipes.text: Enchilada Casserole. Fry hamburger with onions. Drain meat. Add soups, taco sauce and chilies. Heat until hot. Place a layer of tortillas in casserole dish. Pour part of mixture on top. Layer cheese, tortillas, meat mixture and cheese until everything is used. End with cheese. Place in 350° oven. Bake until cheese is melted good.

recipes.title: Cheese Ball With Beef
ingredients: 1/4 c. chopped green onions or regular onions, finely chopped
1/4 c. fresh mushrooms or 1 small can mushrooms, finely chopped
1/4 c. black or green olives, chopped fine
directions: Let cheese soften.
Combine all ingredients with cheese and form into a ball.
Roll in parsley or pecans.
recipes.text: Cheese Ball With Beef. Let cheese soften. Combine all ingredients with cheese and form into a ball. Roll in parsley or pecans.

recipes.title: Piggy Wraps
directions: Cut sausage into desired shapes.
Wrap in dough.
Bake at 400° for 5 minutes or until golden brown. May be frozen.
recipes.text: Piggy Wraps. Cut sausage into desired shapes. Wrap in dough. Bake at 400° for 5 minutes or until golden brown. May be frozen.

recipes.title: Texas Sheet Cake
directions: Bring water, butter and cocoa to a boil. Remove from heat and add flour, sugar and salt. Beat in eggs, sour cream and baking soda. Bake at 350° in a 15 1/2 x 12 1/2 x 1-inch pan for 25 to 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Texas Sheet Cake. Bring water, butter and cocoa to a boil. Remove from heat and add flour, sugar and salt. Beat in eggs, sour cream and baking soda. Bake at 350° in a 15 1/2 x 12 1/2 x 1-inch pan for 25 to 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Busy Day Casserole
directions: In medium bowl mix rice, soup, water, salt and pepper.
Pour into greased casserole dish.
Place pork chops on top of rice mixture, sprinkle with paprika.
Cover dish with foil and bake at 350° for 45 minutes.
Remove foil and return to oven for 10 minutes longer to brown chops.
recipes.text: Busy Day Casserole. In medium bowl mix rice, soup, water, salt and pepper. Pour into greased casserole dish. Place pork chops on top of rice mixture, sprinkle with paprika. Cover dish with foil and bake at 350° for 45 minutes. Remove foil and return to oven for 10 minutes longer to brown chops.

recipes.title: Ham Glaze
directions: Mix together.
Brush on ham before cooking and then again during cooking.
Yummy!
recipes.text: Ham Glaze. Mix together. Brush on ham before cooking and then again during cooking. Yummy!

recipes.title: Mexican Cornbread
directions: Mix all ingredients except cheese. Pour half of batter into hot greased 10 1/2-inch cast-iron skillet. Sprinkle cheese. Then pour remaining batter. Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes.
recipes.text: Mexican Cornbread. Mix all ingredients except cheese. Pour half of batter into hot greased 10 1/2-inch cast-iron skillet. Sprinkle cheese. Then pour remaining batter. Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Strawberry Pie
directions: Mix 1 cup strawberries in blender or slice thinly.
Mix sugar and cornstarch in 2-quart saucepan.
Stir in water until smooth. Add blended berries.
Cook over medium heat until thick and clear, stirring constantly.
Cool.
Stir in remaining berries.
Pour in shell and chill for 3 hours.
Garnish with whipped cream or Cool Whip.
recipes.text: Strawberry Pie. Mix 1 cup strawberries in blender or slice thinly. Mix sugar and cornstarch in 2-quart saucepan. Stir in water until smooth. Add blended berries. Cook over medium heat until thick and clear, stirring constantly. Cool. Stir in remaining berries. Pour in shell and chill for 3 hours. Garnish with whipped cream or Cool Whip.

recipes.title: Barley Vegetable Soup
directions: Brown hamburger and drain.
Prepare all veggies for the soup. Mix all together; cook about 30 minutes after it comes to a boil or until veggies are tender.
recipes.text: Barley Vegetable Soup. Brown hamburger and drain. Prepare all veggies for the soup. Mix all together; cook about 30 minutes after it comes to a boil or until veggies are tender.

recipes.title: Simply Sinful Casserole
directions: Mix soups, margarine and milk together in a large pot.
Add Velveeta (cut in small pieces) and heat to melt cheese, stirring constantly.
Cook the cavatelli noodles as directed on package. Thaw the broccoli. Add these last 2 ingredients to cheese sauce. Put into casserole dish and bake at 350° for 45 minutes to 1 hour.
recipes.text: Simply Sinful Casserole. Mix soups, margarine and milk together in a large pot. Add Velveeta (cut in small pieces) and heat to melt cheese, stirring constantly. Cook the cavatelli noodles as directed on package. Thaw the broccoli. Add these last 2 ingredients to cheese sauce. Put into casserole dish and bake at 350° for 45 minutes to 1 hour.

recipes.title: Faye'S Pecan Pie
directions: Beat eggs well. Add white Karo and dark Karo to eggs. Melt butter and add to mixture. Blend well. Fold in chopped pecans. Pour into pie crust and bake at 350° for about 1 hour or until medium brown and center of pie is set.
recipes.text: Faye'S Pecan Pie. Beat eggs well. Add white Karo and dark Karo to eggs. Melt butter and add to mixture. Blend well. Fold in chopped pecans. Pour into pie crust and bake at 350° for about 1 hour or until medium brown and center of pie is set.

recipes.title: Sourdough Bread Recipe
directions: In a large bowl, make a stiff batter of ingredients.
Use plastic instead of metal bowls.
Grease another bowl.
Put dough in and turn over to put oiled side up.
Cover lightly with Saran Wrap to set overnight.
(Do not put in refrigerator.)
This dough will raise up a lot so use a very large bowl.
The next morning, punch down and knead a little.
Divide into 2 parts.
Knead each part on a floured board a few times, 8 to 10 times.
recipes.text: Sourdough Bread Recipe. In a large bowl, make a stiff batter of ingredients. Use plastic instead of metal bowls. Grease another bowl. Put dough in and turn over to put oiled side up. Cover lightly with Saran Wrap to set overnight. (Do not put in refrigerator.) This dough will raise up a lot so use a very large bowl. The next morning, punch down and knead a little. Divide into 2 parts. Knead each part on a floured board a few times, 8 to 10 times.

recipes.title: Grandma Austin'S Custard Pie
directions: Pour into unbaked crust and bake until firm at 350°.
recipes.text: Grandma Austin'S Custard Pie. Pour into unbaked crust and bake until firm at 350°.

recipes.title: Layered Hot Dish
directions: Brown ground beef and onion.
Drain.
Put in casserole (first layer), then layer other ingredients.
Add water.
Cook on top of stove for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Layered Hot Dish. Brown ground beef and onion. Drain. Put in casserole (first layer), then layer other ingredients. Add water. Cook on top of stove for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Brownies
ingredients: 1/4 to 1/2 c. chopped nuts (pecan or walnut)
directions: Melt the chocolate and margarine in a pan.
Beat eggs.
Fold the sugar and melted chocolate mixture into the beaten eggs.
Add flour, baking powder, salt, vanilla and nuts.
Bake in a 8 x 8-inch pan at 350° for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Brownies. Melt the chocolate and margarine in a pan. Beat eggs. Fold the sugar and melted chocolate mixture into the beaten eggs. Add flour, baking powder, salt, vanilla and nuts. Bake in a 8 x 8-inch pan at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Apple Crisp Or Paradise
ingredients: 7 or 8 large apples, peeled, cored and sliced
directions: Slice the apples into a 7 x 7-inch pan.
Dot with butter; sprinkle with lemon juice.
With pastry blender, blend the remaining ingredients; mix well.
Spread over apples.
Bake at 375° for 30 minutes, or until crisp as desired.
recipes.text: Apple Crisp Or Paradise. Slice the apples into a 7 x 7-inch pan. Dot with butter; sprinkle with lemon juice. With pastry blender, blend the remaining ingredients; mix well. Spread over apples. Bake at 375° for 30 minutes, or until crisp as desired.

recipes.title: Persimmon Cookies
directions: In a bowl, combine flour, baking soda and spices.
In a second bowl or food processor, cream the butter, sugar, orange rind and egg.
Combine the dry ingredients with the creamed mixture. Lightly mix in the persimmon pulp.
Drop the batter by the tablespoonful on a greased cookie sheet.
Sprinkle with anise seed and bake for 15 to 20 minutes at 350°.
Yields approximately 3 dozen cookies.
recipes.text: Persimmon Cookies. In a bowl, combine flour, baking soda and spices. In a second bowl or food processor, cream the butter, sugar, orange rind and egg. Combine the dry ingredients with the creamed mixture. Lightly mix in the persimmon pulp. Drop the batter by the tablespoonful on a greased cookie sheet. Sprinkle with anise seed and bake for 15 to 20 minutes at 350°. Yields approximately 3 dozen cookies.

recipes.title: Quick Brown Bread
directions: Preheat oven to 350°. Mix flour, sugar, salt and soda together. Add buttermilk. Pour batter into greased and floured 8-ounce coffee cans. Fill half full. Bake 45 to 60 minutes. Remove from can and cool. Use coffee cans or loaf pans; loaf pans will be longer to bake.
recipes.text: Quick Brown Bread. Preheat oven to 350°. Mix flour, sugar, salt and soda together. Add buttermilk. Pour batter into greased and floured 8-ounce coffee cans. Fill half full.
