Bake 45 to 60 minutes. Remove from can and cool. Use coffee cans or loaf pans; loaf pans will be longer to bake.

recipes.title: Meatball Parmigiana(Serves 6)
directions: In large skillet, heat oil.
Saute onions until soft.
Add tomatoes with liquid.
Add spaghetti sauce.
Simmer uncovered while making meatballs.
Combine 1/4 cup water, bread crumbs, meat, 1/4 cup Parmesan cheese, oregano, salt and pepper.
Mix thoroughly and form into 24 small meatballs.
Add meatballs to sauce and simmer 15 minutes while cooking noodles.
Drain noodles. Put noodles in 13 x 9-inch pan.
Cover with meatballs and most of sauce.
Cover with cheese slices.
Pour on rest of sauce and sprinkle with Parmesan cheese.
Bake for 20 minutes at 350° until golden brown.
recipes.text: Meatball Parmigiana(Serves 6). In large skillet, heat oil. Saute onions until soft. Add tomatoes with liquid. Add spaghetti sauce. Simmer uncovered while making meatballs. Combine 1/4 cup water, bread crumbs, meat, 1/4 cup Parmesan cheese, oregano, salt and pepper. Mix thoroughly and form into 24 small meatballs. Add meatballs to sauce and simmer 15 minutes while cooking noodles. Drain noodles. Put noodles in 13 x 9-inch pan. Cover with meatballs and most of sauce. Cover with cheese slices. Pour on rest of sauce and sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Bake for 20 minutes at 350° until golden brown.

recipes.title: Green Bean Casserole
ingredients: 2 (10 3/4 oz.) cans condensed cream of mushroom soup (undiluted)
2 (16 oz.) pkg. frozen whole or cut green beans, cooked and drained
directions: In mixing bowl combine soup, milk, soy sauce and pepper. Gently stir in beans.
Spoon half of the mixture into a 12 x 8 x 2-inch baking dish.
Sprinkle with half of the onions.
Spoon remaining bean mixture over the top.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until heated through.
Sprinkle with remaining onions.
Return to oven for 5 minutes or until onions are brown and crispy. Yields 10 servings.
recipes.text: Green Bean Casserole. In mixing bowl combine soup, milk, soy sauce and pepper. Gently stir in beans. Spoon half of the mixture into a 12 x 8 x 2-inch baking dish. Sprinkle with half of the onions. Spoon remaining bean mixture over the top. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until heated through. Sprinkle with remaining onions. Return to oven for 5 minutes or until onions are brown and crispy. Yields 10 servings.

recipes.title: Cocktail Wieners
directions: Cut up wieners into bite size pieces.
Mix together mustard and jelly; heat.
Pour the mixture over the wieners.
Cook in crock-pot on low for 2 to 3 hours.
recipes.text: Cocktail Wieners. Cut up wieners into bite size pieces. Mix together mustard and jelly; heat. Pour the mixture over the wieners. Cook in crock-pot on low for 2 to 3 hours.

recipes.title: Salmon Party Log
directions: Drain salmon, bone and skin.
Mix thoroughly the next 5 ingredients.
Chill for several hours.
Shape into a log; garnish with parsley.
Serve with party crackers.
recipes.text: Salmon Party Log. Drain salmon, bone and skin. Mix thoroughly the next 5 ingredients. Chill for several hours. Shape into a log; garnish with parsley. Serve with party crackers.

recipes.title: Pork Chop Lula'S Scalloped Oysters
ingredients: 3/4 c. cracker crumbs (I use Waverly Wafers)
directions: Drain oysters.
Combine the bread and cracker crumbs, salt, pepper and butter.
Sprinkle 1/3 of the buttered, seasoned crumbs in a well-greased, round (8 x 2-inch) baking dish.
Cover with a layer of oysters.
Repeat layers.
Add Worcestershire sauce to milk and pour over oysters.
Then sprinkle remaining crumbs over top of casserole.
Bake at 400° for 20 to 25 minutes or until golden brown.
Serves 6.
recipes.text: Pork Chop Lula'S Scalloped Oysters. Drain oysters. Combine the bread and cracker crumbs, salt, pepper and butter. Sprinkle 1/3 of the buttered, seasoned crumbs in a well-greased, round (8 x 2-inch) baking dish. Cover with a layer of oysters. Repeat layers. Add Worcestershire sauce to milk and pour over oysters. Then sprinkle remaining crumbs over top of casserole. Bake at 400° for 20 to 25 minutes or until golden brown. Serves 6.

recipes.title: Birdie Cake
directions: Combine all ingredients; beat well.
Pour into a greased and floured 13 x 15-inch pan.
Bake at 325° for 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Birdie Cake. Combine all ingredients; beat well. Pour into a greased and floured 13 x 15-inch pan. Bake at 325° for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Mudgie'S Coconut Pie
directions: Mix well and pour into unbaked pie shell.
Bake until brown on top at 350° to 375°.
recipes.text: Mudgie'S Coconut Pie. Mix well and pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake until brown on top at 350° to 375°.

recipes.title: Mashed Potato Candy
directions: Mix all ingredients; let stand in refrigerator for 20 to 30 minutes.
Form small balls; chill overnight.
Dip in melted Hershey bars or almond bark.
recipes.text: Mashed Potato Candy. Mix all ingredients; let stand in refrigerator for 20 to 30 minutes. Form small balls; chill overnight. Dip in melted Hershey bars or almond bark.

recipes.title: Party Sausage Balls
directions: Mix all together in bowl.
Then make round balls, size of walnuts.
Place on cookie sheets.
Bake at 350° for 15 minutes. Then turn them over and bake 10 minutes more.
Drain on paper towels.
recipes.text: Party Sausage Balls. Mix all together in bowl. Then make round balls, size of walnuts. Place on cookie sheets. Bake at 350° for 15 minutes. Then turn them over and bake 10 minutes more. Drain on paper towels.

recipes.title: Christmas Boiled Custard
directions: Put milk in double boiler and when thoroughly heated, add eggs, sugar and salt which have been previously mixed together. Cook approximately 10 minutes or longer, stirring constantly.
Do not overcook as milk will curdle.
Custard is done when it coats a wooden spoon.
Add vanilla to taste.
My dad usually added something a little stronger.
Chill as cold as possible.
Also, good over vanilla ice cream.
recipes.text: Christmas Boiled Custard. Put milk in double boiler and when thoroughly heated, add eggs, sugar and salt which have been previously mixed together. Cook approximately 10 minutes or longer, stirring constantly. Do not overcook as milk will curdle. Custard is done when it coats a wooden spoon. Add vanilla to taste. My dad usually added something a little stronger. Chill as cold as possible. Also, good over vanilla ice cream.

recipes.title: Poppy Seed Dressing
directions: Process on low for 30 seconds in blender.
Chill.
recipes.text: Poppy Seed Dressing. Process on low for 30 seconds in blender. Chill.

recipes.title: Cheesecake Cupcakes
directions: Mix together first 4 ingredients and fill cupcake papers, with cookie on bottom, about 2/3 full.
Bake at 350° for 11 to 14 minutes.
Top with cherries.
recipes.text: Cheesecake Cupcakes. Mix together first 4 ingredients and fill cupcake papers, with cookie on bottom, about 2/3 full. Bake at 350° for 11 to 14 minutes. Top with cherries.

recipes.title: Hungarian Goulash
directions: Cut meat into 1 to 1 1/2-inch pieces.
Prepare quick meat broth and set aside.
Dice bacon and place into pot.
Cook slowly, stirring and turning frequently, until bacon is lightly brown. Remove bacon with slotted spoon from saucepot to small bowl and set aside.
Add chopped onion to bacon fat and cook over medium heat until onion is almost tender.
Remove onion with slotted spoon to bowl containing bacon and set aside.
Add meat to bacon fat and slowly brown on all sides, stirring occasionally. Sprinkle evenly over meat a mixture of paprika, salt, pepper and marjoram.
Stir in bacon-onion mixture.
Slowly pour in meat broth and wine.
Bring to boiling.
Reduce heat, cover and simmer 2 to 2 1/2 hours or until meat is tender.
Remove meat with slotted spoon to thicken liquid.
Mix cornstarch with about 1/2 cup water and add to liquid.
Let boil for 5 to 6 minutes.
Add meat.
Serve over noodles.
recipes.text: Hungarian Goulash. Cut meat into 1 to 1 1/2-inch pieces. Prepare quick meat broth and set aside. Dice bacon and place into pot. Cook slowly, stirring and turning frequently, until bacon is lightly brown. Remove bacon with slotted spoon from saucepot to small bowl and set aside. Add chopped onion to bacon fat and cook over medium heat until onion is almost tender. Remove onion with slotted spoon to bowl containing bacon and set aside. Add meat to bacon fat and slowly brown on all sides, stirring occasionally. Sprinkle evenly over meat a mixture of paprika, salt, pepper and marjoram. Stir in bacon-onion mixture. Slowly pour in meat broth and wine. Bring to boiling. Reduce heat, cover and simmer 2 to 2 1/2 hours or until meat is tender. Remove meat with slotted spoon to thicken liquid. Mix cornstarch with about 1/2 cup water and add to liquid. Let boil for 5 to 6 minutes. Add meat. Serve over noodles.

recipes.title: Cheese Ball
directions: Mix all ingredients together and roll in pecans.
Makes about 1 1/2 cups.
recipes.text: Cheese Ball. Mix all ingredients together and roll in pecans. Makes about 1 1/2 cups.

recipes.title: 24 Hour Salad
ingredients: 1 large bottle Hidden Valley Ranch dressing
directions: Early in the day, put all ingredients in a large bowl, one layer at a time, in the order given.
Cover and refrigerate.
Toss just before serving.
recipes.text: 24 Hour Salad. Early in the day, put all ingredients in a large bowl, one layer at a time, in the order given. Cover and refrigerate. Toss just before serving.

recipes.title: Quick Rice Pudding
ingredients: 1/2 c. whipped cream or Cool Whip
directions: Add sugar to cooked rice.
In medium saucepan, combine dessert mix and milk.
Bring to a boil, stirring occasionally.
Stir in rice mixture and raisins.
Let cool, stirring occasionally.
Pour into 6 dessert cups.
Refrigerate until firm.
Garnish with whipped cream or Cool Whip.
recipes.text: Quick Rice Pudding. Add sugar to cooked rice. In medium saucepan, combine dessert mix and milk. Bring to a boil, stirring occasionally. Stir in rice mixture and raisins. Let cool, stirring occasionally. Pour into 6 dessert cups. Refrigerate until firm. Garnish with whipped cream or Cool Whip.

recipes.title: Make Ahead Mashed Potatoes
directions: Boil potatoes with 1 whole onion until potatoes are done. Discard onion.
Mash potatoes with cream cheese, sour cream, salt and pepper.
If dry, add a little milk and 1 beaten egg. Refrigerate in buttered dish.
Dot with butter on top. Cover while refrigerated.
Bring to room temperature.
Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 45 minutes.
Serves 8.
recipes.text: Make Ahead Mashed Potatoes. Boil potatoes with 1 whole onion until potatoes are done. Discard onion. Mash potatoes with cream cheese, sour cream, salt and pepper. If dry, add a little milk and 1 beaten egg. Refrigerate in buttered dish. Dot with butter on top. Cover while refrigerated. Bring to room temperature. Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 45 minutes. Serves 8.

recipes.title: Lime Pear Jello Salad
ingredients: 1 can pears, mashed, drain, retain juice
1 pkg. Dream Whip or 1 c. whipping cream
directions: Put jello in boiling water. Add cream cheese and dissolve. Add juice of pears; mix. Place in refrigerator and let partially congeal.
Remove and beat.
Add mashed pears, nuts and Dream Whip. Blender may be used.
recipes.text: Lime Pear Jello Salad. Put jello in boiling water. Add cream cheese and dissolve. Add juice of pears; mix. Place in refrigerator and let partially congeal. Remove and beat. Add mashed pears, nuts and Dream Whip. Blender may be used.

recipes.title: Broccoli Cornbread
directions: Mix all ingredients together.
Pour into 9 x 15-inch pan. Bake at 400° for 40 to 50 minutes.
recipes.text: Broccoli Cornbread. Mix all ingredients together. Pour into 9 x 15-inch pan. Bake at 400° for 40 to 50 minutes.

recipes.title: Long Island Cheesecake
directions: Mix together 1 egg and 1 package cream cheese.
Repeat with second egg and cream cheese, etc.
Mix thoroughly after each addition.
Add vanilla, lemon juice and sugar; beat well.
Stir in chocolate chips.
Pour into lightly greased 8-inch spring-form pan.
Bake in a preheated 400° oven for 30 minutes.
Turn off oven and leave cheesecake in oven until oven is cold (can be overnight if necessary).
Remove from pan onto a serving plate.
recipes.text: Long Island Cheesecake. Mix together 1 egg and 1 package cream cheese. Repeat with second egg and cream cheese, etc. Mix thoroughly after each addition. Add vanilla, lemon juice and sugar; beat well. Stir in chocolate chips. Pour into lightly greased 8-inch spring-form pan. Bake in a preheated 400° oven for 30 minutes. Turn off oven and leave cheesecake in oven until oven is cold (can be overnight if necessary). Remove from pan onto a serving plate.

recipes.title: Hook'S Cafeteria Brownies
directions: Mix together all dry ingredients.
Then add remaining ingredients.
Bake in a 375° oven until done.
recipes.text: Hook'S Cafeteria Brownies. Mix together all dry ingredients. Then add remaining ingredients. Bake in a 375° oven until done.

recipes.title: Butterfinger Cookies
directions: Sift together flour, soda and salt.
Cream together margarine and sugar until light and fluffy.
Beat in egg.
Stir in crushed Butterfinger pieces and dry ingredients.
Add vanilla and blend well.
Chill dough for 30 minutes.
Drop by tablespoons onto greased cookie sheet.
Bake in moderate 350° oven 10 to 12 minutes.
Makes about 3 1/2 dozen.
recipes.text: Butterfinger Cookies. Sift together flour, soda and salt. Cream together margarine and sugar until light and fluffy. Beat in egg. Stir in crushed Butterfinger pieces and dry ingredients. Add vanilla and blend well. Chill dough for 30 minutes. Drop by tablespoons onto greased cookie sheet. Bake in moderate 350° oven 10 to 12 minutes. Makes about 3 1/2 dozen.

recipes.title: Oscar'S Hot Sauce
directions: Pour juice from tomatoes into blender container.
Add onion, peppers and seasonings.
Blend to liquefy.
Add tomatoes.
Blend. Store in glass jar in refrigerator.
recipes.text: Oscar'S Hot Sauce. Pour juice from tomatoes into blender container. Add onion, peppers and seasonings. Blend to liquefy. Add tomatoes. Blend. Store in glass jar in refrigerator.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Bread
directions: Heat oven to 350°.
Grease two 9 x 5 x 3-inch or three 8 1/2 x 4 1/2 x 2 1/2-inch or four 7 1/2 x 3 3/4 x 2 1/4-inch loaf pans. In large bowl cream shortening and sugar until fluffy.
Stir in eggs, pumpkin and water.
Blend in flour, baking soda, baking powder, cinnamon and cloves.
Stir in nuts and raisins.
Pour into pans.
Bake about 70 minutes or until wooden toothpick inserted in center comes out clean.
recipes.text: Pumpkin Bread. Heat oven to 350°. Grease two 9 x 5 x 3-inch or three 8 1/2 x 4 1/2 x 2 1/2-inch or four 7 1/2 x 3 3/4 x 2 1/4-inch loaf pans. In large bowl cream shortening and sugar until fluffy. Stir in eggs, pumpkin and water. Blend in flour, baking soda, baking powder, cinnamon and cloves. Stir in nuts and raisins. Pour into pans. Bake about 70 minutes or until wooden toothpick inserted in center comes out clean.

recipes.title: Sweet-N-Sour Franks
directions: In a medium saucepan, mix jelly, mustard, onion and Worcestershire sauce; bring to a boil.
Add frank, reduce heat and simmer 15 minutes.
recipes.text: Sweet-N-Sour Franks. In a medium saucepan, mix jelly, mustard, onion and Worcestershire sauce; bring to a boil. Add frank, reduce heat and simmer 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Quick Peach Pie
directions: Melt 1 stick of margarine and place in bottom of pan.
Add flour mixture, then the peach mixture.
Peel peaches.
Add sugar; let set overnight in refrigerator.
Bake at 400° until done.
recipes.text: Quick Peach Pie. Melt 1 stick of margarine and place in bottom of pan. Add flour mixture, then the peach mixture. Peel peaches. Add sugar; let set overnight in refrigerator. Bake at 400° until done.

recipes.title: El Dorado Casserole
ingredients: 3 to 4 chopped chilies or small can diced chilies
directions: Using taco seasoning, prepare meat following package directions.
Add tomato sauce.
Combine sour cream, cottage cheese, chilies and olives in a bowl.
Crush 1/2 package of chips and put in bottom of 9 x 13-inch casserole dish.
Add 1/2 meat mixture, 1/2 cheese mixture and 1 cup shredded Monterey Jack cheese.
Repeat layers, finishing with Monterey Jack cheese.
Top with crushed chips and bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
Pour wine over chicken and return to oven for 30 minutes.
Serves 4.
recipes.text: El Dorado Casserole. Using taco seasoning, prepare meat following package directions. Add tomato sauce. Combine sour cream, cottage cheese, chilies and olives in a bowl. Crush 1/2 package of chips and put in bottom of 9 x 13-inch casserole dish. Add 1/2 meat mixture, 1/2 cheese mixture and 1 cup shredded Monterey Jack cheese. Repeat layers, finishing with Monterey Jack cheese. Top with crushed chips and bake at 350° for 30 minutes. Pour wine over chicken and return to oven for 30 minutes. Serves 4.

recipes.title: Pork Chop 'N Potato Bake
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream of celery soup
directions: Brown pork chops in lightly greased skillet.
Combine soup, milk, sour cream, salt and pepper.
Stir in potatoes, 1/2 cup cheese and 1/2 can onions.
Spoon into a 13 x 9-inch baking dish. Arrange pork chops over potatoes.
Bake, covered, in a 350° oven for 40 minutes.
Top with remaining cheese and onions.
Bake, uncovered, 5 minutes longer.
Makes 6 servings.
recipes.text: Pork Chop 'N Potato Bake. Brown pork chops in lightly greased skillet. Combine soup, milk, sour cream, salt and pepper. Stir in potatoes, 1/2 cup cheese and 1/2 can onions. Spoon into a 13 x 9-inch baking dish. Arrange pork chops over potatoes. Bake, covered, in a 350° oven for 40 minutes. Top with remaining cheese and onions. Bake, uncovered, 5 minutes longer. Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Rice Pudding
directions: Combine rice, milk and margarine and boil for 1 hour in a double boiler, stirring occasionally. Mix together the eggs, sugar, salt and vanilla and stir into the hot mixture. Pour into an oven-safe dish and bake at 350° for 40 minutes with the pan set in hot water. Stir once after 15 minutes and sprinkle with cinnamon.
Raisins can be added.
recipes.text: Rice Pudding. Combine rice, milk and margarine and boil for 1 hour in a double boiler, stirring occasionally. Mix together the eggs, sugar, salt and vanilla and stir into the hot mixture. Pour into an oven-safe dish and bake at 350° for 40 minutes with the pan set in hot water. Stir once after 15 minutes and sprinkle with cinnamon. Raisins can be added.

recipes.title: Irish Soda Bread
directions: Sift dry ingredients.
Add raisins; coat with flour.
Add remaining ingredients; stir until well blended.
Pour into greased and floured layer cake pan.
Bake at 375° for 60 minutes.
recipes.text: Irish Soda Bread. Sift dry ingredients. Add raisins; coat with flour. Add remaining ingredients; stir until well blended. Pour into greased and floured layer cake pan. Bake at 375° for 60 minutes.

recipes.title: Creamy Mashed Potatoes
ingredients: 8 to 10 medium potatoes (can also use 6 to 8)
onions to taste (about 1 Tbsp.), chopped finely
directions: Peel potatoes.
Cook and mash.
Add cream cheese, egg and onions.
Bake until fluffy or about 30 minutes at 350°.
recipes.text: Creamy Mashed Potatoes. Peel potatoes. Cook and mash. Add cream cheese, egg and onions. Bake until fluffy or about 30 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Mama'S Summer Tomato Pie
ingredients: 2 c. tomatoes, peeled, seeded and chopped
1 tsp. fresh basil, cut in thin strips
1 (4 oz.) pkg. Ukrops shredded Cheddar cheese
directions: Bake empty pie shell at 350° for 5 - 6 minutes, do not brown. Combine tomatoes, salt, basil, lemon pepper, and place in pie shell.
Mix Cheddar cheese and mayonnaise and spoon over tomatoes. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Mama'S Summer Tomato Pie. Bake empty pie shell at 350° for 5 - 6 minutes, do not brown. Combine tomatoes, salt, basil, lemon pepper, and place in pie shell. Mix Cheddar cheese and mayonnaise and spoon over tomatoes. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Unstuffed Cabbage Soup
ingredients: 1 (28 oz.) can peeled tomatoes with juice
directions: Combine soup ingredients in large heavy pot and bring to a boil over medium high heat while preparing meatballs.
recipes.text: Unstuffed Cabbage Soup. Combine soup ingredients in large heavy pot and bring to a boil over medium high heat while preparing meatballs.

recipes.title: Taco Dip
ingredients: 16 oz. El Paso mild taco sauce
directions: Combine first three ingredients and spread on cookie sheet. Spread taco sauce on top of mixture.
Spread onion, lettuce, chopped tomatoes and shredded cheese on top of mixture.
recipes.text: Taco Dip. Combine first three ingredients and spread on cookie sheet. Spread taco sauce on top of mixture. Spread onion, lettuce, chopped tomatoes and shredded cheese on top of mixture.

recipes.title: Fruit Salad Deluxe(Quick And Delicious!)
ingredients: 1 (16 oz.) can dark sweet pitted cherries, drained
1 (3 oz.) pkg. dry banana instant pudding mix
directions: In large bowl, combine all fruit.
With electric mixer, blend sour cream, sugar and vanilla until sugar is dissolved.
Pour over fruit and stir.
Stir in instant pudding mix and blend.
Fold in marshmallows; chill and serve.
Recipe makes 8 servings.
Fat-free.
recipes.text: Fruit Salad Deluxe(Quick And Delicious!). In large bowl, combine all fruit. With electric mixer, blend sour cream, sugar and vanilla until sugar is dissolved. Pour over fruit and stir. Stir in instant pudding mix and blend. Fold in marshmallows; chill and serve. Recipe makes 8 servings. Fat-free.

recipes.title: Lentil Shepherd'S Pie
ingredients: 1 c. dried green or brown lentils
2 large onions, peeled and thinly sliced
a little extra butter or vegan margarine
directions: Put the washed lentils into a large saucepan.
Cover with water and boil gently until tender, about 45 minutes.
Drain. Preheat oven to 400°.
Use 1/2 of the butter or vegan margarine to grease a shallow ovenproof dish.
Saute the onions in the remaining butter or vegan magarine in a large saucepan for 10 minutes.
Add the garlic, mixed herbs, tomatoes, soy sauce, lentils, parsley, salt and pepper.
Spoon the mixture into the dish.
Spread the mashed potatoes evenly over the top, drawing the prongs of the fork over the surface to make ridges.
Dot the whole surface with a little butter or vegan margarine.
Bake for 45 minutes until golden brown.
recipes.text: Lentil Shepherd'S Pie. Put the washed lentils into a large saucepan. Cover with water and boil gently until tender, about 45 minutes. Drain. Preheat oven to 400°. Use 1/2 of the butter or vegan margarine to grease a shallow ovenproof dish. Saute the onions in the remaining butter or vegan magarine in a large saucepan for 10 minutes. Add the garlic, mixed herbs, tomatoes, soy sauce, lentils, parsley, salt and pepper. Spoon the mixture into the dish. Spread the mashed potatoes evenly over the top, drawing the prongs of the fork over the surface to make ridges. Dot the whole surface with a little butter or vegan margarine. Bake for 45 minutes until golden brown.

recipes.title: Baked Beans
directions: Cut bacon into small strips and fry it.
Pour off grease. Dice onion into small pieces.
Warm the pork and beans in a kettle.
Add all ingredients; warm until hot.
Bake in a 350° oven for 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Baked Beans. Cut bacon into small strips and fry it. Pour off grease. Dice onion into small pieces. Warm the pork and beans in a kettle. Add all ingredients; warm until hot. Bake in a 350° oven for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Sweet Potato Sun Wheels
directions: Boil sweet potatoes; peel and mash.
Beat potatoes until smooth.
Add egg, butter, sugar and vanilla.
Slice each pineapple ring to make 2 thin rings.
(Rings may break, but merely put together in a circle.
Also, it helps to freeze the pineapple before slicing.)
Place 8 thin rings of pineapple in a baking pan and place a mound of the potato mixture on each slice of pineapple.
Cover with the remaining 8 rings.
Bake at 325° until heated (about 30 minutes).
Remove and sprinkle with coconut. Place in oven to brown coconut or in broiler, watching carefully to avoid burning coconut.
Serves 8.
recipes.text: Sweet Potato Sun Wheels. Boil sweet potatoes; peel and mash. Beat potatoes until smooth. Add egg, butter, sugar and vanilla. Slice each pineapple ring to make 2 thin rings. (Rings may break, but merely put together in a circle. Also, it helps to freeze the pineapple before slicing.) Place 8 thin rings of pineapple in a baking pan and place a mound of the potato mixture on each slice of pineapple. Cover with the remaining 8 rings. Bake at 325° until heated (about 30 minutes). Remove and sprinkle with coconut. Place in oven to brown coconut or in broiler, watching carefully to avoid burning coconut. Serves 8.

recipes.title: Mackerel-Noodle Bake
ingredients: 1 (16 oz.) can peas, drained or 1 (10 oz.) pkg. frozen peas, cooked and drained
1 (15 oz.) can mackerel or 1 (16 oz.) can pink salmon, drained, bones and skin removed and flaked
2 oz. process American cheese, shredded (1/2 c.)
directions: Cook celery and onion in 2 tablespoons water, covered, until tender, 5 to 7 minutes.
Combine with next 4 ingredients, 3/4 teaspoon salt and 1/8 teaspoon pepper.
Turn into a 2-quart casserole. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
Top with cheese.
Bake 5 minutes.
Makes 6 to 8 servings.
recipes.text: Mackerel-Noodle Bake. Cook celery and onion in 2 tablespoons water, covered, until tender, 5 to 7 minutes. Combine with next 4 ingredients, 3/4 teaspoon salt and 1/8 teaspoon pepper. Turn into a 2-quart casserole. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes. Top with cheese. Bake 5 minutes. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

recipes.title: Banana Split Cake
ingredients: 1 (20 oz.) can crushed pineapple, well drained
directions: Make a crust with graham crackers and margarine.
Combine sugar, eggs, vanilla and soft margarine and beat for 15 minutes with mixer.
Spread on crust; add bananas and pineapple.
Spread Cool Whip on top and decorate with nuts and cherries. Refrigerate!
recipes.text: Banana Split Cake. Make a crust with graham crackers and margarine. Combine sugar, eggs, vanilla and soft margarine and beat for 15 minutes with mixer. Spread on crust; add bananas and pineapple. Spread Cool Whip on top and decorate with nuts and cherries. Refrigerate!

recipes.title: Tamale Pie
directions: In a medium bowl, blend corn meal, baking powder and flour. Stir in water, egg and 1 cup cheese.
Spread 1/2 of the corn meal mixture in a 9-inch greased pie plate. Set aside.
recipes.text: Tamale Pie. In a medium bowl, blend corn meal, baking powder and flour. Stir in water, egg and 1 cup cheese. Spread 1/2 of the corn meal mixture in a 9-inch greased pie plate. Set aside.

recipes.title: Macaroni Salad
directions: Cook, drain and rinse macaroni.
Drain fruit.
Mix all together and chill.
Serves 10 to 12.
Keeps well.
recipes.text: Macaroni Salad. Cook, drain and rinse macaroni. Drain fruit. Mix all together and chill. Serves 10 to 12. Keeps well.

recipes.title: Chicken Ala King
directions: Melt butter, blend in flour, salt and pepper.
Gradually stir in broth.
Heat and stir until thick.
Add all other ingredients. Serve over pastry shells.
recipes.text: Chicken Ala King. Melt butter, blend in flour, salt and pepper. Gradually stir in broth. Heat and stir until thick. Add all other ingredients. Serve over pastry shells.

recipes.title: Bavarian Kielbasa With Noodles
ingredients: 3/4 lb. smoked kielbasa or cooked ham, cut up
1 can Campbell's condensed cream of mushroom soup
directions: Cook noodles according to package directions; drain. Meanwhile, in a 10-inch skillet over medium heat, cook kielbasa and onion until browned, stirring often.
Spoon off fat.
Add soup; stir until smooth.
Gradually stir in milk.
Add beans and pepper.
Heat to boiling.
Reduce heat to low.
Cover; cook 5 minutes or until beans are tender, stirring occasionally.
Stir cooked noodles into skillet.
Heat 2 minutes, stirring often. Serve with mustard, if desired (spicy brown mustard or French mustard).
Makes 4 servings.
ner: campbell's condensed cream of mushroom soup
recipes.text: Bavarian Kielbasa With Noodles. Cook noodles according to package directions; drain. Meanwhile, in a 10-inch skillet over medium heat, cook kielbasa and onion until browned, stirring often. Spoon off fat. Add soup; stir until smooth. Gradually stir in milk. Add beans and pepper. Heat to boiling. Reduce heat to low. Cover; cook 5 minutes or until beans are tender, stirring occasionally. Stir cooked noodles into skillet. Heat 2 minutes, stirring often. Serve with mustard, if desired (spicy brown mustard or French mustard). Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: Broccoli Casserole
ingredients: 1 c. Ritz or Town House crackers
directions: Cook broccoli until tender and drain. Mix with sour cream, soup and cheese. Pour in baking dish and top with cracker crumbs. Bake at 350° until crumbs are brown.
recipes.text: Broccoli Casserole. Cook broccoli until tender and drain. Mix with sour cream, soup and cheese. Pour in baking dish and top with cracker crumbs. Bake at 350° until crumbs are brown.

recipes.title: Watergate Salad
directions: Mix dry pudding into crushed pineapple. Add marshmallows and nuts. Fold in Cool Whip and pour into shallow 8 x 10-inch pan. Keep refrigerated until ready to serve.
recipes.text: Watergate Salad. Mix dry pudding into crushed pineapple. Add marshmallows and nuts. Fold in Cool Whip and pour into shallow 8 x 10-inch pan. Keep refrigerated until ready to serve.

recipes.title: Barbara'S Candy
directions: Melt almond bark; crush Bugles.
Mix nuts and Bugles with almond bark.
Drop by teaspoon on waxed paper.
recipes.text: Barbara'S Candy. Melt almond bark; crush Bugles. Mix nuts and Bugles with almond bark. Drop by teaspoon on waxed paper.

recipes.title: Apple Kuchen
ingredients: 1 (20 oz.) can pie-sliced apples or 2 1/2 c. sliced baking apples
directions: Heat oven to 350°.
Cut butter into dry cake mix until crumbly.
Stir in coconut; pat mixture lightly into 9 x 13-inch pan, building up slight edges.
Bake 10 minutes.
Arrange apple slices on warm crust.
Mix sugar and cinnamon, sprinkle on apples. Blend sour cream and egg yolks.
Drizzle on apples (topping will not completely cover apples).
Bake 25 minutes or until edges are light brown (do not overbake).
Serve warm.
recipes.text: Apple Kuchen. Heat oven to 350°. Cut butter into dry cake mix until crumbly. Stir in coconut; pat mixture lightly into 9 x 13-inch pan, building up slight edges. Bake 10 minutes. Arrange apple slices on warm crust. Mix sugar and cinnamon, sprinkle on apples. Blend sour cream and egg yolks. Drizzle on apples (topping will not completely cover apples). Bake 25 minutes or until edges are light brown (do not overbake). Serve warm.

recipes.title: Quick Peanut Brittle
directions: Grease a large cookie sheet. Spread peanuts on cookie sheet. In a 2-quart saucepan, stir together remaining ingredients. Bring to a full rolling boil, stirring occasionally. Boil gently over medium heat for 14 minutes.
Remove from heat and pour over peanuts.
Cool and break into pieces.
Store in tightly covered container.
recipes.text: Quick Peanut Brittle. Grease a large cookie sheet. Spread peanuts on cookie sheet. In a 2-quart saucepan, stir together remaining ingredients. Bring to a full rolling boil, stirring occasionally. Boil gently over medium heat for 14 minutes. Remove from heat and pour over peanuts. Cool and break into pieces. Store in tightly covered container.

recipes.title: Kabobs
directions: Using toothpicks, skewer Cheddar cheese, sweet gherkin and ham.
recipes.text: Kabobs. Using toothpicks, skewer Cheddar cheese, sweet gherkin and ham.

recipes.title: Sweet Potato Fluffy
directions: Beat potatoes, butter, sugar, eggs, milk and orange juice until fluffy.
Add marshmallows and nuts.
Pour in greased 1 1/2-quart casserole.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Sweet Potato Fluffy. Beat potatoes, butter, sugar, eggs, milk and orange juice until fluffy. Add marshmallows and nuts. Pour in greased 1 1/2-quart casserole. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Dump Cake
directions: Layer pineapple, cherries, cake mix, oleo and pecans in 9 x 13-inch pan.
Bake at 400° to 425° until top is brown.
recipes.text: Dump Cake. Layer pineapple, cherries, cake mix, oleo and pecans in 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 400° to 425° until top is brown.

recipes.title: Aunt Dorothy'S Cake Brownies
directions: Cream margarine and sugar together.
Then add remaining ingredients (except nuts) and mix together.
Stir in nuts.
Put in 9 x 13-inch greased pan.
Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes.
If desired, frost with chocolate frosting.
recipes.text: Aunt Dorothy'S Cake Brownies. Cream margarine and sugar together. Then add remaining ingredients (except nuts) and mix together. Stir in nuts. Put in 9 x 13-inch greased pan. Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes. If desired, frost with chocolate frosting.

recipes.title: Potato Casserole
directions: Mix together, put in greased pan.
Bake for 1 hour and 15 minutes to 1 hour and 30 minutes at 350°.
recipes.text: Potato Casserole. Mix together, put in greased pan. Bake for 1 hour and 15 minutes to 1 hour and 30 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Pink Salad
directions: Drain oranges and pineapple.
In a bowl, mix cottage cheese with strawberry jello. Add in the drained fruit, then fold in the Cool Whip and pecans. Chill until hardens.
recipes.text: Pink Salad. Drain oranges and pineapple. In a bowl, mix cottage cheese with strawberry jello. Add in the drained fruit, then fold in the Cool Whip and pecans. Chill until hardens.

recipes.title: Rhubarb Crumble
ingredients: 1 c. sugar or equivalent in honey
directions: Spread diced rhubarb evenly in bottom of a 7 x 11-inch pan. Sprinkle 1 cup of sugar and Jell-O powder over the top, then the Jiffy cake mix.
Pour the hot water over the contents and drizzle the margarine.
Bake for 1 hour in 350° oven.
May be served with whipped cream or ice cream.
recipes.text: Rhubarb Crumble. Spread diced rhubarb evenly in bottom of a 7 x 11-inch pan. Sprinkle 1 cup of sugar and Jell-O powder over the top, then the Jiffy cake mix. Pour the hot water over the contents and drizzle the margarine. Bake for 1 hour in 350° oven. May be served with whipped cream or ice cream.

recipes.title: Autumn Soup
directions: Brown ground beef and onion.
Combine all other ingredients in large pan.
Bring to a boil.
Let simmer for 45 minutes to an hour.
recipes.text: Autumn Soup. Brown ground beef and onion. Combine all other ingredients in large pan. Bring to a boil. Let simmer for 45 minutes to an hour.

recipes.title: Hamburger Vegetable Soup
directions: Combine all ingredients. Cover with water and bring to a boil for ten minutes. Turn down to simmer for 2 hours.
recipes.text: Hamburger Vegetable Soup. Combine all ingredients. Cover with water and bring to a boil for ten minutes. Turn down to simmer for 2 hours.

recipes.title: Taco Dip
directions: Layer in baking pan in order given.
Place in oven until the cheese on top is melted (or microwave).
Top with hot red pepper. Serve with tortilla chips.
recipes.text: Taco Dip. Layer in baking pan in order given. Place in oven until the cheese on top is melted (or microwave). Top with hot red pepper. Serve with tortilla chips.

recipes.title: Wiggles
directions: Fry bacon in skillet. Lift out and fry hamburger in bacon fat until brown.
Then put in roaster and add all cooked vegetables and spaghetti and mix.
Arrange bacon, then cheese on top.
Pour the tomato paste on top of cheese; put in oven and bake 1 1/2 to 2 hours.
You can also put hot into jars, seal and use later.
recipes.text: Wiggles. Fry bacon in skillet. Lift out and fry hamburger in bacon fat until brown. Then put in roaster and add all cooked vegetables and spaghetti and mix. Arrange bacon, then cheese on top. Pour the tomato paste on top of cheese; put in oven and bake 1 1/2 to 2 hours. You can also put hot into jars, seal and use later.

recipes.title: Healthy Heroes
ingredients: 1/2 c. (2 oz.) shredded part-skim Mozzarella cheese
directions: Combine first 6 ingredients; let stand 30 minutes.
Slice buns in half horizontally.
Pull out soft inside of both top and bottom halves, leaving 1/2-inch thick shells (reserve crumbs for other uses).
Line each bottom half with a lettuce leaf.
Spoon mushroom mixture evenly onto lettuce, using a slotted spoon.
Cover with remaining lettuce.
Arrange ham, turkey, tomato slices and cheese on lettuce.
Place top halves on sandwiches; wrap in plastic wrap. Chill up to 2 hours.
Cut in half to serve.
Yields 4 servings.
recipes.text: Healthy Heroes. Combine first 6 ingredients; let stand 30 minutes. Slice buns in half horizontally. Pull out soft inside of both top and bottom halves, leaving 1/2-inch thick shells (reserve crumbs for other uses). Line each bottom half with a lettuce leaf. Spoon mushroom mixture evenly onto lettuce, using a slotted spoon. Cover with remaining lettuce. Arrange ham, turkey, tomato slices and cheese on lettuce. Place top halves on sandwiches; wrap in plastic wrap. Chill up to 2 hours. Cut in half to serve. Yields 4 servings.

recipes.title: Bean Salad
ingredients: 1 (4 oz.) jar chopped and drained pimentos
directions: Combine and drain first 6 ingredients; put in large bowl. Combine and mix well sugar, oil, vinegar, pepper and salt.
Pour over mixed ingredients.
Cover tightly; refrigerate.
Flavor improves after 2 to 3 days.
Makes about 12 servings.
Can be halved or doubled.
(I do not use either the black pepper or the salt.)
recipes.text: Bean Salad. Combine and drain first 6 ingredients; put in large bowl. Combine and mix well sugar, oil, vinegar, pepper and salt. Pour over mixed ingredients. Cover tightly; refrigerate. Flavor improves after 2 to 3 days. Makes about 12 servings. Can be halved or doubled. (I do not use either the black pepper or the salt.)

recipes.title: Honey Soy Wings
ingredients: 2 to 3 lb. chicken wings, separated at joints and discard tips
directions: In medium bowl, mix honey, soy sauce and ginger.
Coat wings with mixture; allow to marinate in refrigerator for 2 hours.
Bake in preheated 350° oven for 30 to 40 minutes.
Serves 8.
recipes.text: Honey Soy Wings. In medium bowl, mix honey, soy sauce and ginger. Coat wings with mixture; allow to marinate in refrigerator for 2 hours. Bake in preheated 350° oven for 30 to 40 minutes. Serves 8.

recipes.title: Christmas Fruit Cake Cookies
directions: Knead together eggs, sugar and margarine.
Sift flour and mix with egg mixture.
Add remaining ingredients.
Cover and refrigerate overnight.
Drop by teaspoon on cookie sheet, sprayed with Pam.
(I shape them in little balls.) Bake at 275° for 25 to 28 minutes.
"Do not overbake." Best after 2 to 3 weeks.
Bake in advance for Christmas!
recipes.text: Christmas Fruit Cake Cookies. Knead together eggs, sugar and margarine. Sift flour and mix with egg mixture. Add remaining ingredients. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Drop by teaspoon on cookie sheet, sprayed with Pam. (I shape them in little balls.) Bake at 275° for 25 to 28 minutes. "Do not overbake." Best after 2 to 3 weeks. Bake in advance for Christmas!

recipes.title: Noodles For Noodle Cutter
ingredients: extra flour (as needed to run through cutter)
directions: Mix together and separate into 5 cakes.
Run through cutter on #5 setting; cut in half and run through on #3 setting.
Use scissors to cut into length of noodle you want and run through cutter.
Put cut noodles on cookie sheet and freeze immediately. When frozen, bag and keep frozen until ready to use.
When ready to use, put frozen noodles into boiling broth and cook for about 20 minutes.
recipes.text: Noodles For Noodle Cutter. Mix together and separate into 5 cakes. Run through cutter on #5 setting; cut in half and run through on #3 setting. Use scissors to cut into length of noodle you want and run through cutter. Put cut noodles on cookie sheet and freeze immediately. When frozen, bag and keep frozen until ready to use. When ready to use, put frozen noodles into boiling broth and cook for about 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Arnaud'S Sauce
ingredients: 2 to 3 lb. shrimp, boiled and peeled
directions: Mix all ingredients, except shrimp.
Pour over shrimp; marinate in refrigerator for 24 hours, stirring occasionally. Serve ice cold shrimp over a bed of shredded lettuce on individual salad plates.
recipes.text: Arnaud'S Sauce. Mix all ingredients, except shrimp. Pour over shrimp; marinate in refrigerator for 24 hours, stirring occasionally. Serve ice cold shrimp over a bed of shredded lettuce on individual salad plates.

recipes.title: Easy Bran Muffins
directions: Mix dry ingredients together.
Beat eggs well.
Add oil and buttermilk.
Add all to dry ingredients.
Bake at 400° for 15 to 20 minutes.
Can be kept in fridge and baked as needed for a couple of weeks.
recipes.text: Easy Bran Muffins. Mix dry ingredients together. Beat eggs well. Add oil and buttermilk. Add all to dry ingredients. Bake at 400° for 15 to 20 minutes. Can be kept in fridge and baked as needed for a couple of weeks.

recipes.title: Easy Apple Crisp
directions: Place pie filling in greased, 1-quart dish.
Combine remaining ingredients; sprinkle over apples.
Bake at 375° for 25 to 30 minutes.
Serve warm with ice cream or Cool Whip.
recipes.text: Easy Apple Crisp. Place pie filling in greased, 1-quart dish. Combine remaining ingredients; sprinkle over apples. Bake at 375° for 25 to 30 minutes. Serve warm with ice cream or Cool Whip.

recipes.title: Snicker - Bar Cookies
ingredients: 1 (16 oz) pkg. miniature Snickers candy bars or Milky Way candy bars
directions: Mix all ingredients together and spoon onto ungreased cookie sheet.
Bake at 350 degrees for 8 to 10 minutes.
recipes.text: Snicker - Bar Cookies. Mix all ingredients together and spoon onto ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 350 degrees for 8 to 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Mushroom Sauce
directions: In saucepan, melt 3 tablespoons butter.
Blend in 3 tablespoons flour.
Stir in 1 cup milk and 1 (3 ounce) can broiled mushroom slices with liquid.
Cook, stirring constantly, until mixture thickens and bubbles.
Add 1 tablespoon onion and 1 tablespoon parsley.
Season with 1/4 teaspoon salt and dash of pepper.
Spoon over ham puffs or other main dish just before serving.
Makes 1 1/2 cups sauce.
recipes.text: Mushroom Sauce. In saucepan, melt 3 tablespoons butter. Blend in 3 tablespoons flour. Stir in 1 cup milk and 1 (3 ounce) can broiled mushroom slices with liquid. Cook, stirring constantly, until mixture thickens and bubbles. Add 1 tablespoon onion and 1 tablespoon parsley. Season with 1/4 teaspoon salt and dash of pepper. Spoon over ham puffs or other main dish just before serving. Makes 1 1/2 cups sauce.

recipes.title: Impossible Cheeseburger Pie
directions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Brown ground beef and onion; drain. Stir in salt. Spread into 9 inch pie plate. Sprinkle with cheese. Stir milk, eggs and Bisquick mix with fork until blended. Pour on top of ground beef and cheese. Bake at 400 degrees for 25 minutes or until knife inserted comes out clean.
recipes.text: Impossible Cheeseburger Pie. Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Brown ground beef and onion; drain. Stir in salt. Spread into 9 inch pie plate. Sprinkle with cheese. Stir milk, eggs and Bisquick mix with fork until blended. Pour on top of ground beef and cheese. Bake at 400 degrees for 25 minutes or until knife inserted comes out clean.

recipes.title: Strawberry Jello Salad
directions: Dissolve jello in boiling water, add berries, stirring occasionally until thawed.
Add pineapple and bananas.
Pour 1/2 the mixture into 8 x 8 x 2 pan or jello mold.
Chill until firm. Spoon sour cream over chilled jello spreading an even layer.
Pour remaining jello over top and chill until firm.
Serves 8.
recipes.text: Strawberry Jello Salad. Dissolve jello in boiling water, add berries, stirring occasionally until thawed. Add pineapple and bananas. Pour 1/2 the mixture into 8 x 8 x 2 pan or jello mold. Chill until firm. Spoon sour cream over chilled jello spreading an even layer. Pour remaining jello over top and chill until firm. Serves 8.

recipes.title: Cavatini
directions: Brown ground chuck and onion.
Cook macaroni.
Mix together ground chuck, macaroni, mushrooms, spaghetti sauce and 1 cup of cheese in 1-quart baking dish.
Sprinkle 1 cup cheese over top of casserole.
Bake 1/2 hour at 300° or microwave 15 minutes on High.
recipes.text: Cavatini. Brown ground chuck and onion. Cook macaroni. Mix together ground chuck, macaroni, mushrooms, spaghetti sauce and 1 cup of cheese in 1-quart baking dish. Sprinkle 1 cup cheese over top of casserole. Bake 1/2 hour at 300° or microwave 15 minutes on High.

recipes.title: Oakley'S Chocolate Pie
directions: Mix dry ingredients in 1/4 cup milk.
Add egg yolks and whip together.
Add rest of milk.
Put on heat until mixture begins to boil and add butter.
Let it cool and pour it into baked pie crust.
Beat egg whites with 1/2 cup sugar and some vanilla. Spread it on top of pie and place it under the broiler until it turns golden brown.
recipes.text: Oakley'S Chocolate Pie. Mix dry ingredients in 1/4 cup milk. Add egg yolks and whip together. Add rest of milk. Put on heat until mixture begins to boil and add butter. Let it cool and pour it into baked pie crust. Beat egg whites with 1/2 cup sugar and some vanilla. Spread it on top of pie and place it under the broiler until it turns golden brown.

recipes.title: Angel Strawberry Delight
ingredients: 1 angel food cake (store bought or homemade)
directions: Mix together Cool Whip and whipped cream.
Remove 2 to 3 cups of this for use later.
Slice the strawberries, reserving 10 whole ones for decoration.
Add a little sugar to the sliced strawberries.
Divide the angel food cake in half.
Mix the sliced strawberries with the 2 to 3 cups of Cool Whip mixture.
Spread this on the middle layer of the angel food cake.
Replace the top layer of the cake.
Frost the cake with the remaining Cool Whip mixture.
Decorate the top of the cake with the whole strawberries.
Refrigerate until ready to serve.
recipes.text: Angel Strawberry Delight. Mix together Cool Whip and whipped cream. Remove 2 to 3 cups of this for use later. Slice the strawberries, reserving 10 whole ones for decoration. Add a little sugar to the sliced strawberries. Divide the angel food cake in half. Mix the sliced strawberries with the 2 to 3 cups of Cool Whip mixture. Spread this on the middle layer of the angel food cake. Replace the top layer of the cake. Frost the cake with the remaining Cool Whip mixture. Decorate the top of the cake with the whole strawberries. Refrigerate until ready to serve.

recipes.title: Nachos
ingredients: 1 (16 oz.) can refried beans with green chilies
directions: Spread tortilla chips on a large baking sheet.
Top each with beans and a few green chilies.
Sprinkle each with a tablespoon of cheese.
Place under broiler until cheese melts, about 2 to 3 minutes.
Serve immediately.
recipes.text: Nachos. Spread tortilla chips on a large baking sheet. Top each with beans and a few green chilies. Sprinkle each with a tablespoon of cheese. Place under broiler until cheese melts, about 2 to 3 minutes. Serve immediately.

recipes.title: Pretzel Salad
directions: Mix pretzels, 3 teaspoons sugar and margarine.
Press into 9 x 13-inch pan.
Bake 10 minutes at 350°.
Mix cream cheese, 1 cup sugar and Cool Whip.
Spread over cooled crust.
Dissolve jello in boiling water.
Add strawberries.
Pour over all.
Chill.
recipes.text: Pretzel Salad. Mix pretzels, 3 teaspoons sugar and margarine. Press into 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake 10 minutes at 350°. Mix cream cheese, 1 cup sugar and Cool Whip. Spread over cooled crust. Dissolve jello in boiling water. Add strawberries. Pour over all. Chill.

recipes.title: Easy Sherried Beef
directions: Stir all together.
Put in tightly covered casserole or Dutch oven.
Bake
about	4
hours
at
Baking longer at low temperature makes it even better.
Serve on wild rice.
recipes.text: Easy Sherried Beef. Stir all together. Put in tightly covered casserole or Dutch oven. Bake about	4 hours at 300° to 325°. Baking longer at low temperature makes it even better. Serve on wild rice.

recipes.title: Dutch Meat Loaf
directions: Preheat oven to 350°.
Lightly mix beef, bread crumbs, onion, 1/2 can sauce, egg, salt and pepper.
Shape into loaf and put in shallow baking pan.
Combine remaining ingredients and pour over meat loaf.
Bake for 1 1/4 hours; baste occasionally.
recipes.text: Dutch Meat Loaf. Preheat oven to 350°. Lightly mix beef, bread crumbs, onion, 1/2 can sauce, egg, salt and pepper. Shape into loaf and put in shallow baking pan. Combine remaining ingredients and pour over meat loaf. Bake for 1 1/4 hours; baste occasionally.

recipes.title: Fiesta Cranberry Nut Bread
directions: Cream sugar and margarine.
Add egg and liquid ingredients; beat well.
Add dry ingredients and mix.
Fold in cranberry sauce and pecans.
Pour into greased and floured loaf pan.
Bake in a 350° oven for 60 to 65 minutes.
recipes.text: Fiesta Cranberry Nut Bread. Cream sugar and margarine. Add egg and liquid ingredients; beat well. Add dry ingredients and mix. Fold in cranberry sauce and pecans. Pour into greased and floured loaf pan. Bake in a 350° oven for 60 to 65 minutes.

recipes.title: Potatoes
directions: Peel potatoes; cut them in slices crosswise, about 1/4-inch apart, cutting within 1/4 or 1/2 of the bottom so that the potato remains whole. Place potatoes in melted butter pan. Sprinkle with salt and drizzle tops with more melted butter. Bake in a 425° oven for 30 minutes. Remove from oven and sprinkle with bread crumbs. Add more melted butter.
Cook for another 20 minutes. Sprinkle with grated cheese, if desired.
recipes.text: Potatoes. Peel potatoes; cut them in slices crosswise, about 1/4-inch apart, cutting within 1/4 or 1/2 of the bottom so that the potato remains whole. Place potatoes in melted butter pan. Sprinkle with salt and drizzle tops with more melted butter. Bake in a 425° oven for 30 minutes. Remove from oven and sprinkle with bread crumbs. Add more melted butter. Cook for another 20 minutes. Sprinkle with grated cheese, if desired.

recipes.title: Baked Pork Chops
directions: Salt and pepper chops.
Brown in small amount of oil in hot skillet.
Place in shallow greased baking dish.
Combine remaining ingredients.
Pour over chops.
Cover and bake at 350° for 1 hour or until tender.
recipes.text: Baked Pork Chops. Salt and pepper chops. Brown in small amount of oil in hot skillet. Place in shallow greased baking dish. Combine remaining ingredients. Pour over chops. Cover and bake at 350° for 1 hour or until tender.

recipes.title: Classic Ham 'N Cheese
directions: Makes enough canape spread for 24 Melba toast rounds or dry, crisp crackers.
recipes.text: Classic Ham 'N Cheese. Makes enough canape spread for 24 Melba toast rounds or dry, crisp crackers.

recipes.title: Banana Nut Bread
directions: Beat
eggs
well.
Add sugar and beat until light.
Add mashed bananas,
flour
and
soda, dissolved in a little warm water, vanilla, salt, melted butter and nuts,
stirring after you add each
item.
Pour into a Bundt pan.
Bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes.
Do not overbake.
recipes.text: Banana Nut Bread. Beat eggs well. Add sugar and beat until light. Add mashed bananas, flour and soda, dissolved in a little warm water, vanilla, salt, melted butter and nuts, stirring after you add each item. Pour into a Bundt pan. Bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes. Do not overbake.

recipes.title: Creole Pork Chops
directions: Brown chops in 2 tablespoons oil.
Place in a 2-quart casserole.
Add remaining ingredients, except rice.
Cover with foil.
Bake 1 1/2 to 2 hours at 325°.
Serve over cooked rice.
recipes.text: Creole Pork Chops. Brown chops in 2 tablespoons oil. Place in a 2-quart casserole. Add remaining ingredients, except rice. Cover with foil. Bake 1 1/2 to 2 hours at 325°. Serve over cooked rice.

recipes.title: No Bake Banana Split Pie
ingredients: 1/2 c. melted butter or margarine (not whipped)
directions: Mix together and press into 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish. Chill for 1 hour.
recipes.text: No Bake Banana Split Pie. Mix together and press into 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish. Chill for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Veggie Pizza
directions: *Broccoli, cauliflower, red cabbage, mushrooms, carrots, black olives, green pepper and tomatoes.
Cut up veggies small.
Crumble broccoli and cauliflower.
You could also use baby shrimp; be creative.
recipes.text: Veggie Pizza. *Broccoli, cauliflower, red cabbage, mushrooms, carrots, black olives, green pepper and tomatoes. Cut up veggies small. Crumble broccoli and cauliflower. You could also use baby shrimp; be creative.

recipes.title: Rice Pudding
directions: Simmer rice in water with butter and salt for 1/2 hour or until stiff.
Add half and half; cover.
Bring to boil.
Boil 20 minutes, stirring frequently.
In separate bowl, beat eggs, sugar and vanilla.
Add to rice and bring to boil.
Remove from stove. Sprinkle with cinnamon.
Refrigerate.
(Best when done in a double boiler.)
recipes.text: Rice Pudding. Simmer rice in water with butter and salt for 1/2 hour or until stiff. Add half and half; cover. Bring to boil. Boil 20 minutes, stirring frequently. In separate bowl, beat eggs, sugar and vanilla. Add to rice and bring to boil. Remove from stove. Sprinkle with cinnamon. Refrigerate. (Best when done in a double boiler.)

recipes.title: Nacho Dip
directions: Brown hamburger and drain.
Add 1/2 jar or picante sauce.
Add soups and cheese.
Heat until cheese melts.
recipes.text: Nacho Dip. Brown hamburger and drain. Add 1/2 jar or picante sauce. Add soups and cheese. Heat until cheese melts.

recipes.title: Broccoli Ham Ring
directions: Have head and stomach removed.
Leave bone in; wash well. Make slashes on top of fish.
Fill with 1/8 teaspoon pepper, chopped fine garlic and chopped fine parsley.
Place under broiler.
recipes.text: Broccoli Ham Ring. Have head and stomach removed. Leave bone in; wash well. Make slashes on top of fish. Fill with 1/8 teaspoon pepper, chopped fine garlic and chopped fine parsley. Place under broiler.

recipes.title: That Incredible Holiday Sandwich
ingredients: 1 loaf French bread (Pepperidge Farm is good)
directions: Cut bread in half lengthwise.
Hollow out both sides.
Spread mayonnaise and cream cheese evenly on both sides.
Sprinkle both sides with chopped onion.
Sprinkle both sides liberally with chopped parsley.
Drain dill quarters and wrap with two slices boiled ham (I use rectangular size slices).
Place pickle and ham roll diagonally across trough in one side of bread loaf.
Cut last pickle and ham roll in two to fill space at ends of loaf.
Place top of loaf over filled bottom loaf and press down gently.
Wrap tightly with plastic wrap and refrigerate for several hours before serving.
Cut slices at angle, about 1 1/2 inches thick to serve.
recipes.text: That Incredible Holiday Sandwich. Cut bread in half lengthwise. Hollow out both sides. Spread mayonnaise and cream cheese evenly on both sides. Sprinkle both sides with chopped onion. Sprinkle both sides liberally with chopped parsley. Drain dill quarters and wrap with two slices boiled ham (I use rectangular size slices). Place pickle and ham roll diagonally across trough in one side of bread loaf. Cut last pickle and ham roll in two to fill space at ends of loaf. Place top of loaf over filled bottom loaf and press down gently. Wrap tightly with plastic wrap and refrigerate for several hours before serving. Cut slices at angle, about 1 1/2 inches thick to serve.

recipes.title: Fancy Brussels Sprouts
ingredients: 2 (10 oz.) pkg. frozen Brussels sprouts, thawed or 2 pt. fresh, halved
1 (8 oz.) can water chestnuts, drained and diced
directions: In a saucepan over medium heat, bring water, parsley, sugar and salt to the boil. Add sprouts. Cover and simmer for 6 to 8 minutes or until tender; drain. Add butter and water chestnuts; heat through. Yield: 6 servings.
recipes.text: Fancy Brussels Sprouts. In a saucepan over medium heat, bring water, parsley, sugar and salt to the boil. Add sprouts. Cover and simmer for 6 to 8 minutes or until tender; drain. Add butter and water chestnuts; heat through. Yield: 6 servings.

recipes.title: Chicken (Or Turkey) Tetrazzini
directions: Cook spaghetti as directed on package.
While spaghetti is boiling, saute mushrooms in separate pan.
Add wine.
Drain spaghetti and add mushrooms.
In separate saucepan, make a sauce of butter, flour and chicken broth.
Remove from heat and add heated whipping cream.
Add shredded chicken and sauce to spaghetti-mushroom mixture.
Mix well.
Place in greased baking dish and sprinkle the top with Parmesan cheese.
Bake in a 375° oven until lightly browned and heated through.
recipes.text: Chicken (Or Turkey) Tetrazzini. Cook spaghetti as directed on package. While spaghetti is boiling, saute mushrooms in separate pan. Add wine. Drain spaghetti and add mushrooms. In separate saucepan, make a sauce of butter, flour and chicken broth. Remove from heat and add heated whipping cream. Add shredded chicken and sauce to spaghetti-mushroom mixture. Mix well. Place in greased baking dish and sprinkle the top with Parmesan cheese. Bake in a 375° oven until lightly browned and heated through.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Balls
directions: In mixing bowl put confectioners sugar.
Make a hole in the center of it.
Put margarine, milk, peanut butter and graham cracker crumbs in the hole.
Work up well.
(Add more milk if necessary.)
Form into balls and dip into icing.
(You can double the mixture and still have enough icing without doubling the icing.)
recipes.text: Peanut Butter Balls. In mixing bowl put confectioners sugar. Make a hole in the center of it. Put margarine, milk, peanut butter and graham cracker crumbs in the hole. Work up well. (Add more milk if necessary.) Form into balls and dip into icing. (You can double the mixture and still have enough icing without doubling the icing.)

recipes.title: Cheese Sauce For Vegetables
ingredients: 1 c. shredded cheese (you can use 1/2 c. Cheddar and 1/2 c. Velveeta)
directions: Heat
margarine
over
low heat until melted.
Blend in flour, mustard, salt and pepper.
Cook over low heat, stirring constantly,
until	mixture is smooth and bubbly.
Remove from heat.
Stir
in
milk.
Heat
to boiling, stirring constantly. Boil
and
stir
1	minute.
Stir
in cheese and pepper sauce. Cook and stir over low heat until cheese is melted.
Good over cauliflower and broccoli.
recipes.text: Cheese Sauce For Vegetables. Heat margarine over low heat until melted. Blend in flour, mustard, salt and pepper. Cook over low heat, stirring constantly, until	mixture is smooth and bubbly. Remove from heat. Stir in milk. Heat to boiling, stirring constantly. Boil and stir 1	minute. Stir in cheese and pepper sauce. Cook and stir over low heat until cheese is melted. Good over cauliflower and broccoli.

recipes.title: Rice Krispies Squares
directions: Mix sugar and syrup.
Cook until it bubbles.
Stir in peanut butter.
Add Rice Krispies, then press in buttered pan and cool. Melt butterscotch and chocolate chips over hot water, then spread over Rice Krispies.
recipes.text: Rice Krispies Squares. Mix sugar and syrup. Cook until it bubbles. Stir in peanut butter. Add Rice Krispies, then press in buttered pan and cool. Melt butterscotch and chocolate chips over hot water, then spread over Rice Krispies.

recipes.title: Apple Bread
directions: Mix together by hand, oil, nuts, apples, eggs, sugar, salt and vanilla.
Sift together soda and flour.
Add to apple mixture. Bake in an ungreased angel food pan for about 75 minutes at 350°.
recipes.text: Apple Bread. Mix together by hand, oil, nuts, apples, eggs, sugar, salt and vanilla. Sift together soda and flour. Add to apple mixture. Bake in an ungreased angel food pan for about 75 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Potato And Kielbasa Casserole
ingredients: 4 to 6 large potatoes, peeled and sliced
directions: Mix all ingredients but potatoes, kielbasa and cheese in microwave pan.
Cook 3 minutes on High.
Stir and continue cooking on Medium heat until thick.
Add potatoes and continue cooking until potatoes are almost done.
Add kielbasa and cook an additional 5 minutes.
Top with cheese and serve.
recipes.text: Potato And Kielbasa Casserole. Mix all ingredients but potatoes, kielbasa and cheese in microwave pan. Cook 3 minutes on High. Stir and continue cooking on Medium heat until thick. Add potatoes and continue cooking until potatoes are almost done. Add kielbasa and cook an additional 5 minutes. Top with cheese and serve.

recipes.title: Cherry Cheese Pie
directions: Whip cream and set aside.
Mix remaining ingredients and fold into whipped cream.
Place mixture in cooked and cooled pie crust. Top with can of cherry pie filling.
Refrigerate for several hours before cutting.
recipes.text: Cherry Cheese Pie. Whip cream and set aside. Mix remaining ingredients and fold into whipped cream. Place mixture in cooked and cooled pie crust. Top with can of cherry pie filling. Refrigerate for several hours before cutting.

recipes.title: Barbecue Sauce
directions: Mix all ingredients; simmer over low heat for 20 minutes.
It can be put directly into refrigerator or canned in glass containers.
recipes.text: Barbecue Sauce. Mix all ingredients; simmer over low heat for 20 minutes. It can be put directly into refrigerator or canned in glass containers.

recipes.title: Spicy Lamb Steaks
directions: Combine all ingredients and pour over steaks.
Refrigerate 2 hours, turning steaks every 20 minutes.
Broil 4 inches from heat, 6 minutes on each side for medium or 7 minutes for well done.
recipes.text: Spicy Lamb Steaks. Combine all ingredients and pour over steaks. Refrigerate 2 hours, turning steaks every 20 minutes. Broil 4 inches from heat, 6 minutes on each side for medium or 7 minutes for well done.

recipes.title: German Skillet Beans
directions: Fry
bacon
until crisp;
crumble and set aside.
Saute onions in bacon drippings until tender.
Add bacon and remaining ingredients.
Simmer
to 10 minutes or until thickened and heated thoroughly.
recipes.text: German Skillet Beans. Fry bacon until crisp; crumble and set aside. Saute onions in bacon drippings until tender. Add bacon and remaining ingredients. Simmer 5 to 10 minutes or until thickened and heated thoroughly.

recipes.title: Chicken Casserole
ingredients: 6 split skinless and boneless chicken breasts
directions: Bake 1 hour and 10 minutes in greased casserole dish (covered) at 350°.
Remove cover and bake 20 minutes longer until brown. Serves 10.
recipes.text: Chicken Casserole. Bake 1 hour and 10 minutes in greased casserole dish (covered) at 350°. Remove cover and bake 20 minutes longer until brown. Serves 10.

recipes.title: Pizza Dough
ingredients: 1 yeast cake or 1 pkg. dry yeast
directions: In first bowl, add lukewarm water and yeast.
In second bowl, put sugar, salt, shortening and boiling water, plus 1 1/2 cups of flour and mix together well.
Then add 1 1/2 cups of flour.
Add first bowl mix of water and yeast.
Mix well.
Let rise 15 minutes.
Spare dough into well oiled pan.
(Add pizza sauce and toppings.)
recipes.text: Pizza Dough. In first bowl, add lukewarm water and yeast. In second bowl, put sugar, salt, shortening and boiling water, plus 1 1/2 cups of flour and mix together well. Then add 1 1/2 cups of flour. Add first bowl mix of water and yeast. Mix well. Let rise 15 minutes. Spare dough into well oiled pan. (Add pizza sauce and toppings.)

recipes.title: Pork Chops
directions: Place pork chops in an ungreased shallow baking pan.
Top each pork chop with onion slice, 1 tablespoon brown sugar and 1 tablespoon ketchup.
Cover.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Pork Chops. Place pork chops in an ungreased shallow baking pan. Top each pork chop with onion slice, 1 tablespoon brown sugar and 1 tablespoon ketchup. Cover. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Go Chicken In Puff Pastry
ingredients: 6 chicken breasts, cut into bite-size pieces
directions: Saute chicken, garlic and butter until chicken starts to brown; drain.
Save butter; set aside.
recipes.text: Go Chicken In Puff Pastry. Saute chicken, garlic and butter until chicken starts to brown; drain. Save butter; set aside.

recipes.title: Apple Crisp
directions: Combine oatmeal, flour, brown sugar, sugar and butter; blend together until crumbly.
Place apples in 8 x 13-inch pan.
Top with oatmeal mixture; sprinkle with salt and cinnamon.
Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.
Yields about 12 servings.
recipes.text: Apple Crisp. Combine oatmeal, flour, brown sugar, sugar and butter; blend together until crumbly. Place apples in 8 x 13-inch pan. Top with oatmeal mixture; sprinkle with salt and cinnamon. Bake at 350° for 40 minutes. Yields about 12 servings.

recipes.title: No-Cook Freezer Jam
directions: You will also need 3 clean pint jars with covers.
recipes.text: No-Cook Freezer Jam. You will also need 3 clean pint jars with covers.

recipes.title: Banana Yams
directions: Peel and quarter the yams.
Cook for 20 minutes in boiling salted water; drain.
Cut into 1-inch cubes; add bananas, cut into thick slices.
Add the pineapple chunks and half the juice.
Add the cherries that have been cut in half and the marshmallows.
Stir gently to mix the ingredients.
Put into a buttered baking dish. Pour the melted butter over the top; sprinkle on the brown sugar and bake in 350° oven for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Banana Yams. Peel and quarter the yams. Cook for 20 minutes in boiling salted water; drain. Cut into 1-inch cubes; add bananas, cut into thick slices. Add the pineapple chunks and half the juice. Add the cherries that have been cut in half and the marshmallows. Stir gently to mix the ingredients. Put into a buttered baking dish. Pour the melted butter over the top; sprinkle on the brown sugar and bake in 350° oven for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Refrigerator Rolls
directions: Soften yeast in lukewarm water.
Cream shortening, sugar and salt.
Add boiling water and cool to lukewarm.
Add well beaten eggs, yeast mixture and flour; mix well.
Place in refrigerator at least 2 hours (overnight is best).
Make into rolls.
Let rise 2 hours in warm place.
Bake for 15 minutes at 425°.
recipes.text: Refrigerator Rolls. Soften yeast in lukewarm water. Cream shortening, sugar and salt. Add boiling water and cool to lukewarm. Add well beaten eggs, yeast mixture and flour; mix well. Place in refrigerator at least 2 hours (overnight is best). Make into rolls. Let rise 2 hours in warm place. Bake for 15 minutes at 425°.

recipes.title: Cabbage Casserole
ingredients: 1 can diced Ro-Tel chilies and tomatoes
directions: Preparation Time:
30 minutes.
Cooking Time: 10 minutes. Oven Temperature: 350°.
Baking Time: 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Cabbage Casserole. Preparation Time: 30 minutes. Cooking Time: 10 minutes. Oven Temperature: 350°. Baking Time: 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Fresh Apple Cake
directions: Dust apples, raisins and nuts with some of the flour; set aside.
Blend oil, sugar and slightly beaten eggs; set aside. Sift together flour, salt and soda; add to egg mixture and add vanilla.
Fold in coated apples, nuts and raisins; pour into a 10-inch greased tube pan.
Bake in 350° oven for 1 hour and 15 minutes.
recipes.text: Fresh Apple Cake. Dust apples, raisins and nuts with some of the flour; set aside. Blend oil, sugar and slightly beaten eggs; set aside. Sift together flour, salt and soda; add to egg mixture and add vanilla. Fold in coated apples, nuts and raisins; pour into a 10-inch greased tube pan. Bake in 350° oven for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Pina Colada Punch
directions: Mix in punch bowl the juice, cream of coconut and Sprite. Place ice cream on top.
Stir and serve.
recipes.text: Pina Colada Punch. Mix in punch bowl the juice, cream of coconut and Sprite. Place ice cream on top. Stir and serve.

recipes.title: Pasta E Fagioli Soup
directions: Brown hamburger meat and onions; drain.
Add all other ingredients except beans and pasta.
Simmer 1 hour.
Cook pasta for 5 minutes; drain.
Add beans and cooked pasta to soup.
Simmer 30 minutes.
Extra water may be added for thinner consistency.
recipes.text: Pasta E Fagioli Soup. Brown hamburger meat and onions; drain. Add all other ingredients except beans and pasta. Simmer 1 hour. Cook pasta for 5 minutes; drain. Add beans and cooked pasta to soup. Simmer 30 minutes. Extra water may be added for thinner consistency.

recipes.title: Chunk Ham Fettuccine
ingredients: 1 (5 oz.) can Hormel chunk ham, drained and flaked
directions: Prepare
fettuccine,
according
to package directions. While fettuccine	is cooking, cook peas, according to package directions;
set
aside.
Prepare
white
sauce,
according to package directions, using 1 1/4 cups milk.	Stir in nutmeg.
recipes.text: Chunk Ham Fettuccine. Prepare fettuccine, according to package directions. While fettuccine	is cooking, cook peas, according to package directions; set aside. Prepare white sauce, according to package directions, using 1 1/4 cups milk.	Stir in nutmeg.

recipes.title: Mexican Cornbread With Ground Meat
directions: Mix corn meal, eggs, milk, soda, salt, corn and drippings and set aside.
Saute ground meat and put on absorbent paper to drain. Prepare onion, cheese and peppers in separate mounds.
Grease a large iron skillet and heat.
Sprinkle a very thin layer of corn meal in the skillet and let brown slightly.
Pour half the batter in skillet; sprinkle the grated cheese evenly over the batter, then the meat, next the chopped onions and finely the jalapeno peppers. Pour remaining batter on top.
Bake for 45 to 50 minutes at 350°.
recipes.text: Mexican Cornbread With Ground Meat. Mix corn meal, eggs, milk, soda, salt, corn and drippings and set aside. Saute ground meat and put on absorbent paper to drain. Prepare onion, cheese and peppers in separate mounds. Grease a large iron skillet and heat. Sprinkle a very thin layer of corn meal in the skillet and let brown slightly. Pour half the batter in skillet; sprinkle the grated cheese evenly over the batter, then the meat, next the chopped onions and finely the jalapeno peppers. Pour remaining batter on top. Bake for 45 to 50 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Banana Split Cake
directions: Mix cream cheese and confectioners sugar well.
Spread over cooled graham crust.
Slice bananas over cream cheese mixture. Drain pineapple and spread over bananas.
Spread Cool Whip over bananas.
Top with cherries and pecans.
Refrigerate.
Very good.
recipes.text: Banana Split Cake. Mix cream cheese and confectioners sugar well. Spread over cooled graham crust. Slice bananas over cream cheese mixture. Drain pineapple and spread over bananas. Spread Cool Whip over bananas. Top with cherries and pecans. Refrigerate. Very good.

recipes.title: Short Cut Fudge
directions: Melt chocolate over hot water.
Remove from water.
Add and stir until smooth and satiny the condensed milk, 1 tablespoon water and vanilla.
Add peanut butter and 1 tablespoon water. Stir until creamy.
Spread in 8 x 8-inch pan.
Refrigerate 1 hour. Cut into squares.
recipes.text: Short Cut Fudge. Melt chocolate over hot water. Remove from water. Add and stir until smooth and satiny the condensed milk, 1 tablespoon water and vanilla. Add peanut butter and 1 tablespoon water. Stir until creamy. Spread in 8 x 8-inch pan. Refrigerate 1 hour. Cut into squares.

recipes.title: Poppy Seed Fruit Salad
directions: Drain fruit.
Reserve 1 tablespoon pineapple juice.
Cut strawberries and apple,
Combine fruit in a bowl.
Mix yogurt, poppy seed and reserved pineapple juice.
Arrange fruit in 6 serving bowls.
Drizzle dressing over fruit.
recipes.text: Poppy Seed Fruit Salad. Drain fruit. Reserve 1 tablespoon pineapple juice. Cut strawberries and apple, Combine fruit in a bowl. Mix yogurt, poppy seed and reserved pineapple juice. Arrange fruit in 6 serving bowls. Drizzle dressing over fruit.

recipes.title: Hot Buttered Apple Rum
directions: Tie spices in a spice bag or cheesecloth.
In a 3 1/2 or larger crock-pot, put spice bag, apple juice, rum and sugar.
Cover; cook on low heat setting for 7 to 8 hours or on high 3 to 4 hours. Discard spice bag.
Ladle hot punch into cups.
Float about 1/2 teaspoon of butter atop each serving.
Makes 10 (6-ounce) servings.
recipes.text: Hot Buttered Apple Rum. Tie spices in a spice bag or cheesecloth. In a 3 1/2 or larger crock-pot, put spice bag, apple juice, rum and sugar. Cover; cook on low heat setting for 7 to 8 hours or on high 3 to 4 hours. Discard spice bag. Ladle hot punch into cups. Float about 1/2 teaspoon of butter atop each serving. Makes 10 (6-ounce) servings.

recipes.title: Skillet Ham, Pineapple And Peppers
directions: Stir-fry ham in margarine 3 to 5 minutes until lightly browned. Add pineapple and green peppers.
Stir-fry 3 to 4 minutes until peppers are crisp-tender.
Mix all other ingredients.
Stir into skillet and heat, stirring until thickened.
Serve over rice.
recipes.text: Skillet Ham, Pineapple And Peppers. Stir-fry ham in margarine 3 to 5 minutes until lightly browned. Add pineapple and green peppers. Stir-fry 3 to 4 minutes until peppers are crisp-tender. Mix all other ingredients. Stir into skillet and heat, stirring until thickened. Serve over rice.

recipes.title: Black Bean And Corn Salad
directions: Mix together all ingredients, except tomatoes.
Cover and chill.
recipes.text: Black Bean And Corn Salad. Mix together all ingredients, except tomatoes. Cover and chill.

recipes.title: Applesauce Muffins
ingredients: 2 tsp. soda, dissolved in 4 Tbsp. water
directions: Cream shortening and sugar.
Add applesauce and soda, then dry ingredients, raisins and nuts, if desired.
Bake at 350°.
recipes.text: Applesauce Muffins. Cream shortening and sugar. Add applesauce and soda, then dry ingredients, raisins and nuts, if desired. Bake at 350°.

recipes.title: Corn Pudding
directions: Mix eggs, sugar, salt and pepper.
Boil milk and margarine; add to mixture.
Add corn.
Bake at 325° for 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Corn Pudding. Mix eggs, sugar, salt and pepper. Boil milk and margarine; add to mixture. Add corn. Bake at 325° for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Baked Potato Soup
ingredients: 4 large baked potatoes, peeled and cubed
directions: Place bacon in large, deep skillet. Cook over medium heat until browned. Drain, crumble and set aside.
recipes.text: Baked Potato Soup. Place bacon in large, deep skillet. Cook over medium heat until browned. Drain, crumble and set aside.

recipes.title: Chocolate Cake
directions: Beat eggs, sugar and oil.
Add other ingredients.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes. Makes 4 layers.
recipes.text: Chocolate Cake. Beat eggs, sugar and oil. Add other ingredients. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes. Makes 4 layers.

recipes.title: Apple Cake
directions: Combine apples and sugar in bowl.
Let stand for 10 minutes. Blend oil and egg into apple mixture.
Combine dry ingredients and add to apples, mixing well.
Pour into oiled 8-inch square pan. Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes.
Test with toothpick to see if it is done.
Let cool 10 minutes before taking out of pan.
recipes.text: Apple Cake. Combine apples and sugar in bowl. Let stand for 10 minutes. Blend oil and egg into apple mixture. Combine dry ingredients and add to apples, mixing well. Pour into oiled 8-inch square pan. Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes. Test with toothpick to see if it is done. Let cool 10 minutes before taking out of pan.

recipes.title: Turkey Meat Loaf
ingredients: 1 c. dry bread crumbs (preferably whole wheat) or stuffing mix
directions: Spray baking sheet with nonstick spray.
Place all ingredients in large bowl and use your hands to mix gently.
Shape turkey into a loaf and place on the baking sheet.
Bake at 350° for 40 minutes or until firm.
Slice and serve with mashed potatoes and mushroom gravy.
recipes.text: Turkey Meat Loaf. Spray baking sheet with nonstick spray. Place all ingredients in large bowl and use your hands to mix gently. Shape turkey into a loaf and place on the baking sheet. Bake at 350° for 40 minutes or until firm. Slice and serve with mashed potatoes and mushroom gravy.

recipes.title: Cider Syrup
directions: Combine sugar, cornstarch and cinnamon in a small saucepan. Stir in apple cider and lemon juice. Cook and stir the mixture over a medium heat until thickened and bubbly.
Cook and stir 2 minutes more.
Remove from heat and stir in butter until melted. Makes about 1 1/3 cups.
recipes.text: Cider Syrup. Combine sugar, cornstarch and cinnamon in a small saucepan. Stir in apple cider and lemon juice. Cook and stir the mixture over a medium heat until thickened and bubbly. Cook and stir 2 minutes more. Remove from heat and stir in butter until melted. Makes about 1 1/3 cups.

recipes.title: Cold Vegetable Dish
ingredients: 1 bunch broccoli, fresh and cut up
1 head cauliflower, fresh and cut up
directions: Mix ingredients the day before you are ready to serve.
Serve cold.
Serves 8 to 10.
recipes.text: Cold Vegetable Dish. Mix ingredients the day before you are ready to serve. Serve cold. Serves 8 to 10.

recipes.title: Streusel Filled Coffee Cake
directions: Sift flour once before measuring, then sift flour, baking powder, salt and sugar together.
Cut in shortening with pastry blender or rub with fingers until blended and is like fine cornmeal.
Mix in egg, vanilla and milk.
Pour into sprayed 9 x 13 pan.
recipes.text: Streusel Filled Coffee Cake. Sift flour once before measuring, then sift flour, baking powder, salt and sugar together. Cut in shortening with pastry blender or rub with fingers until blended and is like fine cornmeal. Mix in egg, vanilla and milk. Pour into sprayed 9 x 13 pan.

recipes.title: Anise Cakes
directions: Cream butter and sugar; add
eggs
one
at a time.
Add flavorings
plus the anise
seed.
Sift
together
the
flour, baking powder and salt into a
large bread bowl.
Make well in center; add the first mixture and mix as for old fashioned tea cakes, incorporating all of the flour.
recipes.text: Anise Cakes. Cream butter and sugar; add eggs one at a time. Add flavorings plus the anise seed. Sift together the flour, baking powder and salt into a large bread bowl. Make well in center; add the first mixture and mix as for old fashioned tea cakes, incorporating all of the flour.

recipes.title: Quick And Easy Baked Chicken
ingredients: 1 (10 3/4 oz.) can Campbell's cream of chicken soup
1/2 tsp. each: garlic powder, onion powder, Lawry's seasoned salt and pepper
1 small pkg. chicken legs (8 to 10) or 1 small pkg. wings
directions: Preheat oven to 350° to 375°; lay legs or wings around pan (side by side).
Mix together seasonings and sprinkle all over chicken.
Chop or slice onion and toss all over chicken.
Mix together in separate bowl the soup and sherry, then put spoonfuls all over top of onion and chicken.
Put pats (tablespoons) of margarine or butter all across top of soup mixture.
Cover pan or baking dish with foil and bake.
Bake 1 hour or until chicken is very tender.
Yum, yum ...
"The sauce (after chicken is done) goes great with rice or mashed potatoes."
Enjoy.
recipes.text: Quick And Easy Baked Chicken. Preheat oven to 350° to 375°; lay legs or wings around pan (side by side). Mix together seasonings and sprinkle all over chicken. Chop or slice onion and toss all over chicken. Mix together in separate bowl the soup and sherry, then put spoonfuls all over top of onion and chicken. Put pats (tablespoons) of margarine or butter all across top of soup mixture. Cover pan or baking dish with foil and bake. Bake 1 hour or until chicken is very tender. Yum, yum ... "The sauce (after chicken is done) goes great with rice or mashed potatoes." Enjoy.
