recipes.title: Applesauce Cake
ingredients: 1 Tbsp. each: nutmeg, cloves, cinnamon and allspice
directions: Cream fat and sugar.
Add egg, then applesauce into which soda has been stirred.
Sift salt and spices into flour.
Add nuts and raisins.
Mix all ingredients thoroughly.
Bake in tube pan 1 1/4 hours in moderate oven.
recipes.text: Applesauce Cake. Cream fat and sugar. Add egg, then applesauce into which soda has been stirred. Sift salt and spices into flour. Add nuts and raisins. Mix all ingredients thoroughly. Bake in tube pan 1 1/4 hours in moderate oven.

recipes.title: Rice Topping
directions: Melt 1 stick of butter in skillet or Wok.
Add onion, bell pepper, mushrooms, and seasonings.
Cook until tender.
Pour into bowl to be used later.
Melt 1 stick of butter in Wok and add shrimp and seasoning and cook until done.
Add to bowl mixture. Melt 1 stick of butter in Wok and add oysters and seasoning.
Cook until done.
Add ingredients from bowl back into Wok and cook until done.
Pour over cooked rice.
recipes.text: Rice Topping. Melt 1 stick of butter in skillet or Wok. Add onion, bell pepper, mushrooms, and seasonings. Cook until tender. Pour into bowl to be used later. Melt 1 stick of butter in Wok and add shrimp and seasoning and cook until done. Add to bowl mixture. Melt 1 stick of butter in Wok and add oysters and seasoning. Cook until done. Add ingredients from bowl back into Wok and cook until done. Pour over cooked rice.

recipes.title: Challah Bread(Easter Bread)
directions: Mix 1 1/4 cups flour, the yeast, sugar and salt.
Heat water and 1 tablespoon oil until very warm.
Add to flour mixture.
Beat 1 minute.
Beat in egg until smooth.
Stir in flour to make dough easy to handle.
Turn dough onto floured surface.
Knead 5 minutes.
Place in greased bowl.
Cover and let rise 1 1/2 to 2 hours until doubled.
Grease cookie sheet.
Punch down dough and divide into 3 parts.
Roll into a 14-inch long rope.
Place on cookie sheet and braid loosely.
Do not stretch.
Form a wreath and secure ends.
Brush with oil.
Cover and let double about 40 to 50 minutes.
Heat oven to 375°.
Mix egg yolk and 2 tablespoons water.
Brush over braid.
Sprinkle with poppy seeds.
Bake 25 to 30 minutes.
Brown lightly.
Remove from sheet to cool on rack. Place colored easter eggs in center for festive gift or centerpiece.
recipes.text: Challah Bread(Easter Bread). Mix 1 1/4 cups flour, the yeast, sugar and salt. Heat water and 1 tablespoon oil until very warm. Add to flour mixture. Beat 1 minute. Beat in egg until smooth. Stir in flour to make dough easy to handle. Turn dough onto floured surface. Knead 5 minutes. Place in greased bowl. Cover and let rise 1 1/2 to 2 hours until doubled. Grease cookie sheet. Punch down dough and divide into 3 parts. Roll into a 14-inch long rope. Place on cookie sheet and braid loosely. Do not stretch. Form a wreath and secure ends. Brush with oil. Cover and let double about 40 to 50 minutes. Heat oven to 375°. Mix egg yolk and 2 tablespoons water. Brush over braid. Sprinkle with poppy seeds. Bake 25 to 30 minutes. Brown lightly. Remove from sheet to cool on rack. Place colored easter eggs in center for festive gift or centerpiece.

recipes.title: Jello Cream Cake
directions: Cream sugar and butter. Add flour and nuts.
Lightly butter the bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Press crust into pan. Bake at 375° for 10 to 15 minutes. Cool.
recipes.text: Jello Cream Cake. Cream sugar and butter. Add flour and nuts. Lightly butter the bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan. Press crust into pan. Bake at 375° for 10 to 15 minutes. Cool.

recipes.title: Ritz Cracker Chicken
directions: Boil and chop chicken breasts.
Place in casserole dish and top with blended soup and sour cream.
Crush enough Ritz crackers to cover chicken mixture and sprinkle with 1 T of poppy or sesame seeds.
Drizzle with melted oleo and bake at 300° for 40-45 minutes or until done.
recipes.text: Ritz Cracker Chicken. Boil and chop chicken breasts. Place in casserole dish and top with blended soup and sour cream. Crush enough Ritz crackers to cover chicken mixture and sprinkle with 1 T of poppy or sesame seeds. Drizzle with melted oleo and bake at 300° for 40-45 minutes or until done.

recipes.title: Tarts
directions: Mix all ingredients together well.
Place unbaked tart shell on baking sheet and fill (not all the way to top).
Bake at 350° until crust edges are well done.
recipes.text: Tarts. Mix all ingredients together well. Place unbaked tart shell on baking sheet and fill (not all the way to top). Bake at 350° until crust edges are well done.

recipes.title: Basic Oven Fried Fish
ingredients: 1 c. dry bread crumbs or cracker crumbs
directions: Combine salt and milk.
Dip fish in milk, then roll in dry crumbs.
Place portions in a well-greased baking dish and drizzle with melted butter.
Place baking dish on top shelf of preheated 500° oven and bake 10 to 12 minutes or until portions flake easily when tested with a fork.
Makes 4 to 6 servings.
recipes.text: Basic Oven Fried Fish. Combine salt and milk. Dip fish in milk, then roll in dry crumbs. Place portions in a well-greased baking dish and drizzle with melted butter. Place baking dish on top shelf of preheated 500° oven and bake 10 to 12 minutes or until portions flake easily when tested with a fork. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

recipes.title: Fat-Free Chocolate Cake
ingredients: 1/2 c. light or dark corn syrup
directions: Mix flour, sugar, unsweetened cocoa, cornstarch, baking soda and salt in a bowl.
In another bowl, whisk egg whites with water and corn syrup.
Stir wet ingredients into dry and mix until smooth.
Pour into 9-inch square pan, bake at 350° for 30 minutes. Serves 16.
recipes.text: Fat-Free Chocolate Cake. Mix flour, sugar, unsweetened cocoa, cornstarch, baking soda and salt in a bowl. In another bowl, whisk egg whites with water and corn syrup. Stir wet ingredients into dry and mix until smooth. Pour into 9-inch square pan, bake at 350° for 30 minutes. Serves 16.

recipes.title: Orange Fuzzy Jello
directions: Add hot water to jello and stir well.
Add pudding and Cool Whip and mix (use a whisk or fork).
Add mandarin oranges.
(Okay to use juice also if they are Dole.)
Chill.
recipes.text: Orange Fuzzy Jello. Add hot water to jello and stir well. Add pudding and Cool Whip and mix (use a whisk or fork). Add mandarin oranges. (Okay to use juice also if they are Dole.) Chill.

recipes.title: Italian Biscuits
directions: Cream together sugar and butter. Add the remaining ingredients and blend together.
Place in a floured pan shaped in a loaf. Bake 20 to 30 minutes at 375°.
While still hot, cut biscuits to thickness desired.
recipes.text: Italian Biscuits. Cream together sugar and butter. Add the remaining ingredients and blend together. Place in a floured pan shaped in a loaf. Bake 20 to 30 minutes at 375°. While still hot, cut biscuits to thickness desired.

recipes.title: Coconut-Pecan Frosting
directions: Beat egg yolk and milk together in saucepan; add sugar, butter and vanilla.
Cook and stir over medium heat until thickened, about 12 minutes.
Add coconut and pecans.
Cool until thick enough to spread, beating occasionally.
Makes 2 1/2 cups.
recipes.text: Coconut-Pecan Frosting. Beat egg yolk and milk together in saucepan; add sugar, butter and vanilla. Cook and stir over medium heat until thickened, about 12 minutes. Add coconut and pecans. Cool until thick enough to spread, beating occasionally. Makes 2 1/2 cups.

recipes.title: Cauliflower And Broccoli Casserole
directions: Cook the broccoli and cauliflower until half done (you can steam or boil).
Place florets and stalks in the bottom of a casserole dish.
Layer one can of onion rings on top of vegetables.
Beat together soup, milk, salt and pepper.
Pour over vegetables.
Top with remaining can of onion rings.
Bake, uncovered, for about 20 to 25 minutes.
Makes 8 servings.
recipes.text: Cauliflower And Broccoli Casserole. Cook the broccoli and cauliflower until half done (you can steam or boil). Place florets and stalks in the bottom of a casserole dish. Layer one can of onion rings on top of vegetables. Beat together soup, milk, salt and pepper. Pour over vegetables. Top with remaining can of onion rings. Bake, uncovered, for about 20 to 25 minutes. Makes 8 servings.

recipes.title: Potato Soup
directions: In large pan, saute onion and celery in butter.
Add remaining ingredients.
Cook on low heat until potatoes are cooked.
Stir frequently.
recipes.text: Potato Soup. In large pan, saute onion and celery in butter. Add remaining ingredients. Cook on low heat until potatoes are cooked. Stir frequently.

recipes.title: Shrimp Toast
directions: Mix ingredients in bowl until fairly smooth.
Add some sesame seed (optional).
Cut off the crust of bread and quarter.
Spread shrimp mixture evenly on each piece of bread.
Deep-fry at medium heat 1 minute on each side, spread side down first.
recipes.text: Shrimp Toast. Mix ingredients in bowl until fairly smooth. Add some sesame seed (optional). Cut off the crust of bread and quarter. Spread shrimp mixture evenly on each piece of bread. Deep-fry at medium heat 1 minute on each side, spread side down first.

recipes.title: Hot Chicken Salad Deluxe
directions: Cook and dice chickens and mix with all ingredients except cheese and onions.
Bake in 9 x 13-inch casserole dish for 30 minutes at 350°.
Add cheese and onions and bake 15 minutes longer.
recipes.text: Hot Chicken Salad Deluxe. Cook and dice chickens and mix with all ingredients except cheese and onions. Bake in 9 x 13-inch casserole dish for 30 minutes at 350°. Add cheese and onions and bake 15 minutes longer.

recipes.title: Home Style Ribs
ingredients: 4 to 5 lb. boneless spareribs, cut up
2 Tbsp. ground mustard (I just use yellow mustard)
directions: Place half the ribs in a slow cooker. Top with half of the onion. Repeat layers. Combine the remaining ingredients; pour over all. Cover and cook on low for 8 to 9 hours or until ribs are tender. Yields 6 to 8 servings.
recipes.text: Home Style Ribs. Place half the ribs in a slow cooker. Top with half of the onion. Repeat layers. Combine the remaining ingredients; pour over all. Cover and cook on low for 8 to 9 hours or until ribs are tender. Yields 6 to 8 servings.

recipes.title: German Chocolate Pie
directions: Mix all ingredients together and bake in two unbaked pie shells 30 minutes at 350°.
recipes.text: German Chocolate Pie. Mix all ingredients together and bake in two unbaked pie shells 30 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Tuna Casserole
directions: Cook egg noodles in boiling water.
When noodles are done, combine noodles, tuna, celery soup, mushroom soup and mushrooms in a 9 x 13-inch baking pan or dish.
Mix thoroughly.
Bake in a preheated 350° oven for 7 to 10 minutes.
Take out and top with cheese (grated) and favorite cracker crumbs.
Bake until cheese is melted.
Enjoy!
recipes.text: Tuna Casserole. Cook egg noodles in boiling water. When noodles are done, combine noodles, tuna, celery soup, mushroom soup and mushrooms in a 9 x 13-inch baking pan or dish. Mix thoroughly. Bake in a preheated 350° oven for 7 to 10 minutes. Take out and top with cheese (grated) and favorite cracker crumbs. Bake until cheese is melted. Enjoy!

recipes.title: Scalloped Oysters
ingredients: 1/2 c. or 1 stick margarine or butter
directions: Grease a 1-quart casserole dish.
Alternate layers of oysters, crackers and dots of margarine, ending with a layer of crumbs. Add milk until liquid almost reaches top of casserole.
Dot with remaining margarine.
Bake at 350° until brown, about 45 to 60 minutes.
Makes 6 generous servings.
recipes.text: Scalloped Oysters. Grease a 1-quart casserole dish. Alternate layers of oysters, crackers and dots of margarine, ending with a layer of crumbs. Add milk until liquid almost reaches top of casserole. Dot with remaining margarine. Bake at 350° until brown, about 45 to 60 minutes. Makes 6 generous servings.

recipes.title: Onion-Tomato Soup
ingredients: 2 large sweet Spanish onions (about 6 c.), sliced
directions: Peel and slice onions thinly.
Saute in butter in large saucepan.
Add tomatoes, beef broth and spices.
Cook over low heat for 45 minutes.
Serve with toasted French bread.
recipes.text: Onion-Tomato Soup. Peel and slice onions thinly. Saute in butter in large saucepan. Add tomatoes, beef broth and spices. Cook over low heat for 45 minutes. Serve with toasted French bread.

recipes.title: Pastel De Choclo
ingredients: 3 to 4 Tbsp. sugar to sprinkle over (optional)
directions: Drain the corn and cook at low heat for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add the milk slowly; it must be creamy.
Add salt and pepper.
recipes.text: Pastel De Choclo. Drain the corn and cook at low heat for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally. Add the milk slowly; it must be creamy. Add salt and pepper.

recipes.title: Italian Green Beans
ingredients: 2 (10 oz.) pkg. frozen green beans, slightly thawed
directions: Place green beans and water in a 1 1/2-quart casserole.
Add onions, salt and pepper.
Stir.
Dot with butter.
Cover; bake at 350° for 1 hour.
Garnish with onion slices, if desired.
recipes.text: Italian Green Beans. Place green beans and water in a 1 1/2-quart casserole. Add onions, salt and pepper. Stir. Dot with butter. Cover; bake at 350° for 1 hour. Garnish with onion slices, if desired.

recipes.title: Microwave Chicken Noodle Casserole
ingredients: 1 can (10 1/2 oz.) cream of mushroom soup
directions: Cook chicken in microwave for 10 minutes, rotating dish 5 to 10 minutes (High).
Cut meat off bone.
Cook noodles; drain.
Add to meat in casserole dish.
Add cream of mushroom soup.
Heat 4 minutes (High).
Before serving warm, add sour cream and Parmesan cheese.
recipes.text: Microwave Chicken Noodle Casserole. Cook chicken in microwave for 10 minutes, rotating dish 5 to 10 minutes (High). Cut meat off bone. Cook noodles; drain. Add to meat in casserole dish. Add cream of mushroom soup. Heat 4 minutes (High). Before serving warm, add sour cream and Parmesan cheese.

recipes.title: No Bake Cookies
directions: In medium skillet, melt butter and add sugar, cocoa and milk. Bring to boil over medium heat. Stir in peanut butter until smooth. Return to boil. Remove from heat, add oatmeal uncooked. Stir until mixed well.
Spoon onto wax paper and let cool.
recipes.text: No Bake Cookies. In medium skillet, melt butter and add sugar, cocoa and milk. Bring to boil over medium heat. Stir in peanut butter until smooth. Return to boil. Remove from heat, add oatmeal uncooked. Stir until mixed well. Spoon onto wax paper and let cool.

recipes.title: Spiders
directions: Melt caramel chips and chocolate chips in top of double boiler.
Add Chinese noodles and salted peanuts.
Drop by teaspoonfuls on waxed paper.
recipes.text: Spiders. Melt caramel chips and chocolate chips in top of double boiler. Add Chinese noodles and salted peanuts. Drop by teaspoonfuls on waxed paper.

recipes.title: Black Bean Dip
ingredients: 2 c. shredded cheese (Cheddar or mixture of your favorites)
directions: Drain black beans. Pour into 9 x 12-inch pan. Chop onion finely with stems and mix into black beans. Spread sour cream over top of bean mixture; you may use as much or as little sour cream as you like. Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes. Cover with shredded cheese and heat until melted. Serve hot with tortilla chips.
recipes.text: Black Bean Dip. Drain black beans. Pour into 9 x 12-inch pan. Chop onion finely with stems and mix into black beans. Spread sour cream over top of bean mixture; you may use as much or as little sour cream as you like. Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes. Cover with shredded cheese and heat until melted. Serve hot with tortilla chips.

recipes.title: Super Easy Dip
ingredients: 1 full bunch green onions, tops and all, cut small
about 1 c. mayo (not Miracle Whip) or enough to make it moist
directions: Mix together.
Really good served with Ritz crackers.
recipes.text: Super Easy Dip. Mix together. Really good served with Ritz crackers.

recipes.title: Supper In A Skillet
ingredients: 1/4 lb. shell macaroni, cooked and drained
directions: Cook beef in oil until red disappears.
Add onion and celery. Cook until onion is soft.
Add catsup, water, Worcestershire sauce and other seasonings.
Mix well.
Stir in macaroni.
Cover. Simmer about 25 minutes.
Fold in cheese just before serving. Sprinkle with Parmesan and parsley.
Serve hot from skillet.
recipes.text: Supper In A Skillet. Cook beef in oil until red disappears. Add onion and celery. Cook until onion is soft. Add catsup, water, Worcestershire sauce and other seasonings. Mix well. Stir in macaroni. Cover. Simmer about 25 minutes. Fold in cheese just before serving. Sprinkle with Parmesan and parsley. Serve hot from skillet.

recipes.title: Butterscotch Brownies
directions: Sift together flour, baking powder and salt.
Stir in nuts. Melt butter in top of double boiler.
Gradually add sugar and cook for 2 minutes.
Stir a couple of times.
Remove from heat and beat in egg and vanilla.
Stir in nut and flour mixture.
Add chocolate chips, if using.
recipes.text: Butterscotch Brownies. Sift together flour, baking powder and salt. Stir in nuts. Melt butter in top of double boiler. Gradually add sugar and cook for 2 minutes. Stir a couple of times. Remove from heat and beat in egg and vanilla. Stir in nut and flour mixture. Add chocolate chips, if using.

recipes.title: "Lime Punch"
directions: Mix all
together in a 1 gallon jar.
Finish filling to the top with water.
recipes.text: "Lime Punch". Mix all together in a 1 gallon jar. Finish filling to the top with water.

recipes.title: Three-Colored Macaroni Salad
ingredients: 1 small can pitted black olives, drained
directions: Cook
macaroni	according to directions.
Drain and add cold water
and drain again.
Add the rest of the ingredients. Add salami, pepperoni, broccoli or any other meats or vegetables you prefer.
recipes.text: Three-Colored Macaroni Salad. Cook macaroni	according to directions. Drain and add cold water and drain again. Add the rest of the ingredients. Add salami, pepperoni, broccoli or any other meats or vegetables you prefer.

recipes.title: Green Beans And Potatoes
directions: Cover salt pork with water and cook for 20 minutes.
Break beans into 1/2-inch pieces and add to pot.
Cover with water. Cook for 1 1/2 hours.
Add more water, if necessary, to keep beans covered.
Add potatoes and any water necessary to cover vegetables.
Cook another 30 minutes or until potatoes are done. Serve with ham and corn bread.
recipes.text: Green Beans And Potatoes. Cover salt pork with water and cook for 20 minutes. Break beans into 1/2-inch pieces and add to pot. Cover with water. Cook for 1 1/2 hours. Add more water, if necessary, to keep beans covered. Add potatoes and any water necessary to cover vegetables. Cook another 30 minutes or until potatoes are done. Serve with ham and corn bread.

recipes.title: Skillet Steak
ingredients: 10 small new potatoes, cut into quarters (about 1 lb.)
1 1/2 c. green and red pepper chunks
1 lb. trimmed boneless sirloin steak, cut in chunks
directions: In 2-quart casserole, combine potatoes, peppers and water. Cover and microwave on High for 8 to 12 minutes, or until potatoes are tender, stirring twice.
Drain; set aside.
Spray 12-inch nonstick skillet with vegetable cooking spray.
Heat skillet over medium heat.
Add beef chunks.
Cook 4 to 6 minutes until meat is pink; stir frequently.
Add potato mixture and remaining ingredients.
Cook 4 to 5 minutes or until potatoes brown and mixture is hot.
Stir frequently.
Serve hot.
recipes.text: Skillet Steak. In 2-quart casserole, combine potatoes, peppers and water. Cover and microwave on High for 8 to 12 minutes, or until potatoes are tender, stirring twice. Drain; set aside. Spray 12-inch nonstick skillet with vegetable cooking spray. Heat skillet over medium heat. Add beef chunks. Cook 4 to 6 minutes until meat is pink; stir frequently. Add potato mixture and remaining ingredients. Cook 4 to 5 minutes or until potatoes brown and mixture is hot. Stir frequently. Serve hot.

recipes.title: Nacho Pizza
directions: Cut tortillas in quarters, making 16 wedges.
Place vegetables evenly on wedges on 2 baking sheets.
Spoon sauce over vegetables and top with cheese.
Bake at 350° for 15 minutes or until cheese starts to brown.
Serves 10 to 12.
recipes.text: Nacho Pizza. Cut tortillas in quarters, making 16 wedges. Place vegetables evenly on wedges on 2 baking sheets. Spoon sauce over vegetables and top with cheese. Bake at 350° for 15 minutes or until cheese starts to brown. Serves 10 to 12.

recipes.title: Ham, Potato And Onion Casserole
directions: Preheat oven to 350°.
Grease a 2 quart casserole dish. Put white sauce in saucepan; stir in salt, pepper and cheese. Cook over
medium heat, stirring occasionally until cheese is melted. Remove
from
heat;
stir in ham, potatoes and onion. Turn	into casserole
dish;
sprinkle with crumbs and butter. Bake 40 minutes.
recipes.text: Ham, Potato And Onion Casserole. Preheat oven to 350°. Grease a 2 quart casserole dish. Put white sauce in saucepan; stir in salt, pepper and cheese. Cook over medium heat, stirring occasionally until cheese is melted. Remove from heat; stir in ham, potatoes and onion. Turn	into casserole dish; sprinkle with crumbs and butter. Bake 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Sugar Drop Cookies
directions: Sift together dry ingredients.
With electric mixer, cream together butter and shortening.
Add sugar and beat until light and fluffy.
Beat in vanilla and egg.
Add flour and mixture and beat until smooth.
Blend in milk.
Drop by teaspoon onto greased baking sheet.
Flatten with bottom of glass dipped into sugar. Bake at 400° for 12 minutes, until edges are lightly browned. Makes 5 1/2 dozen 2-inch cookies.
recipes.text: Sugar Drop Cookies. Sift together dry ingredients. With electric mixer, cream together butter and shortening. Add sugar and beat until light and fluffy. Beat in vanilla and egg. Add flour and mixture and beat until smooth. Blend in milk. Drop by teaspoon onto greased baking sheet. Flatten with bottom of glass dipped into sugar. Bake at 400° for 12 minutes, until edges are lightly browned. Makes 5 1/2 dozen 2-inch cookies.

recipes.title: Icebox Slaw
directions: Boil the vinegar, vegetable oil, celery seed and salt and pour over cabbage, onions, bell pepper and sugar.
Put in refrigerator. This will keep in refrigerator for 3 weeks.
recipes.text: Icebox Slaw. Boil the vinegar, vegetable oil, celery seed and salt and pour over cabbage, onions, bell pepper and sugar. Put in refrigerator. This will keep in refrigerator for 3 weeks.

recipes.title: Harriett'S Stew
ingredients: 1 large can tomatoes, cut up small
your choice stew meat, ground turkey or hamburger (optional)
directions: Start cooking meat in covered pan, you want some liquid from meat.
Season with garlic powder to taste while cooking.
Heat water in pan after meat is done; scrape pan into stew.
recipes.text: Harriett'S Stew. Start cooking meat in covered pan, you want some liquid from meat. Season with garlic powder to taste while cooking. Heat water in pan after meat is done; scrape pan into stew.

recipes.title: Beets And Horseradish Sauce
directions: Pour enough pure vinegar over to cook through good.
Then can.
recipes.text: Beets And Horseradish Sauce. Pour enough pure vinegar over to cook through good. Then can.

recipes.title: Nibbles
directions: In plastic bag add all ingredients.
Shake well to blend.
Zap for 1 minute in a microwave.
Shake bag again.
Zap for 1 minute more.
Let cool.
Store in a plastic bag or airtight container.
recipes.text: Nibbles. In plastic bag add all ingredients. Shake well to blend. Zap for 1 minute in a microwave. Shake bag again. Zap for 1 minute more. Let cool. Store in a plastic bag or airtight container.

recipes.title: Stuffed Manicotti
ingredients: Italian red gravy (I use my own homemade Italian gravy but you can use Ragu red sauce in a jar)
directions: Chop all seasoning.
Remove sausage from casing and combine with beef.
Brown well in skillet.
Add chopped seasoning.
Saute. Remove from heat.
Add Romano cheese.
Let cool.
Cook manicotti according to directions.
Add 3 raw eggs to the cooked meat.
Add Italian breadcrumbs.
Mix, then stuff manicotti.
Arrange in a baking dish.
Add your favorite Italian red gravy.
Sprinkle with Romano cheese and Mozzarella cheese.
Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes.
recipes.text: Stuffed Manicotti. Chop all seasoning. Remove sausage from casing and combine with beef. Brown well in skillet. Add chopped seasoning. Saute. Remove from heat. Add Romano cheese. Let cool. Cook manicotti according to directions. Add 3 raw eggs to the cooked meat. Add Italian breadcrumbs. Mix, then stuff manicotti. Arrange in a baking dish. Add your favorite Italian red gravy. Sprinkle with Romano cheese and Mozzarella cheese. Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Mom'S Swedish Meatballs
directions: Combine meat, egg, bread crumbs and water.
Blend all; if too dry, add a little water.
If too wet, add more crumbs.
Form into small meatballs; set aside. Combine jams, chili, lemon juice and brown sugar in a pot.
Heat until melted.
Add raisins and stir. Add meatballs; stir and cook on low heat about 1 1/2 to 2 hours.
recipes.text: Mom'S Swedish Meatballs. Combine meat, egg, bread crumbs and water. Blend all; if too dry, add a little water. If too wet, add more crumbs. Form into small meatballs; set aside. Combine jams, chili, lemon juice and brown sugar in a pot. Heat until melted. Add raisins and stir. Add meatballs; stir and cook on low heat about 1 1/2 to 2 hours.

recipes.title: Holiday Mold
ingredients: 1 c. canned crushed pineapple with juice
directions: Mix packages of lemon and lime jello with hot water and let cool.
Add pineapple and juice.
Add sour cream.
Set in a ring mold.
recipes.text: Holiday Mold. Mix packages of lemon and lime jello with hot water and let cool. Add pineapple and juice. Add sour cream. Set in a ring mold.

recipes.title: Tomato Juice Cocktail
directions: Combine ingredients.
Chill 1 hour.
Strain and serve in cocktail glass.
recipes.text: Tomato Juice Cocktail. Combine ingredients. Chill 1 hour. Strain and serve in cocktail glass.

recipes.title: Easy Yeast Rolls
directions: Dissolve yeast in water.
Add biscuit mix and mix well, then knead about 1 minute on a board dusted with biscuit mix (or until smooth).
Shape into rolls and put on lightly greased baking sheet.
Cover with damp cloth and let rise in a warm place about 1 hour.
Bake in preheated oven at 400° for 10 to 12 minutes.
recipes.text: Easy Yeast Rolls. Dissolve yeast in water. Add biscuit mix and mix well, then knead about 1 minute on a board dusted with biscuit mix (or until smooth). Shape into rolls and put on lightly greased baking sheet. Cover with damp cloth and let rise in a warm place about 1 hour. Bake in preheated oven at 400° for 10 to 12 minutes.

recipes.title: Snickerdoodles
directions: Heat oven to 400°.
Mix 1 1/2 cups of sugar, margarine, shortening and eggs in a large bowl.
Stir in flour, cream of tartar, baking soda and salt.
Shape dough by rounded teaspoonfuls into balls.
Mix 3 tablespoons sugar and the cinnamon; roll balls in mixture.
Place about 2 inches apart on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake until set, 8 to 10 minutes.
Immediately remove from cookie sheet.
Makes about 6 dozen cookies.
recipes.text: Snickerdoodles. Heat oven to 400°. Mix 1 1/2 cups of sugar, margarine, shortening and eggs in a large bowl. Stir in flour, cream of tartar, baking soda and salt. Shape dough by rounded teaspoonfuls into balls. Mix 3 tablespoons sugar and the cinnamon; roll balls in mixture. Place about 2 inches apart on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake until set, 8 to 10 minutes. Immediately remove from cookie sheet. Makes about 6 dozen cookies.

recipes.title: Queso Chicken
ingredients: 4 boneless skinless chicken breasts (cut in half)
1 can milder Ro-Tel diced tomatoes and green chilies
directions: Salt and pepper chicken pieces and roll in flour; dip in beaten egg and water mixture and then back in flour. Fry uncovered in hot oil until done; drain on paper towel. Cook rice. Cube Velveeta in a large microwave safe bowl and add Ro-Tel to top; cover loosely and microwave on high for 5 minutes; stir well and continue cooking until melted. Place cooked rice in a Pam sprayed casserole dish. Stir in just enough cheese sauce to moisten rice. Arrange cooked chicken pieces over rice and add more cheese sauce on top.
recipes.text: Queso Chicken. Salt and pepper chicken pieces and roll in flour; dip in beaten egg and water mixture and then back in flour. Fry uncovered in hot oil until done; drain on paper towel. Cook rice. Cube Velveeta in a large microwave safe bowl and add Ro-Tel to top; cover loosely and microwave on high for 5 minutes; stir well and continue cooking until melted. Place cooked rice in a Pam sprayed casserole dish. Stir in just enough cheese sauce to moisten rice. Arrange cooked chicken pieces over rice and add more cheese sauce on top.

recipes.title: Parslied Potatoes
directions: Peel a strip of skin from around the middle of each potato; place potatoes in cold water. Set aside. Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat; add oil. Saute onion and garlic for 5 minutes or until tender. Add broth and 3/4 cup parsley; mix well. Bring to a boil. Place potatoes in a single layer in skillet. Return to a boil; reduce heat. Simmer, covered, for 10 minutes or until potatoes are tender. Remove potatoes with a slotted spoon to serving bowl. Add pepper to skillet; stir. Pour sauce over potatoes. Sprinkle with remaining parsley.
recipes.text: Parslied Potatoes. Peel a strip of skin from around the middle of each potato; place potatoes in cold water. Set aside. Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat; add oil. Saute onion and garlic for 5 minutes or until tender. Add broth and 3/4 cup parsley; mix well. Bring to a boil. Place potatoes in a single layer in skillet. Return to a boil; reduce heat. Simmer, covered, for 10 minutes or until potatoes are tender. Remove potatoes with a slotted spoon to serving bowl. Add pepper to skillet; stir. Pour sauce over potatoes. Sprinkle with remaining parsley.

recipes.title: Spinach Dip
ingredients: 1 (10 oz.) pkg. frozen spinach, thawed, drained and squeezed
2 c. mayonnaise (or 1 c. sour cream and 1 c. mayo)
2 lb. round rye (hollowed out) or chopped up fresh vegetables
directions: Mix well; chill for 2 or more hours and serve.
Pour into center of rye loaf.
Surround outside of loaf with torn up pieces from center of loaf or serve in container surrounded with fresh vegetables.
recipes.text: Spinach Dip. Mix well; chill for 2 or more hours and serve. Pour into center of rye loaf. Surround outside of loaf with torn up pieces from center of loaf or serve in container surrounded with fresh vegetables.

recipes.title: Pasta With Broccoli, Sausage And Tomatoes(Serves 4 To 6)
ingredients: 1 lb. broccoli flowerets, cut into 1/2-inch pieces
2 Tbsp. chopped sun-dried tomatoes (not oil packed)
1 lb. pasta (rigatoni or penne), cook as directed on box
directions: Over medium heat, cook sausage for 2 minutes in 2 tablespoons oil, remove sausage from pan. Add broccoli, garlic, tomatoes, salt, pepper and red pepper to same pan on medium heat 3 minutes, then add cooked sausage and wine. Cook another 3 minutes, scraping bottom of pan, stirring; add chicken stock and bring to a boil. Reduce heat, keeping lid ajar; simmer for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Pasta With Broccoli, Sausage And Tomatoes(Serves 4 To 6). Over medium heat, cook sausage for 2 minutes in 2 tablespoons oil, remove sausage from pan. Add broccoli, garlic, tomatoes, salt, pepper and red pepper to same pan on medium heat 3 minutes, then add cooked sausage and wine. Cook another 3 minutes, scraping bottom of pan, stirring; add chicken stock and bring to a boil. Reduce heat, keeping lid ajar; simmer for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Microwave Hot Fudge Sauce
directions: Mix dry ingredients in a 1-quart casserole.
Stir in water and butter, using water at room temperature.
Cook in microwave for about 1 1/2 minutes, stirring every 30 seconds.
Stir halfway through cooking time.
(This will get quite thick.)
Remove from microwave stirring thoroughly.
Blend in vanilla.
recipes.text: Microwave Hot Fudge Sauce. Mix dry ingredients in a 1-quart casserole. Stir in water and butter, using water at room temperature. Cook in microwave for about 1 1/2 minutes, stirring every 30 seconds. Stir halfway through cooking time. (This will get quite thick.) Remove from microwave stirring thoroughly. Blend in vanilla.

recipes.title: Potato Sausage Casserole
ingredients: chives, salt and pepper to taste
directions: Boil potatoes and set aside.
Melt margarine in saucepan.
Add flour to make a paste. Add milk and bring to a boil to thicken. Add cheese and seasonings.
Pour cheese sauce over potatoes. Slice sausage and place in a 9 x 13-inch casserole dish.
Spoon potatoes over sausage and heat in oven at 350° for 20 minutes.
recipes.text: Potato Sausage Casserole. Boil potatoes and set aside. Melt margarine in saucepan. Add flour to make a paste. Add milk and bring to a boil to thicken. Add cheese and seasonings. Pour cheese sauce over potatoes. Slice sausage and place in a 9 x 13-inch casserole dish. Spoon potatoes over sausage and heat in oven at 350° for 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Stove Top Meat Loaf
ingredients: 1 16 oz. pkg. Stove Top Stuffing (any variety)
1/2 c. Kraft original BBQ sauce, divided in half
directions: Mix water and all ingredients except 1/4 cup of barbecue sauce. Shape meat mixture into oval loaf in a 9 x 13 inch baking dish, top with remaining 1/4 cup barbecue sauce.
Bake at 375° for 1 hour or until center is no longer pink.
Makes 6 to 8 servings.
recipes.text: Stove Top Meat Loaf. Mix water and all ingredients except 1/4 cup of barbecue sauce. Shape meat mixture into oval loaf in a 9 x 13 inch baking dish, top with remaining 1/4 cup barbecue sauce. Bake at 375° for 1 hour or until center is no longer pink. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

recipes.title: Cinnamon Rolls
directions: Mix yeast with 2 cups flour, sugar and salt.
Add margarine, then tap water.
Beat 2 minutes on medium speed (#6 on mixer). Add 1 cup flour.
Beat on high speed until thick and elastic for about 2 minutes.
Turn off mixer.
recipes.text: Cinnamon Rolls. Mix yeast with 2 cups flour, sugar and salt. Add margarine, then tap water. Beat 2 minutes on medium speed (#6 on mixer). Add 1 cup flour. Beat on high speed until thick and elastic for about 2 minutes. Turn off mixer.

recipes.title: Peach-Banana Dessert
directions: Drain peaches, measuring syrup.
Add enough water to measure 1 cup.
Dissolve jello in boiling water.
Add liquid.
Pour into individual dessert dishes; add peaches and bananas.
Chill until set.
Makes 4 cups or 8 servings.
recipes.text: Peach-Banana Dessert. Drain peaches, measuring syrup. Add enough water to measure 1 cup. Dissolve jello in boiling water. Add liquid. Pour into individual dessert dishes; add peaches and bananas. Chill until set. Makes 4 cups or 8 servings.

recipes.title: French Silk Pie
directions: Cream butter, gradually add sugar, cream together well.
Melt chocolate and blend with butter mixture.
Add vanilla.
Add eggs one at a time beating 5 minutes each time (you can use electric mixer if desired).
Pour into cooled crust.
Chill 1 to 2 hours. Top with whipped topping and walnuts to serve.
recipes.text: French Silk Pie. Cream butter, gradually add sugar, cream together well. Melt chocolate and blend with butter mixture. Add vanilla. Add eggs one at a time beating 5 minutes each time (you can use electric mixer if desired). Pour into cooled crust. Chill 1 to 2 hours. Top with whipped topping and walnuts to serve.

recipes.title: Pennsylvania Dutch Cole Slaw
ingredients: 1 medium head green cabbage, shredded (about 8 c.)
directions: In a large bowl, combine cabbage and carrots; set aside.
In a small bowl, combine all remaining ingredients.
Pour over cabbage mixture; toss well and refrigerate overnight.
Yields 12 to 16 servings.
recipes.text: Pennsylvania Dutch Cole Slaw. In a large bowl, combine cabbage and carrots; set aside. In a small bowl, combine all remaining ingredients. Pour over cabbage mixture; toss well and refrigerate overnight. Yields 12 to 16 servings.

recipes.title: Strawberry Cake
ingredients: 3 eggs, added one at a time
directions: Mix cake mix and jello together.
Add remaining ingredients to it.
Mix and bake in a large sheet pan, greased and floured, at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes.
recipes.text: Strawberry Cake. Mix cake mix and jello together. Add remaining ingredients to it. Mix and bake in a large sheet pan, greased and floured, at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Brownie Mix
directions: Mix and store in airtight container.
recipes.text: Brownie Mix. Mix and store in airtight container.

recipes.title: Pasta Salad
ingredients: 1 bag or box Rontini pasta noodles
red or green peppers or both
any other vegetable you might want to put in
directions: Cook noodles; drain.
Put in bowl.
Add all ingredients.
Add Italian dressing and Parmesan cheese and mix well.
recipes.text: Pasta Salad. Cook noodles; drain. Put in bowl. Add all ingredients. Add Italian dressing and Parmesan cheese and mix well.

recipes.title: Brisket
directions: Cover and bake at 350° for 3 hours (until tender).
Cool; refrigerate overnight.
Slice thin.
Reheat before serving (juice good with noodles or gravy).
recipes.text: Brisket. Cover and bake at 350° for 3 hours (until tender). Cool; refrigerate overnight. Slice thin. Reheat before serving (juice good with noodles or gravy).

recipes.title: Creamy Delight
directions: Mix and press into 9 x 13-inch pan.
Bake at 350° approximately 15 minutes.
Cool.
recipes.text: Creamy Delight. Mix and press into 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350° approximately 15 minutes. Cool.

recipes.title: Sad Cake
directions: Mix together Bisquick, brown sugar, oil and eggs.
Add remaining ingredients.
Bake at 325° for 50 minutes.
recipes.text: Sad Cake. Mix together Bisquick, brown sugar, oil and eggs. Add remaining ingredients. Bake at 325° for 50 minutes.

recipes.title: Banana Pudding
directions: Mix pudding with 4 cups of cold milk.
Beat in sour cream. Fold in Cool Whip.
Alternate with vanilla wafers, pudding and bananas.
recipes.text: Banana Pudding. Mix pudding with 4 cups of cold milk. Beat in sour cream. Fold in Cool Whip. Alternate with vanilla wafers, pudding and bananas.

recipes.title: Mahogany Cake
directions: Preheat oven to 375°.
Cream butter and sugar; add 1 egg at a time.
Beat well.
Add flour and baking soda and alternate with 1/2 cup milk.
Heat other 1/2 cup milk and chocolate.
Add while warm; beat well.
Bake at 375° for 35 minutes.
Use 10 x 10-inch pan.
recipes.text: Mahogany Cake. Preheat oven to 375°. Cream butter and sugar; add 1 egg at a time. Beat well. Add flour and baking soda and alternate with 1/2 cup milk. Heat other 1/2 cup milk and chocolate. Add while warm; beat well. Bake at 375° for 35 minutes. Use 10 x 10-inch pan.

recipes.title: Saucy Pork Chops
ingredients: 2 c. extra chunky mushroom and onion spaghetti sauce
directions: In 10-inch skillet, over medium heat, brown chops.
Stir in sauce.
Reduce heat to low.
Cover and simmer 15 minutes.
Serve with rice.
Makes 4 servings.
recipes.text: Saucy Pork Chops. In 10-inch skillet, over medium heat, brown chops. Stir in sauce. Reduce heat to low. Cover and simmer 15 minutes. Serve with rice. Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: Artichoke Dip
directions: Chop artichokes.
Mix with mayonnaise, garlic powder and Parmesan cheese.
Put in glass baking dish.
Put in a 350° oven for 20 minutes, until brown on top.
Serve with warmed wedges of pita bread, or crackers.
recipes.text: Artichoke Dip. Chop artichokes. Mix with mayonnaise, garlic powder and Parmesan cheese. Put in glass baking dish. Put in a 350° oven for 20 minutes, until brown on top. Serve with warmed wedges of pita bread, or crackers.

recipes.title: Rowser'S Famous Melt-Away Teriyaki Steaks
ingredients: 1 c. Dale's steak sauce and marinade
1 large can crushed pineapple in heavy syrup
directions: Blend steak sauce and pineapple in blender until frothy.
Pour over steaks and refrigerate for a minimum of 8 hours.
Grill steaks on barbecue grill.
recipes.text: Rowser'S Famous Melt-Away Teriyaki Steaks. Blend steak sauce and pineapple in blender until frothy. Pour over steaks and refrigerate for a minimum of 8 hours. Grill steaks on barbecue grill.

recipes.title: Great Chocolate Cake
directions: Mix all together.
It's a big cake.
Bake in a tube pan at 350° for 45 to 50 minutes.
Ice with chocolate icing and sprinkle with chopped walnuts.
recipes.text: Great Chocolate Cake. Mix all together. It's a big cake. Bake in a tube pan at 350° for 45 to 50 minutes. Ice with chocolate icing and sprinkle with chopped walnuts.

recipes.title: Play Dough
directions: Boil water, salt and oil.
Add flour and alum, knead.
Makes white play dough.
If want color, add food coloring to oil first and mix well, then follow recipe.
recipes.text: Play Dough. Boil water, salt and oil. Add flour and alum, knead. Makes white play dough. If want color, add food coloring to oil first and mix well, then follow recipe.

recipes.title: Beef Barley Soup
ingredients: 3 to 4 pieces short ribs of beef
directions: Put short ribs in soup pot.
Cover ribs with water.
Bring to boil (do not skim top).
Reduce heat and add remaining ingredients.
Cover with lid and simmer 2 1/2 to 3 hours.
Cook barley separately.
Drain. Cool, then add to soup.
recipes.text: Beef Barley Soup. Put short ribs in soup pot. Cover ribs with water. Bring to boil (do not skim top). Reduce heat and add remaining ingredients. Cover with lid and simmer 2 1/2 to 3 hours. Cook barley separately. Drain. Cool, then add to soup.

recipes.title: Chicken Piccata
ingredients: 4 boneless chicken breasts, halved and skinned
directions: Beat egg with 1 tablespoon lemon juice.
Combine flour, garlic powder and paprika.
Dip chicken into egg mixture, then into flour mixture.
In a skillet, brown chicken in butter or margarine. Dissolve bouillon cubes in water.
Add bouillon broth and the 2 remaining tablespoons of lemon juice to skillet.
Cover skillet and simmer 30 minutes or until chicken is tender.
Serves 4.
recipes.text: Chicken Piccata. Beat egg with 1 tablespoon lemon juice. Combine flour, garlic powder and paprika. Dip chicken into egg mixture, then into flour mixture. In a skillet, brown chicken in butter or margarine. Dissolve bouillon cubes in water. Add bouillon broth and the 2 remaining tablespoons of lemon juice to skillet. Cover skillet and simmer 30 minutes or until chicken is tender. Serves 4.

recipes.title: Spaghetti Pie
ingredients: 1 lb. ground round, browned and drained
2 (8 oz.) cans tomato sauce with garlic
4 c. hot cooked spaghetti (about 8 oz.; uncooked)
1 1/3 c. (5 oz.) extra sharp Cheddar cheese, shredded
directions: Preheat oven to 350°. Mix meat, sauce, salt and pepper; simmer for 20 minutes. In a small bowl, combine sour cream, green onions and cream cheese; set aside. Spray a 2-quart casserole dish with cooking spray; add pasta. Spread the sour cream mixture over the pasta. Add meat mixture next and sprinkle with cheese. Cover and bake for 25 minutes. Uncover and bake
for an additional 5 minutes.
recipes.text: Spaghetti Pie. Preheat oven to 350°. Mix meat, sauce, salt and pepper; simmer for 20 minutes. In a small bowl, combine sour cream, green onions and cream cheese; set aside. Spray a 2-quart casserole dish with cooking spray; add pasta. Spread the sour cream mixture over the pasta. Add meat mixture next and sprinkle with cheese. Cover and bake for 25 minutes. Uncover and bake for an additional 5 minutes.

recipes.title: Hearty Baked Bean Casserole
ingredients: 1-8 oz pkg small pork sausage links
directions: Brown sausages in skillet. Add ground beef, stirring until lightly browned.
Drain off excess fat.
Stir in tomatoes and gravy mix.
In a 2 1/2 or 3 quart casserole, combine meat mixture with beans.
Cut onions into thick slices.
Pierce each with 3 or 4 cloves.
Arrange onion slices on top of casserole and sprinkle with brown sugar. Bake at 350 degrees for about 1 hour.
Serves 6-8.
recipes.text: Hearty Baked Bean Casserole. Brown sausages in skillet. Add ground beef, stirring until lightly browned. Drain off excess fat. Stir in tomatoes and gravy mix. In a 2 1/2 or 3 quart casserole, combine meat mixture with beans. Cut onions into thick slices. Pierce each with 3 or 4 cloves. Arrange onion slices on top of casserole and sprinkle with brown sugar. Bake at 350 degrees for about 1 hour. Serves 6-8.

recipes.title: Pasta Salad
ingredients: 2 c. tri-color rotini, cooked and drained
1/4 c. sliced red onion, peppercorn, Italian or Ranch dressing to taste.
directions: Mix prepared pasta and vegetables in a large bowl.
Add dressing.
Mix lightly.
Refrigerate several hours.
Stir and serve.
recipes.text: Pasta Salad. Mix prepared pasta and vegetables in a large bowl. Add dressing. Mix lightly. Refrigerate several hours. Stir and serve.

recipes.title: Sweet Potato Casserole
directions: Cook, drain and mash potatoes.
Mix all ingredients.
Pour in shallow baking dish.
recipes.text: Sweet Potato Casserole. Cook, drain and mash potatoes. Mix all ingredients. Pour in shallow baking dish.

recipes.title: Hot Fruit Casserole
directions: Drain fruit, reserving 1 cup juice.
Arrange fruit in 9 x 13-inch baking dish.
Combine reserved juice with brown sugar, cornstarch, orange rind, cinnamon and margarine in saucepan. Bring to a boil.
Pour over fruit.
Bake at 375° for 25 minutes.
recipes.text: Hot Fruit Casserole. Drain fruit, reserving 1 cup juice. Arrange fruit in 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Combine reserved juice with brown sugar, cornstarch, orange rind, cinnamon and margarine in saucepan. Bring to a boil. Pour over fruit. Bake at 375° for 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Pecan Tassies
directions: Let cheese and butter soften at room temperature, then blend. Stir in flour.
Chill slightly (about 1 hour).
Shape into 2 dozen 1-inch balls, then place in ungreased mini muffin tins.
Press dough against bottom and sides of cups.
recipes.text: Pecan Tassies. Let cheese and butter soften at room temperature, then blend. Stir in flour. Chill slightly (about 1 hour). Shape into 2 dozen 1-inch balls, then place in ungreased mini muffin tins. Press dough against bottom and sides of cups.

recipes.title: Easy German Chocolate Cake
directions: Grease and flour 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan.
Spread pecans over pan. Sprinkle coconut over pecans.
Mix cake mix according to directions and pour over nuts and coconut.
Melt and mix cream cheese, butter and powdered sugar.
Pour over cake mix before baking.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Easy German Chocolate Cake. Grease and flour 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Spread pecans over pan. Sprinkle coconut over pecans. Mix cake mix according to directions and pour over nuts and coconut. Melt and mix cream cheese, butter and powdered sugar. Pour over cake mix before baking. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Top Hat Pork Chops
ingredients: pork chops or smoke pork chops
directions: Put pork chops in 9 x 13-inch pan.
Top with sliced onion first, then a slice of lemon, 1 tablespoon brown sugar and 1 tablespoon barbecue sauce.
recipes.text: Top Hat Pork Chops. Put pork chops in 9 x 13-inch pan. Top with sliced onion first, then a slice of lemon, 1 tablespoon brown sugar and 1 tablespoon barbecue sauce.

recipes.title: Japanese Fruit Pie
directions: Beat eggs.
Add
melted
oleo, sugar and vinegar.
Beat well. Add pecans, coconut and raisins.
Pour into unbaked pie shell and bake at 300° for 1 hour.
Good!
recipes.text: Japanese Fruit Pie. Beat eggs. Add melted oleo, sugar and vinegar. Beat well. Add pecans, coconut and raisins. Pour into unbaked pie shell and bake at 300° for 1 hour. Good!

recipes.title: Watergate Cake
directions: Grease and flour a Bundt pan.
Bake about 45 minutes at 375° until no imprint remains.
Ice cake.
recipes.text: Watergate Cake. Grease and flour a Bundt pan. Bake about 45 minutes at 375° until no imprint remains. Ice cake.

recipes.title: Reese Cup Cake
directions: Mix together the graham cracker crumbs, margarine, powdered sugar and peanut butter.
Press in bottom of loaf pan or glass pan.
recipes.text: Reese Cup Cake. Mix together the graham cracker crumbs, margarine, powdered sugar and peanut butter. Press in bottom of loaf pan or glass pan.

recipes.title: Tuna Puffs
directions: Add egg yolks in bread and tuna.
Beat egg whites and fold into soup.
Bake in greased muffin tins at 350° for 50 minutes.
recipes.text: Tuna Puffs. Add egg yolks in bread and tuna. Beat egg whites and fold into soup. Bake in greased muffin tins at 350° for 50 minutes.

recipes.title: Winter'S Day Soup
ingredients: 1 pkg. frozen okra, limas and corn
directions: Brown the ground beef in a large pot and don't drain.
Combine with remaining ingredients and simmer at least 1 1/2 hours or all day.
Add extra water, if necessary.
recipes.text: Winter'S Day Soup. Brown the ground beef in a large pot and don't drain. Combine with remaining ingredients and simmer at least 1 1/2 hours or all day. Add extra water, if necessary.

recipes.title: Pasta Salad
ingredients: 1 medium yellow squash, cut in strips
directions: Cook pasta as directed; drain.
(Add a small amount of butter or oil to prevent sticking.)
Saute vegetables in garlic powder and butter about 5 minutes or until crisp-tender.
Add basil, salt and pepper.
Stir into pasta.
Add Italian dressing to taste. Toss well.
Can sprinkle with Parmesan cheese, if desired.
recipes.text: Pasta Salad. Cook pasta as directed; drain. (Add a small amount of butter or oil to prevent sticking.) Saute vegetables in garlic powder and butter about 5 minutes or until crisp-tender. Add basil, salt and pepper. Stir into pasta. Add Italian dressing to taste. Toss well. Can sprinkle with Parmesan cheese, if desired.

recipes.title: Cheddar Swiss Fondue
ingredients: 1/4 c. Chablis or other dry white wine
directions: In 2-quart saucepan over medium heat, cook onion and garlic in hot margarine for 10 minutes, stirring often.
Stir in soup, wine and caraway seed.
Gradually add cheese, stirring until smooth after each addition.
Pour cheese mixture into fondue pot.
Serve with pumpernickel or French bread cubes for dipping.
Makes 2 1/2 cups.
recipes.text: Cheddar Swiss Fondue. In 2-quart saucepan over medium heat, cook onion and garlic in hot margarine for 10 minutes, stirring often. Stir in soup, wine and caraway seed. Gradually add cheese, stirring until smooth after each addition. Pour cheese mixture into fondue pot. Serve with pumpernickel or French bread cubes for dipping. Makes 2 1/2 cups.

recipes.title: Creamy Baked Corn(A Light Corn Pudding)
ingredients: 2 (11 oz.) cans no salt added whole kernel corn, drained
directions: Melt margarine in a heavy saucepan over low heat.
Add flour, stirring until smooth.
Cook 1 minute, stirring constantly. Gradually add milk; cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until mixture is thickened and bubbly.
recipes.text: Creamy Baked Corn(A Light Corn Pudding). Melt margarine in a heavy saucepan over low heat. Add flour, stirring until smooth. Cook 1 minute, stirring constantly. Gradually add milk; cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until mixture is thickened and bubbly.

recipes.title: Small Hungarian Nut Rolls
directions: Mix together butter, milk and eggs.
Crumble yeast into mixture.
Stir well until yeast disappears.
Mix in remaining salt and flour.
No kneading is needed.
Put into greased bowl and refrigerate overnight.
Cover with wax paper or damp towel.
recipes.text: Small Hungarian Nut Rolls. Mix together butter, milk and eggs. Crumble yeast into mixture. Stir well until yeast disappears. Mix in remaining salt and flour. No kneading is needed. Put into greased bowl and refrigerate overnight. Cover with wax paper or damp towel.

recipes.title: Chicken In Yogurt
directions: Clean and skin chicken breasts.
Squeeze lemon onto chicken. Add garlic, yogurt, salt and pepper.
Mix well together.
Allow to marinate overnight.
To cook, chop onion and fry in skillet in olive oil on low heat until golden.
Add cinnamon and chicken mixture.
Simmer on gentle heat until chicken is done.
Sprinkle chopped cilantro on top.
recipes.text: Chicken In Yogurt. Clean and skin chicken breasts. Squeeze lemon onto chicken. Add garlic, yogurt, salt and pepper. Mix well together. Allow to marinate overnight. To cook, chop onion and fry in skillet in olive oil on low heat until golden. Add cinnamon and chicken mixture. Simmer on gentle heat until chicken is done. Sprinkle chopped cilantro on top.

recipes.title: Beef Stroganoff
ingredients: 2 lb. beef tenderloin, cut into 1-inch cubes
directions: Dredge meat with flour; sear in hot fat in large heavy skillet.
Add paprika; stir so meat is colored.
Remove meat.
Add onions, cook over moderate heat until soft.
Add tomato paste; replace meat.
Add beef broth.
Cook or bake, covered, until meat is done (15 minutes if tenderloin is used; 2 hours for less tender meat, such as round steak).
Season to taste.
Mix cornstarch in cold water.
Add to meat mixture.
Simmer until sauce is smooth and thickened.
Turn off heat.
Add some of the hot sauce to sour cream, then stir sour cream into remaining sauce.
Serve with wide noodles.
recipes.text: Beef Stroganoff. Dredge meat with flour; sear in hot fat in large heavy skillet. Add paprika; stir so meat is colored. Remove meat. Add onions, cook over moderate heat until soft. Add tomato paste; replace meat. Add beef broth. Cook or bake, covered, until meat is done (15 minutes if tenderloin is used; 2 hours for less tender meat, such as round steak). Season to taste. Mix cornstarch in cold water. Add to meat mixture. Simmer until sauce is smooth and thickened. Turn off heat. Add some of the hot sauce to sour cream, then stir sour cream into remaining sauce. Serve with wide noodles.

recipes.title: Lo-Cal Broccoli-Ham Soup
directions: In
a
quart
pan,
cook the chopped onion in butter until tender, but not brown.
Stir in flour, chicken bouillon, mustard, thyme
and	pepper.
Add milk and water all at once. Cook
and stir
over	medium heat until thickened and bubbly. Stir
broccoli and
ham
into
saucepan.	Return	to boiling. Reduce
heat; simmer
for
to 6 minutes, until broccoli is tender
and
soup is	heated	through, stirring occasionally. Makes 4 servings. Each serving is 299 calories.
recipes.text: Lo-Cal Broccoli-Ham Soup. In a 3 quart pan, cook the chopped onion in butter until tender, but not brown. Stir in flour, chicken bouillon, mustard, thyme and	pepper. Add milk and water all at once. Cook and stir over	medium heat until thickened and bubbly. Stir broccoli and ham into saucepan.	Return	to boiling. Reduce heat; simmer for 4 to 6 minutes, until broccoli is tender and soup is	heated	through, stirring occasionally. Makes 4 servings. Each serving is 299 calories.

recipes.title: Cheese-Filled Italian Meat Loaf
directions: Preheat oven to 350°.
In large bowl, combine ground beef, eggs, bread crumbs, spaghetti mix and ketchup.
In large, shallow pan, shape into loaf, placing cheese in center and sealing edges tightly.
Bake 50 minutes or until done.
recipes.text: Cheese-Filled Italian Meat Loaf. Preheat oven to 350°. In large bowl, combine ground beef, eggs, bread crumbs, spaghetti mix and ketchup. In large, shallow pan, shape into loaf, placing cheese in center and sealing edges tightly. Bake 50 minutes or until done.

recipes.title: Cheese Ball
directions: Form into ball and cover with chopped pecans.
recipes.text: Cheese Ball. Form into ball and cover with chopped pecans.

recipes.title: Mountain Dew Cake
directions: Mix all ingredients together. Place in a bundt pan. Bake at 350 degrees for 30 minutes or until golden brown.
recipes.text: Mountain Dew Cake. Mix all ingredients together. Place in a bundt pan. Bake at 350 degrees for 30 minutes or until golden brown.

recipes.title: Poor Man'S Steak
directions: Mix everything together except soup.
Press into cookie sheet and refrigerate overnight.
In morning cut into squares, roll in flour and brown in frying pan.
Put in roaster and pour undiluted soup over meat.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Poor Man'S Steak. Mix everything together except soup. Press into cookie sheet and refrigerate overnight. In morning cut into squares, roll in flour and brown in frying pan. Put in roaster and pour undiluted soup over meat. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Banana Bread
directions: Mix as given.
Bake in greased loaf pans at 350° for 40 to 50 minutes.
recipes.text: Banana Bread. Mix as given. Bake in greased loaf pans at 350° for 40 to 50 minutes.

recipes.title: Tenderloin Spinach Salad
directions: Saute tenderloin in butter; add Worcestershire sauce, garlic salt, green onions, mushrooms and parsley and add Parmesan cheese last.
Serve on bed of fresh spinach with Bleu cheese dressing on the side.
Also may be garnished with more cheese and black olives.
recipes.text: Tenderloin Spinach Salad. Saute tenderloin in butter; add Worcestershire sauce, garlic salt, green onions, mushrooms and parsley and add Parmesan cheese last. Serve on bed of fresh spinach with Bleu cheese dressing on the side. Also may be garnished with more cheese and black olives.

recipes.title: Banana Pudding
ingredients: 1 (6 oz.) pkg. instant vanilla pudding mix
directions: Put milk in large bowl and add pudding mix.
Mix on low speed until thick.
Add sour cream and mix well.
Fold in Cool Whip. Place a layer of vanilla wafers on the bottom of large, deep dish and cover with a layer of sliced bananas.
Cover this with half of the pudding mixture.
Repeat with another layer.
To dress it up, sprinkle some vanilla wafer crumbs on top.
Refrigerate until ready to serve.
Serves 6 to 8.
recipes.text: Banana Pudding. Put milk in large bowl and add pudding mix. Mix on low speed until thick. Add sour cream and mix well. Fold in Cool Whip. Place a layer of vanilla wafers on the bottom of large, deep dish and cover with a layer of sliced bananas. Cover this with half of the pudding mixture. Repeat with another layer. To dress it up, sprinkle some vanilla wafer crumbs on top. Refrigerate until ready to serve. Serves 6 to 8.

recipes.title: Gingered Fruit Salad
ingredients: 1 (16 oz.) pkg. frozen unsweetened peaches, thawed
2 Tbsp. frozen orange juice concentrate, thawed
directions: In a large bowl, combine first four ingredients.
In a small jar, stir together remaining ingredients.
Pour over fruits, tossing to blend.
Cover and refrigerate 4 to 8 hours.
Yields 8 servings.
recipes.text: Gingered Fruit Salad. In a large bowl, combine first four ingredients. In a small jar, stir together remaining ingredients. Pour over fruits, tossing to blend. Cover and refrigerate 4 to 8 hours. Yields 8 servings.

recipes.title: Date Bread
directions: Sift dry ingredients together.
Add dates.
Beat eggs and add with milk and shortening to dry ingredients.
Pour in greased loaf pan.
Bake at 350° until good and brown.
Test with knife in center; if it comes out clean, it is done.
recipes.text: Date Bread. Sift dry ingredients together. Add dates. Beat eggs and add with milk and shortening to dry ingredients. Pour in greased loaf pan. Bake at 350° until good and brown. Test with knife in center; if it comes out clean, it is done.

recipes.title: Lush
directions: Press together in a 9 x 13 pan. Bake 12 minutes at 350°; cool.
recipes.text: Lush. Press together in a 9 x 13 pan. Bake 12 minutes at 350°; cool.

recipes.title: Swans Made Easy
directions: In a medium sized saucepan, bring water, butter and salt to a boil.
Reduce heat.
Add the flour all at once.
Stir constantly with a wooden spoon until the mixture leaves the sides of the pan and forms a ball.
Remove from heat.
Beat in eggs one at a time. Dough is ready to shape.
Fun for children to do.
recipes.text: Swans Made Easy. In a medium sized saucepan, bring water, butter and salt to a boil. Reduce heat. Add the flour all at once. Stir constantly with a wooden spoon until the mixture leaves the sides of the pan and forms a ball. Remove from heat. Beat in eggs one at a time. Dough is ready to shape. Fun for children to do.

recipes.title: Squash Casserole
ingredients: onion, salt, pepper and garlic powder to taste
directions: Saute onion and butter.
Drain squash leaving about 1/3 of its juice in each can.
In large bowl, mix together onion, squash, cream of chicken soup, salt, pepper and garlic powder with corn bread.
Bake at 350° for about 30 minutes or until done.
Cheddar cheese may be added on top.
Cook for about 5 more minutes if desired.
recipes.text: Squash Casserole. Saute onion and butter. Drain squash leaving about 1/3 of its juice in each can. In large bowl, mix together onion, squash, cream of chicken soup, salt, pepper and garlic powder with corn bread. Bake at 350° for about 30 minutes or until done. Cheddar cheese may be added on top. Cook for about 5 more minutes if desired.

recipes.title: Pork Chop Supper
directions: Season pork chops; cut into chunks. Cut raw potatoes into chunks. Add potatoes and pork chops into individual packs of aluminum foil. Add hot sauce and butter. Bake at 400° approximately 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Pork Chop Supper. Season pork chops; cut into chunks. Cut raw potatoes into chunks. Add potatoes and pork chops into individual packs of aluminum foil. Add hot sauce and butter. Bake at 400° approximately 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Butterscotch Pie
directions: Blend sugar and flour thoroughly.
Add scalded milk gradually, stirring constantly to obtain a smooth paste.
Add well beaten egg yolks and cook in a double boiler for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add butter and vanilla.
Mix well and pour into the pie shell.
Add meringue and brown.
recipes.text: Butterscotch Pie. Blend sugar and flour thoroughly. Add scalded milk gradually, stirring constantly to obtain a smooth paste. Add well beaten egg yolks and cook in a double boiler for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally. Add butter and vanilla. Mix well and pour into the pie shell. Add meringue and brown.

recipes.title: Chocolate Chip Cake
directions: Combine and mix together all of the ingredients (except the chocolate chips).
Fold in the chocolate chips.
Spoon into a Bundt pan and bake at 325° for 1 hour.
Cool and serve.
recipes.text: Chocolate Chip Cake. Combine and mix together all of the ingredients (except the chocolate chips). Fold in the chocolate chips. Spoon into a Bundt pan and bake at 325° for 1 hour. Cool and serve.

recipes.title: Taco Dip
directions: Blend all ingredients until smooth.
Spread on bottom of 2 round pizza pans or 1 large serving platter.
Sprinkle with finely chopped onion, lettuce, green peppers, tomatoes and black olives. Top with shredded Cheddar cheese.
Serve with Doritos chips.
recipes.text: Taco Dip. Blend all ingredients until smooth. Spread on bottom of 2 round pizza pans or 1 large serving platter. Sprinkle with finely chopped onion, lettuce, green peppers, tomatoes and black olives. Top with shredded Cheddar cheese. Serve with Doritos chips.

recipes.title: Nancy'S Dip
directions: Mix all ingredients together until smooth consistency is attained.
Serve with crackers or chips.
recipes.text: Nancy'S Dip. Mix all ingredients together until smooth consistency is attained. Serve with crackers or chips.

recipes.title: Lincoln'S Favorite Cake
ingredients: 1/2 c. candied pineapple and cherries, chopped fine
directions: Cream butter and sugar.
Sift flour and baking powder together; add to first mixture alternately with milk.
Add almonds and vanilla.
Fold in stiffly beaten egg whites, to which salt has been added.
Bake at 350° in 3 layers in 8 or 9-inch pans for about 25 minutes.
recipes.text: Lincoln'S Favorite Cake. Cream butter and sugar. Sift flour and baking powder together; add to first mixture alternately with milk. Add almonds and vanilla. Fold in stiffly beaten egg whites, to which salt has been added. Bake at 350° in 3 layers in 8 or 9-inch pans for about 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Easy Skillet Dinner
directions: Brown beef and onions in a large skillet.
Pour off any fat and stir in cooled macaroni, tomato sauce, corn, chili powder and salt.
Simmer, stirring occasionally, for 5 to 10 minutes.
Stir in cheese and serve immediately.
Makes 4 servings.
recipes.text: Easy Skillet Dinner. Brown beef and onions in a large skillet. Pour off any fat and stir in cooled macaroni, tomato sauce, corn, chili powder and salt. Simmer, stirring occasionally, for 5 to 10 minutes. Stir in cheese and serve immediately. Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: Freezer Pickles
directions: Mix together the cucumbers, onion, pepper and salt in big mixing bowl.
Set aside 2 hours, then drain.
Mix together vinegar, sugar, celery seed and mustard seed in cooking pan; bring to boil. Set aside.
Let cool.
Pour over cucumbers.
Put in refrigerator 2 or 3 days, then freeze in small amounts.
recipes.text: Freezer Pickles. Mix together the cucumbers, onion, pepper and salt in big mixing bowl. Set aside 2 hours, then drain. Mix together vinegar, sugar, celery seed and mustard seed in cooking pan; bring to boil. Set aside. Let cool. Pour over cucumbers. Put in refrigerator 2 or 3 days, then freeze in small amounts.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Pie Supreme
ingredients: 1/2 c. firmly packed dark brown sugar
directions: Beat egg yolks until thick and lemon colored.
Gradually add brown sugar, beating until thick.
Add pumpkin, milk, salt, cinnamon, nutmeg and ginger, stirring well.
Pour pumpkin mixture into top of a double boiler and bring water to a boil.
Cook over water until mixture is thickened.
Soften gelatin in cold water, add to pumpkin mixture, stirring well.
Set mixture aside to cool. Beat egg whites (at room temperature) until foamy.
Gradually add 1/2 cup sugar, 1 tablespoon at a time, beating until stiff peaks form.
Pour filling into pastry shell.
Chill.
Beat whipping cream until foamy, gradually add powdered sugar, beating until soft peaks form.
Spread whipping cream over filling.
Garnish with additional cinnamon, if desired.
Yields one 9-inch pie.
recipes.text: Pumpkin Pie Supreme. Beat egg yolks until thick and lemon colored. Gradually add brown sugar, beating until thick. Add pumpkin, milk, salt, cinnamon, nutmeg and ginger, stirring well. Pour pumpkin mixture into top of a double boiler and bring water to a boil. Cook over water until mixture is thickened. Soften gelatin in cold water, add to pumpkin mixture, stirring well. Set mixture aside to cool. Beat egg whites (at room temperature) until foamy. Gradually add 1/2 cup sugar, 1 tablespoon at a time, beating until stiff peaks form. Pour filling into pastry shell. Chill. Beat whipping cream until foamy, gradually add powdered sugar, beating until soft peaks form. Spread whipping cream over filling. Garnish with additional cinnamon, if desired. Yields one 9-inch pie.

recipes.title: Spiced Apple Rings
directions: Core apples, but don't peel.
Cut into 1/2-inch thick rings. In skillet over medium heat, heat butter, brown sugar, cinnamon and ginger until butter melts.
Add apples.
Cook 3 to 5 minutes, until apples are golden and fork-tender.
Makes 6 servings.
recipes.text: Spiced Apple Rings. Core apples, but don't peel. Cut into 1/2-inch thick rings. In skillet over medium heat, heat butter, brown sugar, cinnamon and ginger until butter melts. Add apples. Cook 3 to 5 minutes, until apples are golden and fork-tender. Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Shake And Bake
directions: Crush bread into fine crumbs.
Mix with rest of ingredients and store in a tight container.
recipes.text: Shake And Bake. Crush bread into fine crumbs. Mix with rest of ingredients and store in a tight container.

recipes.title: Tuna Cakes
ingredients: 2 small cans tuna fish in water
1 (5 oz.) cream of chicken soup or cream of mushroom soup
directions: Cook Stove Top stuffing as directed on box.
Add oleo and cool.
When cool, add soup, tuna and eggs; mix well.
Make into cakes and brown in oil or oleo of your choice.
ner: cream of chicken soup or cream of mushroom soup
recipes.text: Tuna Cakes. Cook Stove Top stuffing as directed on box. Add oleo and cool. When cool, add soup, tuna and eggs; mix well. Make into cakes and brown in oil or oleo of your choice.

recipes.title: Turkey Chop Suey
ingredients: 1 (5 oz.) can water chestnuts, drained and thinly sliced
directions: In saucepan, cook onions in butter until tender, but not brown. Add turkey, broth, celery and water chestnuts.
Heat to boiling.
Combine water, soy sauce and cornstarch.
Stir into turkey mixture. Cook and stir until thick and bubbly.
Add bean sprouts and heat through. Serve on hot rice.
Sprinkle with roasted almonds.
If desired, pass additional soy sauce.
Makes 4 to 6 servings.
recipes.text: Turkey Chop Suey. In saucepan, cook onions in butter until tender, but not brown. Add turkey, broth, celery and water chestnuts. Heat to boiling. Combine water, soy sauce and cornstarch. Stir into turkey mixture. Cook and stir until thick and bubbly. Add bean sprouts and heat through. Serve on hot rice. Sprinkle with roasted almonds. If desired, pass additional soy sauce. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

recipes.title: Snack
directions: Boil together Karo syrup, sugar and oleo for one minute and then add soda.
Blend well and pour over crackers and peanuts. Bake at 250° for 45 minutes.
Stir a few times while baking.
recipes.text: Snack. Boil together Karo syrup, sugar and oleo for one minute and then add soda. Blend well and pour over crackers and peanuts. Bake at 250° for 45 minutes. Stir a few times while baking.

recipes.title: Buffet Stroganoff
ingredients: 2 lb. boneless sirloin, cut into 1-inch strips
directions: Saute beef in olive oil or butter until brown.
Add mushrooms, peppers and onions.
Saute.
Add beef stock (if stock is made from cubes, reduce salt to 1/2 teaspoon.) Simmer 15 minutes.
Mix flour and sour cream.
Add to beef mixture, stirring well to thicken. Simmer an additional 15 minutes.
Serve over hot buttered noodles. Serves 6 to 8 people.
recipes.text: Buffet Stroganoff. Saute beef in olive oil or butter until brown. Add mushrooms, peppers and onions. Saute. Add beef stock (if stock is made from cubes, reduce salt to 1/2 teaspoon.) Simmer 15 minutes. Mix flour and sour cream. Add to beef mixture, stirring well to thicken. Simmer an additional 15 minutes. Serve over hot buttered noodles. Serves 6 to 8 people.

recipes.title: Cheesy Potato Supreme
ingredients: 1 (32 oz.) pkg. frozen hash brown potatoes
1 to 2 c. crushed corn flake crumbs
directions: Melt 1/2 cup margarine in 3-quart casserole.
Combine potatoes, onion, cheese, sour cream and soup; place in casserole dish.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes; bake covered.
Saute corn flake crumbs in remaining margarine and spread on top of mixture.
Bake for additional 15 minutes, uncovered.
recipes.text: Cheesy Potato Supreme. Melt 1/2 cup margarine in 3-quart casserole. Combine potatoes, onion, cheese, sour cream and soup; place in casserole dish. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes; bake covered. Saute corn flake crumbs in remaining margarine and spread on top of mixture. Bake for additional 15 minutes, uncovered.

recipes.title: Hot Buttered Rum
directions: Melt all ingredients in a saucepan (except ice cream).
Then beat in ice cream.
Put 2 to 3 teaspoons of mixture in a cup of hot water.
Add 1/2 or 1 jigger of rum.
recipes.text: Hot Buttered Rum. Melt all ingredients in a saucepan (except ice cream). Then beat in ice cream. Put 2 to 3 teaspoons of mixture in a cup of hot water. Add 1/2 or 1 jigger of rum.

recipes.title: Potato And Onion Casserole
directions: Place alternate layers of potatoes, onion and margarine in a buttered casserole.
Cover with the mushroom soup.
Bake at 350° until the potatoes and onions are tender.
recipes.text: Potato And Onion Casserole. Place alternate layers of potatoes, onion and margarine in a buttered casserole. Cover with the mushroom soup. Bake at 350° until the potatoes and onions are tender.

recipes.title: Fern'S Damson Rounds
directions: Remove crusts from bread.
Cut 4 rounds from each slice. Spread with cream cheese and top with a dollop of preserves. Great for last minute guests.
Can be varied by using red or green pepper jelly.
recipes.text: Fern'S Damson Rounds. Remove crusts from bread. Cut 4 rounds from each slice. Spread with cream cheese and top with a dollop of preserves. Great for last minute guests. Can be varied by using red or green pepper jelly.

recipes.title: Mistletoe Salad
ingredients: 1 c. chopped green onion (use tops too)
directions: Simmer 2 minutes and cool.
Add to vegetables.
Store in glass jars.
Keeps a long time.
recipes.text: Mistletoe Salad. Simmer 2 minutes and cool. Add to vegetables. Store in glass jars. Keeps a long time.

recipes.title: Bread Sticks
ingredients: 1 tsp. dill weed (it must be dill weed)
directions: Cut bottom half of hot dog bun in 2 sticks. Cut top in 3 sticks. Heat margarine. Add spices to melted margarine. Put bread on cookie sheet. Brush oil over with mixture. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Bake 1 hour and 15 minutes at 250°.
recipes.text: Bread Sticks. Cut bottom half of hot dog bun in 2 sticks. Cut top in 3 sticks. Heat margarine. Add spices to melted margarine. Put bread on cookie sheet. Brush oil over with mixture. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Bake 1 hour and 15 minutes at 250°.

recipes.title: Marinated Tomatoes
directions: Slice tomatoes; put on plate.
Sprinkle garlic and onion onto slices.
Crush crackers and sprinkle over slice.
Put a teaspoon of oil and a teaspoon of vinegar and spread over slices to moisten crackers.
Cover and chill over 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Marinated Tomatoes. Slice tomatoes; put on plate. Sprinkle garlic and onion onto slices. Crush crackers and sprinkle over slice. Put a teaspoon of oil and a teaspoon of vinegar and spread over slices to moisten crackers. Cover and chill over 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Blueberry Muffins
directions: Cream butter and sugar.
Add eggs.
Sift and add flour, baking powder and salt.
Add milk and vanilla.
Add mashed blueberries, then fold in additional blueberries.
Grease a 12 muffin tin. Divide batter into tin.
Sprinkle tops with additional sugar, if desired.
Bake at 375° for 25 to 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Blueberry Muffins. Cream butter and sugar. Add eggs. Sift and add flour, baking powder and salt. Add milk and vanilla. Add mashed blueberries, then fold in additional blueberries. Grease a 12 muffin tin. Divide batter into tin. Sprinkle tops with additional sugar, if desired. Bake at 375° for 25 to 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Hamburg Potato Bake
ingredients: 2 cans cream of chicken soup, or 1 can cream of mushroom and 1 can cream of chicken soup
directions: Brown meat and onion lightly.
Grease casserole.
Place layer of potatoes and sprinkle with salt and pepper; then layer of meat and repeat.
Pour heated soup over top and sprinkle with Parmesan cheese.
Bake at 350° for about one hour or until potatoes are done.
Can also be done at 225° for 2 to 3 hours.
recipes.text: Hamburg Potato Bake. Brown meat and onion lightly. Grease casserole. Place layer of potatoes and sprinkle with salt and pepper; then layer of meat and repeat. Pour heated soup over top and sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Bake at 350° for about one hour or until potatoes are done. Can also be done at 225° for 2 to 3 hours.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Cake Roll
ingredients: 1 tsp. lemon juice or 1/2 tsp. vinegar
directions: Beat eggs at high speed for 5 minutes.
Gradually add sugar. Stir in flour, baking powder, cinnamon and salt.
Stir in pumpkin and lemon juice.
Spoon into greased and floured 15 x 10 x 1-inch pan.
Top with nuts.
Bake at 375° for 15 minutes.
Turn out on towel; sprinkle with powdered sugar.
Starting at narrow end, roll towel and cake together.
Cool.
Unroll for filling.
recipes.text: Pumpkin Cake Roll. Beat eggs at high speed for 5 minutes. Gradually add sugar. Stir in flour, baking powder, cinnamon and salt. Stir in pumpkin and lemon juice. Spoon into greased and floured 15 x 10 x 1-inch pan. Top with nuts. Bake at 375° for 15 minutes. Turn out on towel; sprinkle with powdered sugar. Starting at narrow end, roll towel and cake together. Cool. Unroll for filling.

recipes.title: Fish Casserole
ingredients: fish fillets (enough to cover bottom of flat, 2-quart casserole dish)
directions: Soak fillets in milk for 2 to 3 hours.
Dip in flour and brown in butter.
Place in baking dish.
Saute bell pepper, celery, parsley and green onions in butter until limp.
Add soup, shrimp, mushrooms, lemon juice, milk and seasonings to taste.
Pour over fillets and bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes.
recipes.text: Fish Casserole. Soak fillets in milk for 2 to 3 hours. Dip in flour and brown in butter. Place in baking dish. Saute bell pepper, celery, parsley and green onions in butter until limp. Add soup, shrimp, mushrooms, lemon juice, milk and seasonings to taste. Pour over fillets and bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Lentil Loaf
directions: You may use a little cottage cheese and cereal in place of bread crumbs.
Add a little more lentils.
Add enough crumbs so it is not soupy.
recipes.text: Lentil Loaf. You may use a little cottage cheese and cereal in place of bread crumbs. Add a little more lentils. Add enough crumbs so it is not soupy.

recipes.title: Pickled Walnuts
directions: To each quart of vinegar allow 2 ounces of pepper, 1 ounce of allspice and 1 ounce of ginger.
recipes.text: Pickled Walnuts. To each quart of vinegar allow 2 ounces of pepper, 1 ounce of allspice and 1 ounce of ginger.

recipes.title: Strawberry Pound Cake
directions: Blend well the cake mix, jello and flour.
Add salad oil and eggs, one at a time, also well drained strawberries.
Beat well. Bake 1 hour at 325°.
recipes.text: Strawberry Pound Cake. Blend well the cake mix, jello and flour. Add salad oil and eggs, one at a time, also well drained strawberries. Beat well. Bake 1 hour at 325°.

recipes.title: Cherry Christmas Tree Cake
ingredients: 2 pkg. Butter Recipe golden cake mix
directions: The assembled cake is 9 x 26 inches long.
Preheat oven to 375°.
Combine in a large bowl the cake mixes, eggs, butter and orange juice.
Mix at medium speed for 4 minutes.
Stir in grated peel and pour into prepared pans.
Bake for 35 to 40 minutes. Cool 15 minutes, then remove from pans.
Place completely cooled cakes upside-down and end to end.
Spread 2 cans frosting on top and sides.
Draw a Christmas tree shape and border in the frosting.
recipes.text: Cherry Christmas Tree Cake. The assembled cake is 9 x 26 inches long. Preheat oven to 375°. Combine in a large bowl the cake mixes, eggs, butter and orange juice. Mix at medium speed for 4 minutes. Stir in grated peel and pour into prepared pans. Bake for 35 to 40 minutes. Cool 15 minutes, then remove from pans. Place completely cooled cakes upside-down and end to end. Spread 2 cans frosting on top and sides. Draw a Christmas tree shape and border in the frosting.

recipes.title: Broccoli Casserole
directions: Lightly grease a 13 x 9-inch dish with margarine.
Cook broccoli and drain well.
Make layers of broccoli, flour, thin pats of margarine, salt, pepper and Velveeta cheese strips. Continue layers until dish is full.
Pour 1 cup of milk over casserole.
Then crush 2 cups crackers and 1 stick margarine.
Mix crackers and margarine.
Put on top of casserole.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Broccoli Casserole. Lightly grease a 13 x 9-inch dish with margarine. Cook broccoli and drain well. Make layers of broccoli, flour, thin pats of margarine, salt, pepper and Velveeta cheese strips. Continue layers until dish is full. Pour 1 cup of milk over casserole.
