Then crush 2 cups crackers and 1 stick margarine. Mix crackers and margarine. Put on top of casserole. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Torn Enchiladas
ingredients: 1 can Old El Paso enchilada sauce (can should be slightly larger than the soup cans)
1 pkg. Old El Paso taco seasoning mix
directions: Brown ground beef and add the taco seasoning.
At this point, do not add any water.
Mix in the cans of soup and the enchilada sauce.
You will now need to add enough water to make it soupy. Spoon sauce onto bottom of 9 x 13-inch casserole dish (just enough to cover the bottom).
recipes.text: Torn Enchiladas. Brown ground beef and add the taco seasoning. At this point, do not add any water. Mix in the cans of soup and the enchilada sauce. You will now need to add enough water to make it soupy. Spoon sauce onto bottom of 9 x 13-inch casserole dish (just enough to cover the bottom).

recipes.title: Caramel Apple Delight
directions: Blend first 4 ingredients using electric mixer.
Use as a dip for apples.
Makes 1 cup.
recipes.text: Caramel Apple Delight. Blend first 4 ingredients using electric mixer. Use as a dip for apples. Makes 1 cup.

recipes.title: Watergate Salad
ingredients: 1 (16 oz.) can crushed pineapple in heavy syrup
directions: Prepare instant pudding as directed on package.
Add all remaining ingredients.
Mix well.
Pour into 9 X 13 dish.
Chill until ready to serve.
recipes.text: Watergate Salad. Prepare instant pudding as directed on package. Add all remaining ingredients. Mix well. Pour into 9 X 13 dish. Chill until ready to serve.

recipes.title: Frozen Fruit Delight
directions: Mix all ingredients together and freeze.
recipes.text: Frozen Fruit Delight. Mix all ingredients together and freeze.

recipes.title: Spinach Cheese Squares
directions: Melt butter in a 9 x 13-inch preheated 350° oven.
In a medium bowl,
beat
eggs;
add
flour,
milk, salt and baking powder. Mix well.
Add cheese and spinach;	blend.	Pour into pan.	Bake for
minutes.
Cool
for 10 minutes.
Cut into small
squares to serve for appetizer; large squares to serve for lunch or light supper.
recipes.text: Spinach Cheese Squares. Melt butter in a 9 x 13-inch preheated 350° oven. In a medium bowl, beat eggs; add flour, milk, salt and baking powder. Mix well. Add cheese and spinach;	blend.	Pour into pan.	Bake for 35 minutes. Cool for 10 minutes. Cut into small squares to serve for appetizer; large squares to serve for lunch or light supper.

recipes.title: Twenty-Four Hour Cole Slaw
directions: Place one-half cabbage in large bowl; cover with onions. Add remaining cabbage. Do not mix. Sprinkle sugar over cabbage.
recipes.text: Twenty-Four Hour Cole Slaw. Place one-half cabbage in large bowl; cover with onions. Add remaining cabbage. Do not mix. Sprinkle sugar over cabbage.

recipes.title: Hot Chicken Sandwiches
ingredients: chicken breasts, boiled or baked and sliced (Virginia baked ham slices can also be used with the chicken slices)
toasted bread slices (Pepperidge Farm is good)
directions: Prepare chicken and set aside.
Combine butter, flour, salt, mustard and milk in top of double boiler to make sauce.
(Stir often.)
Add the cheese and cook until melted.
Place chicken slices (and ham slices if using) on toast and pour sauce over. Sprinkle with paprika.
Bake at 350° to 400° on ovenproof plates for 10 minutes.
Top with tomato slices and bacon.
If desired, garnish with chopped green chilies.
recipes.text: Hot Chicken Sandwiches. Prepare chicken and set aside. Combine butter, flour, salt, mustard and milk in top of double boiler to make sauce. (Stir often.) Add the cheese and cook until melted. Place chicken slices (and ham slices if using) on toast and pour sauce over. Sprinkle with paprika. Bake at 350° to 400° on ovenproof plates for 10 minutes. Top with tomato slices and bacon. If desired, garnish with chopped green chilies.

recipes.title: Lemon Lush
directions: Mix margarine, flour and nuts together.
Press in a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Bake at 350° for 10 minutes.
Let cool.
recipes.text: Lemon Lush. Mix margarine, flour and nuts together. Press in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350° for 10 minutes. Let cool.

recipes.title: Sweet 'N Sour Hot Sauce Pape'
directions: * Adjust to taste.
recipes.text: Sweet 'N Sour Hot Sauce Pape'. * Adjust to taste.

recipes.title: Cherry Salad
directions: Mix all ingredients and pour into 9 x 14-inch dish and chill until firm.
recipes.text: Cherry Salad. Mix all ingredients and pour into 9 x 14-inch dish and chill until firm.

recipes.title: Meat Loaf
directions: Mix all ingredients and 1/2 can tomato sauce; shape into loaf. Pour remaining tomato sauce over loaf and bake at 375° for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Meat Loaf. Mix all ingredients and 1/2 can tomato sauce; shape into loaf. Pour remaining tomato sauce over loaf and bake at 375° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Cool Whip Fruit Salad
directions: Drain fruit and fold all ingredients into Cool Whip. Refrigerate until serving time, placing a cherry on top of each serving, if desired.
recipes.text: Cool Whip Fruit Salad. Drain fruit and fold all ingredients into Cool Whip. Refrigerate until serving time, placing a cherry on top of each serving, if desired.

recipes.title: Lo-Cal Almost Snickers - Weight Watchers
directions: Mix peanut butter, Alba hot cocoa mix, mashed banana, Equal, vanilla flavoring and Grape-Nuts.
Form into a candy bar and freeze.
recipes.text: Lo-Cal Almost Snickers - Weight Watchers. Mix peanut butter, Alba hot cocoa mix, mashed banana, Equal, vanilla flavoring and Grape-Nuts. Form into a candy bar and freeze.

recipes.title: Peppered Steak
directions: Brown steak that has been cut in 1/4-inch strips in butter in a heavy skillet on medium heat.
Add onion soup mix and water. Simmer abut an hour.
Add peppers, onion and Worcestershire sauce. Simmer.
Serve on rice.
recipes.text: Peppered Steak. Brown steak that has been cut in 1/4-inch strips in butter in a heavy skillet on medium heat. Add onion soup mix and water. Simmer abut an hour. Add peppers, onion and Worcestershire sauce. Simmer. Serve on rice.

recipes.title: No-Crust Pepperoni-Cheese Pie
directions: Preheat oven to 400°.
Sprinkle cheese and pepperoni on bottom of 9-inch pie plate.
Set aside.
Beat eggs, milk and basil with wire whisk until well blended.
Pour egg mixture over cheese and pepperoni.
Bake 25 minutes or until knife inserted in center of pie comes out clean.
Makes 6 servings, 240 calories each.
recipes.text: No-Crust Pepperoni-Cheese Pie. Preheat oven to 400°. Sprinkle cheese and pepperoni on bottom of 9-inch pie plate. Set aside. Beat eggs, milk and basil with wire whisk until well blended. Pour egg mixture over cheese and pepperoni. Bake 25 minutes or until knife inserted in center of pie comes out clean. Makes 6 servings, 240 calories each.

recipes.title: Russian Tea
directions: Mix tea, fruit juices,	red candies and sugar to taste. Heat to serving	temperature.
Add
ginger ale.	Yield:	about 25 cups.
recipes.text: Russian Tea. Mix tea, fruit juices,	red candies and sugar to taste. Heat to serving	temperature. Add ginger ale.	Yield:	about 25 cups.

recipes.title: Chess Pie
directions: Mix all together, except crust, and put in an unbaked pie crust.
Bake at 300° for 35 to 40 minutes.
recipes.text: Chess Pie. Mix all together, except crust, and put in an unbaked pie crust. Bake at 300° for 35 to 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Sausage And Peppers With Rice
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup
1 c. (4 oz.) grated sharp Cheddar cheese
directions: In large skillet, cook sausage, onion and green pepper until meat is browned and vegetables are tender.
Drain off all grease.
recipes.text: Sausage And Peppers With Rice. In large skillet, cook sausage, onion and green pepper until meat is browned and vegetables are tender. Drain off all grease.

recipes.title: Microwave Fresh Strawberry Jam
directions: In a 3-quart casserole, place berries and pectin.
Stir well. Cover with plastic wrap.
Microwave at High 8 to 10 minutes until mixture is at full rolling boil.
Add sugar to boiling berries and stir well.
recipes.text: Microwave Fresh Strawberry Jam. In a 3-quart casserole, place berries and pectin. Stir well. Cover with plastic wrap. Microwave at High 8 to 10 minutes until mixture is at full rolling boil. Add sugar to boiling berries and stir well.

recipes.title: Steak Champignon
directions: In 8-inch nonstick skillet, heat margarine over medium heat until bubbly and hot; add mushrooms and saute until browned. Reduce heat to low; add wine and cook, stirring frequently, for 2 minutes, stirring constantly, until heated.
Remove skillet from heat; set aside and keep sauce warm.
On rack in broiling pan, broil steaks, turning once, until done to taste.
Remove steaks to serving platter; pour sauce over steaks or transfer sauce to gravy boat and serve with steaks.
Makes 2 servings.
Contains 353 calories and 170 mg sodium.
recipes.text: Steak Champignon. In 8-inch nonstick skillet, heat margarine over medium heat until bubbly and hot; add mushrooms and saute until browned. Reduce heat to low; add wine and cook, stirring frequently, for 2 minutes, stirring constantly, until heated. Remove skillet from heat; set aside and keep sauce warm. On rack in broiling pan, broil steaks, turning once, until done to taste. Remove steaks to serving platter; pour sauce over steaks or transfer sauce to gravy boat and serve with steaks. Makes 2 servings. Contains 353 calories and 170 mg sodium.

recipes.title: Grandma Coyne'S Fluffy White Frosting
directions: Combine all ingredients in top of double boiler.
Beat with electric mixer until thoroughly blended.
Place over rapidly boiling water (bottom of double boiler) and continue beating until frosting stands in soft peaks.
Add vanilla.
A wonderful frosting for your favorite chocolate cake.
recipes.text: Grandma Coyne'S Fluffy White Frosting. Combine all ingredients in top of double boiler. Beat with electric mixer until thoroughly blended. Place over rapidly boiling water (bottom of double boiler) and continue beating until frosting stands in soft peaks. Add vanilla. A wonderful frosting for your favorite chocolate cake.

recipes.title: Sweet Potato Casserole
directions: Preheat oven to 350°.
Combine potatoes, 1/3 cup margarine, eggs, sugar and vanilla in mixer bowl.
Beat until smooth.
Spoon into buttered 2-quart baking dish.
Combine brown sugar, flour, coconut and pecans in bowl.
Cut in 1/3 cup margarine.
Sprinkle over casserole.
Bake 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Sweet Potato Casserole. Preheat oven to 350°. Combine potatoes, 1/3 cup margarine, eggs, sugar and vanilla in mixer bowl. Beat until smooth. Spoon into buttered 2-quart baking dish. Combine brown sugar, flour, coconut and pecans in bowl. Cut in 1/3 cup margarine. Sprinkle over casserole. Bake 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Vegetable Pull Apart Bread
directions: Cut biscuits into fourths.
Saute in oleo, onion and green pepper.
Cook 1/2 pound bacon crisp and crumble it.
Mix bacon with vegetables and biscuits.
Add Parmesan cheese.
Pour into ungreased Bundt pan.
Cook in 400° oven for 30 minutes.
(Ham can be substituted for bacon.)
recipes.text: Vegetable Pull Apart Bread. Cut biscuits into fourths. Saute in oleo, onion and green pepper. Cook 1/2 pound bacon crisp and crumble it. Mix bacon with vegetables and biscuits. Add Parmesan cheese. Pour into ungreased Bundt pan. Cook in 400° oven for 30 minutes. (Ham can be substituted for bacon.)

recipes.title: Ready The Night Before Hot Dish
ingredients: 2 1/2 c. cooked chicken, turkey or ham, cut up
directions: Mix all ingredients together. Pour into 9 x 13-inch pan. Cover with heavy foil several hours or overnight.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Ready The Night Before Hot Dish. Mix all ingredients together. Pour into 9 x 13-inch pan. Cover with heavy foil several hours or overnight. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Chili Corn Chowder
ingredients: 1 lb. lean ground beef, browned and drained
directions: Brown ground beef and drain any fat. Saute onions and green pepper. Add all ingredients. Heat to boiling. Then reduce heat and simmer for 30 minutes, covered. Serve with grated cheese on top.
recipes.text: Chili Corn Chowder. Brown ground beef and drain any fat. Saute onions and green pepper. Add all ingredients. Heat to boiling. Then reduce heat and simmer for 30 minutes, covered. Serve with grated cheese on top.

recipes.title: French Onion Soup
directions: Fry onions slowly in butter until dark brown.
Add water and bouillon.
Salt and pepper to taste and add sugar.
Thicken with flour.
Serve with grated cheese.
recipes.text: French Onion Soup. Fry onions slowly in butter until dark brown. Add water and bouillon. Salt and pepper to taste and add sugar. Thicken with flour. Serve with grated cheese.

recipes.title: Delicious Banana Pudding
ingredients: 3 small or 2 large boxes vanilla instant pudding
directions: Mix pudding mix and milk.
Add sour cream and 1/2 of Cool Whip.
Beat well.
Layer wafers, bananas and pudding.
Top with remainder of Cool Whip and wafers.
This makes a large dish.
May be halved for a small family.
recipes.text: Delicious Banana Pudding. Mix pudding mix and milk. Add sour cream and 1/2 of Cool Whip. Beat well. Layer wafers, bananas and pudding. Top with remainder of Cool Whip and wafers. This makes a large dish. May be halved for a small family.

recipes.title: Morning Glory Muffins
directions: In large mixing bowl, combine flour, sugar, baking soda, cinnamon and salt.
Stir in carrot, raisins, coconut and pecans.
recipes.text: Morning Glory Muffins. In large mixing bowl, combine flour, sugar, baking soda, cinnamon and salt. Stir in carrot, raisins, coconut and pecans.

recipes.title: Cranberry Pot Roast
ingredients: 3 to 4 lb. beef pot roast (sirloin tip is best)
directions: Combine the flour, salt and pepper and rub onto the roast. (Make more mixture if necessary to cover the roast.)
In Dutch oven, slowly brown the meat on all sides in 2 tablespoons hot shortening or salad oil.
Add the cloves, cinnamon and 1/4 cup water.
Cover tightly and simmer about 2 1/2 hours or until tender, adding small amount of water if necessary.
recipes.text: Cranberry Pot Roast. Combine the flour, salt and pepper and rub onto the roast. (Make more mixture if necessary to cover the roast.) In Dutch oven, slowly brown the meat on all sides in 2 tablespoons hot shortening or salad oil. Add the cloves, cinnamon and 1/4 cup water. Cover tightly and simmer about 2 1/2 hours or until tender, adding small amount of water if necessary.

recipes.title: Hot Chicken Salad
directions: Make sure
chicken
is cooked completely.
Mix chicken, celery, onion, almonds
and
salt. Add lemon juice and mustard to mayonnaise.
Fold
in chicken mixture.
Put in greased 13 x 9-inch casserole
dish.
Sprinkle with chips and cheese.
Bake at 375° for 25 minutes.
recipes.text: Hot Chicken Salad. Make sure chicken is cooked completely. Mix chicken, celery, onion, almonds and salt. Add lemon juice and mustard to mayonnaise. Fold in chicken mixture. Put in greased 13 x 9-inch casserole dish. Sprinkle with chips and cheese. Bake at 375° for 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Tuna Fish Casserole
ingredients: 1 can cream of mushroom soup or cream of chicken soup
directions: Cook noodles in unsalted water and drain.
Mix with soup, milk, tuna, cheese and onion.
Pour into greased 1 1/2-quart baking dish.
Top with broken potato chips or grated cheese.
Bake in hot oven at 425° until bubbly hot, about 15 minutes.
ner: cream of mushroom soup or cream of chicken soup
recipes.text: Tuna Fish Casserole. Cook noodles in unsalted water and drain. Mix with soup, milk, tuna, cheese and onion. Pour into greased 1 1/2-quart baking dish. Top with broken potato chips or grated cheese. Bake in hot oven at 425° until bubbly hot, about 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Recital Cookies
directions: Cream butter or margarine.
Add sugar, water and vanilla. Sift flour and salt.
Add to butter mixture.
Mix well.
Add nuts. Roll into small balls and bake at 350° for 20 minutes on an ungreased cookie sheet.
Roll in powdered sugar while still warm.
recipes.text: Recital Cookies. Cream butter or margarine. Add sugar, water and vanilla. Sift flour and salt. Add to butter mixture. Mix well. Add nuts. Roll into small balls and bake at 350° for 20 minutes on an ungreased cookie sheet. Roll in powdered sugar while still warm.

recipes.title: Chicken Vegetable Soup
directions: In 3-quart saucepan, heat hot margarine.
Cook onion with thyme and garlic powder until tender, stirring often.
Add broth, corn, green beans and tomatoes.
Heat to boiling.
Cook over low heat 5 minutes or until vegetables are tender.
Add chicken.
Heat thoroughly.
Stir occasionally.
Serves 5.
recipes.text: Chicken Vegetable Soup. In 3-quart saucepan, heat hot margarine. Cook onion with thyme and garlic powder until tender, stirring often. Add broth, corn, green beans and tomatoes. Heat to boiling. Cook over low heat 5 minutes or until vegetables are tender. Add chicken. Heat thoroughly. Stir occasionally. Serves 5.

recipes.title: Hot Crawfish Dip
directions: Mix margarine and cream cheese in large mixing bowl until smooth.
Add seasonings and beat until fluffy.
Stir in minced crawfish.
Spoon into ovenproof glass dish and heat at 350° until just hot throughout.
Serve with sourdough bread or Melba toast. Serves 20.
recipes.text: Hot Crawfish Dip. Mix margarine and cream cheese in large mixing bowl until smooth. Add seasonings and beat until fluffy. Stir in minced crawfish. Spoon into ovenproof glass dish and heat at 350° until just hot throughout. Serve with sourdough bread or Melba toast. Serves 20.

recipes.title: Old Fashioned Oatmeal Cookies
ingredients: 1 tsp. baking soda (I dissolve this in 2 tsp. hot water)
directions: Heat oven to 375°.
Beat butter and sugars until creamy.
Add eggs, milk and vanilla; beat well.
Add flour and baking soda; mix well.
Stir in oats, nuts and coconut.
(I bake the first half of the cookie dough without coconut and then add the coconut to the second half.)
recipes.text: Old Fashioned Oatmeal Cookies. Heat oven to 375°. Beat butter and sugars until creamy. Add eggs, milk and vanilla; beat well. Add flour and baking soda; mix well. Stir in oats, nuts and coconut. (I bake the first half of the cookie dough without coconut and then add the coconut to the second half.)

recipes.title: Corn Casserole
ingredients: 1 can whole kernel corn with juice
directions: Mix all ingredients together except cheese and pour into 1 1/2-quart dish.
Bake 45 to 50 minutes at 350°.
Add grated cheese the last ten minutes.
recipes.text: Corn Casserole. Mix all ingredients together except cheese and pour into 1 1/2-quart dish. Bake 45 to 50 minutes at 350°. Add grated cheese the last ten minutes.

recipes.title: Sausage Roll
ingredients: 2 loves frozen bread, thawed and rolled out
directions: Fry, crumble and then drain both sausages.
Sprinkle sausages and cheese over rolled out dough.
Roll up to make a ring.
Brush over the top with beaten egg.
Bake at 350° until golden brown.
recipes.text: Sausage Roll. Fry, crumble and then drain both sausages. Sprinkle sausages and cheese over rolled out dough. Roll up to make a ring. Brush over the top with beaten egg. Bake at 350° until golden brown.

recipes.title: Meat Loaf
directions: Combine all ingredients, mixing well.
Bake at 400° for 1 hour and 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Meat Loaf. Combine all ingredients, mixing well. Bake at 400° for 1 hour and 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Yum-A-Setta
ingredients: 1 can cream of chicken soup, undiluted
directions: Brown hamburger with onion; drain.
Add brown sugar and tomato soup.
Salt and pepper to taste.
Mix well.
Cook noodles; drain and mix with cream of chicken soup.
recipes.text: Yum-A-Setta. Brown hamburger with onion; drain. Add brown sugar and tomato soup. Salt and pepper to taste. Mix well. Cook noodles; drain and mix with cream of chicken soup.

recipes.title: M&M Cookies
ingredients: 1 1/2 c. M&M's plain chocolate candies (3/4 lb. pkg.)
directions: Cream shortening, sugars, eggs and vanilla thoroughly.
Sift together flour, soda and salt.
Add dry ingredients gradually to creamed mixture, mix well.
Stir in 1/2 cup M&M's candies; reserve remaining candies for decorating.
Drop by teaspoon on ungreased baking sheet.
Decorate tops of cookies with remaining M&M's candies.
Bake at 375° for 10 to 12 minutes or until golden brown. After baking some of the candies may be slightly cracked.
This adds texture and interest to your cookies, still the same delightful flavor.
Makes about 6 dozen 2 1/2-inch cookies.
recipes.text: M&M Cookies. Cream shortening, sugars, eggs and vanilla thoroughly. Sift together flour, soda and salt. Add dry ingredients gradually to creamed mixture, mix well. Stir in 1/2 cup M&M's candies; reserve remaining candies for decorating. Drop by teaspoon on ungreased baking sheet. Decorate tops of cookies with remaining M&M's candies. Bake at 375° for 10 to 12 minutes or until golden brown. After baking some of the candies may be slightly cracked. This adds texture and interest to your cookies, still the same delightful flavor. Makes about 6 dozen 2 1/2-inch cookies.

recipes.title: Cheese Straws
directions: Combine all ingredients and press through a cookie press or roll mixture out thin and cut in strips.
Bake at 275° until slightly brown.
recipes.text: Cheese Straws. Combine all ingredients and press through a cookie press or roll mixture out thin and cut in strips. Bake at 275° until slightly brown.

recipes.title: Dark Fruit Cake
directions: Mix butter and sugar.
Mix all fruit with all flour.
Add the fruit and flour mixture to butter mixture.
Add eggs, then add spices.
Pour mixture into tube pans that have been greased and lined with brown paper.
Garnish cakes before cooking with pineapple (glazed) and cherries (glazed).
Cook about 2 1/2 to 3 hours at 250°.
Put pan of water under the cakes in the oven for moisture.
Makes two cakes.
recipes.text: Dark Fruit Cake. Mix butter and sugar. Mix all fruit with all flour. Add the fruit and flour mixture to butter mixture. Add eggs, then add spices. Pour mixture into tube pans that have been greased and lined with brown paper. Garnish cakes before cooking with pineapple (glazed) and cherries (glazed). Cook about 2 1/2 to 3 hours at 250°. Put pan of water under the cakes in the oven for moisture. Makes two cakes.

recipes.title: Graham Cracker Cupcakes
directions: Cream oleo, sugar and egg yolks together.
Add milk, walnuts or pecans, vanilla and crackers.
Beat egg whites until fluffy, about 2 minutes.
Fold into batter with spoon.
Bake in lined muffin tin for 15 minutes at 400°.
recipes.text: Graham Cracker Cupcakes. Cream oleo, sugar and egg yolks together. Add milk, walnuts or pecans, vanilla and crackers. Beat egg whites until fluffy, about 2 minutes. Fold into batter with spoon. Bake in lined muffin tin for 15 minutes at 400°.

recipes.title: Curried Fruit
directions: Drain juice from all fruits.
Place in 8-inch pan.
Combine brown sugar and curry powder and sprinkle over fruit.
Dot with butter.
Let set at least 30 minutes, longer is better and bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Curried Fruit. Drain juice from all fruits. Place in 8-inch pan. Combine brown sugar and curry powder and sprinkle over fruit. Dot with butter. Let set at least 30 minutes, longer is better and bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Superb Doughnuts
directions: Mix together first 3 ingredients.
Sift dry ingredients together and add to shortening.
Mix alternately with milk. Dough will be very soft.
To avoid sticking, rub flour thoroughly with heavy canvas cloth.
Turn dough onto cloth, then fold the four corners, one at a time, over the soft dough to lightly coat with flour.
With as little handling as possible, roll dough 3/4-inch thick.
After rolling, let stand 15 minutes before cutting to make doughnuts easier to handle (this is important). Cut with floured 2 1/2-inch or 3-inch doughnut cutter.
Fry until brown in hot fat (375°), turning when first crack appears (turn with spoon handle to avoid piercing doughnuts).
Takes about 1 1/2 minutes for total frying of doughnuts.
Drain on absorbent paper. Makes 2 to 2 1/2 dozen.
recipes.text: Superb Doughnuts. Mix together first 3 ingredients. Sift dry ingredients together and add to shortening. Mix alternately with milk. Dough will be very soft. To avoid sticking, rub flour thoroughly with heavy canvas cloth. Turn dough onto cloth, then fold the four corners, one at a time, over the soft dough to lightly coat with flour. With as little handling as possible, roll dough 3/4-inch thick. After rolling, let stand 15 minutes before cutting to make doughnuts easier to handle (this is important). Cut with floured 2 1/2-inch or 3-inch doughnut cutter. Fry until brown in hot fat (375°), turning when first crack appears (turn with spoon handle to avoid piercing doughnuts). Takes about 1 1/2 minutes for total frying of doughnuts. Drain on absorbent paper. Makes 2 to 2 1/2 dozen.

recipes.title: Irish Soda Bread
directions: Heat oven to 350°.
Grease a 9 or 10-inch cast-iron baking sheet.
Combine flour, sugar, baking soda, baking powder and salt in a large bowl.
Make a well in the center.
In a small bowl combine butter, buttermilk and egg.
Add the liquids to the dry ingredients, pouring it into the well and stirring to form a soft dough.
Add raisins and mix lightly.
With lightly floured hands, shape into a ball on a baking sheet.
Bake for 50 to 60 minutes.
recipes.text: Irish Soda Bread. Heat oven to 350°. Grease a 9 or 10-inch cast-iron baking sheet. Combine flour, sugar, baking soda, baking powder and salt in a large bowl. Make a well in the center. In a small bowl combine butter, buttermilk and egg. Add the liquids to the dry ingredients, pouring it into the well and stirring to form a soft dough. Add raisins and mix lightly. With lightly floured hands, shape into a ball on a baking sheet. Bake for 50 to 60 minutes.

recipes.title: Cajun Chicken Pasta
ingredients: 3/4 lb. boneless, skinless chicken breasts, cut into pieces
directions: Cook pasta according to package directions to al dente stage. Saute chicken in margarine until browned.
Remove from skillet. Saute mushrooms, green onions, garlic and parsley.
Mix water and cornstarch.
Add to vegetable mixture.
Cook and stir until thickened slightly.
Stir in chicken and pasta.
Simmer a few minutes.
Correct seasoning by adding more Cajun Magic if you want it hotter or salt it if it needs more flavor, but you don't want it too hot.
recipes.text: Cajun Chicken Pasta. Cook pasta according to package directions to al dente stage. Saute chicken in margarine until browned. Remove from skillet. Saute mushrooms, green onions, garlic and parsley. Mix water and cornstarch. Add to vegetable mixture. Cook and stir until thickened slightly. Stir in chicken and pasta. Simmer a few minutes. Correct seasoning by adding more Cajun Magic if you want it hotter or salt it if it needs more flavor, but you don't want it too hot.

recipes.title: Beverly'S Sugar Cookies
directions: Combine sugars, margarine and oil.
Add eggs.
Sift flour and dry ingredients.
Add vanilla.
Mix well.
Add to sugar mixture. Roll into balls the size of a walnut.
Roll in granulated sugar. Place on greased cookie sheet.
Flatten with glass dipped in sugar. Bake at 350° for 10 to 12 minutes.
Yields 5 dozen.
recipes.text: Beverly'S Sugar Cookies. Combine sugars, margarine and oil. Add eggs. Sift flour and dry ingredients. Add vanilla. Mix well. Add to sugar mixture. Roll into balls the size of a walnut. Roll in granulated sugar. Place on greased cookie sheet. Flatten with glass dipped in sugar. Bake at 350° for 10 to 12 minutes. Yields 5 dozen.

recipes.title: Savory Ham And Kraut Puff
ingredients: 1/2 lb. fully cooked ham, cut into 1/2-inch strips
2/3 c. canned sauerkraut, rinsed, drained and snipped
1/4 c. low calorie Italian salad dressing
directions: For Puff:
Grease a 9-inch pie plate with the butter or margarine.
In a blender container or food processor bowl, place eggs, milk and flour.
Cover; blend 30 seconds.
Pour batter into pie plate.
Bake in a 450° oven for 15 minutes.
Reduce oven temperature to 350°.
Bake 5 to 10 minutes more.
recipes.text: Savory Ham And Kraut Puff. For Puff: Grease a 9-inch pie plate with the butter or margarine. In a blender container or food processor bowl, place eggs, milk and flour. Cover; blend 30 seconds. Pour batter into pie plate. Bake in a 450° oven for 15 minutes. Reduce oven temperature to 350°. Bake 5 to 10 minutes more.

recipes.title: Mandarin Chicken With Noodles
ingredients: 1 lb. skinless, boneless chicken breast halves, cut into bite size strips
1 (3 oz.) pkg. Oriental noodles with chicken flavor packet
1/4 c. bottled sweet and sour sauce
1 (11 oz.) can mandarin orange sections, drained
directions: Spray a large skillet with nonstick coating.
Preheat skillet over medium heat.
Stir-fry chicken, half at a time, about 3 minutes or until no longer pink; remove.
Break up the Oriental noodles (set flavor packet aside).
Add noodles, zucchini, celery, garlic and 1 cup of water to skillet.
Bring to boiling; reduce heat.
Cover; simmer 3 to 5 minutes or until noodles and vegetables are tender.
Stir in chicken, the flavor packet contents, sweet and sour sauce and peanuts; heat through.
Top each serving with orange sections.
Makes 4 servings.
recipes.text: Mandarin Chicken With Noodles. Spray a large skillet with nonstick coating. Preheat skillet over medium heat. Stir-fry chicken, half at a time, about 3 minutes or until no longer pink; remove. Break up the Oriental noodles (set flavor packet aside). Add noodles, zucchini, celery, garlic and 1 cup of water to skillet. Bring to boiling; reduce heat. Cover; simmer 3 to 5 minutes or until noodles and vegetables are tender. Stir in chicken, the flavor packet contents, sweet and sour sauce and peanuts; heat through. Top each serving with orange sections. Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: Chicken Pot Pie
directions: Stew and debone chicken (save the broth).
Mix soup and 2 cups broth and pour over chicken, that has been placed into a 9 x 13-inch baking pan or dish.
recipes.text: Chicken Pot Pie. Stew and debone chicken (save the broth). Mix soup and 2 cups broth and pour over chicken, that has been placed into a 9 x 13-inch baking pan or dish.

recipes.title: Christmas Or Southern Kisses
ingredients: 1 or 2 c. nuts (any kind; large pieces)
directions: Beat whites with cream of tartar until past frothy.
Add sugar (1 tablespoon at a time).
Continue to beat until it loses glossiness.
Add vanilla.
Fold in nut meats.
Drop by tablespoon or less on brown paper or cookie sheet.
Place in 400° oven; close door and immediately turn off oven.
Leave in oven overnight.
Do not open oven door.
recipes.text: Christmas Or Southern Kisses. Beat whites with cream of tartar until past frothy. Add sugar (1 tablespoon at a time). Continue to beat until it loses glossiness. Add vanilla. Fold in nut meats. Drop by tablespoon or less on brown paper or cookie sheet. Place in 400° oven; close door and immediately turn off oven. Leave in oven overnight. Do not open oven door.

recipes.title: Cocoa
directions: Place water and salt in a medium sized pan over low heat.
Add sugar and cocoa, stir to dissolve, and heat for 10 minutes.
recipes.text: Cocoa. Place water and salt in a medium sized pan over low heat. Add sugar and cocoa, stir to dissolve, and heat for 10 minutes.

recipes.title: 3 Bean Salad
directions: Fry together bacon and hamburger; drain.
Add 3 cans of beans and juice.
Mix with onion, catsup, brown sugar, prepared mustard and vinegar.
Mix together in casserole dish.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
recipes.text: 3 Bean Salad. Fry together bacon and hamburger; drain. Add 3 cans of beans and juice. Mix with onion, catsup, brown sugar, prepared mustard and vinegar. Mix together in casserole dish. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Noodles
directions: Beat eggs with fork, then add water and salt.
Add enough flour to make a very stiff dough.
Roll very thin and cut noodles.
recipes.text: Noodles. Beat eggs with fork, then add water and salt. Add enough flour to make a very stiff dough. Roll very thin and cut noodles.

recipes.title: Tavern Nut Crunch
directions: In a large bowl, toss together the peanuts, Rice, Wheat and Bran Chex cereal and raisins.
Melt margarine in saucepan. Stir in honey, vanilla and cinnamon until well blended.
Pour syrup over nut-cereal mixture and toss to coat all pieces well.
Spread mixture on a large, ungreased baking sheet. Bake at 350° for 10 minutes. Turn off oven and leave in oven for another 10 minutes. Store in an airtight container.
recipes.text: Tavern Nut Crunch. In a large bowl, toss together the peanuts, Rice, Wheat and Bran Chex cereal and raisins. Melt margarine in saucepan. Stir in honey, vanilla and cinnamon until well blended. Pour syrup over nut-cereal mixture and toss to coat all pieces well. Spread mixture on a large, ungreased baking sheet. Bake at 350° for 10 minutes. Turn off oven and leave in oven for another 10 minutes. Store in an airtight container.

recipes.title: Grandma'S Lemon Cream Pie
ingredients: 1 (9-inch) baked pie shell or graham cracker crust
directions: In a saucepan, mix sugar, cornstarch and salt.
Add milk gradually and stir until smooth.
Cook over low heat, stirring constantly, until smooth and thick, about 10 minutes.
Stir a small amount of hot mixture into beaten egg yolks, then gradually add yolks to remaining hot mixture.
Continue cooking, stirring constantly, about 5 minutes.
Remove from heat.
Add butter, lemon peel and juice and blend thoroughly.
Pour hot filling into pie shell.
If made with a baked pie shell, top with meringue.
If a graham cracker crust is used, serve with whipped cream.
recipes.text: Grandma'S Lemon Cream Pie. In a saucepan, mix sugar, cornstarch and salt. Add milk gradually and stir until smooth. Cook over low heat, stirring constantly, until smooth and thick, about 10 minutes. Stir a small amount of hot mixture into beaten egg yolks, then gradually add yolks to remaining hot mixture. Continue cooking, stirring constantly, about 5 minutes. Remove from heat. Add butter, lemon peel and juice and blend thoroughly. Pour hot filling into pie shell. If made with a baked pie shell, top with meringue. If a graham cracker crust is used, serve with whipped cream.

recipes.title: Spiced Tea Mix
directions: Combine all ingredients and store in a dry container.
Use about 3 teaspoons of mixture per one cup of hot water.
recipes.text: Spiced Tea Mix. Combine all ingredients and store in a dry container. Use about 3 teaspoons of mixture per one cup of hot water.

recipes.title: Snow Peas Oriental(Low Calorie)
ingredients: 1/2 lb. fresh snow pea pods, trimmed
directions: Coat a nonstick skillet with cooking spray.
Add oil and place over medium-high heat until hot.
Add snow peas and carrots.
Saute 2 minutes.
Add water chestnuts and broth.
Bring to a boil. Cover, reduce heat and simmer 5 minutes or until vegetables are crisp-tender.
Combine soy sauce and cornstarch, stirring until cornstarch dissolves.
Add to vegetable mixture.
Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until sauce thickens.
Serve immediately.
Yield:
4 servings (about 51 calories per 1/2 cup serving).
recipes.text: Snow Peas Oriental(Low Calorie). Coat a nonstick skillet with cooking spray. Add oil and place over medium-high heat until hot. Add snow peas and carrots. Saute 2 minutes. Add water chestnuts and broth. Bring to a boil. Cover, reduce heat and simmer 5 minutes or until vegetables are crisp-tender. Combine soy sauce and cornstarch, stirring until cornstarch dissolves. Add to vegetable mixture. Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until sauce thickens. Serve immediately. Yield: 4 servings (about 51 calories per 1/2 cup serving).

recipes.title: Sugar-Free Fruit 'N' Nut Squares
directions: Simmer water, prunes, dates and raisins four minutes.
Beat in eggs, vanilla and walnuts.
Add dry ingredients until well blended.
Bake in a 9 x 9-inch pan at 350° for 30 minutes.
Makes 16 squares.
recipes.text: Sugar-Free Fruit 'N' Nut Squares. Simmer water, prunes, dates and raisins four minutes. Beat in eggs, vanilla and walnuts. Add dry ingredients until well blended. Bake in a 9 x 9-inch pan at 350° for 30 minutes. Makes 16 squares.

recipes.title: Chicken And Dressing Bake
ingredients: 2 c. shredded mild Cheddar cheese, divided
1 (10 3/4 oz.) can each cream of mushroom and cream of celery soup
1 (8 oz.) pkg. corn bread stuffing mix
1/2 c. each chopped onion and celery
directions: Combine water, celery flakes and salt in a large saucepan. Bring to a boil over high heat; reduce heat to medium. Add chicken and cook until tender, about 20 to 25 minutes. Drain chicken, reserving 2 1/2 cups broth. Cool chicken and coarsely chop.
recipes.text: Chicken And Dressing Bake. Combine water, celery flakes and salt in a large saucepan. Bring to a boil over high heat; reduce heat to medium. Add chicken and cook until tender, about 20 to 25 minutes. Drain chicken, reserving 2 1/2 cups broth. Cool chicken and coarsely chop.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Bread
directions: In a large bowl, mix by hand all ingredients.
Grease 3 loaf pans.
Pour batter equally in each of them.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour or until tester comes out clean.
recipes.text: Pumpkin Bread. In a large bowl, mix by hand all ingredients. Grease 3 loaf pans. Pour batter equally in each of them. Bake at 350° for 1 hour or until tester comes out clean.

recipes.title: Pecan Pie
directions: Combine first 5 ingredients.
Mix until well blended.
Stir in pecans.
Pour into pie crust.
Bake at 350° for 55 minutes or until knife inserted comes out clean.
recipes.text: Pecan Pie. Combine first 5 ingredients. Mix until well blended. Stir in pecans. Pour into pie crust. Bake at 350° for 55 minutes or until knife inserted comes out clean.

recipes.title: Banana Pudding
directions: Dissolve pudding in 3 cups of cold, sweet milk, beating with electric mixer on low speed or until pudding gets thick.
Add Cool Whip and sour cream; mix well.
Sprinkle crushed wafers in bottom of a container that holds 3 quarts or more.
Layer with 3 sliced bananas and pudding.
Repeat same procedure using the next 3 bananas.
Sprinkle wafers on top.
Cover well and refrigerate until next day.
recipes.text: Banana Pudding. Dissolve pudding in 3 cups of cold, sweet milk, beating with electric mixer on low speed or until pudding gets thick. Add Cool Whip and sour cream; mix well. Sprinkle crushed wafers in bottom of a container that holds 3 quarts or more. Layer with 3 sliced bananas and pudding. Repeat same procedure using the next 3 bananas. Sprinkle wafers on top. Cover well and refrigerate until next day.

recipes.title: Chocolate Fudge
directions: Melt chips in top of double boiler over low heat.
Stir until melted.
Remove from heat.
Stir in milk, butter and vanilla. Blend until butter is blended with chocolate.
Stir in nuts. Spread mixture immediately into a lightly oiled 8-inch square pan. Cool and cut into squares.
recipes.text: Chocolate Fudge. Melt chips in top of double boiler over low heat. Stir until melted. Remove from heat. Stir in milk, butter and vanilla. Blend until butter is blended with chocolate. Stir in nuts. Spread mixture immediately into a lightly oiled 8-inch square pan. Cool and cut into squares.

recipes.title: No Bake Cookies
directions: Bring all ingredients, except vanilla and oatmeal to a hard boil for 1 minute.
Take off burner.
Pour in oatmeal.
Mix well. Place by spoonfuls on wax paper.
recipes.text: No Bake Cookies. Bring all ingredients, except vanilla and oatmeal to a hard boil for 1 minute. Take off burner. Pour in oatmeal. Mix well. Place by spoonfuls on wax paper.

recipes.title: Chocolate Fudge Pie
directions: Mix together sugar and cocoa.
Stir in eggs.
Add milk, vanilla, melted margarine, nuts; mixing well.
Put in pie crust.
recipes.text: Chocolate Fudge Pie. Mix together sugar and cocoa. Stir in eggs. Add milk, vanilla, melted margarine, nuts; mixing well. Put in pie crust.

recipes.title: Vermicelli (Greek) Salad
ingredients: 1 large can pitted black olives, sliced
directions: Prepare vermicelli according to package directions except boil in unsalted water.
Mix olive oil, lemon juice and seasoning together.
Combine olives, pimento and green onions; mix with vermicelli.
Pour olive oil mixture over pasta and toss.
Make the day before or at least 4 hours before serving.
Keeps for at least 1 week.
recipes.text: Vermicelli (Greek) Salad. Prepare vermicelli according to package directions except boil in unsalted water. Mix olive oil, lemon juice and seasoning together. Combine olives, pimento and green onions; mix with vermicelli. Pour olive oil mixture over pasta and toss. Make the day before or at least 4 hours before serving. Keeps for at least 1 week.

recipes.title: Strawberry-Rhubarb Ice Milk
directions: *May use either Equal or Sweet One instead of sugar.
recipes.text: Strawberry-Rhubarb Ice Milk. *May use either Equal or Sweet One instead of sugar.

recipes.title: Meat Loaf
directions: Mix hamburger and oats.
Chop finely the onion and carrots. Mix all ingredients together.
Bake at 375° for 1 hour in greased baking pan.
recipes.text: Meat Loaf. Mix hamburger and oats. Chop finely the onion and carrots. Mix all ingredients together. Bake at 375° for 1 hour in greased baking pan.

recipes.title: Zucchini Bread
ingredients: 2 c. grated zucchini, seeded and peeled
directions: Cream together eggs, oil and sugar.
Mix in remaining ingredients.
Bake in 2 loaf pans at 325° for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Zucchini Bread. Cream together eggs, oil and sugar. Mix in remaining ingredients. Bake in 2 loaf pans at 325° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Don'T-Cook-The-Pasta Manicotti
ingredients: 1/2 c. grated Parmesan or Romano cheese
directions: In a large skillet, brown meat with onion and garlic.
Drain well.
Stir in 2 cups of tomato juice, tomato paste, sugar and seasonings.
Simmer while preparing filling.
recipes.text: Don'T-Cook-The-Pasta Manicotti. In a large skillet, brown meat with onion and garlic. Drain well. Stir in 2 cups of tomato juice, tomato paste, sugar and seasonings. Simmer while preparing filling.

recipes.title: Breakfast Puffs
directions: Beat first three ingredients together thoroughly.
Sift together next four ingredients.
Stir in alternately with milk. Pour into well-greased and floured tiny muffin tins (half full). Bake at 350° for 20 to 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Breakfast Puffs. Beat first three ingredients together thoroughly. Sift together next four ingredients. Stir in alternately with milk. Pour into well-greased and floured tiny muffin tins (half full). Bake at 350° for 20 to 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Lemon Cheese Filling
ingredients: 1/4 c. lemon juice and rind, grated
directions: Mix and cook over low heat for 12 minutes.
Cool and frost 3 layer cake.
recipes.text: Lemon Cheese Filling. Mix and cook over low heat for 12 minutes. Cool and frost 3 layer cake.

recipes.title: Taverns
directions: Mix all ingredients except meat in pan and bring to boil.
Add the hamburger meat.
Crumble until well mixed with other ingredients.
Boil 10 minutes, then simmer 20 minutes.
Serve on hot toasted buns.
recipes.text: Taverns. Mix all ingredients except meat in pan and bring to boil. Add the hamburger meat. Crumble until well mixed with other ingredients. Boil 10 minutes, then simmer 20 minutes. Serve on hot toasted buns.

recipes.title: Easy Doughnuts
directions: You will need a frying pan, paper towels, a plate and bottle cap.
recipes.text: Easy Doughnuts. You will need a frying pan, paper towels, a plate and bottle cap.

recipes.title: Zucchini Soup
directions: Saute garlic and onion in olive oil.
Add zucchini, celery, potato and parsley.
Cook together until vegetables are softened. Add chicken broth (or 2 cups water and 2 chicken bouillon cubes), pepper and salt.
Cook for 30 minutes.
Put through blender; adjust seasonings.
May be served hot or cold.
recipes.text: Zucchini Soup. Saute garlic and onion in olive oil. Add zucchini, celery, potato and parsley. Cook together until vegetables are softened. Add chicken broth (or 2 cups water and 2 chicken bouillon cubes), pepper and salt. Cook for 30 minutes. Put through blender; adjust seasonings. May be served hot or cold.

recipes.title: "Lo-Cal Blueberry Turnovers"
directions: Spray well with butter flavored nonstick spray sandwich maker (grill).
Put bread on grill.
Top with berries and sprinkle with artificial sweetener.
Spray the other side of bread and cover the berries.
Close sandwich maker and cook until done, about 1 1/2 to 2 minutes.
recipes.text: "Lo-Cal Blueberry Turnovers". Spray well with butter flavored nonstick spray sandwich maker (grill). Put bread on grill. Top with berries and sprinkle with artificial sweetener. Spray the other side of bread and cover the berries. Close sandwich maker and cook until done, about 1 1/2 to 2 minutes.

recipes.title: Corn Flake Cookies
directions: Heat sugar and syrup until boiling.
Boil about 2 minutes. Remove from heat; add peanut butter; stir until smooth.
Pour over corn flakes; mix good.
Drop by teaspoon on wax paper.
recipes.text: Corn Flake Cookies. Heat sugar and syrup until boiling. Boil about 2 minutes. Remove from heat; add peanut butter; stir until smooth. Pour over corn flakes; mix good. Drop by teaspoon on wax paper.

recipes.title: Jello Salad
directions: Dissolve Jell-O in 1 cup hot water.
Mix well, then add 1 cup juice.
When partly congealed, add pineapple, celery, nut meats and cream cheese that has been creamed well.
Then fold in whipping cream.
Chill.
recipes.text: Jello Salad. Dissolve Jell-O in 1 cup hot water. Mix well, then add 1 cup juice. When partly congealed, add pineapple, celery, nut meats and cream cheese that has been creamed well. Then fold in whipping cream. Chill.

recipes.title: So Different Rhubarb Pie
directions: Combine egg yolks and next four ingredients into bowl; mix well.
Beat egg whites with 1/2 cup sugar until stiff peaks form. Fold gently into the egg yolk mixture.
Fold in rhubarb.
Spoon into pie shell.
Bake at 400° for 10 minutes.
Reduce temperature to 325° and bake for 45 minutes longer.
recipes.text: So Different Rhubarb Pie. Combine egg yolks and next four ingredients into bowl; mix well. Beat egg whites with 1/2 cup sugar until stiff peaks form. Fold gently into the egg yolk mixture. Fold in rhubarb. Spoon into pie shell. Bake at 400° for 10 minutes. Reduce temperature to 325° and bake for 45 minutes longer.

recipes.title: Brunswick Stew
ingredients: 1 to 2 chicken breasts, cooked and cubed
1/2 c. each: corn, peas and limas, cooked
salt, pepper and basil to taste
directions: Chop potatoes, carrots and onions for soup and cover with water or leftover broth to cook. When tender, add the rest of the ingredients and simmer 20 minutes. You may substitute turkey chunks from your holiday meal and save vegetables in a "soup carton, " until you have the right proportions. Serves 4 to 5.
recipes.text: Brunswick Stew. Chop potatoes, carrots and onions for soup and cover with water or leftover broth to cook. When tender, add the rest of the ingredients and simmer 20 minutes. You may substitute turkey chunks from your holiday meal and save vegetables in a "soup carton, " until you have the right proportions. Serves 4 to 5.

recipes.title: Pineapple Nut Cake
directions: Mix all ingredients together with a spoon.
Put in ungreased baking dish or pan (9 x 13-inch) and bake about 45 minutes to 1 hour at 350°.
It can be iced with any kind of frosting.
Sprinkle top with nuts, if desired.
recipes.text: Pineapple Nut Cake. Mix all ingredients together with a spoon. Put in ungreased baking dish or pan (9 x 13-inch) and bake about 45 minutes to 1 hour at 350°. It can be iced with any kind of frosting. Sprinkle top with nuts, if desired.

recipes.title: Chocolate Cheesecake
directions: Mix together and press into a 9-inch spring-form pan.
recipes.text: Chocolate Cheesecake. Mix together and press into a 9-inch spring-form pan.

recipes.title: Mexican Round Up
directions: Brown ground beef and onion.
Drain off fat.
Add tomato sauce, chili powder, water, beans and Spanish rice.
Simmer 8 to 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Put Fritos on a pizza pan. Pour meat mixture over Fritos.
Top with grated cheese.
Cook in 350° oven until cheese melts.
recipes.text: Mexican Round Up. Brown ground beef and onion. Drain off fat. Add tomato sauce, chili powder, water, beans and Spanish rice. Simmer 8 to 10 minutes, stirring occasionally. Put Fritos on a pizza pan. Pour meat mixture over Fritos. Top with grated cheese. Cook in 350° oven until cheese melts.

recipes.title: Stuffed Mushrooms
directions: Clean mushrooms and cut stems off; fill with cream cheese filling and bake at 350° for 25 minutes.
recipes.text: Stuffed Mushrooms. Clean mushrooms and cut stems off; fill with cream cheese filling and bake at 350° for 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Cheesy Hash-Spinach Pie
ingredients: 1 (10 3/4 oz.) can condensed cream of mushroom soup
directions: Prick bottom and sides of crust with fork.
Bake at 450° for 10 to 12 minutes.
Remove from oven; reduce temperature to 350°. Cook spinach according to package directions, except omit salt. Drain well, pressing out excess water.
Combine eggs, mushroom soup, flour, horseradish and mustard; stir in drained spinach. Spread hash in baked pastry shell; spoon spinach mixture over. Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 45 minutes.
Combine cheese and pimiento; sprinkle over pie.
Bake 2 to 3 minutes longer.
Let stand 5 minutes.
Makes 6 servings.
recipes.text: Cheesy Hash-Spinach Pie. Prick bottom and sides of crust with fork. Bake at 450° for 10 to 12 minutes. Remove from oven; reduce temperature to 350°. Cook spinach according to package directions, except omit salt. Drain well, pressing out excess water. Combine eggs, mushroom soup, flour, horseradish and mustard; stir in drained spinach. Spread hash in baked pastry shell; spoon spinach mixture over. Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 45 minutes. Combine cheese and pimiento; sprinkle over pie. Bake 2 to 3 minutes longer. Let stand 5 minutes. Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Cheese Christmas Stollen
ingredients: 1 1/2 c. small curd creamed cottage cheese
directions: Sift together 2 cups flour plus next 3 ingredients.
Stir in oats. Beat butter and sugar until creamy. Add lemon peel.
Beat in egg, egg yolks, cottage cheese and last 1/2 cup of flour.
Stir in raisins, candied fruit and nuts.
Dough will be stiff and biscuit like.
Divide dough in half.
Turn out on lightly floured board. With palms of hands, press each half into oval shape 1/2-inch thick. Fold in 1/2 lengthwise.
Lift to lightly greased cookie sheets.
Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes. Cool on rack. Decorate with frosting and candied cherries.
recipes.text: Cheese Christmas Stollen. Sift together 2 cups flour plus next 3 ingredients. Stir in oats. Beat butter and sugar until creamy. Add lemon peel. Beat in egg, egg yolks, cottage cheese and last 1/2 cup of flour. Stir in raisins, candied fruit and nuts. Dough will be stiff and biscuit like. Divide dough in half. Turn out on lightly floured board. With palms of hands, press each half into oval shape 1/2-inch thick. Fold in 1/2 lengthwise. Lift to lightly greased cookie sheets. Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes. Cool on rack. Decorate with frosting and candied cherries.

recipes.title: Chicken Supreme
directions: Tear chipped beef into small bits and place in bottom of flat 2 qt. baking pan.
Wrap bacon around each chicken breast.
Place on beef.
Mix soup and sour cream and cover the chicken completely.
Bake uncovered at 300° for 3 hours.
Glass pan will bake casserole in less time.
recipes.text: Chicken Supreme. Tear chipped beef into small bits and place in bottom of flat 2 qt. baking pan. Wrap bacon around each chicken breast. Place on beef. Mix soup and sour cream and cover the chicken completely. Bake uncovered at 300° for 3 hours. Glass pan will bake casserole in less time.

recipes.title: Strawberry Fudge Revel Cake
ingredients: 1 pkg. Betty Crocker SuperMoist Strawberry Cake Mix
directions: Heat oven to 350°.
Generously grease and flour 12-c. Bundt cake pan or tube pan, 10x4 inches.
Mix brown sugar, flour, cocoa and margarine until crumbly; reserve.
Beat cake mix (dry), water, oil and eggs in large bowl on low speed, scraping bowl frequently, 2 minutes.
Pour about 1 2/3 c. batter into pan; sprinkle with about 1 1/3 c. of the crumbly mixture.
Pour about 1 2/3 c. batter into pan; sprinkle with remaining crumbly mixture.
Pour remaining batter into pan.
Bake until wooden pick inserted in center comes out clean, 45 to 55 minutes.
Cool 10 minutes; invert on wire rack or heatproof serving plate.
Remove pan; cool cake completely. Spread top of cake with Chocolate Glaze, allowing some to drizzle down side.
recipes.text: Strawberry Fudge Revel Cake. Heat oven to 350°. Generously grease and flour 12-c. Bundt cake pan or tube pan, 10x4 inches. Mix brown sugar, flour, cocoa and margarine until crumbly; reserve. Beat cake mix (dry), water, oil and eggs in large bowl on low speed, scraping bowl frequently, 2 minutes. Pour about 1 2/3 c. batter into pan; sprinkle with about 1 1/3 c. of the crumbly mixture. Pour about 1 2/3 c. batter into pan; sprinkle with remaining crumbly mixture. Pour remaining batter into pan. Bake until wooden pick inserted in center comes out clean, 45 to 55 minutes. Cool 10 minutes; invert on wire rack or heatproof serving plate. Remove pan; cool cake completely. Spread top of cake with Chocolate Glaze, allowing some to drizzle down side.

recipes.title: Apple Banana Bread
directions: Cream butter and sugar together.
Then add eggs and fruit. Mix in flour, baking powder, baking soda and salt.
Add flavoring and mix well.
Spoon into 2 greased and floured loaf pans (8 x 5 x 3-inch).
Bake at 325° for approximately 1 hour or when bread tests done.
recipes.text: Apple Banana Bread. Cream butter and sugar together. Then add eggs and fruit. Mix in flour, baking powder, baking soda and salt. Add flavoring and mix well. Spoon into 2 greased and floured loaf pans (8 x 5 x 3-inch). Bake at 325° for approximately 1 hour or when bread tests done.

recipes.title: Marinated Grilled Flank Steak
directions: Marinate flank steak several hours, then grill.
Slice thin on diagonal to serve.
recipes.text: Marinated Grilled Flank Steak. Marinate flank steak several hours, then grill. Slice thin on diagonal to serve.

recipes.title: Easy Banana Cake
directions: Mix all together and bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Easy Banana Cake. Mix all together and bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Squash Casserole
ingredients: 3/4 (8 oz.) pkg. Pepperidge Farm herb stuffing mix or croutons (Italian seasoned)
directions: Boil carrots, onions and squash until tender.
Put in blender or processor.
Add other ingredients.
Bake in casserole dish 45 minutes at 350°.
recipes.text: Squash Casserole. Boil carrots, onions and squash until tender. Put in blender or processor. Add other ingredients. Bake in casserole dish 45 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Strawberry Delight
directions: First Layer:
Crush graham crackers, butter and sugar together.
Bake in 9 x 13-inch pan at 375° for 8 minutes.
Let cool.
recipes.text: Strawberry Delight. First Layer: Crush graham crackers, butter and sugar together. Bake in 9 x 13-inch pan at 375° for 8 minutes. Let cool.

recipes.title: Ency'S Dill Dip
ingredients: 1 Tbsp. minced fresh dill weed or 1 tsp. dried dill
directions: Combine everything together and refrigerate for 24 hours for flavor.
The next day blend together.
Especially good with cucumbers and zucchini.
recipes.text: Ency'S Dill Dip. Combine everything together and refrigerate for 24 hours for flavor. The next day blend together. Especially good with cucumbers and zucchini.

recipes.title: Spaghetti Sauce
ingredients: 2 (1 1/2 oz. each) envelopes Italian style spaghetti sauce mix with mushrooms
directions: Cook and stir ground beef and onion until meat is brown and onion tender.
Stir in remaining ingredients.
Add 1 to 3 cups water to desired consistency.
Cover and simmer 1 1/2 hours, stirring sauce occasionally.
Serves 8.
recipes.text: Spaghetti Sauce. Cook and stir ground beef and onion until meat is brown and onion tender. Stir in remaining ingredients. Add 1 to 3 cups water to desired consistency. Cover and simmer 1 1/2 hours, stirring sauce occasionally. Serves 8.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Bread
directions: Mix sugar, oil and oleo together. Add eggs and beat well.
Add pumpkin and water.
Continue beating. Add remaining ingredients and mix well.
Pour into greased and floured bread pans.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour or until tests done.
Makes 2 loaves.
recipes.text: Pumpkin Bread. Mix sugar, oil and oleo together. Add eggs and beat well. Add pumpkin and water. Continue beating. Add remaining ingredients and mix well. Pour into greased and floured bread pans. Bake at 350° for 1 hour or until tests done. Makes 2 loaves.

recipes.title: Christmas Salad
directions: Boil applesauce in saucepan. Stir in small jello. Mix well. Add crushed pineapple and chopped nuts. Mix well. Pour in jello mold. Chill.
recipes.text: Christmas Salad. Boil applesauce in saucepan. Stir in small jello. Mix well. Add crushed pineapple and chopped nuts. Mix well. Pour in jello mold. Chill.

recipes.title: Frozen Lemonade Pie
ingredients: 1 can Eagle Brand sweetened condensed milk
directions: Mix ingredients and place in graham cracker crust.
Store in freezer overnight.
recipes.text: Frozen Lemonade Pie. Mix ingredients and place in graham cracker crust. Store in freezer overnight.

recipes.title: Marinated Onions
directions: Mix all together and let sit overnight.
recipes.text: Marinated Onions. Mix all together and let sit overnight.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Potato Chip Cookies
ingredients: 1 bag (7 oz.) Ruffles chips, coarsely crushed
directions: In bowl, cream first 5 ingredients.
Add flour.
Stir until soft dough. Stir in chips and potato chips.
Drop by spoonfuls 1 inch apart onto greased sheet.
Bake at 350° for 10 to 12 minutes. Cool.
Store in container.
recipes.text: Peanut Butter Potato Chip Cookies. In bowl, cream first 5 ingredients. Add flour. Stir until soft dough. Stir in chips and potato chips. Drop by spoonfuls 1 inch apart onto greased sheet. Bake at 350° for 10 to 12 minutes. Cool. Store in container.

recipes.title: Harvest Casserole
ingredients: 4 medium green peppers, cut bite size
2 (15 1/2 oz.) cans garbanzo beans or cannellini, drained
directions: In 8-quart pot brown eggplant in oil, stir.
Drain on paper towels.
Brown next 3 veggies, stir.
Add water, boil.
Reduce heat to low, cover and simmer until tender.
Remove from heat, stir in eggplant, beans, tomato sauce, paste, salt, basil and pepper. Preheat oven to 350°.
Bake 30 minutes in 2 (12 x 8-inch) dishes or one large dish.
Add cheese 5 minutes before removing from oven.
recipes.text: Harvest Casserole. In 8-quart pot brown eggplant in oil, stir. Drain on paper towels. Brown next 3 veggies, stir. Add water, boil. Reduce heat to low, cover and simmer until tender. Remove from heat, stir in eggplant, beans, tomato sauce, paste, salt, basil and pepper. Preheat oven to 350°. Bake 30 minutes in 2 (12 x 8-inch) dishes or one large dish. Add cheese 5 minutes before removing from oven.

recipes.title: Portuguese Sweet Bread
directions: Beat eggs and sugar together.
Dissolve yeast in 1/2 cup warm water.
In large bowl combine flour, salt and nutmeg.
Make a well in center.
Pour in egg and sugar mixture, dissolved yeast, warm water and condensed milk.
Begin mixing with hands and working in butter.
Mix very well.
Dough will be sticky.
Cover and let rise. Turn onto floured board.
Shape into loaf, rolls, etc.
Let rise again. Brush tops with beaten egg. Bake at 325°. Rolls: 15 minutes.
Loaf: 20 to 25 minutes.
Dough can also be used for doughnuts or cinnamon rolls.
Yield:
7 to 8 loaves.
recipes.text: Portuguese Sweet Bread. Beat eggs and sugar together. Dissolve yeast in 1/2 cup warm water. In large bowl combine flour, salt and nutmeg. Make a well in center. Pour in egg and sugar mixture, dissolved yeast, warm water and condensed milk. Begin mixing with hands and working in butter. Mix very well. Dough will be sticky. Cover and let rise. Turn onto floured board. Shape into loaf, rolls, etc. Let rise again. Brush tops with beaten egg. Bake at 325°. Rolls: 15 minutes. Loaf: 20 to 25 minutes. Dough can also be used for doughnuts or cinnamon rolls. Yield: 7 to 8 loaves.

recipes.title: Chocolate-Butterscotch Pie
directions: Combine sugar and flour.
Add to milk, stirring constantly. Add cocoa.
Cook over hot water, stirring constantly until mixture thickens.
Cover.
Cook 5 minutes.
Combine egg yolks, salt and water.
Add to cooked mixture, slowly stirring.
Add butter; cook 1 minute.
Cool.
Add vanilla.
Pour into baked pastry shell. Cover with meringue and brown.
recipes.text: Chocolate-Butterscotch Pie. Combine sugar and flour. Add to milk, stirring constantly. Add cocoa. Cook over hot water, stirring constantly until mixture thickens. Cover. Cook 5 minutes. Combine egg yolks, salt and water. Add to cooked mixture, slowly stirring. Add butter; cook 1 minute. Cool. Add vanilla. Pour into baked pastry shell. Cover with meringue and brown.

recipes.title: Frosted Lime Walnut Salad
directions: Dissolve jello in boiling water.
Chill until partly set. Stir in 1 can of pineapple, cottage cheese, celery, pimento and walnuts.
Pour into an 8-inch square pan.
Frost with cream cheese, mayonnaise and lemon juice mixed together.
Chill until firm.
Cut in squares.
Serve on green salad lettuce.
recipes.text: Frosted Lime Walnut Salad. Dissolve jello in boiling water. Chill until partly set. Stir in 1 can of pineapple, cottage cheese, celery, pimento and walnuts. Pour into an 8-inch square pan. Frost with cream cheese, mayonnaise and lemon juice mixed together. Chill until firm. Cut in squares. Serve on green salad lettuce.

recipes.title: Fruit Salad Dressing
directions: Boil pineapple juice.
Beat eggs slightly.
Add sugar and flour.
Pour into hot juice.
Stir constantly, cooking over medium heat until thickened.
When ready to use, add whipped heavy cream to sauce.
Fold in cut-up fruit.
recipes.text: Fruit Salad Dressing. Boil pineapple juice. Beat eggs slightly. Add sugar and flour. Pour into hot juice. Stir constantly, cooking over medium heat until thickened. When ready to use, add whipped heavy cream to sauce. Fold in cut-up fruit.

recipes.title: Lentil(Soup)
ingredients: 1 lb. lentils (wash and remove the debris)
directions: Place all ingredients in a suitable size pot with enough water to make a soup thickness to one's liking.
Cook at medium heat (about 1 1/2 hours or until done).
recipes.text: Lentil(Soup). Place all ingredients in a suitable size pot with enough water to make a soup thickness to one's liking. Cook at medium heat (about 1 1/2 hours or until done).

recipes.title: Our Barbecue Sauce
directions: Melt butter on stove top or in microwave in a medium bowl. Stir in catsup, mustard, Worcestershire, brown sugar, lemon juice and season to taste.
Baste over any meat.
recipes.text: Our Barbecue Sauce. Melt butter on stove top or in microwave in a medium bowl. Stir in catsup, mustard, Worcestershire, brown sugar, lemon juice and season to taste. Baste over any meat.

recipes.title: Poached Fish Fillets With Rich Wine Sauce
ingredients: 1 part dry white wine and 1 part water (enough to cover fillets)
1 c. milk (for richer sauce, use evaporated skim milk)
directions: In a shallow pan or skillet, bring to a boil enough wine and water to cover the fish, adding a pinch of salt, tarragon and the sliced onion.
Add the fillets and simmer gently (do not boil) until fish flakes easily.
This will take about 5 minutes.
Test for doneness with a fork or toothpick.
recipes.text: Poached Fish Fillets With Rich Wine Sauce. In a shallow pan or skillet, bring to a boil enough wine and water to cover the fish, adding a pinch of salt, tarragon and the sliced onion. Add the fillets and simmer gently (do not boil) until fish flakes easily. This will take about 5 minutes. Test for doneness with a fork or toothpick.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Cookies
directions: Cream together shortening, sugar, eggs, peanut butter and brown sugar.
Add flour, soda, baking powder and salt.
Chill dough.
Roll into balls; flatten with fork.
Bake at 375° for 10 to 12 minutes.
recipes.text: Peanut Butter Cookies. Cream together shortening, sugar, eggs, peanut butter and brown sugar. Add flour, soda, baking powder and salt. Chill dough. Roll into balls; flatten with fork. Bake at 375° for 10 to 12 minutes.

recipes.title: Granny Black'S Ham Pasties
directions: Mix softened margarine and softened cream cheese together. Add flour and ice water to make dough.
Cover and chill overnight. When ready to make pastry, mix remaining ingredients to a spreading consistency for filling.
Break off dough, one piece at a time, large enough to make one pastry.
Roll out thin in a circle, about 2 inches in diameter.
Scoop filling on top and fold over into half moon and seal pastry.
Bake at 400° until brown. Great for parties.
Freezes very well.
recipes.text: Granny Black'S Ham Pasties. Mix softened margarine and softened cream cheese together. Add flour and ice water to make dough. Cover and chill overnight. When ready to make pastry, mix remaining ingredients to a spreading consistency for filling. Break off dough, one piece at a time, large enough to make one pastry. Roll out thin in a circle, about 2 inches in diameter. Scoop filling on top and fold over into half moon and seal pastry. Bake at 400° until brown. Great for parties. Freezes very well.

recipes.title: Good-For-You Muffins
directions: In large bowl, combine oats, flours, brown sugar, oat bran, baking powder, cinnamon, baking soda and salt; mix well.
Add currants or raisins, banana chips, dates and nuts.
Stir to coat with flour mixture.
*Stir just until moistened (batter should be lumpy).
Lightly grease 12 muffin cups or line with paper bake cups.
Spoon batter into cups, filling cups full.
Bake in 400° oven for 18 to 20 minutes or until done.
Cool slightly on wire rack.
Serve warm or cool.
Makes 12 muffins.
recipes.text: Good-For-You Muffins. In large bowl, combine oats, flours, brown sugar, oat bran, baking powder, cinnamon, baking soda and salt; mix well. Add currants or raisins, banana chips, dates and nuts. Stir to coat with flour mixture. *Stir just until moistened (batter should be lumpy). Lightly grease 12 muffin cups or line with paper bake cups. Spoon batter into cups, filling cups full. Bake in 400° oven for 18 to 20 minutes or until done. Cool slightly on wire rack. Serve warm or cool. Makes 12 muffins.

recipes.title: Christmas Goose
directions: Saute onion in oleo; soak bread in water and drain moisture. Add onion, bread, spices and sausage.
Stuff goose.
Place on roasting pan with 3 inches of water and bake at 350° for 1 hour. Drain water and baste for 2 hours.
recipes.text: Christmas Goose. Saute onion in oleo; soak bread in water and drain moisture. Add onion, bread, spices and sausage. Stuff goose. Place on roasting pan with 3 inches of water and bake at 350° for 1 hour. Drain water and baste for 2 hours.

recipes.title: Hot Fruit Salad
ingredients: pecan halves, maraschino cherries and apple rings (optional)
directions: Drain all fruit.
Place in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish.
Mix other ingredients; pour over fruit.
Bake for 1 hour, uncovered, at 325°.
This will serve a large group.
recipes.text: Hot Fruit Salad. Drain all fruit. Place in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Mix other ingredients; pour over fruit. Bake for 1 hour, uncovered, at 325°. This will serve a large group.

recipes.title: Hot Ham Sandwiches
directions: Mix all together and spread on rolls.
Wrap in foil (separately).
Put on cookie sheet and heat at 400° for 10 to 12 minutes.
Can be made ahead and store in refrigerator or freezer. Makes about 18 sandwiches.
recipes.text: Hot Ham Sandwiches. Mix all together and spread on rolls. Wrap in foil (separately). Put on cookie sheet and heat at 400° for 10 to 12 minutes. Can be made ahead and store in refrigerator or freezer. Makes about 18 sandwiches.

recipes.title: Soft Pretzels
directions: Mix the water, yeast and sugar in a large mixing bowl and let stand for 1 hour.
Then mix in flour.
Knead mixture for about 10 minutes.
Preheat oven for 5 minutes to warm it, then turn off heat.
Place mixture in a greased bowl.
Cover it and place in the warmed oven for about 1 hour until the mixture doubles.
When it has doubled, make twists.
Place twists on a greased baking sheet not too close together.
Dilute 1 egg yolk with 1 to 2 teaspoons water or milk.
Run a thin coat of liquid around outside of each pretzel.
Sprinkle with coarse salt.
Bake in a preheated oven at 475° for 12 to 15 minutes until they are golden brown.
Yields about 2 dozen.
recipes.text: Soft Pretzels. Mix the water, yeast and sugar in a large mixing bowl and let stand for 1 hour. Then mix in flour. Knead mixture for about 10 minutes. Preheat oven for 5 minutes to warm it, then turn off heat. Place mixture in a greased bowl. Cover it and place in the warmed oven for about 1 hour until the mixture doubles. When it has doubled, make twists. Place twists on a greased baking sheet not too close together. Dilute 1 egg yolk with 1 to 2 teaspoons water or milk. Run a thin coat of liquid around outside of each pretzel. Sprinkle with coarse salt. Bake in a preheated oven at 475° for 12 to 15 minutes until they are golden brown. Yields about 2 dozen.

recipes.title: Mandarin Orange Salad
directions: Dissolve gelatin in boiling water.
Add cream cheese and sugar.
Stir until soft curd is well dissolved and distributed. Stir in orange juice, lemon juice, grated peel, carrot and oranges.
Mix well and chill.
recipes.text: Mandarin Orange Salad. Dissolve gelatin in boiling water. Add cream cheese and sugar. Stir until soft curd is well dissolved and distributed. Stir in orange juice, lemon juice, grated peel, carrot and oranges. Mix well and chill.

recipes.title: Pork Chop Casserole
directions: In a 9x13 inch dish, place a layer of sliced potatoes. Then add a layer of sliced onions. Make as many layers as you wish. Lay pork chops on top of potatoes and onions. Spread can of cream of chicken soup, no water added, on top of the pork chops. Bake at 400° for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Pork Chop Casserole. In a 9x13 inch dish, place a layer of sliced potatoes. Then add a layer of sliced onions. Make as many layers as you wish. Lay pork chops on top of potatoes and onions. Spread can of cream of chicken soup, no water added, on top of the pork chops. Bake at 400° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Potato Cheese Soup
directions: In saucepan, bring potatoes, onion, water and salt to boil. Reduce heat; cover and simmer until potatoes are tender.
Do not drain!
Mash slightly.
Stir in milk.
In a small bowl, blend margarine, flour, parsley and pepper.
Stir into the potato mixture.
Cook and stir constantly over a medium heat until thick and bubbly.
Remove from heat; add cheese and stir until almost melted.
Yields 6 servings (1 1/2 quarts).
recipes.text: Potato Cheese Soup. In saucepan, bring potatoes, onion, water and salt to boil. Reduce heat; cover and simmer until potatoes are tender. Do not drain! Mash slightly. Stir in milk. In a small bowl, blend margarine, flour, parsley and pepper. Stir into the potato mixture. Cook and stir constantly over a medium heat until thick and bubbly. Remove from heat; add cheese and stir until almost melted. Yields 6 servings (1 1/2 quarts).

recipes.title: Crab Cocktail Cakes
ingredients: 1 lb. cooked crabmeat or 2 (6 oz.) cans, rinsed and drained
1 1/4 c. reduced calorie sour cream, divided
1 c. fresh whole wheat bread crumbs
2 tsp. minced fresh dill or 1 tsp. dried dill
directions: In large bowl, blend crabmeat, egg whites, 1/4 cup sour cream, 1/2 cup onions and lemon juice.
Form mixture into 1-inch patties. Combine bread crumbs and dill.
Roll cakes in mixture.
Place on nonstick baking sheet; bake in preheated 375° oven for 10 to 15 minutes.
In small bowl, combine remaining sour cream and onions. Serve cakes garnished with lemon wedges and dipping sour cream mixture.
Makes 16 to 20 (1-inch) appetizers.
recipes.text: Crab Cocktail Cakes. In large bowl, blend crabmeat, egg whites, 1/4 cup sour cream, 1/2 cup onions and lemon juice. Form mixture into 1-inch patties. Combine bread crumbs and dill. Roll cakes in mixture. Place on nonstick baking sheet; bake in preheated 375° oven for 10 to 15 minutes. In small bowl, combine remaining sour cream and onions. Serve cakes garnished with lemon wedges and dipping sour cream mixture. Makes 16 to 20 (1-inch) appetizers.

recipes.title: Chicken Puffs
directions: Heat oven to 400°. Heat water and butter to a rolling boil in a large saucepan. Stir in flour. Stir vigorously over low heat until mixture forms a ball, about 1 minute. Drop dough by slightly rounded teaspoonfuls onto Pam sprayed baking sheet. Bake about 25 minutes or until puffed and golden brown. Remove puffs to wire rack. Cool slowly.
recipes.text: Chicken Puffs. Heat oven to 400°. Heat water and butter to a rolling boil in a large saucepan. Stir in flour. Stir vigorously over low heat until mixture forms a ball, about 1 minute. Drop dough by slightly rounded teaspoonfuls onto Pam sprayed baking sheet. Bake about 25 minutes or until puffed and golden brown. Remove puffs to wire rack. Cool slowly.

recipes.title: Meat Loaf
directions: Mix all ingredients together.
Form into a loaf.
Put in a loaf pan.
Bake, uncovered, for 60 to 90 minutes at 300°.
recipes.text: Meat Loaf. Mix all ingredients together. Form into a loaf. Put in a loaf pan. Bake, uncovered, for 60 to 90 minutes at 300°.

recipes.title: Blueberry Cobbler
directions: Combine melted butter, sugar, milk and flour together, mixing well.
Pour into a deep baking dish.
In a small bowl, put blueberries, sugar and spice to taste.
Stir well.
Pour blueberries over batter.
Bake in a 350° oven for 1 hour. Pour juice over the berries.
recipes.text: Blueberry Cobbler. Combine melted butter, sugar, milk and flour together, mixing well. Pour into a deep baking dish. In a small bowl, put blueberries, sugar and spice to taste. Stir well. Pour blueberries over batter. Bake in a 350° oven for 1 hour. Pour juice over the berries.

recipes.title: Catfish Gumbo
directions: Cut fish in cubes.
Cook celery, pepper, onion and garlic in fat until tender.
Add fish cubes and cook 10 minutes.
Dissolve beef cubes in hot water.
Add bouillon, tomatoes, tomato soup, okra and seasoning.
Simmer for 30 minutes or until fish flakes. Serve over rice.
recipes.text: Catfish Gumbo. Cut fish in cubes. Cook celery, pepper, onion and garlic in fat until tender. Add fish cubes and cook 10 minutes. Dissolve beef cubes in hot water. Add bouillon, tomatoes, tomato soup, okra and seasoning. Simmer for 30 minutes or until fish flakes. Serve over rice.

recipes.title: Strawberry Shortcut Cake
ingredients: 2 c. frozen strawberries with syrup, thawed
directions: Preheat oven to 350° and grease bottom only of a 9 x 13-inch cake pan.
Sprinkle marshmallows in cake pan.
In a mixing bowl, combine flour, sugar, shortening, baking powder, eggs, milk, vanilla and salt.
Beat at medium for 3 minutes.
Pour over marshmallows.
Mix strawberries and gelatin in a bowl; spread evenly over batter.
Bake 45 to 50 minutes.
Top with whipped cream.
recipes.text: Strawberry Shortcut Cake. Preheat oven to 350° and grease bottom only of a 9 x 13-inch cake pan. Sprinkle marshmallows in cake pan. In a mixing bowl, combine flour, sugar, shortening, baking powder, eggs, milk, vanilla and salt. Beat at medium for 3 minutes. Pour over marshmallows. Mix strawberries and gelatin in a bowl; spread evenly over batter. Bake 45 to 50 minutes. Top with whipped cream.

recipes.title: Potato Chip Cookies
directions: Cream butter and sugar, beating until light and fluffy.
Add flour, potato chips and vanilla; beat well.
Drop dough by rounded teaspoonfuls onto ungreased cookie sheets.
Bake at 350° for 10 to 12 minutes or until edges are lightly browned.
Cool 5 minutes on cookie sheets; remove to wire racks.
When cool, roll in powdered sugar.
Yields 4 dozen.
recipes.text: Potato Chip Cookies. Cream butter and sugar, beating until light and fluffy. Add flour, potato chips and vanilla; beat well. Drop dough by rounded teaspoonfuls onto ungreased cookie sheets. Bake at 350° for 10 to 12 minutes or until edges are lightly browned. Cool 5 minutes on cookie sheets; remove to wire racks. When cool, roll in powdered sugar. Yields 4 dozen.

recipes.title: Ground Bologna
directions: Grind bologna.
Grind sweet pickles to taste.
Add Miracle whip to taste.
recipes.text: Ground Bologna. Grind bologna. Grind sweet pickles to taste. Add Miracle whip to taste.

recipes.title: Oriental Rice Medley
ingredients: 1 (10 oz.) pkg. Oriental-style frozen vegetables, thawed
directions: Combine rice and broth in 3-quart micro-proof casserole. Cover with casserole lid and cook on High 10 minutes.
Stir in Oriental vegetables, mushrooms, onions, butter and soy sauce; cover and cook on High 4 to 5 minutes or until hot, stirring once. Yield:
4 servings.
recipes.text: Oriental Rice Medley. Combine rice and broth in 3-quart micro-proof casserole. Cover with casserole lid and cook on High 10 minutes. Stir in Oriental vegetables, mushrooms, onions, butter and soy sauce; cover and cook on High 4 to 5 minutes or until hot, stirring once. Yield: 4 servings.

recipes.title: Quick Sticky Buns
directions: In 8 or 9 inch layer pan, melt margarine in preheated oven. Remove from oven and stir in brown sugar, cinnamon, syrup and nuts. Place biscuits on top. Bake at 400° for 15 minutes or until biscuits are well browned. Let stand for 5 minutes. Invert on serving plate and remove pan.
recipes.text: Quick Sticky Buns. In 8 or 9 inch layer pan, melt margarine in preheated oven. Remove from oven and stir in brown sugar, cinnamon, syrup and nuts. Place biscuits on top. Bake at 400° for 15 minutes or until biscuits are well browned. Let stand for 5 minutes. Invert on serving plate and remove pan.

recipes.title: Potato Casserole
directions: Mix all; pour in greased 9 x 13-inch pan.
Sprinkle 1/4 cup margarine over top.
Bake about 1 hour at 350°; after 30 minutes baking time, cover the top with French fried onion chips and return to oven.
recipes.text: Potato Casserole. Mix all; pour in greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Sprinkle 1/4 cup margarine over top. Bake about 1 hour at 350°; after 30 minutes baking time, cover the top with French fried onion chips and return to oven.

recipes.title: Rhubarb Crisp
directions: Mix first 3 ingredients and put in bottom of buttered baking dish.
Mix flour, sugars, oatmeal and margarine until crumbly and spread on top of rhubarb mixture.
Bake for 25 to 30 minutes at 375°.
recipes.text: Rhubarb Crisp. Mix first 3 ingredients and put in bottom of buttered baking dish. Mix flour, sugars, oatmeal and margarine until crumbly and spread on top of rhubarb mixture. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes at 375°.

recipes.title: Key Lime Pie
directions: Mix 3 ingredients by hand, folding together.
Pour into baked pie shell.
Top with Cool Whip.
Freezes well.
recipes.text: Key Lime Pie. Mix 3 ingredients by hand, folding together. Pour into baked pie shell. Top with Cool Whip. Freezes well.

recipes.title: Creole Corn
ingredients: 1 large onion, sliced and separated into rings
2 c. fresh corn, cut from cob
directions: Fry bacon until crisp; remove from skillet, reserving drippings.
Drain bacon on paper towels.
