Add onion and green pepper to drippings in skillet; cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until crisp-tender.
recipes.text: Creole Corn. Fry bacon until crisp; remove from skillet, reserving drippings. Drain bacon on paper towels. Add onion and green pepper to drippings in skillet; cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until crisp-tender.

recipes.title: Pepper Jelly
directions: Grind both peppers up fine, seeds and all.
Boil sugar and vinegar for 1 minute; add pectin while boiling.
Let set a few minutes; strain through cheesecloth.
Add green food coloring.
recipes.text: Pepper Jelly. Grind both peppers up fine, seeds and all. Boil sugar and vinegar for 1 minute; add pectin while boiling. Let set a few minutes; strain through cheesecloth. Add green food coloring.

recipes.title: Macaroni And Cheese With Olives
directions: Melt in double boiler cheese.
Add gradually milk.
Stir constantly until smooth.
Add olives, salt, pepper and macaroni. Pour into casserole.
Sprinkle with buttered soft bread crumbs. Bake at 375° for 20 minutes or until crumbs are lightly browned.
recipes.text: Macaroni And Cheese With Olives. Melt in double boiler cheese. Add gradually milk. Stir constantly until smooth. Add olives, salt, pepper and macaroni. Pour into casserole. Sprinkle with buttered soft bread crumbs. Bake at 375° for 20 minutes or until crumbs are lightly browned.

recipes.title: Poppy Seed Dressing
directions: In a blender, mix first 5 ingredients slowly (especially the oil; if poured too fat, it will not blend).
Then add onion and poppy seed.
Stores well in refrigerator.
recipes.text: Poppy Seed Dressing. In a blender, mix first 5 ingredients slowly (especially the oil; if poured too fat, it will not blend). Then add onion and poppy seed. Stores well in refrigerator.

recipes.title: Sangria(Red Wine Punch)
ingredients: 2 fifths Rose, Burgundy or any other red wine
directions: Chill one orange and one lemon for garnish.
Squeeze juice from other orange and lemon.
Place juices, wine, sugar and brandy in a large pitcher or bowl.
Stir to dissolve sugar; chill. Just before serving, divide mixture into 2 pitchers or pour into bowl.
Cut chilled orange into wedges.
Slice chilled lemon into cartwheels.
Core apple and cut into wedges.
Thread fruit on 2 long skewers to stand in pitchers or float in fruit bowl.
Slowly pour in chilled carbonated water.
Makes about 24 (4 ounce) servings.
recipes.text: Sangria(Red Wine Punch). Chill one orange and one lemon for garnish. Squeeze juice from other orange and lemon. Place juices, wine, sugar and brandy in a large pitcher or bowl. Stir to dissolve sugar; chill. Just before serving, divide mixture into 2 pitchers or pour into bowl. Cut chilled orange into wedges. Slice chilled lemon into cartwheels. Core apple and cut into wedges. Thread fruit on 2 long skewers to stand in pitchers or float in fruit bowl. Slowly pour in chilled carbonated water. Makes about 24 (4 ounce) servings.

recipes.title: Pineapple Zucchini Bread
directions: Beat eggs well, add sugar. Blend in oil and vanilla. Add zucchini. Add dry ingredients, then pineapple, raisins, nut, and coconut. Mix well. Pour into 2 well-greased loaf pans (don't fill too full). Bake 325° for 1 hour and 20 minutes.
recipes.text: Pineapple Zucchini Bread. Beat eggs well, add sugar. Blend in oil and vanilla. Add zucchini. Add dry ingredients, then pineapple, raisins, nut, and coconut. Mix well. Pour into 2 well-greased loaf pans (don't fill too full). Bake 325° for 1 hour and 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Old Fashioned Sugar Cookies
ingredients: 1 tsp. sour milk (add 1/4 to 1/2 tsp. vinegar to milk)
directions: Sift together flour, salt and powder; add soda and milk. Cream shortening and sugar; add eggs and beat well.
Alternate additions of milk mixture and flour; add vanilla.
Chill.
Roll out and cut out.
Bake at 350° to 400° for 8 to 10 minutes on greased cookie sheet.
recipes.text: Old Fashioned Sugar Cookies. Sift together flour, salt and powder; add soda and milk. Cream shortening and sugar; add eggs and beat well. Alternate additions of milk mixture and flour; add vanilla. Chill. Roll out and cut out. Bake at 350° to 400° for 8 to 10 minutes on greased cookie sheet.

recipes.title: Refrigerated Cheese Spread
ingredients: 8 oz. cream cheese (soft), cut into bits
1/2 lb. lean corned beef, chopped fine
directions: Preheat oven to 375°. In bowl, combine cream cheese, sour cream, sauerkraut, corned beef, onion, ketchup, mustard and Swiss cheese. Transfer dip to medium sized ovenproof casserole, covered. Bake 30 minutes or until bubbles form around the edges. Remove cover and bake 5 more minutes or until it turns golden. Serve warm with crackers.
recipes.text: Refrigerated Cheese Spread. Preheat oven to 375°. In bowl, combine cream cheese, sour cream, sauerkraut, corned beef, onion, ketchup, mustard and Swiss cheese. Transfer dip to medium sized ovenproof casserole, covered. Bake 30 minutes or until bubbles form around the edges. Remove cover and bake 5 more minutes or until it turns golden. Serve warm with crackers.

recipes.title: Coconut Flake Cookies
directions: Mix in order given; drop from teaspoon.
Bake 12 to 15 minutes at 375°.
recipes.text: Coconut Flake Cookies. Mix in order given; drop from teaspoon. Bake 12 to 15 minutes at 375°.

recipes.title: Carrot Oat Muffins
directions: Combine oats and milk; let stand 15 minutes. Beat egg and honey. Combine flour, baking powder and salt. Stir with egg mixture into oat mixture. Fold in carrots and orange rind, stirring only to moisten. Spoon into 12 muffin cups sprayed with nonfat cooking spray. Bake at 400° for 20 to 25 minutes. Serves 12.
recipes.text: Carrot Oat Muffins. Combine oats and milk; let stand 15 minutes. Beat egg and honey. Combine flour, baking powder and salt. Stir with egg mixture into oat mixture. Fold in carrots and orange rind, stirring only to moisten. Spoon into 12 muffin cups sprayed with nonfat cooking spray. Bake at 400° for 20 to 25 minutes. Serves 12.

recipes.title: Caramel Sandwich Cookies
ingredients: 1 (14 oz.) can Eagle Brand sweetened condensed milk
directions: In mixer bowl, beat margarine, sugar, cheese, egg yolk, 1/2 teaspoon almond extract, vanilla and salt until well blended.
Add flour; mix well.
Chill 2 hours on floured surface; knead dough to form a smooth ball.
Divide into thirds on floured surface; roll out each portion to 1/8-inch thickness.
Cut into desired shapes. Place on cookie sheets and brush with slightly beaten egg white and sprinkle with colored sugars.
Bake in 375° oven for 7 to 10 minutes.
Cool.
recipes.text: Caramel Sandwich Cookies. In mixer bowl, beat margarine, sugar, cheese, egg yolk, 1/2 teaspoon almond extract, vanilla and salt until well blended. Add flour; mix well. Chill 2 hours on floured surface; knead dough to form a smooth ball. Divide into thirds on floured surface; roll out each portion to 1/8-inch thickness. Cut into desired shapes. Place on cookie sheets and brush with slightly beaten egg white and sprinkle with colored sugars. Bake in 375° oven for 7 to 10 minutes. Cool.

recipes.title: Meat Loaf
directions: Preheat oven to 350°.
Scald milk.
Allow it to cool.
Mix the milk with the rest of the ingredients.
Bake for at least 1 1/2 hours.
recipes.text: Meat Loaf. Preheat oven to 350°. Scald milk. Allow it to cool. Mix the milk with the rest of the ingredients. Bake for at least 1 1/2 hours.

recipes.title: Spinach Lasagna
ingredients: 1 (10 oz.) pkg. frozen, chopped spinach, cooked and drained
directions: Combine spaghetti sauce and water.
Set aside.
Combine eggs, Ricotta cheese, spinach and 1/4 cup Parmesan cheese, stirring well. Set aside.
Spread 1 cup tomato mixture in a lightly greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish.
Layer half each of uncooked lasagna noodles, spinach mixture, Mozzarella cheese and tomato mixture; repeat layers.
Sprinkle with remaining 1/4 cup Parmesan cheese.
Cover dish securely with aluminum foil.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
Let lasagna stand 10 minutes before serving.
recipes.text: Spinach Lasagna. Combine spaghetti sauce and water. Set aside. Combine eggs, Ricotta cheese, spinach and 1/4 cup Parmesan cheese, stirring well. Set aside. Spread 1 cup tomato mixture in a lightly greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish. Layer half each of uncooked lasagna noodles, spinach mixture, Mozzarella cheese and tomato mixture; repeat layers. Sprinkle with remaining 1/4 cup Parmesan cheese. Cover dish securely with aluminum foil. Bake at 350° for 1 hour. Let lasagna stand 10 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Broccoli Salad
directions: Mix together mayonnaise and lemon juice.
Toss together with other ingredients; chill.
Makes 6 to 8 servings.
recipes.text: Broccoli Salad. Mix together mayonnaise and lemon juice. Toss together with other ingredients; chill. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

recipes.title: Spinach Lasagna Roll-Ups
ingredients: 1 (10 oz.) pkg. frozen chopped spinach, thawed and squeezed to drain
directions: Preheat oven to 350°. Cook noodles as directed on package; drain, rinse and cover in cool water until ready to use. Then remove from water, lay flat on paper towels and pat dry. After noodles are dry, lay flat on a cutting board, side by side.
recipes.text: Spinach Lasagna Roll-Ups. Preheat oven to 350°. Cook noodles as directed on package; drain, rinse and cover in cool water until ready to use. Then remove from water, lay flat on paper towels and pat dry. After noodles are dry, lay flat on a cutting board, side by side.

recipes.title: Corn Fritters
ingredients: 1 1/2 to 2 c. whole kernel corn, drained
directions: Beat egg whites in small mixer bowl on high speed until stiff. Beat egg yolks on high speed for 1 minute.
Add corn, salt, pepper and flour.
Beat on low speed until blended.
Add beaten whites; fold in on lowest speed.
Add oil in frypan.
When hot, drop the batter by spoonfuls.
Fry both sides until brown.
Serve hot with syrup.
recipes.text: Corn Fritters. Beat egg whites in small mixer bowl on high speed until stiff. Beat egg yolks on high speed for 1 minute. Add corn, salt, pepper and flour. Beat on low speed until blended. Add beaten whites; fold in on lowest speed. Add oil in frypan. When hot, drop the batter by spoonfuls. Fry both sides until brown. Serve hot with syrup.

recipes.title: Hash Brown Casserole
directions: Partially thaw
hash browns and mix with other ingredients except parmesan
cheese.
Pour into a greased 9 x 13-inch baking dish.
Sprinkle
Parmesan
cheese
over
top.
Bake, uncovered, for 1 hour at 350°.
recipes.text: Hash Brown Casserole. Partially thaw hash browns and mix with other ingredients except parmesan cheese. Pour into a greased 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Sprinkle Parmesan cheese over top. Bake, uncovered, for 1 hour at 350°.

recipes.title: Apricot Salad
directions: Bring to a boil the jello, sugar and water.
Add baby food, pineapple and juice from pineapple.
Set aside to cool.
Mix milk, cream cheese and nuts.
Combine with first mixture.
Pour in large mold or 9 x 13-inch dish.
Refrigerate until time to serve.
recipes.text: Apricot Salad. Bring to a boil the jello, sugar and water. Add baby food, pineapple and juice from pineapple. Set aside to cool. Mix milk, cream cheese and nuts. Combine with first mixture. Pour in large mold or 9 x 13-inch dish. Refrigerate until time to serve.

recipes.title: Grandma'S Hot Rice
ingredients: 1 small can green chili peppers, chopped
directions: Mix rice together with sour cream, chili peppers, salt and pepper.
Grate cheese and sprinkle over top of rice mixture.
Bake at 350° for 30 to 45 minutes.
Serve hot.
recipes.text: Grandma'S Hot Rice. Mix rice together with sour cream, chili peppers, salt and pepper. Grate cheese and sprinkle over top of rice mixture. Bake at 350° for 30 to 45 minutes. Serve hot.

recipes.title: Broccoli Quiche
ingredients: 1/2 c. Swiss or Cheddar cheese, grated
single pie crust or quiche crust
directions: Combine all ingredients.
Pour into crust-lined pie plate or quiche pan.
Bake 30 to 40 minutes at 375° or until knife comes out clean.
recipes.text: Broccoli Quiche. Combine all ingredients. Pour into crust-lined pie plate or quiche pan. Bake 30 to 40 minutes at 375° or until knife comes out clean.

recipes.title: Baked Spaghetti
directions: Blend eggs with parmesan cheese. Mix with spaghetti. Then layer 1/2 of the spaghetti in 8 x 8 inch pan. Cover with spaghetti sauce, 1/2 cup shredded mozzarella. Then add another layer of spaghetti, sauce and cheese. Cover with foil and bake at 350 degrees for 20 to 30 minutes. Removing foil for the last few minutes of baking.
recipes.text: Baked Spaghetti. Blend eggs with parmesan cheese. Mix with spaghetti. Then layer 1/2 of the spaghetti in 8 x 8 inch pan. Cover with spaghetti sauce, 1/2 cup shredded mozzarella. Then add another layer of spaghetti, sauce and cheese. Cover with foil and bake at 350 degrees for 20 to 30 minutes. Removing foil for the last few minutes of baking.

recipes.title: Buttermilk Pie
directions: Mix all ingredients; beat well.
Pour into unbaked pie shell and bake for 15 minutes at 400°, then reduce to 300° and continue to bake until firm.
recipes.text: Buttermilk Pie. Mix all ingredients; beat well. Pour into unbaked pie shell and bake for 15 minutes at 400°, then reduce to 300° and continue to bake until firm.

recipes.title: Broccoli Salad
ingredients: 1 bunch broccoli or 1 head cauliflower, chopped
directions: Mix first 4 ingredients together in large bowl.
Then mix salad dressing, sugar and vinegar together in small bowl.
Pour over broccoli mixture.
Refrigerate and let stand for a couple of hours.
recipes.text: Broccoli Salad. Mix first 4 ingredients together in large bowl. Then mix salad dressing, sugar and vinegar together in small bowl. Pour over broccoli mixture. Refrigerate and let stand for a couple of hours.

recipes.title: Poppy Seed Dressing
directions: Mix sugar, mustard, salt and vinegar.
Add onion juice and stir in thoroughly.
Add oil slowly and continue to beat until thick.
Add poppy seed and beat a few minutes.
Store in a cool place or refrigerate.
Makes 3 1/2 cups.
recipes.text: Poppy Seed Dressing. Mix sugar, mustard, salt and vinegar. Add onion juice and stir in thoroughly. Add oil slowly and continue to beat until thick. Add poppy seed and beat a few minutes. Store in a cool place or refrigerate. Makes 3 1/2 cups.

recipes.title: Cream Cheese Pound Cake
directions: Cream butter and cream cheese.
Add sugar, beating well.
Add eggs, one at a time.
Add other ingredients, beating well.
Bake at 300° for 1 1/2 hours.
recipes.text: Cream Cheese Pound Cake. Cream butter and cream cheese. Add sugar, beating well. Add eggs, one at a time. Add other ingredients, beating well. Bake at 300° for 1 1/2 hours.

recipes.title: Chocolate Gravy
directions: Combine sugar, flour, and cocoa in sauce pan.
Stir well. Add milk.
Cook on medium heat until desired thickness.
Remove from heat.	Add butter and vanilla.
Serve over hot buttered biscuits.
recipes.text: Chocolate Gravy. Combine sugar, flour, and cocoa in sauce pan. Stir well. Add milk. Cook on medium heat until desired thickness. Remove from heat.	Add butter and vanilla. Serve over hot buttered biscuits.

recipes.title: Sausage Casserole
directions: Cook sausage, crumble and drain.
Set aside.
Cut up vegetables.
In medium saucepan, combine vegetables, soup mix, rice and water.
Boil for 7 minutes.
Mix sausage with soup mixture.
Pour into 2-quart baking dish.
Bake at 350° until bubbly.
recipes.text: Sausage Casserole. Cook sausage, crumble and drain. Set aside. Cut up vegetables. In medium saucepan, combine vegetables, soup mix, rice and water. Boil for 7 minutes. Mix sausage with soup mixture. Pour into 2-quart baking dish. Bake at 350° until bubbly.

recipes.title: Fideo Soup
directions: Put about 1/4-inch oil in pot over low heat. Add slightly crushed fideo.
Cook until light brown. Turn off heat. Drain oil. Add garlic, onion and tomato sauce. Stir quickly. Add boiling water and bouillon cubes.
Return to a boil. Cover and lower heat to a simmer. Cook about 7 to 8 minutes or until noodles are done.
recipes.text: Fideo Soup. Put about 1/4-inch oil in pot over low heat. Add slightly crushed fideo. Cook until light brown. Turn off heat. Drain oil. Add garlic, onion and tomato sauce. Stir quickly. Add boiling water and bouillon cubes. Return to a boil. Cover and lower heat to a simmer. Cook about 7 to 8 minutes or until noodles are done.

recipes.title: Baked Stuffed Tomatoes
directions: Cover bottom of buttered baking dish with 3 cups of bread crumbs.
Drain off some of the tomato juice.
Mix tomatoes with onion, salt and pepper.
Pour over crumbs in baking dish.
Cover remaining crumbs and dot with butter.
Bake at 350° for 20 minutes until crumbs are brown.
recipes.text: Baked Stuffed Tomatoes. Cover bottom of buttered baking dish with 3 cups of bread crumbs. Drain off some of the tomato juice. Mix tomatoes with onion, salt and pepper. Pour over crumbs in baking dish. Cover remaining crumbs and dot with butter. Bake at 350° for 20 minutes until crumbs are brown.

recipes.title: Hot-Milk Sponge Cake
directions: In small saucepan, heat milk until it bubbles around edges of pan.
Remove from heat; set aside.
Sift flour with baking powder and salt.
Set aside.
Beat eggs until thick and lemon-colored. Gradually add sugar, beating until mixture is smooth and well blended, about 5 minutes.
At low speed (mixer) blend in flour mixture until smooth.
Add warm milk and vanilla, beating just until combined.
Bake in two 8-inch round pans, 9 x 9-inch pan or 24 cupcake tins at 375° for 25 to 30 minutes.
Delicious!
recipes.text: Hot-Milk Sponge Cake. In small saucepan, heat milk until it bubbles around edges of pan. Remove from heat; set aside. Sift flour with baking powder and salt. Set aside. Beat eggs until thick and lemon-colored. Gradually add sugar, beating until mixture is smooth and well blended, about 5 minutes. At low speed (mixer) blend in flour mixture until smooth. Add warm milk and vanilla, beating just until combined. Bake in two 8-inch round pans, 9 x 9-inch pan or 24 cupcake tins at 375° for 25 to 30 minutes. Delicious!

recipes.title: Caramel Pull-Aparts
directions: Arrange frozen rolls in a single layer in an angel food pan. Mix brown sugar and dry pudding mix together.
Pour melted butter over rolls and sprinkle with pudding/sugar mixture.
Top with nuts.
Cover and let rise at room temperature 10 to 12 hours, or overnight.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
To serve, slice or pull apart.
recipes.text: Caramel Pull-Aparts. Arrange frozen rolls in a single layer in an angel food pan. Mix brown sugar and dry pudding mix together. Pour melted butter over rolls and sprinkle with pudding/sugar mixture. Top with nuts. Cover and let rise at room temperature 10 to 12 hours, or overnight. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes. To serve, slice or pull apart.

recipes.title: Caramel Popcorn
directions: Boil slowly for 5 minutes the first four ingredients.
Add Soda and stir in well.
Pour over Popcorn.
Put on a cookie sheet or large pan for 1 hour at 200 degrees.
Stir every 10 to 15 minutes.
recipes.text: Caramel Popcorn. Boil slowly for 5 minutes the first four ingredients. Add Soda and stir in well. Pour over Popcorn. Put on a cookie sheet or large pan for 1 hour at 200 degrees. Stir every 10 to 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Vegetables And Pasta
ingredients: Parmesan Cheese, Oregano, Pepper to Taste
directions: 1. Boil pasta until almost done. Add broccoli for one minute. Add remaining vegetables and immediately drain.
2. Mix pasta, vegetables, salad dressing, and seasonings
in a large dish and serve while warm.
recipes.text: Vegetables And Pasta. 1. Boil pasta until almost done. Add broccoli for one minute. Add remaining vegetables and immediately drain. 2. Mix pasta, vegetables, salad dressing, and seasonings in a large dish and serve while warm.

recipes.title: Oven Stew
directions: Mix soups and water well.
Add meat, carrots and potatoes. Put into casserole or pan and cover.
Bake 2 1/2 hours at 350°.
recipes.text: Oven Stew. Mix soups and water well. Add meat, carrots and potatoes. Put into casserole or pan and cover. Bake 2 1/2 hours at 350°.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter And Granola Logs
directions: Stir together peanut butter and honey in large bowl until smooth.
Stir in raisins, then the granola, until blended.
Form 1 heaping tablespoonful of mixture into 2 x 3/4-inch logs.
Repeat with remaining mixture.
Refrigerate 1 hour until firm.
recipes.text: Peanut Butter And Granola Logs. Stir together peanut butter and honey in large bowl until smooth. Stir in raisins, then the granola, until blended. Form 1 heaping tablespoonful of mixture into 2 x 3/4-inch logs. Repeat with remaining mixture. Refrigerate 1 hour until firm.

recipes.title: Old-Fashioned Rice Custard
directions: In the top
of a double boiler, combine rice and 2 cups milk. Cook,
stirring
occasionally, over boiling water until rice is tender
and most of the water has evaporated, about 45 minutes. Stir in butter.
Beat eggs; blend in sugar, vanilla, salt and
the remaining milk.
Stir into the hot rice mixture. Pour into
a lightly
greased
2-quart casserole and top with nutmeg.
Bake at 350° for 50 minutes or until firm.
Yield:
6 to 8 servings.
recipes.text: Old-Fashioned Rice Custard. In the top of a double boiler, combine rice and 2 cups milk. Cook, stirring occasionally, over boiling water until rice is tender and most of the water has evaporated, about 45 minutes. Stir in butter. Beat eggs; blend in sugar, vanilla, salt and the remaining milk. Stir into the hot rice mixture. Pour into a lightly greased 2-quart casserole and top with nutmeg. Bake at 350° for 50 minutes or until firm. Yield: 6 to 8 servings.

recipes.title: German Chocolate Cake Frosting
directions: In a medium saucepan, combine sugar, milk, eggs and shortening.
Cook over medium heat; mix until it comes to a boil. Remove from heat.
Stir in vanilla, coconut and pecans.
Cool for 15 minutes.
recipes.text: German Chocolate Cake Frosting. In a medium saucepan, combine sugar, milk, eggs and shortening. Cook over medium heat; mix until it comes to a boil. Remove from heat. Stir in vanilla, coconut and pecans. Cool for 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Sugared Pecans
directions: Cook sugar, water and juice to soft-ball stage.
Add pecans and stir to coat.
Spread out to cool.
recipes.text: Sugared Pecans. Cook sugar, water and juice to soft-ball stage. Add pecans and stir to coat. Spread out to cool.

recipes.title: Easy Barbecue Sauce
ingredients: 14 oz. hot catsup or 12 oz. chili sauce
directions: In bowl, combine catsup or chili sauce, vinegar and garlic powder.
Cover and chill for several hours.
Use to baste burgers, beef, pork or chicken.
Brush on the last 10 minutes of grilling. Yield: 1 1/2 cups.
recipes.text: Easy Barbecue Sauce. In bowl, combine catsup or chili sauce, vinegar and garlic powder. Cover and chill for several hours. Use to baste burgers, beef, pork or chicken. Brush on the last 10 minutes of grilling. Yield: 1 1/2 cups.

recipes.title: Turkey
directions: Have turkey at room temperature.
Rub inside and out with salt.
Preheat oven to 475°.
recipes.text: Turkey. Have turkey at room temperature. Rub inside and out with salt. Preheat oven to 475°.

recipes.title: Green Onion Dip
directions: Blend all ingredients; cover and chill.
Makes 2 cups.
recipes.text: Green Onion Dip. Blend all ingredients; cover and chill. Makes 2 cups.

recipes.title: Double Batch Easy Baked Beans
ingredients: 2 (16 oz.) cans Ranch Style beans or barbecue style beans
directions: Brown meat and onion together.
In crock-pot, add all ingredients.
Bake at 300° for about 2 hours (low setting on crock-pot).
Can be baked in a large Corning Ware dish in oven.
recipes.text: Double Batch Easy Baked Beans. Brown meat and onion together. In crock-pot, add all ingredients. Bake at 300° for about 2 hours (low setting on crock-pot). Can be baked in a large Corning Ware dish in oven.

recipes.title: Chicken And Dressing
directions: Stew fryer.
Remove skin and bones.
Cut meat into small pieces.
Save broth for dressing.
Spread chicken on bottom of baking dish.
Cover with soup.
Spread evenly over chicken.
Mix dressing as the directions say.
Spread on top of chicken.
Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes.
recipes.text: Chicken And Dressing. Stew fryer. Remove skin and bones. Cut meat into small pieces. Save broth for dressing. Spread chicken on bottom of baking dish. Cover with soup. Spread evenly over chicken. Mix dressing as the directions say. Spread on top of chicken. Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Sweet Peach Pickles
directions: Wash, peel and dice peaches.
Combine all ingredients including peaches.
Bring slowly to a boil; boil uncovered for 5 minutes.
Put in hot jars and seal.
recipes.text: Sweet Peach Pickles. Wash, peel and dice peaches. Combine all ingredients including peaches. Bring slowly to a boil; boil uncovered for 5 minutes. Put in hot jars and seal.

recipes.title: Fruit Dip
directions: Mix well and chill at least 1 hour.
Put fresh fruit around.
recipes.text: Fruit Dip. Mix well and chill at least 1 hour. Put fresh fruit around.

recipes.title: Blackberry Jam Cake
ingredients: 1 c. blackberry jam without seeds (use good quality)
directions: Stir baking soda into buttermilk; set aside.
In large mixer bowl, cream butter or margarine and sugar until light and fluffy. Add eggs, one at a time, beat well.
In medium bowl, combine flour, cinnamon, cloves and nutmeg; add alternately with buttermilk to egg mixture, beginning and ending with flour.
Stir in jam.
Bake at 350° until done.
Frost with Cream Cheese Frosting.
recipes.text: Blackberry Jam Cake. Stir baking soda into buttermilk; set aside. In large mixer bowl, cream butter or margarine and sugar until light and fluffy. Add eggs, one at a time, beat well. In medium bowl, combine flour, cinnamon, cloves and nutmeg; add alternately with buttermilk to egg mixture, beginning and ending with flour. Stir in jam. Bake at 350° until done. Frost with Cream Cheese Frosting.

recipes.title: Tater Tot Casserole
ingredients: 1 can cream of chicken or cream of mushroom soup
directions: Brown ground beef with onion in skillet, stirring until crumbly.
Place in 2-quart casserole.
Top with soup and Tater Tots.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Tater Tot Casserole. Brown ground beef with onion in skillet, stirring until crumbly. Place in 2-quart casserole. Top with soup and Tater Tots. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Canned Fruit For Pie Filling Or Crisp
directions: Bring ingredients to a boil until clear.
Fill jars 3/4 full with fruit.
Pour filling on top.
Process in hot water bath for 35 minutes.
For apples, cherries, peaches and rhubarb.
recipes.text: Canned Fruit For Pie Filling Or Crisp. Bring ingredients to a boil until clear. Fill jars 3/4 full with fruit. Pour filling on top. Process in hot water bath for 35 minutes. For apples, cherries, peaches and rhubarb.

recipes.title: Green Enchiladas
ingredients: 1 (14 oz.) can green chiles or jalapenos
directions: Heat tortillas in skillet, one at a time.
Place 2 tablespoons of cheese, chicken and onion in each tortilla and roll.
Place, seam side down, in 11 x 7 x 1 3/4-inch baking dish.
recipes.text: Green Enchiladas. Heat tortillas in skillet, one at a time. Place 2 tablespoons of cheese, chicken and onion in each tortilla and roll. Place, seam side down, in 11 x 7 x 1 3/4-inch baking dish.

recipes.title: Quiche Lorraine
ingredients: 3/4 c. (3 oz.) shredded reduced-fat reduced sodium Swiss cheese
directions: Unroll breadstick dough, separating into strips.
Working on a flat surface, coil one strip of dough around itself into a spiral pattern.
Add second strip of dough to the end of the first strip, pinching ends together to seal; continue coiling dough in a spiral pattern.
Repeat procedure with remaining dough strips to make an 8-inch flat circle.
Roll dough into a 13-inch circle and fit into a 9-inch quiche dish or pie plate coated with cooking spray.
Fold edges under and flute; set prepared crust aside.
recipes.text: Quiche Lorraine. Unroll breadstick dough, separating into strips. Working on a flat surface, coil one strip of dough around itself into a spiral pattern. Add second strip of dough to the end of the first strip, pinching ends together to seal; continue coiling dough in a spiral pattern. Repeat procedure with remaining dough strips to make an 8-inch flat circle. Roll dough into a 13-inch circle and fit into a 9-inch quiche dish or pie plate coated with cooking spray. Fold edges under and flute; set prepared crust aside.

recipes.title: Broccoli Casserole
ingredients: 1 c. American or Parmesan cheese or Velveeta
directions: Mix all ingredients and put in greased casserole dish. Sprinkle with bread or cracker crumbs.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes to 1 hour.
recipes.text: Broccoli Casserole. Mix all ingredients and put in greased casserole dish. Sprinkle with bread or cracker crumbs. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes to 1 hour.

recipes.title: White Clam Sauce For Vermicelli
ingredients: 1/2 lb. vermicelli, cooked by pkg. instructions
directions: Saute garlic in oil, mashing to extract juice.
Add clam juice, salt, pepper and oregano; simmer 5 minutes.
Add clams with juice.
Stir in well and cook uncovered, about 8 to 10 minutes so liquid will reduce a little.
Mix in parsley and onion tops.
Toss half of sauce with vermicelli and top with the rest of the sauce. Sprinkle with Parmesan.
Serves 4.
(Can be doubled.)
recipes.text: White Clam Sauce For Vermicelli. Saute garlic in oil, mashing to extract juice. Add clam juice, salt, pepper and oregano; simmer 5 minutes. Add clams with juice. Stir in well and cook uncovered, about 8 to 10 minutes so liquid will reduce a little. Mix in parsley and onion tops. Toss half of sauce with vermicelli and top with the rest of the sauce. Sprinkle with Parmesan. Serves 4. (Can be doubled.)

recipes.title: Chicken Casserole
directions: Cook and debone chicken.
Lay chicken in bottom of buttered baking dish.
Mix soup and sour cream and pour over chicken. Crush crackers and spread over soup mixture.
Melt margarine and pour over crackers.
Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Chicken Casserole. Cook and debone chicken. Lay chicken in bottom of buttered baking dish. Mix soup and sour cream and pour over chicken. Crush crackers and spread over soup mixture. Melt margarine and pour over crackers. Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Health Salad
directions: Mix orange jello and boiling water together and let stand. Mix all remaining ingredients with set jello.
Decorate with miniature marshmallows.
recipes.text: Health Salad. Mix orange jello and boiling water together and let stand. Mix all remaining ingredients with set jello. Decorate with miniature marshmallows.

recipes.title: Flaky Pie Crust
ingredients: 1 1/2 c. cold water and a little vinegar
directions: Mix first 4 ingredients thoroughly.
Add the rest of the ingredients. This recipe makes about 12 fruit pies, depending on the thickness of crust.
recipes.text: Flaky Pie Crust. Mix first 4 ingredients thoroughly. Add the rest of the ingredients. This recipe makes about 12 fruit pies, depending on the thickness of crust.

recipes.title: Cornflake Macaroons
directions: Beat egg white.
Add 2 tablespoons of sugar and beat until stiff.
Stir in remaining sugar and ingredients.
Bake at 350° for 10 minutes or until lightly browned.
Makes about 1 1/2 dozen.
recipes.text: Cornflake Macaroons. Beat egg white. Add 2 tablespoons of sugar and beat until stiff. Stir in remaining sugar and ingredients. Bake at 350° for 10 minutes or until lightly browned. Makes about 1 1/2 dozen.

recipes.title: Taco Dip
directions: On a platter, layer the bean dip, then sauce.
Sprinkle the chopped tomatoes, as desired.
Top with shredded lettuce and then shred cheese over the lettuce.
Use tostados or Fritos to scarf down this tasty dish.
recipes.text: Taco Dip. On a platter, layer the bean dip, then sauce. Sprinkle the chopped tomatoes, as desired. Top with shredded lettuce and then shred cheese over the lettuce. Use tostados or Fritos to scarf down this tasty dish.

recipes.title: Tiny Meatballs
directions: In large mixing bowl, combine ingredients and blend well. Form into small balls, about 1-inch in diameter.
Arrange half the meatballs in a single layer in a microproof baking dish.
Cook, uncovered, on 90 (Saute) 5 to 6 minutes.
Place in chafing dish to keep hot.
Cook remaining meatballs and add to chafing dish. Serve hot.
Use toothpicks to spear meatballs and dunk in Curry Dipper.
These may be prepared in advance and reheated just before serving on High (Maximum power) 2 to 3 minutes.
Makes about 60 meatballs.
recipes.text: Tiny Meatballs. In large mixing bowl, combine ingredients and blend well. Form into small balls, about 1-inch in diameter. Arrange half the meatballs in a single layer in a microproof baking dish. Cook, uncovered, on 90 (Saute) 5 to 6 minutes. Place in chafing dish to keep hot. Cook remaining meatballs and add to chafing dish. Serve hot. Use toothpicks to spear meatballs and dunk in Curry Dipper. These may be prepared in advance and reheated just before serving on High (Maximum power) 2 to 3 minutes. Makes about 60 meatballs.

recipes.title: Coffee Cake
directions: Pour batter into 9 x 13-inch baking pan.
Sprinkle sugar mixture on top.
With knife, swirl into batter to marbleize.
Bake 35 to 40 minutes at 350° until it looks done.
recipes.text: Coffee Cake. Pour batter into 9 x 13-inch baking pan. Sprinkle sugar mixture on top. With knife, swirl into batter to marbleize. Bake 35 to 40 minutes at 350° until it looks done.

recipes.title: Midnight Chocolate Cake
directions: Sift together in mixing bowl the flour, salt, cocoa, soda and baking powder.
Add the Crisco, sugar, vanilla and hot water.
Mix together on low speed.
Then continue beating for 2 minutes.
Add the eggs and beat 1 minute more.
Pour into well-greased 8 1/2 x 11-inch cake pan.
Bake 30 minutes at 350°.
Watch carefully and don't overbake.
recipes.text: Midnight Chocolate Cake. Sift together in mixing bowl the flour, salt, cocoa, soda and baking powder. Add the Crisco, sugar, vanilla and hot water. Mix together on low speed. Then continue beating for 2 minutes. Add the eggs and beat 1 minute more. Pour into well-greased 8 1/2 x 11-inch cake pan. Bake 30 minutes at 350°. Watch carefully and don't overbake.

recipes.title: Nacho Cheese Dip
ingredients: 12 oz. Monterey Jack cheese with jalapeno peppers (optional)
directions: Brown hamburger meat and sausage.
Drain fat.
Combine all ingredients in a crock-pot.
Cook until cheese melts.
Serve over chips.
recipes.text: Nacho Cheese Dip. Brown hamburger meat and sausage. Drain fat. Combine all ingredients in a crock-pot. Cook until cheese melts. Serve over chips.

recipes.title: Old Fashioned Potato Candy
directions: In bowl mix potatoes, vanilla and confectioners sugar.
Mix until stiff.
If not stiff enough add more sugar until stiff.
Use a cutting board.
Sprinkle confectioners sugar on board.
Roll out.
Spread peanut butter on thin or thick.
Roll up and cut.
recipes.text: Old Fashioned Potato Candy. In bowl mix potatoes, vanilla and confectioners sugar. Mix until stiff. If not stiff enough add more sugar until stiff. Use a cutting board. Sprinkle confectioners sugar on board. Roll out. Spread peanut butter on thin or thick. Roll up and cut.

recipes.title: Salmon Croquettes
directions: Drain juice from salmon, reserving 1/4 c.
Dump salmon into a bowl and add egg and flour.
Mix until gummy.
Do not mix the following until ready to use.
Mix salmon juice and baking powder until it foams.
Combine foaming mixture with salmon.
Drop by teaspoonfuls into hot deep fat.
Drain on paper towels.
recipes.text: Salmon Croquettes. Drain juice from salmon, reserving 1/4 c. Dump salmon into a bowl and add egg and flour. Mix until gummy. Do not mix the following until ready to use. Mix salmon juice and baking powder until it foams. Combine foaming mixture with salmon. Drop by teaspoonfuls into hot deep fat. Drain on paper towels.

recipes.title: One-Skillet Supper
ingredients: 1/2 large bell pepper or whole small one, chopped
directions: Brown pork chops in a large skillet over medium heat. Sprinkle rice over chops. Add all other ingredients. Cover skillet and reduce heat to low. Simmer mixture until rice has absorbed the liquid and chops are tender, about 45 minutes.
recipes.text: One-Skillet Supper. Brown pork chops in a large skillet over medium heat. Sprinkle rice over chops. Add all other ingredients. Cover skillet and reduce heat to low. Simmer mixture until rice has absorbed the liquid and chops are tender, about 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Pasta Primavera
ingredients: 1 large carrot, scraped and diagonally sliced
2 Tbsp. fresh basil or 2 tsp. dried whole basil
directions: Snap off tough ends of asparagus.
Remove scales with vegetable peeler or knife.

Cut asparagus diagonally into 1 1/2-inch pieces. Place asparagus pieces and broccoli flowerets in a vegetable steamer over boiling water; cover and steam 6 to 8 minutes or until vegetables are crisp-tender.
Remove from heat; set aside.
Saute onion and garlic in oil in a large skillet until tender.
Add carrot and chopped peppers to onion mixture.
Saute until crisp-tender.
Remove from heat; drain.
Combine whipping cream, broth, green onions, basil and salt in a medium skillet.
Cover over medium-high heat; cook 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Cook linguine according to package directions.
Drain well.
Place in a large serving bowl.
Add reserved vegetables, whipping cream mixture and sliced mushrooms.
Toss gently.
Serve immediately.
recipes.text: Pasta Primavera. Snap off tough ends of asparagus. Remove scales with vegetable peeler or knife. Cut asparagus diagonally into 1 1/2-inch pieces. Place asparagus pieces and broccoli flowerets in a vegetable steamer over boiling water; cover and steam 6 to 8 minutes or until vegetables are crisp-tender. Remove from heat; set aside. Saute onion and garlic in oil in a large skillet until tender. Add carrot and chopped peppers to onion mixture. Saute until crisp-tender. Remove from heat; drain. Combine whipping cream, broth, green onions, basil and salt in a medium skillet. Cover over medium-high heat; cook 5 minutes, stirring occasionally. Cook linguine according to package directions. Drain well. Place in a large serving bowl. Add reserved vegetables, whipping cream mixture and sliced mushrooms. Toss gently. Serve immediately.

recipes.title: Butter Pound Cake
directions: Sift flour, sugar, baking powder, baking soda and salt into a medium size mixing bowl, then add raisins.
Add vinegar to the milk and stir into the dry ingredients, mixing well (the dough is sticky).
Turn dough out onto a lightly floured surface and knead gently for about 1 minute.
Grease and flour bunny mold or spray with nonstick cooking spray like Pam and lightly flour.
Place dough in mold, making sure to fill mold evenly.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.
Cool Raisin Bread Bunny completely on wire rack, then have fun decorating as desired with thin icing topped with flaked coconut or topping of your choice.
recipes.text: Butter Pound Cake. Sift flour, sugar, baking powder, baking soda and salt into a medium size mixing bowl, then add raisins. Add vinegar to the milk and stir into the dry ingredients, mixing well (the dough is sticky). Turn dough out onto a lightly floured surface and knead gently for about 1 minute. Grease and flour bunny mold or spray with nonstick cooking spray like Pam and lightly flour. Place dough in mold, making sure to fill mold evenly. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes. Cool Raisin Bread Bunny completely on wire rack, then have fun decorating as desired with thin icing topped with flaked coconut or topping of your choice.

recipes.title: Vegetable Medley
directions: Cook turnips and carrots for 10 minutes in boiling water with 1/2 teaspoon salt added.
Add peas and cook until tender, about 5 to 7 minutes.
Drain; season with butter or margarine.
Sprinkle with salt and pepper.
recipes.text: Vegetable Medley. Cook turnips and carrots for 10 minutes in boiling water with 1/2 teaspoon salt added. Add peas and cook until tender, about 5 to 7 minutes. Drain; season with butter or margarine. Sprinkle with salt and pepper.

recipes.title: Crab Dip
directions: Combine all ingredients and mix well.
Is best if made a day ahead.
recipes.text: Crab Dip. Combine all ingredients and mix well. Is best if made a day ahead.

recipes.title: Meat Loaf Bracciole
ingredients: 1 (4 oz.) can mushrooms, drained and reserve liquid
directions: Add enough water to mushroom liquid to make 1/2 cup.
In bowl, combine beef, 1/2 cup bread crumbs, egg, mushroom liquid, garlic powder and salt.
Heat oven to 350°.
recipes.text: Meat Loaf Bracciole. Add enough water to mushroom liquid to make 1/2 cup. In bowl, combine beef, 1/2 cup bread crumbs, egg, mushroom liquid, garlic powder and salt. Heat oven to 350°.

recipes.title: Rhubarb Custard Bars
directions: Combine flour and sugar.
Cut in butter.
Press into greased 9 x 13 pan.
Bake at 350° for 10 minutes.
recipes.text: Rhubarb Custard Bars. Combine flour and sugar. Cut in butter. Press into greased 9 x 13 pan. Bake at 350° for 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Onion Cucumber Salad
directions: Pull tines of fork firmly down length of the cucumber. Repeat this all the way around the cucumber.
Thinly slice onion, separating rings.
Combine remaining ingredients.
Pour over vegetables.
Marinate 1 hour.
Drain to serve.
recipes.text: Onion Cucumber Salad. Pull tines of fork firmly down length of the cucumber. Repeat this all the way around the cucumber. Thinly slice onion, separating rings. Combine remaining ingredients. Pour over vegetables. Marinate 1 hour. Drain to serve.

recipes.title: Hot Cranberry-Apple Casserole
ingredients: 3 c. Rome apples, sliced and unpeeled
directions: Put apples in casserole.
Add cranberries; sprinkle white sugar over cranberries.
Mix flour, brown sugar, oatmeal and then add melted butter.
Mix with nuts.
Spread over top of casserole. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
(If Jonathan apples are used add 2 to 3 tablespoons of water to apples.)
If canned whole cranberries are used, cook apples before adding rest of ingredients.
recipes.text: Hot Cranberry-Apple Casserole. Put apples in casserole. Add cranberries; sprinkle white sugar over cranberries. Mix flour, brown sugar, oatmeal and then add melted butter. Mix with nuts. Spread over top of casserole. Bake at 350° for 1 hour. (If Jonathan apples are used add 2 to 3 tablespoons of water to apples.) If canned whole cranberries are used, cook apples before adding rest of ingredients.

recipes.title: Vegetable Vinaigrette Salad
directions: Drain all vegetables and place in large bowl with cover. Combine sugar, vinegar, oil, salt and pepper.
Pour over vegetables.
Toss and marinate overnight or several days.
recipes.text: Vegetable Vinaigrette Salad. Drain all vegetables and place in large bowl with cover. Combine sugar, vinegar, oil, salt and pepper. Pour over vegetables. Toss and marinate overnight or several days.

recipes.title: Golden Rum Cake
directions: Beat the eggs about 2 minutes.
Mix eggs with rest of ingredients.
Beat until smooth.
Crumble chopped nuts into greased Bundt type pan.
Pour mixture over nuts.
Bake 1 hour at 325°.
Let set 15 to 20 minutes before taking out of pan.
recipes.text: Golden Rum Cake. Beat the eggs about 2 minutes. Mix eggs with rest of ingredients. Beat until smooth. Crumble chopped nuts into greased Bundt type pan. Pour mixture over nuts. Bake 1 hour at 325°. Let set 15 to 20 minutes before taking out of pan.

recipes.title: Sweet Potato Pie
directions: Combine all ingredients well.
Pour into shells.
Bake at 325° until filling is firm in middle.
recipes.text: Sweet Potato Pie. Combine all ingredients well. Pour into shells. Bake at 325° until filling is firm in middle.

recipes.title: No Cook Fudge Balls
directions: Mix all dry ingredients together with peanut butter.
Mix real good.
Add vanilla and melted butter; mix well.
Shape into approximately 1-inch balls and roll in crushed nuts.
Place on large, foil-lined cookie sheet and freeze 20 minutes.
Remove from freezer and store in refrigerator.
recipes.text: No Cook Fudge Balls. Mix all dry ingredients together with peanut butter. Mix real good. Add vanilla and melted butter; mix well. Shape into approximately 1-inch balls and roll in crushed nuts. Place on large, foil-lined cookie sheet and freeze 20 minutes. Remove from freezer and store in refrigerator.

recipes.title: Cracker Pizza
directions: Put crackers on cookie sheet.
Sprinkle cheese on crackers and place pepperoni on top.
Cook just long enough for the cheese to begin to melt.
recipes.text: Cracker Pizza. Put crackers on cookie sheet. Sprinkle cheese on crackers and place pepperoni on top. Cook just long enough for the cheese to begin to melt.

recipes.title: Easy Peach Cobbler
ingredients: 3/4 c. milk (or if you prefer, 1/2 c. milk and 1/4 c. peach juice)
directions: Mix flour, sugar, baking powder, apple pie spice and salt together in bowl.
Add milk.
Batter will be like thin pancake batter.
Melt butter in loaf pan.
Pour 3/4 batter into pan, then peaches (undrained) on top of batter.
Pour rest of batter on top of peaches.
Bake at 325° until done.
Serve warm.
recipes.text: Easy Peach Cobbler. Mix flour, sugar, baking powder, apple pie spice and salt together in bowl. Add milk. Batter will be like thin pancake batter. Melt butter in loaf pan. Pour 3/4 batter into pan, then peaches (undrained) on top of batter. Pour rest of batter on top of peaches. Bake at 325° until done. Serve warm.

recipes.title: Corn Pudding(Serves 8)
directions: Mix ingredients well; put in 9 x 13-inch greased dish.
Bake in moderate oven until firm.
recipes.text: Corn Pudding(Serves 8). Mix ingredients well; put in 9 x 13-inch greased dish. Bake in moderate oven until firm.

recipes.title: Strawberry Trifle
ingredients: 2 pt. fresh strawberries, hulled and cut in half
3 to 4 Tbsp. sugar (depending on sweetness of berries)
1 1/2 Tbsp. orange liqueur or orange juice
1 small (about 6 oz.) cholesterol-free angel food cake
directions: In medium bowl, toss strawberries with sugar and liqueur or juice.
Let stand at room temperature, tossing occasionally, about 30 minutes.
With long serrated knife cut cake horizontally into 3 equal layers.
Spread half of jam over cut side of bottom layer. Replace middle layer and cover with remaining jam.
Add top layer. Cut reassembled cake into 3/4-inch slices.
To assemble trifle, line bottom and sides of 1 1/2-quart glass serving bowl with about 2/3 of jam-filled cake slices.
Drizzle about 1/4 cup of juice from berries over cake.
Spoon half of vanilla custard over cake and spread half of strawberries over custard.
Cover with remaining cake slices; drizzle with remaining berry juice and top with remaining custard and berries.
Cover trifle and refrigerate up to 6 hours before serving.
recipes.text: Strawberry Trifle. In medium bowl, toss strawberries with sugar and liqueur or juice. Let stand at room temperature, tossing occasionally, about 30 minutes. With long serrated knife cut cake horizontally into 3 equal layers. Spread half of jam over cut side of bottom layer. Replace middle layer and cover with remaining jam. Add top layer. Cut reassembled cake into 3/4-inch slices. To assemble trifle, line bottom and sides of 1 1/2-quart glass serving bowl with about 2/3 of jam-filled cake slices. Drizzle about 1/4 cup of juice from berries over cake. Spoon half of vanilla custard over cake and spread half of strawberries over custard. Cover with remaining cake slices; drizzle with remaining berry juice and top with remaining custard and berries. Cover trifle and refrigerate up to 6 hours before serving.

recipes.title: Chicken And Rice Casserole
directions: Put rice in bottom of 2 1/2-quart casserole.
Pour boiling water and salt over rice.
Layer cut-up chicken pieces on top. Spread mushroom soup over chicken.
Bake 1 hour at 350°.
Test for doneness.
Serves 4.
recipes.text: Chicken And Rice Casserole. Put rice in bottom of 2 1/2-quart casserole. Pour boiling water and salt over rice. Layer cut-up chicken pieces on top. Spread mushroom soup over chicken. Bake 1 hour at 350°. Test for doneness. Serves 4.

recipes.title: No-Flour Peanut Butter Cookies
directions: Preheat oven to 325°.
Mix all ingredients together.
Drop on cookie sheet.
Press with fork to crisscross.
Bake 8 to 10 minutes.
Also you can use any kind of chips (chocolate, vanilla, etc.), mix in chips at beginning or add them fresh out of oven.
recipes.text: No-Flour Peanut Butter Cookies. Preheat oven to 325°. Mix all ingredients together. Drop on cookie sheet. Press with fork to crisscross. Bake 8 to 10 minutes. Also you can use any kind of chips (chocolate, vanilla, etc.), mix in chips at beginning or add them fresh out of oven.

recipes.title: Creamy Italian Dip
directions: Blend all ingredients together in blender on high speed until smooth and creamy.
Chill before serving.
Yields 2 1/2 cups. Contains 8 1/2 calories per serving.
recipes.text: Creamy Italian Dip. Blend all ingredients together in blender on high speed until smooth and creamy. Chill before serving. Yields 2 1/2 cups. Contains 8 1/2 calories per serving.

recipes.title: Corn Bread Muffins
directions: Mix dry ingredients (corn meal, flour and sugar).
Add oil, egg substitute and milk.
Stir together by hand until moistened. Bake in muffin pan sprayed with cooking oil.
Bake in 450° oven for 15 minutes.
recipes.text: Corn Bread Muffins. Mix dry ingredients (corn meal, flour and sugar). Add oil, egg substitute and milk. Stir together by hand until moistened. Bake in muffin pan sprayed with cooking oil. Bake in 450° oven for 15 minutes.

recipes.title: No Bake Pumpkin Pie
directions: In small bowl blend milk, eggs, spices and salt.
Set aside. In medium saucepan, sprinkle gelatin over water, let stand 1 minute.
Stir over low heat until gelatin completely dissolved, about 2 minutes.
Blend in milk mixture.
Continue stirring over low heat until mixture is slightly thickened, about 5 minutes. Blend in pumpkin.
Turn into pie crust.
Chill until firm.
Garnish as desired.
Suggest making the day before serving for best results.
recipes.text: No Bake Pumpkin Pie. In small bowl blend milk, eggs, spices and salt. Set aside. In medium saucepan, sprinkle gelatin over water, let stand 1 minute. Stir over low heat until gelatin completely dissolved, about 2 minutes. Blend in milk mixture. Continue stirring over low heat until mixture is slightly thickened, about 5 minutes. Blend in pumpkin. Turn into pie crust. Chill until firm. Garnish as desired. Suggest making the day before serving for best results.

recipes.title: Green Tomato And Pepper Relish
directions: Wash, chop and mix together.
Add salt.
Let stand several hours or overnight; drain liquid and discard.
Tie spices in bag. Combine all ingredients and simmer 30 minutes.
Ladle hot mixture into hot jars and seal at once.
Process in boiling water bath 10 minutes.
recipes.text: Green Tomato And Pepper Relish. Wash, chop and mix together. Add salt. Let stand several hours or overnight; drain liquid and discard. Tie spices in bag. Combine all ingredients and simmer 30 minutes. Ladle hot mixture into hot jars and seal at once. Process in boiling water bath 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Sausage Bread
directions: Brown sausage and set aside.
Thaw bread dough.
Roll each loaf out in rectangular form and coat with melted butter.
Cover dough with a layer of sausage, olives and cheese.
Sprinkle with peppers and Parmesan cheese.
Fold sides up and ends over (jelly roll style) and seal bread.
Bake on greased pan at 300° for 45 minutes to one hour or until brown.
Makes three large loaves. They can be refrigerated or frozen until needed.
recipes.text: Sausage Bread. Brown sausage and set aside. Thaw bread dough. Roll each loaf out in rectangular form and coat with melted butter. Cover dough with a layer of sausage, olives and cheese. Sprinkle with peppers and Parmesan cheese. Fold sides up and ends over (jelly roll style) and seal bread. Bake on greased pan at 300° for 45 minutes to one hour or until brown. Makes three large loaves. They can be refrigerated or frozen until needed.

recipes.title: Pickles
directions: Select a bowl or jar large enough to hold all of the above ingredients.
This will be your "pickle barrel."
recipes.text: Pickles. Select a bowl or jar large enough to hold all of the above ingredients. This will be your "pickle barrel."

recipes.title: Creme De Menthe Bars
directions: Combine all ingredients.
Bake in a 9 x 13-inch baking pan for 30 minutes at 350°.
Beat together 2 cups 10x sugar, 1/2 cup margarine and 2 tablespoons creme de menthe liquor.
Spread on cool cake.
Melt 1 cup sweet morsels and 6 tablespoons margarine. Allow to cool.
Spread on top of creme de menthe mixture.
recipes.text: Creme De Menthe Bars. Combine all ingredients. Bake in a 9 x 13-inch baking pan for 30 minutes at 350°. Beat together 2 cups 10x sugar, 1/2 cup margarine and 2 tablespoons creme de menthe liquor. Spread on cool cake. Melt 1 cup sweet morsels and 6 tablespoons margarine. Allow to cool. Spread on top of creme de menthe mixture.

recipes.title: Peach Cobbler
directions: Pour peaches into pan.
Mix margarine, sugar, flour and milk together.
Add vanilla.
Pour all ingredients into pan.
Bake until golden brown.
recipes.text: Peach Cobbler. Pour peaches into pan. Mix margarine, sugar, flour and milk together. Add vanilla. Pour all ingredients into pan. Bake until golden brown.

recipes.title: Banana Bread Mix
directions: Mix nuts and bananas.
Add sugar, egg, milk and biscuit mix to nuts and bananas.
Beat hard for 1 to 2 minutes.
It is very important that you beat this batter well.
recipes.text: Banana Bread Mix. Mix nuts and bananas. Add sugar, egg, milk and biscuit mix to nuts and bananas. Beat hard for 1 to 2 minutes. It is very important that you beat this batter well.

recipes.title: Crunchy Chicken
directions: Recipe makes enough batter for 6 pieces boned chicken or 8 chicken cutlets (cutlets preferred).
recipes.text: Crunchy Chicken. Recipe makes enough batter for 6 pieces boned chicken or 8 chicken cutlets (cutlets preferred).

recipes.title: Potato Soup
directions: Melt oleo butter.
Add flour and stir until smooth.
Cook 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add onions and cook until tender. Add broth and stir.
Add potatoes, salt and pepper to taste. Bring to boil and cook 15 minutes (until potatoes are done).
Stir in milk and heat thoroughly.
recipes.text: Potato Soup. Melt oleo butter. Add flour and stir until smooth. Cook 1 minute, stirring constantly. Add onions and cook until tender. Add broth and stir. Add potatoes, salt and pepper to taste. Bring to boil and cook 15 minutes (until potatoes are done). Stir in milk and heat thoroughly.

recipes.title: Pecan Pie
ingredients: 1 c. King syrup or light molasses
directions: Combine eggs, sugar and syrup.
Mix well.
Add butter, salt, vanilla and nut meats.
Pour into unbaked pie shells.
Bake at 350° to 375° for 30 minutes, or until set.
Makes 1 large pie.
(One and one-half recipes make 2 small pies.)
recipes.text: Pecan Pie. Combine eggs, sugar and syrup. Mix well. Add butter, salt, vanilla and nut meats. Pour into unbaked pie shells. Bake at 350° to 375° for 30 minutes, or until set. Makes 1 large pie. (One and one-half recipes make 2 small pies.)

recipes.title: Wiener-Bean Bake
directions: Combine all ingredients in a 2-quart casserole dish.
Bake, uncovered, at 350° about 1 hour.
Makes 6 to 8 servings.
recipes.text: Wiener-Bean Bake. Combine all ingredients in a 2-quart casserole dish. Bake, uncovered, at 350° about 1 hour. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

recipes.title: Turkey Barbecue
directions: Cook and stir celery, onion and green pepper in oleo in medium skillet over medium heat until lightly browned. Add remaining ingredients except buns. Reduce heat to low and simmer 10 to 15 minutes. Spoon turkey barbecue on bottom halves of buns. Cover with the top halves.
recipes.text: Turkey Barbecue. Cook and stir celery, onion and green pepper in oleo in medium skillet over medium heat until lightly browned. Add remaining ingredients except buns. Reduce heat to low and simmer 10 to 15 minutes. Spoon turkey barbecue on bottom halves of buns. Cover with the top halves.

recipes.title: Green Beans And Rice
directions: If beans are fresh, snip the ends and cut in half.
Wash and drain, if frozen.
In a saucepan, brown meat in oil or butter. Add onion and saute.
Add beans and water to cover.
Cook in covered pot until beans and meat are tender, approximately 40 to 50 minutes.
Add tomato paste, salt, pepper and cinnamon.
Cook 10 to 15 minutes longer.
Serve over cooked rice.
recipes.text: Green Beans And Rice. If beans are fresh, snip the ends and cut in half. Wash and drain, if frozen. In a saucepan, brown meat in oil or butter. Add onion and saute. Add beans and water to cover. Cook in covered pot until beans and meat are tender, approximately 40 to 50 minutes. Add tomato paste, salt, pepper and cinnamon. Cook 10 to 15 minutes longer. Serve over cooked rice.

recipes.title: Golden Punch
directions: Mix all ingredients and add a large can of water.
May use a juice can.
Stir.
Add ginger ale before serving.
recipes.text: Golden Punch. Mix all ingredients and add a large can of water. May use a juice can. Stir. Add ginger ale before serving.

recipes.title: Monkey Bread
directions: Cut each biscuit into 6 pieces.
Combine sugar, cinnamon and pecans or raisins.
Shake in a bag.
Place half of biscuits in Bundt pan and cover with half of sugar mixture.
Layer again with biscuits and sugar mixture.
Boil margarine and brown sugar.
Pour over cake and bake 30 to 40 minutes at 325°.
recipes.text: Monkey Bread. Cut each biscuit into 6 pieces. Combine sugar, cinnamon and pecans or raisins. Shake in a bag. Place half of biscuits in Bundt pan and cover with half of sugar mixture. Layer again with biscuits and sugar mixture. Boil margarine and brown sugar. Pour over cake and bake 30 to 40 minutes at 325°.

recipes.title: Egg Rolls
ingredients: 3 chicken breasts, boned and cut into small pieces
directions: Cook chicken in small amount of oil until white.
Remove and drain.
Add mushrooms and onions and saute until just barely soft. Add frozen veggies and cook until soft, not mushy.
Add chicken and remove from stove.
Cool.
recipes.text: Egg Rolls. Cook chicken in small amount of oil until white. Remove and drain. Add mushrooms and onions and saute until just barely soft. Add frozen veggies and cook until soft, not mushy. Add chicken and remove from stove. Cool.

recipes.title: Roast Beef
directions: In a large skillet or pot, season your roast with pepper, salt and oregano.
Let it set overnight in your refrigerator.
Put it in a pot and cut up your onion and green pepper over it.
Bring it to a boil.
Don't forget the 2 cups of water. Simmer, covered, 1 hour. Turn roast.
Brown flour in pan drippings in skillet. When brown, add water to liquid in pot roast.
Cook slowly until thick.
recipes.text: Roast Beef. In a large skillet or pot, season your roast with pepper, salt and oregano. Let it set overnight in your refrigerator. Put it in a pot and cut up your onion and green pepper over it. Bring it to a boil. Don't forget the 2 cups of water. Simmer, covered, 1 hour. Turn roast. Brown flour in pan drippings in skillet. When brown, add water to liquid in pot roast. Cook slowly until thick.

recipes.title: Date Cookies
directions: Bring dates to boil in water, then cool.
Mix dry ingredients together.
Then put all the moist ingredients in.
Drop by a spoon on a greased sheet.
Bake in a 325° oven until done.
recipes.text: Date Cookies. Bring dates to boil in water, then cool. Mix dry ingredients together. Then put all the moist ingredients in. Drop by a spoon on a greased sheet. Bake in a 325° oven until done.

recipes.title: Strawberry Buttermilk Salad
directions: Mix jello and pineapple in large saucepan; heat on stove until jello dissolves.
Do not boil.
Let cool; mix buttermilk and cool whip until well mixed.
Add to jello mixture. Pour into 8 by 12 inch oblong dish, and sprinkle nuts on top.
Chill in refrigerator.
recipes.text: Strawberry Buttermilk Salad. Mix jello and pineapple in large saucepan; heat on stove until jello dissolves. Do not boil. Let cool; mix buttermilk and cool whip until well mixed. Add to jello mixture. Pour into 8 by 12 inch oblong dish, and sprinkle nuts on top. Chill in refrigerator.

recipes.title: Chocolate Sheet Cake
directions: Melt shortening and oleo in saucepan.
Add cocoa and water. Bring to a rapid boil.
Sift together flour and sugar in large bowl.
Add boiling mixture to flour and sugar.
Add remaining ingredients.
Mix well and pour on greased cookie sheet (one with rim on it).
Cook 20 minutes at 350°.
Ice while warm.
recipes.text: Chocolate Sheet Cake. Melt shortening and oleo in saucepan. Add cocoa and water. Bring to a rapid boil. Sift together flour and sugar in large bowl. Add boiling mixture to flour and sugar. Add remaining ingredients. Mix well and pour on greased cookie sheet (one with rim on it). Cook 20 minutes at 350°. Ice while warm.

recipes.title: Spanish Coffee Cake
directions: Mix well first 5 ingredients. Remove 1/2 cup of mixture into small bowl and add cinnamon and nuts; set aside. To rest of mixture add remaining ingredients. Mix well. Pour into greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Sprinkle nut topping on batter. Stir around on top with fork. Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Spanish Coffee Cake. Mix well first 5 ingredients. Remove 1/2 cup of mixture into small bowl and add cinnamon and nuts; set aside. To rest of mixture add remaining ingredients. Mix well. Pour into greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Sprinkle nut topping on batter. Stir around on top with fork. Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Orange Julius
directions: Put orange juice, sugar, water, milk and vanilla in blender with 4 or 5 ice cubes.
Blend 30 seconds or until smooth.
Serve immediately.
recipes.text: Orange Julius. Put orange juice, sugar, water, milk and vanilla in blender with 4 or 5 ice cubes. Blend 30 seconds or until smooth. Serve immediately.

recipes.title: Crispy Fried Chicken
directions: In a small bowl, combine 1/2 cup flour and salad dressing to make a paste. Spread mixture all over chicken pieces to coat. Cover; refrigerate overnight.
recipes.text: Crispy Fried Chicken. In a small bowl, combine 1/2 cup flour and salad dressing to make a paste. Spread mixture all over chicken pieces to coat. Cover; refrigerate overnight.

recipes.title: Light Fruit Cake
ingredients: 2 Tbsp. water with 1 Tbsp. soda dissolved in it
directions: Cream butter and sugar.
Mix 2 cups of flour with fruit, nuts and raisins.
Cream egg yolks with butter and sugar.
Add lemon extract.
Add remaining (3 cups) flour and soda water.
Mix thoroughly.
Add fruit and nuts mixture.
Don't worry if batter is dry.
Fold in beaten egg whites (last).
Batter is still quite dry.
Grease and flour tube cake pan.
Bake 3 hours at 250°.
If you make only half the recipe, bake only 1 3/4 hours.
Wrap in cloth moistened with rum or apple cider.
recipes.text: Light Fruit Cake. Cream butter and sugar. Mix 2 cups of flour with fruit, nuts and raisins. Cream egg yolks with butter and sugar. Add lemon extract. Add remaining (3 cups) flour and soda water. Mix thoroughly. Add fruit and nuts mixture. Don't worry if batter is dry. Fold in beaten egg whites (last). Batter is still quite dry. Grease and flour tube cake pan. Bake 3 hours at 250°. If you make only half the recipe, bake only 1 3/4 hours. Wrap in cloth moistened with rum or apple cider.

recipes.title: Date Cake(Christmas Cake)
ingredients: 1 lb. candied or glazed whole cherries
directions: Sprinkle some extra flour over fruit and nuts.
Cream butter, sugar and eggs together.
Add dry ingredients and liquids; blend with fruit and nuts.
Bake 2 1/4 hours at 250°.
Will make five 1-pound flat type coffee cans or your choice of containers.
recipes.text: Date Cake(Christmas Cake). Sprinkle some extra flour over fruit and nuts. Cream butter, sugar and eggs together. Add dry ingredients and liquids; blend with fruit and nuts. Bake 2 1/4 hours at 250°. Will make five 1-pound flat type coffee cans or your choice of containers.

recipes.title: Katasha'S Chicken Dressing
directions: Combine all ingredients; mix well.
Pour into baking dish, greased.
Bake at 400° for 30 to 40 minutes or until done.
recipes.text: Katasha'S Chicken Dressing. Combine all ingredients; mix well. Pour into baking dish, greased. Bake at 400° for 30 to 40 minutes or until done.

recipes.title: Mexican Wedding Cookies
directions: Combine all ingredients; shape dough into mounds.
Bake about 25 minutes at 325°.
Roll in powdered sugar while still hot.
recipes.text: Mexican Wedding Cookies. Combine all ingredients; shape dough into mounds. Bake about 25 minutes at 325°. Roll in powdered sugar while still hot.

recipes.title: Sloppy Joes
directions: Simmer for about 15 minutes and serve on buns.
recipes.text: Sloppy Joes. Simmer for about 15 minutes and serve on buns.

recipes.title: Pineapple-Cheese Dip
directions: Drain pineapple, but not dry. Mix sugar, flour and cheese. Sprinkle over pineapple. Crumble crackers and sprinkle over pineapple mixture. Melt margarine and pour over top. Bake 30 minutes at 300 degrees.
recipes.text: Pineapple-Cheese Dip. Drain pineapple, but not dry. Mix sugar, flour and cheese. Sprinkle over pineapple. Crumble crackers and sprinkle over pineapple mixture. Melt margarine and pour over top. Bake 30 minutes at 300 degrees.

recipes.title: Cole Slaw
directions: Mix cabbage and carrots with Marzetti slaw dressing until moist.
Slaw will become more moist as it cools in refrigerator.
recipes.text: Cole Slaw. Mix cabbage and carrots with Marzetti slaw dressing until moist. Slaw will become more moist as it cools in refrigerator.

recipes.title: Chocolate Syrup Cake
directions: Cream
together
the margarine and sugar. Add eggs, one at a time.
Sift together dry ingredients. Add vanilla and dry ingredients with chocolate syrup.
Mix well. Pour into greased 13 x
9-inch
pan.
Bake
at
350° for 30 minutes.
Frost with Chocolate Fudge Frosting.
recipes.text: Chocolate Syrup Cake. Cream together the margarine and sugar. Add eggs, one at a time. Sift together dry ingredients. Add vanilla and dry ingredients with chocolate syrup. Mix well. Pour into greased 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes. Frost with Chocolate Fudge Frosting.

recipes.title: Good Baked Beans
ingredients: 6 to 8 strips bacon (bacon bits can be substituted but bacon is better)
directions: Drain the tomato sauce from the 2 cans of pork and beans into a large bowl.
Add about 1 cup of brown sugar and about 1/4 cup of ketchup.
Clean and dice the green pepper and onion.
Add to sauce.
(If you don't like green peppers or hot sauce, they can be omitted.)
Add hot sauce, more ketchup and more brown sugar (to taste).
Combine this sauce with beans in a glass baking dish. Top with bacon strips or sprinkle with bacon bits.
Bake about 45 minutes at 350°.
(If you're in a hurry, you can also cook in microwave for 10 to 15 minutes or until onions, peppers and bacon is cooked.)
recipes.text: Good Baked Beans. Drain the tomato sauce from the 2 cans of pork and beans into a large bowl. Add about 1 cup of brown sugar and about 1/4 cup of ketchup. Clean and dice the green pepper and onion. Add to sauce. (If you don't like green peppers or hot sauce, they can be omitted.) Add hot sauce, more ketchup and more brown sugar (to taste). Combine this sauce with beans in a glass baking dish. Top with bacon strips or sprinkle with bacon bits. Bake about 45 minutes at 350°. (If you're in a hurry, you can also cook in microwave for 10 to 15 minutes or until onions, peppers and bacon is cooked.)

recipes.title: White Cheese Dip
ingredients: 1 can jalapeno peppers drained and juice saved
directions: Melt cheese, milk and
1/8 c. jalapeno juice or a little more. Cook until
melted stirring often. Add more milk or jalapeno juice if you want a thinner dip.
recipes.text: White Cheese Dip. Melt cheese, milk and 1/8 c. jalapeno juice or a little more. Cook until melted stirring often. Add more milk or jalapeno juice if you want a thinner dip.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Delight
directions: Combine graham cracker crumbs, crushed peanuts, sugar and margarine.
Press in pie pan.
Beat until very smooth the cream cheese, sugar, peanut butter and milk.
Fold in 8 ounces of the Cool Whip and spread on crust.
Spread the remaining Cool Whip over the peanut butter filling and garnish with chopped nuts, then drizzle hot fudge.
recipes.text: Peanut Butter Delight. Combine graham cracker crumbs, crushed peanuts, sugar and margarine. Press in pie pan. Beat until very smooth the cream cheese, sugar, peanut butter and milk. Fold in 8 ounces of the Cool Whip and spread on crust. Spread the remaining Cool Whip over the peanut butter filling and garnish with chopped nuts, then drizzle hot fudge.

recipes.title: Peach Muffins
ingredients: 1 (16 oz.) can sliced peaches, drained or 1 1/2 to 2 c. fresh peaches, sweetened
directions: Chop peaches; drain and set aside.
Combine flour, salt, soda and sugar in mixing bowl.
Make a well in the center of dry ingredients.
Add eggs and oil; stir until dry ingredients are well moistened.
Add peaches and remaining ingredients.
Stir until blended.
Spoon batter evenly into greased or paper lined muffin pans, filling 2/3 full.
Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes.
Makes one dozen.
recipes.text: Peach Muffins. Chop peaches; drain and set aside. Combine flour, salt, soda and sugar in mixing bowl. Make a well in the center of dry ingredients. Add eggs and oil; stir until dry ingredients are well moistened. Add peaches and remaining ingredients. Stir until blended. Spoon batter evenly into greased or paper lined muffin pans, filling 2/3 full. Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes. Makes one dozen.

recipes.title: Chicken & Dumplings(Heritage Recipe)
directions: Stir 1 c. broth in flour, salt, and baking powder and add egg.
Stir until thick enough to roll out.
Roll on floured surface.
Cut in 2 inch squares and drop in boiling broth and cook 10 - 15 minutes.
recipes.text: Chicken & Dumplings(Heritage Recipe). Stir 1 c. broth in flour, salt, and baking powder and add egg. Stir until thick enough to roll out. Roll on floured surface. Cut in 2 inch squares and drop in boiling broth and cook 10 - 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Cucumber Dip
directions: Have cheese at room temperature.
Use electric mixer to beat cheese and Miracle Whip together.
Add other ingredients and stir in sour cream.
One-half of this recipe is enough for a small crowd.
recipes.text: Cucumber Dip. Have cheese at room temperature. Use electric mixer to beat cheese and Miracle Whip together. Add other ingredients and stir in sour cream. One-half of this recipe is enough for a small crowd.

recipes.title: Buttermilk Pie(Rich And Delicious!)
directions: Beat eggs; combine sugar and flour.
Stir into eggs.
Add melted margarine and buttermilk.
Mix well.
Pour into unbaked pie shell and bake at 425° for 10 minutes.
Reduce heat to 300° and bake for 25 to 30 minutes longer.
After 25 to 30 minutes baking time, insert knife in center of filling.
If it comes out clean, it's done.
Makes 2 pies.
recipes.text: Buttermilk Pie(Rich And Delicious!). Beat eggs; combine sugar and flour. Stir into eggs. Add melted margarine and buttermilk. Mix well. Pour into unbaked pie shell and bake at 425° for 10 minutes. Reduce heat to 300° and bake for 25 to 30 minutes longer. After 25 to 30 minutes baking time, insert knife in center of filling. If it comes out clean, it's done. Makes 2 pies.

recipes.title: Pecan Cheese Log
directions: Mix first 6 ingredients well.
Add pecans.
Mix well.
Shape into log.
Sprinkle finely chopped pecans on top.
recipes.text: Pecan Cheese Log. Mix first 6 ingredients well. Add pecans. Mix well. Shape into log. Sprinkle finely chopped pecans on top.

recipes.title: Men'S Favorite Cole Slaw
ingredients: 1 small to medium head cabbage, shredded
directions: Put shredded cabbage in bowl; mix in onion, cottage cheese and mayonnaise.
Toss thoroughly.
Salt and pepper to taste.
recipes.text: Men'S Favorite Cole Slaw. Put shredded cabbage in bowl; mix in onion, cottage cheese and mayonnaise. Toss thoroughly. Salt and pepper to taste.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Pie
directions: Mix together.
Bake in a 325° oven for 10 minutes, then reduce to 300° for 35 minutes or until done.
Makes two 9-inch deep dish or 3 small crusts.
recipes.text: Pumpkin Pie. Mix together. Bake in a 325° oven for 10 minutes, then reduce to 300° for 35 minutes or until done. Makes two 9-inch deep dish or 3 small crusts.

recipes.title: Easy Fudge
ingredients: 1 can Eagle Brand sweetened condensed milk
directions: Melt chocolate in double boiler.
Add remaining ingredients and place in a pan.
Refrigerate.
recipes.text: Easy Fudge. Melt chocolate in double boiler. Add remaining ingredients and place in a pan. Refrigerate.

recipes.title: Margie'S Zucchini Quiche
directions: Heat oven to 400°.
Grease 9-inch pie pan.
Mix all ingredients and bake 30 to 35 minutes.
Enough for 2 pies.
recipes.text: Margie'S Zucchini Quiche. Heat oven to 400°. Grease 9-inch pie pan. Mix all ingredients and bake 30 to 35 minutes. Enough for 2 pies.

recipes.title: Spicy Potato Soup
directions: In large Dutch oven, brown ground beef.
Drain.
Add potatoes, onion and tomato sauce.
Stir in water, salt, pepper and hot pepper; bring to a boil.
Reduce heat and simmer for 1 hour or until potatoes are tender and soup has thickened.
recipes.text: Spicy Potato Soup. In large Dutch oven, brown ground beef. Drain. Add potatoes, onion and tomato sauce. Stir in water, salt, pepper and hot pepper; bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer for 1 hour or until potatoes are tender and soup has thickened.

recipes.title: Shrimp Casserole
ingredients: 1/2 lb. or 1/2 c. canned mushrooms (save water)
directions: Saute onion, green peppers and celery to remove stiffness. Add mushrooms and 2 cups raw shrimp.
Cook rice (1 cup) in saucepan using mushroom liquid for part of liquid.
Combine rice to shrimp mixture in casserole and fold in 1 cup sour cream.
Bake at 350 degrees for 35 minutes or until hot.
recipes.text: Shrimp Casserole. Saute onion, green peppers and celery to remove stiffness. Add mushrooms and 2 cups raw shrimp. Cook rice (1 cup) in saucepan using mushroom liquid for part of liquid. Combine rice to shrimp mixture in casserole and fold in 1 cup sour cream. Bake at 350 degrees for 35 minutes or until hot.

recipes.title: Brown Rice
directions: Cook onion, rice and margarine in heavy skillet until brown. Mix consomme and mushroom soup and add to the rice mixture.
Pour into greased casserole dish and bake at 350° for about 40 minutes.
recipes.text: Brown Rice. Cook onion, rice and margarine in heavy skillet until brown. Mix consomme and mushroom soup and add to the rice mixture. Pour into greased casserole dish and bake at 350° for about 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Southern Squash Casserole
directions: Layer in large casserole dish, 1/2 squash, 1/2 stuffing, 1/2 soup, 1/2 sour cream and 1/2 spices and onion; repeat.
Sprinkle with 1/4 cup bread crumbs and bake at 325° for 40 to 50 minutes. Serves 4.
recipes.text: Southern Squash Casserole. Layer in large casserole dish, 1/2 squash, 1/2 stuffing, 1/2 soup, 1/2 sour cream and 1/2 spices and onion; repeat. Sprinkle with 1/4 cup bread crumbs and bake at 325° for 40 to 50 minutes. Serves 4.

recipes.title: Baked Apples Microwave
directions: Put apples in a 1-quart Pyrex casserole dish.
Sprinkle brown sugar, butter slices and dash of cinnamon.
Cover and cook in microwave for 4 to 5 minutes (until apples are tender). Stir once during cook time.
recipes.text: Baked Apples Microwave. Put apples in a 1-quart Pyrex casserole dish. Sprinkle brown sugar, butter slices and dash of cinnamon. Cover and cook in microwave for 4 to 5 minutes (until apples are tender). Stir once during cook time.

recipes.title: Granny K'S Biscuits(Made From Mayonnaise)
directions: Preheat oven to 350°.
Mix the flour and the mayonnaise until flour is course.
Add milk slowly until the flour can be rolled into a dough.
You may not need all of the milk or you may have to add more.
Roll dough and cut out your biscuits.
Put the biscuits on a lightly greased pan and put them in the oven.
Cook until done.
recipes.text: Granny K'S Biscuits(Made From Mayonnaise). Preheat oven to 350°. Mix the flour and the mayonnaise until flour is course. Add milk slowly until the flour can be rolled into a dough. You may not need all of the milk or you may have to add more. Roll dough and cut out your biscuits. Put the biscuits on a lightly greased pan and put them in the oven. Cook until done.

recipes.title: San Antonio Chicken
ingredients: 2 1 oz. slices monterrey jack cheese, cut into 8 strips
directions: Place each chicken breast between sheets of wax paper. Flatten chicken to 1/4 inch thickness, using a meat mallet, or rolling pin.
Season to taste.
Place jalapenos in center of chicken breast and 2 strips of cheese in center.
Roll up lengthwise and tuck edges inside.
Secure with toothpicks.
Roll chicken in the flour, packing it.
Combine egg and milk; dip chicken in egg mixture, then roll in bread crumbs.
Fry chicken in DEEP hot oil, 375 degrees, for 8 minutes or until golden brown. Drain thoroughly on paper towels and serve immediately.
recipes.text: San Antonio Chicken. Place each chicken breast between sheets of wax paper. Flatten chicken to 1/4 inch thickness, using a meat mallet, or rolling pin. Season to taste. Place jalapenos in center of chicken breast and 2 strips of cheese in center. Roll up lengthwise and tuck edges inside. Secure with toothpicks. Roll chicken in the flour, packing it. Combine egg and milk; dip chicken in egg mixture, then roll in bread crumbs. Fry chicken in DEEP hot oil, 375 degrees, for 8 minutes or until golden brown. Drain thoroughly on paper towels and serve immediately.

recipes.title: Curried Tuna Casserole
directions: Heat oven to 350°.
In skillet brown butter and curry powder. Mix in remaining ingredients.
Pour into ungreased casserole dish. Bake uncovered for 30 minutes.
Serves 6.
recipes.text: Curried Tuna Casserole. Heat oven to 350°. In skillet brown butter and curry powder. Mix in remaining ingredients. Pour into ungreased casserole dish. Bake uncovered for 30 minutes. Serves 6.

recipes.title: Broccoli Casserole
directions: Steam broccoli stems for 10 minutes, then put in bottom of casserole.
Fry sausage very little and pour off grease. Alternate broccoli tops, sausage, onion and cheese in casserole with soup.
Put croutons on top and pour on butter.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Broccoli Casserole. Steam broccoli stems for 10 minutes, then put in bottom of casserole. Fry sausage very little and pour off grease. Alternate broccoli tops, sausage, onion and cheese in casserole with soup. Put croutons on top and pour on butter. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Grilled Vegetable Salad
directions: Combine first 7 ingredients, set aside.
Cut carrots and remaining vegetables into large pieces.
Add to vinegar mixture, toss to coat.
Let stand 30 minutes, stirring occasionally. Drain, reserving vinegar mixture.
Cook, covered with grill lid, over medium hot coals, turning occasionally.
Return vegetables to vinegar mixture, tossing gently.
Cover and refrigerator overnight.
Serves 6.
