recipes.text: Grilled Vegetable Salad. Combine first 7 ingredients, set aside. Cut carrots and remaining vegetables into large pieces. Add to vinegar mixture, toss to coat. Let stand 30 minutes, stirring occasionally. Drain, reserving vinegar mixture. Cook, covered with grill lid, over medium hot coals, turning occasionally. Return vegetables to vinegar mixture, tossing gently. Cover and refrigerator overnight. Serves 6.

recipes.title: Vegetable Enchiladas
ingredients: 2 c. zucchini, scrubbed and grated with skin on
1 (15 oz.) can kidney beans with liquid
directions: Baking Temperature: 350°.
Baking Time: 20 minutes.
recipes.text: Vegetable Enchiladas. Baking Temperature: 350°. Baking Time: 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Dreamsicle Cake
ingredients: 1/2 c. undiluted frozen orange juice concentrate
directions: Mix orange Jell-O, water, 3 eggs, oil and orange flavoring. Beat 3 minutes with spoon or wire whip (no electric mixer) until batter is mixed well.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until cake is done.
recipes.text: Dreamsicle Cake. Mix orange Jell-O, water, 3 eggs, oil and orange flavoring. Beat 3 minutes with spoon or wire whip (no electric mixer) until batter is mixed well. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until cake is done.

recipes.title: Fiesta Dip
ingredients: 1 (8 oz.) pkg. low-fat cream cheese, softened
directions: In mixing bowl, combine softened cream cheese and picante sauce. Beat with electric mixer at low speed until smooth. Serve with corn chips, tortilla chips or vegetables, etc. Yield: 2 cups.
recipes.text: Fiesta Dip. In mixing bowl, combine softened cream cheese and picante sauce. Beat with electric mixer at low speed until smooth. Serve with corn chips, tortilla chips or vegetables, etc. Yield: 2 cups.

recipes.title: Meat Balls
directions: Combine first 5 ingredients into 16 meat balls. Brown in shortening.
Combine rest of ingredients and add meatballs. Cook for 20 minutes.
recipes.text: Meat Balls. Combine first 5 ingredients into 16 meat balls. Brown in shortening. Combine rest of ingredients and add meatballs. Cook for 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Broccoli And Cheese Soup
directions: Cook broccoli, chopped onions and chicken broth in medium/large kettle on stove top until broccoli is tender.
Reduce heat and add melted butter, flour, milk, salt, pepper and grated cheese gradually until all cheese is melted and stir the whole time to keep from sticking to pan.
Makes 4 to 6 servings.
Great with cornbread.
recipes.text: Broccoli And Cheese Soup. Cook broccoli, chopped onions and chicken broth in medium/large kettle on stove top until broccoli is tender. Reduce heat and add melted butter, flour, milk, salt, pepper and grated cheese gradually until all cheese is melted and stir the whole time to keep from sticking to pan. Makes 4 to 6 servings. Great with cornbread.

recipes.title: Blt Dip
directions: Let chill about 1 hour.
Serve on crackers or cocktail rye.
recipes.text: Blt Dip. Let chill about 1 hour. Serve on crackers or cocktail rye.

recipes.title: Cucumber Potato Salad
ingredients: 2 1/2 to 3 lb. cooked, cooled and peeled, sliced potatoes
1 1/2 large peeled, sliced cucumbers (after slicing, pat slices dry a little)
directions: In large bowl, place sliced potatoes and cucumber slices; stir together.
In smaller bowl, mix sour cream and sugar, then stir into potato-cucumber mixture.
Stir and dissolve 1/2 teaspoon sugar into vinegar; pour into and mix through the potatoes/cucumbers.
recipes.text: Cucumber Potato Salad. In large bowl, place sliced potatoes and cucumber slices; stir together. In smaller bowl, mix sour cream and sugar, then stir into potato-cucumber mixture. Stir and dissolve 1/2 teaspoon sugar into vinegar; pour into and mix through the potatoes/cucumbers.

recipes.title: Sesame Chicken Kabob
ingredients: 4 medium boneless, skinless chicken breast halves
1 Tbsp. plum sauce or chili sauce
directions: Note:
You will need 8 (6-inch) skewers, soaked in water.
recipes.text: Sesame Chicken Kabob. Note: You will need 8 (6-inch) skewers, soaked in water.

recipes.title: Hershey Fudge
directions: Combine cocoa with sugar and salt. Add milk; bring to boil, stirring frequently. Cook to 232° or until a small amount of mixture forms a soft ball when dropped in cold water. Remove from heat. Drop in butter. Cool to lukewarm (110°). Add vanilla and beat until mixture thickens. Pour into buttered pan and cut in squares.
recipes.text: Hershey Fudge. Combine cocoa with sugar and salt. Add milk; bring to boil, stirring frequently. Cook to 232° or until a small amount of mixture forms a soft ball when dropped in cold water. Remove from heat. Drop in butter. Cool to lukewarm (110°). Add vanilla and beat until mixture thickens. Pour into buttered pan and cut in squares.

recipes.title: Sandwich Filling
directions: Mix ingredients. Add 2 tablespoons Hellmann's mayonnaise to make mixture spreadable.
recipes.text: Sandwich Filling. Mix ingredients. Add 2 tablespoons Hellmann's mayonnaise to make mixture spreadable.

recipes.title: Ranch Muffins
ingredients: 1 (.4 oz.) pkg. Hidden Valley Ranch buttermilk recipe original Ranch salad dressing mix
directions: Preheat oven to 350°.
In large bowl, combine shortening and sugar.
Add eggs; mix well and set aside.
In medium bowl, stir together flour, oats, baking powder, baking soda, salad dressing mix and nuts.
Add dry ingredients alternately with buttermilk to egg mixture.
Stir until just combined.
Spoon batter into greased or paper-lined muffin pans, filling each cup two-thirds full. Bake until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean, 15 to 20 minutes.
Makes 12 muffins.
recipes.text: Ranch Muffins. Preheat oven to 350°. In large bowl, combine shortening and sugar. Add eggs; mix well and set aside. In medium bowl, stir together flour, oats, baking powder, baking soda, salad dressing mix and nuts. Add dry ingredients alternately with buttermilk to egg mixture. Stir until just combined. Spoon batter into greased or paper-lined muffin pans, filling each cup two-thirds full. Bake until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean, 15 to 20 minutes. Makes 12 muffins.

recipes.title: Microwave Cranberry Relish
ingredients: grated peel of 1 orange (1 to 2 Tbsp.)
directions: Mix all ingredients in 3-quart microwave casserole.
Cover tightly and microwave on High for 10 to 12 minutes, stirring after 5 minutes, until boiling.
Cover and refrigerate at least 3 hours.
recipes.text: Microwave Cranberry Relish. Mix all ingredients in 3-quart microwave casserole. Cover tightly and microwave on High for 10 to 12 minutes, stirring after 5 minutes, until boiling. Cover and refrigerate at least 3 hours.

recipes.title: Picadillio (Mexican Meat Course)
ingredients: 1 lb. tomatoes, peeled, seeded and chopped
1 oz. pimento-stuffed green olives, cut up
1/2 pinch each: ground cinnamon, cloves or thyme and oregano
directions: Heat olive oil in a large, heavy skillet and brown meat.
Add onions and garlic and brown.
Add apples, tomatoes, chiles, raisins, olives, cloves, cinnamon, salt and pepper.
Simmer gently, uncovered, until cooked, about 20 minutes.
Add pineapple. Fry almonds until golden and add.
Cook a few minutes longer. Serves 6.
recipes.text: Picadillio (Mexican Meat Course). Heat olive oil in a large, heavy skillet and brown meat. Add onions and garlic and brown. Add apples, tomatoes, chiles, raisins, olives, cloves, cinnamon, salt and pepper. Simmer gently, uncovered, until cooked, about 20 minutes. Add pineapple. Fry almonds until golden and add. Cook a few minutes longer. Serves 6.

recipes.title: Nuggets
directions: Cream peanut butter and shortening.
Add sugar, a little at a time.
Sift flour, salt and soda.
Add eggs to milk.
Add sifted dry ingredients alternately with milk to the creamed mixture.
Add rolled oats, raisins, dates and nuts.
Stir well.
Drop by teaspoon onto a greased cookie sheet.
Bake at 375° for 15 minutes.
Makes 4 dozen.
recipes.text: Nuggets. Cream peanut butter and shortening. Add sugar, a little at a time. Sift flour, salt and soda. Add eggs to milk. Add sifted dry ingredients alternately with milk to the creamed mixture. Add rolled oats, raisins, dates and nuts. Stir well. Drop by teaspoon onto a greased cookie sheet. Bake at 375° for 15 minutes. Makes 4 dozen.

recipes.title: Ham And Pasta Bake
ingredients: 10 oz. frozen, chopped broccoli, cooked and drained
2 c. elbow macaroni, cooked and drained
directions: Combine flour, onions, salt, mustard and pepper in saucepan and add milk.
Stir until blended.
Bring to a boil and cook 2 minutes or until thickened and bubbly.
Stir in broccoli.
Add macaroni, ham and cheese.
Place in 2 quart casserole.
recipes.text: Ham And Pasta Bake. Combine flour, onions, salt, mustard and pepper in saucepan and add milk. Stir until blended. Bring to a boil and cook 2 minutes or until thickened and bubbly. Stir in broccoli. Add macaroni, ham and cheese. Place in 2 quart casserole.

recipes.title: Cuban Chicken Fricassee
directions: Heat olive oil in medium heat in a large saucepan.
Add chicken breast, salt, cumin, garlic powder, potatoes, bell pepper and onion.
Stir until chicken turns white.
Add cooking wine, tomato sauce, water, bouillon cube and cilantro.
Cook until potatoes become soft, about 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Cuban Chicken Fricassee. Heat olive oil in medium heat in a large saucepan. Add chicken breast, salt, cumin, garlic powder, potatoes, bell pepper and onion. Stir until chicken turns white. Add cooking wine, tomato sauce, water, bouillon cube and cilantro. Cook until potatoes become soft, about 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Barbecued Meat Balls
directions: Form into balls; brown.
recipes.text: Barbecued Meat Balls. Form into balls; brown.

recipes.title: Chicken Casserole
directions: Cook chicken; take out bones and skin.
Cut up and place in 9 x 13-inch casserole.
Combine 1 can cream of chicken soup and condensed milk.
Pour over chicken.
Mix stuffing mix, water and margarine.
Pour on top of chicken and bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Chicken Casserole. Cook chicken; take out bones and skin. Cut up and place in 9 x 13-inch casserole. Combine 1 can cream of chicken soup and condensed milk. Pour over chicken. Mix stuffing mix, water and margarine. Pour on top of chicken and bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Grannie Thurston'S Gingersnaps
directions: Shape dough into 1-inch balls and roll them in sugar.
Place on ungreased baking sheets.
Bake at 350° for 10 minutes.
Remove from baking sheet immediately.
(Cookies will firm quickly as they cool.)
recipes.text: Grannie Thurston'S Gingersnaps. Shape dough into 1-inch balls and roll them in sugar. Place on ungreased baking sheets. Bake at 350° for 10 minutes. Remove from baking sheet immediately. (Cookies will firm quickly as they cool.)

recipes.title: Chicken Squares
directions: Combine all ingredients, except rolls. Place in microwave bowl and heat until cheese is softened and mixture can be blended smoothly; set aside. Each package of dinner rolls will make 2 large squares. Press seams of dough flat; separate into squares. On cookie sheet, place 4 squares; top with chicken mixture. Place 4 more squares on top of chicken mixture. Press around edges to seal 4 squares. Bake at 350° until lightly browned.
recipes.text: Chicken Squares. Combine all ingredients, except rolls. Place in microwave bowl and heat until cheese is softened and mixture can be blended smoothly; set aside. Each package of dinner rolls will make 2 large squares. Press seams of dough flat; separate into squares. On cookie sheet, place 4 squares; top with chicken mixture. Place 4 more squares on top of chicken mixture. Press around edges to seal 4 squares. Bake at 350° until lightly browned.

recipes.title: English Pea Dish
directions: Grease casserole dish.
Pour all ingredients in and top with 2 tablespoons of butter.
Bake 30 minutes at 350°.
recipes.text: English Pea Dish. Grease casserole dish. Pour all ingredients in and top with 2 tablespoons of butter. Bake 30 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Lasagne
ingredients: 1 lb. ground meat (beef or turkey), browned
1 large jar thick and chunky spaghetti sauce
directions: Combine meat and spaghetti sauce.
Combine cheeses and eggs. Place small amount of meat sauce mixture in ovenware bowl.
Place a layer of egg-cheese mixture over meat sauce.
Add a layer of noodles.
Continue alternating layers of meat sauce, cheese mixture and noodles, ending with meat sauce.
Bake at 350° for 30 to 45 minutes.
Let set 10 to 15 minutes before serving.
recipes.text: Lasagne. Combine meat and spaghetti sauce. Combine cheeses and eggs. Place small amount of meat sauce mixture in ovenware bowl. Place a layer of egg-cheese mixture over meat sauce. Add a layer of noodles. Continue alternating layers of meat sauce, cheese mixture and noodles, ending with meat sauce. Bake at 350° for 30 to 45 minutes. Let set 10 to 15 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Toasted Pumpkin Seeds
ingredients: vegetable oil, olive oil or butter
directions: Preheat oven to 250°.
Clean seeds by rubbing off any fibers. Do not wash.
Measure seeds.
Combine every cup of seeds with one tablespoon of vegetable oil, olive oil or melted butter.
Spread seeds on baking sheet, or on bottom of a baking dish.
Sprinkle with one teaspoon salt or 1 teaspoon each of salt and curry powder.
Roast 30 to 40 minutes (stir frequently), until seeds are crisp and browned.
Cool and eat.
Store seeds in airtight container.
recipes.text: Toasted Pumpkin Seeds. Preheat oven to 250°. Clean seeds by rubbing off any fibers. Do not wash. Measure seeds. Combine every cup of seeds with one tablespoon of vegetable oil, olive oil or melted butter. Spread seeds on baking sheet, or on bottom of a baking dish. Sprinkle with one teaspoon salt or 1 teaspoon each of salt and curry powder. Roast 30 to 40 minutes (stir frequently), until seeds are crisp and browned. Cool and eat. Store seeds in airtight container.

recipes.title: Pineapple Slices
ingredients: 1 can crushed pineapple and 1 c. sugar (boiled together until it jells; cool)
directions: Sift dry ingredients. Cut in butter as for pie dough. Beat egg yolks. Add sour cream and beat together.
Gradually add to the flour. Work the dough and then roll about 1-inch thick. Divide the dough into 2 parts.

Line pan. Spread cooled pineapple mixture. Cut remaining dough in strips and crisscross over pineapple. Sprinkle chopped nuts and slightly beaten whites of 2 eggs over entire top. Bake in a 350° oven for 45 minutes. Sprinkle with powdered sugar when ready to serve.
recipes.text: Pineapple Slices. Sift dry ingredients. Cut in butter as for pie dough. Beat egg yolks. Add sour cream and beat together. Gradually add to the flour. Work the dough and then roll about 1-inch thick. Divide the dough into 2 parts. Line pan. Spread cooled pineapple mixture. Cut remaining dough in strips and crisscross over pineapple. Sprinkle chopped nuts and slightly beaten whites of 2 eggs over entire top. Bake in a 350° oven for 45 minutes. Sprinkle with powdered sugar when ready to serve.

recipes.title: Apricot Crunch
directions: Layer apricots, crackers, brown sugar and nutmeg.
Dot with butter.
Repeat with several layers.
Pour juice from apricots over top and bake at 350° for 1 hour.
This is very good with pork or can be used as dessert.
recipes.text: Apricot Crunch. Layer apricots, crackers, brown sugar and nutmeg. Dot with butter. Repeat with several layers. Pour juice from apricots over top and bake at 350° for 1 hour. This is very good with pork or can be used as dessert.

recipes.title: Sweet Potato Pudding
ingredients: 2 c. cooked sweet potatoes, drained and mashed
directions: Beat eggs. Add spices, sugar, milk and butter.
Add potatoes to mixture and pour into baking dish. Bake until firm.
recipes.text: Sweet Potato Pudding. Beat eggs. Add spices, sugar, milk and butter. Add potatoes to mixture and pour into baking dish. Bake until firm.

recipes.title: Manicotti
directions: Stuff shells with mixture of 3 cups shredded Mozzarella cheese, 2 cups Ricotta or cottage cheese, 1 tablespoon parsley flakes, 2 eggs and 1/2 teaspoon garlic salt.
Cover bottom of baking dish with thin layer of spaghetti sauce (2 1/2 pounds ground beef and 2 jars Prego sauce).
Place stuffed shells in the dish and cover with remaining sauce.
Bake, covered, at 375° for 40 minutes.
Uncover and sprinkle with Parmesan cheese; bake 10 minutes longer.
recipes.text: Manicotti. Stuff shells with mixture of 3 cups shredded Mozzarella cheese, 2 cups Ricotta or cottage cheese, 1 tablespoon parsley flakes, 2 eggs and 1/2 teaspoon garlic salt. Cover bottom of baking dish with thin layer of spaghetti sauce (2 1/2 pounds ground beef and 2 jars Prego sauce). Place stuffed shells in the dish and cover with remaining sauce. Bake, covered, at 375° for 40 minutes. Uncover and sprinkle with Parmesan cheese; bake 10 minutes longer.

recipes.title: Blueberry Ice Cream
directions: Mix all ingredients except blueberries and refrigerate for a few hours or overnight.
When ready to make ice cream, put blueberries in blender or food processor and puree.
Should be about 4 cups.
Pour cream mixture into ice cream freezer container and process according to freezer instructions.
Ice cream will be a deep blue.
recipes.text: Blueberry Ice Cream. Mix all ingredients except blueberries and refrigerate for a few hours or overnight. When ready to make ice cream, put blueberries in blender or food processor and puree. Should be about 4 cups. Pour cream mixture into ice cream freezer container and process according to freezer instructions. Ice cream will be a deep blue.

recipes.title: South Hills' Lynchburg Lemonade
ingredients: 1 part Daily's sweet and sour mix
directions: Mix single shots in a glass and garnish with lemon slices and cherry or mix multiple shots in a punch bowl to serve many. Garnish with lemon slices
and cherry.
Serves single or many.
recipes.text: South Hills' Lynchburg Lemonade. Mix single shots in a glass and garnish with lemon slices and cherry or mix multiple shots in a punch bowl to serve many. Garnish with lemon slices and cherry. Serves single or many.

recipes.title: Bailey'S Chocolate Chip Cheesecake
directions: Preheat oven to 325°.
In 10-inch spring-form pan, mix graham cracker crumbs, brown sugar and butter.
Pat mixture into bottom of pan.
Bake 5 to 8 minutes or until puffy.
Set aside.
recipes.text: Bailey'S Chocolate Chip Cheesecake. Preheat oven to 325°. In 10-inch spring-form pan, mix graham cracker crumbs, brown sugar and butter. Pat mixture into bottom of pan. Bake 5 to 8 minutes or until puffy. Set aside.

recipes.title: Tomato-Mushroom Bow Tie Pasta
ingredients: 2 lb. plum tomatoes, peeled, seeded and chopped
1/4 c. minced fresh basil or 4 tsp. dried basil
directions: Cook pasta according to package directions.
recipes.text: Tomato-Mushroom Bow Tie Pasta. Cook pasta according to package directions.

recipes.title: Country Style Pork Chops And Carrots
directions: Cut carrots in half lengthwise.
Arrange in bottom of baking pan.
Cut onion crosswise into 8 slices.
Combine flour, salt, thyme and pepper.
Dredge chops in this.
Brown in shortening and arrange in pan over carrots.
Place onion slice on each.
Pour water over chops.
Cover pan tightly with foil.
Bake in 350° oven until meat and carrots are done, about 1 hour.
recipes.text: Country Style Pork Chops And Carrots. Cut carrots in half lengthwise. Arrange in bottom of baking pan. Cut onion crosswise into 8 slices. Combine flour, salt, thyme and pepper. Dredge chops in this. Brown in shortening and arrange in pan over carrots. Place onion slice on each. Pour water over chops. Cover pan tightly with foil. Bake in 350° oven until meat and carrots are done, about 1 hour.

recipes.title: Spareribs And Sauerkraut
directions: Brown pork ribs in pressure cooker. Add rest of ingredients. Pressure cook for 25 minutes.
recipes.text: Spareribs And Sauerkraut. Brown pork ribs in pressure cooker. Add rest of ingredients. Pressure cook for 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Sausage Cheese Balls Or 1, 2, 3 Hors D'Oeuvres
ingredients: 1 lb. hot bulk sausage or mix hot and mild
2 c. finely grated sharp Cheddar cheese
directions: Combine the ingredients and shape in balls the size of walnut (use hands).
Bake on cookie sheets at 350° for 15 minutes.
Makes about 5 dozen.
recipes.text: Sausage Cheese Balls Or 1, 2, 3 Hors D'Oeuvres. Combine the ingredients and shape in balls the size of walnut (use hands). Bake on cookie sheets at 350° for 15 minutes. Makes about 5 dozen.

recipes.title: Russian Tea
directions: Combine fruit slices, cinnamon, cloves and water in large non-aluminum saucepan. Bring to boil and boil 5 minutes. Press mixture through a strainer; discard pulp and spices. Add pineapple juice, sugar and tea to citrus mixture. Stir well; serve hot. Yield: about 2 gallons.
recipes.text: Russian Tea. Combine fruit slices, cinnamon, cloves and water in large non-aluminum saucepan. Bring to boil and boil 5 minutes. Press mixture through a strainer; discard pulp and spices. Add pineapple juice, sugar and tea to citrus mixture. Stir well; serve hot. Yield: about 2 gallons.

recipes.title: Pam'S Broccoli Corn Casserole
directions: Cook broccoli until tender; drain.
Beat egg and add cooked broccoli and corn.
Add onion, salt and pepper to taste.
Add one handful of crackers, crushed with your hand.
recipes.text: Pam'S Broccoli Corn Casserole. Cook broccoli until tender; drain. Beat egg and add cooked broccoli and corn. Add onion, salt and pepper to taste. Add one handful of crackers, crushed with your hand.

recipes.title: Hash(Two And One-Half Gallons)
directions: Boil pork and beef (save broth).
Grind up meat.
Add other ingredients.
Simmer all day adding broth as needed.
recipes.text: Hash(Two And One-Half Gallons). Boil pork and beef (save broth). Grind up meat. Add other ingredients. Simmer all day adding broth as needed.

recipes.title: Surprise Cookies
directions: Mix first 3 ingredients and roll into small balls.
Dip into confectioners sugar.
Place on cookie sheet.
Flatten.
Bake in preheated 350°
oven for 10 minutes.
recipes.text: Surprise Cookies. Mix first 3 ingredients and roll into small balls. Dip into confectioners sugar. Place on cookie sheet. Flatten. Bake in preheated 350° oven for 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Cranberry Meringue Pie
directions: In medium saucepan, cook cranberries in water, stirring until cranberries pop.
Add raisins.
Combine 1 3/4 cups sugar and cornstarch; add to cranberry mixture.
Cook and stir until mixture thickens and bubbles.
Stir in nuts and margarine until margarine melts; cool.
Beat egg whites until soft peaks form.
Gradually add 6 tablespoons sugar and continue beating until stiff peaks form.
Turn cooled filling into baked pie shell.
Spread meringue over filling, sealing to edge.
Bake in a 350° oven for 10 minutes or until golden brown.
recipes.text: Cranberry Meringue Pie. In medium saucepan, cook cranberries in water, stirring until cranberries pop. Add raisins. Combine 1 3/4 cups sugar and cornstarch; add to cranberry mixture. Cook and stir until mixture thickens and bubbles. Stir in nuts and margarine until margarine melts; cool. Beat egg whites until soft peaks form. Gradually add 6 tablespoons sugar and continue beating until stiff peaks form. Turn cooled filling into baked pie shell. Spread meringue over filling, sealing to edge. Bake in a 350° oven for 10 minutes or until golden brown.

recipes.title: Cinnamon "Glass" Candy
directions: Cook first 3 ingredients without stirring to hard crack stage (300° to 310°).
Add coloring and cinnamon oil.
Stir.
Pour into 2 oblong cake pans or cookie sheets (buttered).
Cool. Hit pan to crack in pieces.
recipes.text: Cinnamon "Glass" Candy. Cook first 3 ingredients without stirring to hard crack stage (300° to 310°). Add coloring and cinnamon oil. Stir. Pour into 2 oblong cake pans or cookie sheets (buttered). Cool. Hit pan to crack in pieces.

recipes.title: Oatmeal Cake And Topping
directions: Pour water over oats.
Let stand 20 minutes.
Cream sugars, shortening and oats.
Add eggs; beat well.
Add rest of ingredients.
Bake in greased and floured pan at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes.
recipes.text: Oatmeal Cake And Topping. Pour water over oats. Let stand 20 minutes. Cream sugars, shortening and oats. Add eggs; beat well. Add rest of ingredients. Bake in greased and floured pan at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Cream Cheese Pound Cake
directions: Mix together butter, cream cheese and sugar.
Beat until light and fluffy.
Add eggs, one at a time, beating after each addition. Add flour, salt and vanilla.
Pour into a 10-inch tube pan (greased and floured).
Put in a cold oven.
Bake from 300° to 325° for 1 1/2 hours.
Can also bake in 2 loaf pans.
recipes.text: Cream Cheese Pound Cake. Mix together butter, cream cheese and sugar. Beat until light and fluffy. Add eggs, one at a time, beating after each addition. Add flour, salt and vanilla. Pour into a 10-inch tube pan (greased and floured). Put in a cold oven. Bake from 300° to 325° for 1 1/2 hours. Can also bake in 2 loaf pans.

recipes.title: Baked Pineapple Rice
directions: Boil the rice.
Drain the crushed pineapple.
Place in a buttered baking dish 1/4 of the rice; cover with 1/2 of the pineapple.
Repeat the layer.
Place last of rice on top.
Dot each layer with butter and brown sugar.
Pour pineapple juice over top and bake covered for 1 hour, or until brown, at 350°.
recipes.text: Baked Pineapple Rice. Boil the rice. Drain the crushed pineapple. Place in a buttered baking dish 1/4 of the rice; cover with 1/2 of the pineapple. Repeat the layer. Place last of rice on top. Dot each layer with butter and brown sugar. Pour pineapple juice over top and bake covered for 1 hour, or until brown, at 350°.

recipes.title: Odell And Cindy'S Ice Cream
ingredients: 6 cans or 2 large bottles drink (carbonated colas; your choice, Nehi are the best)
directions: Combine all ingredients and fill freezer with milk if the ingredients do not come up to the line in your freezer.
Real good!
recipes.text: Odell And Cindy'S Ice Cream. Combine all ingredients and fill freezer with milk if the ingredients do not come up to the line in your freezer. Real good!

recipes.title: Squash Stuff(The Kid'S Named It)
directions: Fry bacon crisp, drain and chop.
Slice squash and chop onions.
Mix eggs and corn.
Mix all ingredients.
Place in covered dish.
Bake 30 to 40 minutes at 375°.
recipes.text: Squash Stuff(The Kid'S Named It). Fry bacon crisp, drain and chop. Slice squash and chop onions. Mix eggs and corn. Mix all ingredients. Place in covered dish. Bake 30 to 40 minutes at 375°.

recipes.title: Zucchini Bread
directions: Mix eggs, sugar, oil and vanilla together.
Then add the rest of the ingredients.
Pour into 2 greased loaf pans.
Bake at 350° for 45 to 50 minutes.
recipes.text: Zucchini Bread. Mix eggs, sugar, oil and vanilla together. Then add the rest of the ingredients. Pour into 2 greased loaf pans. Bake at 350° for 45 to 50 minutes.

recipes.title: Chocolate Cookies(Soft)
directions: Blend margarine, sugar and egg.
Add chocolate.
Add dry ingredients, which have been sifted together, alternately with milk to mixture.
Stir in nuts.
Drop from teaspoon onto cookie sheet.
Bake at 375° for 12 to 15 minutes on greased pan.
Makes 3 dozen.
recipes.text: Chocolate Cookies(Soft). Blend margarine, sugar and egg. Add chocolate. Add dry ingredients, which have been sifted together, alternately with milk to mixture. Stir in nuts. Drop from teaspoon onto cookie sheet. Bake at 375° for 12 to 15 minutes on greased pan. Makes 3 dozen.

recipes.title: Strawberry Bread
directions: Combine flour, salt, soda, sugar and cinnamon.
Make a well in center of dry ingredients.
Add eggs and oil, stirring only until dry ingredients are moistened.
Stir in strawberries and pecans. Spoon batter into 2 greased loaf pans and bake 1 hour at 350°. Let stand overnight before slicing.
recipes.text: Strawberry Bread. Combine flour, salt, soda, sugar and cinnamon. Make a well in center of dry ingredients. Add eggs and oil, stirring only until dry ingredients are moistened. Stir in strawberries and pecans. Spoon batter into 2 greased loaf pans and bake 1 hour at 350°. Let stand overnight before slicing.

recipes.title: Ono Cornbread
directions: Preheat oven to 350°.
Grease a 9 x 13-inch (deep) pan.
Melt butter in microwave in a large bowl.
Mix milk and eggs in separate bowl, then add to somewhat cooled butter (cool in freezer for a few minutes), then add dry ingredients to butter, milk and eggs.
Put in pan and bake for 40 to 50 minutes.
recipes.text: Ono Cornbread. Preheat oven to 350°. Grease a 9 x 13-inch (deep) pan. Melt butter in microwave in a large bowl. Mix milk and eggs in separate bowl, then add to somewhat cooled butter (cool in freezer for a few minutes), then add dry ingredients to butter, milk and eggs. Put in pan and bake for 40 to 50 minutes.

recipes.title: Apple-Anna Bread
directions: Heat oven to 350°.
Grease and flour 9-inch loaf pan.
Cream margarine and sugar until fluffy; add eggs.
Sift dry ingredients together and beat into creamed mixture.
Stir in bananas, apples and vanilla.
Pour into pan and bake 1 hour.
recipes.text: Apple-Anna Bread. Heat oven to 350°. Grease and flour 9-inch loaf pan. Cream margarine and sugar until fluffy; add eggs. Sift dry ingredients together and beat into creamed mixture. Stir in bananas, apples and vanilla. Pour into pan and bake 1 hour.

recipes.title: Fudgy Chocolate Cookie Bars
directions: Preheat oven to 350°.
In bowl combine flour, sugar and cocoa. Cut in margarine until crumbly.
Press on bottom of a 13 x 9-inch pan.
Bake 15 minutes.
In saucepan, melt 1 cup chips with sweetened condensed milk and vanilla.
Pour over crust.
Top with walnuts and remaining chocolate chips.
Press down firmly.
Bake 20 minutes or until set.
Cool.
Cut into bars.
recipes.text: Fudgy Chocolate Cookie Bars. Preheat oven to 350°. In bowl combine flour, sugar and cocoa. Cut in margarine until crumbly. Press on bottom of a 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake 15 minutes. In saucepan, melt 1 cup chips with sweetened condensed milk and vanilla. Pour over crust. Top with walnuts and remaining chocolate chips. Press down firmly. Bake 20 minutes or until set. Cool. Cut into bars.

recipes.title: Marinated Vegetable Salad
ingredients: 2 cans artichoke hearts, drained and sliced
2 cans ripe, pitted olives, drained and sliced
2 (4 oz.) cans mushrooms, drained and sliced
1 envelope Hidden Valley dressing mix (use dry)
directions: Combine all and marinate overnight.
Serve cold.
recipes.text: Marinated Vegetable Salad. Combine all and marinate overnight. Serve cold.

recipes.title: Crispy Baked Chicken(Low Cholesterol)
directions: Stir together flour and spices.
Coat chicken with mixture. Lightly oil a jelly roll pan and arrange chicken.
Bake at 425° for 30 minutes.
Turn and bake another 25 minutes.
If pan is lined with foil, clean up is easy.
recipes.text: Crispy Baked Chicken(Low Cholesterol). Stir together flour and spices. Coat chicken with mixture. Lightly oil a jelly roll pan and arrange chicken. Bake at 425° for 30 minutes. Turn and bake another 25 minutes. If pan is lined with foil, clean up is easy.

recipes.title: Bread And Butter Pickles
directions: Don't pare cucumbers.
Slice then add onions and salt.
Cover with cracked ice.
Mix thoroughly.
Let stand 3 hours and drain. Combine remaining ingredients.
Pour over cucumbers.
Heat to a boil.
Seal in hot, sterilized jars.
Makes 8 pints.
recipes.text: Bread And Butter Pickles. Don't pare cucumbers. Slice then add onions and salt. Cover with cracked ice. Mix thoroughly. Let stand 3 hours and drain. Combine remaining ingredients. Pour over cucumbers. Heat to a boil. Seal in hot, sterilized jars. Makes 8 pints.

recipes.title: Cheese Ball
directions: Grate onions, fine or
drop in food processor or blender.
At room
temperature,
combine
1st three ingredients and form one large ball or two smaller ones.
Roll in chopped nuts or paprika to cover.
recipes.text: Cheese Ball. Grate onions, fine or drop in food processor or blender. At room temperature, combine 1st three ingredients and form one large ball or two smaller ones. Roll in chopped nuts or paprika to cover.

recipes.title: Strawberry Pie
directions: Mix sugar, cornstarch, syrup and water.
Bring to a boil; cook until thick and clear.
Add jello; stir until dissolved.
Cool. Pour over strawberries in baked pie shell.
recipes.text: Strawberry Pie. Mix sugar, cornstarch, syrup and water. Bring to a boil; cook until thick and clear. Add jello; stir until dissolved. Cool. Pour over strawberries in baked pie shell.

recipes.title: Popcorn Balls
directions: Bring corn syrup, sugar and salt to a boil over medium heat. Boil 2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add food coloring, if desired.
Gradually pour over popped corn.
Toss until coated and shaped into balls or press in a mold.
recipes.text: Popcorn Balls. Bring corn syrup, sugar and salt to a boil over medium heat. Boil 2 minutes, stirring constantly. Add food coloring, if desired. Gradually pour over popped corn. Toss until coated and shaped into balls or press in a mold.

recipes.title: Nestle Quik Icing
ingredients: 1 or more Tbsp. milk (keep adding as needed)
directions: Cream margarine and shortening.
Add chocolate and sugar. Blend well, then add vanilla and milk.
recipes.text: Nestle Quik Icing. Cream margarine and shortening. Add chocolate and sugar. Blend well, then add vanilla and milk.

recipes.title: Mayonnaise
directions: Cook all ingredients together until thick, then thin with sweet cream when ready to use.
recipes.text: Mayonnaise. Cook all ingredients together until thick, then thin with sweet cream when ready to use.

recipes.title: Chewy Cake
directions: Mix brown sugar and butter.
Beat in eggs and mix well. Add flour (can
sift
if
you
want to) and mix.
Add nuts and vanilla.
Line 9 x 13-inch glass dish with foil.
Bake at 325° for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Chewy Cake. Mix brown sugar and butter. Beat in eggs and mix well. Add flour (can sift if you want to) and mix. Add nuts and vanilla. Line 9 x 13-inch glass dish with foil. Bake at 325° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Potato Soup
directions: Combine potatoes, onions, water, salt, garlic salt, oregano and pepper in a large saucepan.
Cover; bring to a boil, then simmer until potatoes are tender, about 20 minutes.
Mash potatoes slightly.
Add milk and butter.
Heat thoroughly.
Serve.
Hm good.
recipes.text: Potato Soup. Combine potatoes, onions, water, salt, garlic salt, oregano and pepper in a large saucepan. Cover; bring to a boil, then simmer until potatoes are tender, about 20 minutes. Mash potatoes slightly. Add milk and butter. Heat thoroughly. Serve. Hm good.

recipes.title: French Onion Soup
directions: Preheat frypan.
Melt butter.
Add onions and saute until almost tender.
Add remaining ingredients, except broth.
When well blended, transfer to soup pan.
Add beef broth.
Continue to cook on low heat for about 30 minutes.
To serve, place toast round in soup bowl and sprinkle with cheese.
Pour soup into bowl.
Serve immediately.
recipes.text: French Onion Soup. Preheat frypan. Melt butter. Add onions and saute until almost tender. Add remaining ingredients, except broth. When well blended, transfer to soup pan. Add beef broth. Continue to cook on low heat for about 30 minutes. To serve, place toast round in soup bowl and sprinkle with cheese. Pour soup into bowl. Serve immediately.

recipes.title: Pork And Rice Casserole
directions: Beat eggs slightly and combine with remaining ingredients. Turn into a 6-cup casserole, cover and bake in a moderate oven (350°) for 1 1/2 hours.
Serve hot with tomato sauce if desired. Makes 5 servings.
recipes.text: Pork And Rice Casserole. Beat eggs slightly and combine with remaining ingredients. Turn into a 6-cup casserole, cover and bake in a moderate oven (350°) for 1 1/2 hours. Serve hot with tomato sauce if desired. Makes 5 servings.

recipes.title: Chicken Pecan Log
directions: Combine first 3 ingredients; beat until smooth.
Stir in chicken and celery.
Shape into a log; chill 4 hours or overnight. Coat with pecans.
Serve with crackers.
recipes.text: Chicken Pecan Log. Combine first 3 ingredients; beat until smooth. Stir in chicken and celery. Shape into a log; chill 4 hours or overnight. Coat with pecans. Serve with crackers.

recipes.title: Sour Cream Banana Pudding
ingredients: 2 (4 oz.) pkg. vanilla instant pudding mix
directions: Prepare pudding mix with 3 1/2 cups milk using package directions.

Stir in 2 tablespoons whipped topping and sour cream. Layer vanilla wafers, banana slices and pudding mixture alternately in a 9 x 13-inch dish, ending with vanilla wafers. Top with remaining whipped topping.
Chill, covered, for 24 hours. Yield:
15 servings.
recipes.text: Sour Cream Banana Pudding. Prepare pudding mix with 3 1/2 cups milk using package directions. Stir in 2 tablespoons whipped topping and sour cream. Layer vanilla wafers, banana slices and pudding mixture alternately in a 9 x 13-inch dish, ending with vanilla wafers. Top with remaining whipped topping. Chill, covered, for 24 hours. Yield: 15 servings.

recipes.title: Huntington Bay Dip
directions: Saute bread crumbs, garlic powder, onion, salt and oregano in oil until golden brown.
Mix bread crumb mixture with clams and juice.
Add chopped parsley and grated cheese.
Pour into a shallow casserole dish or several small, shallow pans.
Bake in oven at 375° for 30 to 35 minutes until dark brown.
Serve with crackers. If preparing ahead of time, clambake can be frozen before cooking.
recipes.text: Huntington Bay Dip. Saute bread crumbs, garlic powder, onion, salt and oregano in oil until golden brown. Mix bread crumb mixture with clams and juice. Add chopped parsley and grated cheese. Pour into a shallow casserole dish or several small, shallow pans. Bake in oven at 375° for 30 to 35 minutes until dark brown. Serve with crackers. If preparing ahead of time, clambake can be frozen before cooking.

recipes.title: Hot Tomato Relish
directions: After cooking, take 3 to 4 cups and put into blender to thicken.
Add back and cook until it has cooked down and about 1/3 of ingredients are left.
recipes.text: Hot Tomato Relish. After cooking, take 3 to 4 cups and put into blender to thicken. Add back and cook until it has cooked down and about 1/3 of ingredients are left.

recipes.title: Spinach Salad
directions: Brown bacon until crisp.
Combine salad oil, vinegar, sugar, salt and catsup.
Put in blender.
Pour over spinach.
Crumble bacon over top.
May also add water chestnuts, hard-boiled eggs and red onions to salad.
recipes.text: Spinach Salad. Brown bacon until crisp. Combine salad oil, vinegar, sugar, salt and catsup. Put in blender. Pour over spinach. Crumble bacon over top. May also add water chestnuts, hard-boiled eggs and red onions to salad.

recipes.title: Lime Jello Salad For Dieters
ingredients: 1 (3 oz.) pkg. sugar-free Jell-O (I like lime)
directions: Combine all ingredients in a bowl.
Mix well and chill.
Makes 12 to 15 servings.
recipes.text: Lime Jello Salad For Dieters. Combine all ingredients in a bowl. Mix well and chill. Makes 12 to 15 servings.

recipes.title: Easy Peach Jam
directions: Mix peaches and sugar thoroughly.
Set aside 10 minutes.
Stir Sure-Jell with water in saucepan.
Bring to a boil, stirring constantly.
Boil 1 minute.
Remove from heat.
Stir mixtures together until sugar is completely dissolved and no longer grainy, about 3 minutes.
Pour into plastic containers; cover.
Let stand at room temperature 24 hours.
Jam is now ready to use.
Store in refrigerator or freeze extra containers.
Thaw in refrigerator.
recipes.text: Easy Peach Jam. Mix peaches and sugar thoroughly. Set aside 10 minutes. Stir Sure-Jell with water in saucepan. Bring to a boil, stirring constantly. Boil 1 minute. Remove from heat. Stir mixtures together until sugar is completely dissolved and no longer grainy, about 3 minutes. Pour into plastic containers; cover. Let stand at room temperature 24 hours. Jam is now ready to use. Store in refrigerator or freeze extra containers. Thaw in refrigerator.

recipes.title: Grandma'S Mac And Cheese
directions: Cook and drain macaroni.
Place in 2 1/2 qt. greased casserole dish.
Melt butter over medium heat, stir in flour; mix well.
Add milk and cook over medium heat, stir constantly until sauce thickens.
Add salt, sugar, and cheese, mix well.
Mix sour cream and cheese into sauce.
Pour over macaroni; mix well.
Sprinkle grated cheese and bread crumbs over top.
Dot with butter.
The dish may be frozen at this point.
Bake at 350 degrees for 45-50 minutes.
recipes.text: Grandma'S Mac And Cheese. Cook and drain macaroni. Place in 2 1/2 qt. greased casserole dish. Melt butter over medium heat, stir in flour; mix well. Add milk and cook over medium heat, stir constantly until sauce thickens. Add salt, sugar, and cheese, mix well. Mix sour cream and cheese into sauce. Pour over macaroni; mix well. Sprinkle grated cheese and bread crumbs over top. Dot with butter. The dish may be frozen at this point. Bake at 350 degrees for 45-50 minutes.

recipes.title: Peach Salad
ingredients: 2 c. water or 2 c. water and 1 c. peach juice
directions: Mix jello with 2 cups liquid and let partially set.
Add cream cheese and sour cream.
Mash peaches and add all ingredients.
Use blender and blend well.
Pour into molds and let set.
Apricots may be used instead of peaches.
recipes.text: Peach Salad. Mix jello with 2 cups liquid and let partially set. Add cream cheese and sour cream. Mash peaches and add all ingredients. Use blender and blend well. Pour into molds and let set. Apricots may be used instead of peaches.

recipes.title: Creamy Pralines
directions: Combine sugar, cream of tartar, salt and milk.
Stir over low heat until sugar dissolves.
Cook to 236° to 238°; cool to 220°. Add butter, vanilla and pecans.
Beat until creamy.
Drop by spoonfuls on marble or wax paper.
Makes 1 1/2 to 2 dozen.
recipes.text: Creamy Pralines. Combine sugar, cream of tartar, salt and milk. Stir over low heat until sugar dissolves. Cook to 236° to 238°; cool to 220°. Add butter, vanilla and pecans. Beat until creamy. Drop by spoonfuls on marble or wax paper. Makes 1 1/2 to 2 dozen.

recipes.title: Oatmeal Cake
directions: Pour boiling water over oats; add butter, stir and let set for 20 minutes.
Beat in both sugars and eggs.
Add flour, salt, soda, baking powder, cinnamon and vanilla, and lastly the nuts.
Mix all together and bake for 35 minutes at 350° in square pan.
recipes.text: Oatmeal Cake. Pour boiling water over oats; add butter, stir and let set for 20 minutes. Beat in both sugars and eggs. Add flour, salt, soda, baking powder, cinnamon and vanilla, and lastly the nuts. Mix all together and bake for 35 minutes at 350° in square pan.

recipes.title: Pretzel Jello
directions: Mix the first 3 ingredients.
Press into a 9 x 13-inch non-buttered pan.
Bake for 4 minutes at 400°.
Let cool.
recipes.text: Pretzel Jello. Mix the first 3 ingredients. Press into a 9 x 13-inch non-buttered pan. Bake for 4 minutes at 400°. Let cool.

recipes.title: Lemon Squares
directions: Mix first 3 ingredients well and pat into a 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix next 3 ingredients together and pour over batter in pan.
Bake in preheated 350° oven for 35 to 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Lemon Squares. Mix first 3 ingredients well and pat into a 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix next 3 ingredients together and pour over batter in pan. Bake in preheated 350° oven for 35 to 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Crock-Pot Barbecue Ribs
directions: Sprinkle ribs with salt and pepper.
Place ribs in broiler pan under broiler for 30 minutes to brown and remove excess fat. Slice ribs into serving size pieces and put in crock-pot.
Add onion.
Pour in barbecue sauce.
Cover and cook on low 6 to 8 hours (high 3 to 4 hours).
recipes.text: Crock-Pot Barbecue Ribs. Sprinkle ribs with salt and pepper. Place ribs in broiler pan under broiler for 30 minutes to brown and remove excess fat. Slice ribs into serving size pieces and put in crock-pot. Add onion. Pour in barbecue sauce. Cover and cook on low 6 to 8 hours (high 3 to 4 hours).

recipes.title: Persimmon Cake
directions: Cream oleo and sugar; add egg and beat 1 minute. Mix flour, soda, salt, and spices; stir in raisins and pecans. Heat persimmon pulp to boiling; add all ingredients together, beating well. Bake in 2 greased and floured 8 inch pans at 375° for 25 to 30 minutes. (In a loaf pan, bake 45 to 60 minutes at 350°.) Cake keeps well frozen.
recipes.text: Persimmon Cake. Cream oleo and sugar; add egg and beat 1 minute. Mix flour, soda, salt, and spices; stir in raisins and pecans. Heat persimmon pulp to boiling; add all ingredients together, beating well. Bake in 2 greased and floured 8 inch pans at 375° for 25 to 30 minutes. (In a loaf pan, bake 45 to 60 minutes at 350°.) Cake keeps well frozen.

recipes.title: No Peeky Chicken
directions: Put rice, milk, soups and Kitchen Bouquet in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Stir.
Place chicken pieces on top. Sprinkle with dry onion mix. Cover tightly with foil. Bake in a 300° oven for 2 hours. "Don't peek."
recipes.text: No Peeky Chicken. Put rice, milk, soups and Kitchen Bouquet in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Stir. Place chicken pieces on top. Sprinkle with dry onion mix. Cover tightly with foil. Bake in a 300° oven for 2 hours. "Don't peek."

recipes.title: Mexican Chicken
directions: Boil chicken until done.
Save a half cup of chicken broth. Cut chicken into small pieces.
In a boiler, heat cheese whiz, broth, soup and chili powder.
Crunch up doritos.
In a 9x13 in. casserole dish, layer doritos on bottom, then the chicken.
Pour heated mixture over chicken.
Then put rest of doritos on top. Cook on 325 degrees for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Mexican Chicken. Boil chicken until done. Save a half cup of chicken broth. Cut chicken into small pieces. In a boiler, heat cheese whiz, broth, soup and chili powder. Crunch up doritos. In a 9x13 in. casserole dish, layer doritos on bottom, then the chicken. Pour heated mixture over chicken. Then put rest of doritos on top. Cook on 325 degrees for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Cheese Dip
directions: Mix and cook over low heat the first 6 ingredients until it forms a paste.
Then add the remaining ingredients.
Cook over low heat until cheese melts and mixture is smooth.
recipes.text: Cheese Dip. Mix and cook over low heat the first 6 ingredients until it forms a paste. Then add the remaining ingredients. Cook over low heat until cheese melts and mixture is smooth.

recipes.title: Good Cake
directions: Mix all ingredients except pineapple together well, then add pineapple with juice.
recipes.text: Good Cake. Mix all ingredients except pineapple together well, then add pineapple with juice.

recipes.title: Home-Made "Everything" Seasoning Salt
directions: Mix all ingredients together thoroughly.
Store in a screw-top glass jar.
Makes about 1 cup.
recipes.text: Home-Made "Everything" Seasoning Salt. Mix all ingredients together thoroughly. Store in a screw-top glass jar. Makes about 1 cup.

recipes.title: Crab Quiche
directions: You will need a 9-inch pie plate.
recipes.text: Crab Quiche. You will need a 9-inch pie plate.

recipes.title: Million Dollar Pie
directions: Mix lemon juice and milk; add instant topping, pineapple and nuts.
Pour into baked crusts and refrigerate until set or overnight.
Makes 2 pies.
recipes.text: Million Dollar Pie. Mix lemon juice and milk; add instant topping, pineapple and nuts. Pour into baked crusts and refrigerate until set or overnight. Makes 2 pies.

recipes.title: Captain'S Punch
ingredients: 1 (6 oz.) can undiluted frozen lemonade concentrate, thawed
1 (6 oz.) can undiluted frozen orange juice concentrate, thawed
directions: Combine lemonade and orange juice concentrates, sugar, bitters and rum.
Mix well.
Place a large block of ice in large punch bowl.
Pour punch mixture over ice.
Add carbonated water.
Stir well.
Garnish with lemon and orange slices.
Makes about 24 (4 ounce) servings.
recipes.text: Captain'S Punch. Combine lemonade and orange juice concentrates, sugar, bitters and rum. Mix well. Place a large block of ice in large punch bowl. Pour punch mixture over ice. Add carbonated water. Stir well. Garnish with lemon and orange slices. Makes about 24 (4 ounce) servings.

recipes.title: Cobb Salad
ingredients: 2 whole chicken breasts, cooked or baked
directions: Chop all greens; dice tomatoes, also finely dice chicken, avocado and eggs.
Add rest of ingredients and toss with the dressing.
Serves 4 to 6.
recipes.text: Cobb Salad. Chop all greens; dice tomatoes, also finely dice chicken, avocado and eggs. Add rest of ingredients and toss with the dressing. Serves 4 to 6.

recipes.title: Cold Pizza(Appetizer)
ingredients: 1/2 bottle chili sauce (Bennett brand other brands change the taste)
1 pkg. each of white and yellow cheese, shredded
directions: Mix cream cheese, onion, green pepper and spread evenly over bottom of a square dish or small oblong pan (8 x 4 inch).
Spread chili sauce as second layer.
Sprinkle cheese on top.
Serve with large size Fritos.
Since this recipe makes only a small amount, I usually double the recipe.
recipes.text: Cold Pizza(Appetizer). Mix cream cheese, onion, green pepper and spread evenly over bottom of a square dish or small oblong pan (8 x 4 inch). Spread chili sauce as second layer. Sprinkle cheese on top. Serve with large size Fritos. Since this recipe makes only a small amount, I usually double the recipe.

recipes.title: Chocolate Chip Cheesecake
ingredients: 1 1/2 c. crushed creme filled chocolate sandwich cookies (about 18 cookies)
1 (14 oz.) can Eagle Brand sweetened condensed milk
directions: Preheat oven to 300°.
Combine cookie crumbs and butter.
Press firmly into bottom of a 9-inch spring-form pan.
In a large mixer bowl, beat cream cheese until fluffy.
Gradually beat in sweetened condensed milk until smooth.
Add eggs and vanilla.
Mix well.
In a small bowl, toss 1/2 cup chips with flour to coat; stir into cheese mixture.
Pour into crust.
Sprinkle remaining 1/2 cup chips evenly over top.
Bake for 1 hour, or until it springs back when lightly touched.
recipes.text: Chocolate Chip Cheesecake. Preheat oven to 300°. Combine cookie crumbs and butter. Press firmly into bottom of a 9-inch spring-form pan. In a large mixer bowl, beat cream cheese until fluffy. Gradually beat in sweetened condensed milk until smooth. Add eggs and vanilla. Mix well. In a small bowl, toss 1/2 cup chips with flour to coat; stir into cheese mixture. Pour into crust. Sprinkle remaining 1/2 cup chips evenly over top. Bake for 1 hour, or until it springs back when lightly touched.

recipes.title: "Happy Birthday Cake"
directions: Sift first 3 ingredients into bowl.
Add shortening, sugar, 1/2 cup milk, extracts and 1 egg.
Beat 2 minutes on low speed. Add 1/4 cup milk and 2 eggs.
Beat 2 minutes on low speed. Pour into greased layer pans and bake at 375° for 25 to 30 minutes. Yields 2 (9-inch) round layers.
recipes.text: "Happy Birthday Cake". Sift first 3 ingredients into bowl. Add shortening, sugar, 1/2 cup milk, extracts and 1 egg. Beat 2 minutes on low speed. Add 1/4 cup milk and 2 eggs. Beat 2 minutes on low speed. Pour into greased layer pans and bake at 375° for 25 to 30 minutes. Yields 2 (9-inch) round layers.

recipes.title: Rice And Hamburger Dish
directions: Fry hamburger and onion.
Mix all ingredients in casserole dish and bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes.
recipes.text: Rice And Hamburger Dish. Fry hamburger and onion. Mix all ingredients in casserole dish and bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Dawn'S Nachos
ingredients: mushrooms, scallions, peppers, onions etc., chopped
directions: Brown hamburger with onions and drain.
Prepare the taco and chili mixes according to the packages.
recipes.text: Dawn'S Nachos. Brown hamburger with onions and drain. Prepare the taco and chili mixes according to the packages.

recipes.title: Charlie Bread
directions: Mix together and pour into a Pyrex dish.
Bake for 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Charlie Bread. Mix together and pour into a Pyrex dish. Bake for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Sealtest Sour Cream Chicken Nachos
ingredients: 1 (8 oz.) jar Cheez Whiz process cheese spread
1/4 c. picante sauce (mild, medium or hot)
directions: Combine sour cream, process cheese and picante sauce in saucepan; stir over low heat until process cheese spread is melted.
Stir in chicken.
recipes.text: Sealtest Sour Cream Chicken Nachos. Combine sour cream, process cheese and picante sauce in saucepan; stir over low heat until process cheese spread is melted. Stir in chicken.

recipes.title: Vegetable Soup(Ukrainian)
ingredients: 2 c. diced vegetables (carrots, celery, string beans)
directions: Cook the onion in the butter until slightly wilted.
Add the vegetables, soup stock and water.
Cook until vegetables are tender.
Add the tomato juice.
Blend the flour with the cream; add some hot soup to it and stir into the contents of the kettle. Bring to a boil.
Season to taste with the salt and pepper and flavor with the parsley or dill.
recipes.text: Vegetable Soup(Ukrainian). Cook the onion in the butter until slightly wilted. Add the vegetables, soup stock and water. Cook until vegetables are tender. Add the tomato juice. Blend the flour with the cream; add some hot soup to it and stir into the contents of the kettle. Bring to a boil. Season to taste with the salt and pepper and flavor with the parsley or dill.

recipes.title: Greek Bread
directions: Set bread out and let rise.
Cook sausage well.
Cook spinach following directions on package and drain.
Mix sausage, spinach and cheese.
Add onion salt to taste.
Roll out loaves of frozen bread (loaves will be hard to roll out).
Sprinkle one half of sausage mixture on each loaf leaving room around edges.
Roll up into logs and put into lightly greased baking pan.
Bake in a 350° oven for 40 to 45 minutes or until golden brown.
Let cool 15 minutes before slicing.
recipes.text: Greek Bread. Set bread out and let rise. Cook sausage well. Cook spinach following directions on package and drain. Mix sausage, spinach and cheese. Add onion salt to taste. Roll out loaves of frozen bread (loaves will be hard to roll out). Sprinkle one half of sausage mixture on each loaf leaving room around edges. Roll up into logs and put into lightly greased baking pan. Bake in a 350° oven for 40 to 45 minutes or until golden brown. Let cool 15 minutes before slicing.

recipes.title: Buttermilk Wheat Pancakes
directions: Combine dry ingredients.
In another bowl, beat eggs.
Stir in buttermilk and melted butter.
Pour together.
Mix until smooth. Makes 24 pancakes.
recipes.text: Buttermilk Wheat Pancakes. Combine dry ingredients. In another bowl, beat eggs. Stir in buttermilk and melted butter. Pour together. Mix until smooth. Makes 24 pancakes.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Pie
directions: Mix together all ingredients and pour into unbaked pie crust. Bake in hot oven (400°) for 1 hour or until filling is set.
recipes.text: Pumpkin Pie. Mix together all ingredients and pour into unbaked pie crust. Bake in hot oven (400°) for 1 hour or until filling is set.

recipes.title: Fruit Salad
directions: Take juice from can of chunk pineapple and enough peach juice to make 1 cup juice.
Mix juice with vanilla pudding.
Add pineapple chunks, peaches (chopped up), banana, coconut and chopped pecans.
Mix altogether and chill in refrigerator at least one hour.
recipes.text: Fruit Salad. Take juice from can of chunk pineapple and enough peach juice to make 1 cup juice. Mix juice with vanilla pudding. Add pineapple chunks, peaches (chopped up), banana, coconut and chopped pecans. Mix altogether and chill in refrigerator at least one hour.

recipes.title: Wafer Delights
directions: Put it together like a sandwich.
Great for snacking.
recipes.text: Wafer Delights. Put it together like a sandwich. Great for snacking.

recipes.title: Unfried French Fries
ingredients: Cajun powder spice (or your choice of spice)
directions: Spread potatoes with egg whites.
Spread into a sprayed pan and bake in a 400° oven.
recipes.text: Unfried French Fries. Spread potatoes with egg whites. Spread into a sprayed pan and bake in a 400° oven.

recipes.title: Amaretto Dip
directions: Blend with a wire whisk until ingredients are well blended and dip is fluffy.
recipes.text: Amaretto Dip. Blend with a wire whisk until ingredients are well blended and dip is fluffy.

recipes.title: Waffle Iron Cookies
directions: Melt chocolate squares and butter or margarine.
Add sugar, eggs, vanilla, salt and flour.
Drop 1/2 teaspoon amounts on waffle iron.
Bake 2 minutes.
Frost when cool.
recipes.text: Waffle Iron Cookies. Melt chocolate squares and butter or margarine. Add sugar, eggs, vanilla, salt and flour. Drop 1/2 teaspoon amounts on waffle iron. Bake 2 minutes. Frost when cool.

recipes.title: Freezer French Toast(Serves 12)
directions: Combine first 4 ingredients in a small bowl and mix until well blended.
Place muffins on rimmed cookie sheet.
Slowly pour mixture over muffins, turning to coat both sides completely.
Let stand 5 minutes.
Flash freeze and then place muffins in a freezer bag until ready to serve.
recipes.text: Freezer French Toast(Serves 12). Combine first 4 ingredients in a small bowl and mix until well blended. Place muffins on rimmed cookie sheet. Slowly pour mixture over muffins, turning to coat both sides completely. Let stand 5 minutes. Flash freeze and then place muffins in a freezer bag until ready to serve.

recipes.title: Killer Brownies
ingredients: 1 box Betty Crocker Supreme Brownie Mix
directions: Bake brownies as directed on box in a 9x13-inch pan.
When done remove from oven.
Sprinkle marshmallows on top.
Return to oven for 3 minutes.
Remove from oven.
Mix 1 bag (6 oz.) chocolate chips and peanut butter in pan on top of stove until melted. Remove from heat, add rice krispies.
Mix well - Spread on top of brownies.
Refrigerate for 2 hours.
Cut into squares.
recipes.text: Killer Brownies. Bake brownies as directed on box in a 9x13-inch pan. When done remove from oven. Sprinkle marshmallows on top. Return to oven for 3 minutes. Remove from oven. Mix 1 bag (6 oz.) chocolate chips and peanut butter in pan on top of stove until melted. Remove from heat, add rice krispies. Mix well - Spread on top of brownies. Refrigerate for 2 hours. Cut into squares.

recipes.title: Breakfast Casserole
ingredients: additional cheese (as desired to sprinkle over casserole)
directions: Add bread to egg mixture.
Brown sausage and add to egg mixture. Add cheese and mix.
Chill overnight and bake at 350° in a 9 x 13-inch pan for 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Breakfast Casserole. Add bread to egg mixture. Brown sausage and add to egg mixture. Add cheese and mix. Chill overnight and bake at 350° in a 9 x 13-inch pan for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Chocolate Mint Patties
directions: Mix all ingredients until stiff.
Form into patties.
Dip in chocolate; place on wax paper to set.
recipes.text: Chocolate Mint Patties. Mix all ingredients until stiff. Form into patties. Dip in chocolate; place on wax paper to set.

recipes.title: Applesauce Beef Loaf
directions: Blend thoroughly; shape into a round loaf in an 8 x 8 x 2-inch baking pan.
With spoon, make a crater depression in top of loaf.
recipes.text: Applesauce Beef Loaf. Blend thoroughly; shape into a round loaf in an 8 x 8 x 2-inch baking pan. With spoon, make a crater depression in top of loaf.

recipes.title: 7-Up Cake
directions: Mix well the cake mix, pudding mix, 4 eggs, oil and 7-Up. Pour into a 9 x 13-inch pan and bake for 35 minutes at 350°.
recipes.text: 7-Up Cake. Mix well the cake mix, pudding mix, 4 eggs, oil and 7-Up. Pour into a 9 x 13-inch pan and bake for 35 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Fat-Free Potato Salad
ingredients: 4 c. diced, cooked and chilled potatoes
1/2 c. fat-free salad dressing or mayonnaise
1/2 c. sweet pickle juice (bread and butter)
1/4 c. Vidalia sweet onion relish or 1/2 cup chopped Vidalia onion
1 Tbsp. celery seed or 1/2 c. chopped celery
directions: Mix all ingredients, except potatoes. Stir until smooth.
Add small amount of salt and pepper to potatoes.
Stir all ingredients together until well blended.
recipes.text: Fat-Free Potato Salad. Mix all ingredients, except potatoes. Stir until smooth. Add small amount of salt and pepper to potatoes. Stir all ingredients together until well blended.

recipes.title: Chocolate Almond Cake
ingredients: 1 box Duncan Hines fudge marble cake mix
directions: Combine all ingredients with spoon.
Pour into a 9 x 13-inch pan and bake 30 minutes at 350°.
recipes.text: Chocolate Almond Cake. Combine all ingredients with spoon. Pour into a 9 x 13-inch pan and bake 30 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: No Bake Snow Drop Cookies
directions: Beat egg whites until foamy.
Add sugar very gradually; beat until stiff.
Fold in nuts and chocolate chips.
Drop by teaspoons in mounds on baking sheet.
Place in a 350° oven and turn oven off.
Leave 3 hours to overnight.
recipes.text: No Bake Snow Drop Cookies. Beat egg whites until foamy. Add sugar very gradually; beat until stiff. Fold in nuts and chocolate chips. Drop by teaspoons in mounds on baking sheet. Place in a 350° oven and turn oven off. Leave 3 hours to overnight.

recipes.title: Crustless Quiche
directions: Mix all ingredients and bake in glass pie pan at 325° until center is set.
Sprinkle a little of the bacon on top before baking.
recipes.text: Crustless Quiche. Mix all ingredients and bake in glass pie pan at 325° until center is set. Sprinkle a little of the bacon on top before baking.

recipes.title: Sweet And Sour Chicken
ingredients: 1 lb. boneless chicken breasts, cut into cubes
1 (8 oz.) can chunk pineapple in juice
directions: Brown chicken in hot oil in a large skillet or wok.
Add peppers, carrots and garlic; cook and stir 1 to 2 minutes.
Mix cornstarch with soy sauce; add to pan with pineapple and juice, vinegar, sugar and ginger.
Bring to a full boil.
recipes.text: Sweet And Sour Chicken. Brown chicken in hot oil in a large skillet or wok. Add peppers, carrots and garlic; cook and stir 1 to 2 minutes. Mix cornstarch with soy sauce; add to pan with pineapple and juice, vinegar, sugar and ginger. Bring to a full boil.

recipes.title: Fruit Smoothies
directions: Put all together in blender.
Mix until smooth.
Pour into a glass and drink.
recipes.text: Fruit Smoothies. Put all together in blender. Mix until smooth. Pour into a glass and drink.

recipes.title: Seafood Lasagne(Betty Crocker'S Cookbook)
directions: Heat margarine in 3-quart saucepan over low heat until melted. Add garlic.
Stir in flour and salt; cook, stirring constantly, until bubbly.
Remove from heat.
Stir in milk and broth.
Heat to boiling, stirring constantly.
Boil and stir 1 minute.
Stir in Mozzarella cheese, basil and pepper.
Cook over low heat, stirring constantly until cheese is melted.
Spread 1/4 of the cheese sauce (about 1 1/2 cups) in ungreased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish.
recipes.text: Seafood Lasagne(Betty Crocker'S Cookbook). Heat margarine in 3-quart saucepan over low heat until melted. Add garlic. Stir in flour and salt; cook, stirring constantly, until bubbly. Remove from heat. Stir in milk and broth. Heat to boiling, stirring constantly. Boil and stir 1 minute. Stir in Mozzarella cheese, basil and pepper. Cook over low heat, stirring constantly until cheese is melted. Spread 1/4 of the cheese sauce (about 1 1/2 cups) in ungreased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish.

recipes.title: *Swedish Nuts
directions: Toast nuts in slow oven at 325° until light brown.

Fold sugar, salt and vanilla in egg whites (stiff) and add the nuts. Meanwhile, melt butter or oleo in same pan in which nuts were in. Blend nuts well into egg white mixture and put into pan with butter.
Bake in a slow 325° oven for about 30 minutes, until nuts are coated with brown covering and sugar and butter are gone. Spread on waxed paper and separate to cool.
Put in tins and nuts will keep for several months.
Makes about 4 cups of nuts.
recipes.text: *Swedish Nuts. Toast nuts in slow oven at 325° until light brown. Fold sugar, salt and vanilla in egg whites (stiff) and add the nuts. Meanwhile, melt butter or oleo in same pan in which nuts were in. Blend nuts well into egg white mixture and put into pan with butter. Bake in a slow 325° oven for about 30 minutes, until nuts are coated with brown covering and sugar and butter are gone. Spread on waxed paper and separate to cool. Put in tins and nuts will keep for several months. Makes about 4 cups of nuts.

recipes.title: Peach Cobbler
directions: Arrange drained peaches in 10-inch square baking pan. Sprinkle with lemon juice.
Spread brown sugar over peaches. Sprinkle on cinnamon.
In a mixing bowl, combine flour, granulated sugar, baking powder and salt; add milk and beat until smooth. Batter will be very thin.
Pour batter over peaches.
Drizzle butter over batter.
Bake at 350° for 35 minutes.
recipes.text: Peach Cobbler. Arrange drained peaches in 10-inch square baking pan. Sprinkle with lemon juice. Spread brown sugar over peaches. Sprinkle on cinnamon. In a mixing bowl, combine flour, granulated sugar, baking powder and salt; add milk and beat until smooth. Batter will be very thin. Pour batter over peaches. Drizzle butter over batter. Bake at 350° for 35 minutes.

recipes.title: Pistachio Dessert
directions: Mix and press in 9 x 13-inch pan.
Bake 10 minutes at 350°.
recipes.text: Pistachio Dessert. Mix and press in 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake 10 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Ham Cups
directions: Grease custard cups.

Fill 3/4 full and cook 25 minutes at 350°. Let stand 5 to 10 minutes before turning out on top of warmed Chinese noodles. Put heated undiluted mushroom soup on top. Serve with fruit or congealed salad. Serves 7.
recipes.text: Ham Cups. Grease custard cups. Fill 3/4 full and cook 25 minutes at 350°. Let stand 5 to 10 minutes before turning out on top of warmed Chinese noodles. Put heated undiluted mushroom soup on top. Serve with fruit or congealed salad. Serves 7.

recipes.title: Toffee Bars
directions: Line cookie sheet with graham crackers after spraying pan with Pam. Melt butter with brown sugar in saucepan. Bring to full boil and boil 1 minute. Add walnuts. Spoon over graham crackers. Bake at 350° for 10 minutes ONLY.
recipes.text: Toffee Bars. Line cookie sheet with graham crackers after spraying pan with Pam. Melt butter with brown sugar in saucepan. Bring to full boil and boil 1 minute. Add walnuts. Spoon over graham crackers. Bake at 350° for 10 minutes ONLY.

recipes.title: Strawberry Pecan Cake
directions: Mix cake mix and Jell-O together dry.
Add oil, milk and eggs, one at a time.
Use mixing directions on back of box.
Add remaining ingredients.
Pour into a 13 x 9-inch pan.
Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.
Cool thoroughly before frosting.
recipes.text: Strawberry Pecan Cake. Mix cake mix and Jell-O together dry. Add oil, milk and eggs, one at a time. Use mixing directions on back of box. Add remaining ingredients. Pour into a 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes. Cool thoroughly before frosting.

recipes.title: Jeff'S Bachelor Hors D' Oeuvres
directions: Spread cream cheese
on serving plate.	Mix together catsup and horseradish and spread over cream cheese. Top with artificial crab.
Serve
with crackers.
recipes.text: Jeff'S Bachelor Hors D' Oeuvres. Spread cream cheese on serving plate.	Mix together catsup and horseradish and spread over cream cheese. Top with artificial crab. Serve with crackers.

recipes.title: Chicken Casserole
ingredients: 1 pkg. Stove Top stuffing mix (chicken flavor)
directions: Stir first 5 ingredients together.
Heat margarine and broth together until margarine is melted.
Pour half of stuffing mix in bottom of casserole dish.
Pour the chicken mixture over mix and spread evenly.
Pour broth and butter over top of this.
Beat together the milk and eggs and add.
Place in refrigerator overnight.
Spread mushroom soup on top.
Add rest of stuffing mix. Bake at 350° for 50 minutes, uncovered.
Serves 8 to 10.
recipes.text: Chicken Casserole. Stir first 5 ingredients together. Heat margarine and broth together until margarine is melted. Pour half of stuffing mix in bottom of casserole dish. Pour the chicken mixture over mix and spread evenly. Pour broth and butter over top of this. Beat together the milk and eggs and add. Place in refrigerator overnight. Spread mushroom soup on top. Add rest of stuffing mix. Bake at 350° for 50 minutes, uncovered. Serves 8 to 10.

recipes.title: Rhea'S Surprise
directions: Preheat oven to 350°.
Mix the cake mix, sugar, water and oil. Add the vanilla and eggs, one at a time.
Fold in the sour cream. Pour into a greased Bundt pan.
Mix the brown sugar, oleo and cinnamon.
Add the nuts.
Spoon on top of the batter.
Bake for 50 to 55 minutes.
Turn out right away; cool.
Pour a thin powdered sugar glaze over the cake while it is warm.
recipes.text: Rhea'S Surprise. Preheat oven to 350°. Mix the cake mix, sugar, water and oil. Add the vanilla and eggs, one at a time. Fold in the sour cream. Pour into a greased Bundt pan. Mix the brown sugar, oleo and cinnamon. Add the nuts. Spoon on top of the batter. Bake for 50 to 55 minutes. Turn out right away; cool. Pour a thin powdered sugar glaze over the cake while it is warm.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Pie
ingredients: 1 can Eagle Brand milk or 1 c. Pet milk
directions: Beat eggs well.
Add sugar, flour, spices and melted butter. Add pumpkin and milk last.
Pour into unbaked pie shell.
Bake about 45 minutes in 325° oven.
To make two pies, I add extra egg and large can of pumpkin.
recipes.text: Pumpkin Pie. Beat eggs well. Add sugar, flour, spices and melted butter. Add pumpkin and milk last. Pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake about 45 minutes in 325° oven. To make two pies, I add extra egg and large can of pumpkin.

recipes.title: No Bake Cookies
directions: Cook sugar, milk and oleo until butter is melted, about 1 minute. Add peanut butter while still hot. Beat until smooth. Pour over oatmeal to which cocoa and vanilla have been added. Add coconut and nuts last. Make out while still warm in balls or pour into pan and chill in refrigerator.
recipes.text: No Bake Cookies. Cook sugar, milk and oleo until butter is melted, about 1 minute. Add peanut butter while still hot. Beat until smooth. Pour over oatmeal to which cocoa and vanilla have been added. Add coconut and nuts last. Make out while still warm in balls or pour into pan and chill in refrigerator.

recipes.title: Cheesy Artichoke Heart Appetizers
ingredients: 2 (8 oz.) cans refrigerated crescent dinner rolls
1 (14 oz.) can artichoke hearts, drained and packed in water (not marinated)
directions: Unroll dough into rectangles and press into bottom and sides of 10 x 15-inch pan.
Bake at 375° for 10 minutes.
Combine remaining ingredients; mix well.
Spread over crust and bake at 375° for 15 minutes.
Let stand 5 minutes and cut.
Makes 3 dozen.
recipes.text: Cheesy Artichoke Heart Appetizers. Unroll dough into rectangles and press into bottom and sides of 10 x 15-inch pan. Bake at 375° for 10 minutes. Combine remaining ingredients; mix well. Spread over crust and bake at 375° for 15 minutes. Let stand 5 minutes and cut. Makes 3 dozen.

recipes.title: Quickie Chocolate Pie
directions: Mix all ingredients together and pour into 2 pie shells.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Quickie Chocolate Pie. Mix all ingredients together and pour into 2 pie shells. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Chicken Casserole
ingredients: 6 chicken breasts, skinned, boiled and deboned
directions: In a large casserole dish, put some chicken, shredded.
Pour soups and butter mixture over.
Add some crushed crackers, repeating layers, ending with crackers on top.
Bake at 350° for 30 to 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Chicken Casserole. In a large casserole dish, put some chicken, shredded. Pour soups and butter mixture over. Add some crushed crackers, repeating layers, ending with crackers on top. Bake at 350° for 30 to 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Cranberry And Orange Salad Mold
directions: Dissolve cherry gelatin in hot water.
Add sugar and lemon juice.
Soak gelatin in pineapple juice and dissolve over hot water.
Add to cherry gelatin mixture.
When gelatin begins to thicken, add other ingredients.
Pour into molds.
recipes.text: Cranberry And Orange Salad Mold. Dissolve cherry gelatin in hot water. Add sugar and lemon juice. Soak gelatin in pineapple juice and dissolve over hot water. Add to cherry gelatin mixture. When gelatin begins to thicken, add other ingredients. Pour into molds.

recipes.title: Fruit Salad Dressing
directions: Mix all ingredients by shaking until thickened.
Makes 8 ounces.
recipes.text: Fruit Salad Dressing. Mix all ingredients by shaking until thickened. Makes 8 ounces.

recipes.title: Nona'S Bow Ties
directions: Beat together the eggs and sugar in a medium bowl until the mixture is light and fluffy.
Stir 1 1/2 cups of the flour, the vanilla and lemon rind until blended.
Shape into a ball.
recipes.text: Nona'S Bow Ties. Beat together the eggs and sugar in a medium bowl until the mixture is light and fluffy. Stir 1 1/2 cups of the flour, the vanilla and lemon rind until blended. Shape into a ball.

recipes.title: Easy Banana Bread
ingredients: 3 large ripe bananas mashed with a fork
directions: Preheat oven to 350.
Mix all ingredients well but don't overbeat.
Pour into a greased 9 x 5 loaf pan and bake 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Easy Banana Bread. Preheat oven to 350. Mix all ingredients well but don't overbeat. Pour into a greased 9 x 5 loaf pan and bake 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Praline Candy
directions: Mix pudding mix, both kinds of sugar, milk and butter in saucepan.
Cook and stir over low heat until sugar dissolves and mixture boils.
Continue to cook gently, stirring frequently, until a small amount tested in cold water forms a soft ball.
Add nuts and mix well. Remove from heat and beat until mixture begins to thicken, no longer.
Drop by tablespoon onto wax paper and let stand until firm.
recipes.text: Praline Candy. Mix pudding mix, both kinds of sugar, milk and butter in saucepan. Cook and stir over low heat until sugar dissolves and mixture boils. Continue to cook gently, stirring frequently, until a small amount tested in cold water forms a soft ball. Add nuts and mix well. Remove from heat and beat until mixture begins to thicken, no longer. Drop by tablespoon onto wax paper and let stand until firm.

recipes.title: Mexican Taco Chip Dip
directions: Spread cream cheese in round pie plate or baking dish; spread chili on top.
Sprinkle with onion, black olives and taco seasoning mix.
Top with shredded cheese.
Bake at 350° for approximately 10 to 15 minutes or microwave on High for 3 to 5 minutes.
(Cook only until heated through; be careful not to overcook!)
Serve with tortilla chips.
recipes.text: Mexican Taco Chip Dip. Spread cream cheese in round pie plate or baking dish; spread chili on top. Sprinkle with onion, black olives and taco seasoning mix. Top with shredded cheese. Bake at 350° for approximately 10 to 15 minutes or microwave on High for 3 to 5 minutes. (Cook only until heated through; be careful not to overcook!) Serve with tortilla chips.

recipes.title: Sally'S Washboard Cookies
ingredients: 1 c. raisins (if raisins seem dry, soak in hot water and drain)
directions: Cream shortening and sugars.
Beat smooth and add eggs; mix well.
Sift together flour, soda and cream of tartar.
Set aside small amount in which to dredge raisins.
Add dry ingredients to other mixture, then raisins, flavorings and nuts.
Mix well and shape into small balls.
Press with a fork.
Bake at 350° about 12 minutes.
recipes.text: Sally'S Washboard Cookies. Cream shortening and sugars. Beat smooth and add eggs; mix well. Sift together flour, soda and cream of tartar. Set aside small amount in which to dredge raisins. Add dry ingredients to other mixture, then raisins, flavorings and nuts. Mix well and shape into small balls. Press with a fork. Bake at 350° about 12 minutes.

recipes.title: Caramel Popcorn
directions: In a glass bowl, mix together the first 4 ingredients. Microwave on High until the mixture begins to boil; continue microwaving for 2 minutes.
Thoroughly stir in baking soda; mixture turns foamy.
recipes.text: Caramel Popcorn. In a glass bowl, mix together the first 4 ingredients. Microwave on High until the mixture begins to boil; continue microwaving for 2 minutes. Thoroughly stir in baking soda; mixture turns foamy.

recipes.title: Hamburger Corn Casserole
ingredients: 1 (12 oz.) can whole kernel corn, drained
1 (5 oz.) pkg. noodles, cooked and drained
directions: Brown beef in skillet; add onion and cook until tender.
Add corn, soups, sour cream, pimento, salt and pepper.
Stir in noodles and spread mixture into casserole dish.
Combine bread crumbs and butter; sprinkle over top.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Hamburger Corn Casserole. Brown beef in skillet; add onion and cook until tender. Add corn, soups, sour cream, pimento, salt and pepper. Stir in noodles and spread mixture into casserole dish. Combine bread crumbs and butter; sprinkle over top. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Sirloin Tips
directions: Coat skillet with Pam spray; add garlic.
As pieces brown, remove to 1-quart casserole with a cover.
Add 1/4 cup wine to the skillet.
Saute mushrooms; add to meat.
Microcook wine and mushrooms on High for 3 1/2 to 4 minutes, stirring each minute. Cover and bake slowly at 275° for 1 hour, until meat is tender.
recipes.text: Sirloin Tips. Coat skillet with Pam spray; add garlic. As pieces brown, remove to 1-quart casserole with a cover. Add 1/4 cup wine to the skillet. Saute mushrooms; add to meat. Microcook wine and mushrooms on High for 3 1/2 to 4 minutes, stirring each minute. Cover and bake slowly at 275° for 1 hour, until meat is tender.

recipes.title: Cherry Cheesecake Dessert
ingredients: 1 pkg. graham cracker crumbs (approximately 16 crackers, crushed)
directions: Mix together graham cracker crumbs, butter and powdered sugar in bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan.
Cream together cream cheese, sugar and 2 eggs; pour over crust.
Bake at 320° for 20 minutes.
Cool. Pour cherry pie filling over top and garnish with Cool Whip. Sprinkle one tablespoon of crumb mix on top.
recipes.text: Cherry Cheesecake Dessert. Mix together graham cracker crumbs, butter and powdered sugar in bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan. Cream together cream cheese, sugar and 2 eggs; pour over crust. Bake at 320° for 20 minutes. Cool. Pour cherry pie filling over top and garnish with Cool Whip. Sprinkle one tablespoon of crumb mix on top.

recipes.title: Deviled Eggs
directions: Halve hard-cooked eggs, lengthwise.
Remove yolks and mash with mayonnaise, mustard, horseradish and relish. Re-fill whites. Sprinkle with paprika.
recipes.text: Deviled Eggs. Halve hard-cooked eggs, lengthwise. Remove yolks and mash with mayonnaise, mustard, horseradish and relish. Re-fill whites. Sprinkle with paprika.

recipes.title: Skillet Cabbage
directions: Fry bacon crisp and crush into bacon drippings. Add vinegar, onions, sugar and salt. Cook 5 minutes and stir in cabbage. Simmer on medium another 10 minutes.
recipes.text: Skillet Cabbage. Fry bacon crisp and crush into bacon drippings. Add vinegar, onions, sugar and salt. Cook 5 minutes and stir in cabbage. Simmer on medium another 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Baked Vegetarian Ziti
ingredients: 1 (6 oz.) pkg. mushrooms, sliced and washed
1 yellow bell pepper, cut into 1/2-inch dice (about 1 c.)
1 (10 oz.) box frozen chopped spinach, thawed
1 (10 oz.) pkg. Boca meatless Italian sausage, sliced 1/2-inch thick
1/4 c. (4 oz.) egg substitute or 1 egg, beaten
directions: Heat oven to 450°.
