In nonstick skillet over medium heat, cook mushrooms and pepper 3 minutes or until soft.
In bowl, stir together next 8 ingredients.
Spread evenly in 13 x 9-inch baking dish and top with shredded cheese.
Bake 10 minutes or until cheese melts and mixture is heated through.
Makes 6 servings.
recipes.text: Baked Vegetarian Ziti. Heat oven to 450°. In nonstick skillet over medium heat, cook mushrooms and pepper 3 minutes or until soft. In bowl, stir together next 8 ingredients. Spread evenly in 13 x 9-inch baking dish and top with shredded cheese. Bake 10 minutes or until cheese melts and mixture is heated through. Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Banana Bread
directions: Preheat oven to 350°.
Grease a 1 1/2-quart loaf pan.
Mix egg, cream and oil together with a whisk or beater until well combined (set aside).
Combine flour, baking powder, baking soda and salt; set aside.
Whip up the ripe bananas and sugar until watery.
Slowly pour the egg mixture into the sugared bananas, bit by bit.
Beat 1 to 2 minutes.
Add flour mixture and continue beating 1 to 2 minutes more.
Pour batter into greased loaf pan and bake at 350° for 1 hour or until done.
recipes.text: Banana Bread. Preheat oven to 350°. Grease a 1 1/2-quart loaf pan. Mix egg, cream and oil together with a whisk or beater until well combined (set aside). Combine flour, baking powder, baking soda and salt; set aside. Whip up the ripe bananas and sugar until watery. Slowly pour the egg mixture into the sugared bananas, bit by bit. Beat 1 to 2 minutes. Add flour mixture and continue beating 1 to 2 minutes more. Pour batter into greased loaf pan and bake at 350° for 1 hour or until done.

recipes.title: Vegetable Squares
ingredients: 1 pkg. Hidden Valley Ranch dressing mix
1/4 c. each of chopped broccoli, chopped celery, chopped green onions, and chopped carrots (raw)
directions: Spread crescent rolls out in a cookie sheet and press seams together.
Pinch edge to form a rim.
Bake for 7 to 9 minutes at 350°.
Mix together cream cheese, mayonnaise and dressing mix. Spread on baked crescent rolls.
Cover with vegetables and press into mixture.
Sprinkle with grated cheese.
Chill and cut into bars.
recipes.text: Vegetable Squares. Spread crescent rolls out in a cookie sheet and press seams together. Pinch edge to form a rim. Bake for 7 to 9 minutes at 350°. Mix together cream cheese, mayonnaise and dressing mix. Spread on baked crescent rolls. Cover with vegetables and press into mixture. Sprinkle with grated cheese. Chill and cut into bars.

recipes.title: Devilish Eggs
directions: Cut eggs in half lengthwise.
Carefully remove yolks and mash with mayo, sour cream, Worcestershire sauce, salt and pepper. Mound mixture into egg whites (use a pastry bag for decorative effect).
Sprinkle eggs with paprika.
Refrigerate until served.
recipes.text: Devilish Eggs. Cut eggs in half lengthwise. Carefully remove yolks and mash with mayo, sour cream, Worcestershire sauce, salt and pepper. Mound mixture into egg whites (use a pastry bag for decorative effect). Sprinkle eggs with paprika. Refrigerate until served.

recipes.title: Braised Jerusalem Artichokes
ingredients: 2 c. sliced, pared Jerusalem artichokes, cut crosswise into 1/8-inch thick slices
1/2 c. each: dry white wine and water
directions: In an 8 or 9-inch nonstick skillet, heat oil over medium-high heat.
Add onion and garlic and saute until onion is lightly browned.

Add artichoke slices, salt and pepper and saute for 5 minutes; add wine and cook until almost all liquid has evaporated. Add water, cover and let simmer, stirring occasionally, until artichokes are tender, about 15 minutes.
Serve sprinkled with parsley.
Yield:
2 servings.
recipes.text: Braised Jerusalem Artichokes. In an 8 or 9-inch nonstick skillet, heat oil over medium-high heat. Add onion and garlic and saute until onion is lightly browned. Add artichoke slices, salt and pepper and saute for 5 minutes; add wine and cook until almost all liquid has evaporated. Add water, cover and let simmer, stirring occasionally, until artichokes are tender, about 15 minutes. Serve sprinkled with parsley. Yield: 2 servings.

recipes.title: Crab Casserole
directions: Add cheese to white sauce.
Stir until well melted.
Remove from heat.
Add to beaten egg yolks gradually.
Add crabmeat. Turn into casserole. Mix butter with bread crumbs and garnish.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Crab Casserole. Add cheese to white sauce. Stir until well melted. Remove from heat. Add to beaten egg yolks gradually. Add crabmeat. Turn into casserole. Mix butter with bread crumbs and garnish. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Chicken Casserole Delight
ingredients: 2 c. cooked chicken, diced (can use more)
1 small can water chestnuts, drained and sliced
directions: Mix all ingredients in a large bowl.
Put in well-greased 9 x 13-inch pan.
Cover with aluminum foil and refrigerate overnight. Next day remove foil and bake at 350° for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Chicken Casserole Delight. Mix all ingredients in a large bowl. Put in well-greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Cover with aluminum foil and refrigerate overnight. Next day remove foil and bake at 350° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Russian Rock Cookies
directions: Cream margarine and sugar. Add eggs, one at a time. Beat well. Add flour and soda. Mix well. Add nutmeg, then chopped nuts. Mix well. Drop 1/2 tsp. batter onto ungreased cookie sheet. Bake about 10 minutes on 350 degrees. Makes 5-6 dozen cookies.
recipes.text: Russian Rock Cookies. Cream margarine and sugar. Add eggs, one at a time. Beat well. Add flour and soda. Mix well. Add nutmeg, then chopped nuts. Mix well. Drop 1/2 tsp. batter onto ungreased cookie sheet. Bake about 10 minutes on 350 degrees. Makes 5-6 dozen cookies.

recipes.title: Chocolate Cupcakes
directions: Mix together cocoa and water until smooth, let cool.
In a large bowl, sift together flour, sugar, baking powder, baking soda and salt.
Add shortening and cooled cocoa mixture.
Beat with a wooden spoon for 2 minutes.
Add 2 eggs, unbeaten, beat for 2 more minutes.
Fill paper muffin liners 1/2 full and bake for 20 minutes at 400 degrees.
recipes.text: Chocolate Cupcakes. Mix together cocoa and water until smooth, let cool. In a large bowl, sift together flour, sugar, baking powder, baking soda and salt. Add shortening and cooled cocoa mixture. Beat with a wooden spoon for 2 minutes. Add 2 eggs, unbeaten, beat for 2 more minutes. Fill paper muffin liners 1/2 full and bake for 20 minutes at 400 degrees.

recipes.title: Whatever Burritos
directions: Mix ground meat, onion, garlic, salt and pepper in pot.
Brown well. Add taco sauce and simmer for 15 minutes. Spoon small amount of mixture onto center of tortilla. Follow by small amounts of red beans, tomatoes, green onions, sour cream and cheese.
Fold tortillas in 3 to form burrito.
These may be filled with vegetables, meat or whatever is leftover in the refrigerator.
recipes.text: Whatever Burritos. Mix ground meat, onion, garlic, salt and pepper in pot. Brown well. Add taco sauce and simmer for 15 minutes. Spoon small amount of mixture onto center of tortilla. Follow by small amounts of red beans, tomatoes, green onions, sour cream and cheese. Fold tortillas in 3 to form burrito. These may be filled with vegetables, meat or whatever is leftover in the refrigerator.

recipes.title: Sugar Cookies
directions: Cream the butter and sugar.
Add eggs and vanilla.
Add flour with baking soda; mix well.
Drop cookies on cookie sheet or chill and shape into rolls and refrigerate or freeze.
Bake at 350° for 10 minutes.
Makes approximately 5 dozen cookies.
recipes.text: Sugar Cookies. Cream the butter and sugar. Add eggs and vanilla. Add flour with baking soda; mix well. Drop cookies on cookie sheet or chill and shape into rolls and refrigerate or freeze. Bake at 350° for 10 minutes. Makes approximately 5 dozen cookies.

recipes.title: Almond Tea
directions: Squeeze juice from lemons; reserve the juice and set aside the rinds. Combine the lemon rinds, water and sugar in a saucepan. Bring the mixture to a boil and then remove from the heat. Remove and discard the lemon rinds. Stir in the reserved lemon juice, vanilla extract, almond extract, pineapple juice and tea. Freeze the mixture in a container which can be transferred to a punch bowl for serving.
recipes.text: Almond Tea. Squeeze juice from lemons; reserve the juice and set aside the rinds. Combine the lemon rinds, water and sugar in a saucepan. Bring the mixture to a boil and then remove from the heat. Remove and discard the lemon rinds. Stir in the reserved lemon juice, vanilla extract, almond extract, pineapple juice and tea. Freeze the mixture in a container which can be transferred to a punch bowl for serving.

recipes.title: Old Fashioned Sugar Pie
ingredients: 1/4 c. firmly packed dark brown sugar
directions: Mix eggs, flour, sugars and milks in blender; pour into pie shell.
Sprinkle top of pie with cinnamon and dot with butter. Bake at 375° for 30 minutes, then at 350° until center is set, about 10 minutes.
Do not overbake.
recipes.text: Old Fashioned Sugar Pie. Mix eggs, flour, sugars and milks in blender; pour into pie shell. Sprinkle top of pie with cinnamon and dot with butter. Bake at 375° for 30 minutes, then at 350° until center is set, about 10 minutes. Do not overbake.

recipes.title: Green Bean Casserole
ingredients: 1 can undiluted cream of mushroom soup
1/2 c. Durkee French fried onions (for top)
directions: Put beans, water chestnuts, diced potatoes and diced ham in a casserole dish.
Pour mushroom soup over top and bake at 350° for 45 to 60 minutes.
About 15 minutes before the end of baking time, add French fried onions and continue baking.
recipes.text: Green Bean Casserole. Put beans, water chestnuts, diced potatoes and diced ham in a casserole dish. Pour mushroom soup over top and bake at 350° for 45 to 60 minutes. About 15 minutes before the end of baking time, add French fried onions and continue baking.

recipes.title: Swedish Rice Dessert
directions: Cook rice in milk until thick and creamy.
Add salt.
Dissolve gelatine in cold water and add to hot rice.
Let cool until it begins to set.
Whip cream; add sugar and almond flavoring and mix with rice.
Set in mold.
Serve with Crimson Raspberry Sauce.
recipes.text: Swedish Rice Dessert. Cook rice in milk until thick and creamy. Add salt. Dissolve gelatine in cold water and add to hot rice. Let cool until it begins to set. Whip cream; add sugar and almond flavoring and mix with rice. Set in mold. Serve with Crimson Raspberry Sauce.

recipes.title: Bourbon Cake
ingredients: 1 (2 layer size) box yellow cake mix
1 regular size pkg. instant lemon pudding mix
directions: Place all ingredients in a mixing bowl and beat 8 to 10 minutes.
Place in greased Bundt pan and bake in preheated 350° oven for 50 to 60 minutes.
While cake is baking, prepare sauce.
recipes.text: Bourbon Cake. Place all ingredients in a mixing bowl and beat 8 to 10 minutes. Place in greased Bundt pan and bake in preheated 350° oven for 50 to 60 minutes. While cake is baking, prepare sauce.

recipes.title: Mashed Potatoes(Serves 100 People)
directions: Peel and pare potatoes.
Cook potatoes until done.
Add all ingredients
and
mix
well.
Using 1/2 cup servings, this will serve 100.
recipes.text: Mashed Potatoes(Serves 100 People). Peel and pare potatoes. Cook potatoes until done. Add all ingredients and mix well. Using 1/2 cup servings, this will serve 100.

recipes.title: Linguine With Garden Clam Sauce
ingredients: 2 (6 1/2 oz. each) cans minced clams, drained (broth reserved)
directions: In a large skillet melt margarine over medium-high heat.
Add zucchini and garlic; saute 2 minutes.
Combine clam sauce with enough water to equal 1 3/4 cups.
Stir in cornstarch until smooth. Add to skillet with bouillon cubes and clams.
Stirring constantly, bring to a boil over medium heat.
Boil for 1 minute.
Toss with linguine and Parmesan cheese.
Makes 4 servings.
recipes.text: Linguine With Garden Clam Sauce. In a large skillet melt margarine over medium-high heat. Add zucchini and garlic; saute 2 minutes. Combine clam sauce with enough water to equal 1 3/4 cups. Stir in cornstarch until smooth. Add to skillet with bouillon cubes and clams. Stirring constantly, bring to a boil over medium heat. Boil for 1 minute. Toss with linguine and Parmesan cheese. Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: Caramel Fudge Cake
ingredients: 1 (14 oz.) can Eagle Brand sweetened condensed milk
directions: Preheat oven to 350°.
Grease and flour a 9 x 13-inch pan. Prepare cake mix as package directs.
Pour 2 cups batter into pan and bake 15 minutes.
Melt caramels and margarine in saucepan and remove from heat.
Add milk and mix well.
Spread caramel mixture evenly over cake.
Spread remaining cake batter over caramel mixture.
Top with nuts.
Return cake to oven and bake 30 to 35 minutes or until cake springs back.
Cool and serve.
recipes.text: Caramel Fudge Cake. Preheat oven to 350°. Grease and flour a 9 x 13-inch pan. Prepare cake mix as package directs. Pour 2 cups batter into pan and bake 15 minutes. Melt caramels and margarine in saucepan and remove from heat. Add milk and mix well. Spread caramel mixture evenly over cake. Spread remaining cake batter over caramel mixture. Top with nuts. Return cake to oven and bake 30 to 35 minutes or until cake springs back. Cool and serve.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Pie
ingredients: 3/4 c. chunky or smooth peanut butter
directions: Mix together softened cream cheese, sugar, peanut butter and milk.
Fold in Cool Whip.
Pour into pie shell.
Keep in refrigerator or may be made ahead and frozen.
recipes.text: Peanut Butter Pie. Mix together softened cream cheese, sugar, peanut butter and milk. Fold in Cool Whip. Pour into pie shell. Keep in refrigerator or may be made ahead and frozen.

recipes.title: Eggplant Vegetable Medley
directions: Saute eggplant and garlic in oil until lightly browned.
Add remaining ingredients. Simmer 8 minutes or until tender.
Yields 6 servings.
recipes.text: Eggplant Vegetable Medley. Saute eggplant and garlic in oil until lightly browned. Add remaining ingredients. Simmer 8 minutes or until tender. Yields 6 servings.

recipes.title: Booze Wieners
directions: Cut in small pieces.
Cook in fondue pot in glaze until cooked down.
Serve with toothpicks.
recipes.text: Booze Wieners. Cut in small pieces. Cook in fondue pot in glaze until cooked down. Serve with toothpicks.

recipes.title: Zucchini Bread
directions: Combine eggs, sugar, zucchini, oil and vanilla together.
Add remaining ingredients.
Bake at 325° for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Zucchini Bread. Combine eggs, sugar, zucchini, oil and vanilla together. Add remaining ingredients. Bake at 325° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Spinach Rolls
ingredients: 1 red pepper, seeded and finely chopped
2 (10 oz.) pkg. frozen spinach, finely chopped, cooked and squeezed
directions: Saute spinach briefly in butter.
Preheat oven to 375°.
Cook lasagna noodles according to package directions.
Cool in a large bowl of cold water; set aside.
Saute onion and red pepper with 3 tablespoons butter until tender (about 5 minutes).
Combine spinach, onions, red pepper, 1 1/2 cups shredded Mozzarella, Ricotta cheese, 1/2 cup Parmesan and egg; set aside.
Melt 1/4 cup butter in saucepan.
Stir in flour. Add pepper and salt.
Stir in milk and cream and remaining Parmesan.
Bring to boil, stirring constantly.
Boil and stir until thick.
Remove noodles from water.
Pat dry with paper towels.
Spread about 1/2 cup spinach mixture over each noodle.
Roll up jelly roll fashion starting at short end.
Spread a small amount of sauce on bottom of buttered 2-quart rectangular baking dish.
Place rolls in dish.
Spoon remaining sauce over rolls.
Sprinkle with remaining shredded Mozzarella.
Bake 30 to 35 minutes or until hot and bubbly.
recipes.text: Spinach Rolls. Saute spinach briefly in butter. Preheat oven to 375°. Cook lasagna noodles according to package directions. Cool in a large bowl of cold water; set aside. Saute onion and red pepper with 3 tablespoons butter until tender (about 5 minutes). Combine spinach, onions, red pepper, 1 1/2 cups shredded Mozzarella, Ricotta cheese, 1/2 cup Parmesan and egg; set aside. Melt 1/4 cup butter in saucepan. Stir in flour. Add pepper and salt. Stir in milk and cream and remaining Parmesan. Bring to boil, stirring constantly. Boil and stir until thick. Remove noodles from water. Pat dry with paper towels. Spread about 1/2 cup spinach mixture over each noodle. Roll up jelly roll fashion starting at short end. Spread a small amount of sauce on bottom of buttered 2-quart rectangular baking dish. Place rolls in dish. Spoon remaining sauce over rolls. Sprinkle with remaining shredded Mozzarella. Bake 30 to 35 minutes or until hot and bubbly.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Bread
directions: Mix the first 4 ingredients and beat well.
Combine the remaining ingredients and add to the first mixture.
Mix well. Fold in 1 cup raisins and 1 cup nuts, if desired.
Bake at 350° for 50 to 60 minutes.
recipes.text: Pumpkin Bread. Mix the first 4 ingredients and beat well. Combine the remaining ingredients and add to the first mixture. Mix well. Fold in 1 cup raisins and 1 cup nuts, if desired. Bake at 350° for 50 to 60 minutes.

recipes.title: Grandma'S Buttermilk Cake
directions: Beat egg whites; add 3/4 cup sugar and vanilla.
Set aside. Cream butter and sugar; cream well.
Add egg yolks one at a time. Beat well.
Fold in flour and soda, alternating with buttermilk. Cream in egg whites.
Bake at 350° for about 45 minutes.
This recipe can be frozen for later use.
recipes.text: Grandma'S Buttermilk Cake. Beat egg whites; add 3/4 cup sugar and vanilla. Set aside. Cream butter and sugar; cream well. Add egg yolks one at a time. Beat well. Fold in flour and soda, alternating with buttermilk. Cream in egg whites. Bake at 350° for about 45 minutes. This recipe can be frozen for later use.

recipes.title: Corn Casserole
directions: Combine oleo, egg and sour cream.
Add corn and Jiffy mix. Stir well.
Bake at 350° in a greased dish.
recipes.text: Corn Casserole. Combine oleo, egg and sour cream. Add corn and Jiffy mix. Stir well. Bake at 350° in a greased dish.

recipes.title: Breakfast Casserole
directions: Brown sausage; drain and cool.
Butter a 9 x 13-inch casserole dish.
Remove crusts from bread and line bottom and sides of casserole (cut bread in smaller pieces for sides).
Spread sausage over bread.
Sprinkle grated cheese over sausage.
Mix together eggs, milk, salt and pepper.
Pour egg mixture over bread, sausage and cheese layers.
Refrigerate overnight.
Preheat oven to 325°. Bake 35 minutes.
recipes.text: Breakfast Casserole. Brown sausage; drain and cool. Butter a 9 x 13-inch casserole dish. Remove crusts from bread and line bottom and sides of casserole (cut bread in smaller pieces for sides). Spread sausage over bread. Sprinkle grated cheese over sausage. Mix together eggs, milk, salt and pepper. Pour egg mixture over bread, sausage and cheese layers. Refrigerate overnight. Preheat oven to 325°. Bake 35 minutes.

recipes.title: Zucchini Bread
directions: Bake at 350° for 1 hour or until done.
Makes 2 loaves
recipes.text: Zucchini Bread. Bake at 350° for 1 hour or until done. Makes 2 loaves

recipes.title: Drumstick Pie
directions: Mix flour, oleo and half the nuts together.
Mix well and pat into bottom of a 9 x 13-inch cake pan. Bake 10 minutes at 350°. Cool well.
Mix the cream cheese, sugar and Cool Whip.
Spread over crust.
Mix chocolate pudding according to directions on box. Spread over cream cheese. Top with layer of Cool Whip. Sprinkle 1/2 of the nuts over top.
Refrigerate. Will serve 12 to 14.
recipes.text: Drumstick Pie. Mix flour, oleo and half the nuts together. Mix well and pat into bottom of a 9 x 13-inch cake pan. Bake 10 minutes at 350°. Cool well. Mix the cream cheese, sugar and Cool Whip. Spread over crust. Mix chocolate pudding according to directions on box. Spread over cream cheese. Top with layer of Cool Whip. Sprinkle 1/2 of the nuts over top. Refrigerate. Will serve 12 to 14.

recipes.title: Eggplant Salad
ingredients: 2 sweet red peppers (preferably long Italian type)
directions: Peel and quarter onion.
Cut stem from eggplant; cut in half lengthwise and put skin side up in ungreased roasting pan with lid, along with peppers and onion.
Roast, uncovered, at 375° for 17 minutes.
Turn onion and peppers and roast 17 minutes more.
Remove from oven; cover and let sit until cool.
recipes.text: Eggplant Salad. Peel and quarter onion. Cut stem from eggplant; cut in half lengthwise and put skin side up in ungreased roasting pan with lid, along with peppers and onion. Roast, uncovered, at 375° for 17 minutes. Turn onion and peppers and roast 17 minutes more. Remove from oven; cover and let sit until cool.

recipes.title: Chicken Casserole(Microwave)
ingredients: 1 pkg. dry Stove Top stuffing mix
directions: Cook and cube chicken breasts.
Set aside.
Mix together celery, water chestnuts and onions.
Set aside.
Make sauce of mayonnaise, soup and curry powder.
Melt butter.
recipes.text: Chicken Casserole(Microwave). Cook and cube chicken breasts. Set aside. Mix together celery, water chestnuts and onions. Set aside. Make sauce of mayonnaise, soup and curry powder. Melt butter.

recipes.title: Maple Pecan Corn Bread
directions: In a bowl combine well the flour, cornmeal, salt, baking soda and baking powder.
recipes.text: Maple Pecan Corn Bread. In a bowl combine well the flour, cornmeal, salt, baking soda and baking powder.

recipes.title: Shrimp Scampi
directions: Heat oven to 425°.
Remove shells and devein shrimp.
Rinse well and drain on paper towels.
Melt butter in oblong baking dish.
Add garlic and 1 tablespoon parsley.
Mix well.
Add shrimp in single layer.
Bake, uncovered, 5 minutes.
Turn shrimp and sprinkle with lemon peel, juice and remaining parsley.
Bake 5 minutes more or until pink.
Overcooking will toughen.
To serve, garnish with lemon wedges.
recipes.text: Shrimp Scampi. Heat oven to 425°. Remove shells and devein shrimp. Rinse well and drain on paper towels. Melt butter in oblong baking dish. Add garlic and 1 tablespoon parsley. Mix well. Add shrimp in single layer. Bake, uncovered, 5 minutes. Turn shrimp and sprinkle with lemon peel, juice and remaining parsley. Bake 5 minutes more or until pink. Overcooking will toughen. To serve, garnish with lemon wedges.

recipes.title: Corn Pudding
directions: Put milk, corn and butter in a pan; heat until hot, but not boiling.
Put eggs, sugar, flour, salt and pepper in a large bowl.
Beat until smooth.
Pour and stir corn mixture slowly into eggs.
Put in baking pan.
Bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes, until a knife stuck in center comes out clean.
Makes 6 servings, about 2/3 cup each.
recipes.text: Corn Pudding. Put milk, corn and butter in a pan; heat until hot, but not boiling. Put eggs, sugar, flour, salt and pepper in a large bowl. Beat until smooth. Pour and stir corn mixture slowly into eggs. Put in baking pan. Bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes, until a knife stuck in center comes out clean. Makes 6 servings, about 2/3 cup each.

recipes.title: Pineapple Casserole
directions: Combine the flour, sugar and juice.
Mix well with pineapple. Stir Cheddar cheese into pineapple.
Pour into buttered casserole dish.
Melt margarine and add crumbled crackers.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Pineapple Casserole. Combine the flour, sugar and juice. Mix well with pineapple. Stir Cheddar cheese into pineapple. Pour into buttered casserole dish. Melt margarine and add crumbled crackers. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: One Egg Cake
directions: Cream shortening, add sugar and well beaten egg.
Sift flour and baking powder; add to first mixture with milk.
Bake in greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan or two 8 or 9-inch pans.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
This was my grandmother's recipe.
recipes.text: One Egg Cake. Cream shortening, add sugar and well beaten egg. Sift flour and baking powder; add to first mixture with milk. Bake in greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan or two 8 or 9-inch pans. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes. This was my grandmother's recipe.

recipes.title: Strawberry Dream Dessert
directions: Bake cake as directed in a 9 x 13-inch pan.
While warm, flatten cake as much as possible.
Cool completely.
Mix Cool Whip, cream cheese and powdered sugar.
Spread over cake.
Mix 1 cup boiling water with jello.
Add frozen strawberries.
Let thicken slightly and pour over cream cheese mixture.
Keep refrigerated.
recipes.text: Strawberry Dream Dessert. Bake cake as directed in a 9 x 13-inch pan. While warm, flatten cake as much as possible. Cool completely. Mix Cool Whip, cream cheese and powdered sugar. Spread over cake. Mix 1 cup boiling water with jello. Add frozen strawberries. Let thicken slightly and pour over cream cheese mixture. Keep refrigerated.

recipes.title: Chess Meringue Pie
directions: Mix 1 cup sugar, egg yolks, meal, margarine, Pet milk and vanilla.
Pour into unbaked pie shell and bake at 400° for 15 minutes and then at 350° for 20 minutes or until pie is set.
When pie is done, add the cream of tartar to the egg whites.
Beat until stiff peaks form.
Gradually add 1/4 cup sugar and continue beating until well mixed.
Spread on baked pie and return to 350° oven until meringue is brown.
recipes.text: Chess Meringue Pie. Mix 1 cup sugar, egg yolks, meal, margarine, Pet milk and vanilla. Pour into unbaked pie shell and bake at 400° for 15 minutes and then at 350° for 20 minutes or until pie is set. When pie is done, add the cream of tartar to the egg whites. Beat until stiff peaks form. Gradually add 1/4 cup sugar and continue beating until well mixed. Spread on baked pie and return to 350° oven until meringue is brown.

recipes.title: Harvest Moon Cake
directions: Sift together flour, baking powder and salt; set aside.
Cream butter and sugar until light and fluffy.
Add egg yolks and beat well.
Add flour and milk alternately, beating well after each addition.
Bake in greased and floured 8 x 8 x 2-inch pan at 350° for 45 minutes.
Spread with frosting when cool.
recipes.text: Harvest Moon Cake. Sift together flour, baking powder and salt; set aside. Cream butter and sugar until light and fluffy. Add egg yolks and beat well. Add flour and milk alternately, beating well after each addition. Bake in greased and floured 8 x 8 x 2-inch pan at 350° for 45 minutes. Spread with frosting when cool.

recipes.title: Apple And Oat Bran Muffins
directions: In a medium bowl, stir together flour, oat bran, brown sugar, baking powder, baking soda, salt, nutmeg and cinnamon. Set aside. In a small bowl, combine buttermilk, egg whites and oil.
Add to dry ingredients. Stir just until moistened. Stir in shredded apples.
Store batter, tightly covered, in the refrigerator for up to 5 days.
recipes.text: Apple And Oat Bran Muffins. In a medium bowl, stir together flour, oat bran, brown sugar, baking powder, baking soda, salt, nutmeg and cinnamon. Set aside. In a small bowl, combine buttermilk, egg whites and oil. Add to dry ingredients. Stir just until moistened. Stir in shredded apples. Store batter, tightly covered, in the refrigerator for up to 5 days.

recipes.title: Incredible Edible Crabmeat
ingredients: 8 oz. pkg. cream cheese (at room temperature)
1 (6 oz.) pkg. Wakefield frozen cooked snow crabmeat, thawed, drained and broken up
Knorr-Swiss aromat seasoning (for meat) to taste
directions: Place cream cheese in the middle of serving dish.
Combine all ingredients except crabmeat in a small bowl and blend well.
Pour over the cream cheese.
Pile the crabmeat on top of the sauce and season with the meat seasoning.
Serve with your favorite crackers.
Serves 4 to 6 people.
recipes.text: Incredible Edible Crabmeat. Place cream cheese in the middle of serving dish. Combine all ingredients except crabmeat in a small bowl and blend well. Pour over the cream cheese. Pile the crabmeat on top of the sauce and season with the meat seasoning. Serve with your favorite crackers. Serves 4 to 6 people.

recipes.title: North Carolina Corn Pone
ingredients: enough water to make soft batter
directions: Mix ingredients well.
Bake or fry in pones (small cakes) until light brown.
If baking, bake at 400° for 15 minutes.
recipes.text: North Carolina Corn Pone. Mix ingredients well. Bake or fry in pones (small cakes) until light brown. If baking, bake at 400° for 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Roast Potatoes
ingredients: 2 Tbsp. total: basil, thyme and rosemary
directions: Preheat oven to 425°.
Coat bottom of cookie sheet with 1 tablespoon olive oil.
Set aside.
Wash potatoes but do not peel! Cut in 1/4-inch chunks (steak fry size).
Mix with remaining ingredients and spread out on a cookie sheet.
Cook until brown and crisp.
recipes.text: Roast Potatoes. Preheat oven to 425°. Coat bottom of cookie sheet with 1 tablespoon olive oil. Set aside. Wash potatoes but do not peel! Cut in 1/4-inch chunks (steak fry size). Mix with remaining ingredients and spread out on a cookie sheet. Cook until brown and crisp.

recipes.title: Cranberry Holiday Salad
directions: Dissolve Jell-O in boiling water.
Add orange rind and cranberry sauce.
Chill until thick.
Stir in pineapple and celery.
Pour into a 1 1/2-quart mold.
Chill until firm, 3 to 4 hours.
recipes.text: Cranberry Holiday Salad. Dissolve Jell-O in boiling water. Add orange rind and cranberry sauce. Chill until thick. Stir in pineapple and celery. Pour into a 1 1/2-quart mold. Chill until firm, 3 to 4 hours.

recipes.title: Chocolate Candy
directions: Boil together slowly white sugar, brown sugar, butter and Carnation milk until forms a soft ball when dropped in water. Remove from heat; add vanilla.
Mix together chocolate chips and marshmallow cream.
Keep stirring until smooth.
Pour in a 9 x 13 baking pan and let cool.
Cut into squares.
recipes.text: Chocolate Candy. Boil together slowly white sugar, brown sugar, butter and Carnation milk until forms a soft ball when dropped in water. Remove from heat; add vanilla. Mix together chocolate chips and marshmallow cream. Keep stirring until smooth. Pour in a 9 x 13 baking pan and let cool. Cut into squares.

recipes.title: Caramel Brownies
directions: In double boiler or microwave, melt caramels and 1/2 cup milk. Set aside.
Grease 9 x 13-inch pan.
Combine cake mix, 1/2 cup milk and margarine.
Press 1/2 of dough in bottom of pan.
Bake 7 minutes at 350° and remove from oven.
Spread chips over dough and drizzle caramel mixture over chips.
Cover with remaining dough. Bake at 350° for 15 minutes or more.
recipes.text: Caramel Brownies. In double boiler or microwave, melt caramels and 1/2 cup milk. Set aside. Grease 9 x 13-inch pan. Combine cake mix, 1/2 cup milk and margarine. Press 1/2 of dough in bottom of pan. Bake 7 minutes at 350° and remove from oven. Spread chips over dough and drizzle caramel mixture over chips. Cover with remaining dough. Bake at 350° for 15 minutes or more.

recipes.title: Banana Split Cake
directions: Cut cake in 3 layers.
Whip the whipping cream and chocolate pudding.
Layer cake, frosting, bananas and nuts.
Repeat second layer.
Last, layer pineapple, nuts and coconut.
Frost sides. Top with whole cherries.
recipes.text: Banana Split Cake. Cut cake in 3 layers. Whip the whipping cream and chocolate pudding. Layer cake, frosting, bananas and nuts. Repeat second layer. Last, layer pineapple, nuts and coconut. Frost sides. Top with whole cherries.

recipes.title: Russian Tea
directions: Combine above ingredients.
Mix 3 teaspoons to a cup of boiling water.
Store mix in airtight canister.
recipes.text: Russian Tea. Combine above ingredients. Mix 3 teaspoons to a cup of boiling water. Store mix in airtight canister.

recipes.title: Kidney Bean Salad
ingredients: 1 c. cooked macaroni (elbow) may be added
directions: Place all ingredients in bowl.
Add mayonnaise.
recipes.text: Kidney Bean Salad. Place all ingredients in bowl. Add mayonnaise.

recipes.title: Upside Down Cake
ingredients: 3/4 c. firmly packed light brown sugar
directions: Stir together the brown sugar and 1/2 teaspoon of cinnamon and sprinkle half of the mixture over the bottom of a lightly grease 9-inch cake pan.
Arrange mandarin slices in bottom of the pan, sprinkle with the remaining sugar-cinnamon mixture.
recipes.text: Upside Down Cake. Stir together the brown sugar and 1/2 teaspoon of cinnamon and sprinkle half of the mixture over the bottom of a lightly grease 9-inch cake pan. Arrange mandarin slices in bottom of the pan, sprinkle with the remaining sugar-cinnamon mixture.

recipes.title: Ham And Mac Bake
directions: Cook
macaroni	in
boiling
salted water until tender; drain. In saucepan melt 1/4 cup butter; blend in flour, brown sugar, mustard,
salt and pepper.	Add milk all at once; cook and stir until thickened and bubbly.
Stir in cooked macaroni, ham
and sliced apples.
Turn mixture into a 2 quart casserole dish. Combine bread crumbs and 2 tablespoons of melted butter. Sprinkle over casserole. Bake, uncovered, at 350° for about 35 minutes.
recipes.text: Ham And Mac Bake. Cook macaroni	in boiling salted water until tender; drain. In saucepan melt 1/4 cup butter; blend in flour, brown sugar, mustard, salt and pepper.	Add milk all at once; cook and stir until thickened and bubbly. Stir in cooked macaroni, ham and sliced apples. Turn mixture into a 2 quart casserole dish. Combine bread crumbs and 2 tablespoons of melted butter. Sprinkle over casserole. Bake, uncovered, at 350° for about 35 minutes.

recipes.title: Seasonal Jello
directions: Mix orange jello with 2 cups hot water and frozen orange juice.
Toss in mandarin oranges and pineapple.
Let set until hard.
Mix pudding as directed.
Pour over jello mixture.
recipes.text: Seasonal Jello. Mix orange jello with 2 cups hot water and frozen orange juice. Toss in mandarin oranges and pineapple. Let set until hard. Mix pudding as directed. Pour over jello mixture.

recipes.title: Red Velvet Cake
directions: Cream shortening and sugar and add eggs.
Make a paste of cocoa and food coloring and combine with vanilla, salt and buttermilk.
Add alternately with flour to sugar and shortening mixture.
Mix soda with vinegar and fold into batter.
Do not beat.
Bake at 350° for 20 to 30 minutes in two 9-inch pans, well-greased and floured.
Stand full 10 minutes before turning out.
recipes.text: Red Velvet Cake. Cream shortening and sugar and add eggs. Make a paste of cocoa and food coloring and combine with vanilla, salt and buttermilk. Add alternately with flour to sugar and shortening mixture. Mix soda with vinegar and fold into batter. Do not beat. Bake at 350° for 20 to 30 minutes in two 9-inch pans, well-greased and floured. Stand full 10 minutes before turning out.

recipes.title: Chicken Quesadillas
ingredients: 1 can cream of chicken soup (10 3/4 oz.)
2 cans Swanson chunk white chicken, drained (I prefer boneless chicken breasts)
1 can jalapeno peppers, finely chopped (may substitute bell peppers)
directions: In small bowl, combine soup, chicken, 1/2 cup Cheddar cheese and jalapeno peppers.
Top half of each tortilla with 1/4 cup soup mixture, spreading evenly to within one-inch of edge.
Moisten edges of tortillas with water; fold over, pressing edges to seal. On 2 large baking sheets, arrange filled tortillas.
Bake at 400° for 8 minutes or until hot.
Sprinkle with remaining Cheddar cheese.
Top with salsa and sour cream.
Makes 8 quesadillas.
recipes.text: Chicken Quesadillas. In small bowl, combine soup, chicken, 1/2 cup Cheddar cheese and jalapeno peppers. Top half of each tortilla with 1/4 cup soup mixture, spreading evenly to within one-inch of edge. Moisten edges of tortillas with water; fold over, pressing edges to seal. On 2 large baking sheets, arrange filled tortillas. Bake at 400° for 8 minutes or until hot. Sprinkle with remaining Cheddar cheese. Top with salsa and sour cream. Makes 8 quesadillas.

recipes.title: Ginger Steamed Fish
ingredients: 1 or 2 (2 lb.) fish, cleaned with head and tail on
2 Tbsp. ginger, peeled and cut into thin strips
2 to 4 green onion shoots, sliced into 2-inch pieces
directions: Wash the fish under cold running water.
Pat dry.
Rub a little flour onto fish skin surfaces.
recipes.text: Ginger Steamed Fish. Wash the fish under cold running water. Pat dry. Rub a little flour onto fish skin surfaces.

recipes.title: Seasoned Fish
directions: Bring water to boil.
Mix vinegar, salt and seafood seasoning. Add to boiling water.
Add fish; bring to a boil.
Simmer for 20 minutes.
recipes.text: Seasoned Fish. Bring water to boil. Mix vinegar, salt and seafood seasoning. Add to boiling water. Add fish; bring to a boil. Simmer for 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Turkey Chili With Zucchini
directions: Saute onion, green pepper and garlic for 2 minutes.
Add turkey, browning well.
Add tomatoes.
Stir in beans, corn, chili powder, salt and pepper.
Bring to a boil.
Reduce heat.
Cover and simmer for 15 minutes.
Add chopped zucchini.
Cook for 10 minutes.
recipes.text: Turkey Chili With Zucchini. Saute onion, green pepper and garlic for 2 minutes. Add turkey, browning well. Add tomatoes. Stir in beans, corn, chili powder, salt and pepper. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat. Cover and simmer for 15 minutes. Add chopped zucchini. Cook for 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Potato Rolls
directions: Put warm water (105° to 115°) in a bowl.
Sprinkle yeast over the warm water.
Add sugar and salt, stirring until dissolved. Let stand until mixture starts bubbling.
recipes.text: Potato Rolls. Put warm water (105° to 115°) in a bowl. Sprinkle yeast over the warm water. Add sugar and salt, stirring until dissolved. Let stand until mixture starts bubbling.

recipes.title: Chicken And Spaghetti
directions: Boil
chicken.
Cool
and
debone,
saving broth.
Saute peppers, onion and celery until tender, then add 2 cups chicken broth, tomato sauce and chicken.
Then add cooked spaghetti and other
ingredients
and cook 10 minutes, then add cheeses until melted.
Cooks well in crock-pot.
recipes.text: Chicken And Spaghetti. Boil chicken. Cool and debone, saving broth. Saute peppers, onion and celery until tender, then add 2 cups chicken broth, tomato sauce and chicken. Then add cooked spaghetti and other ingredients and cook 10 minutes, then add cheeses until melted. Cooks well in crock-pot.

recipes.title: Chicken Salad Casserole
directions: Combine cooked, cubed chicken with soup.
Add salt, onion, lemon juice, pimento and celery.
Add salad dressing (Miracle Whip or mayonnaise).
Put mixture into casserole dish.
Top with cheese, almonds and crushed potato chips.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Chicken Salad Casserole. Combine cooked, cubed chicken with soup. Add salt, onion, lemon juice, pimento and celery. Add salad dressing (Miracle Whip or mayonnaise). Put mixture into casserole dish. Top with cheese, almonds and crushed potato chips. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Choc-Oat-Chip Cookies
ingredients: 1 (12 oz.) pkg. Nestle Toll House chocolate morsels
directions: Heat oven to 375°.
Beat margarine and sugars until creamy. Add eggs, milk and vanilla.
Beat well.
Add flour, baking soda and salt.
Mix well.
Stir in oats, chocolate morsels and nuts. Mix well.
Drop by rounded tablespoonfuls onto ungreased cookie sheet.
Bake 9 to 10 minutes for a chewy cookie.
Cool 1 minute on cookie sheet.
Remove to wire rack; cool completely.
recipes.text: Choc-Oat-Chip Cookies. Heat oven to 375°. Beat margarine and sugars until creamy. Add eggs, milk and vanilla. Beat well. Add flour, baking soda and salt. Mix well. Stir in oats, chocolate morsels and nuts. Mix well. Drop by rounded tablespoonfuls onto ungreased cookie sheet. Bake 9 to 10 minutes for a chewy cookie. Cool 1 minute on cookie sheet. Remove to wire rack; cool completely.

recipes.title: Shrimp Dip
ingredients: 1 can shrimp, drained, rinsed and cut up
directions: Mix soup and cream cheese.
Heat and stir until cheese is melted. Add mayonnaise and mix well.
Add remaining ingredients. Serve with chips or crackers.
recipes.text: Shrimp Dip. Mix soup and cream cheese. Heat and stir until cheese is melted. Add mayonnaise and mix well. Add remaining ingredients. Serve with chips or crackers.

recipes.title: Dinner Saladgroves, Texas
directions: Layer in platter lettuce, Water Chestnuts and tuna.
recipes.text: Dinner Saladgroves, Texas. Layer in platter lettuce, Water Chestnuts and tuna.

recipes.title: T-Bone Specialty
directions: Marinate steak in Italian dressing overnight in refrigerator (or longer).
Bake in 325° oven, basting with Italian dressing until done to your taste.
Serve with baked potato green salad and corn-on-the-cob and rolls.
recipes.text: T-Bone Specialty. Marinate steak in Italian dressing overnight in refrigerator (or longer). Bake in 325° oven, basting with Italian dressing until done to your taste. Serve with baked potato green salad and corn-on-the-cob and rolls.

recipes.title: Easy Crock-Pot Chili
ingredients: 1 to 2 lb. meat (burger, sausage, a combination of that, venison burger, your choice)
1 medium can stewed tomatoes (may omit if you like)
1 c. soaked pinto beans or 2 cans already prepared
directions: Combine all ingredients in crock-pot.
May be cooked overnight or all day if you have to go to work.
Adjust the seasonings as you prefer.
recipes.text: Easy Crock-Pot Chili. Combine all ingredients in crock-pot. May be cooked overnight or all day if you have to go to work. Adjust the seasonings as you prefer.

recipes.title: Granny'S Chocolate Icing
directions: Bring all ingredients to a boil.
Boil hard 1 minute.
Remove from heat and beat a few minutes until fluffy.
recipes.text: Granny'S Chocolate Icing. Bring all ingredients to a boil. Boil hard 1 minute. Remove from heat and beat a few minutes until fluffy.

recipes.title: No Crust Pumpkin Pie
directions: In 2 pie pans, place 1/2 stick butter.
Melt butter in pans. Mix ingredients together.
Pour 1/2 of mixture in each pan. Sprinkle small amount of nutmeg on top.
Bake 1 hour at 350°.
recipes.text: No Crust Pumpkin Pie. In 2 pie pans, place 1/2 stick butter. Melt butter in pans. Mix ingredients together. Pour 1/2 of mixture in each pan. Sprinkle small amount of nutmeg on top. Bake 1 hour at 350°.

recipes.title: Caramels
directions: In a 3-quart pan, cook sugar, corn syrup, nulomoline, cream and lecithin.
Stir often at beginning to dissolve sugar.
Bring to a boil and cook for 3 minutes. Add broken pieces of butter and cook to 230°. Continue to cook and stir until mixture reaches 246°.
Remove from heat. Add salt and vanilla. Gently stir with wooden spoon.
Pour into buttered pan. Add nuts, if desired.
recipes.text: Caramels. In a 3-quart pan, cook sugar, corn syrup, nulomoline, cream and lecithin. Stir often at beginning to dissolve sugar. Bring to a boil and cook for 3 minutes. Add broken pieces of butter and cook to 230°. Continue to cook and stir until mixture reaches 246°. Remove from heat. Add salt and vanilla. Gently stir with wooden spoon. Pour into buttered pan. Add nuts, if desired.

recipes.title: Baked Chop Suey
ingredients: 1 lb. pork, cut in small pieces
1 lb. veal, cut in small pieces
directions: Mix all ingredients, except chicken soup and rice; place in casserole.
Pour about 1/2 cup uncooked rice over top.
Pour the chicken soup over top.
Cover with water.
Bake for 45 minutes, or until done.
recipes.text: Baked Chop Suey. Mix all ingredients, except chicken soup and rice; place in casserole. Pour about 1/2 cup uncooked rice over top. Pour the chicken soup over top. Cover with water. Bake for 45 minutes, or until done.

recipes.title: Lasagna
directions: Cook noodles until almost done.
Put a little bit of sauce in bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan.
Next, put a layer of noodles (3 across).
Put some sauce on top of noodles.
Put half of the cottage cheese on next, then Colby cheese and Mozzarella cheese. Layer everything in order as first layer.
On last layer, put everything but cottage cheese.
Bake in 350° oven for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Lasagna. Cook noodles until almost done. Put a little bit of sauce in bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan. Next, put a layer of noodles (3 across). Put some sauce on top of noodles. Put half of the cottage cheese on next, then Colby cheese and Mozzarella cheese. Layer everything in order as first layer. On last layer, put everything but cottage cheese. Bake in 350° oven for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Cheese Balls
ingredients: 2 (8 oz.) pkg. softened Philadelphia cream cheese
directions: Mix all together; form in small balls and roll in pecans.
recipes.text: Cheese Balls. Mix all together; form in small balls and roll in pecans.

recipes.title: Southern Corn Bread Dressing
ingredients: 2 to 2 1/2 c. crumbled dry bread (use day old light bread)
4 to 5 c. turkey or chicken stock
directions: Stewart's was a drug store in Waikiki, Hawaii that had a small restaurant. They were famous for their orange bread that they served plain, toasted or in French toast.
recipes.text: Southern Corn Bread Dressing. Stewart's was a drug store in Waikiki, Hawaii that had a small restaurant. They were famous for their orange bread that they served plain, toasted or in French toast.

recipes.title: Ricotta Cake
ingredients: 1 yellow Duncan Hines pudding cake mix (follow directions on box and place in 9 x 13-inch greased and floured pan; set aside)
directions: Combine Ricotta, sugar, eggs and vanilla and beat mixture well.
Pour over cake.
Make sure mixture goes through all of cake.
Bake at 350° for 45 to 50 minutes.
When serving, use cherries or strawberries.
recipes.text: Ricotta Cake. Combine Ricotta, sugar, eggs and vanilla and beat mixture well. Pour over cake. Make sure mixture goes through all of cake. Bake at 350° for 45 to 50 minutes. When serving, use cherries or strawberries.

recipes.title: Texas Pecan Cake
directions: Beat margarine and sugar.
Add slightly beaten egg yolks.
Add pecans and fruit with part of flour.
Add soda to warm water. Beat into mixture of margarine and sugar.
Add lemon extract. Add fruit and flour mixture.
Beat egg whites.
Mix in egg whites, alternating with rest of flour.
Bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours.
recipes.text: Texas Pecan Cake. Beat margarine and sugar. Add slightly beaten egg yolks. Add pecans and fruit with part of flour. Add soda to warm water. Beat into mixture of margarine and sugar. Add lemon extract. Add fruit and flour mixture. Beat egg whites. Mix in egg whites, alternating with rest of flour. Bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours.

recipes.title: Ziti A La Nancy
directions: Cook ziti and drain.
Brown meat; stir in sauce and parsley. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer 5 minutes.
Combine Ricotta, Mozzarella, egg, salt and pepper; mix well.
In a large deep casserole or crock-pot, put a layer of sauce first, then alternate layers of ziti, cheese and sauce, ending with sauce. Sprinkle Parmesan cheese on top.
Bake in oven at 350° for 40 minutes or in a crock-pot at medium setting for about 4 hours.
recipes.text: Ziti A La Nancy. Cook ziti and drain. Brown meat; stir in sauce and parsley. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer 5 minutes. Combine Ricotta, Mozzarella, egg, salt and pepper; mix well. In a large deep casserole or crock-pot, put a layer of sauce first, then alternate layers of ziti, cheese and sauce, ending with sauce. Sprinkle Parmesan cheese on top. Bake in oven at 350° for 40 minutes or in a crock-pot at medium setting for about 4 hours.

recipes.title: Tea Cakes
directions: Mix margarine and oil; add powdered sugar and sugar.
Beat until fluffy.
Add eggs and vanilla.
Mix flour, cream of tartar, soda, and salt.
Add creamed mixture.
Roll in small balls.
Mash with fingers.
Bake at 350° for 8 to 9 minutes.
recipes.text: Tea Cakes. Mix margarine and oil; add powdered sugar and sugar. Beat until fluffy. Add eggs and vanilla. Mix flour, cream of tartar, soda, and salt. Add creamed mixture. Roll in small balls. Mash with fingers. Bake at 350° for 8 to 9 minutes.

recipes.title: Eggplant Parmesan(Low-Fat)
ingredients: olive oil or vegetable spray (1 Tbsp. per lb. eggplant)
directions: Slice eggplant and place on baking sheet and sprinkle with 1 teaspoon of salt.
Let stand 1 hour.
(This draws moisture from eggplant so it won't absorb fat while frying.)
recipes.text: Eggplant Parmesan(Low-Fat). Slice eggplant and place on baking sheet and sprinkle with 1 teaspoon of salt. Let stand 1 hour. (This draws moisture from eggplant so it won't absorb fat while frying.)

recipes.title: Broccoli Casserole
directions: Cook broccoli and drain.
Stir in cheese while hot.
Put crushed crackers in bottom of greased casserole dish.
Add cooked broccoli mixture.
Put another layer of crackers on top.
Melt butter and pour over top.
Bake at 350° until brown.
recipes.text: Broccoli Casserole. Cook broccoli and drain. Stir in cheese while hot. Put crushed crackers in bottom of greased casserole dish. Add cooked broccoli mixture. Put another layer of crackers on top. Melt butter and pour over top. Bake at 350° until brown.

recipes.title: Lil'S Fresh Apple Cake
directions: Mix first 3 ingredients and let stand 1 hour, stirring often so juice will form.
Add dry ingredients to apple mixture, then add oil, vanilla and eggs.
Mix by hand, no mixer.
Pour batter into greased and floured tube pan.
Bake 1 hour and 15 minutes at 350°.
May be iced, but not necessary.
recipes.text: Lil'S Fresh Apple Cake. Mix first 3 ingredients and let stand 1 hour, stirring often so juice will form. Add dry ingredients to apple mixture, then add oil, vanilla and eggs. Mix by hand, no mixer. Pour batter into greased and floured tube pan. Bake 1 hour and 15 minutes at 350°. May be iced, but not necessary.

recipes.title: Cabbage Relish Salad
directions: Crisp cabbage, cucumber and celery in iced water.
Drain and dry.
Blend all the ingredients together except cream and chill in refrigerator.
Just before serving, stir in cream.
recipes.text: Cabbage Relish Salad. Crisp cabbage, cucumber and celery in iced water. Drain and dry. Blend all the ingredients together except cream and chill in refrigerator. Just before serving, stir in cream.

recipes.title: Peach Salad
ingredients: 1 large pkg. peach jello (mix with cheese)
directions: Mix all ingredients together and serve.
Refrigerate leftovers.
recipes.text: Peach Salad. Mix all ingredients together and serve. Refrigerate leftovers.

recipes.title: Fettucine Alfredo
directions: Cook fettucine, drain and set aside. Melt butter; add parsley and garlic. Saute for a few minutes. Add cream and 1 beaten egg. Stir together. Add fettucine and grated cheese. Stir until well blended.
recipes.text: Fettucine Alfredo. Cook fettucine, drain and set aside. Melt butter; add parsley and garlic. Saute for a few minutes. Add cream and 1 beaten egg. Stir together. Add fettucine and grated cheese. Stir until well blended.

recipes.title: Date Bars
directions: Beat eggs until foamy.
Beat in sugar and vanilla.
Sift together flour and baking powder.
Stir into egg mixture.
Mix in walnuts and dates.
Spread in well-greased 8-inch square pan. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes at 325°, until top has dull crust.
recipes.text: Date Bars. Beat eggs until foamy. Beat in sugar and vanilla. Sift together flour and baking powder. Stir into egg mixture. Mix in walnuts and dates. Spread in well-greased 8-inch square pan. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes at 325°, until top has dull crust.

recipes.title: Finger Jello
directions: Add Knox gelatine to boiling water; set aside.
Add jello, cold water and sugar to saucepan.
Heat until boils.
Stir until dissolved.
Take off heat when it boils.
Add another cup of cold water.
Mix together with unflavored gelatine.
Pour into 2 (13 x 9-inch) pans.
Cool 2 to 3 hours.
Cut into cubes or use cookie cutters for shapes.
Better than Jigglers.
recipes.text: Finger Jello. Add Knox gelatine to boiling water; set aside. Add jello, cold water and sugar to saucepan. Heat until boils. Stir until dissolved. Take off heat when it boils. Add another cup of cold water. Mix together with unflavored gelatine. Pour into 2 (13 x 9-inch) pans. Cool 2 to 3 hours. Cut into cubes or use cookie cutters for shapes. Better than Jigglers.

recipes.title: Sun Pickles
directions: Bring water, vinegar and kosher salt to a boil and cool.
Put cukes in jar with dill tops, garlic and alum.
Cover with water mixture.
Place slice of bread on top of cukes.
Cover with foil. Set in sunlight for 3 days.
Remove bread.
Replace with lid.
Keep in refrigerator.
recipes.text: Sun Pickles. Bring water, vinegar and kosher salt to a boil and cool. Put cukes in jar with dill tops, garlic and alum. Cover with water mixture. Place slice of bread on top of cukes. Cover with foil. Set in sunlight for 3 days. Remove bread. Replace with lid. Keep in refrigerator.

recipes.title: American Macaroni And Cheese
ingredients: 8 oz. elbow macaroni, cooked and drained
directions: Fry bacon until lightly browned over medium heat; drain.
In 2 tablespoons of bacon drippings, saute celery about 3 minutes, or until crisp-tender.
Add flour; cook about 1 minute.
Add milk, water, bouillon granules and hot pepper sauce.
Stirring, bring to a boil and boil until thickened.
Add cheese; stir until melts. Remove from heat.
Stir in macaroni, chives, pimento and all but 1/4 cup of crumbled bacon.
Pour into a greased 2-quart casserole. Sprinkle with cracker crumbs and reserved 1/4 cup bacon.
Bake for 30 to 40 minutes in a 350° oven until hot and bubbly.
recipes.text: American Macaroni And Cheese. Fry bacon until lightly browned over medium heat; drain. In 2 tablespoons of bacon drippings, saute celery about 3 minutes, or until crisp-tender. Add flour; cook about 1 minute. Add milk, water, bouillon granules and hot pepper sauce. Stirring, bring to a boil and boil until thickened. Add cheese; stir until melts. Remove from heat. Stir in macaroni, chives, pimento and all but 1/4 cup of crumbled bacon. Pour into a greased 2-quart casserole. Sprinkle with cracker crumbs and reserved 1/4 cup bacon. Bake for 30 to 40 minutes in a 350° oven until hot and bubbly.

recipes.title: Chocolate Filling(Rosa Lee Linder'S Recipe)
directions: Mix ingredients and boil 5 to 7 minutes.
Beat until ready to spread.
Cover cake layers.
recipes.text: Chocolate Filling(Rosa Lee Linder'S Recipe). Mix ingredients and boil 5 to 7 minutes. Beat until ready to spread. Cover cake layers.

recipes.title: Queenie'S Cookies
directions: Cream together shortening, white sugar and brown sugar.
Add eggs, one at a time.
Combine and add to mixture water and vanilla.
Sift flour, salt and soda together; stir into mixture. Add oatmeal and chocolate chips; stir well.
Drop by teaspoonfuls onto a greased cookie sheet.
Bake at 350° for 10 to 12 minutes.
recipes.text: Queenie'S Cookies. Cream together shortening, white sugar and brown sugar. Add eggs, one at a time. Combine and add to mixture water and vanilla. Sift flour, salt and soda together; stir into mixture. Add oatmeal and chocolate chips; stir well. Drop by teaspoonfuls onto a greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350° for 10 to 12 minutes.

recipes.title: Good Orange Salad
ingredients: 1 c. whipping cream or Dream Whip
directions: Drain pineapple; to the juice, add enough water to make 2 cups.
Dissolve marshmallows and gelatin in boiling juice.
Chill until it begins to thicken.
Whip cream; to it, add mayonnaise. Into this mixture, crumble cream cheese or dice very fine.
Add pineapple pieces.
Fold into gelatin; chill until firm.
recipes.text: Good Orange Salad. Drain pineapple; to the juice, add enough water to make 2 cups. Dissolve marshmallows and gelatin in boiling juice. Chill until it begins to thicken. Whip cream; to it, add mayonnaise. Into this mixture, crumble cream cheese or dice very fine. Add pineapple pieces. Fold into gelatin; chill until firm.

recipes.title: Hot Mustard Relish
directions: Chop vegetables, then measure.
Mix all together with salt. Let stand 2 1/2 hours.
Do not drain.
Boil for 10 minutes, or until done.
Combine vinegar, sugar, flour, mustard and turmeric; let come to a boil.
Pour over vegetable mixture; mix well.
Pour into sterilized jars and seal.
Yields 15 pints.
Eat with meats.
recipes.text: Hot Mustard Relish. Chop vegetables, then measure. Mix all together with salt. Let stand 2 1/2 hours. Do not drain. Boil for 10 minutes, or until done. Combine vinegar, sugar, flour, mustard and turmeric; let come to a boil. Pour over vegetable mixture; mix well. Pour into sterilized jars and seal. Yields 15 pints. Eat with meats.

recipes.title: Orange Balls
directions: Mix wafers, orange concentrate, coconut and nuts; make into small balls.
Roll in granulated sugar.
For smoother balls, blend coconuts and nuts in blender.
recipes.text: Orange Balls. Mix wafers, orange concentrate, coconut and nuts; make into small balls. Roll in granulated sugar. For smoother balls, blend coconuts and nuts in blender.

recipes.title: Impossible Taco Pie
ingredients: 1 can (4 oz.) chopped green chilies, drained
directions: Heat oven to 400°.
Grease 9 1/4-inch pie dish.
Cook and stir beef and onion; drain.
Stir in taco mix; spread in pie plate. Sprinkle in chilies.
Beat milk, eggs and Bisquick until smooth with wire whisk.
Pour over meat and chilies.
Bake 25 minutes; top with cheese then tomato slices.
Bake 8 to 10 minutes more or until knife inserted comes out clean.
Let stand 5 minutes before serving.
Cut to desired serving size.
recipes.text: Impossible Taco Pie. Heat oven to 400°. Grease 9 1/4-inch pie dish. Cook and stir beef and onion; drain. Stir in taco mix; spread in pie plate. Sprinkle in chilies. Beat milk, eggs and Bisquick until smooth with wire whisk. Pour over meat and chilies. Bake 25 minutes; top with cheese then tomato slices. Bake 8 to 10 minutes more or until knife inserted comes out clean. Let stand 5 minutes before serving. Cut to desired serving size.

recipes.title: Sweet Pickles
directions: Soak cucumbers in pickling salt and water for 5 to 7 days. Drain and wash cucumbers.
Cover with water and add alum.
Boil 10 minutes. Drain and wash.
Cover with water and add ginger.
Boil 10 minutes. Drain and wash. Add sugar, vinegar and salt.
Place celery seed, allspice, cloves and cinnamon in a small bag and add to cucumbers. Boil for 30 minutes. Makes 3 1/2 pints of pickles. Very good!
recipes.text: Sweet Pickles. Soak cucumbers in pickling salt and water for 5 to 7 days. Drain and wash cucumbers. Cover with water and add alum. Boil 10 minutes. Drain and wash. Cover with water and add ginger. Boil 10 minutes. Drain and wash. Add sugar, vinegar and salt. Place celery seed, allspice, cloves and cinnamon in a small bag and add to cucumbers. Boil for 30 minutes. Makes 3 1/2 pints of pickles. Very good!

recipes.title: Sherried Parmesan Chicken
ingredients: 3 chicken breasts, split, boned and skinned
directions: Place chicken in a 12 x 8-inch baking dish.
Add soup, mushrooms, cheese and sherry.
Sprinkle with paprika.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour, until tender.
Remove chicken to rice covered platter; keep warm.
Stir sour cream into sauce.
Serve over chicken and rice.
Serves 4 to 6.
recipes.text: Sherried Parmesan Chicken. Place chicken in a 12 x 8-inch baking dish. Add soup, mushrooms, cheese and sherry. Sprinkle with paprika. Bake at 350° for 1 hour, until tender. Remove chicken to rice covered platter; keep warm. Stir sour cream into sauce. Serve over chicken and rice. Serves 4 to 6.

recipes.title: Pork Chops With Peaches
ingredients: 2 c. peeled, sliced fresh peaches or canned
directions: In heavy skillet, saute chops in oil until golden brown on both sides, then season with salt and pepper.
Combine orange and lemon juices with honey, cinnamon and ginger and pour over chops. Cover tightly and cook for 20 minutes over medium heat.
Add peaches; cover and cook until heated through (about 10 minutes). Remove chops and peaches; reduce sauce, if desired, and pour over chops and peaches.
Serve.
Makes 3 servings.
recipes.text: Pork Chops With Peaches. In heavy skillet, saute chops in oil until golden brown on both sides, then season with salt and pepper. Combine orange and lemon juices with honey, cinnamon and ginger and pour over chops. Cover tightly and cook for 20 minutes over medium heat. Add peaches; cover and cook until heated through (about 10 minutes). Remove chops and peaches; reduce sauce, if desired, and pour over chops and peaches. Serve. Makes 3 servings.

recipes.title: Chocolate Chip Cake
directions: Combine all ingredients, except chocolate chips. Beat 2 minutes. Fold in chocolate chips.
Pour into greased Bundt pan. Bake at 325° for about 1 hour. Cool 10 minutes, then remove from pan.
recipes.text: Chocolate Chip Cake. Combine all ingredients, except chocolate chips. Beat 2 minutes. Fold in chocolate chips. Pour into greased Bundt pan. Bake at 325° for about 1 hour. Cool 10 minutes, then remove from pan.

recipes.title: Pecan Pie 2
directions: Mix sugar and flour.
Add 1 egg at a time.
Mix well.
Add vanilla, syrup, and pecans.
Pour into unbaked pie shell.
Bake at 350 for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Pecan Pie 2. Mix sugar and flour. Add 1 egg at a time. Mix well. Add vanilla, syrup, and pecans. Pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake at 350 for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Cottage Cheese Salad
directions: Dissolve Jell-O in hot water and cool, but don't allow to thicken.
When cool, add rest of ingredients and stir.
Put in mold or molds and refrigerate.
recipes.text: Cottage Cheese Salad. Dissolve Jell-O in hot water and cool, but don't allow to thicken. When cool, add rest of ingredients and stir. Put in mold or molds and refrigerate.

recipes.title: Cherry Sherbet
ingredients: 1/2 c. instant nonfat dry milk powder
directions: In blender container, blend undrained cherries and undrained pineapple at medium speed until pureed.
Add remaining ingredients and blend until well combined.
Pour into a 13 x 9-inch baking pan. Cover with aluminum foil.
Freeze until frozen about 3 inches from edge, about 4 to 5 hours.
recipes.text: Cherry Sherbet. In blender container, blend undrained cherries and undrained pineapple at medium speed until pureed. Add remaining ingredients and blend until well combined. Pour into a 13 x 9-inch baking pan. Cover with aluminum foil. Freeze until frozen about 3 inches from edge, about 4 to 5 hours.

recipes.title: Sweet Potato Casserole
ingredients: 3 c. sweet potatoes, cooked and mashed
directions: Combine sweet potatoes, sugar, 1/2 cup butter, eggs, milk and vanilla.
Mix well.
Pour in large pan.
Top with brown sugar, flour, 1/2 cup butter and pecans.
Mix well.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Sweet Potato Casserole. Combine sweet potatoes, sugar, 1/2 cup butter, eggs, milk and vanilla. Mix well. Pour in large pan. Top with brown sugar, flour, 1/2 cup butter and pecans. Mix well. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Cheese Ball
directions: Mix cheese spreads together with mixer. Add cream cheese, onion, Worcestershire sauce and lemon juice. Mix all together. Refrigerate until it sets a little. Roll in finely chopped nuts. Makes 2 cheese balls.
recipes.text: Cheese Ball. Mix cheese spreads together with mixer. Add cream cheese, onion, Worcestershire sauce and lemon juice. Mix all together. Refrigerate until it sets a little. Roll in finely chopped nuts. Makes 2 cheese balls.

recipes.title: Easy Chocolate Peanut Butter Cookies
directions: Preheat oven to 375F.
In Large Bowl mix 2/3 of frosting, Peanut Butter, egg and blend well.
recipes.text: Easy Chocolate Peanut Butter Cookies. Preheat oven to 375F. In Large Bowl mix 2/3 of frosting, Peanut Butter, egg and blend well.

recipes.title: Lemon Bars
directions: Combine 2 cups flour and 1/2
cup
powdered sugar.
Cut butter into flour mixture with a pastry blender or fork, until resembles coarse meal.
Spoon flour mixture into a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Press firmly with fingertips.
Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes or until crust is slightly browned.
Cool.
recipes.text: Lemon Bars. Combine 2 cups flour and 1/2 cup powdered sugar. Cut butter into flour mixture with a pastry blender or fork, until resembles coarse meal. Spoon flour mixture into a 9 x 13-inch pan. Press firmly with fingertips. Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes or until crust is slightly browned. Cool.

recipes.title: Crock-Pot Swiss Steak
ingredients: 2 lb. bottom round or Swiss steak
directions: Dredge meat in flour.
Brown in oil.
Put meat and rest of ingredients in crock-pot.
Cook on low all day.
recipes.text: Crock-Pot Swiss Steak. Dredge meat in flour. Brown in oil. Put meat and rest of ingredients in crock-pot. Cook on low all day.

recipes.title: Jiffy Cake
directions: Bake cake according to directions.
Put it into a 9 x 12-inch pan.
Cool.
Put instant pudding, cream cheese and 1 1/2 cups milk into bowl and beat well.
Put pudding mixture on cool cake; add drained pineapple over top, then add Cool Whip over the top of that.
Top with coconut, if desired.
recipes.text: Jiffy Cake. Bake cake according to directions. Put it into a 9 x 12-inch pan. Cool. Put instant pudding, cream cheese and 1 1/2 cups milk into bowl and beat well. Put pudding mixture on cool cake; add drained pineapple over top, then add Cool Whip over the top of that. Top with coconut, if desired.

recipes.title: Zucchini Casserole
directions: Beat eggs, mayo, cheese, salt and pepper.
Add green pepper and onion.
Mix with zucchini.
Put in greased pan; dot with butter and sprinkle with crumbs.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Zucchini Casserole. Beat eggs, mayo, cheese, salt and pepper. Add green pepper and onion. Mix with zucchini. Put in greased pan; dot with butter and sprinkle with crumbs. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Wesley Punch
directions: Chill juices.
Let frozen juices thaw in refrigerator.
Don't chill 7-Up.
Mix the juice first, then Southern Comfort, then the 7-Up.
recipes.text: Wesley Punch. Chill juices. Let frozen juices thaw in refrigerator. Don't chill 7-Up. Mix the juice first, then Southern Comfort, then the 7-Up.

recipes.title: English Toffee
directions: Cook butter and sugar over medium-high heat until color of brown paper bag, 7 minutes or more.
Never remove when yellow and never leave unattended.
Stir in almonds.
Pour into 9 x 9-inch pan.
Pour melted Hershey bars over top and sprinkle nuts over Hershey bars.
Cool and break into chunks.
Put into refrigerator to cool.
recipes.text: English Toffee. Cook butter and sugar over medium-high heat until color of brown paper bag, 7 minutes or more. Never remove when yellow and never leave unattended. Stir in almonds. Pour into 9 x 9-inch pan. Pour melted Hershey bars over top and sprinkle nuts over Hershey bars. Cool and break into chunks. Put into refrigerator to cool.

recipes.title: Cheese Ball
ingredients: 1 small pkg. dried beef, chopped finely
directions: Mix all together and form into ball.
Chill in fridge and serve with crackers.
recipes.text: Cheese Ball. Mix all together and form into ball. Chill in fridge and serve with crackers.

recipes.title: Chili
ingredients: 1 Tbsp. brown sugar or brown Sugar Twin
directions: Brown and drain ground chuck and onion.
Add garlic, brown sugar, jalapeno juice, jalapenos, tomato juice and tomato sauce; simmer.
Add chili powder to taste.
If hotter chili preferred, add more jalapenos or chili powder.
Add spaghetti if desired.
recipes.text: Chili. Brown and drain ground chuck and onion. Add garlic, brown sugar, jalapeno juice, jalapenos, tomato juice and tomato sauce; simmer. Add chili powder to taste. If hotter chili preferred, add more jalapenos or chili powder. Add spaghetti if desired.

recipes.title: Italian Meatballs
ingredients: bread crumbs from 3 slices of bread
oregano, garlic powder and sweet basil
Ragu spaghetti sauce with garden vegetables
directions: Mix the meat, cheese, bread crumbs, eggs and seasonings. Season to taste.
When mixing all together, add cold water, approximately 1/4 cup.
Mix well and form into balls.
Grease large baking pan with olive oil.
Bake at 400° until brown.
recipes.text: Italian Meatballs. Mix the meat, cheese, bread crumbs, eggs and seasonings. Season to taste. When mixing all together, add cold water, approximately 1/4 cup. Mix well and form into balls. Grease large baking pan with olive oil. Bake at 400° until brown.

recipes.title: Breakfast Casserole
directions: Combine all ingredients.
Put in refrigerator and let set until morning.
Cook in oven 30 to 40 minutes at 350°.
recipes.text: Breakfast Casserole. Combine all ingredients. Put in refrigerator and let set until morning. Cook in oven 30 to 40 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Coconut Cake
directions: Mix cake and add 1/2 can of coconut in batter.
Bake in cookie sheet pan at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes (no more).
When done, poke holes in cake and pour coconut milk over cake.
Mix Cool Whip and 1/2 can of coconut.
Spread over cake while warm.
recipes.text: Coconut Cake. Mix cake and add 1/2 can of coconut in batter. Bake in cookie sheet pan at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes (no more). When done, poke holes in cake and pour coconut milk over cake. Mix Cool Whip and 1/2 can of coconut. Spread over cake while warm.

recipes.title: Stuffed Mushrooms
ingredients: 4 oz. king crab meat or sea legs, chopped
directions: Crush crackers to semi-fine grind.
Add and mix all ingredients to soft pasty consistency.
Remove mushroom stems. Mound stuffing in caps.
Place on buttered pie pan in preheated 400° oven for 12 to 15 minutes.
recipes.text: Stuffed Mushrooms. Crush crackers to semi-fine grind. Add and mix all ingredients to soft pasty consistency. Remove mushroom stems. Mound stuffing in caps. Place on buttered pie pan in preheated 400° oven for 12 to 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Chicken Casserole
directions: Cook rice in chicken broth.
When done, put chicken, rice, string beans and cut up water chestnuts in large skillet and simmer for one hour (adding more broth, if necessary).
recipes.text: Chicken Casserole. Cook rice in chicken broth. When done, put chicken, rice, string beans and cut up water chestnuts in large skillet and simmer for one hour (adding more broth, if necessary).

recipes.title: Crock-Pot Macaroni
directions: Cook macaroni noodles.
Mix all ingredients together well. Cook 4 hours on low.
Put slices of cheese on top if desired.
recipes.text: Crock-Pot Macaroni. Cook macaroni noodles. Mix all ingredients together well. Cook 4 hours on low. Put slices of cheese on top if desired.

recipes.title: Crawfish Jambalaya In Rice Cooker
directions: Mix all ingredients, except butter, and place in rice cooker. Pour melted butter over all.
Do not add water.
Cook as you would rice.
Do not open and stir.
After chime sounds on cooker, continue steaming 30 minutes.
Yields 8 servings.
recipes.text: Crawfish Jambalaya In Rice Cooker. Mix all ingredients, except butter, and place in rice cooker. Pour melted butter over all. Do not add water. Cook as you would rice. Do not open and stir. After chime sounds on cooker, continue steaming 30 minutes. Yields 8 servings.

recipes.title: Peppermint Candy
ingredients: 12 oz. Toll house white chocolate morsels
directions: Crush mint and melt white chocolate with oil.
Dip out with spoon on wax paper.
Refrigerate.
Melt almond bark and dip mints. Let cool.
recipes.text: Peppermint Candy. Crush mint and melt white chocolate with oil. Dip out with spoon on wax paper. Refrigerate. Melt almond bark and dip mints. Let cool.

recipes.title: Chess Cake
ingredients: 1 stick butter, softened (do not use spread or margarine)
directions: Mix cake mix, butter and egg and press down in ungreased 9 x 13-inch pan.
recipes.text: Chess Cake. Mix cake mix, butter and egg and press down in ungreased 9 x 13-inch pan.

recipes.title: Chocolate Cake
ingredients: 1 pkg. (2 layer size) yellow cake mix plus pudding
directions: Cook cake mix.
Cook in two layers by directions.
recipes.text: Chocolate Cake. Cook cake mix. Cook in two layers by directions.

recipes.title: Ham Pick-Ups
directions: Slice rolls horizontally into halves.
Do not separate rolls. Combine margarine, poppy seed, dry mustard, onion and Worcestershire sauce in bowl; mix well.
Spread on cut sides of rolls.
Layer ham and cheese on bottom half of rolls.
Replace top of rolls.
recipes.text: Ham Pick-Ups. Slice rolls horizontally into halves. Do not separate rolls. Combine margarine, poppy seed, dry mustard, onion and Worcestershire sauce in bowl; mix well. Spread on cut sides of rolls. Layer ham and cheese on bottom half of rolls. Replace top of rolls.

recipes.title: Porcupine Balls
directions: In saucepan, put dates, beaten egg, sugar and butter.
Cook over low heat for 10 minutes.
Cool.
Add Rice Krispies and chopped nuts.
Stir.
Mix into small balls and roll in flaked coconut.
recipes.text: Porcupine Balls. In saucepan, put dates, beaten egg, sugar and butter. Cook over low heat for 10 minutes. Cool. Add Rice Krispies and chopped nuts. Stir. Mix into small balls and roll in flaked coconut.

recipes.title: Fudge Piediagonal, Iowa
directions: Melt chocolate and butter together.
Let cool.
Combine sugar, eggs, flour, salt and vanilla.
Add the chocolate mixture.
Pour into greased pie pan.
Bake until set on the outside, but still soft in the center.
DO NOT OVERBAKE!
recipes.text: Fudge Piediagonal, Iowa. Melt chocolate and butter together. Let cool. Combine sugar, eggs, flour, salt and vanilla. Add the chocolate mixture. Pour into greased pie pan. Bake until set on the outside, but still soft in the center. DO NOT OVERBAKE!

recipes.title: Cheese-Pumpkin Soup
directions: In large, heavy saucepan, lightly saute green onions in butter.
Stir in flour, seasoned salt, nutmeg and cinnamon. Remove from heat.
Add milk and chicken broth.
Cook, stirring, about 15 minutes, until thickened.
Blend in pumpkin.
Simmer 5 minutes longer, stirring frequently.
Add cheese; stir until melted.
Ladle into soup bowls.
Top each serving, if desired, with a slice of tomato, sprinkled with cheese and green onions (optional).
recipes.text: Cheese-Pumpkin Soup. In large, heavy saucepan, lightly saute green onions in butter. Stir in flour, seasoned salt, nutmeg and cinnamon. Remove from heat. Add milk and chicken broth. Cook, stirring, about 15 minutes, until thickened. Blend in pumpkin. Simmer 5 minutes longer, stirring frequently. Add cheese; stir until melted. Ladle into soup bowls. Top each serving, if desired, with a slice of tomato, sprinkled with cheese and green onions (optional).

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Sugarless Cookies
directions: Preheat oven to 400°. Sift together flour, baking powder and salt. Cream together margarine, sugar, peanut butter, orange zest and vanilla. Add egg, orange juice and sweetener. Blend well. Add dry ingredients gradually; mix well after each addition. Measure 1 level tablespoon dough for each cookie. Roll in hands to form ball. Place 2 inches apart on an ungreased cookie sheet. Flatten with fork. Bake about 15 minutes. Store cookies in a tightly covered tin.
These cookies have better flavor and texture 24 hours after baking.
recipes.text: Peanut Butter Sugarless Cookies. Preheat oven to 400°. Sift together flour, baking powder and salt. Cream together margarine, sugar, peanut butter, orange zest and vanilla. Add egg, orange juice and sweetener. Blend well. Add dry ingredients gradually; mix well after each addition. Measure 1 level tablespoon dough for each cookie. Roll in hands to form ball. Place 2 inches apart on an ungreased cookie sheet. Flatten with fork. Bake about 15 minutes. Store cookies in a tightly covered tin. These cookies have better flavor and texture 24 hours after baking.

recipes.title: Venison Jerky
directions: Trim all fat from meat; cut into very thin strips.
Mix and soak overnight.
Arrange strips on cookie sheet.
Set oven at 200°.
Leave oven door cracked to let moisture escape (put a spoon in the door).
Bake 4 to 7 hours.
recipes.text: Venison Jerky. Trim all fat from meat; cut into very thin strips. Mix and soak overnight. Arrange strips on cookie sheet. Set oven at 200°. Leave oven door cracked to let moisture escape (put a spoon in the door). Bake 4 to 7 hours.

recipes.title: Snappy Glazed Meatballs
directions: In medium bowl combine first 5 ingredients; mix well.
Shape into 1 inch balls.
In skillet, brown meatballs, turning occasionally; drain.
In small bowl, combine remaining ingredients. Pour sauce over meatballs; simmer 15 minutes.
Serve warm in chafing dish or electric frypan.
Makes about 4 dozen meatballs.
recipes.text: Snappy Glazed Meatballs. In medium bowl combine first 5 ingredients; mix well. Shape into 1 inch balls. In skillet, brown meatballs, turning occasionally; drain. In small bowl, combine remaining ingredients. Pour sauce over meatballs; simmer 15 minutes. Serve warm in chafing dish or electric frypan. Makes about 4 dozen meatballs.

recipes.title: Beef Bulgogi
ingredients: 1/2 c. chopped green onions and stems
2 cloves garlic, chopped, or 1 tsp. garlic powder
directions: Slice beef against the grain into 1/4-inch slices.
In bowl, stir together all other ingredients.
Add meat and toss until all pieces are covered.
Marinate at least 1 to 2 hours at room temperature or overnight in fridge.
Can barbecue, broil or saute. Serve with rice.
Use sauce on rice.
Serves 4.
recipes.text: Beef Bulgogi. Slice beef against the grain into 1/4-inch slices. In bowl, stir together all other ingredients. Add meat and toss until all pieces are covered. Marinate at least 1 to 2 hours at room temperature or overnight in fridge. Can barbecue, broil or saute. Serve with rice. Use sauce on rice. Serves 4.

recipes.title: Red Beans And Rice
directions: Soak beans in water for 6 to 8 hours.
Cook beans 3 plus hours.
Add sausage and bring to a boil.
Add rice and spices. Cook 15 to 20 minutes.
Serves 10 to 12.
recipes.text: Red Beans And Rice. Soak beans in water for 6 to 8 hours. Cook beans 3 plus hours. Add sausage and bring to a boil. Add rice and spices. Cook 15 to 20 minutes. Serves 10 to 12.

recipes.title: Irish Soda Bread(Low Cholesterol)
directions: Sift dry ingredients together in a bowl.
Add raisins. Combine egg whites, buttermilk and oil.
Add to dry mixture.
Pour batter into a greased round iron frying pan and bake in a 350° oven for 1 hour.
Cool for 10 minutes and remove from pan.
recipes.text: Irish Soda Bread(Low Cholesterol). Sift dry ingredients together in a bowl. Add raisins. Combine egg whites, buttermilk and oil. Add to dry mixture. Pour batter into a greased round iron frying pan and bake in a 350° oven for 1 hour. Cool for 10 minutes and remove from pan.

recipes.title: Vern'S Light Desserts
directions: Mix margarine, flour and sugar well.
Press in 9 x 13-inch pan and bake 15 minutes at 325° until light brown.
Beat cream cheese and powdered sugar well.
Add 1/2 of Cool Whip in the cheese mixture.
Cool.
Mix the dry puddings together and beat with milk. Pour over cheese mixture.
Put the rest of Cool Whip on top of all and sprinkle with chopped nuts.
recipes.text: Vern'S Light Desserts. Mix margarine, flour and sugar well. Press in 9 x 13-inch pan and bake 15 minutes at 325° until light brown. Beat cream cheese and powdered sugar well. Add 1/2 of Cool Whip in the cheese mixture. Cool. Mix the dry puddings together and beat with milk. Pour over cheese mixture. Put the rest of Cool Whip on top of all and sprinkle with chopped nuts.

recipes.title: Chocolate Brownie Pie
ingredients: 1 (4 oz.) pkg. Baker's German sweet chocolate
directions: Heat oven to 350°.
Microwave chocolate and margarine in large, microwavable bowl on High for 2 minutes or until margarine is melted.
Stir until chocolate is completely melted.
Stir sugar into melted chocolate mixture.
Mix in eggs and vanilla until well blended.
Stir in flour and nuts.
Spread in greased and floured 9-inch pie plate.
Bake for 25 minutes or until toothpick inserted into center comes out with fudgy crumbs.
Do not overbake.
Cool in pie plate.
