Serve with ice cream and regal Chocolate Sauce. Makes 8 servings.
recipes.text: Chocolate Brownie Pie. Heat oven to 350°. Microwave chocolate and margarine in large, microwavable bowl on High for 2 minutes or until margarine is melted. Stir until chocolate is completely melted. Stir sugar into melted chocolate mixture. Mix in eggs and vanilla until well blended. Stir in flour and nuts. Spread in greased and floured 9-inch pie plate. Bake for 25 minutes or until toothpick inserted into center comes out with fudgy crumbs. Do not overbake. Cool in pie plate. Serve with ice cream and regal Chocolate Sauce. Makes 8 servings.

recipes.title: Coconut Pie
ingredients: 2 eggs, separated (save whites for top of pie)
directions: Melt margarine. Pour in sugar and flour.
Cream good, then add egg yolks and beat good.
Add milk and coconut. Stir good and pour in pie shell.
Cook on bottom rack at 375° until done.
recipes.text: Coconut Pie. Melt margarine. Pour in sugar and flour. Cream good, then add egg yolks and beat good. Add milk and coconut. Stir good and pour in pie shell. Cook on bottom rack at 375° until done.

recipes.title: For Eggnog Lovers
ingredients: 1 pkg. Equal or other sugar substitute
directions: Whip Egg Beaters and sugar substitute together and combine with 2 types of milk and flavoring. Mix well. Chill overnight if possible. Pour into tumblers and dust with nutmeg. Preparation time: 10 minutes.
recipes.text: For Eggnog Lovers. Whip Egg Beaters and sugar substitute together and combine with 2 types of milk and flavoring. Mix well. Chill overnight if possible. Pour into tumblers and dust with nutmeg. Preparation time: 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Chess Pie
directions: Mix ingredients together and beat.
Pour into unbaked pie shell.
Bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Chess Pie. Mix ingredients together and beat. Pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Chuck Wagon Beans
ingredients: 3 (1 lb.) cans (6 c.) baked beans in pork and molasses sauce
directions: In a 2-quart casserole or bean pot, combine beans, tomato sauce, onion, catsup, brown sugar and seasonings. Bury bacon in beans. Bake, uncovered, in slow oven (300°) 3 1/2 to 4 hours. Toward end of cooking time, fork bacon to top. Center with drained, cooked or canned onions. Makes 6 servings.
recipes.text: Chuck Wagon Beans. In a 2-quart casserole or bean pot, combine beans, tomato sauce, onion, catsup, brown sugar and seasonings. Bury bacon in beans. Bake, uncovered, in slow oven (300°) 3 1/2 to 4 hours. Toward end of cooking time, fork bacon to top. Center with drained, cooked or canned onions. Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Western Meat Loaf
directions: Mix ingredients well and shape into loaf dish.
Pour sauce over meat and bake for 1 hour at 350°.
Very good.
recipes.text: Western Meat Loaf. Mix ingredients well and shape into loaf dish. Pour sauce over meat and bake for 1 hour at 350°. Very good.

recipes.title: No Cook Flour Icing
directions: Blend together.
Beat on high speed for 10 to 12 minutes. Can add peanut butter.
recipes.text: No Cook Flour Icing. Blend together. Beat on high speed for 10 to 12 minutes. Can add peanut butter.

recipes.title: Cream Cheese Pound Cake
directions: Cream sugar, butter and cream cheese.
Add eggs, one at a time, beating after each.
Add flavorings and blend.
Finally, add flavor all at once.
Beat until smooth.
Pour into greased and floured Bundt pan.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Cream Cheese Pound Cake. Cream sugar, butter and cream cheese. Add eggs, one at a time, beating after each. Add flavorings and blend. Finally, add flavor all at once. Beat until smooth. Pour into greased and floured Bundt pan. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Dip
directions: Mix all ingredients together.
recipes.text: Dip. Mix all ingredients together.

recipes.title: Jiffy Barbeque Sauce
directions: Cook onion until soft in hot oil.
Add remaining ingredients. Simmer for 15 minutes.
Delicious on everything!
recipes.text: Jiffy Barbeque Sauce. Cook onion until soft in hot oil. Add remaining ingredients. Simmer for 15 minutes. Delicious on everything!

recipes.title: Spinach Dip
directions: Combine ingredients.
Add spinach last.
Refrigerate for a few hours.
recipes.text: Spinach Dip. Combine ingredients. Add spinach last. Refrigerate for a few hours.

recipes.title: Peaches-N-Cream
directions: Mix Cool Whip and jello until creamy.
Add cottage cheese. Drain and dice peaches.
Mix together with other ingredients and chill 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Peaches-N-Cream. Mix Cool Whip and jello until creamy. Add cottage cheese. Drain and dice peaches. Mix together with other ingredients and chill 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Banana Bread
directions: Mix all together with mixer.
Grease 2 loaf pans.
Bake at 350° for 55 to 60 minutes.
recipes.text: Banana Bread. Mix all together with mixer. Grease 2 loaf pans. Bake at 350° for 55 to 60 minutes.

recipes.title: Hash Brown Casserole
ingredients: 1 1/2 c. (6 oz.) shredded, reduced-fat sharp Cheddar cheese
1 (32 oz.) pkg. frozen Southern-style hash brown potatoes, thawed
directions: Coat a medium saucepan with vegetable cooking spray; place over medium heat until hot.
Add onion and saute 3 minutes or until tender.
Add flour, mustard and salt; stir well and cook an additional minute.
Remove from heat; gradually add milk and broth, stirring with a wire whisk until blended.
Cook over medium heat 5 minutes or until thickened, stirring constantly.
Remove from heat; add cheeses and pepper, stirring until cheeses melt. Stir in sour cream.
recipes.text: Hash Brown Casserole. Coat a medium saucepan with vegetable cooking spray; place over medium heat until hot. Add onion and saute 3 minutes or until tender. Add flour, mustard and salt; stir well and cook an additional minute. Remove from heat; gradually add milk and broth, stirring with a wire whisk until blended. Cook over medium heat 5 minutes or until thickened, stirring constantly. Remove from heat; add cheeses and pepper, stirring until cheeses melt. Stir in sour cream.

recipes.title: Fettucine Alfredo(Not For Heart Patients)
directions: Melt butter in pan. Add heavy cream and pepper.
Stir well. Add cheese and sifted cornstarch.
Cook on low flame for 15 to 20 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add peas the last minute.
Cook fettucine separately.
Pour sauce over fettucine.
recipes.text: Fettucine Alfredo(Not For Heart Patients). Melt butter in pan. Add heavy cream and pepper. Stir well. Add cheese and sifted cornstarch. Cook on low flame for 15 to 20 minutes, stirring constantly. Add peas the last minute. Cook fettucine separately. Pour sauce over fettucine.

recipes.title: Pineapple Cheese Ball
directions: Drain pineapple.
Soften cream cheese and combine with other ingredients including 1/2 cup of nuts.
Put into refrigerator for 1 1/2 hours.
Take out and roll in remainder of nuts.
recipes.text: Pineapple Cheese Ball. Drain pineapple. Soften cream cheese and combine with other ingredients including 1/2 cup of nuts. Put into refrigerator for 1 1/2 hours. Take out and roll in remainder of nuts.

recipes.title: Ma'S Sugar Cookies
directions: Cream the sugar and margarine.
Beat eggs, milk and vanilla. Add to creamed mixture.
Combine remaining ingredients and fold in with wet ingredients.
Cover and refrigerate for at least an hour. Roll out dough on a floured surface and let grand children cut out cookies.
Decorate with colored sugar, sprinkles and candy or you may use icing after baking.
Bake in a 350° to 400° oven until done.
Sweep the sugar from the floor that doesn't quite make it to the cookies.
Wipe little hands and faces before parents arrive and enjoy the best cookies ever!
recipes.text: Ma'S Sugar Cookies. Cream the sugar and margarine. Beat eggs, milk and vanilla. Add to creamed mixture. Combine remaining ingredients and fold in with wet ingredients. Cover and refrigerate for at least an hour. Roll out dough on a floured surface and let grand children cut out cookies. Decorate with colored sugar, sprinkles and candy or you may use icing after baking. Bake in a 350° to 400° oven until done. Sweep the sugar from the floor that doesn't quite make it to the cookies. Wipe little hands and faces before parents arrive and enjoy the best cookies ever!

recipes.title: Jane'S Neiman-Marcus Bars
directions: Mix together the cake mix, 1 stick butter and 2 of the eggs. Mix well and spread in an ungreased 9 x 13-inch pan.
Mix together with mixer 2 eggs, cream cheese, powdered sugar, pecans and vanilla. Gently spread over first mixture. Bake 35 minutes or until light tan at 350°.
Cut into squares. Serve with sprinkled, sifted powdered sugar or apricot jam or Cool Whip.
recipes.text: Jane'S Neiman-Marcus Bars. Mix together the cake mix, 1 stick butter and 2 of the eggs. Mix well and spread in an ungreased 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix together with mixer 2 eggs, cream cheese, powdered sugar, pecans and vanilla. Gently spread over first mixture. Bake 35 minutes or until light tan at 350°. Cut into squares. Serve with sprinkled, sifted powdered sugar or apricot jam or Cool Whip.

recipes.title: Glazed Carrots
ingredients: 1/4 c. firmly packed light brown sugar
2 Tbsp. minced fresh parsley (1 Tbsp. dried)
directions: Cover the carrots with water in a saucepan and cook until fork tender.
Drain well.
Add butter and brown sugar.
Cook until sugar dissolves and carrots are glazed. Sprinkle with parsley.
recipes.text: Glazed Carrots. Cover the carrots with water in a saucepan and cook until fork tender. Drain well. Add butter and brown sugar. Cook until sugar dissolves and carrots are glazed. Sprinkle with parsley.

recipes.title: Easy Peanut Butter Cookies
directions: Mix together.
Roll into balls and press with fork; place on cookie sheet.
Bake at 350° for 8 to 10 minutes.
recipes.text: Easy Peanut Butter Cookies. Mix together. Roll into balls and press with fork; place on cookie sheet. Bake at 350° for 8 to 10 minutes.

recipes.title: White Chocolate Candy
directions: Melt, stirring constantly over low heat, the first three ingredients.
Add Rice Krispies and peanuts.
Drop by the teaspoon on waxed paper and enjoy.
recipes.text: White Chocolate Candy. Melt, stirring constantly over low heat, the first three ingredients. Add Rice Krispies and peanuts. Drop by the teaspoon on waxed paper and enjoy.

recipes.title: Rocky Road
directions: In double boiler melt chips and butter.
Add milk and mix together.
In seperate bowl mix marshmallows and peanuts.
Pour melted chocolate mixture into peanut mixture.
Mix well.
Pour into a 9x13-inch greased pan.
Spray Pam works well.
Chill in refrigerator.
Cut into squares.
recipes.text: Rocky Road. In double boiler melt chips and butter. Add milk and mix together. In seperate bowl mix marshmallows and peanuts. Pour melted chocolate mixture into peanut mixture. Mix well. Pour into a 9x13-inch greased pan. Spray Pam works well. Chill in refrigerator. Cut into squares.

recipes.title: World Easiest Piegroves, Texas
ingredients: Prepared pie crust (regular or graham cracker)
directions: Crumble butterfingers and mix in Cool Whip.
Pour into pie crust.
Refrigerate until ready to serve.
recipes.text: World Easiest Piegroves, Texas. Crumble butterfingers and mix in Cool Whip. Pour into pie crust. Refrigerate until ready to serve.

recipes.title: Jalapeno Rice
ingredients: 1 c. green chilies or 1/2 c. jalapeno chilies
directions: Mix and bake in a greased casserole for 30 minutes in a 350° oven.
recipes.text: Jalapeno Rice. Mix and bake in a greased casserole for 30 minutes in a 350° oven.

recipes.title: Salad Bowl Puff
directions: Heat oven to 400°.
Grease 9 x 1 1/4-inch pie plate.
Heat water and margarine to rolling boil.
Stir in flour and salt.
Stir vigorously over low heat until mixture forms a ball, about 30 seconds.
Remove from heat; cool 10 minutes.
Beat in eggs all at once.
Continue to beat until smooth.
Spread dough evenly in pie plate, building up edge slightly.
Bake until puffed and dry in center, 45 to 60 minutes.
Cool.
Just before serving, fill with ham salad or tuna filling.
Cut into wedges.
recipes.text: Salad Bowl Puff. Heat oven to 400°. Grease 9 x 1 1/4-inch pie plate. Heat water and margarine to rolling boil. Stir in flour and salt. Stir vigorously over low heat until mixture forms a ball, about 30 seconds. Remove from heat; cool 10 minutes. Beat in eggs all at once. Continue to beat until smooth. Spread dough evenly in pie plate, building up edge slightly. Bake until puffed and dry in center, 45 to 60 minutes. Cool. Just before serving, fill with ham salad or tuna filling. Cut into wedges.

recipes.title: Better Than Sex Cake
ingredients: 4 oz. Borden Eagle Brand Fat Free Sweetened condensed milk
10 oz. Cool whip Free Whipped Topping
directions: Mix together cake mix, soda and egg white. Bake in a greased 9 x 13 pan for 35 to 38 minutes at 350 degrees. During the last 10 minutes of baking, heat the condensed milk and caramel in a saucepan on medium heat until well mixed. As soon as the cake is done, remove from oven and poke holes in the top and immediately pour the hot caramel sauce over the top and sprinkle with 1/2 of Heath bites. After it is completely cooled cut into squares and top with Cool Whip and the rest of the Heath bites. Keep in refrigerator.
recipes.text: Better Than Sex Cake. Mix together cake mix, soda and egg white. Bake in a greased 9 x 13 pan for 35 to 38 minutes at 350 degrees. During the last 10 minutes of baking, heat the condensed milk and caramel in a saucepan on medium heat until well mixed. As soon as the cake is done, remove from oven and poke holes in the top and immediately pour the hot caramel sauce over the top and sprinkle with 1/2 of Heath bites. After it is completely cooled cut into squares and top with Cool Whip and the rest of the Heath bites. Keep in refrigerator.

recipes.title: Cream Of Turnip Soup
directions: Cook first 4 ingredients.
Simmer 30 minutes. Stir in rest of ingredients and heat.
recipes.text: Cream Of Turnip Soup. Cook first 4 ingredients. Simmer 30 minutes. Stir in rest of ingredients and heat.

recipes.title: Meat Loaf With Pecan Stuffing
directions: Combine
beef
with
green
pepper,
onion, salt, sauce, white bread crumbs, milk and 1 egg.
Mix thoroughly.
Place 1/2 of this mixture in bottom of greased loaf pan.
Combine 1 egg, fat,
whole wheat
bread crumbs, celery, black pepper and meat stock
or water.
Add
to this chopped pecans; mix thoroughly. Spread
on top of meat mixture.
Arrange remaining meat mixture on top
of pecan
stuffing.
Bake
at 350° for 1 1/2 hours and cool slightly before removing from pan.
Serves 10.
recipes.text: Meat Loaf With Pecan Stuffing. Combine beef with green pepper, onion, salt, sauce, white bread crumbs, milk and 1 egg. Mix thoroughly. Place 1/2 of this mixture in bottom of greased loaf pan. Combine 1 egg, fat, whole wheat bread crumbs, celery, black pepper and meat stock or water. Add to this chopped pecans; mix thoroughly. Spread on top of meat mixture. Arrange remaining meat mixture on top of pecan stuffing. Bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours and cool slightly before removing from pan. Serves 10.

recipes.title: Mushroom Rice
ingredients: 1/2 c. finely chopped green onion and tops
directions: Put rice and mushrooms in 1 1/2-quart casserole.
Saute onion in butter until tender.
Add broth and salt; bring to a boil.
Pour over rice; stir well.
Cover and bake at 375° for 25 minutes or until tender.
Serves 6.
recipes.text: Mushroom Rice. Put rice and mushrooms in 1 1/2-quart casserole. Saute onion in butter until tender. Add broth and salt; bring to a boil. Pour over rice; stir well. Cover and bake at 375° for 25 minutes or until tender. Serves 6.

recipes.title: Red Beans And Rice(Low-Fat)
directions: Place water and rice in saucepan; bring to boil.
Cover and reduce to low heat for about 20 minutes.
Add remaining ingredients; return to boil.
Cover and simmer on low heat for 10 minutes.
recipes.text: Red Beans And Rice(Low-Fat). Place water and rice in saucepan; bring to boil. Cover and reduce to low heat for about 20 minutes. Add remaining ingredients; return to boil. Cover and simmer on low heat for 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Easy Refrigerator Rolls
directions: Dissolve yeast in water in mixing bowl. Add sugar, salt and half of the flour (approximately 3 1/2 cups). Beat thoroughly. Add egg and shortening.
Beat in remaining flour. Cover with damp cloth. Place in refrigerator.
Punch down occasionally.
recipes.text: Easy Refrigerator Rolls. Dissolve yeast in water in mixing bowl. Add sugar, salt and half of the flour (approximately 3 1/2 cups). Beat thoroughly. Add egg and shortening. Beat in remaining flour. Cover with damp cloth. Place in refrigerator. Punch down occasionally.

recipes.title: Broccoli Salad
ingredients: 8 slices bacon, cooked and cut up
directions: Mix all ingredients together.
Make at least 4 hours ahead or the day before.
recipes.text: Broccoli Salad. Mix all ingredients together. Make at least 4 hours ahead or the day before.

recipes.title: Caramel Brownies
directions: Mix caramels and 1/3 cup milk.
Melt over low heat.
Mix cake, 1/3 cup milk, 1 1/2 sticks Parkay and pecans.
In a lightly greased 9 x 13-inch pan, place 1/2 of cake mixture.
Bake 6 minutes at 350°.
Remove from oven.
Place chocolate chips on top, then pour the melted caramel on.
Add remaining cake mixture. Bake 16 minutes.
Remove and cool before cutting.
recipes.text: Caramel Brownies. Mix caramels and 1/3 cup milk. Melt over low heat. Mix cake, 1/3 cup milk, 1 1/2 sticks Parkay and pecans. In a lightly greased 9 x 13-inch pan, place 1/2 of cake mixture. Bake 6 minutes at 350°. Remove from oven. Place chocolate chips on top, then pour the melted caramel on. Add remaining cake mixture. Bake 16 minutes. Remove and cool before cutting.

recipes.title: Kielbasa Delight
ingredients: 2 to 3 lb. kielbasa, sliced diagonally 1-inch pieces
directions: In crock-pot, mix together last 4 ingredients. Add cut up kielbasa. Mix together and heat about 6 hours on low.
recipes.text: Kielbasa Delight. In crock-pot, mix together last 4 ingredients. Add cut up kielbasa. Mix together and heat about 6 hours on low.

recipes.title: Sweet And Sour Chicken
ingredients: 6 chicken breasts, cut in 1 inch pieces
1 or 2 green or red bell peppers, sliced
1 can drained pineapple, cut in 1 inch pieces
directions: Combine eggs with flour, garlic salt and pepper; beat with fork until blended.
Heat oil in large skillet over medium heat. Dip each piece of chicken into egg mixture; coat well.
Drop pieces one at a time into hot oil.
Cook until golden brown on all sides; remove to paper towel to drain.
Pour off all but 1 tablespoon of oil.
Dissolve chicken bouillon cubes in 2 cups boiling water.
Add 1/3 of chicken broth and chicken pieces together in skillet.
Add pineapple and green peppers; cover and cook on low heat for 10 minutes.
Blend together cornstarch, soy sauce, vinegar, sugar and remaining chicken broth; mix well and add to meat.
Cook about 15 minutes or until chicken is done and broth is thickened.
Serve over rice.
Serves 6.
recipes.text: Sweet And Sour Chicken. Combine eggs with flour, garlic salt and pepper; beat with fork until blended. Heat oil in large skillet over medium heat. Dip each piece of chicken into egg mixture; coat well. Drop pieces one at a time into hot oil. Cook until golden brown on all sides; remove to paper towel to drain. Pour off all but 1 tablespoon of oil. Dissolve chicken bouillon cubes in 2 cups boiling water. Add 1/3 of chicken broth and chicken pieces together in skillet. Add pineapple and green peppers; cover and cook on low heat for 10 minutes. Blend together cornstarch, soy sauce, vinegar, sugar and remaining chicken broth; mix well and add to meat. Cook about 15 minutes or until chicken is done and broth is thickened. Serve over rice. Serves 6.

recipes.title: Miracle Whip Cake
directions: Sift together the flour and cocoa. Dissolve the baking soda in 1 c. hot water.
recipes.text: Miracle Whip Cake. Sift together the flour and cocoa. Dissolve the baking soda in 1 c. hot water.

recipes.title: Pecadillo
directions: Brown meat in skillet.
Add garlic and onion until transparent. Drain grease.
Add tomatoes, green pepper and raisins.
Season to taste.
Cook 10 minutes.
Add almonds and olives.
Serve over rice.
recipes.text: Pecadillo. Brown meat in skillet. Add garlic and onion until transparent. Drain grease. Add tomatoes, green pepper and raisins. Season to taste. Cook 10 minutes. Add almonds and olives. Serve over rice.

recipes.title: Baked Beans
directions: Mix all ingredients. Pour into a casserole dish. Cover. Bake for 1 hour at 350 degrees.
recipes.text: Baked Beans. Mix all ingredients. Pour into a casserole dish. Cover. Bake for 1 hour at 350 degrees.

recipes.title: Quick Potato Soup
directions: Total cooking time:
4 minutes, 30 seconds.
recipes.text: Quick Potato Soup. Total cooking time: 4 minutes, 30 seconds.

recipes.title: Savannah Spiced Peaches
directions: Drain peaches, reserving 3/4 cup syrup.
Heat together syrup, vinegar and spices; simmer 10 minutes.
Add peaches; cook an additional 5 minutes.
Remove peaches; strain liquid to remove spices.
Return peaches to liquid.
Serve warm, topped with whipped cream cheese.
Makes 4 to 6 servings.
recipes.text: Savannah Spiced Peaches. Drain peaches, reserving 3/4 cup syrup. Heat together syrup, vinegar and spices; simmer 10 minutes. Add peaches; cook an additional 5 minutes. Remove peaches; strain liquid to remove spices. Return peaches to liquid. Serve warm, topped with whipped cream cheese. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

recipes.title: Noodles And Cheese
directions: Boil water for noodles.
Cook 5 to 6 minutes.
Drain and put noodles in a bowl.
recipes.text: Noodles And Cheese. Boil water for noodles. Cook 5 to 6 minutes. Drain and put noodles in a bowl.

recipes.title: Green Tomato Jello Jelly
directions: Mix tomatoes and sugar together.
Cook 15 minutes.
Stir in Jell-O.
Put in clean, sterilized jars.
Seal.
Yields 2 pints.
recipes.text: Green Tomato Jello Jelly. Mix tomatoes and sugar together. Cook 15 minutes. Stir in Jell-O. Put in clean, sterilized jars. Seal. Yields 2 pints.

recipes.title: Ritz Cracker Chicken
ingredients: 1/4 to 1/2 c. stick butter or margarine, melted
directions: Line cookie sheet with foil.
Dip chicken in butter; roll in cracker crumbs.
Place pieces on foil; cover with another piece of foil and seal edges.
Bake at 400° for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Ritz Cracker Chicken. Line cookie sheet with foil. Dip chicken in butter; roll in cracker crumbs. Place pieces on foil; cover with another piece of foil and seal edges. Bake at 400° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Wacky Cake
directions: Mix flour, sugar, cocoa, soda and salt.
Add oil, vanilla and water.
Add vinegar last.
Bake at 350° for 35 minutes.
recipes.text: Wacky Cake. Mix flour, sugar, cocoa, soda and salt. Add oil, vanilla and water. Add vinegar last. Bake at 350° for 35 minutes.

recipes.title: Evergreen Punch
directions: Combine sugar, water, Kool-Aid and pineapple juice; chill. When ready to serve, add ginger ale and peppermint extract.
Makes 36 1/2 cup servings.
recipes.text: Evergreen Punch. Combine sugar, water, Kool-Aid and pineapple juice; chill. When ready to serve, add ginger ale and peppermint extract. Makes 36 1/2 cup servings.

recipes.title: Sour Cream Meatballs
directions: Mix together all ingredients.
Roll into meatballs and bake on cookie sheet for 10 to 15 minutes at 350°.
Cool.
Prepare gravy and pour over meatballs.
Serve in crock-pot or other heated container.
recipes.text: Sour Cream Meatballs. Mix together all ingredients. Roll into meatballs and bake on cookie sheet for 10 to 15 minutes at 350°. Cool. Prepare gravy and pour over meatballs. Serve in crock-pot or other heated container.

recipes.title: Grilled Potato Wedges
ingredients: 4 medium potatoes, scrubbed and quartered lengthwise
directions: Heat grill. In a bowl, combine all above ingredients and mix until well coated. Place on grill and turn over every 7 minutes. Move to center of grill each turn. Grill for 20 minutes of until tender with knife.
recipes.text: Grilled Potato Wedges. Heat grill. In a bowl, combine all above ingredients and mix until well coated. Place on grill and turn over every 7 minutes. Move to center of grill each turn. Grill for 20 minutes of until tender with knife.

recipes.title: Peanut Clusters
directions: Melt butterscotch and chocolate morsels.
Remove from heat. Add peanut butter, marshmallows and nuts; stir.
Drop by tablespoon onto waxed paper.
Place in refrigerator to harden. Store in a cool place in sealed container.
recipes.text: Peanut Clusters. Melt butterscotch and chocolate morsels. Remove from heat. Add peanut butter, marshmallows and nuts; stir. Drop by tablespoon onto waxed paper. Place in refrigerator to harden. Store in a cool place in sealed container.

recipes.title: Curry Spiced Rice
directions: In 3-quart casserole dish, combine onion and butter.
Cover with heavy-duty plastic wrap; microwave on High for 3 minutes. Stir in remaining ingredients; cover and microwave on High for 5 minutes.
Stir well.
Cover and microwave for another 20 minutes or until all liquid is absorbed.
Let stand 4 to 5 minutes.
Makes 6 servings.
recipes.text: Curry Spiced Rice. In 3-quart casserole dish, combine onion and butter. Cover with heavy-duty plastic wrap; microwave on High for 3 minutes. Stir in remaining ingredients; cover and microwave on High for 5 minutes. Stir well. Cover and microwave for another 20 minutes or until all liquid is absorbed. Let stand 4 to 5 minutes. Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Sour Cream Blueberry Muffins
directions: Cream the butter and sugar.
Add and blend in the eggs and vanilla.
Sift the flour, baking powder, soda and salt.
Add alternately with sour cream to the first mixture.
Add the blueberries last.
Bake in a 350° oven for 25 minutes.
Yields 24.
recipes.text: Sour Cream Blueberry Muffins. Cream the butter and sugar. Add and blend in the eggs and vanilla. Sift the flour, baking powder, soda and salt. Add alternately with sour cream to the first mixture. Add the blueberries last. Bake in a 350° oven for 25 minutes. Yields 24.

recipes.title: Turkey Fruit Salad
directions: Combine all ingredients.
Mix well.
Cover and chill for 2 to 3 hours.
Serve on a bed of lettuce with cantaloupe halves.
recipes.text: Turkey Fruit Salad. Combine all ingredients. Mix well. Cover and chill for 2 to 3 hours. Serve on a bed of lettuce with cantaloupe halves.

recipes.title: Cheese Ball
ingredients: 2 (8 oz.) pkg. cream cheese, softened (Healthy Choice fat free)
1 can Premium white chunk chicken, chopped up and drained
directions: Mix cream cheese, chicken and pineapple together well.
Be sure to drain chicken and pineapple well.
Roll in crushed pecans.
recipes.text: Cheese Ball. Mix cream cheese, chicken and pineapple together well. Be sure to drain chicken and pineapple well. Roll in crushed pecans.

recipes.title: Southern Chocolate Pecan Pie
directions: Melt butter and chocolate in double boiler; add sugar and salt and stir.
Add 3 beaten eggs, syrup and vanilla. Mix in pecans. Pour into pie shell; bake at 350° for 55 minutes or until set and browned.
recipes.text: Southern Chocolate Pecan Pie. Melt butter and chocolate in double boiler; add sugar and salt and stir. Add 3 beaten eggs, syrup and vanilla. Mix in pecans. Pour into pie shell; bake at 350° for 55 minutes or until set and browned.

recipes.title: Chestnut Chicken Casserole
ingredients: 2 c. chicken, cooked and cut in chunks
1 c. celery, cooked 1 minute in microwave
directions: Line a 3-quart casserole dish with 3 cups of cooked broccoli. Mix remaining ingredients and spread on top of broccoli.
Top with 1 cup crushed corn flakes and drizzle with 1/2 cup melted butter. Bake at 350° for 50 minutes in preheated oven.
recipes.text: Chestnut Chicken Casserole. Line a 3-quart casserole dish with 3 cups of cooked broccoli. Mix remaining ingredients and spread on top of broccoli. Top with 1 cup crushed corn flakes and drizzle with 1/2 cup melted butter. Bake at 350° for 50 minutes in preheated oven.

recipes.title: Jezebel Sauce
directions: Combine all ingredients; stir well.
Pour sauce into airtight container.
Store in refrigerator.
Serve sauce over cream cheese with cheese dough, or with pork or beef.
recipes.text: Jezebel Sauce. Combine all ingredients; stir well. Pour sauce into airtight container. Store in refrigerator. Serve sauce over cream cheese with cheese dough, or with pork or beef.

recipes.title: Buttermilk Pound Cake
directions: Cream butter and sugar.
Add eggs, one at a time.
Add soda and vanilla.
Add flour alternately with buttermilk.
Bake in greased and floured tube pan at 350° for one hour (or a little less, depending on your oven).
recipes.text: Buttermilk Pound Cake. Cream butter and sugar. Add eggs, one at a time. Add soda and vanilla. Add flour alternately with buttermilk. Bake in greased and floured tube pan at 350° for one hour (or a little less, depending on your oven).

recipes.title: Vegetable Pizza
directions: Spread crescent rolls in an 11 x 17-inch jelly roll pan. Brown 15 minutes at 350°.
Cool.
Mix the mayonnaise, sour cream, cream cheese and dry Ranch dressing; smooth over cool crust.
Top with chopped vegetables.
Press vegetables down.
Wrap in foil for 3 hours before serving.
recipes.text: Vegetable Pizza. Spread crescent rolls in an 11 x 17-inch jelly roll pan. Brown 15 minutes at 350°. Cool. Mix the mayonnaise, sour cream, cream cheese and dry Ranch dressing; smooth over cool crust. Top with chopped vegetables. Press vegetables down. Wrap in foil for 3 hours before serving.

recipes.title: Enchilada Casserole
directions: Preheat oven to 350°.
Saute onion, garlic, pepper and mushrooms until onion is transparent.
Add tomato sauce, chili powder and beans.
Heat through.
Stir yogurt and cottage cheese together.
recipes.text: Enchilada Casserole. Preheat oven to 350°. Saute onion, garlic, pepper and mushrooms until onion is transparent. Add tomato sauce, chili powder and beans. Heat through. Stir yogurt and cottage cheese together.

recipes.title: Very Berry Punch
directions: Combine first six ingredients.
Before serving, add 7-Up, Vichy water and ice in large punch bowl.
Yields 1 gallon.
recipes.text: Very Berry Punch. Combine first six ingredients. Before serving, add 7-Up, Vichy water and ice in large punch bowl. Yields 1 gallon.

recipes.title: Steak Sticks
directions: Cut steak into 6 to 8-inch strips.
Wrap each with bacon and fasten with toothpick.
Stir together mustard, juice and sugar. Brush over sticks.
Grill over hot coals about 10 minutes, turning frequently and brushing with mixture.
Remove picks and serve on toasted rolls.
recipes.text: Steak Sticks. Cut steak into 6 to 8-inch strips. Wrap each with bacon and fasten with toothpick. Stir together mustard, juice and sugar. Brush over sticks. Grill over hot coals about 10 minutes, turning frequently and brushing with mixture. Remove picks and serve on toasted rolls.

recipes.title: Pennsylvania Dutch Apple Butter
directions: Quarter unpeeled apples.
Boil until soft.
Put through strainer.
Discard skins and seeds.
Combine apples with cider and sugar.
Bring to a boil.
Simmer until thickened, stirring often. Add spices and continue simmering until of spreading consistency (2 to 3 hours).
Spoon into sterilized jars.
Yields 2 quarts.
recipes.text: Pennsylvania Dutch Apple Butter. Quarter unpeeled apples. Boil until soft. Put through strainer. Discard skins and seeds. Combine apples with cider and sugar. Bring to a boil. Simmer until thickened, stirring often. Add spices and continue simmering until of spreading consistency (2 to 3 hours). Spoon into sterilized jars. Yields 2 quarts.

recipes.title: Play Dough
directions: Mix all ingredients.
Add food coloring to make different colors.
recipes.text: Play Dough. Mix all ingredients. Add food coloring to make different colors.

recipes.title: Eggplant Casserole
directions: Peel, slice and soak eggplant in salt water overnight; drain well.
Soak bread crumbs in evaporated milk.
Saute remaining ingredients.
Combine all ingredients and pour into a casserole dish.
Top with grated Cheddar cheese.
Bake at 350° until done.
recipes.text: Eggplant Casserole. Peel, slice and soak eggplant in salt water overnight; drain well. Soak bread crumbs in evaporated milk. Saute remaining ingredients. Combine all ingredients and pour into a casserole dish. Top with grated Cheddar cheese. Bake at 350° until done.

recipes.title: Pasta Salad
ingredients: 1 pkg. Good Seasons Italian salad dressing mix
directions: Add more dressing, if needed.
Chill again.
Toss and serve.
recipes.text: Pasta Salad. Add more dressing, if needed. Chill again. Toss and serve.

recipes.title: Kool-Aid Pie
directions: Mix Kool-Aid with milk and Cool Whip in bowl.
Mix well.
Pour into pie shell.
Chill about 1 1/2 hours.
recipes.text: Kool-Aid Pie. Mix Kool-Aid with milk and Cool Whip in bowl. Mix well. Pour into pie shell. Chill about 1 1/2 hours.

recipes.title: Apple Fritters
directions: Combine all ingredients together.
Add apples.
Drop large spoonfulls into hot oil.
Fry until brown on both sides.
Remove and coat in sugar.
recipes.text: Apple Fritters. Combine all ingredients together. Add apples. Drop large spoonfulls into hot oil. Fry until brown on both sides. Remove and coat in sugar.

recipes.title: Turtle Cake
directions: Prepare cake mix according to package directions.
Pour 1/2 batter into greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan.
Bake 15 minutes at 350°.
Melt together margarine, evaporated milk and caramels. Pour over baked cake layer.
Sprinkle nuts and chocolate chips over caramel layer.
Pour remaining batter over top.
Bake at 350° for 20 minutes or until done.
Let cool.
Frost with Pillsbury's coconut pecan frosting.
recipes.text: Turtle Cake. Prepare cake mix according to package directions. Pour 1/2 batter into greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake 15 minutes at 350°. Melt together margarine, evaporated milk and caramels. Pour over baked cake layer. Sprinkle nuts and chocolate chips over caramel layer. Pour remaining batter over top. Bake at 350° for 20 minutes or until done. Let cool. Frost with Pillsbury's coconut pecan frosting.

recipes.title: Strawberry Pie
directions: Fill baked pie shell with fresh strawberries sliced in half. Mix water and cornstarch together.
Cook mashed strawberries and sugar.
Slowly add the cornstarch mixture to mashed strawberries and cook until thick.
Add lemon juice.
While still hot, pour over strawberries in pie shell.
Chill and top with whipped cream.
recipes.text: Strawberry Pie. Fill baked pie shell with fresh strawberries sliced in half. Mix water and cornstarch together. Cook mashed strawberries and sugar. Slowly add the cornstarch mixture to mashed strawberries and cook until thick. Add lemon juice. While still hot, pour over strawberries in pie shell. Chill and top with whipped cream.

recipes.title: Moxie Berry Pie
directions: Mix together Jell-O, salt, cornstarch, sugar and water.
Cook 5 minutes after bubbling.
Put berries in pie shell.
Pour sauce over berries.
Refrigerate a few hours.
Top with whipped cream.
recipes.text: Moxie Berry Pie. Mix together Jell-O, salt, cornstarch, sugar and water. Cook 5 minutes after bubbling. Put berries in pie shell. Pour sauce over berries. Refrigerate a few hours. Top with whipped cream.

recipes.title: Betty'S Strawberry Ice Cream
directions: Beat eggs until white.
Beat in sugar.
Add remaining ingredients and pour into ice cream freezer.
Add milk to fill line in ice cream freezer.
Freeze in ice cream freezer.
recipes.text: Betty'S Strawberry Ice Cream. Beat eggs until white. Beat in sugar. Add remaining ingredients and pour into ice cream freezer. Add milk to fill line in ice cream freezer. Freeze in ice cream freezer.

recipes.title: Puppy Chow
directions: Melt chocolate chips and peanut butter in microwave-safe container 20 seconds at a time until well mixed. Pour mixture over Chex, mixing until all cereal is well coated. Pour 1/2 of powdered sugar in large freezer bag with half of the cereal mixture. Shake until well-coated. Repeat with other half sugar and cereal mixture. Place in colander to remove excess sugar. Enjoy!
recipes.text: Puppy Chow. Melt chocolate chips and peanut butter in microwave-safe container 20 seconds at a time until well mixed. Pour mixture over Chex, mixing until all cereal is well coated. Pour 1/2 of powdered sugar in large freezer bag with half of the cereal mixture. Shake until well-coated. Repeat with other half sugar and cereal mixture. Place in colander to remove excess sugar. Enjoy!

recipes.title: Garbanzo Bean Soup
directions: About 20 minutes before serving, slice green onions.
Reserve 1 tablespoon green onions for garnish.
In a 4-quart saucepan, over medium heat in hot butter, cook remaining green onions until tender.
recipes.text: Garbanzo Bean Soup. About 20 minutes before serving, slice green onions. Reserve 1 tablespoon green onions for garnish. In a 4-quart saucepan, over medium heat in hot butter, cook remaining green onions until tender.

recipes.title: Pie Crust
directions: Mix flour and salt; cut in shortening.
In separate bowl combine egg, water and vinegar.
Add to flour all at once.
Blend with spoon until flour is all moistened.
Will keep refrigerated for several days.
For single pie shell, roll out and form in pie plate.
Bake at 425° for 12 to 15 minutes.
recipes.text: Pie Crust. Mix flour and salt; cut in shortening. In separate bowl combine egg, water and vinegar. Add to flour all at once. Blend with spoon until flour is all moistened. Will keep refrigerated for several days. For single pie shell, roll out and form in pie plate. Bake at 425° for 12 to 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Cake Like Banana Bread
directions: Sift the flour, sugar, salt and baking soda. Blend in the shortening, bananas and eggs or egg whites.
Fold together quickly and do not overmix. Spoon or pour into greased and floured pan. Bake at 350° for 45 to 50 minutes.
Let stand 5 minutes.
Loosen edges and cool on rack or cool completely in pan. Glaze with confectioners sugar and water mix.
recipes.text: Cake Like Banana Bread. Sift the flour, sugar, salt and baking soda. Blend in the shortening, bananas and eggs or egg whites. Fold together quickly and do not overmix. Spoon or pour into greased and floured pan. Bake at 350° for 45 to 50 minutes. Let stand 5 minutes. Loosen edges and cool on rack or cool completely in pan. Glaze with confectioners sugar and water mix.

recipes.title: Squash Casserole
directions: Boil squash until tender; drain well.
Add all ingredients except crackers and margarine.
Pour into greased casserole.
Top with cracker crumbs.
Pour melted margarine over top.
Bake 20 minutes or until brown and crusty at 350°.
recipes.text: Squash Casserole. Boil squash until tender; drain well. Add all ingredients except crackers and margarine. Pour into greased casserole. Top with cracker crumbs. Pour melted margarine over top. Bake 20 minutes or until brown and crusty at 350°.

recipes.title: Spiced Tea
directions: Combine all ingredients and store in tightly covered container.
For each serving use heaping teaspoon per cup of boiling water.
Stir until dissolved.
recipes.text: Spiced Tea. Combine all ingredients and store in tightly covered container. For each serving use heaping teaspoon per cup of boiling water. Stir until dissolved.

recipes.title: Coffee Egg Nog Punch
ingredients: 2 (32 oz.) cans Borden egg nog, chilled
1/4 c. firmly packed light brown sugar
directions: In large mixer bowl, combine egg nog, brown sugar, coffee and cinnamon; beat on low speed until sugar and coffee are dissolved. Stir in coffee, liqueur and bourbon (if desired); chill.
In small mixer bowl, beat cream with confectioners sugar and vanilla until stiff.
Pour egg nog into punch bowl; top with whipped cream and cinnamon.
Refrigerate leftovers.
recipes.text: Coffee Egg Nog Punch. In large mixer bowl, combine egg nog, brown sugar, coffee and cinnamon; beat on low speed until sugar and coffee are dissolved. Stir in coffee, liqueur and bourbon (if desired); chill. In small mixer bowl, beat cream with confectioners sugar and vanilla until stiff. Pour egg nog into punch bowl; top with whipped cream and cinnamon. Refrigerate leftovers.

recipes.title: Broccoli Rice Casserole
directions: In a large skillet over medium heat, saute onion, celery and broccoli in butter or margarine for 3 to 5 minutes.
Stir in soup, milk and cheese spread until smooth.
Pour rice in a greased casserole dish and pour cheese mixture over rice but do not stir. Bake uncovered at 325° for 25 to 30 minutes until hot and bubbly.
recipes.text: Broccoli Rice Casserole. In a large skillet over medium heat, saute onion, celery and broccoli in butter or margarine for 3 to 5 minutes. Stir in soup, milk and cheese spread until smooth. Pour rice in a greased casserole dish and pour cheese mixture over rice but do not stir. Bake uncovered at 325° for 25 to 30 minutes until hot and bubbly.

recipes.title: Gnocchi
directions: Boil unpeeled potatoes in water until tender.
Drain and peel. Put through ricer or mash until very smooth.
Heap the potatoes on a board; add half the flour and make a well in the center.
Drop in the egg and knead mixture into a smooth firm dough.
Coat board and hands with flour.
Break dough into large pieces and, using the palms of your hands, roll into a 3/8-inch snake.
Cut into 1 1/4-inch pieces and gently roll over the prongs of a fork, pressing lightly with your thumb to make the characteristic ridges.
They will curl a little.
When complete, drop a few at a time in boiling, salted water.
When they rise to the surface (about 3 minutes), they are done.
Lift out with slotted spoon and place on a heated platter.
When all are cooked, top with your favorite good spaghetti sauce and grated cheese.
recipes.text: Gnocchi. Boil unpeeled potatoes in water until tender. Drain and peel. Put through ricer or mash until very smooth. Heap the potatoes on a board; add half the flour and make a well in the center. Drop in the egg and knead mixture into a smooth firm dough. Coat board and hands with flour. Break dough into large pieces and, using the palms of your hands, roll into a 3/8-inch snake. Cut into 1 1/4-inch pieces and gently roll over the prongs of a fork, pressing lightly with your thumb to make the characteristic ridges. They will curl a little. When complete, drop a few at a time in boiling, salted water. When they rise to the surface (about 3 minutes), they are done. Lift out with slotted spoon and place on a heated platter. When all are cooked, top with your favorite good spaghetti sauce and grated cheese.

recipes.title: Pineapple Party Salad
directions: Drain syrup from pineapple; add enough water to syrup to make 2 cups.
Heat to boiling point; dissolve lemon and lime gelatin in boiling liquid.
Add salt.
Cool until slightly thickened.
When beginning to congeal, fold in cottage cheese, mayonnaise, crushed pineapple and nuts.
Pour into mold or Pyrex dish.
Place in refrigerator to chill and set.
Serve on lettuce leaf.
Serves 10 to 12.
recipes.text: Pineapple Party Salad. Drain syrup from pineapple; add enough water to syrup to make 2 cups. Heat to boiling point; dissolve lemon and lime gelatin in boiling liquid. Add salt. Cool until slightly thickened. When beginning to congeal, fold in cottage cheese, mayonnaise, crushed pineapple and nuts. Pour into mold or Pyrex dish. Place in refrigerator to chill and set. Serve on lettuce leaf. Serves 10 to 12.

recipes.title: Diet Stew
ingredients: 1 qt. tomatoes or 1 1/2 c. tomato juice
directions: Brown and drain beef.
Add all ingredients except Worcestershire sauce.
Simmer until well done.
Add Worcestershire sauce.
recipes.text: Diet Stew. Brown and drain beef. Add all ingredients except Worcestershire sauce. Simmer until well done. Add Worcestershire sauce.

recipes.title: Vegetable Beef And Biscuit Casserole
ingredients: 1 can Campbell's tomato soup (1/3 less salt)
1 (15 oz.) can Veg-All mixed vegetables, drained
directions: In 10-inch skillet over medium-high heat, cook ground meat until browned, stirring to separate meat.
Spoon off fat.
Stir in soups, water, mixed vegetables and Worcestershire sauce.
Spoon into 3-quart baking dish.
Bake at 400° for 10 minutes or until hot and bubbling.
recipes.text: Vegetable Beef And Biscuit Casserole. In 10-inch skillet over medium-high heat, cook ground meat until browned, stirring to separate meat. Spoon off fat. Stir in soups, water, mixed vegetables and Worcestershire sauce. Spoon into 3-quart baking dish. Bake at 400° for 10 minutes or until hot and bubbling.

recipes.title: Blonde Brownies
directions: Combine the first eight ingredients.
Blend well.
Chocolate chips may be sprinkled on top.
Bake in greased and floured 9 x 9-inch pan at 350° for 25 minutes.
recipes.text: Blonde Brownies. Combine the first eight ingredients. Blend well. Chocolate chips may be sprinkled on top. Bake in greased and floured 9 x 9-inch pan at 350° for 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Salsa Dip
directions: Mix all ingredients together.
recipes.text: Salsa Dip. Mix all ingredients together.

recipes.title: Crab Cakes
ingredients: 1 1/2 tsp. Old Bay seasoning (you may adjust this amount)
directions: Mix well and make into cakes.
Pat with cracker dust and fry in hot oil.
recipes.text: Crab Cakes. Mix well and make into cakes. Pat with cracker dust and fry in hot oil.

recipes.title: "Preacher'S" Chili
ingredients: 4 to 6 (15 oz.) cans red kidney beans
directions: Cut up bacon in small pieces and brown with hamburger, onion and green pepper.
Add all other ingredients.
Will probably need about 2 cups of water.
Use heavy pot to keep from scorching. Start on medium-high heat, stirring often for 15 or 20 minutes, then on low heat to simmer.
Then, hope for the best, or better yet, pray for the best!
recipes.text: "Preacher'S" Chili. Cut up bacon in small pieces and brown with hamburger, onion and green pepper. Add all other ingredients. Will probably need about 2 cups of water. Use heavy pot to keep from scorching. Start on medium-high heat, stirring often for 15 or 20 minutes, then on low heat to simmer. Then, hope for the best, or better yet, pray for the best!

recipes.title: Frozen Cranberry Salad
directions: Mix all ingredients together.
Spoon into foil cupcake liners in muffin pans or cake pan.
Freeze until firm.
Remove from freezer 20 to 30 minutes before serving.
recipes.text: Frozen Cranberry Salad. Mix all ingredients together. Spoon into foil cupcake liners in muffin pans or cake pan. Freeze until firm. Remove from freezer 20 to 30 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Ham And Noodle Casserole
directions: Dice ham, cheese and green pepper.
Add uncooked noodles and rest of ingredients.
Pour into greased casserole.
Bake 1 hour at 350°.
recipes.text: Ham And Noodle Casserole. Dice ham, cheese and green pepper. Add uncooked noodles and rest of ingredients. Pour into greased casserole. Bake 1 hour at 350°.

recipes.title: Crock-Pot Pork Chops
directions: Season pork chops and batter in flour.
Fry in grease until both sides are brown.
Place 4 to 5 browned pork chops in 1/4 cup water in crock-pot.
Add 1 can cream of celery soup, 1/2 of chopped onion, 1/4 cup celery and 1/4 cup bell pepper.
Repeat with remaining ingredients, adding the Cheddar cheese soup to the top of mixture.
Cover and cook on high 5 to 6 hours.
Cook on low heat if cooking chops overnight.
The chops will fall away from the bone when done.
recipes.text: Crock-Pot Pork Chops. Season pork chops and batter in flour. Fry in grease until both sides are brown. Place 4 to 5 browned pork chops in 1/4 cup water in crock-pot. Add 1 can cream of celery soup, 1/2 of chopped onion, 1/4 cup celery and 1/4 cup bell pepper. Repeat with remaining ingredients, adding the Cheddar cheese soup to the top of mixture. Cover and cook on high 5 to 6 hours. Cook on low heat if cooking chops overnight. The chops will fall away from the bone when done.

recipes.title: Garden Vegetable Spread
ingredients: 1 c. shredded crunchy veggies (celery, carrots, onions, zucchini)
directions: Combine all ingredients.
Chill at least 1 hour.
Serve on party bread or celery stalks.
recipes.text: Garden Vegetable Spread. Combine all ingredients. Chill at least 1 hour. Serve on party bread or celery stalks.

recipes.title: Scotch Chocolate Cake
directions: Bring butter, cocoa, oil and water to a boil.
Add to flour and sugar, the salt, soda and buttermilk.
Add hot mixture to this mixture.
Bake 25 minutes at 375°.
Have frosting made when cake comes out of the oven.
Pour over hot cake.
recipes.text: Scotch Chocolate Cake. Bring butter, cocoa, oil and water to a boil. Add to flour and sugar, the salt, soda and buttermilk. Add hot mixture to this mixture. Bake 25 minutes at 375°. Have frosting made when cake comes out of the oven. Pour over hot cake.

recipes.title: Potato Hors D'Oeuvres
directions: Wash potatoes and steam until fork-tender.
Cut off a thin slice on the bottom of each potato to allow it to sit without rolling.
Cut off a thin slice on top of each potato and scoop out the inside "meat" of the potato.
Reserve the inside of the potato.
Poach the mushrooms in a saucepan with the dill, parsley, apple juice and lemon juice for 5 minutes.
Pour off liquid.
Put mushrooms and potato "meat" in blender and chop until fine.
Stuff potato skins with mushroom filling.
Sprinkle with cheese. Refrigerate until ready to serve.
Bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes.
Serve warm.
recipes.text: Potato Hors D'Oeuvres. Wash potatoes and steam until fork-tender. Cut off a thin slice on the bottom of each potato to allow it to sit without rolling. Cut off a thin slice on top of each potato and scoop out the inside "meat" of the potato. Reserve the inside of the potato. Poach the mushrooms in a saucepan with the dill, parsley, apple juice and lemon juice for 5 minutes. Pour off liquid. Put mushrooms and potato "meat" in blender and chop until fine. Stuff potato skins with mushroom filling. Sprinkle with cheese. Refrigerate until ready to serve. Bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes. Serve warm.

recipes.title: Bert Diamond'S Mandel Broit
ingredients: 1/3 additional c. sugar (to be combined with up to 1/3 c. cinnamon)
directions: Beat eggs with fork, adding sugar, vanilla and salt.
Mix baking powder into one of the cups of flour.
Then combine with rest of flour.
Alternate flour and oil into eggs and sugar mixture.
Place bowl of dough in refrigerator for 2 hours.
Using flour to handle dough, cut dough into 4 sections.
Stretch and shape each section until it is about 8-inches long.
Sprinkle cinnamon-sugar mixture over each loaf.
Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.
Take out; cut in diagonal strips.
Turn sideways; put back for 10 minutes, then turn on other side for 10 minutes more.
recipes.text: Bert Diamond'S Mandel Broit. Beat eggs with fork, adding sugar, vanilla and salt. Mix baking powder into one of the cups of flour. Then combine with rest of flour. Alternate flour and oil into eggs and sugar mixture. Place bowl of dough in refrigerator for 2 hours. Using flour to handle dough, cut dough into 4 sections. Stretch and shape each section until it is about 8-inches long. Sprinkle cinnamon-sugar mixture over each loaf. Bake at 350° for 25 minutes. Take out; cut in diagonal strips. Turn sideways; put back for 10 minutes, then turn on other side for 10 minutes more.

recipes.title: Coconut Raisin Pie
directions: Mix all together.
Pour into pie shell.
Bake at 350° or until knife inserted comes out clean.
recipes.text: Coconut Raisin Pie. Mix all together. Pour into pie shell. Bake at 350° or until knife inserted comes out clean.

recipes.title: Lemon-Sugar Crepes
directions: From lemons grate 1/2 teaspoon peel and squeeze 3/4 cup juice.
Cover and refrigerate.
In blender at medium speed, mix eggs, milk, flour, salt, lemon peel and 2 tablespoons melted butter until smooth.
Transfer to medium bowl; cover and refrigerate at least 1 hour or overnight.
Whisk batter before using.
recipes.text: Lemon-Sugar Crepes. From lemons grate 1/2 teaspoon peel and squeeze 3/4 cup juice. Cover and refrigerate. In blender at medium speed, mix eggs, milk, flour, salt, lemon peel and 2 tablespoons melted butter until smooth. Transfer to medium bowl; cover and refrigerate at least 1 hour or overnight. Whisk batter before using.

recipes.title: Gone-All-Day Stew
ingredients: 2 lb. beef chuck, cut into 1 to 2 inch cubes
3 medium carrots, cut in 1 inch slices
directions: Mix together soup, water/wine and flour until smooth.
Combine with remaining ingredients in covered roasting pan.
Bake at 275° for 4 to 5 hours.
When ready to serve, adjust seasoning.
Serve over noodles or rice or with crunchy French bread.
Serves 8.
recipes.text: Gone-All-Day Stew. Mix together soup, water/wine and flour until smooth. Combine with remaining ingredients in covered roasting pan. Bake at 275° for 4 to 5 hours. When ready to serve, adjust seasoning. Serve over noodles or rice or with crunchy French bread. Serves 8.

recipes.title: Meat Loaf
directions: Mix all together and put into loaf pan.
Bake 45 minutes to 1 hour.
recipes.text: Meat Loaf. Mix all together and put into loaf pan. Bake 45 minutes to 1 hour.

recipes.title: Ora Avant'S Cranberry Salad
ingredients: 1 small can or 1/2 large can crushed pineapple
1 peeled orange, cut into small bits
1 to 2 Tbsp. lemon juice or apple cider vinegar (to taste for tartness)
directions: Mix Jell-O and boiling water to dissolve.
Mix plain gelatin with cold water.
Add plain gelatin to hot gelatin; stir to dissolve.
Stir all ingredients into Jell-O mixture.
Chill in refrigerator until set or firm.
May also add chopped apple and nuts to this.
recipes.text: Ora Avant'S Cranberry Salad. Mix Jell-O and boiling water to dissolve. Mix plain gelatin with cold water. Add plain gelatin to hot gelatin; stir to dissolve. Stir all ingredients into Jell-O mixture. Chill in refrigerator until set or firm. May also add chopped apple and nuts to this.

recipes.title: Banana Bread
directions: Mix butter and sugar until creamy, add eggs one at a time. Add vanilla, flour, baking soda and salt. Mix until incorporated, but careful not to over-mix. Stir in mashed banana and sour cream. Pour into greased bread pan and bake in preheated 350° oven for 50 to 55 minutes, or until toothpick in the center of the loaf comes out clean.
recipes.text: Banana Bread. Mix butter and sugar until creamy, add eggs one at a time. Add vanilla, flour, baking soda and salt. Mix until incorporated, but careful not to over-mix. Stir in mashed banana and sour cream. Pour into greased bread pan and bake in preheated 350° oven for 50 to 55 minutes, or until toothpick in the center of the loaf comes out clean.

recipes.title: Hot Rice Cakes With Turkey
directions: Preheat broiler. On stove, spray pan with Pam.
Heat over medium heat for 1 minute.
Add turkey, cumin and garlic; cook through about 2 to 3 minutes.
Spoon turkey onto rice cakes, top with remaining ingredients.
Broil for 2 minutes.
recipes.text: Hot Rice Cakes With Turkey. Preheat broiler. On stove, spray pan with Pam. Heat over medium heat for 1 minute. Add turkey, cumin and garlic; cook through about 2 to 3 minutes. Spoon turkey onto rice cakes, top with remaining ingredients. Broil for 2 minutes.

recipes.title: Alfredo Lite
directions: Prepare pasta according to package direction; drain.
Melt butter or margarine in saucepan over medium heat.
Add garlic and scallions.
Add flour and stir constantly until paste is formed. Add egg substitute and milk, stirring constantly.
Cook, stirring, until mixture thickens slightly.
Toss mixture with pasta in a large bowl.
Stir in grated cheese, salt and pepper; garnish with parsley and sage, if desired.
Serves 6.
recipes.text: Alfredo Lite. Prepare pasta according to package direction; drain. Melt butter or margarine in saucepan over medium heat. Add garlic and scallions. Add flour and stir constantly until paste is formed. Add egg substitute and milk, stirring constantly. Cook, stirring, until mixture thickens slightly. Toss mixture with pasta in a large bowl. Stir in grated cheese, salt and pepper; garnish with parsley and sage, if desired. Serves 6.

recipes.title: Fruit Salad
directions: Mix all ingredients together and refrigerate overnight.
recipes.text: Fruit Salad. Mix all ingredients together and refrigerate overnight.

recipes.title: Banana Bread
directions: Grease pans.
Cream together sugar and shortening.
Add bananas and eggs.
Add nuts.
Combine dry ingredients, sift and add to mixture.
Pour into pans and bake at 375° for 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Banana Bread. Grease pans. Cream together sugar and shortening. Add bananas and eggs. Add nuts. Combine dry ingredients, sift and add to mixture. Pour into pans and bake at 375° for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Fudge Scotch Ring
directions: Melt chocolate and butterscotch chips with milk over hot water in double boiler until chips melt and mixture starts to thicken. Remove from heat; add chopped walnuts and vanilla.
Blend well. Chill about 1 hour until mixture thickens.
Line bottom of a 9-inch pie plate with a 12-inch square of foil.
Place 3/4 cup walnut halves in bottom of pan forming a 2-inch wide ring.
Decorate with rest of walnut halves.
Chill in refrigerator until firm enough to slice.
recipes.text: Fudge Scotch Ring. Melt chocolate and butterscotch chips with milk over hot water in double boiler until chips melt and mixture starts to thicken. Remove from heat; add chopped walnuts and vanilla. Blend well. Chill about 1 hour until mixture thickens. Line bottom of a 9-inch pie plate with a 12-inch square of foil. Place 3/4 cup walnut halves in bottom of pan forming a 2-inch wide ring. Decorate with rest of walnut halves. Chill in refrigerator until firm enough to slice.

recipes.title: Molasses Cookies
directions: Combine and drop in 4x sugar.
Put on cookie sheet and press down; put jam or jelly in center.
Bake at 375° until done.
recipes.text: Molasses Cookies. Combine and drop in 4x sugar. Put on cookie sheet and press down; put jam or jelly in center. Bake at 375° until done.

recipes.title: Zucchini Squash Bread
directions: Beat eggs first; add sugar, then other ingredients.
Mix well. Bake 1 hour at 350°.
recipes.text: Zucchini Squash Bread. Beat eggs first; add sugar, then other ingredients. Mix well. Bake 1 hour at 350°.

recipes.title: Stir-Fry Vegetables
ingredients: 1/2 medium onion, sliced and separated into rings
directions: Cut carrots (approximately 6) into 2 x 1/4-inch strips. Slice celery and set aside.
Heat oil in wok or skillet until hot. Add carrots and celery and stir-fry over medium heat for about 10 minutes or until almost tender.
Add onion and
zucchini and continue stirring until crisp and tender.
Add seasonings and serve.
recipes.text: Stir-Fry Vegetables. Cut carrots (approximately 6) into 2 x 1/4-inch strips. Slice celery and set aside. Heat oil in wok or skillet until hot. Add carrots and celery and stir-fry over medium heat for about 10 minutes or until almost tender. Add onion and zucchini and continue stirring until crisp and tender. Add seasonings and serve.

recipes.title: Delightfully Cherry
ingredients: 1 (8 3/4 oz.) can pitted, dark, sweet cherries, drained
directions: Dissolve 1 package of gelatin in 3/4 cup boiling water.
Add 1 cup ice cubes and stir until gelatin starts to thicken (2 to 3 minutes).
Remove unmelted ice and stir in cherries.
Pour into 5-cup mold and chill.
recipes.text: Delightfully Cherry. Dissolve 1 package of gelatin in 3/4 cup boiling water. Add 1 cup ice cubes and stir until gelatin starts to thicken (2 to 3 minutes). Remove unmelted ice and stir in cherries. Pour into 5-cup mold and chill.

recipes.title: Pasta With Shrimp And Vegetables
directions: Brown garlic cloves in olive oil.
Saute zucchini and carrots until tender (approximately 3 minutes).
Add shrimp, basil, oregano and salt.
Toss shrimp with vegetables until they turn pink.
Cook pasta.
Serve shrimp and vegetables over cooked pasta.
recipes.text: Pasta With Shrimp And Vegetables. Brown garlic cloves in olive oil. Saute zucchini and carrots until tender (approximately 3 minutes). Add shrimp, basil, oregano and salt. Toss shrimp with vegetables until they turn pink. Cook pasta. Serve shrimp and vegetables over cooked pasta.

recipes.title: Oreo Cheesecake Squares
ingredients: whipped cream and strawberries for garnish
directions: Finely roll 25 cookies; coarsely chop 15 cookies.
In bowl, combine finely rolled cookies and butter.
Press crumb mixture on bottom of 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan; set aside.
recipes.text: Oreo Cheesecake Squares. Finely roll 25 cookies; coarsely chop 15 cookies. In bowl, combine finely rolled cookies and butter. Press crumb mixture on bottom of 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan; set aside.

recipes.title: Brunch Egg Casserole
directions: In bottom of greased 8 x 8-inch baking dish, combine croutons and cheese.
Combine eggs, milk, salt, mustard and onion powder. Mix until blended.
Pour over crouton mixture in casserole.
Cook bacon until crisp.
Drain and crumble.
Sprinkle over casserole. Set aside 1/4 for garnish.
Bake at 325° for 55 to 60 minutes. Garnish with remaining bacon.
recipes.text: Brunch Egg Casserole. In bottom of greased 8 x 8-inch baking dish, combine croutons and cheese. Combine eggs, milk, salt, mustard and onion powder. Mix until blended. Pour over crouton mixture in casserole. Cook bacon until crisp. Drain and crumble. Sprinkle over casserole. Set aside 1/4 for garnish. Bake at 325° for 55 to 60 minutes. Garnish with remaining bacon.

recipes.title: Becca'S Peanut Blossoms
directions: Beat together milk and peanut butter. Add vanilla and Bisquick. Roll into balls and roll balls in sugar. Bake in a 375° oven for 6 to 8 minutes. Take out of oven and press in a chocolate candy Kiss. Remove from cookie sheets and cool completely.
recipes.text: Becca'S Peanut Blossoms. Beat together milk and peanut butter. Add vanilla and Bisquick. Roll into balls and roll balls in sugar. Bake in a 375° oven for 6 to 8 minutes. Take out of oven and press in a chocolate candy Kiss. Remove from cookie sheets and cool completely.

recipes.title: Orange Tapioca Pudding
directions: Take pudding mixes and jello, mix together, add 3 cups water. Boil 10 minutes, stirring all the time.
Cool.
Fold in the mandarin oranges and add Cool Whip.
recipes.text: Orange Tapioca Pudding. Take pudding mixes and jello, mix together, add 3 cups water. Boil 10 minutes, stirring all the time. Cool. Fold in the mandarin oranges and add Cool Whip.

recipes.title: Strawberry Figs
directions: One morning prayer, said gracefully,
recipes.text: Strawberry Figs. One morning prayer, said gracefully,

recipes.title: Cranberry Jello
directions: Dissolve Jell-O in hot water.
Stir in cranberry sauce.
Chill until thick.
Stir in sour cream and nuts.
Chill until firm.
recipes.text: Cranberry Jello. Dissolve Jell-O in hot water. Stir in cranberry sauce. Chill until thick. Stir in sour cream and nuts. Chill until firm.

recipes.title: Hot Fudge Icing
directions: Mix together the flour and vanilla in a bowl and set aside. Then mix together the sugar, cocoa and water. Cook on stove until it reaches the soft-ball stage. Next, add the flour mixture. Stir until mixed well together. Then pour on cake.
recipes.text: Hot Fudge Icing. Mix together the flour and vanilla in a bowl and set aside. Then mix together the sugar, cocoa and water. Cook on stove until it reaches the soft-ball stage. Next, add the flour mixture. Stir until mixed well together. Then pour on cake.

recipes.title: Orange Cake
directions: Mix sugar, orange juice and orange peel to dissolve.
Next, cream butter and 2 cups sugar.
Add egg yolks and flour alternately with buttermilk in which soda has been dissolved.
Add grated peel of 2 oranges, 1 package dates (cut up) and nuts. Last, add beaten egg whites.
Do not overbeat after you fold in the egg whites.
Bake 1 1/2 hours.
First 45 minutes at 325°, lower to 300° and bake 45 minutes more.
recipes.text: Orange Cake. Mix sugar, orange juice and orange peel to dissolve. Next, cream butter and 2 cups sugar. Add egg yolks and flour alternately with buttermilk in which soda has been dissolved. Add grated peel of 2 oranges, 1 package dates (cut up) and nuts. Last, add beaten egg whites. Do not overbeat after you fold in the egg whites. Bake 1 1/2 hours. First 45 minutes at 325°, lower to 300° and bake 45 minutes more.

recipes.title: Marinated Artichoke Hearts With Pasta In A Creamy Sauce
directions: Pour liquid from hearts into skillet.
Add oil, butter, onion and garlic; saute until soft.
Add hearts and basil and cook for five minutes (you may wish to cut hearts in half).
Take off heat and stir in remaining ingredients.
Mix thoroughly.
Pour onto 1/2 to 3/4 pound cooked pasta and mix completely.
Enjoy!
recipes.text: Marinated Artichoke Hearts With Pasta In A Creamy Sauce. Pour liquid from hearts into skillet. Add oil, butter, onion and garlic; saute until soft. Add hearts and basil and cook for five minutes (you may wish to cut hearts in half). Take off heat and stir in remaining ingredients. Mix thoroughly. Pour onto 1/2 to 3/4 pound cooked pasta and mix completely. Enjoy!

recipes.title: Chewy Mincemeat Bars
ingredients: 2 (7 oz.) pkg. Martha White apple-cinnamon muffin mix
directions: Preheat oven to 400°.
Combine muffin mix, butter and sugar; blend until crumbly.
Reserve 1 cup mixture, loosely packed. Press remaining crust mixture into bottom of ungreased 9-inch square baking pan.
Bake 10 minutes.
Remove from oven; cool 5 minutes.
Carefully spread with mincemeat; sprinkle remaining crumb mixture over mincemeat.
Bake 25 minutes or until golden brown.
Cool on wire rack.
Makes 32 (1 x 2-inch) bars.
recipes.text: Chewy Mincemeat Bars. Preheat oven to 400°. Combine muffin mix, butter and sugar; blend until crumbly. Reserve 1 cup mixture, loosely packed. Press remaining crust mixture into bottom of ungreased 9-inch square baking pan. Bake 10 minutes. Remove from oven; cool 5 minutes. Carefully spread with mincemeat; sprinkle remaining crumb mixture over mincemeat. Bake 25 minutes or until golden brown. Cool on wire rack. Makes 32 (1 x 2-inch) bars.

recipes.title: Holiday Poke Cake
ingredients: 2 baked 9-inch round white cake layers, cooled
1 (3 oz.) pkg. Jell-O gelatin (any red flavor)
directions: Place cake layers, top sides up, in 2 clean 9-inch round cake pans.
Pierce cake with large fork at 1/2-inch intervals.
Dissolve each flavor of gelatin completely in 1 cup boiling water in separate bowls.
Carefully pour red gelatin over 1 cake layer and lime gelatin over second cake layer.
Refrigerate 3 hours.
Dip 1 cake pan in warm water 10 seconds, unmold onto serving plate. Spread with about 1 cup Cool Whip.
Unmold second cake layer. Carefully place on first layer.
Frost top and sides of cake with Cool Whip.
Refrigerate at least 1 hour before serving.
Decorate to look like holly leaves with green leaf gumdrops and red cinnamon candies.
recipes.text: Holiday Poke Cake. Place cake layers, top sides up, in 2 clean 9-inch round cake pans. Pierce cake with large fork at 1/2-inch intervals. Dissolve each flavor of gelatin completely in 1 cup boiling water in separate bowls. Carefully pour red gelatin over 1 cake layer and lime gelatin over second cake layer. Refrigerate 3 hours. Dip 1 cake pan in warm water 10 seconds, unmold onto serving plate. Spread with about 1 cup Cool Whip. Unmold second cake layer. Carefully place on first layer. Frost top and sides of cake with Cool Whip. Refrigerate at least 1 hour before serving. Decorate to look like holly leaves with green leaf gumdrops and red cinnamon candies.

recipes.title: Zucchini Crab Cakes
directions: Mix all ingredients well and fry in olive oil.
recipes.text: Zucchini Crab Cakes. Mix all ingredients well and fry in olive oil.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Pie
directions: Mix cream cheese and powdered sugar together; add peanut butter and milk and fold in Cool Whip.
Pour into graham crust. Freeze until firm.
Take from freezer a few minutes before serving.
recipes.text: Peanut Butter Pie. Mix cream cheese and powdered sugar together; add peanut butter and milk and fold in Cool Whip. Pour into graham crust. Freeze until firm. Take from freezer a few minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Squash Casserole
directions: Arrange squash and onion in steaming rack or microwave. Steam 5
to
minutes	or
to	desired
degree of doneness. Combine squash mixture, butter and cheese.	Stir until butter and
cheese melt.
Combine remaining ingredients and stir into squash mixture.
Spoon
into a lightly greased 2 quart casserole.	Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes or until casserole is set.
It can easily be doubled!	Time of preparation: 30 to 35 minutes.	Serves 6.
recipes.text: Squash Casserole. Arrange squash and onion in steaming rack or microwave. Steam 5 to 10 minutes	or to	desired degree of doneness. Combine squash mixture, butter and cheese.	Stir until butter and cheese melt. Combine remaining ingredients and stir into squash mixture. Spoon into a lightly greased 2 quart casserole.	Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes or until casserole is set. It can easily be doubled!	Time of preparation: 30 to 35 minutes.	Serves 6.

recipes.title: Chicken Apricot
directions: Mix and spread over skinned chicken breast.
Bake at 325° for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Chicken Apricot. Mix and spread over skinned chicken breast. Bake at 325° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Veal Marsala
ingredients: 1 lb. veal, cut in thin slices
directions: Pound the veal lightly until thin.
Dredge with flour seasoned with salt and pepper.
Heat butter; add veal and brown on both sides.
Add Marsala and cook for 1 minute longer over heat. Transfer the meat to warm platter.
Add bouillon to the drippings and bring to a boil, then pour over veal.
recipes.text: Veal Marsala. Pound the veal lightly until thin. Dredge with flour seasoned with salt and pepper. Heat butter; add veal and brown on both sides. Add Marsala and cook for 1 minute longer over heat. Transfer the meat to warm platter. Add bouillon to the drippings and bring to a boil, then pour over veal.

recipes.title: Fruit Crunch
directions: Mix first 4 ingredients.
Then add oleo and egg.
Mixture will be coarse.
Put 1/2 mixture on bottom of 7 1/2 x 12-inch pan. Cover with 1 can cherry pie filling.
Cover with last 1/2 of cake mixture.
Bake 35 minutes at 375°.
recipes.text: Fruit Crunch. Mix first 4 ingredients. Then add oleo and egg. Mixture will be coarse. Put 1/2 mixture on bottom of 7 1/2 x 12-inch pan. Cover with 1 can cherry pie filling. Cover with last 1/2 of cake mixture. Bake 35 minutes at 375°.

recipes.title: Bette'S Chicken With Rice
directions: Heat oven to 350°.
Wash chicken and pat dry; set aside.
In oblong pan, mix rice, water, celery soup, mushroom soup and poultry seasoning.
Arrange chicken pieces on top of mixture. Sprinkle dry onion soup mix over chicken.
Cover pan with aluminum foil and bake at 350° for 1 1/2 to 2 hours in 9 x 13 x 2-inch pan.
recipes.text: Bette'S Chicken With Rice. Heat oven to 350°. Wash chicken and pat dry; set aside. In oblong pan, mix rice, water, celery soup, mushroom soup and poultry seasoning. Arrange chicken pieces on top of mixture. Sprinkle dry onion soup mix over chicken. Cover pan with aluminum foil and bake at 350° for 1 1/2 to 2 hours in 9 x 13 x 2-inch pan.

recipes.title: Broccoli Casserole
directions: Saute butter, onion, garlic and Cheez Whiz until melted.
Add soup and rice.
Add broccoli.
Stir well.
Put in casserole dish. Bake for 30 minutes at 350°.
recipes.text: Broccoli Casserole. Saute butter, onion, garlic and Cheez Whiz until melted. Add soup and rice. Add broccoli. Stir well. Put in casserole dish. Bake for 30 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Fruit Crisp
ingredients: 1 butter brickle or white cake mix
directions: Place pie filling in a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Cut oleo into dry cake mix; add nuts and spread over filling.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
Most prefer butter brickle on apple, while many enjoy the white mix on cherry.
Serve with ice cream or whipped cream.
recipes.text: Fruit Crisp. Place pie filling in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Cut oleo into dry cake mix; add nuts and spread over filling. Bake at 350° for 1 hour. Most prefer butter brickle on apple, while many enjoy the white mix on cherry. Serve with ice cream or whipped cream.

recipes.title: Shrimp Creole
directions: Brown onions, pepper and celery in margarine.
Blend in flour, salt and pepper.
Add tomato sauce and vinegar.
Cover, simmer for 10 minutes.
Add cooked shrimp and serve over rice.
recipes.text: Shrimp Creole. Brown onions, pepper and celery in margarine. Blend in flour, salt and pepper. Add tomato sauce and vinegar. Cover, simmer for 10 minutes. Add cooked shrimp and serve over rice.

recipes.title: Punch
ingredients: 1 c. Tang or 2 pkg. orange Kool-Aid
directions: Mix first 4 ingredients together.
When ready to serve, break up sherbet and add.
Makes about 2 gallons.
recipes.text: Punch. Mix first 4 ingredients together. When ready to serve, break up sherbet and add. Makes about 2 gallons.

recipes.title: Spicy-Sweet Chicken Salad
ingredients: 2 to 2 1/2 c. diced, cooked chicken or turkey (4 split chicken breasts)
1/4 c. sliced green onions with tops (optional)
directions: Combine picante sauce, mayonnaise and honey in medium bowl. Mix well.
Stir in chicken, celery, grapes, pecans and salt.
Cover and chill.
Sprinkle with green onions.
Add a dab of Pace on top for a little extra kick (optional).
Makes 4 servings, about 4 cups of salad.
Toast pecans.
Put in pie plate, single layer, and put in microwave for 3 1/2 minutes on High.
recipes.text: Spicy-Sweet Chicken Salad. Combine picante sauce, mayonnaise and honey in medium bowl. Mix well. Stir in chicken, celery, grapes, pecans and salt. Cover and chill. Sprinkle with green onions. Add a dab of Pace on top for a little extra kick (optional). Makes 4 servings, about 4 cups of salad. Toast pecans. Put in pie plate, single layer, and put in microwave for 3 1/2 minutes on High.

recipes.title: Pizza Burgers
directions: Grind or put in food processor the first 3 ingredients, then mix with pizza sauce.
Spread over open buns.
Bake at 350° until cheese bubbles, about 18 to 20 minutes.
recipes.text: Pizza Burgers. Grind or put in food processor the first 3 ingredients, then mix with pizza sauce. Spread over open buns. Bake at 350° until cheese bubbles, about 18 to 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Italian Cream For Puffs(Crema Italiano)
directions: From my Aunt Lena.
recipes.text: Italian Cream For Puffs(Crema Italiano). From my Aunt Lena.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Pie
directions: Mix all ingredients together; cook over low heat until boiling. Stir. Remove from heat and pour over peanut butter mixture* in deep dish pie shell.
recipes.text: Peanut Butter Pie. Mix all ingredients together; cook over low heat until boiling. Stir. Remove from heat and pour over peanut butter mixture* in deep dish pie shell.

recipes.title: Eclair Dessert
ingredients: 2 pkg. French vanilla instant pie filling
directions: Make instant pudding according to directions, except use 3 cups instead of 4.
When thickened, add Cool Whip.
Line bottom of a 9 x 13-inch buttered pan with 1 layer of graham crackers.
Pour 1/2 of pudding mix over crackers.
Pour remaining 1/2 of pudding over second layer of crackers.
Cover with third layer of crackers.
recipes.text: Eclair Dessert. Make instant pudding according to directions, except use 3 cups instead of 4. When thickened, add Cool Whip. Line bottom of a 9 x 13-inch buttered pan with 1 layer of graham crackers. Pour 1/2 of pudding mix over crackers. Pour remaining 1/2 of pudding over second layer of crackers. Cover with third layer of crackers.

recipes.title: Pot Luck Spuds
directions: Mix the first four ingredients together in an 9x13 inch pan. Drizzle the margarine over the top. Bake at 350 degrees for one hour. (You may use cream of mushroom soup instead of cream of chicken.)
recipes.text: Pot Luck Spuds. Mix the first four ingredients together in an 9x13 inch pan. Drizzle the margarine over the top. Bake at 350 degrees for one hour. (You may use cream of mushroom soup instead of cream of chicken.)

recipes.title: Pecan Pie
ingredients: 1 c. light or dark corn syrup
directions: Preheat oven to 375°. Beat eggs, sugar and salt. Add butter and syrup. Mix in pecans. Bake in pie shell 40 to 45 minutes. If adding chocolate chips, mix in with pecans.
recipes.text: Pecan Pie. Preheat oven to 375°. Beat eggs, sugar and salt. Add butter and syrup. Mix in pecans. Bake in pie shell 40 to 45 minutes. If adding chocolate chips, mix in with pecans.

recipes.title: Baked Broccoli
directions: Cook broccoli and drain.
Trim crust from bread, butter and cut into cubes.
Beat eggs; add milk and bread cubes.
Stir broccoli and cheese into egg mixture.
Pour into buttered oblong baking dish.
Bake at 250° for 1 1/2 hours.
Cut into squares.
recipes.text: Baked Broccoli. Cook broccoli and drain. Trim crust from bread, butter and cut into cubes. Beat eggs; add milk and bread cubes. Stir broccoli and cheese into egg mixture. Pour into buttered oblong baking dish. Bake at 250° for 1 1/2 hours. Cut into squares.

recipes.title: Apricot Delight
ingredients: 40 cream filled chocolate cookies, ground into fine crumbs
1 large can apricots, drained and chopped
directions: Put dessert together in the following order: half of the cookie crumbs, all of the sauce, half of the whipped cream, half of the nuts, all of the apricots, remaining nuts, whipped cream and cookie crumbs. Makes 12 servings. This freezes well.
recipes.text: Apricot Delight. Put dessert together in the following order: half of the cookie crumbs, all of the sauce, half of the whipped cream, half of the nuts, all of the apricots, remaining nuts, whipped cream and cookie crumbs. Makes 12 servings. This freezes well.

recipes.title: Snow On The Mountain
directions: Brown meat until cooked and crumbly.
Drain off excess fat. Place in bottom of greased casserole.
Cover with catsup, corn and then peas.
Top with a generous frosting of mashed potatoes.
Bake in a 350° oven for about an hour.
Sprinkle cheese on top for last 15 minutes of cooking, if desired.
recipes.text: Snow On The Mountain. Brown meat until cooked and crumbly. Drain off excess fat. Place in bottom of greased casserole. Cover with catsup, corn and then peas. Top with a generous frosting of mashed potatoes. Bake in a 350° oven for about an hour. Sprinkle cheese on top for last 15 minutes of cooking, if desired.

recipes.title: Mexican Cornbread
directions: Mix dry ingredients together.
Then add other ingredients except cheese.
Pour 1/2 of the mixture into a greased pan (cast iron skillet works well).
Then spread on the cheese.
Pour the rest of the mixture.
Bake in a 375 degree oven for 1 hour or until done.
recipes.text: Mexican Cornbread. Mix dry ingredients together. Then add other ingredients except cheese. Pour 1/2 of the mixture into a greased pan (cast iron skillet works well). Then spread on the cheese. Pour the rest of the mixture. Bake in a 375 degree oven for 1 hour or until done.

recipes.title: Carrot Pie
directions: Mix
all
ingredients.	Pour
in
pie shell and bake 10 minutes at 450°, then turn oven to 375° for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Carrot Pie. Mix all ingredients.	Pour in pie shell and bake 10 minutes at 450°, then turn oven to 375° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Marinated Vegetables
directions: Drain all vegetables.
Thinly sliced green onions.
Mix all vegetables together.
Mix sugar with vinegar (you can use half tarragon and half wine vinegar or half malt and half regular vinegar).
Add mixture to vegetable.
