May add black pepper if desired.
Refrigerate salad at least 24 hours before serving. Pour off some of marinade or use slotted spoon to serve.
Keeps indefinitely in refrigerator.
recipes.text: Marinated Vegetables. Drain all vegetables. Thinly sliced green onions. Mix all vegetables together. Mix sugar with vinegar (you can use half tarragon and half wine vinegar or half malt and half regular vinegar). Add mixture to vegetable. May add black pepper if desired. Refrigerate salad at least 24 hours before serving. Pour off some of marinade or use slotted spoon to serve. Keeps indefinitely in refrigerator.

recipes.title: Carrot Cake
directions: Beat oil, sugar and eggs until smooth.
Mix dry ingredients together and add along with carrot, vanilla, coconut, pineapple and walnuts.
Mix carefully until blended.
Do not overbeat.
Pour into greased 9 inch square pan.
Bake at 350 degrees for 50 to 60 minutes.
recipes.text: Carrot Cake. Beat oil, sugar and eggs until smooth. Mix dry ingredients together and add along with carrot, vanilla, coconut, pineapple and walnuts. Mix carefully until blended. Do not overbeat. Pour into greased 9 inch square pan. Bake at 350 degrees for 50 to 60 minutes.

recipes.title: Veg-All Casserole
directions: Mix all ingredients together.
Put in casserole with lid.
Top with crumbled Ritz crackers.
(You may put the crackers in melted butter if you like.)
Bake at 325° for 25 minutes.
recipes.text: Veg-All Casserole. Mix all ingredients together. Put in casserole with lid. Top with crumbled Ritz crackers. (You may put the crackers in melted butter if you like.) Bake at 325° for 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Oatmeal Cake
directions: Pour boiling water over oats and let stand 1/2 hour.
Cream margarine.
Add salt, sugars and vanilla.
Add eggs, one at a time.
Add dry ingredients alternately with oatmeal mixture. Bake 50 minutes in a 350° oven.
Use a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Dust with confectioners sugar when cool.
recipes.text: Oatmeal Cake. Pour boiling water over oats and let stand 1/2 hour. Cream margarine. Add salt, sugars and vanilla. Add eggs, one at a time. Add dry ingredients alternately with oatmeal mixture. Bake 50 minutes in a 350° oven. Use a 9 x 13-inch pan. Dust with confectioners sugar when cool.

recipes.title: Cabbage Au Gratin
directions: Cook cabbage and onion in a small amount of boiling salted water in saucepan for 10 minutes or until wilted; drain well. Layer cabbage mixture, cheese and soup 1/2 at a time in casserole. Top with crumbs.
Bake at 400° for 15 minutes.
Yields 8 servings.
recipes.text: Cabbage Au Gratin. Cook cabbage and onion in a small amount of boiling salted water in saucepan for 10 minutes or until wilted; drain well. Layer cabbage mixture, cheese and soup 1/2 at a time in casserole. Top with crumbs. Bake at 400° for 15 minutes. Yields 8 servings.

recipes.title: Cinnamon Rolls
ingredients: 1/2 c. vanilla ice cream or more
directions: Cut rolls in half and roll in a cinnamon/sugar mixture.
Put in a greased 9 x 13-inch pan.
Melt ice cream, sugars and margarine together and pour over rolls in pan.
Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.
Turn upside-down on a cookie sheet to serve.
recipes.text: Cinnamon Rolls. Cut rolls in half and roll in a cinnamon/sugar mixture. Put in a greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Melt ice cream, sugars and margarine together and pour over rolls in pan. Bake at 350° for 20 minutes. Turn upside-down on a cookie sheet to serve.

recipes.title: Spinach Dip
directions: Mix and set overnight.
Use round loaf of bread.
Hollow out center and fill with dip.
Use center of bread or crackers to serve dip.
We use tortilla chips.
recipes.text: Spinach Dip. Mix and set overnight. Use round loaf of bread. Hollow out center and fill with dip. Use center of bread or crackers to serve dip. We use tortilla chips.

recipes.title: Harry'S Salsa
ingredients: 3 (28 oz.) cans tomatoes (be sure to drain very well and chop)
1 (4 oz.) can mild green chillies, chopped to suit
splash of dry red wine to suit
splash of juice from jar of hot jalapeno peppers
3 or 4 hot jalapeno peppers, chopped to suit (chop fine for a milder flavor, larger for hotter flavor)
bit of cumin and oregano (a bit is larger than a pinch)
juice of 1 fresh lime to taste
1 large clove fresh garlic, very finely chopped
directions: Combine the ingredients in a large bowl and adjust consistency to suit yourself.
If you like your salsa on the saucy side, put the chunky bits in the blender and start experimenting.
Proceed with a light touch on the button.
If you like it chunky, and it's a little thin (because you didn't drain the tomatoes enough), now is the time to add a small amount of tomato sauce to thicken it up.
Be sure to experiment with this recipe until it suits your taste.
recipes.text: Harry'S Salsa. Combine the ingredients in a large bowl and adjust consistency to suit yourself. If you like your salsa on the saucy side, put the chunky bits in the blender and start experimenting. Proceed with a light touch on the button. If you like it chunky, and it's a little thin (because you didn't drain the tomatoes enough), now is the time to add a small amount of tomato sauce to thicken it up. Be sure to experiment with this recipe until it suits your taste.

recipes.title: Taco Salad
directions: Chop lettuce, tomatoes and shred cheese; combine into a large bowl.
Mix.
Brown the ground beef and season with seasoned salt, pepper and garlic powder.
Crush tortilla chips.
Combine the ground beef and tortilla chips in a large bowl of lettuce, tomato and cheese.
Mix.
recipes.text: Taco Salad. Chop lettuce, tomatoes and shred cheese; combine into a large bowl. Mix. Brown the ground beef and season with seasoned salt, pepper and garlic powder. Crush tortilla chips. Combine the ground beef and tortilla chips in a large bowl of lettuce, tomato and cheese. Mix.

recipes.title: Oatmeal Muffins
directions: Beat eggs and stir in buttermilk, brown sugar and shortening. Add remaining ingredients; stir until flour is dampened.
Batter will not be smooth.
Fill greased muffin cups 2/3 full.
Bake at 375° for 20 to 25 minutes or until light brown.
Makes 12 muffins.
recipes.text: Oatmeal Muffins. Beat eggs and stir in buttermilk, brown sugar and shortening. Add remaining ingredients; stir until flour is dampened. Batter will not be smooth. Fill greased muffin cups 2/3 full. Bake at 375° for 20 to 25 minutes or until light brown. Makes 12 muffins.

recipes.title: Red Lobster Caesar Salad Dressing
directions: Using a medium size wooden salad bowl, mash and spread the anchovies and the garlic with a fork and run the inside of the bowl with it.
Adding the vinegar and mustard, blend thoroughly.
Using the fork, add the olive oil and the coddled (meaning to cook in simmering water for 1 minute) egg yolk.
Mix together and add the worcestershire, lemon, pepper and parmesan cheese.
You add the croutons and the lettuce to the dressing not the other way around. Toss the salad until everything is coated with the dressing then serve in individual bowls.
recipes.text: Red Lobster Caesar Salad Dressing. Using a medium size wooden salad bowl, mash and spread the anchovies and the garlic with a fork and run the inside of the bowl with it. Adding the vinegar and mustard, blend thoroughly. Using the fork, add the olive oil and the coddled (meaning to cook in simmering water for 1 minute) egg yolk. Mix together and add the worcestershire, lemon, pepper and parmesan cheese. You add the croutons and the lettuce to the dressing not the other way around. Toss the salad until everything is coated with the dressing then serve in individual bowls.

recipes.title: Play Dough
directions: Put all ingredients in a saucepan.
Let cook, stirring constantly until a ball forms.
Take off heat.
Knead until smooth.
Store in an airtight container.
recipes.text: Play Dough. Put all ingredients in a saucepan. Let cook, stirring constantly until a ball forms. Take off heat. Knead until smooth. Store in an airtight container.

recipes.title: Cranberry-Orange Salad
directions: Dissolve jello in hot
water;
add
cranberry
and beat until smooth.
Add orange
juice.
Chill until slightly thickened.
Add celery and apple.
Pour in 9 x 13-inch pan or mold. Half a recipe would fill an 8 x 8-inch pan.
Serves 10 to 12.
recipes.text: Cranberry-Orange Salad. Dissolve jello in hot water; add cranberry and beat until smooth. Add orange juice. Chill until slightly thickened. Add celery and apple. Pour in 9 x 13-inch pan or mold. Half a recipe would fill an 8 x 8-inch pan. Serves 10 to 12.

recipes.title: Fudge
directions: Boil sugar, milk and butter for 7 minutes. Stir in remaining ingredients and pour in well-greased dish. Set before cutting.
recipes.text: Fudge. Boil sugar, milk and butter for 7 minutes. Stir in remaining ingredients and pour in well-greased dish. Set before cutting.

recipes.title: Fresh Peach Ice Cream
directions: Mix all ingredients; chill and churn.
Freeze.
recipes.text: Fresh Peach Ice Cream. Mix all ingredients; chill and churn. Freeze.

recipes.title: Lemon Cream Pie
directions: Mix sugar, flour and cornstarch. Add hot milk and cook in double boiler for 20 minutes.
Add beaten egg yolks, juice of lemons and rind of one. Take from heat and add butter.
Fold in 1 egg white.
Make meringue with the other two whites and spread on pie. Bake in high oven.
recipes.text: Lemon Cream Pie. Mix sugar, flour and cornstarch. Add hot milk and cook in double boiler for 20 minutes. Add beaten egg yolks, juice of lemons and rind of one. Take from heat and add butter. Fold in 1 egg white. Make meringue with the other two whites and spread on pie. Bake in high oven.

recipes.title: Daube Glace
directions: Spray large mold with Pam.
Place the sliced olives in mold and cover with shredded meat.
Dissolve 2 packages unflavored gelatin in 1 can of the beef consomme.
Add the second can of consomme, green onions, parsley, garlic, Worcestershire, Tabasco, salt and pepper.
Mix well and pour over the meat in the mold.
Refrigerate. Turn out on a dish and garnish.
To serve, slice.
recipes.text: Daube Glace. Spray large mold with Pam. Place the sliced olives in mold and cover with shredded meat. Dissolve 2 packages unflavored gelatin in 1 can of the beef consomme. Add the second can of consomme, green onions, parsley, garlic, Worcestershire, Tabasco, salt and pepper. Mix well and pour over the meat in the mold. Refrigerate. Turn out on a dish and garnish. To serve, slice.

recipes.title: Magic Fruitcake
directions: Put mincemeat and water in a medium pan and bring to a boil. Let boil for 1 minute stirring occasionally; cool.
Combine eggs, condensed milk, mince meat, fruit and nuts.
Stir in dry ingredients.
Pour into greased 9 inch tube pan, 2 loaf pans, or 4 small loaf pans.
Bake at 300° for 2 hours until center springs back.
Reduce time to 1-1/2 hours for loaf pans, and to 1 hour for small loaf pans.
Brush with Karo syrup for glaze.
recipes.text: Magic Fruitcake. Put mincemeat and water in a medium pan and bring to a boil. Let boil for 1 minute stirring occasionally; cool. Combine eggs, condensed milk, mince meat, fruit and nuts. Stir in dry ingredients. Pour into greased 9 inch tube pan, 2 loaf pans, or 4 small loaf pans. Bake at 300° for 2 hours until center springs back. Reduce time to 1-1/2 hours for loaf pans, and to 1 hour for small loaf pans. Brush with Karo syrup for glaze.

recipes.title: Instant Russian Tea
directions: Mix all ingredients with 8 cups water.
Serves 10.
Use 3 tablespoons per individual serving.
recipes.text: Instant Russian Tea. Mix all ingredients with 8 cups water. Serves 10. Use 3 tablespoons per individual serving.

recipes.title: Never Fail Pie Meringue
directions: Mix cornstarch, sugar and water in small saucepan.
Cook until thick and clear, about 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Cool. Beat egg whites until frothy.
Add flavoring and cornstarch, mix and beat until fluffy and is peaking.
recipes.text: Never Fail Pie Meringue. Mix cornstarch, sugar and water in small saucepan. Cook until thick and clear, about 1 minute, stirring constantly. Cool. Beat egg whites until frothy. Add flavoring and cornstarch, mix and beat until fluffy and is peaking.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Bread
directions: Combine all wet and dry ingredients together.
Pour into 2 loaf pans.
Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes.
Makes 2 loaves.
recipes.text: Pumpkin Bread. Combine all wet and dry ingredients together. Pour into 2 loaf pans. Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes. Makes 2 loaves.

recipes.title: Boneless Pork Chops With A Slice Of Pineapple
ingredients: meat tenderizer or salt and pepper
directions: Thaw out boneless pork chops; put them in a shallow pan or a baking dish or whatever you desire.
You can boil them or bake them.
Preheat oven if baking, at 350°.
Bake pork chops for 1 hour or until done (or put under broiler).
When pork chops are done, put a slice of whole pineapple on top of pork chop.
Put meat tenderizer or your salt and pepper on them and return to oven or broiler until pineapple gets a little brown on top.
Take out of oven and enjoy.
If you desire, you can put the pineapple juice on top of the pineapple slices.
The juice will absorb in the pork chops when cooked.
recipes.text: Boneless Pork Chops With A Slice Of Pineapple. Thaw out boneless pork chops; put them in a shallow pan or a baking dish or whatever you desire. You can boil them or bake them. Preheat oven if baking, at 350°. Bake pork chops for 1 hour or until done (or put under broiler). When pork chops are done, put a slice of whole pineapple on top of pork chop. Put meat tenderizer or your salt and pepper on them and return to oven or broiler until pineapple gets a little brown on top. Take out of oven and enjoy. If you desire, you can put the pineapple juice on top of the pineapple slices. The juice will absorb in the pork chops when cooked.

recipes.title: Frozen Peanut Butter Pie
directions: Press miniature chocolate chips on crust.
Beat cream cheese until fluffy; add sugar.
Beat well.
Add peanut butter.
Stir in milk.
Add vanilla.
Fold in whipped topping.
Pour into prepared crust.
Top with chopped peanuts.
Freeze 4 hours.
Let thaw a few minutes before serving.
Very rich, but oh so good!
recipes.text: Frozen Peanut Butter Pie. Press miniature chocolate chips on crust. Beat cream cheese until fluffy; add sugar. Beat well. Add peanut butter. Stir in milk. Add vanilla. Fold in whipped topping. Pour into prepared crust. Top with chopped peanuts. Freeze 4 hours. Let thaw a few minutes before serving. Very rich, but oh so good!

recipes.title: Custard Pie
directions: Mix first 5 ingredients well; add scalded milk.
Pour into shell and bake for 1 hour at 350°.
recipes.text: Custard Pie. Mix first 5 ingredients well; add scalded milk. Pour into shell and bake for 1 hour at 350°.

recipes.title: Sugar Cookies
directions: Sift flour once; measure.
Add baking powder and nutmeg, then sift together twice.
Cream butter, adding sugar gradually, until light and fluffy.
Add eggs, lemon rind and cream or milk; beat well.
Roll into a thin sheet on slightly floured board.
Cut with floured cutter and dredge with sugar.
Bake in a 400° oven for 7 minutes.
This makes 2 1/2 dozen cookies, 3-inches in diameter. These may also be cut into fancy shapes and sprinkled with colored sugar.
recipes.text: Sugar Cookies. Sift flour once; measure. Add baking powder and nutmeg, then sift together twice. Cream butter, adding sugar gradually, until light and fluffy. Add eggs, lemon rind and cream or milk; beat well. Roll into a thin sheet on slightly floured board. Cut with floured cutter and dredge with sugar. Bake in a 400° oven for 7 minutes. This makes 2 1/2 dozen cookies, 3-inches in diameter. These may also be cut into fancy shapes and sprinkled with colored sugar.

recipes.title: Nacho Cheese Dip
directions: Melt cubed cheeses over low heat (a microwave works well at 1/2 to 3/4 power setting).
Add next 4 ingredients.
Start adding Tabasco sauce until dip is hot enough, keeping in mind that it gets hotter as it stands.
Serve in crock-pot or chafing dish with tortilla chips.
recipes.text: Nacho Cheese Dip. Melt cubed cheeses over low heat (a microwave works well at 1/2 to 3/4 power setting). Add next 4 ingredients. Start adding Tabasco sauce until dip is hot enough, keeping in mind that it gets hotter as it stands. Serve in crock-pot or chafing dish with tortilla chips.

recipes.title: Sweet Potato Souffle
directions: Dot with butter.
Bake at 350° until it bubbles and the butter and brown sugar are melted.
recipes.text: Sweet Potato Souffle. Dot with butter. Bake at 350° until it bubbles and the butter and brown sugar are melted.

recipes.title: Low-Fat Lasagna
ingredients: 1/2 tsp. garlic powder or 1 garlic clove
directions: Boil noodles, 3 or 4 at a time to prevent breaking.
Brown turkey, onion and garlic in skillet.
Drain.
Add 3/4 can of water to tomato paste and mix.
Add to browned meat and simmer for 15 minutes.
In a separate bowl, slightly beat egg, then blend in cottage cheese.
Add spices to meat mixture the final five minutes of simmering.
Spray large baking dish with Pam.
Layer meat mixture, followed by noodles, then cheese mixture.
Repeat.
Then sprinkle top with Mozzarella cheese.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes or microwave for 20 minutes.
recipes.text: Low-Fat Lasagna. Boil noodles, 3 or 4 at a time to prevent breaking. Brown turkey, onion and garlic in skillet. Drain. Add 3/4 can of water to tomato paste and mix. Add to browned meat and simmer for 15 minutes. In a separate bowl, slightly beat egg, then blend in cottage cheese. Add spices to meat mixture the final five minutes of simmering. Spray large baking dish with Pam. Layer meat mixture, followed by noodles, then cheese mixture. Repeat. Then sprinkle top with Mozzarella cheese. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes or microwave for 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Coleslaw
directions: Grate cabbage and carrot. Set aside.
Mix mayonnaise, Miracle Whip, vinegar, sugar and milk.
Beat by hand until mixture is creamy. Pour over cabbage and carrot.
Mix well.
recipes.text: Coleslaw. Grate cabbage and carrot. Set aside. Mix mayonnaise, Miracle Whip, vinegar, sugar and milk. Beat by hand until mixture is creamy. Pour over cabbage and carrot. Mix well.

recipes.title: Savory Green Beans
directions: Heat beans in saucepan; drain well.
Add butter.
Place in shallow serving dish.
Sprinkle with vinegar.
Toss with cheese and croutons.
Serve immediately.
recipes.text: Savory Green Beans. Heat beans in saucepan; drain well. Add butter. Place in shallow serving dish. Sprinkle with vinegar. Toss with cheese and croutons. Serve immediately.

recipes.title: Chicken And Broccoli Casserole
directions: Cook broccoli and drain (approximately 10 minutes).
Put broccoli in 3-quart casserole dish.
Layer chicken over it.
Mix soup, mayonnaise and cheese and spread over chicken.
Mix margarine, crackers and pecans and layer over top.
Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes.
recipes.text: Chicken And Broccoli Casserole. Cook broccoli and drain (approximately 10 minutes). Put broccoli in 3-quart casserole dish. Layer chicken over it. Mix soup, mayonnaise and cheese and spread over chicken. Mix margarine, crackers and pecans and layer over top. Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Tempera Batter
directions: Combine all ingredients and stir (do not beat).
Batter should be lumpy.
For a thicken batter, use less water.
Also good with Tony's Creole seasoning.
Delicious for shrimp, vegetables, etc.
recipes.text: Tempera Batter. Combine all ingredients and stir (do not beat). Batter should be lumpy. For a thicken batter, use less water. Also good with Tony's Creole seasoning. Delicious for shrimp, vegetables, etc.

recipes.title: Fruit Salad
ingredients: 1 (20 oz.) can pineapple chunks or tidbits
1 (16 oz.) can peach slices, cut up
directions: Drain the pineapple and save the juice.
Add enough orange juice to make 1 1/3 cups.
Mix juice and pudding in a saucepan and cook until thick.
Drain the other fruit. Cut the bananas into the hot tapioca.
Add the other fruit.
Pour into a bowl.
Garnish with cherries.
May be served either warm or chilled; delicious either way.
recipes.text: Fruit Salad. Drain the pineapple and save the juice. Add enough orange juice to make 1 1/3 cups. Mix juice and pudding in a saucepan and cook until thick. Drain the other fruit. Cut the bananas into the hot tapioca. Add the other fruit. Pour into a bowl. Garnish with cherries. May be served either warm or chilled; delicious either way.

recipes.title: Cornbread Salad
directions: Mix all together with mayonnaise and dill pickle juice to taste.
recipes.text: Cornbread Salad. Mix all together with mayonnaise and dill pickle juice to taste.

recipes.title: Sinful Brownies
directions: Place unwrapped caramels in a small saucepan with 1/2 cup evaporated milk.
Heat slowly, stirring constantly until all candy is melted.
Set aside to cool.
recipes.text: Sinful Brownies. Place unwrapped caramels in a small saucepan with 1/2 cup evaporated milk. Heat slowly, stirring constantly until all candy is melted. Set aside to cool.

recipes.title: Broccoli Casserole
directions: Cook rice; set aside.
Bring water to a boil with 1 teaspoon salt and add broccoli.
Return to a boil and cook for 5 minutes. Add rice and let set for 5 minutes, covered.
Put margarine in a large casserole dish in oven to melt.
Mix remaining ingredients with broccoli and rice.
Stir until Cheez Whiz and chicken soup are dissolved.
Pour in casserole dish and bake for 45 minutes to 1 hour at 375°.
recipes.text: Broccoli Casserole. Cook rice; set aside. Bring water to a boil with 1 teaspoon salt and add broccoli. Return to a boil and cook for 5 minutes. Add rice and let set for 5 minutes, covered. Put margarine in a large casserole dish in oven to melt. Mix remaining ingredients with broccoli and rice. Stir until Cheez Whiz and chicken soup are dissolved. Pour in casserole dish and bake for 45 minutes to 1 hour at 375°.

recipes.title: Thermos Flask Lunch
ingredients: 1/4 c. well washed, yellow, split mung beans
1 1/2 c. assorted fresh vegetables, cut into small pieces
whole or ground spices to taste (salt and pepper, cumin, ginger, etc.)
directions: Briefly saute the spices in the ghee.
Add the mung bean dahl, rice and chopped vegetables.
Cover with the water and simmer for 5 minutes.
While still boiling hot, quickly pour the mixture into a one-liter or one-quart thermos.
Close the thermos quickly and leave it closed for about 4 hours.
The meal will cook and be ready to eat after 4 hours in the thermos.
recipes.text: Thermos Flask Lunch. Briefly saute the spices in the ghee. Add the mung bean dahl, rice and chopped vegetables. Cover with the water and simmer for 5 minutes. While still boiling hot, quickly pour the mixture into a one-liter or one-quart thermos. Close the thermos quickly and leave it closed for about 4 hours. The meal will cook and be ready to eat after 4 hours in the thermos.

recipes.title: Date Bars
directions: Grease and flour 7 1/2 x 12-inch pan.
Mix all together.
Bake at 325° for 30 to 35 minutes.
recipes.text: Date Bars. Grease and flour 7 1/2 x 12-inch pan. Mix all together. Bake at 325° for 30 to 35 minutes.

recipes.title: Easy Poppy Seed Bread
directions: In large bowl, combine all ingredients.
Beat 4 minutes.
Turn batter into 2 loaf pans.
Bake at 350° for 40 to 50 minutes.
recipes.text: Easy Poppy Seed Bread. In large bowl, combine all ingredients. Beat 4 minutes. Turn batter into 2 loaf pans. Bake at 350° for 40 to 50 minutes.

recipes.title: Pink Salad
directions: Mix well and pour into serving bowl.
Serves 6 to 8.
recipes.text: Pink Salad. Mix well and pour into serving bowl. Serves 6 to 8.

recipes.title: Oyster Stew
directions: Melt butter in small saucepan.
Add oysters (with liquor); cook and stir over low heat just until edges curl.
In another saucepan, heat milk and cream.
Stir in salt, pepper and oysters. Makes 4 servings (1 cup each).
recipes.text: Oyster Stew. Melt butter in small saucepan. Add oysters (with liquor); cook and stir over low heat just until edges curl. In another saucepan, heat milk and cream. Stir in salt, pepper and oysters. Makes 4 servings (1 cup each).

recipes.title: Bacon And Egg Pie
directions: Line pie plate with pastry.
Fry bacon until cooked; chop coarsely.
Put half of bacon into pastry shell.
Break eggs into pastry shell on top of bacon (eggs may be beaten).
Chop onion; put on top of eggs, along with remaining chopped bacon.
Cover with another pie pastry; glaze with a beaten egg.
Bake in a moderate oven until golden brown.
recipes.text: Bacon And Egg Pie. Line pie plate with pastry. Fry bacon until cooked; chop coarsely. Put half of bacon into pastry shell. Break eggs into pastry shell on top of bacon (eggs may be beaten). Chop onion; put on top of eggs, along with remaining chopped bacon. Cover with another pie pastry; glaze with a beaten egg. Bake in a moderate oven until golden brown.

recipes.title: Pizza Crust
directions: Dissolve yeast and sugar in warm water.
Beat in half the flour and add salt, oil and the rest of the flour.
Mix well. Knead until smooth.
Place in lightly oiled bowl.
Oil bottom, cover, let stand for 1/2 hour.
Place in oiled pan and spread out. Add sauce and cheese.
More options: pepperoni, sausage, broccoli, spinach.
recipes.text: Pizza Crust. Dissolve yeast and sugar in warm water. Beat in half the flour and add salt, oil and the rest of the flour. Mix well. Knead until smooth. Place in lightly oiled bowl. Oil bottom, cover, let stand for 1/2 hour. Place in oiled pan and spread out. Add sauce and cheese. More options: pepperoni, sausage, broccoli, spinach.

recipes.title: Cherry Jello Salad
ingredients: 20 oz. can crushed pineapple with juice
directions: Add boiling water to dry cherry jello.
Add crushed pineapple with juice.
Add cherry pie filling.
Refrigerate.
recipes.text: Cherry Jello Salad. Add boiling water to dry cherry jello. Add crushed pineapple with juice. Add cherry pie filling. Refrigerate.

recipes.title: Pineapple Whip
ingredients: 1 c. pineapple juice, drained from can
directions: Prepare Jell-O mix with boiling water and pineapple juice. Set partially in fridge, then stir in 1 cup crushed pineapple. Return to fridge for short time.
Then stir in sweetened whipped cream.
(Do not make whipped cream too stiff.)
Return to fridge to set completely.
Before serving, trim with whipped cream and any other decoration desired.
recipes.text: Pineapple Whip. Prepare Jell-O mix with boiling water and pineapple juice. Set partially in fridge, then stir in 1 cup crushed pineapple. Return to fridge for short time. Then stir in sweetened whipped cream. (Do not make whipped cream too stiff.) Return to fridge to set completely. Before serving, trim with whipped cream and any other decoration desired.

recipes.title: Shrimp Scallop Primavera
directions: Chop pepper and onion into medium size chunks.
Slice mushrooms.
Mince garlic; peel shrimp.
Rinse both shrimp and scallops and remove excess water.
Heat large frying pan (medium heat for range) and add olive oil.
Once the pan has heated, add garlic, pepper, onion and mushrooms.
Stir the vegetables while cooking for approximately 2 minutes.
Using a slotted spoon, remove the vegetables (to prevent overcooking), then add shrimp, scallops, black pepper, lemon pepper, Old Bay seasoning and sherry (optional).
Cook for approximately 5 minutes, or until shrimp and scallops are tender to the touch of the fork.
recipes.text: Shrimp Scallop Primavera. Chop pepper and onion into medium size chunks. Slice mushrooms. Mince garlic; peel shrimp. Rinse both shrimp and scallops and remove excess water. Heat large frying pan (medium heat for range) and add olive oil. Once the pan has heated, add garlic, pepper, onion and mushrooms. Stir the vegetables while cooking for approximately 2 minutes. Using a slotted spoon, remove the vegetables (to prevent overcooking), then add shrimp, scallops, black pepper, lemon pepper, Old Bay seasoning and sherry (optional). Cook for approximately 5 minutes, or until shrimp and scallops are tender to the touch of the fork.

recipes.title: Blueberry Salad
directions: Mix Jell-O in 2 cups hot water.
Add pineapple and blueberry and let congeal.
recipes.text: Blueberry Salad. Mix Jell-O in 2 cups hot water. Add pineapple and blueberry and let congeal.

recipes.title: Eggplant Casserole
directions: Peel eggplant; cut into cubes.
Cook in boiling, salted water until tender.
Saute onions in butter and add eggplant that has been drained well.
Stir in eggs, cheese, salt and pepper.
recipes.text: Eggplant Casserole. Peel eggplant; cut into cubes. Cook in boiling, salted water until tender. Saute onions in butter and add eggplant that has been drained well. Stir in eggs, cheese, salt and pepper.

recipes.title: Pizza Crust
directions: Dissolve yeast in warm water in large bowl.
Stir in sugar, salt and oil.
Add 2 cups flour and beat until smooth.
Stir in enough remaining flour to make dough easy to handle.
Knead 5 minutes.
Place in lightly greased bowl and turn greased side up. Cover and let rise until double.
Dough is ready when indentations remain when touched.
No oil or cornmeal needed to spread this dough.
Bake at 400° for 20 minutes.
Enjoy!
recipes.text: Pizza Crust. Dissolve yeast in warm water in large bowl. Stir in sugar, salt and oil. Add 2 cups flour and beat until smooth. Stir in enough remaining flour to make dough easy to handle. Knead 5 minutes. Place in lightly greased bowl and turn greased side up. Cover and let rise until double. Dough is ready when indentations remain when touched. No oil or cornmeal needed to spread this dough. Bake at 400° for 20 minutes. Enjoy!

recipes.title: Texas Sheet Cake
ingredients: 1/2 c. buttermilk to which 1 tsp. soda has been added
directions: Boil together the margarine, water and cocoa.
In a bowl, mix flour, sugar, eggs, salt and buttermilk mixture.
Add cocoa mixture and blend well.
Bake in an 18 x 12 x 1-inch pan at 350° for 20 to 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Texas Sheet Cake. Boil together the margarine, water and cocoa. In a bowl, mix flour, sugar, eggs, salt and buttermilk mixture. Add cocoa mixture and blend well. Bake in an 18 x 12 x 1-inch pan at 350° for 20 to 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Pepperoni And Cheese Appetizer Bread
directions: Measure warm water into a large bowl; sprinkle in yeast and stir until dissolved.
Add sugar, salt, margarine and 3 cups flour; beat until smooth.
Stir in remaining flour.
Knead until smooth and elastic, 8 to 10 minutes.
Place in a greased bowl, cover and let rise until double.
recipes.text: Pepperoni And Cheese Appetizer Bread. Measure warm water into a large bowl; sprinkle in yeast and stir until dissolved. Add sugar, salt, margarine and 3 cups flour; beat until smooth. Stir in remaining flour. Knead until smooth and elastic, 8 to 10 minutes. Place in a greased bowl, cover and let rise until double.

recipes.title: Apple Muffins
directions: Put together in a bowl flour, 1/4 cup sugar, salt, baking powder, beaten egg, milk and shortening; just stir enough to mix ingredients.
Don't beat.
Mix 1/4 cup sugar with apples and fold into batter.
Grease muffin tins and fill 2/3 full.
Bake 20 to 25 minutes.
Makes a dozen nice muffins.
Set oven at 400°.
recipes.text: Apple Muffins. Put together in a bowl flour, 1/4 cup sugar, salt, baking powder, beaten egg, milk and shortening; just stir enough to mix ingredients. Don't beat. Mix 1/4 cup sugar with apples and fold into batter. Grease muffin tins and fill 2/3 full. Bake 20 to 25 minutes. Makes a dozen nice muffins. Set oven at 400°.

recipes.title: Next Best Thing To Robert Redford #1
directions: Mix butter, flour and pecans until combined; pat in oblong baking dish (9 x 13-inch or close).
Bake for 15 minutes at 350°. Let cool.
Mix with beater the cream cheese, sugar and Cool Whip; spread over cooled crust.
Whip together the milk and pudding; spread on cream cheese mixture.
Spread small container of chocolate Cool Whip over pudding mixture.
Refrigerate 2 hours, then serve.
recipes.text: Next Best Thing To Robert Redford #1. Mix butter, flour and pecans until combined; pat in oblong baking dish (9 x 13-inch or close). Bake for 15 minutes at 350°. Let cool. Mix with beater the cream cheese, sugar and Cool Whip; spread over cooled crust. Whip together the milk and pudding; spread on cream cheese mixture. Spread small container of chocolate Cool Whip over pudding mixture. Refrigerate 2 hours, then serve.

recipes.title: Granny Oyzort'S Fresh Apple Cake
directions: Cream the eggs, sugar and margarine.
Add diced apples and vanilla.
Mix in dry ingredients.
Bake in an 18 1/2 x 11-inch pan until brown and springy to touch.
recipes.text: Granny Oyzort'S Fresh Apple Cake. Cream the eggs, sugar and margarine. Add diced apples and vanilla. Mix in dry ingredients. Bake in an 18 1/2 x 11-inch pan until brown and springy to touch.

recipes.title: Cheese Cake
directions: Combine cream cheese and sugar; beat until smooth.
Add eggs and beat until well mixed; pour into crust.
Bake 30 minutes at 350°.
recipes.text: Cheese Cake. Combine cream cheese and sugar; beat until smooth. Add eggs and beat until well mixed; pour into crust. Bake 30 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Rice Krispies Squares
directions: Combine peanut butter, sugar and syrup in medium heavy saucepan.
Bring to boil over low heat and boil 3 minutes, stirring constantly, to keep from sticking.
Remove from heat and add Rice Krispies.
Pat into buttered 9 x 13-inch pan. Cool and cut into squares.
recipes.text: Peanut Butter Rice Krispies Squares. Combine peanut butter, sugar and syrup in medium heavy saucepan. Bring to boil over low heat and boil 3 minutes, stirring constantly, to keep from sticking. Remove from heat and add Rice Krispies. Pat into buttered 9 x 13-inch pan. Cool and cut into squares.

recipes.title: Dj'S Quick Macaroni Casserole
ingredients: 1 lb. ground meat, thoroughly cooked and drained
1 (8 oz.) pkg. macaroni, cooked and drained
directions: Combine ingredients.
Bring to a near boil.
Simmer 15 minutes.
Add salt and pepper to taste.
recipes.text: Dj'S Quick Macaroni Casserole. Combine ingredients. Bring to a near boil. Simmer 15 minutes. Add salt and pepper to taste.

recipes.title: French Toast(Low Cholesterol)
directions: Whisk the first 5 ingredients together in bowl until well beaten.
Soak bread in milk mixture on both sides.
Fry in nonstick pan or griddle until lightly browned on both sides, but still moist inside.
Serve with maple syrup, orange marmalade or powdered sugar.
recipes.text: French Toast(Low Cholesterol). Whisk the first 5 ingredients together in bowl until well beaten. Soak bread in milk mixture on both sides. Fry in nonstick pan or griddle until lightly browned on both sides, but still moist inside. Serve with maple syrup, orange marmalade or powdered sugar.

recipes.title: Ice Ring
ingredients: 1 c. fresh strawberries with tops or 1 c. frozen strawberries without sugar
other fruits (grapes, sliced, oranges, limes, peaches or nectarines, can be used depending on punch)
directions: In 2-quart nonmetal container, combine lemonade and water; mix well.
Pour mixture in a 6 cup mold.
Freeze until slushy, about 2 to 3 hours.
Place strawberries in slush, allowing tops of strawberries to show.
Freeze until firm or overnight.
Remove ice from mold; wrap in plastic wrap and store in freezer until ready for use.
recipes.text: Ice Ring. In 2-quart nonmetal container, combine lemonade and water; mix well. Pour mixture in a 6 cup mold. Freeze until slushy, about 2 to 3 hours. Place strawberries in slush, allowing tops of strawberries to show. Freeze until firm or overnight. Remove ice from mold; wrap in plastic wrap and store in freezer until ready for use.

recipes.title: Easy Steak And Rice
directions: Trim fat from steak. Cut steak into 1/2-inch strips. Heat 1 tablespoon oil in skillet over medium-high heat. Add steak and brown. Remove steak from skillet. Add remaining oil. Add onions and garlic and cook, stirring, until onion is tender and transparent. Return steak to pan. Add soy sauce, sugar and water. Cover and simmer over low heat for 1 hour or until steak is tender, adding more water if needed. Serve meat and pan drippings over rice. Makes 4 to 6 servings.
recipes.text: Easy Steak And Rice. Trim fat from steak. Cut steak into 1/2-inch strips. Heat 1 tablespoon oil in skillet over medium-high heat. Add steak and brown. Remove steak from skillet. Add remaining oil. Add onions and garlic and cook, stirring, until onion is tender and transparent. Return steak to pan. Add soy sauce, sugar and water. Cover and simmer over low heat for 1 hour or until steak is tender, adding more water if needed. Serve meat and pan drippings over rice. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

recipes.title: Stewed Chicken In Gravy
ingredients: 1 (10 1/2 oz.) can condensed cream of celery soup or mushroom soup
directions: Cut
chicken
into
frying pieces.
Pour soup and water into large saucepan.
Add chicken and a dash of pepper.
Cover and simmer until tender, about 1 hour.
Add butter during last 10 minutes of cooking.
The combination of the chicken flavor with the
other
ingredients
will
yield
a delicious stewed chicken with
a rich savory gravy.
Serve in a large crockery dish, piping hot.
Hot split biscuits or rolls make an excellent base for smothering with this delicious gravy.
recipes.text: Stewed Chicken In Gravy. Cut chicken into frying pieces. Pour soup and water into large saucepan. Add chicken and a dash of pepper. Cover and simmer until tender, about 1 hour. Add butter during last 10 minutes of cooking. The combination of the chicken flavor with the other ingredients will yield a delicious stewed chicken with a rich savory gravy. Serve in a large crockery dish, piping hot. Hot split biscuits or rolls make an excellent base for smothering with this delicious gravy.

recipes.title: Zucchini Casserole
ingredients: 1 can cream of chicken soup, undiluted
directions: Mix stuffing with oleo; cook zucchini slightly and drain well. Combine zucchini, half the stuffing mixture, carrots, onion, soup and sour cream.
Place in lightly greased baking dish. Sprinkle other half of stuffing mixture over top.
Sprinkle with grated cheese.
Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.
recipes.text: Zucchini Casserole. Mix stuffing with oleo; cook zucchini slightly and drain well. Combine zucchini, half the stuffing mixture, carrots, onion, soup and sour cream. Place in lightly greased baking dish. Sprinkle other half of stuffing mixture over top. Sprinkle with grated cheese. Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Punch Bowl Cake
ingredients: 1 large and 1 small box instant vanilla pudding mix
1 large and 1 small can crushed pineapple, drained
1 carton Cool Whip, can use light, if desired
directions: Tear 1/2 of cake into small pieces and layer bowl.
Put 1/2 of prepared pudding mix over cake.
Put 1 can of pie filling over pudding.
Put 1/2 of drained pineapple over pudding.
Repeat all 4 layers as above.
Refrigerate over night and top with Cool Whip just before serving.
If you want to make a smaller cake use, 1 large box pudding, 1 can pie filling and 1 large can crushed pineapple, drained.
recipes.text: Punch Bowl Cake. Tear 1/2 of cake into small pieces and layer bowl. Put 1/2 of prepared pudding mix over cake. Put 1 can of pie filling over pudding. Put 1/2 of drained pineapple over pudding. Repeat all 4 layers as above. Refrigerate over night and top with Cool Whip just before serving. If you want to make a smaller cake use, 1 large box pudding, 1 can pie filling and 1 large can crushed pineapple, drained.

recipes.title: Outdoor Grilled Potatoes
directions: Tear aluminum foil into 4 pieces, about 10 x 10-inch squares. Add some potatoes, onion, salt and pepper to taste and a pat of butter.
Fold foil over potatoes and seal well.
Put foil-wrapped potatoes on hot outdoor grill, keeping them away from the fire itself, as much as possible.
Take about 30 minutes to cook on a hot grill, so put these on before you throw on the hamburgers, hot dogs or steaks.
recipes.text: Outdoor Grilled Potatoes. Tear aluminum foil into 4 pieces, about 10 x 10-inch squares. Add some potatoes, onion, salt and pepper to taste and a pat of butter. Fold foil over potatoes and seal well. Put foil-wrapped potatoes on hot outdoor grill, keeping them away from the fire itself, as much as possible. Take about 30 minutes to cook on a hot grill, so put these on before you throw on the hamburgers, hot dogs or steaks.

recipes.title: Apple And Yams
directions: Put in 7 x 11-inch baking dish.
Sprinkle with nutmeg and nuts.
Bake in 325° oven for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Apple And Yams. Put in 7 x 11-inch baking dish. Sprinkle with nutmeg and nuts. Bake in 325° oven for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Garden Vegetable Soup
ingredients: 1 c. sliced celery with some of the leafy green tops
9 medium size tomatoes or 2 cans (17 oz. each) tomatoes (undrained), strained to remove seeds
1/4 lb. green beans, washed, trimmed and cut into 1-inch pieces (1 c.)
1/2 lb. zucchini, cut in half lengthwise and thinly sliced (2 c.)
directions: Heat butter and oil in Dutch oven; saute carrots, celery, onion and garlic for 5 minutes.
Peel tomatoes; cut in half crosswise.
Place strainer over large bowl; remove seeds by squeezing gently.
Chop pulp and add to join in large bowl.
Add tomatoes and juice to Dutch oven.
Add oregano, basil, salt and pepper; cook 15 minutes.
Add beef broth and green beans; cook 30 minutes longer, adding zucchini and parsley after 20 minutes. Serve with Parmesan cheese.
recipes.text: Garden Vegetable Soup. Heat butter and oil in Dutch oven; saute carrots, celery, onion and garlic for 5 minutes. Peel tomatoes; cut in half crosswise. Place strainer over large bowl; remove seeds by squeezing gently. Chop pulp and add to join in large bowl. Add tomatoes and juice to Dutch oven. Add oregano, basil, salt and pepper; cook 15 minutes. Add beef broth and green beans; cook 30 minutes longer, adding zucchini and parsley after 20 minutes. Serve with Parmesan cheese.

recipes.title: Carter Peanut Butter Refrigerator Cake
directions: Combine and bake first 3 ingredients (press into a 9 x 12-inch pan) at 350° until light brown.
Cool completely.
Combine cream cheese, powdered sugar and peanut butter.
Beat until smooth. Fold in Cool Whip.
Spread over first layer.
Mix chocolate pudding, vanilla pudding and milk together.
Beat.
Spread over second layer.
Spread on Cool Whip over third layer.
Sprinkle with nuts.
Refrigerate all day.
recipes.text: Carter Peanut Butter Refrigerator Cake. Combine and bake first 3 ingredients (press into a 9 x 12-inch pan) at 350° until light brown. Cool completely. Combine cream cheese, powdered sugar and peanut butter. Beat until smooth. Fold in Cool Whip. Spread over first layer. Mix chocolate pudding, vanilla pudding and milk together. Beat. Spread over second layer. Spread on Cool Whip over third layer. Sprinkle with nuts. Refrigerate all day.

recipes.title: Banana Nut Bread
directions: Cream oleo, sugar and eggs; add sifted flour, soda and salt, then add vanilla, bananas, buttermilk and nuts.
Mix well.
Bake in well-greased and floured bread pan or small loaf pans.
Bake at 350° for 35 minutes or until done.
recipes.text: Banana Nut Bread. Cream oleo, sugar and eggs; add sifted flour, soda and salt, then add vanilla, bananas, buttermilk and nuts. Mix well. Bake in well-greased and floured bread pan or small loaf pans. Bake at 350° for 35 minutes or until done.

recipes.title: Banana Nut Bread
directions: Mix and cool first 2 ingredients.
Cream and add next 3 ingredients.
Add remaining ingredients.
Bake at 400° for 20 minutes.
recipes.text: Banana Nut Bread. Mix and cool first 2 ingredients. Cream and add next 3 ingredients. Add remaining ingredients. Bake at 400° for 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Cornbread Dressing
ingredients: 8 to 10 c. (two 8 x 8-inch pans) day old cornbread
1 c. broth from boiled giblets (if not baked in turkey)
directions: Mix ingredients and bake in turkey until turkey is done.
If baked separately, bake at 350° for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Cornbread Dressing. Mix ingredients and bake in turkey until turkey is done. If baked separately, bake at 350° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Italian Casserole
directions: Cook shells; rinse and drain.
Brown ground beef.
Add salt and pepper.
Stir in sauce (onions, black olives or fresh mushrooms are good in sauce).
Simmer 20 minutes.
Use two cake pans.
Line the bottoms with 1/2 the macaroni; cover shells with 1/2 meat sauce.
Spread 1/2 pint sour cream over sauce.
Sprinkle 1/2 of both cheeses.
Repeat 2nd layer.
Cover and bake 20 minutes or until cheese is melted and lightly brown.
recipes.text: Italian Casserole. Cook shells; rinse and drain. Brown ground beef. Add salt and pepper. Stir in sauce (onions, black olives or fresh mushrooms are good in sauce). Simmer 20 minutes. Use two cake pans. Line the bottoms with 1/2 the macaroni; cover shells with 1/2 meat sauce. Spread 1/2 pint sour cream over sauce. Sprinkle 1/2 of both cheeses. Repeat 2nd layer. Cover and bake 20 minutes or until cheese is melted and lightly brown.

recipes.title: Broccoli Casserole
ingredients: 1 can cream of celery soup or cream of mushroom soup
directions: Mix all ingredients together.
Place in a baking dish and bake for 1 hour at 350°.
ner: cream of celery soup or cream of mushroom soup
recipes.text: Broccoli Casserole. Mix all ingredients together. Place in a baking dish and bake for 1 hour at 350°.

recipes.title: Frozen Cranberry Salad
directions: Combine cream cheese, mayonnaise and sugar, stirring until smooth.
Add cranberry sauce, pineapple and pecans; blend well. Beat whipping cream until foamy.
Gradually add powdered sugar, beating until peaks form; add vanilla.
Fold whipped cream into cranberry mixture.
Spoon into 8-inch square glass pan.
Cover and freeze until firm.
Remove from freezer 15 minutes before cutting into squares and serving.
Makes 9 servings.
recipes.text: Frozen Cranberry Salad. Combine cream cheese, mayonnaise and sugar, stirring until smooth. Add cranberry sauce, pineapple and pecans; blend well. Beat whipping cream until foamy. Gradually add powdered sugar, beating until peaks form; add vanilla. Fold whipped cream into cranberry mixture. Spoon into 8-inch square glass pan. Cover and freeze until firm. Remove from freezer 15 minutes before cutting into squares and serving. Makes 9 servings.

recipes.title: Dave'S Deviled Potatoes
directions: Wash and cut potatoes into 4 pieces each.
Cover with boiling water.
Add salt and cook for 20 to 40 minutes, until tender when tested with a fork.
Drain.
Add softened butter and warm milk. Mash until free of lumps.
Heat the sour cream in a small saucepan over a low flame.
Add mustard and sugar to the sour cream.
Pour over the potatoes and mix well.
Heat in a 350° oven for 12 minutes.
recipes.text: Dave'S Deviled Potatoes. Wash and cut potatoes into 4 pieces each. Cover with boiling water. Add salt and cook for 20 to 40 minutes, until tender when tested with a fork. Drain. Add softened butter and warm milk. Mash until free of lumps. Heat the sour cream in a small saucepan over a low flame. Add mustard and sugar to the sour cream. Pour over the potatoes and mix well. Heat in a 350° oven for 12 minutes.

recipes.title: Pagachi Pizza
directions: Preheat oven to 400°.
Grease pizza pan.
Follow directions on pizza mix package.
Place dough in pan and work flat.
Spread butter on dough (if desired).
Mix together mashed potatoes and onion dip until smooth.
Place mixture on dough and spread evenly. Add onions, garlic and cheese to taste.
Bake in 400° oven 17 to 22 minutes until golden brown.
Slice and serve.
Makes 8 to 10 slices.
recipes.text: Pagachi Pizza. Preheat oven to 400°. Grease pizza pan. Follow directions on pizza mix package. Place dough in pan and work flat. Spread butter on dough (if desired). Mix together mashed potatoes and onion dip until smooth. Place mixture on dough and spread evenly. Add onions, garlic and cheese to taste. Bake in 400° oven 17 to 22 minutes until golden brown. Slice and serve. Makes 8 to 10 slices.

recipes.title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
directions: You also need wax paper.
recipes.text: Chocolate Chip Cookies. You also need wax paper.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Pie
directions: Sift powder sugar.
Add cream cheese; mixing well.
Fold in peanut butter and Cool Whip.
Pour into graham cracker crust and chill.
recipes.text: Peanut Butter Pie. Sift powder sugar. Add cream cheese; mixing well. Fold in peanut butter and Cool Whip. Pour into graham cracker crust and chill.

recipes.title: Cheese Ball Or Log
ingredients: garlic salt or powder to taste
directions: Mix all ingredients.
Shape into a ball or log.
Roll in chopped nuts.
recipes.text: Cheese Ball Or Log. Mix all ingredients. Shape into a ball or log. Roll in chopped nuts.

recipes.title: Strawberry Pretzel Salad
directions: Combine pretzels with butter and 3 tablespoons sugar; press into a 9 x 13-inch cake pan.
Bake 7 minutes at 400°.
Cool.
Mix softened cream cheese with Cool Whip and 1 cup sugar.
Spread over pretzel crust.
In a large bowl, mix jello, water, strawberries and pineapple.
Chill mixture until partially set.
Spread over cream cheese mixture.
Let chill a few hours before serving.
recipes.text: Strawberry Pretzel Salad. Combine pretzels with butter and 3 tablespoons sugar; press into a 9 x 13-inch cake pan. Bake 7 minutes at 400°. Cool. Mix softened cream cheese with Cool Whip and 1 cup sugar. Spread over pretzel crust. In a large bowl, mix jello, water, strawberries and pineapple. Chill mixture until partially set. Spread over cream cheese mixture. Let chill a few hours before serving.

recipes.title: Freezer Pickles
directions: Mix cucumber, pepper and onion in large bowl.
Mix other ingredients and pour over cucumbers.
Refrigerate for 24 hours. Put in plastic containers and freeze.
recipes.text: Freezer Pickles. Mix cucumber, pepper and onion in large bowl. Mix other ingredients and pour over cucumbers. Refrigerate for 24 hours. Put in plastic containers and freeze.

recipes.title: Rumaki
directions: Wrap a slice of bacon around each water chestnut and secure with toothpick.
Place in a shallow pan.
Mix soy sauce and brown sugar.
Pour over water chestnuts and marinate for 1 hour.
Broil in oven until bacon is cooked.
You will need to turn the water chestnuts so that all sides of the bacon cook.
Serve at once.
recipes.text: Rumaki. Wrap a slice of bacon around each water chestnut and secure with toothpick. Place in a shallow pan. Mix soy sauce and brown sugar. Pour over water chestnuts and marinate for 1 hour. Broil in oven until bacon is cooked. You will need to turn the water chestnuts so that all sides of the bacon cook. Serve at once.

recipes.title: Fruit Salad
directions: Drain but save fruit cocktail and pineapple juice.
Blend juice with instant pudding.
Fold in Cool Whip and fruit.
recipes.text: Fruit Salad. Drain but save fruit cocktail and pineapple juice. Blend juice with instant pudding. Fold in Cool Whip and fruit.

recipes.title: Raspberry Cake
ingredients: 10 oz. pkg. frozen red raspberries, thawed (do not drain)
directions: Mix all together. Bake in 13 x 9 pan at 325° for 50 minutes.
recipes.text: Raspberry Cake. Mix all together. Bake in 13 x 9 pan at 325° for 50 minutes.

recipes.title: Baked Chicken Reuben
ingredients: 4 whole broiler-fryer chicken breasts, halved and boned
1 (16 oz.) can sauerkraut, drained (press out excess liquid)
4 slices (each about 4 x 6-inches) natural Swiss cheese
1 1/4 c. bottled Thousand Island salad dressing
directions: In greased baking pan, place chicken.
Sprinkle with salt and pepper.
Place sauerkraut over chicken; top with Swiss cheese. Pour dressing evenly over cheese.
Cover with foil and bake in 325° oven for about 1 1/2 hours or until fork can be inserted in chicken with ease.
Sprinkle with chopped parsley to serve.
Makes 4 servings.
recipes.text: Baked Chicken Reuben. In greased baking pan, place chicken. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Place sauerkraut over chicken; top with Swiss cheese. Pour dressing evenly over cheese. Cover with foil and bake in 325° oven for about 1 1/2 hours or until fork can be inserted in chicken with ease. Sprinkle with chopped parsley to serve. Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: Pickle Relish
directions: Heat to boiling vinegar, sugar, turmeric, ground mustard, celery seed and salt.
Add cucumber mixture; let simmer for 15 to 20 minutes.
Put in cans and seal.
recipes.text: Pickle Relish. Heat to boiling vinegar, sugar, turmeric, ground mustard, celery seed and salt. Add cucumber mixture; let simmer for 15 to 20 minutes. Put in cans and seal.

recipes.title: Breakfast Casserole
ingredients: 4 oz. shredded reduced-fat sharp Cheddar cheese (1 c.)
1 (10 3/4 oz.) condensed cream of mushroom soup
1 (8 oz.) carton frozen egg product, thawed
directions: Cut bread into cubes.
Place in shallow baking dish.
Bake at 350° for 8 to 10 minutes, until toasted.
Spray a 12 x 7 x 2-inch baking dish.
Place half of bread cubes in dish.
Set aside.
recipes.text: Breakfast Casserole. Cut bread into cubes. Place in shallow baking dish. Bake at 350° for 8 to 10 minutes, until toasted. Spray a 12 x 7 x 2-inch baking dish. Place half of bread cubes in dish. Set aside.

recipes.title: Zucchini Bread
directions: Blend squash in blender.
If large, remove seeds and pulp. Mix eggs, oil, sugar, vanilla and squash.
Add rest of ingredients.
Pour in 2 loaf pans.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Zucchini Bread. Blend squash in blender. If large, remove seeds and pulp. Mix eggs, oil, sugar, vanilla and squash. Add rest of ingredients. Pour in 2 loaf pans. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Unpotato Salad(Low Carb)
ingredients: 1 large head cauliflower, cut into small chunks
directions: Put cauliflower in a microwave-safe casserole dish.
Add 1 Tbsp. water and cover.
Cook in microwave on high for 5 to 7 minutes and let stand, covered, another 3 to 5 minutes.
You want the cauliflower tender, but not mushy.
Drain cooked cauliflower and combine with celery and onion in a large bowl.
Combine mayonnaise, vinegar, salt, Splenda and pepper.
Pour mixture over vegetables and mix well.
Mix in chopped eggs last; only stir lightly to preserve some small chunks of yolk.
Chill and serve. Serves 12.
recipes.text: Unpotato Salad(Low Carb). Put cauliflower in a microwave-safe casserole dish. Add 1 Tbsp. water and cover. Cook in microwave on high for 5 to 7 minutes and let stand, covered, another 3 to 5 minutes. You want the cauliflower tender, but not mushy. Drain cooked cauliflower and combine with celery and onion in a large bowl. Combine mayonnaise, vinegar, salt, Splenda and pepper. Pour mixture over vegetables and mix well. Mix in chopped eggs last; only stir lightly to preserve some small chunks of yolk. Chill and serve. Serves 12.

recipes.title: Cinnamon Logs
directions: Cut off crust and roll bread flat.
Spread cream cheese mix (cream cheese, sugar, vanilla and egg yolk) on bread and roll up. Place in freezer for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Cinnamon Logs. Cut off crust and roll bread flat. Spread cream cheese mix (cream cheese, sugar, vanilla and egg yolk) on bread and roll up. Place in freezer for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Meat Loaf
directions: Mix all together well bake till done at 350.
recipes.text: Meat Loaf. Mix all together well bake till done at 350.

recipes.title: Uncooked Fruit Cake
directions: Mix together all the ingredients except milk, marshmallows, red and green cherries and nuts.
In double boiler put the evaporated milk and marshmallows; melt together.
Add to graham cracker mixture.
Press into well-greased 3-quart round casserole dish.
Place in refrigerator for 12 hours.
Decorate the top of cake with alternate rows of red and green cherries and row of walnuts or pecans.
recipes.text: Uncooked Fruit Cake. Mix together all the ingredients except milk, marshmallows, red and green cherries and nuts. In double boiler put the evaporated milk and marshmallows; melt together. Add to graham cracker mixture. Press into well-greased 3-quart round casserole dish. Place in refrigerator for 12 hours. Decorate the top of cake with alternate rows of red and green cherries and row of walnuts or pecans.

recipes.title: Pan Seared Salmon(With Mushroom Reduction)
ingredients: 1/4 c. white wine (use a white wine you would drink, as opposed to cooking wine which may be too salty)
directions: Heat 2 Tbsp. of the oil, add chopped scallions and saute in a large frying pan until nearly cooked.
Add garlic and saute until soft.
Add mushrooms and chicken broth.
Simmer until liquid is reduced by half.
Transfer to a small saucepan, but do not clean out the frying pan (any liquid still coating the side of the pan will add to the flavor of the salmon).
recipes.text: Pan Seared Salmon(With Mushroom Reduction). Heat 2 Tbsp. of the oil, add chopped scallions and saute in a large frying pan until nearly cooked. Add garlic and saute until soft. Add mushrooms and chicken broth. Simmer until liquid is reduced by half. Transfer to a small saucepan, but do not clean out the frying pan (any liquid still coating the side of the pan will add to the flavor of the salmon).

recipes.title: Fried Squash Patties
directions: Mix all ingredients and fry in hot skillet, turning once. Easy to make.
Even squash haters will like it.
recipes.text: Fried Squash Patties. Mix all ingredients and fry in hot skillet, turning once. Easy to make. Even squash haters will like it.

recipes.title: Sour Cream Pound Cake
directions: Sift flour, baking powder and salt 3 or 4 times (important). Cream butter and sugar; add eggs, one at a time, beating good. Add vanilla.
Fold in flour, alternating with sour cream.
Bake 1 hour and 20 minutes at 300°.
recipes.text: Sour Cream Pound Cake. Sift flour, baking powder and salt 3 or 4 times (important). Cream butter and sugar; add eggs, one at a time, beating good. Add vanilla. Fold in flour, alternating with sour cream. Bake 1 hour and 20 minutes at 300°.

recipes.title: Mary'S Pound Cake
directions: Separate whites from yolks of eggs, beat yellows until very light.
Add sugar and beat until it is dissolved, then add softened butter.
Add flour that has been sifted with a pinch of salt.
Beat well, add flavoring and fold in stiffly beaten egg whites.
Bake in 9-inch funnel pan, lined with wax paper, for about an hour and 15 minutes at moderate heat.
Test cake at an hour's baking with ice pick to determine balance of time needed for baking.
recipes.text: Mary'S Pound Cake. Separate whites from yolks of eggs, beat yellows until very light. Add sugar and beat until it is dissolved, then add softened butter. Add flour that has been sifted with a pinch of salt. Beat well, add flavoring and fold in stiffly beaten egg whites. Bake in 9-inch funnel pan, lined with wax paper, for about an hour and 15 minutes at moderate heat. Test cake at an hour's baking with ice pick to determine balance of time needed for baking.

recipes.title: Dream Bars
directions: Mix first 3 ingredients together and pat into 8-inch square pan, ungreased.
Mix next 6 ingredients together and add coconut and nuts.
Pour over crust.
recipes.text: Dream Bars. Mix first 3 ingredients together and pat into 8-inch square pan, ungreased. Mix next 6 ingredients together and add coconut and nuts. Pour over crust.

recipes.title: Garbanzo And Rice Soup
directions: In a 4-quart saucepan, saute the onion and garlic in the butter until translucent.
Add the garbanzos and the liquid from the can, the chicken stock, rice, parsley and tomato paste.
Heat just to a boil.
Add the cheese and serve at once.
Makes 2 to 4 servings.
recipes.text: Garbanzo And Rice Soup. In a 4-quart saucepan, saute the onion and garlic in the butter until translucent. Add the garbanzos and the liquid from the can, the chicken stock, rice, parsley and tomato paste. Heat just to a boil. Add the cheese and serve at once. Makes 2 to 4 servings.

recipes.title: Dora'S Small Wonders
directions: Crush wafers fine. Add raisins, milk and finely chopped nuts. Mix well. Press mixture evenly into a greased 9 x 11 pan. Cover with foil and place in refrigerator for 24 hours. Cut into 1-inch squares and roll pieces in powdered sugar. These are wonderful. I sometimes substitute chocolate chips for raisins.
recipes.text: Dora'S Small Wonders. Crush wafers fine. Add raisins, milk and finely chopped nuts. Mix well. Press mixture evenly into a greased 9 x 11 pan. Cover with foil and place in refrigerator for 24 hours. Cut into 1-inch squares and roll pieces in powdered sugar. These are wonderful. I sometimes substitute chocolate chips for raisins.

recipes.title: Super Bowl Chicken
directions: Saute chicken in butter in a skillet.
Place chicken in casserole.
Saute mushrooms and add to chicken.
Add flour to skillet, stir and add chicken broth to thicken.
Pour sauce over chicken and add artichokes.
Set aside and watch 3 quarters of the game.
Then heat oven to 350°.
recipes.text: Super Bowl Chicken. Saute chicken in butter in a skillet. Place chicken in casserole. Saute mushrooms and add to chicken. Add flour to skillet, stir and add chicken broth to thicken. Pour sauce over chicken and add artichokes. Set aside and watch 3 quarters of the game. Then heat oven to 350°.

recipes.title: Busy Day Chicken
directions: Scatter raw rice in bottom of greased casserole.
Lay chicken, skin side up, on top.
Mix soups and water and pour over chicken. Bake 2 hours at 350°.
Serves 4 to 6.
recipes.text: Busy Day Chicken. Scatter raw rice in bottom of greased casserole. Lay chicken, skin side up, on top. Mix soups and water and pour over chicken. Bake 2 hours at 350°. Serves 4 to 6.

recipes.title: Monkey Bread
directions: Cut biscuits in fourths.
Shake bag with sugar and cinnamon. Layer in a greased tube pan.
Sprinkle nuts between layers.
Melt brown sugar and margarine, pour on top.
Bake at 350° for 35 minutes.
Let stand 10 minutes and then serve.
recipes.text: Monkey Bread. Cut biscuits in fourths. Shake bag with sugar and cinnamon. Layer in a greased tube pan. Sprinkle nuts between layers. Melt brown sugar and margarine, pour on top. Bake at 350° for 35 minutes. Let stand 10 minutes and then serve.

recipes.title: Quiche
ingredients: 1/2 lb. Swiss cheese, cubed or sliced
directions: Fry and crumble bacon.
Fry onions in bacon fat.
Divide between crusts.
Layer cheese on top.
Beat together eggs, cream and seasonings.
Pour into crusts.
Bake at 450° for 10 minutes, then turn to 325° for 20 minutes or until set.
Freezes well after baking.
Can be cut frozen and heated as individual pieces.
recipes.text: Quiche. Fry and crumble bacon. Fry onions in bacon fat. Divide between crusts. Layer cheese on top. Beat together eggs, cream and seasonings. Pour into crusts. Bake at 450° for 10 minutes, then turn to 325° for 20 minutes or until set. Freezes well after baking. Can be cut frozen and heated as individual pieces.

recipes.title: Super Shrimp
directions: In boiling water, cook shrimp 2 to 3 minutes until shrimp are pink.
Cool, peel and devein, leaving tails on as handles.
Place in double freezer bags.
Pour the bottle of Italian dressing over the shrimp in bag.
Close bags and marinate in refrigerator several hours or overnight.
recipes.text: Super Shrimp. In boiling water, cook shrimp 2 to 3 minutes until shrimp are pink. Cool, peel and devein, leaving tails on as handles. Place in double freezer bags. Pour the bottle of Italian dressing over the shrimp in bag. Close bags and marinate in refrigerator several hours or overnight.

recipes.title: Rolls
directions: Mix together.
Add flour to consistency.
Let dough rise once; knead down.
Let rise second time; roll out and cut with glass. Place in pan.
Let rise again and bake at 375° until done.
recipes.text: Rolls. Mix together. Add flour to consistency. Let dough rise once; knead down. Let rise second time; roll out and cut with glass. Place in pan. Let rise again and bake at 375° until done.

recipes.title: Country Morning Scramble
ingredients: 1/4 c. roasted garlic butter (Land O' Lakes)
4 c. frozen potatoes O'Brien (hash browns with bell pepper and onion
directions: Heat garlic butter in large skillet.
Add potatoes and cook until potatoes are tender. Sprinkle with bacon and stir.
Beat together the eggs, water, seasoning, and parsley. Add to skillet and scramble until eggs are set.
Stir in sour cream and cheese. Serve warm.
recipes.text: Country Morning Scramble. Heat garlic butter in large skillet. Add potatoes and cook until potatoes are tender. Sprinkle with bacon and stir. Beat together the eggs, water, seasoning, and parsley. Add to skillet and scramble until eggs are set. Stir in sour cream and cheese. Serve warm.

recipes.title: Sliced Baked Potatoes
directions: Peel potatoes if tough, otherwise just scrub and rinse.
Cut potatoes into thin slices but not all the way through.
Put potatoes in baking dish.
Fan them slightly.
Sprinkle with salt; drizzle with butter and sprinkle with herbs.
Bake at 425° for about 50 minutes.
Remove from oven.
Sprinkle with cheeses. Return to oven for another 10 to 15 minutes, until lightly browned, cheeses are melted and potatoes are soft inside.
Check for fork.
recipes.text: Sliced Baked Potatoes. Peel potatoes if tough, otherwise just scrub and rinse. Cut potatoes into thin slices but not all the way through. Put potatoes in baking dish. Fan them slightly. Sprinkle with salt; drizzle with butter and sprinkle with herbs. Bake at 425° for about 50 minutes. Remove from oven. Sprinkle with cheeses. Return to oven for another 10 to 15 minutes, until lightly browned, cheeses are melted and potatoes are soft inside. Check for fork.

recipes.title: Rhubarb Jam
ingredients: 3 (3 oz.) boxes Jell-O (cherry, strawberry or raspberry)
directions: Mix sugar and rhubarb.
Let stand until liquid forms, then cook 10 minutes after starting to boil.
While still on heat, add Jell-O and stir for 5 minutes until dissolved.
Pour into hot sterilized jars and seal.
Makes 2 pints and 6 quilted jelly jars. Can be used on ice cream and many others.
recipes.text: Rhubarb Jam. Mix sugar and rhubarb. Let stand until liquid forms, then cook 10 minutes after starting to boil. While still on heat, add Jell-O and stir for 5 minutes until dissolved. Pour into hot sterilized jars and seal. Makes 2 pints and 6 quilted jelly jars. Can be used on ice cream and many others.

recipes.title: Beef Or Pork Tamales
ingredients: 2 lb. boneless rump roast, beef round or pork
10 dried chilies (chile de ristra) or whole chile pequin
directions: Cream the lard until it is very soft.

Add the flour, little by little, and continue beating either by hand or with a mixer. Add broth as needed, the salt, baking powder and cumin. Keep the dough soft but not too wet. Put the corn husks to soak in hot water and rinse them well.
recipes.text: Beef Or Pork Tamales. Cream the lard until it is very soft. Add the flour, little by little, and continue beating either by hand or with a mixer. Add broth as needed, the salt, baking powder and cumin. Keep the dough soft but not too wet. Put the corn husks to soak in hot water and rinse them well.

recipes.title: Hills And Humps
directions: Preheat oven to 450°.
Melt butter in a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Beat eggs with electric mixer.
Add flour, 1/3 cup milk and hot butter from pan. Add remaining milk and salt.
Continue to blend with electric mixer.
Pour into prepared pan and bake for 20 minutes. Take out of oven.
Pancake will collapse. Cut into squares and serve with warm maple syrup or warmed fruit.
recipes.text: Hills And Humps. Preheat oven to 450°. Melt butter in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Beat eggs with electric mixer. Add flour, 1/3 cup milk and hot butter from pan. Add remaining milk and salt. Continue to blend with electric mixer. Pour into prepared pan and bake for 20 minutes. Take out of oven. Pancake will collapse. Cut into squares and serve with warm maple syrup or warmed fruit.

recipes.title: Vegetable Pizza(Lo-Fat)
ingredients: 1 (8 oz.) pkg. fat-free cream cheese (such as Philadelphia Free), softened
1 (.4 oz.) packet of Hidden Valley Ranch original buttermilk recipe dressing mix
1 (10 oz.) can Kroger hot and fresh pizza crust (in refrigerator case)
directions: Several hours ahead:
Combine softened cream cheese and mayonnaise in a medium-size bowl; stir until smooth.
Add the dressing mix; blend well.
Cover and refrigerate 4 hours or overnight.
recipes.text: Vegetable Pizza(Lo-Fat). Several hours ahead: Combine softened cream cheese and mayonnaise in a medium-size bowl; stir until smooth. Add the dressing mix; blend well. Cover and refrigerate 4 hours or overnight.

recipes.title: Hungarian Noodles And Cabbage(Galooshka)
ingredients: 1 small head of cabbage, shredded in food processor
egg noodles or "No Yolks" egg noodles substitute
directions: Add enough olive oil to coat the bottom of a nonstick skillet. Heat oil, add cabbage, onion, salt and pepper; saute until cabbage is browned.
Cook, rinse and drain noodles.
Return noodles to pan they were cooked in.
Add cabbage mixture and stir until completely mixed.
recipes.text: Hungarian Noodles And Cabbage(Galooshka). Add enough olive oil to coat the bottom of a nonstick skillet. Heat oil, add cabbage, onion, salt and pepper; saute until cabbage is browned. Cook, rinse and drain noodles. Return noodles to pan they were cooked in. Add cabbage mixture and stir until completely mixed.

recipes.title: Brownies
directions: Beat eggs, sugar and margarine.
Add coconut and flour; beat well.
Stir in vanilla.
Spread mixture in a well-greased 8-inch square pan.
Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.
Set aside to cool and then enjoy!
recipes.text: Brownies. Beat eggs, sugar and margarine. Add coconut and flour; beat well. Stir in vanilla. Spread mixture in a well-greased 8-inch square pan. Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes. Set aside to cool and then enjoy!

recipes.title: Garlic Bubble Bread
directions: Combine butter, egg, parsley, salt and garlic.
Cut dough into walnut sized pieces.
Dip dough into butter mixture.
Place in well-greased loaf pan.
Cover.
Let rise until doubled in size. Bake at 375° for 30 minutes.
Remove from pan; cool on rack. Butter top while still warm.
Serves 6 to 8.
recipes.text: Garlic Bubble Bread. Combine butter, egg, parsley, salt and garlic. Cut dough into walnut sized pieces. Dip dough into butter mixture. Place in well-greased loaf pan. Cover. Let rise until doubled in size. Bake at 375° for 30 minutes. Remove from pan; cool on rack. Butter top while still warm. Serves 6 to 8.

recipes.title: Linda'S Peach Cake
ingredients: 1 box white or yellow cake mix
directions: Layer ingredients in order in a 9 x 13 baking dish.
Bake at 350 for 45 to 60 minutes.
recipes.text: Linda'S Peach Cake. Layer ingredients in order in a 9 x 13 baking dish. Bake at 350 for 45 to 60 minutes.

recipes.title: Baked Chicken And Rice-A-Roni
directions: Prepare Rice-A-Roni according to directions 1 and 2 on package. Pour rice mixture into a 13 x 9 inch pan which has been sprayed with Pam. Place raw chicken on top of rice; sprinkle paprika on chicken. Cover with foil and bake at 350° for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Baked Chicken And Rice-A-Roni. Prepare Rice-A-Roni according to directions 1 and 2 on package. Pour rice mixture into a 13 x 9 inch pan which has been sprayed with Pam. Place raw chicken on top of rice; sprinkle paprika on chicken. Cover with foil and bake at 350° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Pizza Pepperoni
directions: Mix all ingredients together.
Pour into a greased 8 x 8-inch pan. Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes. Cut into squares when cooled.
recipes.text: Pizza Pepperoni. Mix all ingredients together. Pour into a greased 8 x 8-inch pan. Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes. Cut into squares when cooled.

recipes.title: Raisin Bread
directions: Cream butter and sugar; add eggs.
Mix dry ingredients.
Mix lemon juice and vanilla with milk.
Mix dry ingredients with liquid alternately to butter and sugar mixture.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour or until tester comes out clean.
recipes.text: Raisin Bread. Cream butter and sugar; add eggs. Mix dry ingredients. Mix lemon juice and vanilla with milk. Mix dry ingredients with liquid alternately to butter and sugar mixture. Bake at 350° for 1 hour or until tester comes out clean.

recipes.title: Chicken Delight
directions: Boil chicken until it turns white.
While chicken is cooking, mix rice, water, butter, vegetables and mushrooms in a casserole dish.
Mix in chopped chicken and bake at 350° for 1 hour or until rice is done.
recipes.text: Chicken Delight. Boil chicken until it turns white. While chicken is cooking, mix rice, water, butter, vegetables and mushrooms in a casserole dish. Mix in chopped chicken and bake at 350° for 1 hour or until rice is done.

recipes.title: Chicken Spaghetti
ingredients: 1 (2 lb.) box Velveeta cheese, cut into chunks
directions: Boil chicken until done; reserve the chicken broth.
Debone chicken and cut into pieces.
Saute celery and onions in butter until done.
Cook spaghetti in the reserved broth until done.
Add celery, onions, soup, cheese and chicken to spaghetti and broth. Cook until cheese is melted.
Serve hot.
recipes.text: Chicken Spaghetti. Boil chicken until done; reserve the chicken broth. Debone chicken and cut into pieces. Saute celery and onions in butter until done. Cook spaghetti in the reserved broth until done. Add celery, onions, soup, cheese and chicken to spaghetti and broth. Cook until cheese is melted. Serve hot.

recipes.title: Pineapple Stuffing
directions: Combine sugar and butter.
Beat in eggs; add pineapple and bread.
Bake in 2-quart buttered Pyrex dish at 350° for 1 hour. Can be served hot or cold.
recipes.text: Pineapple Stuffing. Combine sugar and butter. Beat in eggs; add pineapple and bread. Bake in 2-quart buttered Pyrex dish at 350° for 1 hour. Can be served hot or cold.

recipes.title: Crab Muffins
directions: Combine all ingredients.
Spread on English muffins.
Place on cookie sheet under broiler until lightly brown.
Cut into quarters and serve.
recipes.text: Crab Muffins. Combine all ingredients. Spread on English muffins. Place on cookie sheet under broiler until lightly brown. Cut into quarters and serve.

recipes.title: Scones
directions: Mix
flour,
baking
powder,
salt
and
sugar.
Cut in butter.
Add raisins and milk.
Fold in one stiffly beaten egg white.
Turn onto floured board and roll about 1/2-inch thick. Beat egg yolk and add 1 teaspoon water.
Brush over top.
Bake at 400° for 15 to 18 minutes until golden brown.
recipes.text: Scones. Mix flour, baking powder, salt and sugar. Cut in butter. Add raisins and milk. Fold in one stiffly beaten egg white. Turn onto floured board and roll about 1/2-inch thick. Beat egg yolk and add 1 teaspoon water. Brush over top. Bake at 400° for 15 to 18 minutes until golden brown.

recipes.title: Sour Cream Pound Cake
directions: Mix eggs, sugar and sour cream.
Add flour, soda and flavoring.
Bake at 325° for 1 hour or until toothpick comes out clean.
recipes.text: Sour Cream Pound Cake. Mix eggs, sugar and sour cream. Add flour, soda and flavoring. Bake at 325° for 1 hour or until toothpick comes out clean.

recipes.title: Party Pinwheels
directions: You will need party toothpicks.
Mix sour cream and Ranch dressing mix.
Spread onto tortillas; then roll tortilla.
Slice filled, rolled tortillas into bite-sized pieces, arranging on platter with party toothpicks.
Place picante sauce in serving bowl for dip.
recipes.text: Party Pinwheels. You will need party toothpicks. Mix sour cream and Ranch dressing mix. Spread onto tortillas; then roll tortilla. Slice filled, rolled tortillas into bite-sized pieces, arranging on platter with party toothpicks. Place picante sauce in serving bowl for dip.

recipes.title: Strawberry Congealed Salad
directions: Bring crushed pineapple with juice to a boil.
Add dry jello and stir until dissolved.
Remove from heat to cool.
When cooled, add buttermilk and then nuts.
Add Cool Whip last.
Stir until mixed well.
Refrigerate.
recipes.text: Strawberry Congealed Salad. Bring crushed pineapple with juice to a boil. Add dry jello and stir until dissolved. Remove from heat to cool. When cooled, add buttermilk and then nuts. Add Cool Whip last. Stir until mixed well. Refrigerate.

recipes.title: Guacamole Dip
directions: Saute the onion in oil until clear but not brown. Chop and mash the avocados and add to this the hard-boiled eggs which have been finely chopped. Add the onion with the oil in which it was cooked. Fold in the mayonnaise and stir all ingredients until well mixed. Serve chilled.
recipes.text: Guacamole Dip. Saute the onion in oil until clear but not brown. Chop and mash the avocados and add to this the hard-boiled eggs which have been finely chopped. Add the onion with the oil in which it was cooked. Fold in the mayonnaise and stir all ingredients until well mixed. Serve chilled.

recipes.title: Two 9-Inch Pumpkin Pies
ingredients: 1 large can evaporated milk plus enough regular milk to fill a total of 3 c. altogether
directions: Thoroughly combine pumpkin, sugar, salt and spices.
Add beaten eggs and milks.
Blend.
Pour into 9-inch pastry-lined pie pans. Bake in a very hot oven (450°) for 10 minutes and then in a slow oven (325°) for 55 minutes or until mixture doesn't adhere to knife.
recipes.text: Two 9-Inch Pumpkin Pies. Thoroughly combine pumpkin, sugar, salt and spices. Add beaten eggs and milks. Blend. Pour into 9-inch pastry-lined pie pans. Bake in a very hot oven (450°) for 10 minutes and then in a slow oven (325°) for 55 minutes or until mixture doesn't adhere to knife.

recipes.title: Delicious Meat Loaf
directions: Combine first 9 ingredients and place in a casserole. Sprinkle cracker meal over top.
Cover with catsup.
Dot with butter.
Bake at 375° for 1/2 hour.
Uncover and continue baking 15 minutes longer.
recipes.text: Delicious Meat Loaf. Combine first 9 ingredients and place in a casserole. Sprinkle cracker meal over top. Cover with catsup. Dot with butter. Bake at 375° for 1/2 hour. Uncover and continue baking 15 minutes longer.

recipes.title: Peanut Brittle
directions: Mix syrup, sugar and water.
Cook until hard ball forms when dropped in cold water.
Add peanuts.
Cook until peanuts turn golden brown.
recipes.text: Peanut Brittle. Mix syrup, sugar and water. Cook until hard ball forms when dropped in cold water. Add peanuts. Cook until peanuts turn golden brown.

recipes.title: Chicken Pot Pie
directions: Mix the first 4 ingredients together and pour into a 9 x 13-inch greased pan. Mix together flour and milk until smooth. Melt butter and add to flour milk mixture. Spread this mixture over vegetables. Bake at 400° for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Chicken Pot Pie. Mix the first 4 ingredients together and pour into a 9 x 13-inch greased pan. Mix together flour and milk until smooth. Melt butter and add to flour milk mixture. Spread this mixture over vegetables. Bake at 400° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Continal Chicken
directions: Season chicken with all seasoning.
Slice chicken into small strips.
Roll then in a circle wrapped in bacon.
Layer one layer of chicken in bottom of crock-pot, then one layer of dried beef. Mix the soup and sour cream together in a large bowl.
Now a layer of the soup mixture and then layer again as before making sure you end up with the soup mixture on top.
Cook on low in the crock for 7 or 8 hours.
recipes.text: Continal Chicken. Season chicken with all seasoning. Slice chicken into small strips. Roll then in a circle wrapped in bacon. Layer one layer of chicken in bottom of crock-pot, then one layer of dried beef. Mix the soup and sour cream together in a large bowl.
