Now a layer of the soup mixture and then layer again as before making sure you end up with the soup mixture on top. Cook on low in the crock for 7 or 8 hours.

recipes.title: Ham Loaf
ingredients: 4 lb. meat (1/2 ground pork and 1/2 ground ham)
directions: Bake at 350° for 3 hours.
recipes.text: Ham Loaf. Bake at 350° for 3 hours.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Cookies
directions: Cream the butter and sugar until light and fluffy.
Beat in egg, pumpkin and vanilla.
Mix and sift the flour, baking powder, soda, salt and spices.
Add to creamed mixture; mix well.
Add almonds and chocolate chips; mix thoroughly.
Drop by spoonfuls onto greased cookie sheet.
Bake at 350° for 15 minutes.
recipes.text: Pumpkin Cookies. Cream the butter and sugar until light and fluffy. Beat in egg, pumpkin and vanilla. Mix and sift the flour, baking powder, soda, salt and spices. Add to creamed mixture; mix well. Add almonds and chocolate chips; mix thoroughly. Drop by spoonfuls onto greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350° for 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Cherry Winks
directions: Sift flour, baking powder, baking soda and salt.
Combine shortening and sugar; mix well.
Blend in eggs; add milk and vanilla.
Blend in sifted dry ingredients; mix well.
Add pecans, dates and cherries; mix well.
Shape into balls using 1 tablespoon dough for 1 cookie.
Roll each ball of dough in cornflakes.
Place on greased cookie sheet.
Top each cookie with 1/4 cherry.
Bake in moderate oven at 375° for 10 to 12 minutes.
Do not stack or store until cold.
Makes 5 dozen cookies.
recipes.text: Cherry Winks. Sift flour, baking powder, baking soda and salt. Combine shortening and sugar; mix well. Blend in eggs; add milk and vanilla. Blend in sifted dry ingredients; mix well. Add pecans, dates and cherries; mix well. Shape into balls using 1 tablespoon dough for 1 cookie. Roll each ball of dough in cornflakes. Place on greased cookie sheet. Top each cookie with 1/4 cherry. Bake in moderate oven at 375° for 10 to 12 minutes. Do not stack or store until cold. Makes 5 dozen cookies.

recipes.title: Hamburger Dish
directions: Brown and drain hamburger meat; add tomato sauce and enchilada sauce.
Place a layer of meat mixture in bowl.
Add a layer of corn chips, then a layer of cheese.
Repeat with meat mixture, corn chips and top with cheese.
Use onions, if preferred.
recipes.text: Hamburger Dish. Brown and drain hamburger meat; add tomato sauce and enchilada sauce. Place a layer of meat mixture in bowl. Add a layer of corn chips, then a layer of cheese. Repeat with meat mixture, corn chips and top with cheese. Use onions, if preferred.

recipes.title: Strawberry Delight
directions: Crumble angel food cake in bowl. Mix cream cheese and
Cool Whip together and add to cake.
Pat into 13 x 9 pan and add strawberries to glaze and then pour over cake mixture.
Chill.
recipes.text: Strawberry Delight. Crumble angel food cake in bowl. Mix cream cheese and Cool Whip together and add to cake. Pat into 13 x 9 pan and add strawberries to glaze and then pour over cake mixture. Chill.

recipes.title: Apple Smothered Pork Chops
directions: Season chops with salt, pepper and sage. Brown in small amount of oil.
Remove from skillet.
Stir flour into skillet.
Stir in water, vinegar and raisins. Arrange chops in casserole top with apple slices.
Pour molasses over apples and add flour mixture. Bake covered for 1 hour and 30 minutes at 350°.
recipes.text: Apple Smothered Pork Chops. Season chops with salt, pepper and sage. Brown in small amount of oil. Remove from skillet. Stir flour into skillet. Stir in water, vinegar and raisins. Arrange chops in casserole top with apple slices. Pour molasses over apples and add flour mixture. Bake covered for 1 hour and 30 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Raspberry Salad
directions: Dissolve 1 package of Jell-O with 3/4 cup water.
Add half the pineapple, half the bananas and half the berries.
Pour into a 9 x 12-inch pan.
Chill until thickened.
Spread sour cream over this. Mix remaining ingredients as previously stated and pour over top. Let set.
recipes.text: Raspberry Salad. Dissolve 1 package of Jell-O with 3/4 cup water. Add half the pineapple, half the bananas and half the berries. Pour into a 9 x 12-inch pan. Chill until thickened. Spread sour cream over this. Mix remaining ingredients as previously stated and pour over top. Let set.

recipes.title: Cold Slaw
directions: Mix the listed ingredients and let set in refrigerator for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Cold Slaw. Mix the listed ingredients and let set in refrigerator for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Pork Chops And Rice
directions: Preheat oven to
In
roasting pan (or cake pan), mix uncooked rice, 2
cans
cream
of
mushroom soup and 1 1/2 cups of water.
Mix well.
Place seasoned pork chops on top of rice mixture.
Top
with
onion
slices and bell pepper rings. Bake 30 to 45 minutes
until
pork chops are brown and rice is tender.
recipes.text: Pork Chops And Rice. Preheat oven to 350°. In roasting pan (or cake pan), mix uncooked rice, 2 cans cream of mushroom soup and 1 1/2 cups of water. Mix well. Place seasoned pork chops on top of rice mixture. Top with onion slices and bell pepper rings. Bake 30 to 45 minutes until pork chops are brown and rice is tender.

recipes.title: Sour Cream Twists
directions: Sprinkle yeast into warm water.
Combine flour, margarine, sour cream, eggs, salt and vanilla in a large bowl.
Stir in dissolved yeast.
Beat until smooth.
Cover with foil or plastic. Refrigerate at least 2 hours or up to two days.
Combine sugar and cinnamon and sprinkle some on board.
Roll dough in rectangle 15 x 18-inches. Turn so both sides are coated.
Fold over 3 times, like a letter, using cinnamon and sugar.
Roll into rectangle 1/4-inch thick again using all the sugar.
Cut into 1 x 4-inch strips.
Twist and place on greased baking sheet.
Bake in 375° oven for 15 minutes.
recipes.text: Sour Cream Twists. Sprinkle yeast into warm water. Combine flour, margarine, sour cream, eggs, salt and vanilla in a large bowl. Stir in dissolved yeast. Beat until smooth. Cover with foil or plastic. Refrigerate at least 2 hours or up to two days. Combine sugar and cinnamon and sprinkle some on board. Roll dough in rectangle 15 x 18-inches. Turn so both sides are coated. Fold over 3 times, like a letter, using cinnamon and sugar. Roll into rectangle 1/4-inch thick again using all the sugar. Cut into 1 x 4-inch strips. Twist and place on greased baking sheet. Bake in 375° oven for 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Baked Banana Squash
directions: Cut squash pieces into about 4 x 6-inch pieces.
Brush melted butter evenly inside part of the squash.
Sprinkle nutmeg and 1 tablespoon brown sugar over each piece of squash.
Place in shallow pan in oven.
Preheat oven to 350°.
Bake for 45 minutes or until tender.
Serves 6.
recipes.text: Baked Banana Squash. Cut squash pieces into about 4 x 6-inch pieces. Brush melted butter evenly inside part of the squash. Sprinkle nutmeg and 1 tablespoon brown sugar over each piece of squash. Place in shallow pan in oven. Preheat oven to 350°. Bake for 45 minutes or until tender. Serves 6.

recipes.title: Barbecue Sauce
ingredients: 4 Tbsp. dark brown sugar, firmly packed
directions: Remove seeds from all peppers
Place ingredients in food processor or blender and puree.
Store in an airtight container in refrigerator until ready to use.
Makes about 2 cups.
recipes.text: Barbecue Sauce. Remove seeds from all peppers Place ingredients in food processor or blender and puree. Store in an airtight container in refrigerator until ready to use. Makes about 2 cups.

recipes.title: Crispy Baked Veggies
ingredients: 1/3 c. Progresso Italian style bread crumbs
1 lb. raw veggies (mushrooms, cauliflower, zucchini, potatoes, green beans (raw), cut into bite-sized pieces
directions: Preheat oven to 500°.
In bowl, combine bread crumbs, Parmesan cheese, salt, garlic powder and pepper.
Place flour in a separate bowl.
Whisk egg and water in a third bowl.
Dip veggies in flour, then egg, then bread crumbs.
Place on lightly greased baking sheet.
Drizzle with oil.
Bake 22 to 24 minutes total; turn after 12 minutes.
Need to be tender and lightly bronze.
recipes.text: Crispy Baked Veggies. Preheat oven to 500°. In bowl, combine bread crumbs, Parmesan cheese, salt, garlic powder and pepper. Place flour in a separate bowl. Whisk egg and water in a third bowl. Dip veggies in flour, then egg, then bread crumbs. Place on lightly greased baking sheet. Drizzle with oil. Bake 22 to 24 minutes total; turn after 12 minutes. Need to be tender and lightly bronze.

recipes.title: Lemon Lush
directions: Mix margarine, flour and nuts.
Put into 9 x 13-inch pan; press into place.
Bake at 350° for 10 to 15 minutes.
Cool. Blend cream cheese and Cool Whip (reserve some for topping). Spread over crust.
Mix pudding and milk.
Put this over cream cheese layer.
Top with Cool Whip and garnish with nuts if desired.
Refrigerate.
recipes.text: Lemon Lush. Mix margarine, flour and nuts. Put into 9 x 13-inch pan; press into place. Bake at 350° for 10 to 15 minutes. Cool. Blend cream cheese and Cool Whip (reserve some for topping). Spread over crust. Mix pudding and milk. Put this over cream cheese layer. Top with Cool Whip and garnish with nuts if desired. Refrigerate.

recipes.title: Cabbage Patch Stew
ingredients: 1 can stewed tomatoes (or Ro-Tel if you like it hot)
directions: Cook and drain ground beef as if making tacos.
Add remaining ingredients.
(Add water if needed.)
Simmer for 1 hour or longer. Serves 4 to 6 people.
Serve with cornbread.
recipes.text: Cabbage Patch Stew. Cook and drain ground beef as if making tacos. Add remaining ingredients. (Add water if needed.) Simmer for 1 hour or longer. Serves 4 to 6 people. Serve with cornbread.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Cheesecake
directions: Preheat oven to 350°.
Combine	crumbs and butter, press onto bottom
of	9-inch	 spring-form
pan.
Bake
minutes. Combine cream cheese, sugar, pumpkin, vanilla, spices and salt; mixing at medium speed until well
blended.
Add eggs, one at a time, mixing well after each
addition.	Pour over crust.
Bake 1 hour and 30 minutes.
Loosen
cake
from
rim.	Remove rim of pan.
Chill several hours or overnight.
recipes.text: Pumpkin Cheesecake. Preheat oven to 350°. Combine	crumbs and butter, press onto bottom of	9-inch	 spring-form pan. Bake 5 minutes. Combine cream cheese, sugar, pumpkin, vanilla, spices and salt; mixing at medium speed until well blended. Add eggs, one at a time, mixing well after each addition.	Pour over crust. Bake 1 hour and 30 minutes. Loosen cake from rim.	Remove rim of pan. Chill several hours or overnight.

recipes.title: Chocolate Logs
directions: Mix first 6 ingredients together well.
Melt butter and pour over mixture.
Make into logs.
Chill and dip.
recipes.text: Chocolate Logs. Mix first 6 ingredients together well. Melt butter and pour over mixture. Make into logs. Chill and dip.

recipes.title: Ground Pork And Shrimp Stir-Fry
directions: Cook
spaghetti
according to package directions, omitting the salt.
Combine soy sauce, cornstarch and 1 cup water; set aside. Heat
cooking
oil
in
wok or electric skillet on medium
high heat.
Thoroughly
cook pork with ginger, garlic and red
pepper. Add
green onion and stir-fry 1 minute.
Add soy sauce mixture; cook until mixture boils and thickens.
Add shrimp and heat through.
Pour over noodles.
Toss to combine.
recipes.text: Ground Pork And Shrimp Stir-Fry. Cook spaghetti according to package directions, omitting the salt. Combine soy sauce, cornstarch and 1 cup water; set aside. Heat cooking oil in wok or electric skillet on medium high heat. Thoroughly cook pork with ginger, garlic and red pepper. Add green onion and stir-fry 1 minute. Add soy sauce mixture; cook until mixture boils and thickens. Add shrimp and heat through. Pour over noodles. Toss to combine.

recipes.title: Dried Apple Or Stack Cake
directions: Cream butter, sugar and eggs.
(Add eggs one at a time.) Measure and sift dry ingredients; add to egg-sugar mixture alternately with milk.
recipes.text: Dried Apple Or Stack Cake. Cream butter, sugar and eggs. (Add eggs one at a time.) Measure and sift dry ingredients; add to egg-sugar mixture alternately with milk.

recipes.title: Fried Chicken With Herbs
ingredients: 2 skinless chicken breast halves (each about 1/2 lb.)
directions: Place the chicken pieces in a bowl with 1 cup of the buttermilk. Cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hour or up to 18 hours. Preheat an oven to 400°.
recipes.text: Fried Chicken With Herbs. Place the chicken pieces in a bowl with 1 cup of the buttermilk. Cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hour or up to 18 hours. Preheat an oven to 400°.

recipes.title: Cheese Loaf
directions: Beat eggs and sugar; add salt, butter, vinegar and milk and cook until thickened (in double boiler).
Add cheese, pimentos and cracker crumbs.
Mix well and pour into greased mold.
Bake 40 minutes at 400°.
recipes.text: Cheese Loaf. Beat eggs and sugar; add salt, butter, vinegar and milk and cook until thickened (in double boiler). Add cheese, pimentos and cracker crumbs. Mix well and pour into greased mold. Bake 40 minutes at 400°.

recipes.title: Fool 'Em Every Time Lemon Cake
directions: Prepare a yellow cake mix according to package directions and bake in a 9 x 13 x 2-inch glass baking dish (greased and floured). While cake is baking, mix powdered sugar with bottled lemon juice (mixture will be thin).
When cake is done, while it's hot, carefully poke holes all over top of cake with fork.
Pour icing mixture evenly over cake.
recipes.text: Fool 'Em Every Time Lemon Cake. Prepare a yellow cake mix according to package directions and bake in a 9 x 13 x 2-inch glass baking dish (greased and floured). While cake is baking, mix powdered sugar with bottled lemon juice (mixture will be thin). When cake is done, while it's hot, carefully poke holes all over top of cake with fork. Pour icing mixture evenly over cake.

recipes.title: Vichysquash
ingredients: 1 c. light cream or half and half
directions: Saute onion in butter until clear.
Add broth and cut up squash; cook until tender.
Puree squash when cool; season and add cream when cold.
Sprinkle top with chives.
Can be served hot or cold.
recipes.text: Vichysquash. Saute onion in butter until clear. Add broth and cut up squash; cook until tender. Puree squash when cool; season and add cream when cold. Sprinkle top with chives. Can be served hot or cold.

recipes.title: Vinegar Taffy Candy
directions: Combine ingredients and cook to hard ball stage.
Pour onto oiled platter.
When cool enough to handle, pull until light colored and porous.
Stretch taffy into a rope and cut off in 1-inch pieces with scissors.
recipes.text: Vinegar Taffy Candy. Combine ingredients and cook to hard ball stage. Pour onto oiled platter. When cool enough to handle, pull until light colored and porous. Stretch taffy into a rope and cut off in 1-inch pieces with scissors.

recipes.title: Nut Bread
directions: Mix sugar with eggs, then add milk.
Stir in flour with the salt and baking powder.
Add nuts.
Bake 1 hour at 350°.
recipes.text: Nut Bread. Mix sugar with eggs, then add milk. Stir in flour with the salt and baking powder. Add nuts. Bake 1 hour at 350°.

recipes.title: Meat-Potato Quiche
ingredients: 1 c. grated Swiss or Cheddar cheese
3/4 c. cooked, diced chicken, ham, browned sausage, etc.
directions: In 9-inch pie pan, stir together oil and potatoes.
Press evenly into pie crust shape.
Bake at 425° for 15 minutes. Remove from oven.
recipes.text: Meat-Potato Quiche. In 9-inch pie pan, stir together oil and potatoes. Press evenly into pie crust shape. Bake at 425° for 15 minutes. Remove from oven.

recipes.title: Williamsburg Tea Bread
directions: Set oven at 300°.
Beat eggs and sugar together until creamy. Add flour, salt and baking powder.
Stir in dates, nuts and vanilla by hand.
Spoon into greased 9 1/2 x 4 1/2
x 2 1/4-inch loaf pan.
Cover with foil and bake on middle shelf for 1 1/2 hours.
Increase heat to 325°, remove foil and bake another 15 to 20 minutes, until a toothpick comes out clean when inserted into middle of the cake.
Turn out and cool completely before slicing.
recipes.text: Williamsburg Tea Bread. Set oven at 300°. Beat eggs and sugar together until creamy. Add flour, salt and baking powder. Stir in dates, nuts and vanilla by hand. Spoon into greased 9 1/2 x 4 1/2 x 2 1/4-inch loaf pan. Cover with foil and bake on middle shelf for 1 1/2 hours. Increase heat to 325°, remove foil and bake another 15 to 20 minutes, until a toothpick comes out clean when inserted into middle of the cake. Turn out and cool completely before slicing.

recipes.title: Fruit Punch
directions: Mix well and pour over ice.
Serve.
recipes.text: Fruit Punch. Mix well and pour over ice. Serve.

recipes.title: Chocolate Cherry Cake
ingredients: 1 can dark sweet cherries in water and corn syrup
directions: Mix cake mix and cherry juice.
Add eggs and extract.
Mix with spoon and fold in cherries.
Pour into greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan.
Bake at 350° for 35 minutes.
recipes.text: Chocolate Cherry Cake. Mix cake mix and cherry juice. Add eggs and extract. Mix with spoon and fold in cherries. Pour into greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350° for 35 minutes.

recipes.title: Sure Thing Brownies
directions: Grease 13 x 9-inch baking pan. Mix all ingredients in a bowl. Blend for 2 minutes. Add nuts. Beat for 1 more minute. Pour into pan. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Sure Thing Brownies. Grease 13 x 9-inch baking pan. Mix all ingredients in a bowl. Blend for 2 minutes. Add nuts. Beat for 1 more minute. Pour into pan. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Asparagus And Cheese Soup
directions: Using a food processor, puree together the potatoes, asparagus, milk and sour cream.
Pour into a saucepan with the chicken or vegetable stock and heat gently.
Add the Cheddar cheese to the pan; add salt and pepper to taste.
Serve with crusty bread. Serves 2.
recipes.text: Asparagus And Cheese Soup. Using a food processor, puree together the potatoes, asparagus, milk and sour cream. Pour into a saucepan with the chicken or vegetable stock and heat gently. Add the Cheddar cheese to the pan; add salt and pepper to taste. Serve with crusty bread. Serves 2.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Cookies
directions: Cream shortening and peanut butter.
Add brown and white sugar, egg and then dry ingredients (sifted together).
Add vanilla.
recipes.text: Peanut Butter Cookies. Cream shortening and peanut butter. Add brown and white sugar, egg and then dry ingredients (sifted together). Add vanilla.

recipes.title: Homemade Marshmallows
directions: Put jello into bowl.
Add water and stir until dissolved. Stir in corn syrup.
Let mix sit.
When thick, whip until fluffy. Let sit.
Cut into cubes and roll in white sugar.
recipes.text: Homemade Marshmallows. Put jello into bowl. Add water and stir until dissolved. Stir in corn syrup. Let mix sit. When thick, whip until fluffy. Let sit. Cut into cubes and roll in white sugar.

recipes.title: Moms Fried Squash
directions: Peel squash cut in 1/4 slices. In another bowl beat eggs add milk salt and pepper. Dip squash in milk; then corn meal. Fry at 350° for 6 minutes.
recipes.text: Moms Fried Squash. Peel squash cut in 1/4 slices. In another bowl beat eggs add milk salt and pepper. Dip squash in milk; then corn meal. Fry at 350° for 6 minutes.

recipes.title: Pork Chop Casserole
directions: Place pork chops in large baking dish (13 x 9) sprayed with Pam. Mix soup, broth and rice. Pour over the pork chops. Bake at 350° for 1 hour and 15 minutes.
recipes.text: Pork Chop Casserole. Place pork chops in large baking dish (13 x 9) sprayed with Pam. Mix soup, broth and rice. Pour over the pork chops. Bake at 350° for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Broccoli Salad
directions: Combine following and pour over veggies:
sugar, salad dressing, mustard, oil, vinegar and salt and pepper.
recipes.text: Broccoli Salad. Combine following and pour over veggies: sugar, salad dressing, mustard, oil, vinegar and salt and pepper.

recipes.title: Kraft Caramel Dessert
directions: Mix graham crackers, sugar, margarine and nuts.
Press into oblong pan.
Bake 10 minutes at 350°.
Cool.
recipes.text: Kraft Caramel Dessert. Mix graham crackers, sugar, margarine and nuts. Press into oblong pan. Bake 10 minutes at 350°. Cool.

recipes.title: Deep Fried Fish
directions: Heat oil in a frying pan on high heat.
Mix flour, salt, seasoning salt and Accent in a Ziploc bag.
Then place some of the fish with mixture and shake.
Finally, take out floured fish and place them in hot oil.
Fry until golden brown, or light brown. Last, when done, take out and place in bowl.
(Repeat process until all of fish is done.)
recipes.text: Deep Fried Fish. Heat oil in a frying pan on high heat. Mix flour, salt, seasoning salt and Accent in a Ziploc bag. Then place some of the fish with mixture and shake. Finally, take out floured fish and place them in hot oil. Fry until golden brown, or light brown. Last, when done, take out and place in bowl. (Repeat process until all of fish is done.)

recipes.title: Alma Todd'S Homemade Bread
ingredients: 5 to 6 c. Pillsbury's Best bread flour
directions: Grease two 8 x 4-inch or 9 x 5-inch loaf pans.	Lightly spoon flour into	measuring
cup; level off.
In a large bowl, combine 2 cups flour, sugar, salt and yeast; blend well.
In a small pan heat water and oil until very warm.
Add warm liquid to flour mixture.
Blend at low speed until moistened.
Beat 3 minutes at medium speed.
Stir
in
additional 2 1/2 to 3 cups flour, until dough
pulls cleanly away from sides of bowl.
On floured surface, knead
dough
about 10 minutes or until dough is smooth and elastic with blisters under the surface.
Place dough in greased bowl;
cover
loosely
with plastic wrap and cloth towel.
Let rise
in warm place until light and doubled in size, about 1 1/2 hours.
recipes.text: Alma Todd'S Homemade Bread. Grease two 8 x 4-inch or 9 x 5-inch loaf pans.	Lightly spoon flour into	measuring cup; level off. In a large bowl, combine 2 cups flour, sugar, salt and yeast; blend well. In a small pan heat water and oil until very warm. Add warm liquid to flour mixture. Blend at low speed until moistened. Beat 3 minutes at medium speed. Stir in additional 2 1/2 to 3 cups flour, until dough pulls cleanly away from sides of bowl. On floured surface, knead dough about 10 minutes or until dough is smooth and elastic with blisters under the surface. Place dough in greased bowl; cover loosely with plastic wrap and cloth towel. Let rise in warm place until light and doubled in size, about 1 1/2 hours.

recipes.title: Carolyn'S Muffins
ingredients: 1 c. quick oats (or 3/4 c. oats and 1/4 c. bran)
directions: Beat egg, then add ingredients listed.
Mix until moist.
Fill greased muffin pans or bake cups 3/4 full.
Bake at 400° for 15 to 20 minutes.
Makes 12.
recipes.text: Carolyn'S Muffins. Beat egg, then add ingredients listed. Mix until moist. Fill greased muffin pans or bake cups 3/4 full. Bake at 400° for 15 to 20 minutes. Makes 12.

recipes.title: Apple Cream Cheese Coffee Cake
directions: Cut cream cheese and margarine into baking mix.
Stir in milk. Turn dough onto cloth covered surface well dusted with baking mix; gently roll in baking mix to coat.
Knead lightly 8 to 10 times.
Roll into rectangle, 12 x 8-inches; place on lightly greased cookie sheet.
Spread Cream Cheese Filling down center of rectangle.
Make cuts, 2 1/2-inches long at 1-inch intervals on 12-inch sides of rectangle.
Fold strips ove filling, overlapping. Mix sugar and cinnamon; sprinkle over top.
Cover and refrigerate up to 24 hours.
recipes.text: Apple Cream Cheese Coffee Cake. Cut cream cheese and margarine into baking mix. Stir in milk. Turn dough onto cloth covered surface well dusted with baking mix; gently roll in baking mix to coat. Knead lightly 8 to 10 times. Roll into rectangle, 12 x 8-inches; place on lightly greased cookie sheet. Spread Cream Cheese Filling down center of rectangle. Make cuts, 2 1/2-inches long at 1-inch intervals on 12-inch sides of rectangle. Fold strips ove filling, overlapping. Mix sugar and cinnamon; sprinkle over top. Cover and refrigerate up to 24 hours.

recipes.title: Pistachio Salad
directions: Drain pineapple slightly.
In medium bowl, combine pineapple, pudding, Cool Whip, marshmallows and walnuts.
Mix until all are well blended.
Green food coloring may be added to enhance the color.
May be served immediately or placed in refrigerator.
recipes.text: Pistachio Salad. Drain pineapple slightly. In medium bowl, combine pineapple, pudding, Cool Whip, marshmallows and walnuts. Mix until all are well blended. Green food coloring may be added to enhance the color. May be served immediately or placed in refrigerator.

recipes.title: Pork Chops And Rice
directions: Brown chops in oil; remove chops and season to taste.
Brown pepper and onion.
In baking dish add rice, water, vegetables and seasonings.
Mix well.
Place chops on top.
Cover and cook 30 to 45 minutes or until rice is tender.
recipes.text: Pork Chops And Rice. Brown chops in oil; remove chops and season to taste. Brown pepper and onion. In baking dish add rice, water, vegetables and seasonings. Mix well. Place chops on top. Cover and cook 30 to 45 minutes or until rice is tender.

recipes.title: Pizza Lasagna
directions: In large skillet, brown ground beef, green pepper, onion and Italian seasoning.
Drain.
Add soup and pizza sauce.
Mix together.
recipes.text: Pizza Lasagna. In large skillet, brown ground beef, green pepper, onion and Italian seasoning. Drain. Add soup and pizza sauce. Mix together.

recipes.title: Banana Split Cake
ingredients: 1 large box instant pudding mix (vanilla; regular or sugar-free)
directions: Mix together cracker crumbs and margarine.
Press in bottom of 13 x 8 x 2-inch Pyrex dish.
Prepare pudding mix according to package directions and spread over crust.
Slice bananas over mixture; spread pineapple over the bananas and then spread with Cool Whip.
Sprinkle nuts and cherries on top.
Cover and refrigerate overnight.
Bananas will not turn dark.
recipes.text: Banana Split Cake. Mix together cracker crumbs and margarine. Press in bottom of 13 x 8 x 2-inch Pyrex dish. Prepare pudding mix according to package directions and spread over crust. Slice bananas over mixture; spread pineapple over the bananas and then spread with Cool Whip. Sprinkle nuts and cherries on top. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Bananas will not turn dark.

recipes.title: Panocha
ingredients: 1 c. medium cream or evaporated milk
directions: Combine sugars and salt in saucepan; add 1/2 cream.
Cook, stirring until sugars dissolve.
Cover sugar mixture and cook 2 minutes.
Remove cover.
Stir constantly and add remaining cream gradually so sugar mixture never stops boiling.
Cook panocha syrup until soft ball forms in icy-cold to lukewarm water.
Add flavoring and beat until panocha is creamy.
Pour panocha into shallow 8-inch pan; mark into squares when almost cool.
recipes.text: Panocha. Combine sugars and salt in saucepan; add 1/2 cream. Cook, stirring until sugars dissolve. Cover sugar mixture and cook 2 minutes. Remove cover. Stir constantly and add remaining cream gradually so sugar mixture never stops boiling. Cook panocha syrup until soft ball forms in icy-cold to lukewarm water. Add flavoring and beat until panocha is creamy. Pour panocha into shallow 8-inch pan; mark into squares when almost cool.

recipes.title: Baked Beans
directions: Mix all ingredients except for bacon.
Place in baking dish and lay strips of bacon over top.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until bacon is done.
recipes.text: Baked Beans. Mix all ingredients except for bacon. Place in baking dish and lay strips of bacon over top. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until bacon is done.

recipes.title: Cucumber Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 large cucumber, peeled, quartered and seeded
directions: Cream mayonnaise and cheese together.
Add lemon juice.
Chop cucumber very fine and add to cheese mixture.
Add remaining ingredients plus a dash of Tabasco, garlic salt and seasoned pepper.
Chill and serve on bread.
recipes.text: Cucumber Sandwiches. Cream mayonnaise and cheese together. Add lemon juice. Chop cucumber very fine and add to cheese mixture. Add remaining ingredients plus a dash of Tabasco, garlic salt and seasoned pepper. Chill and serve on bread.

recipes.title: Palm Beach Burgers
directions: *The egg helps to hold the meat together.
recipes.text: Palm Beach Burgers. *The egg helps to hold the meat together.

recipes.title: Blueberry Salad
directions: 1st Layer:
Six ounce package of
raspberry jello, 2 cups boiling water and 2 cups cold water.
recipes.text: Blueberry Salad. 1st Layer: Six ounce package of raspberry jello, 2 cups boiling water and 2 cups cold water.

recipes.title: Corn-Cheese Casserole
ingredients: 2 (15 oz. each) cans whole kernel corn, drained
directions: Mix corn, 1 cup cheese and onion.
Add remaining ingredients, except remaining cheese.
Mix well.
Pour mixture in lightly greased 1 1/2-quart baking dish.
Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 40 minutes.
Add remaining cheese and bake an additional 5 minutes or until cheese melts.
Makes 6 servings.
recipes.text: Corn-Cheese Casserole. Mix corn, 1 cup cheese and onion. Add remaining ingredients, except remaining cheese. Mix well. Pour mixture in lightly greased 1 1/2-quart baking dish. Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 40 minutes. Add remaining cheese and bake an additional 5 minutes or until cheese melts. Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Chocolate Covered Balls
directions: Melt butter and peanut butter in double boiler.
Remove from heat, stir in sugar.
Roll into 1-inch balls.
Chill for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Chocolate Covered Balls. Melt butter and peanut butter in double boiler. Remove from heat, stir in sugar. Roll into 1-inch balls. Chill for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Cheese Sauce
directions: Melt butter; blend in flour and stir in milk.
Add other ingredients.
Stir over low to medium heat until smooth.
Serve over cooked vegetables.
recipes.text: Cheese Sauce. Melt butter; blend in flour and stir in milk. Add other ingredients. Stir over low to medium heat until smooth. Serve over cooked vegetables.

recipes.title: Chicken Pot Pie
directions: Grease shallow 2-quart dish.
Place vegetables and chicken in dish.
Stir together broth, soup, salt and pepper.
Pour over chicken.
Combine flour, milk and margarine.
Stir until smooth. Pour over mixture.
Bake in 400° oven for 40 to 50 minutes.
recipes.text: Chicken Pot Pie. Grease shallow 2-quart dish. Place vegetables and chicken in dish. Stir together broth, soup, salt and pepper. Pour over chicken. Combine flour, milk and margarine. Stir until smooth. Pour over mixture. Bake in 400° oven for 40 to 50 minutes.

recipes.title: Zucchini Bread
ingredients: 4 c. shredded zucchini (do not shred zucchini in blender)
directions: Heat oven to 325°.
Grease generously bottoms only of 2 loaf pans (9 x 5 x 3-inches).
Blend all ingredients on low speed one minute, scraping bowl constantly.
Beat on medium speed one minute.
Pour into pans.
Bake until wooden pick inserted in center comes out clean, 50 to 60 minutes.
Cool 10 minutes. Remove from pans.
Cool completely.
(If using self-rising flour, omit salt, baking soda and baking powder.)
recipes.text: Zucchini Bread. Heat oven to 325°. Grease generously bottoms only of 2 loaf pans (9 x 5 x 3-inches). Blend all ingredients on low speed one minute, scraping bowl constantly. Beat on medium speed one minute. Pour into pans. Bake until wooden pick inserted in center comes out clean, 50 to 60 minutes. Cool 10 minutes. Remove from pans. Cool completely. (If using self-rising flour, omit salt, baking soda and baking powder.)

recipes.title: Sausage Breakfast Casserole
ingredients: 1 1/2 c. cheese, grated (i.e., Old English sharp Cheddar)
directions: Remove crusts from bread.
Butter bread; place in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish.
Cook and crumble sausage until brown; drain. Spoon over bread slices.
Sprinkle with cheese.
Combine eggs with half and half and salt; mix well and pour over cheese. Cover; chill overnight.
Remove from refrigerator 15 minutes before baking.
Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 45 minutes, or until set.
Serves 8.
recipes.text: Sausage Breakfast Casserole. Remove crusts from bread. Butter bread; place in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Cook and crumble sausage until brown; drain. Spoon over bread slices. Sprinkle with cheese. Combine eggs with half and half and salt; mix well and pour over cheese. Cover; chill overnight. Remove from refrigerator 15 minutes before baking. Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 45 minutes, or until set. Serves 8.

recipes.title: Nachos
directions: Arrange Doritos on cookie sheets.
Place 1/2 to 1 pepper ring on each.
Sprinkle with cheese.
Broil 2 to 3 minutes, until cheese melts and serve immediately.
recipes.text: Nachos. Arrange Doritos on cookie sheets. Place 1/2 to 1 pepper ring on each. Sprinkle with cheese. Broil 2 to 3 minutes, until cheese melts and serve immediately.

recipes.title: Poppy Seed Chicken Casserole
directions: Boil chicken and
cut pieces from bone (or use boneless chicken breasts).
Melt
butter
and
keep
in
separate bowl. Crush one roll of
Ritz
crackers
and press in bottom of pan. Pour 1/2 of
the
butter
mixture
over
the crushed crackers. Break up the chicken pieces
and layer them in the dish on top of cracker crumbs.
Mix
sour cream and soup; pour over chicken. Crush next
roll
of
crackers
and
sprinkle
over
soup mixture. Pour remainder
of margarine over the top.
Sprinkle top with poppy seed.
Bake
for 30 to 40 minutes at 350° until bubbly. Serves 4 to 6.
recipes.text: Poppy Seed Chicken Casserole. Boil chicken and cut pieces from bone (or use boneless chicken breasts). Melt butter and keep in separate bowl. Crush one roll of Ritz crackers and press in bottom of pan. Pour 1/2 of the butter mixture over the crushed crackers. Break up the chicken pieces and layer them in the dish on top of cracker crumbs. Mix sour cream and soup; pour over chicken. Crush next roll of crackers and sprinkle over soup mixture. Pour remainder of margarine over the top. Sprinkle top with poppy seed. Bake for 30 to 40 minutes at 350° until bubbly. Serves 4 to 6.

recipes.title: Squash Casserole
ingredients: 1 (18 oz.) pkg. Pepperidge Farm cornbread dressing
directions: Steam the squash and onion until done. Mash the squash and onion and mix everything (except the dressing) in the squash mixture. Pour into an 8 x 10-inch dish. Pour dressing on top. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Squash Casserole. Steam the squash and onion until done. Mash the squash and onion and mix everything (except the dressing) in the squash mixture. Pour into an 8 x 10-inch dish. Pour dressing on top. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Chicken Spaghetti Casserole
directions: Boil chicken in water for 45 minutes.
Remove.
Boil spaghetti noodles in the same water.
Mix and saute onions, celery and peppers.
Then mix all ingredients together.
Place in a large casserole dish.
Bake for 30 minutes at 350°.
Remove.
Sprinkle with cheese.
Place in oven for 5 to 10 minutes, until cheese is melted.
recipes.text: Chicken Spaghetti Casserole. Boil chicken in water for 45 minutes. Remove. Boil spaghetti noodles in the same water. Mix and saute onions, celery and peppers. Then mix all ingredients together. Place in a large casserole dish. Bake for 30 minutes at 350°. Remove. Sprinkle with cheese. Place in oven for 5 to 10 minutes, until cheese is melted.

recipes.title: Cabbage Rolls
directions: Drop whole cabbage into boiling water in a large saucepan. Let stand about 5 minutes, until soft enough to separate the leaves.
Drain until cool enough to handle.
Cut out hard stem and carefully remove leaves, being sure to keep them as whole as possible.
Combine beef, rice, eggs, onion and salt; blend thoroughly.
Place a tablespoonful of mixture in the center of each cabbage leaf.
Roll leaf around meat and tuck in ends.
Place rolls close
together in skillet.
Combine vinegar, sugar, tomato sauce and water to make just enough sauce to cover rolls.
Cover tightly; simmer over low heat for 1 hour.
Remove cover; cook 15 minutes, until sauce is slightly thickened.
Serves 8.
recipes.text: Cabbage Rolls. Drop whole cabbage into boiling water in a large saucepan. Let stand about 5 minutes, until soft enough to separate the leaves. Drain until cool enough to handle. Cut out hard stem and carefully remove leaves, being sure to keep them as whole as possible. Combine beef, rice, eggs, onion and salt; blend thoroughly. Place a tablespoonful of mixture in the center of each cabbage leaf. Roll leaf around meat and tuck in ends. Place rolls close together in skillet. Combine vinegar, sugar, tomato sauce and water to make just enough sauce to cover rolls. Cover tightly; simmer over low heat for 1 hour. Remove cover; cook 15 minutes, until sauce is slightly thickened. Serves 8.

recipes.title: Olive Relish
directions: Chop olives into small pieces.
Saute onion in butter (olive oil is preferred).
Cool.
Combine all ingredients.
Store in refrigerator.
Serve on sandwiches, as accompaniment to beef or anywhere.
recipes.text: Olive Relish. Chop olives into small pieces. Saute onion in butter (olive oil is preferred). Cool. Combine all ingredients. Store in refrigerator. Serve on sandwiches, as accompaniment to beef or anywhere.

recipes.title: Jello Pudding Pops
ingredients: 1 small pkg. Jell-O instant pudding mix of choice
directions: Mix together until smooth and slightly thickened.
Pour into paper cups and place popsicle sticks into center.
Freeze and enjoy.
Great for picnics.
Use one and three pound coffee cans with ice and rock salt.
recipes.text: Jello Pudding Pops. Mix together until smooth and slightly thickened. Pour into paper cups and place popsicle sticks into center. Freeze and enjoy. Great for picnics. Use one and three pound coffee cans with ice and rock salt.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Roll
directions: Beat eggs at high speed for 3 minutes.
Gradually add sugar, beating well.
Add dry ingredients while continuing to beat.
Pour into jelly roll pan and bake at 375° for 15 minutes.
Turn out on cloth sprinkled with powdered sugar and roll up like jelly roll. Let cool.
Unroll and spread with filling and roll again.
recipes.text: Pumpkin Roll. Beat eggs at high speed for 3 minutes. Gradually add sugar, beating well. Add dry ingredients while continuing to beat. Pour into jelly roll pan and bake at 375° for 15 minutes. Turn out on cloth sprinkled with powdered sugar and roll up like jelly roll. Let cool. Unroll and spread with filling and roll again.

recipes.title: Ham Hot Dish
ingredients: 1 c. mayonnaise (can use less if desired)
directions: Combine all ingredients and bake for 30 minutes at 350°.
You may put extra Cheddar cheese on top and put back in the oven for 15 minutes more.
recipes.text: Ham Hot Dish. Combine all ingredients and bake for 30 minutes at 350°. You may put extra Cheddar cheese on top and put back in the oven for 15 minutes more.

recipes.title: Chili
ingredients: about 2 lb. or less ground chuck
directions: Brown meat and onion.
Drain grease.
Add remaining ingredients; bring to a boil.
Cover and cook for 1 hour on low.
recipes.text: Chili. Brown meat and onion. Drain grease. Add remaining ingredients; bring to a boil. Cover and cook for 1 hour on low.

recipes.title: Butterscotch Crunches
directions: Mix butterscotch morsels with peanut butter.
Mix all ingredients well; spoon onto wax paper and let cool.
recipes.text: Butterscotch Crunches. Mix butterscotch morsels with peanut butter. Mix all ingredients well; spoon onto wax paper and let cool.

recipes.title: Pralines
directions: Mix sugar, buttermilk, butter, soda and salt in a large pot. Cook over medium heat to "soft ball stage".
Remove from heat; add vanilla and nuts and beat to glaze stage and drop by teaspoonful onto waxed paper.
Let cool before removing.
recipes.text: Pralines. Mix sugar, buttermilk, butter, soda and salt in a large pot. Cook over medium heat to "soft ball stage". Remove from heat; add vanilla and nuts and beat to glaze stage and drop by teaspoonful onto waxed paper. Let cool before removing.

recipes.title: Blueberry Supreme
directions: Cook until thick, then add 2 more cups of blueberries and a little cinnamon.
Put mixture in ready prepared pie shell and chill.
recipes.text: Blueberry Supreme. Cook until thick, then add 2 more cups of blueberries and a little cinnamon. Put mixture in ready prepared pie shell and chill.

recipes.title: Creole Franks
directions: Brown wieners, onion, and pepper in skillet with margarine on med. high heat.
Add tomatoes and seasonings.
Cook on high until steam appears, then turn on low for 15 mins.
Serve over rice.
recipes.text: Creole Franks. Brown wieners, onion, and pepper in skillet with margarine on med. high heat. Add tomatoes and seasonings. Cook on high until steam appears, then turn on low for 15 mins. Serve over rice.

recipes.title: Salmon Croquettes
ingredients: 1 1/2 c. mashed potatoes prepared from instant flakes
directions: Prepare potatoes.
Drain salmon; remove bones and skin. Flake salmon into potatoes.
Add egg, pepper and crumbs.
Mix well; shape into patties. (Add more crumbs if needed.)
Pan fry in vegetable oil about 5 minutes on each side.
recipes.text: Salmon Croquettes. Prepare potatoes. Drain salmon; remove bones and skin. Flake salmon into potatoes. Add egg, pepper and crumbs. Mix well; shape into patties. (Add more crumbs if needed.) Pan fry in vegetable oil about 5 minutes on each side.

recipes.title: Chocolate Zucchini Cake
directions: Cream butter, oil and sugar.
Add eggs, vanilla and milk. Blend well.
Stir in all dry ingredients.
Stir in diced zucchini. Put into a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Sprinkle with chocolate chips and nuts.
Bake at 325° for 40 to 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Chocolate Zucchini Cake. Cream butter, oil and sugar. Add eggs, vanilla and milk. Blend well. Stir in all dry ingredients. Stir in diced zucchini. Put into a 9 x 13-inch pan. Sprinkle with chocolate chips and nuts. Bake at 325° for 40 to 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Beef Stroganoff
directions: Cut chuck roast into small pieces.
Put into ovensafe pan.
Mix onion soup mix, mushroom soup and 2 cans milk together.
Pour over chuck roast.
Bake at 325° for 2 hours and 45 minutes.
Remove from oven and turn off.
Mix sour cream in and return to off oven for 15 minutes.
Remove after 15 minutes and serve over buttered noodles.
recipes.text: Beef Stroganoff. Cut chuck roast into small pieces. Put into ovensafe pan. Mix onion soup mix, mushroom soup and 2 cans milk together. Pour over chuck roast. Bake at 325° for 2 hours and 45 minutes. Remove from oven and turn off. Mix sour cream in and return to off oven for 15 minutes. Remove after 15 minutes and serve over buttered noodles.

recipes.title: Easter Eggs
directions: In medium size mixing bowl, cream together butter, vanilla and salt.
Blend in sweetened condensed milk until smooth.
Gradually blend in sugar.
Blend well after each addition until mixture becomes very stiff.
Turn mixture from bowl onto a clean board. Carefully knead the remaining sugar until all is used.
Mixture should be smooth and not sticky.
Cut the mixture in half.
Roll out each piece into long lengths.
The length rolled out is determined by the thickness of the egg you want.
Cut the rolled out lengths into the size of the egg you want to make.
Form the cut edges to shape the eggs.
recipes.text: Easter Eggs. In medium size mixing bowl, cream together butter, vanilla and salt. Blend in sweetened condensed milk until smooth. Gradually blend in sugar. Blend well after each addition until mixture becomes very stiff. Turn mixture from bowl onto a clean board. Carefully knead the remaining sugar until all is used. Mixture should be smooth and not sticky. Cut the mixture in half. Roll out each piece into long lengths. The length rolled out is determined by the thickness of the egg you want. Cut the rolled out lengths into the size of the egg you want to make. Form the cut edges to shape the eggs.

recipes.title: Apple Cobbler
directions: Mix all ingredients together, adding fruit last.
Pour into baking dish.
Bake 30 minutes at 350°.
Serve warm with ice cream.
Other fruit can be used.
recipes.text: Apple Cobbler. Mix all ingredients together, adding fruit last. Pour into baking dish. Bake 30 minutes at 350°. Serve warm with ice cream. Other fruit can be used.

recipes.title: Broccoli Cheddar Chowder
ingredients: 1 (10 oz.) can condensed Cheddar cheese soup
directions: In a saucepan, combine milk and soup.
Cook and stir over medium heat until bubbly.
Stir in remaining ingredients.
Cook over low heat, about 30 minutes.
Yield: 6 servings.
recipes.text: Broccoli Cheddar Chowder. In a saucepan, combine milk and soup. Cook and stir over medium heat until bubbly. Stir in remaining ingredients. Cook over low heat, about 30 minutes. Yield: 6 servings.

recipes.title: Banana Smoothie
directions: Put milk, banana (in half), vanilla, ice cubes and sugar, if desired, into blender and blend for about 20 to 30 seconds.
Pour into glass and serve.
recipes.text: Banana Smoothie. Put milk, banana (in half), vanilla, ice cubes and sugar, if desired, into blender and blend for about 20 to 30 seconds. Pour into glass and serve.

recipes.title: Nut Roll
ingredients: 1 can Eagle Brand sweetened condensed milk
directions: Melt marshmallows and milk in double boiler.
Mix remaining ingredients and add marshmallow mixture.
Mix throughly.
Shape into rolls.
Place in wax paper and then wrap in foil.
Store in refrigerator.
Slice to serve.
recipes.text: Nut Roll. Melt marshmallows and milk in double boiler. Mix remaining ingredients and add marshmallow mixture. Mix throughly. Shape into rolls. Place in wax paper and then wrap in foil. Store in refrigerator. Slice to serve.

recipes.title: 6-Week Muffins
directions: In a large bowl, mix flour, baking soda, salt and sugar, being sure that baking powder is well blended.
Stir in the Raisin Bran, then the shortening, eggs and buttermilk.
Store in a tight container in the refrigerator.
Bake in greased muffin pans as desired at 400° for 15 to 20 minutes.
recipes.text: 6-Week Muffins. In a large bowl, mix flour, baking soda, salt and sugar, being sure that baking powder is well blended. Stir in the Raisin Bran, then the shortening, eggs and buttermilk. Store in a tight container in the refrigerator. Bake in greased muffin pans as desired at 400° for 15 to 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Strawberry Nut Salad
ingredients: 2 (10 oz.) pkg. frozen sliced strawberries, thawed
1 (1 lb. 4 oz.) can crushed pineapple, drained
directions: Combine boiling water and Jell-O until dissolved.
In separate bowl, combine strawberries, pineapple, bananas and walnuts.
Fold into gelatin.
Spread 1/2 mixture in 12 x 8 x 2-inch or 13 x 9-inch baking dish.
Refrigerate until firm, about 1 1/2 to 2 hours.
recipes.text: Strawberry Nut Salad. Combine boiling water and Jell-O until dissolved. In separate bowl, combine strawberries, pineapple, bananas and walnuts. Fold into gelatin. Spread 1/2 mixture in 12 x 8 x 2-inch or 13 x 9-inch baking dish. Refrigerate until firm, about 1 1/2 to 2 hours.

recipes.title: Deviled Food Cake
directions: Sift flour and measure; then sift flour, soda, salt and cocoa together 2 or 3 times.
Cream Crisco, sugar, egg, buttermilk and vanilla.
Mix dry and creamed mixtures and bake at 350° for 25 minutes or until done.
recipes.text: Deviled Food Cake. Sift flour and measure; then sift flour, soda, salt and cocoa together 2 or 3 times. Cream Crisco, sugar, egg, buttermilk and vanilla. Mix dry and creamed mixtures and bake at 350° for 25 minutes or until done.

recipes.title: Escalloped Corn
ingredients: 1 c. sharp shredded cheese for topping
directions: Drain the whole kernel corn and then mix all ingredients together, except cheese.
Bake in 9 x 13-inch well-greased dish after sprinkling cheese on top at 350° about 45 to 50 minutes or until set.
recipes.text: Escalloped Corn. Drain the whole kernel corn and then mix all ingredients together, except cheese. Bake in 9 x 13-inch well-greased dish after sprinkling cheese on top at 350° about 45 to 50 minutes or until set.

recipes.title: "Breakfast The Morning After" Quiche
directions: Brown sausage.
Cube or break bread in an oblong baking dish. Place sausage on top of bread.
Mix eggs, salt and milk in a bowl. Pour mixture over the bread and sausage.
Top with cheese. Mixture will be soupy.
Cover and put in refrigerator overnight. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes the following morning.
recipes.text: "Breakfast The Morning After" Quiche. Brown sausage. Cube or break bread in an oblong baking dish. Place sausage on top of bread. Mix eggs, salt and milk in a bowl. Pour mixture over the bread and sausage. Top with cheese. Mixture will be soupy. Cover and put in refrigerator overnight. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes the following morning.

recipes.title: Calzone
directions: Brown sausage with sliced green pepper and onion.
Rinse and drain well.
Mix meat with cheese.
Chill.
Divide loaves into 4 pieces, total 8.
Roll each piece in a circle.
Put approximately 1/2 cup of meat mixture on one-half of circle.
Fold other half over the meat.
Pinch ends together well.
Place on greased cookie sheet.
Bake at 425° for 15 to 20 minutes.
recipes.text: Calzone. Brown sausage with sliced green pepper and onion. Rinse and drain well. Mix meat with cheese. Chill. Divide loaves into 4 pieces, total 8. Roll each piece in a circle. Put approximately 1/2 cup of meat mixture on one-half of circle. Fold other half over the meat. Pinch ends together well. Place on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 425° for 15 to 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Hot Dog Sauce
directions: Combine all ingredients and cook until thick.
Serve on hot dogs in buns.
This is enough for one package of 10 hot dogs.
recipes.text: Hot Dog Sauce. Combine all ingredients and cook until thick. Serve on hot dogs in buns. This is enough for one package of 10 hot dogs.

recipes.title: Chocolate Cake
directions: Heat oven to 375°.
Mix well and bake 25 to 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Chocolate Cake. Heat oven to 375°. Mix well and bake 25 to 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Pineapple Carrots
ingredients: 3 large carrots (1/2 lb.), peeled and thinly sliced diagonally (2 1/2 c.)
1 can (8 oz.) unsweetened pineapple chunks, drained with juice reserved
directions: In a medium saucepan boil the carrots, water and salt, covered, until carrots are tender, about 8 minutes.
Turn into a strainer to drain.
Add cornstarch to the empty saucepan off heat; gradually stir in pineapple juice.
Cook gently, stirring constantly, until thickened.
Add carrots and pineapple and, if you like, a small amount (a generous tablespoon) of drained carrot liquid.
Heat. Makes 4 servings.
recipes.text: Pineapple Carrots. In a medium saucepan boil the carrots, water and salt, covered, until carrots are tender, about 8 minutes. Turn into a strainer to drain. Add cornstarch to the empty saucepan off heat; gradually stir in pineapple juice. Cook gently, stirring constantly, until thickened. Add carrots and pineapple and, if you like, a small amount (a generous tablespoon) of drained carrot liquid. Heat. Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: Ice Cream Dessert
directions: Melt butter; mix all together.
Put 1/2 mixture in bottom of pan.
Add slightly softened ice cream.
Top with remaining mixture.
Freeze.
Serves 24.
recipes.text: Ice Cream Dessert. Melt butter; mix all together. Put 1/2 mixture in bottom of pan. Add slightly softened ice cream. Top with remaining mixture. Freeze. Serves 24.

recipes.title: Chicken Nuggets
ingredients: 1 to 1 1/2 lb. chicken breasts (skinless and boneless)
directions: Preheat oven to 400°.
In Ziploc bag, crush potato chips. Beat egg and milk together.
Cut up chicken into finger food size. Dip chicken pieces in milk mixture. Toss in Ziploc bag with potato chips and shake. Place chicken pieces on baking sheets. Bake 10 minutes on each side.
recipes.text: Chicken Nuggets. Preheat oven to 400°. In Ziploc bag, crush potato chips. Beat egg and milk together. Cut up chicken into finger food size. Dip chicken pieces in milk mixture. Toss in Ziploc bag with potato chips and shake. Place chicken pieces on baking sheets. Bake 10 minutes on each side.

recipes.title: Apricot Or Orange Fruit Gelatin
directions: Dissolve Jell-O in hot water.
Add cold water.
Allow to thicken.
Drain pineapple; add to gelatin and congeal until firm in 7 x 11-inch pan.
recipes.text: Apricot Or Orange Fruit Gelatin. Dissolve Jell-O in hot water. Add cold water. Allow to thicken. Drain pineapple; add to gelatin and congeal until firm in 7 x 11-inch pan.

recipes.title: Favorite Pumpkin Pie
directions: Mix squash, nutmeg, cinnamon and sugar.
Mix thoroughly.
Add eggs and milk.
Pour into pie shell.
Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes or until done.
(May need to cover edges of pie with foil to prevent overbrowning.)
recipes.text: Favorite Pumpkin Pie. Mix squash, nutmeg, cinnamon and sugar. Mix thoroughly. Add eggs and milk. Pour into pie shell. Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes or until done. (May need to cover edges of pie with foil to prevent overbrowning.)

recipes.title: Prisnic
ingredients: 1 (20 oz.) pkg. cooked and drained California Blend
directions: Cook California Blend.
Beat the eggs.
Add the flour.
Add cottage cheese, butter and Velveeta.
Fold into vegetables.
Place in a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Bake for 1 hour at 350°.
recipes.text: Prisnic. Cook California Blend. Beat the eggs. Add the flour. Add cottage cheese, butter and Velveeta. Fold into vegetables. Place in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake for 1 hour at 350°.

recipes.title: Sweet Potato Pudding
directions: Mix all ingredients together.
Bake for 1 hour at 375°.
recipes.text: Sweet Potato Pudding. Mix all ingredients together. Bake for 1 hour at 375°.

recipes.title: Amazing Coconut Pie
directions: Mix all ingredients; pour into a 9-inch pie pan.
Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.
Makes its own crust.
recipes.text: Amazing Coconut Pie. Mix all ingredients; pour into a 9-inch pie pan. Bake at 350° for 40 minutes. Makes its own crust.

recipes.title: Stuffed Pasta Shell Tacos
directions: Brown ground beef; drain.
Add cream cheese, sour cream and chili powder to beef; stir until well blended.
Boil pasta per package; drain.
Stuff meat mixture into shells; place in a buttered 9 x 13-inch pan.
Spread taco sauce over shells.
Cover with foil; bake for 15 minutes at 375°.
Cover with crushed chips and cheeses; bake for another 15 minutes, uncovered.
Top with toppings that you like.
recipes.text: Stuffed Pasta Shell Tacos. Brown ground beef; drain. Add cream cheese, sour cream and chili powder to beef; stir until well blended. Boil pasta per package; drain. Stuff meat mixture into shells; place in a buttered 9 x 13-inch pan. Spread taco sauce over shells. Cover with foil; bake for 15 minutes at 375°. Cover with crushed chips and cheeses; bake for another 15 minutes, uncovered. Top with toppings that you like.

recipes.title: Chesapeake Bay Scrambled Eggs
directions: Beat eggs and milk together in a bowl.
Scramble eggs. Sprinkle Old Bay seasoning to taste.
recipes.text: Chesapeake Bay Scrambled Eggs. Beat eggs and milk together in a bowl. Scramble eggs. Sprinkle Old Bay seasoning to taste.

recipes.title: Championship Chocolate Chip Bars
ingredients: 1 can sweetened condensed milk (NOT evaporated milk)
directions: Heat oven to 350 degrees.
In a medium bowl, stir together flour and brown sugar; cut in cold butter until crumbly. Stir in 1/2 cup chocolate chips; press mixture on bottom of 13x9x2 inch pan.
Bake 15 minutes.
Meanwhile, in large bowl, combine condensed milk, egg and vanilla.
Stir in remaining 1 & 1/2 cups chips and nuts.
Spread evenly over baked crust. Bake 25 minutes or until golden brown. Cool completely. Cut into bars.
recipes.text: Championship Chocolate Chip Bars. Heat oven to 350 degrees. In a medium bowl, stir together flour and brown sugar; cut in cold butter until crumbly. Stir in 1/2 cup chocolate chips; press mixture on bottom of 13x9x2 inch pan. Bake 15 minutes. Meanwhile, in large bowl, combine condensed milk, egg and vanilla. Stir in remaining 1 & 1/2 cups chips and nuts. Spread evenly over baked crust. Bake 25 minutes or until golden brown. Cool completely. Cut into bars.

recipes.title: Corn Bran Muffins
directions: Preheat oven to 375°.
Stir cereal and milk in a large bowl. Let stand for 10 minutes.
Combine flour, cornmeal, baking powder, soda and salt.
Add beaten eggs, oil and vanilla to milk.
Whisk in brown sugar until smooth.
Add dry ingredients.
Spoon batter into prepared cups.
Bake 20 minutes, until toothpick comes out clean.
recipes.text: Corn Bran Muffins. Preheat oven to 375°. Stir cereal and milk in a large bowl. Let stand for 10 minutes. Combine flour, cornmeal, baking powder, soda and salt. Add beaten eggs, oil and vanilla to milk. Whisk in brown sugar until smooth. Add dry ingredients. Spoon batter into prepared cups. Bake 20 minutes, until toothpick comes out clean.

recipes.title: Fruit Salad
directions: Mix dry pudding and Tang gently with fruit mixture.
Chill. May be used as salad or dessert.
recipes.text: Fruit Salad. Mix dry pudding and Tang gently with fruit mixture. Chill. May be used as salad or dessert.

recipes.title: Egg Custard
directions: Mix ingredients together and empty in pie shell.
Cook at 350° until brown.
recipes.text: Egg Custard. Mix ingredients together and empty in pie shell. Cook at 350° until brown.

recipes.title: My Mother-In-Law'S Stroganoff
directions: Dip beef in flour.
Saute in onions and mushrooms until brown. Add 1 can beef consomme and wine.
Simmer until tender.
Add sour cream.
Serve over rice or egg noodles.
recipes.text: My Mother-In-Law'S Stroganoff. Dip beef in flour. Saute in onions and mushrooms until brown. Add 1 can beef consomme and wine. Simmer until tender. Add sour cream. Serve over rice or egg noodles.

recipes.title: Lemon Chicken
directions: Preheat oven to 400°.
Cut up chicken and place in a pan. Melt butter and squeeze fresh lemon juice into butter.
Baste chicken.
Sprinkle with oregano and bake at 400° for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Lemon Chicken. Preheat oven to 400°. Cut up chicken and place in a pan. Melt butter and squeeze fresh lemon juice into butter. Baste chicken. Sprinkle with oregano and bake at 400° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Salsa
ingredients: 3 to 4 good sized fresh garlic buds
directions: Chop onion, jalapeno pepper and garlic buds in food chopper or chop by hand very fine.
Diced tomatoes may have to be diced into smaller pieces.
Place all ingredients into an airtight container such as a Rubbermaid or Tupperware bowl with snap lid.
Great served with restaurant-style tortilla chips or your favorite Mexican dish.
recipes.text: Salsa. Chop onion, jalapeno pepper and garlic buds in food chopper or chop by hand very fine. Diced tomatoes may have to be diced into smaller pieces. Place all ingredients into an airtight container such as a Rubbermaid or Tupperware bowl with snap lid. Great served with restaurant-style tortilla chips or your favorite Mexican dish.

recipes.title: Creamy Lemon Pie
ingredients: 1 (9-inch) graham cracker crust or baked pastry shell
directions: Preheat oven to 350°.
In medium bowl, beat egg yolks with condensed milk, lemon juice and food coloring.
Pour into crust; bake for 30 minutes.
Chill.
Spread with whipped cream. Refrigerate leftovers.
recipes.text: Creamy Lemon Pie. Preheat oven to 350°. In medium bowl, beat egg yolks with condensed milk, lemon juice and food coloring. Pour into crust; bake for 30 minutes. Chill. Spread with whipped cream. Refrigerate leftovers.

recipes.title: Brown Rice Veggie Stir Fry
directions: In skillet, combine water, soy sauce and oil.
Add the zucchini and onion, stir fry for 4-5 minutes or until vegetables are crisp-tender.
Add the rice, tomato and carrot.
Stir fry for 2-3 minutes or until heated through. sprinkle with almonds.
Yield:
4 servings.
recipes.text: Brown Rice Veggie Stir Fry. In skillet, combine water, soy sauce and oil. Add the zucchini and onion, stir fry for 4-5 minutes or until vegetables are crisp-tender. Add the rice, tomato and carrot. Stir fry for 2-3 minutes or until heated through. sprinkle with almonds. Yield: 4 servings.

recipes.title: Quick Fried Spinach And Rice
directions: Prepare rice according to package directions.
Set aside.
In a large frying pan or wok, cook onion in vegetable oil for a few minutes until translucent.
Add garlic and stir, cooking for 1 minute.
Add spinach and toss until spinach wilts.
Add rice, salt, pepper and nutmeg to spinach mixture; toss together until mixed well and heated through.
Remove from pan and serve. Serves 4.
recipes.text: Quick Fried Spinach And Rice. Prepare rice according to package directions. Set aside. In a large frying pan or wok, cook onion in vegetable oil for a few minutes until translucent. Add garlic and stir, cooking for 1 minute. Add spinach and toss until spinach wilts. Add rice, salt, pepper and nutmeg to spinach mixture; toss together until mixed well and heated through. Remove from pan and serve. Serves 4.

recipes.title: Seafoam Gelatin Mold
directions: Drain juice from pans and add enough water to make 1 1/2 cups liquid.
Heat to boiling and pour over gelatin.
Stir until dissolved.
Add 1/2 cup cold water.
Cool.
Mix cream cheese and cream until smooth.
Add to gelatin mixture and heat until blended.
Chill until partially thickened.
Fold in well-drained mashed pears.
Whip cream and fold into gelatin mixture.
Pour into a 1 1/2-quart mold and chill until firm. Serves 8 to 10.
recipes.text: Seafoam Gelatin Mold. Drain juice from pans and add enough water to make 1 1/2 cups liquid. Heat to boiling and pour over gelatin. Stir until dissolved. Add 1/2 cup cold water. Cool. Mix cream cheese and cream until smooth. Add to gelatin mixture and heat until blended. Chill until partially thickened. Fold in well-drained mashed pears. Whip cream and fold into gelatin mixture. Pour into a 1 1/2-quart mold and chill until firm. Serves 8 to 10.

recipes.title: 5 Cup Salad
ingredients: 1 c. miniature marshmallows (may add nuts if prefer)
directions: Mix all ingredients together.
Increase amounts as needed for increase in number of people served.
recipes.text: 5 Cup Salad. Mix all ingredients together. Increase amounts as needed for increase in number of people served.

recipes.title: Zucchini Casserole
ingredients: 1 pkg. Washington brown broth, dissolved in 1 c. water
directions: Butter a 1 1/2 to 2-quart casserole dish.
Combine all but croutons and cheese.
Top with croutons and cheese.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Zucchini Casserole. Butter a 1 1/2 to 2-quart casserole dish. Combine all but croutons and cheese. Top with croutons and cheese. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Oven Chipped Potatoes
directions: Use large shallow greased metal baking pan.
Scrub the potatoes and have oven preheating to 425°.
Melt the butter or margarine and combine with the onion, salt and pepper.
Let stand on warm burner while slicing potatoes.
Do not peel the potatoes (the skin adds texture).
Slice up to 1/4-inch thick or as thin as you like.
Arrange the slices in a shallow pan which has been generously greased with shortening.
Brush the melted butter mixture on potato slices and bake, uncovered, for 1 hour, reducing oven temperature if necessary, part way through baking time. Serve with catsup or sour cream.
Bake at 425° (at least for the first half hour, then reduce temperature if necessary).
recipes.text: Oven Chipped Potatoes. Use large shallow greased metal baking pan. Scrub the potatoes and have oven preheating to 425°. Melt the butter or margarine and combine with the onion, salt and pepper. Let stand on warm burner while slicing potatoes. Do not peel the potatoes (the skin adds texture). Slice up to 1/4-inch thick or as thin as you like. Arrange the slices in a shallow pan which has been generously greased with shortening. Brush the melted butter mixture on potato slices and bake, uncovered, for 1 hour, reducing oven temperature if necessary, part way through baking time. Serve with catsup or sour cream. Bake at 425° (at least for the first half hour, then reduce temperature if necessary).

recipes.title: Cherry Lemonade
ingredients: 3 1/4 c. cherry flavoring sparkling mineral water
directions: Combine lemon juice and sugar; stir until sugar dissolves. Cover and chill.
Stir in mineral water.
Serve over ice.
If desired, garnish with lemon slices and cherries.
recipes.text: Cherry Lemonade. Combine lemon juice and sugar; stir until sugar dissolves. Cover and chill. Stir in mineral water. Serve over ice. If desired, garnish with lemon slices and cherries.

recipes.title: Lazy Crazy Chocolate Cake
directions: Add ingredients in order given.
Don't beat until all is added.
Beat like any ordinary cake. Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes or until done.
Makes two 8-inch layers.
recipes.text: Lazy Crazy Chocolate Cake. Add ingredients in order given. Don't beat until all is added. Beat like any ordinary cake. Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes or until done. Makes two 8-inch layers.

recipes.title: Dough For Apple Dumplings(Makes About 8)
directions: Mix together.
Make 8 balls, roll and put 1/2 apple (any kind in each).
Sprinkle cinnamon on top, 1 teaspoon sugar and 1 dab butter in each.
Roll apple up and sprinkle more cinnamon and bake at 375° for 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Dough For Apple Dumplings(Makes About 8). Mix together. Make 8 balls, roll and put 1/2 apple (any kind in each). Sprinkle cinnamon on top, 1 teaspoon sugar and 1 dab butter in each. Roll apple up and sprinkle more cinnamon and bake at 375° for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Pizza Burger
directions: Combine meat, salt, onion powder, oregano and 3 tablespoons of the tomato sauce.
Shape into 6 patties.
Broil hamburgers until nearly done.
Top with mushrooms, cheese and remaining tomato sauce.
Broil another 2 to 3 minutes until cheese melts.
recipes.text: Pizza Burger. Combine meat, salt, onion powder, oregano and 3 tablespoons of the tomato sauce. Shape into 6 patties. Broil hamburgers until nearly done. Top with mushrooms, cheese and remaining tomato sauce. Broil another 2 to 3 minutes until cheese melts.

recipes.title: Turkey-Wild Rice Casserole
ingredients: 1 1/2 c. cooked wild rice or regular rice
directions: Cook rice according to package directions.
Saute the celery and onions; combine all ingredients and spread bread crumbs and margarine on top.
Bake at 350° until it bubbles and is fully warmed, approximately 30 minutes.
Serves 6 to 8.
recipes.text: Turkey-Wild Rice Casserole. Cook rice according to package directions. Saute the celery and onions; combine all ingredients and spread bread crumbs and margarine on top. Bake at 350° until it bubbles and is fully warmed, approximately 30 minutes. Serves 6 to 8.

recipes.title: Broccoli And Noodles Supreme
ingredients: 1 can cream of chicken and broccoli soup
directions: In a 4-quart saucepan, prepare noodles according to package directions.
Add broccoli for last 5 minutes of cooking time. Drain.
In saucepan, add soup, sour cream, Parmesan cheese, pepper, noodles and broccoli.
Over low heat, heat through, stirring occasionally.
Makes 5 servings.
ner: cream of chicken and broccoli soup
recipes.text: Broccoli And Noodles Supreme. In a 4-quart saucepan, prepare noodles according to package directions. Add broccoli for last 5 minutes of cooking time. Drain. In saucepan, add soup, sour cream, Parmesan cheese, pepper, noodles and broccoli. Over low heat, heat through, stirring occasionally. Makes 5 servings.

recipes.title: Shrimp Dip
directions: Mash the shrimp with a fork and combine with all ingredients. Chill overnight.
recipes.text: Shrimp Dip. Mash the shrimp with a fork and combine with all ingredients. Chill overnight.

recipes.title: Brunswick Stew
ingredients: 1 tsp. red pepper or to taste
directions: Boil turkey, remove skin and shred turkey.
Add to stock along with all other ingredients.
Add sugar last after simmering for a short while.
Simmer approximately 1 to 2 hours.
recipes.text: Brunswick Stew. Boil turkey, remove skin and shred turkey. Add to stock along with all other ingredients. Add sugar last after simmering for a short while. Simmer approximately 1 to 2 hours.

recipes.title: Superb Ambrosia Salad
ingredients: 1 (8 oz.) container plain or vanilla yogurt
directions: Mix all ingredients together in a large bowl.
Cover.
Chill for 1 hour.
Remove and add nuts, if desired.
recipes.text: Superb Ambrosia Salad. Mix all ingredients together in a large bowl. Cover. Chill for 1 hour. Remove and add nuts, if desired.

recipes.title: Western Meat Balls
directions: Mix ground beef, oats, salt, pepper and milk.
Form into balls.
Roll in mixture of flour, paprika and salt.
Brown meat balls in 2 tablespoons hot fat.
Add onion and cook about 5 minutes.
Stir in barbecue sauce and water.
Cover and simmer for about 45 minutes.
Turn meat balls several times while cooking.
recipes.text: Western Meat Balls. Mix ground beef, oats, salt, pepper and milk. Form into balls. Roll in mixture of flour, paprika and salt. Brown meat balls in 2 tablespoons hot fat. Add onion and cook about 5 minutes. Stir in barbecue sauce and water. Cover and simmer for about 45 minutes. Turn meat balls several times while cooking.

recipes.title: Frog Eye Salad
directions: Cut up fresh fruit and put into mixing bowl.
Add marshmallows and whipped cream to desire.
Put in dessert dishes and top with maraschino cherry.
recipes.text: Frog Eye Salad. Cut up fresh fruit and put into mixing bowl. Add marshmallows and whipped cream to desire. Put in dessert dishes and top with maraschino cherry.

recipes.title: Mexican Chicken
directions: Mix first 5 ingredients in bowl or pan and warm in microwave until warm.
Mix in boiled chicken and pour over chips that are laying in the bottom of a sprayed 9 x 13-inch pan.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until most liquid appears to be absorbed.
recipes.text: Mexican Chicken. Mix first 5 ingredients in bowl or pan and warm in microwave until warm. Mix in boiled chicken and pour over chips that are laying in the bottom of a sprayed 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until most liquid appears to be absorbed.

recipes.title: Cranberry Chicken
directions: Melt oleo in a large skillet.
Add the chicken and brown on all sides over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion to the skillet and cook until tender, about 5 minutes.
Add 1 1/2 cups cider, salt, pepper and lemon peel.
Cover the skillet and let ingredients simmer 30 minutes.
Remove the chicken
and keep warm. Combine cornstarch with the remaining 1/2 cup cider and add to the skillet with the sugar and cranberries.
Cook 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Return chicken to the skillet along with the sliced bananas.
Heat all ingredients to serving temperature.
recipes.text: Cranberry Chicken. Melt oleo in a large skillet. Add the chicken and brown on all sides over medium heat. Add the chopped onion to the skillet and cook until tender, about 5 minutes. Add 1 1/2 cups cider, salt, pepper and lemon peel. Cover the skillet and let ingredients simmer 30 minutes. Remove the chicken and keep warm. Combine cornstarch with the remaining 1/2 cup cider and add to the skillet with the sugar and cranberries. Cook 10 minutes, stirring occasionally. Return chicken to the skillet along with the sliced bananas. Heat all ingredients to serving temperature.

recipes.title: Savannah Anderson'S Applesauce Cake
directions: Cream shortening, sugar, egg, applesauce, soda and boiling water.
Sift together flour, salt, cinnamon, cloves and allspice and add gradually to creamed mixture.
Add raisins and nuts gradually.
Beat well and pour into oblong pan and bake 1 hour at 350°.
recipes.text: Savannah Anderson'S Applesauce Cake. Cream shortening, sugar, egg, applesauce, soda and boiling water. Sift together flour, salt, cinnamon, cloves and allspice and add gradually to creamed mixture. Add raisins and nuts gradually. Beat well and pour into oblong pan and bake 1 hour at 350°.

recipes.title: Spice Cake
directions: Stir shortening to soften.
Add dry ingredients.
Add milk and stir until flour is dampened, then beat 2 minutes.
Add eggs and molasses and beat one minute longer.
Bake at 350° until done.
recipes.text: Spice Cake. Stir shortening to soften. Add dry ingredients. Add milk and stir until flour is dampened, then beat 2 minutes. Add eggs and molasses and beat one minute longer. Bake at 350° until done.

recipes.title: Trifle
ingredients: 28 oz. can peach halves or fruit cocktail
1 large box jello (any kind), partially set
cherries, kiwi fruit or nuts (as desired)
directions: Slice pound cake.
Spread with raspberry jam (like a sandwich).
Spread over bottom of a trifle bowl.
Sprinkle with sherry or peach Schnapps.
Drain peaches.
Sprinkle some of the juice over the cake, then spread the fruit over all.
Pour the partially set jello over top and let set until firm.
Make up 1 envelope of custard; cool and pour over top. Cover with whipped cream or Cool Whip.
Decorate top with cherries, slices of kiwi or nuts, as desired.
recipes.text: Trifle. Slice pound cake. Spread with raspberry jam (like a sandwich). Spread over bottom of a trifle bowl. Sprinkle with sherry or peach Schnapps. Drain peaches. Sprinkle some of the juice over the cake, then spread the fruit over all. Pour the partially set jello over top and let set until firm. Make up 1 envelope of custard; cool and pour over top. Cover with whipped cream or Cool Whip. Decorate top with cherries, slices of kiwi or nuts, as desired.

recipes.title: Fluffy Peanut Butter Pie
ingredients: 1 (9 oz.) carton frozen nondairy whipped topping
1 (9-inch) graham cracker crust or 9-inch baked pastry shell
directions: Whip cream cheese until soft and fluffy.
Beat in peanut butter and sugar.
Slowly add milk, blending thoroughly into mixture.
Pour into prepared crust.
Sprinkle with chopped peanuts, if desired.
Freeze until firm and serve.
Serves 8.
recipes.text: Fluffy Peanut Butter Pie. Whip cream cheese until soft and fluffy. Beat in peanut butter and sugar. Slowly add milk, blending thoroughly into mixture. Pour into prepared crust. Sprinkle with chopped peanuts, if desired. Freeze until firm and serve. Serves 8.

recipes.title: Cocoa Cake
directions: Cream oleo and sugar.
Separate eggs.
Beat yolks and add to creamed mixture.
Sift dry ingredients together.
Add alternately flour mixture and milk to creamed mixture.
Beat egg whites until stiff and fold into cake mixture.
Bake at 320° until done.
recipes.text: Cocoa Cake. Cream oleo and sugar. Separate eggs. Beat yolks and add to creamed mixture. Sift dry ingredients together. Add alternately flour mixture and milk to creamed mixture. Beat egg whites until stiff and fold into cake mixture. Bake at 320° until done.

recipes.title: Broccoli Casserole
directions: Cook rice; wilt or saute onion and celery in oleo (fry). Place broccoli in colander over boiling water; strain.
(May omit this step by letting broccoli thaw.)
Mix all ingredients together and bake 45 minutes at 350°.
recipes.text: Broccoli Casserole. Cook rice; wilt or saute onion and celery in oleo (fry). Place broccoli in colander over boiling water; strain. (May omit this step by letting broccoli thaw.) Mix all ingredients together and bake 45 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Bran Muffins
directions: Soak together for 15 minutes the molasses, milk and All-Bran. Add the beaten egg.
Sift flour, salt and soda; mix well.
Bake 20 minutes at 400°.
recipes.text: Bran Muffins. Soak together for 15 minutes the molasses, milk and All-Bran. Add the beaten egg. Sift flour, salt and soda; mix well. Bake 20 minutes at 400°.

recipes.title: Rice Casserole #1
directions: Preheat oven to 375°.
Mix ingredients together in a 9 x 12-inch greased baking dish.
Cover and bake for 1 hour.
Serves 6 to 8.
Freezes well.
recipes.text: Rice Casserole #1. Preheat oven to 375°. Mix ingredients together in a 9 x 12-inch greased baking dish. Cover and bake for 1 hour. Serves 6 to 8. Freezes well.

recipes.title: Pork Chop Casserole
directions: Mix all ingredients and pour into casserole or baking dish. Salt and pepper pork chops and place on top of rice mixture. Cover tightly with foil and cook at 350° for 45 minutes to 1 hour.
recipes.text: Pork Chop Casserole. Mix all ingredients and pour into casserole or baking dish. Salt and pepper pork chops and place on top of rice mixture. Cover tightly with foil and cook at 350° for 45 minutes to 1 hour.

recipes.title: Meal In One
directions: Brown meat, onions, salt and pepper.
Pour off fat.
Add tomato soup and 1 can of water.
Add Veg-All with liquid.
Serve over mashed potatoes.
recipes.text: Meal In One. Brown meat, onions, salt and pepper. Pour off fat. Add tomato soup and 1 can of water. Add Veg-All with liquid. Serve over mashed potatoes.

recipes.title: Sausage And Cheese Balls
directions: Mix all ingredients and roll into small balls.
Bake at 375° for 15 minutes.
If frozen, cook for 20 minutes in 300° oven.
recipes.text: Sausage And Cheese Balls. Mix all ingredients and roll into small balls. Bake at 375° for 15 minutes. If frozen, cook for 20 minutes in 300° oven.

recipes.title: Japanese Fruit Pie
directions: Melt the butter in pan. Add the sugar; stir well. Add the egg, pecans, raisins, coconut, vinegar and pumpkin pie spice. Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Japanese Fruit Pie. Melt the butter in pan. Add the sugar; stir well. Add the egg, pecans, raisins, coconut, vinegar and pumpkin pie spice. Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Surprise Cupcakes
directions: Mix cake according to package directions.
Fill cupcake cups half full.
Mix cream cheese with sugar.
Beat in egg and salt; stir in chocolate chips.
Drop one teaspoonful of cream cheese mixture into each cupcake cup.
Bake as directed on cake mix package.
recipes.text: Surprise Cupcakes. Mix cake according to package directions. Fill cupcake cups half full. Mix cream cheese with sugar. Beat in egg and salt; stir in chocolate chips. Drop one teaspoonful of cream cheese mixture into each cupcake cup. Bake as directed on cake mix package.

recipes.title: Pig Lickin' Cake
ingredients: 1/2 c. juice from a can of mandarin oranges
directions: Beat the above ingredients for 4 minutes.
Then add oranges and beat until pieces are small.
Pour into greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan.
Bake 25-30 minutes at 350°.
recipes.text: Pig Lickin' Cake. Beat the above ingredients for 4 minutes. Then add oranges and beat until pieces are small. Pour into greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake 25-30 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Russian Tea Cakes
directions: Mix together butter, powdered sugar and vanilla.
Add flour, salt and nuts.
Chill dough.
Roll in 1-inch balls.
Place 2 1/2 inches apart on ungreased cookie sheet.
Bake until set, but not brown, 10 to 12 minutes, at 375°.
While warm, roll in powdered sugar.
Cool and roll again in powdered sugar.
recipes.text: Russian Tea Cakes. Mix together butter, powdered sugar and vanilla. Add flour, salt and nuts. Chill dough. Roll in 1-inch balls. Place 2 1/2 inches apart on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake until set, but not brown, 10 to 12 minutes, at 375°. While warm, roll in powdered sugar. Cool and roll again in powdered sugar.

recipes.title: Glossy Chocolate Frosting
directions: Mix sugar and cornstarch; add chocolate.
Add water.
Cook until mixture thickens.
Remove from heat and add margarine and vanilla.
Spread on cake while frosting is hot for a glossy frosting which remains soft and smooth.
Frosts one 9 x 9-inch square cake.
