recipes.text: Glossy Chocolate Frosting. Mix sugar and cornstarch; add chocolate. Add water. Cook until mixture thickens. Remove from heat and add margarine and vanilla. Spread on cake while frosting is hot for a glossy frosting which remains soft and smooth. Frosts one 9 x 9-inch square cake.

recipes.title: Apple-Sweet Potato Bake
ingredients: 5 medium sweet potatoes, cooked and quartered
directions: Arrange sweet potatoes in buttered casserole dish and pour apples over them.
Sprinkle brown sugar, salt and marshmallow pieces over apples.
Top with cinnamon.
Dot with butter.
Cover and bake in 350° oven for 35 to 40 minutes.
recipes.text: Apple-Sweet Potato Bake. Arrange sweet potatoes in buttered casserole dish and pour apples over them. Sprinkle brown sugar, salt and marshmallow pieces over apples. Top with cinnamon. Dot with butter. Cover and bake in 350° oven for 35 to 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Potato Soup
ingredients: 2 cans condensed cream of chicken soup
directions: Fry bacon until crisp; set aside.
Pour off all but 3 tablespoons of bacon grease.
Saute onions.
Combine potatoes and water; cook 15 minutes or until potatoes feel tender.
Blend in soup, half of bacon pieces, milk, salt and pepper.
Heat, but do not boil.
recipes.text: Potato Soup. Fry bacon until crisp; set aside. Pour off all but 3 tablespoons of bacon grease. Saute onions. Combine potatoes and water; cook 15 minutes or until potatoes feel tender. Blend in soup, half of bacon pieces, milk, salt and pepper. Heat, but do not boil.

recipes.title: Cabbage Soup
directions: Brown ground beef in skillet and drain.
Mix beans, tomatoes, seasonings and browned ground beef in a large pot.
Bring to a boil.
Cut heat to simmer for 35 minutes, stirring often.
When mixture is almost done, add cabbage and cook for 10 minutes or until cabbage is done.
recipes.text: Cabbage Soup. Brown ground beef in skillet and drain. Mix beans, tomatoes, seasonings and browned ground beef in a large pot. Bring to a boil. Cut heat to simmer for 35 minutes, stirring often. When mixture is almost done, add cabbage and cook for 10 minutes or until cabbage is done.

recipes.title: Chinese Pick-Up Sticks
directions: In a medium saucepan, melt margarine.
Add soy sauce and Tabasco; mix well.
Place noodles in a bowl and drizzle sauce over them.
Toss to coat the noodles well.
Sprinkle with celery salt, onion powder and garlic powder and toss again.
recipes.text: Chinese Pick-Up Sticks. In a medium saucepan, melt margarine. Add soy sauce and Tabasco; mix well. Place noodles in a bowl and drizzle sauce over them. Toss to coat the noodles well. Sprinkle with celery salt, onion powder and garlic powder and toss again.

recipes.title: Jambalaya Peppers
ingredients: 1 (8 oz.) can Italian style tomato sauce
1 c. chopped, fully cooked, smoked ham (4 oz.)
directions: Mix rice, tomato sauce, water and chili powder in 1-quart microwavable casserole.
Cover tightly and microwave on High for 5 minutes.
Stir in shrimp and ham.
Cut bell peppers in half lengthwise.
Remove seeds and membranes; rinse.
Arrange peppers, cut sides up, in circle on 9 or 10-inch pie plate.
Fill each pepper with about 1 cup mixture.
Cover and microwave on High 7 to 9 minutes or until filling is hot in center.
recipes.text: Jambalaya Peppers. Mix rice, tomato sauce, water and chili powder in 1-quart microwavable casserole. Cover tightly and microwave on High for 5 minutes. Stir in shrimp and ham. Cut bell peppers in half lengthwise. Remove seeds and membranes; rinse. Arrange peppers, cut sides up, in circle on 9 or 10-inch pie plate. Fill each pepper with about 1 cup mixture. Cover and microwave on High 7 to 9 minutes or until filling is hot in center.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Bars
directions: Combine all.
Pour into a large (13 x 8 1/2) greased and floured cookie sheet.
Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes.
recipes.text: Pumpkin Bars. Combine all. Pour into a large (13 x 8 1/2) greased and floured cookie sheet. Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Crab Cakes
directions: Mix all ingredients together.
Spread on muffins.
Freeze for 1 hour.
When ready to cook cut into small pieces.	Bake at 350° for 10 minutes.
recipes.text: Crab Cakes. Mix all ingredients together. Spread on muffins. Freeze for 1 hour. When ready to cook cut into small pieces.	Bake at 350° for 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Fluffy Cake Doughnuts
directions: Sift together flour, sugar, baking powder and salt.
Add melted shortening, eggs, vanilla and milk.
Mix quickly.
Brush doughnut maker with light coating of vegetable oil and fill with batter.
Hold doughnut maker over oil at surface and release ring of batter onto surface.
Deep fat fry at 375° (medium) for approximately 1 minute on each side, turning to brown evenly. Remove from oil and drain on paper towels.
When done, cover doughnuts with sugar or cinnamon sugar, or your favorite topping.
recipes.text: Fluffy Cake Doughnuts. Sift together flour, sugar, baking powder and salt. Add melted shortening, eggs, vanilla and milk. Mix quickly. Brush doughnut maker with light coating of vegetable oil and fill with batter. Hold doughnut maker over oil at surface and release ring of batter onto surface. Deep fat fry at 375° (medium) for approximately 1 minute on each side, turning to brown evenly. Remove from oil and drain on paper towels. When done, cover doughnuts with sugar or cinnamon sugar, or your favorite topping.

recipes.title: Cherries In The Snow Cake
directions: Cut cake into bite size pieces.
Place 1/2 of the cake in dish.
Beat cream cheese and sugar together.
Add Cool Whip; mix well.
Put 1/2 of this mixture over cake.
Add other 1/2 of cake, then the remainder of cheese mixture.
Top with pie filling. Chill and serve.
recipes.text: Cherries In The Snow Cake. Cut cake into bite size pieces. Place 1/2 of the cake in dish. Beat cream cheese and sugar together. Add Cool Whip; mix well. Put 1/2 of this mixture over cake. Add other 1/2 of cake, then the remainder of cheese mixture. Top with pie filling. Chill and serve.

recipes.title: Frozen Sweet Pickles
directions: Put in large container and refrigerate; stir daily for four days.
Then freeze in bags or containers.
Containers are better.
recipes.text: Frozen Sweet Pickles. Put in large container and refrigerate; stir daily for four days. Then freeze in bags or containers. Containers are better.

recipes.title: Scallop And Squid Stir-Fry
directions: Chop all vegetables (slice mushrooms).
Clean squid (very important).
Stir-fry squid in 1 tablespoon olive oil for 40 minutes.
Add sesame oil.
Add broccoli and peppers.
After 8 to 11 minutes, add the rest of the vegetables; stir-fry for 10 to 15 minutes longer.
Add spices/soy sauce while stirring occasionally. Add scallops; stir-fry for 5 minutes.
Begin to boil water for pasta when cooking broccoli and peppers.
Add pasta to water in time to finish with scallops.
Serve stir-fry over fettucine.
recipes.text: Scallop And Squid Stir-Fry. Chop all vegetables (slice mushrooms). Clean squid (very important). Stir-fry squid in 1 tablespoon olive oil for 40 minutes. Add sesame oil. Add broccoli and peppers. After 8 to 11 minutes, add the rest of the vegetables; stir-fry for 10 to 15 minutes longer. Add spices/soy sauce while stirring occasionally. Add scallops; stir-fry for 5 minutes. Begin to boil water for pasta when cooking broccoli and peppers. Add pasta to water in time to finish with scallops. Serve stir-fry over fettucine.

recipes.title: Orange Cake
directions: Mix all ingredients.
Pour into a greased tube or Bundt pan. Bake at 350° for 45 to 55 minutes.
Leave in pan when done.
Pour glaze over cake and let cake soak up glaze before removing from pan.
recipes.text: Orange Cake. Mix all ingredients. Pour into a greased tube or Bundt pan. Bake at 350° for 45 to 55 minutes. Leave in pan when done. Pour glaze over cake and let cake soak up glaze before removing from pan.

recipes.title: Chocolate Frosting
directions: Melt butter and cocoa.
Add sugar and bring to a rolling boil. Add milk and whipping cream.
Turn heat to medium-low and cook until thickened.
Stir frequently.
Takes 20 to 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Chocolate Frosting. Melt butter and cocoa. Add sugar and bring to a rolling boil. Add milk and whipping cream. Turn heat to medium-low and cook until thickened. Stir frequently. Takes 20 to 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Golden Artichoke Salad
directions: Mix liquid out of artichokes with desired amount of mayonnaise.
Blend in 1/2 to 1 teaspoon curry powder.
Toss all ingredients.
recipes.text: Golden Artichoke Salad. Mix liquid out of artichokes with desired amount of mayonnaise. Blend in 1/2 to 1 teaspoon curry powder. Toss all ingredients.

recipes.title: Becky'S Punch
ingredients: 1 pkg. black cherry or cherry Kool-Aid
directions: Mix the Kool-Aid, Jell-O, and water together.
Add sugar, lemonade, and pineapple juice.
Stir well and freeze.
Thaw one hour before serving and add 2 liters of soda.
recipes.text: Becky'S Punch. Mix the Kool-Aid, Jell-O, and water together. Add sugar, lemonade, and pineapple juice. Stir well and freeze. Thaw one hour before serving and add 2 liters of soda.

recipes.title: Baked Barbecue Chicken
directions: First you parboil chicken (vinegar and water; clean it first), then put in large pan seasoning the chicken.
Put a little water in pan, then put in oven at 400°.
Put a small pot on with the barbecue.
First Lipton soup with a little water, then after the chicken has cooked a little, pour on barbecue sauce.
This is for a large pan of chicken.
recipes.text: Baked Barbecue Chicken. First you parboil chicken (vinegar and water; clean it first), then put in large pan seasoning the chicken. Put a little water in pan, then put in oven at 400°. Put a small pot on with the barbecue. First Lipton soup with a little water, then after the chicken has cooked a little, pour on barbecue sauce. This is for a large pan of chicken.

recipes.title: Carnation Cheeseburger Loaf
directions: Blend milk, egg and cracker crumbs; add other ingredients, except cheese.
Line loaf pan with heavy waxed paper and place 1/2 cup cheese on bottom of pan.
Place 1/2 meat loaf mixture over cheese; top with another 1/2 cup grated cheese.
Cover with remaining meat.
Bake at 350° for about 1 hour.
Allow to stand 10 minutes before removing from pan.
Serves 4 to 6.
recipes.text: Carnation Cheeseburger Loaf. Blend milk, egg and cracker crumbs; add other ingredients, except cheese. Line loaf pan with heavy waxed paper and place 1/2 cup cheese on bottom of pan. Place 1/2 meat loaf mixture over cheese; top with another 1/2 cup grated cheese. Cover with remaining meat. Bake at 350° for about 1 hour. Allow to stand 10 minutes before removing from pan. Serves 4 to 6.

recipes.title: Beth'S Cherry Delight
ingredients: 2 cans of cherry pie filling (can use blueberry, peach, etc)
1 stick of cold butter or margarine
1 box of dry cake mix (white or yellow)
directions: Spoon pie filling into a 9 x 12 inch pan -- spreading evenly -- then mix the butter and cake mix together to form crumbs.
Spoon crumbs over the top of the pie filling.
Bake at 350 degrees for 35 minutes or until top is a very light brown.
So easy and so good -- especially good served warm with ice cream on top.
recipes.text: Beth'S Cherry Delight. Spoon pie filling into a 9 x 12 inch pan -- spreading evenly -- then mix the butter and cake mix together to form crumbs. Spoon crumbs over the top of the pie filling. Bake at 350 degrees for 35 minutes or until top is a very light brown. So easy and so good -- especially good served warm with ice cream on top.

recipes.title: Italian Sausage And Peppers
ingredients: 1 1/2 lb. hot or sweet Italian sausage links
2 large green peppers, cut into strips
directions: In large skillet over medium heat, heat Italian sausage links with water to boiling.
Cover and cook 5 minutes.
Remove cover; continue cooking and turning sausages frequently until water evaporates and sausage links are well browned, about 20 minutes. Remove sausages to paper towels to drain.
recipes.text: Italian Sausage And Peppers. In large skillet over medium heat, heat Italian sausage links with water to boiling. Cover and cook 5 minutes. Remove cover; continue cooking and turning sausages frequently until water evaporates and sausage links are well browned, about 20 minutes. Remove sausages to paper towels to drain.

recipes.title: Apple Slices
directions: Sprinkle on top of apples.
Roll out remaining dough.
Dot the apples with butter, then top with remaining dough.
Cut slits in dough.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
Completely cool.
Frost.
recipes.text: Apple Slices. Sprinkle on top of apples. Roll out remaining dough. Dot the apples with butter, then top with remaining dough. Cut slits in dough. Bake at 350° for 1 hour. Completely cool. Frost.

recipes.title: Guacamole Dip
ingredients: 1/2 bottle Ortega taco sauce (mild or medium)
directions: Mash avocado and spread on the bottom of an 8 x 8-inch serving dish with sides.
Spread sour cream carefully on top of avocado layer.
Drizzle taco sauce on sour cream.
Sprinkle onion over all, then cover with cheese.
Refrigerate at least 3 hours.
Can be made one day ahead.
Serve with tortilla chips.
Stick 3 or 4 chips into dip.
recipes.text: Guacamole Dip. Mash avocado and spread on the bottom of an 8 x 8-inch serving dish with sides. Spread sour cream carefully on top of avocado layer. Drizzle taco sauce on sour cream. Sprinkle onion over all, then cover with cheese. Refrigerate at least 3 hours. Can be made one day ahead. Serve with tortilla chips. Stick 3 or 4 chips into dip.

recipes.title: Layered Salad
directions: Layer each item, ending with Miracle Whip to seal in vegetables.
Top with Cheddar cheese and bacon bits.
Chill for 24 hours.
recipes.text: Layered Salad. Layer each item, ending with Miracle Whip to seal in vegetables. Top with Cheddar cheese and bacon bits. Chill for 24 hours.

recipes.title: Chinese Pot Pie
ingredients: 6 or 8 potatoes or more depending on how much you want
directions: Put in layers in casserole dish potatoes, beef, onion and corn.
After each layer add salt and pepper to taste and a little flour for thickening.
After casserole is filled, pour beef bouillon over top.
Bake at 375° for approximately 1 1/2 hours or longer, depending on your oven.
recipes.text: Chinese Pot Pie. Put in layers in casserole dish potatoes, beef, onion and corn. After each layer add salt and pepper to taste and a little flour for thickening. After casserole is filled, pour beef bouillon over top. Bake at 375° for approximately 1 1/2 hours or longer, depending on your oven.

recipes.title: Popcorn Balls
directions: Blend and melt margarine and marshmallows on stove or microwave on High for 1 1/2 to 2 minutes until marshmallows are puffed.
Add gelatin.
Pour mixture over popcorn and form into balls.
recipes.text: Popcorn Balls. Blend and melt margarine and marshmallows on stove or microwave on High for 1 1/2 to 2 minutes until marshmallows are puffed. Add gelatin. Pour mixture over popcorn and form into balls.

recipes.title: Corn Dog Mix
directions: Mix well; dip hot dogs in batter and deep fry.
This is enough for 2 pounds of hot dogs.
recipes.text: Corn Dog Mix. Mix well; dip hot dogs in batter and deep fry. This is enough for 2 pounds of hot dogs.

recipes.title: Dutch'S Scalloped Potatoes
directions: Brown potatoes and onions.
Cook to tender,
add cheese to taste.
Add milk and cook another 10 to 15 minutes until all cooked together.
recipes.text: Dutch'S Scalloped Potatoes. Brown potatoes and onions. Cook to tender, add cheese to taste. Add milk and cook another 10 to 15 minutes until all cooked together.

recipes.title: Wet Chocolate Cake
directions: Mix sugar and flour in bowl; set aside.
Bring margarine, oil, water and cocoa to a boil in saucepan.
Add to flour mixture. Blend in vanilla, buttermilk and eggs to mixture.
Bake at 300° for 35 minutes in oblong pan.
Mix frosting and have ready when cake is done.
recipes.text: Wet Chocolate Cake. Mix sugar and flour in bowl; set aside. Bring margarine, oil, water and cocoa to a boil in saucepan. Add to flour mixture. Blend in vanilla, buttermilk and eggs to mixture. Bake at 300° for 35 minutes in oblong pan. Mix frosting and have ready when cake is done.

recipes.title: Rich Cocoa Brownies
directions: Beat eggs until light and fluffy. Add sugar, butter and vanilla. Add cocoa, flour and salt. Beat until smooth. Line a 9-inch square pan with parchment paper. Spray parchment paper with Pam. Pour brownie batter onto parchment. Bake at 300° for 40 minutes or until done. Toothpick comes out clean. Onto a cooling rack, lift parchment paper out of pan to rack. Pull paper away from brownies. When cool, cut with a pizza cutter. Delicious and so rich! Serves 1 to 2 chocoholics. Can freeze.
recipes.text: Rich Cocoa Brownies. Beat eggs until light and fluffy. Add sugar, butter and vanilla. Add cocoa, flour and salt. Beat until smooth. Line a 9-inch square pan with parchment paper. Spray parchment paper with Pam. Pour brownie batter onto parchment. Bake at 300° for 40 minutes or until done. Toothpick comes out clean. Onto a cooling rack, lift parchment paper out of pan to rack. Pull paper away from brownies. When cool, cut with a pizza cutter. Delicious and so rich! Serves 1 to 2 chocoholics. Can freeze.

recipes.title: Meat Loaf
directions: Mix well.
Place in loaf pan; spread catsup on top.
Bake at 350° for about 1 hour.
recipes.text: Meat Loaf. Mix well. Place in loaf pan; spread catsup on top. Bake at 350° for about 1 hour.

recipes.title: Cinnamon Pecans
directions: Beat 2 egg whites until foamy.
Add pecan halves; mix until foamy.
Set aside.
recipes.text: Cinnamon Pecans. Beat 2 egg whites until foamy. Add pecan halves; mix until foamy. Set aside.

recipes.title: 90 Minute Dinner Rolls
directions: Mix 3/4 cup flour, sugar, salt and undissolved yeast.
Heat milk, water and margarine to 120° to 130°.
Gradually add to dry ingredients and beat 2 minutes at medium speed.
Stir in enough additional flour to make soft dough.
Knead dough 2 to 3 minutes. Divide into 12 equal parts.
Shape into balls.
Place in greased 8-inch round pan.
Pour 1 inch boiling water into a large pan on bottom rack of oven.
Set rolls on rack above water.
Cover and close oven door.
Let rise for 30 minutes.
Uncover rolls, remove water.
Turn oven to 375°.
Bake 20 to 25 minutes or until done.
recipes.text: 90 Minute Dinner Rolls. Mix 3/4 cup flour, sugar, salt and undissolved yeast. Heat milk, water and margarine to 120° to 130°. Gradually add to dry ingredients and beat 2 minutes at medium speed. Stir in enough additional flour to make soft dough. Knead dough 2 to 3 minutes. Divide into 12 equal parts. Shape into balls. Place in greased 8-inch round pan. Pour 1 inch boiling water into a large pan on bottom rack of oven. Set rolls on rack above water. Cover and close oven door. Let rise for 30 minutes. Uncover rolls, remove water. Turn oven to 375°. Bake 20 to 25 minutes or until done.

recipes.title: Banana Split Cake
directions: Mix together and pack in bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan.
recipes.text: Banana Split Cake. Mix together and pack in bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan.

recipes.title: Toll House Chocolate Chip Cookies
directions: Preheat oven to 375°.
Combine flour, baking soda and salt. Combine butter, sugar, brown sugar and vanilla; beat until creamy. Beat in eggs.
Gradually add flour mixture.
Stir in chocolate bits when everything else is well beat.
Drop by teaspoons onto cookie sheet.
recipes.text: Toll House Chocolate Chip Cookies. Preheat oven to 375°. Combine flour, baking soda and salt. Combine butter, sugar, brown sugar and vanilla; beat until creamy. Beat in eggs. Gradually add flour mixture. Stir in chocolate bits when everything else is well beat. Drop by teaspoons onto cookie sheet.

recipes.title: Oatmeal Muffins
directions: Soak oatmeal in buttermilk for 30 minutes.
Add egg and beat well.
Add sugar and mix.
Add cooled shortening.
Add flour sifted with baking powder, salt and soda.
Fill greased muffin pans two-thirds full.
Bake at 400° for 15 to 20 minutes.
Makes 1 dozen.
recipes.text: Oatmeal Muffins. Soak oatmeal in buttermilk for 30 minutes. Add egg and beat well. Add sugar and mix. Add cooled shortening. Add flour sifted with baking powder, salt and soda. Fill greased muffin pans two-thirds full. Bake at 400° for 15 to 20 minutes. Makes 1 dozen.

recipes.title: Shipwreck Casserole
directions: Layer ingredients in baking dish, seasoning with salt and pepper. Cover tightly and boil.
Bake 1 1/2 hours at 350°.
recipes.text: Shipwreck Casserole. Layer ingredients in baking dish, seasoning with salt and pepper. Cover tightly and boil. Bake 1 1/2 hours at 350°.

recipes.title: Grandma'S Tea Cakes
directions: Cream together sugar, butter, vanilla and eggs.
Add flour and mix well.
Pat out with hands and cut with glass or cookie cutter. Best to use wax paper.
Bake at 375° for approximately 8 to 10 minutes.
recipes.text: Grandma'S Tea Cakes. Cream together sugar, butter, vanilla and eggs. Add flour and mix well. Pat out with hands and cut with glass or cookie cutter. Best to use wax paper. Bake at 375° for approximately 8 to 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Broccoli Cheese Soup
directions: Heat oil.
Add onions; saute for 3 minutes.
Add water and bouillon cubes.
Heat to boiling.
Add noodles and salt.
Cook 3 minutes.
Stir in broccoli and garlic; cook 4 minutes.
Add milk, cheese and pepper, cooking over low heat until cheese melts.
Do not boil after adding milk, or it will clabber.
recipes.text: Broccoli Cheese Soup. Heat oil. Add onions; saute for 3 minutes. Add water and bouillon cubes. Heat to boiling. Add noodles and salt. Cook 3 minutes. Stir in broccoli and garlic; cook 4 minutes. Add milk, cheese and pepper, cooking over low heat until cheese melts. Do not boil after adding milk, or it will clabber.

recipes.title: Dandelion Gravy
ingredients: 2 to 4 c. cream or half and half
directions: Cut bacon in small pieces.
Fry until lightly browned. Sprinkle with flour and fry until flour is browned.
Turn heat to low.
Add sugar, salt, pepper and vinegar to your taste.
Stir in cream.
Simmer until hot; do not boil.
Add sliced eggs; pour over dandelions or lettuce.
Serve over boiled potatoes or toast.
recipes.text: Dandelion Gravy. Cut bacon in small pieces. Fry until lightly browned. Sprinkle with flour and fry until flour is browned. Turn heat to low. Add sugar, salt, pepper and vinegar to your taste. Stir in cream. Simmer until hot; do not boil. Add sliced eggs; pour over dandelions or lettuce. Serve over boiled potatoes or toast.

recipes.title: Hoppin John
directions: Saute sausage and onions until onions are soft and sausage brown.
Combine black-eyed peas, sausage mixture and rice, then heat.
Serves 8.
recipes.text: Hoppin John. Saute sausage and onions until onions are soft and sausage brown. Combine black-eyed peas, sausage mixture and rice, then heat. Serves 8.

recipes.title: Mexican Bean Casserole
directions: Brown meat; drain.
Add onions, saute.
Mix in jalapeno beans, tomatoes, and soup.
In greased pan put one layer of meat mixture, Doritos, cheese.
Bake @ 400 degrees until cheese is golden.
recipes.text: Mexican Bean Casserole. Brown meat; drain. Add onions, saute. Mix in jalapeno beans, tomatoes, and soup. In greased pan put one layer of meat mixture, Doritos, cheese. Bake @ 400 degrees until cheese is golden.

recipes.title: Six In One Cookies
directions: Cream butter gradually.
Add sugar and cream until light and fluffy.
Add eggs and vanilla; mix well.
Sift together flour, soda and salt. Gradually add to cream mixture, beating well after each addition.
Divide dough into 6 parts.
recipes.text: Six In One Cookies. Cream butter gradually. Add sugar and cream until light and fluffy. Add eggs and vanilla; mix well. Sift together flour, soda and salt. Gradually add to cream mixture, beating well after each addition. Divide dough into 6 parts.

recipes.title: Apple Dumplings
directions: Mix flour, baking powder and salt.
Cut in Crisco with blender.
Mix soda and buttermilk together and add to dry ingredients.
Peel, core and quarter 6 or 7 medium apples.
recipes.text: Apple Dumplings. Mix flour, baking powder and salt. Cut in Crisco with blender. Mix soda and buttermilk together and add to dry ingredients. Peel, core and quarter 6 or 7 medium apples.

recipes.title: Beets Royale
ingredients: 1 (1 lb.) can chunk pineapple (in its own juice)
2 cans (1 lb. each) small whole beets
2 Tbsp. sugar (omit if pineapple is in heavy syrup)
1 c. juice (juice drained from pineapple plus beet juice if needed to make 1 c.)
directions: Heat juice.
Thicken with cornstarch.
Add vinegar, salt, pineapple chunks, beets and sugar (only if pineapple was in its own juice).
Heat thoroughly.
recipes.text: Beets Royale. Heat juice. Thicken with cornstarch. Add vinegar, salt, pineapple chunks, beets and sugar (only if pineapple was in its own juice). Heat thoroughly.

recipes.title: Caramel Bars
ingredients: 7 1/2 Tbsp. canned milk or half and half
directions: Melt caramels in a heavy saucepan or in microwave with the cream.
Combine rest of ingredients, except chocolate chips and nuts.
Press 3/4 in greased 9 x 19-inch pan.
Bake 10 minutes. Then sprinkle with chocolate chips and nuts.
Dribble the caramel mixture and then the remaining crumbs.
Bake 15 to 20 minutes at 350°.
Cool before cutting.
recipes.text: Caramel Bars. Melt caramels in a heavy saucepan or in microwave with the cream. Combine rest of ingredients, except chocolate chips and nuts. Press 3/4 in greased 9 x 19-inch pan. Bake 10 minutes. Then sprinkle with chocolate chips and nuts. Dribble the caramel mixture and then the remaining crumbs. Bake 15 to 20 minutes at 350°. Cool before cutting.

recipes.title: Sour Cream Enchiladas
directions: Mix ingredients and spread a little on bottom of pan.
Place tortillas on mixture and put a large amount of sauce on tortilla and roll.
Tortillas may need to be warmed so they won't crack. Save enough sauce to spread over top.
recipes.text: Sour Cream Enchiladas. Mix ingredients and spread a little on bottom of pan. Place tortillas on mixture and put a large amount of sauce on tortilla and roll. Tortillas may need to be warmed so they won't crack. Save enough sauce to spread over top.

recipes.title: Stuffed Peppers
ingredients: 1 (8 3/4 oz.) can whole kernel corn, drained
directions: Cut tops from green peppers; discard seeds and membranes. Place peppers in an 8 x 8 x 2-inch baking dish.
Cover peppers. Microcook on High for 3 minutes.
Remove peppers.
Drain liquid. Sprinkle peppers with salt and pepper.
recipes.text: Stuffed Peppers. Cut tops from green peppers; discard seeds and membranes. Place peppers in an 8 x 8 x 2-inch baking dish. Cover peppers. Microcook on High for 3 minutes. Remove peppers. Drain liquid. Sprinkle peppers with salt and pepper.

recipes.title: Apple Cobbler
directions: Toss apples, sugar and cinnamon.
Mix flour, shortening and water to make crust.
Roll out crust for a bottom and top layer. Put apple mixture on top of bottom crust in a 9 x 12-inch pan. Put top layer of crust on.
Bake at 350° until crust is brown, approximately 1 hour.
recipes.text: Apple Cobbler. Toss apples, sugar and cinnamon. Mix flour, shortening and water to make crust. Roll out crust for a bottom and top layer. Put apple mixture on top of bottom crust in a 9 x 12-inch pan. Put top layer of crust on. Bake at 350° until crust is brown, approximately 1 hour.

recipes.title: Shrimp Pizza
directions: Spread plain cream cheese on dish.
Spread chive cream cheese over.
Spread 1/2 bottle cocktail sauce over.
Spread shrimp on top.
Sprinkle with parsley.
Stick crackers around sides.
Serve with knife.
recipes.text: Shrimp Pizza. Spread plain cream cheese on dish. Spread chive cream cheese over. Spread 1/2 bottle cocktail sauce over. Spread shrimp on top. Sprinkle with parsley. Stick crackers around sides. Serve with knife.

recipes.title: Pistachio Or Watergate Cake
directions: Mix in large mixer, eggs, salad oil and 7-up or soda. Then add the box of cake mix and beat until smooth, then add the instant pistachio pudding and nuts. Pour into well greased and floured tube pan. Bake at 350° for 45 to 50 minutes. When taken from the oven, let stand upright in pan for 30 minutes, not longer, before putting on cake plate.
recipes.text: Pistachio Or Watergate Cake. Mix in large mixer, eggs, salad oil and 7-up or soda. Then add the box of cake mix and beat until smooth, then add the instant pistachio pudding and nuts. Pour into well greased and floured tube pan. Bake at 350° for 45 to 50 minutes. When taken from the oven, let stand upright in pan for 30 minutes, not longer, before putting on cake plate.

recipes.title: Impossible Cheeseburger Pie
directions: Heat oven to 400°.
Grease a 10-inch pie plate and set aside.
recipes.text: Impossible Cheeseburger Pie. Heat oven to 400°. Grease a 10-inch pie plate and set aside.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Bread
directions: Sift together first 4 ingredients.
Cut in peanut butter.
Add egg and milk.
Stir only until moistened.
Pour into greased loaf pan.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes to 1 hour, or until toothpick comes out clean.
This makes 2 medium loaves.
Tip:
Crunchy peanut butter makes this especially good!
recipes.text: Peanut Butter Bread. Sift together first 4 ingredients. Cut in peanut butter. Add egg and milk. Stir only until moistened. Pour into greased loaf pan. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes to 1 hour, or until toothpick comes out clean. This makes 2 medium loaves. Tip: Crunchy peanut butter makes this especially good!

recipes.title: Hot Ham Sandwiches
ingredients: 4 slices Velveeta cheese, cut into little squares
directions: Chop chipped ham up into little pieces in a bowl.
Add chopped onions, celery, eggs and cheese.
recipes.text: Hot Ham Sandwiches. Chop chipped ham up into little pieces in a bowl. Add chopped onions, celery, eggs and cheese.

recipes.title: Broccoli Casserole
ingredients: 2 pkg. frozen broccoli, cooked and chopped
directions: Melt margarine and saute in onion.
Add all other ingredients except onion rings.
Mix together and pour in casserole dish and bake at 350° until really bubbly on top.
Top with onion rings for last 5 minutes of cooking time.
recipes.text: Broccoli Casserole. Melt margarine and saute in onion. Add all other ingredients except onion rings. Mix together and pour in casserole dish and bake at 350° until really bubbly on top. Top with onion rings for last 5 minutes of cooking time.

recipes.title: Breakfast Delight
ingredients: 1 lb. pkg. pork or turkey sausage, browned
5 eggs or 2 eggs and egg substitute, beaten
directions: Put slices of bread in bottom of flat baking pan.
Put sausage over bread in bowl.
Add remaining ingredients; mix and pour over bread and sausage.
Cover and set in refrigerator overnight.
Bake 35 minutes in 350° oven.
recipes.text: Breakfast Delight. Put slices of bread in bottom of flat baking pan. Put sausage over bread in bowl. Add remaining ingredients; mix and pour over bread and sausage. Cover and set in refrigerator overnight. Bake 35 minutes in 350° oven.

recipes.title: Barbecue Cups
directions: Brown beef and drain.
Add barbecue sauce, brown sugar and onions.
Press biscuits into muffin pan.
Spoon mixture into cups. Sprinkle with cheese.
Bake 10 to 12 minutes at 400°.
recipes.text: Barbecue Cups. Brown beef and drain. Add barbecue sauce, brown sugar and onions. Press biscuits into muffin pan. Spoon mixture into cups. Sprinkle with cheese. Bake 10 to 12 minutes at 400°.

recipes.title: Chicken Divan
ingredients: 2 (10 oz.) boxes frozen broccoli, cooked and drained
3 c. cooked chicken breasts, cut up
directions: Arrange broccoli in greased 9 x 13-inch pan (head to trunk). Place chicken on top.
Mix together the soups, mayonnaise, lemon juice and curry powder; pour over chicken and broccoli.
Spread cheese over soup mixture.
Melt margarine; mix with bread crumbs. Spread bread crumbs over cheese.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes to 1 hour.
recipes.text: Chicken Divan. Arrange broccoli in greased 9 x 13-inch pan (head to trunk). Place chicken on top. Mix together the soups, mayonnaise, lemon juice and curry powder; pour over chicken and broccoli. Spread cheese over soup mixture. Melt margarine; mix with bread crumbs. Spread bread crumbs over cheese. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes to 1 hour.

recipes.title: Pork With Clams
directions: Marinade:
Combine wine, garlic and salt in medium-size glass bowl.
Cut pork in 1-inch cubes; add to marinade, turning pork to cover.
Store overnight in refrigerator; turn meat occasionally.
recipes.text: Pork With Clams. Marinade: Combine wine, garlic and salt in medium-size glass bowl. Cut pork in 1-inch cubes; add to marinade, turning pork to cover. Store overnight in refrigerator; turn meat occasionally.

recipes.title: Purple Lady
directions: Dissolve the gelatin in boiling water.
Add blueberries and pineapple; mix well.
Chill until gelatin mixture is partially set.
recipes.text: Purple Lady. Dissolve the gelatin in boiling water. Add blueberries and pineapple; mix well. Chill until gelatin mixture is partially set.

recipes.title: Alicia'S Sweet Potato Pie
directions: Cook potatoes; peel them, then mash them.
Add 1 cup sugar in them.
Put in butter, cinnamon and flavor.
Cook pie crust for 15 minutes.
Put mixture in pie crust.
Put in oven at 325° until golden brown.
recipes.text: Alicia'S Sweet Potato Pie. Cook potatoes; peel them, then mash them. Add 1 cup sugar in them. Put in butter, cinnamon and flavor. Cook pie crust for 15 minutes. Put mixture in pie crust. Put in oven at 325° until golden brown.

recipes.title: Shepherd'S Pie
ingredients: 2 to 3 lb. potatoes, boiled and mashed
directions: Brown beef in 1 tablespoon vegetable oil.
Add onion and cook until tender.
Add carrots and cook a few minutes.
Add tomato sauce and peas.
Cook for 10 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper.
recipes.text: Shepherd'S Pie. Brown beef in 1 tablespoon vegetable oil. Add onion and cook until tender. Add carrots and cook a few minutes. Add tomato sauce and peas. Cook for 10 minutes. Season with salt and pepper.

recipes.title: Tuna Fish Spread
directions: Melt cheese and salad dressing in the top of a double boiler. Remove from range and stir in tuna.
Store in the refrigerator.
recipes.text: Tuna Fish Spread. Melt cheese and salad dressing in the top of a double boiler. Remove from range and stir in tuna. Store in the refrigerator.

recipes.title: Tandoori Chicken
directions: Remove skin from cut-up chicken; prick skin and salt well.
Mix all ingredients into the yogurt except food coloring, cumin seed and butter.
Put large gashes into the chicken and smear yogurt mixture well into the chicken.
Cover with remaining yogurt mixture and let stand 8 to 10 hours.
(Can be prepared night before.) Remove the chicken from the yogurt paste but don't throw away as you will baste the roasting chicken with it.
Heat oven to 400° and put chicken on a well-greased pan and cook for 10 minutes.
Remove from oven and baste well first with yogurt mixture and then a paste of the cumin, red food coloring, butter and a little chili powder and lemon juice.
Return to oven.
Do this 3 to 4 times while baking.
This takes 40 to 50 minutes.
Serve on bed of yellow rice garnished with lemon wedges, sliced tomatoes and onion rings.
recipes.text: Tandoori Chicken. Remove skin from cut-up chicken; prick skin and salt well. Mix all ingredients into the yogurt except food coloring, cumin seed and butter. Put large gashes into the chicken and smear yogurt mixture well into the chicken. Cover with remaining yogurt mixture and let stand 8 to 10 hours. (Can be prepared night before.) Remove the chicken from the yogurt paste but don't throw away as you will baste the roasting chicken with it. Heat oven to 400° and put chicken on a well-greased pan and cook for 10 minutes. Remove from oven and baste well first with yogurt mixture and then a paste of the cumin, red food coloring, butter and a little chili powder and lemon juice. Return to oven. Do this 3 to 4 times while baking. This takes 40 to 50 minutes. Serve on bed of yellow rice garnished with lemon wedges, sliced tomatoes and onion rings.

recipes.title: Sand Tarts
directions: Cream butter, sugar and flour together.
Add water and vanilla.
Mix well.
Add pecans.
Cream well.
Roll into 3/4-inch balls and place on ungreased cookie sheet.
Bake for 20 minutes at 350°.
Roll in powdered sugar while warm.
recipes.text: Sand Tarts. Cream butter, sugar and flour together. Add water and vanilla. Mix well. Add pecans. Cream well. Roll into 3/4-inch balls and place on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake for 20 minutes at 350°. Roll in powdered sugar while warm.

recipes.title: Rice Pudding
directions: Cook rice, apple juice and water in a saucepan.
Bring to a boil.
Stir.
Reduce heat to a simmer.
Cover pan; cook, stirring every five minutes, until rice is tender.
Remove from stove. Stir in raisins and cinnamon.
recipes.text: Rice Pudding. Cook rice, apple juice and water in a saucepan. Bring to a boil. Stir. Reduce heat to a simmer. Cover pan; cook, stirring every five minutes, until rice is tender. Remove from stove. Stir in raisins and cinnamon.

recipes.title: Lemon Cheese Jello Salad
directions: Prepare lemon jello as directed on box.
Add vinegar and sugar; partially set and whip.
Add pineapple and cheese.
Fold in cool whip.
Refrigerate.
recipes.text: Lemon Cheese Jello Salad. Prepare lemon jello as directed on box. Add vinegar and sugar; partially set and whip. Add pineapple and cheese. Fold in cool whip. Refrigerate.

recipes.title: Champagne Punch
directions: Mix in order of ingredients listed.
recipes.text: Champagne Punch. Mix in order of ingredients listed.

recipes.title: Rice And Walnut Roast
ingredients: 1 c. Pepperidge Farm seasoned bread crumbs
directions: Pour 3/4 cup milk over crumbs and let stand 5 minutes.
Saute onion and parsley until smooth.
Blend in milk/crumb mixture.
Add egg and walnuts; mix well.
Fold in rice and press gently into oiled loaf pan.
Bake 30 minutes (or until brown) at 350°.
Serve hot with favorite gravy and cranberry sauce.
Serves 6 to 8.
recipes.text: Rice And Walnut Roast. Pour 3/4 cup milk over crumbs and let stand 5 minutes. Saute onion and parsley until smooth. Blend in milk/crumb mixture. Add egg and walnuts; mix well. Fold in rice and press gently into oiled loaf pan. Bake 30 minutes (or until brown) at 350°. Serve hot with favorite gravy and cranberry sauce. Serves 6 to 8.

recipes.title: Reindeer Fodder
directions: Melt chocolate and oil in microwave.
Mix together all other ingredients.
Pour melted chocolate over mixture and mix and stir. Spread mixture over wax paper on cookie sheet.
Let set for awhile, then break into pieces and store in air tight container.
recipes.text: Reindeer Fodder. Melt chocolate and oil in microwave. Mix together all other ingredients. Pour melted chocolate over mixture and mix and stir. Spread mixture over wax paper on cookie sheet. Let set for awhile, then break into pieces and store in air tight container.

recipes.title: Baked New Potatoes
directions: Preheat
oven
to
Wash	and
dry
potatoes
and arrange in single layer on a rimmed cookie sheet.
Bake for 30 minutes or until tender.
Serve
hot or warm with cheese, ham, bacon, sour cream and chives (scallions).
recipes.text: Baked New Potatoes. Preheat oven to 350°. Wash	and dry potatoes and arrange in single layer on a rimmed cookie sheet. Bake for 30 minutes or until tender. Serve hot or warm with cheese, ham, bacon, sour cream and chives (scallions).

recipes.title: Punch
directions: Mix together and freeze half.
Put other half in containers until ready to serve.
Add ginger ale when serving.
recipes.text: Punch. Mix together and freeze half. Put other half in containers until ready to serve. Add ginger ale when serving.

recipes.title: Fruit Pizza
directions: Spray pizza pan with no stick cooking spray. Press dough on pizza pan and bake according to directions on package.

Let cool. Spread cream cheese on cookie dough; spread on pineapple, arrange orange slices on pineapple, chop cherries and arrange between oranges and pineapple. Just before serving, place bananas between cherries and pineapple. Cherry pie filling may be used instead of strawberry.
recipes.text: Fruit Pizza. Spray pizza pan with no stick cooking spray. Press dough on pizza pan and bake according to directions on package. Let cool. Spread cream cheese on cookie dough; spread on pineapple, arrange orange slices on pineapple, chop cherries and arrange between oranges and pineapple. Just before serving, place bananas between cherries and pineapple. Cherry pie filling may be used instead of strawberry.

recipes.title: Easy Swiss Steak
directions: Cut steak into pieces.
Pat in seasoning and water for 15 minutes.
Take out and flour and brown in skillet, then add meat to water and seasoning.
Cook for one hour.
recipes.text: Easy Swiss Steak. Cut steak into pieces. Pat in seasoning and water for 15 minutes. Take out and flour and brown in skillet, then add meat to water and seasoning. Cook for one hour.

recipes.title: Egg Custard
directions: Mix together.
Place in bowl or pan that can go into oven. Set bowl in pan or skillet of water and bake in oven until knife stuck in the middle comes out clean.
recipes.text: Egg Custard. Mix together. Place in bowl or pan that can go into oven. Set bowl in pan or skillet of water and bake in oven until knife stuck in the middle comes out clean.

recipes.title: Norm'S Meat Loaf
ingredients: 1 c. Brooks tomato ketchup (sweet and tangy)
directions: Mix all together and bake at 350° for 45 minutes to 1 hour. Top with ketchup before baking.
recipes.text: Norm'S Meat Loaf. Mix all together and bake at 350° for 45 minutes to 1 hour. Top with ketchup before baking.

recipes.title: Easy Chicken Casserole
ingredients: 1 can Campbell's cream of chicken soup
1 can Campbell's cream of golden corn soup
1 bag Minute rice (boil in bag), cooked
directions: Pour contents of both cans of soup in an oven bake casserole dish.
Add rice which has been cooked, corn and the chicken, cut up in pieces.
Cover and bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Easy Chicken Casserole. Pour contents of both cans of soup in an oven bake casserole dish. Add rice which has been cooked, corn and the chicken, cut up in pieces. Cover and bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Chicken Casserole
ingredients: 1 whole boneless, skinless chicken breast, cooked
directions: Put prepared stuffing in an 8-inch square pan.
Shred chicken and put on top of stuffing.
Layer on chopped broccoli.
Mix the mayonnaise, soup and cheese; pour on top of broccoli.
Crush Ritz crackers and put on top.
Bake for 1 hour at 350°.
recipes.text: Chicken Casserole. Put prepared stuffing in an 8-inch square pan. Shred chicken and put on top of stuffing. Layer on chopped broccoli. Mix the mayonnaise, soup and cheese; pour on top of broccoli. Crush Ritz crackers and put on top. Bake for 1 hour at 350°.

recipes.title: Yellow Angel Food Cake
directions: Add 1/2 cup sugar to beaten egg whites.
Add 1/3 cup sugar, vanilla, salt, baking powder and flour to egg yolks.
Fold in egg whites.
Bake in ungreased tube pan at 350° for 40 minutes.
recipes.text: Yellow Angel Food Cake. Add 1/2 cup sugar to beaten egg whites. Add 1/3 cup sugar, vanilla, salt, baking powder and flour to egg yolks. Fold in egg whites. Bake in ungreased tube pan at 350° for 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Moist N' Chewy Brownies
ingredients: 1 c. (6 oz.) Hershey's semi-sweet chocolate chips
directions: Preheat oven to 350°.
In a large saucepan sprayed with Pam or other pure vegetable cooking spray, over low heat, melt chocolate chips and butter. Stir occasionally until well blended.
Remove from heat.
Add baking mix, sweetened condensed milk and egg. Stir well. Stir in walnuts. Spray Pam on bottom and sides of a 13 x 9-inch baking pan or dish.
Pour brownie mixture into dish.
Bake 20 to 30 minutes.
Cool slightly, then cut into squares.
recipes.text: Moist N' Chewy Brownies. Preheat oven to 350°. In a large saucepan sprayed with Pam or other pure vegetable cooking spray, over low heat, melt chocolate chips and butter. Stir occasionally until well blended. Remove from heat. Add baking mix, sweetened condensed milk and egg. Stir well. Stir in walnuts. Spray Pam on bottom and sides of a 13 x 9-inch baking pan or dish. Pour brownie mixture into dish. Bake 20 to 30 minutes. Cool slightly, then cut into squares.

recipes.title: Fried Cucumbers
ingredients: 2 medium cucumbers, peeled and cut into 1/4-inch slices
directions: Dip cucumber slices in eggs; dredge in bread crumbs.
Fry cucumbers in deep hot oil until browned on both sides.
Drain well on paper towels.
Yields about 3 dozen.
recipes.text: Fried Cucumbers. Dip cucumber slices in eggs; dredge in bread crumbs. Fry cucumbers in deep hot oil until browned on both sides. Drain well on paper towels. Yields about 3 dozen.

recipes.title: Beef Stroganoff
ingredients: 1 lb. extra-lean ground beef or stew meat
1 can low-fat cream of mushroom soup
1 c. nonfat sour cream or yogurt
directions: Brown the meat with the onion and garlic until meat is cooked through.
Drain any fat.
Add remaining ingredients and stir. Heat but do not boil.
Serve over noodles.
recipes.text: Beef Stroganoff. Brown the meat with the onion and garlic until meat is cooked through. Drain any fat. Add remaining ingredients and stir. Heat but do not boil. Serve over noodles.

recipes.title: Zucchini Hot Dish
ingredients: 1 can cream of mushroom or chicken soup
1 lb. ground beef, cooked, but not browned
directions: Pour boiling water over zucchini and bring quickly to a boil. Boil
minutes.
Drain.
Mix all ingredients together and
put in	greased casserole;
bake at 350° for 40 minutes. Cover last 15 minutes.
recipes.text: Zucchini Hot Dish. Pour boiling water over zucchini and bring quickly to a boil. Boil 5 minutes. Drain. Mix all ingredients together and put in	greased casserole; bake at 350° for 40 minutes. Cover last 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Royal Icing(Egg White Recipe)
directions: Beat all ingredients at high speed for 7 to 10 minutes. Use immediately.
Reheating
will not restore texture so keep icing covered
with a damp cloth;
for making decorations and flowers that last.
It's a smooth hard drying icing.
recipes.text: Royal Icing(Egg White Recipe). Beat all ingredients at high speed for 7 to 10 minutes. Use immediately. Reheating will not restore texture so keep icing covered with a damp cloth; for making decorations and flowers that last. It's a smooth hard drying icing.

recipes.title: Salmon Patties
directions: Drain salmon.
Crumble crackers.
Add eggs and pepper.
Amount of pepper can be reduced, if desired.
Make into patties.
Fry patties in oil until brown.
Remove from heat; drain on paper towel.
recipes.text: Salmon Patties. Drain salmon. Crumble crackers. Add eggs and pepper. Amount of pepper can be reduced, if desired. Make into patties. Fry patties in oil until brown. Remove from heat; drain on paper towel.

recipes.title: Icebox Fruit Cake
directions: Crush crackers; add finely chopped fruit and nuts, then coconut.
Melt marshmallows in milk over low heat.
Add to cracker mixture.
Mix well and pack in sprayed loaf pans or roll into 6 x 1 1/2-inch size rolls and wrap in Saran Wrap.
Keep in refrigerator or freeze until ready to serve, slice thin.
recipes.text: Icebox Fruit Cake. Crush crackers; add finely chopped fruit and nuts, then coconut. Melt marshmallows in milk over low heat. Add to cracker mixture. Mix well and pack in sprayed loaf pans or roll into 6 x 1 1/2-inch size rolls and wrap in Saran Wrap. Keep in refrigerator or freeze until ready to serve, slice thin.

recipes.title: Sausage Delights
directions: Mix all ingredients in a mixing bowl.
Moisten batter with a small amount of water as you mix.
Form into small balls about 1-inch in diameter.
Place on an ungreased cookie sheet.
Bake at 425° for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Sausage Delights. Mix all ingredients in a mixing bowl. Moisten batter with a small amount of water as you mix. Form into small balls about 1-inch in diameter. Place on an ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 425° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Stuffer'S Crunch
directions: Mix together and bake in an open pan for two hours at 225°, stirring occasionally.
Makes 8 quarts.
recipes.text: Stuffer'S Crunch. Mix together and bake in an open pan for two hours at 225°, stirring occasionally. Makes 8 quarts.

recipes.title: Potato Salad
directions: Mix all ingredients together.
Chill several hours.
recipes.text: Potato Salad. Mix all ingredients together. Chill several hours.

recipes.title: Five Cup Salad
directions: Drain oranges and pineapple.
Mix all ingredients together and let set for several hours in the refrigerator to blend the flavors.
recipes.text: Five Cup Salad. Drain oranges and pineapple. Mix all ingredients together and let set for several hours in the refrigerator to blend the flavors.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Cookies
directions: Mix all ingredients and form into 1-inch balls; flatten with fork.
Bake 350 degrees for 8-10 minutes.
Should be slightly brown on the edges.
Makes 6 to 8 dozen.
recipes.text: Peanut Butter Cookies. Mix all ingredients and form into 1-inch balls; flatten with fork. Bake 350 degrees for 8-10 minutes. Should be slightly brown on the edges. Makes 6 to 8 dozen.

recipes.title: Cheese Ball
directions: Mix all ingredients in mixer.
Chill.
Roll
ball in pecans or sprinkle with parsley.
recipes.text: Cheese Ball. Mix all ingredients in mixer. Chill. Roll ball in pecans or sprinkle with parsley.

recipes.title: School Sugar Cookies
directions: Mix all ingredients together.
Bake at 375° for 10 to 12 minutes.
Makes 12 dozen.
recipes.text: School Sugar Cookies. Mix all ingredients together. Bake at 375° for 10 to 12 minutes. Makes 12 dozen.

recipes.title: Lite Oriental Chicken
ingredients: 1 (8 oz.) can water chestnuts, rinsed and drained
2 whole chicken breasts, skinned and boned
directions: Mix together 1/2 cup broth, soy sauce, sherry and cornstarch. Set aside; cut chicken into 1-inch cubes.
Heat 3 tablespoons chicken broth in large pan or wok and brown chicken quickly. Remove from pan and keep warm.
Add garlic, mushrooms and snow peas; stir 2 minutes until mushrooms are golden brown.
Return chicken to pan and add water chestnuts and bamboo shoots.
Pour well mixed sauce over all and cook 2 to 3 minutes until chicken is done and vegetables are crisp and tender.
recipes.text: Lite Oriental Chicken. Mix together 1/2 cup broth, soy sauce, sherry and cornstarch. Set aside; cut chicken into 1-inch cubes. Heat 3 tablespoons chicken broth in large pan or wok and brown chicken quickly. Remove from pan and keep warm. Add garlic, mushrooms and snow peas; stir 2 minutes until mushrooms are golden brown. Return chicken to pan and add water chestnuts and bamboo shoots. Pour well mixed sauce over all and cook 2 to 3 minutes until chicken is done and vegetables are crisp and tender.

recipes.title: John'S Vegetarian "Ska-Betti"
ingredients: any garden vegetables available in any combination: eggplant (trimmed and cubed), zucchini (cubed), yellow squash (cubed), tomatoes (plum), spinach (torn in small pieces)
directions: In your biggest pan, saute in olive oil the onion.
Add fresh garlic, basil, oregano, cinnamon and cloves.
Add cubed vegetables, sauteing rapidly over high heat.
Add sliced tomatoes and red wine (we just fill the pan up with tomatoes).
Once this is bubbling nicely, turn down to medium heat and let liquids boil down about 30 minutes, with lid off.
About 10 minutes before dinner, boil the spaghettini until done.
Rinse and serve with sauce.
Leftover sauce freezes well for future meals.
recipes.text: John'S Vegetarian "Ska-Betti". In your biggest pan, saute in olive oil the onion. Add fresh garlic, basil, oregano, cinnamon and cloves. Add cubed vegetables, sauteing rapidly over high heat. Add sliced tomatoes and red wine (we just fill the pan up with tomatoes). Once this is bubbling nicely, turn down to medium heat and let liquids boil down about 30 minutes, with lid off. About 10 minutes before dinner, boil the spaghettini until done. Rinse and serve with sauce. Leftover sauce freezes well for future meals.

recipes.title: Shrimp Dip
ingredients: 1 pkg. dry Lipton onion soup mix
1 tsp. each: red pepper, salt and lemon pepper
directions: Boil shrimp with 4 cloves of garlic (unpeeled) for 8 minutes. Peel shrimp; chop some and leave some whole.
Combine all other ingredients together; add shrimp last.
Let stand overnight.
recipes.text: Shrimp Dip. Boil shrimp with 4 cloves of garlic (unpeeled) for 8 minutes. Peel shrimp; chop some and leave some whole. Combine all other ingredients together; add shrimp last. Let stand overnight.

recipes.title: Sopa De Tortilla(Tortilla Soup)
ingredients: 1 fresh jalapeno pepper, seeded and chopped
1 large avocado, peeled, pitted and sliced
directions: In 4-quart saucepan, saute onion and garlic in oil. Add beef and chicken broths, tomato juice, cumin, chili powder, jalapeno pepper, salt and Worcestershire sauce.
Heat to boiling; reduce heat and simmer, covered, for 1 hour. Cut corn tortillas into narrow strips.
Heat oil in skillet and fry tortillas until crisp. Drain on paper towels.
Add chicken and tomato to soup; cook 5 minutes.
Place 2 to 3 tortilla strips in each soup bowl. Pour soup into bowls and garnish with avocado slices and 1 tablespoon of cheese.
Makes 8 to 10 servings.
recipes.text: Sopa De Tortilla(Tortilla Soup). In 4-quart saucepan, saute onion and garlic in oil. Add beef and chicken broths, tomato juice, cumin, chili powder, jalapeno pepper, salt and Worcestershire sauce. Heat to boiling; reduce heat and simmer, covered, for 1 hour. Cut corn tortillas into narrow strips. Heat oil in skillet and fry tortillas until crisp. Drain on paper towels. Add chicken and tomato to soup; cook 5 minutes. Place 2 to 3 tortilla strips in each soup bowl. Pour soup into bowls and garnish with avocado slices and 1 tablespoon of cheese. Makes 8 to 10 servings.

recipes.title: Maple Pork Chops
directions: Brown chops.
Place in flat baking dish.
Combine ingredients and pour over chops.
Cover and bake at 400°, basting occasionally, 45 minutes.
Uncover.
Bake 15 minutes at 400°.
Remove chops and thicken sauce with flour.
recipes.text: Maple Pork Chops. Brown chops. Place in flat baking dish. Combine ingredients and pour over chops. Cover and bake at 400°, basting occasionally, 45 minutes. Uncover. Bake 15 minutes at 400°. Remove chops and thicken sauce with flour.

recipes.title: Cream Of Broccoli Soup
ingredients: 1/4 to 1/2 tsp. dried or whole tarragon
directions: Cook broccoli according to package directions; drain well. Add remaining ingredients; cook over low heat until thoroughly heated.
Yields about 8 cups.
recipes.text: Cream Of Broccoli Soup. Cook broccoli according to package directions; drain well. Add remaining ingredients; cook over low heat until thoroughly heated. Yields about 8 cups.

recipes.title: Lollipop Cookies
ingredients: 1 pkg. supermoist golden vanilla cake mix
1 tub rich & creamy ready to spread frosting (any flavor)
directions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees.
Stir together cake mix, oil & eggs using spoon.
Drop dough by rounded tablespoonfuls about 3 inches apart onto ungreased cookie sheet.
Insert wooden stick in edge of dough until tip is in center.
Bake 8-10 minutes or until puffed and almost no indentation remains where touched.
Cool 1 minute before removing from cookie sheet.
Cool completely, about 30 minutes.
Frost and decorate as desired.
recipes.text: Lollipop Cookies. Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Stir together cake mix, oil & eggs using spoon. Drop dough by rounded tablespoonfuls about 3 inches apart onto ungreased cookie sheet. Insert wooden stick in edge of dough until tip is in center. Bake 8-10 minutes or until puffed and almost no indentation remains where touched. Cool 1 minute before removing from cookie sheet. Cool completely, about 30 minutes. Frost and decorate as desired.

recipes.title: Beef Stroganoff(From Overrock Inn)
directions: Brown tenderloin tips.
Brown flour in butter or margarine. Add wine and vinegar to meat juices from browning meat.
Make a brown sauce using browned flour.
Put the tips in the sauce; add seasonings and mushrooms.
Remove from heat and add sour cream. Serve on noodles or toast points.
recipes.text: Beef Stroganoff(From Overrock Inn). Brown tenderloin tips. Brown flour in butter or margarine. Add wine and vinegar to meat juices from browning meat. Make a brown sauce using browned flour. Put the tips in the sauce; add seasonings and mushrooms. Remove from heat and add sour cream. Serve on noodles or toast points.

recipes.title: Icebox Cookies
directions: Sift together flour, soda, baking powder, salt and cinnamon. Cream butter, sugars, eggs and nuts.
Add flour mixture to creamed mixture; mix well.
Put in rolls, and put
in refrigerator until chilled.
Cut in slices and bake at 350° on ungreased cookie sheet.
recipes.text: Icebox Cookies. Sift together flour, soda, baking powder, salt and cinnamon. Cream butter, sugars, eggs and nuts. Add flour mixture to creamed mixture; mix well. Put in rolls, and put in refrigerator until chilled. Cut in slices and bake at 350° on ungreased cookie sheet.

recipes.title: World'S Best Roast
directions: Use deep, long pan.
Line with foil.
Place roast in bottom. Cover with onion slices and mushrooms.
Pour soup over roast.
Add vegetables.
Cook at 325° for 3 1/2 to 4 hours.
recipes.text: World'S Best Roast. Use deep, long pan. Line with foil. Place roast in bottom. Cover with onion slices and mushrooms. Pour soup over roast. Add vegetables. Cook at 325° for 3 1/2 to 4 hours.

recipes.title: Natural Apple Crisp
directions: Heat oven to 350°.
Combine apples, water and lemon juice in large bowl.
Combine brown sugar, flour and cinnamon; toss with apples.
Layer in an 8-inch square glass baking dish.
Combine cereal and margarine; sprinkle evenly over apple mixture.
Bake for 25 to 30 minutes, or until apples are tender.
Serve warm. Top with frozen yogurt, whipped cream or ice cream.
recipes.text: Natural Apple Crisp. Heat oven to 350°. Combine apples, water and lemon juice in large bowl. Combine brown sugar, flour and cinnamon; toss with apples. Layer in an 8-inch square glass baking dish. Combine cereal and margarine; sprinkle evenly over apple mixture. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes, or until apples are tender. Serve warm. Top with frozen yogurt, whipped cream or ice cream.

recipes.title: Chocolate Pie (From Mama)
ingredients: 2 Tbsp. cornstarch, dissolved in 2 Tbsp. water
directions: Line a deep pie pan with a rich pie crust and bake in a 450° oven for 10 to 15 minutes.
recipes.text: Chocolate Pie (From Mama). Line a deep pie pan with a rich pie crust and bake in a 450° oven for 10 to 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Smoked Boneless Shoulder Butt And Cabbage Dish
ingredients: 1 (2 to 3 lb.) smoked shoulder boneless butt
4 to 6 white potatoes, peeled and cut in halves
directions: In the morning place cabbage which has been cut in half and stalks removed, in a pan of cold water.
recipes.text: Smoked Boneless Shoulder Butt And Cabbage Dish. In the morning place cabbage which has been cut in half and stalks removed, in a pan of cold water.

recipes.title: Hot Beans
directions: Cook together the first 3 ingredients until sausage browns. In a large bowl, mix remaining ingredients. Pour all ingredients in a large baking dish, except bacon. Spread bacon on top. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Hot Beans. Cook together the first 3 ingredients until sausage browns. In a large bowl, mix remaining ingredients. Pour all ingredients in a large baking dish, except bacon. Spread bacon on top. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Molasses Cookies
directions: Cream shortening and sugar; add eggs and molasses and mix well.
Stir in dry ingredients.
Make into balls.
Roll in sugar; place on cookie sheet.
Bake at 370° for 10 to 12 minutes.
recipes.text: Molasses Cookies. Cream shortening and sugar; add eggs and molasses and mix well. Stir in dry ingredients. Make into balls. Roll in sugar; place on cookie sheet. Bake at 370° for 10 to 12 minutes.

recipes.title: Gingerbread
directions: Combine all ingredients.
Bake for 30 minutes at 350°.
recipes.text: Gingerbread. Combine all ingredients. Bake for 30 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Zucchini Walnut Bread
directions: Beat eggs and sugar, then add oil.
Add dry ingredients.
Add zucchini.
Stir in raisins, walnuts and vanilla.
Grease 2 loaf pans and flour lightly.
Bake on lowest rack.
Set oven at 325° for 1 hour or until done.
Let stand in pan for 10 minutes.
Turn onto rack to cool.
recipes.text: Zucchini Walnut Bread. Beat eggs and sugar, then add oil. Add dry ingredients. Add zucchini. Stir in raisins, walnuts and vanilla. Grease 2 loaf pans and flour lightly. Bake on lowest rack. Set oven at 325° for 1 hour or until done. Let stand in pan for 10 minutes. Turn onto rack to cool.

recipes.title: Pickled Beans
directions: Combine all ingredients.
Make a day ahead.
Will last up to 2 weeks.
recipes.text: Pickled Beans. Combine all ingredients. Make a day ahead. Will last up to 2 weeks.

recipes.title: Pound Cake Cookies
ingredients: 3 sticks butter, at room temperature (do not substitute margarine)
directions: Cream butter and sugar.
Add egg yolks.
Blend flour into butter mixture.
Add vanilla.
Refrigerate dough until thoroughly chilled.
Form small balls about the size of a quarter and press onto ungreased cookie sheet.
Using thumb, press indentation in top of each cookie and fill with small amount of strawberry jam. If you prefer, press a pecan half on top of cookies.
Bake 12 minutes at 300° or until lightly browned.
Cool several minutes, then slide cookies off pan, using a spatula.
Makes about 6 to 7 dozen cookies.
Keep stored in an airtight container for a crisp, delightful treat.
recipes.text: Pound Cake Cookies. Cream butter and sugar. Add egg yolks. Blend flour into butter mixture. Add vanilla. Refrigerate dough until thoroughly chilled. Form small balls about the size of a quarter and press onto ungreased cookie sheet. Using thumb, press indentation in top of each cookie and fill with small amount of strawberry jam. If you prefer, press a pecan half on top of cookies. Bake 12 minutes at 300° or until lightly browned. Cool several minutes, then slide cookies off pan, using a spatula. Makes about 6 to 7 dozen cookies. Keep stored in an airtight container for a crisp, delightful treat.

recipes.title: Vegetable Stew
directions: Soak
beans
in
broth.
Cook down with garlic that has been minced.
Add
onions,
celery
and carrots, all chopped. Add eggplant, peeled and chopped, and olive oil.
Season with herbs. Cook on very low burner until done.
recipes.text: Vegetable Stew. Soak beans in broth. Cook down with garlic that has been minced. Add onions, celery and carrots, all chopped. Add eggplant, peeled and chopped, and olive oil. Season with herbs. Cook on very low burner until done.

recipes.title: Salami
directions: Mix all ingredients well and refrigerate for 24 hours.
Take out and mix well again and return to refrigerator for another 24 hours.
Shape into loaves and bake on broiler pan at 160° for 8 hours, turning after first 4 hours.
After it cools, you can slice it and freeze it in sealed bags.
recipes.text: Salami. Mix all ingredients well and refrigerate for 24 hours. Take out and mix well again and return to refrigerator for another 24 hours. Shape into loaves and bake on broiler pan at 160° for 8 hours, turning after first 4 hours. After it cools, you can slice it and freeze it in sealed bags.

recipes.title: In-A-Hurry Taco Bake
ingredients: 1 small bag corn chips (1 or 2 oz.)
1 can black beans or chili with beans
1 c. yellow corn (frozen, or if canned, drained)
1/2 c. diced green and/or red sweet peppers
1/4 c. diced onion (equivalent of dried minced)
4 to 8 oz. shredded Cheddar cheese (as desired)
directions: Crush corn chips and place in bottom of a small casserole dish. Top with beans, corn, peppers, onions, salsa and cheese, in that order.
Microwave for 8 to 10 minutes, or bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes.
Serves 4.
recipes.text: In-A-Hurry Taco Bake. Crush corn chips and place in bottom of a small casserole dish. Top with beans, corn, peppers, onions, salsa and cheese, in that order. Microwave for 8 to 10 minutes, or bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes. Serves 4.

recipes.title: No-Bake Cookies
directions: Mix sugar, cocoa and milk in large saucepan; boil 30 seconds to 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Remove from heat.
Add margarine and peanut butter.
Stir until melted.
Add oatmeal, vanilla and nuts.
Stir until well mixed.
Drop by teaspoon onto wax paper.
Makes 3 to 5 dozen.
recipes.text: No-Bake Cookies. Mix sugar, cocoa and milk in large saucepan; boil 30 seconds to 1 minute, stirring constantly. Remove from heat. Add margarine and peanut butter. Stir until melted. Add oatmeal, vanilla and nuts. Stir until well mixed. Drop by teaspoon onto wax paper. Makes 3 to 5 dozen.

recipes.title: Mississippi Fudge
directions: Melt together margarine and cocoa.
Cool.
Gradually add beaten eggs.
Sift flour, sugar and salt and stir into batter.
Add vanilla and pecans.
Bake at 375° for 25 minutes in 14-inch jelly roll pan.
Remove from oven and spread Marshmallow Creme over cake immediately.
recipes.text: Mississippi Fudge. Melt together margarine and cocoa. Cool. Gradually add beaten eggs. Sift flour, sugar and salt and stir into batter. Add vanilla and pecans. Bake at 375° for 25 minutes in 14-inch jelly roll pan. Remove from oven and spread Marshmallow Creme over cake immediately.

recipes.title: Pecan Fudge
directions: In medium saucepan, heat sugar, cocoa, butter, milk, and salt over low heat stirring until smooth. Stir in nuts. Spread mixture quickly in buttered 9 x 5 loaf pan. Cool, cut into squares. Makes 2 dozen.
recipes.text: Pecan Fudge. In medium saucepan, heat sugar, cocoa, butter, milk, and salt over low heat stirring until smooth. Stir in nuts. Spread mixture quickly in buttered 9 x 5 loaf pan. Cool, cut into squares. Makes 2 dozen.

recipes.title: Four-Fruit Wassail
directions: Combine ingredients in a Dutch oven.
Bring to a boil; reduce heat and simmer 30 minutes.
Remove 4 cinnamon sticks; serve with fresh cinnamon sticks, if desired.
Yields 5 quarts.
recipes.text: Four-Fruit Wassail. Combine ingredients in a Dutch oven. Bring to a boil; reduce heat and simmer 30 minutes. Remove 4 cinnamon sticks; serve with fresh cinnamon sticks, if desired. Yields 5 quarts.

recipes.title: Hot Potato Salad Casserole(Even People Who Hate Potato Salad Like This!)
ingredients: 8 potatoes, boiled, peeled and grated (don't overcook and use a food processor)
directions: Gently mix together in a very large bowl the potatoes, cheese and onion.
Shake mayonnaise and milk in a jar.
Gradually pour mayonnaise/milk mixture over potato/cheese mixture and toss gently, adding salt and pepper to taste.
Spread in a large (at least 9 x 13-inch) baking dish and top with crumbled bacon and sliced olives. Can be made a day ahead and stored in the refrigerator.
Bake 1 hour at 325°.
These are also great as leftovers.
recipes.text: Hot Potato Salad Casserole(Even People Who Hate Potato Salad Like This!). Gently mix together in a very large bowl the potatoes, cheese and onion. Shake mayonnaise and milk in a jar. Gradually pour mayonnaise/milk mixture over potato/cheese mixture and toss gently, adding salt and pepper to taste. Spread in a large (at least 9 x 13-inch) baking dish and top with crumbled bacon and sliced olives. Can be made a day ahead and stored in the refrigerator. Bake 1 hour at 325°. These are also great as leftovers.

recipes.title: Pound Cake With Raspberries
directions: Heat jam in saucepan until just melted.
Cut cake in cubes and divide among 6 dessert dishes.
Top each serving with jam, yogurt and fresh raspberries and serve immediately.
recipes.text: Pound Cake With Raspberries. Heat jam in saucepan until just melted. Cut cake in cubes and divide among 6 dessert dishes. Top each serving with jam, yogurt and fresh raspberries and serve immediately.

recipes.title: Bean Soup
directions: Cook beans with onion, bell pepper and Ro-Tel tomatoes until tender.
Cook hamburger meat, drain and add to soup.
Add chili powder and garlic salt as needed.
Add 1/2 cup of tomato sauce if needed.
recipes.text: Bean Soup. Cook beans with onion, bell pepper and Ro-Tel tomatoes until tender. Cook hamburger meat, drain and add to soup. Add chili powder and garlic salt as needed. Add 1/2 cup of tomato sauce if needed.

recipes.title: Easy Berry Pie
directions: Place 2 cups berries in bottom of pie crust.
Bring to a boil 2 cups berries, flour (or cornstarch) and sugar.
Add lemon juice and pour over whole berries in pie crust.
Cool.
Top with the whipped cream.
recipes.text: Easy Berry Pie. Place 2 cups berries in bottom of pie crust. Bring to a boil 2 cups berries, flour (or cornstarch) and sugar. Add lemon juice and pour over whole berries in pie crust. Cool. Top with the whipped cream.

recipes.title: Sausage Balls
directions: Mix sausage, stuffing and water.
Add onion, eggs and baking powder.
Roll into balls and bake them for 15 minutes, covered, at 325°.
Uncover, raise heat to 350° and bake for 25 more minutes.
recipes.text: Sausage Balls. Mix sausage, stuffing and water. Add onion, eggs and baking powder. Roll into balls and bake them for 15 minutes, covered, at 325°. Uncover, raise heat to 350° and bake for 25 more minutes.

recipes.title: Havreflarn (Swedish Lace Wafers)
directions: Sift together in a bowl the flour, baking powder and sugar. Add oats, heavy cream, corn syrup, oleo and vanilla; mix well. Drop on ungreased sheet 4 inches apart using 1/4 teaspoon as measure.
Bake at 375° for 6 to 8 minutes.
Remove carefully to waxed paper to cool.
Makes approximately 6 dozen 2-inch wafers.
recipes.text: Havreflarn (Swedish Lace Wafers). Sift together in a bowl the flour, baking powder and sugar. Add oats, heavy cream, corn syrup, oleo and vanilla; mix well. Drop on ungreased sheet 4 inches apart using 1/4 teaspoon as measure. Bake at 375° for 6 to 8 minutes. Remove carefully to waxed paper to cool. Makes approximately 6 dozen 2-inch wafers.

recipes.title: Green Chili Casserole
ingredients: sprinkle of garlic salt and Parmesan cheese
directions: Boil chicken; debone in bite-size pieces.
Mix together and bake 20 minutes or until bubbly.
Grate Cheddar cheese on top and put back in oven until cheese is melted in 350° oven.
recipes.text: Green Chili Casserole. Boil chicken; debone in bite-size pieces. Mix together and bake 20 minutes or until bubbly. Grate Cheddar cheese on top and put back in oven until cheese is melted in 350° oven.

recipes.title: Tomato Pickles
directions: Quarter the tomatoes.
Slice onions.
Add to tomatoes in a large boiler.
Add peppers and spice.
Add vinegar and sugar until mixture just covers tomatoes.
(Start with small amount because when sugar melts, liquid will rise.) Let simmer until tomatoes are tender enough that a toothpick will stick through them easily. Let cook for a minute more.
Put in hot jars and seal.
recipes.text: Tomato Pickles. Quarter the tomatoes. Slice onions. Add to tomatoes in a large boiler. Add peppers and spice. Add vinegar and sugar until mixture just covers tomatoes. (Start with small amount because when sugar melts, liquid will rise.) Let simmer until tomatoes are tender enough that a toothpick will stick through them easily. Let cook for a minute more. Put in hot jars and seal.

recipes.title: Wacky Cake
directions: Sift dry ingredients together.
Add oil, vanilla and vinegar. Stir and mix well.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
Use an 8 or 9-inch square dish.
recipes.text: Wacky Cake. Sift dry ingredients together. Add oil, vanilla and vinegar. Stir and mix well. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes. Use an 8 or 9-inch square dish.

recipes.title: Fish Chowder
directions: Fry bacon until crisp in soup pot.
Drain pork on paper towel. Fry onions in bacon grease.
Return bacon to pot; add water and potatoes.
Cook until potatoes are done.
Add milk and fish.
Cook until fish is tender.
Do not boil.
Serve piping hot.
recipes.text: Fish Chowder. Fry bacon until crisp in soup pot. Drain pork on paper towel. Fry onions in bacon grease. Return bacon to pot; add water and potatoes. Cook until potatoes are done. Add milk and fish. Cook until fish is tender. Do not boil. Serve piping hot.

recipes.title: Franklin Nut Cake
directions: Mix dates, nuts and candied fruits with 1 cup flour; set aside.
Cream butter and sugar.
Add eggs.
Add 3 cups flour which have been sifted with the baking powder and salt.
Beat until creamy and flour.
Stir in fruit and nut mixture.
(Dough will be very stiff.)
Add vanilla.
Cook in a tube pan that has been lined with brown paper.
(You may use 2 loaf pans lined with paper.) Bake at 250° for 3 hours.
Let cool in pan.
recipes.text: Franklin Nut Cake. Mix dates, nuts and candied fruits with 1 cup flour; set aside. Cream butter and sugar. Add eggs. Add 3 cups flour which have been sifted with the baking powder and salt. Beat until creamy and flour. Stir in fruit and nut mixture. (Dough will be very stiff.) Add vanilla. Cook in a tube pan that has been lined with brown paper. (You may use 2 loaf pans lined with paper.) Bake at 250° for 3 hours. Let cool in pan.

recipes.title: Baked Apple
directions: Cut a thick slice from top of apple and core.
Put sugar in center of apple.
Add cinnamon and raisins.
Wrap loosely in foil. Bake 30 minutes in campfire.
recipes.text: Baked Apple. Cut a thick slice from top of apple and core. Put sugar in center of apple. Add cinnamon and raisins. Wrap loosely in foil. Bake 30 minutes in campfire.

recipes.title: Chocolate Pound Cake With Real Fudge Icing
directions: Cream shortening and sugar.
Sift dry ingredients together. Add dry ingredients and milk alternately about 1/3 at a time, beating constantly.
Add eggs, one at a time.
Add vanilla.
Pour batter into greased and floured tube pan and bake for 1 hour and 25 minutes at 300°.
recipes.text: Chocolate Pound Cake With Real Fudge Icing. Cream shortening and sugar. Sift dry ingredients together. Add dry ingredients and milk alternately about 1/3 at a time, beating constantly. Add eggs, one at a time. Add vanilla. Pour batter into greased and floured tube pan and bake for 1 hour and 25 minutes at 300°.

recipes.title: Christmas Nut Balls
directions: Mix all ingredients together but powdered sugar.
Shape into balls about the size of a quarter.
Place on ungreased cookie sheet.
Bake 10 to 12 minutes at 350°.
While still warm, roll in powdered sugar.
Repeat again when cool.
recipes.text: Christmas Nut Balls. Mix all ingredients together but powdered sugar. Shape into balls about the size of a quarter. Place on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake 10 to 12 minutes at 350°. While still warm, roll in powdered sugar. Repeat again when cool.

recipes.title: Strawberry Salad
directions: Dissolve Jell-O in hot water.
Add strawberries and chopped nuts; let jell.
Cream together the cream cheese and sugar.
Add Dream Whip that has been whipped as directed on package.
Put on top of Jell-O.
Sprinkle with nuts, if desired.
You may use any type berry with Jell-O in that flavor.
recipes.text: Strawberry Salad. Dissolve Jell-O in hot water. Add strawberries and chopped nuts; let jell. Cream together the cream cheese and sugar. Add Dream Whip that has been whipped as directed on package. Put on top of Jell-O. Sprinkle with nuts, if desired. You may use any type berry with Jell-O in that flavor.

recipes.title: Saladmaster Meat Loaf
directions: Use #1 blade on Saladmaster machine to grate potato, carrot, celery and crackers to a fine mesh.
Cut onion on #2 blade.
Add 2 eggs and 1/2 the bottle of soy sauce.
Mix to a consistent color. Add meat and knead thoroughly to a consistent color throughout. (Check for dry spots or lumps of unmixed meat; knead some more.)
recipes.text: Saladmaster Meat Loaf. Use #1 blade on Saladmaster machine to grate potato, carrot, celery and crackers to a fine mesh. Cut onion on #2 blade. Add 2 eggs and 1/2 the bottle of soy sauce. Mix to a consistent color. Add meat and knead thoroughly to a consistent color throughout. (Check for dry spots or lumps of unmixed meat; knead some more.)

recipes.title: Doughnuts
directions: Dissolve yeast in warm water.
Add milk, sugar, salt, egg, shortening and half of flour.
Mix until smooth.
Add rest of flour.
Knead about 5 minutes and put in good greased bowl.
Let rise until double.
Punch down and let rise again.
Roll out and cut.
Let rise again for 30 to 45 minutes.
Drop in grease at 375°.
Remove when golden brown.
Drain and roll in sugar, cinnamon or powdered sugar.
recipes.text: Doughnuts. Dissolve yeast in warm water. Add milk, sugar, salt, egg, shortening and half of flour. Mix until smooth. Add rest of flour. Knead about 5 minutes and put in good greased bowl. Let rise until double. Punch down and let rise again. Roll out and cut. Let rise again for 30 to 45 minutes. Drop in grease at 375°. Remove when golden brown. Drain and roll in sugar, cinnamon or powdered sugar.

recipes.title: Rotini Cucumber Salad
directions: Cook rotini according to package direction.
Drain and rinse in cold water.
Drain well!
Place in bowl; add cucumber and onion.
Combine remaining ingredients in blender or jar with tight-fitting lid; mix well.
Pour over rotini mixture and toss to coat.
Cover and refrigerate for at least an hour before serving. Yield: 4 servings.
recipes.text: Rotini Cucumber Salad. Cook rotini according to package direction. Drain and rinse in cold water. Drain well! Place in bowl; add cucumber and onion. Combine remaining ingredients in blender or jar with tight-fitting lid; mix well. Pour over rotini mixture and toss to coat. Cover and refrigerate for at least an hour before serving. Yield: 4 servings.

recipes.title: Little Chicken Dinners
directions: Shape sausage into 1-inch balls.
In medium skillet, brown balls.
Remove and drain.
Pour fat from skillet.
Melt butter over low heat; stir in flour and salt until mixture is bubbly.
Remove from heat.
Stir in broth, cream and mushrooms with liquid.
Heat to boiling, stirring constantly.
Boil and stir for 1 minute.
Heat oven to 425°.
Divide chicken, sausage and sauce into 6 ungreased individual baking dishes.
Place one pastry round on each dish, fold pastry under, even with edge of dish.
Flute.
Cut slits on top.
Place dishes on baking sheet and cover with aluminum foil. Remove foil the last 10 minutes of baking.
Bake 30 minutes or until crust is brown.
Insert pastry chicken in each baking dish. Makes 6 servings.
recipes.text: Little Chicken Dinners. Shape sausage into 1-inch balls. In medium skillet, brown balls. Remove and drain. Pour fat from skillet. Melt butter over low heat; stir in flour and salt until mixture is bubbly. Remove from heat. Stir in broth, cream and mushrooms with liquid. Heat to boiling, stirring constantly. Boil and stir for 1 minute. Heat oven to 425°. Divide chicken, sausage and sauce into 6 ungreased individual baking dishes. Place one pastry round on each dish, fold pastry under, even with edge of dish. Flute. Cut slits on top. Place dishes on baking sheet and cover with aluminum foil. Remove foil the last 10 minutes of baking. Bake 30 minutes or until crust is brown. Insert pastry chicken in each baking dish. Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Irish Potato Cake
directions: Mix and pour into 2 cake pans.
Bake at 350°.
recipes.text: Irish Potato Cake. Mix and pour into 2 cake pans. Bake at 350°.

recipes.title: Angel Biscuits
directions: Dissolve yeast in water and set aside.
