Sift flour, baking powder, soda, salt and sugar together into large bowl.
Cut shortening into dry ingredients, then add buttermilk and dissolved yeast.
Mix well.
Knead lightly.
Do not let rise!!!
Shape into rounds and bake at 425° for 20 to 25 minutes.
Yield:
25 biscuits.
recipes.text: Angel Biscuits. Dissolve yeast in water and set aside. Sift flour, baking powder, soda, salt and sugar together into large bowl. Cut shortening into dry ingredients, then add buttermilk and dissolved yeast. Mix well. Knead lightly. Do not let rise!!! Shape into rounds and bake at 425° for 20 to 25 minutes. Yield: 25 biscuits.

recipes.title: Easy Pound Cake
directions: Cream margarine, Crisco and sugar together until light.
Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each one.
Add buttermilk and canned milk alternately with flour.
Add flavoring; beat about 3 minutes.
Pour into greased and floured tube pan.
Bake in preheated 300° oven for 1 1/2 hours.
Place small can of water on bottom rack.
recipes.text: Easy Pound Cake. Cream margarine, Crisco and sugar together until light. Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each one. Add buttermilk and canned milk alternately with flour. Add flavoring; beat about 3 minutes. Pour into greased and floured tube pan. Bake in preheated 300° oven for 1 1/2 hours. Place small can of water on bottom rack.

recipes.title: Heart Smart Carrot Pineapple Juice
ingredients: 1 (8 oz.) can crushed pineapple, packed in its own juice
directions: In blender at medium speed, blend carrots and water about 1 minute.
Strain; return liquid to blender.
Add remaining ingredients.
Blend at low speed until smooth.
Pour into 2 glasses.
Makes 2 servings.
recipes.text: Heart Smart Carrot Pineapple Juice. In blender at medium speed, blend carrots and water about 1 minute. Strain; return liquid to blender. Add remaining ingredients. Blend at low speed until smooth. Pour into 2 glasses. Makes 2 servings.

recipes.title: Island Chicken Salad Pitas
ingredients: 1 large apple, cored, peeled and chopped
directions: Combine ingredients.
Use enough mayonnaise to make salad the consistency you like.
Curry powder and chutney can be varied according to taste.
Preferably, use a mango-based chutney, such as Major Gray's.
To serve, scoop salad into pita pockets.
recipes.text: Island Chicken Salad Pitas. Combine ingredients. Use enough mayonnaise to make salad the consistency you like. Curry powder and chutney can be varied according to taste. Preferably, use a mango-based chutney, such as Major Gray's. To serve, scoop salad into pita pockets.

recipes.title: Cheese Balls
directions: Use your hands to mix the cheese and parsley flakes thoroughly.
Roll into 1/2-inch balls.
Roll each cheese ball in the ground nuts.
Refrigerate until 1/2 hour before serving time. Serve at room temperature with crackers.
recipes.text: Cheese Balls. Use your hands to mix the cheese and parsley flakes thoroughly. Roll into 1/2-inch balls. Roll each cheese ball in the ground nuts. Refrigerate until 1/2 hour before serving time. Serve at room temperature with crackers.

recipes.title: Chicken And Broccoli With Rice
ingredients: 1 lb. chicken breast, cut into strips or chunks
directions: Cook and stir chicken in hot oil until light browned.
Stir in soup, milk, mustard and cheese.
Add broccoli.
Bring to a full boil.
Reduce heat and simmer 2 minutes.
Serve over rice.
recipes.text: Chicken And Broccoli With Rice. Cook and stir chicken in hot oil until light browned. Stir in soup, milk, mustard and cheese. Add broccoli. Bring to a full boil. Reduce heat and simmer 2 minutes. Serve over rice.

recipes.title: Spinach Salad Dressing
directions: Combine in container with lid and shake vigorously.
Keeps about 2 weeks in refrigerator.
recipes.text: Spinach Salad Dressing. Combine in container with lid and shake vigorously. Keeps about 2 weeks in refrigerator.

recipes.title: Beef And Bagel Dip
ingredients: 2 pkg. Carl Budding beef, chopped finely
directions: Mix all ingredients together and chill. Serve with torn up honey wheat bagels.
recipes.text: Beef And Bagel Dip. Mix all ingredients together and chill. Serve with torn up honey wheat bagels.

recipes.title: Quick Peach Cobbler
directions: Combine flour, sugar, baking powder and nutmeg.
Add milk (mixture will look like pancake batter).
Use 1 tablespoon melted butter in bottom and on sides of baking dish (medium pan).
Pour batter in baking pan.
Arrange peach slices on top; dot with remaining butter.
Bake 1 hour at 350°.
Serve warm or cold.
recipes.text: Quick Peach Cobbler. Combine flour, sugar, baking powder and nutmeg. Add milk (mixture will look like pancake batter). Use 1 tablespoon melted butter in bottom and on sides of baking dish (medium pan). Pour batter in baking pan. Arrange peach slices on top; dot with remaining butter. Bake 1 hour at 350°. Serve warm or cold.

recipes.title: Black Pepper And Onion Scones
directions: Saute onion in 1/4 cup butter.
Mix flour, sugar, pepper, baking powder and salt. Add egg, whipping cream and onion just until moistened.
On floured board, knead dough gently 5 to 6 times.
Place on ungreased cookie sheet.
Press into 8-inch circle, 1/2-inch thick.
Cut into light wedges.
Pull apart a little.
Lightly brush with butter.
Bake 12 to 16 minutes at 400°.
recipes.text: Black Pepper And Onion Scones. Saute onion in 1/4 cup butter. Mix flour, sugar, pepper, baking powder and salt. Add egg, whipping cream and onion just until moistened. On floured board, knead dough gently 5 to 6 times. Place on ungreased cookie sheet. Press into 8-inch circle, 1/2-inch thick. Cut into light wedges. Pull apart a little. Lightly brush with butter. Bake 12 to 16 minutes at 400°.

recipes.title: Stew Delight
directions: Cut stew meat in small pieces. Combine all other ingredients. Add to meat. Bake at 300° for 2 1/2 hours.
recipes.text: Stew Delight. Cut stew meat in small pieces. Combine all other ingredients. Add to meat. Bake at 300° for 2 1/2 hours.

recipes.title: Stuffed Shells
directions: Saute last four ingredients until cooked.
Add sauce and simmer 20 to 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Stuffed Shells. Saute last four ingredients until cooked. Add sauce and simmer 20 to 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Cajun Quiche
ingredients: 1/2 lb. cooked, peeled shrimp or crawfish, slightly chopped
directions: Sprinkle cheese evenly over unbaked pie shell.
Add chopped shrimp and crabmeat.
Then add green onions.
Mix eggs, whipping cream, salt and pepper.
Pour over shrimp.
Preheat oven to 400°. Place pie on cookie sheet and bake 40 minutes.
Let stand a few minutes if not completely "set" in center.
recipes.text: Cajun Quiche. Sprinkle cheese evenly over unbaked pie shell. Add chopped shrimp and crabmeat. Then add green onions. Mix eggs, whipping cream, salt and pepper. Pour over shrimp. Preheat oven to 400°. Place pie on cookie sheet and bake 40 minutes. Let stand a few minutes if not completely "set" in center.

recipes.title: Scones
directions: Mix flour, baking powder, butter or margarine, egg, sugar, raisins and enough milk to form a ball (soft and doughy).
Roll out dough on floured surface. Cut with 3-inch glass approximately 1/2-inch thick.
Bake at 350° for 10 to 12 minutes or until lightly brown.
Makes 12 scones.
recipes.text: Scones. Mix flour, baking powder, butter or margarine, egg, sugar, raisins and enough milk to form a ball (soft and doughy). Roll out dough on floured surface. Cut with 3-inch glass approximately 1/2-inch thick. Bake at 350° for 10 to 12 minutes or until lightly brown. Makes 12 scones.

recipes.title: Pecan Drops
ingredients: 3 egg whites, beaten stiff and dry
directions: Mix all dry ingredients, then fold in egg whites.
Drop by teaspoonful on cookie
sheet
and bake in slow oven at 325° to 350° for about 10 minutes.
Makes 6 dozen.
recipes.text: Pecan Drops. Mix all dry ingredients, then fold in egg whites. Drop by teaspoonful on cookie sheet and bake in slow oven at 325° to 350° for about 10 minutes. Makes 6 dozen.

recipes.title: Eggplant Skillet
ingredients: 1 lb. ground beef or ground turkey
directions: Cook beef or turkey, onion and celery until meat is browned. Drain off excess fat.
Stir in tomato sauce, water and oregano. Season eggplant slices with salt and pepper.
Arrange on top of meat sauce.
Cover; simmer until eggplant is tender, 15 to 20 minutes.
Top with shredded Cheddar; sprinkle with paprika.
Serve with Parmesan cheese.
recipes.text: Eggplant Skillet. Cook beef or turkey, onion and celery until meat is browned. Drain off excess fat. Stir in tomato sauce, water and oregano. Season eggplant slices with salt and pepper. Arrange on top of meat sauce. Cover; simmer until eggplant is tender, 15 to 20 minutes. Top with shredded Cheddar; sprinkle with paprika. Serve with Parmesan cheese.

recipes.title: Potato Casserole
directions: Reserve 1/2 cup cheese.
Saute onion in small amount oil or margarine.
Combine soup, milk, pimientos, 1 1/2 cups cheese and onion in large pan.
Stir in hash browns.
Pour in oiled 9 x 13-inch baking dish.
Cover with foil.
Bake 45 minutes at 400°. Remove foil, sprinkle reserved cheese on top.
Cook 10 minutes more.
recipes.text: Potato Casserole. Reserve 1/2 cup cheese. Saute onion in small amount oil or margarine. Combine soup, milk, pimientos, 1 1/2 cups cheese and onion in large pan. Stir in hash browns. Pour in oiled 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Cover with foil. Bake 45 minutes at 400°. Remove foil, sprinkle reserved cheese on top. Cook 10 minutes more.

recipes.title: Spicy Corn Relish
directions: Cook corn in boiling
water
for 3 minutes.
Remove and cool. Cut kernels from cobs.
Put peppers, cabbage and onions through food chopper,
using
coarse
blade.
In
large
heavy kettle blend salt,
sugar,
flour, turmeric and mustard.
Stir in vinegar, slowly.
Bring mixture to boil and add vegetables. Reduce heat and simmer
25 minutes, stirring often.
Pour into hot sterilized jars and
seal
at
once.
Process
in
boiling water bath for 20 minutes.
Store in cool, dark place.
Yields about 12 pints.
recipes.text: Spicy Corn Relish. Cook corn in boiling water for 3 minutes. Remove and cool. Cut kernels from cobs. Put peppers, cabbage and onions through food chopper, using coarse blade. In large heavy kettle blend salt, sugar, flour, turmeric and mustard. Stir in vinegar, slowly. Bring mixture to boil and add vegetables. Reduce heat and simmer 25 minutes, stirring often. Pour into hot sterilized jars and seal at once. Process in boiling water bath for 20 minutes. Store in cool, dark place. Yields about 12 pints.

recipes.title: Bread And Butter Pickles
directions: Let spiced vinegar come to a boil; add cucumbers and onions and bring to boiling point.
Simmer 10 minutes.
Seal in sterilized jars.
recipes.text: Bread And Butter Pickles. Let spiced vinegar come to a boil; add cucumbers and onions and bring to boiling point. Simmer 10 minutes. Seal in sterilized jars.

recipes.title: Chicken Gumbo Soup
directions: Cut chicken meat and ham into small pieces.
Add vegetables, bay leaf and broth.
Simmer for 15 minutes.
Taste and add seasonings.
Remove bay leaf.
Pour hot mixture into hot sterilized pint jars.
Seal.
Process in pressure canner 65 minutes at 10 pounds of pressure.
Process quarts 75 minutes at 10 pounds pressure.
Makes 12 pints.
I like to add rice to mine!
recipes.text: Chicken Gumbo Soup. Cut chicken meat and ham into small pieces. Add vegetables, bay leaf and broth. Simmer for 15 minutes. Taste and add seasonings. Remove bay leaf. Pour hot mixture into hot sterilized pint jars. Seal. Process in pressure canner 65 minutes at 10 pounds of pressure. Process quarts 75 minutes at 10 pounds pressure. Makes 12 pints. I like to add rice to mine!

recipes.title: Chicken Rice Casserole
directions: Place chicken breasts in well-greased baking dish.
Mix rice and soups together and pour over chicken.
Do not cover.
Bake 1 hour at 350°.
recipes.text: Chicken Rice Casserole. Place chicken breasts in well-greased baking dish. Mix rice and soups together and pour over chicken. Do not cover. Bake 1 hour at 350°.

recipes.title: Pound Cake
directions: Cream together shortening, oleo and sugar.
Then add eggs, 1 at a time.
Add flour and baking powder alternately with milk.
Then add rum flavoring and coconut flavoring.
Blend well.
Bake in an angel food cake pan at 325° for 1 hour, then check.
Do not check before 1 hour.
recipes.text: Pound Cake. Cream together shortening, oleo and sugar. Then add eggs, 1 at a time. Add flour and baking powder alternately with milk. Then add rum flavoring and coconut flavoring. Blend well. Bake in an angel food cake pan at 325° for 1 hour, then check. Do not check before 1 hour.

recipes.title: Meat Loaf
directions: Combine all ingredients and toss lightly with a spoon.
Place in a 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan and level.
Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 1 hour, or until done.
Serves 8.
recipes.text: Meat Loaf. Combine all ingredients and toss lightly with a spoon. Place in a 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan and level. Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 1 hour, or until done. Serves 8.

recipes.title: "Heavenly" Banana Nut Bars
directions: Cream sugar and shortening together.
Add 2 egg yolks and mix well.
Now add banana pulp.
recipes.text: "Heavenly" Banana Nut Bars. Cream sugar and shortening together. Add 2 egg yolks and mix well. Now add banana pulp.

recipes.title: Corn Bread Taco Bake
ingredients: 1 (2.8 oz.) can Durkee French fried onions
directions: Brown meat; drain.
Stir in taco seasoning, water, corn, green pepper and tomato sauce.
Pour into 2-quart casserole.
Prepare muffin mix separately plus add 1/2 can fried onions.
Spoon muffin mixture around outer edge of casserole.
Bake, uncovered, at 400° for 20 minutes.
Top corn bread with cheese and remaining onions. Bake 2 to 3 minutes longer.
recipes.text: Corn Bread Taco Bake. Brown meat; drain. Stir in taco seasoning, water, corn, green pepper and tomato sauce. Pour into 2-quart casserole. Prepare muffin mix separately plus add 1/2 can fried onions. Spoon muffin mixture around outer edge of casserole. Bake, uncovered, at 400° for 20 minutes. Top corn bread with cheese and remaining onions. Bake 2 to 3 minutes longer.

recipes.title: Brownies
directions: Sift sugar and flour together in a bowl and set aside.
In a saucepan, mix margarine, shortening, cocoa and water.
Bring to a rapid boil and pour over sugar and flour mixture.
Add milk, eggs, baking soda and salt.
Pour into a well-greased brownie pan.
Bake for 20 minutes at 400°.
recipes.text: Brownies. Sift sugar and flour together in a bowl and set aside. In a saucepan, mix margarine, shortening, cocoa and water. Bring to a rapid boil and pour over sugar and flour mixture. Add milk, eggs, baking soda and salt. Pour into a well-greased brownie pan. Bake for 20 minutes at 400°.

recipes.title: Chicken Tater Tot Hot Dish
directions: Place chicken in buttered 9 x 13-inch Pyrex dish.
Stir together soups and milk.
Pour over chicken.
Spread frozen peas over top of soup.
Lay slices of cheese to cover the peas.
Top with a layer of Tater Tots.
Bake at 325° for 1 hour until bubbly and Tots are golden brown.
recipes.text: Chicken Tater Tot Hot Dish. Place chicken in buttered 9 x 13-inch Pyrex dish. Stir together soups and milk. Pour over chicken. Spread frozen peas over top of soup. Lay slices of cheese to cover the peas. Top with a layer of Tater Tots. Bake at 325° for 1 hour until bubbly and Tots are golden brown.

recipes.title: Jello Cookies
directions: Cream the butter and sugar with mixer, beating until light and fluffy.
Add sifted dry ingredients alternately with milk.
Fold in egg whites.
Pour into 3 greased round 8 or 9-inch layer pans. Bake in moderate oven (350°) for 25 to 30 minutes, or until top springs back when lightly touched.
Cool.
recipes.text: Jello Cookies. Cream the butter and sugar with mixer, beating until light and fluffy. Add sifted dry ingredients alternately with milk. Fold in egg whites. Pour into 3 greased round 8 or 9-inch layer pans. Bake in moderate oven (350°) for 25 to 30 minutes, or until top springs back when lightly touched. Cool.

recipes.title: Coconut Pound Cake
directions: Cream the butter, shortening and sugar until fluffy.
Add eggs, 1 at a time, beating well after each addition.
Sift flour and baking powder together.
Add flour mixture
and milk alternately to egg mixture.
Beat well.
Stir in flavoring and coconut.
Place in tube pan.
Bake at 300° for 1 hour and 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Coconut Pound Cake. Cream the butter, shortening and sugar until fluffy. Add eggs, 1 at a time, beating well after each addition. Sift flour and baking powder together. Add flour mixture and milk alternately to egg mixture. Beat well. Stir in flavoring and coconut. Place in tube pan. Bake at 300° for 1 hour and 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Pineapple Bread
directions: Cube the bread.
Cream together the butter and sugar.
Add eggs.
Add the pineapple.
Mix together all ingredients with the bread cubes.
Pour into greased loaf pan.
Bake 60 minutes at 350°.
recipes.text: Pineapple Bread. Cube the bread. Cream together the butter and sugar. Add eggs. Add the pineapple. Mix together all ingredients with the bread cubes. Pour into greased loaf pan. Bake 60 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Breakfast Change
directions: Fill soup bowl 3/4 full with water.
Place 2 ounces thin filet of salmon in the water; let it sink to the bottom.
Break an egg into the water to rest over the salmon.
Cover with Saran Wrap and place in microwave on High.
Cook 1 1/2 minutes or until egg white coagulates.
Remove with slotted spoon by inserting it under the salmon.
Remove from water with egg on top of salmon.
Place on rye toast.
Add dash of paprika.
recipes.text: Breakfast Change. Fill soup bowl 3/4 full with water. Place 2 ounces thin filet of salmon in the water; let it sink to the bottom. Break an egg into the water to rest over the salmon. Cover with Saran Wrap and place in microwave on High. Cook 1 1/2 minutes or until egg white coagulates. Remove with slotted spoon by inserting it under the salmon. Remove from water with egg on top of salmon. Place on rye toast. Add dash of paprika.

recipes.title: Santa Fe Soup
ingredients: 2 pkg. taco mix (use only one for less spicy)
directions: DO NOT DRAIN JUICES.
Brown hamburger meat with either chopped onion or dry beefy onion soup mix.
Drain.
Add remaining ingredients.
Add juice in cans.
Get soup good and hot to boiling, then you can simmer for about 30 minutes to an hour. Stir occasionally.
Can top with sour cream and/or shredded cheese.
Serve with Hot Cornbread.
recipes.text: Santa Fe Soup. DO NOT DRAIN JUICES. Brown hamburger meat with either chopped onion or dry beefy onion soup mix. Drain. Add remaining ingredients. Add juice in cans. Get soup good and hot to boiling, then you can simmer for about 30 minutes to an hour. Stir occasionally. Can top with sour cream and/or shredded cheese. Serve with Hot Cornbread.

recipes.title: Squash Casserole 1
directions: Mix all ingredients.
If bacon drippings are cold, melt them first.
Pour into ungreased dish.
Bake at 350 for 45 to 60 minutes.
recipes.text: Squash Casserole 1. Mix all ingredients. If bacon drippings are cold, melt them first. Pour into ungreased dish. Bake at 350 for 45 to 60 minutes.

recipes.title: Hush Puppies
directions: Mix together all but milk; then add enough milk to make a thick dough.
Drop by teaspoonfuls into hot oil until browned well.
Drain on paper towel.
Serve warm.
recipes.text: Hush Puppies. Mix together all but milk; then add enough milk to make a thick dough. Drop by teaspoonfuls into hot oil until browned well. Drain on paper towel. Serve warm.

recipes.title: Chocolate Fantasy Pie
ingredients: 1 c. flour or regular pie crust
directions: Mix pecans, butter and flour.
Cover bottom of 13 x 9-inch pan.
Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.
(Regular pie crust can be substituted, if desired.)
recipes.text: Chocolate Fantasy Pie. Mix pecans, butter and flour. Cover bottom of 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake at 350° for 20 minutes. (Regular pie crust can be substituted, if desired.)

recipes.title: Pumpkin Bread
directions: Mix dry ingredients together and set aside.
In a large bowl mix sugar, eggs, oil, vanilla, water and pumpkin until combined. Add flour mixture, 1/3 at a time.
Mix well.
Pour into ungreased loaf pans. Bake for 1 1/2 hours at 375°.
Let set for 10 minutes. Loosen with knife around sides and turn out of pan.
Lay on side of wire rack for 15 minutes or until warm.
Put in bread sacks, not foil, wax paper or Saran Wrap.
Store in freezer until needed.
recipes.text: Pumpkin Bread. Mix dry ingredients together and set aside. In a large bowl mix sugar, eggs, oil, vanilla, water and pumpkin until combined. Add flour mixture, 1/3 at a time. Mix well. Pour into ungreased loaf pans. Bake for 1 1/2 hours at 375°. Let set for 10 minutes. Loosen with knife around sides and turn out of pan. Lay on side of wire rack for 15 minutes or until warm. Put in bread sacks, not foil, wax paper or Saran Wrap. Store in freezer until needed.

recipes.title: Chili Con Carne
ingredients: 2 (15 oz.) cans kidney beans, drained and thoroughly rinsed

1 large (28 oz.) can and 1 small (14 1/2 oz.) can tomatoes, drained and chopped or (preferably) 1 (16 oz.) can tomatoes and 2 medium tomatoes (take out core and place fresh tomatoes into bowl of hot water, letting them sit until they fresh ones, just chop)
chopped onions, tomatoes, lettuce or green peppers for garnish
directions: In a large pot, saute onion and garlic in olive oil until soft.
Mix in chili powder, basil, oregano and cumin.
Stir in zucchini and carrots until well blended.
Cook for about 1 minute over low heat, stirring occasionally.
Stir in chopped tomatoes, undrained kidney beans and drained kidney beans.
Bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer for 30 to 45 minutes or until thick.
Top with onions, tomatoes and lettuce or green peppers.
Contains per serving: 142 calories and 30 fat calories.
recipes.text: Chili Con Carne. In a large pot, saute onion and garlic in olive oil until soft. Mix in chili powder, basil, oregano and cumin. Stir in zucchini and carrots until well blended. Cook for about 1 minute over low heat, stirring occasionally. Stir in chopped tomatoes, undrained kidney beans and drained kidney beans. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer for 30 to 45 minutes or until thick. Top with onions, tomatoes and lettuce or green peppers. Contains per serving: 142 calories and 30 fat calories.

recipes.title: Rhubarb Cake
directions: Blend the first 3 ingredients.
Add the sour milk or buttermilk, flour, soda, salt, vanilla and rhubarb.
Top with the sugar and cinnamon combined before baking. Bake at 350° for 35 minutes in
a greased 9 x 3-inch pan. Bake longer if using frozen rhubarb.
recipes.text: Rhubarb Cake. Blend the first 3 ingredients. Add the sour milk or buttermilk, flour, soda, salt, vanilla and rhubarb. Top with the sugar and cinnamon combined before baking. Bake at 350° for 35 minutes in a greased 9 x 3-inch pan. Bake longer if using frozen rhubarb.

recipes.title: Holly Red Punch
ingredients: 1 qt. ice water, mixed with 1 qt. ginger ale
directions: Combine spices, sugar and 2 1/2 cups water in saucepan. Simmer 10 minutes.
Strain and cool.
Combine with lemonade, orange juice and cranberry juice.
Just before serving, add ginger ale mixture.
Pour over ice in punch bowl before serving.
Makes 3 1/2 quarts.
recipes.text: Holly Red Punch. Combine spices, sugar and 2 1/2 cups water in saucepan. Simmer 10 minutes. Strain and cool. Combine with lemonade, orange juice and cranberry juice. Just before serving, add ginger ale mixture. Pour over ice in punch bowl before serving. Makes 3 1/2 quarts.

recipes.title: Mom Northeim'S Rice Pudding
directions: Mix all together and cook a little on top of the stove to speed baking.
Bake at 325° for about one hour.
recipes.text: Mom Northeim'S Rice Pudding. Mix all together and cook a little on top of the stove to speed baking. Bake at 325° for about one hour.

recipes.title: Tomato Dill Pasta
ingredients: 2 Tbsp. each olive oil and minced parsley
1/4 tsp. paprika or ground red pepper (pinch)
directions: Drain off some of the juice from the tomatoes.
Mix all ingredients except the noodles in a large bowl.
Marinate at room temperature at least 30 minutes.
Cook spaghetti and drain.
Add hot pasta to sauce and toss.
Serve immediately.
recipes.text: Tomato Dill Pasta. Drain off some of the juice from the tomatoes. Mix all ingredients except the noodles in a large bowl. Marinate at room temperature at least 30 minutes. Cook spaghetti and drain. Add hot pasta to sauce and toss. Serve immediately.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Bread
directions: Sift flour, baking powder, soda, salt, cinnamon and nutmeg. Cream shortening sugar and vanilla.
Then add one egg at a time, beating thoroughly.
Stir in pumpkin.
Stir in dry ingredients alternating with water until smooth.
Add chopped nuts and pour into prepared pans.
Bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes or until done.
recipes.text: Pumpkin Bread. Sift flour, baking powder, soda, salt, cinnamon and nutmeg. Cream shortening sugar and vanilla. Then add one egg at a time, beating thoroughly. Stir in pumpkin. Stir in dry ingredients alternating with water until smooth. Add chopped nuts and pour into prepared pans. Bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes or until done.

recipes.title: Chimichangas
ingredients: salt, pepper and oregano to taste
directions: Cook ground beef; season with salt, pepper and oregano.
Place large spoonful of ground beef in flour tortillas.
Sprinkle with grated Jack cheese and roll.
Place rolled tortillas in baking pan; butter tops.
Bake at 350° until butter melts and they are very light brown.
Remove from oven and coat tops with tomato sauce and grated Longhorn cheese.
Place back into oven and bake until cheese melts.
Serve with chilies and taco sauce or salsa.
recipes.text: Chimichangas. Cook ground beef; season with salt, pepper and oregano. Place large spoonful of ground beef in flour tortillas. Sprinkle with grated Jack cheese and roll. Place rolled tortillas in baking pan; butter tops. Bake at 350° until butter melts and they are very light brown. Remove from oven and coat tops with tomato sauce and grated Longhorn cheese. Place back into oven and bake until cheese melts. Serve with chilies and taco sauce or salsa.

recipes.title: Five Minute Soup
directions: In a soup pot, heat the chicken broth.
Add the vegetables and leftover meat.
Bring to boil and simmer for 5 minutes.
Season with black pepper.
Makes 6 servings.
recipes.text: Five Minute Soup. In a soup pot, heat the chicken broth. Add the vegetables and leftover meat. Bring to boil and simmer for 5 minutes. Season with black pepper. Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Green Tomato Relish
directions: Put the green tomatoes, peppers, cabbage and onions through the food chopper.
Add the salt.
Let stand overnight; drain.
Mix with the syrup, vinegar, mustard seed and turmeric.
Boil 20 minutes.
Pour into jars and seal.
recipes.text: Green Tomato Relish. Put the green tomatoes, peppers, cabbage and onions through the food chopper. Add the salt. Let stand overnight; drain. Mix with the syrup, vinegar, mustard seed and turmeric. Boil 20 minutes. Pour into jars and seal.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Cookies
directions: Mix all ingredients together.
Spoon on ungreased cookie sheet.
Bake at 325° until golden brown.
Cool and eat!
recipes.text: Peanut Butter Cookies. Mix all ingredients together. Spoon on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 325° until golden brown. Cool and eat!

recipes.title: White Bread
directions: Dissolve yeast into 3/4 cup warm water.
Stir in 2 2/3 cups warm water, sugar, salt, shortening and 5 cups of the flour.
Beat until smooth.
Mix in enough remaining flour to make dough easy to handle.
Turn dough onto lightly floured board, knead until smooth and elastic.
Cover.
Let rise in warm place until double, about 1 hour.
(Dough is ready if impression remains.)
recipes.text: White Bread. Dissolve yeast into 3/4 cup warm water. Stir in 2 2/3 cups warm water, sugar, salt, shortening and 5 cups of the flour. Beat until smooth. Mix in enough remaining flour to make dough easy to handle. Turn dough onto lightly floured board, knead until smooth and elastic. Cover. Let rise in warm place until double, about 1 hour. (Dough is ready if impression remains.)

recipes.title: Fresh Berry Freezer Jam
ingredients: 2 c. crushed fresh strawberries or raspberries
directions: In large bowl, combine berries and sugar; mix well.
Let stand 10 minutes.
In small bowl, combine pectin and lemon juice.
Pour over berries.
Stir thoroughly 3 minutes (a few sugar crystals will remain).
recipes.text: Fresh Berry Freezer Jam. In large bowl, combine berries and sugar; mix well. Let stand 10 minutes. In small bowl, combine pectin and lemon juice. Pour over berries. Stir thoroughly 3 minutes (a few sugar crystals will remain).

recipes.title: Meat Loaf
directions: Mix thoroughly all ingredients together in a large pan.
Form into a loaf.
If desired, place 2 strips bacon on top and pour over all an 8 ounce can of tomato sauce.
Bake 1 hour at 350°.
recipes.text: Meat Loaf. Mix thoroughly all ingredients together in a large pan. Form into a loaf. If desired, place 2 strips bacon on top and pour over all an 8 ounce can of tomato sauce. Bake 1 hour at 350°.

recipes.title: Spaghetti Sauce
directions: Cook on low heat for 1 hour.
Simmer until right consistency. Add meat balls, hot or sweet sausage 1 hour after cooking, just before the simmering stage starts.
recipes.text: Spaghetti Sauce. Cook on low heat for 1 hour. Simmer until right consistency. Add meat balls, hot or sweet sausage 1 hour after cooking, just before the simmering stage starts.

recipes.title: Onion Topped Green Beans
directions: Place ingredients in 2-quart glass dish (12 x 7-inch).
Drain the beans.
Cover and microwave on High 5 minutes.
Let stand 3 minutes.
recipes.text: Onion Topped Green Beans. Place ingredients in 2-quart glass dish (12 x 7-inch). Drain the beans. Cover and microwave on High 5 minutes. Let stand 3 minutes.

recipes.title: Chicken Spaghetti Casserole
ingredients: 2 cans chunk chicken, drained (or 1 c. leftover chicken, chopped)
directions: Cook spaghetti according to package directions; drain.
Stir in all ingredients except potato chips.
Put in casserole dish. If cheesier flavor is desired, layer mixture with sliced American cheese in the middle and more on top.
Bake at 350° for 20 to 30 minutes.
Add crushed potato chips on top and bake for an additional 10 minutes.
recipes.text: Chicken Spaghetti Casserole. Cook spaghetti according to package directions; drain. Stir in all ingredients except potato chips. Put in casserole dish. If cheesier flavor is desired, layer mixture with sliced American cheese in the middle and more on top. Bake at 350° for 20 to 30 minutes. Add crushed potato chips on top and bake for an additional 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Black Beans Ham Hocks(Servings:  4)
directions: Let beans soak overnight.
Chop pepper (bell), onion and garlic; fry lightly with ham hocks, bay leaf and butter until it looks yummy.
Drain bacon and wash.
Combine pan mixture with beans in same juice.
Add hot sauce to taste.
Cook on low 4 to 5 hours or until mushy.
Serve over rice with green onions.
recipes.text: Black Beans Ham Hocks(Servings:  4). Let beans soak overnight. Chop pepper (bell), onion and garlic; fry lightly with ham hocks, bay leaf and butter until it looks yummy. Drain bacon and wash. Combine pan mixture with beans in same juice. Add hot sauce to taste. Cook on low 4 to 5 hours or until mushy. Serve over rice with green onions.

recipes.title: Chicken Milanaise
directions: In a bowl, combine the cheese and bread crumbs.
Whisk the egg with 1 tablespoon water.
Sprinkle chicken with salt and pepper to taste.
Dust breasts with flour, shaking off the excess.
Dip chicken in egg and then coat with cheese and bread crumb mixture.
recipes.text: Chicken Milanaise. In a bowl, combine the cheese and bread crumbs. Whisk the egg with 1 tablespoon water. Sprinkle chicken with salt and pepper to taste. Dust breasts with flour, shaking off the excess. Dip chicken in egg and then coat with cheese and bread crumb mixture.

recipes.title: Cinnamon Pound Cake
directions: Grease a 10-inch tube pan.
Set aside.
Preheat oven to 325°. In a large mixing bowl, cream butter and sugar until smooth.
Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each.
Combine flour, baking powder, 1/2 teaspoon soda, cocoa and cinnamon; add alternately with sour cream, beating after each addition.
Stir in vanilla.
Pour into prepared pan.
Bake for 75 minutes, or until done.
Cool in pan 10 minutes.
Take off wire rack; cool completely.
recipes.text: Cinnamon Pound Cake. Grease a 10-inch tube pan. Set aside. Preheat oven to 325°. In a large mixing bowl, cream butter and sugar until smooth. Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each. Combine flour, baking powder, 1/2 teaspoon soda, cocoa and cinnamon; add alternately with sour cream, beating after each addition. Stir in vanilla. Pour into prepared pan. Bake for 75 minutes, or until done. Cool in pan 10 minutes. Take off wire rack; cool completely.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Cake Bars
directions: Mix eggs, pumpkin, sugar and spice together in mixing bowl. Pour into 9 x 13-inch pan. Sprinkle cake mix on top of mixture. Add chopped pecans. Layer cubes of butter on top. Cover with foil. Bake at 325° for 1 hour and 20 minutes.
recipes.text: Pumpkin Cake Bars. Mix eggs, pumpkin, sugar and spice together in mixing bowl. Pour into 9 x 13-inch pan. Sprinkle cake mix on top of mixture. Add chopped pecans. Layer cubes of butter on top. Cover with foil. Bake at 325° for 1 hour and 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Cinnamon Raisin Biscuit
directions: Mix dry ingredients.
Add raisins and half and half.
Follow usual biscuit procedure.
Ice with powdered sugar glaze.
recipes.text: Cinnamon Raisin Biscuit. Mix dry ingredients. Add raisins and half and half. Follow usual biscuit procedure. Ice with powdered sugar glaze.

recipes.title: Treebeard'S Butter Cake
ingredients: 1 Pillsbury yellow cake mix (with pudding included)
directions: Preheat oven to 350°.
Mix 1 slightly beaten egg with dry cake mix and butter to moisten dough.
Grease a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Press mixture evenly in pan.
Beat the cream cheese with 3 eggs and vanilla until creamy.
Beat in most of the powdered sugar gradually, until smooth.
Pour over crust.
Bake for 35 to 40 minutes at 325° if glass pan, and at 350° if metal.
(It may take longer, 45 to 50 minutes.)
Sprinkle remaining powdered sugar and/or pecans over top.
(It is also good if you sprinkle pecans over crust before pouring liquid mixture over crust.)
recipes.text: Treebeard'S Butter Cake. Preheat oven to 350°. Mix 1 slightly beaten egg with dry cake mix and butter to moisten dough. Grease a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Press mixture evenly in pan. Beat the cream cheese with 3 eggs and vanilla until creamy. Beat in most of the powdered sugar gradually, until smooth. Pour over crust. Bake for 35 to 40 minutes at 325° if glass pan, and at 350° if metal. (It may take longer, 45 to 50 minutes.) Sprinkle remaining powdered sugar and/or pecans over top. (It is also good if you sprinkle pecans over crust before pouring liquid mixture over crust.)

recipes.title: Seafood Stir-Fry
directions: Heat oil in skillet.
Add Crab Delight and vegetables.
Stir over medium-high heat for 2 minutes.
Add seasoning.
Cook 1 minute.
Garnish with chow mein noodles.
recipes.text: Seafood Stir-Fry. Heat oil in skillet. Add Crab Delight and vegetables. Stir over medium-high heat for 2 minutes. Add seasoning. Cook 1 minute. Garnish with chow mein noodles.

recipes.title: Strawberry Shortcake Cake
ingredients: 2 c. frozen sliced strawberries in syrup
directions: Grease bottom only of a 13 x 9-inch pan.
Sprinkle marshmallows in pan.
Combine thawed strawberries and syrup with dry gelatin. Set aside.
recipes.text: Strawberry Shortcake Cake. Grease bottom only of a 13 x 9-inch pan. Sprinkle marshmallows in pan. Combine thawed strawberries and syrup with dry gelatin. Set aside.

recipes.title: Wassail
directions: Cook on high for 2 hours in crock-pot.
Remove spices and leave drink in crock-pot.
Serve hot.
Can be refrigerated and reheated.
recipes.text: Wassail. Cook on high for 2 hours in crock-pot. Remove spices and leave drink in crock-pot. Serve hot. Can be refrigerated and reheated.

recipes.title: Hungarian Kifli Cookies(Hungarian Cookies Made By Hand)
ingredients: 1 1/2 c. apricot, prune or other preserves
directions: In large bowl, blend butter and flour with hands until thoroughly mixed. Add sour cream and mix well. If dough is too sticky, add a little more flour. Using hands, roll dough into balls, using 1 tablespoon of batter for each. Refrigerate overnight.
recipes.text: Hungarian Kifli Cookies(Hungarian Cookies Made By Hand). In large bowl, blend butter and flour with hands until thoroughly mixed. Add sour cream and mix well. If dough is too sticky, add a little more flour. Using hands, roll dough into balls, using 1 tablespoon of batter for each. Refrigerate overnight.

recipes.title: Nuts And Bolts Party Mix
directions: Heat oven to 250°.
Melt butter in large roasting pan.
Stir in Worcestershire sauce, garlic salt and celery salt.
Mix well. Add the rest of the ingredients.
Bake 30 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Let cool on paper toweling.
recipes.text: Nuts And Bolts Party Mix. Heat oven to 250°. Melt butter in large roasting pan. Stir in Worcestershire sauce, garlic salt and celery salt. Mix well. Add the rest of the ingredients. Bake 30 minutes, stirring occasionally. Let cool on paper toweling.

recipes.title: Chicken Noodle Soup
directions: Rinse chicken pieces well and remove skin.
Place in a large pot (4 to 6-quart) and cover with cold water.

Place whole allspice and peppercorns in a tea strainer (or cheesecloth) and add to chicken; simmer until chicken is thoroughly cooked (1 to 2 hours). Remove spices and chicken from broth and debone and cut up chicken in bite-size pieces.
Add carrots, celery, chicken and onion powder to broth and simmer 30 minutes.
Add water as needed.
Add noodles and simmer 30 minutes or more.
Just before serving, stir in chopped parsley.
recipes.text: Chicken Noodle Soup. Rinse chicken pieces well and remove skin. Place in a large pot (4 to 6-quart) and cover with cold water. Place whole allspice and peppercorns in a tea strainer (or cheesecloth) and add to chicken; simmer until chicken is thoroughly cooked (1 to 2 hours). Remove spices and chicken from broth and debone and cut up chicken in bite-size pieces. Add carrots, celery, chicken and onion powder to broth and simmer 30 minutes. Add water as needed. Add noodles and simmer 30 minutes or more. Just before serving, stir in chopped parsley.

recipes.title: Hashburgers
directions: Garnish liberally with love and keep cool until it sparkles. If you have followed God's cookbook in preparing your marriage, your home is ready now!
recipes.text: Hashburgers. Garnish liberally with love and keep cool until it sparkles. If you have followed God's cookbook in preparing your marriage, your home is ready now!

recipes.title: Fish Etouffee
ingredients: 1 pkg. Cajun King etouffee seasoning mix
directions: Rehydrate etouffee mix in 1 cup water.
Slowly add rehydrated mixture to 1/2 cup melted butter, stirring until well blended. Add crabmeat and simmer 10 minutes.
recipes.text: Fish Etouffee. Rehydrate etouffee mix in 1 cup water. Slowly add rehydrated mixture to 1/2 cup melted butter, stirring until well blended. Add crabmeat and simmer 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Low-Fat Cream Of Mushroom Soup
ingredients: 3 Tbsp. whole wheat or white flour
directions: Over medium-low heat, combine milk, flour, salt and pepper. Stir continuously until well blended and thick.
Add drained can of mushrooms and stir well.
(Mushrooms can be finely chopped in food processor first or leave whole or chopped.)
recipes.text: Low-Fat Cream Of Mushroom Soup. Over medium-low heat, combine milk, flour, salt and pepper. Stir continuously until well blended and thick. Add drained can of mushrooms and stir well. (Mushrooms can be finely chopped in food processor first or leave whole or chopped.)

recipes.title: Banana Nut Bread
ingredients: 1 c. pecans or any kind nuts
directions: If using all-purpose flour, use 3 1/2 teaspoons baking powder and 1 teaspoon salt.
recipes.text: Banana Nut Bread. If using all-purpose flour, use 3 1/2 teaspoons baking powder and 1 teaspoon salt.

recipes.title: Lemon-Lime Salad
ingredients: 1 (8 oz.) pkg. cream cheese, room temperature
directions: Mix Jell-O's together according to package directions.
Let gel until slightly thickened.
Add cream cheese and milk.
Beat on slow speed with mixer until well mixed.
Blend in pineapple and nuts. Refrigerate until congealed.
recipes.text: Lemon-Lime Salad. Mix Jell-O's together according to package directions. Let gel until slightly thickened. Add cream cheese and milk. Beat on slow speed with mixer until well mixed. Blend in pineapple and nuts. Refrigerate until congealed.

recipes.title: Dried Apple Cake
directions: Bake at 350°.
Use favorite filling or icing.
recipes.text: Dried Apple Cake. Bake at 350°. Use favorite filling or icing.

recipes.title: Key Lime Cake
directions: Mix cake mix and gelatin.
Add orange juice.
Mix thoroughly. Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each addition.
Add oil.
Stir in thoroughly.
Grease and flour three 9-inch layer pans or a 9 x 11-inch pan.
Bake at 350° for 20 to 30 minutes or until done.
Mix margarine, cream cheese and powdered sugar thoroughly.
Add chopped pecans, if desired.
recipes.text: Key Lime Cake. Mix cake mix and gelatin. Add orange juice. Mix thoroughly. Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each addition. Add oil. Stir in thoroughly. Grease and flour three 9-inch layer pans or a 9 x 11-inch pan. Bake at 350° for 20 to 30 minutes or until done. Mix margarine, cream cheese and powdered sugar thoroughly. Add chopped pecans, if desired.

recipes.title: Health Bread Dough
ingredients: 4 lb. white or whole wheat flour
directions: Dissolve yeast in 1/2 cup warm water.
Sift flour into large bowl.
Add salt, water and yeast.
Stir until flour is thoroughly mixed.
If dough seems too thick, add more water.
Turn out dough on floured board and knead, adding more flour, if necessary.
When dough becomes rubbery and doesn't stick to hands and board too easily, put back into bowl and brush with oil.
Let rise until double in size.
Work down and let rise again.
It is now ready to make into rolls, bread or cinnamon rolls.
Makes about 4 large loaves.
recipes.text: Health Bread Dough. Dissolve yeast in 1/2 cup warm water. Sift flour into large bowl. Add salt, water and yeast. Stir until flour is thoroughly mixed. If dough seems too thick, add more water. Turn out dough on floured board and knead, adding more flour, if necessary. When dough becomes rubbery and doesn't stick to hands and board too easily, put back into bowl and brush with oil. Let rise until double in size. Work down and let rise again. It is now ready to make into rolls, bread or cinnamon rolls. Makes about 4 large loaves.

recipes.title: Molasses Crumb Cake
directions: Combine first 4 ingredients into crumbs.
Set aside 1 1/2 to 2 cups of crumbs for topping.
Into the rest of the crumbs, add remaining ingredients.
Blend with spatula and pour into greased 9 x 13-inch pan.
Sprinkle crumbs on top.
Bake in a 350° oven for approximately 45 to 55 minutes.
recipes.text: Molasses Crumb Cake. Combine first 4 ingredients into crumbs. Set aside 1 1/2 to 2 cups of crumbs for topping. Into the rest of the crumbs, add remaining ingredients. Blend with spatula and pour into greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Sprinkle crumbs on top. Bake in a 350° oven for approximately 45 to 55 minutes.

recipes.title: Poppy Seed Cake
directions: Beat eggs until fluffy.
Add rest of ingredients.
Beat 5 to 6 minutes.
Pour into oiled tube pan.
Bake at 350° for 45 to 60 minutes.
recipes.text: Poppy Seed Cake. Beat eggs until fluffy. Add rest of ingredients. Beat 5 to 6 minutes. Pour into oiled tube pan. Bake at 350° for 45 to 60 minutes.

recipes.title: Noodle Salad
ingredients: 1 (1 lb.) box cooked and drained noodles
directions: Cook and drain noodles; coat with oil.
Add parsley and pimentos.
Set aside.
Chop vegetables and set aside.
Mix vinegar, sugar, mustard, garlic salt, salt and pepper.
Pour sauce mix over noodles mixture and mix well.
Add vegetables to mixture and mix well.
Refrigerate for at least 3 hours.
It is better if it is refrigerated overnight.
recipes.text: Noodle Salad. Cook and drain noodles; coat with oil. Add parsley and pimentos. Set aside. Chop vegetables and set aside. Mix vinegar, sugar, mustard, garlic salt, salt and pepper. Pour sauce mix over noodles mixture and mix well. Add vegetables to mixture and mix well. Refrigerate for at least 3 hours. It is better if it is refrigerated overnight.

recipes.title: Ranch Beans
directions: Brown chuck, onion and green pepper.
Drain.
Add drained limas and kidney beans.
Add pork and beans.
Mix all items together.
Bake 45 minutes at 300°.
Serve with salad and garlic bread.
recipes.text: Ranch Beans. Brown chuck, onion and green pepper. Drain. Add drained limas and kidney beans. Add pork and beans. Mix all items together. Bake 45 minutes at 300°. Serve with salad and garlic bread.

recipes.title: Blueberry Spread(Diabetic)
ingredients: artificial sweetener to substitute for 3 Tbsp. sugar
directions: Combine blueberries, 1/2 cup water and lemon juice in heavy saucepan.
Bring to a boil; simmer gently for about 8 minutes, stirring frequently.
recipes.text: Blueberry Spread(Diabetic). Combine blueberries, 1/2 cup water and lemon juice in heavy saucepan. Bring to a boil; simmer gently for about 8 minutes, stirring frequently.

recipes.title: Hamburger Casserole
directions: Brown hamburger and onion.
Add to other ingredients.
Spread cheese on top.
Cover with foil.
Cook 1 hour at 350°.
recipes.text: Hamburger Casserole. Brown hamburger and onion. Add to other ingredients. Spread cheese on top. Cover with foil. Cook 1 hour at 350°.

recipes.title: Crescent Roll-Ups
ingredients: 1/4 lb. sliced Mozzarella or American cheese
directions: Separate crescent rolls.
Add 1 slice of pepperoni and 1 slice of cheese.
Roll from wide end.
Place on cookie sheet sprayed with Pam.
Brush each roll with beaten egg.
Bake as directed on package of crescent roll.
Makes 16 roll-ups.
recipes.text: Crescent Roll-Ups. Separate crescent rolls. Add 1 slice of pepperoni and 1 slice of cheese. Roll from wide end. Place on cookie sheet sprayed with Pam. Brush each roll with beaten egg. Bake as directed on package of crescent roll. Makes 16 roll-ups.

recipes.title: Sinfully Delicious Pecans
directions: Beat egg whites in mixer bowl until very stiff peaks form. Add vanilla and brown sugar; mix well.
Fold in pecan halves. Remove each pecan half to greased baking sheet with fork.
Bake at 200° for 20 minutes.
Cool completely.
Store in airtight container.
Yields 12 (1/4 cup) servings.
recipes.text: Sinfully Delicious Pecans. Beat egg whites in mixer bowl until very stiff peaks form. Add vanilla and brown sugar; mix well. Fold in pecan halves. Remove each pecan half to greased baking sheet with fork. Bake at 200° for 20 minutes. Cool completely. Store in airtight container. Yields 12 (1/4 cup) servings.

recipes.title: Crabbies
directions: Mix all until creamy.
Spread on muffins.
Freeze.
Cut in fourths.
Broil 3 to 4 minutes until bubbly.
recipes.text: Crabbies. Mix all until creamy. Spread on muffins. Freeze. Cut in fourths. Broil 3 to 4 minutes until bubbly.

recipes.title: Marinade For Chicken Wings Or Spareribs
directions: Place wings in glass baking dish.
Combine ingredients and marinate at least 4 hours, turning wings at least once or twice. Remove wings from sauce.
Place on cookie sheet and bake for 1 hour at 350°.
recipes.text: Marinade For Chicken Wings Or Spareribs. Place wings in glass baking dish. Combine ingredients and marinate at least 4 hours, turning wings at least once or twice. Remove wings from sauce. Place on cookie sheet and bake for 1 hour at 350°.

recipes.title: Dried Beef Gravy
directions: In a heavy saucepan, melt the butter and stir in the flour to make a roux.
Whisk in the hot milk, stirring all the time until the mixture thickens.
When the mixture is thick, add the remaining ingredients and heat for a moment.
Yields 4 servings.
recipes.text: Dried Beef Gravy. In a heavy saucepan, melt the butter and stir in the flour to make a roux. Whisk in the hot milk, stirring all the time until the mixture thickens. When the mixture is thick, add the remaining ingredients and heat for a moment. Yields 4 servings.

recipes.title: Quick Chicken-N-Dumplin'S
directions: Cut chicken into chunks.
Boil.
In a large sauce pan, add chicken, soup, milk and water.
Heat to boiling point, stirring occasionally.
Reduce heat to simmer.
Pull apart biscuits into bite size pieces and add to soup mixture.
Heat and stir until dumplings reach desired texture.
recipes.text: Quick Chicken-N-Dumplin'S. Cut chicken into chunks. Boil. In a large sauce pan, add chicken, soup, milk and water. Heat to boiling point, stirring occasionally. Reduce heat to simmer. Pull apart biscuits into bite size pieces and add to soup mixture. Heat and stir until dumplings reach desired texture.

recipes.title: Old Time Tomato Aspic Snacks
ingredients: 2 envelopes unflavored gelatin, softened in 1/4 c. cold water
directions: Combine tomato juice, onion, celery leaves, sugar, salt, bay leaves and cloves; simmer 5 minutes.
Strain; dissolve gelatin in tomato mixture.
Add lemon juice; chill until partially set.
Add celery; pour small amount in egg cartons that have been sprayed with Pam or Cooking Ease.
Refrigerate until firm.
Unmold on Ritz crackers; top with small amount of dressing with a sprig of parsley stuck in dressing.
recipes.text: Old Time Tomato Aspic Snacks. Combine tomato juice, onion, celery leaves, sugar, salt, bay leaves and cloves; simmer 5 minutes. Strain; dissolve gelatin in tomato mixture. Add lemon juice; chill until partially set. Add celery; pour small amount in egg cartons that have been sprayed with Pam or Cooking Ease. Refrigerate until firm. Unmold on Ritz crackers; top with small amount of dressing with a sprig of parsley stuck in dressing.

recipes.title: Easy-Cheesy Appetizer
directions: Put Ritz crackers on a cookie sheet (as many as you want to serve).
Put a marshmallow on top of each Ritz cracker.
Top all with a slice of your favorite sharp cheese (about an inch by an inch piece).
Broil in oven, watching, until cheese starts to melt.
Don't burn the roof of your mouth.
Serve while warm.
recipes.text: Easy-Cheesy Appetizer. Put Ritz crackers on a cookie sheet (as many as you want to serve). Put a marshmallow on top of each Ritz cracker. Top all with a slice of your favorite sharp cheese (about an inch by an inch piece). Broil in oven, watching, until cheese starts to melt. Don't burn the roof of your mouth. Serve while warm.

recipes.title: Evergreen Punch
directions: Mix Kool-Aid, water and sugar.
Add pineapple juice.
Add ginger ale when serving.
Yields 4 quarts.
recipes.text: Evergreen Punch. Mix Kool-Aid, water and sugar. Add pineapple juice. Add ginger ale when serving. Yields 4 quarts.

recipes.title: Payday Bars
directions: Mix cake mix with 1 stick melted margarine and beaten egg. Press in the bottom of a buttered 9 x 13-inch cake pan and bake at 350° for 15 minutes.
Top with marshmallows and put back in oven until marshmallows are melted.
Melt 1/2 stick margarine and mix with syrup.
Add peanut butter chips and heat until melted.
(I use my microwave for this.)
Stir in nuts and cereal.
Spread on top of marshmallows. Cool. Cut into squares.
recipes.text: Payday Bars. Mix cake mix with 1 stick melted margarine and beaten egg. Press in the bottom of a buttered 9 x 13-inch cake pan and bake at 350° for 15 minutes. Top with marshmallows and put back in oven until marshmallows are melted. Melt 1/2 stick margarine and mix with syrup. Add peanut butter chips and heat until melted. (I use my microwave for this.) Stir in nuts and cereal. Spread on top of marshmallows. Cool. Cut into squares.

recipes.title: Asparagus Casserole
directions: Drain liquid from the asparagus and the mushrooms and place in a boiler.
Add enough butter, milk and flour to this liquid to make a white sauce.
Add garlic that has been put through a garlic press to the white sauce.
Place the asparagus in a casserole. Add mushrooms, eggs, cracker crumbs and grated cheese.
Pour sauce on it and stir.
Cover the top with cracker crumbs and bake in a 350° oven for about 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Asparagus Casserole. Drain liquid from the asparagus and the mushrooms and place in a boiler. Add enough butter, milk and flour to this liquid to make a white sauce. Add garlic that has been put through a garlic press to the white sauce. Place the asparagus in a casserole. Add mushrooms, eggs, cracker crumbs and grated cheese. Pour sauce on it and stir. Cover the top with cracker crumbs and bake in a 350° oven for about 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Green Tomato Pickles
directions: Soak tomatoes in lime water 24 hours; drain and wash carefully through 3 or 4 waters.
Soak in ice water 4 hours. Drain well.
Combine vinegar, spices and sugar.
Heat and pour over tomatoes and let set for 3 or 4 hours.
Add tomatoes and simmer for 35 minutes.
Put in clean, hot jars and seal.
recipes.text: Green Tomato Pickles. Soak tomatoes in lime water 24 hours; drain and wash carefully through 3 or 4 waters. Soak in ice water 4 hours. Drain well. Combine vinegar, spices and sugar. Heat and pour over tomatoes and let set for 3 or 4 hours. Add tomatoes and simmer for 35 minutes. Put in clean, hot jars and seal.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Pie Dessert
ingredients: 1 box yellow cake mix (set aside 1 cup)
directions: Mix first 3 ingredients and press into greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix next 8 ingredients and pour over crust. Mix last 4 ingredients and sprinkle over top. Bake at 350 degrees for about 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Pumpkin Pie Dessert. Mix first 3 ingredients and press into greased 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix next 8 ingredients and pour over crust. Mix last 4 ingredients and sprinkle over top. Bake at 350 degrees for about 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Ragu-By-The-Sea
directions: Saute onion in butter.
Stir in tuna and saute briefly.
Add spaghetti sauce and parsley.
Simmer 10 minutes.
Serve over macaroni.
Serves 4 to 6.
recipes.text: Ragu-By-The-Sea. Saute onion in butter. Stir in tuna and saute briefly. Add spaghetti sauce and parsley. Simmer 10 minutes. Serve over macaroni. Serves 4 to 6.

recipes.title: Cheese-Garlic Biscuits
directions: Preheat oven to 450°.
Mix Bisquick, milk and cheese until soft dough forms.
Beat vigorously 30 seconds.
Drop dough by spoonfuls onto ungreased cookie sheet.
Bake 8 to 10 minutes or until golden brown.
Mix margarine, garlic powder and chives. Brush over hot biscuits before removing from cookie sheet.
Serve hot.
Makes 10 to 12 biscuits.
recipes.text: Cheese-Garlic Biscuits. Preheat oven to 450°. Mix Bisquick, milk and cheese until soft dough forms. Beat vigorously 30 seconds. Drop dough by spoonfuls onto ungreased cookie sheet. Bake 8 to 10 minutes or until golden brown. Mix margarine, garlic powder and chives. Brush over hot biscuits before removing from cookie sheet. Serve hot. Makes 10 to 12 biscuits.

recipes.title: Coffee Punch
directions: Dissolve coffee and sugar in boiling water.
Add milk.
Serve over equal parts of chocolate and vanilla ice cream (2 gallons each flavor).
Serves 100 people.
recipes.text: Coffee Punch. Dissolve coffee and sugar in boiling water. Add milk. Serve over equal parts of chocolate and vanilla ice cream (2 gallons each flavor). Serves 100 people.

recipes.title: Blueberry Buckle
directions: Mix first 4 ingredients until well blended.
Stir in next 5 ingredients.
Fold in blueberries; spread into 18-inch square pan. Combine remaining ingredients until crumbly; sprinkle over batter. Bake in preheated 375° oven for 45 to 50 minutes.
Yield:
18 servings.
recipes.text: Blueberry Buckle. Mix first 4 ingredients until well blended. Stir in next 5 ingredients. Fold in blueberries; spread into 18-inch square pan. Combine remaining ingredients until crumbly; sprinkle over batter. Bake in preheated 375° oven for 45 to 50 minutes. Yield: 18 servings.

recipes.title: Easy Peach Cobbler
directions: In casserole, combine peaches, sugar, 1 tablespoon baking mix and cinnamon.
In bowl, mix baking mix, cinnamon, brown sugar, milk and few drops of vanilla.
Pour over fruit.
Bake at 400° for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Easy Peach Cobbler. In casserole, combine peaches, sugar, 1 tablespoon baking mix and cinnamon. In bowl, mix baking mix, cinnamon, brown sugar, milk and few drops of vanilla. Pour over fruit. Bake at 400° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Zucchini Pie
directions: One teaspoon cinnamon may be used instead of apple pie spice.
recipes.text: Zucchini Pie. One teaspoon cinnamon may be used instead of apple pie spice.

recipes.title: Streusel Topped Fruit Pie
ingredients: 2 (21 oz.) cans fruit pie filling (such as apple, cherry, strawberry, blueberry, peach or raspberry)
1/3 c. firmly packed light brown sugar
directions: Preheat oven to 400°.
Spoon pie filling into pastry shell. In bowl, combine flour and brown sugar.
Cut in butter until mixture is crumbly.
Stir in nuts.
Crumble over pie filling. Bake 40 to 45 minutes or until top is golden and filling is bubbly.
Remove to wire rack to cool.
Makes 8 servings.
recipes.text: Streusel Topped Fruit Pie. Preheat oven to 400°. Spoon pie filling into pastry shell. In bowl, combine flour and brown sugar. Cut in butter until mixture is crumbly. Stir in nuts. Crumble over pie filling. Bake 40 to 45 minutes or until top is golden and filling is bubbly. Remove to wire rack to cool. Makes 8 servings.

recipes.title: Chicken Casserole
ingredients: 1 chicken, cooked and removed from bones
directions: Remove bones from chicken. Cut in small pieces.
Mix rice, chicken soup and onion.
Use water chestnuts and almonds, if desired.
Just as good without.
Place cracker crumbs on top and dot with margarine. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Chicken Casserole. Remove bones from chicken. Cut in small pieces. Mix rice, chicken soup and onion. Use water chestnuts and almonds, if desired. Just as good without. Place cracker crumbs on top and dot with margarine. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Fruit Ball
ingredients: 1 small jar green cherries, cut in half
directions: Mix well.
Roll in 1-inch balls and roll in coconut.
(These are better if they are covered tight for a day or two and refrigerated.)
recipes.text: Fruit Ball. Mix well. Roll in 1-inch balls and roll in coconut. (These are better if they are covered tight for a day or two and refrigerated.)

recipes.title: Lasagna
directions: Brown beef; drain.
Add 2 cups juice plus tomatoes, salt, pepper, eggs and spices; cook.
Mix with cooked macaroni; bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
Cover with cheese.
Ten minutes before taking out of oven, I use Mozzarella cheese plus sharp Cheddar.
recipes.text: Lasagna. Brown beef; drain. Add 2 cups juice plus tomatoes, salt, pepper, eggs and spices; cook. Mix with cooked macaroni; bake at 350° for 30 minutes. Cover with cheese. Ten minutes before taking out of oven, I use Mozzarella cheese plus sharp Cheddar.

recipes.title: Carrots
ingredients: 1 (15 oz.) can sliced carrots, slightly salted or home cooked (same amount)
directions: Combine margarine, sugar, allspice, pepper and lemon juice in pan over low heat until blended.
Drain carrots and add to pan. Simmer about 3 minutes until flavors are blended.
Serve immediately.
recipes.text: Carrots. Combine margarine, sugar, allspice, pepper and lemon juice in pan over low heat until blended. Drain carrots and add to pan. Simmer about 3 minutes until flavors are blended. Serve immediately.

recipes.title: Jello Salad
directions: Put pineapple and jello in saucepan; heat to dissolve jello. Let mixture cool a little, then add buttermilk and Cool Whip.
Mix with mixer and place in refrigerator.
recipes.text: Jello Salad. Put pineapple and jello in saucepan; heat to dissolve jello. Let mixture cool a little, then add buttermilk and Cool Whip. Mix with mixer and place in refrigerator.

recipes.title: Banana Split Cake
directions: Combine cracker crumbs and melted margarine; press into a 9 x 13-inch pan.
recipes.text: Banana Split Cake. Combine cracker crumbs and melted margarine; press into a 9 x 13-inch pan.

recipes.title: Corned Beef Salad
directions: Dissolve the Jell-O in the consomme.
After Jell-O is dissolved, let cool.
Add corned beef, onion, green pepper, celery and mayonnaise.
Press into loaf pan. Top with hard-boiled eggs.
recipes.text: Corned Beef Salad. Dissolve the Jell-O in the consomme. After Jell-O is dissolved, let cool. Add corned beef, onion, green pepper, celery and mayonnaise. Press into loaf pan. Top with hard-boiled eggs.

recipes.title: French-Style Green Beans
ingredients: 1 pkg. frozen French-style green beans or 2 cans French green beans (cook as directed)
directions: Cook green beans as directed.
Mix together cream of mushroom soup, egg, sour cream and mayonnaise and mix with green beans. Put grated cheese over top, bread cubes over cheese and Parmesan cheese over bread cubes.
Bake 1 hour at 350°.
recipes.text: French-Style Green Beans. Cook green beans as directed. Mix together cream of mushroom soup, egg, sour cream and mayonnaise and mix with green beans. Put grated cheese over top, bread cubes over cheese and Parmesan cheese over bread cubes. Bake 1 hour at 350°.

recipes.title: Pat'S Old Fashioned Bread Pudding
directions: Crumble biscuits.
Pour in milk and let stand until dissolved. Add eggs, butter, sugar and vanilla.
Bake in small baking dish at 375° until brown.
recipes.text: Pat'S Old Fashioned Bread Pudding. Crumble biscuits. Pour in milk and let stand until dissolved. Add eggs, butter, sugar and vanilla. Bake in small baking dish at 375° until brown.

recipes.title: Veggie Potato Melt
directions: Pierce potatoes; place on a paper towel.
Microwave until tender.
Let stand 5 minutes.
Combine other ingredients and microwave on High until tender (2 to 3 minutes).
Split potatoes and fill with vegetable mixture.
You may top with cheese or butter.
Microwave another 30 seconds to melt the topping.
recipes.text: Veggie Potato Melt. Pierce potatoes; place on a paper towel. Microwave until tender. Let stand 5 minutes. Combine other ingredients and microwave on High until tender (2 to 3 minutes). Split potatoes and fill with vegetable mixture. You may top with cheese or butter. Microwave another 30 seconds to melt the topping.

recipes.title: Strawberry Bread
directions: Defrost strawberries.
Beat eggs in a bowl until fluffy.
Add cooking oil, sugar and defrosted strawberries.
Sift together flour, cinnamon, soda and salt into mixing bowl.
Add strawberry mixture and mix until well blended.
Stir in nuts.
Pour into 2 greased and floured 9 1/2 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pans.
Bake in a 350° oven for 1 hour and 10 minutes or until done, then turn out of pans and cool on racks.
Makes 2 loaves.
recipes.text: Strawberry Bread. Defrost strawberries. Beat eggs in a bowl until fluffy. Add cooking oil, sugar and defrosted strawberries. Sift together flour, cinnamon, soda and salt into mixing bowl. Add strawberry mixture and mix until well blended. Stir in nuts. Pour into 2 greased and floured 9 1/2 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pans. Bake in a 350° oven for 1 hour and 10 minutes or until done, then turn out of pans and cool on racks. Makes 2 loaves.

recipes.title: No Bake Peanut Butter Munchies
directions: Mix graham cracker crumbs, powdered sugar, peanut butter and butter in a medium size bowl, using a wooden spoon.
Roll between palms to shape into small balls.
Roll half in nuts and half in coconut.
Refrigerate.
recipes.text: No Bake Peanut Butter Munchies. Mix graham cracker crumbs, powdered sugar, peanut butter and butter in a medium size bowl, using a wooden spoon. Roll between palms to shape into small balls. Roll half in nuts and half in coconut. Refrigerate.

recipes.title: Coconut Pie
directions: Melt margarine in 10-inch pie plate.
Mix sugar and flour together.
Add beaten eggs and gradually add milk.
Mix well and add flavoring, coconut and margarine.
Stir well and pour into pie plate.
Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes.
No crust needed.
recipes.text: Coconut Pie. Melt margarine in 10-inch pie plate. Mix sugar and flour together. Add beaten eggs and gradually add milk. Mix well and add flavoring, coconut and margarine. Stir well and pour into pie plate. Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes. No crust needed.

recipes.title: Spaghetti Salad
directions: Break spaghetti into thirds.
Cook and drain.
Place everything remaining into blender; whirl until pepper and carrot are coarsely chopped.
Pour over cooked spaghetti.
Let set overnight; stir occasionally.
If spaghetti is slightly warm it will absorb more flavor.
recipes.text: Spaghetti Salad. Break spaghetti into thirds. Cook and drain. Place everything remaining into blender; whirl until pepper and carrot are coarsely chopped. Pour over cooked spaghetti. Let set overnight; stir occasionally. If spaghetti is slightly warm it will absorb more flavor.

recipes.title: Quick Rolls
directions: Dissolve yeast in warm water.
Add all ingredients and mix well.
Pour into greased muffin tins.
Bake 15 to 20 minutes on 425°.
Makes 2 dozen.
recipes.text: Quick Rolls. Dissolve yeast in warm water. Add all ingredients and mix well. Pour into greased muffin tins. Bake 15 to 20 minutes on 425°. Makes 2 dozen.

recipes.title: Longhorn Brunch Casserole
directions: Jimmy Dean is a good sausage for this.
recipes.text: Longhorn Brunch Casserole. Jimmy Dean is a good sausage for this.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Candy
directions: Cream sugar and Karo in medium saucepan.
Bring to boil on medium heat.
Stir constantly.
Remove from heat; add vanilla and peanut butter and stir until smooth.
Stir in corn flakes until coated.
Drop on wax paper by teaspoons.
recipes.text: Peanut Butter Candy. Cream sugar and Karo in medium saucepan. Bring to boil on medium heat. Stir constantly. Remove from heat; add vanilla and peanut butter and stir until smooth. Stir in corn flakes until coated. Drop on wax paper by teaspoons.

recipes.title: Cherry Chocolate Upside-Down Cake(Microwave)
ingredients: 1 (21 oz.) can cherry pie filling, divided
1 (18 1/2 to 18 3/4 oz.) pkg. devil's food cake mix
directions: Generously butter 12-cup ring cake dish; sprinkle with sugar to coat.
Spread half of pie filling in dish.
Mix remaining ingredients (including rest of filling).
Beat 3 minutes with mixer.
Pour into dish.
Cook at Medium 12 minutes, rotating every 3 minutes.
Increase power to High for 1 to 8 minutes or until cake springs back when lightly touched and begins to pull away from sides.
Let stand 10 minutes.
Invert onto serving plate. Let cool completely before slicing.
Makes one ring cake.
recipes.text: Cherry Chocolate Upside-Down Cake(Microwave). Generously butter 12-cup ring cake dish; sprinkle with sugar to coat. Spread half of pie filling in dish. Mix remaining ingredients (including rest of filling). Beat 3 minutes with mixer. Pour into dish. Cook at Medium 12 minutes, rotating every 3 minutes. Increase power to High for 1 to 8 minutes or until cake springs back when lightly touched and begins to pull away from sides. Let stand 10 minutes. Invert onto serving plate. Let cool completely before slicing. Makes one ring cake.

recipes.title: Pecan Pie
directions: Prepare crust; do not cook.
recipes.text: Pecan Pie. Prepare crust; do not cook.

recipes.title: Hello Dollies
directions: Melt the butter in an 8 or 9-inch pan.
Sprinkle the remaining ingredients over the butter.
Bake for 25 minutes at 350°.
recipes.text: Hello Dollies. Melt the butter in an 8 or 9-inch pan. Sprinkle the remaining ingredients over the butter. Bake for 25 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Onion Mushroom Rice
directions: In a 2-quart saucepan over high heat, bring to boiling soup mix, rice and water.
Reduce heat.
Cover and simmer 25 minutes until tender, stirring occasionally.
Stir in green onions, if used.
Yields 4 servings.
recipes.text: Onion Mushroom Rice. In a 2-quart saucepan over high heat, bring to boiling soup mix, rice and water. Reduce heat. Cover and simmer 25 minutes until tender, stirring occasionally. Stir in green onions, if used. Yields 4 servings.

recipes.title: Feather Sponge Cake
ingredients: 1/2 tsp. each: vanilla and lemon flavor
directions: Beat egg yolks until thick and lemon colored.
Add cold water. Beat until very thick.
Gradually beat in sugar, then add vanilla and lemon flavor.
Sift flour with salt.
Fold into yolk mixture, a little at a time.
recipes.text: Feather Sponge Cake. Beat egg yolks until thick and lemon colored. Add cold water. Beat until very thick. Gradually beat in sugar, then add vanilla and lemon flavor. Sift flour with salt. Fold into yolk mixture, a little at a time.

recipes.title: Corn Dogs
directions: Combine the dry ingredients.
Combine the egg and oil with milk.
Add to the dry ingredients; mix well.
Insert wooden skewers into the wieners; cover the wieners with the corn meal mixture and fry in deep shortening until golden brown.
recipes.text: Corn Dogs. Combine the dry ingredients. Combine the egg and oil with milk. Add to the dry ingredients; mix well. Insert wooden skewers into the wieners; cover the wieners with the corn meal mixture and fry in deep shortening until golden brown.

recipes.title: Snowball Cake
directions: Tear angel food cake into pieces; set aside.
Mix the gelatine in the 4 teaspoons cold water; add the boiling water.
Stir until completely dissolved.
Add sugar, salt, crushed pineapple and lemon flavoring.
Set in the refrigerator until slightly jellied.
Whip 4 Dream Whip to stiff peaks, then fold jellied mixture into Dream Whip.
Add cherries and nuts to mixture.
recipes.text: Snowball Cake. Tear angel food cake into pieces; set aside. Mix the gelatine in the 4 teaspoons cold water; add the boiling water. Stir until completely dissolved. Add sugar, salt, crushed pineapple and lemon flavoring. Set in the refrigerator until slightly jellied. Whip 4 Dream Whip to stiff peaks, then fold jellied mixture into Dream Whip. Add cherries and nuts to mixture.

recipes.title: Strawberry Jello Salad
directions: Mix the first 4 ingredients together and pour half of this mixture into a dish.
Refrigerate until firm.
Keep other half of mixture in bowl at room temperature for top layer.
recipes.text: Strawberry Jello Salad. Mix the first 4 ingredients together and pour half of this mixture into a dish. Refrigerate until firm. Keep other half of mixture in bowl at room temperature for top layer.

recipes.title: Snowy Mashed Potatoes
ingredients: 8 to 10 Russet potatoes, peeled and quartered
1/2 c. minced scallions (including some of greens)
directions: Cook potatoes in boiling water (salted) until tender.
Drain and return pan to low heat, shaking to dry potatoes.
In a large bowl of electric mixer, cream together cheese and sour cream.
Add potatoes, one at a time, to cream mixture; continue beating on high speed until light and fluffy.
On low speed, add minced scallions, celery, green pepper, parsley, 1/4 cup melted butter, garlic powder, salt and pepper.
Spoon into 2 1/2 to 3-quart baking dish.
Sprinkle with paprika and dot with 2 tablespoons butter.
Bake in preheated oven at 375° for 25 minutes or until heated through.
Serves 8 to 10.
recipes.text: Snowy Mashed Potatoes. Cook potatoes in boiling water (salted) until tender. Drain and return pan to low heat, shaking to dry potatoes. In a large bowl of electric mixer, cream together cheese and sour cream. Add potatoes, one at a time, to cream mixture; continue beating on high speed until light and fluffy. On low speed, add minced scallions, celery, green pepper, parsley, 1/4 cup melted butter, garlic powder, salt and pepper. Spoon into 2 1/2 to 3-quart baking dish. Sprinkle with paprika and dot with 2 tablespoons butter. Bake in preheated oven at 375° for 25 minutes or until heated through. Serves 8 to 10.

recipes.title: Oatmeal Cookies
ingredients: 1/2 tsp. soda in 4 Tbsp. hot water
directions: Beat eggs and sugar together.
Add other ingredients in given order, mixing with each item thoroughly as added.
Drop by spoonful out on buttered tin.
Bake at 325° to 350°.
recipes.text: Oatmeal Cookies. Beat eggs and sugar together. Add other ingredients in given order, mixing with each item thoroughly as added. Drop by spoonful out on buttered tin. Bake at 325° to 350°.

recipes.title: Pecan Pie
directions: Cream butter, add sugar gradually and cream together until light and fluffy.
Add remaining ingredients and blend well.
Pour into a pastry shell and bake on lower shelf in a moderate oven (375°) 40 to 45 minutes.
This makes one large pie.
recipes.text: Pecan Pie. Cream butter, add sugar gradually and cream together until light and fluffy. Add remaining ingredients and blend well. Pour into a pastry shell and bake on lower shelf in a moderate oven (375°) 40 to 45 minutes. This makes one large pie.

recipes.title: Dad'S Meatballs
ingredients: 1 lb. ground meat mix (ground round, pork, veal)
directions: Mix together all ingredients well; shape into small to medium size balls.
Brown on all sides in skillet in olive oil.
Cook in favorite tomato sauce recipe.
recipes.text: Dad'S Meatballs. Mix together all ingredients well; shape into small to medium size balls. Brown on all sides in skillet in olive oil. Cook in favorite tomato sauce recipe.

recipes.title: Seven Layer Salad
directions: Layer first 7 ingredients in order given in a large 12 x 9-inch pan or dish.
Combine Miracle Whip and sugar; spread evenly over salad.
Sprinkle with cheese.
Cover and refrigerate 8 to 12 hours.
recipes.text: Seven Layer Salad. Layer first 7 ingredients in order given in a large 12 x 9-inch pan or dish. Combine Miracle Whip and sugar; spread evenly over salad. Sprinkle with cheese. Cover and refrigerate 8 to 12 hours.

recipes.title: Derrick'S Spice German Potato Salad
directions: Boil potatoes in jackets; cool and cut in cubes.
Fry bacon until crisp.
Remove and crumble over potatoes.
Add onions to hot bacon drippings and fry until tender.
Mix vinegar, salt, pepper, sugar, celery seed and water; bring to a boil.
Stir in egg yolk quickly.
Remove from heat; add potatoes and bacon.
Put in casserole and keep warm to serve.
recipes.text: Derrick'S Spice German Potato Salad. Boil potatoes in jackets; cool and cut in cubes. Fry bacon until crisp. Remove and crumble over potatoes. Add onions to hot bacon drippings and fry until tender. Mix vinegar, salt, pepper, sugar, celery seed and water; bring to a boil. Stir in egg yolk quickly. Remove from heat; add potatoes and bacon. Put in casserole and keep warm to serve.

recipes.title: Bulgarian Stew
directions: Grease an oblong casserole dish, large size.
Cut in the vegetables and sprinkle with salt, pepper and a little sugar. Season the meat and mix into the vegetables.
Pour over the juice; stir and cover with foil.
Bake at 350° until done, about 2 1/2 hours.
The meat should be very tender.
This can also be baked at 300° for a longer time.
Makes 6 to 8 servings.
recipes.text: Bulgarian Stew. Grease an oblong casserole dish, large size. Cut in the vegetables and sprinkle with salt, pepper and a little sugar. Season the meat and mix into the vegetables. Pour over the juice; stir and cover with foil. Bake at 350° until done, about 2 1/2 hours. The meat should be very tender. This can also be baked at 300° for a longer time. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

recipes.title: Chicken Hot Wings
directions: Marinate the chicken wings in soy sauce overnight or 6 to 8 hours before cooking.
Heat the oil in a deep frying pan before dropping in the wings.
As the wings become done, they seem to float to the top of the oil.
When they are done, drain well and sprinkle both sides generously with white pepper and roll in sesame seed.
recipes.text: Chicken Hot Wings. Marinate the chicken wings in soy sauce overnight or 6 to 8 hours before cooking. Heat the oil in a deep frying pan before dropping in the wings. As the wings become done, they seem to float to the top of the oil. When they are done, drain well and sprinkle both sides generously with white pepper and roll in sesame seed.

recipes.title: Fudge Brownies
ingredients: 2 (1 oz.) sq. unsweetened chocolate, melted and cooled
directions: In medium saucepan, melt butter and chocolate.
Remove from heat.
Stir in sugar.
Blend in eggs, one at a time.
Add vanilla. Spread in a greased 8-inch square pan and bake at 350° for 30 minutes (be careful not to overbake).
Cool.
Cut into 16 squares.
recipes.text: Fudge Brownies. In medium saucepan, melt butter and chocolate. Remove from heat. Stir in sugar. Blend in eggs, one at a time. Add vanilla. Spread in a greased 8-inch square pan and bake at 350° for 30 minutes (be careful not to overbake). Cool. Cut into 16 squares.

recipes.title: Rhubarb Pie
directions: Add cornstarch and sugar together in a large saucepan.
Mix in 1 cup water.
Cook over low flame until thick.
Add lemon juice and margarine, then add pineapple and rhubarb.
Put in 10-inch deep crust and cover with top crust.
Make a slit in center for steam to escape.
Bake until golden brown at 350°.
recipes.text: Rhubarb Pie. Add cornstarch and sugar together in a large saucepan. Mix in 1 cup water. Cook over low flame until thick. Add lemon juice and margarine, then add pineapple and rhubarb. Put in 10-inch deep crust and cover with top crust. Make a slit in center for steam to escape. Bake until golden brown at 350°.

recipes.title: Oriental Chicken
ingredients: 3 lb. chicken pieces or 2 lb. boneless
directions: Wash chicken; drain.
Shake in mixture of flour, salt and pepper in paper bag to coat.
Melt 4 tablespoons margarine in a 9 x 13 x 2-inch baking dish.
Roll chicken pieces, one at a time, in melted margarine to coat all over.
Place, skin side down in single layer, in baking dish.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
Melt remaining 4 tablespoons margarine in saucepan.
Stir in honey, lemon juice and soy sauce; mix well.
After the 30 minutes, turn chicken.
Pour honey mixture over it.
Bake 30 minutes more.
Baste several times.
Serves 4.
recipes.text: Oriental Chicken. Wash chicken; drain. Shake in mixture of flour, salt and pepper in paper bag to coat. Melt 4 tablespoons margarine in a 9 x 13 x 2-inch baking dish. Roll chicken pieces, one at a time, in melted margarine to coat all over. Place, skin side down in single layer, in baking dish. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes. Melt remaining 4 tablespoons margarine in saucepan. Stir in honey, lemon juice and soy sauce; mix well. After the 30 minutes, turn chicken. Pour honey mixture over it. Bake 30 minutes more. Baste several times. Serves 4.

recipes.title: No Crust German Chocolate Pie
directions: In a saucepan, melt chocolate and butter or margarine over low heat.
Remove from heat.
Stir in vanilla and cool.
recipes.text: No Crust German Chocolate Pie. In a saucepan, melt chocolate and butter or margarine over low heat. Remove from heat. Stir in vanilla and cool.

recipes.title: Gingersnaps
directions: Cream shortening and sugar; beat in egg.
Stir in molasses. Sift dry ingredients into mixture.
Add water.
Drop onto greased cookie sheet.
Bake at 400° for 8 minutes.
recipes.text: Gingersnaps. Cream shortening and sugar; beat in egg. Stir in molasses. Sift dry ingredients into mixture. Add water. Drop onto greased cookie sheet. Bake at 400° for 8 minutes.

recipes.title: Apple Oatmeal Crisp
