ingredients: 4 c. peeled and thinly sliced tart (Granny Smith) cooking apple
1/2 c. firmly packed dark brown sugar
1/2 c. unsalted butter, melted and cooled
directions: In a well buttered 9 inch square baking pan, combine apples, lemon juice, and the granulated sugar.
In a bowl combine the flour, oats, brown sugar, cinnamon, and the salt, add the butter and combine the mixture well.
recipes.text: Apple Oatmeal Crisp. In a well buttered 9 inch square baking pan, combine apples, lemon juice, and the granulated sugar. In a bowl combine the flour, oats, brown sugar, cinnamon, and the salt, add the butter and combine the mixture well.

recipes.title: Cheese Ball
directions: Mix together, saving 1/4 cup of nuts.
Press into a ball and roll into nuts.
recipes.text: Cheese Ball. Mix together, saving 1/4 cup of nuts. Press into a ball and roll into nuts.

recipes.title: Orange Glazed Pork Loin
ingredients: 3 cloves garlic, each cut into 4 pieces
directions: Use a roast tied with string instead of a stocking.
Roast is best if seasoned the day before.
Sauce can be made the day before too.
Preheat the oven to 325 degrees.
Combine the salt, thyme, ginger, and pepper in small bowl.
With sharp knife, make slits in roast and insert a slice of garlic and some of the spice mixture into each.
Rub the roast with remaining spice mixture.
Insert meat thermometer.
Place roast, uncovered, in a roasting pan and bake for a total of 3 hours.
Meanwhile, in a medium saucepan, combine the flour, cornstarch, and sugar.
Add orange juice gradually, then the remaining ingredients.
Cook over medium heat and whisk about 3 to 5 minutes, until smooth and thick.
After the pork has roasted for 2 hours, brush the roast frequently with the glaze. (I put a little sauce in a separate bowl to use as glaze so the meat won't contaminate the rest of the sauce.)
Continue roasting and basting for another hour, or until the meat thermometer registers 170 degrees.
Heat remaining glaze and serve as a sauce with the sliced pork.
Makes 10 servings.
recipes.text: Orange Glazed Pork Loin. Use a roast tied with string instead of a stocking. Roast is best if seasoned the day before. Sauce can be made the day before too. Preheat the oven to 325 degrees. Combine the salt, thyme, ginger, and pepper in small bowl. With sharp knife, make slits in roast and insert a slice of garlic and some of the spice mixture into each. Rub the roast with remaining spice mixture. Insert meat thermometer. Place roast, uncovered, in a roasting pan and bake for a total of 3 hours. Meanwhile, in a medium saucepan, combine the flour, cornstarch, and sugar. Add orange juice gradually, then the remaining ingredients. Cook over medium heat and whisk about 3 to 5 minutes, until smooth and thick. After the pork has roasted for 2 hours, brush the roast frequently with the glaze. (I put a little sauce in a separate bowl to use as glaze so the meat won't contaminate the rest of the sauce.) Continue roasting and basting for another hour, or until the meat thermometer registers 170 degrees. Heat remaining glaze and serve as a sauce with the sliced pork. Makes 10 servings.

recipes.title: Creamy Shrimp Shells
ingredients: 1 1/2 lb. shrimp, cooked, peeled and deveined
directions: Reserve 6 whole shrimp, cut remainder in half lengthwise and set aside.
Saute onion and garlic in 2 tablespoons butter until tender.
Stir in flour and salt, remove from heat and gradually add half and half, stirring constantly.
Bring to a boil and cook 1 minute, stirring constantly, until very thick.
Stir in wine and shrimp.
recipes.text: Creamy Shrimp Shells. Reserve 6 whole shrimp, cut remainder in half lengthwise and set aside. Saute onion and garlic in 2 tablespoons butter until tender. Stir in flour and salt, remove from heat and gradually add half and half, stirring constantly. Bring to a boil and cook 1 minute, stirring constantly, until very thick. Stir in wine and shrimp.

recipes.title: Glazed Fruit Dessert(Serves 6)
ingredients: 1 (3.4 oz.) pkg. instant vanilla pudding mix
1 (20 oz.) can crushed pineapple or pineapple chunks, liquid drained and saved
directions: In a mixing bowl, combine pudding and pineapple juice.
Stir until thickened.
Fold in oranges, pineapple and bananas. Refrigerate until serving.
Garnish with a dollop of whipped topping.
recipes.text: Glazed Fruit Dessert(Serves 6). In a mixing bowl, combine pudding and pineapple juice. Stir until thickened. Fold in oranges, pineapple and bananas. Refrigerate until serving. Garnish with a dollop of whipped topping.

recipes.title: Brown Caramel Filling
directions: Mix all ingredients together in heavy saucepan.
Cook to soft ball stage.
(Stir constantly; otherwise it will scorch.)
When done, set aside.
Brown 1/2 cup sugar in heavy skillet over medium heat, and add to the first mixture.
Stir until cool.
Enough to ice 3-layer cake.
recipes.text: Brown Caramel Filling. Mix all ingredients together in heavy saucepan. Cook to soft ball stage. (Stir constantly; otherwise it will scorch.) When done, set aside. Brown 1/2 cup sugar in heavy skillet over medium heat, and add to the first mixture. Stir until cool. Enough to ice 3-layer cake.

recipes.title: Skillet Cabbage
directions: Shred cabbage; cut pepper and onion in rings.
Slice tomatoes; dice celery and combine all ingredients in a large skillet (electric is nice).
Cover and cook on medium heat until crisp and tender, approximately 15 to 20 minutes.
Stir often.
Leftovers keep well.
recipes.text: Skillet Cabbage. Shred cabbage; cut pepper and onion in rings. Slice tomatoes; dice celery and combine all ingredients in a large skillet (electric is nice). Cover and cook on medium heat until crisp and tender, approximately 15 to 20 minutes. Stir often. Leftovers keep well.

recipes.title: River Bottom Pie
directions: Mix first 3 ingredients with mixer.
Mix other in by hand. Add lemon juice last.
Pour into crust.
Refrigerate until firm. This recipe will serve 4 people.
recipes.text: River Bottom Pie. Mix first 3 ingredients with mixer. Mix other in by hand. Add lemon juice last. Pour into crust. Refrigerate until firm. This recipe will serve 4 people.

recipes.title: French Potato Salad
ingredients: 1 Tbsp. chopped fresh tarragon or 1 tsp. tarragon leaves
2 tsp. chopped fresh chervil or 1/2 tsp. chervil leaves
directions: Cook potatoes, covered, in enough boiling salted water to cover for 30 minutes, or just until fork-tender.
Drain, peel and slice while still warm into 1/4-inch thick slices into salad bowl. In bowl or jar with tight fitting lid, combine vinegar and rest of ingredients; mix very well.
Pour over warm potatoes, gently, to coat with liquid.
Serve warm or let cool and refrigerate. Before serving, toss gently again.
Makes 8 servings.
recipes.text: French Potato Salad. Cook potatoes, covered, in enough boiling salted water to cover for 30 minutes, or just until fork-tender. Drain, peel and slice while still warm into 1/4-inch thick slices into salad bowl. In bowl or jar with tight fitting lid, combine vinegar and rest of ingredients; mix very well. Pour over warm potatoes, gently, to coat with liquid. Serve warm or let cool and refrigerate. Before serving, toss gently again. Makes 8 servings.

recipes.title: Salsa
ingredients: 4 c. peeled and cored tomatoes, chopped
1 c. seeded, chopped jalapeno peppers (use gloves)
directions: Mix all ingredients together and cook until it boils.
Reduce heat and simmer about 20 minutes.
Makes 3 pints.
recipes.text: Salsa. Mix all ingredients together and cook until it boils. Reduce heat and simmer about 20 minutes. Makes 3 pints.

recipes.title: Walding Family Ice Cream
directions: Beat eggs until fluffy.
Add condensed milk and mix well.
Add flour to sugar and add to mixture.
Add milk and flavoring.
recipes.text: Walding Family Ice Cream. Beat eggs until fluffy. Add condensed milk and mix well. Add flour to sugar and add to mixture. Add milk and flavoring.

recipes.title: Chocolate Chess Pie
directions: Mix together and pour into unbaked pie shell.
Bake at 400° for 30 to 40 minutes or until set.
recipes.text: Chocolate Chess Pie. Mix together and pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake at 400° for 30 to 40 minutes or until set.

recipes.title: Strawberry Punch
directions: Use the same flavor in Jell-O as in Kool-Aid.
In mixing your Jell-O, use hot water.
Makes 2 1/2 gallons.
recipes.text: Strawberry Punch. Use the same flavor in Jell-O as in Kool-Aid. In mixing your Jell-O, use hot water. Makes 2 1/2 gallons.

recipes.title: Hot Wassail
directions: Stick 4 small oranges with cloves. Bake for 20 minutes at 350°.
Heat spices and cider.
Add cinnamon sticks and bring to a boil.
Put in bowl to serve.
Put oranges in to float.
recipes.text: Hot Wassail. Stick 4 small oranges with cloves. Bake for 20 minutes at 350°. Heat spices and cider. Add cinnamon sticks and bring to a boil. Put in bowl to serve. Put oranges in to float.

recipes.title: Onion Casserole
ingredients: 1 lb. medium hot sausage, browned and drained
directions: Put sliced onions on bottom of a 12 x 7-inch casserole.
Add layer of crushed crackers, sausage, then another layer of onions. Spread soup on top of onions and sprinkle with seasoned salt.
Add the cheese and pimentos, if desired.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour. Makes 6 to 8 servings.
recipes.text: Onion Casserole. Put sliced onions on bottom of a 12 x 7-inch casserole. Add layer of crushed crackers, sausage, then another layer of onions. Spread soup on top of onions and sprinkle with seasoned salt. Add the cheese and pimentos, if desired. Bake at 350° for 1 hour. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

recipes.title: Punch Bowl Cake
ingredients: 1 box cake mix (follow directions on box; make 2 layers)
2 small boxes Jell-O instant pudding mix (follow directions on box)
1 or more c. chopped pecans or other nuts
directions: Put in punch bowl in this order:
cake layer, 1/2 of everything in order given, cake layer and 1/2 of everything in order given.
Sprinkle with nuts and cherries.
recipes.text: Punch Bowl Cake. Put in punch bowl in this order: cake layer, 1/2 of everything in order given, cake layer and 1/2 of everything in order given. Sprinkle with nuts and cherries.

recipes.title: Tetrazzini
ingredients: 1 (6 oz.) can evaporated milk or 2/3 c. cream
1 c. tuna, cooked chicken or turkey
directions: Preheat oven to 375°.
Cook onion in small amount of oil until tender.
Add soup, milk and cheese.
Heat and stir.
Add meat and remaining ingredients.
Pour into a 2-quart casserole. Sprinkle with cheese.
Bake at 375° for 20 to 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Tetrazzini. Preheat oven to 375°. Cook onion in small amount of oil until tender. Add soup, milk and cheese. Heat and stir. Add meat and remaining ingredients. Pour into a 2-quart casserole. Sprinkle with cheese. Bake at 375° for 20 to 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Peach Ice Cream
directions: Combine peaches with 1 cup sugar.
Mix well.
Set aside.
Beat eggs with electric mixer at medium speed, until frothy.
Gradually add 2 cups sugar to eggs.
Beat until thick.
Add salt, vanilla extract, and 1/2 cup milk.
Beat, until sugar has dissolved.
Stir in whipped cream, half-and-half, and peach mixture.
Pour mixture into freezer cylinder of a 1-gallon ice cream maker.
Add enough milk to fill can 2/3 full.
Freeze according to manufacturer instructions.
Let ripen 1 hour.
recipes.text: Peach Ice Cream. Combine peaches with 1 cup sugar. Mix well. Set aside. Beat eggs with electric mixer at medium speed, until frothy. Gradually add 2 cups sugar to eggs. Beat until thick. Add salt, vanilla extract, and 1/2 cup milk. Beat, until sugar has dissolved. Stir in whipped cream, half-and-half, and peach mixture. Pour mixture into freezer cylinder of a 1-gallon ice cream maker. Add enough milk to fill can 2/3 full. Freeze according to manufacturer instructions. Let ripen 1 hour.

recipes.title: Strawberry Pie
directions: Crush 1 1/2 cups berries.
Cook with water to boil 2 minutes. Put through sieve.
Blend sugar and cornstarch and blend into berry juice.
Cook over medium heat until thick.
Add color. Cover bottom of pie crust with thick juice.
Place berries, stem down, over juice.
Cover with remaining mixture.
Refrigerate.
recipes.text: Strawberry Pie. Crush 1 1/2 cups berries. Cook with water to boil 2 minutes. Put through sieve. Blend sugar and cornstarch and blend into berry juice. Cook over medium heat until thick. Add color. Cover bottom of pie crust with thick juice. Place berries, stem down, over juice. Cover with remaining mixture. Refrigerate.

recipes.title: Eggplant Casserole
directions: Crush corn flakes and mix with other ingredients.
Put in greased baking dish and bake until cheese is melted and casserole is heated thoroughly.
Top with grated cheese.
Serves 6.
recipes.text: Eggplant Casserole. Crush corn flakes and mix with other ingredients. Put in greased baking dish and bake until cheese is melted and casserole is heated thoroughly. Top with grated cheese. Serves 6.

recipes.title: Forget Them Cookies
directions: Beat the hell out of the egg whites.
Add sugar, a little at a time.
Add vanilla, a little at a time.
Place on cookie sheet in little mounds (about 1 heaping teaspoon).
Heat oven to 350°. Turn off oven and put cookie sheet in oven overnight.
recipes.text: Forget Them Cookies. Beat the hell out of the egg whites. Add sugar, a little at a time. Add vanilla, a little at a time. Place on cookie sheet in little mounds (about 1 heaping teaspoon). Heat oven to 350°. Turn off oven and put cookie sheet in oven overnight.

recipes.title: Twinkie Cake
directions: Split Twinkies and place (filling side up) into a 9 x 13-inch baking pan.
Mix pudding mix and milk together.
Put pudding on top of Twinkies.
Slice bananas on top of pudding.
Drain pineapple and put over bananas.
Cover with Cool Whip. Refrigerate overnight.
recipes.text: Twinkie Cake. Split Twinkies and place (filling side up) into a 9 x 13-inch baking pan. Mix pudding mix and milk together. Put pudding on top of Twinkies. Slice bananas on top of pudding. Drain pineapple and put over bananas. Cover with Cool Whip. Refrigerate overnight.

recipes.title: Spiced Chicken And Vegetables
ingredients: 2 1/2 Tbsp. soy sauce (I use a little less)
2 boned chicken breasts, cut in cubes
directions: Mix together garlic salt, ginger, minced garlic, pepper and soy sauce.
Add chicken and marinate approximately 20 minutes.
Use 3 tablespoons oil to cook meat.
Then take meat out of oil and add more oil for cooking broccoli, salt, mushrooms and onion.
Add broccoli and salt first and then mushrooms and onions.
Add all together with chicken.
Serve over rice.
recipes.text: Spiced Chicken And Vegetables. Mix together garlic salt, ginger, minced garlic, pepper and soy sauce. Add chicken and marinate approximately 20 minutes. Use 3 tablespoons oil to cook meat. Then take meat out of oil and add more oil for cooking broccoli, salt, mushrooms and onion. Add broccoli and salt first and then mushrooms and onions. Add all together with chicken. Serve over rice.

recipes.title: Blueberry Salad
directions: Mix ingredients together and chill.
recipes.text: Blueberry Salad. Mix ingredients together and chill.

recipes.title: Balmy Banana Bake
directions: Preheat oven to 375°.
Butter a shallow baking dish; reserve remaining butter.
Peel and layer bananas in the buttered dish; drizzle with lime juice.
Sprinkle with sugar and dot bananas with remaining butter.
Bake for 30 minutes basting once or twice with sauce.
Remove bananas carefully with a long spatula.
Serve hot with sauce spooned on top.
Serves 8.
Per serving: 149 calories, 4 g fat, 8 mg. cholesterol.
recipes.text: Balmy Banana Bake. Preheat oven to 375°. Butter a shallow baking dish; reserve remaining butter. Peel and layer bananas in the buttered dish; drizzle with lime juice. Sprinkle with sugar and dot bananas with remaining butter. Bake for 30 minutes basting once or twice with sauce. Remove bananas carefully with a long spatula. Serve hot with sauce spooned on top. Serves 8. Per serving: 149 calories, 4 g fat, 8 mg. cholesterol.

recipes.title: Pepper Steak
ingredients: 1 lb. Minute steaks, cut in strips
directions: Dip steak strips in flour.
In large skillet, saute steak in 1/2 the butter for about 2 minutes.
Remove meat.
Add remaining butter to skillet and saute peppers, onion, garlic and mushrooms 5 minutes; add tomatoes and bouillon.
Bring to boil, reduce heat and simmer 10 minutes.
Mix cornstarch, wine and soy sauce.
Add to skillet.
Cook, stirring until thickened.
Add meat.
Simmer 5 minutes.
Serve with rice.
recipes.text: Pepper Steak. Dip steak strips in flour. In large skillet, saute steak in 1/2 the butter for about 2 minutes. Remove meat. Add remaining butter to skillet and saute peppers, onion, garlic and mushrooms 5 minutes; add tomatoes and bouillon. Bring to boil, reduce heat and simmer 10 minutes. Mix cornstarch, wine and soy sauce. Add to skillet. Cook, stirring until thickened. Add meat. Simmer 5 minutes. Serve with rice.

recipes.title: Broccoli Cheese Soup
directions: Cook broccoli as directed. Add garlic powder. In large pot, melt butter and saute onions until tender. Add 2 cans of chicken broth and boil. Cook noodles in broth. Add broccoli with juices, then cheese and half and half. Lower heat and cook until melted. Salt and pepper to taste.
recipes.text: Broccoli Cheese Soup. Cook broccoli as directed. Add garlic powder. In large pot, melt butter and saute onions until tender. Add 2 cans of chicken broth and boil. Cook noodles in broth. Add broccoli with juices, then cheese and half and half. Lower heat and cook until melted. Salt and pepper to taste.

recipes.title: Spiced Shrimp
directions: Combine first 4 ingredients.
Bring to a boil.
Add shrimp. Stir gently.
Cover and steam until tender, approximately 10 minutes for small and 20 minutes for large shrimp.
Drain.
If not shelled, remove shells and vein in back.
recipes.text: Spiced Shrimp. Combine first 4 ingredients. Bring to a boil. Add shrimp. Stir gently. Cover and steam until tender, approximately 10 minutes for small and 20 minutes for large shrimp. Drain. If not shelled, remove shells and vein in back.

recipes.title: Capt. Boomer'S Dessert
ingredients: 4 Heath bars, crushed, or Heath brickle
directions: In a 9 x 13-inch pan, rub 2 tablespoons of butter on all sides and bottom.
Freeze for 10 minutes.
Mix graham crackers, cinnamon and 4 tablespoons butter.
Press mixture on bottom and all sides of pan.
Freeze for 15 minutes.
Layer softened ice cream (about 1 1/2 inches thick) on top of crust.
Freeze for 30 minutes, or until frozen.
Layer almonds, then candy, then pour chocolate syrup, covering the top.
Serve with Cool Whip on individual servings.
recipes.text: Capt. Boomer'S Dessert. In a 9 x 13-inch pan, rub 2 tablespoons of butter on all sides and bottom. Freeze for 10 minutes. Mix graham crackers, cinnamon and 4 tablespoons butter. Press mixture on bottom and all sides of pan. Freeze for 15 minutes. Layer softened ice cream (about 1 1/2 inches thick) on top of crust. Freeze for 30 minutes, or until frozen. Layer almonds, then candy, then pour chocolate syrup, covering the top. Serve with Cool Whip on individual servings.

recipes.title: Cooked Play Dough
directions: Mix all ingredients in a saucepan on medium heat and cook until mixture comes away from the pan.
Cool.
Then knead out lumps.
Store in sealed container. Cooked play dough has a longer shelf life and a better consistency than uncooked play dough.
recipes.text: Cooked Play Dough. Mix all ingredients in a saucepan on medium heat and cook until mixture comes away from the pan. Cool. Then knead out lumps. Store in sealed container. Cooked play dough has a longer shelf life and a better consistency than uncooked play dough.

recipes.title: Vi'S Dump Cake
directions: In a large mixing bowl sift the dry ingredients.
Make a well and drop in the eggs, vanilla, buttermilk and cooled margarine. Mix well.
Add nuts and mix well.
Spray a 9 x 13-inch pan with vegetable oil. Bake about 30 to 35 minutes at 350°.
recipes.text: Vi'S Dump Cake. In a large mixing bowl sift the dry ingredients. Make a well and drop in the eggs, vanilla, buttermilk and cooled margarine. Mix well. Add nuts and mix well. Spray a 9 x 13-inch pan with vegetable oil. Bake about 30 to 35 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Applesauce Oatmeal Muffins
directions: Cream margarine and brown sugar.
Add egg.
Add spices, alternating
with
applesauce.
Add flour and oats; stir well. Stir in nuts and raisins.
Fill muffin tins 3/4 full.
Bake at 325° for 20 minutes.
Makes approximately 12 muffins.
recipes.text: Applesauce Oatmeal Muffins. Cream margarine and brown sugar. Add egg. Add spices, alternating with applesauce. Add flour and oats; stir well. Stir in nuts and raisins. Fill muffin tins 3/4 full. Bake at 325° for 20 minutes. Makes approximately 12 muffins.

recipes.title: 1000 Island Dressing
directions: Mix all ingredients together real good and let set a while.
recipes.text: 1000 Island Dressing. Mix all ingredients together real good and let set a while.

recipes.title: Coconut Dessert
directions: Mix first 2 ingredients and press in buttered 13 x 9-inch pan. Mix milk, pudding and vanilla ice cream in a large bowl.
Spread on crust and top with 9 ounces Cool Whip.
recipes.text: Coconut Dessert. Mix first 2 ingredients and press in buttered 13 x 9-inch pan. Mix milk, pudding and vanilla ice cream in a large bowl. Spread on crust and top with 9 ounces Cool Whip.

recipes.title: English Pea Casserole
ingredients: 1 (17 oz.) can small drained English peas with onions
1 can water chestnuts, chopped and drained
directions: Combine peas, water chestnuts, onion, soup and pimento. Sprinkle
cheese
on
top.
Combine
Ritz crackers and butter; sprinkle on top.
Bake at 400° for 15 minutes.
recipes.text: English Pea Casserole. Combine peas, water chestnuts, onion, soup and pimento. Sprinkle cheese on top. Combine Ritz crackers and butter; sprinkle on top. Bake at 400° for 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Raisin Nut Spice Cake
directions: Cream shortening, sugar and eggs.
Sift other dry ingredients, then add alternately the buttermilk and dry ingredients to the shortening mixture.
Beat about 2 minutes.
Fold in nuts and raisins.
Pour into prepared 9-inch cake pans (greased and floured).
Bake 30 to 35 minutes in a 350° oven.
Cool and frost with White Butter Icing.
recipes.text: Raisin Nut Spice Cake. Cream shortening, sugar and eggs. Sift other dry ingredients, then add alternately the buttermilk and dry ingredients to the shortening mixture. Beat about 2 minutes. Fold in nuts and raisins. Pour into prepared 9-inch cake pans (greased and floured). Bake 30 to 35 minutes in a 350° oven. Cool and frost with White Butter Icing.

recipes.title: Sue'S Slaw
directions: Add the evaporated milk to the mayonnaise and blend until smooth.
Stir in Tabasco sauce, vinegar, mustard, sugar, celery seed and salt.
Put cabbage, carrots and green pepper in large bowl.
Pour dressing over and toss gently.
Yield: 12 servings.
recipes.text: Sue'S Slaw. Add the evaporated milk to the mayonnaise and blend until smooth. Stir in Tabasco sauce, vinegar, mustard, sugar, celery seed and salt. Put cabbage, carrots and green pepper in large bowl. Pour dressing over and toss gently. Yield: 12 servings.

recipes.title: Heavenly Broiled Fish
directions: Combine first 6 ingredients in small bowl; set aside.
Place fish in single layer on well-greased broiler pan.
Brush fish with lemon juice.
Broil 4 inches from heat for 4 to 6 minutes.
Remove from broiler and spread mixture on fillets.
Broil 2 minutes or until lightly browned.
Makes 6 servings.
recipes.text: Heavenly Broiled Fish. Combine first 6 ingredients in small bowl; set aside. Place fish in single layer on well-greased broiler pan. Brush fish with lemon juice. Broil 4 inches from heat for 4 to 6 minutes. Remove from broiler and spread mixture on fillets. Broil 2 minutes or until lightly browned. Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Fudge Ecstasies
directions: In a heavy medium saucepan, heat half of the chocolate pieces, the unsweetened chocolate and butter until melted, stirring occasionally.
Add eggs, sugar, flour, vanilla and baking powder. Beat until thoroughly combined.
Stir in remaining chocolate pieces and walnuts.
Drop by rounded 2 inches apart onto a greased cookie sheet.
Bake at 350° for 8 to 10 minutes or until edges are firm and surfaces are dull and cracked.
Cool cookies on a wire rack.
Makes 3 dozen.
recipes.text: Fudge Ecstasies. In a heavy medium saucepan, heat half of the chocolate pieces, the unsweetened chocolate and butter until melted, stirring occasionally. Add eggs, sugar, flour, vanilla and baking powder. Beat until thoroughly combined. Stir in remaining chocolate pieces and walnuts. Drop by rounded 2 inches apart onto a greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350° for 8 to 10 minutes or until edges are firm and surfaces are dull and cracked. Cool cookies on a wire rack. Makes 3 dozen.

recipes.title: Chicken Casserole
directions: Break up cooked chicken in sizes of quarters; place on bottom of 9 x 13-inch baking dish.
Mix milk with two soups; pour over chicken.
Add 1 cup broth to stuffing and place on top.
Break small pieces of oleo and lay them on top of the stuffing.
Add mushrooms on top.
Bake 1 hour at 350°.
recipes.text: Chicken Casserole. Break up cooked chicken in sizes of quarters; place on bottom of 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Mix milk with two soups; pour over chicken. Add 1 cup broth to stuffing and place on top. Break small pieces of oleo and lay them on top of the stuffing. Add mushrooms on top. Bake 1 hour at 350°.

recipes.title: Joy'S Shrimp Salad
ingredients: 1/2 lb. cooked shrimp, cut in half
directions: Cook pasta until tender; drain.
Stir in French dressing while warm and chill in refrigerator.
Add in rest of ingredients and chill.	May garnish with dill weed. Serves 6.
recipes.text: Joy'S Shrimp Salad. Cook pasta until tender; drain. Stir in French dressing while warm and chill in refrigerator. Add in rest of ingredients and chill.	May garnish with dill weed. Serves 6.

recipes.title: Cranberry Salad
directions: Grind cranberries and set aside.
Prepare gelatin according to package directions.
Add sugar, pineapple, marshmallows, lemon juice and cranberries.
Mix well, put in refrigerator.
Stir frequently so ingredients will be well mixed.
recipes.text: Cranberry Salad. Grind cranberries and set aside. Prepare gelatin according to package directions. Add sugar, pineapple, marshmallows, lemon juice and cranberries. Mix well, put in refrigerator. Stir frequently so ingredients will be well mixed.

recipes.title: No Crust Pumpkin Pie
directions: Beat with mixer on high 1 1/2 minutes until smooth.
Grease pie tin.
Bake in moderate oven until knife comes out clean.
recipes.text: No Crust Pumpkin Pie. Beat with mixer on high 1 1/2 minutes until smooth. Grease pie tin. Bake in moderate oven until knife comes out clean.

recipes.title: Frozen Strawberries
directions: Mix strawberries and sugar together.
Let stand 20 minutes. Combine pectin and water and boil 1 minute.
Pour over berries. Mix well.
Seal in freezer containers and freeze.
Makes 5 pints.
recipes.text: Frozen Strawberries. Mix strawberries and sugar together. Let stand 20 minutes. Combine pectin and water and boil 1 minute. Pour over berries. Mix well. Seal in freezer containers and freeze. Makes 5 pints.

recipes.title: Breakfast Casserole
directions: Brown sausage and drain on paper towels.
Preheat oven to 350 degrees.
Line 8x10-inch baking sheet with 1 package crescent rolls, unrolled flat.
Layer browned sausage, green chiles and cream cheese.
Unroll remaining package of crescent rolls and place flat on top and cook according to directions on crescent rolls. Yield:
12 to 15 servings.
recipes.text: Breakfast Casserole. Brown sausage and drain on paper towels. Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Line 8x10-inch baking sheet with 1 package crescent rolls, unrolled flat. Layer browned sausage, green chiles and cream cheese. Unroll remaining package of crescent rolls and place flat on top and cook according to directions on crescent rolls. Yield: 12 to 15 servings.

recipes.title: Stuffed Flank Steak
directions: To Make Stuffing:
Break bread into pieces.
Add onion and 1/2 of gravy to moisten.
Add celery and egg.
Mix.
Then score flank steak (you can have butcher do it for you).
recipes.text: Stuffed Flank Steak. To Make Stuffing: Break bread into pieces. Add onion and 1/2 of gravy to moisten. Add celery and egg. Mix. Then score flank steak (you can have butcher do it for you).

recipes.title: No Fail Muffins
directions: Combine all ingredients in a medium bowl.
Fill greased muffin tins 2/3 full.
Bake at 400° for 20 to 25 minutes.
recipes.text: No Fail Muffins. Combine all ingredients in a medium bowl. Fill greased muffin tins 2/3 full. Bake at 400° for 20 to 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Turkey Pot Pie
directions: In a large bowl mix all the ingredients and set aside.
Then use my Never Fail Pie Crust recipe and make 2 pie crusts.
(The recipe makes 3 crusts, you can save the remaining dough in a Ziploc bag.
It will keep for days in refrigerator, or you can go ahead and roll out crust in an aluminum pie pan and put in plastic bag and freeze for later use).
Use a deep pie pan.
Spray with nonstick spray.
Lay first crust, then pour in turkey mixture. Then fold top crust and make 3 cuts 1 1/2 inches long at a slant. Move 1/2-inch on each side and repeat.
Then open crust and lay over the top.
Gently go around the pie and tuck the top crust behind the bottom crust.
Use fork and press together or finger fan around crust.
Bake in 400° oven for 30 minutes or until browned.
recipes.text: Turkey Pot Pie. In a large bowl mix all the ingredients and set aside. Then use my Never Fail Pie Crust recipe and make 2 pie crusts. (The recipe makes 3 crusts, you can save the remaining dough in a Ziploc bag. It will keep for days in refrigerator, or you can go ahead and roll out crust in an aluminum pie pan and put in plastic bag and freeze for later use). Use a deep pie pan. Spray with nonstick spray. Lay first crust, then pour in turkey mixture. Then fold top crust and make 3 cuts 1 1/2 inches long at a slant. Move 1/2-inch on each side and repeat. Then open crust and lay over the top. Gently go around the pie and tuck the top crust behind the bottom crust. Use fork and press together or finger fan around crust. Bake in 400° oven for 30 minutes or until browned.

recipes.title: Crab Bacon Roll-Ups
directions: Saute
the
onion
in butter;
remove the onion and set aside. Add
the
crabmeat
and
seasonings, tossing crab long enough
to absorb
all
of the butter.
Cut the bacon in half crosswise and roll about 1 teaspoon of crabmeat in each slice, fastening
with a toothpick.
Place the rolls on an ungreased pan;
broil until the bacon crisps.
Drain well and serve hot. These
may
be prepared well in advance and broiled when ready to serve.
recipes.text: Crab Bacon Roll-Ups. Saute the onion in butter; remove the onion and set aside. Add the crabmeat and seasonings, tossing crab long enough to absorb all of the butter. Cut the bacon in half crosswise and roll about 1 teaspoon of crabmeat in each slice, fastening with a toothpick. Place the rolls on an ungreased pan; broil until the bacon crisps. Drain well and serve hot. These may be prepared well in advance and broiled when ready to serve.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Cookies
directions: Mix sugars, oil and vanilla.
Add peanut butter and eggs. Sift dry ingredients together and add to peanut butter mixture. Bake at 350° for 8 to 10 minutes.
Makes 8 to 10 dozen.
recipes.text: Peanut Butter Cookies. Mix sugars, oil and vanilla. Add peanut butter and eggs. Sift dry ingredients together and add to peanut butter mixture. Bake at 350° for 8 to 10 minutes. Makes 8 to 10 dozen.

recipes.title: Spicy Hot Dog Relish
ingredients: crushed red pepper flakes to taste
directions: Dice onions in 5-quart saucepan.
Add other ingredients and simmer for 3 hours on low heat.
recipes.text: Spicy Hot Dog Relish. Dice onions in 5-quart saucepan. Add other ingredients and simmer for 3 hours on low heat.

recipes.title: Broccoli-Ham Shortcake
ingredients: 4 oz. Cheddar cheese, cut in small cubes (1 c.)
8 oz. chunk of ham, cut in small cubes (1 1/2 c.)
1 (10 oz.) pkg. corn bread mix, prepared according to directions
directions: Melt butter in medium sized saucepan over low heat. Add flour and stir constantly until smooth and frothy. Let mixture bubble about 3 minutes, stirring often to prevent browning. Gradually stir in milk. Increase heat to medium and simmer, stirring often, about 5 minutes, until thick and smooth. Add cheese, frozen broccoli and ham. Cook, stirring occasionally, until cheese has melted and broccoli is cooked. Cut corn bread into 4 equal pieces. Slice each in half horizontally. Place bottoms on plates. Top with half of sauce, remaining corn bread and remaining sauce.
recipes.text: Broccoli-Ham Shortcake. Melt butter in medium sized saucepan over low heat. Add flour and stir constantly until smooth and frothy. Let mixture bubble about 3 minutes, stirring often to prevent browning. Gradually stir in milk. Increase heat to medium and simmer, stirring often, about 5 minutes, until thick and smooth. Add cheese, frozen broccoli and ham. Cook, stirring occasionally, until cheese has melted and broccoli is cooked. Cut corn bread into 4 equal pieces. Slice each in half horizontally. Place bottoms on plates. Top with half of sauce, remaining corn bread and remaining sauce.

recipes.title: Ultimate Chocolate Chip Cookie
ingredients: 1 c Hershey's semi- sweet chocolate chip
directions: Pre- Heat oven to 375 degrees.
Combine crisco, lt brown sugar, milk, and vanilla in large bowl.
Beat at medium speed. Beat egg into creamed mixture.
Combine flour, salt, and soda. Mix into creamed mixture.
Stir in Chocolate chips.
Bake at 375 degrees for 8 to 10 minutes.
recipes.text: Ultimate Chocolate Chip Cookie. Pre- Heat oven to 375 degrees. Combine crisco, lt brown sugar, milk, and vanilla in large bowl. Beat at medium speed. Beat egg into creamed mixture. Combine flour, salt, and soda. Mix into creamed mixture. Stir in Chocolate chips. Bake at 375 degrees for 8 to 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Nana'S Spaghetti Sauce
ingredients: 3/4 tsp. ground, dried whole red peppers
directions: Brown one side of meat in margarine in large heavy Dutch oven. Slice onions and garlic on top of meat while browning other side. Add remaining ingredients.
Cook on medium heat until boiling. Reduce heat to low and cook 4 to 5 hours, stirring frequently to prevent scorching or until sauce thickens.
Ladle over cooked spaghetti noodles.
Serve with sliced pork roast.
recipes.text: Nana'S Spaghetti Sauce. Brown one side of meat in margarine in large heavy Dutch oven. Slice onions and garlic on top of meat while browning other side. Add remaining ingredients. Cook on medium heat until boiling. Reduce heat to low and cook 4 to 5 hours, stirring frequently to prevent scorching or until sauce thickens. Ladle over cooked spaghetti noodles. Serve with sliced pork roast.

recipes.title: Country Style Spareribs
directions: Bake spareribs 1 hour at 425° to 450°, then pour off fat.
Mix remaining ingredients together and boil for 2 to 3 minutes.
Pour the sauce over ribs and baste occasionally for 2 to 3 hours or longer at 250°.
recipes.text: Country Style Spareribs. Bake spareribs 1 hour at 425° to 450°, then pour off fat. Mix remaining ingredients together and boil for 2 to 3 minutes. Pour the sauce over ribs and baste occasionally for 2 to 3 hours or longer at 250°.

recipes.title: Chicken Spaghetti
directions: Bake chicken, debone and cut into small pieces. cook noodles, drain. Combine remaining ingredients except cheese and place in 9x13 inch casserole. Sprinkle cheese on top and bake at 400 degrees for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Chicken Spaghetti. Bake chicken, debone and cut into small pieces. cook noodles, drain. Combine remaining ingredients except cheese and place in 9x13 inch casserole. Sprinkle cheese on top and bake at 400 degrees for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Banana Bread
ingredients: 1 c. smushed bananas (2 to 3 ripe bananas)
directions: In mixing bowl, combine and blend sugar and margarine.
Then add 1 egg at a time and blend.
In a separate bowl, blend dry ingredients.
Now blend all ingredients in one bowl and add bananas.
Pour mixture into a greased and floured bread pan.
Bake 30 to 40 minutes or until fork or toothpick comes out clean or until center springs back.
recipes.text: Banana Bread. In mixing bowl, combine and blend sugar and margarine. Then add 1 egg at a time and blend. In a separate bowl, blend dry ingredients. Now blend all ingredients in one bowl and add bananas. Pour mixture into a greased and floured bread pan. Bake 30 to 40 minutes or until fork or toothpick comes out clean or until center springs back.

recipes.title: Lemon Congealed Salad
ingredients: 1 (3 oz.) pkg. lemon flavored gelatin. Can use lime if desired.
directions: Heat milk and marshmallows in a medium saucepan over low heat, stirring until marshmallows melt.
Add gelatin, stir until dissolved.
Combine cream cheese, pineapple, and pecans.
Stir into gelatin mixture.
Let cool completely.
Beat whipping cream at medium speed until stiff peaks form.
Fold into cream cheese mixture.
Spoon into lightly greased dish.
Chill 6 hours.
recipes.text: Lemon Congealed Salad. Heat milk and marshmallows in a medium saucepan over low heat, stirring until marshmallows melt. Add gelatin, stir until dissolved. Combine cream cheese, pineapple, and pecans. Stir into gelatin mixture. Let cool completely. Beat whipping cream at medium speed until stiff peaks form. Fold into cream cheese mixture. Spoon into lightly greased dish. Chill 6 hours.

recipes.title: Modeling Candy
ingredients: 14 oz. candy disks (for melting, chocolate or color of your choice)
directions: Melt candy disks in double boiler or in microwave.
Heat corn syrup over low heat or in microwave until warm, but not hot.
Add corn syrup to melted candy and stir until thoroughly mixed.
Put mixture in an airtight plastic bag for at least 24 hours or up to one week.
Candy becomes easier to work with as it sets.
When ready to use, knead a small amount until it reaches a workable consistency.
(If it's too hard, warm first in microwave on Defrost only just until slightly softened.)
The heat from your hands will cause the candy to become like play dough.
Mold into edible flowers, fruits, whatever!
Candy will "set" again when cool.
recipes.text: Modeling Candy. Melt candy disks in double boiler or in microwave. Heat corn syrup over low heat or in microwave until warm, but not hot. Add corn syrup to melted candy and stir until thoroughly mixed. Put mixture in an airtight plastic bag for at least 24 hours or up to one week. Candy becomes easier to work with as it sets. When ready to use, knead a small amount until it reaches a workable consistency. (If it's too hard, warm first in microwave on Defrost only just until slightly softened.) The heat from your hands will cause the candy to become like play dough. Mold into edible flowers, fruits, whatever! Candy will "set" again when cool.

recipes.title: Rancho Roquefort Dressing
ingredients: 1/2 c. Roquefort or Bleu cheese, crumbled
directions: Blend all ingredients.
Let ripen several hours before serving.
recipes.text: Rancho Roquefort Dressing. Blend all ingredients. Let ripen several hours before serving.

recipes.title: Paris Puffs
directions: Grease muffin cups.
Mix first 3 ingredients.
Blend the flour, baking powder, salt and nutmeg together.
Add to fir mixture alternately with milk.
Fill cups 2/3 full and bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes.
Roll in melted butter and then in cinnamon and sugar.
recipes.text: Paris Puffs. Grease muffin cups. Mix first 3 ingredients. Blend the flour, baking powder, salt and nutmeg together. Add to fir mixture alternately with milk. Fill cups 2/3 full and bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes. Roll in melted butter and then in cinnamon and sugar.

recipes.title: Red Beans And Rice
directions: Put a little bit of boiling whater in a pot.
recipes.text: Red Beans And Rice. 1. Put a little bit of boiling whater in a pot.

recipes.title: Taco Tater Skins
directions: Bake potatoes at 375° for 1 hour or until tender.
Reduce heat to 350°.
When potatoes are cool enough to handle, cut lengthwise into quarters.
Scoop out pulp, leaving a 1/4 inch shell.
(Save pulp for another use.)
Combine the butter and taco seasoning; brush over both sides of potato skins.
Place skin side down on a greased baking sheet.
Sprinkle with cheese, crumbled bacon and green onions.
Return to oven and bake until cheese is melted, and lightly browned.
Serve with salsa and sour cream, if desired.
recipes.text: Taco Tater Skins. Bake potatoes at 375° for 1 hour or until tender. Reduce heat to 350°. When potatoes are cool enough to handle, cut lengthwise into quarters. Scoop out pulp, leaving a 1/4 inch shell. (Save pulp for another use.) Combine the butter and taco seasoning; brush over both sides of potato skins. Place skin side down on a greased baking sheet. Sprinkle with cheese, crumbled bacon and green onions. Return to oven and bake until cheese is melted, and lightly browned. Serve with salsa and sour cream, if desired.

recipes.title: Hot Chicken Salad
directions: Mix ingredients together.
Put in casserole dish and sprinkle more crushed chips on top.
Cook for 15 minutes at 350°.
recipes.text: Hot Chicken Salad. Mix ingredients together. Put in casserole dish and sprinkle more crushed chips on top. Cook for 15 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Sweet Bread Dough
directions: Combine sugar, salt, yeast and 2 cups flour.
In a 2-quart saucepan (low heat), heat milk and butter to 125°.
Using mixer on low, beat liquid into dry ingredients.
Increase speed to medium and beat 2 more minutes.
Scrape bowl often.
Beat in eggs and 2 cups flour.
Beat 2 more minutes.
With spoon, add enough flour to make a soft dough (4 1/2 cups).
recipes.text: Sweet Bread Dough. Combine sugar, salt, yeast and 2 cups flour. In a 2-quart saucepan (low heat), heat milk and butter to 125°. Using mixer on low, beat liquid into dry ingredients. Increase speed to medium and beat 2 more minutes. Scrape bowl often. Beat in eggs and 2 cups flour. Beat 2 more minutes. With spoon, add enough flour to make a soft dough (4 1/2 cups).

recipes.title: Hamburger Cheese Casserole
ingredients: 1 can Golden cream of mushroom soup
directions: Brown hamburger, then add onion and green pepper.
Cook until tender.
Add mushrooms (with juice), chopped olives, soups and 1/2 soup can of water.
Simmer for 10 minutes.
Cook noodles and melt cheeses.
Put meat mixture in large bowl and add all cheeses and pimentos.
Mix well.
Add noodles and mix until well blended. Place in casserole dish (with cover).
Cover and bake in 350° oven for 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Hamburger Cheese Casserole. Brown hamburger, then add onion and green pepper. Cook until tender. Add mushrooms (with juice), chopped olives, soups and 1/2 soup can of water. Simmer for 10 minutes. Cook noodles and melt cheeses. Put meat mixture in large bowl and add all cheeses and pimentos. Mix well. Add noodles and mix until well blended. Place in casserole dish (with cover). Cover and bake in 350° oven for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Southwest Chili Rellenos With Sweet Pepper And Onion Sauce(Serves Six)
ingredients: 1 c. fresh or frozen, thawed whole kernel corn
3 c. shredded cooked chicken breast meat
10 to 12 fresh green chili peppers (without skins)
directions: Saute celery, corn and garlic in oil in medium skillet 3 to 5 minutes.
Stir in chicken and cok 5 minutes; remove from heat and stir in cheese.
Season to taste with salt, pepper and chili seasoning.
recipes.text: Southwest Chili Rellenos With Sweet Pepper And Onion Sauce(Serves Six). Saute celery, corn and garlic in oil in medium skillet 3 to 5 minutes. Stir in chicken and cok 5 minutes; remove from heat and stir in cheese. Season to taste with salt, pepper and chili seasoning.

recipes.title: Good Stuff Banana Pudding
directions: Mix pudding as directed on box. Add sour cream and Cool Whip to pudding and mix together well. Layer in large bowl the vanilla wafers, sliced bananas and then pudding mixture. Continue layers until all pudding mixture is used. You can crush wafers and sprinkle on top if you like.
recipes.text: Good Stuff Banana Pudding. Mix pudding as directed on box. Add sour cream and Cool Whip to pudding and mix together well. Layer in large bowl the vanilla wafers, sliced bananas and then pudding mixture. Continue layers until all pudding mixture is used. You can crush wafers and sprinkle on top if you like.

recipes.title: Herbed Spinach Bake (Or Broccoli)
ingredients: 10 oz. spinach or broccoli, cooked and drained
directions: Combine all ingredients together and bake in a 9-inch square dish at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes or until knife inserted into dish comes out clean.
recipes.text: Herbed Spinach Bake (Or Broccoli). Combine all ingredients together and bake in a 9-inch square dish at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes or until knife inserted into dish comes out clean.

recipes.title: Mexican Cornbread
directions: Mix all ingredients together.
Stir well.
Bake in greased muffin pans or a 9 x 13-inch pan at 350° until done.
recipes.text: Mexican Cornbread. Mix all ingredients together. Stir well. Bake in greased muffin pans or a 9 x 13-inch pan at 350° until done.

recipes.title: Day Before Breakfast
ingredients: 2 slices white bread, cubed (enough to cover bottom of 9 x 13-inch baking dish)
directions: Saute sausage; drain.
Beat eggs with milk and salt.
Layer bread cubes, sausage and cheese in dish.
Pour egg mixture on top. Refrigerate overnight.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Day Before Breakfast. Saute sausage; drain. Beat eggs with milk and salt. Layer bread cubes, sausage and cheese in dish. Pour egg mixture on top. Refrigerate overnight. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Onion Pie
directions: Make a crust of crushed crackers and 1/2 cup melted butter. Put in 10-inch pie plate or similar low dish.
Saute until golden brown the onions in 1/4 cup butter.
Put on top of cracker crumbs in shallow casserole.
Sprinkle on top of onions grated sharp Cheddar cheese.
(This may be fixed hours ahead of time.)
recipes.text: Onion Pie. Make a crust of crushed crackers and 1/2 cup melted butter. Put in 10-inch pie plate or similar low dish. Saute until golden brown the onions in 1/4 cup butter. Put on top of cracker crumbs in shallow casserole. Sprinkle on top of onions grated sharp Cheddar cheese. (This may be fixed hours ahead of time.)

recipes.title: Cashew Crunch Cookies
directions: Sift together flour, baking soda and cream of tartar. Cream together butter and gradually add brown sugar and white sugar; cream well. Blend in egg and vanilla; beat well. Add the dry ingredients gradually and mix thoroughly. Stir in nuts. Drop by rounded teaspoonfuls onto lightly greased baking sheets. Bake at 350° for 12 to 15 minutes or until golden brown. Makes 5 dozen.
recipes.text: Cashew Crunch Cookies. Sift together flour, baking soda and cream of tartar. Cream together butter and gradually add brown sugar and white sugar; cream well. Blend in egg and vanilla; beat well. Add the dry ingredients gradually and mix thoroughly. Stir in nuts. Drop by rounded teaspoonfuls onto lightly greased baking sheets. Bake at 350° for 12 to 15 minutes or until golden brown. Makes 5 dozen.

recipes.title: Turtle Cake
directions: Mix cake mix as instructed.
Pour out half of it into a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Bake for 15 minutes at 350°.
Melt together caramels, butter and milk.
Pour over cake.
Sprinkle with half a bag of chocolate chips.
Pour rest of batter and bake for 15 minutes.
Sprinkle rest of chocolate chips on hot cake.
Spread.
recipes.text: Turtle Cake. Mix cake mix as instructed. Pour out half of it into a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake for 15 minutes at 350°. Melt together caramels, butter and milk. Pour over cake. Sprinkle with half a bag of chocolate chips. Pour rest of batter and bake for 15 minutes. Sprinkle rest of chocolate chips on hot cake. Spread.

recipes.title: Blond Brownies
ingredients: 1 can Eagle Brand sweetened condensed milk
directions: Mix together and bake in greased pan for 25 minutes at 350°.
recipes.text: Blond Brownies. Mix together and bake in greased pan for 25 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Cookie Cutter Cookies
ingredients: 1/2 c. or 1 stick softened butter or margarine
cooking spray or extra butter (for greasing cookie sheet)
directions: You will also need 4 to 6 cookie cutters of your choice.
recipes.text: Cookie Cutter Cookies. You will also need 4 to 6 cookie cutters of your choice.

recipes.title: Happy Day Cake Or "Best Two Egg Cake"
directions: Stir shortening to soften.
Gradually add sugar and cream thoroughly.
Add vanilla.
Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each.
Sift flour with baking powder and salt; add to cream mixture alternately with milk, beating after each addition.
Bake in two 9 x 1 1/2-inch round pans in moderate oven (375°) for about 23 minutes.
recipes.text: Happy Day Cake Or "Best Two Egg Cake". Stir shortening to soften. Gradually add sugar and cream thoroughly. Add vanilla. Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each. Sift flour with baking powder and salt; add to cream mixture alternately with milk, beating after each addition. Bake in two 9 x 1 1/2-inch round pans in moderate oven (375°) for about 23 minutes.

recipes.title: Mexican Corn Casserole
directions: Combine oil, corn, garlic, eggs and cornmeal.
Spread 1/2 of mixture in 2-quart casserole dish.
Top with 1/2 chilies and cheese.
Repeat layers.
Bake at 350° for 50 to 60 minutes.
recipes.text: Mexican Corn Casserole. Combine oil, corn, garlic, eggs and cornmeal. Spread 1/2 of mixture in 2-quart casserole dish. Top with 1/2 chilies and cheese. Repeat layers. Bake at 350° for 50 to 60 minutes.

recipes.title: A-B-C Casserole
ingredients: 1 (15 oz.) can cut asparagus spears, drained
directions: Cook broccoli and cauliflower according to package directions.
Drain.
Combine asparagus, water chestnuts, cheese and soup in bowl; mix well.
Spoon into greased 6 x 9-inch dish. Dot with melted margarine; sprinkle with crumbs.
Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.
Yield:
6 servings.
recipes.text: A-B-C Casserole. Cook broccoli and cauliflower according to package directions. Drain. Combine asparagus, water chestnuts, cheese and soup in bowl; mix well. Spoon into greased 6 x 9-inch dish. Dot with melted margarine; sprinkle with crumbs. Bake at 350° for 20 minutes. Yield: 6 servings.

recipes.title: Caribbean Chicken
ingredients: 12 chicken thighs, skin and fat removed
directions: In large frying pan, cook chicken parts in oil until lightly browned, turning once.
Add onion; stir until cooked.
Mix broth, curry powder, lemon juice and salt.
Pour over chicken; cover and simmer 25 minutes.
Turn chicken once.
Increase temperature; stir in pepper and pineapple.
Cook 5 minutes.
Stir in bananas. Remove chicken to a heated serving platter.
In a small bowl, mix rum and cornstarch until smooth.
Stir in remaining sauce.
Cook until thickened; pour over chicken.
Sprinkle with cashews.
Serve over rice.
Serves 6.
recipes.text: Caribbean Chicken. In large frying pan, cook chicken parts in oil until lightly browned, turning once. Add onion; stir until cooked. Mix broth, curry powder, lemon juice and salt. Pour over chicken; cover and simmer 25 minutes. Turn chicken once. Increase temperature; stir in pepper and pineapple. Cook 5 minutes. Stir in bananas. Remove chicken to a heated serving platter. In a small bowl, mix rum and cornstarch until smooth. Stir in remaining sauce. Cook until thickened; pour over chicken. Sprinkle with cashews. Serve over rice. Serves 6.

recipes.title: Toffee-Nut Bars
directions: Mix shortening and brown sugar. Stir in flour. Bake at 350° for 10 minutes. Combine remaining ingredients. Spread over first mixture. Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.
recipes.text: Toffee-Nut Bars. Mix shortening and brown sugar. Stir in flour. Bake at 350° for 10 minutes. Combine remaining ingredients. Spread over first mixture. Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Coconut Pineapple Chess Pie
directions: Cream oleo and sugar. Add eggs, flour, meal, coconut, vanilla and pineapple; mix well. Pour into a deep dish pie crust. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Coconut Pineapple Chess Pie. Cream oleo and sugar. Add eggs, flour, meal, coconut, vanilla and pineapple; mix well. Pour into a deep dish pie crust. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Gift Of The Magi Bread
ingredients: 1 (11 oz.) can mandarin orange segments, drained
directions: Preheat oven to 350°.
Cream butter or margarine with granulated sugar.
Add eggs and vanilla.
Sift flour with baking soda and salt.
Add alternately with bananas.
Stir in mandarin oranges, chocolate chips, coconut, 1/2
cup sliced almonds, cherries, and figs.
Pour into 2 greased 7 1/2 x 3 3/4 inch loaf pans.
Sprinkle remaining sliced almonds over tops.
Bake 1 to 1 1/4 hours.
When cool, sieve confectioners
sugar over tops.
recipes.text: Gift Of The Magi Bread. Preheat oven to 350°. Cream butter or margarine with granulated sugar. Add eggs and vanilla. Sift flour with baking soda and salt. Add alternately with bananas. Stir in mandarin oranges, chocolate chips, coconut, 1/2 cup sliced almonds, cherries, and figs. Pour into 2 greased 7 1/2 x 3 3/4 inch loaf pans. Sprinkle remaining sliced almonds over tops. Bake 1 to 1 1/4 hours. When cool, sieve confectioners sugar over tops.

recipes.title: Breakfast Cake (Cinnamon Flops)
directions: Mix all ingredients together.
Pour in pan and put lumps of butter the size of peas over cake.
Sprinkle 1 cup brown sugar and cinnamon over cake.
Bake at 350° about 1/2 hour.
recipes.text: Breakfast Cake (Cinnamon Flops). Mix all ingredients together. Pour in pan and put lumps of butter the size of peas over cake. Sprinkle 1 cup brown sugar and cinnamon over cake. Bake at 350° about 1/2 hour.

recipes.title: Began Bharta(North Indian Eggplant Dish)
ingredients: 2 large tomatoes, finely chopped or thinly sliced
1 small piece ginger root, chopped or grated
freshly ground black pepper to taste
directions: Preheat oven to 400°.
Rinse eggplant dry; slice in half lengthwise.
Place halves on foil covered oven rack.
Roast for 40 to 50 minutes.
When the eggplant is done the outside skin will appear charred.
Set aside to cool, then scoop out the flesh from the charred shell.
recipes.text: Began Bharta(North Indian Eggplant Dish). Preheat oven to 400°. Rinse eggplant dry; slice in half lengthwise. Place halves on foil covered oven rack. Roast for 40 to 50 minutes. When the eggplant is done the outside skin will appear charred. Set aside to cool, then scoop out the flesh from the charred shell.

recipes.title: Quick Cheese Bread
directions: Mix Bismix and water together; beat until smooth.
Add remaining ingredients except 1/2 cup cheese and butter.
Mix well; pour into greased loaf pan.
Sprinkle with cheese and butter.
Bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Quick Cheese Bread. Mix Bismix and water together; beat until smooth. Add remaining ingredients except 1/2 cup cheese and butter. Mix well; pour into greased loaf pan. Sprinkle with cheese and butter. Bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Peanut Brittle
ingredients: 2 3/4 c. raw Spanish peanuts or 16 oz. pkg.
directions: Oil a large platter or cookie sheets.
Combine sugar, Karo and water in heavy pan.
Stir until dissolved.
Bring to boil and wash sides of pan down; wash all sugar that sticks to sides of pan. Add peanuts when mixture reaches soft ball stage (235°).
When mixture begins to boil again start stirring.
Cook to hard crack stage (310°) and add soda, salt, butter and then vanilla and coconut.
Remove from heat first and stir well.
Spread as thin as possible on greased platter.
Run knife under brittle as soon as possible to let air beneath candy and platter.
As soon as candy is hard enough to handle, stretch in all directions.
recipes.text: Peanut Brittle. Oil a large platter or cookie sheets. Combine sugar, Karo and water in heavy pan. Stir until dissolved. Bring to boil and wash sides of pan down; wash all sugar that sticks to sides of pan. Add peanuts when mixture reaches soft ball stage (235°). When mixture begins to boil again start stirring. Cook to hard crack stage (310°) and add soda, salt, butter and then vanilla and coconut. Remove from heat first and stir well. Spread as thin as possible on greased platter. Run knife under brittle as soon as possible to let air beneath candy and platter. As soon as candy is hard enough to handle, stretch in all directions.

recipes.title: Citrus Pie
ingredients: 2 c. frozen vanilla yogurt or ice cream
directions: Whip orange
juice,
yogurt or ice cream, Cool Whip and orange extract together.
Fold mandarin oranges into mixture. Pour into pie crust and freeze until firm.
Serves 6.
recipes.text: Citrus Pie. Whip orange juice, yogurt or ice cream, Cool Whip and orange extract together. Fold mandarin oranges into mixture. Pour into pie crust and freeze until firm. Serves 6.

recipes.title: Peppers Stuffed With Sausage
directions: Wash peppers and remove seeds.
Boil for 5 minutes in water to cover.
Remove from water and fill with the meat, rice, salt and strained tomatoes which have been mixed together.
Place in baking dish, add the boiling water and bake at 400° for 1 hour.
Yields 6 servings.
recipes.text: Peppers Stuffed With Sausage. Wash peppers and remove seeds. Boil for 5 minutes in water to cover. Remove from water and fill with the meat, rice, salt and strained tomatoes which have been mixed together. Place in baking dish, add the boiling water and bake at 400° for 1 hour. Yields 6 servings.

recipes.title: Rice Noodle Casserole
ingredients: 1 can drained chopped water chestnuts or slivered almonds
directions: Melt butter, crumble noodles into it and brown for a few minutes.
Add all other ingredients.
Bake at 350 for about 45 minutes to an hour.
recipes.text: Rice Noodle Casserole. Melt butter, crumble noodles into it and brown for a few minutes. Add all other ingredients. Bake at 350 for about 45 minutes to an hour.

recipes.title: Sparkling Pineapple Drink
ingredients: strawberries, lime slices or pineapple chunks (for garnish)
directions: Fill each of 6 glasses 2/3 full of pineapple juice.
Add club soda or seltzer and ice cubes.
Garnish with strawberries, lime slices or pineapple chunks.
recipes.text: Sparkling Pineapple Drink. Fill each of 6 glasses 2/3 full of pineapple juice. Add club soda or seltzer and ice cubes. Garnish with strawberries, lime slices or pineapple chunks.

recipes.title: Graham Cracker Cake
ingredients: 24 graham crackers, rolled fine or 2 1/3 c. crumbs
directions: Cream sugar and margarine.
Add egg yolks.
Mix graham cracker crumbs with baking powder and salt.
Add alternately with milk. Fold in egg whites, stiffly beaten, last.
recipes.text: Graham Cracker Cake. Cream sugar and margarine. Add egg yolks. Mix graham cracker crumbs with baking powder and salt. Add alternately with milk. Fold in egg whites, stiffly beaten, last.

recipes.title: M&M Monster Cookies
directions: Cream all ingredients except M&M's and chips.
Scoop cookies out with ice cream dipper.
Making a firm ball, place on cookie sheet.
Bake 5 minutes, then put more M&M's on top.
Bake 7 to 10 minutes more.
recipes.text: M&M Monster Cookies. Cream all ingredients except M&M's and chips. Scoop cookies out with ice cream dipper. Making a firm ball, place on cookie sheet. Bake 5 minutes, then put more M&M's on top. Bake 7 to 10 minutes more.

recipes.title: Surprise Snowballs
ingredients: 1 c. finely chopped walnuts (9 oz. pkg.)
directions: Beat oleo, sugar and vanilla until light and fluffy.
Add flour and nuts; blend well.
Chill dough.
Remove foil from Kisses. Shape dough around Kisses using 1 tablespoon dough for each.
Roll to make a ball.
Be sure to cover Kiss completely.
Place on ungreased cookie sheet.
Bake in 375° oven for 12 minutes or until set but not browned.
Cool slightly.
Remove carefully to wire rack.
While still warm, sprinkle top with confectioners sugar.
(I put wax paper under the wire racks, put the sugar in a small sieve and shake on the cookies.
Makes them look like the snow fell on them.
Then I save the sugar from the wax paper.)
Store in tightly covered container.
Makes about 50 cookies.
recipes.text: Surprise Snowballs. Beat oleo, sugar and vanilla until light and fluffy. Add flour and nuts; blend well. Chill dough. Remove foil from Kisses. Shape dough around Kisses using 1 tablespoon dough for each. Roll to make a ball. Be sure to cover Kiss completely. Place on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake in 375° oven for 12 minutes or until set but not browned. Cool slightly. Remove carefully to wire rack. While still warm, sprinkle top with confectioners sugar. (I put wax paper under the wire racks, put the sugar in a small sieve and shake on the cookies. Makes them look like the snow fell on them. Then I save the sugar from the wax paper.) Store in tightly covered container. Makes about 50 cookies.

recipes.title: Corn Salad
ingredients: 2 (12 oz.) cans Shoe Peg corn, drained
directions: Mix all vegetables. Combine other ingredients and pour over vegetables.
Cover and refrigerate overnight.
Good with barbecue.
recipes.text: Corn Salad. Mix all vegetables. Combine other ingredients and pour over vegetables. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Good with barbecue.

recipes.title: Strawberry Cake
directions: Put all ingredients together in mixing bowl and beat lightly. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
May be baked in 2 pans and stacked or in 1 long pan.
recipes.text: Strawberry Cake. Put all ingredients together in mixing bowl and beat lightly. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes. May be baked in 2 pans and stacked or in 1 long pan.

recipes.title: Frozen Coconut Pie
ingredients: 1 (3 oz.) pkg. Philadelphia Brand cream cheese, softened
1 (8 oz.) tub Cool Whip extra creamy whipped topping, thawed
1 prepared graham cracker crumb crust (6 oz.)
directions: Beat the cream cheese and sugar in a large bowl.
Gradually add milk; beat until smooth.
Stir in coconut, whipped topping and vanilla.
Spoon into crust.
Freeze for 4 hours or until firm. Garnish with toasted coconut and maraschino cherries, if desired. Let stand at room temperature for 15 minutes, or until pie can be cut easily.
Store leftover pie in freezer.
Makes 8 servings.
recipes.text: Frozen Coconut Pie. Beat the cream cheese and sugar in a large bowl. Gradually add milk; beat until smooth. Stir in coconut, whipped topping and vanilla. Spoon into crust. Freeze for 4 hours or until firm. Garnish with toasted coconut and maraschino cherries, if desired. Let stand at room temperature for 15 minutes, or until pie can be cut easily. Store leftover pie in freezer. Makes 8 servings.

recipes.title: Tortilla Roll-Ups
ingredients: 1/2 tsp. garlic salt or garlic powder
2 to 3 jalapenos, chopped and seeds removed
directions: Mix together all ingredients, except flour tortillas.
Spread this mixture on each flour tortilla; roll up tightly and place in airtight container.
Or, you can wrap each roll up in foil or plastic wrap.
Put in refrigerator at least 3 hours before serving.
(They are better if refrigerated overnight.)
recipes.text: Tortilla Roll-Ups. Mix together all ingredients, except flour tortillas. Spread this mixture on each flour tortilla; roll up tightly and place in airtight container. Or, you can wrap each roll up in foil or plastic wrap. Put in refrigerator at least 3 hours before serving. (They are better if refrigerated overnight.)

recipes.title: Vegetable Casserole
directions: Combine first 5 ingredients. Top with crackers and melted butter. Bake at 325° for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Vegetable Casserole. Combine first 5 ingredients. Top with crackers and melted butter. Bake at 325° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Graham Cracker Crust
directions: Mix all together and line pie pan.
recipes.text: Graham Cracker Crust. Mix all together and line pie pan.

recipes.title: Can'T Believe It'S A Cookie
directions: Stir together the 3 ingredients until mixed.
Drop by spoonful into greased cookie sheet; flatten with fork.
Bake at 350° for 12 to 15 minutes.
Wait 5 minutes before you remove from sheet.
recipes.text: Can'T Believe It'S A Cookie. Stir together the 3 ingredients until mixed. Drop by spoonful into greased cookie sheet; flatten with fork. Bake at 350° for 12 to 15 minutes. Wait 5 minutes before you remove from sheet.

recipes.title: Zucchini Bread
directions: Preheat oven to 350°. Grease bottom only of 9 x 5 x 3 loaf pan. Beat all ingredients on low speed scraping bowl constantly for 30 seconds. Beat on medium speed, scraping bowl, one minute. Pour into loaf pan, bake until wooden pick inserted in center comes out clean, about 55 minutes. Cool 10 minutes, remove from pan. Cool completely before slicing. Store in refrigerator.
recipes.text: Zucchini Bread. Preheat oven to 350°. Grease bottom only of 9 x 5 x 3 loaf pan. Beat all ingredients on low speed scraping bowl constantly for 30 seconds. Beat on medium speed, scraping bowl, one minute. Pour into loaf pan, bake until wooden pick inserted in center comes out clean, about 55 minutes. Cool 10 minutes, remove from pan. Cool completely before slicing. Store in refrigerator.

recipes.title: Tasty Dried Beef Casserole
ingredients: 10 1/2 oz. can condensed cream of chicken soup
directions: Melt butter in saucepan; add onion and green pepper. Cook until tender, about 5 minutes. Cut dried beef into small pieces; add to onion mixture and continue cooking until beef is slightly browned. Stir in soup, milk, pepper and paprika. Heat to boiling. Cook macaroni, using unsalted water. Drain, then rinse with cold water and drain again.
Combine macaroni with dried beef sauce. Pour into 1 1/2-quart casserole dish. Sprinkle with cheese. Bake, uncovered, in 350° oven 20 to 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Tasty Dried Beef Casserole. Melt butter in saucepan; add onion and green pepper. Cook until tender, about 5 minutes. Cut dried beef into small pieces; add to onion mixture and continue cooking until beef is slightly browned. Stir in soup, milk, pepper and paprika. Heat to boiling. Cook macaroni, using unsalted water. Drain, then rinse with cold water and drain again. Combine macaroni with dried beef sauce. Pour into 1 1/2-quart casserole dish. Sprinkle with cheese. Bake, uncovered, in 350° oven 20 to 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Cod A La Spetse
ingredients: 1/4 c. dry white wine or water
directions: Brush 1 tablespoon of oil in the bottom of a shallow baking dish large enough to accommodate the fish in one layer with space in between.
Mix remaining oil with wine, parsley, lemon juice, garlic, salt and pepper.
Sprinkle diced tomato over fish and pour on the oil-wine mixture.
Sprinkle with bread crumbs.
Bake at 350° for about 40 minutes or until fish flakes when probed with a fork.
recipes.text: Cod A La Spetse. Brush 1 tablespoon of oil in the bottom of a shallow baking dish large enough to accommodate the fish in one layer with space in between. Mix remaining oil with wine, parsley, lemon juice, garlic, salt and pepper. Sprinkle diced tomato over fish and pour on the oil-wine mixture. Sprinkle with bread crumbs. Bake at 350° for about 40 minutes or until fish flakes when probed with a fork.

recipes.title: Cranberry Salad
directions: Chop in food chopper the cranberries, orange, pecans and pineapple.
Add sugar; let set 1 to 2 hours.
Add gelatine to cold water.
Set for 15 minutes.
Mix raspberry gelatin and boiling water.
Add all together and pour in dish.
Refrigerate and let set.
recipes.text: Cranberry Salad. Chop in food chopper the cranberries, orange, pecans and pineapple. Add sugar; let set 1 to 2 hours. Add gelatine to cold water. Set for 15 minutes. Mix raspberry gelatin and boiling water. Add all together and pour in dish. Refrigerate and let set.

recipes.title: Chicken Salad
ingredients: 2 whole chicken breasts, cooked, skinned, boned and cubed
1/4 to 1/2 c. slivered almonds, sauteed in 1 to 2 Tbsp. butter
directions: Toss all salad ingredients (except almonds and tomatoes) together with enough mayonnaise to obtain desired consistency. Taste:
Add more seasoning salt if necessary.
Cover and refrigerate.
Serve on lettuce; garnish with toasted almonds and tomato wedges.
Can top each scoop of chicken salad with alfalfa sprouts.
recipes.text: Chicken Salad. Toss all salad ingredients (except almonds and tomatoes) together with enough mayonnaise to obtain desired consistency. Taste: Add more seasoning salt if necessary. Cover and refrigerate. Serve on lettuce; garnish with toasted almonds and tomato wedges. Can top each scoop of chicken salad with alfalfa sprouts.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Cookies
directions: Cream shortening, sugar, eggs and vanilla.
Stir in peanut butter.
Sift together dry ingredients.
Stir into creamed mixture.
Drop by rounded teaspoons on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 350° for 10 minutes.
Makes 5 dozen.
recipes.text: Peanut Butter Cookies. Cream shortening, sugar, eggs and vanilla. Stir in peanut butter. Sift together dry ingredients. Stir into creamed mixture. Drop by rounded teaspoons on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 350° for 10 minutes. Makes 5 dozen.

recipes.title: Layered Chip Dip
directions: First Layer:
Mix beans with 1/2 package of taco seasoning.
recipes.text: Layered Chip Dip. First Layer: Mix beans with 1/2 package of taco seasoning.

recipes.title: Pina Colada Cake
ingredients: 1 can crushed pineapple, drained, save juice
directions: Spread oleo, brown sugar, pineapple and pie filling in 9 x 15-inch pan.
Make yellow cake following directions on box except use juice from pineapple and the pina colada mix for liquid (add water to make the difference).
Bake as directed.
Let stand 5 minutes, then turn out upside down on tray.
Serves 15.
recipes.text: Pina Colada Cake. Spread oleo, brown sugar, pineapple and pie filling in 9 x 15-inch pan. Make yellow cake following directions on box except use juice from pineapple and the pina colada mix for liquid (add water to make the difference). Bake as directed. Let stand 5 minutes, then turn out upside down on tray. Serves 15.

recipes.title: Mexican Salad Toss
ingredients: 1 (8 oz.) jar Cheez Whiz pasteurized process cheese spread
1 (12 oz.) can whole kernel corn with sweet peppers, drained
directions: Combine process cheese spread and sour cream.
Add onion and chili powder; mix well.
Chill.
Combine greens, chips, corn, tomato, avocado and bacon; toss lightly.
Serve with dressing. Makes 8 servings.
ner: whole kernel corn with sweet peppers
recipes.text: Mexican Salad Toss. Combine process cheese spread and sour cream. Add onion and chili powder; mix well. Chill. Combine greens, chips, corn, tomato, avocado and bacon; toss lightly. Serve with dressing. Makes 8 servings.

recipes.title: Egg Beaters
ingredients: couple of drops yellow food coloring
directions: Blend in blender real well.
One-fourth cup is equal to 1 egg for baking.
Will keep in refrigerator for a week.
recipes.text: Egg Beaters. Blend in blender real well. One-fourth cup is equal to 1 egg for baking. Will keep in refrigerator for a week.

recipes.title: Chicken A La King(Makes 4 Servings)
directions: Melt butter in saucepan; add flour.
Cut up chicken and cook. Add all ingredients into saucepan.
Cook for 20 minutes.
Serve over rice.
recipes.text: Chicken A La King(Makes 4 Servings). Melt butter in saucepan; add flour. Cut up chicken and cook. Add all ingredients into saucepan. Cook for 20 minutes. Serve over rice.

recipes.title: Ginger Pickles
directions: Slice the cukes thin and cover with cold water in which the salt has been dissolved to 1 gallon of water. Soak 8 days. Drain and rinse in cold water.

Add the alum to cukes. Cover with water and boil 1/2 hour. Drain and cover with water. Add the ginger and boil 1/2 hour. Drain and add the remaining ingredients. Boil until clear, about 1/2 hour. Can.
recipes.text: Ginger Pickles. Slice the cukes thin and cover with cold water in which the salt has been dissolved to 1 gallon of water. Soak 8 days. Drain and rinse in cold water. Add the alum to cukes. Cover with water and boil 1/2 hour. Drain and cover with water. Add the ginger and boil 1/2 hour. Drain and add the remaining ingredients. Boil until clear, about 1/2 hour. Can.

recipes.title: Annette'S Little Pies
directions: Melt butter in a 9 x 13-inch glass baking dish.
Roll biscuits out, one at a time, and fill with apple and turn over like a fried pie.
Place in melted butter.
Pour 7-Up over pies and sprinkle with brown sugar.
Bake in oven until golden brown.
recipes.text: Annette'S Little Pies. Melt butter in a 9 x 13-inch glass baking dish. Roll biscuits out, one at a time, and fill with apple and turn over like a fried pie. Place in melted butter. Pour 7-Up over pies and sprinkle with brown sugar. Bake in oven until golden brown.

recipes.title: Sauerkraut Salad
directions: Place sauerkraut in strainer.
Wash with cold water and drain well.
Combine kraut, onion, celery, pepper and pimentos in large bowl.
Mix well.
recipes.text: Sauerkraut Salad. Place sauerkraut in strainer. Wash with cold water and drain well. Combine kraut, onion, celery, pepper and pimentos in large bowl. Mix well.

recipes.title: Punch Bowl Cake
ingredients: small amount of nuts for garnish
small amount of shredded coconut for garnish
directions: Make cake as directed on box; cool.
Mix pudding as directed on box and cool.
Place half of cake on the bottom of a large bowl (glass punch bowl works best), then add 1/2 of pudding, 1/2 of cherry pie filling, 1/2 of blueberries, 1/2 of sliced bananas and 1/2 of Cool Whip.
Repeat with remaining ingredients and garnish.
recipes.text: Punch Bowl Cake. Make cake as directed on box; cool. Mix pudding as directed on box and cool. Place half of cake on the bottom of a large bowl (glass punch bowl works best), then add 1/2 of pudding, 1/2 of cherry pie filling, 1/2 of blueberries, 1/2 of sliced bananas and 1/2 of Cool Whip. Repeat with remaining ingredients and garnish.

recipes.title: Shrimply Divine Dip
ingredients: 1 (5/8 oz.) pkg. Good Seasons Italian salad dressing mix
1/2 c. finely chopped shrimp (3 oz. can)
directions: Add sour cream to cream cheese gradually, blending thoroughly. Add other ingredients and blend well.
Chill at least 1 hour before serving.
Makes 1 2/3 cups dip.
recipes.text: Shrimply Divine Dip. Add sour cream to cream cheese gradually, blending thoroughly. Add other ingredients and blend well. Chill at least 1 hour before serving. Makes 1 2/3 cups dip.

recipes.title: Banana Bread
ingredients: 1/4 c. sour milk (add 1 tsp. vinegar to milk)
directions: Blend the first 3 ingredients.
Add remaining ingredients. Bake in greased and floured loaf pan at 375° for 3/4 to 1 hour or until cake leaves sides of pan.
recipes.text: Banana Bread. Blend the first 3 ingredients. Add remaining ingredients. Bake in greased and floured loaf pan at 375° for 3/4 to 1 hour or until cake leaves sides of pan.

recipes.title: Potato Chip Cookies
directions: Beat the butter until very fluffy.
Add sugar very slowly and beat.
Add flour very slowly and by small amounts.
Keep on beating very good.
Add potato chips and blend by hand.
Drop by teaspoon on ungreased cookie sheet.
Cookies should be the size of a walnut.
Bake at 350° for 10 to 12 minutes.
When cool, dust with powdered sugar.
recipes.text: Potato Chip Cookies. Beat the butter until very fluffy. Add sugar very slowly and beat. Add flour very slowly and by small amounts. Keep on beating very good. Add potato chips and blend by hand. Drop by teaspoon on ungreased cookie sheet. Cookies should be the size of a walnut. Bake at 350° for 10 to 12 minutes. When cool, dust with powdered sugar.

recipes.title: Baked Corn
directions: Saute onions
and pepper in butter.
Mix in sour cream; set aside.
Mix all other ingredients and pour into 8 x 8-inch casserole dish.
Pour
sour
cream mixture on top and sprinkle with grated cheese.
Bake at 400° for 40 minutes.
recipes.text: Baked Corn. Saute onions and pepper in butter. Mix in sour cream; set aside. Mix all other ingredients and pour into 8 x 8-inch casserole dish. Pour sour cream mixture on top and sprinkle with grated cheese. Bake at 400° for 40 minutes.

recipes.title: No Bake Cookies
ingredients: 2 c. sugar (cane sugar makes the end product more creamy)
1/2 c. peanut butter or flaked coconut
directions: Melt butter.
Add sugar and cocoa and mash together.
Add milk.
Stir well, then bring to a rolling boil for
1 minute. Take off stove and add remaining ingredients.
Stir as you add this last group of ingredients.
Drop by teaspoonfuls onto waxed paper.
recipes.text: No Bake Cookies. Melt butter. Add sugar and cocoa and mash together. Add milk. Stir well, then bring to a rolling boil for 1 minute. Take off stove and add remaining ingredients. Stir as you add this last group of ingredients. Drop by teaspoonfuls onto waxed paper.

recipes.title: Easy Chicken Pie
directions: Take chicken off bones and put in bottom of flat 3-quart casserole dish.
Mix soup and water and pour over chicken.
Mix flour, milk and margarine and spread over soup and chicken.
Do not stir.
Pour 2 cups of chicken broth on top; do not stir. Bake at 350° until done, about 45 to 50 minutes.
recipes.text: Easy Chicken Pie. Take chicken off bones and put in bottom of flat 3-quart casserole dish. Mix soup and water and pour over chicken. Mix flour, milk and margarine and spread over soup and chicken. Do not stir. Pour 2 cups of chicken broth on top; do not stir. Bake at 350° until done, about 45 to 50 minutes.

recipes.title: Creamy Cheddar Corn And Broccoli
ingredients: 1 (17 oz.) can whole kernel corn, drained
directions: In a large saucepan, cook onion in margarine until tender. Stir in remaining ingredients.
Cook for 10 minutes or until heated through, stirring occasionally.
recipes.text: Creamy Cheddar Corn And Broccoli. In a large saucepan, cook onion in margarine until tender. Stir in remaining ingredients. Cook for 10 minutes or until heated through, stirring occasionally.

recipes.title: Sour Cream Corn Bread
directions: Mix all ingredients well and bake at 350° for 40 to 50 minutes until firm in center.
recipes.text: Sour Cream Corn Bread. Mix all ingredients well and bake at 350° for 40 to 50 minutes until firm in center.

recipes.title: Pina Colada Cake
directions: Pour oil into 9 x 13-inch pan.
In a bowl, combine cake mix, eggs, water and 1 cup coconut; beat until smooth.
Mix in oil from pan, then pour mixture back in pan.
Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.
Remove from oven and punch holes all over cake.
In a small bowl, beat cream of coconut several minutes, then pour over hot cake.
Refrigerate 1 hour.
Mix Cool Whip and remaining coconut.
Spread on cake.
Store in refrigerator overnight.
recipes.text: Pina Colada Cake. Pour oil into 9 x 13-inch pan. In a bowl, combine cake mix, eggs, water and 1 cup coconut; beat until smooth. Mix in oil from pan, then pour mixture back in pan. Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes. Remove from oven and punch holes all over cake. In a small bowl, beat cream of coconut several minutes, then pour over hot cake. Refrigerate 1 hour. Mix Cool Whip and remaining coconut. Spread on cake. Store in refrigerator overnight.

recipes.title: My Favorite Pumpkin Cookies
directions: Cream together sugar and shortening.
Add and mix well the pumpkin, egg and vanilla.
Add flour, baking powder, baking soda, salt, cinnamon and allspice.
Stir in nuts and/or raisins, if desired.
