recipes.text: My Favorite Pumpkin Cookies. Cream together sugar and shortening. Add and mix well the pumpkin, egg and vanilla. Add flour, baking powder, baking soda, salt, cinnamon and allspice. Stir in nuts and/or raisins, if desired.

recipes.title: Zucchini Pizza Appetizers
directions: Mix ingredients well.
Pour into 9 x 12-inch pan.
Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.
Cut into squares.
(Freeze, if desired.)
recipes.text: Zucchini Pizza Appetizers. Mix ingredients well. Pour into 9 x 12-inch pan. Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes. Cut into squares. (Freeze, if desired.)

recipes.title: Coffee Can Bread
directions: Thoroughly mix 1 1/2 cups flour, sugar, salt and yeast. Combine milk, water and margarine.
Heat until just warm.
Slowly add to dry ingredients and beat 2 minutes.
Add egg and 1 cup flour.
Beat 2 minutes.
Scrape bowl.
Add enough flour to make stiff batter.
Spoon into 2 well-greased coffee cans (1 pound size).
Cover with plastic lids.
Let rise until almost to top of can.
Remove lids and bake in 375° oven for 35 minutes.
Remove from cans and cool on rack on side.
recipes.text: Coffee Can Bread. Thoroughly mix 1 1/2 cups flour, sugar, salt and yeast. Combine milk, water and margarine. Heat until just warm. Slowly add to dry ingredients and beat 2 minutes. Add egg and 1 cup flour. Beat 2 minutes. Scrape bowl. Add enough flour to make stiff batter. Spoon into 2 well-greased coffee cans (1 pound size). Cover with plastic lids. Let rise until almost to top of can. Remove lids and bake in 375° oven for 35 minutes. Remove from cans and cool on rack on side.

recipes.title: Red Hot Salad
directions: Cook 1 cup water and candies on stove until candies dissolve. Remove and add jello; stir until dissolved.
Add 1 cup cold water. Stir.
Refrigerate until starts to set.
Add pineapple, celery, apples and nuts, if desired.
Refrigerate until set.
recipes.text: Red Hot Salad. Cook 1 cup water and candies on stove until candies dissolve. Remove and add jello; stir until dissolved. Add 1 cup cold water. Stir. Refrigerate until starts to set. Add pineapple, celery, apples and nuts, if desired. Refrigerate until set.

recipes.title: Scalloped Onions With Cheese
directions: Cook onions in boiling water until tender.
Drain well.
Place onions in 1-quart casserole dish.
Melt butter in saucepan.
Blend in flour and salt.
Add milk and cook over medium heat until mixture boils.
Stir in cheese and pepper.
Stir until cheese is melted.
Pour sauce over onions.
Bake uncovered at 350° for 40 minutes.
Serves 4 to 6.
recipes.text: Scalloped Onions With Cheese. Cook onions in boiling water until tender. Drain well. Place onions in 1-quart casserole dish. Melt butter in saucepan. Blend in flour and salt. Add milk and cook over medium heat until mixture boils. Stir in cheese and pepper. Stir until cheese is melted. Pour sauce over onions. Bake uncovered at 350° for 40 minutes. Serves 4 to 6.

recipes.title: Shrimp Or Tuna Salad
ingredients: 1 can tuna, drained or 1 c. shrimp, chopped
directions: Dilute gelatin in cold water.
Heat soup and add to gelatin. Mix cheese and mayonnaise until smooth.
Add to gelatin mixture. Add pepper, celery and meat.
Pour in casserole or ring mold. Chill.
recipes.text: Shrimp Or Tuna Salad. Dilute gelatin in cold water. Heat soup and add to gelatin. Mix cheese and mayonnaise until smooth. Add to gelatin mixture. Add pepper, celery and meat. Pour in casserole or ring mold. Chill.

recipes.title: Banana Muffins
ingredients: 2 Tbsp. vegetable oil or butter, melted
directions: Heat oven to 400°.
Grease bottoms only of 12 medium muffin cups or line with paper baking cups.
Beat eggs slightly.
Stir in remaining ingredients just until moistened.
Divide batter evenly among cups.
Bake until golden brown 15 to 17 minutes.
Makes 12 muffins.
recipes.text: Banana Muffins. Heat oven to 400°. Grease bottoms only of 12 medium muffin cups or line with paper baking cups. Beat eggs slightly. Stir in remaining ingredients just until moistened. Divide batter evenly among cups. Bake until golden brown 15 to 17 minutes. Makes 12 muffins.

recipes.title: Boiled Icing
directions: Reserve 2 tablespoons sugar.
Combine remaining sugar, water and corn syrup in a heavy pan.
Cook over medium heat, stirring to soft ball stage (240°).
Remove from heat.
Quickly beat egg whites and salt until soft peaks form, gradually add reserved sugar, beat until blended.
Continue to beat, slowly adding syrup mixture.
Add vanilla and beat until stiff peaks form and frosting is thick.
recipes.text: Boiled Icing. Reserve 2 tablespoons sugar. Combine remaining sugar, water and corn syrup in a heavy pan. Cook over medium heat, stirring to soft ball stage (240°). Remove from heat. Quickly beat egg whites and salt until soft peaks form, gradually add reserved sugar, beat until blended. Continue to beat, slowly adding syrup mixture. Add vanilla and beat until stiff peaks form and frosting is thick.

recipes.title: Bonbons
ingredients: 1 tsp. flavoring (vanilla, lemon, walnut, mint or other of your choice)
dipping chocolate or 6 oz. chocolate chips and 1/4 bar paraffin melted together over hot water
directions: Mix the first 5 ingredients well and form balls the size of walnuts.
With fork, dip balls in chocolate and place on waxed paper to dry.
Store in cool place in candy cups or tiny baking papers.
recipes.text: Bonbons. Mix the first 5 ingredients well and form balls the size of walnuts. With fork, dip balls in chocolate and place on waxed paper to dry. Store in cool place in candy cups or tiny baking papers.

recipes.title: Vanilla Butternut Cake
directions: Heat oven to 325°. Grease and dust flour in tube pan. Cream shortening, butter and sugar. Add eggs, flour and milk with flavor. Bake about 1 1/2 hours or until sticks done. Let set in pan until cool.
recipes.text: Vanilla Butternut Cake. Heat oven to 325°. Grease and dust flour in tube pan. Cream shortening, butter and sugar. Add eggs, flour and milk with flavor. Bake about 1 1/2 hours or until sticks done. Let set in pan until cool.

recipes.title: Beer Batter For Fish
directions: Mix ingredients until it resembles batter.
Dip fish in batter, then fry.
recipes.text: Beer Batter For Fish. Mix ingredients until it resembles batter. Dip fish in batter, then fry.

recipes.title: Fresh Tomato Cheese Rarebit
directions: Chop tomatoes and onion and set aside.
Heat soup with milk and mustard mixed in.
Toast bread.
Pile tomatoes and onion on toast and pour soup mixture over this.
recipes.text: Fresh Tomato Cheese Rarebit. Chop tomatoes and onion and set aside. Heat soup with milk and mustard mixed in. Toast bread. Pile tomatoes and onion on toast and pour soup mixture over this.

recipes.title: Mom'S Lo-Cal Cream Cheese Pie
ingredients: 1 (9-inch) graham cracker crust, baked and cooled
1 small pkg. instant Jell-O pudding mix (lemon, pineapple or other cream filling)
directions: Stir cream cheese until soft.
Gradually blend in 1/2 cup milk until mixture is very smooth.
Add remaining milk and pudding mix. Beat slowly with eggbeater for 1 minute.
Pour at once into cooled crust.
recipes.text: Mom'S Lo-Cal Cream Cheese Pie. Stir cream cheese until soft. Gradually blend in 1/2 cup milk until mixture is very smooth. Add remaining milk and pudding mix. Beat slowly with eggbeater for 1 minute. Pour at once into cooled crust.

recipes.title: Rhubarb Cake
directions: Bake 30 to 35 minutes at 350° in 9 x 13-inch pan.
recipes.text: Rhubarb Cake. Bake 30 to 35 minutes at 350° in 9 x 13-inch pan.

recipes.title: Killer Meat Loaf
ingredients: 2 lb. lean ground chuck, 3/4 lb. sausage in bulk
directions: Heat butter, add veggies and garlic, cook until veggies dry up.
Let cool and chill.
Combine spices, eggs, ketchup, half and half, blend.
Mix veggie mix, spice mix, meats and crumbs all together.
Blend well.
Shape into loaf, put in pan, then put pan into a slightly larger pan with some water.
Bake at 375° for 35 to 40 minutes.
Serves 8 to 12.
recipes.text: Killer Meat Loaf. Heat butter, add veggies and garlic, cook until veggies dry up. Let cool and chill. Combine spices, eggs, ketchup, half and half, blend. Mix veggie mix, spice mix, meats and crumbs all together. Blend well. Shape into loaf, put in pan, then put pan into a slightly larger pan with some water. Bake at 375° for 35 to 40 minutes. Serves 8 to 12.

recipes.title: Persimmon Cookies
directions: Cream sugar and butter together; beat in egg.
Sift all dry ingredients except baking soda together, stir in nuts and raisins, set aside.
Puree persimmon pulp until smooth then stir in baking soda.
Add persimmon mixture and dry ingredients alternately into creamed butter and sugar mixture; mixing well after each addition. Drop batter by heaping teaspoon on greased baking sheet.
Bake at 350° for 15 minutes.
Makes about 2 dozen cookies.
recipes.text: Persimmon Cookies. Cream sugar and butter together; beat in egg. Sift all dry ingredients except baking soda together, stir in nuts and raisins, set aside. Puree persimmon pulp until smooth then stir in baking soda. Add persimmon mixture and dry ingredients alternately into creamed butter and sugar mixture; mixing well after each addition. Drop batter by heaping teaspoon on greased baking sheet. Bake at 350° for 15 minutes. Makes about 2 dozen cookies.

recipes.title: Sloppy Joes
directions: Fry hamburger and onion together until done.
Add chili powder, mustard, catsup and soup.
Simmer until real thick, about 1 hour on medium heat.
recipes.text: Sloppy Joes. Fry hamburger and onion together until done. Add chili powder, mustard, catsup and soup. Simmer until real thick, about 1 hour on medium heat.

recipes.title: Lemon Cream Pie
directions: In saucepan, combine sugar, cornstarch, lemon peel, butter, lemon juice, milk and egg yolks.
Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until thick.
Cover and cool.
Fold in sour cream. Pour into baked pastry shell.
Chill for 2 hours or more before serving.
Top with whipped cream.
recipes.text: Lemon Cream Pie. In saucepan, combine sugar, cornstarch, lemon peel, butter, lemon juice, milk and egg yolks. Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until thick. Cover and cool. Fold in sour cream. Pour into baked pastry shell. Chill for 2 hours or more before serving. Top with whipped cream.

recipes.title: Lemon-Basil Mayonnaise
ingredients: 1/2 c. firmly packed fresh basil leaves
directions: Process mayonnaise and garlic clove in a blender or food processor until smooth.
Add basil and lemon rind; pulse 3 or 4 times or until basil is finely chopped.
Store covered in refrigerator up to 1 week.
Makes 2 cups.
Good with fish.
recipes.text: Lemon-Basil Mayonnaise. Process mayonnaise and garlic clove in a blender or food processor until smooth. Add basil and lemon rind; pulse 3 or 4 times or until basil is finely chopped. Store covered in refrigerator up to 1 week. Makes 2 cups. Good with fish.

recipes.title: 30 Minute Fudge Cake
directions: Mix flour, sugar and salt in a large bowl; set aside.
Bring to a boil, in saucepan, water, Crisco, margarine and cocoa.
Pour over dry mixture and mix well.
Add eggs, buttermilk, soda and vanilla.
Bake at 400° for 30 minutes in an 11 x 14-inch pan. (Ice while warm.)
recipes.text: 30 Minute Fudge Cake. Mix flour, sugar and salt in a large bowl; set aside. Bring to a boil, in saucepan, water, Crisco, margarine and cocoa. Pour over dry mixture and mix well. Add eggs, buttermilk, soda and vanilla. Bake at 400° for 30 minutes in an 11 x 14-inch pan. (Ice while warm.)

recipes.title: Peanut Clusters
directions: Melt chips in a double boiler.
Add peanuts.
Drop clusters onto waxed paper.
recipes.text: Peanut Clusters. Melt chips in a double boiler. Add peanuts. Drop clusters onto waxed paper.

recipes.title: Cherry Surprise
directions: Spray an oblong pan with Pam.
Put cherry pie filling on bottom.
Sprinkle cake mix on top.
Sprinkle coconut and pecans. Spoon crushed pineapple for next layer.
Melt butter for topping. Bake at 350° for 35 to 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Cherry Surprise. Spray an oblong pan with Pam. Put cherry pie filling on bottom. Sprinkle cake mix on top. Sprinkle coconut and pecans. Spoon crushed pineapple for next layer. Melt butter for topping. Bake at 350° for 35 to 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Fresh Strawberry Sauce
directions: Combine berries and sugar in a small bowl.
Cover and refrigerate 2 to 3 hours.
Drain, reserving juice.
Set berries aside.
recipes.text: Fresh Strawberry Sauce. Combine berries and sugar in a small bowl. Cover and refrigerate 2 to 3 hours. Drain, reserving juice. Set berries aside.

recipes.title: Holy Cow Cake
directions: Prepare the cake per the directions on the cake in a 13 x 9-inch (1/4 sheet) pan.
Leave the cake in the pan when it is baked.
Poke holes in the top of the cake with a wooden spoon handle.
Pour the condensed milk (not evaporated milk) over the cake, followed by the caramel topping.
Top the cake with Cool Whip and sprinkle with the crushed Heath bar candy bars. Refrigerate before serving for at least 1 hour.
recipes.text: Holy Cow Cake. Prepare the cake per the directions on the cake in a 13 x 9-inch (1/4 sheet) pan. Leave the cake in the pan when it is baked. Poke holes in the top of the cake with a wooden spoon handle. Pour the condensed milk (not evaporated milk) over the cake, followed by the caramel topping. Top the cake with Cool Whip and sprinkle with the crushed Heath bar candy bars. Refrigerate before serving for at least 1 hour.

recipes.title: Fruit Dip
directions: Mix with electric mixer.
Slowly add milk last, to preferred consistency.
Refrigerate.
recipes.text: Fruit Dip. Mix with electric mixer. Slowly add milk last, to preferred consistency. Refrigerate.

recipes.title: Chocolate Sheet Cake
ingredients: 1/2 c. buttermilk with 1 tsp. baking soda dissolved in it
directions: Mix and bring to a boil the oleo, cocoa and milk. Remove from heat.
Add powdered sugar, pecans and vanilla. Spread on cake.
recipes.text: Chocolate Sheet Cake. Mix and bring to a boil the oleo, cocoa and milk. Remove from heat. Add powdered sugar, pecans and vanilla. Spread on cake.

recipes.title: Sour Cream Biscuits
directions: Sift
flour, cut butter into flour.
Stir n sour cream. Drop by	spoon onto baking sheet or place in small muffin tin pan. Bake at 375° for 10 to 12 minutes or until golden brown. Makes 4 to 6 servings.
recipes.text: Sour Cream Biscuits. Sift flour, cut butter into flour. Stir n sour cream. Drop by	spoon onto baking sheet or place in small muffin tin pan. Bake at 375° for 10 to 12 minutes or until golden brown. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

recipes.title: Cherry Yum Yum
directions: Mix crumbs and melted margarine.
Set aside about 1/2 cup crumbs to put on top.
Place remaining crumbs into 9 x 9-inch baking dish and press firmly.
recipes.text: Cherry Yum Yum. Mix crumbs and melted margarine. Set aside about 1/2 cup crumbs to put on top. Place remaining crumbs into 9 x 9-inch baking dish and press firmly.

recipes.title: Polka Dot Cookies
directions: Cream together sugar, butter and cream cheese until light and fluffy.
Beat in eggs and vanilla.
Blend in flour and salt. Stir in chocolate chips and raisins.
Bake in a 350° oven until lightly browned, about 12 minutes.
Makes 5 1/2 dozen.
recipes.text: Polka Dot Cookies. Cream together sugar, butter and cream cheese until light and fluffy. Beat in eggs and vanilla. Blend in flour and salt. Stir in chocolate chips and raisins. Bake in a 350° oven until lightly browned, about 12 minutes. Makes 5 1/2 dozen.

recipes.title: Chicken Casserole
directions: Boil chicken and debone.
Place chicken in bottom of a 9 x 13 dish.
Mix soups, butter and sour cream.
Pour over chicken. Sprinkle Stove Top crumbs over soup mixture, then sprinkle seasoning packet over crumbs.
Pour broth over all; cover and bake 40 minutes at 350 degrees.
Uncover and bake 20 minutes longer.
recipes.text: Chicken Casserole. Boil chicken and debone. Place chicken in bottom of a 9 x 13 dish. Mix soups, butter and sour cream. Pour over chicken. Sprinkle Stove Top crumbs over soup mixture, then sprinkle seasoning packet over crumbs. Pour broth over all; cover and bake 40 minutes at 350 degrees. Uncover and bake 20 minutes longer.

recipes.title: Oatmeal Crispies
directions: Mix oil and sugar. Add eggs and vanilla and beat well. Sift all dry ingredients together and add to sugar mixture. Add oats and nuts and mix well. Dough will be stiff (use hands). Shape into rolls and wrap in waxed paper. Chill in the refrigerator. Slice 1/4-inch thick and bake on ungreased baking sheet for 10 to 15 minutes at 350°. Yield: about 60 cookies.
recipes.text: Oatmeal Crispies. Mix oil and sugar. Add eggs and vanilla and beat well. Sift all dry ingredients together and add to sugar mixture. Add oats and nuts and mix well. Dough will be stiff (use hands). Shape into rolls and wrap in waxed paper. Chill in the refrigerator. Slice 1/4-inch thick and bake on ungreased baking sheet for 10 to 15 minutes at 350°. Yield: about 60 cookies.

recipes.title: Dorene Watts' Gingersnaps
directions: Sift together the dry ingredients.
Mix dry ingredients with liquids.
Let dough chill for 2 hours or overnight.
Roll balls in sugar before putting on cookie sheet.
Bake at 325° for 8 minutes. Do not overbake.
recipes.text: Dorene Watts' Gingersnaps. Sift together the dry ingredients. Mix dry ingredients with liquids. Let dough chill for 2 hours or overnight. Roll balls in sugar before putting on cookie sheet. Bake at 325° for 8 minutes. Do not overbake.

recipes.title: Western Stew
directions: Bring to boil everything except potatoes and cornstarch. Reduce heat; simmer in covered pot for 2 to 2 1/2 hours.
Add potatoes; cook for 30 more minutes.
Dissolve cornstarch in 1/2 cup cold water.
Add to cooked ingredients; bring back to boil for 2 minutes to thicken.
Good to cook ahead and take on a camping trip or to have in cold weather.
recipes.text: Western Stew. Bring to boil everything except potatoes and cornstarch. Reduce heat; simmer in covered pot for 2 to 2 1/2 hours. Add potatoes; cook for 30 more minutes. Dissolve cornstarch in 1/2 cup cold water. Add to cooked ingredients; bring back to boil for 2 minutes to thicken. Good to cook ahead and take on a camping trip or to have in cold weather.

recipes.title: Banana Nut Bread
directions: Cream margarine, sugar and eggs well.
Sift flour, soda and salt together.
Add alternately to creamed mixture with mashed bananas.
Mix well; add nuts and vanilla.
Bake in greased loaf pan 1 hour at 350°.
Before serving, cover with a layer of whipped cream and sprinkle some grated American cheese on top (optional).
recipes.text: Banana Nut Bread. Cream margarine, sugar and eggs well. Sift flour, soda and salt together. Add alternately to creamed mixture with mashed bananas. Mix well; add nuts and vanilla. Bake in greased loaf pan 1 hour at 350°. Before serving, cover with a layer of whipped cream and sprinkle some grated American cheese on top (optional).

recipes.title: Gelatin Salad
directions: Mix together Jell-O, water and marshmallows.
Add mayonnaise, cottage cheese and pineapple.
Chill until set.
Can be frozen. Can add grated carrots or chopped nuts for topping.
recipes.text: Gelatin Salad. Mix together Jell-O, water and marshmallows. Add mayonnaise, cottage cheese and pineapple. Chill until set. Can be frozen. Can add grated carrots or chopped nuts for topping.

recipes.title: Icebox Rolls
directions: Pour boiling water over shortening, sugar and salt.
Blend by cutting up shortening.
Dissolve yeast in cup of warm water.
Add to eggs and mixture.
Add flour and blend well.
Cover with foil and place in refrigerator at least 4 hours before rolling.
Roll out as needed; cut rolls with biscuit cutter, then fold in half. Let rise in pan 2 hours before baking.
Bake at 350° until brown.
recipes.text: Icebox Rolls. Pour boiling water over shortening, sugar and salt. Blend by cutting up shortening. Dissolve yeast in cup of warm water. Add to eggs and mixture. Add flour and blend well. Cover with foil and place in refrigerator at least 4 hours before rolling. Roll out as needed; cut rolls with biscuit cutter, then fold in half. Let rise in pan 2 hours before baking. Bake at 350° until brown.

recipes.title: Yeast Rolls(Makes 36 Rolls)
ingredients: 1 pkg. yeast to 1/4 c. warm water
directions: Scald 1 cup milk.
Add shortening.
Cool.
Beat eggs and 1/2 cup sugar. Add salt, cool milk and shortening.
Add yeast dissolved in water.
Stir in flour.
Let rise for 4 hours. Refrigerate, then divide into 3 balls.
Spread soft butter on it. Cut into 12 wedges.
Roll each roll out side edge into point. Place on a cookie sheet.
Let rise for 4 hours.
Bake at 375° for 12 to 15 minutes.
recipes.text: Yeast Rolls(Makes 36 Rolls). Scald 1 cup milk. Add shortening. Cool. Beat eggs and 1/2 cup sugar. Add salt, cool milk and shortening. Add yeast dissolved in water. Stir in flour. Let rise for 4 hours. Refrigerate, then divide into 3 balls. Spread soft butter on it. Cut into 12 wedges. Roll each roll out side edge into point. Place on a cookie sheet. Let rise for 4 hours. Bake at 375° for 12 to 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Deviled Eggs
directions: Slice eggs in half lengthwise and carefully remove yolks. Mash yolks; stir in mayonnaise and next 5 ingredients.
Spoon into egg whites.
Sprinkle with paprika.
recipes.text: Deviled Eggs. Slice eggs in half lengthwise and carefully remove yolks. Mash yolks; stir in mayonnaise and next 5 ingredients. Spoon into egg whites. Sprinkle with paprika.

recipes.title: Glazed Pineapple Fingers
directions: Sift
dry
ingredients.
Cut in shortening. Mix egg and crushed
pineapple	together and add to dry ingredients, stirring just until moist.
Shape into bars on cookie sheet. Bake at 425° for 12 to 15 minutes. Top with glaze made with confectioners sugar.
recipes.text: Glazed Pineapple Fingers. Sift dry ingredients. Cut in shortening. Mix egg and crushed pineapple	together and add to dry ingredients, stirring just until moist. Shape into bars on cookie sheet. Bake at 425° for 12 to 15 minutes. Top with glaze made with confectioners sugar.

recipes.title: Applesauce Cake Loaf
directions: Grease and flour pan lightly.
In a large mixing bowl, combine all the ingredients except the nuts. Beat at medium speed until well blended.
Stir in nuts.
Pour into a 9 x 5-inch loaf pan. Bake 55 to 60 minutes or until toothpick comes clean at 350°.
recipes.text: Applesauce Cake Loaf. Grease and flour pan lightly. In a large mixing bowl, combine all the ingredients except the nuts. Beat at medium speed until well blended. Stir in nuts. Pour into a 9 x 5-inch loaf pan. Bake 55 to 60 minutes or until toothpick comes clean at 350°.

recipes.title: Potato Casserole
directions: Bake 45 minutes at 350°.
Spread grated cheese on top.
recipes.text: Potato Casserole. Bake 45 minutes at 350°. Spread grated cheese on top.

recipes.title: Pretzels
directions: Mix yeast into warm water. Add flour, sugar and salt.
Knead mixture.
Divide into 16 to 18 parts.
Paint with a mixture of an egg beaten with 1 tablespoon of water after rolling into desired shape.
Sprinkle with coarse salt.
Bake at 425° until golden. (Pretzel recipe used for class at C.N.S. in J. Lee's class.)
recipes.text: Pretzels. Mix yeast into warm water. Add flour, sugar and salt. Knead mixture. Divide into 16 to 18 parts. Paint with a mixture of an egg beaten with 1 tablespoon of water after rolling into desired shape. Sprinkle with coarse salt. Bake at 425° until golden. (Pretzel recipe used for class at C.N.S. in J. Lee's class.)

recipes.title: Delightful Dill Bread Boat
ingredients: 2 loaves rye (round) or 1 rye and 1 dark pumpernickel
directions: Soak in water the chipped beef to remove salt.
Drain and chop. Mix mayonnaise, sour cream and all spices.
Remove center of loaf of rye leaving a bread "bowl".
Cube bread removed plus second loaf.
Fill center of bread bowl with mayonnaise mixture.
Arrange bread cubes around bread bowl for dipping.
recipes.text: Delightful Dill Bread Boat. Soak in water the chipped beef to remove salt. Drain and chop. Mix mayonnaise, sour cream and all spices. Remove center of loaf of rye leaving a bread "bowl". Cube bread removed plus second loaf. Fill center of bread bowl with mayonnaise mixture. Arrange bread cubes around bread bowl for dipping.

recipes.title: Hershey Kisses Cookies
directions: Mix Eagle Brand, peanut butter, Bisquick mix and vanilla; shape into 1-inch balls and roll into sugar.
Bake on ungreased cookie sheet at 350° to 375° for 6 to 8 minutes or until lightly brown (watch carefully).
Remove from oven.
Immediately place chocolate Kiss in center of cookie.
Remove from pan and place them on wax paper until cool.
Enjoy.
recipes.text: Hershey Kisses Cookies. Mix Eagle Brand, peanut butter, Bisquick mix and vanilla; shape into 1-inch balls and roll into sugar. Bake on ungreased cookie sheet at 350° to 375° for 6 to 8 minutes or until lightly brown (watch carefully). Remove from oven. Immediately place chocolate Kiss in center of cookie. Remove from pan and place them on wax paper until cool. Enjoy.

recipes.title: Creamed Cabbage(Microwave)
ingredients: 1 (3 oz.) pkg. cream cheese, cut up
directions: Dissolve cornstarch in milk.
Combine all ingredients in 2-quart microwave-proof casserole dish.
Cover.
Cook 10 to 12 minutes or until tender, stirring once during cooking time.
Stir and let stand 2 minutes before serving.
recipes.text: Creamed Cabbage(Microwave). Dissolve cornstarch in milk. Combine all ingredients in 2-quart microwave-proof casserole dish. Cover. Cook 10 to 12 minutes or until tender, stirring once during cooking time. Stir and let stand 2 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Chicken Diable
directions: Wash chicken; pat dry.
Melt butter; stir in remaining ingredients.
Roll chicken in mixture to coat.
Arrange meaty side up in a single layer in same pan.
Bake at 375° oven for one hour. Serves 4.
recipes.text: Chicken Diable. Wash chicken; pat dry. Melt butter; stir in remaining ingredients. Roll chicken in mixture to coat. Arrange meaty side up in a single layer in same pan. Bake at 375° oven for one hour. Serves 4.

recipes.title: Baked Beans Deluxe
ingredients: 1 can white lima beans or navy
6 slices bacon, diced and fried crisp
directions: Mix all together.
Bake at 375° for 1 hour, or until done.
recipes.text: Baked Beans Deluxe. Mix all together. Bake at 375° for 1 hour, or until done.

recipes.title: Pineapple 7-Up Cake
directions: Mix in large bowl cake mix, pudding mix and 7-Up; beat, then add eggs and Wesson oil.
Beat until smooth and creamy.
Bake at 325° for 22 or 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Pineapple 7-Up Cake. Mix in large bowl cake mix, pudding mix and 7-Up; beat, then add eggs and Wesson oil. Beat until smooth and creamy. Bake at 325° for 22 or 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Apple Crisp(Serves 4)
ingredients: 3 small apples, peeled, cored and sliced
1 pkg. vanilla flavored low calorie milk beverage (i.e., Alba 77)
3/4 oz. dry cereal (i.e., oatmeal or Grape-Nuts)
directions: Place sliced apples in the bottom of an 8-inch square baking dish.
Mix raisins, water, sweetener and spice together.
Sprinkle over apples.
Mix vanilla flavored low calorie beverage, cereal and margarine together.
Sprinkle over all ingredients in baking dish.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.
Can be microwaved on High for 15 minutes.
Divide evenly.
Each serving equals 1 fruit, 1/4 milk, 1/4 bread and 1/4 fat.
ner: vanilla flavored low calorie milk beverage
recipes.text: Apple Crisp(Serves 4). Place sliced apples in the bottom of an 8-inch square baking dish. Mix raisins, water, sweetener and spice together. Sprinkle over apples. Mix vanilla flavored low calorie beverage, cereal and margarine together. Sprinkle over all ingredients in baking dish. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes. Can be microwaved on High for 15 minutes. Divide evenly. Each serving equals 1 fruit, 1/4 milk, 1/4 bread and 1/4 fat.

recipes.title: Cheese Potatoes
directions: Mix potatoes, sour cream, soup, onion and 1/2 melted butter, cheese, salt and pepper. Put in glass dish (spray with nonstick spray).
Top with remaining butter and crushed corn flakes.
Bake 50 minutes at 350°.
recipes.text: Cheese Potatoes. Mix potatoes, sour cream, soup, onion and 1/2 melted butter, cheese, salt and pepper. Put in glass dish (spray with nonstick spray). Top with remaining butter and crushed corn flakes. Bake 50 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Creamy Cucumber Salad Dressing
ingredients: 2 Tbsp. snipped chives or thinly sliced green onions
3/4 c. peeled, seeded and finely chopped cucumber
directions: Stir together mayonnaise, sour cream and chives or green onions in a small bowl.
Stir in the chopped cucumber.
Stir in milk to make the dressing the desired consistency.
recipes.text: Creamy Cucumber Salad Dressing. Stir together mayonnaise, sour cream and chives or green onions in a small bowl. Stir in the chopped cucumber. Stir in milk to make the dressing the desired consistency.

recipes.title: Potato Soup
directions: Melt butter in large saucepan.
Saute onions until light brown.
Add potatoes, carrots, water, salt, pepper and dill weed. Bring to a boil, reduce heat to low and simmer until potatoes are tender, about 25 to 30 minutes.
Stir in
milk and parsley and heat until hot.
recipes.text: Potato Soup. Melt butter in large saucepan. Saute onions until light brown. Add potatoes, carrots, water, salt, pepper and dill weed. Bring to a boil, reduce heat to low and simmer until potatoes are tender, about 25 to 30 minutes. Stir in milk and parsley and heat until hot.

recipes.title: Grape Pie
directions: Separate
skins
from
seeds.
Cook
the
seed and pulp part. Keep
the skins in another pan and save.
Put seeds and pulp through food mill to take out seeds, then put the pulp in with the raw skins.
Add rest of ingredients.
Put in unbaked pie shell. Moisten
edges
of	crust,	then put on top crust. Bake at 400° for 40 minutes.
recipes.text: Grape Pie. Separate skins from seeds. Cook the seed and pulp part. Keep the skins in another pan and save. Put seeds and pulp through food mill to take out seeds, then put the pulp in with the raw skins. Add rest of ingredients. Put in unbaked pie shell. Moisten edges of	crust,	then put on top crust. Bake at 400° for 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Buffalo Wings
ingredients: 1 pkg. Hidden Valley Ranch salad dressing mix
directions: Preheat oven to 350°.
Dip chicken in mixture of melted butter, pepper sauce and vinegar; put in baking pan.
Sprinkle with dry dressing mix.
Bake 25 to 30 minutes or until browned. Sprinkle with paprika.
Serve with celery and Ranch dressing as dip.
recipes.text: Buffalo Wings. Preheat oven to 350°. Dip chicken in mixture of melted butter, pepper sauce and vinegar; put in baking pan. Sprinkle with dry dressing mix. Bake 25 to 30 minutes or until browned. Sprinkle with paprika. Serve with celery and Ranch dressing as dip.

recipes.title: Eggplant Dip
ingredients: 1 c. laban or 1/2 pt. container plain yogurt
directions: Chop finely the eggplant, onions, green pepper, garlic and parsley.
Heat olive oil in large skillet.
Add vegetables and saute over medium heat until they are translucent.
Stir occasionally to keep vegetables from sticking.
Lower heat and cook until vegetables are tender, stirring occasionally.
Cool to lukewarm.
Stir in remaining ingredients.
Chill and store in refrigerator until ready to serve.
Serve with sesame wafers. Makes 1 quart.
recipes.text: Eggplant Dip. Chop finely the eggplant, onions, green pepper, garlic and parsley. Heat olive oil in large skillet. Add vegetables and saute over medium heat until they are translucent. Stir occasionally to keep vegetables from sticking. Lower heat and cook until vegetables are tender, stirring occasionally. Cool to lukewarm. Stir in remaining ingredients. Chill and store in refrigerator until ready to serve. Serve with sesame wafers. Makes 1 quart.

recipes.title: Hobo Beans
directions: Brown ground beef in large skillet; drain grease.
Add onions, barbecue sauce, mushrooms, mustard, pepper and garlic powder. Simmer 15 to 20 minutes.
In separate pan, fry bacon until crisp; drain grease.
Crumble bacon into small pieces.
Combine all ingredients (including beans) and put in crock-pot.
Cover and cook on low for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Hobo Beans. Brown ground beef in large skillet; drain grease. Add onions, barbecue sauce, mushrooms, mustard, pepper and garlic powder. Simmer 15 to 20 minutes. In separate pan, fry bacon until crisp; drain grease. Crumble bacon into small pieces. Combine all ingredients (including beans) and put in crock-pot. Cover and cook on low for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Sausage Bread
ingredients: 1 1/2 lb. turkey sausage or pork sausage
directions: Note:
Hot or sweet may be used.
recipes.text: Sausage Bread. Note: Hot or sweet may be used.

recipes.title: Apple-Carrot Salad
directions: Mix all together in large serving dish.
Use just enough mayonnaise to lightly coat the ingredients.
recipes.text: Apple-Carrot Salad. Mix all together in large serving dish. Use just enough mayonnaise to lightly coat the ingredients.

recipes.title: Okra And Tomatoes
ingredients: 1/4 lb. smoked sweet sausage or smoked turkey pieces
directions: Fry meat.
Add other ingredients in saucepan.
When meat is done, add vegetables.
Cover the saucepan.
Simmer over low heat for 25 minutes.
Do not add water.
The liquid from canned tomatoes should be enough.
recipes.text: Okra And Tomatoes. Fry meat. Add other ingredients in saucepan. When meat is done, add vegetables. Cover the saucepan. Simmer over low heat for 25 minutes. Do not add water. The liquid from canned tomatoes should be enough.

recipes.title: Apple Pizza
ingredients: pie crust (large enough to cover pizza pan)
directions: Make pie crust to fit pizza pan. Slice apples to cover crust (about 3).
Combine 1/2 cup sugar, cinnamon and nutmeg.
Sprinkle lemon juice over apples (or roll apples in juice before putting on crust), then sprinkle cinnamon mixture over this.
Mix flour, 1/2 cup sugar and butter into pea size crumbles. Sprinkle over top.
A few minutes before removing from the oven, sprinkle the cheese (can cut down on cheese).
Bake in a 350° oven.
recipes.text: Apple Pizza. Make pie crust to fit pizza pan. Slice apples to cover crust (about 3). Combine 1/2 cup sugar, cinnamon and nutmeg. Sprinkle lemon juice over apples (or roll apples in juice before putting on crust), then sprinkle cinnamon mixture over this. Mix flour, 1/2 cup sugar and butter into pea size crumbles. Sprinkle over top. A few minutes before removing from the oven, sprinkle the cheese (can cut down on cheese). Bake in a 350° oven.

recipes.title: Beef Stuffed Shells
directions: Cook shells 12 minutes.
Drain and rinse.
Saute in oil, onions, garlic and mushrooms.
Mix in beef, egg, bread crumbs, cheeses, oregano, salt and pepper.
Stuff shells with meat mixture.
Arrange shells in large deep baking pan that has been covered with 3 to 4 cups of spaghetti or tomato sauce.
Cover and bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
Baste with sauce and sprinkle with Parmesan cheese before serving.
recipes.text: Beef Stuffed Shells. Cook shells 12 minutes. Drain and rinse. Saute in oil, onions, garlic and mushrooms. Mix in beef, egg, bread crumbs, cheeses, oregano, salt and pepper. Stuff shells with meat mixture. Arrange shells in large deep baking pan that has been covered with 3 to 4 cups of spaghetti or tomato sauce. Cover and bake at 350° for 30 minutes. Baste with sauce and sprinkle with Parmesan cheese before serving.

recipes.title: Brown Rice
directions: Melt margarine.
Add other ingredients and stir together. Pour into a glass casserole dish and bake at 375° for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Brown Rice. Melt margarine. Add other ingredients and stir together. Pour into a glass casserole dish and bake at 375° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Picnic Potatoes
ingredients: 4 to 5 large potatoes, peeled and sliced
directions: Put butter in the bottom of a long cake pan.
Put a layer of potatoes, then layer with onions, salt and pepper.
Then sprinkle with Parmesan cheese.
Make another layer; then sprinkle with Parmesan cheese.
Bake for 1 hour or until potatoes are tender.
recipes.text: Picnic Potatoes. Put butter in the bottom of a long cake pan. Put a layer of potatoes, then layer with onions, salt and pepper. Then sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Make another layer; then sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Bake for 1 hour or until potatoes are tender.

recipes.title: Carrot Sauce
directions: Drain cooked carrots.
Mix over low heat and set aside.
Put carrots back in pan after drained and pour sauce over carrots and toss.
recipes.text: Carrot Sauce. Drain cooked carrots. Mix over low heat and set aside. Put carrots back in pan after drained and pour sauce over carrots and toss.

recipes.title: Party Casserole
ingredients: 1 lb. fresh or 1 (10 oz.) pkg. frozen broccoli
directions: Cook broccoli.
Make white sauce with butter, flour, milk and salt.
Cook until medium thick.
Cut cooked broccoli into 1-inch pieces and place in buttered casserole.
Combine ham, green pepper, parsley, eggs, cheese and lemon juice.
Place over broccoli.
recipes.text: Party Casserole. Cook broccoli. Make white sauce with butter, flour, milk and salt. Cook until medium thick. Cut cooked broccoli into 1-inch pieces and place in buttered casserole. Combine ham, green pepper, parsley, eggs, cheese and lemon juice. Place over broccoli.

recipes.title: Shrimp Salad
ingredients: 2 Tbsp. gelatin, dissolved in 1/2 c. hot water
2 c. cooked shrimp, cut in small pieces
3/4 c. diced celery (add all to cream cheese mixture)
directions: Heat soup and cream cheese in double boiler or in microwave at 50%, 3 to 5 minutes.
Pour mixture into 6-cup mold or individual molds.
Unmold on serving plate and garnish with greens.
If seafood mold is used, ripe olives and pimento can be used for eyes and mouth.
This may also be used as appetizer and served with your favorite crackers.
recipes.text: Shrimp Salad. Heat soup and cream cheese in double boiler or in microwave at 50%, 3 to 5 minutes. Pour mixture into 6-cup mold or individual molds. Unmold on serving plate and garnish with greens. If seafood mold is used, ripe olives and pimento can be used for eyes and mouth. This may also be used as appetizer and served with your favorite crackers.

recipes.title: Broccoli Salad
ingredients: 1 tsp. vinegar (may need a little more to taste)
directions: Combine ingredients until mixed.
recipes.text: Broccoli Salad. Combine ingredients until mixed.

recipes.title: Bobbi'S Summer Salad
ingredients: 1 medium green and red pepper, cut in strips
directions: Cut lettuce up fine.
Combine all ingredients into an extra large mixing bowl.
Toss well and often.
Serve immediately.
No dressing required.
recipes.text: Bobbi'S Summer Salad. Cut lettuce up fine. Combine all ingredients into an extra large mixing bowl. Toss well and often. Serve immediately. No dressing required.

recipes.title: Dark Cake
directions: In a 9 x 9-inch cake pan, mix all dry ingredients.
Do not grease pan. Make 3 little pockets in the mix.
Place vinegar, oil and vanilla in each pocket.
Pour water over everything and mix. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Dark Cake. In a 9 x 9-inch cake pan, mix all dry ingredients. Do not grease pan. Make 3 little pockets in the mix. Place vinegar, oil and vanilla in each pocket. Pour water over everything and mix. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Eggplant A La Chance
directions: Brown eggplant in olive oil on both sides.
Sprinkle with salt and garlic salt.
In greased casserole, alternate layers of eggplant, pepperoni, Provolone and spaghetti sauce.
top with sauce and sprinkle Parmesan over all.
Bake, uncovered, at 350° about 20 minutes until warm through.
recipes.text: Eggplant A La Chance. Brown eggplant in olive oil on both sides. Sprinkle with salt and garlic salt. In greased casserole, alternate layers of eggplant, pepperoni, Provolone and spaghetti sauce. top with sauce and sprinkle Parmesan over all. Bake, uncovered, at 350° about 20 minutes until warm through.

recipes.title: Sausage Casserole
ingredients: 5 baking size potatoes, peeled and cubed
directions: Boil potatoes until tender.
Cook and scramble sausage and onion together.
Put potatoes in bottom of 13 x 9-inch pan (cake size).
Spread sausage and onion on top.
Pour 2 cans of soup on top.
Cover with shredded cheese.
Bake for 1 hour at 350°.
recipes.text: Sausage Casserole. Boil potatoes until tender. Cook and scramble sausage and onion together. Put potatoes in bottom of 13 x 9-inch pan (cake size). Spread sausage and onion on top. Pour 2 cans of soup on top. Cover with shredded cheese. Bake for 1 hour at 350°.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Candy
directions: Place peanut butter in a bowl.
Add corn syrup and vanilla. Stir until well coated.
Add milk, a little at a time, and stir. Add sugar and mix.
Knead with hands on a dry surface until well coated or until sugar is all gone.
Pat out about 1/2-inch thick and cut in squares.
recipes.text: Peanut Butter Candy. Place peanut butter in a bowl. Add corn syrup and vanilla. Stir until well coated. Add milk, a little at a time, and stir. Add sugar and mix. Knead with hands on a dry surface until well coated or until sugar is all gone. Pat out about 1/2-inch thick and cut in squares.

recipes.title: Chili
directions: Brown and drain hamburger. Put your chili beans, diced tomatoes, tomato sauce and onion in a crock-pot. Add hamburger. Season with chili powder until you like the way it tastes, the way you want it to. Let it simmer all day, stirring occasionally. Eat and you are done.
recipes.text: Chili. Brown and drain hamburger. Put your chili beans, diced tomatoes, tomato sauce and onion in a crock-pot. Add hamburger. Season with chili powder until you like the way it tastes, the way you want it to. Let it simmer all day, stirring occasionally. Eat and you are done.

recipes.title: Apple Rolls
directions: Mix together and chill for 2 hours.
recipes.text: Apple Rolls. Mix together and chill for 2 hours.

recipes.title: Drop Cookies
directions: Mix well in order given.
Drop by spoonfuls on ungreased cookie sheet.
Sprinkle with sugar.
Press down a little.
Bake until light brown in 350° oven.
recipes.text: Drop Cookies. Mix well in order given. Drop by spoonfuls on ungreased cookie sheet. Sprinkle with sugar. Press down a little. Bake until light brown in 350° oven.

recipes.title: Microwave Bread And Butter Pickles
directions: Mix all ingredients together and microwave on High power 7 minutes.
Put in containers and store in refrigerator.
recipes.text: Microwave Bread And Butter Pickles. Mix all ingredients together and microwave on High power 7 minutes. Put in containers and store in refrigerator.

recipes.title: Corn Flake Christmas Wreaths
directions: Be careful in your selection, do not choose too young, and take only such as have been reared in a good moral atmosphere. Some insist on keeping them in a pickle, while others keep them in hot water.

This only makes them sour and sometimes bitter. Even poor varieties may be sweet, tender and good by garnishing them with smiles and flavored with kisses to taste, then wrap them in a mantle of charity, keep warm with a steady fire of domestic devotions and serve with peaches and cream.
When thus prepared, they will keep for years.
recipes.text: Corn Flake Christmas Wreaths. Be careful in your selection, do not choose too young, and take only such as have been reared in a good moral atmosphere. Some insist on keeping them in a pickle, while others keep them in hot water. This only makes them sour and sometimes bitter. Even poor varieties may be sweet, tender and good by garnishing them with smiles and flavored with kisses to taste, then wrap them in a mantle of charity, keep warm with a steady fire of domestic devotions and serve with peaches and cream. When thus prepared, they will keep for years.

recipes.title: Rhubarb Pie
directions: Put rhubarb in large kettle.

Pour boiling water over rhubarb. Let stand for about 5 minutes. Drain and squeeze out much of the liquid. Add sugar, egg yolks, flour, butter, water and salt. Cook over low heat until thick. Remove from heat and add the vanilla. pour into baked pie shell and cover with meringue. Make meringue with the egg whites. Return to oven and brown.
recipes.text: Rhubarb Pie. Put rhubarb in large kettle. Pour boiling water over rhubarb. Let stand for about 5 minutes. Drain and squeeze out much of the liquid. Add sugar, egg yolks, flour, butter, water and salt. Cook over low heat until thick. Remove from heat and add the vanilla. pour into baked pie shell and cover with meringue. Make meringue with the egg whites. Return to oven and brown.

recipes.title: Broccoli And Ground Beef Casserole
ingredients: garlic powder, salt and pepper to taste
directions: Brown ground beef with onion in skillet, stirring until ground beef is crumbly; drain.
Cook broccoli using package directions; drain.
Combine soup with milk, garlic powder, salt and pepper in bowl; mix well.
Layer ground beef, rice, soup, broccoli and cheese 1/2 at a time in baking dish.
Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes or until heated through.
Serve with ambrosia, rolls and iced tea.
Yield: 8 servings.
recipes.text: Broccoli And Ground Beef Casserole. Brown ground beef with onion in skillet, stirring until ground beef is crumbly; drain. Cook broccoli using package directions; drain. Combine soup with milk, garlic powder, salt and pepper in bowl; mix well. Layer ground beef, rice, soup, broccoli and cheese 1/2 at a time in baking dish. Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes or until heated through. Serve with ambrosia, rolls and iced tea. Yield: 8 servings.

recipes.title: Altar Bread Wafers
ingredients: 4 to 5 Tbsp. whipping cream (half and half)
directions: Roll out and cut.
Bake at 375° for 5 to 7 minutes.
recipes.text: Altar Bread Wafers. Roll out and cut. Bake at 375° for 5 to 7 minutes.

recipes.title: Clams Casino
ingredients: 2 (6 or 8 oz.) cans minced clams with juice
directions: Combine all ingredients in small frying pan.
Cook at 350° until tender.
Add bread crumbs.
Put into clam shells; sprinkle with Parmesan cheese.
recipes.text: Clams Casino. Combine all ingredients in small frying pan. Cook at 350° until tender. Add bread crumbs. Put into clam shells; sprinkle with Parmesan cheese.

recipes.title: Chicken Dressing Bake
ingredients: 2 boxes Stove Top stuffing for chicken (or 1 large box)
directions: Stir together the first 4 ingredients.
Make the stuffing according to directions.
Put a layer of dressing in bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Spoon the creamed chicken mixture on top.
Put the rest of the dressing on top.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes, covered, and then 15 minutes, uncovered.
recipes.text: Chicken Dressing Bake. Stir together the first 4 ingredients. Make the stuffing according to directions. Put a layer of dressing in bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan. Spoon the creamed chicken mixture on top. Put the rest of the dressing on top. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes, covered, and then 15 minutes, uncovered.

recipes.title: Moon Balls
directions: Mix milk, honey and peanut butter together until well blended. Chill. Form into marble size balls and roll in crushed cereal or wheat germ.
recipes.text: Moon Balls. Mix milk, honey and peanut butter together until well blended. Chill. Form into marble size balls and roll in crushed cereal or wheat germ.

recipes.title: Icing For Cake
directions: Cook together flour and milk until thick.
Cream cooked mixture with Spry.
Gradually add powdered sugar and vanilla.
recipes.text: Icing For Cake. Cook together flour and milk until thick. Cream cooked mixture with Spry. Gradually add powdered sugar and vanilla.

recipes.title: Strawberry Jello Salad
directions: Cream jello, cream cheese and sugar.
Add strawberries, bananas and pineapple.
Then add Cool Whip.
Salad can be refrigerated in bowl or frozen in 8 x 8-inch pan.
recipes.text: Strawberry Jello Salad. Cream jello, cream cheese and sugar. Add strawberries, bananas and pineapple. Then add Cool Whip. Salad can be refrigerated in bowl or frozen in 8 x 8-inch pan.

recipes.title: Tuna Casserole
directions: Heat oven to 400°.
Blend soup and milk and add all ingredients, except 1/2 cup cheese.
Pour into greased casserole dish.
Sprinkle with reserved cheese.
Bake for 20 minutes. Serves 6 to 8.
recipes.text: Tuna Casserole. Heat oven to 400°. Blend soup and milk and add all ingredients, except 1/2 cup cheese. Pour into greased casserole dish. Sprinkle with reserved cheese. Bake for 20 minutes. Serves 6 to 8.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Fruit Bars(For Hiking, Camping, Picnics)
ingredients: 1 (6 oz.) pkg. dried mixed fruit bits
directions: Stir together brown sugar and honey in a large saucepan.
Bring mixture to boiling, stirring constantly.
Remove from heat.
Stir in peanut butter until smooth.
Measure 1/3 cup of dried fruit bits.
Set aside.
Stir remaining fruit bits into honey mixture until well coated.
Spread mixture into a greased 12 x 7 1/2 x 2-inch baking pan.
Press reserved fruit into top and cool.
Cut bars into individual bars and wrap each in plastic wrap.
Makes 24 bars.
recipes.text: Peanut Butter Fruit Bars(For Hiking, Camping, Picnics). Stir together brown sugar and honey in a large saucepan. Bring mixture to boiling, stirring constantly. Remove from heat. Stir in peanut butter until smooth. Measure 1/3 cup of dried fruit bits. Set aside. Stir remaining fruit bits into honey mixture until well coated. Spread mixture into a greased 12 x 7 1/2 x 2-inch baking pan. Press reserved fruit into top and cool. Cut bars into individual bars and wrap each in plastic wrap. Makes 24 bars.

recipes.title: Chocolate Oatmeal Cookies
directions: Beat egg, water, butter, shortening, brown sugar and half the brownie mix (dry) until smooth.
Stir in remaining dry mix, oats, nuts and chocolate chips.
Drop by teaspoons onto ungreased baking sheet.
Bake at 375° for 10 to 12 minutes.
Cool slightly, then remove to rack to cool.
Makes 6 dozen.
recipes.text: Chocolate Oatmeal Cookies. Beat egg, water, butter, shortening, brown sugar and half the brownie mix (dry) until smooth. Stir in remaining dry mix, oats, nuts and chocolate chips. Drop by teaspoons onto ungreased baking sheet. Bake at 375° for 10 to 12 minutes. Cool slightly, then remove to rack to cool. Makes 6 dozen.

recipes.title: Little Porcupines
directions: Combine rice, meat, onion and salt.
Form mixture into balls of 1 1/2-inches.
Heat in heavy skillet the tomato juice, cinnamon, sugar and Worcestershire sauce.
Drop in meat balls. Cover tightly and simmer 50 minutes.
recipes.text: Little Porcupines. Combine rice, meat, onion and salt. Form mixture into balls of 1 1/2-inches. Heat in heavy skillet the tomato juice, cinnamon, sugar and Worcestershire sauce. Drop in meat balls. Cover tightly and simmer 50 minutes.

recipes.title: Pineapple Casserole
directions: Cream butter and sugar.
Add eggs; beat with electric mixer. Add bread and pineapple with juice.
Put into a buttered casserole.
Bake in a 350° preheated oven for 40 to 45 minutes. Serves 8.
recipes.text: Pineapple Casserole. Cream butter and sugar. Add eggs; beat with electric mixer. Add bread and pineapple with juice. Put into a buttered casserole. Bake in a 350° preheated oven for 40 to 45 minutes. Serves 8.

recipes.title: Coconut Custard Pie
directions: Melt butter.
Add eggs and sugar; mix well.
Add coconut. Pour into unbaked pie shells.
Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes, or until done.
recipes.text: Coconut Custard Pie. Melt butter. Add eggs and sugar; mix well. Add coconut. Pour into unbaked pie shells. Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes, or until done.

recipes.title: Potatoes And Onions
ingredients: 10 red potatoes cut up in quarters
directions: Cook potatoes and onions together when done sprinkle with salt and pepper, italian seasoning and butter. Bake for 20 minutes.
recipes.text: Potatoes And Onions. Cook potatoes and onions together when done sprinkle with salt and pepper, italian seasoning and butter. Bake for 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Texas Potatoes
ingredients: 1 lb. pkg. frozen hash brown potatoes
directions: Combine the ingredients.
Mix and put in 9 x 13-inch buttered dish.
Sprinkle topping on top and bake 45 to 50 minutes at 350°.
recipes.text: Texas Potatoes. Combine the ingredients. Mix and put in 9 x 13-inch buttered dish. Sprinkle topping on top and bake 45 to 50 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Nut Loaf
directions: Cream butter and sugar together in mixing bowl.
Add beaten eggs and pumpkin; mix well.
Combine flour with baking soda, cinnamon, ginger, cloves and salt.
Add flour mixture to pumpkin mixture.
Mix enough to blend ingredients.
Add milk and walnuts and mix well until batter is smooth.
Bake in buttered loaf pan (9 1/2 x 5-inch) at 350° for 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Pumpkin Nut Loaf. Cream butter and sugar together in mixing bowl. Add beaten eggs and pumpkin; mix well. Combine flour with baking soda, cinnamon, ginger, cloves and salt. Add flour mixture to pumpkin mixture. Mix enough to blend ingredients. Add milk and walnuts and mix well until batter is smooth. Bake in buttered loaf pan (9 1/2 x 5-inch) at 350° for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Apple Cobbler
directions: Mix apples, 3 tablespoons sugar and cinnamon into bowl.
Put into a 9-inch square baking pan.
Combine flour, 1 cup sugar, oleo, baking powder and egg into a bowl.
Spread on top of apple mixture.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Apple Cobbler. Mix apples, 3 tablespoons sugar and cinnamon into bowl. Put into a 9-inch square baking pan. Combine flour, 1 cup sugar, oleo, baking powder and egg into a bowl. Spread on top of apple mixture. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Dessert Coffee Cake
directions: Cream shortening, sugar and vanilla.
Add egg.
Beat.
Add dry ingredients alternating with milk.
Spread half of mixture in greased 8-inch pan.
Cover with Date Filling.
Add remaining batter.
recipes.text: Dessert Coffee Cake. Cream shortening, sugar and vanilla. Add egg. Beat. Add dry ingredients alternating with milk. Spread half of mixture in greased 8-inch pan. Cover with Date Filling. Add remaining batter.

recipes.title: Quiche
directions: Cook bacon and break into pieces. Mix all ingredients and put into pie shells. Bake at 350 degrees for 40 minutes.
recipes.text: Quiche. Cook bacon and break into pieces. Mix all ingredients and put into pie shells. Bake at 350 degrees for 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Make Ahead Mashed Potatoes
directions: Peel potatoes and slice into salt water.
Cover and cook until tender; drain well.
Mash or beat with beater.
Add remaining ingredients.
(May add 2 tablespoons chopped chives, if desired.) Place in large casserole dish and dab with more butter.
Sprinkle with paprika for garnish.
recipes.text: Make Ahead Mashed Potatoes. Peel potatoes and slice into salt water. Cover and cook until tender; drain well. Mash or beat with beater. Add remaining ingredients. (May add 2 tablespoons chopped chives, if desired.) Place in large casserole dish and dab with more butter. Sprinkle with paprika for garnish.

recipes.title: Janet'S Salad Dressing
ingredients: 1 (10 3/4 oz.) can cream of mushroom soup
directions: In blender, combine soup (as in the can), onion, cheese, Worcestershire, vinegar, paprika and 1/8 teaspoon pepper.
Blend until all combined.
Through hole in lid or take cover off, gradually add oil in slowly.
Chill in refrigerator 15 minutes to 1/2 hour or longer.
Serve over your favorite salad.
recipes.text: Janet'S Salad Dressing. In blender, combine soup (as in the can), onion, cheese, Worcestershire, vinegar, paprika and 1/8 teaspoon pepper. Blend until all combined. Through hole in lid or take cover off, gradually add oil in slowly. Chill in refrigerator 15 minutes to 1/2 hour or longer. Serve over your favorite salad.

recipes.title: Baked Corn
directions: Mix all ingredients thoroughly in a large bowl.
Pour into a buttered 9 x 13-inch cake pan.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Baked Corn. Mix all ingredients thoroughly in a large bowl. Pour into a buttered 9 x 13-inch cake pan. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Mexican Fiesta Omelet
directions: Spray a skillet with nonstick cooking spray.
Add bell peppers and onion; saute until onion in translucent.
Add tomato and basil and mix well.
Saute another minute.
Remove from pan and keep warm.
recipes.text: Mexican Fiesta Omelet. Spray a skillet with nonstick cooking spray. Add bell peppers and onion; saute until onion in translucent. Add tomato and basil and mix well. Saute another minute. Remove from pan and keep warm.

recipes.title: No Cook Peanut Butter Fudge
directions: Line a 9-inch square pan with foil.
Chop peanuts.
Melt chocolate chips in a double boiler and pour into a bowl.
Melt peanut butter chips in double boiler.
Beat together cream cheese, sugar, milk and vanilla.
Beat melted peanut butter chips into cream cheese.
Press half the fudge into bottom of pan.
Cover remaining mixture to prevent drying out.
Spread melted chocolate over fudge in pan.
Freeze 5 minutes to set quickly.
Press remaining fudge over chocolate.
When set, cut into small squares.
recipes.text: No Cook Peanut Butter Fudge. Line a 9-inch square pan with foil. Chop peanuts. Melt chocolate chips in a double boiler and pour into a bowl. Melt peanut butter chips in double boiler. Beat together cream cheese, sugar, milk and vanilla. Beat melted peanut butter chips into cream cheese. Press half the fudge into bottom of pan. Cover remaining mixture to prevent drying out. Spread melted chocolate over fudge in pan. Freeze 5 minutes to set quickly. Press remaining fudge over chocolate. When set, cut into small squares.

recipes.title: Peaches And Cream Dessert
directions: Stir together flour, pudding mix and baking powder.
Combine egg, milk and melted butter.
Add this to dry ingredients and mix well.
Spread mixture into greased pan.
Drain peaches and reserve liquid.
Chop peaches and sprinkle onto batter.
Beat together cream cheese, 1/2 cup sugar and peach liquid.
Pour this over peaches.
Combine other tablespoon sugar with cinnamon and sprinkle over top.
Bake in a 350° oven for 45 minutes.
Let cool.
recipes.text: Peaches And Cream Dessert. Stir together flour, pudding mix and baking powder. Combine egg, milk and melted butter. Add this to dry ingredients and mix well. Spread mixture into greased pan. Drain peaches and reserve liquid. Chop peaches and sprinkle onto batter. Beat together cream cheese, 1/2 cup sugar and peach liquid. Pour this over peaches. Combine other tablespoon sugar with cinnamon and sprinkle over top. Bake in a 350° oven for 45 minutes. Let cool.

recipes.title: Sandwich Spread
directions: Put all vegetables through food chopper.
Mix well, cook 30 minutes.
Put into jars and seal while hot.
recipes.text: Sandwich Spread. Put all vegetables through food chopper. Mix well, cook 30 minutes. Put into jars and seal while hot.

recipes.title: Grannie'S Chicken Casserole
directions: Cook
chicken breasts.	Cut into small pieces.	Mix all ingredients
together
except cracker crumbs.
If desired, add 1/2 cup chopped celery.
Layer in casserole dish and sprinkle cracker crumbs on top.
Cook, covered at 350° until bubbling.
recipes.text: Grannie'S Chicken Casserole. Cook chicken breasts.	Cut into small pieces.	Mix all ingredients together except cracker crumbs. If desired, add 1/2 cup chopped celery. Layer in casserole dish and sprinkle cracker crumbs on top. Cook, covered at 350° until bubbling.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Pie
directions: Mix powdered sugar and peanut butter together to coarse meal consistency.
Mix and cook next 7 ingredients, over low heat to pudding consistency.
recipes.text: Peanut Butter Pie. Mix powdered sugar and peanut butter together to coarse meal consistency. Mix and cook next 7 ingredients, over low heat to pudding consistency.

recipes.title: Meat Loaf
directions: Mix ingredients well.
Make loaf and bake 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Meat Loaf. Mix ingredients well. Make loaf and bake 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Crescent Cookies
directions: Cream butter and sugar together.
Mix in other ingredients. Using one teaspoon of dough at a time, roll in hand and shape in the form of a crescent moon.
Bake in preheated 325° oven until golden.
recipes.text: Crescent Cookies. Cream butter and sugar together. Mix in other ingredients. Using one teaspoon of dough at a time, roll in hand and shape in the form of a crescent moon. Bake in preheated 325° oven until golden.

recipes.title: Butterscotch Candy
directions: Boil oleo, milk and sugar 6 minutes.
Chop marshmallows; dissolve.
Add pecans.
Drop on waxed pepper or pour into 9 x 11-inch greased pan.
recipes.text: Butterscotch Candy. Boil oleo, milk and sugar 6 minutes. Chop marshmallows; dissolve. Add pecans. Drop on waxed pepper or pour into 9 x 11-inch greased pan.

recipes.title: Barbecue Beef
ingredients: 1 bottle chili sauce or 2 c. catsup
directions: Brown meat in fat. Add rest of ingredients.
Cook at 250° for 2 hours. Serve on toasted hamburger buns.
recipes.text: Barbecue Beef. Brown meat in fat. Add rest of ingredients. Cook at 250° for 2 hours. Serve on toasted hamburger buns.

recipes.title: Dip For Raw Vegetables
ingredients: 1 pkg. Hidden Valley Ranch house dressing
directions: Use on broccoli, cauliflower, mushrooms, celery, radishes, carrots and green onions.
recipes.text: Dip For Raw Vegetables. Use on broccoli, cauliflower, mushrooms, celery, radishes, carrots and green onions.

recipes.title: Scratch Italian Sauce
directions: Peel and seed tomatoes. Chop up and set aside.
Saute green onions, green peppers and garlic.
Pour in tomatoes and spices. Simmer on low for at least 1 1/2 hours, covered.
Serve on pasta or grilled chicken.
recipes.text: Scratch Italian Sauce. Peel and seed tomatoes. Chop up and set aside. Saute green onions, green peppers and garlic. Pour in tomatoes and spices. Simmer on low for at least 1 1/2 hours, covered. Serve on pasta or grilled chicken.

recipes.title: Whip Cream Cake
directions: Cream butter and sugar well.
Add
eggs, one at a time. Beat after each addition.
Add
flour and whipped cream gradually. Add flavoring and
beat
until
creamy.
Pour
into
a 10-inch tube pan.
Bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours.
recipes.text: Whip Cream Cake. Cream butter and sugar well. Add eggs, one at a time. Beat after each addition. Add flour and whipped cream gradually. Add flavoring and beat until creamy. Pour into a 10-inch tube pan. Bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours.

recipes.title: Butter Rolls
ingredients: 1-2 tsp. (1/4 -1/2 inch pat) butter, per biscuit
directions: On a floured surface, roll out each biscuit into a flat circle approximately 6 inches in diameter. Add butter, sugar and vanilla to center of the circle. Fold dough up around ingredients. Place rolls in a baking pan (about 2 inches deep) with fold against bottom of pan. Pour milk over rolls until half way up on sides of rolls. Bake in 325° oven until tops of biscuits are crispy brown. Serve, spooning milk mixture over rolls.
recipes.text: Butter Rolls. On a floured surface, roll out each biscuit into a flat circle approximately 6 inches in diameter. Add butter, sugar and vanilla to center of the circle. Fold dough up around ingredients. Place rolls in a baking pan (about 2 inches deep) with fold against bottom of pan. Pour milk over rolls until half way up on sides of rolls. Bake in 325° oven until tops of biscuits are crispy brown. Serve, spooning milk mixture over rolls.

recipes.title: Potluck Potatoes
directions: Cook potatoes whole, cool and peel, then dice.
Add the remaining ingredients with enough milk so they aren't stuffy.
Mix together corn flakes and oleo and put on top.
This makes enough for 30 people.
recipes.text: Potluck Potatoes. Cook potatoes whole, cool and peel, then dice. Add the remaining ingredients with enough milk so they aren't stuffy. Mix together corn flakes and oleo and put on top. This makes enough for 30 people.

recipes.title: Layered Zucchini Casserole
directions: Fry bacon and onion in skillet; remove.
Saute mushrooms next; remove.
Saute zucchini; remove.
Fry eggplant last, it takes longer.
Put all cooked vegetables back in pan and sprinkle with flour.
Stir in fresh tomato chunks, garlic, basil, salt and pepper.
In large casserole dish, layer vegetables, bacon, cheese, vegetables, bacon and cheese.
Add almonds if desired.
Bake at 400° for 20 minutes.
recipes.text: Layered Zucchini Casserole. Fry bacon and onion in skillet; remove. Saute mushrooms next; remove. Saute zucchini; remove. Fry eggplant last, it takes longer. Put all cooked vegetables back in pan and sprinkle with flour. Stir in fresh tomato chunks, garlic, basil, salt and pepper. In large casserole dish, layer vegetables, bacon, cheese, vegetables, bacon and cheese. Add almonds if desired. Bake at 400° for 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Easy Chicken Wings
directions: Marinate chicken wings with ingredients for at least 1 hour. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Easy Chicken Wings. Marinate chicken wings with ingredients for at least 1 hour. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Doctor Bird Cake
ingredients: 1 (8 oz.) can crushed pineapple with juice
directions: Measure flour, baking soda, cinnamon, sugar and salt and sift together. Dice bananas and measure 2 cups. Add bananas to dry ingredients, along with oil, pineapple with juice, vanilla and eggs. Stir to blend mixture; do not beat. Pour into a greased 9-inch tube pan or Bundt pan. Bake at 350° for 1 hour and 20 minutes. Set aside to cool on a rack without removing from pan.
recipes.text: Doctor Bird Cake. Measure flour, baking soda, cinnamon, sugar and salt and sift together. Dice bananas and measure 2 cups. Add bananas to dry ingredients, along with oil, pineapple with juice, vanilla and eggs. Stir to blend mixture; do not beat. Pour into a greased 9-inch tube pan or Bundt pan. Bake at 350° for 1 hour and 20 minutes. Set aside to cool on a rack without removing from pan.

recipes.title: Irish Soda Bread
ingredients: 1 c. dark seedless raisins or currants
directions: In a large bowl, mix 4 cups flour with the baking powder, soda, salt, sugar and caraway seed.
Add raisins and mix with fingers to separate them.
Add milk and mix with a fork until mixture forms a dough.
Sprinkle about 1/4 cup more flour on a board or counter.
Turn out dough and knead for about 5 minutes, working in the flour from the board and forming the dough into a smooth rond loaf.
If sticky, add more flour.
recipes.text: Irish Soda Bread. In a large bowl, mix 4 cups flour with the baking powder, soda, salt, sugar and caraway seed. Add raisins and mix with fingers to separate them. Add milk and mix with a fork until mixture forms a dough. Sprinkle about 1/4 cup more flour on a board or counter. Turn out dough and knead for about 5 minutes, working in the flour from the board and forming the dough into a smooth rond loaf. If sticky, add more flour.

recipes.title: Junior'S Bacon Beans
directions: In medium-large frying pan add oil and bacon; cook over medium-high until bacon is half cooked, then add fresh green beans and stir-fry for 5 to 8 minutes.
Add garlic salt and soy sauce; stir-fry for 3 to 4 more minutes.
After 8 to 12 minutes, beans are ready to be served.
Makes 5 to 6 servings.
recipes.text: Junior'S Bacon Beans. In medium-large frying pan add oil and bacon; cook over medium-high until bacon is half cooked, then add fresh green beans and stir-fry for 5 to 8 minutes. Add garlic salt and soy sauce; stir-fry for 3 to 4 more minutes. After 8 to 12 minutes, beans are ready to be served. Makes 5 to 6 servings.

recipes.title: Cream Puffs
directions: Preheat oven to 400°.
Heat water and butter to rolling boil. Stir in flour.
Stir vigorously over low heat about 1 minute or until mixture forms a ball.
Remove from heat.
Beat in eggs, all at one time; continue beating until smooth.
Drop dough by scant 1/4 cupfuls 3 inches apart on ungreased cookie sheet.
Bake 35 to 40 minutes until puffed and golden.
Cool away from draft.
Cut off tops.
Pull out any filaments of soft dough.
Fill with Cool Whip or vanilla pudding.
Dust with powdered sugar!
recipes.text: Cream Puffs. Preheat oven to 400°. Heat water and butter to rolling boil. Stir in flour. Stir vigorously over low heat about 1 minute or until mixture forms a ball. Remove from heat. Beat in eggs, all at one time; continue beating until smooth. Drop dough by scant 1/4 cupfuls 3 inches apart on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake 35 to 40 minutes until puffed and golden. Cool away from draft. Cut off tops. Pull out any filaments of soft dough. Fill with Cool Whip or vanilla pudding. Dust with powdered sugar!

recipes.title: Crab Toast Appetizers
ingredients: 1 (5 oz.) jar sharp pasteurized process cheese spread
directions: Beat cheese, butter and mayonnaise until smooth;
blend in crab meat.	(May be made ahead and refrigerated.) Spread on each toasted muffin half.
Bake	in a 350° oven for 5 minutes, then broil several
minutes, until lightly browned and bubbly. Cut each into quarters; sprinkle with paprika.
Serve hot.
recipes.text: Crab Toast Appetizers. Beat cheese, butter and mayonnaise until smooth; blend in crab meat.	(May be made ahead and refrigerated.) Spread on each toasted muffin half. Bake	in a 350° oven for 5 minutes, then broil several minutes, until lightly browned and bubbly. Cut each into quarters; sprinkle with paprika. Serve hot.

recipes.title: Darby'S Chicken Breasts
ingredients: 6 small slices cooked ham (boiled ham may be used)
directions: Place the chicken on the ham and roll up.
Hold this in place with toothpicks.
Place in shallow baking dish and cover with
the Durkee
and soup, mixed together.	Cover the baking dish with foil and bake at 350° for 2 hours.	Serves 6.
More breasts can be added.
recipes.text: Darby'S Chicken Breasts. Place the chicken on the ham and roll up. Hold this in place with toothpicks. Place in shallow baking dish and cover with the Durkee and soup, mixed together.	Cover the baking dish with foil and bake at 350° for 2 hours.	Serves 6. More breasts can be added.

recipes.title: Cabbage Salad
directions: Shred cabbage with knife.
Cut onions in rings.
Layer cabbage and onion.
In medium saucepan, bring vinegar, sugar, salt, pepper and celery salt to a boil.
Remove from heat, add oil.
Stir to mix.
Pour over cabbage and onion.
Cover with Saran Wrap; immediately refrigerate for 24 hours.
recipes.text: Cabbage Salad. Shred cabbage with knife. Cut onions in rings. Layer cabbage and onion. In medium saucepan, bring vinegar, sugar, salt, pepper and celery salt to a boil. Remove from heat, add oil. Stir to mix. Pour over cabbage and onion. Cover with Saran Wrap; immediately refrigerate for 24 hours.

recipes.title: Chicken And Broccoli Au Gratin
ingredients: 1 (10 oz.) pkg. frozen broccoli spears, cooked and drained
directions: Melt butter in skillet.
Saute onion. Remove from heat.
Stir in flour, salt, poultry seasoning and pepper. Drain mushrooms reserving liquid.
Add water to make 1/2 cup liquid.
Gradually stir into flour mixture.
Blend in milk until smooth.

Add mushrooms and cook over medium heat until sauce begins to thicken. Arrange broccoli spears and chicken pieces in bottom of a 13 x 9-inch baking dish. Pour sauce over and top with cheese. Bake at 375° for 30 minutes or until bubbly around edges.
recipes.text: Chicken And Broccoli Au Gratin. Melt butter in skillet. Saute onion. Remove from heat. Stir in flour, salt, poultry seasoning and pepper. Drain mushrooms reserving liquid. Add water to make 1/2 cup liquid. Gradually stir into flour mixture. Blend in milk until smooth. Add mushrooms and cook over medium heat until sauce begins to thicken. Arrange broccoli spears and chicken pieces in bottom of a 13 x 9-inch baking dish. Pour sauce over and top with cheese. Bake at 375° for 30 minutes or until bubbly around edges.

recipes.title: Daddy'S Key Lime Pie
ingredients: 1/2 c. lime juice (use Key lime juice if at all possible)
directions: Beat egg yolks until light and thick.
Blend in lime juice, then milk, stirring until mixture thickens.
If desired green food coloring may be used.
Pour mixture into baked pie shell (either graham cracker crust or pastry crust).
Beat egg whites with cream of tartar until stiff.
Gradually beat in sugar, beating until glossy peaks form.
Spread egg whites over surface of pie to edge of crust.
Bake in 350° oven until golden brown (about 20 minutes). Chill before serving.
recipes.text: Daddy'S Key Lime Pie. Beat egg yolks until light and thick. Blend in lime juice, then milk, stirring until mixture thickens. If desired green food coloring may be used. Pour mixture into baked pie shell (either graham cracker crust or pastry crust). Beat egg whites with cream of tartar until stiff. Gradually beat in sugar, beating until glossy peaks form. Spread egg whites over surface of pie to edge of crust. Bake in 350° oven until golden brown (about 20 minutes). Chill before serving.

recipes.title: Toffee Fantasy Pie
ingredients: 1 (3 1/2 oz.) pkg. instant vanilla pudding mix
1 (6 oz.) pkg. English toffee bits, divided
1 (8 oz.) container nondairy whipped topping, thawed
1 (9-inch) single crust pie shell, baked and cooled
directions: Place milk and pudding mix in a large bowl.
Beat with wire whip until well blended, about 1 minute.
Let stand 5 minutes. Set aside 1/4 cup toffee bits.
Gently fold remaining toffee bits and whipped topping into pudding.
Pour mixture into pie shell. Sprinkle with reserved toffee bits.
Freeze at least 6 hours. Remove from freezer; let stand 10 minutes to soften before serving.
Yield:
8 to 10 servings.
recipes.text: Toffee Fantasy Pie. Place milk and pudding mix in a large bowl. Beat with wire whip until well blended, about 1 minute. Let stand 5 minutes. Set aside 1/4 cup toffee bits. Gently fold remaining toffee bits and whipped topping into pudding. Pour mixture into pie shell. Sprinkle with reserved toffee bits. Freeze at least 6 hours. Remove from freezer; let stand 10 minutes to soften before serving. Yield: 8 to 10 servings.

recipes.title: Crab Appetizer
directions: Mix in small mixer bowl.
Spread on 12 English muffin halves. Quarter.
Broil about 5 minutes until browned.
If not wanting to use right away, freeze on flat pan.
Store in freezer bags.
recipes.text: Crab Appetizer. Mix in small mixer bowl. Spread on 12 English muffin halves. Quarter. Broil about 5 minutes until browned. If not wanting to use right away, freeze on flat pan. Store in freezer bags.

recipes.title: Punch Bowl Cake
ingredients: 2 cans cherry pie filling or blueberry pie filling
directions: You will need an 8 1/2-quart punch bowl.
recipes.text: Punch Bowl Cake. You will need an 8 1/2-quart punch bowl.

recipes.title: Cavatina
ingredients: 8 oz. mixed pastas (at least 4 different types, such as small shells, small corkscrews, small elbow macaroni, thin egg noodles, etc.)
directions: Mix the different pasta together and cook in boiling water until tender.
While pasta is cooking, brown ground beef in skillet.
Remove beef from skillet and use drippings to saute bell pepper and onion slices until tender.
Add mushroom slices and heat thoroughly.
Drain off excess drippings from vegetables.
In large casserole dish, layer the following:
Pasta mixture, vegetables, beef, pepperoni, cheese and sauce.
Repeat layers, ending with cheese on top.
Bake at 350° until thoroughly heated and cheese is melted.
Serve with French bread and a green salad.
Serves 8.
recipes.text: Cavatina. Mix the different pasta together and cook in boiling water until tender. While pasta is cooking, brown ground beef in skillet. Remove beef from skillet and use drippings to saute bell pepper and onion slices until tender. Add mushroom slices and heat thoroughly. Drain off excess drippings from vegetables. In large casserole dish, layer the following: Pasta mixture, vegetables, beef, pepperoni, cheese and sauce. Repeat layers, ending with cheese on top. Bake at 350° until thoroughly heated and cheese is melted. Serve with French bread and a green salad. Serves 8.

recipes.title: Texas Food Cake
directions: Preheat the oven to 325° and set a rack in the middle level. Butter and flour a 10-inch tube pan.
recipes.text: Texas Food Cake. Preheat the oven to 325° and set a rack in the middle level. Butter and flour a 10-inch tube pan.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Candy
directions: Boil sugar and milk in saucepan.
Bring to a soft ball stage. Combine other ingredients in small bowl.
Add hot mixture and beat until smooth.
Pour into buttered pan.
recipes.text: Peanut Butter Candy. Boil sugar and milk in saucepan. Bring to a soft ball stage. Combine other ingredients in small bowl. Add hot mixture and beat until smooth. Pour into buttered pan.

recipes.title: Chocolate Fudge
directions: In a double boiler, melt almond bark.
Add can of Eagle Brand milk; mix well.
Remove from heat.
Add chopped pecans.
Pour into a buttered dish until set.
It will set fast!
Cut into squares and eat it all up!!
recipes.text: Chocolate Fudge. In a double boiler, melt almond bark. Add can of Eagle Brand milk; mix well. Remove from heat. Add chopped pecans. Pour into a buttered dish until set. It will set fast! Cut into squares and eat it all up!!

recipes.title: Chicken Stuffing Bake
ingredients: 1 pkg. each: chopped carrots, celery and onion
1 (10 1/2 oz.) can cream of mushroom soup
directions: First Step:
Preheat oven to 400°.
Prepare stuffing mix according to package directions, but add vegetables with seasoning packet.
Combine soup, milk and parsley; set aside.
recipes.text: Chicken Stuffing Bake. First Step: Preheat oven to 400°. Prepare stuffing mix according to package directions, but add vegetables with seasoning packet. Combine soup, milk and parsley; set aside.

recipes.title: Hush Puppies
directions: Mix all ingredients.
Drop by teaspoon into hot cooking oil. Cook until golden brown, about 3 minutes.
Makes 24.
recipes.text: Hush Puppies. Mix all ingredients. Drop by teaspoon into hot cooking oil. Cook until golden brown, about 3 minutes. Makes 24.

recipes.title: Elda'S "Bride'S Cocoa Cake"
directions: Place dry ingredients in a flour sifter and sift 4 times. Combine eggs, vanilla and sour cream in a bowl and beat together very well.
Add the flour mixture.
Bake at 350°.
recipes.text: Elda'S "Bride'S Cocoa Cake". Place dry ingredients in a flour sifter and sift 4 times. Combine eggs, vanilla and sour cream in a bowl and beat together very well. Add the flour mixture. Bake at 350°.

recipes.title: Refreshing Jello
directions: Boil nectar.
Add jello; stir until dissolved.
Pour half the mixture into mold; set.
Spoon on sour cream.
Add evaporated milk to remaining jello mixture; pour onto sour cream.
Set and enjoy.
recipes.text: Refreshing Jello. Boil nectar. Add jello; stir until dissolved. Pour half the mixture into mold; set. Spoon on sour cream. Add evaporated milk to remaining jello mixture; pour onto sour cream. Set and enjoy.

recipes.title: Party Punch
directions: Mix all ingredients; mix well.
Makes about 2 1/2 gallons.
recipes.text: Party Punch. Mix all ingredients; mix well. Makes about 2 1/2 gallons.

recipes.title: Peanut Patties
directions: Cook the first 5 ingredients until soft balls form in cold water.
Remove from heat. Add the peanuts or pecans.
Put back on heat and let form soft ball again.
Stir good.
Pour into buttered muffin pan or drop on wax paper.
Makes about 20 to 24.
recipes.text: Peanut Patties. Cook the first 5 ingredients until soft balls form in cold water. Remove from heat. Add the peanuts or pecans. Put back on heat and let form soft ball again. Stir good. Pour into buttered muffin pan or drop on wax paper. Makes about 20 to 24.

recipes.title: Slow Cooker Spaghetti Sauce
directions: Brown ground beef in frypan;
drain grease.
