Place into crock-pot.
Add onions, garlic, salt, pepper, oregano, parsley flakes and
mushrooms.
Stir
thoroughly
with fork until well blended.
Add
tomato
sauce,
tomato
puree, tomato paste and tomatoes;
blend together thoroughly and cover.
Cook on (low) setting 12 to
15 hours.
Cook on (high) setting 4 to 7 hours, stirring occasionally.
recipes.text: Slow Cooker Spaghetti Sauce. Brown ground beef in frypan; drain grease. Place into crock-pot. Add onions, garlic, salt, pepper, oregano, parsley flakes and mushrooms. Stir thoroughly with fork until well blended. Add tomato sauce, tomato puree, tomato paste and tomatoes; blend together thoroughly and cover. Cook on (low) setting 12 to 15 hours. Cook on (high) setting 4 to 7 hours, stirring occasionally.

recipes.title: Chicken Casserole
directions: Mix ingredients and pour over dressing mix.
Sprinkle remaining dressing mix over and pour 1 can cream of chicken soup (undiluted) over.
Bake 45 minutes at 325°.
Sprinkle 3/4 cup grated cheese over top the last 10 minutes of baking.
recipes.text: Chicken Casserole. Mix ingredients and pour over dressing mix. Sprinkle remaining dressing mix over and pour 1 can cream of chicken soup (undiluted) over. Bake 45 minutes at 325°. Sprinkle 3/4 cup grated cheese over top the last 10 minutes of baking.

recipes.title: Swiss Chicken Casserole
ingredients: 2 c. toasted bread cubes or croutons
directions: Combine chicken, celery, onion and cheese.
Mix together the salad dressing, salt and milk.
Pour over chicken mixture.
Add bread cubes; mix well.
Place in greased casserole dish.
Sprinkle with slivered almonds or crushed potato chips.
Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes, or until cheese bubbles through.
recipes.text: Swiss Chicken Casserole. Combine chicken, celery, onion and cheese. Mix together the salad dressing, salt and milk. Pour over chicken mixture. Add bread cubes; mix well. Place in greased casserole dish. Sprinkle with slivered almonds or crushed potato chips. Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes, or until cheese bubbles through.

recipes.title: Dream Bars
directions: Combine flour, 1/2 cup brown sugar and margarine until particles are fine (use low speed of mixer).
Press into 9 x 13-inch pan.
Bake at 350° for 15 minutes.
Beat 1 1/2 cups brown sugar with eggs until blended.
Mix in remaining ingredients and spread over partially baked crust.
Bake 20 to 25 minutes or until golden brown.
When cold cut into squares with sharp knife.
recipes.text: Dream Bars. Combine flour, 1/2 cup brown sugar and margarine until particles are fine (use low speed of mixer). Press into 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350° for 15 minutes. Beat 1 1/2 cups brown sugar with eggs until blended. Mix in remaining ingredients and spread over partially baked crust. Bake 20 to 25 minutes or until golden brown. When cold cut into squares with sharp knife.

recipes.title: Chili
ingredients: 1 1/2 lb. lean ground beef, browned and drained
2 cans Luck's pinto beans with liquid
directions: Add ingredients in this order, stirring well after each in a large
pot.
Simmer
at least one hour,
stirring often. Serves 6 to 8.
recipes.text: Chili. Add ingredients in this order, stirring well after each in a large pot. Simmer at least one hour, stirring often. Serves 6 to 8.

recipes.title: King Ranch Chicken
directions: Saute onion and pepper in butter until brown.
Add soups, Ro-Tel and chicken; simmer until heated.
Grease large casserole dish and line with chips.
Pour mixture over chips.
Sprinkle with cheese and top with Durkee onions.
Bake at 325° for 30 minutes or until cheese is bubbly and melted.
recipes.text: King Ranch Chicken. Saute onion and pepper in butter until brown. Add soups, Ro-Tel and chicken; simmer until heated. Grease large casserole dish and line with chips. Pour mixture over chips. Sprinkle with cheese and top with Durkee onions. Bake at 325° for 30 minutes or until cheese is bubbly and melted.

recipes.title: Meat Pie Roma
directions: Brown meat and peppers.
Add spaghetti mix, tomato paste and water.
Cook for 10 minutes on low.
Place biscuits in greased Pyrex dish, and mash flat.
Then add layer of meat sauce, layer of cheese and repeat.
Bake at 350° for 15 minutes.
recipes.text: Meat Pie Roma. Brown meat and peppers. Add spaghetti mix, tomato paste and water. Cook for 10 minutes on low. Place biscuits in greased Pyrex dish, and mash flat. Then add layer of meat sauce, layer of cheese and repeat. Bake at 350° for 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Italian Hunter'S Stew
ingredients: 2 lb. chuck roast, cut in 2-inch pieces
directions: In large Dutch oven, heat salad oil.
Brown chuck lightly on all sides.
Add garlic and onions and saute well, turning frequently.
Now stir in tomato paste, flour, chili powder, oregano, rosemary, seasoned salt, tomatoes and parsley.
Add 1 cup water; simmer, covered, 1 hour and 15 minutes.
Skim off fat, if necessary.
Now add carrots.
Simmer until carrots are tender.
recipes.text: Italian Hunter'S Stew. In large Dutch oven, heat salad oil. Brown chuck lightly on all sides. Add garlic and onions and saute well, turning frequently. Now stir in tomato paste, flour, chili powder, oregano, rosemary, seasoned salt, tomatoes and parsley. Add 1 cup water; simmer, covered, 1 hour and 15 minutes. Skim off fat, if necessary. Now add carrots. Simmer until carrots are tender.

recipes.title: Pecan Sandies
directions: Combine.
Chill for 1/2 hour.
Shape into balls.
Bake for 10 minutes at 325°.
recipes.text: Pecan Sandies. Combine. Chill for 1/2 hour. Shape into balls. Bake for 10 minutes at 325°.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Pie Squares
directions: Mix first 4 ingredients until crumbly and press in 13 x 9-inch pan.
Bake at 350° for 15 minutes.
recipes.text: Pumpkin Pie Squares. Mix first 4 ingredients until crumbly and press in 13 x 9-inch pan. Bake at 350° for 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Aunt Mag'S Caramel Pie
directions: Brown
sugar
and
flour in heavy iron skillet over low heat until it browns, stirring all the time.
Add the milk and stir until
thick
and all melted.
Add butter and cool.
Beat the egg yolks
until
they	are light and add while stirring. Add vanilla. When cool, stack between three cooked pie crusts like
cake filling.
Beat
egg
whites
until	stiff.	Add
8 teaspoons sugar,
one at a time.
Add vanilla.
Put on top and brown.
The crusts have no sides, just roll out 9 inches round and bake.
recipes.text: Aunt Mag'S Caramel Pie. Brown sugar and flour in heavy iron skillet over low heat until it browns, stirring all the time. Add the milk and stir until thick and all melted. Add butter and cool. Beat the egg yolks until they	are light and add while stirring. Add vanilla. When cool, stack between three cooked pie crusts like cake filling. Beat egg whites until	stiff.	Add 8 teaspoons sugar, one at a time. Add vanilla. Put on top and brown. The crusts have no sides, just roll out 9 inches round and bake.

recipes.title: Pork Chops With Orange Sauce
directions: Brown pork chops on both sides in a frying pan with a little oil.
Take pork chops out of frying pan.
Add all other ingredients and mix together.
Put pork chops back in frying pan and cover.
Simmer until done.
recipes.text: Pork Chops With Orange Sauce. Brown pork chops on both sides in a frying pan with a little oil. Take pork chops out of frying pan. Add all other ingredients and mix together. Put pork chops back in frying pan and cover. Simmer until done.

recipes.title: Pork Medallions
ingredients: 1 1/2 to 2 lb. pork tenderloin, cut into 1 1/2 to 2-inch slices
directions: Flatten slices with the heel of your hand.
Spread medallions on one side with mustard.
Saute in butter (mustard side first) for 5 minutes on each side.
Remove to warm platter.
Add beef broth and tarragon to pan and scrape up the drippings.
Simmer until half the liquid is gone.
Add half and half.
Simmer until thick.
Pour over meat and serve.
Serves 4 to 6.
recipes.text: Pork Medallions. Flatten slices with the heel of your hand. Spread medallions on one side with mustard. Saute in butter (mustard side first) for 5 minutes on each side. Remove to warm platter. Add beef broth and tarragon to pan and scrape up the drippings. Simmer until half the liquid is gone. Add half and half. Simmer until thick. Pour over meat and serve. Serves 4 to 6.

recipes.title: Five Layer Dinner
directions: Butter a deep baking dish.
Then start at the bottom and arrange in layers.
First potatoes, then the ground beef, onions, green pepper if used, uncooked rice and tomatoes.
Season each layer, cover and bake for 2 hours at 300°.
Parmesan cheese may be used on top.
recipes.text: Five Layer Dinner. Butter a deep baking dish. Then start at the bottom and arrange in layers. First potatoes, then the ground beef, onions, green pepper if used, uncooked rice and tomatoes. Season each layer, cover and bake for 2 hours at 300°. Parmesan cheese may be used on top.

recipes.title: Pancit Canton(Sauteed Noodles, Canton Style)
ingredients: 3 pieces dried mushrooms, soaked in warm water for 30 minutes
directions: Slice chicken breast thinly; sprinkle with 1 tablespoon of cornstarch and patis. Mix to coat chicken slices evenly and set aside.
Drain mushrooms.
Discard tough stems and slice thinly.
recipes.text: Pancit Canton(Sauteed Noodles, Canton Style). Slice chicken breast thinly; sprinkle with 1 tablespoon of cornstarch and patis. Mix to coat chicken slices evenly and set aside. Drain mushrooms. Discard tough stems and slice thinly.

recipes.title: Spinach Brownies
directions: Preheat oven to 350°.
Mix all ingredients together.
Place in greased 9-inch square pan.	Bake for 30 minutes.
Cut into squares and serve.	Good hot or cold.
Makes 8 servings.
recipes.text: Spinach Brownies. Preheat oven to 350°. Mix all ingredients together. Place in greased 9-inch square pan.	Bake for 30 minutes. Cut into squares and serve.	Good hot or cold. Makes 8 servings.

recipes.title: Whatniks
directions: Preheat oven to 275° and grease cookie sheets.
Sift together brown sugar, flour and salt.
Fold in egg white, vanilla and then pecans.
Drop by small rounds on greased cookie sheets.
Bake 15 to 20 minutes.
recipes.text: Whatniks. Preheat oven to 275° and grease cookie sheets. Sift together brown sugar, flour and salt. Fold in egg white, vanilla and then pecans. Drop by small rounds on greased cookie sheets. Bake 15 to 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Strawberry Jello
directions: Drain strawberries; reserve 1/2 cup juice.
Combine gelatin, sugar and salt in a bowl.
Add hot water.
Stir until dissolved completely.
Add cold water and reserve juice.
Chill until partially set.
Add whipped cream, strawberries and marshmallows.
recipes.text: Strawberry Jello. Drain strawberries; reserve 1/2 cup juice. Combine gelatin, sugar and salt in a bowl. Add hot water. Stir until dissolved completely. Add cold water and reserve juice. Chill until partially set. Add whipped cream, strawberries and marshmallows.

recipes.title: Chicken Crunch
ingredients: 1 (10 3/4 oz.) can cream of mushroom soup
directions: Reserve a few onions for topping.
Mix remaining ingredients together and place in baking dish.
Top with onions.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Chicken Crunch. Reserve a few onions for topping. Mix remaining ingredients together and place in baking dish. Top with onions. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Cranberry Mint Tea
directions: Combine tea bags and water.
Steep 5 minutes.
Remove and discard tea bags.
Let cool.
Stir in cranberry juice.
Serve over ice.
recipes.text: Cranberry Mint Tea. Combine tea bags and water. Steep 5 minutes. Remove and discard tea bags. Let cool. Stir in cranberry juice. Serve over ice.

recipes.title: Clam Dip
directions: Rub inside of small bowl with cut clove of garlic.
Blend cream cheese with seasonings.
Add clams which have been drained and chopped.
Add clam juice.
Put in a bowl and chill.
recipes.text: Clam Dip. Rub inside of small bowl with cut clove of garlic. Blend cream cheese with seasonings. Add clams which have been drained and chopped. Add clam juice. Put in a bowl and chill.

recipes.title: Fruit Salad
directions: Combine all ingredients and mix well.
Serve with your favorite salad dressing.
Serves 10 to 12 people.
recipes.text: Fruit Salad. Combine all ingredients and mix well. Serve with your favorite salad dressing. Serves 10 to 12 people.

recipes.title: Cherry Crunch
ingredients: 1 (9 oz.) box Jiffy yellow cake mix
1 qt. Land O Lakes butter, melted
directions: In 1 1/2 to 2-quart Pyrex dish, spread pie filling.
Spread cake mix over pie filling.
Cover cake mix with nuts.
Melt butter and pour evenly over nuts.
Bake in a 350° oven until top is brown and juice is coming to the top, about 40 minutes.
recipes.text: Cherry Crunch. In 1 1/2 to 2-quart Pyrex dish, spread pie filling. Spread cake mix over pie filling. Cover cake mix with nuts. Melt butter and pour evenly over nuts. Bake in a 350° oven until top is brown and juice is coming to the top, about 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Sweet Potato Pudding Cookies
ingredients: 1 (6 oz.) pkg. instant vanilla pudding mix
directions: Combine flour, oats, soda and cinnamon.
Set aside.
Cream butter, sugars and pudding mix.
Add eggs and vanilla.
Mix well. Alternately add dry ingredients and potatoes to mixture.
Bake on ungreased cookie sheet at 350° for 12 to 15 minutes.
You can also add 1 cup nuts or chocolate chips.
recipes.text: Sweet Potato Pudding Cookies. Combine flour, oats, soda and cinnamon. Set aside. Cream butter, sugars and pudding mix. Add eggs and vanilla. Mix well. Alternately add dry ingredients and potatoes to mixture. Bake on ungreased cookie sheet at 350° for 12 to 15 minutes. You can also add 1 cup nuts or chocolate chips.

recipes.title: Pink Stuff
directions: Place contents of the Eagle Brand milk in a large bowl followed by carton of Cool Whip, cherry pie filling and crushed pineapple (well drained).
recipes.text: Pink Stuff. Place contents of the Eagle Brand milk in a large bowl followed by carton of Cool Whip, cherry pie filling and crushed pineapple (well drained).

recipes.title: Cheese Crispies
directions: Mix flour, salt and cayenne pepper in bowl.
Cut in margarine until crumbly.
Add cheese, cereal and sesame seed; mix well. Shape by tablespoons into balls.
Flatten with fork on ungreased baking sheet.
Bake at 350° for 15 minutes.
Remove to wire rack. Serve warm or cool.
Store in covered container in refrigerator.
recipes.text: Cheese Crispies. Mix flour, salt and cayenne pepper in bowl. Cut in margarine until crumbly. Add cheese, cereal and sesame seed; mix well. Shape by tablespoons into balls. Flatten with fork on ungreased baking sheet. Bake at 350° for 15 minutes. Remove to wire rack. Serve warm or cool. Store in covered container in refrigerator.

recipes.title: Turtles
directions: Place 2 pecan halves on a cookie sheet.
Rest the individual caramel on top.
Fill sheet full and heat in a 275° oven for about 12 minutes (just until the caramel begins to soften).
Let cool. Melt chocolate over low heat and dip each piece in chocolate until coated. Place on waxed paper to set.
recipes.text: Turtles. Place 2 pecan halves on a cookie sheet. Rest the individual caramel on top. Fill sheet full and heat in a 275° oven for about 12 minutes (just until the caramel begins to soften). Let cool. Melt chocolate over low heat and dip each piece in chocolate until coated. Place on waxed paper to set.

recipes.title: Impossible Chicken And Broccoli Pie
ingredients: 1 whole chicken, cooked and boned or 2 (6 3/4 oz.) cans chicken
directions: Heat oven to 400°.
Layer chicken, broccoli and cheese in greased 9-inch pie plate.
Beat remaining ingredients (except topping) 15 seconds in blender on high or 1 minute with mixer. Pour into baking dish.
Bake 20 minutes.
Sprinkle with topping. Bake until knife inserted in center comes out clean, 15 to 20 minutes.
Cool 5 minutes.
recipes.text: Impossible Chicken And Broccoli Pie. Heat oven to 400°. Layer chicken, broccoli and cheese in greased 9-inch pie plate. Beat remaining ingredients (except topping) 15 seconds in blender on high or 1 minute with mixer. Pour into baking dish. Bake 20 minutes. Sprinkle with topping. Bake until knife inserted in center comes out clean, 15 to 20 minutes. Cool 5 minutes.

recipes.title: Cauliflower With Anchovy Sauce
directions: Trim the cauliflower, removing tough stems.
Cook it in boiling salted water until crisp-tender.
The water must barely touch the tips so that they do not break; drain.
Transfer to a serving dish and keep warm.
recipes.text: Cauliflower With Anchovy Sauce. Trim the cauliflower, removing tough stems. Cook it in boiling salted water until crisp-tender. The water must barely touch the tips so that they do not break; drain. Transfer to a serving dish and keep warm.

recipes.title: Mother'S Icebox Cookies
directions: Sift dry ingredients together.
Cream margarine and sugar. Add egg and mix well, then add dry ingredients and nuts.
Divide dough into 4 parts.
Shape into long rolls, each roll will be approximately 1-inch in diameter and about the length of the width of wax paper.
Bake at 375° for 11 minutes.
Yields 2 (1 pound) coffee cans.
A good cookie for mailing.
recipes.text: Mother'S Icebox Cookies. Sift dry ingredients together. Cream margarine and sugar. Add egg and mix well, then add dry ingredients and nuts. Divide dough into 4 parts. Shape into long rolls, each roll will be approximately 1-inch in diameter and about the length of the width of wax paper. Bake at 375° for 11 minutes. Yields 2 (1 pound) coffee cans. A good cookie for mailing.

recipes.title: Apple Cake
directions: Into a mixing bowl, sift flour, soda, cinnamon, nutmeg, salt and sugar.
Mix well and add cooking oil and eggs.
Beat well. Add vanilla.
Last, add chopped apples, nuts and raisins.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour and 15 minutes in 9-inch tube pan or 3 small loaf pans.
If loaf pans are used, cook 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Apple Cake. Into a mixing bowl, sift flour, soda, cinnamon, nutmeg, salt and sugar. Mix well and add cooking oil and eggs. Beat well. Add vanilla. Last, add chopped apples, nuts and raisins. Bake at 350° for 1 hour and 15 minutes in 9-inch tube pan or 3 small loaf pans. If loaf pans are used, cook 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Shrimp Butter
directions: Mix and chill.
Serve with crackers, bread cubes, etc.
recipes.text: Shrimp Butter. Mix and chill. Serve with crackers, bread cubes, etc.

recipes.title: Corn Bread Dressing
directions: In boiler, add chopped celery and onions, sage, black pepper, onion salt and garlic salt.
Cover with water.
Bake a cake of cornbread.
When cornbread is done and cool, crumble into bowl. When celery and onions are tender, mix with cornbread.
Add more sage to taste.
Bake in oven until top is brown.
recipes.text: Corn Bread Dressing. In boiler, add chopped celery and onions, sage, black pepper, onion salt and garlic salt. Cover with water. Bake a cake of cornbread. When cornbread is done and cool, crumble into bowl. When celery and onions are tender, mix with cornbread. Add more sage to taste. Bake in oven until top is brown.

recipes.title: Royal Coconut Cookies
directions: Sift flour, powder, soda and salt.
Add sugars, egg and flavoring.
Beat until smooth. Fold in oats and coconut.
Shape into small balls and place on greased cookie sheet.
Bake at 350° for 12 to 15 minutes.
Makes 3 dozen.
recipes.text: Royal Coconut Cookies. Sift flour, powder, soda and salt. Add sugars, egg and flavoring. Beat until smooth. Fold in oats and coconut. Shape into small balls and place on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350° for 12 to 15 minutes. Makes 3 dozen.

recipes.title: Slush Fruit
ingredients: 1 c. orange juice concentrate or juice of 4 oranges
1 1/2 c. ReaLemon or juice of 3 lemons
directions: Mix well
to dissolve the sugar.
Add crushed pineapple and juice.
Add bananas, grapes, cherries and blueberries.
recipes.text: Slush Fruit. Mix well to dissolve the sugar. Add crushed pineapple and juice. Add bananas, grapes, cherries and blueberries.

recipes.title: Patches(Mom'S Best)
directions: Mix together and roll on lightly floured board to 1/4-inch thick.
Cut into desired squares and drop into boiling meat broth (ham, chicken or beef).
Can have meat and cut up potatoes in same large pot.
Also known as slippery pot pie.
recipes.text: Patches(Mom'S Best). Mix together and roll on lightly floured board to 1/4-inch thick. Cut into desired squares and drop into boiling meat broth (ham, chicken or beef). Can have meat and cut up potatoes in same large pot. Also known as slippery pot pie.

recipes.title: Zucchini Soup
ingredients: 1 lb. unpeeled zucchini, cleaned and chopped
1 3/4 c. chicken broth or 3 bouillon cubes
directions: Chop unpeeled zucchini, shallots and garlic.
Put all 3 into a heavy frying pan.
Cook for 10 to 20 minutes (stir to keep from burning, you don't want it to be brown).
Put all ingredients into blender and blend.
Add table cream.
Heat and serve hot with croutons, or chill and serve cold with chives.
Makes 6 to 8 servings.
recipes.text: Zucchini Soup. Chop unpeeled zucchini, shallots and garlic. Put all 3 into a heavy frying pan. Cook for 10 to 20 minutes (stir to keep from burning, you don't want it to be brown). Put all ingredients into blender and blend. Add table cream. Heat and serve hot with croutons, or chill and serve cold with chives. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

recipes.title: Steak Diane(Serves 4)
directions: Preheat oil for five minutes at 375°.
Meanwhile, wipe steak with paper towels to remove excess moisture. Mix dry mustard, salt and pepper.
Sprinkle over one side of the steak and rub in.
recipes.text: Steak Diane(Serves 4). Preheat oil for five minutes at 375°. Meanwhile, wipe steak with paper towels to remove excess moisture. Mix dry mustard, salt and pepper. Sprinkle over one side of the steak and rub in.

recipes.title: Doughnuts Supreme
directions: Split doughnut.
Put slice of cheese between.
Add brown sugar on top and in doughnut hole.
Put cherry half (or whole) in center.
Put in oven or microwave until cheese and sugar melts.
recipes.text: Doughnuts Supreme. Split doughnut. Put slice of cheese between. Add brown sugar on top and in doughnut hole. Put cherry half (or whole) in center. Put in oven or microwave until cheese and sugar melts.

recipes.title: Pickled Garden Relish
ingredients: 4 oz. roasted red peppers or pimentos, drained and sliced
directions: Combine the vinegar, oil and seasonings in a large saucepan, stirring to dissolve sugar.
Add all other ingredients; toss to coat.
Bring to a boil on high heat; reduce to low and simmer, covered, for 10 to 20 minutes, or until cauliflower is crunchy but cooked.
Cool, then refrigerate a day before serving, stirring several times to marinate all ingredients equally.
Drain just before serving.
(Serve cold.)
recipes.text: Pickled Garden Relish. Combine the vinegar, oil and seasonings in a large saucepan, stirring to dissolve sugar. Add all other ingredients; toss to coat. Bring to a boil on high heat; reduce to low and simmer, covered, for 10 to 20 minutes, or until cauliflower is crunchy but cooked. Cool, then refrigerate a day before serving, stirring several times to marinate all ingredients equally. Drain just before serving. (Serve cold.)

recipes.title: Tartar Sauce
directions: Combine all ingredients and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to 1 hour before serving.
recipes.text: Tartar Sauce. Combine all ingredients and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to 1 hour before serving.

recipes.title: Baked Fish Delmar
ingredients: sole or perch fillets (1 pkg.), defrosted
directions: Combine butter, lemon juice, onions, salt and parsley flakes. Place single layer of fish in sprayed 8 x 11-inch baking pan. Pour mixture over and bake in preheated 325° oven for 20 to 25 minutes or until fish flakes easily with fork.
Ten minutes before finished, sprinkle paprika over fillets.
recipes.text: Baked Fish Delmar. Combine butter, lemon juice, onions, salt and parsley flakes. Place single layer of fish in sprayed 8 x 11-inch baking pan. Pour mixture over and bake in preheated 325° oven for 20 to 25 minutes or until fish flakes easily with fork. Ten minutes before finished, sprinkle paprika over fillets.

recipes.title: Vegetable Pizza
ingredients: 1 pkg. dry Ranch dressing (use amount desired, to taste)
directions: Press together the crescent rolls onto a cookie sheet or jelly roll pan (17 1/2 x 12 1/2-inch).
If there is extra dough, you can make a square and put it in a pie pan or whatever you might have. Bake according to directions until golden brown; cool.
Beat the cream cheese, dry dressing and mayonnaise with mixer.
Mix and spread onto cooled crust.
Add chopped raw vegetables, cut fine, to cover.
You may use any variation of the following:
carrots, cauliflower, green and red peppers, onions, broccoli, fresh mushrooms, red and white radishes, celery, green and black olives and cucumbers.
Grated sharp cheese and eggs may also be used, if desired.
Sprinkle celery seed over all.
Slightly press all vegetables into the mixture with a spatula when finished.
Make the day before; cover with plastic wrap.
Refrigerate.
recipes.text: Vegetable Pizza. Press together the crescent rolls onto a cookie sheet or jelly roll pan (17 1/2 x 12 1/2-inch). If there is extra dough, you can make a square and put it in a pie pan or whatever you might have. Bake according to directions until golden brown; cool. Beat the cream cheese, dry dressing and mayonnaise with mixer. Mix and spread onto cooled crust. Add chopped raw vegetables, cut fine, to cover. You may use any variation of the following: carrots, cauliflower, green and red peppers, onions, broccoli, fresh mushrooms, red and white radishes, celery, green and black olives and cucumbers. Grated sharp cheese and eggs may also be used, if desired. Sprinkle celery seed over all. Slightly press all vegetables into the mixture with a spatula when finished. Make the day before; cover with plastic wrap. Refrigerate.

recipes.title: Stuffed Chile Peppers
directions: Roast peppers on a skillet until well toasted.
Let them cool. Peel the crust off peppers; cut a slice off top of each pepper and scoop out insides.
Fill with slices of cheese, tomatoes and onions.
Whip up egg whites well, then add egg yolks and whip until foams up.
Dip stuffed chile peppers in the eggs and fry in a large frying pan in heated oil until slightly brown.
recipes.text: Stuffed Chile Peppers. Roast peppers on a skillet until well toasted. Let them cool. Peel the crust off peppers; cut a slice off top of each pepper and scoop out insides. Fill with slices of cheese, tomatoes and onions. Whip up egg whites well, then add egg yolks and whip until foams up. Dip stuffed chile peppers in the eggs and fry in a large frying pan in heated oil until slightly brown.

recipes.title: Seafood Pasta Salad
ingredients: 2 c. corkscrew pasta, cooked and drained
directions: Instead of this dressing, you can use Ranch dressing or creamy Italian dressing.
recipes.text: Seafood Pasta Salad. Instead of this dressing, you can use Ranch dressing or creamy Italian dressing.

recipes.title: Patty'S Zucchini Sauce
directions: Crush tomatoes in saucepan and set aside. Chop zucchini, onion and garlic in small pieces.
Saute in a Teflon frying pan with the oil, parsley and basil for about 10 minutes.
Add to the tomatoes and heat to boiling. Add the salt, pepper, lemon pepper, wine and cheese. Simmer, uncovered, for approximately 15 to 20 minutes. Serve over spaghetti.
recipes.text: Patty'S Zucchini Sauce. Crush tomatoes in saucepan and set aside. Chop zucchini, onion and garlic in small pieces. Saute in a Teflon frying pan with the oil, parsley and basil for about 10 minutes. Add to the tomatoes and heat to boiling. Add the salt, pepper, lemon pepper, wine and cheese. Simmer, uncovered, for approximately 15 to 20 minutes. Serve over spaghetti.

recipes.title: Sugarless Ice Cream(5 Quart Freezer)
ingredients: 30 pkg. Equal (do not substitute for other brands)
directions: In a large bowl, mix all ingredients together.
Pour into a blender and blend well.
Pour into a 5 quart freezer can.
Add enough water or skim milk to fill can to the fill line.
Freeze.
recipes.text: Sugarless Ice Cream(5 Quart Freezer). In a large bowl, mix all ingredients together. Pour into a blender and blend well. Pour into a 5 quart freezer can. Add enough water or skim milk to fill can to the fill line. Freeze.

recipes.title: Apple Crisp
ingredients: 2 lb. cooking apples, sliced and peeled (5 1/2 c.)
1/2 c. firmly packed light brown sugar
1/2 tsp. each: ground nutmeg and cinnamon
directions: Put apples in a shallow 2-quart casserole.
Add water. Combine sugars, nutmeg, cinnamon, salt and flour.
Cut in butter with a pastry blender.
Spoon evenly over apples.
Cover and bake in a preheated moderate oven (350°) for 30 minutes.
Uncover and bake for 30 minutes longer.
Makes 6 servings.
recipes.text: Apple Crisp. Put apples in a shallow 2-quart casserole. Add water. Combine sugars, nutmeg, cinnamon, salt and flour. Cut in butter with a pastry blender. Spoon evenly over apples. Cover and bake in a preheated moderate oven (350°) for 30 minutes. Uncover and bake for 30 minutes longer. Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Super Hot Bread
directions: Mix all dry ingredients; add liquids, then mix lightly. Spread in a greased 8 x 8-inch pan.
Bake at 400° for 15 minutes.
recipes.text: Super Hot Bread. Mix all dry ingredients; add liquids, then mix lightly. Spread in a greased 8 x 8-inch pan. Bake at 400° for 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Frozen Cucumbers
directions: Place cucumbers, onions and salt in bowl.
Refrigerate 2 hours.
Mix sugar and vinegar together until sugar is dissolved. Squeeze liquid from cucumbers.
Place in freezer bags; freeze up to 3 months.
recipes.text: Frozen Cucumbers. Place cucumbers, onions and salt in bowl. Refrigerate 2 hours. Mix sugar and vinegar together until sugar is dissolved. Squeeze liquid from cucumbers. Place in freezer bags; freeze up to 3 months.

recipes.title: Inexpensive Fruitcake
directions: Mix the first 6 ingredients and cloves, if used, in a saucepan. Bring to boil for 3 minutes. Cool. Then add a mixture of soda, salt and water. Sift together flour and baking powder and blend into cake. Grease or use Pam and spray the little size pans, 3 of them, or you can use big loaf pan, also. Bake at 325° for 45 minutes or until done.
recipes.text: Inexpensive Fruitcake. Mix the first 6 ingredients and cloves, if used, in a saucepan. Bring to boil for 3 minutes. Cool. Then add a mixture of soda, salt and water. Sift together flour and baking powder and blend into cake. Grease or use Pam and spray the little size pans, 3 of them, or you can use big loaf pan, also. Bake at 325° for 45 minutes or until done.

recipes.title: Butterfinger Cake
ingredients: 1 pkg. devil's food chocolate cake mix
directions: Bake cake according to package directions.
Bake in 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan.
Leave cake in pan.
Poke holes in warm cake with fork.
Spread caramel topping on cake while warm; let cool.
Make pudding according to package directions.
Put on cake.
Top pudding with 1/2 of crushed candy.
Top with Cool Whip.
Top with rest of candy.
Refrigerate.
recipes.text: Butterfinger Cake. Bake cake according to package directions. Bake in 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Leave cake in pan. Poke holes in warm cake with fork. Spread caramel topping on cake while warm; let cool. Make pudding according to package directions. Put on cake. Top pudding with 1/2 of crushed candy. Top with Cool Whip. Top with rest of candy. Refrigerate.

recipes.title: Cucumber Salad
directions: Peel cukes, slice or grate, also the onion.
Sprinkle with salt and set aside for 1 hour.
Squeeze a few at a time (discarding liquid).
Pour the vinegar, water, sugar, black pepper and green pepper and mix thoroughly. Add enough sour cream to make it a bit soupy. Sprinkle paprika on top before serving.
recipes.text: Cucumber Salad. Peel cukes, slice or grate, also the onion. Sprinkle with salt and set aside for 1 hour. Squeeze a few at a time (discarding liquid). Pour the vinegar, water, sugar, black pepper and green pepper and mix thoroughly. Add enough sour cream to make it a bit soupy. Sprinkle paprika on top before serving.

recipes.title: Rocky Road Squares
directions: Mix chips, butter and milk in double boiler.
Pour over peanuts and marshmallows.
Pour on waxed paper in baking dish. Refrigerate for 2 hours or overnight.
recipes.text: Rocky Road Squares. Mix chips, butter and milk in double boiler. Pour over peanuts and marshmallows. Pour on waxed paper in baking dish. Refrigerate for 2 hours or overnight.

recipes.title: Never Fail Peanut Butter Fudge
directions: Cook sugar and milk until soft ball forms in cold water.
Take off stove.
Add peanut butter and marshmallow cream; keep stirring.
Add vanilla.
Pour into a greased pan or platter to cool.
Cut into squares.
recipes.text: Never Fail Peanut Butter Fudge. Cook sugar and milk until soft ball forms in cold water. Take off stove. Add peanut butter and marshmallow cream; keep stirring. Add vanilla. Pour into a greased pan or platter to cool. Cut into squares.

recipes.title: Cornbread Dressing
directions: In large bowl, crumble muffins and bread.

Saute sausage, onions and celery in 1 teaspoon oil until sausage is brown. Drain; pat dry with paper towel and crumble into a small bowl. Combine slightly beaten eggs, evaporated milk and chicken broth. Pour over bread crumb mixture; let stand until liquid is absorbed. Add sausage mixture and spices; stir well.
Spoon into greased pan and bake for 50 to 60 minutes at 350°.
If dressing looks as if it is drying out, cover during baking.
recipes.text: Cornbread Dressing. In large bowl, crumble muffins and bread. Saute sausage, onions and celery in 1 teaspoon oil until sausage is brown. Drain; pat dry with paper towel and crumble into a small bowl. Combine slightly beaten eggs, evaporated milk and chicken broth. Pour over bread crumb mixture; let stand until liquid is absorbed. Add sausage mixture and spices; stir well. Spoon into greased pan and bake for 50 to 60 minutes at 350°. If dressing looks as if it is drying out, cover during baking.

recipes.title: White Texas Sheet Cake
directions: Preheat oven to 350°.
Grease and flour a 15 x 11-inch jelly roll pan.
Put margarine and water in large saucepan.
Bring to a boil.
Add sugar and beat well.
Remove from heat and stir in flour, salt and eggs.
Beat to mix.
Add buttermilk, baking soda and vanilla, beat thoroughly.
Pour into prepared pan.
Bake 20 to 25 minutes or until cake springs back at touch.
Pour on frosting immediately.
recipes.text: White Texas Sheet Cake. Preheat oven to 350°. Grease and flour a 15 x 11-inch jelly roll pan. Put margarine and water in large saucepan. Bring to a boil. Add sugar and beat well. Remove from heat and stir in flour, salt and eggs. Beat to mix. Add buttermilk, baking soda and vanilla, beat thoroughly. Pour into prepared pan. Bake 20 to 25 minutes or until cake springs back at touch. Pour on frosting immediately.

recipes.title: Hardee'S Biscuits
directions: Preheat oven to 500°.
Blend thoroughly.
Roll or cut into biscuits.
Brush on melted butter.
Bake at 500° for 10 minutes.
recipes.text: Hardee'S Biscuits. Preheat oven to 500°. Blend thoroughly. Roll or cut into biscuits. Brush on melted butter. Bake at 500° for 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Baked Or Grilled Chicken
directions: In bowl, mix bread crumbs and spices.
Dip chicken in milk, then roll into spice mixture.
Place on hot grill.
Cook until tender, or bake in 350° oven for about 45 minutes.
Cover with foil to hold in moisture.
recipes.text: Baked Or Grilled Chicken. In bowl, mix bread crumbs and spices. Dip chicken in milk, then roll into spice mixture. Place on hot grill. Cook until tender, or bake in 350° oven for about 45 minutes. Cover with foil to hold in moisture.

recipes.title: Stuffed Peppers
ingredients: salt, pepper and garlic salt to taste
directions: Mix well together and add to cleaned pepper shells.
Place in a shallow baking pan.
Add 1/4 cup water and pour catsup over the peppers and bake in oven at 350° for 1 1/2 hours.
recipes.text: Stuffed Peppers. Mix well together and add to cleaned pepper shells. Place in a shallow baking pan. Add 1/4 cup water and pour catsup over the peppers and bake in oven at 350° for 1 1/2 hours.

recipes.title: Kartoffel Puffer(Potato Pancakes)
directions: Grate the raw potatoes very fine.
Add other ingredients to the potatoes.
Take small portions of dough and fry it in the pan like small pancakes.
We eat this with applesauce.
recipes.text: Kartoffel Puffer(Potato Pancakes). Grate the raw potatoes very fine. Add other ingredients to the potatoes. Take small portions of dough and fry it in the pan like small pancakes. We eat this with applesauce.

recipes.title: Aunt Hattie'S Refrigerator Gingerbread Muffins
ingredients: 1 tsp. each ginger, cinnamon and nutmeg
directions: Cream shortening and sugar; add molasses and stir.
Add beaten eggs.
Sift flour, cinnamon, ginger, nutmeg and salt.
Add dry ingredients alternately with buttermilk to molasses-sugar mix. Add soda, dissolved in hot water.
Add vanilla, raisins and pecans.
Grease muffin tins.
Fill 2/3 full.
Bake at 375° for 30 minutes.
Batter can be kept in refrigerator several days.
Bake as needed.
recipes.text: Aunt Hattie'S Refrigerator Gingerbread Muffins. Cream shortening and sugar; add molasses and stir. Add beaten eggs. Sift flour, cinnamon, ginger, nutmeg and salt. Add dry ingredients alternately with buttermilk to molasses-sugar mix. Add soda, dissolved in hot water. Add vanilla, raisins and pecans. Grease muffin tins. Fill 2/3 full. Bake at 375° for 30 minutes. Batter can be kept in refrigerator several days. Bake as needed.

recipes.title: Crock-Pot Stew
directions: Brown meat with onions in a skillet.
Place in crock-pot (low) with all other ingredients except potatoes.
Cook 3 hours (up to 6 hours on low).
Add potatoes approximately 45 minutes prior to being served.
To thicken, add a little flour and water (in a shaker mix) to mixture.
The longer you can let simmer, the better. (Don't forget the corn bread!)
recipes.text: Crock-Pot Stew. Brown meat with onions in a skillet. Place in crock-pot (low) with all other ingredients except potatoes. Cook 3 hours (up to 6 hours on low). Add potatoes approximately 45 minutes prior to being served. To thicken, add a little flour and water (in a shaker mix) to mixture. The longer you can let simmer, the better. (Don't forget the corn bread!)

recipes.title: Seven Layer Cookies
directions: Melt margarine in 9 x 13-inch pan.
Layer ingredients in order given.
Bake 30 minutes in 350°
oven.
Cut while warm.
recipes.text: Seven Layer Cookies. Melt margarine in 9 x 13-inch pan. Layer ingredients in order given. Bake 30 minutes in 350° oven. Cut while warm.

recipes.title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
directions: Preheat oven to 350°.
With pastry blender or fork, cut Crisco, white sugar, brown sugar and eggs.
Add salt, soda, water and vanilla.
Stir until smooth.
Add flour and chocolate chips. Drop spoonfuls on ungreased cookie sheet.
Bake until lightly brown.
recipes.text: Chocolate Chip Cookies. Preheat oven to 350°. With pastry blender or fork, cut Crisco, white sugar, brown sugar and eggs. Add salt, soda, water and vanilla. Stir until smooth. Add flour and chocolate chips. Drop spoonfuls on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake until lightly brown.

recipes.title: Oven Crisp Chicken
directions: Combine soup mix, bread crumbs, salt and pepper in a paper bag.
Shake chicken pieces, a few at a time, in the mixture to coat well.
Place, not touching, in a single layer in a lightly oiled shallow baking pan.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour or until chicken is tender and richly browned.
recipes.text: Oven Crisp Chicken. Combine soup mix, bread crumbs, salt and pepper in a paper bag. Shake chicken pieces, a few at a time, in the mixture to coat well. Place, not touching, in a single layer in a lightly oiled shallow baking pan. Bake at 350° for 1 hour or until chicken is tender and richly browned.

recipes.title: Oreo Cake(Takes 3 To 4 Hours)
ingredients: 2 small boxes instant chocolate pudding (use directions for pie)
directions: Crush cookies (food processor works great).
Reserve 1/2 cup cookies for top.
Combine cookies and melted butter; press into pan and refrigerate 1/2 hour.
Mix cream cheese and powdered sugar. Add one Cool Whip.
Spread over cookies and refrigerate for 1 hour. Prepare chocolate pudding; spread over cheese layer.
Refrigerate 1 hour.
Spread second Cool Whip.
Sprinkle with remaining cookie crumbs.
Best when refrigerated for another hour.
Yields 1 (9 x 13-inch) pan.
Serves 12 to 16.
recipes.text: Oreo Cake(Takes 3 To 4 Hours). Crush cookies (food processor works great). Reserve 1/2 cup cookies for top. Combine cookies and melted butter; press into pan and refrigerate 1/2 hour. Mix cream cheese and powdered sugar. Add one Cool Whip. Spread over cookies and refrigerate for 1 hour. Prepare chocolate pudding; spread over cheese layer. Refrigerate 1 hour. Spread second Cool Whip. Sprinkle with remaining cookie crumbs. Best when refrigerated for another hour. Yields 1 (9 x 13-inch) pan. Serves 12 to 16.

recipes.title: Hot Onion Appetizers
directions: Melt butter in electric skillet at 150°.
Add soup; stir well. Cut biscuits into quarters; place in skillet.
Cover and cook at 275° about 20 minutes, or until browned, turning once.
Reduce heat to lowest setting; keep warm.
recipes.text: Hot Onion Appetizers. Melt butter in electric skillet at 150°. Add soup; stir well. Cut biscuits into quarters; place in skillet. Cover and cook at 275° about 20 minutes, or until browned, turning once. Reduce heat to lowest setting; keep warm.

recipes.title: Popovers
directions: Break egg in mixer bowl.
Beat until frothy.
Beat in milk and butter.
Slowly beat in flour and salt.
Batter should be light, but not foamy.
If batter becomes lumpy, strain it.
Bake in preheated 400° oven.
Oil custard cups or muffin tins.
Fill 2/3 full.
Bake about 30 minutes or until brown.
recipes.text: Popovers. Break egg in mixer bowl. Beat until frothy. Beat in milk and butter. Slowly beat in flour and salt. Batter should be light, but not foamy. If batter becomes lumpy, strain it. Bake in preheated 400° oven. Oil custard cups or muffin tins. Fill 2/3 full. Bake about 30 minutes or until brown.

recipes.title: Lemon Dessert
directions: Combine flour and margarine, mix with pastry blender.
Add pecans.
Press into 9 x 13-inch pan.
Bake 30 minutes at 350°, don't brown.
Beat cream cheese, powdered sugar and Cool Whip, reserving some Cool Whip for topping.
Spread over cool crust. Combine milk and pudding.
Pour over cheese layer.
Add thick layer of Cool Whip over top of pudding.
Let set.
recipes.text: Lemon Dessert. Combine flour and margarine, mix with pastry blender. Add pecans. Press into 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake 30 minutes at 350°, don't brown. Beat cream cheese, powdered sugar and Cool Whip, reserving some Cool Whip for topping. Spread over cool crust. Combine milk and pudding. Pour over cheese layer. Add thick layer of Cool Whip over top of pudding. Let set.

recipes.title: Green Salad
directions: Pour 1 1/2 cups boiling water over jello; let cool to lukewarm and put in cream cheese.
Mix together.
Add pineapple, celery and nuts.
Put in refrigerator and let cool.
recipes.text: Green Salad. Pour 1 1/2 cups boiling water over jello; let cool to lukewarm and put in cream cheese. Mix together. Add pineapple, celery and nuts. Put in refrigerator and let cool.

recipes.title: Broccoli-Rice Casserole
directions: Cook broccoli and drain. Saute onions in oleo, add soup and 1 can water.
Add broccoli, cheese and cooked rice.
Mix thoroughly. Put in casserole dish, sprinkle with paprika and bake 20 to 25 minutes in 350° oven.
recipes.text: Broccoli-Rice Casserole. Cook broccoli and drain. Saute onions in oleo, add soup and 1 can water. Add broccoli, cheese and cooked rice. Mix thoroughly. Put in casserole dish, sprinkle with paprika and bake 20 to 25 minutes in 350° oven.

recipes.title: Fruit Cocktail Cake
directions: Do not drain fruit cocktail.
Mix first 5 ingredients together.
Pour into 9 x 13-inch greased pan.
Before putting in oven, mix together nuts, brown sugar and coconut; sprinkle over top of cake.
Bake at 350° for 35 minutes.
recipes.text: Fruit Cocktail Cake. Do not drain fruit cocktail. Mix first 5 ingredients together. Pour into 9 x 13-inch greased pan. Before putting in oven, mix together nuts, brown sugar and coconut; sprinkle over top of cake. Bake at 350° for 35 minutes.

recipes.title: Chocolate Chess Pie
directions: Mix sugar and cocoa.
Add beaten eggs.
Add milk, vinegar, vanilla and melted butter.
Pour into pie crust.
Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.
recipes.text: Chocolate Chess Pie. Mix sugar and cocoa. Add beaten eggs. Add milk, vinegar, vanilla and melted butter. Pour into pie crust. Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Crack Salad
directions: Mix.
Put vegetables in jar.
Mix the liquid cold.
Pour over vegetables and refrigerate.
recipes.text: Crack Salad. Mix. Put vegetables in jar. Mix the liquid cold. Pour over vegetables and refrigerate.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Fudge
directions: Combine milk, margarine and sugar in medium size saucepan. Slowly bring to a boil, stirring constantly.
Boil five minutes. Remove from heat; add peanut butter and marshmallow cream.
Stir vigorously.
Pour into lightly greased 9 x 13-inch dish or pan. Cool and cut in squares.
recipes.text: Peanut Butter Fudge. Combine milk, margarine and sugar in medium size saucepan. Slowly bring to a boil, stirring constantly. Boil five minutes. Remove from heat; add peanut butter and marshmallow cream. Stir vigorously. Pour into lightly greased 9 x 13-inch dish or pan. Cool and cut in squares.

recipes.title: Sausage-Egg Casserole
ingredients: 12 oz. pkg. link sausage, cut into 1/4-inch slices
8 slices sandwich bread, cut into 1-inch pieces
1 can cream of mushroom soup, undiluted
directions: Brown sausage in skillet, drain well.
Set aside.
Place bread cubes in 13 x 9-inch greased dish.
Top bread cubes with sausage and cheese.
Combine 2 cups milk and next 4 ingredients in a large bowl and pour over bread mixture.
Cover and chill 8 hours. Combine soup with remaining 1/2 cup milk and pour over casserole. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
Serve immediately.
Serves 8.
recipes.text: Sausage-Egg Casserole. Brown sausage in skillet, drain well. Set aside. Place bread cubes in 13 x 9-inch greased dish. Top bread cubes with sausage and cheese. Combine 2 cups milk and next 4 ingredients in a large bowl and pour over bread mixture. Cover and chill 8 hours. Combine soup with remaining 1/2 cup milk and pour over casserole. Bake at 350° for 1 hour. Serve immediately. Serves 8.

recipes.title: Watergate Cake
directions: Mix all ingredients and bake in 3 layers for about 20 minutes at 350°.
recipes.text: Watergate Cake. Mix all ingredients and bake in 3 layers for about 20 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Butterscotch Chip Cake
directions: Mix together first three items and pour into a greased and floured cake pan.
Then sprinkle over the top the last three items and bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.
recipes.text: Butterscotch Chip Cake. Mix together first three items and pour into a greased and floured cake pan. Then sprinkle over the top the last three items and bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.

recipes.title: **Apricot-Pineapple Dessert
ingredients: 1 1/2 c. Cool Whip (small box) or 1 pkg. Dream Whip
directions: Dissolve jello in one cup boiling water.
Add sugar, salt, apricots and pineapple with juice (3/4 cup).
Cool until thickens. Fold in Cool Whip.
Cover bottom of 9-inch square pan with half the cake, broken in small pieces. Pour over half fruit jello mixture.
Then another layer of cake pieces and another layer of mixture.
Refrigerate 4 to 5 hours or overnight.
Cut into squares.
Serves 16.
recipes.text: **Apricot-Pineapple Dessert. Dissolve jello in one cup boiling water. Add sugar, salt, apricots and pineapple with juice (3/4 cup). Cool until thickens. Fold in Cool Whip. Cover bottom of 9-inch square pan with half the cake, broken in small pieces. Pour over half fruit jello mixture. Then another layer of cake pieces and another layer of mixture. Refrigerate 4 to 5 hours or overnight. Cut into squares. Serves 16.

recipes.title: Pretty Salad
directions: Chop broccoli, tops only, and chop green onions, tops and all.
Add dressing.
Marinate 3 hours or
overnight.
Add tomatoes before serving.
recipes.text: Pretty Salad. Chop broccoli, tops only, and chop green onions, tops and all. Add dressing. Marinate 3 hours or overnight. Add tomatoes before serving.

recipes.title: Shrimp Cheese Ball
directions: Mix all ingredients until smooth.
Form into a ball and roll in chopped nuts.
Serve with crackers or chips.
recipes.text: Shrimp Cheese Ball. Mix all ingredients until smooth. Form into a ball and roll in chopped nuts. Serve with crackers or chips.

recipes.title: Stuffed Shells
directions: Scramble hamburg.
Boil (noodles) shells until firm.
Cook broccoli.
Put a layer of sauce in bottom of a baking dish.
Mix hamburg and broccoli together.
Stuff shells.
Put shells in pan over sauce.
Spread more sauce over stuffed shells.
Cover with Mozzarella cheese.
Bake, until cheese has melted, at 350° about 20 minutes.
Take out of oven and serve.
recipes.text: Stuffed Shells. Scramble hamburg. Boil (noodles) shells until firm. Cook broccoli. Put a layer of sauce in bottom of a baking dish. Mix hamburg and broccoli together. Stuff shells. Put shells in pan over sauce. Spread more sauce over stuffed shells. Cover with Mozzarella cheese. Bake, until cheese has melted, at 350° about 20 minutes. Take out of oven and serve.

recipes.title: Dilly Bread
ingredients: 1 Tbsp. dry yeast (soften with 1/4 c. warm water)
1 c. creamed cottage cheese, heated to lukewarm
directions: Combine cottage cheese, sugar, minced onions, margarine, dill seed, salt, baking soda, egg, softened yeast mixutre and flour. Cover and let rise the ingredients until light and doubled in size (approximately 1 to 2 hours).
Stir down dough.
Turn into well-greased 8-inch round (1 1/2 to 2-quart) casserole.
Let rise again about 1 hour.
Bake at 350° for 45 to 50 minutes until golden brown.
recipes.text: Dilly Bread. Combine cottage cheese, sugar, minced onions, margarine, dill seed, salt, baking soda, egg, softened yeast mixutre and flour. Cover and let rise the ingredients until light and doubled in size (approximately 1 to 2 hours). Stir down dough. Turn into well-greased 8-inch round (1 1/2 to 2-quart) casserole. Let rise again about 1 hour. Bake at 350° for 45 to 50 minutes until golden brown.

recipes.title: Mexican Pinwheels
directions: Mix the first 5 ingredients together.
Spread on flat tortilla shells.
Roll up and then slice into 1/2-inch.
You may add 1 can green chilies (crushed) if you want.
recipes.text: Mexican Pinwheels. Mix the first 5 ingredients together. Spread on flat tortilla shells. Roll up and then slice into 1/2-inch. You may add 1 can green chilies (crushed) if you want.

recipes.title: Christmas Corn
directions: Mix all ingredients.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Christmas Corn. Mix all ingredients. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Chicken Casserole
ingredients: 1 pkg. noodles (small size is best), cooked in chicken broth and drained
directions: In oleo, saute chopped onion, chopped celery and chopped bell pepper.
Mix all ingredients.
Bake for 30 minutes at 350°.
recipes.text: Chicken Casserole. In oleo, saute chopped onion, chopped celery and chopped bell pepper. Mix all ingredients. Bake for 30 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Angela Pasta With Olive Oil And Garlic
ingredients: 1 lb. angel hair pasta or vermicelli pasta
12 cloves garlic, peeled and cut into slivers
1/2 c. fresh basil or fresh parsley leaves, chopped
directions: Cooking pasta according to directions on package and drain well. In skillet, heat oil on high heat. Add garlic, salt, and pepper. Stir and cook 4 minutes. Turn off heat. Add hot cooked and well drained pasta to sauce in skillet and toss well. Add tomatoes and basil (or parsley) and toss gently.
recipes.text: Angela Pasta With Olive Oil And Garlic. Cooking pasta according to directions on package and drain well. In skillet, heat oil on high heat. Add garlic, salt, and pepper. Stir and cook 4 minutes. Turn off heat. Add hot cooked and well drained pasta to sauce in skillet and toss well. Add tomatoes and basil (or parsley) and toss gently.

recipes.title: Baking Mix
directions: Put all ingredients in bowl in order given.
Cut margarine into flour mix until mixture resembles coarse grain.
Store in tightly covered jar (I refrigerate).
Keeps well.
A good substitute for Bisquick.
recipes.text: Baking Mix. Put all ingredients in bowl in order given. Cut margarine into flour mix until mixture resembles coarse grain. Store in tightly covered jar (I refrigerate). Keeps well. A good substitute for Bisquick.

recipes.title: Butter-Nut Pumpkin Bars
directions: In a 3-quart mixer bowl, combine margarine, sugar, eggs and pumpkin.
Beat on medium speed, scraping sides of bowl often, until well blended (1 to 2 minutes).
Reduce to low speed.
Stir in flour, baking powder, soda, salt, cinnamon and raisins.
recipes.text: Butter-Nut Pumpkin Bars. In a 3-quart mixer bowl, combine margarine, sugar, eggs and pumpkin. Beat on medium speed, scraping sides of bowl often, until well blended (1 to 2 minutes). Reduce to low speed. Stir in flour, baking powder, soda, salt, cinnamon and raisins.

recipes.title: Chicken Marengo
ingredients: 1 lb. can small whole white onions
directions: Brown
chicken
in Crisco in frying pan.
Pour off fat. Stir in remaining ingredients.
Cover.
Simmer on low heat for 45 minutes
until
tender, stirring occasionally.
Cook until desired consistency.
recipes.text: Chicken Marengo. Brown chicken in Crisco in frying pan. Pour off fat. Stir in remaining ingredients. Cover. Simmer on low heat for 45 minutes until tender, stirring occasionally. Cook until desired consistency.

recipes.title: Mexican Chicken Casserole
directions: Mix in bowl the tomatoes, chili peppers, both soups and taco season powder; set aside. Put chips in bottom of dish; put chicken on top of chips. Spread mixture on top of chicken. Sprinkle onion and green pepper on top of that. Put cheese on top of onions and peppers. Bake at 350° until bubbly.
recipes.text: Mexican Chicken Casserole. Mix in bowl the tomatoes, chili peppers, both soups and taco season powder; set aside. Put chips in bottom of dish; put chicken on top of chips. Spread mixture on top of chicken. Sprinkle onion and green pepper on top of that. Put cheese on top of onions and peppers. Bake at 350° until bubbly.

recipes.title: Spaghetti Sauce
directions: Brown and drain hamburger; add onion.
Add all dry ingredients and simmer 10 minutes.
Add tomato paste and juice.
Simmer 1 hour (3 or more hours is better).
Can be thinned with water.
recipes.text: Spaghetti Sauce. Brown and drain hamburger; add onion. Add all dry ingredients and simmer 10 minutes. Add tomato paste and juice. Simmer 1 hour (3 or more hours is better). Can be thinned with water.

recipes.title: Snicker Bar Dessert
directions: Mix pudding as directed on box.
Add peanut butter and mix before it sets up and fold in Cool Whip and softened ice cream and pour into square Pyrex dish and freeze.
recipes.text: Snicker Bar Dessert. Mix pudding as directed on box. Add peanut butter and mix before it sets up and fold in Cool Whip and softened ice cream and pour into square Pyrex dish and freeze.

recipes.title: Devastating Chocolate Pie
directions: In top of double boiler, over boiling water, heat butter and chocolate, stirring until melted and well blended.
Allow to cool slightly.
Blend syrup, sugar, salt and vanilla into beaten eggs. Add chocolate; blend well.
recipes.text: Devastating Chocolate Pie. In top of double boiler, over boiling water, heat butter and chocolate, stirring until melted and well blended. Allow to cool slightly. Blend syrup, sugar, salt and vanilla into beaten eggs. Add chocolate; blend well.

recipes.title: Sausage Stuffed Mushrooms
directions: Preheat oven to 375°.
Wipe mushrooms with damp paper towels. Remove stems; set caps aside.
recipes.text: Sausage Stuffed Mushrooms. Preheat oven to 375°. Wipe mushrooms with damp paper towels. Remove stems; set caps aside.

recipes.title: Cabbage Salad
ingredients: 1 pkg. pork ramen noodles and seasoning
directions: Mix cabbage, seeds, onions and nuts. Break noodles and mix with cabbage mixture.
Sprinkle with sauce, sugar and seasoning. Add vinegar and oil. Mix well.
recipes.text: Cabbage Salad. Mix cabbage, seeds, onions and nuts. Break noodles and mix with cabbage mixture. Sprinkle with sauce, sugar and seasoning. Add vinegar and oil. Mix well.

recipes.title: Cheese Potatoes
directions: Make white sauce.
Add 1/2 cup Cheez Whiz. Simmer 5 minutes. Take your 4 cups cold cooked potatoes (1/4-inch thick or cubes) and place in casserole.
Pour over the white sauce and sprinkle with cheese.
Bake at 400° for 20 to 30 minutes or until slightly brown on top.
recipes.text: Cheese Potatoes. Make white sauce. Add 1/2 cup Cheez Whiz. Simmer 5 minutes. Take your 4 cups cold cooked potatoes (1/4-inch thick or cubes) and place in casserole. Pour over the white sauce and sprinkle with cheese. Bake at 400° for 20 to 30 minutes or until slightly brown on top.

recipes.title: Chicken Gumbo
directions: Cut the chicken into pieces, and dredge each piece in flour. Brown the pieces in the bacon fat, then pour in 5 cups of boiling water.
Simmer the chicken, uncovered, until the meat falls from the bones.
Drain the broth.
Bone, skin and chop the meat. Reserve the meat and broth only.
recipes.text: Chicken Gumbo. Cut the chicken into pieces, and dredge each piece in flour. Brown the pieces in the bacon fat, then pour in 5 cups of boiling water. Simmer the chicken, uncovered, until the meat falls from the bones. Drain the broth. Bone, skin and chop the meat. Reserve the meat and broth only.

recipes.title: Peach Rice Pudding
directions: Combine rice, milk and sugar. Cook over medium heat in 3-quart saucepan until thick and creamy, about 20 to 25 minutes, stirring often. Add vanilla. Pour into serving dish. Heat honey, butter, lemon juice, lemon peel, nutmeg and salt. Stir in drained peaches. Cook over low heat for 10 minutes. Spoon over pudding. Serve with Cool Whip.
recipes.text: Peach Rice Pudding. Combine rice, milk and sugar. Cook over medium heat in 3-quart saucepan until thick and creamy, about 20 to 25 minutes, stirring often. Add vanilla. Pour into serving dish. Heat honey, butter, lemon juice, lemon peel, nutmeg and salt. Stir in drained peaches. Cook over low heat for 10 minutes. Spoon over pudding. Serve with Cool Whip.

recipes.title: Frozen Cole Slaw
directions: Sprinkle salt over grated cabbage and let stand 1 hour.
Put chopped celery and pepper over and leave 20 minutes.
Drain well. Mix vinegar, 2 cups water, sugar, mustard and celery seed; bring to a boil until sugar is dissolved.
Pour over cabbage mixture. Let stand until cool.
Pack into containers (not full).
Freeze. Delicious.
recipes.text: Frozen Cole Slaw. Sprinkle salt over grated cabbage and let stand 1 hour. Put chopped celery and pepper over and leave 20 minutes. Drain well. Mix vinegar, 2 cups water, sugar, mustard and celery seed; bring to a boil until sugar is dissolved. Pour over cabbage mixture. Let stand until cool. Pack into containers (not full). Freeze. Delicious.

recipes.title: Angels Delight
directions: Dissolve marshmallows in hot milk.
Layer ingredients in an oblong pan, starting with crumbs mixed with vanilla and marshmallow mixture, then whipped cream and pineapple.
Top with layer of graham cracker crumbs.
Serves 12.
recipes.text: Angels Delight. Dissolve marshmallows in hot milk. Layer ingredients in an oblong pan, starting with crumbs mixed with vanilla and marshmallow mixture, then whipped cream and pineapple. Top with layer of graham cracker crumbs. Serves 12.

recipes.title: Mexican Beef Dip
ingredients: 4-5 lb. hamburger meat (you can substitute 1/2 and 1/2 with ground turkey - no one will know the difference)
2 blocks Velveeta Mexican Cheese (mild or hot)
3-4 large jars of salsa (mild or hot)
directions: Brown the ground hamburger and drain well. Set the cooking temperature to low. Cut the Velveeta cheese into 1/2 inch blocks (that is just to help melt the cheese faster than if you drop the whole block into the pot).

Add the cheese and continue to stir so the ground meat does not burn. Once the cheese has started to melt, add the salsa. Once the cheese is completely melted, the dip is done! Allow the dip to cool and put in the fridge. (It is better if made the night before!) Put the crock-pot on the day to serve and put on low heat. Watch out because if it simmers in the crock-pot too long it will get very soupy! Serve with tortilla chips.
recipes.text: Mexican Beef Dip. Brown the ground hamburger and drain well. Set the cooking temperature to low. Cut the Velveeta cheese into 1/2 inch blocks (that is just to help melt the cheese faster than if you drop the whole block into the pot). Add the cheese and continue to stir so the ground meat does not burn. Once the cheese has started to melt, add the salsa. Once the cheese is completely melted, the dip is done! Allow the dip to cool and put in the fridge. (It is better if made the night before!) Put the crock-pot on the day to serve and put on low heat. Watch out because if it simmers in the crock-pot too long it will get very soupy! Serve with tortilla chips.

recipes.title: Cases Tortilla Casserole
directions: First Layer:
Line 9 x 13-inch casserole dish with corn tortillas.
recipes.text: Cases Tortilla Casserole. First Layer: Line 9 x 13-inch casserole dish with corn tortillas.

recipes.title: Almond Bars
directions: Melt over low heat.
Spread on cooled crust.
recipes.text: Almond Bars. Melt over low heat. Spread on cooled crust.

recipes.title: Veggie Enchiladas
directions: Heat enchilada sauce in skillet.
Heat oil in another skillet; add onion, mushrooms, corn, olives and spices.
Saute 2 minutes and remove from heat.
Add 2/3 of the cheese and mix gently.
Dip each tortilla briefly in enchilada sauce, then stuff with veggie mixture and place seam down in casserole dish.
When finished, pour remaining enchilada sauce over enchiladas and top with remaining cheese.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Veggie Enchiladas. Heat enchilada sauce in skillet. Heat oil in another skillet; add onion, mushrooms, corn, olives and spices. Saute 2 minutes and remove from heat. Add 2/3 of the cheese and mix gently. Dip each tortilla briefly in enchilada sauce, then stuff with veggie mixture and place seam down in casserole dish. When finished, pour remaining enchilada sauce over enchiladas and top with remaining cheese. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Bean Dip
ingredients: 2 can Dennisons Chili con Carne, without beans
directions: Melt Velveeta cheese in a crock pot.
When melted add all other ingredients. Serve warm in crock pot.
recipes.text: Bean Dip. Melt Velveeta cheese in a crock pot. When melted add all other ingredients. Serve warm in crock pot.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Muffins
directions: Mix sugar and oil.
Add eggs, one at a time, beating well. Mix pumpkin and water; add alternately to mixture with sifted dry ingredients.
Mix gently.
Stir in raisins and nuts.
Spoon batter into greased muffin tins.
Bake at 400° for 20 minutes.
Makes about 30 muffins.
recipes.text: Pumpkin Muffins. Mix sugar and oil. Add eggs, one at a time, beating well. Mix pumpkin and water; add alternately to mixture with sifted dry ingredients. Mix gently. Stir in raisins and nuts. Spoon batter into greased muffin tins. Bake at 400° for 20 minutes. Makes about 30 muffins.

recipes.title: Peach Almond Pie
directions: Put into unbaked pie shell and bake.
recipes.text: Peach Almond Pie. Put into unbaked pie shell and bake.

recipes.title: Strawberry Delight
ingredients: 1 qt. fresh or frozen sliced strawberries
directions: Spread half of the vanilla wafers in a 9 x 9-inch cake pan. Cream the butter.
Add sugar and eggs; beat until smooth.
Spread on top of wafer crumbs.
Add strawberries; sprinkle nuts on top. Add remaining wafers.
Spread with whipped cream.
Chill until firm.
Serves 8.
Quite a tasty treat!
recipes.text: Strawberry Delight. Spread half of the vanilla wafers in a 9 x 9-inch cake pan. Cream the butter. Add sugar and eggs; beat until smooth. Spread on top of wafer crumbs. Add strawberries; sprinkle nuts on top. Add remaining wafers. Spread with whipped cream. Chill until firm. Serves 8. Quite a tasty treat!

recipes.title: Grilled Pork Chops
directions: Sprinkle pork chops with salt, lemon pepper and oregano.
Place chops 4 to 5 inches from coals.
Grill over low to medium hot coals 25 minutes or until the chops are no longer pink, turning once. Yields 4 servings.
recipes.text: Grilled Pork Chops. Sprinkle pork chops with salt, lemon pepper and oregano. Place chops 4 to 5 inches from coals. Grill over low to medium hot coals 25 minutes or until the chops are no longer pink, turning once. Yields 4 servings.

recipes.title: Day Ahead Salad
ingredients: 1 (10 oz.) pkg. frozen peas (do not cook)
directions: Layer ingredients in order listed.
Cover and refrigerate overnight.
recipes.text: Day Ahead Salad. Layer ingredients in order listed. Cover and refrigerate overnight.

recipes.title: Seven Layer Cookies
ingredients: 1 can Eagle Brand sweetened condensed milk
directions: Preheat oven to 350°.
In baking dish, melt the butter. Sprinkle the graham crackers on top of butter.
Then sprinkle the coconut.
Then sprinkle the chocolate chips.
Then sprinkle the butterscotch chips.
Pour Eagle Brand milk over all this. Sprinkle the nuts on top.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
Let cool and cut into bars.
recipes.text: Seven Layer Cookies. Preheat oven to 350°. In baking dish, melt the butter. Sprinkle the graham crackers on top of butter. Then sprinkle the coconut. Then sprinkle the chocolate chips. Then sprinkle the butterscotch chips. Pour Eagle Brand milk over all this. Sprinkle the nuts on top. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes. Let cool and cut into bars.

recipes.title: Better Than Sex Cake
directions: Mix and bake at 350° for 45 to 50 minutes in a 13 x 9-inch pan.
recipes.text: Better Than Sex Cake. Mix and bake at 350° for 45 to 50 minutes in a 13 x 9-inch pan.

recipes.title: Fajitas
ingredients: 3 lb. beef flank, skirt or round steaks (cut 1/2-inch)
directions: Trim excess fat and gristle
from steaks.
Pound steaks to 1/4-inch thickness.
Place steaks
in plastic bag; sprinkle steaks with
lime juice, garlic salt
and
pepper.
Tie
bags securely and marinate in refrigerator 6 to
hours
or overnight.
Drain marinade off steaks and discard marinade.
Broil steaks at medium to medium-high about 2 to 3 minutes per side. Carve against
the grain
into
thin
slices.
Serve steak in warmed
tortilla accompanied
by tomato, onion, guacamole and sour cream.
recipes.text: Fajitas. Trim excess fat and gristle from steaks. Pound steaks to 1/4-inch thickness. Place steaks in plastic bag; sprinkle steaks with lime juice, garlic salt and pepper. Tie bags securely and marinate in refrigerator 6 to 8 hours or overnight. Drain marinade off steaks and discard marinade. Broil steaks at medium to medium-high about 2 to 3 minutes per side. Carve against the grain into thin slices. Serve steak in warmed tortilla accompanied by tomato, onion, guacamole and sour cream.

recipes.title: New Year'S Black-Eyed Peas
ingredients: 1 medium size onion, peeled and chopped
2 pkg. fresh or frozen black-eyed peas
directions: Melt bacon drippings in large cast-iron Dutch oven.
Saute onion until translucent.
Add garlic and pepper, then add black-eyed peas.
Cover with water and simmer over low heat for 45 minutes or until the peas are tender, then add salt to taste.
(Do not add salt until the very end or it will make the skin on the peas split open.)
recipes.text: New Year'S Black-Eyed Peas. Melt bacon drippings in large cast-iron Dutch oven. Saute onion until translucent. Add garlic and pepper, then add black-eyed peas. Cover with water and simmer over low heat for 45 minutes or until the peas are tender, then add salt to taste. (Do not add salt until the very end or it will make the skin on the peas split open.)

recipes.title: Famous Lemon Pecan Pie
directions: Combine first
six ingredients.
Mix with fork or whisk (do not use electric mixer).
Stir in pecan pieces.
Pour into pie shell and bake at 300° for 45 minutes or until done.
recipes.text: Famous Lemon Pecan Pie. Combine first six ingredients. Mix with fork or whisk (do not use electric mixer). Stir in pecan pieces. Pour into pie shell and bake at 300° for 45 minutes or until done.

recipes.title: Steak Diane
ingredients: 2 lb. cube steak, cut into pieces
directions: Saute garlic in butter 2 minutes.
Remove.
Stir in mustard and salt.
Add steaks and brown lightly on both sides.
Remove. Stir parsley, lemon juice, Worcestershire sauce and pepper into pan drippings.
Heat and then pour over steaks.
recipes.text: Steak Diane. Saute garlic in butter 2 minutes. Remove. Stir in mustard and salt. Add steaks and brown lightly on both sides. Remove. Stir parsley, lemon juice, Worcestershire sauce and pepper into pan drippings. Heat and then pour over steaks.

recipes.title: Heath Bar Cake
ingredients: 1 jar Smucker's special recipe caramel butterscotch topping
3 to 4 Heath bars, broken into small pieces
directions: Bake cake mix according to directions (in rectangular pan). While still hot, using a wooden spoon, poke holes at 1 1/2 to 2-inch intervals.
Pour condensed milk slowly over cake, allowing it to soak into holes.
Add Smucker's topping (also poured slowly).
Place in refrigerator; allow to cool completely.
Add Cool Whip.
Top with broken Heath bars.
recipes.text: Heath Bar Cake. Bake cake mix according to directions (in rectangular pan). While still hot, using a wooden spoon, poke holes at 1 1/2 to 2-inch intervals. Pour condensed milk slowly over cake, allowing it to soak into holes. Add Smucker's topping (also poured slowly). Place in refrigerator; allow to cool completely. Add Cool Whip. Top with broken Heath bars.

recipes.title: Latkes(Potato)
ingredients: 1 rounded or heaping Tbsp. flour or matzo meal
directions: Combine all ingredients.
Mix well.
Drop mixture by tablespoon onto a hot skillet generously greased with butter or shortening.
Fry on both sides until brown.
Serve hot with sour cream or with applesauce.
recipes.text: Latkes(Potato). Combine all ingredients. Mix well. Drop mixture by tablespoon onto a hot skillet generously greased with butter or shortening. Fry on both sides until brown. Serve hot with sour cream or with applesauce.

recipes.title: Peach Cobbler
directions: Melt 1 stick of butter in pan you are cooking in.
In another bowl, mix the flour, sugar and milk.
Pour all ingredients (flour, sugar, milk) with the butter, but do not stir.
Pour in peaches and do not stir.
Cook 1 hour at 350° to 400°.
recipes.text: Peach Cobbler. Melt 1 stick of butter in pan you are cooking in. In another bowl, mix the flour, sugar and milk. Pour all ingredients (flour, sugar, milk) with the butter, but do not stir. Pour in peaches and do not stir. Cook 1 hour at 350° to 400°.

recipes.title: Southern Blackberry Cobbler
directions: Place berries in 9 inch square baking dish.
Combine sugar, cornstarch, and salt, mixing well.	Sprinkle mixture over berries. Dot with butter.
Roll out pastry to fit dish.
Place pastry over berries.
Brush with milk, and sprinkle with sugar.
Bake at 425° for 30 minutes.
Makes 6-8 servings.
recipes.text: Southern Blackberry Cobbler. Place berries in 9 inch square baking dish. Combine sugar, cornstarch, and salt, mixing well.	Sprinkle mixture over berries. Dot with butter. Roll out pastry to fit dish. Place pastry over berries. Brush with milk, and sprinkle with sugar. Bake at 425° for 30 minutes. Makes 6-8 servings.

recipes.title: Fudge Cupcakes
directions: Combine brown sugar, milk and chocolate in a pan.
Stir over very low heat until chocolate melts; cool.
Gradually add 2/3 cup brown sugar to shortening, creaming until sugar is dissolved.
Add vanilla and eggs, one at a time, beating well after each addition. Sift together flour, soda and salt.
Add to creamed mixture alternately with 1/2 cup milk, beating after each addition.
Stir in chocolate mixture.
Fill muffin cups in muffin pans 1/2 full. Bake at 375° about 20 minutes.
Makes 2 dozen.
recipes.text: Fudge Cupcakes. Combine brown sugar, milk and chocolate in a pan. Stir over very low heat until chocolate melts; cool. Gradually add 2/3 cup brown sugar to shortening, creaming until sugar is dissolved. Add vanilla and eggs, one at a time, beating well after each addition. Sift together flour, soda and salt. Add to creamed mixture alternately with 1/2 cup milk, beating after each addition. Stir in chocolate mixture. Fill muffin cups in muffin pans 1/2 full. Bake at 375° about 20 minutes. Makes 2 dozen.

recipes.title: Hamburger Spins
directions: Brown ground beef; drain and add onions and peppers. Stir in flour and water. Let cool while making dough.
recipes.text: Hamburger Spins. Brown ground beef; drain and add onions and peppers. Stir in flour and water. Let cool while making dough.

recipes.title: Broccoli With Garlic And Lemon
directions: Cut off broccoli tops and divide them into florets.
Peel and slice stems.
Mince garlic.
Cook all the broccoli in a large pot of boiling water until tender, about 8 minutes, and drain.
Just before serving, heat oil with the garlic over medium heat until fragrant, about 2 minutes.
Add broccoli and toss until heated through.
Add the lemon juice and season with salt and pepper. Sprinkle with cheese.
recipes.text: Broccoli With Garlic And Lemon. Cut off broccoli tops and divide them into florets. Peel and slice stems. Mince garlic. Cook all the broccoli in a large pot of boiling water until tender, about 8 minutes, and drain. Just before serving, heat oil with the garlic over medium heat until fragrant, about 2 minutes. Add broccoli and toss until heated through. Add the lemon juice and season with salt and pepper. Sprinkle with cheese.

recipes.title: Grandma Mag'S Banana Bread
directions: Combine all ingredients, mix well.
Grease loaf pan.
Pour batter into pan.
Bake at 350° for about 1 hour.
recipes.text: Grandma Mag'S Banana Bread. Combine all ingredients, mix well. Grease loaf pan. Pour batter into pan. Bake at 350° for about 1 hour.

recipes.title: Quick And Easy Banana Nut Cake
ingredients: 1 box Duncan Hines butter cake mix
directions: Mix all ingredients
together.	Spray a 9 x 13-inch pan with Pam and sprinkle
with
flour.
Bake
at 350° for 35 minutes.
recipes.text: Quick And Easy Banana Nut Cake. Mix all ingredients together.	Spray a 9 x 13-inch pan with Pam and sprinkle with flour. Bake at 350° for 35 minutes.

recipes.title: Moonlight Cornbread
directions: Grease a muffin tin for 12. Beat egg and milk, buttermilk, oil, and margarine; mix well. Add sugar, flour, and cornmeal and mix well.
recipes.text: Moonlight Cornbread. Grease a muffin tin for 12. Beat egg and milk, buttermilk, oil, and margarine; mix well. Add sugar, flour, and cornmeal and mix well.

recipes.title: Frozen Colorful Punch
directions: Dissolve jello in 4 cups boiling water; add 9 additional cups of water.
Add sugar, lemon juice, pineapple juice and almond extract.
Freeze in non-breakable container.
Take out of freezer 3 to 4 hours before serving.
Just before serving, add ginger ale. This can be frozen in ice trays or different shaped molds to have ice cubes with your punch (for those of us who have to have our ice).
recipes.text: Frozen Colorful Punch. Dissolve jello in 4 cups boiling water; add 9 additional cups of water. Add sugar, lemon juice, pineapple juice and almond extract. Freeze in non-breakable container. Take out of freezer 3 to 4 hours before serving. Just before serving, add ginger ale. This can be frozen in ice trays or different shaped molds to have ice cubes with your punch (for those of us who have to have our ice).

recipes.title: Glazed Carrots
directions: Peel carrots; cut in fourths lengthwise.
Place in heavy skillet and add remaining ingredients.
Cover and cook over low heat, turning often, until tender and glazed.
recipes.text: Glazed Carrots. Peel carrots; cut in fourths lengthwise. Place in heavy skillet and add remaining ingredients. Cover and cook over low heat, turning often, until tender and glazed.

recipes.title: Taco Salad
directions: Layer ingredients in salad bowl.
At last minute, pour entire bottle of dressing over top of salad.
Do not substitute any other dressing or it will diminish flavors.
recipes.text: Taco Salad. Layer ingredients in salad bowl. At last minute, pour entire bottle of dressing over top of salad. Do not substitute any other dressing or it will diminish flavors.

recipes.title: Sour Cream Chicken Enchiladas
ingredients: 1 large box grated Velveeta cheese (jalapeno flavored if you like hot)
directions: Mix cheese, onion and chicken in large bowl.
Mix sour cream and chicken soup.
Dip tortillas in hot oil until soft.
Place spoonful of cheese mixture in tortilla and roll up.
Place single layer in pan.
Top with sour cream.
Cover and bake at 325° for 30 to 45 minutes, until sour cream is bubbling.
recipes.text: Sour Cream Chicken Enchiladas. Mix cheese, onion and chicken in large bowl. Mix sour cream and chicken soup. Dip tortillas in hot oil until soft. Place spoonful of cheese mixture in tortilla and roll up. Place single layer in pan. Top with sour cream. Cover and bake at 325° for 30 to 45 minutes, until sour cream is bubbling.

recipes.title: Curried Rice Salad
ingredients: 1 1/2 c. rice, cooked in chicken broth (I use Success rice in boiling bag)
directions: Cook rice, drain and mix with remaining ingredients.
Top with toasted almonds.
recipes.text: Curried Rice Salad. Cook rice, drain and mix with remaining ingredients. Top with toasted almonds.

recipes.title: Cream Cabbage(This Was My Mother, Vera Hancock Dean'S Recipe.)
directions: Beat together in pan all ingredients except cabbage and cream. Stir over heat until boils.
Stir in milk; let boil.
Pour over chopped cabbage while hot.
recipes.text: Cream Cabbage(This Was My Mother, Vera Hancock Dean'S Recipe.). Beat together in pan all ingredients except cabbage and cream. Stir over heat until boils. Stir in milk; let boil. Pour over chopped cabbage while hot.

recipes.title: Sparkling Lemon-Lime Sorbet
directions: In medium saucepan, mix gelatine with sugar.
Blend in water. Let stand for 1 minute.
Stir over low heat until gelatine is completely dissolved, about 5 minutes.
Let cool to room temperature.
Stir in remaining ingredients.
Pour into 9-inch baking pan.
Freeze for 3 hours or until firm.
With electric mixer, beat mixture until smooth.
Return to pan; freeze 2 hours or until firm.
To serve, let stand at room temperature 15 minutes or until slightly softened.
Garnish with fruit, if desired.
recipes.text: Sparkling Lemon-Lime Sorbet. In medium saucepan, mix gelatine with sugar. Blend in water. Let stand for 1 minute. Stir over low heat until gelatine is completely dissolved, about 5 minutes. Let cool to room temperature. Stir in remaining ingredients. Pour into 9-inch baking pan. Freeze for 3 hours or until firm. With electric mixer, beat mixture until smooth. Return to pan; freeze 2 hours or until firm. To serve, let stand at room temperature 15 minutes or until slightly softened. Garnish with fruit, if desired.

recipes.title: Squash Casserole
ingredients: 1 c. chopped, seasoned croutons or cracker crumbs
