directions: Cook squash; drain.
Mix all other ingredients together. Spoon into lightly greased casserole.
Top with grated cheese. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Squash Casserole. Cook squash; drain. Mix all other ingredients together. Spoon into lightly greased casserole. Top with grated cheese. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Pecan Cakes
directions: Blend and beat all ingredients.
Spoon filling into unbaked shells, filling each 3/4 full.
Sprinkle on chopped pecans.
Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.
Cool on rack.
Freezes well.
recipes.text: Pecan Cakes. Blend and beat all ingredients. Spoon filling into unbaked shells, filling each 3/4 full. Sprinkle on chopped pecans. Bake at 350° for 25 minutes. Cool on rack. Freezes well.

recipes.title: Classic Heroes
directions: Layer salami, cheese and ham on bottom halves of rolls.
Top with tomato slices, onion and lettuce.
Sprinkle dressing over lettuce.
Replace tops of rolls.
Serve.
recipes.text: Classic Heroes. Layer salami, cheese and ham on bottom halves of rolls. Top with tomato slices, onion and lettuce. Sprinkle dressing over lettuce. Replace tops of rolls. Serve.

recipes.title: Party Mashed Potatoes
ingredients: 4 oz. extra sharp Cheddar cheese, shredded
directions: Cook potatoes until tender.
Mash while hot.
Add remaining ingredients and beat well.
Cover and store in refrigerator (up to 2 weeks).
On party day, remove casserole from refrigerator 1 hour before baking time.
If desired, fluff up potatoes with a little milk.
Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 45 minutes or until heated through.
recipes.text: Party Mashed Potatoes. Cook potatoes until tender. Mash while hot. Add remaining ingredients and beat well. Cover and store in refrigerator (up to 2 weeks). On party day, remove casserole from refrigerator 1 hour before baking time. If desired, fluff up potatoes with a little milk. Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 45 minutes or until heated through.

recipes.title: Sweet And Sour Meat Balls
directions: Combine beef, egg, 1 tablespoon cornstarch, salt, onion and pepper.
Form into balls.
Brown in fat; drain.
Cook oil and pineapple juice over low heat for a few minutes.
Add cornstarch, soy sauce, vinegar, water and sugar.
Cook until thick.
Add meat balls and pineapple.
Good cover rice when used as a main dish.
recipes.text: Sweet And Sour Meat Balls. Combine beef, egg, 1 tablespoon cornstarch, salt, onion and pepper. Form into balls. Brown in fat; drain. Cook oil and pineapple juice over low heat for a few minutes. Add cornstarch, soy sauce, vinegar, water and sugar. Cook until thick. Add meat balls and pineapple. Good cover rice when used as a main dish.

recipes.title: Cake Mix Cinnamon Rolls
directions: Dissolve yeast in 1/2 c. of the warm water.

Add the rest of the ingredients and knead with the last cup flour.	May need more. Let rise in greased (or sprayed) bowl until double (45-50 minutes). Roll out on floured counter & spread with 1/2-3/4 stick of melted margarine & sprinkle with brown sugar and cinnamon.
Roll up and cut.
Place rolls in a greased cake pan & let rise 40 minutes. Bake about 20 minutes or until lightly browned on top.
Frost if desired.
Easy and Good!
recipes.text: Cake Mix Cinnamon Rolls. Dissolve yeast in 1/2 c. of the warm water. Add the rest of the ingredients and knead with the last cup flour.	May need more. Let rise in greased (or sprayed) bowl until double (45-50 minutes). Roll out on floured counter & spread with 1/2-3/4 stick of melted margarine & sprinkle with brown sugar and cinnamon. Roll up and cut. Place rolls in a greased cake pan & let rise 40 minutes. Bake about 20 minutes or until lightly browned on top. Frost if desired. Easy and Good!

recipes.title: Sweet Potato Casserole
directions: Boil the potatoes until tender.
Mash and add rest of ingredients.
Pour in 3-quart casserole dish. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes. Add marshmallows for the last few minutes of baking time.
recipes.text: Sweet Potato Casserole. Boil the potatoes until tender. Mash and add rest of ingredients. Pour in 3-quart casserole dish. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes. Add marshmallows for the last few minutes of baking time.

recipes.title: Italian Pie
directions: Mix tuna, milk, eggs (beaten), cheese and spices in bowl. Pour into unbaked pie shell.
Bake 30 to 45 minutes in a 425° oven (until firm and lightly golden).
recipes.text: Italian Pie. Mix tuna, milk, eggs (beaten), cheese and spices in bowl. Pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake 30 to 45 minutes in a 425° oven (until firm and lightly golden).

recipes.title: Chicken Casserole
directions: Rinse dried beef and pat dry.
Chop dried beef and put in the bottom of a Pam sprayed baking dish.
Wrap each piece of chicken with a piece of bacon.
Chicken can be cut to any size.
Put chicken in single layer on top of dried beef.
Mix the chicken soup and sour cream.
Pour over chicken and bake, covered, for 1 1/2 hours at 350°.
Remove cover and bake another 1/2 hour at 350°.
recipes.text: Chicken Casserole. Rinse dried beef and pat dry. Chop dried beef and put in the bottom of a Pam sprayed baking dish. Wrap each piece of chicken with a piece of bacon. Chicken can be cut to any size. Put chicken in single layer on top of dried beef. Mix the chicken soup and sour cream. Pour over chicken and bake, covered, for 1 1/2 hours at 350°. Remove cover and bake another 1/2 hour at 350°.

recipes.title: T.V. Cookies
directions: Cream butter and sugar, then add flour, baking powder and soda.
Mix well, then add remaining ingredients.
Bake 10 to 12 minutes at 350°.
Let set until cool.
If you use ice cream dipper, your cookie will be nice and round.
Bake on large cookie sheet.
These are also good with
half whole and half wheat. Makes about 36 cookies.
recipes.text: T.V. Cookies. Cream butter and sugar, then add flour, baking powder and soda. Mix well, then add remaining ingredients. Bake 10 to 12 minutes at 350°. Let set until cool. If you use ice cream dipper, your cookie will be nice and round. Bake on large cookie sheet. These are also good with half whole and half wheat. Makes about 36 cookies.

recipes.title: Banana Blueberry Pudding Pie
ingredients: 2 medium bananas, sliced and dipped in ReaLemon juice from concentrate and well drained
1 (14 oz.) can Eagle sweetened condensed milk (not evaporated milk)
1 (4 serving size) pkg. instant vanilla flavor pudding mix
1 c. (1/2 pt.) Borden whipping cream, whipped
directions: Line pie plate with vanilla wafers; top with bananas and blueberries in large mixer bowl.
Beat cheese until fluffy. Gradually beat in sweetened condensed milk until smooth.
On low speed, beat in water and pudding mix until smooth.
Chill 10 minutes.
Fold in whipped cream.
Pour into prepared pie plate. Chill.
Garnish as desired.
Refrigerate leftovers.
recipes.text: Banana Blueberry Pudding Pie. Line pie plate with vanilla wafers; top with bananas and blueberries in large mixer bowl. Beat cheese until fluffy. Gradually beat in sweetened condensed milk until smooth. On low speed, beat in water and pudding mix until smooth. Chill 10 minutes. Fold in whipped cream. Pour into prepared pie plate. Chill. Garnish as desired. Refrigerate leftovers.

recipes.title: Pina Colada Cake
ingredients: 1 large can pina colada cream of coconut
1 frozen pkg. coconut or fresh coconut
directions: Mix yellow cake mix according to directions and bake.
When cake is done, punch holes in cake with end of wooden spoon.
Spoon cream of coconut on cake and let cool.
(You can use can of Eagle Brand milk to make cake richer, along with cream of coconut.)
Mix Cool Whip and coconut together and put on cake (leave some coconut for topping).
You may also use crushed pineapple.
Keep refrigerated.
recipes.text: Pina Colada Cake. Mix yellow cake mix according to directions and bake. When cake is done, punch holes in cake with end of wooden spoon. Spoon cream of coconut on cake and let cool. (You can use can of Eagle Brand milk to make cake richer, along with cream of coconut.) Mix Cool Whip and coconut together and put on cake (leave some coconut for topping). You may also use crushed pineapple. Keep refrigerated.

recipes.title: Shrimp Dip
directions: Combine cream cheese, sour cream and mayonnaise and place in bottom of 9 to 10-inch clear pie plate.
Layer in order on top of cream cheese mixture:
cocktail sauce, shredded cheese and chopped shrimp.
Combine and layer on top of shrimp:
green pepper and scallions.
Refrigerate.
Remove from refrigerator one hour before serving.
recipes.text: Shrimp Dip. Combine cream cheese, sour cream and mayonnaise and place in bottom of 9 to 10-inch clear pie plate. Layer in order on top of cream cheese mixture: cocktail sauce, shredded cheese and chopped shrimp. Combine and layer on top of shrimp: green pepper and scallions. Refrigerate. Remove from refrigerator one hour before serving.

recipes.title: Confetti Scalloped Potatoes
ingredients: 1 small green pepper, cut into strips
directions: In a skillet melt butter over medium heat.
Saute onion until tender.
Stir in potatoes, soup and milk.
Add cheese, green peppers, pimiento, pepper and 1/2 cup of the crumbs.
Pour into a shallow casserole and top with remaining crumbs.
Bake at 375° for 35 to 40 minutes.
Yields 6 to 8 servings.
recipes.text: Confetti Scalloped Potatoes. In a skillet melt butter over medium heat. Saute onion until tender. Stir in potatoes, soup and milk. Add cheese, green peppers, pimiento, pepper and 1/2 cup of the crumbs. Pour into a shallow casserole and top with remaining crumbs. Bake at 375° for 35 to 40 minutes. Yields 6 to 8 servings.

recipes.title: Cowboy Coffee Cake
ingredients: 1 c. sour cream or sour milk
directions: Combine flour, salt, sugar and shortening.
Mix until crumbly. Reserve 1/2 cup to sprinkle over batter.
To remaining crumbs, add baking powder, soda and spices.
Mix thoroughly.
Add sour cream and eggs; mix well.
Pour into wax paper-lined 13 x 9-inch pan.
Sprinkle with reserved crumbs.
Chopped nuts and cinnamon may be sprinkled over crumbs.
Bake in 375° oven for 25 to 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Cowboy Coffee Cake. Combine flour, salt, sugar and shortening. Mix until crumbly. Reserve 1/2 cup to sprinkle over batter. To remaining crumbs, add baking powder, soda and spices. Mix thoroughly. Add sour cream and eggs; mix well. Pour into wax paper-lined 13 x 9-inch pan. Sprinkle with reserved crumbs. Chopped nuts and cinnamon may be sprinkled over crumbs. Bake in 375° oven for 25 to 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Mexican Dish
directions: Mix all ingredients together.
Layer with chips and grated Cheddar cheese.
Bake until cheese melts.
This can be frozen.
recipes.text: Mexican Dish. Mix all ingredients together. Layer with chips and grated Cheddar cheese. Bake until cheese melts. This can be frozen.

recipes.title: Antipasto
directions: Drain water from mushrooms, pimentos and olives.
Do not drain the artichokes; the oil is to be used to mix all the ingredients. Cut the salami, pepperoni and Provolone into 1/4-inch slices. Then dice into bite size pieces and mix together.
Cut the remaining ingredients into bite size pieces and add.
Mix well before serving.
recipes.text: Antipasto. Drain water from mushrooms, pimentos and olives. Do not drain the artichokes; the oil is to be used to mix all the ingredients. Cut the salami, pepperoni and Provolone into 1/4-inch slices. Then dice into bite size pieces and mix together. Cut the remaining ingredients into bite size pieces and add. Mix well before serving.

recipes.title: Popsicles
directions: Dissolve first 3 ingredients in 2 cups hot water. Add 2 cups cold water.
Freeze.
recipes.text: Popsicles. Dissolve first 3 ingredients in 2 cups hot water. Add 2 cups cold water. Freeze.

recipes.title: Ed'S Green Beans
directions: Pour green beans in a casserole.
Sprinkle with onion powder. Sprinkle brown sugar over beans; pat with 1/4 cup butter and layer with 4 strips bacon.
Bake at 375° for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Ed'S Green Beans. Pour green beans in a casserole. Sprinkle with onion powder. Sprinkle brown sugar over beans; pat with 1/4 cup butter and layer with 4 strips bacon. Bake at 375° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Potato And Ham Soup
directions: Cook potatoes covered with water. Cook until tender. Add cheese, cream of chicken soup and milk.
Mix. Bring to a boil. Salt and pepper.
recipes.text: Potato And Ham Soup. Cook potatoes covered with water. Cook until tender. Add cheese, cream of chicken soup and milk. Mix. Bring to a boil. Salt and pepper.

recipes.title: Easy Jalapeno Dip
ingredients: 2 (8 oz. each) pkg. cream cheese, softened
1 (4 oz.) can chopped green chilies, drained
directions: In a container of an electric blender or food processor, combine cream cheese and tomatoes.
Blend until smooth.
Add chilies; blend well.
Serve with fresh veggies or nacho chips.
recipes.text: Easy Jalapeno Dip. In a container of an electric blender or food processor, combine cream cheese and tomatoes. Blend until smooth. Add chilies; blend well. Serve with fresh veggies or nacho chips.

recipes.title: Vegetarian Fettuccini
ingredients: 3/4 c. chicken broth (or use low-sodium vegetable broth cubes)
Parmesan cheese or fresh basil to garnish the top
directions: Heat oil in a 12-inch nonstick skillet.
Saute broccoli, celery, onion, garlic, basil and mushrooms for 5 minutes over medium-high heat.
Add the milk, Parmesan cheese and pepper.
Heat just to boiling.
Reduce heat; cover and simmer for 5 minutes.
recipes.text: Vegetarian Fettuccini. Heat oil in a 12-inch nonstick skillet. Saute broccoli, celery, onion, garlic, basil and mushrooms for 5 minutes over medium-high heat. Add the milk, Parmesan cheese and pepper. Heat just to boiling. Reduce heat; cover and simmer for 5 minutes.

recipes.title: Summer Squash Casserole
ingredients: 2 lb. yellow summer squash, sliced (6 c.)
1 (8 oz.) pkg. herb seasoned stuffing mix
directions: Cook sliced squash and onions in boiling water (salted) for 5 minutes; drain.
Combine soup and yogurt; stir in carrots.
Fold in drained squash and onions.
Combine stuffing mix and margarine. Spread half of mixture on bottom of 12 x 7 x 2-inch baking dish. Spoon vegetable mixture on top.
Sprinkle remaining stuffing mix over vegetables.
Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes or until heated through.
recipes.text: Summer Squash Casserole. Cook sliced squash and onions in boiling water (salted) for 5 minutes; drain. Combine soup and yogurt; stir in carrots. Fold in drained squash and onions. Combine stuffing mix and margarine. Spread half of mixture on bottom of 12 x 7 x 2-inch baking dish. Spoon vegetable mixture on top. Sprinkle remaining stuffing mix over vegetables. Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes or until heated through.

recipes.title: Banana Nut Bread With Raisins
directions: Mix together all dry ingredients and then add everything else, except nuts and raisins.
Add nuts and raisins last.
Put in loaf pan and cook at 300° for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Banana Nut Bread With Raisins. Mix together all dry ingredients and then add everything else, except nuts and raisins. Add nuts and raisins last. Put in loaf pan and cook at 300° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Baked Beans
directions: Cook and drain beef.
Mix all ingredients and bake 30 minutes at 350°.
recipes.text: Baked Beans. Cook and drain beef. Mix all ingredients and bake 30 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Chicken Creole
ingredients: 4 boneless chicken breast cut into 1 inch strips
1 Tbsp. fresh basil, or 1 tsp. dried basil
1 Tbsp. fresh parsley, or 1 tsp. dried parsley
directions: Spray skillet with non stick coating. Preheat pan over high heat.
Cook chicken in hot skillet for 3 - 5 minutes, or until no longer pink.
Reduce heat.
Add tomatoes and their juice.
Add celery, onion, garlic, basil, parsley, green peppers, chili powder, crushed red pepper, and salt.
Bring to a boil.
Reduce heat and simmer, covered, for 10 minutes.
Serve over hot white rice.
Serves 4.
recipes.text: Chicken Creole. Spray skillet with non stick coating. Preheat pan over high heat. Cook chicken in hot skillet for 3 - 5 minutes, or until no longer pink. Reduce heat. Add tomatoes and their juice. Add celery, onion, garlic, basil, parsley, green peppers, chili powder, crushed red pepper, and salt. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer, covered, for 10 minutes. Serve over hot white rice. Serves 4.

recipes.title: Crazy Cake
directions: Put all dry ingredients in baking pan and make 2 wells.
In one put vinegar and oil.
In the other put vanilla and cold water. Mix and bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.
recipes.text: Crazy Cake. Put all dry ingredients in baking pan and make 2 wells. In one put vinegar and oil. In the other put vanilla and cold water. Mix and bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.

recipes.title: Oyster Corn Casserole
ingredients: 1 pt. canned oysters, drained and rinsed
directions: Mix the first 2 ingredients together.
Mix remaining ingredients together.
Layer crackers, corn mixture, oysters, crackers, corn mixture and oysters.
Top with crackers.
In a 2-quart casserole, bake at 350° for 40 minutes or until crackers are golden brown.
recipes.text: Oyster Corn Casserole. Mix the first 2 ingredients together. Mix remaining ingredients together. Layer crackers, corn mixture, oysters, crackers, corn mixture and oysters. Top with crackers. In a 2-quart casserole, bake at 350° for 40 minutes or until crackers are golden brown.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter And Date Logs
directions: Mix all ingredients, except almond bark.
Form mixture into logs.
Let stand in freezer until firm.
Melt almond bark and dip logs into bark to cover.
Place on wax paper until set.
recipes.text: Peanut Butter And Date Logs. Mix all ingredients, except almond bark. Form mixture into logs. Let stand in freezer until firm. Melt almond bark and dip logs into bark to cover. Place on wax paper until set.

recipes.title: Cranberry Jello
directions: Cool jello not set, then beat very well with electric mixer or blender.
Pour into a mold to set.
recipes.text: Cranberry Jello. Cool jello not set, then beat very well with electric mixer or blender. Pour into a mold to set.

recipes.title: Pineapple Torte
directions: Part 1:
Spread wafer crumbs in 9 x 13-inch pan.
recipes.text: Pineapple Torte. Part 1: Spread wafer crumbs in 9 x 13-inch pan.

recipes.title: Baked Spaghetti
ingredients: 1/2 can black olives, slice and drain
directions: Cook hamburger, onion and peppers.
Drain.
Add mushrooms, olives, spaghetti sauce and oregano.
Simmer all together.
Cook small box of spaghetti, break into small pieces.
recipes.text: Baked Spaghetti. Cook hamburger, onion and peppers. Drain. Add mushrooms, olives, spaghetti sauce and oregano. Simmer all together. Cook small box of spaghetti, break into small pieces.

recipes.title: Pickled Eggs
ingredients: 1/2 to 1 red chile pepper per jar
directions: These are very, very
good
and worth the effort.
Read the recipe and have what you need on hand before you start.
recipes.text: Pickled Eggs. These are very, very good and worth the effort. Read the recipe and have what you need on hand before you start.

recipes.title: Gumdrop Cookies
directions: Cream the margarine and brown sugar.
Beat in egg and vanilla. Combine dry ingredients.
Gradually add to creamed mixture.
Stir in oats, gumdrops and nuts.
Drop by teaspoonfuls on ungreased cookie sheet.
Bake 12 to 14 minutes at 350°.
Makes 5 to 6 dozen cookies.
recipes.text: Gumdrop Cookies. Cream the margarine and brown sugar. Beat in egg and vanilla. Combine dry ingredients. Gradually add to creamed mixture. Stir in oats, gumdrops and nuts. Drop by teaspoonfuls on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake 12 to 14 minutes at 350°. Makes 5 to 6 dozen cookies.

recipes.title: Zesty Carrots
directions: Cut carrots into thin strips.
Cook until tender in salted water.
Place in 6 x 10-inch baking dish.
Mix together rest of the ingredients (except crumbs) and pour over carrots.
Sprinkle with crumbs.
Bake at 375° for 15 minutes.
recipes.text: Zesty Carrots. Cut carrots into thin strips. Cook until tender in salted water. Place in 6 x 10-inch baking dish. Mix together rest of the ingredients (except crumbs) and pour over carrots. Sprinkle with crumbs. Bake at 375° for 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Best Ever Chocolate Sheet Cake
directions: Mix flour and sugar in mixing bowl. Bring to a boil the margarine, baking cocoa and water. Pour over flour mixture and mix well. Beat in eggs. Add buttermilk, soda and 1 teaspoon vanilla and mix well. Spoon into a greased and floured 12 x 17-inch baking pan. Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Best Ever Chocolate Sheet Cake. Mix flour and sugar in mixing bowl. Bring to a boil the margarine, baking cocoa and water. Pour over flour mixture and mix well. Beat in eggs. Add buttermilk, soda and 1 teaspoon vanilla and mix well. Spoon into a greased and floured 12 x 17-inch baking pan. Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Greek Black-Eyed Pea Salad
ingredients: 1/2 c. yellow or red bell pepper, diced
1/4 tsp. salt or Spike with sea salt from health food store (Spike is made up of mixed herbs)
directions: Combine all ingredients in a large bowl.
Marinate 6 to 8 hours.
Refrigerate, stirring occasionally.
recipes.text: Greek Black-Eyed Pea Salad. Combine all ingredients in a large bowl. Marinate 6 to 8 hours. Refrigerate, stirring occasionally.

recipes.title: No Bake Mini Fruit Cake
directions: Prepare cake mix.
Cool; crumble into a large bowl.
Add fruits, raisins, dates and pecans in the bowl.
Using hands, toss and mix well.
Combine applesauce and lemon juice.
Add to cake. Mix until combined. Pack into cups.
Place a cherry on top of each one.
Cover with Saran Wrap.
Refrigerate 24 hours.
recipes.text: No Bake Mini Fruit Cake. Prepare cake mix. Cool; crumble into a large bowl. Add fruits, raisins, dates and pecans in the bowl. Using hands, toss and mix well. Combine applesauce and lemon juice. Add to cake. Mix until combined. Pack into cups. Place a cherry on top of each one. Cover with Saran Wrap. Refrigerate 24 hours.

recipes.title: Turkey Chili
directions: Brown turkey and onion in a large heavy pot, stirring occasionally.
Add beans, water, tomatoes, tomato paste and chili powder.
Cover and simmer for about 1 hour, stirring occasionally. Serve hot with crackers or French bread.
Great on a cold snowy night!
recipes.text: Turkey Chili. Brown turkey and onion in a large heavy pot, stirring occasionally. Add beans, water, tomatoes, tomato paste and chili powder. Cover and simmer for about 1 hour, stirring occasionally. Serve hot with crackers or French bread. Great on a cold snowy night!

recipes.title: Skillet Enchiladas
ingredients: 1 (10 3/4 oz.) can cream of mushroom soup
directions: In a 10-inch skillet, cook ground beef and onion until meat is brown and onion is tender.
Drain.
Stir in soup, enchilada sauce, milk and chilies.
Reduce heat; cover and simmer 20 minutes, stirring occasionally.
recipes.text: Skillet Enchiladas. In a 10-inch skillet, cook ground beef and onion until meat is brown and onion is tender. Drain. Stir in soup, enchilada sauce, milk and chilies. Reduce heat; cover and simmer 20 minutes, stirring occasionally.

recipes.title: Layered Casserole
directions: Brown ground beef.
Set aside.
Slice potatoes and carrots. Cook potatoes and carrots until just tender.
Layer potatoes, carrots, green beans and 1/2 cup of juice.
Sprinkle rice on top of these.
Ground beef over these, then pour on spaghetti sauce. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Layered Casserole. Brown ground beef. Set aside. Slice potatoes and carrots. Cook potatoes and carrots until just tender. Layer potatoes, carrots, green beans and 1/2 cup of juice. Sprinkle rice on top of these. Ground beef over these, then pour on spaghetti sauce. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Sugar Peanuts
directions: Put all ingredients in frypan on high and stir while peanuts eat up water and sugar.
Spread on cookie sheet and bake at 350° in a preheated oven, stirring every 10 minutes for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Sugar Peanuts. Put all ingredients in frypan on high and stir while peanuts eat up water and sugar. Spread on cookie sheet and bake at 350° in a preheated oven, stirring every 10 minutes for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Liver And Onions Grandma'S Way
directions: Fry bacon until crisp.
Remove from pan.
Put onion into hot bacon grease.
Dip liver in flour (both sides); cook liver. Remove from pan.
recipes.text: Liver And Onions Grandma'S Way. Fry bacon until crisp. Remove from pan. Put onion into hot bacon grease. Dip liver in flour (both sides); cook liver. Remove from pan.

recipes.title: Easy Pineapple Cake
directions: Bake cake according to directions on box in a 9 x 13-inch pan. While cake is baking, mix sugar, milk and margarine together, adding beaten egg last.
Cook on low heat until thickened.
Punch holes in cake with handle of a wooden spoon.
Pour juice from pineapple over cake and then spread pineapple over cake.
Pour sauce over pineapple and refrigerate.
Cake will keep for several days in refrigerator.
recipes.text: Easy Pineapple Cake. Bake cake according to directions on box in a 9 x 13-inch pan. While cake is baking, mix sugar, milk and margarine together, adding beaten egg last. Cook on low heat until thickened. Punch holes in cake with handle of a wooden spoon. Pour juice from pineapple over cake and then spread pineapple over cake. Pour sauce over pineapple and refrigerate. Cake will keep for several days in refrigerator.

recipes.title: Green Bean Casserole
directions: Place green beans in baking dish.
Add undiluted soup and top with onion rings.
Thoroughly heat at 325° to 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.
recipes.text: Green Bean Casserole. Place green beans in baking dish. Add undiluted soup and top with onion rings. Thoroughly heat at 325° to 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.

recipes.title: Oatmeal Cake
directions: Combine together boiling water, oleo and oatmeal.
Stir once in a while.
Mix together sugar, brown sugar, vanilla and eggs, then add oatmeal mixture and stir well.
Sift in flour, salt, cinnamon and soda.
Mix thoroughly and bake at 350°.
recipes.text: Oatmeal Cake. Combine together boiling water, oleo and oatmeal. Stir once in a while. Mix together sugar, brown sugar, vanilla and eggs, then add oatmeal mixture and stir well. Sift in flour, salt, cinnamon and soda. Mix thoroughly and bake at 350°.

recipes.title: Coca-Cola Cake
directions: In a large bowl, put flour, sugar, baking powder and salt. Combine margarine, cocoa, Coca-Cola and marshmallows in a saucepan and heat until it comes to a boil.
Remove from heat and stir until marshmallows are dissolved.
recipes.text: Coca-Cola Cake. In a large bowl, put flour, sugar, baking powder and salt. Combine margarine, cocoa, Coca-Cola and marshmallows in a saucepan and heat until it comes to a boil. Remove from heat and stir until marshmallows are dissolved.

recipes.title: Orange Fluff Salad
directions: Mix cottage cheese with dry gelatin.
Blend in whipped topping, oranges and pineapple.
Decorate with cherries.
recipes.text: Orange Fluff Salad. Mix cottage cheese with dry gelatin. Blend in whipped topping, oranges and pineapple. Decorate with cherries.

recipes.title: Tomato-Cucumber Relish
directions: Combine vinegar, water, sugar, salt and pepper; add tomato, cucumber and onion.
Cover and refrigerate 1 to 2 hours.
Before serving, drain well.
Stir in sweet pickle.
recipes.text: Tomato-Cucumber Relish. Combine vinegar, water, sugar, salt and pepper; add tomato, cucumber and onion. Cover and refrigerate 1 to 2 hours. Before serving, drain well. Stir in sweet pickle.

recipes.title: Herb Stuffed Mushrooms
ingredients: 3 Tbsp. finely chopped shallots or green onions
directions: Clean mushrooms.
Remove stems.
Chop stems finely.
Melt 1/4 cup butter in skillet.
Saute mushroom caps briefly on both sides. Remove to shallow baking dish.
Melt remaining butter and saute stems and onions.
Remove from heat.
Add bread crumbs and remaining ingredients.
Toss to mix.
Spoon into caps.
Bake for 20 minutes at 350°.
recipes.text: Herb Stuffed Mushrooms. Clean mushrooms. Remove stems. Chop stems finely. Melt 1/4 cup butter in skillet. Saute mushroom caps briefly on both sides. Remove to shallow baking dish. Melt remaining butter and saute stems and onions. Remove from heat. Add bread crumbs and remaining ingredients. Toss to mix. Spoon into caps. Bake for 20 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Potato Casserole
ingredients: 1 (32 oz.) bag frozen hash brown potatoes
1 (11 oz.) pkg. grated Cheddar or American cheese
1 (12 oz.) carton half and half or 8 oz. sour cream
directions: Thaw potatoes and spread in a 9 x 13-inch casserole.
Mix next 6 ingredients and pour over potatoes.
Top with crushed cornflakes and drizzle butter over all.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes, uncovered.
Serves 12.
recipes.text: Potato Casserole. Thaw potatoes and spread in a 9 x 13-inch casserole. Mix next 6 ingredients and pour over potatoes. Top with crushed cornflakes and drizzle butter over all. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes, uncovered. Serves 12.

recipes.title: Corn Souffle
directions: Drain corn, reserving liquid.
Add enough milk to reserved liquid to measure 1 cup.
Blend flour into melted butter in large saucepan.
Add milk mixture.
Cook until thickened, stirring constantly.
Stir a small amount of hot mixture into eggs; stir eggs into hot mixture.
Add corn, salt and pepper; mix well. Spoon into greased 2-quart baking dish.
Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes or until set and golden brown.
Garnish with paprika.
recipes.text: Corn Souffle. Drain corn, reserving liquid. Add enough milk to reserved liquid to measure 1 cup. Blend flour into melted butter in large saucepan. Add milk mixture. Cook until thickened, stirring constantly. Stir a small amount of hot mixture into eggs; stir eggs into hot mixture. Add corn, salt and pepper; mix well. Spoon into greased 2-quart baking dish. Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes or until set and golden brown. Garnish with paprika.

recipes.title: Broccoli And Cheese Quiche
ingredients: 1 pkg. frozen broccoli or 2 c. fresh
directions: Cook broccoli until tender and drain.
Spray deep glass pie plate with Pam and pour mixture in.
Bake 45 minutes at 375°.
You can add chopped ham or cooked bacon that has been crumbled, if you wish.
recipes.text: Broccoli And Cheese Quiche. Cook broccoli until tender and drain. Spray deep glass pie plate with Pam and pour mixture in. Bake 45 minutes at 375°. You can add chopped ham or cooked bacon that has been crumbled, if you wish.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Cake
directions: Mix together cake mix (reserve 1 cup for topping), 1 stick oleo (melted) and 1 egg.
Put in a 9 x 13-inch pan.
Mix the pumpkin pie mix, 2 eggs and Pet milk.
Pour over cake mixture. Mix 1 cup of the cake mix, 1/4 cup oleo, sugar, cinnamon and nuts. Mix until crumbly.
Sprinkle on top.
Bake 1 hour at 325° in glass pan; 10 minutes longer in metal pan.
Serve with Cool Whip.
recipes.text: Pumpkin Cake. Mix together cake mix (reserve 1 cup for topping), 1 stick oleo (melted) and 1 egg. Put in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix the pumpkin pie mix, 2 eggs and Pet milk. Pour over cake mixture. Mix 1 cup of the cake mix, 1/4 cup oleo, sugar, cinnamon and nuts. Mix until crumbly. Sprinkle on top. Bake 1 hour at 325° in glass pan; 10 minutes longer in metal pan. Serve with Cool Whip.

recipes.title: Greg'S Spaghetti Sauce
ingredients: 28 oz. can whole tomatoes, broken up or pureed
directions: Brown sausage, onion, green pepper and garlic.
Drain.
Add remaining ingredients and simmer for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Greg'S Spaghetti Sauce. Brown sausage, onion, green pepper and garlic. Drain. Add remaining ingredients and simmer for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Chicken With Rice(From The Kitchen Of Sarah Surina.)
directions: Flour pieces of chicken and brown in small amount of oil. Melt butter in shallow baking dish or pan.
Cover bottom with layer of rice.
Place chicken pieces on top of rice.
Add mushroom soup and chicken broth.
Add water.
Salt and pepper to taste. Spread soup over chicken and spread it around.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Chicken With Rice(From The Kitchen Of Sarah Surina.). Flour pieces of chicken and brown in small amount of oil. Melt butter in shallow baking dish or pan. Cover bottom with layer of rice. Place chicken pieces on top of rice. Add mushroom soup and chicken broth. Add water. Salt and pepper to taste. Spread soup over chicken and spread it around. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Mock Margarita Punch
ingredients: 12 oz. can frozen lemonade concentrated, thawed
12 oz. can frozen limeade concentrate, thawed
directions: In 4-quart nonmetal container, combine lemonade, lime-ade, powdered sugar and crushed ice; mix well.
Cover and freeze, stirring occasionally.
Remove container from freezer 30 minutes before serving.
Spoon 2 cups slush mixture into blender; add 1 cup club soda; blend until frothy.
recipes.text: Mock Margarita Punch. In 4-quart nonmetal container, combine lemonade, lime-ade, powdered sugar and crushed ice; mix well. Cover and freeze, stirring occasionally. Remove container from freezer 30 minutes before serving. Spoon 2 cups slush mixture into blender; add 1 cup club soda; blend until frothy.

recipes.title: Fruit Salad
directions: Mix fruit and nuts together. Sprinkle pudding mix over it and toss together.
recipes.text: Fruit Salad. Mix fruit and nuts together. Sprinkle pudding mix over it and toss together.

recipes.title: Veg-All Casserole
directions: Combine Veg-All, chestnuts, onion, mayonnaise, salt and pepper.
Pour into casserole dish.
Sprinkle on cheese, then cracker crumbs.
Pour melted oleo over this and bake at 325° for 25 to 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Veg-All Casserole. Combine Veg-All, chestnuts, onion, mayonnaise, salt and pepper. Pour into casserole dish. Sprinkle on cheese, then cracker crumbs. Pour melted oleo over this and bake at 325° for 25 to 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Holiday Macaroons
ingredients: 1 (10 oz.) jar cherries, drained and halved
directions: In a mixing bowl beat the eggs until foamy.
Gradually add sugar, beating constantly until thick and pale yellow.
Stir together dry ingredients; fold into egg mixture.
Stir in butter, vanilla and coconut.
Drop by teaspoonfuls onto greased and floured cookie sheets.
Top with cherries.
Bake at 325° for 10 to 13 minutes.
Yield:
6 dozen.
recipes.text: Holiday Macaroons. In a mixing bowl beat the eggs until foamy. Gradually add sugar, beating constantly until thick and pale yellow. Stir together dry ingredients; fold into egg mixture. Stir in butter, vanilla and coconut. Drop by teaspoonfuls onto greased and floured cookie sheets. Top with cherries. Bake at 325° for 10 to 13 minutes. Yield: 6 dozen.

recipes.title: Ultimate Chocolate Chip Cookies
ingredients: 1 1/4 c. firmly packed light brown sugar
directions: Heat oven to 375°.
Combine Crisco, light brown sugar, milk and vanilla in large bowl.
Beat at medium speed until well blended.
Beat egg into creamed mixture.
Combine flour, salt and soda.
Mix into creamed mixture just until blended.
Stir in chocolate chips and pecans.
Drop by spoonfuls onto ungreased baking sheet.
Bake for 8 to 10 minutes for chewy cookies, cookies will appear moist (do not overbake) or 11 to 13 minutes for crisp cookies.
recipes.text: Ultimate Chocolate Chip Cookies. Heat oven to 375°. Combine Crisco, light brown sugar, milk and vanilla in large bowl. Beat at medium speed until well blended. Beat egg into creamed mixture. Combine flour, salt and soda. Mix into creamed mixture just until blended. Stir in chocolate chips and pecans. Drop by spoonfuls onto ungreased baking sheet. Bake for 8 to 10 minutes for chewy cookies, cookies will appear moist (do not overbake) or 11 to 13 minutes for crisp cookies.

recipes.title: Stuffed Potato Casserole
ingredients: 1/2 lb. sharp process Cheddar cheese (Cooper cheese works nice), shredded or cut into small pieces
directions: Bake potatoes in a 350° oven for 1 hour or until done.
Let cool until you can handle them.
Meanwhile, fry bacon and cut cheese.
When potatoes have cooled, peel.
Mash lightly in a large bowl.
Add butter and milk; stir.
Potatoes will still be slightly lumpy.
Stir in bacon and cheese.
Season with salt and pepper. Put mixture in a 2 quart casserole.
Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.
recipes.text: Stuffed Potato Casserole. Bake potatoes in a 350° oven for 1 hour or until done. Let cool until you can handle them. Meanwhile, fry bacon and cut cheese. When potatoes have cooled, peel. Mash lightly in a large bowl. Add butter and milk; stir. Potatoes will still be slightly lumpy. Stir in bacon and cheese. Season with salt and pepper. Put mixture in a 2 quart casserole. Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Skillet Noodles And Peas
directions: Heat oil and margarine.
Add cooked noodles to oil.
Add onions.
Brown noodles then add broth and milk.
Add frozen peas. Cook 15 minutes.
recipes.text: Skillet Noodles And Peas. Heat oil and margarine. Add cooked noodles to oil. Add onions. Brown noodles then add broth and milk. Add frozen peas. Cook 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Cooked Potato Salad Dressing
directions: Mix flour and sugar well.
Add eggs.
Add milk and vinegar. Cook until thick.
recipes.text: Cooked Potato Salad Dressing. Mix flour and sugar well. Add eggs. Add milk and vinegar. Cook until thick.

recipes.title: Tea Cookies
directions: Cream butter, sugar and shortening thoroughly. Add egg and blend well. Sift together flour and baking powder. Add with vanilla extract to first mixture; blend thoroughly. Drop mixture by tablespoonfuls on ungreased baking sheet. Bake in oven at 350° for 8 to 10 minutes, depending on thickness of cookie. If desired, press cookies with fork before baking.
recipes.text: Tea Cookies. Cream butter, sugar and shortening thoroughly. Add egg and blend well. Sift together flour and baking powder. Add with vanilla extract to first mixture; blend thoroughly. Drop mixture by tablespoonfuls on ungreased baking sheet. Bake in oven at 350° for 8 to 10 minutes, depending on thickness of cookie. If desired, press cookies with fork before baking.

recipes.title: Strawberry Punch
directions: In a large mixing bowl, dissolve sugar in boiling water.
Add juices and strawberries.
Pour mixture into a large plastic container and freeze until firm.
Remove from freezer 1 hour before serving.
Place in punch bowl and break into chunks.
Add Sprite. Stir until slushy.
Garnish with 1 pint fresh strawberries.
Makes 6 quarts.
recipes.text: Strawberry Punch. In a large mixing bowl, dissolve sugar in boiling water. Add juices and strawberries. Pour mixture into a large plastic container and freeze until firm. Remove from freezer 1 hour before serving. Place in punch bowl and break into chunks. Add Sprite. Stir until slushy. Garnish with 1 pint fresh strawberries. Makes 6 quarts.

recipes.title: Key Lime Pie
ingredients: 1 can Eagle Brand sweetened condensed milk
directions: In a large bowl, combine condensed milk, lime juice and food coloring (color to your own taste).
Pour into crust and chill. Serve with Cool Whip.
recipes.text: Key Lime Pie. In a large bowl, combine condensed milk, lime juice and food coloring (color to your own taste). Pour into crust and chill. Serve with Cool Whip.

recipes.title: Chicken Casserole
ingredients: 1 whole chicken, stewed and bone removed (do not salt)
directions: Mix stuffing with melted margarine.
Put half of mixture in bottom of pan. Add chicken, then soups mixed with chicken broth. Cover with remaining stuffing mixture.
Bake, uncovered, for 1 1/2 hours at 350°.
recipes.text: Chicken Casserole. Mix stuffing with melted margarine. Put half of mixture in bottom of pan. Add chicken, then soups mixed with chicken broth. Cover with remaining stuffing mixture. Bake, uncovered, for 1 1/2 hours at 350°.

recipes.title: Cauliflower Au Gratin
ingredients: 3/4 c. day old bread, diced into 1/2-inch pieces
directions: Separate cauliflower into flowerets and cook in boiling, salted water for 10 minutes.
Drain and turn into a casserole or shallow baking dish.
Melt 2 tablespoons butter in a saucepan.
Blend in flour and salt.
Gradually add milk and cook, stirring constantly, until thickened.
Add spices and parsley.
Pour over cauliflower. Melt remaining butter and add several good shakes of paprika.
Toss with bread cubes.
Add walnuts and sprinkle over cauliflower.
Bake 10 to 15 minutes in a 400° oven.
recipes.text: Cauliflower Au Gratin. Separate cauliflower into flowerets and cook in boiling, salted water for 10 minutes. Drain and turn into a casserole or shallow baking dish. Melt 2 tablespoons butter in a saucepan. Blend in flour and salt. Gradually add milk and cook, stirring constantly, until thickened. Add spices and parsley. Pour over cauliflower. Melt remaining butter and add several good shakes of paprika. Toss with bread cubes. Add walnuts and sprinkle over cauliflower. Bake 10 to 15 minutes in a 400° oven.

recipes.title: Tim'S Peanut Butter Pie
directions: Combine powdered sugar and peanut butter. Blend until appearance is that of biscuit mix. Spread over half of the mixture on pie shell. Combine white sugar, salt and cornstarch; add scalded milk and mix well. Pour small amount

over beaten egg yolks and mix well, then return to milk mixture. Cook in top of double boiler until mixture thickens. Add butter and vanilla. Pour mixture into pie shell. Top with meringue and sprinkle remainder of peanut butter mixture on the top. Baked at 325° until the meringue is brown.
recipes.text: Tim'S Peanut Butter Pie. Combine powdered sugar and peanut butter. Blend until appearance is that of biscuit mix. Spread over half of the mixture on pie shell. Combine white sugar, salt and cornstarch; add scalded milk and mix well. Pour small amount over beaten egg yolks and mix well, then return to milk mixture. Cook in top of double boiler until mixture thickens. Add butter and vanilla. Pour mixture into pie shell. Top with meringue and sprinkle remainder of peanut butter mixture on the top. Baked at 325° until the meringue is brown.

recipes.title: My Favorite Recipe
directions: Blend love and kindness.
Alternately add, in small portions, appreciation and pleasant companionship sifted with deserving praise.
Flavor with carefully chosen advice.
Lightly fold in cheerfulness and sorrow.
Pour with tender care into clean hearts. Let bake until well matured; turn out on the surface of society. Humbly ask God's blessings and it will serve all mankind.
recipes.text: My Favorite Recipe. Blend love and kindness. Alternately add, in small portions, appreciation and pleasant companionship sifted with deserving praise. Flavor with carefully chosen advice. Lightly fold in cheerfulness and sorrow. Pour with tender care into clean hearts. Let bake until well matured; turn out on the surface of society. Humbly ask God's blessings and it will serve all mankind.

recipes.title: Chicken Waldorf Salad
directions: Blend mayo, sugar, mustard, salt and lemon juice.
Add remaining ingredients.
Toss gently to coat.
Serve on bed of lettuce or serve as is.
recipes.text: Chicken Waldorf Salad. Blend mayo, sugar, mustard, salt and lemon juice. Add remaining ingredients. Toss gently to coat. Serve on bed of lettuce or serve as is.

recipes.title: Easy Fruit Dip
directions: Pour dry custard into soft Cool Whip and mix well.
recipes.text: Easy Fruit Dip. Pour dry custard into soft Cool Whip and mix well.

recipes.title: Pizza Salad
directions: Dice tomatoes and onion; cube cheese.
Mix tomatoes, onion and cheese with cooled, cooked macaroni.
Add all other ingredients except Parmesan cheese and croutons.
Refrigerate 2 or more hours. When ready to serve, add croutons and Parmesan cheese.
recipes.text: Pizza Salad. Dice tomatoes and onion; cube cheese. Mix tomatoes, onion and cheese with cooled, cooked macaroni. Add all other ingredients except Parmesan cheese and croutons. Refrigerate 2 or more hours. When ready to serve, add croutons and Parmesan cheese.

recipes.title: Cheese-Garlic Biscuits
directions: Mix baking mix, milk and cheese until soft dough forms.
Drop dough by spoonfuls onto ungreased cookie sheet.
Bake 8 to 10 minutes or golden brown.
Mix butter and garlic powder; brush over warm biscuits.
Serve warm.
Bake at 450°.
recipes.text: Cheese-Garlic Biscuits. Mix baking mix, milk and cheese until soft dough forms. Drop dough by spoonfuls onto ungreased cookie sheet. Bake 8 to 10 minutes or golden brown. Mix butter and garlic powder; brush over warm biscuits. Serve warm. Bake at 450°.

recipes.title: Andy Jones Meat Loaf
directions: Mix all together and pack into baking dish.
Bake at 350°. (For extra flavor, lay 2 slices of bacon on top before baking.)
recipes.text: Andy Jones Meat Loaf. Mix all together and pack into baking dish. Bake at 350°. (For extra flavor, lay 2 slices of bacon on top before baking.)

recipes.title: Nut Fingers
directions: Cream butter, sugar and nuts, then flour.
Shape dough into finger-shapes with hands and place on ungreased cookie sheet.
Bake in slow (325°) oven 15 to 18 minutes.
Cookie will not be brown when done.
Roll in confectioners sugar warm.
Makes about 4 dozen.
recipes.text: Nut Fingers. Cream butter, sugar and nuts, then flour. Shape dough into finger-shapes with hands and place on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake in slow (325°) oven 15 to 18 minutes. Cookie will not be brown when done. Roll in confectioners sugar warm. Makes about 4 dozen.

recipes.title: Diet Snickers
directions: Mix all together and spread in an 8 x 8-inch pan.
Freeze and cut into 8 bars.
recipes.text: Diet Snickers. Mix all together and spread in an 8 x 8-inch pan. Freeze and cut into 8 bars.

recipes.title: Chicken Cordon Bleu
ingredients: 1 can low-fat cream of chicken soup
directions: Pound chicken breasts.
Top each with ham and cheese and roll up and secure with toothpick.
Makes sauce from remaining ingredients and pour over chicken.
Top with stuffing mix.
Bake covered at 350° for 25 minutes, uncovered for 20 minutes more. Serves 4.
Six grams fat.
recipes.text: Chicken Cordon Bleu. Pound chicken breasts. Top each with ham and cheese and roll up and secure with toothpick. Makes sauce from remaining ingredients and pour over chicken. Top with stuffing mix. Bake covered at 350° for 25 minutes, uncovered for 20 minutes more. Serves 4. Six grams fat.

recipes.title: Chocolate Almond Pie
directions: Melt marshmallows and candy bars in milk in double boiler. Remove from heat and cool. Whip the cream until stiff and fold into cooled mixture. Add vanilla. Pour into prepared crust and chill. Top with whipped cream.
recipes.text: Chocolate Almond Pie. Melt marshmallows and candy bars in milk in double boiler. Remove from heat and cool. Whip the cream until stiff and fold into cooled mixture. Add vanilla. Pour into prepared crust and chill. Top with whipped cream.

recipes.title: Luscious Lemon Pie
directions: Combine sugar, water and oleo.
Cook until sugar dissolves. Add cornstarch that has been blended with cold water.
Cook slowly until clear, 8 minutes.
Add lemon juice and grated peel.
Cook 2 minutes.
Slowly add the egg yolks beaten with the 2 tablespoons of milk.
Bring to a boil.
Cool.
Fold the egg whites into filling.
Pour into pie shell and top with meringue.
recipes.text: Luscious Lemon Pie. Combine sugar, water and oleo. Cook until sugar dissolves. Add cornstarch that has been blended with cold water. Cook slowly until clear, 8 minutes. Add lemon juice and grated peel. Cook 2 minutes. Slowly add the egg yolks beaten with the 2 tablespoons of milk. Bring to a boil. Cool. Fold the egg whites into filling. Pour into pie shell and top with meringue.

recipes.title: Mama Terry'S Chocolate Banana Cake
directions: Combine dry ingredients in a large bowl.
Add eggs, bananas, water, oil and butter flavoring until blended.
Blend on medium speed.
Increase speed and whip a few minutes until smooth and creamy.
Grease and flour three 8 or 9-inch pans and fill 1/2 to 2/3 full only.
Bake at 325° for 40 minutes.
Cool 10 minutes and remove from pans.
Set until completely cool.
recipes.text: Mama Terry'S Chocolate Banana Cake. Combine dry ingredients in a large bowl. Add eggs, bananas, water, oil and butter flavoring until blended. Blend on medium speed. Increase speed and whip a few minutes until smooth and creamy. Grease and flour three 8 or 9-inch pans and fill 1/2 to 2/3 full only. Bake at 325° for 40 minutes. Cool 10 minutes and remove from pans. Set until completely cool.

recipes.title: Ice Cream Cone
directions: Sift together dry ingredients.
Add oil and egg whites; mix until smooth.
Add water and vanilla.
recipes.text: Ice Cream Cone. Sift together dry ingredients. Add oil and egg whites; mix until smooth. Add water and vanilla.

recipes.title: Lobster Stew
directions: Saute lobster meat in butter for approximately 10 minutes. Add sherry, cream and milk.
Blend together.
recipes.text: Lobster Stew. Saute lobster meat in butter for approximately 10 minutes. Add sherry, cream and milk. Blend together.

recipes.title: Red Cocktail Sauce
ingredients: juice of 1/2 lemon or to taste
dash of hot pepper sauce or pinch of cayenne pepper
directions: Combine all ingredients in a glass or plastic container. Cover tight and refrigerate.
recipes.text: Red Cocktail Sauce. Combine all ingredients in a glass or plastic container. Cover tight and refrigerate.

recipes.title: Swedish Cake And Topping
directions: Mix first 3 ingredients together and then add baking soda, flour, vanilla and walnuts.
Bake in 9 x 13-inch pan at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes.
While cake is still warm, cover with topping.
recipes.text: Swedish Cake And Topping. Mix first 3 ingredients together and then add baking soda, flour, vanilla and walnuts. Bake in 9 x 13-inch pan at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes. While cake is still warm, cover with topping.

recipes.title: Vanilla Giffolds
directions: Mix together well.
Bake while warm.
Roll in extra powdered sugar.
Shape dough into half moons.
Bake at 350° for 10 to 15 minutes.
recipes.text: Vanilla Giffolds. Mix together well. Bake while warm. Roll in extra powdered sugar. Shape dough into half moons. Bake at 350° for 10 to 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Poached Chicken Breast In Wine
ingredients: 4 (4 oz.) skinned, boned chicken breast halves
3/4 c. Chablis or other dry wine
directions: Place
chicken between two sheets of heavy-duty plastic wrap. Flatten
to 1/4 inch; set aside.
Combine wine and next 4 ingredients
in
a
large skillet; bring to a boil over high heat. Arrange
chicken
in a single layer in skillet.
Cover, reduce heat and simmer 15 minutes or until chicken is tender. Remove chicken
to
serving
plate.
Combine
cornstarch
and water; stir
into
skillet.
Bring
mixture to a boil; boil 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Pour sauce over chicken.
Yields 4 servings.
recipes.text: Poached Chicken Breast In Wine. Place chicken between two sheets of heavy-duty plastic wrap. Flatten to 1/4 inch; set aside. Combine wine and next 4 ingredients in a large skillet; bring to a boil over high heat. Arrange chicken in a single layer in skillet. Cover, reduce heat and simmer 15 minutes or until chicken is tender. Remove chicken to serving plate. Combine cornstarch and water; stir into skillet. Bring mixture to a boil; boil 1 minute, stirring constantly. Pour sauce over chicken. Yields 4 servings.

recipes.title: Layered Mexican Dip
directions: Mix together refried beans, green chilies and taco seasoning mix.
Spread on 12-inch round serving platter.
Blend avocados, lemon juice and 1/2 cup taco sauce until smooth (or use ready made guacamole dip and just drizzle with lemon juice).
Spread on top of bean mixture.
Top with a layer of sour cream, then taco sauce. Top with cheese, scallions and onions.
recipes.text: Layered Mexican Dip. Mix together refried beans, green chilies and taco seasoning mix. Spread on 12-inch round serving platter. Blend avocados, lemon juice and 1/2 cup taco sauce until smooth (or use ready made guacamole dip and just drizzle with lemon juice). Spread on top of bean mixture. Top with a layer of sour cream, then taco sauce. Top with cheese, scallions and onions.

recipes.title: Chili
directions: Brown hamburger meat; drain.
Add beans, chili seasoning, tomato sauce and water (depending on how thick you like it).
Cook in large pan until boiling.
Serve hot.
recipes.text: Chili. Brown hamburger meat; drain. Add beans, chili seasoning, tomato sauce and water (depending on how thick you like it). Cook in large pan until boiling. Serve hot.

recipes.title: Caramel Corn
directions: Pop corn in air popper.
Place into brown paper bag.
In large bowl mix corn syrup, brown sugar, salt and melted butter.
Cook in microwave on High for 4 minutes.
Stir once.
Add soda and vanilla; stir well.
Pour caramel over popcorn and mix with a long wooden spoon.
Fold top of bag over place in microwave.
Cook 1 1/2 minutes on High.
Pour onto large sheet pan and cool.
Store in airtight container if there is any left.
recipes.text: Caramel Corn. Pop corn in air popper. Place into brown paper bag. In large bowl mix corn syrup, brown sugar, salt and melted butter. Cook in microwave on High for 4 minutes. Stir once. Add soda and vanilla; stir well. Pour caramel over popcorn and mix with a long wooden spoon. Fold top of bag over place in microwave. Cook 1 1/2 minutes on High. Pour onto large sheet pan and cool. Store in airtight container if there is any left.

recipes.title: Savory Patties
directions: Combine meat, salt, onion, mustard, 1/4 cup crumbs, egg and Worcestershire sauce.
Mix very well and shape into 6 patties.
Put the 1/2 cup crumbs on a piece of waxed paper and press patties onto it so the crumbs adhere to the outside.
Heat the oil in a frypan. Brown patties on both sides.
Turn down heat.
Drain off any fat from pan.
Open soup and add 1/4 cup water.
Pour over patties. Simmer for 20 to 25 minutes.
Serve with cooked egg noodles. Sprinkle with chopped chives.
You can substitute turkey for all or part of beef.
recipes.text: Savory Patties. Combine meat, salt, onion, mustard, 1/4 cup crumbs, egg and Worcestershire sauce. Mix very well and shape into 6 patties. Put the 1/2 cup crumbs on a piece of waxed paper and press patties onto it so the crumbs adhere to the outside. Heat the oil in a frypan. Brown patties on both sides. Turn down heat. Drain off any fat from pan. Open soup and add 1/4 cup water. Pour over patties. Simmer for 20 to 25 minutes. Serve with cooked egg noodles. Sprinkle with chopped chives. You can substitute turkey for all or part of beef.

recipes.title: The Ultimate Pumpkin Pie
directions: Preheat oven to 425°.
In large bowl, combine all ingredients except pastry shell; mix well.
Pour into pastry shell.
Bake 15 minutes.
Reduce oven temperature to 350°; continue baking 35 to 40 minutes or until knife inserted 1-inch from edge comes out clean.
recipes.text: The Ultimate Pumpkin Pie. Preheat oven to 425°. In large bowl, combine all ingredients except pastry shell; mix well. Pour into pastry shell. Bake 15 minutes. Reduce oven temperature to 350°; continue baking 35 to 40 minutes or until knife inserted 1-inch from edge comes out clean.

recipes.title: Broccoli And Cauliflower
directions: Cut veggies and mix together with cheese and bacon.
Blend 2 cups mayonnaise (must be mayonnaise), 1/2 cup sugar, 4 tablespoons vinegar.
Mix well and pour over vegetables.
recipes.text: Broccoli And Cauliflower. Cut veggies and mix together with cheese and bacon. Blend 2 cups mayonnaise (must be mayonnaise), 1/2 cup sugar, 4 tablespoons vinegar. Mix well and pour over vegetables.

recipes.title: Watergate Salad
directions: Mix all ingredients together well and chill.
recipes.text: Watergate Salad. Mix all ingredients together well and chill.

recipes.title: Marinated Mushrooms
directions: Wash and drain mushrooms.
Mix together all ingredients.
Add mushrooms and let sit overnight.
(Minimum time 8 hours).
Shake or stir once in awhile.
recipes.text: Marinated Mushrooms. Wash and drain mushrooms. Mix together all ingredients. Add mushrooms and let sit overnight. (Minimum time 8 hours). Shake or stir once in awhile.

recipes.title: Favorite Meat Marinade
directions: Score meaty side of ribs.
Place meat in plastic bag. Refrigerate 2 hours.
recipes.text: Favorite Meat Marinade. Score meaty side of ribs. Place meat in plastic bag. Refrigerate 2 hours.

recipes.title: Sour Cream Cornbread
directions: Mix all ingredients together and bake at 400° for 25 minutes. Makes 18 small muffins.
recipes.text: Sour Cream Cornbread. Mix all ingredients together and bake at 400° for 25 minutes. Makes 18 small muffins.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Pie
directions: Combine pumpkin, corn syrup, eggs and evaporated milk.
Stir butter into hot milk.
Combine brown sugar, salt and spices.
Mix until well blended.
Combine all 3 mixtures.
Pour into pie shell.
recipes.text: Pumpkin Pie. Combine pumpkin, corn syrup, eggs and evaporated milk. Stir butter into hot milk. Combine brown sugar, salt and spices. Mix until well blended. Combine all 3 mixtures. Pour into pie shell.

recipes.title: Sugar-Free Squash Pickles
directions: Cover vegetables with crushed ice; let stand for 3 hours.
Mix well and drain.
Bring vinegar and spices to boil.
Add vegetables; bring to boil.
Pack in hot sterilized jars and seal.
recipes.text: Sugar-Free Squash Pickles. Cover vegetables with crushed ice; let stand for 3 hours. Mix well and drain. Bring vinegar and spices to boil. Add vegetables; bring to boil. Pack in hot sterilized jars and seal.

recipes.title: Doughnuts And Holes
directions: Sift dry ingredients together. Lightly beat eggs, sugar, milk and butter together and combine.
recipes.text: Doughnuts And Holes. Sift dry ingredients together. Lightly beat eggs, sugar, milk and butter together and combine.

recipes.title: No Cook Marshmallow Frosting
directions: Beat egg whites and salt with electric beater until soft peaks form.
Add sugar, about 1 teaspoon at a time, beating until smooth and glossy.
Continue beating and add Karo syrup, a little at a time, beating after each addition, until frosting peaks.
Fold in vanilla.
Makes enough to frost two 9-inch layers.
recipes.text: No Cook Marshmallow Frosting. Beat egg whites and salt with electric beater until soft peaks form. Add sugar, about 1 teaspoon at a time, beating until smooth and glossy. Continue beating and add Karo syrup, a little at a time, beating after each addition, until frosting peaks. Fold in vanilla. Makes enough to frost two 9-inch layers.

recipes.title: Pawley'S Island Crab Cakes
ingredients: 2 lb. lump crab meat, picked over
directions: In a large bowl, combine well the mayonnaise, cracker crumbs, cayenne, celery seed, mustard, lemon juice and egg whites and stir in the crab meat gently.
Form the mixture into 12 half-inch thick cakes and coat the cakes with most of the bread crumbs.
Sprinkle a large plate with the remaining bread crumbs; transfer the crab cakes to the plate and chill them, covered loosely, for at least 1 hour and up to 4 hours.

In a large heavy skillet, heat the butter over moderately high heat until it is hot but not smoking and in it, saute the crab cakes, turning them once, for 4 minutes per side or until they are golden.
As the crab cakes are cooked, use a slotted spoon to transfer them to drain on paper towels, then arrange them on a heated platter.
Garnish the cakes with lemon wedges and serve them with tartar sauce.
recipes.text: Pawley'S Island Crab Cakes. In a large bowl, combine well the mayonnaise, cracker crumbs, cayenne, celery seed, mustard, lemon juice and egg whites and stir in the crab meat gently. Form the mixture into 12 half-inch thick cakes and coat the cakes with most of the bread crumbs. Sprinkle a large plate with the remaining bread crumbs; transfer the crab cakes to the plate and chill them, covered loosely, for at least 1 hour and up to 4 hours. In a large heavy skillet, heat the butter over moderately high heat until it is hot but not smoking and in it, saute the crab cakes, turning them once, for 4 minutes per side or until they are golden. As the crab cakes are cooked, use a slotted spoon to transfer them to drain on paper towels, then arrange them on a heated platter. Garnish the cakes with lemon wedges and serve them with tartar sauce.

recipes.title: Mock Shepherd'S Pie
directions: Brown onion in skillet in small amount of hot fat.
Add beef, salt and pepper.
Cook until browned.
Drain beans; add to beef mixture with soup.
Pour into 2-quart casserole.
recipes.text: Mock Shepherd'S Pie. Brown onion in skillet in small amount of hot fat. Add beef, salt and pepper. Cook until browned. Drain beans; add to beef mixture with soup. Pour into 2-quart casserole.

recipes.title: White Cake
directions: Sift flour, baking powder and salt 3 times.
Cream the shortening and sugar until very light. Add flour mixture alternating with milk and beat until smooth and light.
Add vanilla and egg whites beaten very stiff; fold in well.
Bake at 375° for 25 minutes. Makes 3 layers.
recipes.text: White Cake. Sift flour, baking powder and salt 3 times. Cream the shortening and sugar until very light. Add flour mixture alternating with milk and beat until smooth and light. Add vanilla and egg whites beaten very stiff; fold in well. Bake at 375° for 25 minutes. Makes 3 layers.

recipes.title: Broccoli Casserole
directions: Cook broccoli according to directions.
Saute onions in butter.
Mix all ingredients together.
Bake in buttered casserole dish uncovered at 350° for 1 hour.
To make a main dish out of this, add chicken with a small amount of broth.
recipes.text: Broccoli Casserole. Cook broccoli according to directions. Saute onions in butter. Mix all ingredients together. Bake in buttered casserole dish uncovered at 350° for 1 hour. To make a main dish out of this, add chicken with a small amount of broth.

recipes.title: Potato Pancakes
directions: Pare large potatoes and cover with cold water.
Let stand for 12 hours.
Pour off water and grate potatoes.
Drain well.
Add eggs and mix lightly.
Stir in remaining ingredients.
Drop from tablespoon onto hot well-greased skillet and brown on both sides.
recipes.text: Potato Pancakes. Pare large potatoes and cover with cold water. Let stand for 12 hours. Pour off water and grate potatoes. Drain well. Add eggs and mix lightly. Stir in remaining ingredients. Drop from tablespoon onto hot well-greased skillet and brown on both sides.

recipes.title: Cheese Crispies
directions: Preheat oven to 375°.
Combine ingredients with hands until thoroughly mixed.
Form small balls and place 1-inch apart on cookie sheet.
Bake at 375° for 12 minutes.
recipes.text: Cheese Crispies. Preheat oven to 375°. Combine ingredients with hands until thoroughly mixed. Form small balls and place 1-inch apart on cookie sheet. Bake at 375° for 12 minutes.

recipes.title: Tuna Burgers
directions: Heat oven to 350°.
Mix all ingredients, except buns.
Fill buns with tuna mixture.
Place each sandwich on square of aluminum foil; fold foil over sandwich and seal securely.
Place on baking sheet.
Bake 20 minutes or until heated through.
recipes.text: Tuna Burgers. Heat oven to 350°. Mix all ingredients, except buns. Fill buns with tuna mixture. Place each sandwich on square of aluminum foil; fold foil over sandwich and seal securely. Place on baking sheet. Bake 20 minutes or until heated through.

recipes.title: Pickled Green Tomatoes
directions: Put tomatoes in jar.
Make a brine of 1/2 cup vinegar, plus 2 tablespoons salt for each cup of water.
Boil the brine for approximately 2 minutes.
Pour over tomatoes and seal jars.
Use in 1 month.
recipes.text: Pickled Green Tomatoes. Put tomatoes in jar. Make a brine of 1/2 cup vinegar, plus 2 tablespoons salt for each cup of water. Boil the brine for approximately 2 minutes. Pour over tomatoes and seal jars. Use in 1 month.

recipes.title: Hamburg Barbecue
directions: Brown hamburger with onion, salt and pepper.
Drain.
Add remaining ingredients; cook and simmer for 20 minutes.
recipes.text: Hamburg Barbecue. Brown hamburger with onion, salt and pepper. Drain. Add remaining ingredients; cook and simmer for 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Country Swiss Steaks
directions: Slice the meat
into steaks 1-inch thick, 3-inches wide and 5-inches long.
Place
the
cooking
oil
in
a frypan and heat. Roll the steaks
in the flour.
Remove and place in the frypan. Cook,
turning
occasionally
until
done
and brown. Remove from frypan
and
place
in a roasting pan.
Cover with onions, tomatoes and tomato juice.
Cover and bake in preheated 325° oven for 2
to
hours
or until the steaks are tender.
Mix 2 tablespoons
of
flour
with a small amount of water.
Make a smooth mixture and add to the steaks, stirring gently.
Cook for another
to 10 minutes and the steaks are ready to serve. Serves 6 to 10 people.
recipes.text: Country Swiss Steaks. Slice the meat into steaks 1-inch thick, 3-inches wide and 5-inches long. Place the cooking oil in a frypan and heat. Roll the steaks in the flour. Remove and place in the frypan. Cook, turning occasionally until done and brown. Remove from frypan and place in a roasting pan. Cover with onions, tomatoes and tomato juice. Cover and bake in preheated 325° oven for 2 to 2 1/2 hours or until the steaks are tender. Mix 2 tablespoons of flour with a small amount of water. Make a smooth mixture and add to the steaks, stirring gently. Cook for another 5 to 10 minutes and the steaks are ready to serve. Serves 6 to 10 people.

recipes.title: Spinach And Lettuce Salad
directions: Mix oil, vinegar and sugar and pour over the spinach and lettuce, bacon and onion.
Mix well.
recipes.text: Spinach And Lettuce Salad. Mix oil, vinegar and sugar and pour over the spinach and lettuce, bacon and onion. Mix well.

recipes.title: Tea Cakes
ingredients: 3 Tbsp. Pet milk, diluted with 2/3 c. water
directions: Stir flour and baking powder 3 times.
Cream butter and sugar. Add flour and baking powder alternately with diluted milk.
Add vanilla and stir until smooth.
Add eggs.
Bake in muffin pan or in shallow pan at 375° for 20 to 25 minutes.
Cut into squares or fancy shapes.
Makes 20 tea cakes.
recipes.text: Tea Cakes. Stir flour and baking powder 3 times. Cream butter and sugar. Add flour and baking powder alternately with diluted milk. Add vanilla and stir until smooth. Add eggs. Bake in muffin pan or in shallow pan at 375° for 20 to 25 minutes. Cut into squares or fancy shapes. Makes 20 tea cakes.

recipes.title: Food For The Angels
directions: Line pan with 1/2 crushed wafers.
Cream powdered sugar and butter; add beaten eggs and beat.
Repeat.
Beat in vanilla and pour mixture over wafers.
Whip cream; add sugar and pour over first mixture.
Pour pineapple over that and sprinkle rest of wafers over top.
Let stand in cool place 12 hours.
recipes.text: Food For The Angels. Line pan with 1/2 crushed wafers. Cream powdered sugar and butter; add beaten eggs and beat. Repeat. Beat in vanilla and pour mixture over wafers. Whip cream; add sugar and pour over first mixture. Pour pineapple over that and sprinkle rest of wafers over top. Let stand in cool place 12 hours.

recipes.title: Light Dessert
directions: Melt marshmallows in heated milk and put in refrigerator until thickens.
Add whipped cream and nuts to marshmallows and milk. Mix, stirring well.
Add whiskey.
Mix and cover with chocolate decorations.
Freeze, if desired.
recipes.text: Light Dessert. Melt marshmallows in heated milk and put in refrigerator until thickens. Add whipped cream and nuts to marshmallows and milk. Mix, stirring well. Add whiskey. Mix and cover with chocolate decorations. Freeze, if desired.

recipes.title: Peach Cobbler
directions: Melt butter in baking dish in 350° oven.
Mix first 5 ingredients and pour melted butter.
Do not stir.
Pour peaches over mixture and bake at 350° for about one hour.
recipes.text: Peach Cobbler. Melt butter in baking dish in 350° oven. Mix first 5 ingredients and pour melted butter. Do not stir. Pour peaches over mixture and bake at 350° for about one hour.

recipes.title: Ice Cream Cake
directions: Crush Oreos with a food processor or with a rolling pin, putting cookies in a bag.
Melt butter.
Mix into cookie crumbs. Press into a 9 x 12-inch pan, sprayed with a non-stick vegetable spray.
recipes.text: Ice Cream Cake. Crush Oreos with a food processor or with a rolling pin, putting cookies in a bag. Melt butter. Mix into cookie crumbs. Press into a 9 x 12-inch pan, sprayed with a non-stick vegetable spray.

recipes.title: Spiced Beef Roast
ingredients: 1 to 2 Tbsp. to 2 1/2 lb. boneless beef round rump roast
directions: Crush fennel seed, mustard seed and whole black peppercorns. Set aside.
Trim fat from roast.
Place roast on rack in a shallow roasting pan.
recipes.text: Spiced Beef Roast. Crush fennel seed, mustard seed and whole black peppercorns. Set aside. Trim fat from roast. Place roast on rack in a shallow roasting pan.

recipes.title: Peanut Clusters
directions: Melt chocolate and butterscotch bits on low heat, stirring occasionally until smooth. Add peanuts. Drop by teaspoonful onto wax paper.
recipes.text: Peanut Clusters. Melt chocolate and butterscotch bits on low heat, stirring occasionally until smooth. Add peanuts. Drop by teaspoonful onto wax paper.

recipes.title: Apricot Pork Chops
directions: Brown chops; remove.
Combine ingredients.
Put on top of chops.
Simmer covered in pan for 20 minutes.
recipes.text: Apricot Pork Chops. Brown chops; remove. Combine ingredients. Put on top of chops. Simmer covered in pan for 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Texas Potatoes
ingredients: 1 large bag hash brown potatoes, thawed
directions: Mix thoroughly all ingredients except last two.
Place in 9 x 13-inch baking dish.
Top with corn flakes and butter.
Bake uncovered at 350° for 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Texas Potatoes. Mix thoroughly all ingredients except last two. Place in 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Top with corn flakes and butter. Bake uncovered at 350° for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Hot Dish
directions: Brown beef and onions.
Combine other ingredients, except biscuits. Mix in browned, drained meat and onions.
Top with biscuits.
Bake at 375° for 20 minutes.
recipes.text: Hot Dish. Brown beef and onions. Combine other ingredients, except biscuits. Mix in browned, drained meat and onions. Top with biscuits. Bake at 375° for 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Pound Cake
directions: Cream butter and sugar until
light
and fluffy.
Beat 1 egg at a time in mixture adding flour and sour cream alternately starting with flour and
ending with flour.
Add vanilla and almond extract.
Pour into greased
and floured tube pan.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Pound Cake. Cream butter and sugar until light and fluffy. Beat 1 egg at a time in mixture adding flour and sour cream alternately starting with flour and ending with flour. Add vanilla and almond extract. Pour into greased and floured tube pan. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Mclachlin Chicken
directions: Wash and dry chicken.
Mix salt into crushed cereal.
Dip each piece of chicken into butter.
Toss chicken in cereal mixture. Place chicken pieces on cookie sheet.
Drizzle remaining butter and cereal mixture over top.
Bake, uncovered, at 325° (legs 1 1/2 hours, drumsticks 1 hour).
recipes.text: Mclachlin Chicken. Wash and dry chicken. Mix salt into crushed cereal. Dip each piece of chicken into butter. Toss chicken in cereal mixture. Place chicken pieces on cookie sheet. Drizzle remaining butter and cereal mixture over top. Bake, uncovered, at 325° (legs 1 1/2 hours, drumsticks 1 hour).

recipes.title: Sour Cream Chicken
directions: Skin chicken and place in baking dish.
Mix soup, sherry and sour cream.
Cover chicken with sliced mushrooms.
Cover chicken and mushrooms with sour cream mixture.
Sprinkle with paprika. Bake at 350° for approximately 1 hour.
recipes.text: Sour Cream Chicken. Skin chicken and place in baking dish. Mix soup, sherry and sour cream. Cover chicken with sliced mushrooms. Cover chicken and mushrooms with sour cream mixture. Sprinkle with paprika. Bake at 350° for approximately 1 hour.

recipes.title: Sweet And Sour Stir-Fried Beef
ingredients: 1 medium green pepper, cut in 1-inch pieces
directions: Trim excess fat from beef; cut beef with grain into 2-inch strips.
Cut strips across grain into 1/8-inch slices.
Mix cornstarch and 1 tablespoon water.
Heat oil in 12-inch skillet or wok over medium-high heat until hot.
Add beef and onion; cook and stir until beef is brown, about 3 minutes.
Stir in pineapple, 1/2 cup water, the sugar, vinegar, instant bouillon and soy sauce. Heat to boiling.
Stir in cornstarch mixture.
Cook and stir 1 minute. Stir in green pepper and tomatoes; cook and stir 1 minute. Serve with hot, cooked rice.
Makes 5 servings.
recipes.text: Sweet And Sour Stir-Fried Beef. Trim excess fat from beef; cut beef with grain into 2-inch strips. Cut strips across grain into 1/8-inch slices. Mix cornstarch and 1 tablespoon water. Heat oil in 12-inch skillet or wok over medium-high heat until hot. Add beef and onion; cook and stir until beef is brown, about 3 minutes. Stir in pineapple, 1/2 cup water, the sugar, vinegar, instant bouillon and soy sauce. Heat to boiling. Stir in cornstarch mixture. Cook and stir 1 minute. Stir in green pepper and tomatoes; cook and stir 1 minute. Serve with hot, cooked rice. Makes 5 servings.

recipes.title: Sudden Sauce
directions: Stir together onion, Worcestershire sauce, catsup, brown sugar and water. Simmer 1/2 hour or spread over roast pork or beef for the last hour of baking at 350°. Pour simmered sauce over any meat, when ready to be served.
recipes.text: Sudden Sauce. Stir together onion, Worcestershire sauce, catsup, brown sugar and water. Simmer 1/2 hour or spread over roast pork or beef for the last hour of baking at 350°. Pour simmered sauce over any meat, when ready to be served.

recipes.title: Sweet Potato Pie
directions: Cook and drain sweet potatoes and mix rest of ingredients. Pour into 4 pie crusts.
Bake at 350° until crust is brown.
Makes 4 pies.
recipes.text: Sweet Potato Pie. Cook and drain sweet potatoes and mix rest of ingredients. Pour into 4 pie crusts. Bake at 350° until crust is brown. Makes 4 pies.

recipes.title: Punch
directions: Prepare the Kool-Aid as directed on package, adding 1 extra cup of sugar.
Mix all ingredients.
Place in freezer until it is slushy. Serve.
recipes.text: Punch. Prepare the Kool-Aid as directed on package, adding 1 extra cup of sugar. Mix all ingredients. Place in freezer until it is slushy. Serve.

recipes.title: Apricot-Cheese Salad
ingredients: 1 can apricots, drained and diced (save juice)
directions: Drain and chill fruit. Dissolve jello in boiling water.
Add fruit juices. Chill until slightly thickened. Fold in fruit and chill until firm.
recipes.text: Apricot-Cheese Salad. Drain and chill fruit. Dissolve jello in boiling water. Add fruit juices. Chill until slightly thickened. Fold in fruit and chill until firm.

recipes.title: Toti Fields Fruit Salad
directions: Drain all fruit well.
Mix milk, pudding, sour cream and orange juice very well.
Add drained fruit (except bananas).
Make a day ahead.
Add bananas the day you serve salad.
recipes.text: Toti Fields Fruit Salad. Drain all fruit well. Mix milk, pudding, sour cream and orange juice very well. Add drained fruit (except bananas). Make a day ahead. Add bananas the day you serve salad.

recipes.title: Diet Strawberry Pie
directions: Mix the cornstarch in a little cold water. Add to boiling water and jello. Boil for 2 minutes. Let cool. Add Equal and pour in strawberries. Pour this mixture in crust and chill. Top with Cool Whip.
recipes.text: Diet Strawberry Pie. Mix the cornstarch in a little cold water. Add to boiling water and jello. Boil for 2 minutes. Let cool. Add Equal and pour in strawberries. Pour this mixture in crust and chill. Top with Cool Whip.

recipes.title: Oreo And Ice Cream Dessert
directions: Melt margarine and add to cookies.
Spread ice cream over cookies.
Put fudge over ice cream.
Add whipped cream on top of that.
Decorate with nuts or crushed cookies.
Place in freezer for 2 hours.
recipes.text: Oreo And Ice Cream Dessert. Melt margarine and add to cookies. Spread ice cream over cookies. Put fudge over ice cream. Add whipped cream on top of that. Decorate with nuts or crushed cookies. Place in freezer for 2 hours.

recipes.title: Chicken Enchiladas
ingredients: 1 can (10 3/4 oz.) Campbell's condensed cream of celery soup
1 c. shredded Monterey Jack cheese (4 oz.)
directions: Preheat oven to 375°.
In a small bowl, stir together soup and sour cream until smooth; set aside.
In a 2-quart saucepan over medium heat, in hot margarine, cook onion and chili powder until onion is tender.
Stir in chicken, chilies and 2 tablespoon of soup mixture.
Remove from heat.
recipes.text: Chicken Enchiladas. Preheat oven to 375°. In a small bowl, stir together soup and sour cream until smooth; set aside. In a 2-quart saucepan over medium heat, in hot margarine, cook onion and chili powder until onion is tender. Stir in chicken, chilies and 2 tablespoon of soup mixture. Remove from heat.

recipes.title: Seafood Quiche
directions: Note:
May use egg substitute and whole or skim milk.
May use low-fat cheese.
recipes.text: Seafood Quiche. Note: May use egg substitute and whole or skim milk. May use low-fat cheese.

recipes.title: Microwave Cherry Crunch
directions: Mix pie filling and pineapple in square glass microwave cake pan.
Sprinkle cake mix evenly over top.
Sprinkle with pecans. Microwave on High for 15 minutes, stirring at least once.
recipes.text: Microwave Cherry Crunch. Mix pie filling and pineapple in square glass microwave cake pan. Sprinkle cake mix evenly over top. Sprinkle with pecans. Microwave on High for 15 minutes, stirring at least once.

recipes.title: French Bread
directions: Dissolve dry yeast in 1/2 cup water.
In a large bowl combine dissolved yeast, rest of water, shortening, sugar and salt.
Add flour a little at a time. When all flour has been added, knead well.
Let rise. Turn onto floured board and knead again. Divide in half. Form two long loaves.
You can use a French bread pan or cookie sheet. Bake at 350° for 50 to 60 minutes.
recipes.text: French Bread. Dissolve dry yeast in 1/2 cup water. In a large bowl combine dissolved yeast, rest of water, shortening, sugar and salt. Add flour a little at a time. When all flour has been added, knead well. Let rise. Turn onto floured board and knead again. Divide in half. Form two long loaves. You can use a French bread pan or cookie sheet. Bake at 350° for 50 to 60 minutes.

recipes.title: Chocolate Chess Pie
directions: Mix sugar, cocoa and margarine.
Stir well.
Add eggs and beat with electric mixer for 2 1/2 minutes.
Add salt, milk and vanilla.
Stir in pecans.
Pour into pie shell.
Bake in preheated oven at 350° for 35 to 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Chocolate Chess Pie. Mix sugar, cocoa and margarine. Stir well. Add eggs and beat with electric mixer for 2 1/2 minutes. Add salt, milk and vanilla. Stir in pecans. Pour into pie shell. Bake in preheated oven at 350° for 35 to 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Zucchini-Apple Bread
ingredients: 2 c. shredded zucchini (about 3 medium or 1 large)
directions: Combine first 6 dry ingredients; set aside.
Combine eggs, sugars, oil and vanilla in large bowl.
Beat at medium speed until well blended.
Stir in zucchini, apple and nuts.
Add dry ingredients, stirring just to moisten.
Spoon batter into 3 greased and floured 8 1/4 x 4 1/2 x 3-inch loaf pans.
Bake at 350° for 50 to 55 minutes or until wooden pick comes out clean.
Cool in pans for 10 minutes.
Remove to wire rack and cool completely.
recipes.text: Zucchini-Apple Bread. Combine first 6 dry ingredients; set aside. Combine eggs, sugars, oil and vanilla in large bowl. Beat at medium speed until well blended.
