Stir in zucchini, apple and nuts. Add dry ingredients, stirring just to moisten. Spoon batter into 3 greased and floured 8 1/4 x 4 1/2 x 3-inch loaf pans. Bake at 350° for 50 to 55 minutes or until wooden pick comes out clean. Cool in pans for 10 minutes. Remove to wire rack and cool completely.

recipes.title: Best Pecan Pie
ingredients: 1 c. firmly packed dark brown sugar
directions: Heat oven to 350°.
Prepare the pie crust.
In large bowl combine corn syrup, sugar, eggs, butter, salt and vanilla.
Mix well.
Pour filling into unbaked pie crust.
Sprinkle with pecan halves.
Bake 45 to 50 minutes or until center is set.
(Can also add 1/2 to 1 cup crushed pecans to mixture.)
recipes.text: Best Pecan Pie. Heat oven to 350°. Prepare the pie crust. In large bowl combine corn syrup, sugar, eggs, butter, salt and vanilla. Mix well. Pour filling into unbaked pie crust. Sprinkle with pecan halves. Bake 45 to 50 minutes or until center is set. (Can also add 1/2 to 1 cup crushed pecans to mixture.)

recipes.title: Cracker Jacks
directions: In large kettle, melt butter, sugar and syrup.
Boil for 1 minute.
Remove from heat; add 1/2 teaspoon soda and package of peanuts.
Place corn in large baking pan, pour and stir syrup over corn until coated on all pieces.
Bake at 225° for 1 hour.
Stir every 15 minutes.
Cool and put in Ziploc bags.
recipes.text: Cracker Jacks. In large kettle, melt butter, sugar and syrup. Boil for 1 minute. Remove from heat; add 1/2 teaspoon soda and package of peanuts. Place corn in large baking pan, pour and stir syrup over corn until coated on all pieces. Bake at 225° for 1 hour. Stir every 15 minutes. Cool and put in Ziploc bags.

recipes.title: Oatmeal Pecan Raisin Chocolate Chip Cookies
directions: Sift
together flour, baking powder, soda and salt; set aside. In
large
bowl
using
mixer
at
medium
speed, beat margarine, brown
sugar,
granulated
sugar and vanilla until light.
Add eggs; blend well.
Reduce speed to low.
Add oats and dry ingredients, beat just until blended.
Stir in pecans, raisins and
chocolate
pieces.
With damp hands, shape dough into
1 1/2-inch
balls;
place
on
wax paper covered baking sheet. Using
back of teaspoon dipped in water, flatten balls to 3/4-inch thickness.
Put in freezer 15 minutes or refrigerate 6
hours
or overnight.
Remove from wax paper and place 3 inches apart
on greased baking sheets.
Bake at 375° 14 to 16 minutes.
Remove from baking sheets and cool on racks.
Makes about 40 cookies.
recipes.text: Oatmeal Pecan Raisin Chocolate Chip Cookies. Sift together flour, baking powder, soda and salt; set aside. In large bowl using mixer at medium speed, beat margarine, brown sugar, granulated sugar and vanilla until light. Add eggs; blend well. Reduce speed to low. Add oats and dry ingredients, beat just until blended. Stir in pecans, raisins and chocolate pieces. With damp hands, shape dough into 1 1/2-inch balls; place on wax paper covered baking sheet. Using back of teaspoon dipped in water, flatten balls to 3/4-inch thickness. Put in freezer 15 minutes or refrigerate 6 hours or overnight. Remove from wax paper and place 3 inches apart on greased baking sheets. Bake at 375° 14 to 16 minutes. Remove from baking sheets and cool on racks. Makes about 40 cookies.

recipes.title: Speedy Doughnuts
ingredients: powdered sugar, cinnamon sugar or chocolate icing
directions: Separate biscuit dough.
Cut hole in center of each biscuit. Fry biscuits and holes, a few at a time, in 1/2 to 1 inch of hot shortening or oil (375°), or use deep-fryer.
Cook until golden brown, about 1 1/2 minutes on each side.
Drain on paper towels. Sprinkle with sugar or cinnamon sugar, or ice with homemade or prepared chocolate icing.
Serve while warm.
recipes.text: Speedy Doughnuts. Separate biscuit dough. Cut hole in center of each biscuit. Fry biscuits and holes, a few at a time, in 1/2 to 1 inch of hot shortening or oil (375°), or use deep-fryer. Cook until golden brown, about 1 1/2 minutes on each side. Drain on paper towels. Sprinkle with sugar or cinnamon sugar, or ice with homemade or prepared chocolate icing. Serve while warm.

recipes.title: Russian Banana Nut Bread(Wonderfully Moist And Easy!)
directions: Cream the shortening and sugar. Add eggs and cream well.
Sift flour and soda together. Fold flour and bananas into above mixture. Add nuts.
Bake in greased and floured loaf pan for 1 hour at 350°.
recipes.text: Russian Banana Nut Bread(Wonderfully Moist And Easy!). Cream the shortening and sugar. Add eggs and cream well. Sift flour and soda together. Fold flour and bananas into above mixture. Add nuts. Bake in greased and floured loaf pan for 1 hour at 350°.

recipes.title: Earthquake Cake
directions: Mix cake as directed on box.
Grease and flour 9 x 13-inch pan. Cover bottom of pan with coconut and nuts.
Pour cake mixture on top.
Mix margarine, cream cheese, powdered sugar, and vanilla until smooth and creamy.
Spoon in globs on top of cake mix.
Bake at 325° about 40 minutes.
recipes.text: Earthquake Cake. Mix cake as directed on box. Grease and flour 9 x 13-inch pan. Cover bottom of pan with coconut and nuts. Pour cake mixture on top. Mix margarine, cream cheese, powdered sugar, and vanilla until smooth and creamy. Spoon in globs on top of cake mix. Bake at 325° about 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Fruit Cocktail Cake
ingredients: 1 #2 can fruit cocktail, drained and reserved
directions: Mix white sugar, flour and soda. Add juice from fruit cocktail and eggs. Beat until fluffy. Fold in fruit cocktail, and pour into a greased 9X13 pan. Sprinkle brown sugar over top of batter.
recipes.text: Fruit Cocktail Cake. Mix white sugar, flour and soda. Add juice from fruit cocktail and eggs. Beat until fluffy. Fold in fruit cocktail, and pour into a greased 9X13 pan. Sprinkle brown sugar over top of batter.

recipes.title: Marinated Carrots(Copper Pennies)
directions: Cook carrots until tender; drain.
Mix remaining ingredients; let set 12 hours.
Will keep 3 to 4 weeks.
Keep refrigerated.
recipes.text: Marinated Carrots(Copper Pennies). Cook carrots until tender; drain. Mix remaining ingredients; let set 12 hours. Will keep 3 to 4 weeks. Keep refrigerated.

recipes.title: Mexican Dip
directions: Heat on low. Crock-pot has to be on low.
recipes.text: Mexican Dip. Heat on low. Crock-pot has to be on low.

recipes.title: Pepper Jelly
ingredients: 8 to 9 bell peppers, omit part of bell pepper and add hot pepper to taste
directions: Mix peppers, vinegar and Sure-Jell.
Bring to hard boil.
Add sugar and bring to a rolling boil for 1 minute.
Pour into hot sterilized 1/2-pint jars and seal.
recipes.text: Pepper Jelly. Mix peppers, vinegar and Sure-Jell. Bring to hard boil. Add sugar and bring to a rolling boil for 1 minute. Pour into hot sterilized 1/2-pint jars and seal.

recipes.title: Crunchy Crust French Toast
directions: Blend together 1 egg, milk, sugar and cinnamon.
Mix coconut and corn flakes together and put in a pie plate.
Dip 4 slices of bread in egg mixture, then coat with cereal and coconut.
Heat margarine in skillet over medium heat.
Brown toast slices until golden brown on both sides.
Serve hot with maple syrup or honey.
recipes.text: Crunchy Crust French Toast. Blend together 1 egg, milk, sugar and cinnamon. Mix coconut and corn flakes together and put in a pie plate. Dip 4 slices of bread in egg mixture, then coat with cereal and coconut. Heat margarine in skillet over medium heat. Brown toast slices until golden brown on both sides. Serve hot with maple syrup or honey.

recipes.title: Coconut Cake
directions: Sift flour once, then measure.
Add baking powder and salt. Sift three times.
Cream butter thoroughly and add sugar gradually.
Continue creaming until light and fluffy.
Add egg yolks and beat well.
Add flour mixture alternately with milk, beating after each addition.
Stir in vanilla and coconut.
Fold in egg whites carefully.
Bake in greased eight-inch pans at 350° for about 30 minutes or until done.
recipes.text: Coconut Cake. Sift flour once, then measure. Add baking powder and salt. Sift three times. Cream butter thoroughly and add sugar gradually. Continue creaming until light and fluffy. Add egg yolks and beat well. Add flour mixture alternately with milk, beating after each addition. Stir in vanilla and coconut. Fold in egg whites carefully. Bake in greased eight-inch pans at 350° for about 30 minutes or until done.

recipes.title: Tomato Cheese Fondue
directions: In 3-quart saucepan over medium heat in hot butter, cook tomatoes, onion and garlic for 10 minutes or until mixture is slightly thickened, stirring often.
Stir in soup and mustard. Gradually add cheese, stirring until smooth after each addition. Pour cheese mixture into fondue pot and keep warm.
Serve with apple wedges.
Makes about 3 1/2 cups.
recipes.text: Tomato Cheese Fondue. In 3-quart saucepan over medium heat in hot butter, cook tomatoes, onion and garlic for 10 minutes or until mixture is slightly thickened, stirring often. Stir in soup and mustard. Gradually add cheese, stirring until smooth after each addition. Pour cheese mixture into fondue pot and keep warm. Serve with apple wedges. Makes about 3 1/2 cups.

recipes.title: Cheese Balls
directions: Mix well and shape into 2 balls.
Roll in 1 1/2 to 2 cups chopped pecans.
Can be frozen.
recipes.text: Cheese Balls. Mix well and shape into 2 balls. Roll in 1 1/2 to 2 cups chopped pecans. Can be frozen.

recipes.title: Gingerbread Boys
directions: Cream sugar, salt and shortening.
Stir in egg, molasses and vinegar.
Beat well.
Sift together dry ingredients; stir into molasses mix.
Chill about 3 hours.
On lightly floured board, roll to 1/8-inch.
Cut out cookies.
Place 1 inch apart on greased cookie sheet.
Use raisins for eyes and buttons.
Bake about 6 minutes at 375°.
Cool slightly and frost if desired.
recipes.text: Gingerbread Boys. Cream sugar, salt and shortening. Stir in egg, molasses and vinegar. Beat well. Sift together dry ingredients; stir into molasses mix. Chill about 3 hours. On lightly floured board, roll to 1/8-inch. Cut out cookies. Place 1 inch apart on greased cookie sheet. Use raisins for eyes and buttons. Bake about 6 minutes at 375°. Cool slightly and frost if desired.

recipes.title: Hot Mulled Cranberry Drink
directions: Combine all ingredients in saucepan; heat to boiling point. Pour into mugs.
Serve with cinnamon sticks.
recipes.text: Hot Mulled Cranberry Drink. Combine all ingredients in saucepan; heat to boiling point. Pour into mugs. Serve with cinnamon sticks.

recipes.title: Linguine With Garlic And Lemon
ingredients: 2 1/2 c. cooked linguine, cooked without fat or salt
directions: Melt margarine in small saucepan; add garlic and next 3 ingredients, including mushrooms.
Add sauce to linguine and toss gently.
Serve immediately.
recipes.text: Linguine With Garlic And Lemon. Melt margarine in small saucepan; add garlic and next 3 ingredients, including mushrooms. Add sauce to linguine and toss gently. Serve immediately.

recipes.title: Crisp Chicken Casserole
ingredients: 4 chicken breasts, cooked, deboned and chopped
2 (10 3/4 oz.) cans cream of chicken soup
directions: Combine chicken, mayonnaise, celery and onions into mixing bowl. Add 1 cup corn flake crumbs, soup and water chestnuts. Place in 2-quart casserole. Melt oleo. Add remaining 1 cup crumbs. Mix well and use as topping for casserole. Bake at 325° for 45 minutes.
recipes.text: Crisp Chicken Casserole. Combine chicken, mayonnaise, celery and onions into mixing bowl. Add 1 cup corn flake crumbs, soup and water chestnuts. Place in 2-quart casserole. Melt oleo. Add remaining 1 cup crumbs. Mix well and use as topping for casserole. Bake at 325° for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Potato Dough Baked Goods
directions: For doughnuts, cinnamon rolls, sticky buns, dinner rolls and coffee cake.
Dissolve yeast in water.
Mix milk, potatoes, butter and sugar in large bowl.
Let cool, then add yeast mixture and 6 cups flour.
Let stand until mixture foams up (about 20 minutes). Add eggs, salt and additional 11 to 12 cups flour.
Dough should be soft.
Turn out on floured board and knead until satiny.
Let rise in warm place until doubled in bulk.
Form as desired. Serves 100.
recipes.text: Potato Dough Baked Goods. For doughnuts, cinnamon rolls, sticky buns, dinner rolls and coffee cake. Dissolve yeast in water. Mix milk, potatoes, butter and sugar in large bowl. Let cool, then add yeast mixture and 6 cups flour. Let stand until mixture foams up (about 20 minutes). Add eggs, salt and additional 11 to 12 cups flour. Dough should be soft. Turn out on floured board and knead until satiny. Let rise in warm place until doubled in bulk. Form as desired. Serves 100.

recipes.title: Strawberry Pie
directions: Bring to boil and boil 5 to 8 minutes the sugar, cornstarch, salt and water.
Add red food coloring.
Cool and pour over fresh strawberries.
Put in baked pie shell.
Makes glaze for 1 pie.
recipes.text: Strawberry Pie. Bring to boil and boil 5 to 8 minutes the sugar, cornstarch, salt and water. Add red food coloring. Cool and pour over fresh strawberries. Put in baked pie shell. Makes glaze for 1 pie.

recipes.title: Pizza Hot Dish
ingredients: 3 c. cooked noodles or 6 lasagna noodles put on bottom of pan
directions: Saute meat, green peppers, onions, spices and tomato sauce. Simmer 15 minutes.
Place noodles in 9 x 13-inch nonstick pan. Pour meat sauce over.
Top with cheese, then mushrooms.
Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese.
Cover with foil.
Bake at 350° for 35 minutes.
Let set before cutting.
Makes 6 servings.
recipes.text: Pizza Hot Dish. Saute meat, green peppers, onions, spices and tomato sauce. Simmer 15 minutes. Place noodles in 9 x 13-inch nonstick pan. Pour meat sauce over. Top with cheese, then mushrooms. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Cover with foil. Bake at 350° for 35 minutes. Let set before cutting. Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Vegetable Dish
ingredients: 1 1/4 lb. eggplant, peeled and cut in 1/4 inch thick rounds
2 boxes (10 oz. each) frozen chopped spinach, thawed and squeezed dry
1/2 c. plus 2 Tbsp. grated Parmesan cheese
1/2 (16 oz.) pkg. curly-edge lasagna noodles, cooked, drained and cooled
16 oz. Mozzarella cheese, cut crosswise into 15 slices
directions: Have a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish ready.
Coat a nonstick skillet with nonstick cooking spray.
Cook eggplant (in batches) over medium heat 4 minutes per side or until golden and tender. Mix spinach, Ricotta and cottage cheeses, 1/2 cup of the Parmesan cheese and the eggs until blended.
Heat oven to 350°.
Spread 1 cup spaghetti sauce evenly over bottom of baking dish.
Place 3 noodles lengthwise on top.
Cover with half the spinach mixture, then half the eggplant and 5 slices Mozzarella cheese.
Repeat for second layer.
Top with remaining noodles, overlapping to cover, then remaining sauce and Mozzarella.
Sprinkle with remaining 2 tablespoons Parmesan.
Bake 1 hour or until bubbling and lightly brown around edges.
Let stand 15 minutes before cutting in 12 pieces.
Serves 12.
recipes.text: Vegetable Dish. Have a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish ready. Coat a nonstick skillet with nonstick cooking spray. Cook eggplant (in batches) over medium heat 4 minutes per side or until golden and tender. Mix spinach, Ricotta and cottage cheeses, 1/2 cup of the Parmesan cheese and the eggs until blended. Heat oven to 350°. Spread 1 cup spaghetti sauce evenly over bottom of baking dish. Place 3 noodles lengthwise on top. Cover with half the spinach mixture, then half the eggplant and 5 slices Mozzarella cheese. Repeat for second layer. Top with remaining noodles, overlapping to cover, then remaining sauce and Mozzarella. Sprinkle with remaining 2 tablespoons Parmesan. Bake 1 hour or until bubbling and lightly brown around edges. Let stand 15 minutes before cutting in 12 pieces. Serves 12.

recipes.title: Chocolate Chip Cookies(Diabetic)
directions: Preheat oven to 350°.
Sift together the dry ingredients. Cream oleo.
Add NutraSweet, vanilla and egg.
Blend well.
Add dry ingredients and beat well. Stir in chips.
Drop by teaspoonfuls onto lightly greased cookie sheet.
Bake 8 to 10 minutes.
recipes.text: Chocolate Chip Cookies(Diabetic). Preheat oven to 350°. Sift together the dry ingredients. Cream oleo. Add NutraSweet, vanilla and egg. Blend well. Add dry ingredients and beat well. Stir in chips. Drop by teaspoonfuls onto lightly greased cookie sheet. Bake 8 to 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Bread
ingredients: 1/2 tsp. each: cloves, cinnamon and allspice
directions: Mix dry ingredients together in bowl.
Make a well in the center and put in remaining ingredients.
Mix until well-blended. Bake in greased loaf pan at 325° for 1 1/2 hours.
recipes.text: Pumpkin Bread. Mix dry ingredients together in bowl. Make a well in the center and put in remaining ingredients. Mix until well-blended. Bake in greased loaf pan at 325° for 1 1/2 hours.

recipes.title: White Pizza Dip
ingredients: 1 envelope liptons savory garlic herb soup mix
directions: Mix first three ingredients & half of the Mozzarella cheese into shallow pan (pie pan).
Sprinkle the other half of the mozzarella cheese on top.
Bake at 350 for 30 minutes uncovered. Use chunks of bread to dip into mixture.
recipes.text: White Pizza Dip. Mix first three ingredients & half of the Mozzarella cheese into shallow pan (pie pan). Sprinkle the other half of the mozzarella cheese on top. Bake at 350 for 30 minutes uncovered. Use chunks of bread to dip into mixture.

recipes.title: No Sugar Cookies
directions: Beat the first 5 ingredients well.
Mix all together.
Drop on a cookie sheet in a 350° oven for 12 minutes or until done.
recipes.text: No Sugar Cookies. Beat the first 5 ingredients well. Mix all together. Drop on a cookie sheet in a 350° oven for 12 minutes or until done.

recipes.title: Onion Soup
directions: Saute onions in margarine until lightly browned.
Add broth, Worcestershire sauce, salt and pepper.
Simmer 20 minutes. Sprinkle toast with Parmesan cheese, place under broiler a few seconds until cheese is browned.
Cut each slice into 3 pieces. Pour soup in bowls and float toast slices on top.
recipes.text: Onion Soup. Saute onions in margarine until lightly browned. Add broth, Worcestershire sauce, salt and pepper. Simmer 20 minutes. Sprinkle toast with Parmesan cheese, place under broiler a few seconds until cheese is browned. Cut each slice into 3 pieces. Pour soup in bowls and float toast slices on top.

recipes.title: Apple Cream Pie
ingredients: 4 c. thinly sliced peeled tart apples
1 (3.4 oz.) pkg. instant vanilla pudding mix
1/4 c. apricot preserves or strawberry jelly, melted
directions: In a large skillet, saute apples, sugar and lemon juice in butter until apples are tender. Cool. In a mixing bowl, beat the cream cheese until smooth. Gradually beat in 1 cup milk, dry pudding mix and lemon peel. Add remaining milk; beat until thickened. Spread into pastry shell. Arrange apples over filling. Brush with preserves. Refrigerate for 1 hour before serving. Brush with additional preserves if desired. Yield: 6 to 8 servings.
recipes.text: Apple Cream Pie. In a large skillet, saute apples, sugar and lemon juice in butter until apples are tender. Cool. In a mixing bowl, beat the cream cheese until smooth. Gradually beat in 1 cup milk, dry pudding mix and lemon peel. Add remaining milk; beat until thickened. Spread into pastry shell. Arrange apples over filling. Brush with preserves. Refrigerate for 1 hour before serving. Brush with additional preserves if desired. Yield: 6 to 8 servings.

recipes.title: Taco Dip
directions: Mix sour cream, cream cheese and taco seasoning mix with mixer.
Refrigerate after spreading mixture over pizza pan or tray.
Before serving, cover with shredded lettuce, cheese and diced tomatoes.
Serve with plain tortilla chips.
Scoop dip from tray with chips.
recipes.text: Taco Dip. Mix sour cream, cream cheese and taco seasoning mix with mixer. Refrigerate after spreading mixture over pizza pan or tray. Before serving, cover with shredded lettuce, cheese and diced tomatoes. Serve with plain tortilla chips. Scoop dip from tray with chips.

recipes.title: Easy Double Decker Fudge(Microwave)
ingredients: 1 (14 oz.) can sweetened condensed milk (not evaporated milk)
directions: In a glass measure cup, combine peanut butter chips and 2/3 cup sweetened condensed milk.
Cook on High 1 to 1 1/2 minutes. Stir until chips are melted and mixture is smooth.
Stir in 1/2 teaspoon vanilla extract.
Spread evenly into a foil-lined 8-inch square pan.
recipes.text: Easy Double Decker Fudge(Microwave). In a glass measure cup, combine peanut butter chips and 2/3 cup sweetened condensed milk. Cook on High 1 to 1 1/2 minutes. Stir until chips are melted and mixture is smooth. Stir in 1/2 teaspoon vanilla extract. Spread evenly into a foil-lined 8-inch square pan.

recipes.title: Chicken And Dumplings
directions: Boil hen until tender; debone when cool.
Mix flour, salt, pepper and baking powder.
Add chicken fat, milk and beaten egg. Form dough; roll out and cut into strips.
Drop into boiling broth. Cook dumplings until tender.
Add chicken and sliced, boiled eggs. Serves 6.
recipes.text: Chicken And Dumplings. Boil hen until tender; debone when cool. Mix flour, salt, pepper and baking powder. Add chicken fat, milk and beaten egg. Form dough; roll out and cut into strips. Drop into boiling broth. Cook dumplings until tender. Add chicken and sliced, boiled eggs. Serves 6.

recipes.title: Spring Breeze Cheesecake
directions: Beat cheese until smooth; gradually beat in sugar.
Blend in sour cream and vanilla.
Fold in Cool Whip.
Garnish with strawberries and cherry pie filling.
recipes.text: Spring Breeze Cheesecake. Beat cheese until smooth; gradually beat in sugar. Blend in sour cream and vanilla. Fold in Cool Whip. Garnish with strawberries and cherry pie filling.

recipes.title: Pina Colada Cake
directions: Bake cake according to instructions on box.
While cake is still warm, pierce with fork.
Mix Eagle Brand milk and liquid coconut well, then drizzle over warm cake.
Thaw 2 packages of frozen coconut.
Add this to one carton of Cool Whip and frost cake.
Seal and ripen overnight in refrigerator.
recipes.text: Pina Colada Cake. Bake cake according to instructions on box. While cake is still warm, pierce with fork. Mix Eagle Brand milk and liquid coconut well, then drizzle over warm cake. Thaw 2 packages of frozen coconut. Add this to one carton of Cool Whip and frost cake. Seal and ripen overnight in refrigerator.

recipes.title: Mexican Rice
directions: Heat oil in heavy saucepan over medium heat.
Stir in rice and cook about 1 minute.
Stir in onion and garlic and saute about 3 minutes, stirring frequently, until onion is translucent.
Stir in remaining ingredients.
Increase heat to high and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low.
Cover and simmer 20 minutes or until liquid is absorbed and rice is tender.
Let stand 5 minutes.
Fluff rice and serve.
recipes.text: Mexican Rice. Heat oil in heavy saucepan over medium heat. Stir in rice and cook about 1 minute. Stir in onion and garlic and saute about 3 minutes, stirring frequently, until onion is translucent. Stir in remaining ingredients. Increase heat to high and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low. Cover and simmer 20 minutes or until liquid is absorbed and rice is tender. Let stand 5 minutes. Fluff rice and serve.

recipes.title: Lydia Mummert'S Sugar Cookies
ingredients: 1 c. buttermilk (1 Tbsp. vinegar to 1 c. milk)
directions: Sift flour, baking soda and baking powder; set aside.
Cream shortening and add sugar.
Add eggs, one at a time.
Stir in buttermilk and add flour mixture, 1 cup at a time.
Mix well. Drop by spoonful onto ungreased cookie sheet and bake until golden brown.
These will be soft.
recipes.text: Lydia Mummert'S Sugar Cookies. Sift flour, baking soda and baking powder; set aside. Cream shortening and add sugar. Add eggs, one at a time. Stir in buttermilk and add flour mixture, 1 cup at a time. Mix well. Drop by spoonful onto ungreased cookie sheet and bake until golden brown. These will be soft.

recipes.title: Teenage Special
directions: Brown ground beef with onion; drain.
Mix cream of mushroom soup with 1/2 can milk; pour over meat mixture.
Simmer.
Serve on toasted bread.
Great with pickles and chips.
recipes.text: Teenage Special. Brown ground beef with onion; drain. Mix cream of mushroom soup with 1/2 can milk; pour over meat mixture. Simmer. Serve on toasted bread. Great with pickles and chips.

recipes.title: Banana Raisin Bran Muffins
directions: In a large bowl, combine dry ingredients.
In food processor with chopping blade, combine the prunes and water.
Add 1/2 cup mashed banana, yogurt, egg whites and vanilla.
Process just until mixed.
Stir yogurt mixture into flour mixture just until flour is moistened.
Fold in raisins.
Use large spoon; divide batter into cups. If desired, cut 1/2 banana into 1/4-inch thick slices. Place 2 slices on top of each muffin and brush with lemon juice. Bake at 375° for 25 to 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Banana Raisin Bran Muffins. In a large bowl, combine dry ingredients. In food processor with chopping blade, combine the prunes and water. Add 1/2 cup mashed banana, yogurt, egg whites and vanilla. Process just until mixed. Stir yogurt mixture into flour mixture just until flour is moistened. Fold in raisins. Use large spoon; divide batter into cups. If desired, cut 1/2 banana into 1/4-inch thick slices. Place 2 slices on top of each muffin and brush with lemon juice. Bake at 375° for 25 to 30 minutes.

recipes.title: "Ghivetch"" Vegetables
ingredients: 1/2 small head cauliflower, cut into florets (about 3 c.)
1 medium size yellow squash, sliced (about 1 1/2 c.)
2 medium size carrots, peeled and sliced (about 1 c.)
2 medium ripe tomatoes, cut into 8 wedges
1 c. green bell pepper, thin strips
1 c. low-sodium beef or chicken broth
2 Tbsp. fresh dill or 1 Tbsp. dried dill weed
directions: Heat oven to 350°.
In 3-quart casserole, combine cauliflower, squash, carrots, celery, onions, bell pepper, beans, potato and peas; set aside.
In small saucepan, over medium-high heat, bring broth, oil, garlic and bay leaf to a boil.
Remove from heat; pour over vegetables.
Cover tightly.
Bake 35 to 40 minutes, until potatoes are almost tender, stirring once or twice.
Add tomatoes, parsley and dill.
Cook, covered, 5 to 10 minutes longer.
Makes 4 servings.
recipes.text: "Ghivetch"" Vegetables. Heat oven to 350°. In 3-quart casserole, combine cauliflower, squash, carrots, celery, onions, bell pepper, beans, potato and peas; set aside. In small saucepan, over medium-high heat, bring broth, oil, garlic and bay leaf to a boil. Remove from heat; pour over vegetables. Cover tightly. Bake 35 to 40 minutes, until potatoes are almost tender, stirring once or twice. Add tomatoes, parsley and dill. Cook, covered, 5 to 10 minutes longer. Makes 4 servings.

recipes.title: Tuna Cheese Twist
ingredients: 1 (10 3/4 oz.) can cream of mushroom soup
2 c. Bisquick or Jiffy baking mix
directions: Mix baking mix and 1/2 cup water until soft dough forms.
Beat vigorously 20 strokes.
Gently smooth into ball on floured cloth. Knead 5 times.
Roll into 14 x 11-inch rectangle.
Place on lightly greased cookie sheet.
recipes.text: Tuna Cheese Twist. Mix baking mix and 1/2 cup water until soft dough forms. Beat vigorously 20 strokes. Gently smooth into ball on floured cloth. Knead 5 times. Roll into 14 x 11-inch rectangle. Place on lightly greased cookie sheet.

recipes.title: Graham Cracker Fruit Cake
directions: Soak fruits overnight in the Port wine and vanilla.
In the morning, cream the butter and eggs and sugar; mix well.
Add the rest of the ingredients and mix very well.
Be sure to put a pan of boiling water on the floor of the oven to keep the cakes from drying out during the long baking time.
Line the pans with wax paper, greasing pan and paper and fill 3/4 full with the batter. Bake in 250° oven for 2 hours.
Let set in pans for ten minutes. Turn cakes out on racks and cool leaving the paper on.
recipes.text: Graham Cracker Fruit Cake. Soak fruits overnight in the Port wine and vanilla. In the morning, cream the butter and eggs and sugar; mix well. Add the rest of the ingredients and mix very well. Be sure to put a pan of boiling water on the floor of the oven to keep the cakes from drying out during the long baking time. Line the pans with wax paper, greasing pan and paper and fill 3/4 full with the batter. Bake in 250° oven for 2 hours. Let set in pans for ten minutes. Turn cakes out on racks and cool leaving the paper on.

recipes.title: Cheese Ball
ingredients: 2 (2.5 oz.) pkg. smoked dried beef or chipped beef, chopped fine (this is found with lunch meats)
directions: Soften cream cheese, add other ingredients.
Chill at least 1 hour.
Roll in chopped pecans.
Serve with assorted crackers.
recipes.text: Cheese Ball. Soften cream cheese, add other ingredients. Chill at least 1 hour. Roll in chopped pecans. Serve with assorted crackers.

recipes.title: Gazpacho
directions: Put all the ingredients in a blender, except the bread crumbs and liquify.
Strain mixture and reserve the liquid.
Add enough bread crumbs to slightly thicken the liquid.
Chill and serve garnished with cucumber cubes and ice.
Can also be served unstrained and without the bread cubes.
recipes.text: Gazpacho. Put all the ingredients in a blender, except the bread crumbs and liquify. Strain mixture and reserve the liquid. Add enough bread crumbs to slightly thicken the liquid. Chill and serve garnished with cucumber cubes and ice. Can also be served unstrained and without the bread cubes.

recipes.title: Cream Cheese Delight
directions: Mix together melted margarine and crushed graham crackers. Spread on bottom of pan, 9 x 13-inch.
With electric mixer, beat cream cheese, powdered sugar and milk until smooth.
Pour over cracker crust.
Spread 1 container of Cool Whip over cream mixture.
Next, spread 1 can of fruit pie filling over whipped cream.
Sprinkle with pecans, if desired.
Chill at least 1 hour before serving.
recipes.text: Cream Cheese Delight. Mix together melted margarine and crushed graham crackers. Spread on bottom of pan, 9 x 13-inch. With electric mixer, beat cream cheese, powdered sugar and milk until smooth. Pour over cracker crust. Spread 1 container of Cool Whip over cream mixture. Next, spread 1 can of fruit pie filling over whipped cream. Sprinkle with pecans, if desired. Chill at least 1 hour before serving.

recipes.title: Fruit Pizza
directions: Cut into sliced and lay on 12-inch pizza pan covered with aluminum foil.
Bake at 350° until golden brown.
recipes.text: Fruit Pizza. Cut into sliced and lay on 12-inch pizza pan covered with aluminum foil. Bake at 350° until golden brown.

recipes.title: Lime Punch
ingredients: 2 pkg. lime Kool-Aid, mixed as directed
directions: Add ice milk or sherbet to taste.
Serves 25.
recipes.text: Lime Punch. Add ice milk or sherbet to taste. Serves 25.

recipes.title: Mad Hatter Meat Balls
directions: Melt butter in skillet.
Add onion and green pepper.
Stir in chicken and rice soup, tomato soup and water.
Heat on low.
recipes.text: Mad Hatter Meat Balls. Melt butter in skillet. Add onion and green pepper. Stir in chicken and rice soup, tomato soup and water. Heat on low.

recipes.title: Tasty Spread
directions: Cook bacon until crisp.
Cool.
In a blender, put the tomato, mustard, cream cheese and celery salt.
Cover and process until smooth.
Add the almonds and crumbled bacon and process 10 seconds.
Serve with Ritz or saltine crackers.
Makes about 1 cup of spread.
recipes.text: Tasty Spread. Cook bacon until crisp. Cool. In a blender, put the tomato, mustard, cream cheese and celery salt. Cover and process until smooth. Add the almonds and crumbled bacon and process 10 seconds. Serve with Ritz or saltine crackers. Makes about 1 cup of spread.

recipes.title: Tortellini Soup
ingredients: 1/2 lb. mild or hot Italian sausage links, in casings
4 c. beef stock or canned beef broth
1 (16 oz.) can whole tomatoes, drained and chopped
directions: Cook sausage in medium skillet over medium heat 7 minutes or until evenly browned, turning occasionally.
Add water.
Reduce heat to low.
Cover and simmer 20 minutes.
Drain.
Allow sausage to stand at room temperature until cool enough to handle.
Heat oil in 5-quart Dutch oven over medium heat.
Cook and stir onion and garlic in oil 4 minutes or until onion is soft.
recipes.text: Tortellini Soup. Cook sausage in medium skillet over medium heat 7 minutes or until evenly browned, turning occasionally. Add water. Reduce heat to low. Cover and simmer 20 minutes. Drain. Allow sausage to stand at room temperature until cool enough to handle. Heat oil in 5-quart Dutch oven over medium heat. Cook and stir onion and garlic in oil 4 minutes or until onion is soft.

recipes.title: Vegetable Dill Dip
directions: Mix mayonnaise and sour cream together.
Add remaining ingredients.
Mix and let refrigerate 24 hours.
Serve with fresh vegetables.
recipes.text: Vegetable Dill Dip. Mix mayonnaise and sour cream together. Add remaining ingredients. Mix and let refrigerate 24 hours. Serve with fresh vegetables.

recipes.title: Southern Kraut Salad
directions: Mix kraut, celery, bell pepper, onion and pimento.
Mix well. Set aside.
Combine sugar, oil and vinegar, heat until sugar is dissolved.
Cool.
Mix this mixture with the veggie mixture.
Let stand overnight.
recipes.text: Southern Kraut Salad. Mix kraut, celery, bell pepper, onion and pimento. Mix well. Set aside. Combine sugar, oil and vinegar, heat until sugar is dissolved. Cool. Mix this mixture with the veggie mixture. Let stand overnight.

recipes.title: Overnight Salad
ingredients: 1 lb. bacon, fried, drained and crumbled
directions: Layer half of lettuce in a large bowl, then sliced boiled eggs, frozen peas (slightly thawed), salt, pepper, sugar, crumbled bacon, half onion (chopped), bacon, shredded cheese and top with mayonnaise.
Sprinkle with cheese.
recipes.text: Overnight Salad. Layer half of lettuce in a large bowl, then sliced boiled eggs, frozen peas (slightly thawed), salt, pepper, sugar, crumbled bacon, half onion (chopped), bacon, shredded cheese and top with mayonnaise. Sprinkle with cheese.

recipes.title: Chicken Casserole No. 2
directions: Microwave chicken (cover with Saran Wrap) for 10 minutes or more, depending on microwave.
Layer bottom with 1 package of crackers (crumbled).
Add cut-up chicken.
Mix together soups and sour cream.
Pour over chicken.
Top with crumbled crackers and butter.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Chicken Casserole No. 2. Microwave chicken (cover with Saran Wrap) for 10 minutes or more, depending on microwave. Layer bottom with 1 package of crackers (crumbled). Add cut-up chicken. Mix together soups and sour cream. Pour over chicken. Top with crumbled crackers and butter. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: New England Chicken And Wild Rice(Delicious)
ingredients: 1 (10 1/2 oz.) can cream of mushroom soup
2 (6 oz.) pkg. long grain and wild rice with seasonings
directions: Place chicken, water, salt, onion and celery in pot and bring to boil.
Simmer 1 hour.
Strain broth.
Refrigerate broth and chicken.
Remove chicken from bones and cut into bite-size pieces. Saute mushrooms in butter until light golden brown.
Use broth for cooking rice, following package directions for firm rice. Combine chicken, rice and mushrooms in 4-quart casserole.
Blend sour cream and undiluted soup.
Toss together with chicken mixture.
Bake at 350° for about 1 hour.
Serves 8 to 10.
recipes.text: New England Chicken And Wild Rice(Delicious). Place chicken, water, salt, onion and celery in pot and bring to boil. Simmer 1 hour. Strain broth. Refrigerate broth and chicken. Remove chicken from bones and cut into bite-size pieces. Saute mushrooms in butter until light golden brown. Use broth for cooking rice, following package directions for firm rice. Combine chicken, rice and mushrooms in 4-quart casserole. Blend sour cream and undiluted soup. Toss together with chicken mixture. Bake at 350° for about 1 hour. Serves 8 to 10.

recipes.title: Ice Cream
directions: Beat eggs until they form peaks. Add sugar gradually to the egg mixture. Continue to beat until mixture is very stiff. Add remaining ingredients and mix thoroughly.
Pour into gallon freezer and freeze as directed by ice cream maker.
recipes.text: Ice Cream. Beat eggs until they form peaks. Add sugar gradually to the egg mixture. Continue to beat until mixture is very stiff. Add remaining ingredients and mix thoroughly. Pour into gallon freezer and freeze as directed by ice cream maker.

recipes.title: Black-Eyed Pea Supper Dish
ingredients: 1/2 lb. sausage (I use Jimmy Dean hot!)
1/2 c. each: green pepper and onion
1/4 tsp. each: black pepper and oregano
1/2 to 1 c. grated cheese (I use sharp Cheddar)
directions: Cook sausage, breaking into pieces.
Drain fat.
Add green pepper, onion and garlic.
Cook for 5 to 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add tomatoes and seasonings.
Stir well.
Add black-eyed peas (drain first).
Cover and simmer slowly for 15 to 20 minutes or until desired consistency is reached.
Pour in casserole dish and top with grated cheese.
Warm in oven for 15 minutes at 350°.
This is great to make ahead, because it lets the flavors blend.
recipes.text: Black-Eyed Pea Supper Dish. Cook sausage, breaking into pieces. Drain fat. Add green pepper, onion and garlic. Cook for 5 to 10 minutes, stirring occasionally. Add tomatoes and seasonings. Stir well. Add black-eyed peas (drain first). Cover and simmer slowly for 15 to 20 minutes or until desired consistency is reached. Pour in casserole dish and top with grated cheese. Warm in oven for 15 minutes at 350°. This is great to make ahead, because it lets the flavors blend.

recipes.title: Pepper Steak
directions: Cut meat into strips.
In large skillet, brown meat.
Stir in soup mix and 2 cups water.
Cover; simmer 30 minutes.
Stir in pepper strips; cook.
Simmer until meat and pepper are tender. Blend cornstarch with 1/2 cup of water.
Stir in skillet until thick.
Serve over rice.
recipes.text: Pepper Steak. Cut meat into strips. In large skillet, brown meat. Stir in soup mix and 2 cups water. Cover; simmer 30 minutes. Stir in pepper strips; cook. Simmer until meat and pepper are tender. Blend cornstarch with 1/2 cup of water. Stir in skillet until thick. Serve over rice.

recipes.title: Tomato Juice Cocktail
ingredients: 1 c. chopped celery, pureed in blender
1/2 c. chopped onion, pureed in blender
directions: Combine tomato juice, celery, and onion.
Stir often.
Heat gently for 30 minutes.
Add lemon juice, sugar, salt, horseradish, Worcestershire sauce and hot pepper sauce.
Simmer 10 minutes. This can be served hot or chilled.
Makes 5 pints.
recipes.text: Tomato Juice Cocktail. Combine tomato juice, celery, and onion. Stir often. Heat gently for 30 minutes. Add lemon juice, sugar, salt, horseradish, Worcestershire sauce and hot pepper sauce. Simmer 10 minutes. This can be served hot or chilled. Makes 5 pints.

recipes.title: Peanutty Chocolate Chip Bars
ingredients: 2/3 c. light or dark Karo syrup
directions: In large bowl, mix with mixer peanut butter, sugar, corn syrup, butter, eggs and vanilla until smooth.
Reduce speed; beat in flour, baking powder and salt until blended.
Stir in 1 1/2 cups chocolate pieces.
Spread evenly in ungreased 15 x 10 x 1-inch pan.
recipes.text: Peanutty Chocolate Chip Bars. In large bowl, mix with mixer peanut butter, sugar, corn syrup, butter, eggs and vanilla until smooth. Reduce speed; beat in flour, baking powder and salt until blended. Stir in 1 1/2 cups chocolate pieces. Spread evenly in ungreased 15 x 10 x 1-inch pan.

recipes.title: Emerald Isle Mousse
ingredients: 1 (8 1/4 oz.) can crushed pineapple in syrup
1 c. heavy cream, whipped or Cool Whip
directions: Dissolve gelatin in boiling water.
Add pineapple with syrup and creme de menthe.
Chill until thickened, stirring often.
Fold in whipped cream.
Spoon into 1-quart mold.
Chill until firm.
recipes.text: Emerald Isle Mousse. Dissolve gelatin in boiling water. Add pineapple with syrup and creme de menthe. Chill until thickened, stirring often. Fold in whipped cream. Spoon into 1-quart mold. Chill until firm.

recipes.title: Wonderful Window Wash
directions: Fill jug about 3/4 full with water; add the 3 ingredients. Finish filling jug with water; shake.
Pour into spray bottle as needed.
Store with household chemicals.
Keep out of reach of children.
recipes.text: Wonderful Window Wash. Fill jug about 3/4 full with water; add the 3 ingredients. Finish filling jug with water; shake. Pour into spray bottle as needed. Store with household chemicals. Keep out of reach of children.

recipes.title: Turnip Casserole
directions: Pare turnips and chop onion. Boil in small amount of water until tender, then mash. Add 2 cans soup, sour cream and carrot. Add about 2 cups stuffing mix (seasoned). Pour into casserole dish; dot with oleo and sprinkle some stuffing on top. Bake in 350° oven about 35 to 40 minutes.
recipes.text: Turnip Casserole. Pare turnips and chop onion. Boil in small amount of water until tender, then mash. Add 2 cans soup, sour cream and carrot. Add about 2 cups stuffing mix (seasoned). Pour into casserole dish; dot with oleo and sprinkle some stuffing on top. Bake in 350° oven about 35 to 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Almond Chicken Salad
directions: Mix all of the above together. Make sure and tear the chicken into small bite size pieces. Add salt and pepper to taste. "Delicious".
recipes.text: Almond Chicken Salad. Mix all of the above together. Make sure and tear the chicken into small bite size pieces. Add salt and pepper to taste. "Delicious".

recipes.title: Papier-Mache Paste
directions: In a heavy saucepan, stir flour into cold water.
Ask a grownup to cook over low heat until the mixture thickens to a creamy paste. Cool, then add a few drops of peppermint oil.
recipes.text: Papier-Mache Paste. In a heavy saucepan, stir flour into cold water. Ask a grownup to cook over low heat until the mixture thickens to a creamy paste. Cool, then add a few drops of peppermint oil.

recipes.title: Cauliflower Salad
directions: Add all ingredients together except sugar, then pour sugar over ingredients.
Cover with aluminum foil.
Do not toss until ready to serve.
recipes.text: Cauliflower Salad. Add all ingredients together except sugar, then pour sugar over ingredients. Cover with aluminum foil. Do not toss until ready to serve.

recipes.title: Gooey Cake
ingredients: 1 box powdered sugar (save some for topping after baked)
directions: Mix cake mix, butter or margarine and 1 egg and press in bottom of sheet cake pan.
Mix cream cheese, 2 eggs and sugar and put on top of cake mix.
Bake 40 minutes at 350°.
recipes.text: Gooey Cake. Mix cake mix, butter or margarine and 1 egg and press in bottom of sheet cake pan. Mix cream cheese, 2 eggs and sugar and put on top of cake mix. Bake 40 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Vegetable Medley
ingredients: 1 large red onion or a bunch of green onions
directions: Cut vegetables in bite-size pieces. Place all vegetables, except avocados, in a large mixing or storage bowl. Cover vegetables with Italian dressing and refrigerate for at least 4 to 8 hours (can make in the morning to serve at dinner).
Stir vegetables to mix dressing. Place in serving bowl and add bite-sized pieces of avocado and serve.
recipes.text: Vegetable Medley. Cut vegetables in bite-size pieces. Place all vegetables, except avocados, in a large mixing or storage bowl. Cover vegetables with Italian dressing and refrigerate for at least 4 to 8 hours (can make in the morning to serve at dinner). Stir vegetables to mix dressing. Place in serving bowl and add bite-sized pieces of avocado and serve.

recipes.title: Tamale Dip
directions: Heat chili and cheeses.
Add chopped tamales.
Pour into dish.
Add shredded cheese, ripe olives and green onions to top.
recipes.text: Tamale Dip. Heat chili and cheeses. Add chopped tamales. Pour into dish. Add shredded cheese, ripe olives and green onions to top.

recipes.title: Stir-Fry Chicken
ingredients: 1 lb. boneless chicken breast, sliced thin
directions: Pour oil in wok and preheat on high for 3 minutes.
Place meat in hot oil.
Stir-fry.
Turn meat occasionally.
Add celery.
Cook 2 minutes.
Add onion.
Cook 2 minutes.
(When pan gets dry, add vegetable broth as needed.)
Add mushrooms and green peppers.
Cook 2 minutes.
Add remaining vegetable broth and soy sauce.
Serve over cooked rice.
recipes.text: Stir-Fry Chicken. Pour oil in wok and preheat on high for 3 minutes. Place meat in hot oil. Stir-fry. Turn meat occasionally. Add celery. Cook 2 minutes. Add onion. Cook 2 minutes. (When pan gets dry, add vegetable broth as needed.) Add mushrooms and green peppers. Cook 2 minutes. Add remaining vegetable broth and soy sauce. Serve over cooked rice.

recipes.title: Beef Pot Pie
ingredients: 1 can or 1 pkg. frozen mixed vegetables
directions: Brown and drain ground beef.
Drain vegetables.
Mix all ingredients with 1 can water.
Place ingredients in casserole dish (round).
Put pie crust shell on top.
Cook 25 to 30 minutes until crust is brown.
recipes.text: Beef Pot Pie. Brown and drain ground beef. Drain vegetables. Mix all ingredients with 1 can water. Place ingredients in casserole dish (round). Put pie crust shell on top. Cook 25 to 30 minutes until crust is brown.

recipes.title: Date Pudding Cake
directions: Pour boiling water with soda over dates.
Let stand awhile. Cream sugar and shortening.
Add egg; beat well, then add salt, date mixture, dry ingredients and nuts.
Bake at 350° for about 45 minutes.
Serve warm with whipped cream.
recipes.text: Date Pudding Cake. Pour boiling water with soda over dates. Let stand awhile. Cream sugar and shortening. Add egg; beat well, then add salt, date mixture, dry ingredients and nuts. Bake at 350° for about 45 minutes. Serve warm with whipped cream.

recipes.title: Cauliflower Salad
ingredients: 2 lb. bacon, crisp fried and drained
directions: Mix all ingredients.
Season to taste with pepper.
recipes.text: Cauliflower Salad. Mix all ingredients. Season to taste with pepper.

recipes.title: Baked Beans
ingredients: 4 (15 oz.) cans Great Northern white beans
3/4 lb. bacon, cooked and cut in pieces
directions: Combine all ingredients well in a casserole dish.
Bake for 1 hour at 325°.
recipes.text: Baked Beans. Combine all ingredients well in a casserole dish. Bake for 1 hour at 325°.

recipes.title: Chicken Tetrazzini
ingredients: 2 (10 1/2 oz. each) cans cream of chicken soup
2 small (4 oz. each) cans mushrooms, drained
directions: Cube chicken.
Combine soup, sour cream and butter.
Stir in chicken, mushrooms, spaghetti and salt and pepper.
Turn mixture in a greased 13 x 9-inch casserole.
Sprinkle cheese on top.
Bake at 350° until hot and bubbly, 25 to 30 minutes.
Makes 8 servings.
recipes.text: Chicken Tetrazzini. Cube chicken. Combine soup, sour cream and butter. Stir in chicken, mushrooms, spaghetti and salt and pepper. Turn mixture in a greased 13 x 9-inch casserole. Sprinkle cheese on top. Bake at 350° until hot and bubbly, 25 to 30 minutes. Makes 8 servings.

recipes.title: Imperial Chicken
directions: Dip chicken pieces into melted margarine, then into mixture of dry ingredients.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
Do not turn chicken.
recipes.text: Imperial Chicken. Dip chicken pieces into melted margarine, then into mixture of dry ingredients. Bake at 350° for 1 hour. Do not turn chicken.

recipes.title: Seafood Dip
directions: Mix well and chill.
recipes.text: Seafood Dip. Mix well and chill.

recipes.title: Caramel Corn
directions: Melt butter.
Stir in sugar, syrup and salt.
Bring to a boil, stirring constantly.
Boil without stirring for 5 minutes.
Remove from heat.
Stir in baking soda and vanilla.
Gradually pour over popcorn; mix well.
Spread into large shallow baking pans or cookie sheets.
Bake in oven at 250° for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Caramel Corn. Melt butter. Stir in sugar, syrup and salt. Bring to a boil, stirring constantly. Boil without stirring for 5 minutes. Remove from heat. Stir in baking soda and vanilla. Gradually pour over popcorn; mix well. Spread into large shallow baking pans or cookie sheets. Bake in oven at 250° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Lemon Chicken
directions: Lightly pound the chicken breasts to make them even thickness. Using a small pot with the chicken between plastic wrap works well.
recipes.text: Lemon Chicken. Lightly pound the chicken breasts to make them even thickness. Using a small pot with the chicken between plastic wrap works well.

recipes.title: Tourtiere(Pork Pie)
directions: Roll half pastry crust and fit in a 9-inch pie plate.
Brown pork and onion, skim off excess fat and mix in soda crackers, water, apple and spices.
Cook for 15 to 20 minutes.
Fill pie plate.
Cover with other half of pie crust.
Cut holes in center of pie crust.
Bake on center rack of oven for 35 to 40 minutes at 375°.
recipes.text: Tourtiere(Pork Pie). Roll half pastry crust and fit in a 9-inch pie plate. Brown pork and onion, skim off excess fat and mix in soda crackers, water, apple and spices. Cook for 15 to 20 minutes. Fill pie plate. Cover with other half of pie crust. Cut holes in center of pie crust. Bake on center rack of oven for 35 to 40 minutes at 375°.

recipes.title: Cereal - Popcorn Snack
directions: Combine in a large roaster the popcorn, peanuts and cereals. Combine and bring to a boil the margarine, Karo and sugar.
Boil for 5 minutes.
Do not stir while it boils.
Remove from heat; add vanilla and baking soda.
Stir quickly.
Drizzle mixture over popcorn, etc.
Bake at 250° for 1 hour.
Stir every 15 minutes.
recipes.text: Cereal - Popcorn Snack. Combine in a large roaster the popcorn, peanuts and cereals. Combine and bring to a boil the margarine, Karo and sugar. Boil for 5 minutes. Do not stir while it boils. Remove from heat; add vanilla and baking soda. Stir quickly. Drizzle mixture over popcorn, etc. Bake at 250° for 1 hour. Stir every 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Cold Cucumber Soup
directions: Shred cucumbers and onion in food processor.
Add buttermilk, cucumber dressing and add sour cream to thicken the mixture to desired consistency.
Add chives and parsley.
Add sugar to sweeten to individual taste.
Chill in refrigerator.
Thickens as it chills.
recipes.text: Cold Cucumber Soup. Shred cucumbers and onion in food processor. Add buttermilk, cucumber dressing and add sour cream to thicken the mixture to desired consistency. Add chives and parsley. Add sugar to sweeten to individual taste. Chill in refrigerator. Thickens as it chills.

recipes.title: Texas Pie
directions: Mix all ingredients and pour into a 9-inch unbaked pie shell. Bake for 5 minutes at 425°.
Reduce heat to 325° and bake 50 to 60 minutes until top is set.
recipes.text: Texas Pie. Mix all ingredients and pour into a 9-inch unbaked pie shell. Bake for 5 minutes at 425°. Reduce heat to 325° and bake 50 to 60 minutes until top is set.

recipes.title: Strawberry Angel Food
directions: Put cake
pieces in 9 x 13-inch pan.
Mix pudding, milk and ice cream with electric mixer and pour over cake.
Chill.
recipes.text: Strawberry Angel Food. Put cake pieces in 9 x 13-inch pan. Mix pudding, milk and ice cream with electric mixer and pour over cake. Chill.

recipes.title: Fast Spaghetti
directions: Heat and saute onion, celery and green pepper in oil.
Add chopped tomatoes and spaghetti.
Add remaining ingredients and any other spices you like.
Stir well.
Cover and cook over low flame about 30 minutes.
Add water as necessary until spaghetti is al dente.
Serve with grated cheese, Italian bread and a salad.
recipes.text: Fast Spaghetti. Heat and saute onion, celery and green pepper in oil. Add chopped tomatoes and spaghetti. Add remaining ingredients and any other spices you like. Stir well. Cover and cook over low flame about 30 minutes. Add water as necessary until spaghetti is al dente. Serve with grated cheese, Italian bread and a salad.

recipes.title: Lemon Chess Pie
directions: Combine sugar, flour and cornmeal in a large bowl.
Toss lightly with fork to mix.
Add eggs, butter, milk, lemon peel and lemon juice.
Beat with rotary beater until smooth and thoroughly blended.
Pour into pie shell.
Bake at 350° for 35 to 45 minutes until top is golden brown.
recipes.text: Lemon Chess Pie. Combine sugar, flour and cornmeal in a large bowl. Toss lightly with fork to mix. Add eggs, butter, milk, lemon peel and lemon juice. Beat with rotary beater until smooth and thoroughly blended. Pour into pie shell. Bake at 350° for 35 to 45 minutes until top is golden brown.

recipes.title: Black Forest Cake
ingredients: 1 box cake mix (dark chocolate or devil's food)
directions: Prepare cake mix as directed on box.
Bake; cool on rack, then refrigerate 1 to 2 hours.
Take sewing thread and cut each layer in half to make 4 layers.
Open pie filling and mix with almond and vanilla.
Put first layer of cake on plate.
Spread with Cool Whip; top with cherries.
Put second layer on top.
Repeat with remaining filling.
Continue this.
Put fourth layer on top.
Ice with remaining Cool Whip.
Garnish with shaved chocolate. Refrigerate until serving.
recipes.text: Black Forest Cake. Prepare cake mix as directed on box. Bake; cool on rack, then refrigerate 1 to 2 hours. Take sewing thread and cut each layer in half to make 4 layers. Open pie filling and mix with almond and vanilla. Put first layer of cake on plate. Spread with Cool Whip; top with cherries. Put second layer on top. Repeat with remaining filling. Continue this. Put fourth layer on top. Ice with remaining Cool Whip. Garnish with shaved chocolate. Refrigerate until serving.

recipes.title: Potato Salad
directions: Mix the mayonnaise, milk, lemon juice and mustard in a large mixing bowl.
Add potatoes, seasonings, onion, celery and 4 eggs. Toss lightly until well mixed.
Spoon the mixture into serving bowls and garnish with remaining eggs.
Chill in refrigerator until serving time.
Makes 12 servings.
recipes.text: Potato Salad. Mix the mayonnaise, milk, lemon juice and mustard in a large mixing bowl. Add potatoes, seasonings, onion, celery and 4 eggs. Toss lightly until well mixed. Spoon the mixture into serving bowls and garnish with remaining eggs. Chill in refrigerator until serving time. Makes 12 servings.

recipes.title: Fresh Apple Cake
directions: Mix first four ingredients and let set for 1 hour.
Add remaining ingredients, mix well.
Bake in greased and floured tube or Bundt pan 1 hour and 15 minutes at 375°.
recipes.text: Fresh Apple Cake. Mix first four ingredients and let set for 1 hour. Add remaining ingredients, mix well. Bake in greased and floured tube or Bundt pan 1 hour and 15 minutes at 375°.

recipes.title: Santa'S Whiskers
directions: Cream sugar and butter; blend in milk and vanilla.
Stir in flour, chopped cherries and pecans.
Form dough into 3-inch balls and roll in flaked coconut.
Wrap dough in wax paper and chill. Place dough on ungreased cookie sheet.
Bake at 375° for 12 minutes.
recipes.text: Santa'S Whiskers. Cream sugar and butter; blend in milk and vanilla. Stir in flour, chopped cherries and pecans. Form dough into 3-inch balls and roll in flaked coconut. Wrap dough in wax paper and chill. Place dough on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 375° for 12 minutes.

recipes.title: Date Nut Roll(Candy)
directions: Cook together sugar, dates and Pet milk until it forms a soft ball in cold water.
Cool to lukewarm.
Beat a few strokes.
Add nuts and butter.
Knead on a tabletop.
Knead well into powdered sugar.
It will be firm, but not stiff.
Roll into cylinder mold. Let stand 24 hours before slicing.
This recipe will make 2 or 3 rolls.
Slice only enough for occasion.
Place in tin; will keep several weeks.
recipes.text: Date Nut Roll(Candy). Cook together sugar, dates and Pet milk until it forms a soft ball in cold water. Cool to lukewarm. Beat a few strokes. Add nuts and butter. Knead on a tabletop. Knead well into powdered sugar. It will be firm, but not stiff. Roll into cylinder mold. Let stand 24 hours before slicing. This recipe will make 2 or 3 rolls. Slice only enough for occasion. Place in tin; will keep several weeks.

recipes.title: Grandma'S Success Cookies
directions: Cream butter, sugar and soda.
Add vinegar, flour and vanilla. By hand fold in 1 cup Rice Krispies and nuts.
Drop by teaspoon on cookie sheet.
Bake at 275° for 20 to 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Grandma'S Success Cookies. Cream butter, sugar and soda. Add vinegar, flour and vanilla. By hand fold in 1 cup Rice Krispies and nuts. Drop by teaspoon on cookie sheet. Bake at 275° for 20 to 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Rolled Sugar Cookies(Diabetic)
directions: Cream together margarine, sugar, vanilla and egg.
Add the flour, orange juice and baking powder, and mix until dough is workable but not sticky.
Roll out onto a floured surface and cut into shapes.
Place on an ungreased cookie sheet and bake at 350° until lightly browned.
recipes.text: Rolled Sugar Cookies(Diabetic). Cream together margarine, sugar, vanilla and egg. Add the flour, orange juice and baking powder, and mix until dough is workable but not sticky. Roll out onto a floured surface and cut into shapes. Place on an ungreased cookie sheet and bake at 350° until lightly browned.

recipes.title: Brisket Supreme
directions: Place brisket in Dutch oven.
Combine beer, chili sauce, brown sugar and catsup in mixing bowl.
Mix well and pour over brisket. Bake at 275° for 3 to 3 1/2 hours.
Cool meat and slice.
Reheat when ready to serve.
Can be prepared days ahead of time since meat slices much easier when chilled.
recipes.text: Brisket Supreme. Place brisket in Dutch oven. Combine beer, chili sauce, brown sugar and catsup in mixing bowl. Mix well and pour over brisket. Bake at 275° for 3 to 3 1/2 hours. Cool meat and slice. Reheat when ready to serve. Can be prepared days ahead of time since meat slices much easier when chilled.

recipes.title: Tortilla Soup
ingredients: 6 oz. ground cumin (yes, we mean it)
10 ripe tomatoes, finely diced (may use canned tomatoes)
directions: Heat oil in skillet until hot.
Add tortillas and fry until crispy.
Add tomatoes, garlic, onions, cumin and jalapenos.
Cover and cook until tender.
Add chicken stock and cook 45 minutes to 1 hour.
Can be placed in blender and pureed or eaten as is.
Serve hot.
Great on a cold night.
recipes.text: Tortilla Soup. Heat oil in skillet until hot. Add tortillas and fry until crispy. Add tomatoes, garlic, onions, cumin and jalapenos. Cover and cook until tender. Add chicken stock and cook 45 minutes to 1 hour. Can be placed in blender and pureed or eaten as is. Serve hot. Great on a cold night.

recipes.title: Coconut Cake Or Cookies
ingredients: 1 Tbsp. (25 grams) butter or margarine or 1 Tbsp. oil
1/2 to 1 tsp. almond extract or vanilla
directions: Mix all ingredients in bowl.
Add small amounts of milk to make this a sticky ball.
(Note:
When using butter, cut the butter in small pieces.
Using oil, knead first, then decide if there is a need for milk.)
Roll pastry out to about 1 cm (3/8-inch) on cookie sheet; bake for 30 minutes at 300°.
Top of cake should be golden brown.
Cut into squares while warm, or form little balls of dough and spread these out on cookie sheet.
These will form cookies about 1 to 1 1/2 inches diameter.
Top with sliced almonds, if desired, before baking.
recipes.text: Coconut Cake Or Cookies. Mix all ingredients in bowl. Add small amounts of milk to make this a sticky ball. (Note: When using butter, cut the butter in small pieces. Using oil, knead first, then decide if there is a need for milk.) Roll pastry out to about 1 cm (3/8-inch) on cookie sheet; bake for 30 minutes at 300°. Top of cake should be golden brown. Cut into squares while warm, or form little balls of dough and spread these out on cookie sheet. These will form cookies about 1 to 1 1/2 inches diameter. Top with sliced almonds, if desired, before baking.

recipes.title: Champagne Cake
ingredients: 1 box Jiffy cake mix (yellow or white)
directions: In a 9 x 12-inch pan, make Jiffy cake as directed on box.
Mix together cream cheese, pudding and milk.
Spread mixture on cooled cake and refrigerate.
Drain can of pineapple and spread on cake. Spread Cool Whip on top of everything.
Can be made the day before.
recipes.text: Champagne Cake. In a 9 x 12-inch pan, make Jiffy cake as directed on box. Mix together cream cheese, pudding and milk. Spread mixture on cooled cake and refrigerate. Drain can of pineapple and spread on cake. Spread Cool Whip on top of everything. Can be made the day before.

recipes.title: Strawberry Pie
ingredients: red food coloring (until the right color)
directions: Mix ingredients well.
Cook over low heat until mixture thickens.
Add 2 cups fresh strawberries (unsweetened).
Pour in baked or graham cracker crust.
Top with Cool Whip.
Refrigerate until chilled.
recipes.text: Strawberry Pie. Mix ingredients well. Cook over low heat until mixture thickens. Add 2 cups fresh strawberries (unsweetened). Pour in baked or graham cracker crust. Top with Cool Whip. Refrigerate until chilled.

recipes.title: Yogurt Coffee Cake
ingredients: 2 c. flour (whole wheat gives better flavor and texture)
directions: Cream butter and brown sugar.
Add egg and vanilla; beat until fluffy.
Stir together flour, baking soda and salt.
Add to creamed mixture alternately with yogurt.
Blend well.
Turn into a greased 9-inch square cake pan.
The top can be sprinkled with chopped nuts if desired.
Bake in a 350° oven for about 35 to 40 minutes or until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean.
recipes.text: Yogurt Coffee Cake. Cream butter and brown sugar. Add egg and vanilla; beat until fluffy. Stir together flour, baking soda and salt. Add to creamed mixture alternately with yogurt. Blend well. Turn into a greased 9-inch square cake pan. The top can be sprinkled with chopped nuts if desired. Bake in a 350° oven for about 35 to 40 minutes or until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean.

recipes.title: Spicy Pork Chops
directions: Brown chops.
Add other ingredients, cover and simmer 45 minutes or until tender.
recipes.text: Spicy Pork Chops. Brown chops. Add other ingredients, cover and simmer 45 minutes or until tender.

recipes.title: Nuts And Bolts
directions: Melt margarine and mix all ingredients together. Put in slow oven at 150°; stir often.
recipes.text: Nuts And Bolts. Melt margarine and mix all ingredients together. Put in slow oven at 150°; stir often.

recipes.title: Oven Cooked Chitterlings
directions: Lay chitterlings on heavy-duty foil.
On top, place onion, pepper and other seasonings.
Wrap in foil very tightly, making sure ends are tightly closed.
Put 2 inches of water in a roasting pan.
Put foil wrapped chitterlings in pan.
Cover well; bake in 350° oven for 3 hours.
Check water level in pan; if low, add 2 more inches.
Bake 2 hours more (total of 5 hours).
recipes.text: Oven Cooked Chitterlings. Lay chitterlings on heavy-duty foil. On top, place onion, pepper and other seasonings. Wrap in foil very tightly, making sure ends are tightly closed. Put 2 inches of water in a roasting pan. Put foil wrapped chitterlings in pan. Cover well; bake in 350° oven for 3 hours. Check water level in pan; if low, add 2 more inches. Bake 2 hours more (total of 5 hours).

recipes.title: Irish Scones
directions: Heat oven to 450°.
Grease cookie sheet with butter.
Combine dry ingredients.
Add water and mix.
Drop 1 spoonful of mixture onto cookie sheet.
Sprinkle with additional sugar.
Bake 10 to 12 minutes until golden brown.
Serve hot.
Makes 12 scones.
recipes.text: Irish Scones. Heat oven to 450°. Grease cookie sheet with butter. Combine dry ingredients. Add water and mix. Drop 1 spoonful of mixture onto cookie sheet. Sprinkle with additional sugar. Bake 10 to 12 minutes until golden brown. Serve hot. Makes 12 scones.

recipes.title: Crab Sandwiches
directions: Combine crab meat, shredded cheese, celery and parsley. Combine mayonnaise, lemon juice, mustard and Tabasco sauce.
Toss crab meat mixture with dressing.
Split and toast muffins and spread with butter.
Spread crab meat mixture and 1 slice of cheese on each muffin.
Broil about 4 inches from heat for 4 to 5 minutes, until cheese is melted and crab mixture is heated.
Cut in squares.
recipes.text: Crab Sandwiches. Combine crab meat, shredded cheese, celery and parsley. Combine mayonnaise, lemon juice, mustard and Tabasco sauce. Toss crab meat mixture with dressing. Split and toast muffins and spread with butter. Spread crab meat mixture and 1 slice of cheese on each muffin. Broil about 4 inches from heat for 4 to 5 minutes, until cheese is melted and crab mixture is heated. Cut in squares.

recipes.title: All-In-One-Pot-Dinner
directions: Peel and slice potatoes.
Place in casserole.
Slice onions over potatoes.
Scrape and slice carrots, then place slices over onions.
Cover with corn, then spread ground beef evenly over top. Add seasoning.
Spread undiluted soup over ground beef, then cover casserole.
Bake in preheated 250° oven for 3 hours or until done.
Yields 4 to 6 servings.
recipes.text: All-In-One-Pot-Dinner. Peel and slice potatoes. Place in casserole. Slice onions over potatoes. Scrape and slice carrots, then place slices over onions. Cover with corn, then spread ground beef evenly over top. Add seasoning. Spread undiluted soup over ground beef, then cover casserole. Bake in preheated 250° oven for 3 hours or until done. Yields 4 to 6 servings.

recipes.title: Chocolate No Bake Cookies
directions: Boil for 1 minute the sugar, cocoa, milk and oleo; remove from heat.
Add oatmeal, peanut butter and vanilla.
Stir and drop by teaspoon onto waxed paper.
recipes.text: Chocolate No Bake Cookies. Boil for 1 minute the sugar, cocoa, milk and oleo; remove from heat. Add oatmeal, peanut butter and vanilla. Stir and drop by teaspoon onto waxed paper.

recipes.title: Marinated Mushrooms
directions: Combine all ingredients, except mushrooms, in a skillet. Bring to a boil, reduce heat and simmer for ten minutes.
Stir in mushrooms and simmer for five minutes.
Let cool.
Cover and chill several hours.
Drain before serving, removing garlic and bay leaf.
recipes.text: Marinated Mushrooms. Combine all ingredients, except mushrooms, in a skillet. Bring to a boil, reduce heat and simmer for ten minutes. Stir in mushrooms and simmer for five minutes. Let cool. Cover and chill several hours. Drain before serving, removing garlic and bay leaf.

recipes.title: My Mother'S Applesauce Spice Cake
directions: Cream shortening and sugar.
Add applesauce and beaten egg. Mix and sift dry ingredients.
Add nuts and combine the 2 mixtures.
Bake in loaf pans 45 to 60 minutes at 350° to 375°.
recipes.text: My Mother'S Applesauce Spice Cake. Cream shortening and sugar. Add applesauce and beaten egg. Mix and sift dry ingredients. Add nuts and combine the 2 mixtures. Bake in loaf pans 45 to 60 minutes at 350° to 375°.

recipes.title: Quick Strawberry Bread
ingredients: 2 c. frozen strawberries, reserving 3 tsp juice
directions: Pre-heat oven to 350°.
In large bowl, combine flour, sugar, baking soda, cinnamon, nutmeg and Jello. Stir until evenly mixed and make a well in center of dry ingredients.

In food processor or blender combine eggs, strawberries, banana, and oil. Blend until smooth and creamy. Pour into dry ingredients, stir by hand until dry ingredients are moistened. Grease two 9x5 loaf pans. Put equal amounts in each pan and bake on center rack of oven 45-50 min. Let cool before slicing.
recipes.text: Quick Strawberry Bread. Pre-heat oven to 350°. In large bowl, combine flour, sugar, baking soda, cinnamon, nutmeg and Jello. Stir until evenly mixed and make a well in center of dry ingredients. In food processor or blender combine eggs, strawberries, banana, and oil. Blend until smooth and creamy. Pour into dry ingredients, stir by hand until dry ingredients are moistened. Grease two 9x5 loaf pans. Put equal amounts in each pan and bake on center rack of oven 45-50 min. Let cool before slicing.

recipes.title: Broccoli Casserole
ingredients: 2 pkg. frozen broccoli, cooked in salty water until tender and drained
directions: Mix soup and sour cream thoroughly.
In a casserole dish, put in half of broccoli and then half of soup mixture, then another layer of each.
Top with shredded Cheddar cheese and bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
recipes.text: Broccoli Casserole. Mix soup and sour cream thoroughly. In a casserole dish, put in half of broccoli and then half of soup mixture, then another layer of each. Top with shredded Cheddar cheese and bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Barbecue Meat Loaf
directions: Crumb the bread in blender.
Put 1/2 can of tomato sauce, onion, egg, salt and pepper in blender and chop.
Add to ground beef and bread crumbs.
Mix well and form into loaf.
recipes.text: Barbecue Meat Loaf. Crumb the bread in blender. Put 1/2 can of tomato sauce, onion, egg, salt and pepper in blender and chop. Add to ground beef and bread crumbs. Mix well and form into loaf.

recipes.title: Apple Fritters
directions: Sift flour, baking powder and salt.
Blend milk and eggs.
Add milk and egg mixture gradually to dry ingredients.
Stir in apple strips.
Drop by tablespoonfuls into hot fat for 3 to 5 minutes. Drain on paper towel.
Sprinkle with powdered sugar.
recipes.text: Apple Fritters. Sift flour, baking powder and salt. Blend milk and eggs. Add milk and egg mixture gradually to dry ingredients. Stir in apple strips. Drop by tablespoonfuls into hot fat for 3 to 5 minutes. Drain on paper towel. Sprinkle with powdered sugar.

recipes.title: Macaroni And Beef Skillet Dinner
directions: Cook the noodles.
Drain and set aside.
Saute the meat, onions and garlic in oil until the meat loses its pink color and the onions are tender.
Add pepper, tomato sauce, catsup and Worcestershire sauce.
Bring mixture to a boil, then simmer gently about 5 minutes.
Mix in the cooked macaroni and simmer for 5 more minutes.
recipes.text: Macaroni And Beef Skillet Dinner. Cook the noodles. Drain and set aside. Saute the meat, onions and garlic in oil until the meat loses its pink color and the onions are tender. Add pepper, tomato sauce, catsup and Worcestershire sauce. Bring mixture to a boil, then simmer gently about 5 minutes. Mix in the cooked macaroni and simmer for 5 more minutes.

recipes.title: Orange Date Bread
ingredients: 1/2 c. orange juice plus 1/2 c. water
directions: Pour orange juice, water and rind over dates.
Cream butter and sugar.
Add egg and beat well.
Add flour, baking powder, soda, salt and nuts alternately with flour.
Pour into 5 3/4 x 3 1/4-inch foil pans.
Makes 3 pans.
Bake in 350° oven.
recipes.text: Orange Date Bread. Pour orange juice, water and rind over dates. Cream butter and sugar. Add egg and beat well. Add flour, baking powder, soda, salt and nuts alternately with flour. Pour into 5 3/4 x 3 1/4-inch foil pans. Makes 3 pans. Bake in 350° oven.

recipes.title: Banana Trifle
directions: Place vanilla wafers (except 1/2 cup finely crushed) in 9 x 13-inch dish, then set aside.
Combine pudding and milk; beat 1 to 2 minutes.
Add sour cream and half of the Cool Whip; mix well. Place half pudding over wafers and smooth around.
Slice bananas over pudding, then cover with remaining pudding; smooth, then cover with remaining Cool Whip.
Smooth, then sprinkle finely crushed vanilla wafers over top.
Keep in refrigerator.
recipes.text: Banana Trifle. Place vanilla wafers (except 1/2 cup finely crushed) in 9 x 13-inch dish, then set aside. Combine pudding and milk; beat 1 to 2 minutes. Add sour cream and half of the Cool Whip; mix well. Place half pudding over wafers and smooth around. Slice bananas over pudding, then cover with remaining pudding; smooth, then cover with remaining Cool Whip. Smooth, then sprinkle finely crushed vanilla wafers over top. Keep in refrigerator.

recipes.title: Million Dollar Pie
directions: Mix all ingredients together.
Put in crust.
Chill for 1 hour.
Makes 2.
recipes.text: Million Dollar Pie. Mix all ingredients together. Put in crust. Chill for 1 hour. Makes 2.

recipes.title: Spinach Salad
directions: Fry bacon and reserve grease.
Combine last 5 ingredients in grease.
Stir until all combined.
Pour over shredded spinach, crumbled bacon and mushrooms.
recipes.text: Spinach Salad. Fry bacon and reserve grease. Combine last 5 ingredients in grease. Stir until all combined. Pour over shredded spinach, crumbled bacon and mushrooms.

recipes.title: People Puppy Chow
directions: Melt margarine and chocolate chips.
Add peanut butter and let cool.
Add Crispix cereal.
Stir until all cereal is coated.
Put confectioners sugar in trash bag.
Add cereal mixture and shake well.
recipes.text: People Puppy Chow. Melt margarine and chocolate chips. Add peanut butter and let cool. Add Crispix cereal. Stir until all cereal is coated. Put confectioners sugar in trash bag. Add cereal mixture and shake well.

recipes.title: Kringla
directions: Cream together sugar, egg and butter.
Add buttermilk and mix. Add rest of ingredients.
Refrigerate dough overnight.
Using a spoonful of dough, roll into a pencil thin strip.
Form into figure 8 and place on greased cookie sheet.
Bake at 400° for 5 to 7 minutes.
Remove only 1/4 of dough from fridge at a time.
recipes.text: Kringla. Cream together sugar, egg and butter. Add buttermilk and mix. Add rest of ingredients. Refrigerate dough overnight. Using a spoonful of dough, roll into a pencil thin strip. Form into figure 8 and place on greased cookie sheet. Bake at 400° for 5 to 7 minutes. Remove only 1/4 of dough from fridge at a time.

recipes.title: Frozen Lemon Pie
ingredients: 1/2 c. vanilla wafers, crushed (enough to line 9-inch pie dish)
juice and grated peel of 2 lemons
1/3 c. butter or margarine, melted and cooled
3/4 c. firmly packed light brown sugar
1 (5 oz.) can Macadamia nuts, coarsely chopped or 1 c. shelled cashews or walnuts
directions: Prepare pie crust following label directions; roll out.
Cut into 16 (4 1/2-inch) rounds.
Fit into 3 1/2-inch tart pans.
Beat butter and sugar in large bowl with electric mixer until creamy. Beat in corn syrup and honey, then eggs and vanilla.
Stir in nuts.
Place about 1/4 cup filling in each tart shell.
Place on cookie sheet.
Bake in a hot oven (400°) for 15 minutes or until golden brown.
Cool before serving.
Decorate with whipped cream, if you wish.
Makes 16 tarts.
recipes.text: Frozen Lemon Pie. Prepare pie crust following label directions; roll out. Cut into 16 (4 1/2-inch) rounds. Fit into 3 1/2-inch tart pans. Beat butter and sugar in large bowl with electric mixer until creamy. Beat in corn syrup and honey, then eggs and vanilla. Stir in nuts. Place about 1/4 cup filling in each tart shell. Place on cookie sheet. Bake in a hot oven (400°) for 15 minutes or until golden brown. Cool before serving. Decorate with whipped cream, if you wish. Makes 16 tarts.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Spice Muffins
directions: Preheat oven to 350°.
Grease 12 muffin cups.
Place raisins in small bowl.
Pour enough boiling water over to cover; let stand 5 minutes.
Drain raisins.
Mix all dry ingredients in a large bowl.
Add oil, pumpkin and eggs; mix just until combined.
Mix in raisins and nuts.
Put in prepared pans; bake about 25 minutes.
recipes.text: Pumpkin Spice Muffins. Preheat oven to 350°. Grease 12 muffin cups. Place raisins in small bowl. Pour enough boiling water over to cover; let stand 5 minutes. Drain raisins. Mix all dry ingredients in a large bowl. Add oil, pumpkin and eggs; mix just until combined. Mix in raisins and nuts. Put in prepared pans; bake about 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Fey Family Fruit Cups
ingredients: 1 c. sliced bananas, sprinkled with lemon juice
sugar (optional for more of a sweet taste)
1/3 c. rum, sherry or apple juice
directions: Choose from the fruits, selecting
a
total
of
6 to 7 cups of fruit.
Mix
fruits, sugar lightly and coconut.
Chill covered. Just before serving, pour liquor or juice over fruit for extra pick up.
Serve in a beautiful bowl.
Makes 10 to 12 servings.
recipes.text: Fey Family Fruit Cups. Choose from the fruits, selecting a total of 6 to 7 cups of fruit. Mix fruits, sugar lightly and coconut. Chill covered. Just before serving, pour liquor or juice over fruit for extra pick up. Serve in a beautiful bowl. Makes 10 to 12 servings.

recipes.title: Oven Fried Fish Fillets
directions: Cut the fillets into serving pieces.
Dip the fillets in milk and roll in the cracker crumbs.
Place on a shallow, well-greased baking pan.
Sprinkle each piece with melted margarine.
Bake in a 500° oven for 10 to 12 minutes or until the fish flakes.
A nice ending is a few minutes before fish is done, place a slice of Swiss cheese on each piece of fish.
recipes.text: Oven Fried Fish Fillets. Cut the fillets into serving pieces. Dip the fillets in milk and roll in the cracker crumbs. Place on a shallow, well-greased baking pan. Sprinkle each piece with melted margarine. Bake in a 500° oven for 10 to 12 minutes or until the fish flakes. A nice ending is a few minutes before fish is done, place a slice of Swiss cheese on each piece of fish.

recipes.title: Cheese Straws
directions: Cream the butter and cheese until soft. Add egg and water. Beat well. Sift flour, salt, cayenne and paprika together.
Add in additions, beating well after each addition.
Chill dough 10 minutes.
Pack into Wearever cooking gun (sawtooth, spritz cookie discs).
Make long strips lengthwise on ungreased Wearever cookie sheet.
Bake 18 to 20 minutes in moderate oven at 350°.
Cut into 3-inch strips.
Yields 8 dozen 3-inch straws when dial is set on thick.
recipes.text: Cheese Straws. Cream the butter and cheese until soft. Add egg and water. Beat well. Sift flour, salt, cayenne and paprika together. Add in additions, beating well after each addition. Chill dough 10 minutes. Pack into Wearever cooking gun (sawtooth, spritz cookie discs). Make long strips lengthwise on ungreased Wearever cookie sheet. Bake 18 to 20 minutes in moderate oven at 350°. Cut into 3-inch strips. Yields 8 dozen 3-inch straws when dial is set on thick.

recipes.title: Corn Pudding Souffle
directions: Melt butter in a 6-inch deep casserole dish.
Beat the rest and pour into dish.
Bake for 45 minutes at 350°.
recipes.text: Corn Pudding Souffle. Melt butter in a 6-inch deep casserole dish. Beat the rest and pour into dish. Bake for 45 minutes at 350°.

recipes.title: Baked Stuffed Fish(Any Type Fish May Be Used)
directions: Sprinkle fish with salt and pepper.
If whole fish, rub cavity with lemon juice.
recipes.text: Baked Stuffed Fish(Any Type Fish May Be Used). Sprinkle fish with salt and pepper. If whole fish, rub cavity with lemon juice.

recipes.title: Super Bean Soup
ingredients: 1 c. thinly sliced, precooked sausage, chicken or turkey (optional)
directions: Open all 6 cans.
Empty into 2-quart kettle.
Heat to boiling. Serve. Delicious quick meal with fresh bread.
recipes.text: Super Bean Soup. Open all 6 cans. Empty into 2-quart kettle. Heat to boiling. Serve. Delicious quick meal with fresh bread.

recipes.title: Non-Cooked Cookies
directions: Heat the first 3 ingredients until melted.
Add remaining ingredients.
Mix well with nuts and coconut.
Drop by teaspoonful on wax paper.
recipes.text: Non-Cooked Cookies. Heat the first 3 ingredients until melted. Add remaining ingredients. Mix well with nuts and coconut. Drop by teaspoonful on wax paper.

recipes.title: Mexican Cornbread
directions: Mix together grated cheese, green pepper, onion and pimento and set aside.
Add sour cream, corn meal, milk, creamed corn, oil and eggs.
Pour meal mixture in half.
Pour in cheese mixture, then other half of meal mixture.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.
