recipes.text: Mexican Cornbread. Mix together grated cheese, green pepper, onion and pimento and set aside. Add sour cream, corn meal, milk, creamed corn, oil and eggs. Pour meal mixture in half. Pour in cheese mixture, then other half of meal mixture. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Whole Glazed Beets
ingredients: 2 c. drained Libby's tiny whole beets
directions: In a saucepan, combine orange marmalade, orange juice, butter and pineapple.
Bring this to a boil, stirring constantly.
Add beets.
Simmer for 5 minutes, stirring until beets are coated with glaze.
recipes.text: Whole Glazed Beets. In a saucepan, combine orange marmalade, orange juice, butter and pineapple. Bring this to a boil, stirring constantly. Add beets. Simmer for 5 minutes, stirring until beets are coated with glaze.

recipes.title: Chocolate Chip Cake
directions: Mix all ingredients except chocolate chips until well beaten, about 2 minutes. Stir in chocolate chips. Pour into greased and floured Bundt pan. Bake at 350° for 45 to 50 minutes. Yield: 14 to 16 servings.
recipes.text: Chocolate Chip Cake. Mix all ingredients except chocolate chips until well beaten, about 2 minutes. Stir in chocolate chips. Pour into greased and floured Bundt pan. Bake at 350° for 45 to 50 minutes. Yield: 14 to 16 servings.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter And Jelly Sandwich Cookies
ingredients: 1/2 c. plus 1 1/2 Tbsp. grape jelly or strawberry jam
directions: Beat margarine and peanut butter at medium speed of an electric mixer until fluffy.
Gradually add sugar.
Beat well. Add egg substitute and vanilla; beat well.
recipes.text: Peanut Butter And Jelly Sandwich Cookies. Beat margarine and peanut butter at medium speed of an electric mixer until fluffy. Gradually add sugar. Beat well. Add egg substitute and vanilla; beat well.

recipes.title: Mashed Potato Bake
directions: Mix mashed potatoes, sour cream, milk and garlic powder.
Spoon 1/2 of mixture into a 2 quart casserole.
Sprinkle with 2/3 c. onions and 1/2 c. cheese.
Top with remaining potato mixture.
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until hot.
Top with remaining onions and cheese.
Bake 5 minutes until onions are golden.
Makes 6 servings.
recipes.text: Mashed Potato Bake. Mix mashed potatoes, sour cream, milk and garlic powder. Spoon 1/2 of mixture into a 2 quart casserole. Sprinkle with 2/3 c. onions and 1/2 c. cheese. Top with remaining potato mixture. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until hot. Top with remaining onions and cheese. Bake 5 minutes until onions are golden. Makes 6 servings.

recipes.title: Quick And Easy Salad
directions: Make dressing as follows:
recipes.text: Quick And Easy Salad. Make dressing as follows:

recipes.title: Vegetarian Chili
ingredients: 2 (16 oz.) cans beans in chili sauce
directions: Heat all ingredients to a boil.
Then let simmer.
Serves 4.
recipes.text: Vegetarian Chili. Heat all ingredients to a boil. Then let simmer. Serves 4.

recipes.title: The Best Hot Chocolate
directions: Mix well.
Store in airtight container.
Fill cup approximately 1/2 full, then fill up with water.
recipes.text: The Best Hot Chocolate. Mix well. Store in airtight container. Fill cup approximately 1/2 full, then fill up with water.

recipes.title: Lemon Lush(New Year'S Day Dessert)
directions: Mix margarine, flour and salt and pat in bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan.
Bake at 350° for 15 minutes.
Cool.
Beat cream cheese until smooth; add powdered sugar and beat again.
Fold in 1 cup Cool Whip.
Spread over crust.
Beat milk with pudding.
Let stand 5 minutes.
Spread over cream cheese mixture.
Top with Cool Whip and nuts.
recipes.text: Lemon Lush(New Year'S Day Dessert). Mix margarine, flour and salt and pat in bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350° for 15 minutes. Cool. Beat cream cheese until smooth; add powdered sugar and beat again. Fold in 1 cup Cool Whip. Spread over crust. Beat milk with pudding. Let stand 5 minutes. Spread over cream cheese mixture. Top with Cool Whip and nuts.

recipes.title: Date Pinwheel Cookies
directions: In saucepan, bring dates, water, 1/2 cup sugar and nuts to a boil.
Boil for 5 minutes.
Cream shortening and rest of sugars. Add eggs and dry ingredients.
Roll dough 1/4 inch thick and spread with date mixture.
Roll in wax paper and chill overnight. Bake at 400°.
recipes.text: Date Pinwheel Cookies. In saucepan, bring dates, water, 1/2 cup sugar and nuts to a boil. Boil for 5 minutes. Cream shortening and rest of sugars. Add eggs and dry ingredients. Roll dough 1/4 inch thick and spread with date mixture. Roll in wax paper and chill overnight. Bake at 400°.

recipes.title: Cabbage Casserole
directions: Melt butter in saucepan.
Add flour and milk; cook until thick.
Add grated cheese.
Place ingredients in layers in dish and bake 1 hour at 300°.
recipes.text: Cabbage Casserole. Melt butter in saucepan. Add flour and milk; cook until thick. Add grated cheese. Place ingredients in layers in dish and bake 1 hour at 300°.

recipes.title: Madeline'S Zucchini Appetizer
directions: Heat oven to 350°.
Grease oblong pan.
Mix all ingredients and spread in pan.
Bake until golden brown, for 25 minutes.
When slightly cooled, cut into small serving pieces.
recipes.text: Madeline'S Zucchini Appetizer. Heat oven to 350°. Grease oblong pan. Mix all ingredients and spread in pan. Bake until golden brown, for 25 minutes. When slightly cooled, cut into small serving pieces.

recipes.title: Taco Dip
ingredients: 1 can whole tomatoes, chopped and drained
directions: In a crock-pot or double boiler, combine all ingredients.
Cook about one hour on low heat or until hot and bubbly.
Serve with tortilla chips.
recipes.text: Taco Dip. In a crock-pot or double boiler, combine all ingredients. Cook about one hour on low heat or until hot and bubbly. Serve with tortilla chips.

recipes.title: Heavenly Hash
directions: Mix the first 4 ingredients well, then add nuts.
Stir lightly to blend nuts.
Chill and serve.
recipes.text: Heavenly Hash. Mix the first 4 ingredients well, then add nuts. Stir lightly to blend nuts. Chill and serve.

recipes.title: Scallop Corn
ingredients: 2 eggs, beaten (I have used Egg Beaters)
directions: Do not drain corn.
Mix all ingredients together thoroughly. Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes in an 11 x 7-inch baking dish. Puffs up and gets crusty on top.
recipes.text: Scallop Corn. Do not drain corn. Mix all ingredients together thoroughly. Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes in an 11 x 7-inch baking dish. Puffs up and gets crusty on top.

recipes.title: Taco Salad
directions: Mix lettuce, cheese, onion, tomatoes and cooled browned hamburger.
Mix taco seasoning and Miracle Whip together.
Mix with rest of salad.
Just before serving cover salad with broken Doritos chips.
recipes.text: Taco Salad. Mix lettuce, cheese, onion, tomatoes and cooled browned hamburger. Mix taco seasoning and Miracle Whip together. Mix with rest of salad. Just before serving cover salad with broken Doritos chips.

recipes.title: St. Paul'S Rice
ingredients: 1 lb. lean sausage, toss and brown
2 pkg. Lipton noodle soup (not chunk style)
1 c. rice, boiled in 4 1/2 c. water for 7 minutes
directions: Mix all ingredients and put in casserole pan.
Sprinkle with paprika.
Bake 1 hour at 350°.
recipes.text: St. Paul'S Rice. Mix all ingredients and put in casserole pan. Sprinkle with paprika. Bake 1 hour at 350°.

recipes.title: Potato Bake
directions: Mix together potatoes, soup, sour cream, salt and pepper. Next add grated cheese and onions.
Put in large flat greased pan. Drizzle margarine over top and sprinkle with bread crumbs.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
recipes.text: Potato Bake. Mix together potatoes, soup, sour cream, salt and pepper. Next add grated cheese and onions. Put in large flat greased pan. Drizzle margarine over top and sprinkle with bread crumbs. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

recipes.title: Vanilla Pudding Or Pie Mix
directions: Mix together egg yolks, cornstarch and 1 cup of milk.
Put 1 1/2 cups of milk and sugar in a kettle and before it comes to a boil, add egg yolks, cornstarch and milk mixture.
Stir until thick, then add margarine and vanilla.
recipes.text: Vanilla Pudding Or Pie Mix. Mix together egg yolks, cornstarch and 1 cup of milk. Put 1 1/2 cups of milk and sugar in a kettle and before it comes to a boil, add egg yolks, cornstarch and milk mixture. Stir until thick, then add margarine and vanilla.

recipes.title: Its Wild Rice
directions: Put a layer of each in a pan; cover with foil.
Bake for 45 minutes at 325°.
Do not look until time is up.
This recipe does not call for wild rice.
recipes.text: Its Wild Rice. Put a layer of each in a pan; cover with foil. Bake for 45 minutes at 325°. Do not look until time is up. This recipe does not call for wild rice.

recipes.title: Corn Bread Taco Bake
directions: In skillet brown meat and drain.
Stir in taco seasoning, water, corn and tomato sauce.
Pour into 2-quart casserole.
In a separate bowl prepare muffin mix according to package directions. Add 1/2 can French fried onions.
Spoon corn muffin mixture around outer edge of casserole.
Bake uncovered at 400° for 20 minutes. Top corn bread with cheese; add remaining onions, baking 2 to 3 minutes longer.
recipes.text: Corn Bread Taco Bake. In skillet brown meat and drain. Stir in taco seasoning, water, corn and tomato sauce. Pour into 2-quart casserole. In a separate bowl prepare muffin mix according to package directions. Add 1/2 can French fried onions. Spoon corn muffin mixture around outer edge of casserole. Bake uncovered at 400° for 20 minutes. Top corn bread with cheese; add remaining onions, baking 2 to 3 minutes longer.

recipes.title: "Chicken Excellent"
ingredients: 3 to 4 chicken breasts, cut in half
1 c. Burgundy wine (American Baptists may not accept)
directions: Place chicken in shallow baking pan.
Mix all other ingredients and pour over chicken.
Cover with foil and refrigerate at least 3 hours.
When ready to bake, spoon sauce over chicken and bake at 375° for 1 1/4 hours, covered with foil.
recipes.text: "Chicken Excellent". Place chicken in shallow baking pan. Mix all other ingredients and pour over chicken. Cover with foil and refrigerate at least 3 hours. When ready to bake, spoon sauce over chicken and bake at 375° for 1 1/4 hours, covered with foil.

recipes.title: Cathedral Windows
directions: Melt chocolate chips and butter in double boiler.
Add beaten egg and let cool.
Fold in marshmallows and nuts.
Turn on wax paper.
Cover with coconut.
Form into 2 1/2-inch roll.
Cover with coconut.
Wrap in wax paper.
Chill and cut into slices.
Can be frozen.
recipes.text: Cathedral Windows. Melt chocolate chips and butter in double boiler. Add beaten egg and let cool. Fold in marshmallows and nuts. Turn on wax paper. Cover with coconut. Form into 2 1/2-inch roll. Cover with coconut. Wrap in wax paper. Chill and cut into slices. Can be frozen.

recipes.title: Quick Spaghetti Sauce
directions: Mix all ingredients in medium saucepan.
Heat over medium heat; bring to boil, then simmer 15 minutes.
recipes.text: Quick Spaghetti Sauce. Mix all ingredients in medium saucepan. Heat over medium heat; bring to boil, then simmer 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Pistachio Supreme
directions: Layer One:
Combine butter, pecans and flour.
Bake 15 to 20 minutes at 350°.
Cool completely.
recipes.text: Pistachio Supreme. Layer One: Combine butter, pecans and flour. Bake 15 to 20 minutes at 350°. Cool completely.

recipes.title: Stew In A Pumpkin(Serves 8 To 10)
ingredients: 2 lb. boneless beef chuck, trimmed and cut into 1 1/2-inch cubes
2 large tomatoes, peeled, seeded and chopped
1 large green bell pepper, seeded and chopped
3 medium white potatoes, peeled and diced
3 medium sweet potatoes, peeled and diced
1 medium pumpkin (about 12 lb.), measured to fit your oven
1 1/2 c. cooked corn, at room temperature
1 tsp. chopped fresh marjoram, or pinch of dried
directions: Heat the oil in a large saucepan or Dutch oven.
Add the onion and cook 1 minute.
Add the garlic and cook until onion is soft, about 8 minutes.
Transfer to a plate and set aside.
Add the meat to the saucepan and saute until browned on all sides.
Add the tomatoes, green pepper, potatoes, salt, pepper, honey, broth and reserved onion.
Heat to boiling.
Reduce heat, cover and simmer gently 1 hour.
recipes.text: Stew In A Pumpkin(Serves 8 To 10). Heat the oil in a large saucepan or Dutch oven. Add the onion and cook 1 minute. Add the garlic and cook until onion is soft, about 8 minutes. Transfer to a plate and set aside. Add the meat to the saucepan and saute until browned on all sides. Add the tomatoes, green pepper, potatoes, salt, pepper, honey, broth and reserved onion. Heat to boiling. Reduce heat, cover and simmer gently 1 hour.
